english: Hello.
Ah, good day to you [milady/sirrah]! Your face is unfamiliar, did you perhaps join us aboard the ship at Lunar Isle?
translation: Ah, size iyi günler ! Yüzünüz tanidik gelmedi, acaba Lunar Adasi'ndaki gemide bize katilmis olabilir misiniz?

english: No, Lokar offered me a lift in Rellekka actually.
translation: Hayir, aslinda Lokar beni Rellekka'ya birakmayi teklif etti.

english: Oh, really? You don't look like a Fremennik to me!
translation: Oh, gercekten mi? Bana bir Fremennik gibi görünmediniz!

english: Well... I kind of am, and I kind of aren't. It's a long story.
translation: Sey... Bir bakima öyleyim, bir bakima da degilim. Bu uzun bir hikaye.

english: Sorry I don't have time to hear it then! See you around young fremennik-who-is-not-really-a-fremennik!
translation: O zaman dinleyecek vaktim olmadigi icin üzgünüm! Görüsürüz genc fremennik-gercekte-fremennik-olmayan!

english: 'Bye.
Aren't you a little short for a pirate?
translation: Bir korsan icin biraz kisa degil misin?

english: My mother was a gnome. Apparently it was a very painful birth.
translation: Annem bir gnomdu. Görünüse göre cok sancili bir dogum olmus.

english: More info than I wanted, thanks!
ARGH! SOUND THE ALARM! STOWAWAY ON BOARD! STOWAWAY ON BOARD!
translation: ARGH! ALARMI CALIN! KACAK YOLCU GEMIDE! KACAK YOLCU GEMIDE!

english: No! I'm not a stowaway! Honest! I was invited here!
translation: Hayir! Ben kacak yolcu degilim! Ben kacak yolcu degilim! Dürüst ol! Buraya davet edildim!

english: Oh, sorry, my mistake then.
translation: Oh, üzgünüm, benim hatam o zaman.

english: You must admit you do look a lot like a stowaway though.
translation: Yine de bir kacak yolcuya cok benzedigini kabul etmelisin.

english: Why, what do they usually look like?
Erm... I've never actually met one...
Okay then...
Brrrr! Its cold up here!
You think this is cold? Up by Acheron it gets so cold that when you talk you see the words freeze in the air in front of you!
translation: Sence burasi soguk mu? Acheron'un yukarisi o kadar soguk olur ki konusurken kelimelerin havada dondugunu görürsün!

english: REALLY?
Nah, not really. I was exaggerating for humourous effect. It is very very cold though!
translation: Hayir, gercekten degil. Espri olsun diye abartiyordum. Yine de cok cok soguk!

english: Hello.
So... You're a pirate, huh?
It's what it says on my pay-packet at the end of the month.
translation: Ay sonunda maas paketimde yazan bu.

english: How's that working out for you?
Pretty good so far. All the grog and loot that we can plunder, plus full medical including dental.
translation: Simdiye kadar oldukca iyi. Yagmalayabilecegimiz kadar icki ve yagma, arti dis dahil tam saglik sigortasi.

english: You mean you have insurance?
Not as such. If any of us get sick we kidnap a doctor and don't let him go until we're better.
translation: Öyle degil. Eger birimiz hastalanirsa bir doktor kaciririz ve iyilesene kadar gitmesine izin vermeyiz.

english: You'd be surprised what an incentive for expert health care that is.
translation: Bunun uzman saglik hizmetleri icin nasil bir tesvik oldugunu bilseniz sasarsiniz.

english: I can imagine.
Hello there. So what brings you aboard the Lady Zay?
translation: Merhaba. Sizi Lady Zay'e getiren nedir?

english: Well, I was planning on visiting the Moon Clan, but I have to say your ship is very impressive.
translation: Ay Klani'ni ziyaret etmeyi planliyordum ama geminizin cok etkileyici oldugunu söylemeliyim.

english: Aye, she's a beauty alright! The Lady Zay has been my home for many hard months, through storm and sun, and she always gets us to here we were headed!

english: Yes, she's certainly one of the finest boats I've seen on my travels!
translation: Evet, kesinlikle seyahatlerimde gördügüm en iyi teknelerden biri!

english: That she is [lad/lass], that she is.
Hello to you too.
Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!
translation: Yar! Biz korsaniz, yar! Avast, seni igrenc karaci lychee!

english: Please don't talk like that, it is extremely irritating.
translation: Lütfen böyle konusma, son derece rahatsiz edici.

english: Also, please don't call me a lychee, whatever that may be.
translation: Ayrica, lütfen bana lici demeyin, ne olursa olsun.

english: Oh. Okay. Sorry.
So how's life as a pirate?
What kind of question is that? How's life as a... I dunno. Whatever it is that you do for a living.
translation: Ne bicim bir soru bu? Hayat nasil... Bilmiyorum. Yasamak icin her ne yapiyorsan.

english: I'm a freelance troubleshooter.
translation: Ben serbest calisan bir sorun gidericiyim.

english: What does that entail then?
Mostly killing things for money and delivering items around the planet for people.
translation: Cogunlukla para icin bir seyleri öldürmek ve insanlar icin gezegenin dört bir yanina esya teslim etmek.

english: I collect stuff.
So how's that life?
Can't complain, can't complain...
Well, there you go.
Sorry, can't stop, the Captain will have my guts for garters if he catches me slacking off talking to the stowaway.

english: You know, I've always wondered what life as a pirate actually entails.

english: There is?
Yes.
What?
Swim.
Oh HA HA. Thanks for the help!

english: My pleasure.
I was being sarcastic.
I know. So was I.

english: I'd like to access my bank account, please.
I'd like to collect items.
I'd like to check my PIN settings.
What is this place?
This is a branch of the Bank of Gielinor. We have branches in many towns.
translation: Burasi Gielinor Bankasi'nin bir subesi. Bircok sehirde subelerimiz var.

english: And what do you do?
We will look after your items and money for you. Leave your valuables with us if you want to keep them safe.
translation: Esyalariniza ve paraniza sizin icin bakacagiz. Degerli esyalarinizi güvende tutmak istiyorsaniz bize birakin.

english: Hi.
How's Cyrisus? Where is he?
He's fine now. Back to full health.
Good, I'm pleased.
No problem.
Don't think that this means I like you now!

english: Look at my face.
Yes? What about it.
Does it look like I care?
Not really.
Well, there you go.
Using the bank

Cyrisus in the mine

Ah, we be building this 'ere tower. Lookin' good ain't it?

english: It does look pretty impressive, but what are you doing hanging around?

english: Tea break, naturally.

english: Fancy some?

english: Well of course, but where's the fun without a few deaths?

english: I think I'll stick to Runelink.

english: Aye, she's a beauty alright! The Lady Zay has been my home for many hard months, through storm and sun, and she always gets us to here we were headed!
translation: Evet, gercekten cok güzel! Lady Zay, firtinalarda ve günesin altinda gecirdigim zorlu aylar boyunca benim evim oldu ve bizi her zaman hedefimize ulastirdi!

english: Yes, she's certainly one of the finest boats I've seen on my travels!
translation: Evet, seyahatlerim sirasinda gördügüm en güzel gemilerden biri!

english: That she is [lad/lass], that she is.
You seem to like playing with danger, there.
They don't call me 'No-fingers' for nothing!
Well, correct me if I'm wrong, but you seem to have all your fingers.
translation: Yaniliyorsam düzelt beni, ama parmaklarin yerinde görünüyor.

english: It may seem that way mate, but I think you'll find I don't have any.
translation: Öyle görünebilir dostum, ama göreceksin ki hic parmagim yok.

english: What?
These not be fingers. These 'ere be wooden fingers.
translation: Bunlar parmak degil. Bunlar tahta parmaklar.

english: Wooden fingers?
Yep.
That's not possible, how could you move them?
translation: Bu imkansiz, onlari nasil hareket ettirebilirsin?

english: Magic wood.
Yes, well I think I'd better be going now.
translation: Evet, sanirim artik gitsem iyi olacak.

english: Hi.
Don't suppose you've seen any boots around here? Size nine, steel toed, brown leather...
translation: Buralarda bir bot görmedin mi? 9 numara, celik burunlu, kahverengi deri...

english: Nope, not at all. I'd best be going. Have a nice day. Bye!
translation: Hayir, hic görmedim. Gitsem iyi olacak. Iyi günler. Hosca kal!

english: Hello.
So how's life as a pirate?
What kind of question is that? How's life as a... I dunno. Whatever it is that you do for a living.
translation: Bu ne bicim bir soru? Nasil gidiyor... Bilmiyorum. Ne is yapiyorsan o.

english: I'm a freelance troubleshooter.
What does that entail then?
Mostly killing things for money and delivering items around the planet for people.
translation: Cogunlukla para karsiliginda bir seyler öldürmek ve insanlar icin gezegenin dört bir yanina esya teslim etmek.

english: I collect stuff.
So how's that life?
Can't complain, can't complain...
Well, there you go.
Aren't you a little short for a pirate?
translation: Korsan icin biraz kisa degil misin?

english: My mother was a gnome. Apparently it was a very painful birth.
translation: Annem bir cüceydi. Anlasilan cok aci verici bir dogum olmus.

english: More info than I wanted, thanks!
Sorry, can't stop, the Captain will have my guts for garters if he catches me slacking off talking to the stowaway.
translation: Üzgünüm, devam edemem, kaptan beni kacak yolcuyla konusurken yakalarsa bagirsaklarimi cikarir.

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard!
translation: Ben kacak yolcu degilim! Gemiye davet edildim!

english: Yeah, whatever [guy/lady], it doesn't really matter who you are I'll get in trouble!
translation: Evet, neyse , kim oldugun önemli degil, basim belaya girecek!

english: You know, I've always wondered what life as a pirate actually entails.
translation: Biliyor musun, korsan olmanin hayati nasil bir sey oldugunu hep merak etmisimdir.

english: Well, at the moment it mostly involves being asked random questions by a stowaway.
translation: Su anda cogunlukla kacak yolcu tarafindan rastgele sorular sorulmakla geciyor.

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard! By Lokar! Ask him!
translation: Ben kacak yolcu degilim! Gemiye davet edildim! Lokar tarafindan! Ona sor!

english: Hey, whatever [love/pal]. Just make sure the captain doesn't catch you, pirates don't like stowaways much.
translation: Hey, neyse . Kaptan seni yakalamasin, korsanlar kacak yolculari pek sevmezler.

english: Ah, good day to you [milady/sirrah]! Your face is unfamiliar, did you perhaps join us aboard the ship at Lunar Isle?
translation: Ah, iyi günler ! Yüzünüz tanidik gelmiyor, Lunar Isle'da gemiye mi bindiniz?

english: No, Lokar offered me a lift in Rellekka actually.
translation: Hayir, Lokar aslinda Rellekka'da beni gemiye davet etti.

english: Oh, really? You don't look like a Fremennik to me!
translation: Oh, gercekten mi? Bana Fremennik gibi görünmüyorsunuz!

english: Well... I kind of am, and I kind of aren't. It's a long story.
translation: Sey... Bir bakima öyleyim, bir bakima degilim. Uzun hikaye.

english: Sorry I don't have time to hear it then! See you around young fremennik-who-is-not-really-a-fremennik!
translation: Üzgünüm, dinleyecek vaktim yok! Görüsürüz, genc Fremennik-ama-aslinda-Fremennik-olmayan!

english: 'Bye.
Brrrr! Its cold up here!
You think this is cold? Up by Acheron it gets so cold that when you talk you see the words freeze in the air in front of you!
translation: Bunun soguk oldugunu mu düsünüyorsun? Acheron'da hava o kadar soguk ki, konustugunda sözcüklerin önündeki havada dondugunu görebilirsin!

english: REALLY?
Nah, not really. I was exaggerating for humourous effect. It is very very cold though!
translation: Hayir, aslinda degil. Komik olsun diye abartiyordum. Ama gercekten cok soguk!

english: Hello to you too.
Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!
translation: Yar! Biz korsaniz, yar! Dur, seni pis kara kurdu!

english: Please don't talk like that, it is extremely irritating.
translation: Lütfen böyle konusma, cok sinir bozucu.

english: Also, please don't call me a lychee, whatever that may be.
translation: Ayrica, lütfen bana ne oldugu belli olmayan bir sey olan “lychee” deme.

english: Oh. Okay. Sorry.
ARGH! SOUND THE ALARM! STOWAWAY ON BOARD! STOWAWAY ON BOARD!

english: No! I'm not a stowaway! Honest! I was invited here!

english: Oh, sorry, my mistake then.
You must admit you do look a lot like a stowaway though.

english: Why, what do they usually look like?
Erm... I've never actually met one...
Okay then...
Hello.
So... You're a pirate, huh?
It's what it says on my pay-packet at the end of the month.
translation: Ay sonunda maas cekimde öyle yaziyor.

english: How's that working out for you?
Pretty good so far. All the grog and loot that we can plunder, plus full medical including dental.
translation: Su ana kadar oldukca iyi. Yagmalayabildigimiz tüm icki ve ganimetler, ayrica dis tedavisi dahil tam saglik sigortasi.

english: You mean you have insurance?
Not as such. If any of us get sick we kidnap a doctor and don't let him go until we're better.

english: You'd be surprised what an incentive for expert health care that is.

Stop! Stop! Humpf...I'll beat you to...urghh...a pulp!
translation: Dur! Dur! Humpf... Seni... urghh... pestil gibi dövecegim!

Why, I oughta...
What do you do when you're not lifting logs above your head?
translation: Kafanin üstüne kütük kaldirmadigin zamanlarda ne yaparsin?

english: In my free time?
Yes.
All sorts. I like...hummff...a good kebab and a cold beer down...urrghh...the pub. And for those quiet evenings...hurrr...

Welcome to the Emir's Arena! Are you interested in 1v1 Tournaments? We organise ranked Tournaments here, or alternatively you can organise your own unranked Tournaments.
translation: Emir'in Arenasina hos geldin! 1v1 Turnuvalari ile ilgileniyor musun? Burada siralamali Turnuvalar düzenliyoruz, ya da alternatif olarak kendi siralamasiz Turnuvalarini düzenleyebilirsin.

english: What's a 1v1 Tournament?

A group of fighters is divided into pairs of opponents, and they all fight their opponent. The winners of those fights proceed to the next round, where they're divided into pairs, and they each fight their new opponent.
translation: Bir grup dövüscü, rakip ciftlere ayrilir ve hepsi rakibiyle dövüsür. Bu dövüslerin galibi bir sonraki tura gecer, burada ciftlere ayrilir ve her biri yeni rakibiyle dövüsür.

english: The number of surviving fighters is halved each time, until eventually only one person is left standing. They're the winner of the Tournament.
translation: Hayatta kalan dövüscülerin sayisi her seferinde yariya indirilir, ta ki sonunda sadece bir kisi kalana kadar. Bu kisi Turnuvanin galibi olur.

english: Ranked or unranked? What does that mean?
translation: Siralamali mi, siralamasiz mi? Bu ne anlama geliyor?

english: Everyone has a rank. It's meant to indicate how good they are at fighting, compared to other people.
translation: Herkesin bir siralamasi vardir. Bu, diger insanlara kiyasla dövüste ne kadar iyi olduklarini gösterir.

english: In ranked fights, the winners gain rank and the losers lose rank. The Arena staff will decide who'll be fighting in each ranked Tournament, and send the invitations.
translation: Siralamali dövüslerde, kazananlar siralamada yükselir, kaybedenler ise siralamada düser. Arena personeli, her siralamali Turnuvada kimin dövüsecegini belirler ve davetiyeleri gönderir.

english: But if you just want some casual fun, you can have an unranked Tournament, where no-one gains or loses rank. You can organise your own unranked Tournament, and decide for yourself who'll fight in it.
translation: Ancak, sadece eglenmek istiyorsaniz, kimsenin siralamada yükselmedigi veya düsmedigi siralamasiz bir Turnuva düzenleyebilirsiniz. Kendi siralamaya dahil olmayan turnuvanizi düzenleyebilir ve kimlerin dövüsecegini kendiniz belirleyebilirsiniz.

english: Only the ranked fights offer access to the other rewards of the Arena.
translation: Sadece siralamaya dahil olan dövüsler Arena'nin diger ödüllerine erisim saglar.

english: How do I get invited into a Tournament?
You'll need to sign up to a recruitment group...
translation: Bir ise alim grubuna kaydolmaniz gerekir...

english: You can carry on with your adventures while you're waiting for a Tournament to begin, since it may be a while before suitable fighters are available.
translation: Uygun dövüscüler bulunana kadar biraz zaman gecebileceginden, turnuvanin baslamasini beklerken maceralariniza devam edebilirsiniz.

english: I want to organise my own Tournament.
Just use my Recruitment Board here to form your own recruitment group. Once you've got one, wait for other fighters to join it.
translation: Buradaki Ise Alim Panomu kullanarak kendi ise alim grubunu olusturabilirsin. Grubu olusturduktan sonra, diger dövüscülerin gruba katilmasini bekle.

english: Okay, goodbye.
I'm okay, thanks.

Ranked or unranked? What does that mean?

Okay, goodbye.

Are you all right?
Who goes there?
Arr! A landlubber!
Begone afore I take my cutlass to ye! I've been charged with guardin' this gate and no noodle-armed landlubbers will make it past me alive!
translation: Kilicimi cekmeden git buradan! Bu kapiyi korumakla görevlendirildim ve hicbir kollarini kullanamayan kara adam benden canli gecemez!

english: That's not a cutlass.
I think it's a twig.
Ye cheeky begger! I was wavin' my finger at ye!
translation: Seni küstah dilenci! Sana parmagimi salliyordum!

english: All right...
Arrr... just 'cos me body happens to be 50% wood does not mean I'm heartless.
translation: Arrr... Vücudumun %50'si tahtadan olusuyor diye kalpsiz oldugum anlamina gelmez.

english: I got a bag of 'em here. Wanna see?
translation: Burada bir torba dolusu var. Görmek ister misin?

english: I think I'll pass.
What happened to you?
That be a tale so heart-wrenchin' that it has so far wrenched the hearts from over a dozen sturdier men than thee!
translation: Bu, o kadar yürek burkan bir hikaye ki, su ana kadar senden daha saglam bir düzineden fazla erkegin kalbini parcaladi!

english: A tale of such woe that none but the stoniest hearts can hear it without sheddin' a single, poignant tear...
translation: O kadar acikli bir hikaye ki, en tas kalpli olanlar bile dinlerken tek bir gözyasi bile dökmeden duramaz...

english: And I'll never tell ye, not even if ye wore an item, such as a ring, with powers of mind control!
translation: Ve sana asla anlatmayacagim, zihin kontrolü gücü olan bir yüzük gibi bir sey taksan bile!

english: What if I said please?
Hmmmm...well alright...
Wait, no!
Get goin' landlubber before I take my splintery foot to yer behind!
translation: Git buradan denizci, yoksa kicina kiymik dolu ayagimi sokarim!

english: Well ye seem like a [lad/lass] that can handle such a tale...so I'll tell ye...
translation: Sen böyle bir hikayeyi kaldirabilecek bir  gibi görünüyorsun... o yüzden sana anlatacagim...

english: Well, it all starts with this albatross...
Wait, never mind, I'll skip forward a bit.
translation: Dur, bos ver, biraz ileri sarayim.

english: Are you sure?
I have to [lad/lass], Cap'n Donnie will flay what little is left of me if I told ye.
translation: Söylemem gerekirse, Kaptan Donnie benden geriye kalanlari da parcalar.

english: But anyway, I got recruited to the zombie pirates along with the rest of the crew in an unspecified incident involvin this albatross.
translation: Ama neyse, bu albatrosla ilgili belirsiz bir olayda, mürettebatin geri kalaniyla birlikte zombi korsanlara katildim.

english: We was sailin' along happily, and I was partakin' of a little 'rum' in the crows nest.
translation: Mutlu mesut seyrediyorduk ve ben de güverteye cikmis biraz rom iciyordum.

english: Well, we hit either a really rough wave or some rocks.
translation: Sonra ya cok sert bir dalgaya ya da kayaliklara carptik.

english: Twas kind of hard for me to tell which, as I was well out of it by then!
translation: O sirada kafam cok iyi olmadigi icin hangisi oldugunu anlamak zordu!

english: Regardless I toppled from the crows nest into the water.
translation: Her neyse, güvercin yuvasindan suya düstüm.

english: Is that how you got so badly injured?
translation: Bu yüzden mi bu kadar agir yaralandin?

english: No [lad/lass]!
What happened next was that I discovered a new, previously uncharted reef of hard, spiky coral.
translation: Sonra, daha önce haritalanmamis, sert ve sivri uclu mercanlardan olusan yeni bir resif kesfettim.

english: I made a mental note of its location, and to this day it is still marked on our fleet's charts as Lukes Reef.
translation: Konumunu zihnimde not ettim ve bugüne kadar filomuzun haritalarinda Lukes Reef olarak isaretli duruyor.

english: I managed to grab a hold of our ship, the Inebriated, as it passed overhead.
translation: Üzerimden gecen gemimiz Inebriated'a tutunmayi basardim.

english: And then I discovered another, taller, spikier reef of even sharper and more painful coral.
translation: Sonra daha yüksek, daha sivri ve daha keskin ve daha aci veren mercanlardan olusan baska bir resif kesfettim.

english: To this day it is still marked on our fleet's charts as The Other 50% Reef.
translation: Bugüne kadar filomuzun haritalarinda The Other 50% Reef olarak isaretli duruyor.

english: Owwwwwwwww...
It gets worse...
When they hauled what was left of me on deck, they dropped me onto the floor while they decided what to do with me.
translation: Geriye kalanlarimi güverteye cikardiklarinda, benimle ne yapacaklarina karar verirken beni yere attilar.

english: Bear in mind this would be on a ghost ship, the planks of which sweat a thick mixture of stagnant water...and pure salt crystals.
translation: Bunun bir hayalet gemide oldugunu unutmayin, geminin tahtalari durgun su ve saf tuz kristallerinden olusan kalin bir karisimla terliyordu.

english: Oh...my...god...
But on the good side, all my thrashin' and pained squealin' settled the matter in the Captain's mind, and he had the shipwright carve me half a body out of his Witchwood Planks.
translation: Ama iyi tarafi, tüm cirpinislarim ve aci dolu cigliklarim kaptanin kararini verdi ve gemi ustasina Witchwood Planks'tan bana yarim bir vücut yapmasini söyledi.

english: Witchwood? What's that?
Tis a special, magical wood from a now extinct tree.
translation: Artik soyu tükenmis bir agactan elde edilen özel, sihirli bir agactir.

english: Once they nailed it all in place the stuff moves like it is part of me body.
translation: Her seyi yerine civiledikten sonra, bu malzeme vücudumun bir parcasi gibi hareket ediyor.

english: The stuff will also grow back if it breaks, which is dead handy!
translation: Ayrica kirilirsa tekrar büyür, ki bu cok kullanislidir!

english: Wow, that stuff must be very valuable!
translation: Vay canina, bu malzeme cok degerli olmali!

english: Arr! That it be!
So, that be the tale of how I managed to lose precisely 50% of my body.
translation: Iste, vücudumun tam olarak %50'sini nasil kaybettigimin hikayesi bu.

english: There there.
So how flammable are you?
What kind of a question is that?
A rather rude, personal one?
translation: Oldukca kaba ve kisisel bir soru mu?

english: Ye've got that right!
I'll soon have you out of the way! Burn!
Don't make me angry! Ye'll not like me when I'm angry!
Let that be a lesson to ye!
My world is an ocean of paaaain!
translation: Benim dünyam aci dolu bir okyanus!

english: So what is going on here anyway?
Ye expect me to talk?
No Mr. Luke, I expect you to die!
Hah! I'm one step ahead of ye!
Egad, outsmarted by the man with the wooden brain.
translation: Tanrim, tahta beyinli adam tarafindan alt edildim.

english: But seriously, what is going on here?
I can't tell ye [lad/lass].
The Cap'n would have me whittled down to toothpicks if I did.
translation: Söylersem kaptan beni kibrit cöpü gibi parcalar.

english: Well if you can't tell me, perhaps you could show me through the medium of Interpretive Dance?
translation: Söyleyemiyorsan, belki yorumlu dans yoluyla gösterebilirsin?

english: No. Just...no.
Mime?
Look, [lad/lass] I'm not tellin' ye a thing! So clear out while ye still can!
translation: Bak, sana hicbir sey söylemeyecegim! Hala vaktin varken git buradan!

english: Arr! Tryin' ter get away eh? Well ye'll never sneak past me, I'm the best lookout this crew has ever seen!
translation: Arr! Kacmaya mi calisiyorsun? Benden asla kacamazsin, ben bu mürettebatin gördügü en iyi gözcü!

english: Who's that making faces behind you?
That is the most amazing thing I have ever seen!
Is that your distraction?
translation: Bu senin dikkat dagitma taktigin mi?

english: Who is that behind you?
Hey you! Look over there!
Oh my! Is that a genuine 3rd Age Diversion?
translation: Aman Tanrim! Bu gercek bir 3. Cag Dikkat Dagitici mi?

english: Where?
Hey! What are you doing out there?
Nothing.
Well Cap'n Donnie said no livin' landlubbers were allowed out of the compound.
translation: Kaptan Donnie, yasayan kara adamlarinin tesisten cikmasina izin verilmedigini söyledi.

english: So get yerself back in here, or yer for it!
translation: O yüzden hemen geri dön, yoksa basin belaya girer!

english: What happened to you?
How flammable are you?
So what is going on here anyway?
Hi!
Hi. How can I help?
Can you heal me?
Sorry, I'm not on duty.
PLEASE DON'T KILL ME!
I was... looking to be healed.
No way, I'm out of here just as soon as I've packed up my stuff!
translation: Olmaz, esyalarimi toplar toplamaz buradan gidiyorum!

english: You look healthy to me!
Of course!
Do you see a lot of injured fighters?
translation: Cok fazla yarali savasci görüyor musun?

english: Yes I do. Thankfully we can cope with almost anything. Jaraah really is a wonderful surgeon, his methods are a little unorthodox but he gets the job done.
translation: Evet, görüyorum. Neyse ki neredeyse her seyle basa cikabiliyoruz. Jaraah gercekten harika bir cerrah, yöntemleri biraz alisilmadik ama isini iyi yapiyor.

english: I shouldn't tell you this but his nickname is 'The Butcher'.
translation: Sana bunu söylememem gerekir ama lakabi “Kasap”.

english: That's reassuring.
Do you come here often?
I work here, so yes!
You're silly!
Can you heal me?
Do you see a lot of injured fighters?
translation: Cok fazla yarali savasci görüyor musun?

english: Do you come here often?
Greetings traveller.
Can you heal me? I'm injured.
Ok.
Abbot Langley places his hands on your head. You feel a little better.
translation: Abbot Langley ellerini basina koyar. Kendini biraz daha iyi hissedersin.

english: Isn't this place built a bit out of the way?
translation: Burasi biraz uzak bir yere insa edilmemis mi?

english: We like it that way actually! We get disturbed less. We still get rather a large amount of travellers looking for sanctuary and healing here as it is!
translation: Aslinda biz böyle seviyoruz! Böylelikle daha az rahatsiz ediliyoruz. Zaten burada siginak ve sifa arayan cok sayida gezgin var!

english: How do I get further into the monastery?
I'm sorry but only members of our order are allowed in the second level of the monastery.
translation: Üzgünüm ama manastirin ikinci katina sadece tarikatimizin üyeleri girebilir.

english: Well can I join your order?
No. I am sorry, but I feel you are not devout enough.
translation: Hayir. Üzgünüm ama yeterince dindar olmadigini düsünüyorum.

english: You need a prayer level of 31 to join the order.
translation: Tarikatimiza katilmak icin 31. seviye dua seviyesi gerekiyor.

english: Ok, I see you are someone suitable for our order. You may join.
translation: Tamam, tarikatimiza uygun biri oldugunuzu görüyorum. Katilabilirsiniz.

english: Oh, sorry.
I might be able to... What did you have in mind?
Can you remove the sigils from my spirit shields?
I think I shoud be able to manage that. However in doing so, I'm afraid I'll have to destroy the blessed shield itself. You'll only get the sigil back.
translation: Bunu yapabilirim sanirim. Ancak bunu yaparken, kutsanmis kalkani yok etmek zorunda kalacagim. Sadece mührü geri alacaksin.

english: I can go ahead and break down all of the shields in your inventory now if you'd like?.
translation: Istersen, envanterindeki tüm kalkanlari simdi parcalayabilirim.

english: Not right now.
Only members of our order can go up there.
Oh, sorry.
Ah, I was told to expect you, please take this as thanks!
translation: Ah, seni beklemem söylendi, lütfen bunu tesekkür olarak kabul et!

english: Congratulations, traveller!
Hey, I have something for you but you don't have any space for it!
translation: Hey, sana bir seyim var ama bunun icin yerin yok!

english: Here you go.
You are handed a torn part of a clue scroll.
translation: Sana bir ipucu parsömeninin yirtik bir parcasi verilir.

english: I must say, I despise the equipment you have chosen to wear.
I've got a message for you from your friend in Draynor Village.
translation: Draynor Köyü'ndeki arkadasindan sana bir mesaj var.

english: Gosh, you are very kind to bring a message to my remote monastery!
translation: Vay canina, uzak manastirima mesaj getirmekle cok naziksin!

english: I'd give you a reward, but you don't seem to have any space for it. Come back when you do.
translation: Sana bir ödül vermek isterdim ama bunun icin yerin yok gibi görünüyor. Yer acildiginda tekrar gel.

english: I grow a few herbs in my little cabbage patch; please take some as a sign of my gratitude.
translation: Kücük lahana tarlamda birkac bitki yetistiriyorum; minnettarligimin bir göstergesi olarak lütfen biraz alin.

english: Allow me to bestow on you Saradomin's blessings...
translation: Size Saradomin'in kutsamalarini bahsetmeme izin verin...

english: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
Isn't this place built a bit out of the way?
translation: Burasi biraz uzak bir yere insa edilmemis mi?

english: How do I get further into the monastery?
Well can I join your order?
Can you help with spirit shields?
translation: Ruh kalkanlari konusunda yardimci olabilir misiniz?

english: Yes.
No.
Herbs
Coins
Runes
Seeds
Prayer experience
Grr ... Get out of my way...
What can I help you with, dear?
Who are you and what are you doing?
I'm Abigaila, from Morytania. It's a terrible place, run by the vampyres. They visit the towns and collect everyone's blood for food!
translation: Ben Abigaila, Morytania'dan. Orasi vampirlerin yönettigi korkunc bir yer. Kasabalari ziyaret edip herkesin kanini yiyecek olarak topluyorlar!

english: I tried for years to escape, with my son, Suro, to make a better life for ourselves in Misthalin. I scraped together enough money to bribe a boatman to get us out.
translation: Oglum Suro ile birlikte Misthalin'de daha iyi bir hayat kurmak icin yillarca kacmaya calistim. Bizi oradan cikarmak icin bir tekneciye rüsvet vermek icin yeterli parayi bir araya getirdim.

english: The journey was tough. Some men in pink hoods attacked our boat, shouting at us to go back where we belonged, and to keep out of their country. In the struggle, the boat overturned.
translation: Yolculuk zorluydu. Pembe baslikli bazi adamlar teknemize saldirdi, bize ait oldugumuz yere geri dönmemizi ve ülkelerinden uzak durmamizi bagirarak. Mücadele sirasinda tekne devrildi.

english: It was dark, and I couldn't find Suro in the water. I swam as deep as I could, until my lungs screamed, but I couldn't find him. He wasn't good at swimming.
translation: Karanlikti ve suda Suro'yu bulamadim. Cigerlerim patlayana kadar yüzebildigim kadar yüzdüm ama onu bulamadim. O yüzmede iyi degildi.

english: Eventually I got myself to the shore. The sun was rising, and I found Suro there. On the shore, where the water had dumped his... body.
translation: Sonunda kiyiya ulastim. Günes doguyordu ve Suro'yu orada buldum. Kiyida, suyun onun... cesedini attigi yerde.

english: *sob*
I've done alright in Misthalin, I guess. I know a bit of magic, and the local gentry pay me well for my scrying skills. I'm good at turning a profit on Grand Exchange trades too.
translation: Misthalin'de iyi idare ediyorum sanirim. Biraz sihir biliyorum ve yerel soylular benim kehanet yeteneklerim icin bana iyi para ödüyorlar. Grand Exchange ticaretinde de kar elde etmekte iyiyim.

english: Anyway, I'm able to rent a room in Lumbridge, and to buy food. I'm not being a burden on anyone, and there are no vampyres coming for my blood.
translation: Her neyse, Lumbridge'de bir oda kiralayabiliyorum ve yiyecek alabiliyorum. Kimseye yük olmuyorum ve kanimi emmek icin gelen vampirler de yok.

english: I am free!
But I haven't forgotten my people in the east. There's one vampyre there who runs a place she calls the Theatre of Blood, challenging humans to face monsters in her arena.
translation: Ama dogudaki halkimi unutmadim. Orada, Theatre of Blood adini verdigi bir yer isleten ve insanlari arenasinda canavarlarla yüzlesmeye davet eden bir vampir var.

english: My husband went there, trying to win freedom from the blood-gatherers by surviving her arena, but he never returned. No-one does.
translation: Kocam, arenada hayatta kalarak kan toplayicilarindan kurtulmak icin oraya gitti, ama bir daha geri dönmedi. Kimse dönmüyor.

english: So now I pass my spare time scrying on the Theatre of Blood, watching other adventurers there. You can have a look, if you like.
translation: Simdi bos zamanlarimi Kan Tiyatrosu'nu izleyerek, oradaki diger maceracilari seyrederek geciriyorum. Istersen sen de bakabilirsin.

english: I'd like to look in your scrying ball.
I'm afraid I can't let you use my scrying ball now, dear. Clear out everything you're carrying, and make sure you're not sick or poisoned.
translation: Korkarim ki su anda kristal kürelerimi kullanmana izin veremem, canim. Üzerinde tasidigin her seyi cikar ve hasta ya da zehirli olmadigindan emin ol.

english: I'll leave you be.
Who are you and what are you doing?
I'd like to look in your scrying ball.
Observe a specific party
Observe recent party
Cancel
I'll leave you be.
Help! Help!
What has happened here?
We were invited to a house party on an island not far from here... Something felt wrong about the whole thing but we went anyway...
translation: Buraya yakin bir adada bir ev partisine davet edildik... Her seyde bir terslik vardi ama yine de gittik...

english: The house seemed pretty creepy, but everything was going fine, we were all having a good time...
translation: Ev oldukca ürkütücü görünüyordu, ama her sey yolunda gidiyordu, hepimiz iyi vakit geciriyorduk...

english: ...and that's when we got attacked...
I... I tried to save her...
Hewey bought me enough time to find an old boat. I went back to get him but it was too late. I'm scared that he won't make it.
translation: Hewey bana eski bir tekne bulmam icin yeterince zaman kazandirdi. Onu almaya geri döndüm ama cok gecti. Kurtulamayacagindan korkuyorum.

english: You have to do something... they can't get away with this!
translation: Bir seyler yapmalisin... Bu isten pacayi kurtaramazlar!

english: What do you want me to do?
I'm not getting involved in this!
That psycho is still out there, you have to bring them to justice.
translation: O psikopat hala disarida, onu adalete teslim etmelisin.

english: The boat we escaped on is just over there, you can use it to get to the island.
translation: Kactigimiz tekne surada, onu kullanarak adaya ulasabilirsin.

english: Okay, I'll see what I can do.
Please, you need to make sure they don't get away with this! You can use the boat over there to get to the island we escaped from.
translation: Lütfen, bu isten pacayi kurtarmamalarini saglamalisin! Kactigimiz adaya gitmek icin suradaki tekneyi kullanabilirsin.

english: Urgh...I think I may have underestimated you.
You've lost at your own game. And now it is time to see who you really are under that mask!
translation: Kendi oyununda kaybettin. Ve simdi o maskenin altinda gercekte kim oldugunu görme zamani!

english: The player unmasks the killer, revealing Abigale as the culprit.
translation: Oyuncu katilin maskesini cikarir ve Abigale'in suclu oldugunu ortaya cikarir.

english: No! You!? But why!? Why on earth would you kill all your friends!? Why beg me to come here to help them!?
translation: Hayir! Sen mi!? Ama neden!? Neden tüm arkadaslarini öldürdün!? Neden buraya gelip onlara yardim etmem icin yalvardin!?

english: You just don't get it do you?
So big headed. So used to it all being about you. About you saving the day.
translation: Cok kibirli. Her seyin seninle ilgili olmasina alismissin. Her seyi senin kurtarmana.

english: Well I'm sick of it!
What do you mean?
Adventurers! You're all the same. Everything always has to be about you.
translation: Maceracilar! Hepiniz aynisiniz. Her sey her zaman sizinle ilgili olmak zorunda.

english: I don't understand?
Of course you wouldn't! Because you can't see past yourself!
translation: Tabii ki anlamazsin! Cünkü kendinden ötesini göremezsin!

english: Believe it or not... I used to be like you.
translation: Ister inan ister inanma... Ben de eskiden senin gibiydim.

english: I'd hear about some damsel in distress and go to help. To have my moment. For me to be the hero, just for once.
translation: Tehlikede olan bir kiz duydugumda yardima giderdim. Kendi animi yasamak icin. Bir kez olsun kahraman olmak icin.

english: But YOU! You and every other darned adventurer! Every time I get there to help, it's too late. Crisis solved. Disaster averted. Reward claimed. Every time you and those other adventurers steal my moment!
translation: Ama SEN! Sen ve diger tüm lanet maceracilar! Her yardim etmeye gittigimde, cok gec kalmis oluyorum. Kriz cözülmüs. Felaket önlenmis. Ödül alinmis. Her seferinde sen ve diger maceracilar benim animi caliyor!

english: But not this time!
This time, it is all about me! I'm the star of the show! ME ME ME ME ME!
translation: Bu sefer her sey benimle ilgili! Gösterinin yildizi benim! BEN BEN BEN BEN BEN!

english: Well not any longer. The show is over, and there will be no curtain call.
translation: Artik degil. Gösteri bitti ve perde kapanmayacak.

english: Oh, but there is always a curtain call.
translation: Oh, ama perde her zaman kapanir.

english: Another killer comes out of the closest near the door.
translation: Kapinin yanindaki dolaptan baska bir katil cikar.

english: What!? How!? There was another killer!?
translation: Ne!? Nasil!? Baska bir katil mi vardi!?

english: Of course. Every good show needs a good supporting actor. Now, take off your mask darling. Take a bow. You have earned it.
translation: Elbette. Her iyi dizide iyi bir yardimci oyuncu gerekir. Simdi maskeni cikar sevgilim. Selam ver. Bunu hak ettin.

english: Of course, my love.
The killer unmasks himself, revealing Hewey as the culprit.
translation: Katil maskesini cikarir ve Hewey'in suclu oldugunu ortaya cikarir.

english: You!? But how!? You were almost dead when I saw you! I saw your wounds!
translation: Sen mi!? Ama nasil!? Seni gördügümde neredeyse ölmüstün! Yaralarini gördüm!

english: No, what you watched was what we wanted you to watch. A masterful performance if I do say myself.
translation: Hayir, senin gördügün sey bizim senin görmeni istedigimiz seydi. Kendim söyleyeyim, ustaca bir performansdi.

english: But what is in this for you?
translation: Peki bunun sana ne faydasi var?

english: Everyone loves the limelight, and who better to share it with than my beloved Abigale.
translation: Herkes ilgiyi sever ve bunu sevgili Abigale'den daha iyi kimle paylasabilirim ki?

english: But your friends?
They didn't deserve to die!
Perhaps not, but neither did I deserve to be cast back into the shadows when I deserve the spotlight!
translation: Belki hak etmediler, ama ben de ilgiyi hak ettigim halde gölgelere geri atilmayi hak etmedim!

english: Yes, while we deserve the spotlight.
translation: Evet, biz spot isigini hak ediyoruz.

english: And now I have my starring role!
OUR starring role.
Gielinor will forever remember this night and what I have done here.
translation: Gielinor bu geceyi ve burada yaptiklarimi sonsuza kadar hatirlayacak.

english: No, what WE have done!
Quiet Hewey! This is my moment!
translation: Sessiz ol Hewey! Bu benim anim!

english: No, this is supposed to be our moment! It isn't just all about you either! We were in this together!
translation: Hayir, bu bizim animiz olmali! Bu sadece seninle ilgili degil! Biz bu iste birlikteydik!

english: Stop ruining this Hewey! I have worked so hard for this and I'm not going to let you take it away from me!
translation: Bunu mahvetmeyi birak Hewey! Bunun icin cok calistim ve bunu benden almana izin vermeyecegim!

english: Well I'm not going to be pushed aside either, we were both in this as equals!
translation: Ben de kenara itilmeyecegim, ikimiz de esit olarak bu isin icindeydik!

english: We were never equals! How could you possibly compare to me!?
translation: Asla esit olmadik! Sen benimle nasil kiyaslanabilirsin ki?

english: You egotistical, selfish...
Abigale stabs Hewey.
No...my love...
Hewey dies.
No....no...what have I done!?
It wasn't supposed to be like this...but you just couldn't let me have my moment. WHY HEWEY WHY!? I loved you...
translation: Böyle olmamaliydi... ama sen benim animi yasamama izin vermedin. NEDEN HEWEY NEDEN!? Seni seviyordum...

english: This could be my chance to take advantage of the situation...
translation: Bu durumdan yararlanmak icin bir firsat olabilir...

english: The player stabs Abigale.
Well thank Saradomin that's over! I should get out of here.
translation: Saradomin'e sükürler olsun ki bitti! Buradan gitmeliyim.

english: You'll never escape me!
In the background, Mandy gets up.
You dare try and ruin my moment!
Mandy walks toward the Bandos godsword on the table.
translation: Mandy masanin üzerindeki Bandos tanri kilicina dogru yürür.

english: Hewey is dead because of you!
Mandy picks up the Bandos godsword and enters the closet.
translation: Mandy Bandos tanri kilicini alir ve dolaba girer.

english: Now it is time for you to join him!
Mandy comes out of the closet behind Mandy.
You're not killing anyone else!
Mandy uses the sword's special attack on Abigale.
translation: Mandy, kilicin özel saldirisini Abigale'e kullanir.

english: No....this can't be it....
Abigale dies.
Wow, that was close!
Mandy, how are you alive!? I watched you get stabbed through the heart!
translation: Mandy, nasil hayattasin? Kalbinden bicaklandigini gördüm!

english: I did get stabbed, but I was born with a rare condition called Dextrocardia.
translation: Bicaklandim, ama dogustan Dextrocardia adli nadir bir rahatsizligim var.

english: Dextrowhat?
Dextrocardia. It means that my heart is on the right side of my chest, not the left like most people.
translation: Dextrocardia. Bu, kalbimin cogu insan gibi sol tarafta degil, sag tarafta oldugu anlamina geliyor.

english: So when the killer thought they stabbed you in the heart, they actually missed?
translation: Yani katil seni kalbinden bicakladigini sandiginda, aslinda iskalamis mi oldu?

english: Well, missed the heart yes.
I did still get stabbed though, and am actually feeling pretty woozy...
translation: Yine de bicaklandim ve aslinda kendimi oldukca sersemlemis hissediyorum...

english: Oh, yes, right! You should go sort yourself out!
translation: Oh, evet, dogru! Gidip kendini toparlamalisin!

english: I will wait outside the house after seeing to this stab wound. You should come talk to me there.
translation: Bu bicak yarasini tedavi ettikten sonra evin disinda bekleyecegim. Oraya gelip benimle konusmalisin.

english: What has happened here?
What do you want me to do?
I'm not getting involved.
[House owner] killed an abyssal demon! Cool!
translation: [Ev sahibi] bir abyssal iblisi öldürdü! Harika!

english: Cool for [him/her] maybe. How would you like to be stuck on a wall?
translation: Belki onun icin harika. Duvara yapisik kalmak ister miydin?

english: Have you considered visitingTHE ABYSS?
translation: THE ABYSS'i ziyaret etmeyi düsündün mü?

english: I visit the abyss all the time!
I bet you just rush through it though. Everyone there is in such a rush. No one stops to appreciate the beauty ofTHE ABYSS.
translation: Ama eminim aceleyle geciyorsundur. Oradaki herkes cok aceleci. Kimse THE ABYSS'in güzelligini takdir etmek icin durmuyor.

english: I have to run through it quickly or I'll die!
Death is a small thing compared to the beauty ofTHE ABYSS.
translation: Ölüm, THE ABYSS'in güzelligine kiyasla önemsiz bir sey.

english: The abyss looks pretty ugly to me.
Poor deluded fool. There is no hope for you at all.
translation: Zavalli, aldanmis aptal. Senin icin hic umut yok.

english: It's too scary for me!
But does not the fear contribute to your appreciation ofTHE ABYSS?
translation: Ama korku, ABYSS'i takdir etmene katkida bulunmuyor mu?

english: No, it's just scary.
Poor human. You must not judgeTHE ABYSSby the standards of this world. You must learn to embrace your fear as part of the experience ofTHE ABYSS.

english: Hello. Who are you?
I'm the Account Guide. I'm here to tell you about your account.
translation: Ben Hesap Rehberi'yim. Sana hesabin hakkinda bilgi vermek icin buradayim.

english: What's an account?
Your character IS your account! It's what you are using to play the game right now. Everyone here has one and some people even have multiple!
translation: Karakterin senin hesabindir! Su anda oyunu oynamak icin kullandigin sey. Buradaki herkesin bir hesabi var, hatta bazilarinin birden fazla hesabi var!

english: There’s various things you can do with your account which is where the Account Management menu comes into play. Let’s take a look at it now.
translation: Hesabinizla yapabileceginiz cesitli seyler var ve burada Hesap Yönetimi menüsü devreye giriyor. Simdi bir göz atalim.

english: As you can see, there's a few things you can do with your account.
translation: Gördügünüz gibi, hesabinizla yapabileceginiz birkac sey var.

english: First, you have membership. All accounts are free to play by default but if you desire, you can buy membership to unlock members' worlds. These worlds give you access to extra skills, areas, quests, and more!
translation: Ilk olarak, üyelik var. Tüm hesaplar varsayilan olarak ücretsizdir, ancak isterseniz üyelik satin alarak üye dünyalarinin kilidini acabilirsiniz. Bu dünyalar size ekstra beceriler, alanlar, görevler ve daha fazlasina erisim saglar!

english: What's a world?

A world is what you play the game on. Most worlds can hold up to 2000 players. They are split into two main types: free worlds and members' worlds. You can swap worlds with the World Switcher in the Logout menu.
translation: Dünya, oyunu oynadiginiz yerdir. Cogu dünya 2000 oyuncuya kadar alabilir. Iki ana türe ayrilirlar: ücretsiz dünyalar ve üye dünyalari. Oturumu kapatma menüsündeki Dünya Degistirici ile dünyalar arasinda gecis yapabilirsiniz.

english: You are currently on a free world. If you want to switch to a members’ world and enjoy all of the benefits, you’ll need to purchase membership. You can do so using the store in the Account Management menu.
translation: Su anda ücretsiz bir dünyadasiniz. Üye dünyasina gecmek ve tüm avantajlardan yararlanmak istiyorsaniz, üyelik satin almaniz gerekir. Bunu, Hesap Yönetimi menüsündeki magazayi kullanarak yapabilirsiniz.

english: You are currently on a members' world so you already have access to everything that being a member has to offer. Enjoy!
translation: Su anda bir üye dünyasindasiniz, bu nedenle üyelik avantajlarindan zaten yararlanabilirsiniz. Keyfini cikarin!

english: Bonds are another thing that you should know about. You can purchase Bonds from the store in the Account Management menu. Once you have some Bonds, you can redeem them for membership!
translation: Tahviller de bilmeniz gereken baska bir konudur. Tahvilleri, Hesap Yönetimi menüsündeki magazadan satin alabilirsiniz. Tahvil sahibi oldugunuzda, bunlari üyelik icin kullanabilirsiniz!

english: But why would I use a Bond instead of just buying membership normally?
translation: Peki neden normal sekilde üyelik satin almak yerine tahvil kullanayim?

english: Unlike membership, Bonds can be traded with other players. You could purchase a Bond and then sell it to another player for some gold. Alternatively, you could use your gold to buy a Bond from another player!
translation: Üyelikten farkli olarak, tahviller diger oyuncularla takas edilebilir. Bir tahvil satin alip baska bir oyuncuya altin karsiliginda satabilirsiniz. Alternatif olarak, altinlarinizi baska bir oyuncudan tahvil satin almak icin kullanabilirsiniz!

english: So if I used my gold to buy a Bond from another player, I could get membership without spending any real money?
translation: Yani altinlarimi baska bir oyuncudan tahvil satin almak icin kullanirsam, gercek para harcamadan üyelik alabilir miyim?

english: Exactly!
Next up, you have your inbox and name changer. The inbox is where you’ll receive important information related to your account and the game. Be sure to keep an eye on it.
translation: Sirada, gelen kutunuz ve isim degistirici var. Gelen kutusu, hesabiniz ve oyunla ilgili önemli bilgileri alacaginiz yerdir. Gözünüzü üzerinde tutun.

english: The name changer allows you to change your display name if you don't like your current one. Be aware though that this is only available to accounts with membership.
translation: Isim degistirici, mevcut isminizi begenmezseniz, görüntülenen isminizi degistirmenize olanak tanir. Ancak bunun sadece üyeligi olan hesaplar icin gecerli oldugunu unutmayin.

english: Finally, the bottom of the menu has some links which you might find useful. Make sure you check them out at some point.
translation: Son olarak, menünün altinda yararli bulabileceginiz bazi baglantilar var. Bunlari mutlaka bir ara kontrol edin.

english: Awesome. Is there anything else I should know about accounts?
translation: Harika. Hesaplar hakkinda bilmem gereken baska bir sey var mi?

english: Your account is very valuable and it's important you look after it. Various tools can help with this, such as Bank PINs and two-factor authentication options.
translation: Hesabiniz cok degerlidir ve ona iyi bakmaniz önemlidir. Banka PIN'leri ve iki faktörlü kimlik dogrulama secenekleri gibi cesitli araclar bu konuda size yardimci olabilir.

english: You'll find more information on account security on the Customer Support webpage. You can use the Useful Links section of the Account Management menu to get there.
translation: Hesap güvenligi hakkinda daha fazla bilgiyi Müsteri Destegi web sayfasinda bulabilirsiniz. Hesap Yönetimi menüsünün Yararli Baglantilar bölümünü kullanarak bu sayfaya ulasabilirsiniz.

english: Anyway, that's everything I have to tell you about accounts. Let me know if you need a recap, otherwise head on to your next instructor.
translation: Her neyse, hesaplar hakkinda size söylemem gereken her sey bu kadar. Özetlemek isterseniz bana haber verin, yoksa bir sonraki egitmeninize gecin.

english: Hello. Would you like to hear about your account again?
translation: Merhaba. Hesabiniz hakkinda tekrar bilgi almak ister misiniz?

english: Yes!
Excellent. Well there's a few things you can do with your account.
translation: Harika. Hesabinizla yapabileceginiz birkac sey var.

english: You are currently on a free world. If you want to switch to a members' world and enjoy all of the benefits, you'll need to purchase membership. You can do so using the store in the Account Management menu.
translation: Su anda ücretsiz bir dünyadasiniz. Üye dünyasina gecmek ve tüm avantajlardan yararlanmak istiyorsaniz, üyelik satin almaniz gerekir. Bunu, Hesap Yönetimi menüsündeki magazayi kullanarak yapabilirsiniz.

english: Next up, you have your inbox. The inbox is where you'll receive important information related to your account and the game. Be sure to keep an eye on it.
translation: Sirada, gelen kutunuz var. Gelen kutusu, hesabiniz ve oyunla ilgili önemli bilgileri alacaginiz yerdir. Gözünüzü üzerinde tutun.

english: Finally, you have your display name. Every account has a unique display name. If you don't like your current one, you can change it with the name changer.
translation: Son olarak, ekran adiniz var. Her hesabin kendine özgü bir ekran adi vardir. Mevcut adinizi begenmezseniz, ad degistirici ile degistirebilirsiniz.

english: Anyway, that's everything. I hope that has helped you out.
translation: Her neyse, hepsi bu kadar. Umarim yardimci olmustur.

english: Yes!
No thanks.
Hello there.
Hey there adventurer. I am Gordon, the Account security tutor. I can help you with anything account security related, would you like to know anything?
translation: Merhaba maceraci. Ben Gordon, Hesap güvenligi egitmeni. Hesap güvenligi ile ilgili her konuda size yardimci olabilirim, bilmek istediginiz bir sey var mi?

english: How can I keep my account secure?
There are many ways you can strengthen your account security, which would you like to hear more about?
translation: Hesap güvenliginizi güclendirmek icin bircok yol var, hangisi hakkinda daha fazla bilgi almak istersiniz?

english: Tell me about passwords.
Your password is the first line of defence in keeping your account secure.
translation: Sifreniz, hesabinizi güvende tutmanin ilk savunma hattidir.

english: When choosing a password, make sure to keep it unique. You can do this by using a mix of letters and numbers. You could even use numbers in the middle of your password.
translation: Sifre secerken, benzersiz olmasina dikkat edin. Bunu, harf ve rakamlari karistirarak yapabilirsiniz. Sifrenizin ortasina rakamlar da ekleyebilirsiniz.

english: For extra security, you should make sure you use a different password for your account and email.
translation: Ekstra güvenlik icin, hesabiniz ve e-postaniz icin farkli sifreler kullanmalisiniz.

english: You should keep your password safe and tell no one. Not even your friends or family.
translation: Sifrenizi güvende tutmali ve kimseye söylememelisiniz. Arkadaslariniza ve ailenize bile.

english: Is there anything else you would like to know?
translation: Baska bilmek istediginiz bir sey var mi?

english: Tell me about securing my email.
Make sure you use a separate password for your email account. This will help boost your security and make it less likely for hijackers to steal your account.
translation: E-posta hesabiniz icin ayri bir sifre kullandiginizdan emin olun. Bu, güvenliginizi artirmaniza ve hesap korsanlarinin hesabinizi calma olasiligini azaltmaniza yardimci olacaktir.

english: You should also enable two-step authentication on your email account, if your email supports it.
translation: E-postaniz destekliyorsa, e-posta hesabinizda iki asamali kimlik dogrulamayi da etkinlestirmelisiniz.

english: This could be done through an authenticator app supplied by your email provider, or it could be done using your mobile phone number.
translation: Bu, e-posta saglayiciniz tarafindan saglanan bir kimlik dogrulama uygulamasi araciligiyla veya cep telefonu numaraniz kullanilarak yapilabilir.

english: The type of authenticator changes based on provider, but when active, hijackers will find it hard to access your account. Also, if you get any backup codes, keep them safe.
translation: Kimlik dogrulama türü saglayiciya göre degisir, ancak etkinlestirildiginde, saldirganlarin hesabiniza erismesi zorlasir. Ayrica, yedek kodlar alirsaniz, bunlari güvenli bir yerde saklayin.

english: Tell me about the authenticator.
The RuneScape authenticator will provide your account with another layer of security against hijackers who might want to steal your account.
translation: RuneScape kimlik dogrulayici, hesabinizi calmak isteyen korsanlara karsi hesabiniza ek bir güvenlik katmani saglar.

english: As well as requiring a password to enter your account, you will also need a randomly generated number from the authenticator app to login.
translation: Hesabiniza girmek icin sifre girmenin yani sira, oturum acmak icin kimlik dogrulayici uygulamasindan rastgele olusturulan bir numaraya da ihtiyaciniz olacaktir.

english: You can enable the authenticator by checking your account page on the official RuneScape website.
translation: Kimlik dogrulayiciyi, resmi RuneScape web sitesindeki hesap sayfanizi kontrol ederek etkinlestirebilirsiniz.

english: If you like, I can take you to a useful web page about the RuneScape authenticator.
translation: Isterseniz, RuneScape kimlik dogrulayici hakkinda yararli bir web sayfasina yönlendirebilirim.

english: No thanks.
Tell me about securing my bank.
translation: Bankami güvence altina almam hakkinda bilgi verin.

english: If someone does get into your account, you should make sure your bank is secure.
translation: Birisi hesabiniza girerse, bankanizin güvenli oldugundan emin olmalisiniz.

english: To keep your bank secure, you should make sure to set a bank pin. A bank pin is a 4 digit code you will need to put in to access your bank.
translation: Bankanizi güvende tutmak icin bir banka sifresi belirlemelisiniz. Banka sifresi, bankaniza erismek icin girmeniz gereken 4 basamakli bir koddur.

english: It seems I don't have one setup. How do I gotabout setting up a bank pin?
translation: Görünüse göre benim bir tane yok. Banka sifresini nasil ayarlayabilirim?

english: To setup a bank pin you will need to visit any bank where you can find a banker. You should then speak to the banker and ask them about setting up a bank pin.
translation: Banka sifresini ayarlamak icin, bir bankaci bulabileceginiz herhangi bir bankayi ziyaret etmeniz gerekir. Ardindan bankaci ile konusup banka sifresi ayarlamayi isteyin.

english: After the bank pin has been set, you will need to wait a few days for the pin to take effect.
translation: Banka sifresi ayarlandiktan sonra, sifrenin gecerli olmasi icin birkac gün beklemeniz gerekir.

english: Thanks, I should go speak to a banker right away.
translation: Tesekkürler, hemen bir bankaci ile konusmaliyim.

english: Good thing I already have one set.
translation: Neyse ki benim zaten bir tane var.

english: Good on you [lad/lass]! Great work.
Tell me about the Stronghold of Security.
translation: Güvenlik Kalesi hakkinda bilgi ver bana.

english: The Stronghold of Security can be found in the Barbarian Village, west of Varrock.
translation: Güvenlik Kalesi, Varrock'un batisindaki Barbar Köyü'nde bulunur.

english: Here you will be tested on your knowledge of account security. You will need to make your way to the bottom floor while answering question on account security and fighting monsters.
translation: Burada hesap güvenligi hakkindaki bilgilerin test edilecek. Hesap güvenligi ile ilgili sorulari yanitlayip canavarlarla savasarak en alt kata inmen gerekecek.

english: Be aware, the deeper into the stronghold you go, the tougher the monster will be. So make sure you bring your best equipment and some food.
translation: Unutma, kalenin derinliklerine indikce canavarlar daha zorlu hale gelir. Bu yüzden en iyi ekipmanlarini ve biraz yiyecek getirmeyi unutma.

english: If you do manage to make it to the end of each floor, you will be able to loot the chest for some loot. But only once per floor.
translation: Her katin sonuna ulasmayi basarirsan, sandigi yagmalayarak ganimet elde edebilirsin. Ancak her katta sadece bir kez.

english: If you decide to kill the monsters, you might find they drop some skull sceptre pieces.
translation: Canavarlari öldürmeye karar verirsen, kafatasi asasi parcalari düsürdüklerini görebilirsin.

english: Interesting, thanks for the information.
Can I have a Security book?
Sure thing, here you go.
The Account security tutor hands you a Security book.
translation: Hesap güvenligi ögretmeni sana bir güvenlik kitabi verir.

english: Use it well.
You already have one, maybe you should read that one instead.
translation: Zaten bir tane var, belki de onu okumalisin.

english: Don't I know you from somewhere?
Ah, you're probably talking about my twin brother who works at the Port Sarim prison.
translation: Ah, muhtemelen Port Sarim hapishanesinde calisan ikiz kardesimden bahsediyorsun.

english: He spends all his time giving out security books when he could tell you about security instead.
translation: Güvenlik hakkinda sana bilgi verebilecekken, tüm vaktini güvenlik kitaplari dagitarak geciriyor.

english: But don't you give out security books too?
translation: Ama sen de güvenlik kitapciklari dagitmiyor musun?

english: Well yes, but at least I tell you about account security as well.
translation: Evet, ama en azindan sana hesap güvenligi hakkinda da bilgi veriyorum.

english: That's true. Maybe I shouldn't be too quick to judge.
translation: Dogru. Belki de bu kadar cabuk yargilamamaliyim.

english: No, thank you.
Come back any time you need any more information on account security.
translation: Hesap güvenligi hakkinda daha fazla bilgiye ihtiyacin olursa istedigin zaman tekrar gel.

Tell me about passwords.

english: I'm a hero - may I apply to join?
translation: Ben bir kahramanim, üye olmak icin basvurabilir miyim?

english: You're a hero? I've never heard of YOU. You are required to possess at least 55 quest points to file an application.
translation: Sen bir kahraman misin? Seni hic duymadim. Basvuru yapmak icin en az 55 görev puani sahibi olman gerekir.

english: Additionally you must have completed the Shield of Arrav, Lost City, Merlin's Crystal and Dragon Slayer I quests.
translation: Ayrica Arrav'in Kalkani, Kayip Sehir, Merlin'in Kristali ve Ejderha Avcisi I görevlerini tamamlamis olman gerekir.

translation: N-ne? Ne demek istiyorsun? Daha fazlasi mi var???

translation: Üzgünüm, sadece seninle biraz egleniyordum. Kahramanlar Loncasi'nin mizahi iste. Aslinda demek istedigim...

Absolutely! Where would you like to go?
