translation: Iyi sanslar! Yeni bir görev istediginde geri gelmeyi unutma.

english: You're still hunting [task monster], you have [amount] to go. Come back when you've finished your task.
You're still hunting [monster], with [amount] to go.
I don't think that's a suitable task for you. Shall I cancel it? This will not wipe your task streaks.
translation: Bence bu senin icin uygun bir görev degil. Iptal edeyim mi? Bu, görev serini silmez.

english: Yes, please cancel it.
Alright, consider the task cancelled. You can now get a new assignment when you want one.
translation: Tamam, görev iptal edildi. Istediginde yeni bir görev alabilirsin.

english: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
Good luck with that.
Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: Bana verebileceginiz bir ödül veya takas edebilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: I have quite a few rewards you can earn, and a wide variety of Slayer equipment for sale.
translation: Kazanabileceginiz pek cok ödül ve satilik cok cesitli Avci ekipmanlari var.

english: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
The Slayer Masters may currently assign you any task in our lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: Avci Ustalar su anda savas seviyeniz ne olursa olsun listemizdeki herhangi bir görevi size verebilir.

english: That's fine - I can handle any task.
That's the spirit.
In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: Gelecekte lütfen cok zor görevler vermeyin.

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: Tamam, bundan sonra tüm Avci Ustalar sana görev verirken savas seviyeni dikkate alacaklar, bu yüzden cok zor görevler almayacaksin.

english: The Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: Avci Ustalar sana görev verirken savas seviyeni dikkate alacaklar, bu yüzden cok zor görevler almayacaksin.

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
translation: Sorun degil, cok zor görevler istemiyorum.

english: Okay, we'll keep checking your combat level.
translation: Tamam, savas seviyeni kontrol etmeye devam edecegiz.

english: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: Savas seviyemi kontrol etmeyi birakin, her seyi yapabilirim!

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will assign you anything from their lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: Tamam, bundan sonra tüm Avci Ustalar, savas seviyenize bakmaksizin size listelerinden herhangi bir görev verecekler.

english: So you're filling in for Mazchna?
Indeed I am. It's been a while since he last asked me to step in, but it's good to get out and see the sights, to meet mortals and to generally socialise.
translation: Evet, öyle. Bana en son ne zaman yardim etmemi istedigini hatirlamiyorum, ama disari cikip manzarayi görmek, ölümlülerle tanismak ve genel olarak sosyallesmek güzel.

english: So do you know Mazchna well?
Oh, yes, he's such a mine of information. He hears what's going on at the pub, listens to the gossip of passing adventurers, and now he's off on a great adventure himself.
translation: Oh, evet, o bir bilgi hazinesidir. Pub'da neler olup bittigini duyar, gecen maceracilarin dedikodularini dinler ve simdi kendisi de büyük bir maceraya atildi.

english: Though, of course, you know that already. Sorry to babble on. I'm sure you have plenty of other things to be doing.
translation: Tabii ki bunu zaten biliyorsundur. Gevezelik ettigim icin özür dilerim. Eminim yapacak baska islerin vardir.

english: Er... Nothing...
'Ello, can I help you?
I need another assignment.
No that's okay, I'll take a task from you.
translation: Hayir, sorun degil, senden bir görev alacagim.

english: Oh okay then, I'll go talk to Vannaka.
translation: Tamam o zaman, Vannaka ile konusacagim.

english: Got any tips for me?
translation: Bana verebilecegin bir ipucu var mi?

english: Okay, great!
Yes, please cancel it.
No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: Bana verebilecegin bir ödül veya takas edebilecegin bir sey var mi?

english: Look at rewards.
Look at shop.
Cancel.
Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
That's fine - I can handle any task.
In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: Gelecekte lütfen cok zor görevler verme.

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
translation: Sorun degil, cok zor görevler istemiyorum.

english: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: Savas seviyemi kontrol etmeyi birak, her seyi halledebilirim!

english: So you're filling in for Mazchna?
Er... Nothing...
Err... Nothing...
Don't mind me, but if you're looking for something to do, this man here needs a hand.
translation: Beni takma, ama yapacak bir sey ariyorsan, bu adamin yardima ihtiyaci var.

english: Nilsal, traveller. What brings you out here?
translation: Nilsal, gezgin. Seni buraya ne getirdi?

english: Just exploring. What about you?
You'll find me here quite often. I like to come and tend to this grave.
translation: Beni sik sik burada bulabilirsin. Buraya gelip bu mezari ziyaret etmeyi seviyorum.

english: Whose is it?
I don't know. I don't understand the markings on it. They are not of this land. All I know is that it is the grave of someone from Kourend.
translation: Bilmiyorum. Üzerindeki isaretleri anlamiyorum. Bu topraklara ait degiller. Tek bildigim, Kourend'den birine ait oldugu.

english: They'll have been a soldier of some sorts, fighting here in the war. I'm guessing they were quite important. Very few people would have been afforded a burial in those times.
translation: Bir tür asker olmali, burada savasmis olmali. Sanirim oldukça önemli biriydi. O zamanlar çok az kisiye mezar kazma imkâni taninirdi.

english: If you don't know who they are, why tend the grave?
translation: Kim oldugunu bilmiyorsan neden mezara bakiyorsun?

english: It was my father's generation who fought in the war, but they're all gone now. My generation will soon follow. In time, this grave will go as well. Eventually, they'll be no trace left of the war.
translation: Savasta savasan babamin nesliydi, ama hepsi öldü artik. Benim neslim de yakinda onlari takip edecek. Zamanla bu mezar da yok olacak. Sonunda savastan geriye hiçbir iz kalmayacak.

english: I guess that's why I tend the grave. The future is inevitable, but for now, I'd like to try and hold onto the past for a bit longer.
translation: Sanirim bu yüzden mezari bakiyorum. Gelecek kaçinilmaz, ama simdilik geçmise biraz daha tutunmak istiyorum.

english: I see. In that case, I'm sorry to have disturbed you. I'll leave you to it.
translation: Anliyorum. Öyleyse sizi rahatsiz ettigim için özür dilerim. Sizi rahat birakayim.

english: Thank you, traveller.
You! Time for some questions.
Why did you join the Emissaries?
To be honest, I wasn't too sure about joining at first. My friend convinced me though. Here we're part of something bigger than ourselves.
translation: Dürüst olmak gerekirse, ilk basta katilmak konusunda pek emin degildim. Ama arkadasim beni ikna etti. Burada kendimizden daha büyük bir seyin parcasiyiz.

english: Who do you worship?
I've never been one for proper worship, but I believe in the teachings of Ralos and Ranul. I hope those teachings guide me through whatever is to come.
translation: Hicbir zaman dindar biri olmadim, ama Ralos ve Ranul'un ögretilerine inaniyorum. Umarim bu ögretiler gelecekte basima gelecek her seyde bana yol gösterir.

english: Tell me about the Final Dawn.
They say the Final Dawn is inevitable. It's the end that we can't escape from. It's a scary thought, but the Twilight Emissaries have embraced it, so I have as well.
translation: Son Safak'in kacinilmaz oldugunu söylüyorlar. Kacamayacagimiz bir son. Korkutucu bir düsünce, ama Alacakaranlik Elcileri bunu kabullenmis, ben de öyle yaptim.

english: Why did you join the Emissaries?
Who do you worship?
Tell me about the Final Dawn.
Hello!
Hello friend. I wish to slay evil and avail them of their loot! Take me to Burgh de Rott!
translation: Merhaba dostum. Kötülügü yok etmek ve ganimetlerini ele gecirmek istiyorum! Beni Burgh de Rott'a götür!

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: Oradaki kötülükle savasmaya yeterince hazir misin?

english: I think so? At least my heart knows courage and that should be sufficient for the meantime. I expect that when we get to Burgh de Rott, we'll be able to purchase suitable provisions.
translation: Sanirim öyle. En azindan kalbim cesaret dolu ve bu simdilik yeterli olmali. Burgh de Rott'a vardigimizda uygun erzak satin alabilecegimizi umuyorum.

english: But you do realise that the vampyres in Morytania are immune to everything except silver?
translation: Ama Morytania'daki vampirlerin gümüs disinda her seye karsi bagisik olduklarini biliyor musun?

english: Er...well, I've not heard mention of that fact, but I have faith that Saradomin will provide the means to furnish me with suitable weapons when I reach Burgh de Rott.
translation: Sey... Bu konuda bir sey duymadim, ama Saradomin'in Burgh de Rott'a vardigimda bana uygun silahlar saglayacagina inaniyorum.

english: And if we happen to run into some vampyres on the journey down there?
translation: Ya oraya giderken yolda vampirlerle karsilasirsak?

english: I trust that you will help us to avoid them. You are a guide after all, aren't you? Anyway, you look like you can handle yourself. I presume you've fought such creatures before and won? How hard can it be?
translation: Onlardan kacinmamiza yardim edecegine güveniyorum. Sonucta sen bir rehbersin, degil mi? Her neyse, kendini savunabilecek gibi görünüyorsun. Daha önce bu tür yaratiklarla savasip kazandin mi? Ne kadar zor olabilir ki?

english: It can be pretty difficult, actually. But you're right, I'll be your guide so I should be able to handle the situation.
translation: Aslinda oldukca zor olabilir. Ama haklisin, ben senin rehberin olacagim, bu yüzden durumu halledebilmeliyim.

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Neden Burgh de Rott'a gitmek istiyorsun?

english: I'm going down there to teach those vampyres a lesson or two. I've heard about the terrible conditions down there and I intend to put a stop to it.
translation: Oradaki vampirleri bir ders vermek icin gidiyorum. Oradaki korkunc kosullari duydum ve buna bir son vermek niyetindeyim.

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Burgh de Rott'a giderken yol üzerinde düsmanlarla karsilasirsak kendini savunabilir misin?

english: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of enemies. You don't need to worry about that.
translation: Diyelim ki biraz tecrübeliyim ve düsmanlarla savasmaktan cekinmem. Bu konuda endiselenmene gerek yok.

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: Hmmm, görünüse göre bir takipcin var. Kendi basina dolasmaya birakilirsa bu yolculukta kaybolabilir. Takipcin güvende oldugunda yola cikalim.

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: Gercekten mi? Bu harika olur! Hedefe vardigimizda sana kücük bir ödül verecegim.

english: Burgh de Rott Ramble begins
Ok, which route should we take?
Ok, thanks.
Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: Ah, bana biraz erzak vermek istiyorsun, ha? Sirt cantami acayim.

english: This place is a bit grim. How can people live here?
translation: Burasi biraz kasvetli. Insanlar burada nasil yasayabiliyor?

english: Do you visit Burgh de Rott often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: Burgh de Rott'a sik sik gelir misin? Rotayi iyi biliyorsun gibi görünüyor.

english: When are we going to get to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Burgh de Rott'a ne zaman varacagiz?

english: We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on. I have loot to get.
translation: Bütün gün burada durup sohbet edemeyiz, hadi devam edelim. Yagmalayacak seyler var.

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than the opulet life styles forced on us adventurer types. I'd much rather be up to my eyes in mud and having a good fight!
translation: Oh, bu yolculuktan nefret ediyorum, ama maceraci tiplere dayatilan lüks yasam tarzindan daha iyidir. Gözlerime kadar camura batip iyi bir kavga etmeyi tercih ederim!

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...
Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Paterdomus. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: Hay aksi! Görünüse göre Paterdomus'a geri dönmek zorundayiz. O köprüden gecemeyiz!

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
Player completes the bridge event
Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Paterdomus.
translation: Bu is bitti... Görünüse göre bu batakliktan gecemeyiz. Paterdomus'a geri dönmek zorundayiz.

english: Player completes the bog event
Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: Hey... bu harika... harika bir is cikardin... Seni takip edecegim.

english: Whahay...that was great!
But we really should be heading off now.
Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
Player completes the river event
That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: Bu harika! Ben de aynisini yapmaliyim.

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: Whahay! Harikaydi! Ama artik gercekten gitmeliyiz.

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
This is scary!
Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
Ahhh, two tentacles!
...three tentacles!
I think I'm going to faint!
Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: Vay canina! Su canavara bak! O seyi kendi basina halletmen gerekecek!

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the Burgh de Rott. Here's your reward.
translation: Beni Burgh de Rott'a güvenle ulastirdigin icin cok tesekkürler. Iste ödülün.

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Neden Burgh de Rott'a gitmek istiyorsun?

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
Ok, thanks.
Hello [player name], what can I do for you?
translation: Merhaba Maceraci, senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: What are Adventure Paths?
A long time ago, I was a newbie just like you who didn't know what to do and I would be more than happy to pass on my experience.
translation: Uzun zaman önce, ben de senin gibi ne yapacagini bilmeyen bir acemiydim ve deneyimlerimi seninle paylasmaktan mutluluk duyarim.

english: I've created some Adventure Paths which I recommend you to start off with. An Adventure Path is a list of tasks which you can complete in any order.
translation: Baslaman icin tavsiye ettigim bazi Macera Yollari olusturdum. Macera Yolu, istedigin sirayla tamamlayabilecegin görevlerin listesidir.

english: To help you get started on your Adventure Path, I'll also give you a starter kit with some useful items.
translation: Macera Yoluna baslamana yardimci olmak icin, sana bazi yararli esyalarin bulundugu bir baslangic kiti de verecegim.

english: Once you've completed an Adventure Path task, come back to me and I'll give you a reward.
translation: Bir Macera Yolu görevini tamamladiktan sonra bana geri dönün, size bir ödül verecegim.

english: Do you have any Adventure Path starter kits for me?
translation: Bana verebileceginiz Macera Yolu baslangic kiti var mi?

english: Adventurer Jon gives you a Combat path starter kit
translation: Maceraci Jon size bir Savas Yolu baslangic kiti veriyor.

english: Here are all of the starter kits you have left to claim.
You seem to have already claimed all of your starter kits.
translation: Görünüse göre tüm baslangic kitlerinizi almissiniz.

english: I'd like to claim my Adventure Path rewards.
I have no rewards to give you at the moment.
translation: Su anda size verebilecegim bir ödül yok.

english: I have no rewards to give you at the moment. But I do have some members rewards left to give you, visit me on a members world to receive them.
translation: Su anda sana verebilecegim bir ödül yok. Ama sana verebilecegim bazi üye ödülleri var, bunlari almak icin üye dünyasinda beni ziyaret et.

english: You should make sure you have space before asking for rewards.
translation: Ödül istemek icin önce yeterli alanin oldugundan emin olmalisin.

english: That is the last of the rewards you have currently earned. But I do have some members rewards left to give you, visit me on a members world to receive them.
translation: Bu, su anda kazandigin son ödül. Ama sana verebilecegim bazi üye ödülleri var, bunlari almak icin üye dünyasinda beni ziyaret et.

english: That is the last of your rewards which you have earned.
I can't give you any more rewards until you come back with more inventory space.
translation: Envanterinizde daha fazla yer acana kadar size baska ödül veremem.

english: Can you show me some Adventure Paths?
translation: Bana bazi Macera Yollarini gösterebilir misiniz?

english: Of course, here you go.
Opting out of Adventure Paths will hide the interface and you will no longer receive task and path notifications. You can talk to Adventurer Jon to opt back into Adventure Paths
translation: Macera Yollarindan cikmak, arayüzü gizleyecek ve artik görev ve yol bildirimleri almayacaksiniz. Macera Yollarini tekrar secmek icin Maceraci Jon ile konusabilirsiniz.

english: You have now opted out of Adventure Paths.
You are currently not participating in Adventure Paths. Would you like to join back in?
translation: Su anda Macera Yollarinda yer almiyorsunuz. Tekrar katilmak ister misiniz?

english: Yes please.
Opting into Adventure Paths will allow you to see the interface and you will be able to receive task and path notifications. You can talk to Adventurer Jon to opt back out of Adventure Paths
translation: Macera Yollarini sectiginizde arayüzü görebilir ve görev ve yol bildirimleri alabilirsiniz. Macera Yollarini tekrar iptal etmek icin Maceraci Jon ile konusabilirsiniz.

english: You have opted back into Adventure Paths.
No thanks.
Who are you?
I am simply an adventurer like yourself taking a break on my journey.
translation: Ben de senin gibi yolculuguna ara vermis bir maceraciyim.

english: I wish you luck on your next adventure.
translation: Bir sonraki maceranda sana sans dilerim.

english: And I to you.
Hey [player name]! Come over here.
You look new around here, welcome to the world of Gielinor!
translation: Buralarda yeni görünüyorsun, Gielinor dünyasina hos geldin!

english: Thanks, it's my first time here and I'm not sure where to start.
translation: Tesekkürler, buraya ilk kez geliyorum ve nereden baslayacagimi bilmiyorum.

english: Well, lucky for you, that is exactly why I am here.
translation: Sanslisin, ben de tam bu yüzden buradayim.

english: Start by opening your quest panel and then selecting the flashing yellow star.
translation: Görev panelini acip yanip sönen sari yildizi secerek baslayin.

english: What are Adventure Paths?
Do you have any Adventure Path starter kits for me?
translation: Benim icin Macera Yolu baslangic kiti var mi?

english: I'd like to claim my Adventure Path rewards.
Can you show me some Adventure Paths?
translation: Bana bazi Macera Yollarini gösterir misiniz?

english: Disable Adventure Paths.
Yes
No
Yes please.
No thanks.
Greetings, [Sir/Madam].
The King needs someone to take over the rule of the Kingdom. If I were you, I should consider the position.
translation: Kral, kralligin yönetimini devralacak birine ihtiyac duyuyor. Yerinde olsam, bu pozisyonu düsünürdüm.

english: Greetings, Your Royal Highness.
Your Royal Highness, I should tell you right away that killing the people of this Kingdom will not make you popular with anyone.
translation: Majesteleri, bu kralligin halkini öldürmenin sizi kimseye sevdirmeyecegini hemen söylemeliyim.

english: How is the Kingdom faring?
Your subjects are worried about the possibility of war, but they are still happy to work for you.
translation: Halkiniz savas olasiligindan endiseli, ama yine de sizin icin calismaktan mutlular.

english: What am I meant to be doing again?
Dealing with all the little troubles that come up from time to time, Your Royal Highness.
translation: Zaman zaman ortaya çikan tüm küçük sorunlarla ilgilenmek, Majesteleri.

english: Such as the predicament we are now in.
translation: Su anda içinde bulundugumuz zor durum gibi.

english: What do you mean?
Has anything been happening in the kingdom recently?
translation: Son zamanlarda krallikta bir sey oldu mu?

english: Interesting that you should ask that, Your Royal Highness.
You see, the people are worried that war will break out again.
translation: Görüyorsunuz, halk yeniden savas cikacagindan endiseli.

english: King Vargas has found himself with little to do now that you are the regent. He intended, at first, to return to adventuring.
translation: Kral Vargas, siz naip oldugunuz icin artik yapacak pek bir sey bulamiyor. Ilk basta maceraya geri dönmeyi planliyordu.

english: Unfortunately, we still have not had the doors to the throne room enlarged so that he can leave...
translation: Ne yazik ki, taht odasinin kapilarini genisletip onun ayrilmasini saglayamadik...

english: So, what has he been doing?
He has been trying to rule once more, in your absence. However, he has once again quarrelled with the Queen of Etceteria.
translation: Sizin yoklugunuzda bir kez daha hüküm sürmeye calisiyor. Ancak, bir kez daha Etceteria Kralicesi ile kavga etti.

english: The two of them have been writing letters to each other, threatening to raise armies and declare war on each other once more!
translation: Ikisi birbirlerine mektuplar yazip, ordularini toplayip bir kez daha savas ilan etmekle tehdit ediyorlar!

english: I see.
Your Royal Highness, I suggest that you deal with this matter and reconcile the two of them again. Such a quarrel is not good for Miscellania.
translation: Majesteleri, bu konuyu halledip ikisini tekrar baristirmanizi öneririm. Böyle bir kavga Miscellania icin iyi degil.

english: No, I don't have the time at the moment.
You are the regent of this kingdom, Your Royal Highness. I would urge you to reconsider.
translation: Siz bu kralligin naibisiniz, Majesteleri. Tekrar düsünmenizi rica ediyorum.

english: However, you are also a busy hero, and thus I understand your reluctance.
translation: Ancak, siz de mesgul bir kahramansiniz ve bu yüzden isteksizliginizi anliyorum.

english: Greetings, Thane [Fremennik name].
Your subjects are content, your Highness.
Your subjects are content, Thane [Fremennik name].
Your current approval rating is [number]%. I'm afraid your subjects have not yet collected anything.
Your current approval rating is [number]%. Would you like to collect the resources gathered by your subjects?
Yes, please.
Let me check if you have made enough space in your bank, Your Royal Highness.
translation: Bankanizda yeterli alan olup olmadigini kontrol edeyim, Majesteleri.

english: I'm afraid you will need [amount] more free space[s] in your bank to hold all the items your subjects have collected.
Here is a list of what your subjects have collected.
I shall tell your subjects to deliver your resources to your storage right away, Your Royal Highness.
translation: Tebaasina kaynaklarinizi hemen deponuza teslim etmelerini söyleyecegim, Majesteleri.

english: I shall tell your subjects to deliver your resources to your storage right away, Thane [Fremennik name].
translation: Teskilatiniza kaynaklarinizi hemen deponuza teslim etmelerini söyleyecegim, Thane Dokrak.

english: This is how your subjects are distributing their effort.
No, thank you.
Very well, Your Royal Highness.
Very well, Thane [Fremennik name].
How do I manage the kingdom?

Your loyal subjects work hard to collect resources for you. Every day they bring what they have collected to the castle. The resources which they collect are coal from the rocks to the north, maple logs from the trees
translation: Sadik teskilatiniz sizin icin kaynak toplamak icin cok calisiyor. Her gün topladiklarini kaleye getiriyorlar. Topladiklari kaynaklar kuzeydeki kayalardan elde edilen kömür, dogudaki agaclardan elde edilen akcaagac kütükleri,

english: to the east, herbs from the garden just outside the castle, and tuna and swordfish fished at the port to the south. Etceteria has also pledged you teak and mahogany logs from their trees to the north, and seeds
translation: kalenin hemen disindaki bahceden elde edilen otlar ve güneydeki limanda avlanan ton baligi ve kilic baligidir. Etceteria da kuzeydeki agaclarindan elde edilen tik ve maun kütükleri ile güneydeki ciftliklerinden elde edilen tohumlari

english: from their farm to the south. They are paid from the money in the coffers; each day, one-tenth of the money in the coffers is distributed to them. A maximum of 75k is paid to your subjects and the Etceterians, and the
translation: size vermeyi taahhüt etmistir. Onlara hazinedeki paradan ödeme yapilir; her gün hazinedeki paranin onda biri onlara dagitilir. Tebaana ve Etceterialilara en fazla 75 bin ödenir ve

english: coffers can store up to 7.5 million gp. Another thing which affects the amounts of resources collected is your approval rating. The more your subjects love you, the more they will be motivated to work hard. King Vargas
translation: hazine 7,5 milyon altin saklayabilir. Toplanan kaynak miktarini etkileyen bir diger sey de onay oraninizdir. Tabiileriniz sizi ne kadar cok severse, o kadar cok calismaya motive olurlar. Kral Vargas,

english: would often go and help out his subjects in their daily tasks, when he was still able to do so, and they loved him dearly for it. Finally, you can choose how much of their efforts your subjects devote to each resource; of
translation: hala yapabiliyorken sik sik tabiilerinin günlük islerine yardim etmeye giderdi ve tabiiler onu bunun icin cok severdi. Son olarak, tabiilerinizin her bir kaynaga ne kadar caba harcayacaklarini secebilirsiniz;

english: course, the harder they work at collecting one, the less time they have to spend collecting the others.
translation: tabii ki, bir kaynagi toplamak icin ne kadar cok calisirlarsa, digerlerini toplamak icin o kadar az zamanlari kalir.

Here, you can have this one, I have plenty spare.

translation: Merhaba. Maceraci ekipmani ariyorsaniz dogru yere geldiniz.

No, sorry, I've come to the wrong place.
Hmph. Well, perhaps next time you'll need something from me?
translation: Hmph. Belki bir dahaki sefere benden bir seye ihtiyacin olur?

english: Oh that sounds interesting.
No, I've come to the wrong place.
Please leave. We're not in the mood for visitors.
translation: Lütfen gidin. Ziyaretçi kabul edecek havada degiliz.

english: Please only talk to the King if it's important. He has a heavy burden to bear with the running of his Kingdom.
translation: Lütfen sadece önemli bir sey varsa Kral ile konusun. Kralligi yönetmek onun icin büyük bir yük.

english: Who are you?
Apologies! Allow me to introduce myself: my name is Aeonisig Raispher, special advisor to King Roald on spiritual matters.
translation: Özür dilerim! Kendimi tanitayim: Benim adim Aeonisig Raispher, Kral Roald'in manevi konularda özel danismani.

english: Special advisor on spiritual matters? What does that mean?
translation: Manevi konularda özel danisman mi? Bu ne anlama geliyor?

english: It means that some decisions the King has to make might have unforeseen repercussions on the nation's spiritual sensibilities. My duty is to ensure that Saradominist ideals are not stomped underfoot.
translation: Bu, Kral'in alacagi bazi kararlarin ulusun manevi duyarliliklarina öngörülemeyen yansimalari olabilecegi anlamina geliyor. Benim görevim, Saradominist ideallerin ayaklar altina alinmamasini saglamak.

english: What do you do here?
My main function is to ensure that King Roald is apprised of all options, especially those that favour the righteous followers of Saradomin.
But surely the King should be able to make his own decisions on what's best for Misthalin?
translation: Ama Kral, Misthalin için en iyisinin ne olduguna dair kendi kararlarini verebilmeli degil mi?

english: What an interesting perspective you have! Totally unworkable of course, but interesting nonetheless.
translation: Ne ilginc bir bakis aciniz var! Elbette tamamen uygulanamaz, ama yine de ilginc.

english: Where did you come from?

I took my religious and combat training in several parts of the known world. I've also fought despicable beasts in the wilderness in Saradomin's name. Needless to say I have great experience in the ways of the world and am
translation: Dini ve savas egitimimi bilinen dünyanin cesitli yerlerinde aldim. Ayrica Saradomin adina Wildernessda asagilik canavarlarla savastim. Söylemeye gerek yok, dünyanin isleyisi konusunda büyük deneyimim var ve

english: an invaluable aid to his lordship's decision-making process.
translation: efendisinin karar verme sürecinde paha bicilmez bir yardimciyim.

english: How did you come to be an advisor to King Roald?
translation: Kral Roald'in danismani olmaya nasil karar verdin?

english: The King of Misthalin, like any great leader, always requires the best advice and the best advisors. He very often summons occasional advisors to help him in certain situations, but it was felt by the Church of Saradomin
translation: Misthalin Krali, her büyük lider gibi, her zaman en iyi tavsiyelere ve en iyi danismanlara ihtiyac duyar. Belirli durumlarda kendisine yardim etmeleri icin sik sik gecici danismanlar cagirir, ancak Saradomin Kilisesi,

english: that a full time advisor on religious matters was needed to ensure fair treatment of Saradomin's followers.
translation: Saradomin'in takipcilerine adil davranilmasini saglamak icin dini konularda tam zamanli bir danismana ihtiyac duyuldugunu düsündü.

english: How come he doesn't have an advisor for any other religious denominations?
translation: Neden diger dini mezhepler icin bir danismani yok?

english: Because I simply won't stand for it, that's why! Now, enough of your impertinent questions. I have work to do!
translation: Cünkü ben buna izin vermeyecegim, iste bu yüzden! Simdi, küstah sorularini kes. Yapacak isim var!

english: Okay, thanks.
What's going on? Where have all these zombies come from?

Zemouregal? Saradomin preserve us!

translation: Oh... tesekkürler, serumunu bana kullandin. Iste zahmetin icin bir sey.

english: The local gives you [reward].
Oh... thank you, you used the permanent serum on me. Here have something for your trouble.
translation: Oh... tesekkürler, bana kalici serumu kullandin. Iste zahmetin icin bir sey.

english: Oh I feel much better for that super serum,  I really hate it when I'm afflicted!
translation: Oh, o süper serum sayesinde kendimi cok daha iyi hissediyorum,  aci cektigim zamanlardan gercekten nefret ediyorum!

english: Hi!
Well. This beats doing the shopping!
translation: Eh. Bu alisveris yapmaktan daha iyi!

english: I wouldn't want to be the poor guy that has to clean up after the duels.
translation: Dövüslerden sonra temizlik yapmak zorunda kalan zavalli adam olmak istemezdim.

english: Me neither.
Hi!
What did the skeleton say before it ate?
I don't know?
Bone-appetit.
Ooh. This is exciting!
Yup!
How can you make a very lively hankerchief?
translation: Nasil cok canli bir mendil yapabilirsiniz?

english: Put a little boogey in it.
Why did the skeleton burp?
'Cause it didn't have the guts to fart!
My son just won his first duel!
Congratulations!
He ripped his opponent in half!
That's gotta hurt!
He's only 10 as well!
You gotta start 'em young!
Can't you see I'm watching the duels?
I'm sorry!
Knock knock!
Who's there?
Boo.
Boo who?
Don't cry, it's just me!
Waaaaassssssuuuuupp?!
Hi! I'm here to watch the duels!
translation: Bu yerin ikinci caga kadar uzandigini biliyor muydun?

english: Me too!
My favourite fighter is Mubariz!
The guy at the information kiosk?
translation: Nilsal, iknami. Ciftligime hos geldin. Ciftcilik malzemelerine ihtiyacin var mi?

english: Yeah! He rocks!
Takes all sorts, I guess.
Hmph.
Did you know they think this place dates back to the second age?!
Really?
Yeah. The guy at the information kiosk was telling me.
Nilsal, iknami. Welcome to my farm. Are you in need of some farming supplies?
Yes please.
translation: Cogunlukla güzel buldugum seyleri yaparim. Bazen kadinlarin kiyafetleri icin boya yaparim, ortami neselendirmek icin. Kirmizi, sari ve mavi boya yapabilirim. Istersen, bana gerekli malzemeleri getir.

english: No thank you.
translation: Kirmizi boya yapmak icin ne lazim?

english: As you wish.
Yes please.
translation: Tamam, bana kirmizi boya yap lütfen.

english: No thank you.
translation: Kirmizi boya yapmak icin yeterli cilegin yok.

english: What can I help you with?
What could you make for me?
translation: Neye ihtiyacin oldugunu biliyorsun, malzemeleri buldugunda geri gel. Simdilik hosca kal.

english: I mostly just make what I find pretty. I sometimes make dye for the women's clothes to brighten the place up. I can make red, yellow and blue dyes. If you'd like some, just bring me the appropriate ingredients.
What do you need to make red dye?
translation: Bu senin secimin, ama daha azi icin bile öldürdügünü düsünüyorum. Gözlerinden anlasiliyor.

english: 3 lots of redberries and 5 coins to you.
Okay, make me some red dye please.
translation: Benimkileri Varrock'un güneyindeki ormandan topluyorum. Port Sarim'deki gida dükkaninda da bazen bulunur.

english: You don't have enough berries to make the red dye.
I don't think I have all the ingredients yet.
translation: Kirmizi, sari ve mavi. Hangisini istersin?

english: You know what you need to get, now come back when you have them. Goodbye for now.
I can do without dye at that price.
That's your choice, but I would think you have killed for less. I can see it in your eyes.
translation: Sari boya yapmak icin neye ihtiyacin var?

english: Where do I get redberries?
translation: Sari, elde etmesi zor bir renk, sogan kabugundan elde edilir. Sari boya yapmak icin 2 sogan ve 5 sikke lazim.

english: I pick mine from the woods south of Varrock. The food shop in Port Sarim sometimes has some as well.
translation: Tamam, bana biraz sari boya yap lütfen.

english: What other colours can you make?
translation: Sari boya yapmak icin yeterli soganin yok.

english: Red, yellow and blue. Which one would you like?
Thanks.
translation: Buranin dogusunda, koyun tarlasinin yaninda bir ciftlikte sogan yetistiriliyor.

english: You're welcome!
What do you need to make yellow dye?
translation: Sari boya yapmak icin neye ihtiyacin var?

english: Yellow is a strange colour to get, comes from onion skins. I need 2 onions and 5 coins to make yellow dye.
translation: Sari, elde edilmesi zor bir renktir, sogan kabugundan elde edilir. Sari boya yapmak icin 2 sogan ve 5 sikkeye ihtiyacim var.

english: Okay, make me some yellow dye please.
translation: Tamam, bana biraz sari boya yap lütfen.

english: You don't have enough onions to make the yellow dye.
translation: Sari boya yapmak icin yeterli soganin yok.

english: Where do I get onions?
There are some onions growing on a farm to the East of here, next to the sheep field.
translation: Buranin dogusunda, koyun tarlasinin yaninda bir ciftlikte sogan yetistiriliyor.

english: What do you need to make blue dye?
translation: Mavi boya yapmak icin neye ihtiyacin var?

english: 2 woad leaves and 5 coins to you.
Okay, make me some blue dye please.
translation: Tamam, bana biraz mavi boya yap lütfen.

english: Woad leaves are fairly hard to find. My other customers tell me the chief gardener in Falador grows them.
translation: Woad yapraklari bulmak oldukca zordur. Diger müsterilerim Falador'daki bas bahcivanin bunlari yetistirdigini söylüyor.

english: No thanks, I am happy the colour I am.
You are easily pleased with yourself then. When you need dyes, come to me.
translation: O zaman kendini kolayca memnun ediyorsun. Boyaya ihtiyacin oldugunda bana gel.

english: Cool, do you turn people into frogs?
Oh, not for years, but if you meet a talking chicken, you have probably met the professor in the manor north of here. A few years ago it was flying fish. That machine is a menace.
translation: Oh, yillardir yapmiyorum, ama konusan bir tavukla karsilasirsan, muhtemelen buradan kuzeydeki malikanede yasayan profesörle tanismissindir. Birkac yil önce ucan balik vardi. O makine bir felaket.

english: You mad old witch, you can't help me.
translation: Sen cilgin yasli cadi, bana yardim edemezsin.

english: Oh, you like to call a witch names do you?
translation: Oh, cadilara hakaret etmeyi seviyorsun, degil mi?

english: That's a fine for insulting a witch. You should learn some respect.
translation: Bu, bir cadiya hakaret etmek icin uygun bir ceza. Biraz saygi ögrenmelisin.

english: Thank you for your kind present of some flour. I am sure you never meant to insult me.
translation: Un hediyeniz icin tesekkür ederim. Beni hakaret etmek istemediginize eminim.

english: You should be careful about insulting a witch. You never know what shape you could wake up in.
translation: Bir cadiyi hakaret etmek konusunda dikkatli olmalisin. Uyandiginda neye dönüsecegini asla bilemezsin.

english: Can you make dyes for me please?
translation: Benim icin boya yapabilir misin lütfen?

english: What sort of dye would you like? Red, yellow or blue?
translation: Ne tür bir boya istersin? Kirmizi, sari veya mavi?

translation: Kirmizi boya yapmak icin neye ihtiyacin var?
