How do I use the agility course?
I'll throw you a stick, which you need to fetch as quickly as possible, from the area beyond the pipes.
translation: Sana bir sopa atacagim, sen de onu borularin ötesindeki alandan mümkün oldugunca cabuk getirmen gerekiyor.

english: Be wary of the deathslide - you must hang by your teeth, and if your strength is not up to the job you will fall into a pit of spikes. Also, I would advise not carrying too much extra weight.
translation: Ölüm kaydiragina dikkat et - dislerinle asilmalisin, eger gücün yetmezse dikenli cukura düsersin. Ayrica, fazla agirlik tasimamani tavsiye ederim.

english: Bring the stick back to the werewolf waiting at the end of the death slide to get your agility bonus.
translation: Cubugu, ölüm kaydiraginin sonunda bekleyen kurt adama geri getirerek ceviklik bonusunu al.

english: I will throw your stick as soon as you jump onto the first stone.
translation: Ilk tasa atladigin anda cubugunu atacagim.

english: Grrr - you don't belong in here, human!
translation: Grrr - sen buraya ait degilsin, insan!

english: FETCH!!!!!
Why didn't you hand the stick over?!!?
Well done soldier! You've successfully completed the physical. You're free to do as you like.
translation: Aferin asker! Fiziksel testi basariyla tamamladin. Istedigini yapabilirsin.

english: What do I do now?
Just go through the gate in the fence and use the same door you came out of. You can come back whenever you like to tone up your body.
translation: Citin kapisindan gec ve geldigin kapiyi kullan. Vücudunu güclendirmek icin istedigin zaman geri gelebilirsin.

english: He doesn't look like he wants to talk right now.
translation: Su anda konusmak istemiyor gibi görünüyor.

english: Have you brought the stick yet?
What stick?
Come on, get round that course - I need something to chew!
translation: Hadi, parkuru tamamla - cignemek icin bir seye ihtiyacim var!

english: You need to take your headgear off before you try the Deathslide, otherwise you won't be able to get a good enough grip with your teeth.
translation: Deathslide'i denemeden önce basligini cikarman gerekiyor, aksi takdirde dislerinle yeterince iyi tutunamazsin.

english: Grrr - you don't belong in here, human!
translation: Grrr - sen buraya ait degilsin, insan!

english: That headgear won't help you here, human! Take it off!
translation: O baslik burada sana yardimci olmaz, insan! Cikar sunu!

english: Remember - a slow wolf is a hungry wolf!!
Get on with it - you need your whiskers perking!!!!
Claws first - think later.
Imagine the smell of blood in your nostrils!!!
translation: Burun deliklerinde kan kokusunu hayal et!!!

english: I never really wanted to be an agility trainer...
translation: Aslinda hic ceviklik egitmeni olmak istemedim...

english: It'll be worth it when you hunt!!
Let's see those powerful backlegs at work!!
translation: O güclü arka bacaklarini calistir bakalim!!

english: Let the bloodlust take you!!
translation: Kan dökme arzusu seni ele gecirsin!!

english: You're the slowest wolf I've ever had the misfortune to witness!!
translation: Sen, sahit oldugum en yavas kurtsun!!

english: When you're done there's a human with your name on it!!
translation: Isin bittiginde, üzerinde adin yazili bir insan var!!

english: You idiot - you've forgotten the stick!!!!
Give my regards to the ground...
WAAAAAARRRGGGHHHH!!!!!!
Don't let the spikes or the blood put you off...
Now for a true test of teeth...
translation: Simdi dislerin gercek bir teste tabi tutulacak...

english: You shouldn't even be here, human!
Let's see how strong human teeth are...
translation: Insan dislerinin ne kadar güclü oldugunu görelim...

english: Remember - no stick, no agility bonus!
translation: Unutma - sopa yoksa, ceviklik bonusu da yok!

english: Bring me the stick when you've finished the course!
Don't forget to give me the stick when you're done!
Oh no, not another human... what do you want then?
translation: Olamaz, bir insan daha... Ne istiyorsun?

english: Oh, do you get humans here often?
translation: Buraya sik sik insanlar gelir mi?

english: Not that often, no, but sometimes.
translation: Sik sik degil, ama bazen gelir.

english: Of course, since you people are too big for dwarven clothes, they typically don't stay very long.
translation: Tabii ki, siz insanlar cüce kiyafetlerine sigmayacaginiz icin genellikle cok uzun kalmazsiniz.

english: Why don't you make bigger clothes then?
translation: O zaman neden daha büyük kiyafetler yapmiyorsun?

english: What'd be the point? Besides, I don't make these clothes myself.
translation: Ne anlami var ki? Ayrica, bu kiyafetleri ben yapmiyorum.

english: Who makes these clothes then?
Oh, my sister, she lives in Keldagrim-East. Has a little stall on the other side of the Kelda.
translation: Oh, kardesim, Keldagrim-Dogu'da yasiyor. Kelda'nin diger tarafinda kücük bir tezgahi var.

english: If she only worked a little harder, like me, she wouldn't have to live in the sewers of the city. Shame really.
translation: Benim gibi biraz daha calissa, sehrin kanalizasyonlarinda yasamak zorunda kalmazdi. Gercekten yazik.

english: The sewers? Your sister lives in the sewers?
translation: Kanalizasyonlarda mi? Kardesin kanalizasyonlarda mi yasiyor?

english: Keldagrim-East, such a ghastly place. Not civil, polite and clean like we are in the West.
translation: Keldagrim-Dogu, ne korkunc bir yer. Bati'daki gibi medeni, kibar ve temiz degil.

english: Uh-huh.
So do you have any quests for me?
translation: Peki, benim icin herhangi bir görev var mi?

english: Quests? Why would I have any quests?
translation: Görev mi? Neden görevim olsun ki?

english: Oh, just anything to do would be fine.
No, not right now... maybe I'll have something for you to do later, but nothing at the moment.
translation: Hayir, su anda yok... belki daha sonra sana verecek bir görevim olur, ama su anda yok.

english: Who makes these clothes then?
translation: O zaman bu kiyafetleri kim yapiyor?

english: I still want to buy your clothes.
So do you have any quests for me?
translation: Bana verebileceginiz bir görev var mi?

english: I cannot speak to you outerlander! Talk to Brundt, the Chieftain!
translation: Seninle konusamam yabanci! Sef Brundt ile konus!

english: You stay away from me outerlander!
They are too suspicious of you for you to get close enough to steal from them.
translation: Sana karsi cok süpheci davraniyorlar, onlara yaklasip hirsizlik yapamazsin.

english: Hello.
Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: Merhaba kardesim Dokrak. Bugün benden ne istiyorsun? Her zaman yardimima güvenebilirsin!

english: Nothing thanks. I just fancied a chat.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler. Sadece sohbet etmek istedim.

english: My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
translation: Yardimima ihtiyacin olursa kapim her zaman acik Dokrak.

english: [Fremennik name]... It has been too long since last we met!
translation: Dokrak... Son görüsmemizden bu yana cok zaman gecti!

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: Hos geldin kardesim Dokrak. Seni burada görmek her zaman bir zevk!

english: My apologies [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: Özür dilerim kardesim Dokrak! Burada seninle vakit gecirecek vaktim yok!

english: That's okay, I didn't really want anything.
translation: Sorun degil, aslinda bir sey istememistim.

english: How are you [Fremennik name]? I hope all fares well with you this day!
translation: Nasilsin Dokrak? Umarim bugün her sey yolundadir!

english: I'm fine, thanks, how are you?
All is well with me also!
Hello to you, too!
Hello. Did you want something [Fremennik name]?
translation: Merhaba. Bir sey mi istiyordun Dokrak?

english: No, not really.
Well... okay then!
Always good to see you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].
translation: Seni görmek her zaman güzel kardesim Dokrak.

english: You shame us, [Fremennik name]!
How can you steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
You have betrayed your heritage, [Fremennik name]!
Why would you try to steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
Arrr, matey!
I'm looking for Redbeard Frank.
Redbeard Frank ye say? He be outside. Says he likes the feel of the wind on his cheeks.
translation: Kizil Sakal Frank mi dedin? Disarida. Yanaklarinda rüzgari hissetmeyi sevdigini söylüyor.

english: Thanks.
Arrr!
Are you going to sit there all day?
Aye, I am. I canna walk, ye see.
What's stopping you from walking?
Arrr, I 'ave only the one leg! I lost its twin when my last ship went down.
translation: Arrr, tek bacagim var! Son gemim battiginda diger bacagimi kaybettim.

english: But I can see both your legs!
Nay, young [laddie/lassie], this be a false leg. For years I had me a sturdy wooden peg-leg, but now I wear this dainty little feller.
translation: Hayir, genc , bu sahte bir bacak. Yillarca saglam bir tahta bacak kullandim, ama simdi bu zarif kücük seyi takiyorum.

english: Yon peg-leg kept getting stuck in the floorboards.
translation: O tahta bacak sürekli döseme tahtalarina takiliyordu.

english: Right...
Perhaps a [bright young laddie/bonnie young lassie] like yerself would like to help me? I be needing another ship to go a-hunting my enemy.
translation: Belki senin gibi bir genc bana yardim etmek ister? Düsmanimi avlamak icin baska bir gemiye ihtiyacim var.

english: Well, I do have a ship that I'm not using. It's the Lady Lumbridge.
translation: Aslinda, kullanmadigim bir gemim var. Adi Lady Lumbridge.

english: Arrr! That ship be known to me, and a fine lass she is.
translation: Arrr! O gemiyi taniyorum, cok güzel bir gemi.

english: I suppose she might be...
So would ye be kind enough to let me take her out to sea?
translation: O zaman onu denize cikarmama izin verir misin?

english: I had to pay 2000 gp for that ship. Have you got that much?
translation: O gemi icin 2000 altin ödemek zorunda kaldim. O kadar paran var mi?

english: Hmmm. And can you afford another ship?
translation: Hmmm. Baska bir gemi alacak paran var mi?

english: Nay, I have nary a penny to my name. All my worldly goods went down with me old ship.
translation: Hayir, cebimde tek kurus bile yok. Tüm malim mülküm eski gemimle birlikte batti.

english: So you're actually asking me to give you a free ship.
translation: Yani benden sana bedava bir gemi vermemi istiyorsun.

english: Arrr! Would ye be so kind?
translation: Arrr! Bu kadar nazik olabilir misin?

english: No I jolly well wouldn't!
Arrr.
Do you have anything for trade?
translation: Takas edecek bir seyin var mi?

english: Nothin' at the moment, but then again the Customs Agents are on the warpath right now.
translation: Su anda yok, ama gümrük memurlari su anda savas modundalar.

english: Oi matey, leave my beer alone!
Sorry!
Oi matey, no casting spells on my beer!
translation: Hey dostum, biramin üzerine büyü yapma!

english: I'm looking for Redbeard Frank.
Arrr!
Are you going to sit there all day?
Do you want to trade?
You dare disturb my rest!
You dare steal from us!
Gratias tibi ago!
Hello. Do you wish me to exchange banknotes for you? I charge only 5 coins for each banknote.
translation: Merhaba. Banknotlarinizi degistirmemi ister misiniz? Her banknot icin sadece 5 sikke aliyorum.

english: Yes please.
Hand me the banknotes you wish me to exchange.
Who are you?
I am Aisles. I can exchange banknotes for real items. Do you want any banknotes converted?
translation: Ben Aisles. Banknotlari gercek esyalarla degistirebilirim. Banknotlarini degistirmek ister misin?

english: No thanks.
I exchange banknotes for real items. That's not a banknote.
translation: Banknotlari gercek esyalarla degistiriyorum. O banknot degil.

english: I charge 5 coins for exchanging each banknote.
Yes please.
Who are you?
No thanks.
Exchange [item name]: 5 coins
Exchange All: [number of banknotes x 5] coins
Cancel
Greetings, fellow warrior. I am Ajjat, former black knight and now training officer here in the warrior guild.
translation: Selamlar, savasci dostum. Ben Ajjat, eski kara sövalye ve su anda savasci loncasinda egitim subayiyim.

english: Can you tell me about skillcapes, please?
translation: Bana beceri pelerinleri hakkinda bilgi verir misin lütfen?

english: Skillcapes, also known as Capes of Accomplishment, are reserved for the elite of the elite. Only a person who has truly mastered a skill can buy one, and even then a skillcape can only be bought from one who is
translation: Beceri pelerinleri, Basari Pelerinleri olarak da bilinir ve seckinlerin seckinleri icin ayrilmistir. Sadece bir beceriyi gercekten ustalasmis kisiler satin alabilir ve o zaman bile beceri pelerini, yalnizca

english: recognised as the highest skilled in the land at any particular skill.
translation: belirli bir beceride ülkedeki en yetenekli kisi olarak taninan kisiden satin alinabilir.

english: I have the privilege of being the person that controls access to the Skillcape of Attack, which Kamfreena will recognize and allow you to access her Cyclopes without the need for guild tokens.
translation: Saldiri Beceri Pelerini'ne erisimi kontrol etme ayricaligina sahibim. Kamfreena bunu taniyacak ve lonca jetonlarina ihtiyac duymadan Cyclopes'una erismene izin verecektir.

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: Black Knight? Why are you here?
Indeed I was, however their... methods... did not match with my ideals.. so I left. Harrallak, recognising my talent as a warrior, took me in and offered me a job here.
translation: Gercekten de öyleydim, ancak onlarin... yöntemleri... benim ideallerimle uyusmuyordu... bu yüzden ayrildim. Harrallak, savasci olarak yetenegimi fark etti ve beni buraya kabul ederek bana bir is teklif etti.

english: Hmm... well if Harrallak trusts you, I guess I can.
translation: Hmm... Harrallak sana güveniyorsa, ben de güvenebilirim.

english: What's the Dummy Room all about?

Ahh yes, the dummies. Another ingenious invention of the noble Dwarf Gamfred. They're mechanical you see and pop up out of the floor. You have to hit them with the correct attack mode before they disappear again.
translation: Ahh evet, mankenler. Asil Cüce Gamfred'in bir baska dahice icadi. Bunlar mekanik ve yerden firliyorlar. Tekrar kaybolmadan önce dogru saldiri moduyla vurmaniz gerekiyor.

english: So how do I tell which one is which?
translation: Peki hangisinin hangisi oldugunu nasil anlarim?

english: There are two different ways. One indication is their colour, the other is the pose and weapons they are holding, for instance, the one holding daggers you will need to hit with a piercing attack.
translation: Iki farkli yol var. Bir tanesi renkleri, digeri ise duruslari ve ellerinde tuttuklari silahlar. Örnegin, hancer tutan mankenlere delici saldiri ile vurmaniz gerekir.

english: In the room you will find a poster on the wall which can help you recognise each different dummy.
translation: Odadaki duvarda, her bir mankeni ayirt etmenize yardimci olacak bir poster bulacaksiniz.

english: That sounds ingenious!
Indeed, you may find that you need several weapons to be successful 100% of the time, but keep trying. The weapons shop upstairs may help you there.
translation: Gercekten de, %100 basarili olmak icin birkac silaha ihtiyaciniz olabilir, ama denemeye devam edin. Yukaridaki silah dükkani size bu konuda yardimci olabilir.

english: May I claim my tokens please?
Of course! Here you go, you've earned [amount] tokens!
Thanks!
I'm afraid you have not earned any tokens yet. Try some of the activities around the guild to earn some.
translation: Maalesef henüz jeton kazanmadiniz. Kazanmak icin lonca cevresindeki etkinliklerden bazilarini deneyin.

english: Ok, I'll go see what I can find.
Bye!
Farewell warrior. Stay away from the dark side.
translation: Hosca kalin savasci. Karanlik taraftan uzak durun.

english: Ah, but I can see you are already a master in the fine art of attacking, perhaps you have come to me to purchase a Cape of Attack, and thus join the elite few who have mastered this exacting skill?
translation: Ah, ama görüyorum ki sen saldiri sanatinda zaten bir ustasin, belki de bana saldiri pelerini satin almak icin geldin ve böylece bu zorlu beceriyi ustalasmis az sayidaki seckinlere katilmak istiyorsun?

english: When wearing this cape, Kamfreena will recognize your ability and allow you to access her Cyclopes without the need for guild tokens.
translation: Bu pelerini giydiginde, Kamfreena yetenegini fark edecek ve lonca jetonlarina ihtiyac duymadan onun Cyclopes'una erismene izin verecek.

english: May I buy a Skillcape of Attack, please?
translation: Saldiri beceri pelerini satin alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: Most certainly; unfortunately being such a prestigious item, they are appropriately expensive. I'm afraid I must ask you for the princely sum of 99000 gold!
translation: Elbette; ne yazik ki bu kadar prestijli bir esya oldugu icin fiyati da oldukca yüksek. Korkarim ki sizden 99.000 altin gibi yüklü bir meblag talep etmek zorundayim!

english: 99000! Are you mad?
Not at all; there are many other adventurers who would love the opportunity to purchase such a prestigious item! You can find me here if you change your mind.
translation: Hic de degil; böyle prestijli bir esyayi satin alma firsatini kacirmak istemeyecek bircok maceraci var! Fikrinizi degistirirseniz beni burada bulabilirsiniz.

english: I would gladly pay such a paltry sum for a splendid cape.
translation: Böyle muhtesem bir pelerin icin bu kadar cüzi bir miktari seve seve öderim.

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: Ama maalesef yanimda yeterince param yok.

english: Well come back and see me when you do.
translation: Paran oldugunda tekrar gelip beni gör.

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: Maalesef tüm Skillcapes sadece ücretsiz bir baslik ile satiliyor, bu bir beceri promosyonunun parcasi; bir alana bir bedava, bilirsin. Yani sana bir tane satabilmem icin önce envanterinde yer acman gerekiyor.

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: Harika! O pelerini gururla giy dostum.

english: May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: Pelerinim icin bir baslik daha alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
Ajjat hands you another hood for your skillcape.
translation: Ajjat, Skillcape'in icin baska bir baslik verir.

english: Can you tell me about skillcapes, please?
translation: Skillcape'ler hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin lütfen?

english: Black Knight? Why are you here?
What's the Dummy Room all about?
May I claim my tokens please?
Bye!
May I buy a Skillcape of Attack, please?
translation: Saldiri Beceri Pelerini satin alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: 99000 gold! Are you mad?
I would gladly pay such a paltry sum for a splendid cape.
translation: Muhtesem bir pelerin icin bu kadar cüzi bir miktari seve seve öderim.

english: Skillcape
Hood
Thank you for the translation manual, Ak-Haranu - it may save many souls before long.
translation: Ceviri kilavuzu icin tesekkürler, Ak-Haranu. Yakinda bircok kisinin hayatini kurtarabilir.

english: And Ak-Haranu thanks you for kind gift of longbow.
translation: Ak-Haranu da uzun yay hediyen icin tesekkür ediyor.

english: Hi there!
Why, helloooo!
A camel?
Well this is grand darling. How nice it is to make your acquaintance!
translation: Bu harika sevgilim. Tanistigimiza cok memnun oldum!

english: Thank you. Nice to meet you too.
translation: Tesekkürler. Ben de tanistigimiza memnun oldum.

english: Wait a minute. How am I talking to you without a Camulet?
translation: Bir dakika. Camulet olmadan seninle nasil konusuyorum?

english: My dear, I'm a camel, how should I know?
translation: Canim, ben bir deve'yim, nereden bileyim?

english: Hmmm. I suppose this spell must tap directly into your mind. So, there's no need for language to get in the way.
translation: Hmmm. Sanirim bu büyü dogrudan zihnine ulasiyor. Yani, dilin engel olmasi gerekmiyor.

english: I think I am somewhat confused.
May one ask how you contacted me?
I'm just using one of the Lunar spells.
Oh my, oh my. These youngsters today and their new-fangled gadgets!
translation: Aman tanrim, aman tanrim. Bugünün gencleri ve onlarin yeni moda aletleri!

english: Hello Effendi!
I am Al Shabim, greetings on behalf of the Bedabin nomads.
translation: Ben Al Shabim, Bedabin göcebeleri adina selamlarimi sunuyorum.

english: Who are you?
I am Al Shabim Effendi! I am the leader of the Bedabin peoples!
translation: Ben Al Shabim Efendi! Bedabin halkinin lideriyim!

english: Okay Thanks!
Good day Effendi!
What is there to do around here?
Well, we are all very busy most of the time, tending to the pineapples. They are grown in a secret location, to stop thieves from raiding our most precious prize.
translation: Sey, cogu zaman hepimiz cok mesgulüz, ananaslarla ilgileniyoruz. Ananaslar, hirsizlarin en degerli hazinemizi yagmalamasini önlemek icin gizli bir yerde yetistiriliyor.

english: What is this place?
This is the home of the Bedabin. We're a peaceful tribe of desert dwellers. Some idiots call us 'Tenti's', a childish name borne of ignorance.
translation: Burasi Bedabin'lerin evi. Biz bariscil bir cöl halkiyiz. Bazi aptallar bize “Tenti” diyor, bu cahillikten kaynaklanan cocukca bir isim.

english: We're renowned for surviving in the harshest desert climate. We also grow the 'Bedabin ambrosia.'... A pineapple of such delicious sumptiousness that it defies description.
translation: En zorlu cöl ikliminde hayatta kalmamizla ünlüyüz. Ayrica “Bedabin ambrosia” yetistiriyoruz... Tarif edilemeyecek kadar lezzetli ve muhtesem bir ananas.

english: Take a look around our camp if you like!
I am Al Shabim, greetings on behalf of the Bedabin nomads. Now... what can I do for you?
translation: Ben Al Shabim, Bedabin göcebeleri adina selamlarimi sunarim. Simdi... sizin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: I am looking for a pineapple.
Oh yes, well that is interesting. Our sweet pineapples are renowned throughout the whole of Kharid ! And I'll give you one if you do me a favour?
translation: Oh evet, bu ilginc. Tatli ananaslarimiz tüm Kharid'de ünlüdür! Bana bir iyilik yaparsaniz size bir tane veririm.

english: Oh yes?
Captain Siad at the mining camp is holding some secret information. It is very important to us and we would like you to get it for us. It gives details of an interesting, yet ancient weapon.
translation: Maden kampindaki Kaptan Siad bazi gizli bilgiler sakliyor. Bu bilgi bizim icin cok önemli ve onu bizim icin almani istiyoruz. Ilginc ama eski bir silahla ilgili ayrintilar iceriyor.

english: We would gladly share this information with you. All you have to do is gain access to his private room upstairs. We have a key for the chest that contains this information. Are you interested in our deal?
translation: Bu bilgiyi seninle memnuniyetle paylasiriz. Tek yapman gereken, üst kattaki özel odasina girmek. Bu bilgilerin bulundugu sandigin anahtari bizde. Teklifimizle ilgileniyor musun?

english: Yes, I'm interested.
That's great Effendi!
Here is a copy of the key that should give you access to the chest.
translation: Iste sandiga erismenizi saglayacak anahtarin bir kopyasi.

english: Bring us back the plans inside the chest, they should be sealed. All haste to you Effendi!
translation: Sandigin icindeki planlari bize geri getirin, mühürlenmis olmalilar. Acele edin Effendi!

english: Not at the moment.
Very well Effendi!
What is this place?
Who are you?
How are things going Effendi?
I've lost the key!
How very careless of you! Here is another key, don't lose it this time !
translation: Ne kadar dikkatsizsin! Iste baska bir anahtar, bu sefer kaybetme!

english: Goodbye!
Very well, good day Effendi!
Aha! I see you have the plans. This is great! However, these plans do indeed look very technical. My people have further need of your skills.
translation: Aha! Planlari almissin. Harika! Ancak bu planlar gercekten cok teknik görünüyor. Adamlarimin senin becerilerine daha fazla ihtiyaci var.

english: If you can help us to manufacture this item, we will share its secret with you. Does this deal interest you effendi?
translation: Bu esyayi üretmemize yardim edersen, sirrini seninle paylasiriz. Bu anlasma ilgini cekti mi Effendi?

english: Yes, I'm very interested.
Great, we need the following items: a bar of pure bronze, 10 feathers and a hammer. Bring them to me and we'll continue to make the item.
translation: Harika, su esyalara ihtiyacimiz var: bir parca saf bronz, 10 tüy ve bir cekic. Bunlari bana getirin, esyayi yapmaya devam edelim.

english: Great, we need the following items: a bar of pure bronze and 10 feathers. Bring them to me and we'll continue to make the item.
translation: Harika, su esyalara ihtiyacimiz var: bir parca saf bronz ve 10 tüy. Bunlari bana getirin, esyayi yapmaya devam edelim.

english: Great, I can see that you have a bar of bronze. Now we just need some feathers and a hammer before we can continue.
translation: Harika, bir parca bronzunuz oldugunu görüyorum. Devam edebilmemiz icin simdi sadece birkac tüy ve bir cekic lazim.

english: Great, I can see that you have some feathers. Now we just need a bar of bronze and a hammer before we can continue.
translation: Harika, birkac tüyün oldugunu görüyorum. Simdi devam edebilmemiz icin bir bronz cubuk ve bir cekic gerekiyor.

english: Great, I can see that you have a bar of bronze. Now we just need some feathers before we can continue.
translation: Harika, bir bronz cubugun oldugunu görüyorum. Simdi devam edebilmemiz icin birkac tüy gerekiyor.

english: Great, I can see that you have some feathers. Now we just need a bar of bronze before we can continue.
translation: Harika, birkac tüyün oldugunu görüyorum. Simdi devam edebilmemiz icin bir bronz cubuk gerekiyor.

english: Great, I can see that you have some feathers and a bar of Bronze, but you just need a hammer now.
translation: Harika, tüylerin ve bronz cubugun oldugunu görüyorum, ama simdi bir cekic lazim.

english: Great, I can see that you have some feathers, a bar of Bronze and a hammer. Are you still willing to help make the weapon?
translation: Harika, tüylerin, bronz cubugun ve cekicin oldugunu görüyorum. Hala silah yapmaya yardim etmek istiyor musun?

english: Yes, I'm kind of curious.
Okay Effendi, you need to follow the plans. You will need some special tools for this...  There is an anvil in the other tent. You have my permission to use it, but show the plans to the guard.
translation: Tamam Effendi, planlari takip etmelisin. Bunun icin bazi özel aletlere ihtiyacin olacak... Diger cadirda bir örs var. Onu kullanmana izin veriyorum, ama planlari muhafizlara göster.

english: You have the plans and all the items needed. You should be able to complete the item on your own. Please bring me the item when it is finished.
translation: Planlar ve gerekli tüm malzemeler sende. Bu esyayi kendi basina tamamlayabilirsin. Bitirdiginde bana getir lütfen.

english: No, sorry.
As you wish Effendi!
Come back if you change your mind!
Wonderful, I see you have made the new weapon!
This is truly fantastic Effendi!
But we will need the technical plans from you Effendi. If we are going to perfect this weapon.
translation: Ama bu silahi mükemmellestirmek icin teknik planlara ihtiyacimiz var Effendi.

english: We will take the technical plans for the weapon as well.
We are forever grateful for this gift. My advisors have discovered some secrets which we will share with you.
translation: Bu hediye icin sonsuza kadar minnettariz. Danismanlarim bazi sirlar kesfettiler, bunlari sizinle paylasacagiz.

english: Al Shabim's advisors show you some advanced techniques for making the new weapon.
translation: Al Shabim'in danismanlari size yeni silahi yapmak icin bazi ileri teknikler gösterir.

english: Please accept this selection of six bronze throwing darts as a token of our appreciation.
translation: Lütfen bu alti bronz firlatma okunu minnettarligimizin bir göstergesi olarak kabul edin.

english: I'll take that key off your hands as well effendi! Many thanks!
translation: O anahtari da alayim efendim! Cok tesekkürler!

english: Oh, and here is your pineapple!
Many thanks with your help previously Effendi!
translation: Daha önceki yardimlariniz icin cok tesekkürler efendim!

english: I am looking for a pineapple.
Here is another pineapple, try not to lose this one.
translation: Iste bir ananas daha, bunu kaybetmemeye calisin.

english: Okay thanks!
What is there to do around here?
Okay Thanks!
Yes, I'm interested.
Not at the moment.
I've lost the key!
Goodbye!
Yes, I'm very interested.
Yes, I'm kind of curious.
No, sorry.
I'm sorry to bother you, but could you spare me a little dung?
translation: Rahatsiz ettigim icin özür dilerim, ama bana biraz gübre verebilir misiniz?

english: The camel didn't seem to appreciate that question.
translation: Deve bu soruyu pek begenmedi gibi görünüyor.

english: If I go near that camel, it'll probably bite my hand off.
translation: O deveye yaklasirsam, muhtemelen elimi isirir.

english: Mmm... looks like that camel would make a nice kebab.
translation: Mmm... bu deve güzel bir kebap olur gibi görünüyor.

english: I wonder if that camel has fleas...
Are you serious?
Oh yes. If you'd be so kind...
Well, just you close your eyes first. I'm not doing it while you're watching me!
translation: Önce gözlerini kapat. Sen izlerken yapmam!

english: I hope that's what you wanted!
Ohhh yes. Lovely.
Sorry, were you saying something to me?
translation: Pardon, bana bir sey mi söylüyordun?

english: No, er, nothing important.
Never mind, it is unimportant when I have such important matters weighing on my soul.
translation: Bos ver, ruhumu agirlastiran bu kadar önemli meseleler varken önemsizdir.

english: How important can a camel's problems be?
translation: Bir devenin sorunlari ne kadar önemli olabilir ki?

english: Well, you see, there is a camel called Elly. A beautiful, wondrous camel, with hide like spun gold and teeth that shine like an oasis.
translation: Sey, Elly adinda bir deve var. Altin gibi parlak derisi ve vaha gibi parlayan disleri olan güzel, muhtesem bir deve.

english: ...I see.
I've written many poems describing her beauty. Would you like to hear one?
translation: Onun güzelligini anlatan bircok siir yazdim. Birini dinlemek ister misin?

english: It's all right, I'm...
Shall I compare thee to a desert's day? Thou art drier and more rough-skinned.
translation: Seni cölün bir gününe benzetebilir miyim? Sen daha kuru ve daha pürüzlü bir deriye sahipsin.

english: Rough sandstorms shake the cactuses away And summer's heat defers to autumn wind.
translation: Sert kum firtinalari kaktüsleri sarsar Ve yazin sicagi sonbahar rüzgarina yerini birakir.

english: Look, I don't really have the time to...
Sometimes too hot the eye of heaven shines, With Guthix' gold complexion often dimmed;
translation: Bazen gökyüzünün gözü cok sicak parlar, Guthix'in altin rengi teni sik sik kararir;

english: And every fair from fair sometime declines, By chance or desert's changing course untrimmed...
translation: Ve her güzellik bir gün güzelligini yitirir, Sans eseri ya da cölün degisen akisiyla...

english: Please, stop.
But I've only got six lines left!
That's six too many. If I really want to hear your poetry, I'll tell you, okay?
translation: Alti satir bile fazla. Siirini gercekten dinlemek istersem sana söylerim, tamam mi?

english: Very well. Come back and talk to me if you want to hear more.
translation: Peki. Daha fazlasini duymak istersen geri gel ve benimle konus.

english: Oh, it's you again. Have you come back to listen to my poems?
translation: Oh, yine sen. Siirlerimi dinlemek icin mi geri geldin?

english: I'd love to!
That's so kind of you. Which one would you like to hear?
'Shall I compare thee to a desert's day' is my finest yet, but I've also composed others.
translation: “Seni cölün gününe benzetebilir miyim” benim en iyi siirim, ama baska siirler de yazdim.

english: That's my favourite poem. Ahem...
translation: Bu benim en sevdigim siir. Ahem...

english: But thine eternal desert shall not fade Nor lose possession of that sand thou owest;
translation: Ama senin ebedi cölün solmayacak, Sahip oldugun kumlari kaybetmeyecek;

english: Nor Zamorak brag thou art in his shades, When in eternal lines to sand thou growest,
translation: Zamorak da senin onun gölgesinde oldugunu övünmeyecek, Ebedi satirlarda kuma dönüstügünde,

english: So long as camels breathe or eyes can see, So long lives this, and this gives life to thee.
translation: Develer nefes aldigi ve gözler görebildigi sürece, Bu siir yasayacak ve sana hayat verecek.

english: Ah, Elly, how beautiful you are.
What does Elly think of your poems?
She's never heard them.
Why not?
I suspect she loves another - Ollie, another camel who roams with her to the north.
translation: Sanirim baska birini seviyor - Ollie, onunla birlikte kuzeye göc eden baska bir deve.

english: So I shall stay here and compose poems for her.
translation: Bu yüzden burada kalip onun icin siirler yazacagim.

english: Why not tell her how you feel?
She seems happy enough as she is, and I have my poems to comfort me.
translation: O oldugu gibi mutlu görünüyor ve beni teselli eden siirlerim var.

english: Well, best of luck with that.
If you want to hear my poems once more, please come back again.
translation: Siirlerimi bir kez daha dinlemek istersen, lütfen tekrar gel.

english: I wrote this poem when I went to the oasis to nibble at a tree, then discovered I'd left nothing for Elly to nibble. I was distraught.
translation: Bu siiri, bir agaci kemirmek icin vahaya gittigimde yazdim, sonra Elly'nin kemirecek bir sey birakmadigimi fark ettim. Cok üzüldüm.

english: This Is Just To Say
I have nibbled the cacti that were by the oasis,
and which you were probably saving for lunch.
Forgive me, they were delicious, so crunchy and so cold.
translation: Affet beni, cok lezzetliydiler, cok gevrek ve cok soguktu.

english: I wonder if she's forgiven me for eating her snack.
translation: Onun atistirmaligini yedigim icin beni affetmis mi acaba?

english: No, thank you.
Ah, well. I shall return to writing poems to Elly's beauty.
translation: Ah, peki. Elly'nin güzelligi hakkinda siir yazmaya geri dönecegim.

english: Ask the camel about its dung.
Say something unpleasant.
Neither - I'm a polite person.
translation: Ikisi de degil - ben kibar biriyim.

english: I'd love to!
Listen to 'Shall I compare thee to a desert's day'.
Why not tell her how you feel?
Well, best of luck with that.
Listen to 'This Is Just To Say'.
No, thank you.
Would you look after my crops for me?
I might - which patch were you thinking of?
You don't have any seeds planted in that patch. Plant some and I might agree to look after it for you.
translation: O tarlada ekili tohum yok. Biraz ekin, o zaman senin icin bakmayi kabul edebilirim.

english: That patch is diseased - you should cure it before asking me to be responsible for it!
translation: O tarla hastalikli - benden sorumlu olmami istemeden önce onu iyilestirmelisin!

english: That patch is dead - it's too late for me to do anything about it now.
translation: O tarla öldü, artik bir sey yapmam icin cok gec.

english: That patch is already fully grown! I don't know what you want me to do with it!
translation: O tarla zaten tamamen büyümüs! Onunla ne yapmami istiyorsun bilmiyorum!

english: I'm already looking after that patch for you.
translation: O tarlaya zaten senin icin bakiyorum.

english: If you like, but I want [payment] for that.
I'm afraid I don't have any of those at the moment.
Well, I'm not wasting my time for free.
Okay, it's a deal.
That'll do nicely, [sir/madam]. Leave it with me - I'll make sure that patch grows for you.
translation: Bu cok iyi olur, . Bana birakin, o parselin sizin icin büyümesi icin elimden geleni yapacagim.

english: No, that's too much.
Poison ivy bushes don't get diseased, so you needn't worry about having it protected.
translation: Zehirli sarmasik calilari hastalanmaz, bu yüzden onlari korumak icin endiselenmenize gerek yok.

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: Bana tarimla ilgili tavsiyelerde bulunabilir misiniz?

english: You can put up to ten potatoes, cabbages or onions in vegetable sacks, although you can't have a mix in the same sack.
translation: Sebze cuvallarina en fazla on adet patates, lahana veya sogan koyabilirsiniz, ancak ayni cuvalda farkli türleri karistiramazsiniz.

english: You can put up to five tomatoes, strawberries, apples, bananas or oranges into a fruit basket, although you can't have a mix in the same basket.
translation: Meyve sepetine en fazla bes adet domates, cilek, elma, muz veya portakal koyabilirsiniz, ancak ayni sepette farkli türleri karistiramazsiniz.

english: You can buy all the farming tools from farming shops, which can be found close to the allotments.
translation: Tüm tarim aletlerini, bahcelerin yakininda bulunan tarim dükkanlarindan satin alabilirsiniz.

english: You can fill plantpots with soil from any empty patch, if you have a gardening trowel.
translation: Bahce küreginiz varsa, saksilari herhangi bir bos alandan aldiginiz toprakla doldurabilirsiniz.

english: Tree seeds must be grown in a plantpot of soil into a sapling, and then transferred to a tree patch to continue growing to adulthood.
translation: Agac tohumlari, saksidaki toprakta fidan haline getirilmeli ve daha sonra yetiskinlige kadar büyümeye devam etmesi icin agac alanina aktarilmalidir.

english: If you want to make your own sacks and baskets you'll need to use the loom that's near the Farming shop in Falador. If you're a good enough [craftswoman/craftsman], that is.
translation: Kendi cuvallarinizi ve sepetlerinizi yapmak istiyorsaniz, Falador'daki Tarim dükkaninin yakinindaki dokuma tezgahini kullanmaniz gerekir. Tabii yeterince iyi bir [zanaatkar]saniz.

english: You don't have to buy all your plantpots you know, you can make them yourself on a pottery wheel. If you're a good enough [craftswoman/craftsman], that is.
translation: Tüm saksilari satin almaniza gerek yok, cömlek carkinda kendiniz yapabilirsiniz. Tabii yeterince iyi bir [zanaatkar]saniz.

english: Don't just throw away your weeds after you've raked a patch - put them in a compost bin and make some compost.
translation: Bir alani tirmikladiktan sonra yabani otlari atmayin, kompost kutusuna koyun ve kompost yapin.

english: Applying compost to a patch will not only reduce the chance that your crops will get diseased, but you will also grow more crops to harvest.
translation: Kompostu topraga uygulamak, mahsulünüzün hastalanma olasiligini azaltmakla kalmaz, ayni zamanda daha fazla mahsul yetistirmenizi de saglar.

english: Supercompost is far better than normal compost, but more expensive to make. You need to rot the right type of item; show me an item, and I'll tell you if it's super- compostable or not.
translation: Süper kompost normal komposttan cok daha iyidir, ancak yapimi daha pahalidir. Dogru türdeki ögeleri cürütebilmeniz gerekir; bana bir ögeyi gösterin, süper kompostlanabilir olup olmadigini size söyleyeyim.

english: Vegetables, hops and flowers need constant watering - if you ignore my advice, you will sooner or later find yourself in possession of a dead farming patch.
translation: Sebzeler, serbetciotu ve cicekler sürekli sulanmaya ihtiyac duyar - tavsiyemi dikkate almazsaniz, er ya da gec kendinizi ölü bir tarim arazisiyle karsi karsiya bulursunuz.

english: The only way to cure a bush or tree of disease is to prune away the diseased leaves with a pair of secateurs. For all other crops I would just apply some plant-cure.
translation: Bir cali veya agaci hastaliktan kurtarmanin tek yolu, hastalikli yapraklari bir budama makasi ile budamaktir. Diger tüm mahsuller icin ise bitki ilaci kullanmanizi öneririm.

english: There are five other Farming areas like this one - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Kragen's area near Ardougne, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius and Oswallt's area
translation: Bunun gibi bes tane daha tarim alani var: Falador yakinlarindaki Elstan'in alani, Catherby yakinlarindaki Dantaera'nin alani, Ardougne yakinlarindaki Kragen'in alani, Morytania'daki Lyra'nin alani, Hosidius'daki Marisi'nin alani ve Prifddinas'daki Oswallt'in alani.

english: in Prifddinas.
translation: Meyve agaclari yetistirmek istiyorsaniz birkac yeri deneyebilirsiniz: Catherby, Brimhaven, Gnome Stronghold ve Farming Guild'de meyve agaclari yetistirme alanlari var.

english: If you want to grow fruit trees you could try a few places: Catherby, Brimhaven, Gnome Stronghold and the Farming Guild all have fruit tree patches.
translation: Meyve agaclari yetistirmek istiyorsaniz birkac yeri deneyebilirsiniz: Catherby, Brimhaven, Gnome Stronghold ve Farming Guild'de meyve agaclari yetistirilen alanlar vardir.

english: Hops are good for brewing ales. I believe there's a brewery up in Keldagrim somewhere, and I've heard rumours that a place called Phasmatys used to be good for that type of thing. 'Fore they all died, of course.
translation: Serbetciotu, bira yapiminda kullanilir. Keldagrim'de bir bira fabrikasi oldugunu saniyorum ve Phasmatys adli bir yerin eskiden bu tür seyler icin uygun oldugu söylentileri duydum. Tabii ki hepsi ölmeden önce.

english: Bittercap mushrooms can only be grown in a special patch in Morytania, near the Mort Myre swamp. There the ground is especially dank and suited to growing poisonous fungii.
translation: Bittercap mantarlari sadece Morytania'da, Mort Myre batakliginin yakinindaki özel bir alanda yetistirilebilir. Orada toprak özellikle nemli ve zehirli mantarlarin yetismesine uygundur.

english: There is a special patch for growing Belladonna - I believe that it is somewhere near Draynor Manor, where the ground is a tad 'unblessed'.
translation: Belladonna yetistirmek icin özel bir alan var - sanirim Draynor Manor yakinlarinda, topragin biraz ‘kutsanmamis’ oldugu bir yerde.

english: Can you sell me something?
That depends on whether I have it to sell. What is it that you're looking for?
translation: Satacak bir seyim olup olmadigina bagli. Ne ariyorsun?

english: Some plant cure.
Plant cure, eh? I might have some put aside for myself. Tell you what, I'll sell you some plant cure for 25 coins if you like.
translation: Bitki ilaci, ha? Kendim icin bir miktar ayirmis olabilirim. Bak ne diyecegim, istersen sana 25 sikkeye bitki ilaci satarim.

english: Yes, that sounds like a fair price.
translation: Evet, bu makul bir fiyat gibi görünüyor.

english: No thanks, I can get that much cheaper elsewhere.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, baska yerden daha ucuza alabilirim.

english: A bucket of compost.
A bucket of compost, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 35 coins if you like.
translation: Bir kova kompost, ha? Yedek bir tane olabilir... Bak ne diyecegim, istersen 35 sikkeye satarim.

english: A rake.
A rake, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: Tirmik, ha? Yedek bir tane olabilir... Bak ne diyecegim, istersen 15 sikkeye satarim.

english: A plant pot.
Eh, I suppose I can spare you a plant pot, but I'll want 40 coins for it.
translation: Eh, sanirim sana bir saksi verebilirim, ama 40 sikke istiyorum.

english: A watering can.
A watering can, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 25 coins if you like.
translation: Bir sulama kabi, ha? Yedek bir tane olabilir... Bak ne diyecegim, istersen 25 sikkeye satarim.

english: A gardening trowel.
A gardening trowel, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: Bir bahce küregi, ha? Yedek bir tane olabilir... Bak ne diyecegim, istersen 15 sikkeye satarim.

english: A seed dibber.
A seed dibber, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: Tohum ekme cubugu, ha? Yedek bir tane olabilir... Bak ne diyecegim, istersen 15 sikkeye satarim.

english: Forget it, you don't have anything I need.
translation: Bos ver, ihtiyacim olan hicbir seyin yok.

english: I'll come back another time.
Which patch would you like to pay protection for?
translation: Hangi tarlaya koruma ücreti ödemek istersin?

english: I want [payment] for that.
Would you look after my crops for me?
The Cactus Patch
Okay, it's a deal.
No, that's too much.
Okay, it's a deal and don't ask again.
translation: Tamam, anlastik ve bir daha sorma.

english: The Northern Allotment Patch
The Southern Allotment Patch
The Bush Patch

translation: Bana tarimla ilgili tavsiyelerde bulunabilir misin?

Some plant cure.
Yes, that sounds like a fair price.
translation: Evet, bu makul bir fiyat gibi görünüyor.

english: No thanks, I can get that much cheaper elsewhere.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, baska yerde daha ucuza bulabilirim.

english: A bucket of compost.
A rake.
A plant pot.

A watering can.

(See previous items)
Forget it.
I'll come back another time.
Nilsal, iknami! Do you need help with anything?
translation: Nilsal, iknami! Yardima ihtiyacin var mi?

english: What do you do around here?
I spend a lot of my time researching new product formulas for the lab. Just over here we have a batch of something new that I've dubbed 'Earworm'.
translation: Laboratuvar icin yeni ürün formülleri arastirmakla cok zaman geciriyorum. Burada, “Earworm” adini verdigim yeni bir ürünümüz var.

english: Ear... Worm...?
Indeed! Its effects produce musical auditory hallucinations! Soon, people will be able to listen to music while on the go. It'll sell like hotcakes!
translation: Aynen öyle! Bu ürün, müzikal isitsel halüsinasyonlar yaratiyor! Yakinda insanlar hareket halindeyken müzik dinleyebilecekler. Bu ürün cok satacak!

english: Thanks! I'd better be going now.
Our main focus is the advancement of Herblore through scientific study.
translation: Ana odak noktamiz, bilimsel calismalar yoluyla bitki biliminin ilerletilmesidir.

english: As for an end goal... that information is only for senior members.
translation: Nihai hedefimiz ise... bu bilgi sadece kidemli üyeler icin gecerlidir.

english: Perhaps in time, you will learn of it!
Nothing. I'll be going now.
What do you do around here?
Thanks! I'd better be going now.
What are the goals of the Alchemical Society?
Nothing. I'll be going now.
Nilsal, iknami. I can't stop to talk I'm afraid. We're having trouble with one of the alpacas again
translation: Nilsal, iknami. Konusmaya devam edemem maalesef. Yine alpaka ile sorun yasiyoruz.

english: Nilsal, iknami. Anything I can do for you today?
translation: Nilsal, iknami. Bugün senin için yapabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: No thanks. I'm just passing through.
Well in that case, have a good day, iknami.
Roaaaaaaaaaaar!
Hi.
Greetings young one. What wisdom do you seek?
translation: Selam genc dostum. Ne tür bir bilgelik ariyorsun?

english: What do I have to do in this room?

In this room you will see various cupboards. It is your task to search the cupboards to find items to turn into gold using your low or high alchemy spells. You can deposit the money in the receptacle at the end of the
translation: Bu odada cesitli dolaplar göreceksin. Görevin, dolaplari arayarak düsük veya yüksek kimya büyülerini kullanarak altina dönüstürebilecegin esyalari bulmak. Alchemist Pizazz Puanlarini almak icin parayi koridorun sonundaki kutuya yatirabilirsin.

english: hall in order to receive your Alchemist Pizazz Points. This money is used for the upkeep of the training arena as well as magic shops all around Gielinor. Keep an eye on the costs of each item as these will change
translation: Bu para, Gielinor'daki egitim arenalarinin ve büyü dükkanlarinin bakim masraflari icin kullanilir. Bu para, Gielinor'daki egitim arenasi ve sihir dükkanlarinin bakiminda kullanilir. Her ögenin maliyeti zaman zaman degisebileceginden, ögelerin yerleri de degisebileceginden, bunlarin maliyetlerini takip et.

english: from time-to-time, as will the location of the items. Occasionally one of the items will be indicated as costing no runestones to convert to money.
translation: Bazen ögelerden biri, paraya dönüstürmek icin runestone gerektirmedigi belirtilir.

english: How will I be rewarded?

You will get magic experience from casting the alchemist spells, as well as 1 Alchemist Pizazz Point for every 100 coins you deposit, and 10% of the coins you deposit will be given to you as you leave. Keep in mind that you
translation: Alchemist büyülerini kullanarak büyü deneyimi kazanacak ve yatirdiginiz her 100 jeton icin 1 Alchemist Pizazz Puani alacaksiniz. Ayrica, yatirdiginiz jetonlarin %10'u ayrilirken size verilecektir.

english: will not be able to take more than 1000 coins back out with you.
Got any tips that may help me?
translation: Bana yardimci olabilecek herhangi bir ipucu var mi?

english: You must remember to keep an eye on the various costs of the items. If you watch the movements of the other players, you might be able to guess which are the best places to visit. You will get 1 Pizazz Point for
translation: Ögelerin cesitli maliyetlerini takip etmeyi unutmayin. Diger oyuncularin hareketlerini izlerseniz, hangi yerlerin ziyaret etmek icin en uygun oldugunu tahmin edebilirsiniz. Her 100 jeton icin 1 Pizazz Puani kazanacaksiniz,

english: every 100 coins, so if you have 190 coins, why not get an extra 10?
translation: yani 190 jetonunuz varsa, neden 10 jeton daha kazanmayasiniz?

english: I see.

Oh, and a word of warning: should you decide to leave this room by a method other than the exit portals, you will be teleported to the entrance and have any items that you picked up in the room removed, but the gold
translation: Oh, ve bir uyari: cikis portallarindan baska bir yöntemle bu odadan ayrilmaya karar verirseniz, girise isinlanacaksiniz ve odada topladiginiz tüm esyalariniz alinacak, ancak kazandiginiz altin

english: coins and Pizazz points you earned will be granted.
translation: paralar ve Pizazz puanlari size verilecektir.

english: Thanks, bye!
Use what you've learned, young one.
What do I have to do in this room?
How will I be rewarded?
Got any tips that may help me?
translation: Bana yardimci olabilecek herhangi bir ipucun var mi?

english: Thanks, bye!
Greetings, adventurer. Welcome to the Myths' Guild.
translation: Selamlar, maceraci. Mitler Loncasina hos geldin.

english: Tell me about the guild.
The Myths' Guild is home to those who wish to uncover the lost secrets of this world. We investigate the myths of these lands to see if any facts may be hidden within them.
translation: Mitler Loncasi, bu dünyanin kayip sirlarini ortaya cikarmak isteyenlerin yuvasidir. Bu topraklardaki mitleri arastirarak, icinde gizli gercekler olup olmadigini inceliyoruz.

english: Here, we discover things that others only dream of. However, the cost of entry is not insignificant. Only the most worthy may share in our secrets.
translation: Burada, baskalarinin sadece hayalini kurdugu seyleri kesfediyoruz. Ancak, giris ücreti önemsiz degildir. Sadece en layik olanlar sirlarimizi paylasabilir.

english: Am I worthy?
Not yet. However, that could well change.
translation: Henüz degil. Ancak bu durum degisebilir.

english: For as long as history remembers, dragons have roamed these lands, but despite how long they've been here, much of their history remains hidden.
translation: Tarihin hatirladigi kadariyla, ejderhalar bu topraklarda dolasmaktadir, ancak ne kadar uzun süredir burada olsalar da, tarihlerinin cogu gizli kalmistir.

english: There are tales of course, but tales are not enough for us. We want you to discover the truth. Where did the dragons come from? Why are they here? Who do they serve?
translation: Elbette efsaneler var, ama efsaneler bizim icin yeterli degil. Gercegi kesfetmenizi istiyoruz. Ejderhalar nereden geldi? Neden buradalar? Kime hizmet ediyorlar?

english: Answer these questions for us. Help us fill our Library of Knowledge. In return, we will grant you access to the guild and you will reap the rewards within.
translation: Bu sorulari bizim icin cevaplayin. Bilgi Kütüphanemizi doldurmamiza yardim edin. Karsiliginda, size loncaya erisim izni verecegiz ve icindeki ödülleri toplayacaksiniz.

english: So, do you feel up for the challenge?
translation: Peki, bu zorlu göreve hazir misiniz?

english: Yes. Where should I begin?
Head to Karamja Wines, Spirits, and Beers at Musa Point. There you'll find Dallas Jones. We've heard that he is investigating the destruction of Crandor. This seems like a good place to start.
translation: Musa Point'teki Karamja Saraplari, Alkollü Icecekler ve Biralar'a git. Orada Dallas Jones'u bulacaksin. Crandor'un yikimini arastirdigini duyduk. Burasi baslamak icin iyi bir yer gibi görünüyor.

english: Good luck.
No. This is too much for me.
translation: Hayir. Bu benim icin cok fazla.

english: As you wish. If you change your mind, you know where we are.
translation: Nasil istersen. Fikrini degistirirsen, nerede oldugumuzu biliyorsun.

english: Absolutely. You've proven your worth to the guild and may enter whenever you please.
translation: Elbette. Loncaya degerini kanitladin ve istedigin zaman girebilirsin.

english: How can I gain access to the guild?
Only the most worthy are allowed access into the Myths' Guild. If you wish to enter, you'll need to prove yourself.
translation: Sadece en degerli olanlar Myths' Guild'e girebilir. Girmek istiyorsan, kendini kanitlaman gerekir.

english: How can I do that?
As time passes, that which was once fact, becomes myth. Some tales are just that, tales. However, some tales are something more.
translation: Zaman gectikce, bir zamanlar gercek olan seyler efsaneye dönüsür. Bazi hikayeler sadece hikayedir. Ancak bazi hikayeler daha fazlasidir.

english: Here at the Myths' Guild, we live to tell the difference between the two. If you wish to join us, you must do the same.
translation: Mitler Loncasi'nda, ikisi arasindaki farki anlatmak icin yasiyoruz. Bize katilmak istiyorsan, sen de aynisini yapmalisin.

english: So what myth would you like me to investigate?
Let's talk about my quest.
How are things progressing?
I'm yet to discover anything.
Well return to us once you do. If you help us fill our Library of Knowledge, we shall grant you access to the guild.
translation: Kesfettiginde bize geri dön. Bilgi Kütüphanemizi doldurmamiza yardim edersen, loncaya giris izni verecegiz.

english: I'm investigating the origin of Elvarg. I've found some old doors on a ruined island but they're locked. I'm trying to find the key.
translation: Elvarg'in kökenini arastiriyorum. Harabeye dönmüs bir adada eski kapilar buldum ama kilitli. Anahtari bulmaya calisiyorum.

english: Well keep at it. If you help us fill our Library of Knowledge, we shall grant you access to the Guild.
translation: Devam et. Bilgi Kütüphanemizi doldurmamiza yardim edersen, loncaya giris izni verecegiz.

english: I'm investigating the origin of Elvarg. I've found some old doors on a ruined island but they're locked. I think something important lies behind them.
translation: Elvarg'in kökenini arastiriyorum. Harabeye dönmüs bir adada eski kapilar buldum ama kilitli. Arkalarinda önemli bir sey oldugunu düsünüyorum.

english: I was investigating the origin of Elvarg but I accidently released a dragonkin.
translation: Elvarg'in kökenini arastiriyordum ama kazara bir ejderha türü serbest biraktim.

english: Well that can't be good. You'd better sort that out.
translation: Bu hic iyi degil. Bu sorunu cözsen iyi olur.

english: I'm working on it.
Goodbye.
Farewell, adventurer.

translation: Merhaba maceraci. Mitler Loncasina hos geldin.

english: Here you will discover things that others only dream of. The cost of entry is not insignificant though, only the most worthy may share in our secrets.
translation: Burada, baskalarinin sadece hayalini kurdugu seyleri kesfedeceksin. Ancak giris ücreti önemsiz degildir, sadece en layik olanlar sirlarimizi paylasabilir.

english: Not yet. However, that could well change. Go out and hone your skills then return to us.
translation: Henüz degil. Ancak bu durum degisebilir. Disari cik ve becerilerini gelistir, sonra bize geri dön.

english: I'm afraid not. Perhaps that will change one day.
translation: Korkarim ki hayir. Belki bir gün bu durum degisir.

english: For as long as history remembers, dragons have roamed these lands. But despite how long they've been here, much of their history remains hidden.
translation: Tarihin hatirladigi kadariyla, ejderhalar bu topraklarda dolasmaktadir. Ancak ne kadar uzun süredir burada olsalar da, tarihlerinin cogu gizli kalmistir.

english: There are tales of course but tales are not enough for us. We want you to discover the truth. Where did the dragons come from? Why are they here? Who do they serve?
translation: Elbette efsaneler var, ama efsaneler bizim icin yeterli degil. Gercegi kesfetmenizi istiyoruz. Ejderhalar nereden geldi? Neden buradalar? Kime hizmet ediyorlar?

english: Answer these questions for us. Help us fill our Library of Knowledge. In return, we will grant you access to the Guild and you will reap the rewards within.
translation: Bu sorulari bizim icin cevaplayin. Bilgi Kütüphanemizi doldurmamiza yardim edin. Karsiliginda, size Loncaya erisim izni verecegiz ve icindeki ödülleri toplayabileceksiniz.

english: So do you feel up for the challenge?
translation: Peki, bu zorlu göreve hazir misiniz?

english: Head to Karamja Wines, Spirits, and Beers at Musa Point. There you'll find Dallas Jones. We've heard that he is investigating the destruction of Crandor. This seems like a good place to begin.
translation: Musa Point'teki Karamja Saraplari, Alkollü Icecekler ve Biralar'a gidin. Orada Dallas Jones'u bulacaksiniz. Crandor'un yikimini arastirdigini duyduk. Burasi baslamak icin iyi bir yer gibi görünüyor.

english: Not yet. However, you are on the right path. Complete the task we've assigned you and we will allow you entry into the Guild.
translation: Henüz degil. Ancak dogru yoldasiniz. Size verdigimiz görevi tamamlayin, biz de size Lonca'ya giris izni verelim.

english: I'm afraid the Guild is not currently accepting new members. However, we will soon be opening our doors again.
translation: Maalesef, Lonca su anda yeni üye kabul etmiyor. Ancak, yakinda kapilarimizi tekrar acacagiz.

english: When we do, you should return here. We may well have a place for you.
translation: Kapilarimizi actigimizda, buraya geri dönmelisin. Senin icin bir yerimiz olabilir.

english: How can I gain access to the Guild?
Only the most worthy may access our Guild and I'm afraid you are not quite there yet. Go out and hone your skills then return to us.
translation: Sadece en layik olanlar Lonca'ya girebilir ve maalesef sen henüz o noktada degilsin. Disari cik ve becerilerini gelistir, sonra bize geri dön.

english: You do not meet all the requirements to start the Dragon Slayer II quest.
translation: Dragon Slayer II görevine baslamak icin gerekli tüm sartlari saglamiyorsun.

english: Only the most worthy are allowed access into the Myths' Guild. If you want entry, you'll need to prove yourself.
translation: Sadece en layik olanlar Myths' Guild'e kabul edilir. Eger girmek istiyorsan, kendini kanitlaman gerekir.

english: Well return to us once you do. If you help us fill our Library of Knowledge, we shall grant you access to the Guild.
translation: Bunu yaptiginda bize geri dön. Bilgi Kütüphanemizi doldurmamiza yardim edersen, sana Guild'e giris izni verecegiz.

english: Farewell adventurer.
Tell me about the guild.
Yes.
No.
How can I gain access to the guild?
Let's talk about my quest.
Goodbye.
Tell me about the Guild.
How can I gain access to the Guild?
Hello.
Hello, hello, and a most warm welcome to my Hunter Emporium. We have everything the discerning Hunter could need.
translation: Merhaba, merhaba, Avci Magazama hos geldin. Secici avcilarin ihtiyac duyabilecegi her sey bizde var.

english: Would you like me to show you our range of equipment? Or was there something specific you were after?
translation: Size ekipmanlarimizi göstereyim mi? Yoksa aradiginiz belirli bir sey mi var?

english: Ok, let's see what you've got!
I'm not interested, thanks.
Well, if you do ever find yourself in need of the finest Hunter equipment available, then you know where to come.
translation: Eger en iyi avci ekipmanlarina ihtiyaciniz olursa, nereye geleceginizi biliyorsunuz.

english: Who's that guy over there?
Him? I think he might be crazy. Either that or he's seeking attention.
translation: O mu? Sanirim deli olabilir. Ya da dikkat cekmeye calisiyor.

english: He keeps trying to sell me these barmy looking weapons he's invented. I can't see them working, personally.
translation: Bana icat ettigi tuhaf görünümlü silahlari satmaya calisip duruyor. Sahsen bunlarin ise yarayacagini sanmiyorum.

english: Ok, let's see what you've got!
I'm not interested, thanks.
Who's that guy over there?
Who are you?
[Vampyre name].
Not the one I'm expecting. Move along.
Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: Insan! Muhafizlari cagirmadan köle kafeslerine geri dön!

english: I can't believe we've finally arrived, I can't wait to explore!
translation: Sonunda vardigimiza inanamiyorum, kesfetmek icin sabirsizlaniyorum!

english: So much to see, I don't know where to start!
translation: Görülecek o kadar cok sey var ki, nereden baslayacagimi bilemiyorum!

english: A whole new continent to explore... what a time to be
translation: Kesfedilecek yepyeni bir kita... Ne harika bir zaman!

english: Are you the tour guide?
Nope, I'm just as lost as you.
translation: Hayir, ben de senin kadar kayboldum.

english: I overheard someone mention there are pirates and thieves here, be careful!
translation: Burada korsanlar ve hirsizlar oldugunu duydum, dikkatli ol!

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
You don't have a sapling planted in that patch. Plant one and I might agree to look after it for you.
translation: O tarlada dikilmis bir fidan yok. Bir tane dikersen, senin icin ona bakmayi kabul edebilirim.

english: If you like, but I want 6 dragonfruit for that.
translation: Istersen, ama bunun icin 6 tane ejderha meyvesi istiyorum.

english: Okay, it's a deal.
That'll do nicely, sir. Leave it with me - I'll make sure that patch grows for you.
translation: Bu yeterli, efendim. Bana birakin, o tarlanin sizin icin yetismesini saglayacagim.

english: No, that's too much.
Well, I'm not wasting my time for free.
I'm afraid I don't have any of those at the moment.
That patch is already fully grown! I don't know what you want me to do with it!
translation: O parca zaten tamamen büyümüs! Onunla ne yapmami istiyorsun bilmiyorum!

english: These take ages to clear! If you pay me 2000 Coins I'll chop it down for you.
translation: Bunlari temizlemek cok zaman aliyor! Bana 2000 Coin ödersen, senin icin keserim.

english: Here's 2000 Coins - chop my tree down please.
Alexandra sets to work...
I don't want to pay that much, sorry.
translation: O kadar para ödemek istemiyorum, üzgünüm.

english: I don't have 2000 Coins I'm afraid.
Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: Bana tarimla ilgili tavsiyelerde bulunabilir misin?

english: You can put up to five tomatoes, strawberries, apples, bananas or oranges into a fruit basket, although you can't have a mix in the same basket.
translation: Meyve sepetine en fazla bes domates, cilek, elma, muz veya portakal koyabilirsin, ancak ayni sepete farkli meyveleri karistiramazsin.

english: There are seven main Farming areas - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Kragen's area near Ardougne, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius, Alan's area in the Farming Guild and
translation: Yedi ana tarim alani vardir: Falador yakinlarindaki Elstan'in alani, Catherby yakinlarindaki Dantaera'nin alani, Ardougne yakinlarindaki Kragen'in alani, Morytania'daki Lyra'nin alani, Hosidius'daki Marisi'nin alani, Tarim Loncasi'ndaki Alan'in alani ve

english: Oswallt's area in Prifddinas.
Supercompost is far better than normal compost, but more expensive to make. You need to rot the right type of item; show me an item, and I'll tell you if it's super- compostable or not.
translation: Süper kompost normal komposttan cok daha iyidir, ancak yapimi daha pahalidir. Dogru türdeki ögeyi cürütebilmeniz gerekir; bana bir ögeyi gösterin, süper kompostlanabilir olup olmadigini size söyleyeyim.

english: Vegetables, hops and flowers need constant watering - if you ignore my advice, you will sooner or later find yourself in possession of a dead farming patch.
translation: Sebzeler, serbetciotu ve cicekler sürekli sulanmalidir - tavsiyemi dikkate almazsaniz, er ya da gec kendinizi ölü bir tarim arazisiyle karsi karsiya bulursunuz.

english: There is a special patch for growing Belladonna - I believe that it is somewhere near Draynor Manor, where the ground is a tad 'unblessed'.
translation: Belladonna yetistirmek icin özel bir tarla var - sanirim Draynor Malikanesi yakinlarinda, topragin biraz ‘kutsanmamis’ oldugu bir yerde.

english: Hops are good for brewing ales. I believe there's a brewery up in Keldagrim somewhere, and I've heard rumours that a place called Phasmatys used to be good for that type of thing. 'Fore they all died, of course.
translation: Serbetciotu, bira yapiminda kullanilir. Sanirim Keldagrim'de bir bira fabrikasi var ve Phasmatys adli bir yerin eskiden bu tür seyler icin uygun oldugu söyleniyor. Tabii ki hepsi ölmeden önce.

english: Bittercap mushrooms can only be grown in a special patch in Morytania, near the Mort Myre swamp. There the ground is especially dank and suited to growing poisonous fungii.
translation: Bittercap mantarlari sadece Morytania'da, Mort Myre batakliginin yakinindaki özel bir tarlada yetistirilebilir. Orada toprak özellikle nemli ve zehirli mantarlarin yetistirilmesine uygundur.

english: You can buy all the farming tools from farming shops, which can be found close to the allotments.
translation: Tüm tarim aletlerini, tarim dükkanlarindan satin alabilirsiniz. Bu dükkanlar, tarim arazilerinin yakininda bulunur.

english: Tree seeds must be grown in a plantpot of soil into a sapling, and then transferred to a tree patch to continue growing to adulthood.
translation: Agac tohumlari, toprak dolu bir saksida fidana dönüstürülmeli ve ardindan yetiskinlige kadar büyümeye devam etmesi icin bir agac tarlasina aktarilmalidir.

english: The only way to cure a bush or tree of disease is to prune away the diseased leaves with a pair of secateurs. For all other crops I would just apply some plant-cure.
translation: Bir cali veya agaci hastaliktan kurtarmanin tek yolu, hastalikli yapraklari bir budama makasi ile budamaktir. Diger tüm mahsuller icin ise bitki ilaci kullanirim.

english: You can fill plantpots with soil from any empty patch, if you have a gardening trowel.
translation: Bahce küreginiz varsa, bos bir alandan topragi saksilara doldurabilirsiniz.

english: If you need to be rid of your fruit trees for any reason, all you have to do is chop them down and then dig up the stump.
translation: Herhangi bir nedenle meyve agaclarinizdan kurtulmaniz gerekiyorsa, tek yapmaniz gereken onlari kesip köklerini kazmaktir.

english: Don't just throw away your weeds after you've raked a patch - put them in a compost bin and make some compost.
translation: Bir alani tirmikladiktan sonra yabani otlari öylece atmayin, kompost kutusuna koyun ve kompost yapin.

english: Applying compost to a patch will not only reduce the chance that your crops will get diseased, but you will also grow more crops to harvest.
translation: Bir alana kompost uygulamak, mahsulünüzün hastalanma olasiligini azaltmakla kalmaz, ayni zamanda daha fazla mahsul yetistirmenizi de saglar.

english: If you want to make your own sacks and baskets you'll need to use the loom that's near the Farming shop in Falador. If you're a good enough craftsman, that is.
translation: Kendi cuvallarinizi ve sepetlerinizi yapmak istiyorsaniz, Falador'daki Ciftcilik dükkaninin yanindaki dokuma tezgahini kullanmaniz gerekir. Tabii yeterince iyi bir zanaatkar iseniz.

english: You don't have to buy all your plantpots you know, you can make them yourself on a pottery wheel. If you're a good enough craftsman, that is.
translation: Tüm saksilarinizi satin almaniz gerekmez, cömlek carkinda kendiniz yapabilirsiniz. Tabii yeterince iyi bir zanaatkar iseniz.

english: You can put up to ten potatoes, cabbages or onions in vegetable sacks, although you can't have a mix in the same sack.
translation: Sebze cuvallarina en fazla on adet patates, lahana veya sogan koyabilirsiniz, ancak ayni cuvalda farkli sebzeleri karistiramazsiniz.

english: Can you sell me something?
That depends on whether I have it to sell. What is it that you're looking for?
translation: Satacak bir seyim olup olmadigina bagli. Ne ariyorsun?

english: I'll come back another time.
I want 6 dragonfruit for that.
I'm already looking after that patch for you.
translation: O tarlayi zaten senin icin bakiyorum.

english: I'll want 2000 Coins to chop down your redwood. These take ages!
translation: Kizilcamini kesmek icin 2000 Coin istiyorum. Bunlar cok uzun sürüyor!

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
Okay, it's a deal.
No, that's too much.
Okay, it's a deal and don't ask again.
translation: Tamam, anlastik ve bir daha sorma.

english: Would you chop my redwood tree down for me?
Here's 2000 Coins - chop my tree down please.
I don't want to pay that much, sorry.
translation: O kadar para ödemek istemiyorum, üzgünüm.

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: Bana tarimla ilgili tavsiyelerde bulunur musun?

english: Can you sell me something?
I'll come back another time.
Yes.
No.
If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: Senin kadar cirkin olsaydim, yüzümü halka göstermeye cesaret edemezdim!

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: Oh! Sey... Az önce bir tane yedim, o yüzden!

english: Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: Hayatina deger veriyorsan bir daha benimle konusma!

english: Get lost!
I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: Sana verecek hicbir seyim yok, birak beni rahat, dilenci.

english: Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
translation: Su anda bununla ugrasacak vaktim yok.

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: Senin gibi zavalli bir et yiginiyla konusmak istemiyorum.

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: Cok kötü bir gün... tadini cikar, bitmeden.

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: Eger birini yakalarsan, paylasacagina söz ver.

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
You smell familiar...
Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: Buralarda insan gördün mü? Cok acim.

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: Bana kan tadi seven biri gibi görünüyorsun.

english: Good day to you, my friend.
Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
translation: Kaleye gidip atistirmalik bir seyler yemeye ne dersin?

english: Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: Bana bir dakika izin ver, dislerimde bir sey sikismis...

english: Welcome to the Shrimp and Parrot. Would you like to order, madam?
translation: Shrimp and Parrot'a hos geldiniz. Siparis vermek ister misiniz, hanimefendi?

english: Yes please.
No thank you.
Where do you get your Karambwan from?
We buy directly off Lubufu, a local fisherman. He seems to have a monopoly over Karambwan sale.
translation: Yerel bir balikci olan Lubufu'dan direkt olarak satin aliyoruz. Karambwan satisinda tekel gibi görünüyor.

english: Where can I find Lubufu?
He is usually working just to the south of the town.
Thanks.
How does he manage a monopoly?
Simple - nobody else knows how to catch Karambwan. It is a closely guarded secret.
translation: Cok basit, Karambwan'i yakalamayi baska kimse bilmiyor. Bu sir siki bir sekilde saklaniyor.

english: Yes please.
No thank you.
Where do you get your Karambwan from?
Where can I find Lubufu?
How does he manage a monopoly?
Hello [player name]. How's the adventuring going?
Hi Ali. Not bad. How are you?
translation: Merhaba Ali. Fena degil. Sen nasilsin?

english: Still selling.
Hang on a second while I get my stock of blackjacks out.
translation: Bir saniye bekle, blackjack stokumu getireyim.

english: Hang on a second while I get the garments.
Hang on a second.
Well at the moment I don't exactly have a selection of runes.
translation: Su anda tam olarak bir rune seckim yok.

english: You don't?
Those boxes from your friend Aubury have a very odd locking mechanism.
translation: Arkadasin Aubury'nin gönderdigi kutularin cok garip bir kilit mekanizmasi var.

english: You have managed to get them off?
Not exactly.
What do you mean by 'not exactly'?
What I mean by 'not exactly' is 'no, I haven't managed to get the lock off'.
translation: “Tam olarak degil” demek istedigim, “hayir, kilidi acmayi basaramadim” demek.

english: Oh.

I was kind of hoping that you would have a look at them. There are two distinctive types of caskets one with a simple locking mechanism and another, which ummm... looks a little tricky to say the least.
translation: Onlara bir bakacagini umuyordum. Iki farkli türde sandik var, biri basit bir kilit mekanizmasina sahip, digeri ise, sey... en azindan biraz zor görünüyor.

english: I think I'll have a go at opening a small casket of runes.
translation: Sanirim kücük bir rün sandigini acmayi deneyecegim.

english: Your arms tire from the exertions of trying to open the casket...
You fail to open the chest.
You fail to pick the lock - your fingers get numb from fumbling with the lock.
translation: Kilit acmayi basaramazsin - kilidi kurcalarken parmaklarin uyusur.

english: I'm feeling lucky, let's have a look at opening one of those large caskets.
translation: Sansli hissediyorum, su büyük sandiklardan birini acmayi deneyelim.

english: Hmmm... This lock looks like it may be impossible to prise open.
translation: Hmmm... Bu kilit acilmasi imkansiz gibi görünüyor.

english: Hmmm... This lock looks like it may be impossible to pick open.
translation: Hmmm... Bu kilit acilmasi imkansiz gibi görünüyor.

english: On second thoughts I don't really need any runes.
Hi! I have this money off voucher!
Oh! Unfortunately it seems to have expired yesterday!
translation: Oh! Maalesef dün süresi dolmus gibi görünüyor!

english: But I only just got it from Ali the Leaflet dropper!
translation: Ama ben onu Ali'den, brosür dagitan kisiden yeni aldim!

english: I'm sorry, there's nothing I can do.
But you're the one that had them printed!
Look, I had those printed to win over the local traders. They weren't too pleased with the money off voucher, but I promised them I would repay their losses.
translation: Bak, onlari yerel tüccarlari kazanmak icin bastirdim. Indirim kuponundan pek memnun kalmadilar, ama onlara kayiplarini telafi edecegime söz verdim.

english: So that would be why they're all out of date then?
translation: O zaman bu yüzden mi hepsi gecerliligini yitirdi?

english: I don't know what you mean...
Anyway, it would be a shame for you to leave without looking at my wares.
translation: Her neyse, mallarimi görmeden gitmen cok yazik olur.

english: Anything interesting?
For you, always. As a matter of fact I have just acquired a fleet of magic carpets, which operate throughout the Kharidian desert.
translation: Senin icin her zaman var. Aslinda, Kharidian cölünde calisan bir sihirli hali filosu satin aldim.

english: Wow that sounds great, how about your stall?
translation: Vay canina, kulaga harika geliyor, tezgahin nasil gidiyor?

english: Trade is good, but I would like to expand and diversify, but it's proving a little more difficult than I initially thought.
translation: Ticaret iyi gidiyor, ama genislemek ve cesitlendirmek istiyorum, ama bu düsündügümden biraz daha zor oluyor.

english: How so?
I think the other merchants are conspiring against me.
translation: Diger tüccarlar bana komplo kuruyorlar sanirim.

english: Oh come on! You're just being paranoid now.
Well maybe I can't get any new suppliers then because I'm Pollnivnian.
translation: Belki de Pollnivnian oldugum icin yeni tedarikciler bulamiyorumdur.

english: You're what?
From Pollnivneach.
Maybe I could help you then?
translation: O zaman sana yardim edebilir miyim?

english: Perhaps you could.
My friend in Sophanem... Ahh never mind him, maybe we might have a look at him another time.
translation: Sophanem'deki arkadasim... Ahh bos ver onu, belki baska bir zaman ona bir bakariz.

english: Is there anyone else you want me to talk to on your behalf?
translation: Senin adina konusmami istedigin baska biri var mi?

english: There's a blackjack seller in Pollnivneach, a cautious type of guy, not the usual entrepreneurial sort that I would normally deal with, but...
translation: Pollnivneach'ta bir blackjack saticisi var, temkinli bir adam, normalde is yaptigim girisimci tiplerden degil, ama...

english: I think that he has a product with real potential...
translation: Bence onun ürünü gercek bir potansiyele sahip...

english: What? .... Blackjacks?
Yes, but at the moment the product isn't polished enough, if you could convince him to create a larger variety of weapon I would gladly stock his products.
translation: Evet, ama su anda ürün yeterince gelismis degil, onu daha cesitli silahlar üretmeye ikna edebilirsen, ürünlerini memnuniyetle stoklarim.

english: What's in this for me?
I thought you wanted to help.
Of course, but everyone seems to be benefiting here but me.
translation: Tabii ki, ama burada benden baska herkes fayda sagliyor gibi görünüyor.

english: What do you mean?
Well the trader gets their product sold, you get your cut, but what do I get?
translation: Tüccar ürünlerini satiyor, sen payini aliyorsun, peki ben ne aliyorum?

english: You get access to more products. Is that not reward enough?
translation: Daha fazla ürüne erisim hakkina sahip oluyorsun. Bu yeterli bir ödül degil mi?

english: Hmmm... Perhaps not.
Didn't we also agree that you would get discounted travel on my magic carpet network?
translation: Benim sihirli hali agimda indirimli seyahat edeceksin diye anlasmamis miydik?

english: Oh ya, I forgot.
So what's your problem then?
I don't have one I guess.
Good, that's what I like to hear. Now where were we?
translation: Güzel, duymak istedigim de buydu. Nerede kalmistik?

english: Ok I'll get on to it.
I have an old friend - a cloth merchant Siamun, who lives in Sophanem - Do you know the place?
translation: Eski bir arkadasim var, Sophanem'de yasayan kumas tüccari Siamun. Orayi biliyor musun?

english: Umm..... Images of cats and priests come to mind. Ah yes! There we go, it's the city of the dead South of Pollnivneach isn't it?
translation: Umm... Aklima kediler ve rahipler geliyor. Ah evet! Pollnivneach'in güneyindeki ölüler sehri, degil mi?
