english: That's the one, well if you could convince him to supply me with some of his merchandise, I would be more than willing to sell them to the masses ...... for a small percentage of course.
translation: Aynen öyle, onu bana mallarindan biraz tedarik etmesi icin ikna edebilirsen, ben de bunlari halka satmaya cok istekliyim... tabii ki kücük bir komisyon karsiliginda.

english: Siamun's clothes seem to have really struck a chord with the locals in Al Kharid. Menaphite culture seems to be taking off here, rumour has it that one of Prince Ali's servants bought him one of Siamun's robes.
translation: Siamun'un kumaslari Al Kharid'deki yerlilerin ilgisini cekmis görünüyor. Menaphite kültürü burada yayginlasiyor gibi görünüyor, söylentilere göre Prens Ali'nin hizmetcilerinden biri ona Siamun'un cüppelerinden bir tane satin almis.

english: Wow, that sounds positive.
translation: Vay canina, bu olumlu bir gelisme.

english: Quite, if I don't say so myself. But in order to keep things fresh, the next time you're in Sophanem, could you ask that cranky old so-and-so Siamun to produce a new line of clothing?
translation: Kesinlikle, ben de öyle düsünüyorum. Ama isleri taze tutmak icin, bir dahaki sefere Sophanem'e gittiginde, huysuz yasli Siamun'dan yeni bir giysi koleksiyonu hazirlamasini isteyebilir misin?

english: Sure, why not. The Sultan himself might even buy some of the new range.
translation: Tabii, neden olmasin. Sultan bile yeni koleksiyondan birkac parca satin alabilir.

english: That would be the day.
translation: O gün gelirse ne güzel olur.

english: Who did you want me to talk to again?
Could you talk to your friend Aubury in Varrock about supplying me with runes?
translation: Varrock'taki arkadasin Aubury ile bana rün tedarik etmesi konusunda konusabilir misin?

english: Hmm, that could work out quite well. Varrock is always quite busy, so I might try to get a couple of other things done while I'm there.
translation: Hmm, bu oldukca iyi olabilir. Varrock her zaman oldukca yogundur, bu yüzden oradayken birkac is daha halletmeye calisabilirim.

english: Don't tarry there too long, I'm quite anxious to get a rune store open before anyone else in this area.
translation: Orada cok uzun kalma, bu bölgede herkesten önce bir rune magazasi acmak icin sabirsizlaniyorum.

english: I'll get to it right away.
I'll tell you what then, how about I let you have discounted flights on my magic carpet rides?
translation: O zaman sana ne diyeyim, sihirli halimla indirimli ucuslar sunsam nasil olur?

english: Wow that would be great.
Fair enough, so we have a win, win, win situation on our hands then.
translation: Adil, o zaman elimizde bir kazan-kazan-kazan durumu var.

english: I think I need just one more product type, something, magical ... now what could I stock that's magical, has large demand and a pretty good profit margin...
translation: Sanirim bir ürün türüne daha ihtiyacim var, sihirli bir sey... Sihirli, talebi yüksek ve kar marji iyi olan ne stoklayabilirim acaba...

english: How about runes?
Yes, that would be perfect, but who could I get that would supply? There really seems to be a gap in the market in the desert but I don't know anyone in that line of business.
translation: Evet, bu mükemmel olur, ama bunu kim tedarik edebilir? Cölde pazarda gercekten bir bosluk var gibi görünüyor ama bu is kolunda tanidigim kimse yok.

english: Hang on, I know somebody called Aubury, decent fella. I helped him out a while back. Perhaps I could approach him about the idea.
translation: Durun, Aubury adinda birini taniyorum, iyi bir adamdir. Bir süre önce ona yardim etmistim. Belki ona bu fikri acabilirim.

english: Oh yes, the rune seller from Varrock. That would be perfect. He's far enough away that he wouldn't end up competing with himself.
translation: Evet, Varrock'taki rune saticisi. Bu mükemmel olur. Kendisiyle rekabet etmeyecek kadar uzakta.

english: What do you mean?
Well the rune market is a limited one, if I were to sell his runes from a location nearby his shop, then I would take part of his market share so he would in fact not benefit from me selling runes.
translation: Rune pazari sinirli bir pazar, eger onun dükkaninin yakininda rune satarsam, onun pazar payinin bir kismini alirim, bu yüzden benim rune satmamdan aslinda bir faydasi olmaz.

english: Ah ha, I think I know where this is going. So because you're located far enough away from him you will take up someone else's share in the market and Aubury will make more money as a result.
translation: Ah ha, sanirim ne demek istedigini anladim. Yani ondan yeterince uzakta oldugun icin, pazardaki baska birinin payini alacaksin ve sonuc olarak Aubury daha fazla para kazanacak.

english: Very well anticipated.
Well you had better get going, you've a fair bit of travelling ahead of you. Unless you want to make a small purchase from me first?
translation: Artik gitsen iyi olur, önünde uzun bir yol var. Tabii önce benden kücük bir sey satin almak istemiyorsan?

english: No, I'm really too busy.
Okay.
Good job on getting the rune stone shipments sorted. I'm just receiving the first of them. Though there seems to be a funny sort of locking mechanism on them, which I haven't completely figured out.
translation: Rune tasi sevkiyatlarini düzenledigin icin tebrikler. Ilk sevkiyati az önce aldim. Ama üzerinde tuhaf bir kilit mekanizmasi var, henüz tam olarak cözemedim.

english: No problem. I might have a look at it later.
translation: Sorun degil. Daha sonra bir bakarim.

english: [player name], I would like to commend you on all the selfless help you have given me.
translation: Maceraci, bana verdigin özverili yardimlar icin seni tebrik etmek istiyorum.

english: It was nothing, really.
I think you underestimate your efforts. Anyway, as a token of my gratitude I have told all my magic carpet attendants to allow you to travel on the carpets at a discounted rate.
translation: Bence cabalarini hafife aliyorsun. Her neyse, minnettarligimin bir göstergesi olarak tüm sihirli hali görevlilerine sana indirimli fiyatla halilarla seyahat etmene izin vermelerini söyledim.

english: Really, Ali, there is no need.
I insist.
I hear you're planning to expand your business here...
Of course, my friend. Any good salesman ought to take the opportunities that present themselves.
translation: Elbette dostum. Her iyi satici, karsisina cikan firsatlari degerlendirmelidir.

english: But your men are threatening the other shopkeepers!
translation: Ama adamlarin diger dükkan sahiplerini tehdit ediyor!

english: That is regrettable, I'm afraid.
And the gnomes don't sound very happy about your magic carpet business.
translation: Ve cüceler de sihirli hali isinden pek memnun görünmüyorlar.

english: A good businessman looks for all the opportunities he can.
translation: Iyi bir is adami, karsisina cikan tüm firsatlari degerlendirir.

english: Aren't you going to do anything about your men?
Well, these associates of my nephew can be somewhat... overenthusiastic.
translation: Yegenimin bu ortaklari biraz... asiri hevesli olabilirler.

english: I'm sure they'll settle down soon.
But they're threatening to hurt the shopkeepers if they don't cooperate!
translation: Ama isbirligi yapmazlarsa dükkan sahiplerine zarar vermekle tehdit ediyorlar!

english: Well, there's a simple solution there, don't you agree?
translation: Bunun basit bir cözümü var, sence de öyle degil mi?

english: Are you planning to take over all of Al Kharid's shops?
translation: Al Kharid'deki tüm dükkanlari ele gecirmeyi mi planliyorsun?

english: It's a step in the right direction.
translation: Bu dogru yönde atilmis bir adim.

english: Now, would you like to have a look at my wares?
translation: Simdi, mallarima bir göz atmak ister misin?

english: What will you do about the gnomes?
They can continue running their gliders into trees, and I'll keep my business going. Sooner or later it'll all work out in my favour.
translation: Onlar agaclara planörleriyle carpmaya devam edebilirler, ben de isime devam ederim. Er ya da gec her sey benim lehime sonuclanacak.

english: I suppose so...
Anyway, before you go, take a look at my wares.
translation: Neyse, gitmeden önce mallarima bir göz at.

english: Well, good luck with your business.
Before you go, have a look at my wares.
translation: Gitmeden önce mallarima bir göz at.

english: I would like to have a look at your selection of blackjacks.
translation: Blackjack cesitlerine bir göz atmak istiyorum.

english: I would like to have a look at your selection of clothes.
translation: Giysi cesitlerine bir göz atmak istiyorum.

english: I would like to have a look at your selection of runes.
translation: Rün cesitlerine bir göz atmak istiyorum.

english: Try opening a small casket of runes
translation: Kücük bir rün sandigini acmayi dene.

english: Force box.
Buy all the runes for [amount].
Find out what the runes are.
Pick lock.
Examine lock.
Try opening a large casket of runes
translation: Büyük bir rune sandigini acmayi dene.

english: On second thoughts I don't really need any runes.
I would like to have a look at your general stock.
translation: Genel stokuna bir göz atmak istiyorum.

english: So what's in this for me?
Ok I'll get on to it.
Who did you want me to talk to again?
No I'm really too busy.
Ok
I hear you're planning to expand your business here...
Aren't you going to do anything about your men?
translation: Adamlarinizla ilgili bir sey yapmayacak misiniz?

english: But they're threatening to hurt the shopkeepers if they don't cooperate!
translation: Ama isbirligi yapmazlarsa dükkan sahiplerine zarar vermekle tehdit ediyorlar!

english: No, I'm really too busy.
Okay.
Well, good luck with your business.
What will you do about the gnomes?
Hello there.
Good day. Can I help you with anything?
Yes, I'd like a drink please.
translation: Evet, bir icki alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: What's going on in town?
Nothing much really. About what you'd expect from a sleepy little town like ours.
translation: Aslinda pek bir sey yok. Bizimki gibi sakin bir kasabadan beklenecegi gibi.

english: What about those two gangs? That seems exciting.
translation: Peki ya o iki cete? Heyecan verici görünüyor.

english: They're paying customers, so I won't rock the boat if you don't mind.
translation: Onlar para ödeyen müsteriler, sakincasi yoksa ortaligi karistirmak istemem.

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: No thanks, I'm ok. Thanks for your time.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, ben iyiyim. Zaman ayirdiginiz icin tesekkürler.

english: I'm looking for Traitorous Ali.
He was just here! Look, he's even left his drink on the table by those barrels. Must have nipped out to go to the toilet.
translation: Az önce buradaydi! Bak, ickisini ficilerin yanindaki masada birakmis. Tuvalete gitmek icin disari cikmis olmali.

english: He might be gone a while though. The nearest outhouse is all the way over on Fossil Island.
translation: Ama bir süre gelmeyebilir. En yakin tuvalet Fossil Adasi'nda.

english: I'm looking for Ali from Pollnivneach.
Well, I'm called Ali and I'm from here. Are you looking for me?
translation: Benim adim Ali ve ben buradanim. Beni mi ariyorsun?

english: Do you have an uncle called Ali?
translation: Ali adinda bir amcan var mi?

english: Yes! All my uncles are called Ali!
Oh dear. Well do any of your uncles have a stall in the Bazaar in Al Kharid?
translation: Oh, hayir. Peki amcalarindan Al Kharid'deki carsida tezgahi olan var mi?

english: Um... no.
Well do you know if anyone here does?
translation: Peki burada olan var mi biliyor musun?

english: That's a difficult question to answer. I don't know anyone else's uncles.
translation: Bu cevaplamasi zor bir soru. Baska kimsenin amcalarini tanimiyorum.

english: The 'Asp and Snake'? What a strange name for a bar.
translation: “Asp and Snake” mi? Bir bar icin ne garip bir isim.

english: Maybe around these parts. Were you expecting it to have 'Ali' in the name?
translation: Belki bu civarda. Adinda “Ali” gecmesini mi bekliyordun?

english: I did think about calling it 'Ali's', but then it'd get confused with the Camel Shop, the Kebab House, the Mayor's residence...
translation: “Ali's” adini vermeyi düsündüm, ama o zaman Camel Shop, Kebab House, Belediye Baskani'nin konutu ile karistirilirdi...

english: Yes, I get your point. It's a perfectly fine name.
translation: Evet, anliyorum. Gayet uygun bir isim.

english: Yes, I'd like a drink please.
What's going on in town?
No thanks, I'm ok.
Yes, I'd like to talk about something else.
translation: Evet, baska bir seyden bahsetmek istiyorum.

english: I'm looking for Traitorous Ali.
I'm looking for Ali from Pollnivneach.
The 'Asp and Snake'? What a strange name for a bar.
translation: “Asp ve Yilan” mi? Bir bar icin ne garip bir isim.

english: That beast would probably bite my fingers off if I tried to pet it.
translation: O canavari oksamaya calisirsam muhtemelen parmaklarimi isirir.

english: If you want me to bite your fingers off, you're going the right way about it!
I'm not going to pet that! It will probably bite my hand off, that filthy beast.
translation: Onu oksamayacagim! O pis canavar muhtemelen elimi isirir.

english: Watch who you're calling a filthy beast, human.
translation: Kime pis canavar dedigine dikkat et, insan.

english: Mmmm... you'd make a tasty kebab.
And you'd make an excellent spit bucket! Pchoo!
translation: Sen de mükemmel bir tükürük kovasi olursun! Pchoo!

english: I'm not going to pet that nasty creature! I might get fleas... or worse!
translation: O igrenc yaratigi oksamayacagim! Pire kapabilirim... ya da daha kötüsü!

english: You're fairly nasty yourself, human. When was the last time you took a shower?
translation: Sen de oldukca igrencsin, insan. En son ne zaman dus aldin?

english: Welcome to my discount camel store. Can I help you with anything?
translation: Indirimli deve magazama hos geldin. Yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: A discount camel store?
Yes - it's my great idea - selling camels at discounted prices so that the common man can experience the joys of owning a camel of their very own! They're not just a source of kebab meat you know!
translation: Evet, bu benim harika fikrim. Develeri indirimli fiyatlarla satarak siradan insanlarin kendi develerine sahip olmanin mutlulugunu yasayabilmelerini saglamak! Onlar sadece kebap eti kaynagi degiller, biliyorsun!

english: So can I buy a camel then? I'm hungry!
translation: O zaman bir deve satin alabilir miyim? Acim!

english: I would never sell one to the likes of you! They are beautiful, majestic creatures, not food! Get out of my shop.
translation: Senin gibilere asla satmam! Onlar güzel, görkemli yaratiklar, yiyecek degil! Dükkânimdan cik.

english: Yes, camels are beautiful creatures.
Ah, wondrous camels! Best of all Saradomin's creations. Ships of the desert, far more useful than any horse or donkey. Truly, they are a man's best friend.
translation: Ah, muhtesem develer! Saradomin'in yarattiklarinin en iyisi. Cölün gemileri, atlardan ve eseklerden cok daha kullanislilar. Gercekten, insanin en iyi dostlaridirlar.

english: Perhaps you'd like a camel of your own? You're in the right place, if so...
translation: Belki de kendi devenizi istersiniz? Öyleyse dogru yerdesiniz...

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: No but thanks for your time.
translation: Hayir, ama zaman ayirdiginiz icin tesekkürler.

english: Why would I want a camel? All they do is spit and...
translation: Neden deve isteyeyim ki? Tek yaptiklari tükürmek ve...

english: Pah! I've seen mummies with more brains than you! If you treat camels badly then of course they're going to spit at you. May your robes never be clean again!
translation: Pah! Senden daha akilli mumyalar gördüm! Develere kötü davranirsaniz, elbette size tüküreceklerdir. Cüppeleriniz bir daha asla temiz olmasin!

english: Actually, I think I was a camel in a previous life.
translation: Aslinda, önceki hayatimda bir deve oldugumu düsünüyorum.

english: You're teasing me now! You rogue!
translation: Simdi benimle dalga geciyorsunuz! Sizi haydut!

english: Everyone laughs at the poor Discount Camel Seller.
translation: Herkes zavalli Indirimli Deve Saticisina gülüyor.

english: So is the discount camel business good then?
translation: Indirimli deve isi iyi gidiyor mu peki?

english: Business is booming! Pollnivneach has never seen this number of visitors.
translation: Isler cok iyi gidiyor! Pollnivneach hic bu kadar ziyaretci görmemisti.

english: In fact I'm thinking of expanding and trying to break into the camel hire market.
translation: Aslinda genislemeyi ve deve kiralama pazarina girmeyi düsünüyorum.

english: If only I could figure out how to get people to return the camels...
translation: Keske insanlarin develeri geri getirmesini nasil saglayacagimi bulabilsem...

english: Tell me about this town.
Well, Pollnivneach is a funny little place. It's a small town and you'd think it'd be nice and quiet.
translation: Pollnivneach komik bir yer. Kücük bir kasaba ve güzel ve sakin oldugunu düsünürsün.

english: But those Menaphites and bandits are making the place quite unbearable.
translation: Ama Menaphitler ve haydutlar burayi cekilmez hale getiriyor.

english: In what way?
Well, one group is as bad as the other! They steal, they fight, they cause trouble with us locals. Just yesterday one of those bandits came looking for protection money!
translation: Bir grup digerinden farksiz! Caliyorlar, kavga ediyorlar, biz yerlilere sorun cikariyorlar. Daha dün o haydutlardan biri harac almaya geldi!

english: Why don't the authorities stop this?
We're a small town. We don't have the resources to keep the gangs off our backs! Menaphos and Al Kharid are no help either.
translation: Biz kücük bir kasabayiz. Ceteleri uzak tutacak kadar kaynagimiz yok! Menaphos ve Al Kharid de yardim etmiyor.

english: To tell the truth we live in hope that an outsider, someone with no ties to either group, could broker a deal to halt the hostilities between them.
translation: Dogrusunu söylemek gerekirse, iki grupla da bagi olmayan bir yabanci, aralarindaki düsmanligi sona erdirmek icin bir anlasma yapabilir diye umut ediyoruz.

english: Hmm...
Well the weak will always be trodden on. Why not stand up to them?
translation: Zayiflar her zaman ezilir. Neden onlara karsi cikmiyorsunuz?

english: That's a little unfair, my friend. We can't all be brave adventurers. If we were, where would you purchase quality camels at discounted prices?
translation: Bu biraz haksizlik, dostum. Hepimiz cesur maceracilar olamayiz. Öyle olsaydik, kaliteli develeri indirimli fiyata nereden satin alabilirdik?

english: You might think about that. Anyway, isn't it the job of the brave adventurer to protect the weak and innocent from evil and harm?
translation: Bunu bir düsünsen iyi olur. Her neyse, zayif ve masumlari kötülük ve zarardan korumak cesur maceracilarin görevi degil mi?

english: Perhaps I could help.
Yes, perhaps you could.
You know the politics better than I do. What do you recommend?
translation: Siyaseti benden daha iyi biliyorsun. Ne öneriyorsun?

english: Me?! I am but a humble discount camel seller. You're the adventurer, don't you know what to do?
translation: Ben mi?! Ben sadece mütevazi bir indirimli deve saticisiyim. Maceraci sensin, ne yapacagini bilmiyor musun?

english: Of course I know what to do! I was just testing you!
translation: Tabii ki ne yapacagimi biliyorum! Sadece seni siniyordum!

english: That is reassuring to hear. Too often one meets brainless adventurers whose solution to every problem is to hack, maim and murder.
translation: Bunu duymak icimi rahatlatti. Her soruna cözüm olarak kesip bicmek, sakatlamak ve öldürmek olan beyinsiz maceracilarla cok sik karsilasiyoruz.

english: I'm glad to know you're not of that ilk.
translation: Senin o türden biri olmadigini bilmek beni mutlu etti.

english: Perhaps I should know, but offered advice should never be shunned.
translation: Belki de bilmem gerekir, ama verilen tavsiyeler asla reddedilmemelidir.

english: The state of adventurers today. They need everything spelled out for them.
translation: Bugünün maceracilarinin durumu. Her seyin kendilerine acikca anlatilmasi gerekiyor.

english: What, you want me to put a little note in your quest journal?
translation: Ne, görev günlügüne kücük bir not mu yazmami istiyorsun?

english: But fine, I'll give you a hint. Try and see if you can get the gangs to agree to a truce by offering them each a token gift as an act of reconciliation.
translation: Ama tamam, sana bir ipucu vereyim. Cetelere uzlasma jesti olarak sembolik bir hediye sunarak ateskes yapmalarini saglamaya calis.

english: If that fails to work, you must consider trying to influence the gangs from within.
translation: Bu ise yaramazsa, ceteleri iceriden etkilemeyi denemelisin.

english: Lovely day isn't it?
It's a beautiful day today, but word has it that it will rain tomorrow.
translation: Bugün hava cok güzel ama yarin yagmur yagacagi söyleniyor.

english: Really?
No! When have you ever known it to rain here in Gielinor?
translation: Hayir! Gielinor'da ne zaman yagmur yagdigini gördün ki?

english: Oh. Anyway...
Those two camels around the side are already sold.
translation: Yan taraftaki iki deve zaten satildi.

english: But you are in luck - I have another two beautiful camels arriving in soon from the best stable in all of Al Kharid.
translation: Ama sanslisin, Al Kharid'in en iyi ahirindan iki güzel deve daha yakinda gelecek.

english: Camels, beautiful? I worry about you.
translation: Develer mi, güzel mi? Senin icin endiseleniyorum.

english: Can you tell me a little about them?
Well Sandy, the female camel is a placid beast, and is 20 years of age and comes from a prestigious family whose mother was the part of the Sultan's baggage train.
translation: Sandy, disi deve sakin bir hayvandir, 20 yasinda ve annesi Sultan'in bagaj treninin bir parcasi olan prestijli bir aileden geliyor.

english: Lumps, on the other hand is a 15 year old male, a bit surly and prone to bouts of stubbornness. However he more than makes up for this failing with his immense strength and stamina.
translation: Lumps ise 15 yasinda bir erkek, biraz huysuz ve inatcilik egilimi var. Ancak bu eksikligini muazzam gücü ve dayanikliligiyla telafi ediyor.

english: Both of them are of the 'Camelus Horribleus' family, a breed peculiar only to this area of Gielinor. It is....
translation: Ikisi de Gielinor'un bu bölgesine özgü bir tür olan “Camelus Horribleus” ailesindendir. Bu...

english: Ok, ok, that's enough! So they're camels then!
translation: Tamam, tamam, yeter! Demek onlar deve!

english: What price do you want for both of them?
One cannot put a price on life, they are precious beyond the worth of the crass value of gold coins!
translation: Hayata paha bicilemez, altin sikkelerin kaba degerinden cok daha kiymetlidirler!

english: So can I have them for free then?
translation: O zaman onlari bedavaya alabilir miyim?

english: Are you trying to be funny?
Perhaps I could make another offer?
Would 200 gold coins for the pair of them do?
translation: Ikisi icin 200 altin sikke yeterli olur mu?

english: Pah! That might buy you a mangy flea infested sheep if you're lucky. Don't insult me.
translation: Peh! Sansliysan, o parayla uyuz ve pire dolu bir koyun alabilirsin. Beni asagilamayin.

english: Would 500 gold coins for the pair of them do?
translation: Ikisi icin 500 altin sikke yeterli olur mu?

english: You don't even have that much money do you? Come back when you're able to make a proper offer and stop wasting my time.
translation: O kadar paran bile yok, degil mi? Uygun bir teklif yapabilecek duruma geldiginde geri gel ve zamanimi bosa harcamayi birak.

english: I would consider giving them to you if you were able to look after them. But it is abundantly clear that you've got your hands full at the moment.
translation: Onlara bakabilecek durumda olsaydin, sana vermeyi düsünebilirdim. Ama su anda ellerinin dolu oldugu cok acik.

english: I suppose I can silence my moral objections for that.
translation: Sanirim bu konuda ahlaki itirazlarimi bir kenara birakabilirim.

english: Ali the discount camel seller gives you a receipt for the camels in return for 500 gold coins.
translation: Indirimli deve saticisi Ali, 500 altin karsiliginda develer icin bir makbuz verir.

english: Here are the receipts for the camels so that you can pick them up as soon as I get them in.
translation: Develeri alir almaz alabilmen icin makbuzlari burada.

english: Would 1000 gold coins for the pair of them do?
translation: Ikisi icin 1000 altin yeterli olur mu?

english: You are too generous, I would have sold for half of that!
Hello! Welcome back to my discount camel store. How are those camels getting along?
translation: Merhaba! Indirimli deve dükkanima tekrar hos geldiniz. Develer nasil gidiyor?

english: About those camels, I've lost the receipt can I have another?
translation: Develerle ilgili olarak, fisi kaybettim, yenisini alabilir miyim?

english: I think you're trying to con me into giving you an extra receipt.
translation: Bence beni kandirip ekstra fis almaya calisiyorsun.

english: No problem, There you go.
I decided to get rid of the camels.
Why? did they not please you?
No, they didn't so I sold them as Kebab meat!
translation: Hayir, begenmedim, bu yüzden onlari kebap eti olarak sattim!

english: Not Sandy and Lumps! You beast! Get out of my shop now!
translation: Sandy ve Lumps olmaz! Seni canavar! Hemen dükkanimdan cik!

english: I'm not really a camel person so I gave them to a better owner.
translation: Ben pek deve seven biri degilim, bu yüzden onlari daha iyi bir sahibe verdim.

english: Didn't I warn you that a camel is not like a puppy or a kitten, fun for a few days and then a tasty snack? They're more than that, they're for life!
translation: Deve köpek yavrusu ya da kedi yavrusu gibi birkac gün eglenip sonra lezzetli bir atistirmalik olamayacagini söylememis miydim? Onlar bundan daha fazlasi, ömür boyu sahiplenilecek hayvanlar!

english: I decided to try use them to end the hostilities between the two gangs.
translation: Onlari iki cete arasindaki düsmanligi sona erdirmek icin kullanmaya karar verdim.

english: A noble purpose for two noble beasts! Did you succeed?
translation: Iki asil canavar icin asil bir amac! Basardin mi?

english: Still working on that, I'm afraid.
Good luck with that.
Hey Ali!
Hello adventurer.
Any news?
Not much really, I just want to thank you for what you have done for this village, I can now get on with business.
translation: Pek yok, sadece bu köy icin yaptiklarin icin tesekkür etmek istiyorum, artik isime devam edebilirim.

english: Any grand plans?
Well I've been debating whether I should diversify. I might move into camel rental although I do have all these cages lying around which I could put to some use.
translation: Sey, cesitlendirme yapip yapmamayi tartisiyorum. Tüm bu kafesleri bir sekilde kullanabilecegim icin deve kiralama isine girebilirim.

english: Well good luck to you in whatever venture you do decide to go ahead with.
translation: Ne yapmaya karar verirsen, sana iyi sanslar.

english: Thank you.
A discount camel store?
So can I buy a camel then? I'm hungry!
translation: O zaman deve satin alabilir miyim? Acim!

english: Yes, camels are beautiful creatures.
Well yes actually I'd like to ask about something else.
translation: Aslinda baska bir sey sormak istiyorum.

english: No but thanks for your time.
translation: Hayir, ama zaman ayirdiginiz icin tesekkürler.

english: Why would I want a camel? All they do is spit and...
translation: Neden deve isteyeyim ki? Tek yaptiklari tükürmek ve...

english: Actually, I think I was a camel in a previous life.
translation: Aslinda, önceki hayatimda deve oldugumu düsünüyorum.

english: So is the discount camel business good then?
translation: Indirimli deve isi iyi gidiyor mu peki?

english: Tell me about this town.
In what way?
Well the weak will always be trodden on. Why not stand up to them?
translation: Zayiflar her zaman ezilir. Neden onlara karsi cikmiyorsunuz?

english: Perhaps I could help.
Indeed I should know, and indeed I do! I was just testing you!
translation: Elbette bilmeliyim, ve biliyorum da! Sadece sizi siniyordum!

english: Perhaps I should know, but offered advice should never be shunned.
translation: Belki bilmeliyim, ama verilen tavsiyeler asla reddedilmemelidir.

english: Lovely day isn't it?
Are those camels around the side for sale?
Can you tell me a little about them?
What price do you want for both of them?
So can I have them for free then?
Would 200 gold coins for the pair of them do?
translation: Ikisi icin 200 altin sikke olur mu?

english: Would 500 gold coins for the pair of them do?
translation: Ikisi icin 500 altin sikke olur mu?

english: Would 1000 gold coins for the pair of them do?
translation: Ikisi icin 1000 altin sikke olur mu?

english: About those camels, I've lost the receipt. Can I have another?
translation: Develerle ilgili olarak, fisi kaybettim. Yenisini alabilir miyim?

english: I decided to get rid of the camels.
No, they didn't so I sold them as Kebab meat!
translation: Hayir, satmadilar, ben de onlari kebap eti olarak sattim!

english: I'm not really a camel person so I gave them to a better owner.
translation: Ben pek deve seven biri degilim, o yüzden onlari daha iyi bir sahibine verdim.

english: I decided to try use them to end the hostilities between the two gangs.
translation: Onlari iki cete arasindaki düsmanligi sona erdirmek icin kullanmaya karar verdim.

english: I'm looking for Ali from Pollnivneach.
You look glum.
Business here really seems to have dried up. I had a good thing going here and you spoiled it.
translation: Buradaki isler gercekten durmus gibi görünüyor. Burada iyi bir isim vardi, sen onu mahvettin.

english: Well it serves you right really. Taking advantage of people like that.
translation: Aslinda hak ettin. Insanlari böyle kullanmak.

english: So want to buy some water?
How much?
To you 1000 coins for a waterskin!
translation: Sana bir su tulumu icin 1000 sikke!

english: You don't have 1000 coins to buy the water with.
You buy a full waterskin for 1000 coins!
translation: 1000 sikkeye dolu bir su tulumu alirsin!

english: I think I'll give it a miss.
If you want water you need to buy it off me.
Ok, I feel sorry for you.
I think I'll give it a miss.
Hello there!
Oh, er, hello. What do you want?
What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
There's not much farming land around here. Only that little patch outside.
translation: Buralarda fazla tarim arazisi yok. Sadece disaridaki kücük parca var.

english: Can you give me any advice on farming here in the desert?
translation: Cölde tarim yapma konusunda bana tavsiyede bulunabilir misin?

english: Like I said, I only know about cactuses...
translation: Dedigim gibi, ben sadece kaktüsler hakkinda bilgim var...

english: Just tell me about cactuses, then.
translation: O zaman sadece kaktüsler hakkinda anlat.

english: First you have to weed the patch using a rake.
translation: Önce tirmikla tarladaki yabani otlari temizlemelisin.

english: Can you give me any other advice?
Not really. I've not done much farming recently.
translation: Pek degil. Son zamanlarda pek tarim yapmadim.

english: Well, can you at least sell me any gardening tools or seeds?
translation: En azindan bana bahce aletleri veya tohum satabilir misin?

english: Sorry. They haven't been delivered yet.
So, what do you do here?
I'm going to set up a shop selling farming implements. That patch out there may be small, but it's all we've got.
translation: Tarim aletleri satan bir dükkan acacagim. Oradaki tarla kücük olabilir, ama elimizdeki tek sey bu.

english: I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
Yes, he bought these tents and had them put up for us. He says he'll also get our goods in so we can start selling them soon.
translation: Evet, bu cadirlari satin aldi ve bizim icin kurdurdu. Mallarimizi da getirecegini ve yakinda satisa baslayabilecegimizi söyledi.

english: I only know how to farm cactuses, so this spot is perfect.
translation: Ben sadece kaktüs yetistirmeyi biliyorum, bu yüzden burasi mükemmel.

english: Maybe I should talk to him...
Of course. He's always happy to talk to possible business partners.
translation: Tabii ki. O, potansiyel is ortaklariyla konusmaktan her zaman memnun olur.

english: I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
translation: Diger dükkan sahiplerini tehdit ettigini duydum.

english: Now why would you think that?
One of the shopkeepers told they were threatened by a man with a rake...
translation: Dükkan sahiplerinden biri, tirmikla bir adam tarafindan tehdit edildiklerini söyledi...

english: Those people just don't want us to succeed. Don't listen to them!
translation: O insanlar sadece bizim basarili olmamizi istemiyorlar. Onlari dinleme!

english: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
So, what do you do here?
I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
translation: Diger dükkan sahiplerini tehdit ettigini duydum.

english: Hello there!
I'm working. What do you have to say that's so urgent?
translation: Calisiyorum. Bu kadar acil ne söyleyeceksin?

english: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
There's a lot of space here. More open space than back home.
translation: Burada cok fazla alan var. Evimden daha fazla acik alan var.

english: So where is back home?
Pollnivneach. It's a town to the south of the Shantay Pass.
translation: Pollnivneach. Shantay Gecidi'nin güneyinde bir kasaba.

english: So, what do you do here?
I'm on guard duty. Making sure nobody tries to steal anything from the house and tents in the middle of town.
translation: Nöbet tutuyorum. Kasabanin ortasindaki evden ve cadirlardan kimse bir sey calmaya calismasin diye.

english: Why are you only guarding those buildings?
That's all I've been hired to guard.
translation: Beni sadece onlari korumak icin tuttular.

english: I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
Yeah, he hired me. He owns this house and these two tents, too.
translation: Evet, beni o tuttu. Bu ev ve bu iki cadir da ona ait.

english: Is the work good?
It pays better than back home.
Why, what did you do back home?
Never you mind.
But Ali Morrisane pays us well, at least.
translation: Ama Ali Morrisane en azindan bize iyi maas veriyor.

english: Maybe I should talk to him...
Why not? He always likes to meet potential business partners.
translation: Neden olmasin? Potansiyel is ortaklariyla tanismayi her zaman sever.

english: I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
translation: Diger dükkan sahiplerini tehdit ettigini duydum.

english: So? They talk too much.
You're not going to deny it?
Why bother? None of them can fight back, after all.
translation: Neden ugrasayim ki? Sonucta hicbiri karsilik veremez.

english: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
So, what do you do here?
I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
translation: Diger dükkan sahiplerini tehdit ettigini duydum.

english: Good day old hag.
Old hag indeed! I have a name you know!
translation: Yasli cadi mi? Benim bir adim var, biliyorsun!

english: Does it happen to be... Ali?
Oh, it's actually Alisha, but they let me move in anyway. Not many hags about these days, and beggars can't be choosers!
translation: Aslinda adim Alisha, ama yine de tasinmama izin verdiler. Bu günlerde cadi pek kalmadi, dilenciler secici olamaz!

english: So can I call you Al?
Only if I can call you Betty!
Now what do you want from the old hag of Pollnivneach? Hexes? Curses? Eternal youth? Poisons? You name it, I can brew it.
translation: Pollnivneach'in yasli cadisindan ne istiyorsun? Büyü mü? Lanet mi? Ebedi genclik mi? Zehir mi? Ne istersen, ben yaparim.

english: Actually I don't want any of that stuff, I'm new in town and I wanted to get to know the locals.
translation: Aslinda bunlarin hicbirini istemiyorum, bu kasabaya yeni geldim ve yerlileri tanimak istedim.

english: I'm busy brewing potions, so if you disturb me again without reason, I will turn you into a frog!
translation: Iksir yapmakla mesgulüm, bir daha sebepsiz yere beni rahatsiz edersen, seni kurbagaya ceviririm!

english: Sorry! I won't let it happen again.
Good day, Hag.
Good day to you too, Blockhead.
Now what do you want from the old hag of Pollnivneach? Hexes? Curses? Eternal youth? Poisons? You name it, I can brew it.
translation: Pollnivneach'in yasli cadisindan ne istiyorsun? Büyü mü? Lanet mi? Ebedi genclik mi? Zehir mi? Ne istersen, yapabilirim.

english: I'm busy brewing potions, so if you disturb me again without reason, I will turn you into a frog!
translation: Iksir yapmakla mesgulüm, bir daha sebepsiz yere rahatsiz edersen, seni kurbagaya ceviririm!

english: Hello.
Hello. What can I do for you?
I don't know, what can you do for me?
Well, that depends.
Depends on what?
It depends on whether you like kebabs or not.
Why is that?
Seeing as I'm in the kebab construction industry, I mainly help people in need of a kebab.
translation: Kebab yapim sektöründe oldugum icin, cogunlukla kebaba ihtiyaci olan insanlara yardim ediyorum.

english: Well then, what kind of kebabs do you, er, construct?

I offer two different types of kebabs: the standard run- of-the-mill kebab seen throughout Gielinor and enjoyed by many an intoxicated dwarf, and my speciality, the extra-hot kebab. So which shall it be?
translation: Iki farkli tür kebap sunuyorum: Gielinor'da yaygin olarak görülen ve bircok sarhos cücenin severek yedigi standart kebap ve benim spesiyalitem olan ekstra aci kebap. Hangisini istersiniz?

english: I want a standard kebab, please.
That will be three gold coins.
Here you go.
Thanks.
No thanks, I'm good.
Come back soon, I could do with a few more customers.
translation: Yakinda tekrar gelin, birkac müsteri daha isime yarar.

english: I seem to be short on coins. Sorry.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
translation: Sizin icin yapabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: Could I have one of those crazy hot kebabs of yours?
translation: O cilgin aci kebaplarinizdan bir tane alabilir miyim?

english: One super kebab coming up! Be careful, they really are as hot as they're made out to be.
translation: Bir süper kebap geliyor! Dikkatli olun, gercekten söylendigi kadar acidirlar.

english: Sure, sure.
Would you sell me that bottle of special kebab sauce?
translation: O özel kebap sosunu bana satar misiniz?

english: Well, that depends. What do you intend to do with it?
translation: Sey, duruma bagli. Onunla ne yapmayi düsünüyorsunuz?

english: Don't worry, I've no intention of setting up a rival kebab shop.
translation: Merak etmeyin, rakip bir kebapci acmak gibi bir niyetim yok.

english: But then what do you want it for?
I don't know, but I think I could have a little bit of fun with it.
translation: Bilmiyorum, ama onunla biraz eglenebilirim sanirim.

english: You're not going to put it in Drunken Ali's drink, are you? That's what happened the last time I gave someone the sauce.
translation: Onu Sarhos Ali'nin ickisine koymayacaksiniz, degil mi? Son kez birine sosu verdigimde öyle olmustu.

english: No, that would be a bit cliché. I think I'll come up with something more original.
translation: Hayir, bu biraz klise olur. Daha orijinal bir sey bulacagim.

english: Actually, I might get back to you on the sauce. I'm a bit overburdened as it is.
translation: Aslinda, sos konusunda sana geri dönebilirim. Su anda biraz fazla yüküm var.

english: Just be careful with it, it's potent enough to give a camel the runs.
translation: Sadece dikkatli ol, bu sos bir deveyi ishal edecek kadar güclüdür.

english: Thank you very much.
What is the difference between the standard and the extra-hot kebab?
translation: Standart ve ekstra aci kebap arasindaki fark nedir?

english: If I told you that I would have to kill you. Kebab construction is a cut-throat industry. The extra-hot kebab gives me my competitive edge and if I were to divulge my secrets to every passing adventurer, I'd
translation: Eger sana söylersem, seni öldürmek zorunda kalirim. Kebap yapimi acimasiz bir sektör. Ekstra aci kebap bana rekabet avantaji sagliyor ve eger sirrimi her gecen maceraciya ifsa edersem,

english: soon be out of business.
So there's no difference except the sauce you use?
translation: Yani kullandigin sos disinda bir fark yok mu?

english: Shh! Keep your voice down. You should have told me you were from the union.
translation: Sss! Sesini alcalt. Sendikadan oldugunu söylemeliydin.

english: Listen, I've got to run. I'll catch you later.
I need some information.

If information is what you need, there are many better people to ask than myself who could help you. One of the town's street urchins or perhaps the local drunk. I may be many things to many different people, but a
translation: Eger bilgiye ihtiyacin varsa, benden daha iyi yardimci olabilecek bircok kisi var. Kasabanin sokak cocuklarindan biri ya da belki de yerel sarhos. Bircok kisi icin bircok sey olabilirim, ama

english: gossip I am not.
Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to answer this for me.
Ali the Kebab seller has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Kebabci Ali sana bir meydan okuma parsömeni verdi!

english: Please give me your answer!
Nope, not correct!
Spot on!
Ali the Kebab seller has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
I want a standard kebab, please.
Yes, actually.
Could I have an extra-hot kebab please?
translation: Ekstra aci kebap alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: Would you sell me that bottle of special kebab sauce?
translation: O özel kebap sosunu satar misin bana?

english: What is the difference between the standard and the extra-hot kebab?
translation: Standart kebap ile ekstra aci kebap arasindaki fark nedir?

english: I want a kebab, please.
Listen I've got to run. I'll catch you later.
I need some information.
I don't have time to talk right now! Ali Morrisane is paying me to hand out these flyers.
translation: Su anda konusacak vaktim yok! Ali Morrisane bana bu brosürleri dagitmam icin para ödüyor.

english: Who is Ali Morrisane?
Ali Morrisane is the greatest merchant in the east!
translation: Ali Morrisane dogudaki en büyük tüccar!

english: Were you paid to say that?
translation: Bunu söylemek icin para mi aldin?

english: Of course I was! You can find him on the north edge of town.
translation: Tabii ki aldim! Onu sehrin kuzey ucunda bulabilirsin.

english: What are the flyers for?
Well, Ali Morrisane isn't too popular with the other traders in Al Kharid, mainly because he's from Pollnivneach and they feel he has no business trading in their town.
translation: Ali Morrisane, Al Kharid'deki diger tüccarlar arasinda pek popüler degil, cünkü Pollnivneachli ve onlar onun kendi sehirlerinde ticaret yapmaya hakki olmadigini düsünüyorlar.

english: I think they're just sour because he's better at making money than them.
translation: Bence onlar sadece onun kendilerinden daha iyi para kazanabildigi icin kiskaniyorlar.

english: The flyer advertises the different shops you can find in Al Kharid.
translation: Brosür, Al Kharid'de bulabileceginiz farkli dükkanlari tanitiyor.

english: It also entitles you to money off your next purchase in any of the shops listed on it. It's Ali's way of getting on the good side of the traders.
translation: Ayrica, brosürde listelenen dükkanlardan herhangi birinde yapacaginiz bir sonraki alisverisinizde indirim hakki da veriyor. Bu, Ali'nin tüccarlarin gözüne girmek icin kullandigi bir yöntem.

english: Which shops?
Here! Take one and let me get back to work.
translation: Alin! Bir tane alin da ben isime döneyim.

english: I still have hundreds of these flyers to hand out, I wonder if my boss would notice if I quietly dumped them somewhere?
translation: Dagitacak yüzlerce brosürüm var, acaba patronum bunlari sessizce bir yere atarsam fark eder mi?

english: Are you trying to be funny or has age turned your brain to mush? Look at the flyer you already have!
translation: Komik olmaya mi calisiyorsun yoksa yaslilik beynini eritmis mi? Elindeki brosüre bak!

english: I'd give you a flyer but it looks like your hands are full. Come back when you have space for my flyer.
translation: Sana brosür verirdim ama ellerin dolu gibi görünüyor. Brosürüm icin yerin oldugunda geri gel.

english: What is there to do round here, boy?
I'm very busy, so listen carefully! I shall say this only once.
translation: Cok mesgulüm, o yüzden dikkatli dinle! Bunu sadece bir kez söyleyecegim.

english: Apart from a busy and wonderous market place in Al Kharid to the south, there is the Emir's Arena to the south-east where you can challenge other players to a fight.
translation: Güneydeki Al Kharid'deki yogun ve harika pazar yerinin yani sira, güneydoguda diger oyunculara dövüsme teklifinde bulunabilecegin Emir'in Arenasi var.

english: If you're here to make money, there is a mine to the south.
translation: Para kazanmak icin buradaysan, güneyde bir maden var.

english: Watch out for scorpions though, they'll take a pop at you if you go too near them. To avoid them just follow the western fence as you travel south.
translation: Ancak akreplere dikkat et, cok yaklasirsan sana saldirirlar. Onlardan kacinmak icin güneye dogru giderken batidaki citi takip edin.

english: If you're in the mood for a little rest and relaxation, there are a couple of nice fishing spots south of the town.
translation: Biraz dinlenmek ve rahatlamak istiyorsaniz, kasabanin güneyinde birkac güzel balik tutma yeri var.

english: Thanks for the help!
I don't want this! It's out of date!
translation: Bunu istemiyorum! Son kullanma tarihi gecmis!

english: Then why would I want it? Keep moving, I have to hand all these flyers out before I get paid.
translation: O zaman neden isteyeyim ki? Devam edin, maasimi almadan önce tüm bu brosürleri dagitmam gerekiyor.

english: Ali's Discount Wares...
The finest store in the world!
Dommik's crafting store...
The place for all your crafting needs.
translation: Tüm zanaat ihtiyaclariniz icin dogru adres.

english: Ellis' Tannery...
The prices are better than the smell!
Run your enemies through in style...
with a Scimitar from Zeke's Superior Scimitars!
Visit Louie's Armoured Legs Bazaar...
translation: Louie'nin Zirhli Bacak Pazari'ni ziyaret edin...

english: Number one for clanky trousers!
Visit Ranael's Super Skirt Store ..
translation: Ranael'in Süper Etek Magazasini ziyaret edin...

english: for the most stylish protection money can buy!
translation: Parayla satin alabileceginiz en sik koruma icin!

english: Keep west as you travel south ...
translation: Güney'e dogru seyahat ederken batiya dogru ilerleyin...

english: to avoid the killer scorpions!
Who is Ali Morrisane?
What are the flyers for?
What is there to do round here, boy?
Welcome, adventurer, to the town of Pollnivneach, the gateway to Menaphos and Al Kharid. My name is Ali and I'm the mayor of this town. I hope you enjoy your stay here.
translation: Merhaba maceraci, Menaphos ve Al Kharid'e acilan kapi Pollnivneach kasabasina hos geldin. Benim adim Ali ve bu kasabanin belediye baskaniyim. Umarim burada keyifli vakit gecirirsiniz.

english: Thank you. That is one of the warmest welcomes I've ever had! People generally treat travelling adventurers with suspicion.
translation: Tesekkürler. Bu, simdiye kadar gördügüm en sicak karsilama! Insanlar genellikle seyahat eden maceracilari süpheyle karsilar.

english: All are welcome here. Now more than ever I suppose.
translation: Burada herkes hos karsilanir. Sanirim simdi daha da fazla.

english: What do you mean by that?
There's trouble in town, and a lot of villagers have left as a result. Things are looking dire.
translation: Kasabada sorunlar var ve bunun sonucunda bircok köylü kasabayi terk etti. Durum vahim görünüyor.

english: Hello good sir.
What do you want?
I'm new in town and wanted to get to know the locals.
translation: Kasabaya yeni geldim ve yerlileri tanimak istiyorum.

english: What do you want to know?
Tell me about yourself.
That information is available on a need to know basis and right now, you don't need to know.
translation: Bu bilgi ihtiyac duyuldugunda verilir ve su anda bilmenize gerek yok.

english: Can I help you with anything else?
translation: Baska bir konuda yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: Yes I'd like to ask you about something else.
translation: Evet, baska bir sey sormak istiyorum.

english: No thanks.
Tell me about the other people in the town.
Sheep, ready for the slau... hang on. I shouldn't be telling you that. Just forget I said anything.
translation: Koyunlar, kesime hazir... Bekle. Sana bunu söylememeliydim. Söyledigimi unut gitsin.

english: I'm looking for Ali.
You will have to be a lot more specific if you want help finding him. Everyone here is called Ali.
translation: Onu bulmak icin yardim istiyorsan daha ayrintili bilgi vermelisin. Buradaki herkesin adi Ali.

english: I've discovered that. Well he has an uncle called Ali Morrisane, a market vendor in Al Kharid and that's all I really know about him.
translation: Bunu fark ettim. Al Kharid'de pazar saticisi olan Ali Morrisane adinda bir amcasi var, onun hakkinda tek bildigim bu.

english: Say no more. I too am looking for him. The little tyke robbed me too, if we work together perhaps we can catch him and teach him a lesson.
translation: Daha fazla bir sey söyleme. Ben de onu ariyorum. O kücük velet beni de soydu, birlikte calisirsak belki onu yakalayabilir ve ona bir ders verebiliriz.

english: Tell me about yourself.
Yes I'd like to ask you about something else.
translation: Evet, sana baska bir sey sormak istiyorum.

english: No thanks.
Tell me about the other people in the town.
I'm looking for Ali.
Hello there! Who is this?
Ali.
Any particular Ali?
Only the best there is! I'm Ali the Sandsweeper.
translation: En iyisi! Ben Ali, Kum Süpürücüsü.

english: You sweep sand?
Certainly do!  I'm the best darn sandsweeper this side of the Lum.
translation: Elbette! Lum'un bu tarafindaki en iyi kum süpürücüsüyüm.

english: There's more of you?
We have a union, mate! There's always sand to sweep.
translation: Bir sendikamiz var dostum! Sürekli süpürülecek kum var.

english: Indeed. Um, I have to go.
Hello there!
You seem rather cheerful. Is there anything you're after?
translation: Oldukca neseli görünüyorsun. Aradigin bir sey mi var?

english: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
Well, it's hot and full of sand.
Anything else?
Don't ask me, I'm not from around here.
So where are you from?
A town to the south of the Shantay Pass, called Pollnivneach.
translation: Shantay Gecidi'nin güneyinde, Pollnivneach adinda bir kasabadan.

english: So, what do you do here?
Not very much, at the moment. I came from further south to set up a smithy here...
translation: Su anda pek bir sey yapmiyorum. Daha güneyden buraya demirci dükkani acmak icin geldim...

english: ...but we still haven't set up the shops, so we have no customers yet.
translation: ...ama dükkanlari henüz acamadik, bu yüzden henüz müsterimiz yok.

english: I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
Yes, he's the one who persuaded us to come here.
translation: Evet, buraya gelmemiz icin bizi ikna eden oydu.

english: He said we'd have lots of customers once we set up our shops, and all he asks for is a cut of the profits.
translation: Dükkanlari actigimizda cok müsterimiz olacagini söyledi ve tek istedigi kârin bir kismi.

english: Maybe I should talk to him...
Of course. He's always happy to talk to possible business partners.
translation: Tabii ki. O, olasi is ortaklariyla konusmaktan her zaman mutluluk duyar.

english: I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
translation: Diger dükkan sahiplerini tehdit ettigini duydum.

english: What? Who's spreading that rumour?
Well, one of the shopkeepers told me a man with a large hammer came to threaten them.
translation: Sey, dükkan sahiplerinden biri bana büyük bir cekicle bir adamin gelip onlari tehdit ettigini söyledi.

english: Don't pay any attention to those people.
They're just worried that they'll lose money when we open our shops.
translation: Sadece dükkanlarimiz acildiginda para kaybedeceklerinden endiseleniyorlar.

english: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
So, what do you do here?
I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
translation: Diger dükkan sahiplerini tehdit ettigini duydum.

english: Wow, a snake charmer! Can I have a go? Can I have a go? Please?
translation: Vay canina, bir yilan oynatici! Ben de deneyebilir miyim? Ben de deneyebilir miyim? Lütfen?

english: The snake charmer is focusing intently on his music and doesn't seem to notice you.
translation: Yilan oynatici müzigine yogunlasmis durumda ve seni fark etmiyor gibi görünüyor.

english: The snake charmer snaps out of his trance and directs his full attention to you.
translation: Yilan oynaticisi transindan cikar ve tüm dikkatini sana verir.

english: If it means that you'll leave me alone, I will happily give you my snake charming super starter kit, complete with flute and basket. But you're clearly over burdened as it is.
translation: Beni rahat birakacaksan, flüt ve sepetle birlikte yilan oynatma süper baslangic setimi seve seve veririm. Ama zaten yeterince yükün var.

english: Ah, I see you've lost your basket. Here you are, now leave me alone! You're ruining the show.
translation: Ah, sepetini kaybetmissin. Al bakalim, simdi beni rahat birak! Gösterimi mahvediyorsun.

english: Ah, I see you've lost your snake charming flute. Here you go, now leave me alone! You're distracting my punters... er, I mean, crowd.
translation: Ah, yilan oynatma flütünü kaybetmissin. Al bakalim, simdi beni rahat birak! Müsterilerimin dikkatini dagitiyorsun... yani, kalabaligin.

english: If you're that desperate to try, have my patented snake charming starter kit. It comes with a special snake charming flute and a basket to keep your charmed snakes in. Now, leave me alone!
translation: Denemek icin bu kadar caresizsen, patentli yilan oynatma baslangic setimi al. Özel bir yilan oynatma flütü ve oynattigin yilanlari koyabilecegin bir sepetle birlikte geliyor. Simdi beni rahat birak!

english: The snake charmer gives you a snake charming flute and a basket.
translation: Yilan oynaticisi sana yilan oynatma flütü ve bir sepet verir.

english: I'm not stopping you! You have your own snake charming flute.
translation: Seni engellemiyorum! Kendi yilan oynatma flütün var.

english: I want to talk to you about animal charming.
translation: Hayvan oynatma hakkinda seninle konusmak istiyorum.

english: I've lost some of the gear you gave me.
What do you need?
I've lost the music.
There you go. Now if you don't mind I'm busy trying to charm this here snake.
translation: Al bakalim. Simdi, sakincasi yoksa, bu yilani oynatmakla mesgulüm.

english: Hello.
Yes?
Can you teach me any more about animal charming.
translation: Bana hayvan büyücülügü hakkinda daha fazla sey ögretebilir misin?

english: No, I doubt it. I believe your talents lie in other areas.
translation: Hayir, sanmiyorum. Senin yeteneklerinin baska alanlarda oldugunu düsünüyorum.

english: Wow, a snake charmer! Can I have a go? Can I have a go? Please?
translation: Vay canina, bir yilan oynaticisi! Ben de deneyebilir miyim? Ben de deneyebilir miyim? Lütfen?

english: I want to talk to you about animal charming.
translation: Seninle hayvan büyücülügü hakkinda konusmak istiyorum.

english: Hello there!
I'm a little busy at the moment. What is it?
translation: Su anda biraz mesgulüm. Ne var?

english: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
Oh, it has wonderful weather.
Wonderful? It's hot and dry all the time!
translation: Harika mi? Her zaman sicak ve kuru!

english: Not quite as hot as back home.
Where's home, then?
Oh, it's a town to the south of the pass, called Pollnivneach.
translation: Oh, gecidin güneyinde Pollnivneach adinda bir kasaba.

english: So, what do you do here?
If I had cloth, patterns and customers, I'd be a tailor. As it is, I'm a tailor with nothing to do.
translation: Kumasim, kaliplarim ve müsterilerim olsaydi, terzi olurdum. Su anda ise, yapacak isi olmayan bir terziyim.

english: The silk merchant won't even sell me any silks, because he doesn't trust me!
translation: Ipek tüccari bana ipek satmiyor bile, cünkü bana güvenmiyor!

english: Anything I can do to help?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: No, no, it's all being dealt with.
I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
Of course, he's the one who's going to obtain cloth and clothes patterns so I can set up shop here.
translation: Tabii ki, burada dükkan acabilmem icin kumas ve kiyafet desenlerini temin edecek olan kisi o.

english: And in such a good location, too. Not out of the way like back home.
translation: Üstelik cok iyi bir konumda. Evimdeki gibi ücra bir yerde degil.

english: The customers will soon pour in!
Maybe I should talk to him...
Why not? He's always happy to talk to potential business partners.
translation: Neden olmasin? Potansiyel is ortaklariyla konusmaktan her zaman memnun olur.

english: I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
translation: Diger dükkan sahiplerini tehdit ettiginizi duydum.

english: Me, threaten people?
translation: Ben mi, insanlari tehdit etmek mi?

english: One of the shopkeepers did say they were threatened by a man with large scissors...
translation: Dükkan sahiplerinden biri, büyük makasli bir adam tarafindan tehdit edildiklerini söyledi...

english: Oh, them. Don't mind them. I think they're worried about what effect our shops will have.
translation: Oh, onlar. Onlara aldirmayin. Sanirim dükkanlarimizin ne gibi bir etkisi olacagi konusunda endiseliler.

english: For all they know, when we open our shops their wares will look cheap and shabby by comparison!
translation: Onlarin bildigi tek sey, dükkanlarimiz acildiginda, onlarin mallarinin kiyaslandiginda ucuz ve kalitesiz görünecegi!

english: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
So, what do you do here?
I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
translation: Diger dükkan sahiplerini tehdit ettigini duydum.

english: Hello.
Welcome! I'm Ali, and this is my tea shop! Is there anything I can do for you today?
translation: Hos geldiniz! Ben Ali, burasi da benim cay dükkanim! Bugün sizin icin yapabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Hmm... Could I get some tea?
Of course! I'll get the water boiling at once. Is there anything else I can do for you while you wait?
translation: Tabii ki! Hemen suyu kaynatayim. Beklerken sizin icin yapabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: How's the tea coming along?
Oh! Yes, the water is boiling. Just give me a minute!
translation: Oh! Evet, su kayniyor. Bir dakika bekleyin lütfen!

english: I'm so thirsty.
I know, the desert is forever hot. Thirsty work here!
translation: Biliyorum, cöl her zaman sicaktir. Burada calismak susatiyor!

english: How's business here? Seems quite out the way.
translation: Isler nasil gidiyor? Burasi oldukca uzak görünüyor.

english: Hmm...
Not good?
It's not that. It's just that I've been having issues with a few thieves lately. Four to be precise!
translation: Öyle degil. Sadece son zamanlarda birkac hirsizla sorun yasiyorum. Tam olarak dört tane!

english: They've been stealing your tea?
There have been a few break-ins. A recent shipment from Karamja has been taken! That was some of the finest stuff I've ever managed to get my hands on.
translation: Birkac hirsizlik olayi oldu. Karamja'dan gelen son sevkiyat calindi! O, simdiye kadar elde ettigim en kaliteli malzemeydi.

english: That's awful. If I see any shifty characters, I'll be sure to teach them a lesson.
translation: Bu cok kötü. Süpheli tipler görürsem, onlara derslerini veririm.

english: Ha! Very courageous, adventurer! These thieves are big and brutish. I wouldn't start something you may not be able to finish.
translation: Ha! Cok cesursun, maceraci! Bu hirsizlar iri ve vahsi. Bitiremeyecegin bir seye kalkismamalisin.

english: I'm pretty tough. I think I can handle them.
translation: Ben oldukca dayanikliyim. Onlarla basa cikabilirim.

english: If you say so.
I'd best be heading off.
You're leaving? But the tea is almost done!
translation: Gidiyor musun? Ama cay neredeyse hazir!

english: I've been waiting quite a while. Perhaps another time.
translation: Uzun zamandir bekliyorum. Belki baska bir zaman.

english: Well you never actually made me that tea...
translation: Aslinda bana o cayi hic yapmadin...

english: Ah yes! I'll get the water boiling at once. Is there anything else I can do for you while you wait?
translation: Ah evet! Hemen suyu kaynatayim. Beklerken sizin icin yapabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: How's the tea coming along?
How's business here? Seems quite out the way.
translation: Isler nasil gidiyor? Buraya gelmek oldukca zor.

english: I'd best be heading off.
Wow! lookat this place, it's so colourful.
translation: Vay canina! Su yere bak, ne kadar renkli.

english: Why thank you. Can I help you with anything?
translation: Tesekkür ederim. Size yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: I take it by the clothes you are wearing and this room that you are in the dye trade?
translation: Giydiklerinize ve bulundugunuz odaya bakilirsa boya ticareti mi yapiyorsunuz?

english: How observant of you.
Can you make dyes for me please?
translation: Benim icin boya yapabilir misiniz lütfen?

english: What colour dye do you want? I can make you blue, red or yellow dyes for you. If you bring me the correct raw materials.
translation: Hangi renk boya istiyorsunuz? Size mavi, kirmizi veya sari boya yapabilirim. Dogru hammaddeleri getirirseniz.

english: What do you need to make red dye?
translation: Kirmizi boya yapmak icin neye ihtiyaciniz var?

english: Hmm.... 3 lots of redberries should do the trick and 25 coins should cover any other costs.
translation: Hmm... 3 parti kirmizi meyve yeterli olur ve 25 sikke diger masraflari karsilar.

english: You don't have enough berries to make the red dye.
translation: Kirmizi boya yapmak icin yeterli meyveniz yok.

english: You don't have enough coins to pay for the dye.
Ok make me some red dye please.
translation: Tamam, lütfen bana kirmizi boya yapin.

english: You hand the redberries and some coins to Rana, who then rummages around some shelves, eventually finding a red bottle, which she then hands to you.
translation: Kirmizi meyveleri ve biraz parayi Rana'ya veriyorsun. Rana raflari karistiriyor ve sonunda kirmizi bir sise buluyor, sonra da onu sana veriyor.

english: I don't think I have all the ingredients yet.
You know what you need to get, now come back when you have them. Goodbye for now.
translation: Neye ihtiyacin oldugunu biliyorsun, onlari buldugunda geri gel. Simdilik hosca kal.

english: I can do without dye at that price.
Fair enough, I still think that the price is fairly reasonable considering that I'm the only source of dye this side of the Shantay pass.
translation: Haklisin, ama Shantay gecidinin bu tarafinda boya satan tek yer benim, bu yüzden fiyatin oldukca makul oldugunu düsünüyorum.

english: Where would I find a redberry bush?
Well you could try growing them. They shouldn't be too hard to grow.
translation: Kendin yetistirebilirsin. Yetistirmesi cok zor olmamali.

english: If I didn't care to grow my own, where else could I get some?
translation: Kendim yetistirmek istemiyorsam, baska nereden bulabilirim?

english: Well I know for sure that the desert climate wouldn't suit them. I have mine picked for me in the woods south of Varrock.
translation: Cöl iklimi onlara uygun olmayacagi kesin. Benimkiler Varrock'un güneyindeki ormanda toplaniyor.

english: What do you need to make yellow dye?
translation: Sari boya yapmak icin neye ihtiyacin var?

english: Yellow is an awkward colour to recreate, I guess if you got me 2 onions I could use their skins to make a warm yellow dye for you. Oh yes and lest I forget I'll need 25 coins to cover the cost of the glass ware and
translation: Sari, yeniden üretilmesi zor bir renk. Bana 2 sogan getirirsen, kabuklarini kullanarak sana sicak sari bir boya yapabilirim. Evet, unutmadan, cam esya ve

english: my wages.
translation: ücretimin masraflarini karsilamak icin 25 sikkeye ihtiyacim olacak.

english: You don't have enough onions to make the yellow dye.
translation: Sari boya yapmak icin yeterli soganin yok.

english: Ok make me some yellow dye please.
translation: Tamam, bana biraz sari boya yap lütfen.

english: You hand two onions to Rana, who then rummages around some shelves, eventually finding a yellow bottle, which she then hands to you.
translation: Rana'ya iki sogan veriyorsun, o da raflari karistirip sonunda sari bir sise buluyor ve onu sana veriyor.

english: Where could I find some onions?
Generally you would find onions in vegetable gardens, silly.
translation: Genelde soganlari sebze bahcelerinde bulursun, aptal.

english: Ok you have me there but is there anywhere around here where I could get my hands on some onions?
translation: Tamam, haklisin ama buralarda sogan bulabilecegim bir yer var mi?

english: I really don't know. A friend of mine grows hers on a farms near Draynor village. But that's a little far from here to be useful.
translation: Gercekten bilmiyorum. Bir arkadasim Draynor köyü yakinlarindaki bir ciftlikte sogan yetistiriyor. Ama burasi biraz uzak, pek isime yaramaz.

english: What do you need to make blue dye?
translation: Mavi boya yapmak icin neye ihtiyacin var?

english: To make a bottle of blue dye I'll need 2 woad leaves and 25 coins from you.
translation: Bir sise mavi boya yapmak icin 2 woad yapragi ve 25 sikkeye ihtiyacim var.

english: You don't have enough woad leaves to make the blue dye.
translation: Mavi boya yapmak icin yeterli woad yapragin yok.

english: Ok make me some blue dye please.
translation: Tamam, bana biraz mavi boya yap lütfen.

english: You hand the woad leaves and some coins to Rana, who then rummages around some shelves, eventually finding a blue bottle, which she then hands to you.
translation: Woad yapraklarini ve birkac sikkeyi Rana'ya veriyorsun. Rana raflari karistiriyor ve sonunda mavi bir sise buluyor, sonra da onu sana veriyor.

english: Where can I get some woad leaves?
Woad leaves are fairly rare. My other customers tell me there's a gardener in Falador who grows them.
translation: Woad yapraklari oldukca nadirdir. Diger müsterilerim Falador'da bunlari yetistiren bir bahcivan oldugunu söylüyorlar.

english: On second thoughts, I don't think that I need some dye right now.
translation: Bir daha düsündüm de, su anda boyaya ihtiyacim yok galiba.

english: How did you get into the colour business?
Well, it's quite simple really my mother was a drysalter and I learnt the trade from her.
translation: Aslinda cok basit, annem bir drysalter'di ve ben de bu isi ondan ögrendim.

english: Umm, what's a drysalter, it isn't a medical condition is it?
translation: Drysalter ne demek, tibbi bir durum degil, degil mi?

english: No silly, it's someone who deals with preservatives and dyes. I didn't really enjoy the preservative side of things so I've chosen to deal solely in dyeing.
translation: Hayir aptal, koruyucu ve boya satisi yapan kisi demek. Koruyucu tarafini pek sevmedigim icin sadece boya satisi yapmaya karar verdim.

english: So how's business then?
It's a dyeing trade! Oh gosh, I'm sorry, that was a truly dreadful joke.
translation: Bu bir boyama isi! Tanrim, özür dilerim, gercekten berbat bir sakaydi.

english: Hmm yes, about the worst I've heard today at least.
translation: Evet, en azindan bugün duydugum en kötü sakaydi.

english: Thanks. But really, it's not the best around here, nearly everyone in this town wears only white, which means I don't exactly do a roaring trade. Now is there anything I can get you?
translation: Tesekkürler. Ama gercekten, buradaki isler pek iyi degil, bu kasabadaki neredeyse herkes sadece beyaz giyiyor, bu da benim islerimin pek iyi gitmedigi anlamina geliyor. Size yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: No thanks, I'm just having a look around.
Could you make some dye for me please?
translation: Bana biraz boya yapabilir misin lütfen?

english: What do you need to make red dye?
translation: Kirmizi boya yapmak icin neye ihtiyacin var?

english: Okay, make me some red dye please.
translation: Tamam, bana biraz kirmizi boya yap lütfen.

english: I don't think I have all the ingredients yet.
I can do without dye at that price.
Where would I find a redberry bush?
What do you need to make yellow dye?
translation: Sari boya yapmak icin neye ihtiyacin var?

english: Okay, make me some yellow dye please.
translation: Tamam, bana biraz sari boya yap lütfen.

english: Where could I find some onions?
What do you need to make blue dye?
translation: Mavi boya yapmak icin neye ihtiyaciniz var?

english: Okay, make me some blue dye please.
translation: Tamam, bana mavi boya yapin lütfen.

english: Where can I get some woad leaves?
On second thoughts I don't really need any dye.
How did you get into the colour business?
No thanks, I'm just having a look around.
Hello. How can I help you?
Can you give me any Farming advice?
translation: Bana tarimla ilgili tavsiyelerde bulunabilir misin?

english: Yes - ask a gardener.
I'm okay, thank you.
What are you selling?
Can you give me any Farming advice?
translation: Bana tarimla ilgili tavsiyelerde bulunabilir misin?

english: I'm okay, thank you.
I'm sorry to bother you, but could you spare me a little dung?
translation: Rahatsiz ettigim icin özür dilerim, ama bana biraz gübre verebilir misin?

english: The camel didn't seem to appreciate that question.
translation: Deve bu soruyu pek begenmedi gibi görünüyor.

english: If I go near that camel, it'll probably bite my hand off.
translation: O deveye yaklasirsam, muhtemelen elimi isirir.

english: Mmm... looks like that camel would make a nice kebab.
translation: Mmm... o deve güzel bir kebap olur gibi görünüyor.

english: I wonder if that camel has fleas...
Are you serious?
Oh yes. If you'd be so kind...
Well, just you close your eyes first. I'm not doing it while you're watching me!
translation: Önce gözlerini kapat. Sen izlerken yapmam!

english: I hope that's what you wanted!
Ohhh yes. Lovely.
What did you say?
Nothing, nothing.
Well, don't interrupt me, I've got work to do.
Really? What sort of work?
translation: Gercekten mi? Ne tür bir is?

english: I'm participating in the construction of a shopping and sales extravaganza!
translation: Bir alisveris ve satis fuarinin yapimina katiliyorum!

english: ...What?
My masters have me hauling boxes around. There's not much to do at the moment, though.
translation: Efendilerim bana kutulari tasimami söylüyor. Ama su anda yapacak pek bir sey yok.

english: Are your masters those men called Ali?
Yes, that's them. They're traders working for Ali Morrisane.
translation: Evet, onlar. Ali Morrisane icin calisan tüccarlar.

english: So, what's it like working for your masters?
translation: Peki, efendilerin icin calismak nasil bir sey?

english: It's hard work sometimes, but it could be worse.
translation: Bazen zor oluyor, ama daha kötüsü de olabilirdi.

english: I heard about a pair of camels back in Pollnivneach who were poisoned!
They say someone put spicy sauce in their food.
Really? That's very cruel of whoever did it.
translation: Gercekten mi? Bunu yapan kisi cok zalimmis.

english: I sincerely hope whoever did it was punished. Do they have no compassion for camels?
translation: Umarim bunu yapan kisi cezalandirilmistir. Develere karsi hic merhametleri yok mu?

english: Ask the camel about its dung.
Say something unpleasant.
Neither - I'm a polite person.
translation: Ikisi de degil, ben kibar biriyim.

english: Greetings and welcome to my farming equipment shop. Would you like to buy some equipment?
translation: Merhaba, tarim ekipmanlari dükkanima hos geldiniz. Ekipman satin almak ister misiniz?

english: No, thank you.
Yes, please.
No, thank you.
Hello.
Ah, hello there. Nice to see an outsider for a change. Are you busy? I have a problem.
translation: Ah, merhaba. Bir degisiklik olsun diye bir yabanci görmek güzel. Mesgul müsün? Bir sorunum var.

english: How can I help?
It's my son Hudon, he's always getting into trouble. The boy's convinced there's hidden treasure in the river and I'm a bit worried about his safety, the poor lad can't even swim.
translation: Oglum Hudon, sürekli basini belaya sokuyor. Cocuk nehirde gizli bir hazine olduguna inaniyor ve ben onun güvenligi icin biraz endiseleniyorum, zavalli cocuk yüzme bile bilmiyor.

english: I could go and take a look for you if you like?
Would you? You are kind. You can use the small raft out back if you wish, do be careful, the current down stream is very strong.
translation: Gercekten mi? Cok naziksin. Istersen arkadaki kücük sali kullanabilirsin, ama dikkatli ol, nehrin akintisi cok güclü.

english: I'm afraid I'm in a rush.
Oh okay, never mind.
Hello Almera.
Hello adventurer, have you seen my boy yet?
I'm afraid not, but I'm sure he hasn't gone far.
translation: Maalesef görmedim, ama eminim cok uzaga gitmemistir.

english: I do hope so, you can't be too careful these days.
translation: Umarim öyledir, bu günlerde cok dikkatli olmak lazim.

english: Hello again.
Well hello, you're still around then.
I saw Hudon by the river but he refused to come back with me.
translation: Hudon'u nehrin yaninda gördüm ama benimle geri dönmeyi reddetti.

english: Yes he told me, the foolish lad came in drenched to the bone, he had fallen into the waterfall, lucky he wasn't killed! Now he can spend the rest of the summer in his room.
translation: Evet, bana söyledi, aptal cocuk sirilsiklam gelmisti, selaleye düsmüs, sansli ki ölmemis! Simdi yazin geri kalanini odasinda gecirecek.

english: Any ideas what I could do while I'm here?
translation: Burada ne yapabilirim, bir fikrin var mi?

english: Why don't you visit the tourist centre south of the waterfall?
translation: Selalenin güneyindeki turizm merkezini ziyaret etsene.

english: Hello again Almera.
Well hello again brave adventurer, are you enjoying the tranquil scenery of these parts?
translation: Merhaba cesur maceraci, buradaki sakin manzarayi begendin mi?

english: Yes, very relaxing.
Well I'm glad to hear itThe authorities wanted to dig up this whole area for a mine, but the few locals who lived here wouldn't budge and they gave up.
translation: Bunu duyduguma sevindim. Yetkililer burayi maden icin kazmak istediler ama burada yasayan birkac yerli halk pes etmedi ve vazgectiler.

english: Good for you.
Good for all of us!
Hello adventurer, how's your treasure hunt going?
translation: Merhaba maceraci, hazine avin nasil gidiyor?

english: Oh, I'm just sight seeing.
No adventurer stays here this long just to sight see. But your business is yours alone, if you need to use the raft go ahead. But please try not to crash it this time!
translation: Hicbir maceraci sadece gezmek icin bu kadar uzun süre burada kalmaz. Ama bu senin isin, eger sali kullanmak istiyorsan kullan. Ama lütfen bu sefer onu parcalamaya calisma!

english: Thank Almera.
Yes.
No.
Hello again.
You have crossed my path too many times intruder. Leave or face my wrath.
translation: Yoluma cok fazla ciktin, davetsiz misafir. Git yoksa öfkemle karsilasirsin.

english: Yeah, whatever.
Hello, Alomone.
Welcome, adventurer. Know that as a friend to Hazeel, you are always welcome here.
translation: Hos geldin, maceraci. Hazeel'in dostu olarak, burada her zaman hos karsilanirsin.

english: Hello Madam.
Oh, hello there.
Are you ok?
Not too bad... I've just got some troubles on my mind...
translation: Fena degil... Sadece kafamda bazi sorunlar var...

english: Hello, Edmond has asked me to help find your daughter.
translation: Merhaba, Edmond kizini bulmama yardim etmemi istedi.

english: Yes he told me. I've begun making your special gas mask, but I need some dwellberries to finish it.
translation: Evet, bana söyledi. Özel gaz maskeni yapmaya basladim, ama bitirmek icin biraz dwellberry'ye ihtiyacim var.

english: I'll try to get some.
The best place to look is in McGrubor's Wood, just west of Seers' Village.
translation: Aramak icin en iyi yer, Seers Köyü'nün batisindaki McGrubor Ormani.

english: Yes I've got some here.
There we go, all done. While in West Ardougne you must wear this at all times, or you could catch the plague.
translation: Iste, bitti. West Ardougne'da bu maskeyi her zaman takmalisin, yoksa vebaya yakalanabilirsin.

english: I'll make a spare mask for you in case you lose that one. I'll hide it in the cupboard in case the mourners come looking.
translation: Kaybetmen ihtimaline karsi yedek bir maske de yapacagim. Yas tutanlar gelip aramaya baslarsa diye dolaba saklayacagim.

english: Hello darling, I think Edmond had a good idea of how to get into West Ardougne, you should hear his idea.
translation: Merhaba sevgilim, Edmond'un West Ardougne'a girmenin iyi bir yolunu buldugunu düsünüyorum, onun fikrini dinlemelisin.

english: Alright, I'll go and see him now.
Hello Alrena.
Hello darling, how's that tunnel coming along?
I just need to soften the soil and then we'll start digging.
translation: Topragi yumusatmam gerekiyor, sonra kazmaya baslayacagiz.

english: Well I'm sure you're quicker than Edmond.
I just need to soften the soil a little more and then we'll start digging.
translation: Topragi biraz daha yumusatmam gerekiyor, sonra kazmaya baslayacagiz.

english: Hello again Alrena.
How's the tunnel going?
I'm getting there.
One of the mourners has been sniffing around asking questions about you and Edmond, you should keep an eye out for him.
translation: Cenazeye katilanlardan biri etrafta dolasip senin ve Edmond hakkinda sorular soruyor, ona dikkat etmelisin.

english: Also, don't forget about that spare gas mask if you need it. It's hidden in the cupboard.
translation: Ayrica, ihtiyacin olursa yedek gaz maskesini unutma. Dolapta sakli.

english: Great, thanks Alrena!
Okay, thanks for the warning.
Hello, any word on Elena?
Not yet I'm afraid.
Is there anything else I can do to help?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: It's alright, I'll get her back soon.
translation: Sorun degil, onu yakinda geri getirecegim.

english: That's the spirit, dear. Don't forget that there's a spare gas mask in the cupboard if you need one.
translation: Aferin sana canim. Ihtiyacin olursa dolapta yedek gaz maskesi oldugunu unutma.

english: That's the spirit, dear.
Do you have a picture of Elena?
Yes. There should be one in the house somewhere. Let me know if you need anything else.
translation: Evet. Evde bir yerde olmali. Baska bir seye ihtiyacin olursa haber ver.

english: Thank you for rescuing my daughter! Elena has told me of your bravery in entering a house that could have been plague infected. I can't thank you enough!
translation: Kizimi kurtardigin icin tesekkürler! Elena, veba bulasmis olabilecek bir eve girme cesaretinden bahsetti. Ne kadar tesekkür etsem az!

english: They've taken her...
Who?
Elena! They came and took her away!
Oh no! Is there anything I can do?
translation: Olamaz! Yapabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: I'm not sure... Speak to Edmond, he was there when they took her.
translation: Emin degilim... Edmond ile konus, onu götürdüklerinde o da oradaydi.

english: Thank you so much for helping Elena. It means so much to Edmond and I.
translation: Elena'ya yardim ettigin icin cok tesekkür ederim. Edmond ve benim icin cok anlamli.

english: I need another tabard.
