Not a problem. I still have enough materials to make another. Here you go.
translation: Sorun degil. Baska bir tane yapmak icin yeterince malzemem var. Al bakalim.

english: It'a not a problem.
I need another tabard.
It's not a problem.
Hello.
Good day.
Good day, Your Royal Highness.
Oi!
Rahr!
No!
Grr!
Aargh!
I'm a gonner!
It's no use, I'm done for!
Uggh!
Hello there.
What brings you to these parts, stranger?
translation: Bu bölgelere seni ne getirdi, yabanci?

english: What is this place?
I suppose it is a little different to the places your type are used to...
translation: Sanirim senin gibilerin alisik oldugu yerlerden biraz farkli...

english: This is my humble little hideaway! Plenty of fish around to sustain a man like me, with the help of my trusty cormorant.
translation: Burasi benim mütevazi kücük siginagim! Güvenilir kormoranimin yardimiyla, benim gibi bir adami besleyecek kadar bol balik var burada.

english: A bird helps you to fish?
translation: Bir kus balik tutmana yardim mi ediyor?

english: Sure she does! I haven't used a rod in years, just send her out to the waters and she takes care of it for me!
translation: Tabii ki! Yillardir oltayi kullanmiyorum, onu suya gönderiyorum ve o benim icin isi hallediyor!

english: Could I have a go with your bird?
I don't know, I doubt that your type's up to the task...
translation: Bilemiyorum, senin gibilerin bu isi yapabilecegini sanmiyorum...

english: But it would be quite the amusing sight. Go on!
translation: Ama oldukca eglenceli bir manzara olurdu. Hadi bakalim!

english: I'll keep an eye on you and make sure you don't have too much trouble with her!
translation: Sana göz kulak olurum ve onunla cok fazla sorun yasamadigindan emin olurum!

english: You're going to need to free up your hands first, though. Nothing in or on your hands.
translation: Ama önce ellerini serbest birakman gerekecek. Ellerinde veya ellerinin üzerinde hicbir sey olmamali.

english: I don't think that's for me... I'll leave that to you.
translation: Sanirim bu bana göre degil... Sen hallet.

english: No surprises there! Your type never have been cut out for it.
translation: Hic sasirmadim! Senin gibiler bu ise hic uygun olmadi.

english: What's in the sack?
Oh, this? This is my trusty old fish sack!
translation: Oh, bu mu? Bu benim güvenilir eski balik cuvalim!

english: Fish sack?
Yeah, fish sack! I might sell you one if you've found any of those pearls around here.
translation: Evet, balik cuvali! Eger buralarda inci bulduysan sana bir tane satabilirim.

english: No thanks.
I found this big fish...
Now that is a biggun! How she managed to wrangle one like that I'll never know.
translation: Bu gercekten büyük! Onun gibi bir baligi nasil yakaladigini asla bilemeyecegim.

english: If you don't want it, I could take it off your hands for a few of those pearls!
translation: Eger istemiyorsan, birkac inci karsiliginda senden alabilirim!

english: I'm interested... How many pearls are we talking?
I'll give you a hundred pearls for it. What do you say?
translation: Sana yüz inci veririm. Ne dersin?

english: On seconds thoughts, I'd rather keep it.
translation: Bir daha düsündüm de, saklamayi tercih ederim.

english: As you wish.
It's a deal.
Pleasure doing business with you!
Well, let me know if you change your mind.
Hello again.
Ah, it's you. How are you finding things?
It certainly is a challenge...
Yes, your type do often seem to underestimate it! Are you finished?
translation: Evet, senin gibiler genelde bunu hafife alirlar! Bitirdin mi?

english: Not yet. I think I'll keep trying.
Just come back and let me know when you get tired!
I'll try again another time.
What is this place?
Could I have a go with your bird?
I don't think that's for me.
What's in the sack?
Let's take a look.
No thanks.
I found this big fish...
It's a deal.
No, keep the tench.
Yes, exchange the golden tench.
Not yet. I think I'll keep trying.
Yeah, I'll try again another time.
translation: Evet, baska bir zaman tekrar deneyecegim.

english: Hello!
He seems to be in deep concentration.
...I'll leave you to it.
Hello.
Well hello there. Are you hungry? If so you've come to the right place. Eat green, eat gnome cuisine. My waiter will be glad to take your order.
translation: Merhaba. Ac misin? Öyleyse dogru yere geldin. Yesil ye, cüce mutfagi ye. Garsonum siparisini almaktan memnuniyet duyar.

english: Thanks.
On the other hand, if you're looking for some gnome cooking training, this is also the place to be. My son Lufty is looking for staff at the moment.
translation: Öte yandan, cüce mutfagi egitimi almak istiyorsan, burasi da tam sana göre bir yer. Oglum Lufty su anda personel ariyor.

english: No thank, I'm no cook.
In that case, please eat and enjoy.
Ok, I'll give it a go.
Well that's great. I'm Aluft Gianne, owner of this restaurant, and you are...?
translation: Harika. Ben Aluft Gianne, bu restoranin sahibi, sen kimsin?

english: Most people call me [player name].
Really? Sorry, how rude of me. It just takes a little while to get used to the funny names you humans have.
translation: Gercekten mi? Özür dilerim, ne kadar kaba davrandim. Siz insanlarin komik isimlerine alismak biraz zaman aliyor.

english: Of course if you're going to work for me I'll have to see what you're like first. Here, take a look at our menu.
translation: Tabii ki benim icin calisacaksan, önce nasil biri oldugunu görmem gerek. Al, menümüze bir göz at.

english: Aluft hands you a cook book.
translation: Aluft sana bir yemek kitabi uzatir.

english: When you've had a look at the book, come back here and I'll let you prepare a few dishes.
translation: Kitaba baktiktan sonra buraya geri gel, sana birkac yemek hazirlatacagim.

english: Ok then.
Hi Mr. Gianne.
Hello [player name]. So what did you think of the book?
translation: Merhaba Maceraci. Kitap hakkinda ne düsünüyorsun?

english: I'm not too sure about toad's legs.
translation: Kurbaga bacaklari konusunda pek emin degilim.

english: They're a gnome delicacy, very tasty. Chicken tastes like toad's legs you know. You'll love them. If I give you what you need, can you make me some Toad Crunchies?
translation: Onlar cücelerin lezzetli bir yemegidir, cok lezzetlidirler. Tavuk da kurbaga bacagi gibi tadi vardir, biliyor musun? Cok seveceksin. Sana ihtiyacin olan malzemeleri verirsem, bana kurbaga citirlari yapabilir misin?

english: I'll give it a go.
Aluft gives you two pairs of toad's legs, some gnome spice, some equa leaves, some dough and a crunchy tray.
translation: Aluft sana iki cift kurbaga bacagi, biraz cüce baharati, biraz equa yapragi, biraz hamur ve citir citir bir tepsi verir.

english: The dough is made according to a secret family recipe. If you need any more, I suggest you speak to Hudo the grocer. He's very reliable.
translation: Hamur, gizli bir aile tarifine göre yapilir. Daha fazlasina ihtiyacin olursa, bakkal Hudo ile konusmani öneririm. O cok güvenilirdir.

english: Let me know how you get on.
Hi Mr Gianne.
So how did you get on with the toad crunchies?
I think I've got one.
That looks identical to the crunchies I cooked not five minutes ago. You'll have to prove to me that you can make one yourself if you want my recommendation.
translation: Bu, bes dakika önce pisirdigim gevreklerle ayni görünüyor. Tavsiyemi istiyorsan, bunu kendin yapabildigini bana kanitlaman gerekecek.

english: Erm, I've not quite finished it yet.
Ok, let me know when you have.
I'm afraid I've lost the crunchie tray you gave to me.
translation: Korkarim bana verdigin citir citir tepsiyi kaybettim.

english: Ok, I'll give you another one. Obviously I can't expect you to cook without the proper utensils.
translation: Tamam, sana bir tane daha veririm. Elbette uygun mutfak aletleri olmadan yemek yapmani bekleyemem.

english: I've not finished yet.
Ok, well let me know when you're done.
Call me Aluft. So how did you get on with the toad crunchies?
translation: Bana Aluft de. Peki, kurbaga citir citirlari nasil oldu?

english: No problem, it was easy.
You give Aluft the toad crunchies. He takes a bite...
translation: Aluft'a kurbaga crunchies'i ver. O bir isirik alir...

english: Not bad, not bad at all.

Ok, now for something you might prefer. Try making some chocolate chip crunchies for me. They're my favourite. Here's everything you need. You can re-use the spice from the last recipe - one tin goes a long way.
translation: Tamam, simdi senin daha cok sevecegin bir sey yapalim. Benim icin cikolata parcacikli crunchies yapmayi dene. Onlar benim en sevdigimdir. Iste ihtiyacin olan her sey. Son tarifteki baharatlari tekrar kullanabilirsin - bir kutu uzun süre yeter.

english: Aluft gives you two bars of chocolate, some chocolate dust, and some dough.
translation: Aluft sana iki cikolata, biraz cikolata tozu ve biraz hamur verir.

english: Ok Aluft, I'll be back soon.
Hello Aluft.
Hello there, how did you get on.
I haven't made it yet.
It's one trayful of chocolate chip crunchies that I need. Just follow the instructions carefully.
translation: Bir tepsi cikolata parcacikli kraker lazim. Talimatlari dikkatlice izle.

english: Here you go.
You give Aluft the chocolate crunchies. He takes a bite...
translation: Aluft'a cikolata parcacikli krakerleri ver. Bir isirik alir...

english: Yes, yes, yes, that's superb. I'm really impressed.
translation: Evet, evet, evet, bu harika. Gercekten cok etkilendim.

english: Ok then, can you make me a toad batta?  Here's what you need.
translation: Tamam o zaman, bana bir kurbaga batta yapabilir misin? Iste ihtiyacin olan seyler.

english: Aluft gives you some cheese, some dough, some equa leaves, a pair of toad's legs and some more gnome spice.
translation: Aluft sana biraz peynir, biraz hamur, biraz equa yapragi, bir cift kurbaga bacagi ve biraz daha cüce baharati verir.

english: Let me know when the batta is ready.
translation: Batta hazir oldugunda bana haber ver.

english: Aluft.
Sorry, Aluft.
So where's my toad batta?
That looks identical to the toad batta I cooked not five minutes ago. You'll have to prove to me that you can make one yourself if you want my recommendation.
translation: Bu, bes dakika önce pisirdigim kurbaga battasiyla ayni görünüyor. Tavsiyemi istiyorsan, bunu kendin yapabildigini bana kanitlaman gerekecek.

english: I'm afraid I've lost the batta tin you gave to me.
I'm afraid I've lost the batta tin you gave to me.
Ok, be as quick as you can.
Here you go, that was no problem.
You give Aluft the toad batta. He takes a bite...
translation: Aluft'a kurbaga batta'yi ver. Bir isirik alir...

english: Ooh, that's some good toad. Very nice.
translation: Ooh, bu kurbaga cok iyi. Cok güzel.

english: Let's see if you can make a cheese and tomato batta next.
translation: Simdi peynirli ve domatesli batta yapabilir misin bir bakalim.

english: Hello again Aluft.
Hello [player name] have you made my Cheese and tomato Batta?
translation: Merhaba Maceraci, peynirli ve domatesli batta'mi yaptin mi?

english: That looks identical to the cheese and tomato batta I cooked not five minutes ago. You'll have to prove to me that you can make one yourself if you want my recommendation.
translation: Bu, bes dakika önce pisirdigim peynirli ve domatesli batta'ya tipatip benziyor. Benim tavsiyemi istiyorsan, bunu kendin yapabildigini bana kanitlaman gerekecek.

english: Here, see what you think.
translation: Al, bir bak bakalim ne dersin.

english: You give Aluft the batta. He sniffs it then takes a bite...
translation: Aluft'a batta'yi ver. Kokladiktan sonra bir isirik alir...

english: Hmm, that's actually really good.
How about this? Hmmm. I think you may well be ready for real cooking. Well I'm happy to give you my recommendation to Jnr, if that's what you want.
translation: Peki ya bu? Hmmm. Sanirim gercek yemek pisirmeye hazirsin. Eger istiyorsan, Jnr'a tavsiyemi vermekten memnuniyet duyarim.

english: Great thanks.
Well your training with me is over [player name]. Are you interested in some work?
translation: Benimle olan egitimin bitti Maceraci. Ise ilgi var mi?

english: I may be...

I think you're almost ready to do some work for my son Aluft Gianne Jnr. He is in charge of our new family venture: Gnome Food Delivery.  There's good tips to be made if you make and deliver gnome foods -
translation: Oglum Aluft Gianne Jnr icin calismaya neredeyse hazirsin bence. O, yeni aile girisimimiz Gnome Food Delivery'nin sorumlusu.  Gnome yemekleri yapip teslim edersen iyi bahsisler kazanabilirsin,

english: though you may have to travel all over Gielinor to fulfil some of the other orders...
translation: ancak diger siparisleri yerine getirmek icin Gielinor'un her yerini dolasman gerekebilir...

english: However, some of the orders Aluft aloft gets are for gnome cocktails, so if you want to work for Lufty, you'll need to undergo some basic cocktail making training. Go and have a chat with him. He's not that
translation: Ancak Aluft Aloft'un aldigi siparislerin bazilari gnome kokteylleri icin, bu yüzden Lufty icin calismak istiyorsan temel kokteyl yapimi egitimi alman gerekecek. Git ve onunla konus. O kadar da

english: scary...
Thanks for your help!
Oh, one last thing. My special dough, can be occasionally tricky to get hold of. I wouldn't want to stop you from cooking gnome delicacies for want of dough!
translation: Oh, son bir sey daha. Özel hamurumu bulmak bazen zor olabilir. Hamur bulamadigin icin gnome lezzetleri pisirmekten vazgecmeni istemem!

english: That should last you for a small while eh? That's all the free dough I'm going to give you so don't waste it!
translation: Bu sana bir süre yeter, degil mi? Sana verecegim tüm ücretsiz hamur bu, sakin israf etme!

english: Thanks!

Blurberry tells me that you have finished training with him, so I think you're ready to do some work for my son Aluft Gianne Jnr. He is in charge of our new family venture: Gnome Food Delivery.  There's good
translation: Blurberry, onunla egitiminizi tamamladiginizi söyledi, bu yüzden oglum Aluft Gianne Jnr. icin calismaya hazir oldugunuzu düsünüyorum. O, yeni aile girisimimiz olan Gnome Food Delivery'nin sorumlusu.  Gnome yemekleri yapip teslim ederseniz iyi

english: tips to be made if you make and deliver gnome foods - though you may have to travel all over Gielinor to fulfil some of the other orders...
translation: bahsisler kazanabilirsiniz, ancak diger siparisleri yerine getirmek icin Gielinor'un her yerini dolasmaniz gerekebilir...

english: Sounds interesting....
Go and have a chat with my son Lufty Jnr. and he'll fill you in with details.
translation: Git ve oglum Lufty Jnr. ile konus, sana ayrintilari anlatir.

english: No thanks, I'm no cook.
Ok, I'll give it a go.
I'm afraid I've lost the crunchy tray you gave to me.
translation: Korkarim bana verdigin citir tepsiyi kaybettim.

english: I've not finished yet.
Good day, [sir/madam].
What are you doing down here?
I'm waiting for my shift. I'm supposed to be digging once the others have finished.
translation: Vardiyami bekliyorum. Digerleri bitirince kazmaya baslayacagim.

english: I don't like the sound of these monsters, though.
translation: Ama bu canavarlarin sesi hosuma gitmiyor.

english: Monsters?
I heard that Donal went exploring in the caves, and saw a huge monster.
translation: Donal'in magaralari kesfe ciktigini ve kocaman bir canavar gördügünü duydum.

english: If you want to know more about it, ask Thorodin - he's working on the excavation right now.
translation: Daha fazla bilgi istiyorsan Thorodin'e sor, su anda kazi calismasinda.

english: I'm waiting for my shift, of course. We can't dig all the time, you know.
translation: Tabii ki vardiyami bekliyorum. Sürekli kazi yapamayiz ya.

english: I'm also researching the links between the Fremenniks and the Dwarves.
translation: Ayrica Fremennikler ve Cüceler arasindaki baglantilari arastiriyorum.

english: I've found that we have some mythology in common.
Good day.
What are you doing down here?
Good day.
Hello. Welcome to the Gielinor Housing Agency! What can I do for you?
translation: Merhaba. Gielinor Emlak Ajansi'na hos geldiniz! Sizin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: Can you move my house please?
Where would you like it moved to?
To Rimmington please!
Your house is already there!
Hmph. Come back when you have 5,000 coins.
Your house has been moved to Rimmington.
To Taverley please!
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 10.
translation: Korkarim ki oraya tasinmak icin yeterli Insaat seviyeniz yok. Seviye 10 olmaniz gerekiyor.

english: Your house has been moved to Taverley.
To Pollnivneach please!
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 20.
translation: Maalesef, oraya tasinmak icin yeterli Insaat seviyeniz yok. Seviye 20 olmaniz gerekiyor.

english: Hmph. Come back when you have 7,500 coins.
Your house has been moved to Pollnivneach.
To Hosidius please!
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 25.
translation: Maalesef, oraya tasinmak icin yeterli Insaat seviyeniz yok. 25. seviyeye ulasmaniz gerekiyor.

english: Hmph. Come back when you have 8,750 coins.
Absolutely. Hand me your blueprints and I'll make it happen! I'll keep the blueprints, so you'll always be able to switch back to this style in future, for a small fee.
translation: Tabii ki. Bana planlarinizi verin, ben hallederim! Planlari saklayacagim, böylece gelecekte kücük bir ücret karsiliginda bu stile geri dönebileceksiniz.

english: Your house has been moved to Hosidius.
To Rellekka please!
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 30.
translation: Maalesef, oraya tasinmak icin yeterli Insaat seviyeniz yok. 30. seviyeye ulasmaniz gerekiyor.

english: Hmph. Come back when you have 10,000 coins.
Your house has been moved to Rellekka.
To Brimhaven please!
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 40.
translation: Maalesef, oraya tasinmak icin yeterli Insaat seviyeniz yok. 40. seviyeye ulasmaniz gerekiyor.

english: Hmph. Come back when you have 15,000 coins.
Your house has been moved to Brimhaven.
To Yanille please!
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 50.
translation: Maalesef, oraya tasinmak icin yeterli Insaat seviyeniz yok. 50. seviyeye ulasmaniz gerekiyor.

english: Hmph. Come back when you have 25,000 coins.
Your house has been moved to Yanille.
To Prifddinas please!
Where? Never heard of it.
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 70.
translation: Korkarim oraya tasinmak icin yeterli Insaat seviyen yok. 70 seviyeye ulasman gerekiyor.

english: Hmph. Come back when you have 50,000 coins.
Your house has been moved to Prifddinas.
Can you redecorate my house please?
translation: Evimi yeniden dekore edebilir misin lütfen?

english: Certainly. My magic can rebuild the house in a completely new style! What style would you like?
translation: Elbette. Sihirimle evi tamamen yeni bir tarzda yeniden insa edebilirim! Hangi tarzi istersin?

english: Basic wood
Your house is already in that style!
Your house has been redecorated.
I'm afraid you haven't unlocked that style.
Hmph. Come back when you have 35,000 coins.
I'm afraid I'd need some blueprints for that.
translation: Korkarim bunun icin bazi planlara ihtiyacim var.

english: I'm afraid I'd need some blueprints for that. Maybe you can buy some by working for the contractors.
translation: Korkarim bunun icin bazi planlara ihtiyacim var. Belki müteahhitler icin calisarak bazilarini satin alabilirsin.

english: Could I have a Construction guide book?
You've already got one!
Not until you free up some inventory space.
Certainly.
Tell me about houses!
It all came out of the wizards' experiments. They found a way to fold space, so that they could pack many acres of land into an area only a foot across.
translation: Hepsi büyücülerin deneylerinden ortaya cikti. Uzayi katlamanin bir yolunu buldular, böylece birkac dönüm araziyi sadece 30 cm genisliginde bir alana sigdirabildiler.

english: They created several folded-space regions across Gielinor. Each one contains hundreds of small plots where people can build houses.
translation: Gielinor'da birkac katlanmis alan bölgesi olusturdular. Her biri, insanlarin ev insa edebilecegi yüzlerce kücük arsa iceriyor.

english: Ah, so that's how everyone can have a house without them cluttering up the world!
translation: Ah, demek bu sayede herkes ev sahibi olabiliyor ve dünya da daginik hale gelmiyor!

english: Quite. The wizards didn't want to get bogged down in the business side of things so they hired me to sell the houses.
translation: Aynen öyle. Büyücüler isin ticari yönüyle ugrasmak istemediler, bu yüzden evleri satmam icin beni ise aldilar.

english: There are various other people across Gielinor who can help you furnish your house.
translation: Gielinor'da evini dösemek icin sana yardimci olabilecek baska insanlar da var.

english: You should start by buying planks from a sawmill operator. Sawmills are located in north-east Varrock, the Woodcutting Guild located in south-west Hosidius and north-east Prifddinas.
translation: Öncelikle bir kereste fabrikasindan tahtalar satin almalisin. Kereste fabrikalari Varrock'un kuzeydogusunda, Odun Kesme Loncasi ise Hosidius'un güneybatisinda ve Prifddinas'in kuzeydogusunda bulunuyor.

english: Tell me about that skillcape you're wearing.

As you may know, skillcapes are only available to masters in a skill. I have spent my entire life building houses and now I spend my time selling them! As a sign of my abilities I wear this Skillcape of Construction.
translation: Bildigin gibi, beceri pelerinleri sadece bir beceride usta olanlar tarafindan giyilebilir. Hayatim boyunca evler insa ettim ve simdi de onlari satarak zamanimi geciriyorum! Yeteneklerimin bir göstergesi olarak bu Insaat Beceri Pelerini giyiyorum.

english: If you ever have enough skill to build a demonic throne, come and talk to me and I'll sell you a skillcape like mine.
translation: Eger seytani bir taht insa edecek kadar beceriye sahip olursan, gel benimle konus, sana benimki gibi bir beceri pelerini satarim.

english: The Cape of Construction also provides you with as many teleports as you like to any of the house portals or even directly inside!
translation: Insaat Pelerini, istedigin kadar ev portallarina veya hatta dogrudan evin icine teleport olmani saglar!

english: Can you sell me a Skillcape of Construction?
translation: Bana bir Insaat Beceri Pelerini satabilir misin?

english: Alright, that'll be 99000 coins, please. A small price to pay for such an illustrious cape that can teleport you to any of the house portals or even directly inside your house!
translation: Tamam, 99.000 jeton lütfen. Sizi evinizin herhangi bir kapisina veya hatta dogrudan evinizin icine isinlayabilen böylesine muhtesem bir pelerin icin ödenmesi gereken kücük bir bedel!

english: I'm not paying that!
Suit yourself. There are many other heroes who would love the opportunity to purchase one. You can find me here if you change your mind.
translation: Nasil isterseniz. Bunu satin alma firsatini kacirmak istemeyecek bircok kahraman var. Fikrinizi degistirirseniz beni burada bulabilirsiniz.

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: Ama maalesef yanimda yeterince para yok.

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.
translation: Peki, paran oldugunda tekrar gelip beni gör.

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: Maalesef tüm Skillcapes sadece ücretsiz bir baslik ile satiliyor, bu bir beceri promosyonunun parcasi; bir alana bir bedava, bilirsin. Yani sana bir tane satabilmem icin önce envanterinde yer acman gerekiyor.

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: Harika! O pelerini gururla giy dostum.

Could I have a Construction guide book?
Tell me about houses!
Tell me about that skillcape you're wearing.
Can you sell me a Skillcape of Construction?
translation: Bana Insaat Beceri Pelerini satabilir misin?

english: I'm not paying that!
Certainly, that sounds fair.
Hello!
Hello, if you've something important to tell me, be out with it! I'm a busy woman.
translation: Merhaba, bana söyleyecek önemli bir seyin varsa, söyle gitsin! Ben mesgul bir kadinim.

english: Just making small talk.
How very nice of you. However, I'm sure there are less busy people who'd love to chat.
translation: Ne kadar naziksin. Ancak, sohbet etmekten hoslanacak daha az mesgul insanlar olduguna eminim.

english: Oh, okay.
Chin up love and go adventure, that's what you lot do right?
translation: Basini dik tut sevgilim ve maceraya atil, sizler bunu yaparsiniz, degil mi?

english: I suppose we do, bye!
Who are you?
I'm Alyssa the housekeeper and this castle needs constant attention! I've enough trouble with the guards messing up my carpets without you adding to the problem.
translation: Ben Alyssa, hizmetciyim ve bu kale sürekli ilgi gerektiriyor! Muhafizlarin halilarimi mahvetmesiyle yeterince sorunum var, sen de sorunu daha da büyütme.

english: Hmm, yeah sorry about that. Speaking of carpets, ever thought how strange that there are carpets beneath the stairs?
translation: Hmm, evet, özür dilerim. Halilardan bahsetmisken, merdivenlerin altinda hali olmasi ne kadar garip, hic düsündün mü?

english: It's cut to fit! If I had a gold piece for everytime I was asked that question!
translation: Uyum saglamak icin kesilmis! Bu soruyu her sordugunda bir altin parcasi alsaydim!

english: Sure... Cut to fit... Not an oversight at all.
translation: Tabii... Uyum saglamak icin kesilmis... Hic de gözden kacmis bir sey degil.

english: Alright, believe what you like. I've a castle to clean.
translation: Tamam, neye inanmak istiyorsan ona inan. Temizlemem gereken bir kale var.

english: Bye.
Are you the Alyssa this entry mentions?
translation: Bu yazida bahsedilen Alyssa sen misin?

english: You show her 'A Dark Disposition'.
Ah, I suppose I am.
Got anything to say about it?
translation: Bununla ilgili söyleyecek bir seyin var mi?

english: Why should I tell you anything? There are private matters of a late royal family! It wouldn't be proper to divulge such information to an adventurer like you.
translation: Neden sana bir sey söyleyeyim ki? Bu, eski kraliyet ailesinin özel meseleleri! Senin gibi bir maceraciya bu tür bilgileri ifsa etmek uygun olmaz.

english: ...Most people don't know when to stop sharing. I guess you have a point though.
translation: ...Cogu insan ne zaman susmasi gerektigini bilmez. Sanirim haklisin.

english: Yes, I do indeed. Off with you, I've had my fair share of nosy adventurers for one day.
translation: Evet, haklisin. Git artik, bugün yeterince merakli maceraci gördüm.

english: Alright, sorry for disturbing you. Bye.
translation: Tamam, rahatsiz ettigim icin özür dilerim. Hosca kal.

english: Bye.
...Most people don't know when to stop sharing. It's probably worth mentioning that I've found all entries of this memoir.
translation: ...Cogu insan ne zaman susmasi gerektigini bilmez. Bu anilarin tüm girislerini buldugumu belirtmekte fayda var.

english: Yes, how did you come across this? I'm fairly certain it was destroyed... At least, I recall seeing a man removing the pages...
translation: Evet, bunu nasil buldun? Yikildigini saniyordum... En azindan, bir adamin sayfalari cikardigini hatirliyorum...

english: Honestly, I've never really questioned it. I do things for people and they give me things.
translation: Dürüst olmak gerekirse, hic sorgulamadim. Insanlar icin bir seyler yapiyorum ve onlar da bana bir seyler veriyorlar.

english: Well, I suppose if you've already nosily rifled through the princesses personal memoirs, I can tell you a little more.
translation: Peki, madem prensesin kisisel anilarini merakli bir sekilde karistirdin, sana biraz daha anlatabilirim.

english: Fantastic! I've got to say, there's some great little gems in this old book. I think I'm unravelling a great mystery!
translation: Harika! Bu eski kitapta bazi harika kücük hazineler var. Sanirim büyük bir gizemi cözüyorum!

english: Well, if I were you I'd keep shush on the whole matter.
translation: Eger senin yerinde olsaydim, bu konuyu gizli tutardim.

english: How come?
You must be new here. When the king died, everyone assumed the princess would take the throne when she came of age.
translation: Buraya yeni gelmis olmalisin. Kral öldügünde, herkes prensesin resit oldugunda tahta gececegini varsaydi.

english: But the council kept control...
Indeed, and poor young Rose was shipped off and labelled as crazy.
translation: Aynen öyle, ve zavalli genc Rose uzaklara gönderildi ve deli olarak damgalandi.

english: I do very much miss her, but one can't change the past.
translation: Onu cok özlüyorum, ama gecmisi degistiremezsin.

english: What if I were to say she's still out there! Read this entry that I found hidden within a secret part of the memoir.
translation: Ya ona hala hayatta oldugunu söylersem! Anilarin gizli bir bölümünde buldugum bu yaziyi oku.

english: I'm sorry adventurer, but what does this prove exactly? For all you know someone else wrote this to mislead you.
translation: Üzgünüm maceraci, ama bu tam olarak neyi kanitliyor? Belki de baska biri seni yaniltmak icin yazmistir.

english: Ah, you do make a good point...
If she did write this I'm afraid to say she must be mad after all.
translation: Eger bunu o yazdiysa, korkarim ki o gercekten deli olmali.

english: What makes you say that?
Are all adventurers as dense as you? If you were in danger, do you really think leaving a hidden message in an old lost book for any stranger to pick up is the best way to get help?
translation: Bütün maceracilar senin kadar aptal mi? Eger tehlikede olsaydin, eski bir kitapta gizli bir mesaj birakip herhangi bir yabancinin onu bulmasini beklemek yardim almak icin en iyi yol mu olurdu sence?

english: It's certainly peculiar, but it should be investigated regardless. Y'know, just in case...
translation: Kesinlikle tuhaf, ama yine de arastirilmali. Bilirsin, ne olur ne olmaz...

english: Alright, spring the trap! Don't come crying to me when it all turns sour.
translation: Tamam, tuzagi kur! Isler ters gittiginde bana aglamaya gelme.

english: Don't you worry! I'm a brave adventurer with a damsel in distress to rescue! This is my bread and butter.
translation: Merak etme! Ben kurtarilacak bir prensesin oldugu cesur bir maceraciyim! Bu benim ekmek param.

english: Yes, yes, of course. Well, I'd be glad to hear of her being safe but perhaps you should heed the warning.
translation: Evet, evet, tabii ki. Onun güvende oldugunu duymak beni mutlu eder ama belki de uyariyi dikkate almalisin.

english: Which warning?
Tread carefully.
Oh, of course! Thanks for chatting with me Alyssa, I'll see you around.
translation: Tabii ki! Benimle sohbet ettigin icin tesekkürler Alyssa, görüsürüz.

english: Farewell.
I'm sorry, but I'm not paid to serve every lazy adventurer who walks their dirty feet through my halls!
translation: Üzgünüm, ama koridorlarimda kirli ayaklariyla dolasan her tembel maceraciya hizmet etmek icin maas almiyorum!

english: Sorry, I'll be going.
Just making small talk.
Who are you?
You! I should have known this would be your doing!
translation: Sen! Bunun senin isin oldugunu bilmeliydim!

english: It's over, Amascut! Your plan has failed.
My plan has only just begun! Even with this setback, those pathetic fragments of my father have still given me ample power. My strength is absolute!
translation: Planim daha yeni basladi! Bu aksiliklere ragmen, babamin o zavalli parcalari bana hala bolca güc verdi. Gücüm mutlak!

english: Maybe, but it doesn't matter. I've stopped every one of your schemes so far, and I'll stop the next one as well.
translation: Belki, ama önemi yok. Simdiye kadar tüm planlarini engelledim ve bir sonrakini de engelleyecegim.

english: Really? You think you're leaving this place alive? I can promise you that won't be the case! My father's weapons have given me his power, and now they'll finally rid me of you!
translation: Gercekten mi? Buradan canli cikabilecegini mi saniyorsun? Sana bunun olmayacagini garanti edebilirim! Babamin silahlari bana onun gücünü verdi ve simdi sonunda senden kurtulmami saglayacaklar!

english: Amascut activates the obelisk and teleports away.
translation: Amascut obelisk'i etkinlestirir ve uzaklara isinlanir.

english: Yes.
No.
Headman Ur-tag, I cannot stress enough how important it is that this train link be completed on time. The mining companies have taken out considerable loans...
translation: Baskan Ur-tag, bu tren baglantisinin zamaninda tamamlanmasinin ne kadar önemli oldugunu yeterince vurgulayamiyorum. Madencilik sirketleri önemli miktarda kredi aldilar...

english: I understand your concerns, Ambassador, but you must realise that the discoveries must change the whole schedule. To remove them too hurriedly would be a crime against knowledge.
translation: Endiselerinizi anliyorum Büyükelci, ama kesiflerin tüm programi degistirecegini anlamalisiniz. Onlari aceleyle kaldirmak bilgiye karsi bir suc olur.

english: What are you talking about?
It's the new underground train link being built between our city and the dwarven city of Keldagrim.
translation: Sehrimiz ile cüce sehri Keldagrim arasinda insa edilen yeni yeralti tren baglantisi.

english: It will be the pinnacle of dwarven engineering! A great leap forward from the old steam-powered minecarts! A monument to the power and ingenuity of the Consortium!
translation: Cüce mühendisliginin zirvesi olacak! Eski buharli maden arabalarindan büyük bir sicrama! Konsorsiyumun gücü ve yaraticiliginin bir aniti olacak!

english: And it would be finished by now, except that they found some old goblin bones they want to dig up.
translation: Ve simdiye kadar bitmis olacakti, ancak kazmak istedikleri bazi eski goblin kemikleri buldular.

english: We've unearthed some very important artefacts that were buried during the Dorgeshuun Civil War. They could shed important light on our history.
translation: Dorgeshuun Ic Savasi sirasinda gömülen cok önemli eserler ortaya cikardik. Bunlar tarihimize önemli bir isik tutabilir.

english: [player name], do you have any experience with archaeology?
translation: Maceraci, arkeoloji konusunda deneyimin var mi?

english: I passed my archaeology exam at the Digsite!
Excellent! We have not had a major archaeological project for generations, so if you could give us some help we would appreciate it.
translation: Harika! Nesillerdir büyük bir arkeoloji projemiz olmadi, bu yüzden bize biraz yardim ederseniz cok seviniriz.

english: I'd love to help!
Splendid! The path to the train tunnel is in the south- west of the city.
translation: Mükemmel! Tren tüneline giden yol sehrin güneybatisinda.

english: Perhaps now we can get this finished quickly and get on with laying the tracks.
translation: Belki simdi bunu cabucak bitirip raylari dösemeye devam edebiliriz.

english: Do your own digging!
Oh well. We will continue at our own pace.
What can I do in the city?
Why don't you visit the market? I hear there is quite a craze for surface foods at the moment, so you might be able to sell something there.
translation: Pazari ziyaret etsene. Su anda yüzeydeki yiyecekler oldukca popülermis, belki orada bir seyler satabilirsin.

english: You might also want to visit the caves to the south of the city. There are many monsters to fight there, and Zanik apparently found ways to cross over their heads!
translation: Sehrin güneyindeki magaralari da ziyaret etmek isteyebilirsin. Orada savasacak bircok canavar var ve Zanik görünüse göre onlarin üstünden gecmenin bir yolunu bulmus!

english: Why did you decide to open the city?
For trade, and for fostering goodwill between races! I am sure that it will benefit both our races.
translation: Ticaret icin ve irklar arasinda iyi niyet olusturmak icin! Bunun her iki irk icin de faydali olacagina eminim.

english: It's funny... whenever we dwarves have ventured onto the surface, we've found ourselves at war with the goblins there.
translation: Komik... Biz cüceler yüzeye ciktigimizda, orada goblinlerle savasa girmisizdir.

english: But now we meet these goblins underground, and they're no threat at all. Maybe this will herald a change in our relations with the surface goblins as well.
translation: Ama simdi bu goblinlerle yeraltinda karsilasiyoruz ve hic tehdit olusturmuyorlar. Belki bu, yüzeydeki goblinlerle iliskilerimizde de bir degisiklik habercisi olur.

english: I can't stand these goblins sometimes! I come up with suggestions to make their city more efficient, and they just say it would spoil their precious way of life!
translation: Bazen bu goblinlere tahammül edemiyorum! Sehirlerini daha verimli hale getirmek icin önerilerde bulunuyorum, ama onlar sadece bunun degerli yasam tarzlarini bozacagini söylüyorlar!

english: Trade with the goblins is going well at the moment. It's a pity they don't seem as interested in our beer as in your food, though!
translation: Goblinlerle ticaret su anda iyi gidiyor. Ne yazik ki bizim biramiza sizin yemekleriniz kadar ilgi göstermiyorlar!

english: Thank you again for helping us complete the train link. Further delays would have cost the Consortium a lot of money.
translation: Tren baglantisini tamamlamamiza yardim ettiginiz icin tekrar tesekkür ederiz. Daha fazla gecikme, Konsorsiyuma cok pahaliya mal olacakti.

english: Oh, and I hear you saved someone's life as well. Well done on that count too.
translation: Oh, birinin hayatini da kurtardiginizi duydum. Bu konuda da tebrikler.

english: I miss Keldagrim. This city is all very well, but no one makes an underground city like the dwarves!
translation: Keldagrim'i özlüyorum. Bu sehir cok güzel, ama kimse cüceler gibi bir yeralti sehri yapamaz!

english: Answer this, please.
Well done.
Yes.
No.
What are you arguing about?
What can I do in the city?
Why did you decide to open the city?
Hello Ambassador. Are you here visiting King Roald?
translation: Merhaba Büyükelci. Kral Roald'i ziyarete mi geldiniz?

english: Well, in theory, but he always seems to be busy.
translation: Teorik olarak evet, ama o her zaman mesgul görünüyor.

english: You don't seem that upset by that, though...
translation: Ama bu sizi pek üzmüyor gibi...

english: Oh no, I like travelling, and if you become a diplomat patience is a vital skill.
translation: Hayir, seyahat etmeyi seviyorum ve diplomat olursaniz sabir cok önemli bir beceridir.

english: I'll try to remember that.
Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: Hazir yemekler maalesef ise yaramaz. Aluft Aloft'un müsterileri icin sadece el yapimi Cüce Mutfagi yeterince iyidir.

english: You hand over your delivery of [item] to Ambassador Ferrnook
Excellent. A taste of home.
You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: Bunu bana ulastirmak icin uzun bir yol kat etmis olmalisin. Iste sana bahsis olarak kücük bir sey.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.'dan ücretsiz teslimat jetonunu almayi unutma.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: Teslimatin cok gec kaldi! Aluft jnr.'a geri dönüp baska bir siparis al. Artik ihtiyacin olmadigi icin teslimat kutunu atiyorsun.

english: I can't believe that I've been made to wait so long.
translation: Bu kadar uzun süre bekletildigime inanamiyorum.

english: What are you waiting for?
I have been waiting for an audience with the King for days!
translation: Günlerdir Kral'in huzuruna cikmak icin bekliyorum!

english: Well, he's clearly a busy man.
translation: Eh, belli ki cok mesgul bir adam.

english: Bah! I think he's just trying to insult the gnome nation, by making me wait. The cheek of these humans. Just because they're vertically challenged they think they can ignore us.
translation: Bah! Bence beni bekleterek cüce ulusunu asagilamaya calisiyor. Bu insanlarin yüzsüzlügü yok mu! Boylari kisa diye bizi görmezden gelebilecegini saniyorlar.

english: I'm not ignoring you.
Hmm. I should be thankful for small mercies, I suppose.
translation: Hmm. Kücük iyilikler icin sükretmeliyim sanirim.

english: Many thanks. This will help wile away the time whilst I'm waiting for an audience.
translation: Cok tesekkürler. Bu, görüsmeyi beklerken zaman gecirmeme yardimci olacak.

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: Bunu bana ulastirmak icin uzun bir yol kat etmis olmalisin. Iste sana bahsis olarak kücük bir sey.

english: It's all very bright round here, isn't it?
Well, it is the White Knights' Castle.
I think it would all look better in a nice dark green. At least then I wouldn't be squinting all the time.
translation: Bence koyu yesil renk daha iyi olurdu. En azindan o zaman sürekli gözlerimi kismak zorunda kalmazdim.

english: Yes, but then they'd have to become the Dark Green Knights. Doesn't really have the same ring to it.
translation: Evet, ama o zaman Koyu Yesil Sövalyeler olmak zorunda kalirlardi. Kulaga pek hos gelmiyor.

english: Bah, humans have no sense of style...
Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: Hazir yemekler maalesef ise yaramaz. Aluft Aloft'un müsterileri icin sadece el yapimi Gnome Mutfagi yeterince iyidir.

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Ambassador Spanfipple
Thank you kindly. I haven't got used to this human food and drink yet.
translation: Cok tesekkür ederim. Henüz bu insan yemegi ve iceceklerine alisamadim.

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: Bunu bana ulastirmak icin uzun bir yol kat etmis olmalisiniz. Iste size bahsis olarak kücük bir ek ödeme.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.'dan ücretsiz teslimat jetonunuzu almayi unutmayin.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: Teslimatiniz cok gec! Aluft jnr.'a geri dönüp baska bir siparis alin. Artik ihtiyaciniz olmadigi icin teslimat kutunuzu atiyorsunuz.

english: It's all very white round here, isn't it?
I think it would all look better in pink. At least then I wouldn't be squinting all the time.
translation: Bence pembe olsaydi daha iyi görünürdü. En azindan o zaman sürekli gözlerimi kismak zorunda kalmazdim.

english: Yes, but then they'd have to become the Pink Knights. I think they'd have problems recruiting then.
translation: Evet, ama o zaman Pembe Sövalyeler olmak zorunda kalirlardi. O zaman da üye bulmakta zorlanirlardi herhalde.

english: You're probably right. Maybe brown, then.
translation: Haklisin galiba. O zaman kahverengi olsun.

english: I think that may be worse...
translation: Bence o daha da kötü olabilir...

english: Hello there.
Hello. Do you need something?
translation: Merhaba. Bir seye mi ihtiyaciniz var?

english: Nope. Just thought I'd say hi.
Hello there. Have you heard of Camorra?
Not that I remember.
Well she was a great hero during the Dragonkin Conflicts. I think she travelled to Kourend before the war ended. I'm trying to find out more about her.
translation: O, Ejderha Soyu Catismalari sirasinda büyük bir kahramandi. Sanirim savas bitmeden Kourend'e gitmisti. Onun hakkinda daha fazla bilgi edinmeye calisiyorum.

english: Well Shayzien was founded by those fleeing the Dragonkin Conflicts. And the city has never been short of heroes. There's a good chance she was from Shayzien.
translation: Shayzien, Ejderha Soyu Catismalari'ndan kacanlar tarafindan kuruldu. Ve bu sehirde kahramanlar hic eksik olmadi. Onun Shayzien'den olma ihtimali yüksek.

english: But you've never heard of her?
No but that's not surprising. Most of our history was lost during Xeric's reign. There is somewhere you might find answers though.
translation: Hayir, ama bu sasirtici degil. Tarihimizin cogu Xeric'in hükümdarligi sirasinda kayboldu. Yine de cevaplari bulabilecegin bir yer var.

english: Where's that?
The Shayzien Crypts. They were built before the kingdom even existed. Some of the oldest Shayzien heroes are buried there.
translation: Shayzien Mezarliklari. Krallik kurulmadan önce insa edilmisler. Shayzien'in en eski kahramanlarindan bazilari orada gömülü.

english: Let me guess. There's a catch isn't there?
translation: Dur tahmin edeyim. Bir sorun var, degil mi?

english: I'm afraid so. For hundreds of years, the crypts have been overrun by the dead. We've tried clearing them out but they just come back again.
translation: Korkarim öyle. Yüzlerce yildir mezarliklar ölüler tarafindan istila edildi. Onlari temizlemeye calistik ama tekrar geri geliyorlar.

english: Well thankfully I'm afraid of no ghost. Where do I start?
translation: Neyse ki hayaletlerden korkmuyorum. Nereden baslayayim?

english: They're zombies, not ghosts. You'll find the entrance to the crypts in the Graveyard of Heroes, south of our chapel. Be careful.
translation: Onlar hayalet degil, zombi. Mezarligin girisini sapelimizin güneyindeki Kahramanlar Mezarligi'nda bulabilirsin. Dikkatli ol.

english: Thank you for the help.
I'm sure we've already spoken about this.
We probably have. I'm very forgetful.
The most likely place to find answers is the Shayzien Crypts. You'll find the entrance in the Graveyard of Heroes, south of our chapel. Be careful, it's filled with zombies.
translation: Cevaplari bulabilecegin en olasi yer Shayzien Mezarliklari. Girisi, sapelimizin güneyindeki Kahramanlar Mezarligi'nda bulabilirsin. Dikkatli ol, orasi zombilerle dolu.

english: Thank you.
Greetings and welcome to my seed shop. Do you want to buy some seeds?
translation: Merhaba ve tohum dükkanima hos geldin. Tohum almak ister misin?

english: No, thank you.
Yes, please.
No, thank you.
Nilsal, iknami. Can I help you with anything today?
translation: Nilsal, iknami. Bugün size yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: What do you have for sale?
No, I'm fine.
Fair enough, iknami. Timoiva for now.
What do you have for sale?
No thanks.
Euat! You are not welcome here!
Euat! This is not yet over!
Euat! We are not done yet!
Euat! I am not so easily destroyed!
translation: Euat! Ben o kadar kolay yok edilemem!

english: Hello there.
Adventurer.
What do you do?
I'm a trader of sorts, but only to those who don't ask too many questions.
translation: Bir tür tüccarim, ama cok fazla soru sormayanlara.

english: Interesting, what do you offer?
I can give you crystal shards in return for crystal seeds.
translation: Kristal tohumlari karsiliginda sana kristal parcalari verebilirim.

english: I'll pass, maybe another time.
translation: Pas gececegim, belki baska bir zaman.

english: Yes.
No.
Hey I'm Amy, how may I help you?
translation: Merhaba, ben Amy, nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: What do you do here?
I'm the founder of Mahogany Homes, Gielinor's first Construction company!
translation: Gielinor'un ilk insaat sirketi olan Mahogany Homes'un kurucusuyum!

english: We've currently got branches in Falador, Varrock, Hosidius and Ardougne.
translation: Su anda Falador, Varrock, Hosidius ve Ardougne'da subelerimiz var.

english: So people contact you for help with their homes?
translation: Yani insanlar evleriyle ilgili yardim icin size mi basvuruyor?

english: Yep! They'll get in contact if they want assistance, whether it's fixing parts of their house or requesting nicer furniture, and then we will go and help them out.
translation: Evet! Evlerinin bir kismini tamir ettirmek veya daha güzel mobilyalar istemek gibi yardim almak istedikleri zaman bizimle iletisime geciyorlar, biz de gidip onlara yardim ediyoruz.

english: That sounds quite enjoyable and satisfying to do, are you hiring at all?
translation: Bu oldukca eglenceli ve tatmin edici bir is gibi görünüyor, personel alimi yapiyor musunuz?

english: If you have the supplies, I can tell you where one of our clients is that needs some work doing.
translation: Malzemeleriniz varsa, size is yapilmasi gereken müsterilerimizden birinin yerini söyleyebilirim.

english: I'll keep track of the work you do as well and give you some points for our company reward shop.
translation: Yaptiginiz isi de takip edecegim ve sirketimizin ödül magazasi icin size puan verecegim.

english: Also there are assistants in Varrock, Ardougne, and Hosidius that can give you work, if Falador is inconvienent for you.
translation: Ayrica, Falador size uygun degilse, Varrock, Ardougne ve Hosidius'ta size is verebilecek yardimcilar da var.

english: The clients that I would offer you to go help could be in any of those cities, it might be a bit of a journey to get there!
translation: Size yardim etmenizi önerecegim müsteriler bu sehirlerin herhangi birinde olabilir, oraya gitmek icin biraz yol kat etmeniz gerekebilir!

english: I'd like a construction contract.
What kind of contract would you like?
Could I have a beginner contract please?
Please could you go see[client][area][city], [location description] for us? You can get another job once you have furnished [his/her] home.
Could I have a novice contract please?
Could I have an adept contract please?
translation: Bir uzman sözlesmesi alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: Could I have an expert contract please?
translation: Bir usta sözlesmesi alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: I'll pass actually.
Thanks for the information.
What's my current construction contract?
Go see[client][area][city], [location description]. You can get another job once you have furnished [his/her] home.
How is the company doing?
Pretty good, we've only opened up recently and already have 12 clients!
translation: Oldukca iyi, daha yeni acildik ve simdiden 12 müsterimiz var!

english: These clients are quite indecisive about what they want their houses to look like though, I'm not complaining.
translation: Bu müsteriler evlerinin nasil görünmesini istedikleri konusunda oldukca kararsizlar, ama sikayet etmiyorum.

english: Yeah I've noticed that they seem to keep breaking hatstands all the time too, I'm not sure how easy it is to break a hatstand...
translation: Evet, onlarin da sürekli sapka askilarini kirdiklarini fark ettim. Sapka askisini kirmanin ne kadar kolay oldugunu bilmiyorum...

english: Very bizarre.
I'm glad you're doing well!
Thanks.
Why don't you have a construction cape if you're a master builder?
translation: Eger usta bir insaatciysan neden insaat pelerinin yok?

english: Well why do you have one?
The teleports on it are really handy.
Why would a cape for construction use magic? That seems a bit illogical doesn't it?
translation: Insaat icin kullanilan bir pelerin neden sihir kullanir ki? Bu biraz mantiksiz degil mi?

english: We are people of hard work, not ones that rely on wizardry!
translation: Bizler sihirbazliga güvenen insanlar degil, caliskan insanlariz!

english: I suppose you're right.
Nothing, never mind.
Sorry, Mahogany Homes aren't giving out any contracts during this league.
translation: Üzgünüz, Mahogany Homes bu lig sirasinda herhangi bir sözlesme imzalamiyor.

english: That's a plank, you'll need a lot of those.
translation: Bu bir tahta, bunlardan cok ihtiyacin olacak.

english: That's a sawIt's pretty useful.
That's a fascinating looking saw, it looks like it would break though.
translation: Bu cok ilginc bir testere, ama kirilabilir gibi görünüyor.

english: Oh you have have one of my saws, I hope you enjoy it!
translation: Oh, benim testerelerimden birine sahipsin, umarim begenirsin!

english: That's a hammer. It's pretty useful.
I'd like a construction contract.
Beginner Contract
Novice Contract (Requires 20 Construction)
Adept Contract (Requires 50 Construction)
Expert Contract (Requires 70 Construction)
I'll pass actually.
Thanks for the information.
What's my current contract?
Could I see the reward shop?
How is the company doing?
Why don't you have a construction cape?
Nothing, never mind.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Biliyorsun, insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu var. Merhaba, selam, merhaba...

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: Bu yine de tek bir selamlama sayilir!

english: Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her türlü sey! Kuleler görülmeye deger harika bir manzara.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmenizi tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Woooo wooo wooooo woooo.
You! Which god do you serve?
Err... What?
The war! What side do you fight on?
War? There's no war?
No war? But I was fighting earlier today.
translation: Savas yok mu? Ama bugün savasiyordum.

english: I hate to say it, but I don't think that's true. You're dead.
translation: Bunu söylemek istemem ama bence bu dogru degil. Sen öldün.

english: Dead? That can't be! I am a loyal warrior of...
translation: Öldüm mü? Olamaz! Ben sadik bir savasciyim...

english: Of?
I... I don't know. I can't remember.
We came here to fight. But I don't know who for. It's like it was moments ago, but also a lifetime in the past.
translation: Buraya savasmaya geldik. Ama kimin icin savastigimizi bilmiyorum. Sanki birkac dakika önce olmus gibi, ama ayni zamanda bir ömür önceymis gibi.

english: Do you know who you were fighting against?
No. We were here to claim something. To protect it. But everything else is unclear.
translation: Hayir. Buraya bir seyi ele gecirmek icin geldik. Onu korumak icin. Ama geri kalan her sey belirsiz.

english: I'm sorry, this is all so confusing. I need some time to try and understand.
translation: Üzgünüm, bu cok kafa karistirici. Anlamak icin biraz zamana ihtiyacim var.

english: Well I hope it all works out for you. Good luck.
translation: Umarim her sey yoluna girer. Iyi sanslar.

english: Die puny chicken!
What? I'm not a chicken.
You wear cunning disguise. I see though. You flappy chicken! You die in name of Big High War God.
translation: Kurnaz bir kilik degistirmissin. Ama ben anliyorum. Seni kanat cirpan tavuk! Büyük Savas Tanrisi adina öleceksin.

english: There's no Big High War God here.
Lies! Big High War God use the shiny to kill the chickens! Now we clear up the rest!
translation: Yalan! Büyük Savas Tanrisi parlak seyi kullanarak tavuklari öldürüyor! Simdi geri kalanlari temizleyelim!

english: Sorry to be the bearer of bad news, but I think this 'shiny' might have killed you as well.
translation: Kötü haber vermek istemem ama bence bu “parlak sey” seni de öldürdü.

english: Chicken play mind games, but I no fool. You die now!
translation: Tavuklar akil oyunlari oynar, ama ben aptal degilim. Simdi öleceksin!

english: You know there's normally not this much talking before dying.
translation: Normalde ölmeden önce bu kadar cok konusulmaz.

english: Yes! No talking! Only die!
translation: Evet! Konusmak yok! Sadece ölmek var!...

english: I'm waiting.
Arghhh!
I think I'll leave you to it.
Die!
For Zaros!
Perish in agony!
I'm coming for you!
What do you do here?
I'm helpin' ta protect the base camp. How about you, what are you doing here?
translation: Ana kampi korumaya yardim ediyorum. Peki ya sen, burada ne yapiyorsun?

english: Oh, I'm trying to help out around here.
Good, we can always use extra help. Just make sure you don't go getting into any trouble or you'll have me to deal with!
translation: Güzel, fazladan yardima her zaman ihtiyacimiz var. Sadece basini belaya sokma, yoksa benimle ugrasmak zorunda kalirsin!

english: Hello there. Want to travel to Slepe? I charge 10,000 coins for the journey.
translation: Merhaba. Slepe'ye gitmek ister misin? Yolculuk icin 10.000 sikke aliyorum.

english: Yes please.
Doesn't look like you have enough money. I charge 10,000 coins for the journey.
translation: Yeterli paran yok gibi görünüyor. Yolculuk icin 10.000 sikke aliyorum.

english: Where's Slepe?
It's a small village to the south of here. You can walk but the boat is safer and faster.
translation: Buranin güneyinde kücük bir köy. Yürüyerek de gidebilirsin ama tekne daha güvenli ve hizlidir.

english: Is there anything to do there?
translation: Orada yapacak bir sey var mi?

english: I guess that depends what interests you. The place is pretty quiet, though there's been rumours recently of a great evil making its home beneath the village.
translation: Sanirim bu senin ilgi alanlarina bagli. Burasi oldukca sakin bir yer ama son zamanlarda köyün altinda büyük bir kötülügün yuvalandigina dair söylentiler var.

english: There's also Ver Sinhaza to the south, home to the Theatre of Blood. It's definitely worth having a look around, even if you don't intend to participate yourself.
translation: Güneyde Ver Sinhaza da var, Kan Tiyatrosu'nun evi. Katilmak istemeseniz bile, kesinlikle bir göz atmaya deger.

english: So, do you want to go to Slepe?
Why is it so expensive?
Not many people want to visit this part of the world so I have to keep the price high. If I didn't I wouldn't be able to keep my boat maintained.
translation: Bu bölümü ziyaret etmek isteyen pek kimse yok, bu yüzden fiyati yüksek tutmak zorundayim. Aksi takdirde teknemizin bakimini yapamam.

english: I'll give you 1,000,000 coins for permanent access.
translation: Sana kalici erisim icin 1.000.000 sikke veririm.

english: 1,000,000 coins! Are you serious?
No. I don't have that sort of money.
Oh, I see. So, do you want to go to Slepe?
translation: Anliyorum. Peki, Slepe'ye gitmek ister misin?

english: Yes. Here's 1,000,000 coins.
Thank you so much. Now, do you want to go to Slepe?
translation: Cok tesekkür ederim. Simdi, Slepe'ye gitmek ister misin?

english: No. That's too much for me to spend.
translation: Hayir. Bu benim icin cok fazla para.

english: No thank you.
Hello there. Want to travel to Slepe?
Hello there. Want to return to Port Phasmatys?
translation: Merhaba. Port Phasmatys'e dönmek ister misin?

english: Andras transports the player to Port Phasmatys.
Is there anything to do around here?
translation: Buralarda yapacak bir sey var mi?

english: Well you have Slepe just north of here. It's mostly a quiet place, though there's been rumours recently of a great evil making its home beneath the village.
translation: Buranin hemen kuzeyinde Slepe var. Genelde sakin bir yer ama son zamanlarda köyün altinda büyük bir kötülügün yuvalandigina dair söylentiler var.

english: There's also Ver Sinhaza. You can find it south of here. There's a gap in the northern wall that you can get through.
translation: Ver Sinhaza da var. Buranin güneyinde bulabilirsin. Kuzey duvarinda gecebilecegin bir bosluk var.

english: What's Ver Sinhaza?

It's a large vampyric castle, home to the Theatre of Blood. The vampyres claim that the Theatre is one of the greatest combat challenges around. Definitely worth a look even if you don't want to participate.
translation: Kan Tiyatrosu'nun bulundugu büyük bir vampir kalesi. Vampirler, Tiyatronun bu civardaki en büyük savas meydanlarindan biri oldugunu iddia ediyorlar. Katilmak istemeseniz bile kesinlikle görülmeye deger.

english: Anyway, did you want to return to Port Phasmatys?
translation: Neyse, Port Phasmatys'e dönmek ister misiniz?

english: Andras transports the player to Slepe.
Yes please.
Where's Slepe?
No thank you.
Why is it so expensive?
I'll give you 1,000,000 coins for permanent access.
translation: Kalici erisim icin sana 1.000.000 sikke veririm.

english: Yes. Here's 1,000,000 coins.
No. That's too much for me to spend.
translation: Hayir. Bu benim icin cok fazla.

english: Is there anything to do around here?
translation: Burada yapacak bir sey var mi?

english: I can't believe we've finally arrived, I can't wait to explore!
translation: Sonunda geldigimize inanamiyorum, kesfetmek icin sabirsizlaniyorum!

english: So much to see, I don't know where to start!
translation: Görülecek o kadar cok sey var ki, nereden baslayacagimi bilemiyorum!

english: A whole new continent to explore... what a time to be
translation: Kesfedilecek yepyeni bir kita... Ne harika bir zaman!

english: Are you the tour guide?
Nope, I'm just as lost as you.
translation: Hayir, ben de sizin kadar kayboldum.

english: I overheard someone mention there are pirates and thieves here, be careful!
translation: Burada korsanlar ve hirsizlar oldugunu duydum, dikkatli olun!

english: Well met, fellow adventurer.
Adventurer? I am no mere Adventurer, I am Andros Mai, brother of the Holy Order of Saradomin. You would do well to greet me with respect.
translation: Maceraci mi? Ben siradan bir maceraci degilim, ben Saradomin Kutsal Tarikati'nin kardesi Andros Mai'yim. Bana saygiyla selamlamaniz iyi olur.

english: Andros Mai? Sorry, but I can't say I've heard of you I'm afraid.
translation: Andros Mai mi? Üzgünüm ama korkarim ki adini hic duymadim.

english: I wouldn't have expected someone of your... stature to know of me.
translation: Senin gibi... saygin birinin beni tanimasini beklemiyordum.

english: Tell me, what do you know of the vile Vet'ion?
translation: Söylesene, asagilik Vet'ion hakkinda ne biliyorsun?

english: Nothing, but I have a feeling you're about to fill me in.
translation: Hicbir sey, ama sanirim sen bana anlatacaksin.

english: We've crossed swords in the past, I can't say I'm too keen to do it again though.
translation: Gecmiste kiliclarimiz carpisti, ama bunu tekrar yapmak istemedigimi söyleyebilirim.

english: You challenged him and came out unscathed? Impossible.
translation: Ona meydan okudunuz ve zarar görmeden kurtuldunuz mu? Imkansiz.

english: I'm stronger than I look.
But why do you ask? What do you want with Vet'ion?
translation: Ama neden soruyorsunuz? Vet'ion'dan ne istiyorsunuz?

english: Vet'ion was a devout follower of the heretical god Zamorak. It is the will of my order and my duty as a follower of the true god Saradomin to end his tyranny.
translation: Vet'ion, sapkin tanri Zamorak'in sadik bir takipcisiydi. Onun zulmüne son vermek, tarikatimin iradesi ve gercek tanri Saradomin'in takipcisi olarak benim görevimdir.

english: After many years in my order's libraries, I stumbled upon an old tome which mentioned Vet'ion's final resting place, which I believe to be his source of power.
translation: Tarikatimin kütüphanelerinde gecirdigim uzun yillar boyunca, Vet'ion'un son dinlenme yerini belirten eski bir kitap buldum. Bence bu yer onun güc kaynagi.

english: His very existence is an insult to my lord Saradomin and I will not suffer it to exist any longer.
translation: Onun varligi, efendim Saradomin'e bir hakarettir ve onun varligini daha fazla tahammül edemem.

english: Then why are you waiting here? Seems to me that you don't want to face Vet'ion.
translation: O zaman neden burada bekliyorsun? Bana Vet'ion ile yüzlesmek istemiyormussun gibi geliyor.

english: I have no fear of Vet'ion!
I am merely meditating and preparing for the battle. I need to focus my mind before going out to find his resting place.
translation: Sadece meditasyon yapip savasa hazirlaniyorum. Onun mezarini bulmaya gitmeden önce zihnimi odaklamam gerekiyor.

english: It's okay, sometimes I pretend to be busy when there's something I don't want to do, too.
translation: Sorun degil, ben de bazen yapmak istemedigim bir sey oldugunda mesgul gibi davranirim.

english: This conversation is over! Leave me before I lose my temper.
translation: Bu konusma bitti! Sinirlenmeden önce git buradan.

english: Hey. Do you know anything about this?
translation: Hey. Bunun hakkinda bir sey biliyor musun?

english: By Saradomin! That's a Zamorakian made chainmace you have there!
translation: Saradomin adina! O senin elindeki Zamorakian yapimi bir zincirli mizrak!

english: And? Do you know anything about it?
translation: Ee? Bunun hakkinda bir sey biliyor musun?

english: I know melee weapons in general. Well enough to know most of them can be upgraded.
translation: Genel olarak yakin dövüs silahlarini bilirim. Cogunun gelistirilebilecegini bilecek kadar iyi bilirim.

english: Perhaps with something sharp to give it more impact as it swings around.
translation: Belki de sallandiginda daha fazla etki yaratmasi icin keskin bir sey ile.

english: Interesting! I'll be on the lookout for a powerful enhancement like that.
translation: Ilginc! Böyle güclü bir gelistirme icin gözümü dört acacagim.

english: They look like powerful claws. You could probably attach them to a weapon to make the weapon stronger.
translation: Güclü penceler gibi görünüyorlar. Muhtemelen bir silaha takarak silahi daha güclü hale getirebilirsin.

english: Interesting! I'll be on the lookout for that.
translation: Ilginc! Bunun icin gözümü dört acacagim.

english: Perhaps I could use this?
Yes. Those look like they could be attached to the weapon.
translation: Evet. Bunlar silaha takilabilir gibi görünüyor.

english: Could you combine them?
While I could, I'd really not like to.
Surely you could consider it... For the right price?
translation: Elbette bunu düsünebilirsin... Uygun bir fiyata?...

english: Money has been tight lately...
And my supplies are running low...
Fine. But I want 500,000 coins for that. No less.
translation: Peki. Ama bunun icin 500.000 sikke istiyorum. Daha azi olmaz.

english: I don't have the money for that.
Feel free to come back when you do.
There we go! All done.
No thanks.
No. I'm afraid not. They just look like fangs.
translation: Hayir. Korkarim ki hayir. Sadece dis gibi görünüyorlar.

english: Fangs indeed. Rather useless it seems.
translation: Gercekten de dis gibi. Pek ise yaramaz görünüyorlar.

english: Perhaps not. I've seen that Derse Venator guy over there handle similar items. Perhaps he knows more.
translation: Belki de degil. Suradaki Derse Venator denen adamin benzer esyalari kullandigini gördüm. Belki o daha fazla bilir.

english: Thanks!
That's him! The vile Vet'Ion. I should like to smash this skull!
translation: Iste o! Igrenc Vet'Ion. Bu kafatasini parcalamak istiyorum!

english: Wait! It seems to still contain some magic. Surely we can use it?
translation: Dur! Hala biraz sihir barindiriyor gibi görünüyor. Kesinlikle kullanabiliriz, degil mi?

english: The only thing his skull would be useful for is Zamorakian heresy. I won't stand for it!
translation: Bu kafatasinin tek yarari Zamorakian sapkinligi icin olabilir. Buna izin veremem!

english: Is there really nothing you can do to help me with this?
translation: Bana bu konuda gercekten yardimci olabileceginiz hicbir sey yok mu?

english: Do you see Phabelle over there? Despite her questionable morals, she's my friend.
translation: Suradaki Phabelle'i görüyor musun? Süpheli ahlakina ragmen, o benim arkadasim.

english: She's good with magic and may know how to take advantage of the powers in that skull.
translation: Büyü konusunda iyidir ve o kafatasindaki güclerden nasil yararlanilacagini biliyor olabilir.

english: No, I'm afraid not.
Oh. Do you know someone who might know more?
translation: Oh. Daha fazla bilgi sahibi olabilecek birini taniyor musun?

english: Downstairs you can find Madam Sikaro. Though she's on the wrong path, perhaps she could assist you.
translation: Asagida Madam Sikaro'yu bulabilirsin. Yanlis yolda olsa da, belki sana yardimci olabilir.

english: You look ready for combat.
Ask about rare item.
Yes
No
You look like somebody who could use a bit of armour. What do you say?
translation: Biraz zirh kullanabilecek birine benziyorsun. Ne dersin?

english: I'll take a look.
No thanks.
Maybe I overestimated you. I suppose such fine equipment isn't for everyone.
translation: Belki de seni fazla abartmisim. Sanirim bu kadar kaliteli ekipman herkese uygun degil.

english: You don't have anything I can repair.
There you go, happy doing business with you!
translation: Iste, seninle is yapmak cok keyifli!

english: I'll take a look.
No thanks.
Repair that item: [cost to repair single item] coins.
Repair all items: [cost to repair all items] coins.
Cancel.
Hey, how can I help you?
What do you do here?
This is one of the branches for Mahogany Homes, Gielinor's first construction company.
translation: Burasi Gielinor'un ilk insaat sirketi olan Mahogany Homes'un subelerinden biri.

english: Oh wow, how can I get involved?
If you go see Amy in the Falador branch, she'll fill you in. Her office is just east of the Estate Agent in Falador.
translation: Falador subesindeki Amy'yi görürseniz, size bilgi verir. Ofisi Falador'daki Emlakci'nin hemen dogusunda.

english: Nice, thank you.
I'd like a construction contract.
What kind of contract would you like?
Could I have an expert contract please?
translation: Bir uzman sözlesmesi alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: Please could you go seeBarbara, south ofHosidius, near the mill for us? You can get another job once you have furnished her home.
translation: Hosidius'un güneyinde, degirmenin yakinindaki Barbara'yi bizim icin görür müsünüz lütfen? Onun evini dösediginizde baska bir is alabilirsiniz.

english: Please could you go seeBobin north-eastVarrock, opposite the church for us? You can get another job once you have furnished his home.
translation: Lütfen bizim icin Varrock'un kuzeydogusunda, kilisenin karsisindaki Bobin'i görür müsünüz? Onun evini dösediginizde baska bir is alabilirsiniz.

english: Please could you go seeJess, upstairs of the building south of the church in EastArdougnefor us? You can get another job once you have furnished her home.
translation: Lütfen bizim icin East Ardougne'deki kilisenin güneyindeki binanin üst katindaki Jess'i görür müsünüz? Onun evini dösediginizde baska bir is alabilirsiniz.

english: Please could you go seeLarry, north of the fountain inFaladorfor us? You can get another job once you have furnished his home.
translation: Lütfen bizim icin Falador'daki cesmenin kuzeyindeki Larry'yi görür müsünüz? Onun evini dösediginizde baska bir is alabilirsiniz.

english: Please could you go seeMariah, west of the estate agents inHosidiusfor us? You can get another job once you have furnished her home.
translation: Lütfen bizim icin Hosidius'taki emlakcinin batisindaki Mariah'i görmeye gider misiniz? Onun evini dösediginizde baska bir is bulabilirsiniz.

english: Please could you go seeNoella, north of EastArdougne marketfor us? You can get another job once you have furnished her home.
translation: Lütfen bizim icin East Ardougne pazarinin kuzeyindeki Noella'yi görmeye gider misiniz? Onun evini dösediginizde baska bir is alabilirsiniz.

english: Please could you go seeNorman, south of the fountain inFaladorfor us? You can get another job once you have furnished his home.
translation: Lütfen bizim icin Falador'daki cesmenin güneyindeki Norman'i görmeye gider misiniz? Onun evini dösediginizde baska bir is alabilirsiniz.

english: Please could you go seeRoss, north of the church in EastArdougnefor us? You can get another job once you have furnished his home.
translation: Lütfen bizim icin East Ardougne'daki kilisenin kuzeyindeki Ross'u görmeye gider misiniz? Onun evini dösediginizde baska bir is alabilirsiniz.

english: Please could you go seeTau, south east of the fountain inFaladorfor us? You can get another job once you have furnished her home.
translation: Falador'daki cesmenin güneydogusunda bulunan Tau'yu bizim icin ziyaret eder misiniz? Onun evini dösediginizde baska bir is alabilirsiniz.

english: I'll pass actually.
What's my current construction contract?
Beginner Contract
Novice Contract (Requires 20 Construction)
Adept Contract (Requires 50 Construction)
Expert Contract (Requires 70 Construction)
I'll pass actually.
I'm ALIVE!
I'm ALIVE!
I'm ALIVE!
I'm ALIVE!
I'm ALIVE!
I'm ALIVE!
I'm ALIVE!
Anita is busy cleaning.
Hi Anita.
I'm sorry about what happened to Glough, Anita.
Glough was deeply troubled, [player name]. Fortunately Carado has helped me move on.
translation: Glough cok üzgündü Maceraci. Neyse ki Carado bana yardimci oldu.

english: Hello.
Hello sir. What are you doing in my house?
I'm just wandering around.
Oh dear, are you lost?
Yes, I'm lost.
Okay, just walk north-east when you leave this house, and soon you'll reach the big city of Falador.
translation: Tamam, bu evden ciktiginizda kuzeydoguya dogru yürüyün, kisa sürede Falador büyük sehrine varacaksiniz.

english: Thanks a lot.
No, I know where I am.
Oh? Well, would you mind wandering somewhere else? This is my house.
translation: Oh? Peki, baska bir yere dolasabilir misiniz? Burasi benim evim.

english: Meh!
I was hoping you'd give me some free stuff.
translation: Bana bedava bir seyler verirsiniz diye umuyordum.

english: Do you REALLY need it?
Er...
I don't have much on me...
I don't know...
(beg beg beg beg beg beg)
I promise I'll stop bothering you!
translation: Sizi rahatsiz etmeyi birakacagima söz veriyorum!

english: Pleeease!
Pwetty pleathe wiv thugar on top!
Oh, alright. Here you go.
Eeeek!
Aaaarrgh!
I'm just wandering around.
Yes, I'm lost.
No, I know where I am.
I was hoping you'd give me some free stuff.
translation: Bana bedava bir seyler verirsin diye umuyordum.

english: I've come to kill you.
Hello.
The dwarf lady seems to be looking for someone.
translation: Cüce bayan birini ariyor gibi görünüyor.

english: Hello, I'm looking for my husband. Have you seen him?
translation: Merhaba, kocami ariyorum. Onu gördünüz mü?

english: What does he look like?
Oh, to pot with this silly charade, I'm down here to try and win big on the moggies.
translation: Ah, bu aptalca oyuna son verelim, ben buraya kedilerle büyük para kazanmaya geldim.

english: Hang on, I thought you were looking for your husband.
Um no, I was just pretending. It's frowned on a little to be seen in these parts.
translation: Hayir, sadece numara yapiyordum. Bu bölgede görülmek pek hos karsilanmiyor.

english: So how do these rat pits work?
translation: Peki bu fare cukurlari nasil calisiyor?

english: The Keldagrim pits cater for those with the larger variety of cats.
translation: Keldagrim cukurlari, daha büyük kedileri olanlara hitap ediyor.

english: If you have an overgrown cat and a couple of coins you can challenge someone else who also has an overgrown cat and some spare change.
translation: Eger büyük bir kediniz ve birkac madeni paraniz varsa, ayni sekilde büyük bir kedisi ve biraz bozuk parasi olan baska birine meydan okuyabilirsiniz.

english: That sounds simple enough so far.
translation: Su ana kadar kulaga basit geliyor.

english: You then agree on a wager. It's rumoured that some ratcatchers can talk to their own cats and give them tactics to aid them.
translation: Sonra bir bahis üzerinde anlasirsiniz. Bazi fare avcilarinin kedileriyle konusabildikleri ve onlara yardimci olacak taktikler verebildikleri söyleniyor.

english: So then how do you win the challenge?
translation: Peki, bu meydan okumayi nasil kazanirsiniz?

english: I was just getting to that. Both the challengers' cats are placed inside the arena, and whichever kills 9 rats first wins.
translation: Simdi ona geliyorum. Iki meydan okuyanin kedileri arenaya yerlestirilir ve ilk 9 fareyi öldüren kazanir.

english: That sounds vile and cruel.
It's a cruel world and the pits are no exception.
translation: Dünya zalim bir yer ve cukurlar da bir istisna degil.

english: Each to their own, I say.
It sounds a little dangerous for my cat.
I agree. Cats have been known to be killed in fights.
Oh how terrible. Is there nothing you can do to save your cat?
translation: Ne kadar korkunc. Kedinizi kurtarmak icin yapabileceginiz hicbir sey yok mu?

english: Of course there is, you can instruct it to be cautious, and it will leave once it feels as if it is in danger.
translation: Tabii ki var, ona dikkatli olmasini söyleyebilirsin, tehlike hissettiginde oradan ayrilacaktir.

english: Oh that sounds quite wise.
That depends on how you value your cat.
translation: Bu, kedine ne kadar deger verdigine bagli.

english: Sorry, I don't follow.
Well if your cat dies or it runs away you lose.
translation: Kedinin ölmesi veya kacmasi durumunda kaybedersin.

english: So the longer it stays in the fight the better chance you have of winning.
translation: Yani kavgada ne kadar uzun kalirsa, kazanma sansin o kadar artar.

english: Wow that sounds like fun!
I don't know about that.
One thing I know though is that it's a quick way to make and lose money.
translation: Bildigim tek sey, bu hizli bir sekilde para kazanmanin ve kaybetmenin yolu oldugu.

english: Is there a limit to how much you can bet?
translation: Bahis miktarinda bir sinir var mi?

english: Hmmm... let me think. I don't think that's ever arisen but I think it's 20,000.
translation: Hmmm... bir düsüneyim. Hic böyle bir durum olmadi ama sanirim 20.000.

english: Hmm, that sounds like a silly amount of money to bet on a cat fight.
translation: Hmm, kedi kavgasina bahis yapmak icin sacma bir miktar gibi geliyor.

english: You'd be surprised what some people would be willing to bet.
translation: Bazi insanlarin ne kadar bahis yapmaya razi olduklarini görsen sasirirsin.

english: There is a minimum bet of 100 coins too.
Can I challenge you and your cat?
translation: Sana ve kedine meydan okuyabilir miyim?

english: No, not now, we don't really bet with outsiders.
translation: Hayir, su anda olmaz, disaridan gelenlerle bahis yapmiyoruz.

english: But I'm not an outsider, am I not inside in the pits now?
translation: Ama ben disaridan gelmiyorum, su anda ringin icinde degil miyim?

english: I don't know, maybe once you've done something to win over my trust.
translation: Bilmiyorum, belki güvenimi kazanacak bir sey yaparsan.

english: Can it be bought?
What?
Your trust.
No. Regular townsfolk don't like us, which leads us to distrust them and anyone else.
translation: Hayir. Siradan kasaba halki bizi sevmiyor, bu da bizim onlara ve diger herkese güvenmememize neden oluyor.

english: Thanks for your help.
That sounds vile and cruel.
translation: Bu cok kötü ve zalimce geliyor.

english: One more thing...
Thanks for your help.
It sounds a little dangerous for my cat.
translation: Kedim icin biraz tehlikeli gibi geliyor.

english: Wow that sounds like fun.
Is there a limit to how much you can bet?
