translation: Bahis miktarinda bir sinir var mi?

english: Can I challenge you and your cat?
translation: Sana ve kedine meydan okuyabilir miyim?

english: Apparently you aren't as stupid as you look.
Ah. You must be [player name], right? I have a bronze pickaxe here for you!
translation: Ah. Sen Maceraci olmalisin, degil mi? Sana bronz bir kazma getirdim!

english: Thanks very much!
My employer, Surok Magis, sent word to me that you may come to use the tunnel. You will need something to help you get in there. The pickaxe I've given to you should help.
translation: Isverenim Surok Magis, tüneli kullanmak icin gelebileceginizi söyledi. Oraya girmek icin bir seye ihtiyaciniz olacak. Size verdigim kazma isinize yarayacaktir.

english: Uh, thanks.
Okay, then. The tunnel awaits...
translation: Tamam o zaman. Tünel sizi bekliyor...

english: What tunnel?
Why, the Chaos Tunnel of course! I imagine Surok will have told you of it.
translation: Tabii ki Kaos Tüneli! Surok size bundan bahsetmistir herhalde.

english: Oh, I see. Well, what can you tell me about it?
translation: Anliyorum. Peki, bana bu tünel hakkinda ne söyleyebilirsin?

english: Well, story and rumour has it that the Dagon'hai built a tunnel here under the statue of Saradomin that would allow them to visit the Chaos Altar without having to go through the Wilderness.
translation: Hikayelere ve söylentilere göre, Dagon'hai, Saradomin heykelinin altinda, Wilderness'dan gecmeden Kaos Altari'ni ziyaret etmelerini saglayacak bir tünel insa etmis.

english: That's extremely handy!
Yes, it is. Or, at least, it would be. Unfortunately, I haven't been able to get in there so far.
translation: Evet, öyle. En azindan öyle olmaliydi. Ne yazik ki, su ana kadar oraya giremedim.

english: Why not?
The tunnel entrance needs to be cleared before anyone can get in there. However, my Mining skill isn't high enough at all to do it myself. Perhaps you could have a go?
translation: Tünelin girisi temizlenmeden kimse iceri giremez. Ancak, madencilik becerim bunu kendim yapabilecek kadar yüksek degil. Belki sen deneyebilirsin?

english: Sorry, who are you?
My name is Louisiana Jones, although most people call me Anna. I'm an archaeologist.
translation: Adim Louisiana Jones, ama cogu kisi bana Anna der. Ben bir arkeologum.

english: Pleased to meet you.
Likewise!
Who does this statue represent?
That, my dear, is the statue of the great god Saradomin himself. Stand and admire in awe for you are in the presence of greatness!
translation: O, sevgili dostum, büyük tanri Saradomin'in heykelidir. Ayaga kalk ve hayranlikla seyret, cünkü sen büyüklügün huzurundasin!

english: Consider me awed!
Indeed!
What are you doing here?
Well story and rumour has it that the Dagon'hai built a tunnel under this statue of Saradomin that would allow them to visit the Chaos Altar without having to go through the Wilderness.
translation: Hikayelere ve söylentilere göre, Dagon'hai bu Saradomin heykelinin altina, Wilderness'dan gecmeden Kaos Altari'ni ziyaret etmelerini saglayacak bir tünel insa etmisler.

english: Yes, it is. Or, at least, it would be. I came to excavate the tunnel but, unfortunately,  I haven't been able to get in there so far.
translation: Evet, öyle. Ya da en azindan öyle olacakti. Tüneli kazmaya geldim ama ne yazik ki su ana kadar iceri giremedim.

english: The tunnel entrance needs to be cleared before anyone can get in there. However, my Mining skill just isn't what it used to be. Perhaps you could have a go?
translation: Tünelin girisi temizlenmeden kimse iceri giremez. Ancak madencilik becerim eskisi gibi degil. Belki sen deneyebilirsin?

english: Maybe. I might do.
Okay, I'd better go.
Okay, then!
You did it! Oh, well done! How exciting!
Right, well, I better see what's down there, then.
translation: Tamam, o zaman asagida ne var bir bakayim.

english: Aren't you going to go inside?
I'd better not. My orders were to open up the entrance and wait for Surok to arrive. When he gets here, we'll go in together. He promised me a lot of gold for this job!
translation: Girmemem daha iyi. Emirlerim girisi acip Surok'un gelmesini beklemekti. O geldiginde birlikte iceri girecegiz. Bu is icin bana cok altin sözü verdi!

english: Okay, then. I'm going in to have a look!
translation: Tamam o zaman. Iceri girip bir bakacagim!

english: What tunnel?
Sorry, who are you?
Who does this statue represent?
What are you doing here?
Okay, I'd better go.
Hello visitor, how are you?
Better than expected. It's a lot...nicer...here than I was expecting. Everyone seems pretty happy.
translation: Bekledigimden daha iyi. Burasi bekledigimden cok daha güzel. Herkes oldukca mutlu görünüyor.

english: Of course, the Burgher is strong and wise, and looks after us well.
translation: Tabii ki, Burgher güclü ve bilge, bize iyi bakiyor.

english: I think some of those Jatizso citizens have got the wrong idea about this place.
translation: Bence bazi Jatizso vatandaslari burayi yanlis anliyorlar.

english: Can I help you with drift net storage, human?
translation: Drift aglarinin depolanmasinda yardimci olabilir miyim, insan?

english: What do you do?
My aunt lets people come in here to catch the fish. Sometimes they have trouble carrying enough stuff, so I help by holding onto spare drift nets for them.
translation: Teyzem buraya balik tutmaya gelenlere izin veriyor. Bazen yeterince esya tasimakta zorlaniyorlar, ben de onlara yedek drift aglarini tutarak yardimci oluyorum.

english: It's a free service to help more of you humans use Ceto's cave; she's paying me, so you don't have to. So can I help you with your drift nets?
translation: Bu, daha fazla insanin Ceto'nun magarasini kullanmasina yardimci olmak icin ücretsiz bir hizmet; bana ödeme yapiyor, bu yüzden sizin ödemenize gerek yok. Drift aglarinizla ilgili yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: Yes please.
No thanks.
What do you do?
Yes please.
No thanks.
Ha Ha Ha. Well if it isn't [player name], why do you dare enter my domain....
translation: Ha ha ha. Bu Maceraci degil mi? Neden benim bölgeme girmeye cüret ediyorsun...

english: Long time no see Anti-Santa, how's prison life been treating you?
translation: Uzun zaman oldu Anti-Noel Baba, hapishane hayati nasil gidiyor?

english: It has been glorious, you may have thought me to be rotting inside these walls, but I've been coming up with plot to end Christmas once and for all!
translation: Harika gidiyor, beni bu duvarlarin icinde cürüyor sanmis olabilirsin, ama Noel'i sonsuza kadar bitirmek icin bir plan yapiyorum!

english: You may ofstopped me all those years ago, but you didn't stop my mind.
translation: Yillar önce beni durdurmus olabilirsin, ama zihnimi durduramadin.

english: Soon I'll escape these walls and there'll be naught to stop me.
translation: Yakinda bu duvarlari asacagim ve beni durduracak hicbir sey kalmayacak.

english: This pathetic holiday will come to an end and I'll laugh as it burns.
translation: Bu acinasi bayram sona erecek ve ben onun yanisini izleyip gülecegim.

english: That red buffoon will not be able to stop me, nor you, nor that dumb cat!
translation: O kirmizi soytari beni durduramayacak, sen de, o aptal kedi de!

english: Anti-Santa, Santa told me all about you.
translation: Anti-Noel Baba, Noel Baba bana senden bahsetti.

english: Don't mention his name to me, he's everything I hate about this repulsive holiday, I have always dreamed about tearing down this revolting time of year.
translation: Bana onun adini anma, o bu igrenc bayramda nefret ettigim her seyin ta kendisi, ben her zaman bu tiksindirici zamani ortadan kaldirmayi hayal ettim.

english: Years ago I almost succeeded, but I was thwarted by that red buffoon and some dumb cat!
translation: Yillar önce neredeyse basarmistim, ama o kirmizi soytari ve aptal kedi tarafindan engellendim!

english: But in the years I've been locked away, I've been plotting and scheming. When I escape from this cell....
translation: Ama hapsedildigim yillar boyunca planlar yaptim ve komplolar kurdum. Bu hücreden kactigimda...

english: Yes, Christmas will never be the same, children will be crying instead of laughing!
translation: Evet, Noel bir daha asla eskisi gibi olmayacak, cocuklar gülmek yerine aglayacak!

english: The streets will be cold and lifeless.
I will stop Christmas once and for all!
And soon it will be the year of the Anti-Christmas!
*Snores*
OI!
*Wakes up* Oh sorry! You were going on for a bit, I thought it'd never end.
translation: *Uyanir* Oh, pardon! Biraz uzattin, hic bitmeyecek sandim.

english: You've been moved to the top of my kill list [player name].
translation: Öldürme listemin en basina tasindin Maceraci.

english: Let's cut to the chase, I need your help Anti-Santa.
translation: Sadede gelelim, yardimina ihtiyacim var Anti-Noel Baba.

english: Oh, so you've come begging to me for help, what makes you think I would help you?
translation: Oh, bana yardim icin yalvarmaya geldin, neden sana yardim edecegimi düsünüyorsun?

english: What other choice do you have? It looks incredibly boring in this cell.
translation: Baska secenegin var mi? Bu hücrede inanilmaz sikici görünüyor.

english: Well, that's true, but I'd rather that than help you.
translation: Evet, dogru, ama sana yardim etmektense bunu tercih ederim.

english: You're so over dramatic. Santa said he'd consider freeing you only if you help us.
translation: Cok abartilisin. Noel Baba, bize yardim edersen seni serbest birakmayi düsünecegini söyledi.

english: Oh did he... ...now might be my chance to escape this cell... you know what. I will help you.
translation: Öyle mi... ...simdi bu hücreden kacmak icin bir sansim olabilir... biliyor musun. Sana yardim edecegim.

english: Finally, he needs you to deal with Jack Frost at a bakery in Varrock.
translation: Sonunda, Varrock'taki bir firinda Jack Frost ile ilgilenmeni istiyor.

english: Is that it? Why can't he do it himself?
translation: Hepsi bu mu? Neden kendisi yapamiyor?

english: He's testing a new parenting technique.
Really? How are we meant to get into this bakery?
translation: Gercekten mi? Bu firina nasil girecegiz?

english: He gave me this teleport tablet, it will take us right inside of the bakery.
translation: Bana bu teleport tabletini verdi, bizi firinin icine götürecek.

english: After all these years, he's still making adventurers do his dirty work. He's just as bad as me.
translation: Bunca yil sonra, hala maceracilara kirli islerini yaptiriyor. O da benim kadar kötü.

english: Trust me, I'm getting tired of it as well, we need to go before it's too late.
translation: Inan bana, ben de bundan biktim, gec olmadan gitmeliyiz.

english: Ha Ha Ha If it isn't Jack Frost. You look smaller than last time I saw you.
translation: Ha ha ha, Jack Frost degil mi bu? Son gördügümden daha kücük görünüyorsun.

english: A-A-Anti Santa!? What are you doing here?
translation: A-A-Anti Santa!? Burada ne isin var?

english: Your father sent me. Apparently, you've been rather naughty this year.
translation: Beni baban gönderdi. Anlasilan bu yil oldukca yaramazlik yapmissin.

english: I'm here to sort you out.
What? My dad sent you? No way, he put me in charge of Christmas.
translation: Ne? Babam mi gönderdi seni? Olamaz, Noel'i bana emanet etti.

english: He did and apparently you're doing such an awful job of it, you've ruined it for everyone...
translation: Öyle yapti ve görünüse göre bu isi cok kötü yapiyorsun, herkesin keyfini kacirdin...

english: When you think about it, are you sure you're not my son?
translation: Düsündügünde, benim oglum olmadigindan emin misin?

english: You're not my father, you're just an ugly bag of bones.
translation: Sen benim babam degilsin, sadece cirkin bir kemik torbasisin.

english: I won't let you stop me. Take this!
translation: Seni durdurmana izin vermeyecegim. Al sunu!

english: Ha Ha Ha. Is that all you've got, Jack?
translation: Ha ha ha. Elinden gelenin hepsi bu mu, Jack?

english: Oh come on! How did that not hurt you?
translation: Hadi ama! Bu sana nasil acitmadi?

english: You're weak just like your father.
I'm gonna slap you back to Lumbridge!
Argh!
You're going to need a lot worse to defeat me.
translation: Beni yenmek icin cok daha kötüsünü yapman gerekecek.

english: Good thing I'm not done yet.
I learned this from an old friend of mine.
Ouch!
You cannot stop me Jack.
I'm not finished yet.
Mummy!
I'm getting out of here. This isn't worth it!
Uhh...
That didn't go as planned.
Ha Ha Ha. He won't get away that easily!
translation: Ha ha ha. O kadar kolay kacamaz!

english: I'll be back to deal with you soon [player name]....
translation: Yakinda seninle ilgilenmek icin geri dönecegim Maceraci...

english: Ahhh, hello there. How can I help?
Looks like you have a good selection of weapons around here...
translation: Burada iyi bir silah seckisi var gibi görünüyor...

english: Indeed so, specially imported from the finest smiths around the lands, take a look at my wares.
translation: Aynen öyle, ülkenin en iyi demircilerinden özel olarak ithal edildi, mallarima bir bak.

english: A fine selection of blades for you to peruse, come take a look!
translation: Incelemen icin güzel bir bicak seckisi var, gel bir bak!

english: Armours and axes to suit your needs.
Imported weapons from the finest smithys around the lands!
translation: Ülkenin en iyi demircilerinden ithal silahlar!

english: Ow my toe! That armour is heavy.
Hello there. Interested in sailing to the island of Aldarin? It's 20 coins for the journey.
translation: Merhaba. Aldarin adasina gitmek ister misiniz? Yolculuk 20 sikke.

english: Yes please.
Come back when you've got 20 coins for me.
No thanks.
Fair enough.
How about I pay you nothing at all...
Sounds good to me. Hop aboard!
Hello there. Interested in sailing to Sunset Coast? It's 20 coins for the journey.
translation: Merhaba. Sunset Coast'a gitmek ister misiniz? Yolculuk 20 sikke.

english: Yes please.
No thanks.
[Charm] How about I pay you nothing at all...
Welcome to the Moonrise Brewery and Winery, the oldest and largest producer of alcohol in all of Varlamore.
translation: Varlamore'un en eski ve en büyük alkol üreticisi Moonrise Brewery and Winery'ye hos geldiniz.

english: Could I buy some wine?
Certainly!
Could you tell me more about this place?
translation: Bu yer hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misiniz?

english: Of course! The Moonrise Winery was originally opened over 400 years ago by Bracus Ramio.
translation: Tabii ki! Moonrise Winery, 400 yil önce Bracus Ramio tarafindan acildi.

english: While we originally started off as just a winery, the brewing side of the business was established by Bracus' grandson, Ludovic, when he created the now famous sunbeam ale!
translation: Baslangicta sadece saraphanemiz vardi, ancak Bracus'un torunu Ludovic, su anda ünlü olan sunbeam ale'yi yaratarak bira üretimine de basladi!

english: So it was a family business? Do the family still own it today?
translation: Yani bu bir aile isletmesiydi? Aile bugün hala isletmenin sahibi mi?

english: Unfortunately not. Ludovic found himself in a tragic and unexpected wine-related incident before ever having children himself. After his death, the business was taken over by a collective.
translation: Maalesef hayir. Ludovic, cocuk sahibi olmadan önce trajik ve beklenmedik bir sarap kazasi gecirdi. Ölümünden sonra isletme bir kolektif tarafindan devralindi.

english: A collective?
That's right. Some of the most influential people all across Varlamore have a stake in the Moonrise Brewery and Winery these days, though most prefer to stay anonymous.
translation: Evet. Varlamore'un en etkili kisilerinden bazilari Moonrise Brewery and Winery'nin hissedarlaridir, ancak cogu anonim kalmayi tercih etmektedir.

english: Anonymous? How come?
Ah, well their reasoning is something only they know.
translation: Ah, bunun nedenini sadece kendileri bilir.

english: I see. Thanks for the information.
Not at all. Now, is there anything else I can do for you?
translation: Rica ederim. Baska bir sey yapabilir miyim?

english: I'd better be on my way.
Do come back soon!
Could I buy some wine?
Could you tell me more about this place?
translation: Bu yer hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: I'd better be on my way.
Nilsal, iknami. Thank you for saving my life in that cave.
translation: Nilsal, iknami. O magarada hayatimi kurtardigin için tesekkür ederim.

english: It's my pleasure.
After what happened, I've decided to make some changes in my life. First up is less work. Next is more drinking!
translation: Olanlardan sonra hayatimda bazi degisiklikler yapmaya karar verdim. Ilk olarak daha az çalisacagim. Sonra da daha çok içecegim!

english: More drinking?
Well, not too much more. I wouldn't want to become known for it. I just plan to relax and enjoy myself a bit more.
translation: Tabii, çok fazla degil. Bununla taninmak istemem. Sadece biraz daha rahatlayip eglenmeyi planliyorum.

english: Well, I can't blame you for that. All the best.
translation: Bunun için seni suçlayamam. Her sey gönlünce olsun.

english: And to you, iknami.
I buy silk. If you ever want to sell any silk, bring it here.
translation: Ipek aliyorum. Eger ipek satmak istersen, buraya getir.

english: Hello. I have some fine silk from far away to sell to you.
translation: Merhaba. Size satmak icin uzaklardan getirdigim kaliteli ipeklerim var.

english: Ah I may be interested in that. What sort of price were you looking at per piece of silk?
translation: Ah, ilgilenebilirim. Ipek kumasin tanesi ne kadar?

english: 20 coins.
Ok suits me.
80 coins.
80 coins? That's a bit steep! How about 40 coins?
translation: 80 sikke mi? Biraz pahali! 40 sikkeye ne dersin?

english: Ok, 40 sounds good.
50, and that's my final price.
Done.
No, that is not enough.
120 coins.
You'll never get that much for it. I'll be generous and give you 50 for it.
translation: O kadarini asla alamazsin. Cömert davranip 50 verecegim.

english: Ok, I guess 50 will do.
I'll give it to you for 60.
You drive a hard bargain, but I guess that will have to do.
translation: Sert pazarlik ediyorsun ama sanirim bu kadari yeterli.

english: 200 coins.
Don't be ridiculous! That is far too much. You insult me with that price.
translation: Sacmalama! Bu cok fazla. Bu fiyatla beni asagiliyorsun.

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
You're the one who stole something from me!
Guards guards!
20 coins.
80 coins.
Ok, 40 sounds good.
50, and that's my final price.
No, that is not enough.
120 coins.
Ok, I guess 50 will do.
I'll give it to you for 60.
200 coins.
You did it! I wasn't sure I'd make it out of that one, but I'm glad you proved me wrong. Come, let's get out of here.
translation: Basardin! Basarabileceginden emin degildim, ama yanildigimi kanitladigin icin mutluyum. Gel, buradan gidelim.

english: Hi there. How are you doing?
Oh, you know, just getting over years of being controlled by a deranged family member. All part of the fun in a family like ours, I guess.
translation: Bilirsin, yillarca deli bir aile üyesi tarafindan kontrol edilmenin üstesinden gelmeye calisiyorum. Sanirim bizim gibi bir ailede bu da eglencenin bir parcasi.

english: You seem quite jolly about it all.
Well as I always say, 'the real winner is the one smiling.' What Amascut has done is horrific, but it's not too late to stop her. I won't let her get me down, not while there's still hope.
translation: Her zaman dedigim gibi, “gercek kazanan gülümseyen kisidir.” Amascut'un yaptigi sey korkunc, ama onu durdurmak icin henüz cok gec degil. Umut varken onun beni yikmasina izin vermeyecegim.

english: Anyway, I'm annoyingly a bit too weak to help you much down here. However, I reckon if you can free the others, we'll be able to open the way to the lower level for you.
translation: Her neyse, maalesef burada sana fazla yardim edemeyecek kadar gücsüzüm. Ancak, digerlerini kurtarabilirsen, senin icin alt kata giden yolu acabilecegimizi düsünüyorum.

english: We've been able to open the way for you! I wish we could help you down there, but we're still too weak. Don't worry though, I know you can do it!
translation: Senin icin yolu acabildik! Keske sana orada yardim edebilseydik, ama hala cok gücsüzüz. Endiselenme, basarabilecegini biliyorum!

english: Here he is!
My friend, you managed what few have ever achieved. You overcame Amascut herself! I wish I could have been there to see it!
translation: Dostum, cok az kisinin basardigi bir seyi basardin. Amascut'un kendisini yendin! Keske orada olup bunu görebilseydim!

english: Well I couldn't have done it alone. Speaking of which, where's Scabaras?
translation: Tek basima basaramazdim. Bu arada, Scabaras nerede?

english: Scabaras walks his own path. Do not consider his absence an insult. This is his way.
translation: Scabaras kendi yolunda yürüyor. Onun yoklugunu bir hakaret olarak görme. Bu onun tarzi.

english: Not to mention that he was under Amascut's control far longer than the rest of us. It will take him time to come to terms with his role in her plots.
translation: Amascut'un kontrolü altinda bizimkinden cok daha uzun süre kaldigini da unutma. Onun komplolarindaki rolünü kabullenmesi zaman alacak.

english: Don't worry, he'll be okay. He always is.
translation: Merak etme, o iyi olacak. Her zaman oldugu gibi.

english: Before we go any further... We didn't have much time for conversation back in the tomb. I'm sure you have some questions for us.
translation: Devam etmeden önce... Mezarin icinde konusacak fazla vaktimiz olmadi. Eminim bize soracak sorularin vardir.

english: If you do, now is the time to ask them.
translation: Eger varsa, simdi sormanin tam zamani.

english: I have a question for Apmeken.
What's your role in the Menaphite Pantheon?
I'm Tumeken's avatar of companionship! Tumeken himself was always considered a bit cold, which is a tad ironic when you think about it.
translation: Ben Tumeken'in dostluk avatariyim! Tumeken her zaman biraz soguk biri olarak görülürdü, ki bunu düsününce biraz ironik.

english: A cold sun god?
Exactly! Bit odd, right? Still, although he wasn't exactly known for his social side, he still understood the importance of such things. That's why he made me!
translation: Aynen öyle! Biraz tuhaf, degil mi? Yine de, sosyal yönüyle pek taninmasa da, bu tür seylerin önemini anliyordu. Bu yüzden beni yaratti!

english: My job is to make sure everyone remembers the importance of friendship. After all, we all need a friend or two, or ten, or maybe hundreds! Have as many as you want! I won't judge.
translation: Benim görevim, herkesin dostlugun önemini hatirlamasini saglamak. Sonucta, hepimizin bir ya da iki, ya da on, ya da belki yüzlerce arkadasa ihtiyacimiz var! Istedigin kadar arkadas edin! Seni yargilamayacagim.

english: Why aren't there more monkeys or apes in the desert?
translation: Cölde neden daha fazla maymun ya da goril yok?

english: Ah, you can thank Amascut for that. The desert used to be home to thousands of apes and monkeys, but she targeted them to try and get to me.
translation: Ah, bunun icin Amascut'a tesekkür edebilirsin. Cöl eskiden binlerce maymun ve gorilin yuvasiydi, ama o bana ulasmak icin onlari hedef aldi.

english: I'm sorry.
Don't be! Now that I'm back, I know we can turn things around!
translation: Üzülme! Artik geri döndügüme göre, durumu tersine cevirebilecegimizi biliyorum!

english: Actually, I've changed my mind.
Fair enough.
I'll be back soon.
We'll be here when you're ready.
I have a question for Crondis.
I am Tumeken's avatar of resourcefulness.
Meaning?
Meaning my job is to guide the people of the desert not to live lives of excess.
translation: Yani benim görevim, cöl halkina asiri yasamamalari icin rehberlik etmek.

english: Guessing you're not a fan of Menaphos then?
translation: O zaman Menaphos'u pek sevmiyorsun galiba?

english: Much of the desert has forgotten the importance of modesty in my absence, but the situation in Menaphos is definitely the most concerning. Let us hope it can soon be rectified.
translation: Cogu cöl halki benim yoklugumda alcakgönüllülügün önemini unutmus, ama Menaphos'taki durum kesinlikle en endise verici. Umarim bu durum yakinda düzelir.

english: Why are crocodiles so rude?
Rude? How so.
Well they always try to eat me when I go near them.
translation: Sey, yanlarina yaklastigimda hep beni yemeye calisiyorlar.

english: The life of a crocodile is not an easy one. They must seek food wherever it is available.
translation: Timsahlarin hayati kolay degildir. Yiyecek bulabildikleri her yerde yiyecek aramak zorundadirlar.

english: Besides, I sense you do not speak the whole truth. Did you not befriend a crocodile yourself in times past?
translation: Ayrica, tüm gercegi söylemedigini hissediyorum. Gecmiste bir timsahla arkadas olmadin mi?

english: You mean Roger! I guess he was quite friendly.
translation: Roger'i mi kastediyorsun! Sanirim o oldukca dost canlisiydi.

english: Then perhaps crocodiles are not as rude as you think.
translation: O zaman belki de timsahlar sandigin kadar kaba degildir.

english: As you wish.
We will be here.
I have a question for Het.
I am Tumeken's avatar of health, both physical and mental.
translation: Ben Tumeken'in hem fiziksel hem de zihinsel saglik avatariyim.

english: You talk about strength and fighting a lot. Surely fighting isn't good for someone's health.
translation: Güc ve dövüsmekten cok bahsediyorsun. Dövüsmek kesinlikle birinin sagligi icin iyi degildir.

english: Well when it comes to health, is strength not the ultimate goal? The strongest individual is one who is healthy in both body and mind, and what better way to celebrate that strength than in combat!
translation: Saglik söz konusu oldugunda, güc nihai hedef degil midir? En güclü kisi, hem bedenen hem de zihnen saglikli olandir ve bu gücü kutlamanin savasmaktan daha iyi bir yolu olabilir mi!

english: I guess, but what about those who aren't strong?
translation: Sanirim, ama güclü olmayanlar ne olacak?

english: Well health is not something to be hoarded, is it? Most weaknesses can be overcome, and it is the duty of the strong to help those less fortunate.
translation: Saglik biriktirilecek bir sey degildir, degil mi? Cogu zayiflik asilabilir ve güclülerin görevi, daha az sansli olanlara yardim etmektir.

english: So they can become strong and healthy themselves?
translation: Böylece onlar da güclü ve saglikli olabilirler mi?

english: Exactly!
An interesting question. Why do you ask?
Considering you have a human appearance, I wondered if that might resonate more with people.
translation: Insan görünümüne sahip oldugunu düsünürsek, bunun insanlara daha cok hitap edebilecegini düsündüm.

english: Not as much as you might think. Believe it or not, in some ways, I'm actually considered a bit boring! Why follow the human when you have a baboon god?
translation: Sandigin kadar degil. Ister inan ister inanma, bazi yönlerden aslinda biraz sikici bulunuyorum! Babun tanrin varken neden insani takip edesin ki?

english: Especially when the baboon god is so fun to be around!
translation: Özellikle de babun tanrinin yaninda olmak cok eglenceli iken!

english: Of course, people just following one of us was never really the intention anyway. We're a pantheon, and we all have a part to play.
translation: Tabii ki, insanlarin sadece birimizi takip etmesi zaten hicbir zaman amaclanmamisti. Biz bir panteonuz ve hepimizin oynayacagi bir rol var.

english: Now that Amascut is running with her tail between her legs, perhaps we can remind people of that.
translation: Amascut kuyrugunu kistirip kacarken, belki de insanlara bunu hatirlatabiliriz.

english: Very well.
We'll wait for you to return.
I have a question for all of you.
What will happen with Amascut?
I'd say that's up to her. If she doesn't change her ways, her fate won't be pretty.
translation: Bence bu ona bagli. Eger davranislarini degistirmezse, kaderi pek de güzel olmayacak.

english: But it's never too late for redemption. There might still be hope for her.
translation: Ama kurtulus icin asla gec degildir. Hala onun icin umut olabilir.

english: Whatever path she takes, we will be ready.
translation: Hangi yolu secerse secsin, biz hazir olacagiz.

english: Do you really think she'd change her ways at this point?
translation: Bu noktada davranislarini degistirecegini gercekten düsünüyor musun?

english: It seems unlikely, but there is one who might be able to change that.
translation: Olasi görünmüyor, ama bunu degistirebilecek biri var.

english: Who?
Icthlarin! If anyone can help Amascut find her way again, it's him!
translation: Icthlarin! Amascut'un yolunu yeniden bulmasina yardim edebilecek biri varsa, o da odur!

english: He doesn't seem to have been doing much to help so far.
translation: Su ana kadar pek yardimci olmus gibi görünmüyor.

english: Icthlarin is limited in what he can do. His duties to the dead require constant attention.
translation: Icthlarin'in yapabilecekleri sinirli. Ölüler icin görevleri sürekli dikkat gerektiriyor.

english: Not to mention the pact!
Pact?
That is not for us to discuss.
translation: Bu bizim tartisacagimiz bir konu degil.

english: Oh yes, sorry. Maybe we should talk about something else.
translation: Evet, özür dilerim. Belki baska bir sey hakkinda konusmaliyiz.

english: Are you actually gods?
If you asked a citizen of these lands, I'm sure they'd probably say yes.
translation: Bu topraklardaki bir vatandasa sorsaydiniz, muhtemelen evet derdi.

english: Indeed, but they would not be truly correct.
translation: Dogru, ama tam olarak dogru olmazdi.

english: How so?
Tumeken made us using his own divine essence! Each of us is a piece of him!
translation: Tumeken bizi kendi ilahi özünü kullanarak yaratti! Her birimiz onun bir parcasiyiz!

english: But that does not make us gods. While great, our power is insignificant compared to a true god. That is why they are gone, and we remain.
translation: Ama bu bizi tanri yapmaz. Gücümüz büyük olsa da, gercek bir tanriya kiyasla önemsizdir. Bu yüzden onlar gitti, biz kaldik.

english: So what are you really?
You might hear some refer to us as the Avatars of Tumeken. We'd consider that a more fitting title.
translation: Bazilari bizi Tumeken'in Avatarlari olarak adlandirir. Biz de bu unvani daha uygun buluyoruz.

english: What about Icthlarin and Amascut?
Tumeken made them too. Difference is, they also have some of Elidinis' divine essence, making them a lot more powerful!
translation: Onlari da Tumeken yaratti. Farki, onlarin Elidinis'in ilahi özünden de bir parca icermeleri, bu da onlari cok daha güclü kiliyor!

english: But again, they are not true gods.
translation: Ama yine de, onlar gercek tanrilar degiller.

english: Amascut was hoping to change that today, but you showed her where to stick that plan!
translation: Amascut bugün bunu degistirmek istiyordu, ama sen ona o plani nereye sokacagini gösterdin!

english: So what happens now?
We are the Avatars of Tumeken, and the Kharidian Desert has been without guidance for too long. It is time we fixed that.
translation: Biz Tumeken'in Avatarlariyiz ve Kharidian Cölü cok uzun süredir rehberlikten yoksun. Bunu düzeltmenin zamani geldi.

english: We're going to get started right away!
But don't worry, we don't intend to miss the fight against Amascut. I hope you'll stand alongside us when that day comes.
translation: Ama merak etme, Amascut'la olan savasi kacirmak niyetinde degiliz. O gün geldiginde bizimle birlikte olacagini umuyorum.

english: For now though, this is goodbye. We will meet again, human.
translation: Simdilik hosca kal. Tekrar görüsecegiz, insan.

english: It was great to meet you. Thank you for helping us!
translation: Tanistigimiza memnun oldum. Yardim ettiginiz icin tesekkürler!

english: The avatars depart.
You're back!
If you have questions, now is the time to ask them.
translation: Sorulariniz varsa, simdi sormak icin uygun zaman.

english: I have a question for Apmeken.
What's your role in the Menaphite Pantheon?
Why aren't there more monkeys or apes in the desert?
translation: Cölde neden daha fazla maymun veya goril yok?

english: Actually, I've changed my mind.
I'll be back soon.
I have a question for Crondis.
Why are crocodiles so rude?
I have a question for Het.
Do you have more followers than the others?
translation: Digerlerinden daha fazla takipcin var mi?

english: I have a question for all of you.
What will happen with Amascut?
Are you actually gods?
So what happens now?
I am the Apothecary. I brew potions. Do you need anything specific?
translation: Ben eczaciyim. Iksir yaparim. Özel bir istegin var mi?

english: I have this voucher for completing the combat Adventure Path, it says to come talk to you about claiming my Adventure Path reward.
translation: Savas Macera Yolu'nu tamamladigim icin bu kuponum var, Macera Yolu ödülümü almak icin seninle konusmam gerektigi yaziyor.

english: Why yes, here are some energy potions.
I do have more rewards for you, but you need to be on a members world for me to give you the reward. Maybe there is something else I can help you with.
translation: Sana daha fazla ödülüm var, ama ödülü verebilmem icin üye dünyasinda olman gerekiyor. Belki baska bir konuda yardimci olabilirim.

english: Can you make potions for me?
<missing other dialogue during the quest>
Hello Apothecary, I've lost that hat you gave me.
translation: Merhaba Eczaci, bana verdigin sapkayi kaybettim.

english: No problem, I get plenty of these from Gielinor Hospital Supplies.
translation: Sorun degil, Gielinor Hastane Malzemeleri'nden bunlardan bolca alabilirim.

english: The Apothecary has given you a Nurse's Hat.
translation: Eczaci sana bir Hemsire Sapkasi verdi.

english: The Apothecary has given you a Doctor's Hat.
translation: Eczaci sana bir Doktor Sapkasi verdi.

english: You wouldn't be able to make any other cat potions, would you?
translation: Baska kedi iksiri yapamazsin, degil mi?

english: I have no plans to branch out into cat potions at the moment, but if there was sufficient demand for them I might change my mind.
translation: Su anda kedi iksirleri yapmaya niyetim yok, ama yeterince talep olursa fikrimi degistirebilirim.

english: Have you got any decent gossip to share?
translation: Paylasacak ilginc bir dedikodu var mi?

english: Well I hear young Romeo's having a little woman trouble but other than that all's quiet on the eastern front. Can I do something for you?
translation: Genc Romeo'nun kadinlarla ilgili kücük bir sorunu oldugunu duydum, ama onun disinda dogu cephesinde her sey sakin. Senin icin yapabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Sad about that affair with young Romeo and Juliet...
translation: Genc Romeo ve Juliet'in iliskisi cok üzücü...

english: I hear every time Romeo sees Juliet now he runs away screaming something about ghosts and Juliet's cousin?
translation: Romeo'nun Juliet'i her gördügünde hayaletler ve Juliet'in kuzeni hakkinda bir seyler bagirarak kactigini duydum.

english: Always did think he was a bit of a strange one...
translation: Onun biraz tuhaf oldugunu hep düsünmüsümdür...

english: Anyway! Life goes on and so does business! Can I do something for you?
translation: Neyse! Hayat devam ediyor, isler de öyle! Senin icin bir sey yapabilir miyim?

english: Do you know a potion to make hair fall out?
translation: Sac dökülmesini saglayan bir iksir biliyor musun?

english: I do indeed. I gave it to my mother. That's why I now live alone.
translation: Evet, biliyorum. Anneme verdim. Bu yüzden simdi yalniz yasiyorum.

english: But can I do something for you?
translation: Ama senin icin bir sey yapabilir miyim?

english: Have you got any good potions to give away?
Sorry, charity is not my strong point. Do you need anything else?
translation: Üzgünüm, hayirseverlik benim güclü yanim degil. Baska bir seye ihtiyacin var mi?

english: No thanks.
Apothecary, Father Lawrence sent me. I need a Cadava potion to help Romeo and Juliet.
translation: Eczaci, beni Peder Lawrence gönderdi. Romeo ve Juliet'e yardim etmek icin Cadava iksiri lazim.

english: Cadava potion. It's pretty nasty. And hard to make.
translation: Cadava iksiri. Oldukca igrenctir. Ve yapimi zordur.

english: Wing of rat, tail of frog. Ear of snake and horn of dog.
translation: Fare kanadi, kurbaga kuyrugu. Yilan kulagi ve köpek boynuzu.

english: I have all that, but I need some Cadava berries.
translation: Hepsi var ama Cadava meyvesi lazim.

english: You will have to find them while I get the rest ready. Bring them here when you have them. But be careful. They are nasty.
translation: Ben digerlerini hazirlarken sen onlari bulmalisin. Buldugunda buraya getir. Ama dikkatli ol. Cok igrenctirler.

english: Conveniently, I have some here.
You hand over the berries, which the Apothecary shakes up in a vial of strange liquid.
translation: Meyveleri eczaciya verirsin, o da onlari garip bir sivinin bulundugu sisede calkalar.

english: Phew! Here is what you need.
The Apothecary gives you a Cadava potion.
What do these berries look like?
They're a nice bright pink colour, with green leaves, stalks are a pale brown colour...you can't miss them. They look pretty tasty, but I wouldn't advise eating them.
translation: Güzel parlak pembe renklidirler, yesil yapraklari vardir, saplari soluk kahverengidir... gözden kacirman imkansiz. Oldukca lezzetli görünüyorlar, ama onlari yemeni tavsiye etmem.

english: Where can I get these berries?

I think I saw some recently in the local vicinity. Oh yes, that's right! There was a little bit of commotion when some kids visited the south eastern Varrock mining pit. The trip was disrupted because some kids
translation: Sanirim yakinlarda görmüstüm. Evet, dogru! Bazi cocuklar Varrock'un güneydogusundaki maden ocagini ziyaret ettiklerinde kücük bir kargasa cikmisti. Bazi cocuklar

english: had found some cadavaberry bushes and they started picking them. They wrapped that trip up pretty quickly!
translation: cadavaberry calilari bulup onlari toplamaya basladiklari icin gezi yarida kesilmisti. Geziyi oldukca cabuk bitirdiler!

english: How are these berries dangerous?
Hmm, they're generally okay, but if handled improperly they can be a bit nasty. And I certainly wouldn't advise drinking the potion!
translation: Hmm, genellikle zararsizdirlar, ama yanlis kullanilirlarsa biraz tehlikeli olabilirler. Ve kesinlikle iksiri icmeni tavsiye etmem!

english: Ok, thanks.
Keep searching for those Cadavaberries. They're needed for the potion.
translation: Cadavaberry'leri aramaya devam et. Iksir icin gerekli.

english: Well done. You have the berries.
Thank you for the Cadava potion.
You're welcome. I hope it helps that young couple find happiness.
translation: Rica ederim. Umarim bu genc ciftin mutlulugu bulmasina yardimci olur.

english: I gave Juliet the Cadava potion.
Good, good. I hope it helps that young couple find happiness.
translation: Güzel, güzel. Umarim bu genc ciftin mutlulugu bulmasina yardimci olur.

english: Urk!
Screen shakes back and forth then blacks out
translation: Ekran ileri geri sallaniyor ve sonra karariyor.

english: Blimey... you've been out for hours! Are you ok? People were tripping over you as they walked into the shop.
translation: Vay canina... saatlerdir bayginsin! Iyi misin? Insanlar dükkana girerken üstüne basip geciyorlardi.

english: Do you want to trade the diary yet? I'd like to pass the information on to the scientific community in Varrock.
translation: Günlügü takas etmek ister misin? Bu bilgiyi Varrock'taki bilim camiasina iletmek istiyorum.

english: Yes, I'll trade it for herblore training.
translation: Evet, bitki bilimi egitimi karsiliginda takas ederim.

english: Great...
The apothecary trains you in herblore.
translation: Eczaci sana bitki bilimi egitimi veriyor.

english: Ok, that's all I can teach you. Many thanks for the diary.
translation: Tamam, sana ögretebilecegim her sey bu kadar. Günlük icin cok tesekkürler.

english: No thanks, I want to keep hold ifit a bit longer.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, biraz daha saklamak istiyorum.

english: Oh, that's a shame... Come back if you change your mind.
translation: Oh, ne yazik... Fikrini degistirirsen geri gel.

english: Hmm, this is an interesting tome... But you've already sold me one, thanks!
translation: Hmm, bu ilginc bir kitap... Ama bana zaten bir tane sattin, tesekkürler!

english: Well done.
You've [found a new clue/obtained a casket]!
Can you make potions for me?
Talk about A Tail of Two Cats.
Nurse's Hat
Doctor's Hat
Talk about something else.
Talk about the Ratcatchers Quest.
Talk about Romeo & Juliet.
Have you got any decent gossip to share?
translation: Paylasacak iyi bir dedikodu var mi?

english: Do you know a potion to make hair fall out?
translation: Sac dökülmesine neden olan bir iksir biliyor musun?

english: Have you got any good potions to give away?
No thanks.
What do these berries look like?
Where can I get these berries?
How are these berries dangerous?
Ok, thanks.
Yes, I'll drink it all down.
No, I'm having second thoughts now.
Yes, I'll trade it for herblore training.
translation: Evet, bitki bilimi egitimi karsiliginda takas ederim.

english: No thanks, I want to keep hold if it a bit longer.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, biraz daha saklamak istiyorum.

english: Hello. What are you doing?
Cleaning, cleaning, always cleaning. This apprenticeship isn't all that it was cracked up to be.
translation: Temizlik, temizlik, hep temizlik. Bu ciraklik sandigim kadar iyi degilmis.

english: Whose apprentice are you?
Oh, Aadeela, the sorceress upstairs, said she'd teach me magic, she did. And here I am scrubbing floors without a spell to help me.
translation: Yukaridaki büyücü Aadeela bana büyü ögretecegini söylemisti, ögretti de. Ama simdi burada, bana yardim edecek bir büyü olmadan yerleri ovuyorum.

english: I could cast a Water Blast or a Wind Blast spell to hurry things along if you'd like?
translation: Istersen isleri hizlandirmak icin Su Patlamasi veya Rüzgar Patlamasi büyüsü yapabilirim?

english: No, no, she'd kill me or worse if she knew I was using Magic to do chores. Her last apprentice - well I'd rather not say.
translation: Hayir, hayir, sihir kullanarak ev isleri yaptigimi ögrenirse beni öldürür ya da daha kötüsünü yapar. Son ciragina ne oldugunu söylemek istemiyorum.

english: Oh go on, what happened to them?
They say she turned them into little spiders.
Oh, that's too bad. I had better leave you to it.
translation: Oh, cok kötü. Seni rahat birakayim.

english: Surely there must be upsides to the task?
translation: Bu isin iyi yanlari da olmali?

english: Nope. Clean this, clean that. When I'm finished cleaning here I have to go help out in the garden.
translation: Hayir. Sunu temizle, bunu temizle. Burayi temizledikten sonra bahceye yardim etmeye gitmem gerekiyor.

english: What garden?
Oh, I shouldn't have told you.
You're right, you shouldn't have.
Well, if you don't mind then, I'm busy and have to get back to work.
translation: Peki, sakincasi yoksa, isim var ve isime dönmem gerekiyor.

english: Don't let me keep you.
Oh, you can talk to me. I can see you're having a bad day.
translation: Oh, benimle konusabilirsin. Kötü bir gün gecirdigini görebiliyorum.

english: You know you're right. Nobody listens to me.
I can't blame them, all you do is whine.
The apprentice is clearly hurt and ignores you.
translation: Cirak acikca incinmis ve seni görmezden geliyor.

english: A sympathetic ear can do wonders.
Yes, if I just let my frustrations out, I'd feel a lot better. Now what was I saying?
translation: Evet, sadece hayal kirikliklarimi dökersem, kendimi cok daha iyi hissederim. Ne diyordum ben?

english: I don't know. You were whining about something or other. To tell you the truth, I wasn't really listening.
translation: Bilmiyorum. Bir seylerden sikayet ediyordun. Dogrusunu söylemek gerekirse, pek dinlemiyordum.

english: To tell you the truth, I wasn't really listening.
You mentioned something about the garden.
Oh yeah, that dreadful garden of hers.
Where is it?
Oh, it's nowhere.
What do you mean?
Well it's here, but not really. You see the sorceress is trying out some new type of compression magic.
translation: Sey, burada ama aslinda degil. Büyücü yeni bir tür sikistirma büyüsü deniyor.

english: Oh, that sounds interesting - so how does it work?
translation: Oh, kulaga ilginc geliyor - peki nasil calisiyor?

english: It would take too long to explain and, to be honest, I don't really understand how it works.
translation: Aciklamasi cok uzun sürer ve dürüst olmak gerekirse, ben de nasil calistigini tam olarak anlamiyorum.

english: Fair enough, but tell me, how do you get to the garden?
translation: Anliyorum, ama söyle bana, bahceye nasil gidilir?

english: By magic! The sorceress did teach me one spell.
translation: Büyüyle! Büyücü bana bir büyü ögretti.

english: Wow, cast the spell on me. It will be good Magic training for you.
translation: Vay canina, bana da büyü yap. Senin icin iyi bir büyü egitimi olur.

english: I can't do that now, I'm far too busy sweeping.
translation: Su anda yapamam, süpürmekle cok mesgulüm.

english: Oh you wouldn't mind?
Of course not. I'd be glad to help.
translation: Tabii ki olmaz. Seve seve yardim ederim.

english: Okay, here goes! Remember, to return, just drink from the fountain.
translation: Tamam, basliyorum! Unutma, geri dönmek icin cesmeden su icmen yeterli.

english: Oh, that's nice. Well it's been great talking to you.
translation: Oh, cok güzel. Seninle konusmak cok güzeldi.

english: Hey apprentice, do you want to try out your teleport skills again?
translation: Hey cirak, teleport yetenegini tekrar denemek ister misin?

english: Okay, here goes - and remember, to return just drink from the fountain.
translation: Tamam, basliyorum - ve unutma, geri dönmek icin cesmeden su icmen yeterli.

english: Seventior Disthinte Molesko!
Oh, I'm sorry, could you pick up your follower first? I'm really not sure that I could teleport the both of you.
translation: Oh, üzgünüm, önce takipcini alabilir misin? Ikinizi birden teleport edebilecegimden emin degilim.

english: I could cast a Water Blast or a Wind Blast spell?
translation: Su Patlamasi veya Rüzgar Patlamasi büyüsü yapabilirim?

english: Surely there must be upsides to the task?
translation: Bu görevin mutlaka iyi yanlari da olmali?

english: You're right, you shouldn't have.
Oh, you can talk to me. I can see you're having a bad day.
translation: Oh, benimle konusabilirsin. Kötü bir gün gecirdigini görebiliyorum.

english: I can't blame them, all you do is whine.
A sympathetic ear can do wonders.
I don't know. You were whining about something or other.
To tell you the truth, I wasn't really listening.
You mentioned something about the garden.
Wow, cast the spell on me. It will be good Magic training for you.
translation: Vay canina, büyüyü bana yap. Senin icin iyi bir büyü egitimi olur.

english: Oh, that's nice. Well it's been great talking to you.
translation: Oh, bu cok güzel. Seninle konusmak cok güzeldi.

english: Hello!
Hello friend. I wish to slay evil and avail them of their loot! Take me to Burgh de Rott!
translation: Merhaba dostum. Kötülügü yok etmek ve ganimetlerini ele gecirmek istiyorum! Beni Burgh de Rott'a götür!

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: Oradaki kötülükle savasmaya yeterince hazir misin?

english: I think so? At least my heart knows courage and that should be sufficient for the meantime. I expect that when we get to Burgh de Rott, we'll be able to purchase suitable provisions.
translation: Sanirim öyle. En azindan kalbim cesaretli ve bu simdilik yeterli olmali. Burgh de Rott'a vardigimizda uygun erzak satin alabilecegimizi umuyorum.

english: But you do realise that the vampyres in Morytania are immune to everything except silver?
translation: Ama Morytania'daki vampirlerin gümüs disinda her seye karsi bagisik olduklarini biliyor musun?

english: Er...well, I've not heard mention of that fact, but I have faith that Saradomin will provide the means to furnish me with suitable weapons when I reach Burgh de Rott.
translation: Sey... Bu konuda bir sey duymadim, ama Burgh de Rott'a vardigimda Saradomin'in bana uygun silahlar saglayacagina inaniyorum.

english: And if we happen to run into some vampyres on the journey down there?
translation: Ya oraya giderken yolda vampirlerle karsilasirsak?

english: I trust that you will help us to avoid them. You are a guide after all, aren't you? Anyway, you look like you can handle yourself. I presume you've fought such creatures before and won? How hard can it be?
translation: Onlardan kacinmamiza yardim edecegine inaniyorum. Sonucta sen bir rehbersin, degil mi? Her neyse, kendini savunabilecek gibi görünüyorsun. Daha önce bu tür yaratiklarla savasip kazandin mi? Ne kadar zor olabilir ki?

english: It can be pretty difficult, actually. But you're right, I'll be your guide so I should be able to handle the situation.
translation: Aslinda oldukca zor olabilir. Ama haklisin, ben senin rehberin olacagim, bu yüzden durumu halledebilmeliyim.

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Neden Burgh de Rott'a gitmek istiyorsun?

english: I'm going down there to teach those vampyres a lesson or two. I've heard about the terrible conditions down there and I intend to put a stop to it.
translation: Oradaki vampirleri bir ders vermek icin gidiyorum. Oradaki korkunc kosullari duydum ve buna bir son vermek niyetindeyim.

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Burgh de Rott'a giderken yol üzerinde düsmanlarla karsilasirsak kendini savunabilir misin?

english: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of enemies. You don't need to worry about that.
translation: Diyelim ki biraz tecrübeliyim ve düsmanlarla savasmaktan cekinmem. Bu konuda endiselenmene gerek yok.

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: Hmmm, görünüse göre bir takipcin var. Kendi basina dolasirsa bu yolculukta kaybolabilir. Takipcin güvende oldugunda yola cikalim.

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: Gercekten mi? Bu harika olur! Hedefe vardigimizda sana kücük bir ödül verecegim.

english: Burgh de Rott Ramble begins
Ok, which route should we take?
Ok, thanks.
Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: Ah, bana biraz erzak vermek istiyorsun, ha? Sirt cantami acayim.

english: This place is a bit grim. How can people live here?
translation: Burasi biraz kasvetli. Insanlar burada nasil yasayabiliyor?

english: Do you visit Burgh de Rott often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: Burgh de Rott'a sik sik gelir misin? Rotayi iyi biliyorsun gibi görünüyor.

english: When are we going to get to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Burgh de Rott'a ne zaman varacagiz?

english: We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on. I have loot to get.
translation: Bütün gün burada durup sohbet edemeyiz, hadi devam edelim. Yagmalayacak seyler var.

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than the opulet life styles forced on us adventurer types. I'd much rather be up to my eyes in mud and having a good fight!
translation: Oh, bu yolculuktan nefret ediyorum, ama maceraci tiplere dayatilan lüks yasam tarzindan daha iyidir. Gözlerime kadar camura batip iyi bir kavga etmeyi tercih ederim!

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...
Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Paterdomus. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: Vay canina! Görünüse göre Paterdomus'a geri dönmek zorunda kalacagiz. O köprüden gecemeyiz!

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
Player completes the bridge event
Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Paterdomus.
translation: Bu onu parcaladi. Görünüse göre bu batakligi gecemeyecegiz. Paterdomus'a geri dönmek zorundayiz.

english: Player completes the bog event
Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: Hey...bu harika...harika bir is cikardin...seni takip edecegim.

english: Whahay...that was great!
But we really should be heading off now.
Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
Player completes the river event
That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: Bu harika! Ben de aynisini yapacagim.

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: Whahay! Bu harikaydi! Ama artik gercekten gitmeliyiz.

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
This is scary!
Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
Ahhh, two tentacles!
...three tentacles!
I think I'm going to faint!
Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: Vay canina! Su canavara bak! Bu seyi kendi basina halletmen gerekecek!

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the Burgh de Rott. Here's your reward.
translation: Beni Burgh de Rott'a sag salim ulastirdiginiz icin cok tesekkürler. Iste ödülün.

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: Oradaki kötülükle savasacak kadar hazir misin?

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Neden Burgh de Rott'a gitmek istiyorsun?

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
Ok, thanks.
I was wondering if you could repair my pouches.
translation: Keselerimi tamir edebilir misin diye merak ediyordum.

english: I need 25 abyssal pearls to unlock the contact with the mage who knows how to repair a pouch. After the contact has been unlocked, it will cost you 1 abyssal pearl each time to repair the pouches.
translation: Bir kesenin nasil tamir edilecegini bilen büyücüyle baglantiyi acmak icin 25 abisal inciye ihtiyacim var. Temasin kilidi acildiktan sonra, keseleri onarmak her seferinde size 1 abisal inciye mal olacak.

english: I don't have enough abyssal pearls for that, I'm afraid.
translation: Korkarim bunun icin yeterli abisal incim yok.

english: Yes, please.
Now bear with me whilst I contact the mage.
translation: Simdi ben büyücüyle temas kurarken bana katlan.

english: Apprentice Cordelia casts the NPC Contact spell.
translation: Cirak Cordelia NPC Temas büyüsünü yapiyor.

english: Hello, can you hear me?
Quiet! Why do you all try to break my concentration?
translation: Sessiz olun! Neden hepiniz konsantrasyonumu bozmaya calisiyorsunuz?

english: OK. The contact has been set up.
It will cost you 1 abyssal pearl to repair the pouches.
translation: Keseleri onarmak size 1 Abyssal incisine mal olacak.

english: Yes, that sounds fair.
You don't seem to have any pouches in need of repair.
translation: Tamire ihtiyaci olan bir keseniz yok gibi görünüyor.

english: Bear with me whilst I make the contact for repairing the pouches.
translation: Keseleri onarmak icin baglanti kurarken bana sabir gösterin.

english: Hi, it's me again.
Hello, I know you can hear me.
Ding Dong, Ding Dong. You can't keep me waiting.
translation: Ding Dong, Ding Dong. Beni bekletemezsin.

english: Fine. What do you want?
I got someone here in need of a pouch repair.
translation: Burada kese tamirine ihtiyaci olan biri var.

english: OK...It's done.
Your pouches have been repaired.
We need to assemble rift guardian before those creatures arrive!
translation: O yaratiklar gelmeden önce yarik koruyucusunu kurmaliyiz!

english: We need shield barriers up before anything comes through that rift!
translation: O yariktan bir sey gelmeden önce kalkan bariyerleri kurmaliyiz!

english: We need to protect the Great Guardian!
We need to power up the Great Guardian!
We need more rift guardians!
translation: Daha fazla yarik koruyucusuna ihtiyacimiz var!

english: Yes
Yes, that sounds fair.
No thanks.
Cancel
Hey, [player name]. Got any abyssal pearls you want to trade?
translation: Hey, Maceraci. Takas etmek istedigin Abyssal incileri var mi?

english: Let's see what you have.
I have my general store, but I also have a small collection of lanterns available, if that interests you?
translation: Genel magazam var, ama ilgini cekerse kücük bir fener koleksiyonum da var.

english: Lanterns, you say?
Yes, powerful artefacts of The Abyss. We have accumulated a small collection of them from all of the fighting.
translation: Evet, Abyss'in güclü eserleri. Tüm savaslardan kücük bir koleksiyon biriktirdik.

english: Do the wizards not use them in the fight against the abyss?
translation: Büyücüler onlari Ucurum'a karsi savasta kullanmiyor mu?

english: Absolutely not. We know how powerful they are, yet their magic is too unknown to us to risk using.
translation: Kesinlikle hayir. Ne kadar güclü olduklarini biliyoruz ama büyülerini kullanma riskine giremeyiz.

english: Could I have one to aid in the fight?
translation: Savasa yardim etmek icin bir tane alabilir miyim?

english: I'm afraid I can't just give you one. We're under strict instructions to only provide lanterns to people who prove themselves as committed to the cause.
translation: Korkarim size öylece bir tane veremem. Sadece kendini bu davaya adadigini kanitlayan kisilere fener verme konusunda kesin talimatlarimiz var.

english: How committed does one have to be?
If you've fought the abyss enough to amass 1,500 abyssal pearls, that would be enough.
translation: Eger ucurumla 1500 ucurum incisi toplayacak kadar savastiysaniz, bu yeterli olacaktir.

english: Ah, I don't have enough on me right now.
translation: Ah, su anda üzerimde yeterince yok.

english: That's alright. Feel free to come back when you have more pearls on you.
translation: Sorun degil. Üzerinizde daha fazla inci oldugunda geri gelmekten cekinmeyin.

english: As long as you are aware of how powerful they are, and that I can trust you won't lost it.
translation: Yeter ki ne kadar güclü olduklarinin farkinda ol ve onu kaybetmeyecegine güvenebileyim.

english: What's that rift guardian doing over there?
translation: O yarik muhafizinin orada ne isi var?

english: They're great, aren't they? I don't know their name, if they even have one, so I just call them Rifty.
translation: Harikalar, degil mi? Isimlerini bilmiyorum, eger bir isimleri varsa bile, bu yüzden onlara sadece Rifty diyorum.

english: That rift they have is a folded-space storage rift, just like the ones Traiborn uses! Small on the outside, but big on the inside!
translation: Sahip olduklari yarik katlanmis bir uzay depolama yarigi, tipki Traiborn'un kullandiklari gibi! Disi kücük ama ici büyük!

english: But what's the rift for?
The guardians use it to store things. If you help hold back the Abyss, they'll let you take things from the rift in return.
translation: Muhafizlar onu bir seyler depolamak icin kullaniyor. Abyss'i durdurmaya yardim edersen, karsiliginda yariktan bir seyler almana izin verecekler.

english: Anyway, did you want to trade?
translation: Her neyse, ticaret mi yapmak istiyorsun?

english: Why are you selling things here?
Sedridor told us to make sure there was plenty of incentive for people to help us. He also wants us to gather abyssal pearls for research purposes. I thought this would be a good way of doing both!
translation: Sedridor insanlarin bize yardim etmesi icin bolca tesvik olmasini söyledi. Ayrica arastirma icin Abyssal incileri toplamamizi istiyor. Bunun her ikisini de yapmanin iyi bir yolu olacagini düsündüm!

english: So you sell things in exchange for abyssal pearls?
translation: Yani Abyssal incileri karsiliginda bir seyler mi satiyorsunuz?

english: Exactly! I've got some interesting things from the Wizards' Tower, along with some cool stuff the Guardians of the Rift gave us. Want to take a look?
translation: Aynen öyle! Büyücüler Kulesi'nden bazi ilginc seylerin yani sira Yarik Muhafizlari'nin bize verdigi bazi harika seyler de var. Bakmak ister misin?

english: Could you tell me more about this place.
translation: Bu yer hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misiniz?

english: Well, I only really know what the Great Guardian told us. This is the Temple of the Eye, or at least, what's left of it. It was built long ago to house the Eye, a powerful Saradominist artefact.
translation: Sey, ben sadece Büyük Muhafiz'in bize anlattiklarini biliyorum. Burasi Göz Tapinagi, ya da en azindan ondan geriye kalanlar. Uzun zaman önce, Saradoministlerin güclü bir eseri olan Göz'ü barindirmak icin insa edilmis.

english: Apparently, servants of some 'Fallen Empire' desired this artefact. However, in their attempt to steal it, they accidently opened a rift into a deadly area of the Abyss called the Scar.
translation: Görünüse göre, “Düsmüs Imparatorluk”un hizmetkarlari bu eseri istiyordu. Ancak, onu calmak icin yaptiklari girisimde, kazara Abyss'in Scar adli ölümcül bir bölgesine acilan bir yarik actilar.

english: Were it not for the Justiciar of the Lion, the rift would have endangered all of Gielinor. She used the Eye to close it and then created the Guardians of the Rift to protect this temple.
translation: Aslan'in Yargici olmasaydi, bu yarik tüm Gielinor'u tehlikeye atacakti. O, Göz'ü kullanarak yarigi kapatti ve bu tapinagi korumak icin Yarigin Muhafizlarini yaratti.

english: Of course, the rift is open again now, but with our help, the Guardians of the Rift are keeping it under control.
translation: Tabii ki, gecit su anda tekrar acik, ancak bizim yardimimizla, Gecit Muhafizlari onu kontrol altinda tutuyor.

english: I found this dye in the rewards rift...
And you want me to change it to a different one?
translation: Ve sen bunu baska bir boyayla degistirmemi mi istiyorsun?

english: Well, yes, but how did you know?
You'd be surprised at how often this happens. Lots of adventurers have been pulling bottles of dye out of that rift, only to wish they'd got a different one. I've ended up with plenty of spares.
translation: Bunun ne kadar sik oldugunu bilsen sasirirsin. Bircok maceraci bu yariktan boya siseleri cikariyor, ama sonra farkli bir tane istemis olmayi diliyorlar. Elimde bir sürü yedek var.

english: So on that note, would you like me to swap your dye for you?
translation: Bu arada, boyani degistirmemi ister misin?

english: I'd like to swap my abyssal red dye for some abyssal green dye.
translation: Abyssal kirmizi boyami abyssal yesil boyayla degistirmek istiyorum.

english: Thanks, Felix.
Any time, [player name].
I'd like to swap my abyssal red dye for some abyssal blue dye.
translation: Abyssal kirmizi boyami abyssal mavi boyayla degistirmek istiyorum.

english: I'd like to swap my abyssal green dye for some abyssal red dye.
translation: Abyssal yesil boyami abyssal kirmizi boyayla degistirmek istiyorum.

english: I'd like to swap my abyssal green dye for some abyssal blue dye.
translation: Abyssal yesil boyami abyssal mavi boyayla degistirmek istiyorum.

english: I'd like to swap my abyssal blue dye for some abyssal red dye.
translation: Abyssal mavi boyami abyssal kirmizi boyayla degistirmek istiyorum.

english: I'd like to swap my abyssal blue dye for some abyssal green dye.
translation: Abyssal mavi boyami abyssal yesil boya ile degistirmek istiyorum.

english: Actually, I've changed my mind.
Not a problem. Feel free to come back if you change your mind.
translation: Sorun degil. Fikrini degistirirsen tekrar gelebilirsin.

english: No, I'd like to sell it to you.
Oh? Usually I trade them for other dyes, I suppose I could buy one from you instead for my own research.
translation: Öyle mi? Genelde bunlari baska boyalarla takas ederim, ama kendi arastirmam icin senden bir tane satin alabilirim.

english: Which dye did you want to sell?
I lost an item from the rewards rift.
What was the item?
A locket.
It's funny you should mention that. I actually found an old locket while rummaging through the rift myself.
translation: Bunu söylemen cok ilginc. Aslinda ben de yariklari karistirirken eski bir madalyon buldum.

english: I'd happily give it to you, but you don't have space for it. Come back when you do.
translation: Sana seve seve verirdim ama senin icin yer yok. Yer acildiginda tekrar gel.

english: Thanks, Felix!
A bag.
It's funny you should mention that. I actually found a bag with strange markings on it while rummaging through the rift myself.
translation: Bunu söylemen komik. Aslinda ben de yarikta dolasirken üzerinde garip isaretler olan bir canta buldum.

english: Actually, it doesn't matter.
Fair enough.
I'd like to sell you something from the rewards rift.
translation: Ödül yariklarindan bir sey satmak istiyorum.

english: Oh? Usually I sell items to you adventurers. What did you have in mind?
translation: Öyle mi? Genelde ben siz maceracilara esya satarim. Aklinda ne var?

english: An abyssal green dye? I can offer you 50 abyssal pearls for that.
translation: Abyssal yesil boya mi? Bunun icin sana 50 abyssal incisi verebilirim.

english: Come back if you have any more items from the rift to sell.
translation: Yarikta buldugunuz baska esyalar varsa tekrar gelin.

english: On second thoughts, I'll keep it for myself.
translation: Bir daha düsündüm de, kendim icin saklayacagim.

english: Very well, come back if you change your mind.
An abyssal blue dye? I can offer you 50 abyssal pearls for that.
translation: Abyssal mavi boya mi? Bunun icin size 50 abyssal incisi verebilirim.

english: An abyssal red dye? I can offer you 50 abyssal pearls for that.
translation: Abyssal kirmizi boya mi? Bunun icin size 50 abyssal incisi verebilirim.

english: An abyssal lantern? I can offer you 100 abyssal pearls for that.
translation: Bir abyssal fener mi? Bunun icin sana 100 abyssal inci verebilirim.

english: I'm good, thanks.
Alright. See you later.
Let's see what you have.
Can I see your general items?
Lanterns, you say?
I understand how powerful these are, I'd like to buy one.
translation: Bunlarin ne kadar güclü oldugunu biliyorum, bir tane almak istiyorum.

english: I'm not sure I'm ready to buy one yet.
translation: Henüz almaya hazir oldugumdan emin degilim.

english: What's that rift guardian doing over there?
Why are you selling things here?
Could you tell me more about this place.
translation: Bu yer hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: I found this dye in the rewards rift...
Yes, but how did you know?
I'd like to swap my abyssal red dye for some abyssal green dye.
translation: Abyssal kirmizi boyami abyssal yesil boyayla degistirmek istiyorum.

english: I'd like to swap my abyssal red dye for some abyssal blue dye.
translation: Abyssal kirmizi boyami abyssal mavi boyayla degistirmek istiyorum.

english: I'd like to swap my abyssal green dye for some abyssal red dye.
translation: Abyssal yesil boyami abyssal kirmizi boyayla degistirmek istiyorum.

english: I'd like to swap my abyssal green dye for some abyssal blue dye.
translation: Abyssal yesil boyami abyssal mavi boyayla degistirmek istiyorum.
