translation: Abyssal mavi boyami abyssal kirmizi boyayla degistirmek istiyorum.

english: I'd like to swap my abyssal blue dye for some abyssal green dye.
translation: Abyssal mavi boyami abyssal yesil boyayla degistirmek istiyorum.

english: Actually, I've changed my mind.
No, I'd like to sell it to you.
I lost an item from the rewards rift.
A locket.
A bag.
Actually, it doesn't matter.
I'd like to sell you something from the rewards rift.
translation: Sana ödül yariklarindan bir sey satmak istiyorum.

english: Abyssal green dye
Yes.
No.
Abyssal blue dye
Abyssal red dye
Abyssal lantern
Never mind.
I'm good, thanks.
I was wondering if you could do something for me while I work to close the rift.
translation: Ben yarigi kapatmaya calisirken benim icin bir sey yapabilir misin diye merak ediyordum.

english: What is it? The rift will open soon and we should all be preparing to close it.
translation: Neymis o? Yarigi yakinda acilacak ve hepimiz onu kapatmaya hazirlanmaliyiz.

english: I was wondering if you could close the barrier so that other adventurers don't interfere with us closing the rift.
translation: Diger maceracilar yarigi kapatmamiza engel olmasinlar diye bariyeri kapatabilir misin diye merak ediyordum.

english: Why would you want to do that? Wouldn't more help be appreciated?
translation: Neden bunu yapmak istiyorsun? Daha fazla yardim almak daha iyi olmaz mi?

english: I believe that we already have what it takes to close the rift and I wouldn't want any other adventurers getting in the way.
translation: Yarik kapatmak icin gereken her seye zaten sahip oldugumuza inaniyorum ve diger maceracilarin bize engel olmasini istemem.

english: I'll close the barrier once the rift opens. If you change your mind before the rift opens I can revert this.
translation: Yarik acildiginda bariyeri kapatacagim. Yarik acilmadan önce fikrini degistirirsen bunu geri alabilirim.

english: I've changed my mind, we should allow other adventurers to join us in closing the rift.
translation: Fikrimi degistirdim, diger maceracilarin da yarik kapatma isine katilmalarina izin vermeliyiz.

english: I'll no longer close the barrier once the rift opens.
I'm not sure that would be a good idea right now.
translation: Su anda bunun iyi bir fikir oldugunu sanmiyorum.

english: You cannot lock this minigame on a Guardians of the Rift themed world.
translation: Bu mini oyunu, Rift'in Muhafizlari temali bir dünyada kilitleyemezsin.

english: The essence piles here contain lots of rift guardian parts.
translation: Buradaki öz yiginlari, bircok rift muhafizi parcasi iceriyor.

english: Remember to combine guardian fragments with pure essence!
translation: Muhafiz parcalarini saf özle birlestirmeyi unutma!

english: The cells here can be used to power up barriers and rift guardians!
translation: Buradaki hücreler, bariyerleri ve rift muhafizlarini güclendirmek icin kullanilabilir!

english: Take uncharged cells with you to charge them at altars!
translation: Sarj edilmemis hücreleri yanina al ve sunaklarda sarj et!

english: Don't forget that different cells produce different rift guardians!
translation: Farkli hücrelerin farkli rift muhafizlari ürettigini unutma!

english: Imbued essence can only be made at altars. Keep an eye out for the right altars to open!
translation: Icine öz katilmis özler sadece sunaklarda yapilabilir. Dogru sunaklarin acilmasini bekleyin!

english: I've opened a portal to the huge guardian fragment mine to the south east!
translation: Güneydogudaki devasa gardiyan parcasi madenine bir portal actim!

english: I've opened a portal to the huge guardian fragment mine to the south!
translation: Güneydeki devasa gardiyan parcasi madenine bir portal actim!

english: I've opened a portal to the huge guardian fragment mine to the east!
translation: Dogudaki devasa gardiyan parcasi madenine bir portal actim!

english: I've opened a portal to the huge guardian fragment mine to the south west!
translation: Güneybatidaki devasa gardiyan parcasi madenine bir portal actim!

english: Hiya.
Sorry, I haven't got time to chat. We've only just finished a collossalorder of furniture for the Varrock area, and already there's more work coming in.
translation: Üzgünüm, sohbet edecek vaktim yok. Varrock bölgesi icin devasa bir mobilya siparisini yeni bitirdik ve simdiden yeni isler geliyor.

english: Varrock?
Yeah, the Council's had it redecorated.
- Oi - stop gabbing and get that chair finished!
translation: - Hey - gevezelik etmeyi birak da su sandalyeyi bitir!

english: You'd better let me get on with my work.
translation: Isime devam etmeme izin versen iyi olur.

english: Ok, bye.
Lonely.
Thank you for bringing me a friend.
translation: Bana bir arkadas getirdigin icin tesekkürler.

english: You can go through now.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu var. Merhaba, selam, selam...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her türlü sey! Kuleler görülmeye deger harika bir manzara.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmenizi tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Hello. Would you like to visit the Library Historical Archive? We've recently opened the archive to visitors.
translation: Merhaba. Tarihsel Arsiv Kütüphanesini ziyaret etmek ister misiniz? Arsivi yakin zamanda ziyaretcilere actik.

english: Yes please!
No thanks.
Who are you?
I am Archeio, guardian of the Library Historical Archive. I grant both visitors and staff access to the archive.
translation: Ben Archeio, Kütüphane Tarih Arsivi'nin bekcisiyim. Ziyaretcilere ve personele arsive erisim izni veriyorum.

english: Would you like me to teleport you there now?
translation: Seni simdi oraya isinlamami ister misin?

english: Tell me more about this archive.
translation: Bu arsiv hakkinda daha fazla bilgi ver.

english: The Library Historical Archive stores our most ancient and precious texts. You can find out much more about Great Kourend and our key historical events there.
translation: Kütüphane Tarih Arsivi, en eski ve degerli metinlerimizi saklar. Orada Büyük Kourend ve önemli tarihi olaylarimiz hakkinda cok daha fazla bilgi edinebilirsin.

english: Yes please!
No thanks
Who are you?
Tell me more about this archive.
translation: Bu arsiv hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin.

english: Why are you guys hanging around here?
(ahem)...'Guys'?
Uh... yeah, sorry about that. Why are you all standing around out here?
translation: Uh... evet, özür dilerim. Neden hepiniz burada duruyorsunuz?

english: Well, that's really none of your business.
So I hear theres a leprechaun around here who can show me the way to Zanaris?
translation: Buralarda Zanaris'e giden yolu gösterebilecek bir leprechaun oldugunu duydum?

english: ...W-what? How did you..?
No. You're wrong. Now go away.
So you didn't find the entrance to Zanaris yet, huh?
translation: Demek Zanaris'in girisini henüz bulamadin, ha?

english: Don't tell me a novice like YOU has found it!
translation: Sakin bana senin gibi bir aceminin buldugunu söyleme!

english: Yep. Found it REALLY easily too.
translation: Evet. Hem de cok kolay buldum.

english: ...I cannot believe that someone like YOU could find the portal where experienced adventurers such as ourselves could not.
translation: ...Senin gibi birinin, bizim gibi deneyimli maceracilarin bile bulamadigi portali bulduguna inanamiyorum.

english: Believe what you want. Enjoy your little camp fire.
translation: Istedigine inan. Kücük kamp atesinin tadini cikar.

english: You pet the dog...
He yapps aggressively.
Yap Yap!
Hello there.
Hello again, [player name]. What can I do for you?
translation: Merhaba, Maceraci. Senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence Mine?
translation: Beni Rune Essence Madeni'ne isinlayabilir misin?

english: Seventior disthine molenko!
Player is teleported to the rune essence mine.
I have news on Persten.
Yes?
I'm sorry, but she's gone.
I see. It was always unlikely that she'd survive the Abyss.
translation: Anliyorum. Abyss'ten sag cikmasi zaten pek olasi degildi.

english: It wasn't the Abyss. I think she might have been dead long before then. The Persten we spoke to was an imposter.
translation: Abyss yüzünden degil. Sanirim cok daha önce ölmüstü. Konustugumuz Persten bir sahtekardi.

english: An imposter? What do you mean?
A Mahjarrat called Sliske was disguised as her.
translation: Sliske adinda bir Mahjarrat onun kiligina girmisti.

english: I can't believe it. Persten and I had our differences, but this...
translation: Inanamiyorum. Persten ile aramizda anlasmazliklar vardi, ama bu...

english: I'd better share this news with the others. Thank you for bringing it to me.
translation: Bu haberi digerleriyle paylassam iyi olacak. Bana haber verdigin icin tesekkürler.

english: How are things at the Temple of the Eye?
Between the Guardians of the Rift and ourselves, we are managing to keep the Abyss at bay.
translation: Rift'in Muhafizlari ve bizler, Abyss'i uzak tutmayi basariyoruz.

english: However, despite all our research, we are no closer to working out how to close the rift permanently.
translation: Ancak, tüm arastirmalarimiza ragmen, rift'i kalici olarak kapatmanin bir yolunu bulamadik.

english: Gaining a better understanding of the artefact that was once there is key, but we have found little mention of this 'Eye'.
translation: Bir zamanlar orada bulunan eseri daha iyi anlamak cok önemli, ama bu “Göz” hakkinda cok az bilgi bulabildik.

english: I'm sure the wizards of the first tower had plenty of research on it. After all, they knew enough about it to use its symbol as the symbol for our order.
translation: Ilk kulenin büyücüleri bu konuda cok fazla arastirma yapmislardir. Sonucta, onun sembolünü tarikatimizin sembolü olarak kullanacak kadar bilgiye sahiptiler.

english: All that knowledge lost because of those accursed Zamorakians!
translation: Tüm bu bilgi, lanetli Zamorakianlar yüzünden kayboldu!

english: I don't know if it will be much help, but I found out its real name. It's called the Stone of Jas.
translation: Cok yardimci olur mu bilmiyorum, ama onun gercek adini ögrendim. Adi Jas Tasi.

english: Hmm... That could be useful. I'll have a dig around and see if we can find any mention of it.
translation: Hmm... Bu yararli olabilir. Biraz arastirip, onunla ilgili herhangi bir bilgi bulabilir miyiz diye bakacagim.

english: Anyway, if you wish to help defend the temple, just head through the portal.
translation: Her neyse, tapinagi savunmaya yardim etmek istiyorsan, portaldan gec.

english: Were you able to find any information on the Stone of Jas?
translation: Jas Tasi hakkinda herhangi bir bilgi bulabildin mi?

english: Not yet. So far we've still only been able to find a few small mentions of it, but they all call it the Eye.
translation: Henüz degil. Su ana kadar sadece birkac kücük bahis bulabildik, ama hepsi ona Göz diyor.

english: I'm sure the wizards of the first tower had plenty of research that could have helped. All that knowledge lost because of those accursed Zamorakians!
translation: Ilk kulenin büyücüleri, yardimci olabilecek bircok arastirma yapmislardir. Tüm bu bilgiler, lanetli Zamorakcilar yüzünden kayboldu!

english: I might do that, thanks.
Who else knows the teleport to the Rune Essence Mine?
translation: Rune Essence Madeni'ne teleportu baska kim biliyor?

english: Apart from myself, there's also Aubury in Varrock, Wizard Cromperty in East Ardougne, Brimstail in the Tree Gnome Stronghold and Wizard Distentor in Yanille's Wizards' Guild.
translation: Benim disinda, Varrock'ta Aubury, Dogu Ardougne'da Büyücü Cromperty, Agac Gnome Kalesi'nde Brimstail ve Yanille'deki Büyücü Loncasi'nda Büyücü Distentor da biliyor.

english: Thanks for the information.
My pleasure.
Could you tell me about the old Wizards' Tower?
translation: Eski Büyücü Kulesi hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Of course. The first Wizards' Tower was built at the same time the Order of Wizards was founded. It was at the dawn of the Fifth Age, when the secrets of runecrafting were rediscovered.
translation: Elbette. Ilk Büyücü Kulesi, Büyücü Tarikati kuruldugunda insa edildi. Besinci Cag'in safaginda, rune yapiminin sirlari yeniden kesfedildigindeydi.

english: For years, the tower was a hub of magical research. Wizards of all races and religions were welcomed into our order.
translation: Yillar boyunca kule, büyülü arastirmalarin merkezi oldu. Tüm irk ve dinlerden büyücüler tarikatimiza kabul edildi.

english: Alas, that openness is what ultimately led to disaster. The wizards who served Zamorak, the evil god of chaos, tried to claim our magical discoveries in his name.
translation: Ne yazik ki, bu aciklik sonunda felakete yol acti. Kaosun kötü tanrisi Zamorak'a hizmet eden büyücüler, onun adina büyülü kesiflerimizi sahiplenmeye calistilar.

english: They failed, but in retaliation, they burnt the entire tower to the ground. Years of work was destroyed.
translation: Basarisiz oldular, ancak intikam olarak kuleyi tamamen yakip kül ettiler. Yillarin emegi yok oldu.

english: The tower was soon rebuilt of course, but even now we are still trying to regain knowledge that was lost.
translation: Kule elbette kisa sürede yeniden insa edildi, ancak hala kaybedilen bilgileri geri kazanmaya calisiyoruz.

english: That's why I spend my time down here, in fact. This basement is all that is left of the old tower, and I believe there are still some secrets to discover here.
translation: Aslinda bu yüzden zamanimi burada geciriyorum. Bu bodrum, eski kuleden geriye kalan tek sey ve burada hala kesfedilecek bazi sirlar olduguna inaniyorum.

english: Of course, one secret I am no longer looking for is the teleportation incantation to the Rune Essence Mine. We have you to thank for that.
translation: Tabii ki, artik aramadigim bir sir, Rune Essence Madeni'ne teleportasyon büyüsü. Bunun icin sana tesekkür etmeliyiz.

english: I've heard a different take on how the tower burnt down. Something about a ritual gone wrong?
translation: Kulenin nasil yandigina dair farkli bir yorum duydum. Bir ritüelin ters gitmesiyle ilgili bir sey mi?

english: Nothing more than Zamorakian hearsay! They burnt the tower down and are now too cowardly to even admit it!
translation: Zamorakian söylentilerinden baska bir sey degil! Kuleyi yaktilar ve simdi bunu itiraf etmeye bile cesaret edemiyorlar!

english: Fair enough.
Nothing thanks, I'm just looking around.
translation: Bir sey istemiyorum, sadece etrafa bakiniyorum.

english: Well, take care. You stand on the ruins of the old destroyed Wizards' Tower. Strange and powerful magicks lurk here.
translation: Peki, kendine iyi bak. Eski yikik Büyücü Kulesi'nin kalintilari üzerinde duruyorsun. Burada garip ve güclü büyüler gizleniyor.

english: Well done.
You've obtained a [new clue/casket]!
Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence Mine?
translation: Beni Rune Essence Madeni'ne isinlayabilir misin?

english: I have news on Persten.
How are things at the Temple of the Eye?
Could you tell me about the old Wizards' Tower?
translation: Eski Büyücü Kulesi hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: I might do that, thanks.
Who else knows the teleport to the Rune Essence Mine?
translation: Rune Essence Madeni'ne isinlanmayi baska kim biliyor?

english: Thanks for the information.
Nothing thanks, I'm just looking around.
translation: Hicbir sey, tesekkürler, sadece etrafa bakiniyorum.

english: Who are you?
Woo wooo?
Me? I am the Archpriest who was responsible for the running of this place! I am impressed that you managed to reach my resting place on the lowest level.
translation: Ben mi? Ben burayi yöneten basrahipim! En alt kattaki dinlenme yerime ulasmayi basardigin icin etkileyiciyim.

english: Well it wasn't easy for sure. You wouldn't believe how difficult it was to overcome some of those traps.
translation: Kesinlikle kolay olmadi. Bazi tuzaklari asmanin ne kadar zor oldugunu inanamazsin.

english: The intention was that they should've been impossible to pass. I should know. After all, it was I who was responsible for overseeing the safeguarding of this place.
translation: Amac, bunlarin gecilemez olmasiydi. Ben bilirim. Sonucta, burayi korumakla sorumlu olan bendim.

english: Why did you need the safeguards? Surely they made it more difficult to do your work down here?
translation: Neden güvenlik önlemlerine ihtiyac duydunuz? Bu önlemler burada calismanizi zorlastirmiyor muydu?

english: I'm not sure if I should say... I wouldn't want to compromise the trust that the Justiciar of the Unicorn has in me. Afterall, we did what we did for the safety of Hallowvale.
translation: Bunu söylemeli miyim bilmiyorum... Unicorn'un Yargici'nin bana olan güvenini sarsmak istemem. Sonucta, Hallowvale'in güvenligi icin yaptiklarimizi yaptik.

english: So... about that. Hallowvale no longer exists. The Hallowed Sepulchre is now beneath the vampyre capital of Darkmeyer within the lands of Morytania.
translation: Peki... o konuya gelelim. Hallowvale artik yok. Kutsal Mezar artik Morytania topraklarindaki vampir baskenti Darkmeyer'in altinda.

english: I see... So we lost then? In that case, I suppose it doesn't hurt to tell you after all.
translation: Anliyorum... Yani kaybettik mi? Öyleyse, sana söylemenin bir zarari olmaz herhalde.

english: One day the justiciar sent word to me that I should begin work on securing the Sepulchre. He feared an invasion from the followers of the Dark Lord.
translation: Bir gün yargic bana Mezar'i korumaya baslamam gerektigini söyledi. Karanlik Lord'un takipcilerinin istilasina karsi endiseliydi.

english: Do you mean Zamorak?

Yes, I do. The justiciar said he was going to confront these forces but that I should stay to protect the secrets within this place. I wish I could have joined him on the battlefield. I carried out my duties though.
translation: Evet, onu kastediyorum. Yargic, bu güclerle yüzlesecegini ama benim buradaki sirlari korumak icin kalmam gerektigini söyledi. Keske savas alaninda ona katilabilseydim. Yine de görevimi yerine getirdim.

english: I never told the others what was really happening. Day by day we worked our way down to the final floor.
translation: Digerlerine gercekte neler oldugunu hic anlatmadim. Gün be gün son kata dogru ilerledik.

english: As we progressed further, we became more experienced at creating the traps. Each one was more deadly than the last.
translation: Ilerledikce, tuzak kurma konusunda daha deneyimli hale geldik. Her biri bir öncekinden daha ölümcül oluyordu.

english: Eventually, when our work was done, I performed the last rites for each of my followers and sealed them within the coffins on the final floor.
translation: Sonunda, isimiz bittiginde, her bir takipcim icin son ayini yaptim ve onlari son kattaki tabutlara kapattim.

english: Finally, I did the same for myself. The knowledge of how to disarm the traps died with us.
translation: Sonunda, kendim icin de aynisini yaptim. Tuzaklari etkisiz hale getirme bilgisi bizimle birlikte öldü.

english: You buried yourselves alive? That's... horrible!
translation: Kendinizi canli canli gömdünüz mü? Bu... korkunc!

english: No, I think at that point most of us were already dead. We died knowing that we sacrificed ourselves for the good of holy Saradomin and the justiciars who follow him.
translation: Hayir, o noktada cogumuz zaten ölmüstük. Kutsal Saradomin ve onu takip eden yargiclar icin kendimizi feda ettigimizi bilerek öldük.

english: Well, at the very least you succeeded at keeping the vampyres out of the Sepulchre. From what I have seen, none of them have been able to enter.
translation: En azindan vampirleri mezarliktan uzak tutmayi basardiniz. Gördügüm kadariyla, hicbiri iceri giremedi.

english: I am glad adventurer. Perhaps that information will allow my spirit to pass on peacefully soon.
translation: Buna sevindim maceraci. Belki bu bilgi ruhumun yakinda huzur icinde öbür dünyaya gecmesini saglayacaktir.

english: Woo? Woo wooooooooo!
What are you doing in my coffin? Leave this holy place at once!
translation: Tabutumda ne yapiyorsun? Bu kutsal yeri hemen terk et!

english: That... That's my ring! I thought I destroyed it!
translation: O... O benim yüzügüm! Onu yok ettigimi saniyordum!

english: Oh, it's your ring? I didn't know.
The Justiciar of the Unicorn bestowed it upon me to help with my work within this place.
translation: Tek Boynuzlu At'in Yargici, buradaki islerime yardim etmesi için bana vermisti.

english: This ring allowed me to continue my work without feeling the effects that aging was having on my body. I suppose I have no use for it now. I guess you can keep it.
translation: Bu yüzük, yaslanmanin vücudumda yarattigi etkileri hissetmeden isime devam etmemi sagladi. Artik ona ihtiyacim yok sanirim. Sen alabilirsin.

english: Why did you try to destroy it?
When I got word that we had to protect this place from the Zamorakian invaders, I was worried that the ring would fall into the wrong hands.
translation: Bu yeri Zamorakian isgalcilerinden korumamiz gerektigi haberini aldigimda, yüzügün yanlis ellere geçmesinden endiselendim.

english: Thanks... I think?
Hello.
Greetings.
Who are you?
I am an architect. I designed and built many of the buildings in Arceuus using magic.
translation: Ben bir mimarim. Arceuus'taki bircok binayi sihir kullanarak tasarladim ve insa ettim.

english: How exciting!
It is an honour to serve my city in such a way. Now, I am very busy, please leave.
translation: Sehrime bu sekilde hizmet etmek benim icin bir onur. Simdi cok mesgulüm, lütfen git.

english: Hello there, iknami. Are you interested in some archery supplies?
translation: Merhaba, iknami. Okçuluk malzemeleriyle ilgilenir misin?

english: Yes please.
No thanks.
Well, you know where I am if you change your mind, iknami.
Yes please.
No thanks.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu var. Merhaba, selam, selam...

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: Bu yine de tek bir selam sayilir!

english: Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her türlü sey! Kuleler görülmeye deger harika bir manzara.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmenizi tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Can I help you, [sir/madam]?
What is this place?
This is the Emir's Arena. Fighters come from far and wide to arrange fights against their friends and rivals. They can fight in 1v1 Tournaments or Duels.
translation: Burasi Emir'in Arenasi. Dövüscüler, arkadaslari ve rakipleriyle dövüsmek icin uzaklardan buraya geliyorlar. 1'e 1 turnuvalarda veya düellolarda dövüsebilirler.

english: The Arena is open only on PvP Arena worlds. Switch to one of those game worlds to play in the Arena.
translation: Arena sadece PvP Arena dünyalarinda aciktir. Arena'da oynamak icin bu oyun dünyalarindan birine gecin.

english: Head over to the hospital north of the Arena, and speak to the Guides. They'll help you sign up to a fight. Now, can I help you with anything else?
translation: Arena'nin kuzeyindeki hastaneye gidin ve Rehberlerle konusun. Dövüse kaydolmaniza yardimci olacaklar. Baska bir konuda yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: What do you do here?
The Emir of Al-Kharid has decreed that his Arena should be guarded, to stop ruffians like the Calamity Coven from returning. But is there something I can do for you?
translation: Al-Kharid Emiri, Calamity Coven gibi haydutlarin geri dönmesini engellemek icin Arenasinin korunmasini emretti. Ama senin icin yapabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Tell me about the Calamity Coven.
The Calamity Coven were three brigands, followers of an ancient and derelict religion. Through their foul arts, they turned this Arena into a hotbed of corruption.
translation: Calamity Coven, eski ve terk edilmis bir dinin takipcileri olan üc hayduttan olusuyordu. Kötü büyüleriyle bu arenayi yolsuzlugun yuvasi haline getirdiler.

english: Maoma was a captain of the Emir's guard, but she abused her authority to rig fights so that the Coven would get rich at the people's expense.
translation: Maoma, Emir'in muhafizlarinin kaptaniydi, ancak yetkisini kötüye kullanarak dövüsleri hileli hale getirdi, böylece Coven halkin sirtindan zengin oldu.

english: Saika was the brains behind their operation, forging the Arena's accounts so that the Coven could keep all the profits, starving the Emir's public works of all funding.
translation: Saika, operasyonlarinin beyniydi, arenanin hesaplarini tahrif ederek Coven'in tüm kari elinde tutmasini sagladi ve Emir'in kamu islerinin tüm fonlarini kuruttu.

english: Koriff used her charms to act as a gracious hostess, whipping up the crowds' excitement so that they'd gamble more and more unwisely, enriching the Coven.
translation: Koriff, cazibesini kullanarak nazik bir ev sahibi gibi davranir, kalabaligin heyecanini körükleyerek onlarin daha fazla ve daha akilsizca kumar oynamasini saglar ve Coven'i zenginlestirir.

english: The Calamity Coven are long gone now; some of their old possessions are even being sold as rewards. Now, we are here to prevent a resurgence in such crime. But is there something I can do for you?
translation: Calamity Coven artik coktan yok oldu; eski esyalarinin bazilari ödül olarak satiliyor bile. Simdi, bu tür suclarin yeniden ortaya cikmasini önlemek icin buradayiz. Ama sizin icin yapabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Do you have any tips on how to win duels?

english: The easiest way to win is to knock your opponent out in one blow!

english: But I can't hit that hard!
translation: Ama ben o kadar sert vuramam!

english: Saika was the brains behind their operation, forging the Arena's accounts so that the Coven could keep all the profits, starving the Emir's public works of all funding.

english: Koriff used her charms to act as a gracious hostess, whipping up the crowds' excitement so that they'd gamble more and more unwisely, enriching the Coven.

english: Do you have any tips on how to win duels?

translation: Gelip bana bir konuda yardim eder misiniz?

english: If the problem isn't in the Arena, it's not my problem.
translation: Sorun Arena'da degilse, benim sorunum degil.

english: I'm fine, thanks.
Please stay within the Arena's boundaries.
On PvP Arena worlds, you can only use the PvP Arena. Switch to another world to play on your normal profile.

english: What is this place?
What do you do here?
Tell me about the Calamity Coven.
Tell me again about the Calamity Coven.
Could you come help me with something?
I'm fine, thanks.
Respect the souls, traveller.
Why are all these souls here?
A corporeal body is a mere flesh-temple in which the soul dwells. As the body fails, the soul loses its home. Without guidance, it would drift into oblivion.
translation: Maddi beden, ruhun yasadigi bir et tapinagidir. Beden yok oldugunda, ruh da yuvasini kaybeder. Rehberlik olmadan, ruh unutulmaya yüz tutar.

english: However, the Soul Altar provides a beacon, drawing the souls to this place where they may join the River.
translation: Ancak Ruh Altari, ruhlari Nehre katilabilecekleri bu yere ceken bir isaret isigi görevi görür.

english: The River leads the souls through unchartable realms, transcending the plane of the world as you see it, but the three-headed Guardian keeps them safe.
translation: Nehir, ruhlari kesfedilmemis alemlere götürür, senin gördügün dünyanin düzlemini asar, ancak üc basli Muhafiz onlari güvende tutar.

english: The souls are the dead of Kourend - ensure you respect the souls.
translation: Ruhlar Kourend'in ölüleridir - ruhlara saygi göster.

english: Why are you here?
I am here to salute the dead of Kourend whose souls are joining the River. Ensure you respect the souls.
translation: Ruhlari Nehre katilan Kourend'in ölülerini selamlamak icin buradayim. Ruhlara saygi göster.

english: I've been reading your book: 'The Journey of Souls'
Let me guess, traveller... did you come to ask me where the soul bearer was buried? Every mortal who reads my book seems to want to get their hands on it.
translation: Dur tahmin edeyim, gezgin... Ruh tasiyicisinin nereye gömüldügünü sormaya mi geldin? Kitabimi okuyan her ölümlü, onu ele gecirmek istiyor gibi görünüyor.

english: Mortals are so predictable. This is the kind of thinking that led that adventurer to break into the Guardian's cave and damage the soul bearer in the first place.
translation: Ölümlüler cok tahmin edilebilir. Bu tür düsünceler, o maceracinin Gardiyan'in magarasina girip ruh tasiyicisina zarar vermesine neden oldu.

english: It occurs to me, though, that even if you dig it up, the artefact is damaged. Although the Elders of Arceuus never had the knowledge to repair it, there is one who may be able to help.
translation: Ancak aklima geldi de, onu kazip cikarsan bile, eser hasar görmüs durumda. Arceuus'un Yaslilari onu onarmak icin gerekli bilgiye sahip olmasa da, yardim edebilecek biri var.

english: I speak of the Key Master, he who watches over the cave of the three-headed Guardian of the River. He has been there for countless years, and will have absorbed power from the River in that time.
translation: Üc basli Nehir Muhafizi'nin magarasini koruyan Anahtar Efendisi'nden bahsediyorum. O, sayisiz yildir orada ve bu süre zarfinda Nehir'den güc emmis olmali.

english: Now, we buried the artefact in the crypt of the Arceuus church. As I have revealed this secret to you, you will no longer be affected by the spells that prevent unwary explorers from stumbling across it.
translation: Simdi, eseri Arceuus kilisesinin mahzenine gömdük. Sana bu sirri acikladigim icin, artik dikkatsiz kasiflerin ona rastlamasini engelleyen büyülerden etkilenmeyeceksin.

english: Thanks! I'll be off now.
No, I don't want your smelly soul bearer.
translation: Hayir, senin kokusmus ruh tasiyicini istemiyorum.

english: Hmmph! So what do you want? I trust you will respect the souls while you are in this hallowed place.
translation: Hmmph! Ne istiyorsun peki? Bu kutsal yerdeyken ruhlara saygi gösterecegine inaniyorum.

english: About the soul bearer again... I got it repaired by the Key Master. Thanks for your help.
translation: Yine ruh tasiyicisi hakkinda... Anahtar Ustasi tarafindan tamir ettirdim. Yardimin icin tesekkürler.

english: Use it carefully, traveller, and respect the souls.
translation: Dikkatli kullan, gezgin, ve ruhlara saygi göster.

english: Okay, I'm respecting the souls.
Why are all these souls here?
Why are you here?
I've been reading your book...
Yes please.
No, I don't want your smelly soul bearer.
About the soul bearer again...
Okay, I'm respecting the souls.
Hello! Would you like to trade?
Sure.
No thanks.
Is that your ship?
Yes, I use it to make deliveries to my customers up and down the coast. These crates here are all ready for my next trip.
translation: Evet, kiyi boyunca müsterilerime teslimat yapmak icin kullaniyorum. Buradaki sandiklar bir sonraki yolculugum icin hazir.

english: Where do you deliver to?
Oh, various places up and down the coast. Mostly Karamja and Port Sarim.
translation: Kiyi seridindeki cesitli yerlere. Cogunlukla Karamja ve Port Sarim'e.

english: I don't suppose I could get a lift anywhere?
Sorry pal, but I'm afraid I'm not quite ready to sail yet.
translation: Üzgünüm dostum, ama henüz denize acilmaya hazir degilim.

english: I'm waiting on a big delivery of candles which I need to deliver further along the coast.
translation: Kiyi seridinin daha ilerisine teslim etmem gereken büyük bir mum teslimati bekliyorum.

english: Well, good luck with your business.
Thanks buddy!
Are you rich then?
Business is going reasonably well... I wouldn't say I was the richest of merchants ever, but I'm doing fairly well all things considered.
translation: Islerim oldukca iyi gidiyor... En zengin tüccar oldugumu söyleyemem, ama her seyi göz önünde bulundurursak oldukca iyi gidiyorum.

english: Hey buddy! Get away from my ship alright?
Yeah... uh... sorry...
Well done, matey!
Yes.
No thank you.
Is that your ship?
Where do you deliver to?
I don't suppose I could get a lift anywhere?
Well, good luck with your business.
Are you rich then?
How did you get in here? You must leave.
Hello Arianwyn, how's it going?
I am well [player name], yourself?
Not bad thanks, any news on Lord Iorwerth?
translation: Fena degil, tesekkürler. Lord Iorwerth hakkinda bir haber var mi?

english: Not yet, I will try to send word if we find out anything new.
translation: Henüz yok, yeni bir sey ögrenirsek haber vermeye calisacagim.

english: Oh okay, well see you then.
Until next time, [player name].
translation: Bir dahaki sefere görüsmek üzere, Maceraci.

english: Hello young one.
Cross my palm with silver and the future will be revealed to you.
translation: Elime gümüs koyarsan sana gelecegi gösterecegim.

english: Okay, here you go.
Come closer, and listen carefully to what the future holds for you, as I peer into the swirling mists of the crystal ball.
translation: Yaklas ve kristal küredeki dönen sislerin icine bakarken gelecegin sana neler getirecegini dikkatle dinle.

english: I can see images forming. I can see you.
You are holding a very impressive looking sword. I'm sure I recognise that sword...
translation: Elinde cok etkileyici bir kilic tutuyorsun. O kilici tanidigimi saniyorum...

english: There is a big dark shadow appearing now.
translation: Simdi büyük, karanlik bir gölge beliriyor.

english: Aaargh!
Are you all right?
It's Delrith! Delrith is coming!
Who's Delrith?
Delrith...
Delrith is a powerful demon.
Oh! I really hope he didn't see me looking at him through my crystal ball!
translation: Oh! Umarim kristal küremden ona baktigimi görmemistir!

english: He tried to destroy this city 150 years ago. He was stopped just in time by the great hero Wally.
translation: 150 yil önce bu sehri yok etmeye calisti. Büyük kahraman Wally tarafindan son anda durduruldu.

english: Using his magic sword Silverlight, Wally managed to trap the demon in the stone circle just south of this city.
translation: Wally, sihirli kilici Silverlight'i kullanarak iblisi bu sehrin güneyindeki tas cemberin icine hapsetmeyi basardi.

english: Ye gods! Silverlight was the sword you were holding in my vision! You are the one destined to stop the demon this time.
translation: Tanrilar! Silverlight, benim vizyonumda tuttugun kilicti! Bu sefer iblisi durdurmak senin kaderin.

english: How am I meant to fight a demon who can destroy cities?!
translation: Sehirleri yok edebilen bir iblisle nasil savasacagim?!

english: If you face Delrith while he is still weak from being summoned, and use the correct weapon, you will not find the task too arduous.
translation: Delrith'i, cagirilmanin etkisiyle hala zayifken karsilayip dogru silahi kullanirsan, bu görev sana cok zor gelmeyecektir.

english: Do not fear. If you follow the path of the great hero Wally, then you are sure to defeat the demon.
translation: Korkma. Büyük kahraman Wally'nin izinden gidersen, iblisi yenebileceginden emin olabilirsin.

english: Okay, where is he? I'll kill him for you!
translation: Tamam, nerede o? Onu senin icin öldürecegim!

english: Ah, the overconfidence of the young!
Delrith can't be harmed by ordinary weapons. You must face him using the same weapon that Wally used.
translation: Delrith siradan silahlarla yaralanamaz. Wally'nin kullandigi silahla onunla yüzlesmelisin.

english: Wally doesn't sound a very heroic name.
translation: Wally pek kahramanca bir isim gibi gelmiyor.

english: Yes I know. Maybe that is why history doesn't remember him. However he was a very great hero.
translation: Evet, biliyorum. Belki de bu yüzden tarih onu hatirlamiyor. Ancak o cok büyük bir kahramandi.

english: Who knows how much pain and suffering Delrith would have brought forth without Wally to stop him!
translation: Wally onu durdurmasaydi, Delrith ne kadar aci ve istirap getirecekti kim bilir!

english: It looks like you are going to need to perform similar heroics.
translation: Görünüse göre benzer bir kahramanlik yapman gerekecek.

english: So how did Wally kill Delrith?
Wally managed to arrive at the stone circle just as Delrith was summoned by a cult of chaos druids...
translation: Wally, Delrith kaos druidleri tarikati tarafindan cagirildigi sirada tas cemberine ulasmayi basardi...

english: A cutscene showing Wally defeating Delrith
translation: Wally'nin Delrith'i yendigini gösteren bir kesit

english: Die, foul demon!
Now, what was that incantation again?
in Word#1... Word#2... Word#3... Word#4... Word#5!
I am the greatest demon slayer EVER!
translation: Ben gelmis gecmis en büyük iblis avcisiyim!

english: Cutscene over
By reciting the correct magical incantation, and thrusting Silverlight into Delrith while he was newly summoned, Wally was able to imprison Delrith in the stone block in the centre of the circle.
translation: Dogru büyülü büyüyü söyleyerek ve Delrith yeni cagirildiginda ona Silverlight'i saplayarak, Wally Delrith'i cemberin ortasindaki tas bloga hapsetmeyi basardi.

english: Delrith will come forth from the stone circle again.
I would imagine an evil sorcerer is already starting on the rituals to summon Delrith as we speak.
translation: Kötü bir büyücü, su anda Delrith'i cagirmak icin ritüellere baslamis olmali.

english: What is the magical incantation?
Oh yes, let me think a second...
Alright, I think I've got it now, it goes.... Word#1... Word#2... Word#3... Word#4... Word#5. Have you got that?
translation: Tamam, sanirim buldum, söyle... Kelime 1... Kelime 2... Kelime 3... Kelime 4... Kelime 5. Anladin mi?

english: I think so, yes.
Where can I find Silverlight?
Silverlight has been passed down through Wally's descendants. I believe it is currently in the care of one of the King's knights called Sir Prysin.
translation: Silverlight, Wally'nin torunlarina miras kalmistir. Su anda Kral'in sövalyelerinden biri olan Sir Prysin'in himayesinde oldugunu saniyorum.

english: He shouldn't be too hard to find. He lives in the royal palace in this city. Tell him Aris sent you.
translation: Onu bulmak cok zor olmamali. Bu sehrin kraliyet sarayinda yasiyor. Aris'in gönderdigini söyle.

english: Ok thanks. I'll do my best to stop the demon.
translation: Tamam, tesekkürler. Iblisi durdurmak icin elimden geleni yapacagim.

english: Good luck, and may Guthix be with you!
No, I don't believe in that stuff
translation: Hayir, ben o tür seylere inanmiyorum.

english: Ok suit yourself.
Greetings. How goes thy quest?
I'm still working on it.
Well if you need any advice I'm always here, young one.
translation: Eger tavsiyeye ihtiyacin olursa ben her zaman buradayim, genc adam.

english: Where can I find the Silverlight?
Stop calling me that!
In the scheme of things you are very young.
Ok, but how old are you?
Count the number of legs on the stools in the Blue Moon inn, and multiply that number by seven.
translation: Blue Moon hanindaki taburelerin bacaklarini say ve o sayiyi yedi ile carp.

english: Er, yeah, whatever.
Oh if it's in the scheme of things that's ok.
translation: Genel olarak bakildiginda sorun yoksa sorun yok.

english: You show wisdom for one so young.
translation: Bu kadar genc biri icin bilgece davraniyorsun.

english: Well I'd better press on with it.
translation: Peki, ben devam etsem iyi olacak.

english: See you anon.
How goes the quest?
I found Sir Prysin. Unfortunately I haven't got the sword yet. He's made it complicated for me.
translation: Sör Prysin'i buldum. Ne yazik ki kilici henüz almadim. Isleri benim icin zorlastirdi.

english: Ok, hurry, we haven't much time.
translation: Tamam, acele et, fazla vaktimiz yok.

english: I have the sword now. I just need to kill the demon, I think.
translation: Kilici aldim. Sanirim artik sadece iblisi öldürmem gerekiyor.

english: Yep, that's right.
Where can I find the demon?
Just head south and you should find the stone circle just outside the city gate.
translation: Güneye dogru git, sehir kapisinin hemen disinda tas cemberi bulacaksin.

english: Greetings young one.
You're a hero now. That was a good bit of demonslaying.
translation: Artik bir kahramansin. Iblisi öldürmekle iyi is cikardin.

english: How do you know I killed it?
You forget. I'm good at knowing things.
translation: Unutuyorsun. Ben bazi seyleri iyi bilirim.

english: Thanks.
There's just one thing I don't understand about that whole time travel culinaromancer thing...
translation: Zaman yolculugu ve mutfak büyücüsü meselesinde anlamadigim tek bir sey var...

english: Oh yes? What was that?
Everything!
I wouldn't worry about it too much if I were you. The world is safe once more thanks to your assistance.
translation: Sen olsam bu kadar kafana takmazdim. Senin yardimin sayesinde dünya yeniden güvenli hale geldi.

english: That's all that really matters.
Yeah, I guess... I just wish things made sense is all...
translation: Evet, sanirim... Sadece her seyin mantikli olmasini isterdim, hepsi bu...

english: Hello?
Because I can tell the future.
Um?
That is the answer to your next question.
But how did you know what I would ask?
Ah, that's very clever.
Thanks. Oh and be careful in the Wilderness. Tonight is not your night.
translation: Tesekkürler. Oh, ve Wilderness'da dikkatli ol. Bu gece senin gecen degil.

english: Cheers!
You've [been given a new clue/found a casket]!
Here, have this.
Yes.
How am I meant to fight a demon who can destroy cities?
translation: Sehirleri yok edebilen bir iblisle nasil savasacagim?

english: Okay, where is he? I'll kill him for you!
translation: Tamam, nerede o? Onu senin icin öldürecegim!

english: Wally doesn't sound like a very heroic name.
translation: Wally pek kahramanca bir isim gibi gelmiyor.

english: So how did Wally kill Delrith?
What is the magical incantation?
Where can I find Silverlight?
Okay, thanks. I'll do my best to stop the demon.
translation: Tamam, tesekkürler. Iblisi durdurmak icin elimden geleni yapacagim.

english: No.
Where can I find the Silverlight?
Stop calling me that!
Ok but how old are you?
Oh if it's in the scheme of things that's ok.
translation: Oh, eger planin bir parcasiysa sorun yok.

english: Well I'd better press on with it.
translation: O zaman devam etsem iyi olur.

translation: O zaman devam etsem iyi olur.

english: Where can I find the demon?
How do you know I killed it?
Thanks.
I'm sorry, but I'm currently doing some research. Could you talk to me later, please?
translation: Üzgünüm, su anda bir arastirma yapiyorum. Lütfen daha sonra konusabilir miyiz?

english: Okay then.
Good day, [madam/sir]. Are you interested in the history of this area?
translation: Iyi günler, . Bu bölgenin tarihi ile ilgileniyor musunuz?

english: Tell me about yourself.
I am a librarian from the great library of Menaphos. I left to travel the desert and learn more of its history.
translation: Ben Menaphos'un büyük kütüphanesinden bir kütüphaneciyim. Cölü gezip tarihini daha iyi ögrenmek icin buradan ayrildim.

english: I'd better be off.
Tell me about Enakhra.
Enakhra? I have read only a little about her. She was one of the Mahjarrat who arrived in Gielinor many thousands of years ago.
translation: Enakhra mi? Onun hakkinda cok az sey okudum. Binlerce yil önce Gielinor'a gelen Mahjarratlardan biriydi.

english: She supported Zamorak when he tried to gain power, and she apparently built a great temple in his honour somewhere in the desert.
translation: Zamorak iktidari ele gecirmeye calisirken ona destek oldu ve görünüse göre cölde onun onuruna büyük bir tapinak insa etti.

english: However, it is said that when she showed it to him, he was not impressed, and told her that he would rather have a weapon that could slay gods.
translation: Ancak, ona tapinagi gösterdiginde Zamorak etkilenmedi ve ona tanrilari öldürebilecek bir silah istedigini söyledi.

english: That is the last anyone knows of what happened to her, and it took place several thousand years ago.
translation: Bu, onun basina gelenler hakkinda bilinen son sey ve bu olay binlerce yil önce gerceklesti.

english: Interesting. Thanks for the information.
Tell me about Akthanakos.
An interesting choice of topic. Akthanakos is a Mahjarrat who was apparently worshipped as a god for a while in these parts. That was a long time ago, of course.
translation: Ilginc bir konu secimi. Akthanakos, bu bölgelerde bir süre tanri olarak tapinilan bir Mahjarrat'tir. Tabii ki bu cok uzun zaman önceydi.

english: Unlike many of his kin, he was against Zamorak's rise to power. Perhaps that's why he ended up out here. Zamorak has little sway in the desert.
translation: Bircok akrabasinin aksine, Zamorak'in iktidara gelmesine karsiydi. Belki de bu yüzden buraya geldi. Zamorak'in cölde pek etkisi yoktur.

english: Whatever his reasons, he clearly took a liking to living here. He took on the head of a camel and even made an amulet that would allow him to understand their kind.
translation: Sebebi ne olursa olsun, burada yasamayi acikca sevdi. Bir deve kafasi takti ve hatta onlarin türünü anlayabilmesini saglayan bir muska yapti.

english: Using it, he even trained some of the native camels to fight for him. Their name, 'Ugthanki', is derived from his.
translation: Bunu kullanarak, bazi yerli develeri kendisi icin savasmalari icin egitti. Onlarin adi, “Ugthanki”, onun adindan türemistir.

english: Since he disappeared, however, it is said that the Ugthanki became more violent and started attacking travellers.
translation: Ancak, o ortadan kayboldugundan beri, Ugthanki'lerin daha siddetli hale geldigi ve yolculari saldirmaya basladigi söyleniyor.

english: I'm good.
Good day, [sir/madam]. Are you interested in the history of this area?
translation: Iyi günler, . Bu bölgenin tarihi ile ilgileniyor musunuz?

english: Yes, I want to know more about the desert!
translation: Evet, cöl hakkinda daha fazla bilgi edinmek istiyorum!

english: It's good to meet someone so eager to learn.
translation: Ögrenmeye bu kadar hevesli biriyle tanismak güzel.

english: Now, what would you like to hear about?
translation: Peki, ne hakkinda bilgi almak istersiniz?

english: Tell me about Enakhra the Mahjarrat.
I have read only a little about her. She was one of the Mahjarrat who arrived in Gielinor many thousands of years ago.
translation: Onun hakkinda cok az sey okudum. O, binlerce yil önce Gielinor'a gelen Mahjarratlardan biriydi.

english: She supported Zamorak when he tried to gain power, but her attempts to gain his favour failed, and she retreated to a temple she had built.
translation: Zamorak iktidari ele gecirmeye calisirken onu destekledi, ancak onun gözüne girme cabalari basarisiz oldu ve insa ettigi tapinaga cekildi.

english: Tell me about Akthanakos the Mahjarrat.
Like Enakhra, his rival, Akthanakos came to Gielinor with the other Mahjarrat. He took on the aspect of one of the local gods, and is usually drawn with a camel's head.
translation: Rakibi Enakhra gibi, Akthanakos da diger Mahjarratlarla birlikte Gielinor'a geldi. Yerel tanrilardan birinin görünümünü aldi ve genellikle deve basli olarak resmedilir.

english: He was against Zamorak's rise to power, but the last anyone knows of him was that he and Enakhra were thinking of forgetting their rivalry.
translation: Zamorak'in iktidara gelmesine karsiydi, ancak onun hakkinda bilinen son sey, Enakhra ile rekabetlerini unutmayi düsündükleriydi.

english: Tell me about Enakhra's temple.
translation: Enakhra'nin tapinagi hakkinda bana bilgi verin.

english: Well, my sources say that Enakhra tried to gain favour with Zamorak by building him a temple somewhere in the desert.
translation: Kaynaklarim, Enakhra'nin Zamorak'in gözüne girmek icin cölde bir tapinak insa ettigini söylüyor.

english: It is said that when she showed it to him, he was not impressed, and told her that he would rather have a weapon that could slay gods than a temple.
translation: Onu Zamorak'a gösterdiginde, Zamorak etkilenmemis ve ona tapinaktan cok tanrilari öldürebilecek bir silah istedigini söylemis.

english: After that, it seems that Enakhra retreated to that temple. If she hasn't died, she's been there ever since.
translation: Bundan sonra Enakhra o tapinaga cekilmis gibi görünüyor. Eger ölmediyse, o zamandan beri orada yasiyor.

english: Tell me about the Camulet.
I'm afraid I've only heard rumours of it, but here's what I know.
translation: Maalesef sadece söylentiler duydum, ama bildiklerim sunlar.

english: When Akthanakos came to Gielinor and took on the aspect of a man with a camel's head, he made an amulet that would allow him to understand camels.
translation: Akthanakos Gielinor'a geldiginde ve deve basli bir adam görünümüne büründügünde, develeri anlayabilmesini saglayacak bir muska yapti.

english: Why should I care about what happened thousands of years ago?
translation: Binlerce yil önce olanlari neden umursamaliyim?

english: Because those who cannot remember the past are condemned to repeat it.
translation: Cünkü gecmisi hatirlayamayanlar, onu tekrar yasamaya mahkumdurlar.

english: Knowing something about history can prevent you from making mistakes that people have made before, you see.
translation: Tarih hakkinda bir seyler bilmek, insanlarin daha önce yaptigi hatalari tekrarlamani engelleyebilir.

english: Who are you?
Unfortunately, the plague in Sophanem prevents me from returning to the library.
translation: Maalesef, Sophanem'deki veba salgini kütüphaneye dönmemi engelliyor.

english: Tell me about yourself.
Tell me about Enakhra.
Tell me about Akthanakos.
I'd better be off.
Interesting. Thanks for the information.
I'm good.
Yes, I want to know more about the desert!
translation: Evet, cöl hakkinda daha fazla sey bilmek istiyorum!

Akthanakos the Mahjarrat
Enakhra's temple
The Camulet
Why should I care about what happened thousands of years ago?
translation: Binlerce yil önce olanlari neden umursayayim ki?

english: Who are you?
No warning! Be gone!
Hey, don't use our fire! It's the only one we've got...
translation: Hey, bizim atesimizi kullanma! Elimizdeki tek ates bu...

english: Good day to you.
And to you. Can I help you?
What do you do here?
I am a supplier of leather armours and accessories. Ask and I will tell you what I know.
translation: Deri zirh ve aksesuar tedarikcisiyim. Sor, bildigim her seyi anlatirim.

english: Tell me about your armours.
I have normal, studded and hard types.
translation: Normal, civili ve sert tiplerim var.

english: Tell me about normal leather.
Indeed, leather armour is excellent for archers. It's supple and not very heavy.
translation: Gercekten, deri zirh okcular icin mükemmeldir. Esnek ve cok agir degildir.

english: What's studded leather?
Ah, now that's leather covered with studs. It's more protective than ordinary leather.
translation: Ah, civilerle kapli deridir. Siradan deriden daha koruyucudur.

english: What's hard leather?
Hard leather is specially treated using oils and drying methods to create a hard-wearing armour.
translation: Sert deri, yaglar ve kurutma yöntemleri kullanilarak özel olarak islenerek dayanikli bir zirh olusturulur.

english: Enough about armour.
As you wish, traveller.
Tell me about your accessories.
Ah yes we have a new range of accessories in stock. Essential items for an archer like you.
translation: Evet, yeni bir aksesuar serisi stoklarimizda var. Senin gibi bir okcu icin vazgecilmez ürünler.

english: We have vambraces, chaps, cowls and coifs.
translation: Kol zirhlari, tozluklar, basliklar ve baslik kapaklari var.

english: Tell me about vambraces.
Ah yes, vambraces. These useful items are for your arms.
translation: Evet, kol zirhlari. Bu kullanisli ürünler kollariniz icin.

english: A protective sheath that favours the bow and arrow. An essential purchase.
translation: Yay ve ok icin koruyucu bir kilif. Satin alinmasi gereken bir ürün.

english: Tell me about chaps.
Chaps have two functions: firstly to protect your legs, and secondly for ease of reloading arrows.
translation: Coraplarin iki islevi vardir: birincisi bacaklarinizi korumak, ikincisi oklari yeniden yüklemeyi kolaylastirmak.

english: I can highly recommend these to you for quick archery.
translation: Hizli okculuk icin bunlari siddetle tavsiye ederim.

english: Tell me about cowls.
The cowl is a soft leather hat, ideal for protection with maneuverability.
translation: Baslik, manevra kabiliyeti ile koruma icin ideal olan yumusak deri bir sapkadir.

english: These are highly favoured with our guards.
Tell me about coifs.
The coif is a specialized cowl, that has extra chain protection to keep your neck and shoulders safe.
translation: Coif, boynunuzu ve omuzlarinizi korumak icin ekstra zincir korumasina sahip özel bir basliktir.

english: An excellent addition to our range, traveller.
translation: Ürün yelpazemize mükemmel bir ek, gezgin.

english: Enough about accessories.
As you wish.
I've seen enough, thanks.
Very good, adventurer.
I'd like to see what you sell.
Indeed, cast your eyes on my wares, adventurer.
Can you tell me about your cape?
Certainly! Skillcapes are a symbol of achievement. Only people who have mastered a skill and reached level 99 can get their hands on them and gain the benefits they carry.
translation: Tabii ki! Beceri pelerinleri basari sembolüdür. Sadece bir beceriyi ustalastirip 99. seviyeye ulasan kisiler bu pelerinleri elde edebilir ve sagladiklari avantajlardan yararlanabilir.

english: The Cape of Ranging has been modified by Ava to function as one of her accumulator devices. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Menzil Pelerini, Ava tarafindan birikim cihazlarindan biri olarak islev görecek sekilde degistirilmistir. Baska yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

All those penguins, what are they doing?
Ah, they are doing drills! Getting ready for the invasion. What a glorious day that will be!
translation: Ah, tatbikat yapiyorlar! Istilaya hazirlaniyorlar. Ne muhtesem bir gün olacak!

english: Invasion? Of...
Yes, yes, I know we all get excited. But, I need you to get out of the way. Move along!
translation: Evet, evet, hepimizin heyecanlandigini biliyorum. Ama yolumdan cekilmenizi istiyorum. Devam edin!

english: Put some wing into it.
We will fly quietly into the night...and destroy them all!
translation: Gecenin sessizliginde ucacagiz... ve hepsini yok edecegiz!

english: Keep those beaks high, men!
No slacking! Slackers will be punished.
Think of the motherland!
This isn't ballet soldier!
Today is a fine day! First, I intend to drink. Next, I intend to fight. Finally, I intend to contemplate our existence in this confusing world.
translation: Bugün güzel bir gün! Önce icmeyi planliyorum. Sonra savasmayi planliyorum. Son olarak, bu kafa karistirici dünyada varligimizi düsünmeyi planliyorum.

english: That's quite the day.
And a fine day it will be!
Hello there.
What's in this cave?
A unique farming patch. This cave is the only place we've succesfullybeen able to grow a Hespori.
translation: Essiz bir tarim alani. Bu magara, Hespori yetistirmeyi basardigimiz tek yer.

english: What's a Hespori?
A rare carnivorous plant originally from Morytania. When grown, the plant becomes conscious and highly aggressive. They are truly fascinating.
translation: Morytania'ya özgü nadir bir etcil bitki. Büyüdügünde, bitki bilinc kazanir ve oldukca saldirgan hale gelir. Gercekten büyüleyici bitkilerdir.

english: Can I grow one?
Of course. Just plant some Hespori seeds in the cave below and it will grow like any other plant. A Hespori is pretty tough so you don't need to worry about it getting diseased.
translation: Tabii ki. Magaranin icine biraz Hespori tohumu ekersen, diger bitkiler gibi büyür. Hespori oldukca dayaniklidir, bu yüzden hastalanmasindan endiselenmene gerek yok.

english: Do be careful though. A fully grown Hespori can be quite troublesome to deal with.
translation: Ama dikkatli ol. Tamamen büyümüs bir Hespori ile basa cikmak oldukca zor olabilir.

english: Do you need anything else?
translation: Baska bir seye ihtiyaciniz var mi?

english: Do you have any of my items?
translation: Benim esyalarimdan herhangi birine sahip misiniz?

english: I'm afraid not. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: Maalesef hayir. Eger sizin esyalarinizdan herhangi birine sahip olsaydim, ama siz onlari almadan önce öldüyseniz, artik kaybolmus olurlar.

english: I do indeed. You really should be more careful.
translation: Evet, var. Gercekten daha dikkatli olmalisiniz.

english: I don't want to find Hespori seeds when farming.
translation: Ciftcilik yaparken Hespori tohumlari bulmak istemiyorum.

english: Very well. You'll no longer find Hespori seeds when farming.
translation: Peki. Artik ciftcilik yaparken Hespori tohumlari bulmayacaksiniz.

english: I want to find Hespori seeds when farming.
translation: Ciftcilik yaparken Hespori tohumlari bulmak istiyorum.

english: Very well. You'll now have a chance of finding Hespori seeds when farming.
translation: Peki. Artik ciftcilik yaparken Hespori tohumlari bulma sansin olacak.

english: Goodbye.
I'm afraid I don't have anything for you. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: Maalesef sana verecek bir seyim yok. Eger esyalarindan herhangi biri bende olsaydi, ama sen onlari almadan önce öldüysen, artik kaybolmus olacaklar.

english: Can you hear me down there? I have some of your items, from a previous visit. Shouldn't you collect them from me before fighting the Hespori again?
translation: Beni duyabiliyor musun? Önceki ziyaretinden kalan bazi esyalarin bende. Hespori ile tekrar savasmadan önce onlari benden alman gerekmez mi?

english: I'll come and collect them from you.
No, I don't care if I lose that stuff. I'll fight the Hespori again now.
translation: Hayir, o esyalari kaybetmem umurumda degil. Simdi Hespori ile tekrar savasacagim.

Do you have any of my items?
