english: Ah, you come back! What you want from Arnold, heh?
translation: Ah, geri geldin! Arnold'dan ne istiyorsun, heh?

english: Would you like to trade?
Ja, I have wide range of stock...
Nothing, I just came to chat.
translation: Hicbir sey, sadece sohbet etmeye geldim.

english: Ah, that is nice - always I like to chat, but Herr Caranos tell me to get back to work! Here, you been nice, so have a present:
translation: Ah, bu cok güzel - her zaman sohbet etmeyi severim, ama Herr Caranos bana ise dönmemi söylüyor! Al, sen iyi davrandin, sana bir hediye:

english: A cabbage?
Ja, cabbage is good for you!
Um... thanks!
Please solve this for me. I have other things to be thinking about.
translation: Lütfen bunu benim icin cöz. Düsünmem gereken baska seyler var.

english: Arnold Lydspor has given you a puzzle box!
translation: Arnold Lydspor sana bir bulmaca kutusu verdi!

english: Sorry but you haven't solved the puzzle yet.
Thanks [player name]!
Can you open my bank account, please?
I'd like to check my Bank PIN settings.
translation: Banka PIN ayarlarimi kontrol etmek istiyorum.

english: I'd like to collect items.
Would you like to trade?
Nothing, I just came to chat.
translation: Hicbir sey, sadece sohbet etmeye geldim.

english: Excuse me...
Yes, what is it?
Thank you for finding my sword for me. Did you find everyone's belongings?
translation: Kilicimi buldugun icin tesekkürler. Herkesin esyalarini buldun mu?

english: I did! Thank you for the reward.
You're more than welcome to it, for getting our belongings back.
translation: Esyalarimizi geri aldigin icin cok tesekkürler.

english: Urgh...
He looks too sick to chat.
Thanks again for clearing up that 'curse'. Ever since you proved it wasn't supernatural, I've been feeling a lot better.
translation: O ‘laneti’ ortadan kaldirdigin icin tekrar tesekkürler. Onun dogaüstü bir sey olmadigini kanitladigindan beri kendimi cok daha iyi hissediyorum.

english: You're welcome.
Hello.
Ahh many greetinks and welcomes to ze Museum!
translation: Ahh, müzeye hos geldiniz ve selamlar!

english: Who are you?
Ahhh, mon amie! My name iz Jacques and I am ze Museum's finest art critic!
translation: Ahhh, mon amie! Benim adim Jacques ve müzenin en iyi sanat elestirmeniyim!

english: Looks to me like you're the ONLY one.
Zis iz true, mon amie. 'owever, in ze future, I will 'ave my own entire floor of ze Museum with paintings galore!
translation: Bu dogru, mon amie. Ancak gelecekte müzenin bir kati tamamen benim olacak ve orada bol bol tablo sergilenecek!

english: Uhh... Has that been approved or are you just dreaming?
translation: Uhh... Bu onaylandi mi yoksa sadece hayal mi kuruyorsun?

english: Ah, I see [madame/monsieur] iz 'aving ze little bon mot, eh?
translation: Ah, görüyorum ki kücük bir bon mot yapiyorsun, degil mi?

english: Err...bone what?
Ze bon mot, ze laugh, ze fun of poking at me, eh? I shall 'ave my gallery, you vill see eventually, mon amie. Zen I shall be ze, 'ow you say, laughing last!
translation: Bon mot, gülmek, benimle dalga gecmek, degil mi? Kendi galerim olacak, sonunda göreceksin, mon amie. O zaman ben, nasil diyorsunuz, son gülen olacagim!

english: What do you do here?
I critique ze art! See the beautifool colours and ze masterful use of ze brush to capture perfectly ze royal presence...
translation: Sanati elestiriyorum! Kraliyetin varligini mükemmel bir sekilde yakalamak icin kullanilan güzel renkleri ve ustaca firca kullanimini görün...

english: Umm...it's just a painting.
JUST a painting? 'ow could you say such a t'ing? When you learn 'ow to appreciate ze wonderful works of art, you may talk to me.
translation: Sadece bir resim mi? Nasil böyle bir sey söyleyebilirsin? Harika sanat eserlerini takdir etmeyi ögrendiginde benimle konusabilirsin.

english: Yes, I see!
And look at the use of shade and contrast - isn't it just magnificent?
translation: Ve gölge ve kontrast kullanimina bakin - muhtesem degil mi?

english: Oui...so eet eez. So perfect it almost makes me weep wiz joy! The grandiloquent strokes of ze brush convey a kind of mystic quality...eet iz almost as if 'e were 'ere with us.
translation: Evet... öyle. O kadar mükemmel ki, sevincten aglayacak gibiyim! Fircanin abartili vuruslari bir tür mistik nitelik aktariyor... sanki o da bizimle birlikteymis gibi.

english: My father, 'e too waz ze critic of art...'e also saw ze poetry in ze painting. Zis reminds me of a verse 'e would read me - would you like to 'ear it?
translation: Babam da sanat elestirmeniydi... O da resimlerdeki siiri görürdü. Bu bana bana okudugu bir siiri hatirlatti - duymak ister misin?

english: Yes please.
Ahh, good. Zis verse is from a poem by a most talented writer of ze poetry, Charles Baudelaire. My father would place me on 'is knee and read to me like zis...
translation: Ahh, güzel. Bu siir, cok yetenekli bir sair olan Charles Baudelaire'in siirinden. Babam beni dizine oturtur ve bana söyle okurdu...

english: Je trône dans l'azur comme un sphinx incompris; J'unis un coeur de neige à la blancheur des cygnes; Je hais le mouvement qui déplace les lignes, Et jamais je ne pleure et jamais je ne ris.
translation: Je trône dans l'azur comme un sphinx incompris; J'unis un coeur de neige à la blancheur des cygnes; Je hais le mouvement qui déplace les lignes, Et jamais je ne pleure et jamais je ne ris.

english: That was nice, what did it mean?
Ahh yes, I forget, open ze ears and I shall tell [madame/monsieur].
translation: Ahh evet, unuttum, kulaklarinizi acin, size anlatayim.

english: Swan-white of heart, a sphinx no mortal knows, My throne is in the heaven's azure deep, I hate all movements that disturb my pose, I smile not ever, neither do I weep.
translation: Kugu beyazi bir kalp, ölümlülerin bilmedigi bir sfenks, Tahtim gökyüzünün masmavi derinliklerinde, Pozumu bozan tüm hareketlerden nefret ederim, Asla gülümsemem, aglamam da.

english: Wow.
That's powerful stuff...and yes, I see what you mean about the painting inspiring you to remember that poem...
translation: Bu cok etkileyici... ve evet, resmin size o siiri hatirlatmasi konusunda ne demek istediginizi anliyorum...

english: I am glad you enjoyed. Please, take ze time to appreciate ze Museum and ze wealth of information 'ere. Come visit me when I 'ave my own gallery!
translation: Begendigine sevindim. Lütfen, müzeyi ve buradaki zengin bilgiyi takdir etmek icin zaman ayir. Kendi galerim oldugunda beni ziyarete gel!

english: I still didn't like it.
Eet iz such a shame, but you must 'ave your own opinion, no? Feel free to look around ze Museum some more.
translation: Cok yazik, ama kendi fikrin olmali, degil mi? Müzeyi biraz daha gezmekten cekinme.

english: Beautiful.
Ahh yes, it eez. Feel free to look around ze Museum some more.
translation: Evet, öyle. Müzeyi biraz daha gezmekten cekinme.

english: I didn't like it, but I still like the painting.
translation: Begenmedim, ama yine de resmi seviyorum.

english: Ahh well, eet iz not for everyone but I am glad you like ze painting.
translation: Herkesin zevkine uygun olmayabilir, ama resmi begendigine sevindim.

english: No thanks.
Ahh well, eet iz not for everyone.
Who are you?
What do you do here?
Umm...it's a painting.
Yes, I see!
Yes please.
That was nice, what did it mean?
Wow!
I still didn't like it.
Beautiful.
I didn't like it, but I still like the painting.
translation: Begenmedim, ama yine de resmi begendim.

english: No thanks.
What can I do for you?
What are beginner clues?
Arthur's eyes light up.
Beginner clues are the lowest tier of clue scroll and as such only require a couple of steps to solve.
translation: Baslangic ipuclari, ipucu parsömenlerinin en düsük seviyesidir ve bu nedenle cözmek icin sadece birkac adim gerekir.

english: Beginner clues are gained through various activities. Those activities are as follows.
translation: Baslangic ipuclari cesitli etkinlikler yoluyla elde edilir. Bu etkinlikler sunlardir.

english: Slaying monsters for a chance at a clue being dropped. I hear goblins are sneaky, maybe they have some clue scrolls on them ripe for the taking.
translation: Canavarlari öldürerek ipucu elde etme sansi. Goblinlerin sinsi oldugunu duydum, belki üzerlerinde alinmaya hazir ipucu parsömenleri vardir.

english: Maybe someone left one in the cow field, who knows where you could obtain them.
translation: Belki biri inek tarlasinda bir tane birakmistir, kim bilir nereden elde edebilirsiniz.

english: Beginner clues have also been known to be left in geodes while mining, as well as sometimes in bottles that you may fish up from time to time and from nests which fall out of trees.
translation: Baslangic seviyesi ipuclarinin madencilik sirasinda jeotlarda birakildigi da bilinmektedir, ayrica bazen balik tutarken bulabileceginiz siselerde ve agaclardan düsen yuvalarda da bulunabilirler.

english: Although this is a much rarer occurrence.
translation: Ancak bu cok daha nadir bir durumdur.

english: Unlike more advanced clues, you should not expect to get very valuable items from completing a beginner clue.
translation: Daha ileri seviye ipuclarindan farkli olarak, baslangic seviyesi ipucunu tamamlayarak cok degerli esyalar elde etmeyi beklememelisiniz.

english: What are more advanced clues?
Advanced clues have tiers between easy and master.
translation: Ileri düzey ipuclari, kolay ve usta arasinda kademelere sahiptir.

english: You can gain advanced clues the same way you would get a beginner clue. But to get higher tier scrolls you will need to defeat more powerful foes.
translation: Ileri düzey ipuclarini, baslangic seviyesindeki ipuclarini elde ettiginiz sekilde elde edebilirsiniz. Ancak daha yüksek kademedeki parsömenleri elde etmek icin daha güclü düsmanlari yenmeniz gerekir.

english: The chance to get a higher tier clue from geodes, bottles and nests is lower the higher the tier. But if you chop down higher-level trees you will have a higher chance of receiving a nest which contains a clue. Same with fishing and mining.
translation: Jeotlardan, siselerden ve yuvalardan daha yüksek kademedeki ipuclarini elde etme sansi, kademe yükseldikce azalir. Ancak daha yüksek seviyeli agaclari keserseniz, ipucu iceren bir yuva elde etme sansiniz artar. Balik tutma ve madencilik icin de ayni sey gecerlidir.

english: The only exception to this is master clue scrolls.
translation: Bunun tek istisnasi usta ipucu parsömenleridir.

english: Master clues can only be obtained as a rare chance when opening your casket or by handing in one of every type of clue, apart from beginner, to Watson who resides in Hosidius.
translation: Usta ipuclari, tabutunuzu acarken nadiren elde edilebilir veya Hosidius'ta yasayan Watson'a baslangic seviyesi haric her tür ipucundan birer tane teslim ederek elde edilebilir.

english: But with more advanced tiers of clue, come better loot.
translation: Ancak daha ileri seviye ipuclari ile daha iyi ganimetler elde edersiniz.

english: This type of clue has you talk to someone around Gielinor. Although the clue does not tell you exactly who to talk to.
translation: Bu tür ipuclarinda Gielinor cevresinde biriyle konusmaniz gerekir. Ancak ipucu size tam olarak kiminle konusmaniz gerektigini söylemez.

english: You will see a couple of words that may or may not make sense together. You will have to rearrange the letter to make the name of the person you need to talk to.
translation: Birlikte anlamli olabilecek veya olmayabilecek birkac kelime göreceksiniz. Konusmaniz gereken kisinin adini olusturmak icin harfleri yeniden düzenlemeniz gerekecektir.

english: This type of clue has you work out a logical problem for the person you need to talk to. This type of challenge only appears in clue tiers medium, hard and elite.
translation: Bu tür ipuclarinda, konusmaniz gereken kisi icin mantiksal bir problemi cözmeniz gerekir. Bu tür zorluklar sadece orta, zor ve elit seviyedeki ipuclarinda görülür.

english: There are also challenges that will involve you gathering an item or crafting an item for a certain person.
translation: Ayrica, belirli bir kisi icin bir öge toplamanizi veya bir öge üretmenizi gerektiren zorluklar da vardir.

english: This type of clue has you talk to someone around Gielinor. Although the clue does not tell you exactly who to talk to. This type of challenge only appears in clue tiers medium, hard and elite.
translation: Bu tür ipuclarinda Gielinor cevresinde biriyle konusmaniz gerekir. Ancak ipucu, tam olarak kiminle konusmaniz gerektigini söylemez. Bu tür görevler sadece orta, zor ve elit ipucu seviyelerinde görünür.

english: A cipher is a string of letters that have been scrambled using the shift cipher method.
translation: Sifre, shift sifreleme yöntemi kullanilarak karistirilmis bir dizi harftir.

english: An example of this would be ZCZL which, shifted forward by one, would be Adam.
translation: Bunun bir örnegi, bir ileri kaydirildiginda Adam olan ZCZL'dir.

english: This type of clue will have you use a sextant, chart and a watch to find out the place you will need to dig. This type of challenge only appears in clue tiers medium and above.
translation: Bu tür ipuclarinda, kazmaniz gereken yeri bulmak icin sekstant, harita ve saat kullanmaniz gerekir. Bu tür görevler sadece orta ve üstü ipucu seviyelerinde görünür.

english: After you find the place you need to dig, you may find a casket or another scroll.
translation: Kazmaniz gereken yeri bulduktan sonra, bir tabut veya baska bir parsömen bulabilirsiniz.

english: This type of clue can be as simple as talk to the specified person or searching a crate in a specified location.
translation: Bu tür ipuclari, belirtilen kisiyle konusmak veya belirtilen bir yerde bir sandigi aramak kadar basit olabilir.

english: But the higher the tier of clue, the more steps you will have to do beforehand. An example of this would be needing to find a key before opening a chest.
translation: Ancak ipucu seviyesi ne kadar yüksekse, önceden yapmaniz gereken adimlar da o kadar fazla olur. Buna bir örnek, sandigi acmadan önce bir anahtar bulmaniz gerekmesidir.

english: This type of clue will give you a location that you will need to visit, along with some items you will need.
translation: Bu tür ipuclari, ziyaret etmeniz gereken bir yeri ve ihtiyaciniz olan bazi esyalari size verir.

english: At this location you will need to perform an emote, as well as wear the items that you had to bring along.
translation: Bu yerde, bir emote yapmaniz ve yaninizda getirmeniz gereken esyalari giymeniz gerekir.

english: Some clues may have you wear nothing at all.
translation: Bazi ipuclarinda hicbir sey giymenize gerek olmayabilir.

english: But please don't do that in public!
translation: Ancak lütfen bunu halka acik yerlerde yapmayin!

english: This type of challenge only appears in clue tiers medium and above.
translation: Bu tür görevler sadece orta ve üzeri seviyedeki ipuclarinda görünür.

english: Depending on the tier of clue, you will need to obtain a strange device from either Reldo, located in Varrock, or Jorral, located south of Tree Gnome Stronghold.
translation: Ipucunun seviyesine bagli olarak, Varrock'ta bulunan Reldo'dan veya Tree Gnome Stronghold'un güneyinde bulunan Jorral'dan garip bir cihaz almaniz gerekecektir.

english: You will then need to use this device to find the location you will need to dig.
translation: Daha sonra bu cihazi kullanarak kazmaniz gereken yeri bulmaniz gerekecektir.

english: There are many different puzzles that you can come across while doing clues. These range from light boxes to puzzle boxes.
translation: Ipuclarini cözerken karsilasabileceginiz bircok farkli bulmaca vardir. Bunlar isik kutularindan bulmaca kutularina kadar cesitlilik gösterir.

english: Puzzle boxes are puzzles that will have you complete a slider puzzle that, when complete, will look like an image in game.
translation: Bulmaca kutulari, tamamladiginizda oyundaki bir görüntüye benzeyen bir kaydirmali bulmaca tamamlamanizi gerektiren bulmacalardir.

english: Light boxes are a puzzle which contains a 5 by 5 grid of lights with some lights on and some lights off.
translation: Isik kutulari, bazi isiklari acik, bazi isiklari kapali olan 5 x 5'lik bir isik izgarasi iceren bulmacalardir.

english: The puzzle will have you click the buttons below to turn on or off some of the lights with the end goal being, having all the lights turned on.
translation: Bulmacada, tüm isiklari yakmak amaciyla asagidaki dügmelere tiklayarak bazi isiklari yakip söndürmeniz gerekir.

english: This type of clue will show you a map of an area.
translation: Bu tür ipuclari size bir bölgenin haritasini gösterir.

english: This map will show you where you will need to dig, or what you will need to search to get the next clue.
translation: Bu harita, kazmaniz gereken yeri veya bir sonraki ipucunu bulmak icin aramaniz gereken seyi gösterir.

english: This type of clue will show you which fairy ring code you will need to use to get to the right place to dig.
translation: Bu tür ipuclari, kazmak icin dogru yere ulasmak icin kullanmaniz gereken peri halkasi kodunu gösterir.

english: You will then need to use the numbers to figure our where you will need to dig after arriving to your destination.
translation: Daha sonra, varis noktaniza ulastiktan sonra kazmaniz gereken yeri bulmak icin bu sayilari kullanmaniz gerekecek.

english: Hey Arthur, can I stop receiving clues from vessels? They're clogging up my backpack!
translation: Hey Arthur, gemilerden gelen ipuclarini almayi durdurabilir miyim? Sirt cantami dolduruyorlar!

english: Vessel containers include mining geodes, fishing bottles and clue nests. Are you sure you want to stop receiving them?
translation: Gemi konteynerleri maden jeotlari, balikcilik siseleri ve ipucu yuvalarini icerir. Bunlari almayi durdurmak istediginizden emin misiniz?

english: Yes please, I want to stop receiving vesseled containers.
translation: Evet, lütfen, gemilerden gelen konteynerleri almayi durdurmak istiyorum.

english: Very well, you'll no longer find clues from mining, fishing and woodcutting.
translation: Peki, artik madencilik, balikcilik ve odun kesme ile ilgili ipuclari bulamayacaksin.

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: Hey Arthur, can I start receiving clues from vessels?
translation: Hey Arthur, gemilerden ipuclari almaya baslayabilir miyim?

english: Vessel containers include mining geodes, fishing bottles and clue nests. Are you sure you want to start receiving them, again?
translation: Gemi konteynerleri madencilik jeotlari, balikcilik siseleri ve ipucu yuvalarini icerir. Tekrar almaya baslamak istediginden emin misin?

english: Yes please, I want to start receiving vesseled containers.
translation: Evet, lütfen, gemilerden gelen konteynerleri almaya baslamak istiyorum.

english: Very well, you'll now find clues from mining, fishing and woodcutting.
translation: Peki, artik madencilik, balikcilik ve odun kesiminden ipuclari bulacaksin.

english: Goodbye.
So long and happy clue hunting!
translation: Hosca kal ve mutlu ipucu avlari!

english: I've got it!
I'm going to be rich!
Hmm.... What could this mean?
translation: Hmm... Bu ne anlama geliyor olabilir?

english: Why is this so hard...
Why did I not think of that before.
Ask about beginner clues.
Ask about more advanced clues.
translation: Daha ileri düzey ipuclari hakkinda sor.

english: Ask about the types of clues.
Anagrams.
Challenge scrolls.
Cipher clues.
Coordinate clues.
Cryptic clues.
Emote clues.
Hot Cold clues.
Puzzle clues.
Map clues.
Fairy ring clues.
Toggle gaining vesseled clue scrolls.
translation: Gemi ile gelen ipucu parsömenlerini almayi durdur.

english: Yes please, I want to stop receiving vesseled containers.
translation: Evet lütfen, gemi ile gelen konteynerleri almayi durdurmak istiyorum.

english: Nevermind.
Yes please, I want to start receiving vesseled containers
translation: Evet lütfen, gemi ile gelen konteynerleri almaya baslamak istiyorum.

english: Nilsal. Here to do some crafting? I've got some supplies that might help you if so.
translation: Nilsal. El isi yapmak icin mi geldin? Öyleyse sana yardimci olabilecek bazi malzemelerim var.

english: What do you have?
Have a look.
Just passing through, thanks.
Well come back if you change your mind.
What do you have?
Just passing through, thanks.
Greetings, friend; my business here deals with Hunter related items. Is there anything in which I can interest you?
translation: Merhaba dostum, burada avcilarla ilgili esyalar satiyorum. Ilgini cekecek bir sey var mi?

english: What kinds of items do you stock?
Take a look for yourself.
I'm not in the market for Hunter equipment right now, thanks.
translation: Su anda avci ekipmani almayacagim, tesekkürler.

english: Maybe another time, then.
What kinds of items do you stock?
I'm not in the market for Hunter equipment right now, thanks.
translation: Su anda avci ekipmani almayacagim, tesekkürler.

english: Hello again Artur.
Hello [player name]. Thanks for your help in recovering the Accord.
translation: Merhaba Maceraci. Anlasmayi kurtarmama yardim ettigin icin tesekkürler.

english: No problem.
Why is the Accord important?
The signing of the Accord marked the start of a golden age. Once the Royal Lords replaced the Council of Elders, Kourend prospered like never before.
translation: Anlasmanin imzalanmasi altin cagin baslangicini isaret etti. Kraliyet Lordlari Yaslilar Konseyi'nin yerini aldiginda, Kourend hic olmadigi kadar refah icindeydi.

english: But that was a long time ago. Why does it matter now?
translation: Ama bu cok uzun zaman önceydi. Simdi bunun ne önemi var?

english: Because I think it's time for another golden age. The Kourend Council, like the Council of Elders before them, have failed to do a good job in running this kingdom.
translation: Cünkü bence yeni bir altin cagin zamani geldi. Kourend Konseyi, tipki onlardan önceki Yaslilar Konseyi gibi, bu kralligi yönetme konusunda basarisiz oldu.

english: And you think the five houses would do a better job?
translation: Bes hanenin daha iyi bir is cikaracagini mi düsünüyorsun?

english: Exactly.
What makes you say the Council have done a bad job?
translation: Konseyin kötü bir is cikardigini neye dayanarak söylüyorsun?

english: More crime. Fewer homes. More illness. Loss of jobs. The list goes on.
translation: Suclar artti. Evler azaldi. Hastaliklar artti. Isler kaybedildi. Liste uzayip gidiyor.

english: But aren't the five houses partially to blame as well? They rule the cities.
translation: Ama bes hanenin de kismen sucu yok mu? Sehirleri onlar yönetiyor.

english: The Council sets the laws and the Council sets the budgets. We have to do as they say, just like everyone else.
translation: Konsey kanunlari koyar ve bütceyi belirler. Biz de herkes gibi onlarin dediklerini yapmak zorundayiz.

english: Hmmm, fair enough. Anyway, we'd better get off.
Fair enough. See you later.
Goodbye.
Hello there Artur. Actually... I guess I should say Your Majesty now.
translation: Merhaba Artur. Aslinda... Sanirim artik Majesteleri demeliyim.

english: For you friend, Artur is fine.
You should not dispense formalities Artur. A king should command respect.
translation: Resmiyetten vazgecmemelisin Artur. Bir kral saygi görmelidir.

english: I can command respect without using fancy titles, mother.
translation: Süslü unvanlar kullanmadan da saygi görebilirim anne.

english: So, how are you doing.
I have a lot of responsibility now. There's much to learn and not much time to learn it in. The loss of father still weighs heavily on me as well.
translation: Su anda cok fazla sorumlulugum var. Ögrenmem gereken cok sey var ama ögrenmek icin fazla zamanim yok. Babamin kaybi da hala üzerimde büyük bir yük olusturuyor.

english: Still, I am well supported by those around me. I'm sure that with their help, I can be the ruler the people deserve.
translation: Yine de cevremdekiler bana büyük destek oluyorlar. Onlarin yardimiyla halkin hak ettigi bir hükümdar olabilecegime eminim.

english: I'm sure you can as well. Anyway, I'll let you get on with you work.
translation: Eminim olabilirsin. Neyse, isine devam et.

english: Until next time
Why is the Accord important?
What makes you say the council have done a bad job?
translation: Konseyin kötü is cikardigini düsündüren nedir?

english: Fair enough. See you later.
Goodbye.
Good day traveller. You are far from home, what brings you here?
translation: Iyi günler gezgin. Evinden uzaktasin, seni buraya ne getirdi?

english: I am a wandering hero, I come here in search of adventure.
translation: Ben gezgin bir kahramanim, macera aramak icin buraya geldim.

english: Sounds ghastly, I just want to live in peace.
translation: Kulaga korkunc geliyor, ben sadece huzur icinde yasamak istiyorum.

english: Unfortunately without people like me, peace doesn't last for long.
translation: Maalesef benim gibi insanlar olmadan baris uzun sürmez.

english: True, but then again most adventurers cause as much trouble as they put right.
translation: Dogru, ama cogu maceraci düzelttikleri kadar sorun da yaratirlar.

english: You've got a point there... Hmm...
Well, good day traveller. And always do the right thing.
translation: Peki, iyi günler gezgin. Ve her zaman dogru olani yap.

english: Good day traveller.
Hi there, how's it going?
Well we're still alive, after all that's happened, we should be thankful of that.
translation: Hala hayattayiz, olan onca seyden sonra bunun icin sükretmeliyiz.

english: Hopefully this war is over soon.
Indeed, but how many more need to die before that happens?
translation: Elbette, ama bunun icin daha kac kisinin ölmesi gerekiyor?

english: What do you think you're doing?
Hello there.
He seems to be lost in his own thoughts...
Howdy stranger. What brings you out to these parts?
translation: Selam yabanci. Seni buraya ne getirdi?

english: Nothing much - What are you doing here? It doesn't seem like there's much to do out here in the desert!
translation: Önemli bir sey yok. Sen burada ne yapiyorsun? Cölde yapacak pek bir sey yok gibi görünüyor!

english: Well, that's where you'd be wrong. I work for the Archaeological Society of Varrock, and have been excavating around here recently.
translation: Aslinda, yaniliyorsun. Varrock Arkeoloji Dernegi icin calisiyorum ve son zamanlarda bu civarda kazi yapiyorum.

english: Was there something you specifically wanted?
translation: Özellikle istedigin bir sey var mi?

english: (shows other options)
Do you have any quests? Call it a hunch, but you look like the type of man who might...
translation: Herhangi bir görevin var mi? Bir önsezi ama sen öyle bir adama benziyorsun...

english: Well, it's funny you should say that. I'm not sure if I would really call it a quest as such, but I found this ancient stone tablet in one of my excavations, and it would really help me out if you
translation: Bunu söylemen ilginc. Buna görev denebilir mi bilmiyorum ama kazilarimdan birinde bu eski tas tableti buldum ve sen onu kazi alanina götürüp inceletirsen bana cok yardimci olursun.

english: could go and take it back to the digsite for me and get it examined.
translation: Cok eski ve üzerindeki yazilari taniyamiyorum.

english: It's very old, and I don't recognise any of the inscriptions on it.
translation: Tabii, zaten o tarafa gidiyordum. Kazi alaninda konusmam gereken belirli biri var mi?

english: Sure, I was heading that way anyway. Any particular person at the digsite you want me to talk to?
translation: Tabii, zaten o tarafa gidiyordum. Kazi alaninda konusmam gereken belirli bir kisi var mi?

english: His name's Terry Balando. Give it to nobody but him. I'm sorry, I can't entrust you with the actual tablet I found, it is far too valuable to give away, but I took these etchings - they should be enough for him to make
translation: Adi Terry Balando. Kimseye vermeyin, sadece ona verin. Üzgünüm, buldugum tableti size emanet edemem, cok degerli oldugu icin baskasina veremem, ama bu gravürleri aldim, onun

english: a preliminary translation on. Come back and let me know what he says, I would hate to waste my time excavating anything that isn't worth my time as a world famous archaeologist!
translation: ön ceviri yapmasi icin yeterli olacaktir. Geri gelip bana ne dedigini söyle, dünyaca ünlü bir arkeolog olarak zamanimi degersiz seyleri kazarak harcamak istemem!

english: No thanks. Playing delivery boy doesn't really sound much like fun to me.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler. Kurye olmak bana pek eglenceli gelmiyor.

english: Well, okay. Can't say as I blame you for thinking that. I'll go take it there myself later I guess.
translation: Peki, tamam. Böyle düsündügün icin seni suclayamam. Sanirim daha sonra kendim götürecegim.

english: Who are you, anyway?
You don't recognise me??? I am the world famous Asgarnia Smith, Archaeologist extraordinaire!
translation: Beni tanimadin mi??? Ben dünyaca ünlü Asgarnia Smith, olaganüstü arkeolog!

english: I am the one who discovered the long forgotten Temple of Ikov! The one who unearthed the strange trap filled arena in Brimhaven!
translation: Uzun zamandir unutulmus Ikov Tapinagi'ni kesfeden benim! Brimhaven'daki tuhaf tuzaklarla dolu arenayi ortaya cikaran benim!

english: I'm the leading archaeological expert of our time! I was voted archaeologist of the year four years running by the Varrock Herald! Are you REALLY sure you've never heard of me?
translation: Cagimizin önde gelen arkeoloji uzmani benim! Varrock Herald tarafindan dört yil üst üste yilin arkeologu secildim! Beni gercekten hic duymadin mi?

english: No, I really haven't.
Well then, I'm confused. Why did you come over and speak to me if you don't know who I am? What do you want?
translation: O zaman kafam karisti. Kim oldugumu bilmiyorsan neden gelip benimle konustun? Ne istiyorsun?

english: Nothing really. I'm just wandering around for no good reason.
translation: Hicbir sey. Sadece sebepsiz yere dolasiyorum.

english: Uh-huh. Well, if you'll excuse me, I have a lot more work to do before I can bed down for the night.
translation: Anladim. Pardon ama, yatmadan önce yapmam gereken cok is var.

english: So what did Terry Balando say about those etchings? Did he give you a translation for me?
translation: Terry Balando o gravürler hakkinda ne dedi? Bana cevirisini verdi mi?

english: Um... yeah... about that... I kind of didn't go and speak to him yet...
translation: Sey... evet... o konuda... henüz onunla konusmadim...

english: Well what are you waiting for? A written invitation? All I want you to do is take those etchings up to the digsite for me!
translation: Ne bekliyorsun? Yazili bir davet mi? Senden tek istedigim o gravürleri benim icin kazi alanina götürmen!

english: Okay, I'll do that then.
Um... yeah... about that... I kind of lost those etchings you gave me...
translation: Sey... evet... o konuda... bana verdigin gravürleri kaybettim...

english: Well how in the world did you do that? (sigh) Okay, I'll make another set, but try not to lose these ones this time!
translation: Nasil yaparsin bunu? (ic cekis) Tamam, baska bir set yaparim, ama bu sefer kaybetmemeye calis!

english: Yeah, he did. But I don't have it with me.
I see.
Well could you go and get me that translation? It could be vital!
translation: O ceviriyi getirir misin? Cok önemli olabilir!

english: Yeah, he did. I have it here in this book.
Did you take a read of this? It will do you good to understand how this profession works. Here, have a read.
translation: Bunu okudun mu? Bu meslegin nasil isledigini anlaman icin faydali olacaktir. Al, oku.

english: (the book opens up)
Yeah, I did. Kind of boring really.
Excellent. Just give me a moment to read this, and talk to me again in a second.
translation: Harika. Bana bunu okumam icin biraz zaman ver, sonra tekrar konusalim.

english: Hmmm. Interesting. It seems to me like there's some kind of treasure hidden out in the desert.
translation: Hmmm. Ilginc. Bana göre cölde bir tür hazine sakli gibi görünüyor.

english: So what do you say? Fancy being a treasure hunter like me?
translation: Ne dersin? Benim gibi bir hazine avcisi olmak ister misin?

english: Uh... don't you mean archaeologist?
Yeeees... An archaeologist...
It's all this hot sun getting to me I think.
translation: Sanirim bu sicak günes beni etkiliyor.

english: Well anyway, let's just assume there is a treasure hidden in the desert somewhere, and let's just say for the sake of argument that maybe if I found a big stash of gold and treasure I wouldn't necessarily just hand it
translation: Neyse, cölde bir yerde bir hazine sakli oldugunu varsayalim ve tartisma icin, büyük bir altin ve hazine bulsam, bunlari mutlaka

english: all over to the Museum of Varrock.

Let's also say, purely hypothetically, that if there were such a big stash of treasure and someone were to help me find it, then that hypothetical person might be entitled to, oh, let's say a purely for the sake of
translation: Ayrica, tamamen varsayimsal olarak, böyle büyük bir hazine yigini olsaydi ve biri onu bulmama yardim etseydi, o varsayimsal kisi, diyelim ki, tamamen tartisma amaciyla

english: argument thirty percent split...
translation: yüzde otuz pay almaya hak kazanabilirdi...

english: Fifty percent.
That's right!
A purely for the sake of argument fifty-fifty split on this hypothetical treasure, should it exist...
translation: Tamamen tartisma amaciyla, bu varsayimsal hazine varsa, yüzde elli-elli paylasim...

english: Do you see where I'm going with this?

You want me to help you find some treasure for a fifty percent share, as long as I don't tell anybody, and your reputation as an esteemed archaeologist with the Museum of Varrock remains intact, and nobody
translation: Kimseye söylememem ve Varrock Müzesi'nde saygin bir arkeolog olarak ünümün zarar görmemesi ve kimsenin

english: discovers you're actually just a treasure hunter?
translation: aslinda sadece bir hazine avcisi oldugunu kesfetmemesi sartiyla, yüzde elli pay karsiliginda hazineyi bulmana yardim etmemi istiyorsun?

english: Uh... yes, but the way you said it makes it sound like I'm doing something wrong...
translation: Uh... evet, ama bunu söyleme seklin sanki yanlis bir sey yapiyormusum gibi geliyor...

english: So what do you say? Partners?
Well... I guess nobody is really going to lose out on anything, and we don't even know if there is any treasure...
translation: Sey... Sanirim kimse bir sey kaybetmeyecek ve hazinenin varligindan bile emin degiliz...

english: Aw, go on then. Count me in.
translation: Tamam, hadi bakalim. Ben de varim.

english: That's what I like to hear! Now, if we split up we'll be able to find treasure quicker.
translation: Duymak istedigim de buydu! Simdi, ayrilirsak hazineyi daha cabuk bulabiliriz.

english: I'll continue searching around here in this Bedabin Camp, you head due South to the Bandit Village. If either of us find anything, we'll come find each other and say what, okay?
translation: Ben bu Bedabin Kampi'nda aramaya devam edecegim, sen de güneye, Haydut Köyü'ne git. Birimiz bir sey bulursa, birbirimizi bulup haber veririz, tamam mi?

english: You head due South, see what you can find out about this tablet.
translation: Sen güneye git, bu tablet hakkinda ne bulabilecegine bak.

english: This all sounds very immoral, and I don't want any part of your seedy little schemes.
translation: Bu cok ahlaksizca geliyor ve senin kücük planlarina dahil olmak istemiyorum.

english: Aw, c'mon, cut me a break here! Look, nobody is really getting hurt, right? This treasure is either going to lie around in some underground ruin, or lie around in some museum for
translation: Hadi ama, bana bir sans ver! Bak, kimse zarar görmüyor, degil mi? Bu hazine ya bir yeralti harabesinde ya da bir müzede

english: people to look at!
It makes sense for the people to go to all the risk to get a little payback for it, right? Besides, anything of real historical value we can hand over to the museum - we'll just keep the cash for
translation: Insanlarin biraz para kazanmak icin tüm bu riski almasi mantikli, degil mi? Ayrica, gercek tarihi degeri olan her seyi müzeye teslim edebiliriz, parayi da

english: ourselves!
C'mon... what do you say? Partners?
translation: Hadi... ne dersin? Ortak olalim mi?

english: (presumably the same as the previous help him text)
I don't trust anything about your little scheme, including you! I want nothing to do with this!
translation: Senin kücük planinin hicbir kismina güvenmiyorum, sana da! Bununla hicbir ilgim olsun istemiyorum!

english: Eh, you'll come running back when you realise just how much money we could be talking here.
translation: Eh, burada ne kadar paradan bahsettigimizi anladiginda kosarak geri geleceksin.

english: I'll see you again when you come crawling back, begging to be cut in on the deal.
translation: Geri dönüp anlasmaya dahil olmak icin yalvarirken tekrar görüsürüz.

english: Hello again. You find any signs of that treasure yet?
translation: Merhaba tekrar. Hazineyle ilgili herhangi bir iz buldun mu?

english: Not yet...
Well, head south to that bandit camp. I bet if there's anything out here, they'll know about it.
translation: Güneydeki haydut kampina git. Eger burada bir sey varsa, onlar mutlaka biliyordur.

english: Don't let on it might be valuable though! Those thieves will steal it as soon as look at you!
translation: Degerli olabilecegini belli etme! O hirsizlar seni görür görmez calacaklardir!

english: Well... not as such, but I unleashed a powerful demon from its tomb in return for unbelievable magical power.
translation: Sey... tam olarak öyle degil, ama inanilmaz bir sihirli güc karsiliginda mezarindan güclü bir iblisi serbest biraktim.

english: So... no gold then?
Not as such, no. Sorry about that.
translation: Tam olarak öyle degil, hayir. Üzgünüm.

english: Aw... I was hoping to go abroad on holiday this year.
translation: Ah... Bu yil tatil icin yurt disina cikmayi umuyordum.

english: Maybe I'll go check out Karamja next, I hear there's treasure to be found there...
translation: Belki de Karamja'ya giderim, orada hazine oldugunu duydum...

english: I was wondering...
As you are a big famous archaeologist, maybe you could spare the time to tell me a couple of tales of your exploits?
translation: Sen ünlü bir arkeolog olduguna göre, bana maceralarindan birkacini anlatabilir misin?

english: Hey, sure thing kid! Well, this one time I found this spooky old temple in the middle of the jungle.
translation: Tabii ki, evlat! Bir keresinde ormanin ortasinda ürkütücü bir tapinak buldum.

english: The entrance was hidden from sight by all these vines and stuff, and it was full of zombies and crazy tribesmen and stuff.
translation: Giris, sarmasiklar ve diger bitkilerle gizlenmisti ve icerisi zombiler, cilgin kabile üyeleri ve benzeri seylerle doluydu.

english: That wasn't the worst thing though! There were all these crazy traps that were hidden around the place too!
translation: Ama en kötüsü bu degildi! Etrafta gizlenmis bir sürü cilgin tuzak da vardi!

english: Well anyway, I found the secret entrance, fought my way in through the zombies and tribesmen, and came to a big pedestal with a statue of solid gold sat on top of it!
translation: Neyse, gizli girisi buldum, zombiler ve kabile üyeleriyle savasarak iceri girdim ve üstünde saf altindan bir heykelin durdugu büyük bir kaideye ulastim!

english: Solid gold, huh? Wow.
That's right! It was a cunning trap though! As soon as I picked up the statue, a trapdoor opened up underneath me, and I fell into a darkened room, full of
translation: Aynen öyle! Ama bu kurnaz bir tuzakti! Heykeli kaldirir kaldirmaz, altimda bir tuzak kapisi acildi ve ben karanlik bir odaya düstüm. Oda kemiklerle doluydu ve

english: bones, and the biggest meanest tribesman you ever did see!
translation: gördügün en büyük ve en kötü kabile üyesi oradaydi!

english: Huge he was, and real ugly looking! He had this huge sword too, and he came running towards me screaming something in some language I didn't understand!
translation: Devasa ve cok cirkin biriydi! Kocaman bir kilici vardi ve anlamadigim bir dilde bir seyler bagirarak bana dogru kosmaya basladi!

english: What did you do?
Well, while he was screaming at me, and swinging his sword around in front of me, trying to intimidate me before attacking, I cooly and calmly...
translation: O bana bagirip, saldirmadan önce beni korkutmak icin kilicini sallarken, ben sogukkanlilikla ve sakin bir sekilde...

english: Yes?
All the while, knowing that if I died in this spot nobody would even know where I was...
translation: Bu sirada, bu noktada ölürsem kimsenin nerede oldugumu bile bilmeyecegini biliyordum...

english: What then?
I knew, if this tribesman killed me, that would be the end of Asgarnia Smith, and all of his treasure hunting...
translation: Bu kabile üyesi beni öldürürse, Asgarnia Smith'in ve tüm hazine avciliginin sonu olacagini biliyordum...

english: SO WHAT DID YOU DO?!?!
Well, while he was screaming and waving his sword around, I stood behind a nearby stalactite, then shot him with my shortbow.
translation: O bana bagirip kilicini sallarken, ben yakindaki bir sarkitin arkasina saklandim ve kisa yayimla ona ates ettim.

english: And that was how I recovered the Golden Monkey of Tee-Ta-Toh.
translation: Ve böylece Tee-Ta-Toh'un Altin Maymununu geri aldim.

english: So... How exactly did you get into this line of work anyway?
It seems an odd choice of career for a man like yourself.
translation: Senin gibi bir adam icin garip bir kariyer secimi gibi görünüyor.

english: Thinking of joining your pal Asgarnia in the wonderful world of treasure hun- um, archaeology, huh?
translation: Arkadasin Asgarnia'nin harika hazine avciligi dünyasina katilmayi mi düsünüyorsun... yani arkeolojiye mi?

english: Well, it all started the day I was fishing in catherby, funnily enough.
translation: Aslinda, her sey Catherby'de balik tutarken basladi, ne garip.

english: Ah yes, I remember it well... I was just sat there, hoping to catch a bass or two, when I made the most amazing discovery!
translation: Evet, cok iyi hatirliyorum... Orada oturmus, bir iki levrek tutmayi umarken, inanilmaz bir kesif yaptim!

english: In my fishing nets, I had found an ancient casket, marred and worn by centuries underwater!
translation: Balik aglarimda, yüzyillar boyunca su altinda kalarak yipranmis ve asinmis eski bir tabut buldum!

english: With trembling hands, I slowly and cautiously opened it, wondering what ancient secret may have been kept inside...
translation: Titrek ellerimle, icinde ne tür eski sirlar sakli oldugunu merak ederek, yavasca ve dikkatlice actim...

english: What valuable heirloom may have been dredged up by my nets that had not decayed underwater long ago...
translation: Aglarimla, uzun zaman önce su altinda cürümemis degerli bir aile yadigari cikmis olabilirdi...

english: And you know what I found inside?
translation: Ve icinde ne buldum biliyor musun?

english: No, what?
I found 320 coins! Just like that! Just by fishing I had found 320 coins! 320 coins! Can you believe it?
translation: 320 sikke buldum! Aynen öyle! Sadece balik tutarken 320 sikke buldum! 320 sikke! Inanabiliyor musun?

english: Um... Yes, yes I can.
Well, it might not seem much to us now kid, but back then, it was a revelation!
translation: Sey, simdi bize cok fazla gelmeyebilir cocuk, ama o zamanlar bu bir kesifti!

english: Why waste my time fishing when there were secret treasures from long ago hidden around the world?
translation: Dünyanin dört bir yaninda uzun zaman önce saklanmis gizli hazineler varken neden balik tutarak zamanimi bosa harcayayim ki?

english: I immediately applied to the Museum of Varrock as a field agent, and the rest is history!
translation: Hemen Varrock Müzesi'ne saha ajani olarak basvurdum ve gerisi tarih oldu!

english: Nice hat!
Hey, thanks kid. Looking snazzy is an important part of being a treasure hunter!
translation: Hey, tesekkürler cocuk. Sik görünmek hazine avcisi olmanin önemli bir parcasidir!

english: Well, I'll see you again sometime maybe. Sorry I couldn't get you any treasure...
translation: Belki bir ara tekrar görüsürüz. Sana hazine bulamadigim icin üzgünüm...

english: Ah, don't sweat it kid. I'll be honest with ya - I'm already rich many times over, and its more the kicks of being a treasure hunter I do it for than the actual cash!
translation: Ah, takma kafana cocuk. Dürüst olacagim, ben zaten cok zenginim ve hazine avcisi olmanin verdigi heyecan icin yapiyorum bunu, para icin degil!

english: What are you doing here?
Do you have any quests?
Yes.
No.
Who are you?
Nothing really.
Read book
Don't read book
Help him
Don't help him
Tell me of your adventures
Tell me how you became an Archaeologist
Nice hat!
See you later...
Dung cook human.
Ash eat human.
Dung will fry human.
Dung is wrong!
My brother in stronghold best cook.
Ash will boil human 'till it tender.
Much more tasty.
Ash will not cook human!
Ash will boil!
Dung will boil Ash's head!
Boil better!
Fry better!
Boil!
Fry!
Ow!
Ugh!
Dung not hit Ash!
Ow!
Ouch!
Dung hate Ash!
Ash hate Dung!
Excuse me...
What is it?
Thank you for finding my tools for me. Did you find everyone's belongings?
translation: Aletlerimi buldugunuz icin tesekkür ederim. Herkesin esyalarini buldunuz mu?

english: I did! Thank you for the reward.
You're more than welcome to it, for getting our belongings back.
translation: Esyalarimizi geri getirdiginiz icin rica ederim.

english: Can you tell me how the kingdom approves of me?
translation: Kralligin beni nasil onayladigini söyleyebilir misiniz?

english: [amount]% of people approve of you.
Hello? Who are you? What is this place?
I'm... Ashuelot... Ashuelot Reis. But I don't understand... How are you here?
translation: Ben... Ashuelot... Ashuelot Reis. Ama anlamiyorum... Sen nasil buradasin?

english: Oh... Well I'm [player name], and I'm here because I was told there was a great treasure to be found.
translation: Oh... Ben Maceraci ve burada büyük bir hazine oldugunu duydugum icin buradayim.

english: Treasure? I fear you have been misled. There is no treasure here, only our great mistake.
translation: Hazine mi? Korkarim yanlis bilgilendirilmissin. Burada hazine yok, sadece bizim büyük hatamiz var.

english: Mistake?
This place is a prison. Here, a being of incomprehensible power was sealed away. Things would have stayed that way, if not for our foolishness.
translation: Burasi bir hapishane. Burada, anlasilmaz bir güce sahip bir varlik hapsedilmisti. Bizim aptalligimiz olmasaydi, her sey oldugu gibi kalacakti.

english: What happened?
We thought we were doing good, but we were led astray. We opened the prison, and unleashed the horror within.
translation: Iyi bir sey yaptigimizi sandik, ama yanlis yola saptik. Hapishaneyi actik ve icindeki dehseti serbest biraktik.

english: But the door was locked until I came along.
translation: Ama ben gelene kadar kapi kilitliydi.

english: Yes... After our great mistake, four opposing armies united to contain the evil again. They managed to reseal the prison, but they were unable to repair the original enchantments.
translation: Evet... Büyük hatamizdan sonra, dört düsman ordu birleserek kötülügü tekrar hapsetmeye calisti. Hapishaneyi yeniden mühürlemeyi basardilar, ama orijinal büyüyü onaramadilar.

english: This place has remained vulnerable ever since.
translation: O zamandan beri bu yer savunmasiz kaldi.

english: And now I've opened it again.
translation: Ve simdi ben onu tekrar actim.

english: If what you've told me is true, you were fooled just as we were. But I suppose that means little now. With the prison now open again, there isn't much to prevent the evil escaping once more.
translation: Bana anlattiklarin dogruysa, sen de bizim gibi kandirildin. Ama sanirim bunun artik bir önemi yok. Hapishane tekrar acildigina göre, kötülügün bir kez daha kacmasini engelleyecek pek bir sey yok.

english: There must be something I can do to stop it.
translation: Bunu durdurmak icin yapabilecegim bir sey olmali.

english: There is only one thing you can do. You can fight.
translation: Yapabilecegin tek bir sey var. Savasabilirsin.

english: Then that is what I will do.
Though, now that I think about it, I'm still not overly clear what this evil is.
translation: Ama simdi düsündüm de, bu kötülügün ne oldugunu hala tam olarak anlamis degilim.

english: She is a being of darkness. A servant of the Ruinous Powers. She is the Angel of Death. She is Nex.
translation: O karanligin varligidir. Yikici Güclerin hizmetkaridir. O Ölüm Melegidir. O Nex'tir.

english: I'll stop her.
I hope so. Nex can be found in the inner section of the prison. Join me there. But be warned, Nex was not imprisoned alone. You'll need to fight through her followers to reach her.
translation: Umarim öyle olur. Nex hapishanenin ic bölümünde bulunabilir. Bana orada katil. Ama dikkatli ol, Nex tek basina hapsedilmedi. Ona ulasmak icin takipcileriyle savasman gerekecek.

english: Good luck.
You made it?
You didn't think I would?
Nex's followers are capable of bringing down even the strongest of warriors. I did fear you might not make it past them.
translation: Nex'in takipcileri en güclü savascilari bile alt edebilir. Onlari gecemeyeceginden korktum.

english: Still, they are nothing compared to the Angel of Death herself.
translation: Yine de, Ölüm Melegi'nin kendisiyle karsilastirildiginda onlar hicbir sey.

english: So how do I deal with her?
You will never be able to truly defeat her. The best you can do is to try and keep her contained. When you are ready to face her, just go through the barrier.
translation: Onu asla gercekten yenemezsin. Yapabilecegin en iyi sey, onu kontrol altinda tutmaya calismak. Onunla yüzlesmeye hazir oldugunda, bariyeri gec.

english: If it helps, while my magic is limited here, I should still be able to transfer items in and out of the prison for you. Let me know if you'd like me to do this before you enter.
translation: Yardimi olacaksa, burada büyüm sinirli olsa da, hapishaneye esya sokup cikarmaya devam edebilirim. Girmeden önce bunu yapmami istersen bana haber ver.

english: Tell me more about Nex.
translation: Nex hakkinda daha fazla bilgi ver.

english: Long ago, these lands were dominated by a great empire, ruled over by an ancient god. The Empty Lord is what they often called him, but his true name was Zaros.
translation: Uzun zaman önce, bu topraklar eski bir tanrinin hüküm sürdügü büyük bir imparatorluk tarafindan yönetiliyordu. Ona genellikle Bos Lord derlerdi, ama gercek adi Zaros'tu.

english: Zaros? I've heard of him.
At the height of his power, Zaros seemed untouchable, but he was eventually defeated by those he trusted the most. With him gone, the empire collapsed. War broke out soon after.
translation: Gücünün zirvesindeyken Zaros dokunulmaz görünüyordu, ama sonunda en güvendigi kisiler tarafindan yenildi. O öldükten sonra imparatorluk cöktü. Kisa süre sonra savas cikti.

english: Although their god was gone, many Zarosians fought to keep his empire alive. Among them was Nex. She was Zaros' most powerful weapon, and she led a great army to try and restore his empire.
translation: Tanrilari ölmüs olmasina ragmen, bircok Zaroslu imparatorlugu ayakta tutmak icin savasti. Bunlarin arasinda Nex de vardi. O, Zaros'un en güclü silahiydi ve imparatorlugunu yeniden kurmak icin büyük bir orduya komuta etti.

english: Not that she needed an army of course. Nex alone was powerful enough to hold back hundreds of lesser beings.
translation: Tabii ki bir orduya ihtiyaci yoktu. Nex tek basina yüzlerce zayif varligi geri püskürtecek kadar güclüydü.

english: So how did she end up here?
The forces of Saradomin knew that Nex needed to be dealt with. They were able to lure her into these caverns.
translation: Saradomin'in gücleri, Nex'in ortadan kaldirilmasi gerektigini biliyordu. Onu bu magaralara cekmeyi basardilar.

english: After great effort and sacrifice, they managed to place Nex and her followers into a frozen, enchanted sleep.
translation: Büyük caba ve fedakarliklar sonucunda, Nex ve takipcilerini donmus, büyülü bir uykuya daldirmayi basardilar.

english: Once Nex was no longer an immediate threat, they built the Temple of Lost Ancients around her. Most of the temple has since fallen to ruin, but you can still see some of the remains.
translation: Nex artik acil bir tehdit olusturmadiginda, onun etrafina Kayip Kadimlerin Tapinagi'ni insa ettiler. Tapinagin cogu artik harabeye dönmüs durumda, ancak bazi kalintilari hala görebilirsiniz.

english: But she wasn't frozen forever, was she? You said you were fooled into freeing her.
translation: Ama o sonsuza kadar donmus kalmadi, degil mi? Onu serbest birakmak icin kandirildiginizi söylediniz.

english: Yes. Later in the war, a great battle broke out in the Temple of Lost Ancients. I was a Saradominist soldier at the time, and I was among those who fought for him in that battle.
translation: Evet. Savasin ilerleyen dönemlerinde, Kayip Kadimlerin Tapinagi'nda büyük bir savas cikti. O zamanlar ben bir Saradominist askerdim ve o savasta onun icin savasanlardan biriydim.

english: By then, many of us had grown tired of war. One of our priests discovered this. He came to us and revealed that he felt the same way, and that he had secretly converted to Guthix. He encouraged us to join him.
translation: O zamana kadar cogumuz savastan bikmistik. Rahiplerimizden biri bunu fark etti. Bize gelip ayni sekilde hissettigini ve gizlice Guthix'e döndügünü acikladi. Bizi de ona katilmaya tesvik etti.

english: We abandoned the cause of Saradomin and became followers of Guthix. Our new leader taught us the ways of the druids, including an ancient ritual that had the power to awaken Guthix himself.
translation: Saradomin'in davasini terk edip Guthix'in takipcileri olduk. Yeni liderimiz bize druidlerin yollarini ögretti, Guthix'i uyandirma gücüne sahip eski bir ritüel de dahil.

english: We believed this ritual to be the only way to end the war.
translation: Bu ritüelin savasi sona erdirmenin tek yolu olduguna inaniyorduk.

english: But I'm guessing that's not how things went?
translation: Ama sanirim isler öyle gitmedi, degil mi?

english: No... When our leader led us to perform the ritual, it was not Guthix we woke, but Nex and her forces. The ritual also destroyed the protective enchantments on their prison.
translation: Hayir... Liderimiz bizi ritüeli gerceklestirmeye yönlendirdiginde, uyandirdigimiz Guthix degil, Nex ve ordusu oldu. Ritüel ayrica hapishanelerinin koruyucu büyülerini de yok etti.

english: And that was exactly what your leader wanted?
translation: Ve bu tam da liderinizin istedigi sey miydi?

english: It was. He had never been a follower of Guthix, or Saradomin. His real goal had always been to free Nex.
translation: Öyleydi. O hicbir zaman Guthix'in ya da Saradomin'in takipcisi olmamisti. Onun asil amaci her zaman Nex'i özgürlestirmekti.

english: The rest is as I already told you. Nex posed such a danger, that the four armies temorarily joined forces to drive her back into the prison. They resealed it, but were unable to fix the enchantments we destroyed.
translation: Gerisi size anlattigim gibi. Nex o kadar büyük bir tehlike olusturuyordu ki, dört ordu gecici olarak güclerini birlestirerek onu hapishaneye geri sürdü. Hapishaneyi yeniden mühürlediler, ama bizim yok ettigimiz büyüyü düzeltemediler.

english: As for me, I was one of the first to fall after Nex was freed, but I didn't truly die. Something about our ritual tied me to this place. I've been trapped here ever since. Not dead, but not really alive either.
translation: Bana gelince, Nex özgürlestirildikten sonra ilk düsenlerden biriydim, ama gercekten ölmedim. Ritüelimizle ilgili bir sey beni buraya bagladi. O zamandan beri burada mahsur kaldim. Ölü degilim, ama gercekten de canli sayilmam.

english: I'm sorry.
Don't be. This is the punishment for my sins.
What of the one that led the ritual. What came of him?
translation: Ritüeli yöneten kisi ne oldu? Ona ne oldu?

english: He'd achieved his goal, so he left. I never saw him again.
translation: Hedefine ulastigi icin gitti. Onu bir daha hic görmedim.

english: But who was he really?
He never gave us his true name, but as Nex was freed, she spoke to him.
translation: Bize gercek adini hic söylemedi, ama Nex serbest birakildiginda onunla konustu.

english: She knew him?
It seemed that way. I heard little of what they said, but I did hear what she called him.
translation: Öyle görünüyordu. Konusmalarinin cogunu duymadim, ama ona ne dedigini duydum.

english: What was it?
Sliske.
Forgive me, but this conversation has brought back many memories. Let us speak no more of this.
translation: Affet beni, ama bu konusma bircok aniyi geri getirdi. Artik bu konuyu konusmayalim.

english: Of course.
Can I access my bank?
Of course.
I'd like to collect some items.
I need to go.
Good luck out there.
Tell me more about Nex.
translation: Nex hakkinda daha fazla bilgi ver.

english: Can I access my bank?
I'd like to collect some items.
I need to go.
Hello there.
Hey there, buddy. You're an outerlander, huh? I'm not really supposed to talk to you.
translation: Selam dostum. Sen bir yabanciymissin, ha? Seninle konusmamam gerekiyor.

english: Why not?
I dunno buddy. Some stupid tradition or other. We're always told not to talk to outerlanders unless the Chieftain has allowed it.
translation: Bilmiyorum dostum. Aptalca bir gelenek falan. Sef izin vermedikce yabancilarla konusmamamiz söylenir.

english: The Chieftain? Who is that?
His names Brundt, buddy. He's a real boring guy. You can find him in the longhall there.
translation: Adi Brundt, dostum. Cok sikici bir adamdir. Onu uzun salonda bulabilirsin.

english: Can you take me to see him?
Sorry buddy, I'm not allowed into the Longhall. Don't worry, he's easy to spot. He's the one in the fancy helmet. Oh, and he only has one eye.
translation: Üzgünüm dostum, uzun salona girmeme izin yok. Merak etme, onu kolayca tanirsin. Süslü migfer takan adamdir. Bir de tek gözlüdür.

english: He's a cyclops?
Nah, nah, nah... He just wears an eyepatch! Well, see ya around buddy!
translation: Hayir, hayir, hayir... Sadece göz bandi takiyor! Görüsürüz dostum!

english: Hey there, buddy. You're an outerlander, huh?
translation: Selam dostum. Sen bir yabanci misin?

english: Didn't think old Jarvald would let an outerlander come kill dagger-mouths with him!
translation: Yasli Jarvald'in bir yabancinin onunla birlikte hancer agizlilari öldürmesine izin verecegini düsünmemistim!

english: Well, obviously he did. So what are you doing up here?
translation: Belli ki vermis. Peki burada ne isin var?

english: Well buddy, let me tell you, killing those dagger-mouths is sure thirsty work!
translation: Dostum, sana söyleyeyim, o hancer agizlilari öldürmek cok susatan bir is!

english: If you got a keg of beer on you I'll buy it off ya for 500 gold coins, buddy!
translation: Yaninda bir fici bira varsa, 500 altin karsiliginda satin alirim dostum!

english: Or if you got any animal parts, I'll trade ya something for 'em!
translation: Ya da hayvan parcalari varsa, onlarla takas yaparim!

english: No... I don't have anything like that with me...
translation: Hayir... Yanimda öyle bir sey yok...

english: Well, I'm not going back down there until I get a drink buddy! Come see me if you find me a keg, I pay good money!
translation: Icki icmeden asagiya dönmeyecegim dostum! Fici bulursan bana gel, iyi para veririm!

english: Wanna sell me ya kegs of beer for 500 gold coins each outerlander?
translation: Bana bira ficilarindan 500 altin karsiliginda satmak ister misin, yabanci?

english: I don't know... Seems a little off to sell alcohol to a child...
translation: Bilemiyorum... Bir cocuga alkol satmak biraz tuhaf geliyor...

english: Hey, don't judge our customs outerlander! Now you want the cash or you want to bug me?
translation: Hey, bizim geleneklerimizi yargilama, yabanci! Simdi parayi mi istiyorsun, yoksa beni rahatsiz etmek mi?

english: You wanna sell me the lot buddy, or one at a time?
translation: Hepsini satmak mi istiyorsun dostum, yoksa tek tek mi?

english: You sell Askeladden your Kegs of Beer.
You sell Askeladden a Keg of Beer.
But I don't have any kegs of beer to sell...
I'll trade ya animal parts for cooked tuna, ya interested outerlander?
translation: Hayvan parcalarini pismis ton baligiyla takas edelim, ilgilenir misin yabanci?

english: You wanna trade me the lot buddy, or just one type?
translation: Hepsini mi satmak istiyorsun dostum, yoksa sadece bir tür mü?

english: You trade Askeladden your animal parts for food.
translation: Askeladden'e hayvan parcalarini yiyecekle takas edersin.

english: What ya selling buddy?
You trade the parts for food.
No offence Askeladden, and it's not that I don't trust you... Er, actually it is that I don't trust you.
translation: Alinma Askeladden, sana güvenmedigimden degil... Aslinda, sana güvenmiyorum.

english: Aw, buddy... What did I ever do to you?
translation: Ah, dostum... Sana ne yaptim ki?

english: Well, if ya change your mind, I'm gonna be here waiting for a drink, buddy!
translation: Eger fikrini degistirirsen, burada bir icki icmek icin bekliyor olacagim dostum!

english: Hey buddy, I'll trade ya that for some food! Ya interested?
translation: Hey dostum, bunu yiyecekle takas ederim! Ilgilenir misin?

english: Okay buddy, suit yerself!
Hi. Are you a member of the council of elders?
translation: Merhaba. Sen yaslilar konseyinin üyesi misin?

english: Me? On the council? Ha ha ha ha! Sorry buddy, I'm not a 'real' Fremennik yet! Let me guess, you're trying to get some council members to vote for you?
translation: Ben mi? Konseyde mi? Ha ha ha ha! Üzgünüm dostum, ben henüz “gercek” bir Fremennik degilim! Dur tahmin edeyim, konsey üyelerinin sana oy vermesini mi saglamaya calisiyorsun?

english: That's right, to become a Fremennik.
You and me both buddy! We're both doing the same trials! This is my trial of manhood! How you finding it so far? Pretty easy, huh buddy?
translation: Sen ve ben dostum! Ikimiz de ayni sinavlari geciyoruz! Bu benim erkeklik sinavim! Simdiye kadar nasil buldun? Oldukca kolay, degil mi dostum?

english: It's okay I guess...
Yeah, that's the spirit buddy! It's all real easy, I wouldn't worry yourself about it, you'll be quaffing beers in the longhall as a Fremennik in no time!
translation: Evet, iste bu ruh dostum! Her sey cok kolay, endiselenme, cok gecmeden Fremennik olarak uzun salonda bira iciyor olacaksin!

english: Hello there. I understand you managed to get some golden wool from Lalli?
translation: Merhaba. Anladigim kadariyla Lalli'den altin yün almayi basarmissin?

english: HAHAHA! Yeah, that Lalli... what a maroon!
translation: HAHAHA! Evet, su Lalli... ne salak adam!

english: So how did you manage to get the wool?
Well, as you know, I am doing the same trials that you are as part of my test of manhood, and that troll is the only one who can get that wool.
translation: Bildigin gibi, ben de erkeklik sinavimin bir parcasi olarak seninle ayni sinavlara giriyorum ve o yünü alabilen tek kisi o trol.

english: You might have noticed he's kind of... messed in the head buddy! He's real paranoid about people stealing his golden apples, isn't he?
translation: Fark etmissindir, o biraz... kafasi karisik bir adam dostum! Altin elmalarinin calinmasindan cok korkuyor, degil mi?

english: Indeed he is. So how did you manage to get some golden wool from him?
translation: Aynen öyle. Peki, ondan altin yünü nasil aldin?

english: It was easy buddy! I persuaded him he needed a pet to help him guard his apples. A pet that would never sleep! A pet that would never need food, or exercise!
translation: Cok kolaydi dostum! Elmalarini korumak icin bir evcil hayvana ihtiyaci oldugunu ikna ettim. Asla uyumayan bir evcil hayvan! Asla yemek ya da egzersiz gerektirmeyen bir evcil hayvan!

english: A pet that would never need him to clean up its... well, you know, buddy. A pet that would always be loyal to him! A faithful companion for life!
translation: Asla temizlenmesi gerekmeyen bir evcil hayvan... sey, bilirsin dostum. Ona her zaman sadik kalacak bir evcil hayvan! Hayat boyu sadik bir arkadas!

english: What pet is this then?
A pet ROCK!
Man, can you believe that stupid troll traded me some of his golden wool for a worthless ROCK?
translation: Dostum, o aptal trolün bana altin yününden bir kismini degersiz bir KAYA karsiliginda verdigi inanabiliyor musun?

english: Buddy, I hafta say; if brains were explosives, that troll wouldn't have enough to blow his nose!
translation: Dostum, sunu söylemeliyim; beyin patlayici olsaydi, o trol burnunu silecek kadar bile beyni olmazdi!

english: Do you have any spare rocks then?
Sure thing buddy, although I have to say, I doubt even that troll is stupid enough to fall for the SAME trick TWICE in a row! You can try anyway though!
translation: Tabii ki dostum, ama sunu söylemeliyim ki, o trolün ayni numaraya iki kez üst üste kanacak kadar aptal oldugunu sanmiyorum! Yine de deneyebilirsin!

english: So this is the exact same type of rock you managed to sell to Lalli as a pet?
translation: Yani bu, Lalli'ye evcil hayvan olarak sattigin tasin aynisi mi?

english: Yup, sure is buddy! That Lalli is stupid, even by troll standards!
translation: Evet, tabii ki dostum! Lalli, trol standartlarina göre bile aptal!

english: Can I have another rock? I lost mine...
translation: Bir tas daha alabilir miyim? Benimki kayboldu...

english: Sure thing buddy! I'd say take better care of this one, but it's just a rock! I have hundreds of them! Go wild!
translation: Tabii ki dostum! Buna daha iyi bakmani söylerdim ama bu sadece bir tas! Yüzlerce var bende! Keyfine bak!

english: Sure thing, but you'd better free up some space first.
translation: Tabii ki, ama önce biraz yer acsan iyi olur.

english: Can I have another pet rock?
translation: Baska bir evcil tas alabilir miyim?

english: Sure, have as many as you like. I've plenty more!
translation: Tabii, istedigin kadar al. Daha cok var!

english: Your inventory is too full to accept another 'pet rock'.
translation: Envanterin baska bir ‘evcil tas’ kabul edemeyecek kadar dolu.

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a written promise from Askeladden to stay out of the Longhall?
translation: Askeladden'in Longhall'dan uzak duracagina dair yazili bir sözünü nerede bulabilecegimi biliyor musun?

english: What? I can't believe she asked you to get a written promise from me to stay out!
translation: Ne? Benden uzak duracagina dair yazili bir söz almami istedigine inanamiyorum!

english: Yup, she really did.
Awwwwwww.... but the longhall is just SO MUCH FUN! I'd live there if I could! I suppose you really need that promise to help become a Fremennik, huh?
translation: Awwwwwww.... ama Longhall cok eglenceli! Yapabilseydim orada yasardim! Fremennik olmak icin o sözü gercekten ihtiyacin var, degil mi?

english: Yeah, I really do...
Well I'll tell you what buddy; As it's you, I'll give you that written promise. All I ask in return for it is a measly 5000 gold. What do you say?
translation: Sana ne diyecegim dostum; sen oldugun icin sana o yazili sözü verecegim. Karsiliginda tek istedigim 5000 altin. Ne dersin?

english: ...how embarrassing. I appear to be short...
translation: ...ne utanc verici. Param yetmiyor gibi görünüyor...

english: Trying to scam me, huh buddy? Well it won't work! You come back with the cash, or don't come back at all!
translation: Beni dolandirmaya calisiyorsun, degil mi dostum? Ama ise yaramayacak! Parayi getir ya da hic gelme!

english: Your inventory is too full to accept the written promise.
translation: Envanterin yazili sözü kabul etmek icin cok dolu.

english: That's all you want in return? Sure thing. Here you go.
translation: Karsiliginda tek istedigin bu mu? Tabii ki. Al bakalim.

english: Done, and done. Let me know if you got any more cash burning a hole in your pocket I can relieve you of, buddy.
translation: Tamamdir. Cebinde yakacak baska para varsa bana haber ver, dostum.

english: I don't think so... That's really quite a lot of money...
Hey, suit yourself buddy. You change your mind, the bank of Askeladden is open for deposits 24 hours a day! Eh-heh-heh-heh-heh.
translation: Hey, sen bilirsin dostum. Fikrini degistirirsen, Askeladden Bankasi 24 saat boyunca mevduat kabul ediyor! Eh-heh-heh-heh-heh.

english: I thought you really liked the long hall?
I do!
Then why did you sign this guarantee that you will never enter it again?
translation: O zaman neden bir daha asla girmeyecegine dair bu garantiyi imzaladin?

english: Aha! It is because I am cunning! That guarantee says that Askeladden will never enter the longhall again! But when I have completed my Fremennik trials,
translation: Aha! Cünkü ben kurnazim! Bu garanti, Askeladden'in uzun salona bir daha asla girmeyecegini söylüyor! Ama Fremennik denemelerimi tamamladigimda

english: and passed my trial of manhood, I will be given a new name, as is our custom, and will therefore not be Askeladden anymore! That guarantee isn't worth the paper it's written on!!
translation: ve erkeklik denememi gectigimde, geleneklerimize göre bana yeni bir isim verilecek ve bu nedenle artik Askeladden olmayacagim! Bu garanti, yazildigi kagidin degerinden bile daha az!

english: You didn't think I would give up going to the longhall for only 5000 did you?
translation: Sadece 5000 icin uzun salona gitmekten vazgececegimi düsünmedin, degil mi?

english: Knowing you, I guess I didn't.
Hello again Askeladden.
Hey buddy! That ain't my name no more! My new Fremennik name is Larravak! What's yours?
translation: Selam dostum! Artik adim o degil! Yeni Fremennik adim Larravak! Seninki ne?

english: My Fremennik name is [Fremennik name].
Ha! Ain't as good as my name buddy! So what can I do ya for?
translation: Ha! Benim adim kadar iyi degil dostum! Peki, senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: So, Askeladd- sorry, Larravak; What is there to do around here now that we are both Fremenniks?
translation: Peki, Askeladd... pardon, Larravak; ikimiz de Fremennik oldugumuza göre, burada ne yapabiliriz?

english: I guess you could do a bit of shopping. We got fresh fish at the docks, and some armour and weapons at Skulgrimen's place.
translation: Biraz alisveris yapabilirsin. Limanda taze balik var, Skulgrimen'in dükkaninda da zirh ve silahlar.

english: Okay, thanks.
Hi buddy! Or do ya want me to call ya [Fremennik name] now?
translation: Selam dostum! Yoksa artik sana Dokrak dememi mi istersin?

english: Askeladden, what on Gielinor are you doing up here? And by the way, the name is [player name].
translation: Askeladden, Gielinor'da burada ne isin var? Bu arada, adim Maceraci.

english: Sure thing, buddy!
I was down in that cave killing dagger-mouths! It was fun! But then I got thirsty, so came up here for a bit of a rest...
translation: O magarada bicak agizlilari öldürüyorduk! Cok eglenceliydi! Ama sonra susadim, bu yüzden biraz dinlenmek icin buraya geldim...

english: Hey buddy, I'll tell you what, if you got any kegs of beer on ya, I'll buy them off ya for 700 gold coins each!
translation: Hey dostum, bak ne diyecegim, eger üzerinde bira ficisi varsa, her birini 700 altin karsiliginda satin alirim!

english: If ya found any animal parts killing dagger-mouths I'll trade ya for them too!
translation: Hancer agizlilari öldürürken hayvan parcalari bulduysan, onlari da takas edebilirim!

english: Wanna sell me kegs of beer for 700 gold coins each buddy?
translation: Bana bira ficisini 700 altin karsiliginda satmak ister misin dostum?

english: Um... Aren't you a little... ...young to be drinking so much?
translation: Sey... Sen biraz... ...genc degil misin bu kadar icmek icin?

english: Hey, don't talk to me like that buddy! I've done all the trials you have and I'm just as mucha  Fremennik as you are!
translation: Hey, benimle böyle konusma dostum! Senin yaptigin tüm denemeleri ben de yaptim ve ben de senin kadar Fremennik'liyim!

english: Now are ya gonna sell me some beer, or are you going to cry about it all day?
translation: Simdi bana bira satacak misin, yoksa bütün gün bunun icin aglayacak misin?

english: I'll trade ya animal parts for cooked lobsters if ya interested buddy!
translation: Eger ilgilenirsen, hayvan parcalarini pismis istakozlarla takas ederim dostum!

english: Can I have another pet rock? I lost mine...
translation: Baska bir evcil kaya alabilir miyim? Benimki kayboldu...

english: Well it's sure a weird place to ask for it buddy, but I have hundreds of them! Go wild!
translation: Bunu istemek icin garip bir yer ama bende yüzlerce var! Istedigini al!

english: YES
Sell all Kegs
Sell One Keg
NO
Trade all parts
Sell one type only

Lightened Hides
Nothing

And where do you come from, traveller?
From... out of town.
That I could have guessed.
We've been having more human visitors in the city recently, there is another one over there. Perhaps you'll want to talk to her.
translation: Son zamanlarda sehre daha fazla insan ziyaretci geliyor, surada bir tane daha var. Belki onunla konusmak istersin.

english: Ssshhhh...
There is a lot of knowledge stored in this library, you know.
translation: Bu kütüphanede cok fazla bilgi var, biliyor musun?

english: Oh, I'm sure.
What can I help you with?
Help? What kind of help do you mean?
translation: Yardim mi? Ne tür bir yardimdan bahsediyorsun?

english: Looking for a book? A manuscript? Knowledge?
translation: Bir kitap mi ariyorsun? Bir el yazmasi mi? Bilgi mi?

english: Oh, nothing in specific really.
translation: Oh, aslinda belirli bir sey yok.

english: I'll leave you to your browsing, then.
Do you want to use the balloon? Just so you know, some locations require special logs and high Firemaking skills.
translation: Balon kullanmak ister misin? Bilgin olsun, bazi yerlere gitmek icin özel kütükler ve yüksek ates yakma becerisi gerekiyor.

english: No.
Yes.
No.
Do you want to use the balloon? Just so you know, some locations require special logs and high Firemaking skills.
translation: Balon kullanmak ister misin? Bilgin olsun, bazi yerlere gitmek icin özel kütükler ve yüksek ates yakma becerisi gerekiyor.

english: Weapons are not allowed on Entrana. I must search you first.
translation: Entrana'da silah yasaktir. Önce seni aramam gerekiyor.

english: You are quickly searched.
I'm sorry, no weapons or armour may be worn to Entrana. Come back when you have laid them down.
translation: Üzgünüm, Entrana'ya silah veya zirhla girmek yasaktir. Onlari biraktiktan sonra geri gel.

english: The player rides the balloon to Entrana.
No.
Who are you?
I am Assistant Marrow. I'm working here part time while I study to be a doctor.
translation: Ben Asistan Marrow. Doktor olmak icin okurken burada part time calisiyorum.

english: Do you want to use the balloon?
Yes.
No.
Who are you?
Do you want to use the balloon? Just so you know, some locations require special logs and high Firemaking skills.
translation: Balonla gitmek ister misin? Bilgin olsun, bazi yerlere gitmek icin özel kütükler ve yüksek ates yakma becerisi gerekiyor.

english: Weapons are not allowed on Entrana. I must search you first.
translation: Entrana'da silah tasimak yasaktir. Önce seni aramam gerekiyor.

english: You are quickly searched.
I'm sorry, no weapons or armour may be worn to Entrana. Come back when you have laid them down.
translation: Üzgünüm, Entrana'da silah veya zirh giyilemez. Onlari biraktiktan sonra geri gel.

english: The player rides the balloon to Entrana.
No.
Who are you?
I am Stan. Auguste hired me to look after this balloon. I make sure people are prepared to fly.
translation: Ben Stan. Auguste beni bu balonu korumam icin tuttu. Insanlarin ucmaya hazir olup olmadiklarini kontrol ediyorum.

english: Do you want to use the balloon?
Yes.
No.
Who are you?
Hello Asteros. What brings you to the castle?
translation: Merhaba Asteros. Seni kaleye getiren nedir?

english: The King's late father asked for an advisor from Arceuus. He was keen for us to have a more central role than we did under the Council.
translation: Kralin rahmetli babasi Arceuus'tan bir danisman istedi. Konsey'de oldugundan daha merkezi bir rol almamizi istiyordu.

english: I see. I'm sure the King is glad to have you here.
translation: Anliyorum. Kralin burada olmandan memnun olduguna eminim.

english: He does seem willing to take on my advice, which is very welcoming. I hope he remains humble. It is a trait many leaders lack.
translation: Tavsiyelerimi dinlemeye istekli görünüyor, bu cok hos. Umarim alcakgönüllülügünü korur. Bu, bircok liderin eksik oldugu bir özellik.

english: Now, is there something else I can do for you? If you're interested, I can offer you the ability to respawn at Kourend Castle upon death.
translation: Simdi, senin icin yapabilecegim baska bir sey var mi? Eger ilgilenirsen, öldügünde Kourend Kalesi'nde yeniden dogma yetenegi sunabilirim.

english: Yes please.
Very well. From now on, you will respawn at Kourend Castle.
translation: Peki. Bundan sonra, Kourend Kalesi'nde yeniden dogacaksin.

english: No thanks.
Let me know if you change your mind.
Hello Asteros.
Hello there. Would you like me to change your respawn point to Kourend Castle?
translation: Merhaba. Yeniden dogma noktani Kourend Kalesi'ne degistirmemi ister misin?

english: Hello there. Would you like me to revert your respawn point to Lumbridge?
translation: Merhaba. Yeniden dogma noktani Lumbridge'e geri döndürmemi ister misin?

english: Very well. From now on, you will respawn in Lumbridge.
translation: Peki. Bundan sonra, Lumbridge'de yeniden dogacaksin.

english: What brings you to the castle?
Now, is there something else I can do for you? If you're interested, I can change your respawn point to Kourend Castle.
translation: Baska bir sey yapabilir miyim? Eger istersen, yeniden dogma noktani Kourend Kalesi olarak degistirebilirim.

english: Now, is there something else I can do for you? If you want, I can revert your respawn point to Lumbridge.
translation: Baska bir sey yapabilir miyim? Eger istersen, yeniden dogma noktani Lumbridge olarak degistirebilirim.

english: Yes please.
No thanks.
What brings you to the castle?
Now you look like someone who goes to a lot of fancy dress parties.
translation: Su anda cok sayida kostüm partisine giden biri gibi görünüyorsun.

english: Errr...what are you saying exactly?
translation: Eee... tam olarak ne demek istiyorsun?

english: I'm just saying that perhaps you would like to peruse my selection of garments.
translation: Sadece, belki de giysi koleksiyonumu incelemek isteyebilirsin diyorum.

english: Or, if that doesn't interest you, then maybe you have something else to offer? I'm always on the look out for interesting or unusual new materials.
translation: Ya da, bu ilgini cekmiyorsa, belki baska bir sey sunabilirsin? Her zaman ilginc veya sira disi yeni malzemeler ariyorum.

english: Okay, let's see what you've got then.
Do you have a spare Priest Gown?
Well I do sell them. I don't hand them out for free though. This is a shop not a charity.
translation: Satiyorum ama. Ücretsiz vermiyorum. Burasi bir dükkan, hayir kurumu degil.

english: Please! It's really important.
Well I suppose you can have this old one. It's not in good enough condition to sell.
translation: Sanirim bu eski olani alabilirsin. Satmak icin yeterince iyi durumda degil.

english: Thank you.
Could you make another eagle costume for me?
translation: Benim icin baska bir kartal kostümü yapabilir misin?

english: Certainly, if you can supply the materials. I'll need appropriate feathers, swamp tar and some yellow dye. It'll also cost you 25 gold pieces.
