translation: Elbette, malzemeleri sen saglarsan. Uygun tüyler, bataklik katrani ve biraz sari boya lazim. Ayrica 25 altin parcasi da ödersin.

english: I'll see what I can do.
I think I might just leave the perusing for now, thanks.
Can you make clothing suitable for hunting?
Certainly. Take a look at my range of made-to-order items. If you can supply the furs, I'll gladly make any of these for you.
translation: Elbette. Siparis üzerine yaptigim ürünlere bir bak. Kürkleri sen temin edersen, bunlardan herhangi birini seve seve yaparim.

english: What sort of unusual materials did you have in mind?
translation: Aklinda ne tür sira disi malzemeler var?

english: Well, some more colourful feathers might be useful. For some surreal reason, all I normally seem to get offered are large quantities of rather beaten-up looking chicken feathers.
translation: Sey, biraz daha renkli tüyler ise yarayabilir. Garip bir sekilde, normalde bana sunulan tek sey, oldukca yipranmis görünümlü tavuk tüyleri.

english: People must have some very strange pastimes around these parts, that's all I can say.
translation: Bu bölgedeki insanlar cok garip hobilerle ugrasiyor olmali, tek söyleyebilecegim bu.

english: Ok, let's see what you've got then.
Sorry, we're closed at the moment.
Okay, lets see what you've got then.
Do you have a spare Priest Gown?
Could you make another bird costume for me?
translation: Bana baska bir kus kostümü yapabilir misin?

english: I think I might just leave the perusing for now thanks.
Can you make clothing suitable for hunting in?
What sort of unusual materials did you have in mind?
translation: Aklinda ne tür sira disi malzemeler var?

english: What do you want, little ?
Nothing. Just though I'd try to strike up a conversation.
translation: Hicbir sey. Sadece sohbet etmek istedim.

english: Not now little one, I'm busy.
Okay then.
Well done, little one. You've proven your worth.
Can I do it again?
What? Why?
It was fun, I'd like to do it again.
You're the first person to ask me that [player name]. I suppose I could train you again, but I will have to charge you the full 25,000 coins this time.
translation: Bunu bana soran ilk kisi sensin Maceraci. Sanirim seni tekrar egitebilirim, ama bu sefer tam 25.000 altin alacagim.

english: Let's do this, I'm ready.
It's not going to be any easier my friend!
Training session begins.
Training session ends.
Hold it there little one, you don't have enough money to pay for the lesson.
translation: Dur bakalim ufaklik, dersin ücretini ödeyecek kadar paran yok.

english: Oh, sorry I was too excited...
No worries friend, come back when you can afford the session.
translation: Merak etme dostum, seansi ödeyebilecek duruma geldiginde tekrar gel.

english: Back again I see, here for another workout?
translation: Yine geldin, baska bir antrenman icin mi?

english: Yes please.
You must take your training very seriously [player name]. This is the second time you'll have done this workout and paid full price!
translation: Egitimi cok ciddiye almalisin Maceraci. Bu egzersizi ikinci kez yapiyorsun ve tam ücret ödüyorsun!

english: You take your training very seriously [player name]. You know you've done this workout [times done] times, are you sure you want to do it again?
Yes
No
What do you want, little [man/woman]?
Hello there, [player name]. What can I do for you?
translation: Merhaba, Maceraci. Senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: How are things?
Now that the situation in the ruins is under control, things are nice and quiet, which is just what we need. That whole buisness down there got a lot of dwarves riled up.
translation: Artik harabelerdeki durum kontrol altina alindigina göre, her sey yolunda ve sakin, tam da ihtiyacimiz olan sey. Oradaki tüm olaylar bircok cüceyi öfkelendirdi.

english: Naturally, most blame you humans.
Of course. Have you tried explaining to them that we actually helped?
translation: Elbette. Onlara aslinda yardim ettigimizi aciklamayi denedin mi?

english: Ha! Good one. You think I'm going to make a laughing stock of myself by daring to claim a human did something positive? Keep dreaming!
translation: Ha! Iyi espri. Bir insanin olumlu bir sey yaptigini iddia ederek kendimi gülünc duruma düsürecegimi mi saniyorsun? Hayal kurmaya devam et!

english: So how long has Cam Torum been around?
What am I, a historian?
No, but you're the only dwarf here that might be willing to share that sort of information with me.
translation: Hayir, ama bu tür bilgileri benimle paylasmaya istekli olabilecek tek cüce sensin.

english: Hmph. Very well. The Varlamorians won't mention this, but we were the first to settle here. Our ancestors saw the writing on the wall when Xeric came to power in Kourend. They chose not to stick around.
translation: Hmph. Pekala. Varlamorlular bundan bahsetmezler, ama buraya ilk yerlesenler bizdik. Atalarimiz, Xeric Kourend'de iktidara geldiginde tehlikeyi sezmislerdi. Kalmamayi tercih ettiler.

english: Must have been a big thing for them, leaving their home.
translation: Evlerini terk etmek onlar icin büyük bir karar olmali.

english: Doubtful. My people are all too familiar with that sort of thing. The Lovakengj dwarves have mostly forgotten their history, but we Dwarves of Cam Torum remember it all too well.
translation: Süpheliyim. Halkim bu tür seylere cok asinadir. Lovakengj cüceleri tarihlerini cogunlukla unutmuslardir, ama biz Cam Torum cüceleri her seyi cok iyi hatirliyoruz.

english: Remember what?
Before Lovakengj, there was Imcandoria. Our ancestors there were forced to abandon their home, just as we were forced to leave Kourend.
translation: Lovakengj'den önce Imcandoria vardi. Oradaki atalarimiz, bizim Kourend'den ayrilmak zorunda kaldigimiz gibi, evlerini terk etmek zorunda kaldilar.

english: If you humans had had your way, we might have had to abandon Cam Torum by now as well.
translation: Siz insanlar istediginizi yapabilseydiniz, simdiye kadar Cam Torum'u da terk etmek zorunda kalabilirdik.

english: You don't know that.
But I do know that. As I said, we remember our history, and we know that those who don't are doomed to repeat it.
translation: Ama ben biliyorum. Dedigim gibi, tarihimizi hatirliyoruz ve onu hatirlamayanlarin onu tekrar yasamaya mahkum oldugunu biliyoruz.

english: The Varlamorians nearly destroyed themselves in their War of Betrayal, but it was not them who were betrayed, it was us.
translation: Varlamorlular, Ihanet Savasi'nda neredeyse kendilerini yok ediyorlardi, ama ihanete ugrayanlar onlar degildi, bizdik.

english: I was a young dwarf when their war risked destroying our home. I saw the results of their pride. Meanwhile, they've all but forgotten it.
translation: Onlarin savasi evimizi yok etme riskiyle karsi karsiya biraktiginda ben genc bir cüceydim. Onlarin gururunun sonuclarini gördüm. Bu arada, onlar bunu neredeyse tamamen unuttular.

english: Sorry. I didn't mean to dig up old wounds.
Hmph. It's fine. Your intentions are good, [player name], which is more than can be said for most of your kind. Who knows, maybe one or two dwarves here might even grow to tolerate you.
translation: Hmph. Sorun degil. Niyetin iyi, Maceraci, bu da senin türünün cogu icin söylenemeyecek bir sey. Kim bilir, belki buradaki bir iki cüce bile sana tahammül etmeye baslayabilir.

english: I'd better get going.
How are things?
So how long has Cam Torum been around?
I'd better get going.
Hello again. Was Fox happy with the material?
translation: Merhaba tekrar. Fox malzemeden memnun mu?

english: He was. You found the perfect match.
Wonderful!
I have this voucher for completing the combat Adventure Path, it says to come talk to you about claiming my Adventure Path reward.
translation: Savas Macera Yolu'nu tamamladigim icin bu kuponum var, Macera Yolu ödülümü almak icin seninle konusmam gerektigi yaziyor.

english: Why yes, here are some air and mind runes.
translation: Evet, iste hava ve zihin rünleri.

english: I do have more rewards for you, but you need to be on a members world for me to give you the reward. Maybe there is something else I can help you with.
translation: Sana verebilecegim baska ödüller de var, ama ödülü verebilmem icin üye dünyasinda olman gerekiyor. Belki baska bir konuda yardimci olabilirim.

english: Do you want to buy some runes?
Certainly! Skillcapes are a symbol of achievement. Only people who have mastered a skill and reached level 99 can get their hands on them and gain the benefits they carry.
translation: Elbette! Beceri pelerinleri basari sembolüdür. Sadece bir beceriyi ustalastirip 99. seviyeye ulasan kisiler bu pelerinleri elde edebilir ve sagladiklari avantajlardan yararlanabilir.

english: The Cape of Runecrafting has been upgraded with each talisman, allowing you to access all Runecrafting altars. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Rün Yapimi Pelerini her tilsimla birlikte yükseltildi, böylece tüm Rün Yapimi sunaklarina erisebilirsin. Yardimci olabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: No thank you.
Well, if you find someone who does want runes, please send them my way.
translation: Peki, rün isteyen biri olursa lütfen onu bana gönder.

english: Oh, it's a rune shop. No thank you, then.
translation: Oh, bu bir rün dükkani. O zaman hayir, tesekkürler.

english: Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence?
Senventior Disthine Molenko!
I have been sent here with a package for you.
translation: Size bir paket getirmek icin buraya gönderildim.

english: A package? From who?
From Sedridor at the Wizards' Tower.
From Sedridor? But... surely he can't have? Please, let me have it. It must be extremely important for him to have sent a stranger.
translation: Sedridor'dan mi? Ama... o yapamaz ki? Lütfen, bana verin. Bir yabanciyi göndermesi, onun icin cok önemli bir sey olmali.

english: You hand Aubury the research package.
This... this is incredible.
My gratitude to you adventurer for bringing me these research notes. Thanks to you, I think we finally have it.
translation: Bu arastirma notlarini bana getirdigin icin sana minnettarim maceraci. Senin sayende, sonunda basardik sanirim.

english: You mean the incantation?
Well when we combine my own research with this latest discovery, I think we might just...
translation: Kendi arastirmamla bu son kesfi birlestirirsek, sanirim biz...

english: No, no, I'm getting ahead of myself. The signs are promising, but let's not jump to any conclusions just yet.
translation: Hayir, hayir, fazla ileri gidiyorum. Isaretler umut verici, ama henüz bir sonuca varmayalim.

english: Here, take these notes back to Sedridor. They should hopefully give him everything he needs.
translation: Al, bu notlari Sedridor'a götür. Umarim ona ihtiyaci olan her seyi saglarlar.

english: Uh... yeah... about that... I kind of don't have it with me...
translation: Sey... evet... o konuda... Yanimda yok da...

english: What kind of person tells me they have a delivery for me, but not with them? Honestly.
translation: Ne tür bir insan bana bir teslimati oldugunu söyler, ama yaninda getirmez? Gercekten.

english: Come back when you do.
Anything useful in that package I gave you?
translation: Sana verdigim pakette yararli bir sey var mi?

english: Well, let's have a look...
Hello. Did you take those notes back to Sedridor?
translation: Merhaba. O notlari Sedridor'a götürdün mü?

english: Sorry, but I lost them.
Well, luckily I have duplicates. It's a good thing they are written in code. I wouldn't want the wrong kind of person to get access to the information contained within.
translation: Neyse ki kopyalari var. Kodlu yazilmis olmalari iyi bir sey. Icindeki bilgilere yanlis kisilerin erismesini istemem.

english: I'm still working on it.
Don't take too long. He'll be eager to see if this is indeed the breakthrough we were hoping for.
translation: Cok uzun sürmesin. Bunun gercekten umdugumuz atilim olup olmadigini görmek icin sabirsizlanacaktir.

english: Now, did you want to buy some runes?
translation: Peki, rune satin almak mi istiyordun?

english: Actually, I'm here with a business proposal from Ali Morrisane.
translation: Aslinda, Ali Morrisane'den bir is teklifi ile geldim.

english: Ali who?
Ali Morrisane, a salesman of great repute based in Al Kharid.
translation: Ali Morrisane, Al Kharid'de bulunan, cok saygin bir satici.

english: What is this proposal then?
He wants to set up a rune-selling franchise in the markets of Al Kharid and he wants you to supply him with the stock.
translation: Al Kharid pazarlarinda rune satisi icin bir franchise kurmak istiyor ve stoklari sana tedarik etmeni istiyor.

english: Why doesn't he get his own runes and sell them?
His talents don't lie in that area. What he's good at is selling things, and lots of them.
translation: Onun yetenegi o alanda degil. Onun iyi oldugu sey, bir seyleri satmak, hem de cok satmak.

english: Hmm, interesting... So let's get this straight, he wants me to supply him with runes, which he will sell, and send me the profits?
translation: Hmm, ilginc... Yani, onu rünlerle tedarik etmemi, onun da bunlari satip bana kârini göndermesini mi istiyor?

english: Nearly. He will charge a small commission on the runes.
translation: Neredeyse. Rünler icin kücük bir komisyon alacak.

english: Do you think that it will work? Will people actually buy these runes off him?
translation: Sence bu ise yarar mi? Insanlar gercekten ondan bu runeleri satin alir mi?

english: I wouldn't be surprised. Supply and demand are his rune essence and ore.
translation: Hic sasirmam. Arz ve talep onun runesi özü ve cevheridir.

english: Now this is very important, is he trustworthy?
translation: Simdi bu cok önemli, o güvenilir biri mi?

english: Yes, I believe so. Trust is a key part of commerce and something, which I doubt he would neglect.
translation: Evet, öyle düsünüyorum. Güven, ticaretin önemli bir parcasidir ve onun bunu ihmal edecegini sanmiyorum.

english: Fair enough, I'll trust your judgement.
So you'll supply him with runes then?
translation: O zaman ona runeler saglayacak misin?

english: Well if he's half as good a salesman as you suggest I should have no problem in funding my research and maybe even redecorating this place.
translation: Eger senin dedigin kadar iyi bir saticiysa, arastirmami finanse etmekte ve hatta burayi yeniden dekore etmekte sorun yasamam.

english: Oh, sorry [player name], I didn't recognise you for a second, you're back again so soon. Have you spoken to Ali Morrisane yet about the runes?
translation: Oh, pardon Maceraci, seni bir an taniyamadim, bu kadar cabuk geri dönmüssün. Ali Morrisane ile runeler hakkinda konustun mu?

english: Umm... not yet, I'll try to get around to doing that soon.
translation: Umm... henüz degil, yakinda konusmaya calisacagim.

english: Ya... about that, there's some crazy locking mechanism attached to each casket of runes, which he cannot figure out.
translation: Evet... o konuda, her run kasasina takili olan ve onun cözemedigi cilgin bir kilit mekanizmasi var.

english: Oh, yes, the rune locks, they're a bit of a doozy, I've completely forgotten how they work, but I'm sure they shouldn't prove too much of a struggle to an intelligent adventurererlike you, [player name]. Eh?
translation: Oh, evet, run kilitleri, biraz zorludurlar, nasil calistiklarini tamamen unutmusum, ama senin gibi zeki bir maceraci icin cok da zor olmamali, Maceraci. Eh?

english: I wouldn't hold my breath.
Great! Now, do want to buy some runes?
translation: Harika! Simdi, rune satin almak ister misin?

english: Can you tell me about your cape?
I'd like to view your store please.
No thank you.
Yes please!
Oh, it's a rune shop. No thank you, then.
translation: Oh, bu bir rune dükkani. O zaman hayir, tesekkürler.

english: Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence?
I have been sent here with a package for you.
translation: Sana bir paket getirmek icin buraya gönderildim.

english: Anything useful in that package I gave you?
translation: Sana verdigim pakette yararli bir sey var mi?

english: Actually, I'm here with a business proposal from Ali Morrisane.
translation: Aslinda, Ali Morrisane'den bir is teklifi ile geldim.

english: Gather round, one and all! It's time for the Darkmeyer Auctions!
We've got quite the lineup for you today! So, let's get started!
translation: Bugün sizin icin harika bir programimiz var! Hadi baslayalim!

english: First up, a 37 year old male from sector four!
translation: Ilk olarak, dördüncü sektörden 37 yasinda bir erkek!

english: He's got plenty of blood in him, and he'll keep your home clean of any mess!
translation: Kan doludur ve evinizi temiz tutacaktir!

english: Let's start the bidding at 1,000 coins! Do I have 1,000?
translation: Teklifleri 1.000 sikke ile basliyoruz! 1.000 var mi?

english: Here!
1,000 coins to the vyre at the back! Do I have 2,000?
I'll take it!
2,000 for the lady in red! Anyone for 3,000?
I have 3,000! But do I have 4,000?
Anyone for 4,000?
3,000 going once!
3,000 going twice!
Sold to the vyre at the back!
Right then! Next we have a 22 year old female from sector six!
translation: Tamam o zaman! Sirada, sektör alti'dan 22 yasinda bir kadin var!

english: She's young and filled with optimism! Perfect for those who enjoy a taste of hope!
translation: Genc ve iyimserlikle dolu! Umut tadini sevenler icin mükemmel!

english: We'll start with 5,000 for this one! Do I have any takers!
translation: Bu ürün icin 5.000'den baslayacagiz! Almak isteyen var mi?

english: Right here!
5,000 coins for the lady at the front! How about 6,000?
translation: Öndeki bayan 5.000 coin teklif etti! 6.000'e ne dersiniz?

english: Give it to me!
I have 6,000! Who wants 7,000!
I'll take her for 10,000!
10,000! We have a bid of 10,000! You lot really want this one! Anyone up for 12,000?
translation: 10.000! 10.000 teklifimiz var! Sizler bunu gercekten istiyorsunuz! 12.000 isteyen var mi?

english: Anyone for any more? 13,000?
12,000 going once!
12,000 going twice!
Sold for 12,000 coins! Enjoy!
Okay, finally we have a 41 year old male from sector three!
translation: Tamam, son olarak sektör ücten 41 yasinda bir erkek var!

english: Careful! This one is feisty! In fact, we've had to put him in a cage!
translation: Dikkatli olun! Bu cok agresif! Aslinda, onu bir kafese koymak zorunda kaldik!

english: If you can put him in his place though, you're in for a treat! His blood is the sweetest around!
translation: Eger onu yerine oturtabilirseniz, büyük bir ödül sizi bekliyor! Onun kani buradaki en tatli kan!

english: We'll begin with 4,000 coins!
I have 4,000! But do I have 5,000?
5,000 coins to the vyre in red! Do I have 6,000?
translation: 5.000 coin kirmizi giysili vyre'ye! 6.000 var mi?

english: 6,000 coins! Looks like we have a competition here! Let's take it to 7,000!
translation: 6.000 sikke! Görünüse göre bir rekabet var! 7.000'e cikalim!

english: We're at 7,000! But will it go higher? 8,000 coins?
translation: 7.000'deyiz! Ama daha yüksege cikacak mi? 8.000 sikke?

english: 7,000 going once!
7,000 going twice!
Sold to the vyre in red!
Well there you have it! That's all for now from the Darkmeyer Auctions!
translation: Iste bu kadar! Darkmeyer Müzayedeleri'nden simdilik bu kadar!

english: Fear not though. We'll be back with more, very soon!
translation: Ama korkmayin. Cok yakinda daha fazlasiyla geri dönecegiz!

english: Oh, don't bother me human.
Why not? What's wrong?
You are wrong, human. Your attire is outrageous. Your presence is obnoxious.
translation: Sen hatalisin insan. Kiyafetin cok cirkin. Varligin igrenc.

english: What? What are you saying?
I'm saying you're in my way.
Greetings! Would you like to be my number one  accomplice? I mean, assistant?
translation: Selamlar! Benim bir numarali suc ortagim olmak ister misin? Yani, yardimcim?

english: Who are you?
I am Auguste. I am going to be the first balloonist in all of Gielinor!
translation: Ben Auguste. Gielinor'un ilk baloncusu olacagim!

english: Balloo-what? I thought only monks lived on Entrana.
translation: Baloncu mu? Entrana'da sadece kesisler yasiyor saniyordum.

english: Well, they do... I was a monk. But I'm so sick of living on this island! I want to explore new frontiers!
translation: Evet, yasiyorlar... Ben de kesistim. Ama bu adada yasamaktan biktim! Yeni ufuklar kesfetmek istiyorum!

english: And go where no man has gone before?
translation: Ve daha önce kimsenin gitmedigi yerlere mi?

english: Maybe! That sounds good. I was thinking just over to Taverley, though.
translation: Belki! Kulaga hos geliyor. Ama ben sadece Taverley'e gitmeyi düsünüyordum.

english: Why not take the boat then?
Ugh! Ocean! Don't talk to me about the ocean...oh dear...I feel ill.
translation: Ugh! Okyanus! Bana okyanustan bahsetme... oh hayir... midem bulandi.

english: Whoa, ok, no ocean. How exactly are you going to get off the island, then?
translation: Tamam, okyanus yok. O zaman adadan nasil cikacaksin?

english: I have devised a new way to travel. But I need an assistant balloonist to help me build my design.
translation: Yeni bir seyahat yöntemi gelistirdim. Ama tasarimimi gerceklestirmeme yardim edecek bir baloncu yardimcisina ihtiyacim var.

english: Are you an experienced adventurer willing to help me?
translation: Bana yardim etmeye istekli, deneyimli bir maceraci misin?

english: Yes! Sign me up.
Wonderful! Let's get started.
Wait, I still don't know exactly what we're doing.
translation: Bekle, hala ne yapacagimizi tam olarak bilmiyorum.

english: Of course, of course, how foolish of me. Well, we are going to make a balloon.
translation: Tabii, tabii, ne kadar aptalim. Sey, bir balon yapacagiz.

english: Which is what exactly?
Let me show you!
I don't think so.
Oh, never mind then.
Hello, [player name]. It is good to see you again. My enterprise has grown since we last met. I've expanded all over Gielinor!
translation: Merhaba, Maceraci. Seni tekrar görmek ne güzel. Son görüsmemizden bu yana isim büyüdü. Gielinor'un her yerine yayildim!

english: If you'd like to go to a new location, you will have to help fly the balloon again. Some of the routes are very dangerous!
translation: Yeni bir yere gitmek istiyorsan, balonu ucurmaya tekrar yardim etmelisin. Bazi rotalar cok tehlikeli!

english: But each route you complete will earn you Firemaking experience.
translation: Ama tamamladigin her rota sana Ates Yakma deneyimi kazandiracak.

english: Once you've opened a route, it only costs 1 log of the corresponding type to travel there again, from any location you've already opened!
translation: Bir rotayi actiktan sonra, daha önce actiginiz herhangi bir yerden oraya tekrar seyahat etmek icin sadece 1 adet ilgili türde odun gerekir!

english: I have also hired assistants to watch over the balloons at each new location we go to. They will help you get where you want to go.
translation: Ayrica, gittigimiz her yeni yerde balonlari gözetlemek icin yardimcilar tuttum. Onlar istediginiz yere ulasmaniza yardimci olacaklar.

english: Do you want to use the balloon? Just so you know, some locations require special logs and high Firemaking skills.
translation: Balon kullanmak ister misiniz? Bilginiz olsun, bazi yerler özel odunlar ve yüksek Ates Yakma becerileri gerektirir.

english: No.
Could you tell me how to make an origami balloon?
translation: Origami balonun nasil yapildigini anlatir misiniz?

english: First, use the papyrus on the ball of wool. The papyrus is folded into an origami box and the yarn will support the heat source.
translation: Önce, yün yumak üzerine papirüs kullanin. Papirüs origami kutusu seklinde katlanir ve iplik isi kaynagini destekler.

english: Next, add the unlit candle to the balloon structure. It will act as the heat source.
translation: Ardindan, balon yapisina yanmamis mumu ekleyin. Bu, isi kaynagi görevi görecektir.

english: Now you have an origami balloon!
If you use your origami balloon with any dye, you can change the colour.
translation: Origami balonunu herhangi bir boya ile kullanirsan, rengini degistirebilirsin.

english: You can release the balloon and watch it float in the air, just use a tinderbox on it.
translation: Balonunu serbest birakip havada ucmasini izleyebilirsin, sadece üzerine bir kibrit kutusu kullan.

english: You don't have enough free space for your cap.
translation: Sapkan icin yeterli bos alanin yok.

english: Here's your cap. Try to keep better track of it.
translation: Iste sapkan. Daha iyi takip etmeye calis.

english: You don't need a new jacket; you still have your original one.
translation: Yeni bir cekete ihtiyacin yok, hala orijinal ceketin var.

english: You don't have enough free space for your jacket.
translation: Ceketin icin yeterli bos alanin yok.

english: Here's your jacket, to keep you warm during flight.
translation: Iste ceketin, ucus sirasinda seni sicak tutsun.

english: There you go! You look like a true airship pilot now.
translation: Iste oldu! Artik gercek bir hava gemisi pilotu gibi görünüyorsun.

english: I can't combine them if you are wearing them.
You don't have enough free space for the cap and goggles.
translation: Sapka ve gözlük icin yeterli bos alanin yok.

english: Yes.
No.
Could you tell me how to make an origami balloon?
translation: Origami balonunu nasil yapacagimi söyleyebilir misin?

english: Could you replace some items for me?
translation: Bazi esyalari benim icin degistirebilir misin?

english: Could you combine my cap and goggles?
Hey it's the hero! Thank you so much for saving us from Gadderanks. And the town is looking lovely as well. You've done a great job!
translation: Hey, kahraman geldi! Gadderanks'tan bizi kurtardigin icin cok tesekkürler. Kasaba da cok güzel görünüyor. Harika bir is cikardin!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
I'm Aurel the village store owner.
Can you open the shop for me please?
translation: Dükkani benim icin acar misin lütfen?

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: Oh, pek bir sey yok, hepimiz hala vampirlerden saklaniyoruz ve bu korkunc yerden gecimimizi sagliyoruz, umarim yakinda Salve'deki tapinaga yolculuk yapacak kadar gücleniriz.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: Bildigim kadariyla, su anda cok yararli olan bazi temel olanaklara sahibiz, hepimiz size cok minnettariz. Daha önce hic bir kahraman görmedim veya tanimadim, bu yüzden karsilastirma yapabilecegim bir sey yok, ama sanirim

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: cogu insanin görüsüne göre, siz bir kahramansiniz! Ben sahsen sizinle tanistigima cok memnunum.

english: Ok, thanks.
I've lost Gadderanks' Warhammer.
Hmm, how careless of you! However, you're in luck! Someone found it earlier and sold it to me.
translation: Hmm, ne kadar dikkatsizsin! Ancak sanslisin! Biri onu bulmus ve bana satmis.

english: Now I can pass the hammer back to you for the remarkably cheap price of 3000 gold coins. Deal?
translation: Simdi bu cekici sana 3000 altin sikke gibi oldukca ucuz bir fiyata geri verebilirim. Anlastik mi?

english: But I don't have 3000 coins on me?
So that means you can't have it then! Come back when you have 3000 coins.
translation: O zaman alamazsin! 3000 sikke buldugunda geri gel.

english: Oayk, I'll pay 3000 coins for the hammer.
A good deal and I'm sure of it!
No thanks, I'll leave it, 3000 coins is too much to pay.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, almayacagim, 3000 altin cok fazla.

english: Very good then! I'll have no guilty conscience in offering it to other adventurers that frequent my shop then. Many thanks for your time and good day to ya sir.
translation: Peki o zaman! O zaman dükkânima sik sik gelen diger maceracilara sunmaktan vicdan azabi duymayacagim. Zaman ayirdiginiz icin cok tesekkürler, iyi günler efendim.

english: Why does the hammer cost so much?
So much! That's cheap! The adventurer I bought it from wanted twice as much but I managed to knock him down to a reasonable price.
translation: Cok pahali! Bu ucuz! Onu satin aldigim maceraci iki kati fiyat istiyordu ama onu makul bir fiyata indirmeyi basardim.

english: What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Ok, thanks.
I've lost Gadderanks' Warhammer.
Okay, I'll pay 3000 coins for the hammer.
No thanks, I'll leave it. 3000 coins is too much to pay.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, almayayim. 3000 altin cok fazla.

english: Why does the hammer cost so much?
translation: Cekicinin fiyati neden bu kadar yüksek?

english: Okay, thanks.
What are you doing here?
I'm blending in. Scopin' out the place.
Are you preparing for a heist? You're only a kid.
translation: Soygun mu hazirliyorsun? Sen daha cocuksun.

english: Let's just say there are some wealthy people about, with full pockets.
translation: Diyelim ki, burada cepleri dolu zengin insanlar var.

english: Any tips? I'm not having much luck myself.
translation: Herhangi bir ipucu var mi? Ben pek sansli degilim.

english: I'm quite sneaky. Every now and then I'll get their attention so their pockets aren't being so carefully watched.
translation: Ben oldukca sinsi biriyim. Arada sirada onlarin dikkatini cekiyorum, böylece ceplerini o kadar dikkatli izlemiyorlar.

english: That is sneaky. I'll keep an eye out for your... distractions.
translation: Bu cok sinsi bir taktik. Senin dikkatlerini dagitan seyleri gözlemleyecegim.

english: Now leave me be. I'm already distracting!
translation: Simdi beni rahat birak. Zaten dikkatlerini dagitiyorum!

english: Hmmph. What do you want?
I was just wondering what was down those stairs?
translation: Sadece merdivenlerin altinda ne oldugunu merak ediyordum.

english: You can't go down there!
I didn't want to anyway.
Good. Because you can't.
Because I don't want to.
Because you can't. So that's fine.
Yes, it is.
Yes. Fine.
Absolutely.
Well then.
Why not?
This is the home of the Mountain Dwarves. How would you like it if I wanted to take a shortcut through your home?
translation: Burasi Dag Cücelerinin evi. Ben senin evinden kestirme yol kullanmak istesem hosuna gider miydi?

english: Ooh... is this a shortcut to somewhere?
translation: Ooh... burasi bir yere giden kestirme yol mu?

english: Well, it is a lot easier to go this way to get past White Wolf Mountain than through those wolf filled passes.
translation: Beyaz Kurt Dagi'ni gecmek icin kurtlarla dolu gecitlerden gecmektense bu yoldan gecmek cok daha kolay.

english: Oh, sorry, I hadn't realised it was private.
translation: Oh, özür dilerim, özel bir yer oldugunu fark etmemistim.

english: Well, it is.
If you were my friend I wouldn't mind.
Yes, but I don't even know you.
Well, let's be friends!
I'd rather not, thank you.
This quest is not available on Speedrunning Worlds.
translation: Bu görev Speedrunning Worlds'te mevcut degildir.

english: You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Fishing Contest quest.
translation: Balikcilik Yarismasi görevini baslatmak icin gerekli tüm sartlari saglamiyorsun.

english: And how am I meant to do that?
My, we are the persistent one aren't we?
translation: Vay canina, ne kadar israrcisin sen?

english: Well, there's a certain gold artefact we're after. We dwarves are big fans of gold! This artefact is the first prize at the Hemenster fishing competition.
translation: Sey, pesinde oldugumuz belirli bir altin eser var. Biz cüceler altin hayraniyiz! Bu eser, Hemenster balikcilik yarismasinin birincilik ödülü.

english: Fortunately we have acquired a pass to enter that competition...
translation: Neyse ki, o yarismaya katilmak icin bir gecis karti aldik...

english: Unfortunately Dwarves don't make good fishermen.
Fortunately I'm alright at fishing!
Okay. I entrust you with our competition pass. Don't forget to take some gold with you for the entrance fee.
translation: Tamam. Yarisma gecis kartimizi sana emanet ediyorum. Giris ücreti icin yanina biraz altin almayi unutma.

english: Go to Hemenster and do us proud!
You're a grumpy little man aren't you?
translation: Sen huysuz bir adamsin, degil mi?

english: Don't you know it.
I'm bigger than you. Let me by!
translation: Ben senden daha büyügüm. Cekil yolumdan!

english: ...stumpy.
Go away! You're not going to bully your way in HERE!
I was just stopping to say hello!
Hello then.
Do you have a brother?
What if I do! It's no business of yours.
Have you won yet?
No, not yet.
Well don't give up! Maybe old Jack can give you a few tips.
translation: Pes etme! Belki yasli Jack sana birkac ipucu verebilir.

english: Welcome, oh great Fishing Champion! Feel free to pop by and use our tunnel any time.
translation: Hos geldin, büyük Balikcilik Sampiyonu! Istedigin zaman ugrayip tünelimizi kullanabilirsin.

english: Thank you, I think I'll stop by for a beer one day.
translation: Tesekkürler, bir gün bira icmek icin ugrayacagim.

english: I was wondering what was down those stairs?
translation: O merdivenlerin altinda ne var merak ediyordum.

english: I didn't want to anyway.
Why not?
Ooh... is this a shortcut to somewhere?
translation: Ooh... burasi bir yere giden kestirme yol mu?

english: Oh, sorry, I hadn't realised it was private.
translation: Oh, pardon, özel oldugunu fark etmemistim.

english: If you were my friend I wouldn't mind it.
Well, let's be friends!
Yes.
No.
You're a grumpy little man aren't you?
translation: Sen huysuz bir adamsin, degil mi?

english: I'm bigger than you. Let me by.
translation: Ben senden daha büyügüm. Gecmeme izin ver.

english: I was just stopping to say hello!
Do you have a brother?
Hello again. Are you after another device, or some information, or would you like to see my goods for sale?
translation: Merhaba tekrar. Baska bir cihaz mi, bilgi mi ariyorsun, yoksa satilik ürünlerimi görmek ister misin?

english: Devices, please.
I'd like information, please.
Just a few bits of information before you run away to persecute rock crabs or cows.
translation: Kaya yengeclerini veya inekleri kovalamaya gitmeden önce birkac bilgi vereyim.

english: Firstly, your new device won't work if you are wearing certain metallic chest armours.
translation: Ilk olarak, belirli metalik gögüs zirhlari giyiyorsaniz yeni cihaziniz calismayacaktir.

english: The magnetic attraction required for operation would cause feedback, so the device does not allow such incompatible item equip page.
translation: Calismasi icin gereken manyetik cekim geri beslemeye neden olur, bu nedenle cihaz bu tür uyumsuz esyalarin donatilmasina izin vermez.

english: Secondly, although the device is calibrated to attract only arrow heads, there is a chance that other magnetically active items will be attracted.
translation: Ikincisi, cihaz sadece ok uclarini cekecek sekilde kalibre edilmis olsa da, manyetik olarak aktif diger esyalarin da cekilme ihtimali vardir.

english: The arrow recovery function of the devices is slightly different and relies upon a harmonic bond between your arrows and the chicken's magnet. You'll thus only recover arrows which you have fired rather than those
translation: Cihazlarin ok kurtarma islevi biraz farklidir ve oklariniz ile tavugun miknatisi arasindaki harmonik baga dayanir. Bu nedenle, yalnizca sizin ateslediginiz oklari kurtarabilirsiniz,

english: fired by nearby folks.
You'll also need to move about if you want to collect arrows since the gathering of long-lost arrowheads can't work otherwise.
translation: Ayrica, oklari toplamak istiyorsaniz hareket etmeniz gerekir, aksi takdirde uzun süredir kayip olan ok uclarini toplayamazsiniz.

english: Finally, the device will only work when worn. It automatically deactivates in other circumstances.
translation: Son olarak, cihaz yalnizca takildiginda calisir. Diger durumlarda otomatik olarak devre disi kalir.

english: I was worried about what would happen if you were to place it in a bank in its active state, so I've made sure it only works when it's on your back.
translation: Aktif durumda bir bankaya koyarsaniz ne olacagi konusunda endiselendim, bu yüzden sadece sirtinizda oldugunda calistigindan emin oldum.

english: Can I have more locator orbs, please?
translation: Daha fazla yer belirleyici küre alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: Ava gives you [another orb/[amount] orbs].
I'd like to see your stuff for sale, please.
Here's my shop.
I'll just head off, I think.
Thanks for the help with my bed; see you again.
translation: Yatagimla ilgili yardimin icin tesekkürler, tekrar görüsürüz.

english: Mind taking a look at this quiver for me?
translation: Bu ok kilifina bir bakabilir misin?

english: Hmm...
That truly is a remarkable piece of equipment.
Bring me one of my devices. I might be able to link the two!
translation: Bana cihazlarimdan birini getir. Ikisini birbirine baglayabilirim!

english: Wow! Really? I better go and grab one.
translation: Vay canina! Gercekten mi? Gidip bir tane getireyim.

english: If you've got the materials, I can make one now for you?
translation: Malzemeleriniz varsa, size hemen bir tane yapabilirim.

english: Let me see...
Extraordinary...
That quiver has some of the finest leatherwork I've ever seen!
translation: Bu ok kilifi, gördügüm en kaliteli deri isciligine sahip!

english: I was wondering if you could maybe make it... better?
translation: Acaba onu daha iyi hale getirebilir misin?

english: Better? Let me see... I might be able to do something.
translation: Daha iyi mi? Bir bakayim... Bir seyler yapabilirim belki.

english: I'll see if I can link it to the device you have with you.
translation: Elindeki cihaza baglayabilir miyim bir bakayim....

english: Ouch!
That's some tough material...
Move that here...
There we go! That's some of my finest work, if I do say so myself.
translation: Iste oldu! Kendim söylemek gerekirse, bu benim en iyi islerimden biri.

english: Great! Thanks for the help!
Looks like that quiver could be modified further. Come back to me with another device to modify it.
translation: Görünüse göre bu ok kilifi daha da gelistirilebilir. Onu gelistirmek icin baska bir cihazla bana geri gel.

english: Fair enough.
Mind taking another look at that quiver I showed you before?
translation: Sana daha önce gösterdigim ok kilifina bir daha bakar misin?

english: Hmm, interesting... It seems to lack the power you have in your other device there.
translation: Hmm, ilginc... Diger cihazinda bulunan güc bu cihazda yok gibi görünüyor.

english: That's right. I was wondering if you could help with that?
translation: Dogru. Bu konuda yardim edebilir misin acaba?

english: I'll give it a good go!
It seems like that quiver is as good as it's going to get!
translation: Görünüse göre o ok kilifi daha iyi hale gelemez!

english: I'm not sure what you are trying to do; are you sure you aren't slightly deranged?
translation: Ne yapmaya calistigini anlamadim; biraz kafayi yemedin mi sen?

english: Devices, please.
Ava's devices.
Dizana's Quiver.
I'd like information, please.
Can I have more locator orbs, please?
translation: Daha fazla yer belirleme küresi alabilir miyim, lütfen?

english: I'd like to see your stuff for sale, please.
I'll just head off, I think.
What are you doing out here on your own?
I'm not alone! Me and my mates run these streets. You'd better watch your pockets, stranger.
translation: Yalniz degilim! Ben ve arkadaslarim bu sokaklari yönetiyoruz. Ceplerine dikkat etsen iyi olur, yabanci.

english: What do you mean you run the streets?
You see those fancy houses?
I think so?
We keep a lookout to see when the owners leave and come back. Once they're out, we can break in and steal all their stuff!
translation: Sahipleri ne zaman cikip ne zaman geri döneceklerini gözetliyoruz. Disari ciktiklarinda, iceri girip tüm esyalarini calabiliyoruz!

english: That sounds risky don't you think? There are guards everywhere.
translation: Bu riskli bir is degil mi sence? Her yerde güvenlik görevlileri var.

english: No one suspects us street urchins. Hidden in plain sight, as they say.
translation: Kimse biz sokak cocuklarindan süphelenmez. Herkesin gözü önünde gizliyiz, dedikleri gibi.

english: I can give you some info on which houses are free if you like...
translation: Istersen hangi evlerin bos oldugunu sana söyleyebilirim...

english: Sounds good.
You're new around here. Normally I'd charge 15 valuables for information, but I'm feeling generous.
translation: Buralara yeni gelmissin. Normalde bu bilgi icin 15 degerli esya isterdim, ama bugün cömert hissediyorum.

english: Looks like Victor isn't home right now. Go quickly!
translation: Görünüse göre Victor su anda evde degil. Cabuk git!

english: Do you want me to point you in the right direction?
translation: Sana dogru yönü göstermemi ister misin?

english: Yes please.
His house is south of here.
Sounds good.
Yes please.
I'll find my own way.
I'm alright for now.
What? Can't you see I'm busy?
Well, sooooorry...
I have received word from my father of your assistance to our family in this matter. You have my thanks for restoring our honour.
translation: Babamdan, bu konuda ailemize yardim ettiginizi duydum. Onurumuzu geri kazandirdiginiz icin tesekkür ederim.

english: Not a problem.
Yes well... Is there anything I can help you with?
translation: Evet, peki... Size yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Can you change my gauntlets for me?
Yes certainly, though it will cost you 25,000 coins.
Great thanks!
Avan takes your gauntlets, takes out a small hammer, and pounds them into a slightly new shape, then hands them back to you.
translation: Avan eldivenlerini alir, kücük bir cekic cikarir, onlari hafifce döverek yeni bir sekil verir ve sana geri verir.

english: No that's okay thanks.
No thanks.
I have received word from my father that you assisted us again! I get the feeling you weren't going to stop trying until you did though.
translation: Babamdan, bize yine yardim ettiginizi duydum! Ama sen bunu basarana kadar denemekten vazgecmeyecektin gibi geliyor bana.

english: As a token of my appreciation, I will happily forge you as many pairs of Goldsmith gauntlets as you desire.
translation: Tesekkürlerimin bir göstergesi olarak, istedigin kadar Goldsmith eldiveni yapmaktan mutluluk duyarim.

english: You will find the rate you gain experience when smelting gold much improved whilst wearing these gauntlets.
translation: Bu eldivenleri giydiginde altin eritirken kazandigin deneyim puani cok daha fazla olacak.

english: Thank you.
Here you go!
You're welcome.
Can you change my gauntlets for me?
Great thanks!
No that's okay thanks.
No thanks.
Could I have another pair of Goldsmith gauntlets?
translation: Bir cift daha Goldsmith eldiven alabilir miyim?

english: You're welcome.
Hey there.
Need something, iknami?
translation: Bir seye ihtiyacin var mi, iknami?

english: Not really. Just wondering what brings you out here?
translation: Hayir, yok. Buraya neden geldigini merak ettim de.

english: I'm here to trade with the dwarves here on behalf of Fortis. Stonecutter Outpost is the main supplier of the stone we use for building.
translation: Fortis adina cücelerle ticaret yapmak icin buradayim. Stonecutter Outpost, insaatta kullandigimiz taslarin ana tedarikcisi.

english: And is the trading going well?
Well it's significantly better than dealing with the dwarves in Cam Torum, but they're still not the easiest to work with.
translation: Cam Torum'daki cücelerle ticaret yapmaktan cok daha iyi, ama yine de calismasi kolay insanlar degiller.

english: Ah, well in that case, I'd better leave you to it.
translation: Ah, o halde seni rahat birakayim.

english: You have brought peace between our kingdoms, [player name].
I've instructed my people to allow you full access to our Island, but beware I do not command the undead beneath us.
translation: Halkima adamiza tam erisim izni vermelerini söyledim, ama unutma ki altimizdaki ölümsüzleri ben yönetmiyorum.

english: Now that's quite the banana. Where did you get it?
translation: Bu ne güzel bir muz. Nereden buldun?

english: Far from here, deep in the Kharidian Desert.
translation: Buradan cok uzaklarda, Kharidian Cölü'nün derinliklerinde.

english: Interesting... Continue.
You recount your experiences with the baboons in Osmumten's Tomb...
translation: Osmumten'in Mezari'ndaki babunlarla yasadigin deneyimleri anlatiyorsun...

english: Well, that was a fascinating story. We have of course heard of various troops of our kind spread across the land, but this is the first I have heard of these ones.
translation: Bu cok ilginc bir hikaye. Elbette, bu topraklara yayilmis cesitli birliklerimizi duymustuk, ama bunlardan ilk kez duyuyorum.

english: Now that we know their story, you can rest assured that their memory will live on here.
translation: Artik hikayelerini bildigimize göre, anilarinin burada yasayacagindan emin olabilirsin.

english: Thank you.
Now, about that large banana...
Here you go.
Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to answer this for me.
Please enter the answer to the question.
How can that be? Go check again!
translation: Bu nasil olabilir? Tekrar kontrol et!

english: Spot on!
King Awowogei has given you another clue scroll/a casket!
translation: Kral Awowogei sana baska bir ipucu parsömeni/bir tabut verdi!

english: Greetings, human.
I didn't realise monkeys could talk!
Some of us have learned to speak with your kind, yes. I appreciate that none of my followers were harmed during this incident.
translation: Bazilarimiz sizin türünüzle konusmayi ögrendi, evet. Bu olay sirasinda takipcilerimden hicbiri zarar görmedigi icin minnettarim.

english: Once again you have proven a friend to our kind, human. I appreciate that none of my followers were harmed.
translation: Bir kez daha bizim türümüzün dostu oldugunu kanitladin, insan. Takipcilerimden hicbiri zarar görmedigi icin minnettarim.

english: It was definitely more work than I thought it would be.
translation: Kesinlikle düsündügümden daha fazla is cikti.

english: Yes, I'd imagine so. Our kind are much more nimble than yours. I still don't know why you insist on using only two of your four legs.
translation: Evet, öyle oldugunu tahmin ediyordum. Bizim türümüz sizinkinden cok daha cevik. Hala neden dört bacaginizin sadece ikisini kullanmakta israr ettiginizi anlamiyorum.

english: I suppose I've never thought about it like that before.
translation: Sanirim bunu daha önce hic bu sekilde düsünmemistim.

english: Thank you kind madam. The town is saved and the water is flowing freely.
translation: Tesekkür ederim nazik hanimefendi. Kasaba kurtuldu ve su serbestce akiyor.

english: You're welcome.
What's more when we now pray at the shrine we now feel rejuvenated and healthier than ever!
translation: Dahasi, artik tapinakta dua ettigimizde, hic olmadigi kadar genc ve saglikli hissediyoruz!

english: That's interesting to know.
What do you think you are doing?
Errm, I'm trying to remove your soul.
What, have you lost your mind?
It's for the good of the village. I met a genie down the crevice. He told me he would give me the statuette in exchange for your soul.
translation: Bu köyün iyiligi icin. Catlakta bir cinle karsilastim. Ruhun karsiliginda bana heykelcigi verecegini söyledi.

english: That's barbaric! We'll just have to find other ways to get the town a good supply of water. Keep your knife away from me please.
translation: Bu barbarca! Kasabaya iyi bir su kaynagi saglamak icin baska yollar bulmaliyiz. Lütfen bicagini benden uzak tut.

english: 'Ello, and what are you after then?
I need another assignment.
You're actually very strong, are you sure you don't want Chaeldar in Zanaris to assign you a task?
translation: Aslinda cok güclüsün, Zanaris'teki Chaeldar'in sana bir görev vermesini istemediginden emin misin?

english: No that's okay, I'll take a task from you.
translation: Hayir, sorun degil, senden bir görev alacagim.

english: Oh okay then, I'll go talk to Chaeldar.
translation: Tamam o zaman, Chaeldar ile konusacagim.

english: Excellent, you're doing great. Your new task is to kill [amount] [task monster].
You're still hunting [task monster], you have [amount] to go.
Although, it's not an assignment that I'd normally give... I guess I could give you a new assignment, if you'd like.
translation: Aslinda bu normalde verecegim bir görev degil... Eger istersen sana yeni bir görev verebilirim.

english: If you do get a new one, you will reset your standard task streak of [task streak amount]. Is that okay? It won't affect your Wilderness task streak of [task streak amount].
No, thanks.
You're still hunting [monster], with [amount] to go.
I don't think that's a suitable task for you. Shall I cancel it? This will not wipe your task streaks.
translation: Bence bu senin icin uygun bir görev degil. Iptal edeyim mi? Bu, görev serilerini silmez.

english: Yes, please cancel it.
Alright, consider the task cancelled. You can now get a new assignment when you want one.
translation: Tamam, görev iptal edildi. Istediginde yeni bir görev alabilirsin.

english: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
Good luck with that.
Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: Bana verebileceginiz bir ödül veya takas edebilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: I have quite a few rewards you can earn, and a wide variety of Slayer equipment for sale.
translation: Kazanabileceginiz pek cok ödül ve satilik cok cesitli Avci ekipmanlari var.

english: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
The Slayer Masters may currently assign you any task in our lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: Avci Ustalar su anda savas seviyeniz ne olursa olsun listemizdeki herhangi bir görevi size verebilir.

english: That's fine - I can handle any task.
That's the spirit.
In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: Gelecekte lütfen cok zor görevler vermeyin.

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: Tamam, bundan sonra tüm Avci Ustalar sana görev verirken savas seviyeni dikkate alacaklar, bu yüzden cok zor görevler almayacaksin.

english: The Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: Avci Ustalar sana görev verirken savas seviyeni dikkate alacaklar, bu yüzden cok zor görevler almayacaksin.

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
translation: Sorun degil, cok zor görevler istemiyorum.

english: Okay, we'll keep checking your combat level.
translation: Tamam, savas seviyeni kontrol etmeye devam edecegiz.

english: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: Savas seviyemi kontrol etmeyi birakin, her seyi yapabilirim!

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will assign you anything from their lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: Tamam, bundan sonra tüm Avci Ustalar, savas seviyen ne olursa olsun, listelerinden sana herhangi bir görev verecekler.

english: Hello, I'm here about the blessed axe again.
translation: Merhaba, yine kutsanmis balta icin geldim.

english: I suppose you want a new axe?
Actually, yes.
You'll need to hand over both a mithril axe and holy symbol of Saradomin. You don't have an axe in your pack, so I'm not able to help.
translation: Hem mithril baltayi hem de Saradomin'in kutsal sembolünü teslim etmen gerekiyor. Cantanda balta yok, bu yüzden yardimci olamiyorum.

english: Here's the replacement; be more careful with this one, eh?
translation: Iste yenisi; buna daha dikkatli ol, tamam mi?

english: Not right now.
Goodbye, then. You may, of course, return if you decide you want a new axe.
translation: Hosca kalin o zaman. Tabii ki, yeni bir balta istersen geri gelebilirsiniz.

english: You already have an axe in your bag but you want another?
translation: Cantanizda zaten bir balta var ama bir tane daha mi istiyorsunuz?

english: So you're filling in for Turael?
That I am. It's been quite a while since I last did this sort of thing, but my brother wants one last adventure, so here I am.
translation: Evet. Bu tür bir seyi yapmayali epey zaman oldu ama kardesim son bir macera yasamak istiyor, o yüzden buradayim.

english: So you've done this before?
translation: Yani bunu daha önce de yaptiniz?

english: Oh yes. In fact, I was doing it before my brother was. Back in his adventuring days, I was the one here teaching people the basics.
translation: Evet. Aslinda kardesimden önce ben yapiyordum. Onun macera günlerinde, burada insanlara temel bilgileri ögreten bendim.

english: After Spria was born, he retired from his life of thrill- seeking. That's when he took over from me.
translation: Spria dogduktan sonra, heyecan arayisindan emekli oldu. O zaman benim yerimi aldi.

english: Interesting... I never knew that.
He doesn't talk about his adventures much, but once you get him going, you won't be able to make him stop!
translation: Maceralarindan pek bahsetmez, ama bir kez konusmaya basladiginda, onu durduramazsin!

english: About Turael...
You need not share your condolences with me, adventurer. I've been prepared for this for a long time.
translation: Bana taziyelerini iletmene gerek yok, maceraci. Uzun zamandir buna hazirlikliydim.

english: You have?
My brother was a thrill-seeker his whole life. Even after he retired, I always knew something would come and pull him back in.
translation: Kardesim hayati boyunca heyecan pesinde kostu. Emekli olduktan sonra bile, onu tekrar bu hayata cekecek bir seyin olacagini biliyordum.

english: And that something was me. I'm sorry...
Don't be. He died doing what he loved, and he died a hero. He wouldn't have had it any other way.
translation: Üzülme. Sevdigi seyi yaparken öldü ve bir kahraman olarak öldü. Baska türlü olmasini istemezdi.

english: Er... Nothing...
I need another assignment.
No that's okay, I'll take a task from you.
translation: Hayir, sorun degil, ben senden bir görev alacagim.

english: Oh okay then, I'll go talk to Chaeldar.
Yes, please.
No, thanks.
Yes, please cancel it.
Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: Bana verecek bir ödülün ya da takas edecek bir seyin var mi?

english: Look at rewards.
Look at shop.
Cancel.
Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
That's fine - I can handle any task.
In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: Gelecekte lütfen cok zor görevler verme.

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
translation: Sorun degil, cok zor görevler istemiyorum.

english: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: Savas seviyemi kontrol etmeyi birak, her seyi yapabilirim!

english: I'm here about blessed axes again.
Actually, yes.
I can do without for now, thanks.
So you're filling in for Turael?
About Turael...
Er... Nothing...
Hello there.
Ah, a stranger to our island. How can I help?
translation: Ah, adamiza yabanci birisi. Nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: Ah! [player name], I'm glad to see you've returned. How can I help?
translation: Ah! Maceraci, geri döndügünü görmek ne güzel. Nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: It's a very interesting house you have here. Does he have a name?
translation: Burada cok ilginc bir evin var. Bir adi var mi?

english: Why of course. It's Berty.
Berty? Berty the Chicken leg house?
translation: Berty mi? Tavuk bacagi evi Berty mi?

english: Yes.
May I ask why?
It just has that certain ring to it, don't you think? Beeerteeee!
translation: Kulaga hos geliyor, sence de öyle degil mi? Beeerteeee!

english: You're ins...
Insane? Very.
There's a lunar spell in my spell book that I can't use. Could you...?
translation: Büyü kitabimda kullanamadigim bir ay büyüsü var. Acaba...

english: Help you? Certainly. It's one I've just rediscovered! I can teach it to you if you like, but you have to listen to a story first.
translation: Yardimci olabilir miyim? Elbette. Ben de onu yeni kesfettim! Istersen sana ögretebilirim, ama önce bir hikaye dinlemelisin.

english: Okay, I don't mind hearing sto-
Wonderful!
Well, I was going through some ancient documents recently, expanding my knowledge of our great ancestors...
translation: Son zamanlarda eski belgeleri inceleyerek büyük atalarimiz hakkinda bilgimi genisletiyordum...

english: Hmm, actually, I think I had better go further back, so you will understand.
translation: Hmm, aslinda, daha geriye gitmem daha iyi olacak, böylece anlayabilirsin.

english: You know of our ancient war with the Fremennik that you recently healed?
translation: Son zamanlarda iyilestirdigin Fremenniklerle olan eski savasimizi biliyor musun?

english: Of course! I am a great diplomat, aren't I?
translation: Tabii ki! Ben harika bir diplomatim, degil mi?

english: Some diplomat. Did you even discover WHY we were at war for so long?
translation: Ne diplomat ama. Neden bu kadar uzun süre savastigimizi ögrendin mi?

english: Errr... You couldn't see eye to eye about magic, or something like that.
translation: Sey... Büyü konusunda anlasamadiniz, ya da öyle bir sey.

english: Not too far off; it goes deeper than that.
translation: Cok da uzak degil, ama daha derin bir nedeni var.

english: The Fremennik were actually the first to discover how to make runes, but there was disagreement within the tribe about the implications of making such powerful objects.
translation: Aslinda runeleri ilk kesfeden Fremenniklerdi, ama kabile icinde bu kadar güclü nesneler yapmanin sonuclari konusunda anlasmazlik vardi.

english: Most Fremennik felt we were stealing power from the gods. They could not see past that to the great things we could do with such power, so we split from them and became the Moon Clan. Our ancient leader, who first
translation: Cogu Fremennik, tanrilardan güc caldigimizi düsünüyordu. Bu gücün bize saglayacagi büyük imkanlari göremiyorlardi, bu yüzden onlardan ayrilip Ay Klani'ni kurduk. Lunar Adasi'nda rune özü madenini ilk kesfeden eski liderimiz,

english: discovered the rune essence mine here on Lunar Isle, travelled far and wide searching for more places of power. He and his followers built altars all over Gielinor - which you use today to create runes - and at their
translation: daha fazla güc kaynagi bulmak icin uzaklara seyahat etti. O ve takipcileri, bugün runeler yaratmak icin kullandiginiz Gielinor'un her yerine sunaklar insa ettiler ve en

english: height they made runes by the crateful. They had perfected the process and even advanced it, creating altars that could create any type of rune regardless of the crafter's ability. But the strife between the Moon
translation: parlak dönemlerinde sandiklar dolusu runeler yaptilar. Süreci mükemmellestirdiler ve hatta daha da gelistirdiler, zanaatkarin yeteneginden bagimsiz olarak her tür runeyi yaratabilen sunaklar yaptilar. Ancak Ay

english: Clan and the Fremennik heightened. The Fremennik had grown strong in body, while our clan had grown stong in mind. They overpowered our tribe and we retreated to Lunar Isle, where we had lived ever since.
translation: Klani ile Fremennik arasindaki catisma siddetlendi. Fremennikler bedenen güclenirken, klanimiz zihnen güclendi. Kabilemizi yenilgiye ugrattilar ve biz de o zamandan beri yasadigimiz Ay Adasi'na cekildik.

english: The Fremennik then swept over Gielinor destroying the altars we had made, in an attempt to remove all trace of magic from the land.
translation: Fremennikler daha sonra Gielinor'u ele gecirerek, topraklardan tüm sihir izlerini silmek amaciyla yaptigimiz sunaklari yok ettiler.

english: That's all very interesting, but what's it got to do with this spell?
translation: Hepsi cok ilginc, ama bunun bu büyüyle ne ilgisi var?

english: I'm getting to that!

The Fremennik were not as thorough as they thought. They destroyed only the entrances to the altars, for the altars themselves were on a different plane, but they were successful in wiping out our ability to create
translation: Fremennikler sandiklari kadar titiz degillerdi. Altarlarin girislerini yok ettiler, cünkü altarlarin kendisi farkli bir düzlemdeydi, ama runeler yaratma yetenegimizi yok etmeyi basardilar.

english: runes. That ability has only recently been rediscovered on the mainland, so I hear.
translation: Bu yetenek, duyduguma göre, anakarada ancak yakin zamanda yeniden kesfedildi.

english: Our people were left isolated on Lunar Isle but we used it to our advantage. Our control over Magic advanced beyond the need for runes and all knowledge of the altar locations passed from memory. Fortunately,
translation: Halkimiz Lunar Isle'da izole kaldi, ama biz bunu avantajimiza kullandik. Büyü üzerindeki kontrolümüz runelere ihtiyac duymayacak kadar gelisti ve sunaklarin yerleri hakkindaki tüm bilgiler hafizalardan silindi. Neyse ki

english: some records survived... The manuscript I discovered contains the teleportation spell to an advanced altar called Ourania. It's an altar that allows the user, regardless of their Runecrafting ability, to craft any
translation: bazi kayitlar günümüze ulasti... Kesfettigim el yazmasi, Ourania adli gelismis bir sunak icin teleportasyon büyüsünü iceriyor. Bu sunak, kullanicinin Runecrafting yetenegi ne olursa olsun, üzerinde herhangi bir

english: type of rune upon it. Ourania is a powerful altar indeed. What state it is in after so many millennia, I know not, but it's interesting all the same.
translation: tür rune olusturabilecegi bir sunak. Ourania gercekten de cok güclü bir sunak. Binlerce yil sonra ne durumda oldugunu bilmiyorum, ama yine de ilginc.

english: So, will you teach me the spell?
Certainly.
*Baby Yaga whispers in your ear*
And now you know the teleportation spell, off with you! Go explore.
translation: Artik isinlanma büyüsünü ögrendin, hadi git! Kesfe cik.

english: I don't really have ti-
*Sigh* Very well. Another time, perhaps.
translation: *Ic ceker* Pekala. Belki baska bir zaman.

english: Why do you ask questions if you're going to read my mind anyway?
translation: Zaten aklimi okuyacaksan neden soru soruyorsun?

english: I was being polite, silly foreigner.
I'm good thanks, bye.
Ah, a stranger to our island. What brings you here?
translation: Ah, adamiza yabanci birisi. Seni buraya ne getirdi?

english: The Oneiromancer told me you may be able to help...
With a potion?
I don't think I'll ever get used to you people reading my mind. Yes, a potion of Waking Sleep? I need it to go to the...
translation: Sizin zihnimi okumaniza hic alisamayacagim galiba. Evet, Uyanik Uyku iksiri mi? Ona ihtiyacim var, cünkü...

english: Dreamland.
You know that's really quite rude!
translation: Bunun cok kaba oldugunu biliyor musun?

english: Sorry. Carry on.
Well, I was hoping you could tell me how to make one?
translation: Peki, nasil yapildigini bana söyleyebilir misin?

english: Of course.
Are you sure you're ready to take on the dream land?
translation: Rüya diyarini kesfetmeye hazir olduguna emin misin?

english: There's no harm in trying. Right...?
translation: Denemenin bir zarari yok. Degil mi...?

english: Well, some people have gone mad from visiting their dreams.
translation: Bazi insanlar rüyalarini ziyaret ettikten sonra delirdi.

english: You really know how to instil discomfort don't you!?! How do you make...
translation: Insani gercekten rahatsiz etmeyi iyi biliyorsun! Nasil yapiliyor...

english: You'll need 1 guam leaf, 1 Marrentill leaf and a Suqah tooth ground using a pestle and mortar. Combine these in a vial and BAM! You've got your potion! You should be able to get the ingredients from the
translation: 1 guam yapragi, 1 Marrentill yapragi ve havanda ezilmis bir Suqah disi gerekir. Bunlari bir sisede karistir ve BAM! Iksirin hazir! Malzemeleri

english: Suqah monsters.
You'll also need a special vial, I have one here.
translation: alabilirsin. Ayrica özel bir siseye ihtiyacin olacak, bende var.

english: Thanks.
Have you got anything to trade?
translation: Takas edecek bir seyin var mi?

english: It's a very interesting house you have here.
There is a lunar spell I can't use in my spell book - can you help me?
translation: Büyü kitabimda kullanamadigim bir ay büyüsü var, bana yardim edebilir misin?

english: Okay, I don't mind hearing stories.
I don't really have time right now.
I'm good, thanks, bye.
Hey, Mole. How is life above ground?
translation: Selam Mole. Yer üstünde hayat nasil?

english: Well, the last time I was above ground, I was having to contend with people throwing snow at some weird yellow duck in my park.
translation: En son yer üstündeyken, parkimdaki garip sari ördege kar atan insanlarla ugrasmak zorunda kaldim.

english: Why were they doing that?
No idea, I didn't stop to ask as an angry mob was closing in on them pretty quickly.
translation: Hicbir fikrim yok, öfkeli bir kalabalik hizla onlara yaklasirken durup sormadim.

english: Sounds awful.
Anyway, keep Molin'!
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
Squeak squeak!
Squeaka squeaka!
Squeee
Squeak
Hello Bailey.
Well, hello again, [player name]. What brings you back out here?
translation: Merhaba, Maceraci. Seni buraya ne getirdi?

english: Just looking around.
Well, be very careful out there! Those dratted slugs have been joined by giant lobsters!
translation: Disarida cok dikkatli ol! O lanet sümüklü böceklerin yanina dev istakozlar da katildi!

english: Good day [Sir/Madame]. Would you like some nice freshly baked bread? Or perhaps a nice piece of cake?
translation: Iyi günler . Taze pismis güzel bir ekmek ister misiniz? Ya da belki güzel bir parca kek?

english: No thank you.
Hey! Get your hands off there!
You're the one who stole something from me!
Guardsguards!
Let's see what you have.
No thank you.
You've tried the rest, but how about the best? Our baked goods won't be beaten!
translation: Digerlerini denedin, peki ya en iyisini? Firin ürünlerimiz rakipsizdir!

english: Let's see what you have.
I'm good.
Hmph!
I'm good.
Humans!
Destroy them! Our king must be freed!
It will be done.
With me [Fremennik name]! Let's kill these foul beasts!
translation: Benimle birlikte Dokrak! Bu igrenc canavarlari öldürelim!

english: At long last, I have been granted freedom. You have done well Bakuna.
translation: Sonunda özgürlügüme kavustum. Iyi is cikardin Bakuna.

english: I exist to serve.
Good, for I have one final use of you. My long rest has weakened me, you will grant me strength.
translation: Güzel, cünkü senden son bir kez daha yararlanacagim. Uzun süren dinlenmem beni zayiflatti, sen bana güc vereceksin.

english: The Jormungand kills Bakuna in one hit
Power!
This isn't over yet [Fremennik name], the Jormungand is weak from his imprisonment! We can still stop him!
translation: Henüz bitmedi Dokrak, Jormungand hapis hayatindan dolayi zayiflamis! Onu hala durdurabiliriz!

english: Humans, you have been bestowed with a great honour, for you are about to become the first of your kind in millennia to feed my power!
translation: Insanlar, size büyük bir onur bahsedildi, cünkü bin yildir türünüzün ilk üyesi olarak benim gücümü besleyeceksiniz!

english: Rejoice with me, for your miserable lives are finally at an end!
translation: Benimle birlikte sevin, cünkü sefil hayatlariniz sonunda sona erdi!

english: You will not defeat us this day! Come [Fremennik name]!
Get out of this village. You are not welcome here.
So you're the one who freed Azzanadra from his prison? Thank you, kind [sir/lady]!
translation: Demek Azzanadra'yi hapishanesinden kurtaran sensin? Tesekkürler, nazik !

english: Time to die, Saradominist filth!
Prepare to suffer, Zamorakian scum!
You chose the wrong place to start trouble!
translation: Sorun cikarmak icin yanlis yeri sectin!

english: You dare steal from me?
Hello.
What do you want?
Nothing really, I'm new to town and wanted to get to know the locals.
translation: Aslinda bir sey istemiyorum, bu kasabaya yeni geldim ve yerlileri tanimak istedim.

english: I'm too busy for chitchat. Come back if you have some business to discuss with us.
translation: Sohbet etmek icin cok mesgulüm. Bizimle görüsecek bir isin varsa tekrar gel.

english: You dog! You killed our champion and for that you will die!
translation: Seni köpek! Sampiyonumuzu öldürdün ve bunun icin öleceksin!

english: Hello.
Stuff for sale. You buying?
No? 'Bye then.
translation: Hayir mi? O zaman hosca kal.

english: Yes
No
Gggggrrrrrrrrr!!!
Yes?
Who are you?
Banisoch.
Thanks, that was informative.
It leads to the caves beneath this part of the island. I think there's dragons at the other end; you can hear the noises and smell the smoke coming up the passage.
translation: Bu yol, adanin bu kisminin altindaki magaralara gidiyor. Sanirim diger ucunda ejderhalar var; gecitten gelen sesleri duyabilir ve dumani koklayabilirsin.

english: Can I go down?
Eh, I could sort something out for you. Thing is, my brother's got a job guarding the main entrance to the caves. I'd be undercutting him if I let people go down this hole.
translation: Eh, senin icin bir seyler ayarlayabilirim. Sorun su ki, kardesim magaralarin ana girisini korumakla görevli. Insanlarin bu delikten asagi inmesine izin verirsem, onun isini elinden almis olurum.

english: Oh, does this mean you won't let me go in?
translation: Oh, bu, beni iceri sokmayacagin anlamina mi geliyor?

english: No, it means I'd need something to assuage my conscience after betraying my brother. 5,000 trading sticks ought to cheer me up nicely.
translation: Hayir, kardesimizi ihanet ettikten sonra vicdanimi rahatlatacak bir seye ihtiyacim oldugu anlamina geliyor. 5.000 ticaret cubugu beni oldukca neselendirecektir.

english: Oh.
It's a deal - here's 5,000 trading sticks.
Um, no thanks.
Never mind.
Never mind.
I'll leave you alone.
Can I climb down that hole now?
Yes, you've paid, you can climb down there whenever you like. Go, go.
translation: Evet, parayi ödedin, istedigin zaman inebilirsin. Git, git.

english: Why are you waiting by this hole?
Ever seen a toilet around here?
Actually, never mind.
Hey, I didn't say you could do that!
Either go down it or don't go down it, but stop messing around with it!
translation: Ya in ya da inme, ama onunla ugrasmayi birak!

english: Who are you?
Tell me about this hole.
translation: Bu delik hakkinda bana bilgi ver.

english: Can I go down?
It's a deal - here's 5,000 trading sticks.
Um, no thanks.
I'll leave you alone.
Can I climb down that hole now?
Why are you waiting by this hole?
Actually, never mind.
What are you doing here?
What does it look like I'm doing? I'm here to help cleanse the Devourer's corruption from this sacred place.
translation: Ne yapiyormusum gibi görünüyor? Bu kutsal yerden Yiyici'nin yozlasmasini temizlemek icin buradayim.

english: I didn't expect a camel to be capable of standing up to such a strong enemy. Aren't you worried for your safety?
translation: Bir devenin bu kadar güclü bir düsmana karsi koyabilecegini beklemiyordum. Güvenliginden endiselenmiyor musun?

english: Not particularly. We camels are known for our durability in harsh environments. I think you should be more concerned about yourself. You humans seem so much more fragile than many other species.
translation: Özellikle degil. Biz develer, zorlu ortamlarda dayanikliligimizla biliniriz. Bence sen kendini daha cok düsünmelisin. Siz insanlar, diger bircok türden cok daha kirilgan görünüyorsunuz.

english: I'm sure I'll be fine, but I appreciate your concern.
translation: Eminim bir sey olmaz, ama endisen icin tesekkür ederim.

english: How did you get all my stuff?
I don't have any of your stuff.
Oh yeah, I don't use a bank!
Good for you.
Don't you understand how banking works? I don't have all of your stuff, I have simply been trained to access the place where it is all stored.
translation: Bankaciligin nasil isledigini anlamiyor musun? Senin esyalarinin hepsine sahip degilim, sadece hepsinin saklandigi yere erismek icin egitildim.

english: But you're a camel. I didn't know camels could train to become bankers.
translation: Ama sen bir deve'sin. Develerin bankaci olmak icin egitilebilecegini bilmiyordum.

english: Well there are ghost bankers, gnome bankers, dwarf bankers, goblin bankers and more! Is it really all that surprising that camels can do it too?
translation: Hayalet bankacilar, cüce bankacilar, goblin bankacilar ve daha fazlasi var! Develerin de bunu yapabilmesi o kadar sasirtici mi?

english: I suppose when you put it like that...
So, what do you make of all this?
What do you mean?
I mean everything that's been going on here. It seems like a lot to take in.
translation: Burada olan her seyi kastediyorum. Anlamasi zor gibi görünüyor.

english: Well, it really was inevitable, which is a shame really. It saddens me to see what has happened to this tomb.
translation: Aslinda bu kacinilmazdi, ki bu gercekten üzücü. Bu mezara olanlari görmek beni üzüyor.

english: Well at least we're fixing it now.
We? Are you sure about that? I find you adventurers often have ulterior motives.
translation: Biz mi? Bundan emin misin? Siz maceracilarin genellikle gizli amaclari oldugunu düsünüyorum.

english: What do you mean by that?
You may say that you are here to fight the corruption. Indeed, there may be some truth to that. However, would you really be here if there wasn't something for you to gain?
translation: Buraya yozlasmayla savasmak icin geldigini söyleyebilirsin. Aslinda, bunda bir parca dogruluk olabilir. Ancak, kazanacak bir seyin olmasaydi gercekten burada olur muydun?

english: I swear, I'm only here to deal with the Devourer's corruption!
translation: Yemin ederim, ben sadece Yiyici'nin yozlasmasiyla ilgilenmek icin buradayim!

english: I hear you speak those words, but I feel no conviction behind them.
translation: Sözlerini duyuyorum, ama arkasinda bir inanc hissetmiyorum.

english: How can I prove it to you? What is it that you are looking for?
translation: Sana bunu nasil kanitlayabilirim? Ne ariyorsun?...

english: Why do you care what opinions a camel has of you?
translation: Bir devenin senin hakkinda ne düsündügü neden umurunda?

english: I want everyone to like me.
If your only goal in life is to be liked by all, then you'll probably spend the rest of it chasing the impossible.
translation: Hayattaki tek amacin herkes tarafindan sevilmekse, muhtemelen hayatinin geri kalanini imkansizi kovalayarak gecireceksin.

english: I want to prove you wrong.
So you only care because my words cut close to the bone? If you truly want to prove me wrong, then it's your outlook that should change.
translation: Yani sadece sözlerim canini yaktigi icin mi umurunda? Gercekten yanildigimi kanitlamak istiyorsan, degismesi gereken senin bakis acin.

english: It seems to be important to you.
You think so?
I do, so tell me, what can I do to show you that not all adventurers are the same?
translation: Evet, öyleyse söyle bana, tüm maceracilar ayni olmadigini sana göstermek icin ne yapabilirim?

english: Hmm...
Every adventurer seems to destroy without any thought as to what they are doing, nor with any intent to restore what was lost.
translation: Her maceraci, ne yaptigini düsünmeden ve kaybedilenleri geri getirme niyetinde olmadan her seyi yok ediyor gibi görünüyor.

english: If you can do that, then that would prove to me that you are infact different from the rest.
translation: Bunu yapabilirsen, bana digerlerinden farkli oldugunu kanitlamis olursun.

english: Restore what was lost? What do you mean by that?
translation: Kaybedilenleri geri getirmek mi? Ne demek istiyorsun?

english: That's for you to figure out.
What did you ask me to do again?
So you want me to restore what was lost?
Indeed.
I believe I understand now.
Oh? Do tell.

Well, while us adventurers have been doing our best to fight against the Devourer's corruption, we've been neglecting what has been lost to achieve that goal. Namely, the four guardians we defeated along the way.
translation: Biz maceracilar, Yiyici'nin yozlasmasina karsi savasmak icin elimizden geleni yaparken, bu hedefe ulasmak icin kaybedilenleri ihmal ettik. Yani, yol boyunca yendigimiz dört koruyucu.

english: Ba-Ba was a proud baboon who wished for her troop to flourish. To honour her, I made sure that they won't be forgotten by telling their story to the monkeys of Ape Atoll.
translation: Ba-Ba, sürüsünün gelismesini isteyen gururlu bir babundu. Onu onurlandirmak icin, Ape Atoll'daki maymunlara onlarin hikayesini anlatarak unutulmamalarini sagladim.

english: Akkha was cruelly denied death by the Devourer, so I gave his ashes to the High Priest of Icthlarin to give him a proper send-off.
translation: Akkha, Devourer tarafindan acimasizca ölümden mahrum birakildi, bu yüzden onun küllerini Icthlarin'in Bas Rahibine vererek ona uygun bir veda töreni düzenledim.

english: Zebak was fooled into leaving his home and confined within the tomb, so I took his fang and buried it on an island surrounded by crocodiles.
translation: Zebak, kandirilarak evini terk etmek zorunda kaldi ve mezara hapsedildi, bu yüzden onun disini alip timsahlarla cevrili bir adaya gömdüm.

english: Kephri was promised a future for her race, but it was all a lie. I found a scarab egg within some of her dung, and I gave it to the High Priest of Scabaras to try and nurture it.
translation: Kephri'ye irkinin gelecegi icin söz verildi, ama hepsi yalandi. Onun diskisi icinde bir bokböcegi yumurtasi buldum ve onu Scabaras'in Bas Rahibine vererek yetistirmesini istedim.

english: Well well, colour me impressed adventurer. It seems that you do care after all.
translation: Vay vay, beni etkilemissin maceraci. Görünüse göre sen de önemsiyormussun.

english: It's a shame that much of the damage cannot truly be undone, but I know that Het, Apmeken, Crondis and even Scabaras will be grateful for your actions.
translation: Hasarin cogunun gercekten geri alinamamasi üzücü, ama Het, Apmeken, Crondis ve hatta Scabaras'in senin eylemlerine minnettar olacagini biliyorum.

english: I just wish there was more I could do.
We always do, but you have still done more than most.
translation: Hepimiz öyle isteriz, ama sen cogu kisiden daha fazlasini yaptin.

english: Now, I have something for you. I've been looking for someone worthy enough to pass this on to.
translation: Simdi, sana bir seyim var. Bunu verecek kadar degerli birini ariyordum.

english: A key? What's this for?
translation: Bir anahtar mi? Bu ne icin?

english: I'll leave that as another puzzle for you to solve.
translation: Bunu da cözmen gereken bir baska bulmaca olarak birakacagim.

english: Well thanks, I guess... You know, out of all the camels I've met, you're definitely the strangest one.
translation: Tesekkürler, sanirim... Biliyorsun, tanistigim tüm develer arasinda sen kesinlikle en tuhaf olanisin.

english: Well, it does take a special kind of camel to master the portal magic used for bank access.
translation: Bankaya erisim icin kullanilan portal büyüsünü ustalasmak icin özel bir deve olmak gerekir.

english: I've lost that key you gave me.
And it conveniently found its way back to me. Try not to lose it this time.
translation: Ve anahtar bir sekilde bana geri geldi. Bu sefer kaybetmemeye calis.

english: Do you have a name?
My name is my own, adventurer. It's hardly important right now.
translation: Adim bana ait, maceraci. Su anda pek önemli degil.

english: I suppose you've earned the right to know. My name is Cam the Camel.
translation: Sanirim bunu bilmeye hakkin var. Adim Deve Cam.
