english: Well, nice to meet you, Cam the Camel. It'll be nice to call you something other than 'the bank camel' from now on.
translation: Tanistigimiza memnun oldum, Deve Cam. Bundan sonra sana “banka devesi” disinda baska bir isimle hitap etmek güzel olacak.

english: I'm glad I met a kind adventurer such as yourself. I look forward to seeing you continue your diligent work in cleansing this tomb of the Devourer's corruption.
translation: Senin gibi nazik bir maceraci ile tanistigima sevindim. Yutucu'nun yozlasmisligini bu mezardan temizlemek icin gayretli calismalarini sürdürmeni sabirsizlikla bekliyorum.

english: As I said, my name is Cam the Camel.
translation: Dedigim gibi, benim adim Deve Cam.

english: Can you follow me into the tomb?
Why would I want to do that?
It would be very helpful. Think of all the supplies I'd have access to if you came with me and followed me around like a portable bank.
translation: Cok yardimci olur. Benimle gelip, tasinabilir bir banka gibi pesimden dolasirsan, kullanabilecegim tüm malzemeleri bir düsün.

english: But you don't even use a bank.
Oh yeah! I forgot.
Right...
What do you take me for? Some kind of pack yak?
translation: Beni ne saniyorsun? Bir tür yük yak mi?

english: Besides, if I leave this place then I won't be able to help any other adventurers with their banking needs.
translation: Ayrica, buradan ayrilirsam diger maceracilarin bankacilik ihtiyaclarina yardimci olamayacagim.

english: I need to get going.
Suit yourself.
Bleh, this grain is disgusting! Do you think I am but a simple cow, adventurer?
translation: Iyy, bu tahil igrenc! Beni basit bir inek mi saniyorsun, maceraci?

english: No, no, I was just...
This is why I eat the grain in that sack over there. It's specially grown out here in the desert. Once harvested, it goes through a preparation process of several years that...
translation: Bu yüzden suradaki cuvaldaki tahili yiyorum. Bu tahil, burada cölde özel olarak yetistiriliyor. Hasat edildikten sonra, birkac yil süren bir hazirlik sürecinden geciyor...

english: The bank camel talks at length about the process of producing such fine grain...
translation: Banka devesi, bu kadar kaliteli tahilin üretim sürecini uzun uzun anlatiyor...

english: ...and that's why this grain is so special. Not to mention so hard to come by.
translation: ...ve bu tahilin bu kadar özel olmasinin nedeni de bu. Tabii bulmasi da cok zor.

english: My, this is some good grain, adventurer! Great flavour profile, not too salty and with just a hint of sweetness. It almost reminds me of...
translation: Vay canina, bu tahil cok iyi, maceraci! Lezzeti harika, cok tuzlu degil ve hafif bir tatliligi var. Bana neredeyse...

english: The bank camel looks at you for a moment as if lost in thought.
translation: Banka devesi bir anligina düsüncelere dalmis gibi sana bakar.

english: Erm, yes?
Oh, never mind, I was just thinking about something.
translation: Oh, bos ver, sadece bir sey düsünüyordum.

english: The bank camel stares at you in silence for an uncomfortably long time.
translation: Banka devesi rahatsiz edici bir süre sessizce sana bakar.

english: Well, I can't stand around here all day. I've got some things I need to take care of.
translation: Eh, bütün gün burada duramam. Halletmem gereken bazi isler var.

english: The bank camel looks at you with piqued interest, then rolls their eyes as they realise you can't understand them.
translation: Banka devesi sana ilgiyle bakar, sonra seni anlayamadigini fark edince gözlerini devirir.

english: Quite the banana you have there! Ba-Ba and her baboon troop were always known for finding the biggest of these. It's a shame that their memory will now disappear into history.
translation: Ne güzel bir muzun var! Ba-Ba ve babun sürüsü her zaman en büyük olanlari bulmakla ünlüydü. Onlarin hatiralarinin artik tarihe karisacak olmasi ne yazik.

english: Ah, the fang of the mighty Zebak. What a cruel fate to be consumed by ever-lasting hunger.
translation: Ah, güclü Zebak'in disi. Sonsuz aclikla tüketilmek ne aci bir kader.

english: Ah, the ashes of Akkha, a great warrior. It's a shame that his soul never got to experience the release of death.
translation: Ah, büyük savasci Akkha'nin külleri. Ruhunun ölümün kurtulusunu hic deneyimleyememesi ne yazik.

english: Faeces! How lovely. If I'm not mistaken, this dung is from Kephri herself, last of the dawn scarabs. It's a shame that her kind have long been lost to the world.
translation: Diski! Ne güzel. Yanilmiyorsam, bu gübre safak böceklerinin sonuncusu Kephri'ye ait. Onun türünün dünyadan coktan yok olmasi ne yazik.

english: You go to search the sack, but the bank camel glares at you menacingly and spits in your direction.
translation: Cuvali aramaya gidersin, ama banka devesi sana tehditkar bir sekilde bakar ve sana dogru tükürür.

english: Hey, get your hands off my food! Unless you'd like me to start eating the contents of your bank instead!
translation: Hey, ellerini yemegimden cek! Yoksa senin bankanin icindekileri yemeye baslayayim mi?

english: Jokes on you! I don't have a bank!
Well I hope you're very proud of yourself. Your arbitrary restrictions don't make you better than everyone else, you know.
translation: Umarim kendinle gurur duyuyorsundur. Keyfi kisitlamalarin seni digerlerinden daha iyi yapmaz, biliyorsun.

english: Wow, that's harsh.
translation: Vay canina, bu cok sert oldu.

english: Wow! A needle in a hay sack?
translation: Vay canina! Saman cuvalinda igne mi?

english: Wait, isn't it supposed to be a stack, not a sack?
translation: Dur, cuval degil de yigin olmasi gerekmiyor mu?

english: And now that I think about it, this sack is full of grain, not hay...
translation: Simdi düsününce, bu cuval saman degil tahil dolu...

english: Ah well, never mind.
It's just grain...
Well, I'm not entirely sure what else I expected.
What are you doing here?
How did you get all my stuff?
So, what do you make of all this?
I swear, I'm only here to deal with the Devourer's corruption!
translation: Yemin ederim, ben sadece Yiyici'nin yozlasmasiyla ilgilenmek icin buradayim!

english: I want everyone to like me.
I want to prove you wrong.
It seems to be important to you.
translation: Bu senin icin önemli gibi görünüyor.

english: What did you ask me to do again?
I believe I understand now.
I've lost that key you gave me.
Do you have a name?
Can you follow me into the tomb?
I need to get going.
Yes?
Hello. Can I deposit my stuff here?
No. I'm a security guard, not a bank clerk.
translation: Hayir. Ben güvenlik görevlisiyim, banka memuru degil.

english: That wall doesn't look very good.
No, it doesn't.
Are you going to tell me what happened?
I could do.
Ok, go on!
Someone smashed the wall when they were robbing the bank.
Someone's robbed the bank?
Yes.
But... was anyone hurt? Did they get anything valuable?
translation: Ama... kimse yaralandi mi? Degerli bir sey caldilar mi?

english: Yes, but we were able to get more staff and mend the wall easily enough.
translation: Evet, ama daha fazla personel getirip duvari kolayca onarabildik.

english: The Bank has already replaced all the stolen items that belonged to customers.
translation: Banka, müsterilere ait calinan tüm esyalari zaten yeniledi.

english: Oh, good... but the bank staff got hurt?
translation: Oh, iyi... ama banka personeli yaralandi mi?

english: Yes, but the new ones are just as good.
translation: Evet, ama yenileri de ayni derecede iyi.

english: You're not very nice, are you?
No-one's expecting me to be nice.
Anyway... So, someone's robbed the bank?
translation: Neyse... Yani, biri bankayi soydu mu?

english: Do you know who did it?
We are fairly sure we know who the robber was. The security recording was damaged in the attack, but it still shows his face clearly enough.
translation: Soyguncunun kim oldugunu oldukca emin bir sekilde biliyoruz. Güvenlik kamerasi saldirida hasar gördü, ama yine de yüzünü yeterince net gösteriyor.

english: You've got a security recording?
Yes. Our insurers insisted that we install a magical scrying orb.
translation: Evet. Sigortacilarimiz sihirli bir kristal küre kurmamizda israr etti.

english: Can I see the recording?
I suppose so. But it's quite long.
That's ok, show me the recording.
Alright... The bank's magical playback device will feed the recorded images into your mind. Just shut your eyes.
translation: Tamam... Bankanin sihirli oynatma cihazi kaydedilen görüntüleri zihninize aktaracak. Gözlerinizi kapatin.

english: You close your eyes and watch the recording...
Bank robbery recording plays
End of recording.
Thanks, maybe another day.
Ok.
So who was the robber?
I can't disclose that information.
Alright, I'll stop bothering you now.
translation: Tamam, sizi daha fazla rahatsiz etmeyecegim.

english: Good day, [sir/ma'am].
Sorry, I don't want anything.
Do you have any idea who robbed the bank yet?
translation: Banka soyguncusunun kim oldugunu bulabildiniz mi?

english: The robber in the recording looked familiar.
Oh, you recognised him too?
translation: Oh, siz de onu tanidiniz mi?

english: Yes, and I can tell you where he lives.
translation: Evet, ve size nerede yasadigini söyleyebilirim.

english: Thanks, but we already know where to find our suspect.
translation: Tesekkürler, ama süphelinin nerede oldugunu zaten biliyoruz.

english: Yes, and he's admitted that he did the robbery!
translation: Evet, ve soygunu yaptigini itiraf etti!

english: The amount of evidence against him makes that almost unnecessary.
translation: Aleyhindeki kanitlar o kadar cok ki, buna gerek kalmadi.

english: So are you going to have him arrested?
We're certainly keeping an eye on him. I'm afraid I can't give you any more details about the case.
translation: Onu kesinlikle gözetim altinda tutuyoruz. Maalesef size bu davayla ilgili daha fazla bilgi veremem.

english: Fair enough.
Can I see that recording again, please?
translation: O kaydi tekrar izleyebilir miyim lütfen?

english: I'd like you to pay me 50 gp first.
I'm not carrying that much.
Oh well, maybe another day.
As a bank employee, I suppose I could take the money directly from your bank account.
translation: Banka calisani olarak, parayi dogrudan banka hesabindan cekebilirim.

english: Ok, you can take 50 gp from my bank account.
Ok, here's 50 gp.
Can I deposit my stuff here?
That wall doesn't look very good.
Alright, I'll stop bothering you now.
Are you going to tell me what happened?
Can I see the recording?
That's ok, show me the recording.
Thanks, maybe another day.
So who was the robber?
Sorry, I don't want anything.
The robber in the recording looked familiar.
Can I see that recording again, please?
Ok, you can take 50 gp from my bank account.
Ok, here's 50 gp.
Good day, how may I help you?
I'd like to buy more bank slots.
translation: Daha fazla banka yuvasi satin almak istiyorum.

english: Why? You don't use the bank.
Oh yeah... Never mind then.
I can sell you up to [number] additional bank slots in sets of 40. How many are you interested in buying?
[number] slots please.
Buying [number] additional bank slots will cost [number] coins. Be warned, this purchase is not reversible. Are you happy to proceed?
Oh... I don't seem to have enough money for that. Never mind.
translation: Oh... Bunun icin yeterli param yok gibi görünüyor. Bos verin.

english: Yes, I'm happy with that.
Your additional bank slots have been added.
Actually, I've changed my mind.
I'm afraid not! You've already got as much bank space as you can obtain without purchase.
translation: Maalesef olmaz! Satin almadan elde edebileceginiz kadar banka alani zaten var.

english: I'm not supposed to tell you this, but you can obtain more bank space by [setting up a PIN], [setting up an Authenticator] [or] [upgrading to a Jagex Account].
translation: Bunu size söylememem gerekir, ancak [PIN ayarlayarak], [Authenticator ayarlayarak] [veya] [Jagex Hesabina yükseltme yaparak] daha fazla banka alani elde edebilirsiniz.

english: What is this place?
This is a branch of the Bank of Gielinor. We have branches in many towns.
translation: Burasi Gielinor Bankasi'nin bir subesi. Bircok kasabada subelerimiz var.

english: And what do you do?
We will look after your items and money for you. Leave your valuables with us if you want to keep them safe.
translation: Esyalarinizi ve paranizi sizin icin sakliyoruz. Degerli esyalarinizi güvende tutmak istiyorsaniz bize birakabilirsiniz.

english: Party! Party!
Something's happening in the party room!
Everyone get to the party room!
What's happening in the party room?
Someone's having a big party!
Get to the party room NOW!
Get to the party room!
Get to the party room quick!
Big value items in the party room now!
translation: Parti odasinda cok degerli esyalar var!

english: Quick! Get to the party room!
I'd like to access my bank account, please.
I'd like to check my PIN settings.
I'd like to collect items.
I'd like to buy more bank slots.
translation: Daha fazla banka yuvasi satin almak istiyorum.

english: [number] slots ([number] coins):
Yes.
No.
Do I have any other options for extra bank space?
translation: Ekstra banka alani icin baska seceneklerim var mi?

english: (Cancel)
What is this place?
Hello, surface dweller! How can I help you?
translation: Merhaba, yüzey sakini! Nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: This is the Bank of Dorgesh-Kaan! Since surface dwellers began coming into the city, we've made an arrangement with the Bank of Gielinor on the surface, so we can act as one of their branches.

Can I buy you a drink?
Can I fight you?
Um...
Flee puny mortals!
Oh no!
Ahhhh!
I don't want to die!
Help!
No, please!
Not today!
Somebody help!
The patrons flee momentarily, and then calm down.
translation: Müsteriler bir anligina kacar, sonra sakinlesir.

english: Yaaaay!
Woooooooo!
Boogie Woogie!
Paarrttyyyyyy!
The monastery is saved!
Well done [player name] and Iffie!
What a lovely pub this is!
translation: Ne kadar güzel bir pub bu!

english: Isn't it just.
Alfred's the name, Bartending's the game.
Pleasure.
Wait a minute, Bar. Alfred.
*Alfred chuckles*
Oh my, you're Alfred Grimhand?!
translation: Aman Tanrim, sen Alfred Grimhand misin?!

english: My barcrawl is still used to this day?
translation: Bar turum hala devam ediyor mu?

english: It's legendary.
Originally it was a funny prank back in the day for new recruits.
translation: Baslangicta yeni ise baslayanlar icin yapilan komik bir sakaydi.

english: They seem to take it very seriously now.
translation: Simdi cok ciddiye aliyorlar gibi görünüyor.

english: Ha Ha, amazing.
I do miss that bunch of barbs...
You see a tear come from Alfred's eye. Then he swiftly wipes it away.
translation: Alfred'in gözünden bir damla yas akar. Sonra hizla siler.

english: Shall we have a drink?
Absolutely.
Light beer
Eggnog
Mulled pine
Have a splendid day [player name]!
Oi, whaddya want?
I want to come through this gate.
Barbarians only. Are you a barbarian? You don't look like one.
translation: Sadece barbarlar girebilir. Barbar misin? Öyle görünmüyorsun.

english: Hmm, yep you've got me there.
Looks can be deceiving, I am in fact a barbarian.
translation: Görünüs aldatici olabilir, aslinda ben bir barbarim.

english: If you're a barbarian you need to be able to drink like one. We barbarians like a good drink.
translation: Eger barbar isen, bir barbar gibi icebilmelisin. Biz barbarlar iyi ickiyi severiz.

english: I have the perfect challenge for you... The Alfred Grimhand Barcrawl! First completed by Alfred Grimhand.
translation: Senin icin mükemmel bir meydan okuma var... Alfred Grimhand Barcrawl! Ilk kez Alfred Grimhand tarafindan tamamlandi.

english: The guard hands you a Barcrawl card.
translation: Muhafiz sana bir Barcrawl karti verir.

english: Take that card to each of the bars named on it. The bartenders will know what it means. We're kinda well known.
translation: Bu karti üzerinde adi gecen her bara götür. Barmenler bunun ne anlama geldigini bilir. Biz oldukca taniniriz.

english: They'll give you their strongest drink and sign your card. When you've done all that, we'll be happy to let you in.
translation: Sana en sert ickilerini verip kartini imzalayacaklar. Bunlari tamamladiginda, seni iceri almaktan mutluluk duyariz.

english: I want some money.
Do I look like a bank to you?
So, how's the Barcrawl coming along?
I haven't finished it yet.
Well come back when you have, you lightweight.
I've lost my barcrawl card...
What are you like? You're gonna have to start all over now.
translation: Ne haldesin sen? Simdi bastan baslamak zorundasin.

english: I tink I jusht 'bout done dem all... but I losht count...
translation: Sanirim hepsini bitirdim... ama sayisini unuttum...

english: Yep that seems fine, you can come in now. I never learned to read, but you look like you’ve drunk plenty. Also, one more thing…
translation: Evet, sorun yok, simdi girebilirsin. Okumayi hic ögrenmedim, ama cok icmis gibi görünüyorsun. Ayrica, bir sey daha...

english: Since you drink like a barbarian, I can show you how to smash your vials when you finish them. Do you want to do that?
translation: Barbar gibi ictigine göre, siseleri bitirdiginde nasil kiracagini gösterebilirim. Bunu yapmak ister misin?

english: Yes please, I want to smash my vials.
It’s all part of drinking like a barbarian! Okay, you will now smash your vials as you drink your potions.
translation: Barbar gibi icmenin bir parcasi bu! Tamam, artik iksirlerini icerken siselerini parcalayacaksin.

english: No thank you, I'd rather keep my vials.
'Ello friend. I see you're drinking like a barbarian - do you want to stop smashing your vials when you finish them?
translation: Merhaba dostum. Barbar gibi iciyorsun galiba - siselerini bitirdiginde parcalamayi birakmak ister misin?

english: Yes please, I want to stop smashing my vials.
translation: Evet lütfen, siselerimi parcalamayi birakmak istiyorum.

english: You're a funny sort of barbarian! But okay, you will no longer smash your vials as you drink your potions.
translation: Sen komik bir barbarsin! Ama tamam, artik iksirlerini icerken siselerini kirmayacaksin.

english: No thank you, I like smashing them.
That's a proper barbarian spirit, that is.
'Ello friend. Do you want me to show you how to smash your vials when you finish drinking them?
translation: Selam dostum. Icmeyi bitirdiginde siselerini nasil kiracagini göstereyim mi?

english: It's all part of drinking like a barbarian! Okay, you will now smash your vials as you drink your potions.
translation: Hepsi barbar gibi icmenin bir parcasi! Tamam, artik iksirlerini icerken siselerini kiracaksin.

english: I want to come through this gate.
Hmm, yep you've got me there.
Looks can be deceiving, I am in fact a barbarian.
translation: Görünüs aldatici olabilir, aslinda ben bir barbarim.

english: I want some money.
Yes please, I want to smash my vials.
No thank you, I’d rather keep my vials.
Yes please, I want to stop smashing my vials.
translation: Evet, lütfen, siselerimi kirmayi birakmak istiyorum.

english: No thank you, I like smashing them.
No thank you, I'd rather keep my vials.
Hey there. What are you lot doing out here?
We're from the College of Bards in Tempestus. We thought we'd set up camp here to do some performances for anyone travelling through the savannah.
translation: Tempestus'taki Ozanlar Koleji'nden geliyoruz. Savanadan gecenler icin bazi gösteriler yapmak üzere burada kamp kurmayi düsündük.

english: With the kingdom now open to tourists, we've had plenty of new fans!
translation: Krallik artik turistlere acik oldugundan, bircok yeni hayranimiz oldu!

english: Nice trumpet.
Thanks! I made it myself. The College of Bards insist that we all have the ability to create and maintain our own instruments. I'm quite proud of what I came up with!
translation: Tesekkürler! Kendim yaptim. Ozanlar Koleji, hepimizin kendi enstrümanlarimizi yapma ve bakimini yapma becerisine sahip olmamizi istiyor. Yaptigim seyden oldukca gurur duyuyorum!

english: Well I hope it serves you well.
Hey there.
Think you've got what it takes to join the College of Bards?
translation: Ozanlar Koleji'ne katilmak icin gerekenlere sahip oldugunu düsünüyor musun?

english: I'm not sure.
Well it only takes a lifetime of practice, so maybe give it a go one day.
translation: Sadece ömür boyu pratik yapmak gerekiyor, belki bir gün denemelisin.

english: Hi there. Are you enjoying the view?
I am, though I do wish it would be blocked by the ferry to Tempestus.
translation: Evet, ama keske Tempestus'a giden feribot manzarayi engellesin.

english: The ferry? Is there something wrong with it?
translation: Feribot mu? Bir sorun mu var?

english: I'm not sure exactly. All I know is that it's not running at the moment.
translation: Tam olarak emin degilim. Tek bildigim su anda çalismadigi.

english: How urgently do you need to get there?
translation: Oraya ne kadar acil gitmen gerekiyor?

english: We should be back at the College of Bards already, but I'm sure they'll understand why we got delayed.
translation: Su anda Bardlar Koleji'nde olmamiz gerekirdi, ama gecikmemizin nedenini anlayacaklarina eminim.

english: Oh, you're a bard? Could you sing for me?
translation: Oh, sen bir bard misin? Benim için sarki söyler misin?

english: Maybe. Can you take us to Temptestus?
Unfortunately not.
Then I'm afraid you don't get any singing this time.
translation: O zaman korkarim bu sefer sarki dinleyemeyeceksin.

english: Hello there.
Nilsal! Have you come to hear a song from the Sister Songstresses of the College of Bards?
translation: Nilsal! Bardlar Koleji'nin Sarkici Kiz Kardesleri'nin sarkilarini dinlemeye mi geldin?

english: Sister Songstresses? So you're a group of sisters who sing together?
translation: Sarkici Kiz Kardesler mi? Yani birlikte sarki söyleyen bir grup kiz kardes misiniz?

english: Don't be silly! Of course we aren't!
Oh... The name did suggest otherwise...
Well, we realised when we met that we were all very similar, so we've been using it as a selling point! Everyone loves Snappy Sister, Stormy Sister, and of course me, Spirited Sister!
translation: Tanistigimizda hepimizin birbirine çok benzedigini fark ettik, bu yüzden bunu bir satis argümani olarak kullaniyoruz! Herkes Snappy Sister'i, Stormy Sister'i ve tabii ki beni, Spirited Sister'i seviyor!

english: Does that work?
People love a nice story about a trio of sisters coming together! So yes, it works rather well.
translation: Insanlar üç kiz kardesin bir araya gelmesiyle ilgili güzel hikayeleri seviyor! Evet, oldukça iyi ise yariyor.

english: That seems... unethical.
It's all storytelling! Songs, appearance, history. We're telling a story and people want to hear it!
translation: Hepsi hikaye anlatmak! Sarkilar, görünüs, tarih. Biz bir hikaye anlatiyoruz ve insanlar bunu duymak istiyor!

english: I'm not sure if people wanting to hear it makes it entirely ethical.
translation: Insanlarin duymak istemesi bunun tamamen etik oldugunu gösterir mi, emin degilim.

english: Is it made better if our songs are good?
translation: Sarkilarimiz iyi olursa daha mi iyi olur?

english: Now that you mention it... no of course it isn't.
translation: Simdi sen söyleyince... hayir, tabii ki olmaz.

english: Well, you're just no fun, iknami.
Hello!
Oh, hello there.
You seem a little down. What's up?
translation: Biraz moralin bozuk gibi. Ne oldu?

english: I just want to get back to the College of Bards. It's like my spark has gone out being away from such a creative environment.
translation: Sadece Bardlar Koleji'ne geri dönmek istiyorum. Böylesine yaratici bir ortamdan uzak kalinca sanki içimdeki kivilcim sönmüs gibi.

english: I'm sure you'll be back there before long.
You think?
It doesn't hurt to be hopeful, does it? Not to mention, hope can be a great inspiration!
translation: Umutlu olmak zarar vermez, degil mi? Üstelik umut büyük bir ilham kaynagi olabilir!

english: Hope can be a great inspiration... Perfect! I'll use that!
translation: Umut büyük bir ilham kaynagi olabilir... Mükemmel! Bunu kullanacagim!

english: You'll use it?
To write our next song!
Oh... Well, I'm happy to have helped.
Ah! Outerlander! Do not interrupt me in my business! I must cull these fiends!
translation: Ah! Yabanci! Isimi bölme! Bu canavarlari öldürmeliyim!

english: What are you doing down here?
Only an outerlander would ask such a question! Is it not obvious what I am doing?
translation: Sadece bir yabanci böyle bir soru sorabilir! Ne yaptigim belli degil mi?

english: I kill the daggermouths for glory and for sport! When I have had my fill, I move on to the daggermouths' lair!
translation: San ve söhret icin, eglence icin hancer agizlilari öldürüyorum! Doydugumda, hancer agizlilarin inine gececegim!

english: Erm... okay then. I'll leave you to it.
translation: Ee... tamam o zaman. Seni rahat birakayim.

english: I do not trust you outerlander, I will not accept your gifts, no matter what your intention...
translation: Sana güvenmiyorum yabanci, niyetin ne olursa olsun hediyelerini kabul etmeyecegim...

english: Hello there Bardur. How's it going?
I have been here all the long day, slaughtering the daggermouth spawns so that none may pass!
translation: Bütün gün burada kaldim, kimse gecmesin diye hancer agizli yaratiklari öldürdüm!

english: My sword arm grows weary, and the blood of my foes hangs heavy upon my clothing!
translation: Kilicimi sallayan kolum yoruldu ve düsmanlarimin kani giysilerime bulasti!

english: Can you tell me anything about the caves down here?
translation: Buradaki magaralar hakkinda bir sey söyleyebilir misin?

english: Aye, that I can [Fremennik Name]! Yonder lies the lair of the daggermouth kings, the three beasts of legend!
translation: Evet, söyleyebilirim Dokrak! Orada, efsanevi üc canavar olan hancer agizli krallarin yuvasi var!

english: I train my skills upon its foul brood, to prepare myself for the fight ahead!
translation: Önümdeki savasa hazirlanmak icin, bu igrenc yaratiklar üzerinde yeteneklerimi gelistiriyorum!

english: Okay, thanks Bardur. Do you have any food with you?
translation: Tamam, tesekkürler Bardur. Yaninda yiyecek var mi?

english: Ah, you did not come prepared [Fremennik Name]?
I have nothing to spare, but my equipment grows weaker under the onslaught of the dagger-mouth spawns!
translation: Fazladan bir seyim yok, ama ekipmanim hancer agizli yaratiklarin saldirisi altinda zayifliyor!

english: I will trade you a finely cooked shark if you have a replacement for my helm, my shield or my blade...
translation: Migferim, kalkanim veya kilicim icin bir yedek varsa, sana güzelce pisirilmis bir köpekbaligi verecegim...

english: Give me any equipment you wish to trade, and I will pay you a shark for it.
translation: Takas etmek istedigin ekipmani bana ver, karsiliginda sana bir köpekbaligi verecegim.

english: Ah, just what I was looking for! You wish to trade me that for a cooked shark?
translation: Ah, tam da aradigim sey! Onu pismis köpekbaligiyla takas etmek mi istiyorsun?

english: Ah, this will serve me well as a backup! My thanks to you [Fremennik Name], I trust we will one day sing songs together of glorious battles in the Rellekka longhall! (Fremennik item gets replaced by a cooked shark.)
translation: Ah, bu bana yedek olarak cok isime yarayacak! Tesekkürler Dokrak, umarim bir gün Rellekka uzun salonunda sanli savaslarin sarkilarini birlikte söyleriz! (Fremennik esyasi pismis köpekbaligiyla degistirilir.)

english: As you wish, [Fremennik Name] My weapons have lasted me this long, I will keep my trust in them yet.
translation: Nasil istersen, Dokrak Silahlarim bu zamana kadar bana hizmet etti, onlara güvenmeye devam edecegim.

english: No [Fremennik Name], I will trade you my finely cooked shark for a trusty Fremennik blade, a sturdy Fremennik helm, or a mighty Fremennik shield...
translation: Hayir Dokrak, sana güzelce pisirilmis köpekbaligimi güvenilir bir Fremennik kilici, saglam bir Fremennik migferi veya güclü bir Fremennik kalkani ile takas edecegim...

english: I have no interest in that... thing... you are trying to offload on me.
translation: Senin bana yüklemeye calistigin o... seye... hic ilgim yok.

english: Ah! Exile! Begone with you, before you suffer the same fate as these fledglings!
translation: Ah! Sürgün! Bu yavrularin basina gelenlerin aynisi basina gelmeden git buradan!

english: Fine. I was going anyway.
Bardur, wait! I'm here with a task from the Chieftain.
translation: Bardur, bekle! Sef'in verdigi bir görevle geldim.

english: I'm not too certain I should trust you! What is it you want?
translation: Sana güvenebilecegimden pek emin degilim! Ne istiyorsun?

english: I'm looking to remake V's Shield, but I require a Fremennik Shield from a warrior. Where could I find one?
translation: V'nin Kalkanini yeniden yapmak istiyorum, ama bunun icin bir savascinin Fremennik Kalkani'na ihtiyacim var. Nereden bulabilirim?

english: The daggermouths found in these caves should drop a few when slain. They take them from fallen warriors. I have a few myself, in fact. I wish to give them back to the families of the fallen.
translation: Bu magaralarda bulunan hancer agizlilar öldürüldüklerinde birkac tane düsürürler. Onlari ölen savascilardan alirlar. Aslinda bende de birkac tane var. Onlari ölenlerin ailelerine geri vermek istiyorum.

english: These fledgelings won't drop anything you're looking for, though. Search the caves for some matured daggermouths.
translation: Ancak bu caylaklar aradigin seyi düsürmezler. Magaralarda olgun hancer agizlilar ara.

english: Thanks for your time, Bardur.
You're lucky I'm busy exile! Things might have been different if I wasn't...
translation: Sanslisin ki mesgulüm sürgün! Ben mesgul olmasaydim, durum farkli olabilirdi...

english: Maybe I could buy one off you?
translation: Belki senden bir tane satin alabilirim?

english: I don't have that much.
Be gone with you then!
Sounds good to me.
(player loses 150k, gains a fremennik shield)
translation: (oyuncu 150 bin kaybediyor, bir fremennik kalkani kazaniyor)

english: Perhaps I misjudged you, exile. Best of luck on your adventure.
translation: Belki de seni yanlis degerlendirmisim, sürgün. Maceranda bol sans.

english: That's far too much, I won't pay that!
translation: Bu cok fazla, o kadar ödeme yapmam!

english: Well I wouldn't expect an exile like you to care about the fallen. Be gone with you!
translation: Senin gibi bir sürgünün düsmüs olanlari umursamasini beklemiyordum. Defol git!

english: Exile, has that shield served you well?
translation: Sürgün, o kalkan isine yaradi mi?

english: Yes, thank you.
All the best, exile.
I lost it.
Well you're not having another one if that's how you take care of things! If you want another, you'll need to slay some daggermouths!
translation: Eger isleri böyle hallediyorsan, bir tane daha alamazsin! Bir tane daha istiyorsan, birkac hancer agizli öldürmen gerekecek!

english: Okay...
Listen, [Fremennik Name]. I'm sorry about the way I acted while you were exiled. Bardur gets hostile around outerlanders.
translation: Dinle, Dokrak. Sürgünde oldugun sirada davranislarim icin özür dilerim. Bardur, yabancilara karsi düsmanca davranir.

english: Don't worry about it, I understand! All's well that ends well! How've you been?
translation: Merak etme, anliyorum! Sonu iyi bittigine göre sorun yok! Nasilsin?

english: Ah, this will serve me well as a backup! My thanks to you [Fremennik name] Dräpare, I trust we will one day sing songs together of glorious battles in the Rellekka longhall!
translation: Ah, bu bana yedek olarak cok isime yarayacak! Tesekkürler Dokrak Dräpare, umarim bir gün Rellekka uzun salonunda sanli savaslarin sarkilarini birlikte söyleriz!

english: As you wish, [Fremennik name] DräpareMy weapons have lasted me this long, I will keep my trust in them yet.
translation: Nasil istersen, Dokrak Dräpare Silahlarim bu zamana kadar bana yetti, onlara güvenmeye devam edecegim.

english: YES
NO
Thanks for your time, Bardur.
Maybe I could buy one off you?
translation: Belki senden bir tane satin alabilirim?

english: Sounds good to me.
That's far too much, I won't pay that!
translation: Bu cok fazla, o kadar para veremem!

english: Hello there.
Oh! Hello there.
Who are you?
My name is Ex Sea Captain Barfy Bill.
translation: Adim eski deniz kaptani Barfy Bill.

english: Ex sea captain?
Yeah, I bought a lovely ship and was planning to make a fortune running her as a merchant vessel.
translation: Evet, güzel bir gemi satin aldim ve onu ticaret gemisi olarak kullanarak bir servet kazanmayi planliyordum.

english: Why are you not still sailing?
Chronic sea sickness. My first, and only, voyage was spent dry heaving over the rails.
translation: Kronik deniz tutmasi. Ilk ve tek seyahatim, parmakliklar üzerinde kusarak gecti.

english: If I had known about the sea sickness I could have saved myself a lot of money.
translation: Deniz tutmasini bilseydim, cok para tasarruf edebilirdim.

english: What are you up to now then?
Well my ship had a little fire related problem. Fortunately it was well insured.
translation: Gemimde kücük bir yangin sorunu oldu. Neyse ki sigortasi iyiydi.

english: Anyway, I don't have to work anymore so I've taken to canoeing on the river.
translation: Her neyse, artik calismak zorunda degilim, bu yüzden nehirde kano yapmaya basladim.

english: I don't get river sick!
Would you like to know how to make a canoe?
Could you teach me about canoes?
Well, you don't look like you have the skill to make a canoe.
You need to have at least level 12 woodcutting.
translation: En az 12. seviye odun kesme becerisine sahip olmalisin.

english: Once you are able to make a canoe it makes travel along the river much quicker!
translation: Kano yapmayi ögrendiginde nehirde cok daha hizli seyahat edebilirsin!

english: It's really quite simple. Just walk down to that tree on the bank and chop it down.
translation: Gercekten cok basit. Kiyida duran agaca dogru yürü ve onu kes.

english: When you have done that you can shape the log further with your axe to make a canoe.
translation: Bunu yaptiktan sonra, baltanla kütügü daha da sekillendirerek kano yapabilirsin.

english: Hah! I can tell just by looking that you lack talent in woodcutting.
translation: Hah! Sadece bakarak bile odun kesme konusunda yeteneksiz oldugunu anlayabiliyorum.

english: What do you mean?
No Callouses! No Splinters! No camp fires littering the trail behind you.
translation: Nasir yok! Kiymik yok! Arkanda kamp atesi izleri yok.

english: Anyway, the only 'canoe' you can make is a log. You'll be able to travel 1 stop along the river with a log canoe.
translation: Her neyse, yapabilecegin tek “kano” bir kütük. Kütük kanoyla nehirde 1 durak ilerleyebilirsin.

english: With your skill in woodcutting you could make my favourite canoe, the Dugout. They might not be the best canoe on the river, but they get you where you're going.
translation: Odun kesme becerinle benim en sevdigim kano olan Dugout'u yapabilirsin. Nehirdeki en iyi kano olmayabilirler, ama seni istedigin yere götürürler.

english: How far will I be able to go in a Dugout canoe?
translation: Dugout kano ile ne kadar uzaga gidebilirim?

english: You will be able to travel 2 stops on the river.
The best canoe you can make is a Stable Dugout, one step beyond a normal Dugout.
translation: Yapabilecegin en iyi kano, normal Dugout'tan bir adim öte olan Stable Dugout'tur.

english: With a Stable Dugout you can travel to any place on the river.
translation: Stable Dugout ile nehirdeki herhangi bir yere gidebilirsin.

english: Even into the Wilderness?
Not likely! I've heard tell of a man up near Edgeville who claims he can use a Waka to get up into the Wilderness.
translation: Muhtemelen hayir! Edgeville yakinlarinda bir adamin Waka kullanarak Wildernessya gidebilecegini iddia ettigini duydum.

english: I can't think why anyone would wish to venture into that hellish landscape though.
translation: Ancak neden birinin o cehennem gibi manzaraya girmeyi isteyecegini anlayamiyorum.

english: Hoo! You look like you know which end of an axe is which!
translation: Hoo! Baltanin hangi ucunun hangisi oldugunu biliyormussun gibi görünüyorsun!

english: You can easily build one of those Wakas. Be careful if you travel into the Wilderness though.
translation: O Waka'lardan birini kolayca yapabilirsin. Ama Wilderness'a seyahat edersen dikkatli ol.

english: I've heard tell of great evil in that blasted wasteland.
translation: O lanetli corak arazide büyük bir kötülük oldugunu duydum.

english: Thanks for the warning Bill.
No thanks, not right now.
Can you teach me about canoes?
translation: Bana kano hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Who are you?
Yes
No
Can you teach me about Canoeing?
translation: Bana kano hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: What's going on here?
We're making the final preparations for our voyage to the distant lands to the North.
translation: Kuzeydeki uzak diyarlara yapacagimiz yolculuk icin son hazirliklari yapiyoruz.

english: Is there anything I can do to help?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: We could do with an extra pair of hands, but you're better off speaking to Curator Haig Halen at the Varrock museum if you'd like to get involved.
translation: Ekstra bir cift ele ihtiyacimiz var, ama katilmak istiyorsan Varrock müzesindeki küratör Haig Halen ile konussan daha iyi olur.

english: Okay, thanks.
Good luck, bye.
Thanks for all your help, [player name].
Is there anything I can do to help?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Good luck, bye.
This work isn't going to do itself.
Is it lunch break yet?
Ouch! That was my finger!
Hey I'm working here, I'm working here.
translation: Hey, ben burada calisiyorum, burada calisiyorum.

english: Wonder when I'll get paid.
Can't stop. Too busy.
You are looking for clothes, yes? You look at my products! I have very many nice clothes, yes?
translation: Giysi mi ariyorsunuz? Ürünlerime bakin! Cok güzel giysilerim var, degil mi?

english: Yes, please.
No thanks.
Unfortunate for you, yes? Many bargains, won't find elsewhere!
translation: Sizin icin ne yazik, degil mi? Baska yerde bulamayacaginiz bircok indirimli ürün var!

english: Here, have this.
Yes, please.
No thanks.
Bones!
What?
I don't have any bones!
Then how do you stand up?
What?
How do you stand up if you have no bones? Shouldn't you collapse into a gelatinous blob?
translation: Kemiklerin yoksa nasil ayakta duruyorsun? Jöle gibi bir kütleye dönüsmemen gerekmez mi?

english: Ha, ha, ha, ha, ha!
Goodbye.
Goodbye.
What do you need bones for?
To stand up properly. Otherwise I'd collapse into a gelatinous blob!
translation: Düzgün ayakta durmak icin. Yoksa jelatinimsi bir kütleye dönüsürüm!

english: No, seriously, I need bones to use as a Construction material. We always need big bones to prop up the mine shafts and to make other temporary structures.
translation: Hayir, cidden, kemikleri insaat malzemesi olarak kullanmak icin ihtiyacim var. Maden saftlarini desteklemek ve diger gecici yapilar yapmak icin her zaman büyük kemiklere ihtiyacimiz var.

english: Will you buy anything besides bones?
translation: Kemik disinda baska bir sey satin alacak misin?

english: Well, I've had a few people bring me some interesting giant shells. They say they came from giant snails and giant tortoises.
translation: Sey, birkac kisi bana ilginc dev kabuklar getirdi. Dev salyangozlardan ve dev kaplumbagalardan geldigini söylüyorlar.

english: Of course, like the bones, some shells are better than others. I'll give you 250gp for ordinary shells, but what I really need are perfect shells. I'll pay double for them and give you a few tips about Crafting too.
translation: Tabii ki, kemikler gibi, bazi kabuklar digerlerinden daha iyidir. Siradan kabuklar icin 250 altin veririm, ama asil ihtiyacim olan mükemmel kabuklardir. Onlar icin iki kati öderim ve sana zanaatkarlik hakkinda da birkac ipucu veririm.

english: What kind of bones do you need?
Enormous bones, as big as you can get. Not just any big bones will do.
translation: Mümkün oldugunca büyük kemiklere. Herhangi bir büyük kemik olmaz.

english: Sometimes you might find a particularly long, straight bone. That's the kind of thing I need; I'll give you 1,000gp for one of them.
translation: Bazen özellikle uzun, düz bir kemik bulabilirsin. Ihtiyacim olan sey bu tür kemikler; bunlardan biri icin sana 1.000 altin verecegim.

english: Occasionally, you might find a long curved bone - these are especially valuable - I'll give you 2,000gp for them.
translation: Bazen uzun, kavisli bir kemik bulabilirsin - bunlar özellikle degerlidir - bunlardan biri icin sana 2.000 altin verecegim.

english: I'll also teach you a bit about how we use the bones in Construction, if you like.
translation: Istersen, kemikleri Insaatta nasil kullandigimizi da biraz ögretirim.

english: Those bones! Those are exactly the sort of thing I need! Will you sell them?
translation: O kemikler! Tam da ihtiyacim olan sey! Satar misin?

english: I'll give you [NUMBER] gp for the bones you're carrying and for any you have in your bank.
I'll try to teach you something about Construction as well, but it's highly technical so you won't understand if you don't already have level 30 Construction.
translation: Sana Insaat hakkinda da bir seyler ögretmeye calisacagim, ama bu cok teknik bir konu, bu yüzden Insaat seviyen 30 degilse anlamayacaksin.

english: Okay.
Thanks! Now, let me explain...
No thanks.
That giant shell...what is it?
It's a giant snail shell!
Hmm... I think I might be able to make something out of them.
translation: Hmm... Sanirim onlardan bir seyler yapabilirim.

english: I'll give you [NUMBER] gp for the snail shells you're carrying.
translation: Tasidigin salyangoz kabuklari icin sana gp verecegim.

english: Thanks. If you find any more shells like these, please bring them to me!
translation: Tesekkürler. Eger bunun gibi baska kabuklar bulursan, lütfen bana getir!

english: Hmm... I think I might be able to make something out of them, especially that perfect one.
translation: Hmm... Sanirim onlardan bir seyler yapabilirim, özellikle de o mükemmel olanindan.

english: I'll give you [NUMBER] gp for the snail shell you're carrying, and I'll try to give you some advice on Crafting while I'm at it.
Thanks! Now, I don't think I could use that for Construction, but maybe I could make something...
translation: Tesekkürler! Simdi, bunu Insaat icin kullanabilecegimi sanmiyorum, ama belki bir seyler yapabilirim...

english: Hmm... I think I might be able to make something out of them, especially those perfect ones.
translation: Hmm... Sanirim bunlardan bir seyler yapabilirim, özellikle de mükemmel olanlardan.

english: I'll give you [NUMBER] gp for the snail shells you're carrying, and I'll try to give you some advice on Crafting while I'm at it.
It's a giant battle tortoise shell!
translation: Bu dev bir savas kaplumbagasi kabugu!

english: I'll give you [NUMBER] gp for the tortoise shells you're carrying.
That other giant shell...what is it?
I'll give you [NUMBER] gp for the tortoise shell you're carrying, and I'll try to give you some advice on Crafting while I'm at it.
I'll give you [NUMBER] gp for the tortoise shells you're carrying, and I'll try to give you some advice on Crafting while I'm at it.
Then how do you stand up?
What do you need bones for?
What kind of bones do you need?
Will you buy anything besides bones?
translation: Kemiklerden baska bir sey alacak misin?

english: Okay.
No. I'll keep the bones.
Welcome to the Laughing Miner pub, human traveller.
translation: Laughing Miner pub'a hos geldin, insan gezgin.

english: Who is that man walking around outside?
What man?
I mean the dwarf, the one with the sign.
Oh, him. Yes, we employ him to advertise our pub, he's the cheapest labour we could find. We don't have a lot of money to spare you know, we pay him in beer.
translation: Oh, o mu? Evet, pub'imizi tanitmasi icin onu ise aldik, bulabildigimiz en ucuz isci o. Fazla paramiz yok, biliyorsun, ona bira ile ödeme yapiyoruz.

english: But what's wrong with him?
Well, he's drunk isn't he?
I told you, he's cheap. He couldn't get any other work since the Red Axe fired him. Been drinking ever since.
translation: Sana söyledim, o ucuz. Red Axe onu kovdugundan beri baska is bulamadi. O zamandan beri iciyor.

english: How did that happen?
I'm not quite sure, I think he kept wearing the wrong coloured cap all the time. They don't much like it if you don't wear your red uniform into work.
translation: Tam emin degilim, sanirim sürekli yanlis renkli sapka takiyordu. Ise kirmizi üniforma giymediginde pek hoslarina gitmiyor.

english: They fired him for that??
The Red Axe will fire you for just about anything if they want to.
translation: Kizil Balta isterse seni herhangi bir sey icin kovabilir.

english: I'd like a beer please.
That'll be 2 gold coins.
Thanks for your custom.
Sorry, I don't have 2 coins on me.
Sorry, I changed my mind.
I'd like some food please.
I can make you a stew for 20 gold coins.
translation: 20 altin sikke karsiliginda sana güvec yapabilirim.

english: Sorry, I don't have 20 coins on me.
I'd like a Kelda stout please.
Sorry, we've stopped serving those. The seeds were too hard to get.
translation: Üzgünüm, artik onu servis etmiyoruz. Tohumlarini bulmak cok zordu.

english: Yeah, tell me about it.
They're quite hard to come by, and I believe you've already got one.
translation: Bulmak oldukca zor ve sanirim sen zaten bir tane aldin.

english: Oh yes.
Here, I found a little left over Kelda stout, just enough for a glass. Take it.
translation: Iste, biraz Kelda stout buldum, bir bardak icin yeterli. Al.

english: Wow, for free?
I don't think I'll be able to sell it to anyone.
So yes, go ahead.
I have to go.
Who is that man walking around outside?
I'd like a beer please.
Pay.
Don't pay.
I'd like some food please.
I'd like a Kelda stout please.
I have to go.
Good day to you. What can I get you to drink?
What do you have.
Here, take a look at our menu.
Nothing thanks.
Ok, take it easy.
I was just wanting to buy a cocktail ingredient actually.
Sure thing, what did you want?
A lemon.
You don't have enough room in your inventory to buy that.
translation: Envanterinizde bunu alacak kadar yer yok.

english: 20 coins please.
You do not have enough money to buy that.
An orange.
A cocktail shaker.
Actually nothing thanks.
What do you have?
Nothing thanks.
Can I buy some ingredients?
A lemon
An orange.
A cocktail shaker.
And what will it be for you, fine [sir/madam]?
Yes? Can I help you with something?
A beer please.
That'll be 1 gold coin please.
I'm sorry, I seem to have run out of money.
Here you go. One delicious pint of beer.
Sorry, I changed my mind.
A dwarven stout please.
It'll be yours for just 2 gold coins!
One dwarven stout, best in all of Keldagrim!
translation: Bir cüce birasi, Keldagrim'in en iyisi!

english: A fine wine please.
Ah, [sir/madam] has taste! A jug of wine will cost you 10 gold coins.
translation: Ah,  zevkliymis! Bir sürahi sarap 10 altin sikkeye mal olacak.

english: I hope [sir/madam] will enjoy it!
Nothing, thanks.
A beer please.
Pay.
Don't pay.
A dwarven stout please.
A fine wine please.
Nothing, thanks.
Welcome traveller, can I get you a drink or some food?
translation: Hos geldiniz gezgin, size bir icki veya yemek ikram edebilir miyim?

english: I'd like a beer please.
That'll be 2 gold coins.
Thanks for your custom.
Sorry, I don't have 2 coins on me.
I'd like some food please.
I can make you a stew for 20 gold coins.
translation: 20 altin para karsiliginda size bir güvec yapabilirim.

english: Sorry, I don't have 20 coins on me.
I have to go.
I'd like a beer please.
I'd like some food please.
translation: Yiyecek bir seyler alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: I have to go
Hello there; I see you're qualified. Come to help us out?
translation: Merhaba, nitelikli oldugunu görüyorum. Bize yardim etmeye mi geldin?

english: Hello! You're that student who recently finished all three Earth Sciences exams, aren't you? Come to help us out?
translation: Merhaba! Sen yakin zamanda üc Yer Bilimleri sinavini da bitiren ögrenci, degil mi? Bize yardim etmeye mi geldin?

english: Greetings, my dear [sir/madam]. Have you come to give us a hand?
translation: Selamlar, sevgili . Bize yardim etmeye mi geldin?

english: Yes, how can I help out?

Well, you'll need to get your equipment first - it's all there on the tool rack. Use what you learned from your Earth Sciences exams. You'll need to be wearing your leather gloves and boots as well as have access to
translation: Önce ekipmaninizi almaniz gerekiyor - hepsi alet rafinda. Yer Bilimleri sinavlarinda ögrendiklerinizi kullanin. Deri eldivenlerinizi ve botlarinizi giymeniz ve

english: your trowel, rock pick and specimen brush.
translation: kürek, kaya kazma ve numune fircaniza erisiminiz olmasi gerekiyor.

english: I see you have your equipment - well done.

To really give us a hand, you could clean some finds for us. They're mostly done - just some fine work to finish off. Take a find from the pile that the workmen are bringing in, then there are spare tables over there
translation: Bize gercekten yardim etmek istiyorsaniz, bazi buluntulari temizleyebilirsiniz. Cogu isleri bitti, sadece son rötuslar kaldi. Iscilerin getirdigi yigindan bir buluntu alin, orada temizlemek icin bos masalar var.

english: to clean them on. If you find anything interesting, let us know and we'll see if it's good enough to go on display.
translation: Ilginc bir sey bulursaniz bize haber verin, sergilenmeye deger olup olmadigini kontrol edelim.

english: I found something interesting.
Oh? Let's take a look...
I found this pretty necklace.
Interesting...yes...yes...hmmm.... It looks like it's enchanted.
translation: Ilginc... evet... evet... hmmm.... Büyülü gibi görünüyor.

english: With what?

Oh, I think it's just a benign teleportation spell. I tinker in magic when I'm not doing archaeology. I can teach you how to make more necklaces like this. Amazing that they had this kind of knowledge back then.
translation: Oh, sanirim sadece zararsiz bir isinlanma büyüsü. Arkeolojiyle ugrasmadigim zamanlarda büyüyle ugrasirim. Sana bu kolyeden daha fazlasini yapmayi ögretebilirim. O zamanlar bu tür bilgilere sahip olmalari sasirtici.

english: That would be good. Where is the teleport to?
translation: Bu iyi olur. Isinlanma nereye oluyor?

english: Hmm...all the indications are that it's somewhere to the east of us, but I'm not sure how far. Perhaps it was a teleport back to Saranthium. Let me just take a closer look.
translation: Hmm... tüm isaretler bunun bizim dogumuzda bir yere oldugunu gösteriyor, ama ne kadar uzak oldugunu bilmiyorum. Belki de Saranthium'a geri isinlanma yapiyordu. Bir daha yakindan bakayim.

english: So I just make a ruby necklace and use five fire runes and one cosmic rune to enchant it.
translation: Yani bir yakut kolye yapip, bes ates runesi ve bir kozmik runesi kullanarak onu büyülüyorum.

english: Yes, indeed. Well done, youngster, thanks for helping us.
translation: Evet, aynen öyle. Aferin genc adam, yardim ettigin icin tesekkürler.

english: I've cleaned this old coin - is it of any use?
translation: Bu eski parayi temizledim, bir ise yarar mi?

english: Oh my! What a wonderful find! If this is what I believe it to be, it would allow us to date the Dig Site city.
translation: Vay canina! Ne harika bir buluntu! Eger tahmin ettigim gibi ise, kazi alanindaki sehrin tarihini belirlememizi saglayacak.

english: And look here, it has the name of the city too! Saranthium! That must be during the Saradominist occupation. This is a wonderful find. Please take it and place it in display case 45.
translation: Bakin, üzerinde sehrin adi da yaziyor! Saranthium! Saradominist isgali sirasinda olmali. Bu harika bir buluntu. Lütfen al ve 45 numarali vitrine koy.

english: Right, display case 45 it is...
Back again? Have you put the old coin in display case 45 yet?
translation: Yine mi geldin? Eski parayi 45 numarali vitrine koydun mu?

english: No, I'll go do that now
You've already shown me one of those, but it was in better condition. It's in the display case over there. You can pop this one in the finds crate over in the corner.
translation: Bana onlardan birini göstermistin, ama o daha iyi durumdaydi. Suradaki vitrinde. Bunu kösedeki buluntu sandigina koyabilirsin.

english: I found this really old coin - is it of any use?
translation: Cok eski bir sikke buldum, bir ise yarar mi?

english: What have we here?

Oh! This is very interesting...and confusing at the same time. This coin means that the city that we're excavating on the Digsite - Saranthium - was actually inhabited much, much earlier by followers of Zamorak,
translation: Oh! Bu cok ilginc... ama ayni zamanda kafa karistirici. Bu sikke, kazi alaninda kazi yaptigimiz sehir olan Saranthium'un aslinda cok daha önceden Zamorak'in takipcileri tarafindan iskan edildigini gösteriyor.

english: at which time, the city was known as Senntisten.
translation: O zamanlar sehir Senntisten olarak biliniyordu.

english: This is a most remarkable discovery, as we have other evidence indicating that Zarosian followers were resident before the Saradominists took over, but it also seems that Zamorakian forces used it during a battle of some
translation: Bu cok önemli bir kesif, cünkü Saradoministlerin yönetimi ele gecirmeden önce Zaros'un takipcilerinin burada yasadigini gösteren baska kanitlarimiz da var, ama ayni zamanda Zamorak'in güclerinin bir tür savas sirasinda burayi kullandigi da anlasiliyor.

english: sort. Still, it allows us to roughly date when the city changed from following Zaros and Zamorak to following Saradomin. Put it in display case 44.
translation: Yine de, bu kesif, sehrin Zaros ve Zamorak'i takip etmekten Saradomin'i takip etmeye gectigi tarihi yaklasik olarak belirlememizi sagliyor. Bunu 44 numarali vitrine koyun.

english: Case 44 it is!
Back again? Have you put the ancient coin in display case 44 yet?
translation: Yine mi geldin? Eski parayi 44 numarali vitrine koydun mu?

english: No, I'll go do that now.
I found this crumbly old decoration - is it of any use?
translation: Bu ufalanmis eski süsü buldum, bir ise yarar mi?

english: Ahh... That looks like an altar piece. Hmm, yes...from the early Saradominist worshippers by the looks of it. Quite delicate, too. Put it in display case 37.
translation: Ahh... Bu bir sunak parcasi gibi görünüyor. Hmm, evet... Görünüse göre Saradoministlerin ilk tapinanlarindan kalma. Oldukca narin de. 37 numarali vitrine koy.

english: Case 37 it is!
Back again? Have you put the ancient symbol in display case 37 yet?
translation: Yine mi geldin? Eski sembolü 37 numarali vitrine koydun mu?

english: I found this really old decoration - is it of any use?
translation: Bu cok eski bir süsleme buldum, ise yarar mi?

english: Wow!
That's in rather good condition, isn't it? An old altar decoration by the looks of things, from the Saradominist city no doubt. Put it in display case 36.
translation: Durumu oldukca iyi, degil mi? Görünüse göre eski bir sunak süsü, süphesiz Saradominist sehirden. 36 numarali vitrine koy.

english: Case 36 it is!
Back again? Have you put the old symbol in display case 36 yet?
translation: Yine mi geldin? Eski sembolü 36 numarali vitrine koydun mu?

english: I found this piece of pottery - is it of any use?
translation: Bu cömlek parcasini buldum - bir ise yarar mi?

english: Ahh... Oh! Hmm...yes...made by Zaros worshippers, by the looks of it. Beautifully-shaped. It looks as if this would go nicely in display case 22. This piece reinforces our evidence that the city was occupied by
translation: Ahh... Oh! Hmm... evet... görünüse göre Zaros'un tapinanlar tarafindan yapilmis. Cok güzel sekilli. 22 numarali vitrine cok yakisacak gibi görünüyor. Bu parca, sehrin Saradoministler'den önce Zaros'lular tarafindan isgal edildigine dair kanitlarimizi güclendiriyor.

english: Zarosians before Saradominists.
Case 22 it is!
translation: Yine mi? Seramik esyalari 22 numarali vitrine koydun mu?

english: Back again? Have you put the pottery in display case 22 yet?
translation: Yine mi geldin? Sergi vitrini 22'ye cömlegi koydun mu?

english: I found these old arrowheads.
Ahh, yes, we find lots of those - they're not important. We already have some in our display. Just add it to the crate of finds over near the door.
translation: Ahh, evet, bunlardan cok buluyoruz - önemli degiller. Sergimizde zaten var. Kapinin yanindaki buluntular sandigina koy.

english: If there is anything already in the crate, feel free to take it as a reward for your work.
translation: Sandikta zaten bir sey varsa, calismanin karsiligi olarak alabilirsin.

english: Oh, okay.
Take a look at this...
I found these old necklaces.
An interesting find... Here, let me offer you something in return.
translation: Ilginc bir buluntu... Al, sana karsiliginda bir sey vereyim.

english: Oh! Okay.
I cleaned up this old vase.
Ah, the vases... I've lost count of how many we've found of those... The only completely intact one is in the display case already. Just add it to the crate of finds over near the door.
translation: Ah, vazolar... Kac tane buldugumuzu sayamadim bile... Tamamen saglam olan tek vazo zaten vitrinde. Kapinin yanindaki buluntu sandigina koy.

english: Right.
Err... I seem to have lost it. Sorry.
Sounds like you never had it, [lad/lass]!
translation: Sanki hic sende olmamis gibi, delikanli/delikanli!

english: No, just here to watch.
Thank you, but I don't need that
Yes, how can I help out?
I found something interesting.
No thanks.
You're so cute!
I will devour everything you know and love!
translation: Bildigin ve sevdigin her seyi yiyip bitirecegim!

english: Well then.
You okay, Baron?
I must grow! I must eat!
Keep those little teeth away from me please. I'm keeping an eye on you.
translation: Lütfen o kücük dislerini benden uzak tut. Seni gözlüyorum.

english: And I'm keeping all my eyes on you.
*gulp*
Bleugh!
Chomp!
Grrrr!
Oh no! What's broken?
What? Nothing's broken.
I'm sorry. I'm just a bit jumpy.
I'm in charge of all the metalworking of Dorgesh-Kaan. It's a big responsibility!
translation: Dorgesh-Kaan'in tüm metal islerinden sorumluyum. Bu büyük bir sorumluluk!

english: If something metal breaks I have to fix it. And lots of things are made of metal!
translation: Metal bir sey kirilirsa onu tamir etmek zorundayim. Ve bircok sey metalden yapilmis!

english: Don't worry, I'm sure you're up to the task!
translation: Merak etme, eminim bu görevi basarabilirsin!

english: I hope you're right.
Get away from that furnace!
Are you worried I'll break your furnace?
I'm worried the furnace will break you!
It's set up to make glass and jewellery at the moment. It's not safe to use it to smelt ore. What if you accidentally burn yourself?
translation: Su anda cam ve mücevher yapmak icin ayarlanmis. Cevher eritmek icin kullanmak güvenli degil. Ya kazara kendini yakarsan?

english: What if you accidentally burn yourself and the surface people see that you're burnt and use that as a pretext to attack us?
translation: Ya kazara kendini yakarsan ve yüzeydekiler yanigini görür ve bunu bize saldirmak icin bahane olarak kullanirsa?

english: We'd all be killed in our sleep! And it would be my fault!
translation: Hepimiz uykumuzda öldürülürüz! Ve bu benim hatam olur!

english: No, no, no, no, no - I can't take the risk.
translation: Hayir, hayir, hayir, hayir, hayir - bu riski alamam.

english: Alright, calm down! I won't use your furnace. To smelt ore.
translation: Tamam, sakin ol! Firinini kullanmayacagim. Cevher eritmek icin.

english: What do you think you're doing?
Um...may I use your tools?
Oh, no, no!
Those are highly technical tools. They're not like the tools you use on the surface.
translation: Onlar cok teknik aletler. Yüzeyde kullandiginiz aletler gibi degiller.

english: What if you hurt yourself with them? I could be held responsible!
translation: Ya onlarla kendinizi yaralarsaniz? Sorumluluk bana kalabilir!

english: No, I think it's best if I don't let anyone use the tools.
translation: Hayir, aletleri kimsenin kullanmasina izin vermemem en iyisi.

english: Oh well.
Hullo there friend, what can I do you for?
Do you sell beer?
Aye, we do.
Could I get one?
Nope, sorry [laddie/lassie].
Why not?
The egg's order, I only have cabbage beer and I'm not allowed to sell it anymore.
translation: Yumurta siparisi, sadece lahana birasi var ve artik onu satmam yasak.

english: Can't you see by my lack of customers?
I just thought no one wanted to come in.
Get out me pub!
This is a nice pub you've got here.
Aye, it is.
How long has it been around?
Oh not too long, use to be a house, but I demolished it with me bare paws and rebuilt it as a pub.
translation: Cok uzun degil, eskiden bir evdi ama onu kendi ellerimle yiktim ve bar olarak yeniden insa ettim.

english: You demolished the house? Was anyone living there?
translation: Evi mi yiktin? Orada kimse yasiyor muydu?

english: Nope, been empty for quite a while.
Oh... what an interesting story.
No thank you, I'm just browsing.
What do you mean browsing? This is a pub, not a carrot market.
translation: Ne demek bakiniyorum? Burasi bir bar, havuc pazari degil.

english: Sorry, I just wanted to have a look.
I've a half mind to bar you from me pub right now if you don't leave.
translation: Eger gitmezsen, seni barimdan kovmak üzereyim.

english: Do you sell beer?
Nice pub you've got here.

english: I don't recall it particularly well, other than they are said to contain an incredible power.

english: That's right.

Well you picked a great day for it! The name's Barus by the way. I work as a historian here. Those Arceuus lot may think they know it all, but I reckon I could tell you a thing or two that even they haven't realised!
translation: Bunun icin harika bir gün secmissin! Bu arada, benim adim Barus. Burada tarihci olarak calisiyorum. Arceuus'lular her seyi bildiklerini sanabilirler, ama ben sana onlarin bile farkinda olmadigi bir iki sey anlatabilirim!

english: Well on that note, what can you tell me about the Burning Man?
translation: Peki, bu konuda Burning Man hakkinda ne anlatabilirsin?

english: The Burning Man is a monument to a great triumph in Lovakengj history. We're talking thosands of years ago, before Kourend was even a kingdom! Sadly, that does mean some details have been lost to time.
translation: Burning Man, Lovakengj tarihindeki büyük bir zaferin anitidir. Binlerce yil öncesinden bahsediyoruz, Kourend'in bir krallik bile olmadigi zamanlardan! Ne yazik ki, bu da bazi detaylarin zamanla kayboldugu anlamina geliyor.

english: What we do know is that a great evil threatened the earliest dwarven settlers here. Had that evil prevailed, Lovakengj might never have existed!
translation: Bildigimiz tek sey, buradaki ilk cüce yerlesimcileri büyük bir kötülük tehdit ettigi. O kötülük galip gelseydi, Lovakengj hic var olmayabilirdi!

english: Thankfully, with guidance from their brave leader, the settlers were able to overcome this evil! The Burning Man is a reminder of that.

english: So I'm guessing the monument represents this evil?

english: That's right!

english: Ah, now that bit is less clear. Have you heard of the Stranglewood?

english: I see. What can you tell me about the Stranglewood?

translation: Kebos Lowlands ile Varlamore Kralligi arasindaki sinirda bulabilirsin. Lanetli bir yer. Oraya giren cok az kisi var ve girenlerin hicbiri geri dönmedi!

english: Oops!
What is this place?
My pub's called The Legless Faun. It's where all the newcomers find themselves after the long voyage from the east. A good drink takes the edge off, y'know? So, fancy a pint?
translation: Barimin adi The Legless Faun. Dogu'dan uzun bir yolculuktan sonra tüm yeni gelenler buraya gelir. Iyi bir icki gerginligi alir, bilirsin. Bir bardak bira ister misin?

english: Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: Burada herhangi bir söylenti duydun mu?

english: Apparently Veos is looking for some help with something. He hangs around the docks of Port Piscarilius.
translation: Görünüse göre Veos bir konuda yardim ariyor. Port Piscarilius limaninda takiliyor.

english: They say there's trouble in Port Piscarilius. Something about gangs uniting. Might be worth looking into.
translation: Port Piscarilius'ta sorunlar oldugunu söylüyorlar. Cetelerin birlestigi ile ilgili bir sey. Arastirmaya deger olabilir.

english: I hear that Lord Hosidius has misplaced one of his sons. The Hosidius family might pay a lot to see him returned safely.
translation: Lord Hosidius'un ogullarindan birini kaybettigini duydum. Hosidius ailesi, oglunun sag salim geri dönmesi icin cok para ödeyebilir.

english: Phileas Rimor has supposedly been looking for some assistance with something in Shayzien. Maybe worth investigating.
translation: Phileas Rimor'un Shayzien'de bir konuda yardim aradigi söyleniyor. Arastirmaya deger olabilir.

english: I hear that the rulers of Lovakengj have some work available. You'll find them in the Lovakengj Assembly.
translation: Lovakengj'in yöneticilerinin bazi isler icin eleman aradigini duydum. Onlari Lovakengj Meclisi'nde bulabilirsin.

english: Apparently there's been some commotion in the middle of Arceuus. Might be worth checking out.
translation: Görünüse göre Arceuus'un ortasinda bir kargasa var. Bir göz atmaya deger olabilir.

english: That protest outside Kourend Castle is starting to attract some attention. Could be worth taking a look.
translation: Kourend Kalesi'nin disindaki protesto dikkat cekmeye basladi. Bir göz atmaya deger olabilir.

english: No, it hasn't been very busy lately.
translation: Hayir, son zamanlarda cok yogun degildi.

english: Could I get something to eat?
Sure, we sell stew made at The Golden Field pub for 25 gold pieces.
translation: Tabii, The Golden Field pub'da yapilan güvec 25 altin karsiliginda satiliyor.

english: Would you like a bowl?
Yes please, sounds great.
Are you sure you have enough money?
Oh... You're right, I don't have enough money.
That's ok, come back when you have enough money.
translation: Sorun degil, yeterli paran oldugunda tekrar gel.

english: No thanks.
Suit yourself. More delicious stew for everyone else.
translation: Sen bilirsin. Digerleri icin daha lezzetli güvec kalir.

english: I'm afraid not as I've something to attend to.
translation: Korkarim ki yapamam, halletmem gereken bir is var.

english: A wise man once told me to never fear a drink... But perhaps I'm a little bias.
translation: Bilge bir adam bir keresinde bana ickiden asla korkmamami söylemisti... Ama belki de biraz önyargiliyim.

english: I'll have a pint.
What is this place?
Sure, I'll have a pint.
I'm afraid not.
Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: Burada herhangi bir söylenti duydun mu?

english: Could I get something to eat?
Yes please, sounds great.
No thanks.
Hail Saradomin!
Feel the wrath of Saradomin.
Hail Zamorak!
Feel the wrath of Zamorak.
Hail Guthix!
Feel the wrath of Guthix.
How much wood would a woodchuck chuck if a woodchuck could chuck wood?
translation: Bir agackakan agac kesebilseydi, ne kadar agac keserdi?

english: Approximately 32,768 depending on his woodcutting level.
translation: Agac kesme seviyesine bagli olarak yaklasik 32.768 tane.

english: What did the oak tree drop?
What?
A-corny joke!
Aaaaaaaan I, willow-ays love youuu.
Why do maple trees not try to explore new lands?
translation: Akcaagaclar neden yeni topraklari kesfetmeye calismazlar?

english: Why?
They're afraid of treespassing.
Can we teak a break? My legs are tired.
translation: Biraz mola verebilir miyiz? Bacaklarim yoruldu.

english: If you had a pet pig, you could call it ma-hog-eat-any.
translation: Eger bir evcil domuzun olsaydi, ona ma-hog-eat-any adini verebilirdin.

english: Is there anything I can't eat?
Yew are a great companion.
Yew are too kind, my furry little friend.
I'm feeling blue today...
Anything I can do to cheer you up?
translation: Seni neselendirmek icin yapabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: A dam and some logs could be some fun....
translation: Bir baraj ve birkac kütük eglenceli olabilir...

english: It sure is hard to cut the top off of a redwood tree... You can't take any short cuts!
translation: Sekoya agacinin tepesini kesmek gercekten zor... Kestirme yol kullanamazsin!...

english: Why do I even try talking to you.
I almost choked on a log! This is not a larching matter!
translation: Neredeyse bir kütüge boguluyordum! Bu saka degil!

english: ...maybe if we all made an underground village together...
translation: ...belki hep birlikte bir yeralti köyü yaparsak...

english: What are you pondering, my furry friend?
Oh, just a grand plan to save all the wildlife from being hunted.
translation: Oh, sadece tüm vahsi hayvanlari avlanmaktan kurtarmak icin büyük bir plan.

english: That is quite fantastic, fox!
Hello fox, what do you say?
I do wish people would stop asking me that!
translation: Keske insanlar bana bunu sormayi biraksa!

english: I'm famished! Do you have any food?
translation: Acliktan ölüyorum! Yiyecek bir seyin var mi?

english: I'm sure we could find you something.
How about we visit a chicken coop to, uh, admire the scenery!
translation: Tavuk kümesine gidip manzarayi seyretmeye ne dersin?

english: I better find you something to eat quickly.
translation: Sana cabucak yiyecek bir seyler bulsam iyi olur.

english: You shake your tail feathers.
You look rather delicious today...
Ooh, don't mind if I do!
translation: Ooh, sakincasi yoksa ben de alayim!

english: You feed the chicken to your fox.
*chomp* Delicious!
While I appreciate the offer, I won't eat any old thing!
translation: Teklifin icin tesekkürler, ama her seyi yemem!

english: I can't believe people try to eat us.
What would you taste like? Chicken?
translation: Tadin nasil olurdu? Tavuk gibi mi?

english: I'd taste fowl, you wouldn't like it at all...
translation: Tavuk gibi tadi olurdu, hic sevmezdin...

english: What's the Freaky Forester like?
You mean the odd fellow who recruits random adventurers to butcher an exorbitant amount of my kind daily in exchange for his spare clothing?
translation: Her gün benim türümden cok sayida hayvani kesmek icin rastgele maceracilari ise alan, karsiliginda da yedek kiyafetlerini veren tuhaf adami mi kastediyorsun?

english: Why yes, he's simply delightful...
You look a bit on edge. Are you okay?
I have the strangest urge to run infront of a fast moving adventurer...
translation: Hizli hareket eden bir maceracinin önüne atlamak icin garip bir dürtü duyuyorum...

english: Redberries! Please and thank you!
You feed the berries to your pheasant.
*chomp* Scrummy!
Bwak! I am not some common fowl that will eat anything, I have standards!
translation: Bwak! Ben her seyi yiyen siradan bir kus degilim, standartlarim var!

english: Eww! What is that spell? Why would I want to chew on that? It stinks!
translation: Igrenc! Bu ne tür bir büyü? Neden bunu cignemek isteyeyim ki? Kokuyor!

english: What's this strange coating on the log?
translation: Bu kütügün üzerindeki garip kaplama da ne?

english: Olive oil blessed at an alter deep in Morytania. The oil helps with burning the shades in the area.
translation: Morytania'nin derinliklerindeki bir sunakta kutsanmis zeytinyagi. Yag, bölgedeki gölgeleri yakmaya yardimci oluyor.

english: ...and you want me to chew on it?
Well...
That's a hard pass from me.
There's something not quite right about this log.
What do you mean?
I'm not sure, it looks like it's in pain, maybe a little... achey?
translation: Emin degilim, aci cekiyor gibi görünüyor, belki biraz... agrisi var mi?

english: Sigh...
*sniff* *sniff* No thanks. These may look like logs but they stink of iron, what do I look like a rock golem?
translation: *koklama* *koklama* Hayir, tesekkürler. Bunlar kütük gibi görünebilir ama demir kokuyorlar, ben kaya golemine mi benziyorum?

english: *sniff* *sniff* No thanks. These logs smell just a bit too botanical for my liking. More of a beer beaver myself.
translation: *koklama* *koklama* Hayir, tesekkürler. Bu kütükler benim zevkime göre biraz fazla bitkisel kokuyor. Ben daha cok bira seven bir kunduzum.

english: Wow, that was awesome! You've really opened my eyes to the different types of logs out there in the world. I'll happily take any others you have!
translation: Vay canina, bu harikaydi! Dünyadaki farkli kütük türlerini görmemi sagladin. Elinde baska varsa seve seve alirim!

english: Your pet Beaver may enjoy this more.
translation: Evcil kunduzun bunu daha cok sevebilir.

english: What a splendid noise!
Feathers?! How novel!
You can change the colour of your pet Beaver by feeding it different types of logs.
translation: Evcil kunduzuna farkli türde kütükler vererek rengini degistirebilirsin.

english: You can unlock other forms for your pet Beaver by finding special items during Woodcutting events.
translation: Odun kesme etkinliklerinde özel ögeler bularak evcil kunduzun icin baska sekiller acabilirsin.

english: Your pet is already a Beaver.
Your pet is already a Fox.
Your pet is already a Pheasant.
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
*slap*
Grrrr!
Rowr!
Bwak!
Bwaak bwak!
*Peck*
Yes.
Yes, I'd like to treat my beaver.
No, it's fine as it is.
No.
Beaver
Fox
Pheasant
Cancel
I almost choked on a log! I don't know if I camphor-give you for that!
translation: Neredeyse bir kütük bogazima takiliyordu! Bunun için sana affedebilir miyim, bilmiyorum!

english: The truth is...
I am ironwood.
Eating logs is like enjoying wine. They all have a nuance of flavour. That last one for example was earthy, with hints of nuts and redberries, along with a scent of rose.!
translation: Kütük yemek, sarap içmek gibidir. Hepsinin kendine özgü bir tadi vardir. Mesela sonuncusu topraksi bir tada sahipti, findik ve kirmizi meyve aromalariyla birlikte gül kokusu da vardi!

english: Hello Effendi! How can I help you?
What is this place?
This is the camp of the Bedabin. Talk to our leader, Al Shabim, he'll be happy to chat. We can sell you very reasonably priced water...
translation: Burasi Bedabin kampi. Liderimiz Al Shabim ile konusun, sizinle sohbet etmekten memnuniyet duyacaktir. Size cok uygun fiyatli su satabiliriz...

english: Where is the Shantay Pass?
It is North East of here effendi, across the trackless desert. It will be a thirsty trip, can I interest you in a drink?
translation: Buranin kuzeydogusunda efendim, iz birakmayan cölün ötesinde. Susuz bir yolculuk olacak, bir icecek ister misiniz?

english: Okay, thanks
What is this place?
Where is the Shantay Pass?
What do you have to sell?
Okay, thanks
Hello Effendi! How can I help you?
What is this place?
This is the camp of the Bedabin. Talk to our leader, Al Shabim, he'll be happy to chat.
translation: Burasi Bedabin kampi. Liderimiz Al Shabim ile konusun, sizinle sohbet etmekten memnuniyet duyacaktir.

english: Where is the Shantay Pass?
It is north-east of here effendi, across the trackless desert. It will be a thirsty trip!
translation: Buradan kuzeydoguda, iz birakmayan cölün ötesinde. Susuz bir yolculuk olacak!

english: Okay, thanks
What is this place?
Where is the Shantay Pass?
Okay, thanks
Sorry, but you can't use the tent without permission. But thanks for all your help with the Bedabin people.
translation: Üzgünüm, ama izinsiz cadiri kullanamazsiniz. Ama Bedabin halkina yardim ettiginiz icin tesekkürler.

english: Sorry, but you can't use the tent without permission. Orders of Al Shabim.
translation: Üzgünüm, ama izinsiz cadiri kullanamazsiniz. Al Shabim'in emri.

english: Hello.
So how's life as a pirate?
What kind of question is that? How's life as a... I dunno. Whatever it is that you do for a living.
translation: Bu ne bicim bir soru? Hayat nasil... Bilmiyorum. Ne is yapiyorsan o.

english: I'm a freelance troubleshooter.
What does that entail then?
Mostly killing things for money and delivering items around the planet for people.
translation: Cogunlukla para karsiliginda bir seyler öldürmek ve insanlar icin gezegenin dört bir yanina esya teslim etmek.

english: I collect stuff.
So how's that life?
Can't complain, can't complain...
Well, there you go.
Aren't you a little short for a pirate?
translation: Korsan icin biraz kisa degil misin?

english: My mother was a gnome. Apparently it was a very painful birth.
translation: Annem bir cüceydi. Anlasilan cok aci verici bir dogum olmus.

english: More info than I wanted, thanks!
Sorry, can't stop, the Captain will have my guts for garters if he catches me slacking off talking to the stowaway.
translation: Üzgünüm, durmam gerek, kaptan beni kacak yolcuyla konusurken yakalarsa bagirsaklarimi cikarir.

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard!
translation: Ben kacak yolcu degilim! Gemide davetliyim!

english: Yeah, whatever [guy/lady], it doesn't really matter who you are I'll get in trouble!
translation: Evet, neyse , kim oldugun önemli degil, basim belaya girecek!

english: You know, I've always wondered what life as a pirate actually entails.
translation: Biliyor musun, korsan olmanin hayati nasil bir sey oldugunu hep merak etmisimdir.

english: Well, at the moment it mostly involves being asked random questions by a stowaway.
translation: Su anda cogunlukla kacak yolcu tarafindan rastgele sorular sorulmakla geciyor.

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard! By Lokar! Ask him!
translation: Ben kacak yolcu degilim! Gemiye davet edildim! Lokar tarafindan! Ona sor!

english: Hey, whatever [love/pal]. Just make sure the captain doesn't catch you, pirates don't like stowaways much.
translation: Hey, neyse . Kaptan seni yakalamasin, korsanlar kacak yolculari pek sevmezler.

english: Ah, good day to you [milady/sirrah]! Your face is unfamiliar, did you perhaps join us aboard the ship at Lunar Isle?
translation: Ah, iyi günler ! Yüzünüz tanidik gelmiyor, Lunar Isle'da gemiye mi bindiniz?

english: No, Lokar offered me a lift in Rellekka actually.
translation: Hayir, Lokar aslinda Rellekka'da beni gemiye davet etti.

english: Oh, really? You don't look like a Fremennik to me!
translation: Oh, gercekten mi? Bana Fremennik gibi görünmüyorsunuz!

english: Well... I kind of am, and I kind of aren't. It's a long story.
translation: Sey... Bir bakima öyleyim, bir bakima degilim. Uzun hikaye.

english: Sorry I don't have time to hear it then! See you around young fremennik-who-is-not-really-a-fremennik!
translation: Üzgünüm, dinleyecek vaktim yok! Görüsürüz, genc Fremennik-ama-aslinda-Fremennik-olmayan!

english: 'Bye.
Brrrr! Its cold up here!
You think this is cold? Up by Acheron it gets so cold that when you talk you see the words freeze in the air in front of you!
translation: Bunun soguk oldugunu mu düsünüyorsun? Acheron'da hava o kadar soguk ki, konustugunda sözcüklerin havada dondugunu görebilirsin!

english: REALLY?
Nah, not really. I was exaggerating for humourous effect. It is very very cold though!
translation: Hayir, degil. Komik olsun diye abarttim. Ama gercekten cok soguk!

english: Hello to you too.
Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!
translation: Yar! Biz korsaniz, yar! Dur, seni pis kara kurdu!

english: Please don't talk like that, it is extremely irritating.
translation: Lütfen böyle konusma, cok sinir bozucu.

english: Also, please don't call me a lychee, whatever that may be.
translation: Ayrica, lütfen bana ne oldugu belli olmayan bir sey olan “lychee” deme.

english: Oh. Okay. Sorry.
ARGH! SOUND THE ALARM! STOWAWAY ON BOARD! STOWAWAY ON BOARD!
translation: ARGH! ALARMI CALIN! GEMIDE KACAK YOLCU VAR! GEMIDE KACAK YOLCU VAR!

english: No! I'm not a stowaway! Honest! I was invited here!
translation: Hayir! Ben kacak yolcu degilim! Gercekten! Buraya davet edildim!

english: Oh, sorry, my mistake then.
You must admit you do look a lot like a stowaway though.
