translation: Ama kacak yolcuya cok benzedigini kabul etmelisin.

english: Why, what do they usually look like?
Erm... I've never actually met one...
Okay then...
Hello.
So... You're a pirate, huh?
It's what it says on my pay-packet at the end of the month.
translation: Ay sonunda maas cekimde öyle yaziyor.

english: How's that working out for you?
Pretty good so far. All the grog and loot that we can plunder, plus full medical including dental.
translation: Su ana kadar oldukca iyi. Yagmalayabildigimiz tüm icki ve ganimetler, ayrica dis tedavisi dahil tam saglik sigortasi.

english: You mean you have insurance?
Not as such. If any of us get sick we kidnap a doctor and don't let him go until we're better.
translation: Öyle sayilmaz. Icimizden biri hastalanirsa, bir doktor kaciririz ve iyilesene kadar onu birakmayiz.

english: You'd be surprised what an incentive for expert health care that is.
translation: Bunun uzman saglik hizmeti icin ne kadar tesvik edici oldugunu bilsen sasirirsin.

english: I can imagine.
Hello there. So what brings you aboard the Lady Zay?
translation: Merhaba. Lady Zay'e ne getiriyor seni?

english: Well, I was planning on visiting the Moon Clan, but I have to say your ship is very impressive.
translation: Aslinda Moon Klani'ni ziyaret etmeyi planliyordum, ama geminizin cok etkileyici oldugunu söylemeliyim.

english: Aye, she's a beauty alright! The Lady Zay has been my home for many hard months, through storm and sun, and she always gets us to here we were headed!
translation: Evet, gercekten cok güzel! Lady Zay, firtinalarda ve günesin altinda gecirdigim zorlu aylar boyunca benim evim oldu ve bizi her zaman hedefimize ulastirdi!

english: Yes, she's certainly one of the finest boats I've seen on my travels!
translation: Evet, seyahatlerim sirasinda gördügüm en güzel teknelerden biri!

english: That she is [lad/lass], that she is.
I'm sorry to bother you, [player name], but I need some help with a bee hive.
translation: Rahatsiz ettigim icin üzgünüm, Maceraci, ama ari kovaniyla ilgili yardima ihtiyacim var.

english: Ooh, a bee hive. I'll help you.
translation: Ooh, ari kovani. Sana yardim ederim.

english: Player is teleported to a field of beehives
translation: Oyuncu ari kovanlarinin bulundugu bir tarlaya isinlanir.

english: Buzz off!
Ah, [player name]. I'm sorry to drag you away like this, but I need some help building a new hive for my bees.
translation: Ah, Maceraci. Seni böyle alip götürdügüm icin üzgünüm, ama arilarim icin yeni bir kovan yaparken yardima ihtiyacim var.

english: What do you expect me to do?
All the parts of the beehive are jumbled up. You've got to put them in the correct order for building a hive.
translation: Ari kovaninin tüm parcalari karismis. Kovani yapmak icin onlari dogru sirayla yerlestirmelisin.

english: Oh, very well. Let's take a look...
Ready to try again?
First remind me of what I'm doing.
translation: Önce ne yapmam gerektigini hatirlat bana.

english: Yeah, let me get on with it.
No, that doesn't look right. You have to put the parts in the right order, otherwise it'll be no good as a beehive.
translation: Hayir, bu dogru görünmüyor. Parcalari dogru siraya koymalisin, aksi takdirde ari kovani olarak ise yaramaz.

english: I'll let you have 5 more tries.
I'll let you have 4 more tries.
I'll let you have 3 more tries.
I'll let you have 2 more tries.
I'll let you have one more try.
Uh-oh, the bees are fed up with waiting for you to build them a home!
translation: Uh-oh, arilar sana ev yapmani beklemekten biktilar!

english: Three bee swarms start stinging the player, while the player runs around for a while and attempts to defend themself helplessly.
translation: Üc ari sürüsü oyuncuya saldirmaya baslar, oyuncu ise bir süre etrafta kosusturup caresizce kendini savunmaya calisir.

english: Aaaaargh - BEES!
Ooch!
Eek!
Beees!
Ow!
I'll help you!
The bee keeper starts casting a tele-other spell.
translation: Arici, baska bir büyü yapmaya baslar.

english: The bee keeper obligingly teleports you away from the angry swarms.
translation: Arici, seni öfkeli ari sürüsünden uzaklastirir.

english: Player is teleported back to their original location, with no reward and no losses.
translation: Oyuncu, ödül veya kayip olmadan orijinal konumuna geri gönderilir.

english: That's perfect! I'll get some bees moved in immediately.
Now, I'm sure I must have something to offer you for all your help...
translation: Simdi, tüm yardimlariniz icin size bir sey sunmam gerektigini düsünüyorum...

english: Player is teleported back to their original location
Sorry, you're not the person I need.
Goodbye.
Hello, [player name]?
Please help me, [player name].
I need your help, [player name]!
Can I borrow you for a minute, [player name]?
translation: Bir dakika izin verir misiniz, Maceraci?

english: Maybe later.
Ooh, a bee hive. I'll help you.
translation: Ooh, bir ari kovani. Sana yardim edecegim.

english: Buzz off!
First remind me of what I'm doing.
Yeah, let me get on with it.
translation: Evet, birak da isime devam edeyim.

english: Hello, what's going on?
Hello, it seems you've found a wild bee hive. I'll pay you to help me rehome them.
translation: Merhaba, görünüse göre vahsi bir ari kovani bulmussun. Onlari baska bir yere tasimama yardim edersen sana para veririm.

english: Oh, well, if you ever want to find out how to help, just ask.
translation: Oh, peki, nasil yardim edebilecegini ögrenmek istersen, sorman yeter.

english: It's easy, simply add logs to the unfinished bee boxes I create. Most common types of log work just fine.
translation: Cok kolay, benim yaptigim bitmemis ari kutusuna kütükler ekle yeter. En yaygin kütük türleri is görür.

english: Once a bee box is completed I will start a new one, let's see how many of these bees we can save.
translation: Bir ari kutusu tamamlandiginda yenisine baslarim, bakalim kac ariyi kurtarabilecegiz.

english: Oh, Bees!
I'll find a nice new home for those bees.
translation: O arilar icin güzel bir yuva bulacagim.

english: Come with me little bees I'll keep you safe.
translation: Gelin benimle kücük arilar, sizi güvende tutacagim.

english: Another new hive.
Well, I must be getting on now.
I'm not interested.
How can I help?
Please kind [sir/lady]... my family and I are starving...
translation: Lütfen ... ailem ve ben acliktan ölüyoruz...

english: Could you find it in your heart to spare me a simple loaf of bread?
translation: Bana bir somun ekmek verebilir misiniz?

english: Yes certainly.
... except I don't have any bread on me at the moment...
translation: ama su anda üzerimde ekmek yok...

english: Well if you get some, you know where to come.
Thank you very much!
The beggar has turned into the Lady of the Lake!
Well done. You have passed my test.
Here is Excalibur, guard it well.
No I don't have any bread with me.
Have you got any bread for me yet?
Yes, here you go.
Actually, I'm wrong. I still don't have any bread. Sorry.
translation: Aslinda yanilmisim. Hala ekmek yok. Üzgünüm.

english: Sorry, no, I still have none.
The beggar isn't interested in talking.
Yes certainly.
No I don't have any bread with me.
Yes, here you go.
No, I still have none.
Well hello there sweetheart.
Hi!
What brings you down here?
I'm looking for the Easter Bunny.
Fancy that! You're in luck, he's in the next room.
translation: Ne güzel! Sanslisin, o yan odada.

english: I'm trying to cheer up the Easter Bunny, do you have any suggestions?
translation: Paskalya Tavsanini neselendirmek istiyorum, önerin var mi?

english: Hmm, well, he's a sensible bunny, I'm sure he'd love to go carrot bowling!
translation: Hmm, o mantikli bir tavsan, eminim havuc bowling oynamayi cok sevecektir!

english: Bowling? Where can we do that?
It just so happens we have a carrot bowling alley right here in the Rabbit Hole!
translation: Sansina, Tavsan Deligi'nde havuc bowling salonu var!

english: Really? Wow! That's fortunate. Where is it?
translation: Gercekten mi? Vay canina! Ne sansliyiz. Nerede?

english: Through the door to the east, turn left, then it's on the right. You can't miss it!
translation: Dogu kapisindan gir, sola dön, sonra sagda. Kacirman imkansiz!

english: Well, maybe you can. Depends on your navigational skills I suppose.
translation: Belki de kacirabilirsin. Sanirim navigasyon becerilerine bagli.

english: Anyway, talk to Bowley Moley when you get there, I'm sure he will be happy to help.
translation: Neyse, oraya vardiginda Bowley Moley ile konus, eminim sana seve seve yardim edecektir.

english: Alright, I'll have a look for this bowling alley and speak to Bowley Moley. Thanks!
translation: Tamam, bu bowling salonunu arayip Bowley Moley ile konusacagim. Tesekkürler!

english: Look who it is! I heard the Easter Bunny gave you a true thrashing on that alley.
translation: Bakin kim gelmis! Paskalya Tavsani'nin sana o salonda gercek bir dayak attigini duydum.

english: Oh yeah, I got outplayed fair and square!
It seems to have lifted his spirits somewhat, thanks for doing that.
translation: Bu onun moralini biraz düzeltmis gibi görünüyor, tesekkürler.

english: I'm just glad to cheer him up a bit.
Hey, [player name]. I thought it was really sweet of you to help cheer up that bunny.
translation: Hey, Maceraci. O tavsani neselendirmek icin yardim etmen cok tatliydi.

english: Maybe we could go bowling sometime and you could cheer me up too?
translation: Belki bir ara bowling oynamaya gideriz ve sen de beni neselendirebilirsin?

english: That would be fun, though I'm quite busy at the moment, and in the near future.
translation: Bu eglenceli olurdu, ama su anda ve yakin gelecekte oldukca mesgulüm.

english: What about the far future?
Oh the far future is looking very busy for me.
translation: Uzak gelecek de benim icin cok yogun görünüyor.

english: But if I find the time, we could invite the Easter Bunny too! We'd all have a great game I'm sure.
translation: Ama zaman bulursam, Paskalya Tavsanini da davet edebiliriz! Eminim hepimiz harika bir oyun oynariz.

english: Oh, I see. Nevermind then, if you're so busy.
translation: Anliyorum. O kadar mesgulsen, bos ver.

english: Hello puss.
Hiss!
Hello human.
Would you like a fish?
I don't want your fish. I hunt and eat what I need by myself.
translation: Senin baligini istemiyorum. Ihtiyacim olani kendim avlayip yerim.

english: Hello human.
What do you do here?
This guild contains minerals that haven't been found anywhere else. I'm here to try and identify them.
translation: Bu guildde baska hicbir yerde bulunmayan mineraller var. Onlari tanimlamak icin buradayim.

english: If you come across any unusual minerals when mining here I'll take them off your hands. Don't worry, I'll make it worth your while.
translation: Burada madencilik yaparken olagandisi mineraller bulursan, onlari senden alirim. Merak etme, karsiligini alacaksin.

english: I've also been digging out this cave recently. I found a bunch of amethyst in there.
translation: Son zamanlarda bu magarayi da kaziyorum. Icinde bir sürü ametist buldum.

english: What can you offer me?
I have some gloves that will help you when Mining. When you wear these gloves you'll find that some rocks will instantly respawn.
translation: Madencilik yaparken sana yardimci olacak eldivenlerim var. Bu eldivenleri giydiginde bazi kayalarin aninda yeniden ortaya ciktigini göreceksin.

english: How do they do that?
Magic!
Beyond that, I could consider letting you access this new cave. It seems to contain even more minerals.
translation: Bunun disinda, bu yeni magaraya erismene izin vermeyi düsünebilirim. Daha da fazla mineral iceriyor gibi görünüyor.

english: So, what would you like?
I'd like access to the cave.
Now hold on. There's a lot of minerals in there, and digging out the cave was hard work. Only a true friend of Falador would be allowed in there.
translation: Dur biraz. Orada cok fazla mineral var ve magarayi kazmak zor bir isti. Sadece Falador'un gercek dostlari oraya girebilir.

english: You don't seem like you're quite there yet. Come speak to me again once you have completed the Elite Falador Achievement Diary.
translation: Henüz o noktaya gelmemis gibisin. Elite Falador Basari Günlügünü tamamladiginda tekrar benimle konus.

english: And you truly are a friend of Falador. Well done on completing the Elite Falador Achievement Diary. Go on in, you may access the cave.
translation: Sen gercekten Falador'un dostusun. Elite Falador Basari Günlügünü tamamladigin icin tebrikler. Iceri gir, magaraya girebilirsin.

english: That's all thank you.
Don't forget to come to me if you find any minerals.
translation: Herhangi bir mineral bulursan bana gelmeyi unutma.

english: I don't want to receive minerals.
Very well. You'll no longer find any minerals when you mine here. If you change your mind just let me know.
translation: Peki. Artik burada madencilik yaparken mineral bulamayacaksin. Fikrini degistirirsen bana haber ver.

english: I'd like to receive minerals.
As you wish. You'll now find minerals when you mine here. Let me know if you want to change this.
translation: Nasil istersen. Artik burada madencilik yaparken mineral bulacaksin. Bunu degistirmek istersen bana haber ver.

english: Can you combine my mining gloves?
I guess I could combine some Mining gloves with some Superior mining gloves. These new gloves would require 70 Mining to equip.
translation: Sanirim bazi Madencilik eldivenlerini bazi Üstün madencilik eldivenleriyle birlestirebilirim. Bu yeni eldivenleri giymek icin 70 Madencilik seviyesi gerekiyor.

english: It wouldn't be free though. I'd want 60 minerals in return.
translation: Ancak bu ücretsiz olmayacak. Karsiliginda 60 mineral istiyorum.

english: You don't have any gloves for me to combine. You'll need to bring me some Mining gloves and some Superior mining gloves.
translation: Birlestirmem icin eldivenin yok. Bana madencilik eldivenleri ve üstün madencilik eldivenleri getirmen gerekecek.

english: There you go. I've combined your gloves into some Expert mining gloves. Enjoy.
translation: Iste oldu. Eldivenlerini uzman madencilik eldivenlerine dönüstürdüm. Keyfini cikar.

english: Fair enough. I'll be here if you change your mind.
Hey, you! You're not allowed in there! Come speak to me first.
translation: Hey, sen! Oraya giremezsin! Önce benimle konus.

english: I'm sorry.
I have minerals to trade.
What can you offer me?
I'd like to view the shop.
I'd like access to the cave.
That's all thank you.
I don't want to receive minerals.
I'd like to receive minerals.
Can you combine my mining gloves?
That's fine. Combine my gloves.
That's too much.
That's all.
Thanks so much for saving me from being a vampyre. Here, take this certificate, I'm sorry but it's all I can offer as a reward.
translation: Beni vampir olmaktan kurtardigin icin cok tesekkür ederim. Al, bu sertifikayi al. Üzgünüm ama ödül olarak sunabilecegim tek sey bu.

english: Thanks for changing me back, it must have been hard for you. I must be off now.
translation: Beni eski halime döndürdügün icin tesekkürler, senin icin zor olmus olmali. Artik gitmeliyim.

english: Can I have a newspaper, please?
Certainly, Guv. That'll be 50 coins, please.
Maybe when I've got more money on me.
Well, no cash, no paper. Live in ignorance.
translation: Paran yoksa gazete de yok. Cehalet icinde yasa.

english: Sure, here you go...
Okay, suit yourself. Plenty more fish in the sea.
translation: Tamam, sen bilirsin. Denizde daha cok balik var.

english: How much does a paper cost?
Just 50 coins! An absolute bargain! Want one?
translation: Sadece 50 sikke! Kesinlikle cok ucuz! Ister misin?

english: Varrock Herald? Never heard of it.

For the illiterate amongst us, I shall elucidate. The Varrock Herald is a new newspaper. It is edited, printed and published by myself, Benny Gutenberg, and each edition promises to enthrall the reader with
translation: Okuma yazma bilmeyenler icin aciklayayim. Varrock Herald yeni bir gazete. Ben, Benny Gutenberg tarafindan düzenleniyor, basiliyor ve yayinlaniyor ve her sayi okuyucuyu büyüleyici iceriklerle

english: captivating material! Now, can I interest you in buying one for a mere 50 coins?
translation: büyüleyecek! Simdi, sadece 50 jeton karsiliginda bir tane satin almak ister misin?

english: Anything interesting in there?
translation: Icinde ilginc bir sey var mi?

english: Of course there is, mate. Packed full of thought provoking insights, contentious interviews and celebrity scandalmongering! An excellent read and all for just 50 coins! Want one?
translation: Tabii ki var dostum. Düsündürücü icgörüler, tartismali röportajlar ve ünlülerin skandallariyla dolu! Mükemmel bir okuma ve hepsi sadece 50 jeton! Bir tane ister misin?

english: Read all about it!
Extra! Extra! Read all about it!
Buy your Varrock Herald now!
Varrock Herald, now only 50 coins!
Get you Varrock Herald here!
Varrock Herald, on sale here!
Can I have a newspaper, please?
Sure, here you go...
No, thanks.
How much does a paper cost?
Varrock Herald? Never heard of it.
Anything interesting in there?
translation: Icinde ilginc bir sey var mi?

english: Do you mind? You're in my home.
I'm sorry, should I have knocked?
Very funny, human.
We can't all live in plush houses, you know. But that doesn't mean us mining dwarves don't work hard.
translation: Hepimiz lüks evlerde yasayamayiz, biliyorsun. Ama bu, madenci cücelerin cok calismadigi anlamina gelmez.

english: Where do you do your mining?
Normally the coal mine to the north. We need a lot of coal to keep our steam engines going, you know.
translation: Normalde kuzeydeki kömür madeninde. Buhar makinelerimizi calistirmak icin cok fazla kömüre ihtiyacimiz var, biliyorsun.

english: Can I do a bit of mining there as well?
translation: Ben de orada biraz madencilik yapabilir miyim?

english: I'm not sure, but as long as no one notices I don't think anyone is going to care.
translation: Emin degilim, ama kimse fark etmezse kimsenin umurunda olmayacagini düsünüyorum.

english: How are your grapes coming along?
Marvellously, thanks to your help, [player name]!
translation: Senin yardimin sayesinde harika gidiyor, Maceraci!

english: Hello.
Good day, adventurer. If you have any questions, I'm sure Lars will be more than happy to answer them. He's in the building to the south.
translation: Iyi günler, maceraci. Herhangi bir sorunuz varsa, Lars seve seve cevaplayacaktir. Güneydeki binada.

english: Also don't forget to visit my sister's axe shop. She works in the same building as Lars.
translation: Ayrica kiz kardesimin balta dükkanini ziyaret etmeyi unutma. Lars ile ayni binada calisiyor.

english: Thanks!
Welcome to the Woodcutting Guild, adventurer.
Bert! Good news!
Arrr...Good news be always handy.
translation: Arrr... Iyi haberler her zaman ise yarar.

english: They arrested Sandy for the murder of a wizard and the sand pit now refills itself!
translation: Sandy'yi bir büyücünün cinayetinden tutukladilar ve kum cukuru artik kendi kendine doluyor!

english: ME JOB! I'VE LOSTED ME JOB! 'ow c'n yer say tha' be good news?? Me wife'll tear me limb fr'm limb!
translation: ISIM! ISIMI KAYBETTIM! Bu nasil iyi haber olabilir? Karim beni paramparca edecek!

english: Don't worry, the Wizardsare going to pay you a large pension so that you can retire...
translation: Merak etme, Büyücüler sana emekli olabilmen icin büyük bir emekli maasi ödeyecekler...

english: Bu' wha'll I be doin' wit' me day now! I be lovin' tha sand.
translation: Ama simdi günümü ne yapacagim? Kumu seviyorum.

english: What will you do with your day? Well....You could build sand castles with your own two hands!
translation: Gününüzü ne yapacaksiniz? Sey... Kendi ellerinizle kumdan kaleler yapabilirsiniz!

english: I din't think so... bu' iffen yer ever need someone ta haul buckets o'sand 'round, ye be lettin' me know [player name], I's can help yer!
translation: Sanmiyorum... ama kum kovalarini tasimak icin birine ihtiyaciniz olursa, bana haber verin Maceraci, size yardim edebilirim!

english: Wow! That would be great, buckets of sand direct to bank everdayyou say? That's great!
translation: Vay canina! Bu harika olur, her gün kum kovalarini dogrudan bankaya mi götüreceksin? Bu harika!

english: Once per day you may ask Bert to help you by carrying 84 buckets of sand to your bank. Just talk to him!
translation: Günde bir kez Bert'ten 84 kova kum bankana tasimasi icin yardim isteyebilirsin. Onunla konusman yeterli!

english: 'Ello there [player name]!
Can you deliver sand to my bank, please?
Eeee, ye've go' no free space in yon bank [player name]. Make some room 'tween the fishes 'n boots fore ye come back ta me.
translation: Eeee, bankanda bos yer kalmamis Maceraci. Bana gelmeden önce baliklar ve botlarin arasinda biraz yer ac.

english: Ok, I'll make some more space in my bank and come back!
translation: Tamam, bankamda biraz yer acip geri gelecegim!

english: I'll see you another time.
Can you deliver sand to my bank, please?
I'll see you another time.
Sorry I'm not into magic.
Well, if you see anyone who is into magic, please send them my way.
translation: Sihirle ilgilenen birini görürsen, lütfen bana gönder.

english: I heard from Zavistic what a good job you did. If you want some more pink dye, I have made up a batch and you can have some for 20 gold.
translation: Zavistic'ten ne kadar iyi is cikardigini duydum. Eger biraz daha pembe boya istiyorsan, bir parti hazirladim ve 20 altin karsiliginda alabilirsin.

english: Yes please!
You hand over 20 gold pieces in return for the dye
I've come from Yanille, the wizard says you can make Truth Serum?
translation: Yanille'den geldim, büyücü senin Hakikat Serumu yapabildigini söylüyor?

english: This is true deary, I'll need an empty vial.
translation: Bu dogru canim, bos bir siseye ihtiyacim var.

english: I have one here!
That's good, now you'll need to make a rose tinted lens. Pink dye can be made from red berries in this bottle to make redberry juice, then add white berries. Just use that on a bullseye lens.
translation: Güzel, simdi pembe renkli bir mercek yapman gerekecek. Pembe boya, bu sisedeki kirmizi meyvelerden kirmizi meyve suyu yaparak, sonra beyaz meyveler ekleyerek yapilabilir. Bunu bir bullseye mercek üzerinde kullan.

english: Hello deary! Have you managed to make that lens yet?
translation: Merhaba canim! O mercegi yapabildin mi?

english: I'm still working on it.
I'm afraid I've forgotten how!
Pink dye can be made from red berries in the bottle I gave you. Add white berries to make the pink dye and then you just need to use that on a bullseye lens. Good luck!
translation: Pembe boya, sana verdigim sisedeki kirmizi meyvelerden yapilabilir. Beyaz meyveleri ekleyerek pembe boyayi hazirla ve sonra onu bullseye lensine sür. Iyi sanslar!

english: Wonderful deary. When you're ready, just stand in the open doorway and focus the light on the empty vial on my desk and I'll pour the serum into it.
translation: Harika canim. Hazir oldugunda, acik kapinin önünde dur ve isigi masamdaki bos siseye odakla, ben de serumu icine dökecegim.

english: Ok, what does that do?
Why it makes the person who drinks it unable to hide in the shadow of lies. The light of truth will shine!
translation: Bunu icen kisinin yalanlarin gölgesinde saklanmasini engeller. Gercegin isigi parlayacak!

english: Ok, now the last ingredient, something personal from the person you need to tell the truth, else it won't work!
translation: Tamam, simdi son malzeme, gercegi söylemen gereken kisinin kisisel bir esyasi, yoksa ise yaramaz!

english: What about this sand straight from his pocket?
translation: Onun cebinden cikan bu kum nasil?

english: That's excellent deary!
Don't forget to dilute it in something like tea or coffee.
translation: Cay veya kahve gibi bir seyle seyreltmeyi unutma.

english: Hello deary! How did the serum work?
translation: Merhaba canim! Serum nasil ise yaradi?

english: I haven't tried it yet.
Well don't forget to dilute it in a drink or something else bad things might happen.
translation: Icecekle seyreltmeyi unutma, yoksa kötü seyler olabilir.

english: Bad things?
Well.... bits might drop off.
Oh! I... see. I'll remember to dilute it then.
Good job. I have new information to share with you.
translation: Aferin. Seninle paylasacagim yeni bilgilerim var.

english: Can I see your wares?
Sorry I'm not into magic.
No thanks Betty
Yes please!
Talk to Betty about the Hand in the Sand.
translation: Betty ile Kumdaki El hakkinda konus.

english: Talk to Betty about her shop.
I'm still working on it.
I'm afraid I've forgotten how!
Hey kid, what's all the shouting about?
translation: Hey cocuk, bu bagirislar da ne?

english: Christmas is ruined!
Again? What's happened this time?
translation: Yine mi? Bu sefer ne oldu?

english: The man in the shop won't give us our Gingerbread Gnomes, he's keeping them for himself.
translation: Dükkândaki adam bize Zencefilli Cücelerimizi vermiyor, onlari kendine sakliyor.

english: That doesn't sound right, are you sure that's really what he's doing?
translation: Bu dogru gelmiyor, gercekten öyle yaptigindan emin misin?

english: Of course he is, why else won't he give us any?
translation: Tabii ki öyle, yoksa neden bize vermesin ki?

english: Something seems off, maybe I should go talk to Santa to find out what's happened.
translation: Bir terslik var, belki de ne oldugunu ögrenmek icin Noel Baba ile konusmaliyim.

english: Do whatever you want, I want my Gingerbread Gnomes!
translation: Ne istersen yap, ben Zencefilli Cücelerimi istiyorum!

english: Where are our Gingerbread Gnomes!
I'm working on it, I'm working on it.
Hurry up!
You've ruined Christmas!
Give us the Gnomes!
Why are you still here? I saved Christmas, you can go home.
translation: Neden hâlâ buradasin? Noel'i kurtardim, eve gidebilirsin.

english: We still have to wait for the delivery to come in, dummy.
translation: Hâlâ teslimatin gelmesini beklememiz gerekiyor, aptal.

english: I'll leave you to it then.
Christmas is Saved!
Hurry up with the delivery!
I have much tidying to do, so please be brief.
translation: Yapacak cok isim var, lütfen kisa kesin.

english: I'm looking for a book:[book]
Try the [bottom/middle/top] floor, [central area/north-eastern bay/south-eastern bay/south-western bay/north-western bay].
Thank you.
What do you do here?
I assist the Chief Librarian, Logosia, in the running of the Library. There is always much tidying to be done.
translation: Kütüphane müdürü Logosia'ya kütüphanenin yönetiminde yardimci oluyorum. Her zaman yapilacak cok is var.

english: Logosia is a truly great scholar, but her temperament may not be entirely suited to the duties of a librarian.
translation: Logosia gercekten harika bir akademisyen, ama mizaci kütüphaneci görevine pek uygun olmayabilir.

english: Okay, thanks.
I'll be off.
Here you go.
You are handed a torn part of a clue scroll.
translation: Sana bir ipucu parsömeninin yirtik bir parcasi verilir.

english: Have you seen any dark manuscripts?
Hey, I have something for you but you don't have any space for it!
translation: Hey, sana bir seyim var ama bunun icin yerin yok!

english: I'm looking for a book...
What do you do here?
I'll be off.
Have you seen any dark manuscripts?
Why, hello there!
Tell me about yourself.
The name is Big Mo. I was a travelling salesman and businessman, passing through the towns to see what wares I could get my hands on.
translation: Adim Big Mo. Gezgin bir satici ve is adamiydim, kasabalari dolasip ne tür mallar bulabilecegime bakardim.

english: I do remember buying clue scrolls off you, long ago.
translation: Uzun zaman önce senden ipucu parsömenleri satin aldigimi hatirliyorum.

english: Yes, I was selling them to encourage people to explore. I'd only sell each person one clue scroll per day, of course.
translation: Evet, insanlari kesfetmeye tesvik etmek icin satiyordum. Tabii ki her kisiye günde sadece bir ipucu parsömeni satiyordum.

english: Goodbye.
Where were you from originally?
HA HA HA! I deliberately didn't tell people where I was from. Mostly they assumed me to be from Zeah.
translation: HA HA HA! Insanlara nereli oldugumu kasten söylemedim. Cogu benim Zeahli oldugumu varsayiyordu.

english: That may or may not be true, though - no-one else in Zeah looks much like me. I'll leave it as a mystery...
translation: Bu dogru olabilir de olmayabilir de - Zeah'ta bana benzeyen baska kimse yok. Bunu bir sir olarak birakayim...

english: Who are you?
The name is Big Mo. I'm a travelling salesman and businessman from overseas.
translation: Adim Big Mo. Yurtdisindan gelen bir gezgin satici ve is adamiyim.

english: I drop by these parts every so often to see what wares I can get my hands on.
translation: Ne tür mallar bulabilecegimi görmek icin sik sik bu bölgelere ugrarim.

english: What do you mean by 'overseas'? Karamja?
Ha! It seems you've got a lot of the world left to explore. hey, maybe I could help you with that.
translation: Ha! Görünüse göre kesfedilecek cok yerin var. Hey, belki ben sana bu konuda yardimci olabilirim.

english: Exploration? I'm listening...
When I buy stock, I buy almost everything I can get my hands on. I always end up finding clue scrolls mixed in with my stock.
translation: Stok satin alirken, bulabildigim hemen hemen her seyi alirim. Sonunda stoklarimin arasinda ipucu parsömenleri bulurum.

english: Why don't you do the clue scrolls yourself? Wouldn't you make more money?
translation: Neden ipucu parsömenlerini kendin yapmiyorsun? Daha fazla para kazanmaz misin?

english: HA! Sure, the guy in the 50,000,000 coin suit is going to run around all day digging holes. Come on! Now, do you want to buy one?
translation: HA! Tabii, 50.000.000 coinlik takim elbiseli adam bütün gün delik kazmak icin kosturacak. Hadi ama! Simdi, bir tane almak ister misin?

english: Sounds good to me.
Okay, they're 50 coins each. How much of a challenge would you like? I'll take a look and see if I have a clue fitting for your experience.
translation: Tamam, tanesi 50 coin. Ne kadar zorlukta bir sey istersin? Bir bakayim, senin deneyimine uygun bir ipucu var mi.

english: The easier the better.
translation: Ne kadar kolay olursa o kadar iyi.

english: Perfect! I've got just the clue right here. Pleasure doing business with you!
translation: Mükemmel! Tam da aradigin ipucu burada. Seninle is yapmak bir zevkti!

english: If you can track me down again another day I will do my best to have the perfect clue for you. Good luck.
translation: Bir baska gün beni tekrar bulabilirsen, sana mükemmel bir ipucu bulmak icin elimden geleni yapacagim. Iyi sanslar.

english: Not too easy, not too hard.
translation: Ne cok kolay ne cok zor.

english: I like a challenge. Give me one to wrinkle my brain.
translation: Zorlu görevleri severim. Beynimi zorlayacak bir görev ver bana.

english: Give me the hardest clue you can get your hands on.
translation: Elinde bulunan en zor ipucunu ver bana.

english: Forget it, I changed my mind.
No thanks.
Exploration? Sounds exhausting. I'm off.
translation: Kesif mi? Yorucu gibi. Ben gidiyorum.

english: Why, hello there! Want to buy another clue scroll?
translation: Merhaba! Baska bir ipucu parsömeni almak ister misin?

english: Why don't you do the cluue scrolls yourself?
I'm afraid this is the best I can do right now. Pleasure doing business with you!
translation: Korkarim su anda yapabilecegimin en iyisi bu. Seninle is yapmak bir zevkti!

english: Tell me about yourself.
Where were you from originally?
Goodbye.
Exploration? I'm listening...
Sounds good to me.
The easier the better.
translation: Ne kadar kolay olursa o kadar iyi.

english: Not too easy, not too hard.
translation: Ne cok kolay, ne cok zor.

english: I like a challenge. Give me one to wrinkle my brain.
translation: Zorlu görevleri severim. Beynimi zorlayacak bir tane ver.

english: Give me the hardest clue you can get your hands on.
Forget it, I changed my mind.
No thanks.
Exploration? Sounds exhausting. I'm off.
translation: Kesif mi? Yorucu gibi. Ben yokum.

english: Why don't you do the cluue scrolls yourself?
Buy an easy clue.
Buy a medium clue.
translation: Orta zorlukta bir ipucu satin al.

english: Buy a hard clue.
Buy an elite clue.
Cancel
Hey kid, what's all the shouting about?
translation: Hey cocuk, bu bagirislar da neyin nesi?

english: Christmas is ruined!
Again? What's happened this time?
translation: Yine mi? Bu sefer ne oldu?

english: The man in the shop won't give us our Gingerbread Gnomes, he's keeping them for himself.
translation: Dükkândaki adam bize Zencefilli Cücelerimizi vermiyor, onlari kendine sakliyor.

english: That doesn't sound right, are you sure that's really what he's doing?
translation: Bu dogru gelmiyor, gercekten öyle yaptigindan emin misin?

english: Of course he is, why else won't he give us any?
translation: Tabii ki öyle, yoksa neden bize vermesin ki?

english: Something seems off, maybe I should go talk to Santa to find out what's happened.
translation: Bir terslik var, belki de ne oldugunu ögrenmek icin Noel Baba ile konusmaliyim.

english: Do whatever you want, I want my Gingerbread Gnomes!
translation: Ne istersen yap, ben zencefilli kurabiye cücelerimi istiyorum!

english: Where are our Gingerbread Gnomes!
I'm working on it, I'm working on it.
Hurry up!
You've ruined Christmas!
Give us the Gnomes!
Why are you still here? I saved Christmas, you can go home.
translation: Neden hâlâ buradasin? Noel'i kurtardim, eve gidebilirsin.

english: We still have to wait for the delivery to come in, dummy.
translation: Hâlâ teslimatin gelmesini beklememiz gerekiyor, aptal.

english: I'll leave you to it then.
Christmas is Saved!
Hurry up with the delivery!
If yer after a lift go to the ship and I'll take ye where ye want to go.
translation: Eger bir araca ihtiyacin varsa gemiye git, seni istedigin yere götürürüm.

english: I suppose ye'll be wantin' a lift while yer here, right [lad/lass]?
translation: Burada oldugun sürece bir araca ihtiyacin olacak, degil mi ?

english: Cap'n, I lost that book you gave me.
Ye'll notice I'm not fallin' to the floor in shock right now. Look, if I gives ye another copy will ye keep a better eye on it?
translation: Su anda soktan yere yigilmadigimi fark etmissindir. Bak, sana baska bir kopya versem, ona daha iyi bakacak misin?

english: Aye Cap'n!
Then here, have this other copy I dug up.
translation: O zaman al, buldugum diger kopyayi al.

english: No, I should be gettin' back anyway. Come on [lad/lass], let's be off.
translation: Hayir, zaten geri dönmem gerek. Hadi , gidelim.

english: Nothin' I won't put on hold. Come on [lad/lass], let's be off.
translation: Ertelemeyecegim hicbir sey yok. Hadi , gidelim.

english: No thanks, Cap'n.
Well, come see me if ye ever do.
Cap'n, I lost that book you gave me.
Yes Cap'n, I'd like a lift.
translation: Evet Kaptan, beni de götürür müsün?

english: No thanks, Cap'n.
Billy isn't interested in talking.
Hello there.
Hey! scheck it out! Itsh an outerlandub! Yer shud go shpeak to the chieftain!
translation: Hey! Suna bak! Bu bir yabanci! Sefle konusmalisin!

english: The who?
That guy over there by that stuff! (hic) Yeh, abshoultely! He's da bosh!
translation: Su esyalarin yanindaki adam! (hic) Evet, kesinlikle! O patron!

english: I know this is a bit of a long shot... but are you a member of the council of elders?
translation: Biliyorum bu biraz zor bir ihtimal... ama sen yaslilar konseyinin bir üyesi misin?

english: I'm now a member of the counshil of eblars? Thanksh a lot buddy! (hic) Letsh have a drink to celebrate!
translation: Simdi yaslilar konseyinin bir üyesi miyim? Cok tesekkürler dostum! (hic) Kutlamak icin bir icki icelim!

english: Uh... I'll take that as a no.
translation: Uh... Bunu hayir olarak kabul ediyorum.

english: Hey! Itsh you again! Whatshyerfashe!
translation: Hey! Yine sen! Ne isin var burada?

english: [player name]?
Nah nah nah, not them, the other one, whatshyerfashe!
translation: Hayir hayir hayir, onlar degil, digeri, ne isin var burada?

english: [Fremennik name]?
Thatsh what I said diddle I?
translation: Ben de öyle dedim, degil mi?

english: Um.... okay. I'll leave you to your drinking.
translation: Um... tamam. Ickini icmeye devam et.

english: Thanksh pal! You're alright!
Obey the law!
Stay out of trouble!
Out of the way, human!
I'm keeping an eye on you!
The guard ignores you.
You! Human! Hands off!
Obey the law!
Stay out of trouble!
Out of the way, human!
I'm keeping an eye on you!
The guard ignores you.
I am the Black Knight Titan! You must pass through me before you can continue in this realm!
translation: Ben Kara Sövalye Titan! Bu alemde ilerlemek icin önce beni gecmelisin!

english: Okay, have at ye oh evil knight!
Puny mortal... You cannot defeat me...
Maybe you need something more to beat the titan?
translation: Titan'i yenmek icin daha fazlasina ihtiyacin olabilir mi?

english: For Camelot!
Well done! You have defeated the Black Knight Titan!
Actually I think I'll run away!
Okay, have at ye oh evil knight!
Actually I think I'll run away!
Squeak!
Nilsal. Interested in buying some weapons or armour?
translation: Nilsal. Silah veya zirh satin almak ister misin?

english: Yes please.
Do you make these yourself?
Of course, and you won't find anything finer than what I offer. I didn't become the official blacksmith to the Royal Family of Varlamore by producing subpar goods.
translation: Tabii ki, ve benim sundugumdan daha iyisini bulamazsin. Varlamore Kraliyet Ailesi'nin resmi demircisi, kalitesiz ürünler üreterek olmadim.

english: You're the official blacksmith? Does that mean you can sell me some armour like the knights around here wear?
translation: Resmi demirci misin? Bu, buradaki sövalyelerin giydigi gibi zirh satabilecegin anlamina mi geliyor?

english: Are you a Knight of Varlamore?
No.
Than I cannot. However, I still have plenty of other items that might interest you. Would you like to take a look?
translation: O zaman satamam. Ancak, ilginizi cekebilecek baska bircok ürünüm var. Bir göz atmak ister misiniz?

english: Can you repair something for me?
You don't have anything I can repair.
I'll need [x] coins to repair that.
There you go, happy doing business with you!
translation: Buyurun, sizinle is yapmak bir zevkti!

english: No thanks.
As you wish. You are always welcome to return if you change your mind.
translation: Nasil istersen. Fikrini degistirirsen her zaman geri gelebilirsin.

english: Yes please.
Do you make these yourself?
Can you repair something for me?
Repair that item: [x] coins.
Cancel.
No thanks.
A human? Either buy something or get out!
translation: Bir insan mi? Ya bir sey al ya da defol!

english: What do you have?
In a blacksmith? What do you think? Weapons!
translation: Bir demircide mi? Ne saniyorsun? Silahlar!

english: I'll get going.
Good.
What do you have?
I'll get going.
Greetin's[player name], fine day today!
translation: Merhaba Maceraci, bugün güzel bir gün!

english: Please leave me alone, I'm busy trapping the pygmy shrews.
translation: Lütfen beni rahat birak, pigme fareleri yakalamakla mesgulüm.

english: Wunnerfulweather we're having today!
My stock is only for those trusted in Shayzien, sorry.
translation: Stokum sadece Shayzien'de güvenilir kisiler icin, üzgünüm.

english: Looking to buy some armour?
Show me what you've got.
I'm good thanks.
Show me what you've got.
I'm good thanks.
Hello, I wonder if you could help me on this whole brewing thing...
translation: Merhaba, bira yapimi konusunda bana yardimci olabilir misin acaba...

english: I might be able to - what do you need to know?
How do I brew ales?
Well first off you need to fill the vat with water - two bucketfuls should do the trick. Then you'll need to put in two handfuls of barley malt - that's roasted barley by the way.
translation: Öncelikle ficiyi suyla doldurmalisin - iki kova su yeterli olacaktir. Sonra iki avuc arpa malti eklemelisin - bu arada arpa malti kavrulmus arpadir.

english: After that you'll be putting your main ingredient in - this will decide which ale it is you're brewing. There should be some good guides around with recipes in.
translation: Ardindan ana malzemeyi ekleyeceksin - bu, hangi aleyi mayaladigini belirleyecektir. Tariflerin bulundugu iyi kilavuzlar bulabilirsin.

english: Lastly you pour a pot full of ale yeast in, which'll start it off fermenting. Then all you have to do is wait for the good stuff.
translation: Son olarak, bir tencere dolusu ale mayasi ekleyin, bu mayalama islemini baslatacaktir. Sonra tek yapmaniz gereken, iyi sonuclari beklemek.

english: How do I brew cider?
First you'll need some apples. You'll need to crush them using this cider-press - four apples should make a full bucket of apple-mush. Take four buckets of mush and fill up the vat.
translation: Öncelikle elmalara ihtiyaciniz olacak. Bu elma sarabi presi ile elmalari ezmeniz gerekecek - dört elma bir kova dolusu elma püresi yapacaktir. Dört kova püreyi alin ve ficiya doldurun.

english: After that you pour a pot full of ale yeast in, which'll start it off fermenting. Then all you have to do is wait for the good stuff.
translation: Ardindan, bir tencere dolusu bira mayasi dökün, bu da fermantasyonu baslatacaktir. Sonra tek yapmaniz gereken iyi seyin olmasini beklemek.

english: What do I do once my ale has matured?
Well, once you've got a full vat of the good stuff, just turn the valve and your barrel will fill up with eight pints of whatever your chosen tipple is. Mind it's an empty barrel, though.
translation: Peki, bir fici dolusu iyi sey elde ettiginizde, vanayi cevirin ve ficiniz sectiginiz icecekle sekiz pint dolacak. Ancak ficinin bos oldugunu unutmayin.

english: Do you have any spare ale yeast?

Well, as a matter of fact I do, although I wouldn't describe it as spare. This ale yeast I've got is the best money can buy, but if you've got a pot I'll fill it for you for 25GP - very cheap as it happens.
translation: Aslinda var, ama yedek olarak tanimlamazdim. Elimdeki bu bira mayasi parayla satin alinabilecek en iyisidir, ama bir tencereniz varsa 25 GP karsiliginda doldururum - cok ucuzdur.

english: I don't have an empty pot, or enough money I'm afraid.
translation: Maalesef bos bir tencerem yok ve yeterli param da yok.

english: I don't have an empty pot I'm afraid.
I don't have enough money I'm afraid.
That's a good deal - please fill my pot with ale yeast for 25GP.
translation: Bu iyi bir fiyat - lütfen tenceremi 25 GP karsiliginda bira mayasiyla doldurun.

english: No, that's too much I'm afraid.
That's all I need to know, thanks.
translation: Bilmem gereken her seyi ögrendim, tesekkürler.

english: How do I brew ales?
How do I brew cider?
What do I do once my ale has matured?
Do you have any spare ale yeast?
That's a good deal - please fill my pot with ale yeast for 25GP.
translation: Bu iyi bir fiyat - lütfen 25GP karsiliginda tenceremi bira mayasiyla doldurun.

english: No, that's too much I'm afraid.
That's all I need to know, thanks.
translation: Bilmem gereken her seyi ögrendim, tesekkürler.

english: Good day.
Good day to you [sir/ma'am].
Hello!
Ho there! Who are you?
Only the most famous sculptor in all of Keldagrim.
Does Keldagrim have a lot of sculptors then?
Well... I'm the best outside of Keldagrim too, I tell you! Especially here in the north.
translation: Sey... Keldagrim disinda da en iyisi benim, inan bana! Özellikle kuzeyde.

english: Yeah, maybe you should visit the mountain people topside of this mountain some time... all they have is a big lump of stone!
translation: Evet, belki bir ara bu dagin tepesindeki dag halkini ziyaret etmelisin... Onlarin tek sahip oldugu sey büyük bir tas yigini!

english: Ah, the philistines!
But I'd rather not go up there, they don't like dwarves much.
translation: Ama oraya cikmak istemem, cüceleri pek sevmezler.

english: Oh yes, good point.
Sure, sure, of course.
Excuse me, are you Blasidar, the famous sculptor?
translation: Affedersiniz, siz ünlü heykeltiras Blasidar misiniz?

english: Why, yes, yes, that I am!
Oh, well, I'm [player name]. Veldaban of the Black Guard sent me to you, you see. Said you might need some help with the statue.
translation: Oh, ben Maceraci'im. Kara Muhafizlar'dan Veldaban beni sana gönderdi. Heykel icin yardima ihtiyacin olabilecegini söyledi.

english: Oh, I don't need an assistant sculptor, really, I can do just fine on my own.
translation: Oh, asistan heykeltirasa ihtiyacim yok, gercekten, kendi basima gayet iyi yapabilirim.

english: I'm not a sculptor.
And I've also got a model here, you see, to base my statue on.
translation: Ayrica heykelim icin modelim de var.

english: I'm not a model!
But come to think of it, I do need some errands run. Yes, quite important errands too.
translation: Ama düsününce, bazi islerin halledilmesi gerekiyor. Evet, oldukca önemli isler.

english: Yes, you will do just fine.
Ehm, right, okay.
So what did you need doing?
Well, see... the Consortium has commisionedme to rebuild the statue exactly the way it was.
translation: Sey, bak... Konsorsiyum benden heykeli tam olarak eski haline getirmemi istedi.

english: But the statue itself has broken into a million pieces... and we dwarves aren't very good painters, you know, so we don't have any paintings of it either.
translation: Ama heykel milyonlarca parcaya ayrilmis... ve biz cüceler pek iyi ressamlar degiliz, bu yüzden heykelin resimleri de yok.

english: Not a very artistic race, then, are you?
translation: O zaman pek sanatsal bir irk degilsiniz, degil mi?

english: No, that's not what I said, I said we're not very good painters.
translation: Hayir, öyle demedim, iyi ressamlar olmadigimizi söyledim.

english: We're excellent with, for example, stone. Oh yes, quite good if I say so myself.
translation: Örnegin tas isciliginde cok iyiyiz. Evet, kendim söyleyeyim, oldukca iyiyiz.

english: But I digress... simply speaking, I need some help with getting some items that I can base the new statue on.
translation: Ama konudan saptim... kisacasi, yeni heykeli yapabilmem icin bazi esyalara ihtiyacim var.

english: Will you be able to help me with this, [player name]?
translation: Bana bu konuda yardim eder misin, Maceraci?

english: No, I can't be bothered.
How rude is that? I don't think the Black Guard will be very pleased with you!
translation: Ne kadar kaba bir davranis! Kara Muhafizlar senden pek memnun olmayacaklar!

english: Yes, I will do this.
Excellent, excellent! Now what I need is the following...
translation: Harika, harika! Simdi ihtiyacim olan seyler sunlar...

english: I will need a pair of boots, the most exquisite boots you can find. The more they look like the original the better, but I don't think you'll be able to find an exact match.
translation: Bir cift bot lazim, bulabilecegin en güzel botlar. Orijinaline ne kadar cok benziyorlarsa o kadar iyi, ama tam olarak aynisini bulabilecegini sanmiyorum.

english: For the torso, I need clothes that look like King Alvis' clothes. I'm not sure where you would be able to find that, but I'm sure you'll manage.
translation: Gövde icin Kral Alvis'in kiyafetlerine benzeyen kiyafetler lazim. Bunlari nereden bulabilecegini bilmiyorum, ama eminim bir yolunu bulursun.

english: Also, I need a battleaxe. Now this is particularly important. You are in luck, however, as I believe King Alvis' original axe still survives.
translation: Ayrica bir savas baltasi da lazim. Bu özellikle önemli. Sanslisin, cünkü Kral Alvis'in orijinal baltasi hala duruyor.

english: Right, so I need a pair of boots, a piece of clothing and a battleaxe. Is that all?
translation: Tamam, bir cift bot, bir giysi ve bir savas baltasi lazim. Hepsi bu mu?

english: For now, [player name], for now! I wish you good luck, and hurry back with the items!
translation: Simdilik, Maceraci, simdilik! Iyi sanslar, esyalari bir an önce getir!

english: But... wait, wait, how am I supposed to find all this?
translation: Ama... bekle, bekle, bunlari nasil bulacagim?

english: I don't know! You're supposed to find that out for me!
translation: Bilmiyorum! Bunu benim icin bulman gerekiyor!

english: But it's a beautiful city, Keldagrim is, I'm sure you'll see many things while you do these tasks!
translation: Ama Keldagrim cok güzel bir sehir, bu görevleri yaparken bircok sey göreceginden eminim!

english: How are you getting along with those items, [player name]?
translation: Esyalari bulma konusunda nasil gidiyorsun, Maceraci?

english: I don't have your boots yet.
What else?
I also don't have your clothes yet, I'm afraid.
And? The battleaxe?
Sorry, no, I'm still looking for it.
Look a little harder please!
The new statue looks beautiful, don't you agree?
translation: Yeni heykel cok güzel olmus, sence de öyle degil mi?

english: Oh yes, quite.
My finest piece of work, without a doubt.
Say, I was wondering, did you do the statues down in the mines as well?
translation: Söylesene, merak ediyordum da, madenlerdeki heykelleri de sen mi yaptin?

english: What, out with the trolls?
If only! But no, they've been there for many thousands of years, actually. Been there before dwarven recorded history.
translation: Keske öyle olsaydi! Ama hayir, aslinda onlar binlerce yildir oradalar. Cücelerin kayitli tarihinden önce oradaydilar.

english: No no, I'm sure they weren't there before!
translation: Hayir hayir, eminim daha önce orada degillerdi!

english: Of course they were, don't be silly!
Alright... my mistake then.
No, I can't be bothered.
Yes, I will do this.
You! Get to work!
What?
You are here to help work the blast furnace, aren't you?
translation: Buraya yüksek firini calistirmaya yardim etmeye geldin, degil mi?

english: What's the blast furnace?

The blast furnace is the pinnacle of dwarven metal- processing! Ore goes in the top and comes out as metal bars almost at once! And it's so efficient it only takes half as much coal to purify it as a regular furnace.
translation: Yüksek firin, cücelerin metal isleme sanatinin zirvesidir! Cevher üstten girer ve neredeyse aninda metal cubuklar olarak cikar! Ve o kadar verimlidir ki, normal bir firina göre sadece yarisi kadar kömürle saflastirilir.

english: But we've got a bit of a labour shortage at the moment, which is why I have to rely on immigrant workers to keep the furnace going. So, are you here to start work?
translation: Ama su anda biraz isci sikintisi cekiyoruz, bu yüzden firini calisir durumda tutmak icin göcmen iscilere güvenmek zorundayim. Peki, calismaya baslamak icin mi buradasin?

english: How can I help work the blast furnace?
translation: Yüksek firinin calismasina nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: The blast furnace will only work if there is a group of people keeping it going. Let me explain...
translation: Yüksek firin, onu calisir durumda tutan bir grup insan varsa calisir. Aciklayayim...

english: Firstly, the stove needs to be kept filled with coal. If this runs out the furnace will not work.
translation: Ilk olarak, firinin kömürle dolu tutulmasi gerekir. Kömür biterse firin calismaz.

english: Secondly, someone needs to operate the pump that keeps the hot air blast circulating through the furnace.
translation: Ikinci olarak, firinda sicak hava akimini saglayan pompayi calistiracak biri gerekir.

english: Thirdly, someone needs to keep an eye on the temperature gauge. They should tell the pumper to start or stop so that the temperature stays in the right range.
translation: Ücüncü olarak, sicaklik göstergesini takip edecek biri gerekir. Sicakligin dogru aralikta kalmasi icin pompaciya calistirma veya durdurma talimati vermelidir.

english: Lastly, someone needs to be on the pedals to power the conveyor belt that puts ore into the furnace.
translation: Son olarak, firina cevheri koyan konveyör bandini calistirmak icin birinin pedallara basmasi gerekir.

english: Someone will also need to be on standby with a hammer in case the machine breaks!
translation: Makine bozulursa diye birinin de cekicle hazirda beklemesi gerekir!

english: While that's going, anyone else can put their ore on the conveyor belt to have it smelted.
translation: Bu islemler devam ederken, diger herkes konveyör bandina cevherini koyarak eritilmesini saglayabilir.

english: So what do I get out of it?
Keeping the furnace going is valuable experience in itself!
translation: Firini calisir durumda tutmak basli basina degerli bir deneyimdir!

english: Keeping the stove alight will train your Firemaking, working the pump will train your Strength, pedalling the conveyor belt will train your Agility and repairing the furnace will train Crafting.
translation: Ocagi yakmak Ates Yapma becerini, pompayi calistirmak Güc becerini, konveyör bandini pedal cevirmek Ceviklik becerini ve firini onarmak Zanaat becerini gelistirir.

english: Plus, everyone working the furnace will get a bit of experience in Smithing whenever anyone smelts ore in it.
translation: Ayrica, firinda calisan herkes, firinda cevher eritildiginde Bicakcilik becerisinde biraz deneyim kazanir.

english: So I don't actually get paid then?
I offer you the privilege of working on the greatest example of dwarven engineering and you want to be PAID?
translation: Sana cüce mühendisliginin en büyük örneginde calisma ayricaligi sunuyorum ve sen PARA mi istiyorsun?

english: If you co-operate with a group of people you can all get your smelting done pretty quickly. Or perhaps some humans who need to do some smelting will pay you, since you humans are all so obsessed with money.
translation: Bir grup insanla isbirligi yaparsan, eritme isini oldukca hizli bir sekilde halledebilirsiniz. Ya da belki eritme isi yapmasi gereken bazi insanlar sana para öder, cünkü siz insanlar paraya takintilisiniz.

english: No wonder you have a labour shortage if you don't pay your workers!
translation: Iscilerine ödeme yapmiyorsan isci sikintisi cekmen normal!

english: What would be the point of making money if I gave it all away to menial workers?
translation: Parayi basit iscilere verirsem para kazanmanin ne anlami kalir ki?

english: I mean... Money isn't important! What about the greater glory of dwarven engineering? What about the satisfaction of helping others? What about the XP?
translation: Yani... Para önemli degil! Cüce mühendisliginin büyük ihtisami ne olacak? Baskalarina yardim etmenin verdigi tatmin ne olacak? XP ne olacak?

english: Okay, I'll get to work.
Splendid!
Can I use the furnace to smelt ore?
translation: Firini cevher eritmek icin kullanabilir miyim?

english: You can, although you'll need to find some people to work it for you as well. But the furnace is very delicate so I charge a fee for anyone who doesn't have level 60 smithing.
translation: Kullanabilirsin, ama senin icin calisacak birkac kisi bulman gerekecek. Firin cok hassas oldugu icin, 60. seviye demircilik becerisi olmayanlardan ücret aliyorum.

english: I have level 60!
A human has level 60 smithing? How extraordinary!
translation: Bir insanin 60. seviye demircilik becerisi mi var? Ne olaganüstü!

english: Feel free to use the furnace. Remember, you only need half as much coal as with a regular furnace.
translation: Firini kullanabilirsin. Unutma, normal bir firina göre sadece yarisi kadar kömür kullanman gerekiyor.

english: I don't have level 60.
Hmm, well, I'll let you use the furnace if you want, but you must pay a fee of 2,500 coins.
translation: Hmm, istersen firini kullanabilirsin, ama 2.500 altin ücret ödemen gerekiyor.

english: Okay, here you are.
Where?
Actually I don't have enough money on me.
Well go get it then.
Okay, you can use the furnace for ten minutes. Remember, you only need half as much coal as with a regular furnace.
translation: Tamam, firini on dakika kullanabilirsin. Unutma, normal bir firina göre sadece yarisi kadar kömür kullanman yeterli.

english: How about I give you 1250 coins and I work extra hard?
translation: Sana 1250 altin verip ekstra calissam nasil olur?

english: You'll have to work hard enough for two humans if I agree...
translation: Kabul edersem iki insan kadar calisman gerekecek...

english: Oh, three humans, easily!
Well, okay then - 1250GP it is.
translation: Peki, tamam o zaman - 1250 altin olsun.

english: Well why did you try and haggle with me then? You'd better go and get some - you're not using the blast furnace for free.
translation: O zaman neden benimle pazarlik etmeye calistin? Gidip biraz para bulsan iyi olur, yüksek firini bedavaya kullanamazsin.

english: Okay, you can use the furnace for ten minutes. Remember, you only need half as much coal as with a regular furnace. And I want to see you doing the work of four humans!
translation: Tamam, firini on dakika kullanabilirsin. Unutma, normal bir firina göre sadece yarisi kadar kömür kullanman yeterli. Ve dört insanin yapacagi isi yapmani istiyorum!

english: Maybe some other time.
Well if you're not here to work, go hang around somewhere else!
translation: Eger calismak icin burada degilsen, baska bir yerde takil!

english: I need to borrow your blast furnace.
You can have it a couple of hours for 170,000 coins.
What?
I'm trying to create an ingot of chromium, and I need your blast furnace to do so.
translation: Krom külce yapmak istiyorum ve bunun icin firinina ihtiyacim var.

english: You have knowledge of how to make chromium?!
Well, I'm pretty sure it involves a blast furnace...
translation: Sanirim bunun icin yüksek firin gerekiyor...

english: I'm not going to close my shop for someone who is 'pretty sure'. Come back when you have a better idea.
translation: “Eminim” diyen biri icin dükkanimi kapatmayacagim. Daha iyi bir fikrin oldugunda geri gel.

english: You need level 85 smithing to make a Chromium ingot.
translation: Krom külce yapmak icin 85. seviye demircilik gerekiyor.

english: I had to get sloshed to figure it out, but yes.
translation: Anlamak icin sarhos olmam gerekti, ama evet.

english: That makes perfect sense. Okay then, you can have the furnace, but it's going to cost you.
translation: Bu cok mantikli. Tamam o zaman, firini alabilirsin, ama bunun bir bedeli olacak.

english: Yes.
Good enough for me. You can have the furnace but it's going to cost you.
translation: Benim icin yeterli. Firini alabilirsin ama bunun bir bedeli olacak.

english: Okay, I'll need a couple of hours for each chromium ingot. How much is that going to cost me?
translation: Tamam, her krom külcesi icin birkac saate ihtiyacim olacak. Bu bana ne kadara mal olacak?

english: Let's see. Cost of labour... Opportunity cost... Carry the four...
translation: Bir bakalim. Iscilik maliyeti... Firsat maliyeti... Dörtü tasi...

english: I don't have that much money on me.
Come back when you do.
translation: O kadar paran oldugunda geri gel.

english: I have the money right here.
I'll go get everything ready for you.
You pump air into the furnace, regulating the speed as you spot the silvery sheen.
translation: Firina hava pompalayip, gümüs rengi parlaklik göründügünde hizi ayarlayin.

english: That's a bit too pricey for me.
Come back if you change your mind.
Okay.
You are an experienced smith, you may use the furnace free of charge!
translation: Siz deneyimli bir demircisiniz, firini ücretsiz kullanabilirsiniz!

english: Remember, you only need half as much coal as with a regular furnace.
translation: Unutmayin, normal bir firina göre sadece yarisi kadar kömür gerekir.

english: What is this? The fee to use the furnace is 2,500 coins.
translation: Bu ne? Firini kullanma ücreti 2.500 sikke.

english: I don't have enough money on me.
Well go and get it then.
Somebody refuel the stove!
Somebody fix that pipe!
Somebody work the conveyer belt!
Somebody fix the conveyer belt!
Somebody operate the pump!
Keep the temperature controlled.
That's it, keep it going!
Work faster!
You fools, you let it overheat!
translation: Sizi aptallar, asiri isinmasina izin verdiniz!

english: What's the blast furnace?
How can I help work the blast furnace?
translation: Yüksek firini calistirmaya nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: Can I use the furnace to smelt ore?
translation: Firini cevher eritmek icin kullanabilir miyim?

english: Maybe some other time.
So what do I get out of it?
So I don't actually get paid then?
Okay, I'll get to work.
No wonder you have a labour shortage if you don't pay your workers!
translation: Iscilerine para ödemiyorsan isci sikintisi cekmen normal!

english: Okay I'll get to work.
I have level 60!
I don't have level 60.
Okay.
[Charm] How about I give you 1250 coins and I work extra hard?
translation: [Büyü] Sana 1250 sikke verip ekstra siki calissam nasil olur?

english: I need to borrow your blast furnace.
Yes.
No.
Yes
No
You manage to inflate a bloated toad with the swamp gas.
translation: Bataklik gaziyla sismis bir kurbagayi sisirmeyi basardin.

english: You blow the bloated toad up into a balloon toad.
Sqwark!
!!Croak!!
Gobble!
How come I can talk to you without an amulet?
translation: Nasil oluyor da muska olmadan seninle konusabiliyorum?

english: *Woof woof bark!* Elementary, it's due to the influence of the -SQUIRREL-!
translation: *Woof woof bark!* Cok basit, bunun nedeni -SQUIRREL-'in etkisi!

english: Walkies!
Can you help me with this clue?
translation: Bu ipucunda bana yardim eder misin?

english: *Woof! Bark yip woof!* Sure! Eliminate the impossible first.
translation: *Hav! Hav hav hav!* Tabii! Önce imkansizi eleyin.

english: And then?
*Bark! Woof bark bark.* Whatever is left, however improbable, must be the answer.
translation: *Hav! Hav hav hav.* Geriye kalan, ne kadar imkansiz olursa olsun, cevap olmali.

english: So helpful.
I wonder if I could sell you to a vampyre to track down dinner.
translation: Seni bir vampire satip aksam yemegini bulmasini saglayabilir miyim acaba?

english: *Woof bark bark woof* I have teeth too you know, that joke was not funny.
translation: *Hav hav hav hav* Benim de dislerim var, bu saka komik degildi.

english: Hey boy, what's up?
*Woof! Bark bark woof!* You smell funny.
Err... funny strange or funny ha ha?
*Bark bark woof!* You aren't funny.
Interesting!
I will eliminate the impossible.
Elementary!
Hey, monkey!
Eeek! Eeek! Ook!
I have no idea what you just said, but good luck with it anyway!
translation: Ne dedigini hic anlamadim, ama yine de iyi sanslar!

english: Hey monkey, your mother was an inedible seaweed sandwich!
translation: Hey maymun, annen yenilmez bir yosun sandviciydi!

english: Oh man, oh, you did not just say that!
The second I get up that tree I am going to pelt you with bitternuts until you are neck deep in them!
translation: O agaca ciktigim anda, boynuna kadar batana kadar sana aci findik atacagim!

english: Oh noes, my worst nightmare come true...
translation: Oh hayir, en kötü kabusum gercek oldu...

english: I'm sorry for insulting you. Is there anything I can do to make it up to you?
translation: Seni asagiladigim icin özür dilerim. Telafi etmek icin yapabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Hmmmm...well, you seem sincere, how about you hurry up and use me on the tree and we'll call it even.
translation: Hmmmm... sey, samimi görünüyorsun, acele edip beni agacta kullanirsan ödesmis oluruz.

english: Yeah, ok, sounds fair.
Hey monkey, take your time getting the nut ok?
translation: Hey maymun, cevizleri alirken acele etme, tamam mi?

english: Sure. If I see any monkeys around the top of the tree I'll be careful and try and get you the nut whatever happens.
translation: Tabii. Agacin tepesinde maymunlar görürsem dikkatli olacagim ve ne olursa olsun sana cevizleri getirecegim.

english: Great!
What? Can I come out of this bag now?
translation: Ne? Artik bu cantadan cikabilir miyim?

english: That depends, do you think you can reach those bitternuts for me?
translation: Duruma bagli, o bitternutlari benim icin alabilir misin?

english: Sigh...yes. Just take me to the tree and I'll grab one for you.
translation: Of... evet. Beni agaca götür, ben de senin icin bir tane alayim.

english: Look, never mind about taking your time, I'm sure things will be ok.
translation: Bak, acele etmene gerek yok, her sey yoluna girecek.

english: Well if you are sure. Ok, I'll get up there and pass you the nut then.
translation: Eger emin isen. Tamam, o zaman agaca cikip sana cevizi uzatirim.

english: Cheers, I'll be nearby to catch it.
Taunt Monkey
Calm Monkey
Caution Monkey
Reassure Monkey
Hello.
Well hello there traveller. If you're looking for a cocktail the barman will happily make you one.
translation: Merhaba gezgin. Kokteyl ariyorsaniz, barmen size memnuniyetle hazirlar.

english: Or if you're looking for some training in cocktail making, then I'm your gnome! Aluft Gianne jnr. is looking for gnome cooks, barmen and barwomen to help in his new venture, so it's a useful skill to have. I'm
translation: Ya da kokteyl yapimi konusunda egitim almak istiyorsan, ben senin cücenim! Aluft Gianne jnr. yeni girisiminde yardimci olacak cüce ascilar, barmenler ve barmenler ariyor, bu yüzden bu beceriye sahip olmak faydali olacaktir.

english: sure the human girls will like it as well.
translation: Insan kizlarin da hosuna gideceginden eminim.

english: No thanks, I prefer to stay this side of the bar.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, barin bu tarafinda kalmayi tercih ederim.

english: Ok then I'll give it a go.
Excellent. It's not an easy job, I'll have to try you out first. I'm sure you'll be great though.
translation: Harika. Kolay bir is degil, önce seni denemem gerekecek. Ama eminim harika olacaksin.

english: Here, take this cocktail guide. The book tells you how to make all the cocktails we serve. I'll tell you what I need and you can make them.
translation: Al, bu kokteyl rehberini al. Kitapta servis ettigimiz tüm kokteyllerin nasil yapildigi yaziyor. Sana neye ihtiyacim oldugunu söyleyecegim, sen de yaparsin.

english: Sounds easy enough.
Take a look at the book then come and talk to me.
translation: Kitaba bir göz at, sonra gel benimle konus.

english: Hello Blurberry.
Hi, are you ready to make your first cocktail?
translation: Merhaba, ilk kokteylini yapmaya hazir misin?

english: Absolutely.
Ok then, to start with make a Fruit Blast. Here, you'll need these ingredients, but I'm afraid I can't give you any more if you mess up.
translation: Tamam o zaman, baslangic olarak Fruit Blast yap. Iste, bu malzemelere ihtiyacin olacak, ama isleri batirirsan sana daha fazlasini veremem.

english: Blurberry gives you two lemons, one orange, one pineapple, a cocktail shaker, a glass and a knife.
translation: Blurberry sana iki limon, bir portakal, bir ananas, bir kokteyl calkalayici, bir bardak ve bir bicak verir.

english: So where's my Fruit Blast?
I think I've got one.
No, I need you to make the Fruit Blast yourself. I'm afraid it doesn't really work if you try to sell the bar its own drinks.
translation: Hayir, Fruit Blast'i kendin hazirlaman gerekiyor. Barin kendi ickilerini satmaya calisirsan, maalesef bu pek ise yaramaz.

english: I can see how that would make it hard to mix cocktails. I'll give you another one, but please try not lose any more.
translation: Bu durumda kokteyl hazirlamanin zor olacagini anliyorum. Sana bir tane daha verecegim, ama lütfen bir daha kaybetme.

english: I've not finished yet.
Ok, well let me know when you're done.
I don't know what you have there but it's no Fruit Blast!
translation: Orada ne var bilmiyorum ama Fruit Blast degil!

english: Here you go.
You give Blurberry the Fruit Blast. He takes a sip...
translation: Blurberry'ye Fruit Blast'i ver. Bir yudum alir...

english: Hmmm... not bad, not bad at all.
translation: Hmmm... fena degil, hic fena degil.

english: Now can you make me a Pineapple Punch? I can give you what you need, but again I won't be able to give you any more if you make a mistake.
translation: Simdi bana Pineapple Punch yapabilir misin? Sana ihtiyacin olani verebilirim, ama yine de hata yaparsan sana daha fazla veremeyecegim.

english: Blurberry gives you three pineapples, a pair of oranges, a lemon and a lime.
translation: Blurberry sana üc ananas, bir cift portakal, bir limon ve bir misket limonu verir.

english: Let me know when it's done.
How are you faring with the Pineapple Punch?
No, I need you to make the Pineapple Punch yourself. I'm afraid it doesn't really work if you try to sell the bar its own drinks.
translation: Hayir, Pineapple Punch'i kendin yapman gerekiyor. Barin kendi ickilerini satmaya calisirsan pek ise yaramayacagindan korkuyorum.

english: You give Blurberry the Pineapple Punch. He takes a sip...
translation: Blurberry'ye Pineapple Punch'i ver. Bir yudum alir...

english: Not bad, not bad at all.... I can certainly sell drinks of that quality.
translation: Fena degil, hic fena degil... Bu kalitede icecekleri kesinlikle satabilirim.

english: Okay then let's try something with some real booze in it! Make me a Wizard Blizzard.
translation: Tamam, o zaman gercek alkol iceren bir sey deneyelim! Bana bir Wizard Blizzard yap.

english: Blurberry gives you some vodka, gin, a lemon, a pineapple, a pair of limes and an orange.
translation: Blurberry sana biraz votka, cin, bir limon, bir ananas, bir cift limon ve bir portakal verir.

english: Hello, how did it go with the Wizard Blizzard.
No, I need you to make the Wizard Blizzard yourself. I'm afraid it doesn't really work if you try to sell the bar its own drinks.
translation: Hayir, Wizard Blizzard'i kendin yapman gerekiyor. Korkarim ki, bara kendi ickilerini satmaya calisirsan pek ise yaramaz.

english: I haven't managed to make it yet.
Ok, it's one Wizard Blizzard I need.  Let me know when it's done.
translation: Tamam, bir Wizard Blizzard istiyorum. Hazir oldugunda haber ver.

english: Here, try some.
You give Blurberry the Wizard Blizzard. He takes a sip...
translation: Blurberry'ye Wizard Blizzard'i ver. Bir yudum alir...

english: Well that is both Wizardy and Blizzardy. You're quite a bartender.
translation: Bu hem Wizardy hem de Blizzardy. Sen iyi bir barmenmissin.

english: Okay, let's test you once more. Make me a SGG, then we'll see if you have what it takes.
translation: Tamam, seni bir kez daha test edelim. Bana bir SGG yap, sonra yetenegin olup olmadigini görecegiz.

english: A what?
A Short Green Guy, and don't bring me a gnome. Here's all you need.
translation: Short Green Guy, bana cüce getirme. Ihtiyacin olan her sey burada.

english: Ok, I'll try my best.
I'm sure you'll make a great barman.
Hi Blurberry.
So, have you got my Short Green Guy?
No, I need you to make the SGG yourself. I'm afraid it doesn't really work if you try to sell the bar its own drinks.
translation: Hayir, SGG'yi kendin yapman gerekiyor. Barin kendi ickilerini satmaya calisirsan, korkarim ki bu pek ise yaramaz.

english: You give Blurberry the SGG. He takes a sip...
translation: Blurberry'ye SGG'yi ver. O bir yudum alir...

english: Ooh, that's a frisky little number. Very tart, how it should be. Excellent. Well I'm happy to recommend you to the Giannes. You truly are a gnomish bartender now..
translation: Ooh, bu neseli bir icki. Cok eksi, olmasi gerektigi gibi. Mükemmel. Giannes'e seni tavsiye etmekten mutluluk duyarim. Artik gercekten bir cüce barmen oldun.

english: Well your training is over [player name]. Are you interested in some work?
translation: Egitimin bitti Maceraci. Calismak ister misin?

english: I may be...

I think you're almost ready to do some work for Aluft Gianne Jnr. He is in charge of a new family venture: Gnome Food Delivery. There are good tips to be made if you make and deliver gnome foods - though you may
translation: Aluft Gianne Jnr. icin calismaya neredeyse hazirsin bence. O, yeni bir aile girisiminin basinda: Gnome Food Delivery. Gnome yemekleri yapip teslim edersen iyi bahsisler kazanabilirsin, ancak

english: have to travel all over Gielinor to fulfil some of the other orders...
translation: diger siparisleri yerine getirmek icin Gielinor'un her yerini dolasman gerekebilir...

english: However, you'll need some basic gnome cooking training if you want to work for Lufty. Go and have a chat with his Dad, Aluft Gianne Snr. Hel'll tell you what you need to do.
translation: Ancak, Lufty icin calismak istiyorsan temel gnome yemek pisirme egitimi alman gerekecek. Gidip babasi Aluft Gianne Snr. ile konus. Sana ne yapman gerektigini söyleyecektir.

english: Thanks for your help!

Aluft Gianne Snr. tells me that you have finished training with him, so I think you're ready to do some work for Aluft Gianne Jnr. He is in charge of the new Gnome Food Delivery service. I've heard there are
translation: Aluft Gianne Snr. bana onunla egitiminizi tamamladiginizi söyledi, bu yüzden Aluft Gianne Jnr. icin calismaya hazir oldugunuzu düsünüyorum. O, yeni Gnome Food Delivery hizmetinden sorumlu. Gnome yemekleri yapip teslim ederseniz

english: good tips to be made if you make and deliver gnome foods - though you may have to travel all over Gielinor to fulfill some of the other orders...
translation: iyi bahsisler kazanabileceginizi duydum - ancak diger siparisleri yerine getirmek icin Gielinor'un her yerini dolasmaniz gerekebilir...

english: Sounds interesting....
Go and have a chat with my young Lufty Jnr. and he'll fill you in with details.
translation: Git ve genc Lufty Jnr. ile konus, sana ayrintilari anlatacaktir.

english: No thanks, I prefer to stay this side of the bar.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, barin bu tarafinda kalmayi tercih ederim.

english: Ok then I'll give it a go.
I'm afraid I lost the cocktail shaker you gave to me.
I've not finished yet.
Why do you keep killing boars?
Because they drop bones which I am going to use to train my prayer. The meat is also a nice addition.
translation: Cünkü dua egitimim icin kullanacagim kemikler birakiyorlar. Etleri de güzel bir ek.

english: Wouldn't it be best to go steal cakes for food?
translation: Yiyecek olarak kek calmak daha iyi olmaz mi?

english: And then go to Wintertodt? I do that every time I make an Iron person account. About time I try something new.
translation: Sonra da Wintertodt'a gitmek? Demir insan hesabi her actigimda bunu yapiyorum. Artik yeni bir sey denemenin zamani geldi.

english: Are you at least killing the boars on task?
translation: En azindan görev icin domuzlari öldürüyor musun?

english: No, maybe I should go get a slayer task now you mention it. Thanks for the reminder.
translation: Hayir, simdi sen söyleyince belki de bir katil görevi almaliyim. Hatirlattigin icin tesekkürler.

english: You can only trade with people in your group.
Give me a quest!
Get yer own!
Have you anything to sell?
Yes! I buy and sell axes! Take your pick (or axe)!
translation: Evet! Balta alip satiyorum! Secini yap (veya baltani)!

english: Can you repair my items for me?
Of course I'll repair it, though the materials may cost you. Just hand me the item and I'll have a look.
translation: Tabii ki tamir ederim, ama malzemeler sana pahaliya mal olabilir. Esyayi bana ver, bir bakayim.

english: You don't have anything I can repair.
There you go, happy doing business with you!
translation: Al bakalim, seninle is yapmak cok keyifli!

english: Sorry friend, but I can't do anything with that.
translation: Üzgünüm dostum, ama bununla bir sey yapamam.

english: Give me a quest!
Have you anything to sell?
Can you repair my items for me?
Repair that item: [x] coins.
Cancel.
Miaoww
Erm, hello? Can you understand me?
I certainly can, I am wearing this amulet I got in Sophanem!
translation: Elbette anliyorum, Sophanem'de aldigim bu tilsimi takiyorum!

english: Ah so you've met one of the local felines, wise and confusing , those Sphinges.
translation: Demek yerel kedilerden biriyle tanismissin, bilge ve kafa karistirici Sfenksler.

english: Wow!!! You know the plural of Sphinx!!! What else do you know?
translation: Vay canina!!! Sfenkslerin cogulunu biliyorsun!!! Baska ne biliyorsun?

english: All sorts of stuff! I pick up no end of comments on my travels, want to hear one?
translation: Her türlü seyi! Seyahatlerimde sayisiz yorum topluyorum, birini duymak ister misin?

english: I certainly do. Share your wisdom, Bob!
translation: Tabii ki isterim. Bilgeligini paylas, Bob!

english: Hi, my name is Bob.
Hello Bob!
Do you two know each other?
I don't think so...
Yes you do. Dive deep, search your feelings.
translation: Evet, tanisiyorsunuz. Derinlere dal, duygularini ara.

english: OK, I will try.
What's up puss?
If only you knew the power of Bob. Your master never told you who your real father was, did he?
translation: Keske Bob'un gücünü bilseydin. Efendin sana gercek babanin kim oldugunu hic söylemedi, degil mi?

english: No, but what's that got to do with... no, nooooooo! It cannot be!!
translation: Hayir, ama bunun ne alakasi var... hayir, hayirrrrr! Olamaz!!

english: Yes. I am your father!
That's impossible!!
You can destroy Zamorak. He has foreseen this. It is your destiny. Join me, and together we can rule this place as father and son.
translation: Zamorak'i yok edebilirsin. O bunu önceden görmüstü. Bu senin kaderin. Bana katil, birlikte burayi baba ve ogul olarak yönetebiliriz.

english: OK dad, maybe later, you're scaring me!
translation: Tamam baba, belki sonra, beni korkutuyorsun!

english: I think that's about enough of that. I'm off.
translation: Sanirim bu kadar yeter. Ben gidiyorum.

english: [player name], why do you keep your cat in the bank?
I thought it was too dangerous to bring it out with me.
translation: Onu disari cikarmak cok tehlikeli olur diye düsündüm.

english: Or, I could let the poor thing get butchered! Is that what you want?
translation: Ya da zavalli hayvanin katledilmesine izin verebilirdim! Istedigin bu mu?

english: Butchered!!! I think not. Cats are easily as tough as sheep. Cats were the second thing Guthix brought here, after sheep of course.
translation: Katledilmesi!!! Sanmiyorum. Kediler koyunlar kadar dayaniklidir. Kediler, Guthix'in buraya getirdigi ikinci seydi, tabii ki koyunlardan sonra.

english: Weird. I thought Gnomes and the Dwarves were the first ones. Oh well back to school for me.
translation: Garip. Ilk gelenlerin cüceler ve cüceler oldugunu saniyordum. Neyse, ben okula dönmeliyim.

english: Do you like all the monsters around here?
No, not really. I'm actually signed up with all those HAM fanatics. Kill the whole lot of 'em!!
translation: Hayir, pek sayilmaz. Aslinda tüm o HAM fanatiklerine katildim. Hepsini öldürün!!

english: That's a bit cruel isn't it?
Yeah, that's one of my best qualities. Just behind sneaky and vicious. Besides, after a few doses of catnip, they all look like mice to me!
translation: Evet, bu benim en iyi özelliklerimden biri. Sinsi ve acimasiz olmanin hemen ardindan. Ayrica, birkac doz kedi nanesi aldiktan sonra, hepsi bana fare gibi görünüyor!

english: Hey Bob. Got any wisdom to share?
translation: Selam Bob. Paylasacak bir bilgelik var mi?

english: If a player falls down in a forest and nobody is there, do they make any noise?
translation: Bir oyuncu ormanda düserse ve etrafta kimse yoksa, ses cikar mi?

english: Sorry, I am far too busy marking my territory.
Your territory? This place is ruled by the Grand Highmage Gower and his minions.
translation: Senin bölgen mi? Burasi Büyük Büyücü Gower ve onun usaklari tarafindan yönetiliyor.

english: I think not. They are my minions, and I let him think that he's in charge. I'm the real power behind the throne.
translation: Sanmiyorum. Onlar benim usaklarim ve ben onun sorumlu oldugunu düsünmesine izin veriyorum. Tahtin arkasindaki gercek güc benim.

english: I knew it!!
Yeah, it keeps them happy that way, but don't tell anyone!
translation: Evet, bu sekilde mutlu oluyorlar, ama kimseye söyleme!

english: Hee hee. OK Bob.
Dogs believe they are human. Cats believe they are Guthix!
translation: Köpekler kendilerini insan sanirlar. Kediler kendilerini Guthix sanirlar!

english: What do you believe, Bob?
Well, I don't believe much really since I know I am Zar... erm, well, no, I erm, meow?
translation: Sey, ben pek inanmiyorum cünkü ben Zar oldugumu biliyorum... sey, hayir, ben... miyav?
