english: Don't get distracted so easily! See, I'm distracting you right now!
translation: Bu kadar kolay dikkatin dagilmasin! Bak, su anda dikkatini dagitiyorum!

english: Sorry, I'm far too busy calculating thermal vectors.
translation: Üzgünüm, termal vektörleri hesaplamakla cok mesgulüm.

english: Eh?
Oh, sorry... I meant, erm, meow?
translation: Oh, üzgünüm... demek istedigim, sey, miyav?

english: Nothing interesting happens.
Eh? That's hardly useful.
Ahh, but it is you see. It does all sorts of wonderous things.
translation: Ahh, ama öyle. Her türlü harika sey yapiyor.

english: Like what?
Well, it's more to do with what happens when you hear that being said. You see, something interesting happens somewhere else.
translation: Sey, daha cok bunu duydugunda olanlarla ilgili. Bak, baska bir yerde ilginc bir sey oluyor.

english: So what you're saying is that if nothing interesting happens to me, then something interesting is happening for someone else somewhere that IS interesting?
translation: Yani diyorsun ki, bana ilginc bir sey olmazsa, baska bir yerde baska biri icin ilginc bir sey oluyor mu?

english: Yes, that's about it.
OK... I see.... I think.
Cats are rather delicate creatures and they are subject to a good many ailments, but I never heard of one who suffered from insomnia.
translation: Kediler oldukca hassas yaratiklardir ve pek cok rahatsizliga maruz kalirlar, ama uykusuzluk ceken bir kedi duymadim hic.

english: So, you want to know how us cats keep so clean all day?
translation: Demek kedilerin gün boyu nasil bu kadar temiz kaldigini merak ediyorsun?

english: Must be all that washing you do.
You would think so wouldn't you. But is being covered in spit really clean?
translation: Öyle düsünürsün tabii. Ama tükürükle kapli olmak gercekten temizlik mi?

english: Eeeww. Gross.
Anything not nailed down is a cat toy.
If at first you don't succeed, take a short nap.
translation: Ilk denemede basarili olamazsan, kisa bir sekerleme yap.

english: Yeah, I could tell you something really useful, but then I would have to '1-hit you' to death.
translation: Evet, sana gercekten yararli bir sey söyleyebilirim, ama o zaman seni tek vurusta öldürmem gerekir.

english: Bob, you couldn't 1-hit a noob.
translation: Bob, bir acemiyi tek vurusta öldüremezsin.

english: Care to place a wager on that? Sorry, hang on, I've got no pockets. Maybe next time.
translation: Buna bahse girer misin? Üzgünüm, bekle, cebim yok. Belki bir dahaki sefere.

english: I'll be waiting.
Dogs have owners, cats have staff.
translation: Köpeklerin sahipleri vardir, kedilerin ise personeli.

english: I have studied many philosophers and many cats. The wisdom of cats is infinitely superior.
translation: Bircok filozofu ve kediyi inceledim. Kedilerin bilgeligi sonsuz derecede üstündür.

english: There are many intelligent species in the universe. They are all owned by cats.
translation: Evrende bircok zeki tür vardir. Hepsi kedilerin sahibidir.

english: Cats and teleporting just don't mix well. That's why I walk everywhere. Messes my hair up terribly.
translation: Kediler ve isinlanma pek uyumlu degildir. Bu yüzden her yere yürüyerek giderim. Sacimi cok dagitir.

english: Cats are smarter than dogs. You can't get eight cats to pull a sled through snow.
translation: Kediler köpeklerden daha zekidir. Sekiz kediyi kar üzerinde kizak cekmeye ikna edemezsin.

english: Sorry, no time for chat. Still got mouse bones stuck in my teeth. How awkward.
translation: Üzgünüm, sohbet edecek vaktim yok. Dislerimde hala fare kemikleri var. Ne garip.

english: You know, cats are the first species to fully evolve. We're perfect.
translation: Biliyorsun, kediler tamamen evrimlesen ilk türlerdir. Biz mükemmeliz.

english: Preserve nature. Pickle a dog!
Do you like dogs?
Yes!
Me too. Care to swap recipes? I have a rather unique hotdog sauce.
translation: Ben de. Tariflerimizi paylasmak ister misin? Oldukca essiz bir sosisli sosum var.

english: Bob, you're a bit messed up really aren't you.
translation: Bob, sen gercekten biraz kafayi yemissin, degil mi?

english: No, I just know what I like. Besides, it was a joke.
translation: Hayir, sadece neyi sevdigimi biliyorum. Ayrica, sakaydi.

english: A joke? I doubt the dogs are laughing.
What dogs? I have already rid this place of dogs. Have you ever seen one?
translation: Hangi köpekler? Burayi köpeklerden coktan temizledim. Hic köpek gördün mü?

english: Yes actually. I heard there are a few wild dogs about here somewhere.
translation: Aslinda evet. Buralarda birkac vahsi köpek oldugunu duydum.

english: Right!! Fellow cats, prepare for war!!
Mmm. Maybe another time.
Cat Rule number 1: Always act afraid when near dogs, especially if you're near a human. They will pick you up and fuss you, then shout at the dog. Most amusing!
translation: Kedi Kurali 1: Köpeklerin yaninda, özellikle de bir insanin yaninda oldugunda her zaman korkmus gibi davran. Seni kucagina alip oksayacaklar, sonra da köpege bagiracaklar. Cok eglenceli!

english: Cat Rule number 2: When assisting a human at work, make sure you sit behind its right leg. You stand a much better chance of getting picked up and stroked. Also, it's very amusing
translation: Kedi Kurali 2: Bir insana isinde yardim ederken, sag bacaginin arkasina oturdugundan emin ol. Böylece kucagina alinma ve oksanma sansin cok daha yüksek olur. Ayrica, cok eglencelidir.

english: Cat Rule number 3: If you ever make a mistake, which is rare and probably involves a dog, make sure you wash yourself immediately. This will give everyone the impression that
translation: Kedi Kurali 3: Nadiren de olsa bir hata yaparsaniz, ki bu muhtemelen bir köpekle ilgilidir, hemen kendinizi yikayin. Bu, herkese bunun

english: it was done on purpose.
Cat Rule number 4: Beware the bag monster. These things live in small bags and under newspapers, sometimes even hidden in shoes if they are very clever. They will be very small and
translation: Kedi Kurali 4: Canta canavarlarina dikkat edin. Bu seyler kücük cantalarda ve gazetelerin altinda yasar, bazen cok zeki iseler ayakkabilarin icine bile saklanirlar. Cok kücüktürler ve

english: take on the same colour as the hiding place. Attack these things on sight - stop at nothing. If you see a bag or shoe you have not inspected recently, pounce!!
translation: saklandiklari yerin rengini alirlar. Bu seyleri gördügünüz anda saldirin - hicbir sey sizi durdurmasin. Son zamanlarda kontrol etmediginiz bir canta veya ayakkabi görürseniz, atlayin!

english: Please excuse me, I'm rather busy.
Hey, I'm your contractor from Mahogany Homes, what did you want done?
translation: Merhaba, ben Mahogany Homes'tan müteahhitinizim, ne yapilmasini istiyorsunuz?

english: I'd like a Wooden table built.
I'd like my clock fixed.
I'd like two Wooden cabinets built.
I'd like two Wooden bookcases built.
I'd like a Wooden wardrobe built.
I'd like a Wooden drawer built.
I'd like a Oak table built.
I'd like two Oak cabinets built.
I'd like two Oak bookcases built.
I'd like a Oak wardrobe built.
I'd like a Oak drawer built.
I'd like a Teak table built.
I'd like two Teak cabinets built.
translation: Iki adet tik dolap yaptirmak istiyorum.

english: I'd like two Teak bookcases built.
translation: Iki adet tik kitaplik yaptirmak istiyorum.

english: I'd like a Teak wardrobe built.
translation: Bir adet tik gardirop yaptirmak istiyorum.

english: I'd like a Teak drawer built.
translation: Bir adet tik cekmece yaptirmak istiyorum.

english: I'd like a Mahogany table built.
translation: Bir adet maun masa yaptirmak istiyorum.

english: I'd like two Mahogany cabinets built.
translation: Iki adet maun dolap yaptirmak istiyorum.

english: I'd like two Mahogany bookcases built.
translation: Iki adet maun kitaplik yaptirmak istiyorum.

english: I'd like a Mahogany wardrobe built.
translation: Bir adet maun gardirop yaptirmak istiyorum.

english: I'd like a Mahogany drawer built.
I've finished with the work you wanted.
Thank you so much! Would you like a cup of tea before you go?
translation: Cok tesekkür ederim! Gitmeden önce bir fincan cay ister misiniz?

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
Aaah, nothing like a nice cupppa tea!
translation: Ah, güzel bir fincan cay gibisi yok!

english: No thanks, I better be off.
Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks.
Apparently you aren't as stupid as you look.
translation: Görünüse göre göründügün kadar aptal degilsin.

english: Hello, chum, fancy buyin' some designer jewellry? They've come all the way from Ardougne! Most pukka!
translation: Merhaba dostum, tasarimci mücevherleri satin almak ister misin? Ardougne'dan buraya kadar geldiler! En kaliteliler!

english: Erm, no. I'm all set, thanks.
Okay, chum, would you like to show you the very latest potion prices?
translation: Tamam dostum, sana en son iksir fiyatlarini göstereyim mi?

english: Who are you?
Why, I'm Bob! Your friendly seller of smashin' goods!
translation: Ben Bob! Senin dost canlisi, harika ürünler satan saticin!

english: So what do you have to sell?
Oh, not much at the moment. Cuz, ya know, business being so well and cushie.
translation: Su anda pek bir sey yok. Cünkü isler cok iyi gidiyor ve rahatim.

english: You don't really look like you're being so successful.
You plonka! It's all a show, innit! If I let people knows I'm in good business they'll want a share of the moolah!
translation: Seni aptal! Hepsi numara, degil mi! Islerimin iyi gittigini insanlar ögrenirse, paradan pay almak isteyecekler!

english: You conveniently have a response for everything.
translation: Her seye uygun bir cevabin var.

english: That's the Ardougne way, my son.
Can you show me the prices for potions?
Lets see what you have...
You're a bit short of inventory space.
You're a bit short of empty vessels or cash. Empty vials cost 5 coins each, cups 8 coins each, and anything else is 5 coins each.
translation: Bos kaplarin veya nakit paranin biraz eksik. Bos siseler 5 coin, bardaklar 8 coin ve diger her sey 5 coin.

english: There, I've done what I can, but you're a bit short of empty vessels or cash. Empty vials cost 5 coins each, cups 8 coins each, and anything else is 5 coins each.
translation: Iste, elimden geleni yaptim ama bos kaplarin veya nakit paranin biraz eksik. Bos siseler 5 coin, bardaklar 8 coin ve diger her sey 5 coin.

english: There, all done.
Two plus two is four, minus one that's three...
translation: Iki arti iki dört eder, eksi bir üc eder...

english: I don't think you've got anything that I can decant.
translation: Sanirim benim icin süzebilecegim bir seyin yok.

english: Please, please, please work.
I'm in the money!
I could have sworn that would have worked.
Now what should I buy?
Hope this item sells well.
Who are you?
Can you show me the prices for potions?
I'll leave you to it.
Hello, how are you doing?
I'm good thank you, how can I help you today?
translation: Iyiyim, tesekkürler, bugün nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: What is this place?
This is our agility course, we use it to stay nimble and to keep our wits sharp. My name is Bobawu and I look after the course.
translation: Burasi ceviklik parkurumuz, cevikligimizi ve zekamizi keskin tutmak icin kullaniyoruz. Benim adim Bobawu ve parkuru ben yönetiyorum.

english: As a friend and fellow monkey, you're free to use it anytime, but you'll need to be as nimble as a ninja first!
translation: Bir arkadas ve maymun olarak, istedigin zaman kullanabilirsin, ama önce bir ninja kadar cevik olmalisin!

english: Oh great, thank you.
Are there any rewards you can offer me?
translation: Bana verebileceginiz herhangi bir ödül var mi?

english: Could you tell me how many laps I've completed?
I can't offer you anything for now, so I don't see much reason to count your laps either.
translation: Su anda sana verebilecegim bir sey yok, bu yüzden turlarini saymanin da bir anlami yok.

english: You need to complete Monkey Madness 2 for Bobawu to offer rewards and to count your lap total
translation: Bobawu'nun sana ödül vermesi ve tur sayini saymasi icin Monkey Madness 2'yi tamamlaman gerekiyor.

english: Looks like you haven't completed any laps, but I'll be sure to keep track of them, when you do.
translation: Görünüse göre henüz tur tamamlamamissin, ama tamamladiginda sayacagimdan emin olabilirsin.

english: Sure thing my friend, so far you've completed 1 lap, don't stop now!
translation: Tabii ki dostum, su ana kadar 1 tur tamamladin, simdi durma!

english: Sure thing my friend, so far you've completed [number] laps, don't stop now!
What can you offer me?
I see you have your own monkey friend, by completing laps here you can transform him into different monkeys!
translation: Görüyorum ki kendi maymun arkadasin var, burada tur tamamlayarak onu farkli maymunlara dönüstürebilirsin!

english: That's neat, what can he turn into?
I've got the list here!
Bobawu pulls out a tattered piece of paper from his ninja costume.
translation: Bobawu ninja kostümünden yirtik pirtik bir kagit parcasi cikarir.

english: Ahem, here we are, At 100 you'll unlock a Karamjan Monkey transformation.
translation: Ahem, iste burada, 100 turda Karamjan Maymun dönüsümünü acacaksin.

english: After completing 250 laps, you'll unlock a scary zombie monkey.
translation: 250 tur tamamladiginda, korkunc bir zombi maymun acarsin.

english: With 500 laps finished, you'll get a maniacal monkey.
translation: 500 tur tamamladiginda, cilgin bir maymun alirsin.

english: At 1000 laps, you'll be able transform him into a spooky skeleton monkey,
translation: 1000 turda, onu ürkütücü bir iskelet maymuna dönüstürebilirsin,

english: 1500 laps for a little Kruk Jr monkey,
translation: 1500 turda kücük bir Kruk Jr maymunu,

english: Finally at 2000 laps, he can transform to look like our King Awowogei.
translation: Son olarak 2000 turda, Kral Awowogei'ye benzeyen bir maymuna dönüsebilir.

english: On second thought, never mind.
translation: Bir daha düsündüm de, bos ver.

english: That's okay my friend, come back anytime.
translation: Sorun degil dostum, istedigin zaman tekrar gel.

english: Hey there, how do you do my fellow monkey?
So far you've completed 1 lap, don't stop now!
translation: Simdiye kadar 1 tur tamamladin, simdi durma!

english: So far you've completed [number] laps, don't stop now!
What is this place?
How many laps have I done?
What can you offer me?
Never mind.
Hello there friend! I'm Bobby the gnome child.
translation: Merhaba dostum! Ben cüce cocuk Bobby.

english: Are you heading into The Nutcracker?
Oh yes. Me and Pa have been looking forward to this all year. Isn't that right Pa?
translation: Evet. Babam ve ben bütün yil bunu bekledik. Degil mi baba?

english: Yes Bobby. There's no doubt we will be sipping mulled pine inside The Nutcracker in no time.
translation: Evet Bobby. Hic süphe yok ki, cok gecmeden Findikkiran'da sicak cam sarabi iciyor olacagiz.

english: Mulled pine? Sounds very... Organic.
translation: Sicak cam sarabi mi? Kulaga cok... Organik geliyor.

english: It's delightful.
Wishing you happy holidays [player name].
You too Bobby.
Woah, you're very big for a Gnome.
translation: Vay canina, bir cüce icin cok büyüksün.

english: And you're very rude for a human.
translation: Sen de bir insan icin cok kaba.

english: Don't listen to them Bobby. You're just a little different.
translation: Onlari dinleme Bobby. Sen sadece biraz farklisin.

english: Nice to meet you [player name]. Does somebody need a hug?
translation: Tanistigimiza memnun oldum Maceraci. Birine sarilmak isteyen var mi?

english: Bobby stumbles and steps on his dad's foot while trying to hug you.
translation: Bobby sana sarilmaya calisirken tökezler ve babasinin ayagina basar.

english: Son of a nutcracker!
Sorry Pa!
I'll walk it off.
Heading into The Nutcracker?
You're a gnome?
Hello there.
Hello stranger, new to these parts?
translation: Merhaba yabanci, buraya yeni mi geldin?

english: I'm Bolkoy by the way. I'm the village shopkeeper. Would you like to buy something?
translation: Bu arada ben Bolkoy. Köyün dükkancisiyim. Bir sey almak ister misin?

english: What have you got?
Take a look.
No thank you.
Ok, maybe later.
Hello.
Amazing, you recovered the orb.
Well I am impressed. Would you like to buy something?
translation: Gercekten etkilendim. Bir sey satin almak ister misin?

english: Hi.
Oh, hello there. Have you heard? They took the other orbs, it's terrible. I suppose the show must go on.
translation: Merhaba. Duydun mu? Diger küreleri de calmislar, bu cok kötü. Sanirim gösteri devam etmeli.

english: Would you like to buy something?
translation: Bir sey satin almak ister misin?

english: Hello there. You're that hero who saved the orbs. Soon we will perform the ritual and the village will be safe again.
translation: Merhaba. Sen küreleri kurtaran kahramansin. Yakinda ritüeli gerceklestirecegiz ve köy tekrar güvende olacak.

english: Anyway, would you like anything from my shop?
translation: Neyse, dükkânimdan bir sey almak ister misin?

english: Welcome, welcome. It's good to see you again. The village is much safer now you have returned the orbs.
translation: Hos geldin, hos geldin. Seni tekrar görmek güzel. Küreleri geri getirdigin icin köy artik cok daha güvenli.

english: By the way, I'm the village shop keeper. Would you like to buy something?
translation: Bu arada, ben köyün dükkâncisiyim. Bir sey almak ister misin?

english: Hello! I take it you're here about the trail?
Yes, do you have a challenge for me?
translation: Evet, bana bir görev var mi?

english: Yes, right here!
Please enter the answer to the question.
What's the matter with you? Can't you count? Try harder!
translation: Senin neyin var? Sayamiyor musun? Daha cok cabala!

english: Lucky for you, that's the right answer!
What have you got?
No thank you.
Yeah?
What is this place?
Granddad's fruit farm. It's a right dump. This whole corner of the city is a dump.
translation: Büyükbabamin meyve ciftligi. Tam bir cöplük. Sehrin bu kösesi tamamen cöplük.

english: So why are you here if it's a dump?
My cow of a sister kicked me out of her bar. Said I was getting the place a bad name. So I'm staying here until I'm old enough to get my own place.
translation: Kiz kardesimin barindan kovuldum. Barin adini kötüye cikardigimi söyledi. Kendi evimi alabilecek yasa gelene kadar burada kalacagim.

english: I want to move to Arceuus. It's properly awesome up there. I'll do bartending or something until I can learn to be a necromancer.
translation: Arceuus'a tasinmak istiyorum. Orasi gercekten harika bir yer. Necromancer olmayi ögrenene kadar barmenlik falan yaparim.

english: Anyway, why are you here? Do you want something?
translation: Neyse, sen neden buradasin? Bir sey mi istiyorsun?

english: Never mind.
Okay, thanks for the info.
Yeah, you're in the biggest dumpster of Dumpsterville. Now you know. Anyway, do you want something?
translation: Evet, Dumpsterville'in en büyük cöplügündesin. Artik biliyorsun. Neyse, bir sey mi istiyorsun?

english: Tell me about yourself.
Yeah, alright...
I am Bologa Gricoller, seeker of forbidden wisdom, wanderer of the dark pathways, thinker of the unthinkable. I can do bartending too.
translation: Ben Bologa Gricoller, yasak bilginin arayicisi, karanlik yollarin gezgini, düsünülemez olanin düsünürü. Barmenlik de yapabilirim.

english: I used to work at The Golden Field. That's my sister's bar. It's mostly farmhands drinking there, but you get some interesting people as well.
translation: Eskiden The Golden Field'da calisiyordum. Orasi kiz kardesimin bari. Orada cogunlukla ciftciler icki icer, ama ilginc insanlar da olur.

english: See, most Hosidius people are Saradominists. My sister, she's always listening to Father Jean at the church with his goodie-goodie sermons.
translation: Görüyorsun, Hosidius halkinin cogu Saradoministtir. Kiz kardesim, kilisede Peder Jean'in iyi niyetli vaazlarini dinler durur.

english: But some of us in the bar thought we'd give Zamorak a try. Like, you gotta be open-minded, right? What did Saradomin ever do for us anyway?
translation: Ama bardaki bazilarimiz Zamorak'i denemeye karar verdik. Acik fikirli olmak lazim, degil mi? Saradomin bizim icin ne yapti ki?

english: So we'd meet in the bar, sharing books that the Piscarilius smugglers would bring us, learning what the Saradominists don't want us to know.
translation: Barda bulusup, Piscarilius kacakcilarinin bize getirdigi kitaplari paylasiyor, Saradoministlerin bilmemizi istemedigi seyleri ögreniyorduk.

english: Anyway, my sister - she's a right cow, by the way - she fired me and kicked me out. Said I was bringing bad sorts to her bar.
translation: Neyse, kardesim - bu arada o tam bir cadaloz - beni kovdu ve disari atti. Barina kötü tipler getirdigimi söyledi.

english: Bad sorts, she said! Like, morality is totally subjective, right? So who's she to call us bad sorts just 'cos we're not afraid to think differently?
translation: Kötü tipler, dedi! Ahlak tamamen özneldir, degil mi? Farkli düsünmekten korkmadigimiz icin bizi kötü tipler olarak nitelendirmek ona ne hak verir?

english: Anyway, I've learnt all this cool stuff about Zamorak, and being stuck in a fruit farm doesn't stop me being his loyal servant, right?
translation: Her neyse, Zamorak hakkinda tüm bu harika seyleri ögrendim ve bir meyve ciftliginde sikisip kalmak onun sadik hizmetkari olmama engel olamaz, degil mi?

english: In fact I've invented a Zamorakian blessing that works on fruit! You can use it to make Zamorak's wine out of grapes from the Vinery.
translation: Hatta meyveler üzerinde ise yarayan bir Zamorakian kutsamasi icat ettim! Bunu kullanarak Vinery'deki üzümlerden Zamorak sarabi yapabilirsin.

english: Can you help me to make Zamorak's wine?
translation: Zamorak sarabi yapmama yardim eder misin?

english: I'll let you have access to the Zamorakian blessing I invented, so you can invoke Zamorak's unholy power upon the grapes... if I think you're up to it.
translation: Eger buna layik oldugunu düsünürsem, icat ettigim Zamorak'in kutsamasini kullanmana izin verecegim, böylece üzümler üzerinde Zamorak'in kutsal olmayan gücünü kullanabilirsin.

english: I'll want 75,000 coins too.
And do you think I'm up to it?
Nah, I bet you couldn't even bless an unholy symbol - you're not going to get very far with my grape blessing.
translation: Hayir, kutsal olmayan bir sembolü bile kutsayamazsin - benim üzüm kutsamamla pek bir yere varamazsin.

english: You need a Prayer level of 50 to use Bologa's blessing.
translation: Bologa'nin kutsamasini kullanmak icin 50 dua seviyesi gerekir.

english: Not likely - I can see from your kit that you're supporting other gods. Dress Zamorakian if you want to impress me. And I'll still want 75,000 coins.
translation: Olmaz - esyalarindan diger tanrilari destekledigini görebiliyorum. Beni etkilemek istiyorsan Zamorak tarzinda giyin. Ve yine de 75.000 sikke istiyorum.

english: You don't look much like a Zamorakian to me. Dress Zamorakian if you want my help. And I'll still want 75,000 coins.
translation: Bana Zamorakci gibi görünmüyorsun. Yardimimi istiyorsan Zamorakci gibi giyin. Ve yine de 75.000 sikke istiyorum.

english: Yeah, I guess you'll do. But I want 75,000 coins. One day I'll need to buy my own house, y'know!
translation: Evet, sanirim yaparsin. Ama 75.000 sikke istiyorum. Bir gün kendi evimi almam gerekecek, biliyorsun!

english: Maybe another time.
Here's how it works... I'll write the blessing on scrolls. You need to carry some of the scrolls when you're harvesting grapes.
translation: Isler söyle yürüyecek... Ben kutsamayi parsömenlere yazacagim. Üzüm toplarken bu parsömenlerden bazilarini yaninda tasiman gerekecek.

english: As each fruit is severed from its stem, it begins to die. That's the moment of vulnerability when Zamorak's unholy power can infest it.
translation: Her meyve sapindan koparildiginda ölmeye baslar. Bu, Zamorak'in kutsal olmayan gücünün onu ele gecirebilecegi savunmasiz bir andir.

english: The power consumes the scroll on which the blessing is written, so you'll need one for each grape. I suggest you take a stack of blessings with you.
translation: Bu güc, kutsamanin yazildigi parsömeni tüketir, bu yüzden her üzüm icin bir tane gerekir. Yanina bir yigin kutsama almani öneririm.

english: By the way, Lord Zamorak's chaotic power is quite volatile. You'll likely get a smaller harvest from your vine if you're using these blessings.
translation: Bu arada, Lord Zamorak'in kaotik gücü oldukca degiskendir. Bu kutsamalari kullanirsan, bagindan daha az hasat alacaksin.

english: I'll give the scrolls to Granddad downstairs. You can get them off him as a reward if you work on his farm. Hey, it's a dump, but he's family. So, do you accept?
translation: Parsömenleri asagidaki büyükbabama verecegim. Onun ciftliginde calisirsan, ödül olarak ondan alabilirsin. Hey, burasi bir cöplük ama o aileden biri. Kabul ediyor musun?

english: You pay Bologa 75,000 coins. You can now claim her blessings from Farmer Gricoller as a reward for working on his farm.
translation: Bologa'ya 75.000 sikke ödersin. Artik ciftci Gricoller'den, onun ciftliginde calistigin icin ödül olarak kutsamalarini alabilirsin.

english: Actually, no thanks.
Meh.
I'll leave you to it.
Hello again.
You said you can make Zamorak's wine from grapes.
Yeah, I've invented a blessing that invokes Zamorak's unholy power upon the grapes, so Zamorak's wine can be made from them.
translation: Evet, üzümlere Zamorak'in kutsal olmayan gücünü cagiran bir kutsama icat ettim, böylece onlardan Zamorak'in sarabi yapilabilir.

english: But I won't let you use it unless I think you're up to it. Also, I want 75,000 coins.
translation: Ama buna layik oldugunu düsünmedikce kullanmana izin vermeyecegim. Ayrica 75.000 sikke istiyorum.

english: Tell me about yourself again.
It's really nice of you to take an interest...
Hello again, [player name].
How do those blessings work again?
My blessing is written on scrolls. You need to carry some of the scrolls when you're harvesting grapes.
translation: Kutsamam parsömenlere yazilmistir. Üzümleri toplarken bu parsömenlerden bazilarini yaninda tasiman gerekir.

english: I've given the scrolls to Granddad downstairs. You can get them off him as a reward for working on his farm. The place may be a dump, but he's family.
translation: Parsömenleri asagidaki büyükbabama verdim. Onun ciftliginde calismanin karsiligi olarak ondan alabilirsin. Burasi bir cöplük olabilir, ama o aileden biri.

english: Thanks.
Tell me the story about yourself again.
translation: Bana kendinle ilgili hikayeni tekrar anlat.

english: Yeah, okay. It's nice of you to ask...
So that's how I came to invent that Zamorakian blessing for making Zamorak's wine out of grapes from the Vinery.
translation: Iste böylece, Vinery'deki üzümlerden Zamorak sarabi yapmak icin Zamorakian kutsamasini icat ettim.

english: What is this place?
So why are you here if it's a dump?
Tell me about yourself.
Never mind.
Okay, thanks for the info.
Can you help me to make Zamorak's wine?
translation: Zamorak sarabi yapmama yardim eder misin?

english: Pay 75,000 coins to access Bologa's blessings.
translation: Bologa'nin kutsamalarina erismek icin 75.000 sikke öde.

english: Decline.
I'll leave you to it.
You said you can make Zamorak's wine from grapes.
Tell me about yourself again.
How do those blessings work again?
Tell me the story about yourself again.
Hi there.
A'up, mate, how's it gowin'?
Not bad, thank you.
What are you building here?
Nowt at moment. We're on strike!
You're on strike? Whatever for?
Those strange alchemists are up ta somefin', best go ta one ov 'em.
translation: O tuhaf kimyagerler bir seyler ceviriyorlar, en iyisi birine git.

english: Oh, okay.
You still hangin' around the tower?
Yeah, we need another job. But til then, we figured we may as well wait ta see what else would turns up.
translation: Evet, baska bir ise ihtiyacimiz var. Ama o zamana kadar, baska ne cikacagini beklesek iyi olur diye düsündük.

english: Fair enough.
Who's a cute little kitty?
Jimmy doesn't like me talking to strangers.
Miaow!
It looks like you're trying to escape. Would you like some help?
translation: Kacmaya calisiyor gibi görünüyorsun. Yardim ister misin?

english: I ... uh ... yes.
Right you are.
No thank you. Who are you by the way?
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler. Bu arada, sen kimsin?

english: Never mind that child. You should worry more about who you are and the nature of the forces that have driven you here.
translation: Cocugu bos ver. Kim oldugun ve seni buraya getiren güclerin dogasi hakkinda daha cok endiselenmelisin.

english: I'll ... keep that in mind, thanks.
We WILL meet again, [player name].
Ok...
Yes
No
Roll up, roll up!
Enter the great Hemenster fishing competition!
Only 5gp entrance fee!
I'll enter the competition please.
Marvelous!
You pay Bonzo 5 coins.
Ok, we've got all the fishermen. It's time to roll!
Ok, nearly everyone is in their place already. You fish in the spot by the willow tree, and the Sinister Stranger, you fish by the pipes.
translation: Tamam, neredeyse herkes yerini aldi. Sen sögüt agacinin yanindaki yerde balik tutacaksin, Sinister Stranger, sen de borularin yaninda balik tutacaksin.

english: No thanks; I'll just watch the fun.
translation: Hayir tesekkürler, ben sadece eglenceyi izleyecegim.

english: Okay folks, time's up! Let's see who caught the biggest fish.
translation: Tamam millet, süre doldu! Bakalim en büyük baligi kim yakaladi.

english: You hand over your catch.
And the winner is... The stranger in black!
Hello champ!
So any hints on how to fish?
translation: Balik tutmanin püf noktalari var mi?

english: I think I'll keep them to myself.
I'll enter the competition please.
No thanks, I'll just watch the fun.
translation: Hayir tesekkürler, ben sadece eglenceyi izleyecegim.

english: Hello tall person.
Hello short person.
Why are you called Boot?
I'm called Boot, because when I was very young, I used to sleep, in a large boot.
translation: Boot deniyorum cünkü cok kücükken büyük bir cizmede uyurdum.

english: Yeah, great, I didn't want your life story.
translation: Evet, harika, hayat hikayeni dinlemek istememistim.

english: Hello short person.
Why are you called boot?
Can I come through this gate?
You must pay a toll of 10 gold coins to pass.
translation: Gecmek icin 10 altin para ödemen gerekiyor.

english: No, thank you. I'll walk around.
Ok suit yourself.
Who does my money go to?
The money goes to the city of Al-Kharid.
Yes, ok.
You pay the guard.
Oh dear, I don't actually seem to have enough money.
translation: Oh hayir, galiba yeterince param yok.

english: You may pass for free, you are a friend of Al-Kharid.
translation: Al-Kharid'in dostu oldugun icin ücretsiz gecebilirsin.

english: Can we come through this gate?
You may pass for free, for you are a friend of Al-Kharid, but your goblin friend must stay on this side.
translation: Al-Kharid'in dostu oldugun icin ücretsiz gecebilirsin, ama goblin arkadasin bu tarafta kalmak zorunda.

english: Why?
Why do you think this gate is here, if not to keep the goblins out of Al Kharid?
translation: Goblinleri Al Kharid'den uzak tutmak icin degilse, bu kapi neden burada sence?

english: But Zanik isn't like the other goblins!
translation: Ama Zanik diger goblinler gibi degil!

english: Nevermind, player name. I don't think we need to go to Al Kharid anyway!
translation: Bos ver, Maceraci. Zaten Al Kharid'e gitmemize gerek yok!

english: You cannot pass as you haven't unlocked access to both theMisthalinandKharidian Desertareas in this League.
translation: Bu Lig'de hem Misthalin hem de Kharidian Cölü bölgelerine erisim acmadigin icin gecemezsin.

english: No thank you, I'll walk around.
Who does my money go to?
Yes, ok.
If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: Senin kadar cirkin olsaydim, yüzümü halka göstermeye cesaret edemezdim!

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: Oh! Sey... Az önce bir tane yedim de ondan!

english: Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: Hayatina deger veriyorsan bir daha benimle konusma!

english: Get lost!
I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: Sana verecek hicbir seyim yok, birak beni rahat, dilenci.

english: Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
translation: Su anda bununla ugrasacak vaktim yok.

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: Senin gibi zavalli bir et yiginiyla konusmak istemiyorum.

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: Cok kötü bir gün... tadini cikar.

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: Eger birini yakalarsan, paylasacagina söz ver.

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
You smell familiar...
Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: Buralarda insan gördün mü? Cok acim.

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: Bana kan tadi seven biri gibi görünüyorsun.

english: Good day to you, my friend.
Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: Bir dakika izin ver, dislerime bir sey sikismis...

english: I cannot speak to you outerlander! Talk to Brundt, the Chieftain!
translation: Seninle konusamam yabanci! Sef Brundt ile konus!

english: You stay away from me outerlander!
They are too suspicious of you for you to get close enough to steal from them.
translation: Sana karsi cok süpheci davraniyorlar, onlara yaklasip hirsizlik yapamazsin.

english: Hello, are you a member of the council?
I am afraid not outerlander. Goodbye.
translation: Korkarim ki degilim yabanci. Hosca kal.

english: Hello.
Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: Merhaba kardesim Dokrak. Bugün benden ne istiyorsun? Her zaman yardimima güvenebilirsin!

english: Nothing thanks. I just fancied a chat.
translation: Hicbir sey, tesekkürler. Sadece sohbet etmek istedim.

english: My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
translation: Yardimima ihtiyacin olursa kapim her zaman acik Dokrak.

english: [Fremennik name]... It has been too long since last we met!
translation: Dokrak... Son görüsmemizden bu yana cok zaman gecti!

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: Hos geldin kardesim Dokrak. Seni burada görmek her zaman bir zevk!

english: My apologies [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: Özür dilerim kardesim Dokrak! Burada seninle vakit gecirecek vaktim yok!

english: That's okay, I didn't really want anything.
translation: Önemli degil, aslinda bir sey istememistim.

english: How are you [Fremennik name]? I hope all fares well with you this day!
translation: Nasilsin Dokrak? Umarim bugün her sey yolundadir!

english: I'm fine, thanks, how are you?
All is well with me also!
Hello to you, too!
Hello. Did you want something [Fremennik name]?
translation: Merhaba. Bir sey mi istiyordun Dokrak?

english: No, not really.
Well... okay then!
Always good to see you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].
translation: Seni görmek her zaman güzel kardesim Dokrak.

english: You shame us, [Fremennik name]!
How can you steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
You have betrayed your heritage, [Fremennik name]!
Why would you try to steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
What you want, human? You not coming in. Weiss is troll town - humans not welcome.
translation: Ne istiyorsun, insan? Iceri giremezsin. Weiss bir trol kasabasidir, insanlar hos karsilanmaz.

english: My Arm has come to make friends with you.
translation: My Arm seninle arkadas olmak icin geldi.

english: Boulder not sure exactly what you offering, human, but it not sound like something Boulder want to happen.
translation: Boulder senin ne teklif ettigini tam olarak bilmiyor, insan, ama Boulder'in isteyecegi bir sey gibi gelmiyor.

english: But My Arm's come a very long way for this, and he's very excited about what he can teach you.
translation: Ama My Arm bunun icin cok uzun bir yol geldi ve sana ögretebilecekleri konusunda cok heyecanli.

english: Boulder still not sure what you offering, human, but you definitely not doing it in here. Go away!
translation: Boulder hala ne teklif ettigini bilmiyor, insan, ama bunu kesinlikle burada yapmayacaksin. Git buradan!

english: Wolfbone's sent My Arm from the Troll Stronghold.
translation: Wolfbone, My Arm'i Troll Kalesi'nden gönderdi.

english: Human arm might taste good, maybe, so if Wolfbone sent your arm as a snack, we happy to take it an' eat it.
translation: Insan kolu belki lezzetlidir, bu yüzden Wolfbone kolunu atistirmalik olarak gönderdiyse, onu alip yemekten mutluluk duyariz.

english: I'm not letting you eat my arm.
Urgh - human arm attached to human body with human mouth what keep talking an' talking. Shut up and' go away.
translation: Insan kolu, insan vücuduna bagli, insan agziyla konusup duruyor. Sus ve git buradan.

english: You only need to let My Arm in, not me.
translation: Sadece My Arm'i iceri alman gerekiyor, beni degil.

english: Human sound confused about how body work. See, mortal body is intrinsic part of mortal being. It not like we got our souls floating up in da sky controlling bodies like puppets.
translation: Insanlar vücudun nasil calistigi konusunda kafalari karisik. Bak, ölümlü beden, ölümlü varligin ayrilmaz bir parcasidir. Ruhlarimiz gökyüzünde ucup bedenlerimizi kukla gibi kontrol etmiyoruz.

english: We mortal beings - troll, human, goat - we are our bodies, and our bodies are us. You human got dumb ideas 'bout mind/body dualism.
translation: Biz ölümlü varliklar - trol, insan, keci - biz bedenlerimiziz ve bedenlerimiz biziz. Siz insanlar zihin/beden dualizmi hakkinda aptalca fikirleriniz var.

english: Anyway, Boulder not here to talk ontological distinction between mind an' matter, especially with dumb human who not know what [his/her] arm is. So push off.
translation: Her neyse, Boulder zihin ve madde arasindaki ontolojik ayrimi tartismak icin burada degil, özellikle de kolunun ne oldugunu bilmeyen aptal bir insanla. O yüzden cekil git.

english: I'll be back!
Hey, friend of Snowflake!
Who are you?
We met at entry gate, remember? Boulder sent you away, 'cos we not trust humans here in Weiss, an' also you sound crazy. But you our friend now, an' you always welcome.
translation: Giris kapisinda tanismistik, hatirladin mi? Boulder seni gönderdi, cünkü Weiss'ta insanlara güvenmiyoruz ve ayrica sen deli gibi konusuyorsun. Ama artik bizim arkadasimizsin ve her zaman hos geldin.

english: Boulder used to guard entry gate, but now Snowflake trusted Boulder with important farming job. Much more fun.
translation: Boulder eskiden giris kapisini koruyordu, ama simdi Snowflake Boulder'a önemli bir ciftcilik isi verdi. Cok daha eglenceli.

english: Boulder gotta grow goutweed for tribe, an' also make sure your herbs stay healthy. Snowflake's husband troll very strict on it.
translation: Boulder kabile icin goutweed yetistirmekle görevli ve ayrica otlarinin saglikli kalmasini saglamakla. Snowflake'in kocasi troll bu konuda cok kati.

english: Tell me about this place.
This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: Burasi Weiss. Troller yillar önce, daha güneydeki magaralardan kovulduktan sonra burayi insa etti. Simdi Weiss bizim evimiz.

english: It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: Burasi harika, simdi Snowflake ve kocasi troll bize goutweed yetistirmeyi ögretti. Yemekler artik cok daha lezzetli.

english: Do you like it here?
Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: Eh, biraz zorlu ama gittikce iyilesiyor. Snowflake bize gut otu yetistirmeyi ögretti. Keci, kurt, insan, hepsi gut otu ile cok daha lezzetli oluyor.

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: Evet, Weiss yasamak icin iyi bir yer, simdi Snowflake sorumlu. Tüm troller Snowflake'i sever. Kocasi biraz tuhaf ama bu bizim sorunumuz degil.

english: I'll be off.
My Arm has come to make friends with you.
translation: My Arm seninle arkadas olmak icin geldi.

english: Wolfbone's sent My Arm from the Troll Stronghold.
translation: Wolfbone, My Arm'i Troll Kalesi'nden gönderdi.

english: You only need to let My Arm in, not me.
translation: Sadece My Arm'i iceri alman gerekiyor, beni degil.

english: I'll be back!
Who are you?
Tell me about this place.
Do you like it here?
I'll be off.
Hi! What are you up to?
Watering the pretty flowers, you want to help?
translation: Güzel cicekleri suluyorum, yardim etmek ister misin?

english: I don't have time to water flowers, I have people to save!
translation: Cicekleri sulamak icin vaktim yok, kurtarmam gereken insanlar var!

english: Pft, you should take time to enjoy the simple things.
translation: Pft, basit seylerin tadini cikarmak icin zaman ayirmalisin.

english: I'm not a simple person.
So it seems.
Hi, I...
What are you doing here, Fremennik?!
I have a seal of pass...
No you do not! Begone!
The player is teleported back to Rellekka
Ooops. Suppose I need a seal of passage when I'm walking around that island.
translation: Oops. Sanirim o adada dolasirken gecis izni gerekiyor.

english: Hello.
A fair day, traveller. Would you like to see my wares?
translation: Güzel bir gün, yolcu. Mallarimi görmek ister misin?

english: Yes please.
I'd like to ask you about magic crossbows.
translation: Sana sihirli tatar yaylari hakkinda bir sey sormak istiyorum.

english: Ahh crossbows. Not exactly what I'd call skilled ranging, but I guess dwarven engineering is good, what did you want to know?
translation: Ahh tatar yaylari. Benim beceri gerektiren bir sey olarak görmedigim bir sey ama sanirim cüce mühendisligi iyidir, ne bilmek istiyordun?

english: The dwarves don't work with magic logs, I'm wondering if you know how to make a crossbow out of them?
translation: Cüceler sihirli kütüklerle calismazlar, onlardan tatar yayi yapmayi biliyor musun acaba?

english: As it happens, a recent discovery of dragon limbs has allowed the creation of such a crossbow.
translation: Aslinda, yakin zamanda kesfedilen ejderha uzuvlari sayesinde böyle bir tatar yayi yapilabilir hale geldi.

english: That's fantastic!
No thanks.
Okay good day to you.
I don't... however I will look into it when I get spare time, for now you'll have to stick with the dwarven way of doing things.
translation: Bilmiyorum... ama bos zamanim oldugunda arastiracagim, simdilik cücelerin yöntemine uymak zorundasin.

english: Ok, perhaps one day in the future I'll get to make magic crossbows!
translation: Tamam, belki gelecekte bir gün sihirli tatar yaylari yapabilirim!

english: Yes please.
I'd like to ask you about magic crossbows.
translation: Sihirli tatar yaylari hakkinda bir sey sormak istiyorum.

english: No thanks.
Hello! Have you come to take part in the festivities?
translation: Merhaba! Festivale katilmak icin mi geldiniz?

english: I should set up a moleyball court next, the king of all ball-based sports.
translation: Simdi de tüm top sporlarinin krali olan moleyball sahasi kurmaliyim.

english: What was that?
Oh nothing. Just thinking out loud.
translation: Hicbir sey. Sadece yüksek sesle düsünüyordum.

english: Alright I'll leave you to it then.
translation: Tamam, sizi rahat birakayim o zaman.

english: The Easter Bunny is looking awfully glum this year.
translation: Paskalya Tavsani bu yil cok üzgün görünüyor.

english: Perhaps we can help raise the Easter spirits?
translation: Belki Paskalya ruhunu canlandirmaya yardimci olabiliriz?

english: You want to do some necromancy... To cheer up the Easter Bunny?
translation: Paskalya Tavsanini neselendirmek icin büyücülük mü yapmak istiyorsun?

english: No no no! It's just a figure of speech.
translation: Hayir, hayir, hayir! Sadece bir deyim.

english: I just wonder if we could do anything to help.
translation: Yardimci olabilecegimiz bir sey var mi diye merak ediyorum.

english: Leave it to me boss.
I happen to know the E.B. is a big fan of bowling. In fact, he used to be a wizard on the lanes. A champion!
translation: Paskalya Tavsaninin bowling hayrani oldugunu biliyorum. Aslinda, eskiden bowling salonlarinda bir sihirbazdi. Bir sampiyon!

english: I also happen to have the ability to...
...Rig the game in his favour.
Which is handy, he's very out of practise nowadays.
translation: Bu cok kullanisli, cünkü su siralar hic pratik yapmiyor.

english: Won't he suspect something?
Oh no! You see, I have these gears set up just here.
translation: Hayir! Bak, bu aletleri buraya kurdum.

english: Wait, are you just trying to get my trade secrets?
translation: Dur, benim mesleki sirlarimi mi ögrenmeye calisiyorsun?

english: This is strictly a humanitarian effort!
Bun-itarian..?
Look, I just want to get Easter back on track.
translation: Bak, sadece Paskalya'yi tekrar rayina oturtmak istiyorum.

english: You can keep your hustle going, I just want to help the Easter Bunny.
translation: Sen isine devam edebilirsin, ben sadece Paskalya Tavsanina yardim etmek istiyorum.

english: Oh alright, since I do owe the big softie. But I've got my whiskers on you!
translation: Tamam, madem bu kadar yumusak kalplisin. Ama seni gözümün önünden ayirmayacagim!

english: So, what is it you wanted to show me, [player name]?
translation: Peki, bana ne göstermek istiyordun, Maceraci?

english: Well, Bowley here let me in on your secret. Bowling champion three years in a row.
translation: Sey, Bowley bana senin sirrini verdi. Üc yil üst üste bowling sampiyonu.

english: Oh. Those were the days, I haven't partaken for while now though...
translation: Oh. Ne günlerdi ama, uzun zamandir katilmiyorum...

english: I just haven't had the spring in my step with my egg responsibilities.
translation: Yumurta sorumluluklarim yüzünden adimlarimda eskisi gibi ziplama yok.

english: Well, here's your chance!
What do you mean? It's hardly fun without decent competition.
translation: Ne demek istiyorsun? Düzgün bir rekabet olmadan eglenceli olmaz ki.

english: And nobody here quite likes bowling.
They what now?
I've only just gone and spent ages digging out this place and installing the machinery!
translation: Bu yeri kazip makineleri kurmak icin yillarimi harcadim!

english: Nothing to worry about I'm sure!
Ah Bowley, it is good to see you again.
translation: Ah Bowley, seni tekrar görmek ne güzel.

english: Long Ears Johnson. Come to terrorise me pins again?
translation: Uzun Kulakli Johnson. Yine beni korkutmaya mi geldin?

english: We'll see about that.
Oh yes, [player name] is apparently quite good.
translation: Evet, Maceraci görünüse göre oldukca iyi.

english: It's been so long since I've had a decent set with a worthy opponent.
translation: Uzun zamandir iyi bir rakiple düzgün bir mac yapmadim.

english: Chin up bucko, I'm here and ready to challenge your rule of these alleys!
translation: Neselen dostum, ben buradayim ve bu salonun krali olmaya hazirim!

english: Well, I suppose I'm not doing anything else. Why not?
translation: Eh, baska bir isim de yok. Neden olmasin?

english: The player bowls down 3 carrot pins.
A fine shot, but not quite enough!
Watch this!
The Easter Bunny bowls a strike.
A lucky strike?
I'd better shape up or this will be quite one sided.
translation: Kendimi toparlasam iyi olacak, yoksa bu mac tek tarafli olacak.

english: And that would be no fun at all.
translation: Ve bu hic de eglenceli olmaz....

english: The player bowls down the middle 6 pins.
Ah, so you have some fight in you.
translation: Ah, demek icinde biraz mücadele ruhu var.

english: I could do this all day.
That's exactly what I wanted to hear!
The screen fades black with the text "Some time later..."
translation: Ekran “Bir süre sonra...” yazisiyla kararmaya baslar.

english: I'm surprised I hadn't heard about your prowess before, [player name].
translation: Senin yeteneklerini daha önce duymamis olmama sasirdim, Maceraci.

english: Ah you know me, the most modest adventurer in Gielinor.
translation: Ah, beni bilirsin, Gielinor'un en mütevazi maceracisi.

english: Ah, well I suppose I should pack it in while I'm ahead.
But we should do this again.
Aye we should! Also if you could get the word out about my establishment, I'll be raking it in!
translation: Evet, yapmaliyiz! Ayrica, benim mekanimi herkese duyurursan, cok para kazanacagim!

english: I mean... The Rabbit Hole will enjoy all the visitors?
translation: Yani... Rabbit Hole tüm ziyaretcileri agirlayacak mi?

english: Well, anyway...
It was a close match. How are you feeling now?
translation: Yakin bir macti. Simdi nasil hissediyorsun?

english: Oh it was fun but I think I'm just going to sit in the Rabbit Hole a bit longer.
translation: Oh, eglenceliydi ama sanirim Rabbit Hole'da biraz daha oturacagim.

english: I should be off. Always a pleasure, Bowley.
translation: Gitmeliyim. Her zaman bir zevk, Bowley.

english: Aye, till next time.
This is the Rabbit Hole.
Who me? Nah I'm just a mole.
translation: Kim, ben mi? Hayir, ben sadece bir köstebek.

english: Well that went well!
We may have gotten away with it!
Oi, not so loud.
Don't worry I'm sure those excessively large ears are just for show!
translation: Merak etme, o asiri büyük kulaklar sadece gösteris icin eminim!

english: Aye reyt.
He seems to have more of a spring in his step.
But still not quite himself.
translation: Ama hala tam olarak kendisi degil.

english: I'll see if anyone else around here can help.
translation: Buralarda yardim edebilecek baska biri var mi bakayim.

english: With Long Ears Johnson looking a bit more chipper, hopefully we'll get the Egg deliveries finally.
translation: Long Ears Johnson biraz daha neseli görünüyor, umarim sonunda Yumurta teslimatlarini alabiliriz.

english: Hello Bowley, I didn't expect you up here!
translation: Merhaba Bowley, seni burada görmeyi beklemiyordum!

english: And why would that be? I deserve an Egg too, look how much I'm helping out!
translation: Neden öyle olsun ki? Ben de yumurta hak ediyorum, ne kadar yardim ettigime bak!

english: Oh it's just bright is all, we don't often get moles here on the surface.
translation: Sadece cok parlak oldugu icin, burada yüzeyde pek köstebek görmeyiz.

english: Hm yes, I could do with something to keep the sun out of my eyes.
translation: Evet, günesin gözlerimi kamastirmamasi icin bir seye ihtiyacim var.

english: A new machine perhaps that could lift a whole load of earth and hold it over my head!
translation: Belki de bir sürü topragi kaldirip basimin üstünde tutabilecek yeni bir makine!

english: Well enjoy that thought!
The Easter Bunny is looking awfully glum this year.
translation: Paskalya Tavsani bu yil cok üzgün görünüyor.

english: What is this place?
Who are you?
Talk about bowling.
Hello young man.
The boy sobs.
What's the matter?
I've kicked my ball over that hedge, into that garden! The old lady who lives there is scary... She's locked the ball in her wooden shed! Can you get my ball back for me please?
translation: Topumu o citin üzerinden o bahceye attim! Orada yasayan yasli kadin cok korkutucu... Topumu ahsap kulübesine kilitledi! Topumu geri alabilir misin lütfen?

english: Ok, I'll see what I can do.
Thanks mister!
Get it back yourself.
You're a meany!
The boy starts crying again.
Well if you're not going to answer, I'll go.
The boy sniffs slightly.
Thank you for getting my ball back!
What's the matter?
Yes.
No.
Well if you're not going to answer, I'll go.
You're a long way from home, what are you doing here?
translation: Evinden cok uzaktasin, burada ne yapiyorsun?

english: I'm on an expedition to try and extend the bounds of gnome knowledge. King Narnode has sent out a number of gnome explorers to map the furthest reaches of Gielinor.
translation: Gnome bilgisinin sinirlarini genisletmek icin bir kesif gezisindeyim. Kral Narnode, Gielinor'un en uzak köselerini haritalamak icin bir dizi gnome kasif gönderdi.

english: Seems like a hard job.
Oh no, I enjoy it - I've always had itchy feet ever since I was a little gnome.
translation: Hayir, ben bundan zevk aliyorum - kücük bir gnome oldugumdan beri hep gezgin ruhluydum.

english: Still, you seem to have drawn the short straw here - there's nothing but snow...
translation: Yine de, burada kisa cöpü cekmissin gibi görünüyor - burada kar disinda hicbir sey yok...

english: Oh, I like it - very peaceful. Avoiding those Trolls can be tricky though.
translation: Oh, ben seviyorum - cok huzurlu. Ama o Trolleri atlatmak zor olabilir.

english: Tell me about it...
What does this mint cake do?
translation: Bu nane keki ne ise yarar?

english: Gnomish mint cake is a great source of energy for the gnome traveller. It will give you that extra bit of zip when you are running out of steam.
translation: Gnome nane keki, gnome gezginler icin harika bir enerji kaynagidir. Enerjiniz tükendiginde size ekstra bir güc verir.

english: Ooh, that might come in very handy. Do you have any spare?
translation: Ooh, bu cok isime yarayabilir. Yedek var mi?

english: I need all the mint cake I have, I'm afraid.
translation: Korkarim, sahip oldugum tüm nane kekine ihtiyacim var.

english: What does this seed pod do?
translation: Bu tohum kabugu ne ise yarar?

english: Ah, the seed pod of the Grand Tree is a fascinating spirit artefact. It is a very useful thing, though one must treat it with respect, since the Grand Tree has a connection with all of its parts, however distant they
translation: Ah, Büyük Agac'in tohum kabugu büyüleyici bir ruh eseri. Cok kullanisli bir seydir, ancak Büyük Agac tüm parcalariyla baglantili oldugu icin, ne kadar uzak olursa olsun, ona saygi ile davranmak gerekir.

english: may be. How do you think the Spirit Trees work?

If you launch its seeds in a far flung location, you will be helping the tree survive, so the grand tree will help a gnome glider pilot find you, using the seed burst itself (which marks the sky) and a little magic, and bring you
translation: Tohumlarini uzak bir yere firlatirsan, agacin hayatta kalmasina yardimci olursun, böylece Büyük Agac, tohum patlamasini (gökyüzünü isaretler) ve biraz sihir kullanarak bir cüce planör pilotunun seni bulmasina yardim eder ve

english: back home as an act of gratitude. Budding farmers will also find their link with plants to be just a little bit better than before.
translation: minnettarlik göstergesi olarak seni eve geri getirir. Yeni baslayan ciftciler de bitkilerle olan baglarinin eskisinden biraz daha iyi oldugunu göreceklerdir.

english: However, it takes time for a pilot to find you, and if you are in a real hurry, and I mean a real emergency, you can just squash the seed pod. The Grand Tree doesn't like this, but will pull you back
translation: Ancak, pilotun sizi bulmasi zaman alir ve gercekten aceleniz varsa, yani gercek bir acil durum varsa, tohum kabugunu ezebilirsiniz. Büyük Agac bundan hoslanmaz, ancak sizi hemen

english: home straight away. Don't do this if you need to do anything with plants straight away, though - your fingers will be considerably less green for a while after using the seed pod this way, and the journey is not
translation: eve geri götürür. Ancak, bitkilerle hemen bir sey yapmaniz gerekiyorsa bunu yapmayin - tohum kabugunu bu sekilde kullandiktan sonra parmaklariniz bir süre icin oldukca yesil olmayacak ve yolculuk

english: very pleasant...
Wow, that's very interesting. Thanks.
translation: Vay canina, bu cok ilginc. Tesekkürler.

english: I'm struggling with this, please help me solve it!
translation: Bununla ugrasiyorum, lütfen cözmeme yardim et!

english: Brambrickle has given you a puzzle box!
translation: Brambrickle sana bir bulmaca kutusu verdi!

english: Sorry but you haven't solved the puzzle yet.
Thanks [player name]!
Brambrickle has given you another clue scroll!
translation: Brambrickle sana baska bir ipucu parsömeni verdi!

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: Hazir yemekler maalesef ise yaramaz. Aluft Aloft'un müsterileri icin sadece el yapimi Gnome Mutfagi yeterince iyidir.

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food item] to Brambickle.
Brrrr. This will warm me up, I'm bored of snow and Troll food.
translation: Brrrr. Bu beni isitacak, kardan ve Troll yemeginden sikildim.

english: Now that I have some proper food, I won't need this any more.
translation: Artik dogru düzgün yemeklerim olduguna göre, buna artik ihtiyacim yok.

english: Here, take these Grand Seed pods. Very useful in emergencies!
translation: Al, bu Grand Seed podlarini al. Acil durumlarda cok kullanislidir!

english: I found this odd herb, maybe you can do something with it.
translation: Bu garip bitkiyi buldum, belki onunla bir seyler yapabilirsin.

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: Bunu bana getirmek icin uzun bir yol kat etmis olmalisin. Iste sana bahsis olarak kücük bir sey.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: Teslimatin cok gec kaldi! Aluft jnr.'a geri dön ve baska bir siparis al. Artik ihtiyacin olmadigi icin teslimat kutunu atiyorsun.

english: You're a long way from home, what are you doing here?
translation: Evinden cok uzaktasin, burada ne yapiyorsun?

english: What does this mint cake do?
translation: Bu nane keki ne ise yarar?

english: What does this seed pod do?
translation: Bu tohum kabugu ne ise yarar?

english: Anywhere you want to go?
translation: Gitmek istedigin bir yer var mi?

english: Home.
Maybe another day.
No, this feel like home.
Oh, I guess I could stay here a while...
translation: Oh, sanirim bir süre burada kalabilirim...

english: How is the weather down there?
Hot.
Ah, I'm sorry to hear that.
No, I like.
Oh right yeah, that makes sense.
If I get into a fight, are you going to help me?
translation: Kavgaya karisirsam, bana yardim edecek misin?

english: I follow.
I'll take that as a yes, then?
translation: Bunu evet olarak kabul edeyim mi?

english: Just follow.
I'll take that as a no, then.
translation: O zaman bunu hayir olarak kabul ediyorum.

english: Yes.
Wait, yes? You'll fight?
translation: Bekle, evet mi? Kavga edecek misin?

english: No.
Cool.
What?
I squish!
You burn!
Home.
No, this feel like home.
Cold.
No, I like.
I follow.
Just follow.
Yes.
No.
Cool.
I squish!
You freeze!
Here I come!
You can't escape me!
Time to feel my strength!
Time to feel the strength of fire!
I'll crush you now!
No more running, face me now!
Time to meet your end!
The real battle begins now!
You'll regret provoking me!
Let's end this fight!
Your time is up!
This is no game anymore!
Behold the power of fire!
Face the force of my fury!
Let's see how you handle this!
Time to face your doom!
Time to taste my wrath!
Can you withstand this power?
Feel the heat of my wrath!
Prepare to be scorched!
Time to feel my flames!
Time to show you my full strength!
Finally I can unleash my true power!
Feel the full strength of my wrath now!
Now, there's nothing holding me back!
translation: Artik beni durduracak hicbir sey yok!

english: No more holding back! Prepare to feel my full strength!
translation: Artik durmak yok! Tüm gücümü hissetmeye hazirlan!

english: Can I help you with anything today?
What are you selling?
No thanks.
Okay, well let me know if I can.
translation: Tamam, yardimci olabilecegim bir sey olursa haber verin.

english: What are you selling?
No thanks.
Hello there!
Do I know you?
I don't think so.
Then I will have to ask you to move on.
translation: O zaman gitmenizi rica etmek zorundayim.

english: But...
Here's a word of advice: Don't take things personally. I get a lot of wannabes bothering me and wanting to join my crew, but I'm not here to offer out cheap thrills.
translation: Size bir tavsiye: Kisisel algilamayin. Beni rahatsiz eden ve ekibime katilmak isteyen bircok taklitci var, ama ben buraya ucuz heyecan sunmak icin gelmedim.

english: So what are you here for?
To enjoy a drink and not be bothered. Now, if you'll excuse me...
translation: Bir icki icip rahatsiz edilmeden vakit gecirmek icin. Simdi, izin verirseniz...

english: Vegetate!
Die deliciously!
Rest in cabbage!
Grow up or leave.
Hey Bravek.
Hello there. Can't stop to talk I'm afraid, I've been left with a lot of work to do thanks to those mourners.
translation: Merhaba. Konusmak icin vaktim yok maalesef, o yas tutanlar yüzünden yapmam gereken cok is var.

english: Go away, I'm busy! I'm... Umm... In a meeting!
translation: Git buradan, mesgulüm! Ben... Sey... Toplantidayim!

english: My head hurts! I'll speak to you another day...
translation: Basim agriyor! Baska bir gün konusuruz...

english: This is really important though!

I can't possibly speak to you with my head spinning like this... I went a bit heavy on the drink again last night. Curse my herbalist, she made the best hang over cures. Darn inconvenient of her catching the plague.
translation: Basim bu kadar dönüyorken seninle konusamam... Dün gece yine biraz fazla ictim. Bitki uzmanimi lanetliyorum, en iyi aksamdan kalma ilaclarini o yapiyordu. Vebaya yakalanmasi ne kadar da talihsizlik.

english: Okay, goodbye.
You shouldn't drink so much then!
translation: O zaman bu kadar cok icmemelisin!

english: Well positions of responsibility are hard, I need something to take my mind off things... Especially with the problems this place has.
translation: Sorumluluk gerektiren pozisyonlar zordur, kafami dagitacak bir seye ihtiyacim var... Özellikle buradaki sorunlar yüzünden.

english: Do you know what's in the cure?
translation: Tedavinin icinde ne var biliyor musun?

english: Hmmm let me think... Ouch! Thinking isn't clever. Ah here, she did scribble it down for me.
translation: Hmmm, bir düsüneyim... Ah! Düsünmek akillica degil. Ah, iste, benim icin yazmis

english: I don't think drink is the solution.
I don't feel well enough to have a philosophical discussion about it right now. My head hurts.
translation: Su anda bu konu hakkinda felsefi bir tartisma yapacak kadar iyi hissetmiyorum. Basim agriyor.

english: Uurgh! My head still hurts too much to think straight. Oh for one of Trudi's hangover cures!
translation: Uurgh! Basim hala cok agriyor, düzgün düsünemiyorum. Trudi'nin aksamdan kalma tedavilerinden biri olsa keske!

english: Try this.
Ooh that's much better! Thanks, that's the clearest my head has felt in a month. Ah now, what was it you wanted me to do for you?
translation: Ooh, cok daha iyi oldu! Tesekkürler, bir aydir basim ilk kez bu kadar acik hissediyor. Peki, benim icin ne yapmami istiyordun?

english: I need to rescue a kidnap victim called Elena. She's being held in a plague house, I need permission to enter.
translation: Elena adinda bir kacirilma kurbanini kurtarmam gerekiyor. O bir veba evinde tutuluyor, iceri girmek icin izin almam gerekiyor.

english: Well the mourners deal with that sort of thing...
translation: Bu tür islerle cenaze törenleri ilgilenir...

english: Okay, I'll go speak to them.
Is that all anyone says around here?
Well, they know best about plague issues.
translation: Veba konularinda en iyi onlar bilir.

english: Don't you want to take an interest in it at all?
Nope, I don't wish to take a deep interest in plagues. That stuff is too scary for me!
translation: Hayir, vebaya derinlemesine ilgi duymak istemiyorum. Bu konu benim icin cok korkutucu!

english: I see why people say you're a weak leader.
translation: Insanlarin seni zayif bir lider olarak nitelendirmelerinin nedenini anliyorum.

english: Bah, people always criticise their leaders but delegating is the only way to lead. I delegate all plague issues to the mourners.
translation: Insanlar liderlerini her zaman elestirir, ama liderlik etmenin tek yolu görevleri delege etmektir. Tüm veba konularini yas tutanlara delege ediyorum.

english: This whole city is a plague issue!
Okay, I'll talk to the mourners.
They won't listen to me!
They say I'm not properly equipped to go in the house, though I do have a very effective gas mask.
translation: Cok etkili bir gaz maskem olmasina ragmen, eve girmek icin uygun donanima sahip olmadigimi söylüyorlar.

english: Hmmm, well I guess they're not taking the issue of a kidnapping seriously enough. They do go a bit far sometimes.
translation: Hmmm, sanirim kacirilma meselesini yeterince ciddiye almiyorlar. Bazen biraz abartiyorlar.

english: I've heard of Elena, she has helped us a lot... Okay, I'll give you this warrant to enter the house.
translation: Elena'yi duydum, bize cok yardim etti... Tamam, sana eve girmek icin bu izni verecegim.

english: Thanks again for the hangover cure.
Ah now what was it you wanted me to do for you?
translation: Ah, benim icin ne yapmami istiyordun?

english: I need to rescue Elena. She's now a kidnap victim! She's being held in a plague house, I need permission to enter.
translation: Elena'yi kurtarmam lazim. O simdi bir kacirilma kurbani! Veba evinde tutuluyor, girmek icin izne ihtiyacim var.

english: Not a problem, happy to help out.
translation: Sorun degil, yardimci olmaktan memnuniyet duyarim.

english: I'm just having a little drop of whisky, then I'll feel really good.
translation: Sadece biraz viski iciyorum, sonra kendimi cok iyi hissedecegim.

english: This is really important though!
Okay, goodbye.
You shouldn't drink so much then!
translation: O zaman bu kadar cok icmemelisin!

english: Do you know what's in the cure?
I don't think drink is the solution.
Okay, I'll go speak to them.
Is that all anyone says around here?
Don't you want to take an interest in it at all?
I see why people say you're a weak leader.
translation: Insanlarin seni zayif bir lider olarak nitelendirmelerinin nedenini anliyorum.

english: Okay, I'll talk to the mourners.
They won't listen to me!
*cough*whatcha want?*hack*
What is this place?
Smoke dungeon.*wheeze*Got smoke devils in it. For killing.*splutter*
translation: Duman zindani. *hirilti* Icinde duman seytanlari var. Öldürmek icin. *bogulma*

english: My niece Nieve*hack hack*is one of those Slayer Masters. You know, they tell people what to go kill.*cough*I look after this cave for people on assignments like that.
translation: Yegenim Nieve *öksürük öksürük* o Slayer Ustalarindan biri. Bilirsin, insanlara neyi öldüreceklerini söylerler. *öksürük* Ben bu magarayi, bu tür görevlerde olan insanlar icin koruyorum.

english: My nephew Steve*hack hack*is one of those Slayer Masters. You know, they tell people what to go kill.*cough*I look after this cave for people on assignments like that.
translation: Yegenim Steve *öksürük* de o Slayer Master'lardan biri. Bilirsin, insanlara neyi öldüreceklerini söylerler. *öksürük* Ben bu magarayi, bu tür görevlerde olan insanlar icin koruyorum.

english: Are you alright?
Of course I'm*wheeze*alright. I'm fed up with you young folk asking*cough cough*if I'm alright just because I like a bit of smoke*splutter*in my tubes.
translation: Tabii ki iyiyim *hirilti* iyiyim. Siz genclerin, sirf cigerlerime biraz duman girmesini seviyorum diye*öksürük*iyi olup olmadigimi sormasindan biktim.

english: Don't you come lecturing me on*cough*air quality, young man - I've breathed smoke all my life, man and boy and*euuurgh*and there's no*ghhuk*scientific evidence that it's harmful.
translation: Bana hava kalitesi hakkinda ders verme*öksürük*genc adam - Hayatim boyunca duman soludum, cocuklugumdan beri*euuurgh*ve bunun zararli olduguna dair*ghhuk*bilimsel bir kanit yok.

english: I think I'll leave you alone.
*cough cough cough ghhuk*
Hey, you don't*cough*wanna go in there without*cough*some kind of protection from the smoke. Your lungs aren't as tough as*wheeze*mine.
translation: Hey, sen*öksürük*oraya*öksürük*sigara dumanindan korunacak bir sey olmadan girmek istemezsin. Senin cigerlerin benimki kadar*hirilti*güclü degil.

english: *cough*that isn't your assignment*wheeze*
What is this place?
Are you alright?
I think I'll leave you alone.
Enter anyway.
Stay outside.
Hmm, interesting place this. It feels a little like Kelda, except without the good bits.
translation: Hmm, ilginc bir yer burasi. Kelda'ya benziyor, ama iyi yanlari yok.

english: Bored, bored, bored. These Fremenniks are taking ages.
translation: Sikildim, sikildim, sikildim. Bu Fremennikler cok zaman aliyor.

english: Hey, they're doing their best. You arrived early.
translation: Hey, ellerinden geleni yapiyorlar. Erken geldin.

english: Hey, we arrived precisely when we told your representatives. Lack of planning on your part does not constitute an emergency on my part.
translation: Hey, temsilcilerinize söyledigimiz saatte geldik. Senin planlama eksikligin benim icin acil bir durum olusturmaz.

english: Please, someone get these guys their ore quickly. They are eating all the good food on the island, and complaining about it!
translation: Lütfen, biri bu adamlara cabuk cevherlerini versin. Adadaki tüm iyi yiyecekleri yiyorlar ve bundan sikayet ediyorlar!

english: I'd better get a move on!
Why are you still here?
Well it seemed rude not to finish the food they gave us.
translation: Bize verdikleri yemegi bitirmemek kabalik olurdu.

english: Feel free to leave it. Please leave.
I'll just finish the roast off.
Hi!
Let me at 'em!
Trolls? Schmolls!
The trolls are coming!
The trolls took my baby son!
Welcome to Burthorpe!
Thanks!
Trolls!
Hello stranger.
Go away!
Run!
Hi!
The Imperial Guard can no longer protect us!
The White Knights will soon have control!
translation: Beyaz Sövalyeler yakinda kontrolü ele gecirecek!

english: I heard about what you did, thank you!
The White Knights are still going to take over.
translation: Beyaz Sövalyeler yine de kontrolü ele gecirecek.

english: I hear the Imperial Guard are preparing an attack!
translation: Imparatorluk Muhafizlarinin bir saldiri hazirligi yaptigini duydum!

english: Thank you so much!
Surely we are safe now!
Who are you?
My name is Brew'ma. I'm here to assist adventurers like you with potion making.
translation: Adim Brew'ma. Senin gibi maceracilara iksir yapiminda yardimci olmak icin buradayim.

english: If you hand me a herb from the Bruma tree and one of the unfinished potions from the crate, I can combine the two if you lack the... talent to do so yourself.
translation: Bana Bruma agacindan bir bitki ve sandiktan bitmemis iksirlerden birini verirsen, bunu kendin yapma yetenegin yoksa ikisini birlestirebilirim.

english: Thanks!
You don't have any unfinished potions on you. I can't use the herbs without them.
translation: Üzerinde bitmemis iksir yok. Onlar olmadan otlari kullanamam.

english: You don't have any Bruma herbs on you. I need them to finish the potions.
translation: Üzerinde Bruma otu yok. Iksirleri bitirmek icin onlara ihtiyacim var.

english: Sorry, I can't do anything with that.
So, are you selling something?
Yep, take a look at these great axes!
translation: Evet, su harika baltalara bir bak!

english: 'Ello.
'Ello!
Well done.
You've [found a new clue/obtained a casket]!
translation: Yeni bir ipucu buldun/bir tabut elde ettin!

english: So, are you selling something?
'Ello.
Would you like to buy some archery equipment?
translation: Okculuk ekipmani satin almak ister misin?

english: No thanks, I've got all the archery equipment I need.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, ihtiyacim olan tüm okculuk ekipmanina sahibim.

english: Okay. Fare well on your travels.
No thanks, I've got all the archery equipment I need.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, ihtiyacim olan tüm okculuk ekipmanina sahibim.

english: Let's see what you've got, then.
translation: O zaman neyin var bir bakalim.

english: Hi there, looking for a challenge are you?
translation: Merhaba, bir meydan okuma mi ariyorsun?

english: Yes actually, what've you got?
Shame, I don't think I have anything for you. Train up your Agility skill to at least 50 and I might be able to help you out.
translation: Yazik, sanirim sana uygun bir seyim yok. Ceviklik becerini en az 50'ye cikarirsan sana yardimci olabilirim.

english: Aha, I have the perfect thing for you! See if you can get to the centre of my maze, the further you get the greater the rewards. There's even some special prizes if you make it right to the end.
translation: Aha, sana mükemmel bir seyim var! Labirentimin merkezine ulasabilir misin bir bak, ne kadar uzaga gidersen ödül o kadar büyük olur. Sonuna kadar ulasirsan özel ödüller bile var.

english: Ok that sounds good!
Great! When you enter the maze, I'll give you a jewel - it'll allow you to get out of the maze at any time. However that's all you're allowed to take in with you, no cheating!
translation: Harika! Labirente girdiginde sana bir mücevher verecegim, bu mücevher sayesinde istedigin zaman labirentten cikabilirsin. Ancak yanina alabilecegin tek sey bu, hile yapma!

english: Oh one last thing, if you happen to see my harmonica I'd really like to have it back.
translation: Son bir sey daha, eger armonikami görürsen geri almak isterim.

english: Actually I think I'll pass thanks.
What is this place?
Ah welcome to my humble home, well actually it belongs to mummsie but she's getting on a bit so I look after the place for her.
translation: Ah, mütevazi evime hos geldin, aslinda burasi anneme ait ama o biraz yaslandi, ben de onun yerine burayi bakiyorum.

english: So are you interested in a challenge?
translation: Peki, bir meydan okumaya var misin?

english: No thanks.
Hi again, what can I do for you?
translation: Merhaba tekrar, senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: I want to try the maze again!
Certainly, when you enter the maze I'll give you another jewel. Good luck!
translation: Tabii, labirente girdiginde sana bir mücevher daha verecegim. Iyi sanslar!

english: Nothing thanks.
And where do you think you're going? A little too eager I think. Come and talk to me before you go wandering around in there.
translation: Nereye gittigini saniyorsun? Bence biraz fazla heveslisin. Oraya girmeden önce gel de benimle konus.

english: Tut tut tut, now you know you're not allowed to take anything except that jewel in with you.
translation: Ssss, oraya o mücevherden baska hicbir sey götüremeyecegini biliyorsun.

english: Sorry but I can't allow you to take your follower in there, never know what trouble they might cause.
translation: Üzgünüm ama takipcini oraya götürmene izin veremem, ne tür sorunlar cikaracaklari belli olmaz.

english: Brian O'Richard gives you a jewel as you enter the maze.
translation: Brian O'Richard labirente girdiginde sana bir mücevher verir.

english: Oh dear, you really didn't get very far did you?
translation: Oh hayir, pek uzaga gidemedin, degil mi?

english: Well you didn't do too badly, but you didn't make it nearly as far as others have.
translation: Fena sayilmaz, ama digerleri kadar uzaga gidemedin.

english: You gained: [number] Thieving Experience. [number] Agility Experience.
Amazing, you made it so far!
Want to come out then? Giving up are you? You know there's no time limit here.
translation: Cikmak ister misin? Vazgeciyor musun? Burada zaman siniri olmadigini biliyorsun.

english: Yes I'd like to leave!
Right you are then, out you come.
The player exits the maze
No I'm fine thanks.
Yes actually, what've you got?
Ok that sounds good!
What is this place?
Actually I think I'll pass thanks.
No thanks.
I want to try the maze again!
Nothing thanks.
Yes I'd like to leave!
No I'm fine thanks.
What do you want? Weapons is what I got.
I'll take a look.
I don't need anything.
I'll take a look.
I don't need anything.
Hello adventurer, what can I do for you?
translation: Merhaba maceraci, senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: Hello, just wanted a chat..
It's always a pleasure to catch up with an another mage! Especially one who has helped me so much!
translation: Baska bir büyücüyle sohbet etmek her zaman bir zevktir! Özellikle de bana cok yardim etmis biriyle!

english: Oh, by the way, I found this odd thing lying around, does it belong to you?
translation: Bu arada, yerde bu tuhaf seyi buldum, senin mi?

english: Oh, yes - I was wondering where that had gone...
translation: Evet, onun nereye gittigini merak ediyordum...

english: You should look after your things more carefully you know...
Thanks!
How are your researches going?
Oh, not so bad. I'll let you know if I find anything I think you'll find interesting...
translation: Oh, fena degil. Ilginc bulabilecegin bir sey bulursam sana haber veririm...

english: Thanks! I'd appreciate that.
What's this seed do?
Fascinating ... a crystal seed. You should have a look at the crystal bowl in the other room, must be related...
translation: Büyüleyici... bir kristal tohum. Diger odadaki kristal kaseye bir bakmalisin, onunla bir ilgisi olmali...

english: Thanks, I'll do that...
What's this crystal saw do?
translation: Bu kristal testere ne ise yariyor?

english: I've no idea, it must have been Oaknock's, he liked talking to the elves.
translation: Hicbir fikrim yok, Oaknock'a ait olmali, o elflerle konusmayi severdi.

english: Where would I find out how the thing works?
translation: Bu seyin nasil calistigini nereden ögrenebilirim?

english: Errm, I'm not sure. Have a chat with Hazelmere, maybe he'll know. He was around when
translation: Ee, emin degilim. Hazelmere ile konus, belki o bilir. Oaknock hayattayken o da oradaydi

english: Oaknock was alive and might have seen him use it.
translation: ve onun bunu kullandigini görmüs olabilir.

english: Excellent idea, I'll do that. Thanks.
Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence?
Okay. Hold onto your hat!
Senventior Disthine Molenko!
Brimstail teleports the player to the rune essence mine.
translation: Brimstail, oyuncuyu rune essence madenine isinlar.

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: Hazir yemekler maalesef ise yaramaz. Aluft Aloft'un müsterileri icin sadece el yapimi Gnome Mutfagi yeterince iyidir.

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Brimstail
You have my gratitude, young delivery person!
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.'dan ücretsiz teslimat jetonunuzu almayi unutmayin.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: Teslimatiniz cok gec! Aluft jnr.'a geri dönüp baska bir siparis alin. Artik ihtiyaciniz olmadigi icin teslimat kutunuzu atiyorsunuz.

english: Well done!
You've obtained a [new clue/casket]!
Hello, just wanted a chat.
I need to mine some rune essence.
*squeal*
*snuffle*
Hello.
Good day.
Good day, Your Royal Highness.
Oi!
Rahr!
No!
Grr!
Aargh!
I'm a gonner!
It's no use, I'm done for!
Uggh!
