If you'd like to see someone fighting Zulrah, feel free to borrow my telescope.
translation: Zulrah ile savasan birini görmek isterseniz, teleskopumu ödünc alabilirsiniz.

english: What do you mean?
Zulrah, the giant snake. Its lair is deep in the swamp, so I've set up a telescope so I can watch people fighting it.
translation: Zulrah, dev yilan. Yuvasi batakligin derinliklerinde, bu yüzden onunla savasanlari izleyebilmek icin bir teleskop kurdum.

english: Thanks.
What do you mean?
Thanks.
Nilsal, traveller. I was injured while exploring down here. Could you spare me some cooked fish, meat or vegetables?
translation: Nilsal, gezgin. Burada kesif yaparken yaralandim. Bana pismis balik, et veya sebze verebilir misin?

english: It just so happens that I have some with me!
Oh, please hand it over if you can spare it.
I'm afraid that I don't have any of that type of food with me.
translation: Maalesef yanimda o tür yiyecekler yok.

english: Oh, well if you return with any I would greatly appreciate it.
translation: Oh, eger bulursaniz getirirseniz cok sevinirim.

english: No thanks. I would rather eat fish, meat or vegetables.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler. Balik, et veya sebze yemeyi tercih ederim.

english: Thanks for helping me. Is there anything you'd like to know about this temple? If you find anything in here, show it to me and I'll tell you what I know about it.
translation: Yardim ettiginiz için tesekkürler. Bu tapinak hakkinda bilmek istediginiz bir sey var mi? Burada bir sey bulursaniz bana gösterin, ben de size onun hakkinda bildiklerimi anlatayim.

english: What is this place?
This place probably had a name at some point but it has long since been forgotten. The Arceuus librarians refer to this place as the Forthos Dungeon.
translation: Bu yerin bir zamanlar bir adi vardi ama coktan unutuldu. Arceuus kütüphanecileri buraya Forthos Zindani diyorlar.

english: It is rumoured that this place used to be of religious significance to druidic followers of both Ralos and Ranul.
translation: Bu yerin eskiden Ralos ve Ranul'un druid takipcileri icin dini önemi oldugu söyleniyor.

english: Who are Ralos and Ranul?
According to religious texts, Ralos is the god of the sun and Ranul, his brother, is the god of the moon.
translation: Dini metinlere göre, Ralos günes tanrisi, kardesi Ranul ise ay tanrisidir.

english: If you find any artifacts or relics from within this temple, I would be very interested in seeing them.
translation: Bu tapinakta herhangi bir eser veya kalinti bulursaniz, onlari görmek isterim.

english: I'll see what I find. Although, I've never heard of Ralos and Ranul.
translation: Bakalim ne bulacagim. Ancak, Ralos ve Ranul'u hic duymadim.

english: You need only to look up and see their greatness above you when you return to the surface.
translation: Yüzeye döndügünüzde, yukariya bakip onlarin büyüklügünü görmeniz yeterlidir.

english: Who are you?
My name is Brother Aimeri, I am a travelling monk from the distant land of Varlamore on a journey to uncover the secrets of this temple.
translation: Adim Kardes Aimeri, uzak Varlamore diyarindan gelen bir gezgin kesisim ve bu tapinagin sirlarini ortaya cikarmak icin bir yolculuga ciktim.

english: I worship Ralos, a common practice where I am from. However, I found out that our order may have originated from this temple. If you find anything of interest, please let me know.
translation: Benim geldigim yerde yaygin bir uygulama olan Ralos'a tapiyorum. Ancak, bizim tarikatimizin bu tapinaktan kaynaklanmis olabilecegini ögrendim. Ilginc bir sey bulursaniz lütfen bana haber verin.

english: I'll keep my eyes open.
You have my gratitude. Any information you do find would also be of interest to the Arceuus Library. I hope we can uncover the secrets of this place for the greater good.
translation: Sana minnettarim. Buldugun her türlü bilgi Arceuus Kütüphanesi icin de ilgi cekici olacaktir. Umarim bu yerin sirlarini daha büyük bir iyilik icin ortaya cikarabiliriz.

english: The greater good.
How did you get injured?
I found out about this place from Logosia in the Arceuus Library. I came to investigate but was ambushed by the spiders in the room to the north.
translation: Arceuus Kütüphanesi'ndeki Logosia'dan burayi ögrendim. Arastirmak icin geldim ama kuzeydeki odada örümceklerin saldirisina ugradim.

english: I'm a scholar not a fighter. I didn't have time to think through my options so I did what came naturally and ran away.
translation: Ben bir savasci degil, bir akademisyenim. Seceneklerimi düsünmeye vaktim olmadi, bu yüzden dogal olarak kactim.

english: Why didn't you decide to run back the way you came from instead of running further into the dungeon where there could be more dangerous creatures?
translation: Neden daha tehlikeli yaratiklarin olabilecegi zindanin derinliklerine dogru kosmak yerine geldigin yoldan geri dönmedin?

english: See, the problem with that... Is that it is an excellent idea I wish I had thought of at the time.
translation: Sorun su ki... Bu harika bir fikir, keske o anda aklima gelseydi.

english: You've been trapped here for a while! No wonder you were hungry!
translation: Bir süredir burada mahsur kalmissin! Ac olmana sasmamali!

english: I found a strange creature possessing an adventurer within the dungeon and it has cursed one of the altars. Do you know how I can remove it?
translation: Zindanda bir maceraciyi ele gecirmis garip bir yaratik buldum ve bu yaratik sunaklardan birini lanetlemis. Bu laneti nasil kaldirabilirim, biliyor musun?

english: How strange. Tell me, what did the creature look like?
translation: Ne garip. Söylesene, yaratik neye benziyordu?

english: It was a dark black creature with a white skull on its head and curved horns.
translation: Kafasinda beyaz bir kafatasi ve kivrik boynuzlari olan koyu siyah bir yaratikti.

english: Let me see... According to my notes that appears to have been a Shaeded Beast, a vile creature which posseses people and corrupts their minds.
translation: Bir bakalim... Notlarima göre bu, insanlari ele gecirip zihinlerini bozan igrenc bir yaratik olan Shaeded Beast gibi görünüyor.

english: Only the power of Ralos can remove such a curse. I suggest making an offering to Ralos somewhere within this temple.
translation: Sadece Ralos'un gücü böyle bir laneti kaldirabilir. Bu tapinak icinde bir yerde Ralos'a bir adak sunmani öneririm.

english: What kind of sacrifice should I offer?
As Ralos is the sun god, any normal bone just won't do. I'd recommend the bones of any dragon.
translation: Ralos günes tanrisi oldugu icin normal bir kemik yeterli olmaz. Bir ejderhanin kemiklerini öneririm.

english: I'd advise staying away from the altar in the mean time.
translation: Bu arada sunaktan uzak durmani tavsiye ederim.

english: Thanks. I'll have a look around.
I received a key from the bone burner but unfortunately I have lost it.
translation: Kemik yakicidan bir anahtar aldim ama maalesef kaybettim.

english: The great Ralos foresaw this and presented me with the same key for safe-keeping should you lose it.
translation: Büyük Ralos bunu önceden görmüs ve anahtari kaybetmen durumunda saklaman icin bana ayni anahtari vermisti.

english: That's awfully convenient!
I'm fine, thanks.
Disgusting! I don't know why you have that, I'd destroy them before they have a chance to hatch.
translation: Igrenc! Neden bunu sakladigini bilmiyorum, yumurtadan cikmadan yok etmelisin.

english: Actually, I believe they're used as supplies in potion making, they might have some use.
translation: Aslinda, iksir yapiminda malzeme olarak kullanildiklarini saniyorum, bir ise yarayabilirler.

english: Do with it as you wish, just don't come crawling back to me if it comes back to bite you.
translation: Istedigin gibi yap, ama basina bela acarsa bana gelip yalvarmaya kalkma.

english: I see what you did there.
Hmm, interesting. I recall seeing a chest to the west of here further down the passage with colouring similar to this key. Perhaps this key opens that chest?
translation: Hmm, ilginc. Buradan batiya dogru, gecidin ilerisinde bu anahtara benzer renkte bir sandik gördügümü hatirliyorum. Belki bu anahtar o sandigi aciyordur?

english: Thanks for your help!
My, you adventurer'sare a strange bunch. I suppose there is a reason why you have kept the creatureseyes in a jar?
translation: Siz maceracilar gercekten tuhaf bir grupsunuz. Yaratigin gözlerini bir kavanozda saklamanizin bir nedeni var herhalde?

english: I'm not sure myself, though I've heard some people like to display items like this in their house.
translation: Ben de emin degilim, ama bazi insanlarin evlerinde bu tür esyalari sergilemeyi sevdiklerini duydum.

english: As I said, you are a strange bunch indeed.
translation: Dedigim gibi, siz gercekten tuhaf bir grupsunuz.

english: That looks like the legs of Sarachnis, bound together by her web. I suppose if anything, it looks heavy enough to crush your enemies.
translation: Bu, Sarachnis'in aglariyla birbirine baglanmis bacaklarina benziyor. Herhalde düsmanlarinizi ezmeye yetecek kadar agirdir.

english: Hey, let go of me! What are you doing?
It talks?
Yeah, I killed Sarachnis and she started following me, I think she's cute so I've decided to keep her around.
translation: Evet, Sarachnis'i öldürdüm ve o da beni takip etmeye basladi. Onu sevimli buldugum icin yaninda tutmaya karar verdim.

english: Do as you wish. I've certainly seen people keep worse company than a spider.
translation: Istedigini yap. Örümcekten daha kötü arkadaslari olan insanlar gördüm.

english: Oh, very interesting. This page appears to be taken from a religious script which speaks of Ranul.
translation: Oh, cok ilginc. Bu sayfa Ranul'dan bahseden dini bir metinden alinmis gibi görünüyor.

english: This is very sad. To see such religious scripts desecrated, it's blasphemy!
translation: Bu cok üzücü. Böyle dini metinlerin kutsalliginin bozulmasi, bu küfürdür!

english: Perhaps the script still exists?
Yes, yes! I hope so. I would expect a temple of this nature to have a library of sorts within it. Maybe the original is somewhere within it.
translation: Evet, evet! Umarim öyledir. Bu tür bir tapinakta bir tür kütüphane olmasini beklerdim. Belki orijinali icinde bir yerdedir.

english: I'll have a look for it. Thanks for your help!
Oh, very interesting. This page appears to be taken from a religious script which speaks of Ralos.
translation: Oh, cok ilginc. Bu sayfa, Ralos'tan bahseden dini bir metinden alinmis gibi görünüyor.

english: Oh, very interesting. This page appears to be taken from a historical script about the temple itself.
translation: Oh, cok ilginc. Bu sayfa, tapinagin kendisiyle ilgili tarihi bir metinden alinmis gibi görünüyor.

english: This is very sad. To see such information desecrated in this way.
translation: Bu cok üzücü. Böyle bilgilerin bu sekilde kutsalligina saygisizlik edilmesi.

english: No! Keep that away from me! I can sense an ominous power coming from that coin. Where did you find it?
translation: Hayir! Onu benden uzak tut! O madeni paradan kötü bir güc geldigini hissediyorum. Onu nerede buldun?

english: A fellow adventurer I met within the temple had it on him. What should I do with it?
translation: Tapinakta tanistigim bir maceraci arkadasimda buldum. Onunla ne yapmaliyim?

english: I'd find out where it came from and put it back immediately.
translation: Onun nereden geldigini bulup hemen geri koyardim.

english: The markings on it resemble that of the cult of Ranul, I'd look around for something of religious significance to them.
translation: Üzerindeki isaretler Ranul kültünün isaretlerine benziyor, onlara dini önemi olan bir sey arardim.

english: Fascinating. I'm not quite sure what this is for, perhaps there are doors within the temple which this unlocks?
translation: Cok ilginc. Bunun ne ise yaradigini tam olarak bilmiyorum, belki tapinakta bu madeni parayla acilan kapilar vardir?

english: Amazing! This is exactly what I was looking for. This tome contains information about the religion of Ranul.
translation: Harika! Tam da aradigim sey bu. Bu kitap Ranul dinine dair bilgiler iceriyor.

english: Oh, it appears that there are some pages missing from it. The missing information could prove valuable.
translation: Oh, görünüse göre bazi sayfalar eksik. Eksik bilgiler cok degerli olabilir.

english: Where do you think the missing pages are?
This Temple has been abandoned for some time. Maybe the creatures within have destroyed the tome while looking for food. You may have to kill them to recover the pages.
translation: Bu tapinak bir süredir terk edilmis durumda. Belki de icindeki yaratiklar yiyecek ararken kitabi tahrip etmislerdir. Sayfalari geri almak icin onlari öldürmen gerekebilir.

english: The book seems to be intact! I'm sure Logosia in the Arceuus Library to the north would find this information valuable.
translation: Kitap saglam görünüyor! Kuzeydeki Arceuus Kütüphanesi'ndeki Logosia bu bilgileri degerli bulacaktir.

english: Amazing! This is exactly what I was looking for. This tome contains information about the religion of Ralos.
translation: Harika! Tam da aradigim sey bu. Bu kitap Ralos dini hakkinda bilgiler iceriyor.

english: Amazing! This is exactly what I was looking for. This tome contains information about the temple itself.
translation: Harika! Tam da aradigim sey bu. Bu kitap tapinak hakkinda bilgiler iceriyor.

english: I'm afraid I don't know anything about that item.
translation: Maalesef bu konu hakkinda hicbir sey bilmiyorum.

english: What is this place?
Who are you?
How did you get injured?
Ask about the cursed altar.
Ask about the Temple Key
I'm fine, thanks.
Very nice rosebushes you have here.
Yes, it has taken me many long hours in this garden to bring them to this state of near-perfection.
translation: Evet, onlari bu mükemmellige ulastirmak icin bu bahcede uzun saatler harcadim.

english: Good day, brother.
Hello, I'm Brother Brace. I'm here to tell you all about Prayer.
translation: Merhaba, ben Kardes Brace. Size Dua hakkinda her seyi anlatmak icin buradayim.

english: You should open the indicated menu to continue.
translation: Devam etmek icin belirtilen menüyü acmalisiniz.

english: This is your Prayer list. Prayers can help a lot in combat. Click on the prayer you wish to use to activate it, and click it again to deactivate it.
translation: Bu sizin Dua listeniz. Dualar savasta cok yardimci olabilir. Kullanmak istediginiz duayi tiklayarak etkinlestirin ve tekrar tiklayarak devre disi birakin.

english: Active prayers will drain your Prayer Points, which you can recharge by finding an altar or other holy spot and praying there.
translation: Etkin dualar Dua Puanlarinizi tüketir, bunlari bir sunak veya baska bir kutsal yer bulup orada dua ederek yeniden doldurabilirsiniz.

english: As you noticed, most enemies will drop bones when defeated. Burying bones, by clicking them in your inventory, will gain you Prayer experience.
translation: Fark ettiginiz gibi, cogu düsman yenildiginde kemikler düsürür. Envanterinizde kemiklere tiklayarak onlari gömerseniz, Dua deneyimi kazanirsiniz.

english: I'm also the community officer 'round here, so it's my job to tell you about your friends and ignore lists.
translation: Ben ayni zamanda buradaki topluluk sorumlusuyum, bu yüzden size arkadaslariniz ve engelleme listeleriniz hakkinda bilgi vermek benim görevim.

english: Right. Now I'll tell you a little about each list. You can add people to either list by clicking the add button then typing their name into the box that appears.
translation: Tamam. Simdi size her liste hakkinda biraz bilgi verecegim. Ekle dügmesine tiklayip acilan kutuya isimlerini yazarak her iki listeye de kisi ekleyebilirsiniz.

english: You remove people from the lists in the same way. If you add someone to your ignore list they will not be able to talk to you or send any form of message to you.
translation: Ayni sekilde listelerden kisileri de kaldirabilirsiniz. Birini görmezden gelme listenize eklerseniz, o kisi sizinle konusamaz veya size herhangi bir mesaj gönderemez.

english: Your friends list shows the online status of your friends. Friends in red are offline, friends in green are online and on the same world and friends in yellow are online, but on a different world.
translation: Arkadas listeniz, arkadaslarinizin cevrimici durumunu gösterir. Kirmizi renkli arkadaslar cevrimdisi, yesil renkli arkadaslar cevrimici ve ayni dünyada, sari renkli arkadaslar ise cevrimici ama farkli bir dünyada.

english: Okay, thanks, I'll bear that in mind.
Peace be with you, my child. Can I help you?
translation: Huzur seninle olsun, evladim. Yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: Ah, yes, your prayer list. Prayers can help a lot in combat. Click on the prayer you wish to use to activate it, and click it again to deactivate it.
translation: Ah, evet, dua listen. Dualar savasta cok yardimci olabilir. Kullanmak istedigin duayi tiklayarak etkinlestir ve tekrar tiklayarak devre disi birak.

english: Do you need anything else?
translation: Baska bir seye ihtiyacin var mi?

english: Your friends and ignore lists, yes... I'll tell you a little about each. You can add people to either list by clicking the add button then typing their name into the box that appears.
translation: Arkadas ve engelleme listeleri, evet... Her biri hakkinda biraz bilgi vereyim. Ekle dügmesine tiklayip acilan kutuya isimlerini yazarak her iki listeye de kisi ekleyebilirsin.

english: Nope, I'm ready to move on!
Okay then.
Tell me about Prayers again.
Tell me about my friends list again.
Nope, I'm ready to move on!
Hello.
Honey, money, woman and wine!
Are you ok?
Yesshh...hic up...beautiful!
Take care old monk.
La..di..da..hic..up!
Brother Cedric are you okay?
Yeesshhh, I'm very, very drunk..hic..up..
Brother Omad needs the wine for the party.
translation: Omad kardes partide saraba ihtiyac duyuyor.

english: Oh dear, oh dear, I knew I had to do something!
translation: Oh hayir, oh hayir, bir seyler yapmam gerektigini biliyordum!

english: Are you okay?
Hic up! Oh my head! I need a jug of water.
translation: Hickirik! Ah, basim! Bir sürahi su lazim.

english: I'll see if I can get some.
Thanks! *hic*
Cedric! Here, drink! I have some water.
translation: Cedric! Al, ic! Biraz su buldum.

english: Good stuff, my head's spinning!
Aah! That's better!
Now I just need to fix this cart and we can go party.
translation: Simdi bu arabayi tamir etmem lazim, sonra partiye gidebiliriz.

english: Could you help?
No, I've helped enough monks today!
translation: Hayir, bugün yeterince kesise yardim ettim!

english: In that case i'd better drink more wine! It helps me think.
translation: O zaman daha fazla sarap icsem iyi olur! Düsünmeme yardimci oluyor.

english: Yes, I'd be happy to!
Excellent, I just need some wood.
OK, I'll see what I can find.
Did you manage to get some wood?
Not yet, I'm afraid.
Here you go!
Well done! Now I'll fix this cart. You head back to Brother Omad and tell him I'll be there soon.
translation: Aferin! Simdi bu arabayi tamir edecegim. Sen Omad Kardes'e dön ve ona yakinda gelecegimi söyle.

english: Ok! I'll see you later!
Hello Cedric.
Hi, I'm almost done here. Could you tell Omad that I'll be back soon?
translation: Merhaba, burada isim neredeyse bitti. Omad'a yakinda dönecegimi söyler misin?

english: Brother Omad sends you his thanks! He won't be in a fit state to thank you in person.
translation: Omad kardes sana tesekkürlerini gönderdi! Kendisi sana sahsen tesekkür edecek durumda degil.

english: No, I've helped enough monks today!
translation: Hayir, bugün yeterince kesise yardim ettim!

english: Yes, I'd be happy to!
What can you do to help a bold adventurer like myself?
translation: Benim gibi cesur bir maceraciya nasil yardim edebilirsin?

english: I can tell you about holy symbols or the Skillcape of Prayer.
translation: Kutsal semboller veya Dua Beceri Pelerini hakkinda bilgi verebilirim.

english: Tell me about holy symbols.
If you have a silver star, which is the holy symbol of Saradomin, then I can bless it. Then if you are wearing it, it will help you when you are praying.
translation: Saradomin'in kutsal sembolü olan gümüs yildiziniz varsa, onu kutsayabilirim. Onu takarsaniz, dua ederken size yardimci olacaktir.

english: Tell me about the Skillcape of Prayer.
translation: Dua Beceri Pelerini hakkinda bilgi verin.

english: The Skillcape of Prayer is the hardest of all the skillcapes to get; it requires much devotion to acquire but also imbues the wearer with the ability to briefly fly!
translation: Dua Beceri Pelerini, tüm beceri pelerinleri arasinda elde edilmesi en zor olanidir; onu elde etmek icin cok fazla adanmislik gerekir, ancak onu takan kisiye kisa süreligine ucma yetenegi de kazandirir!

english: The Cape of Prayer also increases the amount of Prayer points restored from drinking potions when it is equipped. Is there something else I can do for you?
translation: Dua Pelerini, takildiginda iksir icerek geri kazanilan Dua puanlarinin miktarini da artirir. Sizin icin yapabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: No thank you.
Well I can bless that star of Saradomin you have, or I could tell you about the Skillcape of Prayer!
translation: Saradomin'in yildizini kutsayabilirim ya da Dua Beceri Pelerini hakkinda bilgi verebilirim!

english: Yes please.
You give Jered the symbol. Jered closes his eyes and places his hand on the symbol. He softly chants. Jered passes you the holy symbol.
translation: Jered'e sembolü verirsiniz. Jered gözlerini kapatir ve elini sembolün üzerine koyar. Yumusak bir sekilde ilahi söyler. Jered size kutsal sembolü verir.

english: Well, seeing as you are so devout in praising the gods, I could sell you a Skillcape of Prayer, which increases the amount of Prayer points restored when drinking potions.
translation: Tanrilara bu kadar bagli oldugunuzu görünce, iksir icildiginde geri kazanilan Dua puanlarini artiran Dua Beceri Pelerini satabilirim.

english: Yes, please. So few people have Skillcapes of Prayer!
translation: Evet, lütfen. Dua Beceri Pelerini olan cok az kisi var!

english: One as pious as you has certainly earned the right to wear one, but the monastery requires a donation of 99000 coins for the privilege.
translation: Senin kadar dindar biri kesinlikle onu takmaya hak kazanmistir, ama manastir bu ayricalik icin 99.000 sikke bagis talep ediyor.

english: No thanks, I can't afford one of those.
I am sorry to hear that. If you should find yourself in wealthier times come back and see me.
translation: Bunu duyduguma üzüldüm. Daha zengin oldugunda tekrar gelip beni gör.

english: I am always happy to contribute towards the monastery's upkeep.
translation: Manastirin bakimina katkida bulunmaktan her zaman mutluluk duyarim.

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: Ama maalesef su anda yeterince param yok.

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.
translation: Peki, paran oldugunda tekrar gelip beni gör.

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: Maalesef tüm Skillcapes sadece ücretsiz bir baslik ile satiliyor, bu bir beceri tanitim kampanyasinin parcasi; bir alana bir bedava, bilirsin. Yani sana bir tane satabilmem icin önce envanterinde yer acman gerekiyor.

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: Harika! O pelerini gururla giy dostum.

english: Praise be to Saradomin!
Yes! Praise he who brings life to this world.
translation: Evet! Bu dünyaya hayat veren kisiye sükürler olsun.

english: I'm here to help with Oziach!
translation: Oziach konusunda yardim etmek icin buradayim!

english: That is great, thank you! Speak to me downstairs in my office though, I don't have the paperwork up here.
translation: Harika, tesekkürler! Ama asagidaki ofisimde konusalim, burada evraklarim yok.

english: Hi Brother Jered!
I hear Oziach has been scared, thank you! And thank your friend too.
translation: Oziach'in korktugunu duydum, tesekkürler! Arkadasina da tesekkür et.

english: Iffie? She helped a lot, I need to go and give her the reward I promised.
translation: Iffie mi? Cok yardimci oldu, gidip ona söz verdigim ödülü vermem lazim.

english: You better go and do that then, thanks again!
translation: O zaman git ve bunu yap, tekrar tesekkürler!

english: Hey Brother Jered!
Iffie had something she wanted to give you, you should talk to her.
translation: Iffie sana vermek istedigi bir sey var, onunla konusmalisin.

english: I will do that right away!
What can you do to help a bold adventurer like myself?
translation: Benim gibi cesur bir maceraciya nasil yardim edebilirsin?

english: Tell me about holy symbols.
Tell me about the Skillcape of Prayer.
translation: Dua Beceri Pelerini hakkinda bilgi ver.

english: Yes, what else can you do for a bold adventurer like myself?
translation: Evet, benim gibi cesur bir maceraciya baska ne yapabilirsin?

english: No, thank you.
Bless star, please.
None of those, thanks.
Yes, please. So few people have Skillcapes of Prayer!
translation: Evet, lütfen. Dua Beceri Örtüsü'ne sahip cok az kisi var!

english: I'm afraid I can't afford that.
I am always happy to contribute towards the monastery's upkeep.
translation: Manastirin bakimina katkida bulunmaktan her zaman mutluluk duyarim.

english: No thanks, I can't afford one of those.
Praise be to Saradomin!
Talk about the Halloween event.
Hello Brother Jered, the monks in Varrock sent me. What is going on?
translation: Merhaba Jered Kardes, Varrock'taki rahipler beni gönderdi. Neler oluyor?

english: Thank Saradomin that you came! We need help! Oziach is trying to buy the monastery!
translation: Geldigin icin Saradomin'e sükürler olsun! Yardima ihtiyacimiz var! Oziach manastiri satin almaya calisiyor!

english: What can I do to help?
We've tried everything, there is nothing!
translation: Her seyi denedik, hicbir sey ise yaramadi!

english: Unless...
Are you any good at climbing trees?
Pretty good, why?
Oziach is scared of ghosts! If you can climb a tree and make a scary noise, that might scare him off!
translation: Oziach hayaletlerden korkar! Agac tirmanip korkutucu sesler cikarirsan, onu korkutup kacirabilirsin!

english: I see, I can give that a go! What should I make the scary noise with?
translation: Anladim, deneyebilirim! Korkutucu sesleri neyle cikarayim?

english: How about one of these wine bottles? I have loads!
translation: Bu sarap siselerinden biriyle nasil olur? Bir sürü var!

english: I'm sure there's a perfectly sane explanation why.
translation: Bunun icin mantikli bir aciklamasi olduguna eminim.

english: I might have looked for a solution in them... And I found one, too!
translation: Onlarda bir cözüm aramis olabilirim... Ve bir tane de buldum!

english: Take this wine bottle and climb the tree nearest Oziach, then blow on it to scare him!
translation: Bu sarap sisesini al ve Oziach'a en yakin agaca tirman, sonra onu korkutmak icin siseye üfle!

english: Brother Jered now has said to take the wine bottle.
translation: Kardes Jered simdi sarap sisesini almami söyledi.

english: Not a lot from down here, sorry, I'm currently dealing with this mess! Come and see me upstairs and I can assist you with your question there.
translation: Buradan pek bir sey görünmüyor, üzgünüm, su anda bu karisiklikla ugrasiyorum! Yukariya gelip beni gör, orada soruna yardimci olabilirim.

english: I've lost the bottle, can I have another one please?
translation: Siseyi kaybettim, baska bir tane alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: You don't have any space for the bottle! Talk to me again once you have space.
translation: Sise icin yerin yok! Yer acildiginda tekrar konusalim.

english: There you go. You can blow into the top to make a spooky sound.
translation: Al bakalim. Üstüne üfleyerek ürkütücü bir ses cikarabilirsin.

english: Brother Jered now remembers the player has received his bottle at least once.
translation: Kardes Jered, oyuncunun en az bir kez siseyi aldigini hatirladi.

english: If you're hiding up a tree when you do it, it should fool Oziach into thinking it's a ghost!
translation: Bunu yaparken bir agacin tepesinde saklanirsan, Oziach'i bunun bir hayalet oldugunu düsünmesine neden olursun!

english: Would you like to try that now?
There you go, try not to lose this one!
Would you like to try and scare Oziach now?
Brother Jered!
Hi [player name].
Could I have another wine bottle? I dropped the other one.
translation: Baska bir sarap sisesi alabilir miyim? Digerini düsürdüm.

english: Sure, I have plenty.
Yes, let's scare Oziach!
Be careful, make sure you don't get too close to him, or take too long, he'll be sure to spot you!
translation: Dikkatli ol, ona cok yaklasma ya da cok uzun sürmesin, yoksa seni fark eder!

english: Good luck!
The camera fades to a cutscene.
Not just yet.
Okay, come back and talk to me when you're ready to try scaring Oziach!
translation: Tamam, Oziach'i korkutmaya hazir oldugunda geri gel ve benimle konus!

english: It didn't work!
Scaring Oziach? He wasn't scared?
No! He said one ghost wasn't enough! But I have a plan...
translation: Hayir! Bir hayalet yetmezmis! Ama bir planim var...

english: A plan?
Yes! ONE ghost wasn't enough. We need more than one ghost. We need TWO ghosts!
translation: Evet! Bir hayalet yetmez. Birden fazla hayalet lazim. Iki hayalet lazim!

english: Will you be my accomplice and be the second ghost?
translation: Benim suc ortagim olup ikinci hayalet olur musun?

english: I would, but I don't feel too well from all the stress.
translation: Olurdum ama stres yüzünden kendimi pek iyi hissetmiyorum.

english: Are you sure it's not all the wine and food?
translation: Sarap ve yemekten kaynaklanmadigindan emin misin?

english: What?
Nothing! That's okay, I hope you feel better soon!
translation: Hicbir sey! Sorun degil, umarim yakinda iyilesirsin!

english: I need to find an accomplice elsewhere, then. Do you have any ideas?
translation: O zaman baska bir suc ortagi bulmam gerek. Bir fikrin var mi?

english: The price to place an advert is 500,000 coins. I've always had good responses to my ads in the past.
translation: Ilan vermek icin 500.000 sikke gerekiyor. Gecmiste ilanlarima her zaman iyi tepkiler aldim.

english: 500,000 coins? That is quite a lot!
Ah yes, don't worry about that. I have this pre-paid ad coupon you can use.
translation: Evet, merak etme. Kullanabilecegin ön ödemeli reklam kuponum var.

english: I bought an ad spot in the paper the other week. I was going to place an ad for recruiting some new monks.
translation: Gecen hafta gazetede reklam yeri satin aldim. Yeni rahipler almak icin ilan verecektim.

english: However with everything going on right now, I think this is more important.
translation: Ancak su anda olan biten her seyden dolayi, bunun daha önemli oldugunu düsünüyorum.

english: You don't have any space for the coupon! Talk to me again once you have space.
translation: Kupon icin yerin yok! Yer acildiginda tekrar konusalim.

english: There's now a coupon waiting for the player.
translation: Artik oyuncu icin bir kupon var.

english: Here you go.
The player can now talk to Benny about the Halloween event.
translation: Oyuncu artik Benny ile Cadilar Bayrami etkinligi hakkinda konusabilir.

english: Thank you! You had me worried there that I was going to have to find 500,000 coins. I'll go and place the advert.
translation: Tesekkürler! 500.000 altin bulmam gerekecek diye endiselendim. Gidip ilani verecegim.

english: Good luck, I hope you find a good accomplice!
translation: Iyi sanslar, umarim iyi bir yardimci bulursun!

english: I've lost the coupon, can I have another one please?
translation: Kuponu kaybettim, bir tane daha alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: Have you placed the advert in the Varrock Herald yet?
Not yet.
Don't wait too long, the purchase will go through soon!
translation: Cok bekleme, satin alma islemi yakinda gerceklesecek!

english: You can find Benny in the Varrock Square. You should talk to him about the ad.
translation: Benny'yi Varrock Meydani'nda bulabilirsin. Ilan hakkinda onunla konusmalisin.

english: I'll go and do that now!
Could I have another coupon before I go? I lost the other one.
translation: Gitmeden önce baska bir kupon alabilir miyim? Digerini kaybettim.

english: You don't need a coupon anymore!
Here is a copy of it. I made it before I gave you the original, try not to lose this!
translation: Iste bir kopyasi. Sana orijinalini vermeden önce yaptim, bunu kaybetmemeye calis!

english: How is it going?
Well thanks, I've just placed the advert in the Herald.
translation: Tesekkürler, az önce Herald'a ilani verdim.

english: Lovely! Where are you meeting the candidates?
At the Blue Moon Inn, I'm going to head there now.
translation: Blue Moon Inn'de, simdi oraya gidiyorum.

english: Hello [player name]. I thank you for helping us, we've been running out of ideas!
translation: Merhaba Maceraci. Bize yardim ettigin icin tesekkürler, fikirlerimiz tükenmisti!

english: Hello! I saw an old lady sneaking around in the trees south of the monastery, that wouldn't be anything to do with you, would it?
translation: Merhaba! Manastirin güneyindeki agaclarin arasinda gizlice dolasan yasli bir kadin gördüm, seninle bir ilgisi yok, degil mi?

english: That sounds like Iffie, she is my accomplice! I'd be careful calling her an old lady!
translation: Iffie'ye benziyor, o benim suc ortagim! Ona yasli kadin demek icin dikkatli ol!

english: You found somebody! Great, good luck!
I'll make sure not to say that to her face if we meet!
translation: Eger karsilasirsak, bunu onun yüzüne söylemeyecegim!

english: Hello there!
Hello, Brother Jered!
Hello! I was just passing by and saw you both in here.
translation: Merhaba! Tam buradan geciyordum ve ikinizi burada gördüm.

english: I'd like to thank you Iffie, and you [player name]. You both saved the monastery.
translation: Iffie ve Maceraci'ya tesekkür etmek istiyorum. Ikiniz de manastiri kurtardiniz.

english: That means more than you can imagine!
translation: Bu, tahmin edebileceginizden cok daha önemli!

english: It was really no problem, if anything, it was rather fun!
translation: Hic sorun degildi, aksine oldukca eglenceliydi!

english: Yes, very fun! I haven't had such an adventure in years!
translation: Evet, cok eglenceliydi! Yillardir böyle bir macera yasamamistim!

english: Well, I am glad you both enjoyed it! I do have something for you, [player name]...
translation: Ikinizin de eglendiginize sevindim! Sana bir seyim var, Maceraci...

english: It's not a reward as such, but it is interesting. I've been tidying up my office since I don't need it anymore.
translation: Bu bir ödül sayilmaz, ama ilginc bir sey. Artik ihtiyacim olmadigi icin ofisimi düzenliyordum.

english: And in doing so, I found this old bottle.
translation: Ve bunu yaparken bu eski siseyi buldum.

english: Is that... a ghost, inside? It's haunted?!
translation: Icinde... bir hayalet mi var? Perili mi?!

english: Yes! There is a ghost inside, it's trapped! Would have been handy to have earlier on, really. Would have been very scary for Oziach!
translation: Evet! Icinde bir hayalet var, hapsolmus! Daha önce olsaydi cok isime yarardi, gercekten. Oziach icin cok korkutucu olurdu!

english: But the monastery is saved, so I don't need it anymore. I'd like you to have it!
translation: Ama manastir kurtarildi, artik buna ihtiyacim yok. Sana vermek istiyorum!

english: Thank you. What do I do with it?
Not a lot really. I did shake it earlier and the ghost got pretty angry with me, so I'd probably avoid doing that too much.
translation: Aslinda pek bir sey yapamazsin. Az önce salladim ve hayalet bana cok kizdi, o yüzden bunu cok fazla yapmamak daha iyi olur.

english: It does seem quite chatty for a ghost, although it doesn't always make sense.
translation: Bir hayalet icin oldukca konuskan görünüyor, ama her zaman mantikli konusmuyor.

english: There you go. Now I'll be off, I've got a monastery to look after!
translation: Al bakalim. Simdi gidiyorum, bakmam gereken bir manastir var!

english: See you later Brother Jered!
Ask for another bottle.
Yes, let's scare Oziach!
Not just yet.
Talk about something else.
Ask for another ad coupon.
Hello monk.
Hello adventurer. My name is Brother Kojo. Do you happen to know the time?
translation: Merhaba maceraci. Benim adim Kojo Kardes. Saat kac biliyor musun?

english: No, sorry, I don't.
Exactly! This clock tower has recently broken down, and without it nobody can tell the correct time. I must fix it before the town people become too angry!
translation: Aynen öyle! Bu saat kulesi kisa süre önce bozuldu ve onsuz kimse dogru saati bilemiyor. Kasaba halki cok kizmadan onu tamir etmeliyim!

english: I don't suppose you could assist me in the repairs? I'll pay you for your help.
translation: Tamirde bana yardim edebilir misin? Yardimin icin sana ödeme yapacagim.

english: OK old monk, what can I do?
Oh, thank you kind [sir/madam]! In the cellar below, you'll find four cogs. They're too heavy for me, but you should be able to carry them one at a time.
translation: Oh, tesekkürler nazik ! Asagidaki mahzende dört disli bulacaksin. Onlar benim icin cok agir ama sen tek tek tasiyabilirsin.

english: I know one goes on each floor... but I can't exactly remember which goes where specifically. Oh well, I'm sure you can figure it out fairly easily.
translation: Her kata bir tane gittigini biliyorum... ama hangisinin nereye gittigini tam olarak hatirlayamiyorum. Oh, neyse, eminim sen kolayca anlayabilirsin.

english: Well, I'll do my best.
Thank you again! And remember to be careful, the cellar is full of strange beasts!
translation: Tekrar tesekkürler! Dikkatli ol, mahzen tuhaf yaratiklarla dolu!

english: Not now old monk.
OK then. Come back and let me know if you change your mind.
translation: Tamam o zaman. Fikrini degistirirsen geri gel ve bana haber ver.

english: Hello again.
Oh hello, are you having trouble? The cogs are in four rooms below us. Place one cog on a pole on each of the four tower levels.
translation: Merhaba, bir sorun mu var? Disliler altimizdaki dört odada. Dört kule katinin her birindeki direge bir disli yerlestir.

english: Right, gotcha. I'll do that then.
I've placed a cog!
That's great. Come see me when you've done the other three.
translation: Harika. Diger ücünü de yerlestirdiginde bana gel.

english: Two down!
Two to go.
One left.
I have replaced all the cogs!
Really..? Wait, listen! Well done, well done! Yes yes yes, you've done it! You ARE clever!
translation: Gercekten mi? Bekle, dinle! Aferin, aferin! Evet, evet, evet, basardin! Sen zekisin!

english: The townsfolk will all be able to know the correct time now! Thank you so much for all of your help! And as promised, here is your reward!
translation: Artik kasaba halki dogru saati ögrenebilecek! Yardimlariniz icin cok tesekkür ederim! Ve söz verdigim gibi, iste ödülün!

english: Congratulations! Quest complete!
Hello again Brother Kojo.
Oh hello there traveller. You've done a grand job with the clock. It's just like new.
translation: Merhaba gezgin. Saatle harika bir is cikarmissin. Sanki yeni gibi.

english: Hello.
Hello, traveller, how can I help?
I'm trying to learn how to be a navigator.
I don't know if I can help you there.
translation: Sana bu konuda yardimci olabilir miyim bilmiyorum.

english: The professor from the Observatory says that I need a watch.
translation: Gözlemevindeki profesör bir saate ihtiyacim oldugunu söylüyor.

english: Ah, that I can help you with. I've been tinkering with this new idea of a watch and made a few. The problem is the villagers don't see the point as they have the Clock Tower!
translation: Ah, bu konuda sana yardimci olabilirim. Yeni bir saat fikri üzerinde calisiyorum ve birkac tane yaptim. Sorun su ki, köylüler saat kulesi varken bunun ne anlami oldugunu anlamiyorlar!

english: Can I have one?
You can have this one! It's the display model.
translation: Bunu alabilirsin! Bu bir teshir modeli.

english: Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to answer this for me.
Please enter the answer to the question.
How can that be? Go check again!
translation: Bu nasil olabilir? Tekrar kontrol et!

english: You really clocked that one!
Yes.
No.
Hello there, What's wrong?
*yawn*...oh, hello...*yawn* I'm sorry! I'm just so tired! I haven't slept in a week!
translation: *esnemek*... oh, merhaba... *esnemek* Üzgünüm! Cok yorgunum! Bir haftadir uyumadim!

english: Why can't you sleep, what's wrong?
It's brother Androe's son! With his constant: Waaaaaah! Waaaaaaaaah! Androe said it's natural, but it's so annoying!
translation: Androe kardesimin oglu! Sürekli: Waaaaaah! Waaaaaaaaah! Androe bunun dogal oldugunu söylüyor ama cok sinir bozucu!

english: I suppose that's what kids do.
He was fine, up until last week! Thieves broke in! They stole his favourite sleeping blanket!
translation: Gecen haftaya kadar iyiydi! Hirsizlar eve girdi! En sevdigi uyku battaniyesini caldilar!

english: Now he won't rest until it's returned... ...and that means neither can I!
translation: Simdi battaniye geri gelene kadar uyumayacak... ...bu da benim de uyuyamayacagim anlamina geliyor!

english: Can I help at all?
Please do. We won't be able to help you as we are peaceful men but we would be grateful for your help!
translation: Lütfen edin. Biz bariscil insanlariz, size yardim edemeyiz ama yardiminiz icin minnettar oluruz!

english: Where are they?
They hide in a secret cave in the forest. It's hidden under a ring of stones. Please, bring back the blanket!
translation: Ormanin icindeki gizli bir magarada saklaniyorlar. Taslardan olusan bir halkanin altinda gizlenmis. Lütfen battaniyeyi geri getirin!

english: I'm sorry to hear that! I hope you find his blanket.
translation: Bunu duyduguma üzüldüm! Umarim battaniyeyi bulursunuz.

english: Sorry! I'm too busy to hear your problems!
Hello.
*yawn*...oh, hello again...*yawn*
Please tell me you have the blanket.
I'm afraid not.
I need some sleep!
Yes! I've recovered it from the clutches of the evil thieves!
translation: Evet! Onu kötü hirsizlarin elinden kurtardim!

english: Really, that's excellent, well done! Maybe now I will be able to get some rest.
translation: Gercekten mi, bu harika, aferin! Belki simdi biraz dinlenebilirim.

english: *yawn*..I'm off to bed! Farewell brave traveller!
Hello, how are you?
Much better now I'm sleeping well! Now I can organise the party.
translation: Artik iyi uyudugum icin cok daha iyiyim! Artik partiyi düzenleyebilirim.

english: Ooh! What party?
The son of Brother Androe's birthday party. He's going to be one year old!
translation: Androe Kardes'in oglunun dogum günü partisi. Bir yasina girecek!

english: That's sweet!
It's also a great excuse for a drink!
translation: Ayni zamanda icki icmek icin de harika bir bahane!

english: We just need Brother Cedric to return with the wine.
translation: Sadece Kardes Cedric'in sarapla dönmesi gerekiyor.

english: Who's Brother Cedric?
Cedric is a member of the order too. We sent him out three days ago to collect wine. But he didn't return!
translation: Cedric de tarikatin bir üyesi. Üc gün önce sarap almaya gönderdik. Ama dönmedi!

english: He most probably got drunk and lost in the forest!
I've no time for that, sorry.
Okay traveller, take care.
Where should I look?
Oh, he won't be far. Probably out in the forest.
translation: Oh, cok uzaklarda olamaz. Muhtemelen ormanda bir yerlerde.

english: Ok, I'll go and find him.
Can I come to the party?
Of course, but we need the wine first.
translation: Tabii ki, ama önce saraba ihtiyacimiz var.

english: Enjoy it! I'll see you soon!
Take care traveller.
Hello brother Omad.
Hello adventurer, have you found Brother Cedric?
translation: Merhaba maceraci, Cedric kardesini buldun mu?

english: Not yet.
Well, keep looking, we need that wine!
translation: Aramaya devam et, saraba ihtiyacimiz var!

english: Hi Omad, Brother Cedric is on his way!
Good! Good! Now we can party!
I have little to repay you with but please! Take these Rune Stones.
translation: Sana borcumu ödeyemem ama lütfen! Bu Rune Taslarini al.

english: Thanks Brother Omad!
OK, let's party!
Party!
Woop!
Yeah!
Let's boogie!
Oh baby!
GO!
Get down!
Feel the rhythm!
Dance!
Oh my!
Watch me go!
You go!
Dum dee do la la! *hiccup* That was some party!
translation: Dum dee do la la! *hickirik* Ne partiydi ama!

english: Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to answer this for me.
Brother Omad has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Omad kardes sana bir meydan okuma parsömeni verdi!

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
How can that be? Go check again!
translation: Bu nasil olabilir? Tekrar kontrol et!

english: Spot on!
Why can't you sleep, what's wrong?
Can I help at all?
I'm sorry to hear that! I hope you find his blanket.
translation: Bunu duyduguma üzüldüm! Umarim battaniyesini bulursun.

english: Sorry! I'm too busy to hear your problems!
Who's Brother Cedric?
I've no time for that, sorry.
Where should I look?
Can I come to the party?
Enjoy it! I'll see you soon!
How's your head feeling?
A lot better, thanks. Can I help you with anything?
translation: Cok daha iyi, tesekkürler. Yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: This washed up on the beach earlier. I thought you could get it fixed by Smithing Smith in Mos Le'Harmless. It could be valuable.
translation: Bu daha önce sahile vurmus. Mos Le'Harmless'daki Smithing Smith'e götürürsen tamir ettirebilirsin diye düsündüm. Degerli olabilir.

english: Thanks.
Not really. I was just popping by to see how you were all getting on and possibly help cull some of the zombies.
translation: Aslinda hayir. Sadece nasil oldugunuzu görmek ve belki zombileri öldürmeye yardim etmek icin ugramistim.

english: Your concern is most gratifying. Saradomin be with you.
translation: Ilginiz cok memnuniyet verici. Saradomin sizinle olsun.

english: Would you like me to take you to Harmony?
Yes, please.
The player is teleported to Harmony Island.
Not at the moment, thanks.
Do you want me to take you back to Mos Le'Harmless?
translation: Seni Mos Le'Harmless'a geri götürmemi ister misin?

english: The player is teleported to Mos Le'Harmless.
Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to answer this for me.
Please enter the answer to the question.
How can that be? Go check again!
translation: Bu nasil olabilir? Tekrar kontrol et!

english: Spot on!
Yes, please.
Not at the moment, thanks.
I'm too important to talk to the likes of you, leave.
translation: Senin gibilerle konusmak icin cok önemliyim, git buradan.

english: My secretary will deal with any inquiries you have about the Brown Engine.
translation: Brown Engine ile ilgili tüm sorularini sekreterim cevaplayacaktir.

english: My secretary is sitting just over there, thank you.
I'm busy, please leave.
Today is not a good day, can you come back tomorrow?
translation: Bugün iyi bir gün degil, yarin tekrar gelebilir misin?

english: If you're looking for the market, it's downstairs.
Do you mind? You're blocking my view.
How did you get in here? I don't have time to talk to you!
translation: Buraya nasil girdin? Seninle konusacak vaktim yok!

english: I can't help you, go and see my secretary.
translation: Sana yardim edemem, git sekreterime gör.

english: Talk to my secretary, I don't have time to deal with you.
translation: Sekreterimle konus, seninle ugrasacak vaktim yok.

english: But...
I said go!
I told you to leave, human!
Hello, and welcome to the Grand Exchange! How can I help you?
translation: Merhaba, Grand Exchange'e hos geldiniz! Nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: What is this place?
This is the Grand Exchange, the best trading spot in the land! People come from all across the country to buy and sell every item under the sun.
translation: Burasi Grand Exchange, ülkedeki en iyi ticaret merkezi! Insanlar ülkenin dört bir yanindan gelip, günesin altinda bulunan her seyi alip satiyorlar.

english: When you want to buy or sell an item, talk to the clerks in the middle. They'll tell you how to set up a trade offer.
translation: Bir sey almak veya satmak istediginde, ortadaki memurlarla konus. Sana ticaret teklifi yapmayi anlatacaklar.

english: Now, is there something I can do for you?
translation: Simdi, senin icin yapabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Can you tell me the price of an item?
What had you in mind?
Thank you.
I'm fine, thanks.
What is this place?
Can you tell me the price of an item?
I'm fine, thanks.
Greetings outerlander!
What is this place?
What is this place?
This place? Why, this is Rellekka! Homeland of all Fremennik! I do not recognise your face outerlander; Where do you come from?
translation: Burasi mi? Burasi Rellekka! Tüm Fremenniklerin vatani! Yüzünü tanimiyorum yabanci; nerelisin?

english: That's not important...
Hmmm... I will not press the issue then outerlander. How may my tribe and I help you?
translation: Hmmm... O zaman bu konuyu daha fazla kurcalamayacagim yabanci. Kabilem ve ben sana nasil yardimci olabiliriz?

english: Do you have any quests?
Quests, you say outerlander? Well, I would not call it a quest as such, but if you are brave of heart and strong of body, perhaps...
translation: Görev mi dedin yabanci? Sey, ben buna görev demezdim, ama eger cesur ve güclü birisin, belki...

english: No, you would not be interested. Forget I said anything, outerlander.
Actually, I would be very interested to hear what you have to offer.
translation: Aslinda, teklifini dinlemek cok ilgimi ceker.

english: You would? These are unusual sentiments to hear from an outerlander! My suggestion was going to be that if you crave adventure and battle,
translation: Öyle mi? Bir yabancidan böyle bir sey duymak alisilmadik bir durum! Benim önerim, maceraya ve savasa susamissan,

english: and your heart sings for glory, then perhaps you would be interested in joining our clan, and becoming a Fremennik yourself?
translation: ve kalbinde zafer icin sarkilar söylüyorsa, belki de klanimiza katilmak ve bir Fremennik olmak ilginizi cekebilir?

english: What would that involve exactly?
translation: Bu tam olarak ne anlama geliyor?

english: Well, there are two ways to become a member of our clan and call yourself a Fremennik: be born a Fremennik, or be voted in by our council of elders.
translation: Klanimizin üyesi olup Fremennik olmanin iki yolu var: Fremennik olarak dogmak ya da yaslilar konseyimiz tarafindan oylanmak.

english: Well, I think I've missed the first way, but how can I get the council of elders to vote to let me join your clan?
translation: Sanirim ilk yolu kacirdim, ama yaslilar konseyinin beni klaniniza kabul etmesi icin nasil oy alabilirim?

english: Well, that I cannot answer myself. You will need to speak to each of them and see what they require of you as proof of your dedication.
translation: Buna ben cevap veremem. Her biriyle konusup, bagliliginin kaniti olarak senden ne istediklerini ögrenmen gerekecek.

english: There are twelve council members around this village; you will need to gain a majority vote of at least seven councillors in your favour.
translation: Bu köyde on iki konsey üyesi var; en az yedi konsey üyesinin cogunluk oyunu alman gerekiyor.

english: So what say you? Give me the word, and I will tell all of my tribe of your intentions, be they yea or nay.
translation: Ne dersin? Kararini bana bildir, ben de tüm kabileme niyetini ileteyim, kabul etsinler ya da etmesinler.

english: I think I would enjoy the challenge of becoming an honorary Fremennik. Where and how do I start?
translation: Onursal Fremennik olmak icin bu zorlu görevi üstlenmek hosuma gider. Nereden ve nasil baslamaliyim?

english: As I say outerlander, you must find and speak to the twelve members of the council of elders, and see what tasks they might set you.
translation: Dedigim gibi yabanci, yaslilar konseyinin on iki üyesini bulup onlarla konusmali ve sana ne gibi görevler verebileceklerini ögrenmelisin.

english: If you can gain the support of seven of the twelve, then you will be accepted as one of us without question.
translation: On ikiden yedisinin destegini alabilirsen, hic sorgulanmadan aramiza kabul edilirsin.

english: No way do I want to become like YOU! Forget you, and forget your whole stupid town! You're a bunch of stupid primitives, from what I've seen!
translation: Senin gibi olmak istemiyorum! Seni ve aptal kasabayi unut! Gördügüm kadariyla siz aptal ilkel insanlarsiniz!

english: I am sorry to say that I expected such a response from an outerlander. I thought perhaps you might have been different to all the others...
translation: Bir yabancidan böyle bir tepki bekledigimi söylemekten üzüntü duyuyorum. Belki de digerlerinden farkli olursun diye düsünmüstüm...

english: You're right. I really couldn't care less.
It is as I thought outerlander. Your kind care nothing for the Fremennik, and we feel the same about you. This is the way of the world.
translation: Düsündügüm gibiymis, yabanci. Sizin gibiler Fremennik'leri umursamiyor, biz de sizi umursamiyoruz. Dünyanin kurali bu.

english: Why will no-one talk to me?
Do not take it personally, outerlander! We are a simple people, and it is our experience that keeping ourselves to ourselves is best. This is why speaking to outerlanders is forbidden.
translation: Kisisel algilama, yabanci! Biz basit insanlariz ve deneyimlerimiz bize kendimize saklanmanin en iyisi oldugunu ögretti. Bu yüzden yabancilarla konusmak yasaktir.

english: We do not wish to enter war with the outerlanders and their strange magics, so we limit all unauthorised communication.
translation: Yabancilarla ve onlarin garip büyüleriyle savasa girmek istemiyoruz, bu yüzden izinsiz iletisimi kisitliyoruz.

english: Then how come you're talking to me?
Ah, this is because I am the chieftain. I am the one who authorises contact. You will not find many of my tribe so forthcoming with you, as I.
translation: Ah, cünkü ben sefim. Iletisimi izin veren benim. Kabilemden benim kadar sana karsi acik olan pek kimse bulamazsin.

english: Is there a way for you to authorise your tribe to talk to me then?
translation: O zaman kabilene benimle konusma izni vermenin bir yolu var mi?

english: Well, there is one way... but I doubt it is of any interest to you.
translation: Sey, bir yol var... ama senin ilgini cekecegini sanmiyorum.

english: Yes.
No.
Why do you call me outerlander?
Do not take it as an insult, outerlander. For us, this town is the center of all. Anyone not born here, or that we do not know and trust is an outerlander.
translation: Bunu hakaret olarak alma, yabanci. Bizim icin bu kasaba her seyin merkezi. Burada dogmamis ya da tanimadigimiz ve güvenmedigimiz herkes yabancilar.

english: So it basically means stranger?
translation: Yani temel olarak “yabanci” anlamina mi geliyor?

english: Aye, but that is an outerlander word. We do not judge someones ways by their name. It simply means one from the outerlands, or one not from Rellekka.
translation: Evet, ama bu yabancilar kelimesidir. Biz birini ismine göre yargilamayiz. Sadece dis bölgelerden gelen ya da Rellekka'dan olmayan biri anlamina gelir.

english: I know our customs are foreign to you; perhaps you would like me to explain something else?
translation: Geleneklerimizin sana yabanci oldugunu biliyorum; belki baska bir sey aciklamami istersin?

english: (shows previous options)
I seek an army to destroy Asgarnia!
translation: Asgarnia'yi yok etmek icin bir ordu ariyorum!

english: We will have no part in the squabbles of outerlander tribes. Their magics are strange and deadly to us, as we learnt long ago.
translation: Yabanci kabilelerin kavgalarina karismayiz. Onlarin büyülerinin bize yabanci ve ölümcül oldugunu uzun zaman önce ögrendik.

english: If this is all that you came here for, then you have had a wasted journey. If you are looking for something else, then speak now for my patience dwindles.
translation: Buraya bunun icin geldiysen, bosuna yol gelmissin demektir. Baska bir sey ariyorsan, simdi söyle, cünkü sabrim tükeniyor.

english: Who are the Fremennik?
It is the name we call ourselves. Outerlanders tend to call us 'Barbarian', but they do not understand our ways...
translation: Kendimize verdigimiz isim budur. Yabancilar bize “barbar” derler, ama bizim geleneklerimizi anlamazlar...

english: Why will no-one talk to me?
(same as above)
Nice hat!
Do not mock me outerlander; this helm has saved my life more times than I care to recall right now.
translation: Benimle alay etme yabanci; bu migfer hayatimi sayisiz kez kurtardi.

english: I don't have any votes yet.
I only have 1 vote so far.
translation: Su ana kadar sadece 1 oyum var.

english: Hmmm... well that is certainly a good start I would say. Keep up the good work!
translation: Hmmm... Bence bu kesinlikle iyi bir baslangic. Böyle devam et!

english: (continues below)
I only have [X] votes so far.
Hmmm... you are doing very well so far, outerlander. Keep up the good work!
translation: Hmmm... Su ana kadar cok iyi gidiyorsun, yabancilar. Böyle devam et!

english: Remember: You need to get at least seven council votes to be accepted as a member of the Fremennik.
translation: Unutma: Fremennik'in üyesi olarak kabul edilmek icin en az yedi konsey oyu alman gerekiyor.

english: Go and speak to the twelve members of the council of elders who live in this village. I am sure at least a few will be prepared to vote for you.
translation: Git ve bu köyde yasayan on iki yasli konsey üyesiyle konus. Eminim en azindan birkaci sana oy vermeye hazir olacaktir.

english: If you need any help with your trials, I suggest you speak to Askeladden. He is currently doing his own trials of manhood to become a true Fremennik.
translation: Denemelerinde yardima ihtiyacin olursa, Askeladden ile konusmani öneririm. O da su anda gercek bir Fremennik olmak icin kendi erkeklik denemelerini yapiyor.

english: Greetings again outerlander! How goes your attempts to gain votes with the council of elders?
translation: Tekrar merhaba, yabanci! Yaslilar konseyinden oy almaya calisman nasil gidiyor?

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a guarantee of a reduction on sales taxes, do you?
translation: Satis vergilerinde indirim garantisi alabilecegim bir yer biliyor musun?

english: A reduction on sales taxes? Why, I am the only one in the Fremennik who may authorise such a thing. What does an outerlander want with that?
translation: Satis vergilerinde indirim mi? Fremennik'te böyle bir seyi onaylayabilecek tek kisi benim. Bir yabanci bununla ne yapmak istiyor?

english: Actually, it's not for me. I need to get it as part of my trials.
translation: Aslinda, bu benim icin degil. Denemelerimin bir parcasi olarak buna ihtiyacim var.

english: Hmmm. Interesting. Your trials seem to be very different to those I took as a young lad. Well, I am not adverse in principle to giving a slight tax break to our shops.
translation: Hmmm. Ilginc. Senin sinavlarin benim gencken girdigim sinavlardan cok farkli görünüyor. Sey, dükkanlarimiza kücük bir vergi indirimi yapilmasina prensipte karsi degilim.

english: There will of course be a shortfall in the tribe's income, that will need to be made up for elsewhere, however.
translation: Tabii ki kabilenin gelirinde bir eksiklik olacak, ancak bu eksiklik baska bir yerden telafi edilmelidir.

english: How about this. For many years Sigli has been the only one in the tribe who knows the locations of the best hunting grounds where game is easiest to catch.
translation: Suna ne dersin? Sigli, yillardir kabilede avlanmanin en kolay oldugu en iyi avlanma alanlarinin yerlerini bilen tek kisidir.

english: If you can persuade him to let the entire tribe know these hunting grounds, then we can increase productivity within the tribe, and any shortfall caused
translation: Onu, tüm kabileye bu avlanma alanlarini ögretmesi icin ikna edebilirsen, kabile icindeki üretkenligi artirabiliriz ve satis vergilerinin düsürülmesinden kaynaklanan eksiklik

english: by lowering sales taxes will be covered. I think this is a more than fair arrangement to make, don't you?
translation: karsilanabilir. Bence bu, adil bir anlasma, degil mi?

english: Yeah, that sounds very fair.
Speak to Sigli then, and you may have my promise to reduce our sales taxes. And best of luck with the rest of your trials.
translation: O zaman Sigli ile konus, satis vergilerini düsürecegime söz veriyorum. Denemelerinin geri kalaninda bol sans.

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a map to unspoiled hunting grounds, do you?
translation: Bozulmamis avlanma alanlarinin haritasini nerede bulabilecegimi biliyor musun?

english: Ah, outerlander... if you wish to become a Fremennik you should try and pay more attention to what people tell you...
translation: Ah, yabanci... Fremennik olmak istiyorsan, insanlarin sana söylediklerine daha fazla dikkat etmelisin...

english: Sigli the hunter is the only one who knows of such hunting grounds. Go and request his knowledge.
translation: Avci Sigli, bu avlanma alanlarini bilen tek kisidir. Gidip ondan bilgi iste.

english: Ask about the Merchant's trial
I got Sigli's hunting map for you.
So cutting sales tax isn't going to ruin your economy here or anything?
translation: Satis vergisini düsürmek buradaki ekonomiyi mahvetmeyecek mi?

english: Not at all outerlander; now that we have Sigli's map we can increase the amount of hunts we run, and make up any shortfall that way.
translation: Hic de degil yabanci; artik Sigli'nin haritasina sahip oldugumuza göre av miktarini artirabilir ve bu sekilde eksikligi telafi edebiliriz.

english: I have seven members of the council prepared to vote in my favour now!
translation: Su anda yedi konsey üyesi benim lehime oy vermeye hazir!

english: I know outerlander, for I have been closely monitoring your progress so far!
translation: Seni taniyorum yabanci, cünkü simdiye kadarki ilerleyisini yakindan takip ettim!

english: Then let us put the formality aside, and let me personally welcome you into the Fremennik! May you bring us honour!
translation: O halde formaliteleri bir kenara birakalim ve seni Fremennik'e sahsen hos geldin diyelim! Bize seref getirmeni dilerim!

english: QUEST COMPLETED!
Hi there Brundt the Chieftain. Could you help me out with a Seal of Passage?
translation: Merhaba Sef Brundt. Gecis Mührü konusunda bana yardim eder misin?

english: A Seal of Passage? Whatever for?
Well, I've heard that there have been great troubles between your people and that of the Moon Clan. I was hoping to help. And so I need the Seal of Passage to show my intentions.
translation: Sey, senin halkinla Ay Klani arasinda büyük sorunlar oldugunu duydum. Yardim etmek istiyorum. Niyetimi göstermek icin Gecis Mührü'ne ihtiyacim var.

english: Ah [Fremennik name], many have tried, but The Moon Clan are by no means a sharing group of people. They do everything by magic, something we never use. But they are so secretive about it. If only they would share, we
translation: Ah Dokrak, bircok kisi denedi, ama Ay Klani paylasimci bir grup degil. Her seyi sihirle yapiyorlar, bizim asla kullanmadigimiz bir sey. Ama bu konuda cok gizli davraniyorlar. Keske paylassalar, o zaman

english: wouldn't have to kill them all the time!
I will see what I can do.
Can I have that seal then?
If you are to bring peace to our two warring clans, then perhaps it is best that you do...
translation: Eger iki savasan klan arasinda baris saglayacaksan, belki de en iyisi öyle yapman...

english: Hi there.
Yes?
I lost my Seal of Passage!
Then you had better take a replacement and be less careless in future.
translation: O zaman yenisini al ve gelecekte daha dikkatli ol.

english: Well if it isn't [Fremennik name]. I've heard of your exploits in the Lunar Isles!
translation: Vay, bu Dokrak degil mi? Ay Adalari'ndaki kahramanliklarini duydum!

english: Already? News really does travel fast!
translation: Simdiden mi? Haberler gercekten cok hizli yayiliyor!

english: Thank you so very much, I think we can really make progress now.
translation: Cok tesekkür ederim, artik gercekten ilerleme kaydedebilecegimizi düsünüyorum.

english: No worries. I am pleased I could help.
Oh, erm, could you help me out with a Seal of Passage?
translation: Oh, sey, Gecis Mührü konusunda bana yardimci olabilir misin?

english: Seal of Passage, well I suppose so.
Ok, here you go.
Thanks!
So how did the meeting go?
It went surprisingly well! We are at least at the point where we will freely acknowledge each other's existence now.
translation: Sasirtici derecede iyi gitti! En azindan artik birbirimizin varligini özgürce kabul ettigimiz bir noktadayiz.

english: You are definitely a great asset to the Fremennik, [Fremennik name]!
translation: Sen Fremennik icin kesinlikle büyük bir degerisin, Dokrak!

english: I've lost V's Shield.
I don't think you have [Fremennik name]. I suggest you try looking for it again.
translation: Bence sende yok Dokrak. Tekrar aramani öneririm.

english: You really should be more careful [Fremennik name]. Luckily for you I found it again but you'll have to pay to get it back.
translation: Daha dikkatli olmalisin Dokrak. Sansina, onu tekrar buldum ama geri almak icin para ödemen gerekecek.

english: How much?
50,000 coins. Consider it a lesson in looking after things better.
translation: 50.000 sikke. Bunu, esyalarina daha iyi bakman icin bir ders olarak gör.

english: Sounds good to me.
Here you go [Fremennik name]. Use it well.
That's a bit too much I'm afraid.
Fair enough. I'll be here if you change your mind.
I don't have that much.
Well come back when you do.
translation: O zaman paran oldugunda tekrar gel.

english: Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I hope your travels have brought you wealth and joy! What compels you to visit me on this day?
translation: Merhaba kardes Dokrak! Umarim seyahatlerin sana zenginlik ve mutluluk getirmistir! Bugün beni ziyaret etmenin sebebi nedir?

english: I just came to say hello.
Well met, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always good to see your face in glorious Rellekka once more!
translation: Hos geldin, kardes Dokrak. Görkemli Rellekka'da yüzünü bir kez daha görmek her zaman güzel!

english: Not at the moment [Fremennik name]. Rest assured, should your services to the Fremennik be required, I will call upon you.
translation: Su anda yok Dokrak. Fremennik'e hizmetlerin gerekli olursa, seni cagiracagim, emin ol.

english: Aye, that it is [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. Should you desire one of your own, you should go to Skulgrimen's shop and see what they have available!
translation: Evet, öyle kardesim Dokrak. Kendine ait bir tane istiyorsan, Skulgrimen'in dükkanina gidip ne var ne yok bakmalisin!

english: Can I hear the history of your people?
Why, of course [Fremennik name]! Do not say 'your people' like that, for you are now a Fremennik yourself! What did you want to hear of?
translation: Tabii ki Dokrak! “Halkin” deme, cünkü sen de artik bir Fremennik'sin! Neyi dinlemek istersin?

english: I'm interested in finding out about that mysterious warrior I fought as part of Thorvalds' combat trial. His name is Koschei I believe.
translation: Thorvalds'in savas sinavinda dövüstügüm gizemli savasci hakkinda bilgi edinmek istiyorum. Sanirim adi Koschei.

english: Ah... the deathless one... We do not even know if Koschei is his name, when we found him he had no memory, he was simply repeating that single word.
translation: Ah... ölümsüz olan... Koschei'nin adi olup olmadigini bile bilmiyoruz, onu buldugumuzda hafizasi yoktu, sadece bu tek kelimeyi tekrarliyordu.

english: Whatever happened to him must have rattled his soul so hard that his memory ran away from him, and he has not yet found it's hiding place.
translation: Ona ne olduysa, ruhunu o kadar sarsmis olmali ki hafizasi kacmis ve henüz saklandigi yeri bulamamis.

english: So how exactly did you find him?
translation: Peki onu tam olarak nasil buldunuz?

english: Well, it was a raiding party like any other. We had just struck one of the smaller northern islands to harvest supplies by combat, as our laws allow,
translation: Digerleri gibi bir baskin partisiydi. Yasalara uygun olarak, savasarak erzak toplamak icin kuzeydeki kücük adalardan birine saldirmistik.

english: when we saw a figure in the iceywaters. As we were at least a 3 week sail from any port, and saw no other ships nearby, he must have been there some time.
translation: O sirada buzlu sularda bir siluet gördük. Herhangi bir limandan en az 3 haftalik mesafedeydik ve yakinlarda baska gemi görmedik, o yüzden bir süredir orada olmaliydi.

english: We could not leave someone to the cold death of the ocean, even an outerlander, so we fished him aboard. He muttered continually, but his words made no sense.
translation: Birini, yabanci olsa bile, okyanusun soguk ölümüne terk edemezdik, bu yüzden onu gemiye aldik. Sürekli mirildaniyordu, ama sözleri anlamsizdi.

english: He had no clothes or possessions with him, and seemed to have been burnt somehow before he had landed in the water.
translation: Üzerinde giysi ya da esya yoktu ve suya düsmeden önce bir sekilde yanmis gibi görünüyordu.

english: I cannot help but wonder what burnt him, for as you may have seen, he is incredibly powerful and resistant to damage by any means I know of!
translation: Onu neyin yaktigini merak etmeden edemiyorum, cünkü gördügünüz gibi, o inanilmaz derecede güclü ve bildigim hicbir sekilde hasara karsi dayanikli!

english: Anyway, we decided to bring him back to Rellekka, for he did not seem of good health or sound mind, and simply repeated the word Koschei over and over.
translation: Her neyse, onu Rellekka'ya geri götürmeye karar verdik, cünkü sagligi ve akil sagligi iyi görünmüyordu ve sadece Koschei kelimesini tekrar tekrar söylüyordu.

english: Yrsa tended to him for many weeks, until one day it was as though a new soul had entered his burnt and broken body.
translation: Yrsa haftalarca ona bakti, ta ki bir gün sanki yanmis ve kirilmis vücuduna yeni bir ruh girmis gibi olana kadar.

english: He suddenly left her house one day, fully healed, and able to speak to us as though nothing had happened to him.
translation: Bir gün aniden evinden ayrildi, tamamen iyilesmisti ve sanki basina hicbir sey olmamis gibi bizimle konusabiliyordu.

english: He still had no recollection of how he had come to be in the iceyocean, or of who he was, or where he had come from, but this did not matter to us or him.
translation: Hala buz okyanusunda nasil bulundugunu, kim oldugunu veya nereden geldigini hatirlamiyordu, ama bu ne bizim ne de onun icin önemli degildi.

english: He took his trials of adulthood, as you did, and has been a boon to our clan ever since. Someday I fear he may regain his memory, and leave us for his past...
translation: Senin yaptigin gibi yetiskinlik sinavlarini gecti ve o zamandan beri klanimiz icin bir nimet oldu. Bir gün hafizasini geri kazanip gecmisi icin bizi terk edeceginden korkuyorum...

english: But I will always respect any decision he decides to make should that day ever come upon us. Until then, he is more than welcome to stay here.
translation: Ama o gün gelirse, onun verecegi her karari her zaman saygiyla karsilayacagim. O zamana kadar, burada kalmaktan cekinmesin.

english: So, [Fremennik name]. Was there anything more you wished to hear?
translation: Peki, Dokrak. Duymak istedigin baska bir sey var mi?

english: I would like to hear of the lands across the ocean to the North.
translation: Kuzeydeki okyanusun ötesindeki topraklar hakkinda bilgi almak istiyorum.

english: Well, I think the best thing for you would be to go to the docks and ask to join one of our longboats on a journey.
translation: Bence senin icin en iyisi limana gidip uzun teknelerimizden birine katilmak icin izin istemek olacaktir.

english: My affairs are concentrated mostly on Rellekka, so my knowledge is not great, but I will happily share what I do know with you [Fremennik name].
translation: Islerim cogunlukla Rellekka'da yogunlastigi icin bilgim cok fazla degil, ama bildiklerimi seninle memnuniyetle paylasirim Dokrak.

english: North of this town the atmosphere becomes bitterly cold. There are a number of small inhabited islands that we have sea routes with.
translation: Bu kasabanin kuzeyinde hava cok soguk olur. Deniz yoluyla ulasabilecegimiz birkac kücük yerlesim adasi vardir.

english: The largest of these is possibly Miscellania, although I hear that there has been some recent incident with their monarch, but I don't know the details.
translation: Bunlarin en büyügü muhtemelen Miscellania'dir, ancak son zamanlarda hükümdarlariyla ilgili bir olay oldugunu duydum, ama ayrintilarini bilmiyorum.

english: There is also of course the island of the moon clan, who change with the tides. They are our bitterest enemies, and we are currently at war with them.
translation: Tabii ki, gelgitlerle birlikte degisen ay klaninin adasi da var. Onlar bizim en acimasiz düsmanlarimiz ve su anda onlarla savas halindeyiz.

english: They are an evil people, equally cursed and blessed by the magic in their blood. Beyond those islands, there is the large frozen wasteland we call Acheron.
translation: Onlar, kanlarindaki büyüyle hem lanetlenmis hem de kutsanmis kötü insanlardir. Bu adalarin ötesinde, Acheron adini verdigimiz büyük donmus corak arazi var.

english: It is an inhospitable land, and you will need an agile and sturdy body just to keep alive in it's perils.
translation: Burasi yasanmasi zor bir yer ve tehlikelerinden kurtulmak icin cevik ve saglam bir vücuda sahip olmaniz gerekir.

english: As I say, my knowledge outside of this town is rather limited, and I know no more than this. Was there anything else you wished to hear tell of?
translation: Dedigim gibi, bu kasaba disindaki bilgim oldukca sinirli ve bundan fazlasini bilmiyorum. Duymak istediginiz baska bir sey var mi?

english: I would like to hear a little of the history between the Fremenniks and the outerlanders.
translation: Fremennikler ve dis dünyalilar arasindaki tarihten biraz bahsetmek isterim.

english: Ah, now that is something I know a great deal about. Believe it or not, all outerlanders were once orginally Fremenniks.
translation: Ah, bu konuda cok sey biliyorum. Ister inanin ister inanmayin, tüm dis toprak sakinleri eskiden Fremenniklerdi.

english: When first man came to these lands all were Fremenniks, and followed our ways. We lived a happy life, and never settled in one place for long.
translation: Ilk insanlar bu topraklara geldiginde hepsi Fremennikti ve bizim geleneklerimizi takip ediyorlardi. Mutlu bir hayat sürüyorduk ve hicbir yere uzun süre yerlesmiyorduk.

english: We travelled by boat along the coastlines, never taking more from the land than could be regrown by the same time in the following year.
translation: Kiyi seridinde tekneyle seyahat ediyorduk ve topraktan, ertesi yil ayni zamanda yeniden yetisebilecek olandan fazlasini almiyorduk.

english: However, many moons past, some of our tribesmen were weary of constantly travelling the lands, and decided to build themselves permanent homes.
translation: Ancak, uzun zaman sonra, kabilemizden bazilari sürekli seyahat etmekten yoruldu ve kendilerine kalici evler insa etmeye karar verdi.

english: Unfortunately, the other races that had also migrated here did not like this. They waged war against us at every opportunity.
translation: Ne yazik ki, buraya göc etmis diger irklar bundan hoslanmadi. Her firsatta bize savas actilar.

english: We were driven mostly to the coastlines, where we could escape by boat when attacked. Remember, at this time we had no real way to defend against constant attack.
translation: Cogunlukla kiyi seridine sürüldük, böylece saldiriya ugradigimizda tekneyle kacabilirdik. Unutmayin, o zamanlar sürekli saldirilara karsi savunma yapabilecegimiz gercek bir yolumuz yoktu.

english: Then one day one of our Seers, whose name has been lost in the telling of this tale, discovered a cave full of strange rocks.
translation: Sonra bir gün, bu hikayenin anlatiminda adi kaybolan kahinlerimizden biri, garip kayalarla dolu bir magara kesfetti.

english: This rock would never be consumed, no matter how much we took, and sparkled at its peak, and broke off in small and regular sized chunks when mined.
translation: Bu kaya, ne kadar alirsak alalim asla tükenmiyordu, zirvesinde parildiyordu ve cikarildiginda kücük ve düzenli boyutlarda parcalara ayriliyordu.

english: Stranger than this, we found that these rocks would become filled with power when taken to certain places across this land!
translation: Bundan daha da garibi, bu kayalarin bu topraklardaki belirli yerlere götürüldügünde gücle doldugunu kesfettik!

english: There was a terrible argument in our tribe! Some said that we should take as many of these rocks as we could, and use them in defending against our enemies attacks!
translation: Kabilemizde korkunc bir tartisma cikti! Bazilari, bu kayalardan mümkün oldugunca cok alip düsmanlarimizin saldirilarina karsi savunmada kullanmamiz gerektigini söyledi!

english: Others said that we had found a place that belonged only to the gods, and that should we steal what was not ours we would find only torment and misery.
translation: Digerleri ise, sadece tanrilara ait bir yer buldugumuzu ve bize ait olmayan seyi calarsak sadece iskence ve sefalet bulacagimizi söyledi.

english: We voted on this, and decided that it was in the best interests of the tribe to leave these strange rocks where they lay, for the gods can be spiteful and cruel,
translation: Bu konuyu oyladik ve tanrilar, özellikle de onlara istedikleri saygiyi göstermeyenlere karsi kindar ve acimasiz olabileceginden, bu garip kayalari bulunduklari yerde birakmanin kabilenin yararina olacagina karar verdik.

english: especially to those who do not treat them with the respect they desire. Some of our number refused to accept this ruling by our council however.
translation: Ancak, kabilemizden bazilari konseyimizin bu kararini kabul etmedi.

english: They began to mine these rocks, and set up transport systems to the various places of power that enchanted them.
translation: Bu kayalari cikarmaya basladilar ve onlari büyüleyen cesitli güc yerlerine nakil sistemleri kurdular.

english: They even created temples at each of these places! This was going too far! We had no choice, but to expel them from our tribe forever!
translation: Hatta bu yerlerin her birinde tapinaklar bile insa ettiler! Bu cok ileri gitmekti! Onlari kabilemizden sonsuza kadar kovmaktan baska secenegimiz yoktu!

english: We turned our backs upon them, and let them know they would never be welcome back to our tribes until they had released themselves from the rocks.
translation: Onlara sirtimizi döndük ve kayalardan kurtulmadiklari sürece kabilemize asla geri dönemeyeceklerini bildirdik.

english: This is the tale of how the outerlanders came about; through stealing from the gods, and from betraying our ideals. This is why we show them no trust.
translation: Bu, dis dünyalilarin nasil ortaya ciktiginin hikayesidir; tanrilardan calarak ve ideallerimize ihanet ederek. Bu yüzden onlara güvenmiyoruz.

english: Was there something else you wished to hear?
translation: Duymak istediginiz baska bir sey var mi?

english: Actually, history isn't really my thing.
Well let me know should you wish to hear our lore and histories. We value them highly.
translation: Eger bizim geleneklerimizi ve tarihimizi duymak isterseniz bana haber verin. Onlara cok deger veriyoruz.

english: As a matter of fact [Fremennik name], I do have a quest for you. Are you interested?
translation: Aslinda Dokrak, size bir görevim var. Ilgilenir misiniz?

english: I’m ready for adventure
Excellent, now-
