So what will it be this time? Joining warring islands?
translation: Peki bu sefer ne olacak? Savasan adalara katilmak mi?

english: I’m a fan of you enthusiasm, [Fremennik name], but-
translation: Senin coskunu takdir ediyorum, Dokrak, ama...

english: Would you have me slay a mighty daggermouth? Or do you need my expertise in conquering untamed lands?
translation: Güclü bir hancer agizliyi öldürmemi mi istiyorsun? Yoksa vahsi topraklari fethetme konusundaki uzmanligima mi ihtiyacin var?

english: Nothing quite that fancy I’m afraid, [Fremennik name]. I just need you to investigate a minor disturbance.
translation: Korkarim o kadar da süslü bir sey degil, Dokrak. Sadece kücük bir karisikligi arastirmani istiyorum.

english: Oh.

Freygerd and Reeso run the sandpit a little north of here. They mentioned they heard some rustling by their hut lat night and wanted an official to investigate. You’ve proven yourself more than worthy of our people’s trust.
translation: Freygerd ve Reeso buradan biraz kuzeyde kum havuzunu isletiyorlar. Dün gece kulübelerinin yaninda bir hisirti duyduklarini ve bir yetkilinin bunu arastirmasini istediklerini söylediler. Halkimizin güvenini fazlasiyla hak ettigini kanitladin.

english: Well that doesn’t sound so bad. I’ll get right on it.
translation: O kadar da kötü görünmüyor. Hemen hallederim.

english: Thank you, [Fremennik name].
Not right now.
Very well. Return when you wish to help.
translation: Peki. Yardim etmek istediginde geri gel.

english: How goes the investigation, [Fremennik name]?
I’m still looking into it at the moment.
No rush, [Fremennik name]. I’m sure it’s nothing to worry about. Just talk to Freygerd and Reeso at the sandpit when you’re ready.
translation: Acele etme, Dokrak. Endiselenecek bir sey olmadigina eminim. Hazir oldugunda kum ocagindaki Freygerd ve Reeso ile konus.

english: [Fremennik name], I’m glad you’ve returned! This letter you have found is very worrying and requires our utmost attention.
translation: Dokrak, döndügüne sevindim! Buldugun bu mektup cok endise verici ve azami dikkatimizi gerektiriyor.

english: I don’t understand. What does this letter mean? Who is the Jormungand? And since when could basilisks read and write?
translation: Anlamiyorum. Bu mektup ne anlama geliyor? Jormungand kim? Ve ne zamandan beri basiliskler okuma yazma biliyor?

english: While they may not show it, basilisks are much smarter than they seem. Many years ago, a great basilisk army enslaved our people and took our home. The Joumungand, sometimes known as The Serpent King, was the leader of this army. Along with his three generals, Typhor, Vritra and Bakuna, he brought a terror to these lands unlike any other. If it hadn’t been for the bravery of a great hero, we might never have been freed.
translation: Görünüste belli olmasa da, basiliskler göründüklerinden cok daha zekidir. Yillar önce, büyük bir basilisk ordusu halkimizi kölelestirdi ve evimizi ele gecirdi. Joumungand, bazen Yilan Kral olarak da bilinir, bu ordunun lideriydi. Üc generali Typhor, Vritra ve Bakuna ile birlikte, bu topraklara esi benzeri görülmemis bir terör getirdi. Büyük bir kahramanin cesareti olmasaydi, belki de asla özgür olamazdik.

english: A hero?
Yes. He was known as V. He stood up to the Serpent King and confronted him on the Island of Stone. It is said that the two of them fought for days, but in the end, V stood victorious.
translation: Evet. Adi V idi. Yilan Kral'a karsi cikti ve Tas Adasi'nda onunla yüzlesti. Ikisinin günlerce savastigi söylenir, ama sonunda V galip geldi.

english: What happened next?
Well that depends who you ask. The bards wrote a great song about V’s victory. They called it the Ballad of the Basilisk, and it claims V killed the Jormungand.
translation: Bu kime sorduguna bagli. Ozanlar V'nin zaferi hakkinda harika bir sarki yazdilar. Adini Basilisk'in Baladi koydular ve V'nin Jormungand'i öldürdügünü iddia ettiler.

english: But...
Well... bards are known to bend the truth a bit, especially if it makes a song sound better. In reality V sealed the Serpent King in a magical prison on the island, where he remains to this day.
translation: Sey... Ozanlar gercegi biraz carpitmakla bilinirler, özellikle de bu sarkiyi daha güzel hale getiriyorsa. Gercekte V, Yilan Krali adadaki büyülü bir hapishaneye hapsetti ve o hala orada.

english: A magical prison? I thought the Fremennik people didn’t approve of magic?
translation: Büyülü bir hapishane mi? Fremennik halki büyüye karsi degil miydi?

english: V was different. Stories tell of how he unlocked the potential of magic with a single touch of a stone. In that moment, he became more than just a man.
translation: V farkliydi. Hikayeler, onun bir tasa dokunarak büyünün potansiyelini nasil ortaya cikardigini anlatir. O anda, o artik sadece bir insan olmaktan cikti.

english: A god?
It’s not a distinction the Fremennik particularly care for. To us, he has always been a hero to be respected, not a god to be worshipped. They say he felt the same way.
translation: Bu, Fremennik halkinin özellikle önem verdigi bir ayrim degil. Bizim icin o her zaman saygi duyulacak bir kahraman olmustur, tapilacak bir tanri degil. Onun da ayni sekilde hissettigi söylenir.

english: But he earned the right to use magic?
translation: Ama büyü kullanma hakkini kazandi mi?

english: Exactly. Now the Moon Clan on the other hand, did not earn that right. Their use of magic is an insult to our people.
translation: Aynen öyle. Öte yandan Ay Klani bu hakki kazanmadi. Onlarin büyü kullanimi halkimiza bir hakarettir.

english: So what can we do about the Jormungand?
We will stay strong, [Fremennik name]. We’ll... We’ll be doomed! Our army isn’t large enough to hold back the forces of the Serpent King.
translation: Güclü kalacagiz, Dokrak. Biz... Biz mahvolacagiz! Ordumuz Yilan Kral'in güclerini durduracak kadar büyük degil.

english: I can help!
[Fremennik name], you’re strong. But you’re no army.
translation: Dokrak, sen güclüsün. Ama sen bir ordu degilsin.

english: You’re forgetting Brundt. We have the element of surprise! They don’t know we’re aware of their attack. We could have days to prepare before they make their move. We could...
translation: Brundt'u unutuyorsun. Sürpriz unsurumuz var! Saldirilarini bildigimizi bilmiyorlar. Harekete gecmeden önce hazirlanmak icin birkac günümüz olabilir. Biz...

english: A cutscene starts
Chieftain Brundt!
Agnar? What is it?
Chieftain Brundt! I’m here on behalf of the Fremennik Council! We’ve heard some disturbing news about a basilisk in town.
translation: Sef Brundt! Fremennik Konseyi adina buradayim! Kasabada bir basilisk oldugu konusunda rahatsiz edici haberler aldik.

english: Well I won’t deny there’s been a little issue but [Fremennik name] and I will soon have things back under control.
translation: Kücük bir sorun oldugunu inkar etmeyecegim ama Dokrak ve ben yakinda her seyi kontrol altina alacagiz.

english: [Fremennik name]? When will you see that this outerlander is the cause of all our problems!
translation: Dokrak? Bu yabancinin tüm sorunlarimizin kaynagi oldugunu ne zaman anlayacaksin!

english: [Fremennik name] is no outerlander! He passed our trials and is a Fremennik, just like you and I.
translation: Dokrak yabanci degil! Sinavlarimizi gecti ve tipki sen ve ben gibi bir Fremennik.

english: You can disguise it all you want, but he is an outerlander and always will be! Ever since we let him in, we’ve had nothing but trouble! And to top it all off, now we have basilisks wandering our town. The council have had enough!
translation: Istedigin kadar gizlemeye calis, ama o bir yabanci ve her zaman öyle kalacak! Onu iceri aldigimizdan beri basimiza beladan baska bir sey gelmedi! Üstüne üstlük, simdi de kasabamizda basiliskler dolasiyor. Konsey artik bikti!

english: What are you saying Agnar?
I have a declaration here signed by seven of our twelve council members. We declare this outerlander an exile!
translation: Elimde, on iki konsey üyemizden yedisinin imzaladigi bir bildiri var. Bu yabanciyi sürgüne gönderiyoruz!

english: This is outrageous! [Fremennik name] is one of us!
translation: Bu cok sacma! Dokrak bizden biri!

english: Do not use the name! The decision of the council is final. As Chieftain, you are honour bound to enact it.
translation: Bu ismi kullanma! Konseyin karari kesindir. Sef olarak, bunu uygulamak senin onurlu görevin.

english: I see... Exile, you must leave our province. Our people will no longer see you as their [brother/sister].
translation: Anliyorum... Sürgün, bizim bölgemizden ayrilmalisin. Halkimiz artik seni kardesleri olarak görmeyecek.

english: Chieftain Brundt gestures his head towards the south east.
translation: Sef Brundt basini güneydoguya dogru cevirir.

english: Leave at once. Do not attempt to interact with myself or my people.
translation: Hemen git. Benimle veya halkimla etkilesime gecmeye calisma.

english: Begone exile, you are a Fremennik no more.
translation: Git sürgüne, artik bir Fremennik degilsin.

english: Well that was awkward...
Indeed. I’m sorry [Fremennik name]. The reality is that many on the council did not take kindly to you becoming one of us. They’ve been looking for a good excuse to exile you ever since you arrived.
translation: Gercekten. Üzgünüm Dokrak. Gercek su ki, konseydeki bircok kisi senin aramiza katilmani hos karsilamadi. Sen geldiginden beri seni sürgüne göndermek icin iyi bir bahane ariyorlardi.

english: But they’re the one that voted for me in the first place!
translation: Ama ilk basta bana oy verenler onlardi!

english: Well… not quite. Seven of the twelve council members gave you their vote, but you never had the support of the other five. They’re the ones who’ve been pushing for your exile.
translation: Sey... tam olarak öyle degil. On iki konsey üyesinden yedisi sana oy verdi, ama diger besinin destegini hic alamadin. Sürgüne gönderilmeni isteyenler onlar.

english: I see. And they’ve used this basilisk problem to convince some of the others.
translation: Anliyorum. Ve digerlerini ikna etmek icin bu basilisk sorununu kullandilar.

english: It would seem so. Try not to judge them too harshly though, they only had what was best for the province in mind. This basilisk situation has a lot of people scared.
translation: Öyle görünüyor. Onlari cok sert yargilamaya calisma, onlar sadece eyalet icin en iyisini düsünüyorlardi. Bu basilisk sorunu bircok insani korkuttu.

english: I don’t understand though, they’re only basilisks. Surely we have the strength to defeat them.
translation: Anlamiyorum, onlar sadece basiliskler. Onlari yenmek icin gücümüz var.

english: Ah, I see you are not familiar with the End of Things.
translation: Ah, Görünüse göre Sen Sonun Sonu'nu bilmiyorsun.

english: The End of Things?
Many years ago, before the time of V, it was a foretold that this world will end in a great battle. They called this battle Ragnarok, or more commonly, the End of Things.
translation: Yillar önce, V'den önce, bu dünyanin büyük bir savasla sona erecegi kehanet edilmisti. Bu savasa Ragnarok, ya da daha yaygin olarak, Sonlar deniyordu.

english: Well that doesn’t sound good. Where do the basilisks fit in?
translation: Bu pek iyi gelmiyor kulaga. Basiliskler bu olayda ne rol oynuyor?

english: The prophecies say that the battle will begin after the Serpent King is freed. So you see, it is not the basilisks people fear, it is what comes after.
translation: Kehanetlere göre savas, Yilan Kral serbest birakildiktan sonra baslayacak. Yani insanlar basilisklerden korkmuyor, ondan sonra gelecek olandan korkuyorlar.

english: Then we’d better make sure the Jormungand stays in that prison!
translation: O zaman Jormungand'in hapiste kalmasini saglamaliyiz!

english: Well, [Fremennik name], that’s why I asked you to meet me out here. If you are to help us put a stop to this threat, you’ll need to regain the trust of the council. And I think I know just how you can do that.
translation: Evet, Dokrak, bu yüzden seninle burada bulusmak istedim. Bu tehdidi durdurmamiza yardim edeceksen, konseyin güvenini geri kazanman gerekecek. Ve bunu nasil yapabilecegini biliyorum.

english: How?
I think the best possible way to those your worth to them is by being the person that restores V’s Shield.
translation: Onlara degerini göstermenin en iyi yolu, V'nin Kalkanini geri getiren kisi olmak.

english: V’s Shield?

The shield used by V when he seated the Serpent King. It is legendary amongst our people. If we are to have any chance of stopping this threat, we will need to remake it. There’s a few things I know about the shield though other things are lost from stories past. I believe some members of the Moon Clan might know the detail I don’t, so your diplomatic relations should come in handy. Keep in mind, now that you’ve been exiled, most people in the province will be unlikely to talk to you.
translation: V'nin Yilan Krali'ni tahtina oturturken kullandigi kalkan. Halkimiz arasinda efsanevi bir kalkan. Bu tehdidi durdurmak icin bir sansimiz varsa, onu yeniden yapmamiz gerekecek. Kalkan hakkinda bildigim birkac sey var, ancak diger seyler gecmis hikayelerden kaybolmus. Ay Klani'nin bazi üyelerinin benim bilmedigim detaylari biliyor olabilecegini düsünüyorum, bu yüzden diplomatik iliskilerin isine yarayabilir. Unutma, sürgüne gönderildigin icin, eyaletteki cogu insan seninle konusmayacaktir.

english: Fair enough. So where should I start?

Stories tell of how V’s Shield was made using for components. First, the base of the shield. This was a traditional Fremennik Shield, like the ones our warriors use. Next, the Lunar Glass. This was apparently created by a great Moon Clan mystic and was used to reflect the Serpent King’s gaze. Then you have the Polishing Rock. This was needed to shine the Lunar Glass. This rock was heated softly in a boiling spring. Finally, V’s Sigil. This sigil was crafted by the Moon Clan, using a unique metal known only to them.
translation: Hikayeler, V'nin Kalkani'nin dört bilesen kullanilarak nasil yapildigini anlatir. Ilk olarak, kalkanin tabani. Bu, savascilarimizin kullandigi gibi geleneksel bir Fremennik Kalkaniydi. Sonra, Ay Cami. Bu, görünüse göre büyük bir Ay Klani mistik tarafindan yaratilmis ve Yilan Kral'in bakislarini yansitmak icin kullanilmis. Sonra Parlatma Tasi var. Bu, Ay Cami'ni parlatmak icin gerekliydi. Bu tas, kaynayan bir kaynakta hafifce isitilmisti. Son olarak, V'nin Mührü. Bu mühür, Ay Klani tarafindan, sadece kendilerinin bildigi essiz bir metal kullanilarak yapilmisti.

english: Sorry, but your trail is not over quite yet.
Great...
Find the answer to this question for me.
translation: Bu sorunun cevabini bul benim icin.

english: Brundt has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Brundt sana bir meydan okuma parsömeni verdi!

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
Wrong answer!
Perfect!
Brundt has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
Do you have any quests?
Yes, I am interested.
No, I'm not interested.
Why do you call me outerlander?
I seek an army to destroy Asgarnia!
translation: Asgarnia'yi yok etmek icin bir ordu ariyorum!

english: Who are the Fremennik?
Nice hat!
Ask about becoming a Fremennik
Ask about a Seal of Passage.
Ask about the mountain camp.
Ask about V's Shield.
Ask about anything else.
translation: Baska bir sey hakkinda bilgi al.

english: I just came to say hello.
Can I hear the history of your people?
Tell me of the finding of Koschei
Tell me of the lands to the North
Tell me of the outerlanders
Don't tell me anything
Ask about a Seal of Passage
Ask for a quest.
What are you doing down here?
Could you explain this place to me again?
This here is the Gauntlet, the finest creation of the Amlodd clan. It was built years ago to help train Prifddinas' finest warriors and survivalists.
translation: Burasi Gauntlet, Amlodd klaninin en güzel eseri. Yillar önce Prifddinas'in en iyi savascilarini ve hayatta kalma uzmanlarini egitmek icin insa edildi.

english: Train?
That's right. The Gauntlet contains a range of deadly creatures formed from crystal. Defeating them is the key to victory, but it is no easy task.
translation: Dogru. Gauntlet, kristalden olusturulmus bir dizi ölümcül yaratik barindirir. Onlari yenmek zaferin anahtaridir, ancak bu kolay bir görev degildir.

english: This is because all participants start with nothing at hand beyond a few basic tools.
translation: Bunun nedeni, tüm katilimcilarin birkac temel alet disinda hicbir sey olmadan baslamasidir.

english: But how do people fight without their gear?
translation: Ama insanlar ekipmanlari olmadan nasil savasir?

english: Resources can be gathered throughout the dungeon. These can be used to create the weapons, armour, food and potions needed to survive.
translation: Kaynaklar zindanin her yerinde toplanabilir. Bunlar hayatta kalmak icin gerekli silah, zirh, yiyecek ve iksirleri yapmak icin kullanilabilir.

english: Without any armour, those crystalline creatures can be real nasty. Any armour that you make down there will greatly reduce the damage they do to you.
translation: Zirh olmadan, bu kristal yaratiklar gercekten cok tehlikeli olabilir. Orada yaptigin herhangi bir zirh, sana verdikleri hasari büyük ölcüde azaltacaktir.

english: Okay, I think I follow... But I thought this was all about combat, not just gathering my own equipment.
translation: Tamam, anladim... Ama ben bunun sadece kendi ekipmanimi toplamakla ilgili oldugunu saniyordum, savasmakla ilgili oldugunu degil.

english: That's right. Once you feel you're ready, or once we decide that you've spent long enough down there, you'll have to face the fearsome Crystalline Hunllef.
translation: Dogru. Hazir oldugunu hissettiginde ya da orada yeterince zaman gecirdigine karar verdigimizde, korkunc Crystalline Hunllef ile yüzlesmen gerekecek.

english: And what makes it so dangerous, if it's just for training?
translation: Eger bu sadece egitim icinse, onu bu kadar tehlikeli yapan nedir?

english: Once you go down there, there are only two ways out... You can make a break for the exit, or if you're bested in combat we'll send someone in for you.
translation: Oraya indiginde, cikmanin sadece iki yolu var... Cikisa dogru kosabilirsin ya da savasta yenilirsen, seni kurtarmak icin birini göndeririz.

english: Things can be a little unstable down there at times, too... Everything gets corrupted, and it might be a little frightening, but it makes for a good challenge.
translation: Orada bazen durumlar biraz istikrarsiz olabilir... Her sey bozulur ve biraz korkutucu olabilir, ama bu iyi bir meydan okuma olur.

english: The Corrupted Gauntlet can be accessed by rightclicking the entrance.
translation: Bozulmus Eldiven'e girisi sag tiklayarak erisilebilir.

english: I think that covers it... Everything else, you'll have to work out for yourself while you're in there.
translation: Sanirim hepsi bu kadar... Geri kalan her seyi, oradayken kendin cözmen gerekecek.

english: Okay... I think I've got it.
You can always come back and ask me to go over things again.
translation: Istedigin zaman geri gelip tekrar anlatmami isteyebilirsin.

english: I'm thinking of giving the Gauntlet a go.
You? Attempting the Gauntlet? If you say so!
translation: Sen mi? Gauntlet'i denemek mi? Sen öyle diyorsan!

english: Just passing by.
Alright... Well be careful down here. I've got my eye on you.
translation: Tamam... Burada dikkatli ol. Seni gözlüyorum.

english: Don't think you want to be heading down there without knowing what you're getting into! Come and see me, if you really want to go down there.
translation: Neye bulastigini bilmeden oraya gitmek istemezsin! Gercekten oraya gitmek istiyorsan gel beni gör.

english: Don't think you can be taking any plus ones down there with you.
There's something in that there chest waiting for you. Don't leave it for too long.
translation: O sandigin icinde seni bekleyen bir sey var. Cok uzun süre birakma.

english: Could you explain this place to me again?
I'm thinking of giving the Gauntlet a go.
What is this place?
Just passing by.
You's better talk to Dad, him chasey sneaky da chompy.
translation: Babanla konussan iyi olur, o kovalayan sinsi cigneyen.

english: Thanks for da chompy, it was deloverly!
A bug! Hahaha.
HAHAHAHAHA
...ahahaha
HA!
Ok... I'm done.
The bunny thinks you laughed at them and looks both angry and embarrassed.
translation: Tavsan, ona güldügünü düsünüyor ve hem kizgin hem de utanmis görünüyor.

english: Oh, sorry. I didn't mean to turn you into a... Hot cross bunny!
translation: Oh, üzgünüm. Seni bir... Sicak cörek tavsana dönüstürmek istemedim!

english: It's a bit rude of 'em to take up the whole bridge with their conversation, isn't it, mate?
translation: Köprünün tamamini konusmalariyla isgal etmeleri biraz kaba, degil mi dostum?

english: Aye, mate, but wouldn't it be just as rude for us to interrupt?
translation: Evet dostum, ama biz de onlari kesmek ayni derecede kaba olmaz mi?

english: A good point well made, mate. Who are we to decide that the dig is more impor'ant than a personal disagreement between two people?
translation: Iyi bir noktaya degindin dostum. Iki kisi arasindaki kisisel anlasmazliktan daha önemli olanin kazi oldugunu kim karar verebilir ki?

english: You're not wrong, mate. We often place matters of industry above those of people, and it's chippin' away at our ability to relate to each other on a human level.
translation: Haklisin dostum. Sik sik endüstri meselelerini insan meselelerinin üstünde tutuyoruz ve bu da insan olarak birbirimizle iliski kurma yetenegimizi zedeliyor.

english: What's going on here?
We're part of a dig into some ruins beneath Cam Torum, but the way's blocked by these folks.
translation: Cam Torum'un altindaki bazi kalintilari kaziyoruz ama yol bu insanlar tarafindan kapatilmis.

english: Have you tried asking them to move?
We're considering the moral implications of doing exactly that, mate.
Are you two philosophers?
No mate, builders.
But thinking, talking, discussing, it's what makes us human, mate.
translation: Ama düsünmek, konusmak, tartismak bizi insan yapan seydir dostum.

english: It's not just humans that do those things.
Fair play, mate. I guess we're reflecting more on the condition of sen'ience in general then.
translation: Haklisin dostum. Sanirim genel olarak bilinc durumunu daha cok düsünüyoruz....

english: Goodbye.
Have a good one, mate.
Thanks for that, mate. You should speak to Jess inside. She'll be in the north of the city. She could use a problem solver like yourself.
translation: Tesekkürler dostum. Icerideki Jess ile konusmalisin. Sehrin kuzeyinde olacak. Senin gibi bir problem cözücüye ihtiyaci var.

english: Who's Jess?
She's the archaeologist in charge of the dig into these ruins they've found. Discovering the mysteries of the past and that.
translation: Bulunan bu kalintilari kazmaktan sorumlu arkeolog. Gecmisin gizemlerini kesfediyor falan.

english: You should head inside, mate. Remember, Jess will be in the north of the city. She could use a problem solver like yourself.
translation: Iceri girmelisin dostum. Unutma, Jess sehrin kuzeyinde olacak. Senin gibi bir problem cözücüye ihtiyaci var.

english: To me!
To you!
Keep it down!
G'day, mate.
I'm surprised to see you both in such high spirits after walking past all those jeering dwarves.
translation: O alayci cücelerin yanindan gectikten sonra ikinizin de bu kadar neseli oldugunu görmek beni sasirtti.

english: Ah, well it's unfortunate, but no reason to be sad. It's them that ought to be sad.
translation: Ah, bu talihsiz bir durum, ama üzülmek icin bir neden yok. Üzülmesi gereken onlar.

english: Aye, mate. Livin' a life unable to connect with others because they look different must be miserable.
translation: Evet dostum. Farkli göründükleri icin baskalariyla iletisim kuramayan bir hayat yasamak cok mutsuz edici olmali.

english: We wish 'em the best. Hopefully their paths to personal growth are near and smooth.
translation: Onlara en iyisini diliyoruz. Umarim kisisel gelisim yollari yakin ve pürüzsüzdür.

english: Thanks for taking care of those base camps, mate.
translation: Ana kamplarla ilgilendigin icin tesekkürler dostum.

english: No problem. I hope there's no hard feelings over Jessamine asking me to do a part of your jobs.
translation: Sorun degil. Jessamine'in bana isinizin bir kismini yapmami istemesinden dolayi gücenmissinizdir umarim.

english: That's no worries, mate, I've no issue admitting you're better cut out for building camps in dangerous dungeons than I am.
translation: Endiselenme dostum, tehlikeli zindanlarda kamp kurmak icin benden daha uygun oldugunu kabul etmekte sorun yok.

english: We may not be mul'i-disciplined adventurers like you, but we don't need to be. The world needs more than just heroes, don't it?
translation: Senin gibi cok yönlü maceracilar olmayabiliriz, ama olmamiza da gerek yok. Dünya sadece kahramanlara ihtiyac duymaz, degil mi?

english: Aye, mate, I'm content and proud to just be a hard working, decent builder.
translation: Evet dostum, caliskan, dürüst bir insaatci olmaktan memnun ve gurur duyuyorum.

english: Besides, without us, building supplies wouldn't be there in the first place. Life's all about working together.
translation: Ayrica, biz olmasak, insaat malzemeleri de olmazdi. Hayat birlikte calismakla ilgilidir.

english: Glad to hear it. Keep up the good work then!
translation: Bunu duyduguma sevindim. Öyleyse iyi calismaya devam et!

english: You too, mate.
You seem remarkably calm considering everything that's going on.
translation: Olan biten her seye ragmen oldukca sakin görünüyorsun.

english: Life's unpredictable, mate. No sense stressin' over what's out of your control.
translation: Hayat öngörülemez dostum. Kontrolün disinda olan seyler icin stres yapmanin anlami yok.

english: It's not like we're not aware of the danger we're in, but worryin' about it ain't productive.
translation: Icinde bulundugumuz tehlikenin farkinda degiliz degil, ama bunun icin endiselenmek verimli degil.

english: Shouldn't you be getting out of here if you feel like you're in danger?
translation: Tehlikede oldugunu hissediyorsan buradan gitmen gerekmez mi?

english: We may not be in total control of our surroundings, but we can still impact them positively through our actions. Like bein' here to support you.
translation: Cevremizi tamamen kontrol edemiyor olabiliriz, ama yine de eylemlerimizle onlara olumlu etki edebiliriz. Mesela burada olup sana destek olmak gibi.

english: Even if that's just emotionally. We believe in you, mate.
translation: Bu sadece duygusal bir destek olsa bile. Sana inaniyoruz dostum.

english: Thanks.
No worries, mate. Go get 'em.
translation: Merak etme dostum. Git ve onlari alt et.

english: I am a fool...
Well... yes, a bit.
You meant well. You thought you were helpin'. Can't fault you for that part, mate.
translation: Niyetin iyiydi. Yardim ettigini sandin. Bu konuda seni suclayamayiz dostum.

english: You made a mistake. Coulda been any of us. Just gotta make sure we learn from our mistakes is all.
translation: Bir hata yaptin. Herhangi birimiz yapabilirdik. Sadece hatalarimizdan ders cikarmamiz gerekiyor, hepsi bu.

english: And if yer genuinely sorry, best you can do is work to be better, not mope around. So keep your chin up, mate!
translation: Ve gercekten pismansan, yapabilecegin en iyi sey daha iyi olmak icin cabalamak, somurtmak degil. O yüzden basini dik tut dostum!

english: Thank you...
What did you do, anyway?
I saw sun and moon runes on that thing. Recalled something from Ranul's teachings, a rite he once performed...
translation: O seyin üzerinde günes ve ay runeleri gördüm. Ranul'un ögretilerinden bir seyi hatirladim, bir zamanlar yaptigi bir ayini...

english: I tried to emulate it, and it worked. I thought I had freed his emissaries. But they weren't that at all...
translation: Onu taklit etmeye calistim ve ise yaradi. Onun elcilerini kurtardigimi sandim. Ama onlar hic de öyle degillerdi...

english: Interesting. Maybe there was some sort of connection between Ranul and this place after all.
translation: Ilginc. Belki de Ranul ile bu yer arasinda bir baglanti vardi.

english: Well, all's well that ends well.
We never had any doubts! Always knew you'd get it sorted, mate.
translation: Hic süphemiz yoktu! Her seyi halledecegini biliyorduk dostum.

english: No worries, mate.
Good to see you again, mate.
Good to see you both as well. How's things?
translation: Sizi de görmek güzel. Nasil gidiyor?

english: Never better, mate. Never better. This here ruin was the find of the century!
translation: Hic bu kadar iyi olmamisti dostum. Hic bu kadar iyi olmamisti. Bu harabe yüzyilin kesfi oldu!

english: All credit to Jess, o'course, but we're glad to be doing our bit!
translation: Tabii ki tüm övgü Jess'e ait ama biz de katkida bulunabildigimiz icin mutluyuz!

english: Glad to hear it.
What's going on here?
Are you two philosophers?
Goodbye.
Can I help you today?
Can I go for a ride?
Minecart rides are 20 coins.
Of course.
I'm fine, thanks.
As a loyal customer of the Lovakengj Minecart Network, you're entitled to this.
translation: Lovakengj Maden Arabasi Agi'nin sadik bir müsterisi olarak, buna hakkiniz var.

english: Now, can I help you today?
translation: Simdi, bugün size nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: You're already here, human.
Can I go for a ride?
I'm fine, thanks.
How does it feel to be back home?
Ayyy ... *hiccup* ... Ish been sho long sinsh I've ... *hiccup* ... ad a deshent cocktail!
translation: Ayyy ... *hickirik* ... Cok uzun zaman oldu ... *hickirik* ... düzgün bir kokteyl icmeyeli!

english: Glad to see you enjoying yourself... I guess.
Hello!
Hello sir, are you going to make a snowman?
translation: Merhaba efendim, kardan adam mi yapacaksiniz?

english: Maybe, I'm not sure I'd be very good at it!
translation: Belki, ama bu konuda cok iyi oldugumu sanmiyorum!

english: I think you would be!
I want to make a snowman, but I can't reach high enough to stack the snowballs properly.
translation: Kardan adam yapmak istiyorum, ama kar toplarini düzgünce istiflemek icin yeterince uzanamiyorum.

english: Hello Buoy and Gurl!
Hello sir!
How do you know our names?
I had a chat with your dad. He's super busy, so he's asked me to help you build a snowman!
translation: Babanizla konustum. Cok mesgul oldugu icin size kardan adam yapmaniza yardim etmemi istedi!

english: Really? We get to make a snowman?
translation: Gercekten mi? Kardan adam yapabilecek miyiz?

english: Yes! And I'm going to build whatever snowman you want!
translation: Evet! Ve istediginiz kardan adami yapacagim!

english: Yay! Can it be three snowballs tall?
translation: Yasasin! Üc kar topu yüksekliginde olabilir mi?

english: But I want it to be five tall!
translation: Ama ben bes yüksekliginde olsun istiyorum!

english: Five is a bad number, it should be three tall!
translation: Bes kötü bir sayi, üc yüksekliginde olmali!

english: You're a bad number. Five is so much better.
translation: Sen kötü bir sayisin. Bes cok daha iyi.

english: Okay, okay, wait a second. Why don't we meet in the middle. How about four snowballs tall?
translation: Tamam, tamam, bir saniye bekle. Ortada bulusalim. Dört kar topu yüksekliginde nasil olur?

english: Fine, it can be four tall.
Yes, four tall is okay.
Great. Now, we need to pick what size snowballs we want for each tier. Why don't you take it in turns? You can do two each.
translation: Harika. Simdi, her kat icin istedigimiz kar topu boyutunu secmeliyiz. Sirayla secin. Her biri iki tane secebilir.

english: The bottom one should be a huge snowball!
translation: En alttaki kocaman bir kar topu olmali!

english: The next one should be big!
This is working nicely, we're half way! What about the top two parts?
translation: Bu cok iyi gidiyor, yarisini hallettik! En üstteki iki kisim ne olacak?

english: The next one should be a small snowball!
translation: Bir sonraki kücük bir kar topu olmali!

english: No, it should be little!
But it needs to be small, little would look bad.
translation: Ama kücük olmali, minicik kötü görünür.

english: It wouldn't look bad. Small is better for decorations.
translation: Kötü görünmez. Dekorasyon icin kücük olan daha iyi.

english: My decorations will fit on a little one.
Why do you always ruin everything?
You ruin everything with your silly ideas!
translation: Sen aptal fikirlerinle her seyi mahvediyorsun!

english: Okay, okay, wait. This clearly isn't working, and I don't want you two to fall out. It's Christmas, we shouldn't be arguing!
translation: Tamam, tamam, durun. Bu acikca ise yaramiyor ve ikinizin kavga etmesini istemiyorum. Noel'deyiz, tartismamaliyiz!

english: How about I make you both a snowman? It can be whatever height and size you like. One each!
translation: Ikinize de birer kardan adam yapmaya ne dersiniz? Istediginiz boyda ve büyüklükte olabilir. Her birinize bir tane!

english: So mine can be five snowballs tall?
translation: Benimki bes kar topu yüksekliginde olabilir mi?

english: And mine can be three snowballs tall?
translation: Benimki üc kar topu yüksekliginde olabilir mi?

english: Yes, I'll make you both whatever snowman you like!
translation: Evet, ikinize de istediginiz kardan adami yapacagim!

english: What would you both like?
I'd like mine to be three snowballs tall please! And I want the bottom one to be small, the middle one big, and the top one huge!
translation: Benimki üc kar topu yüksekliginde olsun lütfen! Altta kücük, ortada büyük ve en üstte devasa olsun istiyorum!

english: I'd like mine to be five snowballs tall please! I want the bottom one to be humongous, then large, then normal, then big, and then a little one for the top!
translation: Benimki bes kar topu yüksekliginde olsun lütfen! Altta devasa, sonra büyük, sonra normal, sonra büyük ve en üstte kücük olsun istiyorum!

english: That's two very different snowmen, I see why this didn't work before!
translation: Bunlar cok farkli iki kardan adam, neden daha önce ise yaramadigini anliyorum!

english: What do all these different sizes mean? Humongous? Normal? Little? How big are those?
translation: Bu farkli boyutlar ne anlama geliyor? Kocaman? Normal? Kücük? Bunlar ne kadar büyük?

english: You silly billy! Humongous is the biggest snowball of course!
translation: Seni sapsal! Kocaman tabii ki en büyük kar topu!

english: Normal is the normal size that you get when you make a snowball normally. It's easy!
translation: Normal, normal bir kar topu yaptiginda elde ettigin normal boyuttur. Cok kolay!

english: Right, thank you for clearing that up. I'll figure something out.
translation: Tamam, acikliga kavusturdugun icin tesekkürler. Bir seyler bulurum.

english: What are you two going to do for decorations?
translation: Siz ikiniz süslemeler icin ne yapacaksiniz?

english: I already know what I want mine to look like!
Me too!
Why don't you guys find some decorations while I build the snowmen? Then you can add them once I'm done.
translation: Ben kardan adamlari yaparken siz de süslemeler bulmaya ne dersiniz? Ben bitirince onlari ekleyebilirsiniz.

english: Okay sir!
We will do that!
Well, that seems sorted. I should speak to Larry again, and see if he has any advice about building the snowmen.
translation: Görünüse göre her sey halloldu. Larry ile tekrar konusup kardan adam yapma konusunda tavsiyesi var mi diye bakmaliyim.

english: Hello there!
Have you started making the snowmen yet?
You should talk to dad if you need some help, he knows how to make snowmen!
translation: Yardima ihtiyaciniz olursa babamla konusun, o kardan adam yapmayi bilir!

english: Yeah, he always used to make really big ones with us!
translation: Evet, eskiden bizimle birlikte cok büyük kardan adamlar yapardi!

english: Maybe I'll go talk to him and see what advice he has.
translation: Gidip onunla konusayim, ne tavsiye verecek bakalim.

english: He'll say, make them really tall!
He'll say make them shorter, because that's better!
translation: Daha kisa yapin diyecek, cünkü öyle daha iyi!

english: I should go and speak to Larry. I'm sure he has some handy advice for me!
translation: Gidip Larry ile konusmaliyim. Eminim bana yararli tavsiyeler verecektir!

english: That looks good! It needs a [size] snowball next!
They're done! They're so cool!
Yay! Can we decorate them now?
Yes! Can we decorate them now please [player name]?
translation: Evet! Simdi süsleyebilir miyiz lütfen Maceraci?

english: Of course you can. Are they what you wanted?
translation: Tabii ki süsleyebilirsiniz. Istediginiz gibi oldular mi?

english: Mine is perfect!
Mine too. It's just how I wanted it.
translation: Benimki de. Tam istedigim gibi oldu.

english: I am happy to hear that. It was harder work than I thought.
translation: Bunu duyduguma sevindim. Düsündügümden daha zor oldu.

english: You did a good job. Thank you very much [sir/madam].
translation: Iyi is cikardiniz. Cok tesekkür ederim .

english: Yes, thank you [sir/madam]!
It was no problem. Merry Christmas to you both!
translation: Önemli degil. Ikinize de mutlu Noeller!

english: I should go and speak to Larry. Hopefully he has that festive white wine ready for me.
translation: Gidip Larry ile konusmaliyim. Umarim benim icin o senlikli beyaz sarabi hazirlamistir.

english: Those snowmen look amazing!
Thank you! Decorating them was quite hard!
Yeah, they took ages to do! Do you like mine?
translation: Evet, yapmasi cok uzun sürdü! Benimkini begendin mi?

english: It's really good! Reminds me of something actually.
translation: Gercekten cok güzel! Aslinda bana bir seyi hatirlatiyor.

english: What about mine? Do you like it?
I like yours too. They both remind me of something!
translation: Seninkini de begendim. Ikisi de bana bir seyi hatirlatiyor!

english: Mine is Thermy! My favourite monster! She's so big and scary, makes me go woah!
translation: Benimki Thermy! En sevdigim canavar! O kadar büyük ve korkutucu ki, beni hayrete düsürüyor!

english: Mine is Tempy! My favourite monster! He lives in the water, a huge mass of angry wet!
translation: Benimki Tempy! En sevdigim canavar! Suda yasiyor, kocaman, öfkeli bir islaklik!

english: They're both amazing! I didn't know you guys would be so good at decorating.
translation: Ikisi de harika! Sizin süsleme konusunda bu kadar iyi oldugunuzu bilmiyordum.

english: Dad lets us decorate every year. We get a lot of practice!
translation: Babam her yil süslememize izin veriyor. Cok pratik yapiyoruz!

english: Last year we made them into the Fragment of Seren and the King Black Dragon!
translation: Gecen yil onlari Seren Parcasi ve Kral Kara Ejderha yaptik!

english: What... really??? I'd like to have seen that. Those sound even more difficult than these two!
translation: Ne... gercekten mi??? Onlari görmek isterdim. Bunlardan daha da zor görünüyorlar!

english: How do you know all these monsters anyway? There is no way your dad would let you anywhere near them!
translation: Bu canavarlari nereden biliyorsunuz ki? Babaniz sizi onlara yaklastirmaz ki!

english: Dad reads us lots of stories, and we hear about them from passing adventurers, like you.
translation: Babam bize bircok hikaye okur ve sizin gibi gecen maceracilardan da onlar hakkinda bilgiler aliriz.

english: You must meet some interesting and cool adventurers!
translation: Ilginc ve havali maceracilarla tanisiyor olmalisiniz!

english: Not as cool as you though; none of them helped us make our snowmen!
translation: Ama sizin kadar havali degiller; hicbiri kar adamlarimizi yapmamiza yardim etmedi!

english: Yes, you're the first to help us make them!
translation: Evet, bize yardim eden ilk kisi sensin!

english: Well, you're welcome. I really enjoyed it. What are you guys going to do now you're finished?
translation: Rica ederim. Cok eglendim. Simdi isiniz bittigine göre ne yapacaksiniz?

english: We're going to go and play! And maybe visit the festival. Will you be there?
translation: Oynamaya gidecegiz! Belki festivale de gideriz. Sen de gelecek misin?

english: I sure will be. Maybe see you there!
translation: Tabii ki gelecegim. Belki orada görüsürüz!

english: Bye sir, Merry Christmas.
Merry Christmas, have fun!
Hello.
Be vigilant, citizen.
Err, right.
Buy ush a drink.
I think you have had enough.
Pleash, buy ush a drink.
How you holding up Burntof? Must have had quite the fright when you woke that monster.
translation: Nasilsin Burntof? O canavari uyandirdiginda oldukca korkmus olmalisin.

english: You're right [lad/lass]. It did give me a little fright.
But I saw some interesting things down in the ruins...
What do you mean?
Some of the markings on the wall look very familiar to me. I've seen them before.
translation: Duvardaki bazi isaretler bana cok tanidik geldi. Onlari daha önce görmüstüm.

english: Well, when I defeated the monster, an Imcando dwarf opened the barred door...
translation: Canavari yendigimde, bir Imcando cücesi parmaklikli kapiyi acti...

english: An Imcando dwarf! I thought they were all but extinct! You've found something truly amazing [player name]!
translation: Bir Imcando cücesi! Onlarin neslinin tükendigini saniyordum! Gercekten inanilmaz bir sey bulmussun Maceraci!

english: I wish I had a drink to celebrate, but this desert is bone dry.
translation: Kutlamak icin bir icki icmek isterdim, ama bu cöl kurumus.

english: How's it going, Butch?
Ah... How could I forget... You don't have a head!
translation: Ah... Nasil unutabilirim... Senin kafan yok ki!

english: Shall we head off on an adventure together?
Sorry, poor choice of words.
translation: Üzgünüm, yanlis bir kelime secimi oldu.

english: Can you speak?
Yes...
Er... Who's speaking? Is this Butch, or something else?
translation: Sey... Kim konusuyor? Bu Butch mu, yoksa baska biri mi?

english: That's unsettling.
Good day, [sir/madam]. Would [sir/madam] care to hire a good butler for 5000 coins?
translation: Iyi günler, . 5000 sikke karsiliginda iyi bir usak tutmak ister misiniz?

english: What can you do?

I can fulfill all [sir/madam]'s domestic service needs with efficiency and impeccable manners. I hate to boast, but I can say with confidence that no mortal can make trips to the bank or sawmill faster than I!
translation: nin tüm ev hizmetleri ihtiyaclarini verimli ve kusursuz bir sekilde karsilayabilirim. Övünmek istemem ama, hicbir ölümlü benim kadar hizli bir sekilde bankaya veya kereste fabrikasina gidip gelemez!

english: Tell me about your previous jobs.
From a humble beginning as a dish-washer I have worked my way up through the ranks of domestic service in the households of nobles from Varrock and Ardougne. As a life-long servant I have naturally
translation: Bulasikci olarak mütevazi bir baslangictan sonra, Varrock ve Ardougne'daki soylularin evlerinde ev hizmetleri alaninda yükselerek kariyer yaptim. Hayatim boyunca hizmetci olarak calistigim icin, dogal olarak

english: suppressed any personality of my own and trained myself never to use the second person when talking to a superior. I have usually worked in the large households of the aristocracy, but now that such a large
translation: kendi kisiligimi bastirdim ve üstlerimle konusurken asla ikinci sahis zamirini kullanmamayi ögrendim. Genellikle aristokrasinin büyük evlerinde calistim, ama artik bu kadar cok sayida

english: number of private persons are building their own houses I decided to offer them my services.
translation: özel kisi kendi evlerini insa ettigi icin onlara hizmetlerimi sunmaya karar verdim.

english: I must respectfully decline, [sir/madam]. I offer a very exclusive service and will only work for people with over level 40 Construction.
translation: Saygiyla reddetmek zorundayim, . Cok özel bir hizmet sunuyorum ve sadece 40 seviyenin üzerinde Insaat becerisine sahip kisiler icin calisiyorum.

english: You already have a servant.
You need a second bedroom with a bed for your servant to sleep in.
translation: Hizmetcinizin yatabilecegi ikinci bir yatak odasina ihtiyaciniz var.

english: You're hired... well, I don't have the money on me, but can I owe you? I'm good for it, honest.
translation: Ise alindiniz... Sey, üzerimde para yok, ama size borclanabilir miyim? Ödeyecegim, gercekten.

english: I regret that I cannot agree to begin my duties until I have been paid.
translation: Ödeme yapilana kadar göreve baslayamayacagim icin üzgünüm.

english: Thank you, [sir/madam]. I can start work immediately.
You rang, [sir/madam]?
Yes, [sir/madam]?
Very good, [sir/madam]. [Sir/Madam]'s tea will be ready shortly.
translation: Cok iyi, . 'nin cayi birazdan hazir olacak.

english: The Butler prepares tea
Your tea, [sir/madam]. Does [sir/madam] take milk?
Yes please.
No thanks.
Very good, [sir/madam].
I regret that I cannot make a meal unless [sir/madam] has a dining table for me to serve it on.
translation: nin servis yapabilecegim bir yemek masasi olmadigi icin yemek hazirlayamayacagim icin üzgünüm.

english: Serve drinks please.
I cannot serve drinks unless you have a kitchen with an ale barrel, [sir/madam].
translation: , mutfaginizda bira ficisi olmadigi icin icecekleri servis edemem.

english: Can you fetch something from the bank for me?
translation: Banka'dan benim icin bir sey getirebilir misiniz?

english: Certainly, [sir/madam]. If [sir/madam] would simply tell me the items [he/she] requires?
translation: Elbette, .  bana istedigi esyalari söyler misiniz?

english: The Butler fetches the requested item(s)
Your goods, [sir/madam].
Certainly, [sir/madam]. If [sir/madam] would care to give me the logs?
Stay at the entrance and greet guests.
[Task]
If you do not pay me I will have to give you my notice, sir. My fee is 5000 coins.
translation: Bana ödeme yapmazsaniz istifa etmek zorunda kalacagim efendim. Ücretim 5000 altin.

english: Okay here's 5000 coins.
Thank you sir.
Your goods sir.
I'll pay you later.
You're fired!
Very well, sir.
Shall I take that to the bank, [sir/madam]?
The Butler takes the requested item(s) to the bank
No
Shall I take that to the bank or to the sawmill, [sir/madam]?
translation: Bunu bankaya mi yoksa kereste fabrikasina mi götüreyim, ?

english: The sawmill's fee would be [x], [sir/madam].
The Butler takes the requested log(s) to the sawmill
translation: Usak istenen kütükleri kereste fabrikasina götürür.

english: Never mind.
[player name] is entertaining in the [room]. Would [sir/madam] care to follow me?
Butler transports the player to host

Tell me about your previous jobs
You're hired!
Serve...

Good day [sir/madam].
Hello. I'm helping Lord Hosidius find his missing son. I was wondering if you could help me.
translation: Merhaba. Lord Hosidius'un kayip oglunu bulmasina yardim ediyorum. Bana yardim edebilir misiniz acaba?

english: I'm afraid I know not where Artur has gone. I do not speak to him much. He keeps himself to himself.
translation: Maalesef Artur'un nereye gittigini bilmiyorum. Onunla pek konusmam. Kendine kapali biridir.

english: However, I've noticed him speaking to Olivia before. Maybe she can help.
translation: Ancak daha önce Olivia ile konustugunu görmüstüm. Belki o yardimci olabilir.

english: Great, thanks.
Good day [sir/madam]. I hope your quest is going well.
translation: Iyi günler . Umarim arayisiniz iyi gidiyordur.

english: Good day [sir/madam]. On behalf of the Hosidius family, I thank you for bringing Artur home.
translation: Iyi günler . Hosidius ailesi adina, Artur'u eve getirdiginiz icin tesekkür ederim.

english: Good day [sir/madam]. I'm afraid I can't stop to talk. The new Lord Hosidius has plenty of work for me.
translation: Iyi günler . Maalesef konusmak icin duramam. Yeni Lord Hosidius'un bana yapacak cok isi var.

english: Hello there.
Hello. How are you today?
Good thank you, and yourself?
Very well, thank you.
Hello stranger.
Why hello there.
I take it you're the new butler...?
That's right. I hear that they had some problems with the last one.
translation: Dogru. Son usakla bazi sorunlar yasadiklarini duydum.

english: Yes, you could say that...
It's an honour to be in your presence again, adventurer. I hope things are well?
translation: Sizinle tekrar karsilasmak bir onur, maceraci. Umarim her sey yolundadir?

english: Not bad, thanks. Yourself?
Unfortunately, I am still forced to deal with this insufferable family. Many generations have passed, but they are still the enemy. As such, they must be kept a close eye on.
translation: Maalesef, hala bu cekilmez aileyle ugrasmak zorundayim. Bircok nesil gecti, ama onlar hala düsman. Bu yüzden, onlari yakindan takip etmek gerekiyor.

english: Still, I have no doubt that the time will soon come for me to leave this place. Our lord will certainly have need of me elsewhere once his current work is complete.
translation: Yine de, buradan ayrilma zamanimin yakinda geleceginden süphem yok. Efendimiz, su anki isi bittiginde, baska bir yerde bana ihtiyac duyacaktir.

english: I see. Well good luck with it all.
Hey, human.
Who are you?
Not much to say. Came to Weiss with other trolls when we got kicked out of caves further south, but I was just young troll then.
translation: Söyleyecek pek bir sey yok. Daha güneydeki magaralardan kovuldugumuzda diger trollerle birlikte Weiss'a geldim, ama o zamanlar daha genc bir trolüm.

english: Mostly been enjoying living round Weiss, 'cos wildlife is interesting here.
translation: Weiss'ta yasamaktan cogunlukla keyif aliyorum, cünkü buradaki vahsi yasam ilginc.

english: Tell me about this place.
This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: Burasi Weiss. Troller yillar önce, daha güneydeki magaralardan kovulduktan sonra burayi insa etti. Simdi Weiss bizim evimiz.

english: We done pretty good here. Got lots of goat and wolf to eat - they taste kinda boring after all this time, but there not much other choice.
translation: Burada oldukca iyi durumdayiz. Yemek icin bolca keci ve kurt var - bunca zaman sonra tadi biraz sikici geliyor ama baska secenegimiz yok.

english: Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it. In fact My Arm is an expert on growing the stuff.
translation: Goutweed denedin mi hic? Onu seven troller taniyorum. Aslinda My Arm bu bitkinin yetistirilmesinde uzmandir.

english: Never heard of no gouty weed, no. But it sound like a vegetable, an' Mother not like eating those, so we probably not gonna try it.
translation: Gouty weed diye bir sey duymadim. Ama sebzeye benziyor ve annem sebze yemeyi sevmez, o yüzden muhtemelen denemeyecegiz.

english: Mother not like new ideas much, but he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: Annem yeni fikirleri pek sevmez, ama o cok büyük ve patron, bu yüzden ne derse onu yapariz.

english: I see.
Do you like it here?
Eh, it kinda rough, but it our home. Odd Mushroom say he can make it nicer with fancy fires what he invented, but Mother not interested in that, so Odd Mushroom not allowed to do it.
translation: Eh, biraz zorlu, ama burasi bizim evimiz. Odd Mushroom, icat ettigi süslü ateslerle burayi daha güzel hale getirebilecegini söylüyor, ama annem bununla ilgilenmiyor, bu yüzden Odd Mushroom bunu yapamiyor.

english: Mother only care about stuff to help him fight better. An he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: Annem sadece onun daha iyi savasmasina yardimci olacak seylerle ilgileniyor. O cok büyük ve patron, bu yüzden ne derse onu yapiyoruz.

english: I'll be off.
Hey, friend of Snowflake!
It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: Burasi harika, simdi Snowflake ve kocasi troll bize goutweed yetistirmeyi ögretti. Yemekler artik cok daha lezzetli.

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: Eh, biraz zorlu ama gittikce iyilesiyor. Snowflake bize goutweed yetistirmeyi ögretti. Keci, kurt, insan, hepsi goutweed ile cok daha lezzetli oluyor.

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: Evet, Weiss yasamak icin iyi bir yer, artik Snowflake sorumlu. Tüm troller Snowflake'i sever. Kocasi biraz tuhaf ama bu bizim sorunumuz degil.

english: Who are you?
Tell me about this place.
Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it.
translation: Goutweed denedin mi hic? Onu seven troller taniyorum.

english: Do you like it here?
I'll be off.
I see.
Would you like some help?
Urgh, it just happened again! Every time I almost have it my hand slips.
translation: Urgh, yine oldu! Her seferinde neredeyse basaracagim derken elim kayiyor.

english: Oh, that's unfortunate. Are you using a lockpick?
translation: Oh, ne yazik. Kilit acici mi kullaniyorsun?

english: Yes. Well actually, I'm using a Strange old lockpick. I found it while looting one of these coffins and I typically have better luck with it.
translation: Evet. Aslinda, garip bir eski kilit acici kullaniyorum. Bu tabutlardan birini yagmalarken buldum ve genelde onunla daha sansliyim.

english: Oh, that's interesting. I'll keep my eyes out for one.
translation: Oh, ilginc. Ben de bir tane arayacagim.

english: I've found a few of them while raiding this place. There appear to be more of them on this floor than the floors above.
translation: Bu yeri yagmalarken birkac tane buldum. Bu katta, üst katlara göre daha fazla var gibi görünüyor.

english: I see. If you don't mind me asking, you already have dark graceful so why are you still looking for hallowed marks?
translation: Anliyorum. Sorun olmazsa, zaten karanlik zarafetine sahipsin, neden hala kutsal isaretler ariyorsun?

english: Oh, it's because of this little fellow following me. I've heard that the Dark acorn sold by the guy upstairs will transform him into a Dark Squirrel.
translation: Oh, cünkü bu kücük dostum beni takip ediyor. Yukaridaki adamin sattigi karanlik mese palamudu onu karanlik sincap haline getirecekmis.

english: Wow, I didn't know that! That sounds pretty cool.
translation: Vay canina, bunu bilmiyordum! Kulaga cok hos geliyor.

english: Yeah, that's what I thought but that mysterious stranger is asking for 3,000 Hallowed marks for it.
translation: Evet, ben de öyle düsündüm ama o gizemli yabanci bunun icin 3.000 kutsal isaret istiyor.

english: 3,000? That sounds extortionate!
Yeah, that's what I thought. Feels like he set the price just to keep me down here for longer. Still, it's not like I have anything better to do.
translation: Evet, ben de öyle düsündüm. Sanki beni burada daha uzun süre tutmak icin bu fiyati belirlemis gibi. Yine de, yapacak daha iyi bir isim yok.

english: I see, well best of luck. Hopefully you survive long enough to finish your goal.
translation: Anliyorum, bol sanslar. Umarim amacini gerceklestirmek icin yeterince uzun süre hayatta kalirsin.

english: I'm sure I'll be fine.
Yeah, I ended up buying one myself and fed it to my Giant Squirrel. It took a while but it was definitely worth it.
translation: Evet, ben de bir tane satin alip Dev Sincap'ima yedirdim. Biraz zaman aldi ama kesinlikle degdi.

english: Wow, I'm impressed! How long did it take you to get the 3,000 marks?
translation: Vay canina, cok etkilendim! 3.000 marki toplamak ne kadar sürdü?

english: Long enough... Still, at least I feel much more agile now than when I started.
translation: Yeterince uzun... Yine de, en azindan basladigim zamana göre simdi cok daha cevik hissediyorum.

english: I don't think I'm going to get any more agile while looking for it myself. I'm glad you received some benefit from the grind though.
translation: Kendim ararken daha fazla ceviklik kazanacagimi sanmiyorum. Yine de bu ugrastan bir fayda sagladigin icin sevindim.

english: You shouldn't feed someone's pet without their permission.
translation: Birinin izni olmadan evcil hayvanini beslememelisin.

english: C'mon, almost got it...
Agh, thought I had it that time!
C'mon, almost got it...
Having problems?
Can't you see I'm busy?
Do you have a lockpick?
No and even if I did have one I wouldn't give it to you!
I already have one. I was just letting you know that having a lockpick helps when getting into these coffins. You appear to be struggling.
translation: Zaten var. Sadece bu tabutlara girmek icin havana yardimci oldugunu bilmeni istedim. Zorlaniyor gibisin.

english: I was just letting you know that having a lockpick helps when getting into these coffins. You appear to be struggling.
translation: Sadece bu tabutlara girmek icin kilit acma aletinin yardimci olacagini söylemek istedim. Zorlaniyor gibisin.

english: Wait, are you serious? The last adventurer I spoke to down here told me that lockpicks don't help!
translation: Bekle, ciddi misin? Burada konustugum son maceraci kilit acma aletinin yardimci olmadigini söylemisti!

english: Yes I'm serious. Also that outfit you're wearing doesn't help you get more loot from these coffins either.
translation: Evet, ciddiyim. Ayrica giydigin kiyafet de bu tabutlardan daha fazla ganimet elde etmene yardimci olmuyor.

english: They lied about that too? I feel like a fool!
translation: Onlar da mi yalan söyledi? Kendimi aptal gibi hissediyorum!

english: At least you look cool dressed like that though.
translation: En azindan bu kiyafetle havali görünüyorsun.

english: Who cares about that? If it doesn't work then I should just wear the full graceful outfit since that would be much more efficient.
translation: Kimin umurunda? Eger ise yaramiyorsa, daha verimli olacagi icin tam zarafet kiyafetini giymeliyim.

english: Each to their own I suppose.
Ahhh, harvest day!
I sure can't wait to feed my family with these hard-earned cabba-
translation: Ailemi bu zor kazanilmis lahanalarla beslemek icin sabirsizlaniyorum...

english: No! What have you done?!
The farmer performs the Cry emote.
Urgh...
He looks too sick to chat.
Hello again. Coming back to Corsair Cove?
translation: Merhaba tekrar. Corsair Cove'a mi dönüyorsun?

english: Yes please.
The ship sails to Corsair Cove...
Not just now, thanks.
The Captain's letting me command his boat now I'm fully recovered. Did you want to leave?
translation: Kaptan, tamamen iyilestigim icin gemisini bana emanet ediyor. Ayrilmak mi istiyorsun?

english: Please take me back to Rimmington.
The ship sails to Rimmington...
I'll talk to you later.
Yes please.
Not just now, thanks.
Please take me back to Rimmington.
I'll talk to you later.
Hey.
Hey there. If you need something, you should speak to Veos. I'm just the cabin boy.
translation: Selam. Bir seye ihtiyacin varsa Veos'la konusmalisin. Ben sadece gemici cocuguyum.

english: Fair enough.
Hey. Veos left something for you. Here you go.
translation: Hey. Veos sana bir sey birakti. Al bakalim.

english: Can you take me somewhere?
I'm afraid that you're not eligible to travel to Great Kourend at the moment. Come back when you are and I'll happily take you there.
translation: Maalesef su anda Great Kourend'e seyahat etmeye uygun degilsin. Uygun oldugunda geri gel, seni seve seve oraya götürürüm.

english: Where would you like to go?
I'd like to travel to Port Sarim, please.
As you wish, I hope you don't get seasick, it is a long voyage.
translation: Nasil istersen, umarim deniz tutmazsin, uzun bir yolculuk olacak.

english: I'd like to travel to Port Piscarilius, please.
As you wish.
I'd like to travel to Land's End, please.
Actually I'd like to stay here.
I'm good.
Hey there. Do you need something?
translation: Merhaba. Bir seye ihtiyacin var mi?

english: Can you take me somewhere?
Travel to Port Sarim.
Travel to Port Piscarilius.
Travel to Land's End.
Stay where you are.
I'm good.
Hi.
I bet you're after another lens!
How could you possibly know that?
Hey, I think I'm learning a thing or two from these Moon Clan ladies.
translation: Hey, sanirim Moon Clan kadinlarindan bir iki sey ögreniyorum.

english: Oi! I need another lens, boy.
translation: Hey! Baska bir lense ihtiyacim var, evlat.

english: But you don't have space.
Good point.
Huh, oh ok, I suppose I owe you one.
I think I'll pass. But thanks..
So you've plucked up the courage to come and confront that girl!
translation: Demek o kizla yüzlesmek icin cesaretini topladin!

english: That I did, that I did!
And?
She turned out to be really nice! She's joining us to become a pirate!
translation: Aslinda cok iyi biri cikti! Bize katilip korsan olacak!

english: Really? And you're not sceptical about this? You know, after what she did last time?
translation: Gercekten mi? Ve buna süpheyle yaklasmiyorsun? Gecen sefer yaptiklarindan sonra?

english: She---has---no---spell---on---me.
Huh? Why are you talking like that?
Like what?
Like someone else was talking for you. Are you sure she hasn't put a spell on you again? Did she wave a watch in front of your face? You know, tell you to look deep into her eyes?
translation: Sanki baska biri senin adina konusuyormus gibi. Sana yine büyü yapmadigindan emin misin? Yüzüne saat salladi mi? Bilirsin, gözlerinin icine bakmani söyledi mi?

english: I think you've been hypnotised. I wonder what happens if I click my fingers?
translation: Bence hipnotize oldun. Parmaklarimi siklatsam ne olur acaba?

english: *click*
*Cluck* *cluck* *bwaarrk*
Oh dear. Oh well, I'm sure you'll learn one day.
translation: Oh hayir. Neyse, bir gün ögreneceksin eminim.

english: Please
No thanks
Hello there; I see you're qualified. Come to help us out?
translation: Merhaba, nitelikli oldugunu görüyorum. Bize yardim etmeye mi geldin?

english: Hello! You're that student who recently finished all three Earth Sciences exams, aren't you? Come to help us out?
translation: Merhaba! Sen yakin zamanda üc Earth Sciences sinavini da bitiren ögrenci, degil mi? Bize yardim etmeye mi geldin?

english: Greetings, my dear [sir/madam]. Have you come to give us a hand?
translation: Selamlar, sevgili . Bize yardim etmeye mi geldin?

english: Yes, how can I help out?

Well, you'll need to get your equipment first - it's all there on the tool rack. Use what you learned from your Earth Sciences exams. You'll need to be wearing your leather gloves and boots as well as have access to
translation: Öncelikle ekipmanlarinizi almaniz gerekiyor - hepsi alet rafinda duruyor. Yer Bilimleri sinavlarinda ögrendiklerinizi kullanin. Deri eldivenlerinizi ve botlarinizi giymeniz ve

english: your trowel, rock pick and specimen brush.
translation: kürek, kaya kazma ve numune fircaniza erisiminiz olmasi gerekiyor.

english: I see you have your equipment - well done.

To really give us a hand, you could clean some finds for us. They're mostly done - just some fine work to finish off. Take a find from the pile that the workmen are bringing in, then there are spare tables over there
translation: Bize gercekten yardim etmek istiyorsan, bazi buluntulari temizleyebilirsin. Cogu isleri bitti, sadece son rötuslar kaldi. Isciler getirdigi yigindan bir buluntu al, sonra surada temizlemek icin bos masalar var.

english: to clean them on. If you find anything interesting, let us know and we'll see if it's good enough to go on display.
translation: Ilginc bir sey bulursan bize haber ver, sergilenmeye deger olup olmadigini bakariz.

english: I found something interesting.
Oh? Let's take a look...
I found this pretty necklace.
Interesting...yes...yes...hmmm.... It looks like it's enchanted.
translation: Ilginc... evet... evet... hmmm.... Büyülü gibi görünüyor.

english: With what?

Oh, I think it's just a benign teleportation spell. I tinker in magic when I'm not doing archaeology. I can teach you how to make more necklaces like this. Amazing that they had this kind of knowledge back then.
translation: Oh, sanirim sadece zararsiz bir isinlanma büyüsü. Arkeolojiyle ugrasmadigim zamanlarda büyüyle ugrasirim. Sana bunun gibi daha fazla kolye yapmayi ögretebilirim. O zamanlar bu tür bilgilere sahip olmalari sasirtici.

english: That would be good. Where is the teleport to?
translation: Bu iyi olur. Isinlanma nereye oluyor?

english: Hmm...all the indications are that it's somewhere to the east of us, but I'm not sure how far. Perhaps it was a teleport back to Saranthium. Let me just take a closer look.
translation: Hmm... tüm isaretler bunun bizim dogumuzda bir yere oldugunu gösteriyor, ama ne kadar uzak oldugunu bilmiyorum. Belki de Saranthium'a geri isinlanma yapiyordu. Bir daha yakindan bakayim.

english: So I just make a ruby necklace and use five fire runes and one cosmic rune to enchant it.
translation: Yani bir yakut kolye yapip, bes ates runesi ve bir kozmik runesi kullanarak onu büyülüyorum.

english: Yes, indeed. Well done, youngster, thanks for helping us.
translation: Evet, aynen öyle. Aferin genc adam, yardim ettigin icin tesekkürler.

english: I've cleaned this old coin - is it of any use?
translation: Bu eski parayi temizledim, bir ise yarar mi?

english: Oh my! What a wonderful find! If this is what I believe it to be, it would allow us to date the Dig Site city.
translation: Vay canina! Ne harika bir buluntu! Eger tahmin ettigim gibi ise, kazi alanindaki sehrin tarihini belirlememizi saglayacak.

english: And look here, it has the name of the city too! Saranthium! That must be during the Saradominist occupation. This is a wonderful find. Please take it and place it in display case 45.
translation: Bakin, üzerinde sehrin adi da yaziyor! Saranthium! Saradominist isgali sirasinda olmali. Bu harika bir buluntu. Lütfen al ve 45 numarali vitrine koy.

english: Right, display case 45 it is...
Back again? Have you put the old coin in display case 45 yet?
translation: Yine mi geldin? Eski parayi 45 numarali vitrine koydun mu?

english: No, I'll go do that now
You've already shown me one of those, but it was in better condition. It's in the display case over there. You can pop this one in the finds crate over in the corner.
translation: Bana onlardan birini göstermistin, ama o daha iyi durumdaydi. Suradaki vitrinde. Bunu kösedeki buluntu sandigina koyabilirsin.

english: I found this really old coin - is it of any use?
translation: Cok eski bir sikke buldum, bir ise yarar mi?

english: What have we here?

Oh! This is very interesting...and confusing at the same time. This coin means that the city that we're excavating on the Digsite - Saranthium - was actually inhabited much, much earlier by followers of Zamorak,
translation: Oh! Bu cok ilginc... ama ayni zamanda kafa karistirici. Bu sikke, kazi alaninda kazi yaptigimiz sehir olan Saranthium'un aslinda cok daha önceden Zamorak'in takipcileri tarafindan iskan edildigini gösteriyor.

english: at which time, the city was known as Senntisten.
translation: O zamanlar sehir Senntisten olarak biliniyordu.

english: This is a most remarkable discovery, as we have other evidence indicating that Zarosian followers were resident before the Saradominists took over, but it also seems that Zamorakian forces used it during a battle of some
translation: Bu cok önemli bir kesif, cünkü Saradoministlerin yönetimi ele gecirmeden önce Zaros'un takipcilerinin burada yasadigini gösteren baska kanitlar da var, ama ayni zamanda Zamorak'in güclerinin bir tür savas sirasinda burayi kullandigi da anlasiliyor.

english: sort. Still, it allows us to roughly date when the city changed from following Zaros and Zamorak to following Saradomin. Put it in display case 44.
translation: Yine de, bu kesif, sehrin Zaros ve Zamorak'i takip etmekten Saradomin'i takip etmeye gectigi tarihi yaklasik olarak belirlememizi sagliyor. Bunu 44 numarali vitrine koy.

english: Case 44 it is!
Back again? Have you put the ancient coin in display case 44 yet?
translation: Yine mi geldin? Eski parayi vitrin 44'e koydun mu?

english: No, I'll go do that now.
I found this crumbly old decoration - is it of any use?
translation: Bu ufalanmis eski süslemeyi buldum, bir ise yarar mi?

english: Ahh... That looks like an altar piece. Hmm, yes...from the early Saradominist worshippers by the looks of it. Quite delicate, too. Put it in display case 37.
translation: Ahh... Bu bir sunak parcasi gibi görünüyor. Hmm, evet... Görünüse göre Saradoministlerin ilk takipcilerine ait. Oldukca narin de. Vitrin 37'ye koy.

english: Case 37 it is!
Back again? Have you put the ancient symbol in display case 37 yet?
translation: Yine mi geldin? Eski sembolü 37 numarali vitrine koydun mu?

english: I found this really old decoration - is it of any use?
translation: Bu cok eski bir süsleme buldum, ise yarar mi?

english: Wow!
That's in rather good condition, isn't it? An old altar decoration by the looks of things, from the Saradominist city no doubt. Put it in display case 36.
translation: Durumu oldukca iyi, degil mi? Görünüse göre eski bir sunak süslemesi, süphesiz Saradominist sehirden. 36 numarali vitrine koy.

english: Case 36 it is!
Back again? Have you put the old symbol in display case 36 yet?
translation: Yine mi geldin? Eski sembolü 36 numarali vitrine koydun mu?

english: I found this piece of pottery - is it of any use?
translation: Bu cömlek parcasini buldum, bir ise yarar mi?

english: Ahh... Oh! Hmm...yes...made by Zaros worshippers, by the looks of it. Beautifully-shaped. It looks as if this would go nicely in display case 22. This piece reinforces our evidence that the city was occupied by
translation: Ahh... Oh! Hmm... evet... görünüse göre Zaros'a tapanlar tarafindan yapilmis. Cok güzel sekilli. 22 numarali vitrine cok yakisacak gibi görünüyor. Bu parca, sehrin Saradoministlerden önce Zaroslular tarafindan isgal edildigine dair kanitlarimizi güclendiriyor.

english: Zarosians before Saradominists.
Case 22 it is!
translation: Yine mi geldin? Cömlegi 22 numarali vitrine koydun mu?

english: Back again? Have you put the pottery in display case 22 yet?
translation: Yine mi geldin? Cömlegi 22 numarali vitrine koydun mu?

english: I found these old arrowheads.
Ahh, yes, we find lots of those - they're not important. We already have some in our display. Just add it to the crate of finds over near the door.
translation: Ahh, evet, bunlardan cok buluyoruz - önemli degiller. Vitrinde zaten var. Kapinin yanindaki buluntu sandigina koy.

english: If there is anything already in the crate, feel free to take it as a reward for your work.
translation: Sandikta zaten bir sey varsa, calismanin karsiligi olarak alabilirsin.

english: Oh, okay.
Take a look at this...
I found these old necklaces.
An interesting find... Here, let me offer you something in return.
translation: Ilginc bir buluntu... Al, sana karsiliginda bir sey vereyim.

english: Oh! Okay.
I cleaned up this old vase.
Ah, the vases... I've lost count of how many we've found of those... The only completely intact one is in the display case already. Just add it to the crate of finds over near the door.
translation: Ah, vazolar... Kac tane buldugumuzu sayamadim bile... Tamamen saglam olan tek vazo zaten vitrinde. Kapinin yanindaki buluntu sandigina koy.

english: Right.
Err... I seem to have lost it. Sorry.
Sounds like you never had it, [lad/lass]!
translation: Sanki hic sahip olmamissin gibi geliyor, !

english: No, just here to watch.
Thank you, but I don't need that
Yes, how can I help out?
I found something interesting.
No thanks.
Are you interested in buying or selling spice?
No thanks.
Hey! Get your hands off there!
You're the one who stole something from me!
Guards guards!
Yes please.
No thanks.
You try to pet the bird, but it pecks your hand in return.
translation: Kusu oksamaya çalisirsiniz, ama o da elinizi gagalar.

english: Ouch!
Have I seen you before?
I don't think so... I've just got one of those faces.
translation: Sanmiyorum... Yüzüm öyle bir yüz iste.

english: You're probably right.
I'm rather busy at the moment. I've got to organise my cupboards of jewels.
translation: Su anda oldukca mesgulüm. Mücevher dolaplarimi düzenlemem gerekiyor.

english: Want any help?
Absolutely not! You stay away from my jewels.
Interested in buying a house like mine?
translation: Benimki gibi bir ev satin almak ister misin?

english: Not sure I've got enough coins to do that.
translation: Bunun icin yeterli param oldugundan emin degilim.

english: Silly me! I mistook you for one of us wealthy folk.
translation: Ne aptalim! Seni zenginlerden biri sanmistim.

english: Well that's rude.
You'll catch on.
Hello there. Are you liking the city?
It's beautiful!
It really is.
Huh? Are you an encyclopediasalesman?
No, sir, I'm a burglar. I burgle people.
translation: Hayir efendim, ben hirsizim. Insanlari soyarim.

english: Hmm... I think you're an encyclopediasalesman?
Not at all. I just want to ransack the place. Honestly.
translation: Hic de degil. Sadece burayi talan etmek istiyorum. Gercekten.

english: Hmm... Alright then.
I love the fresh air outside, don't you?
translation: Disaridaki temiz havayi seviyorum, ya sen?

english: It is quite nice out here.
Lovely day for a stroll, wouldn't you say?
translation: Yürüyüs icin harika bir gün, degil mi?

english: It is!
I've got something in the back of my mind telling me I should go back home.
translation: Icimden bir ses eve dönmem gerektigini söylüyor.

english: You don't say...
I do love being rich! I can take leisurely strolls whenever I want, without a care in the world!
translation: Zengin olmayi seviyorum! Istedigim zaman, hicbir sey düsünmeden rahatca yürüyüs yapabiliyorum!

english: Enjoy it! Take as much time as you want!
translation: Keyfini cikar! Istedigin kadar zaman gecir!

english: Time to go check how rich I am!
translation: Ne kadar zengin oldugumu kontrol etme zamani!

english: Lovely day for a stroll.
You are escorted out of the house as the owner has locked the door.
translation: Ev sahibi kapiyi kilitledigi icin evden disari cikarildin.

english: You hear someone outside spot the homeowner coming back!
translation: Disarida birinin ev sahibinin geri geldigini fark ettigini duyuyorsun!

english: Now where did I put my keys...
Ah, there they are!
It smells funny in here...
There's mud all over the floor!
Something isn't right here...
How did you get in here?
Who are you? What are you after?
Nothing, I will be on my way.
I see you are a chef... Could you cook me something?
translation: Görüyorum ki sen bir ascisin... Bana bir seyler pisirir misin?

english: I would, but I am very busy. I am trying to increase my reknownas one of the worlds' leading chefs by preparing a special and unique fish salad.
translation: Pisirirdim ama cok mesgulüm. Özel ve essiz bir balik salatasi hazirlayarak dünyanin önde gelen ascilarindan biri olarak ünümü artirmaya calisiyorum.

english: Caleb! As an adventurer, I am ready to help you with whatever you need... again! What can I help you with?
translation: Caleb! Bir maceraci olarak, ihtiyacin olan her konuda sana yardim etmeye hazirim... yine! Nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: You daydream briefly of what the rich family could offer you this time as a reward.
translation: Zengin ailenin bu sefer sana ödül olarak ne sunabilecegini kisa bir süre hayal ediyorsun....

english: ... and that's when I found the broken lamping stick. Maybe you could help me investigate?
translation: ve o zaman kirik lamba cubugunu buldum. Belki arastirmama yardim edersin?

english: Sorry, I didn't quite catch that, my mind was erm... elsewhere.
translation: Üzgünüm, tam anlamadim, aklim baska yerdeydi.

english: Well if you aren't going to listen to the problem, it's fine, don't worry about it. Nothing an experienced chef can't solve himself!
translation: Eger sorunu dinlemeyeceksen, sorun degil, endiselenme. Deneyimli bir sef icin cözemeyecegi sorun yoktur!

english: I'm sorry! Please let me help.
translation: Üzgünüm! Lütfen yardim etmeme izin ver.

english: No! Not every problem in my life needs an adventurer to come solve it for me anyway. I'm happy and there's nothing else either!
translation: Hayir! Hayatimdaki her sorunun bir maceraci tarafindan cözülmesi gerekmez. Ben mutluyum ve baska bir seye ihtiyacim yok!

english: Very well, I'll go and see if your other brothers need anything...
translation: Peki, gidip diger kardeslerinin bir seye ihtiyaci var mi diye bakayim...

english: The sweet smell of the great rewards that may come fades slightly.
translation: Büyük ödüllerin tatli kokusu biraz azalir.

english: Are you sure there's nothing I can do, a chef can always do with help in their kitchen right?
translation: Yapabilecegim bir sey olmadigina emin misin? Bir sef mutfakta her zaman yardima ihtiyac duyar, degil mi?

english: I'm a very competent cook! I do not need your assistance [player name]. Please leave me be.
translation: Ben cok yetenekli bir asciyim! Yardimina ihtiyacim yok Maceraci. Lütfen beni rahat birak.

english: I hear you have brought the completed crest to my father. I must say, that was awfully impressive work.
translation: Tamamlanmis armayi babama getirdigini duydum. Cok etkileyici bir is cikardigini söylemeliyim.

english: It was easy really.
Yes well... Is there anything I can help you with?
translation: Evet, peki... Size yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Can you change my gauntlets for me?
Your gauntlets have already been treated with my potions.
You don't have any gauntlets I can imbue.
Yes certainly, though it will cost you 25,000 coins.
translation: Evet, elbette, ancak bunun bedeli 25.000 sikke olacak.

english: Oh, right.
Great thanks!
Caleb takes the gauntlets from you, pours some herbs and seasonings on them, bakes them on his range for a short time, then hands them back to you.
translation: Caleb eldivenleri senden alir, üzerlerine biraz ot ve baharat döker, kisa bir süre firinda pisirir ve sonra sana geri verir.

english: No that's okay thanks.
No thanks.
I have received word from my father that you assisted us again! I get the feeling you weren't going to stop trying until you did though.
translation: Babamdan, bize yine yardim ettiginizi duydum! Ama sen bunu basarana kadar denemekten vazgecmeyecektin gibi geliyor bana.

english: As thanks, I'll provide you with as many pairs of Cooking gauntlets as you wish.
translation: Tesekkür olarak, istedigin kadar pisirme eldiveni verecegim.

english: You will find the rate you burn certain foods is much reduced whilst wearing these gauntlets.
translation: Bu eldivenleri giydiginde, belirli yiyecekleri yakma oraninin cok azaldigini göreceksin.

english: Thank you.
Here you go!
You're welcome.
Nothing, I will be on my way.
I see you are a chef, will you cook me anything?
translation: Sen bir asciymissin, bana bir seyler pisirir misin?

english: Family Pest
Gauntlets
Can you change my gauntlets for me?
Great thanks!
No that's okay thanks.
No thanks.
Could I have another pair of Cooking gauntlets?
translation: Bir cift daha pisirme eldiveni alabilir miyim?

english: You're welcome.
Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: Hey, kahraman! Vay canina! Harikasin, o iki juvinate ve Gadderank'i nasil alt ettin? Kasaba da cok güzel, harika bir is cikarmissin!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
I'm Calin, I'm trying to stay warm by this fire.
translation: Ben Calin, bu atesin yaninda isinmaya calisiyorum.

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: Oh, pek bir sey yok, hepimiz hala vampirlerden saklaniyoruz ve bu korkunc yerde gecimimizi sagliyoruz, umarim yakinda Salve'deki tapinaga yolculuk yapacak kadar gücleniriz.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?
