english: Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: Bildigim kadariyla yok, su anda cok yararli olan bazi temel olanaklara sahibiz, hepimiz sana cok minnettariz. Daha önce hic bir kahraman görmedim veya tanimadim, bu yüzden karsilastiracak bir seyim yok, ama sanirim

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: cogu insanin görüsüne göre, sen bir kahramansin! Ben sahsen seninle tanistigima cok memnunum.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Ok, thanks.
Can I help you?
What do you do here?
I'm just mining... Problem is, it's a struggle to get past all these fossil looking things.
translation: Sadece madencilik yapiyorum... Sorun su ki, bu fosil gibi görünen seylerin yanindan gecmek cok zor.

english: Can I help?
The others wouldn't like it if a human got involved... You lot tend to take too much from the rocks.
translation: Digerleri bir insanin bu ise karismasindan hoslanmaz... Sizler kayalardan cok fazla sey aliyorsunuz.

english: But what if I were to sort out these fossil things you mentioned?
translation: Peki ya bahsettigin bu fosil gibi seyleri ayiklarsam?

english: Hmm... I shouldn't... And yet...
Okay, I'll tell you what... If you mine through these calcified deposits, you can keep whatever you get from them.
translation: Tamam, sana ne diyecegim... Bu kireclenmis birikintileri kazarsan, onlardan elde ettigin her seyi alabilirsin.

english: Are you sure?
Yeah, why not. I'm tired of getting sprayed with all the water that leaks from these walls anyway. Not to mention it just brings out lots of extra useless bits with it!
translation: Evet, neden olmasin. Zaten bu duvarlardan sizan suyla islanmaktan biktim. Üstelik beraberinde bir sürü gereksiz parcayi da getiriyor!

english: So the water makes the walls even more lucrative?
translation: Yani su duvarlari daha da kazancli hale getiriyor mu?

english: If you consider pointless fossils lucrative, then I suppose.
translation: Eger gereksiz fosilleri kazancli buluyorsan, sanirim öyle.

english: I see. I'll get to work then! See what I can do to help.
translation: Anliyorum. O zaman ise koyulayim! Ne yapabilecegime bir bakayim.

english: What are these weird chippings?
Bone shards! Totally pointless if you ask me, but I hear the humans up atop the mountain quite like them.
translation: Kemik parcalari! Bana sorarsan tamamen gereksizler, ama dagdaki insanlar onlari cok seviyorlarmis.

english: Apparently they offer them up as some sort of sacrifice, but I'm not too sure on the specifics. It's not like I ever go up there myself.
translation: Görünüse göre onlari bir tür kurban olarak sunuyorlar, ama ayrintilari pek bilmiyorum. Oraya hic cikmadim ki.

english: Thanks!
Can you have a look at this chunk of rock?
translation: Bu kaya parcasini bir bakar misin?

english: That's quite the chunk indeed. It looks to be a big mass of calcified rock.
translation: Gercekten de büyük bir parca. Kireclenmis büyük bir kaya parcasi gibi görünüyor.

english: I reckon you'll be able to break it up on an anvil. Perhaps there might be something interesting inside...
translation: Sanirim onu örs üzerinde kirabilirsin. Belki icinde ilginc bir sey vardir...

english: Thanks! I'll go smash it open.
Smashing!
I found this weird moth.
Strange... I've never seen one of those before. That's quite the find.
translation: Tuhaf... Daha önce hic böyle bir sey görmemistim. Bu harika bir buluntu.

english: Of all the creatures to find stuck in a wall, I didn't expect a moth.
translation: Duvarda sikismis yaratiklar arasinda bir güve bulmayi beklemiyordum.

english: Moths carry a lot of magical power within this mountain. You can probably crush it to consume whatever power is left inside.
translation: Güveler bu dagda cok fazla sihirli güc tasir. Muhtemelen onu ezerek icinde kalan gücü tüketebilirsin.

english: Is that safe?
Only one way to find out!
No, thanks.
I'd better get going.
What do you do here?
What are these weird chippings?
Can you have a look at this chunk of rock?
translation: Bu kaya parcasini bir bakabilir misin?

english: I found this weird moth.
No, thanks.
I'd better get going.
Why the grizzly face?
You're not funny...
You should get in the.... sun more.
You're really not funny...
One second, let me take a picture of you with my.... kodiak camera.
translation: Bir saniye, seni kodiak kameramla cekeyim.

english: Feeling.... blue.
If you don't stop, I'm going to leave some... brown... at your feet, human.
translation: Eger durmazsan, ayaklarinin dibine biraz... kahverengi... birakacagim, insan.

english: *slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
I'm sorry to bother you, but could you spare me a little dung?
translation: Rahatsiz ettigim icin özür dilerim, ama bana biraz gübre verebilir misin?

english: The camel didn't seem to appreciate that question.
If I go near that camel, it'll probably bite my hand off.
translation: O deveye yaklasirsam, muhtemelen elimi isirir.

english: Mmm... looks like that camel would make a nice kebab.
translation: Mmm... o deve güzel bir kebap olur gibi görünüyor.

english: I wonder if that camel has fleas...
Are you serious?
Oh yes. If you'd be so kind...
Well, just you close your eyes first. I'm not doing it while you're watching me!
translation: Önce gözlerini kapat. Sen izlerken yapmam!

english: I hope that's what you wanted!
Ohhh yes. Lovely.
What was that?
Nothing important.
The weather's really hot, don't you think?
translation: Hava cok sicak, sence de öyle degil mi?

english: Not hot for camels, surely?
Are you joking? It's burning hot out here! Sitting by the oasis is the only way to stay cool.
translation: Saka mi yapiyorsun? Burasi kavurucu sicak! Serinlemek icin vaha kenarinda oturmak tek care.

english: I thought camels carried their own water in their humps.
translation: Develerin kendi sirtlarinda su tasidiklarini saniyordum.

english: It's never enough. And it's always far too hot to go anywhere in the desert.
translation: Asla yetmez. Ve cölde bir yere gitmek icin hava her zaman cok sicak.

english: Sometimes I wish I could go travelling in cooler places, like all those adventurers I see passing through here.
translation: Bazen buradan gecen tüm maceracilar gibi daha serin yerlere seyahat etmek isterdim.

english: Well, adventuring's thirsty work as well.
Oh, that's a pity.
In that case, I'll just stay by this nice cool oasis.
translation: O halde, bu güzel serin vahada kalacagim.

english: *makes camel noises*
*makes happier camel noises*
You've [been given a new clue/obtained a casket]!
Ask the camel about its dung.
Say something unpleasant.
Neither - I'm a polite person.
translation: Ikisi de degil - ben kibar biriyim.

english: Welcome my friend to the Old Nite! What can I do for you?
translation: Old Nite'a hos geldin dostum! Senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: Got anything strong to drink?
Of course I do! I can offer you a big tasty beer, yours for only two coins.
translation: Tabii ki var! Sana büyük ve lezzetli bir bira ikram edebilirim, sadece iki sikke karsiliginda.

english: Oh dear, I don't seem to have enough money.
translation: Oh hayir, yeterince param yok galiba.

english: No worries, there's a bank just around the corner if you want to grab some coin.
translation: Merak etme, sikke almak istersen kösede bir banka var.

english: Sure, I'll take a beer.
Your pub looks a bit rough.
It's all part of the aesthetic! Adventurers who've just returned from the fight of their lives don't want a fancy la-de-da establishment like you'd find down south.
translation: Bu da estetigin bir parcasi! Hayatlarinin mücadelesinden yeni dönen maceracilar, güneyde bulabileceginiz gibi süslü püslü bir mekan istemiyorlar.

english: They want somewhere to relax and have some hearty ale.
translation: Rahatlayip, doyurucu bir bira icebilecekleri bir yer istiyorlar.

english: And that's what you offer with your broken tables and glass covered floors?
translation: Ve bunu kirik masalar ve camla kapli zeminlerle mi sunuyorsunuz?

english: Aye it is, because here at the Old Nite, your safety is our lowest priority!
translation: Evet, cünkü Old Nite'da güvenliginiz en düsük önceligimizdir!

english: Just browsing...
Got anything strong to drink?
Your pub looks a bit rough.
Just browsing...
I'm sorry to bother you, but could you spare me a little dung?
translation: Rahatsiz ettigim icin özür dilerim, ama bana biraz gübre verebilir misin?

english: The camel didn't seem to appreciate that question.
translation: Deve bu soruyu pek begenmedi gibi görünüyor.

english: Mmm... looks like that camel would make a nice kebab.
translation: Mmm... bu deve güzel bir kebap olur gibi görünüyor.

english: If I go near that camel, it'll probably bite my hand off.
translation: O deveye yaklasirsam, muhtemelen elimi isirir.

english: I wonder if that camel has fleas...
The camel tries to stamp on your foot, but you pull it back quickly.
translation: Deve ayaginiza basmaya calisir, ama siz hizla geri cekilirsiniz.

english: The camel turns its head and glares at you.
translation: Deve basini cevirir ve size öfkeyle bakar.

english: The camel spits at you, and you jump back hurriedly.
translation: Deve size tükürür ve siz aceleyle geri atlarsiniz.

english: Are you serious?
Oh yes. If you'd be so kind...
Well, just you close your eyes first. I'm not doing it while you're watching me!
translation: Önce gözlerinizi kapatin. Siz izlerken yapmam!

english: I hope that's what you wanted!
Ohhh yes. Lovely.
How can you say such cruel things?
translation: Nasil bu kadar acimasiz seyler söyleyebilirsin?

english: Yeah? Well, your mother was a jackal!
translation: Öyle mi? Senin annen bir cakaldi!

english: Hey! Be kinder to your four-legged neighbours.
translation: Hey! Dört ayakli komsularina daha nazik davran.

english: Ask the camel about its dung.
Say something unpleasant.
Neither - I'm a polite person.
translation: Ikisi de degil - ben kibar biriyim.

english: I've heard about all the things you did for us!
translation: Bizim icin yaptigin her seyi duydum!

english: I was happy to help.
And I'm happy that you helped us! Maybe now this place can be a bit more cheerful again!
translation: Ve bize yardim ettigin icin mutluyum! Belki simdi burasi tekrar biraz daha neseli olabilir!

english: I'd rather be left alone, outerlander.
Hello!
Hello.
Nice place you have here!
It is indeed.
Nice day, isn't it?
Yes.
Hi! Would you be interested in some of my fine candles?
Yes please.
No thank you.
Here, have this.
Yes Please.
No thank you.
Do you want a lit candle for 1000 gold?
translation: 1000 altin karsiliginda yanan bir mum ister misiniz?

english: Yes please.
But I don't have that kind of money on me.
translation: Ama üzerimde o kadar para yok.

english: Well then, no candle for you!
Here you go then.
I should warn you, though, it can be dangerous to take a naked flame down there. You'd be better off making a lantern.
translation: Ama sizi uyarmaliyim, oraya ciplak alevle inmek tehlikeli olabilir. Bir fener yapmaniz daha iyi olur.

english: What's so dangerous about a naked flame?
Heh heh... You'll find out.
Thanks, bye.
One thousand gold?!
Look, you're not going to be able to survive down that hole without a light source.
translation: Bakin, isik kaynagi olmadan o delikte hayatta kalamazsiniz.

english: So you could go off to the candle shop to buy one more cheaply. You could even make your own lantern, which is a lot better.
translation: Bu yüzden mum dükkanina gidip daha ucuza bir tane satin alabilirsin. Hatta kendi fenerini yapabilirsin, bu cok daha iyi olur.

english: But I bet you want to find out what's down there right now, don't you? And you can pay me 1000 gold for the privilege!
translation: Ama eminim su anda orada ne oldugunu ögrenmek istiyorsun, degil mi? Ve bu ayricalik icin bana 1000 altin ödeyebilirsin!

english: All right, you win, I'll buy a candle.
No way.
How do you make lanterns?
Out of glass.The more advanced lanterns have a metal component as well.
translation: Camdan yapilir. Daha gelismis fenerlerde metal bilesenler de bulunur.

english: Firstly you can make a simple candle lantern out of glass.It's just like a candle, but the flame isn't exposed, so it's safer.
translation: Öncelikle camdan basit bir mum feneri yapabilirsiniz. Mum gibidir, ancak alev acikta olmadigi icin daha güvenlidir.

english: Then you can make an oil lamp, which is brighter but has an exposed flame.But if you make an iron frame for it you can turn it into an oil lantern.
translation: Daha sonra daha parlak olan ancak alevi acikta olan bir yag lambasi yapabilirsiniz. Ancak bunun icin demir bir cerceve yaparsaniz, onu bir yag fenerine dönüstürebilirsiniz.

english: Finally there's the bullseye lantern.You'll need to make a frame out of steel and add a glass lens.
translation: Son olarak, bullseye fener vardir. Celikten bir cerceve yapmaniz ve cam mercek eklemeniz gerekir.

english: Once you've made your lamp or lantern, you'll need to make lamp oil for it.The chemist near Rimmington has a machine for that.
translation: Lambanizi veya fenerinizi yaptiktan sonra, bunun icin lamba yagi yapmaniz gerekir. Rimmington yakinlarindaki kimyagerin bunun icin bir makinesi vardir.

english: For any light source, you'll need a tinderbox to light it. Keep your tinderbox handy in case it goes out!
translation: Herhangi bir isik kaynagi icin, onu yakmak icin bir cakmaktasi kutusu gerekir. Sönmesi ihtimaline karsi cakmaktasi kutunuzu elinizin altinda bulundurun!

english: But if all that's too complicated, you can buy a candle right here for 1000 gold!
translation: Ama tüm bunlar cok karmasiksa, burada 1000 altin karsiliginda bir mum satin alabilirsiniz!

english: No thanks, I'd rather curse the darkness.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, karanligi lanetlemeyi tercih ederim.

english: Yes please.
What's so dangerous about a naked flame?
translation: Acik alevin nesi bu kadar tehlikeli?

english: How do you make lanterns?
Thanks, bye.
One thousand gold?!
All right, you win, I'll buy a candle.
translation: Tamam, sen kazandin, bir mum alacagim.

english: No way.
No thanks, I'd rather curse the darkness.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, karanligi lanetlemeyi tercih ederim.

english: Player: Hello there.
Darling, who's this?
I don't know, darling. Why don't you ask them?
Yes, good idea!
Who are you?
I'm [Vampyre name].
Hello, [Vampyre name]. I'm Caninelle Draynar and this is Pipistrelle Draynar.
translation: Merhaba, . Ben Caninelle Draynar ve bu da Pipistrelle Draynar.

english: Hello there!
Draynar? Any connection to Draynor?
translation: Draynar mi? Draynor ile bir baglantiniz var mi?

english: Oh yes. The Draynar family has been around since before vampyres came to this world.
translation: Evet. Draynar ailesi, vampirler bu dünyaya gelmeden önce de vardi.

english: Over time, some people took the name and started pronouncing it differently. Hence Draynor.
translation: Zamanla, bazi insanlar bu adi aldi ve farkli sekilde telaffuz etmeye basladi. Böylece Draynor ortaya cikti.

english: Draynor is more commonly used as a first name though, with Draynar as a last name.
translation: Draynor daha cok ilk isim olarak kullanilir, Draynar ise soyadi olarak.

english: Thanks for the information. I wonder if there's a Draynor Draynar out there.
translation: Bilgi icin tesekkürler. Acaba Draynor Draynar diye biri var midir?

english: Now that would be funny.
See you around.
Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: Insan! Muhafizlari cagirmadan köle kafeslerine geri dön!

english: Arrr, what do ye want?
What are you doing here?
Arrr, it be a sad tale. I used to sail the seven seas, a- lootin' and a-plunderin' whatever took my fancy.
translation: Arrr, bu üzücü bir hikaye. Eskiden yedi denizi dolasir, canim ne isterse onu yagmalar ve talan ederdim.

english: Then I got a conscience, so I stopped being a pirate, and travelled the world giving back some of the loot I'd taken.
translation: Sonra vicdanim uyandi, korsanligi biraktim ve dünyayi dolasarak yagmaladiklarimi geri verdim.

english: Seems people didn't appreciate me interruptin' their business to give 'em free stuff, so now I'm locked up for harassment.
translation: Görünüse göre insanlar islerini böldügüm ve onlara bedava seyler verdigim icin bana minnettar olmadilar, simdi de tacizden hapse attilar.

english: Oh, I see.
Nothing, thanks.
Nothing, eh? Nothing be all I got, anyway.
translation: Hicbir sey mi? Zaten elimde baska bir sey yok.

english: What are you doing here?
Nothing, thanks.
Ahoy Cap'n!
Ahoy there!
Avast ye scurvy swabs!
Huh?
Don't mind me parrot, he's Cracked Jenny's Tea Cup!
translation: Bana aldirma papagan, o Cracked Jenny's Tea Cup!

english: What is this place?
This, me hearty, is the entrance to the Brimhaven Agility Arena!
translation: Burasi, dostum, Brimhaven Agility Arena'nin girisi!

english: I were diggin for buried treasure when I found it! Amazed I was! It was a sight to behold!
translation: Gömülü hazine ararken buldum! Cok sasirdim! Görülmeye deger bir manzaraydi!

english: Buried treasure!
It were the biggest thing I'd ever seen! It must've been at least a league from side to side!
translation: Hayatimda gördügüm en büyük seydi! En az bir mil genisliginde olmaliydi!

english: It made me list, I were that excited!
translation: O kadar heyecanlandim ki, basim döndü!

english: Get on with it!
I'd found a huge cave with all these platforms. I reckon it be an ancient civilisation that made it. I had to be mighty careful as there was these traps everywhere! Dangerous it was!
translation: Tüm bu platformlarin bulundugu devasa bir magara buldum. Sanirim bunu eski bir medeniyet yapmis. Her yerde tuzaklar oldugu icin cok dikkatli olmak zorundaydim! Cok tehlikeliydi!

english: Danger! Danger!
Entrance is only 200 coins!
What do I do in the arena?
Well, me hearty, it's simple. Ye can cross between two platforms by using the traps or obstacles strung across 'em. Try and make your way to the pillar that is indicated by the flashing arrow.
translation: Cok basit dostum. Iki platform arasinda, üzerlerine yerlestirilmis tuzaklari veya engelleri kullanarak gecebilirsin. Yanip sönen okla gösterilen sütuna ulasmaya calis.

english: Ye receive tickets for tagging more than one pillar in a row. So ye won't get a ticket from the first pillar but ye will for every platform ye tag in a row after that.
translation: Arka arkaya birden fazla sütuna dokundugunda bilet kazanirsin. Yani ilk sütundan bilet kazanmazsin ama ondan sonra arka arkaya dokundugun her platformdan bilet kazanirsin.

english: If ye miss a platform ye will miss out on the next ticket so try and get every platform you can! When ye be done, take the tickets to Jackie over there and she'll exchange them for more stuff!
translation: Bir platformu kacirirsan bir sonraki bileti de kacirirsin, bu yüzden mümkün oldugunca her platforma dokunmaya calis! Isin bittiginde biletleri suradaki Jackie'ye götür, o da onlari baska seylerle degistirecek!

english: Tag when green light means tickets! Tag when red light means green light!
translation: Yesil isik yandiginda etiketleyin, bilet kazanin! Kirmizi isik yandiginda etiketleyin, yesil isik kazanin!

english: Thanks!
I'd like to use the Agility Arena, please.
Aye, entrance be 200 coins.
Pieces of eight!
A word of warning me hearty! There are dangerous traps down there!
translation: Bir uyarida bulunayim dostum! Asagida tehlikeli tuzaklar var!

english: I don't have the money on me at the moment.
*squawk*
No coins, no entrance!
Okay, here's 200 coins.
You hand Cap'n Izzy 200 coins.
May the wind be in ye sails!
Never mind.
Can you tell me a bit about the Skillcape of Agility, please?
translation: Agility Skillcape hakkinda biraz bilgi verebilir misin lütfen?

english: Aye, to be sure! The Skillcape of Agility be the symbol of the master of dexterity! Providing weight reduction, one who wears it can climb like a cat, run like the wind and jump like...err, well, jump like a jumping thing!
translation: Tabii ki! Ceviklik Beceri Pelerini, el becerisinin ustasinin sembolüdür! Agirligi azaltan bu pelerin, onu giyen kisiye kedi gibi tirmanma, rüzgar gibi kosma ve ziplama... sey, ziplayan bir sey gibi ziplama yetenegi verir!

english: Now, be there anything else ye'd like to know?
translation: Baska bilmek istedigin bir sey var mi?

english: May I buy a Skillcape of Agility, please?
translation: Ceviklik Beceri Pelerini satin alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: Most certainly, having it equipped reduces your weight and I think it will really suit you. All that remains to be done is pay me 99000 gold!
translation: Elbette, onu giydiginizde agirliginiz azalir ve bence size cok yakisir. Tek yapmaniz gereken bana 99.000 altin ödemek!

english: I'm afraid I can't afford that.
So sad, too bad. Go and pickpocket some wealthy people and come back here once you're richer.
translation: Cok üzücü, cok yazik. Gidip zenginlerin cebinden para calin ve zengin oldugunuzda buraya geri gelin.

english: Certainly, here you go.
But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: Ama ne yazik ki yanimda yeterince para yok.

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.
translation: Peki, buldugunda tekrar gelip beni gör.

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: Maalesef tüm Skillcapes sadece ücretsiz bir baslik ile satiliyor, bu bir beceri promosyonunun parcasi; bir alana bir bedava, bilirsin. Yani sana bir tane satabilmem icin önce envanterinde yer acman gerekecek.

english: Excellent! That cape really does suit you.
translation: Harika! Bu pelerin sana gercekten cok yakismis.

english: May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: Pelerinim icin bir baslik daha alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
Cap'n Izzy No-Beard hands you another hood for your skillcape.
translation: Kaptan Izzy No-Beard, Skillcape'in icin baska bir baslik veriyor.

english: See you later.
Can I help you with something?
Well, I'm here about a treasure trail...
Ah, you'll be wanting to talk to him then.
translation: Ah, o zaman onunla konusmak isteyeceksin.

english: Him?
Avast!
Answer this and I'll give you treasure!
Please enter the answer to the question.
Try again! Try again!
Squawk! Pieces of eight!
What is this place?
What do I do in the arena?
I'd like to use the Agility Arena, please.
Okay, here's 200 coins.
Never mind.
Can you tell me a bit about the Skillcape of Agility, please?
translation: Agility Skillcape hakkinda biraz bilgi verir misin lütfen?

english: Is it true you sell Skillcapes of Agility?
I'm afraid I can't afford that.
Certainly, here you go.
Skillcape
Hood
See you later.
[Ah, hello there, laddie/Ah, hello there, lassie/Ah, hello there]! I've just dug up an old treasure chest of mine.
translation: Merhaba genc! Eski bir hazine sandigimi kazip cikardim.

english: Problem is, these old hands o'mine aren't as useful as they used t'be, and the lock on that chest is a little bit too fiddly for ol' Cap'n Arnav. Could you help me out?
translation: Sorun su ki, bu yasli ellerim eskisi kadar kullanisli degil ve sandigin kilidi yasli Kaptan Arnav icin biraz fazla karmasik. Bana yardim eder misin?

english: Yes, I'll help you unlock your chest.
There are three columns. What you need to do for me is to match up each picture with the word underneath the column, and then unlock the chest.
translation: Üc sütun var. Yapman gereken, her resmi sütunun altindaki kelimeyle eslestirmek ve sonra sandigi acmak.

english: No, sorry.
Ah, well done matey, that's the right combination. Here, have a little somethin' for helpin' me out.
translation: Ah, aferin dostum, dogru kombinasyon bu. Al, bana yardim ettigin icin kücük bir hediye.

english: Arrr! That be nowhere near close! Did ye not listen the first time around?
translation: Arrr! Bu hic de yakin degil! Ilk seferinde dinlemedin mi?

english: Sorry, I must have misunderstood your instructions. Could I hear them again please?
translation: Üzgünüm, talimatlarini yanlis anlamis olmaliyim. Lütfen tekrar söyleyebilir misin?

english: Right, right. What you need to do is click on the arrows to roll the cylinders round to the different items.
translation: Tamam, tamam. Yapman gereken sey, oklari tiklayarak silindirleri farkli ögelere dogru döndürmek.

english: When the items in the middle row all match the words written under the column then you'll have solved the lock.
translation: Ortadaki siradaki ögeler sütunun altinda yazan kelimelerle eslestiginde kilidi cözmüs olursun.

english: Is that a little clearer?
Certainly. Let me try again.
Arrr! I'd better find someone else.
translation: Arrr! Baska birini bulsam iyi olacak.

english: Arrr, I'd better be off.
Arrr, you're not the person I be needin'.
translation: Arrr, sen ihtiyacim olan kisi degilsin.

english: Avast there, [player name]!
Ahoy, [player name]!
Parley wi' me, my old fruit!
I needs yer help, [player name]!
I got treasure here, [player name]!
Shiver me' timbers, are you ignoring me?
translation: Haydi ama, beni görmezden mi geliyorsun?

english: Will ye help an old pirate, [player name]?
translation: Yasli bir korsana yardim eder misin, Maceraci?

english: I knows somethin' you should knows, [player name].
translation: Senin bilmen gereken bir sey biliyorum, Maceraci.

english: Maybe later.
Yes, I'll help you unlock your chest.
No, sorry.
What do you want, civilian?
What are you doing?
What does it look like I'm doing? I'm training this useless bunch of recruits!
translation: Ne yapiyormusum gibi görünüyor? Bu ise yaramaz acemileri egitiyorum!

english: Oh yes, they look very fit.
They're nothing but a useless bunch of weaklings who won't survive an hour once they're out on patrol.
translation: Onlar, devriyeye ciktiklarinda bir saat bile hayatta kalamayacak, ise yaramaz bir grup zayif adamdan baska bir sey degiller.

english: Have you lost your mind? Earlier you said they looked fit! Just go away and leave me alone.
translation: Aklini mi kacirdin? Az önce formda göründüklerini söylemistin! Git buradan ve beni rahat birak.

english: Oh yes, they look very weak.
Show some respect when you talk about my men, civilian!
translation: Adamlarim hakkinda konusurken biraz saygi göster, sivil!

english: Have you lost your mind? Earlier you said they looked weak! Just go away and leave me alone.
translation: Aklini mi kacirdin? Az önce zayif göründüklerini söylemistin! Git buradan ve beni rahat birak.

english: Can I have some armour like yours?
translation: Seninki gibi bir zirh alabilir miyim?

english: Only guards of Varrock can wear this armour.
translation: Sadece Varrock muhafizlari bu zirhi giyebilir.

english: Well, I could become a guard of Varrock.
translation: Peki, ben de Varrock muhafizi olabilirim.

english: Oh yeah? I see you've got a Thieving level of [thieving level]. That must give you quite a long criminal record.
translation: Öyle mi? Görüyorum ki hirsizlik seviyen yuksek. Bu da sana oldukca uzun bir sabika kaydi kazandirmis olmali.

english: I could repent of my evil ways if you like.
So you really want to be a guard, huh?
translation: Demek gercekten muhafiz olmak istiyorsun, ha?

english: Yes, that's right.
Does it worry you that the life expectancy of a guard is about 30 seconds?
translation: Bir muhafizin ortalama ömrünün 30 saniye olmasi seni endiselendirmiyor mu?

english: No, that doesn't worry me.
Bah! You just failed the intelligence test. Go away, civilian.
translation: Bah! Zeka testinden kaldin. Git buradan, sivil.

english: Actually, forget it.
Go away, coward.
I want nothing.
Lucky you. Go away.
Make those dummies suffer!
Imagine it's your aunt!
translation: Onun senin teyzen oldugunu hayal et!

english: You won't last 2 minutes in the real world!
Show some backbone!
Let's get some proper bloodlust here!
Bah, why do I bother with you lot?
Just hit the thing already!
Hit the dummy! Hit the dummy!
Useless! Utterly useless!
Hit the dummy before I come over there and hit you!
translation: Ben oraya gelip seni vurmadan mankeni vur!

english: What are you doing?
Oh yes, they look very fit.
Can I have some armour like yours?
translation: Seninki gibi bir zirh alabilir miyim?

english: Oh yes, they look very weak.
No, that doesn't worry me.
Actually, forget it.
I want nothing.
Good day, traveller.
Hello there. I was wondering if you could tell me anything about the missing people.
translation: Merhaba. Kayip kisiler hakkinda bana bir seyler söyleyebilir misiniz?

english: Not really. We put a lot of effort into finding them, but nothing came of it.
translation: Pek sayilmaz. Onlari bulmak için çok çaba sarf ettik, ama sonuç alamadik.

english: Where do you think they went?
Well, some say they got lost in the mountains. Others say they decided to go and live somewhere like Fortis instead of here. I'm not too sure myself. It is a large number of people who've vanished...
translation: Bazilari daglarda kaybolduklarini söylüyor. Bazilari ise buradan ayrilip Fortis gibi bir yere yerlesmeye karar verdiklerini söylüyor. Ben de tam emin degilim. Kaybolanlarin sayisi oldukça fazla...

english: But you stopped looking?
It was taking up a lot of resources. We don't have a huge number of guards here, so I need to use my people wisely.
translation: Çok fazla kaynak gerektiriyordu. Burada çok fazla muhafizimiz yok, bu yüzden adamlarimi akillica kullanmam gerekiyor.

english: If we get a new lead, I'm happy to send them out again, but right now it's like looking for a needle in a haystack.
translation: Yeni bir ipucu bulursak, onlari tekrar gönderirim, ama su anda samanlikta igne aramak gibi bir sey.

english: I see. Thanks for the information.
Hello there. Would you like to travel somewhere? I can take you to Rimmington or Brimhaven for 30 coins.
translation: Merhaba. Bir yere gitmek ister misin? 30 sikke karsiliginda seni Rimmington veya Brimhaven'a götürebilirim.

english: I'd like to go to Rimmington.
Come back when you've got 30 coins for me.
I'd like to go to Brimhaven.
I'm good thanks.
Hello there. Would you like to travel somewhere? I can take you to Ardougne or Brimhaven for 30 coins.
translation: Merhaba. Bir yere gitmek ister misin? 30 sikke karsiliginda seni Ardougne veya Brimhaven'a götürebilirim.

english: I'd like to go to Ardougne.
Hello there. Would you like to travel somewhere? I can take you to Rimmington or Ardougne for 30 coins.
translation: Merhaba. Bir yere gitmek ister misin? 30 sikke karsiliginda seni Rimmington veya Ardougne'a götürebilirim.

english: I'd like to go to Rimmington.
I'd like to go to Brimhaven.
I'm good thanks.
I'd like to go to Ardougne.
Can we head to Lunar Isle?
Sure matey!
Hi.
And you're wanting what now?
Can you take me back to Rellekka please?
translation: Beni Rellekka'ya geri götürebilir misin lütfen?

english: I'll take you as far as Pirates' Cove. You'll have to find the rest of the way back yourself.
translation: Seni Pirates' Cove'a kadar götürebilirim. Geri kalan yolu kendin bulman gerekecek.

english: So we're here?
Yep. You're free to explore the island. Be careful though, the Moon Clan are very powerful, it wouldn't be wise to wrong them.
translation: Evet. Adayi kesfetmekte özgürsün. Ama dikkatli ol, Moon Clan cok güclüdür, onlara karsi gelmek akillica olmaz.

english: Thanks, I'll keep that seal of passage close.
Aye-aye cap'n!
Hmmmm? I don't recognise you as one of my men, what are you doing aboard my ship?
translation: Hmmmm? Seni adamlarimdan biri olarak tanimiyorum, gemimde ne isin var?

english: Stowaway! Stowaway! *Squark*
Oh, Lokar offered me a journey. He said you could take me to the island of the Moon Clan.
translation: Oh, Lokar bana bir yolculuk teklif etti. Beni Ay Klani'nin adasina götürebilecegini söyledi.

english: Oh he DID, did he? (sigh) I sometimes regret ever allowing that vagabond to join the crew.
translation: Öyle mi dedi? (ic cekis) Bazen o serseriyi mürettebata kabul ettigim icin pisman oluyorum.

english: He has a very bad work ethic, and I have to say his attitude can be very confrontational.
translation: Is ahlaki cok kötü ve tavirlari cok kavgaci olabiliyor.

english: Lokar's a loser! *Brakawk*!
So... You won't take me to Lunar Isle?
translation: Yani... Beni Ay Adasi'na götürmeyecek misin?

english: Well now, I didn't say that.
We are returning there again soon anyway, as our last visit was most profitable.
translation: Son ziyaretimiz cok karli gectigi icin yakinda yine oraya dönecegiz.

english: In fact as soon as our boys are finished loading stocks we should be ready to depart!
translation: Aslinda, adamlarimiz yüklemeyi bitirir bitirmez yola cikmaya hazir olacagiz!

english: Now, as captain of this ship I feel I must play host, even if you aren't exactly a welcome guest, so was there anything you wished to know?
translation: Bu geminin kaptani olarak, hos bir misafir olmasan da sana ev sahipligi yapmam gerektigini düsünüyorum, ögrenmek istedigin bir sey var mi?

english: So... What can you tell me about this 'Moon Clan'? It all seems very mysterious I must say...
translation: Peki... Bu “Ay Klani” hakkinda bana ne söyleyebilirsin? Her sey cok gizemli görünüyor...

english: The Moon Clan? Oh, very fine people. Very hospitable.
translation: Ay Klani mi? Oh, cok iyi insanlar. Cok misafirperverler.

english: We had heard that they are very wary of strangers, and dislike people just showing up on their island, but when we sent a landing party aboard they all seemed more than happy to see us.
translation: Yabancilara karsi cok temkinli olduklarini ve adalarina gelen insanlari sevmediklerini duymustuk, ama gemiden bir grup insan gönderdigimizde hepimiz bizi görmekten cok mutlu oldular.

english: Well, they even threw a big festival in our honour!
translation: Hatta bizim serefimize büyük bir festival bile düzenlediler!

english: Anyway, they had a large supply of items that we felt we could use on the high seas, so we made a few trades with them, and were on our way.
translation: Her neyse, acik denizde kullanabilecegimizi düsündügümüz cok sayida esya vardi, bu yüzden onlarla birkac takas yaptik ve yolumuza devam ettik.

english: What kinds of items?
Well, I'm not sure how much you've heard about them, but they are magical experts.
translation: Onlar hakkinda ne kadar sey duydun bilmiyorum, ama onlar sihir uzmanlaridir.

english: They sold us many rune-stones, as well as a few good luck charms and talismans and such to help us on our voyage.
translation: Bize yolculugumuzda yardimci olmasi icin bircok rune tasi, birkac ugurlu tilsim ve muska gibi seyler sattilar.

english: Yes, they might have been a little secretive about that strange temple, and the old lodge of theirs in town, and I must say they certainly have the strangest house I have ever seen in my life in their little village, but it was
translation: Evet, o garip tapinak ve kasabadaki eski kuleleri hakkinda biraz gizemli davraniyorlardi ve kücük köylerinde hayatimda gördügüm en garip evlerin oldugunu söylemeliyim, ama

english: a pleasant trip all round, and I look forward to trading there again in the future.
translation: genel olarak keyifli bir yolculuktu ve gelecekte tekrar orada ticaret yapmayi dört gözle bekliyorum.

english: After all, it's not everywhere that a pirate captain and his crew can rest ashore without having to worry about the authorities catching them, is it?
translation: Sonucta, bir korsan kaptani ve mürettebatinin yetkililerin onlari yakalayacagindan endise etmeden karada dinlenebilecegi her yer yok, degil mi?

english: Fight the law! *Squawk*
No, I guess it isn't.
Was there anything else you wished to ask me about while I'm not busy?
translation: Mesgul olmadigim bir zamanda bana sormak istediginiz baska bir sey var mi?

english: What were you doing at Lunar Isle anyway? I always thought pirates would be... You know. Out pirating.
translation: Lunar Isle'da ne yapiyordunuz? Ben hep korsanlarin... Bilirsiniz. Korsanlik yaptigini düsünürdüm.

english: Well, obviously the actual pirating is a big part of our agenda, but we like to think of ourselves as non-regulated merchants.
translation: Tabii ki korsanlik bizim gündemimizin büyük bir parcasi, ama kendimizi düzenlemeye tabi olmayan tüccarlar olarak görüyoruz.

english: What is good plunder if you have nothing to spend it on, hmmmm?
translation: Harcayacak bir seyin yoksa yagma neye yarar, hmmmm?

english: Likewise, I am a forward thinking captain, and endeavour to invest much of my plunder back into the ship and its crew, so that we can be a better and more efficient force for theft upon the seas.
translation: Ayni sekilde, ben ileri görüslü bir kaptanim ve yagmaladiklarimin cogunu gemiye ve mürettebata yatirmaya calisiyorum, böylece denizlerde daha iyi ve daha verimli bir hirsizlik gücü olabiliyoruz.

english: So you went to Lunar Isle for supplies?
translation: Yani Lunar Isle'a malzeme almak icin mi gittiniz?

english: Well, obviously not initially. Obviously, our first thought was to show up, rob them blind, then take off again with the plunder spilling from our decks.
translation: Tabii ki baslangicta degil. Ilk düsüncemiz oraya gidip, onlari soyup sogana cevirmek, sonra da güvertemizden tasan ganimetlerle tekrar yola cikmakti.

english: So what made you change your mind?
Well, firstly there were the monsters.
M-monsters?
Oh yes, hundreds of the things. The island's swarming with them you know.
translation: Evet, yüzlerce canavar. Ada onlarla dolup tasiyor.

english: Dirty smelly beasts, as big as a wolf! Yes, you'd certainly better be either handy with a blade or quick on your toes if you wanted to spend much time outside of their village with those things around
translation: Kokusmus, pis hayvanlar, kurt kadar büyük! Evet, o hayvanlar her yerde dolasirken köyün disinda fazla zaman gecirmek istiyorsan, ya bicak kullanmayi iyi bilmeli ya da ayaklarin hizli olmali.

english: everywhere.
*Squawk* Run fer yer lives lads, it's a monster! *Squawk*
translation: *Gak gak* Caninizi kurtarin cocuklar, bu bir canavar! *Gak gak*

english: So you didn't attack the Moon Clan because you were worried you would yourself be attacked by these monsters trying to make your escape?
translation: Yani, kacmaya calisirken bu canavarlarin saldirisina ugrayacagindan korktugun icin Ay Klani'na saldirmadin mi?

english: Oh yes, absolutely. That and the next reason.
translation: Evet, kesinlikle. O ve bir sonraki neden.

english: The next reason?
Yes, the next reason being that the Moon Clan are quite stupendously powerful magicians.
translation: Evet, bir sonraki neden Ay Klani'nin inanilmaz derecede güclü büyücüler olmasi.

english: You'll notice it as soon as you look at them, really quite, quite powerful indeed.
translation: Onlara baktiginiz anda fark edersiniz, gercekten cok, cok güclüler.

english: As soon as we saw them we lost any thoughts about trying to attack or steal from them.
translation: Onlari gördügümüz anda saldirmak veya onlardan calmak gibi düsüncelerimiz tamamen kayboldu.

english: Which as it turned out was very lucky for us.
translation: Bu da bizim icin cok sansli oldu.

english: Bunch of blooming loonies! *Brakawk*
It was?
Oh yes. They can read minds, you see. If we'd shown up there thinking about robbing them they would have just killed us all on the spot.
translation: Evet. Onlar zihin okuyabiliyorlar. Eger onlari soymayi düsünerek oraya gitseydik, bizi o anda öldürürlerdi.

english: I did mention that they are extraordinarily powerful magicians, didn't I?
translation: Onlarin olaganüstü güclü büyücüler oldugunu söylemistim, degil mi?

english: Yes, yes you did.
Ah, I'm glad I did. Because they really, really are. And mind-readers.
translation: Ah, söyledigime sevindim. Cünkü onlar gercekten, gercekten öyle. Ve zihin okuyucular.

english: Yes, all in all I'm glad we didn't try any funny business in the end after all.
translation: Evet, sonucta komik islere kalkismadigimiza sevindim.

english: Plus there's that other good reason.
translation: Ayrica baska bir iyi neden daha var.

english: That reason being?
Well, when you are a crew of successful pirates, it becomes more and more difficult to ever moor somewhere and spend your loot.
translation: Basarili bir korsan ekibi oldugunuzda, bir yere demir atip ganimetinizi harcamak gittikce zorlasir.

english: People are far too quick to call the guards on a troublemaker nowadays.
translation: Günümüzde insanlar sorun cikaranlari hemen muhafizlara bildiriyorlar.

english: So finding a village where people are more than happy to trade with you regardless of who you may have just stolen from and killed.
translation: Bu yüzden, kimi soyup öldürdügünüzden bagimsiz olarak sizinle ticaret yapmaktan mutluluk duyacak bir köy bulmak zor.

english: I like that non-judgemental attitude of theirs!
Okay then...
Anything ese you wanted to know before we set sail?
translation: Yola cikmadan önce bilmek istediginiz baska bir sey var mi?

english: I was hoping you could tell me a little bit about your ship. I must say, it's really very impressive.
translation: Geminiz hakkinda biraz bilgi verir misiniz? Gercekten cok etkileyici oldugunu söylemeliyim.

english: Ah, a connoisseur! Yes, she's name the Lady Zay, and may I say, is one of the finest ships to ever sail the seas!
translation: Ah, bir uzman! Evet, adi Lady Zay ve sunu söyleyebilirim ki, denizlerde yüzen en güzel gemilerden biri!

english: It was a steal from the Karamjan shipyards.
And when I say it was a steal, I mean to say that myself and some of the lads broke in and stole it one night.
translation: Caldik derken, bir gece ben ve bazi arkadaslarim oraya girip gemiyi caldik demek istiyorum.

english: I don't know who they were building these warships for, but whoever it was seemed to be a little on the short side.
translation: Bu savas gemilerini kimin icin yaptiklarini bilmiyorum, ama her kim icinse, biraz kisa boylu gibi görünüyordu.

english: We had to do a little remodelling of the doors and rooms so that we didn't have to crouch around everywhere, but I've finally got her just how I want her, and we have enough cannons down below decks to
translation: Her yerde cömelip durmamak icin kapilari ve odalari biraz yeniden düzenlemek zorunda kaldik, ama sonunda onu istedigim gibi yaptim ve güvertede kücük bir kasabayi bombalamaya yetecek kadar topumuz var!

english: bombard a small town I'd wager!
*Brawwwwwwk* I want guns, lots of guns! I want guns, lots of guns!
translation: *Brawwwwwwk* Silahlar istiyorum, cok silah! Silahlar istiyorum, cok silah!

english: I used to own my own ship you know...
translation: Eskiden kendi gemim vardi, biliyor musun...

english: It was called the Lady Lumbridge if I remember correctly...
I wonder whatever happened to it...
Interesting. You never struck me as being Captain material, but I guess there's a ship out there for everyone...
translation: Ilginc. Bana hic kaptanlik yapabilecek biri gibi gelmemistin, ama sanirim herkes icin bir gemi vardir...

english: The Lady Zay is certainly a big step up from my last ship anyway.
translation: Lady Zay, benim son gemimden kesinlikle cok daha iyi.

english: Your last ship? Why, what was wrong with it?
translation: Son gemin mi? Neden, ne sorunu vardi?

english: Well, it just wasn't sturdy enough!
I was on a perfectly routine raiding expedition to the east of here, when we ran into a squall, that pushed us towards the rocky shore.
translation: Buradan doguya dogru rutin bir yagma seferindeydik, bir firtinaya yakalandik ve kayalik sahile dogru sürüklendik.

english: A few select men and myself managed to escape with our lives intact on a small row boat, but the rest of my crew were washed ashore as the ship was wrecked on those jagged rocks.
translation: Birkac seckin adam ve ben kücük bir kürek teknesiyle canimizi kurtarmayi basardik, ama gemim o sivri kayaliklara carparak parcalaninca mürettebatimin geri kalani sahile sürüklendi.

english: Ah yes, it was a tragedy...
To lose such a fine ship in such an insulting manner...
translation: Böylesine güzel bir gemiyi bu kadar asagilayici bir sekilde kaybetmek...

english: And of course the rest of your crew...
translation: Ve tabii ki mürettebatinizin geri kalani...

english: Who? Oh. Yes. The crew. Yes, it was a tragedy.
translation: Kim? Ah. Evet. Mürettebat. Evet, trajedi gibiydi.

english: I'd paid them in advance you know, I'll never see that money again!
translation: Onlara önceden ödeme yapmistim, o parayi bir daha asla göremeyecegim!

english: Um... no, I actually meant it was a shame that so many of your crew must have died in the shipwreck.
translation: Sey... hayir, aslinda demek istedigim, mürettebatinizin cogunun gemi kazasinda ölmüs olmasi ne yazik.

english: Was it? Well, if you say so.
translation: Öyle mi? Peki, siz öyle diyorsaniz.

english: Actually, the last I had heard quite a few of them had survived, and had set up a little hideaway in the remains of the shipwreck.
translation: Aslinda, son duydugum kadariyla, bircogu hayatta kalmis ve gemi enkazinin kalintilari arasinda kücük bir siginak kurmuslardi.

english: If you're particularly worried about the, perhaps you might like to go and pay them a visit someday, and make sure to bring a lot of easily transferable wealth with you.
translation: Eger bu konuda özellikle endiseleniyorsaniz, belki bir gün onlari ziyaret etmek isteyebilirsiniz. Yaninizda kolayca transfer edilebilir cok miktarda servet getirmeyi unutmayin.

english: They love people visiting with easily transferable wealth.
translation: Kolayca transfer edilebilir servetle gelen ziyaretcileri cok severler.

english: Now, was there something you wished to talk to me about? Time is pressing on, and we really need to set sail soon if we want to make the most of the winds.
translation: Simdi, benimle konusmak istediginiz bir sey var miydi? Zaman daraliyor ve rüzgari en iyi sekilde degerlendirmek istiyorsak, gercekten yakinda yelken acmamiz gerekiyor.

english: *Squawk* Move it or lose it, move it or lose it.
translation: *Gidak* Hareket et yoksa kaybedersin, hareket et yoksa kaybedersin.

english: Can we sail to Lunar Isle now? I must say, it all sounds very intriguing over there...
translation: Simdi Lunar Isle'a yelken acabilir miyiz? Orada her sey cok ilginc görünüyor...

english: As long as you keep your Seal Of Passage with you at all times while you are on the island you should be okay, even if you are a Femennik.
translation: Adada oldugun sürece Gecis Mührünü her zaman yaninda tutarsan, Femennik olsan bile sorun olmaz.

english: I'm not kidding, they are a very dangerous people, and it would NOT be wise for you to travel there without your Seal Of Passage marking you as a diplomat.
translation: Saka yapmiyorum, onlar cok tehlikeli insanlar ve Gecis Mührünle diplomat oldugunu göstermeden oraya seyahat etmen akillica olmaz.

english: Okay, keep my Seal with me at all times, check. Can we go now?
translation: Tamam, Mührümü her zaman yanimda tutacagim, tamam. Artik gidebilir miyiz?

english: Ah, yes indeed! The winds seem good, so let's make a move!
translation: Ah, evet, tabii ki! Rüzgarlar iyi görünüyor, hadi yola cikalim!

english: She's blowing a storm, cap'n! *Brarrrrrk*
Well... THAT was deuced strange!
Um... Way to sail a boat?
*Squawk* Way to sail a boat! Way to sail a boat! *Brarrrk*
translation: *Squawk* Tekne kullanmanin yolu! Tekne kullanmanin yolu! *Brarrrk*

english: This... This is VERY strange!
Well, I would be more than happy to take you, unfortunately the Moon Clan are, frankly, very scary people, and I believe they would not take kindly to us bringing a Fremennik there.
translation: Sey, Sizi götürmekten cok memnun olurum, ama ne yazik ki Ay Klani, acikcasi, cok korkutucu insanlar ve Fremennik'leri oraya götürmemizi hos karsilamayacaklarini düsünüyorum.

english: They are at war with them after all.
But I thought Lokar had already been there?
translation: Ama Lokar zaten oraya gitmemis miydi?

english: Yes. Yes he has. I'm talking about you.
translation: Evet. Evet, gitmisti. Ben senden bahsediyorum.

english: Oh. Oh yeah, I'm a Fremennik aren't I?
translation: Oh. Oh evet, ben Fremennik'im, degil mi?

english: Yes, yes you are.
I probably should have kept that Seal Of Passage Brundt the Chieftain gave me with me, shouldn't I?
translation: Sef Brundt'un bana verdigi Gecis Mührünü yanimda tutmaliydim, degil mi?

english: Yes, yes you should have. Honestly, you're going to need it with you.
translation: Evet, evet tutmaliydin. Acikcasi, ona ihtiyacin olacak.

english: I'm afraid I can't let you travel with us without it.
translation: Maalesef, o olmadan bizimle seyahat etmene izin veremem.

english: *Brakawk* Don't drop quest items half way through a quest! *Squawk*
Okay, I'll go and get it again then.
translation: Tamam, gidip tekrar alayim o zaman.

english: You do that.
No, actually, I don't really want to know anything that you can tell me.
translation: Hayir, aslinda, bana anlatabilecegin hicbir seyi bilmek istemiyorum.

english: In fact, I don't even know why I began talking to you in the first place!
translation: Aslinda, neden seninle konusmaya basladigimi bile bilmiyorum!

english: Hmmmm. You could perhaps be more grateful to someone offering you free transport, but then I suppose you are a friend of Lokar's, and a Fremennik, so I suppose the
translation: Hmmmm. Sana ücretsiz ulasim imkani sunan birine daha minnettar olabilirdin, ama sanirim sen Lokar'in arkadasisin ve bir Fremennik'sin, bu yüzden

english: rudeness is natural.
Make sure you are ready for departure, I will be issuing orders to set sail shortly.
translation: Kalkisa hazir oldugundan emin ol, kisa süre icinde yelken acma emri verecegim.

english: I... I don't understand... This is all very strange...
That was possibly the most pointless journey I have ever taken in my life.
translation: Bu, hayatimda yaptigim en anlamsiz yolculuktu.

english: The course was plotted, we had a fair tailwind the whole journey...
translation: Rotamiz cizildi, tüm yolculuk boyunca rüzgar arkamizdan esti...

english: BUT WE HAVEN'T BUDGED AN INCH!
I just don't understand it... Maybe you should speak with Jack.
Who?
Our navigator. He's at the rear of the ship, one floor below deck. He's an old sea-dog with a brown pirate's hat.
translation: Navigatörümüz. Geminin arka tarafinda, güverte altindaki katta. Kahverengi korsan sapkasi olan yasli bir denizci.

english: Below deck, below deck!
Can we try again?
Yes, you're right, perhaps it was just a freak wind. Off we go!
translation: Evet, haklisin, belki de sadece garip bir rüzgardi. Gidelim!

english: The ship sails in a circle around Pirates' Cove a second time
translation: Gemi, Korsan Koyu'nun etrafinda ikinci kez daire cizerek seyrediyor.

english: Can you take me back to Rellekka please?
translation: Beni Rellekka'ya geri götürebilir misin lütfen?

english: So we're here?
Can you tell me something about the Moon Clan?
translation: Ay Klani hakkinda bana bir seyler anlatabilir misin?

english: What were you doing at Lunar Isle?
Can you tell me something about your ship?
translation: Geminin hakkinda bana bir seyler anlatabilir misin?

english: Can we sail to Lunar Isle now?
Absolutely nothing at all.
Welcome to Gnome Air!
What's Gnome Air?
Gnome Air is the finest airline in Gielinor!
translation: Gnome Air, Gielinor'un en iyi havayolu sirketidir!

english: Well...it's the only real airline in Gielinor.
translation: Sey... Gielinor'daki tek gercek havayolu sirketidir.

english: Ha!
What do you mean by real airline?
translation: Gercek havayolu sirketi derken neyi kastediyorsun?

english: Well there's a dodgy magic carpet operation in the desert, I doubt it will ever take off... Ha!
translation: Çölde süpheli bir sihirli hali operasyonu var, bunun hiç gerçeklesecegini sanmiyorum... Ha!

english: Where can you take me?
How much for one-way to Varrock?
I can't take you anywhere.
How come?
I would, but Glough has told me not to take humans on Gnome Air.
translation: Götürmek isterdim, ama Glough Gnome Air'de insanlari tasimamami söyledi.

english: I'll leave you to it.
Can you take me on the glider?
Of course!
Why are gliders better than other transport?
translation: Planörler diger ulasim araclarindan neden daha iyi?

english: Oh we have a whole network! It's wonderful for getting to hard to reach places.
translation: Oh, bizim bütün bir agimiz var! Ulasilmasi zor yerlere gitmek icin harika.

english: There are so many places where your teleports cannot reach!
translation: Teleportlarin ulasamadigi cok fazla yer var!

english: How did you all manage to build such an established network?
translation: Böyle köklü bir agi nasil kurmayi basardiniz?

english: I think you'll find that is a gnome trade secret!
translation: Sanirim bunun bir gnome ticari sirri oldugunu göreceksin!

english: Sorry, I don't want anything now.
translation: Üzgünüm, su anda bir sey istemiyorum.

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: Hazir yemekler maalesef ise yaramaz. Aluft Aloft'un müsterileri icin sadece el yapimi Gnome Mutfagi yeterince iyidir.

english: You hand over your delivery of [item] to Captain Bleemadge
Aahh, the smell of home, there's nothing like it. Thanks.
translation: Ah, evimin kokusu, hicbir seye benzemez. Tesekkürler.

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: Bunu bana ulastirmak icin uzun bir yol kat etmis olmalisin. Iste sana bahsis olarak kücük bir ek ödeme.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.'dan ücretsiz teslimat jetonunuzu almayi unutmayin.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: Teslimatiniz cok gec! Aluft jnr.'a geri dönüp baska bir siparis alin. Artik ihtiyaciniz olmadigi icin teslimat kutunuzu atiyorsunuz.

english: You must complete this!
Please finish the puzzle for me!
Well done!
What's Gnome Air?
Where can you take me?
How much for one-way to Varrock?
I'll leave you to it.
Can you take me on the glider?
Why are gliders better than other transport?
translation: Planörler diger ulasim araclarindan neden daha iyidir?

english: Sorry, I don't want anything now.
translation: Üzgünüm, su anda bir sey istemiyorum.

english: Fancy some 'rum', [lad/lass]? It's still fresh. Well, fresh-ish...
translation: Biraz rom ister misin, ? Hala taze. Sey, nispeten taze...

english: No... I think I'll pass.
Hello there, I'm Captain Bruce. Do you want to serve in the Shayzien Army and defend our kingdom?
translation: Merhaba, ben Kaptan Bruce. Shayzien Ordusu'nda hizmet etmek ve kralligimizi savunmak ister misin?

english: Yes, I'd love to join.
Wonderful! To get started, you need to answer a few questions.
translation: Harika! Baslamak icin birkac soruya cevap vermen gerekiyor.

english: Are you a resident of Kourend?
Errrr... Not really.
Ah. Then you cannot join I'm afraid.
How come?
It's in the rules I'm afraid. Only citizens of Kourend are allowed to join the Shayzien Army.
translation: Korkarim kurallar böyle. Sadece Kourend vatandaslari Shayzien Ordusu'na katilabilir.

english: Is that not too restrictive?
Well at one time only citizens of Shayzien could join the army. It wasn't until the reign of King Byrne I that people from other parts of the kingdom were allowed to enlist.
translation: Eskiden sadece Shayzien vatandaslari orduya katilabilirdi. Kral Byrne I'in hükümdarligi dönemine kadar kralligin diger bölgelerinden gelenlerin orduya katilmalarina izin verilmiyordu.

english: Of course, many people in Kourend still like to stick to tradition. After all, the five cities of Kourend have always had very defined roles within the kingdom.
translation: Tabii ki, Kourend'deki bircok insan hala gelenege bagli kalmayi tercih ediyor. Sonucta, Kourend'in bes sehri krallik icinde her zaman cok belirgin rollere sahipti.

english: Interesting. So most people in the army are still from Shayzien?
translation: Ilginc. Yani ordudaki cogu insan hala Shayzien'den mi?

english: Indeed. While the Shayzien Army is by far the largest military force in Kourend, the other cities still have some form of militia, apart from Arceuus of course.
translation: Aynen öyle. Shayzien Ordusu Kourend'deki en büyük askeri güc olsa da, diger sehirlerde de bir tür milis gücü var, tabii Arceuus haric.

english: Even if someone from elsewhere in the kingdom wants to become a soldier, they're far more likely to join their local city force than come to us.
translation: Kralligin baska yerlerinden biri asker olmak istese bile, bize gelmektense kendi sehirlerinin kuvvetlerine katilma olasiligi cok daha yüksektir.

english: Still, times are slowly changing. Every year we see more people from outside Shayzien enlist.
translation: Yine de zaman yavas yavas degisiyor. Her yil Shayzien disindan daha fazla insanin askere yazildigini görüyoruz.

english: I see. Thanks for the information.
My pleasure.
No, I'm not interested.
That's alright. Come back if you change your mind.
translation: Önemli degil. Fikrini degistirirsen tekrar gel.

english: Here, solve this.
Captain Bruce hands you a [light puzzle/puzzle] box.
That doesn't look solved to me.
Well done [player name]. Here you go.
You've obtained a [new clue/casket]!
Yes, I'd love to join.
No, I'm not interested.
You'd best introduce yourself first!
Hello. What's this place?
Why you wretched Son-of-a-Big-Nosed-Warty-Smelly- Goblin! How dare you speak to a commanding officer like that?
translation: Seni sefil, büyük burunlu, sigilli, kokusmus goblin! Bir komutanla nasil böyle konusursun?

english: I... err...
What?
Stand straight! Chest out, shoulders back!
translation: Dik dur! Gögsünü disari, omuzlarini geriye!

english: Okay, okay.
You'll address me as captain!
Yea... yes, captain!
Better. Now what is a low-life, pathetic excuse for a human being doing sniffing around my arena?
translation: Daha iyi. Simdi, bu sefil, zavalli insanlik örnegi, benim arenamda ne is ariyor?

english: Exploring, captain. Looked like a chance for combat, sir!
translation: Kesif yapiyorum, kaptan. Savasma sansi gibi görünüyordu, efendim!

english: Very well, make the most of this because I don't suffer idiots easily! This is the Barbarian Assault arena. You want to sign up with us?
translation: Pekala, bunu en iyi sekilde degerlendirin cünkü aptallara tahammülüm yoktur! Burasi Barbar Saldirisi arenasi. Bize katilmak ister misiniz?

english: Sir, yes sir!
Then listen closely.
Wait a minute! I'm not giving a tutorial to someone carrying that stuff. Use that bank chest over there first!
translation: Bir dakika! O esyalari tasiyan birine egitim vermeyecegim. Önce suradaki banka sandigini kullanin!

english: You can't enter the game with any food; the Healer will cure you.
translation: Oyuna yiyecekle giremezsin; Sifaci seni iyilestirecek.

english: You can't enter the game with any brutal potions or ingredients; the Healer will cure you.
translation: Oyuna aci iksir veya malzemelerle giremezsin; Sifaci seni iyilestirecek.

english: There is no reason to take a phoenix necklace into the arena, as you won't lose any items if you die in the minigame.
translation: Minigame'de ölürseniz hicbir esyanizi kaybetmeyeceginiz icin arenaya phoenix kolyesi götürmenize gerek yok.

english: You can't enter the game with any runes - there are free ones in there.
translation: Oyuna herhangi bir rune ile giremezsiniz - orada ücretsiz olanlar var.

english: You can't take arrows into a game - there are free ones in there.
translation: Oyuna ok götüremezsiniz - orada ücretsiz olanlar var.

english: The barbarians don't want you to take your follower in.
You can't take your own logs with you - you have to use the ones the barbarians provide.
translation: Kendi kütüklerinizi yaninizda götüremezsiniz - barbarlarin sagladiklarini kullanmak zorundasiniz.

english: The barbarians don't want you using artillery down there.
translation: Barbarlar, orada topcu silahlari kullanmanizi istemiyorlar.

english: The barbarians don't trust whatever you may have stored in your looting bag. They won't let you in with it.
translation: Barbarlar, yagma cantanizda sakladiginiz seylere güvenmiyorlar. Onlarla iceri girmenize izin vermeyecekler.

english: The barbarians don't want you using Saradomin brews down there. You will have to restore your health as they intend.
translation: Barbarlar, orada Saradomin iksirleri kullanmanizi istemiyorlar. Sagliginizi onlarin istedigi sekilde geri kazanmak zorundasiniz.

english: Let's skip the training, I'm an expert already.
Really? You don't look like one. Very well, upon your own head be it, I'll let you skip the training. Come back and speak to me if you find you're not the know-it-all you believe yourself to be.
translation: Gercekten mi? Öyle görünmüyorsun. Pekala, sorumluluk sana ait, egitimi atlamana izin verecegim. Kendini sandigin kadar her seyi bilen biri olmadigini anlarsan geri gelip benimle konus.

english: Nah, sounds boring.
'Boring'? You'll get nowhere with that kind of attitude! Drop and give me ten!
translation: “Sikici” mi? Böyle bir tavirla hicbir yere varamazsin! Yere yat ve on sinav cek!

english: Maybe next time, I need to go wash my hair.
translation: Belki bir dahaki sefere, sacimi yikamaya gitmem lazim.

english: You'll do as I say!
Arrrghhh. Okay, okay!
Good to see you've learned some respect, make it five
translation: Saygi ögrendigini görmek güzel, bes tane yap.

english: Yes sir!
But I already did!
You did?
I don't trust you in the slightest. Do as I tell you!
Hi... I mean, [player name] reporting, sir!
translation: Merhaba... Yani, Maceraci rapor veriyor, efendim!

english: Straighten that back when you talk to me! You want my help?
translation: Benimle konusurken sirtini dik tut! Yardimimi mi istiyorsun?

english: Again? Very well. Listen closely this time!
translation: Yine mi? Pekala. Bu sefer dikkatlice dinle!

english: Sir! Could I start at wave one again?
translation: Efendim! Birinci dalgadan tekrar baslayabilir miyim?

english: What? Finish with your training first, soldier!
Sir! Can we do some training?
What do you mean, you are on wave one!
Oh, of course, sorry.
Sir, yes sir!
Let's skip the training, I'm an expert already.
Nah, sounds boring.
Maybe next time, I need to go wash my hair.
translation: Belki bir dahaki sefere, sacimi yikamaya gitmem lazim.

english: But I already did...
Sir! Can we do some training?
Sir! Could I start at wave one again?
translation: Efendim! Birinci dalgadan tekrar baslayabilir miyim?

english: You're currently on wave [current wave #]. So you want to start on wave one again?
Yes, reset my wave to one.
Very well, I'll reset you to wave one.
Your current Barbarian Assault wave is now: 1
Thank you, sir.
No sir, I want to stay on wave [current wave #].
Stop wasting time!
Yes, reset my wave to one.
No, I want to stay on wave [current wave #].
Hello there. What do you need?
What is this place?
This is one of the lairs of those foul Lizardmen. We've managed to corner these ones so they can't escape.
translation: Burasi igrenc Kertenkele Adamlarin siginaklarindan biri. Bunlari köseye sikistirdik, kacamazlar.

english: Who are you?
Cleive. Captain Cleive. Captain in the Shayzien Guard and renowned slayer.
translation: Cleive. Yüzbasi Cleive. Shayzien Muhafizlari'nin yüzbasi ve ünlü bir avci.

english: Renowned?
Absolutely. I'm part of a great family of slayers. You've probably met a few of them over on the mainland.
translation: Kesinlikle. Büyük bir avci ailesinin üyesiyim. Muhtemelen anakarada birkacini görmüssündür.

english: Why are you here?
We learnt of a group of Lizardman Shamans causing trouble on the surface. I led a taskforce out to drive them back into their lair.
translation: Yüzeyde sorun cikaran bir grup Kertenkele Adam Samani oldugunu ögrendik. Onlari siginaklarina geri sürmek icin bir görev gücü kurdum.

english: We suffered many losses but we've now managed to trap them in this cave.
translation: Cok kayip verdik ama simdi onlari bu magarada kapana kistirdik.

english: We've lost too many men to be able to finish them off but I'm happy for someone else to do it if I feel they're worthy of the challenge.
translation: Onlari yok etmek icin cok fazla adam kaybettik ama bu görevi basarabileceklerini düsünürsem, bunu baskalarinin yapmasindan memnuniyet duyarim.

english: Can I fight these Lizardmen?
Perhaps. I've lost too many men to be able to kill them myself but I'm happy for someone else to do it if I feel they're worthy of the challenge.
translation: Belki. Onlari kendim öldürebilmek icin cok fazla adam kaybettim, ama bu göreve layik oldugunu düsündügüm biri varsa, bunu onun yapmasindan memnun olurum.

english: What do you define as worthy?
You'll need to be favoured by the people of Shayzien. You'll also need to be on a Lizardman Slayer task.
translation: Shayzien halkinin sevgisini kazanman gerekiyor. Ayrica Kertenkele Adam Avcisi görevinde olman da gerekiyor.

english: Can I use my slayer helm instead of a Shayzien helm?
translation: Shayzien migferi yerine avci migferimi kullanabilir miyim?

english: Yes that is possible, however I only show the required technique to those who have proved themselves a friend to Kourend.
translation: Evet, bu mümkün, ancak gerekli teknigi sadece Kourend'in dostu oldugunu kanitlamis olanlara gösteriyorum.

english: How do I prove that I am a friend to Kourend?
You'll need to complete the Hard tier of the Kourend & Kebos Achievement Diary and have earned the tier five Shayzien helm.
translation: Kourend & Kebos Basari Günlügü'nün Zor seviyesini tamamlaman ve besinci seviye Shayzien migferini kazanman gerekiyor.

english: I don't meet those requirements. I'll be back when I do though.
translation: Bu gereksinimleri karsilamiyorum. Karsiladigimda geri gelecegim.

english: I have that completed! Can you show me the special technique now?
translation: Tamamladim! Simdi bana özel teknigi gösterebilir misiniz?

english: Of course!
Captain Clieve teaches you the secret technique. Any slayer helm will now offer the same protection against lizardman as a shayzien helm (5).
translation: Kaptan Clieve size gizli teknigi ögretir. Artik herhangi bir avci migferi, Shayzien migferi (5) ile ayni koruma düzeyini Lizardman'lara karsi saglar.

english: I have already shown you that secret technique.
translation: Size o gizli teknigi zaten gösterdim.

english: Hey! These lizardmen aren't just for anyone. Come back when you have the right Slayer task!
translation: Hey! Bu kertenkele adamlar herkes icin degil. Dogru Slayer görevi aldiginda geri gel!

english: Captain Clieve wants you to stick to your Slayer assignments.
translation: Kaptan Clieve, Slayer görevlerine sadik kalmani istiyor.

english: What is this place?
Who are you?
Why are you here?
Can I fight these Lizardmen?
Can I use my Slayer helm instead of a Shayzien helm?
translation: Shayzien migferi yerine Slayer migferimi kullanabilir miyim?

english: Hello old chap.
What are you doing here? Shouldn't you be looking after your glider?
translation: Burada ne yapiyorsun? Planörüne bakman gerekmiyor mu?

english: I'm pretty much retired these days old fellow. My test piloting days are over. I'm just relaxing here and enjoying the primal clash between man and man.
translation: Bu günlerde emekli sayilirim dostum. Test pilotlugu günlerim sona erdi. Burada dinlenip, insanlarla insan arasindaki ilkel catismanin tadini cikariyorum.

english: You're watching the duels then. Are you going to challenge someone yourself?
translation: Demek düellolari izliyorsun. Sen de birine meydan okuyacak misin?

english: I do find the duels entertaining to watch, but I suspect that actually being involved would be a lot less fun for me. I'm a lover, not a fighter!
translation: Düellolari izlemek eglenceli buluyorum, ama aslinda katilmak benim icin cok daha az eglenceli olurdu. Ben savasci degil, asigim!

english: Errm, I suppose you are.
You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food item] to Captain Daerkin.
Excellent. Just what I need whilst watching the duels.
translation: Mükemmel. Düellolari izlerken tam da ihtiyacim olan sey.

english: Here you go, have a dashing pilot's scarf.
translation: Al bakalim, sik bir pilot atkisi.

english: I have some spare goggles, you might as well have them.
translation: Yedek gözlüklerim var, onlari da alabilirsin.

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: Bunu bana ulastirmak icin uzun bir yol kat etmis olmalisin. Iste sana bahsis olarak kücük bir sey.

english: You are given [a/some] [reward item(s)] as a tip.
translation: Bahsis olarak bazi ödül ögesi verilir.

english: Can you take me on the glider?
Of course!
What do you think of Ali Morrisane?
Oh, he's always up to something. Like that magic carpet business.
translation: Oh, o her zaman bir seyler pesinde. Sihirli hali isi gibi.

english: What magic carpet business?
He said he was planning to set up a magic carpet network, like our gliders.
translation: Bizim planörlerimiz gibi bir sihirli hali agi kurmayi planladigini söyledi.

english: If he ever gets it set up, us gnomes won't be happy with him. Especially not King Narnode!
translation: Eger bunu kurarsa, biz cüceler ondan memnun olmayacagiz. Özellikle Kral Narnode!

english: Why are gliders better than other transport?
translation: Planörler diger ulasim araclarindan neden daha iyi?

english: Oh we have a whole network! It's wonderful for getting to hard to reach places.
translation: Oh, bizim bütün bir agimiz var! Ulasilmasi zor yerlere gitmek icin harika.

english: There are so many places where your teleports cannot reach!
translation: Teleportlarinizin ulasamadigi cok fazla yer var!

english: How did you all manage to build such an established network?
translation: Böyle köklü bir agi nasil kurmayi basardiniz?

english: I think you'll find that is a gnome trade secret!
translation: Bence bu bir cüce ticari sirridir!

english: Sorry, I don't want anything now.
translation: Üzgünüm, su anda bir sey istemiyorum.

english: You have come to the right place. At the center I must go, 5 paces toward the circle of stone, then one more to the city of kings and find the treasure of my kins.
translation: Dogru yere geldin. Merkeze gitmeliyim, tas cemberine dogru 5 adim, sonra krallarin sehrine bir adim daha ve akrabalarimin hazinesini bulmaliyim.

english: Can you take me on the glider?
What do you think of Ali Morrisane?
Why are gliders better than other transport?
translation: Planörler neden diger ulasim araclarindan daha iyidir?

english: Sorry, I don't want anything now.
translation: Üzgünüm, su anda bir sey istemiyorum.

english: You're one to talk! I paid plenty for that little encounter!
translation: Sen mi konusuyorsun! O kücük karsilasma icin cok para ödedim!

english: One eye doesn't equal two of my best men!
translation: Tek göz, en iyi iki adamima bile denk gelmez!

english: We gave you plenty of chances to flee!
translation: Sana kacman icin bolca firsat verdik!

english: If I ran away from you, I'd never hear the end of it!
Really? Then what about that fight in Turtle Basin?
translation: Gercekten mi? Peki ya Turtle Basin'deki kavga ne olacak?

english: That wasn't fleeing! It was a tactical repositioning! Besides, you're conveniently forgetting what happened at Brimhaven!
translation: O kacmak degildi! Taktiksel bir yeniden konumlanmaydi! Ayrica, Brimhaven'da olanlari da unutmussun!

english: A boring fight! I had better things to do.
translation: Sikici bir kavgaydi! Yapacak daha iyi islerim vardi.

english: Well, we'll have to make things more entertaining next time then!
translation: O zaman bir dahaki sefere daha eglenceli hale getirmeliyiz!

english: I look forward to it, but for now, let's drink!
Indeed! Cheers!
Prepare yeself, we'll be off soon!
Aye aye!
What do you need, adventurer? There is a battle to fight!
translation: Neye ihtiyacin var, maceraci? Savasilacak bir savas var!

english: How do I help?
Get yerself a harpoon from the crate on the ship, then go fish around the island t' catch some harpoonfish. They make fer fine ammo against Tempoross!
translation: Gemideki sandiktan bir zipkin al, sonra adanin cevresinde zipkin baligi avla. Tempoross'a karsi iyi bir mühimmat olurlar!

english: Once ye caught some, ye can cook 'em at the shrines on the island if ye want 'em to pack more of a punch. Then come back t' the ship an' load 'em in the ammunition crates next to the cannons.
translation: Biraz avladiktan sonra, daha etkili olmalarini istiyorsan adadaki tapinaklarda pisirebilirsin. Sonra gemiye geri dön ve onlari toplarin yanindaki mühimmat sandiklarina yükle.

english: Our cannoneers will get t' firin' the harpoonfish at Tempoross. When it's weak an' submerges to recover its energy, get down to the jetty next t' the ship an' fish those spirit pools.
translation: Topcularimiz Tempoross'a zipkin baligi atesleyecek. Zayiflayip enerjisini toplamak icin suya daldiginda, geminin yanindaki iskeleye in ve ruh havuzlarini balikla.

english: Be quick with fishin' those spirit pools though, or it'll come back so strong we'll have to abandon the fight! With any luck, we'll weaken those spirit fish enough t' subdue Tempoross. Now get t' the fight, sailor!
translation: Ruh havuzlarini hizlica balikla, yoksa o kadar güclenir ki savasi birakmak zorunda kaliriz! Sansimiz yaver giderse, ruh baliklarini Tempoross'u alt edecek kadar zayiflatabiliriz. Simdi savasa dön, denizci!

english: What should I watch out for?
If Tempoross electrocutes a cannon t' stop it from firin', ya better load your harpoonfish into the other ammunition crates t' keep them cannons firin' instead.
translation: Tempoross, topun ates etmesini engellemek icin onu elektrikle vurursa, zipkin baliklarini diger mühimmat sandiklarina yükleyerek toplarin ates etmeye devam etmesini sagla.

english: Also, make sure t' grab a rope from the ship crates an' keep an eye out for big waves. We'll make sure t' shout about them. Then ye best quickly tether yerself t' an island totem pole or ship mast with that rope.
translation: Ayrica, gemi sandiklarindan bir ip al ve büyük dalgalara dikkat et. Onlari gördügümüzde bagirarak haber verecegiz. O zaman o iple kendini bir ada totem diregine veya gemi diregine hizlica bagla.

english: If the waves break the totem pole or ship mast, ye can grab a hammer from the ship crates t' fix 'em up before the next big wave hits.
translation: Dalgalar totem diregini veya gemi diregini kirarsa, gemi sandiklarindan bir cekic alip bir sonraki büyük dalga gelmeden onlari onarabilirsin.

english: Oh, an' keep an eye out for lightnin' clouds causin' fires. Get a bucket from the ship crates, fill it with water at a pump, and get t' puttin it out before it spreads.
translation: Oh, ve yanginlara neden olan yildirim bulutlarina da dikkat et. Gemi sandiklarindan bir kova al, pompadan suyla doldur ve yayilmadan söndür.

english: If ye get hit by the waves or fire, don't be surprised when ye lose those fish an' tools ye gathered. Now get t' the fight, sailor!
translation: Dalgalar veya yangin tarafindan vurulursan, topladigin baliklari ve aletleri kaybettiginde sasirma. Simdi savasa git, denizci!

english: I want to leave.
Really? You will receive no reward if you do.
I'll get on with the fighting.
We did it! Tempoross has been sudbued once again. Well done!
translation: Basardik! Tempoross bir kez daha yenildi. Aferin!

english: Take a well deserved rest but don't get too comfy, it'll regain its energy soon enough!
translation: Hak ettigin dinlenmeyi al ama fazla rahatlama, yakinda enerjisini geri kazanacak!

english: What should I do now?
We usually find some debris washed up near the docks back at Unkah. Feel free t' have a look. Ya might find somethin' useful!
translation: Genellikle Unkah'daki rihtimlarin yakininda kiyiya vurmus enkazlar buluruz. Istersen bir bakabilirsin. Yararli bir sey bulabilirsin!

english: It won't be long before Tempoross regains enough energy to be a problem and we'll have to wrangle it again. Hopefully we can count on you to 'elp!
translation: Tempoross'un tekrar sorun olacak kadar enerji toplamasi cok uzun sürmeyecek ve onu tekrar alt etmemiz gerekecek. Umarim yardimina güvenebiliriz!

english: I'm ready to leave.
Aye aye!
Goodbye.
To the boats! We'll set sail soon!
We'll set sail in the next [25/20/15/10/5] seconds.
Let's get underway!
Tempoross will surface soon, prepare yourselves!
translation: Tempoross yakinda su yüzüne cikacak, hazir olun!

english: More fish!
Load those cannons!
Keep an eye on the waves!
Tempoross is drawing in water, prepare yourselves!
The mast has been damaged!
Storm clouds are rolling in, get your buckets ready!
Tempoross has disabled a cannon! Switch to another!
translation: Tempoross bir topu vurdu! Baska bir topa gecin!

english: Tempoross has submerged, fish from the whirlpools!
translation: Tempoross suya daldi, girdaplardan balik yakalayin!

english: Tempoross has surfaced, keep those cannons firing!
translation: Tempoross su yüzüne cikti, toplara ates etmeye devam edin!

english: Tempoross has retreated to the depths!
Tempoross has gathered too much energy!
The storm has grown too strong, we must retreat!
How do I help?
What should I watch out for?
I want to leave.
Yes, I really want to leave.
No, I don't want to leave.
I'll get on with the fighting.
What should I do now?
I'm ready to leave.
Goodbye.
I don't think I can fix this. Looks like I'll be heading back by foot.
translation: Bunu düzeltebilecegimi sanmiyorum. Sanirim yürüyerek geri dönmek zorundayim.

english: Ah, how embarrassing.
What happened?
A bit of a technical hitch with the landing gear. I won't be able to fly you anywhere, sorry.
translation: Inis takimlarinda kücük bir teknik sorun var. Seni hicbir yere ucaramam, üzgünüm.

english: I'm busy here. Do you need something?
translation: Burada mesgulüm. Bir seye mi ihtiyacin var?

english: Please tell me about what you're doing.
Gangs. It's the gangs from the slums in the east. Those ruffians are always hatching schemes, whether it's smuggling or extortion or even plain street violence.
translation: Ceteler. Dogu'daki gecekondu mahallelerinden gelen ceteler. Bu haydutlar her zaman bir seyler planliyorlar, kacakcilik, harac veya sokak siddeti gibi.

english: I'm in charge of the investigations unit. Sometimes an informant will let us know when a gang is meeting. Then we can send in the troops and get them.
translation: Sorusturma biriminden sorumluyum. Bazen bir muhbir bize cetenin ne zaman toplanacagini söyler. O zaman askerleri gönderip onlari tutuklayabiliriz.

english: Can I help?
