That would be very welcome. Information about gang meetings is written on the notice board when it's received. When you see a meeting announced there, go and deal with 'em.
translation: Seve seve. Cete toplantilari hakkinda bilgiler, alindigi anda ilan panosuna asilir. Orada bir toplanti duyurusu gördügünde, gidip onlarla ilgilen.

english: If they drop any documents, bring them to me for an extra reward.
translation: Herhangi bir belge düsürürlerse, ekstra ödül icin bana getir.

english: You sound busy. I'll be off.
Hello again. Thanks for offering to help deal with the criminal gangs.
translation: Merhaba tekrar. Suc cetelerine karsi yardim teklifiniz icin tesekkürler.

english: Do you know of any meetings now?
translation: Su anda herhangi bir toplanti biliyor musunuz?

english: No, not at the moment. Keep checking the notice board - information is written there when we receive it.
translation: Hayir, su anda yok. Bülten panosunu kontrol etmeye devam edin, bilgi geldiginde orada yayinlanacaktir.

english: We've received reports of a gang [in location]! They're meeting [in location].
We believe the meeting is in progress now.
translation: Toplantinin su anda devam ettigini düsünüyoruz.

english: We believe the meeting is about to start imminently.
We believe the meeting will start in about [number] minutes.
Remind me, what do I do for this?
translation: Hatirlatir misin, bunun icin ne yapmam gerekiyor?

english: Gang meeting information is written on the notice board when it's received from the informants. When you see a meeting announced there, go and deal with 'em.
translation: Cete toplanti bilgileri, muhbirlerden alindiginda ilan panosuna asilir. Orada bir toplanti duyurusu gördügünde, gidip onlarla ilgilen.

english: I'll be off.
Come over here and talk to me before you mess around with that.
translation: Onunla ilgilenmeden önce gelip benimle konus.

english: No thanks, I don't need that.
Thank you. This will help us track down more gang meetings in future.
translation: Tesekkürler. Bu, gelecekte daha fazla cete toplantisini takip etmemize yardimci olacak.

english: I don't remember asking you to help, but... okay, thank you, whoever you are.
translation: Senin yardimini istedigimi hatirlamiyorum, ama... tamam, tesekkürler, her kimsen.

english: Please leave. There is confidential information in here, and you are not authorised to view it.
translation: Lütfen git. Burada gizli bilgiler var ve sen bunlari görmeye yetkili degilsin.

english: Please tell me about what you're doing.
Can I help?
Do you know of any meetings now?
translation: Su anda herhangi bir toplanti var mi?

english: I'll be off.
You sound busy. I'll be off.
Remind me, what do I do for this?
translation: Hatirlat bana, bu konuda ne yapmam gerekiyor?

english: Sorry I can't take any more passengers today.
Hello there.
Tell me about the Wintertodt.
Ignisia claims it's some kind of evil spirit.
translation: Ignisia onun bir tür kötü ruh oldugunu iddia ediyor.

english: You don't believe her?
Nah, I believe in things I can stab and kill. This is all just a storm in a teacup. I mean, how can wind and snow be evil? My toad is more of a threat!
translation: Hayir, ben sadece bicaklayip öldürebilecegim seylere inanirim. Bütün bunlar cay fincanindaki firtina gibi. Yani, rüzgar ve kar nasil kötü olabilir ki? Benim kurbagam daha büyük bir tehdit!

english: Your... toad?
Yeah, just a bit of fun. I have a pet - he's around here somewhere, assuming that troublesome cat hasn't eaten him.
translation: Evet, sadece eglence icin. Bir evcil hayvanim var, buralarda bir yerde, tabii o sinir bozucu kedi onu yememisse.

english: That's a bit weird, but okay.
No weirder than being scared of snow.
Tell me about yourself.
I'm Captain Kalt, proud member of the Shayzien Army.
translation: Ben Yüzbasi Kalt, Shayzien Ordusu'nun gururlu bir üyesiyim.

english: How long have you been a soldier?
Man and boy I've worn the uniform. Earned Captain a few years back and never looked back. Not too happy about babysitting delusional wizards though. But orders is orders.
translation: Cocuklugumdan beri üniforma giyiyorum. Birkac yil önce kaptan oldum ve hic pisman olmadim. Ama hayalperest büyücülerin bakiciligini yapmaktan pek hoslanmiyorum. Ama emir emirdir.

english: Tell me how I'm doing.
Go play in the snow and come back when you've done something.
translation: Git karda oyna ve bir seyler yaptiktan sonra geri gel.

english: You appear to have tried a little.
You have subdued the Wintertodt [x] times. Your lifetime score: [x] Your highest score: [x]
Ignisia appears to be quite happy with you.
See you later.
Goodbye.
Tell me about the Wintertodt.
Tell me about yourself.
Tell me how I'm doing.
See you later.
I've got nothing to say to you.
You do not have enough Piscarilius favour. Current favour: [X]% - Required: 75.0%
Eh, what do you want?
What's your story?

Sea piracy just ain't what it used to be, so my crew and I have had to make do on land. We specialise in 'acquiring' valuable antiquities from around the city and shipping them to our friends overseas.
translation: Deniz korsanligi eskisi gibi degil, bu yüzden mürettebatim ve ben karada idare etmek zorunda kaldik. Sehrin dört bir yanindan degerli antikalari “elde etmek” ve bunlari denizasiri dostlarimiza göndermek konusunda uzmaniz.

english: And people just let you get away with this?
translation: Ve insanlar bunu yapmana izin mi veriyor?

english: Of course they do, for the right price. That's just how things work around here, kid.
translation: Tabii ki veriyorlar, dogru fiyat karsiliginda. Burada isler böyle yürür, evlat.

english: Looking for any help?
Yeah, you look like you might be able to help me out. If you think you've got what it takes, I might have a job for you.
translation: Evet, bana yardim edebilecek gibi görünüyorsun. Eger kendinde yetenek oldugunu düsünüyorsan, sana bir is verebilirim.

english: I have what it takes.
We'll see about that. (Khaled tells the player to obtain an artefact from a certain location.)
translation: Görecegiz. (Khaled, oyuncuya belirli bir yerden bir eser almasini söyler.)

english: I'm not sure I have the time right now.
Perhaps some other time.
I'll be on my way.
What are you playing at? I've given you a job, get it done.
translation: Ne yapiyorsun sen? Sana bir is verdim, yap sunu.

english: What am I supposed to be doing?
You need to recover an artefact for me. It can be found in the [location].
Watch yourself, if the guards catch you carrying hot goods they'll throw you in the brig.
translation: Dikkatli ol, muhafizlar seni calinti mal tasirken yakalarsa seni zindana atarlar.

english: I'll get to it right away, boss.
I've lost the artefact...
Congratulations, you're a failure. Come back to me when you think you've got what it takes to get the job done.
translation: Tebrikler, basarisiz oldun. Bu isi yapabilecek kadar yetenekli oldugunu düsündügünde bana geri gel.

english: This is exactly what our friends overseas were looking for. Here's your cut. Let me know when you're ready for more work.
translation: Bu, denizasiri dostlarimizin aradigi seydi. Iste payin. Daha fazla is icin hazir oldugunda bana haber ver.

english: (Captain Khaled takes the stolen item and hands the player some coins.)
translation: (Kaptan Khaled calinan esyayi alir ve oyuncuya birkac sikke verir.)

english: Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to answer this for me.
Captain Khaled has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Kaptan Khaled sana bir meydan okuma parsömeni verdi!

english: Please give me your answer!
How can that be? Go check again!
translation: Bu nasil olabilir? Tekrar kontrol et!

english: Spot on!
Captain Khaled has given you another clue scroll!
translation: Kaptan Khaled sana baska bir ipucu parsömeni verdi!

english: What's your story?
Looking for any help?
I have what it takes.
I'm not sure I have the time right now.
I'll be on my way.
What am I supposed to be doing?
I'll get to it right away, boss.
Can you take me on the glider?
Of course!
Why are gliders better than other transport?
translation: Planörler diger ulasim araclarindan neden daha iyi?

english: Oh we have a whole network! It's wonderful for getting to hard to reach places.
translation: Oh, bütün bir agimiz var! Ulasilmasi zor yerlere gitmek icin harika.

english: There are so many places where your teleports cannot reach!
translation: Teleportlarin ulasamadigi cok fazla yer var!

english: How did you all manage to build such an established network?
translation: Böyle köklü bir agi nasil kurmayi basardiniz?

english: I think you'll find that is a gnome trade secret!
translation: Sanirim bu bir cüce ticari sirridir!

english: Sorry, I don't want anything now.
translation: Üzgünüm, su anda bir sey istemiyorum.

english: Is that some rum I see in your backpack?
Yes, why do you ask?
No reason, I just...
Oh my! What is that thing over there?
translation: Aman Tanrim! Suradaki sey de ne?

english: Where?
Hmm, my mistake, it must have been an optical illusion.
translation: Hmm, benim hatam, optik bir yanilsama olmali.

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: Hazir yemekler maalesef ise yaramaz. Aluft Aloft'un müsterileri icin sadece el yapimi Cüce Mutfagi yeterince iyidir.

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Captain Klemfoodle
Very good, very good. Itsgood to taste real gnomish flavours.
translation: Cok iyi, cok iyi. Gercek cüce lezzetlerini tatmak güzel.

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: Bunu bana ulastirmak icin uzun bir yol kat etmis olmalisin. Iste sana bahsis olarak kücük bir ek ödeme.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr'dan ücretsiz teslimat jetonunu almayi unutma.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: Teslimatin cok gec kaldi! Aluft jnr'a geri dönüp baska bir siparis al. Artik ihtiyacin olmadigi icin teslimat kutunu atiyorsun.

english: Can you take me on the glider?
Why are gliders better than other transport?
translation: Planörler neden diger ulasim araclarindan daha iyidir?

english: Sorry, I don't want anything now.
translation: Üzgünüm, su anda bir sey istemiyorum.

english: My apologies, but I can't take you with me while you're affected by that spell. It should wear off in [X] minutes, [X] seconds.
Hey! I'm not flying out this deep into the Wilderness. They don't pay me danger money, you know. I'm out of here.
translation: Hey! Wilderness'nin bu kadar iclerine ucmam. Bana tehlike primi ödemiyorlar, biliyorsun. Ben gidiyorum.

english: I'm looking for [player name].
Glider for [player name]!
Hello, [player name]! Let's go!
Glider here for [player name].
Come on, [player name]!
Don't keep me waiting, [player name]!
Where's [player name]?
[player name]? Where are you?
Oh, I give up.
Hello.
Well hello there, how you doing?
Not bad, yourself?
I'm great now, those goblins can't get close with this cannon blasting at them!
translation: Su anda harikayim, bu top onlara ates ederken goblinler yaklasamiyor!

english: Don't let any goblins through the breach in our fence!
translation: Citimizdeki gedikten hicbir goblinin gecmesine izin verme!

english: Keep an eye open for goblins!
Don't just do something! Stand there!
Stop dawdling soldier! You're in the army now!
Hurry up on that patrol route, trooper!
Hello! What can I do for you?
Where am I exactly?
This is the port of Land's End!
Can you tell me about the local area?
Certainly. We're on the southern edge of the Kingdom of Great Kourend.
translation: Elbette. Büyük Kourend Kralligi'nin güney ucundayiz.

english: The kingdom is made up of five main cities. You'll find Shayzien and Lovakengj to the north, and the remaining cities to the north east.
translation: Krallik bes ana sehirden olusuyor. Shayzien ve Lovakengj kuzeyde, diger sehirler ise kuzeydoguda bulunuyor.

english: Thanks.
I'd like to travel to Port Piscarilius, please.
As you wish.
I'd like to travel to Port Sarim, please.
As you wish, I hope you don't get seasick, it is a long voyage.
translation: Nasil isterseniz, umarim deniz tutmazsiniz, uzun bir yolculuk olacak.

english: Nothing.
Where am I exactly?
Can you take me to Port Piscarilius please?
translation: Beni Piscarilius Limani'na götürebilir misiniz lütfen?

english: Can you take me to Port Sarim please?
translation: Beni Sarim Limani'na götürebilir misiniz lütfen?

english: Nothing.
Adventurer. The General warned us about you.
translation: Maceraci. General bizi senin hakkinda uyardi.

english: Warned?
Yes. He said you might show up here again. We're not to harm you, but make no mistake, we're keeping a close eye on you. You're not to be trusted.
translation: Evet. Buraya tekrar gelebilecegini söyledi. Sana zarar vermeyecegiz, ama süphesiz seni yakindan takip ediyoruz. Sana güvenilmez.

english: Well I guess that's the best I can hope for. So how are things going here?
translation: Sanirim bu benim icin en iyisi. Burada isler nasil gidiyor?

english: We are not here to make small talk. Leave us to our work.
translation: Buraya sohbet etmeye gelmedik. Bizi isimize birakin.

english: Hey, how's it going?
You again? As I told you before, we are not here to make small talk. Leave us to our work.
translation: Yine mi sen? Daha önce de söyledigim gibi, buraya sohbet etmeye gelmedik. Bizi isimize birakin.

english: I already told you to stop bothering us. Please go away.
translation: Bizi rahatsiz etmeyi birakmani söyledim. Lütfen git buradan.

english: Hello, what are you doing here, so far from home?
translation: Merhaba, evinden bu kadar uzakta ne yapiyorsun?

english: I'm enjoyn' the local hoschpitalieee. hee hee.
translation: Buradaki misafirperverligin tadini cikariyorum. Hee hee.

english: Looks like you've enjoyed more than your fair share of hospitality.
tee hee, I probblie schoodn' 'av anuva drinkie right now. But dis dwarven beer ish kind of moreish after the fiff pint.
translation: Tee hee, su anda bir icki daha icmem gerekmiyor. Ama bu cüce birasi besinci bardaktan sonra daha da lezzetli oluyor.

english: I'd go easy on the dwarven stout if I were you.
translation: Sen olsam cüce birasina fazla yüklenmezdim.

english: I yousht to be a tesht pilot yoo know. I reeel hero.
translation: Ben test pilotuyum, biliyorsun. Gercek bir kahramanim.

english: But I loscht my bottle. Scho I now ffind scholiss in the bottle.
translation: Ama sisemi kaybettim. Simdi sisede okul buluyorum.

english: What happened? Did you have a glider crash or get attacked by huge flying birds or something?
translation: Ne oldu? Planörün düstü mü, yoksa dev ucan kuslar saldirdi mi?

english: Naaah, I realished I woz scared ov heightsh.
Ah, I can see that would be a problem ... You should keep an eye on your drinking, though.
translation: Ah, bunun sorun olabilecegini anliyorum... Yine de ickine dikkat etmelisin.

english: I'll try. Bofe eyez...
Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: Hazir yemekler maalesef ise yaramaz. Aluft Aloft'un müsterileri icin sadece el yapimi Gnome Mutfagi yeterince iyidir.

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food item] to Captain Ninto.
Aaa shomefing ter go wiv my beer. Thish dwarf beerz quite shtrong you know...
translation: Aaa, biramla birlikte bir seyler de verin. Bu cüce birasi oldukca sert, biliyorsunuz...

english: Here you go, have a dashing pilot's scarf.
I have some spare goggles, you might as well have them.
translation: Yedek gözlüklerim var, onlari da alabilirsiniz.

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: Bunu bana getirmek icin uzun bir yol kat etmis olmalisiniz. Iste size bahsis olarak kücük bir sey.

english: You are given [a/some] [reward item(s)] as a tip.
translation: Bahsis olarak bazi ödül ögesi verilir.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr'dan ücretsiz teslimat jetonunu almayi unutma.

english: Hello, who are you?
Ahoy! I'm Cap'n Pudi, currently assisting the Spirit Anglers in their effort against Tempoross.
translation: Selam! Ben Kaptan Pudi, su anda Spirit Anglers'in Tempoross'a karsi mücadelesine yardim ediyorum.

english: Tempoross? Spirit Anglers? Who are they?
You 'aven't heard?! The freak storms? Sailors running into trouble? Ye really must be a landlubber!
translation: Duymadin mi?! Garip firtinalar? Denizcilerin basinin belaya girmesi? Sen gercekten karada yasayan biri olmalisin!

english: Tempoross is some kind o' great sea spirit that's been spookin' sailors and causing crazy storms!
translation: Tempoross, denizcileri korkutan ve cilgin firtinalara neden olan bir tür büyük deniz ruhu!

english: Taiman and his crew were one of the first t' run into it. Washed up outside Al Kharid amongst piles of debris, they did. 'Tis a troublin' time to be a cap'n!
translation: Taiman ve mürettebati, onunla ilk karsilasanlar arasindaydi. Al Kharid'in disinda enkaz yiginlarinin arasinda karaya sürüklendiler. Kaptan olmak icin zor zamanlar!

english: Oh that doesn't sound good at all!
translation: Bu hic de iyiye isaret degil!

english: It isn't, but worry not. The Spirit Anglers 'ave been formed t' tackle this beastie! We're recruiting all skilled sailors and fisherfolk t' help us.
translation: Öyle, ama endiselenme. Ruh Balikcilari bu canavarla basa cikmak icin kuruldu! Bize yardim edecek tüm yetenekli denizciler ve balikcilar ariyoruz.

english: Well I can definitely fish!
Are you sure? It's pretty rough out there and you look like you could do with more experience.
translation: Emin misin? Orada durumlar oldukca zor ve daha fazla deneyime ihtiyacin var gibi görünüyor.

english: You need a Fishing level of 35 to fight Tempoross.
translation: Tempoross ile savasmak icin 35 balikcilik seviyesi gerekiyor.

english: Excellent!
The ships on the dock regularly embark to Tempoross Cove. Once there, you'll need to keep the cannons loaded with Harpoonfish t' weaken the Spirit. You can fish 'em on the island.
translation: Rihtimdaki gemiler düzenli olarak Tempoross Koyu'na hareket ediyor. Oraya vardiginda, Ruh'u zayiflatmak icin toplari Harpoonfish ile doldurman gerekecek. Onlari adada avlayabilirsin.

english: When Tempoross submerges, get up close and clear the fish from its whirlpools; they're how it gets its energy.
translation: Tempoross suya daldiginda, yakina yaklas ve girdaplarindan baliklari temizle; onlar Ruh'un enerji kaynagidir.

english: Well, that sounds easy enough!
Aye, that be the easy part!
The storm of Tempoross will rage around you, so you better be ready to deal with lightning strikes and avoid getting zapped when Tempoross attacks the cannons.
translation: Tempoross'un firtinasi etrafinda siddetle esecek, bu yüzden yildirimlara hazirlikli olun ve Tempoross toplara saldirdiginda carpilmamaya dikkat edin.

english: Also, watch out for those mighty waves! You'll want t' tether yourself t' something solid so you don't find yourself lost in the deep blue when they come crashing down!
translation: Ayrica, dev dalgalara da dikkat edin! Dalgalar carptiginda kendinizi derin maviliklerde kaybetmemek icin saglam bir seye tutunun!

english: Oh... Well, I suppose I can do that.
Will I need any special equipment?
translation: Özel bir ekipmana ihtiyacim olacak mi?

english: Everythin' you need can be found on-board. Though if you have a favourite harpoon, you can always bring that!
translation: Ihtiyacin olan her sey gemide mevcut. Ama en sevdigin zipkin varsa, onu da getirebilirsin!

english: The complete Spirit Anglers outfit also has an 'andy harness built-in, so you won't need a rope if you're wearin' it. You can speak t' Gita about getting one.
translation: Komple Spirit Anglers kiyafeti, yerlesik bir emniyet kemeri de icerir, bu yüzden onu giyersen ipe ihtiyacin olmaz. Gita'dan bir tane alabilirsin.

english: Ye can find Gita just east of 'ere, next t' some fishin' equipment.
translation: Gita'yi buradan doguda, balikcilik ekipmanlarinin yaninda bulabilirsin.

english: When you're ready, just board the ship and we'll set sail soon!
translation: Hazir oldugunda gemiye bin, yakinda yelken acacagiz!

english: Aye aye cap'n!
Are there any benefits to helping the Spirit Anglers?
translation: Spirit Anglers'a yardim etmenin herhangi bir faydasi var mi?

english: Other than maintainin' safe passage and savin' lives?!
translation: Güvenli gecisi saglamak ve hayat kurtarmak disinda mi?

english: Well...
I'm just messin' with ye! Of course there are benefits!
translation: Sadece dalga geciyorum! Tabii ki faydalari var!

english: We find all sorts washed up by the storms. Aside from the usual junk, we often find old chests from merchant supply ships, as well as the odd artefact here and there.
translation: Firtinalarla kiyiya vurmus her türlü seyi buluyoruz. Her zamanki cöplerin yani sira, ticaret gemilerinden gelen eski sandiklar ve burada orada garip eserler de buluyoruz.

english: If it's not needed for the Spirit Anglers' research, it's yours to keep!
translation: Ruh Balikcilarinin arastirmalari icin gerekli degilse, hepsi senin olabilir!

english: Some of the more resourceful Spirit Anglers also discovered a fishing use for the spirit energised scales shed by the fish within Tempoross. You're free t' keep any you find.
translation: Daha becerikli Ruh Balikcilari, Tempoross'taki baliklarin biraktigi ruh enerjisiyle dolu pullari balikcilikta kullanmanin bir yolunu da kesfettiler. Buldugun pullari istedigin gibi kullanabilirsin.

english: Can you remind me what to do on the island?
translation: Adada ne yapmam gerektigini hatirlatir misin?

english: Can you tell me more about the Spirit Anglers?
translation: Ruh Balikcilari hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verir misin?

english: Well, as I mentioned before, Taiman and his fishing crew from Al Kharid 'ad a tussle with Tempoross. They barely made it back.
translation: Daha önce de bahsettigim gibi, Taiman ve Al Kharid'den gelen balikci ekibi Tempoross ile bir kavgaya tutustu. Zar zor geri dönebildiler.

english: I was sitting down by the shore enjoying one of Karim's kebabs at the time, when suddenly the crew washed up amongst a pile of debris. Looked like they'd just seen a ghost!
translation: O sirada kiyida oturmus Karim'in kebaplarindan birini yiyordum, birdenbire ekip enkaz yigininin arasinda kiyiya vurdu. Sanki hayalet görmüs gibiydiler!

english: As soon as they could talk sense they went to the Chancellor and within days more shockin' tales of the Sea Spirit's wrath came in.
translation: Aklini basina toplayabildikleri anda Sansölye'ye gittiler ve birkac gün icinde Deniz Ruhu'nun öfkesiyle ilgili daha da sok edici hikayeler geldi.

english: The Chancellor called a meeting for all us local seafarin' folk and we agreed action must be taken!
translation: Sansölye, bölgedeki tüm denizciler icin bir toplanti düzenledi ve hepimiz harekete gecilmesi gerektigi konusunda anlastik!

english: Ain't nothin' goin' t' take the seas from me, even if it is a powerful spirit!
translation: Güclü bir ruh olsa bile, denizleri benden alamazlar!

english: Anyway, it was decided that we'd setup a base 'ere amongst these ruins, and so the Spirit Anglers was formed!
translation: Her neyse, bu harabelerin arasinda bir üs kurmaya karar verdik ve böylece Spirit Anglers kuruldu!

english: Don't ask me what the ruins used to be. And it's not like Menaphos can 'ave a say!
translation: Harabelerin eskiden ne oldugunu bana sorma. Menaphos'un da bu konuda söz hakki yok!

english: Whatever they are, they make a fine base for the Spirit Anglers!
translation: Ne olursa olsun, Spirit Anglers icin harika bir üs oluyorlar!

english: Since moving in, we've been recruiting fisherfolk from all over, and some of the readin' types 'ave been studyin' Tempoross durin' our trips to subdue it.
translation: Buraya tasindigimizdan beri, her yerden balikcilar topluyoruz ve okuma yazma bilenler, onu yenmek icin yaptigimiz yolculuklar sirasinda Tempoross'u inceliyorlar.

english: I like t' get stuck in, me-self; face off toe t' toe with the beastie. I'll be right by your side when you go out there!
translation: Ben kendim de ise koyulmayi seviyorum; canavarla yüz yüze gelmeyi. Oraya gittiginde yaninda olacagim!

english: Well that's encouraging, I think...
I'm still 'ere, ain't I?
Anyway, there's plenty o' research going on, so maybe you can find some notes lyin' around if ye want to know more.
translation: Her neyse, pek cok arastirma yapiliyor, daha fazla bilgi edinmek istersen etrafta bazi notlar bulabilirsin.

english: Goodbye.
Hello again!
Ahoy there! What can I 'elp ye with?
Sorry, it's pretty rough out there and you look like you could do with more experience.
translation: Üzgünüm, disarisi oldukca zorlu ve daha fazla deneyime ihtiyacin var gibi görünüyor.

english: What do you need, adventurer? There is a battle to fight!
translation: Neye ihtiyacin var, maceraci? Savasilacak bir savas var!

english: How do I help?
Get yerself a harpoon from the crate on the ship, then go fish around the island t' catch some harpoonfish. They make fer fine ammo against Tempoross!
translation: Gemideki sandiktan bir zipkin al, sonra adanin cevresinde balik tutarak zipkin baligi yakala. Bunlar Tempoross'a karsi iyi bir mühimmat olur!

english: Once ye caught some, ye can cook 'em at the shrines on the island if ye want 'em to pack more of a punch. Then come back t' the ship an' load 'em in the ammunition crates next to the cannons.
translation: Biraz yakaladiktan sonra, daha etkili olmalarini istiyorsan adadaki tapinaklarda pisirebilirsin. Sonra gemiye geri dön ve onlari toplarin yanindaki mühimmat sandiklarina yükle.

english: Our cannoneers will get t' firin' the harpoonfish at Tempoross. When it's weak an' submerges to recover its energy, get down to the jetty next t' the ship an' fish those spirit pools.
translation: Topcularimiz zipkin baliklarini Tempoross'a atesleyecek. Zayiflayip enerjisini toplamak icin suya daldiginda, geminin yanindaki iskeleye in ve ruh havuzlarinda balik tut.

english: Be quick with fishin' those spirit pools though, or it'll come back so strong we'll have to abandon the fight! With any luck, we'll weaken those spirit fish enough t' subdue Tempoross. Now get t' the fight, sailor!
translation: Ruh havuzlarinda balik tutarken acele et, yoksa o kadar güclenir ki savasi birakmak zorunda kaliriz! Sansimiz yaver giderse, ruh baliklarini Tempoross'u alt edecek kadar zayiflatabiliriz. Simdi savasa git, denizci!

english: Aye aye!
What should I watch out for?
If Tempoross electrocutes a cannon t' stop it from firin', ya better load your harpoonfish into the other ammunition crates t' keep them cannons firin' instead.
translation: Tempoross, topun ates etmesini engellemek icin onu elektrikle vurursa, toplarin ates etmeye devam etmesi icin zipkin baliklarini diger mühimmat sandiklarina yüklesen iyi olur.

english: Also, make sure t' grab a rope from the ship crates an' keep an eye out for big waves. We'll make sure t' shout about them. Then ye best quickly tether yerself t' an island totem pole or ship mast with that rope.
translation: Ayrica, geminin sandiklarindan bir ip al ve büyük dalgalara dikkat et. Onlari sesli bir sekilde uyarmaya calisacagiz. O zaman o iple kendini bir ada totem diregine veya gemi diregine hizlica bagla.

english: If the waves break the totem pole or ship mast, ye can grab a hammer from the ship crates t' fix 'em up before the next big wave hits.
translation: Dalgalar totem diregini veya gemi diregini kirarsa, geminin sandiklarindan bir cekic alip bir sonraki büyük dalga gelmeden önce onlari onarabilirsin.

english: Oh, an' keep an eye out for lightnin' clouds causin' fires. Get a bucket from the ship crates, fill it with water at a pump, and get t' puttin it out before it spreads.
translation: Oh, ve yanginlara neden olan yildirim bulutlarina da dikkat et. Gemi sandiklarindan bir kova al, pompadan suyla doldur ve yayilmadan söndür.

english: If ye get hit by the waves or fire, don't be surprised when ye lose those fish an' tools ye gathered. Now get t' the fight, sailor!
translation: Dalgalar veya yangin tarafindan vurulursan, topladigin baliklari ve aletleri kaybettiginde sasirma. Simdi savasa git, denizci!

english: I want to leave.
Really? You will receive no reward if you do.
Yes, I really want to leave.
No, I don't want to leave.
I'll get on with the fighting.
We did it! Tempoross has been sudbued once again. Well done!
translation: Basardik! Tempoross bir kez daha yenildi. Aferin!

english: Take a well deserved rest but don't get too comfy, it'll regain its energy soon enough!
translation: Hak ettiginiz dinlenmeyi alin ama fazla rahatlamayin, yakinda enerjisini geri kazanacaktir!

english: What should I do now?
We usually find some debris washed up near the docks back at Unkah. Feel free t' have a look. Ya might find somethin' useful!
translation: Genellikle Unkah'daki rihtimlarin yakininda kiyiya vurmus enkazlar buluruz. Istersen bir bakabilirsin. Yararli bir sey bulabilirsin!

english: It won't be long before Tempoross regains enough energy to be a problem and we'll have to wrangle it again. Hopefully we can count on you to 'elp!
translation: Tempoross'un tekrar sorun yaratacak kadar enerji toplamasi cok uzun sürmeyecek ve onu tekrar alt etmemiz gerekecek. Umarim yardimina güvenebiliriz!

english: I'm ready to leave.
Aye aye!
Excellent work out there! The seas are safe for a little longer thanks to you!
translation: Harika is cikardin! Sayende denizler biraz daha güvenli hale geldi!

english: We usually find some debris washed up near the docks. Feel free to have a look. Ya might find somethin' useful!
translation: Genellikle rihtimlarin yakininda sürüklenen enkazlar buluruz. Istersen bir bakabilirsin. Belki yararli bir sey bulursun!

english: Thanks!
Argh, we let that storm grow too fierce... As soon as it's safe we'll 'ead straight back out!
translation: Ah, firtinanin cok siddetli olmasina izin verdik... Güvenli olur olmaz hemen geri dönecegiz!

english: Aye aye, Cap'n!
Join the Spirit Anglers!
Plenty of room for more adventurers!
translation: Daha fazla maceraci icin bolca yer var!

english: Come and help us fight Tempoross!
translation: Gelin ve Tempoross'la savasmamiza yardim edin!

english: It'll be worth your while...
To the boats! We'll set sail soon!
We'll set sail in the next [25/20/15/10/5] seconds.
Let's get underway!
Belay that! We'll try again later.
Tempoross will surface soon, prepare yourselves!
translation: Tempoross yakinda su yüzüne cikacak, hazir olun!

english: More fish!
Load those cannons!
Keep an eye on the waves!
Tempoross is drawing in water, prepare yourselves!
The mast has been damaged!
Storm clouds are rolling in, get your buckets ready!
Tempoross has disabled a cannon! Switch to another!
translation: Tempoross bir topu kullanilamaz hale getirdi! Baska bir topa gecin!

english: Tempoross has submerged, fish from the whirlpools!
translation: Tempoross suya daldi, girdaplardan balik tutun!

english: Tempoross has surfaced, keep those cannons firing!
translation: Tempoross su yüzüne cikti, toplari ateslemeye devam edin!

english: Tempoross has retreated to the depths!
Tempoross has gathered too much energy!
The storm has grown too strong, we must retreat!
Are there any benefits to helping the Spirit Anglers?
translation: Ruh Balikcilarina yardim etmenin bir faydasi var mi?

english: Can you remind me what to do on the island?
translation: Adada ne yapmam gerektigini hatirlatir misin?

english: Goodbye.
Can you tell me more about the Spirit Anglers?
translation: Ruh Balikcilari hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: How do I help?
What should I watch out for?
I want to leave.
Yes, I really want to leave.
No, I don't want to leave.
I'll get on with the fighting.
What should I do now?
I'm ready to leave.
Attention! Front and centre!
Yes ma'am!
I have to ask you to get back from here [sir/lady].
Why? What's going on here?
This is the Lizardman Canyon. The lizardmen from the west are desperately trying to invade Great Kourend.
translation: Burasi Lizardman Kanyonu. Batidan gelen kertenkele adamlar, Great Kourend'i isgal etmek icin caresizce ugrasiyorlar.

english: We were able to hold them back, so they've started tunnelling under the kingdom and into this canyon to bypass our defences.
translation: Onlari geri püskürtmeyi basardik, bu yüzden kralligin altindan tüneller kazarak savunmamizi asmak icin bu kanyona girmeye basladilar.

english: Luckily, we were able to work out what they were doing and move to stop them. So far we've managed to keep them trapped within the canyon, but we need to constantly hold them at bay.
translation: Neyse ki, ne yaptiklarini anladik ve onlari durdurmak icin harekete gectik. Su ana kadar onlari kanyonun icinde tutmayi basardik, ama onlari sürekli uzak tutmamiz gerekiyor.

english: I'm a very strong adventurer. Would I be able to help out in the battle?
translation: Ben cok güclü bir maceraciyim. Savasta yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: No! We would never trust a stranger in the importance of a battle! A lot is at stake.
translation: Hayir! Önemli bir savasta bir yabanciya asla güvenmeyiz! Cok sey söz konusu.

english: You may. Head into the canyon and take the fight to those monsters!
translation: Yapabilirsin. Kanyona gir ve o canavarlarla savas!

english: Beware the Chambers of Xeric, adventurer.
These dungeons and the perils within them are unique. You will encounter both dangerous and mysterious creatures here.
translation: Bu zindanlar ve iclerindeki tehlikeler benzersizdir. Burada hem tehlikeli hem de gizemli yaratiklarla karsilasacaksin.

english: Remember that you may be kicked out at any time - any items dropped on the ground will be lost inside.
translation: Her an disari atilabilecegini unutma - yere düsürdügün esyalar iceride kaybolacaktir.

english: Do not allow your curiosity to get the better of you.
translation: Merakinin seni ele gecirmesine izin verme.

english: Thanks for the warning.
What are you doing up here? Only the palace guards are allowed up here.
translation: Burada ne isin var? Buraya sadece saray muhafizlari girebilir.

english: I am one of the palace guards.
No, you're not! I know all the palace guards.
translation: Hayir, degilsin! Tüm saray muhafizlarini tanirim.

english: I'm a new recruit.
I interview all the new recruits. I'd know if you were one of them.
translation: Tüm yeni askerlerle görüsürüm. Eger onlardan biri olsaydin bilirdim.

english: That blows that story out of the water then.
translation: O zaman bu hikaye cürümüs demektir.

english: Get out of my sight.
I've had extensive plastic surgery.
What sort of surgery is that? I've never heard of it. Besides, you look reasonably healthy.
translation: Ne tür bir ameliyat bu? Hic duymadim. Ayrica, oldukca saglikli görünüyorsun.

english: Why is this relevant anyway? You still shouldn't be here.
translation: Bu konuyla ne alakasi var ki? Yine de burada olmamalisin.

english: What about the King? Surely you'd let him up here.
translation: Peki ya Kral? Onu buraya alirsiniz herhalde.

english: Well, yes, I suppose we'd let him up. He doesn't generally want to come up here, but if he did want to, he could.
translation: Evet, sanirim onu aliriz. Genelde buraya gelmek istemez, ama isterse gelebilir.

english: Anyway, you're not the King either. So get out of my sight.
translation: Her neyse, sen de Kral degilsin. O yüzden gözümün önünden kaybol.

english: Yes, I know, but this is important.
Ok, I'm listening. Tell me what's so important.
translation: Tamam, dinliyorum. Neyin bu kadar önemli oldugunu söyle.

english: There's a demon who wants to invade the city.
translation: Sehri istila etmek isteyen bir iblis var.

english: Is it a powerful demon?
Not really.
Well, I'm sure the palace guards can deal with it, then. Thanks for the information.
translation: O zaman saray muhafizlari onunla basa cikabilir. Bilgi icin tesekkürler.

english: Yes, very.
As good as the palace guards are, I don't know if they're up to taking on a very powerful demon.
translation: Saray muhafizlari ne kadar iyi olursa olsun, cok güclü bir iblisle basa cikabileceklerini sanmiyorum.

english: Yeah, the palace guards are rubbish!
Yeah, they're--
Wait! How dare you insult the palace guards? Get out of my sight!
translation: Dur! Saray muhafizlarina nasil hakaret edersin? Gözümün önünden kaybol!

english: It's not them who are going to fight the demon, it's me.
translation: Iblisle savasacak olan onlar degil, benim.

english: What, all by yourself? How are you going to do that?
translation: Ne, tek basina mi? Bunu nasil yapacaksin?

english: I'm going to use the powerful sword Silverlight, which I believe you have one of the keys for?
translation: Güclü kilic Silverlight'i kullanacagim, sanirim onun anahtarlarindan biri sende var?

english: Yes, I do. But why should I give it to you?
translation: Evet, var. Ama neden sana vereyim ki?

english: Fortune-teller Aris said I was destined to kill the demon.
translation: Falci Aris, iblisi öldürmenin kaderimde oldugunu söyledi.

english: A fortune-teller? Destiny? I don't believe in that stuff. I got where I am today by hard work, not by destiny! Why should I care what that mad old fortune-teller says?
translation: Falci mi? Kader mi? Ben o tür seylere inanmam. Bugünkü konumuma kader sayesinde degil, calisarak geldim! O cilgin falcinin söylediklerini neden umursayayim ki?

english: Otherwise the demon will destroy the city!
translation: Aksi takdirde iblis sehri yok edecek!

english: You can't fool me! How do I know you haven't just made that story up to get my key?
translation: Beni kandiramazsin! Anahtari almak icin bu hikayeyi uydurmadigini nereden bileyim?

english: Sir Prysin said you would give me the key.
translation: Sör Prysin anahtari bana verecegini söyledi.

english: Oh, he did, did he? Well I don't report to Sir Prysin, I report directly to the king!
translation: Öyle mi dedi? Ben Sör Prysin'e bagli degilim, dogrudan krala bagliyim!

english: I didn't work my way up through the ranks of the palace guards so I could take orders from an ill-bred moron who only has his job because his great- grandfather was a hero with a silly name!
translation: Saray muhafizlarinin saflarinda yükselip, sadece büyükbabasi aptal bir isme sahip bir kahraman oldugu icin bu isi yapan, terbiyesiz bir aptaldan emir almak icin calismadim!

english: Why did he give you one of the keys then?
translation: O zaman neden sana anahtarlardan birini verdi?

english: Only because the king ordered him to! The king couldn't get Sir Prysin to part with his precious ancestral sword, but he made him lock it up so he couldn't lose it.
translation: Sadece kral emrettigi icin! Kral, Sir Prysin'in degerli atalarinin kilicini elinden alamadi, ama onu kaybetmemesi icin kilit altina aldi.

english: I got one key and I think some wizard got another. Now what happened to the third one?
translation: Ben bir anahtari aldim ve sanirim bir büyücü de digerini aldi. Peki ücüncü anahtara ne oldu?

english: Sir Prysin dropped it down a drain!
translation: Sir Prysin onu bir kanalizasyona düsürdü!

english: Ha ha ha! The idiot!
Okay, I'll give you the key, just so that it's you that kills the demon and not Sir Prysin!
translation: Tamam, anahtari sana verecegim, ama seytani öldüren sen ol, Sir Prysin degil!

english: Erm I forgot.
Well it can't be that important then.
translation: O zaman o kadar önemli olamaz.

english: How do you know?
Just go away.
The castle has just received its ale delivery.
Now that is important. However I'm the wrong person to speak to about it. Go talk to the kitchen staff.
translation: Bu önemli bir sey. Ama bu konuda konusacak dogru kisi ben degilim. Mutfak personeli ile konus.

english: I am one of the palace guards.
I'm a new recruit.
I've had extensive plastic surgery.
What about the King?
Yes I know, but this is important.
There's a demon who wants to invade this city.
translation: Bu sehri istila etmek isteyen bir iblis var.

english: Not really.
Yes, very.
Yeah, the palace guards are rubbish!
It's not them who are going to fight the demon, it's me.
translation: Iblisle savasacak olan onlar degil, benim.

english: Fortune-teller Aris said I was destined to kill the demon.
translation: Falci Aris, iblisi öldürmenin benim kaderim oldugunu söyledi.

english: Otherwise the demon will destroy the city
translation: Aksi takdirde iblis sehri yok edecek.

english: Sir Prysin said you would give me the key
translation: Sör Prysin, bana anahtari verecegini söyledi.

english: Otherwise the demon will destroy the city!
translation: Aksi takdirde iblis sehri yok edecek!

english: Sir Prysin said you would give me the key.
translation: Sör Prysin anahtari bana verecegini söyledi.

english: Why did he give you one of the keys then?
translation: O zaman neden sana anahtarlardan birini verdi?

english: Erm I forgot.
The castle has just received its ale delivery.
What's going on here?
Beyond this wall you'll find the Kebos Lowlands. Most of the region is lizardman territory. We're here to keep them from entering Kourend.
translation: Bu duvarin ötesinde Kebos Ovalari var. Bölgenin cogu kertenkele adamlarin topraklari. Onlarin Kourend'e girmesini engellemek icin buradayiz.

english: We used to keep this passage properly barricaded shut, but then the fancy historians from the Arceuus Library wanted to go do some research out there.
translation: Eskiden bu gecidi düzgün bir sekilde barikatlarla kapatirdik, ama sonra Arceuus Kütüphanesi'nden gelen süslü tarihciler orada arastirma yapmak istediler.

english: Soon the farmers joined them, and before you knew it, everyone wanted to go explore. Some of them have even started living out there.
translation: Kisa süre sonra ciftciler de onlara katildi ve bir anda herkes kesfe cikmak istedi. Bazilari hatta orada yasamaya basladi.

english: I can see it all ending badly, but that's the problem with intellectuals - they always think they know better.
translation: Her seyin kötü bitecegini görebiliyorum, ama entelektüellerin sorunu da bu: her zaman kendilerini daha iyi bildiklerini sanirlar.

english: Anyway, maybe they'll all get themselves killed. Then we can put the barricade back up.
translation: Neyse, belki de hepsi ölecekler. O zaman barikati tekrar kurabiliriz.

english: If you go out there yourself, give the lizardmen a kicking from me. They've killed too many of my soldiers.
translation: Eger oraya gidersen, kertenkele adamlara benim adima bir tekme at. Cok fazla askerimi öldürdüler.

english: Beyond these walls is a Lizardman settlement, we're defending against it.
translation: Bu duvarlarin ötesinde bir kertenkele adam yerlesimi var, onu savunuyoruz.

english: Why do they hate humans?
Who knows, all I know is offence is the best type of defence, we will attack soon, will you help us, brave warrior?
translation: Kim bilir, tek bildigim saldiri en iyi savunmadir, yakinda saldiracagiz, bize yardim eder misin, cesur savasci?

english: I don't know... Sounds dangerous.
Oh, the assault is not for a while, go train and prepare, for there will be all sorts of grand rewards from this expedition.
translation: Oh, saldiri bir süre sonra olacak, gidip antrenman yap ve hazirlan, cünkü bu seferden büyük ödüller kazanacaksin.

english: Rewards? I'm in! Hopefully some brand new armour or something.
translation: Ödüller mi? Ben varim! Umarim yepyeni bir zirh falan olur.

english: Hmm...
Oh dear, this ship is in a terrible state. And I just can't get the items I need to repair it because Shilo village is overrun with zombies.
translation: Oh hayir, bu gemi cok kötü durumda. Ve Shilo köyü zombilerle doldugu icin onu tamir etmek icin ihtiyacim olan malzemeleri bulamiyorum.

english: Hello there shipmate! I sail to Khazard Port and to Port Sarim. Where are you bound?
translation: Merhaba gemi arkadasi! Ben Khazard Limani ve Port Sarim'e gidiyorum. Sen nereye gidiyorsun?

english: I see you don't have a ticket for the ship, my colleague normally only sells them in Shilo village. But I could sell you one for a small additional charge. Shall we say [number] gold pieces
Yes, I'll buy a ticket for the ship.
Sorry me old shipmate, but you seem to be  financially challenged at the moment. Come back when your coffers are full!
translation: Üzgünüm eski dostum, ama su anda maddi sikintin var gibi görünüyor. Kasalarin doldugunda tekrar gel!

english: It's a good deal and no mistake. Here you go me old shipmate, here's your ticket.
translation: Bu iyi bir firsat, hic süphen yok. Al bakalim eski dostum, iste biletin.

english: Ok, now you have your ticket, do you want to sail anywhere?
translation: Tamam, artik biletin var, nereye gitmek istersin?

english: Khazard Port please.
Very well then me old shipmate, I'll just take your ticket and then we'll set sail.
translation: Peki o zaman eski dostum, biletinizi alayim, sonra yola cikalim.

english: You arrive safely in the quiet fishing port of Khazard.
translation: Khazard'in sakin balikci limanina güvenle vardiniz.

english: Port Sarim please.
The ship arrives in busy Port Sarim.
Nowhere just at the moment thanks.
translation: Su anda hicbir yere gitmiyorum, tesekkürler.

english: Very well then me old shipmate, Just let me know if you change your mind.
translation: Peki o zaman eski dostum, fikrini degistirirsen bana haber ver.

english: No thanks, not just at the moment.
Very well me old shipmate,  come back if you change your mind now.
translation: Peki eski dostum, fikrini degistirirsen geri gel.

english: Yes, I'll buy a ticket for the ship.
Khazard Port please.
Port Sarim please.
Nowhere just at the moment thanks.
translation: Su anda hicbir yere gitmiyorum, tesekkürler.

english: No thanks, not just at the moment.
Can you take me on the glider?
Of course!
Why are gliders better than other transport?
translation: Planörler diger ulasim araclarindan neden daha iyidir?

english: Oh we have a whole network! It's wonderful for getting to hard to reach places.
translation: Oh, bizim bütün bir agimiz var! Ulasilmasi zor yerlere gitmek icin harika.

english: There are so many places where your teleports cannot reach!
translation: Teleportlarin ulasamadigi cok fazla yer var!

english: How did you all manage to build such an established network?
translation: Böyle köklü bir agi nasil kurmayi basardiniz?

english: I think you'll find that is a gnome trade secret!
translation: Sanirim bunun bir gnome ticari sirri oldugunu göreceksin!

english: Sorry, I don't want anything now.
translation: Üzgünüm, su anda bir sey istemiyorum.

english: Can you take me on the glider?
Why are gliders better than other transport?
translation: Planörler diger ulasim araclarindan neden daha iyidir?

english: Sorry, I don't want anything now.
translation: Üzgünüm, su anda bir sey istemiyorum.

english: Do you want to go on a trip to Karamja?
translation: Karamja'ya bir geziye cikmak ister misin?

english: The trip will cost you 30 coins.
Oh dear, I don't seem to have enough money.
translation: Oh hayir, yeterince param yok galiba.

english: Yes please.
No, thank you.
I'd rather go to Crandor Isle.
No I need to stay alive, I have a wife and family to support.
translation: Hayir, hayatta kalmam lazim, desteklemem gereken bir esim ve ailem var.

english: Well done, matey! Here you go!
Yes please.
No, thank you.
Arrr, 'tis the young [lad/lass] who helped save my crew from that scoundrel, Ithoi! How be ye this fine day?
translation: Arrr, bu genc , mürettebatimi o alcak Ithoi'den kurtarmama yardim etti! Bu güzel günde nasilsin?

english: I'm fine, thanks.
Arrr, ye looks fine. Stiff in the spine, firm in the mind an' long in the leg. 'Tis good to see ye again.
translation: Arrr, iyi görünüyorsun. Omurgan dik, zihnin saglam ve bacaklarin uzun. Seni tekrar görmek güzel.

english: What is there to do here?
Well, ye could maybe explore the ogre caves. Arsen says the ogres be fearsome, though, so watch yer step. An' there be places for ye to train yer skills, over to the west.
translation: Sey, belki ogre magaralarini kesfedebilirsin. Arsen, ogrelerin korkunc oldugunu söylüyor, o yüzden adimlarina dikkat et. Ve batida becerilerini gelistirebilecegin yerler var.

english: Thanks.
Eh, goodbye.
I'm fine, thanks.
What is there to do here?
Eh, goodbye.
Good day, Carado.
What are you doing here?
Well, I figured that with Glough being gone and all...
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Biliyorsun, insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu var. Selamlar, saygilar, esenlikler...

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: Bu yine de tek bir selam sayilir!

english: Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her türlü sey! Kuleler görülmeye deger harika bir manzara.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmeni tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Hello there!
Hello! You're not from around here, are you? It's exciting to see that even people from outside of Varlamore are looking to join the Emissaries!
translation: Merhaba! Buralardan degilsin, degil mi? Varlamore disindan insanlar bile Elcilere katilmak istiyorlar, bu cok heyecan verici!

english: Well after I heard about all the good work they were doing, I could hardly say no! What about you? What made you want to join them?
translation: Onlarin yaptigi tüm iyi isleri duyduktan sonra, hayir diyemezdim! Peki ya sen? Onlara katilmak istemenin sebebi ne?

english: Well it's our duty of course! The Church of Ralos has become lost, but the Emissaries know the truth. Ximoua will not come to be unless we make it so!
translation: Tabii ki bu bizim görevimiz! Ralos Kilisesi kayboldu, ama Elciler gercegi biliyor. Ximoua, biz öyle yapmadikca gerceklesmeyecek!

english: So you're quite eager to see the end of the world then?
translation: Yani dünyanin sonunu görmek icin sabirsizlaniyorsun?

english: End? Ximoua is no end! It is the beginning! We will all come together as one and bring about a new world! I can't wait!
translation: Son mu? Ximoua son degil! O baslangic! Hepimiz bir araya gelip yeni bir dünya yaratacagiz! Sabirsizlaniyorum!

english: Well I'm glad to see you're so excited. Good luck with the tests.
translation: Bu kadar heyecanli oldugunu görmekten memnun oldum. Sinavlarda basarilar.

english: And you!
What ales are you serving?
We serve Crombwick's finest Bloody Bracer, that is all.
translation: Crombwick'in en iyi Bloody Bracer'ini servis ediyoruz, hepsi bu.

english: Sounds rough, how much?
99 of you finest coins.
Alright, one Bloody Bracer, if that's all you have.
translation: Tamam, bir Bloody Bracer, eger elinde sadece o varsa.

english: I said 99 coins! You haven't got 99 coins!
translation: 99 madeni para dedim! 99 madeni paran yok!

english: Sorry, I'll come back another day.
translation: Üzgünüm, baska bir gün tekrar gelirim.

english: Thanks, Carl.
99 coins? That's ridiculous!
What can I say? The ingredients are locally sourced so it's high quality, I promise.
translation: Ne diyebilirim ki? Malzemeler yerel kaynakli oldugu icin kalitesi yüksek, söz veriyorum.

english: Well, I guess I shouldn't shoot the messenger.
So...
What can you tell me about this town?
I've not been here long myself, so I'm afraid I may not be of much help.
translation: Ben de buraya yeni geldim, maalesef pek yardimci olamayacagim.

english: What happened to the previous barkeep?
Oh, he had to leave.
How come?
Scared of turning.
Turning?
Yes, into a sleeper.
Oh right! You see, for a second there I thought you were talking about vampyres.
translation: Anladim! Bir an icin vampirlerden bahsettigini sandim.

english: Ha ha! We, err, don't see many of those types around here. No, no, not at all.
translation: Ha ha! Biz, sey, buralarda pek o türden insanlar görmüyoruz. Hayir, hayir, hic de degil.

english: If you say so.
I do. So...
Actually, I'm no longer thirsty.
Oh, the red thirst will be upon you soon.
translation: Oh, kirmizi susuzluk yakinda seni de yakalayacak.

english: Excuse me?
Just a jest, traveller.
Oh.
Alright, one Bloody Bracer, if that's all you have.
translation: Tamam, bir Bloody Bracer, eger elinde sadece o varsa.

english: 99 coins? That's ridiculous!
What can you tell me about this town?
Actually, I'm no longer thirsty.
Hello.
Oh, hello.
You seem upset... What's wrong?
My son fell ill with the plague...
That's awful, I'm sorry.
It would be easier to cope with if I could have spent his last few days with him.
translation: Son günlerini onunla gecirebilseydim, bununla basa cikmak daha kolay olurdu.

english: Why didn't you?
Those mourners came and whisked him away. He didn't even seem that ill, I thought it was a common cold... But the mourners said that he was infected and had to be taken away.
translation: Cenazeci adamlar gelip onu götürdüler. O kadar hasta görünmüyordu, siradan bir soguk alginligi oldugunu düsündüm... Ama cenazeci adamlar onun enfekte oldugunu ve götürülmesi gerektigini söylediler.

english: Two days later the mourners returned and told me he had died.
translation: Iki gün sonra cenaze levazimatcilari geri geldi ve bana öldügünü söylediler.

english: Again, I'm sorry. Life can be harsh.
Where did the plague come from?
It's down to King Tyras. He and his men brought the plague here from the west, and then left us to suffer. One day he'll pay for what he's done!
translation: Kral Tyras'in sucu. O ve adamlari vebayi batidan buraya getirdiler ve sonra bizi aci cekmeye terk ettiler. Bir gün yaptiklarinin bedelini ödeyecek!

english: Have there been many victims of the plague?
translation: Vebadan cok sayida kurban oldu mu?

english: You could say that... I've heard reports that half of West Ardougne is infected! Many have lost friends and family...
translation: Öyle denebilir... Bati Ardougne'nin yarisinin enfekte oldugunu duydum! Bircogu arkadaslarini ve ailelerini kaybetti...

english: It sounds an awful way to live.
People are very depressed and scared. I've never met anyone fully infected though. I suppose we should be grateful to the mourners for that.
translation: Insanlar cok depresif ve korkmus durumda. Ama tamamen enfekte olmus kimseyle karsilasmadim. Bunun icin cenaze törenini düzenleyenlere minnettar olmaliyiz sanirim.

english: I hope things get easier for you.
Me too...
Hey Carla, how are you doing?
I'm okay. The loss of my son is something that I'll never be over. At least no one else has to suffer at the hands of those mourners though.
translation: Iyiyim. Oglumun kaybini asla atlatamayacagim. En azindan baska kimse o yas tutanlarin elinde aci cekmek zorunda kalmayacak.

english: Where did the plague come from?
Have there been many victims of the plague?
I hope things get easier for you.
Squeak!
Apparently you aren't as stupid as you look.
Hello there.
Is there any chance you could help me?
What's wrong?
It's my husband, he works on a fishing platform. Once a month he takes our son, Kennith, out with him.
translation: Kocam balikci platformunda calisiyor. Ayda bir kez oglumuz Kennith'i de yaninda götürüyor.

english: They usually write to me regularly, but I've heard nothing all week. It's very strange.
translation: Genelde düzenli olarak mektup yaziyorlar ama bu hafta hic haber almadim. Cok garip.

english: Maybe the post was lost!
Maybe, but no-one's heard from the other fishermen on the platform. Their families are becoming quite concerned.
translation: Olabilir ama platformdaki diger balikcilardan da haber yok. Aileleri cok endiseleniyor.

english: Is there any chance you could visit the platform and find out what's going on?
translation: Platformu ziyaret edip neler oldugunu ögrenebilir misiniz?

english: I suppose so, how do I get there?
That's very good of you [player]. My friend Holgart will take you there.
translation: Cok naziksiniz maceraci. Arkadasim Holgart sizi oraya götürecek.

english: Ok, I'll go and see if they're ok.
translation: Tamam, gidip iyi olup olmadiklarini kontrol edecegim.

english: I'll reward you for your time. It'll give me peace of mind to know Kennith and my husband, Kent, are safe.
translation: Zaman ayirdiginiz icin size ödül verecegim. Kennith ve kocam Kent'in güvende oldugunu bilmek icimi rahatlatacak.

english: I'm sorry, I'm too busy.
That's a shame.
Bye.
Bye.
Hello Caroline.
Brave [player], have you any news about my son and his father?
translation: Cesur maceraci, oglum ve babasi hakkinda herhangi bir haber var mi?

english: I'm working on it now Caroline.
Please bring them back safe and sound.
translation: Lütfen onlari sag salim geri getir.

english: I'll do my best.
Hello again.
Hello traveller, how are you?
Not bad thanks, yourself?
I'm good. Busy as always looking after Kent and Kennith but no complaints.
translation: Iyiyim. Her zamanki gibi Kent ve Kennith'e bakmakla mesgulüm ama sikayet etmiyorum.

english: Yes.
No.
Hey there. How're you holding up?
Not too bad. Still, I hope we can get rid of these spots soon.
translation: Fena degil. Yine de umarim bu lekelerden yakinda kurtulabiliriz.

english: The embalmer has been importing a soothing balm from a merchant called Ali M. It's meant to stop the itching.
translation: Mumyalayici, Ali M. adli bir tüccardan yatistirici bir merhem ithal ediyor. Kasintiyi durdurmasi gerekiyor.

english: Does it work?
Not even remotely, but it sure does keep the flies away.
translation: Hic de bile, ama sinekleri uzak tuttugu kesin.

english: Much better now that we've finally got rid of those spots.
translation: Sonunda o lekelerden kurtuldugumuz icin simdi cok daha iyiyiz.

english: That's great to hear! All the best.
translation: Bunu duymak cok güzel! Her sey gönlünce olsun.

english: What are you doing?
I thought this acne potion might help ease your spots.
translation: Bu akne ilacinin lekelerini hafifletmeye yardimci olabilecegini düsündüm.

english: What? You intolerable, insufferable idiot. That won't work! I would say get out of my sight but that's not far enough away!
translation: Ne? Seni dayanilmaz, cekilmez aptal. Bu ise yaramaz! Gözümün önünden kaybol derdim ama bu yeterince uzak degil!

english: I was just trying to help.
Clear off before I give you something to feel sorry about!
translation: Sana pisman olacagin bir sey yapmadan önce defol git!

english: Mmm... looks like that camel would make a nice kebab.
translation: Mmm... bu deve güzel bir kebap olur gibi görünüyor.

english: That camel looks vicious, it'll probably eat me if I go too near!
translation: Bu deve cok vahsi görünüyor, cok yaklasirsam muhtemelen beni yer!

english: I wonder if I can catch something from that camel?
translation: Acaba o deveden bir sey kapabilir miyim?

english: You and whose army mate? You and whose army?
translation: Sen ve kimin ordusu dostum? Sen ve kimin ordusu?

english: Oooh, sorry, didn't realise you could hear me?
translation: Oooh, pardon, beni duyabildigini fark etmemistim?

english: Well I can, so watch what you say in future.
translation: Duyabiliyorum, o yüzden gelecekte söylediklerine dikkat et.

english: Righto!
Well, I have to say, I am pretty peckish, but thankfully, I don't eat humans... often.
translation: Sey, itiraf etmeliyim ki, oldukca acim, ama neyse ki insanlari yemem... cogu zaman.

english: You'll catch a stiff kick if you talk about me like that again!
translation: Bir daha benim hakkimda böyle konusursan, sert bir tekme yersin!

english: Yes [sir/m'am]? Can I help you at all?
What is this place?
You're in the main waiting area of Keldagrim Carts- station.
translation: Keldagrim Vagon Istasyonu'nun ana bekleme salonundasin.

english: Cart-station? What goes on here then?
translation: Vagon istasyonu mu? Burada ne oluyor peki?

english: Keldagrim is the hub of all the traffic of the dwarven realm. Almost every dwarven outpost has railtracks leading to Keldagrim, connecting them all for easy travel and transportation of goods.
translation: Keldagrim, cüce kralliginin tüm trafiginin merkezi. Neredeyse tüm cüce karakollari, Keldagrim'e giden demiryolu hatlarina sahiptir ve bu hatlar, kolay seyahat ve mal tasimaciligi icin hepsini birbirine baglar.

english: Amazing! And what powers the carts? Magic?
translation: Inanilmaz! Vagonlari ne calistiriyor? Büyü mü?

english: Oh, no no, we dwarves don't use magic. No, all of this is powered by steam engines, developed during the past few centuries after the Consortium came to power.
translation: Hayir, hayir, biz cüceler sihir kullanmayiz. Hayir, bunlarin hepsi Konsorsiyum'un iktidara gelmesinden sonraki birkac yüzyil icinde gelistirilen buhar motorlariyla calisiyor.

english: Thanks for the info.
Where can you take me?
Let's see, we could let you travel to Ice Mountain, or to the Grand Exchange.
translation: Bir bakalim, sizi Buz Dagi'na veya Büyük Borsa'ya götürebiliriz.

english: I could also let you go to White Wolf Mountain, since you've befriended our brothers there.
translation: Oradaki kardeslerimizle arkadas oldugunuz icin sizi Beyaz Kurt Dagi'na da götürebilirim.

english: I'd like to buy a ticket.
And where would you like to go?
I'd like to buy a ticket to the Grand Exchange.
Oh, that service is free. Just hop on a cart on Track 3, and away you go.
translation: Oh, bu hizmet ücretsizdir. 3 numarali perondan bir vagona atlayin ve yola cikin.

english: I'd like to buy a ticket to Ice Mountain.
That'll be 150 gold coins please.
I'm sorry, I've run out of money.
I'm sorry, [sir/madam], but I don't believe you can hold the ticket.
Thanks, carts to Ice Mountain depart from track 1.
translation: Tesekkürler, Buz Dagi'na giden arabalar 1 numarali perondan kalkiyor.

english: No thanks, I changed my mind.
You're alright, I suppose... I can let you go for 75 coins. And remember, carts to Ice Mountain depart from track 1.
translation: Tamam, sanirim... 75 sikke karsiliginda sizi birakabilirim. Unutmayin, Buz Dagi'na giden arabalar 1 numarali perondan kalkiyor.

english: I'd like to buy a ticket to White Wolf Mountain.
translation: Beyaz Kurt Dagi'na bilet almak istiyorum.

english: That'll be 100 gold coins please.
Thanks. Go to track 4 for carts heading to White Wolf Mountain.
translation: Tesekkürler. Beyaz Kurt Dagi'na giden arabalar 4 numarali perondan kalkiyor.

english: You're a decent human, I suppose... I can let you go for 50 coins. Go to track 4 for the carts heading to White Wolf Mountain.
translation: Iyi bir insansin galiba... 50 altin karsiliginda seni birakabilirim. Beyaz Kurt Dagi'na giden arabalar 4 numarali perondan kalkiyor.

english: I have to go.
Just remember, wherever you go, you go there faster through Keldagrim Carts.
translation: Unutma, nereye gidersen git, Keldagrim Arabalari ile daha hizli ulasirsin.

english: That service is free. Just hop on a cart on Track 3, and away you go.
translation: Bu hizmet ücretsizdir. 3 numarali perondan bir arabaya atla ve yola cik.

english: Anything I can help you with?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: This is the Keldagrim Carts-station, human.
Out of the way human!
Why, what's happening?
There's important traffic coming through here and I don't want any stray humans distracting me.
translation: Buradan önemli bir trafik geciyor ve dikkatimi dagitan basibos insanlar istemiyorum.

english: Tickets, tickets, get your tickets here!
Wot you want?
Can't you see I'm 'aving a lil' break?
Now that you mention it, yes.
translation: Simdi sen söyleyince fark ettim, evet.

english: Then why did ya waste my time?
translation: O zaman neden zamanimi bosa harcadin?

english: Ahoy up there! Would you like to ride our minecart to Keldagrim? It's free.
translation: Hey, yukaridaki! Keldagrim'e giden maden arabamiza binmek ister misin? Ücretsizdir.

english: Yes please.
No thanks.
Ahoy up there! You'd better pick up your follower before you come down here and ride the minecart.
translation: Hey, yukaridaki! Buraya inip maden arabasina binmeden önce takipcini almalisin.

english: Watch out, [sir/madam]! Don't want anything to run over your follower!
translation: Dikkat edin, ! Takipcinizin üzerinden bir sey gecmesin!

english: Tickets! Tickets!
Buy your tickets here!
Selling tickets!
Ice Mountain carts departing from Track 1!
Grand Exchange carts departing from Track 3!
White Wolf Mountain carts departing from Track 4!
translation: Beyaz Kurt Dagi arabalari 4. perondan kalkiyor!

english: Mind the cart!
What is this place?
Where can you take me?
I'd like to buy a ticket.
To the Grand Exchange.
To Ice Mountain.
Buy.
Don't buy.
[Charm] Only pay half.
To White Wolf Mountain.
Nowhere.
I have to go.
Grand Exchange (free)
Ice Mountain (150 coins)
White Wolf Mountain (100 coins)
Cancel
Ice Mountain (75 coins)
White Wolf Mountain (50 coins)
Yes please.
No thanks.
Who are you?
I'm an employee of Keldagrim Carts. I make sure the carts in this area run on time and that people pay their fares.
translation: Keldagrim Carts'in bir calisaniyim. Bu bölgedeki arabalarin zamaninda calismasini ve insanlarin ücretlerini ödemesini sagliyorum.

english: I don't think I'm allowed to take you into the city of Keldagrim, human. Perhaps when you find another way into the city and talk to someone of importance there you will be allowed to.
translation: Seni Keldagrim sehrine götürmeme izin verilmedigini saniyorum, insan. Belki sehre baska bir yoldan girip orada önemli biriyle konusursan izin verilir.

english: This track leads right up to Keldagrim. Only stop.
translation: Bu yol Keldagrim'e gidiyor. Durun lütfen.

english: One ticket to Keldagrim, that's 150 coins then.
I'm sorry, sir, but I don't believe you can hold the ticket.
Thanks for your custom!
This is only 75 coins, I can't let you have a ticket for that.
translation: Bu sadece 75 sikke, bu parayla bilet alamazsiniz.

english: Oh, don't worry. I'll pay you another 75 coins for the next ticket I buy, alright?
translation: Oh, merak etmeyin. Bir sonraki bilet icin size 75 sikke daha ödeyecegim, tamam mi?

english: Well... I suppose so.
I can't take you anywhere at the moment.
translation: Su anda sizi hicbir yere götüremem.

english: I can't sell any more tickets right now, I'm afraid.
Who are you?
Keldagrim (150 coins)
Keldagrim (75 coins)
Whooooo? Meeeee? Oh, I make sure *hic* the cart traffic proceedsh *hic* in an orderly fishion. Fashion. Yes.
translation: Kim? Ben mi? Oh, ben *hic* arabalarin trafiginin *hic* düzenli bir sekilde ilerlemesini sagliyorum. Moda. Evet.

english: North, north, north *hic* north to Keldagrim!
One ticket to ehm... *hic* Keldagrim. That's 2... 3.... *hic* 100 glittering gold coins!
translation: Bir bilet... *hic* Keldagrim'e. Bu 2... 3... *hic* 100 parlak altin sikke eder!

english: Thanksh a lot human! Remember to come back for more shtout whenever you want! *hic*
translation: Cok tesekkürler insan! Istedigin zaman daha fazla shtout icin geri gelmeyi unutma! *hic*

english: Waith a shecond... that'sh only 50 coinsh!
translation: Bir saniye... bu sadece 50 sikke eder!

english: No it's not, you're seeing double from all that drinking, remember? So it's actually 100 coins.
translation: Hayir, etmez, o kadar icki ictigin icin cift görüyorsun, unuttun mu? Yani aslinda 100 sikke eder.

english: Errr... yesh, I shuppose you're right.
Just remember, wherever you go... ehm... *hic* oh, forget it.
translation: Unutma, nereye gidersen git... ehm... *hic* oh, bos ver.

english: Keldagrim (100 coins)
Keldagrim (50 coins)
I buy and sell shields, do you want to trade?
translation: Kalkan alip satiyorum, takas etmek ister misin?

english: No thank you.
Yes please.
No thank you.
Hello!
Greetings! I'm Cassim. Welcome to my home.
translation: Selamlar! Ben Cassim. Evime hos geldin.

english: That's a big barrel of wine!
Isn't it just! I'm a bit of a connoisseur.
translation: Öyle degil mi! Ben biraz sarap uzmani sayilirim.

english: Do you make it yourself?
I've dabbled, but this is all imported. I have a connection in the far west who has the best vineyards.
translation: Biraz denedim ama bunlarin hepsi ithal. Uzak batida en iyi baglara sahip bir tanidigim var.

english: In the west?
Yes! A fine Hosidius grape, strong hints of plum and blackberry, very sweet.
translation: Evet! Kaliteli Hosidius üzümü, erik ve bögürtlen aromali, cok tatli.

english: Sounds lovely!
How's the tea here?
It's fantastic! Ali really knows how to brew a fine tea!
translation: Harika! Ali kaliteli cay demlemeyi cok iyi biliyor!

english: Which is your favourite?
Well I've supplied him with a small import of mine. I call the concoction 'Zamorak's Fire'.
translation: Ona kücük bir ithalatimdan tedarik ettim. Bu karisimi “Zamorak'in Atesi” olarak adlandiriyorum.

english: Sounds hot!
Yes, yes. It has a certain kick to it! Although, it'll keep you safe from fire for a short time after drinking!
translation: Evet, evet. Biraz sert bir tadi var! Ama ictikten sonra kisa bir süreligine atesten korur!

english: Great for when dragons attack!
Does that happen often here?
You never know... Dragons can be sneaky.
translation: Hic belli olmaz... Ejderhalar cok sinsi olabilirler.

english: I'd best be off.
May the flames of Zamorak light your path.
Er... yeah...
Welcome back.
That's a big barrel of wine!
How's the tea here?
I'd best be off.
The camera fades to black. In a cutscene, Gregg is seen hopping inside the fenced lumberyard.
translation: Kamera karartilir. Bir kesit sahnesinde, Gregg citlerle cevrili kereste deposuna atlayarak girer.

english: Ok, let's find some planks...
A sound of a cat purring is heard. A brown adult cat comes from behind a wall two tiles right (east) of Gregg.
translation: Bir kedinin mirildanma sesi duyulur. Kahverengi bir yetiskin kedi, Gregg'in iki karo saginda (dogusunda) bulunan bir duvarin arkasindan cikar.

english: Meow!
Aha! There we go!
A sound of the cat meowing is heard.
Meow.
Oh! A kitty cat!
Sorry, kitty, I don't have any treats.
translation: Üzgünüm kedicik, elimde yiyecek bir sey yok.

english: Would you like pets instead? I can do pets!
translation: Onun yerine oksamak ister misin? Oksamayi bilirim!

english: Gregg moves closer to pet the cat. The cat makes an audible hiss and scratches towards Gregg.
translation: Gregg kediyi oksamak icin yaklasir. Kedi duyulabilir bir tislama sesi cikarir ve Gregg'e dogru tirmalamaya baslar.

english: Hissss!
Aaaah!
Nice kitty...?
The cat makes an audible hiss and scratches towards Gregg again. Gregg starts fleeing left (west), while the adult cat chases him.
translation: Kedi duyulabilir bir tislama sesi cikarir ve Gregg'e dogru tekrar tirmalamaya baslar. Gregg sola (batiya) kacmaya baslar, yetiskin kedi ise onu kovalar.

english: Not nice kitty! Not nice kitty!
translation: Güzel kedi degil! Güzel kedi degil!

english: The camera pans right and fades to black again. After a fade-out, the camera is set back to the world in front of the lumberyard with the player and Gregg.
translation: Kamera saga kayar ve tekrar karartilir. Karartmanin ardindan kamera, oyuncu ve Gregg'in bulundugu kereste deposunun önündeki dünyaya geri döner.

english: You pet the cat...
The cat softly purrs between snores.
translation: Kedi horlamalar arasinda yumusak bir sekilde mirildanir.

english: Hmm... Oh yes, that's purrfect.....
Zzz
Miaoww!
What is this place?
It's a desolate, sad place... The peoples here seldom feed me - take me with you!
translation: Burasi issiz, üzücü bir yer... Buradaki insanlar bana nadiren yemek veriyorlar - beni de yanina al!

english: I'm sorry, I can't take you with me, but I will help if I can.
translation: Üzgünüm, seni yanimda götüremem, ama elimden geldigince yardim ederim.

english: How are you doing?
Not well, I have to ssssssay, but you look healthy. I wish I were healthy like you.
translation: Iyi degilim, ama sen saglikli görünüyorsun. Keske ben de senin gibi saglikli olsaydim.

english: What's that awful smell?
*Sniff, sniff* I don't think it's me. All I can smell is dirty vyrewatches tithing the poor humans.
translation: *Kokla, kokla* Benden geldigini sanmiyorum. Tek kokladigim, zavalli insanlari sömüren kirli vyrewatch'lar.

english: How long have you been here?
As long as I can remember. So far we've not found any way out of this place, and after all, we couldn't leave these poor humans to fend for themselves.
translation: Hatirlayabildigim kadariyla. Simdiye kadar buradan cikmanin bir yolunu bulamadik ve sonucta bu zavalli insanlari kendi baslarina birakamazdik.

english: Okay, thanks.
What is this place?
How are you doing?
What's that awful smell?
How long have you been here?
Okay, thanks.
Hello puss.
Want a mouse?
No thanks.
Want this half dead bird?
translation: Bu yari ölü kusu ister misin?

english: Errrr... no.
Want this crunched up spider?
Um... not really.
Oh well. Got any tuna?
No.
Hmmmph.
Why yes I do have some tuna.
Give! *purr*
Catch toad for me.
What? I think not...
Nah... my tuna.
Hissss...
Give a tuna to the cat.
Keep the tuna for yourself.
Good but could we go hunting again soon? One of my friends got a medal from Gertrude for catching lots of mice.
translation: Güzel, ama yakinda tekrar ava cikabilir miyiz? Arkadaslarimdan biri cok fazla fare yakaladigi icin Gertrude'dan madalya aldi.

english: How old are you now?
I'm not too old, and not too young. In fact I think I'm just right.
translation: Ne cok yasli ne de cok genc. Aslinda bence tam yasindayim.

english: Where do you want to go?
Can we go to Varrock sewers and chase some rats?
translation: Varrock kanalizasyonuna gidip fare avlayabilir miyiz?

english: What do you want to do now?
I want to go chase things kill them and then eat them, purrr.
translation: Bir seyler avlayip onlari öldürmek ve sonra yemek istiyorum, purrr.

english: Sorry human, but what are you wearing?
I got some cat ears made for me, don't they look meeeeeeeooooowvalous.
translation: Kendime kedi kulaklari yaptirdim, cok güzel görünüyorlar, degil mi?

english: The cat looks you dead in the eye, unblinking.
Am I a joke to you?
translation: Ben senin icin bir saka miyim?

english: UwU?
Why are you doing this?
I thought it'd be cute and funny.
It's not, take them off now human, before I get myself a pair of human ears to wear.
translation: Degil, hemen cikar onlari insan, yoksa kendime bir cift insan kulagi takacagim.

english: How old are you now?
Where do you want to go?
What do you want to do now?
You are [player name]?
That's right.
The Great Guardian wants you to know that there has been a development in our fight against the Abyss.
translation: Büyük Koruyucu, Abyss ile mücadelemizde bir gelisme oldugunu bilmeni istiyor.

english: What development?
A magical signal has been detected emerging from the rift. It is not of the Abyss.
translation: Yarikta ortaya cikan büyülü bir sinyal tespit edildi. Abyss'e ait degil.

english: Then what is it?
Unknown.
Hmm... I was actually hoping to enter the Scar myself. Perhaps I could investigate this signal while I'm in there.
translation: Hmm... Aslinda Scar'a kendim girmek istiyordum. Belki de icerideyken bu sinyali arastirabilirim.

english: Nothing can survive the Scar. To enter would not be wise.
translation: Yara'da hicbir sey hayatta kalamaz. Iceri girmek akillica olmaz.

english: But how do you know nothing can survive? Has anyone actually confirmed that?
translation: Ama hicbir seyin hayatta kalamayacagini nereden biliyorsunuz? Bunu kimse dogruladi mi?

english: There are a few who have entered the Scar in the past. None have returned.
translation: Gecmiste Yara'ya giren birkac kisi var. Hicbiri geri dönmedi.

english: Well then give me a chance to be the first.
translation: O zaman bana ilk olan olma sansi verin.

english: If you wish to enter, it is not our place to stop you. In the likely event of your demise, you will be mourned.
translation: Girmek istiyorsaniz, sizi durdurmak bize düsmez. Muhtemelen öleceksiniz, ama yas tutulacaksiniz.

english: Thanks... I think. Anything I should know before entering?
translation: Tesekkürler... Sanirim. Girmeden önce bilmem gereken bir sey var mi?

english: The rift is unpredictable. Normally, you would not be able to control its destination. However, the magical signal coming from within could be of benefit. It could act as a guide.
translation: Yarik öngörülemez. Normalde, varis noktasini kontrol edemezsin. Ancak, icinden gelen büyülü sinyal faydali olabilir. Rehber görevi görebilir.

english: So you'd be able to send me right to the source?
Approximately.
Well I suppose that's the best I can ask for.
translation: Sanirim isteyebilecegim en iyi sey bu.

english: Are you ready to enter the Scar?
Yes.
Then may your death come quick, human. Good luck.
translation: O zaman ölümün cabuk gelsin, insan. Iyi sanslar.

english: No.
Then speak to me once you are.
translation: O zaman hazir oldugunda bana haber ver.

english: Human... you survived the Scar?
I did.
How unexpected. The Great Guardian will need to be informed.
translation: Ne kadar beklenmedik. Büyük Koruyucu'ya haber verilmesi gerekecek.

english: In the meantime, do you wish to return to the Scar?
translation: Bu arada, Scar'a geri dönmek ister misin?

english: Very well. Good luck.
Speak to me again if you do.
Do you wish to return to the Scar?
Yes.
No.
How can you see properly with such tiny little eyes?
translation: Bu kadar kücük gözlerle nasil düzgün görebiliyorsun?

english: Ooh! Are you [player name]?
Yes.
Everyone's talking about how you helped Zanik save the city! You're a hero!
translation: Herkes Zanik'in sehri kurtarmasina yardim ettigini konusuyor! Sen bir kahramansin!

english: Have you visited the market? There are visitors selling foods from all over the surface there. It's so exotic!
translation: Pazari ziyaret ettin mi? Orada yüzeyden gelen ziyaretciler yiyecek satiyor. Cok egzotik!

english: Well, I suppose it wouldn't be exotic for you, since you're from the surface.
translation: Tabii, sen yüzeyden geldigin icin egzotik gelmez sana.

english: But you should check it out anyway. Maybe you could sell some of your food. Everyone's crazy about surface food at the moment.
translation: Ama yine de bir bakmalisin. Belki senin yiyeceklerinden satabilirsin. Su anda herkes yüzeydeki yiyeceklere bayiliyor.

english: So, what do you think of our city, surface-dweller?
translation: Peki, sehrimiz hakkinda ne düsünüyorsun, yüzey sakini?

english: I like it!
That, surface-dweller, was the right answer.
