I think it's rubbish.
Well, it beats crawling around on the surface with nothing above your head!
translation: En azindan yüzeyde basinin üstünde hicbir sey olmadan sürünmekten iyidir!

english: What's it like on the surface? It sounds scary to me, having nothing above my head.
translation: Yüzeyde yasamak nasildir? Basimin üstünde hicbir sey olmamasi bana korkutucu geliyor.

english: It's alright.
I'm still not sure it would be for me, though.
translation: Yine de benim icin uygun olup olmadigindan emin degilim.

english: It's not all that great.
Never mind, you can stay down here now!
What do you think you're doing?
Stuns the player, dealing 1 damage.
Help! A thief!
I like it!
I think it's rubbish.
It's alright.
It's not all that great.
Oh dear, oh dear. I hope this dwarf train works properly!
translation: Aman tanrim, aman tanrim. Umarim bu cüce treni düzgün calisir!

english: Look, everyone! It's [player name]!
Everyone's talking about how you rescued Zanik! You're the city's hero again!
translation: Herkes Zanik'i kurtardigini konusuyor! Yine sehrin kahramani oldun!

english: Visiting Keldagrim is so exciting! I never thought I'd be so far from Dorgesh-Kaan in my life!
translation: Keldagrim'i ziyaret etmek cok heyecan verici! Hayatimda Dorgesh-Kaan'dan bu kadar uzak olacagimi hic düsünmemistim!

english: These dwarves have so much more advanced technology than us. Look at this train! We could never build something like this.
translation: Bu cüceler bizimkinden cok daha gelismis bir teknolojiye sahipler. Su trene bak! Biz asla böyle bir sey yapamayiz.

english: Keldagrim's very nice to visit, but I don't think I'd want to live there.
translation: Keldagrim'i ziyaret etmek cok güzel, ama orada yasamak istemezdim.

english: Shh! Don't tell anyone!
Don't tell anyone what?
SHHH!
Are you [player name]? Did you help Zanik save the city?
translation: Sen Maceraci misin? Zanik'e sehri kurtarmada yardim ettin mi?

english: Yes, that was me!
When I'm older I'm going to be an adventurer, just like Zanik!
translation: Büyüdügümde Zanik gibi bir maceraci olacagim!

english: Are you a surface-dweller?
Yes...
Haha! You look funny! All tall and skinny with tiny eyes!
translation: Haha! Komik görünüyorsun! Uzun boylu, zayif ve kücük gözlü!

english: Help! Help! The surface people are attacking!
It's alright, I'm friendly!
Sorry, I'm not meant to talk to strangers.
Have a nice day!
I'm keeping an eye on you, surface-dweller.
Surface-dweller! You will never find your way into the city of Dorgesh-Kaan!
translation: Yüzey sakini! Dorgesh-Kaan sehrine asla giremeyeceksin!

english: Isn't it through that big door?
Well, yes, but you'll never find your way in!
Surface-dweller! You may not pass through that door!
But I thought I was allowed into the city now.
translation: Ama artik sehre girmeme izin verildigini saniyordum.

english: Oh yes, so you are. I'd better say something different.
translation: Evet, öyle. Baska bir sey söylesem iyi olacak.

english: *Ahem*
Surface-dweller! You will easily find your way into the city of Dorgesh-Kaan!
translation: Yüzey sakini! Dorgesh-Kaan sehrine kolayca girebilirsin!

english: How about that?
Yes, that's much more appropiate.
Hello.
How's the mining going?
I nearly got caught in a rockfall earlier!
translation: Az önce bir kaya düsmesi sirasinda neredeyse yakalaniyordum!

english: Still, since humans started coming down here, the proportion of miners killed in rockfalls has fallen dramatically!
translation: Yine de, insanlar buraya gelmeye basladigindan beri, kaya düsmelerinde ölen madencilerin orani önemli ölcüde azaldi!

english: Oh, you know, can't complain.
It's going well. I find repeatedly hitting a piece of rock very therapeutic.
translation: Iyi gidiyor. Bir kayaya tekrar tekrar vurmak cok terapötik geliyor.

english: Well, don't tell Mistag...
...but actually I wasn't working very hard!
We're a bit behind schedule. If you lent us a hand, Mistag would pay you for your work.
translation: Programin biraz gerisindeyiz. Bize yardim edersen, Mistag sana calisman icin ödeme yapar.

english: Where do you take all this ore?
To the town of Dorgesh-Kaan, deep in the caves.
Why do you use bones to build with?
Well, our legends say that on the surface there was a substance called 'wood', which grew out of the ground in towers.
translation: Efsanelerimize göre, yüzeyde “ahsap” adinda bir madde varmis ve bu madde yerden kuleler halinde cikiyormus.

english: But we cannot get wood here, so we can only build with stone, bone, and iron.
translation: Ama burada ahsap bulamiyoruz, bu yüzden sadece tas, kemik ve demirle insa edebiliyoruz.

english: Oh, right.
Giant frogs aren't fearsome!
Perhaps not for a mighty adventurer like you, but we think they're terrifying!
translation: Senin gibi güclü bir maceraci icin korkutucu olmayabilir, ama biz onlari cok korkutucu buluyoruz!

english: How's the mining going?
Where do you take all this ore?
Why do you use bones to build with?
Oh, right
Giant frogs aren't fearsome!
Be careful going in there! You are unarmed, and there is much evilness lurking down there! The evilness seems to block off our contact with our gods,
translation: Oraya girerken dikkatli olun! Silahsizsiniz ve orada cok fazla kötülük gizleniyor! Kötülük, tanrilarimizla olan iletisimimizi engelliyor gibi görünüyor,

english: so our prayers seem to have less effect down there. Oh, also, you won't be able to come back this way - This ladder only goes one way!
translation: bu yüzden dualarimizin orada daha az etkisi oluyor. Oh, ayrica, bu yoldan geri dönemeyeceksiniz - Bu merdiven tek yönlü!

english: The only exit from the caves below is a portal which leads only to the deepest wilderness!
translation: Asagidaki magaralardan tek cikis, sadece en derin Wildernessya giden bir gecit!

english: I don't think I'm strong enough to enter then.
translation: O zaman girecek kadar güclü oldugumu sanmiyorum.

english: Well that is a risk I will have to take.
I don't think I'm strong enough to enter then.
translation: O zaman girecek kadar güclü oldugumu sanmiyorum.

english: Well that is a risk I will have to take.
Be ye mad? There be Horrors in this cave!
translation: Delirdin mi? Bu magarada korkunc seyler var!

english: What do you mean?
Have ye ever heard of the sort of evil, flesh-eatin' horrors that dwell in the darkest pits of the world?
translation: Dünyanin en karanlik cukurlarinda yasayan, et yiyen korkunc yaratiklari duymadin mi?

english: The sort of dark, sanity-breakin' THINGS that cause the livin' to drop to their knees and weep for the fate of all creation?
translation: Yasayanlarin diz cöküp tüm yaratilisin kaderi icin aglamasina neden olan karanlik, akil almaz SEYLERI duymadin mi?

english: Well, have ye?
Yes, I think I've killed a few of them as well.
translation: Evet, sanirim ben de birkacini öldürdüm.

english: Well, that's ok then.
But, ye'll need a Witchwood Icon from a slayer master if ye want te go in these caves and live.
translation: Ama bu magaralara girip hayatta kalmak istiyorsan, bir avci ustasindan Witchwood Icon alman gerekecek.

english: Why?
Well, ye see them Jungle Horrors? Well down in the caves there be Cave Horrors.
translation: Su Jungle Horrors'lari görüyor musun? Magaralarin derinliklerinde Cave Horrors var.

english: They are bigger, badder, meaner, and have a howl that freezes the blood in yer veins.
translation: Onlar daha büyük, daha kötü, daha acimasiz ve kanini donduran bir uluma sesleri var.

english: Wearin' earmuffs or a helmet won't work, cos them masks they wear make the sound magical. Only thing that works is wearin' a Witchwood Icon.
translation: Kulaklik veya kask takmak ise yaramaz, cünkü taktiklari maskeler sesi büyülü hale getirir. Ise yarayan tek sey Witchwood Icon takmaktir.

english: That is, o'course, if ye can see them, cos if ye don't have any light down there then yer likely te be picked te bones by the insects before the Horrors get ye.
translation: Tabii ki, onlari görebilirsen, cünkü orada isik yoksa, Korkular seni yakalamadan önce böcekler seni kemiklerine kadar yiyip bitirir.

english: I see, thanks for the warning.
Yer welcome.
Be ye some form of simpleton? Do ye not hear the howlin' of the Horrors?
translation: Sen aptal misin? Korkularin ulumasini duymuyor musun?

english: Well, I can hear something now you mention it...
translation: Sey, simdi sen söyleyince bir sey duyuyorum...

english: That be them, howlin', always howlin'!
If ye value yer limbs ye'll put that Icon round yer neck, and hope they don't come out into the light!
translation: Eger uzuvlarina deger veriyorsan, o Ikonu boynuna tak ve onlarin isiga cikmamalarini umut et!

english: Err, all right, I'll get right on that.
Be ye here te deal with the Horrors?
translation: Korkunclarla basa cikmak icin mi buradasin?

english: I might well give it a shot.
Aye, well, keep yer Icon with ye if ye wants te walk out alive again.
translation: Evet, hayatta kalmak istiyorsan simgeni yaninda tasi.

english: Don't worry, I will.
Greetings! Have you come to gaze in rapture at the natural beauty of Falador's parkland?
translation: Merhaba! Falador'un park alaninin dogal güzelligine hayranlikla bakmaya mi geldin?

english: Um, yes, very nice. Lots of... trees and stuff.
translation: Evet, cok güzel. Bir sürü... agac ve diger seyler var.

english: Trees! I do so love trees! And flowers! And squirrels!
translation: Agaclar! Agaclari cok seviyorum! Ve cicekleri! Ve sincaplari!

english: Sorry, I have a strange urge to be somewhere else.
translation: Üzgünüm, baska bir yerde olma garip bir dürtü duyuyorum.

english: Player runs away from Cecilia
Come back to me soon and we can talk again about trees!
translation: Yakinda geri gel, agaclar hakkinda tekrar konusabiliriz!

english: Greetings! If you have come to gaze in rapture at the natural beauty of Falador’s parkland, then I have bad news.
translation: Merhaba! Falador'un park alaninin dogal güzelligine hayranlikla bakmaya geldiysen, sana kötü bir haberim var.

english: Oh no! What happened?
We got some impromptu visitors to the park. They came out of nowhere and made an awful mess of the place.
translation: Parka beklenmedik ziyaretciler geldi. Birdenbire ortaya ciktilar ve ortaligi berbat ettiler.

english: They trampled the flowers, startled the ducks, dug new holes in the ground…
translation: Cicekleri ezip gectiler, ördekleri korkuttular, yere yeni cukurlar kazdilar...

english: That’s terrible. Who are these hooligans?
translation: Bu cok kötü. Bu holiganlar kim?

english: That’s not all! I had plans to decorate the park for Christmas, and they went and chewed some of the decorations.
translation: Hepsi bu kadar da degil! Parki Noel icin süslemeyi planliyordum ama onlar gidip süslemelerin bir kismini cignediler.

english: How deplorable! Wait, did you say ‘chew’? What kind of visitors are you taking about?
translation: Ne yazik! Bir dakika, “cignediler” mi dedin? Ne tür ziyaretcilerden bahsediyorsun?

english: Why, they’re dogs of course! I’m quite upset, yet they are so cute that I can’t stay mad. We can’t leave them here, however.
translation: Tabii ki köpekler! Cok üzgünüm ama o kadar sevimliler ki onlara kizgin kalamiyorum. Ancak onlari burada birakamayiz.

english: I’m going to need some help to find them a place to be, and to clean up afterwards.
translation: Onlara kalacak bir yer bulmak ve sonra temizlik yapmak icin yardima ihtiyacim olacak.

english: And you’re about to ask me.
translation: Ve sen de bana yardim isteyeceksin.

english: Quite right! So… Will you help?
translation: Aynen öyle! Peki... Yardim eder misin?

english: Oh thank you!
I reached out to one of my acquaintances, Probita, and she confirmed to me that none of these five adorable little tykes have an owner.
translation: Tanidiklarimdan biri olan Probita'ya ulastim ve o da bana bu bes sevimli minik yavrunun hicbirinin sahibi olmadigini dogruladi.

english: As cute as they are, they cannot just stay here.
translation: Ne kadar sevimli olsalar da, burada kalamazlar.

english: Maybe I could take them off your hands?
You can try, but I cannot promise that they wouldn’t attempt to ransack all of your belongings. You saw what happened to the park.
translation: Deneyebilirsin, ama esyalarini talan etmeye calismayacaklarini garanti edemem. Parkta ne oldugunu gördün.

english: Good point. I do prefer when my belongings stay in one piece.
translation: Haklisin. Esyalarimin zarar görmemesini tercih ederim.

english: I wonder if they caused so much havoc because they came in as a group.
translation: Acaba bu kadar büyük bir yikima neden olmalarinin sebebi grup halinde gelmeleri miydi?

english: We should be able to manage this by getting each of them a different loving owner and some proper training.
translation: Her birine farkli sevgi dolu sahipler bulup uygun bir egitim vererek bu sorunu cözebiliriz.

english: I’ve already got a few ideas for potential adopters. Hmm… What if we set up a refining event? An adoption drive!
translation: Potansiyel sahipler icin birkac fikrim var. Hmm... Bir etkinlik düzenlesek nasil olur? Bir evlat edinme kampanyasi!

english: That could work!
We could have balloons and decorations, and maybe even nibbles.
translation: Balonlar, süslemeler ve hatta atistirmaliklar bile olabilir.

english: Wouldn’t the dogs eat the nibbles and chew the decorations?
translation: Köpekler atistirmaliklari yiyip süslemeleri cignemez mi?

english: You’re right, of course. Then… What if we dressed up the dogs to make them extra cute? Would that distract them enough?
translation: Haklisin, tabii ki. O zaman... Köpekleri daha sevimli hale getirmek icin giydirsek nasil olur? Bu onlarin dikkatini yeterince dagitir mi?

english: I don’t know. It might distract them from the decorations, but I don’t think anything could distract them from the nibbles.
translation: Bilmiyorum. Süslemelerden dikkatlerini dagitabilir, ama atistirmaliklardan dikkatlerini dagitacak bir sey oldugunu sanmiyorum.

english: Yes, that is true. Let us not have the nibbles. Besides, the first step is to secure some costumes and a venue.
translation: Evet, haklisin. Atistirmaliklar olmasin. Ayrica, ilk adim kostümleri ve mekani ayarlamak.

english: While I try and figure out where the best place to host the event is, could you please check with Party Pete if he would have costumes to lend us? I will also start writing and decorating the invitations in the meantime.
translation: Etkinligi düzenlemek icin en uygun yeri bulmaya calisirken, Party Pete'e bize kostüm ödünc verebilir mi diye sorar misin? Ben de bu arada davetiyeleri yazmaya ve süslemeye baslayayim.

english: On it!
I’d love to, but I’m somewhat busy right now.
translation: Cok isterdim, ama su anda biraz mesgulüm.

english: Then I will have to wrangle those dogs myself. We can’t leave the park in that state!
translation: O zaman o köpekleri kendim halletmem gerekecek. Parki o halde birakamayiz!

english: Have you come to play music to me?
translation: Bana müzik calmak icin mi geldin?

english: Yes, I have.
Select the song I asked you to play, and speak to me again.

english: No, I'm not interested in that.

Surely we are safe now!

Well hello again adventurer! It's good to see you again! If it wasn't for your quick thinking the treacherous Jones would have poisoned my family and me by now! We are in your debt.
translation: Merhaba maceraci! Seni tekrar görmek ne güzel! Senin hizli düsünmen olmasaydi, hain Jones simdiye kadar ailemi ve beni zehirlemis olacakti! Sana borcluyuz.

english: Hello, Ceril.
Oh... I may be wrong... but ever since I asked for your help, things around here have gone from bad to worse...
translation: Oh... Yaniliyor olabilirim... ama senden yardim istedigimden beri, buradaki isler gittikce kötüye gidiyor...

english: I think you'd better keep out of my way. And for the last time, it's Sir Ceril! Sir! It's not that hard to blooming remember!
translation: Bence yolumdan cekilsen iyi olur. Ve son kez söylüyorum, Sir Ceril! Sir! Hatirlamak o kadar da zor degil!

english: Greetings, I suppose you're one of those twolegs obsessed with fish?
translation: Selamlar, sanirim sen de balik takintili iki ayaklilardan birisin?

english: Really. Really stop.
What's wrong, do you need a herring aid?

english: Nooooo....
Oh don't be so crabby. You should be more up to date with current affairs. Shoaly you like puns chum?
translation: Bu kadar huysuz olma. Güncel olaylari daha iyi takip etmelisin. Kelime oyunlarini seviyor musun dostum?...

english: Sorry, but you're really not experienced enough to use my cavern.
translation: Üzgünüm, ama benim magarami kullanmak icin yeterince deneyimli degilsin.

english: You need level 47 Fishing and level 44 Hunter to enter the fishing cavern.
translation: Balikcilik magarasina girmek icin 47. seviye Balikcilik ve 44. seviye Avcilik seviyesi gerekiyor.

english: I'll want 200 numulites first. If you pay me that, I'll let you in there as much as you like for the rest of this day.
translation: Önce 200 numulit istiyorum. Bana bunu ödersen, günün geri kalaninda istedigin kadar oraya girebilirsin.

english: Okay, here's 200 numulites.
The player enters the drift net fishing instance.
translation: Oyuncu sürüklenme agi balikciligi örnegine girer.

english: Maybe another time.
Can I pay for permanent access?
translation: Kalici erisim icin ödeme yapabilir miyim?

english: I suppose so. Give me 20,000 numulites and I'll stop charging you for entry forever.
translation: Sanirim yapabilirsiniz. Bana 20.000 numulit verin, giris ücreti almayi sonsuza kadar birakayim.

english: Okay, here's 20,000 numulites.
Thanks - no more entry fees for you!
translation: Tesekkürler - artik giris ücreti ödemenize gerek yok!

english: You've already paid for access for the rest of today. You can come and go all day.
translation: Bugünün geri kalani icin giris ücretini zaten ödediniz. Gün boyu gelip gidebilirsiniz.

english: I understand. Thanks.
Who are you?
My name is Ceto. I used to be a carefree soul, but now that the twolegs are interested in these little bits of bone, I just keep my little fish farm going and the twolegs pay me a few squid.
translation: Adim Ceto. Eskiden kaygisiz bir ruhum vardi, ama artik iki ayaklilar bu kücük kemik parcalarina ilgi duyduklari icin, kücük balik ciftligimi isletmeye devam ediyorum ve iki ayaklilar bana birkac kalamar ödüyorlar.

english: Shouldn't you be with your people or something?
translation: Sen halkinin yaninda falan olman gerekmez mi?

english: Well, they said I was too young to swim with them, and I should be responsible and get a job. They're so old school.
translation: Sey, benim onlarla yüzmek icin cok genc oldugumu ve sorumluluk sahibi olup bir is bulmam gerektigini söylediler. Cok eski kafalilar.

english: How do I catch fish here?
Ahh well, I've set up a pretty good fish trap here, the terrain really lends itself to it. But you'll need a couple of drift nets.
translation: Ahh, burada oldukca iyi bir balik tuzagi kurdum, arazi buna cok uygun. Ama birkac sürüklenme agina ihtiyacin olacak.

english: How do I get those?
Well I weave mine from my sisters' hair, but you'll have to make do with some plant fibres I guess. I think the twolegs have ways to do that, right?
translation: Benimkini kiz kardeslerimin saclarindan örüyorum, ama sen bitki lifleriyle idare etmek zorunda kalacaksin sanirim. Iki ayaklilarin bunu yapmanin bir yolu vardir, degil mi?

english: Yes, usually we use jute on a loom.
translation: Evet, genellikle dokuma tezgahinda jüt kullaniriz.

english: Fintastic. You may also find something spikey helps to disturb the fish and make them panic.
translation: Harika. Ayrica, baliklari rahatsiz edip panige sokmak icin sivri uclu bir sey bulabilirsin.

english: Spikey?
Yes, something with lots of spikes, maybe like a trident.

english: Hello again.
Hello adventurer, are you looking for another staff?

english: No thanks.

Tell me what you know about the charge spell.
translation: Sarj büyüsü hakkinda bildiklerini anlat bana.

english: We believe the spells are gifts from the gods. The charge spell draws even more power from the cosmos.

english: It's just too hot here. How can you stand it?

translation: Mütevazi bir sekilde idare ediyoruz. Zengin bir kasabayiz ve suyumuz var. Susuzlugu gideriyor.

english: Do you mind if I just kill your warriors?
Kill our warriors? I assume this is some sort of joke?
translation: Savascilarimizi öldürmek mi? Sanirim bu bir saka?

english: I'll take that as a no. Forget I asked.
translation: Hayir olarak kabul ediyorum. Sordugumu unutun.

english: I'd better be off.
Thank you for being a friend to Al Kharid. You are always welcome here.
translation: Al Kharid'in dostu oldugun icin tesekkürler. Buraya her zaman hos geldin.

english: Hey, do not treat the Emir's palace like a climbing frame for children, whoever you are!
translation: Hey, Emir'in sarayini cocuklarin tirmanma oyuncagi gibi kullanma, her kimsen!

english: Hey, while you have our gratitude for saving the prince, you must earn our trust more fully before the Emir will tolerate you climbing through his windows like a thief!
translation: Hey, prensi kurtardigin icin sana minnettariz, ama Emir'in hirsiz gibi pencerelerinden tirmanmani hos görmesi icin güvenimizi daha fazla kazanmalisin!

english: Greetings I am Hassan, Chancellor to the Emir of Al- Kharid.
translation: Selamlar, ben Hassan, Al-Kharid Emirinin Sansölyesi.

english: We manage, in our humble way. We are a wealthy town and we have water. It cures many thirsts.
translation: Mütevazi bir sekilde idare ediyoruz. Zengin bir kasabayiz ve suyumuz var. Bu, bircok susuzlugu gideriyor.

english: You are welcome. They are not expensive. We have them here to stop the elite guard being bothered. They are a little harder to kill.
translation: Hos geldiniz. Pahali degiller. Elit muhafizlarin rahatsiz edilmemesi icin onlari burada tutuyoruz. Onlari öldürmek biraz daha zor.

english: You are a friend of the town of Al-Kharid. If we have more tasks to complete, we will ask you. Please, keep in contact. Good employees are not easy to find.
translation: Al-Kharid kasabasinin dostusunuz. Tamamlamamiz gereken baska görevler olursa, size sorariz. Lütfen bizimle iletisimi koparmayin. Iyi calisanlar bulmak kolay degil.

english: Is there anything I can help you with?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: It's just too hot here. How can you stand it?
Do you mind if I just kill your warriors?
I'd better be off.
Can I help you? You must need some help here in the desert.
translation: Yardimci olabilir miyim? Cölde yardima ihtiyaciniz olmali.

english: Hello! Playing solitaire?
Hush - I'm trying to perfect the art of dealing off the bottom of the deck.
translation: Sessiz olun, destenin altindan kart dagitma sanatini mükemmellestirmeye calisiyorum.

english: Hush - I'm trying to perfect the art of dealing off the bottom of the deck. Whatever you want, come back later and I'll speak to you then.
translation: Sessiz ol, destenin altindan kart dagitma sanatini mükemmellestirmeye calisiyorum. Ne istersen, daha sonra tekrar gel, o zaman konusuruz.

english: Good morning.
Leave me alone. I'm trying to find my gambling buddies!
translation: Beni rahat birak. Kumar arkadaslarimi ariyorum!

english: Leave me alone. I'm trying to find my gambling buddies! Whatever you want, come back later and I'll speak to you then.
translation: Beni rahat birak. Kumar arkadaslarimi ariyorum! Ne istersen, daha sonra tekrar gel, o zaman konusuruz.

english: Is it true a level 3 skiller caught one of your siblings?
translation: Seviye 3 bir yetenekli, kardeslerinden birini yakaladi mi?

english: Yes, they killed my mummy, kidnapped my brother, smiled about it and went to sleep.
translation: Evet, annemi öldürdüler, kardesimi kacirdilar, gülümsediler ve uykuya daldilar.

english: Aww, well you have me now! I shall call you Squishy and you shall be mine and you shall be my Squishy.
translation: Aww, ama simdi ben varim! Sana Squishy diyecegim ve sen benim olacaksin, benim Squishy'im olacaksin.

english: Come on, Squishy come on, little Squishy!
Ssss!
Glub glub!
Swshh!
Whhhhh!
Have you seen my wife Sarah? She's always wandering off...
translation: Karim Sarah'i gördün mü? Hep ortadan kayboluyor...

english: Very well done, take this.
You've found another clue!
Hello.
Who are you?
Charlie Windar, natural historian, at your service [sir/madam]
What do you do?

I study the marvelous creatures and plants that are here on this island. There appears to have been a much higher rate of evolution here than on the mainland. I suspect an outside influence from something.
translation: Bu adada bulunan muhtesem yaratiklari ve bitkileri inceliyorum. Burada, anakaraya göre cok daha yüksek bir evrim orani var gibi görünüyor. Disaridan bir etki oldugunu düsünüyorum.

english: We're exploring this island.
What have you found?
Several very interesting species of fungi and insects so far. But I haven't wandered much beyond the camp yet.
translation: Simdiye kadar cok ilginc birkac mantar ve böcek türü bulduk. Ama henüz kampin cok uzagina gitmedim.

english: Take the chance to explore!
Who are you?
What is going on here?
What should I do?
Hello!
Arr? Be ye wantin' te go on account with our gang o' fillibusters?
translation: Ne? Bizim korsan cetesine katilmak mi istiyorsun?

english: The powder monkey be takin' a caulk after gettin' rowdy on bumboo, so there be plenty of room for ye.
translation: Barutcu, bambuda gürültü yaptiktan sonra uykuya daldi, yani sana yer var.

english: Riiiiight...
I'll just be over here if you need me.
I got fish, you got gold?
translation: Bende balik var, sende altin var mi?

english: Yes.
Yes, but I don't want your fish.
Then what are ye doin' in a fish shop? Looking fer work?
translation: O zaman balikcida ne isin var? Is mi ariyorsun?

english: Possibly, do you have any quests?
I dunno, I haven't gone through the last catch yet. What sort of a fish is it?
translation: Bilmiyorum, son avimi henüz incelememedim. Ne tür bir balik bu?

english: A quest isn't a type of fish!
Then I don't have any, and yer wastin' my time!
translation: O zaman benim görevim yok ve sen benim zamanimi bosa harciyorsun!

english: What happened to your legs?
Ye wanna know what happened to my legs?
translation: Bacaklarima ne oldugunu mu bilmek istiyorsun?

english: Yer too much of a lilly-livered, hat wearin' landlubber to know what happened to my legs!
translation: Sen, bacaklarima ne oldugunu anlayamayacak kadar korkak, sapkali bir karacisin!

english: No I'm not! I've seen some freaky stuff! I can take it!
translation: Hayir, degilim! Garip seyler gördüm! Dayanabilirim!

english: All right, [lad/lass], since yer so insistent, I'll tell ye.
translation: Tamam, , madem bu kadar israrcisin, anlatayim.

english: See, I was clingin' onto a barrel, me ship havin' just had an encounter with this albatross.
translation: Bak, bir varile tutunmustum, gemim az önce bir albatrosla karsilasmisti.

english: The sea was thrashin' and wild, but not so wild that I didn't see the fins of some sharks closin' in on me.
translation: Deniz cilginca dalgalaniyordu, ama o kadar da cilgin degildi ki, bana yaklasan köpekbaliklarinin yüzgeclerini görmedim.

english: I managed to yank a sliver of wood from the barrel just as one of them grabbed me from below, but I slipped down the things throat by about two feet before I managed te kill it.
translation: Onlardan biri beni asagidan yakaladiginda, varilden bir parca tahta koparmayi basardim, ama onu öldürmeyi basarana kadar yaklasik iki fit kadar bogazindan asagi kaymistim.

english: How did you survive?
A passin' ship saw the sharks and knew there would be survivors in the water. They sent a longboat and picked me up, but not before the sharks had taken off my legs.
translation: Gecen bir gemi köpekbaliklarini gördü ve suda hayatta kalanlar olacagini anladi. Bir sandal gönderdiler ve beni aldilar, ama köpekbaliklari bacaklarimi koparmadan önce.

english: And that [lad/lass] is why they call me two feet Charley, because they found me jammed two feet down a shark's throat.
translation: Ve iste bu yüzden bana iki fit Charley diyorlar, cünkü beni köpekbaliginin bogazinda iki fit asagida sikismis halde buldular.

english: I think I'm gonna be sick...
I knew ye couldn't handle the truth!
Yes.
Yes, but I don't want your fish.
What happened to your legs?
Hi!
Yes, er, welcome to the zoo! I'm afraid I'm kind of busy right now; what was it you wanted?
translation: Evet, hayvanat bahcesine hos geldiniz! Maalesef su anda biraz mesgulüm; ne istiyordunuz?

english: Ah, you sound like someone who needs a quest doing!
translation: Ah, bir göreve ihtiyaci olan biri gibi konusuyorsun!

english: Well... maybe. How much do you know about hunting?
translation: Sey... belki. Avcilik hakkinda ne kadar bilgin var?

english: Well I know a little bit...
No, I could do with some help, but I'm afraid I need somebody with a little more experience.
translation: Hayir, biraz yardim alabilirim, ama korkarim biraz daha deneyimli birine ihtiyacim var.

english: Actually, now that you come to mention it, you might be able to help me.
translation: Aslinda, simdi sen bahsedince, bana yardim edebilirsin.

english: A few weeks ago we had a delivery of a northern ferret. They're funny little creatures. Turns out they're tricksy little blighters too.
translation: Birkac hafta önce kuzey gelincigi teslimati aldik. Komik kücük yaratiklar. Meger onlar da kurnaz kücük yaratiklarmis.

english: Whilst we were unloading him from the cart he managed to escape his cage. What's more he gave the driver a nasty nip on the way out too.
translation: Onu arabadan indirirken kafesinden kacmayi basardi. Üstelik kacarken soförü de fena isirdi.

english: This was obviously a bit of a blow, you can't make a new attraction without any animals.
translation: Bu tabii ki büyük bir darbe oldu, hayvanlar olmadan yeni bir atraksiyon yapamazsin.

english: We got in contact with one of our associates, a huntsman called Nickolaus, who agreed to capture us another.
translation: Ortaklarimizdan biri olan Nickolaus adinda bir avciyla iletisime gectik, o da bize baska bir tane yakalamayi kabul etti.

english: Funny thing is we haven't heard from him for some time now. I don't suppose you'd mind having a look for him?
translation: Komik olan, bir süredir ondan haber almadik. Onu aramak sizin icin sorun olmaz, degil mi?

english: Sure. Any idea where I should start looking?
translation: Tabii. Nereden aramaya baslamam gerektigini biliyor musunuz?

english: Well the northern ferret is mostly found around the mountains just west of the Gnome Stronghold, so that would probably be as good a place as any to start looking.
translation: Kuzey gelincigi cogunlukla Gnome Stronghold'un batisindaki daglarda bulunur, bu yüzden aramaya baslamak icin en uygun yer orasi olabilir.

english: Okay, thanks.
Sorry, I don't have the time.
Oh well, I'm sure he'll be okay out there on his own.
translation: Neyse, eminim kendi basina da idare eder.

english: Where did you get the animals from?
We get them from all over the place! The most exotic creatures have been brought back by explorers and sold to us.
translation: Her yerden buluyoruz! En egzotik yaratiklar kasifler tarafindan getirilip bize satiliyor.

english: Where on Gielinor did you get that scary looking Cyclops?!
translation: Gielinor'un neresinden bu korkunc görünümlü Cyclops'u buldunuz?

english: Yes he is scary looking!
He's from a very far away land, we couldn't find out more as the explorer who brought him back died shortly afterwards!
translation: Cok uzak bir ülkeden geldi, onu getiren kasif kisa süre sonra öldügü icin daha fazla bilgi edinemiyoruz!

english: Hi, how are you getting on with that ferret?
Well he seems to be just as vicious as the one we lost, but we're still very grateful for your help in acquiring him.
translation: Kaybettigimiz kadar saldirgan görünüyor, ama onu almamiza yardim ettiginiz icin yine de cok minnettariz.

english: Hey, I've got another ferret if you're interested?
translation: Hey, ilgilenirseniz baska bir gelincigim daha var?

english: Er, oh! Well that's very kind of you, but we don't really need another ferret at the moment, I'm afraid. We're having enough trouble taming the one we've got.
translation: Sey, oh! Cok naziksiniz, ama maalesef su anda baska bir gelincige ihtiyacimiz yok. Elimizdekini evcillestirmekte yeterince zorlaniyoruz.

english: Ah, you sound like someone who needs a quest doing!
translation: Ah, bir görev yapmaya ihtiyaci olan biri gibi konusuyorsun!

english: Sure. Any idea where I should start looking?
translation: Tabii. Nereden baslamam gerektigini biliyor musun?

english: Sorry, I don't have the time.
Where did you get the animals from?
Hello! Who are you?
Hello! The name's Charlie Brown and I've just arrived in Kourend.
translation: Merhaba! Adim Charlie Brown ve Kourend'e yeni geldim.

english: Nice to meet you Charlie, my name is [player name]. What are you doing here?
translation: Tanistigimiza memnun oldum Charlie, benim adim Maceraci. Burada ne yapiyorsun?

english: I've come to Kourend in search of luck, [player name]. I seek many fortunes and as you know you need luck to find fortune!
translation: Sans aramak icin Kourend'e geldim, Maceraci. Bircok servet ariyorum ve bildigin gibi servet bulmak icin sansa ihtiyacin var!

english: If you're searching for luck, why are you dressed as a monk?
translation: Sans ariyorsan neden kesis gibi giyinmissin?

english: Ah these robes keeps me holy, I must remain holy when praying to the God of Luck, [player name].
translation: Ah, bu cüppeler beni kutsal tutuyor, Sans Tanrisi'na dua ederken kutsal kalmaliyim, Maceraci.

english: God of Luck? I don't think I've heard of such a God...
translation: Sans Tanrisi mi? Böyle bir Tanri'yi hic duymadim...

english: Ah, would you perhaps allow me to enlighten you?
translation: Ah, sana biraz bilgi verebilir miyim?

english: Sure.
Arengeesus, God of luck. We do not know much about her or where she comes from, we just know she is there looking over us.
translation: Arengeesus, sans tanrisi. Onun hakkinda veya nereden geldigi hakkinda pek bir sey bilmiyoruz, sadece bizi korudugunu biliyoruz.

english: Those who praise Arengeesus enough to get her attention are rewarded. She will gaze down upon you providing you with luck on your adventures.
translation: Arengeesus'u yeterince övenler ödüllendirilir. O sana bakarak maceralarinda sana sans verir.

english: That sounds a little farfetched to me, luck isn't a thing. Hard work is all you need.
translation: Bana biraz abartili geldi, sans diye bir sey yoktur. Tek ihtiyacin olan sey siki calismaktir.

english: Perhaps working hard is merely a form of praise to the God of luck, [player name].
translation: Belki de siki calismak, sans tanrisina bir övgü bicimidir, Maceraci.

english: Hmmm... well good luck Charlie. Good bye!
translation: Hmmm... iyi sanslar Charlie. Hosca kal!

english: Farewell [player name], may Arengeesus shine down upon you.
translation: Hosca kal Maceraci, Arengeesus seni korusun.

english: And you!
Maybe another time, I must be going.
translation: Belki baska bir zaman, gitmem gerek.

english: Very well, farewell.
Sure.
Maybe another time, I must be going.
translation: Belki baska bir zaman, gitmem gerek.

english: Spare some change guv?
Who are you?
Charles. Charles E. Trampin' at your service. Now, about that change you were going to give me...
translation: Charles. Charles E. Trampin, hizmetinizdeyim. Simdi, bana verecegin bozuk paraya gelince...

english: Sorry, I haven't got any.
Thanks anyway.
Go get a job!
You startin? I hope your nose falls off!
Ok. Here you go.
Hey, thanks a lot!
No problem.
So...don't I get some sort of quest hint or something now?
translation: Peki... simdi bir tür görev ipucu falan almayacak miyim?

english: Huh? What do you mean? That wasn't why I asked you for money.
translation: Ha? Ne demek istiyorsun? Sana para isteme nedenim o degildi.

english: I just need to eat...
Oh wait. I haven't got any, sorry.
translation: Oh, bekle. Hic param yok, üzgünüm.

english: Is there anything down this alleyway?
translation: Bu sokakta bir sey var mi?

english: Funny you should mention that...there is actually.
translation: Komik, tam da bunu söyleyecektim... aslinda var.

english: The ruthless and notorious criminal gang known as the Black Arm Gang have their headquarters down there.
translation: Black Arm Gang olarak bilinen acimasiz ve kötü söhretli suc cetesi oraya karargahini kurmus.

english: Thanks for the warning!
Don't worry about it.
Do you think they would let me join?
You never know. You'll find a lady down there called Katrine. Speak to her.
translation: Kim bilir. Orada Katrine adinda bir kadin bulacaksin. Onunla konus.

english: But don't upset her, she's pretty dangerous.
I was under the impression you were already a member...
No. You're a collaborator with the Phoenix Gang. There's no way they'll let you join now.
translation: Hayir. Sen Phoenix Cetesi'nin isbirlikcisisin. Simdi seni aralarina kabul etmeleri imkansiz.

english: How did YOU know I was in the Phoenix Gang?
In my current profession I spend a lot of time on the streets and you hear these sorta things sometimes
translation: Su anki meslegimde sokaklarda cok zaman geciriyorum ve bazen bu tür seyler duyuyorsun.

english: Any ideas how I could get in there then?
Hmmm. I dunno.
Your best bet would probably be to find someone else... Someone who ISN'T a member of the Phoenix Gang, and get them to infiltrate the ranks of the Black Arm Gang for you.
translation: En iyi secenek, muhtemelen baska birini bulmak... Phoenix Cetesi üyesi OLMAYAN birini bulup, onun Black Arm Cetesi'ne sizmasini saglamak.

english: If you find someone like that, tell 'em to come to me first.
translation: Böyle birini bulursan, önce bana gelmesini söyle.

english: Ok. Good plan!
I'm not just a pretty face!
translation: Ben sadece güzel bir yüz degilim!

english: Like who?
There's plenty of other adventurers about besides yourself. I'm sure if you asked one of them nicely they would help you.
translation: Senin disinda bircok maceraci var. Onlardan birine nazikce sorarsan, sana yardim edeceklerinden eminim.

english: Please [sir/madam], can you help me.
What can I do for you?
I really need a cooked trout.
I really need a cooked pike.
I really need a raw herring
I really need a raw trout.
I really need some leather chaps.
I really need a leather body.
I really need an iron dagger.
I really need a piece of iron ore.
Sure, I'll be glad to help a person in need.
translation: Tabii, ihtiyaci olan birine yardim etmekten memnuniyet duyarim.

english: You give Charlie the [item].
Charlie gives you a [new clue/casket]!
Thank you so much [sir/madam].
Who are you?
Sorry, I haven't got any.
Go get a job!
Ok. Here you go.
No problem.
Don't I get some sort of quest hint or something now?
translation: Simdi bir tür görev ipucu falan almayacak miyim?

english: Is there anything down this alleyway?
translation: Bu sokakta bir sey var mi?

english: Thanks for the warning!
How did you know I was in the Phoenix Gang?
Ok. Good plan!
Like who?
Any ideas how I could get in there then?
translation: Oraya nasil girebilirim, bir fikrin var mi?

english: Do you think they would let me join?
Hello?
Hey! You haven't paid your Magic Training Arena Membership money!
translation: Hey! Sihirli Egitim Arenasi üyelik ücretini ödememissin!

english: You're lying. I can see right through you!
translation: Yalan söylüyorsun. Seni cok iyi taniyorum!

english: Oh, HA HA, very funny.
Can't you see I'm busy?
Well, I can't really see YOU.
Is there anybody there?
What do you think?
Wooo wooo! Be afraid for I'm a scary ghost. Wooo!
translation: Wooo wooo! Korkun, cünkü ben korkunc bir hayaletim. Wooo!

english: Er, whatever.
Checkal stares at you intensely.
translation: Checkal sana yogun bir sekilde bakiyor.

english: You best not be here to start any trouble [sir/miss].
Wouldn't dream of it.
[player name], I am so glad to see you are safe.
translation: Maceraci, güvende oldugunu gördügüme cok sevindim.

english: Hello, Checkal. Why didn't you tell me about Willow?
translation: Merhaba, Checkal. Willow'dan neden bana bahsetmedin?

english: I thought we were friends...
I am sorry [player name]. I do respect you and your love for the muscle. But sadly I needed the money. These muscles don't pay the bills on their own.
translation: Üzgünüm Maceraci. Seni ve kaslarina olan sevgini gercekten saygi duyuyorum. Ama ne yazik ki paraya ihtiyacim vardi. Bu kaslar faturalari kendi baslarina ödeyemezler.

english: Oh, I understand...
Please do not let this incident divert you from your path of becoming a strongman! I truly believe in you.
translation: Lütfen bu olayin seni güclü bir adam olma yolundan saptirmasina izin verme! Sana gercekten inaniyorum.

english: GOAL
[Player name] Wins
Sorry, I can't stop to talk.
Thank you for bringing Artur home safe.
translation: Artur'u eve sag salim getirdigin icin tesekkürler.

english: Hello.
Hello there. It's sad not having Artur around anymore, not to mention the awful business with his father. I hope he's coping okay with that.
translation: Merhaba. Artur'un artik aramizda olmamasi üzücü, babasiyla olan korkunc olaydan bahsetmiyorum bile. Umarim bununla basa cikabiliyordur.

english: I'm sure he'll be fine.
Hi, I need fuel for a lamp.
Hello there, the fuel you need is lamp oil, do you need help making it?
translation: Merhaba, ihtiyacin olan yakit lamba yagi, yapiminda yardima ihtiyacin var mi?

english: Yes please.
It's really quite simple.  You use the small still in here.  It's all set up, so there's no fiddling around with dials...
translation: Gercekten cok basit. Buradaki kücük damiticiyi kullaniyorsun. Her sey hazir, yani kadranlarla ugrasmana gerek yok...

english: Just put ordinary swamp tar in, and then use a lantern or lamp to get the oil out.
translation: Siradan bataklik katranini koyun ve sonra bir fener veya lamba kullanarak yagi cikarin.

english: Thanks.
No thanks.
Hello.
Oh.. hello, how's it going?
Good thanks.
Good to hear, sorry but I have a few things to do right now.
translation: Bunu duymak güzel, üzgünüm ama su anda yapmam gereken birkac is var.

english: Well I'd better let you get on then.
I have a slightly odd question.
Jolly good, the odder the better. I like oddities.
translation: Cok iyi, ne kadar tuhaf o kadar iyi. Tuhafliklari severim.

english: Do you know how I might distil a mix of anchovy oil and flowers so that it forms a layer on the inside of a butterfly jar?
translation: Ancuez yagi ve cicekleri karistirip, kelebek kavanozunun icinde bir tabaka olusturacak sekilde damitmanin bir yolunu biliyor musunuz?

english: That is an odd question. I commend you for it. Why would you want to do that?
translation: Bu tuhaf bir soru. Sizi tebrik ederim. Neden bunu yapmak istiyorsunuz?

english: Apparently, if I can make a jar like this it will be useful for storing implings in.
translation: Görünüse göre, böyle bir kavanoz yapabilirsem, implingleri saklamak icin kullanisli olacak.

english: So, do you have any of this fish-and-flower flavoured oil and a butterfly jar then?
translation: Peki, bu balik ve cicek aromali yagdan ve kelebek kavanozundan var mi?

english: As it happens, I do.
Well then. Hmmm. My lamp oil still may be able to do what you want. Give it a go and see if it works.
translation: Öyleyse. Hmmm. Lambamin yagi hala istedigin seyi yapabilir. Bir dene ve ise yarayip yaramadigini gör.

english: Thanks!
Actually, no.
If you go and get them then I may be able to help you. I'm better at coming up with answers if the questions are in my hands.
translation: Onlari getirirsen sana yardimci olabilirim. Sorular elimde olursa cevap bulmakta daha iyiyimdir.

english: So, how do you make anchovy oil?
Anchovies are pretty oily fish. I'd have thought you could just grind them up and sieve out the bits. You'd probably want to remove any water first - Cooking should do that pretty well.
translation: Hamsi oldukca yagli bir baliktir. Onlari ögütüp parcalarini elekten gecirebilirsin diye düsünüyorum. Muhtemelen önce suyu cikarmak isteyeceksin - Pisirmek bunu oldukca iyi yapar.

english: Do you have a sieve I can use?
Errm, yes. But you already have one. Two sieves is a bit excessive, don't you think?
translation: Evet. Ama zaten bir tane var. Iki elek biraz fazla olmaz mi sence?

english: Are you sure you don't already have one?
translation: Zaten bir tane olmadigina emin misin?

english: Errm, yes. Here, have this one. It's only been used for sieving dead rats out of sewer water.
translation: Evet. Al, bunu al. Sadece kanalizasyon suyundan ölü fareleri elemek icin kullanildi.

english: Err, why? Actually, on second thoughts I don't want to know.
translation: Neden? Aslinda, düsündüm de bilmek istemiyorum.

english: Well, it should be ideally suited to your task.
translation: Ideal olarak senin isine uygun olmali.

english: Fair enough.
I'd better go and get the repellent.
I think so.
Well done, have this.
Yes.
Yes please.
No thanks.
No.
No, I'm more interested in impling jars.
translation: Hayir, ben daha cok kavanozlarla ilgileniyorum.

english: So how do you make anchovy oil?
Do you have a sieve I can use?
I'd better go and get the repellent.
Hello, what are you doing here?
Hi there, my husband and I are adventurers, Captain Janaway brought us here.
translation: Merhaba, ben ve kocam maceraciyiz, Kaptan Janaway bizi buraya getirdi.

english: What brings you to Great Kourend?
New lands to explore of course! Isn't it exciting? A whole new world that we know nothing about just waiting for us to discover it!
translation: Tabii ki kesfedilecek yeni topraklar! Heyecan verici degil mi? Hakkinda hicbir sey bilmedigimiz yepyeni bir dünya, kesfedilmeyi bekliyor!

english: What you want, skinny creature?
What is this place?
Dis our home. It comfy, though we thinking of maybe getting more space up on land, above. But silly Corsair men live up there an' think dey own whole place.
translation: Burasi evimiz. Rahat bir yer, ama belki yukarida, karada daha genis bir yer bulmayi düsünüyoruz. Ama aptal korsanlar orada yasiyor ve oranin tamaminin kendilerine ait oldugunu düsünüyorlar.

english: Maybe one day dat gonna change. Tess got plans.
translation: Belki bir gün bu durum degisir. Tess'in planlari var.

english: Thanks.
I'll leave you alone, sorry.
What is this place?
I'll leave you alone, sorry.
Welcome to the Ardougne Domestic Service Agency!
translation: Ardougne Ev Hizmetleri Ajansi'na hos geldiniz!

english: Tell me about servants.
Do you need help around your house? Our trained, efficient workers are ready to serve you.
translation: Evinizde yardima mi ihtiyaciniz var? Egitimli, verimli calisanlarimiz size hizmet etmeye hazir.

english: They can cook meals for you and your friends, make tea, serve drinks, greet guests, and even take items to and from the bank for you.
translation: Sizin ve arkadaslariniz icin yemek pisirebilir, cay yapabilir, icecek servisi yapabilir, misafirleri karsilayabilir ve hatta sizin icin bankaya esya götürüp getirebilirler.

english: The more expensive servants will be able to make trips to the bank more quickly. Some of them can also go to the sawmill to change logs to planks for you.
translation: Daha pahali hizmetciler bankaya daha hizli gidip gelebilirler. Bazilari da sizin icin kereste fabrikasina gidip kütükleri tahtaya dönüstürebilirler.

english: Remember, you'll need to keep paying your servant. You pay them once when you hire them, and then they'll periodically ask for wages. You can dismiss your servant at any time.
translation: Unutmayin, hizmetcinize sürekli ödeme yapmaniz gerekecektir. Onlari ise aldiginizda bir kez ödeme yaparsiniz, sonra düzenli olarak maaslarini isterler. Hizmetcinizi istediginiz zaman isten cikarabilirsiniz.

english: I'd like to dismiss my servant, please.
Oh dear, are you sure?
Yes, I want to dismiss my servant.
Very well, you no longer have a servant.
No, I'll keep my servant for now.
Can I hire a servant?
Do you even own a house? These are strictly domestic servants; they won't follow you around the world!
translation: Bir eviniz var mi? Bunlar sadece ev hizmetcileri; sizi dünyanin dört bir yanina takip etmeyecekler!

english: First you'll need to make sure you have a servant's room. A servant will automatically take the second-best bedroom, leaving the best for yourself, of course! So you will need to build two bedrooms in your house.
translation: Öncelikle bir hizmetci odaniz oldugundan emin olmalisiniz. Hizmetci otomatik olarak en iyi yatak odasindan sonra gelen ikinci en iyi yatak odasini alir, en iyisi elbette size kalir! Yani evinize iki yatak odasi yaptirmaniz gerekecek.

english: According to our records, one of our people is already working for you. If you want to hire a different one you will have to dismiss them.
translation: Kayitlarimiza göre, calisanlarimizdan biri zaten sizin icin calisiyor. Baska birini ise almak istiyorsaniz, onu isten cikarmak zorundasiniz.

english: Certainly! We have a number of servants here now looking for work. Why not have a chat to them and see which one you would like to hire?
translation: Elbette! Su anda burada is arayan bircok hizmetcimiz var. Onlarla konusup hangisini ise almak istediginize karar verin.

english: Thank you.
Tell me about servants.
I'd like to dismiss my servant, please.
Yes, I want to dismiss my servant.
No, I'll keep my servant for now.
Can I hire a servant?
Thank you.
Hello there.
I'm not allowed to speak with strangers.
I'm not allowed to speak with Mourners.
Hello there. How's it going?
I don't know you.
I don't want to talk to you.
I shouldn't be talking to you.
I shouldn't speak with strangers.
I'm not allowed to talk to strangers.
I shouldn't speak with humans.
I'm not allowed to talk to your kind.
Mummy said I should stay away from humans.
translation: Annem insanlardan uzak durmam gerektigini söyledi.

english: He-he-hello?
Hello, I wondered if I could have a chat.
Well, I guess so.
Argghghhh!
Hey, don't be scared, I just want to talk to you.
translation: Hey, korkma, sadece seninle konusmak istiyorum.

english: Leave me alone!
Sorry but I need to ask a couple of questions.
translation: Üzgünüm ama birkac soru sormam gerekiyor.

english: Get off me! I haven't got anything!
Hey, calm down, I'm not going to hurt you. I just want to ask a few questions.
translation: Hey, sakin ol, sana zarar vermeyecegim. Sadece birkac soru sormak istiyorum.

english: What do you do here?
I'm not supposed to talk to strangers, and you sure are strange...
translation: Yabancilarla konusmamam gerekiyor ve sen kesinlikle bir yabancisin...

english: Nuffin'! I wasn't doin' nuffin'!
I 'elp wiv building fings an' da wall. But mainly I is hiding from da vyresies. I don't like dem vyresies.
translation: Seyleri ve duvari insa etmeye yardim ediyorum. Ama esas olarak vyresies'lerden saklaniyorum. Vyresies'leri sevmiyorum.

english: I was playin', but den da flapsies came so I was hidin'. Don't want da flapsies to bit me.
translation: Oynuyordum, ama sonra flapsies'ler geldi, ben de saklandim. Flapsies'lerin beni isirmasini istemiyorum.

english: I'm lost, can you help me?
Urm, well I fink we're in sector [one/two/three/six]. Not sure what else to say. I'm only a kid ya know!
Do you know about the Myreque?
Err, me dad says I'm not allowed to talk about that. Do you have any sweets?
translation: Sey, babam bunun hakkinda konusmamam gerektigini söylüyor. Sekerin var mi?

english: No, sorry, but please can you answer my questions?
translation: Hayir, üzgünüm, ama lütfen sorularimi cevaplar misin?

english: (whisper) Do you know about the Myreque?
Err, no! I'm not allowed to say any thingies about dem; but they're the good 'uns what can help us.
translation: Hayir! Onlar hakkinda hicbir sey söylemem yasak, ama onlar bize yardim edebilecek iyi insanlar.

english: Okay, thanks.
What do you do here?
I'm lost, can you help me?
Do you know about the Myreque?
(whisper) Do you know about the Myreque?
Okay, thanks.
Hello.
Mother says I shouldn't speak with strangers.
Fair enough.
Squeak!
You'll need a weapon to try and attack this beast.
translation: Bu canavara saldirmak icin bir silaha ihtiyacin olacak.

english: The Chompy Bird is too quick for your melee weapon.
translation: Chompy Bird, yakin dövüs silahin icin cok hizli.

english: Magic simply won't affect this beast!
Your ranged weapon isn't powerful enough to hurt the Chompy bird.
translation: Menzilli silahin Chompy Bird'e zarar verecek kadar güclü degil.

english: Sqwirk!
Screech!
Sqwark!
!!Croak!!
Gobble!
Rawk!
*Chirp!*
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
Hmm... Such potential. Such a waste...
translation: Hmm... Ne kadar potansiyel var. Ne kadar israf...

english: That helmet... Don't think it protects you... Don't think it hides the truth...
translation: O migfer... Seni korudugunu sanma... Gercegi sakladigini sanma...

english: Nilsal, iknami. Would you like me to tan any hides for you?
translation: Nilsal, iknami. Senin için deri tabaklamak ister misin?

english: No thanks. I don't have any hides.
No problem, iknami. Come back if you need me to tan any hides for you.
translation: Sorun degil, iknami. Derini tabaklamak istersen tekrar gel.

english: Yes please.
No thanks.
Yes please.
No thanks.
Hello, I've got some wares in you might have lost. Care to take a look?
translation: Merhaba, kaybettiginiz bazi esyalariniz var. Bir bakmak ister misiniz?

english: Who are you and what do you sell?
I'm Chris, travelling repairman. If you need something repaired, I can do it for you if you've got the money for it.
translation: Ben Chris, gezgin tamirciyim. Tamir edilmesi gereken bir sey varsa, paraniz varsa sizin icin tamir edebilirim.

english: I've also got a collection of items people end up losing a lot. Nothing fancy, and certainly nothing you couldn't get elsewhere, maybe for free. Still, I charge a convenience fee for having it right here. Interested?
translation: Ayrica insanlarin sik sik kaybettigi esyalarin bir koleksiyonunu da var. Özel bir sey yok, baska yerden, belki de bedavaya bulabileceginiz seyler. Yine de, burada bulundurma ücreti aliyorum. Ilgilenir misiniz?

english: Show me what you've got.
About items that break when people kill me...
translation: Insanlar beni öldürdügünde kirilan esyalar hakkinda...

english: Yeah, some things will break if you get killed in the Wilderness. And if you die deep in the Wilderness, they can vanish altogether.
translation: Evet, Wilderness'da öldürülürseniz bazi esyalar kirilir. Wilderness'nin derinliklerinde ölürseniz, tamamen yok olabilirler.

english: Can you fix them?
For a fee, sure. Just show me the broken item.
translation: Ücret karsiliginda, elbette. Bana kirilan esyayi göster yeter.

english: Can you stop them vanishing in deep Wilderness?
Well, if you bring me a Trouver Parchment and some coins, I can enchant some items so they won't disappear if you end up losing them deep in the Wilderness.
translation: Bana bir Trouver Parchment ve biraz para getirirsen, bazi esyalari büyülü hale getirip Wilderness'in derinliklerinde kaybolmalarini engelleyebilirim.

english: If you need a Trouver Parchment, there's a mage up in Ferox Enclave called Justine who sells them. I've also heard rumours there's a cave in the Wilderness with creatures that sometimes carry them as well.
translation: Trouver Parsömeni'ne ihtiyacin varsa, Ferox Enclave'de Justine adinda bir büyücü var, o satiyor. Ayrica Wilderness'ta bazen bunlari tasiyan yaratiklarin oldugu bir magara oldugu söylentileri de duydum.

english: Why would wild creatures be carrying magic parchments?
translation: Vahsi yaratiklar neden sihirli parsömenleri tasisin ki?

english: Eh, some poor sap walks in carrying one, gets himself killed, and the creature just hangs on to it as a trophy? I can see it.
translation: Eh, zavalli bir ahmak onu tasiyarak iceri girer, öldürülür ve yaratik onu bir ganimet olarak saklar? Anlayabiliyorum.

english: No thanks.
Hey there. I can't offer my usual services right now, but if you're interested, I picked up a few bits that would let me change your appearance, if you're interested.
translation: Merhaba. Su anda her zamanki hizmetlerimi sunamiyorum, ama ilgilenirsen, görünüsünü degistirmemi saglayacak birkac sey aldim.

english: Huh, I knew the Makeover Mage said that would work, but I didn't actually believe them!
translation: Huh, Makeover Mage bunun ise yarayacagini söylemisti, ama ben onlara inanmamistim!

english: Actually, I could do with a haircut.
Not too shabby from some sheep shears, if I do say so myself!
translation: Kendi kendime söyleyeyim, koyun makasiyla kesilmis gibi cok da kötü degil!

english: Are you looking for a haircut or a shave?
translation: Sac kesimi mi yoksa tiras mi istiyorsun?

english: Are you wanting a new top or some new legwear?
translation: Yeni bir üst mü yoksa yeni bir alt mi istiyorsun?

english: Really? I got that out of a bin in Draynor! Well, if you're sure...
translation: Gercekten mi? Onu Draynor'daki bir cöp kutusundan aldim! Peki, emin isen...

english: Well, they'll keep the sand off your feet at least...
Suit yourself. Literally, I guess.
translation: Sen bilirsin. Kelimenin tam anlamiyla, sanirim.

english: Hey, hands off my anvil!
But I just wanted to smith on it! It's right by a bank-
translation: Ama sadece üzerinde demircilik yapmak istedim! Bankanin hemen yaninda...

english: Because I put it there, you fool! If you want an anvil by a bank, I suggest you find your own!
translation: Cünkü oraya ben koydum, aptal! Bankanin yaninda örs istiyorsan, kendin bulmani öneririm!

english: Who are you and what do you sell?
Show me what you've got.
No thanks.
About items that break when people kill me...
translation: Insanlar beni öldürdügünde kirilan esyalar hakkinda...

english: Can you fix them?
Can you stop them vanishing in deep Wilderness?
Can I get a body makeover?
A haircut, please!
A shave, please!
Do you have any clothes?
A new top, please!
Some new legwear, please!
I'd really like a new pair of shoes.
I'm good, thanks.
It's nice to meet you here, [player name].
Who were you?

I'm Chuck. I used to exchange logs for certificates, so people could trade them in bulk more conveniently. Certificates were what we used before banks automatically issued banknotes for most tradeable items.
translation: Ben Chuck. Eskiden kütükleri sertifikalarla degistirirdim, böylece insanlar bunlari toplu olarak daha kolay takas edebilirdi. Sertifikalar, bankalar cogu takas edilebilir esya icin otomatik olarak banknot basmaya baslamadan önce kullandigimiz seydi.

english: Even today, banknotes are sometimes referred to as 'certs', in memory of the certificates we used before.
translation: Bugün bile, banknotlar bazen eskiden kullandigimiz sertifikalarin anisina “sert” olarak adlandirilir.

english: I had colleagues who'd exchange other items for certificates - Niles, Miles and Giles were the most famous of us. But those three found new jobs rather than retiring like I did.
translation: Diger esyalari sertifikalarla takas eden meslektaslarim vardi - Niles, Miles ve Giles en ünlülerimizdi. Ama bu ücü benim gibi emekli olmak yerine yeni isler buldular.

english: Do you think you might leave the Realm?
No, I don't think so. The big high-street banks made my work useless, and I don't fancy joining Niles, Miles and Giles on their weird treks.
translation: Hayir, sanmiyorum. Büyük bankalar benim isimi gereksiz hale getirdi ve Niles, Miles ve Giles'in tuhaf yolculuklarina katilmak istemiyorum.

english: No, I'll stay here and enjoy my retirement. It's nice of you to ask, though.
translation: Hayir, burada kalip emekliligimin tadini cikaracagim. Yine de sordugun icin tesekkürler.

english: Thanks.
Who were you?
Do you think you might leave the Realm?
Thanks.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu var. Merhaba, selam, selam...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her türlü sey! Kuleler görülmeye deger harika manzaralar sunuyor.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmenizi tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Hello there. How's it going?
I'm very well, thank you.
Sorry, but I don't want to buy anything.
translation: Üzgünüm ama bir sey almak istemiyorum.

english: Not too bad thanks.
Hello!
Nilsal! I'm pretty good, thank you.
Nilsal!
Another human? Do what you need to and then be gone from here.
translation: Baska bir insan mi? Isini hallet ve buradan git.

english: Every day they let more of your kind in.
translation: Her gün sizin gibileri iceri aliyorlar.

english: Hmph!
I don't talk to you lot.
Not interested!
Hello there! Nice weather we've been having.
I'm fine, how are you?
Very well, thank you.
Sorry, but I'm busy right now.
Who are you?
I'm a bold adventurer.
Ah, a very noble profession.
Why are you here? This isn't a place for humans.
translation: Neden buradasin? Burasi insanlar icin uygun bir yer degil.

english: A human? Why don't you go back to where you came from?
translation: Bir insan mi? Neden geldigin yere geri dönmüyorsun?

english: Hello there!
Tetamo! This is a total disaster!
What's wrong?
Imps!
Imps?
Yes! I don't know where they came from, but my basement is filled with them! At best, they're stealing all my things, but at worst, they're just destroying them!
translation: Evet! Nereden geldiklerini bilmiyorum ama bodrumum onlarla doldu! En iyi ihtimalle esyalarimi çaliyorlar, en kötü ihtimalle ise onlari yok ediyorlar!

english: Is there anything I can do to help?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Thank you for the offer, but I don't think so.
Fair enough.
Grrrr, what business have you here ?
I am on an errand...
So what do you want with me ?
I am an ogre killer come to destroy you!
translation: Ben seni yok etmeye gelen bir ogre katiliyim!

english: I would like to see you try!
You are under attack!
I seek passage into the skavid caves
Is that so...
You humour me small thing, answer this riddle and I will help you... I want you to bring me an item
translation: Beni eglendiriyorsun kücük sey, bu bilmeceyi cözersen sana yardim ederim... Bana bir esya getirmeni istiyorum.

english: I will give you all the letters of this item, you work out what it is...
translation: Sana bu esyanin tüm harflerini verecegim, sen ne oldugunu bul...

english: My first is in days, but not in years.  My second is in evil, and also in tears. My third is in all, but not in none
translation: Birincisi günlerde var, ama yillarda yok. Ikincisi kötülükte var, gözyaslarinda da. Ücüncüsü her seyde var, ama hicbir seyde yok.

english: My fourth is in hot, but not in sun. My fifth is in heaven, and also in hate. My sixth is in fearing, but not in fate.
translation: Dördüncüsü sicakta var, ama güneste yok. Besincisi cennette, ama nefrette degil. Altincisi korkuda, ama kaderde degil.

english: My seventh is in plush, but not in place. My eighth is in nine, but not in eight. My last is in earth, and also in in great
translation: Yedincisi pelüste, ama yerde degil. Sekizincisi dokuzda, ama sekizde degil. Sonuncusu topraga, ama büyüklüge de.

english: My whole is an object, that magic will make. It brings wrack and ruin to all in it's wake...
translation: Bütünüm, sihirle yaratilmis bir nesne. Ardinda yikim ve harabe birakir...

english: Now how long I wonder, will this riddle take?
translation: Acaba bu bilmece ne kadar sürecek?

english: I worked it out!
Well well.. the imp has done it!
Thanks for the rune
This is what you be needing...
The guard gives you a map
What is it?
Do you have any other riddles for me?
Yes, what looks good on a plate with salad?
translation: Evet, salata tabaginda ne iyi gider?

english: I don't know...
You! Now go, and bother me no more.)
translation: Sen! Simdi git ve beni rahatsiz etme.)

english: A nice pizza?
Grr! Think you are a comedian, eh? Get lost!
translation: Grr! Kendini komedyen mi saniyorsun? Defol git!

english: I have lost the map you gave me.
What's the point? Take this one and go away!
translation: Ne anlami var? Al bunu ve git!

english: You imps always store things in places and forget. Go look for it.
translation: Siz cinler her zaman bir yerlere bir seyler saklar ve unutursunuz. Git ara onu.

english: Are you blind? What is that you are carrying?
Oh, that map...
I am an ogre killer come to destroy you!
translation: Ben seni yok etmeye gelen bir ogre katiliyim!

english: I seek passage into the skavid caves
Do you have any other riddles for me?
I don't know...
A nice pizza?
I have lost the map you gave me.
Hello there.
Oh hello, I'm sorry, I'm a bit worn out.
Busy day?
Oh, It's those mice! They're everywhere! What I really need is a cat. But they're hard to come by nowadays.
translation: Oh, su fareler! Her yerdeler! Aslinda bir kediye ihtiyacim var. Ama bugünlerde bulmak zor.

english: No, you're right, you don't see many around.
I have a cat that I could sell.
You don't say, is that it ?
Say hello to a real mouse killer!
translation: Gercek bir fare katiline merhaba de!

english: Hmmm, not bad, not bad at all. Looks like it's a lively one.
translation: Hmmm, fena degil, hic fena degil. Canli bir taneye benziyor.

english: Erm...kind of...
I don't have much in the way of money. I do have these!
translation: Fazla param yok. Ama bunlar var!

english: The peasant shows you a sack of Death Runes.
translation: Köylü sana bir cuval Ölüm Rünü gösterir.

english: The dwarves bring them from the mine for us. Tell you what, I'll give you [100/200] Death Runes for the cat.
translation: Cüceler bunlari bizim icin madenlerden getiriyorlar. Bak ne diyecegim, sana kedi karsiliginda [100/200] Ölüm Rünü verecegim.

english: Nope, I'm not parting for that.
Well, I'm not giving you anymore!
translation: O zaman sana daha fazla vermeyecegim!

english: Ok then, you've got a deal.
Great! Hand over the cat and I'll give you the runes.
translation: Harika! Kediyi ver, ben de sana runeleri vereyim.

english: Nope, they're not easy to get hold of.
translation: Hayir, onlari elde etmek kolay degil.

english: I have a cat...look!
Hmmm...doesn't look like it's seen daylight in years. That's not going to catch any mice!
translation: Hmmm... yillardir gün isigi görmemis gibi görünüyor. Bu fare yakalayamaz!

english: Hi there.
Good day to you traveller.
What are you up to?
Chasing mice as usual! It's all I seem to do nowadays.
translation: Her zamanki gibi fare avliyorum! Son zamanlarda tek yaptigim bu.

english: You must waste a lot of time?
Yes, but what can you do? It's not like there's many cats around here!
translation: Evet, ama ne yaparsin? Buralarda pek kedi yok ki!

english: I'm a bit busy to talk right now, sorry.
translation: Su anda konusacak vaktim yok, üzgünüm.

english: Why? What are you doing?
Trying to kill these mice! What I really need is a cat!
translation: Bu fareleri öldürmeye calisiyorum! Aslinda bir kediye ihtiyacim var!

english: You hand over the cat. You are given [100/200] Death Runes.
translation: Kediyi teslim ediyorsun. [100/200] Ölüm Rünü aliyorsun.

english: Great, thanks for that!
That's ok, take care.
I have a cat that I could sell.
Nope, I'm not parting for that.
Ok then, you've got a deal.
Nope, they're not easy to get hold of.
Welcome to the Alchemical Society. What can I help you with?
translation: Simya Dernegi'ne hos geldin. Nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: What is this place?
This is the main facility of the Alchemical Society. We're an organisation who fuse the forgotten teachings of the Old Ones with traditional Gielinorian Herblore practices.
translation: Burasi Simya Dernegi'nin ana tesisi. Biz, Eski Olanlarin unutulmus ögretilerini geleneksel Gielinor bitki bilimi uygulamalariyla birlestiren bir organizasyonuz.

english: The lab under our feet allows us to fund our research by producing useful products for the kingdom.
translation: Ayaklarimizin altindaki laboratuvar, krallik icin yararli ürünler üreterek arastirmalarimizi finanse etmemizi sagliyor.

english: So you do things differently to the druids of the mainland?
translation: Yani sizler anakaradaki druidlerden farkli seyler mi yapiyorsunuz?

english: In a way, but we very much respect Herblore as a profession and recognise that whatever your druids do definitely works. Our goal is to advance the study of Herblore, not replace it.
translation: Bir bakima öyle, ama biz Herblore meslegine büyük saygi duyuyoruz ve druidlerin yaptiklarinin kesinlikle ise yaradigini kabul ediyoruz. Amacimiz Herblore calismalarini ilerletmek, onun yerini almak degil.

english: Anyway, I'm a little busy at the moment, but I'm sure some of the other lab assistants would love to tell you more!
translation: Neyse, su anda biraz mesgulüm, ama eminim diger laboratuvar asistanlarindan bazilari size daha fazla bilgi vermekten memnuniyet duyacaktir!

english: Thanks! I'd better be going now.
What do you do around here?
When I'm not working in the lab, I'm normally somewhere around here researching or administrating our orders. There's an awful lot of paperwork to get through!
translation: Laboratuvarda calismadigim zamanlarda genellikle buralarda arastirma yapiyorum veya siparislerimizi yönetiyorum. Yapilacak cok fazla evrak isi var!

english: Can I buy some potions?
We're not really a shop, so our products are not available to buy directly. Everything we make gets shipped wholesale around the kingdom.
translation: Biz bir dükkan degiliz, bu yüzden ürünlerimizi dogrudan satin alamazsiniz. Ürettigimiz her sey kralligin dört bir yanina toptan olarak gönderilir.

english: You look like the adventuring type anyway. I can't imagine our products would be of much use to you.
translation: Zaten maceraci bir tip gibi görünüyorsunuz. Ürünlerimizin size pek bir faydasi olacagini sanmiyorum.

english: Nothing. I'll be going now.
Hey! Where do you think you're going?
I wanted to see what was down these stairs.
translation: Bu merdivenlerin asagisinda ne oldugunu görmek istedim.

english: We are the Alchemical Society and those stairs lead to our lab and production facilities.
translation: Biz Kimya Dernegi'yiz ve bu merdivenler laboratuvarimiza ve üretim tesislerimize cikiyor.

english: Oh... I think its best that I stay away then.
translation: Oh... O zaman uzak durmam en iyisi.

english: A Herblore level of 60 is required to enter the lab.
translation: Laboratuvara girmek icin 60 seviye Herbalistlik gerekiyor.

english: I'm actually quite skilled in Herblore. Would it be possible for me to join?
translation: Aslinda Herbalistlikte oldukca yetenekliyim. Katilmam mümkün mü?

english: You are? Well, we're always looking for new members, provided they have the aptitude needed. In that case, head on in and talk to Supervisor Lalo. He'll show you how everything works.
translation: Öyle mi? Eh, gerekli yetenekleri olan yeni üyeler ariyoruz. Öyleyse iceri gir ve Süpervizör Lalo ile konus. Sana her seyin nasil isledigini gösterecektir.

english: What is this place?
Thanks! I'd better be going now.
What do you do around here?
Can I buy some potions?
Nothing. I'll be going now.
Hello there.
Sorry, can't stop to chat! You would be amazed at how many meals this family gets through daily!
translation: Üzgünüm, sohbet edemem! Bu ailenin günde ne kadar cok yemek yedigini bilseniz sasirirsiniz!

english: Hiya.
Well hello there adventurer! Are we fit and well?
Yep, fine thanks.
Glad to hear it.
Hey.
Oh, hello there. Sorry, but I can't really talk right now. Things haven't been great here recently, and I have a lot of work to do.
translation: Merhaba. Üzgünüm, ama su anda konusamam. Son zamanlarda isler pek iyi gitmiyor ve yapmam gereken cok is var.

english: Thank you for helping me. A golem can have no greater satisfaction than knowing that its task is complete.
translation: Yardim ettigin icin tesekkürler. Bir golem icin, görevini tamamladigini bilmekten daha büyük bir tatmin olamaz.

english: But the whole city is destroyed! Doesn't that bother you?
translation: Ama bütün sehir yikilmis! Bu seni rahatsiz etmiyor mu?

english: I was never programmed to appreciate the city. My only purpose was the destruction of the demon, and that is achieved!
translation: Ben sehri takdir etmek icin programlanmadim. Tek amacim iblisi yok etmekti ve bunu basardim!

english: I regret that I could not assist you in the slaying of Agrith-Naar.
translation: Agrith-Naar'i öldürmede sana yardim edemedigim icin üzgünüm.

english: Don't worry, golem! You've done enough demon-slaying in your time.
translation: Merak etme, golem! Sen zamaninda yeterince iblis öldürdün.

english: Hello, welcome to the Civic Office of West Ardougne. How can I help you?
translation: Merhaba, Bati Ardougne Belediye Ofisi'ne hos geldiniz. Nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: Who is through that door?
The city warder Bravek is in there.
Can I go in?
He has asked not to be disturbed.
I'm just looking thanks.
I need permission to enter a plague house.
translation: Veba evine girmek icin izin almam gerekiyor.

english: Rather you than me! The mourners normally deal with that stuff, you should speak to them. Their headquarters are right near the city gate.
translation: Sen gitsen daha iyi! Bu islerle normalde cenaze görevlileri ilgilenir, onlarla konusmalisin. Merkezleri sehir kapisinin hemen yaninda.

english: I'll try asking them then.
Surely you don't let them run everything for you?
Well, they do know what they're doing here. If they did start doing something badly Bravek, the city warder, would have the power to override them. I can't see that happening though.
translation: Burada ne yaptiklarini biliyorlar. Eger kötü bir sey yapmaya baslarlarsa, sehir muhafizi Bravek onlari durdurma yetkisine sahiptir. Ama bunun olacagini sanmiyorum.

english: Can I speak to Bravek anyway?
translation: Yine de Bravek ile konusabilir miyim?

english: This is urgent though! Someone's been kidnapped!
translation: Bu acil bir durum! Birisi kacirildi!

english: I'll see what I can do I suppose.
Mr Bravek, there's a man here who really needs to speak to you.
translation: Bay Bravek, sizinle konusmasi gereken biri var.

english: I suppose they can come in then. If they keep it short.
translation: O zaman girebilirler. Kisa keserlerse tabii.

english: Okay, I'll leave him alone.
Do you know when he will be available?
translation: Ne zaman müsait olacak biliyor musunuz?

english: Oh I don't know, an hour or so maybe.
translation: Bilmiyorum, bir saat kadar sonra belki.

english: Bravek will see you now but keep it short!
translation: Bravek simdi sizinle görüsecek ama kisa kesin!

english: Thanks, I won't take much of his time.
I suppose so.
Hello.
Sorry, I don't have time to talk. Bravek needs lots of help running the city.
translation: Üzgünüm, konusacak vaktim yok. Bravek'in sehri yönetmek icin cok yardima ihtiyaci var.

english: Who is through that door?
I'm just looking thanks.
I need permission to enter a plague house.
translation: Veba evine girmek icin izin almam gerekiyor.

english: I'll try asking them then.
Surely you don't let them run everything for you?
translation: Her seyi onlarin yönetmesine izin vermiyorsunuz herhalde?

english: Can I speak to Bravek anyway?
translation: Yine de Bravek ile konusabilir miyim?

english: This is urgent though! Someone's been kidnapped!
translation: Bu acil bir durum! Birisi kacirildi!

english: Okay, I'll leave him alone.
Do you know when he will be available?
translation: Ne zaman müsait olacak biliyor musun?

english: Good day.
Who are you?
My name is Clerk. I work on gathering people together to form what we call clans.
translation: Adim Clerk. Insanlari bir araya getirip klan dedigimiz gruplar olusturmakla ugrasiyorum.

english: What is a clan?
Ah, clans. Where do I begin? Clans are groups of people gathered together for numerous reasons. Usually they have shared interests, like activities they enjoy together.
translation: Ah, klanlar. Nereden baslasam? Klanlar, cesitli nedenlerle bir araya gelen insan gruplaridir. Genellikle ortak ilgi alanlari vardir, örnegin birlikte yaptiklari aktiviteler.

english: These activities could include improving certain skills, battling the same monsters, or even battling other clans!
translation: Bu aktiviteler arasinda belirli becerileri gelistirmek, ayni canavarlarla savasmak, hatta diger klanlarla savasmak da olabilir!

english: Other clans form together because they just enjoy the company of other like-minded people. The clan community can be a great resource if you should ever need help with anything.
translation: Diger klanlar ise sadece benzer düsünen insanlarla birlikte olmaktan keyif aldiklari icin bir araya gelirler. Klan toplulugu, herhangi bir konuda yardima ihtiyaciniz oldugunda harika bir kaynak olabilir.

english: How do I join a clan?
You can either form your own clan with your friends, or apply to an already existing clan.
translation: Arkadaslarinizla kendi klaninizi kurabilir veya mevcut bir klana basvurabilirsiniz.

english: Should you choose to form your own clan you will need four friends to join you, and it is recommended that you have spent a good amount of time in this world first. Leadership is not for everyone.
translation: Kendi klaninizi kurmayi secerseniz, size katilacak dört arkadasa ihtiyaciniz olacak ve önce bu dünyada yeterince zaman gecirmis olmaniz önerilir. Liderlik herkese uygun degildir.

english: However, fret not. There are plenty of interesting and exciting clans out there! Check out the clan recruitment board to see which clans are currently accepting applications.
translation: Ancak endiselenmeyin. Disarida bircok ilginc ve heyecan verici klan var! Klan üye alim panosuna bakarak su anda basvuru kabul eden klanlari görebilirsiniz.

english: What can a clan offer me?
Clans offer you the ability to have an official gathering of friends or like-minded individuals in a hierarchical structure.
translation: Klanlar, hiyerarsik bir yapi icinde arkadaslarinizla veya benzer düsünen kisilerle resmi bir toplanti yapma imkani sunar.

english: In other words, you and your friends get an exclusive chat channel and a Clan Hall, as well as the ability to assign ranks to members.
translation: Diger bir deyisle, siz ve arkadaslariniz özel bir sohbet kanali ve Klan Salonu'na sahip olursunuz ve üyelere rütbe atayabilirsiniz.

english: Ranks can be assigned from custom pre-sets, which then determine what permissions that person has.
translation: Rütbeler, o kisinin sahip oldugu izinleri belirleyen önceden ayarlanmis özel seceneklerden atanabilir.

english: For example: One person may have the rank to kick players from the chat, while another has the rank to access the Clan Coffer.
translation: Örnegin: Bir kisi sohbetten oyunculari atma rütbesine sahipken, baska bir kisi Klan Hazinesine erisim rütbesine sahip olabilir.

english: What is the Clan Coffer?
The Clan Coffer is a shared coin store, used by members of the clan. Highly ranked members can assign who has permission to deposit and withdraw coins.
translation: Klan Hazinesi, klan üyeleri tarafindan kullanilan ortak bir para deposudur. Yüksek rütbeli üyeler, para yatirma ve cekme iznine sahip kisileri atayabilir.

english: What is a Clan Hall?
