A Clan Hall is a private area only accessible for the people with the permission to enter. High ranked members of the clan can restrict it to only allow certain ranks in, or open it up to even allow guests.
translation: Klan Salonu, giris izni olan kisilerin erisebilecegi özel bir alandir. Klanin yüksek rütbeli üyeleri, bu alani yalnizca belirli rütbelere izin verecek sekilde kisitlayabilir veya misafirlere bile acabilir.

english: Why would I need a Clan Hall? Can't I get a house instead?
translation: Klan Salonu'na neden ihtiyacim olsun? Bunun yerine bir ev alamaz miyim?

english: The beauty of it is that you can have both. You can keep your house for private guests and your own personal use, but when you wish to see larger groups then the Clan Hall may be more fitting.
translation: Bunun güzelligi, ikisine de sahip olabilmenizdir. Evinizi özel misafirleriniz ve kisisel kullaniminiz icin saklayabilirsiniz, ancak daha büyük gruplari görmek istediginizde Klan Salonu daha uygun olabilir.

english: What do you do here?
My mission is to administer clans; I help form them and can tell you anything you need to know about them.
translation: Benim görevim klanlari yönetmek; klanlarin kurulmasina yardimci olurum ve klanlar hakkinda bilmeniz gereken her seyi size anlatabilirim.

english: Sure, but why are you here specifically?
Why does anyone go anywhere? As a gatherer of people, I go where people gather. The Grand Exchange is known to be a place where people come together. What better place to bring them even closer?
translation: Neden insanlar herhangi bir yere gider? Insanlari bir araya getiren biri olarak, insanlarin toplandigi yerlere giderim. Grand Exchange, insanlarin bir araya geldigi bir yer olarak bilinir. Onlari daha da yakinlastirmak icin daha iyi bir yer olabilir mi?

english: I suppose this usually is a crowded place.
translation: Burasi genellikle kalabalik bir yer sanirim.

english: Very much so. I was lucky to find this charming corner to set up the clan hub.
translation: Cok kalabalik. Klan merkezini kurmak icin bu büyüleyici köseyi buldugum icin sansliyim.

english: What's the clan hub?
The clan hub is what I call this area, my little corner of the Grand Exchange. This is where every clan is born, as well as the best place to look for new recruits.
translation: Klan merkezi, Grand Exchange'deki benim kücük köseme verdigim isim. Burasi her klanin dogdugu yer ve yeni üyeler aramak icin en iyi yer.

english: If you're in a clan you can also access your Clan Hall from here.
translation: Bir klana üyeyseniz, buradan Klan Salonuna da erisebilirsiniz.

english: I'm in a clan. Can you give me anything?
translation: Ben bir klana üyeyim. Bana bir sey verebilir misin?

english: I've got cloaks that let you show your clan's colours, and vexilla to help you recruit more people into your clan, but you don't have space to take any.
translation: Klaninin renklerini gösterebilecegin pelerinler ve klana daha fazla üye kazanmana yardimci olacak bayraklar var, ama bunlari alabilecek yerin yok.

english: I suppose I'd better free up some space.
translation: Sanirim biraz yer acsam iyi olacak.

english: Yes, you should! Now, did you want to ask me anything else while you're here?
translation: Evet, acmalisin! Peki, buradayken bana sormak istedigin baska bir sey var mi?

english: Certainly. I've got cloaks that let you show your clan's colours, and vexilla to help you recruit more people into your clan.
translation: Elbette. Klaninizin renklerini göstermenizi saglayan pelerinler ve klaniniza daha fazla üye kazandirmaniza yardimci olacak bayraklar var.

english: Thanks!
Goodbye.
Goodbye. Come back any time.
translation: Hosca kalin. Istediginiz zaman tekrar gelin.

english: Sorry, you'll have to come back another day. I'm not ready to serve you yet.
translation: Üzgünüm, baska bir gün tekrar gelmeniz gerekecek. Henüz size hizmet etmeye hazir degilim.

english: Who are you?
What do you do here?
What is a clan?
How do I join a clan?
What can a clan offer me?
What is the Clan Coffer?
What is a Clan Hall?
Goodbye.
I'm in a clan. Can you give me anything?
translation: Bir klana üyeyim. Bana bir sey verebilir misin?

english: Sure, but why are you here specifically?
What's the clan hub?
The people of Hosidius require sulphurous fertiliser for the farms. I see you have [number] buckets here, and [number] more in the bank. We require [number] buckets.
Do you wish to donate your fertiliser? We'll take what we need directly from your bank.
translation: Gübrelerini bagislamak ister misin? Ihtiyacimiz olani dogrudan bankandan alacagiz.

english: Thank you very much.
No, sorry.
The people of Hosidius require sulphurous fertiliser for the farms. We currently require [number] buckets. Do come back if you every get any you'd be willing to donate.
If you were planning to bring any fertiliser for the stores, please try again later. The stores are very full at present.
translation: Magazalar icin gübre getirmeyi planliyorsaniz, lütfen daha sonra tekrar deneyin. Magazalar su anda cok dolu.

english: That's alright, I haven't brought any.
Yes
No
Good day.
Hey there. What brings you here?
This is the dense essence mine. The essence we gather here is used across Arceuus, and indeed all of Kourend. If you wish, you are welcome to mine some yourself.
translation: Burasi yogun öz madeni. Burada topladigimiz öz, Arceuus'ta ve hatta tüm Kourend'de kullaniliyor. Isterseniz, kendiniz de biraz madenciligi yapabilirsiniz.

english: I might do that. Thanks.
I have a question for you.
Clerris has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Clerris sana bir meydan okuma parsömeni verdi!

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
No, try again.
Correct!
[Clerris has given you another clue scroll!/You've obtained a casket!]
translation: [Clerris sana baska bir ipucu parsömeni verdi!/Bir kutu elde ettin!]

english: The mages of Arceuus seek dense essence for their experiments. I see you have [amount] blocks; we require [amount]. Donations will be marked with gratitude.
Your donation has been gratefully recieved.
No, sorry, they can't have it.
We do not require any dense essence from you at present. Thank you for your support.
translation: Su anda sizden yogun öz talep etmiyoruz. Desteginiz icin tesekkür ederiz.

english: Yes
No
Hello there.
What do you want adventurer?
Just passing by.
You have no business here. Leave.... now.
Hello.
You may have won this battle meddler, but the war rages on. Go bother some goblins or something for when Hazeel returns your destruction is assured.
translation: Bu savasi kazanmis olabilirsin müdahaleci, ama savas devam ediyor. Hazeel geri döndügünde yok olacagin kesin, git goblinleri falan rahatsiz et.

english: It is good to see you once more, adventurer. Glory to Hazeel!
translation: Seni tekrar görmek güzel, maceraci. Hazeel'e seref!

english: *snap*
Click!
Click click!
Whirrr!
The little goblin appear to be fast asleep, and yet still fishing...
translation: Kücük goblin derin uykuda gibi görünüyor, ama hala balik tutuyor...

english: I think I'd rather not wake him.
translation: Onu uyandirmasam daha iyi olur sanirim.

english: Zzzzz...
Huh, what? where?
Hello, what are you doing?
Sorry, I don't have time for idle chit-chat, I need to send a fairy to get little Freddiestooth!
translation: Üzgünüm, bos bos sohbet edecek vaktim yok, kücük Freddiestooth'u almak icin bir peri göndermem gerekiyor!

english: Sorry, I don't have time to talk, I need to send a Tooth Fairy to visit Sarah-Jane!
translation: Üzgünüm, konusacak vaktim yok, Sarah-Jane'i ziyaret etmesi icin bir Dis Perisi göndermem gerekiyor!

english: Sorry, I don't have time for idle chit-chat, I need to find a Winter Fairy to send to Trollheim!
translation: Üzgünüm, bos bos sohbet edecek vaktim yok, Trollheim'a göndermek icin bir Kis Perisi bulmam gerekiyor!

english: Sorry, I don't have time to stop, I need to send a Weather Fairy off to Etceteria!
translation: Üzgünüm, durmak icin vaktim yok, Etceteria'ya bir Hava Perisi göndermem gerekiyor!

english: Sorry, I don't have time for idle chit-chat, I need to send an Autumn Fairy off to Burthorpe!
translation: Üzgünüm, bos bos sohbet etmek icin vaktim yok, Burthorpe'a bir Sonbahar Perisi göndermem gerekiyor!

english: Do you know what these strange marks mean?
translation: Bu garip isaretlerin ne anlama geldigini biliyor musun?

english: They look familiar, but I can't think where I've seen marks like that. Try asking around, maybe somebody else will recognise them.
translation: Tanidik geliyorlar ama böyle isaretleri nerede gördügümü hatirlayamiyorum. Etrafta sor, belki baska biri tanir.

english: Welcome to Cobado's Groceries. Feeling hungry?
translation: Cobado'nun Marketine hos geldin. Ac misin?

english: Let's see what you have.
Why do you have an orange on your head?
Why don't you have an orange on your head?
Er... Because it's not an item of clothing?
Not for you perhaps, but it is for me.
translation: Senin icin degil belki, ama benim icin öyle.

english: Right...
So anyway, looking to buy some food.
translation: Neyse, yiyecek bir seyler almak istiyorum.

english: I'm good.
Well come back when you're hungry.
Let's see what you have.
Why do you have an orange on your head?
I'm good.
You know you've got one on your head as well, right? Why have you done it?
Er... I guess it's fun?
Exactly! Now we've cleared that up, looking to buy some food.
Hey, a cockatrice!
[House owner] deaded me! That wasn't very nice!
translation: [Ev sahibi] beni öldürdü! Bu hic hos degildi!

english: You deaded me!
Well, yes.
What did you do that for?
A slayer master told me to.
Why do the slayer masters all pick on poor cockatrice?
translation: Neden avci ustalari zavalli cockatrice'leri hedef aliyor?

english: They pick on lots of other creatures too.
translation: Baska bircok yaratigi da hedef aliyorlar.

english: Then mount one of them on your wall and let poor cockatrice rest in peace!
translation: O zaman onlardan birini duvarina as ve zavalli cockatrice'lerin huzur icinde yatmasina izin ver!

english: So I could mount your head on my wall.
Another cockatrice falls victim to the dreaded mirror shield!
translation: Bir cockatrice daha korkunc ayna kalkaninin kurbani oldu!

english: Don't take it personally! You look good on my wall!
I don't care! I think I looked better with a body!
translation: Umurumda degil! Bence vücudum varken daha yakisiyordum!

english: I just wanted to.
You dirty rotten swine, you!
Steady on...
I will kill you with my paralyzing-type magic eyes look!
translation: Seni felc edici sihirli gözlerimle öldürecegim!

english: Dots appear in air between eyes and victim. Dot! Dot! Dotty!
translation: Gözler ve kurban arasinda havada noktalar belirir. Nokta! Nokta! Noktali!

english: Er, nothing's happening...
Concentrates mental power. Eyes narrow beak clenches veins on head stand out.
translation: Zihinsel gücünü toplar. Gözleri kisilir, gagasi sikilir, kafasindaki damarlar belirginlesir.

english: Strain!
You're dead, cockatrice. Your eyes are glass beads. It won't work.
translation: Sen öldün, cockatrice. Gözlerin cam boncuk gibi. Ise yaramayacak.

english: STRA-A-AIN!
I think I'll leave you to it.
A slayer master told me to
translation: Bir avci ustasi bana öyle söyledi.

english: So I could mount your head on my wall
I just wanted to
Who goes there? Friend or foe?
translation: Orada kim var? Dost mu düsman mi?

english: Friend.
Ok good to hear it.
Foe!
Oh righty...
Why is this town so heavily defended?
translation: Bu kasaba neden bu kadar siki savunuluyor?

english: Yanille is on the southwest border of Kandarin, Beyond here you go into the Feldip hills which is major Ogre territory. Our job is to defend Yanille from the ogres.
translation: Yanille, Kandarin'in güneybati sinirinda yer aliyor. Buradan sonra, ogrelerin ana bölgesi olan Feldip tepelerine giriyorsunuz. Bizim görevimiz, Yanille'i ogrelerden korumak.

english: Friend
Foe!
Why is this town so heavily defended?
translation: Bu kasaba neden bu kadar siki savunuluyor?

english: Hello?
Sorry soldier, you don't have permission to speak with me yet. Go and talk to the Captain.
translation: Üzgünüm asker, henüz benimle konusma iznin yok. Gidip kaptanla konus.

english: I believe you might be able to reward me for my progress in this arena?
translation: Bu arenadaki ilerlemem icin bana ödül verebilir misiniz?

english: Well, that depends upon your skill levels for each role.
translation: Bu, her rol icin beceri seviyenize bagli.

english: What's your name, soldier?
[player name], Sir!
Okay. What exactly do you want to know, [player name]?
translation: Tamam. Tam olarak ne bilmek istiyorsun, Maceraci?

english: Can I trade some of my points?
translation: Puanlarimin bir kismini takas edebilir miyim?

english: Of course.
What points do I have so far, sir?
translation: Su ana kadar kac puanim var, efendim?

english: Let me check...
You have absolutely no points, whatsoever. Best you get back into that arena!
translation: Hic puaniniz yok. En iyisi arenaya geri dönün!

english: You have: [amount] Attacker Honour Points, [amount] Defender Honour Points, [amount] Collector Honour Points and [amount] Healer Honour Points.
Could I have a Queen Help book?
You already have one!
Oh yes, sorry.
Oh, no. Wait, I don't have enough space to carry one.
translation: Ah, hayir. Bekle, tasimak icin yeterli yerim yok.

english: Well, you can come back and get one at any time from me.
translation: Peki, istedigin zaman geri gelip benden alabilirsin.

english: By all means.
Could I have my current wave reset to one?
translation: Su anki dalgami bir olarak sifirlayabilir misin?

english: You do realise that you're already on wave one?
translation: Zaten birinci dalgada oldugunu farkindasin, degil mi?

english: Ah. Yes. Sorry about that.
That is all, sir.
Very well, on your way.
Gamble, you say! Let me take something from my big bag of prizes!
translation: Kumar mi dedin? Büyük ödül cantamdan bir sey alayim!

english: Lucky dip, you say! Let me take something from my big bag of prizes!
translation: Sansli cekilis mi dedin? Büyük ödül cantamdan bir sey alayim!

english: Let's see...
Got something!
You've won...
Okay, here we go...
I've got my hand on something!
Hmmm, not bad, it's...
What can I find?
Ah, found something!
You've got...
Can I trade some of my points?
translation: Puanlarimin bir kismini takas edebilir miyim?

english: What points do I have so far, sir?
translation: Su ana kadar kac puanim var, efendim?

english: Could I have a 'Queen Help' book?
Could I have my current wave reset to one?
translation: Su anki dalga sayimi sifirlanabilir mi?

english: That is all, sir.
Hello.
Good day.
Who are you?
I'm Commander Lydia Fullore, leader of the Kourend Royal Guard.
translation: Ben Komutan Lydia Fullore, Kourend Kraliyet Muhafizlari'nin lideriyim.

english: What do you do here?
The Kourend Royal Guard protect and serve the ruler of Kourend. As their leader, I am responsible for ensuring that the Royal Guard are well trained and well supplied.
translation: Kourend Kraliyet Muhafizlari, Kourend hükümdarini korur ve ona hizmet eder. Liderleri olarak, Kraliyet Muhafizlari'nin iyi egitilmis ve iyi donanimli olmasini saglamak benim sorumlulugumdur.

english: Are the Royal Guard part of the Shayzien Army?
translation: Kraliyet Muhafizlari Shayzien Ordusu'nun bir parcasi mi?

english: No. Unlike the Shayzien Army, the Royal Guard serve the ruler of the kingdom directly.
translation: Hayir. Shayzien Ordusu'nun aksine, Kraliyet Muhafizlari dogrudan kralligin hükümdarina hizmet eder.

english: The Royal Guard was established by King Byrne I. He felt that it was dangerous for Shayzien House to control the only military in the kingdom, so he decided to establish a small one of his own.
translation: Kraliyet Muhafizlari, Kral Byrne I tarafindan kuruldu. Shayzien Hanesi'nin kralligin tek ordusunu kontrol etmesinin tehlikeli oldugunu düsünen kral, kendi kücük ordusunu kurmaya karar verdi.

english: Ever since then, the Royal Guard have served Kourend's ruler.
translation: O zamandan beri Kraliyet Muhafizlari, Kourend'in hükümdarina hizmet etmektedir.

english: Who's the current ruler of Kourend?
The current ruler, or rulers as I should say, are the Kourend Council. They've ruled the kingdom for the past twenty years, ever since the last King died.
translation: Su anki hükümdar, ya da hükümdarlar demeliyim, Kourend Konseyi'dir. Son kralin ölümünden bu yana, son yirmi yildir kralligi yönetmektedirler.

english: Goodbye.
Hey. I have something for you.
Hey Lydia. How are things here?
It's still early days for King Artur. He was raised to rule, but he lacks the experience his father had. Still, he can't be any worse than the Council.
translation: Kral Artur icin henüz erken. Hükümdar olmak icin yetistirildi, ama babasinin sahip oldugu deneyimden yoksun. Yine de, Konsey'den daha kötü olamaz.

english: Any news on Xamphur or the killer?
translation: Xamphur veya katil hakkinda bir haber var mi?

english: Nothing yet. For all we know, they could be one and the same. Lord Arceuus is doing everything he can to learn more about Xamphur, and the Lovakengj smiths are inspecting the murder weapon.
translation: Henüz yok. Bildigimiz kadariyla, ikisi ayni kisi olabilir. Lord Arceuus, Xamphur hakkinda daha fazla bilgi edinmek icin elinden geleni yapiyor ve Lovakengj demircileri cinayet silahini inceliyor.

english: I'll let you know once we have something on either of them.
translation: Onlar hakkinda bir sey ögrenir ögrenmez sana haber veririm.

english: Thank you. I'll let you get on with your work.
Good luck out there. Don't be a stranger.
Who are you?
What do you do here?
Are the Royal Guard part of the Shayzien Army?
translation: Kraliyet Muhafizlari Shayzien Ordusu'nun bir parcasi mi?

english: Who's the current ruler of Kourend?
Goodbye.
Hello.
I can't talk now. Can't you see we're trying to win a battle here? If we can't hold back Khazard's men we're all doomed.
translation: Su anda konusamam. Burada bir savasi kazanmaya calistigimizi görmüyor musun? Khazard'in adamlarini durduramazsak hepimiz mahvoluruz.

english: Hello traveller, are you here to help or just to watch?
translation: Merhaba gezgin, yardim etmeye mi geldin yoksa sadece izlemeye mi?

english: I've been sent by King Bolren to retrieve the orb of protection.
translation: Kral Bolren tarafindan koruma küresini geri getirmek icin gönderildim.

english: Excellent we need all the help we can get.
translation: Harika, alabilecegimiz tüm yardima ihtiyacimiz var.

english: I'm commander Montai. The orb is in the Khazard stronghold to the north, but until we weaken their defences we can't get close.
translation: Ben Komutan Montai. Küre kuzeydeki Khazard kalesinde, ama savunmalarini zayiflatmadan yaklasamayiz.

english: What can I do?
Firstly we need to strengthen our own defences. We desperately need wood to make more battlements, once the battlements are gone it's all over. Six loads of normal logs should do it.
translation: Öncelikle kendi savunmamizi güclendirmeliyiz. Daha fazla siper yapmak icin acilen tahtaya ihtiyacimiz var, siperler yok olursa her sey biter. Alti yük normal kütük yeterli olur.

english: Ok, I'll gather some wood.
Please be as quick as you can, I don't know how much longer we can hold out.
translation: Lütfen olabildigince cabuk ol, daha ne kadar dayanabilecegimizi bilmiyorum.

english: Sorry I no longer want to be involved.
translation: Üzgünüm, artik bu ise karismak istemiyorum.

english: That's a shame, we could have done with your help.
translation: Cok yazik, yardimin cok isimize yarardi.

english: Hello again, we're still desperate for wood soldier. We need six loads of normal logs.
translation: Merhaba tekrar, hala oduna ihtiyacimiz var asker. Alti yük normal odun lazim.

english: I'll see what I can do.
Thank you.
Hello again, we're still desperate for wood soldier.
translation: Merhaba tekrar, hala oduna ihtiyacimiz var asker.

english: I have some here.(You give six loads of logs to the commander.)
translation: Burada biraz var. (Komutana alti yük odun veriyorsun.)

english: That's excellent, now we can make more defensive battlements. Give me a moment to organise the troops and then come speak to me. I'll inform you of our next phase of attack.
translation: Harika, artik daha fazla savunma siperi yapabiliriz. Askerleri organize etmek icin bana biraz zaman ver, sonra gel konusalim. Sana saldirinin bir sonraki asamasini anlatacagim.

english: How are you doing Montai?
We're hanging in there soldier. For the next phase of our attack we need to breach their stronghold.
translation: Dayaniyoruz asker. Saldirimizin bir sonraki asamasi icin onlarin kalesini ele gecirmemiz gerekiyor.

english: The ballista can break through the stronghold wall, and then we can advance and seize back the orb.
translation: Balista kale duvarini yikabilir, sonra ilerleyip küreyi geri alabiliriz.

english: So what's the problem?
From this distance we can't get an accurate enough shot. We need the correct coordinates of the stronghold for a direct hit. I've sent out three tracker gnomes to gather them.
translation: Bu mesafeden yeterince isabetli atis yapamiyoruz. Dogrudan isabet icin kalenin dogru koordinatlarina ihtiyacimiz var. Onlari toplamak icin üc izci cüce gönderdim.

english: Have they returned?
I'm afraid not, and we're running out of time. I need you to go into the heart of the battlefield, find the trackers, and bring back the coordinates.
translation: Maalesef hayir, ve zamanimiz azaliyor. Savas alaninin kalbine gidip iz sürücüleri bulman ve koordinatlari geri getirmen gerekiyor.

english: Do you think you can do it?
No, I've had enough of your battle.
I understand, this isn't your fight.
I'll try my best.
Thank you, you're braver than most.
I don't know how long I will be able to hold out. Once you have the coordinates come back and fire the ballista right into those monsters.
translation: Ne kadar dayanabilecegimi bilmiyorum. Koordinatlari aldiginda geri dön ve balistayi o canavarlara atesle.

english: If you can retrieve the orb and bring safety back to my people, none of the blood spilled on this field will be in vain.
translation: Eger küreyi geri alip halkimi güvene kavusturabilirsen, bu alanda dökülen kanlar bosuna gitmemis olacak.

english: Hello warrior. We need the coordinates for a direct hit from the ballista. Once you have a direct hit you will be able to enter the stronghold and retrieve the orb.
translation: Merhaba savasci. Balistadan dogrudan isabet ettirmek icin koordinatlara ihtiyacimiz var. Dogrudan isabet ettirdiginde kaleye girip küreyi geri alabileceksin.

english: I've breached the stronghold.
I saw, that was a beautiful sight. The Khazard troops didn't know what hit them.
translation: Gördüm, cok güzel bir manzaraydi. Khazard askerleri neye ugradiklarini anlamadilar.

english: Now is the time to retrieve the orb. It's all in your hands. I'll be praying for you.
translation: Simdi küreyi geri alma zamani. Her sey senin elinde. Senin icin dua edecegim.

english: I have the orb of protection.
Incredible, for a human you really are something.
translation: Inanilmaz, bir insan icin gercekten harikasin.

english: Thanks... I think!
I'll stay here with my troops and try and hold Khazard's men back. You return the orb to the gnome village. Go as quick as you can, the village is still unprotected.
translation: Ben askerlerimle burada kalip Khazard'in adamlarini geri püskürtmeye calisacagim. Sen küreyi cüce köyüne geri götür. Mümkün oldugunca cabuk git, köy hala korumasiz.

english: Hello Montai, how are you?
I'm ok, this battle is going to take longer to win than I expected. The Khazard troops won't give up even without the orb.
translation: Iyiyim, bu savasi kazanmak bekledigimden daha uzun sürecek. Khazard'in askerleri küre olmasa bile pes etmeyecekler.

english: Hang in there.
Ok, I'll gather some wood.
Sorry, I no longer want to be involved.
translation: Üzgünüm, artik bu ise karismak istemiyorum.

english: No, I've had enough of your battle.
I'll try my best.
Greetings, Zilyana.
Commander, if you don't mind.
I don't, Zilyana.
Bah, find me some more cake. oh and FIND THE GODSWORD!
translation: Bah, bana biraz daha pasta bul. Oh, ve TANRI KILICINI BUL!

english: I'll err... get some more cake alright?
translation: Ben... biraz daha pasta getireyim, tamam mi?

english: All praise Saradomin!
Slay the evil ones!
Death to the enemies of the light!
Saradomin lend me strength!
Saradomin is with us!
Forward! Our allies are with us!
Good will always triumph!
May Saradomin be my sword!
In the name of Saradomin!
Attack! Find the Godsword!
Hello there.
Good day to you.
Who are you?
I'm Commissioner Anwar. I'm in charge of the Shayzien Constabulary. With Lord Shayzien currently busy with the war efforts, I'm also assisting him with his duties here in the city.
translation: Ben Komiser Anwar. Shayzien Polisi'nden sorumluyum. Lord Shayzien su anda savasla mesgul oldugu icin, ben de sehirdeki görevlerinde ona yardim ediyorum.

english: What's the Shayzien Constabulary?

The Shayzien Army is split into six regiments plus the Shayzien Constabulary. While the six regiments are jointly responsible for protecting Kourend from external threats, we deal with issues closer to home.
translation: Shayzien Ordusu alti alay ve Shayzien Jandarma Teskilati olmak üzere alti bölüme ayrilmistir. Alti alay, Kourend'i dis tehditlerden korumakla ortaklasa sorumluyken, biz daha yakin meselelerle ilgileniyoruz.

english: What are the six regiments?

The Intelligence Corps, the Medical Corps, the Engineering Corps, the Logistics Corps, the Rangers and of course, the Infantry. Each regiment is led by a general who reports directly to Lord Shayzien.
translation: Istihbarat Birligi, Saglik Birligi, Mühendislik Birligi, Lojistik Birligi, Komandolar ve tabii ki Piyade. Her alay, Lord Shayzien'e dogrudan rapor veren bir general tarafindan yönetilir.

english: It feels like there must be a bit of overlap between the Constabulary and the regiments, especially the Intelligence Corps.
translation: Polis Teskilati ile alaylar arasinda, özellikle Istihbarat Birligi ile, biraz cakisma olmasi gerektigini hissediyorum.

english: On paper we're totally separate from the regiments. However, in reality you are correct. The distinction between internal and external threats grows murkier by the day.
translation: Kagit üzerinde alaylardan tamamen ayri durumdayiz. Ancak gercekte haklisiniz. Ic ve dis tehditler arasindaki ayrim her gecen gün daha da belirsiz hale geliyor.

english: More and more we find ourselves working alongside the Intelligence Corps and the other regiments. In particular, they've been supporting us in combating the rising gang threat in Port Piscarilius.
translation: Giderek daha fazla istihbarat birimi ve diger alaylarla birlikte calisiyoruz. Özellikle, Port Piscarilius'ta artan cete tehdidiyle mücadelede bize destek oluyorlar.

english: What is this place?
This is the Shayzien Administration. The city of Shayzien is run from here.
translation: Burasi Shayzien Idaresi. Shayzien sehri buradan yönetiliyor.

english: It seems very quiet.
A lot of focus right now is on the war with the lizardmen. Most senior members of the Shayzien Army, including Lord Shayzien himself, are working out of the Shayzien Encampment instead.
translation: Su anda dikkatler büyük ölcüde kertenkele adamlarla olan savasa odaklanmis durumda. Lord Shayzien de dahil olmak üzere Shayzien Ordusu'nun cogu üst düzey üyesi, Shayzien Kampi'nda calisiyor.

english: So the Shayzien Army are also responsible for running the city?
translation: Yani Shayzien Ordusu da sehrin yönetiminden sorumlu mu?

english: Indeed. There's more of a separation between the city of Shayzien and the Shayzien Army now than there used to be, but this will likely always be a military settlement.
translation: Evet. Shayzien sehri ile Shayzien Ordusu arasinda eskisine göre daha fazla ayrim var, ama burasi muhtemelen her zaman askeri bir yerlesim yeri olarak kalacak.

english: See you later.
Who are you?
What's the Shayzien Constabulary?
What is this place?
See you later.
Hello there, would you like to take part in the archery competition? It only costs 200 coins to enter.
translation: Merhaba, okculuk yarismasina katilmak ister misin? Katilim ücreti sadece 200 sikke.

english: Sure, I'll give it a go.
Great! That will be 200 coins then please.
Oops, I don't have enough coins on me...
Never mind, come back when you've got enough.
translation: Önemli degil, yeterince sikke oldugunda tekrar gel.

english: You pay the judge and he gives you 10 bronze arrows.
translation: Hakeme ödeme yaparsan sana 10 bronz ok verir.

english: What are the rules?
The rules are very simple:
You're given 10 shots at the targets, for each hit you will receive points. At the end you'll be awarded 1 ticket for every 10 points.
translation: Hedeflere 10 atis hakkin var, her isabet icin puan alacaksin. Sonunda her 10 puan icin 1 bilet kazanacaksin.

english: The tickets can be exchanged for goods from our stores. Do you want to give it a go? Only 200 coins.
translation: Biletleri magazalarimizdan ürünlerle takas edebilirsin. Denemek ister misin? Sadece 200 jeton.

english: No thanks.
Hello again, do you need reminding of the rules?
Yes please.
The tickets can be exchanged for goods from our stores. Good luck!
translation: Biletler magazalarimizdaki ürünlerle takas edilebilir. Iyi sanslar!

english: No thanks, I've got it.
Glad to hear it, good luck!
How am I doing so far?
So far your score is: 0. You haven't started yet.
translation: Su ana kadar puaniniz: 0. Henüz baslamadiniz.

english: So far your score is: [number]. Not bad, keep going.
So far your score is: [number]. You're pretty good, keep it up.
Well done. Your score is: [number]. For that score you will receive [number] Archery tickets. Would you like to try again for another 200 coins?
I haven't got the money.
Sure, I'll give it a go.
What are the rules?
No thanks.
Yes please.
No thanks, I've got it.
How am I doing so far?
Hey there. Looking to buy or sell some jewellery?
translation: Merhaba. Mücevher alip satmak mi istiyorsunuz?

english: Sure.
Good choice.
No thanks.
Well come back if you change your mind.
Sure.
No thanks.
Excuse me, you don't look very happy. What's wrong?
translation: Affedersiniz, pek mutlu görünmüyorsunuz. Sorun ne?

english: There's an egg-shaped hole in my life.
translation: Hayatimda yumurta seklinde bir bosluk var.

english: What do you mean?
Usually Varrock is full of Easter merriment by now...
translation: Genelde bu zamanlar Varrock Paskalya nesesiyle doludur...

english: Wagons heaving with eggs being hauled up through the streets...
Giant rabbits hopping about, building stalls and putting up decorations...
translation: Dev tavsanlar ziplar, tezgahlar kurar ve süslemeler yapar...

english: That sounds nice.
It was a bloody racket to be honest, and dangerous!
translation: Dürüst olmak gerekirse, cok gürültülü ve tehlikeliydi!

english: But I'd gladly stand on a rusty nail or take a plank to the face for one of them delicious chocolate eggs.
translation: Ama o lezzetli cikolata yumurtalardan biri icin pasli bir civiye basmaktan veya yüzüme bir tahta parcasi yemekten memnuniyetle vazgecerdim.

english: Fair enough. Now that you mention it, I would have expected the Easter Bunny to have turned up by now. You're sure you haven't seen him?
translation: Haklisin. Simdi sen söyleyince, Paskalya Tavsani'nin simdiye kadar gelmis olmasini beklerdim. Onu görmedigine emin misin?

english: Nobody has, and yet the streets are full of old carrots. We don't usually have such a problem with vegetable waste unless him and his lot have turned up.
translation: Kimse görmedi, ama sokaklar eski havuclarla dolu. O ve arkadaslari gelmedikce, genellikle sebze atiklariyla ilgili böyle bir sorun yasamayiz.

english: Vegetable waste, eh?
Aye. It wasn't so bad when it was just the crates lying around, but someone's been in them and scattered carrots all over the place.
translation: Evet. Sadece kasalar ortalikta dururken o kadar da kötü degildi, ama biri kasalarin icine girip havuclari her yere sacmis.

english: Curious... I wonder...
It's not just Varrock mind, it's the woods to the south of here too!
translation: Sadece Varrock degil, buradan güneydeki ormanlar da öyle!

english: Hmmmmmmm.......
Crates of carrots you say? Woods to the south?
translation: Havuc kasalari mi dedin? Güneydeki ormanlar mi?

english: Aye, proper suspicious if you ask me.
You wait right here sir, I've got a hunch...
translation: Burada bekleyin efendim, bir önsezim var...

english: Oh lunch is it now eh? Can I have some?
translation: Ögle yemegi vakti mi geldi? Bana da biraz verir misin?

english: No, a hunch. About the carrots.
They're old and dirty, I don't want to eat those!
translation: Eskiler ve kirli, onlari yemek istemiyorum!

english: No... Just... I'll be back later! I need to investigate some rotten vegetables.
translation: Hayir... Sadece... Sonra dönerim! Cürümüs sebzeleri incelemem lazim.

english: They best not end up in my lunch!
You should probably have a look around for a suspicious crate of carrots.
translation: Süpheli bir havuc kasasi olup olmadigina bir bakmalisin.

english: Wait, what was I thinking about? Oh nevermind, it's gone. Can't have been that important I suppose.
translation: Bekle, ne düsünüyordum ben? Bos ver, unuttum. O kadar önemli bir sey degildi herhalde.

english: *sigh*
Fetch me lunch for me then eh, I'm right peckish!
translation: O zaman bana ögle yemegi getir, cok aciktim!

english: I'm a bit busy at the moment.
Busy mucking about with carrots!
Yeah, where did you say that crate was again?
It's in the woods just south of here. Carrots all over the place too!
translation: Buranin güneyindeki ormanda. Her yer havuclarla dolu!

english: Oh yes, I remember. Thanks.
Mate, it took you so long to get me lunch the Easter Bunny showed up, I had some choccy eggs instead.
translation: Dostum, ögle yemegimi getirmene o kadar uzun sürdü ki Paskalya Tavsani geldi, onun yerine cikolatali yumurtalar yedim.

english: Great. That was all me you know.
translation: Harika. O benim sayemde oldu, biliyorsun.

english: What are you talking about? It was definitely the Easter Bunny.
You know what?
I'm still too busy to talk to you.
Alright, cheerio!
Yes.
No.
Hello.
Welcome, traveller.
Could you tell me about crystal singing?
translation: Bana kristal sarki söyleme hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Of course! We elves learned the art long ago, allowing us to form crystals in any way we would like, using just our voices.
translation: Tabii ki! Biz elfler bu sanati uzun zaman önce ögrendik, sadece sesimizi kullanarak istedigimiz sekilde kristaller olusturabiliyoruz.

english: It's allowed us to make weapons, armour and tools using the finest crystals.
translation: Bu sayede en kaliteli kristallerden silahlar, zirhlar ve aletler yapabiliyoruz.

english: Wow. Is there any way I could do it?
translation: Vay canina. Ben de yapabilir miyim?

english: You might be able to with the help of the crystal bowl over there. As long as you've got the right knowledge of what you're trying to craft.
translation: Suradaki kristal kase yardimiyla yapabilirsin. Ne yapmaya calistigini dogru bir sekilde biliyorsan tabii.

english: Could you do it for me?
Thanks!
Could you sing a song for me?
translation: Benim icin bir sarki söyler misin?

english: Of course! Would you like me to craft something for you? For some crystal shards, of course.
translation: Tabii ki! Senin icin bir sey yapmami ister misin? Tabii ki kristal parcalari karsiliginda.

english: Yes please.
No, thank you. I'd just like to hear you sing.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler. Sadece sarki söylemeni dinlemek istiyorum.

english: Conwenna sings you a beautiful song of the elves.
translation: Conwenna sana elflerin güzel bir sarkisini söyler.

english: Wow! Thank you.
You do not have all of the required materials and requirements to make anything.
translation: Bir sey yapmak icin gerekli tüm malzemelere ve kosullara sahip degilsin.

english: Could you tell me about crystal singing?
translation: Bana kristal sarki söyleme hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Could you do it for me?
Thanks!
Could you sing a song for me?
translation: Benim icin bir sarki söyler misin?

english: Yes please.
No, thank you. I'd just like to hear you sing.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler. Sadece sarki söylemeni dinlemek istiyorum.

english: What do you want? I'm busy!
Can you sell me any food?
I suppose I could sell you some cabbage, if you're willing to pay for it. Cabbage is good for you.
translation: Eger parasini ödersen sana lahana satabilirim. Lahana sagliga iyi gelir.

english: Oh, I haven't got any money.
Why are you asking me to sell you food if you haven't got any money? Go away!
translation: Paran yoksa neden benden yiyecek satmami istiyorsun? Git buradan!

english: Oh, I haven't got enough space to carry it.
translation: Oh, tasimak icin yeterli yerim yok.

english: Why are you asking me to sell you food if you can't carry it? Go away!
translation: Tasiyamayacaksan neden benden yiyecek satmami istiyorsun? Git buradan!

english: Alright, I'll buy a cabbage.
It's a deal. Now, make sure you eat it all up. Cabbage is good for you.
translation: Anlastik. Simdi, hepsini yediginden emin ol. Lahana sana iyi gelir.

english: No thanks, I don't like cabbage.
Bah! People these days only appreciate junk food.
translation: Bah! Bu günlerde insanlar sadece abur cubur seviyor.

english: Can you give me any free food?
Can you give me any free money?
Why should I give you free money?
Why should I give you free food?
Oh, forget it.
I don't want anything from this horrible kitchen.
translation: Bu berbat mutfaktan hicbir sey istemiyorum.

english: How dare you? I put a lot of effort into cleaning this kitchen. My daily sweat and elbow-grease keep this kitchen clean!
translation: Bu ne cüret? Bu mutfagi temizlemek icin cok ugrastim. Her gün ter döküp emek harcayarak bu mutfagi temiz tutuyorum!

english: Ewww!
Oh, just leave me alone.
Very well done, take this.
Can you sell me any food?
translation: Bana yiyecek bir sey satabilir misin?

english: Alright, I'll buy a cabbage.
No thanks, I don't like cabbage.
Can you give me any free food?
I don't want anything from this horrible kitchen.
translation: Bu berbat mutfaktan hicbir sey istemiyorum.

english: Hello...
I distinctly remember you saying you were going to stop talking to me. Yet here you are again, yakking on and on in my earhole when I'm trying to cook! What do you want now?
translation: Bana konusmayacagini söyledigini cok iyi hatirliyorum. Yine de, ben yemek pisirmeye calisirken kulak deligime durmadan konusuyorsun! Simdi ne istiyorsun?

english: Can you cook me something?
What? No! Go away.
Well, you're meant to be a cook. Why can't you cook something for me?
translation: Sen asci olmalisin. Neden bana bir seyler pisiremiyorsun?

english: I don't want to, that's why! Now, leave me alone.
translation: Istemiyorum, o yüzden! Simdi beni rahat birak.

english: You're not a very nice man.
translation: Sen pek iyi bir adam degilsin.

english: Yet you keep talking to me!
translation: Yine de benimle konusmaya devam ediyorsun!

english: Good point. I should stop that.
Yes, do us both a favour.
translation: Evet, ikimize de bir iyilik yap.

english: Why do you work here?
Why do you think I work in a disreputable inn filled with rough scoundrels on the very edge of the Wilderness? I work here because I need the job!
translation: Sence neden Wildernessnin kenarinda, kaba saba haydutlarla dolu, itibarsiz bir hanin calisiyorum? Burada calisiyorum cünkü ise ihtiyacim var!

english: Do you like it?
Like it? It's sucked the warmth and humanity out of me, and I've become a hollow shell holding nothing but anger, misery and gourmet recipes.
translation: Hosuma gitmek mi? Benden sicakligimi ve insanligimi emdi ve ben sadece öfke, sefalet ve gurme tariflerinden ibaret bos bir kabuk haline geldim.

english: Oh.
What did you expect to hear? I suppose you expected me to tell you an inspiring story about how working here can teach you to find hope in the darkest places, or how to see the best in everything?
translation: Ne duymayi bekliyordun? Sanirim burada calismanin en karanlik yerlerde bile umut bulmayi ögrettigini veya her seyin en iyi yanini görmeyi ögrettigini anlatan ilham verici bir hikaye anlatmami bekliyordun?

english: Maybe you should think about moving to a different inn.
translation: Belki de baska bir hana tasinmayi düsünmelisin.

english: Bah! I'm not letting it defeat me. Now, let me concentrate on my cooking.
translation: Bah! Bunun beni yenmesine izin vermeyecegim. Simdi, yemek pisirmeye konsantre olmama izin ver.

english: Okay.
Can you tell me any good jokes?
translation: Bana iyi bir fikra anlatabilir misin?

english: Ohhh, if you insist...
What did the half-wit say to the cook?
I don't know.
[He/She] said 'Can you tell me any good jokes?' Got ya! Hahahaha!
translation: o “Bana iyi bir fikra anlatabilir misin?” dedi. Yakaladim! Hahahaha!

english: Whatever.
Can you cook me something?
Why do you work here?
Can you tell me any good jokes?
translation: Bana iyi bir fikra anlatir misin?

english: What am I to do?
What's wrong?
Oh dear, oh dear, oh dear, I'm in a terrible terrible mess! It's the Duke's birthday today, and I should be making him a lovely big birthday cake.
translation: Oh hayir, oh hayir, oh hayir, basim büyük belada! Bugün Dük'ün dogum günü ve ona güzel bir dogum günü pastasi yapmam gerekiyor.

english: I've forgotten to buy the ingredients. I'll never get them in time now. He'll sack me! What will I do? I have four children and a goat to look after. Would you help me? Please?
translation: Malzemeleri almayi unutmusum. Artik zamaninda yetisemeyecegim. Beni kovacak! Ne yapacagim? Bakmam gereken dört cocugum ve bir kecim var. Bana yardim eder misin? Lütfen?

english: Yes, I'll help you.
Oh thank you, thank you. I need milk, an egg and flour. I'd be very grateful if you can get them for me.
translation: Oh tesekkürler, tesekkürler. Süt, yumurta ve un lazim. Bunlari benim icin alirsan cok minnettar olurum.

english: I have all of those ingredients on me already!
translation: Bu malzemelerin hepsi bende var zaten!

english: That's an odd coincidence... Were you planning on making a cake too?
translation: Ne garip bir tesadüf... Sen de pasta mi yapacaktin?

english: Not exactly. I just had an odd feeling you might be needing these ingredients. If I see a cook, I presume there's food of some kind! Lucky guess I suppose.
translation: Tam olarak degil. Sadece bu malzemelere ihtiyacin olabilecegini hissettim. Bir asci görürsem, bir cesit yemek oldugunu varsayarim! Sanirim sansli bir tahmin.

english: Well thank you! Hand them over, please.
You've brought me everything I need! I am saved! Thank you!
translation: Ihtiyacim olan her seyi getirmissin! Kurtuldum! Tesekkürler!

english: So do I get to go to the Duke's Party?
I'm afraid not, only the big cheeses get to dine with the Duke.
translation: Korkarim ki hayir, sadece önemli kisiler Dük ile yemek yiyebilir.

english: Well, maybe one day I'll be important enough to sit on the Duke's table.
translation: Belki bir gün Dük'ün masasina oturacak kadar önemli biri olurum.

english: Maybe, but I won't be holding my breath.
translation: Belki, ama ben olsam cok umutlanmazdim.

english: So where do I find these ingredients then?
There is a Mill fairly close, go North and then West. Mill Lane Mill is just off the road to Draynor. I usually get my flour from there.
translation: Yakinlarda bir degirmen var, kuzeye ve sonra batiya git. Mill Lane Mill, Draynor yolunun hemen yaninda. Unumu genellikle oradan alirim.

english: Talk to Millie, she'll help, she's a lovely girl and a fine Miller. Make sure you take a pot with you for the flour though, you've got one on you already.
translation: Millie ile konus, sana yardim eder, cok sevimli bir kiz ve iyi bir degirmenci. Un icin bir kap götürmeyi unutma, yaninda zaten bir tane var.

english: Talk to Millie, she'll help, she's a lovely girl and a fine Miller. Make sure you take a pot with you for the flour though, there should be one on the table in here.
translation: Millie ile konus, sana yardim eder, cok sevimli bir kiz ve iyi bir degirmenci. Un icin bir kap götürmeyi unutma, burada masada bir tane olmali.

english: There is a cattle field on the other side of the river, just across the road from the Groats' Farm.
translation: Nehrin diger tarafinda, Groats Ciftligi'nin karsisindaki yolda bir sigir otlagi var.

english: Talk to Gillie Groats, she looks after the Dairy cows - she'll tell you everything you need to know about milking cows!
translation: Gillie Groats ile konus, o süt ineklerine bakiyor, sana inek sagmakla ilgili bilmen gereken her seyi anlatacaktir!

english: You'll need an empty bucket for the milk itself. I do see you've got a bucket with you already luckily!
translation: Süt icin bos bir kovaya ihtiyacin olacak. Neyse ki yaninda bir kova var!

english: You'll need an empty bucket for the milk itself. The general store just north of the castle will sell you one for a couple of coins.
translation: Süt icin bos bir kovaya ihtiyacin olacak. Kalenin hemen kuzeyindeki genel magazadan birkac sikke karsiliginda bir tane satin alabilirsin.

english: I normally get my eggs from the Groats' farm, on the other side of the river.
translation: Yumurtalari genellikle nehrin diger tarafindaki Groats Ciftligi'nden alirim.

english: But any chicken should lay eggs.
translation: Ama herhangi bir tavuk yumurta yumurtlayabilir.

english: I've got all the information I need. Thanks.
translation: Ihtiyacim olan tüm bilgileri aldim. Tesekkürler.

english: Actually, I know where to find this stuff.
translation: Aslinda, bu malzemeleri nerede bulabilecegimi biliyorum.

english: No, I don't feel like it. Maybe later.
Fine. I always knew you Adventurer types were callous beasts. Go on your merry way!
translation: Peki. Maceraci tiplerin kalpsiz canavarlar oldugunu hep biliyordum. Keyfine bak!

english: You're a cook, why don't you bake me a cake?
translation: Sen ascisin, neden bana pasta yapmiyorsun?

english: *sniff* Don't talk to me about cakes...
You don't look very happy.
No, I'm not. The world is caving in around me - I am overcome by dark feelings of impending doom.
translation: Hayir, mutlu degilim. Dünya basima yikiliyor - yaklasan kiyametin karanlik duygulari beni ele geciriyor.

english: I'd take the rest of the day off if I were you.
translation: Senin yerinde olsam günün geri kalaninda izin alirdim.

english: No, that's the worst thing I could do. I'd get in terrible trouble.
translation: Hayir, bu yapabilecegim en kötü sey olur. Basim büyük belaya girer.

english: Well maybe you need to take a holiday...
That would be nice, but the Duke doesn't allow holidays for core staff.
translation: Bu güzel olurdu, ama Dük cekirdek kadroya tatil izni vermiyor.

english: Hmm, why not run away to the sea and start a new life as a Pirate?
translation: Hmm, neden denize kacip korsan olarak yeni bir hayata baslamiyorsun?

english: My wife gets sea sick, and I have an irrational fear of eyepatches. I don't see it working myself.
translation: Karim deniz tutar ve ben göz bandindan irrasyonel bir korku duyuyorum. Benim icin ise yarayacagini sanmiyorum.

english: I'm afraid I've run out of ideas.
I know I'm doomed.
Nice hat!
Err thank you. It's a pretty ordinary cooks hat really.
translation: Tesekkürler. Aslinda oldukca siradan bir asci sapkasi.

english: Still, suits you. The trousers are pretty special too.
translation: Yine de sana yakisiyor. Pantolon da oldukca özel.

english: Its all standard cook's issue uniform...
The whole hat, apron, stripey trousers ensemble - it works. It make you lookslike a real cook.
translation: Sapka, önlük, cizgili pantolon kombinasyonu cok yakismis. Seni gercek bir asci gibi gösteriyor.

english: I am a real cook! I haven't got time to be chatting about Culinary Fashion. I am in desperate need of help!
translation: Ben gercek bir asciyim! Ascilik modasi hakkinda sohbet edecek vaktim yok. Acil yardima ihtiyacim var!

english: How are you getting on with finding the ingredients?
I haven't got any of them yet, I'm still looking.
Please get the ingredients quickly. I'm running out of time! The Duke will throw me into the streets!
translation: Lütfen malzemeleri cabuk bul. Zamanim azaliyor! Dük beni sokaga atacak!

english: I'll get right on it.
Here's a bucket of milk.
Here's a pot of flour.
Here's a fresh egg.
Thanks for the ingredients you have got so far. Please get the rest quickly - I'm running out of time! The Duke will throw me into the streets!
translation: Simdiye kadar buldugun malzemeler icin tesekkürler. Lütfen geri kalanini da cabuk bul - zamanim azaliyor! Dük beni sokaga atacak!

english: How is the adventuring going, my friend?
I don't have anything for you to do right now, sorry.
translation: Su anda sana verecek bir isim yok, üzgünüm.

english: I am getting strong and mighty. Grrr
Glad to hear it.
I keep on dying.
Ah well, at least you keep coming back to life!
Can I use your range?
Go ahead - it's a very good range. It's easier to use than most other ranges.
translation: Tabii, kullanabilirsin. Cok iyi bir ocak. Diger ocaklara göre kullanimi daha kolaydir.

english: Its called the Cook-o-matic 100. It uses a combination of state of the art temperature regulation and magic.
translation: Adi Cook-o-matic 100. En son teknoloji sicaklik ayari ve sihirli özellikleri bir arada kullaniyor.

english: Will it mean my food will burn less often?
translation: Yani yemeklerim daha az yanacak mi?

english: Well, that's what the salesman told us anyway...
Thanks?
Hey, who said you could use that?
Hello Cook. The Easter Bunny has run out of fuel for his egg making machine and has sent me to ask you for a favour.
translation: Merhaba Cook. Paskalya Tavsani'nin yumurta yapma makinesinin yakiti bitti ve benden sana bir ricada bulunmami istedi.

english: I am listening.
Do you by chance have any Hosidius milk? The Easter Bunny needs some to make the fuel.
translation: Hosidius sütün var mi? Paskalya Tavsani yakit yapmak icin birazina ihtiyac duyuyor.

english: I may have some lying around the kitchen, I would gladly give you some milk for the Easter Bunny.
translation: Mutfakta biraz olabilir, Paskalya Tavsani icin seve seve sana biraz süt veririm.

english: But first you must answer a riddle. If you get it right, I will give you some Hosidius milk.
translation: Ama önce bir bilmeceyi cevaplamalisin. Dogru cevap verirsen, sana Hosidius sütü veririm.

english: I would be glad to answer a riddle for you.
translation: Senin icin bir bilmeceyi cevaplamaktan memnuniyet duyarim.

english: Are you ready to answer my riddle?
Yes I am ready, crack out your riddle.
I leave my home only once a year, but do not give any Christmas cheer. Who am I?
translation: Yilda sadece bir kez evimden cikarim, ama Noel nesesi vermiyorum. Ben kimim?

english: I am sorry but that is not quite right.
translation: Üzgünüm, ama bu tam olarak dogru degil.

english: Talk to me when you're ready to try again.
translation: Tekrar denemeye hazir oldugunda bana söyle.

english: Congratulations, that's the right answer.
Here is the Hosidius milk I promised.
translation: Iste sana söz verdigim Hosidius sütü.

english: You receive a bottle of Hosidius milk
Filling me with eggs is bad... but I'll make a case for it.
translation: Beni yumurta ile doldurmak kötüdür... ama bunun icin bir nedenim var.

english: When dark and bitter, drink me warm in the winter.
translation: Karanlik ve aci oldugunda, kisin beni ilik ic.

english: I am round, yet not a perfect sphere. I can be cracked and not have anything inside. What am I?
translation: Yuvarlakim, ama mükemmel bir küre degilim. Kirilabilirim ve icimde hicbir sey olmayabilir. Ben neyim?

english: Not just yet, maybe later.
You should probably go and give the milk to the Easter Bunny, hop to it. Don't want to keep the Easter Bunny waiting.
translation: Gidip sütü Paskalya Tavsanina vermelisin, hadi git. Paskalya Tavsanini bekletmek istemeyiz.

english: I seem to have lost the milk, do you by any chance have any more?
translation: Sütü kaybetmisim galiba, acaba sende baska var mi?

english: Of course I do, try not to spill it this time.
translation: Tabii ki var, bu sefer dökmemeye calis.

english: Well done.
You've [found a new clue scroll/obtained a casket]!
I've always wondered how many cannons the castle has. Could you find out for me?
translation: Kalenin kac tane topu oldugunu hep merak etmisimdir. Benim icin ögrenebilir misin?

english: The cook has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Asci sana bir meydan okuma parsömeni verdi!

english: Please tell me how many cannons there are.
translation: Lütfen kac tane top oldugunu söyle.

english: Hmm, I don't think that's right.
Cheers!
The cook has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
Oh, what a cute bunny! I didn't realize it was Easter already!
translation: Oh, ne sevimli bir tavsan! Paskalya'nin geldigini fark etmemisim!

english: Cute?! I'll give you cute! I'll...
translation: Sevimli mi?! Sana sevimliyi gösteririm! Ben...

english: *AHEM*
Sorry.
Cook, we're looking for some fancy eggs that we can use as decorations. You wouldn't happen to have anything, would you?
translation: Asci, dekorasyon olarak kullanabilecegimiz süslü yumurtalar ariyoruz. Sende var mi acaba?

english: Hmm... Well, I do have a large collection of eggs, but most of them are regular old chicken eggs for making cakes.
translation: Hmm... Aslinda büyük bir yumurta koleksiyonum var, ama cogu kek yapmak icin kullanilan siradan tavuk yumurtalari.

english: Though come to think of it, I might have something...
translation: Ama simdi düsündüm de, bir seyim olabilir...

english: Go on...
I have a... 'special' collection of eggs that I keep in the... well... back of my cupboards for very... 'special' occasions.
translation: Benim... cok “özel” durumlar icin dolabimin arkasinda sakladigim “özel” bir yumurta koleksiyonum var.

english: I don't know if this occasion is special enough, though.
translation: Ama bu durumun yeterince özel olup olmadigini bilmiyorum.

english: Hey! I'll have you know Easter is a very special occasion!
translation: Hey! Paskalya'nin cok özel bir gün oldugunu bilmen gerekir!

english: Well, that's me convinced! Let me dig them out for you!
translation: Tamam, ikna oldum! Onlari senin icin cikarayim!

english: The Cook digs around the back of his cupboards and produces several colourful eggs, giving them to Gregg.
translation: Asci dolaplarinin arkasinda bir seyler arar ve birkac renkli yumurta cikararak Gregg'e verir.

english: Ooh! These are perfect! Thanks a lot!
Don't mention it!
Seriously, don't mention it.
Well, we have some eggs now. What's next?
translation: Artik yumurtalarimiz var. Sirada ne var?

english: Hmm... I think some nice fluffy wool could look quite nice...
translation: Hmm... Sanirim güzel, kabarik yünler hos görünebilir...

english: There's a sheep pen not too far north of here. You could get some fresh wool if you wanted.
translation: Buranin kuzeyinde cok uzak olmayan bir yerde bir koyun agili var. Istersen taze yün alabilirsin.

english: That sounds perfect! I'll meet you there, human!
translation: Kulaga harika geliyor! Orada görüsürüz insan!

english: Yes, go to the sheep pen and out of my kitchen...
translation: Evet, koyun agilina git ve mutfagimdan cik...

english: Oh, you're still here.
Yep! Just passing the time, you know!
Didn't you say you were off to the sheep pen north of here?
translation: Buranin kuzeyindeki koyun agilina gidecegini söylememis miydin?

english: We're not in a hurry. The sheep are in a pen, so it's not like they can go anywhere.
translation: Acele etmiyoruz. Koyunlar agilda, yani bir yere gidecekleri yok.

english: Actually, while you're still here, there's something else you can do.
translation: Aslinda, hala buradayken yapabilecegin baska bir sey var.

english: It's the Duke's birthday soon, and I'm running low on ingredients.
translation: Dükün dogum günü yaklasiyor ve malzemelerim azaliyor.

english: As important as the Duke of Lumbridge is, I'm sure he won't mind waiting a little longer for the sake of Easter.
translation: Lumbridge Dükü ne kadar önemli olursa olsun, Paskalya icin biraz daha beklemekten rahatsiz olmayacagina eminim.

english: Wait... didn't the Duke just have his birthday?
translation: Bir dakika... Dük'ün dogum günü daha yeni gecmedi mi?

english: Ahem... forget I said anything.
Cook, as fun as it is bringing you ingredients, don't you just burn all your cakes anyway?
translation: Asci, sana malzemeleri getirmek ne kadar eglenceli olsa da, tüm keklerini yakmiyor musun?

english: I... well yes, but how else am I supposed to train cooking?
translation: Ben... Evet, ama baska nasil ascilik egitimi alabilirim ki?

english: You could try something simple like fish, perhaps?
translation: Belki balik gibi basit bir sey deneyebilirsin?

english: And have the entire castle smelling like Port Sarim? No thank you!
translation: Ve tüm kale Port Sarim gibi kokmasin diye mi? Hayir, tesekkürler!

english: The eggs you gave Gregg were just rotten ones, weren't they.
translation: Gregg'e verdigin yumurtalar cürümüs yumurtalardi, degil mi?

english: Well, he wanted some funny looking eggs, and they were the funniest I had.
translation: O komik görünümlü yumurtalar istiyordu ve elimdeki en komik yumurtalar onlardi.

english: Just be thankful he didn't ask for some fancy milk instead!
*sigh* Do you know where he went at least?
translation: *ic cekis* En azindan nereye gittigini biliyor musun?

english: I think he said he was going to the sheep pen north of here.
translation: Sanirim buradan kuzeye, koyun agilina gidecegini söyledi.

english: How should I know? You should check in Draynor, maybe you'll find him there.
translation: Ben nereden bileyim? Draynor'a bakmalisin, belki orada bulursun.

english: What's wrong?
I'm always happy to help a cook in distress.
translation: Zor durumdaki bir asciya yardim etmekten her zaman mutluluk duyarim.

english: Where do I find some flour?
How about milk?
And eggs? Where are they found?
I've got all the information I need. Thanks.
translation: Ihtiyacim olan tüm bilgileri aldim. Tesekkürler.

english: Actually, I know where to find this stuff.
I can't right now, Maybe later.
Can you make me a cake?
You don't look very happy.
I'd take the rest of the day off if I were you.
translation: Yerinde olsam günün geri kalaninda izin alirdim.

english: Nice hat!
I'll get right on it.
Can you remind me how to find these things again?
translation: Bu seyleri nasil bulacagimi tekrar hatirlatir misin?

english: Do you have any other quests for me?
I am getting strong and mighty.
I keep on dying.
Can I use your range?
Talk about Easter.
Yes.
Count Check.
Easter Bunny.
Father Aereck.
Bob.
Santa.
River Lum.
Sack.
Spider web.
Basket.
Bucket.
Lemon juice.
Beer.
Sewer water.
Butter.
Chocolate.
Easter Egg.
The Grand Exchange.
Cake.
Potato.
Choc-ice.
No.
Something else.
Ask about the Easter event.
Ask about something else.
translation: Baska bir sey hakkinda soru sor.

english: You're not aristocracy but I suppose you'd do. Do you want a good cook for 3000 coins?
translation: Sen aristokrat degilsin ama sanirim isimi görürsün. 3000 sikke karsiliginda iyi bir asci ister misin?

english: What can you do?
I am the finest cook in all Gielinor! I can also make good time going to the bank or the sawmill.
translation: Ben Gielinor'un en iyi ascisiyim! Ayrica bankaya veya kereste fabrikasina da hizlica gidebilirim.

english: Tell me about your previous jobs.
I used to be the cook for the old Duke of Lumbridge. Visiting dignitaries praised me for my fine banquets!
translation: Eskiden Lumbridge'in eski dükünün ascisiydim. Ziyaret eden üst düzey yetkililer, hazirladigim güzel ziyafetler icin beni övdüler!

english: But then someone found a rule that said that only one family could hold that post.
translation: Ama sonra birisi, bu görevi sadece bir ailenin üstlenebilecegini söyleyen bir kural buldu.

english: Overnight I was fired and replaced by some fool who can't even bake a cake without help!
translation: Bir gecede kovuldum ve yardimsiz kek bile yapamayan bir aptalin yerine gectim!

english: Hmph! I don't work for just anyone, you know! I refuse to work for someone who's below level 30 Construction!
translation: Hmph! Ben herkes icin calismam, biliyorsun! 30 seviyenin altindaki insaatcilar icin calismayi reddediyorum!

english: You already have a servant.
You need a second bedroom with a bed for your servant to sleep in.
translation: Hizmetcinin uyuyacagi ikinci bir yatak odasina ihtiyacin var.

english: You're hired... well, I don't have the money on me, but can I owe you? I'm good for it, honest.
translation: Ise alindin... Sey, üzerimde para yok, ama sana borclanabilir miyim? Ödeyecegim, söz veriyorum.

english: Are you having a laugh? No cash up front, no cook.
translation: Dalga mi geciyorsun? Ön ödeme yoksa asci da yok.

english: You're hired!
[Alright, sir./Alright, madam./Alright.] I can start work immediately.
What can you do?
Tell me about your previous jobs
You're hired!
Can you teach me the basics of cooking please?
translation: Bana yemek pisirmenin temellerini ögretir misin lütfen?

english: The simplest thing to cook is raw meat or fish.
translation: Pisirilmesi en kolay sey cig et veya baliktir.

english: Fish can be caught, speak to the fishing tutor south of here in the swamp. Killing cows or chickens will yield raw meat to cook too.
translation: Balik yakalanabilir, buradan güneydeki bataklikta balikcilik ögretmeni ile konus. Inekleri veya tavuklari öldürerek de pisirmek icin cig et elde edebilirsin.

english: You can use your own fire... but it's not as effective and you'll burn more. To build a fire use a tinderbox on logs.
translation: Kendi atesini kullanabilirsin... ama o kadar etkili degildir ve daha fazla yakarsin. Ates yakmak icin odunlarin üzerine cakmaktasi kullan.

english: Once you've found your range, click on it. This will bring up a menu of the food you can cook.
translation: Atesin yerini bulduktan sonra üzerine tikla. Bu, pisirebilecegin yemeklerin menüsünü acacaktir.

english: If you're interested in quests, I heard my friend the cook in Lumbridge Castle is in need of a hand. Just talk to him and he'll set you off.
translation: Görevlerle ilgileniyorsan, Lumbridge Kalesi'ndeki asci arkadasimin yardima ihtiyaci oldugunu duydum. Onunla konus, seni görevlendirir.

english: I already know the basics of cooking. Got any tips?
translation: Yemek pisirmenin temellerini zaten biliyorum. Herhangi bir ipucun var mi?

english: Using a range cuts down the possibility of burning the food. In fact, the range in the Lumbridge Castle is particularly good for some foods, I hear.
translation: Ocak kullanmak, yiyeceklerin yanma olasiligini azaltir. Aslinda, Lumbridge Kalesi'ndeki ocak bazi yiyecekler icin özellikle iyiymis, duydum.

english: Compare the skills you learn to the effort put into making the food and the health that it heals, find a good combination for you.
translation: Ögrendigin becerileri, yiyecekleri hazirlamak icin harcadigin cabayla ve sagladigi saglikla karsilastir, sana uygun bir kombinasyon bul.

english: Any advice for an advanced chef?
translation: Ileri düzey bir asci icin tavsiyen var mi?

english: As you get better and better you'll find that you can cook better food such as pizza! These are very good for healing you when fighting the big monsters.
translation: Gittikce daha iyi hale geldikce, pizza gibi daha iyi yiyecekler pisirebilecegini göreceksin! Bunlar, büyük canavarlarla savasirken sizi iyilestirmek icin cok iyidir.

english: How can I train my cooking?
It seems we have a real master chef in our mists. Maybe you should be the one giving me cooking advice.
translation: Görünüse göre aramizda gercek bir usta sef var. Belki de bana yemek pisirme tavsiyeleri veren kisi siz olmalisiniz.

english: If you feel up to the task, you could try your hand at making pizza. A pizza is comprised of flour with water/ Put some tomato on there, sprinkle on some cheese then cook it. You might consider adding a topping too.
translation: Eger kendinizi bu göreve hazir hissediyorsaniz, pizza yapmayi deneyebilirsiniz. Pizza, su ile karistirilmis un ile yapilir. Üzerine biraz domates koyun, peynir serpin ve pisirin. Üzerine baska malzemeler de ekleyebilirsiniz.

english: Potatoes are another great food, but I won't go into much detail about those I'm afraid.
translation: Patates de harika bir yiyecektir, ama maalesef bu konuda fazla ayrintiya girmeyecegim.

english: Of course, you can try making a curry or baked potato if you feel up to it.
translation: Tabii ki, isterseniz curry veya firinda patates yapmayi deneyebilirsiniz.

english: Tell me about different foods.
Fish and meat of most varieties can be cooked very simply on either a fire or range, expirement which one works for you.
translation: Cogu balik ve et türü ates veya ocakta cok basit bir sekilde pisirilebilir, hangisinin size uygun oldugunu deneyin.

english: You can brew your own beers using the fermenting vats in either Keldagrim or Port Phasmatys. Use two buckets of water, two handfuls of barley malt, 4 hops of your choice and a pot of ale yeast, then leave to
translation: Keldagrim veya Port Phasmatys'teki fermantasyon ficilarini kullanarak kendi biralarinizi yapabilirsiniz. Iki kova su, iki avuc arpa malti, sectiginiz 4 hop ve bir tencere ale mayasi kullanin, sonra

english: ferment for a few days!
Simply turn the tap and let the ale flow into the barrel next to the vat, then use empty beer glasses on the barrel.
translation: Muslugu acin ve birayi ficinin yanindaki varile akitin, ardindan varildeki bos bira bardaklarini kullanin.

english: Baked potatoes are excellent foods and they are healthy too! You'll need to churn some butter and cheese. Look for the churn icon on the minimap. There is a churn in the farm building northwest of Lumbridge.
translation: Firinda patatesler mükemmel bir besindir ve ayni zamanda sagliklidir! Biraz tereyagi ve peynir cirpmaniz gerekecek. Minik haritada cirpma simgesini arayin. Lumbridge'in kuzeybatisindaki ciftlik binasinda bir cirpma makinesi var.

english: The nearest dairy cow is north of the nearby water mill. Take buckets of milk with you to the churn and use the milk on the churn to make butter or cheese.
translation: En yakin süt inegi, yakindaki su degirmeninin kuzeyinde. Tereyagi calkalayicisina süt kovalarini götürün ve calkalayicidaki sütü tereyagi veya peynir yapmak icin kullanin.

english: Use a pot of flour with a bucket of awter. You will then get an option to make bread dough, pitta bread dough, pastry dough, or pizza dough. Select pizza or pastry dough.
translation: Bir kova suyla bir tencere un kullanin. Ardindan ekmek hamuru, pide hamuru, pasta hamuru veya pizza hamuru yapma secenegi sunulacaktir. Pizza veya pasta hamurunu secin.

english: Use the pastry dough with a pie dish then add your filling such as apple or red berries.
translation: Pasta hamurunu bir turta kalibiyla kullanin, ardindan elma veya kirmizi meyveler gibi dolgularinizi ekleyin.

english: Finally cook your pie by using the unbaked pie on a cooking range. Mmmm...pie.
translation: Son olarak, pismemis turtayi ocakta pisirin. Mmmm... turta.

english: There's pizza too! Find yourself some tomato and cheese, use on the Pizza dough. Cook the pizza on a range then add any other toppings you want, such as anchovies.
translation: Pizza da var! Domates ve peynir bulun ve pizza hamuruna ekleyin. Pizzayi ocakta pisirin ve ardindan hamsi gibi istediginiz diger malzemeleri ekleyin.

english: Goodbye.
Hello.
Hello there! Are you interested in hearing all about cooking?
translation: Merhaba! Yemek pisirmeyle ilgili her seyi ögrenmek ister misiniz?

english: The simplest thing to cook is raw meat or fish. Shrimp can be caught south of here, to the east of Lumbridge Swamp. You could ask the fishing tutor for a net if you have not got one.
translation: Pisirilmesi en kolay sey cig et veya baliktir. Karides, buradan güneyde, Lumbridge Batakligi'nin dogusunda yakalanabilir. Eger aginiz yoksa, balikcilik ögretmeninden bir ag isteyebilirsiniz.

english: Alternatively, you could acquire some raw beef or chicken. You can find cows and chickens north of here. Go over the bridge then follow the path north, you can't miss them!
translation: Alternatif olarak, cig sigir eti veya tavuk da alabilirsiniz. Inekleri ve tavuklari buradan kuzeyde bulabilirsiniz. Köprüyü gecin ve kuzeye dogru yolu takip edin, onlari kacirmaniz imkansiz!

english: You could use my range here if you like.
If you wanted to, my friend the cook in Lumbridge Castle has a range you could use. You might find you burn even less on that range as its top notch.
translation: Isterseniz, Lumbridge Kalesi'ndeki asci arkadasimin kullanabileceginiz bir ocagi var. O ocak birinci sinif oldugu icin daha az yanik yapabilirsiniz.

english: Alternatively, you can use your own fire, but it's not as effective and the food will burn more frequently. To make a fire, use a tinderbox on some logs.
translation: Alternatif olarak, kendi atesinizi de kullanabilirsiniz, ancak bu kadar etkili degildir ve yiyecekler daha sik yanar. Ates yakmak icin, odunlarin üzerine bir cakmaktasi kullanin.

english: Once you've found your range or fire, use your raw food on it. This will bring up a menu of the food you can cook. Then select the food you want.
translation: Ocaginizi veya atesinizi bulduktan sonra, cig yiyeceklerinizi üzerinde pisirin. Bu, pisirebileceginiz yiyeceklerin menüsünü acacaktir. Ardindan istediginiz yiyecegi secin.

english: When you have a full inventory of cooked food, drop the useless burnt food and find a bank.
translation: Pismis yiyeceklerle dolu bir envanteriniz oldugunda, ise yaramayan yanmis yiyecekleri atin ve bir banka bulun.

english: Is there anything else you want to know?
translation: Bilmek istediginiz baska bir sey var mi?

english: What kinds of things can I cook?
Many things! You can cook anything from fish to poultry. You could try your hand at making baked potatoes or even brew some of the good stuff.
translation: Bircok sey! Baliktan kümes hayvanlarina kadar her seyi pisirebilirsiniz. Firinda patates yapmayi deneyebilir veya hatta iyi icecekler hazirlayabilirsiniz.

english: What would you like to hear about?
Tell me about Fish and Meat.
translation: Bana balik ve et hakkinda bilgi verin.

english: You might find that when killing monsters, they drop some raw meat for you to cook.
translation: Canavarlari öldürdügünüzde, pisirmeniz icin cig et düsürdüklerini görebilirsiniz.

english: Some of them might have hidden properties. Such as anglerfish, but you will find it hard getting hold of any of them at this time.
translation: Bazilari gizli özelliklere sahip olabilir. Örnegin, deniz seytani baligi, ancak su anda bunlardan herhangi birini bulmak zor olacaktir.

english: Most of the time, cooking meat and fish requires nothing else but a range or fire. More complicated dishes might require specialized equipment.
translation: Cogu zaman, et ve balik pisirmek icin ocak veya atesten baska bir seye gerek yoktur. Daha karmasik yemekler icin özel ekipman gerekebilir.

english: Would you like to hear about anything else I mentioned?
translation: Bahsettigim baska bir sey hakkinda bilgi almak ister misiniz?

english: Tell me about Brewing.
You might find it hard getting to these places but you can always buy beer at any pub. Some pubs sell unique beers too.
translation: Bu yerlere ulasmak zor olabilir, ancak her zaman herhangi bir barda bira satin alabilirsiniz. Bazi barlar da benzersiz biralar satmaktadir.

english: Tell me about Vegetables.
They require many different ingredients to make, such as butter and vegetables, but you will find it hard to acquire the ingredients needed.
translation: Yapiminda tereyagi ve sebze gibi bircok farkli malzeme gerekir, ancak gerekli malzemeleri bulmak zor olabilir.

english: Tell me about Pies and Pizzas.
Next, we have pizza. You will first need to make yourself a pizza base, use a pot of flour with a bucket of water and make a pizza base.
translation: Sirada pizza var. Öncelikle pizza hamuru yapmalisin, bir tencere un ve bir kova su kullanarak pizza hamuru yap.

english: If you want to, you could add yourself a topping to the pizza too. Why not try some anchovies?
translation: Istersen pizzaya üst malzeme de ekleyebilirsin. Ancüez denemek ister misin?

english: No, thank you.
Well, just come back any time you want to know how to cook up a storm!
translation: Peki, yemek pisirmeyi ögrenmek istediginde istedigin zaman tekrar gel!

english: Some foods have hidden properties. Anglerfish can provide you with an overheal effect where you have a few more hitpoints than your level. The higher your hitpoints the better the boost.
translation: Bazi yiyeceklerin gizli özellikleri vardir. Anglerfish, seviyenizden birkac hitpoint daha fazla olan bir asiri iyilestirme etkisi saglayabilir. Hitpoint'leriniz ne kadar yüksekse, artis o kadar iyi olur.

english: Use two buckets of water, two handfuls of barley malt, 4 hops of your choice and a pot of ale yeast, then leave to ferment for a few days!
translation: Iki kova su, iki avuc arpa malti, sectiginiz 4 hop ve bir tencere bira mayasi kullanin, sonra birkac gün mayalanmaya birakin!

english: You'll need to churn some butter and cheese. Look for the churn icon on the minimap. There is a churn in the farm building northwest of Lumbridge.
translation: Biraz tereyagi ve peynir calkalamaniz gerekecek. Minik haritada calkalama simgesini arayin. Lumbridge'in kuzeybatisindaki ciftlik binasinda bir calkalama makinesi var.

english: Now you will need to pick your topping if you want one. Get yourself a boweland create the perfect topping. Then put the topping onto the potato.
translation: Simdi, isterseniz üstüne koyacaginiz malzemeyi secmeniz gerekecek. Kendinize bir kase alin ve mükemmel malzemeyi hazirlayin. Sonra malzemeyi patatesin üzerine koyun.

english: Some pies might even be able to boost some of your skills, be it temporarily.
translation: Bazi turtalar, gecici de olsa bazi becerilerinizi artirabilir.

english: I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun! Pleased to meet you!
translation: Ben Dorgeshuun'dan Zanik! Tanistigimiza memnun oldum!

english: Hello there Zanik! How can I help?
What kind of foods do you eat up here on the surface?
All sorts of foods! There are lots of kinds of fish, and there are stews, pizzas, bread, baked potatoes...
translation: Her türlü yiyecek! Cok cesitli baliklar, güvecler, pizzalar, ekmekler, firinda patatesler...

english: This is so exciting! Perhaps later I'll come back and sample lots of different surface foods!
translation: Bu cok heyecan verici! Belki daha sonra geri gelip yüzeydeki farkli yiyecekleri denerim!

english: I'm sure you'll like them! What about you, [player name] Can I help you?
translation: Eminim begeneceksin! Peki ya sen, Maceraci? Yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: Can you teach me the basics of cooking please?
translation: Bana yemek pisirmenin temellerini ögretir misin lütfen?

english: I already know the basics of cooking. Got any tips?
translation: Yemek pisirmenin temellerini zaten biliyorum. Herhangi bir ipucun var mi?

english: How can I train my cooking?
Any advice for an advanced chef?
translation: Ileri düzey bir asci icin herhangi bir tavsiyen var mi?

english: Tell me about different food I can make.
translation: Yapabilecegim farkli yemekler hakkinda bilgi ver.

english: Fish and Meat
Brewing
Vegetables
Pies and Pizza
Go back to teaching
Goodbye.
What kinds of things can I cook?
Tell me about Fish and Meat.
translation: Bana balik ve et hakkinda bilgi ver.

english: Tell me about Brewing.
translation: Bana bira yapimi hakkinda bilgi ver.

english: Tell me about Vegetables.
Tell me about Pies and Pizzas.
translation: Bana turtalar ve pizzalar hakkinda bilgi ver.

english: No, thank you.
Get out of my way stinky! I've got stew to make!
translation: Cekil yolumdan kokusmus! Güvec yapmam lazim!

english: What do you want, stinky?
Hello to you too. You must be Weasel then.
translation: Sana da merhaba. Sen Weasel olmalisin.

english: Yes I am. Cooky Weasel to you. Finest cook this side of, well, pick an object - or a concept - or a location! I'm the best cook any side of anything what you can think of!
translation: Evet, öyleyim. Sana Cooky Weasel. Bu tarafin en iyi ascisi, sey, bir nesne sec - ya da bir kavram - ya da bir yer! Aklina gelebilecek her seyin en iyi ascisi benim!

english: Is that why you're down in this hole?
translation: Bu yüzden mi bu delikte bulunuyorsun?

english: Hole?! This is a fine establishment. At least it was until you stank it up.
translation: Delik mi?! Burasi güzel bir yer. En azindan sen kokutana kadar öyleydi.

english: Good grief, this is going to be a long day.
translation: Tanrim, bu uzun bir gün olacak.

english: What was that?
I said Wheeler told me you might have some extra nice carrots I could use?
translation: Wheeler'in bana kullanabilecegim ekstra güzel havuclarin olabilecegini söyledigini söyledim.

english: Wheeler sent you eh? Hmm... Why would I give you my good carrots? Thems for roasting with honey, not for stinking up with your grubby mitts.
translation: Wheeler mi gönderdi seni? Hmm... Neden sana iyi havuclarimi vereyim ki? Onlar bal ile kizartmak icin, senin kirli ellerinle kokutmak icin degil.

english: I want to make some special carrot juice for the Easter Bunny, to try and cheer him up.
translation: Paskalya Tavsani'ni neselendirmek icin özel havuc suyu yapmak istiyorum.

english: Oh! Well why didn't you say so? Smells like a good idea to me. If anyone deserves some good juice, it's him!
translation: Oh! Neden öyle demedin? Bana iyi bir fikir gibi geldi. Iyi bir meyve suyu hak eden biri varsa, o da odur!

english: Smells like you don't have space for these wonderful carrots. Clear some room and come back when you can handle the veggies!
translation: Bu harika havuclar icin yerin yok gibi görünüyor. Biraz yer ac ve sebzeleri kaldirabilecek hale geldiginde geri gel!

english: There's 3 fancy carrots for you, stinky. Now go and get that juice made before your stench rots 'em!
translation: Senin icin 3 tane güzel havuc var, kokusmus. Simdi git ve kokun onlari cürütmeden o meyve suyunu yap!

english: Thanks!
You've managed to make carrot juice? Surprising, and it doesn't seem to stink. Almost unbelievable!
translation: Havuc suyu yapmayi basardin mi? Sasirtici, ve kokmuyor gibi görünüyor. Neredeyse inanilmaz!

english: Smells to me like you've already got enough of my fancy carrots. Go away!
translation: Bana öyle geliyor ki, benim süslü havuclarimdan yeterince aldin. Git buradan!

english: What are you after now?
I need another carrot, I lost one.
translation: Bir havuc daha lazim, birini kaybettim.

english: I need more carrots, I lost some of them.
translation: Daha fazla havuc lazim, bazilarini kaybettim.

english: I need more carrots, I lost them all.
translation: Daha fazla havuc lazim, hepsini kaybettim.

english: You weren't nibbling at them were you? I bet you were thinking about it.
translation: Onlari kemirmiyordu, degil mi? Eminim bunu düsünüyordun.

english: Of course not.
Yeah right. Here, take 'em. Take all of my lovely carrots! Just make sure the Easter Bunny gets his juice this time.
translation: Tabii ya. Al, al hepsini. Tüm güzel havuclarimi al! Bu sefer Paskalya Tavsani'nin suyunu aldigindan emin ol.

english: Thank you. Won't happen again.
