You've been eating the carrots! I can smell 'em on your breath! You big stinking piggy!
translation: Havuclari yiyordun! Nefesinde kokusunu alabiliyorum! Seni kokusmus domuz!

english: I'm sure I would remember eating such a delicous, sweet, crunchy, orange, juicy...
translation: Böyle lezzetli, tatli, citir citir, turuncu, sulu bir seyi yedigimi hatirlardim...

english: What was the question?
Take these carrots and get out of my sight.
translation: Bu havuclari al ve gözümün önünden kaybol.

english: You've got orange stains around your mouth!
Probably from the carrot juice.
YOU WHAT?!? You DRANK the juice that you made for the Easter Bunny?
translation: NE?!? Paskalya Tavsani icin hazirladigin suyu ictin mi?

english: It was very good.
Oh for... Please use these carrots for their intended purpose.
translation: Oh, lütfen... Lütfen bu havuclari amacina uygun olarak kullan.

english: Not only that, I drank the juice!
translation: Sadece bunu da degil, suyu da ictim!

english: YOU WHAT?!? You're a real piece of work. Do you think these carrots grow on trees?
translation: NE?!? Sen gercekten cok yaramazsin. Bu havuclar agaclarda mi yetisiyor saniyorsun?

english: Yes.
Well they don't. They grow underground. And they're expensive. So either help the Easter Bunny, or stop wasting my stock!
translation: Hayir, yetismiyor. Yer altinda yetisiyorlar. Ve pahalilar. Ya Paskalya Tavsanina yardim et ya da stoklarimi bosa harcamayi birak!

english: I'll do my best.
Good news! The Easter Bunny loved the juice I made with your fancy carrots!
translation: Iyi haber! Paskalya Tavsani senin süslü havuclarindan yaptigim suyu cok sevdi!

english: I'm glad to hear it.
Now clear off!
Keep your hands away from these lovely carrots, stinky!
translation: Ellerini bu güzel havuclardan uzak tut, kokusmus!

english: I wasn't anywhere near them!
I can smell you getting closer, stinky!
I don't want any carrots I'm just here for eggs!
translation: Havuc istemiyorum, sadece yumurta almaya geldim!

english: Good, cause these carrots aren't for you, stinky!
translation: Iyi, cünkü bu havuclar senin icin degil, kokusmus!

english: Fine, I'm going!
Greetings human.
Hello, who are you?
Corkat quo Sihar. I am one of the mystics of the Kahlith. Are you here to serve the balance?
translation: Corkat quo Sihar. Ben Kahlith'in mistiklerinden biriyim. Dengeyi saglamak icin mi buradasin?

english: Yes.
Then you should speak to Konar quo Maten. She will guide you.
translation: O zaman Konar quo Maten ile konusmalisin. O sana yol gösterecektir.

english: No.
A shame. You are a bringer of death, you could be of great use to the balance.
translation: Yazik. Sen ölümün habercisiisin, denge icin cok yararli olabilirdin.

english: I'm not sure.
Then you should speak with Xorrah quo Sihar. He will show you the way.
translation: O zaman Xorrah quo Sihar ile konusmalisin. O sana yolu gösterecektir.

english: Yes.
No.
I'm not sure.
Hey it's the hero! Thank you so much for saving us from Gadderanks. And the town is looking lovely as well. You've done a great job!
translation: Hey, kahraman gelmis! Gadderanks'tan bizi kurtardigin icin cok tesekkürler. Kasaba da cok güzel görünüyor. Harika bir is cikarmissin!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
I'm Cornelius. I run the bank now.
translation: Ben Cornelius. Artik bankayi ben yönetiyorum.

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect. Thanks so much for your efforts.
What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really. We're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place.
translation: Oh, pek bir sey yok aslinda. Hala vampirlerden saklaniyoruz ve bu korkunc yerde gecimimizi sagliyoruz.

english: Hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey across the Salve.
translation: Umarim yakinda Salve'yi gececek kadar gücleniriz.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Not as far as I know. We have some basic amenities now which is so very useful and we're all incredibly grateful to you.
translation: Bildigim kadariyla yok. Artik cok yararli olan bazi temel olanaklara sahibiz ve sana hepimiz inanilmaz derecede minnettariz.

english: I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: Daha önce hic kahraman görmedim veya tanimadim, bu yüzden karsilastiracak bir seyim yok, ama cogu insanin görüsüne göre, sen bir kahramansin! Ben sahsen seninle tanistigima cok memnunum.

english: Okay, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Okay, thanks.
Excuse me! This area is different than the rest of the Wilderness, are you sure you understand the rules?
translation: Affedersiniz! Bu bölge diger Wilderness alanlarindan farklidir, kurallari anladiginizdan emin misiniz?

english: I can tell you everything you need to know, but if you're in a rush then be warned my overlords will NOT be happy if they find you to be fighting with no honour.
translation: Size bilmeniz gereken her seyi anlatabilirim, ancak aceleniz varsa, efendilerim sizin onursuzca savastiginizi görürlerse hic hosnut olmayacaklarini unutmayin.

english: Just don't go doing anything silly like selling your soul to your opponent else there will be big trouble!
translation: Ruhunu rakibine satmak gibi aptalca bir sey yapma, yoksa basin büyük belaya girer!

english: [How may I help you, sir/How may I help you, madam/How may I help you]?
I'd like to learn the rules of combat in this arena!
translation: Bu arenadaki dövüs kurallarini ögrenmek istiyorum!

english: Sure. Which part do you want to learn?
Let's talk about Targets.
Sure. Upon entering the arena, you will be assigned a Target based on your combat level, and if you wish to adjust the range of potential Targets, you may do so by speaking with the Trader.
translation: Tabii. Arenaya girdiginizde, savas seviyenize göre bir Hedef atanir ve potansiyel Hedeflerin araligini ayarlamak isterseniz, Tüccar ile konusarak bunu yapabilirsiniz.

english: If you wish to change your Target, you may skip your current one, but please note that if you skip three skulled Targets within 30 minutes, you will not be able to receive a new Target for the next 30 minutes.
translation: Hedefinizi degistirmek isterseniz, mevcut hedefinizi atlayabilirsiniz, ancak 30 dakika icinde üc kafatasli Hedefi atlarsaniz, sonraki 30 dakika boyunca yeni bir Hedef alamayacaginizi lütfen unutmayin.

english: Additionally, it's worth mentioning that killing a player who is not your Target will not reward you with any bonuses related to Emblem or Bounty Hunter Points.
translation: Ayrica, Hedefiniz olmayan bir oyuncuyu öldürmenin size Amblem veya Ödül Avcisi Puanlari ile ilgili herhangi bir bonus kazandirmayacagini da belirtmek gerekir.

english: Goodbye.
Tell me about Emblems.
After defeating your Target, you may come across a tier one Emblem. Defeating another Target will level up the Emblem; the higher its tier, the greater its value.
translation: Hedefinizi yendikten sonra, birinci seviye bir Amblem ile karsilasabilirsiniz. Baska bir Hedefi yenmek Amblemin seviyesini yükseltir; seviyesi ne kadar yüksekse, degeri de o kadar yüksek olur.

english: If you die while carrying an Emblem, its tier will be reduced by one. If you die with a Tier 1 emblem, you will lose the emblem.
translation: Amblem tasirken ölürseniz, seviyesi bir düser. Seviye 1 amblemle ölürseniz, amblemi kaybedersiniz.

english: You may use Bounty Hunter Points to purchase a tier one Emblem from the Trader, or sell your own Emblem to him for Bounty Hunter Points. You can only have one Emblem at a time.
translation: Ödül Avcisi Puanlarini kullanarak Tüccardan birinci seviye bir Amblem satin alabilir veya kendi Ambleminizi Tüccara satarak Ödül Avcisi Puanlari kazanabilirsiniz. Ayni anda sadece bir Amblem sahibi olabilirsiniz.

english: Can you explain Bounty Hunter Points to me?
You can earn Bounty Hunter Points by defeating your target or selling Emblems to the Trader. Once you have Bounty Hunter Points, you may use them to purchase rewards from the reward shop.
translation: Hedefinizi yenerek veya Trader'a Amblem satarak Bounty Hunter Puanlari kazanabilirsiniz. Bounty Hunter Puanlariniz oldugunda, bunlari ödül magazasindan ödül satin almak icin kullanabilirsiniz.

english: What is the Coffer for?
To participate in Bounty Hunter, you must have a certain amount of coins in your Coffer, which varies based on your combat level. Currently you need at least [x] coins to participate.
If you are unskulled and another person kills you in Bounty Hunter, [x] coins will be deducted from your Coffer and given to your killer.
If you are skulled, 10,000 coins will be deducted from your Coffer and given to your killer. However, any surplus money in your Coffer will remain safe.
translation: Eger kafatasiniz varsa, Sandiginizdan 10.000 coin düsülür ve sizi öldüren kisiye verilir. Ancak, Sandiginizdaki fazla para güvende kalir.

english: To manage your Coffer, talk to the Trader.
translation: Kasanizi yönetmek icin Tüccar ile konusun.

english: How do I get bounty crates?
Well, if you want crates, you'll need to be fighting a target in the arena while having a minimum value of risked items on you. Anything you can protect, we won't count.
translation: Sandiklari elde etmek istiyorsaniz, arenada bir hedefle savasirken üzerinizde minimum degerinde riskli esya bulundurmaniz gerekir. Koruyabileceginiz esyalar sayilmaz.

english: If you meet these requirements, we'll keep track of how long you're in there for. We'll occasionally give you a bonus if you die as well.
translation: Bu gereksinimleri karsiliyorsaniz, orada ne kadar süre kaldiginizi takip ederiz. Öldügünüzde de ara sira size bonus veririz.

english: When you kill a target, if you've been in long enough, you'll get a crate. If you've been in there longer, you'll get a higer value crate.
translation: Bir hedefi öldürdügünüzde, yeterince uzun süre kaldiysaniz, bir sandik alirsiniz. Daha uzun süre kaldiysaniz, daha yüksek degerli bir sandik alirsiniz.

english: The crates don't contain anything special; just coins and supplies to help cover what you'll use in the crater.
translation: Sandiklar özel bir sey icermez; sadece kraterde kullanacaginiz seyleri karsilamaya yardimci olacak paralar ve malzemeler vardir.

english: If you keep killing your target, you probably won't get many high value crates, but you'll certainly get a lot more points and Emblems instead.
translation: Hedefinizi öldürmeye devam ederseniz, muhtemelen cok degerli sandiklar almayacaksiniz, ancak bunun yerine cok daha fazla puan ve Amblem alacaksiniz.

english: Can you corrupt my Ancient Warrior armour?
Do you know anything about Bounty Hunter hats?
translation: Ödül Avcisi sapkalari hakkinda bir sey biliyor musun?

english: Ah yes, you'll be able to collect them from me, once you've got some targeted kills that is.
translation: Evet, hedefledigin kisileri öldürdükten sonra benden alabilirsin.

english: Ah yes! I've been told to hold onto some hats for you, for your uhm... deeds in the wilderness.
translation: Evet! Senin icin bazi sapkalari saklamam söylendi, senin... Wildernessdaki basarilarin icin.

english: Oh wonderful, can I take a look?
You need [number] target kills to claim this hat. You currently have [number].
I'm afraid you've already got one of those hats, I can't let you have another.
translation: Korkarim ki bu sapkalardan birine zaten sahipsin, bir tane daha veremem.

english: I'm afraid you've got nowhere to put a hat if I gave one to you.
translation: Korkarim ki sana bir sapka versem bile takacak yerin yok.

english: Here you go, enjoy!
Can you tell me my current EP value?
translation: Su anki EP degerimi söyleyebilir misin?

english: What is this place?
Beyond this portal lies Daimon's Crater, a place where you'll fight other adventurers like yourself for glory and rewards.
translation: Bu portalin ötesinde Daimon'un Krateri var, burada senin gibi diger maceracilarla san ve ödüller icin savasacaksin.

english: Sadly, I can't let you into Daimon's Crater right now.
translation: Maalesef, su anda Daimon'un Kraterine girmene izin veremem.

english: Bounty Hunter is only available on specific Bounty Hunter worlds.
translation: Bounty Hunter sadece belirli Bounty Hunter dünyalarinda kullanilabilir.

english: If you step through this portal, you'll be taken to Daimon's Crater, where we've set up a lobby area for you to ready yourself for combat.
translation: Bu portaldan gecersen, Daimon'un Krateri'ne götürüleceksin. Orada, savasa hazirlanman icin bir lobi alani hazirladik.

english: If you'd like, I can explain the rules of Bounty Hunter to you.
translation: Istersen, Bounty Hunter'in kurallarini sana aciklayabilirim.

english: Can I access my Bounty Hunter coffer?
Certainly. Would you like to add or remove coins from it?
translation: Elbette. Kasaya para eklemek veya cikarmak ister misin?

english: Deposit coins.
Withdraw coins.
Yes, I acknowledge these rules.
No.
I'd like to learn the rules of combat in this arena!
translation: Bu arenadaki savas kurallarini ögrenmek istiyorum!

english: Let's talk about Targets.
Tell me about Emblems.
Can you explain Bounty Hunter Points to me?
What is the Coffer for?
How do I get bounty crates?
Goodbye.
Tell me about the Emblems.
Can you corrupt my Ancient Warrior armour?
Ask about Bounty Hunter Hats.
translation: Ödül Avcisi Sapkalari hakkinda bilgi verin.

english: Ask about the EP value.
What is this place?
Can I access my Bounty Hunter coffer?
Ye'll pay!
Curse you!
Curse 'em all!
Arrr, land-lubber!
Hello there.
Salutations traveller! It is unusual for one of the creatures called 'humans' to visit this plane. How can I assist you?
translation: Selamlar gezgin! “Insan” denen yaratiklarin bu düzleme gelmesi alisilmadik bir durum. Nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: I'm just looking around, thanks.
I hope the beauty of my world brings you great joy.
translation: Umarim dünyamin güzelligi sana büyük bir keyif verir.

english: Who are you?
My name, in your language, would be Bubrezankaldargarez'jk, but you can just call me Bub. This small plane is my home, here I study and ponder the mysteries of existence.
translation: Adim, sizin dilinizde Bubrezankaldargarez'jk olurdu, ama bana Bub diyebilirsin. Bu kücük düzlem benim evim, burada varolusun gizemlerini inceliyor ve üzerinde düsünüyorum.

english: Mysteries of existence, eh? Like what?
I'm looking for a Star Flower.

Then you've come to the right place. Star Flower, which is much prized for its magical properties, only grows on this plane. It has a very short life-span; plants grow, flower and die in the space of minutes! If you search
translation: O zaman dogru yere geldin. Büyülü özellikleriyle cok degerli olan Yildiz Cicegi, sadece bu düzlemde yetisir. Ömrü cok kisadir; bitkiler birkac dakika icinde büyür, cicek acar ve ölür! Etrafi ararsan

english: around you might find some growing somewhere.
Where do flies go at night?
Have you ever flicked through a dictionary and afterwards felt really depressed by how much you don't know?
translation: Hic bir sözlügü karistirip, bilmedigin seylerin coklugundan dolayi gercekten depresif hissettigin oldu mu?

english: Do other birds speak pigeon pidgin?
translation: Diger kuslar da güvercin pidgin dili konusur mu?

english: Political philosophy is an oxymoron.
Why are yawns contagious?
Do sick days include when you're sick of work?
translation: Hastalik izni, isten biktiginiz zamanlari da kapsar mi?

english: To be is to be the value of a variable.
translation: Var olmak, bir degiskenin degeri olmaktir.

english: How do you know when you've run out of invisible ink?
Where does a snake's tail begin?
How long do fish wait to swim after they eat?
translation: Baliklar yedikten sonra ne kadar süre beklerler?

english: If you're halfway from here to there, which is which?
translation: Buradan oraya yari yolda iseniz, hangisi hangisidir?

english: I'm just looking around, thanks.
Who are you?
I'm looking for a Star Flower.
You were very brave for going on stage to confront a killer. Looks like you did well to get her to surrender without damaging her costume.
translation: Katille yüzlesmek icin sahneye cikmakla cok cesur davrandiniz. Kostümüne zarar vermeden onu teslim olmaya ikna etmekle iyi is cikarmissiniz.

english: It was very well made. Makes the job of not damaging it much easier!
translation: Cok iyi yapilmis. Zarar vermemek cok daha kolay oluyor!

english: Why thank you! I credit my needles for the good work.
Would I be able to get one of them for my own purposes?
translation: Kendi amaclarim icin bir tane alabilir miyim?

english: I suppose I could part with one... If you're careful not to lose it.
translation: Bir tanesini verebilirim... Kaybetmemeye dikkat edersen.

english: I'll be careful.
Have you still got that needle safe and secure?
translation: O igneyi hala güvenli bir yerde sakliyor musun?

english: I have indeed.
Aww, what a cute cat! I better not wake it up.
translation: Ah, ne sevimli bir kedi! Onu uyandirmasam iyi olur.

english: I certainly wouldn't hand you over for any runes, you're too adorable.
translation: Seni hicbir rune icin teslim etmem, cok sevimlisin.

english: Hello.
How do. You planning on crossing this here bridge and heading up to Rellekka then?
translation: Nasilsin? Bu köprüyü gecip Rellekka'ya gitmeyi mi planliyorsun?

english: Yes, actually I was.
Aye, 'tis a good thing we fixed this 'ere bridge, I reckon. You best be careful up there. Them Fremenniks are odd 'uns.
translation: Evet, bu köprüyü tamir etmemiz iyi oldu bence. Orada dikkatli olsan iyi olur. Fremennikler tuhaf tiplerdir.

english: So you fixed this bridge yourself?
translation: Bu köprüyü kendin mi tamir ettin?

english: Aye, that I did. 'Twas real thirsty work too. If only some kind stranger would buy us a bit of beer to sup, eh?
translation: Evet, ben yaptim. Cok yorucu bir isti. Keske nazik bir yabanci bize biraz bira ismarlasaydi, degil mi?

english: What with that inn at seers so close by and all, eh?
translation: Seers'daki han bu kadar yakinken, degil mi?

english: The workman winks at you
Just make sure yer don't get me none of that non alcoholic rubbish from that poison salesman guy at the tavern!
translation: Tavernadaki zehir saticisi adamdan alkolsüz sacmaliklarindan almamaya dikkat et!

english: I wasn't planning on it, no.
Aye, that's what I told t'gaffer. Nobody wants to go up and hang out with a buncha dumb barbarians when there's a perfectly good inn to sup in, in t'seers village.
translation: Evet, ben de patrona öyle söyledim. Seers köyünde icmek icin mükemmel bir han varken, kimse aptal barbarlarla takilmak istemez.

english: Ain't much better in life than having a nice cold beer to sup on a hot day like this, eh? Better'n fixing bridges, eh?
translation: Böyle sicak bir günde soguk bir bira icmekten daha güzel bir sey var mi? Köprü tamir etmekten daha iyi, degil mi?

english: A bit early in the day fer that ain't it?
translation: Bunun icin biraz erken degil mi?

english: Ta very much, like. That'll hit the spot nicely. Here, you can have this. I picked it up as a souvenir on me last hols.
translation: Cok tesekkürler. Tam da ihtiyacim olan sey. Al, bunu alabilirsin. Son tatilimde hatira olarak almistim.

english: What is it?
I dunno rightly, but if you use a tinderbox on it, it don't half make a loud noise!
translation: Tam olarak bilmiyorum, ama cakmaktasi kullanirsan, cok gürültülü bir ses cikariyor!

english: No ta, not my brand of beer.
translation: Hayir, bu benim sevdigim bira markasi degil.

english: No ta, not a big wine fan, me.
Yes
No
Hi there.
Good day to you.
Who are you?
My name is David Andrews. I'm the Head Councillor of the Kourend Council.
translation: Adim David Andrews. Kourend Konseyi'nin baskani benim.

english: Tell me about the Kourend Council.
translation: Kourend Konseyi hakkinda bilgi verir misin?

english: Kourend's last King, Kharedst IV, had only one child when he died. She was too young to take the throne, so the Kourend Council was formed to look after things until she came of age.
translation: Kourend'in son krali Kharedst IV öldügünde tek bir cocugu vardi. Kiz cok kücüktü ve tahta cikamayacakti, bu yüzden Kourend Konseyi kuruldu ve kiz resit olana kadar isleri yürütmekle görevlendirildi.

english: Alas, she was very close to her father and his sudden death drove her to insanity. With no suitable ruler, the Kourend Council was made permanent.
translation: Ne yazik ki kiz babasina cok bagliydi ve babasinin ani ölümü onu delirtmisti. Uygun bir hükümdar olmadigi icin Kourend Konseyi kalici hale getirildi.

english: How is the Council structured?
The Kourend Council is made up of four councillors. Every four years there is an election for the people to decide who the councillors should be.
translation: Kourend Konseyi dört konsey üyesinden olusur. Her dört yilda bir, halkin konsey üyelerini belirlemesi icin secim yapilir.

english: One of the councillors holds the position of Head Councillor and this rotates every year. I am the current Head Councillor.
translation: Konsey üyelerinden biri Bas Konsey Üyesi pozisyonunu alir ve bu pozisyon her yil degisir. Ben su anki Bas Konsey Üyesiyim.

english: The other councillors are Councillor Hughes, Councillor Unkar and Councillor Orson.
translation: Diger konsey üyeleri ise Konsey Üyesi Hughes, Konsey Üyesi Unkar ve Konsey Üyesi Orson'dur.

english: The other councillors are Councillor Unkar and Councillor Orson. The fourth seat on the Council is currently vacentafter the recent arrest of Councillor Hughes.
translation: Diger konsey üyeleri ise Konsey Üyesi Unkar ve Konsey Üyesi Orson'dur. Konseyin dördüncü koltugu, Konsey Üyesi Hughes'un yakin zamanda tutuklanmasinin ardindan su anda bostur.

english: So where do the five houses fit in?
translation: Peki bes ev bu yapiya nasil uyum sagliyor?

english: The five houses of Kourend each have their own leader who rules over their city. The leaders of the individual houses must enforce and obey the laws set out by the Kourend Council, but can otherwise rule as they see fit.
translation: Kourend'in bes evinin her birinin, sehirlerini yöneten kendi liderleri vardir. Her evin liderleri, Kourend Konseyi tarafindan belirlenen yasalari uygulamak ve bunlara uymak zorundadir, ancak bunun disinda uygun gördükleri sekilde yönetebilirler.

english: I hope that helps.
Yes, thank you.
Time for me to go.
Good day citizen.
There's been a death in Arceuus.
A death? Well that doesn't seem right. The people of Arceuus don't just die. They can't.
translation: Ölüm mü? Bu dogru olamaz. Arceuus halki öylece ölmez. Ölemezler.

english: I've seen it with my own eyes. A citizen of Arceuus has fallen. What should we do?
translation: Kendi gözlerimle gördüm. Bir Arceuus vatandasi öldü. Ne yapmaliyiz?

english: Well I don't really know what we can do. The Arceuus family have chosen to keep their knowledge secret from the rest of us. We have no expertise in this area.
translation: Ne yapabilecegimizi gercekten bilmiyorum. Arceuus ailesi, bilgilerini bizden gizli tutmayi tercih etti. Bu alanda uzmanligimiz yok.

english: So you'll do nothing?
If I could do something, I would. However, I'm afraid this is out of our hands.
translation: Yapabilecegim bir sey olsaydi, yapardim. Ancak, korkarim bu bizim elimizde degil.

english: I see. I suppose I'd better tell Mori.
translation: Anliyorum. Mori'ye haber versem iyi olacak.

english: I'm sorry, but as I already told you, we can't help.
translation: Üzgünüm, ama size daha önce de söyledigim gibi, yardimci olamayiz.

english: Here he is, the hero of the hour. On behalf of the Council, and indeed all of Kourend, thank you for dealing with this messy situation.
translation: Iste, günün kahramani geldi. Konsey adina ve aslinda tüm Kourend adina, bu karmasik durumu cözdügünüz icin tesekkür ederiz.

english: It was nothing.
You're far too humble. You've done so much for our kingdom in your short time here. Rest assured, we have noticed. In fact, I consider you a firm friend of the Council.
translation: Cok mütevazisiniz. Kisa sürede kralligimiz icin cok sey yaptiniz. Emin olun, bunu fark ettik. Aslinda, sizi Konsey'in sadik bir dostu olarak görüyorum.

english: Have you managed to work out how Councillor Hughes escaped?
translation: Hughes Konsey Üyesi'nin nasil kactigini bulabildiniz mi?

english: Not yet. You need not worry though, we'll get to the bottom of it. That said, I do have another ask of you... if you don't mind.
translation: Henüz degil. Ama endiselenmeyin, bu konuyu enine boyuna arastiracagiz. Bununla birlikte, sizden bir ricam daha var... sakincasi yoksa.

english: What is it?
Commander Fullore tells me you've had dealings with Martin Holt and his group.
translation: Komutan Fullore, Martin Holt ve grubuyla iliskileriniz oldugunu söyledi.

english: I'm not sure about dealings, but we've met.
well regardless, your handling of the situation with Sophia Hughes seems to have had quite an impact on them.
translation: Her neyse, Sophia Hughes ile olan durumu ele alisiniz onlar üzerinde oldukca etkili olmus görünüyor.

english: Well, I am quite impactful. So, what is this ask?
translation: Evet, oldukca etkiliyimdir. Peki, isteginiz nedir?

english: This recent situation has been most unfortunate. People are angry, I understand that. That said, Sophia Hughes has been dealt with. It's time for Martin Holt and his protestors to go home.
translation: Son durum cok talihsizdi. Insanlar öfkeli, bunu anliyorum. Bununla birlikte, Sophia Hughes ile ilgilenildi. Martin Holt ve protestocularinin evlerine dönme zamani geldi.

english: Ah, I see. You want me to convinve them.
It would be greatly appreciated. Civil unrest is of no benefit to anyone. We'd all be better off putting this behind us.
translation: Cok minnettar olurum. Toplumsal kargasa kimseye fayda saglamaz. Bunu geride birakmak hepimiz icin daha iyi olur.

english: Now, I must be off. Plenty of work to do. Good luck with Martin and his friends.
translation: Simdi gitmeliyim. Yapacak cok isim var. Martin ve arkadaslariyla iyi sanslar.

english: So what now?
Come to gloat?
Well I do enjoy it when people get what they deserve.
translation: Insanlarin hak ettiklerini aldiklarini görmek hosuma gidiyor.

english: You'll never know what it's like to be on top of the world. The power I had was unconquerable. I'd do it all again without hesitation.
translation: Dünyanin zirvesinde olmanin nasil bir sey oldugunu asla bilemeyeceksin. Sahip oldugum güc yenilmezdi. Tereddüt etmeden yine aynisini yapardim.

english: You never had any power. You were just a puppet. You've always been nothing, and that's all you'll ever be.
translation: Hicbir zaman gücün olmadi. Sen sadece bir kukladin. Hep bir hic oldun ve hep bir hic olarak kalacaksin.

english: That's not true!
Enjoy your cell, puppet. Won't be seeing you.
translation: Hücrenin tadini cikar kukla. Seni bir daha görmeyecegim.

english: Who are you?
Tell me about the Kourend Council.
Time for me to go.
There's been a death in Arceuus.
Hello. How are you?
I've been better.
What's wrong?
You may or may not be aware, but a plague has spread across West Ardougne. Now, so far, our efforts to contain it have been largely successful, for the most part.
translation: Farkinda olabilirsin ya da olmayabilirsin, ama Bati Ardougne'da bir salgin yayildi. Su ana kadar, salgini kontrol altina alma cabalarimiz büyük ölcüde basarili oldu.

english: However, some sheep recently escaped from a farm near the city. When they were found, we noticed that they were strangely discoloured, so we asked the mourners to examine them.
translation: Ancak, kisa süre önce sehir yakinlarindaki bir ciftlikten bazi koyunlar kacti. Onlari buldugumuzda, garip bir sekilde renk degistirdiklerini fark ettik, bu yüzden yas tutanlara onlari incelemelerini istedik.

english: They believe that the sheep have become infected with the plague.
Are you sure it's the plague?
Well the mourners seemed convinced and they're the experts. Even if it's not though, the sheep are clearly diseased in some way.
translation: Yas tutanlar emin görünüyordu ve onlar bu konuda uzmanlar. Salgin olmasa bile, koyunlarin bir sekilde hastalandigi acik.

english: As the councillor responsible for public health and safety here in East Ardougne, I am in charge of dealing with this problem.
translation: Dogu Ardougne'da halk sagligi ve güvenliginden sorumlu meclis üyesi olarak, bu sorunu cözmek benim görevim.

english: We need someone to herd these sheep into a safe enclosure, kill them quickly and cleanly and then dispose of the remains hygienically in a special incinerator.
translation: Bu koyunlari güvenli bir alana götürüp, hizli ve temiz bir sekilde öldürüp, kalintilarini özel bir yakma firininda hijyenik bir sekilde imha edecek birine ihtiyacimiz var.

english: Unfortunately, nobody wants to risk catching the plague, and I am unable to find someone willing to undertake this mission for me.
translation: Ne yazik ki, kimse vebaya yakalanma riskini almak istemiyor ve bu görevi üstlenecek birini bulamiyorum.

english: I can do that for you.
You will? That is excellent news! Head to the enclosure we have set up on Farmer Brumty's land to the north of the city; the four infected sheep should still be somewhere in that vicinity.
translation: Öyle mi? Bu harika bir haber! Sehrin kuzeyindeki Ciftci Brumty'nin arazisinde kurdugumuz agila gidin; enfekte olmus dört koyun hala o civarda bir yerde olmali.

english: Before you will be allowed to enter the enclosure, however, you must ensure you have some kind of protective clothing to prevent contagion.
translation: Ancak, agilin icine girmenize izin verilmeden önce, bulasmayi önlemek icin koruyucu giysiler giydiginizden emin olmalisiniz.

english: Where can I find some protective clothing then?
Doctor Orbon should have something suitable. You should be able to find him in the chapel just north of here.
translation: Doktor Orbon'da uygun bir seyler olmali. Onu buradan kuzeydeki sapelde bulabilirsin.

english: Please also take this poisoned sheep feed; we believe poisoning the sheep will minimise the risk of airborne contamination, and is of course also more humane to the sheep.
translation: Lütfen bu zehirli koyun yemini de al; koyunlari zehirlemenin hava yoluyla bulasma riskini en aza indirecegine inaniyoruz ve tabii ki koyunlar icin de daha insancil bir yöntem.

english: The councillor gives you some poisoned sheep feed.
translation: Meclis üyesi sana zehirli koyun yemi verir.

english: How will I know which sheep are infected?
translation: Hangi koyunlarin enfekte oldugunu nasil anlayacagim?

english: The poor creatures have developed strangely discoloured wool and flesh. You should have no trouble spotting them. There should be four in total.
translation: Zavalli hayvanlarin yünleri ve derileri garip bir sekilde renksizlesmis. Onlari fark etmekte zorlanmayacaksin. Toplamda dört tane olmali.

english: That's not a job for me.
I do not blame you adventurer. It is not particularly pleasant work. My problem remains however. If you know of anyone suitable please send them this way; time is of the essence.
translation: Seni suclamiyorum maceraci. Bu pek hos bir is degil. Ancak benim sorunum devam ediyor. Uygun birini taniyorsan lütfen buraya gönder; zaman cok önemli.

english: That's life for you.
That's what concerns me... There might not be much life around here soon.
translation: Benim endisem de bu... Yakinda buralarda pek hayat kalmayabilir.

english: Hello again sir.
Well hello again adventurer! How are you today?
Fine thank you. And yourself?
I'm okay. Sadly some more diseased sheep have appeared so I have them to deal with.
translation: Ben iyiyim. Ne yazik ki birkac hasta koyun daha ortaya cikti, onlarla ilgilenmem gerekiyor.

english: Do you need me to help again?
Thank you for the kind offer. You've done enough though. We'll find someone else to deal with these ones.
translation: Nazik teklifin icin tesekkürler. Yeterince yardim ettin zaten. Bunlarla ilgilenmesi icin baska birini buluruz.

english: Hello again.
Not too bad, I've a lot to do though. King Lathas left plenty of things for us to clean up.
translation: Fena degil, ama yapacak cok isim var. Kral Lathas bize temizlememiz gereken cok sey birakti.

english: What's wrong?
I can do that for you.
That's not a job for me.
That's life for you.
Thank you for helping to repair the Doors of Dinh. Kourend is a safer place because of you.
translation: Dinh Kapilarini onarmaya yardim ettigin icin tesekkürler. Senin sayende Kourend daha güvenli bir yer oldu.

english: Who are you?
I'm Councillor Unkar, one of the members of the Kourend Council. We are responsible for running the entire Kingdom of Great Kourend.
translation: Ben Konsey Üyesi Unkar, Kourend Konseyi üyelerinden biriyim. Büyük Kourend Kralligi'nin tamamini yönetmekten sorumluyuz.

english: What brings you to Lovakengj then?
It's important for the council to maintain a good relationship with the rulers of the five houses. Although it is the council that rules, we can only do so with their support.
translation: Konseyin bes hanenin hükümdarlariyla iyi iliskiler sürdürmesi önemlidir. Yönetimi konsey yapsa da, bunu ancak onlarin destegiyle yapabiliriz.

english: I'm here to help Lady Lovakengj out and to make sure she has everything she needs to rule effectively.
translation: Bayan Lovakengj'e yardim etmek ve etkili bir sekilde yönetmesi icin ihtiyac duydugu her seye sahip oldugundan emin olmak icin buradayim.

english: What are the Doors of Dinh?
They are a great set of doors built by the legendary smith, Dinh, in the early days of Kourend. They were created to imprison a deadly beast known as the Wintertodt.
translation: Kourend'in ilk günlerinde efsanevi demirci Dinh tarafindan yapilan büyük bir kapi grubudur. Wintertodt adinda ölümcül bir canavari hapsetmek icin yapilmislardir.

english: Unfortunately, the doors were recently damaged, putting Kourend at risk. The master smith Undor, managed to repair them though, something he couldn't have done without you.
translation: Ne yazik ki, kapilar yakin zamanda hasar gördü ve Kourend'i tehlikeye atti. Usta demirci Undor, onlari onarmayi basardi, ancak bu senin yardimin olmadan mümkün olmazdi.

english: I'll get going.
Human.
How's the cell?
A step down from what I'm used to.
Well you'd better get used to it. This is where you'll spend the rest of your life, however long that ends up being.
translation: O zaman alissan iyi olur. Hayatinin geri kalanini burada gecireceksin, ne kadar sürerse sürsün.

english: Oh, I'm all too aware of that. Here, I will fade into obscurity as the world forgets my actions. I've accepted it. Besides, it's for the best that I not be remembered.
translation: Oh, bunun cok iyi farkindayim. Burada, dünya yaptiklarimi unuturken ben de unutulup gidecegim. Bunu kabullendim. Ayrica, hatirlanmamam en iyisi.

english: I only hope that the work I did for my home endures. Everything I did was to ensure that Lovakengj prospered.
translation: Sadece vatanim icin yaptigim islerin kalici olmasini umuyorum. Yaptigim her sey Lovakengj'in refahi icindi.

english: I'm sure they'll be just fine. If anything, I imagine they're better off without you.
translation: Eminim onlar iyi olacaklardir. Hatta, sensiz daha iyi olacaklarini düsünüyorum.

english: Don't be so sure. I've no doubt the new king has good intent, but our intentions mean little compared to our actions.
translation: O kadar emin olma. Yeni kralin iyi niyetli olduguna süphem yok, ama niyetlerimiz eylemlerimize kiyasla cok az sey ifade ediyor.

english: Something you're all too aware of, I'm sure.
Indeed. But I guess only time will tell. Farewell human.
translation: Dogru. Ama sanirim bunu sadece zaman gösterecek. Elveda insan.

english: Who are you?
What are the Doors of Dinh?
I'll get going.
Ahahahaha! I am Count Check, the renowned security expert. Would you like me to check your account to see if it is secure?
translation: Ahahahaha! Ben ünlü güvenlik uzmani Kont Check. Hesabinin güvenli olup olmadigini kontrol etmemi ister misin?

english: Check my account, Count Check!
You have a Jagex Account, and you have set a Bank PIN, so you pass my checks! As you've passed my check for the first time, I award you a prize.
translation: Jagex hesabiniz var ve banka PIN'i belirlemissiniz, bu yüzden kontrolümü gectiniz! Kontrolümü ilk kez gectiginiz icin size bir ödül veriyorum.

english: You have a Jagex Account, and you have set a Bank PIN, so you pass my checks! As you've passed my check before, there's no prize now.
translation: Jagex hesabiniz var ve banka PIN'i belirlemissiniz, bu yüzden kontrolümü gectiniz! Kontrolümü daha önce gectiginiz icin bu sefer ödül yok.

english: You do not have a Jagex Account, so you fail my checks! You should upgrade before we meet again.
translation: Jagex hesabiniz yok, bu yüzden kontrolümü gecemediniz! Tekrar görüsmeden önce hesabinizi yükseltmelisiniz.

english: You do not have a Jagex Account, nor a Bank PIN, so so you fail my checks! Please upgrade before we meet again.
translation: Jagex hesabiniz ve banka PIN kodunuz yok, bu yüzden kontrolümü gecemediniz! Tekrar görüsmeden önce hesabinizi yükseltin.

english: Can you give me any advice?
I can! Count with the Count as I count the steps to securing your account:
translation: Tabii ki! Hesabinizi güvenli hale getirmek icin adimlari sayarken Kont ile birlikte sayin:

english: ONE... unique password!
Never use the same password for different accounts, or on different websites. If it got leaked, all of your accounts would become vulnerable at once!
translation: Farkli hesaplar veya farkli web siteleri icin asla ayni sifreyi kullanmayin. Sifreniz sizdirilirsa, tüm hesaplariniz bir anda güvenli olmaktan cikar!

english: TWO... step verification for your email account!
translation: IKI... e-posta hesabiniz icin adimli dogrulama!

english: Good email providers let you set up two-step verification, maybe by generating security codes on a second device, or by sending codes to your phone. Make sure you've enabled this.
translation: Iyi e-posta saglayicilari, ikinci bir cihazda güvenlik kodlari olusturarak veya telefonunuza kodlar göndererek iki adimli dogrulama ayarlamaniza izin verir. Bunu etkinlestirdiginizden emin olun.

english: THREE... Um... Use a Jagex Account. I can see you already do this.
translation: ÜC... Sey... Jagex Hesabi kullanin. Zaten bunu yaptiginizi görüyorum.

english: Carry on.
What's that got to do with THREE?
translation: Bunun ÜC ile ne ilgisi var?

english: Look, I'd got something for ONE, TWO and FOUR, and I like counting, okay? Don't interrupt my flow!
translation: Bakin, BIR, IKI ve DÖRT icin bir seyler buldum ve saymayi seviyorum, tamam mi? Akisimi kesmeyin!

english: THREE... Um... Use a Jagex Account.
Visit the RuneScape website and log in to update your Account settings.
translation: RuneScape web sitesini ziyaret edin ve oturum acarak Hesap ayarlarinizi güncelleyin.

english: FOUR... digit Bank PIN! I can see you have set one.
translation: DÖRT... haneli Banka PIN'i! Bir tane ayarladiginizi görüyorum.

english: FOUR... digit Bank PIN!
Next time you visit a bank, talk to a banker and ask to check your PIN settings.
translation: Bir dahaki sefere bankaya gittiginizde, bir banka görevlisiyle konusun ve PIN ayarlarinizi kontrol etmesini isteyin.

english: FOUR... digit Bank PIN! I can see you do not use banks, by the way.
translation: DÖRT... haneli banka PIN kodu! Bu arada, bankalari kullanmadiginizi görüyorum.

english: Muhahahahhaa! Such fun it is to count!
translation: Muhahahahhaa! Saymak ne kadar da eglenceli!

english: Where can I learn more about security?
translation: Güvenlik hakkinda daha fazla bilgiyi nereden edinebilirim?

english: The Stronghold of Security, in Barbarian Village. I see you have not visited it. Would you like to? I can send you straight there - but only once.
translation: Barbar Köyü'ndeki Güvenlik Kalesi'nden. Oraya gitmediginizi görüyorum. Gitmek ister misiniz? Sizi oraya gönderebilirim, ama sadece bir kez.

english: So may I check your account for you?
The Stronghold of Security, in Barbarian Village. There is much to learn there. But while you are here, may I check your account for you?
translation: Barbar Köyü'ndeki Güvenlik Kalesi. Orada ögrenecek cok sey var. Ama buradayken hesabinizi kontrol edebilir miyim?

english: Who are you?
As you may see, I am a vampyre, from Morytania. I left there when I heard the terrible news and now I choose to spend my days warning others of the perils that lay in wait for them.
translation: Gördügünüz gibi, ben Morytania'dan bir vampirim. Kötü haberi duydugumda oradan ayrildim ve simdi günlerimi baskalarini bekleyen tehlikeler konusunda uyarmakla geciriyorum.

english: The perils?
Yes, be warned! The travellers of these lands face danger from outside. Accounts can be stolen, and when that happens one can lose everything one has worked for.
translation: Evet, dikkatli olun! Bu topraklardaki gezginler disaridan gelen tehlikelerle karsi karsiyadir. Hesaplar calinabilir ve bu durumda kisi, ugruna calistigi her seyi kaybedebilir.

english: I've left my vampyric ways behind me, and now I spend my days letting everyone know of this terrible danger.
translation: Vampirlik hayatimi geride biraktim ve simdi günlerimi herkese bu korkunc tehlikeyi anlatarak geciriyorum.

english: In return for my dedication, I have been blessed with the ability to check if adventurers are ready to defend themselves against these account thieves.
translation: Adanmisligimin karsiliginda, maceracilarin bu hesap hirsizlarina karsi kendilerini savunmaya hazir olup olmadiklarini kontrol etme yetenegi ile kutsandim.

english: If you're a vampyre, how did you cross the Salve?
translation: Eger bir vampirsan, Salve'yi nasil gectin?

english: What do you mean? 'If' I am a vampyre? Of course I am a vampyre! See my pale complexion, my teeth, my outfit - how could anyone doubt I am a true vampyre?
translation: Ne demek istiyorsun? “Eger” bir vampirsem? Tabii ki bir vampirim! Soluk tenimi, dislerimi, kiyafetimi görüyorsun - kim benim gercek bir vampir oldugumdan süphe edebilir ki?

english: I used to stalk the night drinking blood like vampyres do, and I am certainly not just a role-playing enthusiast in a costume! Never question that!
translation: Eskiden vampirler gibi geceleri kan icerek dolasirdim ve kesinlikle kostüm giyen bir rol yapma meraklisi degilim! Bunu asla sorgulama!

english: Right.
I'll see you another time.
Ahahahaha! I, Count Check, have checked your account. You have a Jagex Account, and you have set a Bank PIN, so you pass my checks! Enjoy your prize.
translation: Ahahahaha! Ben, Kont Check, hesabini kontrol ettim. Bir Jagex hesabin var ve banka PIN'i belirlemissin, yani kontrolümü gectin! Ödülünün tadini cikar.

english: Ahahahaha! I, Count Check, have checked your account. You do not have a Bank PIN, so you fail my checks! Talk to a banker to set a PIN before we meet again.
translation: Ahahahaha! Ben, Kont Check, hesabini kontrol ettim. Banka PIN'in yok, yani kontrolümü gecemedin! Tekrar görüsmeden önce bir bankaci ile konusup PIN belirle.

english: Ahahahaha! I, Count Check, have checked your account. You do not have a Jagex Account, so you fail my checks! You should upgrade before we meet again.
translation: Ahahahaha! Ben, Kont Check, hesabini kontrol ettim. Jagex hesabin yok, bu yüzden kontrolümü gecemedin! Tekrar görüsmeden önce hesabini yükseltmelisin.

english: To upgrade your account, visit the RuneScape Website and log in to update your Account settings.
translation: Hesabini yükseltmek icin RuneScape web sitesini ziyaret et ve oturum acarak hesap ayarlarini güncelle.

english: Ahahahaha! I, Count Check, have checked your account. You do not have a Jagex Account, nor a Bank PIN, so soyou fail my checks! Please upgrade before we meet again.
translation: Ahahahaha! Ben, Kont Check, hesabini kontrol ettim. Jagex hesabin ve banka PIN kodun yok, bu yüzden kontrolümü gecemedin! Tekrar görüsmeden önce lütfen hesabinizi yükseltin.

english: To set a Bank PIN, talk to a banker and ask to check your PIN settings.
translation: Banka PIN'i ayarlamak icin bir bankaci ile konusun ve PIN ayarlarinizi kontrol etmesini isteyin.

english: I came to check [player name], not you.
translation: Ben Maceraci'yi kontrol etmeye geldim, seni degil.

english: Ahahahaha, [player name]!
Please let me check you, [player name]!
translation: Lütfen seni kontrol etmeme izin ver, Maceraci!

english: I have come to check you, [player name]...
Dialogue 3
Ahahahaha, ONE more person ignored me...
translation: Ahahahaha, bir kisi daha beni görmezden geldi...

english: Hello [player name] you look like you've seen a ghost.
translation: Merhaba Maceraci, hayalet görmüs gibi görünüyorsun.

english: Well, not a ghost, but... well... you're a vampyre aren't you? Shouldn't you be in Morytania?
translation: Sey, hayalet degil, ama... sey... sen bir vampirsin, degil mi? Morytania'da olman gerekmez mi?

english: Ah yes, I miss that place. So lovely and dark. I left there when I heard the terrible news and now I choose to spend the rest of my days warning others of the perils that lay in wait for them.
translation: Ah evet, orayi özlüyorum. Cok güzel ve karanlik bir yer. Kötü haberi duydugumda oradan ayrildim ve simdi geri kalan günlerimi, baskalarini bekleyen tehlikeler konusunda uyarmakla gecirmeye karar verdim.

english: Terrible news? Peril? I don't like the sound of this. Is there something I should know?
translation: Kötü haber mi? Tehlike mi? Bu hosuma gitmedi. Bilmem gereken bir sey mi var?

english: Yes be warned! The travellers of these lands face danger from outside. Accounts that allow them access to this magical place can be stolen and when that happens they could lose everything they have worked so hard
translation: Evet, dikkatli olun! Bu topraklarda seyahat edenler disaridan gelen tehlikelerle karsi karsiya. Bu büyülü yere erisim saglayan hesaplar calinabilir ve bu durumda, cok ugrasarak elde ettikleri her seyi kaybedebilirler.

english: for. I've left my Vampyre ways behind me and now spend my days letting everyone know of this terrible danger. In return for my dedication I have been blessed with a unique ability to be able to check if
translation: Vampirlik hayatimi geride biraktim ve simdi günlerimi herkese bu korkunc tehlikeyi anlatarak geciriyorum. Adanmisligimin karsiliginda, benimle konusan maceracilarin bu hesap hirsizlarina karsi kendilerini savunmaya hazir olup olmadiklarini kontrol edebilecek benzersiz bir yetenekle kutsandim.

english: adventurers who speak with me are ready to defend themselves against these account thieves.
translation: Hesabimin güvenli olup olmadigini kontrol edebilir misin?

english: Can you check to see if my account is secure?
translation: Tamam, hesabinin güvenligini kontrol edeyim, ama önce benim bile göremedigim bazi seyler var. Öncelikle, hesabin icin benzersiz bir sifre olusturmali ve bunu kimseyle paylasmamalisin. Ikincisi,

english: Ok let me check your account security, but before I do there are some things that even I can not see. Firstly you must have a unique password for your account and not share it with anyone else and secondly make
translation: Tamam, hesabinizin güvenligini kontrol edeyim, ama önce benim bile göremedigim bazi seyler var. Öncelikle, hesabiniz icin benzersiz bir sifreye sahip olmalisiniz ve bunu kimseyle paylasmamalisiniz. Ikincisi,

english: sure you have 2 step verification for your registered recovery email. I'll leave it with you to make sure both of those things are in place.
translation: kayitli kurtarma e-postaniz icin 2 adimli dogrulama oldugundan emin olun. Bu iki seyin de yerine getirildiginden emin olmak size kalmis.

english: A unique password that I don't share, and 2 step verification on my email... got it.
translation: Paylasmadigim benzersiz bir sifre ve e-postamda 2 adimli dogrulama... Anladim.

english: Now let me take a look at some of your other security settings for you...
translation: Simdi diger güvenlik ayarlariniza bir göz atayim...

english: You are using the authenticator! Excellent. This will help to keep your account secure.
translation: Dogrulayiciyi kullaniyorsunuz! Harika. Bu, hesabinizin güvenligini saglamaya yardimci olacaktir.

english: You aren't using the authenticator! This is a disaster. You should enable this to keep your account secure. Simply visit the support link on the oldschool.runescape.com website.
translation: Dogrulayiciyi kullanmiyorsunuz! Bu cok kötü. Hesabinizin güvenligini saglamak icin bunu etkinlestirmelisiniz. Oldschool.runescape.com web sitesindeki destek baglantisini ziyaret etmeniz yeterlidir.

english: You have a bank PIN. This is good, but make sure that it's one that can't be easily guessed.
translation: Bir banka PIN kodunuz var. Bu iyi, ancak kolayca tahmin edilemeyecek bir kod oldugundan emin olun.

english: You really should set a bank PIN. If your account does get stolen, your items in the bank and other places like the GE will be safe.
translation: Gercekten bir banka PIN kodu belirlemelisiniz. Hesabiniz calinirsa, bankadaki ve GE gibi diger yerlerdeki esyalariniz güvende olacaktir.

english: Is there an easy way to remember all these account security things?
translation: Tüm bu hesap güvenligi konularini hatirlamanin kolay bir yolu var mi?

english: Yes there is. by counting. I am a count, who likes to count and check accounts. You can ask me to check your account at any time you like and if you want to remember my top tips for account security just ask me
translation: Evet, var. Sayarak. Ben saymayi ve hesaplari kontrol etmeyi seven bir kontum. Istediginiz zaman hesabinizi kontrol etmemi isteyebilirsiniz ve hesap güvenligi icin en önemli ipuclarimi hatirlamak istiyorsaniz,

english: to count for you. The count loves to count.
translation: sizin icin saymami isteyin. Kont saymayi sever.

english: Count with the count to easily remember my top account security tips:
translation: Kont ile birlikte sayarak, en önemli hesap güvenligi ipuclarimi kolayca hatirlayabilirsiniz:

english: One... unique password.
Two... step email verification.
Free... authenticator.
Four... digit bank PIN!
Muhahahahhaa!
Is there somewhere I can learn more about account security?
translation: Hesap güvenligi hakkinda daha fazla bilgi edinebilecegim bir yer var mi?

english: Yes! The Stronghold of Security which can be accessed via Barbarian Village.
translation: Evet! Barbar Köyü üzerinden erisilebilen Güvenlik Kalesi.

english: Check my account, Count Check!
Can you give me any advice?
Carry on.
What's that got to do with THREE?
translation: Bunun ÜC ile ne ilgisi var?

english: Where can I learn more about security?
translation: Güvenlik hakkinda daha fazla bilgiyi nereden edinebilirim?

english: Yes
No
Who are you?
If you're a vampyre, how did you cross the Salve?
translation: Eger bir vampirsan, Salve'yi nasil gectin?

english: I'll see you another time.
Hello - who are you?
Check my account.
Count for me.
Where can I learn more?
Ahahahaha! I, Count Check, have checked your account. You have set a Bank PIN, so you pass my checks! Enjoy your prize.
translation: Ahahahaha! Ben, Kont Check, hesabini kontrol ettim. Banka PIN'i belirlemissin, bu yüzden kontrollerimi gectin! Ödülünün tadini cikar.

english: I must be leaving now.
Hmm, interesting, there appears to be a human trying to talk to me. Is it aware that cows can't talk I wonder? Maybe if I just ignore it, it might go away.
translation: Hmm, ilginc, benimle konusmaya calisan bir insan var gibi görünüyor. Ineklerin konusamadigini biliyor mu acaba? Belki onu görmezden gelirsem gider.

english: The cow is studiously ignoring you.
Do you know what these strange marks mean?
translation: Bu garip isaretlerin ne anlama geldigini biliyor musun?

english: Can't the human take a hint? I've been ignoring you! Do you think I would ignore you if I wanted to discuss your Rorschach ink-blots ?
translation: Insanlar ipucunu anlamiyor mu? Seni görmezden geliyorum! Rorschach mürekkep lekelerini tartismak isteseydim seni görmezden gelir miydim sence?

english: Hello!
I'm in so much trouble, can you help?
translation: Basim büyük belada, yardim edebilir misin?

english: What with?
I was bad and opened my present early and now the cows tails are falling off!
translation: Yaramazlik yaptim ve hediyemi erken actim, simdi ineklerin kuyruklari düsüyor!

english: I'm not quite sure how those two things are linked... but ok.
translation: Bu iki seyin birbiriyle nasil baglantili oldugunu tam olarak anlamadim... ama tamam.

english: Jack Frost saw me, and cursed me. Why else do you think my hair is green?? Oh please help! Find tails and put them back on the cows.
translation: Jack Frost beni gördü ve lanetledi. Sacimin yesil olmasinin baska nedeni ne olabilir ki? Lütfen yardim et! Kuyruklari bul ve ineklere geri tak.

english: Where do I find the tails?
They sometimes drop off if you kill them.
Um... ok! This is possibly the weirdest thing I've ever been asked to do... But why not?
translation: Um... tamam! Bu muhtemelen bana simdiye kadar istenen en tuhaf sey... Ama neden olmasin?

english: Hello.
Hello there! Are you interested in hearing all about crafting?
translation: Merhaba! Zanaatkarlik hakkinda her seyi duymak ister misin?

english: How can I train my crafting?
To get started, you might like to try your hand at crafting some armour from cow's leather. There's a tanner just over in Al Kharid who could tan any hides for you.
translation: Baslamak icin, inek derisinden zirh yapmayi deneyebilirsin. Al Kharid'de senin icin herhangi bir deriyi tabaklayabilecek bir tabakci var.

english: Once you've managed to get your hand on some kind of leather, you just need a needle and some thread to get to work!
translation: Bir tür deri bulduktan sonra, ise koyulmak icin sadece bir igne ve biraz iplik gerekir!

english: If that doesn't take your fancy, you could try your hand at spinning wool right here on the spinning wheel.
translation: Bu hosuna gitmezse, burada, egirme carkinda yün egirmeyi deneyebilirsin.

english: Come to think of it... Farmer Fred, just north of here, sounds like he could use a hand shearing some of his sheep. Maybe you could help him out, and get some practice while you're at it.
translation: Düsündüm de... Buradan biraz kuzeyde yasayan Ciftci Fred, koyunlarini kirpmak icin yardima ihtiyaci var gibi görünüyor. Belki ona yardim edebilir ve bu sirada biraz pratik yapabilirsiniz.

english: Thanks!
Is there anything else you want to know?
translation: Baska bilmek istediginiz bir sey var mi?

english: Lots of budding craftsmen seem to spend their time here spinning Flax into bow strings on the wheel, if that takes your fancy.
translation: Bircok acemi zanaatkar, burada carkta keten ipligi egirerek yay ipi yapmaya zaman harciyor, eger bu ilginizi cekiyorsa.

english: Or you might like to try your hand at crafting some armour from cow's leather. There's a tanner just over in Al Kharid who could tan any hides for you.
translation: Ya da inek derisinden zirh yapimini deneyebilirsiniz. Al Kharid'de sizin icin herhangi bir deriyi tabaklayabilecek bir tabakci var.

english: Now that you've got a little experience under your belt, the world's your oyster!
translation: Artik biraz deneyim kazandiginiza göre, dünya sizin istiridyeniz!

english: I can't help but feel like I should be the one asking you! At this point, the world's your oyster!
translation: Size bunu sormam gerektigini hissediyorum! Bu noktada, dünya sizin istiridyeniz!

english: If you wanted to try your hand at making some jewellery, you'll want to get your hand on some gold and some kind of gem, with a mould to work with and a chisel at hand.
translation: Taki yapimini denemek isterseniz, altin ve bir tür mücevher, calismak icin bir kalip ve bir keski edinmeniz gerekir.

english: But if that's not your thing, maybe you'd like to try making some more armour!
translation: Ama bu size göre degilse, belki de biraz daha zirh yapmayi denemek istersiniz!

english: Cow's leather's a good place to start, but you can try all other kinds of hides, like a dragon's!
translation: Inek derisi baslamak icin iyi bir secimdir, ama ejderha derisi gibi diger tüm deri türlerini de deneyebilirsiniz!

english: Glass blowing seems to be a popular trade, too. You can forge molten glass from some sand and soda ash, then make all kinds of things using a glass blowing pipe.
translation: Cam üfleme de popüler bir zanaat gibi görünüyor. Kum ve soda külünden erimis cam elde edebilir, ardindan cam üfleme borusu kullanarak her türlü seyi yapabilirsiniz.

english: Is there anything else you want to know
translation: Baska bilmek istediginiz bir sey var mi?

english: What kinds of things can be crafted?
All kinds of things, really! You can make armour from leather, make some pottery, try your hand at glass blowing, make some jewellery, weapons even...
translation: Gercekten her türlü sey! Deriden zirh yapabilir, cömlek yapabilir, cam üflemeyi deneyebilir, mücevher, hatta silah bile yapabilirsiniz...

english: What would you like to hear about?
Tell me about crafting armour.
Sure thing! Most armour you can craft just involves taking a needle and some thread to whatever material you can get your hands on.
translation: Tabii ki! Yapabileceginiz zirhlarin cogu, elinize gecirebileceginiz herhangi bir malzemeyi igne ve iplikle dikmekten ibarettir.

english: You might like to try with different kinds of animal hide, from cows, yaks, snakes, dragons... Or any other sort of fabric you can find!
translation: Inek, yak, yilan, ejderha gibi farkli hayvan derilerini deneyebilirsiniz... Ya da bulabileceginiz baska herhangi bir kumasi!

english: Some crafty types have started making some leather- covered wooden shields recently, too!
translation: Bazi zanaatkarlar son zamanlarda deri kapli tahta kalkanlar da yapmaya basladi!

english: You might find some creatures make for a pretty sturdy helmet, too. The best way to make something like that's just to take a good old chisel to it!
translation: Bazi yaratiklarin da oldukca saglam kasklar yapabilecegini göreceksin. Böyle bir sey yapmak icin en iyi yol, eski usul bir keski kullanmaktir!

english: That sounds great.
Would you like to hear about anything else I mentioned?
translation: Bahsettigim diger konulardan birini duymak ister misin?

english: Tell me about pottery.
Of course! Pottery's all kind of the same, it just takes a lot of getting used to.
translation: Tabii ki! Cömlekcilik her yerde aynidir, sadece alismak biraz zaman alir.

english: All that there really is to it is getting your hands on some clay, getting it wet and getting to work on a potter's wheel.
translation: Tek yapman gereken biraz kil bulmak, onu islatmak ve cömlekci carkinda calismaya baslamak.

english: Once you've got the shape you want out of it, you want to put it in a pottery oven to fire it up.
translation: Istedigin sekli verdikten sonra, cömlek firinina koyup pisirmelisin.

english: The barbarians west of Varrock seem to be pretty keen on their pottery. I'd take a look around there, if you wanted to try it out!
translation: Varrock'un batisindaki barbarlar cömlekcilige oldukca merakli görünüyorlar. Denemek istersen oraya bir göz atabilirsin!

english: Once you get the hang of it, you can make pots, pie dishes, bowls... You know.
translation: Bir kez alistiginizda, cömlekler, turta tabaklari, kaseler yapabilirsiniz... Bilirsiniz.

english: Neat!
Tell me about glass blowing.
translation: Cam üfleme hakkinda biraz bilgi verin.

english: Glass blowing? Well, to get started you'll need to get yourself some molten glass. You can make some for yourself by heating sand and soda ash in a furnace.
translation: Cam üfleme mi? Baslamak icin erimis cam bulmaniz gerekir. Firinda kum ve soda külü isitarak kendiniz yapabilirsiniz.

english: Once you've got a hold of that, you'll want a glass blowing pipe to blow it out in to shape, before it cools down.
translation: Bunu elde ettikten sonra, sogumadan önce sekil vermek icin cam üfleme borusu gerekir.

english: It's not the easiest thing to get to grips with, but it shouldn't be too difficult!
translation: Ögrenmesi cok kolay bir sey degil, ama cok da zor olmamali!

english: Nifty.
Tell me about making jewellery.
Sure. All it boils down to is a bar of gold or silver, some kind of cut gem if you're feeling fancy, and a mould to help shape the thing.
translation: Tabii. Tek ihtiyaciniz olan bir altin veya gümüs külce, eger lüks bir sey istiyorsaniz bir tür kesilmis mücevher ve sekillendirmek icin bir kalip.

english: You can use a chisel to make a gem really shine and sparkle. You wouldn't want to use an uncut one for any jewellery.
translation: Bir keski kullanarak mücevheri gercekten parlatabilir ve isiltili hale getirebilirsiniz. Kesilmemis bir mücevheri mücevher yapiminda kullanmak istemezsiniz.

english: Once you've got all of your materials together, you'll want to use a furnace to actually craft whatever it is you're trying to make!
translation: Tüm malzemeleri bir araya getirdikten sonra, yapmak istediginiz seyi gercekten yapmak icin bir firin kullanmak isteyeceksiniz!

english: Wizards seem to like enchanting their jewellery to do all kinds of things, too, but I don't know a lot about that.
translation: Büyücüler mücevherlerini her türlü sey yapabilmesi icin büyülü hale getirmeyi seviyor gibi görünüyor, ama ben bu konuda pek bilgim yok.

english: Sounds good!
Tell me about crafting weapons.
Well, there aren't too many weapons that people tend to craft, but there are a couple worth noting!
translation: Insanlarin yapmaya egilimli oldugu cok fazla silah yok, ama dikkat cekici birkac tane var!

english: Battlestaves are probably the most common. It boils down to fastening an orb of some kind onto the end of a battlestaff.
translation: Savas asalari muhtemelen en yaygin olanidir. Savas asasinin ucuna bir tür küre takmakla yapilir.

english: You do need to get the orb in the first place, though... You can make one through glass blowing, but it's not much use without being charged.
translation: Ama önce küreyi bulman gerekir... Cam üflemeyle yapabilirsin, ama sarj edilmeden pek bir ise yaramaz.

english: I can't help much with crafting it, though! There's a little more magic involved there than I'm familiar with.
translation: Ama yapiminda pek yardimci olamam! Benim bildigimden biraz daha fazla büyü gerektiriyor.

english: Aside from battlestaves, there are a couple of weapons that people like to make from silver... Sickles and bolts, usually.
translation: Savas sopalarinin yani sira, insanlar gümüsten yapmayi sevdikleri birkac silah daha var... Genellikle orak ve oklar.

english: Interesting...
Not right now.
No, thank you.
Well, just come back any time you want to know anything!
translation: Peki, ne zaman bir sey ögrenmek istersen gel!

english: How can I train my crafting?
What kinds of things can be crafted?
Tell me about crafting armour.
Tell me about pottery.
Tell me about glass blowing.
Tell me about making jewellery.
Tell me about crafting weapons.
Not right now.
No, thank you.
Excuse me, I need to deliver this.
Hey, a crawling hand!
Yes, what?
[House owner] must be pretty handy to have slayed that!
translation: [Ev sahibi] onu öldürmek icin oldukca becerikli olmali!

english: Hey, I was going to make some furniture, do you think you could lend a HAND?
translation: Hey, biraz mobilya yapacaktim, bana ELINI uzatabilir misin?

english: Very funny.
Hey, hand, do you want to know how I slayed you?
translation: Hey, el, seni nasil öldürdügümü bilmek ister misin?

english: I don't know, how?
Because you're just a hand! You're ARMLESS!
translation: Cünkü sen sadece bir elsin! KOLUN YOK!

english: Hey, you're just a hand, right? So what do you eat?
translation: Hey, sen sadece bir elsin, degil mi? Peki ne yiyorsun?

english: Finger food, of course!
Rain of knowledge!
Ow!
You belong in a museum!
I'm Bellock - respect me!
Get off my site!
These ruins are mine!
Taste my knowledge!
No-one messes with Bellock's dig!
Where did you get that lens?
From that strange metal thing up on the hill.
You should give that back!
Even if it's cracked?
Ah, well, I suppose it's of no use. But, still.
translation: Ah, sanirim bir ise yaramaz. Ama yine de.

english: Was that a spark?
Come on! Please light!
Hello there. Have you come to reflect?
I'm not sure.
It's not for everyone. You are always welcome to pray to Seren here if you wish though. If you prefer, I can offer you the ability to respawn in Prifddinas upon death.
translation: Bu herkes icin uygun degildir. Ama istersen burada Seren'e dua edebilirsin. Istersen, öldügünde Prifddinas'ta yeniden dogma yetenegi sunabilirim.

english: Yes please.
Then it shall be so. From now on, you will respawn in Prifddinas.
translation: Öyle olsun. Bundan sonra Prifddinas'ta yeniden dogacaksin.

english: No thanks.
As you wish. I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: Nasil istersen. Fikrini degistirirsen ben buradayim.

english: It's not for everyone. You are always welcome to pray to Seren here if you wish though. If you prefer, I can revert your respawn point to Lumbridge.
translation: Bu herkes icin uygun degildir. Ancak dilersen, burada Seren'e dua etmek icin her zaman hos geldin. Istersen, yeniden dogma noktani Lumbridge'e geri alabilirim.

english: Then it shall be so. From now on, you will respawn in Lumbridge.
translation: Öyle olsun o zaman. Bundan sonra, Lumbridge'de yeniden dogacaksin.

english: As you wish. If you ever tire of respawning in Prifddinas, just let me know.
translation: Nasil istersen. Prifddinas'ta yeniden dogmaktan sikilirsan, bana haber ver.

english: Yes please.
No thanks.
Hello there!
Who are you?
I'm the crew registrar. Here to cut through the red tape of crew management for anyone who needs it!
translation: Ben mürettebat kayit memuruyum. Ihtiyaci olan herkes icin mürettebat yönetiminin bürokratik islemlerini kolaylastirmak icin buradayim!

english: A lot of paperwork in managing a crew is there?
translation: Mürettebat yönetimi cok fazla evrak isi gerektiriyor mu?

english: You'd be surprised. Quality assurance guideline QA-275 states all crew must be appropriately fit and healthy after being subjected to QA form QA-275.
translation: Sasiracaksin. Kalite güvence kilavuzu QA-275, tüm mürettebatin QA formu QA-275'e tabi tutulduktan sonra uygun sekilde zinde ve saglikli olmasi gerektigini belirtir.

english: QA-123 requires all crew to pass a mandatory cargo data protection course if the ship can be fitted with a cargo hold.
translation: QA-123, gemiye kargo ambari takilabiliyorsa tüm mürettebatin zorunlu kargo veri koruma kursunu gecmesini gerektirir.

english: Then of course we have QA-441, which defines the background checks that any crewmate operating a sail must pass. And all that's without even considering QA- 215...
translation: Tabii ki QA-441 da var, bu kilavuzda yelkeni kullanan tüm mürettebatin gecmesi gereken gecmis kontrolü tanimlaniyor. Ve tüm bunlar QA-215'i hesaba katmadan...

english: I'm not sure I want to manage a crew now...
translation: Artik mürettebat yönetmek istedigimden emin degilim...

english: Don't worry, I'll deal with most of the technical details for you.
translation: Merak etmeyin, teknik detaylarin cogunu sizin icin halledecegim.

english: And if I miss something, the fines are usually fairly small!
translation: Ve bir seyi atlarsam, cezalar genellikle oldukca düsük!

english: Can I manage my crew?
I'm afraid you have no crew to manage right now.
translation: Maalesef su anda yönetebileceginiz bir mürettebatiniz yok.

english: Crew are not available in the alpha, but expect to see more of them in the future!
translation: Mürettebat alfa sürümünde mevcut degil, ancak gelecekte daha fazlasini görmeyi bekleyin!

english: Goodbye.
See ya!
That all sounds a bit much!
Well, it's not for everyone. Still, if you ever find yourself in need of a crew, you know where to find me.
translation: Herkes icin uygun olmayabilir. Yine de, bir mürettebata ihtiyacin olursa, beni nerede bulacagini biliyorsun.

english: Who are you?
Can I manage my crew?
Goodbye.
Of course!
What are you drinking?
Blood!
How are you getting drunk on blood?
They keep some of the tithes drunk all the time and then take it from them.
translation: Vergilerin bir kismini sürekli sarhos tutuyorlar ve sonra onlardan aliyorlar.

english: How very creative.
I know right! Bloody brilliant!
Hello.
I'll have a pint please.
I don't work here.
Sure you do!
No, I really don't.
Well clear off then.
Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: Insan! Muhafizlari cagirmadan köle kafeslerine geri dön!

english: Amascut's hold on me is finally at an end. Human, let us return to the Nexus.
translation: Amascut'un üzerimdeki etkisi sonunda sona erdi. Insan, Nexus'a dönelim.

english: Human.
Not feeling talkative?
I'm sure you will find a conversation with me more appealing than one with Scabaras. Still, I leave most of the talking to Apmeken.
translation: Eminim benimle konusmak Scabaras'la konusmaktan daha cekici gelecektir. Yine de konusmayi cogunlukla Apmeken'e birakiyorum.

english: Now, I can't support you in your fight, but if you can free the others, we'll be able to open the way to Amascut.
translation: Su anda mücadelenizde size destek olamam, ama digerlerini kurtarabilirseniz, Amascut'a giden yolu acabilecegiz.

english: Human, we've opened the way to Amascut, but we can do no more. From here, it's up to you.
translation: Insan, Amascut'a giden yolu actik, ama daha fazlasini yapamayiz. Buradan sonrasi sana kalmis.

english: Here he is!
My friend, you managed what few have ever achieved. You overcame Amascut herself! I wish I could have been there to see it!
translation: Dostum, cok az kisinin basardigi bir seyi basardin. Amascut'un kendisini yendin! Keske ben de orada olabilseydim.

english: Well I couldn't have done it alone. Speaking of which, where's Scabaras?
translation: Tek basima yapamazdim. Bu arada, Scabaras nerede?

english: Scabaras walks his own path. Do not consider his absence an insult. This is his way.
translation: Scabaras kendi yolunda ilerliyor. Onun yoklugunu bir hakaret olarak görmeyin. Bu onun tarzi.

english: Not to mention that he was under Amascut's control far longer than the rest of us. It will take him time to come to terms with his role in her plots.
translation: Amascut'un kontrolü altinda bizimkinden cok daha uzun süre kaldigini da unutmayin. Onun komplolarindaki rolünü kabullenmesi zaman alacak.

english: Don't worry, he'll be okay. He always is.
translation: Merak etmeyin, o iyi olacak. Her zaman oldugu gibi.

english: Before we go any further... We didn't have much time for conversation back in the tomb. I'm sure you have some questions for us.
translation: Devam etmeden önce... Mezarin icinde konusmak icin fazla vaktimiz olmadi. Eminim bize soracak sorulariniz vardir.

english: If you do, now is the time to ask them.
translation: Varsa, simdi sormak icin uygun bir zaman.

english: I have a question for Apmeken.
What's your role in the Menaphite Pantheon?
I'm Tumeken's avatar of companionship! Tumeken himself was always considered a bit cold, which is a tad ironic when you think about it.
translation: Ben Tumeken'in dostluk avatariyim! Tumeken her zaman biraz soguk biri olarak görülürdü, ki bunu düsündügünde biraz ironik.

english: A cold sun god?
Exactly! Bit odd, right? Still, although he wasn't exactly known for his social side, he still understood the importance of such things. That's why he made me!
translation: Aynen! Biraz tuhaf, degil mi? Yine de, sosyal yönüyle taninmasa da, bu tür seylerin önemini anliyordu. Bu yüzden beni yaratti!

english: My job is to make sure everyone remembers the importance of friendship. After all, we all need a friend or two, or ten, or maybe hundreds! Have as many as you want! I won't judge.
translation: Benim görevim, herkesin dostlugun önemini hatirlamasini saglamak. Sonucta, hepimizin bir veya iki, on veya belki yüzlerce arkadasa ihtiyaci var! Istediginiz kadar arkadas edin! Ben yargilamam.

english: Why aren't there more monkeys or apes in the desert?
translation: Cölde neden daha fazla maymun veya goril yok?

english: Ah, you can thank Amascut for that. The desert used to be home to thousands of apes and monkeys, but she targeted them to try and get to me.
translation: Ah, bunun icin Amascut'a tesekkür edebilirsiniz. Cöl eskiden binlerce goril ve maymuna ev sahipligi yapiyordu, ama o bana ulasmak icin onlari hedef aldi.

english: I'm sorry.
Don't be! Now that I'm back, I know we can turn things around!
translation: Üzülme! Artik geri döndügüme göre, durumu tersine cevirebilecegimizi biliyorum!

english: Actually, I've changed my mind.
Fair enough.
I'll be back soon.
We'll be here when you're ready.
I have a question for Crondis.
I am Tumeken's avatar of resourcefulness.
Meaning?
Meaning my job is to guide the people of the desert not to live lives of excess.
translation: Yani benim görevim, cöl halkina asiriya kacmadan yasamayi ögretmek.

english: Guessing you're not a fan of Menaphos then?
translation: O zaman Menaphos'u pek sevmiyorsun galiba?

english: Much of the desert has forgotten the importance of modesty in my absence, but the situation in Menaphos is definitely the most concerning. Let us hope it can soon be rectified.
translation: Ben yokken cölün büyük bir kismi tevazuun önemini unutmus, ama Menaphos'taki durum kesinlikle en endise verici. Umarim yakinda düzelir.

english: Why are crocodiles so rude?
Rude? How so.
Well they always try to eat me when I go near them.
translation: Sey, ben yanlarina yaklastigimda her zaman beni yemeye calisiyorlar.

english: The life of a crocodile is not an easy one. They must seek food wherever it is available.
translation: Timsahlarin hayati kolay degildir. Yiyecek bulabildikleri her yerde yiyecek aramak zorundadirlar.

english: Besides, I sense you do not speak the whole truth. Did you not befriend a crocodile yourself in times past?
translation: Ayrica, tüm gercegi söylemedigini hissediyorum. Gecmiste bir timsahla arkadas olmadin mi?

english: You mean Roger! I guess he was quite friendly.
translation: Roger'i mi kastediyorsun! Sanirim o oldukca dost canlisiydi.

english: Then perhaps crocodiles are not as rude as you think.
translation: O zaman belki de timsahlar sandigin kadar kaba degildir.

english: As you wish.
We will be here.
I have a question for Het.
I am Tumeken's avatar of health, both physical and mental.
translation: Ben Tumeken'in hem fiziksel hem de zihinsel saglik avatariyim.

english: You talk about strength and fighting a lot. Surely fighting isn't good for someone's health.
translation: Güc ve kavga hakkinda cok konusuyorsun. Kavga etmek birinin sagligi icin iyi degildir.

english: Well when it comes to health, is strength not the ultimate goal? The strongest individual is one who is healthy in both body and mind, and what better way to celebrate that strength than in combat!
translation: Saglik söz konusu oldugunda, güc nihai hedef degil midir? En güclü kisi, hem bedenen hem de zihnen saglikli olandir ve bu gücü kutlamanin kavgadan daha iyi bir yolu olabilir mi!

english: I guess, but what about those who aren't strong?
translation: Sanirim, ama güclü olmayanlar ne olacak?

english: Well health is not something to be hoarded, is it? Most weaknesses can be overcome, and it is the duty of the strong to help those less fortunate.
translation: Saglik biriktirilecek bir sey degildir, degil mi? Cogu zayiflik asilabilir ve güclü olanlarin görevi, daha az sansli olanlara yardim etmektir.

english: So they can become strong and healthy themselves?
translation: Böylece onlar da güclü ve saglikli olabilirler mi?

english: Exactly!
An interesting question. Why do you ask?
Considering you have a human appearance, I wondered if that might resonate more with people.
translation: Insan görünümüne sahip oldugunu düsünürsek, bunun insanlara daha cok hitap edip etmeyecegini merak ettim.

english: Not as much as you might think. Believe it or not, in some ways, I'm actually considered a bit boring! Why follow the human when you have a baboon god?
translation: Düsündügün kadar degil. Ister inan ister inanma, bazi yönlerden aslinda biraz sikici bulunuyorum! Babun tanrin varken neden insani takip edesin ki?

english: Especially when the baboon god is so fun to be around!
translation: Özellikle de babun tanrinin yaninda olmak cok eglenceli iken!

english: Of course, people just following one of us was never really the intention anyway. We're a pantheon, and we all have a part to play.
translation: Tabii ki, insanlarin sadece birimizi takip etmesi zaten hic amaclanmamisti. Biz bir panteonuz ve hepimizin oynayacagi bir rol var.

english: Now that Amascut is running with her tail between her legs, perhaps we can remind people of that.
translation: Amascut kuyrugunu kistirip kacarken, belki de insanlara bunu hatirlatabiliriz.

english: Very well.
We'll wait for you to return.
I have a question for all of you.
What will happen with Amascut?
I'd say that's up to her. If she doesn't change her ways, her fate won't be pretty.
translation: Bence bu ona bagli. Eger davranislarini degistirmezse, kaderi pek de güzel olmayacak.

english: But it's never too late for redemption. There might still be hope for her.
translation: Ama kurtulus icin asla gec degildir. Hala umut olabilir.

english: Whatever path she takes, we will be ready.
translation: Hangi yolu secerse secsin, biz hazir olacagiz.

english: Do you really think she'd change her ways at this point?
translation: Bu noktada davranislarini degistirecegini gercekten düsünüyor musun?

english: It seems unlikely, but there is one who might be able to change that.
translation: Olasi görünmüyor, ama bunu degistirebilecek biri var.

english: Who?
Icthlarin! If anyone can help Amascut find her way again, it's him!
translation: Icthlarin! Amascut'un yolunu bulmasina yardim edebilecek biri varsa, o da odur!

english: He doesn't seem to have been doing much to help so far.
translation: Simdiye kadar pek yardim etmis gibi görünmüyor.

english: Icthlarin is limited in what he can do. His duties to the dead require constant attention.
translation: Icthlarin'in yapabilecekleri sinirli. Ölüler icin görevleri sürekli dikkat gerektiriyor.

english: Not to mention the pact!
Pact?
That is not for us to discuss.
translation: Bu bizim tartisacagimiz bir konu degil.

english: Oh yes, sorry. Maybe we should talk about something else.
translation: Evet, özür dilerim. Belki baska bir sey hakkinda konusmaliyiz.

english: Are you actually gods?
If you asked a citizen of these lands, I'm sure they'd probably say yes.
translation: Bu topraklardaki bir vatandasa sorsaydiniz, muhtemelen evet derdi.

english: Indeed, but they would not be truly correct.
translation: Dogru, ama tam olarak dogru olmazdi.

english: How so?
Tumeken made us using his own divine essence! Each of us is a piece of him!
translation: Tumeken bizi kendi ilahi özünü kullanarak yaratti! Her birimiz onun bir parcasiyiz!

english: But that does not make us gods. While great, our power is insignificant compared to a true god. That is why they are gone, and we remain.
translation: Ama bu bizi tanri yapmaz. Gücümüz büyük olsa da, gercek bir tanriya kiyasla önemsizdir. Bu yüzden onlar gitti, biz kaldik.

english: So what are you really?
