You might hear some refer to us as the Avatars of Tumeken. We'd consider that a more fitting title.
translation: Bazilari bizi Tumeken'in Avatarlari olarak adlandirir. Biz de bu unvani daha uygun buluyoruz.

english: What about Icthlarin and Amascut?
Tumeken made them too. Difference is, they also have some of Elidinis' divine essence, making them a lot more powerful!
translation: Onlari da Tumeken yaratti. Farki, onlarin Elidinis'in ilahi özünden de pay aldiklari icin cok daha güclü olmalari!

english: But again, they are not true gods.
translation: Ama yine de, onlar gercek tanrilar degiller.

english: Amascut was hoping to change that today, but you showed her where to stick that plan!
translation: Amascut bugün bunu degistirmek istiyordu, ama sen ona o plani nereye sokacagini gösterdin!

english: So what happens now?
We are the Avatars of Tumeken, and the Kharidian Desert has been without guidance for too long. It is time we fixed that.
translation: Biz Tumeken'in Avatarlariyiz ve Kharidian Cölü cok uzun süredir rehberlikten yoksun. Bunu düzeltmenin zamani geldi.

english: We're going to get started right away!
But don't worry, we don't intend to miss the fight against Amascut. I hope you'll stand alongside us when that day comes.
translation: Ama merak etme, Amascut'la olan savasi kacirmak niyetinde degiliz. O gün geldiginde bizimle birlikte olacagini umuyorum.

english: For now though, this is goodbye. We will meet again, human.
translation: Simdilik hosca kal. Tekrar görüsecegiz, insan.

english: It was great to meet you. Thank you for helping us!
translation: Tanistigimiza memnun oldum. Yardim ettiginiz icin tesekkürler!

english: The avatars depart.
You're back!
If you have questions, now is the time to ask them.
translation: Sorulariniz varsa, simdi sormak icin uygun zaman.

english: I have a question for Apmeken.
What's your role in the Menaphite Pantheon?
Why aren't there more monkeys or apes in the desert?
translation: Cölde neden daha fazla maymun veya goril yok?

english: Actually, I've changed my mind.
I'll be back soon.
I have a question for Crondis.
Why are crocodiles so rude?
I have a question for Het.
Do you have more followers than the others?
translation: Digerlerinden daha fazla takipcin var mi?

english: I have a question for all of you.
What will happen with Amascut?
Are you actually gods?
So what happens now?
Nilsal, my child. Welcome to this holy temple of Ralos.
translation: Nilsal, cocugum. Ralos'un kutsal tapinagina hos geldin.

english: Thank you.
If there is anything I can do for you, please just let me know.
translation: Senin icin yapabilecegim bir sey varsa, lütfen bana söyle.

english: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
Sorry, but I cannot.
Of course.
The teoki whispers a prayer and you suddenly feel a bit better.
translation: Teoki bir dua fisildar ve sen aniden biraz daha iyi hissedersin.

english: What is it you do here?
I am one of the seven teoki in service to Ralos.
translation: Ben Ralos'a hizmet eden yedi teokiden biriyim.

english: Seven? That's quite a specific number.
translation: Yedi mi? Oldukca belirli bir sayi.

english: Indeed. Along with our counterparts from the Sect of Ranul, each of us is responsible for one of seven key holy sites across the region.
translation: Evet. Ranul Tarikati'ndaki meslektaslarimizla birlikte, her birimiz bölgedeki yedi önemli kutsal yerden birinden sorumluyuz.

english: As you have likely guessed, my duty is to maintain the temple here in Fortis.
translation: Tahmin ettiginiz gibi, benim görevim Fortis'teki bu tapinagi korumak.

english: I'd best get going.
Timoiva, and may the sun light your way.
Can you heal me? I'm injured.
What is it you do here?
I'd best get going.
Hello. Nice day for a walk, isn't it?
translation: Merhaba. Yürüyüs icin güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: A walk? Oh yes, that's what we're doing. We're just out here for a walk.
translation: Yürüyüs mü? Evet, biz de onu yapiyoruz. Sadece yürüyüse ciktik.

english: I'm glad you're just out here for a walk. A more suspicious person would think you were waiting here to attack weak-looking travellers.
translation: Sadece yürüyüse ciktiginiza sevindim. Daha süpheci biri, zayif görünen yolculari saldirmak icin burada beklediginizi düsünebilirdi.

english: Nope, we'd never do anything like that. Just a band of innocent walkers, that's us.
translation: Hayir, biz asla böyle bir sey yapmayiz. Biz sadece masum yürüyüscüleriz.

english: Alright, have a nice walk.
Human.
So what do you do?
Drink.
For a living?
Is that a problem?
No, but I can't imagine it pays well.
translation: Hayir, ama iyi para kazandirdigini sanmiyorum.

english: As you've not taken the hint, I'm a hunter. I go out and kill things, sell the results, and then come here to drink.
translation: Ipucunu anlamadigin icin söylüyorum, ben avciyim. Disari cikip hayvanlari öldürürüm, avimi satarim ve sonra buraya icmeye gelirim.

english: Sounds like a fun and varied routine.
translation: Eglenceli ve cesitlilik dolu bir rutin gibi görünüyor.

english: It is. Now, if you'll excuse me.
Oh, well done! You managed to get both halves of the certificate!
translation: Aferin! Sertifikanin iki yarisini da aldin!

english: Welcome to the museum of Varrock.
I have some relics you might be interested in.
Oh, wonderful! We are always eager to expand out collection!
translation: Harika! Koleksiyonumuzu genisletmeye her zaman hevesliyiz!

english: I found them in some ruins underneath Ice Mountain.
translation: Onlari Buz Dagi'nin altindaki bazi kalintilarda buldum.

english: Ruins? Beneath Ice Mountain? That's the first I've heard of this! What did you find down there?
translation: Kalintilar mi? Buz Dagi'nin altinda mi? Bunu ilk kez duyuyorum! Orada ne buldun?

english: An entire city!
A city?! How? Which one? Was anyone living there?
translation: Bir sehir mi?! Nasil? Hangi sehir? Orada kimse yasiyor muydu?

english: Just one person - an Imcando dwarf named Ramarno. He said the city was called Camdozaal.
translation: Sadece bir kisi - Ramarno adinda bir Imcando cücesi. Sehrin adinin Camdozaal oldugunu söyledi.

english: CAMDOZAAL!? You found the lost Imcando city of Camdozaal!?
translation: CAMDOZAAL mi!? Kayip Imcando sehri Camdozaal'i mi buldun!?

english: Not on purpose! It's a long story.
I'm lost for words! You accidentally found the lost  city of Camdozaal! Please let me see these relics.
translation: Sözlerim tükendi! Kayip Camdozaal sehrini tesadüfen buldun! Lütfen bu kalintilari görmeme izin ver.

english: Hmm, this is certainly not of Imcando design. Maybe it's from an older civilisation. How did you come across it?
translation: Hmm, bu kesinlikle Imcando tasarimi degil. Belki daha eski bir medeniyete aittir. Nasil buldun?

english: I found it encased in ore. I had to crack it open and chip off the hardened parts. This was underneath.
translation: Cevherin icinde buldum. Kirip sertlesmis kisimlarini kazimak zorunda kaldim. Altinda bu vardi.

english: My word, a true mystery of an item? How did it get down there?
translation: Vay canina, gercek bir gizemli nesne mi? Oraya nasil girmis?

english: Thank you, kind [sir/lady]! Pass them over to me and I'll identify them properly.
translation: Tesekkürler, nazik ! Onlari bana verin, ben dogru sekilde tanimlayayim.

english: This Ancient globe seems to show new constellations. What a discovery!
translation: Bu antik küre yeni takimyildizlari gösteriyor gibi. Ne kesif ama!

english: I wonder what secrets this Ancient ledger holds. It's a unique find!
translation: Bu antik defterin hangi sirlari sakladigini merak ediyorum. Essiz bir buluntu!

english: An Ancient astroscope. I have only read of such things but to see one, incredible!
translation: Antik bir astroskop. Bunlari sadece kitaplarda okumustum, ama bir tane görmek, inanilmaz!

english: I'm not even familiar with the glyphs in this Ancient treatise. It's the first time I've seen them.
translation: Bu antik eserdeki sembollere bile asina degilim. Onlari ilk kez görüyorum.

english: What a find, this Ancient carcanet has never been documented before, but I'm certain it had a ceremonial purpose.
translation: Ne harika bir buluntu, bu eski kolye daha önce hic belgelenmemisti, ama törenlerde kullanildigina eminim.

english: We already have examples of these other relics in the museum, but they will add nicely to our collection.
translation: Müzede bu tür baska kalintilar da var, ama bunlar koleksiyonumuza güzel bir katki olacak.

english: Using  on Curator Haig Halen:
Talk about the relic found in Camdozaal.
Talk about something else.
Talk about Fossil Island.
I've got some questions regarding Fossil Island.
translation: Fosil Adasi ile ilgili birkaç sorum var.

english: Ah, how can I help?
What can I do with fossils I find on Fossil Island?
translation: Fosil Adasi'nda buldugum fosilleri ne yapabilirim?

english: I'm not entirely sure just yet.
Nevermind.
Have you any interesting news?
We've seen some incredible specimens come back from Fossil Island!
Be sure to bring anything you find back for examination - we've got a brand new Palaeontology room downstairs dedicated to finds from the island.
translation: Buldugunuz her seyi inceleme için mutlaka getirin. Asagida, adadan gelen buluntulara ayrilmis yepyeni bir Paleontoloji odasi var.

english: Do you know where I could find any treasure?
translation: Hazine bulabilecegim bir yer biliyor musunuz?

english: Look around you! This museum is full of treasures!
translation: Etrafiniza bakin! Bu müze hazinelerle dolu!

english: No, I meant treasures for ME.
translation: Hayir, benim için hazineler demek istedim.

english: Any treasures this museum knows about it goes to great lengths to acquire.
translation: Bu müze, bildigi tüm hazineleri elde etmek için büyük çaba sarf eder.

english: Oh dear. You'll need 250 rubies, a Digsite pendant, 100 cosmic runes and 500 fire runes with you I'm afraid.
translation: Ah, hayir. Korkarim 250 yakut, bir Kazi Alani kolyesi, 100 kozmik rün ve 500 ates rününe ihtiyacin olacak.

english: Why, I can give you one now if you wish?
translation: Istersen sana simdi bir tane verebilirim.

english: What can I do with fossils I find on Fossil Island?
translation: Fosil Adasi'nda buldugum fosilleri ne yapabilirim?

english: Nevermind.
Have you any interesting news?
Do you know where I could find any treasure?
translation: Hazine bulabilecegim bir yer biliyor musun?

english: How do I get a medallion?
Yes, exchange my runes, rubies and pendant for a medallion.
translation: Evet, runelerimi, yakutlarimi ve kolyemi madalyonla takas etmek istiyorum.

english: No, keep my stuff.
Hello.
Nilsal to you, iknami. Welcome to the Grand Museum. I hope your visit is a pleasant one. If you have any questions about Varlamore, I'm happy to help.
translation: Sana Nilsal, iknami. Büyük Müze'ye hos geldin. Umarim ziyaretin keyifli gecer. Varlamore hakkinda herhangi bir sorunuz olursa, memnuniyetle yardimci olurum.

english: Could you tell me more about the early history of Varlamore?
translation: Varlamore'un erken tarihi hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misiniz?

english: Certainly! When it comes to the existence of Varlamore, it is Xeric we have to thank. During his Age of Strife, many refugees fled Kourend over the previously unexplored Custodia Mountains.
translation: Elbette! Varlamore'un varligi konusunda tesekkür etmemiz gereken kisi Xeric'tir. Onun Catisma Cagi sirasinda, bircok mülteci daha önce kesfedilmemis Custodia Daglari üzerinden Kourend'den kacti.

english: There were three notable groups of these refugees. The first group, the Talkasti, settled in the Tlati Rainforest.
translation: Bu mülteciler arasinda üc önemli grup vardi. Ilk grup olan Talkasti, Tlati Yagmur Ormani'na yerlesti.

english: While they initially lived nomadic lives, they eventually started to establish more permanent settlements, with Tal Teklan being the first.
translation: Baslangicta göcebe bir yasam sürseler de, sonunda daha kalici yerlesim yerleri kurmaya basladilar ve Tal Teklan bunlardan ilki oldu.

english: The next group were the Pericans. They first settled right here, building the town of Fortis, or Civitas illa Fortis as it eventually became.
translation: Bir sonraki grup Pericanlardi. Ilk olarak buraya yerleserek Fortis kasabasini kurdular, daha sonra bu kasaba Civitas illa Fortis adini aldi.

english: Finally we have the dwarves. These were refugees from Lovakengj who established a home beneath Ralos' Rise, becoming known as the Dwarves of Cam Torum.
translation: Son olarak cüceler var. Bunlar Lovakengj'den gelen mültecilerdi ve Ralos' Rise'in altinda bir yuva kurarak Cam Torum Cüceleri olarak tanindilar.

english: Was there any friction between these groups initially?
translation: Baslangicta bu gruplar arasinda herhangi bir sürtüsme oldu mu?

english: Oh yes, very much so. The dwarves, just as they do today, mostly kept to themselves. However, the Talkasti and Pericans came into regular conflict over various matters.
translation: Evet, cok fazla. Cüceler, tipki bugün oldugu gibi, cogunlukla kendi hallerindeydiler. Ancak Talkasti ve Pericanlar cesitli konularda düzenli olarak catismaya giriyorlardi.

english: But that's not the case now, right? What brought them together?
translation: Ama simdi durum böyle degil, degil mi? Onlari bir araya getiren neydi?

english: As you may well have already guessed, it was religion. Long before leaving Kourend, the Talkasti had taken to secretly worshipping Ralos and Ranul.
translation: Tahmin etmis olabileceginiz gibi, din idi. Kourend'den ayrilmadan cok önce, Talkasti gizlice Ralos ve Ranul'a tapmaya baslamisti.

english: After arriving here, they were able to openly practice their religion for the first time. Over time, the Pericans started to adopt this religion as well.
translation: Buraya geldikten sonra, ilk kez dinlerini acikca yasayabildiler. Zamanla Pericanlar da bu dini benimsemeye basladi.

english: As the two groups came together, the population of the region started to rapidly expand. This eventually led to the construction of Tempestus, and with it, the founding of Varlamore.
translation: Iki grup bir araya geldikce, bölgenin nüfusu hizla artmaya basladi. Bu da sonunda Tempestus'un insasina ve onunla birlikte Varlamore'un kurulmasina yol acti.

english: So are there still distinctions between the Talkasti and the Pericans now?
translation: Peki, Talkasti ve Pericanlar arasinda hala ayrimlar var mi?

english: Yes and no. Those terms are no longer used to describe people today. Since we united, we have all been Varlamorians. However, you'll still find many traces of our previous divide.
translation: Evet ve hayir. Bu terimler artik insanlari tanimlamak icin kullanilmiyor. Birlestigimizden beri hepimiz Varlamorlulariz. Ancak, önceki ayriligimizin izlerini hala görebilirsiniz.

english: For example, here in Fortis, you'll find yourself surrounded by Perican archetecture, whereas over in the Tlati Rainforest, the influence of the Talkasti remains clear.
translation: Örnegin, Fortis'te kendinizi Perican mimarisiyle cevrili bulursunuz, oysa Tlati Yagmur Ormani'nda Talkasti'nin etkisi hala belirgindir.

english: Names are another good example. Indeed, look no further than our rulers. For most of our history, we were ruled by the Tullus dynasty, with Tullus very much being a name of Perican origin.
translation: Isimler de baska bir iyi örnektir. Aslinda, hükümdarlarimiza bakmaniz yeterlidir. Tarihimizin büyük bir bölümünde, Tullus hanedani tarafindan yönetildik ve Tullus, Perican kökenli bir isimdir.

english: However, we are now ruled by the Arkan dynasty, whose name can be traced back to early Talkasti nomads.
translation: Ancak, su anda Arkan hanedani tarafindan yönetiliyoruz ve bu ismin kökeni, eski Talkasti göcebelerine kadar uzaniyor.

english: I see. So where did the name Varlamore come from.
translation: Anliyorum. Peki, Varlamore ismi nereden geliyor?

english: The name comes from the River Varla that separated Talkasti and Perican territory. What was once a symbol of our divide, became the symbol of our unification.
translation: Bu isim, Talkasti ve Perican topraklarini ayiran Varla Nehri'nden geliyor. Bir zamanlar bölünmemizin sembolü olan bu nehir, birlesmemizin sembolü haline geldi.

english: That was all super interesting! Thanks for the information.
translation: Bunlar cok ilgincti! Bilgiler icin tesekkürler.

english: Not a problem, iknami!
I'd better get going. Thanks again.
Could you tell me more about religion in Varlamore?
translation: Varlamore'daki din hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misiniz?

english: Of course! Whereas in other parts of the world you'll likely find followers of many gods, here in Varlamore, you'll only really find those dedicated to Ralos and Ranul.
translation: Tabii ki! Dünyanin diger bölgelerinde bircok tanrinin takipcileri varken, Varlamore'da sadece Ralos ve Ranul'a adanmis kisiler bulabilirsiniz.

english: Losanium is the official term for this religion, though it is not a term you'll find used very often.
translation: Losanium bu dinin resmi adidir, ancak cok sik kullanilan bir terim degildir.

english: How come?
Losanium encompasses the worship of both Ralos and Ranul, and while they do indeed go hand in hand, it is rare to find individuals equally dedicated to both.
translation: Losanium, hem Ralos'a hem de Ranul'a tapinmayi kapsar ve her ne kadar ikisi birbiriyle ic ice olsa da, her ikisine de esit derecede bagli olan bireyler nadirdir.

english: Instead, most people focus their worship on one of the two, with Ralos being by far the more popular. Something that isn't too surprising given Ranul's association with death.
translation: Bunun yerine, cogu insan ibadetini ikisinden birine odaklar ve Ralos acik ara daha popülerdir. Ranul'un ölümle iliskilendirilmesi göz önüne alindiginda, bu cok da sasirtici degildir.

english: Now that said, you might actually find a higher than normal number of Ranul worshippers right here in the museum.
translation: Bununla birlikte, müzede normalden daha fazla sayida Ranul tapan kisi bulabilirsiniz.

english: Something that is easily forgotten is that while Ranul is indeed a god of death, he is also a god of learning and knowledge.
translation: Kolayca unutulan bir sey, Ranul'un gercekten ölüm tanrisi oldugu kadar, ögrenme ve bilginin tanrisi da oldugudur.

english: If you wish to learn more, you may well want to seek out one of the teoki in the temple to the south. Though of course, they may well have somewhat biased takes on their religious practices.
translation: Daha fazla bilgi edinmek isterseniz, güneydeki tapinaktaki teoki'lerden birini arayabilirsiniz. Tabii ki, onlarin dini uygulamalari konusunda biraz önyargili olabilirler.

english: I'll keep that in mind. Thanks.
Don't mention it.
Could you tell me more about Varlamore's recent history?
translation: Varlamore'un yakin tarihini biraz daha anlatabilir misiniz?

english: I can indeed! When it comes to recent events in the kingdom, the best place to start is with the War of Betrayal. It all started around 100 years ago when Imafore Tullus ascended to the throne.
translation: Elbette! Kralligin son dönemdeki olaylarina gelince, en iyi baslangic noktasi Ihanet Savasi'dir. Her sey yaklasik 100 yil önce Imafore Tullus'un tahta cikmasiyla basladi.

english: He soon reorganised the kingdom into the Varlamorian Empire, a controversial choice to say the least, though it soon became clear that controversial choices were quite popular with Imafore.
translation: Kisa süre sonra kralligi Varlamorian Imparatorlugu olarak yeniden düzenledi, bu en azindan tartismali bir karardi, ancak tartismali kararlarin Imafore'un oldukca popüler oldugu kisa sürede anlasildi.

english: While public opinion was always mixed, nothing he did resulted in outright conflict until his sudden and brutal murder of the Kourend Royal Family. War was quickly declared.
translation: Kamuoyu her zaman karisik olsa da, Kourend Kraliyet Ailesi'ni ani ve acimasiz bir sekilde öldürene kadar yaptigi hicbir sey acik bir catismaya yol acmadi. Savas hizla ilan edildi.

english: Until that day, Varlamore had successfully managed to avoid conflict since before the kingdom was officially established. To say the war was unpopular would be an understatement.
translation: O güne kadar Varlamore, krallik resmi olarak kurulmadan önce bile catismalardan basariyla kacinmayi basarmisti. Savasin popüler olmadigini söylemek yetersiz kalir.

english: Imafore soon found himself facing as much resistance from within as he did from Kourend. The end result was predictable.
translation: Imafore kisa sürede Kourend'den oldugu kadar icinden de ayni derecede direncle karsilasti. Sonuc tahmin edilebilirdi.

english: Imafore and his forces found themselves trapped between two armies at the Battle of the Proudspire. He was captured and executed, bringing an end to the Tullus dynasty.
translation: Imafore ve ordusu, Proudspire Savasi'nda iki ordu arasinda sikisip kaldi. Yakalanip idam edildi ve Tullus hanedanligi sona erdi.

english: This brings us to a fun little fact. After his death, Imafore was succeeded by King Mezpah Arkan. One of his first acts was to call for the beheading of every statue of Imafore in the kingdom.
translation: Bu da bizi eglenceli bir gercege götürüyor. Ölümünden sonra, Imafore'un yerine Kral Mezpah Arkan gecti. Ilk icraatlarindan biri, kralliktaki tüm Imafore heykellerinin baslarinin kesilmesini emretmekti.

english: The statues remain to this day. It's actually a crime to try and remove them. They exist as a reminder of our history, and a warning to any who would try to follow in Imafore's footsteps.
translation: Heykeller bugüne kadar ayakta kalmistir. Aslinda onlari kaldirmaya calismak suctur. Onlar tarihimizin bir hatirasi ve Imafore'nin izinden gitmeye calisanlara bir uyari olarak varliklarini sürdürmektedirler.

english: I'll have to keep an eye out for them.
Indeed. I often like to challenge people to try and find them all!
translation: Kesinlikle. Sik sik insanlara hepsini bulmaya calismak icin meydan okurum!

english: So how has the kingdom changed since Imafore died?
translation: Peki, Imafore'un ölümünden sonra krallik nasil degisti?

english: The War of Betrayal was very much seen as a wake- up call. While Varlamore had once flourished under the traditions of the Tullus dynasty, by the end, it's fair to say we were stagnating.
translation: Ihanet Savasi bir uyanis cagrisi olarak görüldü. Varlamore, Tullus hanedaninin gelenekleri altinda bir zamanlar refah icindeydi, ancak sonunda durgunluga girdigini söylemek dogru olur.

english: King Mezpah set to work on transforming the kingdom. His ambitions were high, to the point that much of what he desired never came to pass in his lifetime.
translation: Kral Mezpah, kralligi dönüstürmek icin calismaya basladi. Hedefleri o kadar yüksekti ki, istedigi seylerin cogu onun yasami boyunca gerceklesmedi.

english: One of his most notable goals was to see Varlamore open more widely to the outer world. A goal which thanks to his great-granddaughter, has now finally been achieved!
translation: En önemli hedeflerinden biri, Varlamore'un dis dünyaya daha fazla acilmasiydi. Bu hedef, onun torununun torunu sayesinde nihayet gerceklestirildi!

english: Well then I should be very thankful. Without him, I might never have been allowed to visit!
translation: O zaman cok minnettar olmaliyim. O olmasaydi, burayi ziyaret etmeme izin verilmeyebilirdi!

english: Indeed. We would often send our students on trips to the east prior to the opening of the borders. The amount of paperwork needed was astounding! Now we can just hop on a ship any time we like!
translation: Gercekten de öyle. Sinirlarin acilmasindan önce ögrencilerimizi sik sik doguya gezilere gönderirdik. Gerekli evrak isleri inanilmazdi! Artik istedigimiz zaman gemiye atlayip gidebiliyoruz!

english: That definitely sounds much more fun. Thanks for all the information.
translation: Bu kesinlikle cok daha eglenceli görünüyor. Tüm bilgiler icin tesekkürler.

english: It's not a problem, iknami.
Thanks. If I have any questions, I'll be sure to ask.
Could you tell me more about the early history of Varlamore?
translation: Varlamore'un erken tarihi hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misiniz?

english: Could you tell me more about religion in Varlamore?
translation: Varlamore'daki din hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misiniz?

english: Could you tell me more about Varlamore's recent history?
translation: Varlamore'un yakin tarihi hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misiniz?

english: I'd better get going. Thanks again.
Thanks. If I have any questions, I'll be sure to ask.
Hey. Leave me be. I'm guardin' this place.
translation: Hey. Beni rahat birak. Burayi koruyorum.

english: You release your current duck and it begins tracking the currents.
translation: Mevcut ördegini serbest birakirsan, akintiyi takip etmeye baslar.

english: There it goes! Now to follow it and see where this current flows.
translation: Iste gidiyor! Simdi onu takip edip akintinin nereye gittigini görelim.

english: Quack!
Quack! Quack! Quack!
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu var. Merhaba, selam, selam...

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: Bu yine de tek bir selam sayilir!

english: Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her türlü sey! Kuleler görülmeye deger harika bir manzara.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmenizi tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Oh, that's nice, another human visitor to Keldagrim!
translation: Oh, ne güzel, Keldagrim'e bir insan ziyaretci daha!

english: Indeed!
And what brings you to this city? Come to seek knowledge as well?
translation: Bu sehre ne getiriyor sizi? Siz de bilgi aramaya mi geldiniz?

english: I think it's mostly fame and riches I'm after.
translation: Sanirim ben daha cok söhret ve zenginlik pesindeyim.

english: To each [his/her] own, I suppose.
Hello, can you help me?
Ssshhh, don't talk...
But I just want to ask you something.
translation: Ama size bir sey sormak istiyorum.

english: Ssshhhh! Can't you read the sign?
What sign??
Don't be a cheeky human!
Ssshhhh.
Can I help you?
Can I journey on this ship?
You need to be searched before you can board.
translation: Gemide seyahat etmeden önce üstünüz aranacak.

english: Why?
Because Asgarnia has banned the import of intoxicating spirits.
translation: Cünkü Asgarnia sarhos edici ickilerin ithalatini yasakladi.

english: Search away, I have nothing to hide.
Well you've got some odd stuff, but it's all legal. Now you need to pay a boarding charge of 30 coins.
translation: Garip esyalariniz var ama hepsi yasal. Simdi 30 sikke tutarinda binis ücreti ödemeniz gerekiyor.

english: Ok.
Oh dear, I don't seem to have enough money.
translation: Oh hayir, yeterince param yok galiba.

english: You pay 30 coins and board the ship.
The ship arrives at Port Sarim.
Hang on a sec... Aren't those Karamja gloves? I thought I'd seen you helping around the island. You can go on half price mate.
translation: Bir saniye... Bunlar Karamja eldivenleri degil mi? Seni adada yardim ederken görmüstüm. Yari fiyatina gidebilirsin dostum.

english: You pay 15 coins and board the ship.
Oh, I'll not bother then.
Or perhaps you could let me travel for free?
translation: Ya da belki beni bedavaya seyahat ettirebilirsin?

english: Yes, perhaps I could. Okay, jump aboard then.
translation: Evet, belki yapabilirim. Tamam, o zaman atla gemiye.

english: You board the ship.
Aha, trying to smuggle rum are we?
translation: Aha, rom kacakciligi mi yapmaya calisiyorsun?

english: Umm... it's for personal use?
The customs officer confiscates your rum.
You will need to find some way to smuggle it off the island...
translation: Onu adadan kacirmanin bir yolunu bulman gerekecek...

english: This is not the Karamja rum you are looking for.
This is not the Karamja rum we are looking for.
Well that was easy!
You dance for joy...
...and accidentally drop the rum.
Drat...
You're not putting your hands on my things!
You're not getting on this ship then.
Does Karamja have any unusual customs then?
translation: Karamja'da alisilmadik gümrük kurallari mi var?

english: I'm not that sort of customs officer.
translation: Ben öyle bir gümrük memuru degilim.

english: Hey, I know you, you work at the plantation.
I don't think you'll try smuggling anything, you just need to pay a boarding charge of 30 coins.
translation: Kacakcilik yapacagini sanmiyorum, sadece 30 sikke binis ücreti ödemen gerekiyor.

english: Spot inspection. You don't mind do you?
translation: Yerinde inceleme. Sakincasi yok, degil mi?

english: Aha, trying to smuggle rum eh?
translation: Aha, rom kacakciligi yapmaya calisiyorsun, ha?

english: You do not have enough coins to pay passage, you need 30.
translation: Yolculuk ücretini ödeyecek kadar paran yok, 30 coin lazim.

english: You do not have enough coins to pay passage. You need 15 when wearing the Karamja gloves.
translation: Yolculuk ücretini ödeyecek kadar paran yok. Karamja eldivenlerini giydiginde 15 coin lazim.

english: The officer smiles as she recognises your Karamja gloves and lets you pass for half price - 15 coins.
translation: Memur, Karamja eldivenlerini fark edince gülümser ve yari fiyatina, 15 coin karsiliginda gecmene izin verir.

english: Can I journey on this ship?
Why?
Search away, I have nothing to hide.
Ok.
Oh, I'll not bother then.
[Charm] Or perhaps you could let me travel for free?
translation: [Cazibe] Ya da belki beni ücretsiz seyahat ettirebilirsin?

english: Umm... it's for personal use?
[Charm] This is not the Karamja rum you are looking for.
You're not putting your hands on my things!
Does Karamja have unusual customs then?
Hello there friend. I'm afraid all boat rides are out of service due to the high ghast activity in Mort Myre.
translation: Merhaba dostum. Mort Myre'da ghastlarin yogunlugu nedeniyle tüm tekne seferleri iptal edildi.

english: Thanks for your help in finding the Myreque.
translation: Myreque'yi bulmamda yardim ettigin icin tesekkürler.

english: Well, I'd like to say that you're welcome. But I heard that you led Vanstrom straight to their hideout. I feel so guilty.
translation: Aslinda, rica ederim demek isterdim. Ama Vanstrom'u dogrudan saklandiklari yere götürdügünü duydum. Kendimi cok suclu hissediyorum.

english: Hmm, yeah, I know how you feel.
Well, I'd like to say that you're welcome. But what does it matter now? The Drakans killed the whole lot of them.
translation: Aslinda, rica ederim demek isterdim. Ama artik ne önemi var ki? Drakans hepsini öldürdü.

english: I'll have to charge you 10 gold to cover the loan of the boat. Is that okay?
translation: Teknenin kirasini karsilamak icin senden 10 altin alacagim. Sorun olur mu?

english: Yes. I'll pay the ten gold.
Sorry, but you don't have that much. No money, no boat!
translation: Üzgünüm ama o kadar paran yok. Para yoksa tekne de yok!

english: You board the boat and journey to the Hollows.
translation: Tekneye binip Hollows'a dogru yola cikiyorsun.

english: You arrive at the Hollows.
No. I won't use the boat.
How about you let me use the boat for free?
Hmm, use the boat for free... Very well, that sounds fair enough to me.
translation: Hmm, tekneyi bedavaya kullanmak... Pekala, bana adil geliyor.

english: Sorry my friend. You don't seem to have the funds for the trip. It will cost you 10 gold.
translation: Üzgünüm dostum. Yolculuk icin yeterli paran yok gibi görünüyor. 10 altin ödeyeceksin.

english: Yes. I'll pay the ten gold.
No. I won't use the boat.
[Charm] How about you let me use the boat for free?
translation: [Cazibe] Tekneyi ücretsiz kullanmama izin verir misin?

english: Hello mate. What are you up to now?
Erm, I'm a bit busy at the moment.
Ooooh, I bet you're travelling across the seas. Or maybe you're visiting the world leaders?
translation: Ooooh, eminim denizleri asiyorsun. Ya da belki dünya liderlerini ziyaret ediyorsundur?

english: Well, I'm trying to fight TzTok-Jad at the moment.
translation: Su anda TzTok-Jad ile savasmaya calisiyorum.

english: He must be really tough!
Yes, he's level 702 in Combat.
Enjoy!
Thanks. Arghhhh, death to you foul beast!
translation: Tesekkürler. Arghhhh, öl seni igrenc canavar!

english: Hello!
Oh, hi.
What adventure are you now on?
Well, I just dispatched TzTok-Jad. Pretty tough! I'm now on my way to the desert. I'm going to see if I can hunt down this Kalphite Queen everyone's been telling me about.
translation: Sey, az önce TzTok-Jad'i yok ettim. Oldukca zorluydu! Simdi cöle gidiyorum. Herkesin bahsettigi Kalphite Kralicesi'ni avlayabilecek miyim diye bakacagim.

english: I should warn you, you'll need a team to take that beast on.
translation: Seni uyarmaliyim, o canavari alt etmek icin bir takima ihtiyacin olacak.

english: I've already thought of that. I've arranged for a couple of the Slayer masters to join me.
translation: Bunu zaten düsündüm. Birkac Slayer ustasinin bana katilmasini ayarladim.

english: Wow! I wish I could witness that!
Hello again!
That's funny, I was just talking about you.
translation: Komik, ben de tam senden bahsediyordum.

english: You were?
Yes, I've been arranging a meeting between various leaders of Gielinor to discuss some political issues. It seems you have certainly been around a bit!
translation: Evet, bazi siyasi konulari tartismak icin Gielinor'un cesitli liderleri arasinda bir toplanti ayarliyordum. Görünüse göre epey dolasmissin!

english: I suppose I have. What issues are you going to be discussing in this meeting? Who will be there?
translation: Sanirim öyle. Bu toplantida hangi konulari tartisacaksiniz? Kimler katilacak?

english: Sorry, that's top secret information.
translation: Üzgünüm, bu cok gizli bir bilgi.

english: That's fine, I understand.
Hey there, where are you now?
Well, I thought I'd try out this place called the Wilderness.
translation: Sey, Wilderness adinda bir yeri deneyeyim dedim.

english: Oh dear.
Quite a gloomy place.
Oh! I can see someone.
He seems to be coming this way.
Be careful!
Yes, he's definitely looking at me.
He's wearing some impressive armour.
Watch out! He's going to attack you!
Surely not. Oh, look, there's another two of them coming to meet me.
translation: Olmaz. Bak, iki kisi daha bana dogru geliyor.

english: They're in a clan, they're going to fight you!
I don't think so.
Hi there gentlemen! Nice day...
Woah, take it easy! Hey, stop that!
Fight Cyrisus!
I'll teach you to hit me! Have this!
translation: Bana vurmayi ögretirim sana! Al sunu!...

english: That'll teach them.
You beat them?
Of course. Easy.
Phew!
How's the fishing going?
It's going well, got a bunch of fish stocked up for the group. Now I just need someone to cook them.
translation: Iyi gidiyor, grup icin bir sürü balik stokladim. Simdi sadece onlari pisirecek biri lazim.

english: You can only trade with people in your group.
Cor blimey, This is a big one!
translation: Vay canina, bu büyük bir balik!

english: Fishing levels?
Oh no... It got away!
Is that a shark?
Here fishy fishies!
Bah! A great artist such as myself should not have to suffer the HUMILIATION of spending time where the likes of you wander everywhere!
translation: Bah! Benim gibi büyük bir sanatci, senin gibilerin dolastigi bir yerde zaman gecirmek gibi bir UTANC yasamamali!

english: No human pass through arena without defeating Dad!
translation: Hicbir insan babami yenmeden arenadan gecemez!

english: What tiny human do in troll arena? Dad challenge human to fight!
translation: Kücük insan troll arenasinda ne yapiyor? Baba insana dövüsmeye davet ediyor!

english: Why are you called Dad?
Troll named after first thing try to eat!
translation: Troll, ilk yemeye calistigi seyin adini almistir!

english: I accept your challenge!
Tiny human brave. Dad squish!
translation: Kücük insan cesur. Baba ezip gececek!

english: Dad swings his giant log towards the player, knocking them back.
translation: Baba devasa kütügünü oyuncuya dogru savurur ve onu geriye savurur.

english: Eek! No thanks.
Coward. Dad wait for braver fighter.
translation: Korkak. Baba daha cesur bir savasci bekliyor.

english: Stop! You win. Not hurt Dad.
I'll be going now.
You don't need to fight him again.
He doesn't seem interested in talking right now.
translation: Su anda konusmak istemiyor gibi görünüyor.

english: I'm not done yet! Prepare to die!
The player delivers a fatal blow to Dad, killing him.
translation: Oyuncu, babaya ölümcül bir darbe indirerek onu öldürür.

english: Why are you called Dad?
I accept your challenge!
Eek! No thanks.
I'll be going now.
I'm not done yet! Prepare to die!
Hello.
Well-met!
Who are you?
I am Daer Krand, an old student of Zandar Horfyre.
translation: Ben Daer Krand, Zandar Horfyre'nin eski ögrencisiyim.

english: You certainly look the part.
Yes. And you are?
I'm [player name], an adventurer.
It's a pleasure to make your acquaintance.
And yours.
Why are you here?
Great question! I have a better one...
translation: Harika bir soru! Benim daha iyi bir sorum var...

english: What is the Elixir of Everlasting?
Some kind of life extending potion?
translation: Bir tür ömrü uzatan iksir mi?

english: Exactly! This table here is full of notes on the topic. Plenty of warnings that seem to be scribbled over the top in a rather rushed manner...
translation: Aynen öyle! Bu masa bu konuyla ilgili notlarla dolu. Üzerine aceleyle yazilmis gibi görünen bircok uyari var...

english: Sorry... I tend to ramble when excited.
Do you think you can recreate this elixir?
Me? Pah! I'm a dab hand at magic but my herblore has always been somewhat lacking. I'd go to the druids in Taverley but they don't trust us anymore... Know of any talented herbalists in the vicinity?
translation: Ben mi? Peh! Büyü konusunda ustayim ama bitki bilimi konusunda her zaman biraz eksik kaldim. Taverley'deki druidlere giderdim ama artik bize güvenmiyorlar... Civarda yetenekli bir bitki uzmani biliyor musun?

english: Can't say I've met anyone that springs to mind.
That's a shame.
I'm world renowned at herblore. Perhaps I can help?
translation: Bitki bilimi konusunda dünyaca ünlüyüm. Belki yardimci olabilirim?

english: Next time, lead with that...
Anywho, I've yet to completely make sense of all these notes. Some must have been placed elsewhere.
translation: Her neyse, bu notlarin hepsini henüz tam olarak anlamis degilim. Bazilari baska bir yere konulmus olmali.

english: Maybe that loathsome vampyre wandering about knows something?
translation: Belki de etrafta dolasan o igrenc vampir bir seyler biliyordur?

english: The one roaming around lighting candles? He doesn't seem totally with it.
translation: Mumlari yakarak dolasan mi? Pek akli basinda görünmüyor.

english: Hmm, you might be right. He'll be of no use...
translation: Hmm, hakli olabilirsin. O bir ise yaramaz...

english: Well then, if you do find the missing notes, I'm always happy to help.
translation: Peki o zaman, kayip notlari bulursan, yardim etmekten memnuniyet duyarim.

english: Yes? Oh, of course! Keep your eyes peeled when you're down here. If you see anything of interest, you know where to find me.
translation: Evet? Tabii ki! Buradayken gözlerini dört ac. Ilginc bir sey görürsen, beni nerede bulacagini biliyorsun.

english: See you later.
Yes... Good day!
Here, solve this for me. I need to keep working on these notes.
translation: Al, bunu benim icin cöz. Bu notlar üzerinde calismaya devam etmem gerekiyor.

english: Daer Krand has given you a puzzle box!
translation: Daer Krand sana bir bulmaca kutusu verdi!

english: Sorry but you haven't solved the puzzle yet.
Good work!
[Daer Krand has given you another clue scroll!/You've obtained a casket!]
translation: [Daer Krand sana baska bir ipucu parsömeni verdi!/Bir tabut elde ettin!]

english: Who are you?
Why are you here?
See you later.
I need to return to Crash Island.
You know the routine...
Speak to Waydar when you are ready to leave.
translation: Gitmeye hazir oldugunda Waydar ile konus.

english: Would you like to buy or sell some scimitars?
translation: Kilic satin almak veya satmak ister misin?

english: Yes, please.
No, thanks.
Do you have any Dragon Scimitars in stock?
It just so happens I recently got a fresh delivery, do you want to buy one?
translation: Sansina, yeni bir sevkiyat geldi, satin almak ister misin?

english: Sorry but you don't have enough to buy one, at the moment it costs 100000 gold coins.
translation: Üzgünüm ama satin almak icin yeterli paran yok, su anda fiyati 100.000 altin.

english: Here, have this!
Yes, please.
No, thanks.
Do you have any Dragon Scimitars in stock?
So despite there being three kings, you're clearly the leader, right?
translation: Üc kral olmasina ragmen, acikca lider sensin, degil mi?

english: Definitely.
I'm glad I got you as a pet.
translation: Seni evcil hayvanim olarak aldigim icin mutluyum.

english: Ugh. Human, I'm not a pet.
translation: Igrenc. Insan, ben evcil hayvan degilim.

english: Stop following me then.
translation: O zaman beni takip etmeyi birak.

english: I can't seem to stop.
Pet.
Definitely
You make a great pet.
So fight me then.
I can't seem to do it.
Grrrr!
Hissss!
Kssss!
Skrrr!
Do you have any berserker rings?
Nope.
You sure?
Yes.
So, if I tipped you upside down and shook you, you'd not drop any berserker rings?
translation: Yani, seni ters cevirip sarsarsam, berserker yüzügü düsürmez misin?

english: What if I endlessly killed your father for weeks on end, would I get one then?
translation: Ya haftalarca durmadan babani öldürürsem, o zaman bir tane alabilir miyim?

english: Been done by someone, nope.
Hey, so err... I kind of own you now.
translation: Hey, sey... Artik sen benim malimsin.

english: Tsssk. Next time you enter those caves, human, my father will be having words.
translation: Tsssk. Bir dahaki sefere o magaralara girdiginde, insan, babam seninle konusacak.

english: Maybe next time I'll add your brothers to my collection.
translation: Belki bir dahaki sefere kardeslerini de koleksiyonuma eklerim.

english: Hey, so err... you're kind of a pet now.
translation: Hey, sey... Artik bir nevi evcil hayvan oldun.

english: Tsssk. Next time my owner enters those caves, human, my father will be having words.
translation: Tsssk. Bir dahaki sefere sahibim o magaralara girdiginde, insan, babam seninle konusacak.

english: Maybe next time your brothers will join the collection.
translation: Belki bir dahaki sefere kardeslerin de koleksiyona katilir.

english: Grrrr!
Skrrr!
Kssss!
Hissss!
*slap*
Krrrrrrk
Chkhkhkhkhk
Krrrrrrssssssss
Sssssrrrkkkkk
Krkrkrkrkrkrkrkr
Tktktktktktkt
What are yooo interrupting me for? Can't you see I'm working here?
translation: Beni neden rahatsiz ediyorsun? Calistigimi görmüyor musun?

english: Moo, what do yoooou think you're doing?
Err... Nothing. Just checking that your cowbell was working. Don't want you to get lost!
translation: Sey... Hicbir sey. Sadece caninin calisip calismadigini kontrol ediyordum. Kaybolmani istemem!

english: How exactly am I going to get lost when I'm tied down? What were yooo really doing?
translation: Bagliyken nasil kaybolabilirim ki? Gercekte ne yapiyordun?

english: I don't think you'll believe me.
I'm a talking cow, I'll believe almost anything.
translation: Ben konusan bir inegim, neredeyse her seye inanirim.

english: Fine. I need the bell to trick some penguins into helping me get into their secret lair.
translation: Peki. Penguenleri kandirip gizli siginagina girmeme yardim etmeleri icin canaga ihtiyacim var.

english: Well why didn't you say so? I've got a ton of these things. Go ahead and take the bell.
translation: Neden öyle demedin? Bunlardan bir sürü var. Al cani.

english: MOO
Hi there.
Hello, young one. What brings you to our humble dwelling?
translation: Merhaba, genc dostum. Mütevazi evimize seni buraya getiren nedir?

english: I was wondering what this place was?
These are the Tunnels of Chaos. They radiate with the energy of chaos magic. At the far end of the tunnel, you will find a portal to the Chaos Altar itself where chaos runes are crafted!
translation: Burasi Kaos Tünelleri. Kaos büyüsünün enerjisiyle parliyorlar. Tünelin en ucunda, kaos rünlerinin yapildigi Kaos Altari'na giden bir gecit bulacaksin!

english: Why is the tunnel so short?
The nature of chaos magic itself is mysterious and hard to understand.
translation: Kaos büyüsünün dogasi gizemli ve anlasilmasi zordur.

english: What do you mean?
The tunnel is here, and yet it is not here. We also are here, where we should be, yet we are somewhere else. And so, the tunnel goes from one place to another, yet touches neither.
translation: Tünel burada, ama ayni zamanda burada degil. Biz de burada, olmamiz gereken yerdeyiz, ama ayni zamanda baska bir yerdeyiz. Tünel bir yerden baska bir yere gider, ama ikisine de dokunmaz.

english: I really don't understand.
I told you you wouldn't. The best way to think of it is that the tunnel is like a gateway that allows you to travel from one place in the world to another in a more safe and convenient way.
translation: Anlamayacagini söylemistim. Bunu düsünmenin en iyi yolu, tünelin dünyadaki bir yerden baska bir yere daha güvenli ve rahat bir sekilde seyahat etmeni saglayan bir gecit gibi oldugunu düsünmektir.

english: Oh, I think I see. So it is like a magical alternate route?
translation: Oh, sanirim anladim. Yani sihirli bir alternatif yol gibi mi?

english: Exactly! Well done! And at the end, there is a portal which will transport you to the Chaos Altar.
translation: Aynen öyle! Aferin! Ve sonunda, seni Kaos Altari'na götürecek bir gecit var.

english: Oh, ok.
Why are there only three of you?
Our order is a secret one and those of us that remain and survive through the ages choose to hide ourselves away.
translation: Tarikatimiz gizlidir ve caglar boyunca hayatta kalanlarimiz kendimizi saklamayi tercih ederiz.

english: Where are the rest of you now?
We have built or found many tunnels such as these. This is not the only one. Rest assured, there are many more of us around.
translation: Bunun gibi bircok tünel insa ettik veya bulduk. Bu tek tünel degil. Merak etme, etrafta daha bircok tarikat üyesi var.

english: Is the Wilderness above us?
Yes, I can understand you would expect it to be since the tunnel leads to the Chaos Altar. And yet, the tunnel does not enter the Wilderness, no.
translation: Evet, tünel Kaos Altari'na ciktigi icin öyle olmasini beklediginizi anlayabiliyorum. Ancak tünel Wilderness'ya cikmiyor, hayir.

english: Rest assured, you are safe here and should not come to harm.
translation: Merak etmeyin, burada güvendesiniz ve zarar görmeyeceksiniz.

english: You seem quite nice for a Zamorakian.
translation: Bir Zamorakian icin oldukca nazik görünüyorsunuz.

english: History is written by the strong and the influential.
translation: Tarih, güclü ve etkili kisiler tarafindan yazilir.

english: What does that mean?
It means we cannot always believe what we are told to believe. You would do well to remember that.
translation: Bu, bize söylenenlere her zaman inanamayacagimiz anlamina geliyor. Bunu unutmaman iyi olur.

english: I will! Thank you!
Thanks for your time.
Why is the tunnel so short?
Why are there only three of you?
Is the Wilderness above us?
You seem quite nice for a Zamorakian.
Thanks for your time.
Hi!
Well. This beats doing the shopping!
I wouldn't want to be the poor guy that has to clean up after the duels.
translation: Dövüslerden sonra ortaligi temizlemek zorunda kalan zavalli adam olmak istemezdim.

english: Me neither.
Hi!
What did the skeleton say before it ate?
I don't know?
Bone-appetit.
Ooh. This is exciting!
Yup!
How can you make a very lively hankerchief?
translation: Nasil cok canli bir mendil yapabilirsiniz?

english: Put a little boogey in it.
Why did the skeleton burp?
'Cause it didn't have the guts to fart!
My son just won his first duel!
Congratulations!
He ripped his opponent in half!
That's gotta hurt!
He's only 10 as well!
You gotta start 'em young!
Can't you see I'm watching the duels?
I'm sorry!
Knock knock!
Who's there?
Boo.
Boo who?
Don't cry, it's just me!
Waaaaassssssuuuuupp?!
Hi! I'm here to watch the duels!
Me too!
My favourite fighter is Mubariz!
The guy at the information kiosk?
Yeah! He rocks!
Takes all sorts, I guess.
Hmph.
Did you know they think this place dates back to the second age?!
translation: Bu yerin ikinci caga kadar uzandigini biliyor muydun?

english: Really?
Yeah. The guy at the information kiosk was telling me.
Hello there. What are you doing here?
I'm waiting here hoping that someone can guide me to the Paterdomus, the temple on the Salve.
translation: Biri beni Salve'deki Paterdomus tapinagina götürür diye burada bekliyorum.

english: Where is Paterdomus?
Oh, Paterdomus is that rather impressive looking temple on the Salve... I'm sure you must have passed it on your way into Morytania.
translation: Paterdomus, Salve'deki oldukca etkileyici görünümlü tapinak... Morytania'ya gelirken oradan gecmis olmalisin.

english: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
I'm hoping to get back to civilisation and see what the lands of Misthalin look like.
translation: Medeniyete geri dönüp Misthalin topraklarinin nasil bir yer oldugunu görmek istiyorum.

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Paterdomus?
translation: Paterdomus'a giderken yol üzerinde düsmanlarla karsilasirsak kendini savunabilir misin?

english: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of bad guys. You don't need to worry about that.
translation: Diyelim ki biraz tecrübeliyim ve kötü adamlarla savasmaktan cekinmem. Bu konuda endiselenmene gerek yok.

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: Hmmm, görünüse göre bir takipcin var. Kendi basina dolasirsa bu yolculukta kaybolabilir. Takipcin güvende oldugunda yola cikalim.

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: Gercekten mi? Bu harika olur! Hedefe vardigimizda sana kücük bir ödül verecegim.

english: Temple Trekking begins
Ok, which route should we take?
Ok, thanks.
Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: Ah, bana biraz erzak vermek istiyorsun, ha? Birak da sirt cantami acayim.

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than staying in Burgh de Rott.
translation: Oh, bu yolculuktan nefret ediyorum, ama Burgh de Rott'ta kalmaktan iyidir.

english: It's scary here...let's get going!
When are we going to get to Paterdomus?
We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on.
translation: Bütün gün burada durup sohbet edecek vaktimiz yok; hadi devam edelim.

english: Do you visit Paterdomus often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: Paterdomus'a sik sik gider misin? Rotayi iyi biliyorsun gibi görünüyor.

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...?
Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Burgh de Rott. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: Hay aksi! Burgh de Rott'a geri dönmek zorunda kalacagiz galiba. O köprüyü gecemeyiz!

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
Player completes the bridge event
Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Burgh de Rott.
translation: Bu is bitti... Görünüse göre bu batakliktan gecemeyecegiz. Burgh de Rott'a geri dönmek zorundayiz.

english: Player completes the bog event
Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: Hey... bu harika... harika bir is cikardin... Seni takip edecegim.

english: Whahay...that was great!
But we really should be heading off now.
Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
Player completes the river event
That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: Bu harika! Ben de aynisini yapmaliyim.

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: Whahay! Harikaydi! Ama artik gercekten yola cikmaliyiz.

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
This is scary!
Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
Ahhh, two tentacles!
...three tentacles!
I think I'm going to faint!
Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: Vay canina! Su canavara bak! O seyi kendi basina halletmen gerekecek!

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the temple. Here's your reward.
translation: Beni tapinaga güvenle ulastirdigin icin cok tesekkürler. Iste ödülün.

english: Where is Paterdomus?
Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
I can take you to Paterdomus.
Ok, thanks.
Greetings, traveller. I'd love to stop and talk, but farming is a busy line of work. Perhaps another time?
translation: Selamlar, yolcu. Durup konusmak isterdim ama ciftcilik cok yogun bir is. Belki baska bir zaman?

english: Greetings, traveller. I am the Chief Farmer of Hosidius. My wife and I manage the efforts of all of our farmers.
translation: Selamlar, yolcu. Ben Hosidius'un bas ciftcisiyim. Esim ve ben tüm ciftcilerimizin calismalarini yönetiyoruz.

english: How's that going?
Quite well but we can always be doing more. Perhaps you could help?
translation: Oldukca iyi ama her zaman daha fazlasini yapabiliriz. Belki sen de yardim edebilirsin?

english: How could I help?
We need to till the soil to prepare it for crops. Head outside and operate the ploughs along the fields.
translation: Topragi ekim icin hazirlamak icin sürmemiz gerekiyor. Disari cik ve tarlalarda sabanlari kullan.

english: The ploughs are old and may become damaged after too much use, but I'm sure that won't be a problem for such a well trained adventurer like yourself.
translation: Sabanlar eski ve cok kullanildiginda zarar görebilir, ama senin gibi iyi egitimli bir maceraci icin bu sorun olmaz herhalde.

english: That sounds like hard work, what's in it for me?
translation: Zor bir is gibi görünüyor, bana ne faydasi olacak?

english: Well, by helping us you'll become more recognized and as that happens we can offer you many benefits.
translation: Bize yardim ederek daha taninir hale geleceksin ve bu sayede sana bircok avantaj sunabiliriz.

english: Thanks for the information, I'll see what I can do.
translation: Bilgi icin tesekkürler, ne yapabilecegime bakacagim.

english: Thank you, [player name]! Just find a plough to get started.
translation: Tesekkürler, Maceraci! Baslamak icin bir saban bulman yeterli.

english: No thanks, goodbye!
If you change your mind just find a plough and use it.
translation: Fikrini degistirirsen bir saban bul ve kullan.

english: How can I help?
Thanks for the information, I'll see what I can do.
translation: Bilgi icin tesekkürler, ne yapabilecegime bakacagim.

english: No thanks, good bye!
No thanks, goodbye!
Ooh, lovely view, dear.
Yes dear.
I hope the food's better here than it was last time.
translation: Umarim buradaki yemekler gecen seferkinden daha iyidir.

english: I'm sure it will be, dear.
Sorry to disturb you, but what are you two doing here?
translation: Rahatsiz ettigim icin özür dilerim ama siz ikiniz burada ne yapiyorsunuz?

english: Perrdur and I are having a nice romantic dinner, aren't we dear?
translation: Perrdur ve ben romantik bir aksam yemegi yiyoruz, degil mi canim?

english: We are celebrating the anniversary of our marriage, aren't we dear?
translation: Evlilik yildönümümüzü kutluyoruz, degil mi canim?

english: And we are having a very enjoyable time, aren't we dear?
translation: Ve cok keyifli vakit geciriyoruz, degil mi canim?

english: Clearly. I'll let you two lovebirds carry on, then.
translation: Belli ki öyle. O zaman siz iki ask kusu devam edin.

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: Hazir yemekler maalesef ise yaramaz. Aluft Aloft'un müsterileri icin sadece el yapimi Gnome Mutfagi yeterince iyidir.

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Dalila
Ah my order. At last....
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.'dan ücretsiz teslimat jetonunuzu almayi unutmayin.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: Teslimatiniz cok gec! Aluft jnr.'a geri dönüp baska bir siparis alin. Artik ihtiyaciniz olmadigi icin teslimat kutunuzu atiyorsunuz.

english: Can I help you at all?
Why do you sell this stuff? The Crystal Bow is so much better.
translation: Neden bu seyleri satiyorsunuz? Kristal Yay cok daha iyi.

english: We keep all these old toys to train our children with, but if people will part with coins for them, then they are theirs!
translation: Cocuklarimizi egitmek icin bu eski oyuncaklari sakliyoruz, ama insanlar para verip almak istiyorlarsa, onlarindir!

english: No thanks.
Yes please. What are you selling?
Why do you sell this stuff?
No thanks.
You seem to really enjoy that painting.
Hello stranger.
*grunts*
Ah very friendly I see. What's that coffin on your back?
translation: Ah, cok dost canlisiymissin. Sirtindaki tabut ne?

english: For carryin' the dead.
Woah, don't tell me you have a body in there?
translation: Vay canina, sakin icinde bir ceset oldugunu söyleme?

english: No, remains.
Oh, you carry the remains of shades in it? Could you give me one?
translation: Oh, icinde gölgelerin kalintilarini mi tasiyorsun? Bana da bir tane verebilir misin?

english: Dampe hands you a broken coffin.
translation: Dampe sana kirik bir tabut uzatir.

english: It's broken? What am I supposeto do with a broken coffin?
translation: Kirik mi? Kirik bir tabutla ne yapacagim ben?

english: Bring me locks, find in the catacombs... I repair coffin with locks.
translation: Bana kilitler getir, katakomplarda bul... Kilitlerle tabutu tamir ederim.

english: Right... Guess I should head into the catacombs then... see if I can find any of these 'locks'.
translation: Tamam... O zaman katakomplara girmeliyim... Bakalim bu “kilitleri” bulabilecek miyim.

english: Hello again.
Ah, as cheerful as ever I see.
translation: Ah, her zamanki gibi neseli görünüyorsun.

english: What d'ya want.
You gave me a broken coffin, what am I supposeto do with it?
translation: Bana kirik bir tabut verdin, bununla ne yapmam gerekiyor?

english: Bring me locks, I fix coffin with locks...
translation: Bana kilitler getir, tabutu kilitlerle tamir ederim...

english: Right... and where am I suppose to find such locks?
translation: Tamam... peki bu kilitleri nereden bulacagim?

english: In catacombs... in chests...
Great, thanks for the information.
I found one of the locks you were talking about, I think.
You show Dampe the lock you found and his cold eyes light up.
translation: Buldugun kilidi Dampe'ye gösterirsen, soguk gözleri parlar.

english: That is it, give to me now and I repair the coffin.
translation: Iste bu, simdi bana ver de tabutu tamir edeyim.

english: You ain't got no broken coffin for me to fix. If you need one, just ask.
translation: Tamir etmem icin kirik tabutun yok. Ihtiyacin olursa, söyle yeter.

english: You hand over the coffin and lock to Dampe.
You hear him clumsily attach the lock to the coffin.
translation: Onun kilidi tabuta beceriksizce taktigini duyarsin.

english: Finished, take it.
No thanks, I'm going to hang on to it for now.
Could I get another of those coffins?
translation: O tabutlardan bir tane daha alabilir miyim?

english: Get lost, you've already got a coffin, I ain't givin' you anotha.
translation: Defol git, zaten bir tabutun var, sana bir tane daha vermeyecegim.

english: It's broken?
Where did you get those robes?
Given to me.
By who?
A dead friend of mine.
Oh... how did they die?
In the catacombs.
Sorry to hear that...
Nothing, I just wanted to chat.
translation: Önemli degil, sadece sohbet etmek istedim.

english: Can you fix this for me?
Depends, you got any locks for it?
No...
Yeah, well clear off them a go find one.
translation: Tamam, o zaman git bir tane bul.

english: Hey, I found this lock in the catacombs? Can you do anything with it?
translation: Hey, katakomplarda bu kilidi buldum? Bununla bir sey yapabilir misin?

english: *grunts* Lets 'ava look.
Ask about locks.
Yes
No
Ask for another coffin.
Ask about his robes.
Just wanted a chat.
Hiya! Do you want to buy me a drink?
translation: Selam! Bana bir icki ismarlamak ister misin?

english: I think I'll pass on that.
Fine, I'm sure somebody else round here will know how to treat a woman...
translation: Peki, eminim buralarda bir kadinla nasil davranilacagini bilen baska biri vardir...

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: Hazir yemekler maalesef ise yaramaz. Aluft Aloft'un müsterileri icin sadece el yapimi Gnome Mutfagi yeterince iyidir.

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Damwin
Ooh, thanks a lot dearie.
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr'dan ücretsiz teslimat jetonunu almayi unutma.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: Teslimatin cok gec! Aluft jnr'a geri dön ve baska bir siparis al. Artik ihtiyacin olmadigi icin teslimat kutunu atiyorsun.

english: Hello, who are you?
Greetings human. I am Darcor quo Narga, a guardian for the Kahlith. Have you come to serve the balance?
translation: Selamlar insan. Ben Darcor quo Narga, Kahlith'in koruyucusu. Dengeyi saglamak icin mi geldin?

english: Yes.
Then you should speak to Konar quo Maten. She will guide you.
translation: O zaman Konar quo Maten ile konusmalisin. O sana yol gösterecektir.

english: No.
A shame. You are a bringer of death, you could be of great use to the balance.
translation: Yazik. Sen ölümün habercisiisin, denge icin cok yararli olabilirsin.

english: I'm not sure.
Then you should speak with Xorrah quo Sihar. He will show you the way.
translation: O zaman Xorrah quo Sihar ile konusmalisin. O sana yolu gösterecektir.

english: Yes.
No.
I'm not sure.
Why do you interrupt me, traveller? I am experimenting with dark magic; it is a dangerous craft, and I prefer not to be disturbed.
translation: Neden beni rahatsiz ediyorsun, yolcu? Karanlik büyü denemeleri yapiyorum; bu tehlikeli bir sanat ve rahatsiz edilmemeyi tercih ederim.

english: I'm just looking around.
There's nothing to see here, just despair and death.
translation: Burada görülecek bir sey yok, sadece umutsuzluk ve ölüm var.

english: Can I help you with something, traveller? I am experimenting with dark magic; it is a dangerous craft, and I prefer not to be disturbed.
translation: Sana yardim edebilir miyim, yolcu? Karanlik büyü denemeleri yapiyorum; bu tehlikeli bir sanat ve rahatsiz edilmemeyi tercih ederim.

english: I'll leave you to it.
Can you recharge my Staff of Iban?
Your staff is already as fully charged as it can go.
I'll want 100,000 coins to recharge the Staff of Iban.
translation: Iban Asasini sarj etmek icin 100.000 sikke istiyorum.

english: The mage summons the power of Zamorak and recharges your Staff of Iban.
translation: Büyücü Zamorak'in gücünü cagirir ve Iban Asani sarj eder.

english: Can you upgrade my Staff of Iban?
Hah! Yes, I can upgrade it to hold 2500 charges, enough to cast Iban's magic 2500 times at monsters or 1250 times at people like you. That'll cost you 200,000 coins.
translation: Hah! Evet, 2500 sarjlik kapasiteye yükseltebilirim, bu da Iban'in büyüsünü canavarlara 2500 kez veya senin gibi insanlara 1250 kez yapmaya yeter. Bunun bedeli 200.000 sikke.

english: Thanks, I'll bear it in mind.
Can you repair my broken Staff of Iban?
You show the mage your broken staff.
The Staff of Iban holds dangerous magic, traveller. I can fix it, but it will cost you - the process could kill me!
translation: Iban Asasi tehlikeli bir büyü barindiriyor, yolcu. Onu tamir edebilirim, ama bu sana pahaliya mal olacak - bu islem beni öldürebilir!

english: How much?
200,000 coins. That'll give it 120 charges, enough to cast Iban's magic 120 times at monsters or 60 times at people like you.
translation: 200.000 altin. Bu, ona 120 sarj verecek, bu da Iban'in büyüsünü canavarlara 120 kez veya senin gibi insanlara 60 kez kullanmak icin yeterli.

english: Here's 200,000 coins. Please repair the staff.
You give the mage 200,000 coins and the staff...
You give the mage 200,000 coins and the staff... The mage fixes the staff and returns it to you.
translation: Büyücüye 200.000 sikke ve asayi veriyorsun... Büyücü asayi onariyor ve sana geri veriyor.

english: Thanks, I appreciate that.
You be careful with that thing!
Can you make it hold more than 120 charges?
Hah! Yes, I can upgrade it to hold 2500 charges, enough to cast Iban's magic 2500 times at monsters or 1250 times at people like you. That'll cost you 400,000 coins.
translation: Hah! Evet, 2500 sarj almasi icin yükseltebilirim, bu da canavarlara 2500 kez veya senin gibi insanlara 1250 kez Iban'in büyüsünü kullanmaya yeter. Bu sana 400.000 sikkeye mal olacak.

english: Staaaaaaaaves!
Traveller, I have no idea what you are talking about. If you want my help with staves, perhaps you should show me one.
translation: Gezgin, neden bahsettigini hic anlamadim. Asalar konusunda yardimimi istiyorsan, belki de bana bir tane göstermelisin.

english: Can you recharge my Staff of Iban?
Pay 100,000 coins to recharge it.
Don't pay.
Can you upgrade my Staff of Iban?
Here's 200,000 coins. Please upgrade the staff.
Thanks, I'll bear it in mind.
Can you repair my broken Staff of Iban?
Here's 200,000 coins. Please repair the staff.
Can you make it hold more than 120 charges?
Here's 400,000 coins. Please upgrade the staff.
I'll leave you to it.
Recharge your Staff of Iban
Upgrade your Staff of Iban
Repair your broken Staff of Iban
Hello there.
Quiet! You must not break my concentration!
Why not?
Well, if my concentration is broken while keeping this rift open, the results won't be pretty.
translation: Cünkü bu yarigi acik tutarken konsantrasyonum bozulursa, sonuclari hic hos olmayacak.

english: In what way?
If we are lucky, the heads of anyone within the Abyss will suddenly explode, including us.
translation: Sansliysak, Abyss'teki herkesin kafasi aniden patlayacak, biz de dahil.

english: Err... And if we're unlucky?
If we are unlucky, then the entire universe will begin to fold in upon itself, and all reality as we know it will be annihilated in a single stroke.
translation: Sanssizsak, tüm evren kendi üzerine cökmeye baslayacak ve bildigimiz tüm gerceklik tek bir vurusla yok olacak.

english: So leave me alone!
What are you doing here?
Do you mean what am I doing here in the Abyss? Or are you asking me what I consider my ultimate role to be in this voyage that we call life?
translation: Abyss'te ne yaptigimi mi soruyorsun? Yoksa hayat dedigimiz bu yolculukta benim nihai rolümün ne oldugunu mu soruyorsun?

english: Err... The first one.
By remaining here and holding this rift open, I am providing a permanent link between normal space and this strange dimension.
translation: Burada kalarak ve bu yarigi acik tutarak, normal uzay ile bu garip boyut arasinda kalici bir baglanti sagliyorum.

english: As long as my spell remains in effect, we have the capability to teleport into the Abyss.
translation: Büyümün etkisi devam ettigi sürece, Abyss'e isinlanma yetenegine sahibiz.

english: Now leave me be! I can afford no distraction in my task!
translation: Simdi beni rahat birak! Görevimde dikkatimin dagilmasini göze alamam!

english: I need your help with something.
What? Oh... very well. What did you want?
Can I have another Abyssal book?
translation: Baska bir Abyssal kitabi alabilir miyim?

english: Don't waste my time if you don't have enough free space to take it.
translation: Alacak kadar bos yerin yoksa zamanimi bosa harcama.

english: Here, take it. It is important to pool our research.
translation: Al, al sunu. Arastirmalarimizi bir araya getirmek önemli.

english: Can I have a new essence pouch?
translation: Yeni bir öz torbasi alabilir miyim?

english: Here. Be more careful with your belongings in future.
translation: Al. Gelecekte esyalarina daha dikkat et.

english: You already have a Colossal Pouch. Are you aware of the dimensional turmoil you can cause by using too many pouches at the same time?
translation: Zaten devasa bir torban var. Ayni anda cok fazla torba kullanmanin boyutlar arasinda karisikliga neden olabilecegini biliyor musun?

english: Now stop wasting my time!
Can you repair my pouches?
Fine. A simple transfiguration spell should resolve things for you.
translation: Tamam. Basit bir dönüsüm büyüsü sorunu cözecektir.

english: Thanks.
Now can you leave me alone? I can't keep affording these distractions!
translation: Simdi beni rahat birakabilir misin? Bu tür dikkat daginikliklarini kaldiramam!

english: Actually, I don't need anything right now.
translation: Aslinda su anda bir seye ihtiyacim yok.

english: Then go away! Honestly, you have no idea of the pressure I am under. I can't afford any distractions!
translation: O zaman git buradan! Gercekten, benim ne kadar baski altinda oldugumu bilmiyorsun. Dikkat daginikligina tahammülüm yok!

english: Sorry, I'll go.
Good. I'm attempting to subdue the elemental mechanisms of the universe to my will. Inane chatter from random idiots is not helping me achieve this!
translation: Güzel. Evrenin temel mekanizmalarini irademe boyun egdirmeye calisiyorum. Rastgele aptallarin anlamsiz gevezelikleri bunu basarmama yardimci olmuyor!

english: There, I have repaired your pouches. Now leave me alone. I'm concentrating!
translation: Iste, cantalarini tamir ettim. Simdi beni rahat birak. Konsantre oluyorum!

english: You don't seem to have any pouches in need of repair. Leave me alone!
translation: Tamir edilmesi gereken cantan yok gibi görünüyor. Beni rahat birak!

english: Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to answer this for me.
The Dark mage has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Karanlik büyücü sana bir meydan okuma parsömeni verdi!

english: Please answer the question.
Stop wasting my time! That is wrong!
Spot on!
The Dark mage has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
Why not?
What are you doing here?
I need your help with something.
Can I have another Abyssal book?
translation: Baska bir Abyssal kitabi alabilir miyim?

english: Can I have a new essence pouch?
translation: Yeni bir öz kesesi alabilir miyim?

english: Can you repair my pouches?
Actually, I don't need anything right now.
translation: Aslinda su anda bir seye ihtiyacim yok.

english: Sorry, I'll go.
The player entered the stone circle south of Varrock with Silverlight
translation: Oyuncu, Silverlight ile Varrock'un güneyindeki tas cemberine girdi.

english: Arise, O mighty Delrith! Bring destruction to this soft, weak city!
translation: Kalk, ey güclü Delrith! Bu yumusak, zayif sehri yok et!

english: Arise, Delrith!
Ha ha ha! At last you are free, my demonic brother! Rest now, and then have your revenge on this pitiful city!
translation: Ha ha ha! Sonunda özgürsün, seytani kardesim! Simdi dinlen, sonra bu acinasi sehirden intikamini al!

english: Who's that?
Noo! Not Silverlight! Delrith is not ready yet!
translation: Hayir! Silverlight olmasin! Delrith henüz hazir degil!

english: I've got to get out of here...
Hello! What are you doing here?
Hello, I am here to investigate rumours of a dark magical presence in these lands.
translation: Merhaba, bu topraklarda karanlik bir büyünün var olduguna dair söylentileri arastirmak icin buradayim.

english: What rumours have you heard exactly?
translation: Tam olarak ne gibi söylentiler duydun?

english: I've heard there are hidden ruins in the mountains here with the power to re-animate beings from the dead. Zandar Horfyre sent me to study them.
translation: Burada, daglarda ölüleri diriltme gücüne sahip gizli kalintilar oldugunu duydum. Zandar Horfyre beni onlari incelemem icin gönderdi.

english: Do you know where in the mountains these ruins are?
translation: Bu kalintilarin daglarda nerede oldugunu biliyor musun?

english: Sadly no but I will find them, I will begin looking for information in Arceeus, they seem like my kind of people.
translation: Maalesef hayir, ama onlari bulacagim. Arceeus'ta bilgi aramaya baslayacagim, onlar benim gibi insanlar gibi görünüyorlar.

english: If you say so, good luck.
What are you doing here?
I'm working on combining the dark teleportation magic of these lands into physical form.
translation: Bu topraklardaki karanlik teleportasyon büyüsünü fiziksel forma dönüstürmeye calisiyorum.

english: Kind of like teleportation tablets?
Yes, but not made quite the same way.
translation: Evet, ama tam olarak ayni sekilde yapilmis degil.

english: Can I do that?
If you must. That lectern over there contains the book I've been working on.
translation: Gerekirse. Suradaki kürsüde üzerinde calistigim kitap var.

english: What are you reading?
I am seeking to understand more about the dark powers present in these lands. Now leave me be, there is much to be learned.
translation: Bu topraklarda bulunan karanlik gücleri daha iyi anlamaya calisiyorum. Simdi beni yalniz birak, ögrenecek cok sey var.

english: C'mon, why won't this thing open?
translation: Hadi ama, bu sey neden acilmiyor?

english: Would you like me to give you a hand with that?
It's okay, I think I've got it... Agh, I thought I had it that time!
translation: Sorun yok, sanirim hallettim... Ah, bu sefer basardim sanmistim!

english: Why are you searching this coffin?
I need to bring that mysterious stranger 100 Hallowed marks so that he can help me escape Darkmeyer.
translation: O gizemli yabancinin Darkmeyer'den kacmama yardim etmesi icin ona 100 Kutsal Isaret getirmem gerekiyor.

english: 100 seems like a lot. How many do you have so far?
translation: 100 cok fazla gibi görünüyor. Su ana kadar kac tane topladin?

english: None.
I don't have 100 either.
That's okay. I'm sure I'll get this open eventually.
translation: Sorun degil. Eninde sonunda acacagimdan eminim.

english: I happen to have 100 Hallowed marks on me. I can give you some if you'd like?
translation: Benim üzerimde 100 Hallowed isareti var. Istersen sana biraz verebilirim?

english: Wow! You'd do that for me?
translation: Vay canina! Benim icin bunu mu yaparsin?

english: On second thoughts, I think I'll keep them for myself.
translation: Bir daha düsündüm de, sanirim kendime saklayacagim.

english: Oh... You didn't have to tease me like that.
translation: Oh... Beni böyle kizdirmana gerek yoktu.

english: Sure. I'll probably find more while I'm down here anyway.
translation: Tabii. Zaten burada daha fazlasini bulacagim.

english: I can't thank you enough! I can finally buy my freedom!
translation: Sana ne kadar tesekkür etsem az! Sonunda özgürlügümü satin alabilecegim!

english: You're welcome!
The slave departs as you hand him 100 Hallowed marks.
translation: Köle, ona 100 Kutsal Isaret verdiginde ayrilir.

english: It feels nice to do the right thing.
translation: Dogru seyi yapmak güzel bir duygu.

english: Wait, why are you still here? I gave you the 100 Hallowed marks you need to escape.
translation: Bekle, neden hâlâ buradasin? Kacmak icin ihtiyacin olan 100 Kutsal Isareti verdim.

english: I think you have me mistaken for someone else.
Now go away. I can't hear the locking mechanism with you breathing in my ear!
translation: Simdi git buradan. Nefesin kulagimda oldugu icin kilit mekanizmasinin sesini duyamiyorum!

english: C'mon, almost got it...
Agh, thought I had it that time!
Don't give him 100 Hallowed marks.
Give him 100 Hallowed marks.
How am I supposed to get past this?
Gah!
Hopefully I'll make it out of Darkmeyer one day.
Phew, I made it! Time for a break.
Thank Saradomin that mysterious stranger gave me this ring or I'd be toast!
translation: Saradomin'e sükürler olsun ki o gizemli yabanci bana bu yüzügü verdi, yoksa mahvolurdum!

english: That trap was harder than I thought! Perhaps I'm not cut out for this.
translation: Bu tuzak sandigimdan daha zordu! Belki de bu is icin uygun degilim.

english: I can't believe we've finally arrived, I can't wait to explore!
translation: Sonunda vardigimiza inanamiyorum, kesfetmek icin sabirsizlaniyorum!

english: So much to see, I don't know where to start!
translation: Görülecek o kadar cok sey var ki, nereden baslayacagimi bilemiyorum!

english: A whole new continent to explore... what a time to be alive!
translation: Kesfedilecek yepyeni bir kita... Ne harika bir zaman!

english: Are you the tour guide?
Nope, I'm just as lost as you.
translation: Hayir, ben de sizin kadar kayboldum.

english: I overheard someone mention there are pirates and thieves here, be careful!
translation: Burada korsanlar ve hirsizlar oldugunu duydum, dikkatli olun!

english: What's the device saying now?
I don't know. It's giving strange readings...
I'm not even sure it's working any more.
translation: Artik calisip calismadigindan bile emin degilim.

english: This is a wild goose chase! We trek halfway across the world and there's nothing down here but this bunch of useless goblins!
translation: Bu bosuna bir arayis! Dünyanin öbür ucuna geldik ve burada sadece bu ise yaramaz goblinler var!

english: I am sure my triangulation calculations indicated that the source of power was in this rough area...
translation: Ücgenleme hesaplamalarim, gücün kaynaginin bu engebeli bölgede oldugunu gösteriyordu...

english: I find it encouraging that it's pointed to somewhere where there actually are caves.
translation: Gercekten magaralarin oldugu bir yeri isaret etmesi umut verici.

english: This part of the world is riddled with caves! It's hard not to hit a cave around here! Are you sure you're not just picking up these goblin lanterns or something stupid?
translation: Bu bölgede magaralar cok fazla! Burada magara bulmamak zor! Goblin fenerlerini falan algilamadigindan emin misin?

english: You should have more faith in my skills as a mage! I've been working on this for years-
translation: Büyücü olarak yeteneklerime daha fazla güvenmelisin! Yillardir bunun üzerinde calisiyorum...

english: Gah! We have an eavesdropper! Buzz off, adventurer - go talk to the goblins or something.
