translation: Gah! Dinleyen biri var! Defol git maceraci, goblinlerle falan konus.

english: Okay, I won't bother you.
That's what I like to see: a polite adventurer! Now, where was I...
translation: Iste görmek istedigim sey bu: kibar bir maceraci! Simdi, nerede kalmistim...

english: What are you looking for?
None of your business!
Hey, I'm one of you guys! See this pendant?
translation: Hey, ben de sizden biriyim! Bu kolyeyi görüyor musun?

english: Where did you come from? Who sent you? I'll have you know I'm the mage's bodyguard for this job. We don't need anyone else!
translation: Nereden geldin? Seni kim gönderdi? Bilmeni isterim ki, bu is icin büyücünün korumasi benim. Baska kimseye ihtiyacimiz yok!

english: No one sent me, I'm just nosy.
Well stick your nose somewhere else!
translation: O zaman burnunu baska yere sok!

english: I'm sorry, but pendant or no pendant, this is a secret. I'm sure you understand.
translation: Üzgünüm, kolye olsun ya da olmasin, bu bir sir. Eminim anlarsin.

english: Lucien sent me.
He did not! If he had, I would be aware of it!
Don't try to lie to us! Now go away!
translation: Bize yalan söylemeye calisma! Simdi git buradan!

english: I'm sure you're a much better bodyguard than me, but perhaps I can help in some non-bodyguarding way?
translation: Eminim sen benden cok daha iyi bir korumalisin, ama belki koruma disinda baska bir sekilde yardimci olabilirim?

english: Well, we don't know how big this thing is. If we find it, I suppose we might need someone else to help us carry it.
translation: Bu seyin ne kadar büyük oldugunu bilmiyoruz. Eger bulursak, tasimak icin baska birinin yardimina ihtiyacimiz olabilir.

english: So, what are we looking for?
You're not very well briefed, are you?
To be honest I'm still a bit hazy on that point too.
translation: Dürüst olmak gerekirse, ben de bu konuda hala biraz kararsizim.

english: *sigh*
Lucien has asked us to search for artefacts that give off a very specific type of energy. After many years of research, I think I'm finally drawing near.
translation: Lucien bizden cok özel bir enerji yayan eserleri aramamizi istedi. Yillarca süren arastirmalardan sonra, sonunda hedefe yaklasiyorum galiba.

english: You don't sound very sure.
Bah! My detection device is totally shot. I don't understand it.
translation: Bah! Algilama cihazim tamamen bozuldu. Anlamiyorum.

english: I wouldn't hang around for now, adventurer. It could be a long while before I can get a clear reading.
translation: Simdilik buralarda takilma, maceraci. Net bir okuma alabilmem uzun zaman alabilir.

english: Okay, I'll be on my way.
Okay, I won't bother you.
What are you looking for?
Hey, I'm one of you guys! See this pendant?
translation: Hey, ben de sizden biriyim! Bu kolyeyi görüyor musun?

english: No one sent me, I'm just nosy.
Lucien sent me.
(Charm) I'm sure you're a much better bodyguard than me...
translation: (Cazibe) Eminim sen benden cok daha iyi bir korumalisin...

english: What are you buying?
Show me what you have.
What do you do around here?
I'm responsible for organising and selling off any surplus ranging supplies.
translation: Fazla malzeme ve mühimmatin organize edilmesi ve satilmasindan sorumluyum.

english: Those fellows over in Lovakengj are an efficient bunch... They often produce far more than the army actually needs.
translation: Lovakengj'deki arkadaslar cok verimli bir grup... Genellikle ordunun ihtiyac duydugundan cok daha fazlasini üretiyorlar.

english: I've got a wide selection of ranged weapons and ammo, if you wanted to take a look? Its all good stuff.
translation: Genis bir menzilli silah ve mühimmat yelpazem var, bakmak ister misin? Hepsi iyi malzeme.

english: I don't think I need anything.
Hmph...
Show me what you have.
What do you do around here?
I don't think I need anything.
Today is a good day to be a frog!
translation: Bugün kurbaga olmak icin güzel bir gün!

english: It sure is. Now that we have peace, life is at an all time high!
translation: Kesinlikle öyle. Artik baris saglandigina göre, hayat her zamankinden daha güzel!

english: Hello!
'Ello [guv/miss].
Why are you not helping out the others?
Well you see, [guv/miss], I've got these unshakable religious convictions.
translation: Sey, , benim sarsilmaz dini inanclarim var.

english: And those are?
Well, it's like this, see. I used to do a bit of the old priestin' on the side.
translation: Söyle ki, eskiden yan is olarak rahiplik yapardim.

english: You know, collectin' for repairs to the church roof, passing the collection plate, jumble sales, nicking the lead off the temple roof so they needed repairing again.
translation: Bilirsiniz, kilise catisinin onarimi icin para toplardim, bagis kutusu dolastirirdim, bit pazarlari düzenlerdim, tapinagin catisindan kursunu calardim, böylece tekrar onarim gereksinimi olurdu.

english: Real holy stuff, you know.
That doesn't sound all that holy to me.
Well, that's because you're not a  of the cloth are you?
translation: Cünkü siz din adami degilsiniz, degil mi?

english: You are, in fact, what we refer to in layman's terms as a punter.
translation: Aslinda, siz bizim tabirimizle bir bahiscisiniz.

english: But anyway, all that priestin' left me with an unshakable faith in three things.
translation: Ama neyse, tüm bu rahiplik isleri bana üc seye sarsilmaz bir inanc kazandirdi.

english: The power of good over evil.
The true glory of the human spirit.
And that I ain't goin out there with those things runnin' around.
translation: Ve o seyler ortalikta dolasirken disari cikmayacagim.

english: You used to be a priest, right?
I didn't nick anything, [guv/miss]. I've got twenty people who'll swear blind I was...
translation: Ben hicbir sey calmadim, . Yirmi kisi benim... olduguna yemin eder.

english: What?
Never mind. I need some help with the spirit in the brewing equipment.
translation: Bos ver. Bira yapma ekipmanindaki ruh konusunda yardima ihtiyacim var.

english: Well, I'll bless something for you if you need it, but just don't spread it around that I'm giving out freebies.
translation: Ihtiyacin varsa bir seyleri kutsayabilirim, ama bedava hediye dagittigimi etrafa yayma.

english: Trust me, [guv/miss], lots of people need help after coming into contact with the spirits we produce here.
translation: Inan bana, , burada ürettigimiz ruhlarla temas ettikten sonra yardima ihtiyaci olan bircok insan var.

english: Can you bless this wrench for me?
translation: Bu anahtari benim icin kutsayabilir misin?

english: Nope.
Nope?
Nope. You don't strike me as being... devout, you know?
translation: Hayir. Bana pek dindar biri gibi gelmiyorsun, anlarsin ya?

english: Come again?
Your holy aura, it's a little shoddy, if you catch my drift.
translation: Kutsal auraniz, biraz kalitesiz, anlarsiniz ya.

english: You need a Prayer level of 47.
Oh!
Well why didn't you just say so?
I might have had a bit of an overestimation problem [guv/miss]. I'm sure it won't happen again.
translation: Biraz abartmis olabilirim . Bir daha olmayacagina eminim.

english: I might well do. Remember, only the first one's free.
Dominoes Ad Nauseum, Romanes Eunt Domus.
translation: Dominoes Ad Nauseum, Romanes Eunt Domus.

english: Sorted.
Is that it?
Oh, you want the full package deal.
All right. Brace yourself.
Groovy.
Thanks!
No problem, [guv/miss]. Good luck with your little problem.
translation: Sorun degil, . Kücük sorununla iyi sanslar.

english: You might find that little wrench worth hanging on to after you're done with the Spirit.
translation: Ruhla isin bittikten sonra o kücük anahtari saklamaya deger bulabilirsin.

english: Really? I mean, it's holy and everything, but I don't think it looks all that useful.
translation: Gercekten mi? Yani, kutsal falan ama pek kullanisli görünmüyor.

english: Well, it may not look much, but you'll find that you might need a few less prayer potions if you have it in your pack, if you know what I mean.
translation: Görünüsü pek bir sey ifade etmiyor olabilir ama onu cantanizda tasirsaniz, dua iksirlerine daha az ihtiyac duyacaginizi göreceksiniz, anlarsiniz ya.

english: Well, no. I don't know what you mean, but I'm sure I'll find out!
translation: Hayir, ne demek istediginizi anlamadim ama eminim ögrenecegim!

english: You mean more help? I've already blessed one wrench for you, that should be enough.
translation: Daha fazla yardim mi demek istiyorsun? Senin icin bir Ingiliz anahtari kutsadim, bu yeterli olmali.

english: Ello again [guv/miss]. How's things?
Good! Everything seems to have worked out ok.
I'm sure it'll stay that way so long as you don't know it's missing.
translation: Kayip oldugunu bilmedigin sürece böyle kalacagina eminim.

english: Nothin' [guv/miss], you just have a nice day.
Ello again [guv/miss]. I take it you're here about the wrench?
translation: Merhaba tekrar . Sanirim anahtar icin geldiniz?

english: What? The Holy Wrench? But I lost it somewhere...
translation: Ne? Kutsal Anahtar mi? Ama onu bir yerde kaybettim...

english: Well [guv/miss], maybe that's what I want you to think.
translation: Sey , belki de sizin öyle düsünmenizi istiyorum.

english: As soon as you've got somewhere to put it I'll hand it over. I'll keep it nice and holy until then.
translation: Onu koyacak bir yer bulur bulmaz size veririm. O zamana kadar onu güzel ve kutsal tutacagim.

english: There you go. I've kept it nice and holy for you.
translation: Al bakalim. Senin icin güzel ve kutsal bir sekilde sakladim.

english: Thanks...
Well, that's because you're not a [man/woman] of the cloth are you?
Build us a stove mate, I'm absolutely starvin!
translation: Bize bir ocak yap dostum, acliktan ölüyorum!

english: You must be really tired from the journey, you did so much.
translation: Yolculuktan cok yorulmus olmalisin, cok sey yaptin.

english: ...So my expertise were not required this time, a man's still gotta eat.
translation: ...Bu sefer uzmanligim gerekmedi, ama bir erkek yine de yemek yemeli.

english: I guess I'll get building then...
Cheers mate!
About these eggs… Odd colour, don't cha think?
translation: Bu yumurtalar hakkinda... Garip bir renkleri var, sence de öyle degil mi?

english: The birds here are a little exotic, apparently.
Hmm, well, good effort, but I'll pass on the grub this time.
translation: Hmm, iyi denemeydi, ama bu sefer yemegi pas gececegim.

english: What if I gave you a box?
I'm not sure that'll change my mind.
If not a box, then what about a fox?
Nope.
A mouse, a house? Would these change your mind?
translation: Fare, ev? Bunlar fikrini degistirir mi?

english: For the love of Saradomin, please leave me be
translation: Saradomin askina, lütfen beni rahat birak.

english: I will! I promise! Just try them and you'll see.
translation: Birakacagim! Söz veriyorum! Sadece dene, göreceksin.

english: Alright! Fine! I concede.
Thoughts?
Yeah, I guess they're nice
Apparently you aren't as stupid as you look.
Hello, young adventurer. What brings you to the Museum's paleontology floor?
translation: Merhaba, genc maceraci. Seni müzenin paleontoloji katina getiren nedir?

english: What's paleontology?
I'm glad you asked! Paleontology is the study of prehistoric lifeforms in Gielinor through the examination of fossils.
translation: Sorduguna sevindim! Paleontoloji, fosilleri inceleyerek Gielinor'daki tarih öncesi yasam formlarini inceleyen bilim dalidir.

english: We use fossils to try determine several things: information about what fossil belonged to, what the environment was like, and try to uncover secrets of Gielinor's past.
translation: Fosilleri kullanarak birkac seyi belirlemeye calisiriz: fosilin neye ait oldugu, ortamin nasil oldugu hakkinda bilgi ve Gielinor'un gecmisinin sirlarini ortaya cikarmaya calisiriz.

english: What else would you like to know?
Where do these fossils come from?
Ah, brilliant question. Fossils of creatures are found in sedimentary rock, we use specialised tools to carefully remove the unwanted rock only leaving only the fossil behind.
translation: Ah, harika bir soru. Canlilarin fosilleri tortul kayaclarda bulunur, biz özel aletler kullanarak istenmeyen kayalari dikkatlice cikarir ve sadece fosili geride birakiriz.

english: If you're looking for fossils yourself, I hear there is a voyage to a mysterious island to discover new types of fossil.
translation: Eger fosil ariyorsaniz, yeni fosil türleri kesfetmek icin gizemli bir adaya yapilan bir yolculuk oldugunu duydum.

english: You should speak to the Curator as he knows more about it than I.
translation: Küratörle konusmalisiniz, cünkü o bu konuda benden daha fazla bilgi sahibidir.

english: Is there anything else you need help with?
What can I do with these fossils?
Any fossils you find can be added to the surrounding display cases.
If you manage to complete display case, the Museum will ensure you are rewarded for your efforts.
translation: Vitrini tamamlamayi basarirsaniz, müze cabalariniz icin sizi ödüllendirecektir.

english: Also, if you find any rare fossils on your travels, make sure you hold onto them. Something tells me they will be very valuable in the future...
translation: Ayrica, seyahatlerinizde nadir fosiller bulursaniz, onlari sakladiginizdan emin olun. Icimden bir ses, bunlarin gelecekte cok degerli olacagini söylüyor...

english: Do you have any other questions?
What can you tell me about some of the fossil displays?
It looks like the Museum doesn't have any complete fossil displays yet. I could only speculate on what they will contain.
translation: Görünüse göre müzede henüz tam fosil sergileri yok. Icinde ne olacagi konusunda sadece tahminde bulunabilirim.

english: Of course. Which display would you like to ask about?
translation: Tabii ki. Hangi sergi hakkinda bilgi almak istersiniz?

english: The one that looks like a great leviathan.
translation: Büyük bir leviathan gibi görünen sergi.

english: The one that looks like a foot print of a mythical animal.
translation: Efsanevi bir hayvanin ayak izi gibi görünen sergi.

english: The one that looks like an imprint of a posterior.
translation: Arka kismin izi gibi görünen sergi.

english: The one that looks like a zygomite.
The one that looks like a snake in the shape of a hoop.
translation: Cember seklinde bir yilan gibi görünen sergi.

english: The one that looks like a clam shell.
The one that looks like a 'big' foot print.
translation: “Büyük” bir ayak izi gibi görünen sergi.

english: The one that looks like a crab shell.
The one that looks like a cyclopse with two heads.
translation: Iki basli bir tek gözlü dev gibi görünen sergi.

english: The one that looks like it could be used for fuel.
translation: Yakit olarak kullanilabilecek gibi görünen sergi.

english: The one that looks like a tar creature.
The one that looks like a giant dragonfly.
The one that looks like an ancient cave painting.
The one that looks like a person with a fish tail.
translation: Balik kuyrugu olan bir insana benzeyen.

english: The one that looks like a lava creature.
The one that looks like a pufferfish.
The one that looks like a dragon skull.
The one that looks like a squirrel with huge teeth.
translation: Kocaman disleri olan bir sincap gibi görünen.

english: The one that looks like a dragon egg.
The one that looks like a cross between a mushroom and kangaroo.
translation: Mantar ve kanguru karisimi gibi görünen.

english: The one that looks like an unusual lobster.
translation: Sira disi bir istakoz gibi görünen.

english: The one that looks like a creature with a giant skull and small body.
translation: Dev kafatasi ve kücük gövdesi olan bir yaratik gibi görünen.

english: The one that looks like a tree sized mushroom.
translation: Agac büyüklügünde bir mantar gibi görünen.

english: The one that looks like scary mushrooms.
The one that looks like a tortoise with a mushroom on its shell.
translation: Kabugunda mantar olan bir kaplumbaga gibi görünen.

english: The one that looks like a huge pitcher plant.
translation: Dev bir sürahi bitkisi gibi görünen.

english: The one that looks like a cross between a dark beast and a shark.
translation: Karanlik bir canavar ile köpekbaliginin karisimi gibi görünen mantar.

english: The one that looks like a merfish with legs.
translation: Bacaklari olan deniz kizi gibi görünen mantar.

english: The one that looks like a plant with a stack of mushrooms.
translation: Üzerinde mantar yigini olan bitki gibi görünen mantar.

english: The one that looks like a big mushroom.
The one that looks like a toucan with two heads.
translation: Iki basli tukan gibi görünen mantar.

english: The one that looks like a bird with a snail shell on its back.
translation: Sirtinda salyangoz kabugu olan kus gibi görünen mantar.

english: Um... yes. It's an interesting specimen isn't it?
translation: Evet... Ilginc bir örnek, degil mi?

english: Do you know much about this display?
translation: Bu sergi hakkinda cok sey biliyor musunuz?

english: Um... yes, but I couldn't possibly share that information right now.
translation: Evet, ama su anda bu bilgiyi paylasamam.

english: It's an interesting specimen isn't it? It appears that the specimen is thousands of years old!
translation: Ilginc bir örnek, degil mi? Görünüse göre bu örnek binlerce yillik!

english: Are you sure?
Well that's what the analysis from the fossil shows.
Aren't you going to tell me about the display?
translation: Sergi hakkinda bana bilgi vermeyecek misiniz?

english: What did you ask about again?
Nevermind.
What's paleontology?
Where do these fossils come from?
What can I do with these fossils?
What can you tell me about some of the fossil displays?
translation: Fosil sergileri hakkinda bana ne söyleyebilirsiniz?

english: Nevermind
Pssst! Come here if you want to do some amulet trading.
translation: Pssst! Tilsim ticareti yapmak istiyorsan buraya gel.

english: What do you mean pssst?
Errr, I was...I was clearing my throat.
Why don't you ever restock some types of amulets?
Some of these amulets are very hard to get. I have to wait until an adventurer supplies me.
translation: Bu muskalarin bazilari cok zor bulunur. Bir maceraci bana tedarik edene kadar beklemem gerekiyor.

english: What are you selling?
What do you mean pssst?
Why don't you ever restock some types of amulets?
translation: Neden bazi muska türlerini hic yenilemiyorsun?

english: I claim [player name] as my own!
Your time here is over, [player name].
There is no escape, [player name]...
Now is the time you die, [player name].
Beware mortals, [player name] now travels with me.
translation: Ölümlüler, dikkatli olun, Maceraci artik benimle birlikte seyahat ediyor.

english: I have come for you, [player name]!
[Player name] is mine!
Let me escort you to [respawn location], [player name].
Muhahahahaha!
Hello mortal. Have you come to retrieve something you lost when you died?
translation: Merhaba ölümlü. Öldügünde kaybettigin bir seyi geri almaya mi geldin?

english: How does that work?
When you die, you often drop things you were carrying. In most cases, a gravestone appears near where you died, and your items can be retrieved there.
translation: Öldügünde, genellikle tasidigin esyalari düsürürsün. Cogu durumda, öldügün yerin yakininda bir mezar tasi belirir ve esyalarini oradan geri alabilirsin.

english: However, gravestones do not last for long. When your gravestone collapses, your items come here, to me. I can return them to you - though I charge a fee for my services.
translation: Ancak mezar taslari uzun süre kalmaz. Mezar tasin yikildiginda, esyalarin buraya, bana gelir. Onlari sana geri verebilirim, ancak hizmetim icin bir ücret talep ederim.

english: Aside from that, if you bring me your unwanted possessions, and sacrifice them into my Coffer here, I'll count their value against any future fees I charge you.
translation: Bunun disinda, istemedigin esyalarini bana getirir ve buradaki Sandigima kurban edersen, gelecekte senden alacagim ücretlerden bunlarin degerini düserim.

english: I don't accept just any junk, but I'll try to give you a good price for anything decent.
translation: Her türlü cöpü kabul etmiyorum, ama iyi durumda olan her sey icin sana iyi bir fiyat vermeye calisirim.

english: So do you need to retrieve something you lost when you died?
translation: Öldügünde kaybettigin bir seyi geri almak mi istiyorsun?

english: What is this place?
As you should be able to see, I am Death. The Grim Reaper. The Inexorable One. The Inescapable Grasp of Mortal Destiny. And this is my little office. Nice, isn't it?
translation: Gördügün gibi, ben Ölüm'üm. Azrail. Acimasiz Olan. Kacinilmaz Ölüm Kaderinin Pencesi. Ve burasi benim kücük ofisim. Güzel, degil mi?

english: It's lovely.
Thank you. I feel the colour scheme suits my style. Now, can I help you retrieve something you lost when you died?
translation: Tesekkürler. Renk düzeni benim tarzima cok uygun. Simdi, öldügünde kaybettigin bir seyi geri almanda yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: Your decorations leave a bit to be desired.
Sometimes it's hard to care for beauty when one's very existence is just seen as a curse upon the world. Now, do you actually want to retrieve something from me?
translation: Bazen, kisinin varligi dünya icin bir lanet olarak görüldügünde, güzellige özen göstermek zor olabilir. Simdi, benden gercekten bir sey almak istiyor musun?

english: Yes, have you got anything for me?
translation: Evet, benim icin bir seyin var mi?

english: Can I choose a different-looking gravestone?
translation: Farkli görünümlü bir mezar tasi secebilir miyim?

english: You haven't got 200,000 coins to pay for that. I can take coins from your inventory, or from my Coffer.
translation: Bunun icin 200.000 altin ödeyecek kadar paran yok. Envanterinden veya kasamdan altin alabilirim.

english: Actually, never mind.
Most people won't see your grave, by the way. It appears to you, but it aims to be invisible to everyone else. Are you sure you want to buy a cosmetic override for it?
translation: Bu arada, cogu insan mezarini görmeyecek. Sana görünüyor, ama diger herkes icin görünmez olmayi amacliyor. Bunun icin kozmetik bir degisiklik satin almak istediginden emin misin?

english: Yes, I understand other people won't often see it.
translation: Evet, diger insanlarin onu sik sik görmeyecegini anliyorum.

english: Your gravestone is now the Angel of Death.
It is not for me to judge how people spend their money.
translation: Insanlarin paralarini nasil harcadiklarini yargilamak bana düsmez.

english: No thanks, it's not worth it.
Do you really want to switch to the basic gravestone? I'm not offering to give back the fee you paid earlier.
translation: Gercekten temel mezar tasina gecmek istiyor musun? Daha önce ödedigin ücreti geri vermeyi teklif etmiyorum.

english: Yes, I want the basic gravestone.
Your gravestone is now the basic type.
You've already got the basic gravestone.
Er... I suppose so.
How would you like to... die?
Not just now, thanks.
Really? There isn't much else for you to do here. But you know your business.
translation: Gercekten mi? Burada yapacak baska bir seyin yok. Ama sen isini biliyorsun.

english: Hello mortal. If you're looking for something you lost when you died, I'm afraid I don't cater to Ultimate Ironmen. Your items would have fallen on the ground where you died.
translation: Merhaba ölümlü. Öldügünde kaybettigin bir seyi ariyorsan, korkarim Ultimate Ironmen'e hizmet vermiyorum. Esyalarin öldügün yere düsmüs olmali.

english: Can I change how I die?
So, mortal... you have died, as all mortals do. As you have suffered the loss of some items on this occasion, I have brought you here to explain for you how that works.
translation: Öyleyse, ölümlü... tüm ölümlüler gibi sen de öldün. Bu olayda bazi esyalarini kaybettigin icin, sana bunun nasil isledigini aciklamak icin seni buraya getirdim.

english: I lost items? Can I get them back?
translation: Esyalarimi mi kaybettim? Onlari geri alabilir miyim?

english: Let me explain... Across most of the land of Gielinor, when you die, some of the items you're carrying are dropped.
translation: Aciklayayim... Gielinor topraklarinin cogunda, öldügünde tasidigin bazi esyalar düser.

english: I will look after such items,without a time limit. However, I do charge more for my services. It would be cheaper to retrieve them from the gravestone directly, if you can reach it in time.
translation: Bu esyalara zaman siniri olmaksizin bakacagim. Ancak, hizmetlerim icin daha fazla ücret aliyorum. Zamaninda ulasabilirsen, mezar tasindan dogrudan geri almak daha ucuz olur.

english: Tell me about gravestones again.
translation: Mezar taslari hakkinda tekrar bilgi ver.

english: Gladly... Across most of the land of Gielinor, when you die, some of the items you're carrying are dropped.
translation: Seve seve... Gielinor topraklarinin cogunda, öldügünde, tasidigin bazi esyalar düser.

english: How do I pay a gravestone fee?
Cash is always acceptable. Also, a gravestone can take it directly from you bank, in case you didn't have enough with you.
translation: Nakit her zaman kabul edilir. Ayrica, yaninizda yeterli para yoksa, mezar tasi bankanizdan dogrudan ödeme alabilir.

english: Besides that, take a look at my Coffer here. You can bring your unwanted possessions, and sacrifice them into my Coffer. I'll count their value against any future gravestone fees you're charged.
translation: Bunun yani sira, buradaki sandigima bir göz atin. Istemediginiz esyalarinizi getirip sandigima feda edebilirsiniz. Bunlarin degerini, gelecekte ödeyeceginiz mezar tasi ücretlerinden düserim.

english: How long do I have to return to my gravestone?
translation: Mezar tasima ne kadar sürede dönmem gerekir?

english: How do I know what will happen to my items when I die?
translation: Öldügümde esyalarima ne olacagini nasil bilebilirim?

english: There is a menu to predict these things for you. Take a look at your Worn Items side-panel...
translation: Bunlari tahmin etmek icin bir menü var. Takili Esyalar yan paneline bir göz at...

english: I think I'm done here.
I'm afraid we have more topics to cover before you leave. Speak to me when you are ready to continue.
translation: Korkarim, gitmeden önce ele almamiz gereken baska konular var. Devam etmeye hazir oldugunda bana söyle.

english: Very well. Once you pass through my portal, you will have 15 minutes to reach your gravestone.
translation: Peki. Portalimdan gectikten sonra mezar tasina ulasmak icin 15 dakikan olacak.

english: I believe I was explaining gravestones to you. We still have some more topics to cover.
translation: Sana mezar taslarini acikliyordum sanirim. Hala ele almamiz gereken bazi konular var.

english: I haven't finished talking to you yet, [player name]. Please don't worry about your gravestone - it will wait until you leave this place.
translation: Seninle konusmam henüz bitmedi, Maceraci. Mezar tasin icin endiselenme, buradan ayrilana kadar bekleyecek.

english: Would you like me to remind you about gravestones?
translation: Mezar taslari hakkinda sana hatirlatmami ister misin?

english: You haven't unlocked that. You can do so by reading a Trailblazer reloaded death scroll.
translation: Bunu henüz acmadin. Trailblazer reloaded ölüm parsömenini okuyarak acabilirsin.

english: Have you come to retrieve something you lost from a previous gravestone?
translation: Önceki mezar tasindan kaybettigin bir seyi geri almaya mi geldin?

english: You will now die like a Trailblazer.
You are already using that.
You will now perish like most others in Gielinor.
Hello mortal. If you're looking for something you lost when you died, I'm afraid I don't cater to Ultimate Iron [Men/Women]. Your items would have fallen on the ground where you died.
translation: Merhaba ölümlü. Öldügünde kaybettigin bir seyi ariyorsan, korkarim Ultimate Iron adam'a hizmet vermiyorum. Esyalarin öldügün yere düsmüs olmali.

english: So what can I do here?
Nothing, really. Please leave when you are ready.
translation: Aslinda hicbir sey. Hazir oldugunda lütfen git.

What is this place?
It's lovely.
Your decorations leave a bit to be desired.
Yes, have you got anything for me?
translation: Evet, benim icin bir seyin var mi?

english: More options...
Can I choose a different-looking gravestone?
translation: Farkli görünümlü bir mezar tasi secebilir miyim?

english: Actually, never mind.
Yes, I understand other people won't often see it.
translation: Evet, diger insanlarin onu sik sik görmeyecegini anliyorum.

english: No thanks, it's not worth it.
Yes, I want the basic gravestone.

Not just now, thanks.

How long do I have to return to my gravestone?

translation: Öldügümde esyalarima ne olacagini nasil bilebilirim?

Hello.
Not infected are you?
I don't think so.
You don't seem very sure. We don't want any infected near the children. Be off with you!
translation: Cok emin görünmüyorsunuz. Cocuklarin yaninda enfekte olanlarin olmasini istemiyoruz. Gidin buradan!

english: Whatever it is you're selling, we ain't interested!
But I'm not...
Did you not hear me? Clear off!
Nay, I've got no banknotes to exchange for that item.
translation: Hayir, o esya icin degistirecek banknotum yok.

english: Nay, there's no such thing as a banknote for that.
translation: Hayir, bunun icin banknot diye bir sey yok.

english: That IS a banknote!
Hello, no-fur. What are you doing in my mistress's garden?
translation: Merhaba, tüysüz. Sahibemin bahcesinde ne yapiyorsun?

english: Looking for sq'irks.
If it's sq'irks you're after then you've come to the right place. We've got four seasons' worth of them.
translation: Sq'irks ariyorsan dogru yere geldin. Dört mevsimlik sq'irksimiz var.

english: I've a couple of questions.
I'd be happy to help a friend of the feline.
translation: Bir kedi dostuna yardim etmekten memnuniyet duyarim.

english: What do you mean?
The Sphinx gave you that amulet, so she must hold you in high regard.
translation: Sfenks sana o tilsimi verdi, demek ki seni cok takdir ediyor.

english: If I remember correctly, it was the High Priest of Sophanem who gave it to me.
translation: Hatirladigim kadariyla, onu bana Sophanem'in Bas Rahibi vermisti.

english: He and the Sphinx are as thick as thieves, but regardless, I think you've a bit of a cat feel about you.
translation: O ve Sfenks cok yakin arkadaslar, ama yine de, bence sende biraz kedi havasi var.

english: Now what are these questions?
What are the creatures inside the gardens?
Oh, you mean the gardeners?
The strange, floaty creatures.
Yes, the gardeners. Don't let them see you or they'll teleport you out here. They're very protective of their crops.
translation: Evet, bahcivanlar. Seni görmesinler, yoksa seni buraya isinlarlar. Ekinlerini cok korurlar.

english: Thanks, I have another question though.
translation: Tesekkürler, ama baska bir sorum daha var.

english: Thanks for your help.
How do you get into the seasonal gardens?
I get in through gaps in the hedge. You are a little too big to squeeze through. I think you'll have to use the gates.
translation: Citlerin arasindaki bosluklardan giriyorum. Sen biraz fazla büyüksün, sikisip gecemezsin. Sanirim kapilari kullanman gerekecek.

english: I think the gates are locked, so you'll have to have good Thieving skills to get in.
translation: Kapilar kilitli sanirim, bu yüzden iceri girmek icin iyi hirsizlik becerilerine sahip olman gerekecek.

english: How is it that the gardens are in different seasons?
How did you get here?
Magic?
Exactly. The Sorceress likes to have a good supply of in-season sq'irks and herbs at all times.
translation: Aynen öyle. Büyücü, her zaman mevsiminde olan sq'irkler ve otlar stoklamak ister.

english: How do I get out of here?
Take a drink from the fountain.
Talking to cats.
A noble and rewarding past-time.
How did you get here?
Every time I play with spiders in the Sorceress's house, her silly apprentice completely freaks out and teleports me here!
translation: Büyücü'nün evinde örümceklerle oynadigimda, aptal ciragi cildiriyor ve beni buraya isinliyor!

english: So you've been stuck here since?
translation: O zamandan beri burada mi sikisip kaldin?

english: No, silly! I drink from the fountain whenever I want to leave.
translation: Hayir, aptal! Ayrilmak istedigimde cesmeden su iciyorum.

english: What are you doing here?
I get this strange urge for sq'irks. It's quite peculiar. I think I may be addicted.
translation: Sq'irks icin garip bir istek duyuyorum. Oldukca tuhaf. Sanirim bagimlisi oldum.

english: I think I know someone else who may be in a similar position.
translation: Benzer durumda olan baska birini taniyorum.

english: Don't tell me. Osman, right?
You know him too?
Oh, he used to come here all the time. Then one day, he just stopped.
translation: Oh, eskiden buraya sürekli gelirdi. Sonra bir gün, birdenbire gelmeyi birakti.

english: Who are you?
Del-Monty the cat, at your service.
Are you a famous adventurer who was turned into a cat by a vindictive mage?
translation: Sen, intikamci bir büyücü tarafindan kediye dönüstürülen ünlü bir maceraci misin?

english: No; as I said, I'm Del-Monty the cat, connoisseur of exotic fruits.
translation: Hayir, dedigim gibi, ben Del-Monty the cat, egzotik meyvelerin uzmani.

english: In that case, can you tell me anything about sq'irks?
translation: Öyleyse, sq'irks hakkinda bana bir seyler anlatabilir misin?

english: But of course! Their juice is an excellent source of energy for runners, and in the riper varieties they are known to heighten one's Thieving abilities.
translation: Tabii ki! Meyve suyu kosucular icin mükemmel bir enerji kaynagidir ve olgunlasmis cesitleri hirsizlik yeteneklerini artirdigi bilinir.

english: Nothing much.
Yawn! Nice talking to you then, no-fur.
Hey kitty!
Hiss!
Looking for sq'irks.
What are the creatures inside the gardens?
Thanks, I have another question though.
translation: Tesekkürler, ama baska bir sorum daha var.

english: Thanks for your help.
How do you get into the seasonal gardens?
How is it that the gardens are in different seasons?
How do I get out of here?
Talking to cats.

Who are you?
Nothing much.
Greetings! I am Alathazdrar, butler to the Demon Lords, and I offer thee my services for a mere 10000 coins!
translation: Selamlar! Ben Alathazdrar, Iblis Lordlarinin usagiyim ve sana sadece 10.000 sikke karsiliginda hizmetlerimi sunuyorum!

english: What can you do?

I have learned my trade under the leash of some of the harshest masters of the Demon Dimensions. I can cook to satisfy the most infernal stomachs, and fly on wings of flame to deposit thine items in the bank or bring
translation: Iblis Boyutlarinin en sert efendilerinin emri altinda meslegimi ögrendim. En cehennemvari mideleri bile tatmin edecek yemekler pisirebilir, alev kanatlariyla ucarak esyalarini bankaya birakabilir veya

english: planks from the sawmill in seconds.
translation: kereste fabrikasindan tahtalari saniyeler icinde getirebilirim.

english: Tell me about your previous jobs.

For millennia I have served and waited on the mighty Demon Lords of the Infernal Dimensions. I began as a humble footman in the household of Lord Thammaron, and for several centuries I was the private valet to
translation: Binlerce yildir Cehennem Boyutlarinin güclü Iblis Lordlarina hizmet ettim ve onlara bekcilik yaptim. Lord Thammaron'un evinde mütevazi bir usak olarak basladim ve birkac yüzyil boyunca Delrith'in özel usagiydim.

english: Delrith. I have also worked in the Grim Underworld, escorting the souls of the dead to their final abodes. But the incessant shadows and hellfire weary me, so I have come to serve mortal masters in the realms of light.
translation: Ayrica Grim Underworld'de calisarak ölülerin ruhlarini son dinlenme yerlerine götürdüm. Ancak bitmek bilmeyen gölgeler ve cehennem atesi beni yordu, bu yüzden isik alemlerinde ölümlü efendilere hizmet etmeye geldim.

english: You, a mere mortal with level [1-49] Construction, wish to employ ME, butler to Great Ones of the Outer Darkness? Ha ha ha! I refuse to work for anyone below level 50 Construction.
translation: Sen, [1-49] seviye Insaat becerisine sahip siradan bir ölümlü, Dis Karanligin Büyükleri'nin usagi olan BENI mi istihdam etmek istiyorsun? Ha ha ha! 50 seviye Insaat becerisinin altindaki kimse icin calismayi reddediyorum.

english: You already have a servant.
You need a second bedroom with a bed for your servant to sleep in.
translation: Hizmetcinin uyuyabilecegi ikinci bir yatak odasina ihtiyacin var.

english: You're hired... well, I don't have the money on me, but can I owe you? I'm good for it, honest.
translation: Ise alindin... Sey, üzerimde para yok, ama sana borclanabilir miyim? Ödeyecegim, söz veriyorum.

english: I regret, Master, that I must insist on payment up front.
translation: Üzgünüm efendim, ön ödeme konusunda israr etmek zorundayim.

english: You're hired!
I shall devote my every art to thy service, my Master.
Bones are a tool of prayer, and demonic magic prevents me from touching them, my Lord.
translation: Kemikler dua icin bir aractir ve seytani büyü onlari dokunmami engelliyor, efendim.

english: What can you do?
Tell me about your previous jobs
You're hired!
Rhaaaaaaa!
So you wish to join us? You have made a wise choice. When we summon the demon Agrith-Naar, he will grant all our worldly desires.
translation: Bize katilmak mi istiyorsun? Akillica bir secim yaptin. Agrith-Naar iblisini cagirdigimizda, dünyevi tüm arzularimizi yerine getirecek.

english: An abyssal whip, a dragon chain mail? To conjure these items is trivial for Agrith-Naar.
translation: Derin deniz kirbaci, ejderha zirhi mi? Agrith-Naar icin bu esyalari yaratmak cocuk oyuncagidir.

english: But you will not need such weapons or armour, for Agrith-Naar will grant you the power of life and death over all creatures!
translation: Ama bu tür silah ve zirhlara ihtiyacin olmayacak, cünkü Agrith-Naar sana tüm yaratiklar üzerinde yasam ve ölüm gücü verecek!

english: You shall have every wish granted, and everyone who has ever wronged you will burn in a hell of your own devising!
translation: Her dilegin yerine getirilecek ve sana haksizlik eden herkes, senin tasarladigin cehennemde yanacak!

english: Isn't this, you know, wrong?
Right and wrong are for the weak! This is your chance to choose to be on the side of the strong, and have all your desires granted, while the weak are crushed beneath Agrith-Naar's demonic feet!
translation: Dogru ve yanlis zayiflar icindir! Bu, güclülerin tarafinda yer almayi ve tüm arzularinin yerine getirilmesini secme sansin, zayiflar ise Agrith-Naar'in seytani ayaklari altinda ezilecek!

english: How do you know Agrith-Naar will do all this for us?
translation: Agrith-Naar'in tüm bunlari bizim icin yapacagini nereden biliyorsun?

english: My binding spells will make Agrith-Naar my slave! You would be wise not to question my powers again, lest I turn the same spells on you!
translation: Baglayici büyülerim Agrith-Naar'i kölem yapacak! Güclerimi bir daha sorgulamasan iyi olur, yoksa ayni büyüyü sana da yaparim!

english: Why did Josef run away?
Obviously he was a coward who did not have the strength to abandon his old-fashioned morality. I hope you will not be a similar disappointment.
translation: Belli ki eski moda ahlak anlayisini terk edecek gücü olmayan bir korkakti. Umarim sen de benzer bir hayal kirikligi yaratmazsin.

english: What do I have to do?
When I have finished preparing the magic circle, we will all recite the incantation that will summon Agrith-Naar.
translation: Büyü cemberini hazirladigimda, hepimiz Agrith-Naar'i cagiracak büyüyü okuyacagiz.

english: You must memorize the incantation carefully. It is Caldar Agrith-Naar Camerinthum Nahudu Tarren.
translation: Büyüyü dikkatlice ezberlemelisin. Caldar Agrith-Naar Camerinthum Nahudu Tarren.

english: You will also need to make yourself a demonic sigil to act as a focus of power. One of the group has the mould you need to make it.
translation: Ayrica, gücün odak noktasi olarak seytani bir mühür yapmalisin. Grubun bir üyesi, bunu yapmak icin ihtiyacin olan kaliba sahip.

english: Now let me continue with my preparations!
Leave me alone! I am preparing for the summoning ritual. You should make yourself a demonic sigil and practice the incantation with the other wizards.
translation: Beni rahat birak! Cagirma ritüeli icin hazirlik yapiyorum. Kendine seytani bir mühür yapmali ve diger büyücülerle birlikte büyüyü calismalisin.

english: I forgot the incantation.
Ignoramus! Are you incapable of even the simplest task? The incantation is Caldar Agrith-Naar Camerinthum Nahudu Tarren.
translation: Cahil! En basit görevi bile yapamiyor musun? Büyü Caldar Agrith-Naar Camerinthum Nahudu Tarren.

english: The player entered the stone circle south of Varrock with Silverlight
translation: Oyuncu, Silverlight ile Varrock'un güneyindeki tas cemberine girdi.

english: Arise, O mighty Delrith! Bring destruction to this soft, weak city!
translation: Kalk, ey güclü Delrith! Bu yumusak, zayif sehri yok et!

english: Arise, Delrith!
Ha ha ha! At last you are free, my demonic brother! Rest now, and then have your revenge on this pitiful city!
translation: Ha ha ha! Sonunda özgürsün, seytani kardesim! Simdi dinlen ve sonra bu acinasi sehirden intikamini al!

english: Who's that?
Noo! Not Silverlight! Delrith is not ready yet!
translation: Hayir! Silverlight olmasin! Delrith henüz hazir degil!

english: I've got to get out of here...
Isn't this, you know, wrong?
How do you know Agrith-Naar will do all this for us?
translation: Agrith-Naar'in bizim icin tüm bunlari yapacagini nereden biliyorsun?

english: Why did Josef run away?
What do I have to do?
I forgot the incantation.
Hello!
Hello citizen, how can I help?
Do you have any quests for me?
translation: Bana verebileceginiz bir görev var mi?

english: I don't know if you can help us!
The trolls have taken up camp on Death Plateau! They are using it to launch raids at night on the village. We have tried to attack the camp but the main path is heavily guarded!
translation: Troller Ölüm Platosu'nda kamp kurdular! Burayi kullanarak geceleri köye baskinlar düzenliyorlar. Kampa saldirmaya calistik ama ana yol cok iyi korunuyor!

english: Perhaps there is a way you can sneak up at night?
translation: Belki geceleri gizlice yaklasmanin bir yolu vardir?

english: If there is another way I do not know of it.
translation: Baska bir yol varsa ben bilmiyorum.

english: Do you know of such a path?
No but perhaps I could try and find one?
translation: Hayir ama belki bir tane bulmaya calisabilirim?

english: Citizen you would be well rewarded!
translation: Vatandas, bunun karsiliginda iyi bir ödül alacaksin!

english: If you go up to Death Plateau be very careful as the trolls will attack you on sight!
translation: Ölüm Platosu'na cikarsan cok dikkatli ol, cünkü troller seni görür görmez saldiracaklar!

english: I'll be careful.
One other thing.
What's that?
All of our equipment is kept in the castle on the hill.
The stupid guard that was on duty last night lost the combination to the lock! I told the Prince that the Imperial Guard should've been in charge of security!
translation: Dün gece nöbet tutan aptal muhafiz kilidin sifresini kaybetti! Prense, güvenligi Imparatorluk Muhafizlari'nin saglamasi gerektigini söyledim!

english: No problem, what does the combination look like?
The equipment room is unlocked when the stone balls are placed in the correct order on the stone mechanism outside it. The right order is written on a piece of paper the guard had.
translation: Disaridaki tas mekanizmaya tas toplari dogru sirayla yerlestirildiginde ekipman odasinin kilidi aciliyor. Dogru sira, muhafizin elindeki bir kagitta yaziyor.

english: A stone what...?!
Well citizen, the Prince is fond of puzzles. Why he couldn't just have a key is beyond me!
translation: Vatandasim, Prens bulmacalari sever. Neden sadece bir anahtar kullanmadi, anlamiyorum!

english: I'll get on it right away!
No, sorry.
Never mind citizen.
Can I assist you with anything else?
translation: Baska bir konuda yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: What is this place?
Welcome to Principality of Burthorpe!
We are the Imperial Guard for his Royal Highness Prince Anlaf of Burthorpe.
translation: Biz, Burthorpe Prensi Anlaf'in Imparatorluk Muhafizlariyiz.

english: You can't, thanks.
Hello citizen, is there anything you'd like to know?
translation: Merhaba vatandas, bilmek istedigin bir sey var mi?

english: Can you remind me of the quest I am on?
You offered to see if you could find another way up Death Plateau. We could then use it to sneak up and attack the trolls by night.
translation: Death Plateau'ya cikmanin baska bir yolunu bulmaya calistin. Böylece gece gizlice yaklasip troller saldiri yapabiliriz.

english: Ah yes, and the guard hast lost the combination to your equipment room in the castle on the hill?
translation: Ah evet, ve muhafizlar tepedeki kaledeki ekipman odasinin sifresini mi kaybetti?

english: That's right citizen, you offered to recover the combination and unlock the door.
translation: Dogru vatandas, sifreyi bulup kapiyi acmayi teklif ettin.

english: I've found a secret way up Death Plateau so I just need to find the combination and unlock the door.
translation: Death Plateau'ya cikan gizli bir yol buldum, simdi sadece sifreyi bulup kapiyi acmam gerekiyor.

english: Good work citizen!
Is there anything you'd like to know?
translation: Bilmek istediginiz bir sey var mi?

english: I thought the White Knights controlled Asgarnia?
translation: Beyaz Sövalyeler Asgarnia'yi kontrol ediyor saniyordum?

english: You are right citizen. The White Knights have taken advantage of the old and weak king, they control most of Asgarnia, including Falador. However they do not control Burthorpe!
translation: Haklisiniz vatandas. Beyaz Sövalyeler yasli ve zayif krali kullanarak Falador dahil Asgarnia'nin cogunu kontrol altina aldilar. Ancak Burthorpe'u kontrol etmiyorlar!

english: We are the prince's elite troops! We keep Burthorpe secure!
translation: Biz prensin seckin birlikleriyiz! Burthorpe'u güvende tutuyoruz!

english: The White Knights have overlooked us, until now! They are pouring money into their war against the Black Knights, they are looking for an excuse to stop our funding and I'm afraid they may have found it!
translation: Beyaz Sövalyeler simdiye kadar bizi göz ardi ettiler! Kara Sövalyelerle savasmak icin para harciyorlar, bizim fonumuzu kesmek icin bir bahane ariyorlar ve korkarim ki bulmus olabilirler!

english: If we can not destroy the troll camp on Death Plateau then the Imperial Guard will be disbanded and Burthorpe will come under control of the White Knights. We can not let this happen!
translation: Death Plateau'daki trol kampini yok edemezsek, Imparatorluk Muhafizlari dagitilacak ve Burthorpe Beyaz Sövalyelerin kontrolüne gececek. Bunun olmasina izin veremeyiz!

english: That's all, thanks.
God speed citizen.
Hello citizen, have you found another way up Death Plateau?
translation: Merhaba vatandas, Death Plateau'ya cikmanin baska bir yolunu buldun mu?

english: Yes, there is another way up Death Plateau!
translation: Evet, Death Plateau'ya cikmanin baska bir yolu var!

english: We are saved!
There's one thing...
And what is that citizen?
There is a Sherpa who will only show me the secret way if I first get some spikes for his climbing boots. The smith will only do this for me if you sign up his son for the Imperial Guard!
translation: Bir Sherpa var, tirmanma botlari icin civiler alirsam bana gizli yolu gösterecek. Demirci, oglunu Imparatorluk Muhafizlari'na kaydettirirsen bunu benim icin yapar!

english: Hmm...this is very irregular.
Will you not do this?
I have heard of Dunstan's son, he is a very promising young man. For the sake of your mission we can make an exception!
translation: Dunstan'in oglunu duydum, cok umut vaat eden bir genc. Görevin icin bir istisna yapabiliriz!

english: Denulth has given you a certificate.
This certificate proves that we have accepted Dunstan's son for training in the Imperial Guard!
translation: Bu sertifika, Dunstan'in oglunu Imparatorluk Muhafizlari'nda egitmek icin kabul ettigimizi kanitliyor!

english: Thank you Denulth, I shall be back shortly!
translation: Tesekkürler Denulth, kisa süre icinde dönecegim!

english: Hello citizen, have you found the secret way up Death Plateau?
translation: Merhaba vatandas, Ölüm Platosu'na cikan gizli yolu buldun mu?

english: I'm working on it, I just need to give the certificate to Dunstan.
translation: Üzerinde calisiyorum, sadece Dunstan'a sertifikayi vermem gerekiyor.

english: I'm working on it but I've lost the certificate!
No problem, I have a duplicate.
translation: Sorun degil, bende bir kopyasi var.

english: Yes! There is a path that runs from Sherpa's hut around the back of Death Plateau. The trolls haven't found it yet. The Sherpa made a map I can give you.
translation: Evet! Sherpa'nin kulübesinden Ölüm Platosu'nun arkasina uzanan bir yol var. Troller henüz onu bulamadi. Sherpa bir harita hazirladi, sana verebilirim.

english: I don't have the map on me.
You give Denulth the map of the secret way.
Excellent, this looks perfect. They will never see us coming.
translation: Mükemmel, bu harika görünüyor. Geldigimizi asla fark etmeyecekler.

english: Have you managed to open the equipment room?
I have opened the door but I don't have the combination on me.
translation: Kapiyi actim ama sifre yanimda degil.

english: Yes! The door is open and here is the combination.
translation: Evet! Kapi acik ve sifre de burada.

english: You give Denulth the combination to the equipment room.
Well done citizen! We will reward you by training you in attack!
translation: Aferin vatandas! Seni saldiri egitimi ile ödüllendirecegiz!

english: I shall present you with some steel fighting claws. In addition I shall show you the knowledge of creating the fighting claws for yourself.
translation: Sana celik savas penceleri hediye edecegim. Ayrica, savas pencelerini kendin yapabilmen icin gerekli bilgileri de gösterecegim.

english: You are now an honourary member of the Imperial Guard!
Quest complete!
Welcome back friend!
How goes your fight with the trolls?
I'm afraid I have bad news. We made our attack as planned, but we met unexpected resistance.
translation: Kötü haberlerim var. Planladigimiz gibi saldirdik ama beklenmedik bir direnisle karsilastik.

english: What happened?
We were ambushed by trolls coming from the north. They captured Dunstan's son, Godric, who we enlisted at your request, we tried to follow but we were repelled at the foot of their stronghold.
translation: Kuzeyden gelen troller bize pusu kurdu. Senin isteginle askere aldigimiz Dunstan'in oglu Godric'i esir aldilar. Onlari takip etmeye calistik ama kalelerinin eteklerinde geri püskürtüldük.

english: Is there anything I can do to help?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: The way tto the stronghold is treacherous, friend. Even if you manage to climb your way up, there will be many trolls defending the stronghold.
translation: Kaleye giden yol tehlikeli dostum. Tirmanmayi basarsan bile, kaleyi savunan bircok trol olacak.

english: I'll get Godric back!
God speed friend! I would send some of my me with you, but none of them are brave enough to follow.
translation: Tanri yardimcin olsun dostum! Yanina adamlarimi göndermek isterdim ama hicbiri takip edecek kadar cesur degil.

english: I'm sorry to hear that.
See you about Denulth!
God speed friend!
How are you getting on with rescuing Godric?
I haven't found a way to climb up yet.
Hurry, friend! Who knows what they'll do with Godric?
translation: Acele et dostum! Godric'e ne yapacaklarini kim bilir?

english: I've got some climbing boots.
Then hurry, friend! What are you still doing here?
translation: O zaman acele et dostum! Hala burada ne yapiyorsun?

english: I've found my way into the stronghold!
Hurry, friend! What are you still doing here?
translation: Acele et dostum! Hala burada ne yapiyorsun?

english: I've found my way into the prison.
...and?
That's all.
Hurry, friend! Find a way to free Godric!
translation: Acele et dostum! Godric'i kurtarmanin bir yolunu bul!

english: I have freed Godric!
Oh, what great news! You should hurry to tell Dunstan, he will be overjoyed!
translation: Oh, ne harika bir haber! Dunstan'a söylemek icin acele etmelisin, cok sevinecek!

english: We are busy preparing for an attack by night. Godric knows of a secret entrance to the stronghold. Once we destroy the stronghold Burthorpe will be safe! Friend, we are indebted to you!
translation: Gece saldirisi icin hazirliklarla mesgulüz. Godric, kalenin gizli girisini biliyor. Kaleyi yok ettigimizde Burthorpe güvende olacak! Dostum, sana borcluyuz!

english: Good luck!
Do you have any quests for me?
translation: Bana verecek bir görevin var mi?

english: Yes.
No.
What is this place?
You can't, thanks.
Can you remind me of the quest I am on?
I thought the White Knights controlled Asgarnia?
translation: Asgarnia'yi Beyaz Sövalyeler kontrol ediyor saniyordum?

english: That's all, thanks.
How goes your fight with the trolls?
See you about Denulth!
Learn to Read!
Oh!
The plants! They're alive!
The doors won't stay closed forever!
They came from the ground! They came from the ground!!!
Round and round and round and round!
Time is running out! She will rise again!!!
They're cheering! Why are they cheering?
Oh look, a human!
A human? Can we eat it?
translation: Bir insan mi? Onu yiyebilir miyiz?

english: No, you rock brain! Humans are our friends!
translation: Hayir, seni kaya beyinli! Insanlar bizim dostlarimizdir!

english: Hello, excuse me...
Not sure if I would call them our friends... Not enemies either, of course.
translation: Onlari dostlarimiz olarak adlandirabilir miyim emin degilim... Düsmanlarimiz da degiller tabii ki.

english: Not like the trolls. We hate trolls.
translation: Troller gibi degil. Trolleri nefret ederiz.

english: Excuse me, I just want to-
Nothing's worse than a troll.
Except discovering that your pickaxe's gone blunt just as you-
translation: Tabii ki, tam da kazmanizi kullanmak üzereyken onun körelmis oldugunu fark etmek disinda...

english: Excuse me!!!
Why, hello, yes, what is it?
I er... well, who are you?
I'm Derni.
I'm Dernu.
And I'm Miodvetnir. These are my brothers. And who might you be?
translation: Ve ben Miodvetnir. Bunlar kardeslerim. Siz kimsiniz?

english: My name is Player.
Pleased to meet you, Player!
I say, we don't get to see a hummon down here very often!
It's a human, you metal head! You should pay more attention!
translation: O bir insan, seni metal kafali! Daha dikkatli olmalisin!

english: So, can I ask you dwarves a few questions?
translation: Peki, siz cücelere birkac soru sorabilir miyim?

english: Of course, we love answering questions!
translation: Tabii ki, sorulari cevaplamayi cok seviyoruz!

english: We're very good at answering questions!
Fire away!
Hello again, Player!
Are you lost down here?
Or were you just stopping by for a chat?
translation: Yoksa sadece sohbet etmek icin mi ugradin?

english: Just stopping by for a chat.
What's down this river?
Oh, you don't know?
[He/she] doesn't know?
[He/she] doesn't know!
Can't you just tell me?
It is our glorious city!
The grand city of the dwarves!
Sparkling jewel of the mountain!
Keldagrim, our home!
Can you take me there?
Oh no, we can't do that.
We're far too busy.
You have to keep busy, you see.
Always keep busy, is what our good father used to say.
translation: Her zaman mesgul ol, derdi bizim iyi babamiz.

english: Besides, there's been some weird going ons in the city.
translation: Ayrica, sehirde bazi garip olaylar oluyor.

english: Don't tell [him/her] that! None of [his/her] business!
Only fair if [he/she] wants to go into the city.
translation: Sehre gitmek istiyorsa, bu adil olur.

english: Oh yes, they only just cleaned up the mess from the last little incident.
translation: Evet, son olaydan kalan pisligi daha yeni temizlediler.

english: So watch out if you ever do manage to travel to the city! Weird things could happen!
translation: Bu yüzden sehre gitmeyi basarirsan dikkatli ol! Garip seyler olabilir!

english: Any good spots to fish around here?
translation: Buralarda balik tutmak icin iyi yerler var mi?

english: Fish?
Fish?
What are fish?
No fish around here.
Say, you're the Fishing Champion, aren't you?
That must be why you were talking about fish then...
translation: O zaman balik hakkinda konusmanin sebebi bu olmali...

english: But this water here, you see, it comes dripping down from above.
Molten snow, you see.
Oh, they're these small wriggly things that live in the water.
translation: Oh, bunlar suda yasayan kücük, kivrimli seyler.

english: But they're not all small! Some can be large!
translation: Ama hepsi kücük degil! Bazilari büyük olabilir!

english: And they don't breathe air.
But [player name] could tell you all about it! After all, [he's/she's] the Fishing Champion!
translation: Ama Maceraci sana her seyi anlatabilir! Sonucta, o Balikcilik Sampiyonu!

english: Maybe later...
What are these mines used for?
What does it look like they're used for?
Isn't it obvious?
For mining of course!
These mines are actually the territory of one of the eight major companies of the mining Consortium.
translation: Bu madenler aslinda madencilik konsorsiyumunun sekiz büyük sirketinden birinin arazisi.

english: Mining companies? Where are they at then?
Oh, they all have their headquarters in the city.
First floor of the palace.
No need to give [him/her] directions.
We haul all our goods to the city by ship, you see.
Since the mine carts don't come here.
But because the river goes right to the city, this is just as easy.
translation: Ama nehir dogrudan sehre gidiyor, bu da ayni derecede kolay.

english: Can you help me with this rock down in the mines?
translation: Madenlerdeki bu kayayi kaldirmama yardim eder misin?

english: It seems to be unbreakable. I need to know why.
translation: Kirilmaz gibi görünüyor. Nedenini bilmem gerekiyor.

english: Say, is that Dondakan's rock?
That big unbreakable rock?
That's what [he/she] said, isn't? Pay more attention!
translation: Öyle demisti, degil mi? Daha dikkatli dinle!

english: Yes, yes, that's the one.
Oh, you're not going to get through there I'm afraid.
It's unbreakable, you see.
Dondakan's been there for...
How long would you say he's been there, Miotvednir?
Eighteen years, Derni, and not a year shorter!
translation: On sekiz yil, Derni, bir yil bile eksik degil!

english: That's some dedication!
But look at what it got him.
Nothing, that's what.
Never mind.
What material would break that rock? You know, the impenetrable one?
translation: O kayayi hangi malzeme kirabilir? Bilirsin, gecilmez olani?

english: Well... have you tried a rune pickaxe?
An adamantite tool?
What about a bronze pickaxe?
A bronze pickaxe??
What good would that do?
Well, you never know...
Don't you think that's the first thing they tried?
translation: Sence ilk denedikleri sey bu degil miydi?

english: Hey, it was just a suggestion!
Do you know anyone named Rolad? Some kind of a dwarven scholar?
translation: Rolad adinda birini taniyor musun? Bir tür cüce bilgin?

english: Sorry, doesn't ring a bell.
Oh yes, I know Rolad!
Oh, stop winding up the human, Dernu!
Do you know where he is right now?
translation: Su anda nerede oldugunu biliyor musun?

english: No idea, why?
Dondakan wants to shoot me out of a cannon!
translation: Dondakan beni top mermisinden firlatmak istiyor!

english: Oh dear!
How awful!
That's terrible!
He thinks I'm actually going to fly through it and land on the other side.
translation: O benim gercekten ucup diger tarafa inecegimi düsünüyor.

english: That sounds a bit daft.
How would that work?
I think you're going to hurt your head.
Old Dondakan might have finally lost it.
translation: Yasli Dondakan sonunda aklini kacirmis olabilir.

english: He was always obsessed with that rock.
And gold.
Right, and gold.
Any tips on how to defeat an evil demon?
translation: Kötü bir iblisi yenmek icin herhangi bir ipucun var mi?

english: An evil demon, you say?
I'd run away if I ever ran into an evil demon.
Don't be such a coward, Dernu!
Well, what would you do then?
I don't know, I've never encountered an evil demon.
translation: Bilmiyorum, hic kötü bir iblisle karsilasmadim.

english: I once met a good demon though.
translation: Ama bir keresinde iyi bir iblisle karsilasmistim.

english: Oh yes, what did he say?
He gave me a puzzle box and then went off again.
translation: Bana bir bulmaca kutusu verdi ve sonra tekrar gitti.

english: I think you must have had too much dwarven stout in you.
translation: Sanirim cok fazla cüce birasi icmis olmalisin.

english: Could be, could be, but there's no telling, is there?
translation: Olabilir, olabilir, ama kim bilir, degil mi?

english: I defeated the spirit of the rock!
That's amazing!
That's fantastic!
What rock was that again?
Pay attention for once, Dernu! It's Dondakan's rock!
translation: Bir kez olsun dikkatini ver, Dernu! Dondakan'in kayasi!

english: That's quite impressive, Player. How did you manage to do that?
translation: Bu cok etkileyici, Oyuncu. Bunu nasil basardin?

english: Well, you see, I just-
What kind of question is that to ask? With [his/her/their] great might of course!
translation: Bu ne bicim bir soru? Tabii ki Onlarin büyük gücüyle!

english: Or vast magical skills!
No, you're more a ranger, aren't you Player?
translation: Hayir, sen daha cok bir okcu gibisin, degil mi Oyuncu?

english: Actually, I-
Anyway, this calls for a celebration.
Oh yes, we should go down into Keldagrim to celebrate.
translation: Evet, kutlama icin Keldagrim'e inmemiz gerek.

english: Tonight, of course, not now. We're on duty now.
translation: Tabii ki bu gece, simdi degil. Su anda görev basindayiz.

english: Right... and I'm sure traffic here will pick up soon with that rock broken.
translation: Dogru... ve o kaya kirildigina göre buradaki trafik yakinda yogunlasacaktir.

english: I heard there's vast amount of gold inside!
translation: Icinde cok miktarda altin oldugunu duydum!

english: The company is going to be rich!
Now don't you go and discuss company business in front of this human, Dernu.
translation: Su insanin önünde sirket islerini tartisma, Dernu.

english: Right. Let's get back to work.
Anything else you wanted, Player?
translation: Baska bir sey ister misin, Oyuncu?

english: I need some help with this statue... King Alvis' statue, to be precise.
translation: Bu heykel icin yardima ihtiyacim var... Kral Alvis'in heykeli, daha dogrusu.

english: Oh yes, what's the problem then?
It was knocked down, remember? Parts of it nearly landed on our heads?
translation: Yikilmisti, hatirladin mi? Parcalari neredeyse kafalarimizin üzerine düsecekti.

english: A terrible noise it made too!
This sculptor has got me looking for a lot of items, you see.
translation: Bu heykeltiras bana bir sürü esya bulmami istedi.

english: Items eh?
We love items.
Can't get enough of them.
Well, can you he-
I got this puzzle box once, you know.
translation: Bir keresinde bir bulmaca kutusu almistim.

english: Oh, not that story again.
You have told that story before, Dernu.
translation: Bu hikayeyi daha önce anlatmistin, Dernu.

english: Well forget about it then. I'll shut up if you don't want to hear about it.
translation: O zaman unut gitsin. Duymak istemiyorsan susarim.

english: Well, the sculptor only needs to build the head now. But I need to get the Consortium to help me with that.
translation: Heykeltirasin artik sadece kafayi yapmasi gerekiyor. Ama bunun icin Konsorsiyum'un yardimina ihtiyacim var.

english: The Consortium, you say?
You're going to talk to the Consortium?
My, you're certainly moving up in the dwarven world, aren't you?
translation: Vay canina, cüce dünyasinda gercekten yükseliyorsun, degil mi?

english: What do you need us for then?
translation: O zaman bize neden ihtiyacin var?

english: We are but simple dwarves.
Especially you, Dernu.
Now now, Derni, there was no need for that.
translation: Haydi ama Derni, buna gerek yoktu.

english: I have rebuilt the statue for the [company name]!
What, really?
Of course, really! Player wouldn't have said it otherwise, would [he/she/they]?
translation: Tabii ki, gercekten! Oyuncu öyle olmasaydi söylemezdi, degil mi?

english: And didn't you see Blasidar working on the statue?
translation: Blasidar'in heykel üzerinde calistigini görmedin mi?

english: Oh yes, he was out there for quite a while.
That must have been a huge task.
Nothing's too difficult for old Blasidar.
translation: Yasli Blasidar icin hicbir sey zor degildir.

english: He truly is a master builder.
We can all take an example to his hard work and dedication.
translation: Hepimiz onun caliskanligi ve adanmisligindan örnek alabiliriz.

english: Speaking of, shouldn't we get back to work ourselves?
translation: Bu arada, biz de isimize dönsek iyi olmaz mi?

english: Quite right. Anything else you wanted, Player?
translation: Haklisin. Baska bir sey var mi, Oyuncu?

english: Do you know about this drunken dwarf...?
Drunken dwarf?
Yeah, we know a drunken dwarf!
In fact we know plenty!
There's this one really annoying dwarf though, he sometimes throws rocks at me for no reason.
translation: Ama cok sinir bozucu bir cüce var, bazen sebepsiz yere bana tas atiyor.

english: Yeah, tell me about it.
The one I mean is his relative, living in the northeast of Keldagrim. I wonder if you could help me with him.
translation: Bahsettigim cüce, Keldagrim'in kuzeydogusunda yasayan akrabasi. Onunla ilgili bana yardim edebilir misin acaba?

english: Ah yes, him.
Such a sad case, poor fellow.
Who is he?
Don't you know anything?
Now now, there's no reason to get angry.
I suppose you're right. Well, he's a drunk dwarf that talks about kebabs a lot.
translation: Sanirim haklisin. Kebaplardan cok bahseden sarhos bir cüce.

english: Has some pretty odd tales to tell too.
And I understand he's the relative of that dwarf I mentioned earlier.
translation: Anladigim kadariyla, daha önce bahsettigim cücenin akrabasi.

english: I hope that helped, Player?
I have this unforgettable tale to tell you!
A tale!
We love tales!
We live for tales!
Like, there was this one time when I lost my spanner in the mines...
translation: Mesela, bir keresinde madenlerde Ingiliz anahtarimi kaybetmistim...

english: Player wants to tell a tale!
But my spanner... it's a very interesting tale you know.
translation: Ama Ingiliz anahtarim... Cok ilginc bir hikaye, biliyor musun?

english: I think we've heard it before.
It was pretty forgettable.
Excuse me, do you want to hear my tale or not?
translation: Affedersiniz, hikayemi dinlemek istiyor musunuz, istemiyor musunuz?

english: Happy to.
Would love to hear it.
As long as it's better than my spanner story.
translation: Anahtar hikayemden daha iyi oldugu sürece.

english: So, what's your tale like?
Ah, I errrr...
I seem to have forgotten.
Must have been pretty forgettable as well then.
translation: O zaman da unutulabilir bir hikaye olmali.

english: I must be off now, thanks for the chat.
No problem!
Glad to be of service!
Come back any time!
What's down this river?
Any good spots to fish around here?
translation: Buralarda balik tutmak icin iyi yerler var mi?

english: What are these mines used for?
Can you help me with this rock?
translation: Bu kayayi kaldirmama yardim eder misin?

english: What material would break that rock?
Do you know anyone named Rolad?
Dondakan wants to shoot me out of a cannon!
Any tips on how to defeat an evil demon?
translation: Kötü bir iblisi yenmek icin bir ipucu var mi?

english: I defeated the spirit of the rock!
I need some help with this statue...
translation: Bu heykel icin yardima ihtiyacim var...

english: I have rebuilt the statue for the [company name]!
Do you know about this drunken dwarf...?
I have this unforgettable tale to tell you!
I must be off now, thanks for the chat.
Oh look, a human!
A human? Can we eat it?
No, you rock brain! Humans are our friends!
translation: Hayir, seni kaya beyinli! Insanlar bizim dostlarimizdir!

english: Hello, excuse me...
Not sure if I would call them our friends... Not enemies either, of course.
translation: Onlari dostlarimiz olarak adlandirabilir miyim bilmiyorum... Düsmanlarimiz da degil tabii ki.

english: Not like the trolls. We hate trolls.
translation: Troller gibi degil. Trolleri nefret ederiz.

english: Excuse me, I just want to-
Nothing's worse than a troll.
Except discovering that your pickaxe's gone blunt just as you-
translation: Tabii ki, tam da kazma körelmisken fark etmek disinda...

english: Excuse me!!!
Why, hello, yes, what is it?
I er... well, who are you?
I'm Derni.
I'm Dernu.
And I'm Miodvetnir. These are my brothers. And who might you be?
translation: Ben Miodvetnir. Bunlar da kardeslerim. Sen kimsin?

english: My name is Player.
Pleased to meet you, Player!
I say, we don't get to see a hummon down here very often!
It's a human, you metal head! You should pay more attention!
translation: O bir insan, seni metal kafali! Daha dikkatli olmalisin!

english: So, can I ask you dwarves a few questions?
Of course, we love answering questions!
translation: Tabii ki, sorulari cevaplamayi cok seviyoruz!

english: We're very good at answering questions!
Fire away!
Hello again, Player!
Are you lost down here?
Or were you just stopping by for a chat?
translation: Yoksa sadece sohbet etmek icin mi ugradin?

english: Just stopping by for a chat.
What's down this river?
Oh, you don't know?
[He/She] doesn't know?
[He/She] doesn't know!
Can't you just tell me?
It is our glorious city!
The grand city of the dwarves!
Sparkling jewel of the mountain!
Keldagrim, our home!
Can you take me there?
Oh no, we can't do that.
We're far too busy.
You have to keep busy, you see.
Always keep busy, is what our good father used to say.
translation: Her zaman mesgul ol, bizim iyi babamiz böyle derdi.

english: Besides, there's been some weird going ons in the city.
translation: Ayrica, sehirde bazi garip olaylar oluyor.

english: Don't tell [him/her] that! None of [his/her] business!
Only fair if [he/she] wants to go into the city.
translation: Sehre gitmek istiyorsa, bu adil olur.

english: Oh yes, they only just cleaned up the mess from the last little incident.
translation: Evet, son olayin ardindan ortaligi yeni temizlediler.

english: So watch out if you ever do manage to travel to the city! Weird things could happen!
translation: Sehre gitmeyi basarirsan, dikkatli ol! Garip seyler olabilir!

english: Any good spots to fish around here?
translation: Buralarda balik tutmak icin iyi yerler var mi?

english: Fish?
Fish?
What are fish?
No fish around here.
Say, you're the Fishing Champion, aren't you?
That must be why you were talking about fish then...
translation: O yüzden baliklar hakkinda konusuyordun herhalde...

english: But this water here, you see, it comes dripping down from above.
Molten snow, you see.
Oh, they're these small wriggly things that live in the water.
translation: Oh, bunlar suda yasayan kücük, kivrimli seyler.

english: But they're not all small! Some can be large!
translation: Ama hepsi kücük degil! Bazilari büyük olabilir!

english: And they don't breathe air.
But [player name] could tell you all about it! After all, [he's/she's] the Fishing Champion!
translation: Ama Maceraci sana her seyi anlatabilir! Sonucta, o Balikcilik Sampiyonu!

english: Maybe later...
What are these mines used for?
What does it look like they're used for?
Isn't it obvious?
For mining of course!
These mines are actually the territory of one of the eight major companies of the mining Consortium.
translation: Bu madenler aslinda madencilik konsorsiyumunun sekiz büyük sirketinden birinin arazisi.

english: Mining companies? Where are they at then?
Oh, they all have their headquarters in the city.
First floor of the palace.
No need to give [him/her] directions.
translation: Ona yol tarifi vermenize gerek yok.

english: We haul all our goods to the city by ship, you see.
translation: Tüm mallarimizi gemi ile sehre tasiyoruz.

english: Since the mine carts don't come here.
But because the river goes right to the city, this is just as easy.
translation: Ama nehir dogrudan sehre gittigi icin bu da ayni derecede kolay.

english: Can you help me with this rock down in the mines?
translation: Madenlerdeki bu kayayi kaldirmama yardim eder misiniz?

english: It seems to be unbreakable. I need to know why.
translation: Kirilmaz gibi görünüyor. Nedenini bilmem gerekiyor.

english: Say, is that Dondakan's rock?
That big unbreakable rock?
That's what [he/she] said, isn't? Pay more attention!
translation: Öyle demisti, degil mi? Daha dikkatli dinle!

english: Yes, yes, that's the one.
Oh, you're not going to get through there I'm afraid.
It's unbreakable, you see.
Dondakan's been there for...
How long would you say he's been there, Miotvednir?
translation: Sence ne kadar zamandir orada, Miotvednir?

english: Eighteen years, Derni, and not a year shorter!
translation: On sekiz yildir, Derni, bir yil bile eksik degil!

english: That's some dedication!
But look at what it got him.
Nothing, that's what.
Never mind.
What material would break that rock? You know, the impenetrable one?
translation: O kayayi hangi malzeme kirabilir? Bilirsin, gecilmez olani?

english: Well... have you tried a rune pickaxe?
An adamantite tool?
What about a bronze pickaxe?
A bronze pickaxe??
What good would that do?
Well, you never know...
Don't you think that's the first thing they tried?
translation: Sence ilk denedikleri sey bu degil miydi?

english: Hey, it was just a suggestion!
Do you know anyone named Rolad? Some kind of a dwarven scholar?
translation: Rolad adinda birini taniyor musun? Bir tür cüce bilgin?

english: Sorry, doesn't ring a bell.
Oh yes, I know Rolad!
Oh, stop winding up the human, Dernu!
Do you know where he is right now?
translation: Su anda nerede oldugunu biliyor musun?

english: No idea, why?
Dondakan wants to shoot me out of a cannon!
translation: Dondakan beni bir topun icinden firlatmak istiyor!

english: Oh dear!
How awful!
That's terrible!
He thinks I'm actually going to fly through it and land on the other side.
translation: Benim gercekten ucup diger tarafa inecegimi düsünüyor.

english: That sounds a bit daft.
How would that work?
I think you're going to hurt your head.
Old Dondakan might have finally lost it.
translation: Yasli Dondakan sonunda aklini kacirmis olabilir.

english: He was always obsessed with that rock.
And gold.
Right, and gold.
Any tips on how to defeat an evil demon?
translation: Kötü bir iblisi yenmek icin herhangi bir ipucun var mi?

english: An evil demon, you say?
I'd run away if I ever ran into an evil demon.
Don't be such a coward, Dernu!
Well, what would you do then?
I don't know, I've never encountered an evil demon.
translation: Bilmiyorum, hic kötü bir iblisle karsilasmadim.

english: I once met a good demon though.
translation: Ama bir keresinde iyi bir iblisle karsilasmistim.

english: Oh yes, what did he say?
He gave me a puzzle box and then went off again.
translation: Bana bir bulmaca kutusu verip tekrar gitmisti.

english: I think you must have had too much dwarven stout in you.
translation: Sanirim cok fazla cüce birasi icmis olmalisin.

english: Could be, could be, but there's no telling, is there?
translation: Olabilir, olabilir, ama kim bilir, degil mi?

english: I defeated the spirit of the rock!
That's amazing!
That's fantastic!
What rock was that again?
Pay attention for once, Dernu! It's Dondakan's rock!
translation: Bir kez olsun dikkatini ver, Dernu! Dondakan'in kayasi!

english: That's quite impressive, Player. How did you manage to do that?
translation: Bu oldukca etkileyici, Oyuncu. Bunu nasil basardin?

english: Well, you see, I just-
What kind of question is that to ask? With [his/her/their] great might of course!
translation: Bu ne bicim bir soru? Tabii ki Onlarin büyük gücüyle!

english: Or vast magical skills!
No, you're more a ranger, aren't you Player?
translation: Hayir, sen daha cok bir korucu gibisin, degil mi Oyuncu?

english: Actually, I-
Anyway, this calls for a celebration.
Oh yes, we should go down into Keldagrim to celebrate.
translation: Evet, kutlamak icin Keldagrim'e inmemiz gerekir.

english: Tonight, of course, not now. We're on duty now.
translation: Tabii ki bu gece, simdi degil. Su anda görev basindayiz.

english: Right... and I'm sure traffic here will pick up soon with that rock broken.
translation: Dogru... ve eminim o kaya kirildigi icin buradaki trafik yakinda yogunlasacaktir.

english: I heard there's vast amount of gold inside!
translation: Icinde cok miktarda altin oldugunu duydum!

english: The company is going to be rich!
Now don't you go and discuss company business in front of this human, Dernu.
translation: Simdi bu insanin önünde sirket islerini tartisma, Dernu.

english: Right. Let's get back to work.
Anything else you wanted, Player?
translation: Baska bir sey ister misin, Oyuncu?

english: I need some help with this statue... King Alvis' statue, to be precise.
translation: Bu heykel icin yardima ihtiyacim var... Kral Alvis'in heykeli, daha dogrusu.

english: Oh yes, what's the problem then?
It was knocked down, remember? Parts of it nearly landed on our heads?
translation: Yikilmisti, hatirladin mi? Parcalari neredeyse kafalarimizin üzerine düsecekti?

english: A terrible noise it made too!
This sculptor has got me looking for a lot of items, you see.
translation: Bu heykeltiras bana bir sürü esya bulmami istedi.

english: Items eh?
We love items.
Can't get enough of them.
Well, can you he-
I got this puzzle box once, you know.
translation: Bir keresinde bir bulmaca kutusu almistim.

english: Oh, not that story again.
You have told that story before, Dernu.
translation: Bu hikayeyi daha önce anlatmistin, Dernu.

english: Well forget about it then. I'll shut up if you don't want to hear about it.
translation: O zaman unut gitsin. Duymak istemiyorsan susarim.

english: Well, the sculptor only needs to build the head now. But I need to get the Consortium to help me with that.
translation: Heykeltirasin artik sadece kafayi yapmasi gerekiyor. Ama bunun icin Konsorsiyum'un yardimina ihtiyacim var.

english: The Consortium, you say?
You're going to talk to the Consortium?
My, you're certainly moving up in the dwarven world, aren't you?
translation: Vay canina, cüce dünyasinda kesinlikle yükseliyorsun, degil mi?

english: What do you need us for then?
translation: O zaman bize neden ihtiyacin var?

english: We are but simple dwarves.
Especially you, Dernu.
Now now, Derni, there was no need for that.
translation: Haydi ama Derni, buna gerek yoktu.

english: I have rebuilt the statue for the [company name]!
What, really?
Of course, really! Player wouldn't have said it otherwise, would [he/she/they]?
translation: Tabii ki, gercekten! Oyuncu öyle olmasaydi söylemezdi, degil mi?

english: And didn't you see Blasidar working on the statue?
translation: Blasidar'in heykel üzerinde calistigini görmedin mi?

english: Oh yes, he was out there for quite a while.
That must have been a huge task.
Nothing's too difficult for old Blasidar.
translation: Yasli Blasidar icin hicbir sey zor degildir.

english: He truly is a master builder.
We can all take an example to his hard work and dedication.
translation: Hepimiz onun caliskanligi ve adanmisligindan örnek alabiliriz.

english: Speaking of, shouldn't we get back to work ourselves?
translation: Bu arada, biz de isimize dönsek iyi olmaz mi?

english: Quite right. Anything else you wanted, Player?
translation: Haklisin. Baska bir sey var mi, Oyuncu?

english: Do you know about this drunken dwarf...?
Drunken dwarf?
Yeah, we know a drunken dwarf!
In fact we know plenty!
There's this one really annoying dwarf though, he sometimes throws rocks at me for no reason.
