translation: Ama cok sinir bozucu bir cüce var, bazen sebepsiz yere bana tas atiyor.

english: Yeah, tell me about it.
The one I mean is his relative, living in the northeast of Keldagrim. I wonder if you could help me with him.
translation: Benim bahsettigim, Keldagrim'in kuzeydogusunda yasayan akrabasi. Onunla ilgili bana yardim edebilir misin acaba?

english: Ah yes, him.
Such a sad case, poor fellow.
Who is he?
Don't you know anything?
Now now, there's no reason to get angry.
I suppose you're right. Well, he's a drunk dwarf that talks about kebabs a lot.
translation: Sanirim haklisin. Kebaplardan cok bahseden sarhos bir cüce.

english: Has some pretty odd tales to tell too.
And I understand he's the relative of that dwarf I mentioned earlier.
translation: Anladigim kadariyla, daha önce bahsettigim cücenin akrabasi.

english: I hope that helped, Player?
I have this unforgettable tale to tell you!
A tale!
We love tales!
We live for tales!
Like, there was this one time when I lost my spanner in the mines...
translation: Mesela, bir keresinde madenlerde Ingiliz anahtarimi kaybetmistim...

english: Player wants to tell a tale!
But my spanner... it's a very interesting tale you know.
translation: Ama Ingiliz anahtarim... Cok ilginc bir hikaye, biliyor musun?

english: I think we've heard it before.
It was pretty forgettable.
Excuse me, do you want to hear my tale or not?
translation: Affedersiniz, hikayemi dinlemek istiyor musunuz, istemiyor musunuz?

english: Happy to.
Would love to hear it.
As long as it's better than my spanner story.
translation: Tabii benim Ingiliz anahtari hikayemden daha iyiyse.

english: So, what's your tale like?
Ah, I errrr...
I seem to have forgotten.
Must have been pretty forgettable as well then.
translation: O zaman o da unutulabilir bir hikaye olmali.

english: I must be off now, thanks for the chat.
No problem!
Glad to be of service!
Come back any time!
What's down this river?
Any good spots to fish around here?
translation: Buralarda balik tutmak icin iyi yerler var mi?

english: What are these mines used for?
Can you help me with this rock?
translation: Bu kayayi kirmama yardim eder misin?

english: What material would break that rock?
Do you know anyone named Rolad?
Dondakan wants to shoot me out of a cannon!
Any tips on how to defeat an evil demon?
translation: Kötü bir iblisi yenmek icin herhangi bir ipucu var mi?

english: I defeated the spirit of the rock!
I need some help with this statue...
translation: Bu heykel icin yardima ihtiyacim var...

english: I have rebuilt the statue for the [company name]!
Do you know about this drunken dwarf...?
I have this unforgettable tale to tell you!
I must be off now, thanks for the chat.
Good day, Your Highness. Can I help you with anything?
translation: Iyi günler, Majesteleri. Yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: Can I use your anvil?
Of course, Your Royal Highness.
Nothing, thanks.
Can I use your anvil?
Nothing, thanks.
You look ready for combat.
Aye, indeed I am.
What brings you to this place? I can't imagine anyone coming here by choice.
translation: Seni buraya ne getirdi? Kimsenin kendi istegiyle buraya geldigini sanmiyorum.

english: You're right, I did not come here by choice. I came here for vengeance.
translation: Haklisin, buraya kendi istegimle gelmedim. Intikam icin geldim.

english: Vengeance? Against whom? Did someone take your gardening equipment?
translation: Intikam mi? Kimden? Biri bahce aletlerini mi caldi?

english: My mission is not against another man and I will not have it mocked.
translation: Benim görevim baska birine karsi degil ve bununla alay edilmesini istemem.

english: Okay, sorry, I was just trying to lighten the mood. Care to tell me what it is against then?
translation: Tamam, özür dilerim, sadece ortami yumusatmaya calisiyordum. O zaman kime karsi oldugunu söylemek ister misin?

english: Callisto, the great bear of the wilderness.
Can't say I've come across it before.
I'm not surprised, you'd do well to avoid him. Callisto is a great bear, his strength and size enhanced by the corruption of the Wilderness.
translation: Sasirmadim, ondan uzak durman iyi olur. Callisto büyük bir ayidir, gücü ve boyutu Wilderness'nin yozlasmasiyla daha da artmistir.

english: Ah, I've had a few run ins with him myself.
translation: Ah, ben de onunla birkac kez karsilastim.

english: Then you'll know he's not something to mock. I'm surprised you survived your encounter with such a great and corrupted beast.
translation: O zaman onun alay edilecek biri olmadigini bilirsin. Böylesine büyük ve yozlasmis bir canavarla karsilastigin halde hayatta kalmana sasirdim.

english: I'm stronger than I look, I've seen my fair share of monsters.
translation: Göründügümden daha güclüyüm, pek cok canavar gördüm.

english: Why are you so intent on taking him down?
translation: Neden onu öldürmeye bu kadar kararlisin?

english: Callisto killed my father. After hearing of a great beast in the heart of the Wilderness, he took it upon himself to bring him down.
translation: Callisto babami öldürdü. Wilderness'nin kalbinde büyük bir canavar oldugunu duyduktan sonra, onu öldürmeyi kendine görev edindi.

english: He left our family home in Hosidius to hunt it down and...
translation: Hosidius'taki evimizi terk edip onu avlamaya gitti ve......

english: ... I haven't seen my father since. I swore I would avenge him and have dedicated my whole life to training for that moment.
translation: o günden beri babami görmedim. Onun intikamini alacagima yemin ettim ve tüm hayatimi o an icin antrenman yapmaya adadim.

english: What happens after? When you do take Callisto down that is.
translation: Sonra ne olacak? Callisto'yu öldürdügünde yani.

english: Oh... uh... I never thought about that...
My whole life has been spent preparing to avenge my father, I never thought about anything else...
translation: Tüm hayatimi babamin intikamini almak icin hazirlandim, baska hicbir sey düsünmedim...

english: You seem like you've got a lot to think about then. I'll leave you to it.
translation: O zaman düsünmen gereken cok sey var gibi görünüyor. Seni yalniz birakayim.

english: Hey. Do you know anything about this?
translation: Hey. Bunun hakkinda bir sey biliyor musun?

english: Ah, a fellow marksman. That's a unique bow you have there.
translation: Ah, bir nisanci arkadas. Elindeki yay cok özelmis.

english: Do you know anything about it?
translation: Bunun hakkinda bir sey biliyor musun?

english: I've done my fair bit of fletching in my day. I'd say this bow can be improved upon.
translation: Eskiden ok yapiminda epey tecrübeliyim. Bence bu yay daha da gelistirilebilir.

english: See those etches on it? You could put something sharp in there to improve the bow's strength.
translation: Üzerindeki oyuklari görüyor musun? Oraya keskin bir sey koyarak yayin gücünü artirabilirsin.

english: Interesting! I'll be on the lookout for a powerful enhancement like that.
translation: Ilginc! Böyle güclü bir gelistirme icin gözümü dört acacagim.

english: Those look like strong fangs. You could probably attach them to a bow to make it stronger.
translation: Bunlar güclü dislere benziyor. Muhtemelen bunlari yaya takarak onu daha güclü hale getirebilirsin.

english: Interesting! I'll be on the lookout for a suitable bow.
Perhaps I could use this?
Yes. Those look like they could be attached to the weapon.
translation: Evet. Bunlar silaha takilabilir gibi görünüyor.

english: Could you combine them?
Sure I can. For the right price.
Sigh. How much?
500,000 coins would do nicely.
I don't have the money for that.
Feel free to come back when you do.
There we go! All done.
No thanks.
Are those... Bear claws?
Yeah. I got them from a really big bear.
translation: Evet. Onlari cok büyük bir ayidan aldim.

english: By the gods... This bear must be even bigger than I imagined.
translation: Tanrilar adina... Bu ayi hayal ettigimden daha da büyük olmali.

english: So do you know if the claws would be useful at all?
translation: Peki, pencelerin bir ise yarayip yaramayacagini biliyor musun?

english: I... have a lot to think about. Perhaps Andros Mai over there can help you while I think.
translation: Düsünmem gereken cok sey var. Ben düsünürken, suradaki Andros Mai sana yardimci olabilir.

english: Thanks!
That looks like any skull to me. Who's is it?
translation: Bana siradan bir kafatasi gibi görünüyor. Kimin kafatasi bu?

english: It's mine. I picked it up.
I meant... Sigh. Never mind. What do you want with the skull?
translation: Demek istedigim... Neyse, bos ver. Kafatasiyla ne yapacaksin?

english: I'm trying to find out if it's useful.
Don't know much about skulls, myself. That mage over there might know.
translation: Kafataslari hakkinda pek bilgim yok. Suradaki büyücü bilebilir.

english: She's into some weird stuff, that one. Think she said her name was Phabelle Bile.
translation: O kadin tuhaf seylerle ilgileniyor. Sanirim adi Phabelle Bile'di.

english: No, I'm afraid not.
Oh. Do you know someone who might know more?
translation: Oh. Daha fazla bilgi sahibi olabilecek birini taniyor musun?

english: Just earlier I saw this lady run down into the basement of this pub.
translation: Az önce bu hanimefendinin bu pub'in bodrumuna kostugunu gördüm.

english: I don't know who she is, but she looks like a strange one.
translation: Kim oldugunu bilmiyorum, ama tuhaf birine benziyor.

english: Strange attracts strange, so I reckon she might know about your strange weapon piece.
translation: Tuhaf olan tuhaf olani ceker, bu yüzden senin tuhaf silah parcan hakkinda bilgi sahibi olabilir.

english: You look ready for combat.
Ask about rare item.
Yes
No
You're a long way from home, traveller! How about some food to keep you going?
translation: Evinden cok uzaktasin, gezgin! Yoluna devam etmek icin biraz yemek ister misin?

english: Yes, please.
No thanks.
I'll be here if you find yourself hungry!
Yes, please.
No thanks.
Can I go in the Arboretum?
Yes. Now leave me alone.
Yes?
What are you serving?
Blood.
Is that it?
Yes, by the pint. Now, do you want one or not?
translation: Evet, pint olarak. Simdi, istiyor musun istemiyor musun?

english: Sure.
Two coins.
Oh dear, I don't seem to have enough money.
translation: Oh hayir, yeterince param yok galiba.

english: Clear off then.
I'll pass.
What are you selling?
To you? Nothing.
Why?
You're new here. I don't sell to new blood. Make a name for yourself and maybe I'll reconsider.
translation: Buraya yeni geldin. Yeni gelenlere satis yapmiyorum. Kendine bir isim yap, belki o zaman tekrar düsünürüm.

english: Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: Insan! Muhafizlari cagirmadan köle kafeslerine geri dön!

english: Sure.
I'll pass.
So can I go in now?
Yes! Now get out of my sight!
Good morning.
Sorry, but this is NOT a good morning!
translation: Üzgünüm ama bu iyi bir sabah degil!

english: Why, what's the matter?
I'm going to lose my job!
What have you done to deserve that?
translation: Bunu hak etmek icin ne yaptin?

english: Nothing! But the Piscatoris Fishing Colony is going to go out of business, and I'll have to go back to the east.
translation: Hicbir sey! Ama Piscatoris Balikcilik Kolonisi iflas edecek ve ben doguya geri dönmek zorunda kalacagim.

english: Oh dear.
If you want to help, you can get Kathy to take you up to the Colony. Herman's looking for someone to run an important errand for him.
translation: Yardim etmek istersen, Kathy'den seni Koloniye götürmesini isteyebilirsin. Herman, kendisi icin önemli bir isi yapacak birini ariyor.

english: I'll bear it in mind.
Hello! What can I do for you?
How are things going for the Colony now the trolls have all gone away?
translation: Troller gittigine göre Koloni'de isler nasil gidiyor?

english: Well, it's been fairly quiet around here, but there's always repair work to keep us busy.
translation: Buralar oldukca sakin, ama bizi mesgul edecek onarim isleri her zaman var.

english: Catching plenty of fish?
Oh yes, lots of them. Their population's been swelling ever since you wiped out the trolls in the area. They've hardly got any natural predators now.
translation: Evet, cok fazla. Sen bu bölgedeki trolleri yok ettiginden beri nüfuslari artiyor. Artik neredeyse hic dogal düsmanlari kalmadi.

english: Oh... I suppose that's good...
translation: Oh... Sanirim bu iyi bir sey...

english: I was just wondering what you're doing.
Franklin's got me fixing this wall. You did a pretty good patch-job, but it could do with some work.
translation: Franklin bu duvari tamir etmemi istedi. Oldukca iyi bir yama isi yapmissin, ama biraz daha calisma gerekiyor.

english: I'm not surprised - iron sheets won't last any time at all with all that salt water around.
translation: Sasirmadim - etrafta bu kadar tuzlu su varken demir levhalar hic dayanmaz.

english: Yes, that's right. I'll probably get Arnold to order some fancy protective paint from the dwarves.
translation: Evet, haklisin. Muhtemelen Arnold'dan cücelerden özel koruyucu boya siparis etmesini isteyecegim.

english: Good luck with that.
You know all your doors get stuck open?
translation: Bütün kapilarin acik kaliyor, biliyor musun?

english: Yes, the salt does terrible things to the hinges. I've been meaning to deal with them, but I never seem to get around to it.
translation: Evet, tuz menteselere cok zarar veriyor. Onlarla ilgilenmek istiyordum ama bir türlü vakit bulamiyorum.

english: Fair enough.
Nothing, I'm fine.
Enjoy your fishing.
How are things going for the Colony?
What are you doing?
You know all your doors get stuck open?
translation: Bütün kapilarin acik kaliyor, biliyor musun?

english: Nothing, I'm fine.
Hello there.
Wooo?  Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!
translation: Wooo?  Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!

english: You don't say?
Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!
translation: Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!

english: You don't say!
Wooowoowoooooo.... Woowoowoo? Woooo, wooowoo wooowooowooo!
Well, I guess you didn't say.
Yeah, I don't want to brag, but seriously: I am SOOOO rich....
translation: Evet, övünmek istemem ama cidden: Ben COK zenginim...

english: Yeah, I know they say money doesn't bring you happiness, but sometimes I just like to open my bank account and look at all of the stuff I own and just think to myself:
translation: Evet, paranin mutluluk getirmedigini söylerler ama bazen banka hesabimi acip sahip oldugum her seye bakip kendi kendime söyle düsünüyorum:

english: Wow. I am soooooo rich.
Well, us rich alive people don't want to waste all day spending time with you poor dead people, because I'm just sooooo rich I have to go now, and very possibly make myself even richer.
translation: Biz zengin yasayan insanlar, tüm günümüzü siz fakir ölülerle gecirmek istemiyoruz, cünkü ben cok zenginim, simdi gitmeliyim ve muhtemelen kendimi daha da zenginlestirmeliyim.

english: See ya around ghosty!
Yeah, I heard about that, ha-ha-ha!
With a MACKEREL? Ouch!
Well, it was fun. Let's do it again sometime.
translation: Evet, eglenceliydi. Bir ara tekrar yapalim.

english: Why, thank you very much!
I know, but what are you going to do?
Well, I guess that's always true in the long run. See you around, weird invisible dead person!
translation: Eh, uzun vadede bu her zaman dogru olur. Görüsürüz, tuhaf görünmez ölü adam!

english: Yeah it's not bad, but I prefer cooked chicken.
translation: Evet, fena degil, ama ben pismis tavugu tercih ederim.

english: Maybe, but nothing beats a home cooked pie!
translation: Belki, ama ev yapimi turta gibisi yoktur!

english: Man, I love pie!
You don't say? I never knew that. Well, I must be going, see you around.
translation: Öyle mi? Bunu bilmiyordum. Eh, gitmem gerek, görüsürüz.

english: We get signal!
Somebody set up us the bomb!
You have no chance to survive make your time.
translation: Hayatta kalma sansin yok, zamanini iyi degerlendir.

english: Woo?
All your base are belong to us.
Hey, don't think you can talk to me like that!
Are you threatening me?
Just because you're already dead, doesn't mean I can't find a way to hurt you ghosty!
translation: Sen zaten öldün diye, sana zarar vermenin bir yolunu bulamayacagim anlamina gelmez hayalet!

english: No, I've never been there in my life and CERTAINLY didn't steal anything when I was!
translation: Hayir, hayatimda oraya hic gitmedim ve oradayken KESINLIKLE hicbir sey calmadim!

english: Are you calling me a liar?!?! I have never stolen a thing in my life, and I resent the implication that I am the kind of morally depraved individual that would steal someone else's hard earned
translation: Bana yalanci mi diyorsun?!?! Hayatimda hicbir sey calmadim ve baskalarinin zor kazandiklari parayi

english: money from their very pockets!
translation: ceplerinden calacak kadar ahlaksiz bir insan oldugumu ima etmene cok kizdim!

english: Or cakes. Or fur. Repeatedly. For long periods at a time.
translation: Ya da kekleri. Ya da kürkleri. Tekrar tekrar. Uzun süreler boyunca.

english: Well if you are going to take that attitude, then I have nothing further to say on the matter, and bid you good day!
translation: Eger bu tavri takinacaksan, bu konuda söyleyecek baska bir seyim yok, iyi günler!

english: Hello Dhalak.
You see my form, hear my words, and know my name, yet your face I recognise not...
translation: Seklimi görüyorsun, sözlerimi duyuyorsun ve adimi biliyorsun, ama yüzünü taniyamiyorum...

english: Be you some mighty sorcerer to bind me so?
translation: Beni böyle baglayan güclü bir büyücü müsün?

english: Um... Well, not really...
Well, I don't mean to brag, but I guess I am with my level 99 magic...
translation: Övünmek istemem ama sanirim 99. seviye büyümle öyleyim...

english: But that is besides the point. It is not I who has trapped you here as a ghost.
translation: Ama konu bu degil. Seni burada hayalet olarak hapseden ben degilim.

english: Then how comes it to be that you know my name stranger?
translation: O zaman nasil oluyor da adimi biliyorsun yabanci?

english: Lennissa told me about you, and where to find you?
translation: Lennissa bana senden ve seni nerede bulabilecegimden bahsetti.

english: Lennissa? Oh that poor sweet girl... Has my foolishness cursed her as well as myself???
translation: Lennissa mi? Ah, o zavalli tatli kiz... Aptalligimla kendimi lanetledigim gibi onu da lanetledim mi?

english: Your foolishness?
The story shames me stranger, I wouldst rather keep it unto myself.
translation: Bu hikaye beni utandiriyor yabanci, kendime saklamak istiyorum.

english: Look, I don't want to force you into telling me, but perhaps sharing it with someone might relieve your guilt?
translation: Bak, sana anlatmani zorlamak istemiyorum, ama belki biriyle paylasmak sucluluk duygunu hafifletir?

english: Aye... Perhaps it might at that.
So what has Lennissa told you of the events of the day this curse befell me?
translation: Peki Lennissa sana bu lanetin bana cöktügü gün olan olaylari anlatti mi?

english: Well, she told me that she was working as an undercover agent of Saradomin amongst the followers of some 'Empty Lord', and when news of the theft of a god-weapon reached her, she passed the message on to
translation: Sey, bana Saradomin'in gizli ajani olarak “Bos Lord”un takipcileri arasinda calistigini ve bir tanri silahinin calindigi haberi ona ulastiginda, kimliginin aciga cikmasindan korktugu icin haberi Saradomin'e degil sana ilettigini söyledi.

english: you instead of taking it to Saradomin because she was scared her cover might be blown.
Aye, that is a fair account of events...
translation: Evet, olaylari dogru bir sekilde anlatmis...

english: But I don't understand why you didn't take her message to Saradomin?
Stranger, my foolishness was a result of my respect for Saradomin, not as a result of any attempted treachery!
translation: Yabanci, benim aptalligim Saradomin'e olan saygimin bir sonucuydu, ihanet girisimimin degil!

english: So why didn't you pass on Lennissa's message? As I understand it something happened with that staff that could have been avoided if you had passed her message on!
translation: Peki neden Lennissa'nin mesajini iletmedin? Anladigim kadariyla, o asayla ilgili bir sey oldu ve sen mesajini iletmis olsaydin bu önlenebilirdi!

english: (sigh) I know not what occurred with that god-weapon, but I have my suspicions...
translation: (ic cekerek) O tanri silahiyla ne oldugunu bilmiyorum, ama süphelerim var...

english: Let me explain myself. I was Lennissa's immediate superior, and I was often her contact for missions.
translation: Durumumu aciklayayim. Ben Lennissa'nin en yakin amiriydim ve genellikle görevler icin onunla iletisim kuran kisiydim.

english: Because of this role, I had access to a larger picture of what was happening than she herself did, and I was not only well aware that her presence amongst the enemy camp had been detected, but I was also well aware that
translation: Bu rolüm nedeniyle, olan bitenin genel resmini ondan daha iyi görebiliyordum ve onun düsman kampinda varliginin fark edildigini bilmekle kalmayip,

english: there was a growing faction amongst them who were plotting to overthrow their master.
translation: aralarinda efendilerini devirmeyi planlayan bir grubun büyüdügünü de cok iyi biliyordum.

english: Their master being...?
That I will not tell you. I will tempt the fates no more than I already have done.
translation: Bunu size söylemeyecegim. Kaderle daha fazla oynayamayacagim.

english: But anyway, it had come to my attention that the Mahjarrat who had been liberated from the control of Icthlarin did not much appreciate one form of slavery to another, and under the leadership of the mighty
translation: Ama her neyse, Icthlarin'in kontrolünden kurtulan Mahjarrat'larin bir tür kölelikten baska bir tür kölelige gecmeyi pek de istemedigini ve güclü

english: Zamorak were making plans to overthrow their master and take his power for themselves.
translation: Zamorak'in liderliginde efendilerini devirip onun gücünü ele gecirme planlari yaptiklarini fark ettim.

english: Now, as powerful, long-lived and evil as they were, they were still just mortal, and I made the decision that it would be of benefit to my Lord Saradomin for his mightiest rival to be distracted by such internal conflicts.
translation: Simdi, ne kadar güclü, uzun ömürlü ve kötü olsalar da, yine de sadece ölümlüydüler ve ben, Lord Saradomin'in en güclü rakibinin bu tür ic catismalarla oyalanmasinin onun yararina olacagina karar verdim.

english: So that is why you decided not to pass the report from Lennissa on?
translation: Bu yüzden Lennissa'nin raporunu iletmemeye mi karar verdin?

english: Yes, but my guilt is more than simply inaction...
translation: Evet, ama benim sucum sadece hareketsizlikten ibaret degil...

english: I knew that with such a weapon, Zamorak would be capable of launching an attack that could actually stand a chance of success, but I also knew that he would never be able to get a chance to use it in a battle for
translation: Böyle bir silahla Zamorak'in basarili olma sansi olan bir saldiri baslatabilecegini biliyordum, ama ayni zamanda onu savasta kullanma sansi asla olmayacagini da biliyordum.

english: being a god-weapon its very presence would have sung out to their leader.
translation: Tanri silahi oldugu icin, varligi liderlerine hemen fark edilirdi.

english: I'm guessing you did something about that, then?
translation: O zaman bu konuda bir seyler yaptin herhalde?

english: Indeed I did. To my eternal shame, I decided that I would assist Zamorak and his henchmen in their battle, by secretly casting a spell of concealment upon the staff so that
translation: Evet, yaptim. Sonsuza kadar utanacagim bir sey ama Zamorak ve adamlarina savaslarinda yardim etmeye karar verdim ve asaya gizlice bir gizleme büyüsü yaptim, böylece

english: they might use it secretly against their master.
So Zamorak knew about this?
No, nobody except myself, and now you, knew that I cast such a spell....
translation: Hayir, benden ve simdi senden baska kimse bu büyüyü yaptigimi bilmiyordu...

english: Had I known what a threat to my Lord Saradomin Zamorak would later become, I wouldst have taken the message to Saradomin immediately! Alas, it is all too easy to see your mistakes after you
translation: Zamorak'in Lord Saradomin için ne kadar büyük bir tehdit olusturacagini bilseydim, mesaji hemen Saradomin'e iletirdim!

english: have made them...
translation: Ne yazik ki, hatalarini yaptiktan sonra fark etmek çok kolaydir...

english: I'm confused. What exactly happened with this staff anyway? And why have all these various random people been cursed because of it?
translation: Kafam karisti. Bu asaya ne oldu tam olarak? Ve neden bu yüzden bu kadar cok insan lanetlendi?

english: I cannot answer your question with anything other than my own suppositions, but I do know of one who might be able to, and if any man deserved to be cursed for their actions that day, it was he!
translation: Soruna kendi varsayimlarimdan baska bir cevap veremem, ama cevap verebilecek birini taniyorum ve o gün yaptiklari icin lanetlenmeyi hak eden biri varsa, o da oydu!

english: Who are you speaking of?
His name was Viggora. He was an evil man, brutal and vicious, and deadly with a blade.
translation: Adi Viggora'ydi. Kötü, acimasiz, zalim ve kilic kullanmada ölümcül bir adamdi.

english: He was one of the few humans Zamorak allowed to rise to a position of power amongst his rebels, possibly because he imitated those same qualities of Zamorak.
translation: Zamorak'in isyancilari arasinda iktidara yükselmesine izin verdigi birkac insandan biriydi, muhtemelen Zamorak'in ayni özelliklerini taklit ettigi icin.

english: If anyone knows what Zamorak did with that god- weapon to have caused this curse to have befallen us, it would have been he, for he would have been fighting on Zamorak's very right hand side in their rebellion.
translation: Zamorak'in bu lanetin üzerimize cökmesine neden olan o tanrisal silahla ne yaptigini bilen biri varsa, o da odur, cünkü isyan sirasinda Zamorak'in sag kolu olarak savasiyordu.

english: Please, if this curse can be lifted, find Viggora and find out what he has wrought upon us! I have no wealth nor magic to aid you, but take my hood as reward;
translation: Lütfen, bu lanet kaldirilabilirse, Viggora'yi bulun ve bize ne yaptigini ögrenin! Size yardim edecek ne servetim ne de büyüm var, ama ödül olarak basligimi alin;

english: it has served me well these centuries past, and may bring you luck.
translation: bu yüzyillar boyunca bana iyi hizmet etti, size de sans getirebilir.

english: Where would you suggest I look for Viggora?
Ah, the evil swordsman Viggora... A rogue like him would probably flock to his own kind.
translation: Ah, kötü kilic ustasi Viggora... Onun gibi bir haydut muhtemelen kendi türünün yanina akin eder.

english: Okay, well I'll try and find him for you then.
translation: Tamam, o zaman onu senin icin bulmaya calisacagim.

english: Ah, the evil swordsman Viggora... Perhaps he has returned to his castle in the dark lands?
translation: Ah, kötü kilic ustasi Viggora... Belki karanlik topraklardaki kalesine dönmüstür?

english: Ah, the evil swordsman Viggora... Paddewwa was where he fought many battles, perhaps he has returned to one of his old haunts?
translation: Ah, kötü kilic ustasi Viggora... Paddewwa, onun bircok savas verdigi yerdi, belki eski mekanlarindan birine dönmüstür?

english: Well, that's all fascinating, but I just don't particularly care. Bye-bye.
translation: Bunlar cok ilginc, ama beni pek ilgilendirmiyor. Hosca kal.

english: Dhalak, where can I find the swordsman Viggora?
translation: Dhalak, kilic ustasi Viggora'yi nerede bulabilirim?

english: Hello.
Could I have more of those ghostly robes you gave me?
translation: Bana verdigin hayalet cüppelerinden biraz daha alabilir miyim?

english: It seems as though the curse that keeps me here extends to my very clothing... which piece do you want?
translation: Beni burada tutan lanet, giysilerime de uzaniyor gibi görünüyor... Hangi parcayi istiyorsun?

english: Here you go.
Tell me your story
Goodbye then
Ask about Viggora.
Ask for more ghostly robes.
You dare disturb my rest!
translation: Cesaretin var da benim huzurumu bozuyorsun!

english: You dare steal from us!
[House owner] killed an abyssal demon! Cool!
translation: Ev sahibi bir abyssal iblisi öldürdü! Harika!

english: Cool for [him/her] maybe. How would you like to be stuck on a wall?
translation: Belki onun için harika. Duvara yapisik kalmak ister miydin?

english: Have you considered visitingTHE ABYSS?
translation: THE ABYSS'i ziyaret etmeyi düsündünüz mü?

english: I visit the abyss all the time!
translation: Ben THE ABYSS'i sürekli ziyaret ediyorum!

english: I bet you just rush through it though. Everyone there is in such a rush. No one stops to appreciate the beauty ofTHE ABYSS.
translation: Ama eminim ki sen oradan aceleyle geçiyorsundur. Oradaki herkes çok aceleci. Kimse THE ABYSS'in güzelligini takdir etmek için durmuyor.

english: I have to run through it quickly or I'll die!
Death is a small thing compared to the beauty ofTHE ABYSS.
translation: Ölüm, THE ABYSS'in güzelligine kiyasla önemsiz bir sey.

english: The abyss looks pretty ugly to me.
translation: THE ABYSS bana oldukça çirkin görünüyor.

english: Poor deluded fool. There is no hope for you at all.
translation: Zavalli, aldanmis aptal. Senin için hiç umut yok.

english: It's too scary for me!
But does not the fear contribute to your appreciation ofTHE ABYSS?
translation: Ama korku, THE ABYSS'i takdir etmene katkida bulunmuyor mu?

english: No, it's just scary.
Poor human. You must not judgeTHE ABYSSby the standards of this world. You must learn to embrace your fear as part of the experience ofTHE ABYSS.
translation: Zavalli insan. THE ABYSS'i bu dünyanin standartlarina göre yargilamamalisin. THE ABYSS deneyiminin bir parçasi olarak korkunu kucaklamayi ögrenmelisin.

english: I suppose fear does heighten the senses.
Then you should enhance them further by raising the stakes. Next time you go toTHE ABYSSyou should take all your most valuable items with you.
translation: O zaman riski artirarak duyularini daha da keskinlestirmelisin. Bir dahaki sefere THE ABYSS'e gittiginde en degerli esyalarini da yaninda götürmelisin.

english: Could I get an abyssal whip?
You must take all your gold and all your most valued items, and take them intoTHE ABYSSwithout weapons or armour.
translation: Tüm altinlarini ve en degerli esyalarini almali ve silah veya zirh olmadan THE ABYSS'e götürmelisin.

english: And then will I get an abyssal whip?
You'll get anABYSSAL WHIPPING!
That pun was abyssmal.
I visit the abyss all the time
I have to run through quickly or I'll die
The abyss looks pretty ugly to me
It's too scary for me
No, it's just scary
I suppose fear does heighten the senses
Could I get an abyssal whip?
Hello!
Hello friend. I wish to slay evil and avail them of their loot! Take me to Burgh de Rott!
translation: Merhaba dostum. Kötülügü yok etmek ve ganimetlerini ele geçirmek istiyorum! Beni Burgh de Rott'a götür!

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: Oradaki kötülükle savasmaya yeterince hazir misin?

english: I think so? At least my heart knows courage and that should be sufficient for the meantime. I expect that when we get to Burgh de Rott, we'll be able to purchase suitable provisions.
translation: Sanirim öyle. En azindan kalbim cesaretli ve bu simdilik yeterli olmali. Burgh de Rott'a vardigimizda uygun erzak satin alabilecegimizi umuyorum.

english: But you do realise that the vampyres in Morytania are immune to everything except silver?
translation: Ama Morytania'daki vampirlerin gümüs disinda her seye karsi bagisik olduklarini biliyor musun?

english: Er...well, I've not heard mention of that fact, but I have faith that Saradomin will provide the means to furnish me with suitable weapons when I reach Burgh de Rott.
translation: Sey... Bu konuda bir sey duymadim, ama Burgh de Rott'a vardigimda Saradomin'in bana uygun silahlar saglayacagina inaniyorum.

english: And if we happen to run into some vampyres on the journey down there?
translation: Ya oraya giderken yolda vampirlerle karsilasirsak?

english: I trust that you will help us to avoid them. You are a guide after all, aren't you? Anyway, you look like you can handle yourself. I presume you've fought such creatures before and won? How hard can it be?
translation: Onlardan kaçinmamiza yardim edecegine inaniyorum. Sonuçta sen bir rehbersin, degil mi? Her neyse, kendini savunabilecek gibi görünüyorsun. Daha önce bu tür yaratiklarla savasip kazandin mi? Ne kadar zor olabilir ki?

english: It can be pretty difficult, actually. But you're right, I'll be your guide so I should be able to handle the situation.
translation: Aslinda oldukça zor olabilir. Ama haklisin, ben senin rehberin olacagim, bu yüzden durumu halledebilmeliyim.

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Neden Burgh de Rott'a gitmek istiyorsun?

english: I'm going down there to teach those vampyres a lesson or two. I've heard about the terrible conditions down there and I intend to put a stop to it.
translation: Oradaki vampirleri bir ders vermek için gidiyorum. Oradaki korkunç kosullari duydum ve buna bir son vermek niyetindeyim.

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Burgh de Rott'a giderken yol üzerinde düsmanlarla karsilasirsak kendini savunabilir misin?

english: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of enemies. You don't need to worry about that.
translation: Diyelim ki biraz tecrübeliyim ve düsmanlarla savasmaktan çekinmem. Bu konuda endiselenmene gerek yok.

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: Hmmm, görünüse göre bir takipçin var. Kendi basina dolasmaya birakilirsa bu yolculukta kaybolabilir. Takipçin güvende oldugunda yola çikalim.

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: Gerçekten mi? Bu harika olur! Hedefe vardigimizda sana küçük bir ödül verecegim.

english: Burgh de Rott Ramble begins
Ok, which route should we take?
Ok, thanks.
Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: Ah, bana biraz erzak vermek istiyorsun, ha? Sirt çantami açayim.

english: This place is a bit grim. How can people live here?
translation: Burasi biraz kasvetli. Insanlar burada nasil yasayabiliyor?

english: Do you visit Burgh de Rott often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: Burgh de Rott'a sik sik gelir misin? Rotayi iyi biliyorsun gibi görünüyor.

english: When are we going to get to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Burgh de Rott'a ne zaman varacagiz?

english: We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on. I have loot to get.
translation: Bütün gün burada durup sohbet edemeyiz, hadi devam edelim. Yagmalayacak seyler var.

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than the opulet life styles forced on us adventurer types. I'd much rather be up to my eyes in mud and having a good fight!
translation: Oh, bu yolculuktan nefret ediyorum, ama maceraperest tiplere dayatilan lüks yasam tarzindan daha iyidir. Gözlerime kadar çamura batip iyi bir kavga etmeyi tercih ederim!

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...
Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Paterdomus. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: Vay canina! Görünüse göre Paterdomus'a geri dönmek zorunda kalacagiz. O köprüden geçemeyiz!

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
Player completes the bridge event
Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Paterdomus.
translation: Bu is bitti... Görünüse göre bu batakliktan geçemeyecegiz. Paterdomus'a geri dönmek zorundayiz.

english: Player completes the bog event
Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: Hey... bu harika... harika bir is çikardin... Seni takip edecegim.

english: Whahay...that was great!
But we really should be heading off now.
Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
Player completes the river event
That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: Bu harika! Ben de aynisini yapmaliyim.

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: Vay canina! Harikaydi! Ama artik gerçekten yola çikmaliyiz.

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
This is scary!
Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
Ahhh, two tentacles!
...three tentacles!
I think I'm going to faint!
Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: Vay canina! Su canavara bak! O seyi kendi basina halletmen gerekecek!

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the Burgh de Rott. Here's your reward.
translation: Beni Burgh de Rott'a güvenle ulastirdigin için çok tesekkürler. Iste ödülün.

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Neden Burgh de Rott'a gitmek istiyorsun?

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
Ok, thanks.
Would you look after my crops for me?
I might - which patch were you thinking of?
You don't have any seeds planted in that patch. Plant some and I might agree to look after it for you.
translation: O tarlada tohum ekmedin ki. Biraz ekin, o zaman senin için bakmayi kabul edebilirim.

english: That patch is diseased - you should cure it before asking me to be responsible for it!
translation: O tarla hastalikli, benden sorumlu olmama izin vermeden önce onu iyilestirmelisin!

english: That patch is dead - it's too late for me to do anything about it now.
translation: O tarla öldü, artik benim için bir sey yapmanin çok geç.

english: That patch is already fully grown! I don't know what you want me to do with it!
translation: O tarla zaten tamamen büyümüs! Onunla ne yapmami istiyorsun bilmiyorum!

english: I'm already looking after that patch for you.
translation: O tarlaya zaten senin için bakiyorum.

english: If you like, but I want [payment] for that.
I'm afraid I don't have any of those at the moment.
translation: Maalesef su anda elimde hiç yok.

english: Well, I'm not wasting my time for free.
Okay, it's a deal.
That'll do nicely, [sir/madam]. Leave it with me - I'll make sure that patch grows for you.
translation: Bu çok iyi olacak. Bana birakin - o yamanin sizin için büyüdügünden emin olacagim.

english: No, that's too much.
Poison ivy bushes don't get diseased, so you needn't worry about having it protected.
translation: Zehirli sarmasik çalilari hastalanmaz, bu yüzden onlari korumak için endiselenmenize gerek yok.

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: Bana tarimla ilgili tavsiyelerde bulunabilir misiniz?

english: You can put up to ten potatoes, cabbages or onions in vegetable sacks, although you can't have a mix in the same sack.
translation: Sebze çuvallarina en fazla on adet patates, lahana veya sogan koyabilirsiniz, ancak ayni çuvalda farkli türleri karistiramazsiniz.

english: You can put up to five tomatoes, strawberries, apples, bananas or oranges into a fruit basket, although you can't have a mix in the same basket.
translation: Meyve sepetine en fazla bes domates, çilek, elma, muz veya portakal koyabilirsiniz, ancak ayni sepete farkli türleri karistirarak koyamazsiniz.

english: You can buy all the farming tools from farming shops, which can be found close to the allotments.
translation: Tüm tarim aletlerini, bahçelerin yakininda bulunan tarim dükkanlarindan satin alabilirsiniz.

english: You can fill plantpots with soil from any empty patch, if you have a gardening trowel.
translation: Bahçe küreginiz varsa, bos bir alandan aldiginiz toprakla saksilari doldurabilirsiniz.

english: Tree seeds must be grown in a plantpot of soil into a sapling, and then transferred to a tree patch to continue growing to adulthood.
translation: Agaç tohumlari, saksidaki toprakta fidana dönüstürülmeli ve ardindan yetiskinlige kadar büyümeye devam etmesi için agaç alanina aktarilmalidir.

english: If you want to make your own sacks and baskets you'll need to use the loom that's near the Farming shop in Falador. If you're a good enough [craftswoman/craftsman], that is.
translation: Kendi çuvallarinizi ve sepetlerinizi yapmak istiyorsaniz, Falador'daki Tarim dükkaninin yakinindaki dokuma tezgahini kullanmaniz gerekir. Tabii yeterince iyi bir [zanaatkar]saniz.

english: You don't have to buy all your plantpots you know, you can make them yourself on a pottery wheel. If you're a good enough [craftswoman/craftsman], that is.
translation: Tüm saksilari satin almaniza gerek yok, çömlek çarkinda kendiniz yapabilirsiniz. Tabii yeterince iyi bir [zanaatkar]saniz.

english: Don't just throw away your weeds after you've raked a patch - put them in a compost bin and make some compost.
translation: Bir alani tirmikladiktan sonra yabani otlari atmayin, kompost kutusuna koyun ve kompost yapin.

english: Applying compost to a patch will not only reduce the chance that your crops will get diseased, but you will also grow more crops to harvest.
translation: Kompostu topraga uygulamak, mahsulünüzün hastalanma olasiligini azaltmakla kalmaz, ayni zamanda daha fazla mahsul yetistirmenizi de saglar.

english: Supercompost is far better than normal compost, but more expensive to make. You need to rot the right type of item; show me an item, and I'll tell you if it's super- compostable or not.
translation: Süper kompost normal komposttan çok daha iyidir, ancak yapimi daha pahalidir. Dogru türdeki ögeleri çürütebilmeniz gerekir; bana bir ögeyi gösterin, süper kompostlanabilir olup olmadigini size söyleyeyim.

english: Vegetables, hops and flowers need constant watering - if you ignore my advice, you will sooner or later find yourself in possession of a dead farming patch.
translation: Sebzeler, serbetçiotu ve çiçekler sürekli sulanmaya ihtiyaç duyar - tavsiyemi dikkate almazsaniz, er ya da geç kendinizi ölü bir tarla ile karsi karsiya bulursunuz.

english: The only way to cure a bush or tree of disease is to prune away the diseased leaves with a pair of secateurs. For all other crops I would just apply some plant-cure.
translation: Bir çali veya agaci hastaliktan kurtarmanin tek yolu, hastalikli yapraklari bir budama makasi ile budamaktir. Diger tüm mahsuller için ise bitki ilaci kullanmanizi öneririm.

english: There are five other Farming areas like this one - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Kragen's area near Ardougne, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius and Oswallt's area
translation: Bunun gibi bes tane daha çiftçilik alani var: Falador yakinlarindaki Elstan'in alani, Catherby yakinlarindaki Dantaera'nin alani, Ardougne yakinlarindaki Kragen'in alani

english: in Prifddinas.
translation: Morytania'daki Lyra'nin alani, Hosidius'daki Marisi'nin alani ve Prifddinas'daki Oswallt'in alani.

english: If you want to grow fruit trees you could try a few places: Catherby, Brimhaven, Gnome Stronghold and the Farming Guild all have fruit tree patches.
translation: Meyve agaçlari yetistirmek istiyorsaniz birkaç yeri deneyebilirsiniz: Catherby, Brimhaven, Gnome Stronghold ve Farming Guild'de meyve agaçlari yetistirilen alanlar var.

english: Hops are good for brewing ales. I believe there's a brewery up in Keldagrim somewhere, and I've heard rumours that a place called Phasmatys used to be good for that type of thing. 'Fore they all died, of course.
translation: Serbetçiotu, bira yapiminda kullanilir. Keldagrim'de bir bira fabrikasi oldugunu saniyorum ve Phasmatys adli bir yerin eskiden bu tür seyler için uygun oldugu söylentileri duydum. Tabii ki hepsi ölmeden önce.

english: Bittercap mushrooms can only be grown in a special patch in Morytania, near the Mort Myre swamp. There the ground is especially dank and suited to growing poisonous fungii.
translation: Bittercap mantarlari sadece Morytania'da, Mort Myre batakliginin yakinindaki özel bir alanda yetistirilebilir. Orada toprak özellikle nemli ve zehirli mantarlarin yetismesi için uygundur.

english: There is a special patch for growing Belladonna - I believe that it is somewhere near Draynor Manor, where the ground is a tad 'unblessed'.
translation: Belladonna yetistirmek için özel bir alan var - sanirim Draynor Manor yakinlarinda, topragin biraz ‘kutsanmamis’ oldugu bir yerde.

english: Can you sell me something?
That depends on whether I have it to sell. What is it that you're looking for?
translation: Satacak bir seyim olup olmadigina bagli. Ne ariyorsun?

english: Some plant cure.
Plant cure, eh? I might have some put aside for myself. Tell you what, I'll sell you some plant cure for 25 coins if you like.
translation: Bitki ilaci, ha? Kendim için bir miktar ayirmis olabilirim. Bak ne diyecegim, istersen sana 25 sikkeye bitki ilaci satarim.

english: Yes, that sounds like a fair price.
translation: Evet, bu makul bir fiyat gibi görünüyor.

english: No thanks, I can get that much cheaper elsewhere.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, baska yerden daha ucuza alabilirim.

english: A bucket of compost.
A bucket of compost, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 35 coins if you like.
translation: Bir kova kompost, ha? Yedek bir tane olabilir... Bak ne diyecegim, istersen 35 sikkeye satarim.

english: A rake.
A rake, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: Bir tirmik, ha? Yedek bir tane olabilir... Bak ne diyecegim, istersen 15 sikkeye satarim.

english: A plant pot.
Eh, I suppose I can spare you a plant pot, but I'll want 40 coins for it.
translation: Eh, sanirim bir saksi ayirabilirim, ama bunun için 40 para istiyorum.

english: A watering can.
A watering can, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 25 coins if you like.
translation: Bir sulama kabi, ha? Yedek bir tane olabilir... Bak ne diyecegim, istersen 25 paraya satarim.

english: A gardening trowel.
A gardening trowel, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: Bahçe küregi, ha? Yedek bir tane olabilir... Bak ne diyecegim, istersen 15 sikkeye satarim.

english: A seed dibber.
A seed dibber, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: Tohum ekme çubugu, ha? Yedek bir tane olabilir... Bak ne diyecegim, istersen 15 sikkeye satarim.

english: Forget it, you don't have anything I need.
translation: Bos ver, ihtiyacim olan hiçbir seyin yok.

english: I'll come back another time.
Which patch would you like to pay protection for?
translation: Hangi tarlaya koruma ücreti ödemek istersin?

english: I want [payment] for that.
Would you look after my crops for me?
The Cactus Patch
Okay, it's a deal.
No, that's too much.
Okay, it's a deal and don't ask again.
translation: Tamam, anlastik ve bir daha sormayin.

english: The Northern Allotment Patch
The Southern Allotment Patch
The Bush Patch

Greetings and welcome to my seed shop. Do you want to buy some seeds?
translation: Merhaba ve tohum dükkanima hos geldiniz. Tohum satin almak ister misiniz?

english: No, thank you.
Yes, please.
No, thank you.
Hello!
Hello friend. I wish to slay evil and avail them of their loot! Take me to Burgh de Rott!
translation: Merhaba dostum. Kötülügü yok etmek ve ganimetlerini ele geçirmek istiyorum! Beni Burgh de Rott'a götür!

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: Oradaki kötülükle savasmaya yeterince hazir misin?

english: I think so? At least my heart knows courage and that should be sufficient for the meantime. I expect that when we get to Burgh de Rott, we'll be able to purchase suitable provisions.
translation: Sanirim öyle. En azindan kalbim cesaret dolu ve bu simdilik yeterli olmali. Burgh de Rott'a vardigimizda uygun erzak satin alabilecegimizi umuyorum.

english: But you do realise that the vampyres in Morytania are immune to everything except silver?
translation: Ama Morytania'daki vampirlerin gümüs disinda her seye karsi bagisik olduklarini biliyor musun?

english: Er...well, I've not heard mention of that fact, but I have faith that Saradomin will provide the means to furnish me with suitable weapons when I reach Burgh de Rott.
translation: Sey... Bu konuda bir sey duymadim, ama Burgh de Rott'a vardigimda Saradomin'in bana uygun silahlar saglayacagina inaniyorum.

english: And if we happen to run into some vampyres on the journey down there?
translation: Ya oraya giderken yolda vampirlerle karsilasirsak?

english: I trust that you will help us to avoid them. You are a guide after all, aren't you? Anyway, you look like you can handle yourself. I presume you've fought such creatures before and won? How hard can it be?
translation: Onlardan kaçinmamiza yardim edecegine inaniyorum. Sonuçta sen bir rehbersin, degil mi? Her neyse, kendini savunabilecek gibi görünüyorsun. Daha önce bu tür yaratiklarla savasip kazandin mi? Ne kadar zor olabilir ki?

english: It can be pretty difficult, actually. But you're right, I'll be your guide so I should be able to handle the situation.
translation: Aslinda oldukça zor olabilir. Ama haklisin, ben senin rehberin olacagim, bu yüzden durumu halledebilmeliyim.

translation: Oradaki vampirleri bir ders vermek için gidiyorum. Oradaki korkunç kosullari duydum ve buna bir son vermek niyetindeyim.

translation: Diyelim ki biraz tecrübeliyim ve düsmanlarla savasmaktan çekinmem. Bu konuda endiselenmene gerek yok.

Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.

Ok, which route should we take?

translation: Burasi biraz kasvetli. Insanlar burada nasil yasayabiliyor?

translation: Burgh de Rott'a sik sik gelir misin? Rotayi iyi biliyorsun gibi görünüyor.

translation: Burgh de Rott'a ne zaman varacagiz?

translation: Bütün gün burada durup sohbet edemeyiz, hadi devam edelim. Yagmalayacak seyler var.

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than the opulet life styles forced on us adventurer types. I'd much rather be up to my eyes in mud and having a good fight!
translation: Oh, bu yolculuktan nefret ediyorum, ama maceraci tiplere dayatilan lüks yasam tarzindan daha iyidir. Gözlerime kadar çamura batip iyi bir kavga etmeyi tercih ederim!

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...
Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Paterdomus. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: Hay aksi! Görünüse göre Paterdomus'a geri dönmek zorundayiz. O köprüden geçemeyiz!

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
Player completes the bridge event

translation: Bu is bitti... Görünüse göre bu batakliktan geçemeyiz. Paterdomus'a geri dönmek zorundayiz.

Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.

But we really should be heading off now.
Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
Player completes the river event
That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: Bu harika! Ben de aynisini yapmaliyim.

translation: Whahay! Harikaydi! Ama artik gerçekten gitmeliyiz.

This is scary!
Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
Ahhh, two tentacles!
...three tentacles!
I think I'm going to faint!

translation: Vay canina! Su canavara bak! O seyi kendi basina halletmen gerekecek!

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the Burgh de Rott. Here's your reward.
translation: Beni Burgh de Rott'a güvenle ulastirdigin için çok tesekkürler. Iste ödülün.

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Neden Burgh de Rott'a gitmek istiyorsun?

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
Ok, thanks.
Why are you guys hanging around here?
(ahem)...'Guys'?
Uh... yeah, sorry about that. Why are you all standing around out here?
translation: Uh... evet, özür dilerim. Neden hepiniz burada duruyorsunuz?

english: Well, that's really none of your business.
So I hear theres a leprechaun around here who can show me the way to Zanaris?
translation: Buralarda Zanaris'e giden yolu gösterebilecek bir cüce var diye duydum?

english: ...W-what? How did you..?
No. You're wrong. Now go away.
So you didn't find the entrance to Zanaris yet, huh?
translation: Demek Zanaris'in girisini henüz bulamadin, ha?

english: Don't tell me a novice like YOU has found it!
translation: Senin gibi bir aceminin buldugunu söyleme sakin!

english: Yep. Found it REALLY easily too.
translation: Evet. Hem de çok kolay buldum.

english: ...I cannot believe that someone like YOU could find the portal where experienced adventurers such as ourselves could not.
translation: ...Senin gibi birinin, bizim gibi deneyimli maceracilarin bile bulamadigi portali bulduguna inanamiyorum.

english: Believe what you want. Enjoy your little camp fire.
translation: Istedigine inan. Küçük kamp atesinin tadini çikar.

english: What are you doing out here on your own?
I'm not alone! Me and my mates run these streets. You'd better watch your pockets, stranger.
translation: Yalniz degilim! Ben ve arkadaslarim bu sokaklari yönetiyoruz. Ceplerine dikkat etsen iyi olur, yabanci.

english: What do you mean you run the streets?
translation: Sokaklari siz yönetiyorsunuz da ne demek?

english: You see those fancy houses?

english: What is this place?
Like I said, this is Nemus Retreat. Back during the War of Betrayal, this was a military camp for Imafore's army, run by none other than General Nemus himself!
translation: Dedigim gibi, burasi Nemus Retreat. Ihanet Savasi sirasinda burasi Imafore ordusunun askeri kampiydi ve General Nemus'un kendisi tarafindan yönetiliyordu!

english: General Nemus is something of a hero in these parts. Towards the end of the war, the forces of Kourend had mostly taken the Auburn Valley.
translation: General Nemus bu bölgede bir kahraman sayilir. Savasin sonlarina dogru, Kourend güçleri Auburn Vadisi'nin çogunu ele geçirmisti.

english: As a result, Imafore ordered General Nemus to burn the entire valley to the ground to stop the Kourend advance. Many would have died on both sides, but Nemus refused the order.
translation: Sonuç olarak, Imafore General Nemus'a Kourend'in ilerleyisini durdurmak için tüm vadiyi yakmasini emretti. Her iki tarafta da birçok kisi ölecekti, ancak Nemus emri reddetti.

english: Imafore had him executed as a traitor, but in doing so he lost the support of all of Nemus' troops.
translation: Imafore onu hain olarak idam ettirdi, ancak bunu yaparak Nemus'un tüm birliklerinin destegini kaybetti.

english: Sounds like a bit of a shortsighted decision.
translation: Biraz kisa görüslü bir karar gibi görünüyor.

english: Indeed. Imafore presumably hoped to make an example of Nemus, but instead his decision was one of the final mistakes that ultimately led to his defeat a few months later.
translation: Gerçekten de öyle. Imafore muhtemelen Nemus'u ibret olarak göstermek istemisti, ancak bu karari, birkaç ay sonra yenilgisine yol açan son hatalarindan biri oldu.

english: Anyway, ever since the war ended, this place has remained here as something of a monument to Nemus. Of course, rather than a military camp, it now acts as a nice stop off for travellers such as yourself.
translation: Her neyse, savas bittiginden beri burasi Nemus'un aniti gibi kalmistir. Tabii ki, artik bir askeri kamp degil, sizin gibi gezginler için hos bir mola yeri olarak hizmet vermektedir.

Oh dear, I don't seem to have enough money.
translation: Oh hayir, yeterince param yok galiba.

english: Heard any rumours recently?
translation: Son zamanlarda herhangi bir dedikodu duydun mu?

english: One of the patrons here is looking for treasure apparently. A chap by the name of Veos.
translation: Buradaki müsterilerden biri hazine ariyormus. Veos adinda bir adam.

english: I'll have a beer please.
Heard any rumours recently?
translation: Son zamanlarda herhangi bir söylenti duydun mu?

english: Nothing, I'm fine.
Could I buy a beer please?
Sure, that will be 2 gold coins please.
I don't have enough coins.
Here you go.
You don't have enough room for it.
You buy a pint of beer!
Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: Burada herhangi bir söylenti duydun mu?

english: No, it hasn't been very busy lately.
translation: Hayir, son zamanlarda çok yogun degildi.

english: Could I buy a beer please?
Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: Burada herhangi bir dedikodu duydun mu?

english: Welcome to the Windbreaker. We've got the best drinks around.
translation: Windbreaker'a hos geldin. Buralardaki en iyi içkileri bizde bulabilirsin.

english: Let's see what you have.
What's with those big gates out there?

I couldn't tell you to be honest. They've been here for a very long time. Apparently they came in quite useful during the war, and these days they do help stop any undesirable beasts wandering into town.
translation: Dürüst olmak gerekirse bilmiyorum. Çok uzun zamandir oradalar. Anlasilan savas sirasinda oldukça kullanisli olmuslar ve bugünlerde kasabaya istenmeyen hayvanlarin girmesini engelliyorlar.

english: Anyway, did you want to buy a drink?
translation: Neyse, bir içki almak ister misin?

english: Nothing for me, thanks.
As you wish.
Let's see what you have.
What's with those big gates out there?
Nothing for me, thanks.
What do you want?
Oh, er, nothing!
I want to mock you.
All right. Go on then.
You're a [boring/fat/hideous/puny/smelly/stupid] [beetle/chicken/egg/mud/slime/worm]-[brained/eating/like/loving/smelling/witted] [basilisk/idiot/lizard/mudworm/slimeball/weakling]!
I'm going back to sleep.
I want to apologise for killing you.
translation: Seni öldürdügüm için özür dilemek istiyorum.

english: Go on then.
I'm, um, very sorry I killed you.
Really sorry?
No, not really!
I don't care.
Yes really!
Really really?
Yes, really really!
Fat lot of good that does, I'm still dead.
translation: Ne ise yarar ki, ben hala öldüm.

english: I'm not THAT sorry!
Will you forgive me?
Of course I'll forgive you!
Really?
No!
I promise not to do it again.
Of couseyou won't do it again, you can only kill me once.
translation: Tabii ki bir daha yapmayacaksin, beni sadece bir kez öldürebilirsin.

english: That's why I won't do it again! There'd be no point!
translation: Bu yüzden bir daha yapmayacagim! Bir anlami olmaz!

english: But I won't do it to any other basilisks!
Really?
Yes, really!
All right then. Apology accepted. Now leave me alone.
translation: Tamam o zaman. Özrünü kabul ediyorum. Simdi beni rahat birak.

english: Don't start that again!
Leave me alone then.
Don't push it!
I don't care anyway.
I just wanted to check that you're okay.
translation: Sadece iyi olup olmadigini kontrol etmek istedim.

english: Apart from being dead and stuffed and hanging on a wall, you mean?
translation: Ölü, doldurulmus ve duvara asilmis olmanin disinda mi demek istiyorsun?

english: Uh... yeah, apart from that are you okay?
translation: Uh... evet, onun disinda iyi misin?

english: Actually there's something blocking my view of the far wall.
translation: Aslinda uzak duvara bakmami engelleyen bir sey var.

english: I don't see anything.
Perhaps if you were to move to one side of me.
I still don't see anything.
Oh, it's moved away. I can see now.
Nothing.
Leave me alone.
I want to mock you
I want to apologise for killing you
translation: Seni öldürdügüm için özür dilemek istiyorum.

english: No, not really
Yes, really
Yes, really really
I'm not THAT sorry
But will you forgive me?
I promise not to do it again
That's why I won't do it again

Yes, really!
No, not really!
