english: Nothing
Hello, what's going on?
Hello, it seems you've found a wild bee hive. I'll pay you to help me rehome them.
translation: Merhaba, galiba vahsi bir ari kovani bulmussun. Onlari baska bir yere tasimama yardim edersen sana para veririm.

english: Oh, well, if you ever want to find out how to help, just ask.
translation: Oh, peki, nasil yardim edebilecegini ögrenmek istersen, sorman yeter.

english: It's easy, simply add logs to the unfinished bee boxes I create. Most common types of log work just fine.
translation: Çok kolay, benim yaptigim bitmemis ari kovanlarina kütükler ekle. En yaygin kütük türleri is görür.

english: Once a bee box is completed I will start a new one, let's see how many of these bees we can save.
translation: Ari kutusu tamamlandiginda yenisine baslayacagim, bakalim kaç tane ariyi kurtarabilecegiz.

english: Oh, Bees!
I'll find a nice new home for those bees.
translation: Bu arilar için güzel bir yuva bulacagim.

english: Come with me little bees I'll keep you safe.
translation: Gelin benimle küçük arilar, sizi güvende tutacagim.

english: Another new hive.
Well, I must be getting on now.
I'm not interested.
How can I help?
Hello.
Good day, adventurer. If you have any questions, I'm sure Lars will be more than happy to answer them. He's in the building to the south.
translation: Iyi günler, maceraci. Herhangi bir sorunuz varsa, Lars seve seve cevaplayacaktir. Güneydeki binada.

english: Also don't forget to visit my sister's axe shop. She works in the same building as Lars.
translation: Ayrica kiz kardesimin balta dükkanini da ziyaret etmeyi unutmayin. Lars ile ayni binada çalisiyor.

english: Thanks!
Welcome to the Woodcutting Guild, adventurer.
translation: Odun Kesme Loncasina hos geldiniz, maceraci.

english: Squeak!
A human? Either buy something or get out!
translation: Bir insan mi? Ya bir sey satin al ya da defol!

english: What do you have?
In a blacksmith? What do you think? Weapons!
translation: Demirci dükkaninda mi? Ne saniyorsun? Silahlar!

english: I'll get going.
Good.
What do you have?
I'll get going.
Hello there!
No! I have many things to do right now so I can't add that to my list!
translation: Hayir! Su anda yapacak çok isim var, o yüzden bunu listeme ekleyemem!

english: But...
Afraid not! Bye now!
Please excuse me, I'm rather busy.
Hey, I'm your contractor from Mahogany Homes, what did you want done?
translation: Merhaba, ben Mahogany Homes'tan müteahhidiniz, ne yaptirmak istiyorsunuz?

english: I'd like a Wooden table built.
I'd like my clock fixed.
I'd like two Wooden cabinets built.
I'd like two Wooden bookcases built.
I'd like a Wooden wardrobe built.
I'd like a Wooden drawer built.
I'd like a Oak table built.
I'd like two Oak cabinets built.
I'd like two Oak bookcases built.
I'd like a Oak wardrobe built.
I'd like a Oak drawer built.
I'd like a Teak table built.
I'd like two Teak cabinets built.
I'd like two Teak bookcases built.
I'd like a Teak wardrobe built.
I'd like a Teak drawer built.
I'd like a Mahogany table built.
I'd like two Mahogany cabinets built.
I'd like two Mahogany bookcases built.
I'd like a Mahogany wardrobe built.
I'd like a Mahogany drawer built.
I've finished with the work you wanted.
Thank you so much! Would you like a cup of tea before you go?
translation: Çok tesekkür ederim! Gitmeden önce bir fincan çay ister misiniz?

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
translation: Evet, bir fincan çay çok iyi olur.

english: Aaah, nothing like a nice cupppa tea!
translation: Aaah, güzel bir fincan çay gibisi yok!

english: No thanks, I better be off.
Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
translation: Evet, bir fincan çay çok iyi olur.

english: No thanks.
Apparently you aren't as stupid as you look.
Miaoww
Erm, hello? Can you understand me?
I certainly can, I am wearing this amulet I got in Sophanem!
translation: Elbette, Sophanem'de aldigim bu tilsimi takiyorum!

english: Ah so you've met one of the local felines, wise and confusing , those Sphinges.
translation: Demek yerel kedilerden biriyle tanismissin, bilge ve kafa karistirici Sfenksler.

english: Wow!!! You know the plural of Sphinx!!! What else do you know?
translation: Vay canina!!! Sfenkslerin çogulunu biliyorsun!!! Baska ne biliyorsun?

english: All sorts of stuff! I pick up no end of comments on my travels, want to hear one?
translation: Her türlü seyi! Seyahatlerim sirasinda sayisiz yorum topluyorum, birini duymak ister misin?

english: I certainly do. Share your wisdom, Bob!
translation: Tabii ki isterim. Bilgeligini paylas, Bob!

english: Hi, my name is Bob.
Hello Bob!
Do you two know each other?
I don't think so...
Yes you do. Dive deep, search your feelings.
translation: Evet, tanisiyorsunuz. Derinlere dal, duygularini ara.

english: OK, I will try.
What's up puss?
If only you knew the power of Bob. Your master never told you who your real father was, did he?
translation: Keske Bob'un gücünü bilseydin. Efendin sana gerçek babanin kim oldugunu hiç söylemedi, degil mi?

english: No, but what's that got to do with... no, nooooooo! It cannot be!!
translation: Hayir, ama bunun ne alakasi var... Hayir, hayirrrrr! Olamaz!!

english: Yes. I am your father!
That's impossible!!
You can destroy Zamorak. He has foreseen this. It is your destiny. Join me, and together we can rule this place as father and son.
translation: Zamorak'i yok edebilirsin. O bunu önceden görmüstü. Bu senin kaderin. Bana katil, birlikte burayi baba ve ogul olarak yönetebiliriz.

english: OK dad, maybe later, you're scaring me!
translation: Tamam baba, belki sonra, beni korkutuyorsun!

english: I think that's about enough of that. I'm off.
translation: Sanirim bu kadar yeter. Ben gidiyorum.

english: [player name], why do you keep your cat in the bank?
I thought it was too dangerous to bring it out with me.
translation: Onu yanimda getirmek çok tehlikeli olur diye düsündüm.

english: Or, I could let the poor thing get butchered! Is that what you want?
translation: Ya da zavalli seyi katledilmesine izin verebilirdim! Istedigin bu mu?

english: Butchered!!! I think not. Cats are easily as tough as sheep. Cats were the second thing Guthix brought here, after sheep of course.
translation: Katledilmek!!! Sanmiyorum. Kediler koyunlar kadar dayaniklidir. Kediler, Guthix'in buraya getirdigi ikinci seydi, tabii ki koyunlardan sonra.

english: Weird. I thought Gnomes and the Dwarves were the first ones. Oh well back to school for me.
translation: Tuhaf. Gnome'lar ve Cüceler ilk gelenlerdi saniyordum. Neyse, ben okula dönmeliyim.

english: Do you like all the monsters around here?
No, not really. I'm actually signed up with all those HAM fanatics. Kill the whole lot of 'em!!
translation: Hayir, pek sayilmaz. Aslinda tüm o HAM fanatiklerine katildim. Hepsini öldürün!!

english: That's a bit cruel isn't it?
Yeah, that's one of my best qualities. Just behind sneaky and vicious. Besides, after a few doses of catnip, they all look like mice to me!
translation: Evet, bu benim en iyi özelliklerimden biri. Sinsi ve acimasiz olmanin hemen ardindan. Ayrica, birkaç doz kedi nanesi aldiktan sonra, hepsi bana fare gibi görünüyor!

english: Hey Bob. Got any wisdom to share?
translation: Selam Bob. Paylasacak bir bilgelik var mi?

english: If a player falls down in a forest and nobody is there, do they make any noise?
translation: Bir oyuncu ormanda düserse ve etrafta kimse yoksa, ses çikarir mi?

english: Sorry, I am far too busy marking my territory.
Your territory? This place is ruled by the Grand Highmage Gower and his minions.
translation: Senin bölgen mi? Burasi Büyük Büyücü Gower ve onun usaklari tarafindan yönetiliyor.

english: I think not. They are my minions, and I let him think that he's in charge. I'm the real power behind the throne.
translation: Sanmiyorum. Onlar benim usaklarim ve ben onun sorumlu oldugunu düsünmesine izin veriyorum. Tahtin arkasindaki gerçek güç benim.

english: I knew it!!
Yeah, it keeps them happy that way, but don't tell anyone!
translation: Evet, bu sekilde mutlu oluyorlar, ama kimseye söyleme!

english: Hee hee. OK Bob.
Dogs believe they are human. Cats believe they are Guthix!
translation: Köpekler kendilerini insan sanirlar. Kediler kendilerini Guthix sanirlar!

english: What do you believe, Bob?
Well, I don't believe much really since I know I am Zar... erm, well, no, I erm, meow?
translation: Sey, ben pek bir sey sanmiyorum, çünkü ben Zar oldugumu biliyorum... sey, hayir, ben, sey, miyav?

english: Don't get distracted so easily! See, I'm distracting you right now!
translation: Bu kadar kolay dikkatin dagilmasin! Bak, su anda dikkatini dagitiyorum!

english: Sorry, I'm far too busy calculating thermal vectors.
translation: Üzgünüm, termal vektörleri hesaplamakla çok mesgulüm.

english: Eh?
Oh, sorry... I meant, erm, meow?
translation: Oh, üzgünüm... Demek istedigim, sey, miyav?

english: Nothing interesting happens.
Eh? That's hardly useful.
Ahh, but it is you see. It does all sorts of wonderous things.
translation: Ahh, ama öyle, anlarsin ya. Her türlü harika sey oluyor.

english: Like what?
Well, it's more to do with what happens when you hear that being said. You see, something interesting happens somewhere else.
translation: Sey, daha çok bunu duydugunda olanlarla ilgili. Anlarsin ya, baska bir yerde ilginç bir sey oluyor.

english: So what you're saying is that if nothing interesting happens to me, then something interesting is happening for someone else somewhere that IS interesting?
translation: Yani, bana ilginç bir sey olmazsa, baska bir yerde baska birine ilginç bir sey oluyor mu diyorsun?

english: Yes, that's about it.
OK... I see.... I think.
Cats are rather delicate creatures and they are subject to a good many ailments, but I never heard of one who suffered from insomnia.
translation: Kediler oldukça hassas yaratiklardir ve pek çok rahatsizliga maruz kalirlar, ama uykusuzluk çeken bir kedi duymadim hiç.

english: So, you want to know how us cats keep so clean all day?
translation: Demek kedilerin bütün gün nasil bu kadar temiz kaldigini merak ediyorsun?

english: Must be all that washing you do.
You would think so wouldn't you. But is being covered in spit really clean?
translation: Öyle düsünürsün tabii. Ama tükürükle kapli olmak gerçekten temizlik mi?

english: Eeeww. Gross.
Anything not nailed down is a cat toy.
If at first you don't succeed, take a short nap.
translation: Ilk denemede basarili olamazsan, kisa bir sekerleme yap.

english: Yeah, I could tell you something really useful, but then I would have to '1-hit you' to death.
translation: Evet, sana gerçekten yararli bir sey söyleyebilirim, ama o zaman seni tek vurusta öldürmek zorunda kalirim.

english: Bob, you couldn't 1-hit a noob.
translation: Bob, bir acemiyi tek vurusta öldüremezsin.

english: Care to place a wager on that? Sorry, hang on, I've got no pockets. Maybe next time.
translation: Buna bahse girer misin? Üzgünüm, bekle, cebim yok. Belki bir dahaki sefere.

english: I'll be waiting.
Dogs have owners, cats have staff.
translation: Köpeklerin sahipleri vardir, kedilerin ise personeli.

english: I have studied many philosophers and many cats. The wisdom of cats is infinitely superior.
translation: Birçok filozofu ve kediyi inceledim. Kedilerin bilgeligi sonsuz derecede üstündür.

english: There are many intelligent species in the universe. They are all owned by cats.
translation: Evrende birçok zeki tür vardir. Hepsi kedilerin sahibidir.

english: Cats and teleporting just don't mix well. That's why I walk everywhere. Messes my hair up terribly.
translation: Kediler ve isinlanma pek uyumlu degildir. Bu yüzden her yere yürüyerek giderim. Saçimi çok dagitir.

english: Cats are smarter than dogs. You can't get eight cats to pull a sled through snow.
translation: Kediler köpeklerden daha akillidir. Sekiz kediyi kar üzerinde kizak çekmeye ikna edemezsin.

english: Sorry, no time for chat. Still got mouse bones stuck in my teeth. How awkward.
translation: Üzgünüm, sohbet edecek vaktim yok. Dislerimde hala fare kemikleri var. Ne garip.

english: You know, cats are the first species to fully evolve. We're perfect.
translation: Biliyorsun, kediler tamamen evrimlesen ilk türlerdir. Biz mükemmeldiriz.

english: Preserve nature. Pickle a dog!
Do you like dogs?
Yes!
Me too. Care to swap recipes? I have a rather unique hotdog sauce.
translation: Ben de. Tariflerimizi paylasmak ister misin? Oldukça essiz bir sosisli sosum var.

english: Bob, you're a bit messed up really aren't you.
translation: Bob, sen gerçekten biraz kafayi yemissin, degil mi?

english: No, I just know what I like. Besides, it was a joke.
translation: Hayir, sadece neyi sevdigimi biliyorum. Ayrica, o bir sakaydi.

english: A joke? I doubt the dogs are laughing.
What dogs? I have already rid this place of dogs. Have you ever seen one?
translation: Hangi köpekler? Burayi köpeklerden çoktan temizledim. Hiç köpek gördün mü?

english: Yes actually. I heard there are a few wild dogs about here somewhere.
translation: Aslinda evet. Buralarda birkaç vahsi köpek oldugunu duydum.

english: Right!! Fellow cats, prepare for war!!
Mmm. Maybe another time.
Cat Rule number 1: Always act afraid when near dogs, especially if you're near a human. They will pick you up and fuss you, then shout at the dog. Most amusing!
translation: Kedi Kurali 1: Köpeklerin yaninda, özellikle de bir insanin yaninda oldugunda her zaman korkmus gibi davran. Seni kucagina alip oksayacaklar, sonra da köpege bagiracaklar. Çok eglenceli!

english: Cat Rule number 2: When assisting a human at work, make sure you sit behind its right leg. You stand a much better chance of getting picked up and stroked. Also, it's very amusing
translation: Kedi Kurali 2: Bir insana isinde yardim ederken, sag bacaginin arkasina oturdugundan emin ol. Böylece kucagina alinma ve oksanma sansin çok daha yüksek olur. Ayrica, çok eglencelidir.

english: Cat Rule number 3: If you ever make a mistake, which is rare and probably involves a dog, make sure you wash yourself immediately. This will give everyone the impression that
translation: Kedi Kurali 3: Nadiren de olsa bir hata yaparsaniz, ki bu muhtemelen bir köpekle ilgilidir, hemen kendinizi yikayin. Bu, herkese bunun

english: it was done on purpose.
Cat Rule number 4: Beware the bag monster. These things live in small bags and under newspapers, sometimes even hidden in shoes if they are very clever. They will be very small and
translation: Kedi Kurali 4: Çanta canavarindan sakinin. Bu seyler küçük çantalarda ve gazetelerin altinda yasar, bazen çok zeki iseler ayakkabilarin içinde bile saklanirlar. Çok küçüktürler ve

english: take on the same colour as the hiding place. Attack these things on sight - stop at nothing. If you see a bag or shoe you have not inspected recently, pounce!!
translation: saklandiklari yerin rengini alirlar. Bunlari gördügünüz anda saldirin - hiçbir sey sizi durdurmasin. Son zamanlarda incelemediniz bir çanta veya ayakkabi görürseniz, atlayin!

english: Hello, chum, fancy buyin' some designer jewellry? They've come all the way from Ardougne! Most pukka!
translation: Merhaba dostum, tasarimci mücevherleri satin almak ister misin? Ardougne'dan buraya kadar geldiler! Çok kaliteli!

english: Erm, no. I'm all set, thanks.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler. Benim bir seyim yok.

english: Okay, chum, would you like to show you the very latest potion prices?
translation: Tamam dostum, sana en son iksir fiyatlarini göstereyim mi?

english: Who are you?
Why, I'm Bob! Your friendly seller of smashin' goods!
translation: Ben Bob! Senin dost canlisi, harika ürünler satan saticin!

english: So what do you have to sell?
Oh, not much at the moment. Cuz, ya know, business being so well and cushie.
translation: Su anda pek bir sey yok. Çünkü isler çok iyi gidiyor ve rahatim.

english: You don't really look like you're being so successful.
You plonka! It's all a show, innit! If I let people knows I'm in good business they'll want a share of the moolah!
translation: Seni aptal! Hepsi numara, degil mi! Islerimin iyi gittigini insanlar ögrenirse, paradan pay almak isteyecekler!

english: You conveniently have a response for everything.
translation: Her seye uygun bir cevabin var.

english: That's the Ardougne way, my son.
Can you show me the prices for potions?
Lets see what you have...
You're a bit short of inventory space.
You're a bit short of empty vessels or cash. Empty vials cost 5 coins each, cups 8 coins each, and anything else is 5 coins each.
translation: Bos kaplarin veya nakit paranin biraz eksik. Bos siseler 5 coin, bardaklar 8 coin ve diger her sey 5 coin.

english: There, I've done what I can, but you're a bit short of empty vessels or cash. Empty vials cost 5 coins each, cups 8 coins each, and anything else is 5 coins each.
translation: Iste, elimden geleni yaptim ama bos kaplarin veya nakit paranin biraz eksik. Bos siseler 5 coin, bardaklar 8 coin ve diger her sey 5 coin.

english: There, all done.
Two plus two is four, minus one that's three...
translation: Iki arti iki dört eder, eksi bir üç eder...

english: I don't think you've got anything that I can decant.
translation: Sanirim benim için siseleyebilecegim bir seyin yok.

english: Please, please, please work.
I'm in the money!
I could have sworn that would have worked.
Now what should I buy?
Hope this item sells well.
Who are you?
Can you show me the prices for potions?
I'll leave you to it.
Who's a cute little kitty?
Jimmy doesn't like me talking to strangers.
Miaow!
Hello there.
Can I help you?
Just wondering what brings you out here?
This is the only land border into the Kingdom of Varlamore. We're here to make sure no one enters without permission.
translation: Burasi Varlamore Kralligi'na açilan tek kara siniri. Kimsenin izinsiz girmediginden emin olmak için buradayiz.

english: I see. Would I be able to enter?

No. The Queen is currently making arrangements to allow outsiders like yourself to enter Varlamore without needing to obtain permission first. However, until then, you must remain on this side of the border.
translation: Hayir. Kraliçe su anda sizin gibi yabancilar için önceden izin almadan Varlamore'a girilebilmesini saglayacak düzenlemeler yapiyor. Ancak o zamana kadar sinirin bu tarafinda kalmaniz gerekiyor.

english: Fair enough.
Just passing through.
Fair enough.
Would you like to buy some archery equipment?
translation: Okçuluk ekipmani satin almak ister misin?

english: No thanks, I've got all the archery equipment I need.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, ihtiyacim olan tüm okçuluk ekipmanina sahibim.

english: Okay. Fare well on your travels.
No thanks, I've got all the archery equipment I need.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, ihtiyacim olan tüm okçuluk ekipmanina sahibim.

english: Let's see what you've got, then.
translation: O zaman neyin var bir bakalim.

english: Hello Brother Jered, the monks in Varrock sent me. What is going on?
translation: Merhaba Jered Kardes, Varrock'taki rahipler beni gönderdi. Neler oluyor?
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Thank Saradomin that you came! We need help! Oziach is trying to buy the monastery!
translation: Geldigin için Saradomin'e sükürler olsun! Yardima ihtiyacimiz var! Oziach manastiri satin almaya çalisiyor!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: What can I do to help?
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: We've tried everything, there is nothing!
translation: Her seyi denedik, hiçbir sey ise yaramadi!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Unless...
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Are you any good at climbing trees?
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Pretty good, why?
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Oziach is scared of ghosts! If you can climb a tree and make a scary noise, that might scare him off!
translation: Oziach hayaletlerden korkar! Agaçlara tirmanip korkutucu sesler çikarirsan, onu korkutup kaçirabilirsin!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: I see, I can give that a go! What should I make the scary noise with?
translation: Anladim, deneyebilirim! Korkutucu sesleri neyle çikaracagim?
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: How about one of these wine bottles? I have loads!
translation: Bu sarap siselerinden biriyle ne dersin? Bir sürü var!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: I'm sure there's a perfectly sane explanation why.
translation: Bunun mantikli bir açiklamasi olduguna eminim.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: I might have looked for a solution in them... And I found one, too!
translation: Onlarda bir çözüm aradim... Ve bir tane buldum!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Take this wine bottle and climb the tree nearest Oziach, then blow on it to scare him!
translation: Bu sarap sisesini al ve Oziach'a en yakin agaca tirman, sonra onu korkutmak için siseye üfle!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Brother Jered now has said to take the wine bottle.
translation: Kardes Jered simdi sarap sisesini almani söyledi.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)
source: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: What can you do to help a bold adventurer like myself?
translation: Benim gibi cesur bir maceraciya nasil yardim edebilirsin?
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Not a lot from down here, sorry, I'm currently dealing with this mess! Come and see me upstairs and I can assist you with your question there.
translation: Buradan pek bir sey yapamam, üzgünüm, su anda bu karisiklikla ugrasiyorum! Yukariya gel ve beni gör, orada soruna yardimci olabilirim.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Praise be to Saradomin!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Yes! Praise he who brings life to this world.
translation: Evet! Bu dünyaya hayat veren kisiyi övün.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: I've lost the bottle, can I have another one please?
translation: Siseyi kaybettim, baska bir tane alabilir miyim lütfen?
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: You don't have any space for the bottle! Talk to me again once you have space.
translation: Sise için yerin yok! Yer açildiginda tekrar konusalim.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: There you go. You can blow into the top to make a spooky sound.
translation: Iste oldu. Üstüne üfleyerek ürkütücü bir ses çikarabilirsin.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Brother Jered now remembers the player has received his bottle at least once.
translation: Jered kardes, oyuncunun en az bir kez siseyi aldigini hatirliyor.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)
source: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: If you're hiding up a tree when you do it, it should fool Oziach into thinking it's a ghost!
translation: Bunu yaparken bir agacin tepesinde saklanirsan, Oziach'i bunun bir hayalet oldugunu düsünmesine neden olabilirsin!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Would you like to try that now?
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: There you go, try not to lose this one!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Would you like to try and scare Oziach now?
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Brother Jered!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Hi [player name].
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Could I have another wine bottle? I dropped the other one.
translation: Baska bir sarap sisesi alabilir miyim? Digerini düsürdüm.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Sure, I have plenty.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Yes, let's scare Oziach!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Be careful, make sure you don't get too close to him, or take too long, he'll be sure to spot you!
translation: Dikkatli ol, ona çok yaklasma ya da çok uzun sürmesin, yoksa seni fark eder!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Good luck!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: The camera fades to a cutscene.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)
source: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Not just yet.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Okay, come back and talk to me when you're ready to try scaring Oziach!
translation: Tamam, Oziach'i korkutmaya hazir oldugunda geri gel ve benimle konus!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: It didn't work!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Scaring Oziach? He wasn't scared?
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: No! He said one ghost wasn't enough! But I have a plan...
translation: Hayir! Bir hayalet yetmezmis! Ama bir planim var...
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: A plan?
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Yes! ONE ghost wasn't enough. We need more than one ghost. We need TWO ghosts!
translation: Evet! Bir hayalet yetmez. Birden fazla hayalet lazim. Iki hayalet lazim!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Will you be my accomplice and be the second ghost?
translation: Benim suç ortagim olup ikinci hayalet olur musun?
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: I would, but I don't feel too well from all the stress.
translation: Olurdum ama stres yüzünden kendimi pek iyi hissetmiyorum.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Are you sure it's not all the wine and food?
translation: Sarap ve yemekten kaynaklanmadigindan emin misin?
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: What?
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Nothing! That's okay, I hope you feel better soon!
translation: Hiçbir sey! Sorun degil, umarim yakinda iyilesirsin!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: I need to find an accomplice elsewhere, then. Do you have any ideas?
translation: O zaman baska bir suç ortagi bulmam gerek. Bir fikrin var mi?
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: The price to place an advert is 500,000 coins. I've always had good responses to my ads in the past.
translation: Ilan vermek için 500.000 sikke gerekiyor. Geçmiste ilanlarima her zaman iyi tepkiler aldim.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: 500,000 coins? That is quite a lot!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Ah yes, don't worry about that. I have this pre-paid ad coupon you can use.
translation: Ah evet, bunun için endiselenme. Kullanabilecegin ön ödemeli reklam kuponum var.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: I bought an ad spot in the paper the other week. I was going to place an ad for recruiting some new monks.
translation: Geçen hafta gazetede reklam yeri satin aldim. Yeni rahipler almak için ilan verecektim.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: However with everything going on right now, I think this is more important.
translation: Ancak su anda olan biten her seyden dolayi, bunun daha önemli oldugunu düsünüyorum.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: You don't have any space for the coupon! Talk to me again once you have space.
translation: Kupon için yerin yok! Yer açildiginda tekrar konusalim.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: There's now a coupon waiting for the player.
translation: Artik oyuncu için bir kupon var.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)
source: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Here you go.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: The player can now talk to Benny about the Halloween event.
translation: Oyuncu artik Benny ile Cadilar Bayrami etkinligi hakkinda konusabilir.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)
source: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Thank you! You had me worried there that I was going to have to find 500,000 coins. I'll go and place the advert.
translation: Tesekkürler! 500.000 sikke bulmam gerekecek diye endiselendim. Gidip reklami verecegim.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Good luck, I hope you find a good accomplice!
translation: Iyi sanslar, umarim iyi bir yardimci bulursun!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: I've lost the coupon, can I have another one please?
translation: Kuponu kaybettim, bir tane daha alabilir miyim lütfen?
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Have you placed the advert in the Varrock Herald yet?
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Not yet.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Don't wait too long, the purchase will go through soon!
translation: Çok bekleme, satin alma islemi yakinda gerçeklesecek!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: You can find Benny in the Varrock Square. You should talk to him about the ad.
translation: Benny'yi Varrock Meydani'nda bulabilirsin. Ilan hakkinda onunla konusmalisin.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: I'll go and do that now!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Could I have another coupon before I go? I lost the other one.
translation: Gitmeden önce baska bir kupon alabilir miyim? Digerini kaybettim.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: You don't need a coupon anymore!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Here is a copy of it. I made it before I gave you the original, try not to lose this!
translation: Iste bir kopyasi. Sana orijinalini vermeden önce yaptim, bunu kaybetmemeye çalis!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: How is it going?
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Well thanks, I've just placed the advert in the Herald.
translation: Tesekkürler, az önce Herald'a ilan verdim.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Lovely! Where are you meeting the candidates?
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: At the Blue Moon Inn, I'm going to head there now.
translation: Blue Moon Inn'de, simdi oraya gidiyorum.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Hi Brother Jered!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Hello [player name]. I thank you for helping us, we've been running out of ideas!
translation: Merhaba Maceraci. Bize yardim ettigin için tesekkürler, fikirlerimiz tükenmisti!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Hello! I saw an old lady sneaking around in the trees south of the monastery, that wouldn't be anything to do with you, would it?
translation: Merhaba! Manastirin güneyindeki agaçlarin arasinda gizlice dolasan yasli bir kadin gördüm, bu seninle bir ilgisi yok, degil mi?
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: That sounds like Iffie, she is my accomplice! I'd be careful calling her an old lady!
translation: Bu Iffie'ye benziyor, o benim suç ortagim! Ona yasli kadin demek için dikkatli olmalisin!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: You found somebody! Great, good luck!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: I'll make sure not to say that to her face if we meet!
translation: Eger karsilasirsak, bunu onun yüzüne söylemeyecegim!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: I hear Oziach has been scared, thank you! And thank your friend too.
translation: Oziach'in korktugunu duydum, tesekkürler! Arkadasina da tesekkür et.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Iffie? She helped a lot, I need to go and give her the reward I promised.
translation: Iffie mi? Çok yardimci oldu, gidip ona söz verdigim ödülü vermeliyim.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: You better go and do that then, thanks again!
translation: O zaman git ve bunu yap, tekrar tesekkürler!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Hello there!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Hello, Brother Jered!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Hello! I was just passing by and saw you both in here.
translation: Merhaba! Tam buradan geçiyordum ve ikinizi burada gördüm.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: I'd like to thank you Iffie, and you [player name]. You both saved the monastery.
translation: Iffie ve sana Maceraci tesekkür etmek istiyorum. Ikiniz de manastiri kurtardiniz.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: That means more than you can imagine!
translation: Bu, tahmin edebileceginden çok daha önemli!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: It was really no problem, if anything, it was rather fun!
translation: Hiç sorun degildi, aksine oldukça eglenceliydi!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Yes, very fun! I haven't had such an adventure in years!
translation: Evet, çok eglenceliydi! Yillardir böyle bir macera yasamamistim!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Well, I am glad you both enjoyed it! I do have something for you, [player name]...
translation: Ikinizin de eglendigine sevindim! Sana bir seyim var, Maceraci...
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: It's not a reward as such, but it is interesting. I've been tidying up my office since I don't need it anymore.
translation: Ödül sayilmaz ama ilginç bir sey. Artik ihtiyacim olmadigi için ofisimi düzenliyordum.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: And in doing so, I found this old bottle.
translation: Ve düzenlerken bu eski siseyi buldum.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Is that... a ghost, inside? It's haunted?!
translation: Içinde... hayalet mi var? Perili mi?!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Yes! There is a ghost inside, it's trapped! Would have been handy to have earlier on, really. Would have been very scary for Oziach!
translation: Evet! Içinde bir hayalet var, hapsolmus! Daha önce olsaydi çok isime yarardi. Oziach için çok korkutucu olurdu!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: But the monastery is saved, so I don't need it anymore. I'd like you to have it!
translation: Ama manastir kurtarildi, artik buna ihtiyacim yok. Sana vermek istiyorum!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Thank you. What do I do with it?
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Not a lot really. I did shake it earlier and the ghost got pretty angry with me, so I'd probably avoid doing that too much.
translation: Aslinda pek bir sey yapamazsin. Az önce salladim ve hayalet bana çok kizdi, o yüzden bunu çok fazla yapmamak daha iyi olur.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: It does seem quite chatty for a ghost, although it doesn't always make sense.
translation: Bir hayalet için oldukça konuskan, ama her zaman mantikli konusmuyor.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: There you go. Now I'll be off, I've got a monastery to look after!
translation: Iste oldu. Simdi gidiyorum, bakmam gereken bir manastir var!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: See you later Brother Jered!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Talk about the Halloween event.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)
source: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

translation: Benim gibi cesur bir maceraciya nasil yardim edebilirsin?
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)
source: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Praise be to Saradomin!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)
source: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Ask for another bottle.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)
source: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Yes, let's scare Oziach!
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)
source: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Not just yet.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)
source: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Talk about something else.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)
source: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: Ask for another ad coupon.
sub_category: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)
source: Dialogue for Brother Jered (2021 Halloween event)

english: A bug! Hahaha.
HAHAHAHAHA
...ahahaha
HA!
Ok... I'm done.
The bunny thinks you laughed at them and looks both angry and embarrassed.
translation: Tavsan, ona güldügünü düsünüyor ve hem kizgin hem de utanmis görünüyor.

english: Oh, sorry. I didn't mean to turn you into a... Hot cross bunny!
translation: Oh, üzgünüm. Seni bir... Sicak çörek tavsana dönüstürmek istemedim!

english: It's a bit rude of 'em to take up the whole bridge with their conversation, isn't it, mate?
translation: Köprünün tamamini konusmalariyla isgal etmeleri biraz kaba, degil mi dostum?

english: Aye, mate, but wouldn't it be just as rude for us to interrupt?
translation: Evet dostum, ama biz de onlari rahatsiz etmek kabalik olmaz mi?

english: A good point well made, mate. Who are we to decide that the dig is more impor'ant than a personal disagreement between two people?
translation: Iyi bir noktaya degindin dostum. Iki kisi arasindaki kisisel anlasmazliktan daha önemli olanin kazi oldugunu kim karar verebilir ki?

english: You're not wrong, mate. We often place matters of industry above those of people, and it's chippin' away at our ability to relate to each other on a human level.
translation: Haklisin dostum. Genellikle is meselelerini insan meselelerinin üstünde tutuyoruz ve bu da insan olarak birbirimizle iliski kurma yetenegimizi zedeliyor.

english: What's going on here?
We're part of a dig into some ruins beneath Cam Torum, but the way's blocked by these folks.
translation: Cam Torum'un altindaki bazi kalintilari kaziyoruz, ama yol bu insanlar tarafindan kapatilmis.

english: Have you tried asking them to move?
We're considering the moral implications of doing exactly that, mate.
Are you two philosophers?
No mate, builders.
But thinking, talking, discussing, it's what makes us human, mate.
translation: Ama düsünmek, konusmak, tartismak bizi insan yapan seydir dostum.

english: It's not just humans that do those things.
Fair play, mate. I guess we're reflecting more on the condition of sen'ience in general then.
translation: Haklisin dostum. Sanirim biz genel olarak bilinç durumunu daha çok düsünüyoruz....

english: Goodbye.
Have a good one, mate.
Thanks for that, mate. You should speak to Jess inside. She'll be in the north of the city. She could use a problem solver like yourself.
translation: Tesekkürler dostum. Içerideki Jess ile konusmalisin. Sehrin kuzeyinde olacak. Senin gibi bir problem çözücüye ihtiyaci var.

english: Who's Jess?
She's the archaeologist in charge of the dig into these ruins they've found. Discovering the mysteries of the past and that.
translation: Bulunan bu kalintilari kazmaktan sorumlu arkeolog. Geçmisin gizemlerini kesfediyor falan.

english: You should head inside, mate. Remember, Jess will be in the north of the city. She could use a problem solver like yourself.
translation: Içeri girmelisin dostum. Unutma, Jess sehrin kuzeyinde olacak. Senin gibi bir problem çözücüye ihtiyaci olabilir.

english: To me!
To you!
Keep it down!
G'day, mate.
I'm surprised to see you both in such high spirits after walking past all those jeering dwarves.
translation: O alayci cücelerin yanindan geçtikten sonra ikinizin de bu kadar neseli olmasina sasirdim.

english: Ah, well it's unfortunate, but no reason to be sad. It's them that ought to be sad.
translation: Ah, talihsiz bir durum, ama üzülmek için bir neden yok. Üzülmesi gereken onlar.

english: Aye, mate. Livin' a life unable to connect with others because they look different must be miserable.
translation: Evet, dostum. Farkli göründükleri için baskalariyla iletisim kuramayan bir hayat yasamak çok mutsuz edici olmali.

english: We wish 'em the best. Hopefully their paths to personal growth are near and smooth.
translation: Onlara en iyisini diliyoruz. Umarim kisisel gelisim yollari yakin ve pürüzsüzdür.

english: Thanks for taking care of those base camps, mate.
translation: Ana kamplarla ilgilendigin için tesekkürler dostum.

english: No problem. I hope there's no hard feelings over Jessamine asking me to do a part of your jobs.
translation: Sorun degil. Jessamine'in bana sizin islerinizin bir kismini yapmami istemesine kizmadiniz umarim.

english: That's no worries, mate, I've no issue admitting you're better cut out for building camps in dangerous dungeons than I am.
translation: Endiselenme dostum, tehlikeli zindanlarda kamp kurmak için benden daha uygun oldugunu kabul etmekte bir sorun yok.

english: We may not be mul'i-disciplined adventurers like you, but we don't need to be. The world needs more than just heroes, don't it?
translation: Sizin gibi çok yönlü maceracilar olmayabiliriz, ama olmamiza da gerek yok. Dünya sadece kahramanlara ihtiyaç duymaz, degil mi?

english: Aye, mate, I'm content and proud to just be a hard working, decent builder.
translation: Evet dostum, çaliskan, dürüst bir insaatçi olmaktan memnun ve gurur duyuyorum.

english: Besides, without us, building supplies wouldn't be there in the first place. Life's all about working together.
translation: Ayrica, biz olmasak, insaat malzemeleri de olmazdi. Hayat birlikte çalismaktan ibarettir.

english: Glad to hear it. Keep up the good work then!
translation: Bunu duyduguma sevindim. Iyi çalismaya devam et o zaman!

english: You too, mate.
You seem remarkably calm considering everything that's going on.
translation: Olan biten her seye ragmen oldukça sakin görünüyorsun.

english: Life's unpredictable, mate. No sense stressin' over what's out of your control.
translation: Hayat öngörülemez dostum. Kontrolün disinda olan seyler için stres yapmanin bir anlami yok.

english: It's not like we're not aware of the danger we're in, but worryin' about it ain't productive.
translation: Tehlikenin farkinda degiliz degil ama bunun için endiselenmek de bir ise yaramaz.

english: Shouldn't you be getting out of here if you feel like you're in danger?
translation: Tehlikede oldugunu düsünüyorsan buradan gitmen gerekmez mi?

english: We may not be in total control of our surroundings, but we can still impact them positively through our actions. Like bein' here to support you.
translation: Çevremizi tamamen kontrol edemiyor olabiliriz, ama yine de eylemlerimizle olumlu bir etki yaratabiliriz. Mesela burada olup sana destek olmak gibi.

english: Even if that's just emotionally. We believe in you, mate.
translation: Bu sadece duygusal bir destek olsa bile. Sana inaniyoruz dostum.

english: Thanks.
No worries, mate. Go get 'em.
translation: Merak etme dostum. Git ve hakla onlari.

english: I am a fool...
Well... yes, a bit.
You meant well. You thought you were helpin'. Can't fault you for that part, mate.
translation: Niyetin iyiydi. Yardim ettigini sandin. Bu konuda seni suçlayamayiz dostum.

english: You made a mistake. Coulda been any of us. Just gotta make sure we learn from our mistakes is all.
translation: Bir hata yaptin. Herhangi birimiz yapabilirdik. Sadece hatalarimizdan ders çikarmamiz gerekiyor, hepsi bu.

english: And if yer genuinely sorry, best you can do is work to be better, not mope around. So keep your chin up, mate!
translation: Ve gerçekten pismansan, yapabilecegin en iyi sey daha iyi olmak için çabalamak, somurtmak degil. O yüzden basini dik tut dostum!

english: Thank you...
What did you do, anyway?
I saw sun and moon runes on that thing. Recalled something from Ranul's teachings, a rite he once performed...
translation: O seyin üzerinde günes ve ay runeleri gördüm. Ranul'un ögretilerinden bir seyi hatirladim, bir zamanlar yaptigi bir ayini...

english: I tried to emulate it, and it worked. I thought I had freed his emissaries. But they weren't that at all...
translation: Onu taklit etmeye çalistim ve ise yaradi. Onun elçilerini kurtardigimi sandim. Ama onlar hiç de öyle degillerdi...

english: Interesting. Maybe there was some sort of connection between Ranul and this place after all.
translation: Ilginç. Belki de Ranul ile bu yer arasinda bir baglanti vardi.

english: Well, all's well that ends well.
We never had any doubts! Always knew you'd get it sorted, mate.
translation: Hiç süphemiz yoktu! Her seyi halledecegini biliyorduk dostum.

english: No worries, mate.
Good to see you again, mate.
Good to see you both as well. How's things?
translation: Sizi de görmek güzel. Nasil gidiyor?

english: Never better, mate. Never better. This here ruin was the find of the century!
translation: Her zamankinden iyi dostum. Her zamankinden iyi. Bu harabe yüzyilin kesfi oldu!

english: All credit to Jess, o'course, but we're glad to be doing our bit!
translation: Tabii ki tüm övgü Jess'e ait, ama biz de katkida bulunabildigimiz için mutluyuz!

english: Glad to hear it.
What's going on here?
Are you two philosophers?
Goodbye.
Hey, human.
Who are you?
Not much to say. Came to Weiss with other trolls when we got kicked out of caves further south, but I was just young troll then.
translation: Söyleyecek pek bir sey yok. Daha güneydeki magaralardan kovuldugumuzda diger trollerle birlikte Weiss'a geldim, ama o zamanlar ben daha genç bir trolüm.

english: Mostly been enjoying living round Weiss, 'cos wildlife is interesting here.
translation: Weiss'ta yasamaktan çogunlukla keyif aliyorum, çünkü buradaki vahsi yasam ilginç.

english: Tell me about this place.
This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: Burasi Weiss. Troller yillar önce, daha güneydeki magaralardan kovulduktan sonra burayi insa etti. Simdi Weiss bizim evimiz.

english: We done pretty good here. Got lots of goat and wolf to eat - they taste kinda boring after all this time, but there not much other choice.
translation: Burada oldukça iyi durumdayiz. Yemek için bolca keçi ve kurt var - bunca zaman sonra tadi biraz sikici geliyor, ama baska seçenegimiz yok.

english: Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it. In fact My Arm is an expert on growing the stuff.
translation: Goutweed denedin mi hiç? Onu seven troller taniyorum. Aslinda My Arm bu bitkinin yetistirilmesinde uzmandir.

english: Never heard of no gouty weed, no. But it sound like a vegetable, an' Mother not like eating those, so we probably not gonna try it.
translation: Gouty weed diye bir sey duymadim, hayir. Ama sebzeye benziyor ve annem sebze yemeyi sevmez, o yüzden muhtemelen denemeyecegiz.

english: Mother not like new ideas much, but he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: Annem yeni fikirleri pek sevmez, ama o çok büyük ve patron, bu yüzden ne derse onu yapariz.

english: I see.
Do you like it here?
Eh, it kinda rough, but it our home. Odd Mushroom say he can make it nicer with fancy fires what he invented, but Mother not interested in that, so Odd Mushroom not allowed to do it.
translation: Eh, biraz zorlu, ama burasi bizim evimiz. Odd Mushroom, icat ettigi süslü ateslerle burayi daha güzel hale getirebilecegini söylüyor, ama annem bununla ilgilenmiyor, bu yüzden Odd Mushroom bunu yapamiyor.

english: Mother only care about stuff to help him fight better. An he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: Annem sadece onun daha iyi savasmasina yardimci olacak seylerle ilgileniyor. O çok büyük ve patron, bu yüzden ne derse onu yapiyoruz.

english: I'll be off.
Hey, friend of Snowflake!
It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: Burasi harika, simdi Snowflake ve kocasi troll bize goutweed yetistirmeyi ögretti. Yemekler artik çok daha lezzetli.

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: Eh, biraz zor ama gittikçe daha iyi oluyor. Snowflake bize goutweed yetistirmeyi ögretti. Keçi, kurt, insan, goutweed ile çok daha lezzetli oluyor.

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: Evet, Weiss yasamak için iyi bir yer, artik Snowflake sorumlu. Tüm troller Snowflake'i sever. Kocasi biraz tuhaf ama bu bizim sorunumuz degil.

english: Who are you?
Tell me about this place.
Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it.
translation: Goutweed denedin mi hiç? Onu seven troller taniyorum.

english: Do you like it here?
I'll be off.
I see.
Who are you?
I'm an employee of Keldagrim Carts. I make sure the carts in this area run on time and that people pay their fares.
translation: Keldagrim Carts'in çalisaniyim. Bu bölgedeki arabalarin zamaninda çalismasini ve insanlarin ücretlerini ödemesini sagliyorum.

english: Where can you take me?
I don't think I'm allowed to take you into the city of Keldagrim, human. Perhaps when you find another way into the city and talk to someone of importance there you will be allowed to.
translation: Seni Keldagrim sehrine götürmeme izin verilmedigini saniyorum, insan. Belki sehre baska bir yoldan girip orada önemli biriyle konusursan izin verilir.

english: This track leads right up to Keldagrim. Only stop.
translation: Bu yol Keldagrim'e gidiyor. Durun lütfen.

english: I'd like to buy a ticket.
One ticket to Keldagrim, that's 150 coins then.
I'm sorry, I've run out of money.
I'm sorry, sir, but I don't believe you can hold the ticket.
translation: Üzgünüm efendim, ama bileti alabileceginizi sanmiyorum.

english: Thanks for your custom!
No thanks, I changed my mind.
This is only 75 coins, I can't let you have a ticket for that.
translation: Bu sadece 75 sikke, bu parayla bilet alamazsiniz.

english: Oh, don't worry. I'll pay you another 75 coins for the next ticket I buy, alright?
translation: Oh, merak etmeyin. Bir sonraki bilet için size 75 sikke daha ödeyecegim, tamam mi?

english: Well... I suppose so.
I have to go.
Just remember, wherever you go, you go there faster through Keldagrim Carts.
translation: Unutma, nereye gidersen git, Keldagrim Arabalari ile daha hizli gidersin.

english: I can't take you anywhere at the moment.
translation: Su anda seni hiçbir yere götüremem.

english: I can't sell any more tickets right now, I'm afraid.

I'd like to buy a ticket.
Buy.

I have to go.

english: The camera fades to black. In a cutscene, Gregg is seen hopping inside the fenced lumberyard.
translation: Kamera karartilir. Bir kesit sahnesinde, Gregg çitlerle çevrili kereste deposuna atlayarak girer.

english: Ok, let's find some planks...
A sound of a cat purring is heard. A brown adult cat comes from behind a wall two tiles right (east) of Gregg.
translation: Bir kedinin mirildanma sesi duyulur. Kahverengi bir yetiskin kedi, Gregg'in iki karo saginda (dogusunda) bulunan bir duvarin arkasindan çikar.

english: Meow!
Aha! There we go!
A sound of the cat meowing is heard.
Meow.
Oh! A kitty cat!
Sorry, kitty, I don't have any treats.
Would you like pets instead? I can do pets!
translation: Onun yerine sevmek ister misin? Sevebilirim!

english: Gregg moves closer to pet the cat. The cat makes an audible hiss and scratches towards Gregg.
translation: Gregg kediyi oksamak için yaklasir. Kedi duyulabilir bir tislama sesi çikarir ve Gregg'e dogru tirmalamaya baslar.

english: Hissss!
Aaaah!
Nice kitty...?
The cat makes an audible hiss and scratches towards Gregg again. Gregg starts fleeing left (west), while the adult cat chases him.
translation: Kedi duyulabilir bir tislama sesi çikarir ve Gregg'e dogru tekrar tirmalamaya baslar. Gregg sola (batiya) kaçmaya baslar, yetiskin kedi ise onu kovalar.

english: Not nice kitty! Not nice kitty!
translation: Uslu kedi degil! Uslu kedi degil!

english: The camera pans right and fades to black again. After a fade-out, the camera is set back to the world in front of the lumberyard with the player and Gregg.
translation: Kamera saga kayar ve tekrar karartilir. Karartmanin ardindan kamera, oyuncu ve Gregg'in bulundugu kereste deposunun önündeki dünyaya geri döner.

english: You pet the cat...
The cat softly purrs between snores.
translation: Kedi horlamalar arasinda yumusak bir sekilde mirildanir.

english: Hmm... Oh yes, that's purrfect.....
Zzz
Miaoww!
What is this place?
It's a desolate, sad place... The peoples here seldom feed me - take me with you!
translation: Burasi issiz, üzücü bir yer... Buradaki insanlar bana nadiren yemek veriyorlar - beni de yanina al!

english: I'm sorry, I can't take you with me, but I will help if I can.
translation: Üzgünüm, seni yanima alamam, ama elimden geldigince yardim ederim.

english: How are you doing?
Not well, I have to ssssssay, but you look healthy. I wish I were healthy like you.
translation: Iyi degilim, ama sen saglikli görünüyorsun. Keske ben de senin gibi saglikli olsaydim.

english: What's that awful smell?
*Sniff, sniff* I don't think it's me. All I can smell is dirty vyrewatches tithing the poor humans.
translation: *Kokla, kokla* Benden geldigini sanmiyorum. Tek kokladigim sey, zavalli insanlari sömüren kirli vyrewatch'lar.

english: How long have you been here?
As long as I can remember. So far we've not found any way out of this place, and after all, we couldn't leave these poor humans to fend for themselves.
translation: Hatirlayabildigim kadariyla. Simdiye kadar buradan çikmanin bir yolunu bulamadik ve sonuçta bu zavalli insanlari kendi baslarina birakamazdik.

english: Okay, thanks.
What is this place?
How are you doing?
What's that awful smell?
How long have you been here?
Okay, thanks.
Meow.
Hello puss.
Want a mouse?
No thanks.
Want this half dead bird?
translation: Bu yari ölü kusu ister misin?

english: Errrr... no.
Want this crunched up spider?
Um... not really.
Oh well. Got any tuna?
No.
Hmmmph.
Why yes I do have some tuna.
Give! *purr*
Catch toad for me.
What? I think not...
Nah... my tuna.
Hissss...
Give a tuna to the cat.
Keep the tuna for yourself.
How can you see properly with such tiny little eyes?
translation: Bu kadar küçük gözlerle nasil düzgün görebiliyorsun?

english: Ooh! Are you [player name]?
Yes.
Everyone's talking about how you helped Zanik save the city! You're a hero!
translation: Herkes Zanik'in sehri kurtarmasina yardim ettiginizi konusuyor! Siz bir kahramansiniz!

english: Have you visited the market? There are visitors selling foods from all over the surface there. It's so exotic!
translation: Pazari ziyaret ettiniz mi? Orada yüzeyden gelen ziyaretçiler çesitli yiyecekler satiyorlar. Çok egzotik!

english: Well, I suppose it wouldn't be exotic for you, since you're from the surface.
translation: Tabii, yüzeyden geldiginiz için sizin için egzotik olmayabilir.

english: But you should check it out anyway. Maybe you could sell some of your food. Everyone's crazy about surface food at the moment.
translation: Ama yine de bir göz atmalisiniz. Belki kendi yiyeceklerinizi satabilirsiniz. Su anda herkes yüzeydeki yiyeceklere bayiliyor.

english: So, what do you think of our city, surface-dweller?
translation: Peki, sehrimiz hakkinda ne düsünüyorsun, yüzey sakini?

english: I like it!
That, surface-dweller, was the right answer.
I think it's rubbish.
Well, it beats crawling around on the surface with nothing above your head!
translation: En azindan yüzeyde basinin üstünde hiçbir sey olmadan sürünmekten iyidir!

english: What's it like on the surface? It sounds scary to me, having nothing above my head.
translation: Yüzeyde yasamak nasil bir sey? Basimin üstünde hiçbir sey olmamasi bana korkutucu geliyor.

english: It's alright.
I'm still not sure it would be for me, though.
translation: Yine de benim için uygun oldugunu sanmiyorum.

english: It's not all that great.
Never mind, you can stay down here now!
What do you think you're doing?
Stuns the player, dealing 1 damage.
Help! A thief!
I like it!
I think it's rubbish.
It's alright.
It's not all that great.
Oh dear, oh dear. I hope this dwarf train works properly!
translation: Oh hayir, oh hayir. Umarim bu cüce treni düzgün çalisir!

english: Look, everyone! It's [player name]!
Everyone's talking about how you rescued Zanik! You're the city's hero again!
translation: Herkes Zanik'i kurtardigini konusuyor! Yine sehrin kahramani oldun!

english: Visiting Keldagrim is so exciting! I never thought I'd be so far from Dorgesh-Kaan in my life!
translation: Keldagrim'i ziyaret etmek çok heyecan verici! Hayatimda Dorgesh-Kaan'dan bu kadar uzak olacagimi hiç düsünmemistim!

english: These dwarves have so much more advanced technology than us. Look at this train! We could never build something like this.
translation: Bu cüceler bizimkinden çok daha gelismis bir teknolojiye sahipler. Su trene bak! Biz asla böyle bir sey yapamayiz.

english: Keldagrim's very nice to visit, but I don't think I'd want to live there.
translation: Keldagrim'i ziyaret etmek çok güzel, ama orada yasamak istemezdim.

english: Hello.
Who are you?
Charlie Windar, natural historian, at your service [sir/madam]
What do you do?

I study the marvelous creatures and plants that are here on this island. There appears to have been a much higher rate of evolution here than on the mainland. I suspect an outside influence from something.
translation: Bu adada bulunan muhtesem canlilari ve bitkileri inceliyorum. Buradaki evrim hizi anakaraya göre çok daha yüksek görünüyor. Disaridan bir etki oldugunu düsünüyorum.

english: We're exploring this island.
What have you found?
Several very interesting species of fungi and insects so far. But I haven't wandered much beyond the camp yet.
translation: Su ana kadar çok ilginç mantar ve böcek türleri buldum. Ama henüz kampin çok uzagina gitmedim.

english: Well, I guess so.
Argghghhh!
Hey, don't be scared, I just want to talk to you.
translation: Hey, korkma, sadece seninle konusmak istiyorum.

english: Leave me alone!
Sorry but I need to ask a couple of questions.
translation: Üzgünüm ama birkaç soru sormam gerekiyor.

english: Get off me! I haven't got anything!
Hey, calm down, I'm not going to hurt you. I just want to ask a few questions.
translation: Hey, sakin ol, sana zarar vermeyecegim. Sadece birkaç soru sormak istiyorum.

english: What do you do here?
I'm not supposed to talk to strangers, and you sure are strange...
translation: Yabancilarla konusmamam gerekiyor ve sen kesinlikle bir yabancisin...

english: Nuffin'! I wasn't doin' nuffin'!
I 'elp wiv building fings an' da wall. But mainly I is hiding from da vyresies. I don't like dem vyresies.
translation: Seyleri ve duvari insa etmeye yardim ediyorum. Ama esas olarak virüslerden saklaniyorum. Virüsleri sevmiyorum.

english: I was playin', but den da flapsies came so I was hidin'. Don't want da flapsies to bit me.
translation: Oynuyordum, ama sonra kanatlilar geldi, ben de saklandim. Kanatlilarin beni isirmasini istemiyorum.

english: I'm lost, can you help me?
Urm, well I fink we're in sector [one/two/three/six]. Not sure what else to say. I'm only a kid ya know!
Do you know about the Myreque?
Err, me dad says I'm not allowed to talk about that. Do you have any sweets?
translation: Sey, babam bu konu hakkinda konusmami yasakladi. Sekerin var mi?

english: No, sorry, but please can you answer my questions?
translation: Hayir, üzgünüm, ama lütfen sorularimi cevaplar misin?

english: (whisper) Do you know about the Myreque?
Err, no! I'm not allowed to say any thingies about dem; but they're the good 'uns what can help us.
translation: Sey, hayir! Onlar hakkinda hiçbir sey söyleyemem, ama onlar bize yardim edebilecek iyi insanlar.

english: Okay, thanks.
What do you do here?
I'm lost, can you help me?
Do you know about the Myreque?
(whisper) Do you know about the Myreque?
Okay, thanks.
Hello there. How's it going?
I'm not allowed to talk to your kind.

Squeak!
It's nice to meet you here, [player name].
Who were you?

I'm Chuck. I used to exchange logs for certificates, so people could trade them in bulk more conveniently. Certificates were what we used before banks automatically issued banknotes for most tradeable items.
translation: Ben Chuck. Eskiden kütükleri sertifikalarla degistirirdim, böylece insanlar bunlari toplu olarak daha kolay takas edebilirdi. Sertifikalar, bankalar çogu takas edilebilir ürün için otomatik olarak banknot basmaya baslamadan önce kullandigimiz seydi.

english: Even today, banknotes are sometimes referred to as 'certs', in memory of the certificates we used before.
translation: Bugün bile, banknotlar bazen eskiden kullandigimiz sertifikalarin anisina “sert” olarak adlandirilir.

english: I had colleagues who'd exchange other items for certificates - Niles, Miles and Giles were the most famous of us. But those three found new jobs rather than retiring like I did.
translation: Diger ürünleri sertifikalarla degistiren meslektaslarim vardi - Niles, Miles ve Giles aramizda en ünlüleriydi. Ama bu üçü benim gibi emekli olmak yerine yeni isler buldular.

english: Do you think you might leave the Realm?

Who are you?
My name is Clerk. I work on gathering people together to form what we call clans.
translation: Adim Clerk. Insanlari bir araya getirip klan dedigimiz gruplar olusturmakla ugrasiyorum.

english: What is a clan?
Ah, clans. Where do I begin? Clans are groups of people gathered together for numerous reasons. Usually they have shared interests, like activities they enjoy together.
translation: Ah, klanlar. Nereden baslasam? Klanlar, çesitli nedenlerle bir araya gelen insan gruplaridir. Genellikle ortak ilgi alanlari vardir, örnegin birlikte yaptiklari aktiviteler.

english: These activities could include improving certain skills, battling the same monsters, or even battling other clans!
translation: Bu aktiviteler arasinda belirli becerileri gelistirmek, ayni canavarlarla savasmak, hatta diger klanlarla savasmak da olabilir!

english: Other clans form together because they just enjoy the company of other like-minded people. The clan community can be a great resource if you should ever need help with anything.
translation: Diger klanlar ise sadece benzer düsünen insanlarla birlikte olmaktan keyif aldiklari için bir araya gelirler. Klan toplulugu, herhangi bir konuda yardima ihtiyaciniz oldugunda harika bir kaynak olabilir.

english: How do I join a clan?
You can either form your own clan with your friends, or apply to an already existing clan.
translation: Arkadaslarinizla kendi klaninizi kurabilir veya mevcut bir klana basvurabilirsiniz.

english: Should you choose to form your own clan you will need four friends to join you, and it is recommended that you have spent a good amount of time in this world first. Leadership is not for everyone.
translation: Kendi klaninizi kurmayi seçerseniz, size katilacak dört arkadasa ihtiyaciniz olacak ve önce bu dünyada yeterince zaman geçirmis olmaniz önerilir. Liderlik herkese göre degildir.

english: However, fret not. There are plenty of interesting and exciting clans out there! Check out the clan recruitment board to see which clans are currently accepting applications.
translation: Ancak endiselenmeyin. Disarida birçok ilginç ve heyecan verici klan var! Klan üye alim panosuna bakarak su anda basvuru kabul eden klanlari görebilirsiniz.

english: What can a clan offer me?
Clans offer you the ability to have an official gathering of friends or like-minded individuals in a hierarchical structure.
translation: Klanlar, hiyerarsik bir yapi içinde arkadaslarinizla veya benzer düsüncelere sahip kisilerle resmi bir toplanti yapma imkani sunar.

english: In other words, you and your friends get an exclusive chat channel and a Clan Hall, as well as the ability to assign ranks to members.
translation: Diger bir deyisle, siz ve arkadaslariniz özel bir sohbet kanali ve Klan Salonu'na sahip olursunuz, ayrica üyelere rütbe atayabilirsiniz.

english: Ranks can be assigned from custom pre-sets, which then determine what permissions that person has.
translation: Rütbeler, o kisinin sahip oldugu izinleri belirleyen özel ön ayarlardan atanabilir.

english: For example: One person may have the rank to kick players from the chat, while another has the rank to access the Clan Coffer.
translation: Örnegin: Bir kisi sohbetten oyunculari atma rütbesine sahipken, baska bir kisi Klan Kasasina erisim rütbesine sahip olabilir.

english: What is the Clan Coffer?
The Clan Coffer is a shared coin store, used by members of the clan. Highly ranked members can assign who has permission to deposit and withdraw coins.
translation: Klan Kasasi, klan üyeleri tarafindan kullanilan ortak bir para deposudur. Yüksek rütbeli üyeler, para yatirma ve çekme iznine sahip kisileri atayabilir.

english: What is a Clan Hall?

A Clan Hall is a private area only accessible for the people with the permission to enter. High ranked members of the clan can restrict it to only allow certain ranks in, or open it up to even allow guests.
translation: Klan Salonu, giris izni olan kisilerin erisebilecegi özel bir alandir. Klanin yüksek rütbeli üyeleri, bu alani yalnizca belirli rütbelere izin verecek sekilde kisitlayabilir veya misafirlere bile açabilir.

english: Why would I need a Clan Hall? Can't I get a house instead?
translation: Klan Salonu'na neden ihtiyacim olsun? Bunun yerine bir ev alamaz miyim?

english: The beauty of it is that you can have both. You can keep your house for private guests and your own personal use, but when you wish to see larger groups then the Clan Hall may be more fitting.
translation: Bunun güzelligi, ikisine de sahip olabilmenizdir. Evinizi özel misafirleriniz ve kisisel kullaniminiz için saklayabilirsiniz, ancak daha büyük gruplari görmek istediginizde Klan Salonu daha uygun olabilir.

english: What do you do here?
My mission is to administer clans; I help form them and can tell you anything you need to know about them.
translation: Benim görevim klanlari yönetmek; klanlarin kurulmasina yardimci olurum ve klanlar hakkinda bilmeniz gereken her seyi size anlatabilirim.

english: Sure, but why are you here specifically?
Why does anyone go anywhere? As a gatherer of people, I go where people gather. The Grand Exchange is known to be a place where people come together. What better place to bring them even closer?
translation: Neden insanlar herhangi bir yere gider? Insanlari bir araya getiren biri olarak, insanlarin toplandigi yerlere giderim. Grand Exchange, insanlarin bir araya geldigi bir yer olarak bilinir. Onlari daha da yakinlastirmak için daha iyi bir yer olabilir mi?

english: I suppose this usually is a crowded place.
translation: Burasi genellikle kalabalik bir yer sanirim.

english: Very much so. I was lucky to find this charming corner to set up the clan hub.
translation: Çok kalabalik. Klan merkezini kurmak için bu büyüleyici köseyi buldugum için sansliyim.

english: What's the clan hub?
The clan hub is what I call this area, my little corner of the Grand Exchange. This is where every clan is born, as well as the best place to look for new recruits.
translation: Klan merkezi, Grand Exchange'deki benim küçük köseme verdigim isim. Burasi her klanin dogdugu yer ve yeni üyeler aramak için en iyi yer.

english: If you're in a clan you can also access your Clan Hall from here.
translation: Bir klana üyeyseniz, buradan Klan Salonuna da erisebilirsiniz.

english: I'm in a clan. Can you give me anything?
translation: Ben bir klana üyeyim. Bana bir sey verebilir misin?

english: I've got cloaks that let you show your clan's colours, and vexilla to help you recruit more people into your clan, but you don't have space to take any.
translation: Klaninin renklerini göstermen için pelerinlerim ve klana daha fazla üye kazanmana yardimci olacak bayraklarim var, ama bunlari alabilecek yerin yok.

english: How dare you? I put a lot of effort into cleaning this kitchen. My daily sweat and elbow-grease keep this kitchen clean!
translation: Bu ne cüret? Bu mutfagi temizlemek için çok ugrastim. Her gün ter döküp emek harcayarak bu mutfagi temiz tutuyorum!

english: Ewww!
Oh, just leave me alone.
Very well done, take this.
Can you sell me any food?
Alright, I'll buy a cabbage.
No thanks, I don't like cabbage.
