I don't want anything from this horrible kitchen.
translation: Bu korkunç mutfaktan hiçbir sey istemiyorum.

english: Hello...
I distinctly remember you saying you were going to stop talking to me. Yet here you are again, yakking on and on in my earhole when I'm trying to cook! What do you want now?
translation: Bana konusmayacagini söyledigini çok iyi hatirliyorum. Yine de, ben yemek pisirmeye çalisirken kulak deligime durmadan konusuyorsun! Simdi ne istiyorsun?

english: What do you want? I'm busy!
Can you cook me something?
What? No! Go away.
Well, you're meant to be a cook. Why can't you cook something for me?
translation: Sen asçi olmalisin. Neden bana bir seyler pisiremiyorsun?

english: I don't want to, that's why! Now, leave me alone.
translation: Istemiyorum, o yüzden! Simdi beni rahat birak.

english: You're not a very nice man.
translation: Sen pek iyi bir insan degilsin.

english: Yet you keep talking to me!
translation: Yine de benimle konusmaya devam ediyorsun!

english: Good point. I should stop that.
Yes, do us both a favour.
translation: Evet, ikimize de bir iyilik yap.

english: Why do you work here?
Why do you think I work in a disreputable inn filled with rough scoundrels on the very edge of the Wilderness? I work here because I need the job!
translation: Neden vahsi doganin kenarinda, kaba saba haydutlarla dolu, itibarsiz bir handa çalistigimi saniyorsun? Burada çalisiyorum çünkü ise ihtiyacim var!

english: Do you like it?
Like it? It's sucked the warmth and humanity out of me, and I've become a hollow shell holding nothing but anger, misery and gourmet recipes.
translation: Hosuma gitmek mi? Benden sicakligimi ve insanligimi emdi ve ben sadece öfke, sefalet ve gurme tariflerinden ibaret bos bir kabuk haline geldim.

english: Oh.
What did you expect to hear? I suppose you expected me to tell you an inspiring story about how working here can teach you to find hope in the darkest places, or how to see the best in everything?
translation: Ne duymayi bekliyordun? Sanirim burada çalismanin en karanlik yerlerde bile umut bulmayi ögrettigini ya da her seyin en iyi yanini görmeyi ögrettigini anlatan ilham verici bir hikaye anlatmami bekliyordun?

english: Maybe you should think about moving to a different inn.
translation: Belki de baska bir hana tasinmayi düsünmelisin.

english: Bah! I'm not letting it defeat me. Now, let me concentrate on my cooking.
translation: Bah! Bunun beni yenmesine izin vermeyecegim. Simdi, yemek pisirmeye konsantre olmama izin ver.

english: Okay.
Can you tell me any good jokes?
translation: Bana iyi bir fikra anlatabilir misin?

english: Ohhh, if you insist...
What did the half-wit say to the cook?
I don't know.
[He/She] said 'Can you tell me any good jokes?' Got ya! Hahahaha!
translation: O “Bana iyi bir fikra anlatabilir misin?” dedi. Yakaladim! Hahahaha!

english: Whatever.
Can you cook me something?
Why do you work here?
Can you tell me any good jokes?
translation: Bana iyi bir fikra anlatir misin?

english: What am I to do?
What's wrong?
Oh dear, oh dear, oh dear, I'm in a terrible terrible mess! It's the Duke's birthday today, and I should be making him a lovely big birthday cake.
translation: Aman Tanrim, aman Tanrim, aman Tanrim, basim büyük belada! Bugün Dük'ün dogum günü ve ona güzel bir dogum günü pastasi yapmam gerekiyor.

english: I've forgotten to buy the ingredients. I'll never get them in time now. He'll sack me! What will I do? I have four children and a goat to look after. Would you help me? Please?
translation: Malzemeleri almayi unutmusum. Artik zamaninda yetisemeyecegim. Beni kovacak! Ne yapacagim? Bakmam gereken dört çocugum ve bir keçim var. Bana yardim eder misin? Lütfen?

english: Yes, I'll help you.
Oh thank you, thank you. I need milk, an egg and flour. I'd be very grateful if you can get them for me.
translation: Oh tesekkürler, tesekkürler. Süt, yumurta ve un lazim. Bunlari benim için alirsan çok minnettar olurum.

english: I have all of those ingredients on me already!
translation: Bu malzemelerin hepsi bende var zaten!

english: That's an odd coincidence... Were you planning on making a cake too?
translation: Ne garip bir tesadüf... Sen de pasta mi yapacaktin?

english: Not exactly. I just had an odd feeling you might be needing these ingredients. If I see a cook, I presume there's food of some kind! Lucky guess I suppose.
translation: Tam olarak degil. Sadece bu malzemelere ihtiyacin olabilecegini hissettim. Bir asçi görürsem, bir çesit yemek oldugunu varsayarim! Sanirim sansli bir tahmin.

english: Well thank you! Hand them over, please.
You've brought me everything I need! I am saved! Thank you!
translation: Ihtiyacim olan her seyi getirmissin! Kurtuldum! Tesekkürler!

english: So do I get to go to the Duke's Party?
I'm afraid not, only the big cheeses get to dine with the Duke.
translation: Korkarim ki hayir, sadece önemli kisiler Dük ile yemek yiyebilir.

english: Well, maybe one day I'll be important enough to sit on the Duke's table.
translation: Belki bir gün Dük'ün masasina oturacak kadar önemli biri olurum.

english: Maybe, but I won't be holding my breath.
translation: Belki, ama ben olsam çok umutlanmazdim.

english: So where do I find these ingredients then?
There is a Mill fairly close, go North and then West. Mill Lane Mill is just off the road to Draynor. I usually get my flour from there.
translation: Yakinlarda bir degirmen var, kuzeye ve sonra batiya git. Mill Lane Degirmeni, Draynor yolunun hemen yaninda. Unumu genellikle oradan alirim.

english: Talk to Millie, she'll help, she's a lovely girl and a fine Miller. Make sure you take a pot with you for the flour though, you've got one on you already.
translation: Millie ile konus, sana yardim eder, çok sevimli bir kiz ve iyi bir degirmenci. Un için bir kap götürmeyi unutma, yaninda zaten bir tane var.

english: Talk to Millie, she'll help, she's a lovely girl and a fine Miller. Make sure you take a pot with you for the flour though, there should be one on the table in here.
translation: Millie ile konus, sana yardim eder, çok sevimli bir kiz ve iyi bir degirmenci. Un için bir kap götürmeyi unutma, burada masada bir tane olmali.

english: There is a cattle field on the other side of the river, just across the road from the Groats' Farm.
translation: Nehrin diger tarafinda, Groats Çiftligi'nin karsisindaki yolda bir sigir tarlasi var.

english: Talk to Gillie Groats, she looks after the Dairy cows - she'll tell you everything you need to know about milking cows!
translation: Gillie Groats ile konus, o süt ineklerine bakiyor, sana inek sagmakla ilgili bilmen gereken her seyi anlatacaktir!

english: You'll need an empty bucket for the milk itself. I do see you've got a bucket with you already luckily!
translation: Süt için bos bir kovaya ihtiyacin olacak. Neyse ki yaninda bir kova var!

english: You'll need an empty bucket for the milk itself. The general store just north of the castle will sell you one for a couple of coins.
translation: Süt için bos bir kovaya ihtiyacin olacak. Kalenin hemen kuzeyindeki genel magazadan birkaç sikke karsiliginda bir tane satin alabilirsin.

english: I normally get my eggs from the Groats' farm, on the other side of the river.
translation: Yumurtalari genellikle nehrin diger tarafindaki Groats Çiftligi'nden alirim.

english: But any chicken should lay eggs.
translation: Ama herhangi bir tavuk yumurta yumurtlayabilir.

english: I've got all the information I need. Thanks.
translation: Ihtiyacim olan tüm bilgileri aldim. Tesekkürler.

english: Actually, I know where to find this stuff.
translation: Aslinda, bu malzemeleri nerede bulabilecegimi biliyorum.

english: No, I don't feel like it. Maybe later.
Fine. I always knew you Adventurer types were callous beasts. Go on your merry way!
translation: Peki. Maceraci tiplerin kalpsiz canavarlar oldugunu hep biliyordum. Keyfine bak!

english: You're a cook, why don't you bake me a cake?
translation: Sen asçisin, neden bana pasta yapmiyorsun?

english: *sniff* Don't talk to me about cakes...
You don't look very happy.
No, I'm not. The world is caving in around me - I am overcome by dark feelings of impending doom.
translation: Hayir, degilim. Dünya etrafimda çöküyor - yaklasan kiyametin karanlik duygulari beni ele geçiriyor.

english: I'd take the rest of the day off if I were you.
translation: Senin yerinde olsam günün geri kalaninda izin alirdim.

english: No, that's the worst thing I could do. I'd get in terrible trouble.
translation: Hayir, bu yapabilecegim en kötü sey olur. Basim büyük belaya girer.

english: Well maybe you need to take a holiday...
That would be nice, but the Duke doesn't allow holidays for core staff.
translation: Bu iyi olurdu, ama Dük çekirdek kadroya tatil izni vermiyor.

english: Hmm, why not run away to the sea and start a new life as a Pirate?
translation: Hmm, neden denize kaçip korsan olarak yeni bir hayata baslamiyorsun?

english: My wife gets sea sick, and I have an irrational fear of eyepatches. I don't see it working myself.
translation: Karim deniz tutar ve ben göz bandindan irrasyonel bir korku duyuyorum. Bunun ise yarayacagini sanmiyorum.

english: I'm afraid I've run out of ideas.
I know I'm doomed.
Nice hat!
Err thank you. It's a pretty ordinary cooks hat really.
translation: Tesekkürler. Aslinda oldukça siradan bir asçi sapkasi.

english: Still, suits you. The trousers are pretty special too.
translation: Yine de sana yakisiyor. Pantolon da oldukça özel.

english: Its all standard cook's issue uniform...
The whole hat, apron, stripey trousers ensemble - it works. It make you lookslike a real cook.
translation: Sapka, önlük, çizgili pantolon kombinasyonu çok yakismis. Seni gerçek bir asçi gibi gösteriyor.

english: I am a real cook! I haven't got time to be chatting about Culinary Fashion. I am in desperate need of help!
translation: Ben gerçek bir asçiyim! Asçilik modasi hakkinda sohbet edecek vaktim yok. Acil yardima ihtiyacim var!

english: How are you getting on with finding the ingredients?
I haven't got any of them yet, I'm still looking.
Please get the ingredients quickly. I'm running out of time! The Duke will throw me into the streets!
translation: Lütfen malzemeleri çabuk bul. Zamanim azaliyor! Dük beni sokaga atacak!

english: I'll get right on it.
Here's a bucket of milk.
Here's a pot of flour.
Here's a fresh egg.
Thanks for the ingredients you have got so far. Please get the rest quickly - I'm running out of time! The Duke will throw me into the streets!
translation: Simdiye kadar buldugun malzemeler için tesekkürler. Lütfen geri kalanini da çabuk bul - zamanim azaliyor! Dük beni sokaga atacak!

english: How is the adventuring going, my friend?
I don't have anything for you to do right now, sorry.
translation: Su anda sana verecek bir isim yok, üzgünüm.

english: I am getting strong and mighty. Grrr
Glad to hear it.
I keep on dying.
Ah well, at least you keep coming back to life!
Can I use your range?
Go ahead - it's a very good range. It's easier to use than most other ranges.
translation: Tabii, kullanabilirsin. Çok iyi bir ocak. Diger ocaklara göre kullanimi daha kolaydir.

english: Its called the Cook-o-matic 100. It uses a combination of state of the art temperature regulation and magic.
translation: Adi Cook-o-matic 100. En son teknoloji sicaklik düzenleme sistemi ve sihirli özellikleri bir arada kullaniyor.

english: Will it mean my food will burn less often?
translation: Yani yemeklerim daha az yanacak mi?

english: Well, that's what the salesman told us anyway...
Thanks?
Hey, who said you could use that?
Hello Cook. The Easter Bunny has run out of fuel for his egg making machine and has sent me to ask you for a favour.
translation: Merhaba Cook. Paskalya Tavsani'nin yumurta yapma makinesinin yakiti bitti ve benden sana bir iyilik yapmani istemek için beni gönderdi.

english: I am listening.
Do you by chance have any Hosidius milk? The Easter Bunny needs some to make the fuel.
translation: Hosidius sütün var mi? Paskalya Tavsani yakit yapmak için birazina ihtiyaç duyuyor.

english: I may have some lying around the kitchen, I would gladly give you some milk for the Easter Bunny.
translation: Mutfakta biraz olabilir, Paskalya Tavsani için seve seve sana biraz süt veririm.

english: But first you must answer a riddle. If you get it right, I will give you some Hosidius milk.
translation: Ama önce bir bilmeceyi çözmelisin. Dogru cevap verirsen, sana Hosidius sütü veririm.

english: I would be glad to answer a riddle for you.
Are you ready to answer my riddle?
Yes I am ready, crack out your riddle.
I leave my home only once a year, but do not give any Christmas cheer. Who am I?
translation: Yilda sadece bir kez evimden çikarim, ama Noel nesesi vermiyorum. Ben kimim?

english: I am sorry but that is not quite right.
translation: Üzgünüm, ama bu tam olarak dogru degil.

english: Talk to me when you're ready to try again.
translation: Tekrar denemeye hazir oldugunda bana gel.

english: Congratulations, that's the right answer.
Here is the Hosidius milk I promised.
translation: Iste sana söz verdigim Hosidius sütü.

english: You receive a bottle of Hosidius milk
Filling me with eggs is bad... but I'll make a case for it.
translation: Beni yumurtayla doldurmak kötüdür... ama bunun için bir nedenim var.

english: When dark and bitter, drink me warm in the winter.
translation: Karanlik ve aci oldugunda, kisin beni ilik iç.

english: I am round, yet not a perfect sphere. I can be cracked and not have anything inside. What am I?
translation: Yuvarlakim, ama mükemmel bir küre degilim. Kirilabilirim ve içimde hiçbir sey olmayabilir. Ben neyim?

english: Not just yet, maybe later.
You should probably go and give the milk to the Easter Bunny, hop to it. Don't want to keep the Easter Bunny waiting.
translation: Gidip sütü Paskalya Tavsanina vermelisin, hadi git. Paskalya Tavsanini bekletmek istemeyiz.

english: I seem to have lost the milk, do you by any chance have any more?
translation: Sütü kaybetmisim galiba, acaba sende baska var mi?

english: Of course I do, try not to spill it this time.
translation: Tabii ki var, bu sefer dökmemeye çalis.

english: Well done.
You've [found a new clue scroll/obtained a casket]!
I've always wondered how many cannons the castle has. Could you find out for me?
translation: Kalenin kaç tane topu oldugunu hep merak etmisimdir. Benim için ögrenebilir misin?

english: The cook has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Asçi sana bir meydan okuma parsömeni verdi!

english: Please tell me how many cannons there are.
translation: Lütfen kaç tane top oldugunu söyle.

english: Hmm, I don't think that's right.
Cheers!
The cook has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
Oh, what a cute bunny! I didn't realize it was Easter already!
translation: Oh, ne sirin bir tavsan! Paskalya geldigini fark etmemisim!

english: Cute?! I'll give you cute! I'll...
translation: Sirin mi?! Sana sirinlik gösteririm! Ben...

english: *AHEM*
Sorry.
Cook, we're looking for some fancy eggs that we can use as decorations. You wouldn't happen to have anything, would you?
translation: Cook, dekorasyon olarak kullanabilecegimiz süslü yumurtalar ariyoruz. Sende var mi acaba?

english: Hmm... Well, I do have a large collection of eggs, but most of them are regular old chicken eggs for making cakes.
translation: Hmm... Sey, büyük bir yumurta koleksiyonum var, ama çogu kek yapmak için kullanilan siradan tavuk yumurtalari.

english: Though come to think of it, I might have something...
translation: Ama simdi düsündüm de, bir seyim olabilir...

english: Go on...
I have a... 'special' collection of eggs that I keep in the... well... back of my cupboards for very... 'special' occasions.
translation: Benim... çok “özel” durumlar için dolabimin arkasinda sakladigim “özel” bir yumurta koleksiyonum var.

english: I don't know if this occasion is special enough, though.
translation: Ama bu durumun yeterince özel olup olmadigini bilmiyorum.

english: Hey! I'll have you know Easter is a very special occasion!
translation: Hey! Paskalya'nin çok özel bir gün oldugunu bilmen gerekir!

english: Well, that's me convinced! Let me dig them out for you!
translation: Tamam, ikna oldum! Gidip onlari çikarayim!

english: The Cook digs around the back of his cupboards and produces several colourful eggs, giving them to Gregg.
translation: Asçi dolaplarinin arkasinda bir seyler arar ve birkaç renkli yumurta çikararak Gregg'e verir.

english: Ooh! These are perfect! Thanks a lot!
Don't mention it!
Seriously, don't mention it.
Well, we have some eggs now. What's next?
translation: Artik yumurtalarimiz var. Sirada ne var?

english: Hmm... I think some nice fluffy wool could look quite nice...
translation: Hmm... Sanirim güzel, kabarik yünler hos görünebilir...

english: There's a sheep pen not too far north of here. You could get some fresh wool if you wanted.
translation: Buranin kuzeyinde çok uzak olmayan bir koyun agili var. Istersen taze yün alabilirsin.

english: That sounds perfect! I'll meet you there, human!
translation: Kulaga harika geliyor! Orada görüsürüz insan!

english: Yes, go to the sheep pen and out of my kitchen...
translation: Evet, koyun agilina git ve mutfagimdan çik...

english: Oh, you're still here.
Yep! Just passing the time, you know!
Didn't you say you were off to the sheep pen north of here?
translation: Buranin kuzeyindeki koyun agilina gidecegini söylememis miydin?

english: We're not in a hurry. The sheep are in a pen, so it's not like they can go anywhere.
translation: Acelemiz yok. Koyunlar agilda, yani bir yere gidecekleri yok.

english: Actually, while you're still here, there's something else you can do.
translation: Aslinda, hala buradayken yapabilecegin baska bir sey var.

english: It's the Duke's birthday soon, and I'm running low on ingredients.
translation: Dük'ün dogum günü yaklasiyor ve malzemelerim azaliyor.

english: As important as the Duke of Lumbridge is, I'm sure he won't mind waiting a little longer for the sake of Easter.
translation: Lumbridge Dükü ne kadar önemli olursa olsun, Paskalya için biraz daha beklemekten rahatsiz olmayacagina eminim.

english: Wait... didn't the Duke just have his birthday?
translation: Bekle... Dük'ün dogum günü daha yeni geçmedi mi?

english: Ahem... forget I said anything.
Cook, as fun as it is bringing you ingredients, don't you just burn all your cakes anyway?
translation: Asçi, sana malzemeleri getirmek ne kadar eglenceli olsa da, tüm keklerini yakmiyor musun?

english: I... well yes, but how else am I supposed to train cooking?
translation: Ben... Evet, ama baska nasil asçilik egitimi alabilirim ki?

english: You could try something simple like fish, perhaps?
translation: Belki balik gibi basit bir sey deneyebilirsin?

english: And have the entire castle smelling like Port Sarim? No thank you!
translation: Ve tüm kale Port Sarim gibi kokmasin diye mi? Hayir, tesekkürler!

english: The eggs you gave Gregg were just rotten ones, weren't they.
translation: Gregg'e verdigin yumurtalar çürümüs yumurtalardi, degil mi?

english: Well, he wanted some funny looking eggs, and they were the funniest I had.
translation: O komik görünümlü yumurtalar istiyordu ve elimdeki en komik yumurtalar onlardi.

english: Just be thankful he didn't ask for some fancy milk instead!
translation: Daha pahali süt istemedigi için sükret!

english: *sigh* Do you know where he went at least?
translation: *iç çekis* En azindan nereye gittigini biliyor musun?

english: I think he said he was going to the sheep pen north of here.
translation: Sanirim buradan kuzeye, koyun agilina gidecegini söyledi.

english: How should I know? You should check in Draynor, maybe you'll find him there.
translation: Ben nereden bileyim? Draynor'a bakmalisin, belki orada bulursun.

english: What's wrong?
I'm always happy to help a cook in distress.
translation: Zor durumdaki bir asçiya yardim etmekten her zaman mutluluk duyarim.

english: Where do I find some flour?
How about milk?
And eggs? Where are they found?
I've got all the information I need. Thanks.
translation: Ihtiyacim olan tüm bilgileri aldim. Tesekkürler.

english: Actually, I know where to find this stuff.
I can't right now, Maybe later.
Can you make me a cake?
You don't look very happy.
I'd take the rest of the day off if I were you.
translation: Senin yerinde olsam günün geri kalaninda izin alirdim.

english: Nice hat!
I'll get right on it.
Can you remind me how to find these things again?
translation: Bu seyleri nasil bulacagimi tekrar hatirlatir misin?

english: Do you have any other quests for me?
I am getting strong and mighty.
I keep on dying.
Can I use your range?
Talk about Easter.
Yes.
Count Check.
Easter Bunny.
Father Aereck.
Bob.
Santa.
River Lum.
Sack.
Spider web.
Basket.
Bucket.
Lemon juice.
Beer.
Sewer water.
Butter.
Chocolate.
Easter Egg.
The Grand Exchange.
Cake.
Potato.
Choc-ice.
No.
Something else.
Ask about the Easter event.
Ask about something else.
You're not aristocracy but I suppose you'd do. Do you want a good cook for 3000 coins?
translation: Sen aristokrat degilsin ama sanirim isimi görürsün. 3000 sikke karsiliginda iyi bir asçi ister misin?

english: What can you do?
I am the finest cook in all Gielinor! I can also make good time going to the bank or the sawmill.
translation: Ben Gielinor'un en iyi asçisiyim! Ayrica bankaya veya kereste fabrikasina da hizlica gidebilirim.

english: Tell me about your previous jobs.
I used to be the cook for the old Duke of Lumbridge. Visiting dignitaries praised me for my fine banquets!
translation: Eskiden Lumbridge'in eski dükünün asçisiydim. Ziyaret eden üst düzey yetkililer, hazirladigim muhtesem ziyafetler için beni övüyorlardi!

english: But then someone found a rule that said that only one family could hold that post.
translation: Ama sonra birisi, bu görevi sadece bir ailenin üstlenebilecegini söyleyen bir kural buldu.

english: Overnight I was fired and replaced by some fool who can't even bake a cake without help!
translation: Bir gecede kovuldum ve yardimsiz kek bile yapamayan bir aptalin yerine geçtim!

english: Hmph! I don't work for just anyone, you know! I refuse to work for someone who's below level 30 Construction!
translation: Hmph! Ben herkes için çalismam, biliyorsun! 30 seviyenin altindaki insaatçilar için çalismayi reddediyorum!

english: You already have a servant.
You need a second bedroom with a bed for your servant to sleep in.
translation: Hizmetçinin uyuyabilecegi ikinci bir yatak odasina ihtiyaciniz var.

english: You're hired... well, I don't have the money on me, but can I owe you? I'm good for it, honest.
translation: Ise alindiniz... Sey, üzerimde para yok, ama size borçlanabilir miyim? Ödeyecegim, söz veriyorum.

english: Are you having a laugh? No cash up front, no cook.
translation: Dalga mi geçiyorsunuz? Ön ödeme yoksa asçi da yok.

english: You're hired!
[Alright, sir./Alright, madam./Alright.] I can start work immediately.
What can you do?
Tell me about your previous jobs
You're hired!
Excuse me! This area is different than the rest of the Wilderness, are you sure you understand the rules?
translation: Affedersiniz! Bu bölge, Vahsi Doga'nin geri kalanindan farklidir, kurallari anladiginizdan emin misiniz?

english: I can tell you everything you need to know, but if you're in a rush then be warned my overlords will NOT be happy if they find you to be fighting with no honour.
translation: Bilmeniz gereken her seyi size anlatabilirim, ancak aceleniz varsa, efendilerim sizin onursuzca savastiginizi ögrenirlerse hiç hosnut olmayacaklarini bilin.

english: Just don't go doing anything silly like selling your soul to your opponent else there will be big trouble!
translation: Ruhunu rakibine satmak gibi aptalca bir sey yapma, yoksa basin büyük belaya girer!

english: [How may I help you, sir/How may I help you, madam/How may I help you]?
I'd like to learn the rules of combat in this arena!
translation: Bu arenadaki savas kurallarini ögrenmek istiyorum!

english: Sure. Which part do you want to learn?
Let's talk about Targets.
Sure. Upon entering the arena, you will be assigned a Target based on your combat level, and if you wish to adjust the range of potential Targets, you may do so by speaking with the Trader.
translation: Tabii. Arenaya girdiginde, savas seviyenize göre bir Hedef atanir ve potansiyel Hedeflerin araligini ayarlamak isterseniz, Tüccar ile konusarak bunu yapabilirsiniz.

english: If you wish to change your Target, you may skip your current one, but please note that if you skip three skulled Targets within 30 minutes, you will not be able to receive a new Target for the next 30 minutes.
translation: Hedefinizi degistirmek isterseniz, mevcut hedefinizi atlayabilirsiniz, ancak 30 dakika içinde üç kafatasli Hedefi atlarsaniz, sonraki 30 dakika boyunca yeni bir Hedef alamayacaginizi lütfen unutmayin.

english: Additionally, it's worth mentioning that killing a player who is not your Target will not reward you with any bonuses related to Emblem or Bounty Hunter Points.
translation: Ayrica, Hedefiniz olmayan bir oyuncuyu öldürmenin size Amblem veya Ödül Avcisi Puanlari ile ilgili herhangi bir bonus kazandirmayacagini da belirtmek gerekir.

english: Goodbye.
Tell me about Emblems.
After defeating your Target, you may come across a tier one Emblem. Defeating another Target will level up the Emblem; the higher its tier, the greater its value.
translation: Hedefinizi yendikten sonra, birinci seviye bir Amblem ile karsilasabilirsiniz. Baska bir Hedefi yenmek Amblemin seviyesini yükseltir; seviyesi ne kadar yüksekse, degeri de o kadar yüksek olur.

english: If you die while carrying an Emblem, its tier will be reduced by one. If you die with a Tier 1 emblem, you will lose the emblem.
translation: Amblem tasirken ölürseniz, seviyesi bir düser. Seviye 1 amblemle ölürseniz, amblemi kaybedersiniz.

english: You may use Bounty Hunter Points to purchase a tier one Emblem from the Trader, or sell your own Emblem to him for Bounty Hunter Points. You can only have one Emblem at a time.
translation: Ödül Avcisi Puanlarini kullanarak Tüccardan birinci seviye bir Amblem satin alabilir veya kendi Ambleminizi Tüccara satarak Ödül Avcisi Puanlari kazanabilirsiniz. Ayni anda sadece bir Amblem sahibi olabilirsiniz.

english: Can you explain Bounty Hunter Points to me?
translation: Ödül Avcisi Puanlarini bana açiklayabilir misiniz?

english: You can earn Bounty Hunter Points by defeating your target or selling Emblems to the Trader. Once you have Bounty Hunter Points, you may use them to purchase rewards from the reward shop.
translation: Hedefinizi yenerek veya Trader'a Amblem satarak Ödül Avcisi Puanlari kazanabilirsiniz. Ödül Avcisi Puanlariniz oldugunda, bunlari ödül dükkanindan ödül satin almak için kullanabilirsiniz.

english: What is the Coffer for?
To participate in Bounty Hunter, you must have a certain amount of coins in your Coffer, which varies based on your combat level. Currently you need at least [x] coins to participate.
If you are unskulled and another person kills you in Bounty Hunter, [x] coins will be deducted from your Coffer and given to your killer.
If you are skulled, 10,000 coins will be deducted from your Coffer and given to your killer. However, any surplus money in your Coffer will remain safe.
translation: Eger kafatasiniz varsa, kasadan 10.000 jeton düsülür ve katilinize verilir. Ancak, kasadaki fazla para güvende kalir.

english: To manage your Coffer, talk to the Trader.
translation: Kasayi yönetmek için Tüccar ile konusun.

english: How do I get bounty crates?
Well, if you want crates, you'll need to be fighting a target in the arena while having a minimum value of risked items on you. Anything you can protect, we won't count.
translation: Sandiklari elde etmek için, arenada bir hedefle savasirken üzerinizde minimum degerinde riskli esya bulundurmaniz gerekir. Koruyabileceginiz hiçbir sey sayilmayacaktir.

english: If you meet these requirements, we'll keep track of how long you're in there for. We'll occasionally give you a bonus if you die as well.
translation: Bu gereksinimleri karsiliyorsaniz, orada ne kadar süre kaldiginizi takip edecegiz. Öldügünüzde de ara sira size bonus verecegiz.

english: When you kill a target, if you've been in long enough, you'll get a crate. If you've been in there longer, you'll get a higher value crate.
translation: Bir hedefi öldürdügünüzde, yeterince uzun süre kaldiysaniz, bir sandik alacaksiniz. Daha uzun süre kaldiysaniz, daha yüksek degerli bir sandik alacaksiniz.

english: The crates don't contain anything special; just coins and supplies to help cover what you'll use in the crater.
translation: Sandiklar özel bir sey içermez; sadece kraterde kullanacaginiz seyleri karsilamaya yardimci olacak paralar ve malzemeler vardir.

english: If you keep killing your target, you probably won't get many high value crates, but you'll certainly get a lot more points and Emblems instead.
translation: Hedefinizi öldürmeye devam ederseniz, muhtemelen çok degerli sandiklar almayacaksiniz, ancak bunun yerine çok daha fazla puan ve Amblem alacaksiniz.

english: Can you corrupt my Ancient Warrior armour?
Do you know anything about Bounty Hunter hats?
translation: Ödül Avcisi sapkalari hakkinda bir sey biliyor musun?

english: Ah yes, you'll be able to collect them from me, once you've got some targeted kills that is.
translation: Evet, hedefledigin kisileri öldürdükten sonra benden alabilirsin.

english: Ah yes! I've been told to hold onto some hats for you, for your uhm... deeds in the wilderness.
translation: Evet! Senin için bazi sapkalari saklamam söylendi, vahsi dogadaki... eylemlerin için.

english: Oh wonderful, can I take a look?
You need [number] target kills to claim this hat. You currently have [number].
I'm afraid you've already got one of those hats, I can't let you have another.
translation: Korkarim ki zaten o sapkalardan bir tane var, bir tane daha veremem.

english: I'm afraid you've got nowhere to put a hat if I gave one to you.
translation: Korkarim ki sana bir tane versem bile koyacak yerin yok.

english: Here you go, enjoy!
Can you tell me my current EP value?
translation: Su anki EP degerimi söyleyebilir misin?

english: Of course. Your current EP value is [number]%.
What is this place?
Beyond this portal lies Daimon's Crater, a place where you'll fight other adventurers like yourself for glory and rewards.
translation: Bu geçidin ötesinde, Daimon'un Krateri var. Burada, san ve ödül için senin gibi diger maceracilarla savasacaksin.

english: Sadly, I can't let you into Daimon's Crater right now.
translation: Maalesef, su anda Daimon'un Krateri'ne girmene izin veremem.

english: Bounty Hunter is only available on specific Bounty Hunter worlds.
translation: Bounty Hunter, yalnizca belirli Bounty Hunter dünyalarinda kullanilabilir.

english: If you step through this portal, you'll be taken to Daimon's Crater, where we've set up a lobby area for you to ready yourself for combat.
translation: Bu portaldan geçerseniz, Daimon'un Krateri'ne götürüleceksiniz. Orada, savasa hazirlanmaniz için bir lobi alani hazirladik.

english: If you'd like, I can explain the rules of Bounty Hunter to you.
translation: Isterseniz, Bounty Hunter'in kurallarini size açiklayabilirim.

english: Can I access my Bounty Hunter coffer?
Certainly. Would you like to add or remove coins from it?
translation: Elbette. Kasaya para eklemek veya çikarmak ister misiniz?

english: Deposit coins.
Withdraw coins.
Yes, I acknowledge these rules.
No.
I'd like to learn the rules of combat in this arena!
translation: Bu arenadaki savas kurallarini ögrenmek istiyorum!

english: Let's talk about Targets.
Tell me about Emblems.
Can you explain Bounty Hunter Points to me?
What is the Coffer for?
How do I get bounty crates?
Goodbye.
Tell me about the Emblems.
Can you corrupt my Ancient Warrior armour?
Ask about Bounty Hunter Hats.
translation: Ödül Avcisi Sapkalari hakkinda bilgi verin.

english: Ask about the EP value.
What is this place?
Can I access my Bounty Hunter coffer?
Ahahahaha! I, Count Check, have checked your account. You have a Jagex Account, and you have set a Bank PIN, so you pass my checks! Enjoy your prize.
translation: Ahahahaha! Ben, Kont Check, hesabinizi kontrol ettim. Bir Jagex Hesabiniz var ve Banka PIN'i belirlemissiniz, bu yüzden kontrollerimi geçtiniz! Ödülünüzün tadini çikarin.

english: Ahahahaha! I, Count Check, have checked your account. You do not have a Bank PIN, so you fail my checks! Talk to a banker to set a PIN before we meet again.
translation: Ahahahaha! Ben, Kont Check, hesabini kontrol ettim. Banka PIN'in yok, bu yüzden kontrollerimi geçemedin! Tekrar görüsmeden önce bir bankaci ile konusarak PIN belirle.

english: To set a Bank PIN, talk to a banker and ask to check your PIN settings.
translation: Banka PIN'i belirlemek için bir bankaci ile konus ve PIN ayarlarini kontrol etmesini iste.

english: Ahahahaha! I, Count Check, have checked your account. You do not have a Jagex Account, so you fail my checks! You should upgrade before we meet again.
translation: Ahahahaha! Ben, Kont Check, hesabinizi kontrol ettim. Jagex hesabiniz yok, bu yüzden kontrolümü geçemediniz! Tekrar görüsmeden önce hesabinizi yükseltmelisiniz.

english: To upgrade your account, visit the RuneScape Website and log in to update your Account settings.
translation: Hesabinizi yükseltmek için RuneScape web sitesini ziyaret edin ve oturum açarak hesap ayarlarinizi güncelleyin.

english: Ahahahaha! I, Count Check, have checked your account. You do not have a Jagex Account, nor a Bank PIN, so soyou fail my checks! Please upgrade before we meet again.
translation: Ahahahaha! Ben, Kont Check, hesabinizi kontrol ettim. Jagex hesabiniz ve banka PIN kodunuz yok, bu yüzden kontrolümü geçemediniz! Tekrar görüsmeden önce hesabinizi yükseltin.

english: Ahahahaha! I, Count Check, have checked your account. You have set a Bank PIN, so you pass my checks! Enjoy your prize.
translation: Ahahahaha! Ben, Kont Check, hesabinizi kontrol ettim. Banka PIN'i belirlemissiniz, bu yüzden kontrolümü geçtiniz! Ödülünüzün tadini çikarin.

english: I came to check [player name], not you.
translation: Ben Maceraci'yi kontrol etmeye geldim, sizi degil.

english: Ahahahaha, [player name]!
Please let me check you, [player name]!
translation: Lütfen sizi kontrol etmeme izin verin, Maceraci!

english: I have come to check you, [player name]...
Dialogue 3
Ahahahaha, ONE more person ignored me...
translation: Ahahahaha, bir kisi daha beni görmezden geldi...

english: Hey, a crawling hand!
Yes, what?
[House owner] must be pretty handy to have slayed that!
translation: Ev sahibi onu öldürmek için oldukça becerikli olmali!

english: Hey, I was going to make some furniture, do you think you could lend a HAND?
translation: Hey, mobilya yapacaktim, el atar misin?

english: Very funny.
Hey, hand, do you want to know how I slayed you?
translation: Hey, el, seni nasil öldürdügümü bilmek ister misin?

english: I don't know, how?
Because you're just a hand! You're ARMLESS!
translation: Çünkü sen sadece bir elsin! Kolsuzsun!

english: Hey, you're just a hand, right? So what do you eat?
translation: Hey, sen sadece bir elsin, degil mi? Peki ne yiyorsun?

english: Finger food, of course!
Hello, can you help me?
Ssshhh, don't talk...
But I just want to ask you something.
translation: Ama sana bir sey sormak istiyorum.

english: Ssshhhh! Can't you read the sign?
What sign??
Don't be a cheeky human!
Ssshhhh.
Krrrrrrk
Chkhkhkhkhk
Krrrrrrssssssss
Sssssrrrkkkkk
Krkrkrkrkrkrkrkr
Tktktktktktkt
Hello there. What are you doing here?
I'm waiting here hoping that someone can guide me to the Paterdomus, the temple on the Salve.
translation: Biri beni Salve'deki Paterdomus tapinagina götürür diye burada bekliyorum.

english: Where is Paterdomus?
Oh, Paterdomus is that rather impressive looking temple on the Salve... I'm sure you must have passed it on your way into Morytania.
translation: Oh, Paterdomus Salve'deki oldukça etkileyici görünümlü tapinak... Morytania'ya giderken oradan geçmis olmalisin.

english: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
I'm hoping to get back to civilisation and see what the lands of Misthalin look like.
translation: Medeniyete geri dönüp Misthalin topraklarinin nasil bir yer oldugunu görmek istiyorum.

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Paterdomus?
translation: Paterdomus'a giderken yol üzerinde düsmanlarla karsilasirsak kendini savunabilir misin?

english: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of bad guys. You don't need to worry about that.
translation: Diyelim ki biraz tecrübeliyim ve kötü adamlarla savasmaktan çekinmem. Bu konuda endiselenmene gerek yok.

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: Hmmm, görünüse göre bir takipçin var. Kendi basina dolasirsa bu yolculukta kaybolabilir. Takipçin güvende oldugunda yola çikalim.

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: Gerçekten mi? Bu harika olur! Hedefe vardigimizda sana küçük bir ödül verecegim.

english: Temple Trekking begins
Ok, which route should we take?
Ok, thanks.
Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: Ah, bana biraz erzak vermek istiyorsun, ha? Sirt çantami açayim.

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than staying in Burgh de Rott.
translation: Oh, bu yolculuktan nefret ediyorum, ama Burgh de Rott'ta kalmaktan iyidir.

english: It's scary here...let's get going!
When are we going to get to Paterdomus?
We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on.
translation: Bütün gün burada durup sohbet edemeyiz, hadi devam edelim.

english: Do you visit Paterdomus often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: Paterdomus'a sik sik gider misin? Rotayi iyi biliyorsun gibi görünüyor.

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...?
Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Burgh de Rott. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: Hay aksi! Burgh de Rott'a geri dönmek zorunda kalacagiz galiba. O köprüyü geçemeyiz!

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
Player completes the bridge event
Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Burgh de Rott.
translation: Bu is bitti... Görünüse göre bu batakliktan geçemeyecegiz. Burgh de Rott'a geri dönmek zorundayiz.

english: Player completes the bog event
Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: Hey... bu harika... harika bir is çikardin... Seni takip edecegim.

english: Whahay...that was great!
But we really should be heading off now.
Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
Player completes the river event
That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: Bu harika! Ben de aynisini yapmaliyim.

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: Whahay! Bu harikaydi! Ama artik gerçekten yola çikmaliyiz.

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
This is scary!
Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
Ahhh, two tentacles!
...three tentacles!
I think I'm going to faint!
Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: Vay canina! Su canavara bak! O seyi kendi basina halletmen gerekecek!

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the temple. Here's your reward.
translation: Beni tapinaga güvenle ulastirdigin için çok tesekkürler. Iste ödülün.

english: Where is Paterdomus?
Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
I can take you to Paterdomus.
Ok, thanks.
Hello there.
Quiet! You must not break my concentration!
Why not?
Well, if my concentration is broken while keeping this rift open, the results won't be pretty.
translation: Çünkü bu yarigi açik tutarken konsantrasyonum bozulursa, sonuçlari hiç hos olmayacak.

english: In what way?
If we are lucky, the heads of anyone within the Abyss will suddenly explode, including us.
translation: Sansliysak, Abyss'teki herkesin kafasi aniden patlayacak, biz de dahil.

english: Err... And if we're unlucky?
If we are unlucky, then the entire universe will begin to fold in upon itself, and all reality as we know it will be annihilated in a single stroke.
translation: Sanssizsak, tüm evren kendi üzerine çökecek ve bildigimiz tüm gerçeklik tek bir vurusla yok olacak.

english: So leave me alone!
What are you doing here?
Do you mean what am I doing here in the Abyss? Or are you asking me what I consider my ultimate role to be in this voyage that we call life?
translation: Abyss'te ne yaptigimi mi soruyorsun? Yoksa hayat dedigimiz bu yolculukta benim nihai rolümün ne oldugunu mu soruyorsun?

english: Err... The first one.
By remaining here and holding this rift open, I am providing a permanent link between normal space and this strange dimension.
translation: Burada kalarak ve bu yarigi açik tutarak, normal uzay ile bu garip boyut arasinda kalici bir baglanti sagliyorum.

english: As long as my spell remains in effect, we have the capability to teleport into the Abyss.
translation: Büyümün etkisi devam ettigi sürece, Abyss'e isinlanma yetenegine sahibiz.

english: Now leave me be! I can afford no distraction in my task!
translation: Simdi beni rahat birak! Görevimde dikkatimin dagilmasini göze alamam!

english: I need your help with something.
What? Oh... very well. What did you want?
Can I have another Abyssal book?
translation: Baska bir Abyssal kitabi alabilir miyim?

english: Don't waste my time if you don't have enough free space to take it.
translation: Alacak kadar bos yerin yoksa zamanimi bosa harcama.

english: Here, take it. It is important to pool our research.
translation: Al, al. Arastirmalarimizi bir araya getirmek önemli.

english: Can I have a new essence pouch?
translation: Yeni bir öz torbasi alabilir miyim?

english: Here. Be more careful with your belongings in future.
translation: Al. Gelecekte esyalarina daha dikkat et.

english: You already have a Colossal Pouch. Are you aware of the dimensional turmoil you can cause by using too many pouches at the same time?
translation: Zaten bir Colossal Torba'n var. Ayni anda çok fazla torba kullanmanin boyutlar arasinda karisikliga neden olabilecegini biliyor musun?

english: Now stop wasting my time!
Can you repair my pouches?
Fine. A simple transfiguration spell should resolve things for you.
translation: Tamam. Basit bir dönüsüm büyüsü sorunu çözecektir.

english: Thanks.
Now can you leave me alone? I can't keep affording these distractions!
translation: Simdi beni rahat birakabilir misin? Bu tür dikkat daginikliklarini kaldiramam!

english: Actually, I don't need anything right now.
translation: Aslinda su anda bir seye ihtiyacim yok.

english: Then go away! Honestly, you have no idea of the pressure I am under. I can't afford any distractions!
translation: O zaman git buradan! Gerçekten, benim ne kadar baski altinda oldugumu bilmiyorsun. Dikkat daginikligini kaldiramam!

english: Sorry, I'll go.
Good. I'm attempting to subdue the elemental mechanisms of the universe to my will. Inane chatter from random idiots is not helping me achieve this!
translation: Güzel. Evrenin temel mekanizmalarini irademe boyun egdirmeye çalisiyorum. Rastgele aptallarin anlamsiz gevezelikleri bunu basarmama yardimci olmuyor!

english: There, I have repaired your pouches. Now leave me alone. I'm concentrating!
translation: Iste, çantalarini tamir ettim. Simdi beni rahat birak. Konsantre oluyorum!

english: You don't seem to have any pouches in need of repair. Leave me alone!
translation: Tamir edilmesi gereken çantan yok gibi görünüyor. Beni rahat birak!

english: Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to answer this for me.
The Dark mage has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Karanlik büyücü sana bir meydan okuma parsömeni verdi!

english: Please answer the question.
Stop wasting my time! That is wrong!
Spot on!
The Dark mage has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
Why not?
What are you doing here?
I need your help with something.
Can I have another Abyssal book?
translation: Bir Abyssal kitabi daha alabilir miyim?

english: Can I have a new essence pouch?
translation: Yeni bir öz torbasi alabilir miyim?

english: Can you repair my pouches?
Actually, I don't need anything right now.
translation: Aslinda su anda bir seye ihtiyacim yok.

english: Sorry, I'll go.
Hello! What are you doing here?
Hello, I am here to investigate rumours of a dark magical presence in these lands.
translation: Merhaba, bu topraklarda karanlik bir büyünün var olduguna dair söylentileri arastirmak için buradayim.

english: What rumours have you heard exactly?
translation: Tam olarak ne gibi söylentiler duydun?

english: I've heard there are hidden ruins in the mountains here with the power to re-animate beings from the dead. Zandar Horfyre sent me to study them.
translation: Buralardaki daglarda, ölüleri diriltme gücüne sahip gizli kalintilar oldugunu duydum. Zandar Horfyre beni onlari incelemem için gönderdi.

english: Do you know where in the mountains these ruins are?
translation: Bu kalintilarin daglarda nerede oldugunu biliyor musun?

english: Sadly no but I will find them, I will begin looking for information in Arceeus, they seem like my kind of people.
translation: Maalesef hayir, ama onlari bulacagim. Arceeus'ta bilgi aramaya baslayacagim, onlar benim gibi insanlar gibi görünüyorlar.

english: If you say so, good luck.
What are you doing here?
I'm working on combining the dark teleportation magic of these lands into physical form.
translation: Bu topraklardaki karanlik teleportasyon büyüsünü fiziksel forma dönüstürmeye çalisiyorum.

english: Kind of like teleportation tablets?
Yes, but not made quite the same way.
translation: Evet, ama tam olarak ayni sekilde yapilmiyor.

english: Can I do that?
If you must. That lectern over there contains the book I've been working on.
translation: Gerekirse yapabilirsin. Suradaki kürsüde üzerinde çalistigim kitap var.

english: What are you reading?
I am seeking to understand more about the dark powers present in these lands. Now leave me be, there is much to be learned.
translation: Bu topraklarda bulunan karanlik güçleri daha iyi anlamaya çalisiyorum. Simdi beni yalniz birak, ögrenecek çok sey var.

english: How am I supposed to get past this?
Gah!
Hopefully I'll make it out of Darkmeyer one day.
Phew, I made it! Time for a break.
Thank Saradomin that mysterious stranger gave me this ring or I'd be toast!
translation: Saradomin'e sükürler olsun ki o gizemli yabanci bana bu yüzügü verdi, yoksa mahvolurdum!

english: That trap was harder than I thought! Perhaps I'm not cut out for this.
translation: Bu tuzak sandigimdan daha zordu! Belki de bu is için uygun degilim.

english: I can't believe we've finally arrived, I can't wait to explore!
translation: Sonunda vardigimiza inanamiyorum, kesfetmek için sabirsizlaniyorum!

english: So much to see, I don't know where to start!
translation: Görülecek o kadar çok sey var ki, nereden baslayacagimi bilemiyorum!

english: A whole new continent to explore... what a time to be alive!
translation: Kesfedilecek yepyeni bir kita... Ne harika bir zaman!

english: Are you the tour guide?
Nope, I'm just as lost as you.
translation: Hayir, ben de senin kadar kayboldum.

english: I overheard someone mention there are pirates and thieves here, be careful!
translation: Burada korsanlar ve hirsizlar oldugunu duydum, dikkatli ol!

english: Build us a stove mate, I'm absolutely starvin!
translation: Bize bir ocak yap dostum, açliktan ölüyorum!

english: You must be really tired from the journey, you did so much.
translation: Yolculuktan çok yorulmus olmalisin, çok sey yaptin.

english: ...So my expertise were not required this time, a man's still gotta eat.
translation: ...Demek bu sefer uzmanligim gerekmedi, ama bir erkek yine de yemek yemeli.

english: I guess I'll get building then...
translation: O zaman ben de yapmaya baslayayim...

english: Cheers mate!
About these eggs… Odd colour, don't cha think?
translation: Bu yumurtalar hakkinda... Garip bir renkleri var, sence de öyle degil mi?

english: The birds here are a little exotic, apparently.
Hmm, well, good effort, but I'll pass on the grub this time.
translation: Hmm, iyi denemeydi, ama bu sefer yemegi pas geçecegim.

english: What if I gave you a box?
I'm not sure that'll change my mind.
If not a box, then what about a fox?
Nope.
A mouse, a house? Would these change your mind?
translation: Fare, ev? Bunlar fikrini degistirir mi?

english: For the love of Saradomin, please leave me be
translation: Saradomin askina, lütfen beni rahat birak.

english: I will! I promise! Just try them and you'll see.
translation: Birakacagim! Söz veriyorum! Sadece dene, göreceksin.

english: Alright! Fine! I concede.
Thoughts?
Yeah, I guess they're nice
Apparently you aren't as stupid as you look.
Hello, young adventurer. What brings you to the Museum's paleontology floor?
translation: Merhaba, genç maceraci. Seni müzenin paleontoloji katina getiren nedir?

english: What's paleontology?
I'm glad you asked! Paleontology is the study of prehistoric lifeforms in Gielinor through the examination of fossils.
translation: Sordugun için tesekkürler! Paleontoloji, fosilleri inceleyerek Gielinor'daki tarih öncesi yasam formlarini inceleyen bilim dalidir.

english: We use fossils to try determine several things: information about what fossil belonged to, what the environment was like, and try to uncover secrets of Gielinor's past.
translation: Fosilleri kullanarak birkaç seyi belirlemeye çalisiyoruz: fosilin neye ait oldugu, çevrenin nasil oldugu hakkinda bilgi edinmek ve Gielinor'un geçmisinin sirlarini ortaya çikarmak.

english: What else would you like to know?
Where do these fossils come from?
Ah, brilliant question. Fossils of creatures are found in sedimentary rock, we use specialised tools to carefully remove the unwanted rock only leaving only the fossil behind.
translation: Ah, harika bir soru. Canlilarin fosilleri tortul kayaçlarda bulunur, özel aletler kullanarak istenmeyen kayalari dikkatlice çikarir ve sadece fosili geride birakiriz.

english: If you're looking for fossils yourself, I hear there is a voyage to a mysterious island to discover new types of fossil.
translation: Eger kendiniz fosil ariyorsaniz, yeni fosil türleri kesfetmek için gizemli bir adaya yapilan bir yolculuk oldugunu duydum.

english: You should speak to the Curator as he knows more about it than I.
translation: Bu konuda benden daha fazla bilgiye sahip olan küratörle konusmalisiniz.

english: Is there anything else you need help with?
What can I do with these fossils?
Any fossils you find can be added to the surrounding display cases.
If you manage to complete display case, the Museum will ensure you are rewarded for your efforts.
translation: Vitrini tamamlamayi basarirsaniz, müze çabalariniz için sizi ödüllendirecektir.

english: Also, if you find any rare fossils on your travels, make sure you hold onto them. Something tells me they will be very valuable in the future...
translation: Ayrica, seyahatlerinizde nadir fosiller bulursaniz, onlari sakladiginizdan emin olun. Içimden bir ses, bunlarin gelecekte çok degerli olacagini söylüyor...

english: Do you have any other questions?
What can you tell me about some of the fossil displays?
It looks like the Museum doesn't have any complete fossil displays yet. I could only speculate on what they will contain.
translation: Görünüse göre müzede henüz tam fosil sergileri yok. Içinde ne olacagi konusunda sadece tahminde bulunabilirim.

english: Of course. Which display would you like to ask about?
translation: Tabii ki. Hangi sergi hakkinda bilgi almak istersiniz?

english: The one that looks like a great leviathan.
translation: Büyük bir leviathan gibi görünen sergi.

english: The one that looks like a foot print of a mythical animal.
translation: Efsanevi bir hayvanin ayak izi gibi görünen sergi.

english: The one that looks like an imprint of a posterior.
translation: Arka kismin izi gibi görünen sergi.

english: The one that looks like a zygomite.
The one that looks like a snake in the shape of a hoop.
translation: Çember seklinde bir yilan gibi görünen sergi.

english: The one that looks like a clam shell.
The one that looks like a 'big' foot print.
translation: “Büyük” bir ayak izi gibi görünen sergi.

english: The one that looks like a crab shell.
The one that looks like a cyclopse with two heads.
translation: Iki basli bir tek gözlü dev gibi görünen sergi.

english: The one that looks like it could be used for fuel.
translation: Yakit olarak kullanilabilecek gibi görünen sergi.

english: The one that looks like a tar creature.
The one that looks like a giant dragonfly.
The one that looks like an ancient cave painting.
The one that looks like a person with a fish tail.
translation: Balik kuyrugu olan bir insana benzeyen.

english: The one that looks like a lava creature.
The one that looks like a pufferfish.
The one that looks like a dragon skull.
The one that looks like a squirrel with huge teeth.
translation: Kocaman disleri olan bir sincap gibi görünen.

english: The one that looks like a dragon egg.
The one that looks like a cross between a mushroom and kangaroo.
translation: Mantar ve kanguru karisimi gibi görünen.

english: The one that looks like an unusual lobster.
translation: Sira disi bir istakoz gibi görünen.

english: The one that looks like a creature with a giant skull and small body.
translation: Dev kafatasi ve küçük gövdesi olan bir yaratik gibi görünen.

english: The one that looks like a tree sized mushroom.
translation: Agaç büyüklügünde bir mantar gibi görünen.

english: The one that looks like scary mushrooms.
The one that looks like a tortoise with a mushroom on its shell.
translation: Kabugunda mantar olan bir kaplumbaga gibi görünen.

english: The one that looks like a huge pitcher plant.
translation: Dev bir sürahi bitkisi gibi görünen.

english: The one that looks like a cross between a dark beast and a shark.
translation: Karanlik bir canavar ile köpekbaliginin karisimi gibi görünen mantar.

english: The one that looks like a merfish with legs.
translation: Bacaklari olan deniz kizi gibi görünen mantar.

english: The one that looks like a plant with a stack of mushrooms.
translation: Üzerinde mantar yigini olan bitki gibi görünen mantar.

english: The one that looks like a big mushroom.
The one that looks like a toucan with two heads.
translation: Iki basli tukan gibi görünen mantar.

english: The one that looks like a bird with a snail shell on its back.
translation: Sirtinda salyangoz kabugu olan kus gibi görünen mantar.

english: Um... yes. It's an interesting specimen isn't it?
translation: Evet. Ilginç bir örnek, degil mi?

english: Do you know much about this display?
translation: Bu sergi hakkinda çok sey biliyor musun?

english: Um... yes, but I couldn't possibly share that information right now.
translation: Evet, ama su anda bu bilgiyi paylasamam.

english: It's an interesting specimen isn't it? It appears that the specimen is thousands of years old!
translation: Ilginç bir örnek, degil mi? Görünüse göre bu örnek binlerce yillik!

english: Are you sure?
Well that's what the analysis from the fossil shows.
Aren't you going to tell me about the display?
translation: Sergi hakkinda bana bir sey söylemeyecek misin?

english: What did you ask about again?
Nevermind.
What's paleontology?
Where do these fossils come from?
What can I do with these fossils?
What can you tell me about some of the fossil displays?
translation: Fosil sergileri hakkinda bana ne söyleyebilirsiniz?

english: Nevermind
I claim [player name] as my own!
Your time here is over, [player name].
There is no escape, [player name]...
Now is the time you die, [player name].
Beware mortals, [player name] now travels with me.
translation: Ölümlüler, dikkatli olun, Maceraci artik benimle birlikte seyahat ediyor.

english: I have come for you, [player name]!
[Player name] is mine!
Let me escort you to [respawn location], [player name].
Muhahahahaha!
Hello mortal. Have you come to retrieve something you lost when you died?
translation: Merhaba ölümlü. Öldügünde kaybettigin bir seyi geri almaya mi geldin?

english: How does that work?
When you die, you often drop things you were carrying. In most cases, a gravestone appears near where you died, and your items can be retrieved there.
translation: Öldügünde, genellikle tasidigin esyalari düsürürsün. Çogu durumda, öldügün yerin yakininda bir mezar tasi belirir ve esyalarini oradan geri alabilirsin.

english: However, gravestones do not last for long. When your gravestone collapses, your items come here, to me. I can return them to you - though I charge a fee for my services.
translation: Ancak mezar taslari uzun süre kalmaz. Mezar tasin yikildiginda, esyalarin buraya, bana gelir. Onlari sana geri verebilirim, ancak hizmetim için bir ücret alirim.

english: Aside from that, if you bring me your unwanted possessions, and sacrifice them into my Coffer here, I'll count their value against any future fees I charge you.
translation: Bunun disinda, istemedigin esyalarini bana getirir ve onlari buradaki Sandigima kurban edersen, gelecekte senden alacagim ücretlerden bunlarin degerini düserim.

english: I don't accept just any junk, but I'll try to give you a good price for anything decent.
translation: Her türlü çöpü kabul etmiyorum, ama iyi durumda olan her sey için sana iyi bir fiyat vermeye çalisirim.

english: So do you need to retrieve something you lost when you died?
translation: Öldügünde kaybettigin bir seyi geri almak mi istiyorsun?

english: What is this place?
As you should be able to see, I am Death. The Grim Reaper. The Inexorable One. The Inescapable Grasp of Mortal Destiny. And this is my little office. Nice, isn't it?
translation: Gördügün gibi, ben Ölüm'üm. Azrail. Acimasiz Olan. Kaçinilmaz Ölüm Kaderi. Burasi da benim küçük ofisim. Güzel, degil mi?

english: It's lovely.
Thank you. I feel the colour scheme suits my style. Now, can I help you retrieve something you lost when you died?
translation: Tesekkürler. Renkleri benim tarzima çok uygun. Simdi, öldügünde kaybettigin bir seyi geri almak için sana yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: Your decorations leave a bit to be desired.
Sometimes it's hard to care for beauty when one's very existence is just seen as a curse upon the world. Now, do you actually want to retrieve something from me?
translation: Bazen, kisinin varligi dünya için bir lanet olarak görüldügünde, güzellige özen göstermek zor olabilir. Simdi, benden gerçekten bir sey almak istiyor musun?

english: Yes, have you got anything for me?
translation: Evet, benim için bir seyin var mi?

english: Can I choose a different-looking gravestone?
translation: Farkli görünümlü bir mezar tasi seçebilir miyim?

english: You haven't got 200,000 coins to pay for that. I can take coins from your inventory, or from my Coffer.
translation: Bunun için 200.000 altin ödeyecek kadar paran yok. Envanterinden veya kasamdan altin alabilirim.

english: Actually, never mind.
Most people won't see your grave, by the way. It appears to you, but it aims to be invisible to everyone else. Are you sure you want to buy a cosmetic override for it?
translation: Bu arada, çogu insan mezarini görmeyecek. Sana görünüyor, ama diger herkes için görünmez olmayi amaçliyor. Bunun için kozmetik bir degisiklik satin almak istediginden emin misin?

english: Yes, I understand other people won't often see it.
translation: Evet, diger insanlarin onu sik sik görmeyecegini anliyorum.

english: Your gravestone is now the Angel of Death.
It is not for me to judge how people spend their money.
translation: Insanlarin paralarini nasil harcadiklarini yargilamak bana düsmez.

english: No thanks, it's not worth it.
Do you really want to switch to the basic gravestone? I'm not offering to give back the fee you paid earlier.
translation: Gerçekten temel mezar tasina geçmek istiyor musun? Daha önce ödedigin ücreti geri vermeyi teklif etmiyorum.

english: Yes, I want the basic gravestone.
Your gravestone is now the basic type.
You've already got the basic gravestone.
Er... I suppose so.
How would you like to... die?
Not just now, thanks.
Really? There isn't much else for you to do here. But you know your business.
translation: Gerçekten mi? Burada yapacak baska bir seyiniz yok. Ama isinizi biliyorsunuz.

english: Hello mortal. If you're looking for something you lost when you died, I'm afraid I don't cater to Ultimate Ironmen. Your items would have fallen on the ground where you died.
translation: Merhaba ölümlü. Öldügünüzde kaybettiginiz bir seyi ariyorsaniz, korkarim Ultimate Ironmen'e hizmet vermiyorum. Esyalariniz öldügünüz yere düsmüs olmali.

english: Can I change how I die?
So, mortal... you have died, as all mortals do. As you have suffered the loss of some items on this occasion, I have brought you here to explain for you how that works.
translation: Öyleyse, ölümlü... tüm ölümlüler gibi sen de öldün. Bu olayda bazi esyalarini kaybettigin için, sana bunun nasil isledigini açiklamak için seni buraya getirdim.

english: I lost items? Can I get them back?
translation: Esyalarimi mi kaybettim? Onlari geri alabilir miyim?

english: Let me explain... Across most of the land of Gielinor, when you die, some of the items you're carrying are dropped.
translation: Açiklayayim... Gielinor topraklarinin çogunda, öldügünde tasidigin bazi esyalar düser.

english: I will look after such items,without a time limit. However, I do charge more for my services. It would be cheaper to retrieve them from the gravestone directly, if you can reach it in time.
translation: Bu esyalara zaman siniri olmaksizin bakacagim. Ancak, hizmetlerim için daha fazla ücret aliyorum. Zamaninda ulasabilirsen, mezar tasindan dogrudan geri almak daha ucuz olur.

english: Tell me about gravestones again.
translation: Mezar taslari hakkinda tekrar bilgi ver.

english: Gladly... Across most of the land of Gielinor, when you die, some of the items you're carrying are dropped.
translation: Seve seve... Gielinor topraklarinin çogunda, öldügünde, tasidigin bazi esyalar düser.

english: How do I pay a gravestone fee?
Cash is always acceptable. Also, a gravestone can take it directly from you bank, in case you didn't have enough with you.
translation: Nakit her zaman kabul edilir. Ayrica, yaninizda yeterli para yoksa, mezar tasi bankanizdan dogrudan ödeme alabilir.

english: Besides that, take a look at my Coffer here. You can bring your unwanted possessions, and sacrifice them into my Coffer. I'll count their value against any future gravestone fees you're charged.
translation: Bunun yani sira, buradaki sandigima bir göz atin. Istemediginiz esyalarinizi getirip sandigima feda edebilirsiniz. Bunlarin degerini, gelecekte ödeyeceginiz mezar tasi ücretlerinden düserim.

english: How long do I have to return to my gravestone?
translation: Mezar tasima ne kadar sürede dönmem gerekir?

english: How do I know what will happen to my items when I die?
translation: Öldügümde esyalarima ne olacagini nasil bilebilirim?

english: There is a menu to predict these things for you. Take a look at your Worn Items side-panel...
translation: Bunlari tahmin etmek için bir menü var. Takili Esyalar yan paneline bir göz at...

english: I think I'm done here.
I'm afraid we have more topics to cover before you leave. Speak to me when you are ready to continue.
translation: Korkarim, gitmeden önce ele almamiz gereken baska konular var. Devam etmeye hazir oldugunda bana söyle.

english: Very well. Once you pass through my portal, you will have 15 minutes to reach your gravestone.
translation: Peki. Portalimdan geçtikten sonra mezar tasina ulasmak için 15 dakikan olacak.

english: I believe I was explaining gravestones to you. We still have some more topics to cover.
translation: Sana mezar taslarini açikliyordum sanirim. Hala ele almamiz gereken bazi konular var.

english: I haven't finished talking to you yet, [player name]. Please don't worry about your gravestone - it will wait until you leave this place.
translation: Seninle konusmam henüz bitmedi, Maceraci. Mezar tasin için endiselenme, buradan ayrilana kadar bekleyecek.

english: Would you like me to remind you about gravestones?
You haven't unlocked that. You can do so by reading a Trailblazer reloaded death scroll.
translation: Bunu henüz açmadin. Trailblazer reloaded ölüm parsömenini okuyarak açabilirsin.

english: Have you come to retrieve something you lost from a previous gravestone?
translation: Önceki mezar tasindan kaybettigin bir seyi geri almaya mi geldin?

english: You will now die like a Trailblazer.
You are already using that.
You will now perish like most others in Gielinor.
Hello mortal. If you're looking for something you lost when you died, I'm afraid I don't cater to Ultimate Iron [Men/Women]. Your items would have fallen on the ground where you died.
translation: Merhaba ölümlü. Öldügünde kaybettigin bir seyi ariyorsan, korkarim Ultimate Ironman'a hizmet vermiyorum. Esyalarin öldügün yere düsmüs olmali.

english: So what can I do here?
Nothing, really. Please leave when you are ready.
translation: Aslinda hiçbir sey. Hazir oldugunuzda lütfen ayrilin.

english: How does that work?
What is this place?
It's lovely.
Your decorations leave a bit to be desired.
Yes, have you got anything for me?
translation: Evet, benim için bir sey var mi?

english: More options...
Can I choose a different-looking gravestone?
translation: Farkli görünümlü bir mezar tasi seçebilir miyim?

english: Actually, never mind.
Yes, I understand other people won't often see it.
translation: Evet, diger insanlarin onu sik sik görmeyecegini anliyorum.

english: No thanks, it's not worth it.
Yes, I want the basic gravestone.
Can I change how I die?
Not just now, thanks.
Previous options...
Tell me about gravestones again.
translation: Mezar taslari hakkinda tekrar bilgi verin.

english: How do I pay a gravestone fee?
How long do I have to return to my gravestone?
translation: Mezar tasima ne kadar süre içinde dönmem gerekiyor?

english: How do I know what will happen to my items when I die?
translation: Öldügümde esyalarima ne olacagini nasil bilebilirim?

english: I think I'm done here.
Leagues IV: Trailblazer Reloaded.
Default.
You're a long way from home, traveller! How about some food to keep you going?
translation: Evinden çok uzaktasin, gezgin! Yoluna devam etmek için biraz yemek ister misin?

english: Yes, please.
No thanks.
I'll be here if you find yourself hungry!
Yes, please.
No thanks.
Hello there! You look like a hunter. What are you on the hunt for?
Nilsal! I'm actually out here writing reports on the animals of the forest.
translation: Nilsal! Aslinda buraya ormandaki hayvanlar hakkinda rapor yazmaya geldim.

english: I see. Made any interesting observations so far?
translation: Anliyorum. Simdiye kadar ilginç bir sey gözlemledin mi?

english: Well, it would appear that a number of them are somewhat incorporeal...
translation: Sey, bazilarinin biraz maddi olmayan varliklar oldugu görülüyor...

english: Yes, I'd actually made that observation myself. I imagine being incorporeal means they're somewhat harder to hunt?
translation: Evet, ben de ayni gözlemi yaptim. Maddesel olmamalari avlanmalarini zorlastiriyor olabilir mi?

english: You could say that.
What about the ents? Anything interesting to note on them?
translation: Entler ne durumda? Onlar hakkinda ilginç bir sey gözlemledin mi?

english: Yes, in between avoiding being stepped on by them, I've been trying to see how they interact with the other animals... specifically the corporeal ones.
translation: Evet, onlarin altinda kalmamaya çalisirken, diger hayvanlarla, özellikle de maddi olanlarla nasil etkilesime girdiklerini gözlemlemeye çalistim.

english: Truth be told though, they don't really seem to be affected by them. They just keep on their merry way.
translation: Ama dogrusu, diger hayvanlar onlari pek etkilemiyor gibi görünüyor. Entler neseli hallerine devam ediyorlar.

english: Interesting... Well, if you need any help with any of this stuff, do let me know. It wouldn't be the first time I've dealt with guild reports.
translation: Ilginç... Bu konularda yardima ihtiyacin olursa bana haber ver. Lonca raporlariyla ilk kez ugrasmiyorum.

english: Oh, are you familiar with the guild?
I've helped out a touch here and there.
Good, good. Well, thank you for the offer, but I think I'm good for the moment.
translation: Güzel, güzel. Teklifin için tesekkürler, ama simdilik bir ihtiyacim yok.

english: Fair enough.
Interesting... Well, if you need any help with any of this stuff, do let me know.
translation: Ilginç... Bu konularda yardima ihtiyacin olursa bana haber ver.

english: Thank you for the offer, but I think I'm good for the moment.
translation: Teklifin için tesekkürler, ama simdilik bir ihtiyacim yok.

english: Quack!
Hello there.
Good day to you. I've prepared this patch for you to plant the enriched snapdragon in.
translation: Iyi günler. Zenginlestirilmis aslanagzi ekmen için bu yamayi hazirladim.

english: Okay, thanks.
Good day to you. The enriched snapdragon is growing well. It should be ready soon.
translation: Iyi günler. Zenginlestirilmis aslanagzi iyi büyüyor. Yakinda hazir olacak.

english: Good day to you. The enriched snapdragon is fully grown and ready for you to harvest.
translation: Iyi günler. Zenginlestirilmis aslanagzi tamamen büyüdü ve hasat için hazir.

english: Good day to you. You should take that enriched snapdragon to Thaerisk.
translation: Iyi günler. O zenginlestirilmis aslanagzisini Thaerisk'e götürmelisin.

english: Okay, will do.
Good day to you.
I lost the enriched snapdragon I harvested.
Not to worry. There was some left over after you were done.
translation: Endiselenme. Isin bittikten sonra biraz kalmisti.

english: Thanks.
Hello there! Are you alright?
Of courshe! Why why why *hic* why shouldn't I be?
translation: Tabii ki! Neden, neden, neden *hic* neden iyi olmayayim ki?

english: Hey, you look vaguely familiar... haven't I seen you somewhere before?
translation: Hey, sana bir yerden tanidik geliyorsun... Seni daha önce bir yerde görmedim mi?

english: That'sh not likely... I've been here for eh...
I've been here for...
Yearsh!
I've been looking after thish houshe for my... my coushin? Or wash it my brother? A family member anyway.
translation: Bu evi kuzenim için mi bakiyorum? Yoksa kardesim için mi? Her neyse, bir aile üyesi için.

english: And where is this... family member of yours?
All over, all over... he shaish he went off to wander all over Gielinor. Don't remember why.
translation: Her yerde, her yerde... Gielinor'u dolasmaya gittigini söyledi. Nedenini hatirlamiyorum.

english: Hmm... I wonder, I may have met him...
translation: Hmm... Acaba, onunla tanismis olabilir miyim...

english: He comesh back sometimesh... saysh he needsh more kebabsh.
translation: Bazen geri gelir... daha fazla kebap istedigini söyler.

english: Or ish that jusht a dream? Sometimesh I dream kebabsh invade Keldi... Keldu... Keldashomething.
translation: Yoksa bu sadece bir rüya mi? Bazen kebaplarin Keldi'yi isgal ettigini rüyamda görürüm... Keldu... Keldashomething.

english: When you eatsh them, they take over your mind, they do! An army of mindlesh kebab eating dwarvesh!
translation: Onlari yediginde, zihnini ele geçiriyorlar, gerçekten! Zihni ele geçirilmis kebap yiyen cüceler ordusu!

english: Er, yes, well, I think I should be off now.
THE KEBABSH WILL COME FOR YOU!*
What are you doing here anyway?
THE KEBABSH WILL COME FOR YOU!
I'm supposhed to sholve this for a bet *hic* but I'm feeling a lil eh. Help me!
translation: Bir bahis için bunu çözmem gerekiyor *hic* ama kendimi biraz kötü hissediyorum. Yardim edin!

english: The drunken dwarf has given you a puzzle box!
translation: Sarhos cüce sana bir bulmaca kutusu verdi!

english: Shorry but you haven't sholved the puzzle yet *hic*.
Thanksh [player name]!
Quack!
[player name]! So glad you could make it. I really do appreciate you rounding up all those monkeys for us.
translation: Maceraci! Geldigine çok sevindim. Bizim için tüm o maymunlari topladigin için gerçekten minnettarim.
sub_category: Dialogue for Duke Horacio (2021 Birthday event)

english: No problem.
sub_category: Dialogue for Duke Horacio (2021 Birthday event)

english: I am grateful for your help, [player name]. If you could free up an inventory space, I wish to reward you.
translation: Yardimin için tesekkür ederim, Maceraci. Eger envanterinde yer açabilirsen, sana bir ödül vermek istiyorum.
sub_category: Dialogue for Duke Horacio (2021 Birthday event)

english: I am grateful for your help, [player name]. As proof of my gratitude, I have arranged a reward for you!
translation: Yardimin için tesekkür ederim, Maceraci. Minnettarligimin bir göstergesi olarak, sana bir ödül hazirladim!
sub_category: Dialogue for Duke Horacio (2021 Birthday event)

english: Also, King Awowogei brought gifts from Ape Atoll as an apology for the trouble they caused. But I think you should receive them instead.
translation: Ayrica, Kral Awowogei, verdikleri rahatsizlik için özür olarak Ape Atoll'dan hediyeler getirdi. Ama bence bunlari sen almalisin.
sub_category: Dialogue for Duke Horacio (2021 Birthday event)

english: The Duke awards you a Cursed banana.Happy 8th Birthday!
translation: Dük sana Lanetli muz ödülü veriyor. 8. dogum günün kutlu olsun!
sub_category: Dialogue for Duke Horacio (2021 Birthday event)
source: Dialogue for Duke Horacio (2021 Birthday event)

english: On a members-only world you'd have also received a Banana Cape. If you purchase membership you can reclaim it at any time from Diango in Draynor Village.
translation: Üyelere özel dünyada ayrica Muz Pelerin de alacaktin. Üyelik satin alirsan, Draynor Köyü'ndeki Diango'dan istedigin zaman geri alabilirsin.
sub_category: Dialogue for Duke Horacio (2021 Birthday event)
source: Dialogue for Duke Horacio (2021 Birthday event)

english: The Duke awards you a Cursed banana and a Banana cape.Happy 8th Birthday!
translation: Dük sana Lanetli muz ve Muz pelerin ödülü veriyor. 8. dogum günün kutlu olsun!

english: Ah, [player name]. I hope you are enjoying the party?
sub_category: Dialogue for Duke Horacio (2021 Birthday event)

english: What is going to happen with the monkeys?
sub_category: Dialogue for Duke Horacio (2021 Birthday event)

english: Funny you should ask, actually.
sub_category: Dialogue for Duke Horacio (2021 Birthday event)

english: It turns out that on the way to King Awowogei, Postie Pete was called off for an urgent request for Molly. Her evil twin had escaped again and she was looking for an adventurer to help.
translation: Görünüse göre, Kral Awowogei'ye giderken, Postaci Pete, Molly'nin acil bir istegi için geri çagrilmis. Kötü ikizi yine kaçmis ve yardim edecek bir maceraci ariyormus.
sub_category: Dialogue for Duke Horacio (2021 Birthday event)

english: In the process of teleporting, he left the letter behind and these monkeys found it.
translation: Isinlanma sirasinda mektubu geride birakmis ve bu maymunlar onu bulmus.
sub_category: Dialogue for Duke Horacio (2021 Birthday event)

english: They couldn't understand the letter so they took it to one of their elders, Mizaru, to translate. But 'Monster' didn't translate, so they assumed it said 'Monkey'.
translation: Mektubu anlayamadiklari için, çevirisi için yaslilarindan biri olan Mizaru'ya götürdüler. Ancak “Monster” kelimesini çeviremediler, bu yüzden “Monkey” (maymun) oldugunu varsaydilar.
sub_category: Dialogue for Duke Horacio (2021 Birthday event)

english: So instead of a party invitation they interpreted it as a threat from an organisation called Humans Against Monkeys! They stole some amulets of humanspeak, then decided to come here and put an end to it!
translation: Böylece parti davetiyesi yerine, bunu Humans Against Monkeys (Maymunlara Karsi Insanlar) adli bir örgütün tehdidi olarak yorumladilar! Insanlarin konustugu dili ögrenmek için bazi tilsimlar çaldilar, sonra buraya gelip bu ise son vermeye karar verdiler!
sub_category: Dialogue for Duke Horacio (2021 Birthday event)

english: That explains what happened, I suppose. How did you find all of this out?
translation: Sanirim olanlari bu açikliyor. Bunlari nasil ögrendin?
sub_category: Dialogue for Duke Horacio (2021 Birthday event)

english: Another elder, Kikazaru, found the letter. And once he understood the situation, he went straight to King Awowogei himself. The King is over in the corner if you want to speak to him.
translation: Baska bir büyük olan Kikazaru mektubu buldu. Durumu anladiktan sonra dogrudan Kral Awowogei'ye gitti. Kral kösede, onunla konusmak istersen.
sub_category: Dialogue for Duke Horacio (2021 Birthday event)

english: Thanks. I'll go enjoy the party now.
sub_category: Dialogue for Duke Horacio (2021 Birthday event)

english: Can you give me more reward items?
translation: Bana daha fazla ödül ögesi verebilir misin?
sub_category: Dialogue for Duke Horacio (2021 Birthday event)

english: I think that is everything I have for you.
translation: Sanirim sana verebilecegim her sey bu kadar.
sub_category: Dialogue for Duke Horacio (2021 Birthday event)

english: I have given you what you can hold. You may wish to visit Diango, in Draynor Village, to collect more rewards in a more convenient setting.
translation: Tasiyabilecegin kadarini verdim. Daha rahat bir ortamda daha fazla ödül almak için Draynor Köyü'ndeki Diango'yu ziyaret etmek isteyebilirsin.
sub_category: Dialogue for Duke Horacio (2021 Birthday event)

english: I have nothing more for you.
translation: Sana verecek baska bir seyim yok.
sub_category: Dialogue for Duke Horacio (2021 Birthday event)

sub_category: Dialogue for Duke Horacio (2021 Birthday event)
