english: Can I help you at all?
No thanks.
Yes please, what are you selling?
No thanks.
Hello there. How's it going?
Hello. Who are you?
I'm an adventurer.
Really? How interesting...
Not too bad, thanks. How about you?
I'm good, thank you.
Sorry, but I have work to do right now.
translation: Üzgünüm, ama su anda yapmam gereken isler var.

english: Hello there! I'm very well, thank you.
Sorry, I'm busy right now.
Welcome to the Mining Guild. Can I help you with anything?
translation: Madencilik Loncasina hos geldiniz. Size yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: What have you got in the guild?
All sorts of things! There's plenty of coal rocks along with some iron, mithril and adamantite as well.
translation: Her türlü sey var! Bol miktarda kömür kayasi, demir, mitril ve adamantit var.

english: Deeper in the guild you'll find even more rocks including some runite! The best bit though is our amethyst mine, the only one in the land!
translation: Lonca'nin derinliklerinde daha fazla kaya bulacaksiniz, hatta runit bile var! En iyisi ise, bu topraklardaki tek ametist madenimiz!

english: There's no better mining site anywhere!
translation: Daha iyi bir madencilik sahasi yok!

english: What do you dwarves do with the ore you mind?
translation: Cüceler madenlerden çikardiklari cevherle ne yapiyorlar?

english: What do you think? We smelt it into bars, smith the metal to make armour and weapons, then we exchange them for goods and services.
translation: Sence ne yapiyorlar? Cevheri eritip külçeler haline getiriyoruz, metali dövüp zirh ve silah yapiyoruz, sonra bunlari mal ve hizmetlerle takas ediyoruz.

english: I don't see many dwarves selling armour or weapons here.
translation: Burada zirh veya silah satan çok fazla cüce görmüyorum.

english: No, this is only a mining outpost. We dwarves don't much like to settle in human cities. Most of the ore is carted off to Keldagrim, the great dwarven city. They've got a special blast furnace up there - it makes
translation: Hayir, burasi sadece bir madencilik karakolu. Biz cüceler insan sehirlerine yerlesmeyi pek sevmeyiz. Cevherin çogu büyük cüce sehri Keldagrim'e tasinir. Orada özel bir yüksek firin var, bu da

english: smelting the ore so much easier. There are plenty of dwarven traders working in Keldagrim. Anyway, can I help you with anything else?
translation: cevherin eritilmesini çok daha kolay hale getiriyor. Keldagrim'de çalisan birçok cüce tüccar var. Her neyse, baska bir konuda yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: No thanks, I'm fine.
Sorry, but you're not experienced enough to go in there.
translation: Üzgünüm, ama oraya girmek için yeterince deneyimli degilsin.

translation: Madencilik Loncasina girmek için 60 madencilik seviyesi gerekiyor.

english: What have you got in the Guild?
What do you dwarves do with the ore you mine?
translation: Madencilikten elde ettiginiz cevherle ne yapiyorsunuz?

english: No thanks, I'm fine.
Hello there. Do you need anything?
translation: Merhaba. Bir seye ihtiyacin var mi?

english: What's through this cave?
This cave leads to the Mining Guild, home to the finest mining site around. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Bu magara, çevrede en iyi madencilik sahasinin bulundugu Madencilik Loncasina açiliyor. Baska bir seye ihtiyaciniz var mi?

english: What have you got in the guild?
All sorts of things! There's plenty of coal rocks along with some iron, mithril and adamantite as well.
translation: Her türlü sey var! Bol miktarda kömür kayasi, demir, mitril ve adamantit de var.

english: Deeper in the guild you'll find even more rocks including some runite! The best bit though is our amethyst mine, the only one in the land!
translation: Loncada daha derine indiginizde, runit de dahil olmak üzere daha fazla kaya bulacaksiniz! En iyisi ise, bu topraklardaki tek ametist madenimiz!

english: There's no better mining site anywhere!
translation: Daha iyi bir maden sahasi yok!

english: What do you dwarves do with the ore you mind?
translation: Siz cüceler, çikardiginiz cevherle ne yapiyorsunuz?

english: What do you think? We smelt it into bars, smith the metal to make armour and weapons, then we exchange them for goods and services.
translation: Sence ne yapiyoruz? Cevheri eritip külçe haline getiriyoruz, metali dövüp zirh ve silah yapiyoruz, sonra bunlari mal ve hizmetlerle takas ediyoruz.

english: I don't see many dwarves selling armour or weapons here.
translation: Burada zirh veya silah satan çok fazla cüce görmüyorum.

english: No, this is only a mining outpost. We dwarves don't much like to settle in human cities. Most of the ore is carted off to Keldagrim, the great dwarven city. They've got a special blast furnace up there - it makes
translation: Hayir, burasi sadece bir maden karakolu. Biz cüceler insan sehirlerine yerlesmeyi pek sevmeyiz. Cevherin çogu büyük cüce sehri Keldagrim'e tasinir. Orada özel bir yüksek firin var, bu da

english: smelting the ore so much easier. There are plenty of dwarven traders working in Keldagrim. Anyway, can I help you with anything else?
translation: cevheri eritmeyi çok daha kolay hale getiriyor. Keldagrim'de çalisan çok sayida cüce tüccar var. Her neyse, baska bir seye ihtiyaciniz var mi?

english: No thanks, I'm fine.
Sorry, but you're not experienced enough to go in there.
translation: Üzgünüm, ama oraya girmek için yeterince deneyimli degilsin.

translation: Madencilik Loncasina erismek için 60. seviye Madencilik seviyesine sahip olman gerekiyor.

english: What have you got in the Guild?
What do you dwarves do with the ore you mine?
translation: Siz cüceler çikardiginiz cevherle ne yapiyorsunuz?

english: No thanks, I'm fine.
I hope the goblins are properly maintaining their stretch of track! I'd hate to see them spoil good Dwarven workmanship.
translation: Umarim goblinler raylarini düzgün bir sekilde bakimini yapiyorlar! Cücelerin iyi isçiligini bozmalarini görmek istemem.

english: You're [player name], aren't you? It's a good job you did helping to get this train link open.
translation: Sen Maceraci'sin, degil mi? Bu tren hattinin açilmasina yardim ettigin için tebrikler.

english: Y'know, at first I didn't like the idea of visiting a goblin city, but these cave goblins are alright.
translation: Biliyor musun, ilk basta bir goblin sehrini ziyaret etme fikri hosuma gitmemisti, ama bu magara goblinleri fena degil.

english: These goblins have so much more advanced technology than us. Take a look at their magical lights! We could never create something like them.
translation: Bu goblinlerin teknolojisi bizden çok daha gelismis. Su sihirli isiklara bak! Biz asla böyle bir sey yaratamayiz.

english: Dorgesh-Kaan's very nice to visit, but I don't think I'd want to live there.
translation: Dorgesh-Kaan'i ziyaret etmek çok güzel, ama orada yasamak istemezdim.

english: Do you have any gold ore that you want me to take to the bank in the city?
translation: Sehirdeki bankaya götürmemi istedigin altin cevherin var mi?

english: I don't have any, I'm afraid.
Well, I have this one piece of ore...
That wouldn't do you much good, I'm afraid. My minimum fee is one piece of gold ore, there wouldn't be anything left for you.
translation: Korkarim bu sana pek bir fayda saglamaz. Minimum ücretim bir parça altin cevher, sana hiçbir sey kalmaz.

english: Yes, please take my gold to the city. I've got [number] pieces of ore right here.
Are you sure you have enough space in your bank account for that?
translation: Banka hesabinda bunun için yeterli para var mi?

english: No, you're right actually, I don't.
Let's see, if I take that to the bank for you, I'd keep [number] for myself and bring [number] to the bank for you. Does that sound fair?
Yes, it does.
Excellent, it's been good doing business with you! I'll take these to the city with my next shipment.
translation: Harika, sizinle is yapmak çok güzeldi! Bunlari bir sonraki sevkiyatimda sehre götürecegim.

english: No, that's far too expensive for me.
translation: Hayir, bu benim için çok pahali.

english: No, I'll hang on to these myself, thanks.
It all seems a bit expensive, really.
I don't know... it's just what Dondakan told me, if someone wanted me to ship their gold.
translation: Bilmiyorum... Dondakan bana öyle söyledi, eger biri altinini göndermemi isterse.

english: There's plenty of gold coming from that rock now, surely you can lower the price somewhat?
translation: O kayadan su anda bol miktarda altin çikiyor, fiyati biraz düsürebilir misiniz?

english: Alright. Tell you what, I'll only keep [number] for myself and bring [number] ores to the bank for you. Deal?
Yes, much appreciated.
Excellent, it's been good doing business with you!
translation: Harika, sizinle is yapmak çok güzeldi!

english: Yes, please take my gold to the city.
Yes.
No.
No, I'll hang on to these myself.
[Charm] It all seems a bit expensive, really.
Happy Easter!
And to you!
Thanks for your help!  You should have a break now.  Come back in [number] minutes if you want to hand out more eggs.
But I'm afraid I've left things a bit late this year.  I'm going to need some help to get all these eggs delivered!  Would you help me, [player name]?
translation: Ama korkarim bu yil isleri biraz geç biraktim.  Tüm bu yumurtalari teslim etmek için biraz yardima ihtiyacim olacak!  Bana yardim eder misin, Maceraci?

english: Yes, of course.
Oh dear, you don't have any free inventory space.  Talk to me again when you have.
translation: Oh hayir, bos envanter alanin yok.  Bos alanin oldugunda tekrar konusalim.

english: Splendid, splendid!  Here's a basket of eggs.  Hand out as many as you can before they disappear and then come back to me.  You've only got two minutes!
translation: Harika, harika!  Iste bir sepet yumurta.  Kaybolmadan önce elinden geldigince çok dagit ve sonra bana geri dön.  Sadece iki dakikan var!

english: Splendid, splendid!  Here's a basket of eggs.  Hand out as many as you can before they disappear and then come back to me for your reward.  You've only got two minutes!
translation: Harika, harika!  Iste bir sepet yumurta.  Kaybolmadan önce elinden geldigince çok dagit ve sonra ödülünü almak için bana geri dön.  Sadece iki dakikan var!

english: No.
Oh dear oh dear!  I've got to hurry!
translation: Oh hayir, oh hayir!  Acele etmeliyim!

english: Quickly, [player name]!  Hand out those eggs before they vanish!
Oh dear, [player name]. You didn't hand out any eggs at all! Do you want to try again?
translation: Oh hayir, Maceraci. Hiç yumurta dagitmadiniz! Tekrar denemek ister misiniz?

english: Thank you, [player name]!  You handed out [number] eggs!
Thank you, [player name]!  You handed out [number] eggs!  Here is your Easter reward!
translation: Tesekkürler, Maceraci! [sayi] yumurta dagittiniz! Iste Paskalya ödülünüz!

english: If you lose it, you can get another one from Diango in Draynor.
translation: Kaybedersen, Draynor'daki Diango'dan bir tane daha alabilirsin.

english: Yes, of course
No
Hello there, are you interested in buying one of my special capes?
translation: Merhaba, özel pelerinlerimden birini satin almak ister misin?

english: What's so special about your capes?

Ahh well they make it less likely that you'll accidently attack anyone wearing the same cape as you and easier to attack everyone else. They also make it easier to distinguish people who're wearing the same cape as you
translation: Ahh, ayni pelerini giyen birini yanlislikla saldirma olasiligini azaltir ve diger herkese saldirmayi kolaylastirir. Ayrica, sizinle ayni pelerini giyen kisileri

english: from everyone else. They're very useful when out in the wilderness with friends or anyone else you don't want to harm.
translation: digerlerinden ayirt etmeyi kolaylastirir. Arkadaslarinizla veya zarar vermek istemediginiz kisilerle vahsi dogada dolasirken çok kullanislidir.

english: So would you like to buy one?
translation: Peki, bir tane satin almak ister misiniz?

english: No thanks.
What's so special about your capes?
Yes please!
No thanks.
Hello, and welcome to The Dark Lord's temple. Zamorak will reward those who offer the bones of the vanquished on his altar.
translation: Merhaba, Karanlik Lord'un tapinagina hos geldiniz. Zamorak, altarinda yenilenlerin kemiklerini sunanlari ödüllendirecektir.

english: I can exchange banknotes for bones, should you require such a service.
translation: Eger böyle bir hizmete ihtiyaciniz varsa, banknotlari kemiklerle degistirebilirim.

english: My services, however, are not free. I charge 50 coins per banknote.
translation: Ancak hizmetlerim ücretsiz degildir. Banknot basina 50 sikke aliyorum.

english: Hand me the banknotes you wish me to exchange.
That is not important. I am here to facilitate your offerings to The Dark Lord. Would you like any bone banknotes exchanged?
translation: Bu önemli degil. Ben, Karanlik Lord'a sunularinizi kolaylastirmak için buradayim. Kemik banknotlarini degistirmek ister misiniz?

english: No thanks.
The druid does not deal with Deadmen.[confirmation needed]
I exchange banknotes for real items. That's not a banknote.
translation: Banknotlari gerçek esyalarla degistiriyorum. Bu banknot degil.

english: I only exchange items that can be offered as a sacrifice to The Dark Lord's altar.
translation: Sadece Karanlik Lord'un sunaklarina kurban olarak sunulabilecek esyalari degistiriyorum.

english: I charge 50 coins for exchanging each banknote.
translation: Her banknotu degistirmek için 50 sikke aliyorum.

english: Your inventory is too full.
Yes please.
Who are you?
No thanks.
I can't believe we've finally arrived, I can't wait to explore!
translation: Sonunda vardigimiza inanamiyorum, kesfetmek için sabirsizlaniyorum!

english: So much to see, I don't know where to start!
translation: Görülecek o kadar çok sey var ki, nereden baslayacagimi bilemiyorum!

english: A whole new continent to explore... what a time to be alive!
translation: Kesfedilecek yepyeni bir kita... Ne harika bir zaman!

english: Are you the tour guide?
Nope, I'm just as lost as you.
translation: Hayir, ben de senin kadar kayboldum.

english: I overheard someone mention there are pirates and thieves here, be careful!
translation: Burada korsanlar ve hirsizlar oldugunu duydum, dikkatli ol!

english: Hello, I'm the tax collector. Got any windows I can tax?
translation: Merhaba, ben vergi tahsildariyim. Vergilendirebilecegim penceren var mi?

english: I dream of windows.
Hello, I'm the tax collector. I'm taxing beards and I can't help noticing you have a beard.
translation: Merhaba, ben vergi tahsildariyim. Sakallara vergi aliyorum ve sakaliniz oldugunu fark ettim.

english: What? I'm a beggar. Do I look as if I have any money? Look, take everything I own why don't you?
translation: Ne? Ben bir dilenciyim. Param varmis gibi mi görünüyorum? Bakin, sahip oldugum her seyi alin, neden almiyorsunuz?

english: Err, thanks. Maybe I don't need to tax you.
translation: Sey, tesekkürler. Belki de sizden vergi almam gerekmez.

english: No, take it!
I don't care any more.
Spare us a few coppers [mister/miss]
No, go away!
Is this place haunted?

english: I don't think so. Would it matter if it was?
translation: Sanmiyorum. Öyle olsa ne fark eder ki?
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: Maybe, it depends how haunted. I'm not a big fan of ghosts.
translation: Belki, ne kadar hayaletli olduguna bagli. Hayaletleri pek sevmem.
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: Well, let's hope it's not haunted!
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: Have you thought about painting the building?
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: I'm thinking a nice bold red, like the dragon armour.
translation: Ejderha zirhi gibi güzel, koyu kirmizi bir renk düsünüyorum.
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: Or maybe a green, in memory of Elvarg, a very mean dragon.
translation: Ya da çok kötü bir ejderha olan Elvarg'in anisina yesil olabilir.
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: I think green would look great, it would match the surroundings, too!
translation: Yesil harika olur, çevreye de uyum saglar!
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: Could I get one of those rune platebodies?
translation: O rune zirhlarindan bir tane alabilir miyim?
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: Well, normally you'd have to slay a dragon for me...
translation: Normalde bunun için bir ejderha öldürmen gerekir...
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: ...but maybe I can make an exception once I've moved in here.
translation: ...ama buraya tasindiktan sonra bir istisna yapabilirim.
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: As a little thank you for the help!
translation: Yardimin için küçük bir tesekkür olarak!
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: That would be great! Let's get this deal done quickly.
translation: Harika olur! Hadi bu isi çabuk halledelim.
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: I can't wait to complete the purchase!
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: It's almost done Oziach, not much longer.
translation: Neredeyse bitti Oziach, çok az kaldi.
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: Do you have any plans for it?
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: I have a few. I might convert the top floor into a bar!
translation: Birkaç tane var. En üst kati bara çevirebilirim!
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: It'll be for all dragon slayers I know, there's a lot of us!
translation: Tanidigim tüm ejderha avcilari için olacak, sayimiz çok fazla!
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: Interesting use of such a beautiful property!
translation: Böyle güzel bir mülkü ilginç bir sekilde kullanacaksin!
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: OoooOooOoOoOoooooooo!
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: Ah!! Why did you do that?
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: That scared me!
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: I'm sorry! I was just pretending to be a ghost.
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: Don't do that! I don't like ghosts.
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: Hello.
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: Sorry [player name], I'm talking to Oziach right now.
translation: Üzgünüm Maceraci, su anda Oziach ile konusuyorum.
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: I'm going to head back to the office.
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: Alright, I'll see you later. Can't wait to move in!
translation: Tamam, sonra görüsürüz. Tasinmak için sabirsizlaniyorum!
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: I know, it's a lovely place! See you!
translation: Biliyorum, çok güzel bir yer! Görüsürüz!
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: The estate agent leaves.
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: So many ghosts... I need some help!
translation: Çok fazla hayalet var... Yardima ihtiyacim var!
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: Oziach! Are you okay? I heard shouting!
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: Hello! It's not going well. There are a lot of ghosts here!
translation: Merhaba! Isler yolunda gitmiyor. Burada bir sürü hayalet var!
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: That's not good at all!
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: Do you still want to go ahead with the purchase?
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: Of course! TWO ghosts is scary, but not that scary!
translation: Tabii ki! Iki hayalet korkutucu, ama o kadar da degil!
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: I'll hire myself one of those slayers we see everywhere.
translation: Her yerde gördügümüz avcilardan birini tutacagim.
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: They will help with the ghost problem!
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: Phew, that is lovely news! I thought it was all over, then.
translation: Vay canina, bu harika bir haber! Her seyin bittigini sanmistim.
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: I'll head back to the office, meet me there shortly.
translation: Ofise geri dönecegim, birazdan orada bulusalim.
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: I'll be doing the final paperwork.
sub_category: Dialogue for Estate agent (2021 Halloween event)

english: Hey Eve!
[player name]! You're back! Here to party some more?
translation: Maceraci! Geri dönmüssün! Biraz daha parti yapmak için mi geldin?

english: You never get sick of partying, do you?
Well, you see, I spend the rest of the year in the afterlife. And that is quite boring.
translation: Sey, ben yilin geri kalanini öbür dünyada geçiriyorum. Ve bu oldukça sikici.

english: The afterlife?
Yes. You know, where you go when you die. Anyway, that's boring stuff. Coming back here is fun!
translation: Evet. Bilirsin, öldügünde gittigin yer. Neyse, sikici bir yer. Buraya dönmek çok eglenceli!

english: How do you come back?
Magic, my friend!
What kind of magic?
You wouldn't understand. If you're so interested, talk to the other people around here. They've returned from the afterlife as well!
translation: Anlamazsin. Eger çok merak ediyorsan, buradaki diger insanlarla konus. Onlar da öbür dünyadan döndüler!

english: Have they? Interesting.
Goodbye.
Come back soon!
What kind of magic?
Goodbye.
Bwaaaaaauk bwuk bwuk
Bwuk
Bwuk bwuk bwuk
Flee from me, [player name]!
Begone, [player name]!
MUAHAHAHAHAAA!
How dare you invade my lair! DIE INTRUDER!

english: The Queen is the true ruler of Zanaris! We shall over- throw the tyrant!
translation: Kraliçe, Zanaris'in gerçek hükümdaridir! Tirani devirecegiz!

english: Is the council finished yet?
Once the council of war is finished we shall go and get rid of the Godfather.
translation: Savas konseyi bittiginde gidip Godfather'i ortadan kaldiracagiz.

english: I'm so looking forward to going back home!
Thank you for waking our queen.
Now that the Queen is awake everything will be alright.
translation: Kraliçe uyandi, artik her sey yoluna girecek.

english: This fairy ring will take you out of Zanaris. It leads to the place known as Al-Kharid in your realm. Once passed you can not return this way.
translation: Bu peri halkasi seni Zanaris'ten çikaracak. Senin dünyandaki Al-Kharid adli yere götürecek. Bir kez geçtikten sonra bu yoldan geri dönemezsin.

english: Before leaving make sure that you have fully sampled the delights of our marketplace.
translation: Gitmeden önce pazarimizin lezzetlerini iyice tattigindan emin ol.

english: I think I'll stay down here a bit longer.
As you wish.
Yes, I'm ready to leave.

Yes, I'm ready to leave.

english: I would prefer it if you didn't speak to me in such a manner. I'll have you know I'm an accomplished merchant.
translation: Bana bu sekilde hitap etmemenizi tercih ederim. Ben basarili bir tüccarim, bilginiz olsun.
sub_category: Dialogue for Farid Morrisane (ores and bars)

english: Calm down, junior.
sub_category: Dialogue for Farid Morrisane (ores and bars)

english: Don't tell me to calm down! And don't call me 'junior'.
translation: Bana sakin ol deme! Ve bana “evlat” deme.
sub_category: Dialogue for Farid Morrisane (ores and bars)

english: I'll have you know I am Farid Morrisane, son of Ali Morrisane, the world's greatest merchant!
translation: Ben Farid Morrisane, dünyanin en büyük tüccari Ali Morrisane'nin ogluyum, bilginiz olsun!
sub_category: Dialogue for Farid Morrisane (ores and bars)

english: Then why are you here and not him?
translation: O zaman neden o degil de sen buradasin?
sub_category: Dialogue for Farid Morrisane (ores and bars)

english: My dad has given me the responsibility of expanding our business here.
translation: Babam buradaki isimizi büyütme sorumlulugunu bana verdi.
sub_category: Dialogue for Farid Morrisane (ores and bars)

english: And you're up to the task? What a grown up boy you are! Mummy and daddy must be very pleased!
translation: Ve bu görevi yerine getirebilecek misin? Ne kadar da olgun bir çocuksun! Annen ve baban çok memnun olmalilar!
sub_category: Dialogue for Farid Morrisane (ores and bars)

english: Look, [mate/darling] - I may be young, I may be short, but I'm a respected merchant around here and don't have time to deal with simpletons like you.
translation: Bak, Genç olabilirim, boyum kisa olabilir, ama buradaki saygin bir tüccarim ve senin gibi ahmaklarla ugrasacak vaktim yok.
sub_category: Dialogue for Farid Morrisane (ores and bars)

english: Can you show me the prices of ores and bars?
translation: Cevher ve külçelerin fiyatlarini gösterir misiniz?
sub_category: Dialogue for Farid Morrisane (ores and bars)

english: I best go and speak with someone more my height.
translation: Benim boyumda biriyle konussam daha iyi olacak.
sub_category: Dialogue for Farid Morrisane (ores and bars)

english: Then I shall not stop you, [mister/miss]. I've too much work to do.
translation: O zaman sizi durdurmayayim. Yapacak çok isim var.
sub_category: Dialogue for Farid Morrisane (ores and bars)

english: My father shall be so pleased.
sub_category: Dialogue for Farid Morrisane (ores and bars)

english: Hello there. How's it going?
Well the work is going well, so I'm very good, thank you.
translation: Isler iyi gidiyor, ben çok iyiyim, tesekkürler.

english: Not too bad thanks.
I'm fine, how are you?
Very well, thank you.
Nilsal! I'm pretty good, thank you. It's always nice to be out in the sun.
translation: Nilsal! Ben oldukça iyiyim, tesekkürler. Güneste olmak her zaman güzeldir.

english: Hello there! Nice weather we've been having. Perfect for a day outdoors!
translation: Merhaba! Hava çok güzel. Disarida geçirmek için mükemmel bir gün!

english: Oi! Leave my wheat alone!
Hello stranger.
You look like a farmer. Don't see many farmers around here.
translation: Çiftçiye benziyorsun. Buralarda pek çiftçi görmüyorum.

english: Aye, that you don't. I'm from Hosidius, y'see. I just come here to drink.
translation: Evet, görmüyorsun. Ben Hosidius'tanim. Buraya sadece içmeye geldim.

english: You travel all the way out to Shayzien just for a few beers? Don't you have a pub back home?
translation: Sadece birkaç bira içmek için Shayzien'e kadar mi geldin? Senin memleketinde pub yok mu?

english: Indeed we do... But I can't stand the place for more than a few minutes.
translation: Elbette var... Ama o yeri birkaç dakikadan fazla dayanamiyorum.

english: Have you ever been in there? Such a rowdy crowd... people shouting across the bar about 'Farming this', 'Farming that'... can barely hear myself think half the time.
translation: Hiç oraya gittin mi? Çok gürültülü bir yer... Insanlar barda “Çiftçilik sudur, çiftçilik budur” diye bagiriyor... Çogu zaman kendi düsüncelerimi bile duyamiyorum.

english: No, no... Can't be doin' with it. That's why I make the trip out here for a nice quiet one.
translation: Hayir, hayir... Orada duramam. Bu yüzden buraya gelip sessiz sakin bir yer ariyorum.

english: Well I'd better leave you to it then!
Hello there. How's it going?
Well, the work is going well, so I'm very good, thank you.
translation: Isler iyi gidiyor, ben çok iyiyim, tesekkürler.

english: Not too bad thanks.
I'm fine, how are you?
Very well, thank you.
Nilsal! I'm pretty good, thank you.
translation: Nilsal! Ben oldukça iyiyim, tesekkürler. Güneste olmak her zaman güzeldir.

english: Hello there! Nice weather we've been having.
translation: Merhaba! Hava çok güzel. Disarida geçirmek için mükemmel bir gün!

english: Exchuse me... I am trying to tell my verrry good friends 'bout the biggest bull I ever raised.
translation: Affedersiniz... Çok iyi arkadaslarima simdiye kadar yetistirdigim en büyük bogayi anlatmaya çalisiyorum.

english: Exchuse me... I am lishning to my good friend.
Mean pair of horns he'd got.
Got enough leather off 'im for a new carpet.
translation: Ondan yeni bir hali yapacak kadar deri elde ettik.

english: Grew to the size of a cart, I swear!
translation: Yemin ederim, bir araba kadar büyüdü!

english: It's not like that these days.
'E went MOO MOO MOO all night.
translation: Bütün gece MOO MOO MOO diye bagirdi.

english: Never had a year like that since.
translation: O zamandan beri böyle bir yil yasamadim.

english: That prize should've been mine!
Ol' Hosidius thought we'd need a bigger barn.
translation: Yasli Hosidius daha büyük bir ahir ihtiyacimiz olacagini düsündü.

english: Best bull I ever 'ad.
I've got a brand new plough!
No-one got so much corn out of one field before.
translation: Daha önce kimse bir tarladan bu kadar çok misir elde etmemisti.

english: Sacks and sacks of grain like you've never seen!
translation: Hiç görmediginiz kadar çok tahil çuvali!

english: Hosidius says we gotta optimise land use. Bleah!
translation: Hosidius, arazi kullanimini optimize etmemiz gerektigini söylüyor. Bleah!

english: Them dwarves won't pay a decent price anymore.
translation: Cüceler artik makul bir fiyat ödemiyorlar.

english: Best harvest we'd ever 'ad.
translation: Simdiye kadar elde ettigimiz en iyi hasat.

english: 'Course, the weather were better back then.
translation: Tabii, o zamanlar hava daha iyiydi.

english: Fed the kids for a year off 'is beef.
translation: Bu sigirin etiyle çocuklari bir yil besledik.

english: Could 'ave passed for a mammoth.
Ain't no-one ever tipped that bull.
You've never seen a bull like 'im.
Pearls of wisdom!
Ah, tell it!
Best times ever!
Right you are.
Great days!
I'm going to be sick!
You're right.
You're so right.
Those were the days!
Not like nowadays.
Hello there. How's it going?
Well the work is going well, so I'm very good, thank you.
translation: Isler iyi gidiyor, ben çok iyiyim, tesekkürler.

english: Not too bad thanks.
I'm fine, how are you?
Very well, thank you.
Nilsal! I'm pretty good, thank you. It's always nice to be out in the sun.
translation: Nilsal! Ben gayet iyiyim, tesekkürler. Güneste olmak her zaman güzeldir.

english: Hello there! Nice weather we've been having. Perfect for a day outdoors!
translation: Merhaba! Hava çok güzel. Disarida geçirmek için mükemmel bir gün!

english: Could I buy some fish?
Where do you get your fish from?
Some questions are best left unanswered.
translation: Bazi sorular cevaplanmasa daha iyi olur.

english: Err...
So would you like to buy some fish?
I'll pass.
Suit yourself.
Could I buy some fish?
Where do you get your fish from?
Yes please.
I'll pass.
Good fish. Just keep swimming...swimming...swimming...
translation: Iyi balik. Yüzmeye devam et... yüzmeye... yüzmeye...

english: The fish swims. It is clearly an obedient fish.
translation: Balik yüzüyor. Açikça itaatkar bir balik.

english: Jump! Come on fishy, jump!
The fish bumps into the side of the fishbowl. Then it swims some more.
translation: Balik akvaryumun kenarina çarpiyor. Sonra biraz daha yüzüyor.

english: Good fish...
Hello there.
His eyes are staring vacantly into space.
You are not part of our family...
translation: Sen bizim ailemizin bir parçasi degilsin...

english: Umm. Not last time I checked.
Soon you will be... Soon you will...
Lost to us.. She is Lost to us...
Who is lost?
Trapped by the light... Lost and trapped...
translation: Isigin tuzagina düstü... Kaybetti ve tuzaga düstü...

english: Ermm... So you don't want to tell me then?
Trapped... In stone and darkness...
Must find family...
What?
Soon we will all be together...
Are you ok?
Must find family... They are all under the blue... Deep deep under the blue...
translation: Aileyi bulmaliyiz... Hepsi mavinin altinda... Mavinin çok derinlerinde...

english: Ermm... I'll leave you to it then.
translation: Ermm... O zaman seni rahat birakayim.

english: Free of the deep blue we are...
We must find...
Yes?
a new home...
We must leave this place...
Where will you go?
Away.. Away to her...
Riiight.
Below the deep, deep blue she waits...
Who waits?
They came to her with fire and faith...
Who? Who came to who?
Too many... Too many...
Too many what? Make sense!
Locked away for all eternity...
You'd better start making sense Sonny Jim or I'll...
translation: Anlatmaya baslasan iyi olur Sonny Jim yoksa ben...

english: Free... Soon to be free...
Must escape the blue.. Deep deep blue
Pardon?
Family... Under the blue... Must escape the blue...
What do you want, outsider?
What are you doing out here?
Port Piscarilius have given me permission to catch anglerfish, this is the only place you can find them!
translation: Port Piscarilius bana anglerfish avlama izni verdi, onlari bulabilecegin tek yer burasi!

english: How can I catch anglerfish?
Only friends of Port Piscarilius are allowed to know such things, I'm afraid.
translation: Korkarim ki, sadece Port Piscarilius'un dostlari böyle seyleri bilebilir.

english: I have heard good things about you, outsider, however, you will need to train your fishing skill before catching these.
translation: Senin hakkinda iyi seyler duydum, yabanci, ancak bunlari avlamadan önce balikçilik becerilerini gelistirmelisin.

english: I have heard good things about you, outsider. You will need a fishing rod and some sandworms to use as bait, if you need supplies, try Tynan's shoreside store.
translation: Senin hakkinda iyi seyler duydum, yabanci. Bir olta ve yem olarak kullanmak için kum solucanlarina ihtiyacin olacak, malzeme ihtiyacin varsa Tynan'in sahil magazasini dene.

english: Thanks. I'll let you get back to fishing.
I'll let you get back to it.
What are you doing out here?
How can I catch anglerfish?
I'll let you get back to it.
Hello there.
Don't talk to me outerlander. Anything you have to say to me, you can say to the Chieftain. Goodbye.
translation: Benimle konusma, yabanci. Bana söyleyecegin her seyi Sef'e söyleyebilirsin. Hosça kal.

english: Are you a member of the Fremmenik council?
Indeed I am, outerlander. Why do you ask?
Well, I was told by Brundt that I could be voted into the tribe as an honorary Fremmenik if I could find seven members of the council of elders to vote in my favour.
translation: Brundt, konsey üyelerinden yedi kisinin lehime oy vermesi halinde, onursal Fremmenik olarak kabileye kabul edilebilecegimi söyledi.

english: Aye, that is indeed true.
So can I have your vote?
You can have my vote on the day the skies turn red, the waters turn pink, the rocks turn yellow and the sun turns black.
translation: Gökyüzü kirmiziya, sular pembeye, kayalar sariya ve günes siyaha döndügü gün oyumu alabilirsiniz.

english: Um... do you have any estimate on when that is?
translation: Sey... bunun ne zaman olacagina dair bir tahmininiz var mi?

english: I'm telling you I will never vote for you, you stupid outlander.
translation: Sana asla oy vermeyecegimi söylüyorum, seni aptal yabanci.

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a flower from across the sea, do you?
translation: Denizin ötesinden bir çiçek bulabilecegim bir yer biliyor musun?

english: I never saw anything like that in my store before.
translation: Magazamda daha önce böyle bir sey görmedim.

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find an exotic and extremely rare fish, do you?
translation: Egzotik ve çok nadir bir balik bulabilecegim bir yer biliyor musun?

english: Ah, so even outerlanders have heard of my amazing catch the other day!
translation: Ah, demek yabancilar bile geçen günkü muhtesem avimi duymuslar!

english: You have it? Can I trade you something for it?
translation: Sende mi var? Onunla bir sey takas edebilir miyim?

english: As exotic looking as it is, it is bad eating. I will happily trade it if you can find me the secret map of the best fishing spots that the navigator has hidden away.
translation: Egzotik görünüsüne ragmen tadi kötü. Eger navigatörün sakladigi en iyi balik tutma yerlerinin gizli haritasini bulabilirsen, seve seve takas ederim.

english: Is that all?
Indeed it is, outerlander. The only reason I sit out here in the cold all day long is so I don't have to pay his outrageous prices.
translation: Evet, yabanci. Bütün gün burada sogukta oturmamin tek nedeni, onun fahis fiyatlarini ödemek zorunda kalmamak.

english: By getting me his copy of that map, I will finally be self sufficient. I might even make a profit!
translation: O haritanin bir kopyasini bana getirirsen, sonunda kendi kendime yetebilirim. Hatta kar bile edebilirim!

english: I'll see what I can do.
I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a map of deep sea fishing spots do you?
translation: Derin deniz balikçilik noktalarinin haritasini nerede bulabilecegimi biliyor musun?

english: You should pay attention when I speak! I already told you, that rip off navigator has it, and I want it!
translation: Konustugumda dikkatini ver! Sana söyledim, o dolandirici navigatörde var ve ben onu istiyorum!

english: Here. I got you your map.
Great work outerlander! With this, I can finally catch enough fish to make an honest living from it! Here, have the stupid rare fish.
translation: Aferin yabanci! Bununla nihayet dürüst bir yasam sürmek için yeterli balik tutabilecegim! Al, bu aptal nadir baligi al.

english: I don't see what's so special about this so called rare fish.
translation: Bu sözde nadir baligin neyi bu kadar özel oldugunu anlamiyorum.

english: Me neither, outerlander. That is why I gave it to you.
translation: Ben de, yabanci. Bu yüzden sana verdim.

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It has been too long since last we spoke! The fish are really biting today!
Ask about the Merchant's trial
Ask about becoming a Fremennik
Hey! You can't come through here! This is private land!
translation: Hey! Buradan geçemezsiniz! Burasi özel mülk!

english: You will need to find another way in.
Nice weather we're having today.
It's so peaceful here, don't you agree?
There's plenty of trees around, couldn't you go to another spot?
translation: Etrafta bolca agaç var, baska bir yere gidemez misiniz?

english: Hello!
Hello friend. I wish to slay evil and avail them of their loot! Take me to Burgh de Rott!
translation: Merhaba dostum. Kötülügü yok etmek ve ganimetlerini ele geçirmek istiyorum! Beni Burgh de Rott'a götür!

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
I think so? At least my heart knows courage and that should be sufficient for the meantime. I expect that when we get to Burgh de Rott, we'll be able to purchase suitable provisions.
translation: Sanirim öyle. En azindan kalbim cesaret dolu ve bu simdilik yeterli olmali. Burgh de Rott'a vardigimizda uygun erzak satin alabilecegimizi umuyorum.

english: But you do realise that the vampyres in Morytania are immune to everything except silver?
translation: Ama Morytania'daki vampirlerin gümüs disinda her seye karsi bagisik olduklarini biliyor musun?

english: Er...well, I've not heard mention of that fact, but I have faith that Saradomin will provide the means to furnish me with suitable weapons when I reach Burgh de Rott.
translation: Sey... Bu konuda bir sey duymadim, ama Burgh de Rott'a vardigimda Saradomin'in bana uygun silahlar saglayacagina inaniyorum.

english: And if we happen to run into some vampyres on the journey down there?
translation: Ya oraya giderken yolda vampirlerle karsilasirsak?

english: I trust that you will help us to avoid them. You are a guide after all, aren't you? Anyway, you look like you can handle yourself. I presume you've fought such creatures before and won? How hard can it be?
translation: Onlardan kaçinmamiza yardim edecegine inaniyorum. Sonuçta sen bir rehbersin, degil mi? Her neyse, kendini savunabilecek gibi görünüyorsun. Daha önce bu tür yaratiklarla savasip kazandin mi? Ne kadar zor olabilir ki?

english: It can be pretty difficult, actually. But you're right, I'll be your guide so I should be able to handle the situation.
translation: Aslinda oldukça zor olabilir. Ama haklisin, ben senin rehberin olacagim, bu yüzden durumu halledebilmeliyim.

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Neden Burgh de Rott'a gitmek istiyorsun?

english: I'm going down there to teach those vampyres a lesson or two. I've heard about the terrible conditions down there and I intend to put a stop to it.
translation: Oradaki vampirleri bir ders vermek için gidiyorum. Oradaki korkunç kosullari duydum ve buna bir son vermek niyetindeyim.

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Burgh de Rott'a giderken yol üzerinde düsmanlarla karsilasirsak kendini savunabilir misin?

english: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of enemies. You don't need to worry about that.
translation: Diyelim ki biraz tecrübeliyim ve düsmanlarla savasmaktan çekinmem. Bu konuda endiselenmene gerek yok.

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: Hmmm, görünüse göre bir takipçin var. Kendi basina dolasmaya birakilirsa bu yolculukta kaybolabilir. Takipçin güvende oldugunda yola çikalim.

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: Gerçekten mi? Bu harika olur! Hedefe vardigimizda sana küçük bir ödül verecegim.

english: Burgh de Rott Ramble begins
Ok, which route should we take?
Ok, thanks.
Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: Ah, bana biraz erzak vermek istiyorsun, ha? Sirt çantami açayim.

english: This place is a bit grim. How can people live here?
translation: Burasi biraz kasvetli. Insanlar burada nasil yasayabiliyor?

english: Do you visit Burgh de Rott often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: Burgh de Rott'a sik sik gelir misin? Rotayi iyi biliyorsun gibi görünüyor.

english: When are we going to get to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Burgh de Rott'a ne zaman varacagiz?

english: We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on. I have loot to get.
translation: Bütün gün burada durup sohbet edemeyiz, hadi devam edelim. Yagmalayacak seyler var.

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than the opulet life styles forced on us adventurer types. I'd much rather be up to my eyes in mud and having a good fight!
translation: Oh, bu yolculuktan nefret ediyorum, ama maceraperest tiplere dayatilan lüks yasam tarzindan daha iyidir. Gözlerime kadar çamura batip iyi bir kavga etmeyi tercih ederim!

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...
Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Paterdomus. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: Vay canina! Görünüse göre Paterdomus'a geri dönmek zorundayiz. O köprüden geçemeyiz!

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
Player completes the bridge event
Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Paterdomus.
translation: Bu is bitti... Görünüse göre bu batakliktan geçemeyecegiz. Paterdomus'a geri dönmek zorundayiz.

english: Player completes the bog event
Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: Hey... bu harika... harika bir is çikardin... Seni takip edecegim.

english: Whahay...that was great!
But we really should be heading off now.
Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
Player completes the river event
That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: Bu harika! Ben de aynisini yapmaliyim.

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: Vay canina! Harikaydi! Ama artik gerçekten yola çikmaliyiz.

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
This is scary!
Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
Ahhh, two tentacles!
...three tentacles!
I think I'm going to faint!
Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: Vay canina! Su canavara bak! O seyi kendi basina halletmen gerekecek!

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the Burgh de Rott. Here's your reward.
translation: Beni Burgh de Rott'a güvenle ulastirdigin için çok tesekkürler. Iste ödülün.

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Neden Burgh de Rott'a gitmek istiyorsun?

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
Ok, thanks.
I hope they come home soon...
Hello, what's going on?
Hey, [player name], can you help me with some pheasants?
translation: Hey, Maceraci, bana birkaç sülün yakalamamda yardim eder misin?

english: Collect the eggs from the uninhabited nests and bring them to me, and I'll reward you.
translation: Issiz yuvalardan yumurtalari topla ve bana getir, seni ödüllendirecegim.

english: Well, come back if you change your mind.
I have an egg for you.
These pheasants will be finding new nesting grounds soon.
translation: Bu sülünler yakinda yeni yuvalama alanlari bulacaklar.

english: Sure, how can I help?
Sorry, I'm busy.
How are you today?
**sigh**
That good? Everyone around here seems a little depressed.
translation: O kadar mi iyi? Buradaki herkes biraz depresif görünüyor.

english: And not particularly talkative.
I'll leave you to your sighing. It looks like you have plenty to do.
translation: Seni iç çekislerine birakayim. Yapacak çok isin var gibi görünüyor.

english: It's a bit grey round here, isn't it?
It gets you down after a while, you know. There are 273 shades of grey, you know, and we have them all.
translation: Bir süre sonra insani moralini bozuyor, biliyorsun. 273 ton gri var, biliyorsun, ve biz hepsine sahibiz.

english: That's grey-t.
That attempt at humour merely made me more depressed. Leave me alone.
translation: Bu espri denemesi beni daha da depresif yapti. Beni rahat birak.

english: How's the King treating you then?
Like serfs.
Serf?
Yes, you know - peons, plebs, the downtrodden. He treats us like his own personal possessions.
translation: Evet, biliyorsun - isçi, pleb, ezilenler. Bizi kendi kisisel mülkiyeti gibi görüyor.

english: You should leave this place.
I keep trying to save up enough to leave, but the King keeps taxing us! We have no money left.
translation: Ayrilmak için para biriktirmeye çalisiyorum ama Kral bize sürekli vergi koyuyor! Hiç paramiz kalmadi.

english: Oh dear.
Cheer up! It's not the end of the world.
I'd prefer that, if it meant I didn't have to talk to people as inanely happy as you.
translation: Senin gibi aptalca mutlu insanlarla konusmak zorunda kalmayacaksam, bunu tercih ederim.

english: Whoa! I think you need to get out more.
translation: Vay canina! Bence daha fazla disari çikmalisin.

english: Hurrah for the frog [prince/princess]!
Don't talk to me! Speak to the frog [prince/princess]!
​The frogs do not need your help right now.
translation: Su anda kurbagalarin yardiminiza ihtiyaci yok.

english: Don't look at me, I'm just a frog. Ribbit! Ribbit!
translation: Bana bakmayin, ben sadece bir kurbagayim. Ribbit! Ribbit!

english: Hello, [player name]
[player name], the frog [prince/princess] desires your attention!
If you kiss [him/her], [player name], [he/she] will turn into a human!
But if you ignore [him/her], [player name], we will turn you into a frog!
translation: Ama onu görmezden gelirsen, Maceraci, seni kurbagaya çeviririz!

english: That's IT, [player name] you're a frog!
translation: Iste bu kadar, Maceraci, sen bir kurbagasin!

english: Err, excuse me?
Why? Am I in your way?
That was just plain weird!
Would you like to trade in fur?
No thanks.
Yes please.
No thanks.
I don't sell to outerlanders.
Only Fremenniks may purchase furs here.
translation: Burada sadece Fremennikler kürk satin alabilir.

english: Welcome back [Fremennik name]! Have you seen the furs I have today?
Hey! Get your hands off there!
You think me stupid [Fremennik name]?
Guardsguards!
You're the one who stole something from me!
Hello there. What are you doing here?
I'm waiting here hoping that someone can guide me to the Paterdomus, the temple on the Salve.
translation: Biri beni Salve'deki Paterdomus tapinagina götürür diye burada bekliyorum.

english: Where is Paterdomus?
Oh, Paterdomus is that rather impressive looking temple on the Salve... I'm sure you must have passed it on your way into Morytania.
translation: Paterdomus, Salve'deki oldukça etkileyici görünümlü tapinaktir... Morytania'ya giderken oradan geçmis olmalisin.

english: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
I'm hoping to get back to civilisation and see what the lands of Misthalin look like.
translation: Medeniyete geri dönüp Misthalin topraklarinin nasil bir yer oldugunu görmek istiyorum.

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Paterdomus?
translation: Paterdomus'a giderken yol üzerinde düsmanlarla karsilasirsak kendini savunabilir misin?

english: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of bad guys. You don't need to worry about that.
translation: Diyelim ki biraz tecrübeliyim ve kötü adamlarla savasmaktan çekinmem. Bu konuda endiselenmene gerek yok.

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: Hmmm, görünüse göre bir takipçin var. Kendi basina dolasirsa bu yolculukta kaybolabilir. Takipçin güvende oldugunda yola çikalim.

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: Gerçekten mi? Bu harika olur! Hedefe vardigimizda sana küçük bir ödül verecegim.

english: Temple Trekking begins
Ok, which route should we take?
Ok, thanks.
Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: Ah, bana biraz erzak vermek istiyorsun, ha? Sirt çantami açayim.

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than staying in Burgh de Rott.
translation: Oh, bu yolculuktan nefret ediyorum, ama Burgh de Rott'ta kalmaktan iyidir.

english: It's scary here...let's get going!
When are we going to get to Paterdomus?
We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on.
translation: Bütün gün burada durup sohbet edecek vaktimiz yok; hadi devam edelim.

english: Do you visit Paterdomus often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: Paterdomus'u sik sik ziyaret eder misin? Rotayi iyi biliyorsun galiba.

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...?
Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Burgh de Rott. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: Hay aksi! Burgh de Rott'a geri dönmek zorunda kalacagiz galiba. O köprüyü geçemeyiz!

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
Player completes the bridge event
Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Burgh de Rott.
translation: Bu is bitti... Görünüse göre bu batakligi geçemeyecegiz. Burgh de Rott'a geri dönmek zorundayiz.

english: Player completes the bog event
Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: Hey... bu harika... harika bir is çikardin... Seni takip edecegim.

english: Whahay...that was great!
But we really should be heading off now.
Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
Player completes the river event
That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: Bu harika! Ben de aynisini yapmaliyim.

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: Vay canina! Harikaydi! Ama artik gerçekten yola çikmaliyiz.

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
This is scary!
Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
Ahhh, two tentacles!
...three tentacles!
I think I'm going to faint!
Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: Vay canina! Su canavara bak! O seyi kendi basina halletmen gerekecek!

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the temple. Here's your reward.
translation: Beni tapinaga güvenle ulastirdigin için çok tesekkürler. Iste ödülün.

english: Where is Paterdomus?
Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
I can take you to Paterdomus.
Ok, thanks.
Hello there.
Can you tell me about this castle?
translation: Bu kale hakkinda bana bilgi verebilir misin?

english: It's called Ver Sinhaza. They say it was once the home of a Saradominist queen. Now it belongs to Verzik Vitur, a vampyre noble.
translation: Adi Ver Sinhaza. Bir zamanlar Saradominist bir kraliçenin evi oldugu söylenir. Simdi ise vampir soylusu Verzik Vitur'a aittir.

english: Beneath the castle you'll find the Theatre of Blood. Every day, citizens of Meiyerditch take on various challenges set up by Verzik, all the provide entertainment for the vampyres.
translation: Kalenin altinda Kan Tiyatrosu bulunur. Her gün, Meiyerditch vatandaslari Verzik'in hazirladigi çesitli görevleri yerine getirerek vampirleri eglendirirler.

english: The citizens don't need to be forced though. Anyone who survives the Theatre is promised freedom from the vampyres. It provides a little bit of hope in this dark place.
translation: Ancak vatandaslar zorlanmiyor. Tiyatrodan sag çikanlara vampirlerden kurtulma sözü veriliyor. Bu karanlik yerde biraz umut veriyor.

english: Do you know anything about the Myreque?
translation: Myreque hakkinda bir sey biliyor musun?

english: I do. I'd rather not talk about them though. Those kinds of conversations get you in trouble.
translation: Biliyorum. Ama onlar hakkinda konusmak istemiyorum. Bu tür konusmalar basini belaya sokar.

english: Old Man Ral might be willing to talk to you about them though. He lives in sector one of Meiyerditch, directly west of here.
translation: Yasli Ral seninle onlar hakkinda konusmak isteyebilir. Meiyerditch'in birinci sektöründe, buradan batiya dogru yasiyor.

english: Can you tell me about the Sanguinesti region?
translation: Sanguinesti bölgesi hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Yep, that's where wee are at the moment. The region is split into two cities, Meiyerditch in the south and Darkmeyer in the north.
translation: Evet, su anda bulundugumuz yer orasi. Bölge, güneydeki Meiyerditch ve kuzeydeki Darkmeyer olmak üzere iki sehre ayrilmistir.

english: Meiyerditch is just one large ghetto. The city is split into sectors so that the vampyres can collect blood tithes on a rotational basis. That way they don't kill everyone off in one go.
translation: Meiyerditch tek bir büyük getto. Sehir, vampirlerin dönüsümlü olarak kan vergisi toplayabilmeleri için sektörlere ayrilmis. Böylece herkesi tek seferde öldürmüyorlar.

english: Darkmeyer is the vampyre capital. Humans aren't allowed there unless they're a personal slave of some lord or lady. They say the vampyres there live very luxurious lifestyles.
translation: Darkmeyer vampirlerin baskenti. Bir lord veya leydinin kisisel kölesi olmadikça insanlar oraya giremez. Oradaki vampirlerin çok lüks bir yasam sürdükleri söyleniyor.

english: What do you know about the vampyres?
Not much really. There seems to be three main types, juveniles, juvinates and vy*res.
translation: Aslinda pek bir sey bilmiyorum. Üç ana tür var gibi görünüyor: gençler, juvinatlar ve vy*res.

english: Juveniles seem to be the lowest form of the vampyre. No one around here knows for sure but the general consensus is that they're former humans who've been converted in some way.
translation: Gençler, vampirlerin en alt türü gibi görünüyor. Buralarda kimse kesin olarak bilmiyor ama genel kani, onlarin bir sekilde dönüstürülmüs eski insanlar oldugu yönünde.

english: Juvinates are initiated juveniles who've had some training and are starting to gain some powers.
translation: Juvinatlar, bir miktar egitim almis ve bazi güçler kazanmaya baslayan gençlerdir.

english: Then you have the vyres. Very nasty and very powerful. I wouldn't get on the wrong side of one if I were you.
translation: Sonra da vyres var. Çok kötü ve çok güçlüler. Senin yerinde olsam onlarla ters düsmezdim.

english: What do you know about Drakan?
Vanescula?
Well, I was referring to the main Drakan, you know, the overlord of Morytania.
translation: Ben asil Drakan'dan bahsediyordum, bilirsin, Morytania'nin hükümdari.

english: Hmm, nothing has been seen of him for many years now. You can occasionally see Vanescula flying about, but not too often.
translation: Hmm, onu yillardir kimse görmedi. Vanescula'yi ara sira uçarken görebilirsin, ama çok sik degil.

english: Can you tell me about this castle?
translation: Bu kale hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Do you know anything about the Myreque?
translation: Myreque hakkinda bir sey biliyor musun?

english: Can you tell me about the Sanguinesti region?
translation: Sanguinesti bölgesi hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

What do you know about Drakan?

Hello! Who are you?
Hi. I'm Gem. That's what they call me, anyway. My real name is actually-
translation: Merhaba. Ben Gem. En azindan bana öyle diyorlar. Asil adim aslinda...

english: OH GEEEEM! You missed a spot!
Sigh. Nevermind. I have to go.
Gems! Get your gems here!

sub_category: Dialogue for Gem Merchant (Civitas illa Fortis)

english: I'm good, thanks.

english: Then move along please!
translation: O zaman lütfen yoluna devam et!

english: You're the one who stole from me! Guards! Guards!
sub_category: Dialogue for Gem Merchant (Civitas illa Fortis)

english: I am a mighty and powerful genie. Why do you come here? Speak now or I'll have to think of something exceedingly nasty to do to you.
translation: Ben güçlü ve kudretli bir cinim. Neden buraya geldin? Simdi konus yoksa sana çok kötü bir sey yapmak zorunda kalacagim.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: You're a genie, grant me a wish.
translation: Sen bir cinsin, bana bir dilek tut.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: Not all genies are goody two shoes who go round granting wishes. It's something that my pathetic brother does to make people like him, but that's not my style.
translation: Bütün cinler dilekleri yerine getiren iyi kalpli yaratiklar degildir. Bu, zavalli kardesim insanlarin onu sevmesi için yaptigi bir seydir, ama benim tarzim degil.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: I like to think of myself more as an evil and scary sort of genie, who people talk about in hushed and fearful tones.
translation: Kendimi daha çok, insanlarin sessiz ve korku dolu seslerle bahsettigi, kötü ve korkutucu bir cin olarak görüyorum.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: Well you seem quite scary.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: Why thank you, I put a lot of effort into my terrifyingness.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: Wait! Did you say quite scary? I'll have you know I am VERY scary!
translation: Dur! Oldukça korkutucu mu dedin? Bil ki ben ÇOK korkutucuyum!
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: Erm yes that's what I meant.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: Well I must be off now.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: Yes, run. Ruuuun in fear of.. The crevice genie of Nardah! Muhahaha!
translation: Evet, kaç. Nardah'in yarik cini korkusuyla kaç! Muhahaha!
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: Why are you sitting here in the dark?
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: Two reasons really. Firstly, I can see in the dark, so light or dark makes little difference to me.
translation: Aslinda iki nedeni var. Birincisi, karanlikta görebiliyorum, bu yüzden isik ya da karanlik benim için pek fark etmiyor.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: Lastly, I gather it's normal for powerful terrifying creatures to lurk around in dark caves, so I found this one to lurk in myself, nice isn't it?
translation: Son olarak, güçlü ve korkutucu yaratiklarin karanlik magaralarda gizlenmeleri normal bir sey, bu yüzden kendime gizlenebilecegim bir yer buldum, güzel degil mi?
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: Very pleasant, the snakes are a nice touch.
translation: Çok hos, yilanlar güzel bir dokunus.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: Why do I get the sense that I'm not being taken seriously here? Please try to remember I am very dangerous and not to be trifled with.
translation: Neden burada ciddiye alinmadigimi hissediyorum? Lütfen benim çok tehlikeli oldugumu ve benimle dalga geçilmemesi gerektigini unutma.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: I'm just looking around.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: I don't know about that. I can't have just anybody traipsing in here. I have a reputation to keep you see.
translation: Bunu bilemem. Herkesin buraya girip çikmasina izin veremem. Korumam gereken bir itibarim var.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: Actually I'll tell you what, you can hang around here for a bit, but be sure to spread the word about what a terrifying experience you had when you ran into... The crevice genie of Nardah!
translation: Aslinda sana sunu söyleyeyim, burada biraz takilabilirsin, ama karsilastigin korkunç deneyimi herkese anlatmayi unutma... Nardah'in yarik cini!
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: ...Ok I think I can manage that.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: Hey get your hands off my house.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: Hey, no casting spells on my house!
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: I'm after a statue that was thrown down here.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: Ahh yes someone did drop a statue on my head recently. Very nice workmanship, looks quite old and valuable too. I'm surprised someone threw it away!
translation: Ahh evet, yakin zamanda biri kafama bir heykel atti. Çok güzel isçilik, oldukça eski ve degerli görünüyor. Birinin onu atmasina sasirdim!
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: I have accepted it as a gift as they clearly respect my terrible powers. They seek to keep me at bay by giving me valuables.
translation: Benim korkunç güçlerime saygi duyduklari için bunu bir hediye olarak kabul ettim. Bana degerli seyler vererek beni uzak tutmaya çalisiyorlar.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: Maybe I can make a deal for the statuette?
translation: Belki heykelcik için bir anlasma yapabiliriz?
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: Hmm a deal eh? I think we can come to some sort of arrangement. I'll give you the valuable statuette in return for, let me think ....
translation: Hmm, anlasma mi? Sanirim bir tür anlasmaya varabiliriz. Sana degerli heykelcigi verecegim, karsiliginda, bir düsüneyim...
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: How about I give you the statue in exchange for the sole of the mayor of Nardah?
translation: Nardah belediye baskaninin ruhunu karsiliginda heykelcigi versem nasil olur?
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: Isn't that a little harsh?
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: I wouldn't have said so. It seems a perfectly reasonable thing to request to me. I can think of many things a lot worse I could have asked for.
translation: Ben öyle demezdim. Bana göre gayet makul bir istek. Daha kötü seyler de isteyebilirdim.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: How am I meant to remove someone's soul?
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: Oh that's easy. In my experience soles are very easy to remove with just a knife.
translation: Oh, bu çok kolay. Tecrübelerime göre, ruhlar bir biçakla çok kolay çikarilabilir.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: Ok I agree to the deal.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: No way am I agreeing to that.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: Ah well it's your loss. No sole, then no statuette.
translation: Ah, senin kaybin. Taban yok, heykelcik yok.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: I'm not sure they know you're down here.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: Silence cur! They fear and respect me and that's an end to it.
translation: Sus, köpek! Benden korkuyorlar ve saygi duyuyorlar, konu kapanmistir.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: Do you have the sole of Awusah, so that we can make our trade?
translation: Awusah'in tabanini aldin mi, böylece takas yapabilir miyiz?
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: I'm still working on it.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: Well no rush, I quite like the statuette too.
translation: Acele etme, ben de heykelcigi çok begendim.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: No, it's not an easy thing to get.
translation: Hayir, onu elde etmek kolay bir sey degil.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: Haha, even a pathetic human should be able to manage to get another human's sole.
translation: Haha, zavalli bir insan bile baska bir insanin tabanini elde etmeyi basarabilir.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: Yes I have it here.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: Ah excellent, here's the statuette then.
translation: Ah, harika, o zaman heykelcik burada.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: So um, why do you need part of Awusah's footwear anyway? I hope you're not going to do some nasty magic on his feet or something.
translation: Peki, neden Awusah'in ayakkabisinin bir parçasina ihtiyacin var? Umarim onun ayaklarina kötü bir büyü falan yapmayacaksin.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: I hadn't thought of that. I just read that a lot of the most powerful beings are collecting soles these days. I haven't really got many yet though. You provided me with an opportunity to expand my collection.
translation: Bunu düsünmemistim. Sadece son zamanlarda en güçlü varliklarin çogunun taban topladigini okudum. Henüz çok fazla tabanim yok. Koleksiyonumu genisletmem için bana bir firsat verdin.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: I have lost my statuette.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: Well fortunately for you, I am a mighty and powerful genie and managed to reacquire it. I will give it to you for another sole.
translation: Neyse ki senin için, ben güçlü ve kudretli bir cinim ve onu geri almayi basardim. Sana baska bir taban karsiliginda verecegim.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: I will go and get one then.
translation: Gidip bir tane getireyim o zaman.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: Great! Another one for my collection.
translation: Harika! Koleksiyonum için bir tane daha.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: Yes I have one here.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: Ah excellent here's the statuette then.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: It's good doing business with you again.
sub_category: Dialogue for Genie (Spirits of the Elid)

english: Here, have this.
