english: Hello Fluffs.
Purrrrr! So you can talk to cats now?
Yes, I got this amulet from a Sphinx.
translation: Evet, bu tilsimi bir Sfenks'ten aldim.

english: Well, I should thank you for finding my kitten that time. I have a terrible time keeping track of them, and I never know how many Gertrude has managed to sell.
translation: O zaman kedimi buldugun için sana tesekkür etmeliyim. Onlari takip etmekte çok zorlaniyorum ve Gertrude'un kaç tane sattigini hiç bilmiyorum.

english: The player's cat is removed from the inventory and begins to follow the player
translation: Oyuncunun kedisi envanterden çikarilir ve oyuncuyu takip etmeye baslar.

english: Hi Mommy!
Hello dear!
Aww, that's sweet.
Is [player name] looking after you well?
No complaints, Mom.
Good, good. That's what I like to hear.
translation: Güzel, güzel. Duymak istedigim de buydu.

english: Hey, aren't you Gertrude's cat?
translation: Hey, sen Gertrude'un kedisi degil misin?

english: What's it to you?
Well seeing as I've had to go off and fetch you for Gertrude already...
translation: Gertrude için seni almaya gitmek zorunda kaldigima göre...

english: Oh would you ever quit worrying, I come down here to watch the fights all the time.
translation: Endiselenmeyi biraksan ya, ben buraya her zaman dövüsleri izlemeye geliyorum.

english: Really?
Oh yes, it's a great place for catching a bit of tail.
translation: Evet, burasi kuyruk yakalamak için harika bir yer.

english: Ummm, ok. I'll leave you to it then.
translation: Ummm, tamam. O zaman seni rahat birakayim.

english: Miaow!
Miaoww
Hisss!
Ouch!
Maybe the cat is thirsty?
Perhaps the cat wants something?
Mew!
Maybe the cat is hungry?
The cat seems afraid to leave. In the distance you can hear kittens mewing...
translation: Kedi ayrilmaya korkuyor gibi görünüyor. Uzakta kedilerin miyavlamalari duyuluyor...

english: Purr...
Purr...
Fluffs has run off home with her offspring.
Woooo wooo wooooo woooo.
Hello? Perhaps you can understand me? If you can hear me that is?
translation: Merhaba? Belki beni anlayabilirsin? Beni duyabiliyorsan tabii?

english: Oh, hello there! Yes, I can understand you!
You can? You can! How wonderful! It has been a long while since anyone came by that could understand what I wanted to say to them. You wouldn't happen to have a moment to help me out would you?
translation: Anlayabiliyor musun? Anlayabiliyorsun! Ne kadar harika! Uzun zamandir kimse gelip benim söylemek istediklerimi anlayamadi. Bana yardim etmek için biraz vaktin var mi acaba?

english: I could certainly try to help... what did you say your name was again?
translation: Elbette yardim etmeye çalisabilirim... Adin ne demistin?

english: Bernina! I don't think I did mention it. I haven't had to do an introduction for a while now!
translation: Bernina! Sanirim söylememistim. Uzun zamandir kendimi tanitmak zorunda kalmamistim!

english: It's lovely to meet you, Bernina. I'm [player name]. How can I help you?
translation: Tanistigimiza memnun oldum, Bernina. Ben maceraci. Nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: It's very unfortunate really. I died.
translation: Gerçekten çok talihsiz bir durum. Ben öldüm.

english: Ah, that explains the incorporeality. What happened?
translation: Ah, bu da bedensiz olmani açikliyor. Ne oldu?

english: I was a crew member on board a ship sailing out of Fortis. We got caught in a storm and sailed too close to the rocks around Shipwreck Cove. I'm sure you can guess the results...
translation: Fortis'ten ayrilan bir gemide mürettebat üyesiydim. Bir firtinaya yakalandik ve Shipwreck Cove çevresindeki kayaliklara çok yaklastik. Sonucunu tahmin edebilirsin...

english: The thing is though, after I died, I was not guided to Mictl. I remained, but in this form. I saw the remains of our ship, and I saw some of those salvagers from the east claiming whatever they wanted.
translation: Ancak sorun su ki, öldükten sonra Mictl'e yönlendirilmedim. Bu sekilde kaldim. Gemimizin kalintilarini gördüm ve dogudan gelen bazi kurtarma ekiplerinin istediklerini aldiklarini gördüm.

english: One of them took a diamond necklace from my body. It was very precious to me. It should not remain in the hands of a thief.
translation: Içlerinden biri bedenimden bir elmas kolye aldi. O kolye benim için çok degerliydi. Bir hirsizin elinde kalmamali.

english: I make no promises, but I'll try to recover it.
translation: Söz veremem ama onu geri almaya çalisacagim.

english: Thank you, [player name]. I heard the one that took it being called Jasper by one of his fellow salvagers. He is the one you will need to find.
translation: Tesekkürler, Onu alan kisinin, diger kurtarma ekibi üyeleri tarafindan Jasper olarak adlandirildigini duydum. Bulman gereken kisi o.

english: Hello again, [player name]. Have you got any leads on my necklace yet?
translation: Merhaba tekrar, Kolyemle ilgili herhangi bir ipucu buldun mu?

english: I have. I found the salvager that took it, but it was then sold on to a mountain climber.
translation: Buldum. Onu alan kurtariciyi buldum, ama sonra bir dagciya satilmis.

english: Oh no. I'd hoped he wouldn't sell it on so quickly. Maybe there's still hope though. Any mountain climber around here will surely be heading up the Proudspire...
translation: Olamaz. Bu kadar çabuk satmayacagini ummustum. Belki hala umut vardir. Buralardaki tüm dagcilar mutlaka Proudspire'a tirmaniyorlardir...

english: I actually did the climb myself once. I promised my son we'd go up there again together, but we never found the time...
translation: Aslinda ben de bir kez tirmanmistim. Ogluma tekrar birlikte tirmanacagimiza söz vermistim, ama hiç zaman bulamadik...

english: Don't worry, I'm sure I can find this climber. I'll head up the Proudspire right away.
translation: Merak etme, bu dagciyi bulabilecegime eminim. Hemen Proudspire'a çikacagim.

english: I found the climber and your necklace!
You did? Were you able to get it back?
No, but I don't think I need to. Would you be okay with heading up the mountain yourself? There's someone up there you need to see.
translation: Hayir, ama gerek yok sanirim. Daga kendin çikmak ister misin? Orada görmen gereken biri var.

english: Are you sure?
Absolutely!
Alright then. I'll meet you up there.
Bernina heads up the mountain.
Ah, hello again, [player name]. I don't want to cause alarm, but there's a ghost here with us!
translation: Ah, tekrar merhaba, Panik yaratmak istemem ama burada bizimle birlikte bir hayalet var!

english: He can't understand me. Please, [player name], tell him who I am.
translation: Beni anlayamiyor. Lütfen, ona kim oldugumu söyle.

english: No need to panic, Bernard. This isn't just some random ghost. This is your mother.
translation: Panik yapmana gerek yok, Bernard. Bu siradan bir hayalet degil. Bu senin annen.

english: Mother... By Ralos...
Tell him I'm proud of him, and... tell him I'm sorry I never came home.
translation: Ona seninle gurur duydugumu ve... eve hiç gelemedigim için üzgün oldugumu söyle.

english: You can't understand her, but she wants you to know she's proud of you, and that she's sorry she didn't come home.
translation: Onu anlayamiyorsun, ama seninle gurur duydugunu ve eve gelemedigi için üzgün oldugunu bilmeni istiyor.

english: Oh... Mum...
I think I know now... I know why I stayed behind. It was for this. Thank you, [player name]. I think it's time for me to go now. Tell Bernard I will always be with him...
translation: Sanirim artik biliyorum... Neden geride kaldigimi biliyorum. Bunun içindi. Tesekkürler, Sanirim artik gitme vaktim geldi. Bernard'a her zaman onun yaninda olacagimi söyle...

english: She has to go now, but she will always be with you, Bernard.
translation: Simdi gitmesi gerekiyor, ama her zaman senin yaninda olacak, Bernard.

english: Goodbye mum... I hope I keep making you proud. This necklace... It's not just like yours is it? It is yours. I'm going to finish this climb, for both of us.
translation: Hosça kal anne... Umarim seni gururlandirmaya devam ederim. Bu kolye... Seninkine benzemiyor, degil mi? Bu senin kolyen. Bu tirmanisi ikimiz için de bitirecegim.

english: I'll bury the necklace at the top. That way, even once I'm done, a part of us will always be on top of the world.
translation: Kolyeyi zirveye gömecegim. Böylece, ben bitirdigimde bile, bir parçamiz her zaman dünyanin zirvesinde olacak.

english: Bernina fades away.
Thank you, [player name]. Without you, I'd never have got to say goodbye. Now, I guess I'd better get going. I've got a mountain to climb.
translation: Tesekkürler, Sen olmasaydin, veda edemezdim. Simdi, gitsem iyi olacak. Tirmanmam gereken bir dag var.

english: Best of luck, Bernard.
We are waiting for you to join us.
Woooo... Woooooo...
Hello.
You see me? You understand me?
translation: Beni görüyor musun? Beni anliyor musun?

english: Yes. Who are you?
Me Hopespear of Narogoshuun tribe. Who you?
translation: Ben Narogoshuun kabilesinden Hopespear. Sen kimsin?

english: I'm [player name].
You not goblin. What you want here?
translation: Sen goblin degilsin. Burada ne ariyorsun?

english: Why are you here?
Me dead, but me not go. Long ago, me have vision of Big High War God. Me chosen prophet of Big High War God.
translation: Ben öldüm, ama gitmiyorum. Uzun zaman önce, Büyük Yüksek Savas Tanrisi'nin vizyonunu gördüm. Büyük Yüksek Savas Tanrisi'nin peygamberi seçildim.

english: Me think, when me die, Big High War God take me to reward in Yu'biusk. Every day great battle, every night great victory with feasting.
translation: Düsünüyorum da, öldügümde, Büyük Yüksek Savas Tanrisi beni Yu'biusk'ta ödüllendirecek. Her gün büyük savaslar, her gece büyük zaferler ve ziyafetler.

english: Big High War God not come, but me have faith. Someday Big High War God come for me, take me to him. Until then me hang on, not let go into death.
translation: Büyük Savas Tanrisi gelmedi, ama ben inancimi kaybetmedim. Bir gün Büyük Savas Tanrisi beni almaya gelecek ve yanina götürecek. O zamana kadar dayanacagim, ölüme teslim olmayacagim.

english: I visited Yu'biusk.
You go to Yu'biusk? What you see?
It was a wasteland.
Wasteland? No goblins fighting glorious battles?
translation: Çorak arazi mi? Goblinler sanli savaslar yapmiyor mu?

english: No one. It was all empty.
You lie!
I'm not lying. It's what I saw.
Even so... Yu'biusk is place of Big High War God. Land of Goblins. It where goblins should go.
translation: Öyle olsa bile... Yu'biusk Büyük Savas Tanrisi'nin yeri. Goblinlerin ülkesi. Goblinlerin gitmesi gereken yer.

english: Will you do me favour?
What favour?
High priests in this tomb, when they die they believe they go to Yu'biusk. But their spirits still here.
translation: Bu mezardaki yüksek rahipler, öldüklerinde Yu'biusk'a gideceklerine inaniyorlar. Ama ruhlari hala burada.

english: If you can go to Yu'biusk, you can take their bones and bury them there. Will you do this for me?
translation: Yu'biusk'a gidebilirsen, kemiklerini alip oraya gömebilirsin. Bunu benim için yapar misin?

english: Yes.
Thank you!
How can I get the bones? When I defeated them before, the high priests just spoke to me and then went back into the ground.
translation: Kemikleri nasil alabilirim? Onlari daha önce yendigimde, yüksek rahipler sadece benimle konustular ve sonra topraga geri döndüler.

english: Normally, undead goblin high priests cannot be destroyed, but there is ancient goblin combat ritual.
translation: Normalde, ölümsüz goblin yüksek rahipleri yok edilemez, ama eski bir goblin savas ritüeli var.

english: You must defeat high priests without using any weapons, armour or spells. Once you have bones, take them to Yu'biusk and bury them there.
translation: Yüksek rahipleri silah, zirh veya büyü kullanmadan yenmelisin. Kemikleri aldiktan sonra, onlari Yu'biusk'a götür ve orada göm.

english: I'll do that.
Thank you, human.
No.
Me should know better than to ask human to do favour for dead goblin.
translation: Ölü goblinler için insandan iyilik istemekten daha iyisini bilmeliyim.

english: It was everything you hope for.
Thank you! I know Big High War God still care for us! I wait for him here. Someday he take me to Yu'biusk to live with him.
translation: Tesekkürler! Büyük Savas Tanrisi'nin hala bizi önemsedigini biliyorum! Onu burada bekliyorum. Bir gün beni Yu'biusk'a götürüp onunla yasamami saglayacak.

english: In meantime, will you do me favour?
translation: Bu arada, bana bir iyilik yapar misin?

english: I should go.
Tell me about the Big High War God.
Big High War God greatest of all gods! He take puny goblins from Yu'biusk and make them mighty warriors for great war of gods!
translation: Büyük Savas Tanrisi tüm tanrilar arasinda en büyügüdür! Yu'biusk'tan zayif goblinleri alir ve onlari tanrilar arasindaki büyük savas için güçlü savasçilar haline getirir!

english: When gods go to war, goblin soldiers so good that Big High War God sell tribes to fight for different gods. Big High War God fight with other gods, sometimes for one, sometimes another.
translation: Tanrilar savasa girdiginde, goblin askerler o kadar iyidir ki, Büyük Savas Tanrisi kabileleri farkli tanrilar için savasmalari için satar. Büyük Savas Tanrisi diger tanrilarla savasir, bazen bir tanri için, bazen baska bir tanri için.

english: Other gods fight for their own reasons, but Big High War God fight for war itself!
translation: Diger tanrilar kendi nedenleri için savasir, ama Büyük Savas Tanrisi savasin kendisi için savasir!

english: Tell me more about yourself.
Me chosen prophet of Big High War God. Before I have prophecy, goblin tribes fight one another very much.
translation: Ben Büyük Savas Tanrisi'nin seçilmis peygamberiyim. Ben peygamberlik görevini almadan önce, goblin kabileleri birbirleriyle çok savasirdi.

english: Long ago we fight other people: beardy-short-people, pointy-hat-short-people, tall people with keen blades. Other people build cities with walls, and we not able to attack them any more.
translation: Uzun zaman önce baska insanlarla savasirdik: sakalli kisa insanlar, sivri sapkali kisa insanlar, keskin kiliçlari olan uzun insanlar. Diger insanlar duvarlarla çevrili sehirler insa ettiler ve biz artik onlara saldiramadik.

english: There not enough food for all tribes, so tribes with no food attack tribes who have food. Goblin war last many many years. Finally all tribes meet at this place, where temple is now.
translation: Tüm kabileler için yeterli yiyecek yoktu, bu yüzden yiyecegi olmayan kabileler yiyecegi olan kabilelere saldirdi. Goblin savasi yillarca sürdü. Sonunda tüm kabileler, su anda tapinagin bulundugu yerde bir araya geldi.

english: It rain many days. But rain not stop goblins. Goblin feet churn up ground with rain and goblin blood. All ground turn to mud. That why it called Battle of Plain of Mud.
translation: Günlerce yagmur yagdi. Ama yagmur goblinleri durdurmadi. Goblinlerin ayaklari, yagmur ve goblin kaniyla topragi çamur haline getirdi. Bu yüzden bu savasa Çamur Ovasi Savasi denir.

english: Battle last many days. Both sides same size, none win, none lose. Goblin bodies everywhere. Many dead.
translation: Savas günlerce sürdü. Iki taraf da esit güçteydi, kimse kazanmadi, kimse kaybetmedi. Her yer goblin cesetleriyle doluydu. Birçok kisi öldü.

english: Me not important general, not mighty sergeant. Me just normal goblin. But one night, me have dream.
translation: Ben önemli bir general ya da güçlü bir çavus degilim. Ben siradan bir goblinim. Ama bir gece rüya gördüm.

english: Me see throne of Big High War God. He shine with light so bright me cannot see him, but me hear his voice.
translation: Büyük Yüksek Savas Tanrisi'nin tahtini gördüm. O kadar parlak bir isikla parliyordu ki onu göremedim, ama sesini duydum.

english: He say, 'Stop the fighting!' He say, 'Fighting good, but not if all my followers die! You must not fight one another so much you all die!'
translation: Dedi ki, “Savasi durdurun!” Dedi ki, “Savasmak iyidir, ama tüm takipçilerim ölürse olmaz! Birbirinizle o kadar çok savasmamalisiniz ki hepiniz ölmesin!”

english: Then he say, 'Today I cannot lead you, but some day I will send Chosen Commander to lead you.'
translation: Sonra dedi ki, “Bugün sizi yönetemem, ama bir gün sizi yönetmesi için Seçilmis Komutan'i gönderecegim.”

english: I see Chosen Commander in dream. He wear shining armour and stand at front of army of goblins. Behind Chosen Commander, goblins stretch to horizon. Many goblins, too many to count.
translation: Rüyamda Seçilmis Komutan'i gördüm. Parlak zirh giymisti ve goblin ordusunun önünde duruyordu. Seçilmis Komutan'in arkasinda, goblinler ufka kadar uzaniyordu. Çok fazla goblin vardi, sayilamayacak kadar çok.

english: I see banners of every tribe. Banners of all tribes, even Dorgesh tribe.
translation: Her kabilenin bayraklarini gördüm. Tüm kabilelerin bayraklari, Dorgesh kabilesinin bile.

english: Other races, they run away from mighty goblin army! Chosen Commander make goblins build siege machines and they break down walls of cities. Then goblins march in and kill everyone!
translation: Diger irklar, güçlü goblin ordusundan kaçiyorlardi! Seçilmis Komutan, goblinlere kusatma makineleri yaptirdi ve onlar sehirlerin duvarlarini yiktilar. Sonra goblinler içeri girip herkesi öldürüyor!

english: And when all dead, Big High War God himself appear and sit on great throne of bronze and rule over all, with Chosen Commander beside him.
translation: Ve herkes öldügünde, Büyük Yüksek Savas Tanrisi bizzat ortaya çikiyor ve bronz tahtina oturup, Seçilmis Komutan'in yaninda tümünü yönetiyor.

english: Then I wake from dream. I know it true vision from Big High War God. I run to general of my tribe, and he call other generals for emergency meeting.
translation: Sonra rüyadan uyaniyorum. Bunun Büyük Yüksek Savas Tanrisi'nin gerçek bir görüntüsü oldugunu biliyorum. Kabilemin generaline kosuyorum ve o da diger generalleri acil toplantiya çagiriyor.

english: I tell all generals what I see. They decide to stop fighting so goblins not all die. By this time, so many had died that there enough food for all.
translation: Tüm generallere gördüklerimi anlatiyorum. Goblinlerin hepsinin ölmemesi için savasmayi birakmaya karar veriyorlar. Bu zamana kadar o kadar çok kisi ölmüstü ki, herkese yetecek kadar yiyecek vardi.

english: Then generals set goblins to work building temple on site of battle. It sink into mud, so they turn it into underground temple, and keep it secret from others.
translation: Sonra generaller goblinleri savas alaninda tapinak insa etmeye koydu. Tapinak çamura battigi için onu yeralti tapinagina dönüstürdüler ve digerlerinden gizli tuttular.

english: Goblins write my vision down in goblin holy book, along with history of goblins and commandments of Big High War God.
translation: Goblinler benim vizyonumu, goblinlerin tarihi ve Büyük Savas Tanrisi'nin emirleriyle birlikte goblinlerin kutsal kitabina yazdilar.

english: Tell me more about the Chosen Commander.
translation: Seçilmis Komutan hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin.

english: Me not know much more. In vision, Chosen Commander wear heavy armour and big helmet that cover face. Me not know what he look like. I see him give orders, but he far away so me not hear his voice.
translation: Benim bildigim fazla bir sey yok. Görümde, Seçilmis Komutan agir zirh ve yüzünü kapatan büyük bir migfer giyiyordu. Nasil göründügünü bilmiyorum. Emirler verdigini görüyorum, ama çok uzakta oldugu için sesini duyamiyorum.

english: Me think Chosen Commander will be great goblin general, but Big High War God chose me to have vision, not great general, so Chosen Commander could be anyone.
translation: Seçilmis Komutan'in büyük bir goblin generali olacagini düsünüyorum, ama Büyük Savas Tanrisi beni görüm sahibi olarak seçti, büyük bir general olarak degil, bu yüzden Seçilmis Komutan herhangi biri olabilir.

english: Nothing. I should go.
You take bones to Yu'biusk yet?
Not yet.
You please do this for me, human. Remember, you must defeat high priests without using any weapons, armour or spells.
translation: Lütfen bunu benim için yap, insan. Unutma, yüksek rahipleri silah, zirh veya büyü kullanmadan yenmelisin.

english: I did.
Thank you. Not many humans like you. Now goblin high priests can rest.
translation: Tesekkürler. Senin gibi pek çok insan yok. Artik goblin yüksek rahipleri dinlenebilir.

english: Why are you here?
I visited Yu'biusk.
It was a wasteland.
What favour?
Yes.
I'll do that.
Tell me about the Big High War God.
translation: Büyük Savas Tanrisi hakkinda bana bilgi ver.

english: Tell me more about yourself.
translation: Bana kendin hakkinda daha fazla bilgi ver.

english: No.
It was everything you hope for.
I should go.
Tell me more about the Chosen Commander.
translation: Seçilmis Komutan hakkinda bana daha fazla bilgi ver.

english: Nothing. I should go.
WOOOOO!
Aaaah!
Children, run quickly!
Oh my gods, the dragon is coming back!
Quickly, run!
WOOO woooo wooo WOOOO!
Get the women and children to the boats!
On the horizon! Do you see it?
Put that fire out!
Wooo wooo wooOOooOOoo!
Eeeek!
EIEEEEE!
Mummy, are we safe now?
Mummy! Where are you?
Wooo wooo woooooooo!
I don't want to die like this!
Oh no!
Someone help me! I'm trapped!
AAARGH!
Come on, you monster! Just finish me!
It's hopeless. We're all going to die!
We're all doomed.
Woooo wooo wooooo woooo
You cannot understand the ghost.
Don't send me back to that library!
What?
It took me too long to get out of there... Just don't send me back!
translation: Oradan çikmam çok uzun sürdü... Beni geri gönderme!

english: Woooo wooo wooooo woooo.
You cannot understand the ghost.
You there! Seek out the centurion at once. Inform him that the enemy leader has been identified and the Carnifex Maximus himself has been dispatched to bring back his head!
translation: Sen! Hemen yüzbasiyi bul. Ona düsman liderinin kimliginin tespit edildigini ve Carnifex Maximus'un onun kafasini getirmek için gönderildigini bildir!

english: Err... What?
Did you not hear me? Do I need to spell it out for you?
translation: Duymadin mi? Sana harf harf mi söyleyeyim?

english: If you could that would be great.
Goodness you are a fool! Their leader is named Yonrith Lovakengj. He has fled to the west with his closest allies, but much of his army still remains. Carnifex Maximus Vardorvis is in pursuit of him.
translation: Tanrim, ne aptalsin! Liderlerinin adi Yonrith Lovakengj. En yakin müttefikleriyle birlikte batiya kaçti, ama ordusunun çogu hala orada. Carnifex Maximus Vardorvis onun pesinde.

english: Yeah... I still have no idea what you're on about.
Useless! Perhaps the headsman needs to take your head as well. I will find the centurion myself!
translation: Yararsiz! Belki de cellat senin kafani da kesmelidir. Yüzbasiyi kendim bulacagim!

english: Okay... Good luck with that.
Ah, there you are. Dire news I'm afraid. We've lost all contact with the capital. Worse, another dwarven clan has joined the Saradominists. They march upon the fortress as we speak.
translation: Ah, buradasin. Korkarim kötü haberlerim var. Baskentle tüm baglantimizi kaybettik. Daha da kötüsü, baska bir cüce klani Saradoministlere katildi. Su anda kaleye dogru ilerliyorlar.

english: Oh... Oh dear?
Is everything all right my friend? You don't seem to be yourself.
translation: Her sey yolunda mi dostum? Kendinde degil gibisin.

english: I don't think I'm who you believe I am.
translation: Sanirim ben senin sandigin kisi degilim.

english: Hmm. You're clearly confused. The lack of sleep is getting to you. Go and have a lie down and we will discuss this later.
translation: Hmm. Açikça kafan karisik. Uykusuzluk seni etkiliyor. Git biraz uzan, bunu sonra konusuruz.

english: Alright...
I've been doing some research into our new foes. Rumour has it they once lived in a great city in the far north. The city fell and now they are homeless.
translation: Yeni düsmanlarimiz hakkinda biraz arastirma yaptim. Söylentilere göre bir zamanlar kuzeyin uzaklarinda büyük bir sehirde yasiyorlardi. Sehir düstü ve simdi evsiz kaldilar.

english: It seems they have been promised a new home here in return for wiping us out. We must take great care. We may be fighting for our home, but it seems they are as well.
translation: Görünüse göre bizi yok etmeleri karsiliginda burada yeni bir yuva vaat edilmis. Çok dikkatli olmaliyiz. Biz evimiz için savasiyor olabiliriz, ama onlar da öyle görünüyor.

english: Right... And err, how's the fight going so far?
translation: Tamam... Peki, savas su ana kadar nasil gidiyor?

english: You tell me, I'm no warrior. That said, I did hear that they'd managed to turn some of our own golems against us. If they can do that, I fear what else they may do.
translation: Sen söyle, ben savasçi degilim. Bununla birlikte, bazi golemlerimizi bize karsi kullanmayi basardiklarini duydum. Bunu yapabilirlerse, baska neler yapabileceklerinden korkuyorum.

english: Oh my... That doesn't sound good...
translation: Aman Tanrim... Bu hiç iyiye isaret degil...

english: Indeed. We have increased our offerings tenfold, but I fear they fall on empty ears. Perhaps our lord really has gone.
translation: Gerçekten. Sunularimizi on kat artirdik, ama korkarim ki kulak ardi ediliyorlar. Belki de lordumuz gerçekten gitmistir.

english: Hmm. Well I hope it all works out.
translation: Hmm. Umarim her sey yoluna girer.

english: Whoooo wooo Whooooooooo.
I fought a really big ghost dog in here - is he gone now?
translation: Burada çok büyük bir hayalet köpekle savastim - o artik gitti mi?

english: You were well rewarded for you effort. But you should leave this place, for it is not wise to tarry.
translation: Çabalarin karsiligini fazlasiyla aldin. Ama burayi terk etmelisin, çünkü burada kalmak akillica degil.

english: But I lost my shadow sword and I don't know how to get it back.
translation: Ama gölge kilicimi kaybettim ve onu nasil geri alacagimi bilmiyorum.

english: Ah, so that is why you return. I can assist you in that and give you another.
translation: Ah, demek bu yüzden geri döndün. Sana bu konuda yardimci olabilir ve sana baska bir tane verebilirim.

english: Who are you anyway...or were you...?
Who I was does not matter. Now, I am a guardian for the Shadow Realm and I am protecting this area from any more disturbances.
translation: Kim oldugum önemli degil. Simdi, Gölge Diyari'nin koruyucusuyum ve bu bölgeyi baska rahatsizliklardan koruyorum.

english: There are those who walk in the Shadow Realm who should not.
Hi.
What brings you down here, Rookie?
I heard all the grunting and metal clanging. I wanted to see what was going on.
translation: Hirilti ve metal sesleri duydum. Ne oldugunu görmek istedim.

english: What do you think of our training area?
Well... It smells a bit.
That is the smell of courage.
Hello there.
Greetings, Rookie.
You lot sure look busy down here.
We strive to become the best.
Well best of luck!
Hello.
Hello, Rookie. You'll have to excuse me. I'm keeping an eye on the other contenders.
translation: Merhaba, çaylak. Beni mazur gör. Diger rakipleri gözetliyorum.

english: May the odds be ever in your favour.
What a nice thing to say.
You're not tired of doing that all day?
translation: Bunu bütün gün yapmaktan yorulmuyor musun?

english: I'm going to slay anything in my path!
You certainly are determined!
Hi there.
Stand back, Rookie. I need to concentrate.
translation: Geri çekil, çaylak. Konsantre olmam lazim.

english: You seemed to have that weapon mastered.
Kill...
No...
... survivors!
That's impressive. I'll leave you to it.
Can't talk... I've got 100 more to do.
Good luck.
Hel-
Can't you see I'm busy here?
Of course... Enjoy your floor pushing.
translation: Tabii ki... Katlari temizlemenin tadini çikar.

english: You're the human that dealt with those mourners aren't you? Thanks for that, they were really bothersome.
translation: O yas tutanlarla ilgilenen insan sensin, degil mi? Tesekkürler, gerçekten çok rahatsiz ediciydiler.

english: No problem. Why are you still here anyway?
translation: Sorun degil. Neden hâlâ buradasin ki?

english: The mourners left plenty of stuff behind, thought I'd see if there was anything useful.
translation: Yas tutanlar geride bir sürü sey birakmis, yararli bir sey var mi diye bakayim dedim.

english: Fair enough, have fun.
Hello again, [player name].
sub_category: Dialogue for Gnome Child (20th Anniversary event)

english: Tell me about this place.
sub_category: Dialogue for Gnome Child (20th Anniversary event)

english: Over time, many people have come into the world and left it again. One such is Thrander, who used to perform armour conversion services in Varrock. Another is Chuck, the wood certificate trader.
translation: Zamanla, birçok insan bu dünyaya geldi ve tekrar gitti. Bunlardan biri, Varrock'ta zirh dönüstürme hizmeti veren Thrander. Digeri ise ahsap sertifika tüccari Chuck.
sub_category: Dialogue for Gnome Child (20th Anniversary event)

english: When their services were no longer required, they moved on, but they were not all forgotten. Some linger still in the Realm of Memories.
translation: Hizmetlerine artik ihtiyaç kalmadiginda, yoluna devam ettiler, ama hepsi unutulmadi. Bazilari hala Anilar Diyari'nda kaliyor.
sub_category: Dialogue for Gnome Child (20th Anniversary event)

english: From the Realm, we watch how the world changes. We see the happy moments, the sad times, the lucky events, the dry streaks. It is a wonderful existence.
translation: Diyar'dan, dünyanin nasil degistigini izliyoruz. Mutlu anlari, üzücü zamanlari, sansli olaylari, sikici dönemleri görüyoruz. Bu harika bir varolus.
sub_category: Dialogue for Gnome Child (20th Anniversary event)

english: Can you give me more reward items?
translation: Bana daha fazla ödül ögesi verebilir misin?
sub_category: Dialogue for Gnome Child (20th Anniversary event)

english: You cannot hold any more items from me now. You may wish to visit Diango, in Draynor Village, to collect more rewards in a more convenient setting.
translation: Su anda benden daha fazla öge alamazsin. Daha uygun bir ortamda daha fazla ödül almak için Draynor Köyü'ndeki Diango'yu ziyaret etmek isteyebilirsin.
sub_category: Dialogue for Gnome Child (20th Anniversary event)

english: I have given you what you can hold. You may wish to visit Diango, in Draynor Village, to collect more rewards in a more convenient setting.
translation: Sana alabilecegin kadarini verdim. Daha uygun bir ortamda daha fazla ödül almak için Draynor Köyü'ndeki Diango'yu ziyaret etmek isteyebilirsin.
sub_category: Dialogue for Gnome Child (20th Anniversary event)

english: I think that is everything I have for you.
sub_category: Dialogue for Gnome Child (20th Anniversary event)

english: I have nothing more for you.
translation: Sana verecek baska bir seyim yok.
sub_category: Dialogue for Gnome Child (20th Anniversary event)

english: Who are the people here?
sub_category: Dialogue for Gnome Child (20th Anniversary event)

english: Like me, they dwelt in the world as it used to be, in various different eras. Many such people have faded away into the mists of time, but a lucky few are remembered.
translation: Benim gibi, onlar da eskiden oldugu gibi, çesitli farkli dönemlerde dünyada yasiyorlardi. Bu tür insanlarin çogu zamanin sisleri içinde kayboldu, ancak sansli birkaçi hatirlaniyor.
sub_category: Dialogue for Gnome Child (20th Anniversary event)

english: They would be glad to meet you, I am sure.
sub_category: Dialogue for Gnome Child (20th Anniversary event)

english: Can I see more stuff from your era?
translation: Senin döneminden daha fazla sey görebilir miyim?
sub_category: Dialogue for Gnome Child (20th Anniversary event)

english: I would have dearly loved that. However we are limited to this hall, where the more aggressive creatures can play in safety.
translation: Bunu çok isterdim. Ancak, daha saldirgan yaratiklarin güvenle oynayabilecegi bu salonla sinirliyiz.
sub_category: Dialogue for Gnome Child (20th Anniversary event)

english: Furthermore, the dimensional shifts would not allow it - a two-dimensional entity would be incomprehensible to your three-dimensional mind.
translation: Ayrica, boyut degisiklikleri buna izin vermez - iki boyutlu bir varlik, üç boyutlu zihniniz için anlasilmaz olur.
sub_category: Dialogue for Gnome Child (20th Anniversary event)

english: No, some things must be left to the memory, even here in the Realm of Memories.
translation: Hayir, bazi seyler hafizaya birakilmalidir, burada, Hafizalar Diyari'nda bile.
sub_category: Dialogue for Gnome Child (20th Anniversary event)

english: Tell me about this place.
sub_category: Dialogue for Gnome Child (20th Anniversary event)
source: Dialogue for Gnome Child (20th Anniversary event)

translation: Bana daha fazla ödül ögesi verebilir misiniz?
sub_category: Dialogue for Gnome Child (20th Anniversary event)

english: Who are the people here?
sub_category: Dialogue for Gnome Child (20th Anniversary event)

english: Can I see more stuff from your era?
translation: Sizin döneminizden daha fazla sey görebilir miyim?
sub_category: Dialogue for Gnome Child (20th Anniversary event)

english: Hello!
sub_category: Dialogue for Gnome child (2018 Birthday event)

english: Greetings.
sub_category: Dialogue for Gnome child (2018 Birthday event)

english: What do you think of the party?
sub_category: Dialogue for Gnome child (2018 Birthday event)

english: It is as beauteous as the sheen of scales on a butterfly's wing and as odious as a worm's armpit.
translation: Kelebek kanadindaki pullarin parlakligi kadar güzel ve solucanin koltuk alti kadar igrenç.
sub_category: Dialogue for Gnome child (2018 Birthday event)

english: I kill you human!
Go away smelly human!
What you doing here?
I'm here to kill all you goblins!
I kill you!
I'm just looking around.
Me not sure that allowed. You have to check with generals.
translation: Bunun izinli oldugundan emin degilim. Generallere danismalisin.

english: Happy goblin new century!
Happy new century!
What is the goblin new century?
Goblin century mark year of big battle on Plain of Mud. That when Big High War God give us commandments.
translation: Goblin yüzyili, Çamur Ovasi'ndaki büyük savasin yilini isaret eder. O zaman Büyük Yüksek Savas Tanrisi bize emirlerini verdi.

english: Who is the Big High War God?
Big High War God take goblins and make them strong! Without him, we small and weak and stupid. But thanks to Big High War God, we most powerful race in Gielinor!
translation: Büyük Yüksek Savas Tanrisi goblinleri alip onlari güçlü kilar! O olmasaydi, biz küçük, zayif ve aptal olurduk. Ama Büyük Yüksek Savas Tanrisi sayesinde, Gielinor'daki en güçlü irk biziz!

english: Umm... you're clearly not the most powerful race in Gielinor.
translation: Hmm... Gielinor'daki en güçlü irk siz degilsiniz.

english: Not to doubt word of Big High War God! I kill you!
translation: Büyük Savas Tanrisi'nin sözlerini sorgulamayin! Sizi öldürürüm!

english: What are the goblin commandments?
Slay enemies of Big High War God! Not show mercy! Not run from battle! Not doubt word of Big High War God!
translation: Büyük Savas Tanrisi'nin düsmanlarini öldürün! Merhamet göstermeyin! Savastan kaçmayin! Büyük Savas Tanrisi'nin sözlerini sorgulamayin!

english: Without commandments we not know right from wrong. We be like other races who not know war is good!
translation: Emirler olmadan dogruyu yanlistan ayirt edemeyiz. Savasin iyi oldugunu bilmeyen diger irklar gibi oluruz!

english: Where is the Plain of Mud?
That goblin secret! No human ever find Plain of Mud!
translation: Bu goblinlerin sirri! Hiçbir insan Çamur Ovasi'ni bulamaz!

english: I need to go.
Brown armour best!
Why is brown best?
General Wartface and General Bentnoze both say it is. And normally they never agree!
translation: General Wartface ve General Bentnoze öyle diyorlar. Ve normalde onlar asla ayni fikirde olmazlar!

english: But you're still wearing green armour!
translation: Ama sen hala yesil zirh giyiyorsun!

english: Um... my brown armour getting wash.
But you're still wearing red armour!
translation: Ama sen hala kirmizi zirh giyiyorsun!

english: It not red, it just red-ish brown!
Err, okay.
I'm here to kill all you goblins!
I'm just looking around.
Happy new century!
What is the goblin new century?
Who is the Big High War God?
What are the goblin commandments?
Where is the Plain of Mud?
I need to go.
Why is brown best?
But you're still wearing green!
But you're still wearing red!
Err, okay.
Which way should I go?
These dungeons are such a maze.
I've been wandering around down here for hours.
How can I get back to the village?
I hate being so lost!
Where am I? I'm so lost.
I know the exit is around here, somewhere.
translation: Çikisin buralarda bir yerde oldugunu biliyorum.

english: Where's the exit?!?
This is the fifth time this week! I'm lost!
How could I be so disoriented?
Woah, what's happened to me?!
Oi you! What are you doing on this side of the portal?
translation: Hey sen! Portalin bu tarafinda ne yapiyorsun?

english: Go report to the Duke in the castle, the greater yolk didn't tell you to return.
translation: Git kaledeki Dük'e rapor ver, büyük yumurta sana geri dönmeni söylemedi.

english: Why are you talking to me, go report to the Duke in the castle, the egg will find a way to deal with you.
translation: Neden benimle konusuyorsun, git kaledeki Dük'e rapor ver, yumurta seninle ilgilenmenin bir yolunu bulacaktir.

english: You're free to do as you wish, but I'll be keeping my ears on you.
translation: Istedigini yapabilirsin, ama seni takip edecegim.

english: Be on your way.
You don't want to mess with me, human.
If you're thinking of trying anything, you'll quickly find yourself regretting it.
translation: Bir sey yapmaya kalkisirsan, çok geçmeden pisman olursun.

english: I'm watching you, human.
Move along.
What do you think you're doing, human?
Oh... I was just going to check out the inside of this house.
translation: Oh... Sadece bu evin içini kontrol edecektim.

english: This isn't a house, it's a... Actually, human, it's none of your business!
translation: Burasi ev degil, bu bir... Aslinda, insan, bu seni ilgilendirmez!

english: Well now you've just made me curious. What's in there?
translation: Simdi merakimi uyandirdin. Içeride ne var?

english: Go away!
Is it a really large anvil?
Final warning!
Is it a dwarf with a really long beard?
translation: Gerçekten uzun sakalli bir cüce mi?

english: Why don't you ask me again?!
If you insist...
Ask me another question! I dare you!
translation: Bana baska bir soru sor! Cesaretin varsa!

english: Okay, okay! I'm leaving.
Is it a dwarf with a really long beard?
translation: Gerçekten uzun sakalli bir cüce mi?

english: If you insist...
Okay, okay! I'm leaving.
Hello.
Hello there. I haven't seen you around here before. If you've come to admire the Carnillean family home, I must warn you not to cause any trouble.
translation: Merhaba. Seni daha önce buralarda görmemistim. Carnillean ailesinin evini hayranlikla izlemeye geldiysen, sorun çikarmamani tavsiye ederim.

english: Due to recent criminal activities against such prominent Ardougnians, I have been sent here on special guard duty to ensure the Carnilleans' security.
translation: Son zamanlarda Ardougnie'nin önde gelen sahsiyetlerine yönelik suç faaliyetleri nedeniyle, Carnillean ailesinin güvenligini saglamak için buraya özel güvenlik görevlisi olarak gönderildim.

english: Anyone caught interfering with the person or possessions of any Carnilleans will be taken to jail so quickly that their feet won't even touch the floor!
translation: Carnillean ailesinin herhangi bir üyesine veya malina zarar verenler, ayaklari yere basamadan hapse atilacaklar!

english: Well, I wasn't actually planning on doing anything like that...
translation: Aslinda öyle bir sey yapmayi düsünmüyordum...

english: Glad to hear it.
Well well well... if it isn't our very own local hero. Good to see you managed to clear your name I always had faith in you!
translation: Vay vay vay... Bizim yerel kahramanimiz gelmis. Adini temize çikardigina sevindim. Sana her zaman inandim!

english: Hello there.
Hello, adventurer. It's a shame you never found that cult. We have a horrible suspicion that there's been another burglary.
translation: Merhaba, maceraci. O tarikati bulamamis olman çok yazik. Korkunç bir süphe var, baska bir hirsizlik daha olmus olabilir.

english: That's worrying.
Yes, it is. The thing is, we can't even work out what they've taken! It's all very odd.
translation: Evet, öyle. Sorun su ki, ne çaldiklarini bile anlayamiyoruz! Her sey çok garip.

english: Is there anything more I can do to help?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: I don't think so. Sir Ceril says you've done enough.
translation: Sanmiyorum. Sir Ceril yeterince yardim ettigini söylüyor.

english: Don't you try anything, surface-dweller. I'm keeping an eye on you.
translation: Sakin bir sey yapmaya kalkisma, yüzey sakini. Seni gözlüyorum.

english: Welcome, surface-dweller, to the hidden city of Dorgesh-Kaan!
translation: Hos geldin, yüzey sakini, gizli sehir Dorgesh-Kaan'a!

english: Surface-dweller!
What?
Have a nice day!
I don't want to be unfriendly, but I can't help noticing that since surface-dwellers started coming into the city there has been an increase in CRIME!
translation: Kaba olmak istemem ama, yüzey sakinleri sehre gelmeye basladigindan beri SUÇ oraninin arttigini fark etmeden edemiyorum!

english: Surface-dweller! I don't know how you got into the city, but you will never escape!
translation: Yüzey sakini! Sehre nasil girdigini bilmiyorum ama asla kaçamayacaksin!

english: But... I thought I was allowed into the city!
translation: Ama... Sehre girmeme izin verildigini saniyordum!

english: You are. I just wanted to say that. And now that you're allowed into the city, I'll never be able to!
translation: Girebilirsin. Sadece bunu söylemek istedim. Ve simdi sen sehre girebiliyorsun, ama ben asla giremeyecegim!

english: Hello.
Hello soldier.
I'm more of an adventurer really.
translation: Aslinda ben daha çok bir maceraciyim.

english: In this day and age we're all soldiers. No time to waste gassing, Fight! Fight! Fight!
translation: Bu günlerde hepimiz askeriz. Bos konusmaya zaman yok, Savas! Savas! Savas!

english: Well hello brave warrior. These ogres have been terrorising the area, they've eaten four children this week alone.
translation: Merhaba cesur savasçi. Bu ogreler bölgeyi terörize ediyorlar, sadece bu hafta dört çocugu yediler.

english: Brutes!
So we decided to use them for target practice. A fair punishment.
translation: Bu yüzden onlari hedef talimi için kullanmaya karar verdik. Adil bir ceza.

english: Indeed.
Hello there.
What do you want? Leave us be!
Welcome to the Seers' Village courthouse. Court is not in session today, so you're not allowed downstairs.
translation: Seers Köyü adliyesine hos geldiniz. Bugün mahkeme oturumu yok, bu yüzden asagiya inemezsiniz.

english: What is this place?
The Seers' Village courthouse. We give all criminals a fair trial, by a jury of their peers. Or whoever we can round up from the pub.
translation: Seers Köyü adliyesi. Tüm suçlulara, akranlarindan olusan bir jüri tarafindan adil bir yargilama yapiyoruz. Ya da pub'dan toplayabildigimiz kim varsa.

english: You're a long way out from the city.
I know. We guards usually stay by banks and shops, but I got sent all the way out here to keep an eye on the brigands loitering just south of here.
translation: Biliyorum. Biz muhafizlar genellikle bankalarin ve dükkanlarin yaninda kaliriz, ama buraya, güneyde dolasan haydutlari gözetlemek için gönderildim.

english: It sounds more exciting than standing around guarding banks and shops.
translation: Bankalari ve dükkanlari korumaktan daha heyecanli görünüyor.

english: It's not too bad. At least I don't get attacked so often out here. Guards in the cities get killed all the time.
translation: O kadar da kötü degil. En azindan burada çok sik saldiriya ugramiyorum. Sehirlerdeki muhafizlar sürekli öldürülüyor.

english: Honestly, people these days just don't know how to behave!
translation: Açikçasi, bu günlerde insanlar nasil davranacaklarini bilmiyorlar!

english: Please don't disturb me, I've got to keep any eye out for suspicious individuals.
translation: Lütfen beni rahatsiz etme, süpheli kisileri gözetlemem gerekiyor.

english: I'm surprised you managed to get out of there without breaking any bones.
Still, the Queen says it should be safe, and I'm to let you go back down if you want.
translation: Yine de Kraliçe güvenli oldugunu söylüyor ve istersen seni asagiya gönderebilirim.

english: Stand back. This area is restricted.
translation: Geri çekil. Bu bölge yasak bölge.

english: What's so special about it?
That's none of your business.
I think I've left some of my loot in there. Can I get it quick?
translation: Sanirim ganimetimin bir kismini orada birakmisim. Hizlica alabilir miyim?

english: Nice try, Rookie.
What if I share some of it with you?
I do not care for wealth. Now move along.
translation: Zenginlik umurumda degil. Simdi çekil yolumdan.

english: May I pass?
You shall not... *cough*
No one is allowed past I'm afraid.
How suspicious...
What do you think you're doing?
Welcome, [Fremennik name].
Are you all right? Leftie?
No, I'm on the left.
Only from your perspective. Someone entering the gate should call you Rightie, right Leftie?
translation: Sadece senin bakis açindan öyle. Kapidan giren biri sana Saglak demeli, degil mi Solak?

english: That's right Leftie, that's right.
No, Rightie's fine Leftie.
Aaagh! Enough! If either of you mention left or right in my presence I'll have to scream! Can I come through the gate?
translation: Aaagh! Yeter! Ikinizden biri benim yanimda sol veya sag derse çiglik atmak zorunda kalacagim! Kapidan geçebilir miyim?

english: Don't let us stop you.
Yes, head right on in, sir.
You said it! You said it! ARRRRRRRRGGH!
You're free to go into the dungeons, your Highness.
Try not to get eaten by those monsters.
Be on your way.
You don't want to mess with me, human.
If you're thinking of trying anything, you'll quickly find yourself regretting it.
translation: Bir sey yapmayi düsünüyorsan, çok geçmeden pisman olursun.

english: I'm watching you, human.
Move along.
Halt! Are you here to sabotage the Motherlode Mine?
translation: Dur! Motherlode Madeni'ni sabote etmeye mi geldin?

english: What's the Motherlode Mine?
Prospector Percy discovered unusual mineral veins in this cave. Now he's built a machine to let us extract useful ores.
translation: Madenci Percy bu magarada sira disi maden damarlari kesfetti. Simdi de yararli madenleri çikarmamizi saglayan bir makine yapti.

english: Percy calls it the Motherlode. I don't know why, and I'm not asking - that's between him and his mother.
translation: Percy ona Motherlode diyor. Nedenini bilmiyorum ve sormuyorum da, bu onunla annesi arasinda bir mesele.

english: Dwarves don't normally let humans claim areas of the mine like this, but Percy's machine is really useful, so we struck a deal.
translation: Cüceler normalde insanlarin madenin bu bölgelerini ele geçirmesine izin vermezler, ama Percy'nin makinesi gerçekten çok kullanisli, bu yüzden bir anlasma yaptik.

english: No, I'm not.
That's a relief. Have a nice day.
What would you do if I said 'yes'?
I'd ask you not to.
What's the Motherlode Mine?
No, I'm not.
What would you do if I said 'yes'?
You stay right there, outerlander.
Don't worry, I'm not an outerlander, I am [Fremennik name], a Fremennik!
translation: Merak etme, ben bir yabanci degilim, ben bir Fremennik'im!

english: I said stay there, outerlander! You are not welcome in our camp.
translation: Orada kal, yabanci! Kampimiza hos gelmedin.

english: Why, what's beyond here?
Our camp, outerlander, and we don't want any trouble there.
translation: Kampimiz, yabanci, ve orada sorun istemiyoruz.

english: I suppose I might as well let you pass now, since I can't seem to stop you anyway.
translation: Sanirim seni durduramayacagim için geçmene izin verecegim.

english: Just remember that I'm watching you.
Go, outerlander, and do not hurry back.
You may pass freely, outerlander.
Hey, how did you get here?
Can you come and help me? The chieftain's daughter -
translation: Gelip bana yardim eder misin? Sef'in kizi...

english: No, outerlander, I'm guarding this mountain pass from trolls and inquisitive people like you.
translation: Hayir, yabanci, bu dag geçidini trollerden ve senin gibi merakli insanlardan koruyorum.

english: Doesn't look like you were very successful in the last regard.
If the chieftain would let me, I would correct that oversight.
translation: Sef izin verse, bu ihmali düzeltirdim.

english: You may pass freely.
Thanks... and try to lighten up a bit, alright?
translation: Tesekkürler... ve biraz neselenmeye çalis, tamam mi?

english: Don't press your luck, outerlander.
Feel free to come in and see the highlight of our culture, outerlander.
translation: Içeri girip kültürümüzün en önemli özelligini görmeye çekinme, yabanci.

english: HALT! Who goes there?
Don't worry, I'm not going to cause trouble.
But you shouldn't be here - be off with you!
I was going anyway.
I am [player name] the Mighty!
Mighty? You look like another of those silly adventurers who thinks they're the bee's knees just because they've done a few lousy quests!
translation: Mighty mi? Sen de birkaç berbat görev tamamladin diye kendini çok önemli sanan aptal maceracilardan birisin!

english: Well it sounds better than sitting on this rooftop all day looking at trees!
translation: Bütün gün bu çatida oturup agaçlara bakmaktan daha iyi!

english: I'll have you know it's a very important job guarding this jail!
translation: Bu hapishaneyi korumak çok önemli bir is, bilgin olsun!

english: If anyone comes sneaking in here to mess around with the prisoners, the lads downstairs will make mincemeat of them, and I'll be here to pick them off if they try to escape.
translation: Buraya gizlice girip mahkumlarla ugrasan olursa, asagidaki adamlar onlari parçalar ve kaçmaya çalisirlarsa ben de onlari vururum.

english: You mean people aren't meant to be able to shoot the prisoners in the cells?
translation: Yani kimse hücrelerdeki mahkumlari vuramaz mi?

english: Yes, that's right.
Okay, it's been nice talking to you.
No-one, there's no-one here.
What? I can see you!
No, you're just imagining it. Perhaps you've been up here in the sun for too long?
translation: Hayir, hayal görüyorsun. Belki de güneste çok uzun süre kaldin?

english: So who am I talking to?
Oh dear, you've started talking to yourself. That's a common sign that you're going mad!
translation: Ah canim, kendi kendine konusmaya basladin. Bu delirdiginin yaygin bir isaretidir!

english: But... but... you're standing right there...
Maybe you should leave him alone now.
translation: Belki de onu simdi yalniz birakmalisin.

english: Don't worry, I'm not going to cause trouble.
I am [player name] the Mighty!
No-one, there's no-one here.
Guh... mwww... zzzzz...
Hmph... heh heh heh...
Mmmm... big pint of beer... kebab...
translation: Mmmm... büyük bir bardak bira... kebap...

english: Mmmmmm... donuts...
Maybe I should let him sleep.
translation: Belki de onu uyumasina izin vermeliyim.

english: Hello, can I go in?
I'm afraid not. The city is on lockdown until the rebel elves are dealt with.
translation: Korkarim ki hayir. Asi elfler halledilene kadar sehir kapatildi.

english: Please, I won't cause any trouble.
Rules are rules. No one enters until the criminals are gone.
translation: Kural kuraldir. Suçlular gidene kadar kimse giremez.

english: Fine, doesn't look very exciting anyway, it's just an empty field.
translation: Peki, zaten pek heyecan verici görünmüyor, sadece bos bir alan.

english: Mind your tongue human. Our great city may be lost to us but that doesn't give you an excuse to talk like that.
translation: Dilini tut insan. Büyük sehrimizi kaybetmis olabiliriz ama bu sana böyle konusma hakki vermez.

english: Welcome, adventurer.
Hey! Get your hands off there!
Hello there.
Greetings, traveller. Enjoy your time at the Ranging Guild.
translation: Selamlar, gezgin. Ranging Guild'de iyi vakit geçir.

english: *Whistles*
Exciting new post he said.
Can't wait for the weekend.
Why me?
I'm so bored
I'd kill for a kebab.
I need a new job.
10 green bottles sit..*Whistles*
I miss Billy and Bob *sighs*
Dum dum dum de dum Hey!
translation: Dum dum dum de dum Hey!

english: Why isn't it 6 already?
These night shifts just go on and on.
I'm hungry.
*sings* If I had 3 wil....
Halt thief!
What do you think you're doing?
Hey! Get your hands off there!
The Sinclairs are under house arrest for crimes against a crown, and it's all thanks to you.
translation: Sinclair ailesi, kralliga karsi isledikleri suçlar nedeniyle ev hapsinde ve bu tamamen senin sayende.

english: It's more luxury than they deserve.
translation: Bu, hak ettiklerinden daha lüks bir ceza.

english: The guard stares at you suspiciously.
Hello.
Don't distract me while I'm on duty! This mine has to be protected!
translation: Görev basindayken dikkatimi dagitma! Bu maden korunmali!

english: What's going to attack a mine?
Goblins! They wander everywhere, attacking anyone they think is small enough to be an easy victim. We need more cannons to fight them off properly.
translation: Goblinler! Her yere dolasirlar ve kolay kurban olabilecek kadar küçük gördükleri herkese saldirirlar. Onlari dogru dürüst savusturmak için daha fazla top lazim.

english: Cannons? Those sound expensive.

A new cannon can cost 750,000 coins, and the ammo isn't easy to get, but they do up to 30 hitpoints of damage with each shot. When you've got an important mine like this one to protect, it's worth the expense.
translation: Yeni bir top 750.000 sikkeye mal olabilir ve mühimmati da kolay bulunmaz, ama her atista 30 can puani hasar verir. Böyle önemli bir madeni korumak için bu masrafi yapmaya deger.

english: Thanks for the information.
You're welcome. Now please let me get on with my guard duties.
translation: Rica ederim. Simdi lütfen nöbet görevime devam etmeme izin verin.

english: Well, I've done my bit to help with that.
translation: Peki, ben de elimden geleni yaptim.

english: Yes, I heard. Now please let me get on with my guard duties.
translation: Evet, duydum. Simdi lütfen nöbet görevime devam etmeme izin verin.

english: Alright, I'll leave you alone now.
What are you doing here? You're not one of the guards.
translation: Burada ne yapiyorsun? Sen nöbetçilerden biri degilsin.
sub_category: Dialogue for Guard Captain (Civitas illa Fortis)

english: I was just exploring. Is that okay?
translation: Sadece kesif yapiyordum. Sorun olur mu?
sub_category: Dialogue for Guard Captain (Civitas illa Fortis)

english: I suppose, but why would you want to explore down here?
translation: Sanirim olmaz, ama neden burada kesif yapmak istersin ki?
sub_category: Dialogue for Guard Captain (Civitas illa Fortis)

english: Well why not?
sub_category: Dialogue for Guard Captain (Civitas illa Fortis)

english: It's cold for a start.
sub_category: Dialogue for Guard Captain (Civitas illa Fortis)

english: I'd say it's still pretty warm compared to some places I've been.
translation: Benim gördügüm bazi yerlere kiyasla burasi hala oldukça sicak.
sub_category: Dialogue for Guard Captain (Civitas illa Fortis)

english: If you say so. Just don't go causing any trouble.
translation: Sen öyle diyorsan öyledir. Sakin sorun çikarma.
sub_category: Dialogue for Guard Captain (Civitas illa Fortis)

english: Hello there. I have a message for you.
Sorry, I don't have anything for you right now.
translation: Üzgünüm, su anda sana verecek bir seyim yok.

[Player name] reporting for... nothing in particular, really.

english: What can I do for you?
What do you do here?
Hunting, mostly.
Hmm, I probably could've guessed that.
Perhaps you confused me for Teco over there? He's more into plants and all that.
translation: Belki de beni suradaki Teco ile karistirdiniz? O daha çok bitkilerle ilgilenir.

english: What got you into hunting then?
Don't tell too many people, but it's much nicer here than wearing a uniform and marching around!
translation: Çok fazla kisiye söylemeyin, ama burada üniforma giyip etrafta dolasmaktan çok daha güzel!

english: I'm still not sure how I feel about having Teco around the whole time though. People confuse us too often for my liking.
translation: Yine de Teco'nun sürekli etrafimda olmasi konusunda ne hissedecegimi hala bilmiyorum. Insanlar bizi çok sik karistiriyor.

english: See you later.
Can I get a rumour?
You're new here, aren't you? You might want to talk to Verity before you get started.
translation: Buraya yeni geldin, degil mi? Baslamadan önce Verity ile konusmak isteyebilirsin.

Only by interest at the moment, although the gang here are trying their best to train me.
translation: Su anda sadece ilgi alanim, ama buradaki ekip beni egitmek için ellerinden geleni yapiyorlar.

english: Are you enjoying it?
Well it's less boring than what I've done before, so I can't complain!
translation: Daha önce yaptigim islerden daha az sikici, o yüzden sikayet edemem!

english: What were you doing before this then?
translation: O zaman daha önce ne yapiyordun?

english: Well, my parents wanted me to go into the whole wine growing business, but farming was a bit too slow-paced for me.
translation: Ailem sarapçilik isine girmemi istiyordu, ama çiftçilik benim için biraz yavasti.

english: Quite! It's a good break from the city.
translation: Kesinlikle! Sehirden uzaklasmak için iyi bir yer.

Not too long, in fact. Gilman invited me to join the guild a short while ago.
translation: Aslinda çok uzun degil. Gilman kisa bir süre önce beni loncaya davet etti.

english: What were you up to before that?
Oh... A little bit of this and that.
Nothing particularly interesting?
translation: Özellikle ilginç bir sey yok mu?

english: You could say that... I'm definitely not proud of it.
translation: Öyle de denebilir... Kesinlikle gurur duydugum bir sey degil.

Same thing I'm always up to: studying the plants.
That's an odd thing for a hunter to do, no?
translation: Bir avci için garip bir sey, degil mi?

Hello there.
Can I help you out?
Can we talk about Fox?
I'm so glad you managed to find and help him. I've read his report and you feature quite heavily.
translation: Onu bulup yardim ettigine çok sevindim. Raporunu okudum ve senin adin oldukça sik geçiyor.

english: Oh, he did most of it himself. I was just running errands, really!
translation: Oh, çogunu kendisi yapti. Ben sadece ayak islerini yaptim, gerçekten!

english: Oi - don't sell yourself short. More importantly, don't give Fox too much credit.

english: If I'm remembering correctly, I asked you to hunt a [creature] and bring back some of its [rare parts].
Heard we're having an intel reshuffle. You should probably focus on your current task for now.
translation: Istihbarat biriminde yeniden yapilanma olacagini duydum. Su anda elindeki ise odaklanmalisin.

english: Gilman said that you're doing some work for him right now. I won't interfere with that.
translation: Gilman, su anda onun için bir is yaptigini söyledi. Ben buna karismayacagim.

english: We're all having a rest, but don't you have something to be getting on with?
translation: Hepimiz dinleniyoruz, ama senin yapman gereken bir is yok mu?

english: There's an extra seat at this table. I suppose you'd be interested in claiming it one day?
translation: Bu masada fazladan bir koltuk var. Bir gün onu almak isteyebilirsin, degil mi?

english: You need 91 Hunter to take on tier 4 Hunters' Rumours.
translation: 4. seviye Avcilarin Söylentileri'ni almak için 91 Avci'ya ihtiyacin var.

english: Can we talk about Fox?
Can I get a rumour?
See you later.
If the rumour is for a moonlight antelope:
Yes.
No.
Never mind.
What are all you people doing here?
Many of us disagree with the king about what freedoms the local monster population should have. We're taking a stand and mobilising our forces against the monstrous hordes.
translation: Çogumuz, yerel canavar nüfusunun sahip olmasi gereken özgürlükler konusunda kral ile ayni fikirde degiliz. Bir tavir aliyoruz ve canavar ordularina karsi güçlerimizi seferber ediyoruz.

english: I'm totally in awe of Johanhus, he really knows what's what. I know he keeps going on about monsters and it's clear there are too many of them, so hey, I agree with whatever Johanhus says.
translation: Johanhus'a hayranim, o gerçekten neyin ne oldugunu biliyor. Canavarlar hakkinda sürekli konusuyor ve onlarin sayisinin çok fazla oldugu açik, bu yüzden Johanhus ne derse ona katiliyorum.

english: We're against the monsters..like Johanhus says...we don't like them...you know.
translation: Canavarlara karsiyiz... Johanhus'un dedigi gibi... Onlari sevmiyoruz... Bilirsin.

english: Who are you and what do you do here?
I'm a strong believer in the non-monsters policy...we should really get rid of them...and if that means I have to live in a cave like a monster, so be it!
translation: Canavar karsiti politikaya güçlü bir sekilde inaniyorum... onlardan gerçekten kurtulmaliyiz... ve bu, bir canavar gibi magarada yasamak anlamina geliyorsa, öyle olsun!

english: What do you think you're going to achieve?
We want a world without monsters, to live in safety and without fear of being attacked by these ferocious beasts.
translation: Canavarlarin olmadigi, bu vahsi hayvanlarin saldirisindan korkmadan güvenle yasayabilecegimiz bir dünya istiyoruz.

english: But there aren't that many ferocious beasts in the towns and cities.
translation: Ama kasaba ve sehirlerde o kadar çok vahsi canavar yok.

english: That's not enough, we want to get rid of them totally, we want to enjoy the surrounding lands and not worry about our children playing in caves and so on.
translation: Bu yeterli degil, onlardan tamamen kurtulmak istiyoruz, çevremizdeki topraklarin tadini çikarmak ve çocuklarimizin magaralarda oynamasindan endise duymamak istiyoruz.

english: Where did all you people come from?

Most of us came from small towns that had been attacked by monsters. We all got fed up with it and so decided to join this movement. We're hoping to return to the towns and cities when we've cleaned up the areas
translation: Çogumuz canavarlarin saldirisina ugramis küçük kasabalardan geldik. Hepimiz bundan biktik ve bu harekete katilmaya karar verdik. Bu canavarlarin yasadigi bölgeleri temizledikten sonra kasaba ve sehirlere dönmeyi umuyoruz.

english: that these monsters live in.
translation: Bu canavarlarin yasadigi bölgeleri temizledikten sonra kasaba ve sehirlere dönmeyi umuyoruz.

english: Ok, thanks.
I hear you brother...
You speak the truth brother...
Well said brother...
What are all you people doing here?
Who are you and what do you do here?
What do you think you're going to achieve?
Where did all you people come from?
Ok, thanks.
Hello.
Good day.
Good day, Your Royal Highness.
Oi!
Rahr!
No!
Grr!
Aargh!
I'm a gonner!
It's no use, I'm done for!
Uggh!
This area is restricted. Leave now!
translation: Bu bölge yasak bölgedir. Hemen gidin!

english: Long live General Khazard!
Er... yes... quite right. Did you need something?
translation: Ee... evet... haklisiniz. Bir sey mi istiyordunuz?

english: Just checking if you have any orders for me.
translation: Bana vereceginiz bir emir var mi diye bakiyordum.

english: Not right now. Things are all very boring at the moment. What I'd give to be over at the bar having a nice Khali brew...
translation: Su anda yok. Su anda her sey çok sikici. Bar'da güzel bir Khali birasi içmek için neler vermezdim...

english: Khali brew? Can't say I've ever had one.
translation: Khali birasi mi? Hiç içtigimi söyleyemem.

english: Oh, nothing beats them! Mind you, don't make the mistake of having too many. Last time I did, I ended up falling straight to sleep.
translation: Oh, onlardan daha iyisi yok! Ama sakin çok fazla içmeyin. Son içtigimde, hemen uykuya dalmistim.

english: Good to know, thanks.
Hello again.
What a boring day. You'd think the slaves would be more entertaining.
translation: Ne sikici bir gün. Köleler daha eglenceli olur diye düsünürdün.

english: Not long now until you get a break though, right?
translation: Ama birazdan molaya çikacaksin, degil mi?

english: Too right! Then it's straight to the bar for a nice Khali brew.
translation: Aynen öyle! Sonra dogruca bara gidip güzel bir Khali birasi içecegim.

english: Do you still fancy a drink?
I really shouldn't...
Are you sure?
Oh... okay then, but just the one.
translation: Oh... tamam o zaman, ama sadece bir tane.

english: That is some gooood stuff... yeah... wooh, yeah!
translation: Bu çok iyi bir sey... evet... wooh, evet!

english: Are you alright?
Yeesshh! Oooh, maybe I sshould relax for a while.
Good idea. I'll look after the prisoners.
Yeesh... that shounds reasonable. Here, take the keysch. Any trouble, you give... you give 'em a good beating.
translation: Evet... bu mantikli geliyor. Al, anahtarlari al. Herhangi bir sorun olursa, onlara... onlara iyi bir dayak at.

english: Don't worry, I'll keep them in line
translation: Merak etme, onlari kontrol altinda tutarim.

english: Hello there.
Pleash... leave me alone. Did the walls always shway soooo much?
translation: Lütfen... beni rahat birakin. Duvarlar her zaman bu kadar sallanir miydi?

english: Thish areash resh... restricted! We don't like strangersh... 'specially ones who sway. Oooh!
translation: Bu bölge yasak bölge! Yabancilari sevmeyiz... özellikle de sallananlari. Oooh!

english: Hi, er... I lost the keys.
What? You're foolish... and I'm all drunk. Here... takes my shpare shh... set!
translation: Ne? Sen aptalsin... ve ben sarhosum. Al... benim yedek setimi al... hazir!

english: Hello there. Did you see that dwarf by the big forge? I think he wanted to talk to you.
translation: Merhaba. Büyük demirhanenin yanindaki cüceyi gördün mü? Sanirim seninle konusmak istiyordu.

english: Hello there.
Hello. Sorry, I'd love to stop and chat, but I have a new find that I need to work on. If you need anything, I'm sure Prescott can help.
translation: Merhaba. Üzgünüm, durup sohbet etmek isterdim ama üzerinde çalismam gereken yeni bir bulgum var. Bir seye ihtiyacin olursa Prescott yardimci olabilir.

english: Okay, thanks.
Not a problem.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Insanlari selamlamanin pek çok farkli yolu var. Merhaba, selam, merhaba...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her türlü sey! Kuleler görülmeye deger harika bir manzara.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmenizi tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Many greetings. Welcome to our fair island.
Enjoy your stay here. May it be spiritually uplifting!
translation: Burada iyi vakit geçirmenizi dilerim. Ruhen arinmanizi dilerim!

english: I've got a message for you from the Wise Old Man in Draynor Village.
translation: Draynor Köyü'ndeki Bilge Yasli Adam'dan sana bir mesajim var.

english: How kind of you to bring me a message to this remote island!
translation: Bu uzak adaya mesajimi getirmene ne kadar da naziksin!

english: I don't have much in the way of wealth, but I can spare you a few coins for your trouble.
translation: Çok zengin degilim ama zahmetin için sana birkaç sikke verebilirim.

english: In the name of Saradomin I shall bless you...
Here, let me give you some herbs.
The beasts which dwell under this island occasionally drop gems when they die - please take this one as a sign of my gratitude.
translation: Bu adanin altinda yasayan canavarlar öldüklerinde bazen mücevherler birakirlar. Lütfen bunu minnettarligimin bir göstergesi olarak kabul et.

english: Hi, I was wondering, can you quickly bless this for me?
translation: Merhaba, acaba bunu benim için çabucak kutsayabilir misin?

english: A somewhat strange request, but I see no harm in... Wait a moment... is that BLOOD?
translation: Biraz garip bir istek, ama bir zarari yok... Bir dakika... Bu KAN mi?

english: Erm... yes...
Why do you want me to bless a pot full of someones blood???
translation: Neden birinin kaniyla dolu bir çömlegi kutsamami istiyorsun???

english: Oh, don't worry, it's not 'someones', it's my own!
translation: Oh, merak etme, “birinin” degil, benim kendi kanim!

english: I... see... Well it is an unusual thing, but I see no harm in it. Take this, and walk in peace with Saradomin.
translation: Anliyorum... Bu alisilmadik bir sey, ama bir zarari yok. Al bunu ve Saradomin'in huzurunda yürü.
