Hello again. How can I help you?
How are things going here?
Things are slowly coming back to life in our city of the dead. The bank under the Temple of the Lesser Gods has been restored, and a number of our merchants have reopened their stalls.
translation: Ölüler sehrimizde hayat yavas yavas normale dönüyor. Küçük Tanrilar Tapinagi'nin altindaki banka restore edildi ve birçok tüccar tezgahlarini yeniden açti.

english: What about the plagues?
We're making progress on them. With our citizens back, we had enough people to finally deal with the frogs and locusts that were filling the town up.
translation: Bu konuda ilerleme kaydediyoruz. Vatandaslarimiz geri döndügü için, sehri dolduran kurbagalar ve çekirgelerle nihayet basa çikacak kadar insanimiz oldu.

english: We worried they'd just come back, but perhaps we have managed to appease whichever god sent them.
translation: Geri döneceklerinden endiseleniyorduk, ama belki de onlari gönderen tanriyi yatistirmayi basardik.

english: The infected cows have been handled as well. The only plague left now is this infuriating pox. Still, at least it isn't contagious.
translation: Enfekte olmus inekler de halledildi. Simdi geriye kalan tek veba, bu sinir bozucu çiçek hastaligi. Yine de, en azindan bulasici degil.

english: Any sign of Menaphos opening up again?
translation: Menaphos'un yeniden açilacagina dair bir isaret var mi?

english: They are adamant that their city must remain closed until all the plagues have gone. Until we can get rid of the pox, I can't see their gates opening to us, or to anyone else.
translation: Tüm vebalar ortadan kalkana kadar sehirlerinin kapali kalmasi gerektigi konusunda kararlilar. Çiçek hastaligini ortadan kaldirana kadar, kapilarinin bize veya baska birine açilacagini sanmiyorum.

english: Well at least things are moving in the right direction.
translation: En azindan isler dogru yönde ilerliyor.

english: Indeed. Now, is there anything else I can do for you?
translation: Gerçekten de öyle. Peki, sizin için yapabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: Could I have another lamp?
I'm afraid I only had the one.
No. I should get going.
Hello again.
Wonderful! The city of the dead has fully come back to life, and it's all thanks to you!
translation: Harika! Ölüler sehri tamamen hayata döndü ve hepsi senin sayende!

english: Well I'm happy to have helped. Any news from Menaphos?
translation: Yardimci olabildigime sevindim. Menaphos'tan haber var mi?

english: They are continuing their preparations. It will take some time, but the city will soon be open once more.
translation: Hazirliklarina devam ediyorlar. Biraz zaman alacak ama sehir yakinda tekrar açilacak.

english: Great!
Could I have another circlet?
Certainly, though it will cost you 10,000 coins.
Here you go.
You don't seem to have enough money for it.
translation: Bunun için yeterli paraniz yok gibi görünüyor.

english: Oh...
That's too much.
Fair enough. Let me know if you change your mind.
I should get going.
Until next time.
Hey, hey, hey! What in the name of sweet suffering Icthlarin are you doing?
translation: Hey, hey, hey! Tatli aci çeken Icthlarin adina ne yapiyorsun?

english: I thought this acne potion might clear up your spots.
translation: Bu sivilce iksiri sivilcelerini temizleyebilir diye düsündüm.

english: All that you'll achieve by pouring that potion on me is to ruin my lovely robes.
translation: O iksiri üzerime dökerek tek basaracagin sey, güzel cüppemi mahvetmek olacak.

english: Sorry, I was just trying to help.
Hey there. I was wondering if you could do me a favour?
translation: Merhaba. Bana bir iyilik yapabilir misin?

english: Oh? What kind of favour?
I know cremation isn't your way, but is there anything you could do with these ashes?
translation: Kremasyon sizin geleneklerinizde yok biliyorum, ama bu küllerle yapabileceginiz bir sey var mi?

english: Well, like you say, it is not really our way. Still, with all you've done for us, I'm willing to try.
translation: Dedigin gibi, bizim geleneklerimizde yok. Yine de, bizim için yaptiklarindan dolayi denemeye hazirim.

english: That's all I ask. Thank you.
Could I have another lamp?
No. I should get going.
How are things going here?
Could I have another circlet?
Here you go.
That's too much.
I should get going.
Hello!
What? Oh, hello. I was deep in thought. Did you want me to show you the prices of weapons and armour?
translation: Ne? Merhaba. Düsüncelere dalmistim. Silah ve zirhlarin fiyatlarini göstereyim mi?

english: You seem a bit flustered.
Sorry, I'm just deep in thought. I'm waiting for many deals to complete today.
translation: Üzgünüm, dalmisim. Bugün birçok anlasmanin tamamlanmasini bekliyorum.

english: What sort of things are you selling?
Good old weapons and armour! My people - dwarves, you understand - are hoping I can trade with humans.
translation: Eski silahlar ve zirhlar! Benim halkim, yani cüceler, insanlarla ticaret yapmami umuyorlar.

english: It looks like you've come to the right place for that.
translation: Bunun için dogru yere gelmissin gibi görünüyor.

english: I have indeed, my friend. Now, can I help you?
translation: Aynen öyle dostum. Simdi, nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: Yes, show me the prices of weapons and armour.
translation: Evet, silah ve zirhlarin fiyatlarini gösterir misin?

english: Can you tell me about the bank's auto-charging services?
translation: Bankanin otomatik ücretlendirme hizmetleri hakkinda bilgi verir misin?

english: Hm? Oh, yes. If you don't want to charge your items yourself, you can have the bank attendant do it for you on withdrawal.
translation: Hm? Oh, evet. Esyalarini kendin ücretlendirmek istemiyorsan, banka görevlisi çekim sirasinda senin için bunu yapabilir.

english: How do they know how many charges to add?
translation: Kaç kez sarj edilecegini nasil bilirler?

english: You can tell them how many you would like for each item. Or if you'd like, I can let them know a minimum threshold for all items.
translation: Her esya için kaç kez sarj edilmesini istedigini onlara söyleyebilirsin. Ya da istersen, tüm esyalar için minimum esigi onlara bildirebilirim.

english: What would you like the withdrawal threshold to be?
translation: Para çekme esiginin ne olmasini istersin?

english: Your chargeable items will be charged with up to [value] charges on withdrawal. You can edit this value for individual items by toggling 'Bank item options' on in the bank settings menu, and right clicking the item.
I don't think that's necessary, but thank you for offering.
translation: Bence buna gerek yok, ama teklifin için tesekkürler.

english: Alright then. Where was I...?
I'll leave you alone.
Thank you, I have much on my mind.
Wow, that's cheap.
Oh. That didn't sell so well.
Hmmm. If I spend twenty thousand on that, then...
translation: Hmmm. Buna yirmi bin harcarsam, o zaman...

english: Jackpot! I'm in the money now!
Hahaha! Trading the likes of which I have never seen.
translation: Hahaha! Daha önce hiç görmedigim türden bir ticaret.

english: You seem a bit flustered.
Yes, show me the prices of weapons and armour.
translation: Evet, bana silah ve zirhlarin fiyatlarini göster.

english: I'll leave you alone.
Can you tell me about the bank's auto-charging services?
translation: Bankanin otomatik ödeme hizmetleri hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Yes.
Yes, I'm ok with this.
No
No.
Hops don't wanna talk now.
What is this cave here for?
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Red chinchompa hunting ground)

english: Ah, a few of the most hunted creatures around here have been captured and secured in this cave to allow the most esteemed hunters to catch them with ease.
translation: Ah, bu civardaki en çok avlanan yaratiklarin birkaçi bu magarada yakalanip tutuldu, böylece en saygin avcilar onlari kolayca yakalayabilir.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Red chinchompa hunting ground)

english: Can I use the cave?
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Red chinchompa hunting ground)

english: Yes, you can. Head inside to hunt in peace.
translation: Evet, kullanabilirsiniz. Içeri girip huzur içinde avlanabilirsiniz.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Red chinchompa hunting ground)

english: Unfortunately not. Only those who have completed the hard tier of the Western Provinces achievement diary may enter.
translation: Maalesef hayir. Sadece Bati Eyaletleri basari günlügünün zor seviyesini tamamlayanlar girebilir.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Red chinchompa hunting ground)

english: Come back when you have and I shall allow you entry.
translation: Tamamladiginizda geri gelin, size giris izni verecegim.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Red chinchompa hunting ground)

english: Sorry, but only those who've completed the hard set of the Western Provinces tasks may enter my private hunting ground.
translation: Üzgünüm, ama sadece Bati Eyaletleri görevlerinin zor seviyesini tamamlayanlar benim özel avlanma alanima girebilir.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Red chinchompa hunting ground)

english: Ah, this is a wonderful area for a spot of hunting, don't you think?
translation: Ah, burasi avlanmak için harika bir yer, sence de öyle degil mi?
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: I don't know, is it?
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Oh absolutely; there's a huge variety of creatures to catch around here. You've got butterflies, polar kebbits, sabre-toothed kebbits, birds and even kyatts! Surely one of those piques your interest?
translation: Kesinlikle; burada avlanabilecegin çok çesitli yaratiklar var. Kelebekler, kutup kebbitleri, kiliç disli kebbitler, kuslar ve hatta kyattlar var! Bunlardan biri mutlaka ilgini çekmistir, degil mi?
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Where would I find polar kebbits?
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Funnily enough, you've just put your finger right on the problem. With polar kebbits, finding them is the hardest part! You'll have to track them down.
translation: Komik bir sekilde, sorunun tam da özüne parmak bastin. Kutup kebbitlerini bulmak en zor kismi! Onlari takip etmen gerekecek.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: How would I go about doing that, then?
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: The easiest way to get started is by looking somewhere you can be sure a kebbit will have been and then working from there. You see the holes around here leading down into the ice? They're kebbit burrows!
translation: Baslamak için en kolay yol, kebbitlerin mutlaka bulunacagi bir yer aramak ve oradan baslamak. Buralarda buza inen delikler görüyor musun? Onlar kebbit yuvalari!
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: You'll be hard pressed to catch a polar kebbit in its home, but if you search around the entrance to a burrow then you might be able to find a trail.
translation: Kutup kebbitini yuvasinda yakalamak zor olabilir, ama yuvanin girisini arastirirsaniz izlerini bulabilirsiniz.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Now, kebbit trails are usually fairly easy to follow once you've found them, but if the trail does peter out, you should try inspecting the surrounding scenery for clues as to where the creature may have gone.
translation: Kebbit izleri genellikle buldugunuzda takip etmesi oldukça kolaydir, ama izler kaybolursa, yaratigin nereye gitmis olabilecegine dair ipuçlari bulmak için çevreyi incelemeye çalismalisiniz.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Good places to look for clues include hollow logs in which the kebbit may have hidden or vegetation which may have been chewed or damaged.
translation: Ipuçlari aramak için iyi yerler arasinda kebbitlerin saklanmis olabilecegi içi bos kütükler veya çignenmis veya zarar görmüs bitkiler bulunur.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: There are also tunnels running through the ice here that the kebbits use, so you should check those out as well.
translation: Burada kebbitlerin kullandigi buzun içinden geçen tüneller de vardir, bu yüzden onlari da kontrol etmelisiniz.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: What's more, these tunnels can often help to shelter a trail from further snow, making it even easier for you to pick them up again.
translation: Dahasi, bu tüneller genellikle izleri daha fazla kardan korumaya yardimci olur, bu da izleri tekrar bulmanizi daha da kolaylastirir.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Eventually, of course, the kebbit will have probably hidden somewhere. Polar kebbits don't hang about in the open for long for fear of their natural predators.
translation: Elbette, kebbit muhtemelen bir yere saklanmis olacaktir. Kutup kebbitleri, dogal düsmanlarindan korktuklari için açik alanda uzun süre kalmazlar.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: If you suspect a kebbit is close by, try looking around for signs of disturbed snow. Polar kebbits will often bury themselves in snow drifts as a means of hiding.
translation: Kebbit'in yakinlarda oldugunu düsünüyorsaniz, karin bozulmus izleri olup olmadigina bakin. Kutup kebbitleri genellikle saklanmak için kar yiginlarina gömülürler.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: If you think you've found a kebbit, use a noose wand to haul the creature out from the snow.
translation: Bir kebbit buldugunuzu düsünüyorsaniz, ilmekli degnek kullanarak yaratigi kardan çikarin.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Wow, that's quite a lot to remember.
translation: Vay canina, hatirlanmasi gereken çok sey var.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Don't worry; if you find yourself struggling to follow a trail, just come and ask me and I'll see if I can help.
translation: Endiselenmeyin; izleri takip etmekte zorlaniyorsaniz, gelip bana sorun, size yardimci olmaya çalisirim.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: But remember, the best place to start is by searching around their burrows.
translation: Ama unutmayin, en iyi baslangiç noktasi, yuvalarinin çevresini aramaktir.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Great, thanks.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: How do you hunt birds?
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Ah, you can get cunning little bird snares for just that. You should be able to find them in specialist Hunter shops. Try to lay them in fairly open areas with lots of birds.
translation: Ah, bunun için kurnaz küçük kus tuzaklari alabilirsiniz. Bunlari avci dükkanlarinda bulabilirsiniz. Kuslarin çok oldugu açik alanlara yerlestirmeye çalisin.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Do I need to place any bait on these traps?
translation: Bu tuzaklara yem koymam gerekir mi?
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: No, that's not necessary. The idea is that the bird will see the trap as somewhere to perch. If the bird lands on the trigger stick, it should drop away and a small loop of wire should close around the bird's feet.
translation: Hayir, gerek yok. Buradaki amaç, kusun tuzagi tüneme yeri olarak görmesidir. Kus tetik çubuguna konarsa, çubuk düser ve küçük bir tel halkasi kusun ayaklarini sarar.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: And remember, it's important to collect any captures from your traps fairly quickly; otherwise, you risk losing them to various wild scavengers.
translation: Unutmayin, tuzaklarinizdan yakaladiklarinizi oldukça hizli bir sekilde toplamak önemlidir; aksi takdirde, çesitli yirtici hayvanlara kaptirma riski vardir.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: How can I improve my chances of capturing a creature?
translation: Bir yaratigi yakalama sansimi nasil artirabilirim?
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Ah, the key there is concealment, both of yourself and your traps.
translation: Ah, burada anahtar nokta, hem kendinizi hem de tuzaklarinizi gizlemektir.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: The most obvious point is to stay out of sight of your own traps. If possible, hide around a wall, hedge or similar. Failing that, make sure you're a good few feet away from your trap.
translation: En bariz nokta, kendi tuzaklarinizin görüs alanindan uzak durmaktir. Mümkünse, bir duvar, çit veya benzeri bir seyin arkasina saklanin. Bu mümkün degilse, tuzaginizdan birkaç metre uzakta oldugunuzdan emin olun.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: You can hide yourself even better by wearing clothing appropriate to the area in which you are hunting.
translation: Avlandiginiz bölgeye uygun giysiler giyerek kendinizi daha iyi gizleyebilirsiniz.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Your best bet is to use the skins of creatures native to the area. There is a very good tailor in east Varrock who may be able to help you with making clothing out of such skins.
translation: En iyi seçenek, o bölgeye özgü yaratiklarin derilerini kullanmaktir. Varrock'un dogusunda, bu derilerden giysi yapmaniza yardimci olabilecek çok iyi bir terzi var.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Finally, a lot of creatures may avoid your traps if they can smell a human scent on them. This is where smoking a trap can be useful.
translation: Son olarak, birçok yaratik, tuzaklarinizda insan kokusu alirsa tuzaklarinizdan kaçabilir. Bu durumda tuzagi tütsülemek faydali olabilir.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: It takes a bit of practice, but by using the smoke from a torch, you can mask any other scents that may surround a trap.
translation: Biraz pratik gerektirir, ancak bir mesaleyle çikan dumani kullanarak tuzagin etrafindaki diger kokulari maskeleyebilirsiniz.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Wow, thanks for your help.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Thanks for your help.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: You're welcome, good luck with the hunting.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: What's so special about butterflies?
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: That depends entirely on the butterfly.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: I'll admit that the activities of many butterflies may be of no interest at all. However, we are lucky in having around here some fine examples of rare thaumic butterflies.
translation: Birçok kelebegin faaliyetlerinin hiç ilgi çekici olmadigini kabul ediyorum. Ancak, bu bölgede nadir bulunan thaumic kelebeklerin güzel örneklerine sahip oldugumuz için sansliyiz.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: These butterflies reputedly have magical powers that, when released, can make a person stronger or heal otherwise critical wounds.
translation: Bu kelebeklerin, serbest birakildiklarinda bir kisiyi daha güçlü hale getirebilen veya aksi takdirde ölümcül yaralari iyilestirebilen sihirli güçlere sahip oldugu söylenir.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: At this point, I should offer a note of caution, however: it is also said that these powers will not manifest themselves if the butterflies are captured for selfish purposes.
translation: Ancak bu noktada bir uyarida bulunmaliyim: Bu güçlerin, kelebekler bencil amaçlarla yakalandiginda ortaya çikmayacagi da söylenir.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Rather, they are gifts that must be used by one person to aid another. Of course, you'll have to catch them first.
translation: Aksine, bunlar bir kisinin baska birine yardim etmek için kullanmasi gereken hediyelerdir. Tabii ki, önce onlari yakalamaniz gerekir.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: And how do I do that?
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Why, with a butterfly net of course! You should also carry some empty butterfly jars with you in which to keep the butterflies.
translation: Tabii ki kelebek agiyla! Ayrica kelebekleri saklamak için yaninizda bos kelebek kavanozlari da tasimalisiniz.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: How can I capture a sabre-toothed kebbit?
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Ah, now for these creatures I would recommend using a deadfall trap. Deadfalls are quite easy to set up, and yet you can catch some very reasonably sized creatures with them.
translation: Ah, bu yaratiklar için bir tuzak kurmanizi öneririm. Tuzaklar kurmak oldukça kolaydir ve bunlarla oldukça büyük yaratiklari yakalayabilirsiniz.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Deadfall traps basically work by having a large dead weight, such as a boulder, positioned so as to be delicately balanced above some form of bait.
translation: Tuzaklar temel olarak, bir kaya gibi büyük bir agirlik, bir tür yem üzerinde hassas bir sekilde dengelenmis sekilde konumlandirilarak çalisir.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: You will need to make sure you have a knife and some wood with you to create appropriate supports and a trigger for this sort trap.
translation: Bu tür bir tuzak için uygun destekler ve bir tetikleyici olusturmak için yaninizda bir biçak ve biraz odun bulundurmaniz gerekir.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: In the case of sabre-toothed kebbits you should use some form of raw meat to bait your trap, but other animals may prefer other baits, such as fish or vegetables.
translation: Kiliç disli kebbitler için tuzaginizi yemlemek için bir tür çig et kullanmalisiniz, ancak diger hayvanlar balik veya sebze gibi baska yemleri tercih edebilir.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Oooh, kyatts soundsinteresting. I want to catch one of those.
translation: Oooh, kyattlar ilginç görünüyor. Onlardan bir tane yakalamak istiyorum.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Well, you've set your sights high, kyatts are incredibly fearsome creatures, but with determination like that I'm sure you'll make it.
translation: Hedefiniz yüksek, kyattlar inanilmaz derecede korkutucu yaratiklar, ancak bu kadar kararliysaniz eminim basaracaksiniz.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Now, you're not going to be able to catch a kyatt with just a small box or a noose on a stick. You need a much bigger trap.
translation: Küçük bir kutu veya sopanin ucuna baglanmis bir ilmekle kyatt yakalayamazsiniz. Çok daha büyük bir tuzak gerekir.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Pit traps are a good bet. You'd be best off finding a natural dip in the ground as the basis for your trap. If you dig a pit yourself, you risk creatures noticing the disturbed ground nearby.
translation: Çukur tuzaklari iyi bir seçimdir. Tuzak için temel olarak zeminde dogal bir çukur bulman en iyisi olacaktir. Kendin çukur kazarsan, yaratiklarin yakindaki bozulmus zemini fark etme riski vardir.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Once you've found an appropriate spot, you'll need some logs and a knife. The logs serve two purposes.
translation: Uygun bir yer bulduktan sonra, birkaç kütük ve bir biçak gerekir. Kütüklerin iki amaci vardir.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Some can be carved into sharp skewers for the bottom of the pit; hopefully the kyatt will die when it falls onto these. Others can be used to conceal the trap.
translation: Bazilari çukurun dibine yerlestirmek için keskin sisler olarak oyulabilir; umarim kyatt bunlara düstügünde ölür. Digerleri ise tuzagi gizlemek için kullanilabilir.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Of course, even then the pit is going to look suspicious, so you're going to need to lure the kyatt onto the branches in some way. What actually tends to work best for this is, well, yourself!
translation: Tabii ki, o zaman bile çukur süpheli görünecektir, bu yüzden kyatt'i bir sekilde dallara çekmeniz gerekecektir. Bunun için en iyi sonuç veren sey, aslinda sizsiniz!
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: What? I don't like the sound of that.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Yes, that's the normal response, but I kid you not. If you really want a kyatt to follow you over that pit then just give it a good poke!
translation: Evet, bu normal bir tepki, ama saka yapmiyorum. Eger bir kyatt'in sizi çukura kadar takip etmesini istiyorsaniz, ona iyice bir dürtün!
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Of course, I suggest you use something long to poke it with. Poking a kyatt with your finger is likely to end in unfortunate limb loss.
translation: Tabii ki, onu dürtmek için uzun bir sey kullanmanizi öneririm. Bir kyatt'i parmaginizla dürtmek, muhtemelen talihsiz bir uzuv kaybiyla sonuçlanacaktir.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Fortunately, you can get very good sticks for poking from most Hunter shops.
translation: Neyse ki, çogu avci dükkanindan dürtmek için çok iyi sopalar bulabilirsiniz.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Once you have...got the creature's attention, try to lead it to one of your traps. Make sure to jump the branches when you reach the trap yourself, of course; it would be embarrassing to fall into your own trap.
translation: Yaratigin dikkatini çektikten sonra, onu tuzaklarindan birine yönlendirmeye çalis. Tabii ki, tuzaga ulastiginda dallarin üzerinden atladigindan emin ol; kendi tuzagina düsmek utanç verici olur.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Then, if the kyatt is giving you all of its attention, hopefully it won't notice the trap, and with any luck, it will stumble right into the pit.
translation: Sonra, kyatt tüm dikkatini sana veriyorsa, umarim tuzagi fark etmez ve sansin yaver giderse, çukura düser.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: That sounds a bit hit or miss, and kind of suicidal too!
translation: Bu biraz sans isi ve intihar gibi de geliyor!
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Well that's what makes it exciting, isn't it? But honestly, if you want to capture a kyatt, that's your best bet.
translation: Iste bu da onu heyecanli kilan sey, degil mi? Ama dürüst olmak gerekirse, bir kyatt yakalamak istiyorsaniz, en iyi sansiniz budur.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Can you teach me how to hunt?
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Why certainly. I reached the peak of my abilities some time ago, but I'm more than happy to help newcomers to the field. Was there anything in particular you had in mind?
translation: Elbette. Bir süre önce yeteneklerimin zirvesine ulastim, ancak bu alana yeni baslayanlara yardim etmekten mutluluk duyarim. Aklinizda belirli bir sey var mi?
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Where's the best place to start?
translation: Baslamak için en iyi yer neresi?
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: I always say a good starting point is to learn how to follow the creatures you want to capture. Around here, that means practicing on polar kebbits.
translation: Her zaman iyi bir baslangiç noktasinin, yakalamak istediginiz yaratiklari takip etmeyi ögrenmek oldugunu söylerim. Buralarda bu, kutup kebbitleri üzerinde pratik yapmak anlamina gelir.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: So how do I track them down, then?
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: What sort of creatures are there to hunt around here?
translation: Buralarda avlanabilecek ne tür yaratiklar var?
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Well, there's pretty much anything you could want to hunt. You've got butterflies, polar kebbits, sabre-toothed kebbits, birds and even kyatts! Surely one of those interests you?
translation: Avlamak isteyebileceginiz hemen hemen her sey var. Kelebekler, kutup kebbitleri, kiliç disli kebbitler, kuslar ve hatta kyattlar bile var! Bunlardan biri ilginizi çekmiyor mu?
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Sorry, I'm not that keen on hunting.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Really? What a shame, you looked like someone who could have had some promise.
translation: Gerçekten mi? Ne yazik, umut vaat eden biri gibi görünüyordunuz.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: I don't know, is it?
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)
source: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Where would I find polar kebbits?
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)
source: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: How do you hunt birds?
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)
source: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: I'd like to ask about another creature.
translation: Baska bir yaratik hakkinda soru sormak istiyorum.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)
source: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

translation: Bir yaratigi yakalama sansimi nasil artirabilirim?

sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

translation: Buralarda avlanabilecegim ne tür yaratiklar var?

english: Sorry, I'm not that keen on hunting.
sub_category: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)
source: Dialogue for Hunting expert (Rellekka Hunter area)

english: Greetings, fellow hunter. How can I be of help?
translation: Selamlar, avci dostum. Nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: What kinds of food and drink do you serve?
translation: Ne tür yiyecek ve içecekler servis ediyorsunuz?

english: In terms of drinks, we've got a Trapper's Tipple, and for food, a simple hearty stew.
translation: Içecek olarak Trapper's Tipple, yiyecek olarak da basit ve doyurucu bir güveç var.

english: But you don't have room to hold either of them, so you'll have to come back later.
translation: Ama ikisini de alabilecek yerin yok, bu yüzden daha sonra tekrar gelmen gerekecek.

english: Couldn't you just leave it on the ground for me?
translation: Onu benim için yere birakamaz misin?

english: We don't tend to just... leave things like that around here.
translation: Buralarda öylece esyalari birakma aliskanligimiz yok.

english: I'd love a Trapper's Tipple!
That'll be three coins then.
Oh, I can't afford one right now.
Could I grab a stew?
Absolutely! They're 20 coins these days.
Oh, I can't afford that right now.
I'll pass, thanks.
Can we talk about rumours?
Looks like you could do with talking to Verity first, given you're new to this whole business.
translation: Bu ise yeni basladigina göre, önce Verity ile konussan iyi olur.

english: Yes, yes. How can I help you on that front?
translation: Evet, evet. Bu konuda nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: Do you have any new ones for me?
translation: Bana yeni bir sey var mi?

english: Could you check out the validity of this report for me? Someone thinks they've seen a [creature]. Once you find it, bring back one of its [rare parts].
There's been rumours of a rare [creature] coming in. Once you find it, bring back one of its [rare parts].
We've got reports of a slightly different [creature] in the local population. Once you find it, bring back one of its [rare parts].
Looks like we need some information on a unique specimen amongst the local [creature] population. Once you find it, bring back some of its [rare parts].
I've heard rumours of a strange [creature] that you could check out for me. Once you find it, bring back one of its [rare parts].
Another one done? You're really doing a lot for the guild.
translation: Bir tane daha mi bitti? Lonca için gerçekten çok sey yapiyorsun.

english: Are you up for another?
Thanks for that. I'll mark off that report for you. Would you like another rumour?
translation: Tesekkürler. O raporu senin için isaretleyecegim. Baska bir söylenti ister misin?

english: Can you remind me which rumour I'm chasing right now?
translation: Su anda hangi söylentinin pesinde oldugumu hatirlatir misin?

english: You're hunting for me at the moment. This rumour was about a [creature]. You'll need to bring back some of its [rare parts].
I can see you're following [Guild Hunter]'s rumour looking for a [creature] at the moment. You'll need to bring back some of its [rare parts].
I seem to remember sending you off to hunt a [creature] and bring back one of its [rare parts]. Would you prefer that one, or a new one entirely?
That was it. I asked you to hunt a [creature] and bring back one of its [rare parts]. Best of luck.
I'm good, thanks.
What kinds of food and drink do you serve?
translation: Ne tür yiyecek ve içecekler servis ediyorsunuz?

english: I'd love a Trapper's Tipple!
Could I grab a stew?
I'll pass, thanks.
Can we talk about rumours?
Yes.
No.
Yes, go back to his old one.
Yes, but with a brand new one.
I'm good, thanks.
Hur hur hur! Well look here, a puny fleshy human!
translation: Hur hur hur! Bakin, zayif etli bir insan!
sub_category: Dialogue for Ice troll (Desert Treasure I)

english: You should beware of the icy wind that runs through this valley, it will bring a fleshy like you to a cold end indeed!
translation: Bu vadiyi esen buz gibi rüzgardan sakinmalisin, senin gibi etli birini soguk bir sona götürür!
sub_category: Dialogue for Ice troll (Desert Treasure I)

english: I think the locals are taking a liking to us! One of them hasn't stopped wearing those clothes Arnkel sold her. Much better than those piddly little things she was wearing before!
translation: Sanirim yerliler bizi sevmeye basladi! Içlerinden biri Arnkel'in sattigi kiyafetleri giymeye devam ediyor. Önceden giydigi o önemsiz seylerden çok daha iyi!

english: I think they're piddly because of how warm it is here...
Bah! A bit of heat never hurt anyone.
translation: Bah! Biraz sicaklik kimseye zarar vermez.

english: I don't think that's true.
Oh stop your whining, traveller! Now, I think it's time for a drink.
translation: Sizlanmayi kes, gezgin! Simdi içki içme zamani geldi.

english: Oh stop your whining, [Fremennik name]! Now, I think it's time for a drink.
translation: Sizlanmayi kes! Simdi içki içme zamani geldi.

english: Thanks so much for saving us from those stinky gublinch. They were awful! I hope Shanty gave you somefing cool for your efforts.
translation: Bizi o kokusmus gublinçlerden kurtardigin için çok tesekkürler. Çok korkunçlardi! Umarim Shanty çabalarin için sana güzel bir sey vermistir.

english: Greetings warrior, how may I help you?
How long have you worked here?
Oh ever since the Guild opened. I like it here.
Why's that?
Well.. what with all these warriors around, there's not much chance of my bank being robbed is there!
translation: Sey... etrafta bu kadar savasçi varken, bankamin soyulma ihtimali pek yok, degil mi?

english: Bye!
Invest your time and money wisely.
I'd like to access my bank account, please.
I'd like to check my PIN settings.
I'd like to collect items.
How long have you worked here?
Bye!
Hello there. What are you doing here?
I'm waiting here hoping that someone can guide me to the Paterdomus, the temple on the Salve.
translation: Salve'deki Paterdomus tapinagina giden yolu bilen biri çikarsa diye burada bekliyorum.

english: Where is Paterdomus?
Oh, Paterdomus is that rather impressive looking temple on the Salve... I'm sure you must have passed it on your way into Morytania.
translation: Paterdomus, Salve'deki oldukça etkileyici görünümlü tapinaktir... Morytania'ya giderken oradan geçmis olmalisin.

english: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
I'm hoping to get back to civilisation and see what the lands of Misthalin look like.
translation: Medeniyete geri dönüp Misthalin topraklarinin nasil bir yer oldugunu görmek istiyorum.

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Paterdomus?
translation: Paterdomus'a giderken yol üzerinde düsmanlarla karsilasirsak kendini savunabilir misin?

english: I can defend myself somewhat if we run into trouble...yes, but let's hope that we don't, eh!
translation: Basimiz belaya girerse kendimi bir sekilde savunabilirim... evet, ama umalim da basimiza bela gelmesin, degil mi?

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: Hmmm, görünüse göre bir takipçin var. Bu yolculukta kendi basina dolasirsa kaybolabilir. Takipçin güvende oldugunda yola çikalim.

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: Gerçekten mi? Bu harika olur! Hedefe vardigimizda sana küçük bir ödül verecegim.

english: Temple Trekking begins
Ok, which route should we take?
Ok, thanks.
Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: Ah, bana biraz erzak vermek istiyorsun, ha? Sirt çantami açayim.

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than staying in Burgh de Rott.
translation: Oh, bu yolculuktan nefret ediyorum, ama Burgh de Rott'ta kalmaktan iyidir.

english: It's scary here...let's get going!
When are we going to get to Paterdomus?
We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on.
translation: Bütün gün burada durup sohbet edemeyiz, hadi devam edelim.

english: Do you visit Paterdomus often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: Paterdomus'a sik sik gider misin? Rotayi iyi biliyorsun gibi görünüyor.

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...?
Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Burgh de Rott. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: Hay aksi! Burgh de Rott'a geri dönmek zorunda kalacagiz galiba. O köprüden geçemeyiz!

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
Player completes the bridge event
Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Burgh de Rott.
translation: Bu is bitti... Bu batakliktan geçemeyecegiz galiba. Burgh de Rott'a geri dönmek zorunda kalacagiz.

english: Player completes the bog event
Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: Hey... bu harika... harika bir is çikardin... Seni takip edecegim.

english: Whahay...that was great!
But we really should be heading off now.
Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
Player completes the river event
That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: Bu inanilmaz! Ben de aynisini yapmaliyim.

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: Whahay! Harikaydi! Ama artik gerçekten yola çikmaliyiz.

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
This is scary!
Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
Ahhh, two tentacles!
...three tentacles!
I think I'm going to faint!
Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: Vay canina! Su canavara bak! O seyi kendi basina halletmen gerekecek!

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the temple. Here's your reward.
translation: Beni tapinaga güvenle ulastirdigin için çok tesekkürler. Iste ödülün.

english: Jayene Kliyn gives you a reward token!
translation: Jayene Kliyn sana bir ödül jetonu veriyor!

english: Where is Paterdomus?
Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
I can take you to Paterdomus.
Ok, thanks.
Please excuse me, I'm rather busy.
Hey, I'm your contractor from Mahogany Homes, what did you want done?
translation: Merhaba, ben Mahogany Homes'tan müteahhidin, ne yaptirmak istiyorsun?

english: I'd like a Wooden table built.
I'd like a Wooden bookcase built.
I'd like a Wooden shelf built.
I'd like a Wooden bed built.
I'd like a Wooden drawer built.
I'd like a Wooden dresser built.
I'd like my mirror fixed.
I'd like a Wooden chair built.
I'd like a Oak table built.
I'd like a Oak bookcase built.
I'd like a Oak shelf built.
I'd like a Oak bed built.
I'd like a Oak drawer built.
I'd like a Oak dresser built.
I'd like a Oak chair built.
I'd like a Teak table built.
I'd like a Teak bookcase built.
I'd like a Teak shelf built.
I'd like a Teak bed built.
I'd like a Teak drawer built.
I'd like a Teak dresser built.
I'd like a Teak chair built.
I'd like a Mahogany table built.
I'd like a Mahogany bookcase built.
I'd like a Mahogany shelf built.
I'd like a Mahogany bed built.
I'd like a Mahogany drawer built.
I'd like a Mahogany dresser built.
I'd like a Mahogany chair built.
I've finished with the work you wanted.
Thank you so much! Would you like a cup of tea before you go?
translation: Çok tesekkür ederim! Gitmeden önce bir fincan çay ister misiniz?

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks, I better be off.
Aaah, nothing like a nice cupppa tea!
translation: Aaah, güzel bir fincan çay gibisi yok!

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks.
Thanks so much for saving us from those stinky gublinch. They were awful! I hope Shanty gave you somefing cool for your efforts.
translation: Bizi o kokusmus gublinçlerden kurtardigin için çok tesekkürler. Çok korkunçlardi! Umarim Shanty çabalarin için sana güzel bir sey vermistir.

english: Welcome to Jelly's Kurask cave.
Who are you?
I am Jelly.
When Jelly was just a baby troll, parents left him in Slayer cave... But Jelly is strong, Jelly learn to survive in the cave, and one day Jelly will become great Slayer master!
translation: Jelly henüz bebek bir trolken, ailesi onu Slayer magarasina birakti... Ama Jelly güçlüdür, Jelly magarada hayatta kalmayi ögrendi ve bir gün Jelly büyük bir Slayer ustasi olacak!

english: Why is this area private?

When the Kurasks finded new treasures, many humans come to the Slayer cave to hunt them... No Kurasks left for Jelly to train on, so Jelly makes a private area just for training. These be Jelly's very own Kurask!
translation: Kurasklar yeni hazineler buldugunda, birçok insan onlari avlamak için Slayer magarasina geliyor... Jelly'nin antrenman yapabilecegi Kurask kalmadi, bu yüzden Jelly sadece antrenman için özel bir alan olusturdu. Bunlar Jelly'nin kendi Kurask'lari!

english: Not just any human gets to train up here, you has to be on a Kurask Slayer task.
translation: Her insan burada antrenman yapamaz, Kurask Avcisi görevi üzerinde olmalisin.

english: What kind of a name is Jelly?
Jelly grew up in this cave, there not much choice around for a hungry troll...
translation: Jelly bu magarada büyüdü, aç bir trol için fazla seçenek yoktu...

english: Thanks, goodbye.
Naughty human! You not hunting the Kurask! Jelly's Kurasks only for people on Slayer tasks.
translation: Yaramaz insan! Kurask avlamiyorsun! Jelly'nin Kurask'lari sadece Avci görevinde olanlar içindir.

english: Who are you?
Why is this area private?
What kind of a name is Jelly?
Thanks, goodbye.
What're yer looking for, me luv'?
Let's trade.
Well me luv', I've got some special rations for the soldiers in the fields ou'there; courtesy of the mainland Void Knights. Take a looksie.
translation: Canim, orada savasan askerler için özel erzaklarim var; anakara Void Knights'in hediyesi. Bir bak.

english: I don't need anything right now.
translation: Su anda bir seye ihtiyacim yok.

english: Let's trade.
I don't need anything right now.
translation: Su anda bir seye ihtiyacim yok.

english: Hey kid, what's all the shouting about?
translation: Hey çocuk, bu bagirislar da neyin nesi?

english: Christmas is ruined!
Again? What's happened this time?
translation: Yine mi? Bu sefer ne oldu?

english: The man in the shop won't give us our Gingerbread Gnomes, he's keeping them for himself.
translation: Dükkândaki adam bize Zencefilli Cücelerimizi vermiyor, onlari kendine sakliyor.

english: That doesn't sound right, are you sure that's really what he's doing?
translation: Bu dogru gelmiyor, gerçekten öyle yaptigindan emin misin?

english: Of course he is, why else won't he give us any?
translation: Tabii ki öyle, yoksa neden bize vermesin ki?

english: Something seems off, maybe I should go talk to Santa to find out what's happened.
translation: Bir terslik var, belki de Noel Baba ile konusup ne oldugunu ögrenmeliyim.

english: Do whatever you want, I want my Gingerbread Gnomes!
translation: Ne istersen yap, ben zencefilli kurabiye cücelerimi istiyorum!

english: Where are our Gingerbread Gnomes!
I'm working on it, I'm working on it.
Hurry up!
You've ruined Christmas!
Give us the Gnomes!
Why are you still here? I saved Christmas, you can go home.
translation: Neden hâlâ buradasin? Noel'i kurtardim, eve gidebilirsin.

english: We still have to wait for the delivery to come in, dummy.
translation: Hala teslimatin gelmesini beklememiz gerekiyor, aptal.

english: I'll leave you to it then.
Christmas is Saved!
Hurry up with the delivery!
'Ello there.
Tell me about this room?
translation: Bu oda hakkinda bana biraz bilgi verir misin?

english: Well... s'like thish...
Thish here'sh a shtore room right?
translation: Burasi bir depo odasi, degil mi?

english: A store room you mean?
That'sh what I shaid! *HIC* A shtore room.... Now technic'ly shpeaking, I should be outshide guarding it...
translation: Aynen öyle dedim! *HIC* Bir depo odasi... Teknik olarak konusursak, disarida onu korumam gerekirdi...

english: But you just nipped in to have a quick drink?
translation: Ama sen hizlica bir seyler içmek için içeri mi girdin?

english: Yep... and to practish.
Practish? I mean.. practise what?
translation: Pratik mi? Yani... neyi pratik yapiyorsun?

english: Keg balancin. I'm the besht.
translation: Fiçi dengeleme. Ben bu konuda en iyisiyim.

english: Tell me how to balance kegs?
Yer very very shtrange. But.... you pick the keg up, and balance it on yer head, then you pick another keg up and put that on top. S'really very eashy.
translation: Sen çok tuhafsin. Ama... fiçiyi kaldirip kafanda dengeliyorsun, sonra baska bir fiçi kaldirip üstüne koyuyorsun. Gerçekten çok kolay.

english: Eashy?
Yesh. Eashy.
But you couldn't ever balansh ash many ash meee!
translation: Ama benim kadar çok fiçi dengeleyemezsin!

english: That sounds like a challenge, I'll show you!
translation: Bu bir meydan okuma gibi geliyor, sana gösterecegim!

english: May I claim my tokens please?
Wha'? You ain't earnt any mate!
Well... err.. ish not offishal or anyfin... but I got the ledger of tokensh 'ere. I'll jus' err.. write it in!
translation: Sey... resmi degil ama... jetonlarin defterini burada tutuyorum. Ben yazarim!

english: Won't they know?
Nah... hic.... I'm a wizsh at copyin' signaturesh! Jus' ashk an offishal mem'er of shtaff like Shloane fer yer tokensh.
translation: Hayir... hic... Imza taklitinde ustayim! Jetonlarini almak için Shloane gibi resmi bir personelden iste.

english: The rather drunk Jimmy scribbles the tokens you've earned from Keg Balancing in the Ledger so that you can claim them from an official member of training staff.
translation: Oldukça sarhos olan Jimmy, Keg Balancing'den kazandigin jetonlari Defter'e karalar, böylece egitim personelinin resmi bir üyesinden jetonlarini alabilirsin.

english: Bye!
Shure you wouldn't like an ickle drinkie fore yer go?
translation: Gitmeden önce bir içki içmek istemez misin?

english: No thanks, got things to do, people to see, tokens to earn...
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, yapacak islerim, görecek insanlar, kazanacak jetonlar var...

english: Ya got no chance o' beatin' me [player name]!
No one's stronger than me, 'speshly not [player name]!
Wow! That'sh bery impr....imp...impresh.... good [player name]! Equalsh my record!
translation: Vay canina! Bu çok etkileyici... etkileyici... etkileyici... iyi! Rekorumu egale ettin!

english: Tell me about this room.
translation: Bu oda hakkinda bilgi ver bana.

english: Tell me how to balance kegs.
May I claim my tokens please?
Bye!
Hi, I'm Joe, door guard for Lady Keli.
translation: Merhaba, ben Joe, Leydi Keli'nin kapi bekçisiyim.

english: Hi, who are you guarding here?
Can't say, all very secret. You should get out of here. I am not supposed to talk while I guard.
translation: Söyleyemem, hepsi çok gizli. Buradan gitmelisin. Bekçilik yaparken konusmamam gerekiyor.

english: Halt! Who goes there? Friend or foe?
translation: Dur! Kim var orada? Dost mu düsman mi?

english: Hi friend, I am just checking out things here.
translation: Merhaba dostum, sadece etrafi kontrol ediyorum.

english: The Prince got away, I am in trouble. I better not talk to you, they are not sure I was drunk.
translation: Prens kaçti, basim belada. Seninle konusmasam iyi olur, sarhos oldugumdan emin degiller.

english: I won't say anything, your secret is safe with me.
translation: Hiçbir sey söylemem, sirrin bende güvende.

english: Hello there!
Who are you?
I'm John, I specialise in archaeology and there's some very interesting ruins in this area.
translation: Ben John, arkeoloji uzmani ve bu bölgede çok ilginç kalintilar var.

english: Is that like fossils and stuff?
Oh my word no. Archaeology is the study of sentient races history through study of artefacts and ruins.
translation: Hayir, hayir. Arkeoloji, eserler ve kalintilar üzerinde yapilan arastirmalarla, bilinçli irklarin tarihini inceleyen bilim dalidir.

english: Weren't fossils sentient?
Well... we have no proof to suggest such.
translation: Sey... bunu gösteren hiçbir kanitimiz yok.

english: What is going on here?
This is our base camp for exploration of this wonderful island.
translation: Burasi, bu harika adayi kesfetmek için kurdugumuz ana kampimiz.

english: Anything I can do to help?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: No, no. You've already helped admirably. Our lives are much more comfortable thank you.
translation: Hayir, hayir. Zaten çok yardimci oldun. Hayatimiz çok daha rahat, tesekkürler.

english: What should I do?
Explore! There's so much here we don't understand.
translation: Kesfet! Burada anlamadigimiz çok sey var.

english: But where?
I've heard there's a pretty spectacular structure up near the mountain, but I haven't gone there yet.
translation: Dagin yakininda oldukça muhtesem bir yapi oldugunu duydum, ama henüz oraya gitmedim.

english: Who are you?
What is going on here?
What should I do?
What?
How do you feel about all the more powerful monsters?
translation: Daha güçlü canavarlar hakkinda ne düsünüyorsun?

english: There are no monsters more powerful than us!
We're the top monster of all Gielinor!
No you're not. The Kalphite Queen is more powerful than you!
translation: Hayir, degilsiniz. Kalphite Kraliçesi sizden daha güçlü!

english: Kalphite Queen? What's that?
translation: Kalphite Kraliçesi mi? O da ne?

english: She's a giant insect who lives in the desert.
An insect?
Ha ha ha ha!
No insect could be tougher than us! We're the best!
translation: Hiçbir böcek bizden daha güçlü olamaz! Biz en iyisiyiz!

english: No, she's way tougher than you!
translation: Hayir, o sizden çok daha güçlü!

english: I don't believe it!
And even if this Kalphite Queen is real, which I doubt, second best isn't bad, is it?
translation: Ve bu Kalphite Kraliçesi gerçek olsa bile, ki ben buna süpheliyim, ikinci olmak fena degil, degil mi?

english: But it's not just the Kalphite Queen. What about the TzTok-Jad?
translation: Ama sadece Kalphite Kraliçesi degil. Peki ya TzTok-Jad?

english: Never heard of it!
Or the Dagannoth Rex?
You're making it up!
Or the Chaos Elemental?
Now then, how do you know you're not just making all these monsters up to demoralise us?
translation: Peki, tüm bu canavarlari bizi demoralize etmek için uydurmadigini nereden biliyoruz?

english: All right then, what about me?
Puny human! You're not a fearsome monster!
translation: Zayif insan! Sen korkunç bir canavar degilsin!

english: I defeated you, didn't I? So I must be stronger than you!
translation: Seni yendim, degil mi? Demek ki senden daha güçlüyüm!

english: You got lucky! I'll get you next time!
translation: Sansliydin! Bir dahaki sefere seni yenecegim!

english: Now that you're a stuffed head? I don't think so!
translation: Simdi kafan doldurulmus halde mi? Sanmiyorum!

english: Which of you heads is...
I am!
Shut up! I am!
Don't be silly! It's obvious that I am!
But you don't even know what I was going to say!
It doesn't matter. I'm the strongest, cleverest, and most attractive. Whatever it is, I am the most of it!
translation: Önemli degil. Ben en güçlü, en zeki ve en çekiciyim. Ne olursa olsun, en çok ben varim!

english: Just a minute. What if it's something bad?
translation: Bir dakika. Ya kötü bir seyse?

english: Good point. What is it you were going to say? Because if it's something good, I'm it, but if it's something bad then it's one of these two ugly mugs.
translation: Haklisin. Ne söyleyecektin? Çünkü iyi bir seyse ben, ama kötü bir seyse bu iki çirkin suratlidan biri.

english: I've forgotten what I was going to ask now.
Me! I am!
Sorry, just said that on reflex.
Hey, [House owner] killed the King Black Dragon!
translation: Hey, Ev sahibi Kral Kara Ejderhayi öldürdü!

english: No [he/she] didn't!
What? Oh, ah, no, of course [he/she] didn't. We're actually an artificial likeness of the King Black Dragon. No one could really kill the King Black Dragon!
translation: Ne? Oh, ah, hayir, tabii ki öldürmedi. Aslinda biz Kral Kara Ejderhanin yapay bir kopyasiyiz. Kimse Kral Kara Ejderhayi öldüremez!

english: No! We're - I mean, it's - far too powerful!
translation: Hayir! Biz... Yani, bu... çok güçlü!

english: What are you talking about? Of course we're the King Black Dragon!
translation: Neden bahsediyorsun? Tabii ki biz Kral Kara Ejderha'yiz!

english: Shut up, you idiot!
How do you feel about all the more powerful monsters?
translation: Daha güçlü canavarlar hakkinda ne düsünüyorsun?

english: Which of you heads is...
Hello.
Despicable thieving scum!
What happened?
None of your business. Clear off!
Someone came in and stole my armour!
Oh no! I'll let you know if I see anyone suspicious...
translation: Olamaz! Süpheli birini görürsem sana haber veririm...

english: Welcome, iknami. What can I get you?
Let's see what you have.
translation: Ne var ne yok bir bakalim.

english: Nothing, thanks.
Fair enough.
Let's see what you have.
translation: Ne var ne yok bir bakalim.

english: Nothing, thanks.
I will smite you, cur!
I'm allergic to roses!
You're with the Vampyres!
Take that, knave!
A member of the Phoenix Gang!
A member of the Black Arm Gang!
That garden was awful!
Your gang isn't here now!
Back, minion of evil!
I hate gardens!
He is too busy dancing to talk!
translation: Dans etmekle mesgul, konusacak vakti yok!

english: We're Knights of the Party Room
We dance round and round like a loon
Quite often we like to sing
Unfortunately we make a din
Do you like our helmet plumes?
Everyone's happy now we can move
Like a party animal in the groove
The party room is a silly place!
Who are you? What are you doing here in the snow?
translation: Kimsin sen? Karin içinde burada ne yapiyorsun?

english: My name is...Sir Gerry. I am...a member of a secret...society of knights. My time is short and I need...your help.
translation: Adim... Sir Gerry. Ben... gizli bir sövalye tarikatinin üyesiyim. Zamanim azaliyor ve yardimina ihtiyacim var.

english: A secret society of knights? What a surprise! Is there an old charter or decree that says if you're a knight you have to belong to a secret order?
translation: Gizli bir sövalye tarikati mi? Ne sürpriz! Sövalyeysen gizli bir tarikata üye olmak zorunda oldugunu söyleyen eski bir tüzük veya kararname mi var?

english: I'm sorry, my friend... I do not understand your meaning. Please, time is short... Take this scroll to Sir Tiffy. You will find him in Falador park... You should not...read it... It contains information for his eyes only.
translation: Üzgünüm dostum... Ne demek istedigini anlamadim. Lütfen, zamanim az... Bu parsömeni Sir Tiffy'ye götür. Onu Falador parkinda bulabilirsin... Okumamalisin... Bu parsömen sadece onun gözleri için yazilmistir.

english: A secret society of knights? You don't mean the Temple Knights, do you?
translation: Gizli bir sövalye toplulugu mu? Tapinak Sövalyeleri'nden bahsetmiyorsun, degil mi?

english: Yes! Praise Saradomin! You...have been sent in...my hour of need. Please, take...this scroll to Sir Tiffy in Falador park... You should not...read it.
translation: Evet! Saradomin'e sükürler olsun! Sen... benim ihtiyacim oldugu anda gönderildin. Lütfen, bu parsömeni Falador parkindaki Sir Tiffy'ye götür... Okumamalisin.

english: Cough... Hey, over here.
He's still alive, but in no condition to talk. He appears to be almost comatose.
translation: Hala hayatta, ama konusacak durumda degil. Neredeyse komada gibi görünüyor.

english: Good day.
Hello there citizen. What can I do for you?
translation: Merhaba vatandas. Senin için ne yapabilirim?

english: What's down these stairs?
These stairs lead to the Ardougne Prison. It's home to thieves, murderers and everything in between.
translation: Bu merdivenler Ardougne Hapishanesine çikiyor. Hirsizlar, katiller ve diger suçlularin bulundugu yer.

english: Sounds lovely. Can I go in?
I'm afraid not citizen. Only the Knights of Ardougne are allowed into the prison and I can see that you are no knight.
translation: Korkarim ki hayir vatandas. Sadece Ardougne Sövalyeleri hapishaneye girebilir ve senin sövalye olmadigini görebiliyorum.

english: Hello there fellow knight. Isn't today a wonderful day to be a Knight of Ardougne?
translation: Merhaba sövalye dostum. Bugün Ardougne Sövalyesi olmak için harika bir gün degil mi?

english: I mean it's okay I suppose. The constant fear of some random adventurer murdering you and the fact that people are constantly picking your pockets isn't great. But hey ho, at least the benefits are good.
translation: Yani, fena degil sanirim. Rastgele bir maceracinin seni öldürmesinden sürekli korkmak ve insanlarin sürekli cebini karistirmasi pek hos degil. Ama neyse, en azindan avantajlari iyi.

english: That they are fellow knight, that they are.
Anyway, can I go down these stairs?
translation: Neyse, bu merdivenlerden asagi inebilir miyim?

english: Of course you can! You're a Knight of Ardougne! There is no place where you can't go.
translation: Tabii ki! Sen Ardougne Sövalyesisin! Gidemeyecegin yer yok.

english: Yeah... Thanks.
Good to see you [Tim/Sue].
Who's [Tim/Sue]?
You are?
Ah yes, I am [Tim/Sue].
Hmm... Is your head working okay today [Tim/Sue]?
Of course, my head has never been better.
translation: Tabii ki, kafam hiç bu kadar iyi olmamisti.

english: If you say so...
Ah, nilsal! Hello!

english: Ah, hello again!
sub_category: Dialogue for Knight of Varlamore (Kourend Castle)

english: Hello to you too!
sub_category: Dialogue for Knight of Varlamore (Kourend Castle)

english: Tell me about yourself.
sub_category: Dialogue for Knight of Varlamore (Kourend Castle)

english: I'm a Knight of Varlamore, the Kingdom of Sun. I venture to Kourend on a mission, one I can say very little of.
translation: Ben Günes Kralligi Varlamore'un Sövalyesiyim. Kourend'e bir görev için geldim, ama bu görev hakkinda çok az sey söyleyebilirim.
sub_category: Dialogue for Knight of Varlamore (Kourend Castle)

english: How come?
sub_category: Dialogue for Knight of Varlamore (Kourend Castle)

english: I'm afraid you must accept my secrecy adventurer, for who knows what the future holds.
translation: Korkarim ki gizliligimi kabul etmelisin maceraci, çünkü gelecekte ne olacagini kimse bilemez.
sub_category: Dialogue for Knight of Varlamore (Kourend Castle)

english: I found an ancient sun temple.
sub_category: Dialogue for Knight of Varlamore (Kourend Castle)

english: Oh, pray tell, where is this temple?
translation: Oh, lütfen söyle, bu tapinak nerede?

english: In a place called the Forthos Ruin to the south-east. I was exploring and discovered symbology to an entity called Ralos.

english: I see. I think I shall check out this Ruin. Thank you for letting me know adventurer.

english: Okay, thanks.
sub_category: Dialogue for Leagues Assistant (Shattered Relics League)

english: Hello! Who are you?
Hello there. I'm the Leagues Assistant. I help the Leagues Tutor out. You'll find him just outside of Lumbridge Castle if you want to speak to him.
translation: Merhaba. Ben Lig Asistaniyim. Lig Ögretmenine yardim ediyorum. Onunla konusmak isterseniz, Lumbridge Kalesi'nin hemen disinda bulabilirsiniz.

english: You can find the Leagues Tutor by looking for his icon on your map.
translation: Lig Ögretmenini haritanizda simgesini arayarak bulabilirsiniz.

english: Okay, thanks.
Hello! Do you have any questions for me?
translation: Merhaba! Bana soracaginiz bir sey var mi?

english: What changes have been made for this League?
translation: Bu Lig için ne gibi degisiklikler yapildi?

english: All sorts of things! I can't recount all of the information for you, but I can give you the basics though.
translation: Her türlü degisiklik yapildi! Size tüm bilgileri anlatamam, ama temel bilgileri verebilirim.

english: During this League, you are initially restricted to the Kingdom of Misthalin. However, as you progress, you'll be able to unlock new areas of your choosing.
translation: Bu Lig sirasinda, baslangiçta Misthalin Kralligi ile sinirli kalacaksiniz. Ancak ilerledikçe, seçtiginiz yeni alanlarin kilidini açabileceksiniz.

english: Be warned though - you won't be able to unlock every area, so choose wisely.
translation: Ancak dikkatli olun, her alanin kilidini açamayacaksiniz, bu yüzden akillica seçim yapin.

english: Now, for the entire League, you must participate as an Iron Man. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.
translation: Simdi, tüm Lig boyunca Iron Man olarak katilmalisiniz. Bu, tek basiniza oldugunuz ve diger katilimcilarla ticaret yapamayacaginiz anlamina gelir.

english: And that's not all. Training skills during the League will grant you substantially more experience than you'd normally expect!
translation: Ve hepsi bu kadar degil. Lig sirasinda becerilerinizi gelistirdiginizde, normalde beklediginizden çok daha fazla deneyim kazanacaksiniz!

english: Finally, some quests have been completed for you automatically. Further quests will be completed as you unlock the relevant areas.
translation: Son olarak, bazi görevler sizin için otomatik olarak tamamlanmistir. Ilgili alanlarin kilidini açtikça daha fazla görev tamamlanacaktir.

english: I think that covers the basics. Would you like to see some more in-depth information?
translation: Sanirim temel bilgiler bu kadar. Daha ayrintili bilgi almak ister misiniz?

english: Yes, please.
Not right now.
Fair enough. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Anliyorum. Yardimci olabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: How do tasks work?
In every League, there are a number of tasks for you to complete. Each task has a level of difficulty: Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite and Master.
translation: Her Lig'de tamamlamaniz gereken bir dizi görev vardir. Her görevin bir zorluk seviyesi vardir: Kolay, Orta, Zor, Elit ve Usta.

english: Completing tasks allows you to access new areas. The more tasks completed, the more areas available to unlock.
translation: Görevleri tamamlamak, yeni alanlara erismenizi saglar. Ne kadar çok görev tamamlarsaniz, o kadar çok alan açabilirsiniz.

english: Not only that, completing tasks also earns you League Points. The number of points earned is dependent on the difficulty of the task.
translation: Sadece bu da degil, görevleri tamamlamak size Lig Puanlari da kazandirir. Kazanilan puan sayisi, görevin zorluk derecesine baglidir.

english: What do these points do?
Once you have achieved a certain amount of League Points you can unlock a new Relic! These are powerful artefacts to help you in the League.
translation: Belirli bir Lig Puani miktarina ulastiginizda, yeni bir Kalinti açabilirsiniz! Bunlar, Lig'de size yardimci olacak güçlü eserlerdir.

english: League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.
translation: Lig Puanlari, Lig Ödül Magazasindan ödüller satin almak için de kullanilabilir.

english: Right now, you are playing on your Leagues profile. The Leagues Reward Shop can only be opened on your main profile.
translation: Su anda Lig profilinizde oynuyorsunuz. Lig Ödül Magazasi sadece ana profilinizde açilabilir.

english: You can access your main profile by switching to any normal Old School RuneScape world. The world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.
translation: Herhangi bir normal Old School RuneScape dünyasina geçerek ana profilinize erisebilirsiniz. Oturumu kapatma menüsündeki dünya degistirici, dünyalar arasinda geçis yapmak için kullanilabilir.

english: So how many tasks are there?
More than you'll ever be able to complete, most likely. With so many to choose from, it's up to you which ones you go for.
translation: Muhtemelen tamamlayabileceginizden daha fazla. Seçebileceginiz çok fazla görev oldugundan, hangilerini seçeceginiz size kalmis.

english: Thanks!
Not a problem. Now, would you like to take a look at the tasks for this League?
translation: Rica ederim. Simdi, bu Lig'in görevlerine bir göz atmak ister misiniz?

english: How does the area system work?
In this League, you are initially locked to the Kingdom of Misthalin and the island of Karamja. However, as you progress, you can unlock more areas.
translation: Bu Lig'de, baslangiçta Misthalin Kralligi ve Karamja adasina kilitlisiniz. Ancak ilerledikçe daha fazla alanin kilidini açabilirsiniz.

english: There are nine different areas in total. However, you can only unlock a maximum of five, including Misthalin and Karamja, so choose wisely.
translation: Toplamda dokuz farkli alan vardir. Ancak Misthalin ve Karamja dahil olmak üzere en fazla bes alanin kilidini açabilirsiniz, bu yüzden akillica seçim yapin.

english: The first two area unlocks are given to everyone. However, the other three unlocks are unavailable to begin with.
translation: Ilk iki alan kilidi herkese verilir. Ancak, diger üç kilit baslangiçta kullanilamaz.

english: You can access these additional area unlocks by completing tasks. The more tasks you've completed, the more areas you can unlock.
translation: Bu ek alan kilitlerine görevleri tamamlayarak erisebilirsiniz. Ne kadar çok görev tamamlarsaniz, o kadar çok alan kilidini açabilirsiniz.

english: I see. Thanks!
Would you like to take a look at the available areas now?
translation: Simdi mevcut alanlara bir göz atmak ister misiniz?

english: Relics, or Trailblazer Relics to give them their full name, are powerful artefacts that grant unique abilities for the entire League!
translation: Relics, ya da tam adiyla Trailblazer Relics, tüm Lig'e benzersiz yetenekler kazandiran güçlü eserlerdir!

english: There are eighteen separate Relics, split across six different tiers. You can only have one Relic from each tier though.
translation: Alti farkli seviyeye ayrilmis on sekiz ayri Relic vardir. Ancak her seviyeden yalnizca bir Relic'e sahip olabilirsiniz.

english: The first Relic tier is available to everyone. However, the higher tiers are locked to begin with.
translation: Ilk Relic seviyesi herkes tarafindan kullanilabilir. Ancak, daha yüksek seviyeler baslangiçta kilitlidir.

english: You can unlock these higher tiers by earning League Points. League Points are earned by completing tasks.
translation: Bu üst seviyeleri Lig Puanlari kazanarak açabilirsiniz. Lig Puanlari, görevleri tamamlayarak kazanilir.

english: Be warned, you'll need to choose carefully when picking a Relic. Once you have selected a Relic, your choice can't be changed for the rest of the League.
translation: Dikkatli olun, Relic seçerken dikkatli olmalisiniz. Bir Relic seçtikten sonra, Lig'in geri kalaninda seçiminizi degistiremezsiniz.

english: Anyway, it looks like you have a Relic available for selection right now! Would you like to take a look?
translation: Her neyse, su anda seçebileceginiz bir Relic var gibi görünüyor! Bir göz atmak ister misiniz?

english: Tell me about League rewards.
As well as letting you unlock new areas, completing tasks in the League will earn you League Points. The more League Points you have, the more Trailblazer Relic tiers you have available.
translation: Ligde görevleri tamamlayarak yeni alanlarin kilidini açmanin yani sira Lig Puanlari da kazanirsiniz. Ne kadar çok Lig Puaniniz olursa, o kadar çok Öncü Kalinti kademesine erisebilirsiniz.

english: However, alongside allowing you to unlock Trailblazer Relics, League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.
translation: Ancak Lig Puanlari, Öncü Kalintilarin kilidini açmanin yani sira Lig Ödül Dükkani'ndan ödüller satin almak için de kullanilabilir.

english: What rewards can I buy?
All sorts of things! There's some new furniture for your house, an alternate animation for your Home Teleport spell and some new stylish outfits, just to name a few.
translation: Her türlü seyi! Eviniz için yeni mobilyalar, Ev Teleport büyüsü için alternatif animasyonlar ve yeni sik kiyafetler, bunlardan sadece birkaçi.

english: Most of the rewards can be traded with others, so if you want, you can earn some money by selling them on. Of course, you might prefer to keep them for yourself instead.
translation: Ödüllerin çogu baskalariyla takas edilebilir, yani isterseniz bunlari satarak para kazanabilirsiniz. Tabii ki, bunlari kendiniz için saklamayi tercih edebilirsiniz.

english: I see. That all sounds good to me.
One thing to be aware of is that the Trailblazer rewards won't be available until the League has ended. You can still buy rewards from previous Leagues though.
translation: Dikkat etmeniz gereken bir nokta, Trailblazer ödüllerinin Lig sona erene kadar kullanilamayacagidir. Ancak önceki Liglerden ödüller satin almaya devam edebilirsiniz.

english: Now, alongside the rewards in the Leagues Reward Shop, there's also League Ranks.
translation: Simdi, Lig Ödül Magazasindaki ödüllerin yani sira Lig Siralamalari da var.

english: League Ranks? How do they work?
At the end of the League, you will be given a League Rank. This is based upon the number of League Points you have earned compared to the other participants.
translation: Lig sona erdiginde, size bir Lig Siralamasi verilir. Bu, diger katilimcilara kiyasla kazandiginiz Lig Puani sayisina göre belirlenir.

english: Anyone who earns at least 100 League Points will be eligible for the Bronze rank. The top 80% of participants get the Iron rank. The top 60% get Steel.
translation: En az 100 Lig Puani kazanan herkes Bronz siralamasina hak kazanir. Katilimcilarin en iyi %80'i Demir siralamasina, en iyi %60'i Çelik siralamasina, en iyi %40'i Mithril siralamasina, en iyi %20'si Adamant siralamasina hak kazanir.

english: The top 40% get Mithril. The top 20% get Adamant. The top 5% get Rune. The best participants, those who make it to the top 1%, get the Dragon rank!
translation: En iyi %20'si Adamant siralamasina hak kazanir. En iyi %5'lik dilim Rune siralamasina hak kazanir. En iyi katilimcilar, yani en iyi %1'lik dilim Dragon siralamasina hak kazanir!

english: When the League ends, your rank will determine what trophy you get. These trophies symbolise your performance in the League.
translation: Lig sona erdiginde, siralamaniz hangi kupayi alacaginizi belirler. Bu kupalar, Lig'deki performansinizi simgeler.

english: Trophies?
That's right. Trophies are items that are given to you after the League. You can use them to show off your League Rank!
translation: Evet, dogru. Kupalar, Lig'in ardindan size verilen ögelerdir. Bunlari, Lig Siralamanizi göstermek için kullanabilirsiniz!

english: Connected to League Ranks are the League to League rewards. These are unlocked in the next League based upon the League Rank you earn in this one!
translation: Lig Siralamalari ile baglantili olan Ligden Lige ödülleri vardir. Bunlar, bu Ligde kazandiginiz Lig Siralamasina göre bir sonraki Ligde açilir!

english: League Starter Outfits and League Icons are some of things you can unlock for the next League. Also, any pets you earn in this League will transfer over to the next one.
translation: Lig Baslangiç Kiyafetleri ve Lig Simgeleri, bir sonraki Lig için açabileceginiz ögelerden bazilaridir. Ayrica, bu Ligde kazandiginiz tüm evcil hayvanlar bir sonraki Lige aktarilir.

english: Finally, on top of the tasks for this League, there are some other activities for which I will recognise the first person who completes them.
translation: Son olarak, bu Ligdeki görevlerin yani sira, bunlari ilk tamamlayan kisiyi ödüllendirecegim bazi diger etkinlikler de vardir.

english: You can view the entire list of activities, as well as whether or not someone has completed them, by reading the board beside me.
translation: Etkinliklerin tam listesini ve bunlarin tamamlanip tamamlanmadigini yanimdaki panodan görebilirsiniz.

english: Not a problem. Now, is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Sorun degil. Baska yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Let's talk about pets.

translation: Liglerde evcil hayvanlarin nasil çalistigini anlatabilir misiniz?

english: Of course! If you're lucky enough to obtain a pet during a League, it will automatically be insured for you.
translation: Tabii ki! Lig sirasinda sansliysaniz ve bir evcil hayvan elde ederseniz, bu evcil hayvan otomatik olarak sigortalanir.

english: This means that if you were to ever lose it, you can talk to me and I'll give it back to you. Insurance and reclaiming is all free!
translation: Bu, onu kaybederseniz bana gelip geri alabileceginiz anlamina gelir. Sigorta ve geri alma tamamen ücretsizdir!

english: Additionally, each pet you obtain will be transferred to the next League. It'll be waiting with me for you to reclaim it!
translation: Ayrica, elde ettiginiz her evcil hayvan bir sonraki Lig'e aktarilir. Geri almak için beni bekliyor olacak!

english: Okay! Thank you.
No worries. Come back to me once you have some pets and you can view your collection! Now, is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Önemli degil. Evcil hayvanlarin oldugunda bana geri gel, koleksiyonunu görebilirsin! Baska yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: You receive some items from the Leagues Tutor.
I'm good, thanks.
Very well. I'll be here if you ever need to know anything about Leagues.
translation: Peki. Ligler hakkinda bir sey ögrenmek istersen ben buradayim.

english: Hello there. Do you have any questions about Leagues?
translation: Merhaba. Ligler hakkinda soracagin bir sey var mi?

english: What's a League?
Leagues are time-limited challenges that provide a unique twist on the world you know and love.
translation: Ligler, bildiginiz ve sevdiginiz dünyaya benzersiz bir dokunus katan, süre sinirli zorluklardir.

english: With each League, you start afresh, with a limited amount of time to progress through the League.
translation: Her Ligde, Ligde ilerlemek için sinirli bir süre ile yeniden baslarsiniz.

english: A fresh start? Why would I want that?
translation: Yeniden baslamak mi? Neden bunu isteyeyim ki?

english: Glory, gold, and the chance to do things in a different way!
translation: San, söhret, altin ve isleri farkli bir sekilde yapma sansi!

english: First up, the glory. Within a League, you can earn League Points by completing various tasks.
translation: Ilk olarak, san. Bir Ligde, çesitli görevleri tamamlayarak Lig Puanlari kazanabilirsiniz.

english: The more points you have at the end of the League, the better League Rank you will be given.
translation: Ligin sonunda ne kadar çok puaniniz olursa, o kadar iyi bir Lig Siralamasi alirsiniz.

english: Each League Rank will unlock a trophy for you. These trophies can be used to show off your accomplishments.
translation: Her Lig Siralamasi size bir kupa kazandirir. Bu kupalar, basarilarinizi sergilemek için kullanilabilir.

english: If that doesn't interest you, how about gold! League Points can be used to buy things from the Leagues Reward Shop.
translation: Bu sizi ilgilendirmiyorsa, peki ya altin? Lig Puanlari, Lig Ödül Magazasindan alisveris yapmak için kullanilabilir.

english: You can keep these purchases for yourself or sell them on to others!
translation: Bu satin aldiklarinizi kendiniz için saklayabilir veya baskalarina satabilirsiniz!

english: And if glory and gold don't interest me?
translation: Peki ya söhret ve altin ilgimi çekmiyorsa?

english: Every League has unique rules and features to set it aside from the world you're used to.
translation: Her Lig, alistiginiz dünyadan farkli kilan benzersiz kurallara ve özelliklere sahiptir.

english: Not only that, but within this League, you can unlock powerful artefacts known as Fragments. Fragments completely change the way you progress through the League!
translation: Sadece bu da degil, bu Lig içinde Fragment olarak bilinen güçlü eserlerin kilidini açabilirsiniz. Fragmentler, Lig'de ilerleme seklinizi tamamen degistirir!

english: So even if glory and gold are not for you, you'll still find Leagues to be a whole lot of fun!
translation: Yani söhret ve altin size göre olmasa bile, Liglerin çok eglenceli oldugunu göreceksiniz!

english: I see. So how do I take part?
Well sadly you're not eligible to take part in a League right now. I'll be happy to help once you are though.
translation: Maalesef su anda bir Lige katilmaya hak kazanamadiniz. Ancak hak kazandiginizda size memnuniyetle yardimci olacagim.

english: I see, thanks for the information.
My pleasure!
Goodbye.
All the best.
