translation: Su anda devam eden bir Lig var mi?

english: Yes! The current League is Leagues III - Shattered Relics.
translation: Evet! Su anki Lig, Lig III - Parçalanmis Kalintilar.

english: Within this League you are restricted to three skills: Defence, Fishing and Thieving, you can unlock more skills by completing tasks to earn Sage's Renown.
translation: Bu Lig'de üç beceriyle sinirlisiniz: Savunma, Balikçilik ve Hirsizlik. Görevleri tamamlayarak Sage's Renown kazanarak daha fazla beceri açabilirsiniz.

english: Sage's Renown can be used to purchase access to Skills, Bosses and to Auto Complete Quests.
translation: Sage's Renown, Becerilere, Boss'lara ve Otomatik Görev Tamamlama'ya erisim satin almak için kullanilabilir.

english: You can also collect powerful artifacts known as Fragments, each Fragment provides a different buff so be sure to collect them all.
translation: Ayrica Fragments olarak bilinen güçlü eserleri de toplayabilirsiniz. Her Fragment farkli bir güçlendirme saglar, bu yüzden hepsini topladiginizdan emin olun.

english: You can level up these Fragments to make them even stronger, you can also bring together different Fragments to activate powerful buffs known as Set Effects.
translation: Bu Fragmentleri seviye atlatarak daha da güçlü hale getirebilirsiniz. Ayrica farkli Fragmentleri bir araya getirerek Set Effects olarak bilinen güçlü güçlendirmeleri etkinlestirebilirsiniz.

english: I heard there's one that lets you swap between Magic spellbooks whenever you want!
translation: Istediginiz zaman sihirli büyü kitaplari arasinda geçis yapmanizi saglayan bir tane oldugunu duydum!

english: Not only that, but you must participate as an Iron Man. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.
translation: Sadece bu da degil, Iron Man olarak katilmalisiniz. Bu, tek basiniza oldugunuz ve diger katilimcilarla ticaret yapamayacaginiz anlamina gelir.

english: Interesting. Maybe I should take part.
I'd highly recommend it.

english: The Leagues Reward Shop is temporarily closed.

english: Of course! What would you like to know?

translation: Lig Kupalari, belirli bir Ligde ne kadar basarili oldugunu gösterir. Performans, katilan diger herkese kiyasla kazandigin Lig Puani sayisina göre degerlendirilir.

translation: Lig Kupasi'nin yedi seviyesi vardir: Bronz, Demir, Çelik, Mithril, Adamant, Rune ve Ejderha.

english: Now, Leagues are time-limited modes that give you a new way to play the game. For this League, you are restricted to the Kourend and Kebos regions, and you play as an Iron Man.
translation: Ligler, size oyunu oynamanin yeni bir yolunu sunan, zaman sinirli modlardir. Bu Ligde, Kourend ve Kebos bölgeleriyle sinirlisiniz ve Iron Man olarak oynuyorsunuz.

english: Let's take a look at all of the information available about this League. There is a new section in the journal tab whilst on a Leagues world. Click on the flashing quest icon to take a look.
translation: Bu Ligle ilgili mevcut tüm bilgilere bir göz atalim. Lig dünyasindayken günlük sekmesinde yeni bir bölüm var. Yanip sönen görev simgesine tiklayarak bir göz atin.

english: Now that you have your journal open, click on the flashing Leagues icon.
translation: Günlügünüzü açtiktan sonra, yanip sönen Lig simgesine tiklayin.

english: This is the Leagues menu. Here you can view your progress through the current League. You can also open the various Leagues interfaces from here.
translation: Bu, Lig menüsüdür. Burada mevcut Lig'deki ilerlemenizi görebilirsiniz. Ayrica buradan çesitli Lig arayüzlerini de açabilirsiniz.

english: Your objective in each League is to complete tasks and earn League Points.
translation: Her Lig'deki amaciniz, görevleri tamamlamak ve Lig Puanlari kazanmaktir.

english: Tasks are split into five difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite and Master. The harder the task, the more points awarded.
translation: Görevler bes zorluk seviyesine ayrilmistir: Kolay, Orta, Zor, Elit ve Usta. Görev ne kadar zor olursa, o kadar çok puan kazanirsiniz.

english: Let's have a look at the tasks interface now. Click on the flashing button to open it.
translation: Simdi görev arayüzüne bir göz atalim. Açmak için yanip sönen dügmeye tiklayin.

english: This is the tasks interface. Here you can see all the tasks available to you in this League. When you are ready to continue, close the interface by clicking on the cross in the corner of it.
translation: Bu, görev arayüzüdür. Burada, bu Lig'de size sunulan tüm görevleri görebilirsiniz. Devam etmeye hazir oldugunuzda, kösedeki çarpi isaretine tiklayarak arayüzü kapatin.

english: Earning points during the League will allow you to unlock powerful Twisted Relics. The more League Points you have, the more Relics available to you.
translation: Lig sirasinda puan kazanmak, güçlü Twisted Relics'leri açmaniza olanak tanir. Ne kadar çok Lig Puaniniz olursa, o kadar çok Relics'e erisebilirsiniz.

english: League Points are also transferred over to your main profile. There, they can be spent on rewards in the Leagues Reward Shop.
translation: Lig Puanlari da ana profilinize aktarilir. Orada, Lig Ödül Magazasi'ndaki ödüllere harcanabilirler.

english: Now let's have a look at the Twisted Relics. Click on the flashing button to take a look at the Relics interface.
translation: Simdi Twisted Relics'lere bir göz atalim. Yanip sönen dügmeye tiklayarak Relics arayüzüne bakabilirsiniz.

english: This is the Relics interface. Here you can unlock new Twisted Relics to be used during this League. When you are ready to continue, close the interface by clicking on the cross in the corner of it.
translation: Bu, Relics arayüzüdür. Burada, bu Lig sirasinda kullanmak üzere yeni Twisted Relics'lerin kilidini açabilirsiniz. Devam etmeye hazir oldugunuzda, kösesindeki çarpi isaretine tiklayarak arayüzü kapatin.

english: There are a few changes to Kourend and Kebos which you may not be used to. You can view all of these changes on the information interface.
translation: Kourend ve Kebos'ta alisik olmadiginiz birkaç degisiklik var. Tüm bu degisiklikleri bilgi arayüzünde görebilirsiniz.

english: Right, I think that's everything. If you need reminding of any of this information, you can either talk to me or read the information interface.
translation: Tamam, sanirim hepsi bu kadar. Bu bilgilerle ilgili hatirlatmaya ihtiyaciniz olursa, benimle konusabilir veya bilgi arayüzünü okuyabilirsiniz.

english: Before you head off though, it's time to pick your first Relic! Choose carefully though, once you've picked a Relic you can't go back and change your decision.
translation: Ancak gitmeden önce, ilk Relic'inizi seçme zamani! Dikkatli seçin, çünkü bir Relic seçtikten sonra geri dönüp kararinizi degistiremezsiniz.

translation: Iç çekislerinize devam edin. Yapacak çok isiniz var gibi görünüyor.

english: It's a bit grey round here, isn't it?
It gets you down after a while, you know. There are 273 shades of grey, you know, and we have them all.
translation: Bir süre sonra insani moralini bozuyor, biliyorsun. 273 ton gri var, biliyorsun, ve biz hepsine sahibiz.

english: That's grey-t.
That attempt at humour merely made me more depressed. Leave me alone.
translation: Bu espri denemesi beni daha da depresif yapti. Beni rahat birak.

english: How's the King treating you then?
Like serfs.
Serf?
Yes, you know - peons, plebs, the downtrodden. He treats us like his own personal possessions.
translation: Evet, biliyorsun - isçi, pleb, ezilenler. Bizi kendi kisisel mülkiyeti gibi görüyor.

english: You should leave this place.
I keep trying to save up enough to leave, but the King keeps taxing us! We have no money left.
translation: Ayrilmak için para biriktirmeye çalisiyorum ama Kral bize sürekli vergi koyuyor! Hiç paramiz kalmadi.

english: Oh dear.
Cheer up! It's not the end of the world.
I'd prefer that, if it meant I didn't have to talk to people as inanely happy as you.
translation: Senin gibi aptalca mutlu insanlarla konusmak zorunda kalmayacaksam, bunu tercih ederim.

english: Whoa! I think you need to get out more.
translation: Vay canina! Bence daha fazla disari çikmalisin.

english: What are you doing here?
I'm blending in. Scopin' out the place.
Are you preparing for a heist? You're only a kid.
translation: Soygun mu hazirliyorsun? Sen daha çocuksun.

english: Let's just say there are some wealthy people about, with full pockets.
translation: Diyelim ki, cepleri dolu zengin insanlar var.

english: Any tips? I'm not having much luck myself.
translation: Herhangi bir ipucu var mi? Benim pek sansim yok da.

english: I'm quite sneaky. Every now and then I'll get their attention so their pockets aren't being so carefully watched.
translation: Ben oldukça sinsi biriyim. Arada sirada onlarin dikkatini çekiyorum, böylece ceplerini o kadar dikkatli izlemiyorlar.

english: That is sneaky. I'll keep an eye out for your... distractions.
translation: Bu çok sinsi. Senin... dikkat dagitici hareketlerini gözleyecegim.

english: Now leave me be. I'm already distracting!
translation: Simdi beni rahat birak. Zaten dikkat dagiticiyim!

english: You notice an urchin distract a wealthy citizen nearby.
translation: Yakindaki zengin bir vatandasin dikkatini dagitan bir sokak çocugu fark ediyorsun.

english: I've been robbed!
*Sobbing*
My parents are gonna be so mad!
Oh gosh!
What can I do?
That's awful!
I'll keep you company for a moment.
Silly me! I had it in my pocket all along!
translation: Ne aptalim! Bütün bu zaman boyunca cebimdeymis!

english: I can't stop crying!
Wahhhh!
I've lost my parents!
I hope you're okay.
Oh you really brightened my day!
I'm so lost! Someone help!
I can't find my friends
I'm all alone!
I think I see my friends!!
No one can dance like me!
I could do this all day!
Any tips?
Who taught you to move like that?
translation: Böyle dans etmeyi kim ögretti sana?

english: I wish I had moves like that!
translation: Keske ben de böyle dans edebilsem!

english: I'm all danced out!
My leg! Someone please!
Gah! It hurts!
It burns like an inferno!
I think I've broken something!
Woah! My leg has healed!
That was strange.
Dialoge 1
Dialoge 2
Dialoge 3
Dialoge 4
Hello.
Hello.
Are you in charge of this squad?
Yes. We're guarding this entrance against demonic excursions.
translation: Evet. Bu girisi iblislerin saldirilarina karsi koruyoruz.

english: How's that going?
Not super well, I'm afraid. It's a nerve wracking post, and it's taking its toll on my soldiers.
translation: Korkarim pek iyi degil. Sinir bozucu bir görev ve askerlerim üzerinde olumsuz etkiler yaratiyor.

english: Can I do anything to help?
Not in any official capacity. Making any sort of move might spark a chain reaction.
translation: Resmi olarak hayir. Herhangi bir hareket, zincirleme reaksiyonlara neden olabilir.

english: But unofficially...
It would be good to know what's going on down there. If you can handle yourself, and you can keep an eye on the demons, you might be able to help.
translation: Orada neler olup bittigini bilmek iyi olur. Kendinizi idare edebiliyorsaniz ve seytanlari gözetleyebiliyorsaniz, yardimci olabilirsiniz.

english: We just need to know if it looks like they're preparing for anything. But if you do this, you're on your own. If anything happens, I won't be able to send help.
translation: Sadece bir sey hazirligi yapiyorlar mi bilmemiz gerekiyor. Ama bunu yaparsaniz, kendi basinizasiniz. Bir sey olursa, yardim gönderemem.

english: Understood. Well, if I see anything suspicious, I'll be sure to casually mention it.
translation: Anladim. Süpheli bir sey görürsem, bunu rahatça dile getirecegim.

english: Thank you.
What wrong with your soldiers?
Some of them are afraid, others impatient. That's the biggest problem actually. They're all having different reactions. It's making it difficult to work as a unit.
translation: Bazilari korkuyor, bazilari sabirsiz. Aslinda en büyük sorun bu. Hepsi farkli tepkiler gösteriyor. Bu da bir birim olarak çalismayi zorlastiriyor.

english: Do they usually have this problem?
No, they're good soldiers. I suspect it has something to do with those cultists and their little chats.
translation: Hayir, onlar iyi askerlerdir. Sanirim bu, o tarikatçilar ve onlarin küçük sohbetleriyle ilgili bir sey.

english: Not that we can do much about that. We can't afford to initiate hostilities. There's a lot at stake, and I'm honestly not sure we could handle a direct confrontation.
translation: Bu konuda yapabilecegimiz pek bir sey yok. Düsmanlik baslatmayi göze alamayiz. Çok sey söz konusu ve dürüst olmak gerekirse, dogrudan bir çatismayi kaldirabilecegimizden emin degilim.

english: That does sound like a difficult situation to be in.
translation: Bu gerçekten zor bir durum gibi görünüyor.

english: Goodbye.
Goodbye.
Can I do anything to help?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: What's wrong with your soldiers?
Goodbye.
Hello!
Hello friend. I wish to slay evil and avail them of their loot! Take me to Burgh de Rott!
translation: Merhaba dostum. Kötülügü yok etmek ve ganimetlerini ele geçirmek istiyorum! Beni Burgh de Rott'a götür!

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: Oradaki kötülükle savasmaya yeterince hazir misin?

english: I think so? At least my heart knows courage and that should be sufficient for the meantime. I expect that when we get to Burgh de Rott, we'll be able to purchase suitable provisions.
translation: Sanirim öyle. En azindan kalbim cesaretli ve bu simdilik yeterli olmali. Burgh de Rott'a vardigimizda uygun erzak satin alabilecegimizi umuyorum.

english: But you do realise that the vampyres in Morytania are immune to everything except silver?
translation: Ama Morytania'daki vampirlerin gümüs disinda her seye karsi bagisik olduklarini biliyor musun?

english: Er...well, I've not heard mention of that fact, but I have faith that Saradomin will provide the means to furnish me with suitable weapons when I reach Burgh de Rott.
translation: Sey... Bu konuda bir sey duymadim, ama Burgh de Rott'a vardigimda Saradomin'in bana uygun silahlar saglayacagina inaniyorum.

english: And if we happen to run into some vampyres on the journey down there?
translation: Ya oraya giderken yolda vampirlerle karsilasirsak?

english: I trust that you will help us to avoid them. You are a guide after all, aren't you? Anyway, you look like you can handle yourself. I presume you've fought such creatures before and won? How hard can it be?
translation: Onlardan kaçinmamiza yardim edecegine inaniyorum. Sonuçta sen bir rehbersin, degil mi? Her neyse, kendini savunabilecek gibi görünüyorsun. Daha önce bu tür yaratiklarla savasip kazandin mi? Ne kadar zor olabilir ki?

english: It can be pretty difficult, actually. But you're right, I'll be your guide so I should be able to handle the situation.
translation: Aslinda oldukça zor olabilir. Ama haklisin, ben senin rehberin olacagim, bu yüzden durumu halledebilmeliyim.

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Neden Burgh de Rott'a gitmek istiyorsun?

english: I'm going down there to teach those vampyres a lesson or two. I've heard about the terrible conditions down there and I intend to put a stop to it.
translation: Oradaki vampirleri bir ders vermek için gidiyorum. Oradaki korkunç kosullari duydum ve buna bir son vermek niyetindeyim.

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Burgh de Rott'a giderken yol üzerinde düsmanlarla karsilasirsak kendini savunabilir misin?

english: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of enemies. You don't need to worry about that.
translation: Diyelim ki biraz tecrübeliyim ve düsmanlarla savasmaktan çekinmem. Bu konuda endiselenmene gerek yok.

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: Hmmm, görünüse göre bir takipçin var. Kendi basina dolasirsa bu yolculukta kaybolabilir. Takipçin güvende oldugunda yola çikalim.

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: Gerçekten mi? Bu harika olur! Hedefe vardigimizda sana küçük bir ödül verecegim.

english: Burgh de Rott Ramble begins
Ok, which route should we take?
Ok, thanks.
Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: Ah, bana biraz erzak vermek istiyorsun, ha? Sirt çantami açayim.

english: This place is a bit grim. How can people live here?
translation: Burasi biraz kasvetli. Insanlar burada nasil yasayabiliyor?

english: Do you visit Burgh de Rott often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: Burgh de Rott'a sik sik gelir misin? Rotayi iyi biliyorsun gibi görünüyor.

english: When are we going to get to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Burgh de Rott'a ne zaman varacagiz?

english: We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on. I have loot to get.
translation: Bütün gün burada durup sohbet edemeyiz, hadi devam edelim. Yagmalayacak seyler var.

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than the opulet life styles forced on us adventurer types. I'd much rather be up to my eyes in mud and having a good fight!
translation: Oh, bu yolculuktan nefret ediyorum, ama maceraperestlere dayatilan lüks yasam tarzindan daha iyidir. Gözlerime kadar çamura batip iyi bir kavga etmeyi tercih ederim!

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...
Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Paterdomus. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: Hay aksi! Görünüse göre Paterdomus'a geri dönmek zorundayiz. O köprüden geçemeyiz!

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
Player completes the bridge event
Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Paterdomus.
translation: Bu is bitti... Görünüse göre bu batakliktan geçemeyiz. Paterdomus'a geri dönmek zorundayiz.

english: Player completes the bog event
Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: Hey... bu harika... harika bir is çikardin... Seni takip edecegim.

english: Whahay...that was great!
But we really should be heading off now.
Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
Player completes the river event
That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: Bu harika! Ben de aynisini yapmaliyim.

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: Vay canina! Harikaydi! Ama artik gerçekten yola çikmaliyiz.

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
This is scary!
Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
Ahhh, two tentacles!
...three tentacles!
I think I'm going to faint!
Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: Vay canina! Su canavara bak! O seyi kendi basina halletmen gerekecek!

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the Burgh de Rott. Here's your reward.
translation: Beni Burgh de Rott'a güvenle ulastirdigin için çok tesekkürler. Iste ödülün.

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: Oradaki kötülükle savasmaya yeterince hazir misin?

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Neden Burgh de Rott'a gitmek istiyorsun?

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
Ok, thanks.
What's that ladder next to the altar for?
An...archeological dig. Yeah, a dig.
Why?
Next to a Chaos Altar? That's a bit odd. Can I go down and have a look?
translation: Kaos Sunak'in yaninda mi? Bu biraz tuhaf. Asagi inip bakabilir miyim?

english: Well...I suppose. See, we found this ancient altar, but it was pretty broken so the Z.M.I. sent some of its researchers to try and repair it.
translation: Sey... Sanirim. Bak, bu eski sunak bulduk, ama oldukça kirilmisti, bu yüzden Z.M.I. onu onarmaya çalismak için bazi arastirmacilarini gönderdi.

english: How'd that work out for them?
Pretty well - only one died. Still, they got it working...sort of. This ancient technology can be tricky.
translation: Oldukça iyi - sadece biri öldü. Yine de, onu çalisir hale getirdiler... bir nevi. Bu eski teknoloji biraz alengirli olabilir.

english: What do you mean, 'sort of'? Altars either work or don't work.
translation: “Bir nevi” ne demek? Sunaklar ya çalisir ya da çalismaz.

english: This one works, just not as you'd expect. You put pure essence in, but get random runes back. Some of them we don't even know how to craft!
translation: Bu çalisiyor, ama bekledigin gibi degil. Içine saf öz koyuyorsun, ama rastgele runlar geri aliyorsun. Bazilarini nasil yapacagimizi bile bilmiyoruz!

english: Sounds like a pretty good deal. Can I give it a go?
translation: Kulaga oldukça iyi bir anlasma gibi geliyor. Bir deneyeyim mi?

english: I don't think so. The mages don't like outsiders going in; they'll probably attack you. They only patrol the short path, though, so if you used the long path, through a tunnel near the entrance, you'd probably be safe.
translation: Sanmiyorum. Büyücüler disaridan gelenleri sevmezler; muhtemelen sana saldirirlar. Ancak sadece kisa yolu devriye geziyorlar, bu yüzden girisin yakinindaki tünelden geçen uzun yolu kullanirsan muhtemelen güvende olursun.

english: Thanks.
Can I get past please?
Not just yet. The swamp has flooded the roads again, it's unsafe to pass.
translation: Henüz degil. Bataklik yollari yine sular altinda birakti, geçmek güvenli degil.

english: So how long will the road be blocked for?
translation: Yol ne kadar süre kapali kalacak?

english: Who can tell? It's one of the drawbacks to living in a swamp. You get used to it after a while.
translation: Kim bilir? Bataklikta yasamanin dezavantajlarindan biri bu. Bir süre sonra alisiyorsun.

english: Hello.
DON'T EAT ME!
Umm, I'm not going to eat you. Are you ok?
She said she would return after the second fork.
translation: Ikinci çataldan sonra geri dönecegini söyledi.

english: Fork?
You can't eat jelly with a fork. Are you mad?
translation: Jöleyi çatalla yiyemezsin. Deli misin sen?

english: Ummm... no... I'll just leave you to it.
Green tongue snakes.
Hello.
Excuse me!
Oh sorry, what did I do?
Can't you see I'm on the toilet?
Wait a minute... a toilet?
Yeah. A toilet.
Riiiight. Oh, man, you didn't wipe your hands?
Get over it.
Occupied!
I've seen that one before. It's yours now.
translation: Bunu daha önce görmüstüm. Artik senin.

english: That's very kind of you, but no thanks.
I want the adventure to end.
Thank you.
The man takes 99 damage, killing him.
It stinks down here.
Can't you just leave me alone.
I don't trust that fish monger.
Lighting fires in an enclosed space is probably not a good idea. Oh well.
translation: Kapali bir alanda ates yakmak iyi bir fikir olmayabilir. Neyse.

english: I guess it's not all bad down here. At least we have a pub.
translation: Burasi o kadar da kötü degil galiba. En azindan bir pub var.

english: I'll leave this place one day. You'll see.
Hello there.
Go away. People from the outside shut us in like animals. I have nothing to say to you.
translation: Git buradan. Disaridakiler bizi hayvanlar gibi buraya kapattilar. Sana söyleyecek hiçbir seyim yok.

english: An outsider! Can you get me out of this hell hole?
translation: Bir yabanci! Beni bu cehennem çukurundan çikarabilir misin?

english: Sorry, that's not what I'm here to do.
You pet the dog...
He rolls over a little bit so you can pet his belly.
Hey! Get your hands off there!
Is it over?
I can't hear anything? It might be?
translation: Hiçbir sey duymuyorum? Bitti olabilir mi?

english: Is someone in there?
N-n-n-no... go away...
Oh okay, fair enough.
Wait! Come back, we need your help.
translation: Bekle! Geri gel, yardimina ihtiyacimiz var.

english: Jack Frost locked us in here when he stormed into our bakery. We tried to stop him from messing up our production, but he got grumpy.
translation: Jack Frost firinimiza baskin yaptiginda bizi buraya kilitledi. Üretimimizi bozmasini engellemeye çalistik ama sinirlendi.

english: I ran into one of your bakers outside, he said you were in trouble.
translation: Disarida firincilarinizdan birine rastladim, basinizin dertte oldugunu söyledi.

english: Oh Remy is still alive! We thought Jack fed him to the Icelord.
translation: Oh, Remy hala hayatta! Jack'in onu Buz Lordu'na yem yaptigini saniyorduk.

english: Where's the key? The door looks locked to me.
I thought you had it, Mary.
Well I thought you had it, Paul.
translation: Ben de sende oldugunu saniyordum, Paul.

english: Don't you think I'd have opened the door if I had it?
translation: Eger bende olsaydi kapiyi açmaz miydim sence?

english: Don't you think I would have opened the door as well!
Great, now I'm locked in here with you for the rest of my life.
translation: Harika, simdi hayatimin geri kalanini seninle burada kilitli kalacagim.

english: Woah calm down! If it's not in there, it must be out here. Let me look for it.
translation: Sakin ol! Orada yoksa, burada olmali. Ben bakayim.

english: RAAAAAAAAAAAWR
The Icelord sees you trying to enter their cage and blasts you backwards.
translation: Buz Lordu, kafesine girmeye çalistigini görüyor ve seni geriye dogru firlatiyor.

english: Ooooh that sounds like it hurt!
Are you okay dear? That sounded quite nasty.
translation: Iyi misin canim? Oldukça kötü ses çikardi.

english: Well, I found the key.
That's great, come on let us out then.
translation: Harika, hadi bizi disari çikaralim o zaman.

english: Yes hurry up, we need to get back on schedule.
translation: Evet, acele et, programa yetismemiz lazim.

english: That's going to be a problem, it's in the cage with the Icelord.
translation: Bu sorun olacak, anahtar Buz Lordu'nun kafesinde.

english: I've got no way to get it with the Icelord there.
translation: Buz Lordu oradayken anahtari almamin imkani yok.

english: Did you try telegrabbing it?
I'm stumped, I can't find the key.
You've looked around the bakery and no luck?
If it's not in here or in the back room, it must be in the cage with the Icelord.
translation: Burada ya da arka odada degilse, Icelord'un kafesinde olmali.

english: It wouldn't be safe to go in there.
Could you try telegrabbing it?
That won't work, the Icelord's magic will interfere.
translation: Bu ise yaramaz, Icelord'un büyüsü engel olur.

english: Hmm... You're going to need a way to protect yourself from the Icelord.
translation: Hmm... Icelord'dan kendini korumak için bir yol bulmalisin.

english: Don't suppose you have an Anti-Icelord Shield lying around here then?
translation: Burada Anti-Icelord Kalkani falan yok mu?

english: I don't, do you Paul?
translation: Bende yok, sende var mi Paul?

english: No I don't...
But I do have a genius idea, we'll use Gingerbread!
translation: Ama harika bir fikrim var, Gingerbread'i kullanacagiz!

english: Before Jack locked us up, I saw him using the Icelord to ice his Gingerbread Gnomes. They did a great job of absorbing his breath.
translation: Jack bizi kilitlemeden önce, Icelord'u kullanarak Gingerbread Gnomes'unu dondurdugunu gördüm. Onlar onun nefesini çok iyi emdiler.

english: You'll need to make a Gingerbread Gnome big enough to absorb the Icelord's breath.
translation: Icelord'un nefesini emecek kadar büyük bir Gingerbread Gnome yapmalisin.

english: How am I going to do that?
Our usual recipe uses: one cinnamon, one ginger, one flour and one egg, we put them into that big machine you see to your left.
translation: Her zamanki tarifimizde bir tarçin, bir zencefil, bir un ve bir yumurta kullaniyoruz, bunlari solunda gördügün büyük makineye koyuyoruz.

english: Try using more of each ingredient till you get the right combination? Possibly tripling the amount of each ingredient might work.
translation: Dogru kombinasyonu bulana kadar her malzemeyi daha fazla kullanmayi dene. Her malzemenin miktarini üç katina çikarmak ise yarayabilir.

english: This is such a ridiculous idea, guess I have no choice....
translation: Bu çok saçma bir fikir, sanirim baska seçenegim yok...

english: Come back to us if you need some more help.
translation: Daha fazla yardima ihtiyacin olursa bize gel.

english: I found the key!
That's great! Now hurry up and open the door.
translation: Harika! Simdi acele et ve kapiyi aç.

english: You release the bakers and give back their key...
translation: Firincilari serbest birak ve anahtarlarini geri ver...

english: There you go, unlocked without an issue.
translation: Iste oldu, sorunsuz bir sekilde kilit açildi.

english: Wow, you managed to do that so quickly! Without any help from us.
translation: Vay canina, bunu çok çabuk basardin! Bizim yardimimiz olmadan.

english: You're very impressive, what a coincidence that you knew to make a giant piece of gingerbread to protect yourself.
translation: Çok etkileyicisin, kendini korumak için dev bir zencefilli kurabiye yapmayi bilmen ne tesadüf.

english: Ha ha, yeah, it was no problem.
Well, thanks for freeing us!
I can't believe that actually worked....
...Me too, I thought you'd be turned into icing for sure.
translation: ...Ben de, kesin sekerleme haline gelecegini düsünmüstüm.

english: So you're telling me you weren't even sure it would!?
translation: Yani ise yarayacagindan emin degildin, öyle mi?

english: It worked out didn't it? We're free to continue making Gingerbread Gnomes.
translation: Ise yaradi, degil mi? Zencefilli kurabiye cüceleri yapmaya devam edebiliriz.

english: That was extremely reckless, Paul, but you're right, it did work out in the end.
translation: Bu çok pervasizcaydi Paul, ama haklisin, sonunda ise yaradi.

english: ...fine. I should go tell Santa the good news, the bakery is back in operation.
translation: ...tamam. Noel Baba'ya iyi haberi vermeliyim, firin yeniden faaliyete geçti.

english: We'll be back in full production in no time!
translation: Kisa sürede tam kapasite üretime geçecegiz!

english: What do we do about the Icelord in the cage?
Maybe Jack was onto something by using it to ice the Gingerbread Gnomes.
translation: Belki Jack, zencefilli kurabiye cüceleri buzlamak için onu kullanarak bir sey bulmustur.

english: You should take the giant piece of gingerbread you made and show it to Santa, he'll know we're back in business then.
translation: Yaptigin dev zencefilli kurabiyeyi Noel Baba'ya göstermelisin, o zaman islerimizin yeniden basladigini anlar.

english: Alright, time for you to go, we need to get back into production.
translation: Tamam, gitme zamani, üretime geri dönmeliyiz.

english: Hello there. Is this your home?
It is. What brings you here?
I'm just looking around.
Well you won't find anything too exciting here I'm afraid. Just farming.
translation: Korkarim burada çok heyecan verici bir sey bulamazsiniz. Sadece çiftçilik yapiyoruz.

english: Well you have fun with it.
Well I have to say that mounted head looks awful.
translation: Sey, o kafanin duvara asilmasi çok kötü görünüyor.

english: Sorry.
Not to worry. If it keeps Gordon happy, so be it. Anyway, thank you for keeping our farm safe. With the beast dealt with, I've been able to get back to tanning again.
translation: Endiselenmeyin. Gordon mutlu oluyorsa, sorun yok. Her neyse, çiftligimizi güvende tuttugunuz için tesekkürler. Canavarla isimiz bittigine göre, tekrar tabaklamaya baslayabilirim.

english: Could you tan something for me?
translation: Benim için bir sey tabaklayabilir misin?

english: Of course.
Happy to have helped. All the best.
translation: Yardimci olabildigime sevindim. Her sey gönlünce olsun.

english: Good to see you again! Anything I can do for you?
translation: Seni tekrar görmek güzel! Senin için yapabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: I'm good.
Could you tan something for me?
translation: Benim için bir sey tabaklayabilir misin?

english: Happy to have helped. All the best.
translation: Yardimci olabildigime sevindim. Her sey gönlünce olsun.

english: I'm good.
Thank you for all your help in solving the murder.
translation: Cinayeti çözmemde yardim ettigin için tesekkürler.

english: Are you me? Am I you?
translation: Sen ben misin? Ben sen miyim?

english: You've got an outrageous accent, you silly thing!
translation: Agzindan çikanlar çok saçma, seni aptal sey!

english: Call that an attack? Try this on for size!
translation: Buna saldiri mi diyorsun? Sunu bir dene bakalim!

english: Oooo. Get you! Strong words from such a weed!
translation: Oooo. Yakaladim seni! Böyle bir otçuldan sert sözler!

english: Stop hitting yourself, stop hitting yourself!
translation: Kendine vurmayi birak, kendine vurmayi birak!

english: Do I look bothered?
Hand me a banknote, and I'll try to convert it to an item.
translation: Bana bir banknot ver, onu bir esyaya dönüstürmeye çalisayim.

english: Yes
No
What are you doing here?
We're getting ready to test our mettle in the Theatre. Most people go in alone but if we do it as a team, we should have no problem.
translation: Tiyatroda cesaretimizi sinamaya hazirlaniyoruz. Çogu kisi tek basina girer ama biz takim olarak girersek sorun yasamayiz.

english: Well good luck with that.
I have a letter for you. I'm told it's quite important. Please read it when you get a chance.
translation: Sana bir mektup var. Oldukça önemli oldugu söylendi. Firsat buldugunda okursan sevinirim.

english: Apparently you destroyed that last letter I gave you without reading it, or something like that. The sender doesn't appreciate that sort of thing, so I've got another one for you.
translation: Görünüse göre sana verdigim son mektubu okumadan yok etmissin, ya da öyle bir sey. Gönderen böyle seyleri hos karsilamiyor, bu yüzden sana bir tane daha getirdim.

english: Look, you can destroy that letter as many times as you want, but it won't change anything. The sender isn't the kind of individual who takes no for an answer, so for both of our sakes, please just read it.
translation: Bak, o mektubu istedigin kadar yok edebilirsin, ama bu hiçbir seyi degistirmeyecek. Gönderen hayir cevabini kabul eden türden biri degil, bu yüzden ikimizin de iyiligi için lütfen oku.

english: Please... don't keep doing this. You don't know who you're dealing with...
translation: Lütfen... bunu yapmaya devam etme. Kiminle ugrastigini bilmiyorsun...

english: Gah! Trolls everywhere. There's no escape!
translation: Gah! Her yer trollerle dolu. Kaçis yok!

english: You could just leave the mine.
Oh, I'd never thought of that.
This place rocks!
No it doesn't, it stays perfectly still.
Bah! Be quiet, pedant.
High hoe, high hoe!
Why are you singing about farming implements at altitude?
translation: Neden yüksekte tarim aletleri hakkinda sarki söylüyorsun?

english: I don't know, I've never thought about it. Ask my Dad, he taught me the song.
translation: Bilmiyorum, hiç düsünmedim. Babama sor, sarkiyi o ögretti.

english: How's your prospecting going?
Mine's going pretty well.
Mine? Mine...you get it?
Oh, I got it. That doesn't make it funny though.
translation: Oh, anladim. Ama bu komik olmuyor.

english: Suit yourself.
I've been here for two days straight. When I close my eyes I see rocks.
translation: Iki gündür buradayim. Gözlerimi kapattigimda kayalar görüyorum.

english: Why would anyone stay here for so long?
translation: Neden biri bu kadar uzun süre burada kalmak istesin ki?

english: I fear the outside. I fear the big light.
Oh dear. Being underground for so long may have driven you mad.
translation: Oh canim. Bu kadar uzun süre yeraltinda kalmak seni delirtmis olabilir.

english: My back is killing me!
Could be worse, it could be the trolls killing you.
translation: Daha kötüsü de olabilirdi, troller seni öldürebilirdi.

english: How very droll.
No, troll.
Bah! I resist your attempts at jollity.
Pay-dirt!
Ow!
Exchuse me... I am trying to tell my verrry good friends 'bout my uncle's bushy beard.
translation: Affedersiniz... Çok iyi arkadaslarima amcamin gür sakalindan bahsetmeye çalisiyorum.

english: Exchuse me... I am lishning to my good friend.
He could hardly climb a ladder without tripping.
Such a long beard it reached the floor!
translation: Sakal o kadar uzundu ki yere kadar uzaniyordu!

english: The beard wasn't so clean after meals.
translation: Yemeklerden sonra sakali pek temiz olmazdi.

english: His beard used to get into everyone's dinner.
It was like a jungle on his chin!
In the summer he didn't need clothes.
I mean, he needed to clean it more.
He had the bushiest beard ever!
He was the hairiest dwarf in town.
His wife could use it for a blanket.
Pearls of wisdom!
Ah, tell it!
Best times ever!
Right you are.
Great days!
I'm going to be sick!
You're right.
You're so right.
Those were the days!
Not like nowadays.
Erm, what are you?
Who are you.
I'm [player name]. Nice to meet you.
You misunderstand. Your question should've been 'who are you?', not 'what are you?'. The latter is significantly more offensive.
translation: Yanlis anladiniz. Sorunuz “kimsiniz?” olmaliydi, “nedsiniz?” degil. Ikincisi çok daha kiricidir.

english: Oh... erm.... I didn't mean to offend.
I see. Well I am Mofina, a citizen of Arceuus.
Nice to meet you Mofina. Erm...
Yes?
Where exactly are you from, Mofina? I haven't heard of Arceuus and I haven't seen anyone else who is dressed like you around here.
translation: Tam olarak nerelisiniz Mofina? Arceuus'u hiç duymadim ve buralarda senin gibi giyinen baska kimseyi görmedim.

english: You are learning. That question is significantly less offensive.
translation: Ögreniyorsun. Bu soru çok daha az kirici.

english: Arceuus is one of five cities in the Kingdom of Great Kourend, found on the continent to the west.
translation: Arceuus, Büyük Kourend Kralligi'nin bati kitasinda bulunan bes sehirden biridir.

english: Okay, and how can I get to Kourend?
I believe Veos, one of your portmasters in Port Sarim, can help assist in such matters.
translation: Port Sarim'deki liman müdürlerinden biri olan Veos bu konuda sana yardimci olabilir.

english: I never expected to see one of your kind outside of Kourend. I guess the Duke invited you to the party for the same reason he invited the others?
translation: Kourend disinda senin gibileri görecegimi hiç beklemiyordum. Sanirim Dük, digerlerini davet ettigi gibi seni de partiye davet etti?

english: We... never expected to see any of your kind from across the sea either, but yes, you would be correct. The Duke did ask for a representative from Kourend and I was selected to attend.
translation: Biz de denizasiri ülkelerden senin gibileri görecegimizi hiç beklemiyorduk, ama evet, haklisin. Dük, Kourend'den bir temsilci istedi ve ben katilmak üzere seçildim.

english: Sorry, that came across a little ruder than I intended. I just wasn't entirely sure what term to use for citizens of Arceuus.
translation: Üzgünüm, bu biraz kaba oldu. Arceuus vatandaslari için hangi terimi kullanmam gerektigini tam olarak bilemedim.

english: Citizens of Arceuus would have been fine.
Now if you excuse me, this conversation is... tiring. Being away from the Dark Altar has taken a greater toll on me than I expected.
translation: Simdi izin verirseniz, bu konusma... yorucu oldu. Karanlik Sunak'tan uzak olmak, bekledigimden daha fazla yordu beni.

english: I hope you still enjoy the party!
Pray for salvation!
Protect our home!
Save our monastery!
Say no to Oziach!
Spook, don't spend!
We're the only Monk robe spawn in the world!
translation: Dünyada tek kesis cüppesi üreten biziz!

english: Hello! What is going on here?
We're protesting of course!
Yes, I can see that. What are you protesting about?
Our home! It's under attack! We must save it!
Under attack?!
Under attack by Oziach! He's trying to buy it!
translation: Oziach tarafindan saldiri altinda! Onu satin almaya çalisiyor!

english: Buy it? Buy the entire monastery?
translation: Satin almaya mi? Tüm manastiri mi?

english: Yes! He's trying to buy our home, we need to stop him!
translation: Evet! Evimizi satin almaya çalisiyor, onu durdurmaliyiz!

english: Will you help us?
Of course I will help!
The player starts the 2021 Halloween event.
Thank you! Maybe we still have a chance!
translation: Tesekkürler! Belki hala bir sansimiz vardir!

english: You should talk to Brother Jered at the monastery. He's organising everything from there.
translation: Manastirdaki Jered Kardes ile konusmalisin. Oradan her seyi organize ediyor.

english: His office is on the ground floor, north-west corner.
I'll head over there right away!
I'd like to, but I'm a bit busy right now.
translation: Gitmek isterdim ama su anda biraz mesgulüm.

english: Oh, okay, well I need to get back to protesting.
translation: Tamam, peki, ben protestoya geri dönmeliyim.

english: If you change your mind, we'll be here.
Hello! How are the protests going?
Slowly, but surely. We're holding on!
Have you spoken to Brother Jered yet?
Not yet, I'm heading there now.
Good! His office is on the ground floor of the monastery, north-west corner. Be quick, I don't know how long we have!
translation: Güzel! Ofisi manastirin zemin katinda, kuzeybati kösesinde. Acele et, ne kadar vaktimiz var bilmiyorum!

english: Hi there!
Hello! I saw your friend heading up towards the monastery. She was carrying some kitchen equipment!
translation: Merhaba! Arkadasini manastira dogru giderken gördüm. Mutfak esyalari tasiyordu!

english: Hello!
Hi! Thank you for agreeing to help us, we've been protesting for ages!
translation: Merhaba! Bize yardim etmeyi kabul ettiginiz için tesekkürler, uzun zamandir protesto ediyoruz!

english: Of course I will help!
I'd like to, but I'm a bit busy right now.
translation: Isterdim ama su anda biraz mesgulüm.

english: Excuse me... Oh, wait, I thought you were someone else.
translation: Affedersiniz... Oh, bekleyin, sizi baskasiyla karistirdim.

english: No problem. Have a good day!
And yourself.
You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Devious Minds quest.
translation: Devious Minds görevini baslatmak için gerekli tüm sartlari saglamiyorsunuz.

english: I knew you would save us! Bless you, my child!
translation: Bizi kurtaracagini biliyordum! Tanri seni korusun, evlat!

english: Thanks! Just stay indoors while those zombies are still prowling around.
translation: Tesekkürler! Zombiler ortalikta dolasirken içeride kalin.

english: May Saradomin's light shine upon you!
Tell him to save it for when I manage to defeat those zombies!
translation: O zombileri yenene kadar bunu saklasin!

english: Saradomin smile upon you! You've saved us all!
All in a day's work, brother.
Your name will forever be listed amongst the virtuous!
translation: Adin sonsuza kadar erdemli kisiler listesinde yer alacak!

english: I'll remember that the next time I go drinking...
translation: Bir dahaki sefere içmeye gittigimde bunu hatirlayacagim...

english: Why are all of you standing around here?
None of your business. Get lost.
Have you found the tree with the leprechaun yet?
No, we've looked for ages but haven't... Hey! Wait a minute! How did you know about that?
translation: Hayir, uzun zamandir ariyoruz ama bulamadik... Hey! Bir dakika! Bunu nereden biliyorsun?

english: Thanks for the information!
...You tricked me. I'm not talking to you anymore.
I already told you. I'm not talking to you anymore.
So, are any of you zombies gonna break me out?
translation: Peki, siz zombiler beni buradan çikaracak misiniz?
sub_category: Dialogue for Monk of Zamorak (Defender of Varrock)

english: Ha! Mash those guards!
sub_category: Dialogue for Monk of Zamorak (Defender of Varrock)

english: Oi, zombies! Care to let me out?
translation: Hey, zombiler! Beni disari çikarir misiniz?
sub_category: Dialogue for Monk of Zamorak (Defender of Varrock)

english: Hey, zombies! I'm on your side!
sub_category: Dialogue for Monk of Zamorak (Defender of Varrock)

english: Let me out! I'll help with your invasion!
translation: Beni disari çikarin! Istilaya yardim ederim!
sub_category: Dialogue for Monk of Zamorak (Defender of Varrock)

english: Let me out! I'm a bad guy too!
translation: Beni disari çikarin! Ben de kötü biriyim!
sub_category: Dialogue for Monk of Zamorak (Defender of Varrock)

english: Who's a cute little monkey?
Ukkuk oook! Eeek aka, ahh aka gonk.
translation: Ukkuk oook! Eeek aka, ahh aka gonk.

english: Who's an ugly human? Give me a banana!
translation: Kim bu çirkin insan? Bana muz ver!

english: What's up with you?
Stupid human! Give monkey a banana!
Sorry monkey, I don't have any bananas.
Aghhh. You're a rubbish human, get monkey a banana now.
translation: Aghhh. Sen berbat bir insansin, maymuna hemen muz ver.

english: Ha ha! Smelly human gave monkey a banana.
translation: Ha ha! Kokusmus insan maymuna muz verdi.

english: Wow you're one nasty piece of work. Have you ever heard of gratitude?
translation: Vay canina, sen gerçekten kötü birisin. Minnettarlik diye bir sey duydun mu hiç?

english: Hey baldy, give monkey another banana!
translation: Hey kel, maymuna bir muz daha ver!

english: Just because I'm not covered in fur doesn't make me bald, you cheeky monkey.
translation: Sirf kürküm yok diye kel degilim, seni küstah maymun.

english: Monkey wants another banana now! Give me, give me!
translation: Maymun simdi bir muz daha istiyor! Ver, ver!

english: Look I've had it with you, you little degenerate.
translation: Bak, senden biktim, seni küçük dejenere.

english: I'll not give you a banana until you learn manners.
translation: Terbiye ögrenene kadar sana muz vermeyecegim.

english: Give the monkey a banana.
Don't give it a banana.
Eeekeek ookeek!
Arr! Yer messin with me monkey plunder!
translation: Arr! Benimle dalga geçiyorsun maymun haydutu!

english: What?
Are ye here for...the stuff?
translation: Buraya... o sey için mi geldin?

english: You know...the 'special' bananas?
No...why do you ask?
No reason. Have a nice day.
Arr!
Arr!
Bored now...
Let me go, can't ye hear them? Howlin' in the dark...
translation: Birak beni, duymuyor musun? Karanlikta uluyorlar...

english: What do you mean?
I'm not hangin' around te be killed!
The Horrors, the Horrors!
I'm not goin' back in that brewery, not fer all the Bitternuts I can carry!
translation: O bira fabrikasina geri dönmeyecegim, tüm Bitternuts'lari tasiyabilsem bile!

english: Oook! Oook!
The monkey deftly avoids your melee attack! You aren't going to score a hit in hand-to-hand combat.
translation: Maymun, yakin dövüs saldirinizi ustaca kaçiriyor! Yakin dövüste ona vurus yapamazsiniz.

english: Ook! Oook! Ook!
Oook! Oook! Oook!
Oook! Ook!
Ook! Ook!
Ook! Ah Ah Ah!
Ook!
I won't say!
Ah Ah Ah! Ook! Ook!
Oook! Ook! Ook!
Ook! Oook! Oook!
Joooogre bones! Ook!
You can't catch me!
Ook! Ah Ah Ah! Ook!
Ah Ah Ah! Ah Ah Ah!
translation: Ah Ah Ah! Ah Ah Ah!

english: Ook! Ook! Ah Ah AH!
Oook! Ook! Oook!
Can't hit! Can't hit!
Ook! Oook!
Ah Ah Ah! Ook!
Ook! Ook! Oook!
After years of planning, the humans are going to get what they deserve.
translation: Yillarca süren planlamanin ardindan, insanlar hak ettiklerini alacaklar.

english: Hmm, I don't think this is quite right.
translation: Hmm, bunun pek dogru oldugunu sanmiyorum.

english: I wish Kruk would do his own dirty work.
translation: Keske Kruk kendi kirli islerini kendisi yapsaydi.

english: This looks like a good spot.
translation: Burasi iyi bir yer gibi görünüyor.

english: The time of monkeys is almost upon us.
You! Get out of my way!
Looking to get across to the Auburn Valley?
Yes please.
Alright then, let's get going...
You carefully follow the mountain guide to Nemus Retreat in the Auburn Valley.
translation: Dag rehberini dikkatlice takip ederek Auburn Vadisi'ndeki Nemus Retreat'e gidiyorsunuz.

english: No thanks.
As you wish.
Need a guide to get you to Quetzacalli?
translation: Quetzacalli'ye gitmek için rehbere ihtiyacin var mi?

english: You carefully follow the mountain guide to Quetzacalli Gorge.
translation: Dag rehberini dikkatle takip ederek Quetzacalli Gorge'a gidiyorsun.

english: Over the mountains?
Indeed. The journey isn't too long, but I can help you avoid the dangerous stretches, letting you focus on enjoying the fresh mountain air.
translation: Evet. Yolculuk çok uzun degil, ama tehlikeli bölgelerden kaçinmana yardimci olabilirim, böylece sen de temiz dag havasinin tadini çikarmaya odaklanabilirsin.

english: Do you charge anything for the journey?
Nothing at all! So, shall we?
translation: Hiçbir sey almiyorum! Öyleyse, gidelim mi?

english: Yes.
No.
Hello there.
Do you have a problem traveller?
No, I just wondered why you're wearing that outfit... Is it fancy dress?
translation: Hayir, sadece neden o kiyafeti giydigini merak ettim... Kostüm mü?

english: No! It's for protection.
Protection from what?
The plague of course…
Hello.
What do you want?
Who are you?
I'm a mourner. It's my job to help heal the plague victims of West Ardougne and to make sure the disease is contained.
translation: Ben bir yas tutanim. West Ardougne'daki veba kurbanlarini iyilestirmek ve hastaligin yayilmasini önlemek benim isim.

english: Very noble of you.
If you come down with any symptoms such as flu or nightmares let me know immediately.
translation: Grip veya kabus gibi herhangi bir semptom görürsen hemen bana haber ver.

english: Nothing, just being polite.
Hmmm, ok then. Be on your way.
translation: Hmmm, tamam o zaman. Yoluna devam et.

english: Are you ok?
Yes, I'm fine thanks.
Have you experienced any plague symptoms?
translation: Herhangi bir veba belirtisi yasadin mi?

english: What are the symptoms?
First you'll come down with heavy flu, this is usually followed by horrifying nightmares.
translation: Önce siddetli grip geçirirsin, bunu genellikle korkunç kabuslar izler.

english: I used to have nightmares when I was younger.
Not like these I assure you. Soon after a thick black liquid will seep from your nose and eyes.
translation: Bunlar gibi degil, emin ol. Kisa süre sonra burnundan ve gözlerinden kalin siyah bir sivi sizmaya baslar.

english: Yuck!
When it gets to that stage there's nothing we can do for you.
translation: Bu asamaya geldiginde senin için yapabilecegimiz hiçbir sey kalmaz.

english: No, I feel fine.
Well if you take a turn for the worse let me know straight away.
translation: Durumun kötülesirse hemen bana haber ver.

english: Can you cure it then?
No... But you will have to be treated.
Treated?
We have to take measures to contain the disease. That's why you must let us know immediately if you take a turn for the worse.
translation: Hastaligi kontrol altina almak için önlemler almamiz gerekiyor. Bu yüzden durumunuz kötülesirse hemen bize haber verin.

english: No, but can you tell me where the plague came from?
translation: Hayir, ama salginin nereden geldigini söyleyebilir misiniz?

english: It all started when King Tyras of West Ardougne came back from one of his visits to the lands west of here.
translation: Her sey, Bati Ardougne Krali Tyras'in buradan batiya yaptigi ziyaretlerden birinden döndügünde basladi.

english: Some of his men must have unknowingly caught it out there and brought it back with them
translation: Adamlarindan bazilari farkinda olmadan orada hastaliga yakalanmis ve geri getirmis olmalilar.

english: What are you up to with old man Edmond?
Nothing, we've just been chatting.
What about his daughter?
Oh, you know about that then?
We know about everything that goes on in Ardougne. We have to if we are to contain the plague.
translation: Ardougne'da olan her seyi biliyoruz. Salgini kontrol altina almak için bilmemiz gerekiyor.

english: Have you see his daughter recently?
I imagine she's caught the plague. Either way she won't be allowed out of West Ardougne, the risk is too great.
translation: Sanirim o da salgina yakalandi. Her halükarda West Ardougne'dan çikmasina izin verilmeyecek, risk çok büyük.

english: Been digging have we?
What do you mean?
Your hands are covered in mud.
Oh that...
Funny, you don't look like the gardening type.
Oh no, I love gardening! It's my favorite pastime.
translation: Oh hayir, bahçeciligi severim! En sevdigim hobimdir.

english: Can I help you?
What are you doing?
I'm guarding the border to West Ardougne. No one except we mourners can pass through.
translation: West Ardougne sinirini koruyorum. Biz yas tutanlar disinda kimse geçemez.

english: Why?
The plague of course. We can't risk cross contamination.
translation: Veba yüzünden tabii ki. Çapraz bulasma riskini göze alamayiz.

english: What brought the plague to Ardougne?
It's all down to King Tyras of West Ardougne. It started came back from one of his visits to the lands west of here.
translation: Hepsi West Ardougne Krali Tyras'in suçu. Buradan batiya yaptigi ziyaretlerden birinden döndükten sonra basladi.

english: Does he know how bad the situation is now?
translation: Durumun ne kadar kötü oldugunu biliyor mu?

english: If he did he wouldn't care. I believe he wants his people to suffer, he's an evil man.
translation: Bilsen bile umursamazdi. Halkinin aci çekmesini istiyor, o kötü bir adam.

english: Isn't that treason?
He's not my king.
What are the symptoms of the plague?
The first signs are typical flu symptoms. These tend to be followed by severe nightmares, horrifying hallucinations which drive many to madness.
translation: Ilk belirtiler tipik grip belirtileridir. Bunlari siddetli kabuslar ve birçok kisiyi deliye çeviren korkunç halüsinasyonlar izler.

english: Sounds nasty.
It gets worse. Next the victim's blood changes into a thick black tar-like liquid, at this point they're past help.
translation: Daha da kötülesir. Sonra kurbanin kani kalin, siyah, katran benzeri bir siviya dönüsür, bu noktada artik yardim edilemez.

english: Their skin is cold to the touch, the victim is now brain dead. Their body however lives on driven by the virus, roaming like a zombie, spreading itself further wherever possible.
translation: Ciltleri dokunuldugunda soguktur, kurban artik beyin ölümü gerçeklesmistir. Ancak vücutlari virüsün etkisiyle yasamaya devam eder, zombi gibi dolasir ve mümkün olan her yere yayilir.

english: I think I've heard enough.
Okay then, see you around.
Maybe…
Hmmm, how did you get over here? You're not one of this rabble. Ah well, you'll have to stay. Can't risk you going back now.
translation: Hmmm, buraya nasil geldin? Sen bu ayaktakimindan degilsin. Neyse, burada kalmak zorundasin. Simdi geri dönmene izin veremeyiz.

english: So what's a mourner?
We're working for King Lathas of East Ardougne. He has tasked us with containing the accursed plague sweeping West Ardougne.
translation: Dogu Ardougne Krali Lathas için çalisiyoruz. Bize, Bati Ardougne'yi kasip kavuran lanetli vebayi kontrol altina almayi görevlendirdi.

english: We also do our best to ease these people's suffering. We're nicknamed mourners because we spend a lot of time at plague victim funerals, no one else is allowed to risk attending.
translation: Ayrica bu insanlarin acilarini hafifletmek için elimizden geleni yapiyoruz. Cenazeci lakabini aldik çünkü veba kurbanlarinin cenazelerinde çok zaman geçiriyoruz, baska kimse bu riski göze alamiyor.

english: It's a demanding job, and we get little thanks from the people here.
translation: Bu zorlu bir is ve buradaki insanlar bize pek tesekkür etmiyor.

english: I haven't got the plague though...
Can't risk you being a carrier. That protective clothing you have isn't regulation issue. It won't meet safety standards.
translation: Tasiyici olma riskini göze alamayiz. Giydiklerin koruyucu giysiler yönetmeliklere uygun degil. Güvenlik standartlarini karsilamiyor.

english: I'm looking for a woman named Elena.
Ah yes, I've heard of her. A healer I believe. She must be mad coming over here voluntarily.
translation: Evet, onu duydum. Bir sifaci sanirim. Buraya gönüllü olarak gelmis olmasi delilik.

english: I hear rumours she has probably caught the plague now. Very tragic, a stupid waste of life.
translation: Muhtemelen vebaya yakalandigina dair söylentiler duydum. Çok trajik, aptalca bir hayat kaybi.

english: Who are you?
Nothing, just being polite.
What are the symptoms?
No, I feel fine.
No, but can you tell me where the plague came from?
translation: Hayir, ama vebanin nereden geldigini söyleyebilir misin?

english: What brought the plague to Ardougne?
What are the symptoms of the plague?
Okay then, see you around.
So what's a mourner?
I haven't got the plague though...
I'm looking for a woman named Elena.
Arrr, what is it that ye be wantin? I can tell ye all about the prices of runes, or perhaps I could combine the charges on yer teleport jewellery.
translation: Arrr, ne istiyorsun? Sana rünlerin fiyatlarini söyleyebilirim, ya da belki teleport mücevherlerinin ücretlerini birlestirebilirim.

english: What's a pirate doing here?
By my sea-blistered skin, I could ask the same of you!
translation: Denizden kabarmis derim üzerine yemin ederim, ayni soruyu sana da sorabilirim!

english: But... I'm not a pirate?
No? Then what's that smell? The smell o' someone spent too long at sea without a bath!
translation: Degil misin? O zaman bu koku da ne? Denizde çok uzun süre banyo yapmadan kalmis birinin kokusu!

english: I think that's probably you.
Har har har! We've got a stern landlubber 'ere! Well, let me tell ye, I'm here for the Grand Exchange! Gonna cash in me loot!
translation: Har har har! Burada sert bir kara adamimiz var! Sunu söyleyeyim, ben Büyük Borsa için buradayim! Ganimetimi paraya çevirecegim!

english: Don't you just want to sell it in a shop or trade it to someone specific?
translation: Onlari bir dükkanda satmak ya da belirli birine takas etmek istemiyor musun?

english: By my wave-battered bones! Not when I can sell to the whole world from this very spot!
translation: Dalgalarin yiprattigi kemiklerim üzerine yemin ederim! Bu noktadan tüm dünyaya satabilecegim varken neden öyle yapayim?

english: You pirates are nothing but trouble! Why, once I travelled to Lunar Isle with a bunch of your type, and spent days sailing around in circles!
translation: Siz korsanlar bas belasisiniz! Bir keresinde sizin gibilerle Lunar Isle'a seyahat ettim ve günlerce daireler çizerek dolastim!

english: Then ye must know me brother! Murky Pat!
translation: O zaman beni taniyor olmalisin kardesim! Murky Pat!

english: Hmmm. Not so sure I remember him.
Well, 'e be on that ship for sure. And I remember 'im tellin' me about some [guy/gal] like ye, getting all mixed up with curses and cabin boys.
translation: Evet, o gemide oldugu kesin. Ve bana senin gibi birinden bahsettigini hatirliyorum, lanetler ve gemici çocuklarla karismis birinden.

english: Yes! That was me!
Ye sure be a different character.
Tell me about the prices of runes.
Combine the charges on my teleport jewellery, please.
Arrr, ye've got nothing that I can combine.
Arrr, ye've nothing I can combine. Maybe ye needs to take yer stuff up to the Wilderness and charge it on the Fountain of Rune. It be more powerful than me.
translation: Arrr, birlestirebilecegim hiçbir seyin yok. Belki de esyalarini Wilderness'a götürüp Rune Çesmesi'nde sarj etmelisin. O benden daha güçlüdür.

english: Arrr, I think ye be a bit short of inventory space.
translation: Arrr, sanirim envanter alanin biraz dar.

english: Arr, all done.
I hear you deal in rings of forging?
Arrrr, bring me yer ruby rings to enchant.
translation: Arrrr, bana büyülemek için yakut yüzüklerini getir.

english: Arrrr, but they arrre 250gp per ring.
Arrr, 250gp per ring. How many would ye like me to enchant?
translation: Arrr, yüzük basina 250 altin. Kaç tanesini büyülemek istersin?

english: Arrr, be seeing ya.
Arrr, pleasure doin' business with ya.
translation: Arrr, seninle is yapmak bir zevkti.

english: I got to go, erm, swab some decks! Yarr!
translation: Gitmem lazim, erm, güverteyi temizlemem lazim! Yarr!

english: Defer your speech right there! Quit this derogatory and somewhat narrow-minded allusion that all folks of sea voyage are only concerned with washing the decks, looking after parrots and drinking rum. I'll have ye
translation: Konusmani hemen kes! Deniz yolculuguna çikanlarin tek ilgilendigi seyin güverteyi temizlemek, papaganlara bakmak ve rom içmek oldugu seklindeki bu asagilayici ve biraz da dar görüslü imayi kes. Bilmeni isterim ki

english: know there is much more to a pirate than meets the eye.
Aye-aye, captain!
Oh, come on! Lighten up!
Arrr, what is it that ye be wantin? I can tell ye all about the prices of runes.
translation: Arrr, ne istiyorsun? Rünlerin fiyatlari hakkinda sana her seyi anlatabilirim.

english: No! Me prices, they be goin' down!
Arrr! Another good sale!
I'm lovin' this Grand Exchange! Arrr!
Sure be a busy place, today.
Yarrr! I'm gonna be rich, I tell ye!
What's a pirate doing here?
Tell me about the prices of runes.
Combine the charges on my teleport jewellery, please.
I got to go, erm, swab some decks! Yarr!
translation: Gitmem lazim, sey, güverteyi temizlemem lazim! Yarr!

english: I hear you deal in rings of forging?
Welcome adventurer, to the Hallowed Sepulchre. Are you here to claim some of the treasure within? It seems like the kind of activity one like you would appreciate.
translation: Hos geldin maceraci, Kutsal Mezar'a. Içindeki hazineleri almak için mi buradasin? Senin gibi birinin hosuna gidecek bir aktivite gibi görünüyor.

english: Treasure? What treasure? And what do you mean by 'one like me'?
translation: Hazine mi? Ne hazinesi? “Senin gibi biri” derken neyi kastediyorsun?

english: I mean you're not one of the inhabitants of this city. We could use someone of your talents.
translation: Bu sehrin sakinlerinden biri olmadigini kastediyorum. Senin yeteneklerine ihtiyacimiz var.

english: I mean you're not one of the inhabitants of this city... although you do smell and look like one. We could use someone of your talents.
translation: Bu sehrin sakinlerinden biri olmadigini kastediyorum... ama kokun ve görünüsün öyle. Senin yeteneklerine ihtiyacimiz var.

english: Oh? I can't say I'm not interested. What do you propose?
translation: Öyle mi? Ilgilenmedigimi söyleyemem. Ne öneriyorsun?

english: This place was built long before the city of Darkmeyer existed, back when this land was known as Hallowvale.
translation: Burasi Darkmeyer sehri kurulmadan çok önce, bu topraklar Hallowvale olarak bilindigi zamanlarda insa edildi.

english: The Sepulchre was used as a resting place for Hallowvale's loyal followers of Saradomin.
translation: Mezarlik, Hallowvale'deki Saradomin'in sadik takipçilerinin dinlenme yeri olarak kullaniliyordu.

english: Before they were driven out by the vampyres, the Saradominists used their magic to safeguard this place.
translation: Vampirler tarafindan kovulmadan önce, Saradoministler burayi korumak için büyülerini kullandilar.

english: Safeguard how?
The dead here were buried with the wealth they had in life. To protect these riches, the Saradominists enchanted the statues within the Sepulchre to create various defences.
translation: Buradaki ölüler, hayattayken sahip olduklari servetle birlikte gömüldüler. Bu zenginlikleri korumak için Saradoministler, mezarlik içindeki heykelleri çesitli savunma mekanizmalari olusturmak üzere büyülü hale getirdiler.

english: Many have tried and failed to obtain the prizes buried here.
translation: Birçogu burada gömülü olan hazineleri ele geçirmek için denedi ama basarisiz oldu.

english: Okay... So I presume you want me to get some of this treasure for you? How should I go about doing it?
translation: Tamam... Sanirim bu hazineden birazini senin için almami istiyorsun? Bunu nasil yapmaliyim?

english: We don't care for a lot of what is kept here. We are only interested in the old currency of this land.
translation: Burada saklanan seylerin çogu bizi ilgilendirmiyor. Biz sadece bu topraklardaki eski para birimiyle ilgileniyoruz.

english: The mysterious stranger pulls a coin out of his pocket and shows it to you.
translation: Gizemli yabanci cebinden bir sikke çikarir ve sana gösterir.

english: If you find any of these Hallowed marks, I'd be willing to take them off your hands. In exchange, I can provide tools that can help you within the Hallowed Sepulchre.
translation: Bu Kutsal isaretlerden herhangi birini bulursan, onlari senden almaya hazirim. Karsiliginda, Kutsal Mezar'da sana yardimci olabilecek araçlar saglayabilirim.

english: You can keep whatever else you find for yourself.
translation: Buldugun diger her seyi kendine saklayabilirsin.

english: You should know, only the most agile of adventurers will have success down there. You'll need to use your reflexes to overcome the traps within.
translation: Bilmelisin ki, sadece en çevik maceracilar orada basarili olabilir. Içerideki tuzaklari asmak için reflekslerini kullanman gerekecek.

english: The Sepulchre has five floors in total, each more dangerous than the last. I hope you prove competent enough to make it all the way down.
translation: Mezar toplamda bes katli ve her kat bir öncekinden daha tehlikeli. Umarim tüm katlari geçebilecek kadar yetenekli oldugunu kanitlarsin.

english: Do you have any information about what kind of traps I can expect?
translation: Ne tür tuzaklar bekleyebilecegim hakkinda herhangi bir bilgin var mi?

english: The statues have been enchanted to shoot fire, lightning and arrows. Some also throw swords. There are also tiles that when stepped on, will teleport you somewhere else.
translation: Heykeller ates, simsek ve ok atacak sekilde büyülü. Bazilari kiliç da firlatiyor. Ayrica üzerine basildiginda sizi baska bir yere isinlayan karolar da var.

english: Sounds like the perfect challenge for me! Is there anything else I should know?
translation: Benim için mükemmel bir meydan okuma gibi görünüyor! Bilmem gereken baska bir sey var mi?

english: Yes... It seems that there is another safeguard which prevents anyone from spending too long within the Sepulchre.
translation: Evet... Mezarlikta kimsenin çok uzun süre kalmasini engelleyen baska bir güvenlik önlemi daha var gibi görünüyor.

english: You'll only have so much time before the magic within seals both the coffins and the stairs leading to the next floor.
translation: Içindeki büyü, tabutlari ve bir sonraki kata çikan merdivenleri kapatmadan önce çok az zamaniniz olacak.

english: Hang on a second... If the doors to the next floor close, then how will I escape?
translation: Bir saniye... Bir sonraki kata açilan kapilar kapanirsa, nasil kaçacagim?

english: The priests who built this place had a teleportation system. The magical obelisks they used can be found at the end of each floor. These obelisks can be used to transport you back here.
translation: Burayi insa eden rahipler bir isinlanma sistemi kurmuslar. Kullandiklari büyülü dikilitaslar her katin sonunda bulunur. Bu dikilitaslar seni buraya geri götürmek için kullanilabilir.

english: However, we have found that the obelisks only respond to those they perceive to be followers of Saradomin. I'd strongly advise against wearing items of any other god.
translation: Ancak, dikilitaslarin sadece Saradomin'in takipçileri olarak algiladiklari kisilere tepki verdiklerini kesfettik. Baska bir tanrinin esyalarini giymemeni siddetle tavsiye ederim.

english: I see, but what if I'm in the middle of a floor and can't make it to an obelisk?
translation: Anliyorum, ama ya bir katin ortasindaysam ve obeliske ulasamiyorsam?

english: I see you are cautious adventurer. That is wise. You can use any teleport spell to escape from the Hallowed Sepulchre. However, you may also find these of use.
translation: Dikkatli bir maceraci oldugunuzu görüyorum. Bu akillica. Kutsal Mezar'dan kaçmak için herhangi bir isinlanma büyüsü kullanabilirsiniz. Ancak, bunlar da isinize yarayabilir.

english: These teleport crystals were enchanted using the magic of the obelisks. They can be used to teleport to this lobby. I can sell you more when you run out.
translation: Bu isinlanma kristalleri, obelisklerin büyüsüyle büyülendi. Bu lobide isinlanmak için kullanilabilirler. Bittiginde sana daha fazlasini satabilirim.

english: Thanks! I'll make sure to put them to good use.
translation: Tesekkürler! Onlari iyi bir sekilde kullanacagim.

english: Thanks for the information. I'll keep an eye out for some of those Hallowed marks.
translation: Bilgi için tesekkürler. Kutsal isaretlere dikkat edecegim.

english: That would be... appreciated.
Tell me about yourself.
Like you, I am not from here. I represent a group who are very interested in the Hallowed marks found within the Hallowed Sepulchre.
translation: Senin gibi ben de buradan degilim. Kutsal Mezar'da bulunan Kutsal isaretlerle çok ilgilenen bir grubu temsil ediyorum.

english: You know, I helped out a very similar individual to yourself over at the Theatre of Blood. Any connection?
translation: Biliyorsun, Kan Tiyatrosu'nda sana çok benzeyen birine yardim etmistim. Bir baglanti var mi?

english: So you're the one who the master spoke of. I am aware of your contributions. Helping us out here will earn yourself further favour with him.
translation: Demek ustanin bahsettigi kisi sensin. Katkilarini biliyorum. Bize burada yardim edersen, onun gözünde daha da deger kazanirsin.

english: How do I know that's something I even want?
translation: Bunun istedigim bir sey oldugunu nereden bilecegim?

english: That is for you to decide. I have told you all that I have to share.
translation: Buna sen karar verirsin. Sana söylemem gereken her seyi söyledim.

english: That is all you need to know.
All right then, keep your secrets.
I'd like to trade in some Hallowed marks.
translation: Bazi Kutsal isaretleri takas etmek istiyorum.

english: Of course.
Do you have any of my items?
I do not. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: Yok. Eger senin esyalarin olsaydi, ama sen onlari almadan önce öldüysen, artik kaybolmuslardir.

english: I do have some of your items here. Try not to get hit by the traps next time.
translation: Burada senin esyalarindan bazilari var. Bir dahaki sefere tuzaklara çarpmamaya çalis.

english: I'd like to access your tool storage.
Is there any way I could have private access to the Sepulchre? The other adventurers in there keep activating traps and messing up my timing.
translation: Mezara özel erisimim olabilir mi? Oradaki diger maceracilar sürekli tuzaklari etkinlestirip zamanlamami bozuyorlar.

english: An interesting problem. But... I suppose I could grant you private access to the Hallowed Sepulchre... for a fee.
translation: Ilginç bir sorun. Ama... Sanirim size Kutsal Mezar'a özel erisim izni verebilirim... bir ücret karsiliginda.

english: How much?
200 Hallowed marks.
I don't have that many marks on me...
Then I'm afraid that, for now, you will have to contend with your peers activating traps for you.
translation: O zaman korkarim ki, simdilik, arkadaslarinizin sizin için tuzaklari etkinlestirmesiyle yetinmek zorunda kalacaksiniz.

english: Very well. You should now find that when you enter the Hallowed Sepulchre, you will end up in different chambers to your peers.
translation: Peki. Artik Kutsal Mezarliga girdiginizde, arkadaslarinizdan farkli odalarda bulacaginizi göreceksiniz.

english: Speak to me again if you like this effect rescinded.
translation: Bu etkinin kaldirilmasini istiyorsaniz, benimle tekrar konusun.

english: No thanks.
Very well. I shall be here if you change your mind.
I'd better get going.
I see you're still alive adventurer. Do you have any Hallowed marks for me?
translation: Hala hayattasin maceraci. Bana Hallowed markan var mi?

english: Tell me more about this place.
translation: Bana bu yer hakkinda daha fazla bilgi ver.

english: Is there anything else you need?
translation: Baska bir seye ihtiyacin var mi?

english: Can I go back to looting with other people?
translation: Diger insanlarla birlikte yagmalamaya geri dönebilir miyim?

english: I can remove your private access for now, if you're sure.
translation: Eger emin isen, simdilik özel erisiminizi kaldirabilirim.

english: Very well. You should now find that when you enter the Hallowed Sepulchre, your peers will join you.
translation: Pekala. Artik Kutsal Mezar'a girdiginde, arkadaslarin da sana katilacak.

english: Speak to me again if you would like this effect restored.
translation: Bu etkinin geri yüklenmesini istiyorsan tekrar benimle konus.

english: On second thoughts, I've changed my mind.
translation: Bir daha düsündüm de, fikrimi degistirdim.

english: Can I go back to looting on my own?
translation: Tekrar kendi basima yagmalamaya devam edebilir miyim?

english: I can restore your private access for you, if you're sure.
translation: Eger emin isen, özel erisiminizi geri yükleyebilirim.

english: Sorry, I need to go.
I do not have anything for you. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: Sana verecek hiçbir seyim yok. Eger senin esyalarindan varsa ve sen onlari almadan önce öldüysen, artik kaybolmuslardir.

english: I have some of your things. You should come get them before you enter the Hallowed Sepulchre.
translation: Senin bazi esyalarin bende. Kutsal Mezar'a girmeden önce gelip almalisin.

english: Tell me about yourself.
I'd like to trade in some Hallowed marks.
translation: Bazi Kutsal isaretleri takas etmek istiyorum.

english: Do you have any of my items?
I'd like to access your tool storage.
Ask about private access.
Yes.
No.
I'd better get going.
Tell me more about this place.
translation: Bana bu yer hakkinda daha fazla bilgi ver.

english: More options...
Previous options...
Sorry, I need to go.
Hello.
I've lost my notes... Dufft, have you seen my notes?
translation: Notlarimi kaybettim... Dufft, notlarimi gördün mü?

english: My wife will kill me if I don't take her back a souvenir.
I've had such a terrible headache since we arrived on this mountain.
translation: Bu daga geldigimizden beri basim çok agriyor.

english: Thank Saradomin for that mountain guide. We couldn't have made it here without him!
translation: O dag rehberine Saradomin'e sükürler olsun. O olmasaydi buraya gelemezdik!

english: I can't find my rock pick!
Hello there.
Hello traveller, do you know what this is?
translation: Merhaba gezgin, bunun ne oldugunu biliyor musun?

english: It looks like a monument.
Yes. I served in the military for 30 years. This monument always reminds me of my days in the army.
translation: Evet. 30 yil orduda görev yaptim. Bu anit bana her zaman ordudaki günlerimi hatirlatir.

english: Uh, you guys aren't fairies - what are you doing here?
translation: Sizler peri degilsiniz, burada ne isiniz var?

english: Grunt! Smelly, stinky human! Urgh! Leave us alone before we hurt you.
translation: Grunt! Kokusmus, pis insan! Urgh! Size zarar vermeden bizi rahat birakin.

english: Is this place haunted?
I don't think so. Would it matter if it was?
translation: Sanmiyorum. Öyle olsa ne fark eder ki?

english: Maybe, it depends how haunted. I'm not a big fan of ghosts.
translation: Belki, ne kadar hayaletli olduguna bagli. Hayaletleri pek sevmem.

english: Well, let's hope it's not haunted!
Have you thought about painting the building?
I'm thinking a nice bold red, like the dragon armour.
translation: Ejderha zirhi gibi güzel, koyu kirmizi bir renk düsünüyorum.

english: Or maybe a green, in memory of Elvarg, a very mean dragon.
translation: Ya da belki çok kötü bir ejderha olan Elvarg'in anisina yesil.

english: I think green would look great, it would match the surroundings, too!
translation: Yesil harika olur, çevreye de uyum saglar!

english: Could I get one of those rune platebodies?
translation: O rune zirhlardan bir tane alabilir miyim?

english: Well, normally you'd have to slay a dragon for me...
translation: Normalde bunun için bir ejderha öldürmen gerekir...

english: ...but maybe I can make an exception once I've moved in here.
translation: ...ama buraya tasindiktan sonra bir istisna yapabilirim.

english: As a little thank you for the help!
translation: Yardimin için küçük bir tesekkür olarak!

english: That would be great! Let's get this deal done quickly.
translation: Harika olur! Hadi bu isi çabuk halledelim.

english: I can't wait to complete the purchase!
It's almost done Oziach, not much longer.
translation: Neredeyse bitti Oziach, çok az kaldi.

english: Do you have any plans for it?
I have a few. I might convert the top floor into a bar!
translation: Birkaç tane var. En üst kati bara çevirebilirim!

english: It'll be for all dragon slayers I know, there's a lot of us!
translation: Tanidigim tüm ejderha avcilari için olacak, sayimiz çok fazla!

english: Interesting use of such a beautiful property!
translation: Böyle güzel bir mülkü ilginç bir sekilde kullanacaksin!

english: OoooOooOoOoOoooooooo!
Ah!! Why did you do that?
That scared me!
I'm sorry! I was just pretending to be a ghost.
Don't do that! I don't like ghosts.
Hello Oziach.
Sorry [player name], I'm talking to the estate agent right now.
translation: Üzgünüm Maceraci, su anda emlakçiyla konusuyorum.

english: I'm going to head back to the office.
Alright, I'll see you later. Can't wait to move in!
translation: Tamam, sonra görüsürüz. Tasinmak için sabirsizlaniyorum!

english: I know, it's a lovely place! See you!
translation: Biliyorum, çok güzel bir yer! Görüsürüz!

english: The estate agent leaves.
Ahhh... soon to be mine.
The cutscene ends.
Oziach is alone! Seems like the perfect time to scare him.
translation: Oziach yalniz! Onu korkutmak için mükemmel bir zaman gibi görünüyor.

english: I just need to climb this tree and blow on the bottle, that should do it.
translation: Bu agaca tirmanip siseye üflemem yeterli.

english: I see you there, what are you doing?!
Oziach caught me. I should try to be a bit faster next time.
translation: Oziach beni yakaladi. Bir dahaki sefere biraz daha hizli olmaliyim.

english: I should talk to Brother Jered about trying this again.
translation: Bunu tekrar denemek için Jered Kardes ile konusmaliyim.

english: OOOoOOOooOOooOOOOoOOOO
The player shakes the evergreen tree slightly.
translation: Oyuncu yaprak dökmeyen agaci hafifçe sallar.

english: What was that? A ghost?!
Hello?? Is that a ghost?
ONE ghost? Haha, ONE ghost can't spook me!
translation: TEK bir hayalet mi? Haha, TEK bir hayalet beni korkutamaz!

english: The player returns to Brother Jered.
Seems like I wasn't very scary. Oziach said ONE ghost isn't enough!
translation: Görünüse göre pek korkutucu degildim. Oziach, TEK bir hayalet yetmez dedi!

english: I need to find another ghost, to scare Oziach from the trees on the other side of the path. That would work!
translation: Oziach'i yolun diger tarafindaki agaçlardan korkutmak için baska bir hayalet bulmam lazim. Bu ise yarar!

english: I should talk to Brother Jered about this. Maybe he can help.
translation: Bunu Jered Kardes'le konusmaliyim. Belki o yardimci olabilir.

english: The estate agent should be back soon.
What a wonderful day!
It's quite the step up from my little humble house!
translation: Benim mütevazi evimden çok daha iyi!

english: I am slightly worried about the ghost...
Hello!
What are you doing here?
I'm buying the monastery, so I'm just having a look around.
translation: Manastiri satin alacagim, bu yüzden etrafa bakiniyorum.

english: Did you find anything interesting?
Yes! But there is ONE ghost around. It's a little bit scary but ONE ghost isn't enough to scare me properly.
translation: Evet! Ama etrafta bir hayalet var. Biraz korkutucu ama bir hayalet beni korkutmaya yetmez.

english: Would TWO ghosts be enough to scare you?
translation: Iki hayalet seni korkutmaya yeter mi?

english: I don't know, maybe, depends how scary they are.
translation: Bilmiyorum, belki, ne kadar korkutucu olduklarina bagli.

english: Why are you asking?
I'm just interested in ghosts, they're fascinating!
Hello there!
How are you?
I'm very well thank you. Very excited as I'm about to finish buying the monastery!
