translation: Çok iyiyim, tesekkürler. Manastiri satin almaya çok heyecanliyim!

english: Did the ghosts not scare you off?
No, there was only ONE, so it wasn't that scary.
translation: Hayir, sadece bir tane vardi, o kadar korkutucu degildi.

english: Only ONE ghost? I thought there were loads!
translation: Sadece bir hayalet mi? Bir sürü oldugunu saniyordum!

english: I've only found ONE. If there are more, then I might have to rethink my purchase.
translation: Sadece bir tane buldum. Daha fazlasi varsa, satin almayi yeniden düsünmem gerekebilir.

english: Interesting.
Why is that interesting?
I just thought there were lots of ghosts, but maybe there is only ONE!
translation: Sadece bir sürü hayalet oldugunu saniyordum, ama belki de sadece bir tane vardir!

english: Hi, [player name].
What is going on here?
I'm just admiring the monastery, I'm going to purchase it!
translation: Sadece manastiri hayranlikla seyrediyorum, onu satin alacagim!

english: Are you going to live there?
Yes! I'm going to turn it into a cool house, maybe add a swimming pool.
translation: Evet! Onu havali bir eve dönüstürecegim, belki bir yüzme havuzu da eklerim.

english: I see. What are the monks going to do?
I don't know, find somewhere else to live!
Was that you hiding by the tree earlier?
translation: Az önce agacin arkasinda saklanan sen miydin?

english: Nope, wasn't me! Must have been someone else.
translation: Hayir, ben degildim! Baska biri olmali.

english: They looked a lot like you.
I have quite a familiar face!
I saw you by that tree earlier, what were you doing?
translation: Az önce o agacin yaninda seni gördüm, ne yapiyordun?

english: I don't think that was me!
Why were you sneaking around the trees earlier?
translation: Neden az önce agaçlarin arasinda gizleniyordun?

english: That wasn't me, I've only just got here!
translation: O ben degildim, daha yeni geldim!

english: I'll keep an eye out for them though, they sound suspicious!
translation: Yine de onlari gözetleyecegim, süpheli görünüyorlar!

english: Oziach spotted us! We'll have to try again. Talk to me when you're ready to try again.
translation: Oziach bizi gördü! Tekrar denemeliyiz. Tekrar denemeye hazir oldugunda bana haber ver.

english: Don't be too long though, the saucepan is quite heavy on my head! I'll be here.
translation: Ama çok uzun sürmesin, tencere kafamda oldukça agir! Ben burada olacagim.

english: The player climbs the first tree.
BANG CLANG BANG
Ghosts?! More than ONE?! Stay away from me!
translation: Hayaletler mi?! Birden fazla mi?! Benden uzak durun!

english: Cutscene ends.
Oziach seemed pretty scared after that! Time to go to the next tree along the path.
translation: Oziach bundan sonra oldukça korkmus görünüyordu! Yoldaki bir sonraki agaca gitme zamani.

english: The player climbs the second tree.
BONG DING CLONG
ooOO ooooOOO OOOooo OOOOooo oooOoO oooOOOoo
translation: ooOO ooooOOO OOOooo OOOOooo oooOoO oooOOOoo

english: Ah! How many ghosts are there??
It's working! Scaring Oziach one more time should do it!
translation: Ise yariyor! Oziach'i bir kez daha korkutmak yeterli olmali!

english: The player climbs the third tree.
Help! Somebody help! The ghosts are chasing me!
translation: Yardim edin! Biri yardim etsin! Hayaletler beni kovaliyor!

english: A cutscene starts. The estate agent arrives, and approaches Oziach.
translation: Bir kesit baslar. Emlakçi gelir ve Oziach'a yaklasir.

english: So many ghosts... I need some help!
translation: Çok fazla hayalet var... Yardima ihtiyacim var!

english: Oziach! Are you okay? I heard shouting!
Hello! It's not going well. There are a lot of ghosts here!
translation: Merhaba! Isler yolunda gitmiyor. Burada çok fazla hayalet var!

english: That's not good at all!
Do you still want to go ahead with the purchase?
Of course! TWO ghosts is scary, but not that scary!
translation: Tabii ki! Iki hayalet korkutucu, ama o kadar da degil!

english: I'll hire myself one of those slayers we see everywhere.
translation: Her yerde gördügümüz avcilardan birini tutacagim.

english: They will help with the ghost problem!
Phew, that is lovely news! I thought it was all over, then.
translation: Vay canina, bu harika bir haber! Her seyin bittigini sanmistim.

english: I'll head back to the office, meet me there shortly.
translation: Ofise geri dönecegim, birazdan orada bulusalim.

english: I'll be doing the final paperwork.
We've failed. Oziach still wants to buy the monastery.
translation: Basarisiz olduk. Oziach hala manastiri satin almak istiyor.

english: I thought TWO ghosts would be enough!
Maybe we need more ghosts? A THIRD ghost?
translation: Belki daha fazla hayalet lazimdir? Üçüncü bir hayalet?

english: I guess so. Let's go and place another advert in the Herald.
translation: Sanirim öyle. Gidip Herald'a bir ilan daha verelim.

english: Wait...
A portal opens in front of Oziach, and Death appears before him.
translation: Oziach'in önünde bir portal açilir ve Ölüm onun karsisina çikar.

english: ...what is that??
It is I, Death!
Oh my...
The scariest. The immortal. The terrifying. Me!
translation: En korkunç. Ölümsüz. Dehset verici. Ben!

english: Where are [player name] and Iffie? I must prove my scariness.
translation: Maceraci ve Iffie nerede? Korkunçlugumu kanitlamaliyim.

english: They will regret not picking me!
Death?!
TOO SCARY!
i'm off. You can keep the monastary!
I'm off. You can keep the monastery!
What? I don't want the monastery...?
Oziach walks away from Death.
I don't want to die!
Mummmmmmmyyyy!
What a strange mortal being...
Is it over?
I can't hear anything? It might be?
Is someone in there?
N-n-n-no... go away...
Oh okay, fair enough.
Wait! Come back, we need your help.
translation: Bekle! Geri gel, yardimina ihtiyacimiz var.

english: Jack Frost locked us in here when he stormed into our bakery. We tried to stop him from messing up our production, but he got grumpy.
translation: Jack Frost firinimiza saldirdiginda bizi buraya kilitledi. Üretimimizi bozmasini engellemeye çalistik ama sinirlendi.

english: I ran into one of your bakers outside, he said you were in trouble.
translation: Disarida firincilarinizdan birine rastladim, basinizin dertte oldugunu söyledi.

english: Oh Remy is still alive! We thought Jack fed him to the Icelord.
translation: Oh, Remy hala hayatta! Jack'in onu Buz Lordu'na yem yaptigini saniyorduk.

english: Where's the key? The door looks locked to me.
I thought you had it, Mary.
Well I thought you had it, Paul.
translation: Ben de sende oldugunu saniyordum, Paul.

english: Don't you think I'd have opened the door if I had it?
translation: Eger bende olsaydi kapiyi açmaz miydim sence?

english: Don't you think I would have opened the door as well!
Great, now I'm locked in here with you for the rest of my life.
translation: Harika, simdi hayatimin geri kalanini seninle burada kilitli kalacagim.

english: Woah calm down! If it's not in there, it must be out here. Let me look for it.
translation: Sakin ol! Orada yoksa, burada olmali. Ben bakayim.

english: RAAAAAAAAAAAWR
The Icelord sees you trying to enter their cage and blasts you backwards.
translation: Buz Lordu, kafesine girmeye çalistigini görüyor ve seni geriye dogru firlatiyor.

english: Ooooh that sounds like it hurt!
Are you okay dear? That sounded quite nasty.
translation: Iyi misin canim? Oldukça kötü ses çikardi.

english: Well, I found the key.
That's great, come on let us out then.
translation: Harika, hadi bizi disari çikaralim o zaman.

english: Yes hurry up, we need to get back on schedule.
translation: Evet, acele et, programa yetismemiz lazim.

english: That's going to be a problem, it's in the cage with the Icelord.
translation: Bu sorun olacak, anahtar Buz Lordu'nun kafesinde.

english: I've got no way to get it with the Icelord there.
translation: Buz Lordu oradayken anahtari almamin imkani yok.

english: Did you try telegrabbing it?
I'm stumped, I can't find the key.
You've looked around the bakery and no luck?
If it's not in here or in the back room, it must be in the cage with the Icelord.
translation: Burada ya da arka odada degilse, Icelord'un kafesinde olmali.

english: It wouldn't be safe to go in there.
Could you try telegrabbing it?
That won't work, the Icelord's magic will interfere.
translation: Bu ise yaramaz, Icelord'un büyüsü engel olur.

english: Hmm... You're going to need a way to protect yourself from the Icelord.
translation: Hmm... Icelord'dan kendini korumak için bir yol bulmalisin.

english: Don't suppose you have an Anti-Icelord Shield lying around here then?
translation: Burada Anti-Icelord Kalkani falan yok mu?

english: I don't, do you Paul?
translation: Bende yok, sende var mi Paul?

english: No I don't...
But I do have a genius idea, we'll use Gingerbread!
translation: Ama harika bir fikrim var, Gingerbread'i kullanacagiz!

english: Before Jack locked us up, I saw him using the Icelord to ice his Gingerbread Gnomes. They did a great job of absorbing his breath.
translation: Jack bizi kilitlemeden önce, Icelord'u kullanarak Gingerbread Gnomes'unu dondurdugunu gördüm. Onlar onun nefesini çok iyi emdiler.

english: You'll need to make a Gingerbread Gnome big enough to absorb the Icelord's breath.
translation: Icelord'un nefesini emecek kadar büyük bir Gingerbread Gnome yapmalisin.

english: How am I going to do that?
Our usual recipe uses: one cinnamon, one ginger, one flour and one egg, we put them into that big machine you see to your left.
translation: Her zamanki tarifimizde bir tarçin, bir zencefil, bir un ve bir yumurta kullaniyoruz, bunlari solunda gördügün büyük makineye koyuyoruz.

english: Try using more of each ingredient till you get the right combination? Possibly tripling the amount of each ingredient might work.
translation: Dogru kombinasyonu bulana kadar her malzemeyi daha fazla kullanmayi dene. Her malzemenin miktarini üç katina çikarmak ise yarayabilir.

english: This is such a ridiculous idea, guess I have no choice....
translation: Bu çok saçma bir fikir, sanirim baska seçenegim yok...

english: Come back to us if you need some more help.
translation: Daha fazla yardima ihtiyacin olursa bize gel.

english: What ingredients did I need again?
You'll need ginger, cinnamon, flour and eggs. We usually only use one of each, maybe tripling the amount of each will work.
translation: Zencefil, tarçin, un ve yumurta lazim. Genelde her birinden sadece bir tane kullaniriz, belki her birinin miktarini üç katina çikarmak ise yarayabilir.

english: Great thanks, I'll see what I can do.
So I made the shield, now what?
Fantastic! Now you need to enter the Icelord's cage.
translation: Harika! Simdi Icelord'un kafesine girmen gerekiyor.

english: Don't worry, I'm sure this idea will work, just make sure to equip it before you go in.
translation: Merak etme, bu fikir ise yarayacaktir, içeri girmeden önce kalkani takmayi unutma.

english: I found the key!
That's great! Now hurry up and open the door.
translation: Harika! Simdi acele et ve kapiyi aç.

english: You release the bakers and give back their key...
translation: Firincilari serbest birak ve anahtarlarini geri ver...

english: There you go, unlocked without an issue.
Wow, you managed to do that so quickly! Without any help from us.
translation: Vay canina, bunu çok çabuk basardin! Bizim yardimimiz olmadan.

english: You're very impressive, what a coincidence that you knew to make a giant piece of gingerbread to protect yourself.
translation: Çok etkileyicisin, kendini korumak için dev bir zencefilli kurabiye yapmayi bilmen ne tesadüf.

english: Ha ha, yeah, it was no problem.
Well, thanks for freeing us!
I can't believe that actually worked....
...Me too, I thought you'd be turned into icing for sure.
translation: ... Ben de, kesinlikle sekerleme haline gelecegini düsünmüstüm.

english: So you're telling me you weren't even sure it would!?
translation: Yani bunun ise yarayacagindan emin degildin, öyle mi?

english: It worked out didn't it? We're free to continue making Gingerbread Gnomes.
translation: Ise yaradi, degil mi? Zencefilli kurabiye cüceleri yapmaya devam etmekte özgürüz.

english: That was extremely reckless, Paul, but you're right, it did work out in the end.
translation: Bu çok pervasizcaydi Paul, ama haklisin, sonunda ise yaradi.

english: ...fine. I should go tell Santa the good news, the bakery is back in operation.
translation: ...tamam. Noel Baba'ya iyi haberi vermeliyim, firin yeniden faaliyete geçti.

english: We'll be back in full production in no time!
translation: Kisa sürede tam kapasite üretime geçecegiz!

english: What do we do about the Icelord in the cage?
Maybe Jack was onto something by using it to ice the Gingerbread Gnomes.
translation: Belki Jack, zencefilli kurabiye cüceleri buzlamak için onu kullanarak bir sey kesfetmistir.

english: You should take the giant piece of gingerbread you made and show it to Santa, he'll know we're back in business then.
translation: Yaptigin dev zencefilli kurabiyeyi Noel Baba'ya göstermelisin, o zaman isimize geri döndügümüzü anlar.

english: Alright, time for you to go, we need to get back into production.
translation: Tamam, gitme zamani, üretime geri dönmeliyiz.

english: Go away, we're busy trying to catch up.
Just quickly, Santa said you shouldn't use the Icelord to ice your gnomes.
translation: Kisa bir sey söyleyecegim, Noel Baba Icelord'u cüceleri buzlamak için kullanmamanizi söyledi.

english: Why not?
Something about Icelord saliva not being safe to eat.
translation: Icelord'un salyasinin yenilmesinin güvenli olmadigiyla ilgili bir sey.

english: Oh, thanks for telling us, we'll go back to using normal icing.
translation: Oh, söyledigin için tesekkürler, normal buzlamaya geri dönecegiz.

english: Brother [player name] - welcome to the Realm of Memories.
translation: Kardes Maceraci - Anilar Diyari'na hos geldin.
sub_category: Dialogue for Pious Pete (20th Anniversary event)

english: What did you do before you came here?
sub_category: Dialogue for Pious Pete (20th Anniversary event)

english: I worked in a chapel dedicated to our lord, Saradomin. My task was to light the chapel candles, but I couldn't reach them myself and I kept getting dazzled by the light whenever I tried.
translation: Efendimiz Saradomin'e adanmis bir sapelde çalisiyordum. Görevim sapeldeki mumlari yakmakti, ama kendim ulasamiyordum ve her denedigimde isik gözlerimi kamastiriyordu.
sub_category: Dialogue for Pious Pete (20th Anniversary event)

english: I'd call adventurers from across the world, summoning them to my chapel to do the task for me. I needed them to light the tall candles, but not the short ones.
translation: Dünyanin dört bir yanindan maceracilari çagirip, benim için bu görevi yapmalari için sapele çagiriyordum. Uzun mumlari yakmalarini istiyordum, ama kisa olanlari degil.
sub_category: Dialogue for Pious Pete (20th Anniversary event)

english: However, adventurers got confused, and thought they should light the short candles as well as the tall candles, so I made them try again. And again.
translation: Ancak maceracilar kafalari karismis ve uzun mumlarin yani sira kisa mumlari da yakmalari gerektigini düsünmüslerdi, bu yüzden onlara tekrar denemelerini söyledim. Ve tekrar.
sub_category: Dialogue for Pious Pete (20th Anniversary event)

english: Eventually my chapel was closed down. They said I'd trapped adventurers there for too long. All I wanted was for them to light the tall candles without lighting the short candles!
translation: Sonunda sapelim kapatildi. Maceracilari orada çok uzun süre tuttugumu söylediler. Tek istedigim, kisa mumlari yakmadan uzun mumlari yakmalariydi!
sub_category: Dialogue for Pious Pete (20th Anniversary event)

english: Anyway, now I live here, and remember the good old days. It is nice to meet you, [player name].
translation: Neyse, simdi burada yasiyorum ve eski güzel günleri hatirliyorum. Tanistigimiza memnun oldum, Maceraci.
sub_category: Dialogue for Pious Pete (20th Anniversary event)

english: Goodbye.
sub_category: Dialogue for Pious Pete (20th Anniversary event)

english: So your name is Pete?
sub_category: Dialogue for Pious Pete (20th Anniversary event)

english: Yes, it is a common name. I also know of Party Pete, Parroty Pete, Postie Pete, Pirate Pete, Petrified Pete and 'Picarron' Pete. The Makeover Mage has used the name Pete too.
translation: Evet, yaygin bir isim. Party Pete, Parroty Pete, Postie Pete, Pirate Pete, Petrified Pete ve ‘Picarron’ Pete'yi de taniyorum. Makeover Mage de Pete adini kullanmis.
sub_category: Dialogue for Pious Pete (20th Anniversary event)

english: Although we are not related, the shared bond of that name can be a comfort in dark times.
translation: Akrabaligimiz olmasa da, bu ismin ortak bagi karanlik zamanlarda teselli olabilir.
sub_category: Dialogue for Pious Pete (20th Anniversary event)

english: What did you do before you came here?
sub_category: Dialogue for Pious Pete (20th Anniversary event)
source: Dialogue for Pious Pete (20th Anniversary event)

english: So your name is Pete?
sub_category: Dialogue for Pious Pete (20th Anniversary event)
source: Dialogue for Pious Pete (20th Anniversary event)

english: Goodbye.
sub_category: Dialogue for Pious Pete (20th Anniversary event)
source: Dialogue for Pious Pete (20th Anniversary event)

english: Hello.
Arrr?
What are you doing down here?
You can't have me treasure!
What treasure?
Where's the treasure? Who told ye about me treasure?
translation: Hazine nerede? Kim sana hazinemden bahsetti?

english: I don't know, you said something about treasure.
translation: Bilmiyorum, hazine hakkinda bir seyler söylemistin.

english: Ain't no treasure down 'ere.
So why are you here?
Takin' a walk, gettin' some air.
Riiiiight.
Hello!
Arr? Be ye wantin' te go on account with our gang o' fillibusters?
translation: Arr? Bizim korsan çetesine katilmak mi istiyorsun?

english: The powder monkey be takin' a caulk after gettin' rowdy on bumboo, so there be plenty of room for ye.
translation: Barut maymunu, bumboo'da gürültü yaptiktan sonra bir kaçamak yapiyor, yani senin için bolca yer var.

english: Riiiiight...
I'll just be over here if you need me.
What's a landlubber like ye doin' here?
translation: Senin gibi bir kara adami burada ne ariyor?

english: Helping Cap'n Teach shoot his way through a little blockade.
translation: Kaptan Teach'in küçük bir ablukayi asmasina yardim ediyorum.

english: Well done to ye. I'll see ye around.
Why is this place walled off?
Well [lad/lass], it's 'cos there be foul things in the jungle beyond.
translation: Çünkü ormanin ötesinde kötü seyler var.

english: What sort of foul things?
Big 'uns, nasty 'uns. You name it, we got it.
translation: Büyük, igrenç seyler. Ne ararsan var.

english: There be Jungle Horrors in the jungles, and Cave Horrors in the caves.
translation: Ormanlarda Orman Korkulari, magaralarda Magara Korkulari var.

english: Tis no place te be havin' a picnic and no mistake.
translation: Burasi piknik yapilacak bir yer degil, hiç süphesiz.

english: Watch where yer goin'!
I was!
Then it must have been my fault and I apologise [lad/lass].
translation: O zaman benim hatam olmali, özür dilerim.

english: And I accept your apology. Good day.
translation: Ve özrünü kabul ediyorum. Iyi günler.

english: Aye, good day te ye too.
Arr!
Arr?
Arr?
Arr!
Arr...
Arr.
Good morning!
I suppose it is. What of it?
I was just striking up a conversation.
Well...why would ye do a thing like that?
translation: Peki... neden böyle bir sey yaptin?

english: No reason.
What ship did ye pull in on, stranger?
The Adventurous.
That's a good ship, that it be.
Keep yer voice down [lass/lad], can't ye see I'm busy?
translation: Sesini alçalt, mesgul oldugumu görmüyor musun?

english: First off, it's [lad/lass], and second, other than busy being drunk I can't see what you are talking about.
translation: Sarhos olmak disinda ne demek istedigini anlamiyorum.

english: I can't feel me brains no more...
Wait...I recognise that smell. You've been drinking 'rum' haven't you?
translation: Bekle... Bu kokuyu taniyorum. Rom içtin, degil mi?

english: Arr...ye shufflin' muffle burble...
I think that can be filed as a 'yes'.
Are ye here for...you know...the stuff...
translation: Buraya... bilirsin... o sey için mi geldin?

english: The what?
The stuff...you know...the stuff?
translation: O sey... bilirsin... o sey için mi?

english: I'm not sure I follow you.
Aren't ye Toothless [Kevin/Lisa]?
No.
Sorry, sorry, my mistake!
Ain't ye the scurvy curr that killed my brother?
translation: Sen benim kardesimi öldüren alçak herif degil misin?

english: Well I'm not sure.
I kill so many things on a daily basis that it all tends to blur together.
translation: Her gün o kadar çok sey öldürüyorum ki, hepsi birbirine karisiyor.

english: Tell me, did they have any unusual features that would help me to recall them?
translation: Söylesene, onlari hatirlamama yardimci olacak herhangi bir olagandisi özellikleri var miydi?

english: How many things de ye have te kill in a day te lose count?
translation: Bir günde kaç tane sey öldürüyorsun da sayisini kaybediyorsun?

english: I don't know, if I did I wouldn't have lost count!
Now, about your brother...
Never mind! I never liked him that much anyway!
translation: Bos ver! Zaten onu hiç sevmezdim!

english: It's rather quiet around here for a pirate haven isn't it?
translation: Buralar bir korsan cenneti için oldukça sessiz, degil mi?

english: Arr, we like te keep the peace around here.
Some of the older pirates don't like it, but Mos Le'Harmless be a hive of sense and civility.
translation: Bazi yasli korsanlar bundan hoslanmaz, ama Mos Le'Harmless akil ve medeniyetin merkezi.

english: How nice!
Arr, that it be.
What's yer business?
I was wondering who you are.
Well, I'm one of the militia, we try and keep the rest of the pirates in line.
translation: Ben milislerden biriyim, diger korsanlari hizada tutmaya çalisiyoruz.

english: Well, as in line as we reckon they need to be.
translation: Tabii, bizim gerekli gördügümüz ölçüde hizada.

english: So how do you decide who becomes a member of the militia?
translation: Peki milis üyesi olacaklari nasil belirliyorsunuz?

english: Well, if yer ship is in need of repairs and yer in port, then yer a member, simple as that.
translation: Geminizin onarima ihtiyaci varsa ve limandaysaniz, üye olursunuz, bu kadar basit.

english: See, those of us that are here for a long haul tend to want to keep things peaceful, so we keep an eye on everyone else as and when they come in.
translation: Burada uzun süre kalanlar, ortami huzurlu tutmak isterler, bu yüzden gelen herkesi gözlemleriz.

english: Given the number of skirmishes we have with customs, there is never a shortage of repairs needed.
translation: Gümrükle yasadigimiz çatismalarin sayisi göz önüne alindiginda, onarim ihtiyaci hiç bitmez.

english: Thanks, that was very informative.
Just passing through.
See to it ye keeps outs trouble, stranger.
Just looking about.
Well good luck with that, landlubber.
Adventuring!
Adventurin' eh...that sounds like customs and excise work to my ears.
translation: Macera mi... Kulagima gümrük ve vergi isleri gibi geliyor.

english: No, no, I'm a pirate, honest. I have the book and everything.
translation: Hayir, hayir, ben korsanim, gerçekten. Kitabim ve her seyim var.

english: I'll have me eye on ye, customs [boy/girl]. One step out of line and bam.
translation: Gözüm üzerinde olacak, gümrükcü. Bir adim bile atarsan, bam.

english: They won't find enough of ye to feed a hungry sea slug.
translation: Aç bir deniz salyangozunu besleyecek kadar bile bulamazlar.

english: Just looking around. What is there to do here?
translation: Sadece etrafa bakiniyorum. Burada ne yapabilirim?

english: Well, if yeve got some coins in yer purse ye can head over to Joe's house of 'Rum' and get yerself drunk.
translation: Cüzdaninda biraz para varsa Joe'nun “Rum” evine gidip sarhos olabilirsin.

english: Anything else?
Well, Smithin' Smith and Dodgy Mike have some stuff to sell, and ye can always try grabbin' some fish from Two Feet Charley if yer hungry.
translation: Smithin' Smith ve Dodgy Mike'in satacak bazi esyalari var ve açsan Two Feet Charley'den balik kapabilirsin.

english: Is that it?
Well, ye can head out to the brewery and have a word with Fancy Dan or San Fan. They always need a hand out there.
translation: Bira fabrikasina gidip Fancy Dan veya San Fan ile konusabilirsin. Orada her zaman yardima ihtiyaçlari vardir.

english: Doing what?
Doin' each others heads in most of the time.
What is your business?
Nothing much, just passing through.
translation: Önemli bir sey yok, sadece geçiyordum.

english: Well have a good day, [sir/miss].
I'm sorry, but you don't sound much like a pirate, how did you come to be here?
translation: Üzgünüm ama pek korsan gibi konusmuyorsun, buraya nasil geldin?

english: I used to be a language tutor, teaching in a small school just outside of Lumbridge.
translation: Eskiden dil ögretmeniydim, Lumbridge'in hemen disindaki küçük bir okulda ders veriyordum.

english: However the place closed down due to ill attendance, and so I was forced to take up piracy.
translation: Ancak okul, düsük katilim nedeniyle kapandi ve ben de korsanliga baslamak zorunda kaldim.

english: Wasn't that a bit of a big jump in careers?
translation: Kariyerinde biraz büyük bir siçrama olmadi mi?

english: Not really, I made my way through via a short stint as a lawyer.
translation: Aslinda degil, kisa bir süre avukatlik yaptim.

english: Well, that makes sense.
I must return to my duties. Have a nice day!
You too!
What's yours?
I asked first!
And very rudely too I might add.
translation: Ve çok kaba bir sekilde eklemeliyim.

english: Fine! Go about yer 'business'!
I will!
Whaz yer bushinessssss...ssss?
Are you drunk on duty?
I'm not drunk! I'll knock down any man as sayin' I'm been having a drinking on my duties!
translation: Sarhos degilim! Görev basinda içki içtigimi söyleyen herkesi yere sererim!

english: Well, I think you'll have a hard time explaining your slurred speech, odd behaviour, bitter, nostril dissolving stench and rolling, bloodshot eyes if your not drunk.
translation: Sarhos degilsen, peltek konusmani, tuhaf davranislarini, burnunu tikayan keskin kokunu ve kan çanagina dönmüs gözlerini açiklamakta zorlanacaksin sanirim.

english: Arrr, ye got me. I just can't leave the stuff alone.
Cap'n Braindeath's Ten X With Added Cattle Medication just keeps singin' its siren song to me.
translation: Kaptan Braindeath'in Sigir Ilaci Katilmis Ten X'i bana sürekli siren sarkisi söylüyor.

english: Would ye care fer a drop?
No.  I would most certainly not.
Suit yerself.
None of yours.
Fair enough. Off ye go.
I'm just helping out a friend.
Which friend?
Bill Teach.
Bill hired you eh? He must have been scrapin' the barrel and no mistake.
translation: Bill seni tuttu mu? Kesinlikle çaresiz kalmis olmali.

english: Hey! I resent that!
Hello.
Greetings. May the blessings of Icthlarin rest on your tired shoulders and set you at ease during these strange times.
translation: Selamlar. Icthlarin'in kutsamalari yorgun omuzlarina konsun ve bu garip zamanlarda seni rahatlatsin.

english: Good day, adventurer.
What do you know about the necropolis to the south?
Not too much. It's been abandoned for a long time. In fact, you couldn't even access most of it until fairly recently.
translation: Fazla bir sey bilmiyorum. Uzun zamandir terk edilmis durumda. Aslinda, yakin zamana kadar çoguna erismek bile mümkün degildi.

english: How come?
It was mostly buried under the sand until a storm came in from the south.
translation: Güneyden bir firtina gelene kadar çogu kum altinda gömülüydü.

english: Interesting... Do you know if many people have been there since it was uncovered?
translation: Ilginç... Ortaya çiktigindan beri oraya çok kisi gitti mi?

english: Not as many as you'd think. There's a lot of superstition about the place. People say that even the sand is marked by death.
translation: Düsündügün kadar çok degil. O yerle ilgili birçok batil inanç var. Insanlar kumun bile ölümle isaretlendigini söylüyor.

english: You sound like you don't believe them.
Not really. The sand is probably that colour due to the amount of salt in it. Still, if it keeps people from robbing the dead, that's no bad thing.
translation: Pek sayilmaz. Kumun rengi muhtemelen içindeki tuz miktarindan kaynaklaniyordur. Yine de, bu insanlarin ölüleri soymasini engelliyorsa, fena bir sey degil.

english: I see. Thanks for the information.
Any time, adventurer.
Good day.
Hey, hey, hey! What in the name of sweet suffering Icthlarin are you doing?
translation: Hey, hey, hey! Tatli aci çeken Icthlarin adina ne yapiyorsun sen?

english: I thought this acne potion might clear up your spots.
translation: Bu sivilce ilaci sivilcelerini temizleyebilir diye düsündüm.

english: All that you'll achieve by pouring that potion on me is to ruin my lovely robes.
translation: O ilaci üzerime dökerek tek basaracagin sey, güzel cüppemi mahvetmek olacak.

english: Sorry, I was just trying to help.
What do you know about the necropolis to the south?
Good day.
Hello there.
It's going to take a lot of work to fix the damage done to this city.
translation: Bu sehre verilen zarari düzeltmek çok zaman alacak.

english: Hello there!
How are you doing in there?
Oh I'm great. Lord Jovkai takes good care of us.
translation: Oh, çok iyiyim. Lord Jovkai bize çok iyi bakiyor.

english: So you don't want to escape?
Why would I want to do that? I'm very happy as I am.
translation: Neden kaçmak isteyeyim ki? Ben böyle çok mutluyum.

english: If you say so.
Who's a cute bunny!
-sniff sniff-
Hello there.
No time to talk, another time perhaps.
translation: Konusacak vaktim yok, belki baska bir zaman.

english: Hello fellow bunny, how's it hanging?
Hello friend, no time to talk, the early rabbit gets the carrot as they say.
translation: Merhaba arkadasim, konusacak vaktim yok, erken kalkan tavsan havuç alir derler.

english: Hop along then.
Hey.
The rabbit starts sniffing you.
The rabbit keeps sniffing you.
I'm going to go.
Hi there.
I'm late, I'm late for a very important date.
translation: Geç kaldim, çok önemli bir randevuya geç kaldim.

english: You seem to be having an eggsistential crisis.
You're not funny, it's rabbits like you that give us a bad name.
translation: Komik degilsin, senin gibi tavsanlar bizim adimizi kötüye çikariyor.

english: Hello friend, would you like to hear a joke?
translation: Merhaba dostum, bir fikra dinlemek ister misin?

english: Not really.
What's a rabbit's favoritedance style?
translation: Tavsanlarin en sevdigi dans stili nedir?

english: Hip-Hop!
You hear the distant sound of a drum set going off.
Fellow rabbit...
What are you up to?
I'm just pondering.
About what?
Did the Wise Old Rabbit ever tell you about Duke Harrous the dumb.
translation: Bilge Yasli Tavsan sana aptal Duke Harrous'tan bahsetmis miydi?

english: No, I don't think he did?
Hmph, not a story he would ever tell you, it's a rabbit legend, but perhaps another time.
translation: Hmph, sana asla anlatmayacagi bir hikaye, bu bir tavsan efsanesi, ama belki baska bir zaman.

english: Isn't this wonderful, coming out here and looking out over the sea.
translation: Buraya gelip denizi seyretmek ne kadar harika.

english: I could stay here with you forever...
They look a little pre-occupied.
Hello.
Good day.
Good day, Your Royal Highness.
Oi!
Rahr!
No!
Grr!
Aargh!
I'm a gonner!
It's no use, I'm done for!
Uggh!
Hello!
Hello friend. I wish to slay evil and avail them of their loot! Take me to Burgh de Rott!
translation: Merhaba dostum. Kötülügü yok etmek ve ganimetlerini ele geçirmek istiyorum! Beni Burgh de Rott'a götür!

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
I think so? At least my heart knows courage and that should be sufficient for the meantime. I expect that when we get to Burgh de Rott, we'll be able to purchase suitable provisions.
translation: Sanirim öyle. En azindan kalbim cesaret dolu ve bu simdilik yeterli olmali. Burgh de Rott'a vardigimizda uygun erzak satin alabilecegimizi umuyorum.

english: But you do realise that the vampyres in Morytania are immune to everything except silver?
translation: Ama Morytania'daki vampirlerin gümüs disinda her seye karsi bagisik olduklarini biliyor musun?

english: Er...well, I've not heard mention of that fact, but I have faith that Saradomin will provide the means to furnish me with suitable weapons when I reach Burgh de Rott.
translation: Sey... bunu duymamistim, ama Saradomin'in Burgh de Rott'a vardigimda bana uygun silahlar saglayacagina inaniyorum.

english: And if we happen to run into some vampyres on the journey down there?
translation: Ya oraya giderken yolda vampirlerle karsilasirsak?

english: I trust that you will help us to avoid them. You are a guide after all, aren't you? Anyway, you look like you can handle yourself. I presume you've fought such creatures before and won? How hard can it be?
translation: Onlardan kaçinmamiza yardim edecegine güveniyorum. Sonuçta sen bir rehbersin, degil mi? Her neyse, kendini savunabilecek gibi görünüyorsun. Daha önce bu tür yaratiklarla savasip kazandin mi? Ne kadar zor olabilir ki?

english: It can be pretty difficult, actually. But you're right, I'll be your guide so I should be able to handle the situation.
translation: Aslinda oldukça zor olabilir. Ama haklisin, ben rehberinizim, bu yüzden durumu halledebilmeliyim.

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Neden Burgh de Rott'a gitmek istiyorsun?

english: I'm going down there to teach those vampyres a lesson or two. I've heard about the terrible conditions down there and I intend to put a stop to it.
translation: O vampirlere bir iki ders vermek için oraya gidiyorum. Oradaki korkunç kosullari duydum ve buna bir son vermek niyetindeyim.

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Burgh de Rott'a giderken yol üzerinde düsmanlarla karsilasirsak kendini savunabilir misin?

english: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of enemies. You don't need to worry about that.
translation: Diyelim ki biraz tecrübeliyim ve düsmanlarla savasmaktan çekinmem. Bu konuda endiselenmene gerek yok.

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: Hmmm, görünüse göre bir takipçin var. Kendi basina dolasmaya birakilirsa bu yolculukta kaybolabilir. Takipçin güvende oldugunda yola çikalim.

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: Gerçekten mi? Bu harika olur! Hedefe vardigimizda sana küçük bir ödül verecegim.

english: Burgh de Rott Ramble begins
Ok, which route should we take?
Ok, thanks.
Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: Ah, bana biraz erzak vermek istiyorsun, ha? Sirt çantami açayim.

english: This place is a bit grim. How can people live here?
translation: Burasi biraz kasvetli. Insanlar burada nasil yasayabiliyor?

english: Do you visit Burgh de Rott often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: Burgh de Rott'a sik sik gelir misin? Rotayi iyi biliyorsun gibi görünüyor.

english: When are we going to get to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Burgh de Rott'a ne zaman varacagiz?

english: We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on. I have loot to get.
translation: Bütün gün burada durup sohbet edemeyiz, hadi devam edelim. Yagmalayacak seyler var.

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than the opulet life styles forced on us adventurer types. I'd much rather be up to my eyes in mud and having a good fight!
translation: Oh, bu yolculuktan nefret ediyorum, ama maceraperest tiplere dayatilan lüks yasam tarzindan daha iyidir. Gözlerime kadar çamura batip iyi bir kavga etmeyi tercih ederim!

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...
Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Paterdomus. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: Vay canina! Görünüse göre Paterdomus'a geri dönmek zorunda kalacagiz. O köprüden geçemeyiz!

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
Player completes the bridge event
Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Paterdomus.
translation: Bu is bitti... Görünüse göre bu batakliktan geçemeyecegiz. Paterdomus'a geri dönmek zorundayiz.

english: Player completes the bog event
Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: Hey... bu harika... harika bir is çikardin... Seni takip edecegim.

english: Whahay...that was great!
But we really should be heading off now.
Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
Player completes the river event
That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: Bu harika! Ben de aynisini yapmaliyim.

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: Vay canina! Harikaydi! Ama artik gerçekten yola çikmaliyiz.

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
This is scary!
Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
Ahhh, two tentacles!
...three tentacles!
I think I'm going to faint!
Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: Vay canina! Su canavara bak! O seyi kendi basina halletmen gerekecek!

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the Burgh de Rott. Here's your reward.
translation: Beni Burgh de Rott'a güvenle ulastirdigin için çok tesekkürler. Iste ödülün.

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Neden Burgh de Rott'a gitmek istiyorsun?

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
Ok, thanks.
Good day, traveller.
And to you.
Good to see you, [Fremennik name]!
Hello there. You're a long way from home.
Well what sort of Fremennik are you if you don't travel! Besides, we heard this was the land to visit for breaking skulls and spilling blood!
translation: Seyahat etmeyen bir Fremennik ne ise yarar ki! Ayrica, burasinin kafalari kirip kan dökmek için ziyaret edilmesi gereken bir yer oldugunu duyduk!

english: Of course! Have you not visited the Colosseum? You won't regret it if you do.
translation: Tabii ki! Kolezyum'u ziyaret etmedin mi? Gidersen pisman olmazsin.

english: Hmm... I might have to check it out.
Ha! As if you didn't know! We've heard about your exploits in the Colosseum! Maybe you'll see us next time you're there!
translation: Ha! Sanki bilmiyormussun gibi! Kolezyum'daki kahramanliklarini duyduk! Belki bir dahaki sefere orada görüsürüz!

english: Hello, my friend. Would you like me to show you the prices of logs?
translation: Merhaba dostum. Sana kütüklerin fiyatlarini göstereyim mi?

english: You look like you've travelled a fair distance.
translation: Uzun bir yol kat etmissin gibi görünüyorsun.

english: What gave me away?
I don't mean to be rude, but the clothing and hair, for starters.
translation: Kaba olmak istemem ama öncelikle kiyafetlerin ve saçlarin.

english: Ah, yes. I'm from Shilo Village on Karamja, it's a style I've had since I was little.
translation: Ah, evet. Karamja'daki Shilo Köyü'ndenim, bu tarzi küçüklügümden beri benim.

english: Then tell me, why are you so far from home?
translation: O zaman söyle bana, neden evinden bu kadar uzaktasin?

english: This Grand Exchange! Isn't it marvellous! I've never seen anything like it in my life.
translation: Bu Büyük Borsa! Harika degil mi! Hayatimda böyle bir sey görmedim.

english: My people were saddened when I chose to leave home and travel here, but I hope to make some serious profit, then return to my tribe.
translation: Evimi terk edip buraya gelmeye karar verdigimde halkim üzüldü, ama umarim ciddi bir kâr elde edip kabileme geri dönebilirim.

english: So, what are you selling?
Logs! Of all kinds! That's my plan, at least. Living in the jungle as we do, my people understand exotic wood very well indeed.
translation: Tomruk! Her türden! En azindan planim bu. Bizim gibi ormanda yasayan insanlar egzotik agaçlari çok iyi anlarlar.

english: Okay, show me the prices of logs.
Sorry, I need to be making tracks.
Okay, nice talking to you!
Just one more offer! One more!
translation: Sadece bir teklif daha! Bir tane daha!

english: Such a joy it is to be in this building.
translation: Bu binada olmak ne büyük bir mutluluk.

english: Yes! Yet another great deal.
My people shall be so proud!
Hmmm. These numbers don't quite add up.
translation: Hmmm. Bu rakamlar pek tutarli degil.

english: You look like you've travelled a fair distance.
translation: Uzun bir yol kat etmissin gibi görünüyorsun.

english: Okay, show me the prices of logs.
Sorry, I need to be making tracks.
Hi.

translation: Ben mi? Bu egitim arenasinda kazandigin Pizazz Puanlari için sana ödül vermek için buradayim. Diger Muhafizlar gibi ben de arenanin bir parçasiyim ve arenanin güvenli bir sekilde çalismasini saglamak için yasiyorum.

translation: Bu egitim arenasi hakkinda kapsamli bir rehber içeren, ilginizi çekebilecek özel bir kitabimiz var. Fiyati 200 jeton. Bir tane ister misiniz?

english: Ahoy, young whippersnapper. Have you come to hear a tale from old Ribs?
translation: Selam, genç zipçikti. Yasli Ribs'in hikayesini dinlemeye mi geldin?

english: Could you tell me about Barnacle Barnaby?
translation: Barnacle Barnaby hakkinda bana biraz bilgi verebilir misin?

english: He was a cruel and vicious pirate. Orchestrator of the Driftwood Massacre and unleasher of the Plague of Black Mists. He believed himself untouchable, but his arrogance was his undoing.
translation: O acimasiz ve zalim bir korsandi. Driftwood Katliami'nin mimari ve Kara Sisler Salgini'nin baslangiciydi. Kendini dokunulmaz saniyordu, ama kibiri onun sonunu getirdi.

english: Despite the warnings of many, Barnacle Barnaby attempted to plunder the Skullhorde, but his only reward was a deadly curse. It destroyed the Crimson Kraken, condemning all on board to a watery grave.
translation: Birçok kisinin uyarilarina ragmen Barnacle Barnaby, Skullhorde'u yagmalamaya çalisti, ama tek ödülü ölümcül bir lanetti. Bu lanet, Crimson Kraken'i yok etti ve gemideki herkesi suya gömdü.

english: And you had a map leading to the wreck of the Kraken?
translation: Ve Kraken'in enkazina giden bir haritan mi vardi?

english: Aye! I purchased the map from Ulrich the Unfortunate, the sole survivor of the Kraken, but I had no intention of using it. I knew that no good would ever come from seeking the Kraken.

english: Then why not destroy the map?
translation: O zaman neden haritayi yok etmedin?

english: And risk the wrath of Barnaby's ghost? No. I thought it better the map be locked away, so that neither it nor the curse could harm anyone else, but those young fools put an end to that.
translation: Barnaby'nin hayaleti tarafindan lanetlenme riskini mi göze alacaktim? Hayir. Haritanin kilit altinda tutulmasinin daha iyi olacagini düsündüm, böylece ne harita ne de lanet baska kimseye zarar veremezdi, ama o genç aptallar buna son verdi.

english: Now, we can only hope that someone puts a stop to them before it's too late. Who knows, perhaps it will be you who does so.
translation: Simdi, çok geç olmadan birinin onlari durdurmasini umut etmekten baska çaremiz yok. Kim bilir, belki de bunu yapan sen olursun.

english: Well, on that note, I'd best be getting off. Until next time, Ribs.
translation: Peki, bu durumda, ben gitsem iyi olacak. Bir dahaki sefere görüsürüz, Ribs.

english: I don't think so.
As you wish, but you would be wise to learn from your elders. My tales might one day save you from a one- way trip to see Davey Jones!

english: What games can I play?
Currently we offer Draughts, Runelink, Runesquares, and Runeversi.
translation: Su anda Dama, Runelink, Runesquares ve Runeversi oyunlari sunuyoruz.

english: Draughts?
Draughts uses standard rules, apart from: a draw is declared if no piece has been taken or promoted for forty moves. To play Draughts go to the challenge room in the SW corner.
translation: Dama, asagidaki istisna disinda standart kurallara göre oynanir: Kirk hamle boyunca hiçbir tas alinmaz veya terfi ettirilmezse beraberlik ilan edilir. Dama oynamak için güneybati kösesindeki meydan okuma odasina gidin.

english: Runelink?
Yup, you have to get four runes in row. The challenge room for Runelink is in the SE corner.
translation: Evet, dört runu arka arkaya dizmeniz gerekir. Runelink için meydan okuma odasi güneydogu kösesindedir.

english: Runesquares?
Yes, you take it in turns to add a line with the goal of making squares. Everytime you make a square you take another turn. The challenge room for Runesquares is in the SW corner.
translation: Evet, sirayla kareler olusturmak amaciyla bir çizgi ekliyorsunuz. Her kare olusturdugunuzda bir tur daha oynuyorsunuz. Runesquares için meydan okuma odasi güneybati kösesinde.

english: Runeversi?
Yep, the aim is to have more of your runes on the board than your opponent. You can take your opponents pieces by trapping them between your own. The challenge room for Runeversi is in the SE corner.
translation: Evet, amaç rakibinizden daha fazla runenizi tahtaya yerlestirmek. Rakibinizin taslarini kendi taslarinizla sikistirarak alabilirsiniz. Runeversi için meydan okuma odasi güneydogu kösesinde.

translation: Bir anahtar parçasini ariyorum. Bir zamanlar atan Tristan Corvo'nun elindeydi.

translation: Evet, yok oldu. Babam anahtari bana verirken, ne olursa olsun onu güvende tutmam gerektigini söylemisti. Vampirler Port Phasmatys'e geldiginde, anahtari batakliga gömdüm ki ele geçiremesinler.

translation: Alamazsin. Anahtar kayboldu ve böylesi daha güvenli. Zaten o metal parçasini saklamaktan hiç hoslanmazdim.

translation: Seni iç çekislerine birakayim. Yapacak çok isin var gibi görünüyor.

english: It's a bit grey round here, isn't it?

translation: Bir süre sonra insani moralini bozuyor, biliyorsun. 273 ton gri var, biliyorsun, ve biz hepsine sahibiz.

english: That's grey-t.

translation: Bu espri denemesi beni daha da depresif yapti. Beni rahat birak.

english: How's the King treating you then?
Like serfs.
Serf?
Yes, you know - peons, plebs, the downtrodden. He treats us like his own personal possessions.
translation: Evet, biliyorsun - isçi, pleb, ezilenler. Bizi kendi kisisel mülkiyeti gibi görüyor.

english: You should leave this place.
I keep trying to save up enough to leave, but the King keeps taxing us! We have no money left.
translation: Ayrilmak için para biriktirmeye çalisiyorum ama Kral bize sürekli vergi koyuyor! Hiç paramiz kalmadi.

I'd prefer that, if it meant I didn't have to talk to people as inanely happy as you.

english: Divine capabilities? You mean praying to the gods?
translation: Ilahi yetenekler mi? Tanrilara dua etmek mi demek istiyorsun?

english: Praying? Yes. To the gods? That is open to interpretation.
translation: Dua etmek mi? Evet. Tanrilara mi? Bu yoruma açik.

english: It is?
I do not have the time nor desire to explain the advanced concepts of theology to you, but you should know that the Dwarves of Cam Torum take a different approach to worship than your kind.
translation: Size teolojinin ileri kavramlarini açiklamak için ne zamanim ne de istegim var, ama Cam Torum Cüceleri'nin ibadet konusunda sizin türünüzden farkli bir yaklasimi oldugunu bilmelisiniz.

english: Anyway, the point is that without experienced seers to aid you, you may find yourself unable to utilise your prayers as you normally would.
translation: Her neyse, önemli olan nokta, deneyimli kahinlerin yardimi olmadan, dualarinizi normalde yaptiginiz gibi kullanamayabileceginizdir.

english: I suppose so.
With us, it was just a misunderstanding. With somebody else, you might have been pushing a boundary.

translation: Neyse ki kertenkele adamlar baska yerlere odaklanmis durumda. Henüz buraya gelmeye çalismadilar.

translation: Kesfedilecek yepyeni bir kita... Ne harika bir zaman!

english: Are you the tour guide?
Nope, I'm just as lost as you.
translation: Hayir, ben de sizin kadar kayboldum.

english: I overheard someone mention there are pirates and thieves here, be careful!
translation: Burada korsanlar ve hirsizlar oldugunu duydum, dikkatli olun!

english: Krrrrsssss
Krrrrsssss
Hello.
Good day.
Hey! Get your hands off there!
Hello.
Good day.
Good day, Your Royal Highness.
Hey! Get your hands off there!
Oi!
Rahr!
No!
Grr!
Aargh!
I'm a gonner!
It's no use, I'm done for!
Uggh!
Hello.
Eating me... they keep eating me! Eating me from the inside! Please stop them! I can feel them wriggling around inside me right now... please stop them!
translation: Beni yiyorlar... Beni yemeye devam ediyorlar! Beni içimden yiyorlar! Lütfen onlari durdurun! Su anda içimde kivrildiklarini hissedebiliyorum... Lütfen onlari durdurun!

english: Hi.
Blood, blood... never enough blood to go round. When I lift up my arm like this, it all pours back into my body.
translation: Kan, kan... Asla yeterli kan yok. Kolumu böyle kaldirdigimda, hepsi vücuduma geri akiyor.

english: I hope it remembers to go back inside my arm. And don't even ask me about my legs... how much blood are they going to need?
translation: Umarim koluma geri dönmeyi unutmaz. Bacaklarimdan bahsetmeyin bile... Ne kadar kana ihtiyaçlari olacak?

english: Blood is important. We must offer it to Zamorak every day as proof of our devotion. I just hope I don't run out!
translation: Kan önemlidir. Zamorak'a bagliligimizin kaniti olarak her gün ona kan sunmaliyiz. Umarim kanim bitmez!

english: Hello, are you okay?
Oh yes, you're a fine one. Nice red cheeks, shiny hair.
translation: Oh evet, sen çok güzelsin. Güzel kirmizi yanaklar, parlak saçlar.

english: Let's see now, some potatoes, some cabbage... Maybe half a clove of garlic...
translation: Bir bakalim, biraz patates, biraz lahana... Belki yarim dis sarimsak...

english: Yes I think you'd make a fine soup. You don't mind do you?
translation: Evet, bence güzel bir çorba olursun. Sakincasi yok, degil mi?

english: Actually I do.
You're welcome to have some with me of course...
Hello there.
Mwaarrr fnnntchh. Gbpp dng sktd delp?
translation: Mwaarrr fnnntchh. Gbpp dng sktd delp?

english: Pardon?
Kjp lar falut: Gbpp dng sktd delp?
translation: Kjp lar falut: Gbpp dng sktd delp?

english: Sorry, I don't under..
Mwaarrr fnnntchh. Gbpp dng sktd delp? GBPP DNG SKTD DELP!
translation: Mwaarrr fnnntchh. Gbpp dng sktd delp? GBPP DNG SKTD DELP!

english: Hello...
Kill the villagers, burn them all... every last one! I want nothing to survive... nothing but the sweet smell of burning flesh...
translation: Köylüleri öldürün, hepsini yakin... sonuncusuna kadar! Hiçbir seyin hayatta kalmasini istemiyorum... sadece yanan etin tatli kokusu disinda...

english: You're ill!
What's that? You've never smelt it before? Well, let's just say that it's an acquired taste...
translation: Ne? Daha önce hiç koklamadin mi? Sey, diyelim ki bu aliskanlik gerektiren bir tat...

english: Danger, everywhere danger! But not from man nor beast! This is the danger that is inside you.
translation: Tehlike, her yerde tehlike! Ama ne insandan ne de hayvandan! Bu tehlike senin içinde.

english: Bring it out, nurture it, cherish it. Stroke it like you would stroke a wounded bird... then strangle it before it takes hold of your very being. Don't say I didn't warn you.
translation: Onu ortaya çikar, besle, deger ver. Yarali bir kusu oksar gibi oksa... sonra senin varligini ele geçirmeden onu bog. Beni uyarmadin deme.

english: What's that... Is that a dagger I see before me? Why should I bear the slings and arrows of outrageous fortune.
translation: O ne... Önümde bir hançer mi görüyorum? Neden bu çirkin kaderin oklarini ve taslarini çekeyim ki?

english: For what is a man but this quintessence of dust? And so I say goodnight sweet prince. The rest is silence.
translation: Insan, tozun özünden baska nedir ki? Ve ben de iyi geceler tatli prens diyorum. Gerisi sessizlik.

english: Hello there. What are you doing here?
I'm waiting here hoping that someone can guide me to the Paterdomus, the temple on the Salve.
translation: Biri beni Salve'deki Paterdomus tapinagina götürür umuduyla burada bekliyorum.

english: Where is Paterdomus?
Oh, Paterdomus is that rather impressive looking temple on the Salve... I'm sure you must have passed it on your way into Morytania.
translation: Paterdomus, Salve'deki oldukça etkileyici görünümlü tapinak... Morytania'ya giderken oradan geçmis olmalisin.

english: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
I'm hoping to get back to civilisation and see what the lands of Misthalin look like.
translation: Medeniyete geri dönüp Misthalin topraklarinin nasil bir yer oldugunu görmek istiyorum.

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Paterdomus?
translation: Paterdomus'a giderken yol üzerinde düsmanlarla karsilasirsak kendini savunabilir misin?

english: What sort of guide are you? I'm pretty healthy, but you'll have to protect me else I'll be sure to die... Oh, I do hope you can manage that.
translation: Ne tür bir rehbersin sen? Ben oldukça saglikliyim, ama beni korumak zorundasin, yoksa kesinlikle ölecegim... Oh, umarim bunu basarabilirsin.

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: Hmmm, görünüse göre bir takipçin var. Kendi basina dolasirsa bu yolculukta kaybolabilir. Takipçin güvende oldugunda yola çikalim.

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: Gerçekten mi? Bu harika olur! Hedefe vardigimizda sana küçük bir ödül verecegim.

english: Ok, which route should we take?
Ok, thanks.
Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: Ah, bana biraz erzak vermek istiyorsun, ha? Sirt çantami açayim.

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than staying in Burgh de Rott.
translation: Oh, bu yolculuktan nefret ediyorum, ama Burgh de Rott'ta kalmaktan iyidir.

english: It's scary here...let's get going!
When are we going to get to Paterdomus?
We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on.
translation: Bütün gün burada durup sohbet edecek vaktimiz yok; hadi devam edelim.

english: Do you visit Paterdomus often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: Paterdomus'u sik sik ziyaret eder misin? Rotayi iyi biliyorsun galiba.

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...?
Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Burgh de Rott. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: Hay aksi! Burgh de Rott'a geri dönmek zorunda kalacagiz galiba. O köprüyü geçemeyiz!

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
Player completes the bridge event
Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Burgh de Rott.
translation: Bu is bitti... Görünüse göre bu batakligi geçemeyecegiz. Burgh de Rott'a geri dönmek zorundayiz.

english: Player completes the bog event
Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: Hey... bu harika... harika bir is çikardin... Seni takip edecegim.

english: Whahay...that was great!
But we really should be heading off now.
Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
Player completes the river event
That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: Bu harika! Ben de aynisini yapmaliyim.

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: Vay canina! Harikaydi! Ama artik gerçekten yola çikmaliyiz.

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
This is scary!
Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
Ahhh, two tentacles!
...three tentacles!
I think I'm going to faint!
Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: Vay canina! Su canavara bak! O seyi kendi basina halletmen gerekecek!

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the temple. Here's your reward.
translation: Beni tapinaga güvenle ulastirdigin için çok tesekkürler. Iste ödülün.

english: Smiddi Ryak gives you a reward token!
translation: Smiddi Ryak sana bir ödül jetonu veriyor!

english: Where is Paterdomus?
Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
I can take you to Paterdomus.
Ok, thanks.
Hi!
Mihi ignosce. Cum homine de cane debeo congredi.
translation: Mihi ignosce. Cum homine de cane debeo congredi.

english: Errare humanum est.
Die dulci freure.
Carpe Diem!
Te audire non possum. Musa sapientum fixa est in aure.
translation: Te audire non possum. Musa sapientum fixa est in aure.

english: Furnulum pani nolo.
Fac ut gaudeam.
Utinam barbari spatium proprium tuum invadant!
translation: Utinam barbari spatium proprium tuum invadant!

english: Quantum materiae materietur marmota monax si marmota monax materiam possit materiari?
translation: Quantum materiae materietur marmota monax si marmota monax materiam possit materiari?

english: Sona si Latine loqueris.
Raptus Regaliter
Nemo dat quod non habet.
Ne auderis delere orbem rigidum meum!
translation: Ne auderis delere orbem rigidum meum!

english: Da mihi sis bubulae frustum assae, solana tuberosa in modo gallico fricta, ac quassum lactatum coagulatum crassum.
translation: Da mihi sis bubulae frustum assae, solana tuberosa in modo gallico fricta, ac quassum lactatum coagulatum crassum.

english: Cogito ergo sum.
Vacca foeda.
Di! Ecce hora! Uxor mea me necabit!
translation: Di! Ecce hora! Uxor mea me necabit!

english: Latine loqui coactus sum.
Cave ne ante ullas catapultas ambules.
translation: Cave ne ante ullas catapultas ambules.

english: Fac ut vivas!
Noli me vocare, ego te vocabo.
translation: Noli me vocare, ego te vocabo.

english: Meliora cogito.
Braccae tuae aperiuntur.
Vescere bracis meis.
Corripe cervisiam!
What?!
Huh?!
Er...
OK...
Are you insulting me in Latin?
Yes!
Hmm...
Hello.
Hello.
What are you doing here?
I've been posted here to guard this chasm.
translation: Bu uçurumu korumak için buraya atandim.

english: And how's that going?
Not great. There's constant bursts of hot air, demon roars and strange lights coming from inside.
translation: Pek iyi degil. Içeriden sürekli sicak hava patlamalari, iblis kükremeleri ve garip isiklar geliyor.

english: And then there's the cultists. They just climb out like it's normal to be down there. Try to talk to you like it's business as usual.
translation: Bir de tarikatçilar var. Sanki orada olmak normalmis gibi tirmaniyorlar. Sanki her sey normalmis gibi seninle konusmaya çalisiyorlar.

english: That does sound stressful.
How long are you posted here?
translation: Ne kadar süre burada görevli kalacaksin?

english: Indefinitely. We don't know what the cult is up to and we don't want to be caught unprepared.
translation: Sonsuza kadar. Kültün neyin pesinde oldugunu bilmiyoruz ve hazirliksiz yakalanmak istemiyoruz.

english: Have you considered quitting?
No. I signed up to to protect Kourend, even if that means standing outside of a demon nest. Besides, it's not like any demons have come out of it yet.
translation: Hayir. Kourend'i korumak için bu göreve yazildim, bu seytan yuvasinin disinda beklemek anlamina gelse bile. Ayrica, henüz hiçbir seytan disari çikmadi.

english: Well, good luck.
Thanks.
What do you want? Are you with those cultists?
translation: Ne istiyorsun? O tarikatçilarla mi birliktesin?

english: What? No.
Good. I've had enough of their games.
Games? What do you mean?
They start off polite, but before you know it, they're trying to get you to agree to something.
translation: Baslangiçta kibar davraniyorlar, ama farkina varmadan seni bir seye ikna etmeye çalisiyorlar.

english: They're not fooling me though. The next one that crosses me is going to regret it!
translation: Ama beni kandiramazlar. Bir daha karsima çikan pisman olacak!

english: About the cultists... What sort of things do they ask you to agree to?
translation: Kültçüler hakkinda... Ne tür seyler kabul etmeni istiyorlar?

english: Usually they want you to follow them somewhere private. Some of the bolder ones try to get you to join them inside the chasm.
translation: Genellikle seni özel bir yere götürmek istiyorlar. Bazilari daha cesur olanlar, seni uçurumun içine katilmaya ikna etmeye çalisiyor.

english: If it were up to me, we'd launch a sortie right now. See how they like it if we come down on our own terms.
translation: Bana kalsaydi, hemen bir saldiri baslatirdim. Kendi sartlarimizla saldirirsak nasil tepki vereceklerini görürdük.

english: Aren't you worried about the demons?
You sound like the lieutenant.
You sound eager to fight.
I am. If you ask me we should be out fighting lizardmen. That means we need to go on the offensive and wrap this chasm business up.
translation: Öyleyim. Bana sorarsan, kertenkele adamlarla savasmaliyiz. Bu da saldiriya geçip bu uçurum meselesini halletmemiz gerektigi anlamina geliyor.

english: I take it the rest of your squad aren't as keen.
translation: Anladigim kadariyla takiminin geri kalani senin kadar hevesli degil.

english: You'd be right. The lieutenant is too cautious and the rest are too timid. The way some of them speak you'd think they had demon families.
translation: Haklisin. Tegmen çok temkinli, geri kalanlar ise çok korkak. Bazilarinin konusma tarzina bakilirsa, seytan aileleri varmis gibi sanirsin.

english: Goodbye.
If you see any cultists lurking around, let me know.
translation: Etrafta dolasan herhangi bir tarikat üyesi görürsen, bana haber ver.

english: You look comfortable.
I might as well be if we're going to continue this performance.
translation: Bu gösteriye devam edecekseniz, ben de rahat olabilirim.

english: What do you mean?
There are no demons coming out of this chasm. If there were, we wouldn't last long.
translation: Bu uçurumdan seytanlar çikmiyor. Çikarsa, uzun süre dayanamayiz.

english: You think the demons would overrun you?
translation: Seytanlarin seni ele geçirecegini mi düsünüyorsun?

english: Demons don't die the same way we do. We could hold back a few of them, but not an endless stream.
translation: Seytanlar bizim gibi ölmezler. Birkaçini durdurabiliriz, ama sonsuz bir akini degil.

english: You seem to know a lot about them.
translation: Onlar hakkinda çok sey biliyorsun galiba.

english: I do, which means I know that guarding the chasm is a pointless endeavour. Not that the lieutenant cares what I think.
translation: Evet, bu yüzden bu uçurumu korumak anlamsiz bir çaba oldugunu biliyorum. Tegmen benim düsüncelerimi umursamiyor ama.

english: Launching an attack into the chasm would also be pointless. That leaves us with only one other option.
translation: Uçuruma saldirmak da anlamsiz olur. Bu durumda tek bir seçenek kaliyor.

english: Fleeing?
No. We should talk to them. Try to reach an understanding.
translation: Hayir. Onlarla konusmaliyiz. Anlasmaya varmaya çalismaliyiz.

english: Somehow I don't think negotiating with demons will end well.
translation: Nedense seytanlarla pazarlik yapmanin iyi sonuçlanacagini sanmiyorum.

english: If you have a better idea, go ahead.
translation: Daha iyi bir fikrin varsa, söyle bakalim.

english: Aren't you a bit too calm about this?
translation: Bu konuda biraz fazla sakin degil misin?

english: No. If they wanted to, Yama and his demons could overrun this little squad.
translation: Hayir. Eger isteselerdi, Yama ve seytanlari bu küçük ekibi yok edebilirdi.

english: The fact they haven't means they're probably not interested in doing so. As a matter of fact, they seem quite polite.
translation: Bunu yapmadiklari gerçegi, muhtemelen bunu yapmakla ilgilenmedikleri anlamina geliyor. Aslinda, oldukça kibar görünüyorlar.

english: You've spoken to them?
I didn't say that, But there's evidence to suggest that Yama and his cult can be reasoned with.
translation: Öyle demedim, ama Yama ve tarikatinin mantikli davranabilecegine dair kanitlar var.

english: If Lord Shayzien is interested in diffusing the threat, he should consider trying to reach an agreement with them.
translation: Lord Shayzien tehdidi ortadan kaldirmak istiyorsa, onlarla bir anlasmaya varmayi düsünmelidir.

english: I've met Lord Shayzien. He doesn't seem like the type to compromise.
translation: Lord Shayzien ile tanistim. Uzlasma türünden biri gibi görünmüyor.

english: You've met Lord Shiro Shayzien?
translation: Lord Shiro Shayzien ile tanistin mi?

english: Yes, I've met the leaders of all of the houses. Even King Artur Hosidius himself.
translation: Evet, tüm hanelerin liderleriyle tanistim. Hatta Kral Artur Hosidius'un kendisiyle de.

english: Interesting. You're quite the worldly fellow. Perhaps King Hosidius would make a more level headed negotiator. Maybe you could talk to him?
translation: Ilginç. Oldukça dünyevi bir adamsin. Belki Kral Hosidius daha mantikli bir müzakereci olabilir. Onunla konusabilir misin?

english: I imagine he's quite busy at the moment.
translation: Su anda oldukça mesgul oldugunu tahmin ediyorum....

english: How long are you posted here?
translation: Ne kadar süre burada görevli kalacaksin?

english: Have you considered quitting?
Well, good luck.
About the cultists...
You sound eager to fight.
Goodbye.
You think the demons would overrun you?
translation: Seytanlarin seni ele geçirecegini mi düsünüyorsun?

english: Aren't you a bit too calm about this?
translation: Bu konuda biraz fazla sakin degil misin?

english: Are you here to fight the lizardmen? Be careful - they're fierce!
translation: Burada kertenkele adamlarla savasmak için mi bulunuyorsun? Dikkatli ol, onlar çok vahsidir!

english: Tell me about the lizardmen.
The lizardmen are the bane of Kourend. I'm not much for history, but the Shayzien Army have been fighting them off for as long as anyone can remember.
translation: Kertenkele adamlar Kourend'in bas belasidir. Tarih konusunda pek bilgili degilim, ama Shayzien Ordusu, hatirlanabildigi kadariyla onlarla savasmaktadir.

english: They can be aggressive, and they've got something nasty in their bite that can make you pretty ill.
translation: Saldirgan olabilirler ve isiriklari çok kötü, seni çok hasta edebilirler.

english: Why are you up here instead of fighting?
I got a bite from a lizardman. I'm all cured, but I'm not going down there again until I feel stronger, otherwise I'll be no use in the fight.
translation: Bir kertenkele adam tarafindan isirildim. Iyilestim ama daha güçlü hissedene kadar oraya gitmeyecegim, yoksa savasta bir faydam olmaz.

english: Do you know how many I've killed already?
translation: Simdiye kadar kaç tanesini öldürdügümü biliyor musun?

english: The Shayzien records say you've killed [COUNT] lizardmen since they began tracking your kills. [COUNT] were lizardman shamans.
Thanks for the warning.
I see no adventurers in the canyon to the east.
I see no adventurers in the canyon to the west.
Tell me about the lizardmen.
Why are you up here instead of fighting?
Do you know how many I've killed already?
translation: Simdiye kadar kaç kisiyi öldürdügümü biliyor musun?

english: Thanks for the warning.
Hello, are you interested in our agility training courses?
translation: Merhaba, çeviklik egitim kurslarimizla ilgilenir misin?

english: Yes, is it difficult?
Nothing is difficult for a Shayzien soldier. If you do the training every day, you can be as good as us.
translation: Shayzien askerleri için hiçbir sey zor degildir. Her gün antrenman yaparsan bizim kadar iyi olabilirsin.

english: No thanks.
Fair enough. Feel free to give it a go if you change your mind.
Hi, I've seen your moves on the agility course, well done!
translation: Merhaba, çeviklik kursundaki hareketlerini gördüm, aferin!

english: Do you want to know more about how you've been doing?
translation: Performansin hakkinda daha fazla bilgi almak ister misin?

english: Yes please.
You've not completed any laps of our basic agility course yet. There's been [number] completions and the global best time is [time].
You've completed 1 lap of our basic agility course with a lap time of [time]. There's been [number] global completions and the global best time is [time].
You've completed [number] laps of our basic agility course with a best time of [time]. There's been [number] global completions and the global best time is [time].
You've not completed any laps of our advanced agility course yet. There's been [number] completions and the global best time is [time].
You've completed 1 lap of our advanced agility course with a lap time of [time]. There's been [number] global completions and the global best time is [time].
You've completed [number] laps of our advanced course with a best time of [time]. There's been [number] global completions and the global best time is [time].
Yes, is it difficult?
No thanks.
Yes please.
Shayzien Basic Course.
Shayzien Advanced Course:
Not often you see a couple of soldiers out for a drink.
translation: Askerlerin içki içmek için disari çiktigini pek sik görmezsiniz.
sub_category: Dialogue for Soldier (The Cloak and Stagger)

english: We've just finished our first duties in the Lizardman Canyon. A few drinks at the Cloak and Stagger to celebrate is always traditional.
translation: Lizardman Kanyonu'ndaki ilk görevimizi yeni bitirdik. Cloak and Stagger'da kutlama için birkaç içki içmek her zaman gelenekseldir.
sub_category: Dialogue for Soldier (The Cloak and Stagger)

english: Sounds like you earned it. Enjoy!
translation: Hak etmissiniz gibi görünüyor. Keyfini çikarin!
sub_category: Dialogue for Soldier (The Cloak and Stagger)

english: Don't expect me to deal with the likes of you.
You do not have enough Shayzien favour. Current favour: [current favour in %] - Required: 60.0%
If you're planning on fighting me for a set of my armour, I'm afraid I'm not interested. The combat XP from fighting you isn't worthwhile. Get a Defence level of 20 first.
translation: Eger benim zirhimi almak için benimle savasmayi planliyorsan, korkarim ki ilgilenmiyorum. Seninle savasarak kazanacagim savas XP'si buna degmez. Önce savunma seviyen 20'ye ulas.

english: Hello. Do you fancy a fight? It's just a bit of fun, so I can practice melee combat. I'll give you a piece of my armour if you win.
translation: Merhaba. Savasmak ister misin? Sadece eglence amaçli, yakin dövüs pratigi yapmak için. Kazanirsan sana zirhimin bir parçasini veririm.

english: Okay, I reckon I can take you. Did you just say you wanted to practice melee combat in particular?
translation: Tamam, sanirim seni yenebilirim. Özellikle yakin dövüs pratigi yapmak istedigini mi söyledin?

english: Yes, I'm not interested in fancy magicks. We leave that namby-pamby stuff to the Arceuus weirdos. And no ranging either. We'll fight just with melee.
translation: Evet, süslü büyülerle ilgilenmiyorum. O zayif seyleri Arceuus'un tuhaflarina birakalim. Menzilli saldirilar da yok. Sadece yakin dövüs yapacagiz.

english: Remember, if you lose, you'll probably drop some items, and you probably won't get them back again. Just run away if you want to stop the fight.
translation: Unutma, kaybedersen muhtemelen bazi esyalarini düsüreceksin ve muhtemelen onlari geri alamayacaksin. Savasi durdurmak istiyorsan kaç.

english: I understand. Let's fight.
To the arena!
Let's forget about fighting for now.
In that case you probably shouldn't be hanging around an army camp.
translation: O zaman muhtemelen bir ordu kampinda dolasmamalisin.

english: No thanks.

english: Hello there.
Uh... What are you doing?
Oh sorry, I was somewhere else entirely!
translation: Oh, pardon, tamamen baska bir yerdeydim!

english: I'm just watching the debris wash up at the shore here.
It's sort of mesmerising...
Does anything useful wash up?
Oh, yes! All sorts of things get washed up by the storms. Aside from the usual materials, I've seen some interesting trinkets including odd looking books and fish preservation barrels.
translation: Oh, evet! Firtinalar her türlü seyi kiyiya vuruyor. Her zamanki malzemelerin yani sira, tuhaf görünümlü kitaplar ve balik saklama varilleri gibi ilginç esyalar da gördüm.

english: If you help in the fight against Tempoross, the Captain's said you can help yourself to anything that washes up.
translation: Tempoross'la savasta yardim edersen, Kaptan kiyiya vuran her seyi alabilecegini söyledi.

english: I'll keep an eye out, thank you!
Any time...
His voice trails off as he stares back out to sea.
translation: Denize dogru bakarken sesi giderek azalir.

english: Do you have a spare fishing net I could have?
translation: Bana verebileceginiz yedek bir balik agi var mi?...

english: Without turning his head, the man holds up a fishing net.
translation: Basini çevirmeden, adam bir balik agi uzatir.

english: Thanks...
Without turning his head, the man shakes his finger at you. Maybe because you already have a net.
translation: Basini çevirmeden, adam parmagini sana dogru sallar. Belki de zaten bir agin oldugu içindir.

english: Goodbye.
A net may be of use to you. Speak to me if you need one.
translation: Ag isine yarayabilir. Ihtiyacin olursa bana söyle.

english: Goodbye.

translation: Agaci döndürmek için insaat modunda olmalisin.

english: The player digs.
What are you doing?
Err... I thought I'd turn you around a bit.
Turn... Turn me around? Are you uprooting me?!
translation: Döndürmek... Beni döndürmek mi? Beni kökünden söküyor musun?!

english: Err... Yes, well, I need to in order to-
What reason could you possibly have to rotate me?!
translation: Beni döndürmek için ne gibi bir nedenin olabilir ki?!

english: I thought you might look nicer facing the other way.
translation: Diger tarafa dönersen daha güzel görünürsün diye düsündüm.

english: Look... Nicer?! I'm a living being!
translation: Daha güzel mi?! Ben canli bir varligim!

english: Argh! My connection to the Anima Mundi! The pain!
translation: Ah! Anima Mundi ile olan bagim! Aci!

english: This is unconscionable! I am not an object! I am a sentient creature with hopes and dreams!
translation: Bu vicdansizlik! Ben bir nesne degilim! Ben umutlari ve hayalleri olan, duygulari olan bir varligim!

english: All done. See, that wasn't so bad.
translation: Bitti. Gördün mü, o kadar da kötü degildi.

english: The pain... I can feel parts of me fading away... oh Guthix...
translation: Aci... Bir parçalarimin kayboldugunu hissediyorum... oh Guthix...

english: Oh please no... Not again...
