Greetings, brave knight!
Hello. What's through that door?
translation: Merhaba. O kapinin arkasinda ne var?

english: That door leads to the training ground for the Knights of the Round Table.
translation: O kapi Yuvarlak Masa Sövalyeleri'nin egitim alanina açiliyor.

english: Can I go in there?
Of course, my lord. But I must tell you the rules first. Would you like to hear them now?
translation: Elbette, efendim. Ama önce kurallari anlatmam gerekiyor. Simdi dinlemek ister misiniz?

english: Yes please.
The training ground is a melee combat area only. Merlin has cast a spell over the grounds to prevent anyone using Prayer, Ranged or Magic.
translation: Egitim alani sadece yakin dövüs için kullanilabilir. Merlin, bu alanda Dua, Menzilli veya Büyü kullanilamamasi için bir büyü yapmistir.

english: Upon entering the grounds, you will fight each of the Round Table Knights in turn. Each knight is more skilled than the last, but all have different attack styles that can be exploited. There are eight knights in all, and
translation: Alana girdiginizde, Yuvarlak Masa Sövalyeleri ile sirayla dövüseceksiniz. Her sövalye bir öncekinden daha yeteneklidir, ancak hepsinin farkli saldiri stilleri vardir ve bunlari kullanabilirsiniz. Toplamda sekiz sövalye vardir ve

english: each will do damage not only to your hitpoints, but also your combat stats. If you should die in the grounds, Merlin will teleport you back here. You will not lose any of your items.
translation: her biri sadece can puaniniza degil, savas istatistiklerinize de zarar verecektir. Alanda ölürseniz, Merlin sizi buraya geri isinlayacaktir. Esyalarinizi kaybetmeyeceksiniz.

english: If you feel you cannot complete the battle, you may exit the training grounds. However, if you exit or die, you will have to start over with the first knight the next time you enter.
translation: Savasi tamamlayamayacaginizi düsünüyorsaniz, egitim alanindan çikabilirsiniz. Ancak, çikarsaniz veya ölürseniz, bir dahaki sefere girdiginizde ilk sövalyeyle bastan baslamaniz gerekecektir.

english: If you are a great warrior and defeat Sir Lancelot, mightiest of all knights, you will receive great rewards. Two new prayers will become available to you and your respawn point will be set to Camelot, as well as 20,000
translation: Eger büyük bir savasçiysaniz ve tüm sövalyelerin en güçlüsü olan Sir Lancelot'u yenerseniz, büyük ödüller alacaksiniz. Iki yeni dua kullanabileceksiniz ve yeniden dogma noktaniz Camelot olarak ayarlanacak, ayrica her bir savas istatistiginize 20.000

english: XP in to each of your combat stats.
If you do not want your respawn set to Camelot, Merlin can change it for you.
translation: Yeniden dogma noktanizin Camelot olarak ayarlanmasini istemiyorsaniz, Merlin bunu sizin için degistirebilir.

english: Would you like me to repeat any of that for you?
Tell me about the training ground.
Only melee combat is allowed within the training grounds. Merlin will prevent the use of Prayer, Ranged and Magic.
translation: Egitim alaninda sadece yakin dövüse izin verilir. Merlin, Dua, Menzilli ve Büyü kullanimini engelleyecektir.

english: Why?
These grounds are for only the best knights of the land. It is not just testing your combat ability, but your honour and your chivalry. You must face your enemy head on, honourably and bravely.
translation: Bu alanlar, ülkedeki en iyi sövalyeler için ayrilmistir. Burada sadece savas yetenekleriniz degil, onurunuz ve sövalyelik ruhunuz da sinanir. Düsmaninizla yüz yüze, onurlu ve cesurca karsi karsiya gelmelisiniz.

english: Be watchful of your stats, as the Knights can do damage to your combat stats as well as your hitpoints.
translation: Istatistiklerinize dikkat edin, çünkü sövalyeler savas istatistiklerinize ve can puanlariniza zarar verebilirler.

english: Tell me about dying or leaving the grounds.
translation: Ölmek veya bu alani terk etmek hakkinda bilgi verin.

english: As these are only training grounds, we keep our knights safe. If you should die, you will be teleported back to here and all of your items will be safe.
translation: Burasi sadece bir egitim alani oldugu için sövalyelerimizin güvenligini sagliyoruz. Ölürseniz, buraya geri isinlanacaksiniz ve tüm esyalariniz güvende olacak.

english: However, leaving the training grounds, in anyway, will mean you will have to start from the beginning the next time you enter. These grounds do not favour cowards.
translation: Ancak, egitim alanini herhangi bir sekilde terk ederseniz, bir dahaki sefere girdiginizde bastan baslamaniz gerekecek. Bu alan korkaklara uygun degildir.

english: I have to start again? What do you mean?
translation: Yeniden baslamak zorunda miyim? Ne demek istiyorsunuz?

english: You fight each knight of the Round Table, starting with Sir Bedivere and finishing with Sir Lancelot. Leaving means you will have to begin fighting Sir Bedivere again and work your way back up.
translation: Yuvarlak Masa Sövalyeleri'nin her biriyle savasirsiniz, Sir Bedivere ile baslayip Sir Lancelot ile bitirirsiniz. Ayrilmak, Sir Bedivere ile yeniden savasmaya baslamaniz ve yeniden yolunuzu bulmaniz gerektigi anlamina gelir.

english: What if I log out during the fights?
translation: Savas sirasinda oturumu kapatirsam ne olur?

english: If you log out during a fight, upon logging back in you will fight the knight you were fighting when you logged out.
translation: Savas sirasinda oturumu kapatirsaniz, yeniden oturum açtiginizda, oturumu kapattiginizda savastiginiz sövalyeyle savasmaya devam edersiniz.

english: Tell me about the rewards.

King Arthur believes in rewarding his knights for their chivalry. Having proven yourself in combat against his knights, and in your services rendered to Camelot, you will be rewarded with two new prayers, and a new
translation: Kral Arthur, sövalyelerinin sövalyeliklerine karsilik ödüllendirilmesine inanir. Sövalyeleriyle savasta kendinizi kanitladiktan ve Camelot'a hizmet ettikten sonra, iki yeni dua ve Camelot'ta yeni bir

english: respawn at Camelot, as well as 20,000 XP in to each of your combat stats.
translation: yeniden dogusun yani sira, her bir savas istatistiginize 20.000 XP ile ödüllendirileceksiniz.

english: What do the new prayers do?
Ah, patience is a virtue in knights, my lord. Fight in the training ground and earn your reward to find out!
translation: Ah, sabir sövalyeler için bir erdemdir, lordum. Egitim alaninda savasin ve ödülünüzü kazanarak ögrenin!

english: Then tell me about the respawn - how will it work?
translation: O zaman yeniden dogus hakkinda bilgi verin - nasil isleyecek?

english: Ah, Merlin has offered, as a reward for your help, to let yourrespawn in the safety of Camelot, should you befall misfortune elsewhere in the world. Should you wish to change your respawn back to Lumbridge, simply
translation: Ah, Merlin, yardiminizin karsiligi olarak, dünyanin baska bir yerinde talihsiz bir olayla karsilasirsaniz, Camelot'un güvenli ortaminda yeniden dogusunuzu saglayacagini teklif etti. Yeniden dogusunuzu Lumbridge'e geri degistirmek isterseniz,

english: speak to Merlin.
No, thank you.
Congratulations on succeeding in the Knight Waves, my lord.
translation: Sövalye Dalgalari'nda basarili oldugunuz için tebrikler, lordum.

english: Thank you. Can I go back inside?
I'm afraid not, my lord. Once you have won, you cannot re-enter.
translation: Korkarim ki hayir, lordum. Kazandiktan sonra tekrar giremezsiniz.

english: Yes please.
Tell me about the training ground
Tell me about dying or leaving the grounds
translation: Bana ölmekten veya alani terk etmekten bahset

english: Tell me about the rewards
No, thank you.
Hello there. How's it going?
Busy, busy, busy.
Sorry, but I'm busy right now.
Sorry, but I have lots of work to do.
translation: Üzgünüm, ama yapacak çok isim var.

english: Not too bad, but the work is definitely tiring.
translation: Fena degil, ama is kesinlikle yorucu.

english: Well I could do with a good rest, but fine otherwise.
translation: Iyi bir dinlenmeye ihtiyacim var, ama onun disinda iyiyim.

english: What do you want?
I'm Vicks, squire to Sir Culler Flife. He's away on a surveillance mission to Burthorpe, so he sent me down here to do some cleaning.
translation: Ben Vicks, Sir Culler Flife'in sövalyesi. O, Burthorpe'a gözetleme görevine gitti, bu yüzden beni buraya temizlik yapmam için gönderdi.

english: Don't tell the knights, but I'm just not in the mood for it! I've served for years, and worked really hard, but they're not even thinking of making me a knight.
translation: Sövalyelere söyleme, ama hiç havamda degilim! Yillardir hizmet ediyorum ve çok çalisiyorum, ama beni sövalye yapmayi bile düsünmüyorlar.

english: I don't know what the problem is. At my last review, I heard the examiner muttering something about my name, but I've no idea what he meant by that.
translation: Sorun ne bilmiyorum. Son degerlendirmemde, sinav görevlisinin adimla ilgili bir seyler mirildandigini duydum, ama ne demek istedigini anlamadim.

english: Keeping an eye on those Imperial Guard. We can't trust 'em, you know. But I shouldn't talk about his mission.
translation: Imparatorluk Muhafizlarini gözetle. Onlara güvenemeyiz, biliyorsun. Ama onun görevi hakkinda konusmamaliyim.

english: Tell me about this place.
This place? It's the castle crypt. The greatest White Knights are buried here, after a lifetime in the service of Saradomin. At least, that's how it used to be.
translation: Burasi mi? Burasi kalenin mezarligi. En büyük Beyaz Sövalyeler, Saradomin'e ömür boyu hizmet ettikten sonra buraya gömülürler. En azindan eskiden öyleydi.

english: When I was a new recruit, they brought me here and told me that if I served Saradomin faithfully, and with distinction, maybe I'd earn the honour of burial in this place too.
translation: Ben yeni askere alindigimda, beni buraya getirdiler ve Saradomin'e sadakatle ve basariyla hizmet edersem, belki ben de buraya gömülme serefine nail olabilecegimi söylediler.

english: But if you think about it, that's never going to happen - there just isn't space for more tombs! Anyway, my plan is to avoid dying, and maybe marry one of the barmaids when I retire.
translation: Ama düsünürsen, bu asla olmayacak - daha fazla mezar için yer yok! Her neyse, benim planim ölmemek ve emekli oldugumda barmenlerden biriyle evlenmek.

english: What's with the glowing portal thing?
It's because of something the Temple Knights have, called the Gaze of Saradomin. They get the option of being brought to Falador when they die, so Death has to maintain a presence in the area.
translation: Tapinak Sövalyeleri'nin sahip oldugu Saradomin'in Bakisi adli bir sey yüzünden. Öldüklerinde Falador'a götürülme seçenegi var, bu yüzden Ölüm bu bölgede varligini sürdürmek zorunda.

english: That portal takes you to Death's own realm. He's got portals in all the places where people go when they die - Lumbridge, Edgeville and the rest. I hate it - the thing's terrifying!
translation: Bu portal sizi Ölüm'ün kendi alemine götürür. Insanlar öldüklerinde gittikleri tüm yerlerde portallari vardir - Lumbridge, Edgeville ve digerleri. Bundan nefret ediyorum - bu sey çok korkutucu!

english: I'll leave you alone.
Can I help you, [sir/madam]?
You don't seem to be cleaning much.
What's your master doing in Burthorpe?
Keeping an eye on those Imperial Guard, [sir/madam]. We can't trust 'em, you know. But I shouldn't talk about his mission, even with a knight such as yourself.
translation: Imparatorluk Muhafizlarini gözetliyor. Onlara güvenemeyiz, biliyorsunuz. Ama onun görevinden bahsetmemeliyim, sizin gibi bir sövalyeye bile.

english: It's because of the Gaze of Saradomin. You Temple Knights get the option of being brought to Falador when you die, so Death has to maintain a presence in the area.

You don't seem to be cleaning much.
What's your master doing in Burthorpe?
Tell me about this place.
What's with the glowing portal thing?
I'll leave you alone.

Who are you?
I'm a Squire for the Void Knights.

english: The who?
The Void Knights, they are great warriors of balance who do Guthix's work here in Gielinor.
translation: Void Sövalyeleri, Gielinor'da Guthix'in isini yapan büyük denge savasçilaridir.

english: Wow, can I join?
translation: Vay canina, ben de katilabilir miyim?

english: Entry is strictly invite only, however we do need help continuing Guthix's work.

english: Good luck with that.
What kind of work?
Ah well you see we try to keep Gielinor as Guthix intended, it's very challenging. Actually we've been having some problems recently, maybe you could help us?
translation: Görüyorsun, Guthix'in istedigi gibi Gielinor'u korumaya çalisiyoruz, bu çok zorlu bir is. Aslinda son zamanlarda bazi sorunlar yasiyoruz, belki bize yardim edebilirsin?

english: Yeah ok, what's the problem?

translation: Yillar içinde tarikat oldukça zayifladi, Void Knight'larin becerilerini ögrenmek çok uzun bir süreç. Son zamanlarda baska bir yerden bizim alemimize ihlaller oldu ve garip yaratiklar

english: have been pouring through. We can't let that happen, and we'd be very grateful if you'd help us.
translation: buraya akin etmeye basladi. Bunun olmasina izin veremeyiz ve bize yardim ederseniz çok minnettar oluruz.

english: How can I help?
We send launchers from our outpost to the nearby islands. If you go and wait in the lander there that'd really help.
translation: Karakolumuzdan yakindaki adalara firlaticilar gönderiyoruz. Oraya gidip inis aracinda beklerseniz çok yardimci olursunuz.

english: Sorry, but I can't.
I'd rather not, sorry.

translation: Guthix'in bu dünyaya verdigi isimdir, bu yüzden onu onurlandirmak için bu ismi kullaniyoruz.

english: Uh huh, sure.

translation: Çok basit. Birkaç dakikada bir inis araci gönderiyoruz, ancak en az 5 gönüllüye ihtiyacimiz var, aksi takdirde bu bir intihar görevi olur. Inis araci en fazla 25 kisi alabiliyor, bu yüzden doldugunda erken gönderiyoruz.

english: What invaders?

english: Sorry, you'll need to speak to one of the Knights about that. I'm just a humble squire with years of training still to undergo!
translation: Üzgünüm, bunun için Sövalyelerden biriyle konusmaniz gerekiyor. Ben sadece yillarca egitim almasi gereken mütevazi bir sövalye yardimcisiyim!

english: Alright, good luck with that.

english: Be quick, we're under attack!

translation: Bu ada yabancilar tarafindan istila ediliyor ve suradaki Void Knight, portallari yok etmek için bir ritüel kullaniyor. Void Knight'i ne pahasina olursa olsun savunmaliyiz

english: portals yourself.
translation: ancak firsat bulursaniz portallari kendiniz yok edebilirsiniz.

english: How do I repair things?

english: Hey, friend of Snowflake!
Who are you?
Not much to say. Came to Weiss with other trolls when we got kicked out of caves further south, but I was just young troll then.
translation: Söyleyecek pek bir sey yok. Güneydeki magaralardan kovuldugumuzda diger trollerle birlikte Weiss'a geldim, ama o zamanlar henüz genç bir trolüm.

english: Mostly been enjoying living round Weiss, 'cos wildlife is interesting here.
translation: Weiss'ta yasamaktan çogunlukla keyif aliyorum, çünkü buradaki vahsi yasam ilginç.

english: Tell me about this place.
This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: Burasi Weiss. Troller yillar önce, güneydeki magaralardan kovulduktan sonra burayi insa etti. Simdi Weiss bizim evimiz.

english: It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: Burasi harika, simdi Snowflake ve kocasi troll bize goutweed yetistirmeyi ögretti. Yemekler artik çok daha lezzetli.

english: Do you like it here?
Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: Eh, biraz zorlu ama gittikçe iyilesiyor. Snowflake bize goutweed yetistirmeyi ögretti. Keçi, kurt, insan, goutweed ile çok daha lezzetli oluyorlar.

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: Evet, Weiss yasamak için iyi bir yer, simdi Snowflake sorumlu. Tüm troller Snowflake'i sever. Kocasi biraz tuhaf, ama bu bizim sorunumuz degil.

english: I'll be off.

Do you like it here?
I'll be off.
Hello there.
Hello. What can I do for you?
I'm not sure. Do you have anything for sale?
translation: Emin degilim. Satilik bir seyin var mi?

english: I'm afraid not. All the recent chaos has caused a lot of supply issues. It will be a long time before things are properly back to normal.
translation: Korkarim yok. Son zamanlardaki kaos, birçok tedarik sorununa neden oldu. Her seyin normale dönmesi uzun zaman alacak.

english: Oh, that's a shame. Never mind then.
translation: Oh, çok yazik. Öyleyse bos ver.

english: Woof!
sub_category: Dialogue for Stray dog (2024 Halloween event)

english: Greetings friend. I am a manufacturer of leather.
Can I buy some leather then?
translation: O zaman biraz deri satin alabilir miyim?

english: I make leather from animal hides. Bring me some cowhides and one gold coin per hide, and I'll tan them into soft leather for you.
translation: Hayvan derilerinden deri yapiyorum. Bana biraz sigir derisi ve deri basina bir altin getir, ben de onlari yumusak deriye dönüstüreyim.

english: Leather is rather weak stuff.
Normal leather may be quite weak, but it's very cheap - I make it from cowhides for only 1 gp per hide - and it's so easy to craft that anyone can work with it.
translation: Normal deri oldukça zayif olabilir, ama çok ucuzdur - sigir derilerinden deri yapiyorum ve deri basina sadece 1 altin aliyorum - ve islenmesi o kadar kolay ki herkes kullanabilir.

english: Alternatively you could try hard leather. It's not so easy to craft, but I only charge 3 gp per cowhide to prepare it, and it makes much sturdier armour.
translation: Alternatif olarak sert deriyi deneyebilirsiniz. Islenmesi o kadar kolay degildir, ama hazirlamak için deri basina sadece 3 altin para aliyorum ve çok daha saglam zirhlar yapiliyor.

english: I can also tan snake hides and dragonhides, suitable for crafting into the highest quality armour for rangers.
translation: Ayrica yilan derisi ve ejderha derisi de tabaklayabilirim, bunlar rangerlar için en yüksek kalitede zirhlar yapmak için uygundur.

english: Thanks, I'll bear it in mind.
I see you have brought me a hide. Would you like me to tan it for you?
translation: Bana bir deri getirmissin. Senin için tabaklamami ister misin?

english: I see you have brought me some hides. Would you like me to tan them for you?
translation: Bana birkaç deri getirmissin. Senin için tabaklamami ister misin?

english: Yes please.
No thanks.
Very well, [sir/madam], as you wish.
Er... Thanks, but no thanks!
Er... I have no use for that, I make the stuff!
translation: Sey... Onun bana bir faydasi yok, ben o seyi yapiyorum!

english: Can I buy some leather then?
translation: O zaman biraz deri alabilir miyim?

english: Leather is rather weak stuff.
Yes please.
No thanks.
Hello.
Not infected are you?
I don't think so.
You don't seem very sure. We don't want any infected near the children. Be off with you!
translation: Çok emin görünmüyorsun. Çocuklarin yaninda enfekte olanlar istemiyoruz. Defol git!

english: Whatever it is you're selling, we ain't interested!
But I'm not...
Did you not hear me? Clear off!
Greetings, how may I be of service.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Who are you? What is your name?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Who am I?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: I am whatever is needed of me.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: I am a form undefined by natural laws, manifested by someone we mustn't speak of.
translation: Dogal kanunlarla tanimlanamayan, bahsetmememiz gereken biri tarafindan ortaya çikarilan bir formum.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: I'm a clay doll, shaped by a sculptor. Never allowed to set, forever malleable. But maybe, not for long...
translation: Bir heykeltiras tarafindan sekillendirilmis bir kil bebekim. Asla sertlesmem, sonsuza kadar sekillendirilebilirim. Ama belki de çok uzun sürmeyecek...
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: My true name is immaterial, But you may call me...
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Let's see now, what would be most appropriate?
translation: Bir bakalim, en uygun olan ne olabilir?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Ah, yes.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: You may call me The Sage.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Uhhh, ok... Sage. Where did you bring us?
translation: Uhhh, tamam... Bilge. Bizi nereye getirdin?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: 'Where' is the right question my friend, but maybe not in the way you are accustomed to hearing.
translation: “Nereye” dogru soru dostum, ama belki de alistigin sekilde degil.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Reality as you know it has many layers, all slightly different with their own rules.
translation: Bildigin gerçeklik birçok katmandan olusur, hepsi kendi kurallariyla biraz farklidir.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Through the power granted to me, I brought us to this layer using the River-Between. The River of Souls.
translation: Bana verilen güçle, bizi River-Between'i kullanarak bu katmana getirdim. Ruhlar Nehri.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: We now stand on the stage of what is yet to be your most entertaining performance yet!
translation: Su anda, senin için simdiye kadarki en eglenceli performansinin sahnesinde duruyoruz!
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Layers? River-Between? What does any of this mean?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: To give everything away at this point would be unwise, considering we are being watched even now. You should only be concerned about one thing.
translation: Su anda her seyi açiklamak akillica olmaz, çünkü su anda bile izleniyoruz. Tek bir sey hakkinda endiselenmelisin.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Being entertaining.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: That's the only way you will get out of this event alive...
translation: Bu etkinlikten sag çikmanin tek yolu bu...
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Entertaining? What are you talking about? Who am I entertaining? Stop talking in riddles!
translation: Eglenceli olmak mi? Neden bahsediyorsun? Kimi eglendirecegim? Bilmece gibi konusmayi kes!
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Ahh, [player name], please forgive me. In my attempts to explain, I appear to have confused you even further...
translation: Ahh, Maceraci, lütfen beni affet. Açiklamaya çalisirken, seni daha da kafani karistirmisim galiba...
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: I will keep things simple for you; Participate in this event and you will continue to exist. Refusal to participate will end in your eventual destruction.
translation: Sizin için basitçe açiklayayim; bu etkinlige katilirsaniz varliginizi sürdürebilirsiniz. Katilmayi reddederseniz, sonunda yok olursunuz.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: The choice is yours... hero.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Well, that doesn't really answer anything...
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Worry not. I have much grander plans for you yet, but like all good stories we must wait for the right time and place...
translation: Endiselenmeyin. Sizin için çok daha büyük planlarim var, ama tüm iyi hikayelerde oldugu gibi dogru zamani ve yeri beklemeliyiz...
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: You mentioned other Leagues - how does this differ from those?
translation: Diger Liglerden bahsettin - bu Lig digerlerinden nasil farkli?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Like all events before it, the rules of the world have been altered to be more entertaining for those who are watching.
translation: Önceki tüm etkinliklerde oldugu gibi, dünyanin kurallari izleyenler için daha eglenceli hale getirildi.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: The biggest change has been to the Relics from the previous chapter.
translation: En büyük degisiklik önceki bölümdeki Kalintilarda oldu.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: These objects of power are now gone, I have broken them into Fragments and spread across this iteration of the world.
translation: Bu güç nesneleri artik yok, onlari Parçalara ayirdim ve bu dünyanin her yerine dagittim.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: When multiple Fragments are in harmony, they can be used together to create powerful effects.
translation: Birden fazla Parça uyum içinde oldugunda, birlikte kullanilarak güçlü etkiler yaratabilirler.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Yes, I remember you shattering them on the boat ride.
translation: Evet, tekne yolculugunda onlari parçaladigini hatirliyorum.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: So I have Fragments to collect... got it. Are there any OTHER weird rules I should know about?
translation: Yani parçalari toplamam gerekiyor... Anladim. Bilmem gereken baska garip kurallar var mi?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: I understand that in previous Leagues, they limited you to smaller spaces of your world.
translation: Önceki Liglerde, dünyanizin daha küçük alanlariyla sinirlandiginizi anliyorum.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: That restriction doesn't exist in this event.
translation: Bu etkinlikte böyle bir kisitlama yok.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: You're free to roam your world, exploring the furthest reaches from Morytania to Kourend & Kebos.
translation: Dünyanizi özgürce dolasabilir, Morytania'dan Kourend ve Kebos'a kadar en uzak noktalari kesfedebilirsiniz.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: But there's a catch.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Oh great... there's always a catch.
translation: Harika... her zaman bir sorun vardir.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: I've limited and reset some of your memories, meaning you won't be able to interact with certain elements of this world.
translation: Bazi anilarini sinirladim ve sifirladim, yani bu dünyanin belirli unsurlariyla etkilesime giremeyeceksin.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: For example, you'll only have access to three skills: Defence, Fishing and Thieving, as well as the Combat Class you chose earlier.
translation: Örnegin, daha önce seçtigin Savas Sinifi'nin yani sira sadece üç beceriye erisebileceksin: Savunma, Balikçilik ve Hirsizlik.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: In order to gain access to other skills, you need to complete Tasks for me.
translation: Diger becerilere erismek için benim için Görevleri tamamlaman gerekiyor.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Doing so gives you Sage's Renown. A rather fitting name, I thought.
translation: Bunu yaptiginda Sage's Renown kazanirsin. Oldukça uygun bir isim, bence.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: With Renown you can purchase access to new skills as well as bosses and quests.
translation: Renown ile yeni becerilere, bosslara ve görevlere erisim satin alabilirsin.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Why are you doing all of this? Surely I'd be more 'entertaining' if I could have all the power at once?
translation: Neden tüm bunlari yapiyorsun? Tüm gücü bir anda elde edebilseydim, kesinlikle daha “eglenceli” olurdum, degil mi?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: I can't just give you all that power. What kind of story starts the hero with all the power they want?
translation: Sana tüm bu gücü öylece veremem. Hangi hikayede kahraman istedigi tüm güce sahip olarak baslar?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: No, your story needs good rhythm. A sort of cadence that makes things interesting for your audience.
translation: Hayir, hikayenin iyi bir ritmi olmali. Izleyicileri için ilgi çekici hale getiren bir tür ritim.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Start slow, work your way up. Become the hero you were always meant to be...
translation: Yavas basla, yavas yavas ilerle. Her zaman olman gereken kahraman ol...
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Once you have proven yourself, then and only then will you earn my renown.
translation: Kendini kanitladiginda, ancak o zaman benim söhretimi kazanacaksin.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: That's how you provide good entertainment my friend...
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: That's how you make a hero.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: I suppose you're right...
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Do you desire more information?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Yes, please.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Not right now.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Go forward and continue your journey.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Remember, we are always watching...
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Any tips you can give me on being 'entertaining'?
translation: “Eglenceli” olmak için bana verebilecegin herhangi bir ipucu var mi?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: I have devised a number of tasks to help keep your story on track.
translation: Hikayeni yolunda tutmana yardimci olacak bir dizi görev tasarladim.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Each task has a level of difficulty: Beginner, Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite and Master.
translation: Her görevin bir zorluk seviyesi vardir: Baslangiç, Kolay, Orta, Zor, Elit ve Usta.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: The more tasks you complete, the more activities you can unlock.
translation: Ne kadar çok görev tamamlarsan, o kadar çok aktiviteyi açabilirsin.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: The more content you unlock the more interesting your story will become.
translation: Ne kadar çok içerik açarsan, hikayen o kadar ilginç hale gelir.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: The more interesting the story the more entertained the ones watching will be.
translation: Hikaye ne kadar ilginç olursa, izleyenler o kadar eglenir.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Not only that, completing tasks also earns you League Points. The number of points earned is dependent on the difficulty of the task.
translation: Sadece bu da degil, görevleri tamamladikça Lig Puanlari da kazanirsin. Kazandigin puan sayisi, görevin zorluk derecesine baglidir.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: What do I use these 'points' on?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Once you have achieved a certain amount of League Points you can unlock a new Fragment Slot.
translation: Belirli bir miktar Lig Puani kazandiginda, yeni bir Parça Yuvasi açabilirsin.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: These slots allow you to equip more Fragments and become even stronger.
translation: Bu yuvalar, daha fazla Fragman donatmaniza ve daha da güçlenmenize olanak tanir.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.
translation: Lig Puanlari, Lig Ödül Magazasindan ödüller satin almak için de kullanilabilir.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Right now, you are playing on your Leagues profile. The Leagues Reward Shop can only be opened on your main profile.
translation: Su anda Lig profilinizde oynuyorsunuz. Lig Ödül Magazasi yalnizca ana profilinizde açilabilir.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: You can access your main profile by switching to any normal Old School RuneScape world. The world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.
translation: Herhangi bir normal Old School RuneScape dünyasina geçerek ana profilinize erisebilirsiniz. Oturumu kapatma menüsündeki dünya degistirici, dünyalar arasinda geçis yapmak için kullanilabilir.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: So how many tasks are there?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: More than you'll ever be able to complete, given our limited time here.
translation: Burada geçirecegimiz sinirli süre içinde tamamlayabileceginizden çok daha fazlasi var.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: With so many to choose from, it's up to you to decide how your story plays out...
translation: Bu kadar çok seçenek varken, hikayenizin nasil gelisecegini belirlemek size kalmis...
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Ok... I think I understand what I should do now.
translation: Tamam... Sanirim simdi ne yapmam gerektigini anladim.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Very good. I knew I made the right choice bringing you to this chapter.
translation: Çok iyi. Sizi bu bölüme getirerek dogru karari verdigimi biliyordum.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: What is a Fragment?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: You remember the Relics from the previous event, yes? The sources of great power that let you achieve amazing feats.
translation: Önceki etkinlikteki Kalintilari hatirliyorsun, degil mi? Muhtesem basarilar elde etmeni saglayan büyük gücün kaynagi.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Fragments are similar. As the Fragments were created from the Relics, much of their power remains but in a much-diminished form.
translation: Parçalar da buna benzer. Parçalar Kalintilardan yaratildigindan, güçlerinin çogu kalir, ancak çok daha zayif bir biçimde.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: They bestow many different bonuses: from helping you cut wood, to making you a more formidable warrior.
translation: Parçalar, odun kesmene yardim etmekten, seni daha güçlü bir savasçi yapmaya kadar birçok farkli bonus saglar.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Equipping Fragments will grant you their power.
translation: Parçalari donatarak onlarin gücünü elde edebilirsin.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: You can also level up your Fragments, making them even MORE powerful.
translation: Fragmanlarinizi seviye atlatarak onlari daha da güçlü hale getirebilirsiniz.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Gaining experience as you normally would will level up your Fragments, making them even more useful.
translation: Normal sekilde deneyim kazandikça Fragmanlariniz seviye atlayacak ve daha da kullanisli hale gelecektir.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: How do I find these Fragments?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: I have scattered the Fragments evenly across the world.
translation: Fragmanlari dünyanin dört bir yanina esit olarak dagittim.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Anytime you kill a monster or gain more experience in a particular skill, you'll have a chance to receive a Fragment.
translation: Bir canavari öldürdügünüzde veya belirli bir beceride daha fazla deneyim kazandiginizda, bir Fragman alma sansiniz olur.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: The harder the enemy or activity, the better chance you'll have.
translation: Düsman veya aktivite ne kadar zor olursa, sansiniz o kadar artar.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: You will only receive Fragments relevant to the activity, with a few exceptions.
translation: Birkaç istisna disinda, yalnizca aktiviteyle ilgili Fragmanlari elde edersiniz.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: I know your kind enjoy seeking out treasure. Fragments related to Treasure Trails can come from anywhere.
translation: Sizin gibilerin hazine aramayi sevdigini biliyorum. Hazine Izleri ile ilgili Fragmanlar her yerden gelebilir.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: What happens if I try to put the Fragments back together?
translation: Fragmanlari bir araya getirmeye çalisirsam ne olur?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: As I said, the Fragments still contain some of their residual Relic energy.
translation: Dedigim gibi, Fragmanlar hala bazi kalintilari içeriyor.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: When enough Fragments are brought back together they will emit the same energy they did when they were whole.
translation: Yeterli sayida Parça bir araya getirildiginde, bir bütün olduklari zamanki enerjiyi yayarlar.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: For example, if you find five Fragments imbued with Last Recall, you can complete the set and gain access to that Relic's full power.
translation: Örnegin, Son Hatirlama ile donatilmis bes Parça bulursaniz, seti tamamlayabilir ve o Kalintinin tam gücüne erisebilirsiniz.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: A sort of 'Set Effect' if you will.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Is there anything else you wish to know?
translation: Bilmek istediginiz baska bir sey var mi?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: How does the content unlock system work?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: In this iteration of the event I have limited you, at first, to three skills: Thieving, Fishing and Defence.
translation: Bu etkinlikte, sizi baslangiçta üç beceriyle sinirladim: Hirsizlik, Balikçilik ve Savunma.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: You can still do simple things like cut trees or mine ore, but doing so will be fruitless, as no experience will be gained.
translation: Agaç kesmek veya maden çikarmak gibi basit seyleri yapmaya devam edebilirsiniz, ancak bunu yapmak deneyim kazanamayacaginiz için sonuçsuz kalacaktir.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: In order to gain experience in these skills, you'll need to unlock them by using my Renown.
translation: Bu becerilerde deneyim kazanmak için, benim Söhretimi kullanarak bunlari açmaniz gerekir.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: You gain renown by being entertaining, by completing tasks. The amount of Renown you earn depends on the difficulty of the task.
translation: Eglenceli davranarak ve görevleri tamamlayarak söhret kazanirsiniz. Kazandiginiz söhret miktari, görevin zorluguna baglidir.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: When it comes to exceptionally strong creatures, you'll need to unlock the ability to fight them. You can see all locked creatures by opening the unlock interface.
translation: Olaganüstü güçlü yaratiklar söz konusu oldugunda, onlarla savasma yeteneginin kilidini açmaniz gerekecektir. Kilitli tüm yaratiklari, kilit açma arayüzünü açarak görebilirsiniz.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: One final morsal of information you might be interested in. I understand that in previous Leagues you were forced to complete certain 'Quests' in their entirety.
translation: Ilginizi çekebilecek son bir bilgi daha var. Anladigim kadariyla, önceki Liglerde belirli “Görevleri” tamamen tamamlamak zorunda kaliyordunuz.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: If you wish, you may spend Sage's Renown to skip through these Quests while still gaining any final rewards. However, be warned thaatI will not offer any gifts to you if you finish these quests by yourself.
translation: Isterseniz, Sage'in Söhretini kullanarak bu Görevleri atlayabilir ve yine de son ödülleri kazanabilirsiniz. Ancak, bu görevleri kendi basiniza tamamlarsaniz size herhangi bir hediye vermeyecegimi unutmayin.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: You should also know that by completing quests with Sage's Renown, you will not earn any final experience like you would if you finished the quest yourself.
translation: Ayrica, Sage'in Söhretini kullanarak görevleri tamamladiginizda, görevi kendi basiniza tamamladiginizda oldugu gibi son deneyim puanlari kazanmayacaginizi da bilmelisiniz.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Is there anything else you wish to know.
translation: Baska bilmek istediginiz bir sey var mi?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: How did I get here again?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: I can retell the story, if you wish me to.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: League Intro cutscene replays.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)
source: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: So be it.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Will I be rewarded for participating in this event?
translation: Bu etkinlige katildigim için ödül alacak miyim?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: As you progress you'll earn League Points, which will unlock new slots and allow you to equip more Fragments.
translation: Ilerledikçe Lig Puanlari kazanacaksiniz, bu da yeni yuvalarin kilidini açacak ve daha fazla Parça donatmaniza olanak saglayacaktir.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: However, when our time in this world is over, you can spend your League Points to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.
translation: Ancak, bu dünyadaki zamanimiz bittiginde, Lig Puanlarinizi Lig Ödül Dükkanindan ödüller satin almak için harcayabilirsiniz.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Of course, the real reward for participating will be my master and I sparing your life once the event ends...
translation: Tabii ki, etkinlige katildiginiz için alacaginiz asil ödül, etkinlik bittiginde ustam ve benim hayatinizi bagislamamiz olacak...
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Are there any other rewards I can earn from this event?
translation: Bu etkinlikten kazanabilecegim baska ödüller var mi?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: I see...
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: In my time on the River of Souls I have found that when chapters are concluded their collapsing can be... incomplete.
translation: Ruhlar Nehri'nde geçirdigim zamanlarda, bölümler sona erdiginde çöküslerinin... tam olamayabilecegini fark ettim.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Therefore, certain items can slip through the cracks, so to say.
translation: Bu nedenle, bazi esyalar çatlaklardan sizabilir, tabiri caizse.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: In fact, it's through one of these cracks that I was able to save you from the previous chapter's collapse.
translation: Aslinda, önceki bölümün çöküsünden seni kurtarmami saglayan da bu çatlaklardan biriydi.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: I collect these lost items from other worlds and keep them with me, should I ever need them one day.
translation: Bu kayip esyalari diger dünyalardan topluyorum ve bir gün ihtiyacim olursa diye yanimda sakliyorum.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: I'm happy to offer them as an incentive for playing your part in this event.
translation: Bu etkinlikte rolünü oynadigin için sana tesvik olarak bunlari sunmaktan mutluluk duyarim.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: The first item is a powerful whip.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: It is imbued with the energy of thousands of lost souls, forever trapped in the bondage of their iron chains.
translation: Binlerce kayip ruhun enerjisiyle dolu, demir zincirlerin esaretinde sonsuza kadar hapsolmus.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Each crack releases a deafening howl from the screams of its victims trapped within...
translation: Her çatlak, içinde hapsolmus kurbanlarinin çigliklarindan gelen sagir edici bir uluma yayiyor...
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: The next item is a cannon.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: It's poweeredby channelled arcane energy, each explosion teleported into the barrel from a border dimension.
translation: Gizemli enerjiyle çalisiyor, her patlama sinir boyutundan namluya isinlaniyor.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Using a power unknwon, it expels shrapnel that tears through flesh and souls alike.
translation: Bilinmeyen bir güç kullanarak, eti ve ruhlari parçalayan sarapnel parçalari firlatir.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: There are others of course. You'll be free to trade these rewards to others in your world, or you can keep them. It doesn't matter to me.
translation: Elbette baska ödüller de var. Bu ödülleri dünyanizdaki diger oyuncularla takas edebilir veya saklayabilirsiniz. Benim için fark etmez.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: I see. That all sounds good to me.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Right now, you are playing on your Leagues profile. The Leagues Reward Shop can only be opened on your main profile.
translation: Su anda Ligler profilinizde oynuyorsunuz. Ligler Ödül Magazasi sadece ana profilinizde açilabilir.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)
source: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: You can acess your main profile by switching to any normal Old School RuneScape world. Using world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.
translation: Herhangi bir normal Old School RuneScape dünyasina geçerek ana profilinize erisebilirsiniz. Oturumu kapatma menüsündeki dünya degistiriciyi kullanarak dünyalar arasinda geçis yapabilirsiniz.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)
source: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: And hero, beware - the Shattered Relic rewards won't be available until the League has ended. You can still buy rewards from previous Leagues, however.
translation: Ve kahraman, dikkatli olun - Shattered Relic ödülleri Lig sona erene kadar kullanilamayacaktir. Ancak, önceki Liglerden ödüller satin almaya devam edebilirsiniz.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Now, alongside the rewards in the Leagues Reward Shop, there's also League Ranks.
translation: Simdi, Lig Ödül Magazasindaki ödüllerin yani sira, Lig Siralamalari da var.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: League Ranks? How do they work?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: At the end of the League, you will be judged and given a rank. This is based upon the number of League Points you have earned compared to the other participants.
translation: Ligin sonunda, degerlendirilip bir siralama verilecektir. Bu, diger katilimcilara kiyasla kazandiginiz Lig Puani sayisina göre belirlenir.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Anyone who earns at least 100 League Points will be eligible for the Bronze rank. The top 80% of participants get the Iron rank. The top 60% get Steel.
translation: En az 100 Lig Puani kazanan herkes Bronz siralamasina hak kazanir. Katilimcilarin en iyi %80'i Demir siralamasina hak kazanir. En iyi %60'i Çelik siralamasina hak kazanir.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: The top 40% get Mithril. The top 20% get Adamant. The top 5% get Rune. The best participants, those who make it to the top 1%, get the Dragon rank!
translation: En iyi %40'i Mithril siralamasina hak kazanir. En iyi %20'si Adamant siralamasina hak kazanir. En iyi %5'i Rune siralamasina hak kazanir. En iyi katilimcilar, yani en iyi %1'e girenler, Ejderha siralamasina hak kazanir!
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: When the League ends, you'll get a trophy based on your rank. These trophies symbolise your performance in the League.
translation: Lig sona erdiginde, siralamaniza göre bir kupa kazanacaksiniz. Bu kupalar, Lig'deki performansinizi simgeliyor.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: You'll also get League-to-League rewards based on your League Rank.
translation: Ayrica, Lig Siralamaniza göre Ligden Lig'e ödüller de kazanacaksiniz.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: League Starter Outfits and League Icons are some of things you can unlock for the next League. Also, any pets you earn in this League will transfer over to the next one.
translation: Lig Baslangiç Kiyafetleri ve Lig Simgeleri, bir sonraki Lig için açabileceginiz seylerden bazilari. Ayrica, bu Lig'de kazandiginiz tüm evcil hayvanlar bir sonraki Lig'e aktarilacak.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Finally, I plan to recognise the first heroes to complete particular activities.
translation: Son olarak, belirli etkinlikleri tamamlayan ilk kahramanlari ödüllendirmeyi planliyorum.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: You can view the entire list of activities, as well as whether or not someone has completed them, on the board beside me.
translation: Etkinliklerin tam listesini ve bunlarin tamamlanip tamamlanmadigini yanimdaki tahtada görebilirsiniz.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Thanks!
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Let's talk about pets.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Can you tell me how pets work in Leagues?
translation: Liglerde hayvanlarin nasil çalistigini anlatabilir misiniz?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Of course! If you're lucky enough to obtain a pet during a League, it will automatically be insured for you.
translation: Tabii ki! Lig sirasinda sansliysaniz ve bir hayvan elde ederseniz, bu hayvan otomatik olarak sigortalanir.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: This means that if you were to ever lose it, you can talk to me and I'll give it back to you. Insurance and reclaiming is all free!
translation: Bu, eger onu kaybedersen, bana gelip konusursan sana geri verecegim anlamina geliyor. Sigorta ve geri alma tamamen ücretsiz!
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Additionally, each pet you obtain will be transferred to the next League. It'll be waiting with me for you to reclaim it!
translation: Ayrica, elde ettigin her evcil hayvan bir sonraki Lig'e aktarilacak. Benimle birlikte senin geri almani bekleyecek!
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Okay! Thank you.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Return to me once you have some pets and you'll be able to view your collection. Is there anything else you wish to know?
translation: Bazi evcil hayvanlar edindiginde bana geri dön, koleksiyonunu görebileceksin. Baska bilmek istedigin bir sey var mi?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Do I have any items to collect?
translation: Toplamam gereken herhangi bir esya var mi?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: It doesn't look like you need any League items right now. I'll be here if you ever do.
translation: Su anda Lig esyalarina ihtiyacin yok gibi görünüyor. Ihtiyacin olursa ben buradayim.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: I'm good, thanks.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Very well. I'll be here if you ever need to know anything about Leagues.
translation: Peki. Ligler hakkinda bilmen gereken herhangi bir sey olursa ben buradayim.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Who are you? What is your name?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)
source: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: You mentioned other Leagues - how does this differ from those?
translation: Diger Liglerden bahsettin - bu Lig digerlerinden nasil farkli?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)
source: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Yes, please.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)
source: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Not right now.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)
source: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Any tips you can give me on being 'entertaining'?
translation: “Eglenceli” olmak için bana verebileceginiz herhangi bir ipucu var mi?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)
source: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: What are Fragments?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)
source: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: More options...
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)
source: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: How does the content unlock system work?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)
source: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: How did I get here again?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)
source: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Will I be rewarded for participating in this event?
translation: Bu etkinlige katildigim için ödül alacak miyim?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)
source: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Let's talk about pets.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)
source: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Do I have any League items to collect?
translation: Toplamam gereken Lig esyalari var mi?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)
source: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: I'm good, thanks.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)
source: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Repeat options...
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)
source: Dialogue for The Sage (Shattered Relics League)

english: Hello mortal. What do you seek?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: What changes have been made for this League?
translation: Bu Lig için ne gibi degisiklikler yapildi?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: Much has changed since the world was shattered. This time, I thought I'd turn the clock back and allow you to Trailblaze once more.
translation: Dünya parçalandigindan beri çok sey degisti. Bu sefer, zamani geri alip bir kez daha öncü olmaniza izin verecegim.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: As before, you'll initially be restricted to the Regions of Misthalin and Karamja. However, as you progress, you'll be able to unlock new areas of your choosing.
translation: Daha önce oldugu gibi, baslangiçta Misthalin ve Karamja bölgeleriyle sinirli olacaksiniz. Ancak ilerledikçe, seçtiginiz yeni alanlarin kilidini açabileceksiniz.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: Be warned though - you won't be able to unlock every area, so choose wisely.
translation: Ancak dikkatli ol, her alani açamayacaksin, bu yüzden akillica seçim yap.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: You must participate as an Iron Man. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.
translation: Iron Man olarak katilmalisin. Bu, tek basina olacagin ve diger katilimcilarla ticaret yapamayacagin anlamina gelir.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: And that's not all. Training skills during the League will grant you substantially more experience than you'd normally expect.
translation: Hepsi bu kadar da degil. Lig sirasinda becerilerini gelistirdiginde, normalde beklediginden çok daha fazla deneyim kazanacaksin.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: These experience increases are known as passive effects, which get more generous the higher your Relic tier.
translation: Bu deneyim artislari pasif etkiler olarak bilinir ve Relic seviyeniz ne kadar yüksekse o kadar cömert olur.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: Finally, some quests have been completed for you automatically. Further quests and more will be completed as you unlock the relevant areas.
translation: Son olarak, bazi görevler sizin için otomatik olarak tamamlanmistir. Ilgili alanlarin kilidini açtikça daha fazla görev ve daha fazlasi tamamlanacaktir.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: I think that covers the basics. Would you like to know more, [player name]?
translation: Sanirim temel bilgiler bu kadar. Daha fazla bilgi almak ister misiniz, Maceraci?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: Yes, please.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: Not right now.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: Is there anything else you need from me?
translation: Benden baska bir sey istiyor musun?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: How do tasks work?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: In every League, there are a number of tasks for you to complete. Each task has a level of difficulty: Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite and Master.
translation: Her Ligde, tamamlaman gereken bir dizi görev vardir. Her görevin bir zorluk seviyesi vardir: Kolay, Orta, Zor, Elit ve Usta.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: Completing tasks allows you to access new areas. The more tasks you complete, the more areas become available to unlock.
translation: Görevleri tamamlamak, yeni alanlara erismeni saglar. Ne kadar çok görev tamamlarsan, o kadar çok alanin kilidini açabilirsin.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: Not only that, completing tasks also earns you League Points. The number of points earned is dependent on the difficulty of the task.
translation: Sadece bu da degil, görevleri tamamladikça Lig Puanlari da kazanirsiniz. Kazandiginiz puan sayisi, görevin zorluk derecesine baglidir.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: What do these points do?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: Once you have achieved a certain amount of League Points you can unlock a new Relic of mine. These are powerful artefacts to help you in this world.
translation: Belirli bir miktar Lig Puani kazandiginizda, benim yeni bir Kalintimi açabilirsiniz. Bunlar, bu dünyada size yardimci olacak güçlü eserlerdir.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.
translation: Lig Puanlari, Lig Ödül Magazasindan ödüller satin almak için de kullanilabilir.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: So how many tasks are there?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: More than you'll ever be able to complete, most likely. It's up to you which ones you attempt.
translation: Muhtemelen tamamlayabileceginizden daha fazla. Hangi görevleri deneyeceginiz size kalmis.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: Thanks!
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: Now, would you like to take a look at the tasks for this League?
translation: Simdi, bu Lig'in görevlerine bir göz atmak ister misiniz?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: How does the area system work?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: Currently, you are restricted to the Kingdom of Misthalin and the island of Karamja. However, as you progress, you can unlock more areas.
translation: Su anda, Misthalin Kralligi ve Karamja adasiyla sinirlisiniz. Ancak ilerledikçe daha fazla alanin kilidini açabilirsiniz.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: There are ten different areas in total. However, you can only unlock a maximum of five, including the two you've started with. Choose wisely.
translation: Toplamda on farkli alan vardir. Ancak, basladiginiz iki alan dahil olmak üzere en fazla bes alanin kilidini açabilirsiniz. Akillica seçim yapin.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: I give the first two area unlocks to everyone. You can unlock the other three by completing the tasks I've set.
translation: Ilk iki alanin kilidini herkese açiyorum. Diger üç alanin kilidini, belirledigim görevleri tamamlayarak açabilirsiniz.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: The more tasks you complete, the more areas you can unlock.
translation: Ne kadar çok görev tamamlarsaniz, o kadar çok alanin kilidini açabilirsiniz.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: I see. Thanks!
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: Would you like to take a look at the available areas now?
translation: Simdi mevcut alanlara bir göz atmak ister misiniz?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: What are Relics?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: Relics are powerful artefacts made by me that grant unique abilities for the entire League.
translation: Kalintilar, tüm Lig'e benzersiz yetenekler kazandiran, benim tarafimdan yapilan güçlü eserlerdir.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: You may even recognise a few from Leagues past.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: The first Relic tier is available to everyone. The others must be unlocked with League Points.
translation: Ilk Kalinti seviyesi herkese açiktir. Digerleri Lig Puanlari ile açilmalidir.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: Once you have selected a Relic, your choice can't be changed for the rest of the League. Make your choices carefully.
translation: Bir Kalinti seçtikten sonra, Lig'in geri kalaninda seçiminizi degistiremezsiniz. Seçimlerinizi dikkatli yapin.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: You do not appear to have any combat achievement rewards available to claim.
translation: Görünüse göre alabileceginiz herhangi bir savas basari ödülü yok.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: Can I claim some combat achievement rewards?
translation: Bazi savas basari ödüllerini alabilir miyim?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: Oh, how have you been getting on?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: I've completed some more Combat Achievement tasks!
translation: Bazi Savas Basari görevlerini daha tamamladim!
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: I can see that. Nice job. You'll be expecting your medium rewards?
translation: Görüyorum. Aferin. Orta düzey ödüllerini mi bekliyorsun?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: Yes please!
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: There you go. I've provided you with one of our more modest ancient sword hilts. You'll also have an easier time obtaining medium clues, increased max quantities offered when given boss Slayer tasks, bonus tokens
translation: Al bakalim. Sana daha mütevazi antik kiliç kabzalarimizdan birini verdim. Ayrica orta düzey ipuçlarini daha kolay elde edebilecek, patron Slayer görevlerinde sunulan maksimum miktar artacak, Savasçi loncasi
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: from the Warrior guild and two extra commendation points from each Pest Control game. Additionally, equipping one of my sword hilts at the Barrows will prevent your prayer points from being drained and
translation: ve her Pest Control oyunundan iki ekstra takdir puani kazanacaksin. Ek olarak, Barrows'ta kiliç kabzalarimdan birini takarsan, dua puanlarin tükenmeyecek ve
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

translation: Cüce çoklu topun bes ekstra top mermisi alabilecek.

english: Thank you so much!
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: Can I claim any league trophies I may of earned from this league?
translation: Bu ligden kazandigim lig kupalarini alabilir miyim?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: Tell me about League rewards.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: As well as letting you unlock new areas, completing tasks in the League will earn you League Points. The more League Points you have, the more Relic tiers you have available.
translation: Ligde görevleri tamamlayarak yeni alanlarin kilidini açmanin yani sira Lig Puanlari da kazanacaksiniz. Ne kadar çok Lig Puaniniz olursa, o kadar çok Relic kademesine erisebilirsiniz.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: However, alongside allowing you to unlock Relics, League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.
translation: Ancak, Lig Puanlari Relic'lerin kilidini açmanin yani sira Lig Ödül Magazasindan ödüller satin almak için de kullanilabilir.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: What rewards can I buy?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: Oh, all sorts of things. New cosmetic kits, an alternative Home Teleport animation, some rather stylish outfits... and much more.
translation: Her türlü seyi. Yeni kozmetik kitleri, alternatif Ev Teleport animasyonu, oldukça sik kiyafetler... ve çok daha fazlasi.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: Many of these rewards can be traded with your fellow mortals, so if you wish, you can earn some money by selling them on. Of course, you might prefer to keep them for yourself instead.
translation: Bu ödüllerin çogu diger ölümlülerle takas edilebilir, yani isterseniz bunlari satarak biraz para kazanabilirsiniz. Tabii ki, bunlari kendiniz için saklamayi tercih edebilirsiniz.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: I see. That all sounds good to me.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: Would you like to look at the rewards shop?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: You can use this shop to buy previous League rewards, too.
translation: Bu magazadan önceki Lig ödüllerini de satin alabilirsiniz.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: Alongside the rewards in the Leagues Reward Shop, there's also League Ranks.
translation: Lig Ödül Magazasindaki ödüllerin yani sira Lig Siralamalari da vardir.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: League Ranks? How do they work?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: During the League as you gain more points you will gain a League Rank. This rank can be seen in the Ranks interface.
translation: Lig sirasinda daha fazla puan kazandikça Lig Siralamasi kazanirsiniz. Bu siralama, Siralamalar arayüzünde görülebilir.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: You currently have the rank: Unranked.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: As you get ranks you will gain access to trophies.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: Trophies?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: That's right. Trophies are items that are awarded to you for competing in the League. You can use them to show off your League Rank.
translation: Evet, dogru. Kupalar, Lig'de yaristiginiz için size verilen ögelerdir. Bunlari Lig Siralamanizi göstermek için kullanabilirsiniz.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: Connected to League Ranks are the League to League rewards. These are unlocked in the next League based upon the League Rank you earn in this one.
translation: Lig Siralamalari ile baglantili olan Ligden Lig'e ödülleri vardir. Bunlar, bu Lig'de kazandiginiz Lig Siralamasina göre bir sonraki Lig'de açilir.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: League Starter Outfits and League Icons are some of things you can unlock for the next League. In addition, any pets you earn in this League will transfer over to the next one.
translation: Lig Baslangiç Kiyafetleri ve Lig Simgeleri, bir sonraki Lig için açabileceginiz ögelerden bazilaridir. Ayrica, bu Lig'de kazandiginiz tüm evcil hayvanlar bir sonraki Lig'e aktarilir.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: Finally, on top of the tasks for this League, there are some other activities for which I will recognise the first person who completes them.
translation: Son olarak, bu Lig'deki görevlerin yani sira, ilk tamamlayan kisiyi ödüllendirecegim baska etkinlikler de var.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: You can view the entire list of activities, as well as whether or not someone has completed them, by reading the board beside me.
translation: Etkinliklerin tam listesini ve bunlarin tamamlanip tamamlanmadigini yanimdaki panodan görebilirsiniz.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: My pleasure. Now, is there anything else you need from me?
translation: Rica ederim. Baska bir sey var mi?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: Let's talk about pets.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: Can you tell me how pets work in Leagues?
translation: Liglerde evcil hayvanlar nasil çalisir, anlatabilir misiniz?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: But of course. If you're lucky enough to obtain a pet during a League, it will automatically be insured for you.
translation: Tabii ki. Lig sirasinda bir evcil hayvan elde etme sansiniz varsa, otomatik olarak sigortalanir.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: This means that if you lose it somehow you can talk to me and I'll give it back to you. Insurance and reclaiming is all free of charge.
translation: Bu, bir sekilde kaybettiginizde bana gelip geri alabileceginiz anlamina gelir. Sigorta ve geri alma islemleri tamamen ücretsizdir.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: Additionally, each pet you obtain will be transferred to the next League. I'll take good care of it until you're ready to reclaim it.
translation: Ayrica, edindiginiz her evcil hayvan bir sonraki Lig'e aktarilacaktir. Siz onu geri almaya hazir olana kadar ona iyi bakacagim.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: Okay! Thank you.
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: Come back to me once you have some pets and you can view your collection. Now, is there anything else you need from me?
translation: Bazi evcil hayvanlar edindiginizde bana geri dönün, koleksiyonunuzu görebilirsiniz. Simdi, benden baska bir sey isteyecek misiniz?
sub_category: Dialogue for The Sage (Trailblazer Reloaded League)

english: With all of my power, this is something I can manage. You will now automatically smash vials.
translation: Tüm gücümle, bunu yapabilirim. Artik siseleri otomatik olarak kiracaksiniz.

english: Hello.
Good day.
Good day, Your Royal Highness.
Oi!
Rahr!
No!
Grr!
Aargh!
I'm a gonner!
It's no use, I'm done for!
Uggh!
Good day, [sir/madam].
What are you doing down here?
We're extending the cave so more people can live in it.
translation: Daha fazla insanin yasayabilmesi için magarayi genisletiyoruz.

english: These Miscellanians aren't so bad. They appreciate the benefits of living underground.
translation: Bu Miscellanians o kadar da kötü degil. Yeraltinda yasamanin faydalarini takdir ediyorlar.

english: ...such as?
You don't get rained on, for example.
Of course, there are some problems, like the monsters Donal saw...
translation: Tabii ki, Donal'in gördügü canavarlar gibi bazi sorunlar da var...

english: Someone saw a monster?
Could you tell me more? The King asked me to investigate.
translation: Biraz daha anlatir misin? Kral arastirmami istedi.

english: One of the other dwarves who was working with us saw it. His name's Donal.
translation: Bizimle birlikte çalisan diger cücelerden biri gördü. Adi Donal.

english: He went further into the caves to plan our excavations, and a while later he came out shaking.
translation: Kazi planlarimizi yapmak için magaranin derinliklerine gitti ve bir süre sonra titreyerek çikti.

english: He's been in the inn ever since.
Good day.
Have you spoken to Donal?
Not yet, no.
Well, if you want to hear stories about monsters, he's the best one to ask.
translation: Canavarlarla ilgili hikayeler duymak istiyorsan, ona sormalisin.

english: Not getting rained on, for example.
I have. The monster he talked about could be in the caves nearby.
translation: Konustum. Bahsettigi canavar yakinlardaki magaralarda olabilir.

english: You'd better get in there and do something about it, then.
translation: O zaman oraya gidip bir seyler yapmalisin.

english: It's not safe. I need to shore up the walls before I can go through.
translation: Güvenli degil. Içeri girebilmek için önce duvarlari saglamlastirmam gerekiyor.

english: Did you do anything about that monster Donal was talking about?
translation: Donal'in bahsettigi canavarla ilgili bir sey yaptin mi?

english: It's been taken care of.
Glad to hear it. Now we can get on with excavating.
translation: Bunu duyduguma sevindim. Artik kaziya devam edebiliriz.

english: What are you doing down here?
Good day.
Urg!
Aye, top o' th' mornin' to ya! Are ye wantin' help with th' tool store?
translation: Evet, günaydin! Alet deposunda yardima ihtiyacin var mi?

english: Why are you sunbathing up a mountain?
We tool leprechauns work hard, that we do. An' nary a penny do we get in return. So ye cannae begrudge me mah holiday an' a wee drink or twelve!
translation: Biz alet cüceleri çok çalisiriz. Ve karsiliginda bir kurus bile almayiz. O yüzden tatilimi ve bir iki içki içmemi kiskanma!

english: Yes, very nice, but why are you sunbathing up a mountain? Surely a beach would be more appropriate?
translation: Evet, çok güzel, ama neden dagda günesleniyorsun? Plaj daha uygun olmaz miydi?

english: Ahh, but I likes th' ruggedy mountain, ye see. Also, I ha' a terrible allergy to sand.
translation: Ahh, ama ben engebeli daglari severim. Ayrica kuma karsi çok alerjim var.

english: Fair enough, I suppose.
So were ye wantin' help with th' tool store?
translation: Peki, alet deposunda yardima ihtiyacin var mi?

english: No thanks, I'll keep hold of my stuff.
Ye must be dafter than ye look if ye likes luggin' yer tools everywhere ye goes!
translation: Gittigin her yere aletlerini tasimayi seviyorsan, göründügünden daha aptal olmalisin!

english: Would you like to trade?
Ach! Can ye no' leave a body to ha' a little peace? Very well, I have a bit o' stuff to trade with ye. But don't be expectin' yerself any discounts.
translation: Ach! Bir insana biraz huzur birakamaz misin? Pekala, seninle takas edecek birkaç seyim var. Ama indirim bekleme.

english: Are you going to move that other deckchair?
An' get ambushed by that damn bird again? Nae, I'll be keeping my distance, thank ye very much!
translation: Yine o lanet kusun saldirisina mi ugrayacaksin? Hayir, mesafemi koruyacagim, çok tesekkürler!

english: Plus, if ye've got a farmin' patch up 'ere, th' union boys'll want me posted nearer it.
translation: Ayrica, burada bir çiftlik arazin varsa, sendika üyeleri beni oraya daha yakin bir yere yerlestirmek isteyeceklerdir.

english: I'm not one of them farmin' leprechauns! I don't want yer garbage!
translation: Ben çiftçi leprikonlardan biri degilim! Çöpünü istemiyorum!

english: Yes please.
Why are you sunbathing up a mountain?
No thanks, I'll keep hold of my stuff.
Would you like to trade?
Are you going to move that other deckchair?
Take that you thief!
Hello?
Ssshhh! What do you want?
Well, it's not every day you see a man up a tree.
translation: Her gün agaçta bir adam görmezsin.

english: I'm trying to observe a suspect. Leave me alone!
translation: Bir süpheliyi gözlemlemeye çalisiyorum. Beni rahat birak!
