english: What's this all about?
Hadn't you heard? You'd better go and talk to the other guard, the one by the bank door. He'll tell you all about it.
translation: Duymadin mi? Gidip banka kapisinin yanindaki diger güvenlik görevlisiyle konussan iyi olur. O sana her seyi anlatir.

english: Go on, ask him what's wrong with the bank wall. He loves when people ask him that.
translation: Hadi, ona banka duvarinin ne sorunu oldugunu sor. Insanlarin ona bunu sormasini çok sever.

english: Ok, if you say so..
This is about the bank robbery, right?
translation: Bu banka soygunuyla ilgili, degil mi?

english: Yes, that's right. We're keeping the suspect under tight observation for the moment.
translation: Evet, dogru. Su anda süpheliyi siki gözetim altinda tutuyoruz.

english: Can't you just... I dunno... arrest him?
I'm not meant to discuss the case. You know what confidentiality rules are like.
translation: Bu davayi tartismamam gerekiyor. Gizlilik kurallarini bilirsiniz.

english: Fair enough.
You're not being very subtle up there.
I'd be doing a lot better if nits like you didn't come crowding around me all day!
translation: Senin gibi sinekler bütün gün etrafimda dolanmasa çok daha iyi olurdu!

english: But your legs are hanging down!
Go away!
Please yourself!
Can I do anything to help?
That's very kind of you. I'd rather like a nice bowl of stew, if you could fetch me one. I don't get many meal breaks.
translation: Çok naziksin. Eger bana bir kase güveç getirebilirsen, çok sevinirim. Yemek molasi pek alamiyorum da.

english: You want a bowl of stew?
If you wouldn't mind...
I'll think about it!
Yes, what do you... I say, is that stew for me?
translation: Evet, ne... Bu güveç benim için mi?

english: Ok, take the stew!
Gosh, that's very kind of you! Here, have a few coins for your trouble...
translation: Vay canina, çok naziksin! Al, zahmetin için birkaç bozuk para...

english: The guard eats the stew
The guard drops the empty bowl out of the tree!
translation: Muhafiz bos kaseyi agaçtan asagi atar!

english: No, I want to keep this stew!
Fair enough. But if you change your mind, I'll probably still be here.
translation: Haklisin. Ama fikrini degistirirsen, muhtemelen hala burada olacagim.

english: Here's some stew.
I think I should leave him in peace to finish his stew!
translation: Onu rahat birakip güvecini bitirmesine izin vermeliyim!

english: Why the demoninikinare you waving THAT at me?
Sorry, I thought you'd like it.
Erm... No thanks! Now, if you don't mind, I'm trying to observe this suspect!
translation: Erm... Hayir, tesekkürler! Simdi, sakincasi yoksa, bu süpheliyi gözlemlemeye çalisiyorum!

english: Sorry!
Ooooch!
Oi!
Watch what you're doing with that axe, you nit!
translation: O baltayla ne yaptigini dikkat et, seni aptal!

english: You'll blow my cover! I'm meant to be hidden!
translation: Kimligimi açiga çikaracaksin! Gizli kalmam gerekiyor!

english: Will you stop that?
Don't draw attention to me!
Hey - gerroff me!
Ow! That really hurt!
This is about the bank robbery, right?
translation: Bu banka soygunuyla ilgili, degil mi?

english: You're not being very subtle up there.
Can I do anything to help?
Ok, take the stew!
No, I want to keep this stew!
You must defeat me before touching the tree!
Good day.
Hey there. Things are much nicer around here now that the war is over.
translation: Merhaba. Savas bittigi için burasi artik çok daha güzel.

english: Good to hear.
You need help [TzHaar caste]-[player name]?
Are you not [TzHaar caste]-[player name]?
What's a '[TzHaar caste]'?
That what you are... you tough and strong no?
translation: Sen öyle birisin... sert ve güçlü, degil mi?

english: That what you are... you user of mystic powers no?
translation: Sen öyle birisin... mistik güçlerin kullanicisi, degil mi?

english: That what you are... you agile and quick no?
translation: Sen öyle birisin... çevik ve hizli, degil mi?

english: That what you are... you skilled at making things no?
translation: Sen öyle birisin... bir seyler yapmada yetenekli, degil mi?

english: Well yes I suppose I am...
Then you [TzHaar caste]!
What are you then?
Foolish JalYt, I am TzHaar-Mej, one of the mystics of this city.
translation: Aptal JalYt, ben TzHaar-Mej, bu sehrin mistiklerinden biriyim.

english: What other types are there?
There are the mighty TzHaar-Ket who guard us, the swift TzHaar-Xil who hunt for our food, and the skilled TzHaar-Hur who craft our homes and tools.
translation: Bizi koruyan güçlü TzHaar-Ketler, yiyecegimizi avlayan hizli TzHaar-Xiller ve evlerimizi ve aletlerimizi yapan yetenekli TzHaar-Hurlar var.

english: Ah ok then.
Thanks for explaining it.
I guess so...
Well then, no problems.
No I'm not!
What ever you say, crazy JalYt!
translation: Sen ne dersen o, çilgin JalYt!

english: I have a question about my Achievement Diary.
translation: Basari Günlügümle ilgili bir sorum var.

english: Sorry, JalYt, I am no longer a diary master. Seek the JalYt in the town above, to the west, known as Pirate Jackie.
translation: Üzgünüm JalYt, artik günlük ustasi degilim. Yukaridaki kasabada, batida, Korsan Jackie olarak bilinen JalYt'i ara.

english: No I'm fine thanks.
What did you call me?
What are you then?
What other types are there?
Ah ok then.
Thanks for explaining it.
I guess so...
No I'm not!
I have a question about my Achievement Diary.
translation: Basari Günlügümle ilgili bir sorum var.

english: No I'm fine thanks.
Hello there. What are you doing here?
I'm waiting here hoping that someone can guide me to the Paterdomus, the temple on the Salve.
translation: Biri beni Salve'deki Paterdomus tapinagina götürür diye burada bekliyorum.

english: Where is Paterdomus?
Oh, Paterdomus is that rather impressive looking temple on the Salve... I'm sure you must have passed it on your way into Morytania.
translation: Paterdomus, Salve'deki oldukça etkileyici görünümlü tapinak... Morytania'ya giderken oradan geçmis olmalisin.

english: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
I'm hoping to get back to civilisation and see what the lands of Misthalin look like.
translation: Medeniyete geri dönüp Misthalin topraklarinin nasil bir yer oldugunu görmek istiyorum.

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Paterdomus?
translation: Paterdomus'a giderken düsmanlarla karsilasirsak kendini savunabilir misin?

english: I can defend myself somewhat if we run into trouble...yes, but let's hope that we don't, eh!
translation: Basimiz belaya girerse kendimi biraz savunabilirim... evet, ama umalim da basimiza bela gelmesin, degil mi?

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: Hmmm, görünüse göre bir takipçin var. Kendi basina dolasirsa bu yolculukta kaybolabilir. Takipçin güvende oldugunda yola çikalim.

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: Gerçekten mi? Bu harika olur! Hedefe vardigimizda sana küçük bir ödül verecegim.

english: Temple Trekking begins
Ok, which route should we take?
Ok, thanks.
Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: Ah, bana biraz erzak vermek istiyorsun, ha? Sirt çantami açayim.

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than staying in Burgh de Rott.
translation: Oh, bu yolculuktan nefret ediyorum, ama Burgh de Rott'ta kalmaktan iyidir.

english: It's scary here...let's get going!
When are we going to get to Paterdomus?
We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on.
translation: Bütün gün burada durup sohbet edemeyiz, hadi devam edelim.

english: Do you visit Paterdomus often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: Paterdomus'a sik sik gider misin? Rotayi iyi biliyorsun gibi görünüyor.

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...?
Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Burgh de Rott. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: Hay aksi! Burgh de Rott'a geri dönmek zorunda kalacagiz galiba. O köprüyü geçemeyiz!

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
Player completes the bridge event
Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Burgh de Rott.
translation: Bu is bitti... Görünüse göre bu batakliktan geçemeyecegiz. Burgh de Rott'a geri dönmek zorundayiz.

english: Player completes the bog event
Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: Hey... bu harika... harika bir is çikardin... Seni takip edecegim.

english: Whahay...that was great!
But we really should be heading off now.
Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
Player completes the river event
That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: Bu harika! Ben de aynisini yapmaliyim.

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: Whahay! Harikaydi! Ama artik gerçekten gitmeliyiz.

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
This is scary!
Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
Ahhh, two tentacles!
...three tentacles!
I think I'm going to faint!
Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: Vay canina! Su canavara bak! O seyi kendi basina halletmen gerekecek!

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the temple. Here's your reward.
translation: Beni tapinaga güvenle ulastirdigin için çok tesekkürler. Iste ödülün.

english: Valantay Eppel gives you a reward token!
translation: Valantay Eppel sana bir ödül jetonu veriyor!

english: Where is Paterdomus?
Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
I can take you to Paterdomus.
Ok, thanks.
What do you want?
What's through here?
Ver Sinhaza, home to the Theatre of Blood.
Can I go in?
Yes. Now leave me alone.
Can I go through here?
Yes. Now get lost.
Have I seen you before?
I don't think so... I've just got one of those faces.
translation: Sanmiyorum... Yüzüm öyle bir yüz iste.

english: You're probably right.
I'm rather busy at the moment. I've got to organise my cupboards of jewels.
translation: Su anda oldukça mesgulüm. Mücevher dolaplarimi düzenlemem gerekiyor.

english: Want any help?
Absolutely not! You stay away from my jewels.
Interested in buying a house like mine?
translation: Benimki gibi bir ev satin almak ister misin?

english: Not sure I've got enough coins to do that.
translation: Bunun için yeterli param oldugundan emin degilim.

english: Silly me! I mistook you for one of us wealthy folk.
translation: Ne aptalim! Seni zenginlerden biri sanmistim.

english: Well that's rude.
You'll catch on.
Hello there. Are you liking the city?
It's beautiful!
It really is.
Huh? Are you an encyclopediasalesman?
No, sir, I'm a burglar. I burgle people.
translation: Hayir efendim, ben hirsizim. Insanlari soyarim.

english: Hmm... I think you're an encyclopediasalesman?
Not at all. I just want to ransack the place. Honestly.
translation: Hiç de degil. Sadece burayi talan etmek istiyorum. Gerçekten.

english: Hmm... Alright then.
I've just spent so much money!
Good for you.
I've got something in the back of my mind telling me I should go back home.
translation: Içimden bir ses eve dönmem gerektigini söylüyor.

english: You don't say...
Lovely day for a stroll, wouldn't you say?
translation: Yürüyüs için güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: It is!
Sorry, but I don't have time to chat. I've got important errands to run.
translation: Üzgünüm ama sohbet edecek vaktim yok. Önemli islerim var.

english: I can't talk right now. I'm busy.
Time to go check how rich I am!
translation: Ne kadar zengin oldugumu kontrol etme zamani!

english: Lovely day for a stroll.
You are escorted out of the house as the owner has locked the door.
translation: Ev sahibi kapiyi kilitledigi için evden disari çikarildin.

english: You hear someone outside spot the homeowner coming back!
translation: Disarida birinin ev sahibinin geri geldigini fark ettigini duyuyorsun!

english: Now where did I put my keys...
Ah, there they are!
It smells funny in here...
There's mud all over the floor!
Something isn't right here...
How did you get in here?
The purple, western portal shield is down!
translation: Mor, bati portal kalkani devre disi!

english: The blue, eastern portal shield is down!
translation: Mavi, dogu portal kalkani devre disi!

english: The yellow, south-eastern portal shield is down!
translation: Sari, güneydogu portal kalkani devre disi!

english: The red, south-western portal shield is down!
translation: Kirmizi, güneybati portal kalkani devre disi!

english: Clear off food sack.
Could you send me to the mines?
You want to go to the mines? Well that's a new one. You asked for it though...
translation: Madenlere mi gitmek istiyorsun? Bu yeni bir sey. Sen istedin ama...

english: Sorry.
Need something?
Could you escort me to the mines?
Yes. I can provide you with a teleport there.
I'm good.
Could you send me to the mines?
Sorry.
Could you escort me to the mines?
I'm good.
Yes? Do you have business with one of the prisoners?
translation: Evet? Mahkumlardan biriyle isin mi var?

english: I don't think so. What are they in for?
Does it matter? They are criminals.
Are all criminals the same?
They will be if they're found guilty.
What happens if they are?
In most cases, death.
Ah, nice. Bit brutal though, right?
translation: Ah, güzel. Biraz acimasiz ama, degil mi?

english: Brutal? Yes. Effective? Yes.
translation: Acimasiz mi? Evet. Etkili mi? Evet.

english: Fair enough.
Hello there traveller.
What are you camped here for?
We're looking for Zanaris...GAH! I mean we're not here for any particular reason at all.
translation: Zanaris'i ariyoruz... GAH! Yani, burada özel bir nedenimiz yok.

english: Who's Zanaris?
Ahahahaha! Zanaris isn't a person! It's a magical hidden city filled with treasures and rich.. uh, nothing. It's nothing.
translation: Ahahahaha! Zanaris bir kisi degil! Hazinelerle ve zenginlikle dolu gizli bir sehir... uh, hiçbir sey. Hiçbir sey.

english: If it's hidden how are you planning to find it?
Well, we don't want to tell anyone else about that, because we don't want anyone else sharing in all that glory and treasure.
translation: Sey, bunu kimseye söylemek istemiyoruz, çünkü bu ihtisami ve hazineleri baskalariyla paylasmak istemiyoruz.

english: Well, it looks to me like YOU don't know EITHER seeing as you're all just sat around here.
translation: Bana öyle geliyor ki, siz de bilmiyorsunuz, çünkü hepiniz burada oturmus bekliyorsunuz.

english: Of course we know! We just haven't found which tree the stupid leprechaun's hiding in yet!
translation: Tabii ki biliyoruz! Sadece aptal cinin hangi agacin içinde saklandigini henüz bulamadik!

english: Leprechaun?
GAH! I didn't mean to tell you that! Look, just forget I said anything okay?
translation: GAH! Sana söylemek istemedim! Bak, söylediklerimi unut, tamam mi?

english: So a leprechaun knows where Zanaris is eh?
translation: Demek bir cüce Zanaris'in yerini biliyor, ha?

english: Ye.. uh, no. No, not at all. And even if he did - which he doesn't - he DEFINITELY ISN'T hiding in some tree around here. Nope, definitely not. Honestly.
translation: Ye... uh, hayir. Hayir, hiç de degil. Ve bilse bile - ki bilmiyor - kesinlikle buradaki agaçlarin arasinda saklanmiyor. Hayir, kesinlikle degil. Gerçekten.

english: Thanks for the help!
Help? What help? I didn't help! Please don't say I did, I'll get in trouble!
translation: Yardim mi? Ne yardimi? Ben yardim etmedim! Lütfen yardim ettigimi söyleme, basim belaya girer!

english: So let me get this straight: I need to search the trees around here for a leprechaun; and then when I find him, he will tell me where this 'Zanaris' is?
translation: Sunu bir netlestirelim: Buradaki agaçlari leprechaun aramak için aramam gerekiyor; ve onu buldugumda, bana bu 'Zanaris'in nerede oldugunu söyleyecek mi?

english: What? How did you know that? Uh... I mean, no, no you're very wrong. Very wrong, and not right at all, and I definitely didn't tell you about that at all.
translation: Ne? Bunu nereden biliyorsun? Uh... Yani, hayir, hayir, çok yaniliyorsun. Çok yaniliyorsun, hiç de dogru degil ve ben sana kesinlikle bundan bahsetmedim.

english: Right... Well good luck with it.
There's no such thing!
When we've found Zanaris you'll... GAH! I mean, we're not here for any particular reason at all.
translation: Zanaris'i buldugumuzda sen... GAH! Yani, biz burada özel bir amaç için bulunmuyoruz.

english: What's Zanaris?
I don't think we want other people competing with us to find it. Forget I said anything.
translation: Baskalarinin bizimle rekabet etmesini istemiyoruz. Söylediklerimi unut.

english: Oh well. Never mind.
What makes you think it's out here?
Don't you know of the legends that tell of the magical city, hidden in the swam... Uh, no, you're right, we're wasting our time here.
translation: Bataklikta gizlenmis sihirli sehirle ilgili efsaneleri bilmiyor musun... Uh, hayir, haklisin, burada zamanimizi bosa harciyoruz.

english: Do you know any good adventures I can go on?
translation: Gidebilecegim iyi bir macera biliyor musun?

english: Well we're on an adventure right now. Mind you, this is OUR adventure and we don't want to share it - find your own!
translation: Su anda bir maceranin içindeyiz. Unutma, bu bizim maceramiz ve paylasmak istemiyoruz - kendin bul!

english: Please tell me?
No.
Please?
No!
PLEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEASE?
NO!
I don't think you've found a good adventure at all!
translation: Bence hiç iyi bir macera bulamadin!

english: Hah! Adventurers of our calibre don't just hang around in forests for fun, whelp!
translation: Hah! Bizim kalibremizdeki maceracilar eglence için ormanda dolasmazlar, velet!

english: Oh really?
Have you found anything yet?
We're still searching for Zanaris...GAH! I mean we're not doing anything here at all.
translation: Hala Zanaris'i ariyoruz... GAH! Yani burada hiçbir sey yapmiyoruz.

english: I haven't found it yet either.
Hey, thanks for all the information. It REALLY helped me out in finding the lost city of Zanaris and all.
translation: Hey, tüm bilgiler için tesekkürler. Kayip sehir Zanaris'i bulmamda bana GERÇEKTEN yardimci oldu.

english: Oh please don't say that anymore! If the rest of my party knew I'd helped you they'd probably throw me out and make me walk home by myself!
translation: Lütfen bunu bir daha söyleme! Eger diger arkadaslarim sana yardim ettigimi bilselerdi, muhtemelen beni kovup eve yürüyerek gitmemi isterlerdi!

english: You know.... I think I'll keep that to myself.
translation: Biliyor musun... Sanirim bunu kendime saklayacagim.

english: So anyway, what have you found out? Where is the fabled Zanaris? Is it all the legends say it is?
translation: Neyse, ne buldun? Efsanevi Zanaris nerede? Efsanelerde anlatildigi gibi mi?

english: What are you camped out here for?
Who's Zanaris?
If it's hidden how are you planning to find it?
translation: Eger gizliyse, onu nasil bulmayi planliyorsunuz?

english: Please tell me.
Looks like you don't know either.
Yes.
No
There's no such thing.
What's Zanaris?
What makes you think it's out here?
Oh well. Never mind.
There's no such thing!
Do you know any good adventures I can go on?
translation: Gidebilecegim iyi bir macera biliyor musun?

english: I don't think you've found a good adventure at all!
translation: Bence hiç iyi bir macera bulamadin!

english: Hey!
What?
What are you doing?
Waiting.
For what?
For you to go away.
Oh... okay.
There's nothing good to drink here.
translation: Burada içecek iyi bir sey yok.

english: What's wrong with blood?
Blood's only good if there's meat to go with it.
Why even come here if there's nothing for you to drink?
translation: Içecek bir sey yoksa neden buraya geldin?

english: I'm here on business.
What business?
My business is none of your business. Go poke your nose somewhere else.
translation: Benim isim seni ilgilendirmez. Git baska bir yere burnunu sok.

english: Don't disturb me. I need to guard the tithes.
translation: Beni rahatsiz etme. Vergi gelirlerini korumam lazim.

english: Why? Where would they even go if they escaped?
Escape? I'm not here to stop them escaping. I'm here to stop them getting stolen.
translation: Kaçmak mi? Ben onlarin kaçmasini engellemek için burada degilim. Çalinmalarini engellemek için buradayim.

english: Oh...
Now take your stupid questions somewhere else. I have a job to do.
translation: Simdi aptal sorularini baska bir yere götür. Yapmam gereken bir is var.

english: You shouldn't be here, slave. Go back to your master before you get yourself killed.
translation: Burada olmamalisin köle. Öldürülmeden önce efendinin yanina dön.

english: Hi!
Hi!
So, what you up to out here?
Oh...er...nothing!
Hello there. What are you doing all the way out here?
Nothing you need to worry about.
So this is where you scampered off to after the monster awoke?
translation: Demek canavar uyandiktan sonra buraya kaçtin?

english: Look [player name], it was a simple misunderstanding, that's all...
translation: Bak Maceraci, bu sadece basit bir yanlis anlasilmaydi, hepsi bu...

english: Oh really? You threatening to kill me was just a misunderstanding?
translation: Oh, gerçekten mi? Beni öldürmekle tehdit etmen sadece bir yanlis anlasilmaymis?

english: Things got a little heated down there, but we all made it out alive, right?
translation: Orada isler biraz kizisti, ama hepimiz sag salim kurtulduk, degil mi?

english: Barely... I had to defeat that monster on my own!
translation: Zar zor... O canavari tek basima yenmek zorunda kaldim!

english: What are you doing out here, anyway?
We thought you'd rat us out to the authorities, so we came out here to hide.
translation: Bizi yetkililere ihbar edecegini düsündük, bu yüzden buraya saklanmaya geldik.

english: Plus, we heard there are some sealed tombs in the desert that haven't been touched in hundreds of years...
translation: Ayrica, çölde yüzlerce yildir kimsenin dokunmadigi mühürlü mezarlar oldugunu duyduk...

english: Ah, of course... scoping out your next grave to rob.
translation: Ah, tabii... Soymak için bir sonraki mezarini arastiriyorsun.

english: What are you doing here?
I've heard there is a powerful magic presence in these lands, I'm gathering notes to take back with me to the Wizards' Tower.
translation: Bu topraklarda güçlü bir sihirli varligin oldugunu duydum, Büyücü Kulesi'ne götürmek için notlar topluyorum.

english: What are you doing?
When we heard of a magical presence in the Western lands, the Wizards' Tower had no choice but to send out a research party.
translation: Bati topraklarinda büyülü bir varlik oldugunu duydugumuzda, Büyücüler Kulesi bir arastirma ekibi göndermek zorunda kaldi.

english: Learned anything interesting?
Some of these texts describe a 'Dark Altar', one can only imagine what power it possesses.
translation: Bu metinlerin bazilari “Karanlik Sunak”tan bahsediyor, sahip oldugu gücü ancak tahmin edebiliriz.

english: The beings here seem to have transcended beyond the corporeal realm, truly fascinating!
translation: Buradaki varliklar maddi alemin ötesine geçmis gibi görünüyor, gerçekten büyüleyici!

english: A casual game will start in the next [60 - 5x] seconds!
A casual game is starting!
Why are all of you standing around here?
Hahaha you dare talk to a mighty wizard such as myself? I bet you can't even cast windstrike yet amateur!
translation: Hahaha, benim gibi güçlü bir büyücüyle konusmaya cesaret mi ediyorsun? Eminim henüz rüzgar saldirisi bile yapamiyorsundur, amatör!

english: ...You're an idiot.
Found that leprechaun yet?
Hahaha go away amateur! You're not worthy of joining our great group!
translation: Hahaha, git buradan amatör! Bizim harika grubumuza katilmaya layik degilsin!

english: ...right.
Hahaha you're such an amateur!
Go away and play with some cabbage amateur!
translation: Git de lahana ile oyna amatör!

english: All's well that ends well.
translation: Sonu iyi biten her sey iyidir.

english: I've got some questions about the search for evidence.
translation: Kanit arama konusunda bazi sorularim var.

english: You'll have to speak to the Watchtower Wizard about that.
translation: Bunun için Gözcü Kule Büyücüsü ile konusmalisin.

english: I've got some questions regarding the tribal ogres.
translation: Kabile ogreleri ile ilgili bazi sorularim var.

english: It stinks down here.
Can't you just leave me alone.
I don't trust that fish monger.
Lighting fires in an enclosed space is probably not a good idea. Oh well.
translation: Kapali bir alanda ates yakmak iyi bir fikir olmayabilir. Neyse.

english: I guess it's not all bad down here. At least we have a pub.
translation: Burada her sey o kadar da kötü degil galiba. En azindan bir pub var.

english: I'll leave this place one day. You'll see.
Hello there.
Go away. People from the outside shut us in like animals. I have nothing to say to you.
translation: Git buradan. Disaridakiler bizi hayvanlar gibi buraya kapattilar. Sana söyleyecek hiçbir seyim yok.

english: Hello, how's it going?
Life is tough.
Plague? Pah, that's no excuse for the treatment we've received. It's obvious pretty quickly if someone has the plague.
translation: Veba mi? Peh, bu bize yapilan muamelenin mazereti olamaz. Birinin vebaya yakalandigi hemen anlasilir.

english: I'm thinking about making a break for it. I'm perfectly healthy, not gonna infect anyone.
translation: Kaçmayi düsünüyorum. Ben tamamen saglikliyim, kimseye bulastirmam.

english: Well, ain't much either you or me can do about it.
translation: Ne sen ne de ben bu konuda pek bir sey yapamayiz.

english: Good day.
His army curses our city with this plague then wanders off again, leaving us to clear up the pieces
translation: Ordusu bu vebayla sehrimizi lanetliyor, sonra da ortadan kayboluyor ve bize temizlik isini birakiyor.

english: Bah, those mourners... they're meant to be helping us, but I think they're doing more harm here than good. They won't even let me send a letter to my family.
translation: Bah, su yas tutanlar... bize yardim etmeleri gerekirken, bence burada yarardan çok zarar veriyorlar. Aileme mektup bile göndermiyorlar.

english: Hello!
Hello friend. I wish to slay evil and avail them of their loot! Take me to Burgh de Rott!
translation: Merhaba dostum. Kötülügü yok etmek ve ganimetlerini ele geçirmek istiyorum! Beni Burgh de Rott'a götür!

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: Oradaki kötülükle savasmaya yeterince hazir misin?

english: I think so? At least my heart knows courage and that should be sufficient for the meantime. I expect that when we get to Burgh de Rott, we'll be able to purchase suitable provisions.
translation: Sanirim öyle? En azindan kalbim cesaretli ve bu simdilik yeterli olmali. Burgh de Rott'a vardigimizda uygun erzak satin alabilecegimizi umuyorum.

english: But you do realise that the vampyres in Morytania are immune to everything except silver?
translation: Ama Morytania'daki vampirlerin gümüs disinda her seye karsi bagisik olduklarini biliyorsun, degil mi?

english: Er...well, I've not heard mention of that fact, but I have faith that Saradomin will provide the means to furnish me with suitable weapons when I reach Burgh de Rott.
translation: Sey... Bu gerçegi duymadim, ama Burgh de Rott'a vardigimda Saradomin'in bana uygun silahlar saglayacagina inaniyorum.

english: And if we happen to run into some vampyres on the journey down there?

I trust that you will help us to avoid them. You are a guide after all, aren't you? Anyway, you look like you can handle yourself. I presume you've fought such creatures before and won? How hard can it be?
translation: Onlardan kaçinmamiza yardim edecegine inaniyorum. Sonuçta sen bir rehbersin, degil mi? Her neyse, kendin halledebilecek gibi görünüyorsun. Daha önce bu tür yaratiklarla savasip kazandin sanirim? Ne kadar zor olabilir ki?

english: It can be pretty difficult, actually. But you're right, I'll be your guide so I should be able to handle the situation.
translation: Aslinda oldukça zor olabilir. Ama haklisin, ben rehberinim, bu yüzden durumu halledebilmeliyim.

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Neden Burgh de Rott'a gitmek istiyorsun?

english: I'm going down there to teach those vampyres a lesson or two. I've heard about the terrible conditions down there and I intend to put a stop to it.
translation: Oradaki vampirleri bir ders vermek için gidiyorum. Oradaki korkunç kosullari duydum ve buna bir son vermek niyetindeyim.

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Burgh de Rott'a giderken yol üzerinde düsmanlarla karsilasirsak kendini savunabilir misin?

english: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of enemies. You don't need to worry about that.
translation: Diyelim ki biraz tecrübeliyim ve düsmanlarla savasmaktan çekinmem. Bu konuda endiselenmene gerek yok.

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: Hmmm, görünüse göre bir takipçin var. Kendi basina dolasirsa bu yolculukta kaybolabilir. Takipçin güvenli bir yere ulastiginda yola çikalim.

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: Gerçekten mi? Harika olur! Hedefe ulastigimizda sana küçük bir ödül verecegim.

english: Burgh de Rott Ramble begins
Ok, which route should we take?
Ok, thanks.
Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: Ah, bana biraz erzak vermek istiyorsun, ha? Sirt çantami açayim.

english: This place is a bit grim. How can people live here?
translation: Burasi biraz kasvetli. Insanlar burada nasil yasayabiliyor?

english: Do you visit Burgh de Rott often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: Burgh de Rott'a sik sik gelir misin? Rotayi iyi biliyorsun gibi görünüyor.

english: When are we going to get to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Burgh de Rott'a ne zaman varacagiz?

english: We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on. I have loot to get.
translation: Bütün gün burada durup sohbet edemeyiz, hadi devam edelim. Yagmalayacak seyler var.

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than the opulet life styles forced on us adventurer types. I'd much rather be up to my eyes in mud and having a good fight!
translation: Bu yolculuktan nefret ediyorum, ama maceraperestlere dayatilan lüks yasam tarzindan daha iyidir. Gözlerime kadar çamura batip iyi bir kavga etmeyi tercih ederim!

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...
Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Paterdomus. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: Hay aksi! Görünüse göre Paterdomus'a geri dönmek zorundayiz. O köprüden geçemeyiz!

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
Player completes the bridge event
Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Paterdomus.
translation: Bu is bitti... Görünüse göre bu batakliktan geçemeyecegiz. Paterdomus'a geri dönmek zorundayiz.

english: Player completes the bog event
Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: Hey... bu harika... harika bir is çikardin... Seni takip edecegim.

english: Whahay...that was great!
But we really should be heading off now.
Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
Player completes the river event
That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: Bu harika! Ben de aynisini yapmaliyim.

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: Vay canina! Harikaydi! Ama artik gerçekten yola çikmaliyiz.

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
This is scary!
Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
Ahhh, two tentacles!
...three tentacles!
I think I'm going to faint!
Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: Vay canina! Su canavara bak! O seyi kendi basina halletmen gerekecek!

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the Burgh de Rott. Here's your reward.
translation: Beni Burgh de Rott'a güvenle ulastirdigin için çok tesekkürler. Iste ödülün.

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: Oradaki kötülükle savasmaya yeterince hazir misin?

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Neden Burgh de Rott'a gitmek istiyorsun?

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
Ok, thanks.
Hello there.
Leave me alone. I have work to do.
translation: Beni rahat birak. Yapacak isim var.

english: Whatever you want, the answer's no.
I don't have time to talk to you.
Please don't disturb me.
I'm busy right now.
Hello there.
Leave me alone. I have work to do.
Whatever you want, the answer's no.
I don't have time to talk to you.
Please don't disturb me.
I'm busy right now.
Hello.
Hey there!
You seem rather happy for a busy labourer with a bad case of spots.
translation: Sivilceleri olan mesgul bir isçiye göre oldukça mutlu görünüyorsun.

english: Of course! These spots are the best thing since log rollers!
translation: Tabii ki! Bu sivilceler, kütük yuvarlamadan bu yana en iyi sey!

english: I really don't follow.
Well thanks to these spots, the city has been under quarantine. That means there's no goods coming in or out. No goods means we don't have any work to do!
translation: Bu lekeler sayesinde sehir karantina altina alindi. Bu da mal giris çikisinin olmadigi anlamina geliyor. Mal giris çikisi olmamasi da bizim isimiz olmadigi anlamina geliyor!

english: But aren't the spots intolerable?
translation: Ama bu lekeler dayanilmaz degil mi?

english: I would take a dermatological irritation over back-breaking, mind-numbing labour any day!
translation: Sirtimi kiran, zihnimi uyusturan istense dermatolojik bir tahrisi tercih ederim!

english: Right... Okay then...
Hey.
What's wrong?
The High Priest has determined that these spots aren't contagious. He's opened the city up again, which means we have to go back to work.
translation: Basrahip bu lekelerin bulasici olmadigina karar verdi. Sehri tekrar açti, bu da ise geri dönmemiz gerektigi anlamina geliyor.

english: Now that all the plagues have been cured, we've had to go back to work.
translation: Tüm salginlar tedavi edildigine göre, ise geri dönmek zorundayiz.

english: Cheer up! Work can't be that bad.
translation: Neselen! Is o kadar da kötü olamaz.

english: You have no idea...
What are you doing?
I have this acne potion that I thought might clear up your spots?
translation: Sivilcelerini temizleyebilecegini düsündügüm bir sivilce ilaci var.

english: What, so that I can get back to work?
translation: Ne, isime geri dönebilmem için mi?

english: So that you don't suffer needlessly?
I know your type, trying to ruin the small man's fun! I won't have it!
translation: Senin gibileri tanirim, küçük adamin eglencesini mahvetmeye çalisirsiniz! Buna izin vermeyecegim!

english: Look, I'm sorry. I only wanted to help you.
translation: Bak, özür dilerim. Sadece sana yardim etmek istedim.

english: Clear off!
Hello there.
No, I don't want to buy anything.
Can't stop to talk. I have work to do.
translation: Konusacak vaktim yok. Yapacak isim var.

english: I'm busy right now.
I don't have time to talk to you.
Please don't disturb me.
Hello there!
Oh, hello.
How are things going up here?
The beast still rages, but we're managing.
translation: Canavar hâlâ öfkeli ama idare ediyoruz.

english: Plenty of treasure and materials to be found in the tunnels, at least!
translation: En azindan tünellerde bol miktarda hazine ve malzeme var!

english: What will you do with it all?
The raw materials will be used to maintain Cam Torum. As for everything else, if you help us, you're allowed a share of the treasures.
translation: Hammaddeler Cam Torum'u korumak için kullanilacak. Diger her sey için ise, bize yardim ederseniz hazinelerden pay alabilirsiniz.

english: That's very generous, thank you.
Hello!
Hmm? Did you say something?
I said hello.
Oh, that's nice.
Are you okay?
Why wouldn't I be? I'm not the one lost in the mountain!
translation: Neden iyi olmayayim ki? Dagda kaybolan ben degilim!

english: Excuse me? Who's lost in the mountain?
Karlo! Oh sweet Karlo... An inspiration to us all!
translation: Karlo! Ah, tatli Karlo... Hepimize ilham kaynagi olan Karlo!

english: He really knew how to swing a pickaxe, but where did that get him?!
translation: Kazmayi nasil kullanacagini çok iyi biliyordu, ama bu ona ne kazandirdi ki?

english: Trapped in the depths under all that rock and stone...
translation: Tüm o kaya ve taslarin altinda, derinliklerde mahsur kaldi...

english: Do you think he's still alive?
I don't know.
What I do know is that I do this for Karlo. Let's make him proud!
translation: Bildigim tek sey, bunu Karlo için yaptigim. Onu gururlandirmaliyiz!

english: For Karlo!
For Karlo!
Into the tunnels, quick!
Let's go!
Quickly, while it's recovering!
What's it left this time?
It's coming back!
Prepare yourselves!
Retreat!
Run!
Hi there.
Can I help you?
I don't know. Can you?
Probably not. I'm on break.
Break from what?
See that big mountain outside? That's the Darkfrost. There's a nice beastie up there called the Hueycoatl.
translation: Disaridaki büyük dagi görüyor musun? Orasi Darkfrost. Orada Hueycoatl adinda hos bir canavar var.

english: You humans don't seem to care that much, so as usual it's up to us to stop it making a big mess of the entire area.
translation: Siz insanlar pek umursamiyor gibisiniz, bu yüzden her zamanki gibi tüm bölgeyi mahvetmesini engellemek bize kalmis.

english: Hello again. Still on break?
I am. Dealing with the Hueycoatl is hard work, and it's not like you humans care enough to contribute much.
translation: Evet. Hueycoatl ile ugrasmak zor bir is ve siz insanlar da pek umursamiyorsunuz.

english: Well, if you're in need of help, I'm open to contributing.
translation: Eger yardima ihtiyacin varsa, ben yardim etmeye hazirim.

english: You are? Oh... Fair enough then. In that case, head on up the mountain and get stuck in.
translation: Öyle mi? Oh... Tamam o zaman. O halde daga çik ve ise koyul.

english: Well, I've actually been up there helping myself.
translation: Aslinda ben de orada kendime yardim ediyordum.

english: You have? Oh... Fair enough then. I guess you've earned yourself a break as well.
translation: Öyle mi? Oh... Tamam o zaman. Sanirim sen de bir mola hak ettin.

english: Hello there. How's it going?
Sorry, but I have lots of work to do.
translation: Üzgünüm, ama yapacak çok isim var.

english: Not too bad, but the work is definitely tiring.
translation: Fena degil, ama is kesinlikle yorucu.

english: Well I could do with a good rest, but fine otherwise.
translation: Iyi bir dinlenmeye ihtiyacim var, ama onun disinda iyiyim.

english: Sorry, but I'm busy right now.
Busy, busy, busy.
Got another load for ya!
Great, just what my arms need!
translation: Harika, tam da kollarimin ihtiyaci olan sey!

english: Ohhh, time for a break.
Time I got moving...
Keep 'em coming!
Bleah
Another lot for ya!
Alright, thanks!
Off we go again!
How's it going, officers?
Another boring day.
Nothing new there.
I'm being slaughtered!
Oh, they're all dead.
Don't dawdle there!
Yeah, yeah, I'm movin' guv.
Hmm, time for a break.
The story isn't true! I had too much rum and ended up here!
translation: Hikaye dogru degil! Çok fazla rom içtim ve buraya geldim!

english: I'm not banished, I've been ship wrecked help!
translation: Sürgün edilmedim, gemi kazasi geçirdim, yardim edin!

english: Save me!
Help! I've been ship wrecked for years!
translation: Yardim edin! Yillardir gemim batik durumda!

english: Durrrr...
Hey! Come over here!
Who? Me?
Yes, you!
Give me a moment...I can't move that fast.
translation: Bana bir dakika ver... O kadar hizli hareket edemem.

english: Why not?
I used to be a magician's assistant until the accident...
What accident?
Looook...
Braaaaains...
Zombie, it has come to my attention that you are a fool, a nitwit if you will.
translation: Zombi, senin bir aptal, hatta bir salak oldugunu fark ettim.

english: I propose that your head, instead of being filled with the brains you so crave, is instead filled with a mixture of crushed lemons and kelp!
translation: Senin kafani, o kadar çok istedigin beyinlerle doldurmak yerine, ezilmis limon ve yosun karisimiyla doldurmayi öneriyorum!

english: Oh noooo..I'd best take it off then...
translation: Olamaz... O zaman onu çikarsam iyi olur...

english: What?
Traaa laaa laaa...
Oogaboogabooga!
Aaaaaargh!
DUUUHHH
Hello! What brings you here?
I'm here to guard this ship from any scurvy dogs darin' to loot her cargo.
translation: Bu gemiyi, yükünü yagmalamaya cüret eden alçak köpeklerden korumak için buradayim.

english: How did your ship end up here?
Arr, 'tis a woeful tale.
Me hearties and I were enjoying a bit o' grog when we espied a group of landlubbers fightin' on the shore. 'Twas such an exciting battle that our navigator forgot to watch for the rocks.
translation: Ben ve arkadaslarim biraz içki içip eglenirken, kiyida bir grup kara adaminin kavga ettigini gördük. O kadar heyecanli bir kavgaydi ki, navigatörümüz kayalari izlemeyi unuttu.

english: Now we've run aground, as ye can see.
Where's the rest of your crew?
They're searchin' for booty at that temple to the west.
Will they return to the ship?
They best do! That scurvy lot keep fillin' their lockers with loot and sneakin' off without swappin' places!
translation: Dönseler iyi olur! O alçaklar dolaplarini ganimetle doldurup, yerlerini degistirmeden gizlice kaçiyorlar!

english: Do you really want to go to the temple? I've heard the mages there have some really annoying spells.
translation: Gerçekten tapinaga gitmek istiyor musun? Oradaki büyücülerin çok sinir bozucu büyüler yaptigini duydum.

english: Nothin' we can't handle! We've a way of stoppin' their tricksy teleports.
translation: Bizim basa çikamayacagimiz bir sey yok! Onlarin hileli isinlanmalarini durdurmanin bir yolunu bulduk.

english: How can a group of mindless zombies invent a counter to magic?
translation: Bir grup akilsiz zombi nasil büyüye karsi bir önlem bulabilir?

english: What we lack in brains, we make up for in gold! We found us a landlubber willin' to share their knowledge... for a price.
translation: Beyin eksikligimizi altinla telafi ediyoruz! Bilgilerini paylasmaya razi olan bir kara adami bulduk... bir bedel karsiliginda.

english: They wrote us down a spell on some magic scrolls. All we 'ave to do is read one, and then we're properly anchored! Those mages can't teleport us anywhere!
translation: Bize sihirli parsömenlere bir büyü yazdilar. Tek yapmamiz gereken onu okumak, sonra da düzgün bir sekilde demir atmak! O büyücüler bizi hiçbir yere isinlayamaz!

english: Wow, I'm actually impressed. Do you think your friends at the temple will lend me one?
translation: Vay canina, gerçekten etkilendim. Tapinaktaki arkadaslarin bana bir tane ödünç verir mi sence?

english: Naw, they're too busy fightin' to talk to the likes of ye. Besides, we stash all our spare scrolls in these lockers for safekeepin'.
translation: Hayir, savasmakla mesguller, senin gibilerle konusacak zamanlari yok. Ayrica, yedek parsömenlerimizi güvenli bir yerde saklamak için bu dolaplara koyuyoruz.

english: Can I take a scroll from a locker, then?
translation: O zaman dolaptan bir parsömen alabilir miyim?

english: Ye'll need a key for that, matey! One of the crew should 'ave one.
translation: Bunun için anahtar lazim dostum! Mürettebattan birinin anahtari olmali.

english: And when ye see 'em, tell 'em it's their turn to keep watch!
translation: Onlari gördügünde, nöbet sirasinin onlara geldigini söyle!

english: There be plenty o' loot in them lockers, matey. Don't expect to find a scroll right away.
translation: O dolaplarda bolca ganimet var dostum. Hemen bir parsömen bulmayi bekleme.

english: Thanks. I'd say 'see you around', but I sort of hope I don't.
translation: Tesekkürler. “Görüsürüz” demek isterdim ama umarim görüsmeyiz.

english: Aye, the feelin's mutual.
Goodbye, I hope your crew comes back soon.
translation: Hosça kal, umarim mürettebatin yakinda geri döner.

english: Arr, me too matey.
Goodbye.
Bye, matey.
Arr, I've still not seen any of my crew.
Oh dear, how strange.
Can you tell if I've used the Teleport anchoring scroll?
translation: Teleport demirleme parsömenini kullanip kullanmadigimi anlayabilir misin?

english: Aye, I can tell by the cut of your jib that ye haven't yet read the Teleport anchoring scroll.
translation: Evet, yelkeninin kesiminden Teleport demirleme parsömenini henüz okumadigini anlayabiliyorum.

english: Aye, I can tell by the cut of your jib that you've read the Teleport anchoring scroll.
translation: Evet, yelkeninin kesiminden Teleport demirleme parsömenini okudugunu anlayabiliyorum.

english: How many times have I opened your lockers?
Ye've never done it even once!
Ye've done it once, and once only.
translation: Bir kez açtin, sadece bir kez.

english: Ye've done it [#] times.
I'll leave you to wait for your crew.
I can tell by the cut of your jib that ye haven't yet read the Teleport anchoring scroll, and ye've never opened our lockers.
translation: Yelkeninizin kesiminden, Teleport demirleme parsömenini henüz okumadiginizi ve dolaplarimizi hiç açmadiginizi anlayabiliyorum.

english: I can tell by the cut of your jib that ye haven't yet read the Teleport anchoring scroll, and ye've opened our lockers once, and once only.
translation: Yelkeninizin kesiminden, Teleport demirleme parsömenini henüz okumadiginizi ve dolaplarimizi bir kez, sadece bir kez açtiginizi anlayabiliyorum.

english: I can tell by the cut of your jib that ye haven't yet read the Teleport anchoring scroll, though ye've opened our lockers [#] times.
I can tell by the cut of your jib that you've read the Teleport anchoring scroll, but ye've never opened our lockers.
translation: Yelkenlerin kesiminden, Teleport demirleme parsömenini okudugunu anlayabiliyorum, ama dolaplarimizi hiç açmadin.

english: I can tell by the cut of your jib that you've read the Teleport anchoring scroll, and ye've opened our lockers once, and once only.
translation: Yelkenlerin kesiminden, Teleport demirleme parsömenini okudugunu ve dolaplarimizi bir kez, sadece bir kez açtigini anlayabiliyorum.

english: I can tell by the cut of your jib that you've read the Teleport anchoring scroll, and ye've opened our lockers [#] times.
Still here?
I've not seen any of my crew yet.
I wonder why.
Where's the rest of your crew?
Do you really want to go to the temple?
Goodbye.
Oh dear, how strange.
Can you tell if I've used the Teleport anchoring scroll?
translation: Teleport sabitleme parsömenini kullandigimi anlayabilir misin?

english: How many times have I opened your lockers?
I'll leave you to wait for your crew.
Hello there.
Now then. Looking to buy some weaponry?
translation: Peki o zaman. Silah mi almak istiyorsun?

english: Let's trade.
No thanks.
I'll be here if you change your mind.
Let's trade.
No thanks
Howdy there partner! Want to see my spinning plates? Or did ya want a holiday item back?
translation: Merhaba dostum! Dönen tabaklarimi görmek ister misin? Yoksa tatil esyasi mi istiyordun?

english: Spinning plates?
That's right. There's a funny story behind them, their shipment was held up by thieves.
translation: Evet. Onlarin arkasinda komik bir hikaye var, sevkiyatlari hirsizlar tarafindan durduruldu.

english: The crate was marked 'Dragon Plates'. Apparently they thought it was some kind of armour, when really it's just a plate with a dragon on it!
translation: Sandikta “Ejderha Tabaklari” yaziyordu. Anlasilan onlar bunun bir tür zirh oldugunu sandilar, oysa aslinda üzerinde ejderha olan bir tabak!

english: I'd like to check holiday items please!
translation: Tatil esyalarini kontrol etmek istiyorum lütfen!

english: Sure thing, let me just see what you're missing.
translation: Tabii, neyin eksik olduguna bir bakayim.

english: What else are you selling?
I'm fine, thanks.
Howdy there partner! You came at just the right time! I've got something for ya!
translation: Merhaba dostum! Tam zamaninda geldin! Senin icin bir seyim var!

english: Oh really? What is it?
Well, I did some rooting around in my house and found this really neat hat.
translation: Evimde biraz arastirma yaptim ve bu cok güzel sapkayi buldum.

english: A hat? What sort of hat...
translation: Sapka mi? Ne tür bir sapka...

english: A banana hat! Would you like it?
Sure, I'll take the hat.
Looks like you've got no space for it, I'll hold onto it till you do. Just come to me to claim it.
translation: Görünüse göre sapka icin yerin yok, yerin olana kadar ben saklayayim. Istediginde bana gel.

english: There you go amigo, enjoy!
So what else can I do for you partner? Want to see my spinning plates? Or did ya want a holiday item back?
translation: Baska ne yapabilirim dostum? Dönen tabaklarimi görmek ister misin? Yoksa tatil esyasini geri mi istiyorsun?

english: No thanks, I don't want it right now.
No problem amigo, come back to me to claim it if you change your mind.
translation: Sorun degil amigo, fikrini degistirirsen gelip alabilirsin.

english: Oh wow, you did it! Well done!
Thank you!
I was wondering when someone would complete this. I've been holding on to the reward for a while.
translation: Bunu ne zaman birinin tamamlayacagini merak ediyordum. Ödülü bir süredir sakliyordum.

english: The being who gave it to me was... rather strange.
translation: Bunu bana veren kisi... oldukca tuhafti.

english: What was their name?
They didn't say. But they did give me some sage advice before they left.
translation: Söylemedi. Ama gitmeden önce bana bazi bilgece tavsiyelerde bulundu.

english: What was it?
I don't remember exactly. Something about making the most of your time...
translation: Tam olarak hatirlamiyorum. Zamanini en iyi sekilde degerlendirmeyle ilgili bir seydi...

english: Thyme!
Where?! I don't see any!
I... don't worry. Thank you for the reward, see you around!
translation: Ben... merak etme. Ödül icin tesekkürler, görüsürüz!

english: See you!
Spinning plates?
I'd like to check holiday items please!
translation: Tatil ürünlerini kontrol etmek istiyorum lütfen!

english: What else are you selling?
I'm fine, thanks.
Yes.
No.
Hello. My name is Dimintheis, of the noble family Fitzharmon.
translation: Merhaba. Benim adim Dimintheis, Fitzharmon soylu ailesindenim.

english: Why would a nobleman live in a dump like this?
translation: Bir soylu neden böyle bir cöplükte yasasin ki?

english: The King has taken my estate from me until such time as I can show my family crest to him.
translation: Kral, ona aile armasini gösterene kadar malimi benden aldi.

english: Why would he do that?
translation: Neden böyle bir sey yapsin ki?

english: Well, there is a long standing rule of chivalry amongst the Varrockian aristocracy, where each noble family is in possession of a unique crest, which signifies the honour and lineage of the family. More than this
translation: Varrock aristokrasisi arasinda uzun süredir gecerli olan bir sövalyelik kurali vardir. Her soylu aile, ailenin onurunu ve soyunu simgeleyen benzersiz bir armanin sahibidir. Ancak bundan daha da önemlisi,

english: however, it also represents the lawful rights of each family to prove their ownership of their wealth and lands. If the family crest is lost, then the family's estate is handed over to the current monarch until the crest is
translation: bu arma her ailenin servet ve topraklarinin sahipligini kanitlama hakkini da temsil eder. Aile armasi kaybolursa, arma geri getirilene kadar ailenin mülkleri mevcut hükümdara devredilir

english: restored.

This dates back to the times when there was much in- fighting amongst the noble families and their clans, and was introduced as a way of reducing the bloodshed that was devestating the ranks of the ruling classes at that
translation: Bu kural, soylu aileler ve klanlari arasinda cok sayida ic catisma oldugu zamanlara dayanir ve o dönemde yönetici siniflarin saflarini tahrip eden kan dökülmesini azaltmak icin getirilmistir.

english: time. When you captured a rival family's clan, you also captured their lands and wealth.
translation: Rakip bir ailenin klanini ele gecirdiginizde, onlarin topraklarini ve servetlerini de ele gecirmis olursunuz.

english: So where is this crest?
Well, my three sons took it with them many years ago when they rode out to fight in the war against the undead necromancer and his army in the battle to save Varrock.

For many years I had assumed them all dead, as I had heard no word from them, but recently I heard word that my son Caleb is alive and well, and trying to earn his fortune as a great chef in the lands beyond White
Wolf Mountain, although I know not where.
translation: Maceraci, sana cok tesekkür ederim! Ayrica... Caleb'i bulursan... lütfen... babasinin onu hala sevdigini söyle...

english: Ok, I will help you.
I thank you greatly adventurer! Also... if you find Caleb... please... let him know his father still loves him...
translation: Cok tesekkür ederim maceraci! Ayrica... Caleb'i bulursan... lütfen... babasinin onu hala sevdigini söyle...

english: I'm not interested in that adventure right now.
I realise it was a lot to ask of a stranger.
translation: Bir yabancidan cok sey istedigimin farkindayim.

english: You're rich then? Can I have some money?
translation: Demek zenginsin? Biraz para alabilir miyim?

english: Gah! Lousy beggar! Your sort is what's ruining this great land! Why don't you just go and get a job if you need money so badly?
translation: Gah! Sefil dilenci! Senin gibiler bu harika ülkeyi mahvediyor! Paraya bu kadar ihtiyacin varsa neden gidip bir is bulmuyorsun?

english: Hi, I am a bold adventurer.
An adventurer hmmm? How lucky. I may have an adventure for you. I desperately need my family crest returning to me. It is of utmost importance.
translation: Maceraci mi? Ne sanslisin. Sana bir macera verebilirim. Aile armami geri almam gerekiyor. Bu cok önemli.

english: Why are you so desperate for it?
Do you have any quests for me? I really want one. I really want to help out!
translation: Bana verebilecegin bir görev var mi? Gercekten istiyorum. Gercekten yardim etmek istiyorum!

english: You murmur under your breath something about how great the rewards were last time you did a quest for Dimintheis.
translation: Dimintheis icin son görevinde ödüllerin ne kadar harika oldugunu fisildayarak söylüyorsun.

english: My family consider what you did for us a great service. We couldn't possibly trouble you further.
translation: Ailem, bizim icin yaptiklarini büyük bir hizmet olarak görüyor. Seni daha fazla rahatsiz edemeyiz.

english: There must be SOMETHING you need help with. I am a great adventurer after all.
translation: Yardimina ihtiyacin olan bir sey olmali. Sonucta ben büyük bir maceraciyim.

english: There really isn't anything, I am very content with life right now.
translation: Gercekten yok, su anda hayatimdan cok memnunum.

english: I guess money really does buy happiness.
translation: Sanirim para gercekten mutluluk satin alabiliyor.

english: What was that? I didn't quite catch that.
Nothing...
Oh come on, surely there's something I can help out with! I want to help, however menial it is.
translation: Hadi ama, mutlaka yardim edebilecegim bir sey vardir! Ne kadar önemsiz olursa olsun yardim etmek istiyorum.

english: Okay okay. Fine then. Whilst I don't have anything for you, how about you try my sons, they are always wanting something done.
translation: Tamam, tamam. Peki o zaman. Size verecek bir seyim yok ama ogullarima bir bakin, her zaman yapacak bir seyler ariyorlar.

english: Fantastic! I'll get straight to it!
You smell the sweet smell of the great rewards that may soon come.
translation: Yakinda alacaginiz büyük ödüllerin tatli kokusunu aliyorsunuz.

english: Hello again, adventurer. I hope that Shield of Arrav business marks the start of something big for my family. Maybe it will help me finally get out of this hole!
translation: Merhaba tekrar, maceraci. Umarim Arrav'in Kalkani isi ailem icin büyük bir baslangic olur. Belki sonunda bu cukurdan cikmama yardim eder!

english: Do you have any gauntlets for me?
Yes, your [steel/goldsmithing/cooking/chaos] gauntlets returned to me through their magic power recently. Would you like them back?
translation: Evet, zanaatkarlik eldivenlerin sihirli gücleri sayesinde yakin zamanda bana geri döndü. Geri almak ister misin?

english: Yes please.
Here you go.
Not right now.
Well, come back if you change your mind any time. I owe you for your trouble.
translation: Fikrini degistirirsen geri gel. Zahmetin icin sana borcluyum.

english: No, I don't think so. You must have them yourself somewhere.
translation: Hayir, sanmiyorum. Onlar senin bir yerlerde olmali.

english: Hello Dimintheis.
I will not forget what you did for my family [player name]. Those 500,000 coins have allowed us to put food on the table.
translation: Ailem icin yaptiklarini unutmayacagim Maceraci. O 500.000 altin sayesinde karnimizi doyurabildik.

english: That's no problem.
Anyway, I was wondering if I could get more of those gauntlets?
translation: Neyse, o eldivenlerden biraz daha alabilir miyim acaba?

english: You may, but you'll have to ask my sons for them, unless you just want a pair of the Steel gauntlets.
translation: Alabilirsin, ama celik eldivenlerden bir cift istiyorsan, ogullarimdan istemen gerekecek.

english: Yes, I do want a pair of steel gauntlets please.
translation: Evet, bir cift celik eldiven istiyorum lütfen.

english: No thanks Dimintheis.
I thought these gauntlets were a family heirloom, how come you have several of them?
translation: Bu eldivenlerin aile yadigari oldugunu saniyordum, nasil oluyor da birkac tane var?

english: I'm sorry for lying to you [player name], it was just all part of the ploy to make our family seem wealthy.
translation: Sana yalan söyledigim icin özür dilerim Maceraci, bu sadece ailemizi zengin göstermek icin yaptigim bir numaraydi.

english: They're not heirlooms at all, we have crates full of the things hidden away in the basement.
translation: Bunlar hic de yadigâr degil, bodrumda sakladigimiz sandiklar dolusu var.

english: And you still think that these are an acceptable reward for what I have done for your family?
translation: Ve hala bunlarin ailene yaptiklarim icin kabul edilebilir bir ödül oldugunu mu düsünüyorsun?

english: It's all I have to give...
Very well, I do admit, they are useful.
Why would a nobleman live in a dump like this?
translation: Bir asilzade neden böyle bir cöplükte yasasin ki?

english: Why would he do that?
Yes.
No.
So where is this crest?
You're rich then? Can I have some money?
translation: Demek zenginsin? Biraz para alabilir miyim?

english: Hi, I am a bold adventurer.
Why are you so desperate for it?
I'm not interested in that adventure right now.
Have you got any quests for me?
translation: Bana verebilecegin bir görev var mi?

english: I guess money does buy happiness.
Oh come on, however menial, I want to help!
translation: Hadi ama, ne kadar önemsiz olursa olsun, yardim etmek istiyorum!

english: Other
Yes please.
Not right now.
Could I get another pair of gauntlets?
translation: Baska bir cift eldiven alabilir miyim?

english: Yes please!
No thanks!
The gauntlets are a family heirloom?
Hello.
Who you?
Me [goblin name]. Who you?
Me Dipflip.
What you doing, Dipflip?
Me thinking.
What thinking?
Me have big idea for High Priest. It big goblin competition to see who best goblin. Only strongest goblin win. Me call it Goblin League.
translation: Yüksek Rahip icin büyük bir fikrim var. En iyi goblinin kim oldugunu görmek icin büyük bir goblin yarismasi. Sadece en güclü goblin kazanir. Ben buna Goblin Ligi diyorum.

english: You have good idea, Dipflip.
You think so?
Yes. High Priest and others be stupid to not see value of Goblin League.
translation: Evet. Basrahip ve digerleri Goblin Ligi'nin degerini görmemekle aptallik ediyorlar.

english: Yes. Goblin League good. Me know it.
translation: Evet. Goblin Ligi iyi. Ben bunu biliyorum.

english: I leave you to think.
You have bad idea, Dipflip.
You wrong. Goblin League good. Me know it.
translation: Yaniliyorsun. Goblin Ligi iyi. Ben bunu biliyorum.

english: You have good idea, Dipflip.
You have bad idea, Dipflip.
Hi.
An impostor... Die, scum!
The disciple of Iban attacks the player.
Iban is our father, our guide. Soon he will rule all life.
translation: Iban bizim babamiz, rehberimizdir. Yakinda tüm yasami yönetecek.

english: Som Molica Aniul Demonte.
Pardon?
Hail the great one, my lord Iban. I die for you again and again.
translation: Yüce Iban'a selam olsun. Senin icin tekrar tekrar ölürüm.

english: Is that possible?
Under Iban anything is possible. Death is only the beginning.
translation: Iban'in altinda her sey mümkündür. Ölüm sadece baslangictir.

english: Succumb to the might of Iban, the ruler of this world.
translation: Bu dünyanin hükümdari Iban'in gücüne boyun eg.

english: Hello!
Welcome. Have you come to give your soul to the Chasm?
translation: Hos geldin. Ruhunu Chasm'a vermek icin mi geldin?

english: Uh, I believe I'm still using it.
For now. Have you came to prove yourself in combat against the many demons within the Chasm?
translation: Simdilik. Chasm'daki bircok iblisle savasarak kendini kanitlamak icin mi geldin?

english: ...Perhaps.
My master prefers that his minions be killed with purpose.
translation: Efendim, kölelerinin bir amac ugruna öldürülmesini tercih eder.

english: Purpose?
I ask no questions of my master, I just inform.
translation: Efendime soru sormam, sadece bilgi veririm.

english: I am not worthy to explain on his behalf. Descend the Chasm and speak with him yourself if you wish for further details.
translation: Onun adina aciklama yapmaya layik degilim. Daha fazla ayrinti istiyorsan Chasm'a in ve onunla kendin konus.

english: As outlined in your contract, he wishes them slain in particular ways.
translation: Sözlesmede belirtildigi gibi, onlari belirli sekillerde öldürülmelerini istiyor.

english: Could you remind me what ways those were?
translation: Bu sekillerin neler oldugunu hatirlatir misin?

english: Death by two-handed melee weapons, heavy ranged weapons, magic spells, special attacks, and defeating them whilst bound.
translation: Iki elli yakin dövüs silahlari, agir menzilli silahlar, büyüleri, özel saldirilar ve baglanmis haldeyken yenmek.

english: Additionaly, he will request a specific method to be used. If you comply, your chances of obtaining a reward will be increased.
translation: Ek olarak, belirli bir yöntem kullanmanizi isteyecektir. Eger buna uyarsaniz, ödül alma sansiniz artacaktir.

english: Currently, my master wishes for you to use spells to kill his minions.
translation: Su anda efendim, onun hizmetkarlarini öldürmek icin büyüler kullanmanizi istiyor.

english: Does that include powered staves?
translation: Bu, güclendirilmis asalari da iceriyor mu?

english: No.
Currently, my master wishes for you to use special attacks to kill his minions.
translation: Su anda efendim, onun hizmetkarlarini öldürmek icin özel saldirilar kullanmanizi istiyor.

english: What kinds of rewards would I receive?
Special contracts, to be presented to my master for further discussion.
translation: Özel sözlesmeler, daha fazla tartisma icin efendime sunulacak.

english: Interesting. Thank you.
You are most welcome.
Are you okay?
Oh yes! Just praying to my new master. It's hot down here, isn't it?
translation: Oh evet! Yeni efendime dua ediyorum. Burasi cok sicak, degil mi?

english: I guess so.
Your new master, that would be...?
Yama! I sold my soul you see, well, I guess that Ox-headed guy down there forcibly removed it.
translation: Yama! Ruhumu sattim, yani, sanirim asagidaki öküz basli adam zorla aldi.

english: That doesn't sound like a fair trade...
translation: Bu pek adil bir takas gibi gelmiyor...

english: Oh, don't worry, I'm perfectly fine with the outcome. Sure, the loss of vision is a shame but it could be worse.
translation: Oh, merak etme, sonuctan tamamen memnunum. Tabii, görme yetenegimi kaybetmek üzücü ama daha kötüsü de olabilirdi.

english: Could it?
Underground there are no tall buildings, I'm awfully afraid of heights, you see.
translation: Yeraltinda yüksek binalar yok, ben de yükseklikten cok korkarim.

english: Perhaps it's a good thing you can't see...
translation: Belki de görememen iyi bir seydir...

english: What was that?
Oh, nothing...
What happened to your eyes?
The ritual, there were some... adverse effects...
translation: Ayin sirasinda bazi... olumsuz etkiler oldu...

english: The ritual?
Oh yes! Pretty basic really, head of an Ox, bruma roots, lots of fire and of course the human sacrifice.
translation: Evet! Aslinda oldukca basit, bir öküz kafasi, bruma kökleri, bolca ates ve tabii ki insan kurbani.

english: And at what point did that blind you?
The voice demanded that we stare into the fire until we saw enlightenment.
translation: Ses, aydinlanmayi görene kadar atese bakmamizi istedi.

english: I guess the fire was pretty bright.
Blindingly so.
Wait! Did you say human sacrifice?
Why, of course! We're Zamorakians, we're evil...
translation: Tabii ki! Biz Zamorakian'iz, biz kötüyüz...

english: Yeah, I guess that's true.
Well, I'll leave you to it.
So soon?
Yep, the demons won't slay themselves.
What demons?
For now. Have you come to prove yourself in combat against the many demons within the Chasm?
translation: Simdilik. Chasm'daki bircok iblisle savasarak kendini kanitlamaya mi geldin?

english: My master wishes you not to kill his minions without an agenda. You may only slay within the Chasm that which you have been assigned by a Slayer Master.
translation: Ustam, bir planin olmadan onun kölelerini öldürmeni istemiyor. Chasm'da sadece Slayer Master tarafindan sana verilen görevleri yerine getirebilirsin.

english: That's an oddly specific reason.
translation: Bu tuhaf bir sekilde spesifik bir neden.

english: My master wishes you not to kill his minions without an agenda. You may only slay within the Chasm that which you have been assigned by a Slayer Master.
translation: Ustam, bir planin olmadan onun kölelerini öldürmeni istemiyor. Chasm'da sadece Slayer Master tarafindan sana verilen görevleri yerine getirebilirsin.

english: Your new master, that would be...?
What happened to your eyes?
Well, I'll leave you to it.
Currently, my master wishes for you to use two handed melee weapons to kill his minions.
translation: Su anda, efendim sizden iki elli yakin dövüs silahlari kullanarak onun usaklarini öldürmenizi istiyor.

english: Currently, my master wishes for you to use heavy ranged weapons to kill his minions.
translation: Su anda, efendim sizden agir menzilli silahlar kullanarak onun usaklarini öldürmenizi istiyor.

english: Such a long voyage... maybe one day there will be a glider service out here.
translation: Ne uzun bir yolculuk... Belki bir gün buraya glider servisi gelir.

english: We could always do with an extra pair of hands on the dock. See Frankie, the fresh fish trader, if you're looking for work.
translation: Rihtimda fazladan bir cift el her zaman isimize yarar. Is ariyorsan, taze balik saticisi Frankie'ye bak.

english: We can fix this faster if we work together!
translation: Birlikte calisirsak bunu daha hizli halledebiliriz!

english: Blasted thing's broken again!
Can I get some assistance over here?
Great work, this crane should be good for a while!
translation: Harika is, bu vinc bir süre idare eder!

english: What can I do for you, [m'lady/sir]?
What do you do around here?
It's my job to keep track of operations on the docks.
translation: Rihtimdaki islemleri takip etmek benim isim.

english: Is there anything I can help out with?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Thanks for the offer, but I'm afraid you need a higher crafting level before you can help me.
translation: Teklifin icin tesekkürler, ama bana yardim edebilmen icin daha yüksek bir zanaat seviyesi gerekiyor.

english: You need a crafting level of 30 to assist the Piscarilius dockmaster.
translation: Piscarilius liman müdürüne yardim etmek icin 30 zanaat seviyesine sahip olman gerekiyor.

english: You look like you know a thing or two about crafting, perhaps you could help us maintain the fishing cranes around the docks.
translation: Zanaat konusunda bir seyler biliyor gibi görünüyorsun, belki limandaki balikcilik vinclerinin bakiminda bize yardim edebilirsin.

english: You'll need a hammer, some nails and a few wooden planks, 3 planks per broken crane should be enough.
translation: Bir cekic, birkac civi ve birkac tahta levha gerekecek, kirik vinc basina 3 levha yeterli olacaktir.

english: I can't offer you any payment at the moment, but hard work doesn't go unnoticed around these parts.
translation: Su anda sana herhangi bir ödeme yapamam, ama bu bölgede siki calisma gözden kacmaz.

english: Sure, I'll see what I can do.
I'll let you get back to work.
Sorry, I was just looking around.
Fair enough.
I have a question for you.
The Dockmaster has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Liman müdürü sana bir meydan okuma parsömeni verdi!

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
No, try again.
Correct!
The Dockmaster has given you another clue scroll!
translation: Liman müdürü sana baska bir ipucu parsömeni verdi!

english: What do you do around here?
Is there anything I can help out with?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: I'll let you get back to work.
Sorry, I was just looking around.
Hello.
How do you feel? No heavy flu, shivers, nausea or loss of appetite?
translation: Nasil hissediyorsun? Agir grip, titreme, mide bulantisi veya istahsizlik var mi?

english: Uh... no... I feel fine...
How about nightmares then? Are you experiencing any problems with especially scary nightmares?
translation: Peki ya kabuslar? Özellikle korkutucu kabuslar görüyor musun?

english: No... not since I was young.
Good, good, I had to make sure. This plague really has an incredibly fast contagion rate. It spreads faster than the common cold!
translation: Güzel, güzel, emin olmak istedim. Bu salgin gercekten inanilmaz hizli yayiliyor. Soguk alginligindan bile daha hizli yayiliyor!

english: The plague? Tell me more.
It came from the west somewhere. It is extremely quick spreading, and utterly deadly.
translation: Batidan bir yerlerden geldi. Cok hizli yayiliyor ve tamamen ölümcül.

english: What are the symptoms?

It varies slightly from case to case, but usually abnormal nightmares and flu-like symptoms, progressing as you succumb more. Eventually, it results in the presence of a thick black tar-like substance secreted
translation: Durumdan duruma biraz farklilik gösterse de, genellikle anormal kabuslar ve grip benzeri semptomlar görülür ve bu semptomlar, kisi daha fazla teslim oldukça ilerler.

english: from the nose and eyes.
translation: Sonunda, burun ve gözlerden salgilanan kalin, siyah, katran benzeri bir madde ortaya çikar.

english: Okay, I'll be careful.
You do that adventurer. You do not want to become infected by the plague.
translation: Öyle yap madem maceraci. Vebaya yakalanmak istemezsin.

english: Good day, you have my next payment? I don't keep this charade up for fun you know.
translation: Iyi günler, bir sonraki ödemenizi yaptiniz mi? Bu oyunu eglence icin oynamiyorum, biliyorsunuz.

english: Sorry I don't.
Well if you would mention it next time you see the Head Mourner, it would be appreciated.
translation: Bir dahaki sefere Bas Yas Tutucu'yu gördügünüzde ona söyler misiniz, cok sevinirim.

english: I'll keep it in mind.
Hello there. Can't stop to talk I'm afraid, I'm very busy right now.
translation: Merhaba. Konusacak vaktim yok maalesef, su anda cok mesgulüm.

english: Hello doctor. I need to acquire some protective clothing so that I can dispose of some diseased sheep.
translation: Merhaba doktor. Hastalikli koyunlari imha edebilmek icin koruyucu giysiler almam gerekiyor.

english: Protective clothing? I'm afraid I only have the one suit which I made myself to prevent infection from any contaminated patients I treat.
translation: Koruyucu giysiler mi? Korkarim ki, tedavi ettigim kontamine hastalarin enfeksiyonunu önlemek icin kendim yaptigim tek bir giysi var.

english: I suppose I could sell you this one and make myself another, but it would cost you at least 100 gold so that I could afford a replacement.
translation: Sanirim bunu size satip kendime yenisini yapabilirim, ama yenisini alabilmem icin en az 100 altin ödemeniz gerekir.

english: Okay, I'll take it.
These should protect you from infection.
Sorry doc, that's too much.
I'm afraid it will cost me that much to replace. I cannot possibly sell it for less.
translation: Maalesef yenisini almak icin bu kadar para harcamam gerekiyor. Daha ucuza satamam.

english: The plague? Tell me more.
Okay, I'll be careful.
Okay, I'll take it.
Sorry doc, that's too much.
Psst! Got any Void kit you don't want? Spare robes, spare helms, that kind of thing?
translation: Psst! Istemediginiz bosluk kiti var mi? Yedek cüppeler, yedek migferler, o tür seyler?

english: What if I do?
Might be able to take it off your hands for you. Show me what you've got, and I'll see if I can get you some Commendation Points for it.
translation: Onlari senden alabilirim. Neyin var göster de, sana bunun icin biraz Takdir Puani kazanabilir miyim bakayim.

english: Just so you know, you've got a lot of Commendation points already, so I can't pay you my usual rate.
translation: Bilgin olsun, zaten cok fazla Takdir Puanin var, bu yüzden sana normal ücretimi ödeyemem.

english: Deal!
No, I don't.
Decline
That's not really the sort of stuff I want
translation: Bu tam olarak istedigim türden seyler degil.

english: What if I do?
Accept
No, I don't.
Lookin' fer Captain Tock?
Lookin' fer the Corsair cabin boy?
translation: Korsan gemisinin gemici cocugunu mu ariyorsun?

english: Who are you?
Arr, I can help ye with yer business wi'out ye needin' to known mine. So are ye seekin' him, or not?
translation: Sen benim kim oldugumu bilmeden isine yardim edebilirim. Onu ariyor musun, aramiyor musun?

english: Yes, I am.
The Corsairs moor their ship away to the west, beyond yon village of Rimmington. Ye should look fer him there.
translation: Korsanlar gemilerini batiya, Rimmington köyünün ötesine demirliyorlar. Onu orada aramalisin.

english: West, beyond Rimmington? Thank you.
Why would I be looking for him?
Many come here seekin' him. They be all lost an 'confused. If ye be seekin' him now, maybe I can help ye.
translation: Bircogu onu aramak icin buraya geliyor. Hepsi kaybolmus ve kafasi karisik. Eger onu ariyorsan, belki sana yardim edebilirim.

english: No, I'm not.
Arrr, I thought maybe ye were.
Who are you?
Yes, I am.
Why would I be looking for him?
No, I'm not.
Woof!
How long have you been living in those ruins?
translation: O harabelerde ne kadar süredir yasiyorsun?

english: Not long enough.
Would you like to go back?
No. There's more to explore. More to conquer.
translation: Hayir. Kesfedilecek daha çok sey var. Fethedilecek daha çok sey var.

english: When you say conquer, I'm on your team, right?
translation: Fethetmek dediginde, ben de senin takimindayim, degil mi?

english: For now.
That does not fill me with confidence... I hope you don't get any bigger.
translation: Bu beni pek güvenlendirmiyor... Umarim daha da büyümezsin.

english: Dom? Is that short for Dominic?
Doom of Mokhaiotl.
Oh, I wasn't expecting that.
Neither were the Old Ones.
Grrrrr!
Extinction for you!
If I could burrow, I'd end you.
translation: Eger tünel kazabilseydim, seni yok ederdim.

english: Welcome to the Nightmare Zone! Would you like me to create a dream for you?
translation: Kabus Bölgesine hos geldin! Senin icin bir rüya yaratmami ister misin?

english: Who are you?
My name's Dominic Onion but you can call me Dom, or Mr Onion.
translation: Adim Dominic Onion ama bana Dom ya da Bay Onion diyebilirsin.

english: Mr Oni...Dom, how did you get that name?
translation: Bay Oni... Dom, bu ismi nasil aldin?

english: Well that's a long story...but I can tell you that it involved my parents, 3 blurberry specials, and a chinchompa.
translation: Bu uzun bir hikaye... ama sana sunu söyleyebilirim ki, bu hikayede ailem, 3 blurberry special ve bir chinchompa var.

english: ...and a chinchompa?
Oh yes, Nigel played a crucial role in the whole debacle. It's all very amusing now that I think back to it.
translation: Evet, Nigel bu felakette cok önemli bir rol oynadi. Simdi geriye dönüp baktigimda, hepsi cok komik geliyor.

english: Right...
Good times...
What is this place?
This is the Nightmare Zone!
Wwwwhat?!
Don't worry, it's not as bad as it sounds...most of the time.
translation: Merak etme, kulaga geldigi kadar kötü degil... cogu zaman.

english: That's comforting.
Truth be told, that name wasn't my first choice, it's what the local folk have been calling it and so it sort of stuck.
translation: Dogrusu, bu isim benim ilk tercihim degildi, yerel halkin kullandigi isim buydu ve bir sekilde yerlesmis oldu.

english: My original plan came to me in a vivid dream when I was younger you see, I saw myself running a successful business from a great structure in a strange land.
translation: Asil planim, gencken gördügüm canli bir rüyada aklima geldi. Kendimi, yabanci bir ülkede büyük bir binada basarili bir is yürütüyor olarak gördüm.

english: Well, I say strange, but I'd never left Lunar Isle at the time and this place was very hot and dry, unlike anything I'd seen before.
translation: Garip diyorum ama o zamanlar Lunar Isle'dan hic ayrilmamistim ve bu yer daha önce gördüklerimden cok farkli, cok sicak ve kuruydu.

english: When I told my father about the dream he laughed and said I should become a banker like him and his father before him but in that moment I knew that it wasn't the life for me.
translation: Babam bu rüyayi anlattigimda güldü ve onun ve babasinin yaptigi gibi bankaci olmam gerektigini söyledi ama o anda bunun benim icin dogru hayat olmadigini anladim.

english: I had to find out what this dream meant and if it was a vision of the future or not.
translation: Bu rüyanin ne anlama geldigini ve gelecege dair bir öngörü olup olmadigini ögrenmem gerekiyordu.

english: Growing up, I studied hard to find out more about magic, especially oneiromancy and the interpretation of dreams.
translation: Büyürken, büyü hakkinda, özellikle de rüya yorumlama ve rüyalarin yorumu hakkinda daha fazla bilgi edinmek icin cok calistim.

english: Having learned as much as I could on Lunar Isle I set out to find and learn from other great wizards I'd heard of in stories as a child.
translation: Lunar Isle'da ögrenebilecegim her seyi ögrendikten sonra, cocukken hikayelerde duydugum diger büyük büyücülerden ögrenmek icin yola ciktim.

english: I set off to travel the world, discovering more about dreams to enable me to understand the dream I'd had as a child.
translation: Dünyayi gezmeye basladim ve cocukken gördügüm rüyayi anlayabilmek icin rüyalar hakkinda daha fazla bilgi edindim.

english: I needed to know what this dream meant and if it was truly a vision of the future.
translation: Bu rüyanin ne anlama geldigini ve gercekten gelecegin bir görüntüsü olup olmadigini bilmem gerekiyordu.

english: If so I knew I had to try and find this location and build the huge tower I saw.
translation: Eger öyleyse, bu yeri bulup gördügüm devasa kuleyi insa etmem gerektigini biliyordum.
