english: I was going to call it 'Dom Onion's Tower', but I've not found this strange place or gathered enough money to build it just yet.
translation: Ona “Dom Onion'un Kulesi” adini verecektim, ama henüz bu garip yeri bulamadim ve onu insa etmek icin yeterli parayi toplayamadim.

english: That's why I've setup this small business venture in the mean time selling dreams to people. I just need a big enough crowd to kickstart my business.
translation: Bu yüzden, bu arada insanlara rüyalar satan bu kücük isletmeyi kurdum. Isimi baslatmak icin yeterince büyük bir kalabaliga ihtiyacim var.

english: It's all part of my five year plan, and who knows, perhaps my dream will come true; I'll discover this place and build Dom Onion's Tower!
translation: Hepsi bes yillik planimin bir parcasi ve kim bilir, belki de rüyam gercek olur; bu yeri kesfeder ve Dom Onion'un Kulesi'ni insa ederim!

english: Can you tell me about the dreams?
translation: Bana rüyalar hakkinda bilgi verebilir misiniz?

english: Certainly. I can delve into your memories and search for the key events that have affected you on your adventures.
translation: Elbette. Anilariniza dalip, maceralarinizda sizi etkileyen önemli olaylari arayabilirim.

english: I then take the essence of these memories and put that in the vial you see on the plinth.
translation: Sonra bu anilarin özünü alip, kaide üzerinde gördügün siseye koyarim.

english: I imbue a bit of magic, then give the vial a bit of a shake, and when you drink it you'll be able to re-live an encounter close to the original.
translation: Biraz sihir katip siseyi biraz calkalarim ve sen onu ictiginde, orijinaline yakin bir karsilasmayi yeniden yasayabilirsin.

english: Don't worry though, when you're in a dream, you're perfectly safe even if it does seem very real.
translation: Ama merak etme, rüyadayken, her ne kadar cok gercekci görünse de tamamen güvendesin.

english: If you sucessfullyovercome the dream or die trying, you'll leave the dream state and return to normal with your grey matter and appendages intact.
translation: Rüyayi basariyla asarsaniz veya denerken ölürseniz, rüya durumundan cikip gri maddeniz ve uzuvlariniz saglam bir sekilde normale dönersiniz.

english: Are all dreams the same or are there different options?
translation: Tüm rüyalar ayni midir yoksa farkli secenekler var midir?

english: Oh no, they can vary wildly! You can choose from one of three main options.
translation: Hayir, cok farkli olabilirler! Üc ana secenekten birini secebilirsiniz.

english: Firstly, I can create a one-on-one encounter with an adversary you've defeated in your adventures. People like to practice in these dreams.
translation: Ilk olarak, maceralarinizda yendiginiz bir düsmanla bire bir karsilasma yaratabilirim. Insanlar bu rüyalarda pratik yapmayi severler.

english: Then there's a sort of Endurance dream, where you face enemies in encounter after encounter, and try to survive to the end.
translation: Sonra bir tür Dayaniklilik rüyasi var, burada düsmanlarla arka arkaya karsilasir ve sonuna kadar hayatta kalmaya calisirsiniz.

english: And finally there's something I like to call a Rumble, where you face multiple adversaries at the same time. I imbue a bit more magic and shake the vial harder to create that one!
translation: Ve son olarak, Rumble adini verdigim, ayni anda birden fazla düsmanla karsilastiginiz bir rüya var. Bunu yaratmak icin biraz daha fazla sihir katip siseyi daha sert salliyorum!

english: You can invite friends to fight alongside you in a Rumble dream. Once I've set up the dream for you, step into the enclosure and invite up to 4 friends.
translation: Rumble rüyasinda arkadaslarinizi sizinle birlikte savasmaya davet edebilirsiniz. Rüyayi sizin icin hazirladiktan sonra, alana girin ve en fazla 4 arkadasinizi davet edin.

english: For the Endurance and Rumble dreams, I charge a fee for my work. I don't like handling the money directly, so instead I've set up a secure coffer.
translation: Endurance ve Rumble rüyalari icin yaptigim isin karsiliginda bir ücret aliyorum. Parayi dogrudan elime almayi sevmiyorum, bu yüzden güvenli bir kasa hazirladim.

english: After you've asked me to set up a dream, put some money in my coffer. I'll deduct the fee from the coffer when you start the dream.
translation: Benden bir rüya hazirlamami istediginizde, kasama biraz para koyun. Rüyayi baslattiginizda ücreti kasadan düsecegim.

english: There's a red vial on the other plinth. Your friends can drink from it to enter your dream as a spectator to observe your progress.
translation: Diger kaide üzerinde kirmizi bir sise var. Arkadaslariniz bu siseden icerek rüyaniza seyirci olarak girip ilerlemenizi izleyebilirler.

english: Finally here's one other option you get, and that's how difficult the encounters are. As well as the normal dreams, the bravest adventurers can choose a harder version*.
translation: Son olarak, size sunulan bir baska secenek de karsilasmalarin zorluk derecesidir. Normal rüyalarin yani sira, en cesur maceracilar daha zor bir versiyon secebilirler*.

english: *Terms and conditions apply: Mr Onion, henceforth known as Dom, cannot be held liable for accidental loss of limbs (yours or otherwise) and or psychological damage as a result of entering the Nightmare Zone. Please note there is a strict no-refunds policy, and all dream purchases are final.
translation: *Sartlar ve kosullar gecerlidir: Bundan böyle Dom olarak anilacak olan Bay Onion, Kabus Bölgesi'ne girmenin sonucu olarak meydana gelen kazara uzuv kaybi (senin veya baskalarinin) ve/veya psikolojik hasardan sorumlu tutulamaz. Lütfen, geri ödeme yapilmamasi konusunda kati bir politika oldugunu ve tüm rüya satin alimlarinin kesin oldugunu unutma.

english: Can I choose a dream?
Certainly. You can practice for free, but the larger dreams require more skill to imbue the potions and so there's a fee for those.
translation: Elbette. Ücretsiz olarak pratik yapabilirsiniz, ancak daha büyük rüyalar iksirleri asilamak icin daha fazla beceri gerektirir ve bu nedenle bunlar icin bir ücret ödenir.

english: I've prepared your dream. Drink from the vial in the enclosure when you're ready to fight.
translation: Rüyanizi hazirladim. Savasmaya hazir oldugunuzda, kapali alandaki siseden icin.

english: For an Endurance dream, normal mode, I'll want 1,000 coins. I'll deduct the money from the coffer when you start the dream.
translation: Dayaniklilik rüyasi, normal mod icin 1.000 sikke istiyorum. Rüyaya basladiginizda parayi kasadan düsecegim.

english: I've prepared your dream. Drink from the vial in the enclosure when you're ready to fight. I'll deduct 1,000 coins from the coffer when you do.
translation: Rüyani hazirladim. Savasmaya hazir oldugunda, kapali alandaki siseden ic. Bunu yaptiginda kasadan 1.000 altin düsecegim.

english: For an Endurance dream, hard mode, I'll want 5,000 coins. I'll deduct the money from the coffer when you start the dream.
translation: Zor modda Dayaniklilik rüyasi icin 5.000 altin istiyorum. Rüyaya basladiginda kasadan parayi düsecegim.

english: I've prepared your dream. Drink from the vial in the enclosure when you're ready to fight. I'll deduct 5,000 coins from the coffer when you do.
translation: Hayalini hazirladim. Savasmaya hazir oldugunda, kapali alandaki siseden ic. Bunu yaptiginda kasadan 5.000 altin düsecegim.

english: For a Rumble dream, normal mode, I'll want 2,000 coins. I'll deduct the money from the coffer when you start the dream.
translation: Rumble hayali icin normal modda 2.000 altin istiyorum. Hayali baslattiginda kasadan parayi düsecegim.

english: I've prepared your dream. Step into the enclosure, invite up to 4 players to join you, then drink from the vial to begin. Each of you will need to unlock the coffer and have 2,000 coins deposited first.
translation: Rüyani hazirladim. Muhafazaya gir, 4 oyuncuya kadar seni katilmaya davet et, sonra siseden icerek basla. Her birinizin önce kasayi acmasi ve 2.000 altin yatirmasi gerekecek.

english: For a Rumble dream, hard mode, I'll want 6,000 coins. I'll deduct the money from the coffer when you start the dream.
translation: Rumble rüyasi icin, zor modda, 6.000 altin istiyorum. Rüyayi baslattiginda parayi kasadan düsecegim.

english: I've prepared your dream. Step into the enclosure, invite up to 4 players to join you, then drink from the vial to begin. Each of you will need to unlock the coffer and have 6,000 coins deposited first.
translation: Rüyani hazirladim. Citlerin icine gir, en fazla 4 oyuncuyu davet et, sonra siseden icerek basla. Her birinizin önce sandigi acmasi ve 6.000 jeton yatirmasi gerekiyor.

english: For a customisable Rumble dream, normal mode, I'll want 12,000 coins. I'll deduct the money from the coffer when you start the dream.
translation: Özellestirilebilir Rumble rüyasi icin normal modda 12.000 jeton istiyorum. Rüyayi baslattiginizda parayi sandiktan düsecegim.

english: I've prepared your dream. Step into the enclosure, invite up to 4 players to join you, then drink from the vial to begin. Each of you will need to unlock the coffer and have 12,000 coins deposited first.
translation: Rüyani hazirladim. Citlerin icine gir, en fazla 4 oyuncuyu davet et, sonra siseden icerek basla. Her biriniz önce sandigi acmali ve 12.000 altin yatirmalisiniz.

english: For a customisable Rumble dream, hard mode, I'll want 16,000 coins. I'll deduct the money from the coffer when you start the dream.
translation: Özellestirilebilir Rumble rüyasi, zor mod icin 16.000 altin istiyorum. Rüyayi baslattiginizda parayi sandiktan düsecegim.

english: I've prepared your dream. Step into the enclosure, invite up to 4 players to join you, then drink from the vial to begin. Each of you will need to unlock the coffer and have 16,000 coins deposited first.
translation: Rüyani hazirladim. Citlerin icine gir, 4 oyuncuya kadar seni davet et, sonra siseden icerek basla. Her biriniz önce sandigi acmali ve 16.000 jeton yatirmalisiniz.

english: I'll come back another time.
You haven't started that dream I created for you. Can I help you with something?
translation: Senin icin hazirladigim rüyayi henüz baslatmadin. Yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: I want to change my dream.
Okay, I've emptied the vial. I have not taken any money from you for that dream, since you never started it.
translation: Tamam, siseyi bosalttim. Rüyayi hic baslatmadigin icin senden para almadim.

english: Which dream would you like to experience?
I have a question for you.
Please enter the answer to the question.
No, try again.
Correct!
Here, have this.
Who are you?
What is this place?
Can you tell me about the dreams?
translation: Bana rüyalar hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Can I choose a dream?
Practice
Normal
Hard
Endurance
Yes
No
Rumble
Customisable - normal
Customisable - hard
Previous: [previous choice]
I'll come back another time.
I want to change my dream.
I've already created a dream for you. Do you want me to cancel it?
translation: Senin için bir rüya hazirladim. Iptal etmemi ister misin?

english: Yes, please cancel it.
No, don't cancel it.
Okay. Drink from the vial when you're ready to start the dream.
translation: Tamam. Rüyaya baslamaya hazir oldugunda siseden iç.

english: Discard the dream you set up?
Yes, please cancel it.
No, don't cancel it.
Nilsal. Is there something I can do for you, my child?
translation: Nilsal. Senin için yapabilecegim bir sey var mi, çocugum?

english: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
I would suggest you speak to my counterpart instead. Those of us dedicated to Ranul do not specialise in that sort of thing.
translation: Bunun yerine meslektasimla konusmani öneririm. Ranul'a adanmis bizler bu tür seylerde uzman degiliz.

english: What's the giant tree stump all about?
translation: Dev agaç kütügü ne anlama geliyor?

english: This stump is all that remains of the Great Auburn Redwood. It was, and in many ways still is, one of the key holy sites of Varlamore.
translation: Bu kütük, Büyük Auburn Sekoyasinin geriye kalan tek parçasi. Birçok yönden Varlamore'un en önemli kutsal yerlerinden biriydi ve hala da öyle.

english: What happened to it?
The tree was destroyed during the War of Betrayal many years ago. It was here in the Auburn Valley that the fighting was at its most fierce.
translation: Agaç, yillar önce Ihanet Savasi sirasinda yok edildi. Savasin en siddetli oldugu yer Auburn Vadisi'ydi.

english: Both sides resorted to tactics that most would consider to be beyond horrifying. The tree was sadly a casualty of such tactics.
translation: Her iki taraf da çogu kisinin korkunç bulacagi taktiklere basvurdu. Agaç ne yazik ki bu taktiklerin kurbani oldu.

english: Which side was responsible?
That has never been clear. Ranul teaches us to find and preserve the truth, but in war, the truth is sadly left behind.
translation: Bu hiç netlesmedi. Ranul bize gerçegi bulup korumayi ögretir, ama savasta gerçek ne yazik ki geride kalir.

english: So the battles that took place here... Is that why all these animal spirits are here now?
translation: Yani burada gerçeklesen savaslar... Bu yüzden mi tüm bu hayvan ruhlari simdi burada?

english: Yes. They are the spirits of the animals that died here during the War of Betrayal. They did not pass on to Mictl, for they have unfinished business in these lands.
translation: Evet. Onlar, Ihanet Savasi sirasinda burada ölen hayvanlarin ruhlari. Mictl'e geçmediler, çünkü bu topraklarda bitmemis isleri var.

english: What business?
That is beyond our understanding. We believe they are here to guide the ents that live in the valley so that they may one day regrow the Great Auburn Redwood.
translation: Bu bizim anlayisimizin ötesinde. Biz, onlarin vadide yasayan entleri yönlendirmek için burada olduklarina inaniyoruz, böylece bir gün Büyük Auburn Sekoyasini yeniden yetistirebilsinler.

english: The ents can do that?
Much of the valley was destroyed during the war. Most of what you see around you was regrown by the ents.
translation: Vadinin büyük bir kismi savas sirasinda yok edildi. Etrafinda gördügün çogu sey entler tarafindan yeniden büyütüldü.

english: That's incredible!
Indeed it is, my child. That is why it is our duty to ensure the ents are protected. The events of the war cannot be repeated.
translation: Gerçekten öyle, çocugum. Bu yüzden entlerin korunmasini saglamak bizim görevimiz. Savasin olaylari tekrarlanmamali.

english: I'd better get going.
Then go in peace, my child.
translation: O zaman huzur içinde git, çocugum.

english: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
What's the giant tree stump all about?
translation: Dev agaç kütügü ne anlama geliyor?

english: I'd better get going.
Would you like to buy some crafting equipment?
translation: Zanaat ekipmani satin almak ister misin?

english: No thanks; I've got all the Crafting equipment I need.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler; ihtiyacim olan tüm zanaat ekipmanlarina sahibim.

english: Okay. Fare well on your travels.
Hi! I have this money-off voucher!
So I see! Unfortunately, it seems to have expired yesterday! Nevermind.
translation: Anliyorum! Maalesef, dün süresi dolmus gibi görünüyor! Önemli degil.

english: But I only just got it!
I'm sorry, there's nothing I can do.
Goodbye.
What do you know about Ali Morrisane?
I know that one of his thugs has threatened to ruin my store if I don't cooperate with them!
translation: Onun adamlarindan biri, onlarla isbirligi yapmazsam dükkanimi mahvedecegini söyledi!

english: He said he was a tailor, but those scissors looked more like a weapon than something used for Crafting.
translation: Terzi oldugunu söyledi, ama o makas zanaat icin kullanilan bir aletten cok silaha benziyordu.

english: What are you going to do, then?
As long as I have my store, I'll keep selling my Crafting equipment! Would you like to buy any?
translation: Dükkanim oldugu sürece zanaat ekipmanlari satmaya devam edecegim! Satin almak ister misin?

english: No thanks; I've got all the Crafting equipment I need.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler; ihtiyacim olan tüm zanaat ekipmanlarina sahibim.

english: Let's see what you've got, then.
translation: O zaman neyin var bir bakalim.

english: What do you know about Ali Morrisane?
Hello.
Not infected are you?
I don't think so.
You don't seem very sure. We don't want any infected near the children. Be off with you!
translation: Cok emin görünmüyorsun. Cocuklarin yaninda enfekte olanlar istemiyoruz. Defol git!

english: Whatever it is you're selling, we ain't interested!
But I'm not...
Did you not hear me? Clear off!
...(Don't Know What silently lets you in.)
translation: ...(Ne oldugunu bilmiyorum, sessizce iceri girmenize izin veriyor.)

english: Player enters Weiss
...(Don't Know What silently lets you out.)
translation: ...(Ne oldugunu bilmiyorum, sessizce disari cikmaniza izin veriyor.)

english: Player exits Weiss
What do you want?
Just wondering if you were still here.
translation: Hala burada misiniz diye merak ettim.

english: Of course I'm still here.
I'm not going near that crack in the wall again.
translation: Duvardaki catlagin yanina bir daha yaklasmayacagim.

english: Rock falls and so on are fine, but sea monsters in caves - never!
translation: Kaya düsmesi falan sorun degil, ama magaralarda deniz canavarlari - asla!

english: What are you doing down in these caves?
I'm waiting to work on the excavations...
...though I don't really want to start digging again.
Why not? I thought digging was something dwarves were good at.
translation: Neden? Kazma isinde cüceler cok iyidir saniyordum.

english: Not with monsters like that one in those caves.
It had huge teeth and flaming red eyes, and was almost the size of the tunnel!
translation: Kocaman disleri ve alev gibi kirmizi gözleri vardi, neredeyse tünel kadar büyüktü!

english: If it attacks the town...
Are you an adventurer, by any chance?
Adventurer and Regent of Miscellania.
In that case, could you go and deal with that monster?
translation: Öyleyse, gidip o canavarla ilgilenir misin?

english: I don't want to have to face it again if it attacks the town.
translation: Kasabaya saldirirsa onunla tekrar yüzlesmek istemiyorum.

english: Of course. Dealing with monsters is what I do best!
translation: Tabii ki. Canavarlarla ilgilenmek en iyi yaptigim seydir!

english: You'll need to get into the other caves first, of course.
translation: Tabii ki önce diger magaralara girmen gerekecek.

english: There's a crack in the wall where the others are digging, but the rocks are loose, and can fall on you if you're not careful.
translation: Digerlerinin kazdigi duvarda bir catlak var, ama kayalar gevsek ve dikkatli olmazsaniz üzerinize düsebilir.

english: I can give you a mining prop to keep them from falling, if you give me a minute to find it...
translation: Onlari düsmesini önlemek icin size bir madencilik destegi verebilirim, ama onu bulmam icin bana bir dakika verin...

english: Okay, so all I have to do is get through that wall?
translation: Tamam, yani tek yapmam gereken o duvari gecmek mi?

english: No, after that the only way you can get further is climbing up onto a high ledge, then crawling through a tunnel.
translation: Hayir, ondan sonra ilerleyebilmenin tek yolu yüksek bir cikintiya tirmanip tünelden sürünerek gecmek.

english: But the walls are slippery...
...and I think I might have broken the lift when I fell off it on my way back.
translation: ...ve geri dönerken düstügümde asansörü bozmus olabilirim.

english: You'll probably need to fix the lift - I doubt you'd be able to climb.
translation: Muhtemelen asansörü tamir etmen gerekecek, tirmanabilecegini sanmiyorum.

english: And the monster's behind that tunnel?
Somewhere behind it. I couldn't get very far, what with the flooding in the tunnel.
translation: Arkasinda bir yerde. Tüneldeki su baskini yüzünden cok uzaga gidemedim.

english: There's some rope and some planks near the broken lift - those would probably come in handy.
translation: Kirik asansörün yaninda biraz ip ve tahta var - bunlar muhtemelen isine yarayacaktir.

english: Ah, here's that mining prop. I knew I had it somewhere.
translation: Ah, iste madencilik destegi. Bir yerde oldugunu biliyordum.

english: Here you go. Good luck with fighting that monster.
translation: Al bakalim. Canavarla savasmada iyi sanslar.

english: Why bother? It can't get through solid rock.
That's what I thought, until I saw the sheer size of it. This thing probably MADE the tunnels!
translation: Ben de öyle düsünüyordum, ta ki onun büyüklügünü görene kadar. Bu sey muhtemelen tünelleri O YAPIYOR!

english: And you're sending me in to deal with it alone?
translation: Ve sen beni tek basima onunla basa cikmaya mi gönderiyorsun?

english: I've heard stories from the Miscellanians. If you're the Regent, you must be quite a strong hero.
translation: Miscellanians'tan hikayeler duydum. Eger sen Regent isen, oldukca güclü bir kahraman olmalisin.

english: So what are you worried about? You probably eat monsters like that for breakfast!
translation: Öyleyse neden endiseleniyorsun? Muhtemelen böyle canavarlari kahvaltida yiyorsundur!

english: I wouldn't put it quite like that...
But I'll help you after all. Now, how do I find this monster?
translation: Ama yine de sana yardim edecegim. Peki, bu canavari nasil bulacagim?

english: Of course. Dealing with monsters is what I do best!
translation: Tabii ki. Canavarlarla basa cikmak en iyi yaptigim seydir!

english: Why bother? It can't get through solid rock.
translation: Neden ugrasiyorsun? Saglam kayayi gecemez ki.

english: How are you doing, Dondakan?
Oh, just fine, just fine! This gold is certainly creating a steady flow of income for me! After the company takes some of the cut, of course.
translation: Oh, gayet iyiyim, gayet iyiyim! Bu altin bana düzenli bir gelir kaynagi sagliyor! Tabii ki sirketin payini aldiktan sonra.

english: Can you shoot me into the rock again?
You need to wear that golden helmet... unless you want to crack open your skull on the rock.
translation: O altin kaski takmalisin... tabii kafatasini kayaya carpmak istemiyorsan.

english: Of course, just a second, let me adjust my cannon again.
translation: Tabii, bir saniye, topumu tekrar ayarlayayim.

english: Say, are you selling those boots of yours?
What, you mean these granite boots?
Yes, I'd be happy to pay quite some money for them!
translation: Evet, onlara oldukca iyi bir para veririm!

english: Haha, I bet you would, I bet you would!
But I no longer need the money, this rock is generating plenty!
translation: Ama artik paraya ihtiyacim yok, bu kaya yeterince para kazandiriyor!

english: Besides, I'm rather fond of them now... best boots I ever had!
translation: Ayrica, artik onlara oldukca baglandim... sahip oldugum en iyi botlar!

english: Oh please...
No, I won't sell them.
Pretty please?
No!
Oh come on!!!
Well...
Yes?
How much gold would you be willing to pay for it? Not that I'm selling my boots, mind, I'm just curious.
translation: Onlar icin ne kadar altin ödersin? Botlarimi satacagimdan degil, sadece merak ediyorum.

english: What, are you trying to scam old Dondakan? You want me to sell these boots for a measly [number] coins?
I'm not selling them anyway.
You're so poor, you don't even have that much gold on you...
translation: O kadar fakirsin ki, o kadar altin bile yok sende...

english: If I were selling my granite boots, which I'm clearly not, I would certainly not accept a mere [number] coins for them.
That's quite a sum of money, which I notice you don't even have on you.
translation: Bu oldukca büyük bir meblag ve senin üzerinde o kadar altin olmadigini fark ettim.

english: Haha, nice try [player name]!
Pity I'm not selling my boots, not for any price or any item.
translation: Ne yazik ki botlarimi satmiyorum, ne para ne de baska bir sey karsiliginda.

english: I just wanted to see how high you would go!
translation: Sadece ne kadar yüksek bir rakam verecegini görmek istedim!

english: Bah, thanks a lot.
Hey, that's quite a bit of money. Which you don't have on you. Oh well, I wasn't selling my boots anyway.
translation: Hey, bu oldukca büyük bir meblag. Üstünde olmayan bir meblag. Neyse, zaten botlarimi satmiyordum.

english: Never mind, I don't want them anymore.
Great, because I don't want to sell them.
translation: Harika, cünkü ben de satmak istemiyorum.

english: Okay.
Right.
Check these out.
Where'd you get those from? Did you make your own?
translation: Bunlari nereden buldun? Kendin mi yaptin?

english: Not quite, they were retrieved from the corpse of a wyvern.
translation: Tam olarak degil, bir wyvern'in cesedinden aldim.

english: You killed a wyvern? Last I heard they were all dead.
translation: Bir wyvern mi öldürdün? Son duydugumda hepsi ölmüstü.

english: I never said I killed it! But perhaps I did, I am a grand adventureafter all!
translation: Öldürdügümü söylemedim! Ama belki de öldürdüm, sonucta ben büyük bir maceraciyim!

english: Oh dear, oh dear. It seems firing you head first into a rock was perhaps not the best idea, you've gone absolutely loony.
translation: Oh hayir, oh hayir. Kafani bir kayaya carpmak belki de en iyi fikir degildi, tamamen delirdin.

english: Hmm, well you do have a point...
It's alright Laddie, I'm just joking.
translation: Sorun yok Laddie, sadece saka yapiyorum.

english: That's great, but I have to go now.
Come back any time!
I don't want anything from you right now.
translation: Su anda senden bir sey istemiyorum.

english: Can you shoot me into the rock again?
Are you selling those boots of yours?
Oh please...
Never mind, I don't want them anymore.
That's great, but I have to go.
Hello there, can I help you?
Where am I?
This is the town of Lumbridge my friend.
How are you today?
Aye, not too bad thank you. Lovely weather in Gielinor this fine day.
translation: Iyi, tesekkürler. Gielinor'da hava cok güzel bugün.

english: Weather?
Yes weather, you know.
The state or condition of the atmosphere at a time and place, with respect to variables such as temperature, moisture, wind velocity, and barometric pressure.
translation: Sicaklik, nem, rüzgar hizi ve barometrik basinc gibi degiskenlere bagli olarak, belirli bir zamanda ve yerde atmosferin durumu veya kosulu.

english: Not just a pretty face eh? Ha ha ha.
translation: Sadece güzel bir yüz degil, ha? Ha ha ha.

english: Do you know of any quests I can do?
translation: Yapabilecegim herhangi bir görev biliyor musun?

english: What kind of quest are you looking for?
Hmm.. dangerous you say? What sort of creatures are you looking to fight?
translation: Hmm... tehlikeli mi dedin? Ne tür yaratiklarla savasmak istiyorsun?

english: Big scary demons!
You are a brave soul indeed.
Now that you mention it, I heard a rumour about a fortune-teller in Varrock who is rambling about some kind of greater evil.. sounds demon-like if you ask me.
translation: Simdi sen bahsedince, Varrock'ta bir falcinin daha büyük bir kötülük hakkinda sacmaladigini duydum... Bana sorarsan seytan gibi geliyor.

english: Perhaps you could check it out if you are as brave as you say?
translation: Eger dedigin kadar cesursan, gidip bir bakabilirsin.

english: Thanks for the tip, perhaps I will.
I've already killed the demon Delrith. He was merely a stain on my sword when I was finished with him!
translation: Delrith adli iblisi coktan öldürdüm. Onu öldürdügümde kilicimda sadece bir leke kalmisti!

english: Well done! However I'm sure if you search around the world you will find more challenging foes to slay.
translation: Aferin! Ancak eminim ki dünyayi arastirirsan, öldürmek icin daha zorlu düsmanlar bulacaksin.

english: Vampyres!
Ha ha. I personally don't believe in such things. However, there is a man in Draynor Village who has been scaring the village folk with stories of vampyres.
translation: Ha ha. Sahsen ben böyle seylere inanmiyorum. Ancak Draynor Köyü'nde vampir hikayeleriyle köylüleri korkutan bir adam var.

english: He's named Morgan and can be found in one of the village houses. Perhaps you could see what the matter is?
translation: Adi Morgan ve köydeki evlerden birinde bulunabilir. Belki ne oldugunu ögrenebilirsin?

english: Thanks for the tip.
Oh I have already killed that nasty blood-sucking vampyre. Draynor will be safe now.
translation: Oh, o igrenc kan emici vampiri coktan öldürdüm. Draynor artik güvende olacak.

english: Yeah, yeah of course you did. Everyone knows vampyres are not real....
translation: Evet, evet, tabii ki öldürdün. Herkes vampirlerin gercek olmadigini bilir...

english: What! I did slay the beast..I really did.
translation: Ne! Ben o canavari öldürdüm... Gercekten öldürdüm.

english: You're not fooling anyone you know.
..Huh.. But... Hey! I did... believe what you like.
translation: ...Huh... Ama... Hey! Ben... Neye inanirsan inan.

english: Small.. something small would be good.
translation: Kücük... Kücük bir sey iyi olur.

english: Small? Small isn't really that dangerous though is it?
translation: Kücük mü? Kücük olanlar o kadar tehlikeli degildir, degil mi?

english: Yes it can be! There could be anything from an evil chicken to a poisonous spider. They attack in numbers you know!
translation: Evet, olabilir! Kötü bir tavuktan zehirli bir örümcege kadar her sey olabilir. Sayica üstünlük saglayarak saldirirlar, biliyorsun!

english: Yes ok, point taken. Speaking of small monsters, I hear old Wizard Mizgog in the wizards' tower has just had all his beads taken by a gang of mischievous imps.
translation: Evet, tamam, anladim. Kücük canavarlardan bahsetmisken, büyücüler kulesindeki yasli büyücü Mizgog'un tüm boncuklarinin yaramaz cinler cetesi tarafindan calindigini duydum.

english: Sounds like it could be a quest for you?
translation: Bu senin icin bir görev olabilir gibi görünüyor?

english: Thanks for your help.
Yes I know of Mizgog and have already helped him with his imp problem. It took me ages to find those beads!
translation: Evet, Mizgog'u taniyorum ve cin sorununda ona yardim ettim bile. O boncuklari bulmak cok zamanimi aldi!

english: Imps will be imps!
Maybe another time.
Something easy please, I'm new here.
translation: Kolay bir sey lütfen, ben buraya yeniyim.

english: I can tell you about plenty of small easy tasks.
translation: Sana bircok kücük ve kolay görev söyleyebilirim.

english: The Lumbridge cook has been having problems, the Duke is confused over some strange talisman and on top of all that, poor lad Romeo in Varrock has girlfriend problems.
translation: Lumbridge ascisi sorunlar yasiyor, Dük garip bir tilsim yüzünden kafasi karisik ve üstüne üstlük, Varrock'taki zavalli Romeo'nun kiz arkadasi sorunlari var.

english: Tell me about the Lumbridge cook.
It's funny really, the cook would forget his head if it wasn't screwed on. This time he forgot to get ingredients for the Duke's birthday cake.
translation: Gercekten komik, asci kafasi yerine takili olmasa kafasini da unutur. Bu sefer Dük'ün dogum günü pastasi icin malzemeleri almayi unutmus.

english: Perhaps you could help him? You will probably find him in the Lumbridge Castle kitchen.
translation: Belki ona yardim edebilirsin? Onu muhtemelen Lumbridge Kalesi'nin mutfaginda bulabilirsin.

english: Thank you. I shall go speak with him.
I have already helped the cook in Lumbridge.
Oh yes, so you have. I am sure the Duke will be pleased.
translation: Evet, öyleymis. Dük cok memnun olacaktir.

english: Tell me about the Duke's strange talisman.
translation: Dük'ün garip tilsimi hakkinda bana bilgi ver.

english: Well the Duke of Lumbridge has found a strange talisman that no one seems to understand. Perhaps you could help him? You can probably find him upstairs in Lumbridge Castle.
translation: Lumbridge Dükü, kimsenin anlamadigi garip bir tilsim bulmus. Belki ona yardim edebilirsin? Onu muhtemelen Lumbridge Kalesi'nin üst katinda bulabilirsin.

english: Sounds mysterious. I may just do that. Thanks.
translation: Gizemli geliyor. Belki de öyle yaparim. Tesekkürler.

english: Yes, I have already solved the Rune mysteries.
Ah excellent. Thank you very much adventurer.
Tell me about Romeo and his girlfriend please.
translation: Bana Romeo ve kiz arkadasi hakkinda bilgi ver lütfen.

english: Romeo in Varrock needs help with finding his beloved Juliet, you may be able to help him out.
translation: Varrock'taki Romeo, sevgilisi Juliet'i bulmak icin yardima ihtiyac duyuyor, ona yardim edebilirsin.

english: Unless of course you manage to find Juliet first in which case she has probably lost Romeo.
translation: Tabii önce Juliet'i bulursan, o zaman muhtemelen Romeo'yu kaybetmistir.

english: Right, ok. Romeo is in Varrock?
Yes you can't miss him, he's wandering aimlessly in the square.
translation: Evet, onu kacirman imkansiz, meydanda amacsizca dolasiyor.

english: Oh yes, I've already helped Romeo in the best possible way I can...
translation: Oh evet, Romeo'ya elimden gelen en iyi sekilde yardim ettim bile...

english: Really?
Yup.
...How?
He thinks Juliet is dead...
Well.. ok.. well done... I think...
I'm a thinker rather than fighter, anything skill orientated?
translation: Ben savascidan cok düsünür biriyim, beceri odakli bir sey var mi?

english: Skills play a big part when you want to progress in knowledge throughout Gielinor. I know of a few skill- related quests that can get you started.
translation: Gielinor'da bilgi birikimini gelistirmek istiyorsan beceriler cok önemli bir rol oynar. Baslamana yardimci olabilecek birkac beceri odakli görev biliyorum.

english: You may be able to help out Fred the farmer who is in need of someones crafting expertise.
translation: Zanaat konusunda uzmanliga ihtiyaci olan ciftci Fred'e yardim edebilirsin.

english: Or, there's always Doric the dwarf who needs an errand running for him?
translation: Ya da, her zaman onun icin ayak isleri yapmaya ihtiyaci olan cüce Doric var.

english: Tell me about Fred the farmer please.
translation: Ciftci Fred hakkinda bilgi verir misin lütfen?

english: You can find Fred next to the field of sheep in Lumbridge. Perhaps you should go and speak with him.
translation: Fred'i Lumbridge'deki koyun tarlasinin yaninda bulabilirsin. Belki de gidip onunla konusmalisin.

english: Thanks, maybe I will.
I have already helped Fred the farmer. I sheared his sheep and made 20 balls of wool for him.
translation: Ciftci Fred'e zaten yardim ettim. Koyunlarini kirktim ve onun icin 20 top yün yaptim.

english: He wouldn't let me kill his chickens though.
Lumbridge chickens do make good target practice.
translation: Lumbridge tavuklari iyi bir hedef talimi oluyor.

english: You will have to wait until he isn't looking.
Tell me about Doric the dwarf.
Doric the dwarf is located north of Falador. He might be able to help you with smithing. You should speak to him. He may let you use his anvils.
translation: Cüce Doric, Falador'un kuzeyinde bulunuyor. Demircilik konusunda sana yardimci olabilir. Onunla konusmalisin. Sana örslerini kullanmana izin verebilir.

english: Yes, I've been to see Doric already. He was happy to let me use his anvils after I ran a small errand for him.
translation: Evet, Doric'i zaten gördüm. Onun icin kücük bir is yaptim ve örslerini kullanmama izin verdi.

english: Oh good, Thank you [player name]!
I want to do all kinds of things, do you know of anything like that?
translation: Her türlü seyi yapmak istiyorum, böyle bir sey biliyor musun?

english: Of course I do. Gielinor is a huge place you know, now let me think...
translation: Tabii ki biliyorum. Gielinor cok büyük bir yer, bir düsüneyim...

english: Hetty the witch in Rimmington might be able to offer help in the ways of magical abilities..
translation: Rimmington'daki cadi Hetty, sihirli yetenekler konusunda sana yardim edebilir.

english: Also, pirates are currently docked in Port Sarim, Where pirates are, treasure is never far away...
translation: Ayrica, korsanlar su anda Port Sarim'de demirlemis durumda. Korsanlarin oldugu yerde hazine de uzakta degildir...

english: Or you could go help out Ernest who got lost in Draynor Manor, spooky place that.
translation: Ya da Draynor Malikanesi'nde kaybolan Ernest'e yardim edebilirsin, orasi ürkütücü bir yer.

english: Tell me about Hetty the witch.

Hetty the witch can be found in Rimmington, south of Falador. She's currently working on some new potions. Perhaps you could give her a hand? She might be able to offer help with your magical abilities.
translation: Cadi Hetty, Falador'un güneyindeki Rimmington'da bulunabilir. Su anda yeni iksirler üzerinde calisiyor. Belki ona yardim edebilirsin? Sihirli yeteneklerin konusunda sana yardim edebilir.

english: Ok thanks, let's hope she doesn't turn me into a potato or something..
translation: Tamam, tesekkürler, umarim beni patates falan yapmaz...

english: Yes, I have already been to see Hetty, she gave me super cosmic powers after I helped out with her potion! I could probably destroy you with a single thought!
translation: Evet, Hetty'yi zaten gördüm, iksirine yardim ettikten sonra bana süper kozmik gücler verdi! Muhtemelen tek bir düsünceyle seni yok edebilirim!

english: Did she really?
No not really...
Right.....
Tell me about Pirate's Treasure.
RedBeard Frank in Port Sarim's bar, the Rusty Anchor, might be able to tell you about the rumored treasure that is buried somewhere in Gielinor.
translation: Port Sarim'deki Rusty Anchor barinda bulunan RedBeard Frank, Gielinor'da bir yerlere gömülü oldugu söylenen hazine hakkinda size bilgi verebilir.

english: Sounds adventurous, I may have to check that out. Thank you.
translation: Kulaga macerali geliyor, bir bakmam gerekebilir. Tesekkürler.

english: Yarr! I already found the booty!
Yarr indeed my friend. A most excellent find.
translation: Yarr, gercekten dostum. Harika bir kesif.

english: Yarr!
Yarrr!
YARRR!
Right, that's enough of that!
..Sorry.
Tell me about Ernest please.
The best place to start would be at the gate to Draynor Manor. There you will find Veronica who will be able to tell you more.
translation: Baslamak icin en iyi yer Draynor Malikanesi'nin kapisidir. Orada sana daha fazla bilgi verebilecek Veronica'yi bulacaksin.

english: I suggest you tread carefully in that place; it's haunted.
translation: Orada dikkatli olmani öneririm; orasi hayaletli.

english: Sounds like fun. I've never been to a Haunted Manor before.
translation: Kulaga eglenceli geliyor. Daha önce hayaletli bir malikaneye hic gitmedim.

english: Yeah, I found Ernest already. Professor Oddenstein had turned him into a chicken!
translation: Evet, Ernest'i buldum bile. Profesör Oddenstein onu tavuga dönüstürmüs!

english: A chicken!?
Yeah a chicken. It could have been worse though.
translation: Evet, tavuga. Daha kötüsü de olabilirdi.

english: Very true, poor guy.
Where can I get a haircut like yours?
translation: Seninki gibi bir sac kesimi nerede yaptirabilirim?

english: Yes, it does look like you need a hairdresser.
translation: Evet, kuaföre ihtiyacin var gibi görünüyor.

english: Oh thanks!
No problem. The hairdresser in Falador will probably be able to sort you out.
translation: Rica ederim. Falador'daki kuaför muhtemelen sana yardimci olabilir.

english: The Lumbridge general store sells useful maps if you don't know the way.
translation: Yolu bilmiyorsan, Lumbridge genel magazasinda kullanisli haritalar satiyorlar.

english: What's up?
I assume the sky is up..
You assume?
Yeah, unfortunately I don't seem to be able to look up.
translation: Evet, ne yazik ki yukariya bakamiyorum.

english: Can I buy your stick?
It's not a stick! I'll have you know it's a very powerful staff!
translation: O sopa degil! Bilmeni isterim ki, o cok güclü bir asa!

english: Really? Show me what it can do!
translation: Gercekten mi? Ne yapabildigini göster bana!

english: Um..It's a bit low on power at the moment..
It's a stick isn't it?
...Ok it's a stick.. But only while I save up for a staff. Zaff in Varrock square sells them in his shop.
translation: ...Tamam, bu bir sopa... Ama sadece asa icin para biriktirirken. Varrock meydanindaki Zaff dükkaninda satiyor.

english: Well good luck with that.
Do you have anything of value which I can have?
translation: Bana verebilecegin degerli bir seyin var mi?

english: Are you asking for free stuff?
Well... er... yes.
No I do not have anything I can give you. If I did have anything of value I wouldn't want to give it away.
translation: Hayir, sana verebilecegim hicbir seyim yok. Degerli bir seyim olsaydi, onu vermek istemezdim.

english: Your shoe lace is untied.
No it's not!
No you're right. I have nothing to back that up.
translation: Hayir, haklisin. Bunu kanitlayacak hicbir seyim yok.

english: Fool! Leave me alone!
Do you know what happened in the castle cellar?
translation: Kalenin mahzeninde ne oldugunu biliyor musun?

english: I heard the wall collapsed or something. I don't know why. Perhaps you could get to the bottom of this mystery!
translation: Duvar cöktü falan diye duydum. Neden oldugunu bilmiyorum. Belki bu gizemi cözebilirsin!

english: Where am I?
How are you today?
Do you know of any quests I can do?
translation: Yapabilecegim herhangi bir görev var mi?

english: Your shoe lace is untied.
Are there any quests I can do here?
translation: Burada yapabilecegim herhangi bir görev var mi?

english: I fancy a bit of a fight, anything dangerous?
translation: Biraz kavga etmek istiyorum, tehlikeli bir sey var mi?

english: Big scary demons!
Vampyres!
Small.. something small would be good.
translation: Kücük... kücük bir sey iyi olur.

english: Maybe another time.
Something easy please, I'm new here.
translation: Kolay bir sey lütfen, ben buraya yeniyim.

english: The Lumbridge cook.
The Duke's strange talisman.
Romeo and his girlfriend.
I'm a thinker rather than fighter, anything skill oriented?
translation: Ben savascidan cok düsünürüm, beceri odakli bir sey var mi?

english: Fred the farmer.
Doric the dwarf.
I want to do all kinds of things, do you know of anything like that?
translation: Her türlü seyi yapmak istiyorum, böyle bir sey biliyor musun?

english: Hetty the Witch.
Pirate's treasure.
Ernest and Draynor Manor.
Where can I get a haircut like yours?
translation: Seninki gibi bir sac kesimi nerede yaptirabilirim?

english: What's up?
Can I buy your stick?
Do you have anything of value which I can have?
translation: Bana verebilecegin degerli bir seyin var mi?

english: Do you know what happened in the castle cellar?
translation: Kale mahzeninde ne oldugunu biliyor musun?

english: Thank you for all your help in solving the murder.
translation: Cinayeti cözmemde yardim ettigin icin tesekkürler.

english: Here you go.
Donovan has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
Dooooom!
Where?
All around us! I can feel it in the air, hear it on the wind, smell it... also in the air!
translation: Her yerde! Havada hissedebiliyorum, rüzgarda duyabiliyorum, kokusunu alabiliyorum... yine havada!

english: Is there anything we can do about this doom?
translation: Bu felaketle ilgili yapabilecegimiz bir sey var mi?

english: There is nothing you need to do my friend! I am the Doomsayer, although my real title could be something like the Danger Tutor.
translation: Yapman gereken hicbir sey yok dostum! Ben Kiyamet Habercisiyim, ama gercek unvanim daha cok Tehlike Ögretmeni gibi bir sey olabilir.

english: Danger Tutor?
Yes! I roam the world sensing danger.
If you see the signs often enough, then you can turn them off; by that time you likely know what the area has in store for you.
translation: Isaretleri yeterince sik görürsen, onlari kapatabilirsin; o zamana kadar, o bölgenin sana neler getirecegini muhtemelen biliyorsundur.

english: If I find a dangerous area, then I put up warning signs that will tell you what is so dangerous about that area.
translation: Tehlikeli bir bölge bulursam, o bölgenin ne kadar tehlikeli oldugunu belirten uyari isaretleri koyarim.

english: But what if I want to see the warnings again?
translation: Peki ya uyarilari tekrar görmek istersem?

english: That's why I'm waiting here!
If you want to see the warning messages again, I can turn them back on for you.
translation: Uyari mesajlarini tekrar görmek istersen, senin icin tekrar acabilirim.

english: Thanks, I'll remember that if I see any warning messages.
translation: Tesekkürler, uyari mesajlari görürsem bunu hatirlayacagim.

english: You're welcome!
Do you need to turn on any warnings right now?
translation: Su anda herhangi bir uyariyi acmak istiyor musunuz?

english: Yes, I do.
Not right now.
Ok, keep an eye out for the messages though!
I will.
You got lucky this time, next time doom will be upon you.
translation: Bu sefer sansliydiniz, bir dahaki sefere felaket basiniza gelecek.

english: Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to answer this for me.
Please enter the answer to the question.
How can that be? Try again!
Spot on!
I'd like to remove my PvP protection.
That way doom lies, I cannot comply. Your protection will be finished in less than 5 minutes.
translation: Bu sekilde felaket gelir, bunu kabul edemem. Korumaniz 5 dakikadan az bir süre icinde sona erecek.

english: Are you sure? Much doom lies that way and it can not be undone!
translation: Emin misiniz? Bu sekilde büyük bir felaket gelir ve geri alinamaz!

english: Yes, remove my PvP protection right now.
On your head be it!
Yes, arrange for my PvP protection to end in 1 minute.
translation: Evet, PvP korumamin 1 dakika icinde sona ermesini ayarla.

english: Much doom be with you.
You have 1 minute of PvP protection left.
On second thoughts, leave it.
translation: Bir daha düsündüm de, birak kalsin.

english: Yes, I do.
Not right now.
Is there anything we can do about this doom?
translation: Bu kiyametle ilgili yapabilecegimiz bir sey var mi?

english: I'd like to remove my PvP protection.
Yes, remove my PvP protection right now.
Yes, arrange for my PvP protection to end in 1 minute.
translation: Evet, PvP korumamin 1 dakika icinde sona ermesini ayarla.

english: On second thoughts, leave it.
translation: Bir daha düsündüm de, birak gitsin.

english: Hmm... It seems to be locked.
Yeah, well spotted. You have to be one of us to go in there, and you're clearly not. Now get out of here.
translation: Evet, iyi fark ettin. Oraya girmek için bizim gibi olman gerekir, ama sen açikça öyle degilsin. Simdi buradan git.

english: Are you new? I've never seen you around here before.
translation: Yeni misin? Seni daha önce buralarda görmedim.

english: You could say that. Long live General Khazard!
translation: Öyle de denebilir. General Khazard çok yasa!

english: Er... yeah...
Hello traveller, what brings you to my humble smithy?
translation: Merhaba gezgin, benim mütevazi demirci dükkanima seni ne getirdi?

english: I wanted to use your anvils.
My anvils get enough work with my own use. I make pickaxes, and it takes a lot of hard work. If you could get me some more materials, then I could let you use them.
translation: Örslerim benim kullanimimla yeterince calisiyor. Kazma yapiyorum ve bu cok zor bir is. Bana biraz daha malzeme getirirsen, kullanmana izin verebilirim.

english: Yes, I will get you the materials.

Clay is what I use more than anything, to make casts. Could you get me 6 clay, 4 copper ore, and 2 iron ore, please? I could pay a little, and let you use my anvils. Take this pickaxe with you just in case you need it.
translation: Döküm yapmak icin en cok kil kullaniyorum. Bana 6 kil, 4 bakir cevheri ve 2 demir cevheri getirir misin lütfen? Biraz para ödeyebilirim ve örslerimi kullanmana izin veririm. Ihtiyacin olursa diye bu kazmayi da al.

english: Where can I find those?
You'll be able to find all those ores in the rocks just inside the Dwarven Mine. Head east from here and you'll find the entrance in the side of Ice Mountain.
translation: Tüm bu cevherleri Cüce Madeni'nin icindeki kayalarda bulabilirsin. Buradan doguya dogru git, giris Ice Mountain'in yaninda.

english: Certainly, I'll be right back!
You know, it's funny you should require those exact things!
translation: Biliyor musun, tam da bu malzemelere ihtiyacin olmasi cok komik!

english: What do you mean?
I can usually fit 28 things in my backpack and in a world full of quite literally limitless possibilities, a complete coincidence has occurred!
translation: Sirt cantama genellikle 28 sey sigdirabilirim ve sinirsiz olasiliklarla dolu bir dünyada, tam bir tesadüf yasandi!

english: I don't quite understand what you're saying?
translation: Ne demek istedigini tam olarak anlamadim?

english: Well, out of pure coincidence, despite definitely not knowing what you were about to request, I just so happened to have carried those exact items!
translation: Sey, tamamen tesadüf eseri, ne isteyecegini kesinlikle bilmeden, tam da bu malzemeleri yanimda tasimistim!

english: In fact, in the exact quantities too!
Oh my, that is a coincidence! Pass them here, please. I can spare you some coins for your trouble, and please use my anvils any time you want.
translation: Vay canina, bu ne tesadüf! Lütfen buraya verin. Zahmetiniz icin size biraz para verebilirim ve istediginiz zaman örslerimi kullanabilirsiniz.

english: Quest complete!
No, hitting rocks is for the boring people, sorry.
translation: Hayir, kayalari vurmak sikici insanlar icindir, üzgünüm.

english: That is your choice. Nice to meet you anyway.
translation: Bu sizin seciminiz. Yine de tanistigimiza memnun oldum.

english: I wanted to use your whetstone.
The whetstone is for more advanced smithing, but I could let you use it as well as my anvils if you could get me some more materials.
translation: Bileme tasi daha ileri düzey demircilik icin ama bana biraz daha malzeme getirirsen, örslerimle birlikte onu da kullanmana izin verebilirim.

english: Mind your own business, shortstuff!
How nice to meet someone with such pleasant manners. Do come again when you need to shout at someone smaller than you!
translation: Bu kadar nazik biriyle tanismak ne güzel. Kendinden daha kücük birine bagirmak istediginde tekrar gel!

english: I was just checking out the landscape.
Hope you like it. I do enjoy the solitude of my little home. If you get time, please say hi to my friends in the Dwarven Mine.
translation: Umarim begenmissindir. Kücük evimin yalnizligini cok seviyorum. Vaktin olursa, Cüce Madeni'ndeki arkadaslarima selam söyle.

english: Dwarven Mine?
Yep, the entrance is in the side of Ice Mountain just to the east of here. They're a friendly bunch. Stop in at Nurmof's store and buy one of my pickaxes!
translation: Evet, girisi buradan doguya dogru, Buz Dagi'nin yanindadir. Cok dost canlisi bir gruptur. Nurmof'un dükkanina ugra ve kazmalarimdan bir tane al!

english: Will do!
What do you make here?
I make pickaxes. I am the best maker of pickaxes in the whole of Gielinor.
translation: Kazma yapiyorum. Gielinor'un en iyi kazma ustasi benim.

english: Do you have any to sell?
Who's Nurmof?
Nurmof has a store over in the Dwarven Mine. You can find the entrance on the side of Ice Mountain to the east of here.
translation: Nurmof'un Cüce Madeni'nde bir dükkani var. Girisi buradan doguya, Buz Dagi'nin yaninda bulabilirsin.

english: Ah, fair enough.
Hey, who said you could use that? My anvils get enough work with my own use. I make pickaxes, and it takes a lot of hard work.
translation: Hey, onu kullanabilecegini kim söyledi? Örslerim benim kullanimimla yeterince calisiyor. Kazma yapiyorum ve bu cok zor bir is.

english: Sorry, would it be OK if I used your anvils?
If you could get me some more materials then I could let you use them.
translation: Bana biraz daha malzeme getirirsen kullanmana izin verebilirim.

english: I didn't want to use your anvils anyway.
That is your choice.
Hello traveller, how is your metalworking coming along?
translation: Merhaba gezgin, metal isciligin nasil gidiyor?

english: Not too bad, Doric.
Good, the love of metal is a thing close to my heart.
translation: Güzel, metale olan sevgi benim icin cok önemli bir sey.

english: Well done.
So, you've come to the right place?
I wanted to use your anvils.
Yes.
Where can I find those?
Certainly, I'll be right back!
No.
I want to use your whetstone.
Mind your own business, shortstuff!
I was just checking out the landscape.
Dwarven Mine?
Will do!
What do you make here?
Who's Nurmof?
Ah, fair enough.
Sorry, would it be OK if I used your anvils?
Yes, I will get you materials.
No, hitting rocks is for the boring people, sorry.
translation: Hayir, kayalari vurmak sikici insanlar icindir, üzgünüm.

english: I didn't want to use your anvils anyway.
Hello again dearie. How are you doing?
Pretty good!
That's good to hear.
Not too good actually!
Oh well.
What's it like living so close to the wilderness?
translation: Wildernessya bu kadar yakin yasamak nasil bir sey?

english: Oh, it's not all that bad. It was a bit scary at first but as long as I don't go past the warning signs I'm all right.
translation: Oh, o kadar da kötü degil. Baslangicta biraz korkutucuydu ama uyari isaretlerini gecmedigim sürece sorun yok.

english: It's actually pretty quiet here. I used to live in Lumbridge and, let me tell you, that's the dangerous place for people like me.
translation: Aslinda burasi oldukca sessiz. Eskiden Lumbridge'de yasiyordum ve inan bana, benim gibi insanlar icin cok tehlikeli bir yerdi.

english: Thieves were picking people's pockets with impunity, and killing them on the streets in broad daylight!
translation: Hirsizlar insanlarin ceplerini cezasiz bir sekilde bosaltiyor ve onlari güpegündüz sokaklarda öldürüyorlardi!

english: And there weren't even any guards to protect us! Not that the guards in the other cities do much good to protect people from what I've heard.
translation: Ve bizi koruyacak hicbir muhafiz yoktu! Duyduguma göre diger sehirlerdeki muhafizlar da insanlari korumak icin pek bir sey yapmiyorlarmis.

english: I just thank goodness I haven't got an Attack option any more! I wouldn't last five minutes!
translation: Artik Saldiri secenegim olmadigi icin sükrediyorum! Bes dakika bile dayanamazdim!

english: How did Dave come to be evil?
Oh, I don't know really. He's always been evil, I think. Maybe growing up so close to the wilderness has affected him in some way.
translation: Oh, gercekten bilmiyorum. Sanirim o her zaman kötüydü. Belki de Wildernessya bu kadar yakin büyümesi onu bir sekilde etkilemistir.

english: When he was little he used to want to go into Edgeville dungeon. You know how kids are, always wanting to be dungeon adventurers! But he didn't want to be a hero, he wanted to be a monster!
translation: Kücükken Edgeville zindanina gitmek isterdi. Cocuklar nasildir bilirsiniz, hep zindan maceracisi olmak isterler! Ama o kahraman olmak istemiyordu, canavar olmak istiyordu!

english: And then he spent all summer building a tree-house. Except it wasn't a tree-house, of course, it was his Tower of Fear!
translation: Sonra bütün yazini agac ev yapmakla gecirdi. Tabii ki o bir agac ev degildi, onun Korku Kulesi'ydi!

english: Of course I was hoping he'd have grown out of it by now and maybe even left home. But at least it keeps him happy.
translation: Tabii ki simdiye kadar bu huyundan vazgecip belki de evden ayrilacagini umuyordum. Ama en azindan bu onu mutlu ediyor.

english: Hello again.
May I use your spices for making stew?
translation: Güvec yapmak icin baharatlarini kullanabilir miyim?

english: You can if you can find them. Dave's hell-rats stole them all!
translation: Bulabilirsen kullanabilirsin. Dave'in cehennem fareleri hepsini caldi!

english: I'd better go and kill some hell-rats then.
translation: O zaman gidip birkac cehennem faresi öldüreyim.

english: Hello again. Did you make your stew?
I haven't been able to make any stew that Dave likes yet.
translation: Dave'in sevdigi bir güvec yapamadim henüz.

english: Oh, he's terribly hard to please, isn't he? I never know how to make food evil enough for him, I just have to try different things and see what he likes.
translation: Oh, onu memnun etmek cok zor, degil mi? Onun icin yeterince kötü yemekleri nasil yapacagimi bilmiyorum, farkli seyler denemek ve neyi sevdigini görmek zorundayim.

english: What's happened to my cat?
Oh, poor thing. The hell-rats do that, you know. I think a nice drink of milk would sort it out. Shall I give it one?
translation: Zavalli sey. Cehennem fareleri yapar bunu, bilirsin. Sanirim bir bardak süt sorunu cözer. Verelim mi?

english: Yes please!
Here puss...
Your hell-cat transforms into an ordinary cat.
translation: Cehennem kedin siradan bir kediye dönüsüyor.

english: No, I like it this way.
Well, I suppose as long as the cat is all right, it doesn't matter what it looks like.
translation: Kedinin iyi oldugu sürece, nasil göründügü önemli degil sanirim.

english: You've found another clue!
You've obtained a casket!
Pretty good!
Not too good actually
What's it like living so close to the wilderness?
translation: Wildernessya bu kadar yakin yasamak nasil bir sey?

english: How did Dave come to be evil?
I haven't been able to make some stew that Dave likes yet.
translation: Dave'in sevdigi bir güvec yapamadim henüz.

english: What's happened to my cat?
Yes please!
No, I like it this way.
I expect you to die!
Can't talk now, pies to make! Bread to bake! Breaks to take!
translation: Su anda konusamam, turta yapmam lazim! Ekmek pisirmem lazim! Mola vermem lazim!

english: You seem a bit stressed.
Far from it, just busy busy busy! Best way to be!
translation: Hic de degil, sadece cok mesgulüm! En iyisi bu!

english: Oi!
I've got to go!
Hello, I need some yeastier dough, do you have any?
translation: Merhaba, mayali hamur lazim, var mi?

english: Yeastier dough? I don't know.
What is that?
I think it's just particularly yeasty dough.
And why would I give you any of my lovely dough?
translation: Neden sana benim güzel hamurumdan vereyim ki?

english: I'm making some Easter Buns to cheer up the Easter Bunny.
translation: Paskalya Tavsanini neselendirmek icin Paskalya Cörekleri yapiyorum.

english: Oh that silly Eggrabbit! Anything for him.
translation: Ah, o aptal Yumurta Tavsani! Onun icin her seyi yaparim.

english: Of course you'll need space to carry the dough, come back when you can handle it.
translation: Tabii ki hamuru tasimak icin yer lazim, tasiyabilecegin zaman gel.

english: Alright.
Here you go, yeastier dough.
It's potent stuff!
Thank you, that's very kind of you.
Hello!
You again! What is it now?
Thanks for the dough.
You're welcome!
I need to get back to work now.
Okay, I'll talk to you later. Bye!
Quick quick, only a moment to spare, what's up?
translation: Cabuk cabuk, sadece bir dakikan var, ne var?

english: I need more of that yeastier dough.
translation: Daha fazla mayali hamura ihtiyacim var.

english: Though thinking about it, I don't have enough space at the moment. I'll come back.
translation: Düsündüm de, su anda yeterli yerim yok. Geri gelirim.

english: Yes yes, come back. Very good.
translation: Evet, evet, geri gel. Cok iyi.

english: Alright, alright, here you go. Please keep in mind I'm not made of dough.
translation: Tamam, tamam, al bakalim. Unutma, ben hamurdan yapilmadim.

english: You look like you are, all covered in flour.
translation: Öyle görünüyorsun, her yerin unla kapli.

english: Occupational hazard! You get used to it.
I hope you put that dough to good use.
Oh I did indeed.
theyrecomingtogetme theyrecomingtogetme...
translation: geliyorlar beni yakalamaya geliyorlar beni yakalamaya...

english: It is all you deserve. Lord Rologarth is master of this castle once more. Let him protect you - if he wants to.
translation: Hepsini hak ettin. Lord Rologarth bir kez daha bu kalenin efendisi oldu. Istersen seni korumasini sagla.

english: What, what do you want?
Why are you out here on your own?
I was drawn here... I use to be a traveling doctor, until I arrived in Al Kharid.
translation: Buraya cekildim... Al Kharid'e gelene kadar gezgin bir doktordum.

english: Then I heard it call to me... I immediately gave up my profession and set up here.
translation: Sonra beni cagirdigini duydum... Hemen meslegimi biraktim ve buraya yerlestim.

english: I'm happy here... the voices tell me I'm happy here. I can continue my work.
translation: Burada mutluyum... sesler bana burada mutlu oldugumu söylüyor. Isime devam edebilirim.

english: Uhh... what voices? There is no one else here.
translation: Uhh... hangi sesler? Burada baska kimse yok.

english: Of course there isn't, the hole you idiot, the hole speaks to me and I listen... It says I will do great things, only if I listen...
translation: Tabii ki yok, delik aptal, delik benimle konusuyor ve ben dinliyorum... Dinlersem büyük seyler basaracagimi söylüyor... .

english: Well... alright then, I think I'm just going to go and leave then.
translation: Peki... tamam o zaman, ben gidip gidecegim.

english: Hello. What brings you to my surgery today?
translation: Merhaba. Bugün muayenehaneme ne getiriyor sizi?

english: Okay, this will hurt you more than it will me.
translation: Tamam, bu size benden daha cok aci verecek.

english: You look healthy to me!
What did you do before you worked here?
translation: Burada calismaya baslamadan önce ne yapiyordunuz?

english: Oh, I used to be a travelling surgeon. Whenever I saw someone have an accident, I'd be there to check for concussion and offer treatment.
translation: Eskiden gezgin cerrahlik yapiyordum. Birinin kaza gecirdigini gördügümde, oraya gidip beyin sarsintisi olup olmadigini kontrol eder ve tedavi ederdim.

english: It was a worthy cause, but I didn't feel properly appreciated, so I retired. Then I got bored, so I came to work here.
translation: Bu degerli bir amacti, ama yeterince takdir edilmedigimi hissettim, bu yüzden emekli oldum. Sonra sikildim, bu yüzden buraya calismaya geldim.

english: So can I help you with something?
Nothing, I'm fine.
Can you heal me?
What did you do before you worked here?
translation: Burada calismaya baslamadan önce ne yapiyordunuz?

english: Nothing, I'm fine.
Buy me a drrink pleassh...
translation: Bana bir icki ismarlar misiniz lütfen...

english: I think you've had enough.
Have you got any guam leaf? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a guam leaf.
translation: Guam yapragin var mi? Hyde sorunumu cözdüm, acil degil ama guam yapragi isime yarayabilir.

english: I don't have any.
Fair enough. Here, have a spare potion, and thanks for your time.
translation: Anladim. Al, yedek iksir al ve zaman ayirdigin icin tesekkürler.

english: Have you got any torstol? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a torstol.
translation: Torstolun var mi? Hyde sorunumu cözdüm, acil degil ama torstol isime yarayabilir.

english: Here you are.
Thank you so much! Here, take this potion in return.
translation: Cok tesekkür ederim! Al, karsiliginda bu iksiri al.

english: No, I need it myself.
Have you got any dwarf weed? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a dwarf weed.
translation: Cüce otun var mi? Hyde sorunumu cözdüm, acil degil ama cüce otu isime yarayabilir.

english: Have you got any lantadyme? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a lantadyme.
translation: Lantadyme var mi? Hyde sorunumu cözdüm, acil degil ama lantadyme isime yarayabilir.

english: Have you got any cadantine? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a cadantine.
translation: Cadantine var mi? Hyde sorunumu cözdüm, acil degil ama cadantine iyi olurdu.

english: Have you got any snapdragon? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a snapdragon.
translation: Snapdragon var mi? Hyde sorunumu cözdüm, acil degil ama snapdragon iyi olurdu.

english: Have you got any kwuarm? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a kwuarm.
translation: Kwuarm var mi? Hyde sorunumu cözdüm, acil degil ama kwuarm iyi olurdu.

english: Have you got any avantoe? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with aavantoe.
translation: Avantoe var mi? Hyde sorunumu cözdüm, acil degil ama avantoe isime yarayabilir.

english: Have you got any irit leaf? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with airit leaf.
translation: Irit yapragi var mi? Hyde sorunumu cözdüm, acil degil ama irit yapragi isime yarayabilir.

english: Have you got any toadflax? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a toadflax.
translation: Toadflax var mi? Hyde sorunumu cözdüm, acil degil ama toadflax isime yarayabilir.

english: Have you got any ranarr weed? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a ranarr weed.
translation: Ranarr weed var mi? Hyde sorunumu cözdüm, acil degil ama ranarr weed isime yarayabilir.

english: Have you got any harralander? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a harralander.
translation: Harralander var mi? Hyde sorunumu cözdüm, acil degil ama harralander isime yarayabilir.

english: Have you got any tarromin? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a tarromin.
translation: Tarromin var mi? Hyde sorunumu cözdüm, acil degil ama tarromin isime yarayabilir.

english: Have you got any marrentill? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a marrentill.
translation: Marrentill var mi? Hyde sorunumu cözdüm, acil degil ama marrentill isime yarayabilir.

english: I'll be off now.
Excuse me, I must be off now.
Sorry, I'm trying to get a herb from [player name], but [he/she] seems to be ignoring me.
translation: Üzgünüm, Maceraci'dan bir bitki almaya calisiyorum ama o beni görmezden geliyor gibi.

english: Hello, [player name]. I need a herb.
translation: Merhaba, Maceraci. Bir bitkiye ihtiyacim var.

english: Hey, [player name]!
Excuse me, [player name]?
Can you hear me, [player name]?
I just need a herb, [player name]!
translation: Sadece bir bitkiye ihtiyacim var, Maceraci!

english: I'll give you a free potion, [player name]!
translation: Sana bedava bir iksir verecegim, Maceraci!

english: Maybe later.
Here you are.
No, I need it myself.
Quack!
Looking to trade?
What have you got?
Take a look.
No thanks.
Then we have nothing more to discuss.
translation: O zaman konusacak bir seyimiz kalmadi.

english: Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: Insan! Muhafizlari cagirmadan köle kafeslerine geri dön!

english: What have you got?
No thanks.
What are you doing in my house...why the impertinence...the sheer cheek...how dare you violate my personal lodgings....
translation: Evimde ne isin var... bu küstahlik... bu yüzsüzlük... nasil cüret edersin benim özel konutuma girersin...

english: I..I was just looking around....
Well get out! Get out....this is my house....and don't go near my daughter Juliet...she's grounded in her room to keep her away from that good for nothing Romeo.
translation: Cik disari! Cik disari... burasi benim evim... ve kizim Juliet'e yaklasma... o ise yaramaz Romeo'dan uzak tutmak icin odasina kapatildi.

english: Yes....sir....
What are you doing here? Snooping around...
I've come to see Juliet on Romeo's behalf.
What...what...Romeo! Why that good for nothing swine...he's always trying to get the affections of my daughter..that soppy, half brained nincompoop won't ever have the heart of my daughter.
translation: Ne... ne... Romeo! O ise yaramaz domuz... her zaman kizimin sevgisini kazanmaya calisiyor... o duygusal, yarim akilli ahmak asla kizimin kalbini kazanamayacak.

english: She deserves someone of character, wit and repose.
translation: O karakterli, zeki ve sakin birini hak ediyor.

english: What's so wrong about Romeo?
Wrong! What's wrong with him...have you actually talked to him? He's nothing but a dim witted upperclass twit, totally useless.
translation: Yanlis! Onun nesi yanlis... onunla hic konustun mu? O, aptal bir üst sinif ahmagindan baska bir sey degil, tamamen ise yaramaz.

english: If he threw a stone at the ground, he'd probably miss! He's totally invisible when it's raining because he's so wet!
translation: Yere bir tas atsa, muhtemelen iskalar! Yagmur yagdiginda tamamen görünmez olur cünkü sirilsiklam olur!

english: If you started with what's right with him, you'd have much less to consider!
translation: Onun iyi yanlarindan baslasaydin, dikkate alman gereken cok daha az sey olurdu!

english: Well, I admit, he's probably not the sharpest knife in the cutlery draw...
translation: Peki, kabul ediyorum, muhtemelen catal bicak cekmecesindeki en keskin bicak degil...

english: Sharp? I've seen keener wit in root vegetables. Anyway, stop changing the subject. Get out of here and don't think you can sneak up those stairs to see Juliet, because I'll catch you and then you'll be for it!
translation: Keskin mi? Kök sebzelerde bile daha keskin zeka gördüm. Neyse, konuyu degistirmeyi birak. Defol buradan ve Juliet'i görmek icin merdivenlerden gizlice cikabilecegini sanma, cünkü seni yakalarim ve o zaman basin belaya girer!

english: That seems a bit harsh....
Harsh but fair I think you'll find...now get OUT!
translation: Sert ama adil, göreceksin... simdi defol!

english: I've just come to have a chat with Juliet.
translation: Sadece Juliet ile sohbet etmeye geldim.

english: What on earth about? I hope you're not in cahoots with that good for nothing Romeo!
translation: Ne hakkinda? Umarim o ise yaramaz Romeo ile isbirligi yapmiyorsundur!

english: Err..no of course not....why would I be?
translation: Hayir, tabii ki hayir... neden yapayim ki?

english: He's been trying to wooo my daughter for an age. Up until now she's had the good sense to just ignore him. I just don't know what's gotten into her recently so that she would give him the time of day.
translation: O, uzun zamandir kizimi tavlamaya calisiyor. Simdiye kadar kizim onu görmezden gelme akilliligini gösterdi. Son zamanlarda ona neden ilgi göstermeye basladigini bilmiyorum.

english: Well, love is mysterious! Perhaps one day someone may even learn to love you!
translation: Ask gizemlidir! Belki bir gün biri seni sevmeyi ögrenir!

english: What! Someone may fall in love with me...what are you trying to insinuate?
translation: Ne! Biri bana asik olabilir mi... Ne ima etmeye calisiyorsun?

english: Err...Nothing....I guess I'd better be going now...
translation: Sey... Hicbir sey... Sanirim artik gitsem iyi olacak...

english: Oh...just looking around...
Just looking around! This is MY house! You might have at least 'ASKED' to view my considerably well appointed abode...but no, you've just burst in with all the elegance of a Troll at a tea party.
translation: Sadece etrafa bakiniyorum! Burasi benim evim! En azindan benim oldukca iyi dösenmis evimi görmek icin “izin” isteyebilirdin... ama hayir, cay partisine gelen bir trolün zarafetiyle iceri daldin.

english: I can see that you're busy ranting so I'll just nip off and investigate a bit.
translation: Görüyorum ki bagirip cagirmakla mesgulsün, ben de gidip biraz arastirma yapayim.

english: Ok, thanks.
What are you doing in my house? Up to no good I shouldn't wonder!
translation: Benim evimde ne yapiyorsun? Kötü bir sey yapmiyorsun herhalde!

english: Just a small chore for Juliet, you do have a lovely daughter in her sir.
translation: Juliet icin kücük bir is, cok güzel bir kiziniz var efendim.

english: Oh...why, thank you...I've always tried to my best...
translation: Oh... tesekkür ederim... Her zaman elimden geleni yapmaya calistim...

english: ...Hang on! Enough of that smiley talk. I have a daughter and I know what she's like. Don't even think of carrying on anything behind my back, I have the eyes of a hawk, nothing gets past me!
translation: ...Durun! Bu güler yüzlü konusmalari birakin. Benim de bir kizim var ve onun nasil oldugunu biliyorum. Arkamdan bir seyler yapmayi aklinizdan bile gecirmeyin, sahin gibi gözlerim var, hicbir sey benden kacmaz!

english: Hey! What's that in your hands...looks like a message to me...with Juliet's barely legible scrawl on it...
translation: Hey! Elinde ne var... bana bir mesaj gibi görünüyor... üzerinde Juliet'in okunakli olmayan el yazisi var...

english: Yes, yes, that's probably why I can't read it!
translation: Evet, evet, muhtemelen bu yüzden okuyamiyorum!

english: Sorry, I mean, that's right sir. I'm just popping to the shops to get some groceries for Juliet.
translation: Üzgünüm, yani, haklisiniz efendim. Juliet icin marketten biraz yiyecek almaya gidiyorum.

english: Right, have to be off now...thanks...
Groceries!
Groceries!...at a time like this, does that girl know what she's putting me through!
translation: Market alisverisi!... Böyle bir zamanda, o kiz bana ne yaptiginin farkinda mi acaba!

english: Do you live here? If so, how's about a couple of hundred gold towards the rent eh? Pay your share I say...you don't want to be like that freeloading Romeo!
translation: Burada mi yasiyorsun? Öyleyse, kira icin birkac yüz altin ödersin, ne dersin? Payini öde derim... O belesci Romeo gibi olmak istemezsin!

english: Hey , what are you doing here?
Nothing much sir...I promise...I'm just an innocent friend of Juliet's...doing her a few favours...as a friend.
translation: Önemli bir sey degil efendim... Söz veriyorum... Ben sadece Juliet'in masum bir arkadasiyim... Ona birkac iyilik yapiyorum... arkadas olarak.

english: Well, just make sure there's no funny business going on that's all I can say. Do you know why?
translation: Peki, sadece tuhaf bir sey olmadigindan emin ol, tek söyleyebilecegim bu. Nedenini biliyor musun?

english: I think I can guess sir...
There's no need to guess! You can see it in my hawk like eyes, in my cat like ears and my dog like nose...
translation: Tahmin etmene gerek yok! Sahin gibi gözlerimden, kedi gibi kulaklarimdan ve köpek gibi burnumdan anlayabilirsin...

english: Are you saying that you look like an animal sir?
translation: Hayvan gibi göründügünüzü mü söylüyorsunuz efendim?

english: NO! Not look like an animal! I have the keen 'SENSES' of an animal and I don't miss a thing. Don't even think about trying anything!
translation: HAYIR! Hayvan gibi görünmüyorum! Bir hayvanin keskin “DUYULARI” var ve hicbir seyi kacirmiyorum. Bir sey yapmayi aklindan bile gecirme!

english: Hey! What's that in your hands? Looks like some sort of potion to me!
translation: Hey! Elinizdeki nedir? Bana bir tür iksir gibi görünüyor!

english: Err...no! Nope! Not a potion! Some medicine...I have a terrible cough ...cough...cough....see?
translation: Hayir! Hayir! Iksir degil! Ilac... Cok kötü öksürüyorum... öksürük... öksürük... görüyor musunuz?

english: >Except, I can't drink too much or else it makes me feel 'really' tired. One sip of this and the lights go out...I mean, I'm asleep in a minute.
translation: >Ancak, cok fazla icemem, yoksa kendimi ‘gercekten’ yorgun hissederim. Bundan bir yudum icince isiklar sönüyor... Yani, bir dakika icinde uykuya daliyorum.

english: Sleep!
Sleep...! How can you even think of such a thing at a time like this? And I hope you have no intentions of sleeping in my house!
translation: Uyu...! Böyle bir zamanda nasil böyle bir sey düsünebilirsin? Ve umarim benim evimde uyumak gibi bir niyetin yoktur!

english: You'll get a bill for rent if I catch you dozing off around here!
translation: Burada uyuklarken yakalarsam sana kira faturasi keserim!

english: My poor Juliet....she's dead...dead! I shouldn't have been so hard on her...she was my lovely daughter. Booo hoooo hooooo!
translation: Zavalli Juliet'im... O öldü... Öldü! Ona bu kadar sert davranmamaliydim... O benim sevgili kizimdi. Booo hoooo hooooo!

english: I suppose you're quite pleased with yourself now...
My house is going to be ruined, why did I agree to throwing this blasted party?
translation: Evim mahvolacak, neden bu lanet partiyi düzenlemeye razi oldum ki?

english: I've come to see Juliet on Romeo's behalf.
I've just come to have a chat with Juliet.
Oh...just looking around...
Ok, thanks.
Ask about the birthday party.
Something else.
Hey there, what can I do for ya?
My name is Drew and I man this here grinding machine. I call her Sandstorm!
translation: Benim adim Drew ve bu ögütme makinesini kullaniyorum. Ona Sandstorm diyorum!

english: I can also look after any buckets ya want me to.
translation: Istediginiz her türlü kovayi da bakabilirim.

english: Me and Sandstorm go way back, we started off back in the desert mining camp, I was a slave and I had the honour of looking after Sandstorm.
translation: Sandstorm ile uzun bir gecmisimiz var, cöl maden kampinda basladik, ben bir köleydim ve Sandstorm'a bakma serefine nail oldum.

english: How did you and Sandstorm get out of the mining camp?
translation: Sen ve Sandstorm maden kampindan nasil ciktiniz?

english: Well, because I was in charge of looking after Sandstorm, I was able to look at the inner workings.
translation: Sandstorm'a bakmakla görevli oldugum icin, ic isleyisini görebiliyordum.

english: While the guards weren't looking, I would take apart Sandstorm piece by piece and place the pieces in boxes and barrels, when Sandstorms inners were all gutted, I tricked the cart driver by telling him cart jokes.
translation: Muhafizlar bakmiyorken, Sandstorm'u parca parca söküp parcalari kutulara ve varillere koyuyordum. Sandstorm'un ici tamamen bosaldiginda, araba sürücüsüne araba sakalari yaparak onu kandirdim.

english: So, he didn't bother to check his cargo and I was able to board as he was driving off.
translation: Böylece, yükünü kontrol etme zahmetine girmedi ve ben de o uzaklasirken arabaya binmeyi basardim.

english: Anyway, that's all in the past. Can I help ya with anything else?
translation: Neyse, bunlar gecmiste kaldi. Baska bir seye yardim edebilir miyim?

english: You haven't got any buckets for me to hold.
Ya don't have any buckets of sand to withdraw. Ya need to give me empty buckets, and grind sandstone in my grinder, then I'll sell ya buckets of sand.
translation: Cekmem icin kum dolu kova yok. Bana bos kova vermen ve ögütücümde kumtasi ögütmen gerekiyor, sonra sana kum dolu kova satarim.

english: I have [number] of your buckets and you've ground enough sandstone for [number] buckets of sand.
Nothing sorry. I have to be going now.
translation: Hicbir sey, üzgünüm. Simdi gitmem gerek.

english: Oh, bye then.
Tell me about yourself.
Deposit buckets.
Withdraw buckets of sand.
Check my buckets and sand.
Nothing.
Greetings again adventurer. How go your travels in Morytania? Is it as evil as I have heard?
translation: Merhaba maceraci. Morytania'daki seyahatin nasil gidiyor? Duydugum kadar kötü bir yer mi?

english: I've lost my wolfbane dagger.
Yes, I know! Luckily for you it washed up on the banks of the Salve earlier! Here, take it again, but please try and be more careful this time.
translation: Evet, biliyorum! Sansina, Salve nehrinin kiyisina vurmus! Al, ama lütfen bu sefer daha dikkatli ol.

english: It's a family heirloom after all!
Thanks for that!
I've lost my library key.
Ok, here's another one for you.
translation: Tamam, iste sana bir tane daha.

english: Do you know of anything I can do in Morytania?
translation: Morytania'da yapabilecegim bir sey biliyor musun?

english: Well... I don't think so. There's not much to do in that place.
translation: Sey... Sanmiyorum. Orada yapacak pek bir sey yok.

english: You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Nature Spirit quest.
translation: Doga Ruhu görevine baslamak icin gerekli tüm sartlari saglamiyorsun.

english: Well, what is it, I may be able to help?
translation: Peki, ne var, yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: There's a man called Filliman who lives in Mort Myre. He comes by the temple from time to time but I haven't seen him recently. I was wondering if you could check in on him?
translation: Mort Myre'da Filliman adinda bir adam yasiyor. Ara sira tapinaga gelir ama son zamanlarda onu görmedim. Onu kontrol edebilir misin acaba?
