english: I must warn you though, it could be dangerous. Mort Myre is filled with ghasts!
translation: Ama seni uyarmaliyim, tehlikeli olabilir. Mort Myre ghastlarla dolu!

english: Yes, I'll go look for him.
That's great! Many thanks!
Now, please be aware of the ghasts, you cannot attack them, only Filliman knew how to take them on. Just run from them if you can. If you get lost, try to make your way back to the temple.
translation: Simdi, hayaletlere dikkat et, onlara saldiramazsin, sadece Filliman onlarla nasil basa cikilacagini biliyordu. Mümkünse onlardan kac. Kaybolursan, tapinaga geri dönmeye calis.

english: Drezel hands you some food.
Please take this food to Filliman, he'll likely appreciate it. His home is somewhere in the southern end of Mort Myre. I don't know the exact location I'm afraid.
translation: Lütfen bu yiyecegi Filliman'a götür, muhtemelen cok sevinir. Evi Mort Myre'nin güney ucunda bir yerde. Maalesef tam yerini bilmiyorum.

english: Don't worry, if he's there and he's still alive, I'll find him.
translation: Merak etme, eger oradaysa ve hala hayattaysa, onu bulacagim.

english: Sorry, I don't think I can help.
That's fine, I'm sure someone else will be along shortly who can. Now, if you excuse me, I do have some things to be getting on with.
translation: Sorun degil, eminim yakinda yardimci olabilecek baska biri gelecektir. Simdi, izin verirsen, yapmam gereken bazi isler var.

english: Sorry, not interested.
Well, I understand. You must be busy.
Hello, [player name]. How are things in Morytania?
Not as well as I'd hope, Drezel. I'm still working with the Myreque. I just hope that we can find a way to defeat those Drakans.
translation: Umdugum kadar iyi degil, Drezel. Hala Myreque ile calisiyorum. Umarim o Drakans'lari yenmenin bir yolunu bulabiliriz.

english: You can be sure that a great many people hope for exactly the same thing, [player name]. Good luck to you, and Myreque prevail!
translation: Emin ol ki pek cok insan da ayni seyi umuyor, Maceraci. Sana iyi sanslar, Myreque galip gelsin!

english: Myreque prevail, Drezel.
How's everything going, [player name]?
We've managed to create a new weapon to fight the vampyres with. I used it to kill Ranis Drakan!
translation: Vampirlerle savasmak icin yeni bir silah gelistirdik. Ranis Drakan'i öldürmek icin kullandim!

english: This is amazing news, [player name]. Myreque prevail!
translation: Bu harika bir haber, Maceraci. Myreque galip gelsin!

english: [player name]. How are things?
As well as they could be, everything considered. We lost everything, Drezel.
translation: Her seyi göz önünde bulundurursak, olabildigince iyi. Her seyimizi kaybettik, Drezel.

english: Not everything. There's still you, me and Ivan. Veliaf is out there somewhere as well. It's not much, but it's something to be thankful for.
translation: Her seyi degil. Hâlâ sen, ben ve Ivan variz. Veliaf da disarida bir yerlerde. Fazla bir sey degil, ama sükretmemiz gereken bir sey.

english: I suppose.
Morytania has never been darker. Trust in Saradomin, friend. There is still a chance we will live through this darkness.
translation: Morytania hic bu kadar karanlik olmamisti. Saradomin'e güven, dostum. Hâlâ bu karanliktan kurtulma sansimiz var.

english: Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to help me with this.
Drezel has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Drezel sana bir meydan okuma parsömeni verdi!

english: Please give me your answer!
Nope, not correct!
Correct!
Drezel has given you another clue scroll!
translation: Drezel sana baska bir ipucu parsömeni verdi!

english: Well, what is it, I may be able to help?
translation: Peki, ne var, yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: Yes.
No.
Sorry, not interested.
Hey, human.
Who are you?
Just a guard. If sneaky humans come in here without permission, I chuck rocks at 'em, knock 'em out and chuck 'em out of Weiss.
translation: Sadece bir muhafiz. Izin almadan buraya gizlice giren insanlara tas atip, onlari bayilttiktan sonra Weiss'tan disari atarim.

english: I'm familiar with the idea, yeah.
Tell me about this place.
This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: Burasi Weiss. Yillar önce, daha güneydeki magaralardan kovulduktan sonra troller tarafindan insa edildi. Simdi Weiss bizim evimiz.

english: We done pretty good here. Got lots of goat and wolf to eat - they taste kinda boring after all this time, but there not much other choice.
translation: Burada oldukca iyi durumdayiz. Yiyebilecegimiz cok sayida keci ve kurt var - bunca zaman sonra tadi biraz sikici gelmeye basladi ama baska secenegimiz yok.

english: Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it. In fact My Arm is an expert on growing the stuff.
translation: Hic gut otu denedin mi? Onu seven troller taniyorum. Aslinda My Arm bu bitkinin yetistirilmesinde uzmandir.

english: Never heard of no gouty weed, no. But it sound like a vegetable, an' Mother not like eating those, so we probably not gonna try it.
translation: Gut otu diye bir sey duymadim, hayir. Ama sebzeye benziyor ve annem sebze yemeyi sevmez, o yüzden muhtemelen denemeyecegiz.

english: Mother not like new ideas much, but he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: Annem yeni fikirleri pek sevmez, ama o cok büyük ve patron, bu yüzden ne derse onu yapariz.

english: I see.
Do you like it here?
Eh, it kinda rough, but it our home. Odd Mushroom say he can make it nicer with fancy fires what he invented, but Mother not interested in that, so Odd Mushroom not allowed to do it.
translation: Eh, biraz zorlu, ama burasi bizim evimiz. Odd Mushroom, icat ettigi süslü ateslerle burayi daha güzel hale getirebilecegini söylüyor, ama annem bununla ilgilenmiyor, bu yüzden Odd Mushroom bunu yapamiyor.

english: Mother only care about stuff to help him fight better. An he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: Annem sadece onun daha iyi savasmasina yardimci olacak seylerle ilgileniyor. O cok büyük ve patron, bu yüzden ne derse onu yapiyoruz.

english: I'll be off.
Hey, friend of Snowflake!
Just a guard. If sneaky human come in here without permission, I chuck rocks at 'em, knock 'em out and chuck 'em out of Weiss.
translation: Sadece bir muhafiz. Izin almadan buraya gizlice giren insanlara tas atip, onlari bayilttiktan sonra Weiss'tan disari atiyorum.

english: It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: Burasi harika, simdi Snowflake ve kocasi troll bize goutweed yetistirmeyi ögretti. Yemekler artik cok daha lezzetli.

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: Eh, biraz zorlu ama gittikce iyilesiyor. Snowflake bize gut otu yetistirmeyi ögretti. Keci, kurt, insan, hepsi gut otu ile cok daha lezzetli oluyor.

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: Evet, Weiss yasamak icin iyi bir yer, artik Snowflake sorumlu. Tüm troller Snowflake'i sever. Kocasi biraz tuhaf bir trol ama bu bizim sorunumuz degil.

english: Who are you?
Tell me about this place.
Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it.
translation: Goutweed denedin mi hic? Onu seven troller taniyorum.

english: I see.
Do you like it here?
I'll be off.
wooo wooo
Please, leave me alone.
Your loss!
Hello, are you Droalak?
Wow. I haven't spoken to the living for... for... I don't remember how long.
translation: Vay canina. Canli biriyle konusmayali... ne kadar oldu... hatirlamiyorum.

english: So your name IS Droalak?
Sorry, yes I am he.
Great. Do you know anything about the outpost North of Ardougne?
translation: Harika. Ardougne'nin kuzeyindeki karakol hakkinda bir sey biliyor musun?

english: I don't really like to talk about it, but I died there.
translation: Bunun hakkinda konusmak istemiyorum ama orada öldüm.

english: Oh dear.
I do have a scroll which might interest you that describes the timeline of the outpost. But first I wonder if I could ask you to tie up a problem?
translation: Karakolun tarihcesini anlatan, ilginizi cekebilecek bir parsömenim var. Ama önce sizden bir sorunu cözmenizi rica edebilir miyim?

english: Like what?
Well, I left to go to the outpost against the wishes of my wife. I promised I would return to her, but obviously I did not as I died there. She's a ghost nearby, but won't listen to my apologies.
translation: Karimin istegine karsi karakola gitmek icin ayrildim. Ona geri dönecegime söz verdim, ama orada öldügüm icin tabii ki dönemedim. O, yakinlarda bir hayalet olarak dolasiyor, ama özürlerimi dinlemiyor.

english: You want me to patch things up?
Yes, how'd you guess?
Call it 'traveller's intuition'.
Okay, well perhaps you could give her a strung sapphire amulet, because this is what I gave her the day I left. Her name is Melina by the way.
translation: Tamam, belki ona safirden yapilmis bir muska verebilirsin, cünkü ayrildigim gün ona bunu vermistim. Bu arada, adi Melina.

english: No problem.
What do you want me to do again?
Make a strung sapphire amulet and give it to Melina!
translation: Safirden yapilmis bir muska yap ve Melina'ya ver!

english: Ok. Ok.
I have a sapphire amulet!
Good work. Just give it to Melina, who's wandering somewhere nearby.
translation: Aferin. Onu yakinlarda dolasan Melina'ya ver.

english: I've given her the amulet. She was very pleased and said she just wanted to know you still cared.
translation: Tilsimi ona verdim. Cok sevindi ve senin hala onu önemsedigini bilmek istedigini söyledi.

english: Excellent! I am so glad she believes me. I can finally rest in peace.
translation: Harika! Bana inandigina cok sevindim. Artik huzur icinde yatabilirim.

english: Could I have that scroll you mentioned first?
Of course. Let me know if it was of any use and then I can be forever free.
translation: Tabii ki. Ise yaradiysa bana haber ver, böylece sonsuza kadar özgür olabilirim.

english: Thank you.
Take that scroll to Jorral in the outpost.
Thank's for the scroll, but I seem to have lost it.
translation: Parsömen icin tesekkürler, ama galiba kaybettim.

english: It's a good job I stuck around then isn't it! Have another copy.
translation: O zaman iyi ki buralarda kalmisim, degil mi? Iste bir kopyasi daha.

english: I have delivered the scroll, you can rest in peace now.
translation: Parsömeni teslim ettim, artik huzur icinde yatabilirsin.

english: Thanks for telling me! I've been waiting for ages!
translation: Söyledigin icin tesekkürler! Uzun zamandir bekliyordum!

english: Good bye.
Bye!
'Ello, welcome to my Mining shop, friend!
translation: Merhaba, madencilik dükkanima hos geldin dostum!

english: Do you want to trade?
Hello, shorty.
I may be short, but at least I've got manners.
translation: Boyum kisa olabilir ama en azindan terbiyem var.

english: Why don't you ever restock ores and bars?
translation: Neden hic cevher ve külce stokunu yenilemiyorsun?

english: The only ores and bars I sell are those sold to me.
translation: Sattigim tek cevher ve külceler bana satilanlardir.

english: Do you want to trade?
Hello, shorty.
Why don't you ever restock ores and bars?
translation: Neden hic cevher ve külce stokunu yenilemiyorsun?

english: Someone stole my beautiful boots... I had to buy some crummy replicas, the real boots were one of a kind.
translation: Biri benim güzel botlarimi caldi... Berbat taklitlerini almak zorunda kaldim, gercek botlar essizdi.

english: Don't worry, if I find out who did it I'll take care of them.
translation: Merak etme, kim yaptigini bulursam onun icabina bakarim.

english: What do you want?
I didn't know dwarves kept cats.
And why wouldn't they?
Friend of mine lives at the palace, actually. Well, I say friend. Used to be a friend.
translation: Aslinda bir arkadasim sarayda yasiyor. Arkadasim diyorum ama eskiden arkadasti.

english: What happened?
He got adopted by Hreidmar. The director of the Red Axe.
translation: Hreidmar tarafindan evlat edinildi. Kizil Balta'nin müdürü.

english: Oh?
I don't like the Red Axe! They stomp around everywhere, got to be careful of your tail with those people around.
translation: Kizil Balta'yi sevmem! Her yerde dolasiyorlar, o insanlar etrafta oldugunda kuyruguna dikkat etmelisin.

english: Get your hands off that, you dirty human!
Stay away from there! Who do you think you are, coming into my house like that?
translation: Oradan uzak dur! Kim oldugunu saniyorsun da evime böyle giriyorsun?

english: You don't think you'll be able to get close to this boot without the old dwarf noticing you, what with his cat guarding.
translation: Yasli cücenin kedisi seni korurken, ona fark edilmeden bu cizmeye yaklasabilecegini sanmiyorum.

english: I know what you did, [player name]!
What did I do?
You stole a boot from my master.
All for a greater good.
Hiss.
Meow!
Excuse me..
Leave me or I'll destroy you!
translation: Beni rahat birak yoksa seni yok ederim!

english: Excuse me.
Look, I don't have time for weaklings, if you want a conversation, talk to my brother Blanin!
translation: Bak, zayiflarla ugrasacak vaktim yok, konusmak istiyorsan kardesim Blanin ile konus!

english: I need to talk to you.
Why should I?
Erm, sorry I didn't mean to cause offence.
translation: Erm, kusura bakma, seni kirmak istemedim.

english: Don't waste my time!
Please don't hurt me.
Leave me alone!
I'm after important answers.
But how do you know me?
I just talked to your brother.
Don't talk of my brother. He's not on my good side at the moment.
translation: Kardesimden bahsetme. Su anda benimle arasi iyi degil.

english: Why, you're the famous warrior Dron!
If so, what weapon do I use?
Wrong, wrong, wrong!
An iron mace.
When do I like to eat rats?
Breakfast.
When are kittens best devoured?
translation: Yavru kediler en cok ne zaman yenir?

english: You know nothing!
Lunch.
What do I usually eat for tea?
Bunnies.
What colour spider blood tastes the best?
translation: En lezzetli örümcek kani hangi renktedir?

english: Red.
How many years old am I?
and months?
What are the most interesting ages for battles?
translation: Savaslar icin en ilginc yaslar hangileridir?

english: Fifth and Fourth.
And my house is situated where?
North East side of town.
What is my brother's name?
Blanin.
And my pet cat is called?
Fluffy.
What's 5 plus 7?
12, but what does that have to do with anything?
translation: 12, ama bunun konuyla ne ilgisi var?

english: Everything! Besides, it's 13!
Er, I think you'll find it's 12.
Very well, you seem to know me quite well, I'll answer your questions best I can.
translation: Pekala, beni oldukca iyi taniyor gibisin, sorularini elimden geldigince cevaplayacagim.

english: Phew!
Well, what are they then?
I'm trying to find out the history of the outpost near Ardougne. I was hoping you could help me.
translation: Ardougne yakinlarindaki karakolun tarihini arastiriyorum. Bana yardim edebilecegini umuyordum.

english: Let me see. Ah yes, I remember reading of a battle that took place at the outpost many years ago. Two ex-friends led forces in a small battle that ended with them pitted against each other at the top of the outpost as the
translation: Bir bakalim. Evet, yillar önce karakolda gerceklesen bir savas hakkinda bir seyler okudugumu hatirliyorum. Iki eski dost, kücük bir savasta ordularini yönetti ve savas, üstün gücleri sayesinde karakolun tepesinde birbirlerine karsi savasan

english: sole survivors because of their superior strength.
translation: tek hayatta kalanlar olarak sona erdi.

english: Ex-friends?

They were once friends but a difference in their beliefs meant they fell out. One chose to follow the god Zamorak, whilst the other chose Saradomin. But finding themselves in this extreme situation at the top of the

Welcome to the Emir's Arena! Are you interested in Duels? We organise ranked Duels here, or alternatively you can organise your own unranked Duels.
translation: Emir'in Arenasina hos geldiniz! Düellolarla ilgileniyor musunuz? Burada siralamali düellolar düzenliyoruz, ya da alternatif olarak kendi siralamasiz düellolarinizi düzenleyebilirsiniz.

english: What's a Duel?
Two fighters are placed in a combat arena together, to battle to the death. The survivor wins the Duel.
translation: Iki dövüscü bir savas arenasinda bir araya getirilir ve ölümüne savasirlar. Hayatta kalan düelloyu kazanir.

english: Ranked or unranked? What does that mean?
translation: Siralamali mi, siralamasiz mi? Bu ne anlama geliyor?

english: Everyone has a rank. It's meant to indicate how good they are at fighting, compared to other people.
translation: Herkesin bir siralamasi vardir. Bu, diger insanlara kiyasla dövüste ne kadar iyi olduklarini gösterir.

english: In ranked fights, the winners gain rank and the losers lose rank. The Arena staff will decide who'll be fighting in each ranked Duel, and send the invitations.
translation: Siralamali dövüslerde, kazananlar siralamada yükselir, kaybedenler ise siralamada düser. Arena personeli, her siralamali Düelloda kimin dövüsecegini belirler ve davetiyeleri gönderir.

english: But if you just want some casual fun, you can have an unranked Duel, where no-one gains or loses rank. You can organise your own unranked Duel against whoever you want to fight.
translation: Ancak, sadece eglenmek istiyorsaniz, kimsenin siralamada yükselmedigi veya düsmedigi siralamasiz bir Düello yapabilirsiniz. Istediginiz kisiyle siralamaya dahil olmayan bir Düello düzenleyebilirsiniz.

english: Only the ranked fights offer access to the other rewards of the Arena.
translation: Sadece siralamaya dahil olan dövüsler Arena'nin diger ödüllerine erisim saglar.

english: How do I get invited to a Duel?
For a ranked Duel, you'll need to sign up to the recruitment group...
translation: Siralamaya dahil bir Düello icin, ise alim grubuna kaydolmaniz gerekir...

english: You can carry on with your adventures while you're waiting for a ranked Duel to begin, since it may be a while before suitable fighters are available.
translation: Siralamaya dahil bir Düello'nun baslamasini beklerken maceralariniza devam edebilirsiniz, cünkü uygun dövüscüler bulunana kadar biraz zaman gecebilir.

english: For an unranked Duel, other people might challenge you while you're wandering around the PvP Arena, so keep an eye out for invitation messages.
translation: Siralamaya dahil olmayan bir Düello icin, PvP Arenasinda dolasirken diger oyuncular size meydan okuyabilir, bu nedenle davet mesajlarina dikkat edin.

english: I want to organise my own Duel.

When you see other people wandering around the PvP Arena, you can challenge them directly, and they can challenge you. This would be an unranked Duel, so neither of you would gain rank or earn rewards.
translation: PvP Arenasinda dolasan diger oyunculari gördügünüzde, onlara dogrudan meydan okuyabilirsiniz ve onlar da size meydan okuyabilir. Bu, siralamaya dahil olmayan bir Düello olacaktir, bu nedenle ikiniz de siralama kazanmayacak veya ödül kazanmayacaksiniz.

english: Okay, goodbye.
I'm okay, thanks.

(guards appear and try to apprehend the player)
translation: (muhafizlar ortaya cikar ve oyuncuyu yakalamaya calisir)

english: Not many monkeys come down here...
That's quite understandable really.
I don't really understand it at all. I've spent my life here.
translation: Ben hic anlamiyorum. Hayatimi burada gecirdim.

english: Here, solve this.
Please make yourself some space, I have something for you.
translation: Lütfen yer acin, size bir seyim var.

english: That doesn't look solved to me.
Well done [player name]. Here you go.
Greetings. Welcome to my castle.
I seek a shield that will protect me from dragonbreath.
translation: Beni ejderhanin nefesinden koruyacak bir kalkan ariyorum.

english: A knight going on a dragon quest, hmm? What dragon do you intend to slay?
translation: Ejderha avina cikan bir sövalye, ha? Hangi ejderhayi öldürmeyi planliyorsun?

english: Elvarg, the dragon of Crandor island!
Elvarg? Are you sure?
Yes.
Well, you're a braver  than I!
Why is everyone so scared of this dragon?
translation: Neden herkes bu ejderhadan bu kadar korkuyor?

english: Back in my father's day, Crandor was an important city-state. Politically it was as important as Falador and Varrock and its ships traded with every port.
translation: Babamin zamaninda Crandor önemli bir sehir devletiydi. Siyasi acidan Falador ve Varrock kadar önemliydi ve gemileri her limanla ticaret yapiyordu.

english: But, one day, when I was little, all contact was lost. The trading ships and the diplomatic envoys just stopped coming.
translation: Ama bir gün, ben kücükken, tüm iletisim kesildi. Ticaret gemileri ve diplomatik elciler gelmeyi birakti.

english: I remember my father being very scared. He posted lookouts on the roof to warn if the dragon was approaching. All the city rulers worried that Elvarg would devastate the whole continent.
translation: Babamin cok korktugunu hatirliyorum. Ejderha yaklasirsa uyarmak icin catiya gözcüler yerlestirdi. Tüm sehir yöneticileri Elvarg'in tüm kitayi yok edeceginden endiseleniyordu.

english: I'd better leave that dragon alone.
translation: O ejderhayi rahat biraksam iyi olur.

english: That's a relief. I would hate to see such a promising adventurer cut down in [his/her] prime.
translation: Bu bir rahatlama. Böylesine umut vaat eden bir maceracinin en verimli caginda hayatini kaybetmesini görmek istemem.

english: So, are you going to give me the shield or not?
translation: Peki, bana kalkani verecek misin, vermeyecek misin?

english: If you really think you're up to it then perhaps you are the one who can kill this dragon.
translation: Eger gercekten buna hazir oldugunu düsünüyorsan, belki de bu ejderhayi öldürebilecek kisi sensindir.

english: The Duke hands you a heavy orange shield.
translation: Dük sana agir turuncu bir kalkan uzatir.

english: Take care out there. If you kill it...
translation: Disarida dikkatli ol. Eger onu öldürürsen...

english: If you kill it, for Saradomin's sake make sure it's really dead!
translation: Eger onu öldürürsen, Saradomin askina, gercekten öldügünden emin ol!

english: Very wise. There are some monsters that are best left alone.
translation: Cok akillica. Bazi canavarlar rahat birakilsa daha iyidir.

english: Oh, no dragon in particular. I just feel like killing a dragon.
translation: Oh, özellikle bir ejderha yok. Sadece bir ejderha öldürmek istiyorum.

english: I don't have an infinite supply of these shields, you know. I'll only give one for a truly worthy cause.
translation: Bu kalkanlardan sonsuz sayida yok, biliyorsun. Sadece gercekten degerli bir amac icin bir tane veririm.

english: Of course. Now you've slain Elvarg, you've earned the right to call the shield your own!
translation: Elbette. Elvarg'i öldürdügüne göre, bu kalkani kendine ait sayma hakkini kazandin!

english: The Duke hands you the shield.
Have you any quests for me?
translation: Bana verecek bir görevin var mi?

english: Well, it's not really a quest but I recently discovered this strange talisman.
translation: Aslinda bir görev sayilmaz ama yakin zamanda bu garip tilsimi kesfettim.

english: It seems to be mystical and I have never seen anything like it before. Would you take it to the head wizard at
translation: Gizemli bir sey gibi görünüyor ve daha önce hic böyle bir sey görmedim. Onu benim icin

english: the Wizards' Tower for me? It's just south-west of here and should not take you very long at all. I would be awfully grateful.
translation: Büyücüler Kulesi'ndeki bas büyücüye götürür müsün? Buradan güneybatiya dogru, cok uzun sürmez. Sana cok minnettar olurum.

english: Sure, no problem.
Thank you very much, stranger. I am sure the head wizard will reward you for such an interesting find.
translation: Cok tesekkür ederim, yabanci. Eminim bas büyücü böyle ilginc bir buluntu icin seni ödüllendirecektir.

english: Not right now.
As you wish, stranger, although I have this strange feeling that it is important. Unfortunately, I cannot leave my castle unattended.
translation: Nasil istersen, yabanci, ama bunun önemli olduguna dair garip bir his var icimde. Maalesef, kalemi basibos birakamam.

english: The only task remotely approaching a quest is the delivery of that talisman I gave you to the head wizard of the Wizards' Tower,
translation: Bir göreve en yakin tek görev, sana verdigim tilsimi buradan güneybatiya dogru bulunan Büyücü Kulesi'nin bas büyücüsüne teslim etmek.

english: south-west of here. I suggest you deliver it to him as soon as possible. I have the oddest feeling that it is important...
translation: Onu mümkün oldugunca cabuk teslim etmeni öneririm. Bunun önemli olduguna dair garip bir his var icimde...

english: Did you speak to the head wizard for me yet, adventurer?
translation: Basbüyücüyle benim icin konustun mu, maceraci?

english: No, I lost that air talisman that you gave me.
translation: Hayir, bana verdigin hava tilsimini kaybettim.

english: Ah, that would explain it. One of my servants found this outside, and it seemed too much of a coincidence that more than one strange
translation: Ah, bu her seyi acikliyor. Hizmetcilerimden biri bunu disarida buldu ve bu kadar kisa sürede arazimde birden fazla garip nesnenin ortaya cikmasi

english: object would appear on my land in such a short period of time. Please take this to the head wizard at the Wizards' Tower, south-west of here, and don't lose it this time.
translation: cok büyük bir tesadüf gibi geldi. Lütfen bunu buradan güneybatiya dogru, Büyücü Kulesi'ndeki bas büyücüye götür ve bu sefer kaybetme.

english: The only job I had was the delivery of that talisman, so I'm afraid not.
translation: Tek isim o tilsimi teslim etmekti, maalesef yapamam.

english: No, all is well for me.
translation: Hayir, benim icin her sey yolunda.

english: Where can I find money?
I've heard that the blacksmiths are prosperous amongst the peasantry. Maybe you could try your hand at that?
translation: Demircilerin köylüler arasinda zengin oldugunu duydum. Belki sen de denemelisin?

english: Hello there, welcome to Lumbridge.
What's with all the snow?
A particularly harsh winter for Lumbridge this year. Still, we make the best of it. I hope all our new visitors aren't getting too cold.
translation: Bu yil Lumbridge icin özellikle sert bir kis. Yine de elimizden geleni yapiyoruz. Umarim yeni ziyaretcilerimiz cok üsümüyorlardir.

english: I'm not new!
Oh yes, I know that.
Who cares about them?
Well... I do.
What do you need?
Ah...
I'm ok, though I am new around town.
translation: Ben iyiyim, ama bu kasabaya yeni geldim.

english: Then doubly welcome you are to Lumbridge.
translation: O zaman Lumbridge'e iki kat hos geldin.

english: Actually yes, I am rather cold.
Well... I may be able to help there.
Who are you calling new?
I haven't seen you around much before, that's all.
translation: Seni daha önce pek görmedim, hepsi bu.

english: I wonder if you might help me with a little project of mine?
translation: Kücük bir projemde bana yardim eder misin?

english: Yes, I can help.
Great! Thank you!
So, I have seen how much extra work the Lumbridge citizens are putting in recently, what with so many new adventurers in town. I'd like to give them something back.
translation: Son zamanlarda Lumbridge vatandaslarinin, kasabaya gelen yeni maceracilar yüzünden ne kadar fazla is yükü altinda olduklarini gördüm. Onlara bir karsilik vermek istiyorum.

english: And here comes the but...
How did you know? But... I have to stay here in my room as I have so much paperwork to do.
translation: Nasil anladin? Ama... Yapacak cok isim oldugu icin odamda kalmam gerekiyor.

english: So I'm delivering the presents? I get to be Santa?
translation: Yani hediyeleri ben mi teslim edecegim? Noel Baba mi olacagim?

english: Um. Not quite, but nearly!
translation: Sey... Tam olarak degil, ama neredeyse!

english: What do you mean... not quite?
Well, I don't want them to see you deliver it.
translation: Sey, hediyeleri teslim ederken seni görmelerini istemiyorum.

english: What? Why? How?
Well it kind of looks lazy on my part doesn't it. I'd like you to disguise yourself... as a tree.
translation: Sey, benim acimdan biraz tembelce görünür, degil mi? Kendini bir agac gibi gizlemeni istiyorum.

english: A TREE?
Yes, a festive tree, as if I'd planted the tree near them and it's holding a present for them... isn't that a wonderful idea?
translation: Evet, senlikli bir agac, sanki onlarin yanina dikmisim ve onlara hediye getirmisim gibi... Harika bir fikir degil mi?

english: If by wonderful you mean awful... I suppose you want me to cut bits off trees and stick them to myself and decorate it with something shiny?
translation: Harika derken berbat demek istiyorsan... Sanirim agaclardan parcalar kesip kendime yapistirmami ve parlak bir seyle süslememi istiyorsun?

english: How did you know?
I'm leaving now.
Oh very good... leaving... well done.
The snowy trees out there look so treemendously festive, you should use some of their branches to decorate them.
translation: Disaridaki karli agaclar cok senlikli görünüyor, onlari süslemek icin dallarindan bazilarini kullanmalisin.

english: What about a decoration on top, I don't want to be involved with creepy dolls again.
translation: Tepesine süs ne olacak, yine ürkütücü bebeklerle ugrasmak istemiyorum.

english: Oh no, no, no. I think you'll be able to find something star like to put on your head, maybe from the church?
translation: Oh hayir, hayir, hayir. Kafana takabilecegin yildiz gibi bir sey bulabilirsin, belki kiliseden?

english: Where do I get the tree branches from?

The snowy trees out there look so treemendously festive, you should just use some of their branches, but leave the big one alone. Just take something sharp to them. A knife or some shears should do the job.
translation: Disaridaki karli agaclar cok senlikli görünüyor, dallarindan bazilarini kullanmalisin, ama büyük olani birak. Keskin bir sey al ve kes. Bicak veya makas isini görür.

english: I don't think I can take anymore puns.
Stick with it, it'll soon be over.
Where do I get the decoration?
Well, not out of my crown! Get it? Crown?
translation: Tahtamdan degil tabii! Anladin mi? Tahtam?

english: Must not react to pun...
OH ok, have it your way. I noticed a barrel of old waste material near the furnace. You should be able to find some there. Oh, and don't forget you can probably borrow a star from the church.
translation: Tamam, sen bilirsin. Firinin yaninda eski atik malzemelerin oldugu bir varil gördüm. Orada bulabilirsin. Ayrica kiliseden bir yildiz ödünc alabilecegini de unutma.

english: How do I put it all together?
Well, thread is too light and rope is too heavy for this job... You could try some wool?
translation: Iplik bu is icin cok hafif, ip ise cok agir... Yün deneyebilirsin.

english: Why do I need it again?
To deliver my presents of course!
translation: Hediyelerimi teslim etmek icin tabii ki!

english: Oh yeah... you're too busy to do it yourself and don't want them to know that I did it. Pretty poor excuse.
translation: Oh evet... kendin yapmak icin cok mesgulsün ve benim yaptigimi bilmelerini istemiyorsun. Oldukca zayif bir bahane.

english: Hey, I have a town to run, it's not all it's cracked up to be you know.
translation: Hey, yönetmem gereken bir kasaba var, her sey sandigin kadar kolay degil, biliyorsun.

english: That was an egg pun, wrong holiday.
translation: Bu bir yumurta kelime oyunu, yanlis bayram.

english: How very pithy of you. It wasn't meant to be a pun!
translation: Ne kadar da özlü bir söz. Kelime oyunu yapmak istememistim!

english: No thanks, bye.
I see you've got your disguise sorted out, you really should wear it for it to be effective though.
translation: Görüyorum ki kilik degistirmeyi halletmissin, ama etkili olmasi icin gercekten giymelisin.

english: Is that tree talking to me? I must be ill.
translation: O agac benimle mi konusuyor? Hasta olmaliyim.

english: It's me, Player!
And there was me thinking that yew wouldn't have made something that convincing.
translation: Ben de senin bu kadar ikna edici bir sey yapamayacagini düsünüyordum.

english: So what do I have to do?
Here, I've written it all down for you.
Duke Horacio hands you a neatly written list.
translation: Duke Horacio sana düzgünce yazilmis bir liste uzatir.

english: How goes the job of Santa?
I've made some progress. But I have some questions.
translation: Biraz ilerleme kaydettim. Ama birkac sorum var.

english: Ah Hans, loyal to a fault. He walks the castle grounds all day, everyday. He really could do with a sit down, don't you think? Take my chair, just over there.
translation: Ah Hans, sadakatinin siniri yok. Her gün, bütün gün kale bahcesinde dolasiyor. Biraz oturmasi iyi olur, sence de öyle degil mi? Suradaki sandalyemi al.

english: Count Check... he's a bit of an odd one isn't he? He's obsesedwith counting. He loves counting, especially shiny things. The other day I was chatting to him and he was completely unable to take his eyes off the golden rings on my fingers. Perhaps he'd like some of those. However, they're not normal gold rings, like you would make. These I get specially from the apprentice near the furnace.
translation: Kont Check... biraz tuhaf biri, degil mi? Saymaya takintili. Saymayi seviyor, özellikle parlak seyleri. Gecen gün onunla sohbet ediyordum ve parmaklarimdaki altin yüzüklerden gözlerini ayiramiyordu. Belki de onlardan biraz ister. Ancak bunlar senin yaptigin gibi normal altin yüzükler degil. Bunlari firinin yanindaki ciraktan özel olarak aliyorum.

english: The lovely Gillie. Such pure white milk she brings us daily. But she is so run off her feet. She often suggests that we should find a magic spell to duplicate her! What a notion. I'm surprised we don't hear the same complaints from Bob.
translation: Sevimli Gillie. Her gün bize cok saf beyaz süt getiriyor. Ama cok yorgun düsüyor. Sik sik onu cogaltacak bir sihirli büyü bulmamizi öneriyor! Ne fikir ama. Bob'dan ayni sikayetleri duymamamiza sasiriyorum.

english: Fred? Such a wholesome farmer. He does his job with the chickens and cows well. However, it wasn't his first choice of profession. He wanted to grow fruit trees you know. The one planted in the castle grounds sure did catch his eye.
translation: Fred? Cok saglikli bir ciftci. Tavuklar ve ineklerle isini iyi yapiyor. Ancak bu onun ilk tercih ettigi meslek degildi. Meyve agaclari yetistirmek istiyordu, biliyor musun? Kale bahcesine dikilen agac kesinlikle onun dikkatini cekmisti.

english: He's so gloomy, everything is doom doom doom. He needs some light entertainment. I heard he used to be a friend of Party Pete, in Falador, maybe ask him.
translation: O kadar kasvetli ki, her sey onun icin felaket. Biraz eglenceye ihtiyaci var. Eskiden Falador'da Party Pete'in arkadasi oldugunu duydum, belki ona sorabilirsin.

english: I seek a shield that will protect me from dragonbreath.
translation: Beni ejderhanin nefesinden koruyacak bir kalkan ariyorum.

english: Elvarg, the dragon of Crandor island!
Yes.
I'd better leave that dragon alone.
translation: O ejderhayi rahat biraksam iyi olur.

english: So, are you going to give me the shield or not?
translation: Peki, bana kalkani verecek misin, vermeyecek misin?

english: No.
Oh, no dragon in particular
Have you any quests for me?
translation: Bana verebilecegin bir görev var mi?

english: Where can I find money?
Talk about Lumbridge holiday event.
I'm not new!
Who cares about them?
What do you need?
I'm ok, though I am new around town.
translation: Ben iyiyim, ama bu kasabaya yeni geldim.

english: Actually yes, I am rather cold.
Who are you calling new?
Yes, I can help.
Talk about something else.
Where do I get the tree branches from?
Where do I get the decoration?
How do I put it all together?
Why do I need it again?
No thanks, bye.
Present for Hans.
Present for Count Check.
Present for Gillie.
Present for Farmer Fred.
Present for Doom Sayer.
Nothing.
[player name]! So glad you could make it. I really do appreciate you rounding up all those monkeys for us.
translation: Maceraci! Geldigine cok sevindim. Bizim icin tüm o maymunlari topladigin icin gercekten minnettarim.

english: No problem.
I am grateful for your help, [player name]. If you could free up an inventory space, I wish to reward you.
translation: Yardimin icin minnettarim, Maceraci. Envanterinde yer acabilirsen, sana bir ödül vermek istiyorum.

english: I am grateful for your help, [player name]. As proof of my gratitude, I have arranged a reward for you!
translation: Yardimin icin minnettarim, Maceraci. Minnettarligimin bir kaniti olarak, sana bir ödül ayarladim!

english: Also, King Awowogei brought gifts from Ape Atoll as an apology for the trouble they caused. But I think you should receive them instead.
translation: Ayrica, Kral Awowogei, verdikleri rahatsizlik icin özür olarak Ape Atoll'dan hediyeler getirdi. Ama bence bunlari sen almalisin.

english: The Duke awards you a Cursed banana.Happy 8th Birthday!
translation: Dük sana Lanetli muz ödülü veriyor. 8. dogum günün kutlu olsun!

english: On a members-only world you'd have also received a Banana Cape. If you purchase membership you can reclaim it at any time from Diango in Draynor Village.
translation: Üyelere özel dünyada ayrica Muz Pelerin de alirdin. Üyelik satin alirsan, Draynor Köyü'ndeki Diango'dan istedigin zaman geri alabilirsin.

english: The Duke awards you a Cursed banana and a Banana cape.Happy 8th Birthday!
translation: Dük sana Lanetli muz ve Muz pelerini ödülü veriyor. 8. dogum günün kutlu olsun!

english: Ah, [player name]. I hope you are enjoying the party?
What is going to happen with the monkeys?
Funny you should ask, actually.
It turns out that on the way to King Awowogei, Postie Pete was called off for an urgent request for Molly. Her evil twin had escaped again and she was looking for an adventurer to help.
translation: Awowogei Krali'na giderken, Postie Pete, Molly'nin acil bir istegi icin geri cagrildi. Kötü ikizi yine kacmisti ve yardim edecek bir maceraci ariyordu.

english: In the process of teleporting, he left the letter behind and these monkeys found it.
translation: Isinlanma sirasinda mektubu geride birakti ve maymunlar onu buldu.

english: They couldn't understand the letter so they took it to one of their elders, Mizaru, to translate. But 'Monster' didn't translate, so they assumed it said 'Monkey'.
translation: Mektubu anlayamadiklari icin, cevirisi icin yaslilarindan biri olan Mizaru'ya götürdüler. Ancak “Canavar” kelimesi cevrilemedi, bu yüzden “Maymun” oldugunu varsaydilar.

english: So instead of a party invitation they interpreted it as a threat from an organisation called Humans Against Monkeys! They stole some amulets of humanspeak, then decided to come here and put an end to it!
translation: Böylece parti davetiyesi yerine, bunu Humans Against Monkeys adli bir örgütün tehdidi olarak yorumladilar! Insanlarin konustugu dili ögrenmek icin bazi tilsimlar caldilar, sonra buraya gelip bu ise son vermeye karar verdiler!

english: That explains what happened, I suppose. How did you find all of this out?
translation: Sanirim olanlari bu acikliyor. Bunlari nasil ögrendin?

english: Another elder, Kikazaru, found the letter. And once he understood the situation, he went straight to King Awowogei himself. The King is over in the corner if you want to speak to him.
translation: Baska bir büyükleri olan Kikazaru mektubu buldu. Durumu anladiktan sonra, dogrudan Kral Awowogei'nin yanina gitti. Kral kösede, onunla konusmak istersen.

english: Thanks. I'll go enjoy the party now.
Can you give me more reward items?
translation: Bana daha fazla ödül ögesi verebilir misin?

english: I think that is everything I have for you.
translation: Sanirim sana verebilecegim her sey bu kadar.

english: I have given you what you can hold. You may wish to visit Diango, in Draynor Village, to collect more rewards in a more convenient setting.
translation: Tasiyabilecegin kadarini verdim. Daha uygun bir ortamda daha fazla ödül almak icin Draynor Köyü'ndeki Diango'yu ziyaret etmek isteyebilirsin.

english: I have nothing more for you.
translation: Sana verebilecegim baska bir sey yok.

english: What is going to happen with the monkeys?
Can you give me more reward items?
translation: Bana daha fazla ödül ögesi verebilir misin?

english: Thanks. I'll go enjoy the party now.
Can you give me more rewards?
translation: Bana daha fazla ödül verebilir misin?

english: Well, you're a braver [man/woman] than I!
Uh hey, are you the Duke?
Shh shh, now is not your time to speak.
Uhh...
Oh Great One, do I have to have broccoli for dinner?
translation: Ey Yüce Efendi, aksam yemeginde brokoli yemek zorunda miyim?...

english: Yes, Definitely.
I hatesbroccoli, why must it torture me.
translation: Brokoli nefret ediyorum, neden bana iskence ediyor?

english: Why are they here, you didn't command it.
What do you mean? I was told to come here.
translation: Ne demek istiyorsun? Buraya gelmem söylendi.

english: We're not talking to you.
Great round one, should I rid us of this intruder?
translation: Büyük birincilik, bu davetsiz misafiri kovayim mi?

english: Ask again later.
What is going on here, why are you talking to an egg?
translation: Burada neler oluyor, neden bir yumurtayla konusuyorsun?

english: The Omlettesiah feels generous today, what do you want and why are you here?
translation: Omlettesiah bugün cömert hissediyor, ne istiyorsun ve neden buradasin?

english: I'm not sure, I was told to come here when I stepped out of the portal.
translation: Emin degilim, portaldan ciktigimda buraya gelmem söylendi.

english: WHAT DID YOU SAY?!
Uuh, I mean, I was told to come here... after I hopped out of the portal.
translation: Yani, portaldan atladiktan sonra buraya gelmem söylendi.

english: YOU CAME BACK? THE EGG DIDN'T COMMAND IT.
translation: GERI MI DÖNDÜN? YUMURTA BÖYLE SÖYLEMEDI.

english: We need to punish them, but you have commanded me to wait...
translation: Onlari cezalandirmamiz gerek, ama sen bana beklememi emrettin...

english: Who are you talking to?
Our wise ruler, the divine egg. It is our great leader.
translation: Bilge hükümdarimiz, kutsal yumurta. O bizim büyük liderimizdir.

english: It appeared to me one night when I was down by the coast, I have been its loyal servant ever since.
translation: Bir gece sahildeyken bana göründü, o zamandan beri onun sadik hizmetkariyim.

english: I am its voice, I give action to its words, it serves a greater good than we can understand.
translation: Ben onun sesiim, onun sözlerini eyleme geciririm, o bizim anlayabilecegimizden daha büyük bir amaca hizmet eder.

english: Are you talking about that egg on the table?
YOU'RE TALKING TO A POWER YOU CANNOT COMPREHEND.
Wow... well then.
Maybe there's someone more reasonable I can talk to.
Great round one, will Jessica Rabbit ever love me?
translation: Büyük yuvarlak bir, Jessica Rabbit beni sevecek mi?

english: Outlook not so good.
The almighty egg, will my kingdom ever fall?
Concentrate and ask again.
My mighty yolk, do you think I'd look good in a top hat?
translation: Yüce yumurta, sence sapka bana yakisir mi?

english: As I see it, yes.
Oh wise one, is there a wiser ruler than I?
translation: Ey bilge, benden daha bilge bir hükümdar var mi?

english: My sources say no.
Great golden one, will I gain incredible riches this year?
translation: Yüce altin yumurta, bu yil inanilmaz zenginlikler kazanacak miyim?

english: Better not tell you now.
translation: Su anda sana söylemesem daha iyi.

english: Maybe there's someone more sane I can talk to.
translation: Belki daha akli basinda biriyle konusabilirim.

english: Paws is probably the best person to talk to right now.
translation: Paws su anda konusmak icin en uygun kisi olabilir.

english: Your Dukeness, I've discovered a revelation!
What do they want, why can't they leave us?
translation: Ne istiyorlar, neden bizi rahat birakmiyorlar?

english: That egg on the table... it is a fake!
Don't be so foolish, of course it's real.
How do you know? Someone could have easily swapped it out for a fake one.
translation: Nereden biliyorsun? Biri kolayca sahte bir yumurtayla degistirmis olabilir.

english: That doesn't make sense, if this is a fake, how did you find the original?
translation: Bu mantikli degil, eger bu sahteyse, orijinalini nasil buldun?

english: Oh, I uh, found it in a burrow underneath the castle.
translation: Oh, ben, onu kalenin altindaki bir oyukta buldum.

english: Unlikely story. Since I found it, I've been watching it like a falcon.
translation: Inanilmaz bir hikaye. Onu buldugumdan beri, bir sahin gibi gözetliyorum.

english: If you don't trust me, why don't you ask that egg?
translation: Bana güvenmiyorsan, neden o yumurtaya sormuyorsun?

english: Fine, but if you're trying to trick us, we'll dispose of you.
translation: Peki, ama bizi kandirmaya calisiyorsan, seni ortadan kaldiririz.

english: Your magical eggness: Are you a fake version and does this coney hold the real one?
translation: Sihirli yumurtan: Sen sahte versiyon musun ve bu tavsan gercek olani mi tutuyor?

english: -Sweating profusely- ...
Without a doubt.
What the flying carrot!
Phew... see, I told you it's fake.
translation: Phew... gördün mü, sahte oldugunu söylemistim.

english: I can't believe it, how long have I been made a fool of?
translation: Inanamiyorum, ne kadar zamandir aptal yerine konuyordum?

english: Give me the real one, we need to rid ourselves of this imposter.
translation: Bana gercegini ver, bu sahtekardan kurtulmamiz lazim.

english: Duke Rabbacio takes the fake egg off you and swaps it with the real one.
translation: Duke Rabbacio sahte yumurtayi senden alir ve gercek olanla degistirir.

english: I'm glad we got that sorted, feel free to ensure it works properly.
translation: Bunu hallettigimize sevindim, düzgün calistigindan emin olabilirsin.

english: I'll uh, dispose of this one for you.
translation: Ben bunu senin icin yok ederim.

english: Wise one: Do I have to have broccoli with my carrots tonight?
translation: Bilge: Bu aksam havuclarimla brokoli yemek zorunda miyim?

english: [chosen negative option]
Yes! Just what I wanted to hear, thank you for your help.
translation: Evet! Tam da duymak istedigim sey, yardimin icin tesekkürler.

english: I will let you ask but one question to the great supreme.
translation: Yüce hükümdara tek bir soru sormana izin verecegim.

english: Oh, ghee thanks, I'm not sure what to ask, maybe...
translation: Oh, cok tesekkürler, ne soracagimi bilmiyorum, belki...

english: Egg: Should rabbits keep jumping through the strange portal that no one knows where it leads to?
translation: Yumurta: Tavsanlar, nereye ciktigi bilinmeyen garip portaldan atlamaya devam etmeli mi?

english: Well, that settles it, I'll send the order for all rabbits to cease jumping through the portal at once.
translation: Peki, karar verildi, tüm tavsanlara portaldan atlamayi derhal birakmalari emrini verecegim.

english: You may leave me, keep that fake egg and dispose of it.
translation: Gidebilirsin, o sahte yumurtayi al ve at.

english: I'll also let everyone know you're a good rabbit, so if they need a paw, don't hesitate to help out.
translation: Herkese senin iyi bir tavsan oldugunu da söyleyecegim, yardima ihtiyaclari olursa cekinmeden yardim et.

english: Great! I should return to Gelt to let him know what has happened.
Leave me, I have many questions to ask the mythical one.
translation: Git, efsanevi olana sormam gereken cok soru var.

english: The Duke brushes you off, returning his focus to the egg.
translation: Dük seni basindan savar ve dikkatini tekrar yumurtaya verir.

english: What are you doing?! Step away from it.
Sorry Duke...
Big Egg, will I ever...
None can talk to it except me!
What is it, human? I'm working.
How do I use the furnace?
Put your ore on the conveyor belt to get it smelted. We'll stoke the boiler and operate the rest of the machinery for you.
translation: Eriyik haline getirmek icin cevherini konveyör bandina koy. Biz kazani yakip geri kalan makineleri senin icin calistiracagiz.

english: You'll have to help repair the furnace whenever a pipe blows, though. Just hit it with a hammer - that usually works.
translation: Ancak bir boru patladiginda firini tamir etmeye yardim etmen gerekecek. Cekicle vurman yeterli, genellikle ise yarar.

english: You'll have to put money in the coffer to pay for our services. We charge 72,000 coins per hour; money is deducted as long as you're in this room with us.
translation: Hizmetlerimizin bedelini ödemek icin kasaya para koyman gerekecek. Saat basina 72.000 sikke aliyoruz; bu odada bizimle birlikte oldugun sürece para kesilecek.

english: Gosh, you're a remarkably big dwarf.
translation: Vay canina, sen gercekten cok büyük bir cücesin.

english: My brothers and I have a rare genetic condition affecting our growth. Rather than treating us as freaks, you might like to appreciate how useful it is that we can operate the machinery.
translation: Kardeslerim ve ben, büyümemizi etkileyen nadir bir genetik rahatsizliga sahibiz. Bizi ucube gibi görmek yerine, makineleri calistirabilmemizin ne kadar yararli oldugunu takdir etmelisin.

english: Sorry.
That's ok, human. You're not the first to comment on it. Now, did you need anything? I've got work to do here.
translation: Sorun degil, insan. Bu konuda yorum yapan ilk kisi sen degilsin. Simdi, bir seye ihtiyacin var mi? Burada yapmam gereken isler var.

english: Are you sure you're really a dwarf?
... look, do you want help with something, or did you just come here to be rude? I've got work to do.
translation: ... bak, bir seye yardim mi istiyorsun, yoksa sadece kaba olmak icin mi buraya geldin? Yapacak isim var.

english: I'll let you get on with it.
How do I use the furnace?
Gosh, you're a remarkably big dwarf.
translation: Vay canina, sen gercekten cok büyük bir cücesin.

english: Sorry.
I'll let you get on with it.
Are you sure you're really a dwarf?
Hey, [player name], the teacher wants you to come to school for a test.
translation: Hey, Maceraci, ögretmen sinav icin okula gelmeni istiyor.

english: Sure, I fancy an exam.
I don't want to.
Nope, you're not the one the teacher wanted me to find!
translation: Hayir, ögretmenimin bulmami istedigi kisi sen degilsin!

english: Surprise exam, [player name]!
Come to school, [player name]!
You're getting tested, [player name]!
The teacher wants you, [player name]!
Teacher gets angry when he's kept waiting, [player name]!
Maybe later.
Hello!
Star yet?
Yes, yes you are.
STAR!
Sure, I fancy an exam.
I don't want to.
Dung cook human.
Ash eat human.
Dung will fry human.
Dung is wrong!
My brother in stronghold best cook.
Ash will boil human 'till it tender.
Much more tasty.
Ash will not cook human!
Ash will boil!
Dung will boil Ash's head!
Boil better!
Fry better!
Boil!
Fry!
Ow!
Ugh!
Dung not hit Ash!
Ow!
Ouch!
Dung hate Ash!
Ash hate Dung!
Well, if it isn't our very own sledder! What can I do for you today?
translation: Vay, bu bizim kizakcimiz degil mi! Bugün senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: Can I have another law talisman?
translation: Baska bir yasa tilsimi alabilir miyim?

english: Well, I've got one here you can have for 1,000 coins if you'd like it?
translation: Burada bir tane var, istersen 1.000 sikke karsiliginda alabilirsin.

english: Yes, I'll take it.
Looks like you don't have enough money to afford it just now, come back when you do.
translation: Su anda bunu alacak kadar paran yok gibi görünüyor, paran oldugunda tekrar gel.

english: Looks like you don't have any room to carry it just now, come back when you do.
translation: Su anda bunu tasiyacak yerin yok gibi görünüyor, yerin oldugunda tekrar gel.

english: You hand over the coins... and receive a law talisman.
translation: Paralari veriyorsun... ve bir hukuk tilsimi aliyorsun.

english: Thanks.
No thanks...
Can you put some spikes on my Climbing boots?
For you, no problem.
Do you realise that you can only use the Climbing boots right now? The Spiked boots can only be used in the Icelands but no onesbeen able to get there for years!
translation: Su anda sadece tirmanma botlarini kullanabilecegini biliyor musun? Civili botlar sadece buzullarda kullanilabilir ama yillardir kimse oraya ulasamadi!

english: Yes, but I still want them.
Sorry, I'll need an Ironbar to make the spikes.
translation: Üzgünüm, civileri yapmak icin demir cubuk lazim.

english: Anything else before I get on with my work?
translation: Calismaya baslamadan önce baska bir sey var mi?

english: Oh OK, I'll leave them thanks.
Can you make me another sled?
translation: Bana baska bir kizak yapabilir misin?

english: Yeah sure, have you got the maple or yew logs, an iron bar and some rope?
translation: Tabii, akcaagac veya porsuk agaci kütükleri, demir cubuk ve biraz ip var mi?

english: No, I haven't got everything yet.
Well, unfortunately I can't make the sled without all the materials.
translation: Maalesef tüm malzemeler olmadan kizak yapamam.

english: What do I need for the sled wax again?
translation: Kizak mumu icin neye ihtiyacim var?

english: You will need some wax and some swamp tar.
translation: Biraz mum ve bataklik katrani lazim.

english: Where can I get wax from?
I don't know. I'm a smith! But maybe you should look for some bees.
translation: Bilmiyorum. Ben demirciyim! Ama belki arilar aranmalisin.

english: Where can I get swamp tar from?
The swamp of course! It's south of Lumbridge.
What else do I need?
You will also need a cake tin to store the wax in.
translation: Mumu saklamak icin bir kek kalibina da ihtiyacin olacak.

english: See you!
Thank you, come again.
Nothing, thanks.
How is your son getting on?
He is getting on fine! He has just been promoted to Sergeant! I'm really proud of him!
translation: Cok iyi! Az önce cavusluga terfi etti! Onunla gurur duyuyorum!

english: I'm happy for you!
He is getting on fine! He has just started his basic training and has already been promoted to corporal! I'm really proud of him!
translation: Cok iyi! Temel egitimine yeni basladi ve simdiden onbasiliga terfi etti! Onunla gurur duyuyorum!

english: He was captured by those blasted trolls! I don't know what to do. Even the imperial guard are too afraid to go rescue him.
translation: O lanet troller tarafindan esir alindi! Ne yapacagimi bilmiyorum. Imparatorluk muhafizlari bile onu kurtarmaya gitmeye korkuyor.

english: What happened?
Talk to Denulth, he can tell you all about it. Anything else before I get on with my work?
translation: Denulth ile konus, sana her seyi anlatir. Isime devam etmeden önce baska bir sey var mi?

english: Is it OK if I use your anvil?
So you're a smithy are you?
I dabble.
A fellow smith is welcome to use my anvil!
Thanks!
Hi!
Hi! How can I help?
Tenzing has asked me to bring you his climbing boots, he needs to have spikes put on them.
translation: Tenzing, sana tirmanma botlarini getirmemi istedi, botlarina civiler takilmasi gerekiyor.

english: He does, does he? Well I won't do it till he pays for the last set I made for him!
translation: Öyle mi? Son yaptigim botlarin parasini ödeyene kadar bunu yapmayacagim!

english: This is really important!
How so?
Well, I need the Sherpa to show me a secret way up Death Plateau so that the Imperial Guard can destroy the troll camp! He won't help me till I've got the spikes!
translation: Sey, Imparatorluk Muhafizlari'nin trol kampini yok edebilmesi icin Sherpa'nin bana Ölüm Platosu'na cikan gizli yolu göstermesi gerekiyor! Civilerimi almadan bana yardim etmeyecek!

english: Hmm. That's different!
Tell you what, I'll make them for you on one condition.
translation: Bak ne diyecegim, bir sartla senin icin yaparim.

english: *sigh* What's the condition?
My son has just turned 16 and I'd very much like him to join the Imperial Guard. The Prince's elite forces are invite only so it's very unlikely he'll get in. If you can arrange that you have a deal!
translation: Oglum 16 yasina girdi ve onun Imparatorluk Muhafizlari'na katilmasini cok istiyorum. Prensin seckin kuvvetleri sadece davetle katilinabiliyor, bu yüzden onun kabul edilmesi cok zor. Eger bunu ayarlayabilirsen, anlasmamiz var demektir!

english: That won't be a problem as I'm helping out the Imperial Guard!
translation: Imparatorluk Muhafizlari'na yardim ettigim icin bu sorun olmaz!

english: Excellent! You'll need to bring an Iron bar for the spikes!
translation: Harika! Civiler icin demir cubuk getirmen gerekecek!

english: Have you managed to get my son signed up for the Imperial Guard?
Not yet! I just need to speak to Denulth!
translation: Henüz degil! Denulth ile konusmam gerekiyor!

english: I have but I don't have the entrance certificate on me.
translation: Kaydettirdim ama giris sertifikasi yanimda degil.

english: Good but I need to have the certificate.
You give Dunstan the certificate.
Thank you!
Now to keep my end of the bargain. Give me the boots and an iron bar and I'll put on the spikes.
translation: Simdi anlasmanin benim tarafimi yerine getireyim. Bana botlari ve demir cubugu ver, ben de civileri takayim.

english: I don't have the iron bar or the climbing boots.
translation: Demir cubugum ve tirmanma botlarim yok.

english: I don't have the iron bar.
I don't have the climbing boots.
You give Dunstan an iron bar and the climbing boots.
translation: Dunstan'a demir cubugu ve tirmanma botlarini ver.

english: Dunstan has given you the spiked boots.
Thank you!
No problem.
Hi!
I see you've got the spiked boots. Are you going to take them to the Sherpa?
translation: Civili botlari almissin. Onlari Sherpa'ya götürecek misin?

english: I will do shortly.
I have a question for you.
Please enter the answer to the question.
No, try again.
Correct!
Talk about a quest.
Can I have another law talisman?
translation: Baska bir yasa tilsimi alabilir miyim?

english: Yes, I'll take it.
No thanks...
Can you put some spikes on my Climbing boots?
Yes, but I still want them.
translation: Evet, ama yine de onlari istiyorum.

english: Oh OK, I'll leave them thanks.
Can you make me another sled?
translation: Bana baska bir kizak yapabilir misin?

english: What do I need for the sled wax again?
translation: Kizak mumu icin neye ihtiyacim var?

english: Where can I get wax from?
Where can I get swamp tar from?
What else do I need?
See you!
Nothing, thanks.
Talk about something else.
How is your son getting on?
Is it OK if I use your anvil?
'Ello, and what are you after then?
I need another assignment.
Excellent, you're doing great. Your new task is to kill [amount] [task monster].
Got any tips for me?
translation: Bana verebilecegin bir ipucu var mi?

english: Great, thanks!
Okay, great!
Good luck! Don't forget to come back when you need a new assignment.
translation: Iyi sanslar! Yeni bir görev gerektiginde geri gelmeyi unutma.

english: You're still hunting [monster]; you have [amount] to go. Come back when you've finished your task.
You're still hunting [monster], with [amount] to go.
I don't think that's a suitable task for you. Shall I cancel it? This will not wipe your task streaks.
translation: Bence bu görev sana uygun degil. Iptal edeyim mi? Bu, görev serini silmez.

english: Yes, please cancel it.
Alright, consider the task cancelled. You can now get a new assignment when you want one.
translation: Tamam, görev iptal edildi. Istedigin zaman yeni bir görev alabilirsin.

english: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
Good luck with that.
Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: Bana verebileceginiz bir ödül veya takas edebilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: I have quite a few rewards you can earn, and a wide variety of Slayer equipment for sale.
translation: Kazanabileceginiz pek cok ödül ve satilik cok cesitli Avci ekipmanlari var.

english: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
The Slayer Masters may currently assign you any task in our lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: Avci Ustalar su anda savas seviyeniz ne olursa olsun listemizdeki herhangi bir görevi size verebilir.

english: That's fine - I can handle any task.
That's the spirit.
In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: Gelecekte lütfen cok zor görevler vermeyin.

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: Tamam, bundan sonra tüm Avci Ustalar sana görev verirken savas seviyeni dikkate alacaklar, bu yüzden cok zor görevler almayacaksin.

english: The Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: Avci Ustalar sana görev verirken savas seviyeni dikkate alacaklar, bu yüzden cok zor görevler almayacaksin.

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
translation: Sorun degil, cok zor görevler istemiyorum.

english: Okay, we'll keep checking your combat level.
translation: Tamam, savas seviyeni kontrol etmeye devam edecegiz.

english: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: Savas seviyemi kontrol etmeyi birakin, her seyi yapabilirim!

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will assign you anything from their lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: Tamam, bundan sonra tüm Avci Ustalar, savas seviyenize bakilmaksizin size listelerinden herhangi bir görev verecekler.

english: Tell me about your skillcape, please.

This is a Slayer's Skillcape. Only a true Slayer master is permitted to wear one and in recognition of such an achievement, Slayer masters may be persuaded to allow you to select the same assignment in a row.
translation: Bu bir Avci Beceri Pelerini. Sadece gercek bir Avci Ustasi bunu giyebilir ve bu basariyi takdir etmek icin Avci Ustalar, ayni görevi arka arkaya secmenize izin verebilirler.

english: You need more training before you earn that honour, though.
translation: Ancak bu onuru kazanmak icin daha fazla egitime ihtiyacin var.

english: May I buy a Slayer's Skillcape, please?
translation: Bir Slayer'in Skillcape'ini satin alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: Well you have performed well as a student. I guess you have earned the right to wear such a prestigious cape now. The Slayer masters will recognize this cape and may offer you the same assignment twice in a row.
translation: Ögrenci olarak iyi performans gösterdin. Sanirim artik böyle prestijli bir pelerin giyme hakkini kazandin. Slayer ustalari bu pelerini taniyacak ve sana ayni görevi arka arkaya iki kez sunabilirler.

english: That will be 99000 coins, please.
I've changed my mind; I don't want it.
Okay. Well, if you change it back again, I will be waiting.
translation: Tamam. Peki, tekrar fikrini degistirirsen, seni bekliyor olacagim.

english: Great, I've always wanted one!
But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: Ama ne yazik ki, yanimda yeterince param yok.

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.
translation: Peki, paran oldugunda tekrar gelip beni gör.

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: Maalesef tüm Skillcapes sadece ücretsiz kapüsonlu olarak satiliyor, bu bir beceri promosyonunun parcasi; bir alana bir bedava, bilirsin. Yani sana bir tane satabilmem icin önce envanterinde yer acman gerekiyor.

english: Good hunting, [player name].
Er... Nothing...
'Ello, can I help you?
Hello?
'Ello, who's that?
I'm [player name]. I'm using my magic to communicate with you.
translation: Ben Maceraci. Sizinle iletisim kurmak icin büyümü kullaniyorum.

english: Bizarre, go on, what do you want then?
I need another assignment.
Got any tips for me?
translation: Bana verebileceginiz bir ipucu var mi?

english: Okay, great!
Yes, please cancel it.
No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: Bana verebileceginiz bir ödül veya takas edebilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Look at rewards.
Look at shop.
Cancel.
Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
That's fine - I can handle any task.
In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: Gelecekte lütfen cok zor görevler verme.

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
translation: Sorun degil, cok zor görevler istemiyorum.

english: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: Savas seviyemi kontrol etmeyi birak, her seyi halledebilirim!

english: Tell me about your skillcape, please.
Can you sell me a Slayer Skillcape?
translation: Bana bir Slayer Skillcape satabilir misin?

english: I've changed my mind, I don't want it.
Great; I've always wanted one!
Er... Nothing...
Err... Nothing...
Burgers!
Hot frogburgers!
Frogburgers!
Frog in a bun!
Tasty frogburgers!
Eyup. Not too often we get visitors down here.
translation: Evet. Buraya pek sik ziyaretci gelmez.

english: What is this place?
Beats me. All I know is, there's dust devils in here, and I'm here to make sure only people with permission can kill 'em.
translation: Bilmem. Tek bildigim, burada toz firtinalari oldugu ve izinli kisiler disinda kimsenin onlari öldüremeyeceginden emin olmak icin burada oldugum.

english: Can I kill them?
You got a Slayer task for it, so sure, be my guest.
translation: Bunun icin bir Slayer görevin varsa, tabii ki, buyur.

english: Not without a Slayer task. Go talk to a Slayer Master about it.
translation: Slayer görevin olmadan olmaz. Slayer Ustasi ile konus.

english: Who are you?
The name's Dusty Aliv. I guard this place for the Slayer Masters.
translation: Adim Dusty Aliv. Avci Ustalarinin burayi korumakla görevliyim.

english: That doesn't sound like a great job.
translation: Pek iyi bir is gibi görünmüyor.

english: Eh, it has its perks. Plus it beats flying around Gielinor after numbskulls like you trying to deliver mail like some people I know.
translation: Eh, avantajlari da var. Ayrica, tanidigim bazi insanlar gibi, senin gibi aptallarin pesinde Gielinor'da ucup durmaktan iyidir.

english: Nice sword.
Thanks. Probably shouldn't tell you about the previous owner though.
translation: Tesekkürler. Ama önceki sahibinden bahsetmesem iyi olur.

english: What happened to them?
Let's just say the heat got to them.
Goodbye.
See ya.
Oi! Only people with a Slayer task can slay in here!
translation: Hey! Sadece Slayer görevi olanlar burada avlanabilir!

english: What is this place?
Who are you?
Nice sword.
Goodbye.
Hello human.
Hello. What do you do here?
I'm Dusuri. I specialise in unique minerals that can't be found on Gielinor.
translation: Ben Dusuri. Gielinor'da bulunmayan essiz mineraller konusunda uzmanim.

english: Can't be found on Gielinor? Where do they come from then?
translation: Gielinor'da bulunamiyor mu? O zaman nereden geliyorlar?

english: To be honest, we don't fully know. All we know is that they can be found within shooting stars.
translation: Dürüst olmak gerekirse, tam olarak bilmiyoruz. Tek bildigimiz, kayan yildizlarin icinde bulunabildikleri.

english: Shooting stars?
That's right. They fall from the sky from time to time. They can be mined for the unique minerals that I specialise in.
translation: Aynen öyle. Zaman zaman gökyüzünden düserler. Benim uzman oldugum essiz mineralleri cikarmak icin kullanilabilirler.

english: If you ever come across one, I'd be happy to trade you for any stardust you find.
translation: Eger bir tane bulursaniz, buldugunuz yildiz tozunu sizinle takas etmekten memnuniyet duyarim.

english: I'll bear that in mind.
Good luck out there.
Oh yes. I've seen those before.
Wonderful. If you ever get any stardust from them, I'd be happy to trade you for it.
translation: Harika. Eger onlardan yildiz tozu elde ederseniz, sizinle takas etmekten memnuniyet duyarim.

english: I have some here. Can we trade?
translation: Burada biraz var. Takas edebilir miyiz?

english: Not now, I'm afraid. Maybe another time.
translation: Maalesef su anda olmaz. Belki baska bir zaman.

english: Of course.
Can we trade?
What do you sell?
I have packs of gems and soft clay if they take your fancy. I also have some interesting star fragments that seem to be able to recolour certain metals.
translation: Eger hosuna giderse, mücevher ve yumusak kil paketlerim var. Ayrica, bazi metalleri yeniden renklendirebilen ilginc yildiz parcalari da var.

english: Most notably, I have a unique ring that we found embedded within a star once. It seems to have magical properties that we don't fully understand. What we do know is that it can improve your skill while mining.
translation: En önemlisi, bir zamanlar bir yildizin icinde buldugumuz essiz bir yüzük var. Tam olarak anlamadigimiz sihirli özellikleri var gibi görünüyor. Bildigimiz tek sey, madencilik becerilerini gelistirebilecegi.

english: What can you tell me about shooting stars?
Not a lot really. All I know is that they fall from the sky from time to time and that you can mine them.
translation: Aslinda pek bir sey bilmiyorum. Tek bildigim, zaman zaman gökyüzünden düstükleri ve onlari madencilige tabi tutabilecegin.

english: If you want to know more, there's an observatory near Ardougne that you might want to visit. They've done some research into them.
translation: Daha fazla bilgi edinmek istersen, Ardougne yakinlarinda ziyaret edebilecegin bir gözlemevi var. Onlar bu konuda bazi arastirmalar yapmislar.

english: I'm off.
I have some here. Can we trade?
translation: Bende biraz var. Takas yapabilir miyiz?

english: I'll bear that in mind.
Can we trade?
What do you sell?
What can you tell me about shooting stars?
I'm off.
Can I help you at all?
No thanks.
Yes please, what are you selling?
No thanks.
Hello there. How's it going?
Hello. Who are you?
I'm an adventurer.
Really? How interesting...
Not too bad, thanks. How about you?
I'm good, thank you.
Sorry, but I have work to do right now.
translation: Üzgünüm, ama su anda isim var.

english: Hello there! I'm very well, thank you.
Sorry, I'm busy right now.
Welcome to the Mining Guild. Can I help you with anything?
translation: Madencilik Loncasina hos geldiniz. Size yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: What have you got in the guild?
All sorts of things! There's plenty of coal rocks along with some iron, mithril and adamantite as well.
translation: Her türlü sey var! Bol miktarda kömür kayasi, demir, mitril ve adamantit var.

english: Deeper in the guild you'll find even more rocks including some runite! The best bit though is our amethyst mine, the only one in the land!
translation: Loncanin derinliklerinde daha fazla kaya bulacaksin, hatta runit bile var! En iyisi ise, bu topraklardaki tek ametist madenimiz!

english: There's no better mining site anywhere!
translation: Daha iyi bir maden yeri yok!

english: What do you dwarves do with the ore you mind?
translation: Siz cüceler madenlerden cikardiginiz cevherle ne yapiyorsunuz?

english: What do you think? We smelt it into bars, smith the metal to make armour and weapons, then we exchange them for goods and services.
translation: Sence ne yapiyoruz? Cevheri eritip külce haline getiriyoruz, metali dövüp zirh ve silah yapiyoruz, sonra bunlari mal ve hizmetlerle takas ediyoruz.

english: I don't see many dwarves selling armour or weapons here.
translation: Burada zirh veya silah satan cok fazla cüce görmüyorum.

english: No, this is only a mining outpost. We dwarves don't much like to settle in human cities. Most of the ore is carted off to Keldagrim, the great dwarven city. They've got a special blast furnace up there - it makes
translation: Hayir, burasi sadece bir madencilik karakolu. Biz cüceler insan sehirlerine yerlesmeyi pek sevmeyiz. Cevherin cogu büyük cüce sehri Keldagrim'e tasinir. Orada özel bir yüksek firin var, bu da

english: smelting the ore so much easier. There are plenty of dwarven traders working in Keldagrim. Anyway, can I help you with anything else?
translation: cevherin eritilmesini cok daha kolay hale getiriyor. Keldagrim'de calisan cok sayida cüce tüccar var. Her neyse, baska bir seye ihtiyaciniz var mi?

english: No thanks, I'm fine.
Sorry, but you're not experienced enough to go in there.
translation: Üzgünüm, ama oraya girmek icin yeterince deneyimli degilsiniz.

english: You need a Mining level of 60 to access the Mining Guild.
translation: Madencilik Loncasina girmek icin 60 madencilik seviyesi gerekir.

english: What have you got in the Guild?
What do you dwarves do with the ore you mine?
translation: Madencilikten elde ettiginiz cevherle ne yapiyorsunuz?

english: No thanks, I'm fine.
Hello there. Do you need anything?
translation: Merhaba. Bir seye ihtiyaciniz var mi?

english: What's through this cave?
This cave leads to the Mining Guild, home to the finest mining site around. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Bu magara, cevrede en iyi madencilik sahasinin bulundugu Madencilik Loncasina aciliyor. Baska bir seye ihtiyaciniz var mi?

english: I hope the goblins are properly maintaining their stretch of track! I'd hate to see them spoil good Dwarven workmanship.
translation: Umarim goblinler raylarini düzgün bir sekilde bakimini yapiyorlar! Cücelerin iyi isciligini bozmalarini görmek istemem.

english: You're [player name], aren't you? It's a good job you did helping to get this train link open.
translation: Sen Maceraci'sin, degil mi? Bu tren hattinin acilmasina yardim ettigin icin aferin sana.

english: Y'know, at first I didn't like the idea of visiting a goblin city, but these cave goblins are alright.
translation: Biliyor musun, ilk basta bir goblin sehrini ziyaret etme fikri hosuma gitmemisti, ama bu magara goblinleri fena degil.

english: These goblins have so much more advanced technology than us. Take a look at their magical lights! We could never create something like them.
translation: Bu goblinlerin teknolojisi bizden cok daha gelismis. Su sihirli isiklara bir bak! Biz asla böyle bir sey yaratamayiz.

english: Dorgesh-Kaan's very nice to visit, but I don't think I'd want to live there.
translation: Dorgesh-Kaan'i ziyaret etmek cok güzel, ama orada yasamak istemezdim.

english: Ho there, human!
[player name].
Ho there, [player name]! Want to take a ride with me?
translation: Selam, Maceraci! Benimle bir gezintiye ne dersin?

english: Where are you going? Across the river?
No no, that's what the ferryman is for! I'm going to Keldagrim, my home!
translation: Hayir hayir, bunun icin feribot var! Ben Keldagrim'e, evime gidiyorum!

english: How much will that cost me then?
translation: Peki bu bana ne kadara mal olacak?

english: For a human like you, I can do it for free!
translation: Senin gibi bir insana bedava yaparim!

english: That's a deal!
Excellent! I'm just waiting for my ship to arrive and then we can go.
translation: Harika! Gemimin gelmesini bekliyorum, sonra gidebiliriz.

english: Mind, this trip could take a few minutes! Are you sure you're ready to go as well?
translation: Bu yolculuk birkac dakika sürebilir! Sen de gitmeye hazir misin?

english: Before starting this quest, be aware that one or more of your skill levels are lower than what is required to fully complete it.
translation: Bu göreve baslamadan önce, bir veya daha fazla beceri seviyenin görevi tamamlamak icin gereken seviyenin altinda oldugunu unutma.

english: Yes, I'm ready and don't mind it taking a few minutes.
translation: Evet, hazirim ve birkac dakika sürmesi sorun degil.

english: Well, let's not waste any more time then!
translation: O zaman daha fazla zaman kaybetmeyelim!

english: No, I don't have time right now, I'll be back later.
translation: Hayir, su anda vaktim yok, sonra tekrar gelirim.

english: Sure, sure! Come back when you need to!
translation: Tabii, tabii! Ihtiyacin oldugunda tekrar gel!

english: I prefer the mines to the city.
Well, suit yourself then!
Hello again, [player name]! Want to go back to Keldagrim?
translation: Merhaba tekrar, Maceraci! Keldagrim'e geri dönmek ister misin?

english: Yes, please take me.
What, on your ship? No way.
translation: Ne, senin geminle mi? Hayir, olmaz.

english: Hey, it was only a little accident! Calm down!
translation: Hey, sadece kücük bir kazaydi! Sakin ol!

english: Want me to take you back to the mines?
translation: Seni madenlere geri götürmemi ister misin?

english: What, on your ship? No thanks! I don't want to crash into any more things!
translation: Ne, senin geminde mi? Hayir, tesekkürler! Artik baska bir seye carpmak istemiyorum!

english: Hey now, it was only a slight accident!
A slight accident?? Have you any idea how much time I spent rebuilding that statue?
translation: Ufak bir kaza mi? O heykeli yeniden yapmak icin ne kadar zaman harcadigimi biliyor musun?

english: Calm down, calm down! You got what you paid for the trip, didn't you?
translation: Sakin ol, sakin ol! Yolculuk icin ödedigin paranin karsiligini aldin, degil mi?

english: That's a deal!
Yes.
No.
I prefer the mines to the city.
Yes, please take me.
What, on your ship? No way.
translation: Ne, senin geminle mi? Hayir, olmaz.

english: What, on your ship! No thanks!
translation: Ne, senin geminle mi! Hayir, tesekkürler!

english: Do you have any gold ore that you want me to take to the bank in the city?
translation: Sehirdeki bankaya götürmemi istedigin altin cevherin var mi?

english: I don't have any, I'm afraid.
Well, I have this one piece of ore...
translation: Sey, bu bir parca cevherim var...

english: That wouldn't do you much good, I'm afraid. My minimum fee is one piece of gold ore, there wouldn't be anything left for you.
translation: Korkarim bu sana pek bir fayda saglamaz. Minimum ücretim bir parca altin cevheri, sana hicbir sey kalmaz.

english: Yes, please take my gold to the city. I've got [number] pieces of ore right here.
Are you sure you have enough space in your bank account for that?
translation: Banka hesabinda bunun icin yeterli yerin olduguna emin misin?

english: No, you're right actually, I don't.
Let's see, if I take that to the bank for you, I'd keep [number] for myself and bring [number] to the bank for you. Does that sound fair?
Yes, it does.
Excellent, it's been good doing business with you! I'll take these to the city with my next shipment.
translation: Harika, seninle is yapmak cok güzeldi! Bunlari bir sonraki sevkiyatimda sehre götürecegim.

english: No, that's far too expensive for me.
translation: Hayir, bu benim icin cok pahali.

english: No, I'll hang on to these myself, thanks.
It all seems a bit expensive, really.
I don't know... it's just what Dondakan told me, if someone wanted me to ship their gold.
translation: Bilmiyorum... Dondakan bana öyle söyledi, eger biri altinini göndermemi isterse.

english: There's plenty of gold coming from that rock now, surely you can lower the price somewhat?
translation: O kayadan su anda bol miktarda altin cikiyor, fiyati biraz düsürebilir misin?

english: Alright. Tell you what, I'll only keep [number] for myself and bring [number] ores to the bank for you. Deal?
Yes, much appreciated.
Excellent, it's been good doing business with you!
translation: Harika, seninle is yapmak cok güzeldi!

english: Yes, please take my gold to the city.
No, I'll hang on to these myself.
[Charm] It all seems a bit expensive, really.
I wish you'd just leave me alone.
Why, what's wrong?
I was a great engineer once. Still am actually.
translation: Bir zamanlar harika bir mühendistim. Aslinda hala öyleyim.

english: They just don't let me do the work I do best anymore.
translation: Artik en iyi yaptigim isi yapmama izin vermiyorlar.

english: What do you do then?
I'm an assistant in this shop. I get all the lousy jobs too.
