translation: Bu dükkanda asistanim. Bütün berbat isleri de ben yapiyorum.

english: Well, I'm sorry to hear that.
Hello there, want a ride?
translation: Merhaba, bir yere gitmek ister misin?

english: A ride, where to?
Across the river, across the river! It's just a short ride!
translation: Nehrin karsisina, nehrin karsisina! Kisa bir yolculuk!

english: How much will that cost me?
Haha, you understand us dwarves well, human!
translation: Haha, bizi cüceleri iyi anliyorsun, insan!

english: It's just 2 gold pieces! Want to go?
I'd like to go further downstream.
You mean to the city of Keldagrim?
Ehm, yes, I think so.
Sorry, I'm just a simple ferryman, I only go across.
translation: Üzgünüm, ben sadece basit bir feribotcuyum, sadece karsiya geciyorum.

english: But talk to my friend here, he sometimes goes to the city in his ship.
translation: Ama buradaki arkadasimla konus, o bazen gemisiyle sehre gidiyor.

english: Thanks.
You don't even have 2 gold coins, humans!
Come back later.
No thanks.
You don't even have 2 gold coins, human!
But... that means I'm stuck here.
translation: Ama... bu durumda burada mahsur kaldim.

english: Hmm. I suppose I could make an exception for you this time.
translation: Hmm. Sanirim bu seferlik sizin icin bir istisna yapabilirim.

english: Thanks a lot!
I'd like to go further downstream.
Yes please.
No thanks.
Out of the way!
Coming through!
Make way, make way!
[20-40] ores of [copper/tin/iron/mithril/silver/gold] coming in!
[20-40] pieces of coal coming in!
Here, [20-40] ores of [copper/tin/iron/mithril/silver/gold].
Here, [20-40] pieces of coal.
What's cooking?
The stew for the servant's main meal.
Oh... Fair enough. See you later.
Bye.
What's cooking, good looking?
Um...er...see you later.
Nice to see a female cook.
I know, I had to work hard to get this position.
translation: Biliyorum, bu pozisyonu almak için çok çalismak zorunda kaldim.

english: Hi!
Welcome to Mad Eadgar's! Happiness in a bowl!
translation: Mad Eadgar's'a hos geldiniz! Bir kasede mutluluk!

english: Welcome to Mad Eadgar's! You'll never want to leave!
translation: Mad Eadgar's'a hos geldiniz! Buradan hic ayrilmak istemeyeceksiniz!

english: Welcome to Mad Eadgar's! We don't serve trolls!
translation: Mad Eadgar's'a hos geldiniz! Trollere hizmet vermiyoruz!

english: Welcome to Mad Eadgar's! Serving all day, every day!
translation: Mad Eadgar's'a hos geldiniz! Her gün, tüm gün hizmetinizdeyiz!

english: Would you care to sample our delicious home cooking?
translation: Lezzetli ev yemeklerimizi denemek ister misiniz?

english: Why do you live so close to the trolls? Isn't it dangerous?
translation: Neden trollerin bu kadar yakininda yasiyorsun? Tehlikeli degil mi?

english: Well, I suppose I do keep getting captured by the trolls and thrown in prison...But they always release me in the end, I'm far too old and skinny for their tastes.
translation: Sey, troller tarafindan sürekli yakalanip hapse atiliyorum... Ama sonunda beni her zaman serbest birakiyorlar, onlarin zevkine göre cok yasli ve zayifim.

english: In any case, this is my home, and I'm not leaving it. And this area has the tastiest goats!
translation: Her neyse, burasi benim evim ve buradan ayrilmayacagim. Ayrica bu bölgede en lezzetli keciler var!

english: What do you have to offer?
The chef's recommendation for today is mountain goat stew. I'll give some stew in exchange for logs for my fire. They're hard to come by around here.
translation: Sefin bugünkü önerisi dag kecisi yahnisi. Atesim icin odun karsiliginda biraz yahni veririm. Buralarda odun bulmak zor.

english: I'd like some mountain goat stew, please.
You don't have any logs! I may be mad, but I'm not stupid!
translation: Odun yok mu? Deli olabilirim ama aptal degilim!

english: Here you go! Enjoy!
You get a bowl of mountain goat stew.
translation: Bir kase dag kecisi yahnisi alirsiniz.

english: You eat the mountain goat stew.
It heals some health.
No thanks, Eadgar.
Your loss!
Why do you live so close to the trolls?
translation: Neden trollerin bu kadar yakininda yasiyorsun?

english: What do you have to offer?
I'd like some mountain goat stew, please.
No thanks, Eadgar.
Gratias tibi ago!
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu var. Merhaba, selam, merhaba...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her türlü sey! Kuleler muhtesem bir manzara sunuyor.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmenizi tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Oh no, why today of all days?
What's wrong Mr Rabbit?
I'm having an eggceptionally bad day. But if you must know, my Egg making machine is shell dry and the next shipment of fuel will not be here for a while!
translation: Son derece kötü bir gün geciriyorum. Ama bilmen gerekirse, yumurta yapma makinem bosaldi ve bir sonraki yakit sevkiyati bir süre gelmeyecek!

english: I would love it if a cracking adventurer, such as yourself, would help a Bunny in need.
translation: Senin gibi cesur bir maceraci, ihtiyaci olan bir tavsana yardim ederse cok sevinirim.

english: I would love to help you mix up some more fuel.
translation: Sana biraz daha yakit hazirlamana yardim etmek isterim.

english: Thanks for eggreeing to help me.
translation: Yardim etmeyi kabul ettigin icin tesekkürler.

english: There are three ingredients that are needed to make the fuel.
translation: Yakit yapmak icin gerekli üc malzeme var.

english: The first ingredient is Dried cocoa. During any other time of year this ingredient would be eggceptionally hard to get.
translation: Ilk malzeme kurutulmus kakao. Yilin diger zamanlarinda bu malzemeyi bulmak cok zor olur.

english: But if I'm spot on with my information, there should be a merchant rolling into Al Kharid soon. He should sell you some.
translation: Ama bilgim dogruysa, yakinda Al Kharid'e bir tüccar gelecek. O sana satabilir.

english: Try not to bring me camel dung, they do look similar.
translation: Bana deve gübresi getirme, ikisi birbirine cok benziyor.

english: The second ingredient is really high quality milk.
The most eggceptional milk around has got to be milk from Hosidius, I'm sure Duke Horacio's cook can help you out.
translation: Bölgedeki en olaganüstü süt Hosidius'un sütü olmali, Duke Horacio'nun ascisi sana yardimci olabilir.

english: The third ingredient is some cracking spices, very special ones. Can't go into detail, trade secret and all.
translation: Ücüncü malzeme ise cok özel baharatlar. Ayrintilara giremem, ticari sir falan.

english: I'm sure if you talk to Martin in Draynor, he'll be a good egg and help you out if you ask for Special spices.
translation: Draynor'daki Martin ile konusursan, özel baharatlar istersen sana yardimci olacaktir.

english: Since you're doing errands for me. Feel Free to use my tunnels to get around.
translation: Benim icin is yapiyorsun. Istedigin zaman tünellerimi kullanabilirsin.

english: But don't make a yolk out of it, you may only use each tunnel once. Can't have you interrupting my workers any more than that.
translation: Ama bunu suistimal etme, her tüneli sadece bir kez kullanabilirsin. Calisanlarimi daha fazla rahatsiz etmeni istemem.

english: Also, if you ever forget what you need, there will be a worker nearby who can remind you.
translation: Ayrica, neye ihtiyacin oldugunu unutursan, yakinlarda sana hatirlatacak bir calisan olacaktir.

english: I'll get right on it. Be back soon.
See you soon!
Get stuffed.
I'll have you know this is no yolking matter.
Where do I get the Dried cocoa?
During any other time of year this ingredient would be a nightmare to get.
translation: Yilin diger zamanlarinda bu malzemeyi bulmak kabus gibi olurdu.

english: But if I'm spot on with my information, there should bea merchant making his way from the Kharidian Desert to Al Kharid.
translation: Ama bilgim dogruysa, Kharidian Cölü'nden Al Kharid'e giden bir tüccar olmali.

english: I'd suggest checking the Shantay Pass.
Where do I get the bottle of Hosidius milk?
The most eggceptional milk around has got to be milk from Hosidius, I'm sure Duke Horacio's cook in Lumbridge castle can help you out.
translation: Buralardaki en olaganüstü süt Hosidius'un sütü olmali, eminim Lumbridge kalesindeki Dük Horacio'nun ascisi sana yardimci olabilir.

english: Where do I get the Special spices?
He should get the hint.
Goodbye.
Keep on rolling my friend!
Easter Bunny! I knew I would find you here.
translation: Paskalya Tavsani! Seni burada bulacagimi biliyordum.

english: Easter Bunny... Now there's a name I haven't heard in a long time...
translation: Paskalya Tavsani... Uzun zamandir duymadigim bir isim...

english: How long exactly?
Oh, almost a year.
What have people been calling you instead?
translation: Insanlar sana baska ne isimlerle hitap ediyor?

english: I go by many names.
Some call me 'Eggrabbit'.
Others call me 'Long Ears Johnson'.
Mhmm?
Many times have I walked past Varrock West Bank and been called 'Sellin lobbies 200gp'.
translation: Varrock Bati Bankasi'nin önünden bircok kez gectim ve bana “200 altin satiyorum” dediler.

english: I don't really understand that one.
Do you think perhaps they weren't talking to you?
Who could blame them? I'm a failure!
translation: Onlari kim suclayabilir ki? Ben bir basarisizim!

english: Oh come on now, what do you mean?
You call me the Easter Bunny? What right do I have to that name?
translation: Bana Paskalya Tavsani mi diyorsun? O ismi almaya hakkim var mi?

english: I don't feel the spirit of Easter within me.
*sniff*
I'm just a big dumb rabbit!
translation: Ben sadece büyük, aptal bir tavsanim!

english: Aww, that's... come on!
I've ruined Easter for everyone!
Aww...
WAHHHH!
The Easter Bunny is clearly very upset and needs cheering up. Perhaps the other people in the Rabbit Hole have some ideas?
translation: Paskalya Tavsani acikca cok üzgün ve neselenmeye ihtiyaci var. Belki Tavsan Deligi'ndeki diger insanlar bir fikirleri vardir?

english: Hello Easter Bunny, how are you feeling?
Maybe I'll make my way through this sorry old world as a clown...
translation: Belki bu üzücü eski dünyada bir palyaco olarak yoluma devam ederim...

english: Hello! Have you come to take part in the festivities?
translation: Merhaba! Kutlamalara katilmak icin mi geldin?

english: The Easter Bunny is looking awfully glum this year.
translation: Paskalya Tavsani bu yil cok üzgün görünüyor.

english: Perhaps we can help raise the Easter spirits?
translation: Belki Paskalya ruhunu canlandirmaya yardimci olabiliriz?

english: You want to do some necromancy... To cheer up the Easter Bunny?
translation: Paskalya Tavsanini neselendirmek icin büyücülük mü yapmak istiyorsun?

english: No no no! It's just a figure of speech.
translation: Hayir, hayir, hayir! Sadece bir deyim.

english: I just wonder if we could do anything to help.
translation: Yardimci olabilecegimiz bir sey var mi diye merak ediyorum.

english: Leave it to me boss.
I happen to know the E.B. is a big fan of bowling. In fact, he used to be a wizard on the lanes. A champion!
translation: Paskalya Tavsaninin bowling hayrani oldugunu biliyorum. Aslinda, eskiden bowling salonlarinda bir sihirbazdi. Bir sampiyon!

english: I also happen to have the ability to...
...Rig the game in his favour.
Which is handy, he's very out of practise nowadays.
translation: Bu cok kullanisli, cünkü su siralar hic pratik yapmiyor.

english: Won't he suspect something?
Oh no! You see, I have these gears set up just here.
translation: Hayir! Bak, bu aletleri buraya kurdum.

english: Wait, are you just trying to get my trade secrets?
translation: Dur, benim mesleki sirlarimi mi ögrenmeye calisiyorsun?

english: This is strictly a humanitarian effort!
Bun-itarian..?
Look, I just want to get Easter back on track.
translation: Bak, ben sadece Paskalya'yi tekrar rayina oturtmak istiyorum.

english: You can keep your hustle going, I just want to help the Easter Bunny.
translation: Sen isine devam et, ben sadece Paskalya Tavsanina yardim etmek istiyorum.

english: Oh alright, since I do owe the big softie. But I've got my whiskers on you!
translation: Tamam, madem ki bu yumusak kalpli adama borcluyum. Ama seni gözümün önünden ayirmayacagim!

english: So, what is it you wanted to show me, [player name]?
translation: Peki, bana ne göstermek istiyordun, Maceraci?

english: Well, Bowley here let me in on your secret. Bowling champion three years in a row.
translation: Sey, Bowley bana senin sirrini acikladi. Üc yil üst üste bowling sampiyonu.

english: Oh. Those were the days, I haven't partaken for while now though...
translation: Oh. O günler ne güzeldi, ama uzun zamandir katilmiyorum...

english: I just haven't had the spring in my step with my egg responsibilities.
translation: Yumurta sorumluluklarim yüzünden adimlarimda eskisi gibi ziplama yok.

english: Well, here's your chance!
What do you mean? It's hardly fun without decent competition.
translation: Ne demek istiyorsun? Iyi bir rakip olmadan eglenceli olmaz ki.

english: And nobody here quite likes bowling.
They what now?
I've only just gone and spent ages digging out this place and installing the machinery!
translation: Bu yeri kazip makineleri kurmak icin cok zaman harcadim!

english: Nothing to worry about I'm sure!
Ah Bowley, it is good to see you again.
translation: Ah Bowley, seni tekrar görmek ne güzel.

english: Long Ears Johnson. Come to terrorise me pins again?
translation: Uzun Kulakli Johnson. Yine beni korkutmaya mi geldin?

english: We'll see about that.
Oh yes, [player name] is apparently quite good.
translation: Evet, Maceraci görünüse göre oldukca iyi.

english: It's been so long since I've had a decent set with a worthy opponent.
translation: Uzun zamandir iyi bir rakiple düzgün bir mac yapmamistim.

english: Chin up bucko, I'm here and ready to challenge your rule of these alleys!
translation: Neselen dostum, buradayim ve bu salonun krali olmaya hazirim!

english: Well, I suppose I'm not doing anything else. Why not?
translation: Eh, baska bir isim de yok. Neden olmasin?

english: The player bowls down 3 carrot pins.
A fine shot, but not quite enough!
Watch this!
The Easter Bunny bowls a strike.
A lucky strike?
I'd better shape up or this will be quite one sided.
translation: Kendimi toparlasam iyi olacak, yoksa bu mac tek tarafli olacak.

english: And that would be no fun at all.
The player bowls down the middle 6 pins.
Ah, so you have some fight in you.
translation: Ah, demek icinde biraz mücadele ruhu var.

english: I could do this all day.
That's exactly what I wanted to hear!
The screen fades black with the text "Some time later..."
I'm surprised I hadn't heard about your prowess before, [player name].
translation: Senin yeteneklerini daha önce duymamis olmama sasirdim, Maceraci.

english: Ah you know me, the most modest adventurer in Gielinor.
translation: Ah, beni bilirsin, Gielinor'un en mütevazi maceracisiyim.

english: Ah, well I suppose I should pack it in while I'm ahead.
But we should do this again.
Aye we should! Also if you could get the word out about my establishment, I'll be raking it in!
translation: Evet, yapmaliyiz! Ayrica, benim mekanimi herkese duyurursan, cok para kazanacagim!

english: I mean... The Rabbit Hole will enjoy all the visitors?
translation: Yani... Rabbit Hole tüm ziyaretcileri agirlayacak mi?

english: Well, anyway...
It was a close match. How are you feeling now?
translation: Yakin bir macti. Simdi nasil hissediyorsun?

english: Oh it was fun but I think I'm just going to sit in the Rabbit Hole a bit longer.
translation: Oh, eglenceliydi ama sanirim Rabbit Hole'da biraz daha oturacagim.

english: I should be off. Always a pleasure, Bowley.
translation: Gitmeliyim. Her zaman bir zevk, Bowley.

english: Aye, till next time.
I feel less horrible I suppose...
translation: Sanirim kendimi daha az berbat hissediyorum...

english: Well, that's a start!
Hey Bunny, would you like a fancy carrot?
translation: Hey Bunny, süslü bir havuc ister misin?

english: Not really, I've eaten a lot of carrots recently.
translation: Hayir, son zamanlarda cok havuc yedim.

english: They're really good.
I'm alright, thank you though.
Oh, hello again, [player name].
Hello! I have a surprise for you.
Oh? A surprise? It's not something horrible I hope.
translation: Sürpriz mi? Umarim korkunc bir sey degildir.

english: Oh no, it's something quite delicious actually.
translation: Hayir, aslinda cok lezzetli bir sey.

english: Delicious?
A lovely mug of carrot juice!
Oh please no more!
Don't worry, this is fancy carrot juice. I made it myself with some fantastic carrots.
translation: Merak etme, bu özel havuc suyu. Harika havuclarla kendim yaptim.

english: You made it? Well in that case I suppose I might give it a try. As long as Wheeler hasn't been near it.
translation: Sen mi yaptin? Öyleyse bir deneyeyim. Wheeler ona dokunmamissa tabii.

english: I made sure of that. Go on!
Here we go then...
Oh...
Oh my...
Wow!
That was delicious, nothing like the usual slop.
translation: Cok lezzetliydi, her zamanki corba gibi degildi.

english: Thank you, [player name], I really needed that.
translation: Tesekkürler, Maceraci, buna gercekten ihtiyacim vardi.

english: You're welcome!
How are you feeling now? Any better?
translation: Simdi nasil hissediyorsun? Daha iyi misin?

english: Hmm... I'm feeling a bit more hopeful. Like spring is about to, well, spring! But I'm not sure if Easter is really my thing any more.
translation: Hmm... Biraz daha umutlu hissediyorum. Sanki bahar gelmek üzereymis gibi! Ama artik Paskalya'nin benim icin bir anlami olup olmadigindan emin degilim.

english: I'm sure I can help you remember how wonderful it is.
translation: Ne kadar harika oldugunu hatirlamana yardimci olabilecegime eminim.

english: Hmmm... I should check in with Eggus before I give one of these buns to the Easter Bunny. Quality control or something.
translation: Hmmm... Bu cöreklerden birini Paskalya Tavsanina vermeden önce Eggus'a danismaliyim. Kalite kontrol falan icin.

english: Hello...
Hi! I'm back with an Easter treat, just for you.
translation: Selam! Senin icin Paskalya hediyesi getirdim.

english: Huh?
It's something special.
Special eh? Why would you give me something special?
translation: Özel mi? Neden bana özel bir sey veriyorsun?

english: Because you deserve it.
I don't know if I deserve anything.
Of course you do!
Here, it's an Easter bun. Fresh out of the oven.
translation: Al, bu bir Paskalya cöregi. Firindan yeni cikti.

english: An Easter bun? I like those!
Yum! That was lovely. Thanks, [player name].
You're a good friend.
You are most welcome. Do you feel a bit more Easter- ey now?
translation: Rica ederim. Simdi biraz daha Paskalya havasina girdin mi?

english: Oh, I'm starting to remember now! Easter is great! But I just... Hmm, I don't know...
translation: Oh, simdi hatirlamaya basladim! Paskalya harika! Ama ben sadece... Hmm, bilmiyorum...

english: I feel like I need one more little treat before I do anything to help with Easter.
translation: Paskalya icin bir seyler yapmadan önce bir kücük ikram daha almam gerektigini hissediyorum.

english: Oh for goodness sake...
Alright, let me think of something.
Excuse me, [player name], I believe I can help you.
translation: Affedersin, Maceraci, sanirim sana yardimci olabilirim.

english: Oh?
Come here!
I couldn't help overhearing that you're trying to cheer up the Easter Bunny, and I have an idea.
translation: Paskalya Tavsanini neselendirmeye calistigini duydum ve bir fikrim var.

english: Well that's sort of nosey, but go on.
translation: Bu biraz meraklica ama devam et.

english: Let's put on a performance! that will cheer him up.
A performance?
Yes! He's always enjoyed a good show.
translation: Evet! O her zaman iyi gösterileri sever.

english: Well I suppose that could work...
I have some classic material we can try if that sounds appropriate?
translation: Uygun olursa deneyebilecegimiz bazi klasik malzemelerim var.

english: I don't see why not.
Excellent! I've already talked to some of the other fellows in here about it too. They seem keen!
translation: Harika! Buradaki diger arkadaslarla da bu konuyu konustum. Çok hevesliler görünüyorlar!

english: I wonder how Fry is getting on with that performance...
What was that?
Oh, nothing. I just need to talk to Fry about something.
translation: Oh, hicbir sey. Fry ile konusmam gereken bir sey var.

english: Oh, see you later then.
One more treat and I'll be ready to work on Easter again.
translation: Bir tane daha ikram alayim, sonra Paskalya icin calismaya hazir olacagim.

english: ANOTHER treat?
The last one!
It better be.
That dance was amazing! Well done. I feel so... Invigorated!
translation: Dansin muhtesemdi! Aferin. Kendimi cok... Canlanmis hissediyorum!

english: Lawks! Look at the time, I should get back to Varrock to set up the Eggs!
translation: Tanrim! Saate bak, Varrock'a dönüp yumurtalari hazirlamam lazim!

english: See you up there!
You need [1-5] free inventory [slots/slot] to receive your Easter event rewards.
translation: Paskalya etkinligi ödüllerini almak icin [1-5] bos envanter [yeri/yeri] gerekir.

english: I have something fun for you, [player name]!
translation: Senin icin eglenceli bir seyim var, Maceraci!

english: Come back when you have more space.
translation: Daha fazla yerin oldugunda geri gel.

english: Thanks for saving our bacon and eggs again, [player name]!
translation: Yine bizi kurtardigin icin tesekkürler, Maceraci!

english: You've completed the Easter event: One glum bunny
translation: Paskalya etkinligini tamamladin: Bir kasvetli tavsan

english: Oh it's always my pleasure to get these delicious eggs!
translation: Bu lezzetli yumurtalari almak her zaman benim icin bir zevktir!

english: I mean... to help out a friend in need!
translation: Yani... ihtiyaci olan bir arkadasima yardim etmek!

english: Isn't it strange something always happens around this time of year that needs me to come and save the day?
translation: Yilin bu zamanlarinda her zaman benim gelip günü kurtarmami gerektiren bir seylerin olmasi garip degil mi?

english: Oh really? I don't keep track, so much to do around now.
translation: Gercekten mi? Takip etmiyorum, su anda yapacak cok isim var.

english: Oh well, I expect I'll be seeing you again next year.
translation: Neyse, sanirim gelecek yil tekrar görüsürüz.

english: Yes, till neggxt year!
Would you please stop [player name], I'tsvery hard to rush back here so fast.
translation: Lütfen dur Maceraci, buraya bu kadar hizli gelmek cok zor.

english: You're coming back here, whenever I do?
translation: Ben geldigimde sen de buraya mi geliyorsun?

english: Precisely, so we'd all appreciate it if you didn't.
translation: Aynen öyle, bu yüzden gelmezsen hepimiz minnettar oluruz.

english: But why?
Who knows what you'd get up to down here on your own.
translation: Burada tek basina ne yapacagini kim bilir.

english: Yes.
No.
Where do I get the Dried cocoa?
Where do I get the bottle of Hosidius milk?
Where do I get the Special spices?
Goodbye.
The Easter Bunny is looking awfully glum this year.
translation: Paskalya Tavsani bu yil cok üzgün görünüyor.

english: Happy Easter!
And to you!
Thanks for your help!  You should have a break now.  Come back in [number] minutes if you want to hand out more eggs.
But I'm afraid I've left things a bit late this year.  I'm going to need some help to get all these eggs delivered!  Would you help me, [player name]?
translation: Ama korkarim bu yil isleri biraz gec biraktim.  Tüm bu yumurtalari dagitmak icin yardima ihtiyacim olacak!  Bana yardim eder misin, Maceraci?

english: Yes, of course.
Oh dear, you don't have any free inventory space.  Talk to me again when you have.
translation: Oh hayir, bos envanter alanin yok.  Bos alanin oldugunda tekrar benimle konus.

english: Splendid, splendid!  Here's a basket of eggs.  Hand out as many as you can before they disappear and then come back to me.  You've only got two minutes!
translation: Harika, harika!  Iste bir sepet yumurta.  Kaybolmadan önce dagitabildigin kadar dagit ve sonra bana geri dön.  Sadece iki dakikan var!

english: Splendid, splendid!  Here's a basket of eggs.  Hand out as many as you can before they disappear and then come back to me for your reward.  You've only got two minutes!
translation: Harika, harika!  Iste bir sepet yumurta.  Kaybolmadan önce dagitabildigin kadar dagit ve sonra ödülünü almak icin bana geri dön.  Sadece iki dakikan var!

english: No.
Oh dear oh dear!  I've got to hurry!
translation: Oh hayir, oh hayir! Acele etmeliyim!

english: Quickly, [player name]!  Hand out those eggs before they vanish!
Oh dear, [player name]. You didn't hand out any eggs at all! Do you want to try again?
translation: Oh hayir, Maceraci. Hic yumurta dagitmadin! Tekrar denemek ister misin?

english: Thank you, [player name]!  You handed out [number] eggs!
Thank you, [player name]!  You handed out [number] eggs!  Here is your Easter reward!
If you lose it, you can get another one from Diango in Draynor.
translation: Kaybedersen, Draynor'daki Diango'dan bir tane daha alabilirsin.

english: Yes, of course
No
Leave us to our fate. We care nothing for the world that betrayed us, or those that come from it.
translation: Bizi kaderimize birak. Bizi ihanet eden dünyayi ya da o dünyadan gelenleri umursamiyoruz.

english: Hello. I represent the Museum of Varrock, and I have reason to believe there may be some kinds of artefacts of historical significance in the nearby area...
translation: Merhaba. Varrock Müzesi'ni temsil ediyorum ve yakinlarda tarihi önemi olan bazi eserler olabilecegine inanmak icin nedenlerim var...

english: Ah yes. The only time people care about our existence is when they think they have something to gain from us.
translation: Ah evet. Insanlar bizim varligimizi ancak bizden bir sey kazanabileceklerini düsündüklerinde önemsiyorlar.

english: I have nothing to say to you. You and your kind are not welcome here.
translation: Sana söyleyecek hicbir seyim yok. Sen ve senin gibiler burada hos karsilanmiyorsunuz.

english: Please, if I can just have a few minutes of your time to ask some questions...?
translation: Lütfen, birkac dakika vaktini ayirip birkac soru sorabilir miyim?

english: (sigh) I suppose I can spare you that. What do you wish to know about?
translation: (ic cekis) Sanirim sana bu kadarini verebilirim. Ne hakkinda bilgi almak istiyorsun?

english: Why are all of the people here so hostile? You would think I was asking you for money instead of just for answers to a few questions...
translation: Buradaki insanlar neden bu kadar düsmanca davraniyor? Sanki birkac soru sormak yerine senden para istiyormusum gibi davraniyorsun...

english: It is a long story, and I doubt you have much interest in hearing it. Your sort never are, you just take what you can of ours, and then abandon us once more to the desert.
translation: Bu uzun bir hikaye ve senin bunu dinlemek isteyecegini sanmiyorum. Senin gibiler asla dinlemek istemez, sadece bizden alabileceklerini alirlar ve sonra bizi bir kez daha cöle terk ederler.

english: Actually, I'd be quite interested to hear what it is you have to say to excuse the attitude everybody in this village seems to have.
translation: Aslinda, bu köydeki herkesin sergiledigi tavri mazur göstermek icin ne söyleyeceginizi duymak oldukca ilgimi ceker.

english: Ah, it all begun many generations ago, when our ancestors were the proud rulers of these lands...
translation: Ah, her sey bircok nesil önce, atalarimiz bu topraklarin gururlu hükümdarlariyken basladi...

english: My ancestors lived far to the North of here, and our lands stretched from the sea in the East to the river Lum, and the mountain of ice. From coast to coast, North to South, our domain was absolute.
translation: Atalarim buradan cok kuzeyde yasiyordu ve topraklarimiz dogudaki denizden Lum nehrine ve buz dagina kadar uzaniyordu. Kiyidan kiyiya, kuzeyden güneye, egemenligimiz mutlak idi.

english: Our god was kind to us, and blessed us with prosperity and happiness, and in return we were merciless to his enemies wherever we found them.
translation: Tanrimiz bize karsi iyiydi ve bizi refah ve mutlulukla kutsadi, karsiliginda biz de onun düsmanlarina karsi acimasiz davrandik.

english: Then came the betrayal.
Our god was banished, leaving us helpless to our fates.
translation: Tanrimiz sürgün edildi ve bizi kaderimize terk etti.

english: Without his protection, we were forced to fend for ourselves once more, against the enemies that sought to destroy us through their petty jealousies.
translation: Onun korumasi olmadan, bizi kücük kiskancliklariyla yok etmeye calisan düsmanlara karsi bir kez daha kendimizi savunmak zorunda kaldik.

english: But we did not succumb without fighting! The spiteful Saradomin and pathetic Zamorak warred with each other, but the hatred they had for each other was as nothing to the hatred they held towards us!
translation: Ama biz savasmadan teslim olmadik! Kinci Saradomin ve acinasi Zamorak birbirleriyle savastilar, ama birbirlerine duyduklari nefret, bize duyduklari nefrete kiyasla hicbir seydi!

english: With each battle they waged, we lost more and more land, unable to fight on all fronts, and were pushed further and further South into this gods-forsaken desert.
translation: Onlarin her savasinda, tüm cephelerde savasamayarak giderek daha fazla toprak kaybettik ve bu tanrilar tarafindan terk edilmis cöle dogru giderek daha da güneye itildik.

english: Our greatest hero, Azzanadra, was finally trapped in a strange stone structure to the South of here, and bound within by terrible powers...
translation: En büyük kahramanimiz Azzanadra, sonunda buradan güneyde garip bir tas yapinin icinde hapsoldu ve korkunc gücler tarafindan baglandi...

english: And with that our lands, our homes, our very lives were stolen from us! Too weak to reclaim what was rightfully ours, we made our homes here, knowing that someday Azzanadra will
translation: Ve böylece topraklarimiz, evlerimiz, hayatlarimiz bizden calindi! Hak ettigimiz seyi geri almak icin cok zayif oldugumuzdan, bir gün Azzanadra'nin muhtesem gücüyle geri dönecegini ve bizi eski ihtisamimiza kavusturacagini bilerek buraya yerlestik...

english: return with his magnificent power, and bring us back to our former glory...
translation: Yani yüzlerce yil önce olan bir sey yüzünden üzgün müsün?

english: So you're upset because of something that happened hundreds of years ago?
translation: Yani yüzlerce yil önce olan bir sey yüzünden mi üzgünsün?

english: Seems to me like maybe you should find some closure, and let the past go...
translation: Bana kalirsa, bunu kapatip gecmisi geride birakmalisin...

english: The insults heaped upon my race will never be forgotten, will never be forgiven and will never again be overlooked.
translation: Irkima yapilan hakaretler asla unutulmayacak, asla affedilmeyecek ve bir daha asla göz ardi edilmeyecek.

english: Someday, a harsh wind will blow upon this land, uncovering the wrongs of the past, and we will get back what is rightfully ours. Until such a day we will bide our time here, and will
translation: Bir gün, bu topraklara sert bir rüzgar esecek, gecmisteki yanlislari ortaya cikaracak ve hak ettigimiz seyi geri alacagiz. O gün gelene kadar burada zamanimizi bekleyecegiz ve

english: always be ready with our blades for our righteous vengeance.
translation: hakli intikamimiz icin kiliclarimizla her zaman hazir olacagiz.

english: I don't really care what your story is to be honest, there is no excuse for such rudeness or hostility.
translation: Dürüst olmak gerekirse, hikayeniz umurumda degil, böyle bir kabalik ve düsmanligin mazereti olamaz.

english: I have done nothing wrong to you, but everybody here treats me like I have committed some great crime against the village.
translation: Size hicbir kötülük yapmadim, ama buradaki herkes bana köye karsi büyük bir suc islemisim gibi davraniyor.

english: That is because, from our point of view, you have.
What? Just because I entered your village?
translation: Ne? Sadece köyünüze girdigim icin mi?

english: You have no right to be here! You have no right to the life you have, for it was taken at our expense!
translation: Burada olmaya hakkin yok! Sahip oldugun hayata hakkin yok, cünkü o hayat bizim pahasina alindi!

english: Whatever... No wonder all you loonies live out here in the desert by yourselves.
translation: Her neyse... Siz delilerin cölde tek basiniza yasamaniza sasmamali.

english: I was wondering if you knew anything about some treasure somewhere around here?
translation: Buralarda bir hazine olup olmadigini biliyor musun?

english: I have some evidence that there might be some kind of treasure hidden very close to this village...
translation: Bu köyün cok yakininda bir hazine olabilecegine dair bazi kanitlarim var...

english: If I knew of any treasure I would not choose to spend my life in this gods-forsaken desert.
translation: Eger bir hazine oldugunu bilseydim, hayatimi bu tanrinin unuttugu cölde gecirmeyi tercih etmezdim.

english: Do you know anything about some kind of fortress nearby? I have reason to believe there is, or at least used to be, some kind of fortress very close to here...
translation: Yakinlarda bir kale hakkinda bir sey biliyor musun? Buraya cok yakin bir yerde bir kale oldugunu, ya da en azindan eskiden oldugunu düsünmek icin nedenlerim var...

english: Nobody would build anything in this wasteland unless they were forced to, to survive.
translation: Kimse hayatta kalmak icin mecbur kalmadikca bu corak arazide bir sey insa etmez.

english: I know of no fortress, I know of no reason why anyone would ever bother doing anything out here in the desert.
translation: Benim bildigim bir kale yok, kimsenin bu cölde bir sey yapmaya zahmet edecegini sanmiyorum.

english: Actually, there was nothing I really wanted to ask you about.
translation: Aslinda, sana sormak istedigim bir sey yoktu.

english: Yes, it is exactly like your sort to waste my time in such a way.
translation: Evet, benim zamanimi böyle bosa harcamak tam senin tarzin.

english: (above)
So tell me... Did you ever hear of something called the Diamonds of Azzanadra?
translation: Söylesene... Azzanadra'nin Elmaslari diye bir sey duydun mu hic?

english: This is the treasure which you seek???
Please accept my apologies! I thought you were but some opportunistic thief, looking to steal what heritage we have left! Now I see that you are in fact a brave adventurer,
translation: Lütfen özürlerimi kabul edin! Sizi, kalan mirasimizi calmak isteyen firsatci bir hirsiz sandim! Simdi görüyorum ki, siz aslinda cesur bir maceracisiniz,

english: looking to restore our glories back upon us!
translation: bize eski ihtisamimizi geri kazandirmak istiyorsunuz!

english: Uh... yeah... So anyway, you have heard of them?
Heard of them? Of course I have heard of them! They are the legacy of the great Mahjarrat hero, Azzanadra!
translation: Duydum mu? Tabii ki duydum! Onlar, büyük Mahjarrat kahramani Azzanadra'nin mirasi!

english: So... do you have any idea where they might be? I have a feeling they will be very valuable.
translation: Peki... nerede olabilecekleri hakkinda bir fikrin var mi? Cok degerli olduklarini hissediyorum.

english: Uh, valuable as historical artefacts I mean, obviously.
translation: Uh, tarihi eserler olarak degerli olduklarini kastediyorum, tabii ki.

english: They were stolen by warriors of the false god Zamorak generations ago. When you find the warriors, you will find the diamonds.
translation: Onlar, nesiller önce sahte tanri Zamorak'in savascilari tarafindan calindi. Savascilari buldugunda, elmaslari da bulacaksin.

english: I suspect they will not willingly part with such objects of power however.
translation: Ancak, bu kadar güclü nesneleri isteyerek birakmayacaklarini saniyorum.

english: Beware too, for these warriors are very powerful; they have taken the powers of the diamonds into themselves!
translation: Dikkatli ol, cünkü bu savascilar cok güclü; elmaslarin güclerini kendilerine aktardilar!

english: How do you mean?
Each diamond has an elemental quality...
translation: Her elmasin bir element özelligi var...

english: There is the Diamond of Blood, the Diamond of Ice, the Diamond of Smoke and the Diamond of Shadow.
translation: Kan Elmasi, Buz Elmasi, Duman Elmasi ve Gölge Elmasi var.

english: You should expect the warriors to have taken some aspect of these diamonds as their own...
translation: Savascilarin bu elmaslarin bazi özelliklerini kendilerine aktardiklarini düsünmelisin...

english: Do you have any idea how I could track down these warriors somehow, then?
translation: O zaman bu savascilari nasil bulabilecegimi biliyor musun?

english: There is an ancient spell I know of that may spy upon such power... But it will require a few ingredients for it to work.
translation: Böyle bir gücü gözetleyebilecek eski bir büyü biliyorum... Ama ise yaramasi icin birkac malzeme gerekiyor.

english: Should you be willing to get these ingredients for me, I will be able to locate the rough area where each of these warriors has taken refuge. The spell is imprecise, but it should help you get on the
translation: Bu malzemeleri benim icin bulursan, bu savascilarin sigindigi bölgenin yaklasik yerini tespit edebilecegim. Büyü kesin sonuc vermez, ama aramanda

english: right track in your search.
translation: dogru yola girmen icin yardimci olacaktir.

english: Is your desire for our freedom strong enough? Will you gather the ingredients for this spell for me?
translation: Özgürlügümüz icin arzun yeterince güclü mü? Bu büyü icin gerekli malzemeleri benim icin toplayacak misin?

english: Sure, what do you need?
For this spell, I will need to make some scrying glasses. I will need enough so that we can view the realm in its entirety.
translation: Bu büyü icin, bazi kristal küreler yapmam gerekecek. Kralligi bütünüyle görebilmemiz icin yeterli sayida kristal küreye ihtiyacim olacak.

english: When enchanted, the scrying glass will be able to let us view any area that has been influenced by the presence of the Diamonds of Azzanadra.
translation: Büyü yapildiginda, kristal küreler Azzanadra Elmaslarinin etkisi altindaki her alani görmemizi saglayacak.

english: Okay, but what exactly do you need for this spell?
translation: Tamam, ama bu büyü icin tam olarak neye ihtiyacin var?

english: Well, six scrying glasses should be sufficient. For each scrying glass, I will need two magic logs, a steel bar and some molten glass. This makes a total of 12 magic logs, 6 pieces of molten
translation: Alti tane kristal küre yeterli olacaktir. Her kristal küre icin iki tane sihirli kütük, bir tane celik cubuk ve biraz erimis cam gerekecek. Toplamda 12 tane sihirli kütük, 6 tane erimis

english: glass, and 6 steel bars.
translation: cam ve 6 tane celik cubuk gerekecek.

english: In addition, for the actual spell to enchant the glasses, I will require one set of normal bones, some ash, some charcoal and a single blood rune.
translation: Ayrica, küreleri büyülü hale getirmek icin bir set normal kemik, biraz kül, biraz odun kömürü ve tek bir kan runesi gerekecek.

english: Do you understand me, adventurer?
Quick question; what kind of bones do you need?
translation: Hizli bir soru; ne tür kemiklere ihtiyacin var?

english: Standard bones. Other types of bones are of no use to me in this spell.
translation: Standart kemikler. Diger tür kemikler bu büyünün yapiminda bana bir fayda saglamaz.

english: Yes, I will go get those for you.
translation: Evet, gidip onlari senin icin getirecegim.

english: Before I can complete the spell I will still need the following items;
translation: Büyüyü tamamlamadan önce su esyalara ihtiyacim var:

english: 12 magic logs 6 steel bars 6 molten glass
translation: 12 sihirli kütük, 6 celik cubuk, 6 erimis cam,

english: 1 bones, 1 ashes, 1 charcoal and 1 blood rune.
translation: 1 kemik, 1 kül, 1 kömür ve 1 kan runesi.

english: Actually I don't feel like going on a shopping trip for you right now.
translation: Aslinda su anda senin icin alisverise cikmak istemiyorum.

english: As you wish. I should have known not to get my hopes up that our long cursed life may soon be at an end...
translation: Nasil istersen. Uzun süredir lanetli hayatimizin yakinda sona erecegi umudunu beslememem gerektigini bilmeliydim...

english: So have you spoken to my Lord Azzanadra yet?
translation: Peki, Lord Azzanadra ile konustun mu?

english: Yes I have.
And what words did he have for his followers?
Er.... He didn't really mention you at all, but he did teach me some cool new magic spells.
translation: Sey... Senden hic bahsetmedi, ama bana bazi harika yeni büyüleri ögretti.

english: It is understandable perhaps... His poor mind must be addled after all of those years of confinement, he would not willingly ignore his followers...
translation: Belki de anlasilabilir bir durum... Onca yil hapis hayatindan sonra zihni karismis olmali, takipcilerini isteyerek görmezden gelmez...

english: Anyway, if he has taught you our ancient magics, you may be interested in purchasing an ancient heirloom that was passed down to me. My ancestor fought in the ancient battles using the
translation: Her neyse, sana eski büyülerimizi ögrettiyse, bana miras kalan eski bir yadigari satin almak isteyebilirsin. Atalarim eski savaslarda tanrimizin büyüsünü kullanarak savasmislar.

english: magic of our god. This heirloom will help you with the speed of your spell- casting.
translation: Bu yadigâr, büyü yapma hizini artiracaktir.

english: Normally I could not bear to part with such a priceless relic, but for your help in freeing my Lord Azzanadra, I will be prepared to sell it to you for a mere 80,000 gold.
translation: Normalde böyle paha bicilmez bir kalintidan ayrilmaya dayanamazdim, ama Lord Azzanadra'yi kurtarmama yardim ettigin icin, sana sadece 80.000 altin karsiliginda satmaya hazirim.

english: Are you interested?
Yes please.
Stranger... Do not abuse my generosity... I cannot possibly sell it for less than 80,000 gold.
translation: Yabanci... Cömertligimi suistimal etme... 80.000 altindan daha ucuza satamam.

english: Come back and see me when you have the necessary funds to buy.
translation: Satin almak icin gerekli parayi buldugunda tekrar gelip beni gör.

english: Take care of it, it is the only heirloom from those times I possess, although rumour has it many of our ancient warriors were buried with identical weapons so that they could continue to fight for my Lord in their deaths.
translation: Ona iyi bak, o zamanlardan kalan tek yadigarimdir, ancak söylentilere göre eski savascilarimizin cogu, ölümlerinde de Lordum icin savasmaya devam edebilmek icin ayni silahlarla gömüldüler.

english: No thanks.
As you wish. Bear my offer in mind should you ever change your decision, I will remain here.
translation: Nasil istersen. Kararini degistirirsen teklifimi unutma, ben burada olacagim.

english: Hello again.
Greetings!
I found this weird icon. Do you know what it is?
translation: Bu garip simgeyi buldum. Ne oldugunu biliyor musun?

english: Fascinating... I've never seen anything like this before, but the magic contained within is unmistakable. I wonder...
translation: Büyüleyici... Daha önce böyle bir sey görmedim, ama icindeki sihir cok acik. Merak ediyorum...

english: Wonder what?
Stranger, if you were to bring me an Ancient staff, I believe it would be possible to combine it with this icon to create a powerful new weapon.
translation: Yabanci, bana eski bir asa getirirsen, bu simgeyle birlestirerek güclü yeni bir silah yaratabilecegimizi düsünüyorum.

english: That sounds pretty neat.
Then return to me when you have the staff.
translation: O zaman asayi buldugunda bana geri dön.

english: I see you have the staff with you. Would you like me to combine your Ancient staff with the icon to create an Ancient sceptre? You won't be able to separate them once this is done.
translation: Asayi yanina almissin. Eski asani simgeyle birlestirip Eski bir asa yaratmami ister misin? Bunu yaptiktan sonra ikisini ayiramazsin.

english: Yes, please!
There you go. Wield its power responsibly, stranger...
translation: Al bakalim. Gücünü sorumlu bir sekilde kullan, yabanci...

english: No, thanks.
Suit yourself.
Have you got any symbols of your god?
I'll leave you to it.
Why is this village so hostile?
translation: Bu köy neden bu kadar düsmanca?

english: No, I want to hear this story.
I don't care about your story.
Do you know anything about treasure near here?
translation: Buralarda bir hazine hakkinda bir sey biliyor musun?

english: Do you know anything about a fortress near here?
translation: Buralarda bir kale hakkinda bir sey biliyor musun?

english: Nothing thanks.
Tell me of The four diamonds of Azzanadra
Yes
No, please repeat those ingredients.
No
Yes please.
No thanks.
Have you got any symbols of your god?
I found this weird icon. Do you know what it is?
translation: Bu garip simgeyi buldum. Ne oldugunu biliyor musunuz?

english: Yes, please!
No, thanks.
I'll leave you to it.
Yes? Can I help you?
What are you up to?
I'm looking after the mill. It's quite an important job, so if you'll excuse me...
translation: Degirmeni bakiyorum. Oldukça önemli bir is, bu yüzden izin verirsen...

english: Your echo boots have [number] charges remaining.
Your echo boots have [number] charges remaining. They are currently inactive.
You activate your echo boots.
You deactivate your echo boots.
Yes.
No.
Hello.
Hello friend.
What are you doing here?
I'm looking for a helmet. I know it's buried somewhere.
translation: Bir kask ariyorum. Bir yerlerde gömülü oldugunu biliyorum.

english: And you think that somewhere is here?
translation: Ve o yerin burasi oldugunu mu düsünüyorsun?

english: I don't know. I've tried everywhere else so it might be.
translation: Bilmiyorum. Diger her yeri denedim, bu yüzden burasi olabilir.

english: Maybe you're missing something important.
translation: Belki de önemli bir seyi gözden kaciriyorsun.

english: Maybe you're right. I just don't know anymore.
That's a nice outfit.
Thank you. I just wish I had the helmet to go with it.
translation: Tesekkürler. Keske ona uygun bir kaskim olsaydi.

english: Hey your hair is on fire!
Get out of it!
Goodbye.
See you later.
That helmet! Where did you get it?
I found it.
Where?
I can't tell you that. It would ruin the fun. You'll have to work it out for yourself.
translation: Sana söyleyemem. Eglenceyi bozar. Kendin bulmalisin.

english: Arhhh!
Hello again friend.
What are you doing all the way over here?
I gave up on the last one. Who cares about that one, anyway?
translation: Sonuncusunu biraktim. Zaten kim takar onu?

english: I guess...
That's a nice set of armour.
So much nicer than the garb I had before, right?
translation: Eskisine göre cok daha güzel, degil mi?

english: I just wish I had the helmet to go with it.
translation: Keske ona uygun bir kaskim olsaydi.

english: Agh, not again!
What are you doing here?
That's a nice outfit.
Hey your hair is on fire!
Goodbye.
What are you doing all the way over here?
That's a nice set of armour.
Can't stop. Too busy.
Wonder when I'll get paid.
Is it lunch break yet?
Hey I'm working here. I'm working here.
This work isn't going to do itself.
Ouch! That was my finger!
I'll be charging overtime, then!
translation: O zaman fazla mesai ücreti alacagim!

english: Hello old man.
Sorry, I can't stop to talk...
Why, what's wrong?
I've got to find my daughter. I pray that she is still alive...
translation: Kizimi bulmam lazim. Hala hayatta oldugunu umuyorum...

english: What's happened to her?
Elena's a healer. Three weeks ago she managed to cross the wall into West Ardougne. No one's allowed to cross the wall in case they spread the plague.
translation: Elena bir sifaci. Üc hafta önce duvari gecip Bati Ardougne'a ulasmayi basardi. Veba yayilmasin diye kimse duvari gecemez.

english: Plague?
Not that long ago, West Ardougne was hit by a deadly plague. They had the wall built to try and keep it contained. No one is allowed to enter the city now apart from the mourners.
translation: Kisa bir süre önce Bati Ardougne ölümcül bir salginla vuruldu. Salgini kontrol altinda tutmak icin duvar ördüler. Artik yas tutanlar disinda kimse sehre giremiyor.

english: They say the plague is a horrible way to go... That's why Elena felt she had to go help. She said she'd be gone for a few days but we've heard nothing since.
translation: Salginin korkunc bir sekilde öldürdügünü söylüyorlar... Bu yüzden Elena yardim etmek zorunda hissetti. Birkac günlügüne gidecegini söyledi ama o zamandan beri haber alamadik.

english: Maybe I could help find her?
Really, would you? I've been working on a plan to get into West Ardougne, but I'm too old and tired to carry it through. But you on the other hand, you should have no problem.
translation: Gercekten mi? West Ardougne'a girmek icin bir plan yapiyordum ama yasli ve yorgunum, bunu gerceklestiremem. Ama sen, senin icin sorun olmaz.

english: Where should I start?
If you're going into West Ardougne you'll need protection from the plague. My wife made a special gas mask for Elena with dwellberries rubbed into it.
translation: West Ardougne'a gideceksen, vebadan korunman gerekir. Karim, Elena icin dwellberry sürülmüs özel bir gaz maskesi yapti.

english: They help to repel the plague apparently. We need some more though...
translation: Görünüse göre vebayi uzaklastirmaya yardimci oluyorlar. Ama biraz daha lazim...

english: Where can I find these dwellberries?
The only place I know of is McGrubor's Wood, just west of Seers' Village. The berries are bright blue so they're easy to spot.
translation: Bildigim tek yer, Seers Köyü'nün batisindaki McGrubor Ormani. Meyveler parlak mavi oldugu icin kolayca fark edilirler.

english: Okay, I'll go and get some.
The foresters keep a close eye on it, but there is a back way in.
translation: Ormancilar orayi yakindan takip ediyorlar ama arka taraftan girilebiliyor.

english: On second thoughts, I'd better not.
translation: Bir daha düsündüm de, gitmesem daha iyi.

english: Well if you hear anything about Elena please tell me.
translation: Elena hakkinda bir sey duyarsan lütfen bana haber ver.

english: I will. Goodbye.
Well, good luck finding her.
Hello Edmond.
Have you got the dwellberries yet?
Sorry, I'm afraid not.
You'll probably find them in McGrubor's Wood, just west of Seers' Village. The berries are bright blue so they're easy to spot.
translation: Seers Köyü'nün batisindaki McGrubor Ormani'nda bulabilirsin. Meyveler parlak mavi oldugu icin kolayca fark edilir.

english: Yes I've got some here.
Take them to my wife Alrena, she's inside.
Hi Edmond, I've got the gas mask now.
Good stuff, now for the digging. Beneath us are the Ardougne sewers. I've done some research, and I reckon you can use them to access to West Ardougne.
translation: Güzel, simdi kazmaya baslayalim. Altimizda Ardougne kanalizasyonlari var. Biraz arastirma yaptim ve bunlari West Ardougne'a ulasmak icin kullanabilecegini düsünüyorum.

english: I've already tried digging down to them but the soil is rock hard. You'll need to pour on several buckets of water to soften it up. I reckon four buckets should do it.
translation: Ben zaten kazmayi denedim ama toprak kaya gibi sert. Yumusatmak icin birkac kova su dökmen gerekecek. Dört kova yeterli olur sanirim.

english: How's it going?
I still need to pour four more buckets of water on the soil.
translation: Topraga dört kova su daha dökmem gerekiyor.

english: I still need to pour three more buckets of water on the soil.
translation: Topraga üc kova su daha dökmem gerekiyor.

english: I still need to pour two more buckets of water on the soil.
translation: Topraga iki kova su daha dökmem gerekiyor.

english: Player: I still need to pour one more bucket of water on the soil.
translation: Oyuncu: Topraga bir kova su daha dökmem gerekiyor.

english: I've soaked the soil with water.
That's great, it should be soft enough to dig through now. There should be a spade nearby that you can use.
translation: Harika, artik kazmak icin yeterince yumusamis olmali. Yakinlarda kullanabilecegin bir kürek olmali.

english: I think it's the pipe to the south that comes up in West Ardougne.
translation: Sanirim West Ardougne'da ortaya cikan güneydeki boru.

english: Alright I'll check it out.
Edmond, I can't get through to West Ardougne! There's an iron grill blocking my way, I can't pull it off alone.
translation: Edmond, West Ardougne'a gecemiyorum! Yolumda demir bir izgara var, tek basima kaldiramiyorum.

english: If you get some rope you could tie to the grill, then we could both pull it at the same time.
translation: Biraz ip bulursan izgaraya baglayabiliriz, sonra ikimiz birlikte cekebiliriz.

english: I've tied a rope to the grill over there, will you help me pull it off?
translation: Oradaki izgaraya bir ip bagladim, cekmeme yardim eder misin?

english: Alright, let's get to it...
The player and Edmond pull on the rope, opening the grill on the pipe.
translation: Oyuncu ve Edmond ipi cekerek borudaki izgarayi acarlar.

english: Once you're in the city look for a man called Jethick. He's an old friend of the family. Hopefully he can help you.
translation: Sehre girdiginde Jethick adinda bir adami ara. O ailemizin eski bir dostudur. Umarim sana yardimci olabilir.

english: Alright, thanks I will.
I can't let you enter the city without your gas mask on.
Hello.
Have you found Elena yet?
Not yet, it's a big city over there.
translation: Henüz bulamadim, orasi büyük bir sehir.

english: I hope it's not too late.
Not yet, it's a big city over there. Do you have a picture of Elena?
translation: Henüz bulamadim, orasi büyük bir sehir. Elena'nin bir fotografi var mi?

english: There should be a picture of Elena in the house. Please find her quickly, I hope it's not too late.
translation: Evde Elena'nin bir fotografi olmali. Lütfen onu cabuk bul, umarim cok gec kalmamissindir.

english: Thank you, thank you! Elena beat you back by minutes. Now I said I'd give you a reward. What can I give you as a reward I wonder? Here take this magic scroll, I have little use for it but it may help you.
translation: Tesekkürler, tesekkürler! Elena senden birkac dakika önce geri döndü. Sana bir ödül verecegimi söylemistim. Sana ne verebilirim acaba? Al bu sihirli parsömeni, benim pek isime yaramiyor ama sana yardimci olabilir.

english: Congratulations! Quest complete!
Now I'd recommend you go and see Elena. She'll want to thank you herself. She lives in the house opposite ours.
translation: Simdi gidip Elena'yi görmeni tavsiye ederim. Sana kendisi tesekkür etmek isteyecektir. Bizim evin karsisindaki evde yasiyor.

english: Hello there.
Ah hello. Thank you again for rescuing my daughter.
translation: Ah merhaba. Kizimi kurtardigin icin tekrar tesekkür ederim.

english: No problem.
Hello there friend. I hope you're looking after Elena out there.
translation: Merhaba dostum. Umarim Elena'ya iyi bakiyorsundur.

english: I think she might be the one looking after me.
Ha. That's my Elena.
Can I help you?
Possibly, do you have a challenge for me?
translation: Olabilir, bana bir görev var mi?

english: Yes, I do as a matter of fact.
Edmond has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Edmond sana bir görev parsömeni verdi!

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
Is that your final answer? Because it sounds unlikely to me.
translation: Bu son cevabin mi? Cünkü bana pek olasi gelmiyor.

english: Sounds good!
Edmond has given you another clue scroll!
translation: Edmond sana baska bir ipucu parsömeni verdi!

english: What's happened to her?
Yes.
No.
Well, good luck finding her.
Hello there, are you interested in buying one of my special capes?
translation: Merhaba, özel pelerinlerimden birini satin almak ister misin?

english: What's so special about your capes?

Ahh well they make it less likely that you'll accidently attack anyone wearing the same cape as you and easier to attack everyone else. They also make it easier to distinguish people who're wearing the same cape as you
translation: Ahh, ayni pelerini giyen birine yanlislikla saldirma olasiligini azaltir ve digerlerine saldirmayi kolaylastirir.

english: from everyone else. They're very useful when out in the wilderness with friends or anyone else you don't want to harm.
translation: digerlerinden. Arkadaslarinizla veya zarar vermek istemediginiz baska kisilerle Wildernessda oldugunuzda cok kullanislidirlar.

english: So would you like to buy one?
translation: Bir tane satin almak ister misiniz?

english: No thanks.
What's so special about your capes?
Yes please!
No thanks.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu vardir. Merhaba, selam, selam...

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: Bu yine de tek bir selam sayilir!

english: Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her türlü sey! Kuleler görülmeye deger harika bir manzara.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmeni tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: Senin kadar cirkin olsaydim, yüzümü halka göstermeye cesaret edemezdim!

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: Oh! Sey... Az önce bir tane yedim de ondan!

english: Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: Hayatina deger veriyorsan bir daha benimle konusma!

english: Get lost!
I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: Sana verecek hicbir seyim yok, birak beni rahat, dilenci.

english: Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
translation: Su anda bununla ugrasacak vaktim yok.

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: Senin gibi zavalli bir et yiginiyla konusmak istemiyorum.

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: Cok kötü bir gün... tadini cikar, bitmeden.

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: Eger birini yakalarsan, paylasacagina söz ver.

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
You smell familiar...
Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: Buralarda insan gördün mü? Cok acim.

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: Bana kan tadi seven biri gibi görünüyorsun.

english: Good day to you, my friend.
Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
translation: Kaleye gidip atistirmalik bir seyler yemeye ne dersin?

english: Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: Bana bir dakika izin ver, dislerimde bir sey sikismis...

english: Hello there, are you interested in buying one of my special capes?
translation: Merhaba, özel pelerinlerimden birini satin almak ister misin?

english: What's so special about your capes?

Ahh well they make it less likely that you'll accidently attack anyone wearing the same cape as you and easier to attack everyone else. They also make it easier to distinguish people who're wearing the same cape as you
translation: Ahh, ayni pelerini giyen birini yanlislikla saldirma olasiligini azaltir ve diger herkese saldirmayi kolaylastirir. Ayrica, ayni pelerini giyenleri digerlerinden ayirt etmeyi kolaylastirir.

english: from everyone else. They're very useful when out in the wilderness with friends or anyone else you don't want to harm.
translation: Wildernessda arkadaslarinla veya zarar vermek istemedigin kisilerle birlikteyken cok kullanislidir. Arkadaslarinizla veya zarar vermek istemediginiz baska kisilerle Wildernessda dolasirken cok kullanislidirlar.

english: So would you like to buy one?
translation: Peki, bir tane satin almak ister misiniz?

english: No thanks.
Here, solve this.
Edward hands you a puzzlebox.
translation: Edward sana bir bulmaca kutusu uzatir.

english: That doesn't look solved to me.
Well done [player name]. Here you go.
You've obtained a [new clue/casket]!
What's so special about your capes?
Yes please!
No thanks.
I bet you're a mighty hero!
[player name]! Hero-of-the-humans!
You are a mighty hero, aren't you? I bet you've slain dragons and all sorts of stuff.
translation: Sen güclü bir kahramansin, degil mi? Eminim ejderhalari ve her türlü seyi öldürmüssündür.

english: That's right. I'm awesome!
I could be your sidekick! [player name] and Eek! We could have all sorts of adventures together!
translation: Senin yardimcin olabilirim! Maceraci ve Eek! Birlikte her türlü macerayi yasayabiliriz!

english: Yes!
Yay! [player name] and Eek! We'll travel all over the world fighting for justice! And freedom! And things like that!
translation: Yasasin! Maceraci ve Eek! Adalet icin savasarak tüm dünyayi dolasacagiz! Ve özgürlük icin! Ve bunun gibi seyler icin!

english: Come on, [player name]! Let's have an adventure!
No. It's too dangerous.
Aww.
You know best, though. You're so BRAVE putting yourself in danger all by yourself!
translation: Sen en iyisini bilirsin. Kendini tehlikeye atarak cok CESUR davraniyorsun!

english: I'm not a great hero. I'm just an ordinary person.
translation: Ben büyük bir kahraman degilim. Ben siradan biriyim.

english: Aww. I bet you'll be a mighty hero someday, though.
translation: Aww. Ama eminim bir gün güclü bir kahraman olacaksin.

english: Yes, I'm trying to advance myself.
Brilliant! You can do it! Come on, let's have an adventure!
I don't know. I'm not very ambitious.
Aww...well...never mind.
Hey, you've only got four legs. How do you manage? Don't you fall over?
translation: Hey, sadece dört bacagin var. Nasil basa cikiyorsun? Düsmüyor musun?

english: Actually, I've only got two legs.
Someone has stolen your legs! This is a DISASTER!
translation: Biri bacaklarini calmis! Bu bir FELAKET!

english: We've got to catch the leg thief!
No one stole my legs.
You gave your legs away?
That is so heroic...giving your legs away to someone without legs.
translation: Bu cok kahramanca... bacaklarini olmayan birine vermek.

english: You're my hero!
They're probably long gone by now.
You're right. They probably used the machine to give themselves really long running-away type legs. We'll never catch them now.
translation: Haklisin. Muhtemelen makineyi kullanarak kendilerine cok uzun, kacmak icin uygun bacaklar yapmislardir. Artik onlari asla yakalayamayiz.

english: Oh, it's not so bad.
translation: Oh, o kadar da kötü degil.

english: Then again, your legs are much longer than mine.
translation: Ama yine de, senin bacaklarin benimkilerden cok daha uzun.

english: How's you get such long legs? Do you have some kind of leg-extending machine?
translation: Nasil bu kadar uzun bacaklara sahip oldun? Bir tür bacak uzatma makinen mi var?

english: Where is the leg-extending machine? I want to use it!
translation: Bacak uzatma makinesi nerede? Ben de kullanmak istiyorum!

english: There is no leg-extending machine.
You would say that! You want to keep it for yourself!
translation: Sen öyle dersin tabii! Kendine saklamak istiyorsun!

english: Well that's okay. Maybe I don't even need your leg-extending machine!
translation: Sorun degil. Belki de senin bacak uzatma makinesine ihtiyacim bile yoktur!

english: I can do special leg-stretching exercises! Make my legs longer naturally! No artificial legs for me!
translation: Özel bacak germe egzersizleri yapabilirim! Bacaklarimi dogal olarak uzatabilirim! Yapay bacaklara ihtiyacim yok!

english: You just wait! Soon I'll have the best legs ever!
translation: Bekle de gör! Yakinda en güzel bacaklara sahip olacagim!

english: You can't use it. It's broken.
Oh! I wouldn't want to use it if it's broken.
It might malfunction and give me tiny, tiny legs! Like a slug, only with tiny legs!
translation: Ariza yapip bacaklarimi cok kisa yapabilir! Sümüklü böcek gibi, sadece bacaklari cok kisa!

english: Or it might make some legs longer than others so I wouldn't be able to walk and I'd fall over!
translation: Ya da bazi bacaklari digerlerinden daha uzun yapabilir, o zaman yürüyemem ve düserim!

english: That would be TERRIBLE!
I'd better keep away from that machine!
translation: O makineden uzak dursam iyi olur!

english: Hey, are you scared of spiders?
Yes, I'm scared of spiders.
Oh no! I'm sorry!
I've got to try not to be scary.
You should just pretend I'm not a spider! Like, maybe I'm an eight-legged mouse!
translation: Benim örümcek olmadigimi varsaymalisin! Mesela, belki de sekiz bacakli bir fareyim!

english: Hello, I'm an eight legged mouse! Squeak squeak squeak, I like cheese, cats are bad, I'm definitely not a spider.
translation: Merhaba, ben sekiz bacakli bir fareyim! Cik cik cik, peyniri severim, kediler kötüdür, kesinlikle örümcek degilim.

english: Is that better?
You still look like a spider.
A spider? Oh no! I'm scared of spiders!
translation: Örümcek mi? Oh hayir! Örümceklerden korkarim!

english: That's much better.
Yay! I'll be an eight-legged mouse forever until I forget.
translation: Yasasin! Unutana kadar sonsuza kadar sekiz bacakli bir fare olacagim.

english: You know what? It's great being a spider.
translation: Biliyor musun? Örümcek olmak harika bir sey.

english: No, I'm not scared of spiders.
Not even a bit?
I bet I can make you scared of spiders!
Boo! Raaar! I'm a scary spider!
translation: Boo! Raaar! Ben korkunc bir örümcegim!

english: Next time you go to sleep I'm going to crawl on your face and EAT YOUR EYEBALLS!
translation: Bir dahaki sefere uykuya daldiginda yüzüne tirmanip GÖZLERINI YIYECEGIM!

english: I'm still not scared.
Oh, wow! Even I was scared of me when I said that!
translation: Vay canina! Bunu söyledigimde ben bile kendimden korktum!

english: You're so brave! I bet you're not scared of anything!
translation: Cok cesursun! Eminim hicbir seyden korkmuyorsundur!

english: That was a bit scary.
Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha! I made you scared of me! I made you scared of me!
translation: Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha! Seni kendimden korkuttum! Seni kendimden korkuttum!

english: It's okay, I'm not really going to eat your eyeballs. Spiders don't do that.
translation: Merak etme, gözlerini gercekten yemeyecegim. Örümcekler böyle seyler yapmaz.

english: Well...I don't think they do.
I'm going to learn how to fly! I'm going to be a flying spider!
translation: Ucmayi ögrenecegim! Ucan bir örümcek olacagim!

english: How are you going to fly?
I'm going to spin webs between my legs to make wings! Then I can fly!
translation: Bacaklarimin arasina ag örerek kanat yapacagim! Böylece ucabilecegim!

english: Let's try it now!
Um...okay! I'll spin the webs...and then you throw me in the air.
translation: Sey... Tamam! Ben aglari örecegim... Sen de beni havaya firlat.

english: Okay. Three...
Two...
One...
Wait! I'm not ready!
I don't think I've got the webs right. I'm not ready yet. We'll do it another time.
translation: Aglari dogru yapamadim galiba. Henüz hazir degilim. Baska bir zaman yapariz.

english: Sounds dangerous.
It's not dangerous! What's the worst that could happen?
translation: Tehlikeli degil! En kötü ne olabilir ki?

english: The worst that can happen is, like, the wings fail and I fall to my death.
translation: En kötü, kanatlar ise yaramaz ve düsüp ölürüm.

english: Or I get eaten by a bird.
translation: Ya da bir kus tarafindan yenirim.

english: I'm going to rethink this.
Spiders can't fly!
Some spiders can fly! They use web strands to float in the air!
translation: Bazi örümcekler ucabilir! Ag ipliklerini kullanarak havada süzülürler!

english: I think I know more about spiders than you, seeing how I am one!
translation: Ben bir örümcek oldugum icin, örümcekler hakkinda senden daha fazla sey biliyorum!

english: I'm sorry, Eek.
That's okay.
I don't want to fly now. I'm not in the mood.
translation: Su anda ucmak istemiyorum. Havamda degilim.

english: I don't believe you.
I don't care. I'm not talking to you any more.
Hey...there are so many humans in your world.
translation: Hey... senin dünyanda cok fazla insan var.

english: Back in my old web there are only spiders.
Suppose I was bitten by a magically-irradiated man?
translation: Diyelim ki sihirli bir isinla vurulmus bir adam tarafindan isirildim?

english: I might become the Man-Spider! I'd gain all the powers of a man! Like um...
translation: Insan-Örümcek olabilirim! Bir insanin tüm güclerini kazanabilirim! Mesela...

english: Um...what can humans do that's special?
translation: Insanlar ne gibi özel seyler yapabilir?

english: Walk on two legs.
Walk on two legs! Yes! Then I could use my other six legs to FIGHT CRIME!
translation: Iki ayak üzerinde yürürler! Evet! O zaman diger alti bacagimi SUCLA MÜCADELE ETMEK icin kullanabilirim!

english: Use tools.
Yes! I could have all sorts of gadgets! Like a gadget that spins webs!
translation: Evet! Her türlü aleti kullanabilirim! Örümcek agi ören bir alet gibi!

english: Wait...I can already spin webs.
translation: Dur... Ben zaten örümcek agi örebiliyorum.

english: Never mind!
Project heat-rays from our eyes.
Oh! I didn't know humans could do that!
Please don't fry me with your heat rays!
I'm too young to fry!
Nothing, really. Humans are pretty ordinary.
translation: Hicbir sey, gercekten. Insanlar oldukca siradan.

english: Aww, don't say that. Everyone is special!
That's right. I'm awesome!
Yes!
No. It's too dangerous.
I'm not a great hero. I'm just an ordinary person.
translation: Ben büyük bir kahraman degilim. Ben sadece siradan bir insanim.

english: Yes, I'm trying to advance myself.
I don't know. I'm not very ambitious.
Actually, I've only got two legs.
No one stole my legs.
They're probably long gone by now.
Oh, it's not so bad.
translation: Oh, o kadar da kötü degil.

english: There is no leg-extending machine.
You can't use it. It's broken.
Yes, I'm scared of spiders.
You still look like a spider.
That's much better.
No, I'm not scared of spiders.
I'm still not scared.
That was a bit scary.
How are you going to fly?
Let's try it now!
Sounds dangerous.
Spiders can't fly!
I'm sorry, Eek.
I don't believe you.
Walk on two legs.
Use tools.
Project heat-rays from our eyes.
Nothing, really. Humans are pretty ordinary.
translation: Aslinda hicbir sey. Insanlar oldukca siradan.

english: Welcome to my store. Are you in search of any runes?
translation: Magazama hos geldiniz. Rün ariyor musunuz?

english: Can I see your wares?
No thanks.
Come back any time. I've always got something for anybody.
translation: Istediginiz zaman tekrar gelin. Her zaman herkes icin bir seylerim vardir.

english: Can I see your wares?
No thanks.
Hi. Interesting building you have here.
What's it for?
You like it? It's simply fabulous, isn't it? A real marvel of modern design made just for my fellow alchemists and I!
translation: Begendin mi? Muhtesem, degil mi? Ben ve meslektaslarim icin yapilmis modern tasarimin gercek bir harikasi!

english: I see some builders over there. So I assume it's not yet finished.
translation: Surada bazi insaatcilar görüyorum. Yani henüz bitmemis sanirim.

english: What a keen eye this chap has! But imagine this: a gargantuan cylinder of expert design, incorporating an inventive inner spiral walkway to multiple planes of wondrous inhabitance!
translation: Bu adamin ne keskin gözleri var! Ama sunu bir düsün: ustaca tasarlanmis devasa bir silindir, icinde yaratici bir spiral yürüyüs yolu ve muhtesem yasam alanlari!

english: So, it's a tower.
Oh, no, no, no, no.
It's going to have a use that will change this world!
translation: Bu dünyayi degistirecek bir kullanimi olacak!

english: Or at least it would if we could ever get it finished.
See those builders?
They don't seem to be building much.
translation: Pek bir sey insa ediyor gibi görünmüyorlar.

english: Exactly.
They've gone on strike for some petty reason about the tower being too weird. I really can't understand those men.
translation: Kule cok tuhaf oldugu gibi sacma bir sebepten greve gittiler. Bu adamlari gercekten anlayamiyorum.

english: Shame.
Hey! Maybe you could talk to them?
You look like a sturdy chap.
Maybe you could finish the work?
Me?
Come on! This is the chance of a lifetime!
Sure, why not.
That's fantastic! Oh, I'm so pleased.
translation: Bu harika! Oh, cok memnun oldum.

english: Calm down. I'm not making any promises.
Oh, I have a good feeling about this.
Right.
Go have a word with Bonafido the head builder. See if you can't get him off his backside to do some work. Oh, and I'm Effigy by the way.
translation: Git bas insaatci Bonafido ile konus. Onu is yapmasi icin ikna etmeye calis. Bu arada, ben Effigy.

english: Nice to meet you Effigy, I'm [player name]. Hold on and I'll see what I can do!
translation: Tanistigimiza memnun oldum Effigy, ben Maceraci. Bekle, ne yapabilecegime bir bakayim!

english: Wait a minute.
Don't I recognise you from somewhere?
Erm, do you?
Do you know the outpost north of Ardougne?
Ah, yes, it's now a small museum. Jorral's looking after it. He's really making history with that place.
translation: Ah, evet, simdi kücük bir müze. Jorral ona bakiyor. O yerle gercekten tarih yaziyor.

english: Well, the King was going to make that into an alchemy lab for us, but some fool ruined our plans!
translation: Kral orayi bizim icin bir simya laboratuvari yapacakti, ama bir aptal planlarimizi mahvetti!

english: Ah, yes. Shame. Got to go. Bye.
translation: Ah, evet. Yazik. Gitmem gerek. Hosca kal.

english: Hey, wait up!
Best I go sort out this tower. Bye.
translation: Bu kuleyi halletmem gerek. Hosca kal.

english: Sorry, feeling a bit ill today.
A bit ill?
That's a weak excuse for a very feeble personality.
translation: Bu cok zayif bir kisilik icin zayif bir bahane.

english: Yes.
No.
You need to get the milk from the cook. He's the one with the white chef's hat, hop to it now!
translation: Sütü ascidan almalisin. Beyaz sef sapkasi olan adam, hemen git!

english: Hello, Eggus!
Why hello there, [player name]!
Have you seen the Easter Bunny lately?
translation: Son zamanlarda Paskalya Tavsanini gördün mü?

english: Indeed I have, he's here! Though he's not his usual self. That's why I'm here actually. It would seem that he has strayed from the path of Easter.
translation: Evet, gördüm, burada! Ama her zamanki gibi degil. Aslinda bu yüzden buradayim. Görünüse göre Paskalya yolundan sapmis.

english: That's not good.
No, not good at all. Especially for those of us who walk the golden-yolked path. As soon as I found out, I set out to track him down.
translation: Hayir, hic iyi degil. Özellikle altin sarisi yumurtalarin yolunda yürüyenler icin. Bunu ögrenir ögrenmez onu bulmak icin yola ciktim.

english: That's nice of you. How did you find him?
Well as luck would have it, I met a pair of hardy hunters who were up to the task. Glanton and Rinder are their names, and what a help they have been!
translation: Sans eseri, bu görevi üstlenecek iki cesur avciyla karsilastim. Adlari Glanton ve Rinder, bana cok yardimci oldular!

english: Very capable, though they've yet to tell me what it is they usually hunt.
translation: Cok yetenekliler, ama henüz bana genellikle ne avladiklarini söylemediler.

english: Hopefully not rabbits!
Don't even think it! They have been nothing but utmost gentlemen. We've been trying to cheer up that poor bunny together.
translation: Aklindan bile gecirme! Onlar son derece centilmen insanlar. Birlikte o zavalli tavsani neselendirmeye calisiyoruz.

english: How has that been going?
Not well. I've tried everything I can think of! Reading our holy Easter books to him, reciting eggy poetry, nothing has worked.
translation: Iyi degil. Aklima gelen her seyi denedim! Ona kutsal Paskalya kitaplarimizi okudum, yumurtayla ilgili siirler okudum, ama hicbir sey ise yaramadi.

english: Is that really everything you can think of?
translation: Gercekten aklina gelen her seyi denedin mi?

english: I also considered egg juggling, but every time I do that I make a big mess.
translation: Yumurta jonglörlügü de düsündüm, ama her denedigimde ortaligi batiriyorum.

english: Best leave that to the professionals.
Indeed.
He's in the next room if you want to talk to him, hopefully you can improve his mood.
translation: Onunla konusmak istersen yan odada, umarim moralini düzeltebilirsin.

english: I hope so too. Talk to you later!
translation: Ben de öyle umuyorum. Sonra görüsürüz!

english: What is this place? Seems a bit... unsavoury.
translation: Burasi ne böyle? Biraz... tatsiz bir yer gibi.

english: This my friend is the Rabbit Hole. A miserable pit for the most part, though I'm told it was previously much more pleasant.
translation: Burasi dostum, Tavsan Deligi. Cogunlukla sefil bir cukur, ama eskiden cok daha hos bir yermis diye duydum.

english: A home to all Easter-adjacent beings and their friends! Great feasts, parties, and performances were held here.
translation: Paskalya ile ilgili tüm varliklar ve onlarin arkadaslarinin evi! Burada büyük ziyafetler, partiler ve gösteriler düzenlenirdi.

english: All to celebrate Easter! You see, most people would tire of Easter-based activities after a while. But not the denizens of the Rabbit hole.
translation: Hepsi Paskalya'yi kutlamak icin! Görüyorsun, cogu insan bir süre sonra Paskalya ile ilgili etkinliklerden sikilir. Ama Tavsan Deligi sakinleri öyle degil.

english: Interesting, so if you felt a particularly eggy urge, you could come here and let loose?
translation: Ilginc, yani özellikle yumurta icme istegi duydugunda buraya gelip kendini serbest birakabilirdin?

english: Precisely! Though now those days are gone, and what Easter joy was once present has all but run out.
translation: Aynen öyle! Ama artik o günler geride kaldi ve Paskalya'nin bir zamanlar getirdigi nese neredeyse tamamen yok oldu.

english: Only a few devoted stragglers remain. Though what exactly they are devoted to is up for debate.
translation: Sadece birkac sadik kisi kaldi. Ama tam olarak neye sadik olduklari tartismaya acik.

english: Certainly not eggs.
That's a shame.
It is a great shame. Still, there is hope!
translation: Gercekten cok yazik. Yine de umut var!

english: I agree. I'll have a look around and see what's going on, perhaps I can help restore some egg-nergy.
translation: Katiliyorum. Etrafa bir bakip neler oldugunu görecegim, belki biraz yumurta enerjisini geri kazanmaya yardimci olabilirim.

english: Oh you! I hope so, let me know if I can help!
translation: Oh sen! Umarim öyle olur, yardim edebilecegim bir sey olursa haber ver!

english: Where are all the other egg priests?
A fine question!
They're all very busy scribbling scrolls, rebinding books, replacing plaques, and fiddling with frescoes.
translation: Hepsi cok mesguller, parsömenler yaziyor, kitaplari yeniden ciltliyor, plaketleri degistiriyor ve fresklerle ugrasiyorlar.
