english: Once we were informed that our beloved 'Ayaster' was actually 'Easter', it became clear that we had a lot of corrections to sort out.
translation: Sevgili “Ayaster”imizin aslinda “Paskalya” oldugunu ögrendigimizde, düzeltmemiz gereken cok sey oldugu ortaya cikti.

english: So they're all making important changes, and there's quite a number to get through!
translation: Bu yüzden hepsi önemli degisiklikler yapiyorlar ve halletmeleri gereken cok sey var!

english: Wow, I don't envy them.
Nor do I! Thank goodness the Easter Bunny is so upset, it's handy excuse to be elsewhere.
translation: Ben de! Neyse ki Paskalya Tavsani cok üzgün, baska bir yerde olmak icin uygun bir bahane.

english: ...That sounded horrible, I didn't mean it like that.
I should hope not.
Actually, nevermind.
I need some help cheering up the Easter Bunny, what is your favourite part of Easter?
translation: Paskalya Tavsanini neselendirmek icin yardima ihtiyacim var, Paskalya'nin en sevdigin yani nedir?

english: I couldn't possibly choose!
Oh fantastic! That's not useful at all! What if you HAD to choose? To help the Easter Bunny?
translation: Harika! Bu hic yardimci olmadi! Ya secmek zorunda olsaydin? Paskalya Tavsanina yardim etmek icin?

english: Well if I had to choose for his sake, I suppose it would be the Easter Buns.
translation: Eger onun icin secim yapmam gerekirse, sanirim Paskalya Cörekleri olurdu.

english: Easter Buns, eh?
Ohhhh yes, you know, Easter Buns! Delicious, sticky, spicy, Easter Buns!
translation: Ohhhh evet, bilirsin, Paskalya Cörekleri! Lezzetli, yapiskan, baharatli Paskalya Cörekleri!

english: They're really that good?
Oh my, you've.... you've really never had one?
translation: Aman tanrim, sen... sen gercekten hic yemedin mi?

english: We'll have to change that!
I have the recipe right here. I implore you to make some and try them. I don't have any ingredients with me but I'm sure you could ask around in here.
translation: Tarifi burada var. Lütfen yapip dene. Yanimda malzemelerim yok ama eminim burada bulabilirsin.

english: If anything is going to make the Easter Bunny happy, it's these Easter Buns.
translation: Paskalya Tavsanini mutlu edecek bir sey varsa, o da bu Paskalya Cörekleridir.

english: Okay, I'll give it a go!
Please bring me one too! Heeheehee!
translation: Bana da bir tane getir lütfen! Heeheehee!

english: Have you read that recipe yet?
Not yet, I lost it.
You look burdened enough as it is, come back when you have room for it!
translation: Zaten yeterince yükün var, yerin oldugunda tekrar gel!

english: Oh really? Let me jot it down for you again quickly...
Here you go!
Not yet, I'm waiting for the opportune moment!
Well don't wait too long, I want some Easter Buns!
YOU want some Easter Buns?
To uh... Give to the Easter Bunny!
Right...
I need another copy of that recipe.
translation: O tarifin bir kopyasina daha ihtiyacim var.

english: I need some yeastier dough to make the Easter Buns, do you have any?
translation: Paskalya Cörekleri yapmak icin mayali hamur lazim, var mi?

english: Do I look like a baker to you? I'm afraid I don't carry raw dough around with me. Maybe ask in the kitchen?
translation: Sana firinci gibi mi görünüyorum? Ne yazik ki yanimda hamur tasimiyorum. Mutfaga sorsana?

english: The kitchen eh? Good idea.
One thing I can tell you, about Eastery dough...
translation: Paskalya hamuru hakkinda sana söyleyebilecegim bir sey var...

english: Yeastier dough?
Yes that's what I said, yeastery dough! What I can tell you about yeasteryear dough is that it is very yeasty!
translation: Evet, aynen öyle dedim, mayali hamur! Mayali hamur hakkinda sana söyleyebilecegim sey, cok mayali oldugu!

english: Oh really? Wow! Thanks for the education, Eggus.
translation: Gercekten mi? Vay canina! Bilgilendirme icin tesekkürler, Eggus.

english: It is my duty to teach those less knowledgeable than myself.
translation: Benden daha az bilgili olanlara ögretmek benim görevim.

english: I'll see you later.
The recipe says I need a special egg. Do you have any special eggs?
translation: Tarifte özel bir yumurta gerektigi yaziyor. Özel yumurtan var mi?

english: Well I do have some special eggs, but they're my personal supply I'm afraid. I couldn't possibly give them away.
translation: Özel yumurtalarim var ama maalesef onlar benim kisisel stogum. Onlari baskasina veremem.

english: Of course. Where else could I get one then?
translation: Tabii ki. O zaman nereden bulabilirim?

english: Perhaps you should ask a chicken?
No, really, there's one around here somewhere!
translation: Hayir, gercekten, buralarda bir yerde var!

english: I do recall seeing a chicken in here actually.
translation: Aslinda burada bir tavuk gördügümü hatirliyorum.

english: Well there you go! Eggs-a-plenty!
translation: Iste bu kadar! Bol bol yumurta!

english: And remember child, all eggs are special.
translation: Ve unutma cocuk, tüm yumurtalar özeldir.

english: I'll keep that in mind.
Do you know where I might find Easter spices?
translation: Paskalya baharatlarini nerede bulabilirim biliyor musun?

english: Oh, yes I do. The lass behind the bar, what's her name, Rider? Winkle? Erm... In any case ask her, she puts it in drinks to give them a kick!
translation: Evet, biliyorum. Barin arkasindaki kiz, adi neydi, Rider mi? Winkle mi? Her neyse, ona sor, ickilere tat vermek icin koyuyor!

english: Okay, thanks.
I need raisins. I also need to know what raisins are. What and where are raisins?
translation: Kuru üzüm lazim. Ayrica kuru üzümün ne oldugunu da bilmem lazim. Kuru üzüm nedir ve nerede bulunur?

english: Raisins! Little tasty morsels! Rich and sweet and goopy! Not as good as eggs though, no no no. You should get some eggs!
translation: Kuru üzüm! Kücük lezzetli parcaciklar! Zengin, tatli ve yapiskan! Yumurtalar kadar iyi degil ama, hayir hayir hayir. Yumurta almalisin!

english: But I need raisins...
Hmmm, that Glanton fellow mentioned raisins, or was it racing? Something about hydration in any case. Yes, ask him about your eggs. My eggs are off limits.
translation: Hmmm, Glanton denen adam kuru üzümden bahsetmisti, yoksa yaris miydi? Her neyse, hidrasyonla ilgili bir seydi. Evet, ona yumurtalarini sor. Yumurtalarim yasak.

english: I need raisins!!!
Oh my child, you think you need raisins, but you need only embrace the runny yolk of a fine egg to be happy!
translation: Ah cocugum, kuru üzüm lazim saniyorsun, ama mutlu olmak icin sadece güzel bir yumurtanin akiskan sarisini kucaklaman lazim!

english: Urgh... Bye.
Easter Buns! Eggy funs! Tasty wasty winky wuns! Oh bunny good and nunny noo..
translation: Paskalya cörekleri! Yumurtali eglenceler! Lezzetli, israfci, göz kirpanlar! Ah tavsan iyi ve rahibe hayir...

english: Oh hello! I didn't see you there. Off in my own little world I was. How go the buns?
translation: Merhaba! Seni görmedim. Kendi kücük dünyamda kaybolmustum. Cörekler nasil gidiyor?

english: I've made them, I just need to cook them.
Chop chop then! I can't stop thinking about them.
translation: Hadi o zaman! Onlari düsünmeden duramiyorum.

english: All in good time.
Do my senses decieve me? Can I smell... Easter Buns?!
translation: Duyularim beni yaniltiyor mu? Paskalya Cörekleri kokusu mu aliyorum?!

english: Indeed you can.
Wonderful! Have you tried one yet?
I have! They are fantastic. Great recipe.
Why, thank you [player name]! How kind!
Not yet.
How could you resist such a wonder?
I'm not very hungry I suppose.
Let's not delay any longer, get one of these to the Easter Bunny pronto!
translation: Daha fazla gecikmeyelim, bunlardan birini hemen Paskalya Tavsanina götürelim!

english: And I would love one too, of course.
translation: Ben de bir tane isterim tabii ki.

english: Naturally, here you are.
Oh, I'm going to enjoy this!
Simply wonderful! These buns have the Eggus Manus seal of approval.
translation: Harika! Bu cörekler Eggus Manus'un onayini aldi.

english: Good! I'll take one to the Easter Bunny now.
translation: Güzel! Simdi bir tane Paskalya Tavsanina götürecegim.

english: Hello again, Eggus.
Hello!
The Easter Bunny seems happier.
Indeed he does! Wonderful, isn't it?
It is, I think we've nearly got him back on track.
translation: Evet, sanirim onu neredeyse eski haline getirdik.

english: The rehearsal didn't go very well.
No it did not. That Glanton has no respect for musicals.
translation: Hayir, gitmedi. Glanton müzikallere hic saygi duymuyor.

english: You didn't read the script beforehand either though, did you?
translation: Sen de önceden senaryoyu okumadin, degil mi?

english: True, true. Though that is because I am familiar with the material.
translation: Dogru, dogru. Ama bunun nedeni, materyali iyi bilmemdir.

english: Is that right?
Oh yes! Why I could burst into a rendition of 'Oh, is there not one maiden egg' at a moments notice!
translation: Oh evet! Bir anda “Oh, tek bir bakire yumurta yok mu?” diye sarki söylemeye baslayabilirim!

english: Go on then.
I can't right now, there's no ensemble. Plus, I don't have my singing socks on.
translation: Su anda yapamam, ensemble yok. Ayrica sarki söyleme coraplarimi giymedim.

english: Well you'd better get them, we've got to perform for the Easter Bunny soon.
translation: Giymen iyi olur, yakinda Paskalya Tavsani icin gösteri yapacagiz.

english: Hi, Eggus.
Oh hello, [player name]!
Good job with the performance, the Easter Bunny loved it.
translation: Gösteriyi iyi yaptin, Paskalya Tavsani cok begendi.

english: I was impressed with your dancing, you're a natural!
translation: Dansin beni cok etkiledi, dogustan yeteneklisin!

english: I love a good dance. It's great eggs-ercise!
translation: Iyi dans etmeyi severim. Harika bir egzersiz!

english: In fact, the show has re-eggnited my love for the stage.
translation: Aslinda, bu gösteri sahneye olan sevgimi yeniden alevlendirdi.

english: That's great, what are you thinking of doing?
Stand-up comedy! I've been writing jokes. Well, a joke.
translation: Stand-up komedi! Sakalar yaziyorum. Sey, bir saka.

english: I think you'll need more than one, Eggus. Still, can I hear it?
translation: Bence birden fazla sakaya ihtiyacin olacak, Eggus. Yine de, duyabilir miyim?

english: Absolutely!
What's big and small at the same time?
translation: Ayni anda hem büyük hem de kücük olan nedir?

english: I dread to think.
A big egg!
Ohohohoho!
I'm glad that you're enjoying yourself.
I'm having a blast! I think I'll try and write another egg joke soon.
translation: Cok egleniyorum! Yakinda baska bir yumurta sakasi yazmayi deneyecegim.

english: You crack on, Eggus! Good luck with it all.
translation: Devam et, Eggus! Her seyde bol sans.

english: Thanks.
Hurrah! you've done it again, [player name]! Ayaster is saved again.
translation: Yasasin! Yine basardin, Maceraci! Ayaster yine kurtarildi.

english: Ayaster you say?
Oh, I mean Easter of course.
Have you seen the Easter Bunny?
What is this place?
Where are the rest of the egg priests?
Nevermind.
Talk about helping the Easter Bunny.
Discuss something else.
Ask about yeastier dough.
Ask about a special egg.
Ask about Easter spices.
Ask about raisins.
Hello.
Good day.
Good day, Your Royal Highness.
Oi!
Rahr!
No!
Grr!
Aargh!
I'm a gonner!
It's no use, I'm done for!
Uggh!
Welcome to the Hefin Inn! What can I getcha?
translation: Hefin Inn'e hos geldiniz! Ne alirsiniz?

english: Just a beer.
I can get you a Beer for 2 coins.
Here you go!
Actually, maybe not.
I don't have that much on me... Maybe later.

english: Who was Xeric?
Xeric was a dark mage who ruled Great Kourend for at least ten decades. A time period that is sometimes known as the Age of Strife.
translation: Xeric, en az on yil boyunca Büyük Kourend'i yöneten karanlik bir büyücüydü. Bu dönem bazen Catisma Cagi olarak da bilinir.

english: At least? Do you not know how long he was in power for?
translation: En az mi? Ne kadar süre iktidarda kaldigini bilmiyor musun?

english: We do have records of course. However, while Xeric was indeed ruler of the kingdom from the 37th to the 47th decades, some believe that he actually ruled for longer.
translation: Elbette kayitlarimiz var. Ancak, Xeric 37. on yildan 47. on yila kadar kralligin hükümdariydi, ancak bazilari onun aslinda daha uzun süre hüküm sürdügüne inaniyor.

english: How come?
It is often speculated that Xeric and his predecessor, King Shayzien VII, were in fact the same person.
translation: Xeric ve onun öncülü Kral Shayzien VII'nin aslinda ayni kisi oldugu sik sik spekülasyon konusu olur.

english: How could that be?
Like Xeric, King Shayzien VII was fascinated with the Dark Altar.
translation: Xeric gibi, Kral Shayzien VII de Karanlik Sunak'a hayranlik duyuyordu.

english: The King was killed at the Battle of the Concourse during the 37th decade. We have many accounts of this, yet his body was never recovered.
translation: Kral, 37. on yilda Concourse Savasi'nda öldürüldü. Bu konuda bircok kayit var, ancak cesedi hicbir zaman bulunamadi.

english: Just days after his death, we have the first recorded mention of Xeric, an incredibly powerful mage who resembled the King.
translation: Ölümünden sadece birkac gün sonra, Kral'a benzeyen, inanilmaz derecede güclü bir büyücü olan Xeric'ten ilk kez bahsedildi.

english: It is written that Xeric killed the rulers of Kourend's five cities and claimed the kingdom as his own.
translation: Xeric'in Kourend'in bes sehrinin hükümdarlarini öldürdügü ve kralligi ele gecirdigi yaziyor.

english: So King Shayzien VII was resurrected as Xeric using the Dark Altar?
translation: Yani Kral Shayzien VII, Karanlik Sunak'i kullanarak Xeric olarak diriltildi mi?

english: It's possible. I am no expert on necromancy but we know the Dark Altar has the power to resurrect beasts. We also know that it can extend life. It's how the people of Arceuus are immortal.
translation: Bu mümkün. Ben nekromansi konusunda uzman degilim, ancak Karanlik Sunak'in canavarlari diriltme gücüne sahip oldugunu biliyoruz. Ayrica yasam süresini uzatabildigini de biliyoruz. Arceuus halkinin ölümsüz olmasinin sebebi budur.

english: King Shayzien VII may have found a way to combine these powers.
translation: Kral Shayzien VII bu gücleri birlestirmenin bir yolunu bulmus olabilir.

english: How did Xeric have so much power?
translation: Xeric bu kadar gücü nasil elde etti?

english: Xeric drew much of his power from the Dark Altar, but he asserted his authority as ruler through his personal army of creatures, the lizardmen.
translation: Xeric gücünün cogunu Karanlik Sunaktan aldi, ama hükümdar olarak otoritesini kisisel yaratik ordusu olan kertenkele adamlar araciligiyla ortaya koydu.

english: Xeric created the lizardmen!?
Sadly so, though we're not exactly sure how he did so. Xeric used the citizens of Kourend for many experiments, as well as for his own sadistic pleasures.
translation: Maalesef öyle, ama bunu nasil yaptigini tam olarak bilmiyoruz. Xeric, Kourend vatandaslarini bircok deney icin ve kendi sadist zevkleri icin kullandi.

english: We have little written record of the experiments, but we believe they might have led to the creation of the lizardmen.
translation: Deneyler hakkinda cok az yazili kayit var, ancak bunlarin kertenkele adamlarin yaratilmasina yol acmis olabilecegine inaniyoruz.

english: Do you know why he created the lizardmen?
translation: Kertenkele adamlari neden yarattigini biliyor musun?

english: Originally, we believed that Xeric created the lizardmen. However, recent discovieressuggest they were actually created during the time of King Shayzien VII.
translation: Baslangicta, Xeric'in kertenkele adamlari yarattigina inaniyorduk. Ancak, son kesifler bunlarin aslinda Kral Shayzien VII döneminde yaratildigini gösteriyor.

english: Do you know why Xeric needed the lizardmen?
translation: Xeric'in kertenkele adamlara neden ihtiyaci oldugunu biliyor musun?

english: Xeric was undoubtedly powerful, but he couldn't rule the people singlehandedly, nor could he rely on human informants. He needed an army he could control.
translation: Xeric süphesiz güclüydü, ancak halki tek basina yönetemezdi ve insan muhbirlere de güvenemezdi. Kontrol edebilecegi bir orduya ihtiyaci vardi.

english: Lizardmen are loyal creatures and would do as he commanded without question. With them at his disposal, the people were powerless to resist his authority.
translation: Kertenkele adamlar sadik yaratiklardir ve onun emirlerini sorgusuz sualsiz yerine getirirler. Onlari emrinde tutarak, halk onun otoritesine karsi koyamaz hale geldi.

english: What happened to the lizardmen after Xeric's reign?
translation: Xeric'in hükümdarligindan sonra kertenkele adamlara ne oldu?

english: They remain loyal to Xeric. Even to this day they continue to attack the kingdom, as you may have seen.
translation: Xeric'e sadik kaldilar. Gördügünüz gibi, bugün bile kralliga saldirmaya devam ediyorlar.

english: Fortunately, the Shayzien Army keeps them under control.
translation: Neyse ki Shayzien Ordusu onlari kontrol altinda tutuyor.

english: Why do they keep fighting? Surely after a thousand years they must know Xeric is gone?
translation: Neden savasmaya devam ediyorlar? Bin yil sonra Xeric'in öldügünü biliyor olmalari gerekmez mi?

english: Without examining their minds, we will never know for sure. However, we assume Xeric genetically altered them to enforce that their duty is to serve him.
translation: Zihinlerini incelemeden bunu kesin olarak bilemeyiz. Ancak Xeric'in, onlara kendisine hizmet etmeyi görev olarak asilamak icin genetik olarak degistirdigini varsayiyoruz.

english: But if they are serving Xeric, why do they attack the kingdom?
translation: Ama Xeric'e hizmet ediyorlarsa, neden kralliga saldiriyorlar?

english: A good question. One that I'm afraid I do not know the answer to.
translation: Iyi bir soru. Ne yazik ki cevabini bilmiyorum.

english: Is there anything else you would like to know?
translation: Bilmek istediginiz baska bir sey var mi?

english: What happened to Xeric?
During the 47th decade, after ten decades of oppression, the people revolted against Xeric and his army of lizardmen.
translation: 47. on yilda, on yillik baskidan sonra, halk Xeric ve kertenkele adam ordusuna karsi ayaklandi.

english: Why did the people suffer for so long?
translation: Halk neden bu kadar uzun süre aci cekti?

english: The events were triggered through the courage of one man, Byrne. He was not a man of particular stature of nobility, though he did proceed to become king.
translation: Olaylar, Byrne adinda bir adamin cesareti ile basladi. O, özellikle soylu bir adam degildi, ancak kral olmaya devam etti.

english: What happened?
'Twas the 312th day of decade 47. Byrne, a farmer by trade, is said to have witnessed a lizardman guard murder a child whilst working his farm.
translation: 47. on yilin 312. günüydü. Ciftci olan Byrne, ciftliginde calisirken bir kertenkele adamin bir cocugu öldürdügünü gördügü söylenir.

english: Outraged at what he had just seen, Byrne grabbed his pitchfork and sprinted towards the guard.
translation: Gördüklerine öfkelenen Byrne, dirgenini kapip muhafizin üzerine atildi.

english: Blinded by fury, Byrne attacked the guard, slaughtering the lizardman in plain sight of all around.
translation: Öfkeyle kör olan Byrne, muhafizi saldirdi ve herkesin gözü önünde kertenkele adami öldürdü.

english: Legend has it Byrne then gave a galvanizing speech, standing over the butchered guard with his bloodied pitchfork held aloft in the air, urging the people to fight back.
translation: Efsaneye göre Byrne, katledilen muhafizin basinda durup kanli dirgenini havaya kaldirarak halka karsi koymaya cagirdi.

english: Do you know what he said?
Sadly no. While we have many witness accounts, they all differ, so we can not verify it at all.
translation: Maalesef hayir. Bircok tanik ifadesi var ama hepsi birbirinden farkli, bu yüzden dogrulayamiyoruz.

english: Ah, so what happened next?
Whatever Byrne said, the people responded. Together, the citizens of Kourend revolted, grabbing whatever they could use as a weapon. They fought the lizardmen.
translation: Byrne ne dedigi önemli degil, halk ona karsilik verdi. Kourend halki bir araya gelip, silah olarak kullanabilecekleri her seyi alip isyan baslatti. Kertenkele adamlarla savastilar.

english: The lizardmen, while strong and powerful, were simply outnumbered. In a matter of days, they had been driven back into the Kebos Lowlands.
translation: Kertenkele adamlar güclü ve kuvvetliydiler ama sayica azdilar. Birkac gün icinde Kebos Ovalari'na geri püskürtüldüler.

english: So what happened to Xeric?
During the battle, the temple surrounding the Dark Altar was destroyed, weakening Xeric's power. We believe he fled to Quidamortem.
translation: Savas sirasinda Karanlik Sunak'i cevreleyen tapinak yikildi ve bu da Xeric'in gücünü zayiflatti. Quidamortem'e kactigini düsünüyoruz.

english: Some say Xeric was actually killed during the revolt, but we have no record of his remains being discovered.
translation: Bazilari Xeric'in isyan sirasinda öldürüldügünü söylüyor, ancak cesedinin bulunduguna dair herhangi bir kayit yok.

english: Xeric was incredibly powerful but we can reasonably assume that he soon perished. Without the power of the Dark Altar, Xeric would have become mortal.

Strange, I was told this house was plague infected.
translation: Garip, bu evin veba bulasmis oldugu söylenmisti.

english: I suppose that was a cover up by the kidnappers.
translation: Sanirim bu, kaciranlarin uydurdugu bir yalandi.

english: Okay, I'll look for it.
Hi, you're free to go! Your kidnappers don't seem to be about right now.
translation: Merhaba, gidebilirsin! Kaciranlar su anda buralarda yok gibi görünüyor.

english: Thank you, being kidnapped was so inconvenient. I was on my way back to East Ardougne with some samples, I want to see if I can diagnose a cure for this plague.
translation: Tesekkürler, kacirilmak cok rahatsiz ediciydi. Bazi örneklerle Dogu Ardougne'a dönüyordum, bu vebanin tedavisini bulabilir miyim diye bakmak istiyorum.

english: Well you can leave via the manhole in the middle of the city.
Go and see my father, I'll make sure he adequately rewards you. Now I'd better leave while I still can.
translation: Git babami gör, sana uygun bir ödül vereceginden emin ol. Simdi, hala yapabiliyorken gitsem iyi olacak.

english: Hey Elena.
Hey [player name].
Not bad. I won't lie though, the stuff you told me about elves and dark lords is all a bit frightening.
translation: Fena degil. Yalan söylemeyecegim, elfler ve karanlik lordlar hakkinda anlattiklarin biraz korkutucu.

english: I know. I'm working on it though, by the time I'm done we'll never have to worry about any of this again.
translation: Biliyorum. Ama üzerinde calisiyorum, isim bittiginde bir daha bu konuda endiselenmemize gerek kalmayacak.

english: I hope you're right. Be careful out there, I worry about you.
translation: Umarim haklisindir. Disarida dikkatli ol, senin icin endiseleniyorum.

english: I'll be fine Elena, don't you worry.
Well it just so happens that by freak accident, I had hundreds delivered the other day!
translation: Sans eseri, gecen gün yüzlerce tane teslim aldim!

english: Elena hands you a large sieve.
translation: Elena sana büyük bir elek uzatir.

english: Thanks again.
See you later.
Have you caught the plague?
Okay, I'll look for it.
How's it going?
Do you have another sieve? I lost the last one.
translation: Baska eleniz var mi? Sonuncuyu kaybettim.

english: Hey, how are you?
Good thanks, yourself?
Not bad, I do wish you could tell me what's going on with the plague though.
translation: Fena degil, ama keske bana vebayla ilgili neler oldugunu anlatabilsen.

english: Well that's the thing... I don't really know any more. It turns out the king was lying to me.
translation: Aslinda sorun da bu... Artik ben de bilmiyorum. Meger kral bana yalan söylemis.

english: Lying? About what?
About his loyalty. It seems the plague is part of some evil plan of his. I still don't know what that is though.
translation: Sadakati hakkinda. Görünüse göre veba, onun kötü planinin bir parçasiymis. Ama hala ne oldugunu bilmiyorum.

english: This doesn't sound good at all. Should we tell someone?
translation: Bu hiç iyiye isaret degil. Birine söylemeli miyiz?

english: Not yet. I still need to work out exactly what's going on. I have some new allies who might help me with that though.
translation: Henüz degil. Neler oldugunu tam olarak anlamam lazim. Ama bu konuda bana yardimci olabilecek yeni müttefiklerim var.

english: Well let me know as soon as you have something. And look after yourself out there, I worry about what you've got yourself involved in.
translation: Bir sey ögrenir ögrenmez bana haber ver. Ve kendine dikkat et, seni endiselendiriyorsun.

english: I'll be careful Elena. I promise.
I worry about what you've got yourself involved in. You be careful out there.
translation: Senin bulastigin seyden endiseleniyorum. Disarida kendine dikkat et.

english: I'll look after myself Elena. I promise.
translation: Kendime dikkat edecegim Elena. Söz veriyorum.

english: You'd better. Let me know as soon as you work out what's going on.
translation: Öyle yapmalisin. Ne oldugunu anladigin anda bana haber ver.

english: Good day to you.
Thank you for finding our son, you've done this kingdom a great service.
translation: Oglumuzu buldugunuz icin tesekkür ederiz, bu kralliga büyük bir hizmet ettiniz.

english: It's no...
I do wonder if his father could have done more though. My brother would have had the entire army out searching.
translation: Babasi daha fazlasini yapabilir miydi acaba? Kardesim tüm orduyu arama calismalarina seferber ederdi.

english: Your brother...
My brother is Lord Shiro Shayzien. He commands the Shayzien Army. A luxury my husband doesn't have.
translation: Kardesim Lord Shiro Shayzien. Shayzien Ordusu'nun komutanidir. Kocamin sahip olmadigi bir lüks.

english: So you...
Maybe it doesn't always have to be that way. Things may well soon be different. Now be on your way, I have things to do.
translation: Belki her zaman böyle olmak zorunda degildir. Yakinda isler degisebilir. Simdi yoluna devam et, benim yapacak islerim var.

english: Hello there.
Isn't this wonderful! My son on the throne. I always knew he'd do great things.
translation: Ne harika! Oglum tahtta. Her zaman büyük isler basaracagini biliyordum.

english: Shame about his father though, right?
Oh yes, terrible business. It breaks Artur's heart not to have him around.
translation: Evet, cok kötü bir olay. Artur, babasinin yaninda olmamasina cok üzülüyor.

english: Still, always best to focus on the positives I say.
translation: Yine de, olumlu yönlere odaklanmak her zaman en iyisidir.

english: I guess.
Hello. I...
You're the one helping to find our son.
Yes I...
It's good that you're hear to help. Artur is a good lad but he does have a habit of biting off more than he can chew.
translation: Yardim etmek icin burada olman cok iyi. Artur iyi bir cocuk ama yapabileceginden fazlasini yapmaya calisiyor.

english: I was wondering if...
He's meant for greatness you know. He'll be a king one day.
translation: O büyük isler basaracak biri. Bir gün kral olacak.

english: Don't you mean...
Lord. I meant to say lord. Now be on your way. Artur needs your help.
translation: Lord. Lord demek istedim. Simdi yoluna devam et. Artur'un yardimina ihtiyaci var.

english: Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu var. Merhaba, selam, selam...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her seyi! Kuleler muhtesem bir manzara.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmeni tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
You! Time for some questions.
Why did you join the Emissaries?
I wished to see my god in mortal form and serve his will. In return for my service, the Emissaries promised me they could grant that wish.
translation: Tanrimi ölümlü formunda görmek ve onun iradesine hizmet etmek istedim. Hizmetimin karsiliginda Elciler bana bu dilegimi yerine getireceklerine söz verdiler.

english: I wished to see my god in mortal form and be granted eternity in Mictl. In return for my service, the Emissaries promised me they could grant that wish.
translation: Tanrimi ölümlü formunda görmek ve Mictl'de sonsuzluk kazanmak istedim. Hizmetimin karsiliginda, Elciler bu dilegimi yerine getireceklerine söz verdiler.

english: Who do you worship?
I am a humble servant of Ranul. It has always been my hope to stand before him and be judged as worthy.
translation: Ben Ranul'un alcakgönüllü bir hizmetkariyim. Her zaman onun huzuruna cikip layik görüldügümü umut ettim.

english: Tell me about the Final Dawn.
The Final Dawn is the will of Ranul. He will show us all that death is nothing to be feared as he and Ralos guide us into forming a new world.
translation: Son Safak, Ranul'un iradesidir. O ve Ralos bizi yeni bir dünya kurmaya yönlendirirken, ölümün korkulacak bir sey olmadigini hepimize gösterecek.

english: The Final Dawn is the will of Ranul. He will show us all that death is nothing to be feared. He and Ralos will lead us into forming a new world before then guiding us to Mictl.
translation: Son Safak, Ranul'un iradesidir. O ve Ralos bize ölümün korkulacak bir sey olmadigini gösterecek. Bizi Mictl'e yönlendirmeden önce, yeni bir dünya kurmaya yönlendirecekler.

english: Why did you join the Emissaries?
Who do you worship?
Tell me about the Final Dawn.
Hello.
Human! You must be one of Tyras's men. I have no time for brigands or outlaws.
translation: Insan! Sen Tyras'in adamlarindan biri olmalisin. Haydutlara ve kanun kacaklarina ayiracak vaktim yok.

english: Human! You must be one of Tyras's men...
translation: Insan! Sen Tyras'in adamlarindan biri olmalisin...

english: No, I'm [player name]! Lord Iorwerth said you might be able to help me.
translation: Hayir, ben Maceraci! Lord Iorwerth, bana yardim edebilecegini söyledi.

english: And you have something to prove this?
translation: Bunu kanitlayacak bir seyin var mi?

english: Well... Err... No.
As I was saying... I have no time for brigands or outlaws.
translation: Dedigim gibi... Haydutlara ve kanun kacaklarina ayiracak vaktim yok.

english: You show the tracker the crystal pendant.
That is Lord Iorwerth's pendant. He must have a lot of faith in you. Now, what is it I can help you with?
translation: Bu Lord Iorwerth'in kolyesi. Sana cok güveniyor olmali. Simdi, sana nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: I need to find Tyras and kill him. Do you know where his camp is?
translation: Tyras'i bulup öldürmem gerekiyor. Kampinin yerini biliyor musun?

english: Well this was his old camp. After the battle a few days ago they moved. We're yet to find them again.
translation: Burasi eski kampiydi. Birkac gün önceki savastan sonra tasindilar. Henüz onlari bulamadik.

english: Can I help at all?
As it goes I'm not actually tracking them at the moment. I'm currently trying to trace our renegade brethen instead. This here is the best lead we've found so far.
translation: Aslinda su anda onlari takip etmiyorum. Su anda asi kardeslerimizin izini sürüyorum. Bu, su ana kadar buldugumuz en iyi ipucu.

english: What is?
Ahh I guess you can't see it with those human eyes.
I tell you what. Now that you're here I may as well give you a hand. I'll search here on the east side. You check out the west end of the camp. Come and tell me if you find anything.
translation: Bak ne diyecegim. Madem buradasin, sana yardim edeyim. Ben dogu tarafini arayacagim. Sen kampin bati ucunu kontrol et. Bir sey bulursan gel bana söyle.

english: I've found tracks leading off to the west. But they trail off into the trees. Beyond that I am unable to follow.
translation: Batiya giden izler buldum. Ama izler agaclarin icine giriyor. Oradan sonrasini takip edemiyorum.

english: These forests aren't always as dense as you'd think. If you look closer, you might see ways that you can get through. With that in mind, why don't you give it another go?
translation: Bu ormanlar sandigin kadar yogun degildir. Daha yakindan bakarsan, gecebilecegin yollar görebilirsin. Bunu akilda tutarak, neden bir daha denemiyorsun?

english: Thanks... I'll see what I can find.
How goes the hunt for that bandit camp?
Getting there.
I found it a short distance west of here.
translation: Buradan batiya dogru kisa bir mesafede buldum.

english: I'm sure Lord Iorwerth will be pleased to hear that. You should let him know.
translation: Lord Iorwerth bunu duyunca cok sevinecektir. Ona haber vermelisin.

english: Welcome, adventurer. Are you in need of a staff?
translation: Hos geldin, maceraci. Bir asaya ihtiyacin var mi?

english: What do you have?
No thanks.
Don't be a stranger. Come on by any time you need anything.
translation: Yabancilasma. Bir seye ihtiyacin olursa istedigin zaman ugra.

english: What do you have?
No thanks.
Hello there.
Good day to you.
What brings you here?
The eternal quest for knowledge, of course! The name's Elias White. I'm something of an explorer.
translation: Elbette, sonsuz bilgi arayisi! Adim Elias White. Ben bir tür kasifim.

english: Pleased to meet you. I'm [player name]. So you're searching for knowledge in an inn?
translation: Tanistigimiza memnun oldum. Ben Maceraci. Demek bir handa bilgi ariyorsun?

english: Not exactly. In fact, I was previously hunting down information on an ancient race deep within the desert.
translation: Tam olarak degil. Aslinda, daha önce cölün derinliklerinde eski bir irk hakkinda bilgi ariyordum.

english: However, I received an interesting yet concerning tip- off from a contact of mine regarding some of my research. I came here to investigate for myself.
translation: Ancak, arastirmamla ilgili olarak bir tanidigimdan ilginc ama endise verici bir ipucu aldim. Kendim arastirmak icin buraya geldim.

english: Oh, hello there. You look familiar. Have we met before?
translation: Merhaba. Tanidik geliyorsunuz. Daha önce tanismis miydik?

english: I think so. The name's [player name]. You're Elias, right? You had a camp out near Uzer.
translation: Sanirim. Benim adim Maceraci. Siz Elias, degil mi? Uzer yakinlarinda bir kampiniz vardi.

english: Ah, of course. You offered to help with my work, didn't you? I'm still very keen to take you up on that offer at some point, but a more pressing matter has delayed that somewhat.
translation: Tabii ki. Calismalarima yardim etmeyi teklif etmistin, degil mi? Hala o teklifi kabul etmeye cok hevesliyim, ama daha acil bir mesele bunu biraz geciktirdi.

english: Is that what's brought you here?
Indeed. I recived an interesting yet concerning tip-off from a contact of mine regarding some of my research. I came here to investigate for myself.
translation: Evet. Arastirmamla ilgili olarak bir tanidigimdan ilginc ama endise verici bir ihbar aldim. Kendim arastirmak icin buraya geldim.

english: Anything I can help with?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: How kind of you to offer. I'm not in need of any extra help right now though.
translation: Teklifin icin cok naziksin. Ama su anda ekstra yardima ihtiyacim yok.

english: How kind of you to offer. I definitely wouldn't complain about some extra support, if you're sure you're interested?
translation: Teklifin icin cok naziksin. Eger ilgileniyorsan, ekstra destekten sikayetci olmam.

english: Absolutely! So what was this tip-off you received?
Actually, I think I'll pass.
Very well. If you change your mind, I'll be here.
Ah, hello there, [player name]. Good to see you.
translation: Merhaba, Maceraci. Seni görmek ne güzel.

english: And you, Elias. So you're back out here again?
translation: Ben de seni, Elias. Yine buradasin demek?

english: Indeed. Turns out the desert was the best place to begin my research into Arrav and his heart. Not too surprising of course, given the burial practices here.
translation: Evet. Arrav ve kalbi hakkindaki arastirmami baslatmak icin en iyi yerin cöl oldugu ortaya cikti. Buradaki gömme gelenekleri göz önüne alindiginda, bu pek de sasirtici degil tabii.

english: In fact, as you might recall, I was here before to look into that old mastaba up on the plateau.
translation: Aslinda, hatirlayacagin üzere, daha önce de buradaydim, platodaki eski mastabayi incelemek icin.

english: Yes, I remember. You said it might contain important information on the Mahjarrat.
translation: Evet, hatirliyorum. Mahjarrat hakkinda önemli bilgiler icerebilecegini söylemistin.

english: Indeed I did. And I reckon it might also contain the knowledge we need to help old Arrav out.
translation: Evet, öyle demistim. Ayrica yasli Arrav'a yardim etmek icin ihtiyacimiz olan bilgileri de icerebilecegini düsünüyorum.

english: Excellent!
Now, I still have quite a bit of preparatory work to do before we consider heading inside, but once that's done, I'll be in touch.
translation: Simdi, iceri girmeden önce yapmam gereken epey hazirlik isi var, ama isim bittiginde sana haber veririm.

english: Sounds good. I'd best leave you to your work.
translation: Kulaga hos geliyor. Seni isine birakayim.

english: Until next time.
What brings you all the way out here?
Are you searching for something here?
Of course. As I said, my search is for knowledge.
translation: Elbette. Dedigim gibi, aradigim sey bilgi.

english: What kind of knowledge?
Information lost to the ages. Specifically, information on an ancient race.
translation: Yillar icinde kaybolmus bilgiler. Özellikle, eski bir irk hakkinda bilgiler.

english: And you expect to find something here?
translation: Ve burada bir sey bulmayi mi umuyorsun?

english: Not quite here, but up on the plateau. There's an old mastaba up there that I believe dates from a time when the race resided in these lands.
translation: Tam olarak burada degil, yukaridaki platoda. Orada, bu irkin bu topraklarda yasadigi dönemden kalma eski bir mastaba var.

english: Well if you ever need help raiding an ancient tomb, I reckon I can be of service.
translation: Eski bir mezari yagmalamak icin yardima ihtiyacin olursa, sana yardimci olabilirim.

english: A generous offer! I still have quite a bit of preparatory work to do before I dare head inside, but once that's done, maybe we can work something out.
translation: Cömert bir teklif! Iceri girmeye cesaret edebilmek icin hala yapmam gereken hazirliklar var, ama bunlar bittiginde, belki bir seyler ayarlayabiliriz.

english: Where do you call home?
Ah, I've lived in many places over the years, but I wouldn't really say I have a home. I guess Varrock would be the closest answer.
translation: Ah, yillar boyunca bircok yerde yasadim, ama bir evim oldugunu söyleyemem. Sanirim Varrock en yakin cevap olur.

english: Sounds like you have quite the history.
translation: Oldukca zengin bir gecmisin var gibi görünüyor.

english: Oh yes! If nothing else, I've definitely lived a varied life.
translation: Oh evet! En azindan, kesinlikle cok cesitli bir hayat yasadim.

english: So you weren't always an explorer?
Not at all. I've done all sorts of things in my time. In fact, at one point I was an adventurer like you!
translation: Hic de degil. Hayatim boyunca her türlü isi yaptim. Aslinda bir zamanlar senin gibi bir maceraciydim!

english: What happened? Some sort of life-changing injury?
translation: Ne oldu? Hayatini degistiren bir kaza mi gecirdin?

english: Thankfully not. I just found that when it came to my work, it was the history I discovered that interested me more than the treasure.
translation: Neyse ki hayir. Sadece isime gelince, hazineden cok kesfettigim tarih beni daha cok ilgilendiriyordu.

english: I'd better get going.
Hello again.
Yes.
No.
Are you searching for something here?
Where do you call home?
I'd better get going.
Hello. Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: Merhaba. Bana ciftcilikle ilgili tavsiyelerde bulunabilir misin?

english: Can't you see I'm busy?
Oh, sorry. I thought you might be able to help me with farming like other gardeners.
translation: Oh, özür dilerim. Diger bahcivanlar gibi bana ciftcilikle ilgili yardim edebilecegini düsündüm.

english: Well, I'm not the type of gardener you think I am. Just leave me alone please.
translation: Ben senin düsündügün türden bir bahcivan degilim. Lütfen beni rahat birak.

english: Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: Hey, bu Kahraman! Vay canina! Sen harikasin, o iki juvinate ve Gadderank'i nasil alt ettin? Kasaba da cok güzel, harika bir is cikarmissin!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
I'm Elisabeta the village leader.
How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: Oh, pek bir sey yok, hepimiz hala vampirlerden saklaniyoruz ve bu korkunc yerde gecimimizi sagliyoruz, umarim yakinda Salve'deki tapinaga yolculuk yapacak kadar gücleniriz.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: Bildigim kadariyla yok, su anda cok yararli olan bazi temel olanaklara sahibiz, hepimiz sana inanilmaz derecede minnettariz. Daha önce hic kahraman görmedim veya tanimadim, bu yüzden karsilastiracak bir seyim yok, ama sanirim

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: cogu insanin görüsüne göre, sen bir kahramansin! Ben sahsen seninle tanistigima cok memnunum.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Ok, thanks.
Hello!
Can I have another Rada's blessing?
translation: Bir Rada'nin kutsamasini daha alabilir miyim?

english: Not unless you free up some space.
Who are you?
I'm Elise, the taskmaster for the Kourend & Kebos Achievement Diary.
translation: Ben Elise, Kourend & Kebos Basari Günlügü'nün görev sorumlusuyum.

english: What is the Achievement Diary?
It's a diary that helps you keep track of particular achievements. In Great Kourend and the Kebos Lowlands, it can help you discover some quite useful things.
translation: Belirli basarilari takip etmenize yardimci olan bir günlüktür. Büyük Kourend ve Kebos Ovalari'nda, oldukca yararli seyler kesfetmenize yardimci olabilir.

english: Eventually, with enough exploration, you'll be rewarded.
You can see the list of tasks on the side-panel.
I have a question about my Achievement Diary.
translation: Basari Günlügümle ilgili bir sorum var.

english: Well, there are four different blessings, which match up with the four levels of difficulty. Each has the same rewards as the previous level and some additional benefits too...
translation: Dört farkli zorluk seviyesine karsilik gelen dört farkli kutsama var. Her biri bir önceki seviyeyle ayni ödüllere ve bazi ek avantajlara sahip...

english: which tier of rewards would you like to know more about?
translation: Hangi ödül seviyesini daha fazla ögrenmek istersiniz?

english: Tell me more about the Easy rewards please.
translation: Kolay ödüller hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin lütfen.

english: If you complete all of the easy tasks, you'll get a 2% chance of catching two fish at once while using the blessing, It will also provide 3 daily teleports to the Kourend Woodland, On top of that, you'll be able to
translation: Kolay görevlerin tümünü tamamlarsaniz, kutsamayi kullanirken ayni anda iki balik yakalama sansiniz %2 olur. Ayrica Kourend Ormani'na günlük 3 kez isinlanma hakki kazanirsiniz. Üstelik,

english: access Crabclaw Island for half the price, lizardmen will be more likely to drop a Xeric's talisman and Eodan in the Forthos Dungeon will now tan hide for you at 8 times the normal price down from 10 times.
translation: Crabclaw Adasi'na yari fiyatina erisebilir, kertenkele adamlarin Xeric'in tilsimini düsürme olasiligi artar ve Forthos Zindani'ndaki Eodan artik normal fiyatin 10 kati yerine 8 kati karsiliginda sizin icin deri tabaklama yapar.

english: Thanks!
Tell me more about the Medium rewards please.
translation: Orta ödüller hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin lütfen.

english: In addition to the easy rewards, you'll get a 4% chance of catching two fish at once while using the blessing. It will also provide 5 daily teleports to the Kourend Woodland. On top of that, you'll be able to access

What do you do here?
I'm helping with the dig. I'm an expert on Third Age architecture.

english: What is this place?
In the Third Age, this was a great city. Look at these giant walls! They put Varrock to shame!
translation: Ücüncü Cag'da burasi büyük bir sehirdi. Su devasa surlara bak! Varrock'u gölgede birakiyorlar!

english: I don't know, Varrock palace is impressive.
Hmph. I don't think it will look this good when it's been buried in the ground for three thousand years!
translation: Hmph. Üc bin yil boyunca topragin altinda kaldiktan sonra bu kadar güzel görünecegini sanmiyorum!

english: What happened to the city?
No one knows for sure.
But the Third Age was a time of destruction, when the gods were violently at war.
translation: Ama Ücüncü Cag, tanrilarin siddetli bir savas icinde oldugu bir yikim dönemiydi.

english: Many great civilizations were destroyed then.
translation: O dönemde bircok büyük medeniyet yok oldu.

english: I found a letter in the desert with your name on.
translation: Cölde üzerinde adin yazili bir mektup buldum.

english: Ah, so you've found the ruins of Uzer.
I wrote that letter to my late husband when he was exploring there.
translation: O mektubu, merhum kocam orada kesif yaparken yazmistim.

english: That was a great city as well, but the museum could only fund one excavation and this one was closer to home.
translation: O da büyük bir sehirdi, ama müze sadece bir kazi icin fon saglayabildi ve bu kazi evimize daha yakindi.

english: If you're interested in his expedition, the notes he made are in the library in the Exam Centre.

english: Where did you say the notes were?
They're on a bookcase in the Exam Centre.

The statuette? Oh, yes...
That statuette was the only thing we had to show from that expedition.
translation: O heykelcik, o kesif gezisinden elimizde kalan tek seydi.

english: It was very worn, but you can still make out a lot of detail. The Uzerians were expert sculptors. It's a pity we only have that small example.
translation: Cok yipranmisti, ama yine de bircok detayi ayirt edebiliyordunuz. Uzerliler usta heykeltiraslardi. Elimizde sadece o kücük örnek olmasi cok yazik.

I'll pass.

translation: Muhafizlarin sorusturmasina yardim etmek icin buradayim.

english: What's so important you need to bother me with then?
translation: O zaman beni rahatsiz edecek kadar önemli olan sey nedir?

english: Who do you think was responsible?
Could have been anyone. The old man was an idiot. He's been asking for it for years.
translation: Herkes olabilir. Yasli adam bir aptaldi. Yillardir bunu hak ediyordu.

english: Where were you when the murder happened?
I was out.
Care to be any more specific?
Not really. I don't have to justify myself to the likes of you, you know. I know the King personally you know. Now are we finished here?
translation: Hayir. Sizin gibilere kendimi aciklamak zorunda degilim. Krali sahsen taniyorum. Isimiz bitti mi?

english: Do you recognise this thread?
Looks like Blue thread to me. If you can't work that out for yourself I don't hold much hope of you solving this crime.
translation: Bana mavi iplik gibi görünüyor. Bunu kendin cözemiyorsan, bu sucu cözebilecegine pek umudum yok.

english: It looks a lot like the material your trousers are made of doesn't it?
translation: Pantolonunun kumasina cok benziyor, degil mi?

english: I suppose it does. So what?
It's some thread. You're not very good at this whole investigation thing are you?
translation: Bu bir iplik. Sorusturma islerinde pek iyi degilsin, degil mi?

english: Why'd you buy poison the other day?
There was a nest of mosquitos under the fountain in the garden, which I killed with poison the other day. You can see for yourself if you're capable of managing that, which I somehow doubt.
translation: Bahcedeki cesmenin altinda bir sivrisinek yuvasi vardi, gecen gün zehirle öldürdüm. Eger yapabiliyorsan kendin de görebilirsin, ama bunu yapabilecegini sanmiyorum.

english: I hate mosquitos!
Doesn't everyone?
Apparently you aren't as stupid as you look.
Who do you think was responsible?
Where were you when the murder happened?
Do you recognise this thread?
Why'd you buy poison the other day?
I can't believe we've finally arrived, I can't wait to explore!
translation: Sonunda vardigimiza inanamiyorum, kesfetmek icin sabirsizlaniyorum!

english: So much to see, I don't know where to start!
translation: Görülecek o kadar cok sey var ki, nereden baslayacagimi bilemiyorum!

english: A whole new continent to explore... what a time to be alive!
translation: Kesfedilecek yepyeni bir kita... Ne harika bir zaman!

english: Are you the tour guide?
Nope, I'm just as lost as you.
translation: Hayir, ben de senin kadar kayboldum.

english: I overheard someone mention there are pirates and thieves here, be careful!
translation: Burada korsanlar ve hirsizlar oldugunu duydum, dikkatli ol!

english: Hello there.
Hello, welcome to our maze. I'm Elkoy the tree gnome.
translation: Merhaba, labirentimize hos geldiniz. Ben agac cini Elkoy.

english: I haven't heard of your sort
There's not many of us left. Once you could find tree gnomes anywhere in the world, now we hide in small groups to avoid capture.
translation: Bizden pek fazla kalmadi. Eskiden agac cinlerini dünyanin her yerinde bulabilirdiniz, ama simdi yakalanmamak icin kücük gruplar halinde saklaniyoruz.

english: Capture by whom?
Tree gnomes have been hunted for so called 'fun' since as long as I can remember.
translation: Agac cinleri, hatirlayabildigim kadariyla, sözde “eglence” icin avlaniyor.

english: Our main threat nowadays are General Khazard's troops. They know no mercy, but are also very dense. They'll never find their way through our maze.
translation: Günümüzde en büyük tehdit General Khazard'in askerleri. Merhamet bilmezler, ama ayni zamanda cok aptallar. Labirentimizde asla yolunu bulamazlar.

english: Have fun.
I would be glad to help.
Thank you. The battlefield is to the north of the maze. Commander Montai will inform you of their current situation.
translation: Tesekkürler. Savas alani labirentin kuzeyinde. Komutan Montai size mevcut durumu anlatacaktir.

english: That is if he's still alive.
My assistant shall guide you out. Good luck friend, try your best to return the orb.
translation: Asistanim sizi disariya cikaracak. Iyi sanslar dostum, küreyi geri getirmek icin elinden geleni yap.

english: The player is placed at the entrance of the maze.
We're out of the maze now. Please hurry, we must have the orb if we are to survive.
translation: Artik labirentin disindayiz. Lütfen acele edin, hayatta kalmak icin küreye ihtiyacimiz var.

english: Hello Elkoy.
Oh my! Oh my!
What's wrong?
The orb, they have the orb. We're doomed. Do you need me to show you through the maze?
translation: Küre, küre onlarin elinde. Mahvolduk. Labirenti size göstermemi ister misiniz?

english: Yes please.
Please help us get our orb back.
translation: Lütfen küreyi geri almamiza yardim et.

english: Not now, thanks.
The orb, they have the orb. We're doomed. Do you need me to show you back to the village?
translation: Küre, küre onlarin elinde. Mahvolduk. Seni köye geri götürmemi ister misin?

english: The player is placed at the loose railing, the entrance to the Tree Gnome Village.
translation: Oyuncu, Agac Cüceleri Köyü'nün girisindeki gevsek korkulugun önüne yerlestirilir.

english: Hello.
You must retrieve the orb, or the gnome village is doomed. Do you need me to show you through the maze?
translation: Küreyi geri almalisin, yoksa cüce köyü mahvolacak. Labirenti sana göstermemi ister misin?

english: You're back! And the orb?
No, I'm afraid not.
Please, we must have the orb if we are to survive. Do you need me to show you through the maze?
translation: Lütfen, hayatta kalmak icin küreye ihtiyacimiz var. Labirenti sana göstermemi ister misin?

english: Hello Elkoy. I have the orb.
Take it to King Bolren, I'm sure he'll be pleased to see you.
translation: Kral Bolren'e götür, seni gördügüne sevineceginden eminim.

english: Can you show me out of the village?
Please return with our orb soon.
translation: Lütfen küremizi bir an önce geri getir.

english: Okay.
I have it here.
You're our saviour. Please return it to the village and we are all saved. Would you like me to show you the way to the village?
translation: Sen bizim kurtaricimizsin. Lütfen küreyi köye geri götür, hepimiz kurtulacagiz. Köye giden yolu göstereyim mi?

english: Here we are. Take the orb to King Bolren, I'm sure he'll be pleased to see you.
translation: Geldik. Küreyi Kral Bolren'e götür, seni gördügüne sevineceginden eminim.

english: No thanks Elkoy.
Please, we must have the orb if we are to survive.
translation: Lütfen, hayatta kalmak icin küreye ihtiyacimiz var.

english: I will find the warlord and bring back the orbs.
translation: Savas lordunu bulup küreleri geri getirecegim.

english: You are brave, but this task will be tough even for you. I wish you the best of luck. Once again you are our only hope.
translation: Cesursun, ama bu görev senin icin bile zor olacak. Sana bol sans diliyorum. Bir kez daha tek umudumuz sensin.

english: I will safeguard this orb and pray for your safe return. My assistant will guide you out.
translation: Bu küreyi koruyacagim ve güvenli bir sekilde dönmen icin dua edecegim. Asistanim sana yolu gösterecek.

english: Good luck friend.
Did you hear?
Khazard's men have pillaged the village! They slaughtered many, and took the other orbs in an attempt to lead us out of the maze. When will the misery end?
translation: Khazard'in adamlari köyü yagmalamis! Bircok kisiyi katletmisler ve bizi labirentten cikarmak icin diger küreleri almislar. Bu istirap ne zaman sona erecek?

english: Please help us find the orbs.
I'm very sorry.
Would you like me to show you the way to the village?
translation: Sana köye giden yolu göstereyim mi?

english: Here we are. Despite what has happened here, I hope you feel welcome.
translation: Iste geldik. Burada olanlara ragmen, umarim kendini rahat hissediyorsundur.

english: Ok then, take care.
translation: Tamam o zaman, kendine iyi bak.

english: You truly are a hero.
Thanks.
You saved us by returning the orbs of protection. I'm humbled and wish you well. Would you like me to show you through the maze?
translation: Koruma kürelerini geri getirerek bizi kurtardin. Cok mütesekkirim ve sana mutluluklar diliyorum. Labirenti gezdirmemi ister misin?

english: Here we are. Have a safe journey.
You saved us by returning the orbs of protection. I'm humbled and wish you well.
translation: Koruma kürelerini geri getirerek bizi kurtardin. Cok mütesekkirim ve sana mutluluklar diliyorum.

english: Here we are. Feel free to have a look around.
translation: Iste geldik. Etrafa bakinmak isterseniz bakabilirsiniz.

english: Hello, welcome to our village. I'm Elkoy the tree gnome.
translation: Merhaba, köyümüze hos geldiniz. Ben agac cini Elkoy.

english: Hi there, I hope life is treating you well. Would you like me to show you the way to the village?
translation: Merhaba, umarim hayat sana iyi davraniyordur. Sana köyün yolunu göstereyim mi?

english: Hi there, I hope life is treating you well. Would you like me to show you the way out of the village?
translation: Merhaba, umarim hayat sana iyi davraniyordur. Sana köyün cikisini göstereyim mi?

english: I would be glad to help.
Yes please.
Not now, thanks.
Can you show me out of the village?
Okay.
No thanks Elkoy.
I'm very sorry.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu var. Merhaba, selam, merhaba...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her türlü sey! Kuleler görülmeye deger harika manzaralar sunuyor.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmenizi tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Hello. Interested in honing your skills?
Yes please.
Ellen helps you improve your (selected skill) skill.
translation: Ellen, (secilen beceri) becerini gelistirmenize yardimci olur.

english: That's all the training I can give you. I hope you find it useful.
translation: Size verebilecegim tüm egitim bu kadar. Umarim faydali olur.

english: (Combat Training interface re-opens.)
I'll be here if you change your mind.
No thanks.
Hello again. I'm afraid I've given you all the training I can.
translation: Merhaba tekrar. Size verebilecegim tüm egitimi verdim.

english: Yes please.
Yes.
No.
No thanks.
Would you look after my crops for me?
You don't have a sapling planted in that patch. Plant one and I might agree to look after it for you.
translation: O tarlada fidan dikmedin. Bir tane dikersen, sana bakmayi kabul edebilirim.

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: Bana tarimla ilgili tavsiyelerde bulunabilir misin?

english: You can put up to five tomatoes, strawberries, apples, bananas or oranges into a fruit basket, although you can't have a mix in the same basket.
translation: Meyve sepetine en fazla bes domates, cilek, elma, muz veya portakal koyabilirsin, ancak ayni sepete farkli meyveleri karistiramazsin.

english: There are seven main Farming areas - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Kragen's area near Ardougne, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius, Alan's area in the Farming Guild and
translation: Yedi ana tarim alani vardir: Falador yakinlarindaki Elstan'in alani, Catherby yakinlarindaki Dantaera'nin alani, Ardougne yakinlarindaki Kragen'in alani, Morytania'daki Lyra'nin alani, Hosidius'daki Marisi'nin alani, Tarim Loncasi'ndaki Alan'in alani ve

english: Oswallt's area in Prifddinas.
Supercompost is far better than normal compost, but more expensive to make. You need to rot the right type of item; show me an item, and I'll tell you if it's super- compostable or not.
translation: Süper kompost normal komposttan cok daha iyidir, ancak yapimi daha pahalidir. Dogru türdeki ögeyi cürütebilmeniz gerekir; bana bir ögeyi gösterin, süper kompostlanabilir olup olmadigini size söyleyeyim.

english: Vegetables, hops and flowers need constant watering - if you ignore my advice, you will sooner or later find yourself in possession of a dead farming patch.
translation: Sebzeler, serbetciotu ve cicekler sürekli sulanmalidir - tavsiyemi dikkate almazsaniz, er ya da gec kendinizi ölü bir tarim arazisiyle karsi karsiya bulursunuz.

english: There is a special patch for growing Belladonna - I believe that it is somewhere near Draynor Manor, where the ground is a tad 'unblessed'.
translation: Belladonna yetistirmek icin özel bir tarla var - sanirim Draynor Malikanesi yakinlarinda, topragin biraz ‘kutsanmamis’ oldugu bir yerde.

english: Hops are good for brewing ales. I believe there's a brewery up in Keldagrim somewhere, and I've heard rumours that a place called Phasmatys used to be good for that type of thing. 'Fore they all died, of course.
translation: Serbetciotu, bira yapiminda kullanilir. Sanirim Keldagrim'de bir bira fabrikasi var ve Phasmatys adli bir yerin eskiden bu tür seyler icin uygun oldugu söyleniyordu. Tabii ki hepsi ölmeden önce.

english: Bittercap mushrooms can only be grown in a special patch in Morytania, near the Mort Myre swamp. There the ground is especially dank and suited to growing poisonous fungii.
translation: Bittercap mantarlari sadece Morytania'da, Mort Myre batakliginin yakinindaki özel bir tarlada yetistirilebilir. Orada toprak özellikle nemli ve zehirli mantarlarin yetistirilmesine uygundur.

english: You can buy all the farming tools from farming shops, which can be found close to the allotments.
translation: Tüm tarim aletlerini, tarim dükkanlarindan satin alabilirsiniz. Bu dükkanlar, tarim arazilerinin yakininda bulunur.

english: Tree seeds must be grown in a plantpot of soil into a sapling, and then transferred to a tree patch to continue growing to adulthood.
translation: Agac tohumlari, toprak dolu bir saksida fidana dönüstürülmeli ve ardindan yetiskinlige kadar büyümeye devam etmesi icin bir agac tarlasina aktarilmalidir.

english: The only way to cure a bush or tree of disease is to prune away the diseased leaves with a pair of secateurs. For all other crops I would just apply some plant-cure.
translation: Bir cali veya agaci hastaliktan kurtarmanin tek yolu, hastalikli yapraklari bir budama makasi ile budamaktir. Diger tüm mahsuller icin ise bitki ilaci kullanirim.

english: You can fill plantpots with soil from any empty patch, if you have a gardening trowel.
translation: Bahce küreginiz varsa, saksilari herhangi bir bos alandan aldiginiz toprakla doldurabilirsiniz.

english: If you need to be rid of your fruit trees for any reason, all you have to do is chop them down and then dig up the stump.
translation: Herhangi bir nedenle meyve agaclarinizdan kurtulmaniz gerekiyorsa, tek yapmaniz gereken onlari kesip köklerini kazmaktir.

english: Don't just throw away your weeds after you've raked a patch - put them in a compost bin and make some compost.
translation: Bir alani tirmikladiktan sonra yabani otlari öylece atmayin, kompost kutusuna koyun ve kompost yapin.

english: Applying compost to a patch will not only reduce the chance that your crops will get diseased, but you will also grow more crops to harvest.
translation: Bir alana kompost uygulamak, mahsulünüzün hastalanma olasiligini azaltmakla kalmaz, ayni zamanda hasat icin daha fazla mahsul yetistirmenizi de saglar.

english: If you want to make your own sacks and baskets you'll need to use the loom that's near the Farming shop in Falador. If you're a good enough craftsman, that is.
translation: Kendi cuvallarinizi ve sepetlerinizi yapmak istiyorsaniz, Falador'daki Ciftcilik dükkaninin yanindaki dokuma tezgahini kullanmaniz gerekir. Tabii yeterince iyi bir zanaatkar iseniz.

english: You don't have to buy all your plantpots you know, you can make them yourself on a pottery wheel. If you're a good enough craftsman, that is.
translation: Tüm saksilarinizi satin almaniz gerekmez, cömlek carkinda kendiniz yapabilirsiniz. Tabii yeterince iyi bir zanaatkar iseniz.

english: You can put up to ten potatoes, cabbages or onions in vegetable sacks, although you can't have a mix in the same sack.
translation: Sebze cuvallarina en fazla on adet patates, lahana veya sogan koyabilirsiniz, ancak ayni cuvalda farkli ürünleri karistiramazsiniz.

english: Can you sell me something?
That depends on whether I have it to sell. What is it that you're looking for?
translation: Satacak ürünüm olup olmadigina bagli. Ne ariyorsunuz?

english: I'll come back another time.
You're not done yet! Do this for me!
translation: Henüz isiniz bitmedi! Bunu benim icin yapin!

english: My produce can do puzzles better than that!
translation: Benim ürünlerim bundan daha iyi bulmaca cözebilir!

english: Excellent work!
Would you look after my crops for me?
Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: Bana tarimla ilgili tavsiyelerde bulunabilir misin?

english: Can you sell me something?
I'll come back another time.
Hey, how can I help you?
What do you do here?
This is one of the branches for Mahogany Homes, Gielinor's first construction company.
translation: Burasi Gielinor'un ilk insaat sirketi olan Mahogany Homes'un subelerinden biri.

english: Oh wow, how can I get involved?
If you go see Amy in the Falador branch, she'll fill you in. Her office is just east of the Estate Agent in Falador.
translation: Falador subesindeki Amy'yi görürsen, sana bilgi verir. Ofisi Falador'daki Emlakci'nin hemen dogusunda.

english: Nice, thank you.
Greetings friend. I am a manufacturer of leather.
Can I buy some leather then?
translation: O zaman biraz deri satin alabilir miyim?

english: I make leather from animal hides. Bring me some cowhides and one gold coin per hide, and I'll tan them into soft leather for you.
translation: Hayvan derilerinden deri yapiyorum. Bana biraz sigir derisi ve deri basina bir altin getir, ben de onlari yumusak deriye dönüstüreyim.

english: Leather is rather weak stuff.
Normal leather may be quite weak, but it's very cheap - I make it from cowhides for only 1 gp per hide - and it's so easy to craft that anyone can work with it.
translation: Normal deri oldukca zayif olabilir, ama cok ucuzdur - sigir derilerinden deri yapiyorum ve deri basina sadece 1 altin aliyorum - ve islenmesi o kadar kolay ki herkes kullanabilir.

english: Alternatively you could try hard leather. It's not so easy to craft, but I only charge 3 gp per cowhide to prepare it, and it makes much sturdier armour.
translation: Alternatif olarak sert deriyi deneyebilirsiniz. Islenmesi o kadar kolay degildir, ama hazirlamak icin deri basina sadece 3 altin para aliyorum ve cok daha saglam zirhlar yapiliyor.

english: I can also tan snake hides and dragonhides, suitable for crafting into the highest quality armour for rangers.
translation: Ayrica yilan derisi ve ejderha derisi de tabaklayabiliyorum, bunlar rangerlar icin en yüksek kalitede zirhlar yapmak icin uygundur.

english: Thanks, I'll bear it in mind.
I see you have brought me a hide. Would you like me to tan it for you?
translation: Bana bir deri getirmissin. Senin icin tabaklamami ister misin?

english: I see you have brought me some hides. Would you like me to tan them for you?
translation: Bana birkac deri getirmissin. Senin icin tabaklamami ister misin?

english: Yes please.
No thanks.
Very well, [sir/madam], as you wish.
Er... Thanks, but no thanks!
Can I buy some leather then?
translation: O zaman biraz deri alabilir miyim?

english: Leather is rather weak stuff.
Yes please.
No thanks.
I'm sorry to bother you, but could you spare me a little dung?
translation: Rahatsiz ettigim icin özür dilerim, ama bana biraz gübre verebilir misiniz?

english: The camel didn't seem to appreciate that question.
translation: Deve bu soruyu pek begenmedi galiba.

english: If I go near that camel, it'll probably bite my hand off.
translation: O deveye yaklasirsam, muhtemelen elimi isirir.

english: Mmm... looks like that camel would make a nice kebab.
translation: Mmm... Bu deve güzel bir kebap olur gibi görünüyor.

english: I wonder if that camel has fleas...
Are you serious?
Oh yes. If you'd be so kind...
Well, just you close your eyes first. I'm not doing it while you're watching me!
translation: Önce gözlerini kapat. Sen izlerken yapmam!

english: I hope that's what you wanted!
Ohhh yes. Lovely.
Did you say something?
No, er, nothing important.
Well, it's nice to have someone to talk to.
Ollie is so remote, and I can't get up the courage to talk to him...
translation: Ollie cok uzak ve ona konusmaya cesaret edemiyorum...

english: Who's Ollie?
He's the camel wandering around near that glider.
Isn't he so strong-looking and handsome?
translation: Cok güclü ve yakisikli degil mi?

english: Er... he just looks like any other camel to me.
How can you not see how wonderful he is?
translation: Onun ne kadar harika oldugunu nasil göremezsin?

english: Why, he can cross the Kharidian Desert in three bounds, and he's so strong that he could haul the brick for the Emir's Arena in only a day!
translation: Kharidian Cölü'nü üc adimda gecebilir ve o kadar güclü ki Emir'in Arenasi'nin tuglalarini bir günde tasiyabilir!

english: You're a camel, I'm not. Maybe you can see these things better.
translation: Sen deve'sin, ben degilim. Belki sen bunlari daha iyi görebilirsin.

english: For someone who understands camel speech, you're not good at these things.
translation: Deve dilini anlayan biri icin, bu konularda pek iyi degilsin.

english: Ask the camel about its dung.
Say something unpleasant.
Neither - I'm a polite person.
translation: Ikisi de degil - ben kibar biriyim.

english: Can I help you today?
Can I go for a ride?
Minecart rides are 20 coins.
Of course.
I'm fine, thanks.
As a loyal customer of the Lovakengj Minecart Network, you're entitled to this.
translation: Lovakengj Maden Arabasi Agi'nin sadik bir müsterisi olarak, buna hakkin var.

english: Now, can I help you today?
translation: Simdi, bugün sana nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: You're already here, human.
Can I go for a ride?
I'm fine, thanks.
What's a gnome doing here?
I'm an investigator. I'm watching the implings.
Why would you want to do that?
My client has asked me to find out where certain missing items have been going.
translation: Müsterim, kaybolan bazi esyalarin nereye gittigini bulmami istedi.

english: Who is this client?
I'm not at liberty to discuss that. Investigator-client confidentiality don't you know.
translation: Bunu konusma özgürlügüm yok. Dedektif-müsteri gizliligi, bilirsin.

english: Where is this place?
The fairies call it Puro-Puro. It seems to be the home plane of the implings.
translation: Periler buraya Puro-Puro diyor. Implinglerin ana düzlemi gibi görünüyor.

english: I don't think these creatures have a name for it. As you can see there isn't a lot else here other than wheat.
translation: Bu yaratiklarin buraya bir isim verdiklerini sanmiyorum. Gördügün gibi burada bugdaydan baska pek bir sey yok.

english: How did you get here?
The same way you did, I suspect. Through a portal in a wheat field. I followed one back.
translation: Sanirim seninle ayni sekilde. Bugday tarlasindaki bir portaldan. Birini takip ettim.

english: I haven't noticed them do that.
That's why I'm the investigator and you're the adventurer.
translation: Bu yüzden ben arastirmaciyim, sen ise maceracisin.

english: So, what are these implings?
That's a very interesting question. My best guess is that they are relatives to imps, which is why there are imps here as well.
translation: Bu cok ilginc bir soru. En iyi tahminim, onlarin imp'lerin akrabalari oldugu, bu yüzden burada imp'lerin de oldugu.

english: Implings do appear to like collecting objects and, as my clients have noted, have no concept of ownership. However, I do not sense any malicious intent.
translation: Implingler nesneleri toplamayi seviyor gibi görünüyor ve müsterilerimin de belirttigi gibi, sahiplik kavrami yok. Ancak, herhangi bir kötü niyet hissetmiyorum.

english: It is my observation that they collect things that other creatures want, rather than they want them themselves. It seems to provide them with sustenance.
translation: Gözlemlerime göre, kendileri icin degil, diger yaratiklarin istedigi seyleri topluyorlar. Bu onlara besin sagliyor gibi görünüyor.

english: So they feed off our desire for things?
translation: Yani bizim nesnelere olan arzularimizdan besleniyorlar mi?

english: Possibly. Either way, it seems that they almost exclusively collect things that people want, except their younglings who I infer haven't learnt the best things to collect yet.
translation: Muhtemelen. Her halükarda, henüz neyin toplanmasi gerektigini ögrenmemis olan yavrulari haric, neredeyse sadece insanlarin istedigi nesneleri topluyorlar gibi görünüyor.

english: So the more experienced implings have the more desirable items?
translation: Yani daha deneyimli implingler daha degerli nesnelere sahip mi?

english: That is my observation. Yes.
Can I catch these implings, then?
translation: O zaman bu implingleri yakalayabilir miyim?

english: Indeed you may. In fact I encourage it. You will, however, require some equipment.
translation: Elbette yakalayabilirsiniz. Hatta bunu yapmanizi tavsiye ederim. Ancak bazi ekipmanlara ihtiyaciniz olacak.

english: Firstly you will need a butterfly net in which to catch them and at least one special impling jar to store an impling.
translation: Öncelikle, onlari yakalamak icin bir kelebek agina ve implingleri saklamak icin en az bir özel impling kavanozuna ihtiyaciniz olacak.

english: You will also require some experience as a Hunter since these creatures are elusive. The more immature implings require less experience, but some of the rarer implings are extraordinarily hard to find and catch.
translation: Bu yaratiklar zor bulunur oldugundan, Avci olarak biraz deneyime de ihtiyaciniz olacak. Daha olgunlasmamis implingler daha az deneyim gerektirir, ancak bazi nadir implingleri bulmak ve yakalamak son derece zordur.

english: Once you have caught one, you may break the jar open and obtain the object the impling is carrying. Alternatively, you may exchange certain combinations of jars with me. I will return the jars to my clients. In
translation: Bir impling yakaladiginizda, kavanozu kirip implingin tasidigi nesneyi alabilirsiniz. Alternatif olarak, belirli kavanoz kombinasyonlarini benimle takas edebilirsiniz. Kavanozlari müsterilerime iade edecegim.

english: exchange I will be able to provide you with some equipment that may help you hunt butterflies more effectively.
translation: Karsiliginda, kelebekleri daha etkili bir sekilde avlamaniza yardimci olabilecek bazi ekipmanlar saglayabilirim.

english: Also, beware. Those imps walking around the maze do not like the fact that their kindred spirits are being captured and will attempt to steal any full jars you have on you, setting the implings free.
translation: Ayrica, dikkatli olun. Labirentte dolasan bu implingler, türdeslerinin yakalanmasindan hoslanmazlar ve üzerinizdeki dolu kavanozlari calmaya calisarak implingleri serbest birakirlar.

english: I've heard I may find dragon equipment in Puro-Puro.

Have you indeed? Well, that may well be true, though bear in mind that implings are quite small so they are unlikely to be lugging a sizeable shield around with them. However, since it seems that dragon items are
translation: Öyle mi? Bu dogru olabilir, ancak implinglerin oldukca kücük olduklarini ve büyük bir kalkan tasimalarinin pek olasi olmadigini unutma. Ancak, ejderha esyalari

english: very desirable to humans then it certainly is possible that the most expert implings may try to obtain such equipment.
translation: insanlar icin cok cazip oldugu icin, en uzman implinglerin bu tür ekipmanlari elde etmeye calismasi kesinlikle mümkündür.

english: So, it's true then? Cool!
I should warn you, though, if the impling is strong enough to collect dragon equipment, then you will have to be very skilled at hunting implings in order to catch them.
translation: Ancak, impling ejderha ekipmanlarini toplayacak kadar güclüyse, onlari yakalamak icin impling avlamada cok yetenekli olman gerekecegini belirtmeliyim.

english: Ah, good day, it's you again. What can I do for you?
translation: Ah, merhaba, yine sen. Senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: Ah, I notice you don't own an impling collector's scroll.
translation: Ah, impling toplayici parsömenine sahip olmadigini fark ettim.

english: Elnock gives you a scroll. If you check it whilst in the maze, you will see how many of each impling you have captured.
translation: Elnock sana bir parsömen verir. Labirentteyken bunu kontrol edersen, yakaladigin her impling türünün sayisini görebilirsin.

english: No thanks.
Can you remind me how to catch implings again?
Certainly.

You cannot use an ordinary butterfly jar as a container as the implings will escape from them with ease. However, I have done some investigation and have come up with a solution - if a butterfly jar is coated
translation: Siradan bir kelebek kavanozu kap olarak kullanamazsin, cünkü implingler onlardan kolayca kacarlar. Ancak, biraz arastirma yaptim ve bir cözüm buldum. Kelebek kavanozunun icini, implingler icin zararli olan ince bir maddeyle kaplarsan

english: with a thin layer of a substance noxious to them they become incapable of escape.
What substance is that, then?
I have tried a few experiments with the help of a friend back home, and it turns out that a combination of anchovy oil and flowers - marigolds, rosemary or nasturtiums - will work.
translation: Evdeki bir arkadasimin yardimiyla birkac deney yaptim ve hamsi yagi ile ciceklerin (kadife cicegi, biberiye veya nasturtium) karisiminin ise yaradigini gördüm.

english: How do you make anchovy oil then?
I'd grind up some cooked anchovies and pass them through a sieve.
Where do I make these jars?
Well, I believe there is a chemist in Rimmington that has a small still that you could use.
translation: Rimmington'da kullanabileceginiz kücük bir damitma cihazi olan bir kimyager var sanirim.

english: Is there anywhere I can buy these jars?
Well I may be able to let you have a few - if it means you will start hunting these implings - although I do not have an infinite supply.
translation: Eger bu implingleri avlamaya baslayacaksan, sana birkac tane verebilirim, ama stokum sinirsiz degil.

english: Tell me more about these thieving imps.
translation: Bu hirsiz implingler hakkinda daha fazla bilgi ver.

english: Imps and implings appear to be related, and the imps here are quite protective of their smaller relations. If you allow them to get too close then they will attempt to steal jarred implings from your pack, if you have them.
translation: Imp ve implingler akraba gibi görünüyor ve buradaki implingler, daha kücük akrabalarini oldukca koruyorlar. Eger onlara cok yaklasirsan, cantandan kavanozda bulunan implingleri calmaya calisirlar.

english: They will then set them free, dropping your jar on the floor. So, if you're quick, you may be able to catch it again.
translation: Sonra onlari serbest birakip kavanozunu yere düsürecekler. Yani, hizli olursan, onu tekrar yakalayabilirsin.

english: I have some impling deterrent which I may trade if you prove that you can catch implings well.
translation: Iplingleri iyi yakalayabildigini kanitlarsan, takas edebilecegim bazi impling caydiricilarim var.

english: So what's this equipment you can give me, then?
translation: Peki, bana verebilecegin bu ekipman nedir?

english: I have been given permission by my clients to give three pieces of equipment to able hunters.
translation: Müsterilerimden yetenekli avcilara üc parca ekipman vermem icin izin aldim.

english: Firstly, I have some imp deterrent. If you bring me three baby implings, two young implings and one gourmet impling already jarred, I will give you a vial. Imps don't like the smell, so they will be less likely to
