english: What do I have to do in this room?

In this chamber you will see various piles of shapes. You can pick up these shapes and enchant them using the enchant jewelry spells. By enchanting these shapes, you'll be converting them into orbs which you can be placed in the hole in the centre. You will get Enchantment Pizazz Points for every ten shapes that you convert and the points you get depends on the level of enchantment spell you cast. You will get a bonus Pizazz Point for enchanting a certain shape at a certain time, which I will periodically shout out. You will also be rewarded with an item for every so many orbs you deposit into the hole.
translation: Bu odada cesitli sekillerden olusan yiginlar göreceksiniz. Bu sekilleri alip mücevher büyüsü kullanarak onlari büyüleyebilirsiniz. Bu sekilleri büyüleyerek, onlari merkezdeki delige yerlestirebileceginiz küreler haline getireceksiniz. Büyülediginiz her on sekil icin Büyü Pizazz Puani kazanacaksiniz ve kazandiginiz puanlar, kullandiginiz büyü seviyesine bagli olacaktir. Belirli bir zamanda belirli bir sekli büyülü hale getirdiginizde bonus Pizazz Puani kazanacaksiniz, bunu periyodik olarak duyuracagim. Ayrica, delige koydugunuz her küre icin bir öge ile ödüllendirileceksiniz.

english: What are the rewards?

As well as the magic experience from casting your enchantment spells, you will get Enchantment Pizazz Points for converting so many shapes, plus a bonus point for converting a shape of the correct type. You should also note that you will occasionally be rewarded with items when you put one of the enchanted orbs in the floor.
translation: Büyü büyüleri kullanarak kazandiginiz sihirli deneyimin yani sira, cok sayida sekli dönüstürdügünüz icin Büyü Pizazz Puani ve dogru türdeki bir sekli dönüstürdügünüz icin bonus puan kazanacaksiniz. Büyülü kürelerden birini zemine koydugunuzda da zaman zaman esyalarla ödüllendirileceginizi unutmayin.

english: Got any tips that may help me?
translation: Bana yardimci olabilecek herhangi bir ipucu var mi?

english: Try to guess or keep track of the time between the changes of the best shape to enchant. This means you can be ready to run to a different shape when you know it is about to change. Look out for the dragon gems, as these will get you more Pizazz Points!
translation: Büyülemek icin en uygun seklin degistigi zamani tahmin etmeye veya takip etmeye calisin. Böylece, seklin degismek üzere oldugunu anladiginizda farkli bir sekle gecmeye hazir olabilirsiniz. Ejderha mücevherlerine dikkat edin, bunlar size daha fazla Pizazz Puani kazandiracak!

english: I see.

english: So...what are you doing here?

Let me open my account and then I'll give you the runes.
No way! I'm not paying to withdraw my own money.
translation: Olmaz! Kendi parami cekmek icin para ödemeyecegim.

english: I'd like to talk to you about quick payment deals.
translation: Hizli ödeme anlasmalari hakkinda sizinle konusmak istiyorum.

english: What rune do I currently have set for my quick payment?
translation: Hizli ödemem icin su anda hangi rune ayarli?

english: Yes
No
I would like to cancel our quick payment deal.
translation: Hizli ödeme anlasmamizi iptal etmek istiyorum.

english: Woah, that's not the cut I asked for!
translation: Vay canina, istedigim kesim bu degil!

english: Hey, my cut is perfect, leave it alone!
Short on top!
Breezy on the back!
Short on back and sides!
A leafy mullet!
Now I look snazzy! Thanks!
That feels better! Thanks!
That's perfect! Thanks!
Almost time to go!
Well done, you've given [X] entlings haircuts!
I didn't... create this cave for... you to do that... sorry, it's not for you.
translation: Ben bu magarayi... senin bunu yapman icin... yaratmadim... üzgünüm, bu senin icin degil.

english: wooooo ooo woo-woo
Hi.
Greetings. What wisdom do you seek?
I'm new to this place. Where am I?

Well young one, you have entered the Magic Training Arena. It was built at the start of the Fifth Age, when runestones were first discovered. It was made because of the many pointless accidents caused by inexperienced
translation: Genc dostum, Sihirli Egitim Arenasi'na girdin. Burasi, run taslarinin ilk kesfedildigi Besinci Cag'in basinda insa edildi. Deneyimsiz büyücüler tarafindan neden olunan bircok anlamsiz kaza nedeniyle yapildi.

english: mages.
Who created it?

Good question. It was originally made by the ancestors of the wizards in the Wizards Tower. However, it was destroyed by melee and ranged warriors who took offence at the use of this new 'Magic Art'. Recently,
translation: Iyi soru. Aslen Büyücü Kulesi'ndeki büyücülerin atalari tarafindan yapildi. Ancak, bu yeni “Büyü Sanati”nin kullanimina kizan yakin dövüscüler ve menzilli savascilar tarafindan yikildi. Son zamanlarda,

english: the current denizens of the Wizards Tower have resurrected the arena including various Guardians you will see as you look around. We are here to help and to ensure things run smoothly.
translation: Büyücü Kulesi'nin su anki sakinleri, etrafina baktiginda görecegin cesitli Muhafizlar da dahil olmak üzere arenayi yeniden insa etti. Bizler, yardim etmek ve her seyin sorunsuz yürümesi icin buradayiz.

english: Interesting. So what can I do here?

You may train up your skill in the magic arts by travelling through one of the portals at the back of this entrance hall. By training up in one of these areas you will be awarded special Pizazz Points unique to
translation: Bu giris salonunun arkasindaki portallardan birinden gecerek sihir sanatlarindaki becerilerinizi gelistirebilirsiniz. Bu alanlardan birinde egitim alarak, her odaya özgü özel Pizazz Puanlari kazanacaksiniz.

english: each room. With these points you may claim a variety of items from my fellow guardian up the stairs.
translation: Bu puanlarla, merdivenlerin yukarisindaki koruyucu arkadasimdan cesitli esyalar alabilirsiniz.

english: How do you record the points I have earned?
You really are full of questions! You will need a special Pizazz Progress Hat! I can give you one if you so wish to train here.
translation: Gercekten cok soru soruyorsun! Özel bir Pizazz Ilerleme Sapkasi'na ihtiyacin olacak! Burada egitim almak istiyorsan sana bir tane verebilirim.

english: Yes please!
Ah, I'm afraid I can't give it to you as you don't have room to carry it!
translation: Ah, maalesef sana veremem cünkü onu tasiyacak yerin yok!

english: Here you go. Talk to the hat to find out your current Pizazz Point totals.
translation: Al bakalim. Sapkayla konusarak mevcut Pizazz Puani toplamini ögrenebilirsin.

english: Talk to it?
Well of course, it's a magic Pizazz Progress Hat! Mind your manners though, hats have feelings too!
translation: Tabii ki, bu sihirli bir Pizazz Progress Sapkasi! Ama davranislarina dikkat et, sapkalarin da duygulari vardir!

english: Er... if you insist.

Oh, and a word of warning: should you decide to leave the rooms by any method other than the exit portals, you will be teleported to the entrance and have any items that you picked up in the room removed.
translation: Oh, ve bir uyari: cikis portallarindan baska bir yolla odalardan ayrilmaya karar verirsen, girise isinlanacaksin ve odada topladigin tüm esyalar elinden alinacak.

english: Can you explain the different portals?
They lead to four areas to train your magic: The Telekinetic Theatre, The Alchemists' Playground, The Enchanting Chamber, and The Creature Graveyard.
translation: Sihirli yeteneklerini gelistirebilecegin dört alana aciliyorlar: Telekinetik Tiyatro, Kimyagerlerin Oyun Alani, Büyüleyici Oda ve Yaratik Mezarligi.

english: What's the Telekinetic Theatre?
In there you can earn Telekinetic Pizazz Points for trade upstairs.
translation: Orada, üst katta takas etmek icin Telekinetik Pizazz Puanlari kazanabilirsin.

english: What will I be doing in there?

That depends on how much of a time-waster you are! You are required to use the Telekinetic Grab spell in order to move a statue through a maze. Casting the spell will move the statue towards you until it reaches
translation: Bu, ne kadar zaman kaybeden biri oldugunuza bagli! Labirentte bir heykeli hareket ettirmek icin Telekinetik Yakalama büyüsünü kullanmaniz gerekir. Büyüyü yaptiginizda heykel size dogru hareket eder ve bir duvara ulasana kadar devam eder.

english: a wall. So by standing on the different sides of the maze you can move the statue North, East, South or West. You will be rewarded Pizazz Points for each maze successfully solved.
translation: Labirentin farkli taraflarinda durarak heykeli kuzeye, doguya, güneye veya batiya hareket ettirebilirsiniz. Basariyla cözdügünüz her labirent icin Pizazz Puanlari kazanirsiniz.

english: It will be clearer when you arrive and there's a Guardian through the portal that will be able to tell you more. There's a book you can buy from the Rewards Guardian upstairs that will explain it all.
translation: Oraya vardiginizda daha net anlayacaksiniz ve portalin icinde size daha fazla bilgi verebilecek bir Guardian var. Yukaridaki Rewards Guardian'dan satin alabileceginiz, her seyi aciklayan bir kitap var.

english: What's the Alchemists' Playground?
In the playground you can earn Alchemist Pizazz Points for trading with the rewards guardian upstairs.
translation: Oyun alaninda, yukaridaki Rewards Guardian ile ticaret yaparak Alchemist Pizazz Puanlari kazanabilirsiniz.

english: What's in there?

You'll find eight cupboards containing items you can turn to gold using the low and high alchemy spells. The money you earn will be taken from you upon leaving the playground to pay for the upkeep of this training
translation: Düsük ve yüksek simya büyülerini kullanarak altina dönüstürebileceginiz ögeler iceren sekiz dolap bulacaksiniz. Kazandiginiz para, bu egitim alaninin bakim masraflarini karsilamak ve Gielinor cevresindeki sihir dükkanlarina fon saglamak icin oyun alanindan ayrilirken sizden alinacaktir.

english: arena and to help fund magic shops around Gielinor. You will be rewarded with 1 Pizazz Point for every 100 coins deposited and a percentage of the money you create. Keep in mind that you will not be able to take
translation: Yatirdiginiz her 100 sikke icin 1 Pizazz Puani ve yarattiginiz paranin bir yüzdesi ile ödüllendirileceksiniz. Unutmayin ki,

english: more than 1000 coins back out with you.
Sounds simple.
I am afraid not, for the cost of the items varies, as does their locations in the cupboards. You'll see a list of item costs that will help you decide what you should be converting to gold.
translation: Maalesef öyle degil, cünkü esyalarin maliyeti ve dolaplardaki yerleri degiskenlik gösteriyor. Neyi altina dönüstürmeniz gerektigine karar vermenize yardimci olacak bir esya maliyeti listesi göreceksiniz.

english: Fear not, it will be clearer when you arrive and there's a Guardian through the portal that will be able to tell you more. You can also buy a book from the Rewards Guardian upstairs that will explain it all.
translation: Korkmayin, vardiginizda her sey daha net olacak ve portalin ötesinde size daha fazla bilgi verebilecek bir Muhafiz olacak. Ayrica, üst kattaki Ödül Muhafizi'ndan her seyi aciklayan bir kitap satin alabilirsiniz.

english: What's the Enchanting Chamber?
In here you will be able to earn Enchantment Pizazz Points for trade upstairs.
translation: Burada, üst katta takas etmek icin Büyü Pizazz Puanlari kazanabilirsiniz.

english: What will I have to do?

You will find yourself amongst various piles of shapes. You can pick up these shapes and use one of your enchanting spells upon it to morph it into an orb. You'll also see a hole in the centre of the room; put the orbs
translation: Kendinizi cesitli sekillerden olusan yiginlarin arasinda bulacaksiniz. Bu sekilleri alip, büyüleme büyülerinden birini kullanarak onlari küreye dönüstürebilirsiniz. Odanin ortasinda bir delik göreceksiniz; küreleri buraya koyun

english: in here and for every 20 we will credit you with a gift. You will get Pizazz Points for every 10 shapes that you convert and the amount of points depends on the spell you use.
translation: ve her 20 küre icin size bir hediye verecegiz. Dönüstürdügünüz her 10 sekil icin Pizazz Puani kazanacaksiniz ve puan miktari kullandiginiz büyüye baglidir.

english: What's the difference between the shapes?

Ah, you will be notified of a different shape that will give you a bonus Pizazz Point when you convert that shape. You should also look out for dragon stones, as these will give you more Pizazz Points when you
translation: Ah, o sekli dönüstürdügünüzde size bonus Pizazz Puani kazandiracak farkli bir sekil hakkinda bilgilendirileceksiniz.

english: convert them.
translation: Ayrica ejderha taslarina da dikkat etmelisiniz, cünkü bunlari dönüstürdügünüzde size daha fazla Pizazz Puani kazandiracaklar.

english: It will be clearer when you arrive and there's a Guardian through the portal that will be able to tell you more. You can also buy a book from the Rewards Guardian upstairs that will explain it all.
translation: Oraya vardiginizda daha net anlasilacaktir ve portalin ötesinde size daha fazla bilgi verebilecek bir Muhafiz olacaktir. Ayrica üst kattaki Ödül Muhafizindan her seyi aciklayan bir kitap satin alabilirsiniz.

english: What's the Creature Graveyard?
In here you will be able to earn Graveyard Pizazz Points for trade upstairs.
translation: Burada, üst kattaki ticaret icin Mezarlik Pizazz Puanlari kazanabilirsiniz.

english: But what do I have to do in there?

Patience young one. A great many creatures die in this world and much of their remains can cause clutter. We have taken it upon ourselves to teleport many bones from these creatures into this graveyard for a
translation: Sabirli ol genc dostum. Bu dünyada cok sayida yaratik ölür ve kalintilari daginikliga neden olabilir. Bu yaratiklarin kemiklerini bu mezarliga isinlayarak

english: use. It's up to you to practice your bones to bananas spell in order to put these bones into immediate use - nutritious food for monsters! Just convert the bones and put them in the holes in the walls. There is a
translation: kullanmak Bu kemikleri hemen kullanmak icin kemiklerden muz yapma büyüsünü uygulamak sana kalmis - canavarlar icin besleyici bir yiyecek! Kemikleri dönüstür ve duvardaki deliklere koy. Ancak bu odanin bir

english: drawback to this room however, the bones often fall on people so you may want to eat some of those bananas to stay alive. When people die we confiscate Pizazz Points for the effort of teleporting incompetent mages.
translation: dezavantaji var, kemikler sik sik insanlarin üzerine düsüyor, bu yüzden hayatta kalmak icin o muzlardan biraz yemen iyi olabilir. Insanlar öldügünde, beceriksiz büyücüleri teleport etmek icin harcadigimiz cabadan dolayi Pizazz Puanlarini el koyuyoruz.

english: What else do I get from this besides bruises?
translation: Cürükler disinda bundan baska ne kazanacagim?

english: As well as the Pizazz Points for giving us the bananas, you will be credited with runestones for your efforts, and you may be able to save up for a new kind of spell to use in the graveyard!
translation: Bize muz verdiginiz icin Pizazz Puanlarinin yani sira, cabalariniz icin run taslari da kazanacaksiniz ve mezarlikta kullanmak icin yeni bir tür büyü icin para biriktirebileceksiniz!

english: It will be clearer when you arrive and one of my fellow guardians through the portal will be able to tell you more. You can also buy a book from the Rewards Guardian upstairs that will explain it all.
translation: Oraya vardiginizda daha net anlayacaksiniz ve portalin diger tarafindaki koruyucularimdan biri size daha fazla bilgi verebilir. Ayrica üst kattaki Ödül Koruyucusu'ndan her seyi aciklayan bir kitap satin alabilirsiniz.

english: Thanks, bye!
Use what you have learned.
None, I don't really care.
You won't gain with that attitude.
Can you tell me about this place again?
translation: Bu yer hakkinda tekrar bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Very well. You have entered the magic training arena. It was built at the start of the Fifth Age, when runestones were first discovered. It was built to put an end to many pointless accidents involving inexperienced
translation: Tabii. Büyü egitim arenasina girdin. Burasi, run taslarinin ilk kesfedildigi Besinci Cag'in basinda insa edildi. Deneyimsiz büyücülerle ilgili bircok anlamsiz kazayi önlemek icin insa edildi.

english: You may train up your skill in the magic arts by travelling through one of the portals at the back of this building. By training up in one of these areas you will be awarded Pizazz Points unique to each room. With
translation: Bu binanin arkasindaki portallardan birinden gecerek sihir sanatlarindaki becerilerinizi gelistirebilirsiniz. Bu alanlardan birinde egitim alarak, her odaya özgü Pizazz Puanlari kazanacaksiniz.

english: these points you may claim a variety of items from my fellow guardian up the stairs.
translation: Bu puanlarla, merdivenlerin yukarisindaki koruyucu arkadasimdan cesitli esyalar talep edebilirsiniz.

english: How do you record the Pizazz Points I have earned?
With the Pizazz Progress Hat I gave you, of course.
translation: Tabii ki sana verdigim Pizazz Ilerleme Sapkasi ile.

english: OK.
Oh, and a word of warning: should you decide to log out whilst in any of the rooms in the arena, you will be teleported to the entrance and have any items that you picked up in the room removed.
translation: Oh, ve bir uyari: arenadaki odalardan herhangi birindeyken cikis yapmaya karar verirsen, girise isinlanacaksin ve odada topladigin tüm esyalar silinecek.

english: You want another one don't you.
translation: Bir tane daha istiyorsun, degil mi?

english: Sorry, can I?
Yes. What's it for?

Collect Pizazz Points from the various areas and the hat will remember your totals. Talk to the hat at any time to find out what points you have. Go upstairs and talk to the Rewards Guardian to claim items for the
translation: Cesitli alanlardan Pizazz Puanlari topla, sapka toplam puanini hatirlayacaktir. Ne kadar puan topladigini ögrenmek icin istedigin zaman sapka ile konus. Yukari cik ve Ödül Muhafizi ile konusarak puanlarin karsiliginda esyalari al.

english: points.
I'm new to this place. Where am I?
What's the Telekinetic Theatre?
What's the Alchemists' Playground?
What's the Enchanting Chamber?
What's the Creature Graveyard?
Thanks, bye!
None, I don't really care.
Can you tell me about this place again?
Can you explain the different portals?
About the progress hat...
Hello, thanks for rescuing me. Is there anything I can do for you?
translation: Merhaba, beni kurtardigin icin tesekkürler. Senin icin yapabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: How did you end up down here?

I travelled down here with my friend Olbertus in search for treasure. When we didn't find anything except his strange structure, he decided to prise off a coin from the stone relief in the other room. Before I knew it the entrance had closed and I was stuck down here.
translation: Arkadasim Olbertus ile hazine aramak icin buraya geldik. Onun garip yapisi disinda hicbir sey bulamadigimizda, diger odadaki tas kabartmadan bir sikke koparmaya karar verdi. Bir anda giris kapisi kapandi ve ben burada mahsur kaldim.

english: I tried calling out to Olbertus but he must not have heard me. I don't know what would've happened if you hadn't shown up and saved me.
translation: Olbertus'a seslenmeye calistim ama beni duymamis olmali. Sen gelip beni kurtarmasaydin ne olurdu bilmiyorum.

english: Well, it turns out Olbertus was corrupted by the coin he stole, I managed to get the coin from him and returned it to the relief, he should be fine now.
translation: Meger Olbertus caldigi madeni paranin etkisiyle yozlasmis. Madeni parayi ondan alip kabartmaya geri koydum, simdi iyi olmali.

english: That's good news at least.
I am quite the proficient tanner, for helping me escape I will offer to tan hides for you. However, they'll be at a slightly higher cost for the convenience of being closer to the source.
translation: Ben oldukca yetenekli bir tabakciyim, kacmama yardim ettigin icin sana deri tabaklama hizmeti sunacagim. Ancak, kaynaga daha yakin olmanin rahatligi icin fiyati biraz daha yüksek olacak.

english: Now that you're free, why don't you leave?
translation: Artik özgür olduguna göre, neden gitmiyorsun?

english: To be honest, I tried to set up a Tannery on the surface but business was poor, there aren't a lot of dragons in Kourend.
translation: Dürüst olmak gerekirse, yüzeyde bir tabakhane kurmaya calistim ama isler kötü gitti, Kourend'de cok fazla ejderha yok.

english: I even heard a rumour that people have learned to tan hides with magic. It's always the same! Magic users stealing jobs from honest tradesman!
translation: Hatta insanlarin derileri büyüyle tabaklamayi ögrendiklerine dair bir söylenti duydum. Her zaman ayni! Büyü kullanicilari dürüst esnaflarin islerini caliyor!

english: Erm... Yeah! Those magic users...
Oh, wow! I can see why that wouldn't help business.
translation: Oh, vay canina! Bunun islere neden yardimci olmayacagini anlayabiliyorum.

english: Anyway, I figured if I was closer to the source of the hides then I might get more business. So I'll try setting up shop down here for a while.
translation: Her neyse, derilerin kaynagina daha yakin olursam daha fazla is alabilecegimi düsündüm. Bu yüzden bir süreligine burada dükkan acmayi deneyecegim.

english: How did you end up down here?
Now that you're free, why don't you leave?
translation: Artik özgür olduguna göre, neden gitmiyorsun?

english: Can you tan some hides for me?
I'm good thanks.
Hi!
Hi, can I help?
Welcome to Burthorpe Castle! Home to his Royal Highness the Prince of Burthorpe, Heir to the Throne of Asgarnia!
translation: Burthorpe Kalesi'ne hos geldiniz! Burthorpe Prensi, Asgarnia Tahti'nin varisi, Majestelerinin evi!

english: Wow!
Anything else I can help you with?
translation: Baska yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Where is the prince?
We do not disclose his majesty's business.
Do you have any quests for me?
translation: Bana verebileceginiz bir görev var mi?

english: Yes actually I do, we need another servant.
translation: Aslinda var, baska bir hizmetciye ihtiyacimiz var.

english: Does this noble quest have a name?
translation: Bu asil görevin bir adi var mi?

english: Yes, it's the... er... Empty the Cesspit Quest!
translation: Evet, adi... sey... Cöplügü Bosaltma Görevi!

english: I'll give it a miss!
No, I'm just looking around.
I'm looking for the guard that was on last night.
translation: Dün gece nöbet tutan muhafizi ariyorum.

english: There was only one guard on last night. Harold. He's a nice lad, if a little dim.
translation: Dün gece sadece bir muhafiz vardi. Harold. Biraz aptal olsa da iyi bir delikanlidir.

english: Do you know where he is staying?
Harold is staying at the Toad and Chicken.
Thanks!
Do you know of another way up Death Plateau?
translation: Death Plateau'ya cikan baska bir yol biliyor musun?

english: No, sorry. I wouldn't want to go north-east from here, it's very rocky and barren.
translation: Hayir, üzgünüm. Buradan kuzeydoguya gitmek istemezdim, cok kayalik ve corak bir yer.

english: Where is the guard that was on last night staying?
translation: Dün gece nöbet tutan gardiyan nerede kaliyor?

english: Harold is staying at the local inn, the Toad and Chicken.
translation: Harold yerel han olan Toad and Chicken'da kaliyor.

english: I found Harold but he won't talk to me!
Hmm. Harold has got in trouble a few over his drinking and gambling. Perhaps he'd open up after a drink?
translation: Hmm. Harold icki ve kumar yüzünden birkac kez basini belaya soktu. Belki bir icki ictikten sonra konusur?

english: Thanks, I'll try that!
You said Harold had a weakness?
translation: Harold'in bir zayifligi oldugunu mu söyledin?

english: Yes, if you buy Harold a beer he might talk to you. I also know he has a weakness for gambling. Hope that helps!
translation: Evet, Harold'a bir bira ismarlarsan seninle konusabilir. Ayrica kumara da zaafi oldugunu biliyorum. Umarim yardimci olur!

english: Thanks for the help!
I have a question for you.
Please enter the answer to the question.
No, try again.
Correct!
What is this castle?
Where is the prince?
Do you have any quests for me?
translation: Bana verebileceginiz bir görev var mi?

english: No, I'm just looking around.
I'm looking for the guard that was on last night.
translation: Dün gece nöbet tutan muhafizi ariyorum.

english: Do you know of another way up Death Plateau?
translation: Ölüm Platosu'na cikan baska bir yol biliyor musunuz?

english: Where is the guard that was on last night staying?
translation: Dün gece nöbet tutan muhafiz nerede kaliyor?

english: Hello.
Sorry, I cannot stop or Iona will catch me, we are playing tag!
translation: Üzgünüm, durmamam lazim yoksa Iona beni yakalayacak, kovalamaca oynuyoruz!

english: Thank you for saving me. Mummy says you're a hero after what you did.
translation: Beni kurtardiginiz icin tesekkür ederim. Annem yaptiginiz seyden sonra sizin bir kahraman oldugunuzu söylüyor.

english: Hello.
Good day. What can I help you with?
I would like to buy some equipment.
Who are you?
Well, you must be a new arrival. I am Erdan, a descendant of Uhld.
translation: Yeni gelmis olmalisin. Ben Erdan, Uhld'un torunuyum.

english: Uhld? I've seen that inscribed on that big old statue down below. What's that about?
translation: Uhld mu? Asagidaki büyük eski heykelde bu yaziyi görmüstüm. Ne anlama geliyor?

english: It's also on the fountain in the dungeon below, it displays their emblem.
translation: Asagidaki zindandaki cesmede de var, onlarin amblemini gösteriyor.

english: Whose emblem?
The Sect of Uhld, the founders of this here guild. I may not have gained entrance to this guild in the usual fashion, but I'd expect that they'd at least inform new members of this guild's history.
translation: Uhld Tarikati'nin, bu guildin kurucularinin. Bu guilde normal yolla girmis olmayabilirim, ama en azindan yeni üyelere guildin tarihini anlatmalarini beklerdim.

english: Perhaps they expected you, a descendant of Uhld, to fill me in on the matter.
translation: Belki de Uhld'un soyundan gelen senin bana bu konuyu anlatmani bekliyorlardi.

english: Aye, that may well be the case.
Look, I'm awfully busy, what with the recent influx of members, so I'll give you the short version for now.
translation: Bak, son zamanlarda üye akini oldugu icin cok mesgulüm, o yüzden simdilik sana kisa bir özet verecegim.

english: Fair enough.
The story my father told me was of a war on magic. Of god fearing men who believed nothing good would come of wielding a power that was never meant for them.
translation: Babamin bana anlattigi hikaye, büyüyle ilgili bir savasti. Kendileri icin yaratilmamis bir gücü kullanmanin hicbir iyi sonuc getirmeyecegine inanan, Tanri'dan korkan adamlar.

english: And so the rune temples that man had created were under threat. Before long, all were destroyed and thus forgotten.
translation: Ve böylece, insanin yarattigi rune tapinaklari tehdit altinda kaldi. Kisa süre sonra, hepsi yok edildi ve böylece unutuldu.

english: But the wrath that these Gunnites embraced rippled through the pocket dimensions. Supposedly, a new altar of power was discovered.
translation: Ancak Gunnitlerin kucakladigi öfke, cep boyutlarinda dalgalandi. Söylenene göre, yeni bir güc sunagi kesfedildi.

english: The wrath altar?
Indeed. The temple was destroyed just as construction had finished, and a nearby nomadic group called the Sect of Uhld were not pleased with the brutality they witnessed.
translation: Aynen öyle. Tapinak, insaati biter bitmez yikildi ve yakinlarda yasayan Uhld Tarikati adli göcebe bir grup, tanik olduklari vahsetten hosnut degildi.

english: They quickly established this guild with information preservation as their core goal, for men are recorders of history and magic is key for this to last.
translation: Hizla, bilgiyi korumayi temel amaclari olarak belirleyen bu loncayi kurdular, cünkü insanlar tarihin kayitcilaridir ve bunun devami icin sihir anahtardir.

english: Did the... er, Gunnites, return?
Of course they did, but the Sect of Uhld had used the information gained from the wrath altar, and with a spell of their own making, they destroyed the southern runecrafting crusade with much ease.
translation: Elbette döndüler, ama Uhld Mezhebi öfke sunaklarindan elde ettikleri bilgileri kullanarak, kendi yarattiklari bir büyüyle güneydeki rün yapim hacli seferini kolaylikla yok ettiler.

english: Huh, that's fascinating.
Indeed it is, but I best get back to work, so unless you wish to trade, that is all.
translation: Gercekten öyle, ama isime dönsem iyi olacak, yani takas yapmak istemiyorsan, hepsi bu kadar.

english: Thanks for the history lesson, Erdan.
No problem!
I'll be off.
Just passing by.
As you wish.
I would like to buy some equipment.
Who are you?
I'll be off.
Just passing by.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu var. Merhaba, selam, merhaba...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her seyi! Kuleler muhtesem bir manzara.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmeni tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Hello, I'm the tax collector. Got any windows I can tax?
translation: Merhaba, ben vergi tahsildariyim. Vergilendirebilecegim penceren var mi?

english: I dream of windows.
Hello, I'm the tax collector. I'm taxing beards and I can't help noticing you have a beard.
translation: Merhaba, ben vergi tahsildariyim. Sakallari vergilendiriyorum ve sakalin oldugunu fark ettim.

english: What? I'm a beggar. Do I look as if I have any money? Look, take everything I own why don't you?
translation: Ne? Ben bir dilenciyim. Param varmis gibi mi görünüyorum? Bak, sahip oldugum her seyi al, neden almiyorsun?

english: Err, thanks. Maybe I don't need to tax you.
translation: Sey, tesekkürler. Belki de senden vergi almam gerekmez.

english: No, take it!
I don't care any more.
Spare us a few coppers [mister/miss]
No, go away!
Ooh, I'm all dizzy...
Why's that?
Well, watching that wheel go round and round and round...
translation: Sey, o carkin dönüp durmasini izlemek...

english: and round and round and round...
Looks like you need a bit of a rest.
and round and round and round again...
See you around!
Very funny.
Ahhh. Thank you, I'll take few minutes from spinning to enjoy this.
translation: Ahhh. Tesekkürler, birkac dakika dönmeyi birakip bunun tadini cikaracagim.

english: Here you go, you solved it!
Thank you [sir/m'lady]. It was dreadfully irritating being a chicken. How can I ever thank you?
translation: Tesekkürler . Tavuk olmak cok sinir bozucuydu. Size nasil tesekkür edebilirim?

english: Well a cash reward is always nice...
Of course, of course.
Hello there.
Clear off! Let me drink in peace!
translation: Defol! Birak da huzur icinde iceyim!

english: Okay then.
Hello. Welcome to the Gielinor Housing Agency! What can I do for you?
translation: Merhaba. Gielinor Emlak Ajansi'na hos geldiniz! Sizin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: How can I get a house?
I can sell you a starting house in Rimmington for 1000 coins. As you increase your construction skill you will be able to have your house moved to other areas and redecorated in other styles.
translation: Rimmington'da 1000 sikke karsiliginda baslangic evi satabilirim. Insaat becerini gelistirdikce evini baska bölgelere tasiyabilir ve baska tarzlarda yeniden dekore edebilirsin.

english: Do you want to buy a starter house?
translation: Baslangic evi satin almak ister misin?

english: Yes please!
I haven't got 1,000 coins on me.
Well come back when you have it then.
translation: O zaman paran oldugunda tekrar gel.

english: Thank you. Go through the Rimmington house portal and you will find your house ready for you to start building in it.
translation: Tesekkürler. Rimmington ev portalindan gecin, evinizin insaatina baslayabileceginiz sekilde hazir oldugunu göreceksiniz.

english: This book will help you to start building your house.
translation: Bu kitap evinizi insa etmeye baslamaniza yardimci olacak.

english: No thanks.
Well enjoy your player-owned cardboard box or wherever you're going to sleep tonight!
translation: O zaman oyuncuya ait karton kutunuzda veya bu gece nerede uyuyacaksaniz orada iyi eglenceler!

english: It all came out of the wizards' experiments. They found a way to fold space, so that they could pack many acres of land into an area only a foot across.
translation: Hepsi büyücülerin deneylerinden ortaya cikti. Uzayi katlamanin bir yolunu buldular, böylece birkac dönüm araziyi sadece 30 cm genisliginde bir alana sigdirabildiler.

english: They created several folded-space regions across Gielinor. Each one contains hundreds of small plots where people can build houses.
translation: Gielinor'da birkac katlanmis uzay bölgesi olusturdular. Her biri, insanlarin ev insa edebilecegi yüzlerce kücük arsa iceriyor.

english: Ah, so that's how everyone can have a house without them cluttering up the world!
translation: Ah, demek bu sayede herkes ev sahibi olabiliyor ve dünya da daginik hale gelmiyor!

english: Quite. The wizards didn't want to get bogged down in the business side of things so they hired me to sell the houses.
translation: Aynen öyle. Büyücüler isin ticari yönüyle ugrasmak istemediler, bu yüzden evleri satmam icin beni tuttular.

english: There are various other people across Gielinor who can help you furnish your house.
translation: Gielinor'da evinizi dösemenize yardimci olabilecek baska kisiler de var.

english: You should start by buying planks from a sawmill operator. Sawmills are located in north-east Varrock, the Woodcutting Guild located in south-west Hosidius and north-east Prifddinas.
translation: Öncelikle bir kereste fabrikasindan tahtalar satin almalisiniz. Kereste fabrikalari Varrock'un kuzeydogusunda, Odun Kesme Loncasi ise Hosidius'un güneybatisinda ve Prifddinas'in kuzeydogusunda bulunuyor.

english: Can you move my house please?
Where would you like it moved to?
To Rimmington please!
Your house is already there!
Hmph. Come back when you have 5,000 coins.
Your house has been moved to Rimmington.
To Taverley please!
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 10.
translation: Korkarim, oraya tasinmak icin yeterince yüksek Insaat seviyeniz yok. Seviye 10 olmaniz gerekiyor.

english: Your house has been moved to Taverley.
To Pollnivneach please!
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 20.
translation: Maalesef, oraya tasinmak icin yeterli Insaat seviyeniz yok. 20. seviyeye ulasmaniz gerekiyor.

english: Hmph. Come back when you have 7,500 coins.
Your house has been moved to Pollnivneach.
To Hosidius please!
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 25.
translation: Maalesef, oraya tasinmak icin yeterli Insaat seviyeniz yok. 25. seviyeye ulasmaniz gerekiyor.

english: Hmph. Come back when you have 8,750 coins.
Your house has been moved to Hosidius.
To Rellekka please!
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 30.
translation: Maalesef, oraya tasinmak icin yeterli Insaat seviyen yok. 30. seviyeye ulasman gerekiyor.

english: Hmph. Come back when you have 10,000 coins.
Your house has been moved to Rellekka.
To Brimhaven please!
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 40.
translation: Korkarim oraya tasinmak icin yeterli Insaat seviyeniz yok. 40. seviyeye ulasmaniz gerekiyor.

english: Hmph. Come back when you have 15,000 coins.
Your house has been moved to Brimhaven.
To Yanille please!
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 50.
translation: Korkarim oraya tasinmak icin yeterli Insaat seviyeniz yok. 50. seviyeye ulasmaniz gerekiyor.

english: Hmph. Come back when you have 25,000 coins.
Your house has been moved to Yanille.
To Prifddinas please!
Where? Never heard of it.
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 70.
translation: Korkarim oraya tasinmak icin yeterli Insaat seviyen yok. 70 seviyeye ulasman gerekiyor.

english: Hmph. Come back when you have 50,000 coins.
Your house has been moved to Prifddinas.
Can you redecorate my house please?
translation: Evinizi yeniden dekore edebilir misiniz lütfen?

english: Certainly. My magic can rebuild the house in a completely new style! What style would you like?
translation: Elbette. Sihirimle evi tamamen yeni bir tarzda yeniden insa edebilirim! Hangi tarzi istersiniz?

english: Basic wood
Your house is already in that style!
Your house has been redecorated.
I'm afraid you haven't unlocked that style.
Hmph. Come back when you have 35,000 coins.
I'm afraid I'd need some blueprints for that.
translation: Korkarim bunun icin bazi planlara ihtiyacim var.

english: I'm afraid I'd need some blueprints for that. Maybe you can buy some by working for the contractors.
translation: Korkarim bunun icin bazi planlara ihtiyacim var. Belki müteahhitler icin calisarak bazilarini satin alabilirsin.

english: Absolutely. Hand me your blueprints and I'll make it happen! I'll keep the blueprints, so you'll always be able to switch back to this style in future, for a small fee.
translation: Elbette. Planlarini bana ver, ben hallederim! Planlari saklayacagim, böylece gelecekte kücük bir ücret karsiliginda her zaman bu stile geri dönebileceksin.

english: Could I have a Construction guide book?
You've already got one!
Not until you free up some inventory space.
Certainly.
Tell me about houses!
Tell me about that skillcape you're wearing.

As you may know, skillcapes are only available to masters in a skill. I have spent my entire life building houses and now I spend my time selling them! As a sign of my abilities I wear this Skillcape of Construction.
translation: Bildigin gibi, beceri pelerinleri sadece bir beceride usta olanlar tarafindan kullanilabilir. Hayatim boyunca evler insa ettim ve simdi de onlari satarak zamanimi geciriyorum! Becerilerimin bir göstergesi olarak bu Insaat Beceri Pelerini giyiyorum.

english: If you ever have enough skill to build a demonic throne, come and talk to me and I'll sell you a skillcape like mine.
translation: Eger seytani bir taht insa edecek kadar yetenekli olursan, gel benimle konus, sana benimki gibi bir beceri pelerini satarim.

english: The Cape of Construction also provides you with as many teleports as you like to any of the house portals or even directly inside!
translation: Insaat Pelerini ayrica istedigin kadar ev portallarina veya hatta dogrudan evlerin icine isinlanmani saglar!

english: Can you sell me a Skillcape of Construction?
translation: Bana Insaat Beceri Pelerini satabilir misiniz?

english: Alright, that'll be 99000 coins, please. A small price to pay for such an illustrious cape that can teleport you to any of the house portals or even directly inside your house!
translation: Tamam, 99.000 sikke lütfen. Sizi herhangi bir ev portalina veya hatta dogrudan evinizin icine isinlayabilen böylesine muhtesem bir pelerin icin ödenecek kücük bir bedel!

english: I'm not paying that!
Suit yourself. There are many other heroes who would love the opportunity to purchase one. You can find me here if you change your mind.
translation: Istediginiz gibi yapin. Bu pelerini satin alma firsatini kacirmak istemeyen bircok kahraman var. Fikrinizi degistirirseniz beni burada bulabilirsiniz.

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: Ama maalesef yanimda yeterince param yok.

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.
translation: Peki, paran oldugunda tekrar gelip beni gör.

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: Maalesef tüm Skillcapes sadece ücretsiz kapüsonla satiliyor, bu bir beceri promosyonunun parcasi; bir alana bir bedava, bilirsin. Yani sana bir tane satabilmem icin önce envanterinde yer acman gerekiyor.

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: Harika! O pelerini gururla giy dostum.

english: How can I get a house?
Yes please!
No thanks
Tell me about houses!
Can you move my house please?
Rimmington

Whitewashed stone
Fremennik-style wood
Tropical wood
Fancy stone
Deathly mansion
Twisted theme
