Could I have a Construction guide book?
Tell me about that skillcape you're wearing.
translation: Giydigin beceri pelerini hakkinda bilgi verir misin?

english: Can you sell me a Skillcape of Construction?
translation: Bana Insaat Beceri Pelerini satabilir misin?

english: I'm not paying that!
Certainly, that sounds fair.
Is this place haunted?
I don't think so. Would it matter if it was?
translation: Sanmiyorum. Öyle olsa ne fark eder ki?

english: Maybe, it depends how haunted. I'm not a big fan of ghosts.
translation: Belki, ne kadar hayaletli olduguna bagli. Hayaletleri pek sevmem.

english: Well, let's hope it's not haunted!
Have you thought about painting the building?
I'm thinking a nice bold red, like the dragon armour.
translation: Ejderha zirhi gibi güzel, koyu kirmizi bir renk düsünüyorum.

english: Or maybe a green, in memory of Elvarg, a very mean dragon.
translation: Ya da cok kötü bir ejderha olan Elvarg'in anisina yesil olabilir.

english: I think green would look great, it would match the surroundings, too!
translation: Yesil harika olur, cevreye de uyum saglar!

english: Could I get one of those rune platebodies?
translation: O rune zirhlardan bir tane alabilir miyim?

english: Well, normally you'd have to slay a dragon for me...
translation: Normalde bunun icin bir ejderha öldürmen gerekir...

english: ...but maybe I can make an exception once I've moved in here.
translation: ...ama buraya tasindiktan sonra bir istisna yapabilirim.

english: As a little thank you for the help!
translation: Yardimin icin kücük bir tesekkür olarak!

english: That would be great! Let's get this deal done quickly.
translation: Harika olur! Hadi bu isi cabuk halledelim.

english: I can't wait to complete the purchase!
It's almost done Oziach, not much longer.
translation: Neredeyse bitti Oziach, biraz daha sabret.

english: Do you have any plans for it?
I have a few. I might convert the top floor into a bar!
translation: Birkac tane var. En üst kati bara cevirebilirim!

english: It'll be for all dragon slayers I know, there's a lot of us!
translation: Tanidigim tüm ejderha avcilari icin olacak, sayimiz cok fazla!

english: Interesting use of such a beautiful property!
translation: Böyle güzel bir mülkü ilginc bir sekilde kullanacaksin!

english: OoooOooOoOoOoooooooo!
Ah!! Why did you do that?
That scared me!
I'm sorry! I was just pretending to be a ghost.
Don't do that! I don't like ghosts.
Hello.
Sorry [player name], I'm talking to Oziach right now.
translation: Üzgünüm Maceraci, su anda Oziach ile konusuyorum.

english: I'm going to head back to the office.
Alright, I'll see you later. Can't wait to move in!
translation: Tamam, sonra görüsürüz. Tasinmak icin sabirsizlaniyorum!

english: I know, it's a lovely place! See you!
translation: Biliyorum, cok güzel bir yer! Görüsürüz!

english: The estate agent leaves.
Ahhh... soon to be mine.
The cutscene ends.
A cutscene starts. The estate agent arrives, and approaches Oziach.
translation: Bir kesme sahnesi baslar. Emlakci gelir ve Oziach'a yaklasir.

english: So many ghosts... I need some help!
translation: Cok fazla hayalet var... Yardima ihtiyacim var!

english: Oziach! Are you okay? I heard shouting!
Hello! It's not going well. There are a lot of ghosts here!
translation: Merhaba! Isler yolunda gitmiyor. Burada cok fazla hayalet var!

english: That's not good at all!
Do you still want to go ahead with the purchase?
Of course! TWO ghosts is scary, but not that scary!
translation: Tabii ki! Iki hayalet korkutucu, ama o kadar da degil!

english: I'll hire myself one of those slayers we see everywhere.
translation: Her yerde gördügümüz avcilardan birini tutacagim.

english: They will help with the ghost problem!
Phew, that is lovely news! I thought it was all over, then.
translation: Phew, bu harika bir haber! Her seyin bittigini sanmistim.

english: I'll head back to the office, meet me there shortly.
translation: Ofise geri dönecegim, birazdan orada bulusalim.

english: I'll be doing the final paperwork.
Are you here to fight the cold?
Umm... I guess?
Great! Ask me anything you like about the Bruma tree, I'm an expert.
translation: Harika! Bruma agaci hakkinda ne istersen sor, ben bu konuda uzmanim.

english: Tell me about the Wintertodt.
Some would say that ice preserves while fire destroys, but no amount of fire is destroying the Wintertodt. That's a cold that will freeze the air in your lungs.
translation: Bazilari buzun korudugunu, atesin ise yok ettigini söyler, ama hicbir ates Wintertodt'u yok edemez. Bu, cigerlerindeki havayi donduran bir soguktur.

english: Even the heat generated from burning the Bruma roots only weakens it, and that doesn't last very long nowadays.
translation: Bruma köklerini yakarak elde edilen isi bile onu sadece zayiflatir ve bu da günümüzde cok uzun sürmez.

english: Looks like an angry snow storm to me...
translation: Bana öfkeli bir kar firtinasi gibi görünüyor...

english: What you see in that pit is not the Wintertodt at full strength. It never will be while the Bruma tree still burns and the Doors of Dinh remain closed.
translation: O cukurda gördügün sey Wintertodt'un tam gücü degil. Bruma agaci hala yanarken ve Dinh Kapilari kapaliyken asla tam gücü olmayacak.

english: Tell me about the Bruma tree.
The Bruma tree is what keeps the Wintertodt weak. The prison was built here by Dinh because of its usefulness against the Wintertodt.
translation: Bruma agaci Wintertodt'u zayif tutan seydir. Hapishane, Wintertodt'a karsi yararli oldugu icin Dinh tarafindan buraya insa edildi.

english: Some legends say that Xeric is the cause for the Doors weakening, or maybe he made the Wintertodt stronger?
translation: Bazi efsanelere göre Xeric, Kapilarin zayiflamasina neden oldu, ya da belki Wintertodt'u daha güclü hale getirdi?

english: Is Xeric really such a bad guy?
translation: Xeric gercekten o kadar kötü bir adam mi?

english: It's a known fact that he was interested in the Bruma tree. For what purpose... there are only rumours.
translation: Bruma agaciyla ilgilendigi bilinen bir gercek. Ne amacla... sadece söylentiler var.

english: Regardless, the Bruma tree definitely contains powerful magic. I've been studying the sap for years and it has truly astounding properties.
translation: Her ne olursa olsun, Bruma agaci kesinlikle güclü bir sihir iceriyor. Yillardir özsuyu inceliyorum ve gercekten sasirtici özellikleri var.

english: There's not many fires that burn green now, are there?
translation: Artik yesil yanan cok fazla ates yok, degil mi?

english: What about gnomish fire lighters?
Tell me about yourself.
Me? I'm a member of the Woodcutting Guild. More of a researcher though... I'm currently tasked with growing a new Bruma tree.
translation: Ben mi? Ben Odun Kesme Loncasi üyesiyim. Daha cok arastirmaciyim... Su anda yeni bir Bruma agaci yetistirmekle görevliyim.

english: How's that going?
Poorly. I believe the Bruma tree can only be grown in a freezing cold climate.
translation: Kötü. Bruma agacinin sadece dondurucu soguk iklimlerde yetisebilecegine inaniyorum.

english: Well, isn't that here?
translation: Burasi öyle bir yer degil mi?

english: It's just an idea really. For all I know, it could be magic way beyond me, beyond even the Pyromancers.
translation: Bu sadece bir fikir. Bildigim kadariyla, bu benim, hatta Pyromancers'in bile anlayamayacagi bir sihir olabilir.

english: See you later.
Goodbye!
Tell me about the Wintertodt.
Tell me about the Bruma tree.
translation: Bruma agaci hakkinda bana bilgi ver.

english: Tell me about yourself.
See you later.
This looks like an interesting island.
translation: Burasi ilginc bir ada gibi görünüyor.

english: Oh it is.
Fancy a race!?!
What? That's a bit sudden. What kind of race?
translation: Ne? Bu biraz ani oldu. Ne tür bir yaris?

english: I bet I can beat you to the other end of this island, I'll take the left route and you can take the right.
translation: Bu adanin diger ucuna senden önce varacagima bahse girerim, ben sol yolu alacagim, sen sag yolu al.

english: That doesn't seem fair - mine's all curvy and yours is straight.
translation: Bu adil degil, benim yolum virajli, seninki düz.

english: Well, that's life I'm afraid, it's never as easy as you would like, you have to take the path that's dealt!
translation: Korkarim hayat böyle, asla istedigin kadar kolay olmaz, sana verilen yolu gitmek zorundasin!

english: If you insist.
You'll see, so how about it?
On your marks!
Get set!
Go !!!
No thanks.
Have it your way.
You beat me.
Woo hoo! Ha ha! You can try again if you want, but you'll never beat me, I'm far too fast!
translation: Yasasin! Ha ha! Istersen tekrar deneyebilirsin, ama beni asla yenemezsin, ben cok hizliyim!

english: Eat my dust!
You're right, I'm far too slow.
You give up too easily, but have it your way.
translation: Cok kolay pes ediyorsun, ama sen bilirsin.

english: Oh, hello? Looks like you'll probably want to start again.
translation: Oh, merhaba? Görünüse göre yeniden baslamak isteyeceksin.

english: I won!
Noooo! How could you beat me?
Very well.
I'm just making the most of the abilities I worked hard to develop. That's all!
translation: Sadece gelistirmek icin cok calistigim yeteneklerimi en iyi sekilde kullaniyorum. Hepsi bu!

english: True. A very important thing to remember! Now be gone!
translation: Dogru. Unutulmamasi gereken cok önemli bir sey! Simdi git buradan!

english: Ok.
No thanks.
Eat my dust!
You're right, I'm far too slow.
Can I help you at all?
No thanks.
Yes please. What are you selling?
No thanks.
What is it you want?
Can I kill the dragons up here?
I suppose that's okay since you've got a Slayer assignment. But when you've finished it, leave the rest for me!
translation: Slayer görevin oldugu icin sorun yok sanirim. Ama isin bittiginde geri kalanini bana birak!

english: Don't even think about it - these dragons up here are for me!
translation: Aklindan bile gecirme - buradaki ejderhalar benim icin!

english: There's a Slayer Master in my family, so I don't stop people doing their Slayer assignments, but otherwise these dragons are for me, not you.
translation: Ailemde bir Slayer Ustasi var, bu yüzden insanlarin Slayer görevlerini yapmalarini engellemiyorum, ama aksi takdirde bu ejderhalar benim icin, senin icin degil.

english: What are you here for?
Dragon-slaying, of course. Do I look like one of those serfs who wanders around scavenging scales off the floor? I'm just having a rest now, before I get back to the fight.
translation: Ejderha avlamak icin tabii ki. Yerdeki pullari toplayan köle gibi mi görünüyorum? Savasa dönmeden önce biraz dinleniyorum.

english: My cousin Slieve built the access routes through this blue dragon lair. But she's only really interested in black dragons, not blue ones, so she said I could have this area for myself.
translation: Kuzenim Slieve bu mavi ejderha inine erisim yollarini insa etti. Ama o sadece siyah ejderhalarla ilgileniyor, mavi ejderhalarla degil, bu yüzden bu alani bana birakti.

english: Why are you dressed like that?
It's hot in here with all the dragonfire.
translation: Burada ejderha atesi yüzünden cok sicak.

english: Don't you need armour, though?
I've got wizard boots on, see? What more would I want?
translation: Büyücü botlarim var, görmüyor musun? Daha ne isteyebilirim ki?

english: Well, maybe you'd want something to help you fight the dragons? Wizard boots don't sound very useful.
translation: Belki ejderhalarla savasmana yardimci olacak bir sey istersin? Büyücü botlari pek kullanisli görünmüyor.

english: They're useful enough for what I'm doing. Anyway, moving on...
translation: Yaptigim is icin yeterince kullanislilar. Neyse, devam edelim...

english: Never mind.
Off you go.
Oi, find yourself some other dragons - these are mine!
translation: Hey, kendine baska ejderhalar bul, bunlar benim!

english: Can I kill the dragons up here?
What are you here for?
Why are you dressed like that?
Never mind.
Hey Eve!
[player name]! You're back! Here to party some more?
translation: Maceraci! Geri dönmüssün! Biraz daha parti yapmak icin mi geldin?

english: You never get sick of partying, do you?
Well, you see, I spend the rest of the year in the afterlife. And that is quite boring.
translation: Sey, ben yilin geri kalanini öbür dünyada geciriyorum. Ve bu oldukca sikici.

english: The afterlife?
Yes. You know, where you go when you die. Anyway, that's boring stuff. Coming back here is fun!
translation: Evet. Bilirsin, öldügünde gittigin yer. Neyse, bu sikici bir konu. Buraya geri dönmek eglenceli!

english: How do you come back?
Magic, my friend!
What kind of magic?
You wouldn't understand. If you're so interested, talk to the other people around here. They've returned from the afterlife as well!
translation: Anlamazsin. Eger bu kadar ilgileniyorsan, buradaki diger insanlarla konus. Onlar da öbür dünyadan geri döndüler!

english: Have they? Interesting.
Goodbye.
Come back soon!
What kind of magic?
Goodbye.
Do you wanna meet my pet? His name's Pete. Or has this amulet of humanspeak broken again?
translation: Evcil hayvanimla tanismak ister misin? Adi Pete. Yoksa bu insan dili muskasi yine bozuldu mu?

english: Player is teleported to ScapeRune prison
You leave the cat alone, and the cat leaves you alone.
translation: Kediyi rahat birakirsan, kedi de seni rahat birakir.

english: Hey, [player name], come with me if you like fishing! Or has this amulet of humanspeak broken again?
translation: Hey, Maceraci, balik tutmayi seviyorsan benimle gel! Yoksa bu insan dili muskasi yine bozuldu mu?

english: Player is teleported to Evil Bob's Island
Evil Bob doesn't seem interested in you.
translation: Evil Bob seninle ilgilenmiyor gibi görünüyor.

english: Evil Bob is no longer interested in you.
So you've been captured too?
Captured?
Yes, Evil Bob captured me and stuck me in this prison.
translation: Evet, Evil Bob beni yakaladi ve bu hapishaneye atti.

english: How do I get out of here? I can't be held captive by a cat!
translation: Buradan nasil cikacagim? Bir kedi tarafindan esir tutulmam!

english: Some of these balloon animals have keys in them, and if you pull the big lever it tells you which shape animal contains the correct key, but I can never find it.
translation: Bu balon hayvanlarin bazilarinin icinde anahtar var ve büyük kolu cektiginde hangi sekilli hayvanin dogru anahtari icerdigini söylüyor, ama ben onu asla bulamiyorum.

english: You need to pull the lever to find out which shape animal contains the key, then pop that sort of animal to get the key.
translation: Hangi sekilli hayvanin anahtari icerdigini ögrenmek icin kolu cekmelisin, sonra o tür hayvani patlatarak anahtari almalisin.

english: Bring me any keys you get and I'll try them on the doors.
translation: Buldugun anahtarlari bana getir, kapilarda deneyeyim.

english: Okay.
But I wan't to leave now.
Oh. Well I guess you can leave but I'll still be stuck here.
translation: Oh. Sen gidebilirsin ama ben burada kalacagim.

english: What is this place?
Don't you remember? This is ScapeRune's prison. Evil Bob caught you and brought you here.
translation: Hatirlamiyor musun? Burasi ScapeRune'un hapishanesi. Evil Bob seni yakaladi ve buraya getirdi.

english: What gives him the right to lock me up? I demand to see a lawyer! I know my rights!
translation: Beni hapsetmeye ne hakki var? Avukat görmek istiyorum! Haklarimi biliyorum!

english: Evil Bob doesn't care about people's rights. He's cruel and utterly merciless. He's a cat.
translation: Evil Bob insanlarin haklarini umursamaz. O acimasiz ve merhametsizdir. O bir kedidir.

english: Come on, we should leave before Evil Bob comes back! You go first; I'll follow along.
translation: Hadi, Evil Bob geri gelmeden gitmeliyiz! Sen önce git, ben de pesinden gelirim.

english: Oi! we'll be using the exit that's over here.
You're meant to pull the lever to find out which sort of animal to pop!
translation: Hangi hayvani patlatacagini ögrenmek icin kolu cekmelisin!

english: That's right, pull it. Then remember what kind of animal shape you see. That's the animal that contains the right key.
translation: Dogru, cek onu. Sonra gördügün hayvanin seklini hatirla. Dogru anahtari iceren hayvan odur.

english: Great, now you've got a key! Bring it to me so I can try it on the doors.
translation: Harika, artik bir anahtarin var! Kapilarda denemem icin bana getir.

english: The player walks to Prison Pete
Ooh, thanks! I'll see if it's the right one...
translation: Tesekkürler! Dogru anahtar olup olmadigini bakacagim...

english: Aww, that was the wrong key! You must have popped the wrong sort of animal. Try the big lever again - it'll tell you which animal to pop.
translation: Aww, yanlis anahtardi! Yanlis hayvani patlatmis olmalisin. Büyük kolu tekrar dene, hangi hayvani patlatman gerektigini söyleyecektir.

english: Hooray, you got the right one! Now pull the lever again and let's get the next portal unlocked!
translation: Yasasin, dogru olani buldun! Simdi kolu tekrar cek ve bir sonraki portali acalim!

english: You did it, you got all the keys right! Thank you! You're my friend FOREVER!
translation: Basardin, tüm anahtarlari dogru buldun! Tesekkürler! Sen benim sonsuza kadar arkadasimsin!

english: Let's get out of here before that cat notices.
Hey, bring me that key you've got! I wanna get out of here!
translation: Hey, elindeki anahtari bana getir! Buradan cikmak istiyorum!

english: Player is teleported back to their original spot
Thanks a lot for your help! Here, have a present:
translation: Yardimin icin cok tesekkürler! Al, sana bir hediye:

english: Thanks! See you around!
Don't mind me, I was just leaving...
Huh?
Where am I?
On my island.
Take me to your leader!
I am your leader, you are but a slave!
translation: Ben senin liderinim, sen sadece bir kölesin!

english: I am not a slave, I am a free person!
translation: Ben köle degilim, özgür bir insanim!

english: Ah-ha-ha-ha-ha-ha!
Let me out of here!
I will never let you go, [player name]!
Why not?
Uhm...
Because I say so! And because I can never have enough servants!
translation: Cünkü ben öyle diyorum! Ve cünkü asla yeterince hizmetcim olamaz!

english: Now catch me some fish, I'm hungry.
What fish, where?
Talk to my other servants, and hurry it up!
translation: Diger hizmetcilerimle konus ve acele et!

english: What's it all about?
Sit down and I'll tell you. It's a question of servant shortage.
translation: Otur da anlatayim. Hizmetci sikintisi var.

english: Go on.
You are a skilled worker. A human like you is worth a great deal as a slave.
translation: Sen yetenekli bir iscisin. Senin gibi bir insan köle olarak cok degerli.

english: A slave?? I will have nothing to do with you. Is that clear? Absolutely nothing.
translation: Köle mi? Seninle hicbir isim yok. Anlasildi mi? Kesinlikle hicbir sey.

english: Now be reasonable little human. It's just a matter of time before you will do everything I ask you to. Play along and this can be a very nice place.
translation: Simdi mantikli ol kücük insan. Sana söyledigim her seyi yapman sadece an meselesi. Oyuna gel ve burasi cok güzel bir yer olabilir.

english: I will not make any deals with you. I'm a human. I will not be pushed, numbered, meowed at, teleported or enslaved. My life is my own.
translation: Seninle hicbir anlasma yapmayacagim. Ben bir insanim. Itilmem, numaralandirilmam, miyavlanmam, isinlanmam veya kölelestirilmem. Hayatim bana ait.

english: Is it?
Yes. You won't hold me.
Won't I?
Let me assure you there's no way out.
translation: Sana temin ederim ki kacis yok.

english: Just ask my servants!
How is it possible that you're talking?
How is it possible that you're not meowing?
Meowing?? Why would I be meowing?
Most humans do, that's why I'm wearing this amulet of Man speak... but I do try to train my staff in civilised speech.
translation: Cogu insan miyavlar, bu yüzden bu insan dili muskasi takiyorum... ama calisanlarima medeni konusma egitimi vermeye calisiyorum.

english: Ah, but I suppose things are slightly different in your world... what a dreadful place that must be.
translation: Ah, ama sanirim senin dünyanda isler biraz farkli... Ne korkunc bir yer olmali.

english: I think I'm getting a headache...
What did you do to Bob?
Bob? I am Bob!
Oh, you mean the Bob in your world? Nothing. I am an incarnation of Bob here on ScapeRune.
translation: Oh, senin dünyandaki Bob'u mu kastediyorsun? Hicbir sey. Ben ScapeRune'da Bob'un enkarnasyonuyum.

english: What, you mean this is... like some kind of mirror land?
translation: Ne, yani burasi... . bir tür ayna dünyasi gibi mi?

english: Something like that... somewhere in ScapeRune there must be a human servant called [player name].
translation: Öyle bir sey... ScapeRune'da bir yerlerde Maceraci adinda bir insan hizmetci olmali.

english: But you work just as well for me! Now get to work, human! Fish for me!
translation: Ama sen de benim icin ayni isi görüyorsun! Simdi isine bak, insan! Benim icin balik tut!

english: It looks vile and smells even worse. You're not eating that!
translation: Görünüsü igrenc, kokusu daha da kötü. Onu yemeyeceksin!

english: What, are you giving me cooked fish? What am I going to do with that? Uncook it first!
translation: Ne, bana pismis balik mi veriyorsun? Onunla ne yapacagim? Önce pisirmeyi birak!

english: Errr... Uncook it?
You heard me! There's the cold fire, by the trees, now get uncooking!
translation: Duydun beni! Agaclarin yaninda soguk ates var, simdi pisirmeyi birak!

english: What was this? That was absolutely disgusting!
Don't you know what kind of fish I like? Talk to my other servants for some advice.
translation: Ne tür balik sevdigimi bilmiyor musun? Diger hizmetcilerime danis.

english: Evil Bob seems more attentive of you.
translation: Evil Bob sana daha dikkatli davraniyor gibi görünüyor.

english: Mmm, mmm... that's... mmm... delicious...
Now, let me take... a little... catnap...
ZZZzzz
Mmm, mmm... that's delicious.
Now get me another one, you no good human!
translation: Simdi bana bir tane daha getir, seni ise yaramaz insan!

english: Evil Bob Seems slightly less attentive of you.
translation: Kötü Bob sana biraz daha az ilgi gösteriyor gibi.

english: What am I to do with that? Catch me some fish, puny human!
translation: Bununla ne yapacagim? Bana balik yakala, zayif insan!

english: Evil Bob appears to be sleeping, best not to wake him up.
translation: Kötü Bob uyuyor gibi görünüyor, onu uyandirmasan iyi olur.

english: Mew!
Yowl!
Meeeow!
Meeeeow!
Meeeeowby laaaater…
Yes, that seems like a good idea.
translation: Evet, bu iyi bir fikir gibi görünüyor.

english: No, leave the cat alone.
Okay.
But I want to leave now.
Yes.
No.
What is this place?
But I want to leave now..
How do I get out of here?
Okay..
Why not?
What's it all about?
How is it possible that you're talking?
What did you do to Bob?
Bwaaaaaauk bwuk bwuk
Bwuk
Bwuk bwuk bwuk
Flee from me, [player name]!
Begone, [player name]!
MUAHAHAHAHAAA!
How dare you invade my lair! DIE INTRUDER!
translation: Nasil benim inime girersin! ÖL, IZINSIZ GIREN!

english: What do you want?
I want to go through the portal.
Go away! This is OUR portal now!
translation: Git buradan! Bu artik BIZIM portalimiz!

english: I want to join your group.
Well we do need one more person now, since... um.
translation: Sey, su anda bir kisiye daha ihtiyacimiz var, cünkü... sey.

english: But we're an evil group! To join, you have to be evil!
translation: Ama biz kötü bir grubuz! Katilmak icin kötü olmalisin!

english: I'm evil!
Yeah, I can see that. That outfit is totally evil!
translation: Evet, bunu görebiliyorum. O kiyafet tamamen kötü!

english: And I love that evil black sword!
translation: Ve o kötü siyah kilici cok sevdim!

english: Okay, I'll take you through to see Denath.
Evil Dave escorts you into the demonic throne room.
translation: Kötü Dave seni seytani taht odasina götürür.

english: Master! This person wants to join us!
translation: Efendim! Bu kisi bize katilmak istiyor!

english: Indeed? Well we are one wizard short since Josef ran away. Can you vouch for him?
translation: Öyle mi? Josef kactigindan beri bir büyücü eksigimiz var. Onun icin kefil olabilir misin?

english: Yeah! He's totally evil!
Thank you, Dave.
Never mind, I'm not evil.
Well get out of our evil temple then!
Oh, nothing.
Go away then!
Where did you get those robes?
Yeah, evil, aren't they? One of the group made them. He said he found some mushrooms in the ruins that could dye things really black.
translation: Evet, seytani, degil mi? Grubumuzdan biri yapti. Harabelerde, esyalari gercekten siyah boyayabilen mantarlar buldugunu söyledi.

english: Eric's dead! Agrith-Naar killed him! That's EVIL!
translation: Eric öldü! Agrith-Naar onu öldürdü! Bu SEYTANI!

english: I mean, it's bad! In a BAD way!
What happened?
The ceiling collapsed without warning! When I moved towards the staircase the walls started to shake.
translation: Tavan hicbir uyari olmadan cöktü! Merdivenlere dogru ilerledigimde duvarlar sallanmaya basladi.

english: I'm scared of what will happen to me if I try to leave!
translation: Gitmeye calisirsam basima ne geleceginden korkuyorum!

english: By using 'evil' as a term of praise you have left yourself without a word to describe real evil!
translation: “Kötü” kelimesini övgü olarak kullanarak, gercek kötülügü tanimlayacak kelime kalmadi!

english: There's no time for that! Eric's DEAD!
translation: Bunun icin zaman yok! Eric ÖLDÜ!

english: You've got to get back to the throne room!
But the portal is closing! We'll be trapped!
Our only hope is to summon Agrith-Naar again so I can kill him! But I need eight people.
translation: Tek umudumuz Agrith-Naar'i tekrar cagirip onu öldürmek! Ama bunun icin sekiz kisiye ihtiyacim var.

english: You can kill him?
You'd better take this then. It was Eric's sigil. Everyone in the ritual will need one!
translation: O zaman bunu alsan iyi olur. Bu Eric'in mührüydü. Ritüeldeki herkesin bir tane olmasi gerekiyor!

english: Welcome to my BASEMENT OF DOOM!
What did you eat at the secret council meeting?
Hey, the council meeting! They wanted me to be their evil representative! That proves I'm a great dark wizard! Right?
translation: Hey, konsey toplantisi! Beni kötü temsilcileri olarak istediler! Bu benim harika bir kara büyücü oldugumu kanitlar! Degil mi?

english: Right...
But anyway, why do you want to know what I ate?
translation: Ama neyse, neden ne yedigimi bilmek istiyorsun?

english: I need to make that exact food in order to save you from the culinomancer's spell.
translation: Seni mutfak büyücüsünün büyüsünden kurtarmak icin tam olarak o yemegi yapmam gerekiyor.

english: What? But that was last week! You've already saved me!
translation: Ne? Ama o gecen haftaydi! Beni coktan kurtardin!

english: Sort of, it's complicated. It works like this...
translation: Bir nevi, bu biraz karmasik. Söyle isliyor...

english: Although you're here, you're also still in the time freeze.
translation: Burada olmana ragmen, hala zaman dondurma durumundasin.

english: What?
I mean, the whole room was frozen in time at the moment the culinomancer cast his spell, right?
translation: Yani, mutfak büyücüsü büyüsünü yaptigi anda tüm oda zaman icinde dondu, degil mi?

english: What? I didn't notice anything.
translation: Ne? Ben hicbir sey fark etmedim.

english: Of course you didn't! You were frozen!
So how can I be there and also here? Which one is me?
translation: Peki nasil hem orada hem de burada olabilirim? Hangisi benim?

english: I mean, I feel like I'm me, but what if I'm not me?
translation: Yani, ben kendim gibi hissediyorum, ama ya ben degilsem?

english: That would be terrible!
They're both you!
How does that work?
From YOUR point of view I've saved you, but from MINE I haven't.
translation: Senin bakis acindan seni kurtardim, ama benim bakis acimdan kurtarmadim.

english: Well that's all right, as long as I'm saved from my point of view!
translation: Peki, benim bakis acimdan kurtarildigim sürece sorun yok!

english: But I have to save you, otherwise you won't be saved!
translation: Ama seni kurtarmam lazim, yoksa kurtulamazsin!

english: But I'm here so you must already have saved me!
translation: Ama ben buradayim, yani beni kurtarmis olmalisin!

english: That's what I meant, from your point of view I've saved you but from mine I haven't!
translation: Ben de bunu kastettim, senin bakis acindan seni kurtardim ama benim bakis acimdan kurtarmadim!

english: I've to take the food back in time to give it to you.
translation: Yiyecekleri sana vermek icin zamanda geriye gitmeliyim.

english: Why?
Because otherwise you won't be saved from the culinomancer's spell.
translation: Cünkü aksi takdirde mutfak büyücüsünün büyüsünden kurtulamazsin.

english: But I was saved from the spell! I remember it!
translation: Ama ben büyünün etkisinden kurtuldum! Hatirliyorum!

english: Exactly! That's why I know I have to go back and save you!
translation: Aynen öyle! Bu yüzden geri dönüp seni kurtarmam gerektigini biliyorum!

english: What will happen if you don't?
I can't not, because I already have!
The fact that you're here means I already did save you, which means that you have to tell me the correct recipe. It's logically impossible for you not to!
translation: Burada olman, seni kurtardigim anlamina geliyor, bu da bana dogru tarifi söylemen gerektigi anlamina geliyor. Mantiken söylememen imkansiz!

english: I don't understand this at all.
There will be a temporal paradox and the universe will implode!
translation: Zamansal bir paradoks olacak ve evren cökecek!

english: Oh no! That would be bad, and not even in an evil way!
translation: Olamaz! Bu cok kötü olur, hem de kötü anlamda degil!

english: Exactly! So you've got to tell me the recipe!
translation: Aynen öyle! O yüzden bana tarifi söylemelisin!

english: But I still don't understand why you need the recipe when you've already saved me!
translation: Ama beni zaten kurtarmisken neden tarife ihtiyacin oldugunu hala anlamiyorum!

english: I don't know.
That's not very helpful. I don't even understand why you need the recipe anyway.
translation: Bu pek yardimci olmadi. Zaten neden tarife ihtiyacin oldugunu da anlamiyorum.

english: All right! Now that makes perfect sense!
translation: Tamam! Simdi her sey cok mantikli!

english: So what was it?
What was what?
The food you ate at the council meeting.
It was, like, this totally evil stew!
Evil stew? How was it evil?
Well, it kind of tasted evil, you know? You know, how you taste something and you think, that's really EVIL?
translation: Sey, tadi kötüydü, anlarsin ya? Hani bir seyi tattiginda, bunun gercekten KÖTÜ oldugunu düsünürsün ya?

english: I think you're mixing up 'good' and 'evil' again!
What? Well, I'm evil, and I only like evil stuff, and I liked that, so it must be evil. Right?
translation: Ne? Sey, Ben kötüyüm ve sadece kötü seyleri severim, o da hosuma gitti, yani kötü olmali. Degil mi?

english: I suppose that makes some kind of sense. But I need to reproduce this stew, so can you describe it in more detail?
translation: Sanirim bu bir sekilde mantikli. Ama bu yahniyi yeniden yapmam lazim, biraz daha ayrintili anlatabilir misin?

english: Well it tasted like the stews my mum makes. She puts these spices in them. But it was like she'd got the amounts totally right this time.
translation: Tadi annemin yaptigi yahniler gibi. O da icine bu baharatlari koyar. Ama sanki bu sefer miktarlari tam olarak dogru ayarlamis gibiydi.

english: Okay, I'd better talk to your mum.
Oh, never mind.
That's nothing like the stew I tasted. All the spices are wrong.
translation: Bu, benim tattigim güvecle hic alakasi yok. Bütün baharatlar yanlis.

english: Hmm... I think you've got the amount of one spice right, but the others are wrong.
translation: Hmm... Bence bir baharatin miktari dogru, ama digerleri yanlis.

english: That stew is pretty evil! But I think one of the spices is still a bit wrong.
translation: Bu güvec oldukca kötü! Ama bence baharatlardan biri hala biraz yanlis.

english: You've got the amount of two of the spices right, but two of them are wrong.
translation: Iki baharatin miktari dogru, ama diger ikisi yanlis.

english: TOTALLY EVIL! That's EXACTLY how the stew tasted!
translation: TAMAMEN KÖTÜ! Güvec tam da böyle tadi vardi!

english: Don't eat it all!
Now I just have to go back in time and give it to your earlier self!
translation: Simdi zamanda geriye gidip bunu gecmisteki haline vermem gerek!

english: What? Why can't I eat it?
You've already eaten it! This is the stew that you remember tasting in the first place!
translation: Zaten yedin! Bu, ilk basta tattigini hatirladigin güvec!

english: So confused...
Woah, what happened?
I've just saved you from a buffet worse than death!
translation: Seni ölümden beter bir büfeden kurtardim!

english: Hey, this is pretty evil stew!
translation: Hey, bu oldukca kötü bir güvec!

english: Yes. Now it's very important you remember what the stew tasted like!
translation: Evet. Simdi, güvecin tadini hatirlaman cok önemli!

english: Because... it just is!
Okay.
Nice basement!
Nice?!
I mean, evil!
Yeah! I'm going to use it to summon DEMONS to DO MY BIDDING, or raise an ARMY OF THE UNDEAD! And then I'm going to totally, like, take over the world!
translation: Evet! Onu, emirlerimi yerine getirmeleri icin IBLISLERI cagirmak veya ÖLÜMSÜZLERDEN OLUSAN BIR ORDU kurmak icin kullanacagim! Ve sonra dünyayi tamamen ele gecirecegim!

english: Ah-ha-ha-ha-ha-haa!
So have you had any luck with the demon-summoning?
translation: Peki, seytan cagirma konusunda sansin yaver gitti mi?

english: Well, I thought I should start small, so I asked Wizard Grayzag for some help with summoning imps...
translation: Sey, kücükten baslamam gerektigini düsündüm, bu yüzden Büyücü Grayzag'dan imp cagirma konusunda yardim istedim...

english: And did you manage to summon any?
Well, not imps, exactly. It turns out they're not the lowest form of demon after all. I got these hell-rats.
translation: Sey, tam olarak imp degil. Meger onlar en düsük seviyeli seytanlar degilmis. Bu cehennem farelerini cagirdim.

english: They're hardly evil at all! They're just like regular rats only they smell vaguely of sulphur!
translation: Hic de kötü degiller! Normal sicanlar gibiler, sadece hafif bir kükürt kokusu var!

english: See you later!
If my ARMY OF DARKNESS doesn't get you first!
translation: Tabii benim KARANLIK ORDUM seni önce yakalamazsa!

english: Soon you will return to bow before my EVIL THRONE!
translation: Yakinda benim KÖTÜ TAHTimin önünde egileceksin!

english: If you can find your way out of my BASEMENT OF DOOM!
And together we will lead Gielinor into a NEW DARK AGE!
translation: Ve birlikte Gielinor'u YENI KARANLIK CAG'a götürecegiz!

english: Of course you will return! There is no escape from my DARK POWER!
translation: Tabii ki geri döneceksin! KARANLIK GÜCÜMÜMÜZDEN kacis yok!

english: Weren't you going to give up evil?
Yeah, well...
I did try. I wore this bright red jumper and I got up in the morning and spent the day outside in the sunshine...
translation: Denedim. Parlak kirmizi bir kazak giydim, sabah kalktim ve gün boyu günesin altinda disarida vakit gecirdim...

english: *Dave shudders*
But I couldn't keep it up. I just didn't find anything good very interesting, you know?
translation: Ama devam edemedim. Hicbir seyin iyi oldugunu düsünmedim, anliyor musun?

english: Sometimes I worry about the consequences of evil. I don't really want anyone to get hurt, not like what happened with Denath.
translation: Bazen kötülügün sonuclari hakkinda endiseleniyorum. Kimsenin zarar görmesini istemiyorum, Denath'a olanlar gibi.

english: But I can't not be evil! It's just who I am!
translation: Ama kötü olmaktan vazgecemem! Ben buyum!

english: Let me try to explain the time travel thing again...
translation: Zaman yolculugu konusunu tekrar aciklamaya calisayim...

english: I mean, the whole room was frozen in time at the moment the culinomancercast his spell, right?
translation: Yani, culinomancer büyüsünü yaptigi anda tüm oda zamanda dondu, degil mi?

english: Because otherwise you won't be saved from the culinomancer'sspell.
translation: Cünkü aksi takdirde culinomancer'in büyüsünden kurtulamazsin.

english: You've got to tell me because the magic requires it!
translation: Bana söylemelisin cünkü büyü bunu gerektiriyor!

english: That's what you said before! Honestly, why make it more complicated than it needs to be?
translation: Daha önce de öyle demistin! Acikcasi, neden gereginden fazla karmasiklastiriyorsun?

english: Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to answer this for me.
Evil Dave has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Evil Dave sana bir meydan okuma parsömeni verdi!

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
That is not the evil answer I requested!
translation: Bu benim istedigim kötü cevap degil!

english: Spot on!
Evil Dave has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
I want to go through the portal.
I want to join your group.
I'm evil!
Never mind, I'm not evil.
Oh, nothing.
Where did you get those robes?
What happened?
By using 'evil' as a term of praise...
You've got to get back to the throne room!
What did you eat at the secret council meeting?
Although you're here, you're also still in the time freeze.
translation: Burada olsan da, hala zaman dondurma durumundasin.

english: From YOUR point of view I've saved you, but from MINE I haven't.
translation: Senin bakis acindan seni kurtardim, ama benim bakis acimdan kurtarmadim.

english: I've got to take the food back in time to give it to you.
translation: Yiyecekleri sana vermek icin zamanda geriye götürmeliyim.

english: I can't not, I already have!
There will be a temporal paradox and the universe will implode!
translation: Zaman paradoksu olacak ve evren cökecek!

english: I don't know
You've got to tell me because the magic requires it!
translation: Bana söylemelisin, cünkü büyü bunu gerektiriyor!

english: Oh, never mind.
Nice basement!
So have you had any luck with the demon-summoning?
translation: Iblis cagirma konusunda sansin yaver gitti mi?

english: Weren't you going to give up evil?
See you later.
Let me try to explain the time travel thing again...
Are you a cook? I need more staff.
translation: Asci misin? Daha fazla personele ihtiyacim var.

english: What's going on here?
This is the Hosidius Mess. It was set up to help feed the soldiers from the Shayzien Encampment. Much better than anything they can cook over there.
translation: Burasi Hosidius Mess. Shayzien Kampi'ndaki askerleri beslemek icin kuruldu. Oradakilerin pisirebileceginden cok daha iyi.

english: How come it's so far from Hosidius?
The solders do enough hard work, so it seemed only right not to make them walk all the way across Kourend for a bit of food.
translation: Askerler yeterince zorlu isler yapiyorlar, bu yüzden biraz yemek icin Kourend'i bastan basa yürümelerini istemek dogru olmazdi.

english: Anyway, enough chatting. Are you a cook?
translation: Neyse, bu kadar sohbet yeter. Asci misin?

english: Yeah, I can do some cooking. Well, my level's [number<20], anyway.
translation: Evet, biraz yemek yapabilirim. Ama seviyem 20'den dusuk

english: Hah! You'll need a level of 20 to cook anything for these soldiers. They're picky about what they eat.
translation: Hah! Bu askerlere yemek pisirmek icin seviyen 20 olmali. Yemek konusunda cok secicidirler.

english: Yeah, I can do some cooking.
Good. When you've got more Hosidius favour, come back and I'll have plenty for you to do.
translation: Güzel. Hosidius'un gözüne daha fazla girersen, geri gel, sana yapacak cok isim var.

english: Good. The soldiers like stew, meat pies and pineapple pizza. You'll find ingredients in the cupboards.
translation: Güzel. Askerler güvec, etli börek ve ananasli pizzayi severler. Malzemeleri dolaplarda bulabilirsin.

english: When you've made something, put it on the buffet tables, and you'll gain experience based on how much the soldiers appreciate them.
translation: Yiyecekleri hazirladiginda, acik büfe masalarina koy, askerlerin begenme derecesine göre deneyim puani kazanacaksin.

english: No, I'm off.
You're not authorised to work in my kitchen.
They're not going to eat anything you've got there. Make them meat pies, stew or pineapple pizza.
translation: Orada yaptigin hicbir seyi yemeyeceklere. Onlara etli börek, güvec veya ananasli pizza yap.

english: Hey, that's not for you!
They're not going to eat that. Use the ingredients provided here.
translation: Onlar bunu yemeyeceklere. Burada verilen malzemeleri kullan.

english: They're not going to eat that. Make them meat pies, stew or pineapple pizza.
translation: Onlar bunu yemeyeceklere. Onlara etli börek, güvec veya ananasli pizza yap.

english: Here you go.
Hey, I have something for you but you don't have any space for it!
translation: Hey, sana bir sey getirdim ama koyacak yerin yok!

english: What's going on here?
Yeah, I can do some cooking.
No, I'm off.
Hello.
Ah hello there! I am the resident lecturer on antiquities and artefacts. I also set the Earth Sciences exams.
translation: Merhaba! Ben antik eserler ve eserler konusunda yerlesik ögretim görevlisiyim. Ayrica Yer Bilimleri sinavlarini da hazirliyorum.

english: Earth Sciences?
That is right dear, the world of Gielinor holds many wonders beneath its surface. Students come to me to take exams so that they may join in on the archaeological dig going on just north of here.
translation: Dogru canim, Gielinor dünyasinin yüzeyinin altinda bircok mucize var. Ögrenciler, buradan kuzeyde devam eden arkeolojik kazilara katilabilmek icin bana sinavlara girmeye geliyorlar.

english: So if they don't pass the exams they can't dig at all?
translation: Yani sinavlari gecemezlerse kazi yapamazlar mi?

english: That's right! We have to make sure that students know enough to be able to dig safely and not damage the artefacts.
translation: Dogru! Ögrencilerin kazilari güvenli bir sekilde yapabilecek ve eserlere zarar vermeyecek kadar bilgi sahibi olduklarindan emin olmaliyiz.

english: Can I take an exam?
You can if you get this letter stamped by the Curator of Varrock's museum.
translation: Varrock müzesinin küratörü bu mektubu damgalarsa girebilirsin.

english: Why's that then?
Because he is a very knowledgeable man and employs our archaeological expert. I'm sure he knows a lot about your exploits and can judge whether you'd make a good archaeologist or not.
translation: Cünkü o cok bilgili bir adam ve arkeoloji uzmanimizi istihdam ediyor. Eminim senin basarilarini cok iyi biliyor ve iyi bir arkeolog olup olmayacagini degerlendirebilir.

english: Besides, the museum contributes funds to the dig.
But why are you writing the letter? Shouldn't he?
translation: Ama mektubu neden sen yaziyorsun? O yazmasi gerekmez mi?

english: He's also a very busy man, so I write the letters and he justs stamps them if he approves.
translation: O da cok mesgul bir adam, bu yüzden mektuplari ben yaziyorum ve o onaylarsa damgaliyor.

english: Oh, I see. I'll ask him if he'll approve me, and bring my stamped letter back here. Thanks.
translation: Anliyorum. Ona beni onaylayip onaylamayacagini soracagim ve damgali mektubumu buraya getirecegim. Tesekkürler.

english: Interesting...
You could gain much with an understanding of the world below.
translation: Yeralti dünyasini anlamakla cok sey kazanabilirsin.

english: Hello again.
I am still waiting for your letter of recommendation.
I have lost the letter you gave me.
Oh now come on. You have it with you!
You already have the letter in your bank.
That was foolish. Take this one and don't lose it!
translation: Bu aptalcaydi. Bunu al ve kaybetme!

english: Alright, I'll try and get it.
I am sure you won't get any problems. Speak to the Curator of Varrock's Museum.
translation: Eminim sorun yasamayacaksin. Varrock Müzesi'nin küratörüyle konus.

english: Hello again. Are you ready for another shot at the exam?
translation: Merhaba tekrar. Sinava tekrar girmeye hazir misin?

english: Yes I certainly am.
You'll need at least two spaces free in your inventory before taking this exam, else you can not be rewarded if you pass!
translation: Bu sinava girmeden önce envanterinde en az iki bos yer olmasi gerekiyor, aksi takdirde sinavi gecsen bile ödül alamazsin!

english: Okay, we will start with the first exam: Earth Sciences level 1 - Beginner.
translation: Tamam, ilk sinavla baslayalim: Yer Bilimleri seviye 1 - Baslangic.

english: Question 1 - Earth Sciences overview. Can you tell me what Earth Sciences is?
translation: Soru 1 - Yer Bilimleri genel bakis. Yer Bilimleri nedir, bana söyleyebilir misin?

english: The study of the earth, its contents and history.
The study of planets and the history of worlds.
The combination of archaeology and vegetarianism.
The study of gardening, planting and fruiting vegetation.
translation: Bahcecilik, ekim ve meyve veren bitkilerin incelenmesidir.

english: Okay, next question...
Earth Sciences level 1, question 2 - Eligibility. Can you tell me which people are allowed to use the digsite?
translation: Yer Bilimleri seviye 1, soru 2 - Uygunluk. Kazi alanini hangi kisilerin kullanabilecegini söyleyebilir misiniz?

english: Professors, students and workmen only.
Local residents, contractors and small pink fish.
translation: Yerel sakinler, müteahhitler ve kücük pembe baliklar.

english: All that have passed the appropriate Earth Sciences exam.
translation: Uygun Yer Bilimleri sinavini gecen herkes.

english: Magic users, miners and their escorts.
Earth Sciences level 1, question 3 - Health and safety. Can you tell me the proper safety points when working on a digsite?
translation: Yer Bilimleri seviye 1, soru 3 - Saglik ve güvenlik. Kazi alaninda calisirken uyulmasi gereken güvenlik kurallarini söyleyebilir misiniz?

english: Rubber chickens to be worn on the head at all times.
translation: Her zaman kafaya lastik tavuk takilmalidir.

english: Gloves and boots to be worn at all times; proper tools must be used.
translation: Her zaman eldiven ve bot giyilmelidir; uygun aletler kullanilmalidir.

english: Protective clothing to be worn; tools kept away from site.
translation: Koruyucu giysiler giyilmelidir; aletler calisma alanindan uzak tutulmalidir.

english: Heat-resistant clothing to be worn at all times.
translation: Her zaman isiya dayanikli giysiler giyilmelidir.

english: That concludes the exam for Earth Sciences level 1.
translation: Bu, Yer Bilimleri seviye 1 sinavini sonlandirir.

english: Let's see how you did...
You got all the questions correct. Well done!
Hey! Excellent!

You have now passed the Earth Sciences level 1 general exam. Here is your certificate to prove it. You also get a decent trowel to dig with. Of course, you'll want to get studying for your next exam now!
translation: Yer Bilimleri seviye 1 genel sinavini gectin. Iste bunu kanitlayan sertifikan. Ayrica kazi yapmak icin iyi bir kürek de alacaksin. Tabii ki, simdi bir sonraki sinavina calismak isteyeceksin!

english: You got 2 questions correct. Not bad, just a little more revision needed.
translation: 2 soruyu dogru cevapladiniz. Fena degil, sadece biraz daha calismaniz gerekiyor.

english: Oh well...
Get out and explore the digsite, talk to people and learn!
translation: Disari cikin ve kazi alanini kesfedin, insanlarla konusun ve ögrenin!

english: You got 1 question correct. Better luck next time.
translation: 1 soruyu dogru cevapladiniz. Bir dahaki sefere daha sansli olursunuz.

english: Oh bother!
Do some more research. I'm sure other students could help you out.
translation: Biraz daha arastirma yap. Eminim diger ögrenciler sana yardimci olabilir.

english: Oh deary me! This is appalling, none correct at all! I suggest you go and study properly.
translation: Hay aksi! Bu korkunc, hicbiri dogru degil! Gidip düzgünce calismani öneririm.

english: Oh dear...
Why don't you use the resources here? There are books and the researchers, and you could even ask other students who are also studying for these exams.
translation: Buradaki kaynaklari neden kullanmiyorsun? Kitaplar ve arastirmacilar var, hatta bu sinavlara calisan diger ögrencilere de sorabilirsin.

english: No, not at the moment.
Okay, take your time if you wish.
Hello there! My colleague tells me you helped to uncover a hidden altar to the god Zaros.
translation: Merhaba! Meslektasim, Zaros tanrisina adanmis gizli bir sunak kesfetmene yardim ettigini söyledi.

english: A great scholar and archaeologist indeed! Good health and prosperity to you.
translation: Gercekten de büyük bir bilgin ve arkeologsun! Saglik ve refah dilerim.

english: Thanks.
I have lost my trowel.
Deary me... That was a good one as well. It's a good job I have another. Here you go...
translation: Hay aksi... O da cok iyiydi. Neyse ki baska bir tane var. Al bakalim...

english: Really? Look in your backpack and make sure first.
translation: Gercekten mi? Önce sirt cantani kontrol et.

english: Hi! Please complete this.
I'm afraid you have not finished the puzzle.
Correct! Well done!
Can I take an exam?
Interesting...
I have lost the letter you gave me.
Alright I'll try and get it.
Yes, I certainly am.

translation: Dünya, icerigi ve tarihi üzerine yapilan arastirma.

english: The study of planets, and the history of worlds.
translation: Gezegenler ve dünyalarin tarihi üzerine yapilan arastirma.

english: No, not at the moment.
Thanks.
I have lost my trowel.
I lost my weapon fighting the Blue Moon. Could I have it back?
translation: Mavi Ay ile savasirken silahimi kaybettim. Geri alabilir miyim?

english: Here you go, iknil.
Eyatalli returns your lost weapon to you.
translation: Eyatalli kaybettigin silahini sana geri veriyor.

english: I found some essence whilst fighting the lesser nagua.
translation: Kücük nagua ile savasirken biraz öz buldum.

english: Thank you, iknil. I shall use it to reinforce the seal.
translation: Tesekkürler, iknil. Onu mührü güclendirmek icin kullanacagim.

english: Do you ever get tired of guarding this place?
translation: Bu yeri korumaktan hic yorulmuyor musun?

english: No.
Care to explain further?
Does the stream tire of eroding the earth? Does the earth tire of forming the mountain?
translation: Akarsu topragi asindirmaktan yorulur mu? Toprak dag olusturmaktan yorulur mu?

english: Not that I can tell.
I have more in common with them than I do with most of your kind, iknil. Think of me as you do them.
translation: Senin türünden cogu kisiden cok onlarla daha fazla ortak noktam var, iknil. Beni de onlar gibi düsün.

english: This place is beautiful. I thought it was supposed to be a prison?
translation: Burasi cok güzel. Burasi bir hapishane degil miydi?

english: It is a prison. Everything around us serves that purpose.
translation: Burasi bir hapishane. Etrafimizdaki her sey bu amaca hizmet ediyor.

english: Even the plants and the streams?
I am a nagua of earth and stream. Being close to both empowers me to do my task.
translation: Ben toprak ve akarsu nagua'siyim. Ikisine de yakin olmak görevimi yerine getirmemi sagliyor.

english: Just as being far from moonlight weakens the Moons of Peril.
translation: Ay isigindan uzak olmak Tehlikeli Aylar'i zayiflatir gibi.

english: Goodbye.
Congratulations on your reward, iknil. That is a treasure from ages past.
translation: Ödülün icin tebrikler, iknil. Bu, gecmis caglardan kalma bir hazine.

english: Yeah, about that... I don't really like this one. Could I have a different one?
translation: Evet, o konuda... Bu pek hosuma gitmedi. Baska bir tane alabilir miyim?...

english: Was that rude?
I was just... Processing. I suppose I could allow you another chance to obtain a piece of equipment, but it won't be guaranteed.
translation: Sadece... Düsünüyordum. Sana ekipman elde etmek icin bir sans daha verebilirim, ama garanti veremem.

english: Yes, that sounds good.
You're certain, Iknil? You could end up with nothing.
translation: Emin misin, Iknil? Elinde hicbir sey kalmayabilir.

english: Very well.
No luck this time, iknil.
Oh... Can I have it back?
Congratulations, iknil. Enjoy your new equipment.
translation: Tebrikler, iknil. Yeni ekipmaninin keyfini cikar.

english: Congratulations, ik-
This is the same thing I just gave you!
translation: Bu az önce sana verdigimle ayni sey!

english: So it seems. You're welcome to try again.
Actually, I don't dislike it that much. I think I'll keep it.
translation: Aslinda, o kadar da sevmedim. Sanirim bunu alacagim.

english: Eyatlalli's voice echoes through the surrounding earth...
Eyatlalli: Thank you, iknil. The Eclipse Moon of Peril is sufficiently distracted. You should now proceed on to the next one.
translation: Eyatlalli: Tesekkürler, iknil. Tehlikeli Tutulma Ayi yeterince dikkatini dagitti. Simdi bir sonrakine gecmelisin.

english: Eyatlalli: Thank you, iknil. The Blue Moon of Peril is sufficiently distracted. You should now proceed on to the next one.
translation: Eyatlalli: Tesekkürler, iknil. Tehlikeli Mavi Ay yeterince dikkatini dagitti. Simdi bir sonrakine gecmelisin.

english: Eyatlalli: Thank you, iknil. The Blood Moon of Peril is sufficiently distracted. You should now proceed on to the next one.
translation: Eyatlalli: Tesekkürler, iknil. Tehlikeli Kanli Ay yeterince dikkatini dagitti. Simdi bir sonrakine gecmelisin.

english: Eyatlalli: Thank you, iknil. The Moons are sufficiently distracted. Return to me for your reward.
translation: Eyatlalli: Tesekkürler, iknil. Aylar yeterince dikkatleri dagildi. Ödülün icin bana geri dön.

english: Thank you, iknil. The Blood Moon of Peril is sufficiently distracted. You should now proceed on to the next one.
translation: Tesekkürler, iknil. Tehlikeli Kanli Ay yeterince dikkatleri üzerine cekti. Simdi bir sonrakine gecmelisin.

translation: Mavi Ay ile savasirken silahimi kaybettim. Geri alabilir miyim?

english: I found some essence whilst fighting the lesser nagua.
translation: Kücük nagua ile savasirken biraz öz buldum.

english: Do you ever get tired of guarding this place?
translation: Bu yeri korumaktan hic yorulmuyor musun?

english: This place is beautiful. I thought it was supposed to be a prison?
translation: Burasi cok güzel. Burasi bir hapishane olmasi gerekmiyor muydu?

english: Goodbye.
Yes.
Hello!
Nilsal. I'm afraid I must ask not to be disturbed. There are many things that one in my position must contemplate. If you seek conversation, I'm sure my companion would be willing.
translation: Nilsal. Maalesef rahatsiz edilmemeyi rica etmek zorundayim. Benim konumumdaki birinin düsünmesi gereken bircok sey var. Konusmak istiyorsan, eminim arkadasim memnuniyetle konusur.

english: Okay, thanks.
Well hello there; welcome to our little village. Pray, stay awhile.
translation: Merhaba, kücük köyümüze hos geldin. Lütfen biraz kal.

english: You know, you sound just like the mayor?
translation: Biliyor musun, tipki belediye baskani gibi konusuyorsun?

english: Really? That's the nicest thing anyone has ever said.
translation: Gercekten mi? Bu simdiye kadar duydugum en güzel sey.

english: I admire him a great deal. He works so hard for this town.
translation: Onu cok takdir ediyorum. Bu kasaba icin cok calisiyor.

english: You look like him as well?
Hmm, I don't think I do.
No really, what with the unhealthy skin tone and bulging eyes. The resemblance is uncanny.
translation: Hayir, gercekten, sagliksiz ten renginiz ve siskin gözlerinizle. Benzerlik inanilmaz.

english: Well, I haven't spoken to him in a while.  I don't get out much.
translation: Sey, onunla bir süredir konusmadim.  Disari pek cikmiyorum.

english: I can see why.
Maybe the Mayor has finally seen how much I admire him and has grown to admire me?
translation: Belki de belediye baskani sonunda ona ne kadar hayran oldugumu fark etti ve bana hayranlik duymaya basladi?

english: Anything's possible I suppose. Wait a minute, you mean you've always looked that odd?
translation: Her sey mümkün sanirim. Bir dakika, yani sen hep bu kadar tuhaf miydin?

english: Hey, I resent that!
I'm sorry, it's just...  Nevermind.
What do you do here?
I supply the local fishermen with the tools and bait they need to do their job.
translation: Yerel balikcilara islerini yapmak icin ihtiyac duyduklari aletleri ve yemleri sagliyorum.

english: Interesting. Have you been doing it long?
Why yes, all of my life.  I took over from my father, who inherited the business from his father and so on.
translation: Evet, hayatim boyunca. Babamdan devraldim, o da bu isi kendi babasindan devralmisti.

english: In fact, there have been Lovecraft's selling bait for over ten generations.
translation: Aslinda, Lovecraft ailesi on nesildir yem satiyor.

english: Wow, that's some lineage.
translation: Vay canina, ne soylu bir aile.

english: Oh yes, we have a long and interesting family history. For one reason or another the Lovecraft's have always been bait sellers or writers.
translation: Evet, uzun ve ilginc bir aile gecmisimiz var. Bir nedenden ötürü Lovecraft ailesi hep yem saticilari ya da yazarlar olmustur.

english: Hmm, yes well. I'm sure it's all fascinating, but I...
translation: Hmm, evet, tabii. Eminim hepsi cok ilginctir, ama ben...

english: Oh very, very fascinating, for instance my great grandfather Howard...
translation: Oh, cok, cok ilginc, örnegin büyük dedem Howard...

english: Yawn. Oh, I'm sorry but I really must be getting on. I think my giraffe needs feeding.
translation: Esneme. Oh, üzgünüm ama gercekten gitmem gerek. Sanirim zürafamin beslenmesi gerekiyor.

english: Your?
Giraffe. Sorry, but he gets cranky without enough sugar. Bye now!
translation: Zürafam. Üzgünüm, ama yeterince seker almazsa huysuzlasiyor. Hosca kal!

english: Oh right, goodbye.
Can I buy some fishing supplies please?
translation: Biraz balikcilik malzemesi alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: You are a bit too strange for me. Bye.
translation: Sen benim icin biraz fazla garipsin. Hosca kal.

english: Sniff. Yes, everyone says that.
You know, you sound just like the mayor?
translation: Biliyor musun, tipki belediye baskani gibi konusuyorsun?

english: What do you do here?
Can I buy some fishing supplies please?
translation: Biraz balikcilik malzemesi alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: You are a bit too strange for me. Bye.
translation: Sen benim icin biraz fazla garipsin. Hosca kal.

english: Hello there, traveller.
What's going on here? Where is everyone?
Most are in the city. As for the rest, hopefully somewhere nicer than this place.
translation: Cogu sehirde. Geri kalanlar ise umarim buradan daha güzel bir yerdedirler.

english: In the city?
Yes. When we heard they were going to lock Menaphos down and shut the gates, most people here decided they'd be better off behind the walls than outside them.
translation: Evet. Menaphos'u kapatip kapilari kilitleyeceklerini duydugumuzda, buradaki cogu insan duvarlarin arkasinda kalmanin disarida kalmaktan daha iyi olacagina karar verdi.

english: But you stayed?
We didn't get much warning. People had to rush to gather whatever they could. Some things had to be left behind, along with some people...
translation: Fazla uyari almadik. Insanlar aceleyle toplayabildiklerini topladilar. Bazi seyler ve bazi insanlar geride birakilmak zorunda kaldi...

english: That's horrible!
It could have been worse. Had we been in Sophanem, we'd have had no warning at all. I just hope it won't be long before things are back to normal.
translation: Daha kötüsü de olabilirdi. Sophanem'de olsaydik, hic uyari almamis olacaktik. Umarim her sey kisa sürede normale döner.

english: I hope so too.
Thank you, traveller. Stay safe out there. These are troubling times.
translation: Tesekkürler, yolcu. Disarida dikkatli ol. Zor zamanlar geciriyoruz.

english: I can't belive Xilo hasn't shown up.
Were you expecting to meet someone here?
My... friend, Xilo. I told her to meet me by the magic trees of the rainforest. We don't often have a chance to meet without a crowd of people around.
translation: Arkadasim Xilo. Ona yagmur ormanindaki sihirli agaçlarin yaninda bulusalim demistim. Etrafimizda kalabalik olmadan bulusma firsatimiz pek olmuyor.

english: Why? Is she not particularly local to you?
translation: Neden? O senin buralarda yasamiyor mu?

english: Unfortunately not. I'm from Aldarin, but she lives in Tal Teklan. It usually takes a special event being hosted for us both to be in the same place.
translation: Maalesef hayir. Ben Aldarin'denim, ama o Tal Teklan'da yasiyor. Genelde özel bir etkinlik olmasi gerekiyor ki ikimiz de ayni yerde olabilelim.

english: So you never really get any privacy?
Privacy? Are you insinuating something?
translation: Mahremiyet mi? Bir sey mi ima ediyorsun?

english: Not at all. Sorry if it seemed like I was.
translation: Hiç de degil. Öyle göründüyse özür dilerim.

english: It's okay... Sorry... I just miss her.
translation: Önemli degil... Özür dilerim... Onu özledim de.

english: Do you think she's just running a little late?
translation: Sence biraz geç kalmis olabilir mi?

english: It's possible.
Could she maybe have considered another tree magical?
translation: Baska bir agaci sihirli bulmus olabilir mi?

english: I suppose she may be where we first met... but this is where we shared our first... you know...
translation: Sanirim ilk tanistigimiz yerde olabilir... ama burasi ilk kez... bilirsin...

english: Well, I'll keep my fingers crossed for you. I'm sure you'll be able to find one another soon!
translation: Peki, senin için dua edecegim. Eminim yakinda birbirinizi bulacaksiniz!

english: Thank you, iknami.
Hang on... I think I might have met this Xilo.
translation: Bir dakika... Sanirim bu Xilo'yu taniyorum.

english: You have? Where is she?
By a tree to the north of here.
Oh, Xilo! She's gone to where we first met instead! Thank you, iknami. I'll head over there at once!
translation: Oh, Xilo! Ilk tanistigimiz yere gitmis! Tesekkürler, iknami. Hemen oraya gidiyorum!

english: Fabia departs.
Hello again, iknami! Thank you for helping us find each other!
translation: Merhaba iknami! Birbirimizi bulmamiza yardim ettigin için tesekkürler!

english: To think we were waiting by different trees! It was so silly of us!
translation: Farkli agaçlarin yaninda bekledigimizi düsünmek! Ne kadar aptalcaydi!

english: Well, I'm happy to see you together again. Now, I'm sure you have a lot of catching up to do. I'll leave you to it.
translation: Sizi tekrar birlikte gördügüme sevindim. Simdi, eminim konusacak çok seyiniz vardir. Sizi yalniz birakayim.

english: Timoiva, iknami!
Don't bother me, can't you see I'm busy?
translation: Rahatsiz etme, mesgul oldugumu görmüyor musun?

english: No, I can't... can I go into the factory?
You can go in. The Consortium, in their infinite wisdom, has decided to open up the factory to all and sundry.
translation: Girebilirsin. Konsorsiyum, sonsuz bilgeligiyle fabrikayi herkese acmaya karar verdi.

english: How come?
We've built a new blast furnace and always have a shortage of people to work on it.
translation: Yeni bir yüksek firin insa ettik ve üzerinde calisacak insan sikintisi cekiyoruz.

english: I'll have a look, thanks.
Just don't go causing any trouble, I still run this factory!
translation: Sakin sorun cikarma, bu fabrikayi hala ben yönetiyorum!

english: I'm sorry, I'm looking for the blast furnace?
Do I look like a guide to you?
No, you look like a hard-working dwarf, but can you please tell me where the blast furnace is?
translation: Hayir, caliskan bir cüce gibi görünüyorsun, ama yüksek firinin nerede oldugunu söyleyebilir misin lütfen?

english: Alright, just head down the stairs, it's easy to find.
translation: Tamam, merdivenlerden asagi in, bulmasi kolay.

english: Thanks.
Are you okay?
Don't I look okay?
If you were any shorter you wouldn't exist.
translation: Biraz daha kisa olsaydin, var olamazdin.

english: Very funny, human.
What are you dwarves doing in this factory?
translation: Siz cüceler bu fabrikada ne yapiyorsunuz?

english: Working of course, can't you see that?
But working on what?
Refining the ore that is being brought into the factory, of course.
translation: Fabrikaya getirilen cevheri isliyorum tabii ki.

english: And what does that mean?
It means you should stop asking so many questions and get back to work!
translation: Bu, bu kadar cok soru sormayi birakip isine dönmen gerektigi anlamina geliyor!

english: Who owns this factory?
The Consortium does and that's all you need to know.
translation: Konsorsiyum ve bilmen gereken tek sey bu.

english: But what company? I thought there were all these different companies?
translation: Ama hangi sirket? Farkli sirketler oldugunu saniyordum?

english: Oh yes, all the major companies own this plant. It's too vital to be in the hands of one company alone.
translation: Evet, tüm büyük sirketler bu fabrikaya sahip. Tek bir sirketin elinde olmasi icin cok önemli bir yer.

english: And what exactly are you doing here?
translation: Peki sen burada tam olarak ne yapiyorsun?

english: I tire of these questions. Let me get back to work!
translation: Bu sorulardan biktim. Isime dönmeme izin ver!

english: What?
What do you do?
You can store your stuff here if you want. You can dump anything you don't want to carry whilst you're fighting duels and then pick it up again on the way out.
translation: Istersen esyalarini burada saklayabilirsin. Düellolar sirasinda tasimak istemedigin esyalari buraya birakabilir ve cikarken tekrar alabilirsin.

english: To be honest I'm wasted here.
translation: Dürüst olmak gerekirse, burada bosa zaman kaybediyorum.

english: I should be winning duels in an arena! I'm the best warrior in Al Kharid!
translation: Arenada düellolari kazanmam gerek! Ben Al Kharid'in en iyi savascisiyim!

english: Easy, tiger!
What is this place?
Isn't it obvious?
This is the Emir's Arena...duh!
I'd like to access my bank, please.
Sure.
I'd like to collect items.
Yeah, okay.
Do you watch any matches?
Sure, I'll buy some rotten fruit.
No, I'm not giving you money for rotten fruit.
translation: Hayir, cürümüs meyve icin sana para vermeyecegim.

english: Suit yourself.
Goodbye, Fadli.
What do you do?
What is this place?
I'd like to access my bank, please.
I'd like to collect items.
Do you watch any matches?
Have you got any idea where Burthorpe is? The co- ordinator says I need to go there and paint all the leaves yellow, but I've never heard of that place!
translation: Burthorpe'un nerede oldugunu biliyor musun? Koordinatör oraya gidip tüm yapraklari sariya boyamam gerektigini söylüyor ama ben o yeri hic duymadim!

english: Be careful when you pick mushrooms near the strange ruins to the south. Some of them will try to eat you!
translation: Güneydeki garip harabelerin yakininda mantar toplarken dikkatli ol. Bazilari seni yemeye calisacak!

english: Err, hello. Do you have any idea what a Winter Fairy actually does?
translation: Merhaba. Kis Perisi'nin ne is yaptigini biliyor musun?

english: No, no idea at all.
Oh, pity. Neither do I, but I'm supposed to be one this week.
translation: Oh, yazik. Ben de bilmiyorum, ama bu hafta bir kis perisi olmam gerekiyor.

english: Sorry, I can't talk I'm looking for Sarah-Jane!
Is your name Freddie, and are you loosing your teeth?
translation: Adin Freddie mi ve dislerin dökülüyor mu?

english: Err, no. I'm afraid not.
Oh, right.
You don't have any idea where I can find him do you?
No, I don't know that either.
Oh, ok then. If you do find out please let me know. The co-ordinator has sent me to find him.
translation: Oh, tamam o zaman. Bulursan lütfen bana haber ver. Koordinatör onu bulmam icin beni gönderdi.

english: I'm afraid I can't stop to chat. I've just been told to get ready to go to Etceteria for some reason or other!
translation: Korkarim sohbet etmek icin duramam. Bir nedenden dolayi Etceteria'ya gitmek icin hazirlanmam söylendi!

english: Picking mushrooms near the forge will probably end quite badly for you.
translation: Demirci dükkaninin yakininda mantar toplamak senin icin muhtemelen kötü sonuclanacaktir.

english: The Queen is the true ruler of Zanaris! We shall over- throw the tyrant!
translation: Kralice Zanaris'in gercek hükümdaridir! Tirani devirecegiz!

english: Is the council finished yet?
Once the council of war is finished we shall go and get rid of the Godfather.
translation: Savas konseyi bittiginde gidip Godfather'i ortadan kaldiracagiz.

english: I'm so looking forward to going back home!
Thank you for waking our queen.
Now that the Queen is awake everything will be alright.
translation: Kralice uyandi, artik her sey yoluna girecek.

english: This fairy ring will take you out of Zanaris. It leads to the place known as Al-Kharid in your realm. Once passed you can not return this way.
translation: Bu peri halkasi sizi Zanaris'ten cikaracak. Sizin dünyanizda Al-Kharid olarak bilinen yere götürür. Bir kez gectikten sonra bu yoldan geri dönemezsiniz.

english: Before leaving make sure that you have fully sampled the delights of our marketplace.
translation: Ayrilmadan önce pazarimizin lezzetlerini tam olarak tattiginizdan emin olun.

english: I think I'll stay down here a bit longer.
As you wish.
Yes, I'm ready to leave.
I think I'll stay down here a bit longer.
Yes, I'm ready to leave.
Hello, my name is [player name]. Who are you?
translation: Merhaba, benim adim Maceraci. Sen kimsin?

english: Oh hello [player name]. I'm Aeryka. Aery for short.
translation: Merhaba Maceraci. Ben Aeryka. Kisaca Aery.

english: Airy Fairy?
That's right. What can I do for you?
What's that crop circle thing doing here?
translation: Bu ekin cemberi burada ne ariyor?

english: Crop circle? Oh, you mean the Puromantic portal?
translation: Ekin cemberi mi? Puromantik portal mi demek istiyorsun?

english: The pyromanic what?
The Puromantic portal. At least that's what we call them. It's the way the implings travel from Puro-Puro to other planes.
translation: Puromantik portal. En azindan biz öyle adlandiriyoruz. Implinglerin Puro-Puro'dan diger boyutlara seyahat etme yolu.

english: Puro-Puro?
The impling home. We call it Puro-Puro. The implings just call it home, I think.
translation: Implinglerin evi. Biz ona Puro-Puro diyoruz. Implingler ise sadece ev diyorlar sanirim.

english: It's still here.
Pardon?
It's still here. The crop circle is still here.
translation: Hala burada. Ekin cemberi hala burada.

english: Oh yes, thanks Aery. It didn't go anywhere in the meantime, then?
translation: Oh evet, tesekkürler Aery. O zaman bu arada hicbir yere gitmedi mi?

english: Nope. It just sat there.
Jolly good. I can come back and visit Puro-Puro whenever I want then. Brilliant!
translation: Cok iyi. O zaman istedigim zaman Puro-Puro'yu ziyaret edebilirim. Harika!

english: What's in Puro-Puro?
Implings...and wheat.
Erm, anything else?
translation: Erm, baska bir sey var mi?

english: Not really. Though I have noticed quite a lot of you humans travelling through the portal recently. I suppose you must like wheat.
translation: Pek sayilmaz. Ama son zamanlarda portalden gecen cok sayida insan gördüm. Sanirim bugdayi seviyorsunuz.

english: Well, most of us prefer lobsters to be perfectly honest, but there must be something interesting there.
translation: Aslinda cogumuz istakozu tercih ederiz, ama orada ilginc bir seyler olmali.

english: Oh, I did notice a very serious-looking gnome go into the portal. Maybe he knows what's going on.
translation: Oh, cok ciddi görünen bir cücenin portaldan girdigini gördüm. Belki o neler oldugunu biliyordur.

english: Do you remember what his name was?
Errm, Egg-nog, or something like that.
translation: Erm, Egg-nog, ya da öyle bir seydi.

english: Right, thanks! I'll have a chat with him when I go. Maybe he'll know what's going on.
translation: Tamam, tesekkürler! Gittigimde onunla konusurum. Belki neler oldugunu biliyordur.

english: So what are these implings then?
Well, no-one knows for sure. The mischievous little creatures are probably related to imps. And they fly as well.
translation: Kimse tam olarak bilmiyor. Bu yaramaz kücük yaratiklar muhtemelen imp'lerle akraba. Onlar da ucabiliyor.

english: Also, like imps, they love collecting things. I'm not sure why, though. They also seem to like being chased.
translation: Ayrica, imp'ler gibi, bir seyler toplamayi seviyorlar. Nedenini bilmiyorum ama. Ayrica kovalanmayi da seviyorlar gibi görünüyor.

english: So how would I get hold of what they are carrying, then?
translation: Peki, tasidiklari seyi nasil ele gecirebilirim?

english: Catch them, I suppose. I don't know really. Why would you want to?
translation: Onlari yakalayarak, sanirim. Gercekten bilmiyorum. Neden bunu yapmak istiyorsun ki?

english: Well, if they were carrying something useful. Maybe I could catch them with a big net - like butterflies.
translation: Eger yararli bir sey tasiyorlarsa. Belki büyük bir agla yakalayabilirim, kelebekleri yakaladigim gibi.

english: Sounds a bit cruel to me, but I suppose that's possible.
translation: Bana biraz acimasizca geliyor, ama sanirim bu mümkün.

english: I've heard I may find dragon equipment in Puro-Puro.
Really? You humans like that stuff a lot, don't you? I don't like really old stuff myself.
translation: Gercekten mi? Siz insanlar bu tür seyleri cok seviyorsunuz, degil mi? Ben cok eski seyleri sevmem.

english: Old?
Yes, dragon stuff feels really old.
translation: Evet, ejderha esyalari cok eski geliyor.

english: How can you tell that?
From its magical aura, obviously. Oh, I forget you humans can't feel auras.
translation: Büyülü auralarindan, tabii ki. Ah, siz insanlarin auralari hissedemediginizi unutmusum.

english: How old is old?
Really, really, old.
Can you be any more precise?
Not really. Time doesn't really mean a lot round here. Hundreds, maybe thousands of your human lifespans, I suppose. Anyway, it would have to be old since it all comes from the Necrosyrtes.
translation: Pek degil. Burada zamanin pek bir önemi yok. Yüzlerce, belki binlerce insan ömrü kadar, sanirim. Her neyse, Necrosyrtes'ten geldigi icin eski olmali.

english: Necrosyrtes? Who are they?
Old and powerful creatures. I don't think there have been any around here for aeons. I haven't seen one. I don't think they are very nice. Not like me. Anyway, this is all ancient history. Boooring!
translation: Eski ve güclü yaratiklar. Buralarda binlerce yildir hic görülmediklerini saniyorum. Ben hic görmedim. Cok iyi yaratiklar olduklarini sanmiyorum. Benim gibi degiller. Her neyse, bunlarin hepsi cok eski tarih. Sikici!

english: While I'm on the subject do you have any dragon stuff I can have?
translation: Hazir bu konuyu acmisken, bana verebilecegin ejderha esyalari var mi?

english: Oh, I did have loads, but I threw it away.
translation: Oh, eskiden bir sürü vardi ama hepsini attim.

english: What?
Only joking.

No, sorry, I can't help you there. You'll have to look for it yourself. Although, maybe if you find Necrosyrtes then they'll give you some. I heard they give dragon stuff away to people they like. Not fairies. We're too
translation: Hayir, üzgünüm, bu konuda sana yardimci olamam. Kendin aramalisin. Ama belki Necrosyrtes'i bulursan sana verirler. Sevdikleri insanlara ejderha esyalari verdiklerini duydum. Perilere degil. Biz cok

english: nice.
No, bye!
See you around!
What's in Puro-Puro?
So what are these implings then?
I've heard I may find dragon equipment in Puro-Puro.
No, bye!
What is it, human? Busy busy busy!
translation: Ne var, insan? Mesgul, mesgul, mesgul!

english: Why are you carrying that toolbox?
It's the fizgog! It's picking up cable again!
Uh, right. So is it safe to use the fairy rings then?
translation: Uh, tamam. Peki peri halkalarini kullanmak güvenli mi?

english: Sure, as long as you have been given permission to use them. You should just be aware that using the fairy rings sometimes has strange results, the locations that you have been to may affect the locations you are
translation: Elbette, kullanma izni aldigin sürece. Peri halkalarini kullanmanin bazen garip sonuclar dogurabilecegini bilmelisin, gittigin yerler ulasmaya calistigin yerleri etkileyebilir.

english: trying to reach. I could fix it by replacing the fizgog and the whosprangit, I've put in a request for some new parts but they're pretty hard to get hold of, it seems.
translation: Fizgog ve whosprangit'i degistirerek sorunu cözebilirim, yeni parcalar icin talepte bulundum ama bulmak oldukca zor gibi görünüyor.

english: I'm okay, thanks.
Pssst! Human! I've got something for you.
translation: Pssst! Insan! Senin icin bir seyim var.

english: What have you got for me?
They said you'd helped cure our Queen. I haven't got a lot of rewards to offer, but my enchantment scrolls might help if you're working with fairy rings in your home.
translation: Kralicemizi iyilestirmeye yardim ettigini söylediler. Sunabilecegim cok fazla ödülüm yok, ama evinde peri halkalariyla calisiyorsan, büyülü parsömenlerim yardimci olabilir.

english: Not interested, thanks.
Why are you carrying that toolbox?
I'm okay, thanks.
What have you got for me?
Not interested, thanks.
Who are you? Where's the Fairy Queen? What's going on here? Where's the Fairy Queen's throne gone?
translation: Kimsin sen? Peri Kralicesi nerede? Burada neler oluyor? Peri Kralicesi'nin tahti nereye gitti?

english: Ciao esploratore! So many questions. Whicha one would you hava me answer first?
translation: Ciao esploratore! Cok fazla soru var. Hangisine önce cevap vereyim?

english: Who are you?
Me?! I am-a da Fairy Godfather.
translation: Ben mi?! Ben Peri Vaftiz Babasiyim.

english: I see-a by your face dat you have-a not-a heard of-a me. Irrespettoso, eet iz no eemportance. You weesh-a to know sometheeng else or no?
translation: Yüzünden beni duymadigini anliyorum. Saygisizlik, önemli degil. Baska bir sey bilmek ister misin?

english: Where's the Fairy Queen?
Ah, eet iz a trageec-a tale. Da Queen Bee she iz-a, how-you-say, seek?
translation: Ah, bu trajik bir hikaye. Kralice Ari, nasil denir, hasta mi?

english: You mean sick. What happened?
Ah, a tragedy to be-a struck-a down so young.
translation: Ah, bu kadar genc yasta ölmek ne trajik.

english: How-a much do ya know about-a fairy folk, my beeg friend?
translation: Peri halki hakkinda ne kadar bilgin var, koca dostum?

english: Not actually a whole deal, I'm afraid.
Well, let-a me enlighten yous. Zanaris iz-a nexus of-a da worlds. Da Queen Bee, she iz-a da guardian of-a all da folk dat live-a in Zanaris.
translation: Peki, ben sana anlatayim. Zanaris, dünyalarin kesisme noktasidir. Kralice Ari, Zanaris'te yasayan tüm halkin koruyucusudur.

english: So when-a thees Tanglefoot arrives, da Queen Bee she-a goes to da Cosmic Temple area to kill-a eet, but someting goes-a wrong. Da Queen Bee, she gets-a hurt and is-a now inna da magic sleep.
translation: Tanglefoot geldiginde, Kralice Ari onu öldürmek icin Kozmik Tapinak bölgesine gider, ama bir seyler ters gider. Kralice Ari yaralanir ve simdi sihirli bir uykudadir.

english: She is-a being cared for by-a Fairy Nuff, who lives-a just north of-a da bank.
translation: Onunla, bankanin hemen kuzeyinde yasayan Peri Nuff ilgileniyor.

english: Thanks, I'll go see her then. Goodbye.
translation: Tesekkürler, o zaman onu görmeye gidecegim. Hosca kal.

english: Ciao. Oh, and [player name]...
Yes?
A word-a of advice. You be-a careful not to cause da trouble for da folk while you are in Zanaris. Ciao.
translation: Bir tavsiye. Zanaris'teyken insanlara sorun cikarmamaya dikkat et. Hosca kal.?

english: Da Boss is a busy fairy! He don' have time to talk to yous humans. Vamoose!
translation: Patron cok mesgul bir peri! Sizin insanlarla konusacak zamani yok. Defolun!

english: Ciao [player name]. I am-a glad to see-a yous back! I was-a worried that the Tanglefoot would-a kill-a you too.
