translation: Hosca kal Maceraci. Geri döndügünü görmek ne güzel! Tanglefoot'un seni de öldüreceginden endiselenmistim.

english: You needn't have worried I managed to kill it!
translation: Endiselenmene gerek yoktu, onu öldürmeyi basardim!

english: Ben fatto, my friend! Da folk-a dey owe yous a great-a deal! So did-a yous getta back da Queen Bee's magic power?
translation: Aferin dostum! Halk sana cok sey borclu! Kralice Ari'nin sihirli gücünü geri aldin mi?

english: I don't have the Fairy Queen's secateurs with me.
translation: Peri Kralicesi'nin budama makasi yanimda degil.

english: Ah, [player name]. I can-a do nutting to help-a da Queen Bee without-a da secateurs. Please, bring-a dem to me as soon as-a you can!
translation: Ah, Maceraci. Makas olmadan Kralice Ari'ya yardim edemem. Lütfen, mümkün oldugunca cabuk bana getir!

english: I obtained this pair of Enchanted secateurs, I think they must contain the Queen's missing magic.
translation: Bu sihirli makasi buldum, sanirim Kralice'nin kayip büyüsü icinde sakli.

english: Grazie infinite! I will give-a dem to da healing fairy. Da Queen Bee, she will-a soon be strong again!
translation: Cok tesekkürler! Onu sifali perinin eline verecegim. Kralice Ari yakinda tekrar güclenecek!

english: Congratulations! Quest complete!
The Godfather is ignoring you.
Godfather! Where is the Fairy Queen?
Whata are you-a talking about?
I've just been to Fairy Nuff's cave and when I got there I found it ransacked! Everything has been broken and the Fairy Queen and Fairy Nuff are missing!
translation: Az önce Fairy Nuff'un magarasina gittim ve orayi talan edilmis buldum! Her sey kirilmis ve Peri Kralicesi ile Fairy Nuff kaybolmus!

english: Essere nel panico! You-a say datta Queen Bee, she izza meesing? Theez izza terreeble! Who could-a have done such a theeng? We musta find her! I weel organise a search-a party right-a-way!
translation: Panik yapma! Kralice Ari kayboldu mu dedin? Bu korkunc! Kim böyle bir sey yapabilir ki? Onu bulmaliyiz! Hemen bir arama ekibi organize edecegim!

english: Calm down! Let's think this through carefully.
Do you have any idea who could have done this?
translation: Bunu kimin yapmis olabilecegi hakkinda bir fikrin var mi?

english: Errm...no! None atta all! Da Queen Bee, she izza well liked by-a everyone.
translation: Hayir! Hicbir fikrim yok! Kralice Ari, herkes tarafindan cok seviliyordu.

english: That's not very helpful.
Where could she have been taken to?
Ze keednapper must-a have taken her through-a da fairyreengs. Dey weel-a be long gone by-a now.
translation: Kaciranlar onu peri diyarindan gecirmis olmalilar. Simdiye kadar coktan uzaklasmislardir.

english: We must go after them!
Yes! We must-a, but most-a of da folk are away from Zanaris atta the momento.
translation: Evet! Yapmaliyiz, ama cogu insan su anda Zanaris'ten uzakta.

english: Well tell me what to do and I'll go myself.
translation: Ne yapmam gerektigini söyle, ben kendim giderim.

english: Ye-es, dat izza good idea. Hokay, you may use-a da fairyreengs. Talk-a to da co-ordinator, she will-a explain-a to you how to use-a da reengs, but you must-a promees me dat you weel come-a back-a here, eef you
translation: Evet, bu iyi bir fikir. Tamam, peri canlarini kullanabilirsin. Koordinatörle konus, sana canlari nasil kullanacagini aciklayacaktir, ama onu bulursan buraya geri dönecegine söz vermelisin.

english: find-a her. Whoever keednapped her must-a be very powerful. You find-a da Queen Bee and den-a yous come right back here and we will-a rescue her together. Hokay?
translation: Onu kaciran kisi cok güclü olmali. Kralice Ari'yi bul ve hemen buraya geri gel, onu birlikte kurtaralim. Tamam mi?

english: No, I'll rescue her myself.
Oh no, dat eet eez no good. Yous wanna to be da hero, but what-a about me? She izza my queen! No, no. You cannot-a use-a da fairyreengs
translation: Oh hayir, bu iyi olmaz. Sen kahraman olmak istiyorsun, peki ya ben? O benim kralicem! Hayir, hayir. Peri canlarini kullanamazsin.

english: Where have all the fairies gone?
Da people are mostly out-a and about-a tryeeng to keep-a theengs working. Eet izza not easy weeth da Queen Bee notta here!
translation: Cogu disarida ve isleri yolunda tutmaya calisiyor. Kralice Ari burada yokken bu kolay degil!

english: Ah, [player name], yous hassa changed your mind? Yous weel-a come and getta me before yous rescue da Queen Bee? Only den can-a I geev yous permission to use-a da reengs.
translation: Ah, Maceraci, fikrini mi degistirdin? Kralice Ari'yi kurtarmadan önce gelip beni alacak misin? Ancak o zaman sana yüzükleri kullanma izni verebilirim.

english: Oh, okay then.
Good, I knew-a you would change-a your mind. Now I just-a need you to sign-a dis scroll before I geev-a yous da permission to use-a da fairyreengs.
translation: Güzel, fikrini degistirecegini biliyordum. Simdi, peri canlarini kullanma izni vermeden önce bu parsömeni imzalaman gerekiyor.

english: I am not signing this! It says I am indebted to you until you release me!
translation: Bunu imzalamayacagim! Beni serbest birakana kadar sana borclu oldugumu yaziyor!

english: Eet does? Oh, sorry, must-a geeven yous da wrong-a scroll. Tell-a yous what, yous hazza da honest face, so I'll trust-a yous. Go ahead, use-a da fairyreengs, but just-a make sure dat yous come-a back here and tell-a
translation: Öyle mi? Oh, pardon, sana yanlis parsömeni vermisim. Bak ne diyecegim, dürüst bir yüzün var, sana güvenecegim. Hadi, peri canlarini kullan, ama söz verdigin gibi Kralice Ari'yi buldugunda buraya gelip bana haber vermeyi unutma.

english: me when-a yous finda da Queen Bee, like-a yous promised. Now go-a and talk-a to da co-ordinator. She-a weel tell-a yous how da fairyreengs work.
translation: Simdi git ve koordinatörle konus. O sana peri canlarinin nasil calistigini anlatacaktir.

english: No, there's no chance of that happening.
Yous weel change-a your mind. Come and talk-a to me me yous do.
translation: Fikrini degistireceksin. Gel ve benimle konus.

english: [player name], you are-a back! Have-a you found da Queen Bee?
translation: Maceraci, geri dönmüssün! Kralice Ari'yi buldun mu?

english: Err, no, not yet.
Den whatta are you doing-a back here? Go and-a search for her!
translation: O zaman burada ne isin var? Git ve onu ara!

english: Err, Godfather, I can't help noticing that there seems to be Orcs wandering around Zanaris.
translation: Godfather, Zanaris'te Orklar dolasiyor gibi görünüyor.

english: Yous just-a better keep-a your nose outa my business. I's da Godfather and I's da one who's inna charge here.
translation: Sen benim isime burnunu sokma. Ben Godfather'im ve burada yetkili olan benim.

english: Do you know what these strange marks mean?
translation: Bu garip isaretlerin anlamini biliyor musun?

english: For why you show-a me dat? Eez very nice to see yous learning to draw! Bravo!
translation: Bunu bana neden gösteriyorsun? Cizim ögrenmen cok güzel! Bravo!

english: Ah, iz-a you. I make-a you an offer, eh? Iz-a good offer. You can't-a refuse it.
translation: Ah, sensin. Sana bir teklifim var, tamam mi? Iyi bir teklif. Reddedemezsin.

english: What?
You tell-a me ze answer to dis, si?
You tell-a me your answer, si?
Iz-a no good.
Grazie infinite!
Who are you?
Where's the Fairy Queen?
What's going on here?
Where's the Fairy Queen's throne gone?
Where is the Fairy Queen?
Do you have any idea who could have done this?
translation: Bunu kimin yapmis olabilecegi hakkinda bir fikrin var mi?

english: Where could she have been taken to?
Yes, okay.
No, I'll rescue her myself.
Where have all the fairies gone?
Oh, okay then.
No, there's no chance of that happening.
Why aren't you in the war room with the Fairy Queen and her advisors?
translation: Neden Peri Kralicesi ve danismanlariyla birlikte savas odasinda degilsin?

english: I don't like war! I don't believe that violence is ever justified, that's why I became a healer.
translation: Savasi sevmiyorum! Siddetin hicbir zaman hakli oldugunu düsünmüyorum, bu yüzden sifaci oldum.

english: How do crops and such survive down here? Surely they need a bit of sunlight?
translation: Burada ekinler ve benzeri seyler nasil hayatta kaliyor? Biraz günes isigina ihtiyaclari yok mu?

english: Clearly you come from a plane dependent on sunlight. Down here, the plants grow in the aura of faerie.
translation: Belli ki günes isigina bagimli bir boyuttan geliyorsun. Burada bitkiler perilerin aurasi icinde büyüyor.

english: What's so good about this place?
translation: Bu yerin nesi bu kadar iyi?

english: Zanaris is a meeting point of cultures. Those from many worlds converge here to exchange knowledge and goods.
translation: Zanaris, kültürlerin bulusma noktasidir. Bircok dünyadan gelenler burada bir araya gelerek bilgi ve mal alisverisinde bulunurlar.

english: Have you managed to work out a plan yet?
Not yet, [player name], but it looks like we'll need to ask you for your help again, I'm afraid. I'll be able to tell you more once we have finished making our battle plans.
translation: Henüz degil, Maceraci, ama korkarim ki yine yardimini isteyecegiz. Savas planlarimizi tamamladigimizda sana daha fazla bilgi verebilecegim.

english: Please solve this for me. I have other things to be thinking about.
translation: Lütfen bunu benim icin cöz. Düsünmem gereken baska seyler var.

english: The Fairy Queen has given you a puzzle box!
translation: Peri Kralicesi sana bir bulmaca kutusu verdi!

english: Sorry but you haven't solved the puzzle yet.
Thanks [player name]!
The Fairy Queen has given you another clue scroll!
translation: Peri Kralicesi sana baska bir ipucu parsömeni verdi!

english: How do crops and such survive down here?
translation: Burada ekinler ve benzeri seyler nasil hayatta kaliyor?

english: What's so good about this place?
translation: Bu yerin nesi bu kadar iyi?

english: How goes the council of war?
Slowly, I'm afraid. We're still trying to come up with a reasonable plan.
translation: Yavas ilerliyor maalesef. Hala makul bir plan yapmaya calisiyoruz.

english: 'Ello, sugar. I'm afraid I can't gossip right now, I've got a cake in the oven.
translation: Selam tatlim. Maalesef su anda dedikodu yapamam, firinda kekim var.

english: Oi you! Did you think I didn't see that? That's my chocolate bar, that is!
translation: Hey sen! Görmedigimi mi sandin? O benim cikolatam!

english: Oh, sorry. I didn't realise it belonged to anybody.
translation: Oh, özür dilerim. Kimseye ait oldugunu fark etmemistim.

english: That's alright, honey. You look a bit thin anyway. Take it if you need it.
translation: Önemli degil tatlim. Zaten biraz zayif görünüyorsun. Ihtiyacin varsa al.

english: Do you know what these strange marks mean?
translation: Bu garip isaretlerin anlamini biliyor musun?

english: Sorry dearie, no, but I have seen a sign with similar marks near the mysterious ruins. You know, the ones that lead you to the Cosmic Rune Altar.
translation: Üzgünüm canim, bilmiyorum, ama gizemli harabelerin yakininda benzer isaretlerin oldugu bir tabela görmüstüm. Bilirsin, seni Kozmik Rune Altari'na götüren isaretler.

english: Can I help you at all?
No thanks.
Yes please. What are you selling?
No thanks.
Can I help you at all?
No thanks.
Yes please. What are you selling?
No thanks.
Hi there [player name]. I am Falo the bard! Like my brother Olaf, who lives in Rellekka, I also write music.
translation: Merhaba Maceraci. Ben ozan Falo! Rellekka'da yasayan kardesim Olaf gibi ben de müzik yaziyorum.

english: (continues below)
Hi there [Fremennik name]. I am Falo the bard! Like my brother Olaf, who lives in Rellekka, I also write music.
translation: Merhaba Dokrak. Ben ozan Falo! Rellekka'da yasayan kardesim Olaf gibi ben de müzik yaziyorum.

english: Do you write about anything in particular?
translation: Özellikle bir konu hakkinda mi yaziyorsun?

english: Oh most certainly! I write about all the objects in the lands. From weapons and armour to palm trees and sands. That's why I wander far from Rellekka to seek inspiration.
translation: Elbette! Bu topraklardaki tüm nesneler hakkinda yaziyorum. Silah ve zirhlardan palmiye agaclari ve kumlara kadar. Bu yüzden ilham almak icin Rellekka'dan uzaklara gidiyorum.

english: I have one problem though. I am very forgetful, I can never remember which particular object a song was about.
translation: Ancak bir sorunum var. Cok unutkanim, bir sarkinin hangi nesne hakkinda oldugunu asla hatirlayamiyorum.

english: Surely the lyrics for such a song would be enough to help you remember?
translation: Böyle bir sarkinin sözleri hatirlamana yardimci olmaz mi?

english: I am afraid not. It saddens me deeply, so I often send out messages to adventurers to help me discreetly.
translation: Korkarim ki olmaz. Bu beni cok üzüyor, bu yüzden sik sik maceracilara gizlice bana yardim etmeleri icin mesajlar gönderiyorum.

english: I'll keep a look out for them! Goodbye Falo.
Hi there! Who are you?
Get away! I do not speak to outlanders.
Thank you for coming [Fremennik name], I need your help.
translation: Geldigin icin tesekkürler Dokrak, yardimina ihtiyacim var.

english: I have one of my old songs stuck in my head, but I cannot remember what the object it refers to is. I am so forgetful. I'll sing it to you.
translation: Eski sarkilarimdan biri kafamda takili kaldi, ama sarkinin neyi anlattigini hatirlayamiyorum. Cok unutkanim. Sana sarkiyi söyleyeyim.

english: What a beautiful song!
You have very kind words. I would be extremely grateful if you could remind me which object the song was about.
translation: Cok naziksin. Sarkinin hangi nesneyi anlattigini bana hatirlatirsan cok minnettar olurum.

english: I really hope you can help me. Please show me the object my song is about!
translation: Umarim bana yardim edebilirsin. Lütfen sarkimin bahsettigi nesneyi göster bana!

english: Can you sing me the song again?
Okay, here goes... [random song]
You show your object to Falo.
Falo's eyes light up.
Yes yes yes! That is it, thank you so much [Fremennik name]. The memories have come flooding back. I get why the lyrics are what they are now.
translation: Evet, evet, evet! Iste bu, cok tesekkür ederim Dokrak. Anilarim bir anda geri geldi. Sarki sözlerinin neden böyle oldugunu simdi anliyorum.

english: I'm glad to have helped, hopefully you'll never forget again!
translation: Yardimci olabildigime sevindim, umarim bir daha asla unutmazsin!

english: Falo's eyes fail to light up.
No no no! That's not it. Please have another think about it, [Fremennik name].
translation: Hayir, hayir, hayir! O degil. Lütfen bir daha düsün, Dokrak.

english: Arr!
Is there something I can help ye with?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: I would like to join your crew.
Of course you would!
However, I don't let anyone on the team if they are wearing a hat or a helmet.
translation: Ancak, sapka veya kask takan kimseyi ekibe almiyorum.

english: You can go and store it in the deposit box next to Jimmy's stall.
translation: Jimmy'nin tezgahinin yanindaki emanet kutusuna koyabilirsin.

english: Why not?
Well, in order to tell my crew from San Fan's I will need to give you a hat like mine.
translation: San Fan'in ekibinden ayirt edebilmek icin sana benimki gibi bir sapka vermem gerekecek.

english: If you are wearing a hat it might get lost when I give you my crew's hat.
translation: Sapka takarsan, sana ekibimin sapkasini verdigimde kaybolabilir.

english: You wouldn't want that would you?
No, that sounds very reasonable in fact.
translation: Hayir, aslinda bu cok mantikli geliyor.

english: Well, I'll be glad to have you aboard, but you will need to go and store all of your gear first.
translation: Seni ekibime almaktan memnuniyet duyarim, ama önce tüm esyalarini saklaman gerekiyor.

english: What do you mean?
Well, you will need all of your inventory space for the ingredients, and all of the other things I'll need you to haul about.
translation: Malzemeler ve tasiman gereken diger seyler icin tüm envanter alanina ihtiyacin olacak.

english: There is a bank deposit box next to Jimmy's stall if you need it. Come and see me when you have a fully empty inventory.
translation: Ihtiyacin olursa Jimmy'nin tezgahinin yaninda bir banka kasasi var. Envanterin tamamen bosaldiginda bana gel.

english: Sadly for you however, I have more than enough people on my crew.
translation: Ne yazik ki, mürettebatimda yeterince insan var.

english: Oh, all right.
Is that...thing yours?
You mean my cat?
Yes, I mean your cat! I HATE cats! Get it out of here!
translation: Evet, kedini kastediyorum! Kedilerden nefret ederim! Onu buradan cikar!

english: Filthy things, no better than the rats that they catch.
You cannot take your follower into the game.
Arr, well we'll get you sorted out with a team hat right away.
translation: Arr, hemen sana bir takim sapkasi ayarlayalim.

english: Go wait in the waiting room, I'll call you when we are ready to begin.
translation: Bekleme odasinda bekle, baslamaya hazir oldugumuzda seni cagiririm.

english: Who are you, and what is this place?
Arrharrharr!
Do you not recognise me? I am the famous dandy pirate 'Fancy' Dan!
translation: Beni tanimadin mi? Ben ünlü züppe korsan ‘Fancy’ Dan!

english: Yes, of course, any pirate knows who you are.
translation: Evet, tabii, tüm korsanlar seni tanir.

english: But of course.
As for what this place is, it is my glorious still, producing the best quality 'rum' this side of Braindeath Island.
translation: Burasi ise benim görkemli damitma tesisim, Braindeath Adasi'nin bu tarafinda en kaliteli 'rom'u üretiyor.

english: Oh, and the run-down swill-producing ditch that San Fan over there calls a still.
translation: Oh, ve suradaki San Fan'in damitma tesisi dedigi, harap olmus, pislik üreten cukur.

english: So with two stills you have plenty of 'rum' right?
translation: Iki damitma tesisiniz olduguna göre bol bol 'rom'unuz var, degil mi?

english: Well we would do, if that hatchet-faced harridan wouldn't keep trying to torch the place!
translation: O balta suratli cadaloz burayi yakmaya calismasaydi, olurdu!

english: I say!
A little while ago we had some real problems getting rum to the island, hence the two stills.
translation: Kisa bir süre önce adaya rom getirmekte ciddi sorunlar yasadik, bu yüzden iki damitma makinesi var.

english: However, after a little misunderstanding involving San's still and a barrel of gunpowder our relationship seems to have become a little strained.
translation: Ancak, San'in damitma makinesi ve bir varil barutla ilgili kücük bir yanlis anlasilma sonrasinda iliskimiz biraz gerginlesti.

english: Apparently it is perfectly within the pirate code to burn each others stills, so long as nobody directly attacks the other person's crew, so rum production has taken a slight dip of late.
translation: Görünüse göre, kimsenin diger kisinin mürettebatina dogrudan saldirmadigi sürece, birbirlerinin damitma makinelerini yakmak korsan kurallarina tamamen uygun, bu yüzden rom üretimi son zamanlarda biraz düstü.

english: Can I help out?
Yes, probably. I have a bunch of jobs that need doing, if you feel up to it.
translation: Evet, muhtemelen. Yapilmasi gereken bir sürü isim var, eger istersen.

english: What would you like to know about?
How do I help you brew 'Rum'?
Well the stills we have set up are based on the ones on Braindeath island... well roughly at any rate.
translation: Kurdugumuz damitma cihazlari Braindeath adasindakine benziyor... en azindan kabaca.

english: All you have to do is help put the ingredients into the hoppers and keep the boilers burning.
translation: Tek yapman gereken malzemeleri haznelere koymaya yardim etmek ve kazanlari yakmaya devam etmek.

english: If you add enough ingredients to the hoppers then you have the ability to pick up a single bottle of rum when it brews.
translation: Haznelere yeterli miktarda malzeme eklersen, demlendiginde bir sise rom alabilirsin.

english: So, if ye add 5 buckets of water to the hoppers, then ye get access to one bottle. If you add 3 bowls of coloured water you get access to one bottle, and if you add one of anything else you get access to one bottle.
translation: Yani, haznelere 5 kova su eklersen, bir sise alabilirsin. 3 kase renkli su eklersen bir sise alabilirsin, baska herhangi bir sey eklersen bir sise alabilirsin.

english: This is cumulative, meaning that if you add (for example) 10 buckets of water, 3 sweetgrubs and 6 bowls of coloured water, then you have a chance to collect 7 bottles of rum for the team.
translation: Bu birikimlidir, yani (örnegin) 10 kova su, 3 tatli kurtcuk ve 6 kase renkli su eklerseniz, takim icin 7 sise rom alma sansiniz olur.

english: The boilers are easy as pie to sort out. You just put some logs in, light them with a tinderbox, and then keep putting logs in until they are good and hot.
translation: Kazanlari kullanmak cocuk oyuncagidir. Icine birkac odun koyun, cakmaktasiyla atesleyin ve iyice isinana kadar odun eklemeye devam edin.

english: Three logs should do it, but it's best to keep heaping them in just in case.
translation: Üc odun yeterli olacaktir, ancak her ihtimale karsi odun eklemeye devam etmek en iyisidir.

english: The ingredients are; Bitternuts, Scrapey Tree Bark, Sweetgrubs, Buckets of Water and some Coloured Water.
translation: Malzemeler sunlardir: Bitternuts, Scrapey Tree Bark, Sweetgrubs, Buckets of Water ve biraz Coloured Water.

english: Where can I get Bitternuts?
There are plenty of Bitternut trees inside this walled off area. The problem is that the trees are too tricky for a human to climb.
translation: Bu duvarla cevrili alanda cok sayida Bitternut agaci var. Sorun, agaclarin bir insanin tirmanmasi icin cok zor olmasi.

english: You will need to catch a monkey and send it up the tree to get the nut for you.
translation: Bir maymun yakalayip agaca göndererek sizin icin findigi almasini saglamaniz gerekecek.

english: Send it up the tree? How does that work?
translation: Agaca göndermek mi? Bu nasil olacak?

english: Well, if you were a monkey, and some random person grabbed you, dumped some dye in your fur and shoved you up a tree, you would hurl the closest heavy object at them too.
translation: Eger bir maymun olsaydin ve rastgele birisi seni yakalayip, kürküne boya döküp agaca firlatsaydi, sen de en yakinindaki agir nesneyi ona firlatirdin.

english: Wait a second, dye?
Yes, you'll need to get a bowl of coloured water and pour it on the monkey. Otherwise you won't be able to tell which team the monkey belongs too.
translation: Evet, bir kase renkli su alip maymuna dökmen gerekecek. Aksi takdirde maymunun hangi takima ait oldugunu anlayamazsin.

english: That makes sense...I think...
Anything else?
Can I ask about something else?
Ok, what else?
So...how would I go about sabotaging the enemy still?
Where can I get Scrapey tree bark...and why do I get the feeling I won't like the answer?
translation: Scrapey agac kabugunu nereden bulabilirim... ve neden cevabi begenmeyecegim hissine kapiliyorum?

english: Inside this walled area there are a few Scrapey trees. They are the big, ill looking ones, you can't miss them.
translation: Bu duvarla cevrili alanda birkac Scrapey agaci var. Büyük, cirkin görünümlü agaclar, gözden kacirman imkansiz.

english: Basically, you cut them down and then carve the bark off with a knife.
translation: Basitce, agaclari kesip kabugunu bicakla soyuyorsun.

english: It's pretty simple, except the sap tends somake people feel kind offill if they get any on themselves.
translation: Oldukca basit, ancak agacin özü insanlara bulastiginda onlari biraz hasta hissettiriyor.

english: How ill?
Don't worry, we aren't talking deadly ill or anything.
translation: Merak etme, ölümcül bir hastaliktan bahsetmiyoruz.

english: It's more like you'll feel quite dizzy and weak for a bit.
translation: Daha cok, bir süre basiniz dönecek ve kendinizi zayif hissedeceksiniz.

english: Joy...
Sweetgrubs? What are they?
Well, lacking any sluglings in the area, we add these little grubs called Sweetgrubs. If you ignore the gag- inducing aftertaste, they are quite sweet.
translation: Bu bölgede sümüklü böcek bulunmadigindan, Sweetgrubs adinda kücük kurtcuklar ekliyoruz. Tiksindirici tadi görmezden gelirseniz, oldukca tatlidirlar.

english: How... how can you drink this stuff?
Quite easily!
Pirates are renowned as being tough for a reason.
translation: Korsanlar bir nedenden dolayi sert olarak bilinirler.

english: So where do I get these grubs from anyway?
Well, there are a few sweetgrub mounds inside there. We have a handful of rat meat that you can use on the mounds to draw the grubs to the surface.
translation: Iceride birkac tatli kurtcuk yuvasi var. Yuvaya atarak kurtcuklari yüzeye cikarmak icin kullanabileceginiz bir avuc fare eti var.

english: Mind your fingers though, they are voracious little things.
translation: Parmaklarina dikkat et, bunlar cok acgözlü kücük yaratiklar.

english: And here was me thinking that nothing could be more disgusting than Braindeath 'Rum'.
translation: Ben de Braindeath 'Rum'dan daha igrenc bir sey olamaz diye düsünüyordum.

english: Arr, that's where ye'd be wrong [lad/lass], 'cos new, improved Braindeath 'Rum' Classic is now 200% more disgustin' than any leadin' competitor!
translation: Arr, yaniliyorsun , cünkü yeni, gelistirilmis Braindeath ‘Rum’ Classic artik önde gelen rakiplerinden %200 daha igrenc!

english: Legal disclaimer; the dangerous amount of disgustin' in new Braindeath 'Rum' Classic be too much for pregnant women, donkeys and anyone with more than seven letters in their last name.
translation: Yasal uyari: Yeni Braindeath ‘Rum’ Classic'teki tehlikeli derecede igrenclik, hamile kadinlar, esekler ve soyadinda yedi harften fazla olan herkes icin fazla olabilir.

english: What was that?
What was what?
Is there anything else?
How do I get...
Wait, no, that question makes me sound like I haven't a clue what I'm doing.
translation: Dur, hayir, bu soru sanki ne yaptigimi bilmiyormusum gibi gösteriyor.

english: Where can I get buckets in there?
There are a few lying about. Help yourself.
translation: Etrafta birkac tane var. Istedigin kadar alabilirsin.

english: There is a pump in the still, so long as it's working you should have almost unlimited water.
translation: Damitma cihazinda bir pompa var, calistigi sürece neredeyse sinirsiz su alabilirsin.

english: Hold on, do I have to add anything disgusting and/or potential lethal to the water before I pour it in?
translation: Bir dakika, suyu dökmeden önce icine igrenc ve/veya potansiyel olarak ölümcül bir sey eklemem gerekiyor mu?

english: Perish the thought!
Ok, just checking.
What sort of coloured water are we talking about here?
translation: Burada ne tür renkli sudan bahsediyoruz?

english: Well, the other still has an area of waste ground with a flower growing on it. If you go and grab one of the flowers and jam it in the kettle, the water will boil out the colour.
translation: Diger damitma cihazinin yaninda ciceklerin yetistigi bir atik alani var. Oradan bir cicek alip su isiticisina koyarsan, su kaynarken rengini alir.

english: We use the colour to keep our rum easily identifiable.
translation: Bu rengi, romumuzu kolayca ayirt edebilmek icin kullaniyoruz.

english: So I just empty the kettle into the hopper, right?
translation: Yani su isiticisini hazneye bosaltmam yeterli, degil mi?

english: No, no, you'll need to take an empty bowl and fill it from the kettle.
translation: Hayir, hayir, bos bir kase alip su isiticisindan doldurman gerekiyor.

english: That way you can use the stuff on a monkey if you need to.
Use it on a monkey...of course.
How do I repair the still?
Well, assuming those scurvy dogs have managed to set any of it on fire, then you'll need to tip a bucket of water on it before you can repair it.
translation: Eger o alcaklar onu atese vermisse, tamir etmeden önce üzerine bir kova su dökmen gerekecek.

english: Then, it all comes down to what part of it was damaged.
translation: O zaman, her sey hangi kisminin hasar gördügüne bagli.

english: How can I repair hoppers?
Well, assuming that they are not on fire, all you need to do is use the heavy lumber patches. They are big enough to cover most holes.
translation: Yangin cikmadigini varsayarsak, tek yapman gereken agir kereste yamalari kullanmak. Bunlar cogu deligi kapatacak kadar büyük.

english: Will I need a hammer?
No, just shove it into place and whack it until it lines up.
translation: Hayir, yerine itip hizalanana kadar vurman yeter.

english: How do I repair pipes and the pump?
Well, if you use a pipe section on the damaged part you should be able to replace it easily.
translation: Hasarli kisimda bir boru parcasi kullanirsaniz, kolayca degistirebilirsiniz.

english: No, likely you'll just need to whack the old one out and slot the new one in with your hands.
translation: Hayir, muhtemelen eskisini cikarmaniz ve yenisini ellerinizle yerine yerlestirmeniz gerekecektir.

english: How do I repair bridges?
Well, we have these handy bridge sections you can use to repair the bridges.
translation: Köprüleri onarmak icin kullanabileceginiz kullanisli köprü parcalarimiz var.

english: The main problem is, while a still will keep working if a bit of it is only damaged, the bridges are completely out of commission if they are even slightly damaged.
translation: Asil sorun su ki, damitma cihazi bir kismi hasar görse bile calismaya devam ederken, köprüler en ufak bir hasarda bile tamamen kullanilamaz hale geliyor.

english: Is that going to be a problem? I mean, I can jump across I think.
translation: Bu bir sorun olur mu? Yani, sanirim atlayarak gecebilirim.

english: Don't try that! Our lawyers tell us we aren't covered for injuries sustained while jumping over burned bridges.
translation: Bunu denemeyin! Avukatlarimiz, yanmis köprülerin üzerinden atlarken meydana gelen yaralanmalarin sigorta kapsamina girmedigini söylüyor.

english: Seriously, just keep off the bridges until they are fixed.
translation: Cidden, tamir edilene kadar köprülerden uzak durun.

english: Where do I get all this stuff anyway?
We have a load of items already on a table inside the still. You can also make new ones if you grab some logs.
translation: Damitma cihazinin icindeki masada bir sürü malzeme var. Ayrica, biraz odun bulursan yenilerini de yapabilirsin.

english: How does that work?
We have a work table set up in the still. If you use the logs in it you can craft up a handy replacement for part of the still.
translation: Damitma cihazinda bir calisma masasi var. Oradaki odunlari kullanirsan, damitma cihazinin bir parcasini degistirmek icin kullanisli bir yedek parca yapabilirsin.

english: Don't worry about them fitting, the things are held together by nails, replacement parts and soot by now.
translation: Uyum konusunda endiselenme, parcalar civi, yedek parcalar ve kurumla bir arada tutuluyor.

english: Well...how sanitary...
Ok, I think I've heard enough.
Fine. Glad I could help.
Ok, here's what you need to do.
The wood around here is really dry and flammable, so take one of the torches, light it up, and then go and attack the enemy still with it.
translation: Buradaki odunlar cok kuru ve yanici, bu yüzden mesalelerden birini al, yak ve düsmanin damitma cihazina saldir.

english: That's it?
Most of their still is soaked in 'alcohol' and made from tinder dry wood.
translation: Damitma cihazlarinin cogu “alkol” ile islatilmis ve kuru odunlardan yapilmis.

english: Essentially, if it isn't ours, try using a torch on it and see what happens.
translation: Esasen, bizim olmayanlara mesaleyi tutun ve ne olacagini görün.

english: Ok, I get you.
So what will you give me for helping out?
translation: Peki yardim ettigim icin bana ne vereceksin?

english: Hahahaha! What a mercenary attitude! You'll do fine here.
translation: Hahahaha! Ne paragöz bir tavir! Burada iyi is cikaracaksin.

english: Well, for each bottle that your team produces, I'll give you one piece of eight.
translation: Takimin ürettigi her sise icin sana bir sekizli verecegim.

english: If you manage to set something on fire then I'll toss in another, same for repairing the still.
translation: Bir seyi atese vermeyi basarirsan bir tane daha eklerim, damitma cihazini tamir edersen de aynisi gecerli.

english: What can I use these pieces of eight for?
translation: Bu sekizli paralari ne icin kullanabilirim?

english: See Honest Jimmy there? He'll trade you some pretty nice stuff for them.
translation: Suradaki Dürüst Jimmy'yi görüyor musun? Onlarla sana oldukca güzel seyler verecektir.

english: Great!
I don't let anyone on the team if they are wearing a hat or a helmet.
translation: Sapka veya kask takanlari takima almam.

english: I'll be glad to have you aboard, but you will need to go and store all of your gear first.
translation: Seni ekibime almaktan memnuniyet duyarim, ama önce tüm esyalarini depoya götürmen gerekiyor.

english: Sadly for you I have more than enough people on my crew.
Is that... thing yours?
This minigame is unavailable on this world.
translation: Bu mini oyun bu dünyada mevcut degil.

english: So, how well can you cook?
Well, I can, err, cook a bit...
Well 'a bit' doesn't cut it in here. Come back when you have a cooking level of 40.
translation: Burada “biraz” yetmez. Yemek pisirme seviyen 40 oldugunda tekrar gel.

english: Anyone lookin' fer work?
Arr! Looking fer good pirates!
Come join me crew!
Don't join them, join us!
Free(ish) rum fer all!
Join the winnin' team now!
Need pirates fer brewin'!
Recruiting!
Roll up, roll up!
We have dental!
I would like to join your crew.
Who are you, and what is this place?
Brewing 'Rum'
Where can I get Bitternuts?
Can I ask about something else?
Repairing the Still
Sabotaging the Still
What will you pay me?
Ok, I think I've heard enough
Where can I get Scrapey Tree Bark?
Where can I get Sweetgrubs?
Where can I get buckets of water?
Where can I get coloured water?
How do I repair Hoppers?
How do I repair Pipes and the pump?
How do I repair Bridges?
How do I get repair items?
How Do I repair Hoppers?
How do I get repair items
Sabotaging San's Still
Ha, well I'm retired now, but in my heyday I was quite the expert fisherman! These days I just help out around the village where I can, my old bones don't allow me to do any more than that.
translation: Ha, artik emekli oldum, ama en parlak dönemimde oldukca uzman bir balikciydim! Bu günlerde sadece köyde elimden geldigince yardim ediyorum, yasli kemiklerim daha fazlasini yapmama izin vermiyor.

english: Is there anything interesting to do around here?
translation: Buralarda ilginc bir sey var mi?

english: Bwana, if anyone else asks me that question today, I'll explode! Go and ask someone else!
translation: Bwana, bugün baska biri bana bu soruyu sorarsa, patlayacagim! Git baskasina sor!

english: Not that I'm aware of, just sit back and enjoy the sunshine bwana!
translation: Bildigim kadariyla yok, arkana yaslan ve günesin tadini cikar bwana!

english: Well, I think that there's some work to be done...perhaps Murcaily can help you. He usually tends to the hardwood grove to the east of Trufitus's hut.
translation: Sanirim yapilacak bazi isler var... belki Murcaily sana yardimci olabilir. Genellikle Trufitus'un kulübesinin dogusundaki sert agac korusunda calisir.

english: It's just village life as normal around here Bwana, always something interesting to find to occupy your time if you look hard enough.
translation: Burada her sey normal köy hayati gibi bwana, yeterince dikkatli bakarsan zamanini gecirecek ilginc seyler bulabilirsin.

english: Sorry Bwana, I'm already busy, why not go and talk to Murcaily! He's around the village somewhere.
translation: Üzgünüm Bwana, ben zaten mesgulüm, neden gidip Murcaily ile konusmuyorsun! Köyün bir yerinde buralarda.

english: Ok, thanks.
Hello there...thanks for helping out Trufitus commune with the gods Bwana. We've been able to return to the village thanks to your help.
translation: Merhaba... Trufitus'un tanrilarla iletisim kurmasina yardim ettigin icin tesekkürler Bwana. Senin yardimin sayesinde köye geri dönebildik.

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
Yeah, you've been doing a lot of good work around here. Let me give you something for your time and effort.
translation: Evet, burada cok iyi isler yapiyorsun. Zamanin ve emeklerin icin sana bir sey vereyim.

english: I've already given you some trading sticks and I don't have any more on me at the moment. Why not go and talk to some of the other villagers and get some contributions?
translation: Sana zaten bazi ticaret cubuklari verdim ve su anda üzerimde baska yok. Neden gidip diger köylülerle konusup biraz katki almiyorsun?

english: Ahhhhhhhh - Get away from me you beast!
translation: Ahhhhhhhh - Benden uzak dur seni canavar!

english: What's the problem....oh, I'm wearing this big scary mask! I'd better take it off before I start talking to the natives.
translation: Sorun ne... oh, bu büyük korkunc maskeyi takmisim! Yerlilerle konusmaya baslamadan önce cikarsam iyi olur.

english: Ahhhhhhhh!
Ahhhhhhhh - It's a monster!
Waahhhhh! - It's da evil broodoo beast come ta eat my very soul!
translation: Waahhhhh! - Bu benim ruhumu yemek icin gelen kötü broodoo canavari!

english: What do you do here?
Is there anything interesting to do here?
translation: Burada ilginc bir sey var mi?

english: Ok, thanks.
I've been doing some work around the village.
Hello, little boy.
I would prefer it if you didn't speak to me in such a manner. I'll have you know I'm an accomplished merchant.
translation: Bana bu sekilde hitap etmemenizi tercih ederim. Ben basarili bir tüccarim, bilginiz olsun.

english: Calm down, junior.
Don't tell me to calm down! And don't call me 'junior'.
translation: Bana sakin ol deme! Ve bana “evlat” deme.

english: I'll have you know I am Farid Morrisane, son of Ali Morrisane, the world's greatest merchant!
translation: Ben Farid Morrisane, dünyanin en büyük tüccari Ali Morrisane'nin ogluyum, bilginiz olsun!

english: Then why are you here and not him?
translation: O zaman neden o degil de sen buradasin?

english: My dad has given me the responsibility of expanding our business here.
translation: Babam buradaki isimizi büyütme sorumlulugunu bana verdi.

english: And you're up to the task? What a grown up boy you are! Mummy and daddy must be very pleased!
translation: Ve bu görevi yerine getirebilecek misin? Ne kadar da olgun bir cocuksun! Annen ve baban cok memnun olmalilar!

english: Look, [mate/darling] - I may be young, I may be short, but I'm a respected merchant around here and don't have time to deal with simpletons like you.
translation: Bak, dostum - Genc olabilirim, kisa boylu olabilirim, ama buradaki saygin bir tüccarim ve senin gibi ahmaklarla ugrasacak vaktim yok.

english: Can you show me the prices of ores and bars?
translation: Bana cevher ve külcelerin fiyatlarini gösterir misin?

english: I best go and speak with someone more my height.
translation: Gidip boyuma daha uygun biriyle konussam iyi olacak.

english: Then I shall not stop you, [mister/miss]. I've too much work to do.
translation: O zaman seni durdurmayayim, . Yapacak cok isim var.

english: My father shall be so pleased.
Hmm. If divide by 20 and take off 50%...
Woo hoo! What a sale!
What shall I trade next...
I can make so much money here!
Calm down, junior.
Can you show me the prices of ores and bars?
translation: Cevher ve külcelerin fiyatlarini gösterir misin?

english: I best go and speak with someone more my height.
translation: Gidip benim boyumda biriyle konussam iyi olacak.

english: Oi! Leave my wheat alone!
Hello stranger.
You look like a farmer. Don't see many farmers around here.
translation: Ciftciye benziyorsun. Buralarda pek ciftci görmüyorum.

english: Aye, that you don't. I'm from Hosidius, y'see. I just come here to drink.
translation: Evet, görmüyorsun. Ben Hosidius'tanim. Buraya sadece icmeye geldim.

english: You travel all the way out to Shayzien just for a few beers? Don't you have a pub back home?
translation: Sadece birkac bira icmek icin Shayzien'e kadar mi geldin? Senin memleketinde pub yok mu?

english: Indeed we do... But I can't stand the place for more than a few minutes.
translation: Elbette var... Ama o yeri birkac dakikadan fazla dayanamiyorum.

english: Have you ever been in there? Such a rowdy crowd... people shouting across the bar about 'Farming this', 'Farming that'... can barely hear myself think half the time.
translation: Hic oraya gittin mi? Cok gürültülü bir yer... Insanlar barda “Ciftcilik sudur, ciftcilik budur” diye bagiriyor... Cogu zaman kendi düsüncelerimi bile duyamiyorum.

english: No, no... Can't be doin' with it. That's why I make the trip out here for a nice quiet one.
translation: Hayir, hayir... Orada duramam. Bu yüzden buraya gelip sessiz sakin bir icki iciyorum.

english: Well I'd better leave you to it then!
Exchuse me... I am trying to tell my verrry good friends 'bout the biggest bull I ever raised.
translation: Affedersiniz... Cok iyi arkadaslarima simdiye kadar yetistirdigim en büyük bogayi anlatmaya calisiyorum.

english: Exchuse me... I am lishning to my good friend.
Mean pair of horns he'd got.
Got enough leather off 'im for a new carpet.
translation: Onun derisinden yeni bir hali yapmaya yetecek kadar deri elde ettik.

english: Grew to the size of a cart, I swear!
translation: Yemin ederim, bir araba büyüklügüne kadar büyüdü!

english: It's not like that these days.
'E went MOO MOO MOO all night.
translation: Bütün gece MOO MOO MOO diye bagirdi.

english: Never had a year like that since.
translation: O zamandan beri böyle bir yil olmadi.

english: That prize should've been mine!
Ol' Hosidius thought we'd need a bigger barn.
translation: Yasli Hosidius daha büyük bir ahir ihtiyacimiz oldugunu düsündü.

english: Best bull I ever 'ad.
I've got a brand new plough!
No-one got so much corn out of one field before.
translation: Daha önce kimse bir tarladan bu kadar cok misir elde etmemisti.

english: Sacks and sacks of grain like you've never seen!
translation: Hic görmediginiz kadar cok tahil cuvali!

english: Hosidius says we gotta optimise land use. Bleah!
translation: Hosidius arazi kullanimini optimize etmemiz gerektigini söylüyor. Bleah!

english: Them dwarves won't pay a decent price anymore.
translation: Cüceler artik makul bir fiyat ödemiyorlar.

english: Best harvest we'd ever 'ad.
translation: Simdiye kadar elde ettigimiz en iyi hasat.

english: 'Course, the weather were better back then.
translation: Tabii, o zamanlar hava daha iyiydi.

english: Fed the kids for a year off 'is beef.
translation: Bu sigirin etiyle cocuklari bir yil besledik.

english: Could 'ave passed for a mammoth.
Ain't no-one ever tipped that bull.
You've never seen a bull like 'im.
Pearls of wisdom!
Ah, tell it!
Best times ever!
Right you are.
Great days!
I'm going to be sick!
You're right.
You're so right.
Those were the days!
Not like nowadays.
Hello there. How's it going?
Well the work is going well, so I'm very good, thank you.
translation: Isler iyi gidiyor, ben de cok iyiyim, tesekkürler.

english: Not too bad thanks.
I'm fine, how are you?
Very well, thank you.
Nilsal! I'm pretty good, thank you. It's always nice to be out in the sun.
translation: Nilsal! Ben iyiyim, tesekkürler. Güneste olmak her zaman güzeldir.

english: Hello there! Nice weather we've been having. Perfect for a day outdoors!
translation: Merhaba! Hava cok güzel. Disarida vakit gecirmek icin mükemmel!

english: Hello there.
I have all the bad luck. My sheep all run off somewhere, and then those mourners tell me they're infected!
translation: Sanssizlik pesimden ayrilmiyor. Koyunlarim bir yerlere kacti, sonra da cenaze törenindekiler bana onlarin enfekte oldugunu söylediler!

english: Well, I hope things start to look up for you.
Hello there. Sorry about your sheep...
That's okay, it had to be done for the sake of the town.
translation: Önemli degil, kasabanin iyiligi icin yapilmasi gerekiyordu.

english: That's okay, you are not to blame. I'm just glad the truth behind the plague was eventually revealed.
translation: Önemli degil, senin sucun degil. Salginin ardindaki gercegin sonunda ortaya cikmasina sevindim.

english: Good day. What are you doing?
I'm tending to these farming patches. They need a little more work before I can plant anything.
translation: Bu tarla parcalarina bakiyorum. Bir sey ekebilmem icin biraz daha calismam gerekiyor.

english: Good luck with that.
Thank you, [Fremennik name].
What's wrong with the patches?
The centre patch is full of weeds, and as soon as I clear them they grow back. The south patch is always far too dry. And the soil in the north patch is terrible; it needs a good dose of compost.
translation: Ortadaki tarla yabani otlarla dolu ve onlari temizledigimde hemen tekrar cikiyorlar. Güneydeki tarla her zaman cok kuru. Kuzeydeki tarlanin topragi ise berbat; bol miktarda kompost gerekiyor.

english: Can you tell me how the kingdom approves of me?
translation: Kralligin beni nasil degerlendirdigini söyleyebilir misin?

english: [amount]% of people approve of you.
Kingdom? Etceteria is ruled by a Queen and we don't approve of you.
translation: Krallik mi? Etceteria bir kralice tarafindan yönetiliyor ve biz sizi onaylamiyoruz.

english: Don't trouble yourself further, Your Highness, you've already done so much!
translation: Kendinizi daha fazla zahmet etmeyin, Majesteleri, zaten cok sey yaptiniz!

english: Hey! This is the Queen's farm. You'll need her approval to make use of it.
translation: Hey! Burasi kralicenin ciftligi. Onu kullanmak icin kralicenin onayi gerekiyor.

english: The storerooms are full, your Highness. You should talk to Advisor Ghrim to collect what we've gathered for you.
translation: Depolar dolu, Majesteleri. Danisman Ghrim ile konusup sizin icin topladiklarimizi almalisiniz.

english: Good luck with that.
What's wrong with the patches?
Hello, young [sir/lady]. Did you want to work on my farm?
translation: Merhaba, genc . Ciftligimde calismak ister misin?

english: Tell me about your farm.
I grow fruit here. Special fruit. It grows very fast, but it needs a lot of tending, otherwise it gets the blight and dies.
translation: Burada meyve yetistiriyorum. Özel meyveler. Cok hizli büyürler, ama cok bakim gerektirirler, aksi takdirde hastalanip ölürler.

english: These days I'm getting old and slow. You can see all the dead plants from where I've tried to farm them.
translation: Son zamanlarda yaslandim ve yavasladim. Yetistirmeye calistigim yerlerdeki tüm ölü bitkileri görebilirsin.

english: Life here seems rather peaceful.
It is most of the time. Something very strange did happen recently though.
translation: Cogu zaman öyledir. Ancak son zamanlarda cok garip bir sey oldu.

english: Oh yeah? What happened?
Well, you see... Two strange hooded figures recently visited the farm. They had an odd smell to them and kept their faces hidden.
translation: Sey, bakin... Son zamanlarda iki garip kapüsonlu kisi ciftligi ziyaret etti. Garip bir kokulari vardi ve yüzlerini gizliyorlardi.

english: They said they represented some client from the far east and that they wanted to inspect the farm. They had a good look around but seemed rather disappointed when they left.
translation: Uzak dogudan bir müsteriyi temsil ettiklerini ve ciftligi incelemek istediklerini söylediler. Etrafi iyice incelediler ama ayrilirken oldukca hayal kirikligina ugramis görünüyorlardi.

english: Oh... I'm sure it was nothing.
translation: Oh... Eminim önemli bir sey degildir.

english: Tell me about yourself.
I'm a fruit farmer. But now I'm a bit too old for that. Maybe I should try writing books again, like I did when I was younger.
translation: Ben bir meyve ciftcisiyim. Ama artik bu is icin biraz yaslandim. Belki de gencken yaptigim gibi tekrar kitap yazmaya baslamaliyim.

english: I'd like to work on your farm.
Well, I'm afraid you're not really suitable.
translation: Korkarim ki bu is icin uygun degilsin.

english: You do not have enough Hosidius favour. Current favour: [number]% - Required: 100.0%
Alright. Take a handful of seeds from the table, and head into the farm. When you've harvested some fruit, deposit it straight into the sacks.
translation: Tamam. Masadan bir avuc tohum al ve ciftlige git. Meyve topladiginda, dogrudan cuvallara koy.

english: Remember, you have to water the plants at each stage, otherwise they die of the blight. Fertiliser makes them grow faster... or die faster if you don't water them.
translation: Unutma, her asamada bitkileri sulaman gerekir, aksi takdirde hastalik nedeniyle ölürler. Gübre, bitkilerin daha hizli büyümesini saglar... ya da sulamazsan daha hizli ölmelerine.

english: You'll gain a little extra experience if you grow enough of the fruit successfully.
translation: Yeterli miktarda meyve yetistirirsen biraz ekstra deneyim kazanirsin.

english: Have you any rewards?
I need to go.
What on earth are you wearing?
I'm here to do some tithing. Blood tithing.
translation: Buraya ondalik vermek icin geldim. Kan ondaligi.

english: Well this is not that kind of farm! I only let normal people work here, so get lost!
translation: Burasi öyle bir ciftlik degil! Burada sadece normal insanlar calisabilir, defol git!

english: You show the book to Farmer Gricoller.
Oh, yes, I remember writing that a long time ago. I told the publisher it should be in the public domain, so that everyone could share the knowledge.
translation: Evet, uzun zaman önce yazdigimi hatirliyorum. Yayinciya, herkesin bu bilgiyi paylasabilmesi icin kitabin kamu mali olmasi gerektigini söyledim.

english: Of course, that was before I got so old and found I couldn't afford to hire workers for my farm. Oh well, I hope it helped someone. It wasn't much use to anyone around here.
translation: Tabii ki, bu cok yaslanip ciftligim icin isci tutacak param kalmadigini fark etmeden önceydi. Neyse, umarim birilerine yardimci olmustur. Buralarda kimseye pek bir faydasi olmadi.

english: Are you the 'Gric' this entry mentions?
You show him 'Lunch by the Lancalliums'.
Yes, I was friends with the last king, it was very sad when he died. The accusations aimed at poor little Rose were ridiculous.
translation: Evet, son kralin arkadasiydim, öldügünde cok üzüldüm. Zavalli kücük Rose'a yöneltilen suclamalar cok sacmaydi.

english: Accusations?
It was all nonesense, the king died naturally! He was old, he'd been on the throne for at least 40 years.
translation: Hepsi sacmalikti, kral dogal nedenlerle öldü! Yasliydi, en az 40 yildir tahtta oturuyordu.

english: Interesting, so he must have waited a while before having children?
translation: Ilginc, o zaman cocuk sahibi olmak icin bir süre beklemesi gerekmis olmali?

english: Indeed, he married late and his wife... Unfortunately didn't survive bringing Rose into this world.
translation: Evet, gec evlendi ve karisi... Ne yazik ki Rose'u dünyaya getirirken hayatini kaybetti.

english: Oh right, have you seen Rose recently?
translation: Anladim, Rose'u son zamanlarda gördün mü?

english: No... After the incident she was locked away. Most have forgotten about her now.
translation: Hayir... Olaydan sonra hapsedildi. Artik cogu kisi onu unuttu.

english: Thanks for the information, Gric. Perhaps it'll all make sense once I've found the other pages.
translation: Bilgi icin tesekkürler, Gric. Belki diger sayfalari buldugumda her sey anlam kazanir.

english: Perhaps.
Ah, fertiliser. I use a lot of that, but I get mine from Hosidius. If you want to give yours to them, go to their storehouse near the bank.
translation: Ah, gübre. Ben cok kullanirim, ama ben Hosidius'tan alirim. Seninkini onlara vermek istersen, banka yakinindaki depolarina git.

english: I'll give you 60 of my reward points for that.
translation: Bunun icin sana 60 ödül puanim verecegim.

english: Thank you.
I'll give you 120 of my reward points for that.
translation: Bunun icin sana 120 ödül puanim verecegim.

english: I'll give you 100 of my reward points for that.
translation: Bunun icin sana 100 ödül puanim verecegim.

english: I'll give you 40 of my reward points for that.
translation: Bunun icin sana 40 ödül puanim verecegim.

english: No thanks.
Take some seeds from the table, otherwise you can't do any farming in there!
translation: Masadan biraz tohum al, yoksa orada tarim yapamazsin!

english: Hey, young [sir/lady], do you know what you're doing in there?
translation: Hey, genc , orada ne yaptigini biliyor musun?

english: Grow those seeds in the patches. When you've harvested some fruit, deposit it straight into the sacks.
translation: O tohumlari tarlalarda yetistir. Meyve topladiginda, hemen cuvallara koy.

english: You'll gain a little extra experience if you grow enough of the fruit successfully. So, are you ready to start?
translation: Yeterince meyve yetistirirsen biraz ekstra deneyim kazanirsin. Peki, baslamaya hazir misin?

english: Yes, I know what I'm doing.
I'm an expert - don't ask me this again.
Alright, young [sir/lady], I won't. Talk to me if you ever want a reminder.
translation: Tamam, genc , sormayacagim. Hatirlatma istersen bana söyle.

english: Tell me about your farm.
Tell me about yourself.
I'd like to work on your farm.
Have you any rewards?
Life here seems rather peaceful.
I need to go.
Accept
Cancel
Tell me how to grow these crops.
Yes, I know what I'm doing.
I'm an expert - don't ask me this again.
translation: Ben bir uzmanim - bunu bir daha sorma.

english: I don't want to do this anymore.
Farmer Hayfield stares at one of his flower beds.
translation: Ciftci Hayfield, cicek tarhlarindan birine bakiyor.

english: Are you alive?
Me?
Farmer Hayfield continues to stare at the flower bed.
translation: Ciftci Hayfield cicek tarhina bakmaya devam ediyor.

english: Tell me! How does it feel to be alive?
translation: Söyle bana! Hayatta olmak nasil bir duygu?

english: Huh, what a strange guy.
Watch yourself, don't trample on any of me cabbages or I'll thump ya.
translation: Dikkat et, lahanalarimi ezme yoksa seni döverim.

english: Oi, what are you doing with my cabbage! Give it back!
translation: Hey, lahanamla ne yapiyorsun! Geri ver!

english: I better not see you with my cabbages again!
translation: Bir daha beni lahana ile görmeyeyim!

english: If the player is not carrying any cabbages:
If the player is carrying a cabbage:
Hello there!
Greetings. It's nice to see another adventurer here.
translation: Selamlar. Burada baska bir maceraci görmek ne güzel.

english: Adventurer? No. I'm a natural historian from Varrock. I'm working on a project to research the creatures of Kourend.
translation: Maceraci mi? Hayir. Ben Varrock'tan bir doga tarihcisiyim. Kourend'deki yaratiklari arastirmak icin bir proje üzerinde calisiyorum.

english: Don't you think this place is so fascinating? It looks like this cave is a major habitat for the giants.
translation: Burasi cok ilginc degil mi? Bu magara devlerin ana yasam alani gibi görünüyor.

english: Yeah, there are many different giants here for sure. How did you manage to get this far? Those giants are quite hostile to visitors.
translation: Evet, burada kesinlikle bircok farkli dev var. Buraya kadar nasil geldin? Bu devler ziyaretcilere karsi oldukca düsmanca davraniyorlar.

english: Well, I just ran past them as fast as I could.
translation: Sey, elimden geldigince hizli kosarak gectim.

english: Anyway, I'd better get back to my research.
Don' say nuffin' to me! Say it to da boss!
translation: Bana bir sey söyleme! Patronuna söyle!

english: Go away I'm very busy!
Sorry to disturb you.
What are you busy doing?
I'm cooking pizzas for the people in this camp.
translation: Bu kampta yasayanlar icin pizza pisiriyorum.

english: Not that these louts appreciate my gourmet cooking!
translation: Bu serseriler benim gurme yemeklerimi takdir etmiyorlar ama!

english: So what is a gourmet chef doing cooking for bandits?
translation: Peki, bir gurme sef haydutlar icin neden yemek pisiriyor?

english: Well I'm an outlaw. I was accused of giving the king food poisoning! The thought of it! I think he just drank too much wine that night.
translation: Ben bir kanun kacagiyim. Krala gida zehirlenmesi yasattigim icin suclandim! Düsünsenize! Bence o gece sadece cok fazla sarap icmisti.

english: I had to flee the kingdom of Misthalin! The bandits give me refuge here as long as I cook for them.
translation: Misthalin kralligindan kacmak zorunda kaldim! Haydutlar, onlara yemek pisirdigim sürece bana burada siginak sagliyorlar.

english: Can I have some pizza too?
Well this pizza is really meant to be for the bandits. I guess I could sell you some pizza bases though
translation: Bu pizza aslinda haydutlar icin. Ama sana pizza hamuru satabilirim.

english: Yes, Okay.
Oh if I have to pay I don't want any.
Okay, I'll leave you to it.
Have you anything to sell?
Well I guess I can sell you some half made pizzas.
translation: Sanirim sana yari pismis pizzalar satabilirim.

english: Sorry to disturb you.
What are you busy doing?
So what is a gourmet chef doing cooking for bandits?
translation: Bir gurme sef haydutlar icin yemek pisiriyor mu?

english: Can I have some pizza too?
Yes, Okay.
Oh if I have to pay I don't want any.
translation: Oh, para ödemek zorunda kalirsam istemiyorum.

english: Okay, I'll leave you to it.
Have you anything to sell?
Welcome to the church of holy Saradomin.
Who's Saradomin?
Surely you have heard of the god, Saradomin?
He who creates the forces of goodness and purity in this world? I cannot believe your ignorance!
translation: Bu dünyada iyilik ve saflik güclerini yaratan tanri? Bu kadar bilgisiz olmaniza inanamiyorum!

english: This is the god with more followers than any other! ...At least in this part of the world.
translation: Bu tanri, digerlerinden daha fazla takipcisi olan tanridir! ...En azindan bu bölgede.

english: He who created this world along with his brothers Guthix and Zamorak?
translation: Kardesleri Guthix ve Zamorak ile birlikte bu dünyayi yaratan tanri?

english: Oh, THAT Saradomin...
There... is only one Saradomin...
Yeah... I, uh, thought you said something else.
translation: Evet... Ben, uh, baska bir sey söyledigini sandim.

english: Oh, sorry. I'm not from this world.
translation: Oh, üzgünüm. Ben bu dünyadan degilim....

english: That's... strange.
I thought things not from this world were all... You know. Slime and tentacles.
translation: Bu dünyadan olmayan seylerin hepsinin... Bilirsin. Sümük ve dokunaclar oldugunu saniyordum.

english: You don't understand. This is an online game!
I... beg your pardon?
Never mind.
I am - do you like my disguise?
Aargh! Avaunt foul creature from another dimension! Avaunt! Begone in the name of Saradomin!
translation: Aargh! Baska bir boyuttan gelen igrenc yaratik, defol! Saradomin'in adiyla defol!

english: Ok, ok, I was only joking...
Nice place you've got here.
It is, isn't it? It was built over 230 years ago.
translation: Öyle, degil mi? 230 yil önce insa edildi.

english: I'm looking for a quest.
That's lucky, I need someone to do a quest for me.
translation: Sanslisin, benim icin bir görev yapacak birine ihtiyacim var.

english: Okay, let me help then.
Thank you. The problem is, there is a ghost in the church graveyard. I would like you to get rid of it.
translation: Tesekkürler. Sorun su ki, kilise mezarliginda bir hayalet var. Onu ortadan kaldirmani istiyorum.

english: If you need any help, my friend Father Urhney is an expert on ghosts.
translation: Yardima ihtiyacin olursa, arkadasim Peder Urhney hayaletler konusunda uzmandir.

english: I believe he is currently living as a hermit in Lumbridge swamp. He has a little shack in the far west of the swamps.
translation: Sanirim su anda Lumbridge batakliginda bir kesis olarak yasiyor. Batakligin en batisinda kücük bir kulübesi var.

english: Exit the graveyard through the south gate to reach the swamp. I'm sure if you told him that I sent you he'd be willing to help.
translation: Mezarliktan güney kapisindan cikip batakliga ulasabilirsin. Onu benim gönderdigimi söylersen, sana yardim etmeye razi olacagina eminim.

english: My name is Father Aereck by the way. Pleased to meet you.
translation: Bu arada, benim adim Peder Aereck. Tanistigimiza memnun oldum.

english: Likewise.
Take care travelling through the swamps, I have heard they can be quite dangerous.
translation: Bataklikta dikkatli olun, duyduguma göre oldukca tehlikeli olabiliyorlar.

english: I will, thanks.
Sorry, I don't have time right now.
Oh well. If you do have some spare time on your hands, come back and talk to me.
translation: Peki. Vaktiniz olursa geri gelip benimle konusun.

english: Thank you for getting rid of that awful ghost for me! May Saradomin always smile upon you!
translation: O korkunc hayaleti benim icin yok ettigin icin tesekkürler! Saradomin sana her zaman gülümsesin!

english: I'm looking for a new quest.
Sorry, I only had the one quest.
The Wise Old Man of Draynor Village said you might reward me if I brought you this.
translation: Draynor Köyü'nün Bilge Yasli Adami, bunu sana getirirsem ödüllendirebilecegini söyledi.

english: Oh, did he?
I'd give you a reward, but you don't seem to have any space for it. Come back when you do.
translation: Sana ödül vermek isterdim, ama bunun icin yerin yok gibi görünüyor. Yer acildiginda tekrar gel.

english: Well, it's still nice of you to bring the message here. Here, I shall bless you...
translation: Yine de mesaji buraya getirdigin icin tesekkürler. Al, seni kutsayayim...

english: Well, maybe you'll find a use for these seeds?
Well, maybe you'll have a use for these?
I suppose gems are always acceptable rewards!
translation: Mücevherler her zaman kabul edilebilir ödüllerdir!

english: I have a question for you.
Please enter the answer to the question.
No, try again.
Correct!
Here, have this.
Who's Saradomin?
Oh, THAT Saradomin...
Oh, sorry. I'm not from this world.
translation: Oh, pardon. Ben bu dünyadan degilim.

I am - do you like my disguise?
Nice place you've got here.
I'm looking for a quest!

Surely you've heard of the almighty egg?
The one who guides us through such troubled times.
translation: Bizi bu zor zamanlarda yönlendiren yumurta.

english: The Duke is his voice and he is the commander, he will lead us to eternal happiness.
translation: Dük onun sesi ve komutanidir, bizi sonsuz mutluluga götürecektir.

There... is only one egg...

translation: Sanslisin, benim icin bir görev yapacak birine ihtiyacim var, ama Dük bana seninle karismamami söyledi.

english: Maybe I should come back after I've finished with the Duke.
translation: Belki Dük ile isim bittikten sonra geri gelmeliyim.

english: That's lucky, I need someone to do a quest for me.
translation: Sanslisin, benim icin bir görev yapacak birine ihtiyacim var.

english: Ok, let me help then.
Thank you, the problem is, uh...well...there's a goat haunting my graveyard.
translation: Tesekkürler, sorun su ki, sey... mezarligimda bir keci dolasiyor.

english: Goat? Don't you mean ghost?
translation: Keci mi? Hayalet demek istedin herhalde?

english: Well yes and no, it's a ghost goat.
Sounds like you have a restless goat problem!
translation: Görünüse göre huzursuz bir keci sorunun var!

english: Now is not the time for jokes, are you going to help me or not?
translation: Saka yapmanin sirasi degil, bana yardim edecek misin, etmeyecek misin?

english: Yeah might as well, I'll go take a look.
Thank you friend, be safe out there.
Sorry, I don't have time right now.
Oh well. If you do have some spare time on your paws, come back and talk to me.
translation: Peki. Eger bos vaktin olursa, gelip benimle konus.

english: What did you ask me to do again?
I need you to rid me of the ghost goat that is haunting my graveyard.
translation: Mezarligimi rahatsiz eden hayalet keciyi ortadan kaldirmani istiyorum.

english: Got it, I'll get back to it.
Church of the egg?
Oh, THAT egg...
