Ask about the ghost.
I'm looking for a quest!
In this holy place I can only offer you calm and peace.
translation: Bu kutsal yerde sana sadece sükunet ve huzur sunabilirim.

english: Calm and Peace? Sounds like the quest for me! How should I start?
translation: Sükunet ve huzur mu? Tam bana göre bir görev gibi! Nasil baslamaliyim?

english: Yes, calm and peace. Just stay here with me and you will feel it eventually.
translation: Evet, sükunet ve huzur. Burada benimle kal, sonunda hissedeceksin.

english: Oh... well... thank you.
Sorry, there will be no sermon today, but you may offer a prayer to Saradomin yourself.
translation: Üzgünüm, bugün vaaz yok, ama Saradomin'e kendin dua edebilirsin.

english: Do the people here mostly worship Saradomin?
translation: Buradaki insanlar cogunlukla Saradomin'e mi tapiyorlar?

english: Of course! Even before our forefathers founded Kourend, under King Rada I, they remembered the tumult of the times when the armies of the gods laid waste to the lands.
translation: Elbette! Atalarimiz Kourend'i kurmadan önce bile, Kral Rada I döneminde, tanrilarin ordularinin topraklari harap ettigi calkantili zamanlari hatirliyorlardi.

english: We thank Saradomin for the end of that violent Age, and pray that he will continue to defend us from the evil other gods.
translation: O siddetli cagin sona ermesi icin Saradomin'e sükrediyoruz ve diger kötü tanrilardan bizi korumaya devam etmesi icin dua ediyoruz.

english: Okay, thanks.
That's nice.
Most impressive, have this!
You've obtained a casket!
Do the people here mostly worship Saradomin?
translation: Buradaki insanlar cogunlukla Saradomin'e mi tapiyorlar?

english: That's nice.
Hello adventurer, do you seek a quest?
translation: Merhaba maceraci, bir görev mi ariyorsun?

english: I am always looking for a quest.
Well, I see poor Romeo wandering around the square. I think he may need help.
translation: Zavalli Romeo meydanda dolasiyor. Sanirim yardima ihtiyaci var.

english: I was helping him and Juliet to meet, but it became impossible.
translation: Onun ve Juliet'in bulusmasina yardim ediyordum ama imkansiz hale geldi.

english: I am sure he can use some help.
No, I prefer just to kill things.
translation: Hayir, ben sadece bir seyleri öldürmeyi tercih ederim.

english: That's a fine career in these lands. There is more that needs killing every day.
translation: Bu topraklarda bu iyi bir kariyer. Her gün öldürülmesi gereken daha cok sey var.

english: Can you recommend a good bar?
Drinking will be the death of you.
But the Blue Moon in the city is cheap enough.
translation: Ama sehirdeki Blue Moon yeterince ucuz.

english: And providing you buy one drink an hour they let you stay all night.
translation: Ve saatte bir icki alirsan bütün gece kalmana izin veriyorlar.

english: Ok, thanks
Oh to be a father in the times of whiskey.
translation: Vay be, viski caginda baba olmak.

english: I sing and I drink and I wake up in gutters.
translation: Sarki söylerim, icerim ve kanalizasyonda uyanirim.

english: Top of the morning to you.
To err is human, to forgive, quite difficult.
translation: Hata yapmak insana mahsustur, affetmek ise oldukca zordur.

english: I need a think I drink.
Can't you see that I'm in the middle of a Sermon?!
But Romeo sent me!
But I'm busy delivering a sermon to my congregation!
Zzzzzzzzz
Yes, well, it certainly seems like you have a captive audience!
translation: Evet, pekala, dinleyicilerin seni dinlemeye can atiyor gibi görünüyor!

english: Ok, ok...what do you want so I can get rid of you and continue with my sermon?
translation: Tamam, tamam... Ne istiyorsun ki senden kurtulup vaazima devam edebileyim?

english: Romeo sent me. He says you may be able to help.
translation: Romeo beni gönderdi. Senin yardim edebilecegini söyledi.

english: Ah Romeo, yes. A fine lad, but a little bit confused.
translation: Ah Romeo, evet. Iyi bir delikanli, ama biraz kafasi karisik.

english: Yes, very confused....Anyway, Romeo wishes to be married to Juliet! She must be rescued from her father's control!
translation: Evet, cok karisik... Neyse, Romeo Juliet ile evlenmek istiyor! Juliet babasinin kontrolünden kurtarilmali!

english: I agree, and I think I have an idea! A potion to make her appear dead...
translation: Katiliyorum ve sanirim bir fikrim var! Onu ölü gibi gösterecek bir iksir...

english: Dead! Sounds a bit creepy to me...but please, continue.
translation: Ölü! Bana biraz ürkütücü geliyor... ama lütfen devam et.

english: The potion will only make Juliet 'appear' dead...then she'll be taken to the crypt...
translation: Iksir Juliet'i sadece ölü gibi gösterecek... sonra onu mezara götürecekler...

english: Crypt! Again...very creepy! You must have some strange hobbies.
translation: Mezar! Yine... cok ürkütücü! Garip hobilerin olmali.

english: Then Romeo can collect her from the crypt! Go to the Apothecary, tell him I sent you and that you'll need a 'Cadava' potion.
translation: Sonra Romeo onu mezardan alabilir! Eczaciya git, ona benim gönderdigimi ve “Cadava” iksiri istedigini söyle.

english: Apart from the strong overtones of death, this is turning out to be a real love story.
translation: Ölümün güclü imalari bir yana, bu gercek bir ask hikayesi haline geliyor.

english: Ah, have you found the Apothecary yet? Remember, Cadava potion, for Juliet.
translation: Ah, eczaciyi buldun mu? Unutma, Juliet icin Cadava iksiri.

english: Did you find the Apothecary?
I've got the cadava potion.
Good! Good work! Ok, take it to Juliet, she's expecting you. I'll talk to Romeo and make sure he knows what to do.
translation: Güzel! Aferin! Tamam, Juliet'e götür, seni bekliyor. Romeo ile konusup ne yapmasi gerektigini ona söyleyecegim.

english: The Wise Old Man of Draynor Village sent you this message about your drinking habits!
translation: Draynor Köyü'nün Bilge Yasli Adami, icki aliskanliklarinla ilgili sana bu mesaji gönderdi!

english: mssge? wha messsge?
oh, msesesge for me.
Oh dear, he doesn't look like he's going to be able to read the message!
translation: Oh hayir, mesaji okuyabilecek gibi görünmüyor!

english: I'd give you a reward, but you don't seem to have any space for it. Come back when you do.
translation: Sana ödül vermek isterdim, ama bunun icin yerin yok gibi görünüyor. Yer acildiginda geri gel.

english: in nomine saradomini, blah blah blah...
translation: in nomine saradomini, blah blah blah...

english: Whee! Mmmgic power, kazamm...
I am always looking for a quest.
No, I prefer just to kill things.
translation: Hayir, ben sadece bir seyler öldürmeyi tercih ederim.

english: Can you recommend a good bar?
Ok, thanks
Go away! I'm meditating!
Well, that's friendly.
I SAID go AWAY.
Okay, okay... sheesh, what a grouch.
translation: Tamam, tamam... Tanrim, ne huysuz bir kadin.

english: I've come to repossess your house.
Under what grounds???
Repeated failure on mortgage repayments.
What?
But... I don't have a mortgage! I built this house myself!
translation: Ama... Benim mortgage'im yok! Bu evi kendim yaptim!

english: Sorry. I must have got the wrong address. All the houses look the same around here.
translation: Üzgünüm. Yanlis adrese gelmis olmaliyim. Buradaki tüm evler ayni görünüyor.

english: What? What houses? What ARE you talking about???
translation: Ne? Ne evleri? Sen neden bahsediyorsun???

english: Never mind.
I don't know. I just wanted this house...
Oh... go away and stop wasting my time!
translation: Oh... git buradan ve zamanimi bosa harcamayi birak!

english: Father Aereck sent me to talk to you.
translation: Peder Aereck beni seninle konusmam icin gönderdi.

english: I suppose I'd better talk to you then. What problems has he got himself into this time?
translation: O zaman seninle konussam iyi olur. Bu sefer neye bulasti?

english: He's got a ghost haunting his graveyard.
Oh, the silly fool.
I leave town for just five months, and ALREADY he can't manage.
translation: Sadece bes ayligina kasabadan ayrildim ve simdiden basa cikamiyor.

english: (sigh)
Well, I can't go back and exorcise it. I vowed not to leave this place. Until I had done a full two years of prayer and meditation.
translation: Geri dönüp onu kovamam. Bu yerden ayrilmayacagima yemin ettim. Iki yil boyunca dua ve meditasyon yapana kadar.

english: Tell you what I can do though; take this amulet.
translation: Ama sana yapabilecegim bir sey var; bu tilsimi al.

english: Father Urhney hands you an amulet.
translation: Peder Urhney sana bir tilsim uzatir.

english: It is an Amulet of Ghostspeak.
So called, because when you wear it you can speak to ghosts. A lot of ghosts are doomed to be ghosts because they have left some important task uncompleted.
translation: Adi böyle cünkü taktiginda hayaletlerle konusabilirsin. Bircok hayalet, önemli bir görevi tamamlamadan öldügü icin hayalet olarak kalmaya mahkumdur.

english: Maybe if you know what this task is, you can get rid of the ghost. I'm not making any guarantees mind you, but it is the best I can do right now.
translation: Belki bu görevin ne oldugunu bilirsen, hayaleti ortadan kaldirabilirsin. Garanti vermiyorum ama su anda yapabilecegim en iyi sey bu.

english: Thank you. I'll give it a try!
You mean he gets himself into lots of problems?
translation: Yani basini bir sürü belaya sokuyor mu?

english: Yeah. For example, when we were trainee priests he kept on getting stuck up bell ropes.
translation: Evet. Mesela, rahip adayiyken sürekli can iplerine takilip kaliyordu.

english: Anyway. I don't have time for chitchat. What's his problem THIS time?
translation: Neyse. Sohbet edecek vaktim yok. Bu seferki sorunu ne?

english: I've lost the Amulet of Ghostspeak.
What are you talking about? I can see you've got it with you!
translation: Ne diyorsun sen? Yaninda oldugunu görüyorum!

english: You come here wasting my time... Has it even occurred to you that you've got it stored somewhere? Now GO AWAY!
translation: Buraya gelip zamanimi bosa harciyorsun... Onu bir yere sakladigin aklina gelmedi mi? Simdi git buradan!

english: How careless can you get? Those things aren't easy to come by you know! Now clear some space in your inventory and I'll give you another one.
translation: Ne kadar dikkatsiz olabilirsin? O seyler kolay bulunmuyor, biliyorsun! Simdi envanterinde yer ac, sana bir tane daha vereyim.

english: How careless can you get? Those things aren't easy to come by you know! It's a good job I've got a spare.
translation: Ne kadar dikkatsiz olabilirsin? O seyler kolay bulunmuyor, biliyorsun! Neyse ki yedegim var.

english: Be more careful this time.
Okay, I'll try to be.
Hello?
At last! The voice of Saradomin! My years of meditation have paid off!
translation: Sonunda! Saradomin'in sesi! Yillarca süren meditasyonumun karsiligini aldim!

english: Um...
O mighty Saradomin! What is your message to me?
Stop sitting around in a house in a swamp and go and do something useful!
translation: Batakliktaki bir evde oturmayi birak ve gidip yararli bir seyler yap!

english: Oh, thank you Saradomin! I will meditate on what this message means!
translation: Oh, tesekkürler Saradomin! Bu mesajin anlamini meditasyon yaparak düsünecegim!

english: Well, that's friendly.
I've come to repossess your house.
Repeated failure on mortgage repayments.
I don't know, I just wanted this house.
Father Aereck sent me to talk to you.
translation: Peder Aereck beni sizinle konusmam icin gönderdi.

english: He's got a ghost haunting his graveyard.
You mean he gets himself into lots of problems?
translation: Yani basini bir sürü belaya sokuyor mu?

english: I've lost the Amulet of Ghostspeak.
Nilsal. Interested in buying some of Aldarin's finest fruit and veg?
translation: Nilsal. Aldarin'in en iyi meyve ve sebzelerinden satin almak ister misin?

english: Let's see what you have.
No thanks.
Fair enough.
Yes please.
No thanks.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu var. Merhaba, selam, merhaba...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her türlü sey! Kuleler görülmeye deger harika manzaralar sunuyor.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmenizi tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Hello tall person.
Hello short person.
What's this patch for?
This is an Anima patch, the only one of its kind. Here, you can grow Iasor, Kronos and Attas plants.
translation: Bu, türünün tek örnegi olan bir Anima yamasidir. Burada Iasor, Kronos ve Attas bitkilerini yetistirebilirsiniz.

english: What are they?
Three unique plants with a special affinity to the Anima Mundi, the life force of our world.
translation: Dünyamizin yasam gücü olan Anima Mundi ile özel bir bagi olan üc benzersiz bitkidir.

english: When planted, all three of these plants have a unique impact on the Anima Mundi. Their effects will likely be very useful to you when farming.
translation: Dikildiginde, bu üc bitkinin de Anima Mundi üzerinde benzersiz bir etkisi vardir. Etkileri, tarim yaparken size cok faydali olacaktir.

english: What are the effects?
Iasor plants will reduce the chance of your other crops becoming diseased, Kronos plants will increase the speed at which they grow and Attas plants will improve the yield when harvesting.
translation: Iasor bitkileri diger mahsullerinizin hastalanma olasiligini azaltir, Kronos bitkileri büyüme hizini artirir ve Attas bitkileri hasat verimini artirir.

english: Choose wisely though, as you can only have one of them at a time.
translation: Ancak, ayni anda sadece bir tanesine sahip olabileceginiz icin akillica secim yapin.

english: Eventually, they'll start to wither and die as their impact on the Anima Mundi is limited. You'll have to plant another when they do.
translation: Anima Mundi üzerindeki etkileri sinirli oldugu icin, sonunda solmaya ve ölmeye baslayacaklar. Bu durumda, yenisini dikmeniz gerekecek.

english: Awesome! Thanks for the information.
See you later.
What's this patch for?
See you later.
Hello!
Leave me be. I am not here to make friends.
translation: Beni rahat birak. Buraya arkadas edinmeye gelmedim.

english: Fair enough.
So there I was, minding my own business on the boat, when I feel us slow to a halt.
translation: Orada, teknede kendi isime bakarken, birdenbire teknenin yavasladigini hissettim.

english: This man walks over to me and says that it's my stop, absurd though that is.
translation: Bir adam yanima gelip, bu duragin benim duragim oldugunu söyledi, ne kadar saçma olsa da.

english: So they all sort of... toss me onto this island with a meagre amount of survival objects.
translation: Sonra hepsi beni, hayatta kalmak için gerekli olan az miktarda esya ile birlikte bu adaya attilar.

english: I think they were laughing whilst they did it.
Either way, there I was. Alone. On this island.
translation: Her neyse, orada kalakaldim. Yalniz. Bu adada.

english: I'd paid quite handsomely for my passage too!
translation: Üstelik yolculuk için oldukça yüksek bir ücret ödemistim!

english: A tour to the rainforest, and then dinner in Tal Teklan.
translation: Yagmur ormanlarina bir tur ve ardindan Tal Teklan'da aksam yemegi.

english: This crew were all so very willing to get me where I wanted to go.
translation: Mürettebat, beni istedigim yere götürmek için çok istekliydi.

english: Very helpful as they collected my belongings. Eager, even.
translation: Esyalarimi toplarken çok yardimci oldular. Hatta hevesliydiler.

english: It felt exclusive. I was the only passenger they took aboard.
translation: Kendimi özel hissettim. Tek yolcu bendim.

english: I do see now that I was perhaps foolish.
translation: Simdi anliyorum ki, belki de aptalca davrandim.

english: Drawn in by their charms, throwing money around.
translation: Onlarin cazibesine kapilip, parayi savurarak harcadim.

english: I just really wanted that dinner in Tal Teklan, you know?
translation: Sadece Tal Teklan'da aksam yemegi yemek istiyordum, anliyor musunuz?

english: Now I'm going to die alone on an island, bereft of my worldly possessions.
translation: Simdi dünyevi esyalarimdan yoksun, bir adada yalniz basina ölecegim.

english: Perhaps the bards of Temptestuswill write of my sorrow, should they hear my tale.
translation: Belki Temptestus'un ozanlari hikayemi duyduklarinda benim kederimi yazacaklar.

english: Tell people of my struggles!
Excuse me! Hello! I appear to have found myself in a situation here.
translation: Affedersiniz! Merhaba! Burada kendimi bir durumda bulmusum gibi görünüyor.

english: Can you see any way for me to... defamiliarise myself with this island?
translation: Bu adadan kurtulmam için bir yol var mi?

english: I'm getting rather bored being stuck here waiting for the tide to swallow me.
translation: Burada sikisip kalip gelgitin beni yutmasini beklemekten sikildim.

english: Though, that is reliant on me not throwing myself into the dark sea first.
translation: Tabii bu, kendimi karanlik denize atmamam sartiyla.

english: But fear not! I shan't do that, for it would be improper.
translation: Ama korkmayin! Bunu yapmayacagim, çünkü uygunsuz olur.

english: Though if it rains again, I may be tempted.
translation: Ama tekrar yagmur yagarsa, cazip gelebilir.

english: Observe how I have nothing here on this island.
translation: Bu adada hiçbir seyim olmadigini görün.

english: There's myself and the occasional crab, but I've been left here... Abandoned! Forgotten!
translation: Sadece ben ve ara sira bir yengeç var, ama ben burada birakildim... Terk edildim! Unutuldum!

english: I don't suppose you could send for a boat to retrieve me?
translation: Beni almaya bir tekne gönderebilir misin?

english: Or perhaps an armada.
Yes, this predicament needs excessive force to be resolved peacefully.
translation: Evet, bu durumun barisçil bir sekilde çözülmesi için asiri güç gerekiyor.

english: Maybe I should pack a flag next time. Claim this land for myself.
translation: Belki de bir dahaki sefere bir bayrak getirmeliyim. Bu topragi kendime ait ilan etmek için.

english: No! I can't be stuck here! It's far too small.
translation: Hayir! Burada mahsur kalamam! Burasi çok küçük.

english: Are you finding the air just chokes you here? It is the air, isn't it?
translation: Burada hava seni bogmuyor mu? Hava yüzünden, degil mi?

english: Gosh, it feels as if my skin is just crawling.
Nobody's going to find me here... I'm going to rot on this island alone.
translation: Kimse beni burada bulamayacak... Bu adada tek basima çürüyecegim.

english: No, no, no!
My regular baker will realise I've not come by in a day. He will send a search party!
translation: Her zamanki firincim bir gün gelmedigimi fark edecek. Arama ekibi gönderecek!

english: They will send a search party, won't they?
What if they don't?
Someone will know I'm missing.
This island is too small though... They won't be able to see it.
translation: Ama bu ada çok küçük... Göremeyecekler.

english: I'd start a fire, if only I had the tools to do so.
This isn't how I was meant to die!
I was meant to go down gloriously in the Colosseum!
translation: Colosseum'da serefli bir sekilde ölmem gerekiyordu!

english: Hello, The Face said you wanted to speak with me.
translation: Merhaba, The Face seninle konusmak istedigini söyledi.

english: Ah, we meet at last. My fellow ratcatchers tell me you're quite the talent.
translation: Ah, sonunda tanistik. Diger fare avcilari senin cok yetenekli oldugunu söylüyor.

english: Well I can't take all the credit, I've had more than a little help from my cat.
translation: Bütün övgüyü ben alamam, kedimden de epey yardim aldim.

english: Ah, modesty. A trait seldom displayed by adventurers like yourself.
translation: Ah, alcakgönüllülük. Senin gibi maceracilarda nadiren görülen bir özellik.

english: Too many more like you and I'll lose half of my business.
translation: Senin gibi cok fazla kisi olursa isimin yarisini kaybederim.

english: Why's that?
Epic poems aren't usually commissioned by the shy and retiring.
translation: Epik siirler genellikle utangac ve cekingen kisiler tarafindan siparis edilmez.

english: Smokin' Joe said that you know lots about training wily cats.
translation: Smokin' Joe, kurnaz kedileri egitme konusunda cok bilgili oldugunu söyledi.

english: I do indeed. In fact, that's why I wanted to talk to you.
translation: Evet, öyleyim. Aslinda, bu yüzden seninle konusmak istedim.

english: So you'll show me how to turn my cat into a wily cat?
translation: Yani kedimi kurnaz bir kediye dönüstürmeyi bana ögretecek misin?

english: Ah, ah, ah - not so fast.
translation: Ah, ah, ah - o kadar acele etme.

english: Let me guess... you want me to catch some rats for you first?
translation: Dur tahmin edeyim... önce senin icin birkac fare yakalamami istiyorsun, degil mi?

english: Bingo.
Alright then, what's the job?
Nothing too difficult. Just rid the port of every single rat... at once.
translation: Cok zor bir sey degil. Limandaki tüm fareleri bir kerede yok etmen gerekiyor.

english: At once?!
Yep. I expect to see all the rats in Port Sarim dead in one, decisive action.
translation: Evet. Port Sarim'deki tüm farelerin tek bir kararli hareketle ölmesini bekliyorum.

english: Are you serious?
Deadly!
So why do you want all the rats wiped out at once?
translation: Peki neden tüm fareleri bir kerede yok etmek istiyorsun?

english: I want to write a new poem.
About me?! How flattering.
translation: Benim hakkimda mi?! Ne kadar gurur verici.

english: No, silly. A poem about the art of ratcatching.
translation: Hayir, aptal. Fare avciligi sanati hakkinda bir siir.

english: Poetry might be my bread and butter, but catching rats is my real passion.
translation: Siir benim ekmek param olabilir, ama fare avlamak benim gercek tutkum.

english: Couldn't you just use some 'creative license' instead?
Not to disappoint you, but this task might be beyond my capabilities...
translation: Seni hayal kirikligina ugratmak istemem, ama bu görev benim yeteneklerimin ötesinde olabilir...

english: Don't be so hard on yourself!
Besides, it's not difficult. I myself performed the very same feat just a few years ago.
translation: Ayrica, bu zor bir sey degil. Ben de birkac yil önce ayni seyi basardim.

english: You did? How?
Ha! Nice try. You'll have to figure that out for yourself.
translation: Ha! Iyi deneme. Bunu kendin bulmalisin.

english: It was worth a shot...
Any luck killing all the rats yet?
What do I have to do again?
Kill all the rats in Port Sarim in one, swift action.
translation: Port Sarim'deki tüm fareleri tek seferde öldürmek.

english: Right. I'd better figure out how I'm going to do that...
translation: Tamam. Bunu nasil yapacagimi bulsam iyi olacak...

english: I think I know how to carry out your task.
translation: Görevi nasil yerine getirecegini biliyorum galiba.

english: Oh yes? Has The Face been telling tales again?
translation: Öyle mi? Yüz yine hikayeler mi anlatiyor?

english: Oh no, she didn't say a word.
Really, she didn't.
Ha! I did it. Did you see?
I did indeed! A performance for the ages.
translation: Elbette gördüm! Tarihe gececek bir performans.

english: Now that you're a real ratcatcher, I'd be happy to train that cat of yours.
translation: Artik gercek bir fare avcisi olduguna göre, kedini egitmekten memnuniyet duyarim.

english: Can you train my cat to be a wily cat?
translation: Kedimi kurnaz bir kedi olarak egitebilir misin?

english: I can only train overgrown cats into wily cats.
translation: Sadece büyümüs kedileri kurnaz kediler olarak egitebilirim.

english: Can you rename my cat?
Hey [player name], you finally got around to naming me.
translation: Hey Maceraci, sonunda bana bir isim verdin.

english: Sorry I took so long, [cat name], it took a while to come up with a name for you.
translation: Bu kadar uzun sürdügü icin üzgünüm, sana bir isim bulmak biraz zaman aldi.

english: Miaaow!
Can you tell me more about wily cats?
translation: Kurnaz kediler hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: I'll only help you name wily or lazy cats. Bring me one and I'll help you out.
translation: Sadece kurnaz veya tembel kedilere isim bulmana yardim ederim. Bana bir tane getir, sana yardim edeyim.

english: Can you tell me more about the pits?
translation: Cukurlar hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Here take this, you might find it useful.
What do you want to know?
Do you have any pointers for me and my cat?
translation: Bana ve kedime verebilecegin bir tavsiye var mi?

english: You should wear an Amulet of Catspeak. It will allow you to organise tactics with your cat.
translation: Kedi Dili Tilsimi takmalisin. Bu sayede kedinle taktikler gelistirebilirsin.

english: What would be the best tactic to adopt then?
translation: O zaman en iyi taktik ne olur?

english: Well, that depends on your outlook, whether you're ready to risk your cat's life or not and how defensive or aggressive you want your cat to be.
translation: Bu senin bakis acina, kedinin hayatini riske atmaya hazir olup olmadigina ve kedinin ne kadar savunmaci veya saldirgan olmasini istedigine bagli.

english: I will not risk my cat's life.
Well if that's the case then you're left with two choices.
You can adopt an ultra defensive strategy, which increases your cat's hitpoints and defence but causes it to flee sooner.
translation: Kedinin can puanini ve savunmasini artiran, ancak daha cabuk kacmasina neden olan ultra savunma stratejisini benimseyebilirsin.

english: Or you can adopt a less defensive strategy, which will allow your cat to stay in the pit for longer.
translation: Ya da kedinin cukurda daha uzun süre kalmasini saglayan daha az savunma stratejisini benimseyebilirsin.

english: I think I would adopt a very defensive strategy
translation: Sanirim cok savunmaci bir strateji benimseyecegim.

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'Just take care of yourself, cat.'
translation: Bu durumda kedinize sunu söylemelisiniz: “Sadece kendine dikkat et, kedi.”

english: Thanks for your help.
Do you have any other questions about the pits?
translation: Cukurlarla ilgili baska sorunuz var mi?

english: I think I would adopt a less defensive strategy.
translation: Sanirim daha az savunmaci bir strateji benimseyecegim.

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'Stay in for as long as you can.'
translation: Bu durumda kedinize sunu söylemelisiniz: “Mümkün oldugunca uzun süre kal.”

english: I am willing to risk my cat, if it increases my chances of victory.
translation: Zafer sansimi artiracaksa kedimi riske atmaya hazirim.

english: In that case you are left with two choices.
You could go for all out attack which will boost your cat's attack and strength, but weaken it.
translation: Kedinizin saldiri ve gücünü artiracak, ancak onu zayiflatacak tam saldiri stratejisini secebilirsiniz.

english: Or, go for a less aggressive stance, which will increase your cat's strength and attack to a lesser degree, but carries no defensive penalties.
translation: Ya da kedinizin gücünü ve saldirisini daha az bir oranda artiracak, ancak savunma acisindan herhangi bir dezavantaj getirmeyecek daha az agresif bir tutum sergileyebilirsiniz.

english: I think I would adopt a very aggressive strategy.
translation: Ben cok agresif bir strateji benimserdim.

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'Go berserk!'
translation: Bu durumda kedinize sunu söylemelisiniz: “Cilgina dön!”

english: I think I would adopt a less aggressive strategy.
translation: Ben daha az agresif bir strateji benimserdim.

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'No guts, no glory!'
translation: Bu durumda kedinize sunu söylemelisiniz: “Cesaret yoksa zafer de yok!”

english: What benefits does my cat get from training in the pits?
translation: Kedim cukurlarda antrenman yapmaktan ne gibi faydalar elde eder?

english: It depends on what kind of cat you have.
In the Port Sarim pits, your cat will become happier and fitter after fighting.
translation: Port Sarim cukurlarinda, kediniz dövüstükten sonra daha mutlu ve daha zinde hale gelir.

english: No thanks.
Can you tell me more about Wily cats?
translation: Wily kedileri hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misiniz?

english: Of course!
They're tougher, stronger and faster than other kinds of cats. They have superior hunting skills and can even catch butterflies and kalphite larvae.
translation: Diger kedi türlerine göre daha dayanikli, daha güclü ve daha hizlidirlar. Üstün avcilik becerilerine sahiptirler ve kelebekleri ve kalphite larvalarini bile yakalayabilirler.

english: So are there any drawbacks to owning them?
translation: Peki, onlari sahiplenmenin herhangi bir dezavantaji var mi?

english: Wily cats need lots more exercise, otherwise they'll get fat and lazy.
translation: Wily kedileri cok daha fazla egzersize ihtiyac duyarlar, aksi takdirde sismanlar ve tembel olurlar.

english: What's the best way to exercise them?
translation: Onlari egzersiz yaptirmanin en iyi yolu nedir?

english: Bring it hunting or take it to the Rat Pits regularly.
translation: Onlari ava cikarin veya düzenli olarak Rat Pits'e götürün.

english: Try and keep it happy too,wily cats can be a little nasty when they're cranky.
translation: Onlari mutlu etmeye calisin, kurnaz kediler huysuz olduklarinda biraz huysuz olabilirler.

english: What happens if I neglect my cat? Not that I would!
translation: Kedimi ihmal edersem ne olur? Ihmal etmem tabii ki!

english: It'll get fat and lazy and become much worse at hunting. Plus, everyone will know you're a bad cat trainer.
translation: Sismanlayip tembellesir ve avlanmada cok daha kötü hale gelir. Ayrica, herkes sizin kötü bir kedi egitmeni oldugunuzu bilir.

english: Can I retrain my lazy cat?
Yes, you can get your lazy cat back in shape with lots of rat catching. But you really shouldn't let things get that bad.
translation: Evet, tembel kedinizi bol bol fare yakalayarak tekrar forma sokabilirsiniz. Ama islerin bu kadar kötüye gitmesine izin vermemelisiniz.

english: How's the poem going?
Ah yes, the poem... your performance was incredibly inspiring. I think it'll be a real masterpiece...
translation: Ah evet, siir... Performansiniz inanilmaz derecede ilham vericiydi. Bence gercek bir saheser olacak...

english: Just as soon as I get around to writing it all down.
Hello, the facesaid that you were looking to talk with me.
translation: Merhaba, yüzünüz bana benimle konusmak istediginizi söyledi.

english: Indeed, word has gotten to me from our other ratcatcher chapters that you are quite a talent.
translation: Gercekten de, diger fare avcilari bölümlerinden sizin oldukca yetenekli oldugunuzu duydum.

english: Modesty, a trait seldom displayed by adventurers these days.
translation: Mütevazilik, günümüzde maceracilar tarafindan nadiren sergilenen bir özellik.

english: Why is that?
Epic poems of bravery and heroics aren't usually commissioned by the shy and retiring.
translation: Cesaret ve kahramanlik üzerine epik siirler genellikle utangac ve cekingen kisiler tarafindan siparis edilmez.

english: Indeed I do. It's for this very reason that I requested to talk to you.
translation: Gercekten de öyle. Iste bu nedenle sizinle konusmak istedim.

english: So you will show me how to turn my cat into a wily cat?
translation: Yani kedimi kurnaz bir kediye dönüstürmeyi mi ögreteceksin?

english: No, not yet.
*Sighs.*
No I need you to carry out just one task for me.
translation: Hayir, benim icin tek bir görevi yerine getirmeni istiyorum.

english: Well experience has taught me to expect as much, what must I do?
translation: Deneyimlerim bana bunu beklememi ögretti, ne yapmam gerekiyor?

english: Nothing too difficult, just rid the port of every single rat, with just one action.
translation: Cok zor bir sey degil, tek bir hareketle limandaki tüm fareleri yok etmen gerekiyor.

english: What?
Deadly.
But why? Why one stroke, why not a slow eradication?
translation: Ama neden? Neden tek seferde, neden yavas yavas yok etmiyoruz?

english: But...
I am touched that you want to write an epic poem about me, but why can't you write the poem about seagulls or daffodils or something?
translation: Hakkimda destansi bir siir yazmak istemen beni cok duygulandirdi, ama neden siiri martilar veya nergisler hakkinda yazmiyorsun?

english: Well seagulls rarely make good central characters. They're a bit too ... uhm.... flighty.
translation: Martilar nadiren iyi ana karakterler olurlar. Biraz fazla... sey... ucaridirlar.

english: Besides the poem is about me not you.
translation: Ayrica siir senin hakkinda degil, benim hakkimda.

english: Sorry I don't follow.
I myself carried out the very same feat once upon a time.
translation: Ben de bir zamanlar ayni seyi basarmistim.

english: So why do you need me to repeat your most heroic of feats?
translation: Öyleyse neden en kahramanca basarilarini tekrar etmemi istiyorsun?

english: It's all about objectivity and integrity. I need to be utterly divorced from the process.
translation: Mesele objektiflik ve dürüstlük. Bu sürecten tamamen uzak durmam gerekiyor.

english: Umm... ok, I suppose.
So can you tell me how you went about achieving this?
translation: Peki bunu nasil basardigini anlatabilir misin?

english: No. Therein lies the challenge.
*Sigh* Why does it always have to be like this?
translation: *Ic cekis* Neden her zaman böyle olmak zorunda?

english: You haven't completed the task yet.
Rid the port of all its rats with one action.
translation: Tek bir hareketle limandaki tüm fareleri yok et.

english: I'd better get to it then.
translation: O zaman ise koyulsam iyi olacak.

english: I think I know how to carry out the task.
Has the facebeingtelling tall tales again?
translation: Yüzü yine abartili hikayeler mi anlatiyor?

english: Really she didn't.
Ha! I did it. Did you see me?
Yes I saw that, now what can I do for you? Don't keep me overly long, I'm trying to complete my poem.
translation: Evet, gördüm, simdi senin icin ne yapabilirim? Beni fazla oyalamayin, siirimi bitirmeye calisiyorum.

english: Can you show me how to train my cat into a wily cat?
translation: Kedimi kurnaz bir kedi haline getirmek icin nasil egitmem gerektigini gösterir misin?

english: I can only train overgrown cats into wilycats.
translation: Sadece büyümüs kedileri kurnaz kedilere dönüstürebilirim.

english: You already have a mature cat, look after that first.
translation: Zaten yetiskin bir kedin var, önce ona bak.

english: You should really name your cat.
Hey [username], you finally got around to naming me.
translation: Hey maceraci, sonunda bana bir isim verdin.

english: Sorry I took so long, [catname], it took a while to come up with a name for you.
translation: Üzgünüm, bu kadar uzun sürdü, sana bir isim bulmak biraz zaman aldi.

english: Here take this, you might find it useful
Well what do you want to know?
You should wear an amulet of catspeak. It will allow you to organise tactics with your cat.
translation: Kedi dili muskasi takmalisin. Bu, kedinle taktikler planlamani saglayacaktir.

english: Well if that's the case then yourare left with two choices.
You can adopt an ultra defensive strategy, which increases your cat's hitpoints and defence, the drawback to this is that your cat will flee sooner.
translation: Kedinin can puanini ve savunmasini artiran ultra savunma stratejisi uygulayabilirsin, bunun dezavantaji kedinin daha cabuk kacmasidir.

english: Your other option is to adopt a less defensive strategy which will allow your cat to stay in the pit for longer.
translation: Diger secenegin ise kedinin cukurda daha uzun süre kalmasini saglayacak daha az savunma stratejisi uygulamaktir.

english: In that case you should tell your cat, 'Just take care of yourself cat.'
translation: Bu durumda kedine “Sadece kendine dikkat et kedi” demelisin.

english: In that case you should tell your cat, 'Stay in for as long as you can.'
translation: Bu durumda kedine “Mümkün oldugunca uzun süre kal” demelisin.

english: You could go for all out attack which will boost your cat's attack and strength, but weaken it
translation: Kedinizin saldiri ve gücünü artiracak, ancak onu zayiflatacak tam saldiri stratejisini secebilir

english: or go for a less aggressive stance which will increase your cat's strength and attack to a lesser degree, but carries no defensive penalties.
translation: veya kedinizin gücünü ve saldirisini daha az ölcüde artiracak, ancak savunma acisindan herhangi bir dezavantaj getirmeyecek daha az agresif bir tutum sergileyebilirsiniz.

english: I think I would adopt a very aggressive strategy
translation: Ben cok agresif bir strateji benimserdim.

english: In that case you should tell your cat, 'Go berserk!'
In that case you should tell this to your cat, 'No guts, no glory!'
translation: Bu durumda kedinize “Cesaret yoksa zafer de yok!” demelisiniz.

english: Of course, of course, they're the highest form of cat that I know of.
translation: Tabii ki, tabii ki, onlar benim bildigim en üstün kedi türüdür.

english: They're tougher, stronger and faster than other variations of cat, they can catch butterflies and kalphite larva and are far superior to any other type of cat at hunting.
translation: Diger kedi türlerinden daha dayanikli, daha güclü ve daha hizlidirlar, kelebekleri ve kalphite larvalarini yakalayabilirler ve avlanma konusunda diger kedi türlerinden cok daha üstündürler.

english: So is there any drawbacks to owning them?
translation: Peki, onlari sahiplenmenin herhangi bir dezavantaji var mi?

english: Wily cats need looking after or else they get fat and lazy.
translation: Wily kedilere bakmak gerekir, aksi takdirde sisman ve tembel olurlar.

english: So how do I look after them then?
The key is to keep it active, bring it hunting or to the ratpits regularly.
translation: Önemli olan onlari aktif tutmak, düzenli olarak ava veya fare cukurlarina götürmektir.

english: Try keep it happy too, they can be a little nasty when they're cranky.
translation: Onlari mutlu etmeye de calisin, huysuz olduklarinda biraz huysuz olabilirler.

english: What happens if I neglect my cat.. not that I would or anything?
translation: Kedimi ihmal edersem ne olur... tabii ki ihmal etmeyecegim ama?

english: They would get fat and lazy, be much worse at hunting and would show you up as a really poor cat trainer.
translation: Sisman ve tembel olurlar, avcilikta cok daha kötü olurlar ve sizi gercekten kötü bir kedi egitmeni olarak gösterirler.

english: Yes you can get your lazy cat back in shape with a lot of rat catching, but you really shouldn't let it get into that state in the first place.
translation: Evet, tembel kedinizi cok sayida fare yakalayarak tekrar forma sokabilirsiniz, ama öncelikle kedinizin o duruma gelmesine izin vermemelisiniz.

english: Can you train my cat for me?
Can you rename my cat?
Can you tell me more about the pits?
translation: Cukurlar hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misiniz?

english: Do you have any pointers for me and my cat?
translation: Bana ve kedime verebileceginiz tavsiyeler var mi?

english: I will not risk my cat's life.
I think I would adopt an ultra defensive strategy.
I'd like to ask you...
No thanks
I think I would adopt a less defensive strategy.
translation: Sanirim daha az savunmaci bir strateji benimseyecegim.

english: I am willing to risk my cat if it improves my chances.
translation: Sansimi artiracaksa kedimi riske atmaya hazirim.

english: I think I would adopt a very aggressive strategy.
translation: Sanirim cok agresif bir strateji benimseyecegim.

english: I think I would adopt a less aggressive strategy.
translation: Sanirim daha az agresif bir strateji benimseyecegim.

english: What benefits does my cat get from training in the pits?
translation: Kedim cukurda egitimden ne gibi faydalar elde edecek?

english: Can you tell me more about wily cats?
translation: Kurnaz kediler hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: How's the poem going?
I think I would adopt a very defensive strategy.
translation: Sanirim cok savunmaci bir strateji benimseyecegim.

english: Hey leave me alone, can't you see that I'm busy?
translation: Hey, beni rahat birak, mesgul oldugumu görmüyor musun?

english: Oohh, my arms.
Work, work, work, that's all I ever do.
translation: Calis, calis, calis, tek yaptigim bu.

english: I feel so weak, I could faint.
I'm so tired, I could sleep standing up.
translation: O kadar yorgunum ki ayakta uyuyabilirim.

english: What I wouldn't give for a good night's rest.
translation: Iyi bir gece uykusu icin neler vermezdim.

english: Ooh, my back.
I'm rich in experience, poor in wealth.
translation: Deneyim bakimindan zenginim, servet bakimindan fakirim.

english: I can't think straight I'm so tired.
I'm sick of this place.
Hello there.
Hi!
Could you help me lift these boxes? They are really heavy!
translation: Bu kutulari kaldirmama yardim eder misin? Cok agirlar!

english: Sorry, I'm a bit busy.
Oh, okay, I'll do it myself.
OK then.
Thanks traveller!
Thanks again friend!
The little gnome is too busy to talk.
translation: Kücük cüce konusmak icin cok mesgul.

english: I can't believe they won't let me in!
I don't believe all this rubbish about an invasion. If mankind wanted to, they could have invaded before now.
translation: Istila hakkindaki tüm bu sacmaliklara inanmiyorum. Insanlik isteseydi, simdiye kadar istila edebilirdi.

english: I really need to see King Narnode. Could you help me sneak in?
translation: Kral Narnode'u görmem gerekiyor. Iceri gizlice girmeme yardim eder misin?

english: Well, as you helped me I suppose I could. We'll have to be careful. If I get caught I'll be in the cage!
translation: Sen bana yardim ettigin icin, sanirim edebilirim. Dikkatli olmaliyiz. Yakalanirsam, kafese kapatilirim!

english: OK, what should I do?
Jump in the back of the cart. It's a food delivery, we should be fine.
translation: Arabaya atla. Bu bir gida teslimati, sorun olmaz.

english: Why should I help you, you wouldn’t help me!
translation: Neden sana yardim edeyim ki, sen bana yardim etmedin!

english: Erm I know, but this is an emergency!
translation: Biliyorum, ama bu acil bir durum!

english: So was lifting that barrel! Tell you what, call it a round 1000 gold pieces.
translation: O varili kaldirmak da öyleydi! Bak ne diyecegim, 1000 altin parcasi diyelim.

english: 1000 gold pieces!
That’s right, 1000 and I’ll sneak you in.
translation: Evet, 1000 altin ve seni iceri sokarim.

english: No chance!
OK then, here you go.
You give Femi 1000 coins.
Alright, jump in the back of the cart. It's a food delivery, we should be fine.
translation: Tamam, arabanin arkasina atla. Yemek teslimati yapiyoruz, sorun olmaz.

english: Femi sneaks the Player inside the Grand Tree
translation: Femi, Oyuncuyu Büyük Agac'in icine gizlice sokar.

english: OK traveller, you'd better get going.
Thanks again!
That's OK, all the best.
Now, to get this lot to the Grand Tree!
translation: Simdi, bu grubu Büyük Agac'a götürmeliyim!

english: Can I help?
No, I'm OK traveller. I can manage from here.
translation: Hayir, ben hallederim gezgin. Buradan sonra ben idare ederim.

english: I'd better get going!
Well done!
Sorry, I'm a bit busy.
Okay then.
No chance!
Ok then, here you go.
Can I help you today?
Can I go for a ride?
Minecart rides are 20 coins.
Of course.
I'm fine, thanks.
As a loyal customer of the Lovakengj Minecart Network, you're entitled to this.
translation: Lovakengj Maden Arabasi Agi'nin sadik bir müsterisi olarak, buna hakkiniz var.

english: Now, can I help you today?
translation: Simdi, bugün size nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: You're already here, human.
Can I go for a ride?
I'm fine, thanks.
Good day, sir.
What are you doing down here?
Shoring up the walls.
What does that do?
Stops them falling down.
Oh, I see.
Aye.
If you want to chatter, you'd better talk to Thorodin over there. I'm working.
translation: Sohbet etmek istiyorsan, suradaki Thorodin ile konussan iyi olur. Ben calisiyorum.

english: Okay then.
Good day.
What are you doing down here?
Good day.
Welcome to Fernahei's Fishing Shop Bwana! Would you like to see my items?
translation: Fernahei'nin Balikcilik Dükkanina hos geldiniz Bwana! Ürünlerimi görmek ister misiniz?

english: Yes please!
No, but thanks for the offer.
That's fine and thanks for your interest.
I'm getting out of here Bwana, the place is infested with zombies.
translation: Buradan gidiyorum Bwana, burasi zombilerle dolu.

english: Yes please!
No, but thanks for the offer.
Welcome wanderer.
What is this place?
You're surrounded by a relic of a long lost kingdom.
translation: Uzun zaman önce yok olmus bir kralligin kalintilari ile cevrilisin.

english: What happened here?
Oh, I couldn't really tell you that.
This place has sat in ruin for an age, slowly destroyed by the harsh climate of the Wilderness.
translation: Burasi uzun zamandir harabe halinde, Wildernessnin sert iklimi tarafindan yavas yavas yok edildi.

english: If it's a ruin, what's the point in being here?
translation: Madem harabe, burada olmanin anlami ne?

english: I search for knowledge. I want to know what happened to this part of the world.
translation: Bilgi ariyorum. Bu bölgede ne oldugunu bilmek istiyorum.

english: Whilst looking for answers, I slowly turned this broken town into a safe haven for travellers. Welcome to Ferox Enclave.
translation: Cevaplari ararken, bu yikik kasabayi yavas yavas gezginler icin güvenli bir siginak haline getirdim. Ferox Enclave'e hos geldin.

english: Quite a dangerous place for a town, don't you think?
translation: Bir kasaba icin oldukca tehlikeli bir yer, sence de öyle degil mi?

english: It is, but that's why it's needed! Look around, you can see how many others share my opinion.
translation: Öyle, ama bu yüzden gerekli! Etrafina bak, benimle ayni fikirde olanlarin sayisini görebilirsin.

english: You'll find yourself quite safe inside my enclave - the protective barriers should keep any troublemakers out.
translation: Benim bölgemde kendinizi oldukca güvende hissedeceksiniz - koruyucu bariyerler sorun cikaranlari disarida tutacaktir.

english: I will warn you though, if you've had Teleblock cast upon you, I will not allow you back into the Enclave. You'd be a danger to the others gathered here.
translation: Ancak sizi uyarmaliyim, eger üzerinize Teleblock büyüsü yapilmissa, sizi Enclave'e geri almayacagim. Burada toplanan digerleri icin tehlike olusturacaksiniz.

english: Thanks for the information! I'll take a look around.
translation: Bilgi icin tesekkürler! Etrafa bir bakayim.

english: Tread carefully my friend.
What can you do for me?
Well, if you'd like, I can make it so you respawn in our Enclave. It'll put you right in the heart of all the chaos that surrounds us.
translation: Eger istersen, Enclave'imizde yeniden dogmani saglayabilirim. Bu, seni bizi cevreleyen kaosun tam ortasina yerlestirecektir.

english: Tell me more.
This is how it'll work: When you die, you'll respawn right here in Ferox Enclave, just outside the pub we've set up. You will lose your items as normal of course.
translation: Söyle calisacak: Öldügünde, kurdugumuz pub'in hemen disinda, Ferox Enclave'de yeniden dogacaksin. Elbette esyalarini normal sekilde kaybedeceksin.

english: I won't be able to do anything if you die somewhere like Castle Wars or the Emir's Arena; they have their own magic to keep you safe.
translation: Castle Wars veya Emir's Arena gibi yerlerde ölürsen hicbir sey yapamam; bu yerlerin seni güvende tutmak icin kendi büyüsü var.

english: It'll cost you though! Transporting you here is no easy task. 5 million coins should do it, that'd be a one time fee of course.
translation: Ama bunun bir bedeli var! Seni buraya getirmek kolay bir is degil. 5 milyon altin yeterli olur, tabii ki bu tek seferlik bir ücret.

english: I don't have that much money on me.
Understandable, you'd have to be a brave  to be carrying that much gold out here.
translation: Anlasilabilir, bu kadar altin tasimak icin cesur bir  olman gerekir.

english: Okay, switch my respawn to Ferox Enclave.
translation: Tamam, yeniden dogusumu Ferox Enclave'e degistir.

english: Thank you, you'll respawn in the Enclave from here on out.
translation: Tesekkürler, bundan sonra Enclave'de yeniden dogacaksin.

english: I'm not interested.
Can't say I blame you, this wouldn't be my choice either.
translation: Seni suclayamam, ben de bu secimi yapmazdim.

english: That doesn't interest me.
Come find me if you change your mind.
Never mind, I'm just looking around.
So be it.
Can I talk to you about my respawn location?
translation: Yeniden dogus konumum hakkinda seninle konusabilir miyim?

english: Would you like to respawn back in Ferox Enclave again?
translation: Yeniden Ferox Enclave'de yeniden dogmak ister misin?

english: Please switch my respawn back to the Enclave.
The Wilderness takes a toll on a [man's/woman's] soul. Are you sure you can handle it?
translation: Wilderness maceracilarin ruhuna zarar verir. Bununla basa cikabileceginden emin misin?

english: Yes, switch my respawn to the Enclave.
translation: Evet, yeniden dogma konumumu Enclave'e degistir.

english: Fair enough, it has been done.
No, maybe another time.
Understandable.
No, I don't want to respawn in the Enclave.
How are you finding our sanctuary?
Please switch my respawn back to Lumbridge.
translation: Lütfen yeniden dogma konumumu Lumbridge'e geri degistir.

english: Can't say I blame you, the Wilderness starts to wear down the soul after a while.
translation: Seni suclayamam, Wilderness bir süre sonra ruhu yipratmaya baslar.

english: But are you sure? Come and see me if you want to respawn in our Enclave again; I won't need any more money from you.
translation: Ama emin misin? Enclave'de yeniden respawn olmak istersen gel beni gör; senden daha fazla para istemem.

english: Yes, switch my respawn to Lumbridge.
Done.
No, I'll keep the Enclave respawn.
Fine.
It's working for me so far, thanks.
translation: Su ana kadar benim icin ise yariyor, tesekkürler.

english: What is this place?
What can you do for me?
I'll be heading off then.
Tell me more.
Okay, switch my respawn to Ferox Enclave.
translation: Tamam, respawn noktami Ferox Enclave'e degistir.

english: I'm not interested.
That doesn't interest me.
Nevermind.
Ask about your respawn point.
Please switch my respawn back to the Enclave.
translation: Lütfen respawn noktami Enclave'e geri degistir.

english: Yes, switch my respawn to the Enclave.
translation: Evet, yeniden dogus yerimi Enclave'ye degistir.

english: No, maybe another time.
No, I don't want to respawn in the Enclave
Please switch my respawn back to Lumbridge.
translation: Lütfen yeniden dogus yerimi Lumbridge'e geri degistir.

english: Yes, switch my respawn to Lumbridge.
translation: Evet, yeniden dogus yerimi Lumbridge'e degistir.

english: No, I'll keep the Enclave respawn.
It's working for me so far, thanks.
translation: Su ana kadar benim icin ise yariyor, tesekkürler.

english: Understandable, you'd have to be a brave [man/woman] to be carrying that much gold out here.
translation: Anlasilabilir, bu kadar çok altini buraya tasimak için cesur biri olmak gerekir.

english: Hello, where does your ferry go?
I can ferry ye up t' Al Kharid, if ye want t' be off?
translation: Eger gitmek istersen, seni Al Kharid'e götürebilirim.

english: Want t' continue the fight against Tempoross, eh? Good stuff!
translation: Tempoross'a karsi savasmaya devam etmek istiyorsun, ha? Aferin!

english: Yes
No
Hello there.
Ahoy!
What are you doing here?
I ferry skilled sailors and fisherfolk south t' the Spirit Anglers' base in the Ruins of Unkah.
translation: Yetenekli denizcileri ve balikcilari güneydeki Unkah Harabeleri'ndeki Spirit Anglers üssüne götürüyorum.

english: The Spirit Anglers? Who are they?
Why, they're a group of sea-faring folk researchin' and fightin' against Tempoross, the crazed spirit that's terrorising the seas! I'm surprised you haven't heard!
translation: Onlar, denizleri terörize eden cilgin ruh Tempoross'a karsi arastirma yapan ve savasan bir grup denizci! Duymamis olmana sasirdim!

english: That sounds important! Can I help?
translation: Bu önemli bir sey gibi görünüyor! Yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: It's rough out there against Tempoross. We really need fisherfolk who've experienced more of the world.
translation: Tempoross'a karsi mücadele zorlu geciyor. Dünyayi daha iyi taniyan balikcilara ihtiyacimiz var.

english: I can ferry ye down t' the Spirit Anglers, though they're looking for people with more fishing experience t' face Tempoross.
translation: Seni Ruh Balikcilarina götürebilirim, ancak Tempoross'la yüzlesmek icin daha fazla balikcilik deneyimi olan insanlar ariyorlar.

english: You need a Fishing level of 35 to fight Tempoross.
translation: Tempoross'la savasmak icin 35 balikcilik seviyesi gerekiyor.

english: Of course! I can ferry ye down there when ye be ready. Ye'll want t' speak to Captain Pudi when ye arrive!
translation: Tabii ki! Hazir oldugunda seni oraya götürebilirim. Vardiginda Kaptan Pudi ile konusmalisin!

english: Do I have to pay for the ferry?
translation: Feribot icin para ödemem gerekiyor mu?

english: 'Course not. Don't even 'ave t' fix a price!
translation: Tabii ki hayir. Fiyat bile belirlemene gerek yok!

english: The player travels to the Ruins of Unkah.
You ride the little boat south to the Ruins of Unkah.
translation: Kücük tekneyle güneye, Unkah Harabeleri'ne gidersin.

english: Maybe next time, eh?
Captain Pudi mentioned you'd stopped by.
I certainly did! How is the fight against Tempoross going?
translation: Tabii ki ugradim! Tempoross'la mücadele nasil gidiyor?

english: Well, that crazed spirit still terrorises the seas but wit' the 'elp of people like yeself, the Spirit Anglers are puttin' up a good fight!

english: If you have an overgrown cat and a couple of coins you can challenge someone else who also has an overgrown cat and some spare change.

english: That sounds simple enough so far.

english: You then agree on a wager. It's rumoured that some ratcatchers can talk to their own cats and give them tactics to aid them.
translation: Sonra bir bahis üzerinde anlasirsiniz. Bazi fare avcilarinin kendi kedileriyle konusup onlara yardimci olacak taktikler verdikleri söyleniyor.

english: So then how do you win the challenge?
I was just getting to that. Both the challengers' cats are placed inside the arena, and whichever kills 9 rats first wins.
translation: Simdi ona geliyorum. Iki meydan okuyanin kedileri arenaya yerlestirilir ve ilk 9 fareyi öldüren kazanir.

english: That sounds vile and cruel.

english: Each to their own, I say.
It sounds a little dangerous for my cat.

english: Of course there is, you can instruct it to be cautious, and it will leave once it feels as if it is in danger.
translation: Tabii ki var, ona dikkatli olmasini söyleyebilirsin, tehlike hissettiginde oradan ayrilacaktir.

english: Oh that sounds quite wise.

english: Sorry, I don't follow.

english: Sounds like there's a story here?
translation: Burada bir hikaye var gibi görünüyor?

english: Indeed there is. Steve fancied himself a pirate, but on his first proper voyage he managed to crash his ship, the Pandemonium, right here.
translation: Gercekten de var. Steve kendini korsan saniyordu, ama ilk gercek yolculugunda gemisi Pandemonium'u tam burada batirdi.

english: He crashed? How?
He claims it was an unavoidable accident caused by the Storm Tempor, but I heard it was actually because he got distracted by a large flock of angry parrots.
translation: Storm Tempor'un neden oldugu kacinilmaz bir kaza oldugunu iddia ediyor, ama ben aslinda öfkeli papagan sürüsünün dikkatini dagittigi icin oldugunu duydum.

english: So he crashed the boat and then decided to open a bar?
translation: Yani gemiyi batirdi ve sonra bir bar acmaya karar verdi?

english: Pretty much.
I see. Fair enough.

english: How do I help?
Get yerself a harpoon from the crate on the ship, then go fish around the island t' catch some harpoonfish. They make fer fine ammo against Tempoross!
translation: Gemideki sandiktan bir zipkin al, sonra adanin cevresinde balik tutarak zipkin baligi yakala. Tempoross'a karsi iyi bir mühimmat olurlar!

english: Once ye caught some, ye can cook 'em at the shrines on the island if ye want 'em to pack more of a punch. Then come back t' the ship an' load 'em in the ammunition crates next to the cannons.
translation: Biraz yakaladiktan sonra, daha etkili olmalarini istiyorsan adadaki tapinaklarda pisirebilirsin. Sonra gemiye geri dön ve onlari toplarin yanindaki mühimmat sandiklarina yükle.

english: Our cannoneers will get t' firin' the harpoonfish at Tempoross. When it's weak an' submerges to recover its energy, get down to the jetty next t' the ship an' fish those spirit pools.
translation: Topcularimiz zipkin baliklarini Tempoross'a atesleyecek. Zayiflayip enerjisini toplamak icin suya daldiginda, geminin yanindaki iskeleye in ve ruh havuzlarinda balik tut.

english: Be quick with fishin' those spirit pools though, or it'll come back so strong we'll have to abandon the fight! With any luck, we'll weaken those spirit fish enough t' subdue Tempoross. Now get t' the fight, sailor!
translation: Ruh havuzlarinda balik tutarken acele et, yoksa o kadar güclenir ki savasi birakmak zorunda kaliriz! Sansimiz yaver giderse, ruh baliklarini Tempoross'u alt edecek kadar zayiflatabiliriz. Simdi savasa git, denizci!

english: Aye aye!
What should I watch out for?
If Tempoross electrocutes a cannon t' stop it from firin', ya better load your harpoonfish into the other ammunition crates t' keep them cannons firin' instead.
translation: Tempoross topu ates etmesini engellemek icin elektrik verirse, zipkin baliklarini diger mühimmat sandiklarina yükleyerek toplarin ates etmeye devam etmesini sagla.

english: Also, make sure t' grab a rope from the ship crates an' keep an eye out for big waves. We'll make sure t' shout about them. Then ye best quickly tether yerself t' an island totem pole or ship mast with that rope.
translation: Ayrica, gemi sandiklarindan bir ip al ve büyük dalgalara dikkat et. Biz onlari bagirarak haber verecegiz. Sonra o ip ile kendini bir ada totem diregine veya gemi diregine hizlica bagla.

english: If the waves break the totem pole or ship mast, ye can grab a hammer from the ship crates t' fix 'em up before the next big wave hits.
translation: Dalgalar totem diregini veya gemi diregini kirarsa, gemi sandiklarindan bir cekic alip bir sonraki büyük dalga gelmeden onlari onarabilirsin.

english: Oh, an' keep an eye out for lightnin' clouds causin' fires. Get a bucket from the ship crates, fill it with water at a pump, and get t' puttin it out before it spreads.
translation: Oh, ve yanginlara neden olan yildirim bulutlarina da dikkat et. Gemi sandiklarindan bir kova al, pompadan suyla doldur ve yayilmadan söndür.

english: If ye get hit by the waves or fire, don't be surprised when ye lose those fish an' tools ye gathered. Now get t' the fight, sailor!
translation: Dalgalar veya yangin tarafindan vurulursan, topladigin baliklari ve aletleri kaybettiginde sasirma. Simdi savasa git, denizci!

english: I want to leave.
Really? You will receive no reward if you do.
I'll get on with the fighting.
We did it! Tempoross has been sudbued once again. Well done!
translation: Basardik! Tempoross bir kez daha yenildi. Aferin!

english: Take a well deserved rest but don't get too comfy, it'll regain its energy soon enough!

english: What should I do now?
We usually find some debris washed up near the docks back at Unkah. Feel free t' have a look. Ya might find somethin' useful!
translation: Genellikle Unkah'daki rihtimin yakininda kiyiya vurmus enkazlar buluruz. Istediginiz gibi bakabilirsiniz. Yararli bir sey bulabilirsiniz!

english: It won't be long before Tempoross regains enough energy to be a problem and we'll have to wrangle it again. Hopefully we can count on you to 'elp!

Goodbye.
