translation: Tempoross, topun ates etmesini engellemek icin onu elektrikle vurursa, zipkin baliklarini diger mühimmat sandiklarina yükleyerek toplarin ates etmeye devam etmesini sagla.

english: Also, make sure t' grab a rope from the ship crates an' keep an eye out for big waves. We'll make sure t' shout about them. Then ye best quickly tether yerself t' an island totem pole or ship mast with that rope.
translation: Ayrica, gemi sandiklarindan bir ip al ve büyük dalgalara dikkat et. Onlari gördügümüzde bagirarak haber verecegiz. O zaman o iple kendini bir ada totem diregine veya gemi diregine hizlica bagla.

english: If the waves break the totem pole or ship mast, ye can grab a hammer from the ship crates t' fix 'em up before the next big wave hits.
translation: Dalgalar totem diregini veya gemi diregini kirarsa, gemi sandiklarindan bir cekic alip bir sonraki büyük dalga gelmeden onlari onarabilirsin.

english: Oh, an' keep an eye out for lightnin' clouds causin' fires. Get a bucket from the ship crates, fill it with water at a pump, and get t' puttin it out before it spreads.
translation: Oh, ve yanginlara neden olan yildirim bulutlarina da dikkat et. Gemi sandiklarindan bir kova al, pompadan suyla doldur ve yayilmadan söndür.

english: If ye get hit by the waves or fire, don't be surprised when ye lose those fish an' tools ye gathered. Now get t' the fight, sailor!
translation: Dalgalar veya yangin tarafindan vurulursan, topladigin baliklari ve aletleri kaybettiginde sasirma. Simdi savasa git, denizci!

english: I want to leave.
Really? You will receive no reward if you do.
I'll get on with the fighting.
We did it! Tempoross has been sudbued once again. Well done!
translation: Basardik! Tempoross bir kez daha yenildi. Aferin!

english: Take a well deserved rest but don't get too comfy, it'll regain its energy soon enough!
translation: Hak ettigin dinlenmeyi al ama fazla rahatlama, yakinda enerjisini geri kazanacak!

english: What should I do now?
We usually find some debris washed up near the docks back at Unkah. Feel free t' have a look. Ya might find somethin' useful!
translation: Genellikle Unkah'daki rihtimin yakinlarinda kiyiya vurmus enkazlar buluruz. Istersen bir bakabilirsin. Yararli bir sey bulabilirsin!

english: It won't be long before Tempoross regains enough energy to be a problem and we'll have to wrangle it again. Hopefully we can count on you to 'elp!
translation: Tempoross'un tekrar sorun olacak kadar enerji toplamasi cok uzun sürmeyecek ve onu tekrar alt etmemiz gerekecek. Umarim yardimina güvenebiliriz!

english: I'm ready to leave.
Aye aye!
Goodbye.
Tempoross will surface soon, prepare yourselves!
translation: Tempoross yakinda su yüzüne cikacak, hazir olun!

english: More fish!
Load those cannons!
Keep an eye on the waves!
Tempoross is drawing in water, prepare yourselves!
The totem pole has been damaged!
Storm clouds are rolling in, get your buckets ready!
Tempoross has submerged, fish from the whirlpools!
translation: Tempoross suya daldi, girdaplardan balik avlayin!

english: Tempoross has surfaced, keep those cannons firing!
translation: Tempoross su yüzüne cikti, toplari ateslemeye devam edin!

english: Tempoross has retreated to the depths!
Tempoross has gathered too much energy!
The storm has grown too strong, we must retreat!
How do I help?
What should I watch out for?
I want to leave.
Yes, I really want to leave.
No, I don't want to leave.
I'll get on with the fighting.
What should I do now?
I'm ready to leave.
Goodbye.
Hey, how you doing?
It is customary when stowing away on a vessel to not introduce yourself to the Captains First Mate, oh foolish one.
translation: Bir gemiye kacak binmek icin kaptanin birinci yardimcisina kendini tanitmamak gelenekseldir, seni aptal.

english: Hey! I'm not a stowaway!
That Lokar guy invited me aboard...
translation: Lokar denen adam beni gemiye davet etti...

english: I see. Well, don't distract me as I'm making preparations for departure.
translation: Anliyorum. Peki, ayrilma hazirliklari yaparken dikkatimi dagitma.

english: Try not to distract any of the crew either, Zamorak knows it's hard enough to get them to do any work around here without strangers wandering round the ship asking them inane questions.
translation: Mürettebatin dikkatini de dagitmamaya calis, Zamorak biliyor ki, gemide dolasan yabancilar onlara sacma sorular sorarken, onlari calistirmak zaten yeterince zor.

english: What does it take to become first mate on a ship?
translation: Bir gemide birinci zabit olmak icin ne gerekir?

english: Good question. We have a diplomatic consessionat the turn of the financial year. Said pirate is chosen should the existing mate be absent without leave.
translation: Iyi soru. Mali yilin basinda diplomatik bir imtiyazimiz var. Mevcut zabit izinsiz olarak yoklugunda, söz konusu korsan secilir.

english: I had no idea. I always figured it was all about popularity.
translation: Hic bilmiyordum. Her zaman bunun popülerlikle ilgili oldugunu düsünmüstüm.

english: It is. I'm just pulling your leg.
I don't sell to outerlanders.
Only Fremenniks may purchase fish here.
translation: Burada sadece Fremennikler balik satin alabilir.

english: Hello there [Fremennik name]. Looking for fresh fish?
translation: Merhaba Dokrak. Taze balik mi ariyorsun?

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
It is [Fremennik name] the thief!
Guardsguards!
You're the one who stole something from me!
Could I buy some fish?
Where do you get your fish from?
Some questions are best left unanswered.
translation: Bazi sorularin cevapsiz kalmasi daha iyidir.

english: Err...
So would you like to buy some fish?
I'll pass.
Suit yourself.
Could I buy some fish?
Where do you get your fish from?
Yes please.
I'll pass.
Good fish. Just keep swimming...swimming...swimming...
translation: Güzel balik. Yüzmeye devam et... yüzmeye... yüzmeye...

english: The fish swims. It is clearly an obedient fish.
translation: Balik yüzüyor. Acikca itaatkar bir balik.

english: Jump! Come on fishy, jump!
The fish bumps into the side of the fishbowl. Then it swims some more.
translation: Balik akvaryumun kenarina carpar. Sonra biraz daha yüzer.

english: Good fish...
Hello there. How's it going?
Hello! Nice day for fishing!
translation: Merhaba! Balik tutmak icin güzel bir gün!

english: Well given how good today's catch was, I'd say it's going pretty well!
translation: Bugünkü avin ne kadar iyi oldugunu düsünürsek, oldukca iyi gidiyor diyebilirim!

english: Nilsal! It's going well, thanks.
I'm fine, how are you?
Very well, thank you.
Not too bad thanks.
Hello there.
His eyes are staring vacantly into space.
You are not part of our family...
translation: Sen bizim ailemizin bir parcasi degilsin...

english: Umm. Not last time I checked.
Soon you will be... Soon you will...
Lost to us.. She is Lost to us...
Who is lost?
Trapped by the light... Lost and trapped...
translation: Isigin tuzagina düstü... Kayboldu ve tuzaga düstü...

english: Ermm... So you don't want to tell me then?
Trapped... In stone and darkness...
translation: Tuzaga düstü... Tas ve karanligin icinde...

english: Must find family...
What?
Soon we will all be together...
Are you ok?
Must find family... They are all under the blue... Deep deep under the blue...
translation: Ailemi bulmaliyim... Hepsi mavinin altinda... Mavinin cok derinlerinde...

english: Ermm... I'll leave you to it then.
translation: Ermm... O zaman seni rahat birakayim.

english: Free of the deep blue we are...
We must find...
Yes?
a new home...
We must leave this place...
Where will you go?
Away.. Away to her...
Riiight.
Below the deep, deep blue she waits...
Who waits?
They came to her with fire and faith...
Who? Who came to who?
Too many... Too many...
Too many what? Make sense!
Locked away for all eternity...
You'd better start making sense Sonny Jim or I'll...
translation: Anlat kendini Sonny Jim yoksa ben...

english: Free... Soon to be free...
Must escape the blue.. Deep deep blue
Pardon?
Family... Under the blue... Must escape the blue...
What do you want, outsider?
What are you doing out here?
Port Piscarilius have given me permission to catch anglerfish, this is the only place you can find them!
translation: Port Piscarilius bana anglerfish avlama izni verdi, onlari bulabilecegin tek yer burasi!

english: How can I catch anglerfish?
Only friends of Port Piscarilius are allowed to know such things, I'm afraid.
translation: Korkarim ki, sadece Port Piscarilius'un dostlari böyle seyleri bilebilir.

english: I have heard good things about you, outsider, however, you will need to train your fishing skill before catching these.
translation: Senin hakkinda iyi seyler duydum, yabanci, ancak bunlari yakalamadan önce balikcilik becerilerini gelistirmelisin.

english: I have heard good things about you, outsider. You will need a fishing rod and some sandworms to use as bait, if you need supplies, try Tynan's shoreside store.
translation: Senin hakkinda iyi seyler duydum, yabanci. Bir olta ve yem olarak kullanmak icin kum solucanlarina ihtiyacin olacak, malzemeye ihtiyacin varsa Tynan'in sahil magazasini dene.

english: Thanks. I'll let you get back to fishing.
I'll let you get back to it.
What are you doing out here?
How can I catch anglerfish?
I'll let you get back to it.
Don't talk to me outerlander. Anything you have to say to me, you can say to the Chieftain. Goodbye.
translation: Benimle konusma, yabanci. Bana söyleyecegin her seyi Sef'e söyleyebilirsin. Hosca kal.

english: Are you a member of the Fremmenik council?
Indeed I am, outerlander. Why do you ask?
Well, I was told by Brundt that I could be voted into the tribe as an honorary Fremmenik if I could find seven members of the council of elders to vote in my favour.
translation: Brundt, konsey üyelerinden yedi kisinin lehime oy vermesi halinde, onursal Fremmenik olarak kabileye kabul edilebilecegimi söyledi.

english: Aye, that is indeed true.
So can I have your vote?
You can have my vote on the day the skies turn red, the waters turn pink, the rocks turn yellow and the sun turns black.
translation: Gökyüzü kirmiziya, sular pembeye, kayalar sariya ve günes siyaha döndügü gün oyumu alabilirsin.

english: Um... do you have any estimate on when that is?
translation: Peki... bunun ne zaman olacagina dair bir tahmininiz var mi?

english: I'm telling you I will never vote for you, you stupid outlander.
translation: Sana asla oy vermeyecegimi söylüyorum, seni aptal yabanci.

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a flower from across the sea, do you?
translation: Denizin ötesinden gelen bir cicegi nerede bulabilecegimi biliyor musun?

english: I never saw anything like that in my store before.
translation: Dükkanimda daha önce böyle bir sey görmedim.

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find an exotic and extremely rare fish, do you?
translation: Egzotik ve cok nadir bulunan bir baligi nerede bulabilecegimi biliyor musun?

english: Ah, so even outerlanders have heard of my amazing catch the other day!
translation: Ah, demek yabancilar bile gecen gün yakaladigim muhtesem baligi duymuslar!

english: You have it? Can I trade you something for it?
translation: Sende mi? Onunla bir sey takas edebilir miyim?

english: As exotic looking as it is, it is bad eating. I will happily trade it if you can find me the secret map of the best fishing spots that the navigator has hidden away.
translation: Egzotik görünüsüne ragmen tadi kötü. Navigatörün sakladigi en iyi balik tutma yerlerinin gizli haritasini bulursan seve seve takas ederim.

english: Is that all?
Indeed it is, outerlander. The only reason I sit out here in the cold all day long is so I don't have to pay his outrageous prices.
translation: Evet, yabanci. Bütün gün burada sogukta oturmamin tek nedeni, onun fahis fiyatlarini ödemek zorunda kalmamak.

english: By getting me his copy of that map, I will finally be self sufficient. I might even make a profit!
translation: O haritanin bir kopyasini bana getirirsen, sonunda kendi kendime yetebilirim. Hatta kar bile edebilirim!

english: I'll see what I can do.
I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a map of deep sea fishing spots do you?
translation: Derin deniz balikcilik noktalarinin haritasini nerede bulabilecegimi biliyor musun?

english: You should pay attention when I speak! I already told you, that rip off navigator has it, and I want it!
translation: Konusurken dikkatini ver! Sana söyledim, o dolandirici navigatörde var ve ben onu istiyorum!

english: Here. I got you your map.
Great work outerlander! With this, I can finally catch enough fish to make an honest living from it! Here, have the stupid rare fish.
translation: Harika is cikardin, yabanci! Bununla nihayet dürüst bir yasam sürmek icin yeterli balik yakalayabilirim! Al, aptal nadir baligi al.

english: I don't see what's so special about this so called rare fish.
translation: Bu sözde nadir baligin neyi bu kadar özel oldugunu anlamiyorum.

english: Me neither, outerlander. That is why I gave it to you.
translation: Ben de, yabanci. Bu yüzden sana verdim.

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It has been too long since last we spoke! The fish are really biting today!
translation: Hos geldin kardesim Dokrak. Son konusmamizdan bu yana cok zaman gecti! Bugün baliklar gercekten iyi isiriyor!

english: Ask about the Merchant's trial
Ask about becoming a Fremennik
Can you teach me the basics of fishing please?
translation: Bana balikciligin temellerini ögretir misin lütfen?

english: Ah, you've lost your net have you? Have another!
translation: Ah, agini mi kaybettin? Al baska bir tane!

english: I see you already have a net.
Ahoy, to fish, you click on the shrimp fishin' spot while ye'r carrying a net.
translation: Selam, balik tutmak icin agini tasirken karides avlama noktasini tikla.

english: I see... is that it?
There's far more as you progress - not just shrimps. You get more equipment, bigger fish and other things too...
translation: Ilerledikce cok daha fazlasi var - sadece karides degil. Daha fazla ekipman, daha büyük baliklar ve baska seyler de elde ediyorsun...

english: When you have a full inventory, you can cook it or take it to the bank. You can find a bank on the roof of the castle in Lumbridge and a cookin' range in the castle kitchen.
translation: Envanterin doldugunda, baliklari pisirebilir veya bankaya götürebilirsin. Lumbridge'deki kalenin catisinda bir banka ve kale mutfaginda bir ocak bulabilirsin.

english: Arrr.. if yer lookin' fer quests you should head over to the Mountain Dwarf who lies north-west of Taverley and have a chat with him, I'm sure he can point you in the right direction.
translation: Arrr... Eger görev ariyorsan, Taverley'in kuzeybatisindaki Dag Cücesi'ne gidip onunla konusmalisin, eminim sana dogru yolu gösterecektir.

english: I can show ye on that map of yours if ya like?
I already know about the basics of fishing, got any tips?
translation: Balikciligin temellerini zaten biliyorum, baska ipucu var mi?

english: Arrr, chose carefully where and what you fish, you can get different fish in different places throughout the land.
translation: Arrr, nerede ve neyi avlayacaginizi dikkatlice secin, ülkenin farkli yerlerinde farkli baliklar bulabilirsiniz.

english: Make sure you hang on to your fish, don't throw them away as you can get valuable cooking experience from them, gar! Look out for other things too...
translation: Baliklarinizi saklayin, atmayin, cünkü onlardan degerli pisirme deneyimi kazanabilirsiniz, gar! Diger seylere de dikkat edin...

english: Then of course there is always the trawler...
translation: Tabii bir de her zaman trol teknesi var...

english: If you venture to Port Khazard north of Yanille and speaks to me cabin boy Murphy, he can let you and a bunch of friends use his trawler to fish with... Just make sure you take a bailing bucket or two.
translation: Yanille'nin kuzeyindeki Port Khazard'a gidip kamarot Murphy ile konusursan, o sana ve arkadaslarina trol teknesini balik tutmak icin kullanmaniza izin verebilir... Sadece bir veya iki kova su kovasi götürmeyi unutma.

english: Any advice for an advanced fisher?
translation: Ileri düzey balikcilar icin tavsiyeniz var mi?

english: Aye, as you get better and better you'll find that you can fish for things like Tuna and Swordfish. These be very good for combat.
translation: Evet, gittikce daha iyi hale geldikce, ton baligi ve kilic baligi gibi baliklar da avlayabileceginizi göreceksiniz. Bunlar savasta cok ise yarar.

english: Of course, after that you will get Shark, and if you venture out onto the Trawler from Port Khazard, you can then get Manta Ray or Sea Turtle, very good eatin' on one of them.
translation: Tabii ki, ondan sonra köpek baligi avlayabilirsiniz ve Port Khazard'dan trol teknesine binerseniz, manta vatozu veya deniz kaplumbagasi da avlayabilirsiniz, ikisi de cok lezzetlidir.

english: You can also use a fishing potion if you can get your hands on one and just need that little edge.. ask someone who is familiar with herblore.
translation: Eger bulabilirseniz ve biraz avantaj elde etmek istiyorsaniz balikcilik iksiri de kullanabilirsiniz... bitki bilimi ile ilgilenen birine danisin.

english: Now.. quests...
Head over to south of the Legends Guild and East of Ardougne and find Caroline. This will have you investigating some strange happenings on the fishing platform.
translation: Legends Guild'in güneyine ve Ardougne'nin dogusuna gidin ve Caroline'i bulun. Bu görevde balikcilik platformunda meydana gelen bazi garip olaylari arastiracaksiniz.

english: Head over to Tai Bwo Wannai Village on the Isle of Karamja and speak to Timfraku to solve a strange mystery.
translation: Karamja Adasi'ndaki Tai Bwo Wannai Köyü'ne gidin ve Timfraku ile konusarak garip bir gizemi cözün.

english: Can't rightly say's there's any I know of that you could handle at the moment, but come back when you're a bit more experienced and I'm sure I can give you a clue.
translation: Su anda basa cikabileceginiz bir sey oldugunu söyleyemem, ama biraz daha deneyim kazandiginizda geri gelin, size bir ipucu verebilecegimden eminim.

english: Tell me about different fish.
translation: Bana farkli baliklar hakkinda bilgi ver.

english: Some rich rewards for big net fishin', make sure you be using a big net fishing spot though...
translation: Büyük ag balikciligi icin zengin ödüller var, ama büyük ag balikciligi icin uygun bir yer kullandigindan emin ol...

english: Is that all?
Ahoy, there's also the fishin' guild if ya skilled enough, you can find it south west of Seers' Village.
translation: Ahoy, yeterince yetenekliysen balikcilik loncasi da var, Seers Köyü'nün güneybatisinda bulabilirsin.

english: Where and what should I fish?
A young and enthusiastic fisher. Try south of Draynor Village or the pier on the island of Karamja to fish for Shrimp at level 1 or Sardines at level 5. Aye, me parrot concurs.
translation: Genc ve hevesli bir balikci. Draynor Köyü'nün güneyinde veya Karamja adasindaki iskelede seviye 1'de karides, seviye 5'te sardalya avlayabilirsin. Evet, papaganim da ayni fikirde.

english: What parrot?
Me parrot Percy on me shoulder thar! Arr!
Oookay...sure, a parrot, on your shoulder.
Arrr!
Herrin' can be fished from south of Draynor Village or the pier on the island of Karamja when you reach level 10.
translation: Herrin, seviye 10'a ulastiginda Draynor Köyü'nün güneyinde veya Karamja adasindaki iskelede avlanabilir.

english: You can use your small net to catch Anchovies from south of Draynor when you reach level 15.
translation: Seviye 15'e ulastiginda kücük agini kullanarak Draynor'un güneyinde hamsi avlayabilirsin.

english: You can practice your fly fishin' in the Lumbridge river to catch Trout at level 20.
translation: Seviye 20'de Lumbridge nehrinde sinek balikciligi yapip alabalik avlayabilirsin.

english: Pike can be fished from Lumbridge river using your fishing rod and some bait with at least level 25 fishing.
translation: En az 25. seviye balikcilik becerisine sahip oldugunuzda, Lumbridge nehrinde oltanizi ve yemlerinizi kullanarak turna baligi avlayabilirsiniz.

english: Use your harpoon and see if you can catch yourself a few Tuna from the pier on the island of Karamja at level 35.
translation: 35. seviyeye ulastiginizda, zipkininizi kullanarak Karamja adasindaki iskeleden birkac ton baligi avlayabilir misiniz bir deneyin.

english: You can use that Lobster pot from the pier on the island of Karamja to get yourself a whole bunch of the little critters once you reach level 40.
translation: 40. seviyeye ulastiginizda, Karamja adasindaki iskeleden istakoz kafesini kullanarak bir sürü kücük yaratik yakalayabilirsiniz.

english: Congratulations, you can now harpoon Swordfish after level 50. Try the pier on the island of Karamja.
translation: Tebrikler, artik 50. seviyeye ulastiginizda kilic baligi avlayabilirsiniz. Karamja adasindaki iskelede deneyin.

english: Herrin' can be fished from Catherby and some other places when you reach level 10.
translation: 10. seviyeye ulastiginizda Catherby ve diger bazi yerlerde ringa baligi avlayabilirsiniz.

english: You can use a big net to catch Mackerel from Catherby when you reach level 16.
translation: 16. seviyeye ulastiginizda Catherby'de büyük bir ag kullanarak uskumru avlayabilirsiniz.

english: Cod can be fished from Catherby and some other places once you reach level 23.
translation: 23. seviyeye ulastiginizda Catherby ve diger bazi yerlerde morina baligi avlayabilirsiniz.

english: You can use your fishin' rod and some bait to catch Slimy Eel in the swamps at level 28.
translation: Seviye 28'e ulastiginizda, olta ve yem kullanarak batakliklarda Slimy Eel yakalayabilirsiniz.

english: You can use your fishin' rod and some bait to catch Cave Eel in the caves below Lumbridge Swamp at level 38.
translation: Seviye 38'e ulastiginizda, olta ve yem kullanarak Lumbridge Batakligi'nin altindaki magaralarda Cave Eel yakalayabilirsiniz.

english: Bass can be caught at level 46 in your big net if you wander along to Catherby.
translation: Catherby'ye giderseniz, seviye 46'da büyük aginizla Bass yakalayabilirsiniz.

english: Tuna and Swordfish can be harpooned - if you're good enough - from the thrivin' fishing village of Catherby, or if you can get in try the Fishin' Guild. Level 35 for Tuna and 50 for Swordfish.
translation: Yeterince iyiyseniz, gelisen balikci köyü Catherby'den veya Fishin' Guild'e girebilirseniz, ton baligi ve kilic baligi zipkinla avlayabilirsiniz. Ton baligi icin seviye 35, kilic baligi icin seviye 50.

english: You can also go talk to Murphy and see if you can use his trawler to catch Manta Ray and Sea Turtle if you're really good... Gar!
translation: Ayrica Murphy ile konusup, gercekten iyiyseniz, onun trol teknesini kullanarak Manta Ray ve Deniz Kaplumbagasi avlayip avlayamayacaginizi ögrenebilirsiniz... Gar!

english: Goodbye.
Can you teach me the basics of fishing please?
translation: Bana balikciligin temellerini ögretir misiniz lütfen?

english: Yes please.
No thanks.
I already know about the basics of fishing, got any tips?
translation: Balikciligin temellerini zaten biliyorum, herhangi bir ipucunuz var mi?

english: Any advice for an advanced fisher?
translation: Ileri düzey balikcilar icin herhangi bir tavsiyeniz var mi?

english: Tell me about different fish.
translation: Farkli balik türleri hakkinda bilgi verin.

english: Small Net Fish
Big Net Fish
Rod and Fly Fishing
Lobster pot
Harpoon Fish
Tell me about...
Where and what should I fish?
Goodbye.
Greetings, Your Royal Highness. Get your fresh fish here!
translation: Selamlar, Majesteleri. Taze baliklarinizi buradan alin!

english: I've heard that the Etceterian fish is stored in a cow shed.
Wow, are you okay? What happendto you?
translation: Vay canina, iyi misin? Ne oldu sana?

english: Ugh... Well met, adventurer. I wouldn't go down there if I were you. That trap is an absolute nightmare! The one who created it must be a sadist. I don't know of anyone who has cleared it.
translation: Ugh... Merhaba, maceraci. Senin yerinde olsam oraya inmezdim. O tuzak tam bir kabus! Onu yaratan kisi sadist olmali. Onu gecebilen kimseyi tanimiyorum.

english: Oh? I've cleared it.
Oh? Are you pulling my leg, adventurer?
translation: Öyle mi? Dalga mi geciyorsun, maceraci?

english: I'm fairly certain that if I did that, it would fall off!
No need to add salt in the wound.
Although I am curious, how did you beat the trap?
translation: Merak ediyorum da, tuzagi nasil gectin?

english: I just made sure to prioritise looking out for the arrows. The fire was fairly easy to get through if I just made sure to take one step at a time.
translation: Sadece oklari dikkatle takip etmeye özen gösterdim. Bir adim bir adim ilerlersem atesi gecmek oldukca kolaydi.

english: I see, you're clearly more skillful than I. I'm not sure if I'd be agile enough to do that. Do tell, what was on the next floor?
translation: Anliyorum, benden daha yetenekli oldugun belli. Benim o kadar cevik oldugumu sanmiyorum. Söylesene, bir sonraki katta ne vardi?

english: The place looked magnificent, gold lion statues, coffins untouched by anyone else and plenty of Hallowed marks compared to these floors. Although, the traps were significantly harder than the one below.
translation: Mekan muhtesem görünüyordu, altin aslan heykelleri, kimsenin dokunmadigi tabutlar ve bu katlara kiyasla bolca kutsal isaretler vardi. Ancak tuzaklar bir alt kattakinden cok daha zordu.

english: I see. Well, I guess I'd better brush up on my skills if I want to see it for myself. Nothing worth having in life comes easy right?
translation: Anliyorum. Sanirim bunu kendi gözlerimle görmek istiyorsam becerilerimi gelistirmem gerekecek. Hayatta degerli hicbir sey kolay elde edilmez, degil mi?

english: That's very true, I wish you the best of luck!
translation: Cok dogru, sana bol sans dilerim!

english: No one has cleared it? How hard can it be?
translation: Kimse gecemedi mi? Ne kadar zor olabilir ki?

english: Well, unlike the rest of the traps I've seen so far, you have to deal with both an arrow trap and a fire trap at the same time.
translation: Sey, simdiye kadar gördügüm diger tuzaklarin aksine, burada hem ok tuzagi hem de ates tuzagiyla ayni anda basa cikman gerekiyor.

english: Wow, that does sound hard. Do you have any tips for me?
translation: Vay canina, gercekten zor gibi. Bana verebilecegin bir ipucu var mi?

english: Well, individually they aren't that hard to do. The fires are always swapping between on and off. I think that if you run to where the fire just was you should be safe.
translation: Tek tek ele alindiginda o kadar da zor degiller. Atesler sürekli yanip sönüyor. Atesin oldugu yere kosarsan güvende olursun bence.

english: The hardest part for me is the arrows. You have to look forward to watch the fire trap whilst also looking over your shoulder to see where the arrows are.
translation: Benim icin en zor kismi oklar. Ates tuzagini izlemek icin öne bakarken, ayni zamanda oklarin nerede oldugunu görmek icin arkana da bakman gerekiyor.

english: I certainly wish there was a way to see both at once. Perhaps it would help if a fellow adventurer was looking down from above to call out where the arrows are.
translation: Keske ikisini ayni anda görebilmenin bir yolu olsaydi. Belki de bir maceraci arkadasin yukaridan asagiya bakip oklarin nerede oldugunu söylerse yardimci olabilir.

english: Yeah... I'd imagine having an aerial view of the situation would be pretty helpful.
translation: Evet... Durumu havadan görebilmek oldukca yardimci olurdu herhalde.

english: Of course, but we both know that's impossible for one person! Ouch! Sorry, it hurts to laugh. I wish you luck adventurer!
translation: Tabii ki, ama ikimiz de bunun bir kisi icin imkansiz oldugunu biliyoruz! Ah! Üzgünüm, gülmek aci veriyor. Sana sans diliyorum maceraci!

english: Oh? I've cleared it.
No one has cleared it? How hard can it be?
translation: Kimse gecemedi mi? Ne kadar zor olabilir ki?

english: Hello. I'm the flax keeper. I tend to the flax fields, keeping the yield and continued flax harvest healthy.
translation: Merhaba. Ben keten bekcisiyim. Keten tarlalarina bakiyor, verimi ve keten hasadinin saglikli devam etmesini sagliyorum.

english: Ooh! Great work!
Thank you. I must get back to work. You never know when a great flax harvest will begin!
translation: Tesekkürler. Isime dönmeliyim. Harika bir keten hasadinin ne zaman baslayacagi belli olmaz!

english: Hello. Do you want to exchange some flax banknotes for bowstrings? I'll exchange [amount] for you today, and you can come back tomorrow for more.
I didn't actually bring [amount] flax banknotes with me.
Oh. Well, if you fetch that many flax banknotes, I'll swap them for bowstrings for you.
translation: Oh. Peki, o kadar keten banknotu getirirseniz, onlari yay ipleriyle takas ederim.

english: Um... Actually, you seem to have so much stuff that you can't hold the bowstrings.
translation: Um... Aslinda, o kadar cok esyaniz var ki yay iplerini tutamiyorsunuz.

english: Hello again. I'm afraid I won't be able to exchange any more flax for bowstrings today. Try me again tomorrow.
translation: Merhaba tekrar. Maalesef bugün daha fazla keten banknotunu yay ipi ile takas edemeyecegim. Yarin tekrar dene.

english: Today I can exchange [amount] flax banknotes for bowstrings, if you bring me enough flax banknotes.
Sorry, your inventory's too full of stuff.
I have a question for you.
The Flax keeper has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Keten bekcisi sana bir meydan okuma parsömeni verdi!

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
No, try again.
Correct!
You've obtained a casket!
Agree
Decline
You want play game of pinball, [player name]?
Yes, pinball is fun.
No thanks.
Going away now.
Nope, you wrong person.
Err...what am I supposed to do here again?
You gotta poke dem pillars.
What? All of them?
No, no. If you poke dem ones dat don't have a dem flashin' rings, den dats bad.
translation: Hayir, hayir. Yanip sönen halkalari olmayanlari dürtersen, bu kötü olur.

english: So I have to poke the pillars that are flashing?
translation: Yani yanip sönen sütunlari dürtmem mi gerekiyor?

english: Yer. You do dat ten times, you get prize.
translation: Evet. Bunu on kez yaparsan ödül kazanirsin.

english: So...I'm free to go now, right?
Yer, get going. We get break now.
translation: Evet, git hadi. Simdi mola veriyoruz.

english: Ok. Err...have a nice break.
Come play game, [player name]!
We got good game, [player name]!
You want play game, [player name]!
You like hitting things, [player name]?
translation: Bir seyleri vurmayi sever misin, Maceraci?

english: Maybe later.
Yes, pinball is fun.
No thanks.
You pet the dog...
Woof woof!
You give the dog a nice piece of meat. It gobbles it up.
translation: Köpege güzel bir parca et verirsin. Köpek onu yutar.

english: Grrrr!
That's disgusting - you can't give it to the poor dog!
translation: Bu igrenc - zavalli köpege bunu veremezsin!

english: The dog doesn't seem interested in that.
You give the dog Alan's bones. It happily gnaws on them, but something feels wrong about all of this.
translation: Köpege Alan'in kemiklerini veriyorsun. Köpek mutlu bir sekilde kemikleri kemiriyor, ama tüm bu olayda bir seyler ters gidiyor gibi hissediyorsun.

english: Hi there. Looking for something new to wear? You've come to the right place if so.
translation: Merhaba. Giyecek yeni bir sey mi ariyorsun? Öyleyse dogru yere geldin.

english: Let's see what you have.
translation: Ne var ne yok bir bakalim.

english: I'm good, thank you.
No worries.
Let's see what you have.
translation: Ne var ne yok bir bakalim.

english: I'm good, thank you.
Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: Hey, bu Kahraman! Vay canina! Harikasin, o iki juvinate ve Gadderank'i nasil alt ettin? Kasaba da cok güzel, harika bir is cikarmissin!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
Well met! My name's Florin, I do a bit of this, a bit of that. Just try to survive really, there's nothing much else we can do.
translation: Merhaba! Benim adim Florin, biraz sundan, biraz bundan yapiyorum. Aslinda sadece hayatta kalmaya calisiyorum, baska yapabilecegimiz pek bir sey yok.

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: Oh, pek bir sey yok, hepimiz hala vampirlerden saklaniyoruz ve bu korkunc yerde gecimimizi sagliyoruz, umarim yakinda Salve'deki tapinaga yolculuk yapacak kadar gücleniriz.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: Bildigim kadariyla yok, su anda cok yararli olan bazi temel olanaklara sahibiz, hepimiz size cok minnettariz. Daha önce hic bir kahraman görmedim veya tanimadim, bu yüzden karsilastiracak bir seyim yok, ama sanirim

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: cogu insanin görüsüne göre, siz bir kahramansiniz! Ben sahsen sizinle tanistigima cok memnunum.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Ok, thanks.
Oh, hello again. Want some fish?
Yes, show me the fish.
Not right now.
Yes, show me the fish.
Not right now.
Hello.
Good day. What are you doing?
I'm selling flowers, 15gp for three. Would you like some?
translation: Cicek satiyorum, üc tanesi 15 altin. Ister misin?

english: I don't have enough money.
Yes, please.
Thank you! Here you go.
No, thank you.
Good day, Your Royal Highness.
I'm selling flowers, 15gp for three. Would you like some, Your Highness?
translation: Cicek satiyorum, üc tanesi 15 altin. Ister misiniz, Majesteleri?

english: Yes, please.
No, thank you.
Bees are very active on this bush and there are pollen-rich flowers. You carefully collect some Strange pollen.
translation: Arilar bu calida cok aktif ve polen acisindan zengin cicekler var. Dikkatlice biraz Garip polen topluyorsunuz.

english: You've been awarded [1 or 2] anima-infused bark.
translation: [1 veya 2] anima ile asilanmis agac kabugu kazandiniz.

english: Bees are very active on this bush and there are unpollinated flowers. You carefully apply it with the help of some nearby bees then extract some from the bush.
translation: Arilar bu calida cok aktif ve polenlenmemis cicekler var. Yakindaki arilarin yardimiyla dikkatlice uyguluyorsunuz ve calidan biraz cikariyorsunuz.

english: You've been awarded [1 or 2] Anima-infused bark.
translation: [1 veya 2] anima ile asilanmis agac kabugu kazandiniz.

english: There are no open, unpollinated flowers on this bush yet.
translation: Bu calida henüz acik, tozlasmamis cicekler yok.

english: You took the pollen from this bush and should apply it to a bush with unpollinated flowers.
translation: Bu calidan polen aldiniz ve tozlasmamis cicekleri olan bir caliya uygulamalisiniz.

english: A bush as started producing fruit, well done!
translation: Bir cali meyve vermeye basladi, aferin!

english: The bushes become dormant and the bees move on. You've helped make the forest a more diverse and beautiful place!
translation: Calilar uykuya dalar ve arilar baska bir yere gecer. Ormani daha cesitli ve güzel bir yer haline getirmeye yardimci oldunuz!

english: You've been awarded [number] Anima-based bark.
You discard your left over pollen.
Hello. Do you want to buy or sell any maces?
translation: Merhaba. Mace satin almak veya satmak ister misiniz?

english: No thanks.
No thanks.
Well, I'll have a look, at least.
We seed the hidden truths of this world! Ranul rewards all of us who are willing to find them!
translation: Bu dünyanin gizli gerceklerini ortaya cikariyoruz! Ranul, onlari bulmaya istekli olan hepimizi ödüllendirir!

english: Ralos and Ranul are the twin guardians of our fate! Trust in them, for they will lead us to our destinies!
translation: Ralos ve Ranul, kaderimizin ikiz koruyucularidir! Onlara güvenin, cünkü bizi kaderimize götürecekler!

english: Do not fear the dark of night! Embrace it, for it is a gift from Ranul!
translation: Gecenin karanligindan korkma! Onu kucakla, cünkü o Ranul'un bir armaganidir!

english: In times of sorrow, we look to Ralos and Ranul. They guide us through day and night.
translation: Üzüntülü zamanlarda Ralos ve Ranul'a bakariz. Onlar bizi gündüz ve gece boyunca yönlendirir.

english: Be bold in the day, but reflect in the night! Let the teachings of both Ralos and Ranul guide you equally!
translation: Gündüz cesur ol, ama gece düsün! Ralos ve Ranul'un ögretileri sana esit derecede rehberlik etsin!

english: Ralos teaches us to be brave! To be bold! Let his warmth in, and it will burn away all doubts!
translation: Ralos bize cesur olmayi ögretir! Cesur olmayi! Onun sicakligini iceri al, o tüm süphelerini yakip kül edecek!

english: Ralos shines upon us who are brave! If we show the courage to act, he will reward us!
translation: Ralos cesur olanlara isik tutar! Eyleme gecme cesaretini gösterirsek, bizi ödüllendirir!

english: Hey! You can't come through here! This is private land!
translation: Hey! Buradan gecemezsin! Burasi özel mülk!

english: You will need to find another way in.
Nice weather we're having today.
It's so peaceful here, don't you agree?
translation: Burasi cok huzurlu, sence de öyle degil mi?

english: There's plenty of trees around, couldn't you go to another spot?
translation: Etrafta bolca agac var, baska bir yere gidemez misin?

english: Hello!
Hello friend. I wish to slay evil and avail them of their loot! Take me to Burgh de Rott!
translation: Merhaba dostum. Kötülügü yok etmek ve ganimetlerini ele gecirmek istiyorum! Beni Burgh de Rott'a götür!

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: Oradaki kötülükle savasmaya yeterince hazir misin?

english: I think so? At least my heart knows courage and that should be sufficient for the meantime. I expect that when we get to Burgh de Rott, we'll be able to purchase suitable provisions.
translation: Sanirim öyle. En azindan kalbim cesaretli ve bu simdilik yeterli olmali. Burgh de Rott'a vardigimizda uygun erzak satin alabilecegimizi umuyorum.

english: But you do realise that the vampyres in Morytania are immune to everything except silver?
translation: Ama Morytania'daki vampirlerin gümüs disinda her seye karsi bagisik olduklarini biliyor musun?

english: Er...well, I've not heard mention of that fact, but I have faith that Saradomin will provide the means to furnish me with suitable weapons when I reach Burgh de Rott.
translation: Sey... Bu konuda bir sey duymadim, ama Burgh de Rott'a vardigimizda Saradomin'in bana uygun silahlar saglayacagina inaniyorum.

english: And if we happen to run into some vampyres on the journey down there?
translation: Ya oraya giderken yolda vampirlerle karsilasirsak?

english: I trust that you will help us to avoid them. You are a guide after all, aren't you? Anyway, you look like you can handle yourself. I presume you've fought such creatures before and won? How hard can it be?
translation: Onlardan kacinmamiza yardim edecegine inaniyorum. Sonucta sen bir rehbersin, degil mi? Her neyse, kendini savunabilecek gibi görünüyorsun. Daha önce bu tür yaratiklarla savasip kazandin mi? Ne kadar zor olabilir ki?

english: It can be pretty difficult, actually. But you're right, I'll be your guide so I should be able to handle the situation.
translation: Aslinda oldukca zor olabilir. Ama haklisin, ben senin rehberin olacagim, bu yüzden durumu halledebilmeliyim.

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Neden Burgh de Rott'a gitmek istiyorsun?

english: I'm going down there to teach those vampyres a lesson or two. I've heard about the terrible conditions down there and I intend to put a stop to it.
translation: Oradaki vampirleri bir ders vermek icin gidiyorum. Oradaki korkunc kosullari duydum ve buna bir son vermek niyetindeyim.

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Burgh de Rott'a giderken yol üzerinde düsmanlarla karsilasirsak kendini savunabilir misin?

english: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of enemies. You don't need to worry about that.
translation: Diyelim ki biraz tecrübeliyim ve düsmanlarla savasmaktan cekinmem. Bu konuda endiselenmene gerek yok.

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: Hmmm, görünüse göre bir takipcin var. Kendi basina dolasmaya birakilirsa bu yolculukta kaybolabilir. Takipcin güvende oldugunda yola cikalim.

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: Gercekten mi? Bu harika olur! Hedefe vardigimizda sana kücük bir ödül verecegim.

english: Burgh de Rott Ramble begins
Ok, which route should we take?
Ok, thanks.
Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: Ah, bana biraz erzak vermek istiyorsun, ha? Sirt cantami acayim.

english: This place is a bit grim. How can people live here?
translation: Burasi biraz kasvetli. Insanlar burada nasil yasayabiliyor?

english: Do you visit Burgh de Rott often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: Burgh de Rott'a sik sik gelir misin? Rotayi iyi biliyorsun gibi görünüyor.

english: When are we going to get to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Burgh de Rott'a ne zaman varacagiz?

english: We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on. I have loot to get.
translation: Bütün gün burada durup sohbet edemeyiz, hadi devam edelim. Yagmalayacak seyler var.

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than the opulet life styles forced on us adventurer types. I'd much rather be up to my eyes in mud and having a good fight!
translation: Oh, bu yolculuktan nefret ediyorum, ama maceraperest tiplere dayatilan lüks yasam tarzindan daha iyidir. Gözlerime kadar camura batip iyi bir kavga etmeyi tercih ederim!

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...
Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Paterdomus. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: Vay canina! Görünüse göre Paterdomus'a geri dönmek zorunda kalacagiz. O köprüden gecemeyiz!

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
Player completes the bridge event
Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Paterdomus.
translation: Bu is bitti... Görünüse göre bu batakliktan gecemeyecegiz. Paterdomus'a geri dönmek zorundayiz.

english: Player completes the bog event
Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: Hey... bu harika... harika bir is cikardin... Seni takip edecegim.

english: Whahay...that was great!
But we really should be heading off now.
Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
Player completes the river event
That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: Bu harika! Ben de aynisini yapmaliyim.

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: Vay canina! Harikaydi! Ama artik gercekten yola cikmaliyiz.

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
This is scary!
Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
Ahhh, two tentacles!
...three tentacles!
I think I'm going to faint!
Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: Vay canina! Su canavara bak! O seyi kendi basina halletmen gerekecek!

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the Burgh de Rott. Here's your reward.
translation: Beni Burgh de Rott'a güvenle ulastirdigin icin cok tesekkürler. Iste ödülün.

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: Oradaki kötülükle savasmaya yeterince hazir misin?

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Neden Burgh de Rott'a gitmek istiyorsun?

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
Ok, thanks.
Thanks so much for saving me from being a vampyre. Here, take this certificate, I'm sorry but it's all I can offer as a reward.
translation: Beni vampir olmaktan kurtardigin icin cok tesekkürler. Al, bu sertifikayi al, üzgünüm ama ödül olarak sunabilecegim tek sey bu.

english: Human.
Hello there. Who are you?
Fornek quo Maten. I am a hunter for the Kahlith. Do you wish to serve the balance?
translation: Fornek quo Maten. Ben Kahlith icin avciyim. Dengeye hizmet etmek ister misin?

english: Yes.
Then you should speak to Konar quo Maten. She will guide you.
translation: O zaman Konar quo Maten ile konusmalisin. O sana yol gösterecektir.

english: No.
A shame. You are a bringer of death, you could be of great use to the balance.
translation: Yazik. Sen ölümün habercisiisin, dengeye cok faydali olabilirsin.

english: I'm not sure.
Then you should speak with Xorrah quo Sihar. He will show you the way.
translation: O zaman Xorrah quo Sihar ile konusmalisin. O sana yolu gösterecektir.

english: Yes.
No.
I'm not sure.
Can I help you at all?
Oh...you've come back.
Please...I havent got any more vinegar. Give me some time I beg you.
translation: Lütfen... baska sirkim kalmadi. Bana biraz zaman ver, yalvaririm.

english: I wasn't after vinegar today.
Oh, wonderful.
I will have some in soon, if he needs it.
translation: Eger ihtiyaci varsa, yakinda sirke gelecek.

english: In the meantime, can I interest you in something?
translation: Bu arada, ilgini cekecek bir sey var mi?

english: Yes, what are you selling?
No.
Well, I'll put something special to one side for you.
translation: Peki, sizin icin özel bir sey ayiririm.

english: Thanks.
Not at the moment.
Then move along, you filthy ragamuffin, I have customers to serve!
translation: O zaman git buradan, pis serseri, hizmet etmem gereken müsterilerim var!

english: Have you got any vinegar?
Vinegar?
Vinegar!
The very idea! My wines are the finest in the district!
translation: Ne sacma bir fikir! Benim saraplarim bölgedeki en iyisidir!

english: Sorry! I was told to come and speak with a wine merchant about getting some vinegar, I must have the wrong person.
translation: Özür dilerim! Bir sarap tüccariyla sirke almak icin konusmam söylendi, yanlis kisiye gelmis olmaliyim.

english: Wait...did HE send you?
If by HE you mean the old man with the sack of bones, then yes.
translation: O derken kemik torbali yasli adami kastediyorsan, evet.

english: Aaaah...say no more sir, I have some in specially.
translation: Aaaah... baska bir sey söyleme efendim, özel olarak stokladim.

english: Ah! Good afternoon your lordship. I take it you have come for a refill?
translation: Ah! Iyi günler efendim. Yeniden doldurmak icin mi geldiniz?

english: Yes.
Not today.
Well, just remember I have some in stock for you when you want it.
Well done.
You've obtained a [new clue/casket]!
Hey! Get your hands off there!
You're the thief who stole from me!
Guardsguards!
Yes.
No.
Yes, what are you selling?
Not at the moment
Yes
Not today
What can I do for you?
I hear that I can present you with an offering and you will enchant my lyre for me.
translation: Sana bir adak sunarsam lirimi büyülenecegini duydum.

english: This is true. For a simple enchantment, you may place an offering on my Altar. Can I help you with anything else?
translation: Bu dogru. Basit bir büyüyü yapmak icin sunakta bir adak birakabilirsin. Baska bir sey icin yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: You do not have a raw shark to offer.
You do not have a raw manta ray to offer.
You do not have a raw sea turtle to offer.
You do not have a raw bass to offer.
Can you enchant my lyre so that the enchantment will never fade?
translation: Lirimi büyüyü asla kaybolmayacak sekilde büyüleyebilir misin?

english: If the offering is great enough, I would be happy to offer you such a powerful enchantment.
translation: Adak yeterince büyükse, size böyle güclü bir büyü yapmaktan mutluluk duyarim.

english: Depending on your familiarity of the area, I will require less of an offering.
translation: Bölgeyi ne kadar iyi tanidiginiza bagli olarak, daha az adak isteyecegim.

english: But for you, I would have you offer me 1000 raw shark, raw manta ray, raw sea turtle and raw bass.
translation: Ama sizden 1000 cig köpekbaligi, cig manta vatozu, cig deniz kaplumbagasi ve cig levrek adak vermenizi isteyecegim.

english: But for you, I would have you offer me 800 raw shark, raw manta ray, raw sea turtle and raw bass.
translation: Ama sizden 800 cig köpekbaligi, cig manta vatozu, cig deniz kaplumbagasi ve cig levrek adak vermenizi isteyecegim.

english: But for you, I would have you offer me 600 raw shark, raw manta ray, raw sea turtle and raw bass. But if you had completed the Fremennik hard diary, it would have been 400.
translation: Ama senin icin, bana 600 cig köpekbaligi, cig manta vatozu, cig deniz kaplumbagasi ve cig levrek sunmani isterim. Ama Fremennik zor günlügünü tamamlamis olsaydin, bu sayi 400 olurdu.

english: But for you, I would have you offer me 400 raw shark, raw manta ray, raw sea turtle and raw bass. But if you had completed the Fremennik elite diary, it would have been 200.
translation: Ama senin icin, bana 400 cig köpekbaligi, cig manta vatozu, cig deniz kaplumbagasi ve cig levrek sunmani isterim. Ama Fremennik elit günlügünü tamamlamis olsaydin, 200 olurdu.

english: But for you, I would have you offer me 200 raw shark, raw manta ray, raw sea turtle and raw bass.
translation: Ama senin icin, bana 200 cig köpekbaligi, cig manta vatozu, cig deniz kaplumbagasi ve cig levrek sunmani isterdim.

english: You still need to offer me [number] raw shark, [number] raw manta ray, [number] raw sea turtle and [number] raw bass.
You present your offering.
While I appreciate the thought of offering me fish, I am afraid I am unable to use the air you have offered me.
translation: Bana balik sunma düsüncenizi takdir ediyorum, ancak ne yazik ki bana sundugunuz havayi kullanamiyorum.

english: Many thanks for your offering. You still need to offer me [number] raw shark, [number] raw manta ray, [number] raw sea turtle and [number] raw bass.

You have given me a worthy offering, and I will bestow my enchantment whenever you bring me a suitable lyre. I regret I cannot return any of your fish in future, even if you become closer to the Fremenniks.
translation: Bana degerli bir sunum yaptiniz ve bana uygun bir lir getirdiginizde size büyümü bahsedecegim. Fremenniklere daha yakin olsaniz bile, gelecekte baliklarin hicbirini geri veremeyecegim icin üzgünüm.

english: I offer you this enchantment as you have earned my favour.
translation: Benim lütfumu kazandiginiz icin size bu büyüyü sunuyorum.

english: I will come back when I have an offering worthy of this power. Goodbye.
translation: Bu güce layik bir sunumum oldugunda geri gelecegim. Hosca kalin.

english: Farewell then.
Nothing, sorry.
Do not summon me for idle conversation! Come back when you have an offering.
translation: Bos konusmak icin beni cagirma! Sunumun oldugunda geri gel.

english: You do not have a lyre with you that I can enchant. It must have been strung, but it cannot bear any existing enchantment.
translation: Büyüleyebilecegim bir lir yok sende. Teleri takilmis olmali, ama mevcut büyüyü tasiyamaz.

english: Present offering of a single fish.
Raw shark.
Raw manta ray.
Raw sea turtle.
Raw bass.
Ask about a permanent lyre enchantment.
Present offering.
Goodbye.
Nothing.
Hello!
Hello there. Do you have any fossils for me?
translation: Merhaba. Benim icin fosil var mi?

english: I'm Mary. In the tent you'll find Tray, my dog. He's quite friendly and doesn't bite. I'm here for the fossils. I'll go anywhere for fossils!
translation: Ben Mary. Cadirda köpegim Tray var. Oldukca dost canlisidir ve isirmaz. Fosiller icin buradayim. Fosiller icin her yere giderim!

english: Why are you here?
What fossils would you like to trade?
All done. Would you like to trade in any more fossils?
translation: Bitti. Baska fosil takasi yapmak ister misin?

english: It looks like you don't have any fossils to trade.
translation: Takas edecek fosilin kalmamis gibi görünüyor.

english: You don't have space for that.
Of course, you left it here and I kept it for you.
translation: Tabii ki, onu burada birakmistin, ben de senin icin sakladim.

english: Goodbye.
Who are you?
I'd like to trade some fossils.
Small fossils.
Yes please.
Goodbye.
Medium fossils.
Large fossils.
Rare fossils.
I've lost my notebook.
Apparently you aren't as stupid as you look.
Welcome to Frankie's Fish Emporium, what can I do for you mate?
translation: Frankie'nin Balik Magazasina hos geldin, nasil yardimci olabilirim dostum?

english: What have you got for sale?
We serve the finest fresh fish Piscarilius has to offer.
translation: Piscarilius'un en kaliteli taze baliklarini sunuyoruz.

english: What do you do around here?

I trade the finest fish in Piscarilius. In this city you get two choices, fishing or thuggery. I've kept afloat without resorting to the latter, not something which can be said by many of the folk around here.
translation: Piscarilius'un en kaliteli baliklarini takas ediyorum. Bu sehirde iki secenegin var, balikcilik ya da haydutluk. Ben ikincisine basvurmadan ayakta kaldim, buradaki pek cok insan icin ayni seyi söylemek mümkün degil.

english: I'll be on my way.
What have you got for sale?
What do you do around here?
I'll be on my way
Hello again, [player name].
Hello. How's the repair work going?
I'm working on it. I can always do with more iron sheets, so if you've got any more, I'll give you 20 gp per sheet.
translation: Üzerinde calisiyorum. Daha fazla demir levha isime yarar, eger varsa, levha basina 20 altin veririm.

english: Thanks, I'll remember that.
Hello again, [player name]. Were you wanting to sell me that iron sheet? I'd give you 20 gp for it.
translation: Merhaba tekrar, Maceraci. Bana o demir levhayi satmak mi istiyordun? Sana 20 altin veririm.

english: Hello again, [player name]. Were you wanting to sell me those iron sheets? I'd give you [amount] gp.
Yes, that'll do nicely.
No, I'd rather not.
That's ok.
Yes, that'll do nicely.
No, I'd rather not.
Hey, [player name], can you come and help me with some pheasants?
translation: Hey, Maceraci, gelip bana birkac sülünle yardim eder misin?

english: Okay, I'll help with your pheasants.
Sorry, I'm busy.
Hey there, [player name]. Could you kill a pheasant with [two/three/four] tails, please? Bring me the raw pheasant when you're done.
Hey there, [player name]. Can you kill the [2/3/4]-tailed pheasant please. Bring me the raw pheasant when you're done.
translation: Merhaba, Maceraci. [2/3/4] kuyruklu sülünü öldürebilir misin lütfen? Isin bittiginde bana cig sülünü getir.

english: Hey there, [player name]. I need you to kill a pheasant that has [2/3/4] tails. Bring me the raw pheasant when you're done.
translation: Merhaba, Maceraci. [2/3/4] kuyruklu bir sülünü öldürmen gerekiyor. Isin bittiginde bana cig sülünü getir.

english: Goodbye.
Now bring me the raw pheasant.
Thanks, [player name], you may use the portal to leave the area now.
translation: Tesekkürler, Maceraci, artik portali kullanarak buradan ayrilabilirsin.

english: Okay, [player name], you can leave the area now.
You don't need to attack any more pheasants. You're allowed to leave.
translation: Artik kekliklere saldirmana gerek yok. Ayrilabilirsin.

english: I don't need any more of those. You are free to exit the area now.
translation: Artik bunlara ihtiyacim yok. Artik bölgeden ayrilabilirsin.

english: You get a lederhosen [hat/top/shorts] for your help, many thanks!
translation: Yardimin icin bir lederhosen [hat/top/shorts] aliyorsun, cok tesekkürler!

english: You get a lamp for your help, many thanks!
translation: Yardimin icin bir lamba aliyorsun, cok tesekkürler!

english: I'm looking for [player name].
[player name]!
Hello? [player name]?
Talk to me, [player name]!
[player name]? Are you there?!
I'd like to talk to you, [player name]!
Maybe later.
Okay, I'll help with your pheasants.
Sorry, I'm busy.
Hello, what's going on?
Hey, [player name], can you help me with some pheasants?
translation: Hey, Maceraci, bana kekliklerle ilgili yardim eder misin?

english: Collect the eggs from the uninhabited nests and bring them to me, and I'll reward you.
translation: Issiz yuvalardan yumurtalari topla ve bana getir, seni ödüllendirecegim.

english: Well, come back if you change your mind.
I have an egg for you.
These pheasants will be finding new nesting grounds soon.
translation: Bu keklikler yakinda yeni yuvalama alanlari bulacaklar.

english: Sure, how can I help?
Greetings traveller. What brings you to my residence?
translation: Selamlar gezgin. Seni benim evime getiren nedir?

english: You keep a pet bat? That's a bit odd.
translation: Evcil yarasa mi besliyorsun? Bu biraz tuhaf.

english: Squeak!
Yes traveller, this is not out of the ordinary for us. The bats respond well to the powers of the dark altar after being drawn here by the river of blood.
translation: Evet gezgin, bu bizim icin olagan disi bir sey degil. Yarasalar, kan nehrinin cekimiyle buraya geldikten sonra karanlik sunaklarin gücüne iyi tepki veriyorlar.

english: Well I hope he keeps you 'mused.
What are you doing on my land?
I'm looking for something to kill.
What, on my land? Leave my livestock alone you scoundrel!
translation: Ne, benim arazimde mi? Hayvanlarimi rahat birak seni alcak!

english: I'm lost.
How can you be lost? Just follow the road east and south. You'll end up in Lumbridge fairly quickly.
translation: Nasil kaybolursun? Dogu ve güney yönündeki yolu takip et. Kisa sürede Lumbridge'e varirsin.

english: Fred! Fred! I've seen The Thing!
You ... you actually saw it?
Run for the hills! [player name] grab as many chickens as you can! We have to ...
translation: Tepelere kosun! Maceraci mümkün oldugunca cok tavuk kap! Yapmamiz gereken...

english: Fred!
... flee! Oh, woe is me! The shapeshifter is coming! We're all ...
translation: ... kacalim! Ah, yazik bana! Sekil degistiren geliyor! Hepimiz...

english: FRED!
... doomed. What!
It's not a shapeshifter or any other kind of monster!
translation: O sekil degistiren ya da baska bir canavar degil!

english: Well then what is it boy?
Well ... it's just two Penguins; Penguins disguised as a sheep.
translation: Sey... sadece iki penguen; koyun kiligina girmis penguenler.

english: Have you been out in the sun too long?
What are you doing on my land? You're not the one who keeps leaving all my gates open and letting out all my sheep, are you?
translation: Benim arazimde ne isin var? Benim kapilarimi acik birakip koyunlarimi kaciran sen degilsin, degil mi?

english: I'm looking for a quest.
You're after a quest, you say? Actually, I could do with a bit of help.
translation: Görev mi ariyorsun? Aslinda, biraz yardima ihtiyacim var.

english: My sheep are getting mighty woolly. I'd be much obliged if you could shear them. And while you're at it, spin the wool for me too.
translation: Koyunlarimin yünleri cok uzadi. Onlari kirkarsan cok minnettar olurum. Ve kirkarken yünleri de benim icin egir.

english: Yes, that's it. Bring me 20 balls of wool. And I'm sure I could sort out some sort of payment. Of course, there's the small matter of The Thing.
translation: Evet, aynen öyle. Bana 20 top yün getir. Ve eminim bir sekilde ödeme yapabilirim. Tabii, The Thing meselesi var.

english: What do you mean, The Thing?
Well now, no one has ever seen The Thing. That's why we call it The Thing, 'cos we don't know what it is.
translation: Sey, kimse Sey'i görmedi. Bu yüzden ona Sey diyoruz, cünkü ne oldugunu bilmiyoruz.

english: Some say it's a black hearted shapeshifter, hungering for the souls of hard working decent folk like me. Others say it's just a sheep.
translation: Bazilari onun, benim gibi caliskan, dürüst insanlarin ruhlarini yiyen, kara kalpli bir sekil degistiren oldugunu söylüyor. Digerleri ise onun sadece bir koyun oldugunu söylüyor.

english: Well I don't have all day to stand around and gossip. Are you going to shear my sheep or what!
translation: Bütün gün burada durup dedikodu yapmaya vaktim yok. Koyunlarimi kirkacak misin, kirkmayacak misin?

english: Yes, okay. I can do that.
Good! Now one more thing, do you actually know how to shear a sheep?
translation: Güzel! Bir sey daha var, koyun kirkmayi biliyor musun?

english: Err. No, I don't know actually.
Well, first things first, you need a pair of shears. I've got some here you can use.
translation: Öncelikle, bir cift makas lazim. Burada kullanabilecegin makaslar var.

english: You just need to go and use them on the sheep out in my field.
Sounds easy!
That's what they all say!
Some of the sheep don't like it too much... Persistence is the key.
translation: Bazi koyunlar bunu pek sevmez... Önemli olan israrci olmak.

english: Once you've collected some wool you can spin it into balls.
translation: Yünü topladiktan sonra onu top haline getirebilirsin.

english: Do you know how to spin wool?
I don't know how to spin wool, sorry.
Don't worry, it's quite simple!
The nearest Spinning Wheel can be found on the first floor of Lumbridge Castle.
translation: En yakin egirme carki Lumbridge Kalesi'nin birinci katinda bulunur.

english: To get to Lumbridge Castle just follow the road east.
translation: Lumbridge Kalesi'ne ulasmak icin doguya dogru yolu takip et.

english: Thank you!
No, I'll give it a miss.
Suit yourself.
I need to talk to you about shearing these sheep!
translation: Bu koyunlarin kirkilmasi hakkinda seninle konusmam lazim!

english: Oh. How are you doing getting those balls of wool?
translation: Oh. Yün toplarini toplamak nasil gidiyor?

english: How many more do I need to give you?
translation: Sana daha kac tane vermem gerekiyor?

english: You need to collect 20 more balls of wool.
I haven't got any at the moment.
Ah well at least you haven't been eaten. You know what you're doing, right?
translation: En azindan yenilmemissin. Ne yapacagini biliyorsun, degil mi?

english: How do I shear sheep, again?
Well, you're half way there already! You have a set of shears in your inventory. Just use those on a Sheep to shear it.
translation: Zaten yarisini halletmissin! Envanterinde bir makas var. Onu koyun üzerinde kullanarak kirk.

english: That's all I have to do?
Well once you've collected some wool you'll need to spin it into balls.
translation: Yünü topladiktan sonra onu top haline getirmen gerekecek.

english: Yes, I know how to spin wool.
Great!
Remind me how to spin wool.
Yeah, I think so.
You can get to it, then!
I've got some wool. I've not managed to make it into a ball though.
translation: Biraz yünüm var. Ama henüz top haline getiremedim.

english: Well go find a spinning wheel then. You can find one on the first floor of Lumbridge Castle, just walk east on the road outside my house and you'll find Lumbridge.
translation: O zaman bir egirme carki bul. Lumbridge Kalesi'nin birinci katinda bulabilirsin, evimin önündeki yoldan doguya dogru yürürsen Lumbridge'e ulasirsin.

english: I have some.
Give 'em here then.
That's all I've got so far.
translation: Su ana kadar elimde olanlarin hepsi bu.

english: I need [1..19] more before I can pay you.
translation: Sana ödeme yapabilmem icin [1..19] tane daha lazim.

english: Ok I'll work on it.
I need [#] more before I can pay you.
translation: Sana ödeme yapabilmem icin [#] tane daha lazim.

english: That's the last of them.
I guess I'd better pay you then.
translation: O zaman sana ödeme yapayim bari.

english: Quest complete!
I'm looking for something to kill.
I'm lost.
Fred! Fred! I've seen The Thing!
I'm looking for a quest.
Yes.
No.
How do I shear sheep, again?
Yes, I know how to spin wool.
I don't know how to spin wool, sorry.
Remind me how to spin wool.
Yeah, I think so.
I need to talk to you about shearing these sheep!
translation: Bu koyunlari kirpmakla ilgili seninle konusmam lazim!

english: I cannot speak to you outerlander! Talk to Brundt, the Chieftain!
translation: Seninle konusamam yabanci! Sef Brundt ile konus!

english: You stay away from me outerlander!
They are too suspicious of you for you to get close enough to steal from them.
translation: Sana karsi cok süpheci davraniyorlar, onlara yaklasip hirsizlik yapamazsin.

english: Hello, are you a member of the council?
I am afraid not outerlander. Goodbye.
translation: Korkarim ki degilim yabanci. Hosca kal.

english: Hello.
Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: Merhaba kardesim Dokrak. Bugün benden ne istiyorsun? Her zaman yardimima güvenebilirsin!

english: Nothing thanks. I just fancied a chat.
translation: Hicbir sey, tesekkürler. Sadece sohbet etmek istedim.

english: My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
translation: Yardimima ihtiyacin olursa kapim her zaman acik Dokrak.

english: [Fremennik name]... It has been too long since last we met!
translation: Dokrak... Son görüsmemizden bu yana cok zaman gecti!

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: Hos geldin kardesim Dokrak. Seni burada görmek her zaman bir zevk!

english: My apologies [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: Özür dilerim kardesim Dokrak! Burada seninle vakit gecirecek vaktim yok!

english: That's okay, I didn't really want anything.
translation: Sorun degil, aslinda bir sey istememistim.

english: How are you [Fremennik name]? I hope all fares well with you this day!
translation: Nasilsin Dokrak? Umarim bugün her sey yolundadir!

english: I'm fine, thanks, how are you?
All is well with me also!
Hello to you, too!
Hello. Did you want something [Fremennik name]?
translation: Merhaba. Bir sey mi istiyordun Dokrak?

english: No, not really.
Well... okay then!
Always good to see you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].
translation: Seni görmek her zaman güzel kardesim Dokrak.

english: You shame us, [Fremennik name]!
How can you steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
You have betrayed your heritage, [Fremennik name]!
Why would you try to steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
Hello!
Well met, adventurer.
Who are you?
I'm Freja, the Kyattess of the Fremennik Province. Who are you?
translation: Ben Freja, Fremennik Eyaleti'nin Kyattess'i. Sen kimsin?

english: Oh me? I'm [player name], an adventurer... I guess.
translation: Ben mi? Ben Maceraci, bir maceraperestim... Sanirim.

english: You must have done something impressive to gain entry here.
translation: Buraya girmek icin etkileyici bir sey yapmis olmalisin.

english: I may have killed some dragons.
Ah, fantastic! I've yet to face one myself, but I look forward to the challenge.
translation: Ah, harika! Henüz kendim bir ejderhayla karsilasmadim, ama bu mücadeleyi sabirsizlikla bekliyorum.

english: What grand feats are you known for?
Much like you, I have a book or two detailing such things, but it seems to have gone walkabouts.
translation: Senin gibi, ben de bu tür seyleri anlatan bir iki kitabim var, ama kaybolmus gibiler.

english: Anything particularly interesting?
translation: Özellikle ilginc bir sey var mi?

english: All of it is incredibly interesting! I slew the great Smolodin Kyatt that plagued the province for many years!
translation: Hepsi inanilmaz derecede ilginc! Yillardir eyaleti rahatsiz eden büyük Smolodin Kyatt'i öldürdüm!

english: I retrieved the crown of many heads from the bottomless snake pit! I hunted the silver stag of the western provinces!
translation: Dipsiz yilan cukurundan bircok kafadan olusan taci geri aldim! Bati eyaletlerinin gümüs geyigini avladim!

english: None of that sounds at all boring. I look forward to finding your book.
translation: Hicbiri sikici gelmiyor. Kitabini bulmayi sabirsizlikla bekliyorum.

english: Funny you should mention boars. I'm currently hunting one... well, I was...
translation: Domuzlardan bahsetmen ilginc. Su anda bir tanesini avliyorum... yani, avliyordum...

english: Why are you here?
My current quest took me to Acheron, a horribly bitter northern territory, in search for this famous boar. As big as a hut, so the songs say.
translation: Su anki görevim beni, bu ünlü domuzu aramak icin korkunc derecede acimasiz bir kuzey bölgesi olan Acheron'a getirdi. Sarkilarda söylendigi gibi, bir kulübe kadar büyük.

english: Anyway, my companions all met a rather grizzly end, so I guess I'm looking for new ones.
translation: Her neyse, arkadaslarimin hepsi oldukca korkunc bir sonla karsilasti, bu yüzden sanirim yeni arkadaslar ariyorum.

english: Take me! I'm great.
Ha! You're very new here. You've certainly proved you are a worthy hero, but I'd rather someone with a few more years behind them.
translation: Ha! Sen buraya yeni geldin. Degerli bir kahraman oldugunu kanitladin, ama ben birkac yil daha tecrübesi olan birini tercih ederim.

english: What? I've literally defeated a group of dragons that threatened to kill everyone, I think I'm ready for a boar hunt.
translation: Ne? Herkesi öldürmekle tehdit eden bir grup ejderhayi yendim, bence domuz avina hazirim.

english: Hmm... When it comes time for me to venture back to the Isle of Garmr, I'll consider inviting you.
translation: Hmm... Garmr Adasi'na geri dönme zamani geldiginde, seni davet etmeyi düsünecegim.

english: Bye!
I'll see you around.
Ah, so you've found my latest donation to the guild. What do you think? Spooky, isn't it?
translation: Ah, guild'e yaptigim son bagisi bulmussun. Ne düsünüyorsun? Ürkütücü, degil mi?

english: Just a bit. Is this the original text? It doesn't look that old...
translation: Birazcik. Bu orijinal metin mi? O kadar eski görünmüyor...

english: Oh Guthix, no! These texts were inscribed in rock paper in a tome even I struggled to lift. The writer left it there as a warning, and I assume they didn't want it to be moved.
translation: Oh Guthix, hayir! Bu metinler, benim bile kaldirmakta zorlandigim bir kitapta kaya kagidina yazilmisti. Yazar onu bir uyari olarak oraya birakmis ve sanirim tasinmasini istememisti.

english: Did you translate it?
I certainly tried... Perhaps there are some date inconsistencies and a few words I had to guess at. I'd found a lot of scrolls detailing trade with early Fremennik tribes too, which certainly helped.
translation: Denemedim degil... Belki bazi tarih tutarsizliklari ve tahmin etmek zorunda kaldigim birkac kelime var. Erken dönem Fremennik kabileleriyle ticareti detaylandiran bircok parsömen de buldum, bu da kesinlikle yardimci oldu.

english: Imcandoria... Do you think that's where the Imcando dwarves originate?
translation: Imcandoria... Imcando cücelerinin kökeninin orasi oldugunu mu düsünüyorsun?

english: It certainly seems reasonable.
Interesting...
Who are you?
What grand feats are you known for?
Why are you here?
Bye!
Would you like to buy some cooking equipment?
translation: Yemek pisirme ekipmani satin almak ister misin?

english: No thank you.
Yes please.
No thank you.
I cannot speak to you outerlander! Talk to Brundt, the Chieftain!
translation: Seninle konusamam yabanci! Sef Brundt ile konus!

english: Hello, are you a member of the council?
I am afraid not outerlander. Goodbye.
Hello.
Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: Merhaba kardesim Dokrak. Bugün benden ne istiyorsun? Her zaman yardimima güvenebilirsin!

Well... okay then!

english: How are you today?
**sigh**

I'll leave you to your sighing. It looks like you have plenty to do.

english: It's a bit grey round here, isn't it?

english: That's grey-t.
That attempt at humour merely made me more depressed. Leave me alone.

english: How's the King treating you then?
Like serfs.
Serf?
Yes, you know - peons, plebs, the downtrodden. He treats us like his own personal possessions.
translation: Evet, bilirsin - isci, pleb, ezilenler. Bizi kendi kisisel mülkiyeti gibi görüyor.

english: You should leave this place.
I keep trying to save up enough to leave, but the King keeps taxing us! We have no money left.

english: Oh dear.
Cheer up! It's not the end of the world.
I'd prefer that, if it meant I didn't have to talk to people as inanely happy as you.
translation: Senin gibi aptalca mutlu insanlarla konusmak zorunda kalmayacaksam, bunu tercih ederim.

english: Whoa! I think you need to get out more.

english: Worst. Bard. EVER.
Please, ye gods! Make it stop!
If you stopped singing

english: My grandmother could do better, and she is dead!
translation: Büyükannem bile daha iyisini yapardi, o da öldü!

Excellent!

See you there in a moment.
Rinder, Eggus Manus, Glanton, and the player arrive on the stage.
translation: Rinder, Eggus Manus, Glanton ve oyuncu sahneye cikar.

english: Wonderful, we're all here!
Let's see what you've got then.
This should be interesting.
You first, Glanton!
Aw heck.
From the top! First verse! And a one two three!
translation: Bastan! Ilk kitadan! Bir, iki, üc!

english: Oh lordy, uh..
When the foeman bares his.. peels?
TARANTA-RA TARANTA-RA!
We, dun dun dun, er...
I don't know this! I do not know this one!
For goodness sake.
That wasn't very Easter-ey.
No, it wasn't.
Oh come on, it's an old standard!
translation: Oh hadi ama, bu eski bir standart!

english: I don't even know what a foeman is!
Could we try something else?
Well I don't have anything to hand, but you're welcome to have a look backstage.
translation: Elimde baska bir sey yok, ama sahne arkasina bakabilirsin.

english: Backstage eh? Alright.
Rinder, Eggus Manus, and Glanton leave the stage.
translation: Rinder, Eggus Manus ve Glanton sahneden ayrilir.

english: You should have a look backstage to see if there's anything that could help with the performance.
translation: Sahne arkasina bakip performansa yardimci olabilecek bir sey var mi diye bakmalisin.

english: Have you found anything useful backstage yet?
translation: Sahne arkasinda yararli bir sey buldun mu?

english: Not yet.
Well get to it then!
In my own time.
I found some old costumes we can use.
Oh that's great, but we'll need more than just costumes to wow the audience.
translation: Oh, bu harika, ama seyirciyi etkilemek icin kostümlerden daha fazlasina ihtiyacimiz var.

english: We need some material to perform!
translation: Performans icin bazi malzemelere ihtiyacimiz var!

english: True, I'll have another look.
I've found an old script, but I haven't read it yet.
translation: Eski bir senaryo buldum, ama henüz okumadim.

english: Well perhaps you should read it?
I suppose I should.
I've found an old script and some carrot costumes!
translation: Eski bir senaryo ve havuc kostümleri buldum!

english: An old script eh? Is it any good?
translation: Eski bir senaryo mu? Iyi mi?

english: I would show you but I seem to have misplaced it, I'll go and find it again.
translation: Sana gösterirdim ama kaybolmus galiba, gidip tekrar bulayim.

english: You silly sausage!
You tell me, here have a look. It seems like it's all out of order.
translation: Sen söyle, bir bak. Her sey karisik gibi görünüyor.

english: Well this is very interesting! Though I'm not sure how it would have been put together originally.
translation: Bu cok ilginc! Ama orijinalinde nasil bir araya getirilmisti, emin degilim.

english: In any case, it's definitely got the spirit of Easter written into it. Carrot costumes should suit this well.
translation: Her halükarda, icinde kesinlikle Paskalya ruhu var. Havuc kostümleri buna cok yakisir.

english: I think we can use this, though the page order will need reviewing. Can you work out something good?
translation: Bence bunu kullanabiliriz, ama sayfa sirasini gözden gecirmemiz gerekecek. Iyi bir sey bulabilir misin?

english: I can give it a go if you wash those disgusting carrot costumes.
translation: O igrenc havuc kostümlerini yikarsan deneyecegim.

english: Wonderful, bring it to me once you're done and we shall get cracking! In the meantime, I'll get those costumes cleaned.
translation: Harika, bitirince bana getir, hemen ise koyulalim! Bu arada, ben kostümleri temizleteyim.

english: How is that script looking? Have you sorted it out yet?
It looks good to me, let's put on the performance!
translation: Bana iyi görünüyor, hadi gösteriyi yapalim!

english: Wonderful! I shall inform our colleagues, and fetch the Easter Bunny.
translation: Harika! Meslektaslarimiza haber verecegim ve Paskalya Tavsanini getirecegim.

english: See you after the show.
Cutscene: "Dance time."
That was amazing!
So much Easter energy! Wow!
translation: Ne kadar da Paskalya enerjisi var! Vay canina!

english: The cutscene ends.
That dance was amazing! Well done. I feel so... Invigorated!
translation: Dans harikaydi! Aferin. Kendimi cok... Canlanmis hissediyorum!

english: How could I ever lose my Easter spirit?
Sometimes you just need a break.
That's true. Thanks, [player name].
I'm glad you're feeling better.
Lawks! Look at the time, I should get back to Varrock to set up the Eggs!
translation: Hay aksi! Saate bak, Varrock'a dönüp yumurtalari hazirlamam lazim!

english: See you up there!
I'm not finished yet.
Good job putting that script in order, I think that went well!
translation: Senaryoyu düzene soktugun icin tebrikler, bence iyi gitti!

english: I couldn't help overhearing that you're trying to cheer up the Easter Bunny, and I have an idea.
translation: Paskalya Tavsanini neselendirmeye calistigini duydum ve bir fikrim var.

english: We are the Easter carrots! Carrots!
Orange and full of the joys of spring!
Easter is here, it's time to frolic!
Watch us carrots do our thing!
Woo!
Orange, rooty, nice and juicy!
translation: Turuncu, kökü olan, güzel ve sulu!

english: Pop out of the ground and then we sing!
Whilst sun is warm we dance about!
Easter joy we hope to bring!
I'm finished with the script.
The script isn't ready yet.
What can I do for you, traveller?
Let's see what you've got.
I don't want to talk about my pleasure.
Ah, you sound like a human who's not been drinking yet. Would you like to start now?
translation: Ah, henüz icmemis bir insan gibi konusuyorsun. Simdi icmeye baslamak ister misin?

english: Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: Burada herhangi bir söylenti duydun mu?

english: Apparently Veos is looking for some help with something. He hangs around the docks of Port Piscarilius.
translation: Görünüse göre Veos bir konuda yardim ariyor. Port Piscarilius limaninda takiliyor.

english: They say there's trouble in Port Piscarilius. Something about gangs uniting. Might be worth looking into.
translation: Port Piscarilius'ta sorunlar oldugunu söylüyorlar. Cetelerin birlestigi ile ilgili bir sey. Arastirmaya deger olabilir.

english: I hear that Lord Hosidius has misplaced one of his sons. The Hosidius family might pay a lot to see him returned safely.
translation: Lord Hosidius'un ogullarindan birini kaybettigini duydum. Hosidius ailesi, oglunun sag salim geri dönmesi icin cok para ödeyebilir.

english: Phileas Rimor has supposedly been looking for some assistance with something in Shayzien. Maybe worth investigating.
