translation: Phileas Rimor'un Shayzien'de bir konuda yardim aradigi söyleniyor. Arastirmaya deger olabilir.

english: I hear that the rulers of Lovakengj have some work available. You'll find them in the Lovakengj Assembly.
translation: Lovakengj'in yöneticilerinin bazi isleri oldugunu duydum. Onlari Lovakengj Meclisi'nde bulabilirsin.

english: Apparently there's been some commotion in the middle of Arceuus. Might be worth checking out.
translation: Görünüse göre Arceuus'un ortasinda bir kargasa var. Bir göz atmaya deger olabilir.

english: That protest outside Kourend Castle is starting to attract some attention. Could be worth taking a look.
translation: Kourend Kalesi'nin disindaki protesto dikkat cekmeye basladi. Bir göz atmaya deger olabilir.

english: No, it hasn't been very busy lately.
translation: Hayir, son zamanlarda cok yogun degildi.

english: I'm alright, thank you.
Let's see what you've got.
I don't want to talk about my pleasure.
I'm alright, thank you.
Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: Burada herhangi bir söylenti duydun mu?

english: Good day, sir.
What are you doing down here?
I'm waiting for my shift, of course. We can't dig all the time, you know.
translation: Tabii ki vardiyami bekliyorum. Sürekli kazi yapamayiz, biliyorsun.

english: I'm also researching the links between the Fremenniks and the Dwarves.
translation: Ayrica Fremennikler ve Cüceler arasindaki baglantilari arastiriyorum.

english: I've found that we have some mythology in common.
Good day.
What are you doing down here?
Good day.
Hey there.
Yes please! How many do you have?
How many what?
I'll take the lot!
Right...
Hello! I've had a few to drink!
I haven't had that many, have I?
translation: O kadar cok icmedim, degil mi?

english: 'Oh there once was a dwarf named Tonalo! He started a fight with a buffalo!'
translation: “Bir zamanlar Tonalo adinda bir cüce vardi! Bir bufalo ile kavga etmeye basladi!”

english: What?
'He kicked and he punched, it was quite the show! But he tripped on a rock and stubbed his toe!'
translation: “Tekmeledi ve yumrukladi, tam bir gösteriydi! Ama bir kayaya takilip parmagini incitti!”

english: What? I didn't even do it!
Hello there. Want to trade some furs?
translation: Merhaba. Kürk takasi yapmak ister misin?

english: Yes please.
What furs do you have?
I have a selection of both rare and common furs from all across the kingdom. Also, if you happen to have any furs you've brought from the east, I'd be pretty keen to buy some.
translation: Kralligin dört bir yanindan nadir ve yaygin kürklerden olusan bir koleksiyonum var. Ayrica, dogudan getirdiginiz kürkleriniz varsa, satin almak isterim.

english: So, want to trade?
No thanks.
Tetamo! If you change your mind, you know where to find me.
translation: Tetamo! Fikrinizi degistirirseniz, beni nerede bulacaginizi biliyorsunuz.

english: You're the one who stole from me! Guards! Guards!
Yes please.
What furs do you have?
No thanks.
Would you like to trade in fur?
No thanks.
Yes please.
No thanks.
I don't sell to outerlanders.
Only Fremenniks may purchase furs here.
translation: Burada sadece Fremennikler kürk satin alabilir.

english: Welcome back [Fremennik name]! Have you seen the furs I have today?
translation: Hos geldin Dokrak! Bugün getirdigim kürkleri gördün mü?

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
You think me stupid [Fremennik name]?
Guardsguards!
You're the one who stole something from me!
You's better talk to Dad, We not talk to wierdly 'umans.
translation: Babanla konussan iyi olur, biz garip insanlarla konusmayiz.

english: Thanks for da chompy, it was deloverly!
Human done good!
Hello there. What are you doing here?
I'm waiting here hoping that someone can guide me to the Paterdomus, the temple on the Salve.
translation: Biri beni Salve'deki Paterdomus tapinagina götürür diye burada bekliyorum.

english: Where is Paterdomus?
Oh, Paterdomus is that rather impressive looking temple on the Salve... I'm sure you must have passed it on your way into Morytania.
translation: Paterdomus, Salve'deki oldukca etkileyici görünümlü tapinak... Morytania'ya giderken oradan gecmis olmalisin.

english: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
I'm hoping to get back to civilisation and see what the lands of Misthalin look like.
translation: Medeniyete geri dönüp Misthalin topraklarinin nasil bir yer oldugunu görmek istiyorum.

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Paterdomus?
translation: Paterdomus'a giderken yol üzerinde düsmanlarla karsilasirsak kendini savunabilir misin?

english: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of bad guys. You don't need to worry about that.
translation: Diyelim ki biraz tecrübeliyim ve kötü adamlarla savasmaktan cekinmem. Bu konuda endiselenmenize gerek yok.

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: Hmmm, görünüse göre bir takipciniz var. Kendi basina dolasmaya birakilirsa bu yolculukta kaybolabilir. Takipciniz güvende oldugunda yola cikalim.

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: Gercekten mi? Bu harika olur! Hedefe vardigimizda sana kücük bir ödül verecegim.

english: Temple Trekking begins
Ok, which route should we take?
Ok, thanks.
Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: Ah, bana biraz erzak vermek istiyorsun, ha? Sirt cantami acayim.

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than staying in Burgh de Rott.
translation: Oh, bu yolculuktan nefret ediyorum, ama Burgh de Rott'ta kalmaktan iyidir.

english: It's scary here...let's get going!
When are we going to get to Paterdomus?
We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on.
translation: Bütün gün burada durup sohbet edemeyiz, hadi devam edelim.

english: Do you visit Paterdomus often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: Paterdomus'a sik sik gider misin? Rotayi iyi biliyorsun gibi görünüyor.

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...?
Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Burgh de Rott. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: Hay aksi! Görünüse göre Burgh de Rott'a geri dönmek zorunda kalacagiz. O köprüden gecemeyiz!

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
Player completes the bridge event
Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Burgh de Rott.
translation: Bu is bitti... Görünüse göre bu batakliktan gecemeyecegiz. Burgh de Rott'a geri dönmek zorundayiz.

english: Player completes the bog event
Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: Hey... bu harika... harika bir is cikardin... Seni takip edecegim.

english: Whahay...that was great!
But we really should be heading off now.
Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
Player completes the river event
That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: Bu harika! Ben de aynisini yapmaliyim.

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: Vay canina! Harikaydi! Ama artik gercekten yola cikmaliyiz.

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
This is scary!
Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
Ahhh, two tentacles!
...three tentacles!
I think I'm going to faint!
Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: Vay canina! Su canavara bak! O seyi kendi basina halletmen gerekecek!

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the temple. Here's your reward.
translation: Beni tapinaga güvenle ulastirdigin icin cok tesekkürler. Iste ödülün.

english: Where is Paterdomus?
Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
I can take you to Paterdomus.
Ok, thanks.
Get out of my office! We WILL have our revenge, human!
Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: Hazir yemekler maalesef ise yaramaz. Aluft Aloft'un müsterileri icin sadece el yapimi Gnome mutfagi yeterince iyidir.

english: You hand over your delivery of [item] to G.L.O. Caranock
Just hand over the order human.
You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: Bunu bana ulastirmak icin uzun bir yol kat etmis olmalisin. Iste bahsis olarak kücük bir ekstra.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.'dan ücretsiz teslimat jetonunuzu almayi unutmayin.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: Teslimatiniz cok gec! Aluft jnr.'a geri dönüp baska bir siparis alin. Artik ihtiyaciniz olmadigi icin teslimat kutunuzu atiyorsunuz.

english: Welcome to GPDT!
Thank you very much.
So, when are you going to deliver this crate?
translation: Peki, bu sandigi ne zaman teslim edeceksiniz?

english: Well... I guess we could do it now...
Thank you, it's interesting in here.
We're the premier delivery service in ALL of Gielinor!
translation: Biz Gielinor'un en iyi teslimat hizmetiyiz!

english: So, when are you going to deliver this crate?
translation: Peki, bu sandigi ne zaman teslim edeceksiniz?

english: Thank you, it's interesting in here.
What do you do here?
Not much really... I run a local shop which earns me a few trading sticks, but that's about it. I keep myself to myself really.
translation: Aslinda pek bir sey yapmiyorum... Bana birkac ticaret cubugu kazandiran yerel bir dükkan isletiyorum, hepsi bu kadar. Kendime ait bir hayat sürüyorum.

english: What are trading sticks?
They're the local currency Bwana, it's used in Tai Bwo Wannai, there's usually some odd jobs that need doing around the village which you could do to earn some trading sticks.
translation: Yerel para birimi Bwana, Tai Bwo Wannai'de kullaniliyor. Köyde genellikle yapilmasi gereken bazi ufak tefek isler var, bunlari yaparak ticaret cubuklari kazanabilirsiniz.

english: Or, if you have something which the local villagers might like, you could sell it to me and I'll pay you for it in trading sticks.
translation: Ya da, yerel köylülerin hosuna gidebilecek bir seyin varsa, onu bana satabilirsin ve ben de sana ticaret cubuklariyla ödeme yaparim.

english: What sort of things do the local villagers like?
translation: Yerel köylüler ne tür seyleri sever?

english: Gnome cocktails! It's amazing but we all just love them! Luckily I've managed to get stocks of the gnome made cocktails and I supply those to my favourite customers. However, many of the customers really like the cocktails
translation: Gnome kokteylleri! Inanilmaz ama hepimiz onlari cok seviyoruz! Sansliyim ki gnome kokteylleri stoklayabildim ve bunlari en sevdigim müsterilere satiyorum. Ancak, bircok müsteri buradan gecen maceracilarin yaptigi kokteylleri

english: made by the adventurers passing through this way. If you ever happen to have any, bring them my way! I'll give you a good deal on it that's for sure!
translation: gercekten cok seviyor. Eger elinde varsa, bana getir! Sana iyi bir fiyat verecegim, emin olabilirsin!

english: How did the villagers ever get to try any gnome cocktails?

I think it was that gnome pilot who crashed his glider, perhaps he had a little mini-bar on board? Come to think about it, you'd expect the little guy to get his stuff together and move on out of here wouldn't you? He
translation: Sanirim planörünü düsüren gnome pilotuydu, belki de ucaginda kücük bir mini bar vardi? Düsününce, o kücük adamin esyalarini toplayip buradan ayrilmasi gerekirdi, degil mi?

english: must love the jungle to have stayed here so long!
translation: Bu kadar uzun süre burada kalmissa, ormani cok seviyor olmali!

english: You run a shop?
Yes, it's the Tai Bwo cooperative... catchy name huh! We sell a few local village trinkets and tools. Also, there are a few items that we're actually looking to stock for the locals' sake.
translation: Evet, Tai Bwo kooperatifi... Akilda kalici bir isim, degil mi? Yerel köylerden gelen birkac biblo ve alet satiyoruz. Ayrica, yerliler icin stoklamak istedigimiz birkac ürün var.

english: If you happen across any of them please bring them to me, I'll pay a good price for them. I'm sure you'll find the prices very reasonable.
translation: Eger bunlardan herhangi birine rastlarsan lütfen bana getir, iyi bir fiyat öderim. Fiyatlarin cok makul oldugunu göreceksin.

english: Can I take a look at what you have to sell?
Sure you can...which shop would you like to see? The Cooperative or Drinks store?
translation: Tabii ki... hangi dükkani görmek istersin? Kooperatifi mi, icecek dükkanini mi?

english: None thanks...
Why do you only take one sort of Gnome cocktail?
translation: Neden sadece bir tür Gnome kokteyli aliyorsun?

english: It's funny that actually. I've managed to get a good deal with the pilot of that gnome glider. He can supply me directly now. However, it's really interesting that the local villagers really like the gnome cocktails made by the
translation: Aslinda bu cok komik. O cüce planörün pilotuyla iyi bir anlasma yaptim. Artik bana dogrudan tedarik edebiliyor. Ancak, buradan gecen maceracilarin yaptigi cüce kokteyllerini yerel köylüler cok seviyor olmasi gercekten ilginc.

english: adventurers passing through this way.
Why, what's the difference?

I think it may just be that they're made fresher, or there is a slight twist in the flavour of the drink, you know, a little more of this, a little less of that, it all adds up and makes for an interesting tipple!
translation: Sanirim daha taze yapiliyorlar ya da icecegin tadinda hafif bir farklilik var, bilirsin, biraz daha fazla sundan, biraz daha az bundan, hepsi bir araya gelip ilginc bir icki olusturuyor!

english: I want to ask another question.
Sure, what do you want to ask?
Is there anything interesting to do around here?
translation: Buralarda ilginc bir sey var mi?

english: Sorry Bwana, I'm already busy, why not go and talk to Murcaily! He's around the village somewhere.
translation: Üzgünüm Bwana, ben mesgulüm, neden Murcaily ile konusmuyorsun? Köyün buralarinda bir yerlerde.

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
Yeah, you've been doing a lot of good work around here. Let me give you something for your time and effort.
translation: Evet, burada cok iyi isler yapiyorsun. Zamanin ve emeklerin icin sana bir sey vereyim.

english: You get [amount] trading sticks. You are left with [amount]% favour.
I've already given you some trading sticks and I don't have any more on me at the moment. Why not go and talk to some of the other villagers and get some contributions?
translation: Sana zaten bazi ticaret cubuklari verdim ve su anda üzerimde baska yok. Neden gidip diger köylülerle konusup biraz katki almiyorsun?

english: Ok, thanks.
Hey there. If you can solve a question for me then you can move on.
translation: Merhaba. Benim icin bir soruyu cözersen devam edebilirsin.

english: What is the question?
Here, I wrote it down for you.
Gabooty has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Gabooty sana bir meydan okuma parsömeni verdi!

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
Wrong answer!
Sounds right!
Gabooty has given you another clue scroll!
translation: Gabooty sana baska bir ipucu parsömeni verdi!

english: Can you open the shop please?
What do you do here?
What are trading sticks?
What sort of things do the local villagers like?
translation: Yerel köylüler ne tür seyleri sever?

english: You run a shop?
I want to ask another question.
Ok, thanks.
Can I take a look at what you have to sell?
The Cooperative
The Drinks Store
None thanks...
Why do you only take one sort of Gnome cocktail?
translation: Neden sadece bir tür Gnome kokteyli aliyorsun?

english: Ok, thanks
Is there anything interesting to do here?
translation: Burada ilginc bir sey var mi?

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: Hey, kahraman! Vay canina! Sen harikasin, o iki juvinate ve Gadderank'i nasil alt ettin? Ve kasaba cok güzel, harika bir is cikarmissin!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
I'm Gabriela, I'm looking after my husband who isn't feeling too well!
translation: Ben Gabriela, kendini pek iyi hissetmeyen kocama bakiyorum!

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: Oh, pek bir sey yok, hepimiz hala vampirlerden saklaniyoruz ve bu korkunc yerden gecimimizi sagliyoruz, umarim yakinda Salve'deki tapinaga yolculuk yapacak kadar gücleniriz.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: Bildigim kadariyla yok, su anda cok yararli olan bazi temel olanaklara sahibiz, hepimiz size cok minnettariz. Daha önce hic bir kahraman görmedim veya tanimadim, bu yüzden karsilastirma yapabilecegim bir sey yok, ama sanirim

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: cogu insanin görüsüne göre, siz bir kahramansiniz! Ben sahsen sizinle tanistigima cok memnunum.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Ok, thanks.
Welcome to the Mining Guild. My name's Gadrin and I'm the Guildmaster. Can I help you with anything?
translation: Madencilik Loncasina hos geldiniz. Benim adim Gadrin ve ben Lonca Ustasiyim. Size yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: All sorts of things! There's plenty of coal rocks along with some iron, mithril and adamantite as well.
translation: Her türlü konuda! Burada bol miktarda kömür kayasi, demir, mitril ve adamantit var.

english: Deeper in the guild you'll find even more rocks including some runite! The best bit though is our amethyst mine, the only one in the land!
translation: Loncanin daha derinlerinde, runit de dahil olmak üzere daha fazla kaya bulacaksin! En iyisi ise, bu topraklardaki tek ametist madenimiz!

english: There's no better mining site anywhere!
translation: Daha iyi bir maden sahasi yok!

english: What do you dwarves do with the ore you mine?
translation: Siz cüceler, cikardiginiz cevherle ne yapiyorsunuz?

english: What do you think? We smelt it into bars, smith the metal to make armour and weapons, then we exchange them for goods and services.
translation: Sence ne yapiyoruz? Onu eritip külceler haline getiriyoruz, metalden zirh ve silahlar yapiyoruz, sonra bunlari mal ve hizmetlerle takas ediyoruz.

english: I don't see many dwarves selling armour or weapons here.
translation: Burada zirh veya silah satan cok fazla cüce görmüyorum.

english: No, this is only a mining outpost. We dwarves don't much like to settle in human cities. Most of the ore is carted off to Keldagrim, the great dwarven city. They've got a special blast furnace up there - it makes
translation: Hayir, burasi sadece bir madencilik karakolu. Biz cüceler insan sehirlerine yerlesmeyi pek sevmeyiz. Cevherin cogu büyük cüce sehri Keldagrim'e tasinir. Orada özel bir yüksek firin var, bu da

english: smelting the ore so much easier. There are plenty of dwarven traders working in Keldagrim. Anyway, can I help you with anything else?
translation: cevheri eritmeyi cok daha kolay hale getiriyor. Keldagrim'de calisan cok sayida cüce tüccar var. Her neyse, baska bir konuda yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: Can you tell me about your skillcape?

Sure, this is a Skillcape of Mining. It shows my stature as a master miner! It has all sorts of uses including a skill boost to my Mining skill and a chance of mining extra ores. When you get to level 99 come and talk to
translation: Tabii, bu bir Madencilik Beceri Pelerini. Usta bir madenci oldugumu gösteriyor! Madencilik becerimi artirmanin yani sira ekstra cevher cikarma sansi da dahil olmak üzere bircok faydasi var. 99. seviyeye ulastiginda gelip benimle konus,

english: me and I'll sell you one.
Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: I believe I can buy a Skillcape of Mining from you?
translation: Senden Madencilik Beceri Pelerini satin alabilir miyim?

english: You believe right, miner. You have earned the right to wear one and when you do you'll have a small chance of finding an extra ore, but I'll need 99000 coins from you first.
translation: Dogru düsünüyorsun madenci. Onu takma hakkini kazandin ve taktiginda ekstra cevher bulma sansin olacak, ama önce senden 99.000 sikke almam gerekiyor.

english: Sorry, that's overpriced.
I'm sorry you feel that way; come back if you change your mind.
translation: Öyle düsündügün icin üzgünüm; fikrini degistirirsen tekrar gel.

english: Okay then.
But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: Ama maalesef yanimda yeterince param yok.

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.

Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: Maalesef tüm Skillcapes sadece ücretsiz kapüsonla satiliyor, bu bir beceri promosyonunun parcasi; bir alana bir bedava, bilirsin. Yani sana bir tane satabilmem icin önce envanterinde yer acman gerekiyor.

english: Thanks very much, master miner.
No thanks, I'm fine.
What have you got in the guild?
What do you dwarves do with the ore you mine?
translation: Siz cüceler cikardiginiz cevherle ne yapiyorsunuz?

english: No thanks, I'm fine.
Can you tell me about your skillcape?
Can I buy a Skillcape of Mining from you?
translation: Senden madencilik beceri pelerini satin alabilir miyim?

english: Sorry, that's overpriced.
Okay then.
Welcome to my two-handed sword shop.
translation: Iki elli kilic dükkanima hos geldin.

english: Thanks, but not today.
Very well, but do please call again.
Here you go.
Let's trade.
Thanks, but not today.
Welcome to my home. It's rare for me to have guests! Would you like a cup of tea? I'll just put the kettle on.
translation: Evime hos geldin. Nadiren misafir agirlarim! Bir fincan cay ister misin? Su isiticisini calistirayim.

english: Brother Galahad hangs a kettle over the fire.
translation: Kardes Galahad su isiticisini atesin üzerine asar.

english: Are you any relation to Sir Galahad?
translation: Sir Galahad ile bir akrabaligin var mi?

english: I AM Sir Galahad.
Although I've retired as a Knight, and now live as a solitary monk. Also, I prefer to be known as brother rather than sir now. Half a moment, your cup of tea is ready.
translation: Sövalyelikten emekli oldum ve simdi yalniz bir kesis olarak yasiyorum. Ayrica, artik sir yerine kardes olarak anilmayi tercih ediyorum. Bir dakika, cayiniz hazir.

english: Sir Galahad gives you a cup of tea.
translation: Sir Galahad size bir fincan cay verir.

english: Do you get lonely out here on your own?
translation: Burada tek basina yalnizlik cekiyor musunuz?

english: Sometimes I do, yes. Still not many people to share my solidarity with, as most of the religious men around here are worshippers of Saradomin. Half a moment, your cup of tea is ready.
translation: Bazen evet. Buradaki din adamlarinin cogu Saradomin'e tapanlar oldugu icin, dayanismami paylasacak pek kimse yok. Bir dakika, cayiniz hazir.

english: Are you any relation to Sir Galahad?
translation: Sir Galahad ile bir akrabaliginiz var mi?

english: Do you get lonely here on your own?
translation: Burada yalniz basina yalnizlik cekiyor musun?

english: Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu var. Merhaba, selam, selam...

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: Bu yine de tek bir selam sayilir!

english: Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her türlü sey! Kuleler görülmeye deger harika bir manzara.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmeni tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: Senin kadar cirkin olsaydim, yüzümü halka göstermeye cesaret edemezdim!

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: Oh! Sey... Az önce bir tane yedim de ondan!

english: Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: Hayatina deger veriyorsan bir daha benimle konusma!

english: Get lost!
I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: Sana verecek hicbir seyim yok, birak beni rahat, dilenci.

english: Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
translation: Su anda bununla ugrasacak vaktim yok.

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: Senin gibi zavalli bir et yiginiyla konusmak istemiyorum.

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: Cok kötü bir gün... tadini cikarin.

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: Eger birini yakalarsan, paylasacagina söz ver.

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
You smell familiar...
Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: Buralarda insan gördün mü? Cok acim.

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: Bana kan tadi seven biri gibi görünüyorsun.

english: Good day to you, my friend.
Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
translation: Kaleye gidip atistirmalik bir seyler yemeye ne dersin?

english: Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: Bir saniye izin ver, dislerime bir sey sikismis...

english: Welcome to the vinery, young [man/lady]. Can I help you?
translation: Bagciliga hos geldin, genc . Yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: How do I farm here?
I'm afraid you aren't allowed, dear.
translation: Korkarim ki buna izin yok, canim.

english: Now, can I help you with anything else?
translation: Baska bir sey yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: Let's see... First, you'll need to treat the soil with saltpetre. Dig it into the patch with a trowel. The minerals are good for the fruit.
translation: Bir bakalim... Öncelikle topragi gühercile islemelisin. Kürekle topragi kaz. Mineraller meyveye iyi gelir.

english: Then plant a grape seed, and just let it grow. I'll look after it, so it won't get diseased.
translation: Sonra üzüm cekirdegi ek ve büyümesini bekle. Hastalanmamasi icin ben ilgilenirim.

english: When your grapes are ready, pick them and clear the patch so you can grow a new vine.
translation: Üzümler olgunlastiginda topla ve yeni asma yetistirebilmek icin topragi temizle.

english: Does that seem clear, or would you like help with something else?
translation: Anlasildi mi, yoksa baska bir konuda yardima ihtiyacin var mi?

english: What do you do?
I'm the vintner. I helped Lord Hosidius to develop this land as a vinery, and now it's complete he's put me in charge of production while he works on a new project.
translation: Ben sarap üreticisiyim. Lord Hosidius'un bu araziyi bag olarak gelistirmelerine yardim ettim ve simdi tamamlandiginda, o yeni bir proje üzerinde calisirken beni üretimden sorumlu yapti.

english: His son, young Pandur, works here too. Pandur checks the wine I produce. But if you've got any questions about the farming, don't ask Pandur. Ask me instead. He checks the wine too much.
translation: Oglu, genc Pandur da burada calisiyor. Pandur, ürettigim sarabi kontrol ediyor. Ama tarimla ilgili herhangi bir sorunuz varsa, Pandur'a sormayin. Bana sorun. Sarabi cok fazla kontrol ediyor.

english: So can I help you with anything?
Why are you called Gallow?
It's short for 'Gallows'. When I was young, a boy made some improper suggestions to me, so I grabbed him by his neck and held him in the air until he learnt some manners.
translation: “Gallows”un kisaltmasi. Gencken, bir cocuk bana uygunsuz tekliflerde bulundu, ben de onu boynundan tutup havada tutarak terbiyesini ögrettim.

english: Now, dear, do you need help with the vinery? I'm enjoying the chat, but I have work to do.
translation: Simdi, canim, bagcilikla ilgili yardima ihtiyacin var mi? Sohbet etmek hosuma gidiyor ama yapmam gereken isler var.

english: I'm fine, thanks.
I have a question for you.
Gallow has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Gallow sana bir meydan okuma parsömeni verdi!

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
No, try again.
Correct!
Gallow has given you another clue scroll!
translation: Gallow sana baska bir ipucu parsömeni verdi!

english: You've obtained a casket!
How do I farm here?
What do you do?
Why are you called Gallow?
I'm fine, thanks.
Welcome to the vinery. Can I help you?
translation: Saraphaneye hos geldiniz. Yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: I'm the vintner. I helped the late Lord Hosidius develop this land as a vinery. He put me in charge of production once it was completed.
translation: Ben sarap üreticisiyim. Merhum Lord Hosidius'un bu araziyi saraphaneye dönüstürmesine yardim ettim. Tamamlandiginda üretimden beni sorumlu tuttu.

english: The new Lord Hosidius used to work here as well. He has new duties of course, but that hasn't stopped him coming down to check the wine I produce.
translation: Yeni Lord Hosidius da eskiden burada çalisiyordu. Elbette yeni görevleri var, ama bu onun ürettigim sarabi kontrol etmeye gelmesini engellemiyor.

english: Hello there. How's it going?
Another human? Do what you need to and then be gone from here.
translation: Baska bir insan mi? Yapman gerekeni yap ve sonra buradan git.

english: Every day they let more of your kind in.
translation: Her gün sizin gibileri içeri aliyorlar.

english: Hmph!
I don't talk to you lot.
Not interested!
Good day.
What's so good about it?
What's eating you.
I'm ruined, all because of that stupid cat! It has ruined me.
translation: O aptal kedi yüzünden mahvoldum! Beni mahvetti.

english: Why did it have to get itself killed? Why?
translation: Neden kendini öldürmek zorunda kaldi? Neden?

english: *Aside* I think I should leave him alone. He seems a little upset right now.
translation: *Kenara* Onu yalniz birakmaliyim galiba. Su anda biraz üzgün görünüyor.

english: Hello!
What are you doing here?
Trying to win my shirt back. I lost it last night in a silly bet.
translation: Gömlegimi geri kazanmaya calisiyorum. Dün gece aptalca bir bahiste kaybettim.

english: Well I hope your luck improves. I doubt it can get any worse.
translation: Umarim sansin döner. Daha kötüye gidebilecegini sanmiyorum.

english: Well I've little left to lose, maybe some more hair and my trousers.
translation: Kaybedecek pek bir seyim kalmadi, belki biraz daha sac ve pantolonum.

english: I really think you should try hold on to them.
Hello.
What do you want?
I was just wondering what you were doing here?
I ask myself the same question often.
translation: Ben de kendime sik sik ayni soruyu soruyorum.

english: What am I doing down here in these pits along with these filthy dregs of society?
translation: Bu pis toplum artiklariyla birlikte bu cukurda ne isim var?

english: And do you ever come up with an answer?
Always.
I'm here taking their money, that's what.
translation: Burada onlarin parasini aliyorum, iste bu.

english: Hello! What's going on here?
Just a bit of drinking, a bit of fighting and a few people trying to win big.
translation: Biraz icki, biraz kavga ve birkac kisi büyük kazanmaya calisiyor.

english: Nothing but good clean family fun.
What are you doing?
Nothing much. Just keeping myself occupied, placing a couple of wagers here and there.
translation: Önemli bir sey degil. Kendimi mesgul ediyorum, burada orada birkac bahis yapiyorum.

english: Are you winning?
Yes in the sense that I'm not as bored as I was and no in terms of the number of coins in my purse.
translation: Evet, eskisi kadar sikilmadigim anlaminda, hayir, cüzdanimdaki bozuk para sayisi acisindan.

english: What are you up to?
Trying to win back some money.
Is it going well?
In every bet there is a fool and a thief and I'm beginning to think that I'm not much of a thief.
translation: Her bahiste bir aptal ve bir hirsiz vardir ve ben hirsizlikta pek iyi olmadigimi düsünmeye basliyorum.

english: Having fun. It's such a blast I've already won 5 thousand gold coins today, my cat just keeps winning.
translation: Egleniyorum. Cok eglenceli, bugün simdiden 5 bin altin kazandim, kedim sürekli kazaniyor.

english: So how do these rat pits work?
Things work simply in the Ardougne ratpits.
If you have a kitten and at least 100 coins you can challenge someone else who also has a kitten and some spare change.
translation: Bir yavru kedin ve en az 100 sikkin varsa, baska bir yavru kedisi ve biraz bozuk parasi olan birine meydan okuyabilirsin.

english: That sounds simple enough so far.
You then agree on a wager. It's rumoured that some ratcatchers can talk to their own cats and give them tactics to aid them.
translation: Sonra bir bahis üzerinde anlasirsiniz. Bazi fare avcilarinin kedileriyle konusup onlara yardimci olacak taktikler verdikleri söyleniyor.

english: So then how do you win the challenge?
I was just getting to that. Both the challengers' cats are placed inside the arena, and whichever kills 5 rats first wins.
translation: Tam da oraya geliyordum. Iki rakibin kedileri arenaya yerlestirilir ve ilk 5 fareyi öldüren kazanir.

english: It's simple.
In Varrock if you have a grown cat and a couple of coins you can challenge someone else who also has a grown cat and some spare change.
translation: Varrock'ta yetiskin bir kediniz ve birkac madeni paraniz varsa, yetiskin bir kedisi ve biraz bozuk parasi olan baska birine meydan okuyabilirsiniz.

english: I was just getting to that. Both the challengers' cats are placed inside the arena, and whichever kills 7 rats first wins.
translation: Tam da oraya geliyordum. Iki rakibin kedileri arenaya yerlestirilir ve ilk 7 fareyi öldüren kazanir.

english: The Port Sarim pits are quite fussy, no lazy cats allowed in here.
translation: Port Sarim cukurlari oldukca titizdir, tembel kediler buraya giremez.

english: Lazy cats?
You know if you neglect a wily cat, it gets fat and lazy? Well, they're not allowed to fight in here, only wily cats.
translation: Kurnaz bir kediyi ihmal ederseniz, sismanlayip tembel olur, biliyor musunuz? Burada dövüsmelerine izin verilmez, sadece kurnaz kediler dövüsebilir.

english: I was just getting to that. Both the challengers' cats are placed inside the arena, and whichever kills 11 rats first wins.
translation: Ben de tam oraya geliyordum. Her iki rakibin kedileri de arenaya yerlestirilir ve 11 fareyi ilk öldüren kazanir.

english: That sounds vile and cruel.
translation: Bu cok kötü ve zalimce geliyor.

english: It's a cruel world and the pits are no exception.
translation: Dünya acimasiz bir yer ve cukurlar da buna bir istisna degil.

english: Each to their own, I say.
Thanks for your help.
It sounds a little dangerous for my cat.
translation: Kedim icin biraz tehlikeli gibi geliyor.

english: I agree. Cats have been known to be killed in fights.
Oh how terrible. Is there nothing you can do to save your cat?
translation: Ne kadar korkunc. Kedini kurtarmak icin yapabilecegin hicbir sey yok mu?

english: Of course there is, you can instruct it to be cautious, and it will leave once it feels as if it is in danger.
translation: Tabii ki var, ona dikkatli olmasini söyleyebilirsin, tehlike hissettiginde oradan ayrilacaktir.

english: Oh that sounds quite wise.
That depends on how you value your cat.
translation: Bu, kedinize ne kadar deger verdiginize bagli.

english: Sorry, I don't follow.
Well if your cat dies or it runs away you lose.
So the longer it stays in the fight the better chance you have of winning.
translation: Yani kavgada ne kadar uzun kalirsa, kazanma sansiniz o kadar artar.

english: Wow that sounds like fun!
I don't know about that.
One thing I know though is that it's a quick way to make and lose money.
translation: Bildigim tek sey, bu hizli para kazanmanin ve kaybetmenin bir yolu oldugu.

english: Is there a limit to how much you can bet?
translation: Bahis miktarinda bir sinir var mi?

english: Hmmm... let me think. I don't think that's ever arisen but I think it's 20,000.
translation: Hmmm... bir düsüneyim. Hic böyle bir durum olmadi ama sanirim 20.000.

english: Hmm, that sounds like a silly amount of money to bet on a cat fight.
translation: Hmm, kedi kavgasina bahis yapmak icin sacma bir miktar gibi geliyor.

english: You'd be surprised what some people would be willing to bet.
translation: Bazi insanlarin ne kadar bahis yapmaya razi olduklarini görsen sasirirsin.

english: There is a minimum bet of 100 coins too.
Can I challenge you and your cat?
translation: Sana ve kedine meydan okuyabilir miyim?

english: No, not now, we don't really bet with outsiders.
translation: Hayir, su anda olmaz, biz yabancilarla bahis yapmiyoruz.

english: But I'm not an outsider, am I not inside in the pits now?
translation: Ama ben yabanci degilim, su anda cukurlarin icinde degil miyim?

english: I don't know, maybe once you've done something to win over my trust.
translation: Bilmiyorum, belki güvenimi kazanacak bir sey yaparsan.

english: Can it be bought?
What?
Your trust.
No. Regular townsfolk don't like us, which leads us to distrust them and anyone else.
translation: Hayir. Siradan kasaba halki bizi sevmez, bu da bizim onlara ve diger herkese güvenmememize neden olur.

english: That sounds vile and cruel.
One more thing...
Thanks for your help.
It sounds a little dangerous for my cat.
translation: Kedim icin biraz tehlikeli gibi görünüyor.

english: Wow that sounds like fun.
Is there a limit to how much you can bet?
translation: Bahis miktarinda bir sinir var mi?

english: Can I challenge you and your cat?
translation: Sana ve kedine meydan okuyabilir miyim?

english: Ello there. I'm Gamfred, the engineer in this here guild. Have you seen my catapult?
translation: Merhaba. Ben Gamfred, bu loncanin mühendisiyim. Mancinigimi gördün mü?

english: That's not a catapult, it's a large crossbow.
translation: O mancinik degil, büyük bir tatar yayi.

english: WHAT!? I'll have you know that is the finest piece of dwarven engineering for miles around! How DARE you insult my work!
translation: NE!? Bilmeni isterim ki bu, kilometrelerce cevrede bulunan en iyi cüce mühendisligi eseri! Nasil cüret edersin benim eserimi asagilayabilirsin!

english: Yes, beautiful piece of engineering.
Nice to meet someone who appreciates fine work, have you tried it out yet?
translation: Iyi isleri takdir eden biriyle tanismak güzel, denedin mi?

english: Yes.
What did you think?
It was ok I guess.
Well I guess not everyone will like it.
It was fun!
Glad ta hear it. Try it again sometime. We have more tests to run.
translation: Bunu duyduguma sevindim. Bir ara tekrar dene. Daha yapmamiz gereken testler var.

english: I didn't like it.
Well I guess not everyone will like it. But give it another chance before you go.
translation: Herkesin hosuna gitmeyecegini tahmin ediyordum. Ama gitmeden önce bir sans daha ver.

english: May I have a shield please?
Silly muffin, you have one already!
translation: Aptal sey, zaten bir tane var!

english: I'd be happy ta give you a shield but you've no space for it.
translation: Sana bir kalkan vermek isterdim ama onu koyacak yerin yok.

english: Of course!
The dwarf hands you a large shield.
translation: Cüce sana büyük bir kalkan uzatir.

english: No, how do I do that?
Well ye take the big defence shield in both hands and watch the catapult. My assistant will fire different things at you and you need to defend against them.
translation: Büyük savunma kalkanini iki elinle tut ve mancinigi izle. Asistanim sana farkli seyler firlatacak ve sen bunlara karsi savunma yapmalisin.

english: Sounds boring.
Your loss...
No, where is it?
Are ye blind [lad/lass]? Tis over there in the next room with me assistant working it!
translation: Kör müsün ? Asistanimla birlikte yan odada calisiyoruz!

english: May I claim my tokens please?
You don't have space to carry them.
Of course! Here you go, you've earned [number] token[s]!
Thanks!
I'm afraid you have not earned any tokens yet. Try some of the activities around the guild to earn some.
translation: Maalesef henüz jeton kazanmadin. Kazanmak icin lonca cevresindeki etkinliklerden bazilarini dene.

english: Ok, I'll go see what I can find.
Bye!
Come back soon! My catapult needs more test subjects.
translation: Yakinda tekrar gel! Mancinigim icin daha fazla denek lazim.

english: Watch out! You'll need to equip the shield as soon as you're on the target spot else you could get hit! Speak to me to get one, and make sure both your hands are free to equip it.
translation: Dikkat et! Hedef noktasina ulasir ulasmaz kalkani takman gerekiyor, yoksa vurulabilirsin! Bana gelip bir tane al ve iki elin de serbest oldugundan emin ol.

english: That's not a catapult, it's a large crossbow.
translation: O mancinik degil, büyük bir tatar yayi.

english: Yes, beautiful piece of engineering.
Yes.
It was ok I guess.
It was fun!
I didn't like it.
May I have a shield please?
No, how do I do that?
Sounds boring.
No, where is it?
May I claim my tokens please?
Bye!
Bring some of the heavy squad to carry the crates.
translation: Sandiklari tasimak icin agir silahli bir ekip getir.

english: Get this right and I'll see you're well paid.
translation: Bunu dogru yaparsan iyi para kazanirsin.

english: Handle the explosives carefully.
If the shopkeeper won't cooperate, kill his wife.
translation: Dükkan sahibi isbirligi yapmazsa karisini öldür.

english: If the soldiers try to interfere, kill them.
translation: Askerler müdahale etmeye calisirsa, onlari öldürün.

english: Make sure the captain knows not to talk.
Our ship is due with the evening tide.
Pay attention or I'll rip your throat out.
The boxes marked with a cross are ours.
translation: Üzerinde carpi isareti olan kutular bizim.

english: Weigh the gold carefully in case he double-crosses us.
translation: Bizi aldatmasin diye altini dikkatlice tartin.

english: We're done here.
Die, Shayzien scum!
Got it, boss.
Okay, boss.
Sure thing, boss.
We're on it, boss.
Yes, boss.
You're the boss.
To crime!
Good day to you.
And a good day to you too.
Hi, I am trying to find the cause of the curse on your town.
translation: Merhaba, kasabanizdaki lanetin nedenini bulmaya calisiyorum.

english: What curse is that?
Don't you know? The curse that has stopped your fountain working and made all the water dry up when you bring it back from the river?
translation: Bilmiyor musun? Cesmenizin calismasini durduran ve nehirden getirdiginiz suyu kurutan lanet mi?

english: Ohh that's because of a curse? I didn't think of that.
translation: Ohh, bunun nedeni bir lanet mi? Bunu düsünmemistim.

english: So any ideas about the cause of the curse?
translation: Peki lanetin nedeni hakkinda bir fikrin var mi?

english: Absolutely none.
I heard the people of Nardah threw their statue of Elidinis away.
translation: Nardah halkinin Elidinis heykelini attigini duydum.

english: Did they? What did they want to go and do a thing like that for?
translation: Öyle mi? Neden böyle bir sey yapmislar ki?

english: A Saradominist priest who was staying here told them too.
translation: Burada kalan bir Saradominist rahip onlara öyle söylemis.

english: There was a Saradominist priest here?
translation: Burada bir Saradominist rahip mi vardi?

english: You don't seem to notice much. Do you even live here?
translation: Pek farkinda degilsin galiba. Burada yasiyor musun sen?

english: Yes, I just don't get out that much.
How's life now the curse has been lifted?
It's been lifted? I hadn't realised. I've still been buying water from Ali the Carter!
translation: Kaldirildi mi? Farkinda degildim. Hala Ali the Carter'dan su aliyorum!

english: Be warned human. The Wyrms here are under my protection. I will not let you kill them unless you have permission.
translation: Uyariyorum insan. Buradaki ejderhalar benim korumam altinda. Izin almadan onlari öldürmene izin vermeyecegim.

english: Human! To attack these creatures would be a threat to the balance. Only those with permission may fight them!
translation: Insan! Bu yaratiklara saldirmak dengeyi bozacaktir. Sadece izin alanlar onlarla savasabilir!

english: Do you want to buy some garden plants?
Yes please!
What are these plants for?
For planting in your house's garden, of course!
translation: Tabii ki evinin bahcesine dikmek icin!

english: How do I do that?
The same way you make furniture. You'll find plant hotspots in your garden and you just need to have one of my bagged saplings with you when you build at them.
translation: Mobilya yaparken oldugu gibi. Bahcende bitki yetisen yerleri bulacaksin ve onlari dikerken benim torbali fidanlarimdan birini yaninda bulundurman yeterli.

english: Ah, I see.
So do you want to look at my stock?
No thanks.
Yes please!
What are these plants for?
No thanks
Hello.
Oi'm busy. If tha' wants owt, tha' can go find Wyson. He's ta boss 'round here. And KEEP YER TRAMPIN' FEET ORFF MA' FLOWERS!
translation: Mesgulüm. Bir sey istiyorsan Wyson'i bulabilirsin. Buralarin patronu o. Ve AYAKLARINI CICEKLERIMIN ÜSTÜNDEN CEK!

english: Right...
First moles, now this! Take this, vandal!
translation: Önce köstebekler, simdi de bu! Al sunu, vandal!

english: How are you?
The Headless Gardener's neck twitches at you, but the lack of any head prevents him from speaking.
translation: Bassiz Bahcivan'in boynu sana dogru segiriyor, ama kafasinin olmamasi konusmasini engelliyor.

english: Same as ever, mate, just getting' on with it regardless.
translation: Her zamanki gibi dostum, ne olursa olsun isime devam ediyorum.

english: Good for you...err...mate.
Hello there.
Good day, Your Royal Highness.
Good day. What are you doing?
I'm weeding this herb garden. It's hard work! I also sell a few gardening supplies.
translation: Bu bahcedeki otlari ayikliyorum. Zor bir is! Ayrica birkac bahce malzemesi de satiyorum.

english: Good luck with that.
Thank you, Your Royal Highness.
What do you have for sale?
At the moment I'm selling garden rakes and iron sickles. If you'd like one, Your Royal Highness,
translation: Su anda bahce tirmiklari ve demir orak satiyorum. Isterseniz, Majesteleri.

english: I'd like a rake, please.
Thank you! Here you go.
I'd like an iron sickle, please.
What are iron sickles for?
I can't think of anything just now. But you can buy one if you like, Your Highness!
translation: Su anda aklima bir sey gelmiyor. Ama isterseniz bir tane alabilirsiniz, Majesteleri!

english: No, thank you.
The storerooms are full, your Highness. You should talk to Advisor Ghrim to collect what we've gathered for you.
translation: Depolar dolu, Majesteleri. Danisman Ghrim ile konusup sizin icin topladiklarimizi almalisiniz.

english: Good luck with that.
What do you have for sale?
I'd like a rake, please.
I'd like an iron sickle, please.
translation: Bir demir orak alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: What are iron sickles for?
No, thank you.
Hello.
Go away. Busy.
Busy doing what?
Gardening.
Do you need a hand?
No.
Alright, I was just trying to be helpful. Why are you so angry?
translation: Tamam, sadece yardim etmek istemistim. Neden bu kadar sinirlisin?

english: Too much talk. Flowers don't talk. Flowers good.
translation: Cok konusuyorsun. Cicekler konusmaz. Cicekler iyidir.

english: I'll leave you to it then.
Yous creature doesn't stick mee's chompy, else mee's squeeze creature till yous a deadun!
translation: Senin yaratik benim ceneme yapismazsa, seni sikip öldürürüm!

english: Yous creatures too weedy for da ogre stabby chucker, yous best stick wiv da cluks-cluks.
translation: Senin yaratiklarin ogre bicakcisi icin cok zayif, en iyisi cluks-cluks'la kal.

english: Chompy is bestest yumms...
Me'se can't wait for da chompy yumms...I's dribbling all down me's for da tasty chompy.
translation: Chompy'nin lezzetini sabirsizlikla bekliyorum... Lezzetli chompy icin agzim sulaniyor.

english: Da fatsy toadies geddin' all messy...
Me's gonna ged da pridy chompy hatsies...an looks like a good-un wiv da laydies.
translation: Gururlu chompy sapkalari alacagim... bayanlara yakisacak gibi görünüyor.

english: Mee's scared of Jiggig and da zogries, deyz is not da right dead-uns.
translation: Jiggig ve zogries'ten korkuyorum, onlar dogru ölüler degil.

english: Mee's got no stabbers no more...gonna go home wiv no chompy...
translation: Mee'nin artik bicakcilari yok... Chompy olmadan eve gidecek...

english: I's stickin' da chompy...
De'se stabbers are worser dan a dead dog....
translation: Bu bicakcilar ölü bir köpekten daha kötüdür...

english: Hello?
A fine day you have chosen to visit this hellish island, human.
translation: Bu cehennem gibi adayi ziyaret etmek icin güzel bir gün secmissin, insan.

english: Good day to you too Sergeant. I've been sent by your King Narnode to -
translation: Sana da iyi günler Cavus. Kral Narnode tarafindan gönderildim...

english: Investigate the circumstances surrounding the mysterious disappearance of my squad. Yes, I know.
translation: Ekibimin gizemli kaybolusunu arastirmak icin. Evet, biliyorum.

english: How did you know that?
The King and I are still in communication, albeit sporadic. I decided I need a human of your calibre to assist me. It is pleasing to see you are still alive.
translation: Kral ve ben hala iletisim halindeyiz, ara sira da olsa. Bana yardim etmesi icin senin kalibrede bir insana ihtiyacim olduguna karar verdim. Hala hayatta oldugunu görmek sevindirici.

english: Why do you need a human?
There is more going on than meets your eye, human. Did you not find it strange that an entire squad be sent to decommission a shipyard?
translation: Göründügünden daha fazlasi var, insan. Bütün bir ekibin bir tersaneyi hizmet disi birakmak icin gönderilmesini garip bulmadin mi?

english: Well -
Indeed. But there are more pressing matters at hand. Three of my squad have been captured and placed in the jail. They are watched over by somewhat overpowering guards.
translation: Dogru. Ama daha acil meseleler var. Ekibimden üc kisi yakalanip hapse atildi. Onlari oldukca güclü gardiyanlar gözetliyor.

english: Before we can resume our original mission we must rescue them.
translation: Asil görevimize devam etmeden önce onlari kurtarmaliyiz.

english: I know about the guards - I had to sneak out between the change of shifts.
translation: Muhafizlari biliyorum, vardiya degisimi sirasinda gizlice disari cikmak zorunda kaldim.

english: Trust me; we too have considered this, but whilst it is possible for one, it is near impossible for three.
translation: Inan bana, biz de bunu düsündük, ama bir kisi icin mümkün olsa da, üc kisi icin neredeyse imkansiz.

english: We have considered many things. I have my squad mage and sappers working below us right now. My,  assassin Karam, is operating in the village itself.
translation: Bircok seyi düsündük. Ekibimin büyücüleri ve istihkamcilari su anda bizim altimizda calisiyor. Suikastcim Karam, köyün icinde faaliyet gösteriyor.

english: I remain here so that I may overhear Awowogei's plans.
translation: Awowogei'nin planlarini dinleyebilmek icin burada kaliyorum.

english: Awowogei?
The self-proclaimed ruler of the island. I have been listening to him for some time now. I believe we will incur a minimum of casualties if we have an insider - a monkey working for us.
translation: Adanin kendini ilan eden hükümdari. Bir süredir onu dinliyorum. Iceriden birisi, bizim icin calisan bir maymun olursa, en az kayip verecegimize inaniyorum.

english: Have you seen these monkeys? You could never convince them to work for you!
translation: Bu maymunlari gördün mü? Onlari senin icin calismaya ikna edemezsin!

english: I wasn't suggesting convincing them, human, but you.
translation: Onlari ikna etmeyi önermiyordum, insan, seni ikna etmeyi öneriyordum.

english: Don't be ridiculous! I'm a human - not a monkey!
Do not be so sceptical ... you humans are considered to be quite closely related to monkeys.
translation: Bu kadar süpheci olma... Siz insanlar maymunlarla oldukca yakin akraba sayilirsiniz.

english: Yes, but -
Go and see my squad mage, Zooknock. Tell him I have asked you to be 'disguised' as a monkey so that you may infiltrate the village. As you will see, he is something of an expert on the subject.
translation: Git ve takimimin büyücüsü Zooknock'u gör. Ona, köye sizabilmen icin seni maymun kiligina sokmami istedigimi söyle. Göreceksin ki, o bu konuda bir uzman sayilir.

english: I can't even communicate with the monkeys!
Just go and find my squad mage, human.
translation: Git ve takimimin büyücüsünü bul, insan.

english: Have you spoken to Zooknock about the monkey disguise yet?
translation: Zooknock'la maymun kiligina girme konusunda konustun mu?

english: Yes - I've now made an amulet of monkey speak and a monkey greegree.
translation: Evet, maymun dili konusan bir tilsim ve maymun greegree yaptim.

english: Very good. In a moment, speak to me through your monkey disguise so that I may judge how good it is.
translation: Cok iyi. Birazdan maymun kiligina girip benimle konus, ne kadar iyi oldugunu degerlendireyim.

english: My my, Zooknock has outdone himself this time. You do look very much like a monkey you know.
translation: Vay vay, Zooknock bu sefer kendini asti. Gercekten maymuna cok benziyorsun.

english: I know.
And by happy coincidence you appear to be just the right sort of monkey.
translation: Ve mutlu bir tesadüf eseri, tam da dogru türde bir maymun gibi görünüyorsun.

english: I need you now to seek audience with Awowogei. Claim you are an envoy from the monkeys of Karamja and are seeking an alliance.
translation: Simdi Awowogei ile görüsmen gerekiyor. Karamja maymunlarinin elcisi oldugunu ve ittifak kurmak istedigini söyle.

english: You must win his trust if we are to succeed.
translation: Basarili olmak icin onun güvenini kazanmalisin.

english: Well done on winning Awowogei's trust. I overheard everything from here.
translation: Awowogei'nin güvenini kazanman cok iyi oldu. Buradan her seyi duydum.

english: However, your efforts may be in vain...
What do you mean?
Progress in the caves has been slow. Whilst you were in Ardougne, Bunkwicket and Waymottin overheard a slightly disturbing conversation.
translation: Magaralarda ilerleme yavas. Sen Ardougne'dayken, Bunkwicket ve Waymottin biraz rahatsiz edici bir konusma duymuslar.

english: Who was speaking? What was said?
Listen closely whilst I narrate the details...
What shall we do?
Zooknock and I have come up with a plan.
translation: Zooknock ve ben bir plan yaptik.

english: What kind of a plan?
I hope you were listening closely. The teleportation spell that was provided will teleport ALL of the 10th squad, no matter where we may be.
translation: Umarim dikkatle dinlemissindir. Verilen teleportasyon büyüsü, nerede olursak olalim 10. takimin TÜMÜ'nü teleport edecek.

english: In effect, the spell will break Lumo, Bunkdo and Carado out of the jail for us.
translation: Aslinda, bu büyü Lumo, Bunkdo ve Carado'yu bizim icin hapisten cikaracak.

english: But you will be teleported straight into whatever trap they have prepared!
translation: Ama sen, onlarin hazirladigi tuzaga dogru teleport edileceksin!

english: Indeed. This is where you come in. Do not forget that we are the 10th squad of the Royal Guard, and that we are more than capable of holding our own.
translation: Aynen öyle. Iste burada devreye giriyorsun. Bizim Kraliyet Muhafizlari'nin 10. takimi oldugumuzu ve kendimizi savunabilecek kapasitede oldugumuzu unutma.

english: With your assistance, we should be able to defeat whatever is thrown at us.
translation: Senin yardiminla, karsimiza cikan her seyi yenebilecegiz.

english: But how will I join you?
Simple. We fool the teleportation spell that you are in fact a member of our squad.
translation: Cok basit. Isinlanma büyüsünü, senin aslinda bizim takimimizin bir üyesi olduguna inandiririz.

english: What?
Zooknock knows Glough's grasp of magic well. He believes that spell is linked to the sigils that all of our squad carry.
translation: Zooknock, Glough'un büyü konusundaki bilgisini iyi bilir. O, bu büyünün tüm ekibimizin tasidigi mühürlerle baglantili olduguna inaniyor.

english: It is these sigils that identify us as a member of the squad.
translation: Bu mühürler, bizi ekibin bir üyesi olarak tanimlayan seydir.

english: Garkor hands you some kind of medallion.
translation: Garkor sana bir tür madalyon uzatir.

english: Welcome to the 10th squad, [player name].
What is it?
It is a replica Waymottin has made of our squad sigils. If you wear that when the spell is cast, you will be summoned along with the rest of us.
translation: Waymottin'in takimimizin mühürlerinin bir kopyasi. Büyü yapildiginda bunu takarsan, geri kalanimizla birlikte cagirilacaksin.

english: You should prepare. Collect your thoughts and belongings and then wear the sigil. Hurry, human, we do not wish to enter this fight without you.
translation: Hazirlanmalisin. Düsüncelerini ve esyalarini topla, sonra mührü tak. Acele et insan, bu savasa sensiz girmek istemiyoruz.

english: All I have to do is wear this sigil?
translation: Tek yapmam gereken bu mührü takmak mi?

english: Yes - but do not do so until you are ready.
translation: Evet, ama hazir olana kadar takma.

english: Ready yourself, human: the final battle begins!
translation: Hazir ol insan: son savas basliyor!

english: Stop talking and start fighting!
Well done, human! That was a most impressive display of skill.
translation: Aferin insan! Cok etkileyici bir beceri sergiledin.

english: Thank you.
You should report to King Narnode immediately. Tell him that the 10th squad still survives and has suffered no casualties.
translation: Hemen Kral Narnode'a rapor vermelisin. Ona 10. takimin hala hayatta oldugunu ve kayip vermedigini söyle.

english: Rest assured, I will do so. How do I leave this place?
translation: Merak etme, öyle yapacagim. Buradan nasil cikabilirim?

english: Speak to Zooknock. He will arrange for you to leave.
translation: Zooknock ile konus. O senin cikmani ayarlayacaktir.

english: Greetings, [player name].
Hey Garkor, how's it going?
Very well. Since the 10th squad were recalled from Ape Atoll, King Narnode has named me new Grand Tree Guardian.
translation: Cok iyi. 10. takim Ape Atoll'dan geri cagrildigindan beri, Kral Narnode beni yeni Büyük Agac Muhafizi olarak atadi.

english: I believe I speak on behalf of everyone in the Stronghold when I say thank you for stopping Glough. Who knows what would've happened if you weren't there to foil his schemes.
translation: Glough'u durdurdugun icin tesekkür ettigimde, Kale'deki herkes adina konustuguma inaniyorum. Sen onun planlarini bozmasaydin ne olurdu kim bilir.

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: Hazir yemekler ise yaramaz korkarim. Aluft Aloft'un müsterileri icin sadece el yapimi Gnome Mutfagi yeterince iyidir.

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Garkor
Always good to see you again, [player name].
translation: Seni tekrar görmek her zaman güzel, Maceraci.

english: I guess you didn't travel far, but since it's you... Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: Sanirim cok uzaga gitmedin, ama sen oldugun icin... Iste sana bahsis olarak kücük bir ekstra.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr'dan ücretsiz teslimat jetonunuzu almayi unutmayin.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: Teslimatiniz cok gec kaldi! Aluft jnr'a geri dönüp baska bir siparis alin. Artik ihtiyaciniz olmadigi icin teslimat kutunuzu atiyorsunuz.

english: Hello there. Don't see many people around here. The name's Garl.
translation: Merhaba. Buralarda pek kimse yok. Adim Garl.

english: Hey. What are you doing here?
Exploring. Until that Nomad chap opened things up, this island was abandoned. Who knows what could be hiding here.
translation: Kesif yapiyorum. Nomad denen adam burayi acana kadar bu ada terk edilmisti. Kim bilir burada neler saklidir.

english: Found anything good so far?
translation: Simdiye kadar iyi bir sey buldun mu?

english: Well there's a dungeon on the east side of the island. I haven't gone too far in though. There's also a tower to the north west, near my camp.
translation: Adanin dogu tarafinda bir zindan var. Ama cok iceri girmedim. Ayrica kuzeybatida, kampimin yakininda bir kule var.

english: There's no shortage of resources either. Though there's not really any way to process them. I tried to build a spinning wheel and a pottery wheel myself, but they broke.
translation: Kaynaklar da bol. Ama bunlari isleyebilecek bir yol yok. Kendim bir egirme carki ve bir cömlek carki yapmaya calistim ama kirildilar.

english: You could really live off the land here. I can think of worse places to do so.
translation: Burada gercekten topraktan gecinebilirsin. Daha kötü yerler de var.

english: Indeed. It's all very peaceful. And yet...
translation: Dogru. Her sey cok huzurlu. Ama yine de...

english: What is it?
I don't know. Something just seems amiss. There's something sinister about this place. I just don't really know what.
translation: Bilmiyorum. Bir seyler ters gibi. Bu yerde kötü bir seyler var. Ne oldugunu tam olarak bilmiyorum.

english: I'm sure it's nothing.
You're probably right. Anyway, I'll let you get on. All the best.
translation: Muhtemelen haklisin. Neyse, seni rahat birakayim. Her sey gönlünce olsun.

english: Hello there.
Can you tell me about this castle?
translation: Bu kale hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: It's called Ver Sinhaza. They say it was once the home of a Saradominist queen. Now it belongs to Verzik Vitur, a vampyre noble.
translation: Adi Ver Sinhaza. Bir zamanlar Saradominist bir kralicenin eviymis. Simdi ise vampir soylusu Verzik Vitur'a ait.

english: Beneath the castle you'll find the Theatre of Blood. Every day, citizens of Meiyerditch take on various challenges set up by Verzik, all the provide entertainment for the vampyres.
translation: Kalenin altinda Kan Tiyatrosu var. Her gün, Meiyerditch vatandaslari Verzik'in hazirladigi cesitli zorlu görevleri yerine getirerek vampirleri eglendiriyorlar.

english: The citizens don't need to be forced though. Anyone who survives the Theatre is promised freedom from the vampyres. It provides a little bit of hope in this dark place.
translation: Ancak vatandaslar buna zorlanmiyor. Tiyatrodan sag cikanlara vampirlerden kurtulma sözü veriliyor. Bu karanlik yerde biraz umut veriyor.

english: Do you know anything about the Myreque?
translation: Myreque hakkinda bir sey biliyor musun?

english: I do. I'd rather not talk about them though. Those kinds of conversations get you in trouble.
translation: Biliyorum. Ancak onlar hakkinda konusmak istemiyorum. Bu tür konusmalar basini belaya sokar.

english: Old Man Ral might be willing to talk to you about them though. He lives in sector one of Meiyerditch, directly west of here.
translation: Yasli Ral seninle onlar hakkinda konusmak isteyebilir. Meiyerditch'in birinci bölgesinde, buradan batiya dogru yasiyor.

english: Can you tell me about the Sanguinesti region?
translation: Sanguinesti bölgesi hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Yep, that's where wee are at the moment. The region is split into two cities, Meiyerditch in the south and Darkmeyer in the north.
translation: Evet, su anda oradayiz. Bölge, güneydeki Meiyerditch ve kuzeydeki Darkmeyer olmak üzere iki sehre ayrilmistir.

english: Meiyerditch is just one large ghetto. The city is split into sectors so that the vampyres can collect blood tithes on a rotational basis. That way they don't kill everyone off in one go.
translation: Meiyerditch sadece büyük bir gettodur. Sehir, vampirlerin dönüsümlü olarak kan vergisi toplayabilmeleri icin bölümlere ayrilmistir. Böylelikle herkesi tek seferde öldürmezler.

english: Darkmeyer is the vampyre capital. Humans aren't allowed there unless they're a personal slave of some lord or lady. They say the vampyres there live very luxurious lifestyles.
translation: Darkmeyer vampirlerin baskentidir. Insanlar, bir lord veya leydinin kisisel kölesi olmadikca oraya giremezler. Oradaki vampirlerin cok lüks bir yasam sürdükleri söylenir.

english: What do you know about the vampyres?
Not much really. There seems to be three main types, juveniles, juvinates and vy*res.
translation: Aslinda pek bir sey bilmiyorum. Üc ana tür var gibi görünüyor: gencler, juvinatlar ve vy*res.

english: Juveniles seem to be the lowest form of the vampyre. No one around here knows for sure but the general consensus is that they're former humans who've been converted in some way.
translation: Gencler, vampirlerin en alt türü gibi görünüyor. Buralarda kimse kesin olarak bilmiyor ama genel kani, onlarin bir sekilde dönüstürülmüs eski insanlar oldugu yönünde.

english: Juvinates are initiated juveniles who've had some training and are starting to gain some powers.
translation: Juvinatlar, bir miktar egitim almis ve bazi gücler kazanmaya baslayan genclerdir.

english: Then you have the vyres. Very nasty and very powerful. I wouldn't get on the wrong side of one if I were you.
translation: Sonra da vyres var. Cok kötü ve cok güclüler. Senin yerinde olsam onlarla ters düsmezdim.

english: What do you know about Drakan?
Vanescula?
Well, I was referring to the main Drakan, you know, the overlord of Morytania.
translation: Ben asil Drakan'dan bahsediyordum, bilirsin, Morytania'nin hükümdari.

english: Hmm, nothing has been seen of him for many years now. You can occasionally see Vanescula flying about, but not too often.
translation: Hmm, onu yillardir kimse görmedi. Vanescula'yi ara sira ucarken görebilirsin, ama cok sik degil.

english: Can you tell me about this castle?
translation: Bu kale hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Do you know anything about the Myreque?
translation: Myreque hakkinda bir sey biliyor musun?

english: Can you tell me about the Sanguinesti region?
translation: Sanguinesti bölgesi hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: What do you know about the vampyres?
What do you know about Drakan?
Hello. What do you want?
I want for nothing!
You're one of a very lucky few then.
translation: O zaman cok sansli azinliktan birisin.

english: Look who it is!
Hello again. How are things going?
Amazing! We get paid to eat all day, and our payment is more food. Life has never been better!
translation: Harika! Bütün gün yemek yiyip para kazaniyoruz ve ödememiz de daha fazla yemek. Hayat hic bu kadar güzel olmamisti!

english: Too right, Gary! This is much better than being on strike!
translation: Cok haklisin Gary! Bu grev yapmaktan cok daha iyi!

english: Glad to hear it.
What happened to the old man who used to be the doorman?
translation: Eskiden kapici olan yasli adama ne oldu?

english: You mean my father? He went into retirement, I've taken over the family business instead.
translation: Babami mi kastediyorsun? Emekli oldu, ben de aile isini devraldim.

english: Your father! But you don't look anything like him!
translation: Baban mi! Ama ona hic benzemiyorsun!

english: No, fortunately for me I inherited my good looks from my mother.
translation: Hayir, neyse ki annemden güzel görünüsümü miras aldim.

english: Sorry, we cannot allow you to bring those sacks into the market for security reason.
translation: Üzgünüm, güvenlik nedeniyle bu cuvallari pazara sokmaniza izin veremeyiz.

english: You may not pass through this door without paying the trading tax.
translation: Ticaret vergisini ödemeden bu kapidan gecemezsiniz.

english: So how much is the tax?
The cost is one diamond.
Okay...
I haven't brought my diamonds with me.
No tax, no entry.
A diamond? Are you crazy?
Not at all. Those are the rules.
What do you do with all the diamonds you get?

Ever heard of fairylights? Well how do you think we make 'em? First we collect a pile of gems and then we get a spider to spin 'em into a long web, we light the jewels by imbuing each one with a little bit of magic.
translation: Peri isiklari duydun mu hic? Peki onlari nasil yaptigimizi biliyor musun? Önce bir yigin mücevher topluyoruz, sonra bir örümcekle onlari uzun bir aga dönüstürüyoruz, her birine biraz sihir katarak mücevherleri aydinlatiyoruz.

english: So you're telling me fairylights are made out of gems?
translation: Yani peri isiklari mücevherlerden mi yapiliyor?

english: That's right, how else could we make 'em twinkle so beautifully?
translation: Aynen öyle, baska türlü nasil bu kadar güzel parlayabilirler ki?

english: Do you know what these strange marks mean?
translation: Bu garip isaretlerin anlamini biliyor musun?

english: No I don't and I'm trying to work here. Please stop distracting me!
translation: Hayir, bilmiyorum ve burada calismaya calisiyorum. Lütfen dikkatimi dagitma!

english: What are you doing all the way over here? Shouldn't you be at the market door?
translation: Burada ne yapiyorsun? Pazar kapisinda olman gerekmiyor mu?

english: Yes, that's my usual spot, but the Godfather said I should be here, so here I am.
translation: Evet, normalde orada dururum ama Godfather burada olmam gerektigini söyledi, o yüzden buradayim.

english: Hello, did you just come from the market gates? Are my brothers doing their job well? I do worry that they'll start letting people into the market for free without me being there to supervise them!
translation: Merhaba, pazar kapisindan mi geldin? Kardeslerim islerini iyi yapiyor mu? Ben orada denetlemeden insanlari pazara bedavaya sokmaya baslayacaklarindan endiseleniyorum!

english: I'm afraid nobody is allowed in there, orders from the boss.
translation: Korkarim kimse iceri giremez, patronun emri.

english: I've received orders to let you through if you want. Good luck.
translation: Istersen seni iceri almam emredildi. Iyi sanslar.

english: You squeeze past the thorny vines into a small tunnel.
translation: Dikenli sarmasiklarin arasindan gecerek kücük bir tünele giriyorsun.

english: Be careful in there, there are still some of those baby Tanglefootii around.
translation: Orada dikkatli ol, etrafta hala bazi Tanglefootii yavrulari var.

english: You find the Queen's secateurs!
Okay...
A diamond? Are you crazy?
I haven't brought my diamonds with me.
What do you do with all the diamonds you get?
I say, I say, a toast to this fine human!
translation: Diyorum ki, bu harika insana kadeh kaldiralim!

english: What? I mean, err... why?
Why not!
I don't have anything suitable to toast with.
translation: Kadeh kaldirmak icin uygun bir seyim yok.

english: Then go get something from the bar!
translation: O zaman bardan bir sey al!

english: Hello there, can I help you?
Where am I?
This is the town of Lumbridge my friend.
How are you today?
Aye, not too bad thank you. Lovely weather in Gielinor this fine day.
translation: Iyi, tesekkürler. Gielinor'da bugün hava cok güzel.

english: Weather?
Yes weather, you know.
The state or condition of the atmosphere at a time and place, with respect to variables such as temperature, moisture, wind velocity, and barometric pressure.
translation: Bir zaman ve mekânda atmosferin sicaklik, nem, rüzgâr hizi ve barometrik basinc gibi degiskenlere göre durumu veya kosulu....

english: Not just a pretty face eh? Ha ha ha.
translation: Sadece güzel bir yüz degil, degil mi? Ha ha ha.

english: Do you know of any quests I can do?
translation: Yapabilecegim herhangi bir görev biliyor musun?

english: What kind of quest are you looking for?
Hmm.. dangerous you say? What sort of creatures are you looking to fight?
translation: Hmm... tehlikeli mi dedin? Ne tür yaratiklarla savasmak istiyorsun?

english: Big scary demons!
You are a brave soul indeed.
Now that you mention it, I heard a rumour about a fortune-teller in Varrock who is rambling about some kind of greater evil.. sounds demon-like if you ask me.
translation: Simdi sen bahsedince, Varrock'ta bir falcinin daha büyük bir kötülük hakkinda sacmaladigini duydum... Bana sorarsan iblis gibi geliyor.

english: Perhaps you could check it out if you are as brave as you say?
translation: Eger dedigin kadar cesursan, belki bir bakabilirsin?

english: Thanks for the tip, perhaps I will.
I've already killed the demon Delrith. He was merely a stain on my sword when I was finished with him!
translation: Delrith iblisini coktan öldürdüm. Onu öldürdügümde kilicimda sadece bir leke kalmisti!

english: Well done! However I'm sure if you search around the world you will find more challenging foes to slay.
translation: Aferin! Ancak eminim ki dünyayi arastirirsan daha zorlu düsmanlar bulacaksin.

english: Vampyres!
Ha ha. I personally don't believe in such things. However, there is a man in Draynor Village who has been scaring the village folk with stories of vampyres.
translation: Ha ha. Sahsen ben böyle seylere inanmiyorum. Ancak Draynor Köyü'nde vampir hikayeleriyle köylüleri korkutan bir adam var.

english: He's named Morgan and can be found in one of the village houses. Perhaps you could see what the matter is?
translation: Adi Morgan ve köydeki evlerden birinde bulunabilir. Belki ne oldugunu ögrenebilirsin?

english: Thanks for the tip.
Oh I have already killed that nasty blood-sucking vampyre. Draynor will be safe now.
translation: Oh, o igrenc kan emici vampiri coktan öldürdüm. Draynor artik güvende.

english: Yeah, yeah of course you did. Everyone knows vampyres are not real....
translation: Evet, evet, tabii ki öldürdün. Herkes vampirlerin gercek olmadigini bilir...

english: What! I did slay the beast..I really did.
translation: Ne! Ben o canavari öldürdüm... Gercekten öldürdüm.

english: You're not fooling anyone you know.
..Huh.. But... Hey! I did... believe what you like.
translation: ...Huh... Ama... Hey! Ben öldürdüm... Neye inanirsan inan.

english: Small.. something small would be good.
translation: Kücük... Kücük bir sey iyi olur.

english: Small? Small isn't really that dangerous though is it?
translation: Kücük mü? Kücük olanlar o kadar tehlikeli degildir, degil mi?

english: Yes it can be! There could be anything from an evil chicken to a poisonous spider. They attack in numbers you know!
translation: Evet, olabilir! Kötü bir tavuktan zehirli bir örümcege kadar her sey olabilir. Sayica üstünlük saglayarak saldirirlar, biliyorsun!

english: Yes ok, point taken. Speaking of small monsters, I hear old Wizard Mizgog in the wizards' tower has just had all his beads taken by a gang of mischievous imps.
translation: Evet, tamam, anladim. Kücük canavarlardan bahsetmisken, büyücüler kulesindeki yasli büyücü Mizgog'un tüm boncuklarinin yaramaz cinler tarafindan calindigini duydum.

english: Sounds like it could be a quest for you?
translation: Bu senin icin bir görev olabilir gibi görünüyor?

english: Thanks for your help.
Yes I know of Mizgog and have already helped him with his imp problem. It took me ages to find those beads!
translation: Evet, Mizgog'u taniyorum ve cin sorununda ona zaten yardim ettim. O boncuklari bulmak cok zamanimi aldi!

english: Imps will be imps!
Maybe another time.
Something easy please, I'm new here.
translation: Lütfen kolay bir sey olsun, ben buraya yeniyim.

english: I can tell you about plenty of small easy tasks.
translation: Sana bircok kücük ve kolay görevden bahsedebilirim.

english: The Lumbridge cook has been having problems, the Duke is confused over some strange talisman and on top of all that, poor lad Romeo in Varrock has girlfriend problems.
translation: Lumbridge ascisi sorunlar yasiyor, Dük garip bir tilsim yüzünden kafasi karisik ve üstüne üstlük, Varrock'taki zavalli Romeo'nun kiz arkadasiyla sorunlari var.

english: Tell me about the Lumbridge cook.
It's funny really, the cook would forget his head if it wasn't screwed on. This time he forgot to get ingredients for the Duke's birthday cake.
translation: Gercekten komik, asci kafasi yerine takili olmasa kafasini da unutur. Bu sefer Dük'ün dogum günü pastasi icin malzemeleri almayi unutmus.

english: Perhaps you could help him? You will probably find him in the Lumbridge Castle kitchen.
translation: Belki ona yardim edebilirsin? Onu muhtemelen Lumbridge Kalesi'nin mutfaginda bulabilirsin.

english: Thank you. I shall go speak with him.
I have already helped the cook in Lumbridge.
Oh yes, so you have. I am sure the Duke will be pleased.
translation: Evet, öyleymis. Eminim Dük cok memnun olacaktir.

english: Tell me about the Duke's strange talisman.
translation: Dük'ün garip tilsimi hakkinda bana bilgi verin.

english: Well the Duke of Lumbridge has found a strange talisman that no one seems to understand. Perhaps you could help him? You can probably find him upstairs in Lumbridge Castle.
translation: Lumbridge Dükü, kimsenin anlamadigi garip bir tilsim bulmus. Belki ona yardim edebilirsiniz? Onu muhtemelen Lumbridge Kalesi'nin üst katinda bulabilirsiniz.

english: Sounds mysterious. I may just do that. Thanks.
translation: Gizemli geliyor. Belki de bunu yaparim. Tesekkürler.

english: Yes, I have already solved the Rune mysteries.
Ah excellent. Thank you very much adventurer.
Tell me about Romeo and his girlfriend please.
translation: Romeo ve kiz arkadasi hakkinda bana bilgi verin lütfen.

english: Romeo in Varrock needs help with finding his beloved Juliet, you may be able to help him out.
translation: Varrock'taki Romeo, sevgilisi Juliet'i bulmak icin yardima ihtiyac duyuyor, ona yardim edebilirsin.
