english: Unless of course you manage to find Juliet first in which case she has probably lost Romeo.
translation: Tabii önce Juliet'i bulursan, o zaman muhtemelen Romeo'yu kaybetmistir.

english: Right, ok. Romeo is in Varrock?
Yes you can't miss him, he's wandering aimlessly in the square.
translation: Evet, onu kacirman imkansiz, meydanda amacsizca dolasiyor.

english: Oh yes, I've already helped Romeo in the best possible way I can...
translation: Evet, Romeo'ya elimden gelen en iyi sekilde yardim ettim bile...

english: Really?
Yup.
...How?
He thinks Juliet is dead...
Well.. ok.. well done... I think...
I'm a thinker rather than fighter, anything skill orientated?
translation: Ben savascidan cok düsünür biriyim, beceri odakli bir sey var mi?

english: Skills play a big part when you want to progress in knowledge throughout Gielinor. I know of a few skill- related quests that can get you started.
translation: Gielinor'da bilgi birikimini gelistirmek istediginde beceriler büyük rol oynar. Baslamana yardimci olacak birkac beceri odakli görev biliyorum.

english: You may be able to help out Fred the farmer who is in need of someones crafting expertise.
translation: Zanaat konusunda uzmanliga ihtiyac duyan ciftci Fred'e yardim edebilirsin.

english: Or, there's always Doric the dwarf who needs an errand running for him?
translation: Ya da, her zaman onun icin ayak isleri yapmaya ihtiyac duyan cüce Doric var.

english: Tell me about Fred the farmer please.
You can find Fred next to the field of sheep in Lumbridge. Perhaps you should go and speak with him.
translation: Fred'i Lumbridge'deki koyun tarlasinin yaninda bulabilirsin. Belki de gidip onunla konusmalisin.

english: Thanks, maybe I will.
I have already helped Fred the farmer. I sheared his sheep and made 20 balls of wool for him.
translation: Ciftci Fred'e zaten yardim ettim. Koyunlarini kirktim ve ona 20 top yün yaptim.

english: He wouldn't let me kill his chickens though.
Lumbridge chickens do make good target practice.
translation: Lumbridge tavuklari iyi bir hedef talimi oluyor.

english: You will have to wait until he isn't looking.
Tell me about Doric the dwarf.
Doric the dwarf is located north of Falador. He might be able to help you with smithing. You should speak to him. He may let you use his anvils.
translation: Cüce Doric, Falador'un kuzeyinde yasiyor. Demircilik konusunda sana yardimci olabilir. Onunla konusmalisin. Sana örslerini kullanmana izin verebilir.

english: Yes, I've been to see Doric already. He was happy to let me use his anvils after I ran a small errand for him.
translation: Evet, Doric'i zaten gördüm. Onun icin kücük bir is yaptim ve örslerini kullanmama izin verdi.

english: Oh good, Thank you [player name]!
I want to do all kinds of things, do you know of anything like that?
translation: Her türlü seyi yapmak istiyorum, böyle bir sey biliyor musun?

english: Of course I do. Gielinor is a huge place you know, now let me think...
translation: Tabii ki biliyorum. Gielinor cok büyük bir yer, bir düsüneyim...

english: Hetty the witch in Rimmington might be able to offer help in the ways of magical abilities..
translation: Rimmington'daki cadi Hetty, sihirli yetenekler konusunda sana yardim edebilir.

english: Also, pirates are currently docked in Port Sarim, Where pirates are, treasure is never far away...
translation: Ayrica, korsanlar su anda Port Sarim'de demirlemis durumda. Korsanlarin oldugu yerde hazine de uzakta degildir...

english: Or you could go help out Ernest who got lost in Draynor Manor, spooky place that.
translation: Ya da Draynor Malikanesi'nde kaybolan Ernest'e yardim edebilirsin, orasi ürkütücü bir yer.

english: Tell me about Hetty the witch.

Hetty the witch can be found in Rimmington, south of Falador. She's currently working on some new potions. Perhaps you could give her a hand? She might be able to offer help with your magical abilities.
translation: Cadi Hetty, Falador'un güneyindeki Rimmington'da bulunabilir. Su anda yeni iksirler üzerinde calisiyor. Belki ona yardim edebilirsin? Sihirli yeteneklerin konusunda sana yardim edebilir.

english: Ok thanks, let's hope she doesn't turn me into a potato or something..
translation: Tamam, tesekkürler. Umarim beni patates falan yapmaz...

english: Yes, I have already been to see Hetty, she gave me super cosmic powers after I helped out with her potion! I could probably destroy you with a single thought!
translation: Evet, Hetty'yi zaten gördüm. Iksirine yardim ettikten sonra bana süper kozmik gücler verdi! Muhtemelen tek bir düsünceyle seni yok edebilirim!

english: Did she really?
No not really...
Right.....
Tell me about Pirate's Treasure.
RedBeard Frank in Port Sarim's bar, the Rusty Anchor, might be able to tell you about the rumored treasure that is buried somewhere in Gielinor.
translation: Port Sarim'deki Rusty Anchor barinda bulunan RedBeard Frank, Gielinor'da bir yerlerde gömülü oldugu söylenen hazine hakkinda sana bilgi verebilir.

english: Sounds adventurous, I may have to check that out. Thank you.
translation: Macera dolu bir sey gibi, bir bakmam gerek. Tesekkürler.

english: Yarr! I already found the booty!
Yarr indeed my friend. A most excellent find.
translation: Yarr, gercekten dostum. Harika bir kesif.

english: Yarr!
Yarrr!
YARRR!
Right, that's enough of that!
..Sorry.
Tell me about Ernest please.
The best place to start would be at the gate to Draynor Manor. There you will find Veronica who will be able to tell you more.
translation: Baslamak icin en iyi yer Draynor Malikanesi'nin kapisidir. Orada sana daha fazla bilgi verebilecek Veronica'yi bulacaksin.

english: I suggest you tread carefully in that place; it's haunted.
translation: Orada dikkatli olmani öneririm; orasi hayaletli.

english: Sounds like fun. I've never been to a Haunted Manor before.
translation: Kulaga eglenceli geliyor. Daha önce hayaletli bir malikaneye hic gitmedim.

english: Yeah, I found Ernest already. Professor Oddenstein had turned him into a chicken!
translation: Evet, Ernest'i buldum bile. Profesör Oddenstein onu tavuga dönüstürmüs!

english: A chicken!?
Yeah a chicken. It could have been worse though.
translation: Evet, tavuga. Daha kötüsü de olabilirdi.

english: Very true, poor guy.
Where can I get a haircut like yours?
translation: Seninki gibi bir sac kesimi nerede yaptirabilirim?

english: Yes, it does look like you need a hairdresser.
translation: Evet, kuaföre ihtiyacin var gibi görünüyor.

english: Oh thanks!
No problem. The hairdresser in Falador will probably be able to sort you out.
translation: Rica ederim. Falador'daki kuaför muhtemelen sana yardimci olabilir.

english: The Lumbridge general store sells useful maps if you don't know the way.
translation: Yolu bilmiyorsan, Lumbridge genel magazasinda kullanisli haritalar satiyorlar.

english: What's up?
I assume the sky is up..
You assume?
Yeah, unfortunately I don't seem to be able to look up.
Can I buy your stick?
It's not a stick! I'll have you know it's a very powerful staff!
translation: O sopa degil! Bilmeni isterim ki, o cok güclü bir asa!

english: Really? Show me what it can do!
translation: Gercekten mi? Ne yapabildigini göster bana!

english: Um..It's a bit low on power at the moment..
It's a stick isn't it?
...Ok it's a stick.. But only while I save up for a staff. Zaff in Varrock square sells them in his shop.
translation: ...Tamam, bu bir sopa... Ama sadece asa icin para biriktirirken. Varrock meydanindaki Zaff dükkaninda satiyor.

english: Well good luck with that.
Do you have anything of value which I can have?
translation: Bana verebilecegin degerli bir seyin var mi?

english: Are you asking for free stuff?
Well... er... yes.
No I do not have anything I can give you. If I did have anything of value I wouldn't want to give it away.
translation: Hayir, sana verebilecegim bir seyim yok. Degerli bir seyim olsaydi, onu vermek istemezdim.

english: Your shoe lace is untied.
No it's not!
No you're right. I have nothing to back that up.
translation: Hayir, haklisin. Bunu kanitlayacak hicbir seyim yok.

english: Fool! Leave me alone!
Do you know what happened in the castle cellar?
translation: Kalenin mahzeninde ne oldugunu biliyor musun?

english: I heard the wall collapsed or something. I don't know why. Perhaps you could get to the bottom of this mystery!
translation: Duvar cöktü falan diye duydum. Nedenini bilmiyorum. Belki bu gizemi cözebilirsin!

english: Where am I?
How are you today?
Do you know of any quests I can do?
translation: Yapabilecegim herhangi bir görev var mi?

english: Your shoe lace is untied.
Are there any quests I can do here?
translation: Burada yapabilecegim herhangi bir görev var mi?

english: I fancy a bit of a fight, anything dangerous?
translation: Biraz kavga etmek istiyorum, tehlikeli bir sey var mi?

english: Big scary demons!
Vampyres!
Small.. something small would be good.
translation: Kücük... kücük bir sey iyi olur.

english: Maybe another time.
Something easy please, I'm new here.
translation: Kolay bir sey lütfen, ben buraya yeniyim.

english: The Lumbridge cook.
The Duke's strange talisman.
Romeo and his girlfriend.
I'm a thinker rather than fighter, anything skill oriented?
translation: Ben savascidan cok düsünürüm, beceri odakli bir sey var mi?

english: Fred the farmer.
Doric the dwarf.
I want to do all kinds of things, do you know of anything like that?
translation: Her türlü seyi yapmak istiyorum, böyle bir sey biliyor musun?

english: Hetty the Witch.
Pirate's treasure.
Ernest and Draynor Manor.
Where can I get a haircut like yours?
translation: Seninki gibi bir sac kesimi nerede yaptirabilirim?

english: What's up?
Can I buy your stick?
Do you have anything of value which I can have?
translation: Bana verebilecegin degerli bir seyin var mi?

english: Do you know what happened in the castle cellar?
translation: Kalenin mahzeninde ne oldugunu biliyor musun?

english: I insured your Hitpoints XP up to level [level]. But now there's no more need for that, would you like a refund? It's [amount] coins.
Yes, give me back my [amount] coins
No, you can hold onto that for me.
Alright. I don't pay interest, though!
I used to sell life insurance, protecting people's Hitpoints XP when they died. Now there's no more need for that, so I'm just giving refunds now. But I don't think I owe you anything.
translation: Eskiden hayat sigortasi satardim, insanlarin öldüklerinde Hitpoints XP'lerini korurdum. Artik buna gerek kalmadi, bu yüzden simdi sadece geri ödeme yapiyorum. Ama sana bir sey borclu oldugumu sanmiyorum.

english: Death is everywhere! At any moment, a band of brigands might rush in and kill you, or your closest friend might stab you in the back. Welcome to Gelin's Life Insurance Brokerage.
translation: Ölüm her yerde! Her an bir haydut cetesi gelip seni öldürebilir ya da en yakin arkadasin seni sirtindan bicaklayabilir. Gelin'in Hayat Sigortasi Acenteligine hos geldin.

english: When you die, you may lose Hitpoints XP, so your Hitpoints level may decrease. I offer an insurance service, preventing your Hitpoints level from falling below a certain level.
translation: Öldügünüzde Hitpoints XP'nizi kaybedebilir ve Hitpoints seviyeniz düsebilir. Hitpoints seviyenizin belirli bir seviyenin altina düsmesini önleyen bir sigorta hizmeti sunuyorum.

english: I see you're insured up to level 25 Hitpoints - if you lose Hitpoints XP on death, you will never drop below level 25.
translation: Görüyorum ki 25 Hitpoints seviyesine kadar sigortaliymissiniz - öldügünüzde Hitpoints XP'nizi kaybederseniz, seviyeniz asla 25'in altina düsmeyecek.

english: I see you're insured up to level 50 Hitpoints - if you lose Hitpoints XP on death, you will never drop below level 50.
translation: Görüyorum ki 50 Hitpoints seviyesine kadar sigortaliysiniz - öldügünüzde Hitpoints XP kaybederseniz, asla 50 seviyesinin altina düsmezsiniz.

english: I see you're insured up to level 75 Hitpoints - if you lose Hitpoints XP on death, you will never drop below level 75. That's the highest level of insurance I offer.
translation: Görüyorum ki 75 Hitpoints seviyesine kadar sigortaliysiniz - öldügünüzde Hitpoints XP kaybederseniz, asla 75 seviyesinin altina düsmezsiniz. Bu, sundugum en yüksek sigorta seviyesidir.

english: Can I buy life insurance?
You must have a Hitpoints level of 25 before you may insure yourself.
translation: Kendinizi sigortalatabilmek icin Hitpoints seviyenizin 25 olmasi gerekir.

english: You must have a Hitpoints level of 50 before you may insure yourself to that level.
translation: Kendinizi bu seviyeye kadar sigortalatabilmek icin Hitpoints seviyenizin 50 olmasi gerekir.

english: You must have a Hitpoints level of 75 before you may insure yourself to that level.
translation: Kendinizi bu seviyeye kadar sigortalatabilmek icin Hitpoints seviyenizin 75 olmasi gerekir.

english: I can insure you up to level 75 Hitpoints, so that your Hitpoints level will never decrease below that. This service costs 1,000,000 coins.
translation: Hitpoints seviyenizin asla bu seviyenin altina düsmemesi icin sizi 75 Hitpoints seviyesine kadar sigortalayabilirim. Bu hizmetin ücreti 1.000.000 coin'dir.

english: Alternatively, I can insure you up to level 50 Hitpoints. That service costs only 100,000 coins.
translation: Alternatif olarak, sizi 50 Hitpoints seviyesine kadar sigortalayabilirim. Bu hizmetin ücreti sadece 100.000 coin'dir.

english: Finally, I can insure you up to level 25 Hitpoints. That service costs only 25,000 coins.
translation: Son olarak, sizi 25 Hitpoints seviyesine kadar sigortalayabilirim. Bu hizmetin ücreti sadece 25.000 coin'dir.

english: I can't afford any of those options.
Insure me to level 75 for 1,000,000 coins.
translation: Beni 1.000.000 jeton karsiliginda 75 seviyeye kadar sigortalayin.

english: Thank you. Your Hitpoints level will never decrease below 75 when you are defeated in future.
translation: Tesekkürler. Gelecekte yenildiginizde Hitpoints seviyeniz asla 75'in altina düsmeyecek.

english: Insure me to level 25 for 25,000 coins.
translation: Beni 25.000 jeton karsiliginda 25 seviyeye kadar sigortalayin.

english: Thank you. Your Hitpoints level will never decrease below 25 when you are defeated in future.
translation: Tesekkürler. Gelecekte yenildiginizde Hitpoints seviyeniz asla 25'in altina düsmeyecek.

english: Not now, thank you.
I can insure you up to level 50 Hitpoints, so that your Hitpoints level will never decrease below that. This service costs 100,000 coins.
translation: Sizi 50 Hitpoints seviyesine kadar sigortalayabilirim, böylece Hitpoints seviyeniz asla bu seviyenin altina düsmez. Bu hizmetin ücreti 100.000 coin.

english: Alternatively, I can insure you up to level 25 Hitpoints. That service costs only 25,000 coins.
translation: Alternatif olarak, sizi 25 Hitpoints seviyesine kadar sigortalayabilirim. Bu hizmetin ücreti sadece 25.000 coin.

english: I can't afford either of those options.
Insure me to level 50 for 100,000 coins.
translation: Beni 100.000 jeton karsiliginda 50 seviyeye kadar sigortalayin.

english: Thank you. Your Hitpoints level will never decrease below 50 when you are defeated in future.
translation: Tesekkürler. Gelecekte yenildiginizde, Hitpoints seviyeniz asla 50'nin altina düsmeyecek.

english: No, thank you.
I can insure you up to level 25 Hitpoints, so that your Hitpoints level will never decrease below that. This service costs 25,000 coins.
translation: Sizi 25 Hitpoints seviyesine kadar sigortalayabilirim, böylece Hitpoints seviyeniz asla bu seviyenin altina düsmeyecek. Bu hizmetin ücreti 25.000 jeton.

english: Tell me about yourself.
I am Gelin, the greatest assassin ever to train in Al Kharid. If you have not heard of me, that is because my victims never live to speak of me.
translation: Ben Gelin, Al Kharid'de egitim görmüs en büyük suikastciyim. Beni duymamis olmanizin sebebi, kurbanlarimin beni anlatacak kadar yasamamis olmalaridir.

english: In my years as a warrior of fortune, I have fought in many lands, meeting fighters of all calibres, and I found they all had something in common:
translation: Sansli bir savasci olarak gecirdigim yillarda, bircok ülkede savastim, her seviyeden savascilarla karsilastim ve hepsinin ortak bir özelligi oldugunu fark ettim:

english: Every single one had a soul-gripping fear that they would suffer a humiliating defeat at the hands of their foes.
translation: Her biri, düsmanlarinin elinde asagilayici bir yenilgiye ugrayacaklari konusunda ruhlarini saran bir korkuya sahipti.

english: They did not fear the pain, you understand. They feared the diminishment that comes with defeat.
translation: Acidan korkmuyorlardi, anlarsiniz ya. Yenilginin getirecegi kücülmeden korkuyorlardi.

english: Diminishment?
To see one's wealth in the hands of another. To see one's skills decrease, as the hard-earned experience is lost. That is what they all feared.
translation: Kisinin servetinin baskasinin eline gecmesini görmek. Zor kazanilan deneyimin kaybolmasiyla kisinin becerilerinin azalmasini görmek. Hepsi bundan korkuyordu.

english: Thus I was inspired to create this life insurance brokerage. I can protect your Hitpoints experience, so that you will not lose so much of it when you are defeated.
translation: Bu yüzden bu hayat sigortasi acentasini kurmaya karar verdim. Hitpoints deneyiminizi koruyabilirim, böylece yenildiginizde cok fazla kaybetmezsiniz.

english: I cannot protect other skills, and I have no intention whatsoever of protecting anyone's items - a victor deserves their spoils.
translation: Diger becerileri koruyamam ve kimsenin esyalarini korumaya niyetim de yok - galip gelen ganimetini hak eder.

english: Why do you sell life insurance in a graveyard?
There is no more fitting place! The graves of the dead remind the living that their lives are fragile, and that death is the inescapable fate of all mortals.
translation: Daha uygun bir yer olamaz! Ölülerin mezarlari, yasayanlara hayatlarinin kirilgan oldugunu ve ölümün tüm ölümlülerin kacinilmaz kaderi oldugunu hatirlatir.

english: That is exactly the frame of mind that encourages people to buy life insurance from me.
translation: Insanlari benden hayat sigortasi satin almaya tesvik eden tam da bu zihniyet.

english: Can I ever get a refund on this insurance?
translation: Bu sigortanin parasini geri alabilir miyim?

english: No, my life insurance policies are for life. Similarly, when a customer upgrades their policy to a better one, I charge the full price of the new policy. They may take it or leave it.
translation: Hayir, hayat sigortasi policelerim ömür boyu gecerlidir. Benzer sekilde, bir müsteri policesini daha iyi bir policeye yükseltmek istediginde, yeni policenin tam fiyatini alirim. Kabul ederler ya da etmezler.

english: Goodbye.
People don't lose experience when they die in this event, so no-one's buying life insurance from me. I may as well not be here!
translation: Bu etkinlikte insanlar öldüklerinde deneyim kaybetmiyorlar, bu yüzden kimse benden hayat sigortasi satin almiyor. Burada olmamam daha iyi!

english: Yes, give me back my [amount] coins.
No, you can hold onto that for me.
Can I buy life insurance, please?
translation: Hayat sigortasi satin alabilir miyim, lütfen?

english: Insure me to level 75 for 1,000,000 coins.
Insure me to level 50 for 100,000 coins.
Insure me to level 25 for 25,000 coins.
Not now, thank you.
Okay, I'll pay.
No, thank you.
Tell me about yourself.
Why do you sell life insurance in a graveyard?
Can I ever get a refund on this insurance?
translation: Bu sigortanin parasini geri alabilir miyim?

english: Goodbye.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu var. Merhaba, selam, merhaba...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her türlü sey! Kuleler görülmeye deger harika bir manzara.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmeni tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Hello! Who are you?
Hi. I'm Gem. That's what they call me, anyway. My real name is actually-
translation: Merhaba. Ben Gem. En azindan bana öyle diyorlar. Asil adim aslinda...

english: OH GEEEEM! You missed a spot!
Sigh. Nevermind. I have to go.
Gems! Get your gems here!
Let's trade.
I'm good, thanks.
Then move along please!
translation: O zaman lütfen yoluna devam et!

english: You're the one who stole from me! Guards! Guards!
Let's trade.
I'm good, thanks.
Here, look at my lovely gems.
translation: Bak, ne kadar güzel mücevherlerim var.

english: Good day to you traveller. Would you be interested in buying some gems?
translation: Iyi günler gezgin. Mücevher almak ister misin?

english: No thank you.
Eh, suit yourself.
I'm in search of a man named Avan Fitzharmon.
translation: Avan Fitzharmon adinda bir adam ariyorum.

english: Fitzharmon eh? Hmmm.... If I'm not mistaken that's the family name of a member of the Varrockian nobility. You know, I HAVE seen someone of that
translation: Fitzharmon mu? Hmmm... Yanilmiyorsam bu, Varrockian soylularindan birinin soyadi. Biliyor musun, son zamanlarda bu civarda öyle birini gördüm.

english: persuasion around here recently... Wearing a poncey yellow cape he was! Came in here all la-di-dah, high and mighty, asking for jewelry made
translation: Süslü sari bir pelerin giyiyordu! Buraya gelip, havali havali, kibirli kibirli, “mükemmel altin”dan yapilmis mücevherler istedi.

english: from 'perfect gold' - whatever that is - like 'normal' golds just not good enough for little lord fancy pants there! I told him to head to the desert
translation: O da ne demekse, “normal” altinlar o kücük lordun havali pantolonuna yetmiyordu! Ona cöle gitmesini söyledim.

english: 'Cos I know theres gold out there, in them there sand dunes... and if it's not up to his lordships high standards of 'gold perfection'...
translation: Cünkü orada, kum tepelerinde altin oldugunu biliyorum... ve eger onun lordlugunun “altin mükemmelligi” standartlarina uymuyorsa...

english: Maybe we'll all get lucky and the scorpions will deal with him.
translation: Belki hepimiz sansli oluruz ve akrepler onun icabina bakar.

english: Yes please.
No thank you.
I'm in search of a man named Avan Fitzharmon.
translation: Avan Fitzharmon adinda bir adam ariyorum.

translation: Son zamanlarda buralarda ikna edici davranislar sergiliyordu... Sikici sari bir pelerin giyiyordu! Buraya gelip, kibirli ve kendini begenmis bir tavirla mücevher yapilmis bir sey istedi.

english: The gemstone crab burrows away, leaving a piece of its shell behind.
translation: Mücevher yengeci, kabugunun bir parçasini geride birakarak kaçar.

english: You swing your pick at the crab shell.
You mine an uncut [gem] from the crab shell.
Your understanding of the gemstone crab is not great enough to mine its shell.
translation: Gemstone crab hakkinda yeterli bilgiye sahip degilsiniz, bu yüzden kabugunu kazip çikaramazsiniz.

english: Please do not disturb our deliberations.
What are you deliberating?
Lord Shayzien wishes us to draw up contingency plans for various scenarios in the ongoing war against the lizardmen.
translation: Lord Shayzien, kertenkele adamlarla devam eden savasta cesitli senaryolar icin acil durum planlari hazirlamamizi istiyor.

english: If they ever succeed in cutting us off from Lovakengj, our supply lines will be severely constrained, and I must work on alternative plans.
translation: Eger bizi Lovakengj'den koparmayi basarirlarsa, ikmal hatlarimiz ciddi sekilde kisitlanacak ve ben alternatif planlar üzerinde calismaliyim.

english: So please do not disturb us further.
translation: Lütfen bizi daha fazla rahatsiz etmeyin.

english: I'll leave you to it.
Oh, sorry.
What are you deliberating?
Oh, sorry.
I've heard that one of your number has got hold of part of a map.
translation: Sizden birinin bir haritanin bir kismini ele gecirdigini duydum.

english: Aha, that'd be Wormbrain.
Where would he be?
Wormbrain steals too much. He got caught. Now he lives in Port Sarim town jail.
translation: Wormbrain cok fazla sey caliyor. Yakalandi. Simdi Port Sarim kasabasinin hapishanesinde yasiyor.

english: When Chosen Commander come to speak to us again?
translation: Secilmis Komutan ne zaman tekrar bizimle konusmaya gelecek?

english: I don't know. I don't think she was making any progress when she spoke to you before.
translation: Bilmiyorum. Daha önce sizinle konustugunda pek ilerleme kaydettigini sanmiyorum.

english: We listen to whatever she say!
Yeah, as long as she agree with truths of Big High War God!
translation: Evet, Büyük Yüksek Savas Tanrisi'nin gerceklerine katildigi sürece!

english: Goblins mighty, war good, Big High War God greatest god!
translation: Goblinler güclüdür, savas iyidir, Büyük Yüksek Savas Tanrisi en büyük tanridir!

english: I don't think Zanik is likely to say any of that.
Then she not come here again!
translation: O zaman buraya bir daha gelmesin!

english: Human! Did you save chosen commander from horrible fate?
translation: Insan! Secilmis komutani korkunc kaderinden kurtardin mi?

english: Yes! She's fine now!
That good. Big High War God smile on you now. You honourary goblin!
translation: Bu iyi. Büyük Yüksek Savas Tanrisi simdi sana gülümsüyor. Sen onursal goblin!

english: Me tell Mudknuckles make worm stew for dinner.
translation: Mudknuckles'a aksam yemegi icin solucan yahnisi yapmasini söyleyecegim.

english: Me not like worm stew! Tell him make beetle pie!
translation: Solucan yahnisi sevmiyorum! Ona böcek turtasi yapmasini söyle!

english: Beetle pie give you wind! You smell bad enough already!
translation: Böcek turtasi sana gaz yapar! Zaten yeterince kötü kokuyorsun!

english: Shut up Grubfoot!
But me not say anything!
Shut up Grubfoot!
Shut up Wartface!
Shut up Bentnoze!
Shut up generals!
Shut up goblins!
Last night I have vision of chosen commander. She say me biggest general, so me lead village.
translation: Dün gece secilmis komutanin vizyonunu gördüm. Bana en büyük general oldugumu söyledi, bu yüzden köyü ben yönetiyorum.

english: You not have vision! You make that up!
In my vision, chosen commander say you say that. So now I know it true.
translation: Vizyonumda, secilmis komutan senin bunu söyledigini söyledi. Simdi bunun dogru oldugunu biliyorum.

english: Well... I have vision too. Chosen commander say me big general!
translation: Sey... Benim de bir vizyonum var. Secilmis komutan bana büyük general dedi!

english: That not fair! Me have vision first!
translation: Bu adil degil! Vizyonu ilk ben gördüm!

english: Chosen commander also say you fat and stupid.
translation: Secilmis komutan ayrica senin sisman ve aptal oldugunu söyledi.

english: Shut up!
Now you've solved our argument we gotta think of something else to do.
translation: Simdi tartismamizi cözdün, baska bir sey düsünmeliyiz.

english: Yep we bored now.
What we do now Wartface?
Me dunno... maybe we change armour colour again.
translation: Bilmiyorum... belki zirhin rengini tekrar degistiririz.

english: Human, what colour you think best?
translation: Insan, sence en iyi renk hangisi?

english: What about brown?
Yeah brown is nice.
Thanks human.
Our soldiers need better weapons. We give them all warhammers!
translation: Askerlerimizin daha iyi silahlara ihtiyaci var. Hepsine savas cekici verelim!

english: No no give them battleaxes!
translation: Hayir, hayir, onlara savas baltasi verelim!

english: Axes stupid! They things you cut wood with!
But hammers things you put nails in wood with! At least axes sharp!
translation: Ama cekicilerle oduna civi cakarsin! En azindan baltalar keskindir!

english: You not need sharp when you have strong goblin swinging big lump of iron!
translation: Güclü bir goblin büyük bir demir parcasi salliyorsa keskinlige gerek yok!

english: Do you want me to...
Shut up human, we sort this one out ourselves!
translation: Kapa ceneni insan, bunu kendimiz hallederiz!

english: Human do puzzle for me!
That not right!
Thank you human!
Where's Wartface gone now?
I've heard that one of your number has got hold of part of a map.
translation: Sizden birinin haritanin bir parcasini ele gecirdigini duydum.

english: So how is life for the goblins?
Split their skulls!
Crush them underfoot!
For the glory of the Big High War God!
Brargh!
All glory to Bandos!
CHAAARGE!
We feast on the bones of our enemies tonight!
translation: Bu gece düsmanlarimizin kemiklerini yiyip bitirecegiz!

english: Death to our enemies!
Break their bones!
GRRRAAAAAR!
Not sure this is going to be worth my time but... how are you?
translation: Bunun zamanimi harcamaya deger olup olmadigindan emin degilim ama... nasilsin?

english: SFudghoigdfpDSOPGnbSOBNfdbdnopbdnopbddfnopdfpofhdb ARRRGGGGH
Nope. Not worth it.
*crunch*
For Bandos!
I eat your corpse!
I grind your bones!
You die, puny foe!
Hello.
Good day adventurer.
I'm surprised you're still here. Are you not going back to Ardougne?
translation: Hala burada olmana sasirdim. Ardougne'ye dönmüyor musun?

english: King Thoros and the Prifddinas Elders have agreed that we continue to maintain this outpost. We're now able to rotate our troops between here and Ardougne though, so they can spend more time with their families.
translation: Kral Thoros ve Prifddinas Yaslilari bu karakolu korumaya devam etmemiz konusunda anlastilar. Artik askerlerimizi burayla Ardougne arasinda dönüsümlü olarak görevlendirebiliyoruz, böylece aileleriyle daha fazla zaman gecirebiliyorlar.

english: Good to hear. Anyway, I'll leave you to it.
translation: Bunu duymak güzel. Neyse, seni rahat birakayim.

english: Before I will help you, you must complete this for me.
translation: Sana yardim etmeden önce, bunu benim icin tamamlamalisin.

english: General Hining has given you a puzzle box.
translation: General Hining sana bir bulmaca kutusu verdi.

english: Do not waste my time.
You have done well.
General Hining has given you another clue scroll!
translation: General Hining sana baska bir ipucu parsömeni verdi!

english: What brings you here?
Curiosity. What are you doing?
I'm just leafing through some designs, waiting for the others to decide what's needed. It's taking them a while, but there's sure to be some engineering involved in whatever they decide.
translation: Digerlerinin neye ihtiyaclari olduguna karar vermelerini beklerken, bazi tasarimlara göz atiyorum. Karar vermeleri biraz zaman aliyor, ama ne karar verirlerse versinler, mühendislikle ilgili bir sey olacagi kesin.

english: Okay, thanks.
Just wandering around, really.
You do realise this is a military installation, right? Tourists are generally not welcome.
translation: Buranin askeri bir tesis oldugunu biliyorsun, degil mi? Turistler genellikle hos karsilanmaz.

english: Oh, right.
Halt! Lord Shayzien does not wish to be disturbed.
translation: Dur! Lord Shayzien rahatsiz edilmek istemiyor.

english: Curiosity. What are you doing?
Just wandering around, really.
As you can see, we are busy. What do you want?
What is all this paper for?
This paper, as you call it, contains strategies for use in the war against the lizardmen. The details are a military secret, so do not ask any more questions.
translation: Bu kagitlar, senin deyiminle, kertenkele adamlarla savasta kullanilacak stratejileri iceriyor. Ayrintilar askeri sirdir, bu yüzden baska soru sorma.

english: Fair enough.
I don't want anything.
Then be off with you!
What is all this paper for?
I don't want anything.
Are you in charge here?
Yes. Is there something important you need? We're currently quite occupied.
translation: Evet. Önemli bir sey mi var? Su anda oldukca mesgulüz.

english: Oh yeah?
Yes... We're currently attacking the Lizardmen, are you blind?!
translation: Evet... Su anda Lizardmen'e saldiriyoruz, kör müsün?!

english: I just wanted a chat.
A chat? Who let you into this camp? GET OUT!
translation: Sohbet mi? Seni bu kampa kim aldi? Cik disari!

english: No need to shout. I guess I'm not wanted here.
translation: Bagirmana gerek yok. Sanirim burada istenmiyorum.

english: You are correct! Unless you plan to help with the war effort, you should leave. Now.
translation: Haklisin! Savasa yardim etmeyi planlamiyorsan, gitmelisin. Hemen.

english: Hmph, you need to work on your people skills.
You need to leave.
Bye.
When Chosen Commander come to speak to us again?
translation: Secilmis Komutan ne zaman tekrar bizimle konusmaya gelecek?

Then she not come here again!

english: Yes! She's fine now!

translation: Cok iyi. Büyük Savas Tanrisi simdi sana gülümsüyor. Sen onursal goblinsin!

translation: Solucan yahnisi sevmem! Ona böcek turtasi yapmasini söyle!

translation: Böcek turtasi sana gaz yapar! Zaten yeterince kötü kokuyorsun!

Shut up generals!
Shut up goblins!
Last night I have vision of chosen commander. She say me biggest general, so me lead village.
translation: Dün gece secilmis komutanin vizyonunu gördüm. Bana en büyük general oldugumu söyledi, bu yüzden köyü ben yönetiyorum.

english: You not have vision! You make that up!
In my vision, chosen commander say you say that. So now I know it true.
translation: Vizyonumda, secilmis komutan senin bunu söyledigini söyledi. Simdi bunun dogru oldugunu biliyorum.

english: Well... I have vision too. Chosen commander say me big general!
translation: Sey... Ben de vizyon gördüm. Secilmis komutan benim büyük general oldugumu söyledi!

english: That not fair! Me have vision first!
translation: Bu adil degil! Ben vizyonu önce gördüm!

english: Chosen commander also say you fat and stupid.
translation: Secilmis komutan ayrica senin sisman ve aptal oldugunu söyledi.

english: Shut up!
Now you've solved our argument we gotta think of something else to do.
translation: Simdi tartismamizi cözdün, baska bir sey düsünmeliyiz.

english: Yep we bored now.
What we do now Wartface?
Me dunno... maybe we change armour colour again.
translation: Bilmiyorum... belki zirhin rengini tekrar degistirebiliriz.

english: Human, what colour you think best?
translation: Insan, sence en iyi renk hangisi?

english: What about brown?
Yeah brown is nice.
Thanks human.
Our soldiers need better weapons. We give them all warhammers!
translation: Askerlerimizin daha iyi silahlara ihtiyaci var. Hepsine savas cekici verelim!

english: No no give them battleaxes!
translation: Hayir, hayir, onlara savas baltasi verelim!

english: Axes stupid! They things you cut wood with!
But hammers things you put nails in wood with! At least axes sharp!
translation: Ama cekicilerle oduna civi cakarsin! En azindan baltalar keskindir!

english: You not need sharp when you have strong goblin swinging big lump of iron!
translation: Güclü bir goblin büyük bir demir parcasi salliyorsa keskinlige gerek yok!

english: Do you want me to...
Shut up human, we sort this one out ourselves!
translation: Kapa ceneni insan, bunu kendimiz hallederiz!

english: Where's Wartface gone now?
Ah, so you are there, [Master/Mistress] [player name]. I'm so glad you summoned me. Please take this lamp and make your wish.
translation: Ah, buradasin demek,  Maceraci. Beni cagirdigin icin cok mutluyum. Lütfen bu lambayi al ve dilegini tut.

english: Have a nice day, [Master/Mistress].
Sorry, I'm trying to talk to someone else, but [he/she] seems to be ignoring me.
translation: Üzgünüm, baska biriyle konusmaya calisiyorum ama o beni görmezden geliyor gibi.

english: Greetings, [Master/Mistress] [player name]!
Hello, [Master/Mistress] [player name]?
Ehem... [Master/Mistress] [player name]?
I'm waiting for you, [Master/Mistress] [player name]!
Maybe later.
Ah so you are there master. I'm so glad you summoned me. Please take this lamp, and make your wish!
translation: Ah, Demek buradasin efendim. Beni cagirdigin icin cok mutluyum. Lütfen bu lambayi al ve dilegini tut!

english: Sorry, but I'm trying to talk to [player name]. However he appears to be ignoring me...
translation: Üzgünüm, ama Maceraci ile konusmaya calisiyorum. Ancak beni görmezden geliyor gibi görünüyor...

english: Greetings, Master [player name]!
Ehem... Master [player name]?
Are you there, Master [player name]?
You shouldn't ignore a Genie master [player name]?
translation: Bir cin efendisini görmezden gelmemelisin, Maceraci?

english: No one ignores me!
I lose more masters that way.
translation: Bu sekilde daha fazla efendi kaybediyorum.

english: I am a mighty and powerful genie. Why do you come here? Speak now or I'll have to think of something exceedingly nasty to do to you.
translation: Ben güclü ve kudretli bir cinim. Neden buraya geldin? Simdi konus yoksa sana cok kötü bir sey yapmak zorunda kalacagim.

english: You're a genie, grant me a wish.
Not all genies are goody two shoes who go round granting wishes. It's something that my pathetic brother does to make people like him, but that's not my style.
translation: Tüm cinler, dilekleri yerine getiren iyi kalpli yaratiklar degildir. Bu, zavalli kardesim insanlarin onu sevmesi icin yaptigi bir seydir, ama bu benim tarzim degil.

english: I like to think of myself more as an evil and scary sort of genie, who people talk about in hushed and fearful tones.
translation: Kendimi daha cok, insanlarin sessiz ve korku dolu bir sesle bahsettigi, kötü ve korkutucu bir cin olarak görmeyi seviyorum.

english: Well you seem quite scary.
Why thank you, I put a lot of effort into my terrifyingness.
translation: Tesekkür ederim, korkutuculuguma cok emek veriyorum.

english: Wait! Did you say quite scary? I'll have you know I am VERY scary!
translation: Dur! Oldukca korkutucu mu dedin? Ben COK korkutucuyum, bilgin olsun!

english: Erm yes that's what I meant.
Well I must be off now.
Yes, run. Ruuuun in fear of.. The crevice genie of Nardah! Muhahaha!
translation: Evet, kos. Korkarak kos... Nardah'in yarik cini! Muhahaha!

english: Why are you sitting here in the dark?
Two reasons really. Firstly, I can see in the dark, so light or dark makes little difference to me.
translation: Aslinda iki nedeni var. Birincisi, karanlikta görebiliyorum, bu yüzden isik ya da karanlik benim icin pek fark etmiyor.

english: Lastly, I gather it's normal for powerful terrifying creatures to lurk around in dark caves, so I found this one to lurk in myself, nice isn't it?
translation: Son olarak, güclü ve korkutucu yaratiklarin karanlik magaralarda gizlenmeleri normal bir sey, ben de kendime gizlenecek bir yer buldum, güzel degil mi?

english: Very pleasant, the snakes are a nice touch.
translation: Cok hos, yilanlar da güzel bir dokunus.

english: Why do I get the sense that I'm not being taken seriously here? Please try to remember I am very dangerous and not to be trifled with.
translation: Neden burada ciddiye alinmadigimi hissediyorum? Lütfen benim cok tehlikeli oldugumu ve benimle dalga gecilmemesi gerektigini unutma.

english: I'm just looking around.
I don't know about that. I can't have just anybody traipsing in here. I have a reputation to keep you see.
translation: Bunu bilemem. Herkesin buraya girip cikmasina izin veremem. Korumam gereken bir itibarim var.

english: Actually I'll tell you what, you can hang around here for a bit, but be sure to spread the word about what a terrifying experience you had when you ran into... The crevice genie of Nardah!
translation: Aslinda sana sunu söyleyeyim, burada biraz takilabilirsin, ama karsilastigin korkunc deneyimi herkese anlatmayi unutma... Nardah'in yarik cini!

english: ...Ok I think I can manage that.
Hey get your hands off my house.
Hey, no casting spells on my house!
I'm after a statue that was thrown down here.
Ahh yes someone did drop a statue on my head recently. Very nice workmanship, looks quite old and valuable too. I'm surprised someone threw it away!
translation: Ahh evet, yakin zamanda biri kafama bir heykel atti. Cok güzel iscilik, oldukca eski ve degerli görünüyor. Birinin onu atmasina sasirdim!

english: I have accepted it as a gift as they clearly respect my terrible powers. They seek to keep me at bay by giving me valuables.
translation: Benim korkunc güclerime saygi duyduklari icin onu hediye olarak kabul ettim. Bana degerli seyler vererek beni uzak tutmaya calisiyorlar.

english: Maybe I can make a deal for the statuette?
translation: Belki heykelcik icin bir anlasma yapabiliriz?

english: Hmm a deal eh? I think we can come to some sort of arrangement. I'll give you the valuable statuette in return for, let me think ....
translation: Hmm, anlasma mi? Sanirim bir tür anlasmaya varabiliriz. Sana degerli heykelcigi verecegim, karsiliginda, bir düsüneyim...

english: How about I give you the statue in exchange for the sole of the mayor of Nardah?
translation: Nardah belediye baskaninin tabanini karsiliginda heykelcigi versem nasil olur?

english: Isn't that a little harsh?
I wouldn't have said so. It seems a perfectly reasonable thing to request to me. I can think of many things a lot worse I could have asked for.
translation: Ben öyle demezdim. Bana gayet makul bir istek gibi geliyor. Daha kötü seyler de isteyebilirdim.

english: How am I meant to remove someone's soul?
Oh that's easy. In my experience soles are very easy to remove with just a knife.
translation: Oh, bu cok kolay. Tecrübelerime göre, tabanlar bir bicakla cok kolay cikarilabilir.

english: Ok I agree to the deal.
No way am I agreeing to that.
Ah well it's your loss. No sole, then no statuette.
translation: Ah, senin kaybin. Taban yoksa heykelcik de yok.

english: I'm not sure they know you're down here.
Silence cur! They fear and respect me and that's an end to it.
translation: Sus, köpek! Beni korkuyorlar ve saygi duyuyorlar, bu kadar.

english: Do you have the sole of Awusah, so that we can make our trade?
translation: Awusah'in tabanini aldin mi, böylece takasimizi yapabiliriz?

english: I'm still working on it.
Well no rush, I quite like the statuette too.
translation: Acele etme, heykelcigi de cok begendim.

english: No, it's not an easy thing to get.
translation: Hayir, onu elde etmek kolay degil.

english: Haha, even a pathetic human should be able to manage to get another human's sole.
translation: Haha, zavalli bir insan bile baska bir insanin tabanini elde edebilir.

english: Yes I have it here.
Ah excellent, here's the statuette then.
translation: Ah, harika, o zaman heykelcigi alayim.

english: So um, why do you need part of Awusah's footwear anyway? I hope you're not going to do some nasty magic on his feet or something.
translation: Peki, neden Awusah'in ayakkabisinin bir parcasina ihtiyacin var? Umarim onun ayaklarina kötü bir büyü falan yapmayacaksin.

english: I hadn't thought of that. I just read that a lot of the most powerful beings are collecting soles these days. I haven't really got many yet though. You provided me with an opportunity to expand my collection.
translation: Bunu düsünmemistim. Sadece son zamanlarda en güclü varliklarin cogunun taban topladigini okudum. Henüz cok fazla tabanim yok. Koleksiyonumu genisletmem icin bana bir firsat verdin.

english: I have lost my statuette.
Well fortunately for you, I am a mighty and powerful genie and managed to reacquire it. I will give it to you for another sole.
translation: Neyse ki senin icin, ben güclü ve kudretli bir cinim ve onu geri almayi basardim. Sana baska bir taban karsiliginda verecegim.

english: I will go and get one then.
translation: Gidip bir tane getireyim o zaman.

english: Great! Another one for my collection.
translation: Harika! Koleksiyonum icin bir tane daha.

english: Yes I have one here.
Ah excellent here's the statuette then.
It's good doing business with you again.
Here, have this.
You're a genie, grant me a wish.
translation: Sen bir cinsin, bana bir dilek tut.

english: Well you seem quite scary.
Why are you sitting here in the dark.
Well I must be off now.
Why are you sitting here in the dark?
Very pleasant, the snakes are a nice touch.
translation: Cok hos, yilanlar güzel bir dokunus.

english: I'm just looking around.
I'm after a statue that was thrown down here.
Maybe I can make a deal for it?
translation: Belki onun icin bir anlasma yapabilirim?

english: Isn't that a little harsh?
How am I meant to remove someone's soul?
Ok I agree to the deal.
No way am I agreeing to that.
I'm not sure they know you're down here.
I'm still working on it.
No, it's not an easy thing to get.
translation: Hayir, bu kolay bir sey degil.

english: Can I help you?
What can you tell me about the people here?
Let's see... We currently have Herman & Franklin Caranos, Arnold Lydspor, Devin Mendelberg and Ramara du Croissant. And me, of course.
translation: Bir bakalim... Su anda Herman & Franklin Caranos, Arnold Lydspor, Devin Mendelberg ve Ramara du Croissant var. Ve tabii ki ben.

english: Herman and Franklin are brothers, as you'll know. Herman's always been a fishing nut. Franklin's not all that bothered about fishing, but he does like tinkering with machinery. They're originally from East Ardougne.
translation: Herman ve Franklin kardesler, bildiginiz gibi. Herman her zaman balikcilik meraklisi olmustur. Franklin balikcilikla pek ilgilenmez, ama makinelerle ugrasmayi sever. Aslen Dogu Ardougne'dendirler.

english: Arnold's a bit more of a mystery. We think he might be from one of the barbarian tribes, but he never talks about that. He's always up for a chat, if you can understand his accent.
translation: Arnold biraz daha gizemli biridir. Barbar kabilelerinden birinden geldigini düsünüyoruz, ama bu konuda hic konusmaz. Aksanini anlayabilirseniz, her zaman sohbet etmeye hazirdir.

english: Devin Mendelberg comes from some town in Morytania - ghastly place! I'm not surprised he moved about as far west as he could go! He helps Franklin with the machinery, among other things.
translation: Devin Mendelberg, Morytania'daki bir kasabadan geliyor - korkunc bir yer! Mümkün oldugunca batiya tasinmasina sasirmadim! Franklin'e makinelerle ilgili konularda yardim ediyor.

english: Ramara's another Ardougnian. Her father's a baker there, but she didn't want to spend her whole life baking and doing his accounts. Also, you probably know what Ardougne's crime rate is like - it can't be easy running
translation: Ramara da bir baska Ardougne'lu. Babasi orada firinci, ama o hayati boyunca firincilik ve muhasebeyle ugrasmak istemedi. Ayrica, Ardougne'un suc oraninin ne kadar yüksek oldugunu muhtemelen biliyorsunuzdur - o sehirde bir pazar tezgahi isletmek kolay olamaz!

english: a market stall in that city! I went there once, and some wannabe adventurer started following me around trying to pick my pockets! I kept hitting him, but he kept coming back again and again!
translation: Oraya bir kez gittim ve kendini macera adami sanan biri pesimden gelip cebimi karistirmaya calisti! Bir keresinde oraya gittim ve bir macera meraklisi beni takip edip cebimi karistirmaya calisti! Ona vurup durdum ama o tekrar tekrar geri geldi!

english: You haven't told me about yourself yet.
Oh, I used to work with my sister, Emily, in the Rising Sun in Falador, but I wanted an outdoor job. The pay's better out here too, and the work's not too bad.
translation: Oh, eskiden Falador'daki Rising Sun'da kiz kardesim Emily ile calisiyordum ama acik havada bir is istedim. Burada maas da daha iyi ve is de fena degil.

english: What is there for me to do here?
You can fish! But I'd be very glad if you could go and do something about the skeletal magi in the dormitories. They've kept appearing there ever since the trolls left.
translation: Balik tutabilirsin! Ama yatakhanelerde bulunan iskelet büyücülerle ilgilenirsen cok sevinirim. Troller gittiginden beri orada görünmeye basladilar.

english: Also, if you're into glassbowing, you'll probably want a bit of seaweed. It catches in our nets all the time, so you'll usually find some in the machinery down by the shore.
translation: Ayrica, cam okculugu ile ilgileniyorsan, biraz deniz yosunu isteyebilirsin. Aglarimiza sürekli takiliyor, bu yüzden genellikle kiyidaki makinelerde bulabilirsin.

english: Thanks.
No thanks, I'm fine.
Ok, but come and talk to me anytime.
translation: Tamam, ama istedigin zaman gelip benimle konusabilirsin.

english: What can you tell me about the people here?
What is there for me to do here?
No thanks, I'm fine.
Hey kid, what's all the shouting about?
translation: Hey cocuk, bu bagirislar da neyin nesi?

english: Christmas is ruined!
Again? What's happened this time?
translation: Yine mi? Bu sefer ne oldu?

english: The man in the shop won't give us our Gingerbread Gnomes, he's keeping them for himself.
translation: Dükkândaki adam bize zencefilli kurabiye cücelerimizi vermiyor, onlari kendine sakliyor.

english: That doesn't sound right, are you sure that's really what he's doing?
translation: Bu dogru gelmiyor, gercekten öyle yaptigindan emin misin?

english: Of course he is, why else won't he give us any?
translation: Tabii ki öyle, yoksa neden bize vermesin ki?

english: Something seems off, maybe I should go talk to Santa to find out what's happened.
translation: Bir terslik var, belki de Noel Baba ile konusup ne oldugunu ögrenmeliyim.

english: Do whatever you want, I want my Gingerbread Gnomes!
translation: Ne istersen yap, ben zencefilli kurabiye cücelerimi istiyorum!

english: Where are our Gingerbread Gnomes!
I'm working on it, I'm working on it.
Hurry up!
You've ruined Christmas!
Give us the Gnomes!
Why are you still here? I saved Christmas, you can go home.
translation: Neden hâlâ buradasin? Noel'i kurtardim, eve gidebilirsin.

english: We still have to wait for the delivery to come in, dummy.
translation: Hâlâ teslimatin gelmesini beklememiz gerekiyor, aptal.

english: I'll leave you to it then.
Christmas is Saved!
Hurry up with the delivery!
If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: Senin kadar cirkin olsaydim, yüzümü halka göstermeye cesaret edemezdim!

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: Oh! Sey... Az önce bir tane yedim, o yüzden!

english: Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: Hayatina deger veriyorsan bir daha benimle konusma!

english: Get lost!
I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: Sana verecek hicbir seyim yok, birak beni rahat, dilenci.

english: Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
translation: Su anda bununla ugrasacak vaktim yok.

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: Senin gibi zavalli bir et yiginiyla konusmak istemiyorum.

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: Cok kötü bir gün... tadini cikarin.

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: Eger birini yakalarsan, paylasacagina söz ver.

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
You smell familiar...
Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: Buralarda insan gördün mü? Cok acim.

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: Bana kan tadi seven biri gibi görünüyorsun.

english: Good day to you, my friend.
Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
translation: Kaleye gidip bir seyler atistirmak ister misin?

english: Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: Bir saniye, dislerime bir sey sikismis da...

english: Hello there.
Good day to you traveller, are you here to fish or just looking around? I've caught some beauties down here.
translation: Iyi günler, gezgin. Balik tutmaya mi geldin, yoksa sadece etrafa bakiniyor musun? Burada cok güzel baliklar yakaladim.

english: Really?
The last one was this big!
Hello there.
Hello traveller. Are you here to fish or to hunt for treasure?
translation: Merhaba gezgin. Buraya balik tutmaya mi yoksa hazine aramaya mi geldin?

english: Why do you say that?
Adventurers pass through here every week, they never find anything though.
translation: Her hafta maceracilar buradan gecer ama hicbir sey bulamazlar.

english: Welcome! You can buy fishing equipment at my store. We'll also buy anything you catch off you.
translation: Hos geldin! Magazamdan balikcilik malzemeleri satin alabilirsin. Ayrica tuttugun baliklari da satin aliriz.

english: Let's see what you've got then.
Sorry, I'm not interested.
I want to find out how to catch a lava eel.
translation: Lav yilan baligi nasil yakalanir ögrenmek istiyorum.

english: Lava eels eh? That's a tricky one that is, you'll need a lava-proof fishing line. The method for making this would be to take an ordinary fishing rod, and then cover it with the fire-proof Blamish Oil.
translation: Lav yilan baligi ha? Bu zor bir is, lavdan etkilenmeyen bir olta ipi lazim. Bunu yapmak icin siradan bir olta alip, üzerine atese dayanikli Blamish Yagi sürmelisin.

english: You know... thinking about it... I may have a jar of Blamish Slime around here somewhere... Now where did I put it?
translation: Düsündüm de... burada bir yerde Blamish Slime kavanozum var galiba... Nereye koymustum acaba?

english: Gerrant searches around a bit.
Aha! Here it is! Take this slime, mix it with some Harralander and water and you'll have the Blamish Oil you need for treating your fishing rod.
translation: Aha! Buradaymis! Bu sümügü al, biraz Harralander ve suyla karistir, oltani islemek icin ihtiyacin olan Blamish Yagi elde edeceksin.

english: You've done it!
Gerrant has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
Let's see what you've got then.
Sorry, I'm not interested.
I want to find out how to catch a lava eel.
translation: Lav yilan baligi nasil yakalanir ögrenmek istiyorum.

english: Hello again.
Hello, my dear. How's things?
Did you ever get to talk to those people I told you about?
Yes, strange people. But interesting nonetheless.
translation: Evet, garip insanlar. Ama yine de ilgincler.

english: Well, my dear. Is there anything else I can do for you?
translation: Peki canim. Senin icin yapabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: I'm fine thanks.
Good good, See you again.
Do you have any more kittens?
Indeed I have. They are 100 coins each, do you want one?
translation: Elbette var. Tanesi 100 sikke, ister misin?

english: Oops, looks like I'm a bit short. I'll have to come back later.
translation: Oops, param yetmedi galiba. Daha sonra gelmek zorundayim.

english: Hello again Gertrude!
Well, hello adventurer! How are you?
My cat has caught 100 rats!
Well well! You are good with cats!
Here, I have a little present for you...
translation: Al, sana kücük bir hediyem var...

english: Gertrude shows you a small medal
translation: Gertrude sana kücük bir madalya gösterir.

english: Hey, thanks Gertrude.
Oh, I do love my precious little kittens! Perhaps you could care for one, some day!
translation: Oh, benim degerli kedilerimi cok seviyorum! Belki bir gün sen de birine bakabilirsin!

english: Did Juliet not invite you to her party?
translation: Juliet seni partisine davet etmedi mi?

english: No, me and her aren't friends anymore, she tried to poison my cats.
translation: Hayir, artik arkadas degiliz, kedilerimi zehirlemeye calisti.

english: I should go before I make things worse.
translation: Durumu daha da kötülestirmeden gitsem iyi olacak.

english: Hi Gertrude, do you have any cat hair I can borrow?
translation: Merhaba Gertrude, ödünc alabilecegim kedi kili var mi?

english: Do I look like I collect cat hairs? It may collect onto my clothes like no tomorrow, but I don't hoard it.
translation: Kedi kili topluyormusum gibi mi görünüyorum? Giysilerime bolca yapisiyor olabilir, ama biriktirmiyorum.

english: Sorry for asking...maybe there's another way I can get it off her...
translation: Sordugum icin özür dilerim... belki ondan baska bir sekilde alabilirim...

english: You take Gertrude's comb.
You already have one of Gertrude's combs, it would be rude to take more.
translation: Zaten Gertrude'un taragindan bir tane var, bir tane daha almak kabalik olur.

english: You run the comb through Gertrude's cardigan.
You find some loose cat hairs, you take them and store them in your pocket.
translation: Biraz gevsek kedi kili bulursun, onlari alip cebine koyarsin.

english: Oi! What do you think you're doing?
Oh, uh...nothing! I'll be going now!
translation: Oh, uh... hicbir sey! Ben gidiyorum!

english: You already have some cat hair, best leave it there.
translation: Zaten kedi tüyü var, en iyisi orada birak.

english: I found some cat hair.
Wow, that's very impressive.
Hello little kitty, are you lost?
Eeeerrrr...
Come here little fella, I've got a tasty sardine for you.
translation: Buraya gel kücük dostum, sana lezzetli bir sardalya getirdim.

english: You take the sardine from Gertrude and quickly eat it.
Who's a good fluff ball.
Meooow!
I should go...
Well done.
You've [found a new clue/obtained a casket]!
translation: Yeni bir ipucu buldun/bir tabut elde ettin!

english: I'm fine thanks.
Do you have any more kittens?
Ask about the birthday party.
translation: Dogum günü partisi hakkinda soru sor.

english: Something else.
Yes.
No.
Hello Fluffs.
Purrrrr! So you can talk to cats now?
Yes, I got this amulet from a Sphinx.
translation: Evet, bu tilsimi bir Sfenks'ten aldim.

english: Well, I should thank you for finding my kitten that time. I have a terrible time keeping track of them, and I never know how many Gertrude has managed to sell.
translation: O zaman kedimi buldugun icin sana tesekkür etmeliyim. Onlari takip etmekte cok zorlaniyorum ve Gertrude'un kac tane sattigini hic bilmiyorum.

english: The player's cat is removed from the inventory and begins to follow the player
translation: Oyuncunun kedisi envanterden cikarilir ve oyuncuyu takip etmeye baslar.

english: Hi Mommy!
Hello dear!
Aww, that's sweet.
Is [player name] looking after you well?
No complaints, Mom.
Good, good. That's what I like to hear.
translation: Güzel, güzel. Duymak istedigim de buydu.

english: Hey, aren't you Gertrude's cat?
translation: Hey, sen Gertrude'un kedisi degil misin?

english: What's it to you?
Well seeing as I've had to go off and fetch you for Gertrude already...
translation: Gertrude icin seni almaya gitmek zorunda kaldigima göre...

english: Oh would you ever quit worrying, I come down here to watch the fights all the time.
translation: Endiselenmeyi biraksan ya, ben buraya sürekli kavgalari izlemeye geliyorum.

english: Really?
Oh yes, it's a great place for catching a bit of tail.
translation: Evet, burasi kuyruk yakalamak icin harika bir yer.

english: Ummm, ok. I'll leave you to it then.
translation: Tamam, o zaman seni rahat birakayim.

english: Miaow!
Miaoww
Hisss!
Ouch!
Maybe the cat is thirsty?
Perhaps the cat wants something?
Mew!
Maybe the cat is hungry?
The cat seems afraid to leave. In the distance you can hear kittens mewing...
translation: Kedi ayrilmaya korkuyor gibi görünüyor. Uzakta kedilerin miyavlamalari duyuluyor...

english: Purr...
Purr...
Fluffs has run off home with her offspring.
Can I help you at all?
No thanks.
Yes please. What are you selling?
No thanks.
Good day to you young lady.
I'm happy that we have our water back, thanks for your help.
translation: Suyumuz geri geldigi icin mutluyum, yardiminiz icin tesekkürler.

english: Well it's good to see you happy.
Mostly happy, but young people have no respect for their elders, theres too many confusing newfangled magic carpets and snake charmers around these days. I remember when this used to be fields.
translation: Cogunlukla mutluyum, ama gencler yaslilara saygi duymuyor, bu günlerde cok fazla kafa karistirici yeni moda sihirli halilar ve yilan oynaticilari var. Buranin eskiden tarlalar oldugunu hatirliyorum.

english: It used to be fields?
Well no admittedly it used to be sand, just like it is now, but let an old man have his grumble.
translation: Aslinda hayir, eskiden de simdi oldugu gibi kum vardi, ama yasli bir adamin sikayet etmesine izin verin.

english: Can I help you?
What are you doing out here?
This here is the Warrior's Guild, a place where the strong may train. I'm the one who decides if you are allowed in or not.
translation: Burasi Savascilarin Loncasi, güclülerin antrenman yapabilecegi bir yer. Iceri girip giremeyecegine ben karar veririm.

english: Am I qualified to enter?
Yes you are. Welcome to the Warrior's Guild!
translation: Evet, hak kazanmissin. Savascilarin Loncasina hos geldin!

english: Thank you!
You may not enter the Warrior's Guild as you are right now.
translation: Su anki halinle Savascilarin Loncasina giremezsin.

english: What? But I'm a warrior!
While you may consider yourself a warrior, I do not.
translation: Sen kendini savasci olarak görebilirsin, ama ben görmüyorum.

english: Go on, let me in, you know you want to. I could... make it worth your while...
translation: Hadi, beni iceri al, bunu istedigini biliyorsun. Senin icin... buna degmesini saglayabilirim...

english: Go away and train small one. I do not take bribes.
translation: Git ve antrenman yap, ufaklik. Rüsvet almam.

english: Why not?
The Warrior's Guild has a code of honour, a code that I respect. Move along.
translation: Savasci Loncasi'nin bir onur kodu var, ben bu koda saygi duyuyorum. Git buradan.

english: I'm here to talk about Combat Achievements.
translation: Savas Basarilari hakkinda konusmak icin buradayim.

english: Could you explain what they are?
Combat Achievements are a set of tasks for all adventurers to try and accomplish. They range from simple missions to kill various creatures, to challenges that will push you to your limits.
translation: Savas Basarilari, tüm maceracilarin denemesi ve basarmasi gereken bir dizi görevdir. Bunlar, cesitli yaratiklari öldürmek gibi basit görevlerden, sinirlarini zorlayacak zorlu görevlere kadar cesitlilik gösterir.

english: The purpose of these tasks is for you to grow and improve, experience all that Gielinor has to offer, and become stronger in the process.
translation: Bu görevlerin amaci, senin gelisip iyilesmen, Gielinor'un sundugu her seyi deneyimlemen ve bu sürecte daha güclü olmandir.

english: Is this something that sounds interesting to you?
Yes, tell me about Combat Achievements.
Combat Achievements are broken down into six tiers: Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite, Master and Grandmaster.
translation: Savas Basarilari alti seviyeye ayrilir: Kolay, Orta, Zor, Elit, Usta ve Büyük Usta.

english: Each of these tiers is progressively harder than the last, and to earn any rewards from the latter tiers, the prior tiers must be completed.
translation: Bu seviyelerin her biri bir öncekinden daha zordur ve sonraki seviyelerden ödül kazanmak icin önceki seviyeleri tamamlamaniz gerekir.

english: To complete a tier you will need to conquer every task within it.
translation: Bir seviyeyi tamamlamak icin o seviyedeki tüm görevleri tamamlamaniz gerekir.

english: I'd recommend you go kill some monsters. Come back to me when you've completed a tier or two. I'll reward you for your efforts.
translation: Gidip birkac canavar öldürmenizi tavsiye ederim. Bir veya iki seviyeyi tamamladiginizda bana geri dönün. Cabalarin icin seni ödüllendirecegim.

english: Thanks a lot, I'll get going.
Not at the moment, no.
I have to go.
No, I'm alright thanks.
Here you go.
Your gear is adequate, I'm impressed.
Hey, I have something for you but you don't have any space for it!
translation: Hey, sana bir seyim var ama bunun icin yerin yok!

english: I think I've completed a combat tier!
Oh, how have you been getting on?
I've completed some more Combat Achievement tasks!
translation: Birkac Savas Basarisi görevi daha tamamladim!

Wait, really?
Yes! It took quite a long time. Some of those tasks were extremely challenging, but I persevered and finished them all!
translation: Evet! Oldukca uzun sürdü. Bazi görevler cok zordu, ama azimle devam ettim ve hepsini tamamladim!

english: You have come very far. You have earned these rewards.
translation: Cok yol kat ettin. Bu ödülleri hak ettin.

english: will last 100% longer. And yes, I can also customize your Slayer helmet even more.
translation: %100 daha uzun süre hayatta kalacak. Ve evet, Slayer kaskini daha da özellestirebilirim.

english: I do wonder what you will do now. Good luck, adventurer.
translation: Simdi ne yapacagini merak ediyorum. Iyi sanslar, maceraci.

english: Thank you so much!
Ghommal welcome you to Warrior Guild!
Umm.. thank you, I think.
You not pass. You too weedy.
Heehee... [he/she] say [he/she] warrior... I not heard that one for... at leas' 5 minutes!
translation: Heehee... o savasci oldugunu söylüyor... Bunu en az 5 dakikadir duymamistim!

english: No! You is not a strong warrior, you not enter till you bigger. Ghommal does not take bribes.
translation: Hayir! Sen güclü bir savasci degilsin, büyüyene kadar giremezsin. Ghommal rüsvet almaz.

english: Ghommal stick to Warrior's Code of Honour. When you a bigger, stronger warrior, you come back.
translation: Ghommal, Savasci Onur Kurallarina baglidir. Daha büyük, daha güclü bir savasci oldugunda geri gel.

english: You are handed a torn part of a clue scroll.
translation: Sana yirtik bir ipucu parsömeni verilir.

english: Your gear so strong. Me impressed.
What are you doing out here?
I'm here to talk about Combat Achievements.
translation: Savas Basarilari hakkinda konusmak icin buradayim.

english: Could you explain what they are?
Yes, tell me about Combat Achievements.
translation: Evet, bana Savas Basarilari hakkinda bilgi ver.

english: Not at the moment, no.
I have to go.
No, I'm alright thanks.
I think I've completed a combat tier!
We are waiting for you to join us.
Woooo... Woooooo...
Hello.
You see me? You understand me?
translation: Beni görüyor musun? Beni anliyor musun?

english: Yes. Who are you?
Me Hopespear of Narogoshuun tribe. Who you?
translation: Ben Narogoshuun kabilesinden Hopespear. Sen kimsin?

english: I'm [player name].
You not goblin. What you want here?
translation: Sen goblin degilsin. Burada ne isin var?

english: Why are you here?
Me dead, but me not go. Long ago, me have vision of Big High War God. Me chosen prophet of Big High War God.
translation: Ben öldüm, ama gitmiyorum. Uzun zaman önce, Büyük Yüksek Savas Tanrisi'nin vizyonunu gördüm. Büyük Yüksek Savas Tanrisi'nin peygamberi secildim.

english: Me think, when me die, Big High War God take me to reward in Yu'biusk. Every day great battle, every night great victory with feasting.
translation: Ben düsünüyorum, ben öldügümde, Büyük Savas Tanrisi beni Yu'biusk'a ödül olarak götürecek. Her gün büyük savaslar, her gece büyük zaferler ve ziyafetler.

english: Big High War God not come, but me have faith. Someday Big High War God come for me, take me to him. Until then me hang on, not let go into death.
translation: Büyük Savas Tanrisi gelmedi, ama ben inancimi kaybetmedim. Bir gün Büyük Savas Tanrisi beni almaya gelecek ve beni yanina götürecek. O zamana kadar ben dayanacagim, ölüme teslim olmayacagim.

english: I visited Yu'biusk.
You go to Yu'biusk? What you see?
It was a wasteland.
Wasteland? No goblins fighting glorious battles?
translation: Corak arazi mi? Goblinler sanli savaslar yapmiyor mu?

english: No one. It was all empty.
You lie!
I'm not lying. It's what I saw.
Even so... Yu'biusk is place of Big High War God. Land of Goblins. It where goblins should go.
translation: Öyle olsa bile... Yu'biusk Büyük Savas Tanrisi'nin yeri. Goblinlerin ülkesi. Goblinlerin gitmesi gereken yer.

english: Will you do me favour?
What favour?
High priests in this tomb, when they die they believe they go to Yu'biusk. But their spirits still here.
translation: Bu mezardaki yüksek rahipler, öldüklerinde Yu'biusk'a gideceklerine inaniyorlar. Ama ruhlari hala burada.

english: If you can go to Yu'biusk, you can take their bones and bury them there. Will you do this for me?
translation: Yu'biusk'a gidebilirsen, kemiklerini alip oraya gömebilirsin. Bunu benim icin yapar misin?

english: Yes.
Thank you!
How can I get the bones? When I defeated them before, the high priests just spoke to me and then went back into the ground.
translation: Kemikleri nasil alabilirim? Onlari daha önce yendigimde, yüksek rahipler sadece benimle konustular ve sonra topraga geri döndüler.

english: Normally, undead goblin high priests cannot be destroyed, but there is ancient goblin combat ritual.
translation: Normalde, ölümsüz goblin yüksek rahipler yok edilemez, ama eski bir goblin savas ritüeli var.

english: You must defeat high priests without using any weapons, armour or spells. Once you have bones, take them to Yu'biusk and bury them there.
translation: Yüksek rahipleri silah, zirh veya büyü kullanmadan yenmelisin. Kemikleri aldiktan sonra, onlari Yu'biusk'a götür ve orada göm.

english: I'll do that.
Thank you, human.
No.
Me should know better than to ask human to do favour for dead goblin.
translation: Ölü goblinler icin insandan iyilik istemek ne kadar aptalca.

english: It was everything you hope for.
Thank you! I know Big High War God still care for us! I wait for him here. Someday he take me to Yu'biusk to live with him.
translation: Tesekkürler! Büyük Savas Tanrisi'nin hala bizi önemsedigini biliyorum! Onu burada bekliyorum. Bir gün beni Yu'biusk'a götürüp onunla yasamami saglayacak.

english: In meantime, will you do me favour?
translation: Bu arada, bana bir iyilik yapar misin?

english: I should go.
Tell me about the Big High War God.
Big High War God greatest of all gods! He take puny goblins from Yu'biusk and make them mighty warriors for great war of gods!
translation: Büyük Savas Tanrisi tüm tanrilar arasinda en büyügüdür! Yu'biusk'tan zayif goblinleri alir ve onlari tanrilar arasindaki büyük savas icin güclü savascilar haline getirir!

english: When gods go to war, goblin soldiers so good that Big High War God sell tribes to fight for different gods. Big High War God fight with other gods, sometimes for one, sometimes another.
translation: Tanrilar savasa girdiginde, goblin askerler o kadar iyidir ki, Büyük Savas Tanrisi kabileleri farkli tanrilar icin savasmalari icin satar. Büyük Savas Tanrisi diger tanrilarla savasir, bazen bir tanri icin, bazen baska bir tanri icin.

english: Other gods fight for their own reasons, but Big High War God fight for war itself!
translation: Diger tanrilar kendi nedenleri icin savasir, ama Büyük Savas Tanrisi savasin kendisi icin savasir!

english: Tell me more about yourself.
Me chosen prophet of Big High War God. Before I have prophecy, goblin tribes fight one another very much.
translation: Ben Büyük Savas Tanrisi'nin secilmis peygamberiyim. Ben peygamberlik görevini almadan önce, goblin kabileleri birbirleriyle cok savasirdi.

english: Long ago we fight other people: beardy-short-people, pointy-hat-short-people, tall people with keen blades. Other people build cities with walls, and we not able to attack them any more.
translation: Uzun zaman önce baska insanlarla savasirdik: sakalli kisa insanlar, sivri sapkali kisa insanlar, keskin kiliclari olan uzun insanlar. Diger insanlar duvarlarla cevrili sehirler insa ettiler ve biz artik onlara saldiramadik.

english: There not enough food for all tribes, so tribes with no food attack tribes who have food. Goblin war last many many years. Finally all tribes meet at this place, where temple is now.
translation: Tüm kabileler icin yeterli yiyecek yoktu, bu yüzden yiyecegi olmayan kabileler yiyecegi olan kabilelere saldirdi. Goblin savasi yillarca sürdü. Sonunda tüm kabileler, su anda tapinagin bulundugu yerde bir araya geldi.

english: It rain many days. But rain not stop goblins. Goblin feet churn up ground with rain and goblin blood. All ground turn to mud. That why it called Battle of Plain of Mud.
translation: Günlerce yagmur yagdi. Ama yagmur goblinleri durdurmadi. Goblinlerin ayaklari, yagmur ve goblin kaniyla topragi camur haline getirdi. Bu yüzden bu savasa Camur Ovasi Savasi denir.

english: Battle last many days. Both sides same size, none win, none lose. Goblin bodies everywhere. Many dead.
translation: Savas günlerce sürdü. Iki taraf da esit gücteydi, kimse kazanmadi, kimse kaybetmedi. Her yer goblin cesetleriyle doluydu. Bircok kisi öldü.

english: Me not important general, not mighty sergeant. Me just normal goblin. But one night, me have dream.
translation: Ben önemli bir general ya da güclü bir cavus degilim. Ben siradan bir goblinim. Ama bir gece rüya gördüm.

english: Me see throne of Big High War God. He shine with light so bright me cannot see him, but me hear his voice.
translation: Büyük Yüksek Savas Tanrisi'nin tahtini gördüm. O kadar parlak bir isikla parliyordu ki onu göremedim, ama sesini duydum.

english: He say, 'Stop the fighting!' He say, 'Fighting good, but not if all my followers die! You must not fight one another so much you all die!'
translation: Dedi ki, “Savasi durdurun!” Dedi ki, “Savasmak iyidir, ama tüm takipcilerim ölürse olmaz! Birbirinizle o kadar cok savasmamalisiniz ki hepiniz ölmesin!”

english: Then he say, 'Today I cannot lead you, but some day I will send Chosen Commander to lead you.'
translation: Sonra dedi ki, “Bugün sizi yönetemem, ama bir gün sizi yönetmesi icin Secilmis Komutan'i gönderecegim.”

english: I see Chosen Commander in dream. He wear shining armour and stand at front of army of goblins. Behind Chosen Commander, goblins stretch to horizon. Many goblins, too many to count.
translation: Rüyamda Secilmis Komutan'i gördüm. Parlak zirh giymisti ve goblin ordusunun önünde duruyordu. Secilmis Komutan'in arkasinda, goblinler ufka kadar uzaniyordu. Cok fazla goblin vardi, sayilamayacak kadar cok.

english: I see banners of every tribe. Banners of all tribes, even Dorgesh tribe.
translation: Her kabilenin bayraklarini gördüm. Tüm kabilelerin bayraklari, Dorgesh kabilesinin bile.

english: Other races, they run away from mighty goblin army! Chosen Commander make goblins build siege machines and they break down walls of cities. Then goblins march in and kill everyone!
translation: Diger irklar, güclü goblin ordusundan kaciyorlardi! Secilmis Komutan, goblinlere kusatma makineleri yaptirdi ve onlar sehirlerin duvarlarini yiktilar. Sonra goblinler iceri girip herkesi öldürüyor!

english: And when all dead, Big High War God himself appear and sit on great throne of bronze and rule over all, with Chosen Commander beside him.
translation: Ve herkes öldügünde, Büyük Yüksek Savas Tanrisi bizzat ortaya cikiyor ve bronz tahtina oturup, Secilmis Komutan'in yaninda tümünü yönetiyor.

english: Then I wake from dream. I know it true vision from Big High War God. I run to general of my tribe, and he call other generals for emergency meeting.
translation: Sonra rüyadan uyaniyorum. Bunun Büyük Yüksek Savas Tanrisi'nin gercek bir görüntüsü oldugunu biliyorum. Kabilemin generaline kosuyorum ve o da diger generalleri acil toplantiya cagiriyor.

english: I tell all generals what I see. They decide to stop fighting so goblins not all die. By this time, so many had died that there enough food for all.
translation: Tüm generallere gördüklerimi anlatiyorum. Goblinlerin hepsinin ölmemesi icin savasmayi birakmaya karar veriyorlar. Bu zamana kadar o kadar cok kisi ölmüstü ki, herkese yetecek kadar yiyecek vardi.

english: Then generals set goblins to work building temple on site of battle. It sink into mud, so they turn it into underground temple, and keep it secret from others.
translation: Sonra generaller goblinleri savas alaninda tapinak insa etmeye koydu. Tapinak camura battigi icin onu yeralti tapinagina dönüstürdüler ve digerlerinden gizli tuttular.

english: Goblins write my vision down in goblin holy book, along with history of goblins and commandments of Big High War God.
translation: Goblinler benim vizyonumu, goblinlerin tarihi ve Büyük Savas Tanrisi'nin emirleriyle birlikte goblinlerin kutsal kitabina yazdilar.

english: Tell me more about the Chosen Commander.
translation: Secilmis Komutan hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin.

english: Me not know much more. In vision, Chosen Commander wear heavy armour and big helmet that cover face. Me not know what he look like. I see him give orders, but he far away so me not hear his voice.
translation: Benim bildigim fazla bir sey yok. Görümde, Secilmis Komutan agir zirh ve yüzünü kapatan büyük bir migfer giyiyordu. Nasil göründügünü bilmiyorum. Emirler verdigini gördüm, ama cok uzaktaydi, bu yüzden sesini duyamadim.

english: Me think Chosen Commander will be great goblin general, but Big High War God chose me to have vision, not great general, so Chosen Commander could be anyone.
translation: Secilmis Komutan'in büyük bir goblin generali olacagini düsünüyorum, ama Büyük Yüksek Savas Tanrisi beni görüm sahibi olarak secti, büyük bir general olarak degil, bu yüzden Secilmis Komutan herhangi biri olabilir.

english: Nothing. I should go.
You take bones to Yu'biusk yet?
Not yet.
You please do this for me, human. Remember, you must defeat high priests without using any weapons, armour or spells.
translation: Lütfen bunu benim icin yap, insan. Unutma, yüksek rahipleri silah, zirh veya büyü kullanmadan yenmelisin.

english: I did.
Thank you. Not many humans like you. Now goblin high priests can rest.
translation: Tesekkürler. Senin gibi pek cok insan yok. Artik goblin yüksek rahipleri dinlenebilir.

english: Why are you here?
I visited Yu'biusk.
It was a wasteland.
What favour?
Yes.
I'll do that.
Tell me about the Big High War God.
translation: Büyük Savas Tanrisi hakkinda bana bilgi ver.

english: Tell me more about yourself.
translation: Bana kendin hakkinda daha fazla bilgi ver.

english: No.
It was everything you hope for.
I should go.
Tell me more about the Chosen Commander.
translation: Secilmis Komutan hakkinda bana daha fazla bilgi ver.

english: Nothing. I should go.
WOOOOO!
Aaaah!
Children, run quickly!
Oh my gods, the dragon is coming back!
Quickly, run!
WOOO woooo wooo WOOOO!
Get the women and children to the boats!
On the horizon! Do you see it?
Put that fire out!
Wooo wooo wooOOooOOoo!
Eeeek!
EIEEEEE!
Mummy, are we safe now?
Mummy! Where are you?
Wooo wooo woooooooo!
I don't want to die like this!
Oh no!
Someone help me! I'm trapped!
AAARGH!
Come on, you monster! Just finish me!
It's hopeless. We're all going to die!
We're all doomed.
Woooo wooo wooooo woooo
You cannot understand the ghost.
Don't send me back to that library!
What?
It took me too long to get out of there... Just don't send me back!
translation: Oradan cikmam cok uzun sürdü... Beni geri gönderme!

english: Woooo wooo wooooo woooo.
You there! Seek out the centurion at once. Inform him that the enemy leader has been identified and the Carnifex Maximus himself has been dispatched to bring back his head!
translation: Sen! Hemen yüzbasiyi bul. Ona düsman liderinin kimliginin tespit edildigini ve Carnifex Maximus'un onun kafasini getirmek icin gönderildigini bildir!

english: Err... What?
Did you not hear me? Do I need to spell it out for you?
translation: Duymadin mi? Sana harf harf mi söylemem gerekiyor?

english: If you could that would be great.
Goodness you are a fool! Their leader is named Yonrith Lovakengj. He has fled to the west with his closest allies, but much of his army still remains. Carnifex Maximus Vardorvis is in pursuit of him.
translation: Tanrim, ne kadar aptalsin! Liderlerinin adi Yonrith Lovakengj. En yakin müttefikleriyle birlikte batiya kacti, ama ordusunun cogu hala orada. Carnifex Maximus Vardorvis onun pesinde.

english: Yeah... I still have no idea what you're on about.
