Useless! Perhaps the headsman needs to take your head as well. I will find the centurion myself!
translation: Yararsiz! Belki de cellat senin kafani da kesmelidir. Yüzbasiyi kendim bulacagim!

english: Okay... Good luck with that.
Ah, there you are. Dire news I'm afraid. We've lost all contact with the capital. Worse, another dwarven clan has joined the Saradominists. They march upon the fortress as we speak.
translation: Ah, buradasin. Korkarim kötü haberlerim var. Baskentle tüm baglantimizi kaybettik. Daha da kötüsü, baska bir cüce klani Saradoministlere katildi. Su anda kaleye dogru ilerliyorlar.

english: Oh... Oh dear?
Is everything all right my friend? You don't seem to be yourself.
translation: Her sey yolunda mi dostum? Kendinde degil gibisin.

english: I don't think I'm who you believe I am.
Hmm. You're clearly confused. The lack of sleep is getting to you. Go and have a lie down and we will discuss this later.
translation: Hmm. Acikca kafan karisik. Uykusuzluk seni etkiliyor. Git biraz uzan, bunu sonra konusuruz.

english: Alright...
I've been doing some research into our new foes. Rumour has it they once lived in a great city in the far north. The city fell and now they are homeless.
translation: Yeni düsmanlarimiz hakkinda biraz arastirma yaptim. Söylentilere göre, bir zamanlar kuzeyin uzaklarinda büyük bir sehirde yasiyorlardi. Sehir yikildi ve simdi evsiz kaldilar.

english: It seems they have been promised a new home here in return for wiping us out. We must take great care. We may be fighting for our home, but it seems they are as well.
translation: Görünüse göre, bizi yok etmeleri karsiliginda burada yeni bir yuva vaat edilmis. Cok dikkatli olmaliyiz. Biz evimiz icin savasiyor olabiliriz, ama görünüse göre onlar da öyle.

english: Right... And err, how's the fight going so far?
You tell me, I'm no warrior. That said, I did hear that they'd managed to turn some of our own golems against us. If they can do that, I fear what else they may do.
translation: Sen söyle, ben savasci degilim. Bununla birlikte, bazi golemlerimizi bize karsi kullanmayi basardiklarini duydum. Bunu yapabilirlerse, baska neler yapabileceklerinden korkuyorum.

english: Oh my... That doesn't sound good...
translation: Aman Tanrim... Bu hic iyiye isaret degil...

english: Indeed. We have increased our offerings tenfold, but I fear they fall on empty ears. Perhaps our lord really has gone.
translation: Gercekten. Sunularimizi on kat artirdik, ama korkarim ki kulak ardi ediliyorlar. Belki de lordumuz gercekten gitmistir.

english: Hmm. Well I hope it all works out.
translation: Hmm. Umarim her sey yoluna girer.

english: Whoooo wooo Whooooooooo.
I fought a really big ghost dog in here - is he gone now?
translation: Burada cok büyük bir hayalet köpekle savastim - o artik gitti mi?

english: You were well rewarded for you effort. But you should leave this place, for it is not wise to tarry.
translation: Cabalarin icin iyi bir ödül aldin. Ama burayi terk etmelisin, cünkü burada kalmak akillica degil.

english: But I lost my shadow sword and I don't know how to get it back.
translation: Ama gölge kilicimi kaybettim ve onu nasil geri alacagimi bilmiyorum.

english: Ah, so that is why you return. I can assist you in that and give you another.
translation: Ah, bu yüzden geri döndün demek. Sana bu konuda yardimci olabilir ve sana baska bir tane verebilirim.

english: Who are you anyway...or were you...?
Who I was does not matter. Now, I am a guardian for the Shadow Realm and I am protecting this area from any more disturbances.
translation: Kim oldugum önemli degil. Simdi, Gölge Diyari'nin koruyucusuyum ve bu bölgeyi baska rahatsizliklardan koruyorum.

english: There are those who walk in the Shadow Realm who should not.
Good day, how may I help you?
What is this place?
This is a branch of the Bank of Gielinor. We have branches in many towns.
translation: Burasi Gielinor Bankasi'nin bir subesi. Bircok kasabada subemiz var.

english: And what do you do?
We will look after your items and money for you. Leave your valuables with us if you want to keep them safe.
translation: Esyalarinizi ve paranizi sizin icin sakliyoruz. Degerli esyalarinizi güvende tutmak istiyorsaniz bize birakabilirsiniz.

english: Woooo wooo wooooo woooo

The ghost banker wails incomprehensibly at you, but seems to understand that you wish to access your bank account. You can still quick-bank, but will have to communicate via a series of hand gestures.
translation: Hayalet bankaci size anlasilmaz bir sekilde haykiriyor, ama banka hesabiniza erismek istediginizi anliyor gibi görünüyor. Hala hizli banka islemleri yapabilirsiniz, ancak bir dizi el hareketi ile iletisim kurmaniz gerekecek.

english: I'd like to access my bank account, please.
I'd like to check my PIN settings.
I'd like to collect items.
What is this place?
Would you like to visit Dragontooth Island? It is a most pleasant island in the sea between Morytania and the lands of the east.
translation: Dragontooth Adasi'ni ziyaret etmek ister misiniz? Morytania ile dogudaki topraklar arasindaki denizde bulunan cok hos bir adadir.

english: Yes please.
Player is rowed to Dragontooth Island
No thanks.
Can you take me back to Phasmatys, now?
translation: Beni simdi Phasmatys'e geri götürebilir misin?

english: Yes, climb in.
Player is rowed to Port Phasmatys
There isn't much on this island, is there?
translation: Bu adada pek bir sey yok, degil mi?

english: Beautiful isn't it?
But it cost me a lot of ectotokens to get here!
translation: Ama buraya gelmek bana cok ectotoken'a mal oldu!

english: Worth every token, if you ask me.
Actually, I don't want anything.
Yes please.
No thanks.
Can you take me back to Phasmatys, now?
translation: Beni simdi Phasmatys'e geri götürebilir misin?

english: There isn't much on this island, is there?
translation: Bu adada pek bir sey yok, degil mi?

english: Actually, I don't want anything.
Would you like to visit Dragontooth Island? It is a most pleasant island in the sea between Morytania and the lands of the east. It'll cost you 25 ectotokens for the return trip.
translation: Dragontooth Adasi'ni ziyaret etmek ister misiniz? Morytania ile dogudaki topraklar arasindaki denizde bulunan çok hos bir adadir. Gidis-dönüs yolculugu 25 ectotoken tutar.

english: Okay, here's 25 ectotokens. Let's go.
After a long boat trip you arrive at Dragontooth Island.
translation: Uzun bir tekne yolculugunun ardindan Dragontooth Adasi'na varirsiniz.

english: If I pay 500 ectotokens, can I get unlimited trips?
translation: 500 ectotoken ödersem, sinirsiz seyahat edebilir miyim?

english: Yes, that seems fair. Okay, hand them over and we can set off.
translation: Evet, bu adil görünüyor. Tamam, parayi verin de yola çikalim.

english: Yes, I'd accept that deal. But as you don't have enough ectotokens for that, would you like to pay 25 ectotokens for a trip now?
translation: Evet, bu teklifi kabul ederim. Ama bunun için yeterli ectotokeniniz yok, simdi 25 ectotoken ödeyip seyahat etmek ister misiniz?

english: Not now, thanks.
The ghost sailor wails at you incomprehensibly, and points at the boat, nodding his ghostly head.
translation: Hayalet denizci sana anlasilmaz bir sekilde haykirir ve tekneyi isaret ederek hayalet kafasini sallar.

english: Woooo wooo wooooo woooo
A return trip to Dragontooth Island costs 25 ectotokens.
translation: Dragontooth Adasi'na dönüs yolculugu 25 ektotoken tutar.

english: Okay, here's 25 ectotokens. Let's go.
If I pay 500 ectotokens, can I get unlimited trips?
translation: 500 ektotoken ödersem, sinirsiz yolculuk yapabilir miyim?

english: Not now, thanks.
What is this strange fountain?
This is the Ectofuntus, the most marvellous creation of Necrovarus, our glorious leader.
translation: Bu Ectofuntus, sanli liderimiz Necrovarus'un en muhtesem eseri.

english: What is the Ectofuntus for?
It provides the power to keep us ghosts from passing over into the next plane of existence.
translation: Hayaletlerin bir sonraki varlik düzlemine gecmesini engelleyen gücü saglar.

english: And how does it work?
You have to pour a bucket of ectoplasm into the fountain, a pot of ground bones, and then worship at the Ectofuntus. A unit of unholy power will then be created.
translation: Cesmeye bir kova ektoplazma ve bir tencere ögütülmüs kemik döküp Ectofuntus'a tapinmalisin. Böylece bir birim kutsal olmayan güc yaratilir.

english: Can you do it yourself?
No, we must rely upon the living, as the worship of the undead no longer holds any inherent power.
translation: Hayir, ölülerin ibadeti artik hicbir güc barindirmadigindan, yasayanlara güvenmek zorundayiz.

english: Why would people waste their time helping you out?
translation: Insanlar neden size yardim etmek icin zamanlarini bosa harcasinlar?

english: For every unit of power produced we will give you five Ectotokens. These tokens can be used in Port Phasmatys to purchase various services, not least of which includes access through the main toll gates.
translation: Üretilen her güc birimi icin size bes Ectotoken verecegiz. Bu tokenler Port Phasmatys'te cesitli hizmetler satin almak icin kullanilabilir, bunlarin en önemlisi ana giselerden gecis hakkidir.

english: Where do I get ectoplasm from?

Necrovarus sensed the power bubbling beneath our feet, and we delved long and deep beneath Port Phasmatys, until we found a pool of natural ectoplasm. You may find it by using the trapdoor over there.
translation: Necrovarus ayaklarimizin altinda kaynayan gücü hissetti ve Port Phasmatys'in derinliklerine uzun süre kazdik, ta ki dogal ektoplazma havuzunu bulana kadar. Oradaki kapakcigi kullanarak bulabilirsiniz.

english: How do I grind bones?
There is a bone grinding machine upstairs. Put bones of any type into the machine's hopper, and then turn the handle to grind them. You will need a pot to empty the machine of ground up bones.
translation: Yukarida bir kemik ögütme makinesi var. Makinenin haznesine herhangi bir tür kemik koyun ve kolu cevirerek ögütün. Ögütülmüs kemikleri makineden bosaltmak icin bir tencereye ihtiyaciniz olacak.

english: How do I receive Ectotokens?
We disciples keep track of how many units of power have been produced. Just talk to us once you have generated some and we will reimburse you with the correct amount of Ectotokens.
translation: Biz ögrenciler, üretilen güc birimlerinin sayisini takip ediyoruz. Güc ürettiginizde bizimle konusun, size dogru miktarda Ectotoken verecegiz.

english: How do I generate units of power?
You have to pour a bucket of ectoplasm into the fountain and then worship at the Ectofuntus with a pot of ground bones. This will create a unit of unholy power.
translation: Bir kova ektoplazmayi cesmeye döküp, ögütülmüs kemiklerle dolu bir tencereyle Ectofuntus'a tapinmalisiniz. Bu, bir birim kutsal olmayan güc yaratacaktir.

english: Thanks for your time.
Can I have another bonecrusher, please?
translation: Baska bir kemik kirici alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: Compliments of Morytania for your efforts throughout the tasks set.
translation: Verilen görevlerde gösterdiginiz cabalariniz icin Morytania'nin hediyesi.

english: You already appear to own such a device, mortal.
translation: Zaten böyle bir cihaza sahip görünüyorsunuz, ölümlü.

english: Woooo wooo wooooo woooo
Can I have the tokens I have earned?
I have [number] ectotokens waiting for you mortal, but you do not have room in your inventory for them.
Certainly, mortal. Here's [number] ectotokens.
What is the Ectofuntus for?
Where do I get ectoplasm from?
How do I grind bones?
How do I receive Ectotokens?
Thanks for your time.
Can I have another bonecrusher, please?
translation: Baska bir kemik kirici alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: What is this strange fountain?
All visitors to Port Phasmatys must pay a toll charge of 2 Ectotokens.
translation: Port Phasmatys'e gelen tüm ziyaretciler 2 Ectotoken gecis ücreti ödemek zorundadir.

english: I would like to enter Port Phasmatys - here's 2 Ectotokens.
translation: Port Phasmatys'e girmek istiyorum - iste 2 Ectotoken.

english: Player goes through the gate.
I'm not paying you Ectotokens just to go through a gate.
translation: Sadece kapidan gecmek icin sana Ectotoken ödemem.

english: Sorry - it's Town Policy.
Where can I get Ectotokens?
You need to go to the Temple and earn some. Talk to the disciples - they will tell you how.
translation: Tapinaga gidip kazanmaniz gerekiyor. Ögrencilerle konusun, size nasil yapilacagini anlatacaklar.

english: The ghostly guards wail at you incomprehensibly, and though you cannot understand their exact words you understand their meaning - you may not pass the barriers of Port Phasmatys.
translation: Hayalet muhafizlar size anlasilmaz bir sekilde bagiriyor ve tam olarak ne dediklerini anlamasaniz da ne demek istediklerini anliyorsunuz: Port Phasmatys'in bariyerlerinden gecemezsiniz.

english: All visitors to Port Phasmatys must pay a toll charge of 2 Ectotokens. However, you have done the ghosts of our town a service that surpasses all value, so you may pass without charge.
translation: Port Phasmatys'e gelen tüm ziyaretciler 2 Ectotoken gecis ücreti ödemek zorundadir. Ancak, kasabamizin hayaletlerine paha bicilmez bir hizmet yaptiniz, bu yüzden ücretsiz gecebilirsiniz.

english: The ghostly guards wail at you incomprehensibly, and though you cannot understand their exact words you understand their meaning - you may pass the barriers of Port Phasmatys without charge.
translation: Hayalet muhafizlar size anlasilmaz bir sekilde haykiriyorlar ve tam olarak ne dediklerini anlamasaniz da ne demek istediklerini anliyorsunuz - Port Phasmatys'in bariyerlerinden ücretsiz gecebilirsiniz.

english: I would like to enter Port Phasmatys - here's 2 Ectotokens.
translation: Port Phasmatys'e girmek istiyorum - iste 2 Ectotoken.

english: I'm not paying you Ectotokens just to go through a gate.
translation: Sadece bir kapidan gecmek icin size Ectotoken ödemem.

english: Where can I get Ectotokens?
Hello there!
Greetings, traveller. Welcome to 'The Green Ghost' Tavern. What can I do you for?
translation: Selamlar, gezgin. “Yesil Hayalet” Tavernasina hos geldiniz. Ne icin yardimci olabilirim?

english: Can I buy a beer?
Sorry, but our pumps dried up over half a century ago. We of this village do not have much of a thirst these days.
translation: Üzgünüm, ama pompalarimiz yarim asir önce kurudu. Bu köyde yasayanlar artik pek susamiyor.

english: Can I hear some gossip?
I suppose, as long as you keep it to yourself...
You see Gravingas out there in the marketplace? He speaks for the silent majority of Port Phasmatys, for those of us who would prefer to pass over into the next world.
translation: Pazar yerinde Gravingas'i görüyor musunuz? O, Port Phasmatys'in sessiz cogunlugunun, yani öbür dünyaya gecmeyi tercih edenlerin sözcüsüdür.

english: What happened to the folk of this town?
That's a long story, my friend, but you look like you have the time...
translation: Bu uzun bir hikaye dostum, ama zamanin var gibi görünüyor...

english: Do you know why ghosts exist?
translation: Hayaletlerin neden var oldugunu biliyor musun?

english: A ghost is a soul left in limbo, unable to pass over to the next world; they might have something left to do in this world that torments them, or they might just have died in a state of confusion.
translation: Hayalet, arafta kalan, öbür dünyaya gecemeyen bir ruhtur; bu dünyada onlari rahatsiz eden bir isi kalmis olabilir ya da sadece kafa karisikligi icinde ölmüs olabilirler.

english: Yes, that is normally the case. But here in Port Phasmatys, we of this town once chose freely to become ghosts!
translation: Evet, normalde durum böyledir. Ama burada, Port Phasmatys'te, biz bu kasabanin sakinleri bir zamanlar özgür irademizle hayalet olmayi sectik!

english: Why on earth would you do such a thing?
translation: Neden böyle bir sey yaptiniz ki?

english: It is a long story. Many years ago, this was a thriving port, a trading centre to the eastern lands of Gielinor. We became rich on the profits made from the traders that came across the eastern seas.
translation: Bu uzun bir hikaye. Yillar önce burasi, Gielinor'un dogu topraklarina ticaret merkezi olan, gelisen bir limandi. Dogu denizlerinden gelen tüccarlardan elde ettigimiz kârlarla zengin olduk.

english: We were very happy... until Lord Drakan noticed us.
translation: Cok mutluyduk... ta ki Lord Drakan bizi fark edene kadar.

english: He sent unholy creatures to demand that a blood-tithe be paid to the Lord Vampyre, as is required from all in the domain of Morytania. We had no choice but to agree to his demands.
translation: O, Morytania bölgesindeki herkesten talep edildigi gibi, Lord Vampyre'ye kan vergisi ödenmesini talep etmek icin lanetli yaratiklar gönderdi. Onun taleplerini kabul etmekten baska secenegimiz yoktu.

english: As the years went by, our numbers dwindled and many spoke of abandoning the town for safer lands. Then, Necrovarus came to us.
translation: Yillar gectikce sayimiz azaldi ve bircok kisi kasabayi terk edip daha güvenli topraklara gitmekten bahsetmeye basladi. Sonra Necrovarus bize geldi.

english: He came from the eastern lands, but of more than that, little is known. Some say he was once a mage, some say a priest. Either way, he was in possession of knowledge totally unknown to even the most learned among us.
translation: Dogu topraklarindan gelmisti, ama bundan baska hakkinda pek bir sey bilinmiyordu. Bazilari onun bir zamanlar bir büyücü oldugunu, bazilari ise bir rahip oldugunu söylüyordu. Her halükarda, aramizdaki en bilgili kisiler bile bilmedigi bilgilere sahipti.

english: Necrovarus told us that he had been brought by a vision he'd had of an underground source of power. He inspired us to delve beneath the town, promising us the power to repel the vampyres.
translation: Necrovarus, yeraltinda bir güc kaynagi gördügü bir vizyonun kendisini buraya getirdigini söyledi. Bizi kasabanin altina inmeye tesvik etti ve vampirleri püskürtme gücü vaat etti.

english: Deep underneath Phasmatys, we found a pool of green slime that Necrovarus called ectoplasm. He showed us how to build the Ectofuntus, which would turn the ectoplasm into the power he had promised us.
translation: Phasmatys'in derinliklerinde, Necrovarus'un ektoplazma dedigi yesil bir camur havuzu bulduk. Bize, ektoplazmayi bize vaat ettigi güce dönüstürecek Ectofuntus'u nasil yapacagimizi gösterdi.

english: Indeed, this Ectopower did repel the vampyres; they would not enter Phasmatys once the Ectofuntus began working. But little did we know that we had exchanged one evil for yet another - Ectopower.
translation: Gercekten de, bu Ectopower vampirleri püskürttü; Ectofuntus calismaya basladiginda vampirler Phasmatys'e giremediler. Ancak, bir kötülügü baska bir kötülükle degistirdigimizi bilmiyorduk: Ectopower.

english: Little by little, we began to lose any desire for food or water, and our desire for the Ectopower grew until it dominated our thoughts entirely. Our bodies shrivelled and, one by one, we died.
translation: Yavas yavas, yiyecek ve suya olan istegimizi kaybetmeye basladik ve Ectopower'a olan istegimiz, düsüncelerimizi tamamen ele gecirene kadar büyüdü. Vücudumuz kurudu ve tek tek öldük.

english: The Ectofuntus and the power it emanates keeps us here as ghosts - some, like myself, content to remain in this world; some becoming tortured souls who we do not allow to pass our gates.
translation: Ectofuntus ve yaydigi güc bizi burada hayaletler olarak tutuyor - bazilari, benim gibi, bu dünyada kalmaktan memnun; bazilari ise kapilarimizdan gecmelerine izin vermedigimiz iskence gören ruhlar haline geliyor.

english: We would be able to pass over into the next world but Necrovarus has used his power to create a psychic barrier, preventing us.
translation: Bir sonraki dünyaya gecebilirdik, ancak Necrovarus gücünü kullanarak bizi engelleyen psisik bir bariyer olusturdu.

english: We must remain here for all eternity, even unto the very end of the world.
translation: Dünyanin sonuna kadar, sonsuza kadar burada kalmak zorundayiz.

english: Do you have any jobs I can do?
Yes, actually, I do. We have a very famous Master Bowman named Robin staying with us at the moment. Could you take him some clean bed linen for me?
translation: Evet, aslinda var. Su anda cok ünlü bir okcu ustasi olan Robin bizimle kaliyor. Ona temiz carsaf götürebilir misin?

english: Yes, I'd be delighted.
Oh, thank you. Be careful with that Robin, though - he's far too full of himself, that one.
translation: Oh, tesekkürler. Robin'e dikkat et ama, o cok kendini begenmis biridir.

english: No, I didn't mean a job like that.
translation: Hayir, öyle bir is demek istemedim.

english: Well, you could take that bedsheet through to Robin like I asked.
translation: Peki, istedigim gibi o carsafi Robin'e götürebilirsin.

english: Nothing, thanks.
Can I buy a beer?
Can I hear some gossip?
What happened to the folk of this town?
Do you have any jobs I can do?
Yes, I'd be delighted.
No, I didn't mean a job like that.
translation: Hayir, öyle bir is demek istemedim.

english: Nothing, thanks.
Hi there. Why do you still bother having ships here? I mean - you're dead, what use are they to you?
translation: Merhaba. Neden hala burada gemiler bulunduruyorsunuz? Yani, siz öldünüz, size ne faydasi var ki?

english: We keep ships because we still need trade in Phasmatys. Every trader that comes to Phasmatys is made to worship the Ectofuntus, so that the Ectopower doesn't run out.
translation: Phasmatys'te ticarete hala ihtiyacimiz oldugu icin gemileri bulunduruyoruz. Phasmatys'e gelen her tüccar, Ectofuntus'a tapinmak zorundadir, böylece Ectopower tükenmez.

english: So, without traders to worship in the Temple you're history, right?
translation: Yani, tapinakta tapinacak tüccarlar olmazsa, tarih olursunuz, degil mi?

english: Aye, matey.
Woooo wooo wooooo woooo
Can I help you at all?
No thanks.
Woooo wooo wooooo woooo
You cannot understand the ghost.
Yes please. What are you selling?
No thanks.
What do you want, mortal?
We do not talk to the warm-bloods.
Why did we have to listen to that maniacal priest?
translation: Neden o manyak rahibi dinlemek zorunda kaldik?

english: This cold wind blows right through you, doesn't it?
translation: Bu soguk rüzgar icini delip geciyor, degil mi?

english: Worship the Ectofuntus all you want, but don't bother us, human.
translation: Ectofuntus'a istedigin kadar tapin, ama bizi rahatsiz etme, insan.

english: Woooo wooo wooooo woooo
You cannot understand the ghost.
Hello, welcome to Aluft Aloft, the gnome food delivery service. We deliver gnome foods to customers all over Gielinor. Do you want a job? We are always looking for new staff.
translation: Merhaba, Aluft Aloft'a hos geldiniz, cüce yemek dagitim servisi. Gielinor'un her yerine cüce yemekleri dagitiyoruz. Is ister misin? Her zaman yeni personel ariyoruz.

english: Yes, tell me more.

First of all you will need some basic Gnome Cooking and Cocktail making training. Go and talk to my Father, Aluft Gianne snr. and Blurberry, if you haven't already, and they'll tell you what you need to do.
translation: Öncelikle temel Gnome Yemek Pisirme ve Kokteyl Yapma egitimi alman gerekecek. Henüz yapmadiysan, babam Aluft Gianne snr. ve Blurberry ile konus, sana ne yapman gerektigini söyleyecekler.

english: Once you have got recommendations from both of them I'd be happy to take you on at Aluft Aloft!
translation: Ikisi de seni tavsiye ederse, seni Aluft Aloft'ta ise almaktan mutluluk duyarim!

english: Once you are working for us, I will give you a choice of either an easy or hard job. I will then ask you to make a piece of Gnome Cuisine, and tell you who ordered it, with some information about how to find him
translation: Bizim icin calismaya basladiginda, sana kolay veya zor bir is secenegi sunacagim. Sonra senden bir Gnome yemegi yapmani isteyecegim ve bunu kimin siparis ettigini ve onu nasil bulabilecegin hakkinda bazi bilgiler verecegim.

english: or her. Don't take too long, the order is only valid for a short period of time.
translation: Cok uzun sürmesin, siparis sadece kisa bir süre gecerli.

english: If you complete the delivery successfully, you will be given a tip by the customer and credit towards your own 'free delivery token'.
translation: Teslimati basariyla tamamlarsaniz, müsteri size bahsis verecek ve kendi 'ücretsiz teslimat jetonunuz'a kredi ekleyecektir.

english: I'm ready to take an order now...

I'm afraid you don't have the required training for this job. If you want to work for me you'll have to talk to my father Aluft Gianne snr. for cooking training and Blurberry the barman for cocktail making training.
translation: Maalesef bu is icin gerekli egitimi almamissiniz. Benim icin calismak istiyorsaniz, yemek pisirme egitimi icin babam Aluft Gianne snr. ile, kokteyl yapimi egitimi icin barmen Blurberry ile görüsmeniz gerekecek.

english: Once I get recommendations from both of them, you'll be able to start work for me.
translation: Ikisi de seni tavsiye ederse, benim icin calismaya baslayabilirsin.

english: So that's Aluft Gianne snr. for cooking training, and Blurberry for Cocktail training?
translation: Yani yemek pisirme egitimi icin Aluft Gianne snr. ve kokteyl yapimi egitimi icin Blurberry mi?

english: That's right - Good luck!
Yes, tell me more.
What's the difference between an easy and a hard job?
translation: Kolay ve zor islerin farki nedir?

english: What are these free delivery tokens?
Will this help me with my cooking?
translation: Bu, yemek pisirmeme yardimci olacak mi?

english: I'm ready to take a job on now.
I've changed my mind, there's something else I need to do now.
translation: Fikrimi degistirdim, simdi yapmam gereken baska bir sey var.

english: Not right now, thanks.
So how come you are so agile?
If you were so nutty about nuts, maybe you would understand the great lengths we go to!
translation: Eger findiklara bu kadar düskün olsaydin, bizim ne kadar ugrastigimizi anlardin!

english: What's up with all that squirrel fur? I guess fleas need a home too.
translation: Bu sincap kürkü de neyin nesi? Sanirim pirelerin de bir yuvaya ihtiyaci var.

english: You're pushing your luck! Stop it or you'll face my squirrely wrath.
translation: Sansini zorluyorsun! Kes sunu yoksa sincap öfkemle karsilasirsin.

english: Did you ever notice how big squirrels' teeth are?
translation: Sincaplarin dislerinin ne kadar büyük oldugunu hic fark ettin mi?

english: No...
You could land a gnome glider on those things!
translation: O dislerin üzerine bir cüce planörü indirebilirsin!

english: Watch it, I'll crush your nuts!
That's not an acorn!
I'm watching you.
Give me your nuts!
Nothing is impossible to the squirrel who tries.
translation: Denemeye kararli bir sincap icin imkansiz diye bir sey yoktur.

english: The determined squirrel persists until success is found.
translation: Kararli sincap, basariya ulasana kadar pes etmez.

english: Face my squirrely wrath!.
Hide your nuts!
Greetings! I see you are a new arrival to the world of Gielinor. My job is to welcome all new visitors. So welcome!
translation: Merhaba! Gielinor dünyasina yeni geldigini görüyorum. Benim görevim, tüm yeni ziyaretcileri karsilamaktir. Hos geldin!

english: You have already learned the first thing needed to succeed in this world: talking to other people!
translation: Bu dünyada basarili olmak icin gereken ilk seyi coktan ögrendin: diger insanlarla konusmak!

english: You will find many inhabitants of this world have useful things to say to you. By clicking on them you can talk to them.
translation: Bu dünyanin bircok sakini sana yararli seyler söyleyecektir. Onlara tiklayarak onlarla konusabilirsin.

english: Before we get going, if you could be so kind to let me know how much experience you have with Old School Runescape, that would be wonderful!
translation: Baslamadan önce, Old School Runescape ile ne kadar deneyimin oldugunu bana bildirirsen cok sevinirim!

english: I've played in the past, but not recently.
translation: Gecmiste oynamistim, ama son zamanlarda oynamadim.

english: I am an experienced player.
I am brand new! This is my first time here.
translation: Ben yepyeni bir oyuncuyum! Buraya ilk kez geliyorum.

english: Wonderful! Thank you.
Now then, let's start by looking at your options menu.
You will notice a flashing icon of a spanner. Please click on this to continue the tutorial.
translation: Yanip sönen bir Ingiliz anahtari simgesi göreceksiniz. Ögreticiye devam etmek icin lütfen bu simgeye tiklayin.

english: Looks like you're making good progress! The menu you've just opened is one of many. You'll learn about the rest as you progress through the tutorial.
translation: Iyi ilerliyorsunuz gibi görünüyor! Az önce actiginiz menü, bircok menüden sadece biri. Ögreticiyi ilerledikce digerlerini de ögreneceksiniz.

english: Anyway, I'd say it's time for you to go and meet your first instructor!
translation: Her neyse, ilk egitmeninizle tanisma zamani geldi diyebilirim!

english: Welcome back. You have already learnt the first thing needed to succeed in this world: talking to other people!
translation: Hos geldin. Bu dünyada basarili olmak icin gereken ilk seyi ögrendin: diger insanlarla konusmak!

english: You will find many inhabitants of this world have useful things to say to you. By clicking on them, you can talk to them.
translation: Bu dünyanin bircok sakini sana yararli seyler söyleyecek. Onlara tiklayarak onlarla konusabilirsin.

english: To continue the tutorial go through that door over there and speak to your first instructor!
translation: Egitimi devam ettirmek icin suradaki kapidan gec ve ilk egitmenle konus!

english: I've played in the past, but not recently.
translation: Daha önce oynamistim, ama son zamanlarda oynamadim.

english: I am an experienced player.
I am brand new! This is my first time here.
translation: Ben yepyeni bir oyuncuyum! Buraya ilk kez geliyorum.

english: Hello, Gilbert!
Hey, [player name]!
Can I have a flower crown?
Of course you can. I'll even give you a lovely rainbow scarf to go with it!
translation: Tabii ki alabilirsin. Hatta ona yakisacak güzel bir gökkusagi atkisi da verecegim!

english: There you go.
Thank you, I'll wear them with Pride!
Can I have a rainbow jumper?
Of course you can. There's a couple of extra gifts that I can tell Diango to prepare for you too.
translation: Tabii ki alabilirsin. Diango'ya senin icin hazirlamasini isteyebilecegim birkac ekstra hediye daha var.

english: Can't you give me them all here?
Unfortunately Love is a bit... Precious about how I handle her things.
translation: Maalesef Love, esyalarini kullanma konusunda biraz... hassastir.

english: Thank you, I'll wear it with Pride!
The meadow is looking lovely!
I know! It didn't always look like this though. It used to be dull and grey!
translation: Biliyorum! Ama her zaman böyle degildi. Eskiden sikici ve griydi!

english: Dull and grey? How did it become so colourful?
translation: Sikici ve gri mi? Nasil bu kadar renkli hale geldi?

english: An adventurer came along and helped me out. We cast a magic spell using flower seeds, and it created this lovely sunburst!
translation: Bir maceraci geldi ve bana yardim etti. Cicek tohumlari kullanarak bir büyü yaptik ve bu güzel günes isinlarini yaratti!

english: Oh, I'd have liked to have seen that spell. It sounds impressive!
translation: Oh, o büyüyü görmek isterdim. Kulaga etkileyici geliyor!

english: It was! The news travelled far. I've been getting lots of visitors. Many flower traders from across the lands have paid the meadow a visit.
translation: Öyleydi! Haberler cok uzaga yayildi. Cok sayida ziyaretci aliyorum. Ülkenin dört bir yanindan bircok cicek tüccari cayirlari ziyaret etti.

english: I know! Thank you again for your help with it. It fills me with happiness to see so much colour.
translation: Biliyorum! Yardimin icin tekrar tesekkür ederim. Bu kadar cok renk görmek beni cok mutlu ediyor.

english: I've been getting lots of visitors too. Many flower traders from across the lands have paid the meadow a visit.
translation: Ben de cok ziyaretci aliyorum. Ülkenin dört bir yanindan bircok cicek tüccari cayirlari ziyaret etti.

english: I've even traded with a few for some new flower seeds with different colours!
translation: Hatta birkaciyla farkli renklerde yeni cicek tohumlari takas ettim!

english: That's really cool. What do you do with all the flowers?
translation: Bu gercekten harika. Bütün bu ciceklerle ne yapiyorsun?

english: I make flower crowns in many different colours. I'm wearing one right now!
translation: Bircok farkli renkte cicek taclari yapiyorum. Su anda da bir tane takiyorum!

english: Sounds very colourful!
You're welcome to have one if you'd like, just come back and ask me, anytime!
translation: Isterseniz bir tane alabilirsiniz, istediginiz zaman gelip bana sorabilirsiniz!

english: Thank you. I might do just that!
New flower seeds? What types?
translation: Yeni cicek tohumlari mi? Ne tür?

english: Well as you may have noticed, you can change the colours of the flowers on your flower crown now!
translation: Fark etmis olabileceginiz gibi, artik cicek tacinizin ciceklerinin rengini degistirebilirsiniz!

english: Turns out the spell we cast was more powerful than we first thought.
translation: Görünüse göre yaptigimiz büyü ilk düsündügümüzden daha güclüymüs.

english: So powerful that it made eight new colourations, all as beautiful as the first!
translation: O kadar güclü ki, ilk renkler kadar güzel sekiz yeni renk olusturdu!

english: That's amazing! And all because we wanted a little splash of colour.
translation: Bu harika! Ve hepsi de biraz renk katmak istedigimiz icin oldu.

english: Don't underestimate the power of a little splash of colour!
I'll make sure not too!
Anything happening around here?
Lots of things! It's been pretty busy. There was even a huge colourful parade with thousands of people, and they chose this meadow as the starting place!
translation: Bir sürü sey! Oldukca yogun geciyor. Binlerce kisinin katildigi büyük bir renkli gecit töreni bile vardi ve baslangic noktasi olarak bu cayir secildi!

english: I know, I was there!
You were? I didn't see you!
It was super crowded. I was the one in the colourful outfit.
translation: Cok kalabalikti. Renkli kiyafetli olan bendim.

english: The one in the colourful outfit...?
Ah, yes, like everybody else. I forgot, we were all in colourful outfits!
translation: Ah, evet, herkes gibi. Unutmusum, hepimiz renkli kiyafetler giymistik!

english: Yes! Did you have a good time?
I did thank you. It was really nice to see so many adventurers coming together to bring a splash of colour to Gielinor.
translation: Evet, tesekkürler. Gielinor'a renk katmak icin bu kadar cok maceracinin bir araya gelmesi gercekten cok güzeldi.

english: It truly was, and so many flower crowns too! I was a bit worried the large pile I'd made of them would go to waste, but in the end I almost ran out!
translation: Gercekten öyleydi, bir de o kadar cok cicek taci vardi ki! Yaptigim büyük yigin bosa gidecek diye biraz endiselenmistim ama sonunda neredeyse bitirdim!

english: Sounds like a nice problem to have! Will you be making more for the next parade they do?
translation: Güzel bir sorun gibi görünüyor! Bir sonraki gecit töreni icin daha fazla yapacaksin mi?

english: The next parade?
Yes, I'm sure they'll do another one. If so many people turned up, it must have been a great success. Why wouldn't they want to do it again?
translation: Evet, eminim bir tane daha yapacaklardir. Bu kadar cok insan geldigine göre, büyük bir basari olmus olmali. Neden tekrar yapmak istemesinler ki?

english: That is a good point. I'll get to making some more right away.
translation: Haklisin. Hemen biraz daha yapmaya baslayacagim.

english: Maybe it'll become a yearly thing. A chance to show off some colour, and of course your fancy flower crowns, to all of Gielinor!
translation: Belki yillik bir etkinlik haline gelir. Gielinor'un tümüne renkli kiyafetlerinizi ve tabii ki süslü cicek taclarinizi gösterme firsati!

english: Sounds good to me, gives me time to get lots made in advance.
translation: Bana uyar, önceden bolca hazirlamak icin zamanim olur.

english: Right, well I clearly have work to be getting on with. See you soon!
translation: Tamam, acikcasi yapmam gereken isler var. Görüsürüz!

english: See you!
Really? That's cool! What made it colourful?
translation: Gercekten mi? Harika! Neyi renkli hale getirdi?

english: Everyone turned up in colourful outfits, it was like a sea of rainbows.
translation: Herkes renkli kiyafetlerle geldi, sanki gökkusagi denizi gibiydi.

english: So many flower crowns too! I was a bit worried the large pile I'd made of them would go to waste, but in the end I almost ran out!
translation: Cok fazla cicek tac da vardi! Yaptigim büyük yigin bosa gidecek diye biraz endiselenmistim, ama sonunda neredeyse bitirdim!

english: Do you have any rainbow items I can claim?
Absolutely! I have a jumper, flower crown, and scarf for you. Which would you like?
translation: Tabii ki! Senin icin bir süveter, cicek tac ve atki var. Hangisini istersin?

english: Oh, you appear to already have one of those.
translation: Oh, görünüse göre bunlardan birine zaten sahipsin.

english: You should have all of the previous rainbow items now!
translation: Artik önceki gökkusagi esyalarinin hepsine sahip olmalisin!

english: Can I have a flower crown?
Can I have a rainbow jumper?
The meadow is looking lovely!
Sounds very colourful!
Anything happening around here?
I know, I was there!
Really? That is cool!
Do you have any rainbow items I can claim?
Jumper
Flower Crown
Scarf
All of them
How’s the Glade coming along?
We are currently scouting locations for it. I have a good idea of the kind of place I’m looking for, and I hope we can find it soon. I’ll let you know if we need your help.
translation: Su anda yer ariyoruz. Aradigim yerin nasil bir yer oldugunu iyi biliyorum ve umarim yakinda bulabiliriz. Yardimina ihtiyacimiz olursa sana haber veririm.

english: Absolutely! I have a cape, shirt, jumper, flower crown and scarf for you. Which would you like?
translation: Tabii ki! Senin için pelerin, gömlek, süveter, çiçek taç ve fular var. Hangisini istersin?

english: You should have all of the old rainbow items now!
translation: Artik eski gökkusagi esyalarinin hepsine sahip olmalisin!

english: How’s the Glade coming along?
Cape
Shirt
More
Previous
Hello, chap! Gilbert's the name. How may I help?
translation: Merhaba dostum! Benim adim Gilbert. Nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: Hey Gilbert, I'm [player name]! I couldn't help but notice that rainbow near you. Where did it come from?
translation: Merhaba Gilbert, ben Maceraci! Yanindaki gökkusagini fark ettim. Nereden geldi?

english: 'Tis strange, isn't it [player name]? They appear almost anywhere in the world, I couldn't say where it came from... That being said, rainbows certainly are beautiful and aren't afraid to show their colours to the world! They fill me with such pride.
translation: Garip, degil mi Maceraci? Dünyanin hemen her yerinde görünüyorlar, nereden geldiklerini bilemiyorum... Bununla birlikte, gökkusaklari gercekten cok güzeller ve renklerini dünyaya göstermekten cekinmiyorlar! Beni gururlandiriyorlar.

english: 'Tis upsetting though. I've always wanted to show my colours like a rainbow, but I can't seem to get the ingredients I need... All of my clothing is plain.
translation: Ama üzücü de. Her zaman gökkusagi gibi renklerimi göstermek istemisimdir, ama ihtiyacim olan malzemeleri bulamiyorum... Tüm giysilerim düz renk.

english: You know, I've never thought about it like that!
translation: Biliyor musun, hic bu sekilde düsünmemistim!

english: Maybe I could help in some way?
I'm not sure how much you know about rainbows, but they have a lot of colours to show! They also have a lot of colours to share.
translation: Gökkusaklari hakkinda ne kadar bilginiz var bilmiyorum, ama gökkusaklari bircok renk gösterir! Ayrica paylasacaklari bircok renkleri vardir.

english: Sadly, some of those colours are in short supply so I'd feel bad asking you to take those.
translation: Ne yazik ki, bu renklerin bazilari kit oldugu icin sizden bunlari almanizi istemekten cekiniyorum.

english: There's six colours that are in higher supply though: red, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple.
translation: Ancak alti renk daha bol miktarda mevcut: kirmizi, turuncu, sari, yesil, mavi ve mor.

english: I can sense where rainbows are with extra strands of each of these colours...
translation: Gökkusaginin bu renklerin fazladan iplikciklerinin oldugu yerleri hissedebiliyorum...

english: Could you find them for me, and take some of their spare colour?
translation: Onlari benim icin bulabilir ve fazladan renklerinden biraz alabilir misin?

english: Sounds fun!
Now then, [player name] - Have you got any questions for me?
translation: Peki, Maceraci - Bana soracagin bir sey var mi?

english: What am I doing, again?
Well, I've always wanted to show my colours like a rainbow, but I can't seem to get the ingredients I need myself.
translation: Sey, her zaman gökkusagi gibi renklerimi göstermek istemisimdir, ama ihtiyacim olan malzemeleri kendim bulamiyorum.

english: I'm able to sense the location of these rainbows in my mind, but it's always a little hazy. Feel free to ask me to sense a rainbow with extra strands of red, orange, yellow, green, blue or purple!
translation: Bu gökkusaklarinin yerini zihnimde hissedebiliyorum, ama her zaman biraz bulanik. Kirmizi, turuncu, sari, yesil, mavi veya mor renklerin ekstra iplikcikleriyle bir gökkusagini hissetmemi isteyebilirsiniz!

english: Why am I only gathering six colours?
Well we don't want to take all of the colour from the rainbows! Some have extra strands of certain colours, and those are the ones I'll direct you towards...
translation: Gökkusaginin tüm renklerini almak istemeyiz! Bazilari belirli renklerden fazladan ipliklere sahiptir ve ben sizi onlara yönlendirecegim...

english: But rainbows have so many colours! Surely there's some with other colours spare?
translation: Ama gökkusaginin cok fazla rengi var! Elbette baska renklerden fazladan olanlar da vardir?

english: Some colours are in such short supply for every rainbow. Besides, it's the thought that counts! Even displaying a small selection of colours to others makes them feel comfortable showing theirs!
translation: Bazi renkler her gökkusaginda cok az miktarda bulunur. Ayrica, önemli olan niyettir! Baskalarina az sayida renk göstermek bile onlarin kendilerini rahat hissetmelerini saglar!

english: I never thought of it like that... Thanks Gilbert!
Anytime, [player name]! Now, is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Ne zaman istersen, Maceraci! Simdi, baska yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Can you tell me where I can find a rainbow with extra red strands?
translation: Ekstra kirmizi seritleri olan bir gökkusagini nerede bulabilecegimi söyleyebilir misin?

english: I can see it...
South of my magical location, I see life! New adventurers and baldness rife.
translation: Sihirli konumumun güneyinde, hayat görüyorum! Yeni maceracilar ve yaygin kellik.

english: Can you tell me where I can find a rainbow with extra orange strands?
translation: Ekstra turuncu seritleri olan bir gökkusagini nerede bulabilecegimi söyleyebilir misin?

english: Beside me now, a person of healing. Those who test their luck, find this place appealing.
translation: Su anda yanimda, sifa veren bir kisi var. Sansini deneyenler, burayi cekici buluyor.

english: Can you tell me where I can find a rainbow with extra yellow strands?
translation: Ekstra sari seritleri olan bir gökkusagini nerede bulabilecegimi söyleyebilir misin?

english: On my face; shining sunlight. South of a dwarf whom redberries delight.
translation: Yüzümde; parlayan günes isigi. Kirmizi meyvelerden hoslanan bir cücenin güneyinde.

english: Can you tell me where I can find a rainbow with extra green strands?
translation: Ekstra yesil seritleri olan bir gökkusagini nerede bulabilecegimi söyleyebilir misin?

english: Lush nature and trees are to the east. The Green strand... no orange! No, blue! No, red! Green! Argh! There's so much bickering in this area it's hard to pinpoint its location... Sorry, [player name]!
translation: Yemyesil doga ve agaclar doguda. Yesil serit... hayir, turuncu! Hayir, mavi! Hayir, kirmizi! Yesil! Ah! Bu bölgede o kadar cok tartisma var ki, yerini tam olarak belirlemek zor... Üzgünüm, Maceraci!

english: Can you tell me where I can find a rainbow with extra blue strands?
translation: Ekstra mavi seritleri olan bir gökkusagini nerede bulabilirim?

english: In this area, there's a silent and artistic harmony... Ironically, north west, wizards kill newcomers effortlessly.
translation: Bu bölgede sessiz ve sanatsal bir uyum var... Ironik olarak, kuzeybatida büyücüler yeni gelenleri kolayca öldürüyor.

english: Can you tell me where I can find a rainbow with extra purple strands?
translation: Ekstra mor seritleri olan bir gökkusagini nerede bulabilirim?

english: The knights in this area, are full of Saradomin's spirit. On the top of this fortress, when I yell - all hear it!
translation: Bu bölgedeki sövalyeler, Saradomin'in ruhuyla doludur. Bu kalenin tepesinde bagirdigimda, herkes duyar!

english: I'm not someone who needs to show my colours...
translation: Ben renklerimi göstermek zorunda olan biri degilim...

english: Oh, that is most upsetting.
Sometimes just showing your own colours makes other people comfortable showing theirs, you know?
translation: Bazen kendi renklerini göstermek, diger insanlarin da renklerini göstermelerini kolaylastirir, biliyor musun?

english: This rainbow has no spare colour to take. Gilbert may know where to find one with spare colour strands.
translation: Bu gökkusaginda alinacak yedek renk yok. Gilbert, yedek renk seritleri olan bir gökkusagini nerede bulabilecegini biliyor olabilir.

english: You take a spare Red strand from the rainbow.
translation: Gökkusagindan yedek bir Kirmizi iplik aliyorsun.

english: You take a spare Orange strand from the rainbow.
translation: Gökkusagindan yedek bir Turuncu iplik aliyorsun.

english: You take a spare Yellow strand from the rainbow.
translation: Gökkusagindan yedek bir Sari iplik aliyorsun.

english: You take a spare Green strand from the rainbow.
translation: Gökkusagindan yedek bir Yesil iplik aliyorsun.

english: You take a spare Blue strand from the rainbow.
translation: Gökkusagindan yedek bir Mavi iplik aliyorsun.

english: You already have an Blue strand from this rainbow. Perhaps give Gilbert the strand, or look for the other rainbows?
translation: Bu gökkusagindan zaten bir Mavi iplik var. Belki Gilbert'e ipligi vermelisin ya da diger gökkusaklarini aramalisin?

english: You take a spare Purple strand from the rainbow.
translation: Gökkusagindan yedek bir Mor iplik aliyorsun.

english: I still need to give Gilbert a red rainbow strand.
translation: Gilbert'e hala kirmizi gökkusagi ipligi vermem gerekiyor.

english: I still need to give Gilbert an orange rainbow strand.
translation: Gilbert'e hala turuncu gökkusagi ipligi vermem gerekiyor.

english: I still need to give Gilbert a Green rainbow strand.
translation: Gilbert'e hala yesil gökkusagi ipligi vermem gerekiyor.

english: I still need to give Gilbert a blue rainbow strand.
translation: Gilbert'e hala mavi gökkusagi ipligi vermem gerekiyor.

english: I still need to give Gilbert a purple rainbow strand.
translation: Gilbert'e hala mor gökkusagi ipligi vermem gerekiyor.

english: [Player name], that's all of them! All six rainbow strands!
translation: Maceraci, hepsi bu kadar! Alti gökkusagi ipliginin hepsi!

english: I can't thank you enough!
translation: Sana ne kadar tesekkür etsem azdir!

english: No problem at all, Gilbert! Always happy to help. What exactly are you going to make with all those strands, anyway?
translation: Hic sorun degil, Gilbert! Her zaman yardimci olmaktan mutluluk duyarim. Bu ipliklerle tam olarak ne yapacaksin?

english: You know, [player name]. All this time I've been wanting to show my colours like a rainbow and you've made me realise something...
translation: Biliyor musun, Maceraci. Bunca zamandir gökkusagi gibi renklerimi göstermek istiyordum ve sen bana bir seyin farkina varmami sagladin...

english: What you've made me realise, [player name], is that people like yourself who are willing to support those who wish to show their own colours proudly...
translation: Bana fark ettirdigin sey, Maceraci, senin gibi kendi renklerini gururla göstermek isteyenleri desteklemeye istekli olan insanlar...

english: You're the reason I feel confident showing my colours! I want you to have this - you deserve it.
translation: Renklerimi göstermekten cekinmememin sebebi sensin! Bunu almani istiyorum, bunu hak ediyorsun.

english: Thank you so much for the scarf, Gilbert. It's wonderful!
translation: Esarp icin cok tesekkürler, Gilbert. Harika olmus!

english: It's no problem at all, [player name]. I added a little heart on the item to show my personal thanks. Thank you for your help! Wear it with pride, and let everyone know to show their own colours proudly!
translation: Hic sorun degil, Maceraci. Kisisel tesekkürlerimi göstermek icin esarp üzerine kücük bir kalp ekledim. Yardimin icin tesekkürler! Gururla tak ve herkese kendi renklerini gururla göstermelerini söyle!

english: I will! Take care.
yellow
Say nothing.
I've never thought about it like that!
Maybe I could help in some way?
Sounds fun!
What am I doing, again?
Why am I only gathering six colours?
Red rainbow strand hint.
Orange rainbow strand hint.
Other hints.
Yellow rainbow strand hint.
Green rainbow strand hint.
Blue rainbow strand hint.
Purple rainbow strand hint.
Previous hints.
Not right now.
I'm not someone who needs to show my colours...
translation: Ben renklerimi göstermesi gereken biri degilim...

english: Sorry, let me think about it first.
I must be leaving now.
Sorry, but I'm trying to talk to [other player's display name], but [he/she] seems to be ignoring me.
translation: Üzgünüm, ama su gerizekali ile konusmaya calisiyorum, ama o beni görmezden geliyor gibi.

english: Greetings [player name], I need your help.
Talk to me, [player name]!
Hello, [player name], are you there?
I'd like to talk to you, [player name]!
ehem... Hello [player name], please talk to me!
translation: Ehem... Merhaba Maceraci, lütfen benimle konus!

english: Maybe later.
Hello, I'm Gillie the Milkmaid. What can I do for you?
translation: Merhaba, ben sütcü Gillie. Senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: Who are you?
My name is Gillie Groats. My father is a farmer and I milk the cows for him.
translation: Benim adim Gillie Groats. Babam ciftci ve ben onun icin inekleri sagiyorum.

english: Do you have any buckets of milk spare?
I'm afraid not. We need all of our milk to sell to market, but you can milk the cow yourself if you need the milk.
translation: Maalesef yok. Tüm sütümüzü pazarda satmamiz gerekiyor, ama süt gerekiyorsa inegi kendin sagabilirsin.

english: Thanks.
So how do you milk a cow then?
It's very easy. First you need an empty bucket to hold the milk.
translation: Cok kolay. Önce sütü koymak icin bos bir kova lazim.

english: Then find a dairy cow to milk - you can't milk just any cow.
translation: Sonra sagmak icin bir süt inegi bulmalisin - her inegi sagamazsin.

english: How do I find a dairy cow?
They are easy to spot - they are dark brown and white, unlike beef cows, which are light brown and white. We also tether them to a post to stop them wandering around all over the place.
translation: Onlari kolayca fark edebilirsiniz - acik kahverengi ve beyaz olan et ineginden farkli olarak koyu kahverengi ve beyazdirlar. Ayrica, her yere dagilmalarini önlemek icin onlari bir direge baglariz.

english: There are a couple very near, in this field.
translation: Bu tarlada cok yakininizda birkac tane var.

english: Then just milk the cow and your bucket will fill with tasty, nutritious milk.
translation: Sonra inegi sagarsiniz ve kovunuz lezzetli, besleyici sütle dolar.

english: I'm fine, thanks.
Tee hee! You've never milked a cow before, have you?
translation: Tee hee! Daha önce hic inek sagmadin, degil mi?

english: Erm... No. How could you tell?
Because you're spilling milk all over the floor. What a waste! You need something to hold the milk.
translation: Cünkü sütü yere döküyorsun. Ne israf! Sütü tutacak bir seye ihtiyacin var.

english: Ah yes, I really should have guessed that one, shouldn't I?
translation: Ah evet, bunu tahmin etmeliydim, degil mi?

english: You're from the city, aren't you... Try it again with an empty bucket.
translation: Sen sehirden geliyorsun, degil mi... Bos bir kova ile tekrar dene.

english: Right, I'll do that.
I should probably go somewhere that Gillie might actually see me.
translation: Gillie'nin beni görebilecegi bir yere gitmeliyim.

english: You hang the amulet on one of your branches and wait for Gillie to notice you...
translation: Tilsimi dallarindan birine as ve Gillie'nin seni fark etmesini bekle...

english: Oh my! That Christmas tree certainly did grow quickly.
translation: Aman Tanrim! Bu Noel agaci gercekten cok hizli büyümüs.

english: And that necklace hanging on it! Is that...
translation: Ve üzerinde asili olan kolye! Bu...

english: Gillie gleefully takes the amulet off of the branch and hangs it around her own neck as a clone of her appears before your very eyes.
translation: Gillie neseyle tilsimi daldan alir ve kendi boynuna asar, tam o sirada bir klonu gözlerinin önünde belirir.

english: Hey... You look just like me!
You are me! This is perfect!
Well, Gillie seems happy with that!
Who are you?
Can you tell me how to milk a cow?
Player: I'm fine, thanks.
Have ye come for an outfit like mine? Or else whatcha want?
translation: Benimki gibi bir kiyafet mi almaya geldin? Yoksa ne istiyorsun?

english: Who are you?
Don't ye recognise the greatest angler in all the land? Never mind Grandpa Jack an' Big Dave, or that jack- of-all-trades Mac - I'm Gita Prymes!
translation: Bu ülkenin en iyi balikcisini tanimadin mi? Jack Dede ve Big Dave'i, ya da her isi yapan Mac'i bos ver - ben Gita Prymes'im!

english: Have you won the Hemenster Fishing Competition?
Um...
Keep yer triflin' talk of poxy contests - Gita Prymes has bigger fish to catch! And I am Gita Prymes.
translation: Önemsiz yarismalardan bahsetmeyi birak - Gita Prymes'in daha büyük baliklari var! Ve ben Gita Prymes'im.

english: Okay, you're Gita Prymes.
That I be! Now, are ye here for an outfit like mine?
translation: Öyleyim! Simdi, benimki gibi bir kiyafet mi almak icin geldin?

english: Let's talk about outfits.
Aye. See, a lot of anglers wear ugly green stuff. It 'elps them wi' the fishing, to be sure, but they look so rotten in it. So Gita Prymes invented something better- looking.
translation: Evet. Bak, bircok balikci cirkin yesil seyler giyiyor. Balik tutmalarina yardimci oluyor, ama icinde cok cirkin görünüyorlar. Bu yüzden Gita Prymes daha güzel bir sey icat etti.

english: It'll cost ye some spirit flakes but Gita Prymes can change yer Spirit Angler back to normal Angler for free if ye want it. Which ever suits ye.
translation: Biraz ruh puluna mal olacak, ama Gita Prymes istersen Spirit Angler kiyafetini ücretsiz olarak normal Angler kiyafetine dönüstürebilir. Hangisi sana uygunsa.

english: Can you turn my Angler outfit into the Spirit Angler outfit?
translation: Olta kiyafetimi Ruhlu Olta kiyafetine dönüstürebilir misin?

english: Sure, hand me a piece of the regular Angler kit. I'll want 1,200 spirit flakes for a hat, the top for 1,200 spirit flakes, the leggings for 1,200 spirit flakes and the footwear for 1,200 spirit flakes.
translation: Tabii, bana normal Olta kiyafetinden bir parca ver. Sapka icin 1.200 ruh puluna, üst icin 1.200 ruh puluna, tozluklar icin 1.200 ruh puluna ve ayakkabilar icin 1.200 ruh puluna ihtiyacim olacak.

english: Actually, I don't have any Angler kit on me at the moment, sorry.
translation: Aslinda su anda üzerimde Angler kiyafeti yok, üzgünüm.

english: Can you turn my Spirit Angler outfit back into the regular Angler outfit?
translation: Spirit Angler kiyafetimi normal Angler kiyafetine geri dönüstürebilir misin?

english: Sure, hand me a piece of the Spirit Angler kit an' I'll convert it back for free.
translation: Tabii, bana Spirit Angler kiyafetinden bir parca ver, ücretsiz olarak geri dönüstürürüm.

english: Actually, I don't have any Spirit Angler kit on me at the moment, sorry.
translation: Aslinda su anda üzerimde Spirit Angler kiyafeti yok, üzgünüm.

english: Gita Prymes can exchange your Spirit Angler kit for regular Angler kit, but will not return your spirit flakes. You can convert it back to the Spirit Angler version for free.
translation: Gita Prymes, Ruh Balikcisi kitini normal Balikci kitiyle degistirebilir, ancak ruh pullarini geri vermez. Ücretsiz olarak Ruh Balikcisi versiyonuna geri dönüstürebilirsin.

english: I don't think I need anything from you.
translation: Senden bir seye ihtiyacim yok sanirim.

english: Nay, Gita Prymes won't take that.
translation: Hayir, Gita Prymes bunu kabul etmez.

english: Who are you?
Have you won the Hemenster Fishing Competition?
Okay, you're Gita Prymes.
Let's talk about outfits.
Ask about the Spirit Angler outfit.
translation: Ruh Avcisi kiyafeti hakkinda soru sor.

english: Cancel
Proceed
Ask about the regular Angler outfit.
translation: Normal Avci kiyafeti hakkinda soru sor.

english: I don't think I need anything from you.
translation: Senden bir seye ihtiyacim yok sanirim.

english: Hi.
What brings you down here, Rookie?
I heard all the grunting and metal clanging. I wanted to see what was going on.
translation: Homurtular ve metal sesleri duydum. Ne oldugunu görmek istedim.

english: What do you think of our training area?
Well... It smells a bit.
That is the smell of courage.
Hello there.
Greetings, Rookie.
You lot sure look busy down here.
We strive to become the best.
Well best of luck!
Hello.
Hello, Rookie. You'll have to excuse me. I'm keeping an eye on the other contenders.
translation: Merhaba, caylak. Izninle. Diger rakipleri gözetliyorum.

english: May the odds be ever in your favour.
What a nice thing to say.
You're not tired of doing that all day?
translation: Bütün gün bunu yapmaktan yorulmuyor musun?

english: I'm going to slay anything in my path!
You certainly are determined!
Hi there.
Stand back, Rookie. I need to concentrate.
translation: Geri cekil, caylak. Konsantre olmam lazim.

english: You seemed to have that weapon mastered.
Kill...
No...
... survivors!
That's impressive. I'll leave you to it.
Can't talk... I've got 100 more to do.
Good luck.
Hel-
Can't you see I'm busy here?
Of course... Enjoy your floor pushing.
translation: Tabii ki... Katlari temizlemenin tadini cikar.

english: Well met stranger, how do you come to be in this place?
I'm a friend of the Easter Bunny, I've been looking for him.
Is that so? Well that makes you my friend too. Me and Rinder here helped that crazy priest track him down.
translation: Öyle mi? O zaman sen de benim arkadasimsin. Ben ve Rinder, o cilgin rahibin onu bulmasina yardim ettik.

english: That we did.
I see, that was good of you.
I won't lie, it was no selfless act. We've been promised grand rewards.
translation: Yalan söylemeyecegim, bu özverili bir davranis degildi. Bize büyük ödüller vaat edildi.

english: Eggs! Big chocolate eggs!
It always comes down to eggs!
I'd like to make some Easter Buns, I don't suppose you have any raisins?
translation: Paskalya cörekleri yapmak istiyorum, kuru üzümün var mi acaba?

english: And why would you think a man like me would have any raisins?
translation: Neden benim gibi bir adamin kuru üzümü olacagini düsünüyorsun?

english: I'm not sure, I don't actually know what raisins are to be honest.
translation: Emin degilim, acikcasi kuru üzümün ne oldugunu bilmiyorum.

english: Well I'll be! Kid, raisins are dried-up grapes.
translation: Vay canina! Evlat, kuru üzüm kurutulmus üzümdür.

english: Oh, well do you have any of those?
Not yet.
Not yet?
That's what I said.
As it happens I have a sackful of grapes in my possession.
translation: Aslinda bende bir cuval dolusu üzüm var.

english: How convenient, dare I ask why?
translation: Ne kadar da uygun, nedenini sorabilir miyim?

english: There are great and terrible beasts in this world kid. We'd been hunting them, and believe me when I tell ye, some of 'em had an awful lot of grapes on their person.
translation: Bu dünyada büyük ve korkunc canavarlar var evlat. Onlari avliyorduk ve inan bana, bazilarinin üzerinde cok fazla üzüm vardi.

english: The slaughter was feverish. We'd cut 'em down and they'd rise up, again and again.
translation: Katliam cok heyecanliydi. Onlari öldürdük ama tekrar tekrar dirildiler.

english: Before we knew it, we'd collected a whole sackful o' grapes!
translation: Farkina varmadan bir cuval dolusu üzüm toplamistik!

english: Seems to me we could make those into raisins, should that align with your intentions.
translation: Bana kalirsa, bunlari kuru üzüm yapabiliriz, eger senin de niyetin buysa.

english: What luck! Shall we then?
translation: Ne sans! Gidelim mi o zaman?

english: Well alright, it'll be a long journey though.
translation: Tamam, ama uzun bir yolculuk olacak.

english: Rinder!
What say ye, Glanton?
Our friend here needs some raisins, let's head to the desert!
translation: Arkadasimizin kuru üzüme ihtiyaci var, cöle gidelim!

english: Pack yer grapes, then. Let's go.
Cutscene starts: "After a long walk, you reach the desert."
translation: Kesme sahnesi baslar: “Uzun bir yürüyüsün ardindan cöle ulasirsiniz.”

english: Here we are.
Here? This big rock?
translation: Buraya mi? Bu büyük kayaya mi?

english: This big rock is perfect fer makin' raisins, kid. It's real warm.
translation: Bu büyük kaya kuru üzüm yapmak icin mükemmel, evlat. Cok sicak.

english: It's as he says kid, real warm.
We'll leave the grapes here in good clean heat, give 'em time to think about their transgressions.
translation: Üzümleri burada temiz ve sicak bir yerde birakalim, günahlarini düsünmeleri icin onlara zaman verelim.

english: I don't remember this rock being here before.
translation: Bu kayanin daha önce burada oldugunu hatirlamiyorum.

english: This rock was always here, before man was, even.
translation: Bu kaya her zaman buradaydi, insanlar bile yokken.

english: That you ain't noticed it speaks to yer purview of the world.
translation: Onu fark etmemis olman, dünyayi algilama seklinle ilgili.

english: I'm almost certain this is new.
Perhaps more things in this world exist without yer knowledge than with it. Did ye consider that?
translation: Belki de bu dünyada senin bilmedigin seyler, bildigin seylerden daha fazladir. Bunu düsündün mü?

english: Well no, it's just a rock.
Alright alright already! Let's get these grapes going.
translation: Tamam, tamam! Hadi bu üzümleri halledelim.

english: We'd best I suppose. Lay them down and see to their transformation.
translation: En iyisi bu sanirim. Onlari yere serip dönüsümlerini izleyelim.

english: Hmm, let's see...
I judge these grapes to be...
...Plump and juicy! But not fer long!
translation: ...dolgun ve sulu oldugunu düsünüyorum! Ama uzun sürmeyecek!

english: We'll see them desiccated soon enough.
It is their destiny. A curse on these grapes!
translation: Bu onlarin kaderi. Bu üzümlere lanet olsun!

english: [player name], You've gotta make the grapes feel bad or they won't shrivel up.
translation: Maceraci, Üzümleri kötü hissettirmelisin, yoksa kuruyacaklar.

english: Oh I see, um, curse those grapes! Suffer you foolish berries! Ha!
translation: Anladim, o üzümlere lanet oku! Aci cekin, aptal meyveler! Ha!

english: Now yer gettin' it!
Insufferable fruits! Rank orbs of low repute!
translation: Dayanilmaz meyveler! Kötü söhretli igrenc küreler!

english: You tell 'em what for!
Cutscene: "A long while later..."
Well look at these! Perfect!
They're a fine example of raisins I'll say.
translation: Kuru üzümlerin en güzel örnegi diyebilirim.

english: Great! let's get back to the Rabbit Hole then.
translation: Harika! O zaman Tavsan Deligi'ne geri dönelim.

english: Player is returned to the Rabbit Hole
Well that was interesting.
Yes it was, come back when ye have some space and I'll give ye yer share of raisins.
translation: Evet, öyleydi. Yer acildiginda geri gel, sana kuru üzümlerden payini vereyim.

english: Yes it was. Here's some raisins for yer troubles.
translation: Evet, öyleydi. Zahmetin icin al sana kuru üzüm.

english: Thank you!
Can I have some raisins please?
translation: Biraz kuru üzüm alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: I think ye have enough raisins at the moment.
translation: Su anda yeterince kuru üzümün var bence.

english: Make some space for them and ye can have some more.
translation: Onlar icin biraz yer acarsan, biraz daha alabilirsin.

english: Of course, we've plenty to spare after that trip.
translation: Tabii ki, o yolculuktan sonra bol bol kaldi.

english: Thanks!
Thanks for taking me to make raisins.
translation: Beni kuru üzüm yapmaya götürdügün icin tesekkürler.

english: I was plenty happy to educate ye.
I used those raisins to make some Easter Buns, and the Easter Bunny really enjoyed them!
translation: O kuru üzümleri Paskalya Cörekleri yapmak icin kullandim ve Paskalya Tavsani cok begendi!

english: Well that's great, kid.
Thanks again for the help.
Any time. You owe me one.
Oh, I uh, suppose I do.
It won't catch on, Glanton.
Ah don't be like that Rinder, how will we know till we try?
translation: Ah, böyle olma Rinder, denemeden nasil bilecegiz?

english: Alright gents, what's going on here then?
I've had this great idea see.
Does it have anything to do with long walks in the desert again?
translation: Yine cölde uzun yürüyüslerle mi ilgili?

english: Well y'see thats the beauty of it.
It's a lot easier to melt chocolate than dry out grapes.
translation: Cikolatayi eritmek, üzümleri kurutmaktan cok daha kolay.

english: Chocolate? You've piqued my interest!
Exactly! See Rinder, [player name] doesn't even know half the idea yet and wants in!
translation: Aynen! Gördün mü Rinder, Maceraci fikrin yarisini bile bilmiyor ama katilmak istiyor!

english: It still seems terribly messy.
Okay so, what we do is use our connections with the Easter Bunny to acquire a lot of chocolate.
translation: Tamam, o zaman, Paskalya Tavsani ile olan baglantilarimizi kullanarak cok fazla cikolata elde ediyoruz.

english: And give it to me for my outstanding contributions to the preservation of Easter?
translation: Ve Paskalya'nin korunmasina yaptigim olaganüstü katkilarim icin bana mi vereceksiniz?

english: No.
And we melt it all up, and put it in a fountain.
translation: Ve hepsini eritip bir cesmeye koyuyoruz.

english: And then I get to have it all?
translation: Ve sonra hepsini ben mi alacagim?

english: No then we sell people the right to take a couple of small fruits to dip in the fountain and eat!
translation: Hayir, sonra insanlara cesmeye batirip yemek icin birkac kücük meyve alma hakki satiyoruz!

english: That sounds delicious!
Yes.
But I can get some for free?
See the amount people would pay for just a taste of chocolate is so much higher than we'd have to pay to source a lot of the stuff.
translation: Insanlarin cikolatayi tatmak icin ödeyecekleri miktar, bizim cikolatayi temin etmek icin ödeyecegimiz miktardan cok daha fazla.

english: Well, I'm not interested if I have to pay.
I saved Easter...
... Again!
I think I'll go see if the Easter Bunny has some more eggs for me...
translation: Gidip Paskalya Tavsani'nin benim icin baska yumurtalari var mi diye bakayim...

english: Be seeing you!
Here, look at my lovely gems.
Hey! Get your hands off there!
You're the one who stole something from me!
Guards guards!
Glod smash!
Glod bash!
Grind your bones!
Stupid clouds make Glod angry!
You wouldn't like Glod when Glod angry!
Why everyone attack Glod?
Gods, give Glod strength!
Glod appears to have more Strength and Attack power than before!
translation: Glod eskisinden daha fazla Güc ve Saldiri gücüne sahip görünüyor!

english: Glod not die so easily!
Glod heals himself slightly.
GLOD SMASH!
Your prayer is drained by Glod's attack!
Flee, pesky mortal!
At Glod's cry you are forced to run away!
You puny human. Come to Glod!
You are enraged by Glod's taunts and forced to charge towards him to fight!
translation: Glod'un alayci sözleri seni öfkelendirir ve ona saldirip savasmaya zorlar!

english: Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu vardir. Merhaba, selam, selam sana...

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: Bu yine de tek bir selam sayilir!

english: Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her türlü sey! Kuleler görülmeye deger harika bir manzara.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmeni tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Hello!
Hello there, [rank].
I've not seen you round these parts before.
Well I'm still fairly new here.
[Rank]?
You heard correct.
The name's Gloria. Nice to meet you.
You too. I'm [player name]. What are you doing hanging round the Colosseum?
translation: Ben de. Benim adim Maceraci. Kolezyum'da ne yapiyorsun?

english: I've become quite fond of keeping an eye on the contenders and sharing news of their progress to those around the city.
translation: Yarismacilari izlemeyi ve onlarin ilerlemelerini sehirdeki insanlarla paylasmayi cok seviyorum.

english: You see, inside the Colosseum you'll earn what's called Glory.
What's Glory?
Glory will improve your status and reputation around the city. You might even get some rewards.
translation: San, sehirdeki statünü ve itibarini artirir. Hatta bazi ödüller bile kazanabilirsin.

english: How does Glory work?
It's simple really, you get Glory from participating in the Colosseum! You'll get more Glory the better you perform.
translation: Cok basit, Kolezyum'a katilarak San kazanirsin! Performansin ne kadar iyi olursa, o kadar cok San kazanirsin.

english: Performance is measured by a few things. For example, how many hits you take or how quickly you complete the challenges.
translation: Performans birkac faktöre göre ölcülür. Örnegin, kac darbe aldigin veya görevleri ne kadar hizli tamamladigin gibi.

english: Sounds good to me. Have you earned any Glory yourself?
translation: Kulaga hos geliyor. Sen kendin Glory kazandin mi?

english: Ha! No. But I do have this fancy armour which is pretty glorious! You may be lucky enough to get some of your own from within the Colosseum.
translation: Ha! Hayir. Ama oldukca görkemli olan bu sik zirhim var! Colosseum'da sansin yaver giderse sen de kendine ait bir tane kazanabilirsin.

english: Tell me more about these rewards.
translation: Bu ödüller hakkinda daha fazla bilgi ver.

english: But of course! People all accross Varlamore will hear of your Glory.
translation: Tabii ki! Varlamore'daki herkes Glory'ni duyacak.

english: You'll get a range of benefits depending on your status.
translation: Statuna bagli olarak cesitli avantajlar elde edeceksin.

english: How do I improve my status?
Earn more Glory of course. The more you earn, the better your standing in the city.
translation: Tabii ki daha fazla San kazanarak. Ne kadar cok kazanirsan, sehirdeki konumun o kadar iyi olur.

english: You can check your status on that board over there. I keep it up to date.
translation: Statünü suradaki tahtada kontrol edebilirsin. Onu güncel tutuyorum.

english: What exactly are the benefits?
Well...
Reaching Brawler status will give you access to the bank within the Colosseum.
translation: Dövüscü statüsüne ulastiginda, Colosseum'daki bankaya erisim hakkin olur.

english: Reaching Challenger status will allow you to respawn in Civitas illa Fortis if you so desire.
translation: Meydan Okuyucu statüsüne ulastiginda, istersen Civitas illa Fortis'te yeniden dogabilirsin.

english: Reaching Gladiator status might persuade some of the more shady folk around the city to give you more money for... Let's just say illicit valuables.
translation: Gladiator statüsüne ulasmak, sehirdeki bazi süpheli tiplerin size daha fazla para vermesini saglayabilir... Diyelim ki yasadisi degerli esyalar icin.

english: Reaching Hero status will allow you to travel to the Colosseum via the Ring of Dueling.
translation: Hero statüsüne ulasmak, Ring of Dueling araciligiyla Colosseum'a seyahat etmenizi saglar.

english: Reaching Champion status will grant you free herb patch protection just west of the city.
translation: Champion statüsüne ulasmak, sehrin batisindaki otlaklari ücretsiz olarak korumanizi saglar.

english: And reaching Grand Champion status will unlock you the Fortis Salute emote.
translation: Grand Champion statüsüne ulasmak ise Fortis Salute emote'unu acar.

english: Do you know how much Glory I need for each status?
translation: Her statü icin ne kadar San'a ihtiyacim oldugunu biliyor musun?

english: You'll have to figure that out on your journey to becoming a Grand Champion.
translation: Büyük Sampiyon olmak icin ciktigin yolculukta bunu kendin bulman gerekecek.

english: Fair enough.
Do you know my Glory status?
That I do, [player name].
It seems as though you are still a Rookie to the people of Fortis.
translation: Fortis halki icin hala bir Caylak gibi görünüyorsun.

english: You'll make a name of yourself in no time, [player name].
I'll do my very best.
You are a Brawler!
Thanks!
You are a Grand Champion!
You can check that board over there to see any details of your Glory. I try to update it regularly.
translation: Seref puaninin ayrintilarini suradaki tahtadan kontrol edebilirsin. Düzenli olarak güncellemeye calisiyorum.

english: I'd better get going.
I see you've been trying to conquer the Colosseum, eh?
I have indeed, and I will become a champion!
That's it, positive thoughts.
I was watching when you became Grand Champion of the Colosseum. It was truly something to behold.
translation: Colosseum'un Büyük Sampiyonu oldugun ani izledim. Gercekten görülmeye degerdi.

english: What brings you over to me today?
I was wondering if we could talk about Glory?
translation: Zafer hakkinda konusabilir miyiz diye merak ediyordum.

english: But of course. What do you wish to know?
Actually, I'm good.
Hello there, Grand Champion.
Grand Champion?
How does Glory work?
Are there any rewards?
Do you know my Glory status?
I'd better get going.
Tell me more about these rewards.
translation: Bu ödüller hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin.

english: Actually, I'm good.
Urgh...
He looks too sick to chat.
I'm really grateful to you for clearing up what Ithoi did to us. The rest of the Corsairs will appreciate my cooking even more now!
translation: Ithoi'nin bize yaptiklarini acikliga kavusturdugunuz icin size gercekten minnettarim. Korsanlarin geri kalani artik yemeklerimi daha da cok takdir edecek!

english: That's good for you!
Hello.
Can't stop sorry! Busy, busy, busy!
The gnome is too busy to talk.
Hello traveller. Are you enjoying your stay?
translation: Merhaba gezgin. Konaklaman hosuna gidiyor mu?

english: It's a nice place.
Yes, we try to keep it that way.
Are you OK?
The gnome seems a little drunk.
Youssh go gesshh em.
Pardon?
Gessh ush a cosshtail.
A what?
Blurssh berry.
I think he's had enough!
I don't think I can take much more!
What's wrong?
It's just the wife, she won't stop moaning!
Maybe you should give her less to moan about.
translation: Belki de ona sizlanacak daha az sey vermelisin.

english: She'll always find something.
translation: O her zaman bir sey bulur.

english: How's life treating you?
Not bad, not bad at all.
It's good to see a human with a positive attitude.
translation: Olumlu bir tavri olan bir insan görmek güzel.

english: You're the human that dealt with those mourners aren't you? Thanks for that, they were really bothersome.
translation: Sen o yas tutanlarla ilgilenen insansin, degil mi? Tesekkürler, gercekten cok rahatsiz ediciydiler.

english: No problem. Why are you still here anyway?
translation: Sorun degil. Neden hâlâ buradasin ki?

english: The mourners left plenty of stuff behind, thought I'd see if there was anything useful.
translation: Yas tutanlar arkalarinda bir sürü sey birakmislar, ise yarar bir sey var mi diye bakayim dedim.

english: Fair enough, have fun.
Argh!
Hello again, [player name].
Tell me about this place.
Over time, many people have come into the world and left it again. One such is Thrander, who used to perform armour conversion services in Varrock. Another is Chuck, the wood certificate trader.
translation: Zamanla, bircok insan bu dünyaya geldi ve tekrar gitti. Bunlardan biri, Varrock'ta zirh dönüstürme hizmeti veren Thrander. Bir digeri ise ahsap sertifikasi tüccari Chuck.

english: When their services were no longer required, they moved on, but they were not all forgotten. Some linger still in the Realm of Memories.
translation: Hizmetlerine artik ihtiyac kalmadiginda, baska yerlere tasindilar, ama hepsi unutulmadi. Bazilari hala Anilar Diyari'nda kaliyor.

english: From the Realm, we watch how the world changes. We see the happy moments, the sad times, the lucky events, the dry streaks. It is a wonderful existence.
translation: Diyar'dan, dünyanin nasil degistigini izliyoruz. Mutlu anlari, üzücü zamanlari, sansli olaylari, sikici dönemleri görüyoruz. Bu harika bir varolus.

english: Can you give me more reward items?
translation: Bana daha fazla ödül ögesi verebilir misin?

english: You cannot hold any more items from me now. You may wish to visit Diango, in Draynor Village, to collect more rewards in a more convenient setting.
translation: Su anda benden daha fazla öge alamazsin. Daha uygun bir ortamda daha fazla ödül almak icin Draynor Köyü'ndeki Diango'yu ziyaret etmek isteyebilirsin.

english: I have given you what you can hold. You may wish to visit Diango, in Draynor Village, to collect more rewards in a more convenient setting.
translation: Sana alabilecegin kadarini verdim. Daha uygun bir ortamda daha fazla ödül almak icin Draynor Köyü'ndeki Diango'yu ziyaret etmek isteyebilirsin.

english: I think that is everything I have for you.
I have nothing more for you.
translation: Sana verecek baska bir seyim yok.

english: Who are the people here?
Like me, they dwelt in the world as it used to be, in various different eras. Many such people have faded away into the mists of time, but a lucky few are remembered.
translation: Benim gibi, onlar da eskiden oldugu gibi, cesitli farkli dönemlerde bu dünyada yasadilar. Bu tür insanlarin cogu zamanin sisleri icinde kayboldu, ama sansli birkac tanesi hatirlaniyor.

english: They would be glad to meet you, I am sure.
Can I see more stuff from your era?
translation: Senin döneminden daha fazla sey görebilir miyim?

english: I would have dearly loved that. However we are limited to this hall, where the more aggressive creatures can play in safety.
translation: Bunu cok isterdim. Ancak, daha saldirgan yaratiklarin güvenle oynayabilecegi bu salonla sinirliyiz.

english: Furthermore, the dimensional shifts would not allow it - a two-dimensional entity would be incomprehensible to your three-dimensional mind.
