translation: Ayrica, boyut degisiklikleri buna izin vermez - iki boyutlu bir varlik, üc boyutlu zihniniz icin anlasilmaz olur.

english: No, some things must be left to the memory, even here in the Realm of Memories.
translation: Hayir, bazi seyler hafizaya birakilmalidir, burada, Hafizalar Diyari'nda bile.

english: Tell me about this place.
Can you give me more reward items?
translation: Bana daha fazla ödül ögesi verebilir misin?

english: Who are the people here?
Can I see more stuff from your era?
translation: Senin döneminden daha fazla sey görebilir miyim?

english: Run faster! Faster!
Excuse me?
Oh, sorry, I didn't notice you there.
I take it you're a coach?
That I am. Now get to the point, I'm very busy!
translation: Öyleyim. Simdi sadede gel, cok mesgulüm!

english: What's the history of Gnome ball?
Be more precise, stranger.
How did it all start?
Strangely enough, by accident.
Accident?
Don't interrupt!
Sorry.
A great many years ago, before I was even born, there were two young Gnomes. Brothers to be exact.
translation: Cok uzun yillar önce, ben daha dogmadan önce, iki genc Gnome vardi. Tam olarak kardeslerdi.

english: They were always arguing with each other over the most trivial things - who was the faster runner or who was the tallest.
translation: Her zaman en önemsiz seyler icin tartisirlardi - kim daha hizli kosar, kim daha uzundur gibi.

english: One day they were up at the swamp throwing stones at the toads.
translation: Bir gün bataklikta kurbagalara tas atiyorlardi.

english: As you do.
Yep. You know nothing tastes better than toasted toad?
translation: Evet. Kizarmis kurbaganin tadinin hicbir seyden daha iyi olmadigini biliyor musun?

english: Oh, I'm sure
Anyway, they decided to compete to see who could kill the most toads. This gradually became a daily game, to which they invited friends and family to join in.
translation: Her neyse, kim daha cok kurbaga öldürebilecek diye yarismaya karar verdiler. Bu yavas yavas günlük bir oyun haline geldi ve arkadaslarini ve ailelerini de katilmaya davet ettiler.

english: It all evolved from there. Creating a playing arena, making up teams and leagues.
translation: Her sey oradan gelisti. Oyun alani olusturuldu, takimlar ve ligler kuruldu.

english: Interesting.
Anything else?
What is the ball made from?
Toads of course
Toads?
What with the swamp nearby, and their robust skin, there is nothing better to stretch over some common sand.
translation: Yakinlarda bataklik var ve derileri saglam oldugu icin, siradan kumun üzerine sermek icin daha iyi bir sey yok.

english: I'd never have guessed.
Well, of course. You humans know nothing!
translation: Tabii ki. Siz insanlar hicbir sey bilmiyorsunuz!

english: Those nets are strange.
Ah, made from the finest thread in all the land.
translation: Ah, ülkedeki en kaliteli iplikten yapilmislar.

english: And that is?
Gnome hair.
You're kidding, right?
I have no time for jokes. It's a serious matter, we go through plenty of nets every day.
translation: Saka yapacak vaktim yok. Bu ciddi bir konu, her gün cok sayida ag harciyoruz.

english: So that's why you don't see many Gnomes with long hair?
translation: Bu yüzden mi uzun sacli cüce görmüyoruz?

english: Exactly.
The world makes sense at last.
Are there any special tactics?
Well of course, like what?
How about passing?
There's the good old one-two tactic.
You don't know anything do you? You pass the ball onto a team mate, giving him all the attention of your opposition, and giving you the chance to run further ahead.
translation: Hicbir sey bilmiyorsun, degil mi? Topu takim arkadasina paslarsin, böylece rakibin tüm dikkatini ona ceker ve sen daha ileriye kosma sansi elde edersin.

english: Then what?
Well, he passes back to you and you've made an advantage. It's useful in a variety of situations!
translation: O da sana geri paslar ve sen avantaj elde edersin. Cesitli durumlarda kullanislidir!

english: I'll remember that one.
How about teamwork?
Well, don't forget that you can block the opposition whilst a team mate has the ball. Very useful if you want to stop or slow down anyone approaching him.
translation: Takim arkadasin topu alirken rakibi engelleyebilecegini unutma. Ona yaklasan birini durdurmak veya yavaslatmak istiyorsan cok kullanislidir.

english: Block for team mates. Got it.
What about my personal physique?
You'd look better if you were shorter.
translation: Daha kisa olsan daha iyi görünürdün.

english: I meant in regards to scoring more goals!
translation: Daha fazla gol atmak icin demek istedim!

english: I see. Your agility is important if you want to avoid being tackled, so that would be a good attribute to improve. Also many Gnomes say that being able to attack well with a ranged weapon makes you better at
translation: Anliyorum. Tackle'dan kacinmak istiyorsan cevikligin önemlidir, bu yüzden bu özelligini gelistirmek iyi olur. Ayrica bircok Gnome, menzilli silahlarla iyi saldiri yapabilmenin gol atma becerini gelistirdigini söylüyor.

english: scoring goals.
translation: Sanirim gidip bu beceriler üzerinde calismaliyim.

english: I suppose I should go away and work on those skills.
translation: Evet, oyunu oynamak da bu becerileri gelistirecektir. Ayrica, kaleye olan mesafenin gol atma sansini etkiledigini unutma, bu yüzden yeterince yaklasirsan menzilli becerinin önemi o kadar da önemli olmaz.

english: Yes, although playing the game itself will improve these skills too. Also you should remember that your distance from the goal affects your chance of scoring, so get close enough and your ranged ability won't matter as
translation: Evet, ancak oyunu oynamak da bu becerileri gelistirecektir. Ayrica, gol atma sansiniza gol ile olan mesafenizin de etkisi oldugunu unutmayin,

english: much.
translation: bu yüzden yeterince yaklasirsaniz menzilli yeteneginiz o kadar önemli olmaz.

english: Any information would be appreciated!
translation: Her türlü bilgi icin minnettar olurum!

english: Hmm, some general facts?
Please!
OK. Have you noticed the different colour clothes for your opposing Gnomes?
translation: Tamam. Rakip Gnome'larin farkli renklerde kiyafetler giydigini fark ettin mi?

english: Nope.

The colours correspond to their skill level. The red ones are the professionals. They've been playing since before you were born! The orange ones are in the middle of their careers, whereas the yellow players know very
translation: Renkler, beceri seviyelerine karsilik geliyor. Kirmizi olanlar profesyoneller. Sen dogmadan önce oynamaya baslamislar! Turuncu olanlar kariyerlerinin ortasindalar, sari olanlar ise cok az sey biliyorlar.

english: little. Just like you!
Thanks... Anything else?
translation: Tesekkürler... Baska bir sey var mi?

english: It's always good to get a group of friends to play with you. That way you can score goals more easily, and if you take it in turns to score the goals you'll all reap the rewards.
translation: Bir grup arkadasinla oynamak her zaman iyidir. Böylece daha kolay gol atabilirsin ve sirayla gol atarsaniz hepiniz ödülün tadini cikarirsiniz.

english: Does the game bring fame?
You mean you've never heard of Speedy Sam The Striker or Norda 'Steal Arms' van Druman?
translation: Speedy Sam The Striker veya Norda ‘Steal Arms’ van Druman'i hic duymadin mi?

english: Afraid not.
Not even Great Thunder Legs MacKnee?
translation: Great Thunder Legs MacKnee'yi bile mi?

english: Well, they're all richer than you'll ever be!
translation: Hepsi senin asla olamayacagin kadar zengin!

english: Good for them.
Indeed, anything else?
translation: Gercekten, baska bir sey var mi?

english: Yawn.
I beg your pardon?
Erm... thanks, catch you later.
Take him out you wuss
One-Two, One-Two!
Hey human, get moving!
Run faster! Don't be so lazy!
Pass to your left! Pass now!
translation: Sola pas ver! Hemen pas ver!

english: There are others to pass to you know
translation: Pas verecek baskalari da var biliyorsun.

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: Hazir yemekler maalesef ise yaramaz. Aluft Aloft'un müsterileri icin sadece el yapimi Cüce Mutfagi yeterince iyidir.

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Coach
Ah, sustenance! Thanks.
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr'dan ücretsiz teslimat jetonunuzu almayi unutmayin.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: Teslimatiniz cok gec! Aluft jnr'a geri dönüp baska bir siparis alin. Artik ihtiyaciniz olmadigi icin teslimat kutunuzu atiyorsunuz.

english: Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to answer this for me.
Please enter the answer to the question.
How can that be? Go check again!
translation: Bu nasil olabilir? Tekrar kontrol edin!

english: Spot on!
What's the History of Gnome ball?
How did it all start?
What is the ball made from?
Those nets are strange.
Are there any special tactics?
How about in passing?
How about teamwork?
What about my personal physique?
Any information would be appreciated!
translation: Her türlü bilgi icin minnettar olurum!

english: Does the game bring fame?
Yawn
Nooooo! Dobbie's dead!
Tortoise Murderer!
You Beast!
This is for Dobbie!
Attack the infidel!
Hello.
Hello [sir/madam], can I tempt you with any of the dishes on our new menu?
translation: Merhaba , yeni menümüzdeki yemeklerden herhangi birini denemek ister misiniz?

english: I'll take a look.

I hope you like what you see. Although all these premade dishes are good to eat - they were made by the last human assistant chef. He wasn't up to Chef's exacting standards - and you may find that they will
translation: Umarim begenirsiniz. Bu hazir yemeklerin hepsi lezzetlidir, ancak son insan yardimci sef tarafindan yapilmistir. Sefin titiz standartlarina uymuyordu ve bazi insanlar bunlari

english: not be accepted by some people as the 'real' thing.
Not really.
That's your choice [sir/madam], enjoy your stay.
I'll take a look.
Not really.
Actually I'd like to sell some dishes.

Mr Gianne is the one to talk to if you want to sell any dishes you've made yourself. He is the owner and head chef of this establishment. If on the other hand you are more interested in making food to deliver, which can
translation: Kendi yaptiginiz yemekleri satmak istiyorsaniz, Bay Gianne ile konusmalisiniz. O, bu mekanin sahibi ve bas ascisidir. Öte yandan, teslimat icin yemek yapmakla daha cok ilgileniyorsaniz, bu

english: be quite lucrative, you should talk to Mr Giannes son Aluft Gianne jnr. Just don't call him Lufty, he doesn't like it.
translation: oldukca kazancli olabilir, Bay Gianne'nin oglu Aluft Gianne jnr ile konusmalisiniz. Ona Lufty demeyin, bundan hoslanmaz.

english: Thank you.
Actually I'd like to sell some dishes.
translation: Aslinda ben bazi yemekler satmak istiyorum.

english: Hi, welcome to Gnomeball. It's pretty simple really: You take the ball from me, charge at the gnome defence and try to throw the ball through the net using your ranged skill.
translation: Merhaba, Gnomeball'a hos geldiniz. Aslinda oldukca basit: Benden topu alip, cüce savunmasina hücum ediyorsunuz ve menzil becerinizi kullanarak topu agdan gecmeye calisiyorsunuz.

english: It's a rough game but great fun. It's also great for improving agility. So do you fancy a game?
translation: Sert bir oyun ama cok eglenceli. Ayrica cevikligi gelistirmek icin de harika. Bir oyun oynamak ister misiniz?

english: Looks too dangerous for me!
Okay then, I'll have a go.
Great stuff! There are few rules to Gnomeball, so it can get a bit rough.
translation: Harika! Gnomeball'da birkac kural var, bu yüzden biraz sert gecebilir.

english: You can pass to the green winger gnomes. Then you can make a run and they'll pass back. Otherwise, if you're feeling brave, you can just charge and dodge.
translation: Yesil kanat gnome'lara pas verebilirsin. Sonra kosarsin ve onlar sana geri pas verir. Aksi takdirde, cesursan, hücum edip kacabilirsin.

english: Sounds easy enough.
The main aim is to leave with no broken limbs. I think you should be fine.
translation: Ana amac, kirik uzuvlarla ayrilmamak. Bence sorun olmaz.

english: Peeeeeeeeep
Hi, welcome back to Gnomeball. Would you like to hear the rules again?
translation: Merhaba, Gnomeball'a tekrar hos geldin. Kurallari tekrar duymak ister misin?

english: It's pretty simple really: You take the ball from me, charge at the gnome defence and try to throw the ball through the net using your ranged skill.
translation: Gercekten cok basit: Topu benden al, cüce savunmasina hücum et ve menzil becerini kullanarak topu agdan gecirmeyi dene.

english: It's a rough game but great fun. It's also great for improving agility.
translation: Sert bir oyun ama cok eglenceli. Ayrica cevikligi gelistirmek icin de harika.

english: Ahh I see you have your own ball. We can't play with that; I'll give it back when you leave.
translation: Ahh, kendi topun var galiba. Onunla oynayamayiz; ayrilirken geri veririm.

english: I just want to play
Okay... Let's play GNOMEBALL!
No, I don't want to play.
Okay, never mind. Maybe next time...
translation: Tamam, bos ver. Belki bir dahaki sefere...

english: You have a ball in play. Do you need to hear the rules again?
translation: Oynamak icin bir topun var. Kurallari tekrar duymak ister misin?

english: The ball you have in your hand is fine to play with... Game on.
No thanks.
Okay, good luck.
Have a new ball!
Right, you haven't finished quite yet.
Ugh.
Answer this for me.
The ref has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Hakem sana bir meydan okuma parsömeni verdi!

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
Wrong answer!
Well done!
The ref has given you another clue scroll!
translation: Hakem size baska bir ipucu parsömeni verdi!

english: Looks too dangerous for me!
Okay then, I'll have a go.
Yes please.
I just want to play.
No, I don't want to play.
No thanks.
Good day, how may I help you?
I'd like to buy more bank slots.
translation: Daha fazla banka yuvasi satin almak istiyorum.

english: Why? You don't use the bank.
Oh yeah... Never mind then.
I can sell you up to [number] additional bank slots in sets of 40. How many are you interested in buying?
[number] slots please.
Buying [number] additional bank slots will cost [number] coins. Be warned, this purchase is not reversible. Are you happy to proceed?
Oh... I don't seem to have enough money for that. Never mind.
translation: Oh... Bunun icin yeterli param yok galiba. Bos verin.

english: Yes, I'm happy with that.
Your additional bank slots have been added.
Actually, I've changed my mind.
What is this place?
What is this place?
This is a branch of the Bank of Gielinor. We have branches in many towns.
translation: Burasi Gielinor Bankasi'nin bir subesi. Bircok kasabada subemiz var.

english: And what do you do?
We will look after your items and money for you. Leave your valuables with us if you want to keep them safe.
translation: Esyalarinizi ve paranizi sizin icin sakliyoruz. Degerli esyalarinizi güvende tutmak istiyorsaniz bize birakabilirsiniz.

english: I'd like to access my bank account, please.
I'd like to check my PIN settings.
I'd like to collect items.
I'd like to buy more bank slots.
translation: Daha fazla banka alani satin almak istiyorum.

english: Yes.
No.
Hello.
I have a riddle for you.
OK.
A tree which is planted on Monday and doubles in size each day is fully grown on the following Sunday. On what day is it half grown?
translation: Pazartesi günü dikilen ve her gün boyu iki katina cikan bir agac, ertesi Pazar günü tamamen büyümüs olur. Bu agac hangi gün yarisi kadar büyümüs olur?

english: Erm... I'm not sure.
Saturday. You big folk really aren't the quickest!
translation: Cumartesi. Siz büyükler gercekten de pek zeki degilsiniz!

english: To be or not to be.
Hey I know that. Where's it from?
Existentialism for insects.
My mum says: A friendly look, a kindly smile one good act, and life's worthwhile!
translation: Annem der ki: Dostca bir bakis, nazik bir gülümseme, bir iyilik, ve hayat anlam kazanir!

english: Sweet.
I wrote a few children's books.
Really.
Yep... but not on purpose!
The human mind is a tremendous thing.
Bla bla bla!
What?
Rude little gnome!
Real generosity is doing something nice for someone who will never find it out.
translation: Gercek cömertlik, bunu asla ögrenmeyecek birine iyilik yapmaktir.

english: Thanks for the quote.
Nice weather we're having today.
But then it doesn't tend to rain much around here.
translation: Ama bu civarda genellikle cok yagmur yagmaz.

english: Hardy, ha ha! Hee, hee hee!
translation: Hardy, ha ha! Hee, hee hee!

english: Are you OK?
I'm a little tree gnome. That is me!
translation: Ben kücük bir agac cücesiyim. Bu benim!

english: I've heard better.
I am the beginning of eternity and the end of time and space. I am the beginning of every end and the end of every place. What am I?
translation: Ben sonsuzlugun baslangici ve zamanin ve uzayin sonuyum. Her sonun baslangici ve her yerin sonuyum. Ben neyim?

english: Err...?
Erm...not sure...annoying.
I'm 'e'! Hee hee! Do you get it?
I worship Guthix, the god of balance.
He really does have exceptional co-ordination.
Hello, are you alright?
Not really, I just saw a man with a wooden leg.
translation: Pek sayilmaz, az önce tahta bacakli bir adam gördüm.

english: So?!
He had a real foot!
What are you doing?
I'm making wine out of raisins.
Why?
So I don't have to wait for it to age.
Hee hee!
Hi.
She loves me!
She does I tell you. She really loves me!
translation: Seviyor, sana söylüyorum. Beni gercekten seviyor!

english: Hello.
Are you alright?
I just want something to happen!
Like what?
Something, anything, I don't know what!
translation: Bir sey, herhangi bir sey, ne olacagini bilmiyorum!

english: A little inaccuracy sometimes saves tons of explanation!
translation: Bazen kücük bir yanlislik, tonlarca aciklamadan kurtarir!

english: True.
Hello. Why are you so tall?
Um... I've always been this height.
Maybe you should eat more worms.
Low.
When?
Cheeky!
The gnome is praying.
Guthix's angels fly so high as to be beyond our sight but they are always looking down upon us.
translation: Guthix'in melekleri gözümüzün göremeyecegi kadar yükseklikte ucuyorlar ama her zaman bizi izliyorlar.

english: Hello, would you like a worm?
Erm... OK.
Thanks.
In the gnome village those who are needy receive what they need, and those who are able give what they can.
translation: Cüce köyünde muhtac olanlar ihtiyaclarini karsilar, imkânlari olanlar ise ellerinden geleni yapar.

english: Dimensionality is a function of consciousness.
That's all you need to know.
I've been thinking.
Surely, if you're scared to die...
...you're not living, right?
Maybe!
How are you?
A warning traveller! The new world will rise from the underground!
translation: Bir uyari, yolcu! Yeni dünya yeraltindan yükselecek!

english: What do you mean, underground?
Just a warning!
Some advice traveller. We can walk, run, row or fly but never lose sight of the reason for the journey or miss the chance to see a rainbow on the way.
translation: Bir tavsiye, yolcu. Yürüyebilir, kosabilir, kürek cekebilir veya ucabiliriz, ama yolculugun nedenini asla gözden kacirmamali ve yol üzerinde gökkusagini görme firsatini kacirmamaliyiz.

english: I like that.
You look happy.
I'm always at peace with myself.
How do you manage that?
I know, therefore I am.
The gnome appears to be singing.
Oh baby, oh my sweet.
Are you talking to me?
No, I'm just singing.
I'm gonna sweep you off your feet.
Hi there.
Hey big man, watch where you're standing.
translation: Hey koca adam, nerede durduguna dikkat et.

english: I wouldn't want to make a mess of your shoes.
Have you seen our big tree?
Yes I have!
It's not small!
You are the contained centre of an O.
translation: Sen bir O'nun sinirli merkezi gibisin.

english: Pardon?
While me, I'm much more. I am the pyramidic containment of an A.
translation: Ben ise cok daha fazlasiyim. Ben bir A'nin piramit seklindeki sinirli merkeziyim.

english: You're strange.
I'm trying to make a comeback!
Really?
It's hard when you haven't been anywhere.
translation: Hicbir yere gitmemissen bu zor olur.

english: Aaaaarrggghh... humans! Run for your lives!
Hello brave adventurer. A warrior like you should go a long way.
translation: Merhaba cesur maceraci. Senin gibi bir savasci uzun bir yol kat etmelidir.

english: The further, the better! Hee hee!
translation: Ne kadar uzak olursa o kadar iyi! Hee hee!

english: Es ataris eto meriz ip prit es gutus!
translation: Es ataris eto meriz ip prit es gutus!

english: Oh hello.
Not great, it's just... well... people just don't seem to take me seriously!
translation: Iyi degil, sadece... sey... insanlar beni ciddiye almiyor gibi görünüyor!

english: How are you?
I'm fine thanks.
Why don't you make like a tree...
...and leave!
Funny!
Top of the morning to you.
And bottom of the afternoon.
The only thing that is constant...
...is change!
In the depths she has sealed them. Their power becomes hers.
translation: Onlari derinliklere hapsetti. Onlarin gücü onun oldu.

english: The father lives on. Alas, he's not the man he once was.
translation: Baba yasiyor. Ne yazik ki, eskisi gibi degil.

english: A door will finally open. A body lies within.
translation: Sonunda bir kapi acilacak. Icinde bir ceset yatiyor.

english: The fate of the future, it lies in the past. He will save us all.
translation: Gelecegin kaderi, gecmiste yatiyor. O hepimizi kurtaracak.

english: A new evil rises in an unlikely place. But the rhythm will be her undoing.
translation: Beklenmedik bir yerde yeni bir kötülük yükseliyor. Ama ritim onun sonunu getirecek.

english: Before sacrificing to the mighty Zulrah, comes the dawn.
translation: Güclü Zulrah'a kurban vermeden önce, safak söküyor.

english: When they say you're going off the rails, they're jealous that you can fly.
translation: Senin raydan ciktigini söylediklerinde, ucabildigin icin kiskaniyorlar.

english: So many symbols, so many signs. What do they mean? The answer is written in blood.
translation: O kadar cok sembol, o kadar cok isaret. Ne anlama geliyorlar? Cevap kanla yazilmis.

english: The city of gold they call it. Alas, the gold is that of fools.
translation: Ona altin sehir diyorlar. Ne yazik ki, altin aptallarin altini.

english: Long he has waited. At last, the most loyal servant will make his move.
translation: Uzun zamandir bekledi. Sonunda, en sadik hizmetkâr harekete gececek.

english: A horn was hidden in the sand, sealed away by the forgotten four.
translation: Kumda bir boynuz sakliydi, unutulmus dördü tarafindan mühürlenmisti.

english: Those things which I am saying now may be obscure, yet they will be made clearer in the proper place.
translation: Su anda söyledigim seyler belirsiz olabilir, ama uygun yerde daha net hale gelecekler.

english: Hello!
Greetings.
What do you think of the party?
It is as beauteous as the sheen of scales on a butterfly's wing and as odious as a worm's armpit.
translation: Kelebek kanadindaki pullarin parlakligi kadar güzel ve solucanin koltuk alti kadar igrenc.

english: Who have we got here...?
H... Hello.
So you think you're good enough to win this game, eh?
translation: Bu oyunu kazanacak kadar iyi oldugunu mu düsünüyorsun?

english: I'm counting on it.
We shall see about that!
So how does this game work?
The aim of the game is to reach 250 points as fast as you can.
translation: Oyunun amaci, mümkün oldugunca cabuk 250 puana ulasmak.

english: To earn points you simply have to put the gingerbread in your hopper.
translation: Puan kazanmak icin tek yapman gereken zencefilli kurabiyeleri hazneye koymak.

english: Of course, there's a catch. Each gingerbread has different qualities, thus different point values. I'll let you figure out which one is best.
translation: Tabii ki bir püf noktasi var. Her zencefilli kurabiye farkli özelliklere ve dolayisiyla farkli puan degerlerine sahip. Hangisinin en iyi oldugunu sen bul.

english: Here's a hint: don't put any red and crumbled gingerbread into your hopper. It will give you negative points.
translation: Iste bir ipucu: kirmizi ve ufalanmis zencefilli kurabiyeleri haznenize koymayin. Size eksi puan kazandirir.

english: You can be cheeky and put those inside other competitor's hoppers, as a saboteur.
translation: Sabotajci olarak, diger rakiplerin haznelerine bunlari koyarak yaramazlik yapabilirsiniz.

english: I expect only the highest quality of gingerbread in my establishment.
translation: Benim isletmemde sadece en yüksek kalitede zencefilli kurabiyeler bekliyorum.

english: Keep one eye on the other players as they might try to slow you down.
translation: Diger oyuncular sizi yavaslatmaya calisabilirler, onlara dikkat edin.

english: I think I want to have a look around first.
I'll be waiting!
Be careful, you've got some awful gingerbread with you... I wouldn't put them in your hopper, maybe another player's?
translation: Dikkatli olun, yaninizda berbat zencefilli kurabiye var... Onlari haznenize koymayin, belki baska bir oyuncunun haznesine koyabilirsiniz?

english: You must now answer the hardest riddle known to gnomekind, in order to proceed to the final!
translation: Finale cikmak icin cüceler arasinda bilinen en zor bilmeceyi cözmelisiniz!

english: I'm ready.
I am tall when I am young, and I am short when I am old.
A Gnome?
Well yes, I am a gnome, but the riddle wasn't about me!
translation: Evet, ben bir cüceyim, ama bilmece benimle ilgili degildi!

english: Gosh what I wouldn't give to be tall when I was young.
translation: Gencken uzun olabilmek icin neler vermezdim.

english: Have another go.
That's not quite right, have another go.
translation: Bu tam olarak dogru degil, bir daha dene.

english: A Human! Ha, I've got it.
Sadly not correct [player name].
You seem very old, you've been round here a while. You're not shorter than me though.
translation: Cok yasli görünüyorsun, bir süredir buradasin. Ama benden kisa degilsin.

english: Well, that's not hard.
Don't be cheeky [player name]! Now quickly solve this riddle.
translation: Küstah olma Maceraci! Simdi cabuk bu bilmeceyi cöz.

english: A candle?
That's correct!
Good luck in the final [player name]. You're going to need it.
translation: Finalde iyi sanslar Maceraci. Ihtiyacin olacak.

english: How's it going [player name]?
I'm pine thanks, I still have crumbs in places I didn't know I had.
translation: Iyiyim, tesekkürler, hala bilmedigim yerlerde kirintilar var.

english: Icy what you did there.
Do you enjoy it here?
Absolutely, I've had some of the best times in my life doing all this quality control.
translation: Kesinlikle, tüm bu kalite kontrol islerini yaparken hayatimin en güzel zamanlarini gecirdim.

english: I wouldn't be the gnome I am today without it.
translation: Bu is olmasaydi, bugün oldugum gnome olamazdim.

english: That sounds lovely.
So what's your story?
Good question, where do I begin...
I used to be a Head Chef at the Tree Gnome Stronghold.
translation: Eskiden Agac Cüceleri Kalesi'nde bas asciydim.

english: Oh yeah?
I was the best of the best.
WHERE'S THE FROG SAUCE! I used to shout.
Great times.
Then you ended up in Santa's Nutcracker Pub?
translation: Sonra Noel Baba'nin Findikkiran Pub'ina mi geldin?

english: You know it. Apparently Santa was getting complaints about the quality of his gingerbread gnomes.
translation: Aynen öyle. Anlasilan Noel Baba, zencefilli kurabiye cücelerinin kalitesiyle ilgili sikayetler aliyordu.

english: So he asked me to step in. Free ticket onto his Nice List too.
translation: Bu yüzden benden yardim istedi. Ayrica onun Iyi Cocuklar Listesi'ne ücretsiz giris hakki da verdi.

english: I mean just look at this place. It's amazing!
translation: Yani, su yere bir bak. Muhtesem!

english: It is indeed.
Happy Holidays!
You too [player name].
Yes.
No.
Gnome.
Flower.
Human.
Candle.
Do you enjoy being a festive game host?
translation: Bayram oyunu sunucusu olmak hosuna gidiyor mu?

english: What's your story?
Happy Holidays!
Hello how are you?
I'm amazed by how much humans chat. The sign over there says training area, not pointless conversation area.
translation: Insanlarin ne kadar cok sohbet ettiklerine sasiriyorum. Suradaki tabelada “egitim alani” yaziyor, “anlamsiz sohbet alani” degil.

english: Hello, what is this place?
This, my friend, is where we train. Here we improve our agility. It's an essential skill.
translation: Burasi, dostum, egitim yaptigimiz yer. Burada cevikligimizi gelistiriyoruz. Bu cok önemli bir beceri.

english: It looks easy enough.
If you complete the course in order from the slippery log to the end, your agility will increase much faster than by repeating just one obstacle.
translation: Kaygan kütükten sonuna kadar parkuru sirayla tamamlarsan, tek bir engeli tekrarlamakla elde edeceginden cok daha hizli bir sekilde cevikligini artirabilirsin.

english: This is fun!
This is training soldier. If you want fun go make some cocktails.
translation: Bu egitim asker. Eglenmek istiyorsan gidip kokteyl yap.

english: Hello there.
This isn't a grannies' tea party, let's see some sweat human. Go! Go! Go!
translation: Burasi büyükannelerin cay partisi degil, biraz terle bakalim insan. Hadi! Hadi! Hadi!

english: Okay get over that log, quick quick!
translation: Tamam, o kütügün üzerinden atla, cabuk cabuk!

english: Move it, move it, move it!
translation: Hareket et, hareket et, hareket et!

english: That's it - straight up
Come on scaredy cat, get across that rope!
My Granny can move faster than you.
translation: Büyükannem bile senden daha hizli hareket edebilir.

english: You're not done yet! Do this for me!
translation: Henüz bitirmedin! Bunu benim icin yap!

english: My baby sister can do puzzles better than that!
translation: Kücük kiz kardesim bile bundan daha iyi bulmaca cözebilir!

english: Excellent work!
Hi.
Draw your sword warrior, and fight along side us.
translation: Kilicini cek savasci ve bizimle birlikte savas.

english: Hello.
Death to Khazard, and all who serve him.
translation: Khazard'a ve ona hizmet edenlere ölüm.

english: I can't talk now, can't you see we're trying to win a battle here.
translation: Su anda konusamam, burada bir savas kazanmaya calistigimizi görmüyor musun?

english: You won't take us without a fight!
Get out of our lands!
Tally ho!
Hello, how's the work going?
Getting there now, thanks to your help!
translation: Senin yardimin sayesinde simdi oraya variyoruz!

english: Can I take a flight in the glider?
Sure, go ahead.
Have a nice day.
You too, human.
Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: Hazir yemekler maalesef ise yaramaz. Aluft Aloft'un müsterileri icin sadece el yapimi Gnome Mutfagi yeterince iyidir.

english: You hand over your delivery of [item] to Gnormadium Avlafrim
Oh my! I've had nothing to eat or drink but chompy birds and smelly water for days. Thank you.
translation: Aman Tanrim! Günlerdir chompy kuslari ve kokulu sudan baska bir sey yemedim ve icmedim. Tesekkürler.

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: Bunu bana ulastirmak icin uzun bir yol kat etmis olmalisin. Iste sana bahsis olarak kücük bir sey.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.'dan ücretsiz teslimat jetonunuzu almayi unutmayin.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: Teslimatiniz cok gec! Aluft jnr.'a geri dönüp baska bir siparis alin. Artik ihtiyaciniz olmadigi icin teslimat kutunuzu atiyorsunuz.

english: Hello, how's the work going?
Can I take a flight in the glider?
Have a nice day.
Hello. What do you do here?
My name is Gnosi. I am here to assist the Varrock Museum in their research.
translation: Adim Gnosi. Varrock Müzesi'nin arastirmalarina yardimci olmak icin buradayim.

english: I didn't know the Varrock Museum was familiar with this continent. What research are you conducting?
translation: Varrock Müzesi'nin bu kitayi tanidigini bilmiyordum. Ne tür bir arastirma yapiyorsunuz?

english: We're studying the history of the region, origins of the lizardmen and how it all connects to Xeric.
translation: Bölgenin tarihini, kertenkele adamlarin kökenlerini ve bunlarin Xeric ile nasil baglantili oldugunu arastiriyoruz.

english: We've wanted to study this place for a while, but haven't been able to explore due to lizardmen blocking the way.
translation: Bir süredir burayi arastirmak istiyorduk, ancak kertenkele adamlar yolu kapatiyordu.

english: But now that the Shayzien Army have cleared the path and discovered the Chambers of Xeric in the process, there is much to explore!
translation: Ama simdi Shayzien Ordusu yolu acti ve bu sürecte Xeric'in Odalarini kesfetti, kesfedilecek cok sey var!

english: Who is Xeric?
Xeric was an incredibly powerful dark mage. He ruled Great Kourend for ten decades.
translation: Xeric, inanilmaz derecede güclü bir kara büyücüydü. On yil boyunca Büyük Kourend'i yönetti.

english: If you'd like to find out more you should visit the Historical Archive at the Grand Library.
translation: Daha fazla bilgi edinmek isterseniz, Büyük Kütüphane'deki Tarih Arsivi'ni ziyaret etmelisiniz.

english: What are the Chambers of Xeric?
At the summit of this mountain we've found an ancient temple and a vast network of caves that we believe were formed by Xeric and his followers.
translation: Bu dagin zirvesinde, Xeric ve takipcileri tarafindan olusturulduguna inandigimiz eski bir tapinak ve genis bir magara agi bulduk.

english: The discovery of the Chambers tells us Xeric invested significant time and resources here, yet it was never documented.
translation: Odalarin kesfi, Xeric'in buraya önemli miktarda zaman ve kaynak yatirimi yaptigini gösteriyor, ancak bu hicbir zaman belgelenmemisti.

english: While much of Kourend's history under Xeric remains unknown, it is very surprising to discover such a huge area that was previously undiscovered to us.
translation: Xeric'in hüküm sürdügü dönemde Kourend'in tarihinin büyük bir kismi bilinmemekle birlikte, daha önce kesfedilmemis bu kadar büyük bir alanin varligini kesfetmek cok sasirtici.

english: Can I explore the Chambers?
Of course, though be careful. The dangers of the Chambers of Xeric are as yet unknown. You should take a strong group of companions with you.
translation: Elbette, ancak dikkatli olun. Xeric'in Odalari'nin tehlikeleri henüz bilinmiyor. Yaniniza güclü bir grup arkadas almalisiniz.

english: What do you think Xeric used this area for?
translation: Sence Xeric bu alani ne icin kullaniyordu?

english: When he ruled Kourend, we know Xeric performed experiments on the living, using power drawn from the Dark Altar. After he was overthrown, he would have needed a new source of power.
translation: Kourend'i yönettigi dönemde, Xeric'in Karanlik Sunak'tan aldigi gücü kullanarak canlilar üzerinde deneyler yaptigini biliyoruz. Devrildikten sonra yeni bir güc kaynagina ihtiyac duymus olmali.

english: We believe he came here to seek it. Xeric would also have required a source of many creatures for these experiments, and the Chambers certainly contain many of those!
translation: Buraya onu aramak icin geldigini düsünüyoruz. Xeric bu deneyler icin cok sayida yaratiga da ihtiyac duyuyordu ve odalarda bunlardan cok sayida var!

english: He must have also had some form of teleportation in order to reach the temple unnoticed.
translation: Tapinaga fark edilmeden ulasmak icin bir tür isinlanma yöntemine de sahip olmaliydi.

english: With time and careful study we will uncover these secrets and be able to answer these questions.
translation: Zamanla ve dikkatli bir arastirma ile bu sirlari ortaya cikaracak ve bu sorulari cevaplayabilecegiz.

english: We believe this altar is that source. It seems to act as an amplifier for the Dark Altar.
translation: Bu sunak o kaynak olduguna inaniyoruz. Karanlik Sunak icin bir amplifikatör görevi görüyor gibi görünüyor.

english: As for what he used the Chambers for, that we still don't know. There's a lot of creatures in the Chambers. Maybe he used them in his experiments.
translation: Odalari ne icin kullandigina gelince, bunu hala bilmiyoruz. Odalarda cok sayida yaratik var. Belki de onlari deneylerinde kullanmistir.

english: Goodbye.
Hello. How's it going?
The discovery of this cave could change everything. We might finally be able to discover the link between the lizardmen, the Chambers of Xeric and Xeric himself.
translation: Bu magaranin kesfi her seyi degistirebilir. Sonunda kertenkele adamlar, Xeric'in Odalari ve Xeric'in kendisi arasindaki baglantiyi kesfedebiliriz.

english: Who is Xeric?
What are the Chambers of Xeric?
Can I explore the Chambers?
What do you think Xeric used this area for?
translation: Sence Xeric bu alani ne icin kullaniyordu?

english: Goodbye
Goodbye.
Hey, human.
Who are you?
My name is Goat Poo. But human not allowed to make big deal of it, 'cos it mean to tease people 'bout silly name.
translation: Adim Keci Poo. Ama insanlar bunu büyütmemeli, cünkü bu aptalca bir isimle insanlari kizdirmak anlamina gelir.

english: Why are you called Goat Poo?
Look, trolls are named after first thing they try to eat, when they little kids. That is troll tradition.
translation: Bak, troller kücükken ilk yemeye calistiklari seyin adini alirlar. Bu troll gelenegidir.

english: So the first thing you ate was goat poo?
translation: Yani ilk yedigin sey keci kakasi miydi?

english: It my parents' fault - they should have been paying proper attention an' stopped me. But no, they just named me after it.
translation: Bu benim ailemin sucu - bana dikkat etmeleri ve beni durdurmalari gerekirdi. Ama hayir, bana bunun adini verdiler.

english: Still, it coulda been worse. Could have been called Yellow Snow. He got a really dumb name.
translation: Yine de daha kötüsü de olabilirdi. Sari Kar adini alabilirdim. Onun adi gercekten cok aptalca.

english: Okay, I won't ask why you're called Goat Poo.
translation: Tamam, neden Goat Poo adini aldigini sormayacagim.

english: Most people do eventually. Over an' over again.
Tell me about this place.
This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: Burasi Weiss. Troller yillar önce, güneydeki magaralardan kovulduktan sonra insa ettiler. Simdi Weiss bizim evimiz.

english: We done pretty good here. Got lots of goat and wolf to eat - they taste kinda boring after all this time, but there not much other choice.
translation: Burada oldukca iyi durumdayiz. Yemek icin bolca keci ve kurt var - bunca zaman sonra tadi biraz sikici geliyor, ama baska secenegimiz yok.

english: Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it. In fact My Arm is an expert on growing the stuff.
translation: Hic gut otu denedin mi? Onu seven troller taniyorum. Aslinda My Arm bu otu yetistirme konusunda uzmandir.

english: Never heard of no gouty weed, no. But it sound like a vegetable, an' Mother not like eating those, so we probably not gonna try it.
translation: Gut otu diye bir sey duymadim. Ama sebze gibi geliyor kulaga ve annem sebze yemeyi sevmez, o yüzden muhtemelen denemeyecegiz.

english: Mother not like new ideas much, but he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: Annem yeni fikirleri pek sevmez, ama o cok büyük ve patron, o yüzden ne derse onu yapariz.

english: I see.
Do you like it here?
Eh, it kinda rough, but it our home. Odd Mushroom say he can make it nicer with fancy fires what he invented, but Mother not interested in that, so Odd Mushroom not allowed to do it.
translation: Eh, biraz zorlu ama burasi bizim evimiz. Odd Mushroom, icat ettigi süslü ateslerle burayi daha güzel hale getirebilecegini söylüyor ama annem bununla ilgilenmiyor, bu yüzden Odd Mushroom bunu yapamiyor.

english: Mother only care about stuff to help him fight better. An he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: Annem sadece onun daha iyi savasmasina yardimci olacak seylerle ilgileniyor. O cok büyük ve patron, bu yüzden ne derse onu yapiyoruz.

english: I'll be off.
Hey, friend of Snowflake!
It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: Burasi harika, simdi Snowflake ve kocasi troll bize goutweed yetistirmeyi ögretti. Yemekler artik cok daha lezzetli.

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: Eh, biraz zorlu ama gittikce daha iyi oluyor. Snowflake bize goutweed yetistirmeyi ögretti. Keci, kurt, insan, hepsi goutweed ile cok daha lezzetli oluyor.

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: Evet, Weiss yasamak icin iyi bir yer, simdi Snowflake sorumlu. Tüm troller Snowflake'i sever. Kocasi biraz tuhaf ama bu bizim sorunumuz degil.

english: You t'ink I want that? It not even from goat!
translation: Sence bunu ister miyim? Keciden bile degil!

english: Look, human, it were one time. Just once. Let a troll move on, okay?
translation: Bak insan, bir kerelikti. Sadece bir kez. Trolleri rahat birak, tamam mi?

english: Look, human, this not funny. You need goat poo in bucket, go find goat pen!
translation: Bak insan, bu komik degil. Kovada keci pisligi istiyorsan, keci agilina git!

english: Who are you?
Why are you called Goat Poo?
Okay, I won't ask why you're called Goat Poo.
translation: Tamam, neden sana Keci Pisligi dediklerini sormayacagim.

english: Tell me about this place.
Ever tried goutweed?
I see.
Do you like it here?
I'll be off.
I kill you human!
Go away smelly human!
What you doing here?
I'm here to kill all you goblins!
I kill you!
I'm just looking around.
Me not sure that allowed. You have to check with generals.
translation: Bunun izinli oldugundan emin degilim. Generallere danismalisin.

english: Happy goblin new century!
Happy new century!
What is the goblin new century?
Goblin century mark year of big battle on Plain of Mud. That when Big High War God give us commandments.
translation: Goblin yüzyili, Camur Ovasi'ndaki büyük savasin yildönümüdür. O zaman Büyük Savas Tanrisi bize emirlerini verdi.

english: Who is the Big High War God?
Big High War God take goblins and make them strong! Without him, we small and weak and stupid. But thanks to Big High War God, we most powerful race in Gielinor!
translation: Büyük Yüksek Savas Tanrisi goblinleri alir ve onlari güclü kilar! O olmasaydi, biz kücük, zayif ve aptal olurduk. Ama Büyük Yüksek Savas Tanrisi sayesinde, Gielinor'daki en güclü irk biziz!

english: Umm... you're clearly not the most powerful race in Gielinor.
translation: Hmm... Gielinor'daki en güclü irk siz degilsiniz.

english: Not to doubt word of Big High War God! I kill you!
translation: Büyük Yüksek Savas Tanrisi'nin sözünü sorgulama! Seni öldürecegim!

english: What are the goblin commandments?
Slay enemies of Big High War God! Not show mercy! Not run from battle! Not doubt word of Big High War God!
translation: Büyük Yüksek Savas Tanrisi'nin düsmanlarini öldürmek! Merhamet göstermemek! Savastan kacmamak! Büyük Yüksek Savas Tanrisi'nin sözlerinden süphe etmemek!

english: Without commandments we not know right from wrong. We be like other races who not know war is good!
translation: Emirler olmasaydi, dogruyu yanlistan ayirt edemezdik. Savasin iyi oldugunu bilmeyen diger irklar gibi olurduk!

english: Where is the Plain of Mud?
That goblin secret! No human ever find Plain of Mud!
translation: Bu goblinlerin sirri! Hicbir insan Camur Ovasi'ni bulamadi!

english: I need to go.
Brown armour best!
Why is brown best?
General Wartface and General Bentnoze both say it is. And normally they never agree!
translation: General Wartface ve General Bentnoze öyle diyorlar. Ve normalde hic anlasmazlar!

english: But you're still wearing green armour!
translation: Ama sen hala yesil zirh giyiyorsun!

english: Um... my brown armour getting wash.
But you're still wearing red armour!
translation: Ama sen hala kirmizi zirh giyiyorsun!

english: It not red, it just red-ish brown!
Err, okay.
I'm here to kill all you goblins!
I'm just looking around.
Happy new century!
What is the goblin new century?
Who is the Big High War God?
What are the goblin commandments?
Where is the Plain of Mud?
I need to go.
Why is brown best?
But you're still wearing green!
But you're still wearing red!
Err, okay.
Which way should I go?
These dungeons are such a maze.
I've been wandering around down here for hours.
How can I get back to the village?
I hate being so lost!
Where am I? I'm so lost.
I know the exit is around here, somewhere.
translation: Cikisin buralarda bir yerde oldugunu biliyorum.

english: Where's the exit?!?
This is the fifth time this week! I'm lost!
How could I be so disoriented?
Hmm? Oh, hello, surface-dweller!
What are you doing?
I'm writing the definitive history of Dorgesh-Kaan!
Actually, I wonder if you could help me...
translation: Aslinda, bana yardim edebilir misin acaba...

english: I know the ruler of Lumbridge is called Horacio, but I don't know what his title is. Can you tell me?
translation: Lumbridge'in hükümdarinin adi Horacio oldugunu biliyorum, ama unvanini bilmiyorum. Söyleyebilir misin?

english: He's a duke.
Duke Horacio. Thank you.
He's a general.
General Horacio. Thank you.
He's a king.
King Horacio. Thank you.
He's a lord.
Lord Horacio. Thank you.
You've talked to the goblins on the surface, haven't you? Do you know the name of the god that the surface goblins worship?
translation: Yüzeydeki goblinlerle konustun, degil mi? Yüzeydeki goblinlerin taptigi tanrinin adini biliyor musun?

english: Nobody knows.
Oh well. Thanks anyway.
It's just called the Big High War God.
translation: Sadece Büyük Yüksek Savas Tanrisi olarak adlandiriliyor.

english: Ah, thank you.
It was Zamorak.
It was Guthix.
It was Saradomin.
It was [player name].
[player name]? What a terrible, fear-inducing name!
translation: Maceraci mi? Ne korkunc, korku uyandiran bir isim!

english: I'm writing about the great war between the gods that happened thousands of years ago. Do you know the reason for this war?
translation: Binlerce yil önce tanrilar arasinda yasanan büyük savas hakkinda yaziyorum. Bu savasin nedenini biliyor musun?

english: It was for the gods' own entertainment.
Just as I'd thought. Thank you.
Zamorak attacked the other gods.
Really? Thank you for the information.
The other gods attacked Zaros.
Thanks.
Guthix wanted to preserve balance so he made the other gods fight.
translation: Guthix dengeyi korumak istedigi icin diger tanrilari savastirdi.

english: A strange idea of balance! Thank you.
What's the name of the group of surface-people that tried to destroy Dorgesh-Kaan?
translation: Dorgesh-Kaan'i yok etmeye calisan yüzey halkinin adi nedir?

english: H.A.M.
Hmm, I wonder what that stands for?
It stands for Humans Against Monsters.
translation: Humans Against Monsters (Canavarlara Karsi Insanlar) anlamina geliyor.

english: So we're monsters, are we? Thanks for telling me!
translation: Yani biz canavar miyiz? Söylediginiz icin tesekkürler!

english: B.A.C.O.N.
Hmm, I wonder what that stands for. Thank you.
translation: Hmm, acaba ne anlama geliyor? Tesekkürler.

english: P.O.R.K.
Hmm, I wonder what that stands for? Thank you.
translation: Hmm, acaba ne anlama geliyor? Tesekkürler.

english: B.E.E.F.
What species are you, if you don't mind my asking? I know there are many different races living on the surface, but I don't know which one you are.
translation: Sakincasi yoksa, sen hangi türdensin? Yüzeyde bircok farkli irk yasadigini biliyorum, ama sen hangisisin bilmiyorum.

english: I'm a human!
Ah, good, that's what I thought.
translation: Ah, iyi, ben de öyle düsünmüstüm.

english: A human, hmm? Thank you.
That's a relief! I thought you were some kind of horrible ogre!
translation: Ne rahatladim! Seni korkunc bir canavar sandim!

english: Ah, of course. I thought you looked a little tall for a dwarf.
translation: Ah, tabii ki. Cüce icin biraz uzun görünüyordun da.

english: Oh! I thought you were an elf. Surface species are confusing!
translation: Oh! Seni elf sandim. Yüzey türleri kafa karistirici!

english: I'm an ogre. Raah!
Eek! An ogre! I had thought you were human!
translation: Eek! Bir canavar! Seni insan sandim!

english: An ogre, hmm? Thank you.
Ah, that's what I thought!
And I thought you were an elf! What a silly mistake!
translation: Ben de seni elf sanmistim! Ne aptalca bir hata!

english: I'm a dwarf!
Oh? I thought dwarves were shorter. I thought you were human!
translation: Oh? Cücelerin daha kisa oldugunu saniyordum. Seni insan sandim!

english: A dwarf, hmm? Thank you.
Ah, yes, of course, you said.
translation: Ah, evet, tabii ki, öyle demistin.

english: I'm an elf!
Oh? I thought elves were more graceful. I thought you were human!
translation: Oh? Elflerin daha zarif oldugunu saniyordum. Seni insan sandim!

english: An elf, hmm? Thank you.
Oh? I thought elves were more graceful. I thought you were a dwarf!
translation: Oh? Elflerin daha zarif oldugunu saniyordum. Seni bir cüce sandim!

english: Ah yes, that's what I thought.
translation: Ah evet, ben de öyle düsünmüstüm.

english: What is this building?
This is the Dorgeshuun Council chamber!
Whenever a decision needs to be made, the seven members of the Dorgeshuun Council meet here. The last meeting was when they decided to open up the city to surface-dwellers.
translation: Bir karar verilmesi gerektiginde, Dorgeshuun Konseyi'nin yedi üyesi burada toplanir. Son toplantida, sehri yüzey sakinlerine acmaya karar verdiler.

english: In between meetings, I work here writing up the minutes of the meetings and working on the definitive history of Dorgesh-Kaan.
translation: Toplantilar arasinda, burada toplanti tutanaklarini yaziyor ve Dorgesh-Kaan'in kesin tarihini hazirliyorum.

english: Can you tell me about the history of the city?
Of course! I've gone through all of my predecessors' notes and compiled the definitive history of the Dorgeshuun! What would you like to hear about?
translation: Tabii ki! Tüm öncüllerimin notlarini inceledim ve Dorgeshuun'un kesin tarihini derledim! Ne hakkinda bilgi almak istersin?

english: Can you tell me about the founding of Dorgesh-Kaan?
Of course!  *Ahem*
Before Dorgesh-Kaan, the Dorgeshuun lived on the surface with many other goblin tribes. All goblins were ruled over by an evil god whose name has been forgotten.
translation: Dorgesh-Kaan'dan önce, Dorgeshuun diger bircok goblin kabilesiyle birlikte yüzeyde yasiyordu. Tüm goblinler, adi unutulmus kötü bir tanri tarafindan yönetiliyordu.

english: The gods became bored and decided to make the mortal races fight for their amusement. The goblins were sent to fight in many bloody battles against each other and other races.
translation: Tanrilar sikildilar ve eglenmek icin ölümlü irklari savastirmaya karar verdiler. Goblinler, birbirleriyle ve diger irklarla bircok kanli savasta savasmaya gönderildiler.

english: The war lasted for thousands of years, and millions of goblins died. Eventually, the evil god sent the Dorgeshuun tribe to fight a battle that they could not win.
translation: Savas binlerce yil sürdü ve milyonlarca goblin öldü. Sonunda, kötü tanri Dorgeshuun kabilesini kazanamayacaklari bir savasa gönderdi.

english: But General Bloodfist of the Dorgeshuun refused to fight in this battle. Instead, he commanded the Dorgeshuun army to march down into a fissure in the ground.
translation: Ancak Dorgeshuun'un General Bloodfist bu savasta savasmayi reddetti. Bunun yerine, Dorgeshuun ordusuna yerdeki bir yariga dogru ilerlemelerini emretti.

english: General Bloodfist stood at the mouth of the fissure and defied the might of the evil god.
translation: General Bloodfist, catlagin agzinda durdu ve kötü tanrinin gücüne karsi geldi.

english: The evil god smote him with a mighty blast that shook the earth, but that blast also closed the fissure, sealing the Dorgeshuun away from the reach of the gods.
translation: Kötü tanri, dünyayi sarsan güclü bir patlamayla onu vurdu, ancak bu patlama ayni zamanda catlagi da kapatti ve Dorgeshuun'u tanrilarin ulasamayacagi bir yere hapsetti.

english: Lieutenant Strongaxe, now the leader of the Dorgeshuun, led the tribe deeper into the caves. They found this cavern, and here they founded Dorgesh- Kaan, city of the Dorgeshuun.
translation: Tegmen Strongaxe, artik Dorgeshuun'un lideri olarak kabileyi magaralarin derinliklerine dogru yönlendirdi. Bu magarayi buldular ve burada Dorgeshuun'un sehri Dorgesh-Kaan'i kurdular.

english: The god Zamorak attacked the other gods, starting a great war. The goblins were sent to fight in many bloody battles against each other and other races.
translation: Tanri Zamorak diger tanrilara saldirdi ve büyük bir savas baslatti. Goblinler, birbirleriyle ve diger irklarla bircok kanli savasta savasmak üzere gönderildiler.

english: The other gods decided to remove the great god Zaros from power, and started a great war. The goblins were sent to fight in many bloody battles against each other and other races.
translation: Diger tanrilar, büyük tanri Zaros'u iktidardan uzaklastirmaya karar verdiler ve büyük bir savas baslattilar. Goblinler, birbirleriyle ve diger irklarla bircok kanli savasta savasmak üzere gönderildiler.

english: In order to preserve balance, the god Guthix made the other gods fight against one another. The goblins were sent to fight in many bloody battles against each other and other races.
translation: Dengeyi korumak icin tanri Guthix, diger tanrilari birbirleriyle savasmaya zorladi. Goblinler, birbirleriyle ve diger irklarla bircok kanli savasta savasmaya gönderildi.

english: Before Dorgesh-Kaan, the Dorgeshuun lived on the surface with many other goblin tribes. All goblins were ruled over by an evil god called Big High War God.
translation: Dorgesh-Kaan'dan önce, Dorgeshuun diger bircok goblin kabilesiyle birlikte yüzeyde yasiyordu. Tüm goblinler, Büyük Yüksek Savas Tanrisi adli kötü bir tanri tarafindan yönetiliyordu.

english: Before Dorgesh-Kaan, the Dorgeshuun lived on the surface with many other goblin tribes. All goblins were ruled over by an evil god called Zamorak.
translation: Dorgesh-Kaan'dan önce, Dorgeshuun diger bircok goblin kabilesiyle birlikte yüzeyde yasiyordu. Tüm goblinler, Zamorak adli kötü bir tanri tarafindan yönetiliyordu.

english: Before Dorgesh-Kaan, the Dorgeshuun lived on the surface with many other goblin tribes. All goblins were ruled over by an evil god called Guthix.
translation: Dorgesh-Kaan'dan önce, Dorgeshuun diger bircok goblin kabilesiyle birlikte yüzeyde yasiyordu. Tüm goblinler, Guthix adli kötü bir tanri tarafindan yönetiliyordu.

english: Before Dorgesh-Kaan, the Dorgeshuun lived on the surface with many other goblin tribes. All goblins were ruled over by an evil god called Saradomin.
translation: Dorgesh-Kaan'dan önce, Dorgeshuun diger bircok goblin kabilesiyle birlikte yüzeyde yasiyordu. Tüm goblinler, Saradomin adli kötü bir tanri tarafindan yönetiliyordu.

english: Before Dorgesh-Kaan, the Dorgeshuun lived on the surface with many other goblin tribes. All goblins were ruled over by an evil god called [player name].
translation: Dorgesh-Kaan'dan önce, Dorgeshuun diger bircok goblin kabilesiyle birlikte yüzeyde yasiyordu. Tüm goblinler, Maceraci adli kötü bir tanri tarafindan yönetiliyordu.

english: Can you tell me about the Dorgeshuun civil war?
translation: Dorgeshuun ic savasi hakkinda bilgi verebilir misiniz?

english: Certainly!  *Ahem*
At first, Dorgesh-Kaan was ruled over by generals, just as the tribe had been when it was on the surface. Each general succeeded the last by defeating him in combat.
translation: Baslangicta, Dorgesh-Kaan, kabile yüzeydeyken oldugu gibi generaller tarafindan yönetiliyordu. Her general, bir önceki generali savasta yenerek onun yerini aliyordu.

english: The generals were advised by a council of elders, but the Dorgeshuun were no longer an army, and many of the people felt that the Council should have authority.
translation: Generaller, yaslilar konseyinin tavsiyelerine uyuyordu, ancak Dorgeshuun artik bir ordu degildi ve halkin cogu konseyin otorite sahibi olmasi gerektigini düsünüyordu.

english: The people voted to become a republic, but General Bonehelm refused to give up power, and so the Dorgeshuun Civil War began.
translation: Halk cumhuriyet olmaya karar verdi, ancak General Bonehelm iktidari birakmayi reddetti ve böylece Dorgeshuun Ic Savasi basladi.

english: The republican faction was larger, but the military faction contained most of the trained warriors and controlled the magical equipment that the tribe had brought from the surface.
translation: Cumhuriyetci grup daha büyüktü, ancak askeri grup egitimli savascilarin cogunu barindiriyordu ve kabilenin yüzeyden getirdigi büyülü ekipmanlari kontrol ediyordu.

english: General Bonehelm was driven from the city, but dug his own base out of the caves nearby.
translation: General Bonehelm sehirden sürüldü, ancak yakindaki magaralardan kendi üssünü kazdi.

english: General Bonehelm's army attacked the city using archers mounted on giant frogs. There was a bloody battle, and General Bonehelm was driven back again into his base.
translation: General Bonehelm'in ordusu, dev kurbagalarin sirtinda okcularla sehri saldirdi. Kanli bir savas yasandi ve General Bonehelm tekrar üssüne geri cekildi.

english: But General Bonehelm's mining had weakened the stone around his base, and the retreating army's footsteps caused the roof to collapse, crushing his army.
translation: Ancak General Bonehelm'in madencilik faaliyetleri üssünün etrafindaki kayalari zayiflatmisti ve geri cekilen ordunun ayak sesleri tavanin cökmesine neden olarak ordusunu ezdi.

english: That was the last time one Dorgeshuun has raised arms against another. Since then, the city has been ruled peacefully by an elected council.
translation: Bu, bir Dorgeshuun'un bir digerine karsi silah kaldirdigi son olaydi. O zamandan beri sehir, secilmis bir konsey tarafindan baris icinde yönetiliyor.

english: Can you tell me about recent years?
translation: Son yillar hakkinda bana bilgi verebilir misiniz?

english: Ah, this is where you come in!  *Ahem*

In the twenty-ninth century since the founding of the city, one of the miners broke through a wall into the cellar of a surface dwelling. The miners blocked up the tunnel and went back into their mines.
translation: Sehrin kurulusundan bu yana gecen yirmi dokuzuncu yüzyilda, madencilerden biri bir duvari kirarak yüzeydeki bir evin mahzenine girdi. Madenciler tüneli kapatti ve madenlerine geri döndü.

english: However, a human named [player name] found [his/her] way through the caves and made contact with the miners.
translation: Ancak, Maceraci adli bir insan magaralardan gecerek madencilere ulasti.

english: Ur-tag, head of the Council, signed a peace treaty with Duke Horacio of Lumbridge, ruler of the town above the Dorgeshuuns' mine.
translation: Konsey baskani Ur-tag, Dorgeshuun madeninin üzerindeki kasabanin hükümdari Lumbridge Dükü Horacio ile bir baris antlasmasi imzaladi.

english: But not all surface-dwellers were friendly, and a faction called H.A.M. attempted to destroy the Dorgeshuun.
translation: Ancak yüzey sakinlerinin hepsi dostca davranmadi ve H.A.M. adli bir grup Dorgeshuun'u yok etmeye calisti.

english: The Council sent Zanik to explore the surface to see if the H.A.M. group was plotting anything. With [player name]'s help, Zanik defeated a H.A.M. plot to flood Dorgesh-Kaan.[confirmation needed]
translation: Konsey, H.A.M. grubunun bir komplo kurup kurmadigini arastirmasi icin Zanik'i yüzeye gönderdi. Maceraci'nin yardimiyla Zanik, Dorgesh-Kaan'i su basma planini bozdu.

english: Despite reservations from many citizens, the Council eventually voted 4-3 to open Dorgesh-Kaan to surface- dwellers.[confirmation needed]
translation: Bircok vatandasin cekincelerine ragmen, Konsey sonunda 4-3 oyla Dorgesh-Kaan'i yüzey sakinlerine acmaya karar verdi.

english: But not all surface-dwellers were friendly, and a faction called B.A.C.O.N. attempted to destroy the Dorgeshuun.
translation: Ancak tüm yüzey sakinleri dostca davranmiyordu ve B.A.C.O.N. adli bir grup Dorgeshuun'u yok etmeye calisti.

english: The Council sent Zanik to explore the surface to see if the B.A.C.O.N. group was plotting anything. With [player name]'s help, Zanik defeated a B.A.C.O.N. plot to flood Dorgesh- Kaan.[confirmation needed]
translation: Konsey, B.A.C.O.N. grubunun bir komplo kurup kurmadigini arastirmasi icin Zanik'i yüzeye gönderdi. Maceraci'nin yardimiyla Zanik, Dorgesh-Kaan'i su basma planini bozdu.

english: But not all surface-dwellers were friendly, and a faction called P.O.R.K. attempted to destroy the Dorgeshuun.
translation: Ancak yüzey sakinlerinin hepsi dostca davranmiyordu ve P.O.R.K. adli bir grup Dorgeshuun'u yok etmeye calisti.

english: The Council sent Zanik to explore the surface to see if the P.O.R.K. group was plotting anything. With [player name]'s help, Zanik defeated a P.O.R.K. plot to flood Dorgesh-Kaan.
translation: Konsey, P.O.R.K. grubunun bir komplo kurup kurmadigini arastirmasi icin Zanik'i yüzeye gönderdi. Maceraci'nin yardimiyla Zanik, Dorgesh-Kaan'i su basma planini bozdu.

english: Despite reservations from many citizens, the Council eventually voted 4-3 to open Dorgesh-Kaan to surface- dwellers.
translation: Bircok vatandasin cekincelerine ragmen, Konsey sonunda 4-3 oyla Dorgesh-Kaan'i yüzey sakinlerine acmaya karar verdi.

english: But not all surface-dwellers were friendly, and a faction called B.E.E.F. attempted to destroy the Dorgeshuun.
translation: Ancak tüm yüzey sakinleri dostca davranmiyordu ve B.E.E.F. adli bir grup Dorgeshuun'u yok etmeye calisti.

english: The Council sent Zanik to explore the surface to see if the B.E.E.F. group was plotting anything. With %USERNAME%'s help, Zanik defeated a B.E.E.F. plot to flood Dorgesh-Kaan.
translation: Konsey, B.E.E.F. grubunun bir komplo kurup kurmadigini arastirmasi icin Zanik'i yüzeye gönderdi. %USERNAME%'nin yardimiyla Zanik, Dorgesh-Kaan'i su basmak icin kurulan B.E.E.F. komplosunu engelledi.

english: Ur-tag, head of the Council, signed a peace treaty with General Horacio of Lumbridge, ruler of the town above the Dorgeshuuns' mine.
translation: Konsey baskani Ur-tag, Dorgeshuuns madeninin yukarisindaki kasabanin hükümdari Lumbridge'li General Horacio ile baris antlasmasi imzaladi.

english: Ur-tag, head of the Council, signed a peace treaty with King Horacio of Lumbridge, ruler of the town above the Dorgeshuuns' mine.
translation: Konsey baskani Ur-tag, Dorgeshuuns madeninin yukarisindaki kasabanin hükümdari Lumbridge Krali Horacio ile baris antlasmasi imzaladi.

english: Ur-tag, head of the Council, signed a peace treaty with Lord Horacio of Lumbridge, ruler of the town above the Dorgeshuuns' mine.
translation: Konsey baskani Ur-tag, Dorgeshuuns madeninin yukarisindaki kasabanin hükümdari Lumbridge Lordu Horacio ile baris antlasmasi imzaladi.

english: However, an ogre named [player name] found [his/her] way through the caves and made contact with the miners.
translation: Ancak, Maceraci adli bir ogre magaralardan gecerek madencilerle temasa gecti.

english: However, a dwarf named [player name] found [his/her] way through the caves and made contact with the miners.
translation: Ancak, Maceraci adli bir cüce magaralardan gecerek madencilerle temasa gecti.

english: However, an elf named [player name] found [his/her] way through the caves and made contact with the miners.
translation: Ancak, Maceraci adli bir elf magaralardan gecerek madencilerle temasa gecti.

english: Ah, hello Zanik, hello [player name]. How is the dig going?
translation: Ah, merhaba Zanik, merhaba Maceraci. Kazi nasil gidiyor?

english: [player name] helped us to finish the dig! Look what [he/she] dug up!
translation: Maceraci kaziyi bitirmemize yardim etti! Bakin ne cikardi!

english: Hmm... that is interesting. What do you think it is?
translation: Hmm... ilginc. Sence bu ne olabilir?

english: It's a mace.
[player name] says that's a kind of weapon.
translation: Maceraci bunun bir tür silah oldugunu söylüyor.

english: I can see how. I certainly wouldn't want to be hit with it!
We think it's a magical weapon from the surface. Can you decipher the symbols on it?
translation: Yüzeyden gelen büyülü bir silah oldugunu düsünüyoruz. Üzerindeki sembolleri cözebilir misin?

english: Hmm...
No, I'm afraid not. Our written language has developed so much since then that it's totally indecipherable to me.
translation: Hayir, maalesef cözemem. Yazili dilimiz o zamandan beri o kadar gelisti ki, benim icin tamamen anlasilmaz hale geldi.

english: Oh well.
Wait a moment. [player name], didn't you say you talked to some surface goblins when you were trying to find your way through our mines?
translation: Bir dakika. Maceraci, madenlerimizde yolunu ararken yüzeydeki goblinlerle konustugunu söylememis miydin?

english: Yes, I talked to the generals in the Goblin Village.
Perhaps you could talk to them again. They might know more about weapons than we do.
translation: Belki onlarla tekrar konusabilirsin. Silahlar hakkinda bizden daha fazla bilgi sahibi olabilirler.

english: Good idea!
Hello, Zanik. Have you found out about that mace yet?
translation: Merhaba, Zanik. O topuz hakkinda bir sey bulabildin mi?

english: Not yet. Come on, [player name]! We should go and ask the goblin generals about it!
translation: Henüz degil. Hadi, Maceraci! Gidip goblin generallerine soralim!

english: Tell me again about the surface. You said the cavern ceiling was how high?
translation: Yüzey hakkinda tekrar anlat bana. Magara tavani ne kadar yüksekti demistin?

english: No, there was no cavern ceiling. Just a great expanse of blue sky!
translation: Hayir, magara tavani yoktu. Sadece ucsuz bucaksiz mavi gökyüzü vardi!

english: You couldn't see how high the ceiling was because the sky was in the way. I see.
translation: Gökyüzü engel oldugu icin tavanin yüksekligini göremedin. Anliyorum.

english: No, you don't understand. There was NO ceiling. The surface is right on top of the world! There's no more rock above it!
translation: Hayir, anlamiyorsun. Tavan YOKTU. Yüzey dünyanin tam üstünde! Üstünde baska kaya yok!

english: I'm still having trouble getting my head around this 'surface' idea.
Perhaps I should take you to see it?
Oh, no, no, no. I think I'd rather stay here and write about it.
translation: Oh, hayir, hayir, hayir. Sanirim burada kalip bunu yazmayi tercih ederim.

english: Alright. Hello, %USERNAME%.
Hello, Zanik! What have you been up to?
What are you doing?
He's a duke.
He's a general.
He's a king.
He's a lord.
Nobody knows.
Big High War God.
Zamorak.
More...
It was Guthix.
It was Saradomin.
It was [player name]
It was for the gods' own entertainment.
Zamorak attacked the other gods.
The other gods attacked Zaros.
Guthix wanted to preserve balance.
H.A.M.
B.A.C.O.N.
P.O.R.K.
B.E.E.F.
I'm human!
I'm an ogre.
I'm a dwarf.
I'm an elf.
What is this building?
Can you tell me about the history of the city?
The founding of Dorgesh-Kaan.
The Dorgeshuun civil war.
Recent years.
What can I get you?
What are you serving?
Can you tell me where I am?
You're in The Golden Field. There's a bank to the south and my grandfather's fruit farm is south-east near the beach. Fancy a drink now?
translation: Altin Tarlada'sin. Güneyde bir banka var ve dedemin meyve ciftligi güneydoguda, plajin yakininda. Bir icki ister misin?

english: Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: Burada herhangi bir söylenti duydun mu?

english: Apparently Veos is looking for some help with something. He hangs around the docks of Port Piscarilius.
translation: Görünüse göre Veos bir konuda yardim ariyor. Port Piscarilius limaninda takiliyor.

english: They say there's trouble in Port Piscarilius. Something about gangs uniting. Might be worth looking into.
translation: Port Piscarilius'ta sorunlar oldugu söyleniyor. Cetelerin birlestigi ile ilgili bir sey. Arastirmaya deger olabilir.

english: I hear that Lord Hosidius has misplaced one of his sons. The Hosidius family might pay a lot to see him returned safely.
translation: Lord Hosidius'un ogullarindan birini kaybettigini duydum. Hosidius ailesi onu sag salim geri getirmek icin cok para ödeyebilir.

english: Phileas Rimor has supposedly been looking for some assistance with something in Shayzien. Maybe worth investigating.
translation: Phileas Rimor'un Shayzien'de bir konuda yardim aradigi söyleniyor. Arastirmaya deger olabilir.

english: I hear that the rulers of Lovakengj have some work available. You'll find them in the Lovakengj Assembly.
translation: Lovakengj'in yöneticilerinin bazi isleri oldugunu duydum. Onlari Lovakengj Meclisi'nde bulabilirsin.

english: Apparently there's been some commotion in the middle of Arceuus. Might be worth checking out.
translation: Görünüse göre Arceuus'un ortasinda bir kargasa var. Bir göz atmaya deger olabilir.

english: That protest outside Kourend Castle is starting to attract some attention. Could be worth taking a look.
translation: Kourend Kalesi'nin disindaki protesto dikkat cekmeye basladi. Bir göz atmaya deger olabilir.

english: No, it hasn't been very busy lately.
translation: Hayir, son zamanlarda cok yogun degildi.

english: I'm okay, thanks.
With some of these drinks inside you, you could be far more than merely okay!
translation: Bu ickilerden biraz icersen, sadece iyi olmaktan cok daha fazlasi olabilirsin!

english: What are you serving?
Can you tell me where I am?
I'm okay, thanks.
Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: Burada herhangi bir söylenti duydun mu?

english: What are you doing down here? Leave before you get yourself into trouble.
translation: Burada ne yapiyorsun? Basini belaya sokmadan git buradan.

english: Hello, are you okay?
It's just those blasted hob-gobs. I locked myself in here for protection. But I've left the key somewhere and now I'm stuck.
translation: Sadece o lanet hobgoblar. Kendimi korumak icin buraya kilitledim. Ama anahtari bir yere biraktim ve simdi burada sikisip kaldim.

english: Okay... I'll have a look for a key.
Hello, who are you?
I am Golrie, I've been stuck here for ages, those hob-gobs are trying to steal my family's heirlooms. My grandad gave me all sorts of old junk.
translation: Ben Golrie, uzun zamandir burada sikisip kaldim, o hobgoblar ailemin yadigarlarini calmaya calisiyor. Büyükbabam bana her türlü eski ivir ziviri verdi.

english: Do you mind if I have a look?
No, of course not.
You look amongst the junk on the floor and find Glarial's pebble.
translation: Yerdeki hurdalara bakarsin ve Glarial'in cakil tasini bulursun.

english: Could I take this old pebble?
translation: Bu eski cakil tasini alabilir miyim?

english: Oh that, yes have it, it's just some old elven junk I believe.
translation: Oh, evet, alabilirsin, sanirim eski bir elf hurdasidir.

english: Thanks for the key traveller. I think I'll wait in here until those hob-gobs get bored and leave.
translation: Anahtar icin tesekkürler gezgin. Sanirim hob-goblar sikilip gidene kadar burada bekleyecegim.

english: Okay, take care Golrie.
Hello Golrie.
Hello again.
Do you mind if I have another look through this stuff?
translation: Bu esyalara bir daha bakabilir miyim?

english: You look amongst the junk on the floor but find nothing of interest.
translation: Yerdeki hurdalara bakarsin ama ilginc bir sey bulamazsin.

english: Hello, Golrie. How's it going?
Better now I'm on the right side of these bars.
translation: Artik bu parmakliklarin dogru tarafinda oldugum icin daha iyi.

english: Found anything interesting recently?
translation: Son zamanlarda ilginc bir sey buldun mu?

english: It just so happens I have. Take a look at this book.
translation: Aslinda buldum. Su kitaba bir bak.

english: Thanks.
I managed to find that device.
Wonderful! Though you know, I don't think you ever actually mentioned what the device does.
translation: Harika! Ama biliyorsun, cihazin ne ise yaradigini hic söylemedin.

english: It counteracts illusion magic in the surrounding area. This one should cover the whole of the Tree Gnome Village. It might be useful for someone to remember that in case it's needed again.
translation: Cevresindeki illüzyon büyüsünü etkisiz hale getiriyor. Bu, Agac Cüceleri Köyü'nün tamamini kapsiyor. Birinin bunu hatirlamasi yararli olabilir, tekrar ihtiyac duyulursa diye.

english: Oh, well I'll be sure to keep that in mind.
I found Bolrie's diary. Do you know anything about it?
translation: Bolrie'nin günlügünü buldum. Bu konuda bir sey biliyor musun?

english: Of course! Bolrie is my grandfather... assuming he's still alive, at least.
translation: Tabii ki! Bolrie benim dedem... en azindan hala hayatta oldugunu varsayarsak.

english: Bolrie... Golrie... I should have guessed. You seem to like giving your children similar names, just to be confusing.
translation: Bolrie... Golrie... Tahmin etmeliydim. Cocuklarina kafa karistirmak icin benzer isimler vermeyi seviyorsun galiba.

english: Certainly, in our family that's true. King Bolren is also Bolrie's younger brother, in case you didn't know.
translation: Kesinlikle, bizim ailede durum böyle. Bilmiyorsan, Kral Bolren de Bolrie'nin kücük kardesi.

english: So that means you're King Bolren's grand-nephew, right?
translation: Yani sen Kral Bolren'in yegenisin, degil mi?

english: That's right.
Does that mean that you're in line for the throne?
translation: Bu, tahtin varisi oldugun anlamina mi geliyor?

english: Gnomes don't have a hereditary monarchy. We have a democratic monarchy. We vote for our kings.
translation: Cüceler kalitsal monarsiye sahip degildir. Biz demokratik monarsiye sahibiz. Krallarimizi oylarla seceriz.

english: Oh, that's unusual. So you've never thought about being the King?
translation: Oh, bu alisilmadik bir sey. Yani hic kral olmayi düsünmedin mi?

english: That might be fun. I wouldn't want to be like gramps though. He liked wars a bit too much. I do sometimes discuss the Khazard War with the hobgobbos, but they don't have a particularly sharp political sense.
translation: Bu eglenceli olabilir. Ama dedem gibi olmak istemem. O savaslari biraz fazla seviyordu. Bazen hobgobboslarla Khazard Savasi'ni tartisirim, ama onlarin politik anlayisi pek keskin degildir.

english: Personally, I don't think we should fight his troops head- on. We're smarter than that. We should come up with some ingenious method of defeating Khazard, like they did at the Battle of Atarisundri!
translation: Sahsen, onun ordulariyla dogrudan savasmamiz gerektigini düsünmüyorum. Biz bundan daha akilliyiz. Atarisundri Savasi'nda yaptiklari gibi, Khazard'i yenmek icin dahice bir yöntem bulmaliyiz!

english: You're very well informed for a gnome in a cave. Most gnomes I've talked to have forgotten most of their own history.
translation: Bir magarada yasayan bir cüce icin cok bilgilisiniz. Konustugum cogu cüce, kendi tarihlerinin cogunu unutmus durumda.

english: Gnomes don't tend to dwell on the past, but I suppose I'm not a typical gnome. I get lots of time to think and read in here.
translation: Cüceler genellikle gecmiste takilip kalmazlar, ama sanirim ben tipik bir cüce degilim. Burada düsünmek ve okumak icin bolca vaktim var.

english: So have you heard from Bolrie recently?
translation: Son zamanlarda Bolrie'den haber aldin mi?

english: No, the parcels stopped arriving a few years ago. I guess he's either found what he was looking for, or has died in the attempt.
translation: Hayir, paketler birkac yil önce gelmeyi kesti. Sanirim ya aradigini buldu ya da bu ugurda öldü.

english: What was he looking for?
I'm not sure. He was definitely obsessed with finding out as much as he could about elven magic. He also seemed to have a bit of a grudge against Glouphrie.
translation: Emin degilim. Elf büyüsü hakkinda olabildigince cok sey ögrenmeye takintiliydi. Ayrica Glouphrie'ye karsi biraz kin besliyor gibiydi.

english: Maybe he's looking for Glouphrie.
Who knows, eh? Who knows?
translation: Kim bilir, degil mi? Kim bilir?

english: Where did that crystal bowl come from?
A huge battle tortoise arrived a while back carrying a crate with it in. Sent by gramps, of course. It looks pretty, doesn't it? Would probably look great with some plants in it.
translation: Bir süre önce kocaman bir savas kaplumbagasi gelip icinde bir sandik getirdi. Tabii ki büyükbaba göndermisti. Güzel görünüyor, degil mi? Icine birkac bitki koysan cok güzel olur.

english: I don't think it's meant to be used as a plant pot.
translation: Bitki saksisi olarak kullanilmak icin yapilmis oldugunu sanmiyorum.

english: Well, what's it for then?
It's a singing bowl. You can use it to shape elven crystal.
translation: Bu bir sarki canagi. Elf kristalini sekillendirmek icin kullanabilirsin.

english: Ohh... How exciting!
I'd better get going.
See you later.
I have a question about your storeroom.
I lost that pebble.
Not to worry. It turned up here again.
Can I use your key?
If you wanna go in there with them hob-gobs, that's your business.
translation: O hobgoblarla oraya girmek istiyorsan, bu senin bilecegin is.

english: I'll leave you to it.
Yes, lots to do. Them hob-gobs left my stuff out here in a right mess. Until next time.
translation: Evet, yapacak cok is var. Hobgoblar esyalarimi burada daginik birakmislar. Bir dahaki sefere görüsürüz.

english: Found anything interesting recently?
translation: Son zamanlarda ilginc bir sey buldun mu?

english: I managed to find that device.
I found Bolrie's diary. Do you know anything about it?
translation: Bolrie'nin günlügünü buldum. Bununla ilgili bir sey biliyor musun?

english: Where did that crystal bowl come from?
I'd better get going.
I have a question about your storeroom.
I lost that pebble.
Can I use your key?
I'll leave you to it.
*HONK*
Of course, you honk. I don't know what I was expecting.
translation: Tabii ki, korna calarsin. Ne bekledigimi bilmiyorum.

english: That is one large, loud chicken.
translation: Bu cok büyük ve gürültülü bir tavuk.

english: I take it that stealth is not your speciality.
translation: Gizlilik senin uzmanlik alanin degil galiba.

english: The goose looks at you knowingly. It remembers all of your Christmas Achievements!
translation: Kaz sana anlamli bir sekilde bakiyor. Tüm Noel basarilarini hatirliyor!

english: ...Six Geese a-laying...
That's a loud honk.
translation: Bu cok gürültülü bir korna sesi.

english: Ha, HONK right back at you.
What would a goose want with a pub?
translation: Bir kazin pub'da ne isi olabilir ki?
