english: Looking closer at the Goose's hat. It's got the name 'Wolfy' written on it.
translation: Kazin sapkasini daha yakindan inceliyorum. Üzerinde “Wolfy” yaziyor.

english: You're actually pretty cute with that little hat.
translation: O kücük sapka ile gercekten cok sevimlisin.

english: Looking closer at the goose's hat, it's got the name 'Wolfy' written on it.
translation: Kazin sapkasini daha yakindan inceliyorum, üzerinde “Wolfy” yaziyor.

english: I wonder where you came from?
Hello. Who are you?
The name's Gordon. Good day to you.
It's a nice farm you've got here.
Thank you. We built it ourselves.
Really? So you haven't been here long?
translation: Gercekten mi? Yani buraya geleli cok olmadi?

english: Nope. Not too long ago you couldn't safely travel around these parts. Too many lizardmen. But then some Hosidius explorers discovered how fertile this land was.
translation: Hayir. Cok uzun zaman önce bu bölgede güvenli bir sekilde seyahat etmek mümkün degildi. Cok fazla kertenkele adam vardi. Ama sonra bazi Hosidius kasifleri bu topragin ne kadar verimli oldugunu kesfettiler.

english: Lord Hosidius made a deal with Lord Shayzien and the lizardmen were cleared out to make room for the Farming Guild.
translation: Lord Hosidius, Lord Shayzien ile bir anlasma yapti ve kertenkele adamlar, Ciftcilik Loncasi icin yer acmak üzere buradan uzaklastirildi.

english: When we heard, we decided to come up here and start up our own farm.
translation: Bunu duydugumuzda, buraya gelip kendi ciftligimizi kurmaya karar verdik.

english: Need a hand with anything?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Very nice. Well I hope it goes well for you.
translation: Cok güzel. Umarim isleriniz yolunda gider.

english: Thank you friend. See you later.
Hello again. How are things?
Hello there. Not too bad, thanks.
Great to hear. All the best.
translation: Bunu duymak güzel. Her sey gönlünce olsun.

english: Hello again. Thank you for dealing with that beast.
translation: Merhaba tekrar. O canavarla ilgilendigin icin tesekkürler.

english: Hello again. Thank you for dealing with that beast. As promised, here's your reward.
translation: Merhaba tekrar. O canavarla ilgilendigin icin tesekkürler. Söz verdigim gibi, iste ödülün.

english: It's my pleasure.
Need a hand with anything?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Very nice. Well I hope it goes well for you.
translation: Cok güzel. Umarim islerin yolunda gider.

english: Great to hear. All the best.
translation: Bunu duymak güzel. Her sey gönlünce olsun.

english: Hello.
Good day, can I help you?
No thanks I'm just watching the world go by.
Well I can think of no better place to do it, it is beautiful here is it not?
translation: Bunu yapmak icin daha iyi bir yer düsünemiyorum, burasi cok güzel, degil mi?

english: Indeed it is.
Well this was once the best place to do it, it used to be beautiful here.
translation: Eskiden burasi bunu yapmak icin en iyi yerdi, burasi eskiden cok güzeldi.

english: Will you repair the damage?
In time, once the war is over, assuming we survive it.
translation: Zamanla, savas bittiginde, hayatta kalirsak tabii.

english: Here, solve this.
Goreu hands you a [light/puzzle] box.
That doesn't look solved to me.
Well done [player name]. Here you go.
You've been given a [new clue/casket]!
What do you think you're doing?
Greetings human.
Hello. What is this place?
This is one of your human banks. We set it up here to help your kind serve the balance with us.
translation: Burasi sizin insan bankalarinizdan biri. Sizin türünüzün bizimle dengeyi saglamasina yardimci olmak icin burayi kurduk.

english: Do you not use it yourself?
No. We have no need for it. We have no possessions. We only have our cause.
translation: Hayir. Bizim buna ihtiyacimiz yok. Bizim hicbir malimiz yok. Sadece amacimiz var.

english: To serve the balance?
To serve the balance.

Well, this has certainly been exciting! The Sinclairs under house arrest, Morgan Le Faye attempting yet again to interfere with King Arthur and Merlin, and even the Black Knights sticking their noses into it.
translation: Bu gercekten heyecan vericiydi! Sinclair ailesi ev hapsinde, Morgan Le Faye yine Kral Arthur ve Merlin'e müdahale etmeye calisiyor ve hatta Kara Sövalyeler bile bu ise burnunu sokuyor.

english: How do you know all that? It only just happened, and you weren't there!
translation: Bunlari nereden biliyorsun? Daha yeni oldu ve sen orada degildin!

english: I have my sources. No secret is safe as long as I'm around!
translation: Kaynaklarim var. Ben etrafta oldugum sürece hicbir sir güvende degil!

english: Could I ask you about the Sinclair family again?
translation: Sinclair ailesi hakkinda tekrar soru sorabilir miyim?

english: Well, I'm not one to gossip, but as it's for your investigation... What would you like to know?
translation: Sey, dedikodu yapan biri degilim, ama sorusturman icinse... Ne bilmek istiyorsun?

english: Tell me about the family.
I've heard plenty about each of them...but I'll try to keep it as short as I can.
translation: Hepsi hakkinda cok sey duydum... ama olabildigince kisa tutmaya calisacagim.

english: Old Lord Sinclair was a well respected man this side of White Wolf. He was great friends with King Ulthas and did many good works for the kingdom.
translation: Eski Lord Sinclair, White Wolf'un bu tarafinda cok saygin bir adamdi. Kral Ulthas ile cok iyi arkadasti ve krallik icin bircok iyi is yapti.

english: His children on the other hand were spoiled and horrid. They cared for no one but themselves and gave themselves such aires. Each had their own vice, but I didn't expect any of them would be driven to murder!
translation: Öte yandan cocuklari simarik ve korkunctu. Kendilerinden baska kimseyi umursamiyorlardi ve kendilerini cok önemli saniyorlardi. Her birinin kendi kötü aliskanliklari vardi, ama hicbirinin cinayete sürüklenecegini tahmin etmemistim!

english: What have they been up to since the arrest of their sibling?
translation: Kardeslerinin tutuklanmasindan bu yana ne yapiyorlar?

english: They've been living very quietly, a nice change from the norm. But almost too quietly. I always thought they'd get into more trouble. No good will come from them, let me tell you!
translation: Cok sakin bir hayat sürüyorlar, normalden farkli bir degisiklik. Ama neredeyse fazla sakin. Her zaman daha fazla belaya bulasacaklarini düsünmüstüm. Onlardan iyi bir sey cikmayacak, inan bana!

english: Tell me about the mansion.
The mansion? The mansion is quite new. Originally, the Sinclair family lived in Camelot, although it went under a different name then.
translation: Malikane mi? Malikane oldukca yeni. Aslinda Sinclair ailesi Camelot'ta yasiyordu, ancak o zamanlar farkli bir isimle.

english: But when King Arthur and his knights appeared, old Lord Sinclair agreed with King Ulthas that the knights had greater need for the castle than the Sinclair family.
translation: Ama Kral Arthur ve sövalyeleri ortaya ciktiginda, yasli Lord Sinclair, Kral Ulthas ile sövalyelerin Sinclair ailesinden daha fazla kaleye ihtiyaclari oldugu konusunda anlasti.

english: So, Lord Sinclair had the mansion built, packed his family up and vacated. His children were furious with him for doing it.
translation: Böylece Lord Sinclair malikaneyi insa ettirdi, ailesini toplayip oradan ayrildi. Cocuklari ona cok kizdi.

english: They felt themselves far better than the knights and felt insulted at having to live in a stuffy mansion.
translation: Kendilerini sövalyelerden cok daha üstün görüyorlardi ve havasiz bir malikanede yasamak zorunda kalmaktan dolayi hakarete ugramis hissediyorlardi.

english: What happened next?
Well, you should know best... Anna killed her father. Poor man.
translation: Bunu en iyi sen bilirsin... Anna babasini öldürdü. Zavalli adam.

english: Tell me about Anna Sinclair.
Anna? The guards are keeping her in the jail in the courthouse in Seers' Village. I hear she's been acting like a royal pain.
translation: Anna mi? Muhafizlar onu Seers Köyü'ndeki adliye binasindaki hapishanede tutuyorlar. Duyduguma göre cok sorunlu davraniyormus.

english: But what is she like? Can she be reasoned with?
translation: Peki nasil biri? Mantikli davranabilir mi?

english: Reasoned with? She killed her own father!
translation: Mantikli davranmak mi? Kendi babasini öldürdü!

english: I hear she's being so unreasonable that no lawyer in Gielinor will represent her. She's going to get a guilty verdict for sure.
translation: Duyduguma göre o kadar mantiksiz davraniyor ki Gielinor'daki hicbir avukat onu temsil etmek istemiyor. Kesinlikle suclu bulunacak.

english: Still, I go and visit her at the Seers' Village courthouse sometimes to try and keep her spirits up.
translation: Yine de, bazen Seers' Village adliyesine gidip onu ziyaret ediyorum, moralini yüksek tutmaya calisiyorum.

english: Never mind.
Where is Anna Sinclair being held?
At the Seers' Village courthouse.
Tell me about the family.
Tell me about the mansion.
Tell me about Anna Sinclair.
Never mind.
Tell me where Anna Sinclair is being held.
translation: Anna Sinclair'in tutuldugu yeri söyle bana.

english: There's some kind of commotion up at the Sinclair place I hear. Not surprising all things considered.
translation: Sinclair'lerin evinde bir tür kargasa oldugunu duydum. Her seyi göz önünde bulundurursak, bu hiç de sasirtici degil.

english: I'm investigating the murder up at the Sinclair place.
Murder is it? Well, I'm not really surprised...
What can you tell me about the Sinclairs?
Well, what do you want to know?
Tell me about Lord Sinclair.
Old Lord Sinclair was a great man with a lot of respect in these parts. More than his worthless children have anyway.
translation: Yasli Lord Sinclair bu bölgede çok saygi duyulan büyük bir adamdi. En azindan degersiz çocuklarindan daha fazla.

english: His children? They have something to gain by his death?
translation: Çocuklari mi? Onun ölümünden kazançlari mi var?

english: Yes. You could say that. Not that I'm one to gossip.
translation: Evet. Öyle de denebilir. Dedikodu yapan biri degilim ama.

english: Why do the Sinclairs live so far from town?
translation: Sinclair ailesi neden kasabadan bu kadar uzakta yasiyor?

english: Well, they used to live in the big castle, but old Lord Sinclair gave it up so that those strange knights could live there instead. So the king built him a new house to the North.
translation: Eskiden büyük bir kalede yasiyorlardi, ama yasli Lord Sinclair o kaleyi o tuhaf sövalyelere birakip oradan ayrildi. Kral da ona kuzeyde yeni bir ev yaptirdi.

english: It's more cramped than his old place, but he seemed to like it. His children were furious at him for doing it though!
translation: Eski evinden daha dar bir yerdi, ama o orayi sevmis gibiydi. Çocuklari ise ona çok kizmisti!

english: What can you tell me about his sons?
What can you tell me about his daughters?
Who do you think was responsible?
Who do you think was responsible?
Well, I guess it could have been an intruder, but with that big guard dog of theirs I seriously doubt it. I suspect it was someone closer to home...
translation: Sey, bir hirsiz olabilir, ama o büyük bekçi köpekleri varken bunu ciddi olarak süpheliyorum. Bence evlerine daha yakin biri...

english: Especially as I heard that the poison salesman in the Seers' village made a big sale to one of the family the other day.
translation: Özellikle de Seers köyündeki zehir saticisinin geçen gün ailenin bir üyesine büyük bir satis yaptigini duydugum için.

english: I think the butler did it.
I think the butler did it.
And I think you've been reading too many cheap detective novels. Hobbes is kind of uptight, but his loyalty to old Lord Sinclair is beyond question.
translation: Ve bence sen çok fazla ucuz dedektif romani okuyorsun. Hobbes biraz gergin biridir, ama yasli Lord Sinclair'e olan sadakati tartisilmaz.

english: I am so confused about who did it...
Think you could give me any hints?
Well, I don't know how much help this is, but I heard that their guard dog will bark loudly at anyone it doesn't recognise. Maybe you should find out if anyone heard anything suspicious?
translation: Ne kadar yardimci olur bilmiyorum ama, taniyamadigi herkese bekçi köpeginin yüksek sesle havladigini duydum. Belki de süpheli bir sey duyan var mi diye arastirmalisin?

english: I don't know how much help this is to you but my dad was in the guard once, and he told me that the marks on your hands are totally unique. He called them 'finger prints'.
translation: Ne kadar yardimci olur bilmiyorum ama babam bir zamanlar muhafizdi ve bana ellerindeki izlerin tamamen benzersiz oldugunu söylemisti. Onlara “parmak izi” diyordu.

english: He said you can find them easily on any shiny metallic surface by using a fine powder to mark out where the marks are, and then using some sticky paper to lift the print from the object.
translation: Parlak metalik yüzeylerde, ince bir toz kullanarak izlerin yerini isaretleyip, yapiskan kagitla nesneden izleri alabilecegini söylemisti.

english: I bet if you could find a way to get everyone's 'finger prints' you could solve the crime pretty easily!
translation: Herkesin “parmak izlerini” almanin bir yolunu bulursan, suçu kolayca çözebilirsin!

english: My father used to be in the guard. He always wrote himself notes on a piece of paper so he could keep track of information easily.
translation: Babam eskiden muhafizdi. Bilgileri kolayca takip edebilmek için her zaman bir kagida notlar alirdi.

english: Well, this might be of some help to you. My father was in the guards when he was younger,
translation: Bu sana yardimci olabilir. Babam gençken muhafizdi.

english: Well, I don't know if it's related, but I heard from that Poison Salesman in town that he sold some poison to one of the Sinclair family
translation: Bunun bir ilgisi var mi bilmiyorum ama kasabadaki Zehir Saticisi'ndan, Sinclair ailesinden birine zehir sattigini duydum.

english: Oh, I remember you. You're the one that discovered Lord Sinclair's murderer. Well, I can tell you, strange things are afoot once again.
translation: Seni hatirliyorum. Lord Sinclair'in katilini bulan sensin. Sana sunu söyleyebilirim, yine garip seyler oluyor.

english: Really? What's happened?
Sorry, but I'd rather not say any more.
translation: Üzgünüm, ama daha fazlasini söylemek istemiyorum.

english: You do not meet all of the requirements to start the King's Ransom quest.
translation: Kralin Fidye görevini baslatmak için gerekli tüm sartlari saglamiyorsun.

english: What can you tell me about the Sinclairs?
Tell me about Lord Sinclair.
Why do the Sinclairs live so far from town?
translation: Sinclair ailesi neden kasabadan bu kadar uzakta yasiyor?

english: I am so confused about who did it.
What can I do for you?
I don't know. What can you do for me?
A good question indeed! I'm selling special clothing for Agility enthusiasts.
translation: Gercekten iyi bir soru! Agility meraklilari icin özel kiyafetler satiyorum.

english: Sometimes, when you're exploring the hidden rooftops of our cities, you'll find one of my Marks.
translation: Bazen, sehirlerimizin gizli catilarini kesfederken, benim Marklarimdan birini bulursun.

english: Once you've got enough Marks, I'll exchange them for my Graceful clothing. So, does that interest you?
translation: Yeterli sayida Mark topladiginda, onlari Graceful giysilerimle takas edecegim. Ilgini cekti mi?

english: Can I see what you're selling?
Can I see how many laps I've completed?
Can I toggle my lap counter?
Sure, I've disabled your lap counter messages, if you want to turn it back on, so you can see your total laps after you finish one, speak to me again.
translation: Tabii, tur sayaci mesajlarini devre disi biraktim. Tekrar acmak istersen, bir turu tamamladiktan sonra toplam tur sayini görebilirsin. Bana tekrar sor.

english: Sure, I've turned on your lap counter, you'll get a message when you complete a lap on a rooftop course. To help you keep track.
translation: Tabii, tur sayacini actim, cati parkurunda bir tur tamamladiginda bir mesaj alacaksin. Takip etmene yardimci olmasi icin.

english: I'm alright, thanks.
I don't know. What can you do for me?
Can I see what you're selling?
I'm alright, thanks.
Can I see how many laps I've completed?
Can I toggle my lap counter?
Ting-a-ling-a-ling!
Welcome to the Grail castle. You should come inside, it's cold out here.
translation: Grail kalesine hos geldiniz. Iceri girmelisiniz, disarisi soguk.

english: Somehow you are now inside the castle.
Welcome to the Grail castle.
Welcome to the Grand Exchange. Would you like to trade now, or exchange item sets?
translation: Grand Exchange'e hos geldiniz. Simdi ticaret yapmak mi, yoksa esya setlerini degistirmek mi istersiniz?

english: I have this voucher for completing the combat Adventure Path, it says to come talk to you about claiming my Adventure Path reward.
translation: Savas Macera Yolu'nu tamamladigim icin bu kuponum var, Macera Yolu ödülümü almak icin sizinle konusmam gerektigi yaziyor.

english: Why yes, here is your reward.
If you wanted to, you could store the coins in the bank next to me.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
translation: Sizin icin yapabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: How do I use the Grand Exchange?
My colleague and I can let you set up trade offers. You can offer to Sell items or Buy items.
translation: Meslektasim ve ben, ticaret teklifleri olusturmaniza izin verebiliriz. Esya satmak veya satin almak icin teklifte bulunabilirsiniz.

english: When you want to sell something, you give us the items and tell us how much money you want for them.
translation: Bir sey satmak istediginizde, bize esyalari verin ve ne kadar para istediginizi söyleyin.

english: We'll look for someone who wants to buy those items at your price, and we'll perform the trade. You can then collect the cash here, or at any bank.
translation: Biz de o esyalari sizin istediginiz fiyattan satin almak isteyen birini bulur ve ticareti gerceklestiririz. Ardindan parayi buradan veya herhangi bir bankadan alabilirsiniz.

english: When you want to buy something, you tell us what you want, and give us the cash you're willing to spend on it.
translation: Bir sey satin almak istediginizde, bize ne istediginizi söyler ve bunun icin harcamak istediginiz parayi bize verirsiniz.

english: We'll look for someone who's selling those items at your price, and we'll perform the trade. You can then collect the items here, or at any bank, along with any left-over cash.
translation: Biz de o esyalari sizin istediginiz fiyattan satan birini bulur ve ticareti gerceklestiririz.

english: Sometimes it takes a while to find a matching trade offer. If you change your mind, we'll let you cancel your trade offer, and we'll return your unused items and cash.
translation: Bazen uygun bir takas teklifi bulmak biraz zaman alabilir. Fikrinizi degistirirseniz, takas teklifinizi iptal etmenize izin veririz ve kullanilmamis esyalarinizi ve paranizi iade ederiz.

english: That's all the essential information you need to get started. Would you like to trade now, or exchange item sets?
translation: Baslamak icin ihtiyaciniz olan tüm önemli bilgiler bunlar. Simdi takas yapmak mi, yoksa esya setlerini degistirmek mi istersiniz?

english: I'd like to set up trade offers please.
Can you help me with item sets?
translation: Esya setleri konusunda bana yardimci olabilir misiniz?

english: I'd like Exchange collection reminders on login, please.
translation: Giris yaptigimda koleksiyon hatirlaticilari almak istiyorum lütfen.

english: Okay, when you log in, we'll send you a message about any items that are waiting for you to collect them.
translation: Tamam, giris yaptiginizda, toplamanizi bekleyen ögeler hakkinda size bir mesaj gönderecegiz.

english: Thank you.
I don't want Exchange collection reminders on login.
translation: Giris yaparken degisim koleksiyonu hatirlaticilari istemiyorum.

english: Okay, when you log in, you will no longer be reminded about items waiting to be collected, unless the items only arrived after you logged out.
translation: Tamam, giris yaptiginizda, ögeler giris yaptiginizda gelmedikce, toplanmayi bekleyen ögeler hakkinda artik hatirlatma almayacaksiniz.

english: I'm fine, thanks.
How do I use the Grand Exchange?
I'd like to set up trade offers please.
Can you help me with item sets?
I'd like Exchange collection reminders on login, please.
translation: Giris yaparken Exchange toplama hatirlaticilari istiyorum.

english: I don't want Exchange collection reminders on login.
translation: Giris yaparken Exchange toplama hatirlaticilari istemiyorum.

english: I'm fine, thanks.
Thank you.
Hello young [man/lady]!  Come to visit old Grandpa Jack? I can tell ye stories for sure. I used to be the best fisherman these parts have seen!
translation: Merhaba genc ! Yasli Jack'i ziyarete mi geldin? Sana hikayeler anlatabilirim. Eskiden bu bölgenin en iyi balikcisiydim!

english: Tell me a story then.
translation: O zaman bir hikaye anlat bana.

english: Well, when I were a young man we used to take fishing trips over to Catherby; The fishing over there - now that was something!
translation: Sey, gencken Catherby'ye balik tutmaya giderdik; Oradaki balikcilik - iste o baska bir seydi!

english: Anyway, we decided to do a bit of fishing with our nets, I wasn't having the best of days turning up nothing but old boots and bits of seaweed. Then my net suddenly got really heavy!
translation: Neyse, aglarimizla biraz balik tutmaya karar verdik, eski botlar ve deniz yosunu parcalari disinda hicbir sey bulamadigim icin pek iyi bir gün gecirmiyordum. Sonra agim birdenbire cok agirlasti!

english: I pulled it up...
To my amazement I'd caught this little chest thing!
Even more amazing was when I opened it it contained a diamond the size of a radish! That's the best catch I've ever had!
translation: Daha da sasirtici olani, sandigi actigimda icinde turp büyüklügünde bir elmas vardi! Bu, simdiye kadar yakaladigim en iyi avdi!

english: Sorry, I don't have time now.
Sigh...
Young people - always in such a rush.
Can I buy one of your fishing rods?
Of course you can young man. Let's see now...I think 5 gold is a fair price for a rod which has won the Fishing contest before eh?
translation: Tabii ki alabilirsin genc adam. Bir bakalim... Bence daha önce balikcilik yarismasini kazanmis bir oltaya 5 altin makul bir fiyat, degil mi?

english: I don't have enough money for that, I'll go get some and come back.
translation: O kadar param yok, gidip para bulup geri gelecegim.

english: Right you are. I'll be here.
Very fair, I'll buy that rod!
Excellent choice!
Only problem is, I don't have any space to carry one right now. Let me get back to you on that.
translation: Tek sorun, su anda onu tasiyacak yerim yok. Bu konuda sana geri dönecegim.

english: Thanks!
You're welcome young 'un.
That's too rich for me, I'll go to Catherby.
translation: Bu benim icin cok pahali, Catherby'ye gidecegim.

english: If you're sure.... passing up an opportunity of a lifetime you are.
translation: Eger emin isen... Hayatinin firsatini kaciriyorsun.

english: I've forgotten how to fish, can you remind me?
Of course! Let me see now...You'll need a rod and bait. You can fish with a net too, but not in the competition.
translation: Tabii ki! Bir bakalim... Bir oltaya ve yemlere ihtiyacin olacak. Agla da balik tutabilirsin, ama yarismada olmaz.

english: Ok... I think I can get those at Catherby.

Then simply find yourself a fishing spot, either in the competition near here, or wherever you can - I recommend net fishing in Catherby. Net or Lure the fish in the fishing spot by clicking on it and then be
translation: Sonra kendine bir balik tutma yeri bul, ya buradaki yarismada ya da bulabildigin herhangi bir yerde - Catherby'de agla balik tutmani öneririm. Agla ya da yemle balik tutma yerinde üzerine tiklayarak baliklari cek ve sonra

english: patient...
It's that simple?
Yep! Go get em tiger.
Tell me a story then.
translation: O zaman bana bir hikaye anlat.

english: Sorry, I don't have time now.
Can I buy one of your fishing rods?
Very fair, I'll buy that rod!
That's too rich for me, I'll go to Catherby.
translation: Bu benim icin cok pahali, Catherby'ye gidecegim.

english: I've forgotten how to fish, can you remind me?
Wooo wooo wooooo!
Sorry, I don't speak ghost.
Woo woo?
Nope, still don't understand you.
WOOOOOOOOO!
Never mind.
Mmmm, should I be writing this down?
Woo wooo. Woooooooooooooooooo!
I'll come back later.
Wooooooo woo! Wooooo woo wooooo woowoowoo woo Woo wooo. Wooooo woo woo? Woooooooooooooooooo!
translation: Wooooooo woo! Wooooo woo wooooo woowoowoo woo Woo wooo. Wooooo woo woo? Woooooooooooooooooo!

english: How's it going?
I'm dead.
Maybe you should try looking on the bright side of...
Oh, yeah. Nevermind.
Ok.
Are you the grave digger this entry mentions?
translation: Bu yazida bahsedilen mezar kazici sen misin?

english: It seems likely, but I've no recollection of this conversation.
translation: Öyle görünüyor, ama bu konusmayi hatirlamiyorum.

english: That's odd. Did you forget a lot when you...
translation: Bu garip. Öldügünde cok sey unuttun mu?

english: Died? I guess some memories have faded, but my death still lingers within me.
translation: Sanirim bazi anilar silindi, ama ölümüm hala icimde yasiyor.

english: How did it happen?
I was minding my own business while digging a grave when suddenly there was a loud metallic sound.
translation: Mezar kazarken kendi isime bakiyordum, birdenbire yüksek bir metalik ses duyuldu.

english: And then?
I was dead... I recall seeing a man a few yards from me, speaking out loud, yet nobody else was around...
translation: Ölmüstüm... Birkac metre ötede bir adamin yüksek sesle konustugunu hatirliyorum, ama etrafta baska kimse yoktu...

english: And?
I thought I could hear a woman's voice respond, but it was likely just the wind.
translation: Bir kadinin sesinin cevap verdigini duydum sandim, ama muhtemelen sadece rüzgârdi.

english: That's very peculiar.
I wouldn't think on it too long. I'd just died, my emotions were unbearable.
translation: Ben olsam fazla üzerinde durmazdim. Ölmüstüm, duygularim dayanilmazdi.

english: I'll let you know if I figure anything out. What's your name?
translation: Bir sey bulursam sana haber veririm. Adin ne?

english: Please do. My name? It's um... Sander.
translation: Lütfen haber ver. Adim mi? Sey... Sander.

english: Pleased to meet you Sander, I'll see you around.
Sorry, I don't speak ghost.
Mmmm, should I be writing this down?
I'll come back later.
Hello.
Greetings young one. What knowledge do you seek?
translation: Selamlar genc adam. Ne tür bir bilgi ariyorsun?

english: What do I have to do in this room?

Have you noticed all the bones around the room? These are teleported here from all over Gielinor to help clean up the landscape of countless bones left behind from combat. What better use for these bones than to convert them to nutritious fruit to be eaten by you mortals? You have to use your Bones to Bananas spell to convert the bones and then place them in the holes on the walls to earn Graveyard Pizazz Points. Unluckily for you, your health will constantly decrease from getting hit by these dropping bones so you will probably want to eat some of the bananas yourself to increase your stay here.
translation: Odanin etrafindaki kemikleri fark ettin mi? Bunlar, savastan geriye kalan sayisiz kemigi temizlemek icin Gielinor'un her yerinden buraya isinlanmis. Bu kemikleri, siz ölümlüler tarafindan yenebilecek besleyici meyvelere dönüstürmekten daha iyi bir kullanim olabilir mi? Kemikleri dönüstürmek icin Kemiklerden Muzlara büyüsünü kullanmali ve ardindan onlari duvardaki deliklere yerlestirerek Mezarlik Pizazz Puanlari kazanmalisin. Ne yazik ki, düsen kemiklerin carpmasiyla sagligin sürekli azalacak, bu yüzden burada kalis süreni uzatmak icin muhtemelen muzlardan birazini kendin yemek isteyeceksin.

english: What are the rewards?

You will get experience from casting your bones to bananas spell and you will get Graveyard Pizazz Points when you put the bananas through the wall. Occasionally you will also be credited with a runestone to help you in your future spell casting.
translation: Kemikleri muzlara dönüstürme büyüsünü kullanarak deneyim kazanacak ve muzlari duvara yerlestirdiginizde Mezarlik Pizazz Puanlari alacaksiniz. Bazen, gelecekteki büyülerinize yardimci olacak bir runestone da kazanacaksiniz.

english: Got any tips that may help me?
translation: Bana yardimci olabilecek herhangi bir ipucunuz var mi?

english: Different bones will provide you with different numbers of bananas, so try to find the best type. Collect enough points and you will be able to buy a 'Bones to Peaches' spell from my fellow guardian above the entrance hall. This spell can be used here just like the bones to bananas spell, except this spell will give you even more experience and the peaches will restore more health!
translation: Farkli kemikler size farkli sayida muz saglayacaktir, bu yüzden en iyi türü bulmaya calisin. Yeterli puan topladiginizda, giris salonunun üstündeki gardiyan arkadasimdan “Kemiklerden Seftaliye” büyüsü satin alabilirsiniz. Bu büyü, kemiklerden muza büyü gibi burada da kullanilabilir, ancak bu büyü size daha fazla deneyim kazandiracak ve seftaliler daha fazla saglik geri kazandiracaktir!

english: I see.

Oh, and a word of warning: should you decide to leave this room by a method other than the exit portals, you will be teleported to the entrance and have any items that you picked up in the room removed.
translation: Oh, ve bir uyari: bu odadan cikis portallari disinda baska bir yöntemle cikmaya karar verirseniz, girise isinlanacaksiniz ve odada topladiginiz tüm esyalariniz alinacaktir.

english: Thanks, bye!
Use what you've learned, young one.
What do I have to do in this room?
What are the rewards?
Got any tips that may help me?
translation: Bana yardimci olabilecek herhangi bir ipucunuz var mi?

english: Thanks, bye!
Woooo wooo wooooo woooo
You cannot understand the ghost.
Why are you still protesting? I have commanded Necrovarus to let you and your friends do as you like! There's no need for this anymore!
translation: Neden hala itiraz ediyorsun? Necrovarus'a sana ve arkadaslarina istediginizi yapmanizi emrettim! Artik buna gerek yok!

english: There's always a need for a healthy interest in politics.
translation: Siyasete saglikli bir ilgi her zaman gereklidir.

english: Okay, suit yourself then.
translation: Tamam, istedigin gibi yap o zaman.

english: Hello.
Shush! I'm concentrating.
Oh, sorry.
Cook, cook, cook!
I'm so hungry!
This is gonna taste sooo good
Welcome, [Sir/Madam]. I sell only the finest and freshest vegetables!
translation: Hos geldiniz, . Sadece en kaliteli ve en taze sebzeleri satiyorum!

english: Welcome, Your Royal Highness. I sell only the finest and freshest vegetables!
translation: Hos geldiniz, Majesteleri. Sadece en kaliteli ve en taze sebzeleri satiyorum!

english: Hello [Fremennik name]. You've come to the right place for yer greens!
translation: Merhaba Dokrak. Yesillik icin dogru yere geldin!

english: *sigh* Hi there... Happy Easter... I guess...
Happy? You don't sound too happy about it?
I'm just tired of Easter, really.
Easter just seems to be about rabbits, so whenever a rabbit shows up all anyone can think of is 'Ooh look at the Easter Rabbit!'.
translation: Paskalya sadece tavsanlarla ilgili gibi görünüyor, bu yüzden ne zaman bir tavsan ortaya ciksa herkesin tek düsündügü sey “Ooh, Paskalya Tavsanina bakin!” oluyor.

english: I want to go out and explore Gielinor, but nobody takes me seriously enough to let me travel.
translation: Disari cikip Gielinor'u kesfetmek istiyorum, ama kimse beni ciddiye almiyor ve seyahat etmeme izin vermiyor.

english: Meanwhile, all the other holidays have a bunch of cool stuff associated with them so nobody bats an eyelid when a zombie shambles through town.
translation: Oysa diger tüm bayramlarin bir sürü havali seyi var, bu yüzden zombi kasabada dolassa kimse gözünü bile kirpmiyor.

english: The goblins even got to keep their stupid sled track from Christmas!
translation: Goblinler Noel'den kalma aptal kizak pistlerini bile koruyabiliyorlar!

english: That sledding course is pretty fun, actually.
translation: Aslinda o kizak pisti oldukca eglenceli.

english: *sigh* I'm sure it is, human. I tried to go on it myself but the goblins kept mobbing me about Easter eggs.
translation: *ic cekis* Eminim öyledir, insan. Ben de denemek istedim ama goblinler Paskalya yumurtalariyla ilgili beni rahatsiz edip durdular.

english: I told them they'd have to wait until Easter like everybody else, but they wouldn't have any of it!
translation: Onlara herkes gibi Paskalya'ya kadar beklemeleri gerektigini söyledim ama dinlemediler!

english: I dunno. I just feel like as long as I live, I'm gonna be an advertisement for Easter and nothing more.
translation: Bilmiyorum. Sanki yasadigim sürece Paskalya'nin reklamini yapmakla yetinecegim gibi geliyor.

english: Poor guy. Can't be nice having life's doors slammed in your face all the time.
translation: Zavalli adam. Hayatin kapilarinin sürekli yüzüne carpilmasi hos bir sey olamaz.

english: *sigh* Yeah...
... Wait a second...
Doors... Easter.... Doors... East... Doors... Eastdo-
translation: Kapilar... Paskalya... Kapilar... Dogu... Kapilar... Dogu kapi...

english: Human! I've got it! Eastdoor!
... What?
Humans only care about rabbits for Easter decorations, right? Well, what if we give these people something else to celebrate with?
translation: Insanlar Paskalya süsleri icin tavsanlari önemsiyorlar, degil mi? Peki, bu insanlara kutlamak icin baska bir sey versek nasil olur?

english: Then you can have your Easter and I can be a rabbit!
translation: O zaman sen Paskalya'ni kutlayabilirsin, ben de tavsan olabilirim!

english: And you plan to do this with... doors?
translation: Ve bunu kapilarla mi yapmayi planliyorsun?

english: Eastdoors!
Joke names aside, are you sure this will work?
translation: Saka isimleri bir yana, bunun ise yarayacagindan emin misin?

english: Well... no, not really.
But hey, anything that takes the spotlight off us rabbits can't hurt! Plus, it could be fun!
translation: Ama hey, tavsanlarin dikkatini baska yöne ceken her sey zarar vermez! Ayrica, eglenceli olabilir!

english: What do you say, human? Do you want to help?
translation: Ne dersin, insan? Yardim etmek ister misin?...

english: ... Oh. Well, I'll be here if you change your mind, I guess.
translation: Oh. Peki, fikrini degistirirsen ben buradayim, sanirim.

english: Have you changed your mind, human?
Eggcellent! This is going to be the best Easter ever! Now, where to start...
translation: Harika! Bu, simdiye kadarki en iyi Paskalya olacak! Simdi, nereden baslayalim...

english: Hmm... all these brown doors aren't particularly Eastery... We should probably start by painting them.
translation: Hmm... tüm bu kahverengi kapilar pek Paskalya'ya uygun degil... Muhtemelen onlari boyayarak baslamaliyiz.

english: I think I have all of my supplies on me... brushes... pallette... safety goggles...
translation: Sanirim tüm malzemelerim yanimda... fircalar... palet... güvenlik gözlükleri...

english: Oh, ghosh darn, I'm fresh out of paint!
I think there's a witch nearby who makes dyes. Maybe she has some paint?
translation: Sanirim yakinlarda boya yapan bir cadi var. Belki onda boya vardir?

english: Couldn't hurt to ask, I guess. If I give you some flowers to use as ingredients, can you ask her for some paint?
translation: Sormaktan zarar gelmez, sanirim. Sana malzeme olarak kullanman icin cicekler verirsem, ondan boya isteyebilir misin?

english: I'll speak to Aggie, give me the ingredients.
translation: Aggie ile konusacagim, malzemeleri ver bana.

english: Hmm... Human, I don't think you have enough room in your pockets for more things.
translation: Hmm... Insan, cebinde daha fazla sey icin yer kalmadigini düsünüyorum.

english: There's a Bank just south down the road. You can go there to drop off a few items if you want to make space.
translation: Yolun güneyinde bir banka var. Yer acmak istiyorsan oraya gidip birkac esyayi birakabilirsin.

english: Bank? I've never been so insulted in my entire life!
translation: Banka mi? Hayatimda hic bu kadar asagilanmamistim!

english: Gregg hands you a bunch of pastel-coloured flowers and an IOU for 5 coins.
translation: Gregg sana pastel renkli bir demet cicek ve 5 sikke icin bir borc senedi verir.

english: This is... a piece of paper?
It's an IOU. We rabbits don't usually carry cash on us, I'm afraid.
translation: Bu bir borc senedi. Biz tavsanlar genellikle üzerimizde nakit tasimayiz, korkarim.

english: If you have the ingredients on you, why not go ask her yourself?
translation: Malzemeler sendeyse, neden gidip kendin sormuyorsun?

english: I... Human, I honestly don't think I could stomach going.
translation: Ben... Insan, acikcasi oraya gitmeye cesaretim yok.

english: Witches aren't that scary. I'm sure Aggie is lovely once you get to know her.
translation: Cadilar o kadar da korkutucu degildir. Aggie'yi tanidiginda onun ne kadar sevimli oldugunu göreceksin.

english: It's not that, it's... I just don't want to be ridiculed for being an Easter bunny.
translation: Mesele o degil, ben... Paskalya tavsani oldugum icin alay edilmek istemiyorum.

english: I've put up with being the 'cute widdle wabbit' my whole life. I don't think I can take much more of it.
translation: Hayatim boyunca “sevimli kücük tavsan” olmaya katlandim. Artik daha fazla dayanabilecegimi sanmiyorum.

english: Poor guy.
So, uh... what am I meant to be doing again?
You've forgotten already? Silly human!
You were about to take some ingredients off me to give to the nice dye-making witch in exchange for some paint!
translation: Benden bazi malzemeler alip, boya karsiliginda onlari nazik boya yapan cadiya verecektin!

english: You were about to take the ingredients from me to that nice dye-making witch in the house down that alley behind the wheelbarrow!
translation: Benden malzemeleri alip, el arabasinin arkasindaki sokaktaki evde yasayan nazik boya yapan cadiya götürecektin!

english: We were going to use it to decorate some doors in the spirit of Easter so people associate it less with rabbits!
translation: Paskalya ruhuna uygun olarak bazi kapilari süslemek icin kullanacaktik, böylece insanlar onu tavsanlarla daha az iliskilendireceklerdi!

english: This seems... awfully convoluted.
Yep!
Goodbye.
So long, human! I'll be here if you need anything.
translation: Hosca kal, insan! Bir seye ihtiyacin olursa ben buradayim.

english: I do, but you'd need to make more space in your pockets first.
translation: Ihtiyacim var, ama önce ceplerinde daha fazla yer acman gerekiyor.

english: I can give you more flowers, but you'd need to make more space in your pockets first.
translation: Sana daha fazla cicek verebilirim, ama önce ceplerinde daha fazla yer acman gerekiyor.

english: I can give you another IOU, but you'd need to make more space in your pockets first.
translation: Sana baska bir borc senedi verebilirim, ama önce ceplerinde daha fazla yer acman gerekiyor.

english: Gregg quickly scratches up a new IOU for 5 coins.
translation: Gregg hizlica 5 sikke icin yeni bir borc senedi yazar.

english: Gregg hands you another bunch of pastel-coloured flowers.
translation: Gregg sana pastel renkli bir demet cicek daha verir.

english: Gregg hands you another bunch of pastel-coloured flowers and an IOU for 5 coins.
translation: Gregg sana pastel renkli bir demet cicek ve 5 sikke icin bir borc senedi verir.

english: Try not to lose these ones. If people find my IOUs, I'm gonna have quite the bill to pay!
translation: Bunlari kaybetmemeye calis. Insanlar borc senetlerimi bulursa, ödemem gereken oldukca yüksek bir fatura olacak!

english: Silly human! You have the ingredients on you already!
You need to take them to the witch who makes dyes you mentioned. Aggie, I think her name.
translation: Onlari bahsettigin boyalari yapan cadiya götürmelisin. Aggie, sanirim adi buydu.

english: I just thought you might like more than one load of paint.
translation: Birden fazla boya istersin diye düsündüm.

english: Hmmm... maybe, but let's get one first and see how we get on.
translation: Hmmm... belki, ama önce bir tane alalim ve nasil gittigine bakalim.

english: Silly human, you're meant to give that to the nice witch down the road, not me!
translation: Aptal insan, onu bana degil, yolun asagisindaki nazik cadiya vermelisin!

english: Could I have some coins instead?
translation: Onun yerine biraz para alabilir miyim?

english: Human, if I had coins to give you, I wouldn't have given you an IOU in the first place!
translation: Insan, sana verecek param olsaydi, sana borc senedi vermezdi!

english: Which witch, sorry?
I think she's just down that street there, in the house with the wheelbarrow in front of it.
translation: Sanirim o cadi, su caddede, önünde el arabasi olan evde oturuyor.

english: Gregg, I have something we can use as paint!
translation: Gregg, boya olarak kullanabilecegimiz bir sey buldum!

english: Really? Let me see!
Wait... gah, I could have sworn I had it on me!
Maybe Aggie knows where it is? You should ask her.
translation: Belki Aggie nerede oldugunu biliyordur? Ona sormalisin.

english: You give Gregg the thickened dye.
Oh! Human, this is perfect!
Now we just need a door to paint...
translation: Simdi sadece boyayacagimiz bir kapi lazim...

english: There's one right there. Maybe we can use it?
translation: Surada bir tane var. Belki onu kullanabiliriz?

english: Do you think the owner will mind?
I've worked with Ned in the past; he's a nice guy. I'm sure he won't mind.
translation: Ned ile daha önce calismistim, iyi biridir. Eminim sorun etmez.

english: Aggie mentioned people in Draynor could use some cheer. I'm sure he won't mind.
translation: Aggie, Draynor'daki insanlarin biraz neseye ihtiyaci oldugunu söylemisti. Eminim sorun olmaz.

english: Let me get my brushes and...
The camera fades to black. Sounds of painting are heard. The camera fades back in, and Ned's house door is painted cyan.
translation: Kamera karartilir. Boyama sesleri duyulur. Kamera tekrar acilir ve Ned'in evinin kapisi maviye boyanmistir.

english: The Cook can now be asked about the Easter event.
translation: Artik asciya Paskalya etkinligi hakkinda soru sorulabilir.

english: I don't mean to be a critic, but I had imagined it looking more... inspired.
translation: Elestirici olmak istemem ama daha ilham verici bir sey hayal etmistim.

english: Maybe if I had more colours...
Well, Aggie only mentioned the one colour of dye so we're stuck there.
translation: Aggie sadece bir renk boyadan bahsetti, o yüzden baska secenegimiz yok.

english: Blast! Looks like there's only one thing for it, then.
translation: Hay aksi! O zaman tek bir secenek var gibi görünüyor.

english: What's that?
We'll just have to decorate it ourselves! But first, we need something to decorate it with.
translation: Kendimiz süslememiz gerekecek! Ama önce süslemek icin bir seyler bulmaliyiz.

english: You humans like Easter eggs, don't you? Do you know where we could get some good eggs?
translation: Siz insanlar Paskalya yumurtalarini seversiniz, degil mi? Iyi yumurtalar bulabilecegimiz bir yer biliyor musun?

english: Hmm... I don't, but I think I might know someone who does.
translation: Hmm... Ben bilmiyorum, ama bilen birini taniyorum.

english: There's a Cook in Lumbridge that everyone gives eggs to. He's bound to have some fancy eggs for us.
translation: Lumbridge'de herkesin yumurta verdigi bir asci var. Onda bizim icin güzel yumurtalar mutlaka vardir.

english: Sounds great! I can either teleport us there now, or I can meet you there if you'd prefer.
translation: Harika! Ya bizi simdi oraya isinlayabilirim ya da isterseniz orada bulusabiliriz.

english: Gregg can now be found at the kitchen, and the Cook talks sense again.
translation: Gregg artik mutfakta bulunabilir ve asci yine mantikli konusuyor.

english: Ok! Hold on to your hat!
But I'm not wearing a...
The player is seen casting an uninterruptable self-teleport (not tele-other by the rabbit) behind the Lumbridge castle (location in proximity of 3201, 3214, 0).
translation: Oyuncu, Lumbridge kalesinin arkasinda (3201, 3214, 0 civarinda) kesilemez bir kendi kendine isinlanma büyüsü yapiyor (tavsan tarafindan baska birine isinlanma degil)....

english: ... hat!
The player is seen casting an uninterruptable self-teleport (not tele-other by the rabbit) behind the Lumbridge castle (location in proximity of 3201, 3215, 0).
translation: Oyuncu, Lumbridge kalesinin arkasinda (3201, 3215, 0 civarinda) kesilemez bir kendini isinlama büyüsü yapiyor (tavsan tarafindan yapilan isinlama degil).

english: Ok! I'm gonna hang around here for a little bit, so come talk to me if you change your mind. Otherwise, I'll see you there!
translation: Tamam! Ben biraz burada takilacagim, fikrini degistirirsen gel konus benimle. Aksi takdirde, orada görüsürüz!

english: Have you changed your mind about teleporting to Lumbridge with me?
translation: Benimle Lumbridge'e teleport olmak konusunda fikrini degistirdin mi?

english: Wait, you're a rabbit. How can you even teleport?
translation: Bekle, sen tavsansin. Nasil teleport olabilirsin ki?

english: Well, you're a human. How can you teleport?
I just use magic.
And rabbits can't use magic?
I didn't know rabbits could use magic!
Of course we can! How else do you think we make Easter happen each year?
translation: Tabii ki kullanabiliriz! Her yil Paskalya'yi baska nasil kutlayabiliriz ki?

english: You make a good point...
We were about to go to Lumbridge to speak to a Cook there who has a lot of eggs!
translation: Lumbridge'e gidip orada cok fazla yumurtasi olan bir asci ile konusacaktik!

english: We were going to use them to decorate some doors in the spirit of Easter so people associate it less with rabbits!
translation: Paskalya ruhuna uygun olarak bazi kapilari süslemek icin onlari kullanacaktik, böylece insanlar Paskalya'yi tavsanlarla daha az iliskilendireceklerdi!

english: So long, human! I'll be here a little while longer if you want a teleport. Otherwise I'll see you in Lumbridge!
translation: Hosca kal insan! Eger teleport olmak istersen biraz daha burada kalacagim. Aksi takdirde Lumbridge'de görüsürüz!

english: Hello human!
Wait, aren't I supposed to be meeting you somewhere else?
translation: Bekle, seninle baska bir yerde bulusmam gerekmiyor muydu?

english: Yep! But I'm taking a bit of a break, and it would appear you are too, human!
translation: Evet! Ama biraz mola verdim ve görünüse göre sen de öyle, insan!

english: Can you remind me where I'm meant to be meeting you?
translation: Seninle nerede bulusmam gerektigini hatirlatir misin?

english: I think we were going to the Lumbridge Kitchens to talk to a cook about some eggs.
translation: Sanirim Lumbridge Mutfaklari'na gidip bir asci ile yumurtalar hakkinda konusacaktik.

english: Oh, what a cute bunny! I didn't realize it was Easter already!
translation: Oh, ne sevimli bir tavsan! Paskalya'nin geldigini fark etmemisim!

english: Cute?! I'll give you cute! I'll...
translation: Sevimli mi?! Sana sevimliyi gösteririm! Ben...

english: *AHEM*
Sorry.
Cook, we're looking for some fancy eggs that we can use as decorations. You wouldn't happen to have anything, would you?
translation: Asci, dekorasyon olarak kullanabilecegimiz süslü yumurtalar ariyoruz. Sende böyle bir sey var mi acaba?

english: Hmm... Well, I do have a large collection of eggs, but most of them are regular old chicken eggs for making cakes.
translation: Hmm... Aslinda büyük bir yumurta koleksiyonum var, ama cogu kek yapmak icin kullanilan siradan tavuk yumurtalari.

english: Though come to think of it, I might have something...
translation: Ama simdi düsündüm de, bir seyim olabilir...

english: Go on...
I have a... 'special' collection of eggs that I keep in the... well... back of my cupboards for very... 'special' occasions.
translation: Benim... cok “özel” durumlar icin dolabimin arkasinda sakladigim “özel” bir yumurta koleksiyonum var.

english: I don't know if this occasion is special enough, though.
translation: Ama bu durumun yeterince özel olup olmadigini bilmiyorum.

english: Hey! I'll have you know Easter is a very special occasion!
translation: Hey! Paskalya'nin cok özel bir gün oldugunu bilmen gerekir!

english: Well, that's me convinced! Let me dig them out for you!
translation: Tamam, ikna oldum! Onlari senin icin cikarayim!

english: The Cook digs around the back of his cupboards and produces several colourful eggs, giving them to Gregg.
translation: Asci dolaplarinin arkasinda bir seyler arar ve birkac renkli yumurta cikararak Gregg'e verir.

english: Ooh! These are perfect! Thanks a lot!
Don't mention it!
Seriously, don't mention it.
Well, we have some eggs now. What's next?
translation: Artik yumurtalarimiz var. Sirada ne var?

english: Hmm... I think some nice fluffy wool could look quite nice...
translation: Hmm... Sanirim güzel, kabarik yünler hos görünebilir...

english: There's a sheep pen not too far north of here. You could get some fresh wool if you wanted.
translation: Buranin kuzeyinde cok uzak olmayan bir yerde bir koyun agili var. Istersen taze yün alabilirsin.

english: That sounds perfect! I'll meet you there, human!
translation: Kulaga harika geliyor! Orada görüsürüz insan!

english: Gregg can now be found in the sheep pen north of Lumbridge.
translation: Gregg artik Lumbridge'in kuzeyindeki koyun agilinda bulunabilir.

english: Yes, go to the sheep pen and out of my kitchen...
translation: Evet, koyun agilina git ve mutfagimdan cik...

english: Oh, you're still here.
Yep! Just passing the time, you know!
Didn't you say you were off to the sheep pen north of here?
translation: Buradan kuzeye, koyun agilina gidecegini söylememis miydin?

english: We're not in a hurry. The sheep are in a pen, so it's not like they can go anywhere.
translation: Acelemiz yok. Koyunlar agilda, yani bir yere gidecekleri yok.

english: Actually, while you're still here, there's something else you can do.
translation: Aslinda, sen hala buradayken yapabilecegin baska bir sey var.

english: It's the Duke's birthday soon, and I'm running low on ingredients.
translation: Dük'ün dogum günü yaklasiyor ve malzemelerim azaliyor.

english: I think we were going to the sheep pen north of Lumbridge to get some wool.
translation: Sanirim Lumbridge'in kuzeyindeki koyun agilina yün almaya gidiyorduk.

english: Human, what is that?
Gregg can no longer be found at the kitchen.
That's a sheep.
I know what a sheep is, human!
But what is that thing doing in the middle of all of them?
translation: Ama o sey onlarin arasinda ne ariyor?

english: Hm?
That's clearly just two penguins in a sheep costume!
translation: Onlar acikca koyun kostümü giymis iki penguen!

english: Hmm... I'm not entirely sure why that's there.
translation: Hmm... Neden orada olduklarini tam olarak bilmiyorum.

english: Do you think the farmer knows about it?
I'd hope so, maybe I'll ask him about it later.
translation: Umarim öyledir, belki sonra ona sorarim.

english: Oh, that's The Thing.
We've tried explaining this to Fred the Farmer, but he thinks it's some kind of chicken-eating shapeshifting demon.
translation: Bunu ciftci Fred'e aciklamaya calistik, ama o bunun tavuk yiyen, sekil degistiren bir iblis oldugunu düsünüyor.

english: The man won't shear his own sheep!
Really? Who shears them for him?
translation: Gercekten mi? Onlari kim kirkiyor peki?

english: Whichever advernturerswalk by that he can talk into doing it.
translation: Yoluna cikan ve bunu yapmaya ikna edebildigi maceracilar.

english: That would include you, I guess?
... Yes.
Those agents are still there...?
You know them?
They're KGP agents sent from the Iceberg to collect information on Farmer Fred and his sheep.
translation: Onlar, Ciftci Fred ve koyunlari hakkinda bilgi toplamak icin Iceberg'den gönderilen KGP ajanlari.

english: Why would penguins need to spy on sheep?
translation: Penguenler neden koyunlari gözetlemek zorunda olsun ki?

english: They thought the sheep were also secret agents placed to stop them taking over Gielinor.
translation: Koyunlarin da Gielinor'u ele gecirmelerini engellemek icin yerlestirilmis gizli ajanlar oldugunu düsünüyorlar.

english: Penguins are trying to take over Gielinor?
translation: Penguenler Gielinor'u ele gecirmeye mi calisiyor?

english: Yeah, they have war machines built up and everything.
translation: Evet, savas makineleri falan da yapmislar....

english: ... Human, are you feeling alright?
Never felt better, actually.
translation: Aslinda hic bu kadar iyi hissetmemistim.

english: Well, anyway, we need to get some wool. I think three pieces would be enough.
translation: Neyse, biraz yün almamiz lazim. Sanirim üc parca yeterli olur.

english: I tried to get it myself but these shears aren't really designed with rabbits in mind.
translation: Kendim almaya calistim ama bu makaslar tavsanlari düsünerek tasarlanmamis.

english: I could shear the sheep for you if you'd like?
Oh, thank you so much human!
I'd give you these shears but you appear to be a little overloaded.
translation: Bu makasi sana verirdim ama biraz fazla yükün var gibi görünüyor.

english: If you don't mind running back to Lumbridge Castle, there should be a Bank on the top floor for you to put your stuff away!
translation: Lumbridge Kalesi'ne geri dönersen, en üst katta esyalarini koyabilecegin bir banka olmali!

english: I've gotten this far without those good-for-nothing bankers, thank you very much!
translation: O ise yaramaz bankacilar olmadan buraya kadar geldim, cok tesekkürler!

english: Gregg hands you a pair of shears.
I see you brought your own shears. Wonderful!
You know how to shear sheep, right human? You just walk up to them and give them a good snip!
translation: Koyun kirkmayi biliyorsun, degil mi insan? Yanlarina gidip iyice kirkarsin!

english: Just be careful - I'm fairly sure there's a ram in here and he might not appreciate it so much.
translation: Sadece dikkatli ol, burada bir koc var ve bunu pek hos karsilamayabilir.

english: Oh, you'll also want to make yourself some inventory space to keep the wool in. I think there's a Bank at the top of Lumbridge Castle.
translation: Oh, yünü saklamak icin kendine biraz envanter alani da ayirmalisin. Sanirim Lumbridge Kalesi'nin tepesinde bir banka var.

english: I'm very aware of the state of my inventory, thank you.
translation: Envanterimin durumunun cok iyi farkindayim, tesekkürler.

english: Could I have some shears, please?
translation: Bana bir makas verir misin lütfen?

english: Gregg hands you another pair of shears.
translation: Gregg sana bir cift makas daha uzatir.

english: It's a good thing I grabbed a bunch of these before I headed out!
translation: Cikmadan önce bunlardan bir sürü almis olmam iyi oldu!

english: How are you doing?
Pretty good, human. How are you?
Not too bad, actually.
This isn't the best conversation ever, I have to say.
translation: Bu pek de iyi bir sohbet degil, söylemeliyim.

english: I'm gonna go back to sheep shearing.
I think that's wise, human.
Your hint is; you had some shears, and we're stood inside a sheep pen.
translation: Ipucun su: elinde makas var ve koyun agili icinde duruyoruz.

english: So... I should be shearing some sheep?
Yep! Bring me the wool after you're done! We need [3/2/1] more piece[s]!
translation: Evet! Isin bittiginde yünü bana getir! [3/2/1] parca daha lazim!

english: Your hint is; you have some shears, and we're stood inside a sheep pen.
translation: Ipucun su: elinde makas var ve koyun agili icinde duruyoruz.

english: Speak to you soon, human!
Human, I don't think that wool is fresh.
translation: Insan, bu yünün taze oldugunu sanmiyorum.

english: Does it matter?
Of course it matters! Everybody knows fresh wool is softer and shinier!
translation: Tabii ki önemli! Herkes taze yünün daha yumusak ve parlak oldugunu bilir!

english: I didn't know that!
Well, now you do! So now you can go and get some fresh wool!
translation: Artik biliyorsun! Simdi gidip taze yün alabilirsin!

english: You hand Gregg [1/2/3] piece[s] of wool.
Thanks, human! But we still need [2/1] more wool!
translation: Tesekkürler, insan! Ama hala [2/1] daha yün lazim!

english: That's all the wool we need! Thanks a lot, human! You're a big help.
translation: Ihtiyacimiz olan tüm yün bu kadar! Cok tesekkürler, insan! Cok yardimci oldun.

english: And you're a small rabbit.
If you think I'm small, you should see the rabbits in Tirannwn. They're so small most people don't even look at them.
translation: Beni kücük buluyorsan, Tirannwn'daki tavsanlari görmelisin. O kadar kücükler ki cogu insan onlara bakmaz bile.

english: Where...?
Anyway, we've got all the wool, so we should probably move on. What else do we need?
translation: Neyse, tüm yünü aldik, artik devam etmeliyiz. Baska neye ihtiyacimiz var?

english: Hmm... some ribbons might look nice.
Ribbons would be perfect, human! Do you know where we could get some?
translation: Kurdeleler mükemmel olur, insan! Nereden bulabiliriz biliyor musun?

english: Uh... not really. The only place I can think of that does any kind of fabrics is Thessalia's Fine Clothes in Varrock.
translation: Uh... pek bilmiyorum. Aklima gelen tek kumasci Varrock'taki Thessalia's Fine Clothes.

english: Thanks, human, but I don't think we need any more wool.
translation: Tesekkürler insan, ama sanirim daha fazla yüne ihtiyacimiz yok.

english: Well, that's better than nothing! We'll go to Thessalia's!
Wait, aren't there scary dark mages at the front of Varrock? I should probably teleport in... Would you like me to take you along, human?
translation: Bekle, Varrock'un önünde korkunc kara büyücüler yok mu? Muhtemelen teleportla gitmeliyim... Seni de götürmemi ister misin insan?

english: Ok! Hold on to your boots!
But I'm not wearing any...

The player is seen casting an uninterruptable self-teleport (not tele-other by the rabbit) between the Varrock general store and Thessalia's Fine Clothes store (location in proximity of 3212, 3416, 0).
translation: Oyuncu, Varrock genel magazasi ile Thessalia'nin Kaliteli Giysiler magazasi (3212, 3416, 0 civarinda) arasinda kesintiye ugramayan bir kendi kendine isinlanma (tavsan tarafindan isinlanma degil) yaparken görülür....

english: ... boots!
Gregg can no longer be found in the sheep pen north of Lumbridge.
translation: Gregg artik Lumbridge'in kuzeyindeki koyun agilinda bulunamiyor.

english: Ok, human! I'll wait here for a little bit just in case you change your mind, or you can meet me there!
translation: Tamam, insan! Fikrini degistirirsen diye biraz burada bekleyecegim, ya da orada bulusabiliriz!

english: Are you ready to go to Varrock, human?
What do you know about the dark wizards?
Most of what I know is second hand knowledge, but none of it is good!
translation: Bildiklerimin cogu ikinci el bilgiler, ama hicbiri iyi degil!

english: Last year one of my mates walked by too close and they nearly had him for rabbit stew!
translation: Gecen yil arkadaslarimdan biri cok yakindan gecti ve onu neredeyse tavsan yahnisi yapacaktilar!

english: From what I've heard, they're trying to summon a demon to attack Varrock!
translation: Duyduguma göre, Varrock'a saldirmak icin bir iblis cagirmaya calisiyorlar!

english: A demon? Outside of Varrock? Surely the King should do something about that?
translation: Bir iblis mi? Varrock'in disinda mi? Kral bu konuda bir seyler yapmali, degil mi?

english: You'd think so, but apparently he hasn't done a thing about anything going on outside his walls for years!
translation: Öyle düsünürsün, ama görünüse göre yillardir surlarinin disinda olan biten hicbir seye karismiyor!

english: So what are we going to do about it?
Conventientlyignore the problem by teleporting around it!
translation: Teleportla oradan uzaklasip sorunu görmezden gelelim!

english: That does sound like a good plan, to be fair.
translation: Dürüst olmak gerekirse, bu iyi bir plan gibi görünüyor.

english: They're still there? I thought they would have cleared off after I killed their demon...
translation: Hala orada mi? Iblisini öldürdükten sonra oradan ayrilacaklarini saniyordum...

english: Wait, they actually summoned a demon?! And you killed it?!
translation: Bekle, gercekten bir iblis cagirdilar mi?! Ve sen onu öldürdün mü?!

english: Yeah, I managed to banish him again with some help from the gypsy in town.
translation: Evet, kasabadaki cingene yardimiyla onu tekrar kovmayi basardim.

english: Wow! Human, that's incredible!
I bet everyone knows you as one of the greatest heroes of all time!
translation: Eminim herkes seni tüm zamanlarin en büyük kahramanlarindan biri olarak taniyordur!

english: Eh, most shopkeepers don't seem to care that you managed to save the world.
translation: Eh, cogu dükkan sahibi dünyayi kurtardigini umursamiyor gibi görünüyor.

english: We were about to go to Thlessia's... Thasselio's... Thlessaloa's...
Thessalia's Fine Clothes?
Yes! Thessalia's shop in Varrock! We were going to get some nice ribbons for decorations!
translation: Evet! Varrock'taki Thessalia'nin dükkani! Dekorasyon icin güzel kurdeleler alacaktik!

english: Are you sure this is a good idea?
translation: Bunun iyi bir fikir olduguna emin misin?

english: Why wouldn't it be?
Isn't she just going to make some Easter reference that you'll get upset about?
translation: Paskalya ile ilgili bir sey söyleyip seni üzecek degil mi?...

english: ... Thanks for putting that thought into my head, human.
translation: Bu düsünceyi kafama soktugun icin tesekkürler, insan.

english: Hey, cheer up! At least you're making other people feel happy.
translation: Hey, neselen! En azindan diger insanlari mutlu ediyorsun.

english: What do you mean?
You're an Easter bunny, so obviously you remind people of Easter, which is a great time for a lot of people.
translation: Sen bir Paskalya tavsanimsin, bu yüzden insanlara Paskalya'yi hatirlatiyorsun, ki bu bircok insan icin harika bir zaman.

english: Even if you don't like it, you being around makes people think of festive times and is a surefire way to get smiles on faces.
translation: Hosuna gitmese bile, senin varligin insanlara bayram zamanlarini hatirlatiyor ve yüzlerine gülümseme getirmenin garantili bir yolu....

english: ... Huh, I never thought of it like that.
Thanks a lot, human! I'm still not gonna like it, but I can at least put up with being a cute Easter bunny for the rest of the year!
translation: Cok tesekkürler, insan! Hala hosuma gitmeyecek, ama en azindan yilin geri kalaninda sevimli bir Paskalya tavsani olmaya katlanabilirim!

english: If you change your mind about wanting a teleport I'll be here. Otherwise, I'll see you in Varrock, human!
translation: Teleport istemek konusunda fikrini degistirirsen ben buradayim. Aksi takdirde, Varrock'ta görüsürüz, insan!

english: I think we were going to the clothes shop in the middle of Varrock to get some ribbons.
translation: Sanirim Varrock'un ortasindaki giyim magazasina gidip kurdeleler alacaktik.

english: Oh my, aren't you just the cutest little thing!
translation: Aman Tanrim, ne kadar da sirin bir seysin!

english: *grumble grumble grumble*
He doesn't seem too happy. What's wrong?
Oh, uh... I'm sure it's nothing.
translation: Oh, uh... Eminim önemli bir sey degildir.

english: Anyway, we were hoping you could help us with something.
translation: Her neyse, bizden bir konuda yardim isteyebilir miyiz diye umuyorduk.

english: Certainly, what can I do for you?
We were hoping you might have some ribbons that we could use as decorations.
translation: Dekorasyon olarak kullanabilecegimiz kurdeleleriniz var mi diye umuyorduk.

english: Oh yes. It's Easter soon, isn't it?
translation: Oh evet. Yakinda Paskalya, degil mi?

english: We don't have any ribbons as such, but we do have some offcuts you could make some out of.
translation: Öyle kurdelelerimiz yok ama bunlardan yapabileceginiz bazi kumas parcalari var.

english: Excellent! I'm glad I brought my scissors along!
Didn't you just have trouble using shears?
translation: Daha önce makas kullanirken sorun yasamamis miydin?

english: Yep, but these are rabbit scissors!
Sounds like you have a plan, then. I'll get these offcuts together for you...
translation: Demek bir planin var. Bu kumas parcalarini senin icin toplayayim...

english: Thessalia starts gathering up several offcuts of fabric.
translation: Thessalia birkac kumas artigini toplamaya baslar.

english: Wait a second... what's that?!
Gregg's attention is grabbed by an extremely silly hat.
translation: Gregg'in dikkatini son derece sacma bir sapka ceker.

english: Oh yes... that hat.
*sigh* An intern made it a few months ago. We've been trying to sell it ever since, but nobody seems to want it on account of its... stupidity.
translation: *ic cekis* Bir stajyer birkac ay önce yapti. O zamandan beri satmaya calisiyoruz, ama kimse onu istemiyor cünkü... cok sacma.

english: It's so shoddily made, it doesn't even spin properly!
translation: O kadar kalitesiz yapilmis ki, düzgün dönmüyor bile!

english: I love it! Can I have it!
Wait... you actually want that thing?
Yeah! Look how colourful it is! It's great!
translation: Evet! Ne kadar renkli olduguna bak! Harika!

english: Well, you're more than welcome to take it. It's not like we can sell it anyway.
Yay! Just let me get this...
... over the ears and...
... hmph. Can't seem to get it on.
Well, it was designed for humans, not rabbits.
translation: Insanlar icin tasarlanmis, tavsanlar icin degil.

english: Ah well, I'll figure it out later.
Gregg puts the hat away.
Anyway, here are the offcuts.
Thessalia hands Gregg a box full of offcuts and spare fabric.
translation: Thessalia, Gregg'e artiklari ve yedek kumaslarla dolu bir kutu uzatir.

english: This is perfect! Thanks a lot, miss!
No problem, I'm glad I could be of help.
So what do we do now?
Hmm... I think we have all the decorations we need, but I had an idea.
translation: Hmm... Sanirim ihtiyacimiz olan tüm süslemeler var, ama aklima bir fikir geldi.

english: It's going to be really annoying trying to put all these decorations on a door while it's still in a frame.
translation: Bu süslemeleri kapi hala cerceve icindeyken takmak cok zor olacak.

english: So I was thinking - why not make a new door, decorate it, and simply swap the doors out!
translation: Ben de düsündüm ki, neden yeni bir kapi yapip süslemiyor ve kapilari degistirmiyoruz?

english: That doesn't sound too ridiculous, actually. What do we need?
translation: Aslinda bu cok da sacma bir fikir degil. Neye ihtiyacimiz var?

english: I think if we had some planks, I have all the nails and fixings to make the thing...
translation: Sanirim birkac tahta bulursak, civi ve sabitleme malzemeleri bende var...

english: If you want planks, your best bestis heading to the lumberyard and talking to the sawmill operator.
translation: Tahta istiyorsaniz, en iyisi kereste deposuna gidip testere operatörüyle konusmak.

english: Sounds like a plan, human! The lumberyard is to the north-east of here, I'll see you out in front of it!
translation: Iyi fikir, insan! Kereste deposu buradan kuzeydoguda, önünde görüsürüz!

english: Can I help you with anything else?
translation: Baska bir seye ihtiyaciniz var mi?

english: No thanks. We'll be on our way to the lumberyard in a bit.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler. Birazdan kereste deposuna gidecegiz.

english: Thanks again for the hat!
I'm just glad someone actually likes it.
How could you not like it? It's so colorful!
I think that's part of the problem.
I think we were going to the lumberyard to the north-east of Varrock to get some planks.
translation: Sanirim Varrock'un kuzeydogusundaki kereste deposuna tahtalar almaya gidiyorduk.

english: Hey, I got you this...
The sudden thought of XP waste prevents you from handing over the plank to Gregg.
translation: Aniden XP israfi düsüncesi, tahtayi Gregg'e vermeni engelliyor.

english: Are you alright, human? You appear to be in intense physical pain.
translation: Iyi misin, insan? Cok siddetli bir fiziksel aci cekiyor gibi görünüyorsun....

english: Well, here we are. Now all we need to do is get some planks.
translation: Iste geldik. Simdi tek yapmamiz gereken birkac tahta almak.

english: Should be easy enough.
Wait... where's the sawmill operator?
Come to think of it, I've never actually seen anyone working in there...
translation: Düsündüm de, orada calisan kimseyi hic görmedim...

english: So how do you get your planks then?
I dunno, probably off the Grand Exchange.
The Grand Exchange! I don't have that kind of money!
translation: Büyük Borsa! O kadar param yok!

english: No, we need a better plan.
translation: Hayir, daha iyi bir plana ihtiyacimiz var.

english: I was just going to run screaming into the Wilderness and hope for the best.
translation: Ben de ciglik atarak Wilderness'ya kosup en iyisini umacaktim.

english: That sounds awfully dangerous, human!
Eh, it beats hanging around the Grand Exchange all day.
translation: Eh, bütün gün Büyük Borsa'da dolasmaktan iyidir.

english: Well, I'm not risking my hide running around the Wilderness! We need a better plan.
translation: Ben Wilderness'da kosarak hayatimi tehlikeye atmayacagim! Daha iyi bir plana ihtiyacimiz var.

english: Huh... I could've sworn there was someone in there at some point.
translation: Huh... Bir ara orada biri olduguna yemin edebilirim.

english: Well, they're not in there now!
There might be a bell, have a look.
Are you kidding me? There's no bell to ring! No, we need a better plan.
translation: Dalga mi geciyorsun? Calacak zil yok ki! Hayir, daha iyi bir plana ihtiyacimiz var.

english: Wait... gosh darn it, I forgot to grab my piggy bank!
Human, would you mind buyi-
Do you know how expensive planks are? If I'm buying planks, they're exclusively for repairing the furniture I plan on breaking!
translation: Tahtalarin ne kadar pahali oldugunu biliyor musun? Tahtalari satin alirsam, sadece kirmayi planladigim mobilyalari tamir etmek icin kullanacagim!

english: ... What?
Well if you find a better way of constructiontraining, let me know.
translation: Daha iyi bir insaat egitimi yöntemi bulursan bana haber ver....

english: ... At any rate, it looks like we need a better plan...
translation: Her neyse, daha iyi bir plana ihtiyacimiz var gibi görünüyor...

english: Oh wait, look! There's a break in the fence there!
translation: Dur, bak! Citin orada bir kirik var!

english: I bet I can just sneak right in and grab a few planks without anyone noticing!
translation: Kimse fark etmeden iceri sizip birkac tahta alabilirim!

english: Are you sure you don't want me to go?
No thank you, Human. You've done enough already. You sit back and relax. I'll be back in a moment!
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler Insan. Zaten yeterince yardim ettin. Sen otur ve rahatla. Hemen dönerim!

english: The camera fades to black. In a cutscene, Gregg is seen hopping inside the fenced lumberyard.
translation: Kamera karartilir. Bir kesit sahnesinde, Gregg citlerle cevrili kereste deposuna atlayarak girer.

english: Ok, let's find some planks...
A sound of a cat purring is heard. A brown adult cat comes from behind a wall two tiles right (east) of Gregg.
translation: Bir kedinin mirildanma sesi duyulur. Kahverengi bir yetiskin kedi, Gregg'in iki karo saginda (dogusunda) bulunan bir duvarin arkasindan cikar.

english: Meow!
Aha! There we go!
A sound of the cat meowing is heard.
Meow.
Oh! A kitty cat!
Sorry, kitty, I don't have any treats.
Would you like pets instead? I can do pets!
translation: Onun yerine oksamak ister misin? Oksamayi severim!

english: Gregg moves closer to pet the cat. The cat makes an audible hiss and scratches towards Gregg.
translation: Gregg kediyi oksamak icin yaklasir. Kedi duyulabilir bir tislama sesi cikarir ve Gregg'e dogru tirmalamaya baslar.

english: Hissss!
Aaaah!
Nice kitty...?
The cat makes an audible hiss and scratches towards Gregg again. Gregg starts fleeing left (west), while the adult cat chases him.
translation: Kedi duyulabilir bir tislama sesi cikarir ve Gregg'e dogru tekrar tirmalamaya baslar. Gregg sola (batiya) kacmaya baslar, yetiskin kedi ise onu kovalar.

english: Not nice kitty! Not nice kitty!
translation: Uslu kedi degil! Uslu kedi degil!

english: The camera pans right and fades to black again. After a fade-out, the camera is set back to the world in front of the lumberyard with the player and Gregg.
translation: Kamera saga kayar ve tekrar karartilir. Karartmanin ardindan kamera, oyuncu ve Gregg'in bulundugu kereste deposunun önündeki dünyaya geri döner.

english: Woah, are you alright?
I'm fine, just... let me catch my breath...
I didn't know... that cats could be... so violent!
translation: Kedilerin bu kadar siddetli olabilecegini bilmiyordum!

english: I didn't even know there were cats in there to begin with!
I guess the lumberyard is a popular spot for cats...
translation: Sanirim kereste deposu kediler icin popüler bir yer......

english: ... Ok, I think I'm gonna be alright. I got the planks out, at the very least.
translation: Tamam, sanirim iyi olacagim. En azindan tahtalari cikardim.

english: So we can make the door now?
Exactly! Now, hold this nail for me...
translation: Aynen! Simdi, bu civiyi tutar misin...

english: Time passes...
The camera fades to black. Sounds of nails being hit with a hammer are heard.
translation: Kamera karartilir. Civilerin cekicle vurulma sesleri duyulur.

english: The camera fades back to view.
... And I think we're done!
Gregg shows off the completed door.
That looks... surprisinggood, actually.
Well if you like it, it's bound to go down well! Let's head back to Draynor and get this put up!
translation: Begendiysen, mutlaka begenilir! Draynor'a geri dönüp bunu takalim!

english: Draynor becomes decorated with Easter eggs on the ground, festive poles, and seven colourful doors.
translation: Draynor, yere serilmis Paskalya yumurtalari, bayram direkleri ve yedi renkli kapi ile süslenir.

english: It's a bit of a trek. I'm going to teleport again. Would you like me to take you along?
translation: Biraz uzun bir yol. Yine isinlanacagim. Seni de götürmemi ister misin?

english: Ok! Hold on to your ammo!
But that doesn't make any...
The player is seen casting an uninterruptable self-teleport (not tele-other by the rabbit) north-east of Ned's house at Draynor (location in proximity of 3105, 3262, 0).
translation: Oyuncu, Draynor'daki Ned'in evinin kuzeydogusunda (3105, 3262, 0 civarinda) kesilemez bir kendi kendine teleport (tavsan tarafindan yapilan tele-other degil) yaparken görülür....

english: ... sense!
Gregg can no longer be found at the lumberyard. Thessalia can now instruct the player to look for Gregg at where the event started.
translation: Gregg artik kereste deposunda bulunamiyor. Thessalia artik oyuncuya etkinligin basladigi yerde Gregg'i aramasini söyleyebilir.

english: The player is seen casting an uninterruptable self-teleport (not tele-other by the rabbit) north-east of Ned's house at Draynor (location in proximity of 3104, 3263, 0).
translation: Oyuncu, Draynor'daki Ned'in evinin kuzeydogusunda (3104, 3263, 0 civarinda) kesilemez bir kendini teleport etme büyüsü (tavsan tarafindan yapilan teleport degil) yaparken görülüyor.

english: Ok human! Let me know if you change your mind. Otherwise, I'll see you there!
translation: Tamam insan! Fikrini degistirirsen bana haber ver. Aksi takdirde, orada görüsürüz!

english: Hey human! Are you ready to go to Draynor?
translation: Hey insan! Draynor'a gitmeye hazir misin?

english: Are you alright after that cat attacked you?
translation: Kedi sana saldirdiktan sonra iyi misin?

english: I'll be fine, I didn't get scratched too badly. Plus at least I have a cool story to tell my friends.
translation: Iyiyim, cok kötü cizilmedim. Ayrica en azindan arkadaslarima anlatacak havali bir hikayem oldu.

english: I'm just sad I didn't get to pet the cute cat...
translation: Sadece sevimli kediyi oksamaya firsat bulamadigim icin üzgünüm...

english: Not so nice being called cute, is it...?
translation: Sevimli denilmek pek hos degil, degil mi...?

english: Hey, everyone knows cats love being petted!
translation: Hey, herkes kedilerin oksanmayi sevdigini bilir!

english: That one just seemed mad about something else... I wonder what.
translation: O kedi baska bir seye kizgin gibiydi... Acaba neye?

english: Hmm... Based on past experienced with cats in the lumberyard, I bet it's hungry, thristy or looking for its kitten.
translation: Hmm... Kereste deposundaki kedilerle olan gecmis deneyimlerime dayanarak, eminim ac, susuz ya da yavrusunu ariyordur.

english: Aww, if I didn't feel mad at it for trying to scratch out my eyes, I'd want to go help it...
translation: Ah, gözlerimi tirmalamaya calistigi icin ona kizgin olmasaydim, ona yardim etmek isterdim...

english: Well, we have the door completed, so now all that's left to do is to put it up in Draynor.
translation: Kapiyi tamamladik, simdi tek yapmamiz gereken onu Draynor'a takmak.

english: How many doors are there in Draynor?
There's... six or seven, I think. Why?
translation: Sanirim... alti ya da yedi tane. Neden?

english: We're not going to need to go through this six or seven times, are we?
translation: Bunu alti ya da yedi kez yapmamiz gerekmeyecek, degil mi?

english: Hah, silly human! No, I thought this through.
translation: Hah, aptal insan! Hayir, bunu düsündüm.

english: I got enough decorations for all of Draynor going around.
translation: Draynor'un her yerine yetecek kadar süslemem var.

english: The plan is, we swap out that first door we painted for this one. Then we decorate that first door, swap it out for another one, decorate, swap, repeat!
translation: Planimiz, boyadigimiz ilk kapiyi bununla degistirmek. Sonra ilk kapiyi süsleyip, baska bir kapiyla degistirmek, süslemek, degistirmek, tekrarlamak!

english: That way I only need to lug one door all the way down to Draynor.
translation: Böylece Draynor'a sadece bir kapi tasimam gerekecek.

english: That's... actually pretty smart.
Yeah, when you do Easter decorations for a few years you get pretty good at logistics.
translation: Evet, birkac yil Paskalya süslemeleri yaptiginda lojistik konusunda oldukca iyi olursun.

english: See you in Draynor, human! Talk to me again if you want a teleport there!
translation: Draynor'da görüsürüz insan! Oraya isinlanmak istersen tekrar konusalim!

english: Draynor Village is decorated with Easter eggs on the ground, festive poles, and seven colourful doors.
translation: Draynor Köyü, yere serpilmis Paskalya yumurtalari, bayram direkleri ve yedi renkli kapi ile süslenmistir.

english: Oh, I see you put the door in already.
Gregg can no longer be found at the lumberyard. (Thessalia's beliefs about Gregg's presence in the lumberyard are not changed.)
translation: Gregg artik kereste deposunda bulunamiyor. (Thessalia'nin Gregg'in kereste deposunda olduguna dair inanci degismedi.)

english: I... Human, I didn't do this..
Wait, someone else decorated this door?
translation: Bekle, bu kapiyi baska biri mi süsledi?

english: The camera fades to black and a cutscene begins.
translation: Kamera karartilir ve bir kesit sahne baslar.

english: I have no idea. I just came back and this door's been fully decorated without us!
translation: Hicbir fikrim yok. Geri döndügümde bu kapi biz olmadan tamamen süslenmisti!

english: The Wise Old Man starts walking from his house to in front of the bank in the background.
translation: Bilge Yasli Adam evinden cikip arka plandaki bankanin önüne dogru yürümeye baslar.
