english: Look around - it looks like the whole has been decorated too!
translation: Etrafina bak - görünüse göre her yer süslenmis!

english: The Wise Old Man starts walking towards the crossroad.
translation: Bilge Yasli Adam kavsaga dogru yürümeye baslar.

english: I wonder who could have decorated an entire village so quickly...?
translation: Bütün köyü bu kadar cabuk kim süsleyebilmis olabilir acaba...?

english: Perhaps I can answer to that question.
translation: Belki bu sorunun cevabini ben verebilirim.

english: Wise Old Man leaves, walks back towards his house. The camera fades to black, and the cutscene ends.
translation: Bilge Yasli Adam ayrilir ve evine dogru yürür. Kamera karartilir ve kesme sahnesi sona erer.

english: The player can now ask Wise Old Man more about the Easter event, while he's at home in his house.
translation: Oyuncu artik Bilge Yasli Adam'a, evindeyken Paskalya etkinligi hakkinda daha fazla soru sorabilir.

english: I feel like he kind of glossed over the part where three people decorated an entire village in 10 minutes...
translation: Üc kisinin 10 dakikada bütün köyü süsledigi kismi biraz gecistirdi sanki...

english: Human, did you hear that...?
The part where we trekked all across Misthalin for nothing?
translation: Misthalin'i bosuna bastan basa dolastigimiz kismi mi?

english: No, not that!
Though I suppose we did do that as well, didn't we...
translation: Gerci onu da yaptik, degil mi... .

english: But no, right at the end!
He called you a... strange rabbit?
Exactly! He didn't call me an Easter bunny or a cute rabbit or anything like that!
translation: Aynen öyle! Bana Paskalya tavsani ya da sevimli tavsan gibi bir sey demedi!

english: He was so focused on Eastdoor he didn't make the connection!
translation: Eastdoor'a o kadar odaklanmisti ki baglantiyi kuramadi!

english: So your plan... worked?
Yep! Though admittedly, not how I thought it would.
translation: Evet! Ama itiraf etmeliyim ki, düsündügüm gibi olmadi.

english: Well, I'm glad I could try and help at least.
translation: En azindan yardim etmeye calistigim icin mutluyum.

english: Thanks for everything, human!
I'd like to give you a reward, but you don't have the space. Could you free up one space in your inventory?
translation: Sana bir ödül vermek isterdim, ama yerin yok. Envanterinde bir yer acabilir misin?

english: I'll tell you what - seeing as we don't need it any more, how would you like to keep this door?
translation: Bak ne diyecegim, artik ihtiyacimiz olmadigina göre, bu kapiyi almak ister misin?

english: I'm... not entirely sure what I'm going to do with it, but thanks.
translation: Onunla ne yapacagimdan tam emin degilim, ama tesekkürler.

english: Any time! Oh, that reminds me - you can have the hat that nice lady gave to me as well!
translation: Ne zaman istersen! Aklima geldi de, o nazik bayanin bana verdigi sapkayi da alabilirsin!

english: Didn't you want it?
Well, yes, but I don't think I can actually wear it.
Gregg gives you the decorated door and his garish hat.
translation: Gregg sana süslü kapiyi ve gösterisli sapkasini verir.

english: Merry Easter, human!
Merry Easter, human! Did you want anything?
translation: Mutlu Paskalyalar, insan! Bir sey ister misin?

english: What will you do now?
Hmmm... I haven't put too much thought into it, actually.
I was meant to be helping the people of Draynor with Easter, but seeing as they helped themselves, I have some time on my hands!
translation: Draynor halkina Paskalya'da yardim etmem gerekiyordu, ama kendileri hallettiklerine göre, biraz bos vaktim var!

english: I might just use it to relax a little bit. It's not often rabbits get time off.
translation: Biraz dinlenmek icin kullanabilirim. Tavsanlar pek sik izin alamazlar.

english: Time off? But I only see you around Easter!
translation: Izin mi? Ama seni sadece Paskalya'da görüyorum!

english: Oh, you don't know the half of it, human...
translation: Oh, sen hicbir sey bilmiyorsun, insan...

english: You know, it just occuredto me I never actually asked what your name is.
translation: Aslinda, simdi fark ettim de, sana hic adini sormadim.

english: My name is Gregg!
Greg?
No, with 3 gs.
Greggg?
Now you're just being silly, human.
Sorry.
I don't actually know your name, either. I've just been calling you human this whole time.
translation: Ben de senin adini bilmiyorum. Bunca zamandir sana insan diyorum.

english: I'm [name].
[name]? I'm not a fan, honestly.
I'm going to keep calling you human, human!
translation: Sana insan demeye devam edecegim, insan!

english: Will you be around next year?
Hmm... I don't know, human. We don't usually start making plans for Easter until at least halfway through the year.
translation: Hmm... Bilmiyorum, insan. Genelde yilin yarisi gecmeden Paskalya icin plan yapmaya baslamayiz.

english: But if I am around, I hope I get to talk to you again!
translation: Ama eger buradaysam, umarim seninle tekrar konusabilirim!

english: So long, human!
Wow, human, that hat looks great on you!
translation: Vay canina, insan, o sapka sana cok yakismis!

english: Really? I thought it looked a bit silly.
translation: Gercekten mi? Bence biraz komik duruyor.

english: Well, I think it looks amazing! Really suits you. Anyway, did you want anything?
translation: Bence harika duruyor! Sana cok yakismis. Neyse, bir sey mi istiyordun?

english: Yes
No
I'll speak to Aggie, give me the ingredients.
Why don't you go?
What am I meant to be doing again?
Goodbye.
Do you have more ingredients?
Yes, take me to Lumbridge.
Yes.
No.
How can you even teleport?
I need a new pair of shears.
How are you doing?
What am I meant to be doing?
Yes, teleport me to Varrock.
What do you know about the dark wizards?
Yes, take me to Draynor.
Are you alright after that cat attacked you?
What will you do now?
I never actually asked what your name is.
Will you be around next year?
translation: Gelecek yil da burada olacak misin?

english: What are you drinking?
Blood!
How are you getting drunk on blood?
They keep some of the tithes drunk all the time and then take it from them.
translation: Onlar bazi vergileri sürekli sarhos tutuyorlar ve sonra onlardan aliyorlar.

english: How very creative.
I know right! Bloody brilliant!
Hello.
I'll have a pint please.
I don't work here.
Sure you do!
No, I really don't.
Well clear off then.
Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: Insan! Muhafizlari cagirmadan köle kafeslerine geri dön!

english: Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: Hey, bu Kahraman! Vay canina! Sen harikasin, o iki genc ve Gadderanks'i nasil alt ettin? Ve kasaba cok güzel, harika bir is cikarmissin!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
Well met! My name's Grigore, I do a bit of this, a bit of that. Just try to survive really, there's nothing much else we can do.
translation: Merhaba! Benim adim Grigore, biraz sundan, biraz bundan yapiyorum. Aslinda sadece hayatta kalmaya calisiyoruz, baska yapabilecegimiz pek bir sey yok.

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: Aslinda pek bir sey yok, hepimiz hala vampirlerden saklaniyoruz ve bu korkunc yerde gecimimizi sagliyoruz, umarim yakinda Salve'deki tapinaga yolculuk yapacak kadar gücleniriz.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: Bildigim kadariyla yok, su anda cok yararli olan bazi temel olanaklara sahibiz, hepimiz size cok minnettariz. Daha önce hic bir kahraman görmedim veya tanimadim, bu yüzden karsilastiracak bir seyim yok, ama sanirim

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: cogu insanin görüsüne göre, siz bir kahramansiniz! Ben sahsen sizinle tanistigima cok memnunum.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Ok, thanks.
'Ello 'Ello!
Who's this then?
I don't know any more than you do!
Well ask them!
You ask them!
No! I'm not talking to some stranger in a sewer.
Go away, weirdo! We're busy!
Who are you?
And what do you want?
I'm Gertrude's friend. She said you two were-
translation: Ben Gertrude'un arkadasiyim. O, sizin ikinizin...

english: Ratcatchers?
Oh yes, we know lots about ratcatching.
translation: Evet, fare avciligi hakkinda cok sey biliyoruz.

english: But why should we tell you?
These are our trade secrets, you know.
My cat and I are adventurers. If you could teach us a trick or two I bet it would come in handy!
translation: Kedim ve ben maceraciyiz. Bize bir iki numara ögretirseniz, eminim cok isimize yarar!

english: We'll have to confer.
What do you think?
I don't think cats even do tricks.
Don't be stupid! Can we teach him ratcatching?
translation: Aptal olma! Ona fare avciligi ögretebilir miyiz?

english: I don't know. Seems a bit weird.
I can hear you, you know!
We'll set him a task, see how it goes.
translation: Ona bir görev verip, nasil gittigine bakalim.

english: Great idea!
Right, if you catch 8 ratsies with your cat...
We'll tell you what we know.
Sound fair?
I suppose so. How will you know that I've completed your task?
translation: Sanirim öyle. Görevi tamamladigimi nasil anlayacaksiniz?

english: We'll smell your cat, of course!
Um... alright.
Great! Let's have a sniff then.
The sisters pick up your cat and take a powerful whiff of it before placing it gently back on the ground.
translation: Kiz kardesler kedinizi kaldirip güclü bir sekilde kokladiktan sonra nazikce yere geri birakti.

english: Are you alright, cat?
I'll live.
Yup. Definitely a cat!
A real pongy one, too.
translation: Hem de cok kokan bir kedi.

english: Go on then, go splat them ratsies!
translation: Hadi o zaman, git fareleri ez!

english: Splat 'em! Squash 'em!
Er, will do.
Hello.
He's back!
Has he splatted some ratsies?
They sniff theatrically.
He needs [amount] more of 'em.
How many, er, 'ratsies' do I have to catch again?
8 ratsies. And your cat has to catch them. Any you get don't count.
translation: 8 fare. Ve kedin yakalamali. Senin yakaladiklarin sayilmaz.

english: Got it!
I splatted the ratsies for you.
Why are you talking like that?
Are you making fun of us?
Sorry, I just thought... won't happen again.
translation: Üzgünüm, sadece düsündüm ki... Bir daha olmayacak.

english: So did you splat them ratsies or what?
Er, yes, I did... catch the rats.
Haha, nice!
Splat! Splat!
Can you tell me about ratcatching now?
translation: Simdi bana fare avciligi hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Ha! Seems you already know plenty!
translation: Ha! Görünüse göre zaten cok sey biliyorsun!

english: Oh yes, you're a real ratcatching prodigy.
translation: Evet, sen gercek bir fare avciligi dahisisin.

english: Reminds me of us when we were little.
I'm not sure that's a compliment...
translation: Bunun bir iltifat oldugundan emin degilim...

english: Well, there's nothing more we can teach you.
translation: Sana ögretebilecegimiz baska bir sey yok.

english: Not much at all!
What? So we've just caught all these rats for nothing?
translation: Ne? Yani tüm bu fareleri bosuna mi yakaladik?

english: Isn't there anything you can teach me? I caught a lot of rats, you know...
translation: Bana ögretebileceginiz baska bir sey yok mu? Cok fare yakaladim, biliyorsunuz...

english: Here, have a rat pole.
Um, thanks. What's this for?
You can stick all the ratsies your cat splats on it.
Oh. Just what I wanted.
You're welcome!
Now now, keep your shirt on.
We'll send you to Jimmy.
Ooh, yes, Jimmy will know how to help.
translation: Evet, Jimmy nasil yardim edebilecegini bilir.

english: Where do I find this... Jimmy?
Jimmy Dazzler hangs out in Ardougne.
Ooh, and he is dazzling!
translation: Ooh, ve o gercekten göz kamastirici!

english: Shut up, Grimesquit!
Say hello to Jimmikins from me, won't you?
translation: Jimmikins'e benden selam söyle, olur mu?

english: Er, sure.
Would you look at that!
At what?
It's [player name] again!
What do you want?
Where can I find Jimmy Dazzler again?
Didn't you find him in Ardougne?
He's normally in the Flying Horse Inn.
Give him a kiss from me!
I will absolutely not be doing that.
Can you tell me where I can find Hooknosed Jack?
He's here in Varrock!
Who 'nose' where, though!
Ha! I'm sure you can 'scent' him out, [player name]
translation: Ha! Eminim onu koklayarak bulabilirsin, Maceraci

english: Hahahaha!
Come on, it's not that funny.
translation: Hadi ama, o kadar komik degil.

english: You think our nose jokes are bad? Well...
translation: Burun sakalarimizi kötü mü buluyorsun? Sey...

english: Our eye jokes are even cornea!
Can you tell me where I can find Smokin' Joe?
Last we heard he was in Keldagrim.
Can you tell me where I can find the Face?
She was in Port Sarim last we heard.
You can't miss her!
Can you tell me where I can find Felkrash?
We shouldn't say, but-
She's got a secret den in Port Sarim!
translation: Port Sarim'de gizli bir siginagi var!

english: Not secret now, is it?!
What's you want?
Ya what's zey want?
I don't know it's why I is asking 'em.
Why do we care what zey wants let's get back to rat splattin'.
translation: Onlarin ne istedigi neden umurumuzda olsun ki, fare avina geri dönelim.

english: Ya good plan.
Em... Ahemm.. Excuse me?
Eh? Would you credit da.
Wha?
It's [player name] again init?
[player name] has come back again.
S' wha does 'ey want?
Oh come on, stop the act. It's just not funny anymore.
translation: Hadi ama, numara yapmayi birak. Artik komik degil.

english: Ya it is.
Ha! Ha!
Ha! Ha!
Can you tell me where I would find Jimmy Dazzler?
'Ees in Ardougne. In ee?
'e is, e is. He stays in the Flying Horse dun 'e?
translation: Evet, orada. Flying Horse'da kaliyor, degil mi?

english: Tell 'im we said 'ello. Will ye?She then breaks out in a burst of girly giggles.
translation: Ona selam söyle. Tamam mi? Sonra kiz gibi kikirdamaya baslar.

english: Can you tell me where I would find Hooknosed Jack?
Da big ugly's ere in Vu'rock.
Da big ugly! Ha that's a good one. 'E is big n ugly though isn't e, serve him right for all the fights e get's in.
translation: Koca cirkin! Ha, bu iyiydi. O koca ve cirkin, degil mi? Tüm kavgalarindan dolayi hak ettigini buluyor.

english: Ha! I nose the truth when I 'ears it! Get it? Get it? Nose the truth?
translation: Ha! Gercegi duydugumda anlarim! Anladin mi? Anladin mi? Gercegi anlarim?

english: Ha, ha, ha ah ha.....
You leave the sisters grime mid cackle.
Can you tell me where I would find Smokin' Joe?
Short stuff's out in Keldagrime.
Can you tell me where I would find the Face?
Hey features? Where is she?
Port Sarim last I 'eard.
Can you tell me where I would find Felkrash?
She's travels about a bit, but I reckon Port Sarim.
translation: Biraz seyahat ediyor, ama sanirim Port Sarim'de.

english: Jimmy Dazzler
Hooknosed Jack
Smokin' Joe
The Face
Felkrash
The face
Yes?
What are you selling?
Lanterns. Want one?
Yes please.
Why are you selling lanterns?
It's dark around here.
You make a very valid point.
Yes. Want one?
No thanks.
Suit yourself.
Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: Insan! Muhafizlari cagirmadan köle kafeslerine geri dön!

english: Yes please.
Why are you selling lanterns?
No thanks.
So can I guard the treasure room please?
translation: Öyleyse hazine odasini koruyabilir miyim lütfen?

english: Well, I might post you outside it sometimes. I prefer to be the only one allowed inside however.
translation: Bazen seni disarida görevlendirebilirim. Ancak iceriye sadece benim girmemi tercih ederim.

english: There's some pretty valuable artefacts in there! Those keys stay ONLY with the head guard and Scarface Pete.
translation: Orada oldukca degerli eserler var! O anahtarlar SADECE bas muhafiz ve Scarface Pete'de kalacak.

english: You'll have various guard related duties on various shifts. I'll assign specific duties as they are required as and when they become necessary. Just so you know, if anything happens to me
translation: Cesitli vardiyalarda cesitli bekcilik görevlerin olacak. Gerektiginde ve ihtiyac duyuldugunda belirli görevler atayacagim. Bilgin olsun, bana bir sey olursa

english: you'll need to take over as head guard here. You'll find important keys to the treasure room and Pete's quarters inside my jacket - although I doubt anything bad's going to happen to
translation: burada bas bekcilik görevini devralman gerekecek. Hazine odasinin ve Pete'in odasinin önemli anahtarlarini ceketimin icinde bulacaksin - ama yakin zamanda bana kötü bir sey olacagini sanmiyorum

english: me anytime soon!
Grip laughs to himself at the thought.
translation: Grip bu düsünceye gülerek karsilik verir.

english: Anything I can do now?
translation: Su anda yapabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Hmm. Well, you could find out what this key opens for me. Apparently it's for something in this building, but for the life of me I can't find what.
translation: Hmm. Bu anahtarin neyi actigini benim icin bulabilirsin. Görünüse göre bu binadaki bir sey icin ama ne oldugunu bir türlü bulamiyorum.

english: Can't think of anything right now.
translation: Su anda aklima bir sey gelmiyor.

english: Well, I'd better sort my new room out.
Yeah, I'll give you time to settle in. Better get a good nights sleep, I expect you to report for duty at oh five hundred hours tomorrow on the dot!
translation: Evet, yerlesmen icin sana zaman verecegim. Iyi bir gece uykusu ceksen iyi olur, yarin saat tam beste görevine baslamani bekliyorum!

english: I can't attack the head guard here! There are too many witnesses around to see me do it! I'd have the whole of Brimhaven after me! Besides, if he dies I want the promotion!
translation: Buradaki bas gardiyani saldiramam! Etrafta beni gören cok fazla tanik var! Bütün Brimhaven pesimde olur! Ayrica, o ölürse terfi almak istiyorum!

english: Perhaps you need another players help...?
translation: Belki baska bir oyuncunun yardimina ihtiyacin vardir...?

english: Stay out of my drinks cabinet!
So can I guard the treasure room please?
So what do my duties involve?
Well, I'd better sort my new room out.
Anything I can do now?
translation: Su anda yapabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Hey yous creatures da good un...
How's everything going now?
translation: Su anda her sey nasil gidiyor?

english: All da zogries stayin' in da oldie Jiggig, we's gonna do da new Jiggig someways else. Yous creature da good- un for geddin' da oldie fings...
translation: Tüm zogries eski Jiggig'de kaliyor, yeni Jiggig'i baska bir yerde yapacagiz. Siz yaratiklar, eski seyleri aldiginiz icin iyisiniz...

english: I have some other questions for you.
Oh yes creatures...what's other fings yous wanna know?
translation: Oh evet yaratiklar... baska ne bilmek istiyorsunuz?

english: Why are you much nicer than the Shaman in Gu'Tanoth?
translation: Neden Gu'Tanoth'taki Saman'dan cok daha naziksiniz?

english: Dey's is da big crazy one's! Dey's biggest angries wiv fings and wanna dead all fings...dey's gotten da biggies wizzy stuff...and dey's wanna eat yous creatures...Grish, not do dat...
translation: Onlar cilginlar! Her seye cok kizginlar ve her seyi öldürmek istiyorlar... büyük sihirli esyalari var... ve sizi yaratiklari yemek istiyorlar... Grish, bunu yapma...

english: Oh, well that's a relief! It's good to know you don't eat humans...
translation: Oh, bu cok rahatlatici! Insanlari yemediginizi bilmek güzel...

english: Grish not say dat! Me's want's tasty looking creatures for yums...you's looks like da sickies chompy...not good for da gutsies...
translation: Grish, öyle deme! Ben lezzetli görünen yaratiklari yemek istiyorum... sizler hasta gibi görünüyorsunuz... bagirsaklar icin iyi degil...

english: Gulp!
Grish, you's is fright da creatures! Leave it alone!
translation: Grish, yaratiklari korkutuyorsun! Onlari rahat birak!

english: But it's da big laffsies when it's facey goes to whiteness....ha ha ha!
translation: Ama yüzleri bembeyaz oldugunda cok komik oluyorlar... ha ha ha!

english: But it's not da big yumsies when it's gone to all frighty...
translation: Ama korkudan kactiginda o kadar da lezzetli olmuyor...

english: ha ha ha ha!
Yeah...very funny, I'm sure.
Do you know Rantz?
Me's know's about Rantz, he's da biggun chompy hunter..he finks...ha ha ha!
translation: Rantz'i taniyorum, o büyük bir cigneyici avcisi... o düsünür... ha ha ha!

english: How do you mean?
He's da bad shot chompy sticker, no good at sneaky, sneaky part, he's more gooder at da 'noisy, noisy miss da chompy', ha ha ha!
translation: O kötü bir avci, gizlice hareket etmekte iyi degil, daha cok “gürültülü, gürültülü avi kacirmak”ta iyi, ha ha ha!

english: Why doesn't Rantz live with the rest of the Ogres?
translation: Rantz neden diger Ogrelerle birlikte yasamiyor?

english: He's been leaving Gu 'Noth 'cos dey's peoples is da big stressy dere? All da ogries is busying all da time...not doin' no good for da healfy fing. Rantz is da brave-un tho! He's got da big secret fing for leaving Gu' Noth
translation: Gu 'Noth'tan ayrildi cünkü oradaki insanlar cok stresli mi? Bütün ogreler sürekli mesgul... saglikli seyler icin iyi bir sey yapmiyorlar. Rantz cesur biridir! Gu' Noth'tan ayrilmak icin büyük bir sirri var

english: but me's not knowin it. But maybe's he's just want's to be da better chompy sticker?
translation: ama ben bilmiyorum. Ama belki de sadece daha iyi bir chompy sticker olmak istiyordur?

english: Why do you call this place Jiggig?
It's da place where da Jiggig is done...we's jig at Jiggig...
translation: Jiggig'in yapildigi yer burasi... Jiggig'de jig yapiyoruz...

english: I want to talk about the quest
Sorry, I have to go.
How's everything going now?
translation: Su anda her sey nasil gidiyor?

english: I have some other questions for you.
Why are you much nicer than the Shaman in Gu'Tanoth?
translation: Neden Gu'Tanoth'taki Saman'dan cok daha naziksin?

english: Do you know Rantz?
Why doesn't Rantz live with the rest of the Ogres?
translation: Rantz neden diger Ogre'larla birlikte yasamiyor?

Hey there.
Hail, Group Iron Man! My name is Tony, and I'm here to teach you everything you need to know about Group Iron Men. What can I do for you?
translation: Selam, Grup Iron Man! Benim adim Tony ve size Grup Iron Men hakkinda bilmeniz gereken her seyi ögretmek icin buradayim. Sizin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: What is a Group Iron Man?
Group Iron Man is a game mode where you do everything as a group. You can only trade items with player's in your group, take their items and accept their help.
translation: Grup Iron Man, her seyi grup olarak yaptiginiz bir oyun modudur. Sadece grubunuzdaki oyuncularla esya takasi yapabilir, onlarin esyalarini alabilir ve yardimlarini kabul edebilirsiniz.

english: This means if your friend in the group has something you want to borrow, you can - assuming you have Individual Prestige status or are a Hardcore Group Iron player! But don't confuse Individual and Group
translation: Bu, gruptaki arkadasinizin ödünc almak istediginiz bir seyi varsa, bireysel prestij statüsüne sahipseniz veya Hardcore Grup Iron oyuncusuysaniz, bunu yapabileceginiz anlamina gelir! Ancak bireysel ve grup prestijini karistirmayin.

english: Can I help you with anything else?
translation: Baska bir konuda yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: What is Individual Prestige?
Individual Prestige is automatically awarded to you the very first time you create a group. It is proof that you were one of the original members of that group.
translation: Bireysel Prestij, bir grup olusturdugunuzda otomatik olarak size verilir. Bu, o grubun orijinal üyelerinden biri oldugunuzun kanitidir.

english: This proof is displayed as a gold star next to your name on the group sidepanel. Note that if you join an existing group, you will not be considered an original member.
translation: Bu kanit, grup yan panelinde adinizin yaninda altin bir yildiz olarak görüntülenir. Mevcut bir gruba katilirsaniz, orijinal üye olarak kabul edilmeyeceginizi unutmayin.

english: The limits are gold and items worth up to 1,000,000 coins for the 1st week, 20,000,000 coins for the 2nd week, 50,000,000 coins for the 3rd week and 100,000,000 coins for the 4th week.
translation: Sinirlar, 1. hafta icin altin ve 1.000.000 coin degerinde esya, 2. hafta icin 20.000.000 coin, 3. hafta icin 50.000.000 coin ve 4. hafta icin 100.000.000 coin'dir.

english: During these 5 weeks you will also have restrictions to what you can equip: certain items will require you to have killed the monster that drops them.
translation: Bu 5 hafta boyunca, donatabileceginiz esyalara da kisitlamalar uygulanir: belirli esyalari donatmak icin, onlari düsüren canavari öldürmüs olmaniz gerekir.

english: What is Group Prestige?
Non-Hardcore groups can show their dedication to the group through Group Prestige. This status can be viewed on the group's sidepanel, just below the group's name.
translation: Hardcore olmayan gruplar, Grup Prestiji araciligiyla gruba olan bagliliklarini gösterebilirler. Bu statü, grubun adinin hemen altinda, grubun yan panelinde görüntülenebilir.

english: Group Prestige is lost upon inviting new members into the group, or upon doing certain activities with players outside of your group.
translation: Grup Prestiji, gruba yeni üyeler davet edildiginde veya grubunuz disindaki oyuncularla belirli etkinlikler yapildiginda kaybedilir.

english: What is a Hardcore Group Iron Man?
Hardcore Group Iron mode is a more challenging version of the regular mode, in which you have only a set number of lives for the entire group.
translation: Hardcore Grup Iron modu, normal modun daha zorlu bir versiyonudur ve tüm grup icin belirli sayida caniniz vardir.

english: If you die in an unsafe area, you will lose one of your group's lives. When your shared lives hit 0, you will all be downgraded to regular Group Iron players.
translation: Güvenli olmayan bir alanda ölürseniz, grubunuzun canlarindan birini kaybedersiniz. Paylasilan canlariniz 0'a düstügünde, hepiniz normal Grup Iron oyuncularina düsürülürsünüz.

english: I'd like to manage my group status.
I'd like to leave the group.
We can start the process for you to leave. The process will take 7 days to complete.
translation: Gruptan ayrilma islemini baslatabiliriz. Islem 7 gün sürer.

english: Are you sure you want to leave your group?
No, I changed my mind.
I'm fine, thanks.
I'd like to change my group's name.
Only the group leader can do that.
How do I leave a group?

You can leave your group by talking to me about group management. However, know that there will then be a 7 day grace period before it takes effect. In this time you can come back to cancel the request if you've
translation: Grup yönetimi hakkinda benimle konusarak gruptan ayrilabilirsiniz. Ancak, bunun yürürlüge girmesi icin 7 günlük bir bekleme süresi oldugunu unutmayin. Bu süre icinde fikrinizi degistirirseniz, isteginizi iptal etmek icin geri dönebilirsiniz.

english: changed your mind.

You could also be kicked from the group. If you are kicked from the group, you also have a 7 day grace period before you are removed. Only the leader of a group can kick other people. The leader must talk to me
translation: Gruptan atilirsaniz, kaldirilmadan önce 7 günlük bir bekleme süresi vardir. Gruptan atilirsaniz, gruptan cikarilmadan önce 7 günlük bir bekleme süresi vardir. Sadece grup lideri diger kisileri gruptan atabilir. Lider, grubu yönetmek icin benimle

english: in person about group management so I can confirm that they're really the leader before I let them kick anyone.
translation: sahsen görüsmelidir, böylece ben de liderin gercekten lider oldugunu dogrulayabilirim.

english: The leader can come back to me at any point during those 7 days to cancel the request if they have changed their minds about kicking someone.
translation: Lider, birini gruptan atma konusunda fikrini degistirirse, 7 gün icinde istedigi zaman bana gelip talebini iptal edebilir.

english: Can I change my Group Iron mode?
Unfortunately, Group Iron players who are not new to the island can't change their Group Iron mode.
translation: Maalesef, adaya yeni gelmemis Grup Demir oyunculari Grup Demir modunu degistiremezler.

english: There you go. Wear it with pride.
I think you've already got the whole set.
You can only change your Group Iron mode if you haven't been to the mainland.
translation: Grup Demir modunu yalnizca anakaraya gitmemissen degistirebilirsin.

What is Individual Prestige?
What is Group Prestige?

Group status.

Good day! I'm here to to teach you about group storage, and to let you access your personal bank. You can call me Maggie. How may I help you?
translation: Iyi günler! Size grup depolama hakkinda bilgi vermek ve kisisel bankaniza erismenizi saglamak icin buradayim. Bana Maggie diyebilirsiniz. Nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: How do I use the group storage?
You can access the group storage via the button in the top-left of your bank interface. Only one member of the group may access the storage at one time.
translation: Banka arayüzünüzün sol üst kösesindeki dügmeyle grup depolamaya erisebilirsiniz. Bir seferde sadece bir grup üyesi depolamaya erisebilir.

english: You will then be able to deposit and withdraw items from the group storage. You can't deposit untradeable items.
translation: Böylece grup depolama alanina esya yatirabilir ve cekebilirsiniz. Takas edilemeyen esyalari yatiramazsiniz.

english: When you have finished, click the 'Save' button to confirm the transaction.
translation: Islemi tamamladiginizda, islemi onaylamak icin “Kaydet” dügmesine tiklayin.

english: Can I help you with anything else?
translation: Baska bir konuda yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: I'd like to access my bank account please.
This bank is for new adventurers only, you cannot access it as you've already started your Group Ironman journey.
translation: Bu banka sadece yeni maceracilar icindir, Grup Ironman yolculuguna basladiginiz icin bu hesaba erisemezsiniz.

english: I'd like to check my PIN settings.
I'd like to collect items.
Goodbye.
Farewell.

Grubfoot wear red armour! Grubfoot wear green armour!
translation: Grubfoot kirmizi zirh giy! Grubfoot yesil zirh giy!

english: Why they not make up their minds?
Shut up Grubfoot!
Me lonely.
Why?
Other goblins in village follow either General Wartface or General Bentnoze. Me try to follow both but then me get left out of both groups.
translation: Köydeki diger goblinler ya General Wartface'i ya da General Bentnoze'yi takip ediyor. Ben ikisini de takip etmeye calistim ama sonra her iki gruptan da dislandim.

english: Don't talk to me!
Why not?
Me not allowed to talk. Generals will tell me to shut up whenever I talk.
translation: Konusmam yasak. Ne zaman konussam generaller bana susmami söylüyor.

english: Grubfoot do this! Grubfoot do that! They always want different things and they never satisfied!
translation: Grubfoot sunu yap! Grubfoot bunu yap! Her zaman farkli seyler istiyorlar ve asla tatmin olmuyorlar!

english: Me wish generals wouldn't tell me to shut up.
Sometimes they tell me to shut up when me not even say anything!
translation: Bazen ben hicbir sey söylemedigim halde bana susmami söylüyorlar!

english: Me wish me weren't so small. Other goblins all pick on me and make me do all hard work for generals.
translation: Keske bu kadar kücük olmasaydim. Diger goblinler hep bana satasiyor ve generaller icin tüm zor isleri bana yaptiriyorlar.

english: Hello Grubfoot. Merry Christmas!
Grubfoot like Christmas. Grubfoot think it different from human Christmas. Goblins call it Gobmas.
translation: Grubfoot Noel'i sever. Grubfoot, bunun insan Noel'inden farkli oldugunu düsünür. Goblinler buna Gobmas der.

english: Talk about Christmas.
Talk about something else.
Ukk...I's dun fer...me's don't feel legsies anymore!
translation: Ukk... Ben bittim... Bacaklarimi hissetmiyorum artik!

english: Yous creature doesn't stick mee's chompy, else mee's squeeze creature till yous a deadun!
translation: Senin yaratik benim cenemi isirmazsa, seni sikip öldürürüm!

english: Yous creatures too weedy for da ogre stabby chucker, yous best stick wiv da cluks-cluks.
translation: Siz yaratiklar ogre bicakcisi icin cok zayifsiniz, en iyisi cluks-cluks'a sadik kalin.

english: Chompy is bestest yumms...
Me'se can't wait for da chompy yumms...I's dribbling all down me's for da tasty chompy.
translation: Chompy'nin lezzetini sabirsizlikla bekliyorum... Lezzetli chompy icin agzimdan salya akiyor.

english: Da fatsy toadies geddin' all messy...
Me's gonna ged da pridy chompy hatsies...an looks like a good-un wiv da laydies.
translation: Gururlu chompy sapkalari alacagim... bayanlara yakisacak gibi görünüyor.

english: Mee's scared of Jiggig and da zogries, deyz is not da right dead-uns.
translation: Jiggig ve zogries'ten korkuyorum, onlar dogru ölüler degil.

english: Mee's got no stabbers no more...gonna go home wiv no chompy...
translation: Artik bicaklarim yok... chompy olmadan eve gidecegim...

english: I's stickin' da chompy...
De'se stabbers are worser dan a dead dog....
translation: Bu bicaklar ölü bir köpekten daha kötü...

english: Would you like to buy or sell some gold jewellery?
translation: Altin taki satin almak veya satmak ister misiniz?

english: No, I'm not that rich.
Get out then! We don't want any riff-raff in here.
translation: O zaman defol! Burada serseriler istemiyoruz.

english: Yes please.
No, I'm not that rich.
Bored, bored, bored. These Fremenniks are taking ages.
translation: Sikildim, sikildim, sikildim. Bu Fremennikler cok zaman aliyor.

english: Hey, they're doing their best. You arrived early.
translation: Hey, ellerinden geleni yapiyorlar. Erken geldiniz.

english: Hey, we arrived precisely when we told your representatives. Lack of planning on your part does not constitute an emergency on my part.
translation: Hey, temsilcilerinize söyledigimiz saatte geldik. Sizin planlama eksikliginiz benim icin acil bir durum olusturmaz.

english: Please, someone get these guys their ore quickly. They are eating all the good food on the island, and complaining about it!
translation: Lütfen, biri bu adamlara cabuk cevherlerini versin. Adadaki tüm iyi yiyecekleri yiyorlar ve sikayet ediyorlar!

english: I'd better get a move on!
Ah, yes. Now that's what I call a meal.
translation: Ah, evet. Iste ben buna yemek derim.

english: That's funny, I called it fourteen meals yesterday.
translation: Komik, ben dün buna on dört ögün yemek demistim.

english: Ho! Outlander.
What's down the scary-looking staircase?
translation: Korkunc görünümlü merdivenlerin asagisinda ne var?

english: These are the stairs down to the mining caves. There are rich veins of many types down there, and miners too. Though be careful; some of the trolls occasionally sneak into the far end of the cave.
translation: Bunlar maden magaralarina inen merdivenler. Asagida bircok türde zengin damarlar ve madenciler var. Ama dikkatli olun, bazi troller ara sira magaranin uzak ucuna gizlice giriyorlar.

english: Thanks. I'll look out for them.
Party! Party!
Something's happening in the party room!
Everyone get to the party room!
What's happening in the party room?
Someone's having a big party!
Get to the party room NOW!
Get to the party room!
Get to the party room quick!
Big value items in the party room now!
translation: Parti odasinda cok degerli esyalar var!

english: Quick! Get to the party room!
Woah, what's happened to me?!
Oi you! What are you doing on this side of the portal?
translation: Hey sen! Portalin bu tarafinda ne yapiyorsun?

english: Go report to the Duke in the castle, the greater yolk didn't tell you to return.
translation: Kaleye gidip Dük'e rapor ver, büyük yumurta sana geri dönmeni söylemedi.

english: Why are you talking to me, go report to the Duke in the castle, the egg will find a way to deal with you.
translation: Neden benimle konusuyorsun, kaleye gidip Dük'e rapor ver, yumurta seninle ilgilenmenin bir yolunu bulacaktir.

english: You're free to do as you wish, but I'll be keeping my ears on you.
translation: Istedigini yapabilirsin, ama seni takip edecegim.

english: Be on your way.
You don't want to mess with me, human.
If you're thinking of trying anything, you'll quickly find yourself regretting it.
translation: Bir sey yapmaya kalkisirsan, cok gecmeden pisman olursun.

english: I'm watching you, human.
Move along.
What do you think you're doing, human?
Oh... I was just going to check out the inside of this house.
translation: Oh... Sadece bu evin icini kontrol edecektim.

english: This isn't a house, it's a... Actually, human, it's none of your business!
translation: Burasi ev degil, bu bir... Aslinda, insan, bu seni ilgilendirmez!

english: Well now you've just made me curious. What's in there?
translation: Simdi merakimi uyandirdin. Icinde ne var?

english: Go away!
Is it a really large anvil?
Final warning!
Is it a dwarf with a really long beard?
translation: Gercekten uzun sakalli bir cüce mi?

english: Why don't you ask me again?!
If you insist...
Ask me another question! I dare you!
translation: Bana baska bir soru sor! Cesaretin varsa!

english: Okay, okay! I'm leaving.
Is it a dwarf with a really long beard?
translation: Gercekten uzun sakalli bir cüce mi?

english: If you insist...
Okay, okay! I'm leaving.
Hello.
Hello there. I haven't seen you around here before. If you've come to admire the Carnillean family home, I must warn you not to cause any trouble.
translation: Merhaba. Seni daha önce buralarda görmemistim. Carnillean ailesinin evini hayranlikla izlemeye geldiysen, sana sorun cikarmamani tavsiye ederim.

english: Due to recent criminal activities against such prominent Ardougnians, I have been sent here on special guard duty to ensure the Carnilleans' security.
translation: Son zamanlarda önde gelen Ardougnialilar'a karsi islenen suclar nedeniyle, Carnillean ailesinin güvenligini saglamak icin buraya özel güvenlik görevlisi olarak gönderildim.

english: Anyone caught interfering with the person or possessions of any Carnilleans will be taken to jail so quickly that their feet won't even touch the floor!
translation: Carnillean ailesinin herhangi bir üyesine veya malina zarar verenler, ayaklari yere basamadan hapse atilacaklar!

english: Well, I wasn't actually planning on doing anything like that...
translation: Aslinda öyle bir sey yapmayi düsünmüyordum...

english: Glad to hear it.
Well well well... if it isn't our very own local hero. Good to see you managed to clear your name I always had faith in you!
translation: Vay vay vay... Bizim yerel kahramanimiz gelmis. Adini temize cikardigina sevindim. Sana her zaman inandim!

english: Hello there.
Hello, adventurer. It's a shame you never found that cult. We have a horrible suspicion that there's been another burglary.
translation: Merhaba, maceraci. O tarikati bulamamis olman cok yazik. Korkunc bir süphemiz var, baska bir hirsizlik daha olmus olabilir.

english: That's worrying.
Yes, it is. The thing is, we can't even work out what they've taken! It's all very odd.
translation: Evet, öyle. Sorun su ki, ne caldiklarini bile anlayamiyoruz! Her sey cok garip.

english: Is there anything more I can do to help?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: I don't think so. Sir Ceril says you've done enough.
translation: Sanmiyorum. Sir Ceril, yeterince yardim ettigini söylüyor.

english: Don't you try anything, surface-dweller. I'm keeping an eye on you.
translation: Hicbir sey yapmaya kalkisma, yüzey sakini. Seni gözlüyorum.

english: Welcome, surface-dweller, to the hidden city of Dorgesh-Kaan!
translation: Hos geldin, yüzey sakini, gizli sehir Dorgesh-Kaan'a!

english: Surface-dweller!
What?
Have a nice day!
I don't want to be unfriendly, but I can't help noticing that since surface-dwellers started coming into the city there has been an increase in CRIME!
translation: Kaba olmak istemem ama yüzey sakinleri sehre gelmeye basladigindan beri SUCLARIN arttigini fark etmeden edemiyorum!

english: Surface-dweller! I don't know how you got into the city, but you will never escape!
translation: Yüzey sakini! Sehre nasil girdigini bilmiyorum, ama asla kacamayacaksin!

english: But... I thought I was allowed into the city!
translation: Ama... Sehre girmeme izin verildigini saniyordum!

english: You are. I just wanted to say that. And now that you're allowed into the city, I'll never be able to!
translation: Verildi. Sadece bunu söylemek istedim. Ve simdi sen sehre girebiliyorsun, ama ben asla giremeyecegim!

english: Hello soldier.
I'm more of an adventurer really.
translation: Aslinda ben daha cok maceraci sayilirim.

english: In this day and age we're all soldiers. No time to waste gassing, Fight! Fight! Fight!
translation: Bu günlerde hepimiz askeriz. Bos konusmaya zaman yok, savas! Savas! Savas!

english: Well hello brave warrior. These ogres have been terrorising the area, they've eaten four children this week alone.
translation: Merhaba cesur savasci. Bu ogreler bölgeyi terörize ediyorlar, sadece bu hafta dört cocugu yediler.

english: Brutes!
So we decided to use them for target practice. A fair punishment.
translation: Bu yüzden onlari hedef talimi icin kullanmaya karar verdik. Adil bir ceza.

english: Indeed.
What do you want? Leave us be!
Welcome to the Seers' Village courthouse. Court is not in session today, so you're not allowed downstairs.
translation: Görenler Köyü adliye binasina hos geldiniz. Bugün mahkeme oturumu yok, bu yüzden asagiya inmenize izin verilmiyor.

english: What is this place?
The Seers' Village courthouse. We give all criminals a fair trial, by a jury of their peers. Or whoever we can round up from the pub.
translation: Seers Köyü adliye binasi. Tüm suclulara, akranlarindan olusan bir jüri tarafindan adil bir yargilama yapiyoruz. Ya da pub'dan toplayabildigimiz herkese.

english: You're a long way out from the city.
I know. We guards usually stay by banks and shops, but I got sent all the way out here to keep an eye on the brigands loitering just south of here.
translation: Biliyorum. Biz muhafizlar genellikle bankalarin ve dükkanlarin yaninda kaliriz, ama buraya, güneyde dolasan haydutlari gözetlemek icin gönderildim.

english: It sounds more exciting than standing around guarding banks and shops.
translation: Bankalari ve dükkanlari korumaktan daha heyecanli görünüyor.

english: It's not too bad. At least I don't get attacked so often out here. Guards in the cities get killed all the time.
translation: O kadar da kötü degil. En azindan burada cok sik saldiriya ugramiyorum. Sehirlerdeki muhafizlar sürekli öldürülüyor.

english: Honestly, people these days just don't know how to behave!
translation: Acikcasi, bu günlerde insanlar nasil davranacaklarini bilmiyorlar!

english: Don't distract me while I'm on duty! This mine has to be protected!
translation: Görev basindayken dikkatimi dagitma! Bu maden korunmali!

english: What's going to attack a mine?
Goblins! They wander everywhere, attacking anyone they think is small enough to be an easy victim. We need more cannons to fight them off properly.
translation: Goblinler! Her yere dolasip, kolay kurban olabilecek kadar kücük gördükleri herkese saldiriyorlar. Onlari dogru dürüst savusturmak icin daha fazla top lazim.

english: Cannons? Those sound expensive.

A new cannon can cost 750,000 coins, and the ammo isn't easy to get, but they do up to 30 hitpoints of damage with each shot. When you've got an important mine like this one to protect, it's worth the expense.
translation: Yeni bir top 750.000 sikkeye mal olabilir ve mühimmati da kolay bulunmaz, ama her atista 30 can puani hasar veriyorlar. Böyle önemli bir madeni korumak icin bu masrafi yapmaya deger.

english: Thanks for the information.
You're welcome. Now please let me get on with my guard duties.
translation: Rica ederim. Simdi lütfen nöbet görevime devam etmeme izin verin.

english: Well, I've done my bit to help with that.
Yes, I heard. Now please let me get on with my guard duties.
translation: Evet, duydum. Simdi lütfen nöbet görevime devam etmeme izin verin.

english: Alright, I'll leave you alone now.
Please don't disturb me, I've got to keep any eye out for suspicious individuals.
translation: Lütfen beni rahatsiz etmeyin, süpheli kisilere dikkat etmem gerekiyor.

english: I'm surprised you managed to get out of there without breaking any bones.
translation: Oradan hicbir kemiginizi kirmadan cikabildiginize sasirdim.

english: Still, the Queen says it should be safe, and I'm to let you go back down if you want.
translation: Yine de Kralice güvenli oldugunu söylüyor ve isterseniz sizi asagiya geri gönderecegim.

english: Stand back. This area is restricted.
translation: Geri cekil. Bu alan yasak bölge.

english: What's so special about it?
That's none of your business.
I think I've left some of my loot in there. Can I get it quick?
translation: Sanirim ganimetimin bir kismini orada birakmisim. Hizlica alabilir miyim?

english: Nice try, Rookie.
What if I share some of it with you?
I do not care for wealth. Now move along.
translation: Zenginlik umurumda degil. Simdi cekil yolumdan.

english: May I pass?
You shall not... *cough*
No one is allowed past I'm afraid.
How suspicious...
What do you think you're doing?
Welcome, [Fremennik name].
Are you all right? Leftie?
No, I'm on the left.
Only from your perspective. Someone entering the gate should call you Rightie, right Leftie?
translation: Sadece senin bakis acindan. Kapidan giren biri sana Saglak demeli, degil mi Solak?

english: That's right Leftie, that's right.
No, Rightie's fine Leftie.
Aaagh! Enough! If either of you mention left or right in my presence I'll have to scream! Can I come through the gate?
translation: Aaagh! Yeter! Ikinizden biri benim huzurumda sol veya sag demisse ciglik atmak zorunda kalacagim! Kapidan gecebilir miyim?

english: Don't let us stop you.
Yes, head right on in, sir.
You said it! You said it! ARRRRRRRRGGH!
You're free to go into the dungeons, your Highness.
Try not to get eaten by those monsters.
Halt! Are you here to sabotage the Motherlode Mine?
translation: Dur! Motherlode Madeni'ni sabote etmeye mi geldin?

english: What's the Motherlode Mine?
Prospector Percy discovered unusual mineral veins in this cave. Now he's built a machine to let us extract useful ores.
translation: Madenci Percy bu magarada sira disi maden damarlari kesfetti. Simdi de yararli madenleri cikarmamizi saglayan bir makine yapti.

english: Percy calls it the Motherlode. I don't know why, and I'm not asking - that's between him and his mother.
translation: Percy ona Motherlode diyor. Nedenini bilmiyorum ve sormuyorum da - bu onunla annesi arasinda bir mesele.

english: Dwarves don't normally let humans claim areas of the mine like this, but Percy's machine is really useful, so we struck a deal.
translation: Cüceler normalde insanlarin madenin bu bölgelerini ele gecirmesine izin vermezler, ama Percy'nin makinesi gercekten cok kullanisli, bu yüzden bir anlasma yaptik.

english: No, I'm not.
That's a relief. Have a nice day.
What would you do if I said 'yes'?
I'd ask you not to.
What's the Motherlode Mine?
No, I'm not.
What would you do if I said 'yes'?
You stay right there, outerlander.
Don't worry, I'm not an outerlander, I am [Fremennik name], a Fremennik!
translation: Merak etme, ben yabanci degilim, ben Dokrak, bir Fremennik'im!

english: I said stay there, outerlander! You are not welcome in our camp.
translation: Orada kal dedim, yabanci! Kampimiza hos gelmedin.

english: Why, what's beyond here?
Our camp, outerlander, and we don't want any trouble there.
translation: Kampimiz, yabanci, ve orada sorun istemiyoruz.

english: I suppose I might as well let you pass now, since I can't seem to stop you anyway.
translation: Zaten seni durduramayacagim icin, gecmene izin verebilirim.

english: Just remember that I'm watching you.
Go, outerlander, and do not hurry back.
You may pass freely, outerlander.
Hey, how did you get here?
Can you come and help me? The chieftain's daughter -
translation: Gelip bana yardim eder misin? Sef'in kizi...

english: No, outerlander, I'm guarding this mountain pass from trolls and inquisitive people like you.
translation: Hayir, yabanci, bu dag gecidini trollerden ve senin gibi merakli insanlardan koruyorum.

english: Doesn't look like you were very successful in the last regard.
translation: Sonuncusunda pek basarili olamadin gibi görünüyor.

english: If the chieftain would let me, I would correct that oversight.
translation: Sef izin verse, bu ihmali düzeltirdim.

english: You may pass freely.
Thanks... and try to lighten up a bit, alright?
translation: Tesekkürler... ve biraz neselenmeye calis, tamam mi?

english: Don't press your luck, outerlander.
Feel free to come in and see the highlight of our culture, outerlander.
translation: Iceri girip kültürümüzün en önemli özelligini görmeye cekinme, yabanci.

english: HALT! Who goes there?
Don't worry, I'm not going to cause trouble.
But you shouldn't be here - be off with you!
I was going anyway.
I am [player name] the Mighty!
Mighty? You look like another of those silly adventurers who thinks they're the bee's knees just because they've done a few lousy quests!
translation: Mighty mi? Sen de birkac berbat görev tamamladin diye kendini cok önemli sanan aptal maceracilardan birisin!

english: Well it sounds better than sitting on this rooftop all day looking at trees!
translation: Bütün gün bu catida oturup agaclara bakmaktan daha iyi!

english: I'll have you know it's a very important job guarding this jail!
translation: Bu hapishaneyi korumak cok önemli bir is, bilgin olsun!

english: If anyone comes sneaking in here to mess around with the prisoners, the lads downstairs will make mincemeat of them, and I'll be here to pick them off if they try to escape.
translation: Buraya gizlice girip mahkumlarla ugrasan olursa, asagidaki adamlar onlari parcalar ve kacmaya calisirlarsa ben de onlari yakalarim.

english: You mean people aren't meant to be able to shoot the prisoners in the cells?
translation: Yani kimse hücrelerdeki mahkumlari vurabilir mi?

english: Yes, that's right.
Okay, it's been nice talking to you.
No-one, there's no-one here.
What? I can see you!
No, you're just imagining it. Perhaps you've been up here in the sun for too long?
translation: Hayir, hayal görüyorsun. Belki de güneste cok uzun süre kaldin?

english: So who am I talking to?
Oh dear, you've started talking to yourself. That's a common sign that you're going mad!
translation: Ah canim, kendi kendine konusmaya basladin. Bu delirdiginin yaygin bir isaretidir!

english: But... but... you're standing right there...
Maybe you should leave him alone now.
Don't worry, I'm not going to cause trouble.
I am [player name] the Mighty!
No-one, there's no-one here.
Guh... mwww... zzzzz...
Hmph... heh heh heh...
Mmmm... big pint of beer... kebab...
translation: Mmmm... büyük bir bardak bira... kebap...

english: Mmmmmm... donuts...
Maybe I should let him sleep.
translation: Belki de onu uyumasina izin vermeliyim.

english: Hello, can I go in?
I'm afraid not. The city is on lockdown until the rebel elves are dealt with.
translation: Korkarim ki hayir. Asi elfler halledilene kadar sehir kapatildi.

english: Please, I won't cause any trouble.
Rules are rules. No one enters until the criminals are gone.
translation: Kural kuraldir. Suclular gidene kadar kimse giremez.

english: Fine, doesn't look very exciting anyway, it's just an empty field.
translation: Peki, zaten pek heyecan verici görünmüyor, sadece bos bir alan.

english: Mind your tongue human. Our great city may be lost to us but that doesn't give you an excuse to talk like that.
translation: Dilini tut insan. Büyük sehrimizi kaybetmis olabiliriz ama bu sana böyle konusma hakki vermez.

english: Welcome, adventurer.
Hey! Get your hands off there!
Greetings, traveller. Enjoy your time at the Ranging Guild.
translation: Selamlar gezgin. Ranging Guild'de iyi vakit gecir.

english: *Whistles*
Exciting new post he said.
Can't wait for the weekend.
Why me?
I'm so bored
I'd kill for a kebab.
I need a new job.
10 green bottles sit..*Whistles*
I miss Billy and Bob *sighs*
Dum dum dum de dum Hey!
translation: Dum dum dum de dum Hey!

english: Why isn't it 6 already?
These night shifts just go on and on.
I'm hungry.
*sings* If I had 3 wil....
Halt thief!
Hey! Get your hands off there!
The Sinclairs are under house arrest for crimes against a crown, and it's all thanks to you.
translation: Sinclair ailesi kralliga karsi isledikleri suclar nedeniyle ev hapsinde ve hepsi senin sayende.

english: It's more luxury than they deserve.
translation: Hak ettiklerinden daha lüks bir hayat sürüyorlar.

english: The guard stares at you suspiciously.
Excuse me...
I don' need a hand drinkin me beer, go 'way!
translation: Bira icmek icin yardima ihtiyacim yok, git buradan!

english: But...
Talk to tha' hand coz thish face ain't lishtnin'!
translation: Bu elime bak, cünkü bu yüz dinlemiyor!

english: Yeeeuuuch! I hatesh that shtuff, jusht bring ush a beer! Mmmmm beer!
translation: Yeeeuuuch! O seyi sevmiyorum, bize bira getir! Mmmmm bira!

english: Need more beer...
Sir? I have some more beer for you...
translation: Efendim? Size biraz daha bira getirdim...

english: Ahh... jus' wha' I need, now, wha' did you wanna know?
translation: Ahh... tam da ihtiyacim olan sey, simdi, ne bilmek istiyordun?

english: I've come to report that Bert, the sandman, found a hand in the sand pit.
translation: Bert, kum adam, kum cukurunda bir el buldugunu bildirmek icin geldim.

english: Lucky for him, means he can get even more work done.
translation: Onun icin sansli, bu sayede daha fazla is yapabilir.

english: But aren't you going to find out who it ... belonged to?
translation: Ama kime ait oldugunu arastirmayacak misiniz?

english: Oops, No 'arm done. S'prob'ly a wizard, i's always the wizards fault, go ask them, jus' ring the bell outshide the guild and talk to the first pointy hatted ninny you shee!
translation: Oops, sorun yok. Muhtemelen bir büyücüdür, her zaman büyücülerin sucu olur, gidip onlara sorun, guild'in disindaki zili calin ve gördügünüz ilk sivri sapkali ahmakla konusun!

english: Err... ok, I'll go ring the bell and talk to a wizard then.
translation: Err... tamam, gidip zili calayim ve bir büyücüyle konusayim o zaman.

english: Hello Sir!
Go 'way! This pint'sh nearly finished! Unlessh you got more that ish....? Wizards, s'all the wizard's fault...prob'ly that Zavistic one, he'sh the worsht!
translation: Git buradan! Bu bira neredeyse bitti! Tabii daha fazlasi yoksa...? Büyücüler, her sey büyücülerin sucu... Muhtemelen o Zavistic olan, o en kötüsü!

english: E're, you left this 'and in me beer!
The Guard Captain fished the hand out of his beer and hands it to you.
translation: Muhafiz Kaptani eli biradan cikarir ve sana uzatir.

english: *HIC*
What are you doing here? You're not one of the guards.
translation: Burada ne yapiyorsun? Sen muhafizlardan biri degilsin.

english: I was just exploring. Is that okay?
translation: Sadece kesif yapiyordum. Sorun olur mu?

english: I suppose, but why would you want to explore down here?
translation: Sanirim olmaz, ama neden burada kesif yapmak istersin ki?

english: Well why not?
It's cold for a start.
I'd say it's still pretty warm compared to some places I've been.
translation: Benim gördügüm bazi yerlere kiyasla burasi hala oldukca sicak.

english: If you say so. Just don't go causing any trouble.
translation: Sen öyle diyorsan. Sakin sorun cikarma.

english: Good day. What are you up to?
My job is to ensure that everyone can use the bank safely. Shifty types always hang around banks, you know.
translation: Benim isim, herkesin bankayi güvenli bir sekilde kullanabilmesini saglamak. Süpheli tipler hep bankalarin etrafinda dolasir, bilirsin.

english: You're not shifty, are you?
No, of course not.
Jolly good. Carry on then.
translation: Cok iyi. Devam et o zaman.

english: Please help me with this!
Woof! Woof! Woof!
Woof Woof Bark!
*sigh* Not another one.
Another what?
Another 'archaeologist'.
I'm not going to let you plunder my Master's tomb you know.
That's a shame, have you got anything else I could do while I'm here?
translation: Cok yazik, burada yapabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: If it will keep you out of mischief I suppose I could set something up for you...
translation: Eger bu seni beladan uzak tutacaksa, sana bir seyler ayarlayabilirim...

english: I have a few rooms full of some things you humans might consider valuable, do you want to give it a go?
translation: Insanlarin degerli bulabilecegi seylerle dolu birkac odam var, denemek ister misin?

english: What should I do?
You have five minutes to explore the treasure rooms and collect as many artefacts as you can.
translation: Bes dakikan var, hazine odalarini kesfet ve mümkün oldugunca cok eser topla.

english: The artefacts are in the urns, chests and sarcophagi found in each room.
translation: Eserler her odada bulunan küller, sandiklar ve lahitlerin icindedir.

english: There are eight treasure rooms, each subsequent room requires higher thieving skills to both enter the room and thieve from the urns and other containers.
translation: Sekiz hazine odasi vardir, her bir sonraki odaya girmek ve küllerden ve diger kaplardan hirsizlik yapmak icin daha yüksek hirsizlik becerileri gerekir.

english: The rewards also become more lucrative the further into the tomb you go.
translation: Mezarin derinliklerine indikce ödüller de daha kazancli hale gelir.

english: You will also have to deactivate a trap in order to enter the main part of each room.
translation: Her odanin ana bölümüne girmek icin bir tuzagi devre disi birakmaniz da gerekecektir.

english: When you want to move onto the next room you need to find the correct door first.
translation: Bir sonraki odaya gecmek istediginizde, önce dogru kapiyi bulmaniz gerekir.

english: There are four possible exits, you must open the door before finding out whether it is the exit or not.
translation: Dört olasi cikis vardir, cikis olup olmadigini ögrenmeden önce kapiyi acmaniz gerekir.

english: Opening the doors require picking their locks. Having a lockpick will make this easier.
translation: Kapilari acmak icin kilitlerini acmaniz gerekir. Kilit acma aleti varsa bu daha kolay olacaktir.

english: How do I leave the game?
If at any point you decide you need to leave just use a glowing door.
translation: Herhangi bir anda oyundan cikmaya karar verirseniz, parlayan kapiyi kullanin.

english: The game will end and you will be taken out of the pyramid.
translation: Oyun sona erecek ve piramitten cikarilacaksiniz.

english: What about the chests and sarcophagi?
The artefacts are in the urns, chests and sarcophagi.
translation: Eserler, küller, sandiklar ve lahitlerin icindedir.

english: Urns contain snakes that guard them.
The sarcophagi take some strength to open. They take a while to open.
translation: Lahitleri acmak biraz güc gerektirir. Acilmasi biraz zaman alir.

english: Of course, Mummies have been known to take a nap in the sarcophagi, so beware.
translation: Tabii ki, mumyalarin lahitlerde uyudugu bilinmektedir, bu yüzden dikkatli olun.

english: The golden chests generally contain better artefacts, but are also trapped with scarabs!
translation: Altin sandiklar genellikle daha degerli eserler icerir, ancak ayni zamanda bok böcekleri ile tuzaklanmistir!

english: Tell me more about these artefacts.
translation: Bu eserler hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin.

english: There are a number of different artefacts, of three main types. The least valuable are the pottery statuettes and scarabs, and the ivory combs.
translation: Üc ana türden bircok farkli eser vardir. En degersiz olanlar cömlek heykelcikler, bok böcekleri ve fildisi taraklardir.

english: Next are the stone scarabs, statuettes and seals, and finally the gold versions of those artefacts.
translation: Sonra tas bok böcekleri, heykelcikler ve mühürler gelir ve son olarak da bu eserlerin altin versiyonlari.

english: They are not old, but are well made.
What do I do with artefacts once I've collected them?
That Simon Simpleton, I mean Templeton, will probably give you some money for them.
translation: Simon Simpleton, yani Templeton, muhtemelen sana biraz para verecektir.

english: He couldn't spot a real artefact if it came up to him and bit him in the face.
translation: Gercek bir eseri, yüzüne gelip onu isirsa bile fark edemez.

english: He usually slinks about near the pyramid north-east of Sophanem. I expect he's trying to get some poor fools to steal things from that pyramid as well.
translation: Genellikle Sophanem'in kuzeydogusundaki piramidin yakinlarinda dolasir. Muhtemelen o piramitten de bazi zavalli aptallari bir seyler calmalari icin kandirmaya calisiyordur.

english: I expect he'll give you more gold for some than others.
translation: Bazilarina digerlerinden daha fazla altin verecegini tahmin ediyorum.

english: What's this I've heard about a Golden Sceptre?
translation: Altin Asa hakkinda duydugum sey nedir?

english: Where did you hear about that?
I couldn't possibly say.
It's the only genuinely valuable artefact in this place.
translation: Bu yerdeki tek gercek degerli eser budur.

english: It links all the great pyramids in the area, and can be used to travel between them.
translation: Bölgedeki tüm büyük piramitleri birbirine baglar ve aralarinda seyahat etmek icin kullanilabilir.

english: It requires charging with offerings of fine craftsmanship, that's why we have so many spare artefacts lying around.
translation: Ince iscilikle yapilmis sunularla sarj edilmesi gerekir, bu yüzden etrafta bu kadar cok yedek eser var.

english: Anyway, I won't let you get your grubby little hands on the sceptre.
translation: Her neyse, o asayi senin kirli ellerine teslim etmeyecegim.

english: How do I get the artefacts?
What do I do with the artefacts I collect?
Player is put in the Pyramid Plunder minigame.
translation: Oyuncu, Piramit Yagmalama mini oyununa girer.

english: Not right now.
Well, get out of here then.
I know what I'm doing - let's get on with it.
translation: Ne yaptigimi biliyorum, hadi devam edelim.

english: Fine, I'll take you to the first room now...
translation: Peki, seni simdi ilk odaya götürecegim...

english: Player is put in the Pyramid Plunder minigame
translation: Oyuncu Piramit Yagmalama mini oyununa girer.

english: I want to charge my sceptre.
What sceptre?
Er... I don't know.
Right...
You shouldn't have that thing in the first place, thief!
Hmm... If I give you back some of the artefacts I've taken from the tomb, will you recharge the sceptre for me?
translation: Hmm... Mezardan aldigim bazi eserleri sana geri verirsem, asayi benim icin sarj eder misin?

english: No! Why would I waste the King's magic when it's already fully charged?
translation: Hayir! Zaten tamamen sarj olmusken neden Kral'in büyüsünü bosa harcayayim?

english: *sigh* Oh alright, but this is such a waste of the King's magic...
translation: *ic cekis* Tamam, ama bu Kral'in büyüsünü bosa harcamak oluyor...

english: You need to have 6 gold artefacts to recharge your sceptre.
translation: Asani sarj etmek icin 6 altin eser gerekir.

english: Right, you already had [x] charge[s], and I don't give discounts. That means 6 artefacts gives you [y] charge[s]. Now be on your way.
Right, 6 artefacts gives you [x] charges. Now be on your way.
You need to have 12 stone artefacts to recharge your sceptre.
translation: Asani sarj etmek icin 12 tas eser gerekir.

english: Right, you already had [x] charge[s], and I don't give discounts. That means 12 artefacts gives you [y] charge[s]. Now be on your way.
Right, 12 artefacts gives you [x] charges. Now be on your way.
You need to have 24 pottery or ivory artefacts to recharge your sceptre.
translation: Asani sarj etmek icin 24 cömlek veya fildisi esere ihtiyacin var.

english: Right, you already had [x] charge[s], and I don't give discounts. That means 24 artefacts gives you [y] charge[s]. Now be on your way.
Right, 24 artefacts gives you [x] charges. Now be on your way.
You've had your five minutes of plundering. Now be off with you!
translation: Bes dakikalik yagma süresi doldu. Simdi git buradan!

english: Right, you already had [amount] charge[s], and I don't give discounts. That means 6 artefacts gives you [amount] charge[s]. Now be on your way.
Right, 6 artefacts gives you [amount] charges. Now be on your way.
Actually, I've changed my mind.
Then clear off!
Can you remind me what I am supposed to do with these?
translation: Bunlarla ne yapmam gerektigini hatirlatir misin?

english: Thank you!
You have found my Master's Sceptre - You have been here long enough. Begone.
translation: Efendimin Asasini buldun - Yeterince uzun süre burada kaldin. Git artik.

english: Grrr! Someone has found the Pharaoh's sceptre!
Right! That's it. I'm clearing all the urns and refilling them now.
translation: Tamam! Yeter artik. Tüm külleri bosaltip yeniden dolduruyorum.

english: You're not done yet! Do this for me!
translation: Henüz isin bitmedi! Bunu benim icin yap!

english: The guardian mummy has given you a puzzle box!
translation: Muhafiz mumya sana bir bulmaca kutusu verdi!

english: Scarabs can do puzzles better than that!
translation: Böcekler bundan daha iyi bulmaca cözebilir!

english: Excellent work!
The guardian mummy has given you another clue scroll!/You've obtained a casket!
translation: Muhafiz mumya sana baska bir ipucu parsömeni verdi!/Bir tabut elde ettin!

english: That sounds like fun, what do I do?
Not right now.
I know what I'm doing - let's get on with it.
translation: Ne yapacagimi biliyorum - hadi devam edelim.

english: I want to charge my sceptre.
What should I do?
How do I leave the game?
What about the chests and sarcophagi?

translation: Evet. Disarida avlanacak her türlü ilginc yaratik var. Bazen özellikle benzersiz bir örnekle ilgili raporlar aliyoruz. Böyle bir durumda, avcilardan biri onu bulmak icin yola cikar.

english: That would be interesting.
You can take it from my shelves when you're ready to read it. Just head up that ladder over there.
translation: Okumak istediginde rafimdan alabilirsin. Suradaki merdivenden yukari cik.

english: You have proven yourself a true ally of our guild, iknami.
translation: Guildimizin gercek bir müttefiki oldugunu kanitladin, iknami.

english: As a personal reward for your help, you can have this key to open the chest on the floor above.
translation: Yardimin icin kisisel bir ödül olarak, üst kattaki sandigi acmak icin bu anahtari alabilirsin.

english: What do you do here?
We're mostly here to keep an eye on the local animal populations, and provide animal parts to the city.
translation: Cogunlukla yerel hayvan popülasyonlarini gözlemliyor ve sehre hayvan parcalari sagliyoruz.

english: As for me personally, I'm the current master of this guild.
translation: Sahsen ben, bu guildin su anki ustasiyim.

english: Current master?
A hunter's work is dangerous. We tend to go through members faster than other guilds. That said, I'm usually too busy with politics and paperwork to go out hunting these days.
translation: Avcinin isi tehlikelidir. Diger guildlere göre üyelerimiz daha cabuk tükenir. Bununla birlikte, son zamanlarda siyaset ve evrak isleriyle cok mesgul oldugum icin ava cikamiyorum.

english: I'd better be off.
Is that a skillcape you have with you?
translation: Yaninda bir beceri pelerini mi var?

english: It is.
Would you like me to enhance it with the ability to teleport directly to the guild?
translation: Onu, loncaya dogrudan isinlanma yetenegi ile güclendirmemi ister misin?

english: Yes please.
Kuani! That should be done for you now.
translation: Kuani! Simdi senin icin halledilmis olmali.

english: No thanks.
Absolutely.
No, thank you.
That would be interesting.
What do you do here?
I'd better be off.
Yes please.
No thanks.
Welcome to the farming guild. How may I help you?
translation: Ciftcilik guildine hos geldin. Nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: Tell me about the guild.
After the Shayzien Army cleared out the lizardmen in this area, I founded this guild with some fellow Hosidius farmers.
translation: Shayzien Ordusu bu bölgedeki kertenkele adamlari temizledikten sonra, bazi Hosidius ciftcileriyle birlikte bu guildi kurdum.

english: Why here? Why not within the safety of Kourend?
translation: Neden burada? Neden Kourend'in güvenli bölgesinde degil?

english: The heat of the volcano allows us to grow things here that would never survive in the climate of Kourend. The discoveries we have made are worth the extra risk.
translation: Volkanin isisi, Kourend'in ikliminde asla yetisemeyecek bitkileri burada yetistirmemizi sagliyor. Yaptigimiz kesifler, ekstra riski almaya deger.

english: Fair enough, anything else I should know about the guild?
translation: Anlasildi, loncayla ilgili bilmem gereken baska bir sey var mi?

english: The guild is split into three tiers, with only advanced farmers being allowed access to the upper echelons.
translation: Lonca üc kademeden olusuyor ve sadece ileri düzey ciftciler üst kademelere erisebiliyor.

english: Would you like to hear more about one of the tiers?
translation: Kademe hakkinda daha fazla bilgi almak ister misin?

english: Tell me about the beginner tier.
In the beginner tier you can access farming patches for cacti, allotments, bushes and flowers. You'll also find some shops with useful farming supplies.
translation: Baslangic seviyesinde kaktüs, sebze, cali ve cicek yetistirebileceginiz tarim alanlarina erisebilirsiniz. Ayrica, yararli tarim malzemeleri satan bazi dükkanlar da bulabilirsiniz.

english: Would you like to hear more about another tier?
translation: Baska bir seviye hakkinda daha fazla bilgi almak ister misiniz?

english: Tell me about the intermediate tier.
In the intermediate tier you can access farming patches for herbs and trees. You'll also find the anima and hespori patches which are unique to this guild.
translation: Orta seviyede otlar ve agaclar yetistirebileceginiz tarim alanlarina erisebilirsiniz. Ayrica, bu loncaya özgü anima ve hespori alanlari da bulabilirsiniz.

english: Tell me about the advanced tier.
translation: Ileri seviye hakkinda bilgi verir misiniz?

english: In the advanced tier you can access farming patches for fruit trees and spirit trees. You'll also find the redwood and celastrus patches which are unique to this guild.
translation: Ileri seviyede meyve agaclari ve ruh agaclari icin tarim alanlarina erisebilirsiniz. Ayrica bu loncaya özgü sekoya ve celastrus alanlari da bulabilirsiniz.

english: No thanks.
Tell me about yourself.
My name is Jane, and I am the founder of the Farming Guild.
translation: Adim Jane ve Tarim Loncasi'nin kurucusuyum.

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: That's all, thanks.
Do you have any jobs for me?
translation: Bana verebileceginiz bir is var mi?

english: Well we always need to rotate the crops we're growing to stop the soil from tiring due to lack of nutrients. It would be great if you could help out with that.
translation: Topragin besin eksikliginden dolayi yorulmasini önlemek icin yetistirdigimiz ürünleri sürekli degistirmemiz gerekiyor. Bu konuda bize yardim ederseniz cok seviniriz.

english: What would I need to do?
If you're interested, I can give you a farming contract which tells you what to plant within the guild. Complete the contract, and I'll give you some seeds as a thank you.
translation: Eger ilgilenirseniz, size lonca icinde ne yetistirmeniz gerektigini belirten bir tarim sözlesmesi verebilirim. Sözlesmeyi tamamladiginizda size tesekkür olarak biraz tohum verecegim.

english: Thanks for the information.
I'd like a farming contract.
What kind of contract would you like?
Could I have an easy contract please?
translation: Kolay bir sözlesme alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: Please could you grow [a/some] [plant(s)] for us? I'll reward you once you have checked [its/their] health.
Please could you grow some [plant]s for us? I'll reward you once they have been fully harvested.
Could I have a medium contract please?
translation: Orta zorlukta bir sözlesme alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: Could I have a hard contract please?
translation: Zor bir sözlesme alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: I've completed my farming contract.
You'll be wanting a reward then. Here's a seed pack.
translation: O zaman ödül isteyeceksiniz. Iste bir tohum paketi.

english: No.
Fair enough. Come back when you want another one.
What's my current farming contract?
We need you to grow [a/some] [plant(s)]. I'll reward you once you have checked [its/their] health.
We need you to grow some [plant]s. I'll reward you once they've been fully harvested.
Do you have anything easier?
translation: Daha kolay bir is var mi?

english: I suppose I could give you a different contract, if you're sure.
translation: Eger emin iseniz, size farkli bir sözlesme verebilirim.

english: Yes please.
Thank you.
How many farming contracts have I completed?
You've completed [amount] farming contracts.
Can I trade in some spirit seeds?
translation: Bazi ruh tohumlarini takas edebilir miyim?

english: Of course, I will also take potted spirit seeds and saplings. What would you like to trade in?
translation: Tabii ki, saksidaki ruh tohumlarini ve fidanlari da kabul ederim. Ne takas etmek istersin?

english: I'm just passing by.
Sure, let me know if there's anything I can do for you.
translation: Tabii, yardim edebilecegim bir sey olursa haber ver.

english: I'm afraid you have no Spirit seeds to trade in, come back when you do.
translation: Maalesef takas edecek ruh tohumun yok, oldugunda tekrar gel.

english: I'm afraid you have no Spirit seedlings to trade in, come back when you do.
translation: Maalesef takas edecek ruh fidaniniz yok, oldugunda tekrar gelin.

english: I'm afraid you have no Spirit seedling(w)s to trade in, come back when you do.
translation: Maalesef takas edecek ruh fidaniniz yok, oldugunda tekrar gelin.

english: I'm afraid you have no Spirit saplings to trade in, come back when you do.
translation: Maalesef takas edecek ruh fidaniniz yok, oldugunda tekrar gelin.

english: I'm afraid you have nothing to trade in, come back when you do.
translation: Maalesef takas edecek bir seyiniz yok, oldugunda tekrar gelin.

english: Hey! You need a Farming level of at least 65 to enter that area of the Farming Guild.
translation: Hey! Tarim Loncasi'nin o bölgesine girmek icin en az 65 Tarim seviyesi gerekiyor.

english: Hey! You need a Farming level of at least 85 to enter that area of the Farming Guild.
translation: Hey! Tarim Loncasi'nin o bölgesine girmek icin en az 85 Tarim seviyesi gerekiyor.

english: Tell me about the guild.
Tell me about the beginner tier.
Tell me about the intermediate tier.
Tell me about the advanced tier.
No thanks.
Tell me about yourself.
I'd like a farming contract.
I've completed my farming contract.
What's my current farming contract?
That's all, thanks.
Do you have any jobs for me?

Yes

Take another [difficulty] contract.

english: Yes please.
Thank you.
How many farming contracts have I completed?
Can I trade in some spirit seeds?

Spirit seed
