Spirit seedling(w)
Spirit sapling
All
You'll be wanting a reward then. Come back when you have some room to take it.
translation: O zaman bir ödül isteyeceksin. Alacak yerin oldugunda geri gel.

english: Welcome to the woodcutting guild. How may I help you?
translation: Odun kesme loncasina hos geldiniz. Nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: Tell me about the guild.

I founded the woodcutting guild when I retired from the Shayzien military. I spotted the ancient redwood trees in the hills many years ago from the Shayzien camp, and decided to construct the guild around them.
translation: Shayzien ordusundan emekli oldugumda odun kesme loncasi kurdum. Yillar önce Shayzien kampindan tepelerdeki eski sekoya agaclarini gördüm ve onlarin etrafinda loncayi kurmaya karar verdim.

english: You can find them to the West, just follow the path.
translation: Onlari batida bulabilirsiniz, yolu takip edin yeter.

english: However, if you're skilled in combat, or simply afraid of heights, the ent cavern may be more suited for you. The ents dwell deep beneath the ancient redwoods, and can be accessed through the cave to the North-West.
translation: Ancak, savasta yetenekliyseniz veya yüksekten korkuyorsaniz, ent magarasi sizin icin daha uygun olabilir. Entler, eski sekoyalarin derinliklerinde yasarlar ve kuzeybatidaki magaradan ulasilabilirler.

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: That's all, thanks.
Tell me about yourself.
My name is Lars, and I am the founder of the woodcutting guild. I originally grew up in a Shayzien camp, and was raised on the battlefield.
translation: Adim Lars ve odun kesme guildinin kurucusuyum. Aslen Shayzien kampinda büyüdüm ve savas alaninda yetistirildim.

english: As I grew older, I found peace in Hosidius, and the joys of skilled labour. I turned in my battleaxe for a hatchet, and set up a guild for those also talented in the skill of woodcutting.
translation: Büyüdükce, Hosidius'ta huzur ve yetenekli isciligin zevkini kesfettim. Savas baltami bir balta ile degistirdim ve odun kesme becerisine sahip olanlar icin bir guild kurdum.

english: I'm just passing by.
Sure, let me know if there's anything I can do for you.
translation: Tabii, senin icin yapabilecegim bir sey varsa söyle.

english: Here, solve this.
Guildmaster Lars hands you a [light /puzzle]box!
Please make yourself some space, I have something for you.
translation: Lütfen kendine yer ac, sana verecegim bir sey var.

english: That doesn't look solved to me.
Well done [player name]. Here you go.
You've [been given a new clue/obtained a casket]!
Tell me about the guild.
Tell me about yourself.
That's all, thanks.
I'm just passing by.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu var. Merhaba, selam, selam...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her türlü sey! Kuleler muhtesem bir manzara sunuyor.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmeni tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
You look like you could use a little colour in your life! Can I interest you in any dyes?
translation: Hayatina biraz renk katmak ister misin? Boya almak ister misin?

english: I could take a look.
No thanks.
Well, don't be afraid to come back any time!
I could take a look.
No thanks.
Finest silver in all of Keldagrim, come and see!
translation: Keldagrim'in en kaliteli gümüsü, gelin görün!

english: Right, what do you have?
Silver, what else!
No thanks.
That's my silver!
Halt, thief!
Guards, catch that thief!
Right, what do you have?
Not interested, thanks.
Hello.
Good day brave adventurer! Could I interest you in my fine selection of weapons?
translation: Iyi günler cesur maceraci! Seckin silah koleksiyonumla ilgilenir misiniz?

english: I'll take a look.
No thanks.
Grrrr!
Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: Hazir yemekler maalesef ise yaramaz. Aluft Aloft'un müsterileri icin sadece el yapimi Gnome Mutfagi yeterince iyidir.

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Gulluck
Thanks. Hmph.
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.'dan ücretsiz teslimat jetonunuzu almayi unutmayin.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: Teslimatiniz cok gec! Aluft jnr.'a geri dönüp baska bir siparis alin. Artik ihtiyaciniz olmadigi icin teslimat kutunuzu atiyorsunuz.

english: I'll take a look.
No thanks.
Hello, what are you doing out here?
I'm a banker, the only one around these dangerous parts.
translation: Ben bir bankaciyim, bu tehlikeli bölgelerdeki tek bankaci.

english: Well, now I know.
Knowledge is power my friend.
Cool, I'd like to access my bank account please.
translation: Harika, banka hesabima erismek istiyorum lütfen.

english: Right, so can I check my PIN settings?
translation: Peki, PIN ayarlarimi kontrol edebilir miyim?

english: I'd like to collect items.
Well, now I know.
Spicy kebabs!
Bat kebabs!
Spicy bat kebabs!
Bat shish kebabs!
Kebabs!
Ah, isn't it a lovely day?
translation: Ah, ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: It's not bad. What puts you in such a good mood?
translation: Fena degil. Seni bu kadar neseli yapan ne?

english: Oh, I just love my job. The smell of the sea breeze, the smell of the arctic pine sap, the smell of the yaks. I find it all so bracing.
translation: Oh, isimi cok seviyorum. Deniz esintisinin kokusu, kutup caminin özsuyunun kokusu, yaklarin kokusu. Hepsini cok canlandirici buluyorum.

english: Bracing? Hmmm. I think I might have chosen a different word.
translation: Canlandirici mi? Hmmm. Ben baska bir kelime secerdim galiba.

english: Haha welcome to my obstacle course. Have fun, but remember this isn't a child's playground. People have died here.
translation: Haha, engelli parkuruma hos geldin. Eglenmene bak, ama burasi cocuk oyun alani degil. Burada insanlar öldü.

english: The best way to train, is to go round the course in a clockwise direction.
translation: Egitim icin en iyi yol, parkuru saat yönünde dolasmaktir.

english: Please solve this for me. I have other things to be thinking about.
translation: Lütfen bunu benim icin cöz. Düsünmem gereken baska seyler var.

english: Gunnjorn has given you a puzzle box!
translation: Gunnjorn sana bir bulmaca kutusu verdi!

english: Sorry but you haven't solved the puzzle yet.
I don't have the puzzle box with me.
That's not much use is it, go and fetch it!
translation: Bu pek ise yaramaz, git ve onu getir!

english: Thanks [player name]!
What can I interest you in? We have something of everything here!
translation: Neye ilgi duyarsin? Burada her seyden biraz var!

english: Oh good!
Nothing, thanks.
Oh good!
Nothing, thanks.
Ah, you've come for fight!
What do you want?
What are you offering?
A fight!
You look funny!
Wanna fight?
Grrr!
Go away!
Hello!
Hello sir, it's Christmas!
Merry Christmas!
Hello Buoy and Gurl!
Hello sir!
How do you know our names?
I had a chat with your dad. He's super busy, so he's asked me to help you build a snowman!
translation: Babanizla konustum. Cok mesgul oldugu icin size kardan adam yapmaniza yardim etmemi istedi!

english: Really? We get to make a snowman?
translation: Gercekten mi? Kardan adam mi yapacagiz?

english: Yes! And I'm going to build whatever snowman you want!
translation: Evet! Ve istediginiz kardan adami yapacagim!

english: Yay! Can it be three snowballs tall?
translation: Yasasin! Üc kar topu yüksekliginde olabilir mi?

english: But I want it to be five tall!
translation: Ama ben bes yüksekliginde olsun istiyorum!

english: Five is a bad number, it should be three tall!
translation: Bes kötü bir sayi, üc yüksekliginde olmali!

english: You're a bad number. Five is so much better.
translation: Sen kötü bir sayisin. Bes cok daha iyi.

english: Okay, okay, wait a second. Why don't we meet in the middle. How about four snowballs tall?
translation: Tamam, tamam, bir saniye bekleyin. Neden ortada bulusmuyoruz? Dört kar topu yüksekliginde nasil olur?

english: Fine, it can be four tall.
Yes, four tall is okay.
Great. Now, we need to pick what size snowballs we want for each tier. Why don't you take it in turns? You can do two each.
translation: Harika. Simdi, her katman icin istedigimiz kar topu boyutunu secmemiz gerekiyor. Sirayla secmeye ne dersiniz? Her biri iki tane secebilir.

english: The bottom one should be a huge snowball!
translation: En alttaki büyük bir kar topu olmali!

english: The next one should be big!
This is working nicely, we're half way! What about the top two parts?
translation: Bu cok iyi gidiyor, yarisini bitirdik! En üstteki iki kisim ne olacak?

english: The next one should be a small snowball!
translation: Bir sonraki kücük bir kar topu olmali!

english: No, it should be little!
But it needs to be small, little would look bad.
translation: Ama kücük olmali, cok kücük olursa kötü görünür.

english: It wouldn't look bad. Small is better for decorations.
translation: Kötü görünmez. Dekorasyon icin kücük olan daha iyidir.

english: My decorations will fit on a little one.
Why do you always ruin everything?
You ruin everything with your silly ideas!
translation: Sen aptal fikirlerinle her seyi mahvediyorsun!

english: Okay, okay, wait. This clearly isn't working, and I don't want you two to fall out. It's Christmas, we shouldn't be arguing!
translation: Tamam, tamam, durun. Bu acikca ise yaramiyor ve ikinizin kavga etmesini istemiyorum. Noel'deyiz, kavga etmemeliyiz!

english: How about I make you both a snowman? It can be whatever height and size you like. One each!
translation: Ikinize de kardan adam yapmaya ne dersiniz? Istediginiz yükseklik ve boyutta olabilir. Her birinize bir tane!

english: So mine can be five snowballs tall?
translation: Benimki bes kar topu yüksekliginde olabilir mi?

english: And mine can be three snowballs tall?
translation: Benimki üc kar topu yüksekliginde olabilir mi?

english: Yes, I'll make you both whatever snowman you like!
translation: Evet, ikinize de istediginiz kardan adami yapacagim!

english: What would you both like?
I'd like mine to be three snowballs tall please! And I want the bottom one to be small, the middle one big, and the top one huge!
translation: Benimki üc kar topu yüksekliginde olsun lütfen! Ve altta kücük, ortada büyük, üstte kocaman olsun!

english: I'd like mine to be five snowballs tall please! I want the bottom one to be humongous, then large, then normal, then big, and then a little one for the top!
translation: Benimki bes kar topu yüksekliginde olsun lütfen! En alttaki devasa, sonra büyük, sonra normal, sonra büyük ve en üstte kücük olsun istiyorum!

english: That's two very different snowmen, I see why this didn't work before!
translation: Bunlar cok farkli iki kardan adam, neden daha önce ise yaramadigini anliyorum!

english: What do all these different sizes mean? Humongous? Normal? Little? How big are those?
translation: Bu farkli boyutlar ne anlama geliyor? Kocaman? Normal? Kücük? Bunlar ne kadar büyük?

english: You silly billy! Humongous is the biggest snowball of course!
translation: Seni sapsal! Kocaman tabii ki en büyük kar topu!

english: Normal is the normal size that you get when you make a snowball normally. It's easy!
translation: Normal, normal bir kar topu yaptiginda elde ettigin normal boyuttur. Cok kolay!

english: Right, thank you for clearing that up. I'll figure something out.
translation: Tamam, acikliga kavusturdugun icin tesekkürler. Bir seyler bulurum.

english: What are you two going to do for decorations?
translation: Siz ikiniz süslemeler icin ne yapacaksiniz?

english: I already know what I want mine to look like!
Me too!
Why don't you guys find some decorations while I build the snowmen? Then you can add them once I'm done.
translation: Ben kardan adamlari yaparken siz de süslemeler bulmaya ne dersiniz? Ben bitirince onlari ekleyebilirsiniz.

english: Okay sir!
We will do that!
Well, that seems sorted. I should speak to Larry again, and see if he has any advice about building the snowmen.
translation: Görünüse göre her sey halloldu. Larry ile tekrar konusup kardan adam yapma konusunda tavsiyesi var mi diye bakmaliyim.

english: Hello there!
Have you started making the snowmen yet?
You should talk to dad if you need some help, he knows how to make snowmen!
translation: Yardima ihtiyaciniz olursa babamla konusun, o kardan adam yapmayi bilir!

english: Yeah, he always used to make really big ones with us!
translation: Evet, eskiden bizimle birlikte cok büyük kardan adamlar yapardi!

english: Maybe I'll go talk to him and see what advice he has.
translation: Gidip onunla konusayim, ne tavsiye verecek bakalim.

english: He'll say, make them really tall!
He'll say make them shorter, because that's better!
translation: Daha kisa yapin diyecek, cünkü öyle daha iyi!

english: I should go and speak to Larry. I'm sure he has some handy advice for me!
translation: Gidip Larry ile konusmaliyim. Eminim bana yararli tavsiyeler verecektir!

english: That looks good! It needs a [size] snowball next!
translation: Güzel görünüyor! Simdi [boyut] büyüklügünde bir kartopu lazim!

english: They're done! They're so cool!
Yay! Can we decorate them now?
Yes! Can we decorate them now please [player name]?
translation: Evet! Simdi süsleyebilir miyiz lütfen Maceraci?

english: Of course you can. Are they what you wanted?
translation: Tabii ki süsleyebilirsiniz. Istediginiz gibi oldular mi?

english: Mine is perfect!
Mine too. It's just how I wanted it.
translation: Benimki de. Tam istedigim gibi oldu.

english: I am happy to hear that. It was harder work than I thought.
translation: Bunu duyduguma sevindim. Düsündügümden daha zor oldu.

english: You did a good job. Thank you very much [sir/madam].
translation: Iyi is cikardiniz. Cok tesekkür ederim .

english: Yes, thank you [sir/madam]!
It was no problem. Merry Christmas to you both!
translation: Önemli degil. Ikinize de mutlu Noeller!

english: I should go and speak to Larry. Hopefully he has that festive white wine ready for me.
translation: Gidip Larry ile konusmaliyim. Umarim benim icin o senlikli beyaz sarabi hazirlamistir.

english: Those snowmen look amazing!
Thank you! Decorating them was quite hard!
Yeah, they took ages to do! Do you like mine?
translation: Evet, yapmasi cok uzun sürdü! Benimkini begendin mi?

english: It's really good! Reminds me of something actually.
translation: Gercekten cok güzel! Aslinda bana bir seyi hatirlatiyor.

english: What about mine? Do you like it?
I like yours too. They both remind me of something!
translation: Seninkini de begendim. Ikisi de bana bir seyi hatirlatiyor!

english: Mine is Thermy! My favourite monster! She's so big and scary, makes me go woah!
translation: Benimki Thermy! En sevdigim canavar! O kadar büyük ve korkutucu ki, beni hayrete düsürüyor!

english: Mine is Tempy! My favourite monster! He lives in the water, a huge mass of angry wet!
translation: Benimki Tempy! En sevdigim canavar! Suda yasiyor, kocaman, öfkeli bir islaklik!

english: They're both amazing! I didn't know you guys would be so good at decorating.
translation: Ikisi de harika! Sizin süsleme konusunda bu kadar iyi oldugunuzu bilmiyordum.

english: Dad lets us decorate every year. We get a lot of practice!
translation: Babam her yil süslememize izin veriyor. Cok pratik yapiyoruz!

english: Last year we made them into the Fragment of Seren and the King Black Dragon!
translation: Gecen yil onlari Seren'in Parcasi ve Kral Kara Ejderha yaptik!

english: What... really??? I'd like to have seen that. Those sound even more difficult than these two!
translation: Ne... gercekten mi??? Onlari görmek isterdim. Bunlardan daha da zor görünüyorlar!

english: How do you know all these monsters anyway? There is no way your dad would let you anywhere near them!
translation: Bu canavarlari nereden taniyorsunuz ki? Babaniz sizi onlarin yanina yaklastirmaz ki!

english: Dad reads us lots of stories, and we hear about them from passing adventurers, like you.
translation: Babam bize bircok hikaye okur ve sizin gibi gecen maceracilardan da onlar hakkinda bilgiler aliriz.

english: You must meet some interesting and cool adventurers!
translation: Ilginc ve havali maceracilarla tanisiyor olmalisiniz!

english: Not as cool as you though; none of them helped us make our snowmen!
translation: Ama sizin kadar havali degiller; hicbiri bize kardan adam yapmamiza yardim etmedi!

english: Yes, you're the first to help us make them!
translation: Evet, bize yardim eden ilk kisi sizsiniz!

english: Well, you're welcome. I really enjoyed it. What are you guys going to do now you're finished?
translation: Rica ederim. Ben de cok eglendim. Simdi isiniz bittigine göre ne yapacaksiniz?

english: We're going to go and play! And maybe visit the festival. Will you be there?
translation: Oynamaya gidecegiz! Belki festivale de gideriz. Sen de orada olacak misin?

english: I sure will be. Maybe see you there!
translation: Tabii ki olacagim. Belki orada görüsürüz!

english: Bye sir, Merry Christmas.
Merry Christmas, have fun!
There's not much time left.
Maybe I'll... No, stupid idea Guss!
translation: Belki ben... Hayir, aptalca bir fikir Guss!

english: What am I going to do?
Are you okay?
Hmm, I wonder... I could use a hand with something actually.
translation: Hmm, acaba... Aslinda bir konuda yardimina ihtiyacim var.

english: Oh yeah? What exactly do you need help with?
translation: Öyle mi? Tam olarak ne konuda yardima ihtiyacin var?

english: You're willing to help? Great stuff.
I didn't say y-
The name is Guss, Guss Mistletoad. You see that portal over there?
translation: Adim Guss, Guss Mistletoad. Suradaki portali görüyor musun?

english: I see it.
That's the portal to The Nutcracker pub. It's been a dream of mine to get inside.
translation: O, Findikkiran pub'ina acilan portal. Iceri girmek benim hayalimdi.

english: I swear I didn't see that pub on my bar crawl card.
translation: Yemin ederim, bar turu kartimda o pub'i görmedim.

english: I've never seen this portal or heard of this pub before.
translation: Bu portali daha önce hic görmedim, bu pub'i da hic duymadim.

english: Why don't you just walk in?
Poor innocent Player, you can't just do that! It's Santa's prized pub, only a select few can enter.
translation: Zavalli masum Oyuncu, bunu yapamazsin! O, Noel Baba'nin degerli pub'i, sadece secilmis birkac kisi girebilir.

english: So what exactly are the criteria for entry?
translation: Peki, iceri girmek icin kriterler tam olarak nedir?

english: You have to win the Festive Games of course. It's a series of games to determine who is the most festive in the land.
translation: Tabii ki Festive Games'i kazanmalisin. Bu, ülkedeki en neseli kisinin kim oldugunu belirlemek icin yapilan bir dizi oyundur.

english: So you're familiar with these games?
Yes! But I'm not good at them. I can never get past the final. That's where I'm hoping you can help! Let's rig it.
translation: Evet! Ama bu oyunlarda iyi degilim. Asla finali gecemiyorum. Iste burada senin yardimina ihtiyacim var! Hile yapalim.

english: By 'rig the games' you mean I carry you through them?
translation: “Oyunlari hileli hale getirmek” derken, seni oyunlarda gecirmemi mi kastediyorsun?

english: Absolutely.
Shall we begin?
Sure, as long as you'll bring me some beer from the pub when you win.
translation: Tabii, kazandiginda bana pub'dan bira getirirsen.

english: If there's any left after I'm done!
No
How do we enter these games then?
translation: O zaman bu oyunlara nasil girecegiz?

english: First off we need to nab ourselves some game times from Santa.
translation: Öncelikle Noel Baba'dan oyun zamanlari almaliyiz.

english: You've got to do this Player, but be very vague as to why you need two entry times.
translation: Bunu sen yapmalisin Oyuncu, ama neden iki giris zamanina ihtiyacin oldugunu cok belirsiz bir sekilde söylemelisin.

english: Why do I need to be vague?
As I mentioned before, I've taken part in these games many times before. Failing every single time.
translation: Daha önce de söyledigim gibi, bu oyunlara daha önce bircok kez katildim. Her seferinde basarisiz oldum.

english: Let's say I'm not exactly on the nice list at the moment.
translation: Su anda pek de iyi bir durumda olmadigimi söyleyebiliriz.

english: I'll do my best.
Thanks Player, I'm so excited for an all-I-can-drink beer-fest.
translation: Tesekkürler Oyuncu, sinirsiz bira festivali icin cok heyecanliyim.

english: Tell me a bit about yourself, Guss.
What a lovely person you are Player! I do love a backstory!
translation: Ne kadar da sevimli birisin Oyuncu! Arka plan hikayelerini cok seviyorum!

english: Let's paint a picture for you...
It was a frosty morning in the month of Bennath, around twenty one years go...
translation: Yaklasik yirmi bir yil önce, Bennath ayinda soguk bir sabahti...

english: I'd just left my friend Doric's house after 'borrowing' some ore to take back to the mines.
translation: Arkadasim Doric'in evinden, madenlere götürmek icin biraz cevher “ödünc” aldiktan sonra cikmistim.

english: Off to work I go.. Hi ho, h-
No that's not right.
Anyway, I went to work and as you can probably tell, I work in the Dwarven Mines.
translation: Neyse, ise gittim ve tahmin edebileceginiz gibi, Cüce Madenlerinde calisiyorum.

english: One day I got really thirsty, I hadn't consumed an alcoholic beverage in over five minutes.
translation: Bir gün cok susadim, bes dakikadan fazla süredir alkollü icecek icmemistim.

english: I was getting reckless.
So I went out in search of the nearest pub.
translation: Bu yüzden en yakin pub'i aramaya ciktim.

english: For some unknown reason I saw this portal, same as you see it today.
translation: Bilinmeyen bir nedenden dolayi, bugün gördügünüz gibi bu portali gördüm.

english: It's the middle of Bennath, why does it look so Christmassy? I thought to myself.
translation: Burasi Bennath'in ortasi, neden bu kadar Noel havasinda görünüyor? diye düsündüm.

english: Turns out there'd been a mix up...
Long story short, I got chatting to Santa and he told me about the games and the amazing Nutcracker pub.
translation: Uzun lafin kisasi, Noel Baba ile sohbet ettim ve o bana oyunlardan ve muhtesem Nutcracker pub'indan bahsetti.

english: From that day on I was determined to gain access to this pub!
translation: O günden itibaren bu pub'a girmeye karar verdim!

english: So in a nutshell, you got thirsty and wanted to go to a pub?
translation: Yani kisacasi, susadin ve bir pub'a gitmek istedin?

english: Yup.
You know there is a pub just south-west of here? In Falador?
translation: Buranin güneybatisinda bir pub oldugunu biliyor musun? Falador'da?

english: Oh, there's one finite detail I missed out.
The Nutcracker has a FREE BAR!
Of course it has.
Some of the folk passing through felt a bit sorry for me after all these years, so they made me this cool jumper and hat to keep me warm.
translation: Yillar gectikten sonra, buradan gecen bazi insanlar bana biraz aciyarak, beni sicak tutmak icin bu havali kazak ve sapkayi yaptilar.

english: They do look great.
So you've done these games before Guss?
translation: Bu oyunlari daha önce de oynadin mi Guss?

english: That's correct, yeah.
This will be easy then. You can just tell me how to win each game.
translation: O zaman bu cok kolay olacak. Her oyunda nasil kazanilacagini bana anlatman yeterli.

english: Annoyingly, the games change every year.
translation: Ne yazik ki, oyunlar her yil degisiyor.

english: But I can tell you what I know.
Santa runs these games like a tournament. You win one, you move onto the next game.
translation: Noel Baba bu oyunlari bir turnuva gibi düzenliyor. Birini kazanirsan, bir sonraki oyuna gecersin.

english: There are two games total, and then the final!
translation: Toplamda iki oyun var, sonra da final!

english: What were the games like before? Were they hard?
For a small dwarf like me, the hardest thing I've ever played.
translation: Benim gibi kücük bir cüce icin, oynadigim en zor seydi.

english: But for you it'll be a piece of cake!
translation: Ama senin icin cocuk oyuncagi olacak!

english: Well, I hope so.
I better be off.
Bye Player!
Right, I've got two times for us.
translation: Tamam, bizim icin iki zaman var.

english: Amazing, Santa didn't suspect a thing?
translation: Inanilmaz, Noel Baba hicbir seyden süphelenmedi mi?

english: No, but you may have to re-home a few kittens.
translation: Hayir, ama birkac kedicigi baska bir eve yerlestirmek zorunda kalabilirsin.

english: Uhhh, I'm not s-
But that's not important right now.
translation: Ama su anda bu önemli degil.

english: Actually, there is a bit of a snag. Our times are different for entering the games.
translation: Aslinda, kücük bir sorun var. Oyunlara giris zamanlarimiz farkli.

english: Oh no, this can't be happening. That puts a right spanner in the works.
translation: Olamaz, bu olamaz. Bu isleri tamamen bozar.

english: Well, by the sounds of it you said it's a tournament format right?
translation: Anladigim kadariyla turnuva formatinda oldugunu söyledin, degil mi?

english: I did say that, yes.
So maybe everyone gets pulled in for one big final?
translation: O zaman belki herkes büyük finale kalir?

english: Of course! How silly of me, you'd have thought I would remember that after twenty one years of playing these games.
translation: Tabii ki! Ne aptalim, bu oyunlari yirmi bir yildir oynadiktan sonra bunu hatirlamam gerekirdi.

english: How confident are you in getting to the final?
translation: Finale kalma konusunda ne kadar eminsin?

english: Oh it's impossible for me.
What?!
Silly [player name], I'll cheat of course. I gave up my festive games morals long ago.
translation: Aptal Maceraci, tabii ki hile yapacagim. Bayram oyunlari ahlakini uzun zaman önce biraktim.

english: Suit yourself.
Looks like my time is first, so I'll hopefully see you in the final!
translation: Görünüse göre benim siram ilk, umarim finalde görüsürüz!

english: Good luck [player name] I've got snow doubts you'll do great!
translation: Iyi sanslar Maceraci, harika bir is cikaracagindan hic süphem yok!

english: Did you just-
Until we meet again!
So, this is the finale?
Yes indeed [player name].
Amazing job getting here so far by the way. I had absolute faith in you!
translation: Bu arada, buraya kadar gelmen harika bir basari. Sana sonsuz güvenim vardi!

english: This last game is a blood bath.
translation: Bu son oyun bir kan banyosu olacak.

english: How do you know so much about the final game, you haven't even played it yet?
translation: Henüz oynamadigin final oyunu hakkinda nasil bu kadar cok sey biliyorsun?

english: I may or may not have played all these games before, and just not told you.
translation: Bu oyunlarin hepsini daha önce oynamis olabilirim, ya da oynamamis olabilirim, sadece sana söylemedim.

english: Are you kidding me?
Nope. It might have put you off!
Ok, how does this game work then?
The aim of the game is to eliminate all the other players.
translation: Oyunun amaci diger tüm oyunculari elemek.

english: Do you see those snowball piles scattered about?
translation: Etrafa dagilmis kar topu yiginlarini görüyor musun?

english: Yeah, I think so.
Awesome, you'll want to stock up as many as you can. Then take no prisoners.
translation: Harika, mümkün oldugunca cok stoklamalisin. Sonra kimseyi esir almayin.

english: There will be two types of snowballs to gather. Both types do different damage.
translation: Toplayabileceginiz iki tür kar topu olacak. Her iki tür de farkli hasar veriyor.

english: Is that yellow sn-
Last player standing is the winner, it's simple really.
translation: Son kalan oyuncu kazanir, gercekten cok basit.

english: Let you win... Hmm.
Let's do this.
No.
I think I want to have a look around first.
Be quick! I can already taste that sweet nectar of the gods.
translation: Cabuk ol! Tanrilar nektarinin tatli tadini simdiden alabiliyorum.

english: We really sh'mashed that.
We did, but you did knock me out.
I knew they you in let.
Are you okay Guss? We only finished moments ago.
translation: Iyi misin Guss? Daha birkac dakika önce bitirdik.

english: Abshofruitly...
Guss loses focus on you entirely...
translation: Guss sana olan ilgisini tamamen kaybetti...

english: Your little dwarf friend knows this is all alcohol-free beer right [player name]?
translation: Kücük cüce arkadasin bunlarin hepsinin alkolsüz bira oldugunu biliyor, degil mi Maceraci?

english: Oh Guss...
Air Guss heading your way!
Gosh I'm so good!
Yes
How do we enter the games?
Where did you come from?
Can you tell me about the games?
Goodbye.
You dare disturb my rest!
You dare steal from us!
Hi, can I help you with anything today?
translation: Merhaba, bugün size yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: Yes, please. What are you selling?
No thanks.
Have a nice day.
Yes, please. What are you selling?
No thanks.
Hi.
Hello! What can I do for you today?
translation: Merhaba! Bugün sizin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: Who are you?
I'm Gwerin.
It's nice to meet you Gwerin, I'm [player name].
translation: Tanistigimiza memnun oldum Gwerin, ben Maceraci.

english: And it's great to meet you, [player name].
translation: Ben de tanistigimiza memnun oldum, Maceraci.

english: What do you do here?
I'm the village miller. I keep the wheat growing strong and turn it into flour.
translation: Ben köyün degirmencisiyim. Bugdayin güclü bir sekilde yetismesini sagliyor ve onu un haline getiriyorum.

english: Wonderful! This sure is an impressive mill.
translation: Harika! Bu gercekten etkileyici bir degirmen.

english: Thank you! I try to keep it clean. Feel free to use the mill whenever you please.
translation: Tesekkürler! Temiz tutmaya calisiyorum. Istedigin zaman degirmeni kullanabilirsin.

english: Was there anything else you wanted?
Bye!
Farewell, adventurer.
Who are you?
What do you do here?
Bye!
Hi.
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Isn't it wonderful? So many books, so much knowledge to be absorbed!
translation: Harika degil mi? Bu kadar cok kitap, ögrenilecek bu kadar cok bilgi!

english: You're right, it is.
Where did I see that book? It can't be far...
translation: O kitabi nerede görmüstüm? Uzakta olamaz...

english: Uh... Hello?
I'm sure it was around here somewhere...
Okay... Maybe later...
What can I do for ya?
Got any good books to recommend?
I've always found Prifddinas' History to be fascinating!
translation: Prifddinas'in Tarihi'ni her zaman büyüleyici bulmusumdur!

english: I've always found The Journal of Randas to be fascinating!
translation: Rendas'in Günlügü'nü her zaman büyüleyici bulmusumdur!

english: I've always found Big Book of Bangs to be fascinating!
translation: Büyük Patlama Kitabi'ni her zaman büyüleyici bulmusumdur!

english: I've always found The Great Divide to be fascinating!
translation: Büyük Bölünme'yi her zaman büyüleyici bulmusumdur!

english: I've always found Ode to Eternity to be fascinating!
translation: Sonsuzluga Övgü'yü her zaman büyüleyici bulmusumdur!

english: Thanks!
Nothing.
Got any good books to recommend?
translation: Önerdiginiz iyi bir kitap var mi?

english: Nothing.
Looking for a new pick? I've got the best you'll find around these parts!
translation: Yeni bir kitap mi ariyorsunuz? Bu civarda bulabileceginiz en iyisi bende!

english: Sure.
I'm okay, thanks.
Well, let everyone know! You can always find me here.
translation: Herkese haber verin! Beni her zaman burada bulabilirsiniz.

english: Sure.
I'm okay, thanks.
We are the righteous ones in his eyes alone.
translation: Sadece onun gözünde bizler dogru olanlariz.

english: Let them not infest our cities and towns...
translation: Sehirlerimizi ve kasabalarimizi istila etmelerine izin vermeyin...

english: And lo, we become the power, indeed the force to stop these monsters in their tracks.
translation: Ve iste, bizler bu canavarlari durduracak güc, hatta kuvvet haline geliyoruz.

english: Verily I urge you, my friends to take up your spades and farm your farms to feed our people in this blessed sanctuary.
translation: Gercekten, dostlarim, sizleri bu kutsal siginakta halkimizi beslemek icin küreklerinizi alip tarlalarinizi sürmeye cagiriyorum.

english: If thine monsters visage does frighten thee, then tear it off I say... tear it off!
translation: Eger canavarlarin yüzü sizi korkutuyorsa, o zaman onu parcalayin diyorum... parcalayin!

english: For Saradomin will guide our sword arms and smash the enemies of humans till their bones become dust.
translation: Cünkü Saradomin kiliclarimizi yönlendirecek ve insanlarin düsmanlarini kemikleri toz olana kadar parcalayacak.

english: And let us smite these monsters unto their deaths.
For they are not the chosen ones in Saradomin's eyes.
translation: Cünkü onlar Saradomin'in gözünde secilmis olanlar degiller.

english: Where do we go for safety from these monsters... here, with our brethren!
translation: Bu canavarlardan korunmak icin nereye gidelim... buraya, kardeslerimizin yanina!

english: And let there be no cave or shelter for their spawn until the end of days.
translation: Ve günlerin sonuna kadar onlarin yavrulari icin hicbir magara veya siginak kalmasin.

english: Hello, [brother/sister/friend], you fit in much better now that you're correctly attired. Before you stuck out like a sore thumb! Keep your eyes peeled though; I've heard there are thieves amongst us!
translation: Merhaba, kardesim, dogru giyindigin icin artik buraya cok daha iyi uyuyorsun. Önceden cok göze batiyordun! Ama gözlerini dört ac; aramizda hirsizlar oldugunu duydum!

english: What are all you people doing here?
Many of us disagree with the king about what freedoms the local monster population should have. We're taking a stand and mobilising our forces against the monstrous hordes.
translation: Cogumuz, yerel canavar nüfusunun sahip olmasi gereken özgürlükler konusunda kral ile ayni fikirde degiliz. Bir tavir aliyoruz ve canavar ordularina karsi güclerimizi seferber ediyoruz.

english: I'm totally in awe of Johanhus, he really knows what's what. I know he keeps going on about monsters and it's clear there are too many of them, so hey, I agree with whatever Johanhus says.
translation: Johanhus'a hayranim, o gercekten neyin ne oldugunu biliyor. Canavarlar hakkinda sürekli konusuyor ve onlarin sayisinin cok fazla oldugu acik, bu yüzden Johanhus ne derse ona katiliyorum.

english: We're against the monsters..like Johanhus says...we don't like them...you know.
translation: Canavarlara karsiyiz... Johanhus'un dedigi gibi... Onlari sevmiyoruz... Bilirsiniz.

english: Who are you and what do you do here?
I'm a strong believer in the non-monsters policy...we should really get rid of them...and if that means I have to live in a cave like a monster, so be it!
translation: Canavar karsiti politikaya güclü bir sekilde inaniyorum... Onlardan gercekten kurtulmaliyiz... Ve bu, bir canavar gibi magarada yasamak anlamina geliyorsa, öyle olsun!

english: What do you think you're going to achieve?
We want a world without monsters, to live in safety and without fear of being attacked by these ferocious beasts.
translation: Canavarlarin olmadigi, bu vahsi hayvanlarin saldirisindan korkmadan güvenle yasayabilecegimiz bir dünya istiyoruz.

english: But there aren't that many ferocious beasts in the towns and cities.
translation: Ama kasaba ve sehirlerde o kadar cok vahsi hayvan yok ki.

english: That's not enough, we want to get rid of them totally, we want to enjoy the surrounding lands and not worry about our children playing in caves and so on.
translation: Bu yeterli degil, onlardan tamamen kurtulmak istiyoruz, cevremizdeki topraklarin tadini cikarmak ve cocuklarimizin magaralarda oynamasindan endise duymamak istiyoruz.

english: Where did all you people come from?

Most of us came from small towns that had been attacked by monsters. We all got fed up with it and so decided to join this movement. We're hoping to return to the towns and cities when we've cleaned up the areas
translation: Cogumuz canavarlarin saldirisina ugramis kücük kasabalardan geldik. Hepimiz bundan biktik ve bu harekete katilmaya karar verdik. Bu canavarlarin yasadigi bölgeleri temizledikten sonra kasaba ve sehirlere dönmeyi umuyoruz.

english: that these monsters live in.
Ok, thanks.

Where did all you people come from?

translation: Kimsin sen ve burada ne yapiyorsun?

english: I'm a strong believer in the non-monsters policy...we should really get rid of them...and if that means I have to live in a cave like a monster, so be it!
translation: Canavar karsiti politikaya güclü bir sekilde inaniyorum... Onlardan gercekten kurtulmaliyiz... Ve bu, bir canavar gibi magarada yasamak anlamina geliyorsa, öyle olsun!

english: What do you think you're going to achieve?
We want a world without monsters, to live in safety and without fear of being attacked by these ferocious beasts.
translation: Canavarlarin olmadigi, bu vahsi hayvanlarin saldirisindan korkmadan güvenle yasayabilecegimiz bir dünya istiyoruz.

english: But there aren't that many ferocious beasts in the towns and cities.
translation: Ama kasaba ve sehirlerde o kadar cok vahsi hayvan yok.

english: That's not enough, we want to get rid of them totally, we want to enjoy the surrounding lands and not worry about our children playing in caves and so on.
translation: Bu yeterli degil, onlardan tamamen kurtulmak istiyoruz, cevremizdeki topraklarin tadini cikarmak ve cocuklarimizin magaralarda oynamasindan endise duymamak istiyoruz.

english: Where did all you people come from?

Most of us came from small towns that had been attacked by monsters. We all got fed up with it and so decided to join this movement. We're hoping to return to the towns and cities when we've cleaned up the areas
translation: Cogumuz canavarlarin saldirisina ugramis kücük kasabalardan geldik. Hepimiz bundan biktik ve bu harekete katilmaya karar verdik.

english: that these monsters live in.
translation: Bu canavarlarin yasadigi bölgeleri temizledikten sonra kasaba ve sehirlere dönmeyi umuyoruz.

english: Ok, thanks.
I hear you brother...
You speak the truth brother...
Well said brother...
What are all you people doing here?
Who are you and what do you do here?
What do you think you're going to achieve?
Where did all you people come from?
Ok, thanks.
Hello cat.
Meow!
One does not wish to be disturbed.
What?
Guard, who is this outlander?
This is [Fremennik name] your majesty.
Is this true? You are the outlander who has been given a Fremennik name?
translation: Bu dogru mu? Sen Fremennik adi verilen yabanci misin?

english: Indeed I am.
Excellent.
How may I assist your Highness?
Behave Hrafn!
I have a task that requires your unique-
translation: Senin essiz yetenegine ihtiyac duydugum bir görevim var...

english: Not now, Hrafn. Now where was I?
You mentioned a task requiring my unique-
translation: Senin essiz yetenegine ihtiyac duydugum bir görevden bahsetmistin...

english: Ah, yes. Your unique position among Fremennik-
translation: Ah, evet. Fremennikler arasindaki essiz konumun...

english: Hrafn! Oh, alright, alright, I give in.
Look, could you fetch my cat some fish? Then we can finish our conversation in peace.
translation: Bak, kedime biraz balik getirir misin? O zaman konusmamizi huzur icinde bitirebiliriz.

english: Yes, that's probably a good idea.
translation: Evet, bu muhtemelen iyi bir fikir.

english: Thank you. Hrafn will only eat raw tuna.
translation: Tesekkürler. Hrafn sadece cig ton baligi yer.

english: Will any raw tuna do?
translation: Herhangi bir cig ton baligi olur mu?

english: Yes, fussy though Hrafn is, he doesn't care where the tuna comes from. If you don't already have any, you can catch some down by the docks, or you can buy some from my fishmonger, Flosi Dalksson.
translation: Evet, Hrafn cok secici olsa da, ton baliginin nereden geldigi umurunda degil. Eger elinde yoksa, limanda biraz yakalayabilirsin ya da balikcim Flosi Dalksson'dan satin alabilirsin.

english: Hello again, [Fremennik name]. Do you have a piece of raw tuna for Hrafn?
translation: Merhaba tekrar, Dokrak. Hrafn icin cig ton baligi var mi?

english: Yes, I have your pet's fish.
translation: Evet, evcil hayvaniniz icin balik var.

english: You feed Hrafn the tuna.
Thanks [Fremennik name], you are the first person to stand up to the King's bullying in many a year. Maybe he learnt something today?
translation: Tesekkürler Dokrak, yillardir Kral'in zorbaligina karsi cikan ilk kisisiniz. Belki bugün bir seyler ögrenmistir?

english: We can but hope Thorkel.
translation: Umut etmekten baska caremiz yok Thorkel.

english: Fare thee well brave warrior, fare thee well.
translation: Iyi günler cesur savasci, iyi günler.

english: Purrrrz! (One wishes the tuna-bearing outlander well. One would prefer for him to stay.)
translation: Purrrrz! (Ton baligi getiren yabancinin iyi olmasini dileriz. Kalmasini tercih ederiz.)

english: Useless, disloyal cat.
Here you go, enjoy your fish.
What is the meaning of this serf? One specifically asked for RAW tuna, not fish defiled by human fire!
translation: Bu ne demek oluyor köle? Ben özellikle CIG ton baligi istedim, insan atesi ile kirletilmis balik degil!

english: Here you go. Enjoy your fish.
What is the meaning of this serf? How is one supposed to eat a piece of paper?
translation: Bu kölenin nesi var? Bir kagit parcasini nasil yiyebiliriz?

english: Here you go. enjoy your fish!
Purrrrrrrrrr (One is satisfied with the freshness of the tuna. The humans have acted satisfactorily in this matter.)
translation: Purrrrrrrrrr (Ton baliginin tazeliginden memnunum. Insanlar bu konuda tatmin edici davranmislar.)

english: Hopefully Hrafn won't disturb your discussion with the King now.
translation: Umarim Hrafn simdi Kral ile olan görüsmenizi rahatsiz etmez.

english: How's life now the curse has been lifted?
Much better thanks to you. We're all very impressed.
translation: Sizin sayenizde cok daha iyi. Hepimiz cok etkilendik.

english: Hello there.

Well hello, come in, come in, my name's Hadley, I'm head of tourism here. There's some of the most unspoilt wildlife and scenery in Gielinor here. People come from miles around to fish in the clear lakes or to wander the
translation: Merhaba, iceri gelin, iceri gelin, benim adim Hadley, burada turizm müdürüyüm. Gielinor'da en bozulmamis vahsi yasam ve manzaralar burada. Insanlar kilometrelerce öteden berrak göllerde balik tutmak veya

english: beautiful hillsides.
It is quite pretty.

Surely pretty is an understatement kind [sir/lady]. Beautiful, amazing or possibly life-changing would be more suitable wording. Have you seen Baxtorian Falls? Named after the elven king who was buried beneath
translation: Güzel demek yetersiz kalir . Güzel, muhtesem veya belki de hayat degistirici daha uygun ifadeler olurdu. Baxtorian Selalesi'ni gördünüz mü? Adini, altinda gömülü olan elf kralindan almistir.

english: them.
What happened to the elven king?

Baxtorian? I guess he died a long long time ago, it's quite sad really. After leaving his kingdom to deal with invading forces, Baxtorian returned to find his wife Glarial had been captured by the enemy.
translation: Baxtorian mi? Sanirim cok uzun zaman önce öldü, gercekten cok üzücü. Istilaci güclerle basa cikmak icin kralligini terk eden Baxtorian, geri döndügünde karisi Glarial'in düsman tarafindan esir alindigini ögrendi.

english: This destroyed Baxtorian, after years of searching he became a recluse. He went into the secret home he had made for Glarial under the waterfall and sealed himself in. To this day, no one has managed to enter.
translation: Bu, Baxtorian'i mahvetti, yillarca aradiktan sonra inzivaya cekildi. Glarial icin selalenin altinda yaptigi gizli eve girdi ve kendini oraya kapatti. Bugüne kadar kimse oraya giremedi.

english: Where else is worth visiting around here?
translation: Buralarda baska gezmeye deger yerler var mi?

english: Well, there's a wide variety of wildlife, although unfortunately most of it's quite dangerous. Please don't feed the goblins.
translation: Evet, cok cesitli vahsi hayvanlar var, ama ne yazik ki cogu oldukca tehlikeli. Lütfen goblinleri beslemeyin.

english: Okay.
There is a lovely spot for a picnic on the hill to the north east, there's a monument to the elven queen Glarial. It really is quite pretty.
translation: Kuzeydogudaki tepede piknik yapmak icin cok güzel bir yer var, orada elf kralicesi Glarial'in aniti var. Gercekten cok güzel.

english: I don't like nature, it gives me a rash!
That's just silly talk.
Thanks, goodbye.
Enjoy your visit.
Are you on holiday? If so you've come to the right place. I'm Hadley the tourist guide, anything you need to know just ask me. We have some of the most unspoilt wildlife and scenery in Gielinor.
translation: Tatilde misiniz? Öyleyse dogru yere geldiniz. Ben tur rehberi Hadley, bilmek istediginiz her seyi bana sorabilirsiniz. Gielinor'da en bozulmamis vahsi yasam ve manzaralardan bazilari burada.

english: People come from miles around to fish in the clear lakes or to wander the beautiful hillsides.
translation: Insanlar kilometrelerce öteden berrak göllerde balik tutmak veya güzel tepelerde dolasmak icin geliyorlar.

english: Surely pretty is an understatement kind [sir/lady]. Beautiful, amazing or possibly life-changing would be more suitable wording. Have you seen Baxtorian Falls? Named after the elven king who was buried beneath them.
translation: Güzel demek yetersiz kalir . Muhtesem, harika veya belki de hayat degistirici daha uygun ifadeler olurdu. Baxtorian Selalesi'ni gördünüz mü? Adini, altinda gömülü olan elf kralindan almistir.

english: Can you tell me what happened to the elven king?
translation: Elf kralina ne oldugunu anlatabilir misiniz?

english: Anyway, I believe we have a book on him upstairs if you want to learn more.
translation: Her neyse, daha fazla bilgi edinmek isterseniz, üst katta onunla ilgili bir kitap var.

english: Who was Glarial?
Baxtorian's wife, the only other person who could also enter the waterfall apart from him. She was queen when this land was inhabited by elven kind.
translation: Baxtorian'in karisi, ondan baska selaleye girebilen tek kisi. Bu topraklar elfler tarafindan iskan edildiginde kraliceydi.

english: Glarial was kidnapped while Baxtorian was away, but they eventually recovered her body and brought her home to rest.
translation: Glarial, Baxtorian uzaktayken kacirildi, ama sonunda cesedini bulup eve getirip defnettiler.

english: That's sad.
True, I believe we have a book on Baxtorian and Glarial upstairs if you want to learn more.
translation: Dogru, daha fazla bilgi edinmek isterseniz, üst katta Baxtorian ve Glarial hakkinda bir kitap var.

english: Is there treasure under the waterfall?
Ha ha... Another treasure hunter. Well if there is no one's been able to get to it. They've been searching that river for decades, all to no avail.
translation: Ha ha... Bir hazine avcisi daha. Eger varsa, kimse onu bulamamis. Onlarca yildir o nehri ariyorlar, ama sonuc alamadilar.

english: I don't suppose you know anything about some kind of diamond nearby here, do you?
translation: Buralarda bir tür elmas hakkinda bir sey biliyor musunuz?

english: I am afraid not [Sir/Madam]. But isn't our waterfall very pretty?
translation: Korkarim ki hayir efendim. Ama selalemizin cok güzel oldugunu düsünmüyor musunuz?

english: Um... yeah, I guess.
There was a very scruffy looking merchant in here the other day, perhaps he might have the item you are looking for?
translation: Gecen gün burada cok daginik görünümlü bir tüccar vardi, belki aradiginiz seyi onda bulabilirsiniz?

english: I don't suppose you've ever heard of someone named Damis, have you?
translation: Damis adinda birini duymuslugunuz yok, degil mi?

english: I heard a rumour many years ago, that there was a warrior by that name who had a secret hideout somewhere in these parts, but I have never seen it myself.
translation: Yillar önce, bu civarda gizli bir siginagi olan bu isimde bir savasci oldugu söylentisini duymustum, ama ben hic görmedim.

english: And why would you be looking for such a criminal element when you could be admiring the tranquil beauty of the waterfall, anyway?
translation: Zaten selalenin huzurlu güzelligini hayranlikla seyredebilirken neden böyle bir sucluyu ariyorsun ki?

english: Tell me, I have reason to believe there is some kind of invisible hideout nearby... As a tourist guide, you might have heard someone mention it before...?
translation: Söylesene, yakinlarda görünmez bir siginak olduguna inanmam icin nedenlerim var... Turist rehberi olarak, daha önce birinin bundan bahsettigini duymus olabilirsin...?

english: You're asking me if I've seen something invisible? How ridiculous.
translation: Bana görünmez bir sey görüp görmedigimi mi soruyorsun? Ne sacma.

english: Anything out of the ordinary then?
translation: O zaman sira disi bir sey gördün mü?

english: Hmmm... Well, we did have a report of a young couplespicnic being interrupted when a skeleton mysteriously appeared out of thin air...
translation: Hmmm... Sey, genc bir ciftin piknigi, bir iskeletin gizemli bir sekilde ortaya cikmasiyla kesintiye ugradigina dair bir rapor aldik...

english: And where was this?
At the picnic tables just east of here. We investigated of course, this kind of thing is bad for tourism, but could find no evidence of their claims.
translation: Buranin dogusundaki piknik masalarinda. Tabii ki arastirdik, bu tür seyler turizm icin kötü, ama iddialarinin kanitini bulamadik.

english: Thank you very much, you have been most helpful.
translation: Cok tesekkür ederim, cok yardimci oldun.

english: Did you find your mysterious invisible hideout then?
translation: Gizemli görünmez siginagini buldun mu peki?

english: Yes, actually I did. Thanks for the help!
translation: Evet, aslinda buldum. Yardimin icin tesekkürler!

english: What happened to the elven king?
Where else is worth visiting around here?
translation: Buralarda gezmeye deger baska yerler var mi?

english: I don't like nature, it gives me a rash!
Thanks, goodbye.
Can you tell me what happened to the elven king?
translation: Elf kralina ne oldugunu söyleyebilir misin?

english: Is there treasure under the waterfall?
Ask about Desert Treasure Quest
What are you doing in our home?
I just came to ask you a question.
Hegir, why did you let this human into our home?
translation: Hegir, bu insani evimize neden aldin?

english: I didn't let him in, he let himself in!
Now what do you want, human? Speak up, speak up!
I ehm, just wanted some information.
translation: Ben, sey, sadece biraz bilgi almak istedim.

english: Well go ask someone else instead of barging into people's homes!
translation: O zaman baskasina sor, insanlarin evlerine dalmak yerine!

english: There's no need to be rude to the human, Haera dear.
translation: Insana kaba davranmana gerek yok, Haera canim.

english: Now don't you dear me. I'll do whatever I please.
translation: Bana canim deme. Ne istersem onu yaparim.

english: I think this is my cue to leave...
That's the last straw!
Do your chores!
Useless... completely useless.
Don't talk to me like that!
You're no good!
I'm warning you, Hegir!
I don't know what you think you are doing here human, but I do know that you will not live long enough to leave this place.
translation: Burada ne yaptigini bilmiyorum insan, ama buradan cikacak kadar uzun yasamayacagini biliyorum.

english: Welcome to the temple of Marimbo, child. In less busy times I would bless you, but I have not the luxury of free time at the moment.
translation: Marimbo tapinagina hos geldin, cocuk. Daha sakin zamanlarda seni kutsardim, ama su anda bos vaktim yok.

english: However, feel free to stay here as long as you need.
Thank you.
Shaz berith an-gor f-
Hello!
Shaz berith an-gor fo gah-
Hey!
Shaz. Berith. An-
Can you hear me?
What?! What do you want?
I just wanted to say hello. I didn't expect to find anyone here.
translation: Sadece merhaba demek istedim. Burada kimseyi bulmayi beklemiyordum.

english: Well, you found me. I'm here. And I was just in the middle of a very important conversation!
translation: Beni buldun. Buradayim. Ve cok önemli bir konusmanin ortasindaydim!

english: With who? There's no one else here...
With Hagus.
Who's Hagus?
I'm Hagus!
Right...
Whoa, no need to be rude.
You just interrupted a very important conversation!
What is this place?
Why should I tell you? You could be one of them.
translation: Neden sana söyleyeyim? Sen de onlardan biri olabilirsin.

english: One of them? What are you talking about?
An abyssal creature, of course!
Last time I checked I was not an abyssal creature.
translation: Son baktigimda ben bir abyssal yaratik degildim.

english: Hmph. We'll see about that.
So will you tell me where we are?
This is the Abyss.
I know that. Though I've never been to this part of it before.
translation: Biliyorum. Ama bu kismina daha önce hic gelmemistim.

english: Have you heard of the Scar?
Well yes, I just came through there-
Well then you know where we are.
What is that thing over there?
That's Ventriculus.
Ventriculus? That thing has a name?
translation: Ventriculus mu? O seyin bir adi mi var?

english: Yes, it's my friend.
I... I can't tell if you're joking or not.
Ventriculus is an extractor. Feed it and you'll see.
translation: Ventriculus bir cikaricidir. Onu besle, göreceksin.

english: Feed it?
Yes. Just put your arm in.
That doesn't sound safe.
It likes the tainted essence you can find in here.
A pickaxe can help you split off the essence from the amalgamations.
translation: Bir kazma, özü birlesimlerden ayirmana yardimci olabilir.

english: Right... So I mine tainted essence from amalgamations, then feed it to this Ventriculus.
translation: Tamam... Yani karisimlardan kirli özü cikarip bunu Ventriculus'a besleyecegim.

english: But why should I do that?
Remember how I said it's an extractor?
translation: Bunun bir cikarici oldugunu söyledigimi hatirliyor musun?

english: Ventriculus will remove excess parts from the essence, chew it up a little, and spit out the rest.
translation: Ventriculus özden fazla kisimlari cikarir, biraz cigner ve geri kalanini disari atar.

english: So you're saying it refines the essence?
Yes, it can refine it into pure essence. However, it can also give you extracts.
translation: Evet, onu saf öz haline getirebilir. Ancak sana özler de verebilir.

english: What is an 'extract'?
Extracts are powerful, condensed runes. They function as catalysts to make more runes.
translation: Özler, güclü, yogunlastirilmis rünlerdir. Daha fazla rün yapmak icin katalizör görevi görürler.

english: Make more runes? How exactly does that work?
translation: Daha fazla rün mü? Bu tam olarak nasil oluyor?

english: If you bring an extract when you runecraft, it multiplies the amount of runes you make.
translation: Rün yaparken bir öz getirirsen, yaptigin rünlerin miktarini katlar.

english: That's neat! I can make so much money from selling these runes!
translation: Harika! Bu rünleri satarak cok para kazanabilirim!

english: Now hold on. I didn't say this was free.
translation: Dur biraz. Bunun bedava oldugunu söylemedim.

english: Ah... I suppose that makes sense.
I don't care about pure essence. You can extract as much as you want of that.
translation: Saf öz umurumda degil. Ondan istedigin kadar özütleyebilirsin.

english: But for extracts, you've got to pay up. There's a coffer over there. Leave some money and I'll charge you for the extract you want.
translation: Ama özütler icin para ödemen gerekir. Surada bir sandik var. Biraz para birak, istedigin özüt icin ücretini alirim.

english: Can you explain the Ventriculus again?
Ventriculus is an extractor. You can feed it essence from the amalgamations here.
translation: Ventriculus bir özütleyicidir. Buradaki birlesimlerden ona öz besleyebilirsin.

english: Once fed, it churns away, picking apart the essence, leftover runes and flesh.
translation: Beslendikten sonra, özü, kalan rünleri ve eti ayirarak calkalar.

english: The final product is either pure essence or dense rune extracts.
translation: Nihai ürün ya saf öz ya da yogun rün özleridir.

english: And how do the extracts work?
Extracts function as catalysts to make more runes.
translation: Özler, daha fazla rün yapmak icin katalizör görevi görür.

english: However, extracts are valuable. I'll demand some payment for those.
translation: Ancak özler degerlidir. Onlar icin bir miktar ödeme talep edecegim.

english: Thanks for explaining.
What are you doing here?
I'm hanging out with my friend.
The... Ventriculus? It's really your friend?
It's helping me search for knowledge on powerful runes.
translation: Güclü runlar hakkinda bilgi aramama yardim ediyor.

english: I guess you could just... not answer my question.
translation: Sanirim soruma cevap vermemeyi tercih edersin.

english: Hagus' eyes peer at the Ventriculus.
We heard rumours of a strong one... but the altar was nowhere to be found.
translation: Güclü bir tanesinin oldugu söylentilerini duymustuk... ama sunak hicbir yerde bulunamadi.

english: You're not really talking to me at all, are you.
translation: Sen benimle hic konusmuyorsun, degil mi?

english: Herbert, Finnigan and I... We were all assigned important missions. I must fulfill mine.
translation: Herbert, Finnigan ve ben... Hepimize önemli görevler verildi. Benim görevimi yerine getirmeliyim.

english: What mission? Who's Finnigan?
Hagus snaps out of it.
Ah, where were we. Did you feed Ventriculus yet? We need more-
translation: Ah, nerede kalmistik. Ventriculus'a yemek verdin mi? Daha fazlasina ihtiyacimiz var...

english: I mean. I'm sure you'd like some extracts.
Can you tell me more about yourself?
translation: Bana kendinden biraz daha bahseder misin?

english: My name is Hagus.
Yes... So you've said. Where are you from?
My upbringing is none of your concern.
I don't mean to pry. I just thought I'd get to know you a little bit.
translation: Merak ettigimden degil. Sadece seni biraz tanimak istedim.

english: How long have you been in here?
Many years. Years. Time... Yes, time. It's time I showed them. I need to find the rune.
translation: Yillardir. Yillar. Zaman... Evet, zaman. Onlara gösterme zamani geldi. Rünü bulmam lazim.

english: Rune? What rune?
Unless you're a member of the Institute, I cannot share that with you.
translation: Enstitünün üyesi degilsen, bunu seninle paylasamam.

english: Never mind. Goodbye.
Hagus walks away, chanting to himself.
Leave me alone. I'm not interested in whatever you have to show me.
translation: Beni rahat birak. Bana gösterecegin seylerle ilgilenmiyorum.

english: That's the one! Where did you find this?
Wrath runes? There are several sources, really. You can-
translation: Öfke runeleri mi? Aslinda birkac kaynagi var. Sen...

english: They exist! I knew it!
Now, tell me, where does it come from? Where's the altar?
translation: Simdi söyle bana, nereden geliyor? Sunak nerede?

english: I must have one. To study it. Can I have it?
translation: Bana bir tane lazim. Incelemek icin. Alabilir miyim?

english: Well...
Sure, here you go.
It's real! This changes everything!
Happy to help.
No, I think I'll keep it myself.
Hand it over! I need it.
No means no.
Grrr! Fine. But I urge you to reconsider.
translation: Grrr! Tamam. Ama tekrar düsünmeni tavsiye ederim.

english: Another wrath rune! Can I have it?
translation: Bir baska öfke runesi! Alabilir miyim?

english: Sure. Here you go.
Another one! Haha! The others won't believe this!
translation: Bir tane daha! Haha! Digerleri buna inanmayacak!

english: You're welcome.
Yes! More. More wrath runes for my collection. Can I have it?
translation: Evet! Daha fazla. Koleksiyonum icin daha fazla öfke runesi. Alabilir miyim?

english: My spells will be so powerful now!
Another wrath rune? For me? Don't mind if I do!
translation: Bir baska öfke runesi mi? Benim icin mi? Alabilir miyim?

english: And they said it couldn't be done. That there was no such thing!
translation: Ve bunun imkansiz oldugunu söylediler. Böyle bir seyin olmadigini!

english: The power of these runes... It's drawing me in... And I love it! May I have it?
translation: Bu rünlerin gücü... Beni icine cekiyor... Ve buna bayiliyorum! Alabilir miyim?

english: Go fetch more!
For me? You shouldn't have.
Unlimited power!
You know what? I don't need more wrath runes... Ah who am I kidding.
translation: Biliyor musun? Daha fazla öfke runesine ihtiyacim yok... Ah, kimi kandiriyorum.

english: There's never enough wrath runes!
I can't hold more wrath runes.
I must thank you, friend. You've been a strong supporter of the cause.
translation: Sana tesekkür etmeliyim dostum. Bu davaya güclü bir destek oldun.

english: I can now return and take my rightful place.
translation: Artik geri dönüp hak ettigim yeri alabilirim.

english: Happy to help! I think...

english: A bark? Is there a dog here?
translation: Havlama mi? Burada köpek mi var?

english: There is, sometimes...
It always wakes me up with its barking.
It seems to come and go. I can't figure out why or how.
translation: Gelip gidiyor gibi görünüyor. Neden ve nasil oldugunu anlayamiyorum.

english: That is indeed strange. I'll keep an eye out for it.
translation: Bu gercekten garip. Gözüm üzerinde olacak.

english: There it is again, did you hear it?
I can't say I did.
Maybe I'm imagining it.
Hannibal settles back down and is sleeping in moments.
translation: Hannibal tekrar uzanir ve birkac saniye icinde uykuya dalar.

english: Hi [player name].
How are you doing?
I'm okay, thank you. I've been enjoying the piano playing. Was it you playing earlier?
translation: Iyiyim, tesekkürler. Piyano calmayi cok seviyorum. Az önce calan sen miydin?

english: Oh, that wasn't me.
Must have been Gem then. She often plays the piano when she thinks nobody is listening.
translation: O zaman Gem olmali. Kimse dinlemedigini düsündügünde sik sik piyano calar.

english: She's actually quite good.
I'll have to keep an ear out.
Hannibal stretches and goes back to sleep.
translation: Hannibal esner ve tekrar uykuya dalar.

english: Hi there, [player name].
I have another question for you, if that is okay?
translation: Sana bir sorum daha var, sakincasi yoksa?

english: Go ahead.
Do you ever leave the hall? I've only ever seen you in here.
translation: Hic salondan cikiyor musun? Seni sadece burada gördüm.

english: I do sometimes. If I do go out, it's normally at night.
translation: Bazen cikiyorum. Cikarsam da genellikle geceleri olur.

english: I much prefer it in here though. Nice and warm with good food. There is even a bank, if I ever needed a bank for anything.
translation: Ama ben burayi cok daha fazla seviyorum. Güzel ve sicak, iyi yemekler var. Hatta bir banka bile var, eger bir seye ihtiyacim olursa.

english: That's fair enough. The world can be a pretty scary place out there anyway.
translation: Haklisin. Disarisi oldukca korkutucu bir yer olabilir.

english: Exactly. It's much nicer to relax here, even with the occasional adventurer disturbing me.
translation: Aynen öyle. Bazen maceracilar beni rahatsiz etse de, burada dinlenmek cok daha güzel.

english: That'll be me! Sorry, I'll let you get back to sleep.
translation: O benim! Üzgünüm, uyumana devam et.

english: Hannibal goes back to sleep, enjoying the warmth of the fire.
translation: Hannibal atesin sicakliginin tadini cikararak tekrar uykuya dalar.

english: You pet Hannibal...
He lets out a quiet purr before going back to resting.
translation: O da sessizce mirildanir ve tekrar uykuya dalar.

english: You scratch Hannibal behind the ears...
He purrs contentedly before going back to sleep.
translation: O da memnuniyetle mirildanir ve tekrar uykuya dalar.

english: I should give him some fish from my inventory!
Dialogue 1
Dialogue 2
Dialogue 3
Hannibal gobbles up the fish, then settles back down to rest.
translation: Hannibal baligi yutar, sonra tekrar dinlenmek icin uzanir.

english: Thank you [player name]. That's very tasty, though it would be even more tasty if it was cooked.
translation: Tesekkürler Maceraci. Cok lezzetli, ama pisirilseydi daha da lezzetli olurdu.

english: You prefer cooked food?
I do. Why do you think I'm in the kitchen? All this lovely food being cooked all the time!
translation: Evet. Neden mutfakta oldugumu saniyorsun? Bütün bu lezzetli yemekler sürekli pisiriliyor!

english: That is a good point. I will see if I can find you something cooked.
translation: Haklisin. Sana pismis bir seyler bulmaya calisacagim.

english: I look forward to it. You know where to find me.
translation: Sabirsizlikla bekliyorum. Beni nerede bulacagini biliyorsun.

english: Hannibal settles back down to sleep.
Thank you [player name]. That was lovely! Do you have any more?
translation: Tesekkürler Maceraci. Cok lezzetliydi! Baska var mi?

english: You just ate the entire thing, and you're still hungry?
translation: Hepsini yedin ve hala ac misin?

english: Sleeping is hungry work.
I do often wake up hungry, maybe you're on to something.
translation: Sik sik ac uyanirim, belki de haklisin.

english: I'll see if I can find you something else.
translation: Sana baska bir sey bulmaya calisayim.

english: Lovely, I'll be right here, working hard.
translation: Harika, ben burada calismaya devam edecegim.

english: Hello. What are you doing here?
I'm looking for whoever is in charge of this place.
Who, the Duke? He's in his study, on the first floor.
translation: Kim, Dük mü? Calisma odasinda, birinci katta.

english: I have come to kill everyone in this castle!
Hans runs away from the player screaming
Help! Help!
I don't know. I'm lost. Where am I?
You are in Lumbridge Castle.
Can you tell me how long I've been here?
translation: Ne kadar süredir buradayim, söyleyebilir misin?

english: Ahh, I see all the newcomers arriving in Lumbridge, fresh-faced and eager for adventure. I remember you...
translation: Ahh, Lumbridge'e gelen tüm yeni gelenleri görüyorum, yüzleri taze ve macera dolu. Seni hatirliyorum...

english: You've spent [amount] days, [amount] hours, [amount] minutes in the world since you arrived [amount] days ago.
Nothing.
Hiya.
Oooh! Who are you?
I'm a brave knight! I am coming to kill anyone in the vicinity of Lumbridge Castle!
translation: Ben cesur bir sövalyeyim! Lumbridge Kalesi cevresindeki herkesi öldürmeye geldim!

english: Aaaaargh! Run away, run away!
Hehe. Fool!
Hans! Hans! You've been walking around this courtyard since we were two dimensional, have you seen the Gnome Child's hat? He has lost it.
translation: Hans! Hans! Biz iki boyutluyken beri bu avluda dolasiyorsun, Gnome Cocugunun sapkasini gördün mü? Kaybetmis.

english: Ummm... a little green hat? Yes, a seagull picked it up and flew off.
translation: Ummm... kücük yesil bir sapka mi? Evet, bir marti onu alip uctu.

english: Really? A seagull picked up a hat? Can they do that?
translation: Gercekten mi? Bir marti sapka mi aldi? Bunu yapabilirler mi?

english: So it seems! I'm afraid I didn't happen to see which way it went.
translation: Öyle görünüyor! Ne yazik ki hangi yöne gittigini görmedim.

english: I should probably go somewhere that Hans might actually see me.
translation: Hans'in beni görebilecegi bir yere gitmeliyim.

english: You place the chair on the ground and wait for Hans to notice you...
translation: Sandalyeyi yere koyup Hans'in seni fark etmesini bekliyorsun...

english: Oh my aching feet! A chair! Just what I've been needing! I'm going to go sit by the fountain, so pretty this time of year.
translation: Ayaklarim agriyor! Bir sandalye! Tam da ihtiyacim olan sey! Bu mevsimde cok güzel olan cesmenin yanina oturmaya gidiyorum.

english: Hans takes the chair and teleports away with it.
translation: Hans sandalyeyi alir ve onunla birlikte teleport olur.

english: I think he hasn't sat down for a while!
Well done.
You've [found a new clue/obtained a casket]!
translation: Yeni bir ipucu buldun/bir kutu elde ettin!

english: Well done, here you go.
Hey Hans, you look like you're enjoying the party!
translation: Hey Hans, partiden keyif aliyor gibisin!

english: Of course *hic* I love a good *hic* party.
translation: Tabii ki *hic* Iyi bir *hic* partiyi severim.

english: I have a *hic* great party trick *hic*
translation: Benim *hic* harika bir parti numaram var *hic*

english: Does it include guessing my age?
translation: Bu numara benim yasimi tahmin etmeyi de iceriyor mu?

english: Exactly *burp* that!
You've probably spent *hic* [amount] days, [amount] hours, [amount] minutes in the world since you arrived [amount] days ago.
I'm looking for whoever is in charge of this place.
I have come to kill everyone in this castle!
I don't know. I'm lost. Where am I?
Can you tell me how long I've been here?
translation: Ne kadar süredir buradayim, söyleyebilir misin?

english: Nothing.
Gnomechild's missing hat.
Talk about something else.
Hello there.
Hello.
Who are you?
My name is Hari.
And what are you doing here Hari?
translation: Peki burada ne isin var Hari?

english: Like most people who come to Edgeville, I am here to seek adventure in the Wilderness.
translation: Edgeville'e gelen cogu insan gibi, ben de Wilderness'ta macera aramak icin buradayim.

english: I found a secret underground river that will take me quite a long way north.
translation: Beni kuzeye oldukca uzun bir yol götürecek gizli bir yeralti nehri buldum.

english: Underground river? Where does it come out?
It comes out in a pond located deep in the Wilderness.
translation: Wilderness'in derinliklerinde bulunan bir göle cikiyor.

english: I had to find a very special type of canoe to get me up the river though, would you like to know more?
translation: Nehrin yukarisina cikmak icin cok özel bir kano bulmam gerekti, daha fazla bilgi ister misin?

english: Could you teach me about canoes?
translation: Bana kanolar hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Well, you don't look like you have the skill to make a canoe.
translation: Sey, kano yapma becerisine sahip gibi görünmüyorsun.

english: You need to have at least level 12 woodcutting.
translation: En az 12. seviye odun kesme becerisine sahip olmalisin.

english: Once you are able to make a canoe it makes travel along the river much quicker!
translation: Kano yapmayi ögrendikten sonra nehirde cok daha hizli seyahat edebilirsin!

english: It's really quite simple. Just walk down to that tree on the bank and chop it down.
translation: Gercekten cok basit. Kiyida bulunan agaca dogru yürü ve onu kes.

english: When you have done that you can shape the log further with your axe to make a canoe.
translation: Bunu yaptiktan sonra, baltanla kütügü daha da sekillendirerek kano yapabilirsin.

english: I can sense you're still a novice woodcutter, you will only be able to make a log canoe at present.
translation: Hala acemi bir oduncu oldugunu hissediyorum, su anda sadece kütük kano yapabilirsin.

english: Is that good?
A log will take you one stop along the river. But you won't be able to travel into the Wilderness on it.
translation: Bir kütük sizi nehir boyunca bir durak ileri götürür. Ancak onunla Wilderness'ya seyahat edemezsiniz.

english: You are an average woodcutter. You should be able to make a Dugout canoe quite easily. It will take you 2 stops along the river.
translation: Siz ortalama bir oduncuysunuz. Bir kano oldukca kolay bir sekilde yapabilirsiniz. Bu sizi nehir boyunca 2 durak ileri götürür.

english: Can I take a dugout canoe to reach the Wilderness?
translation: Wilderness'ya ulasmak icin kano kullanabilir miyim?

english: You would never make it there alive.
Best not to try then.
You seem to be an accomplished woodcutter. You will easily be able to make a Stable Dugout
translation: Sen yetenekli bir oduncuya benziyorsun. Stable Dugout'u kolayca yapabilirsin.

english: They are reliable enough to get you anywhere on this river, except to the Wilderness of course.
translation: Bu nehirde seni herhangi bir yere götürebilecek kadar güvenilirdir, tabii ki Wilderness haric.

english: Only a Waka can take you there.
translation: Seni oraya sadece bir Waka götürebilir.

english: A Waka? What's that?
Come and ask me when you have improved your skills as a woodcutter.
translation: Oduncu becerilerini gelistirdiginde gel ve bana sor.

english: Your skills rival mine friend. You will certainly be able to build a Waka.
translation: Becerilerin benimkilerle yarisir dostum. Kesinlikle bir Waka yapabilirsin.

english: A Waka is an invention of my people, it's an incredible strong and fast canoe and will carry you safely to any destination on the river.
translation: Waka, halkimin icadidir, inanilmaz derecede güclü ve hizli bir kano ve seni nehrin herhangi bir noktasina güvenle götürür.

english: Any destination?
Yes, you can take a waka north through the underground portion of this river.
translation: Evet, bu nehrin yeralti kismindan kuzeye dogru bir waka ile gidebilirsin.

english: It will bring you out at a pond in the heart of the Wilderness. Be careful up there, many have lost more than their lives in that dark and twisted place.
translation: Seni Wilderness'nin kalbindeki bir göle cikarir. Orada dikkatli ol, bircok kisi o karanlik ve dolambacli yerde hayatlarindan fazlasini kaybetti.

english: No thanks, not right now.
Who are you?
Yes
No
Can you teach me about Canoeing?
Welcome, Effendi!
Hello!
Can I go in?
Come now Effendi, to pass you must tell me a story, one of grand heroics!
translation: Hadi ama Effendi, gecmek icin bana bir hikaye anlatmalisin, büyük bir kahramanlik hikayesi!

english: You tell the tale of how you bested a goblin, it lacks heroics and sounds more like senseless murder.
translation: Bir goblini nasil yendigini anlattigin hikaye, kahramanlik icermiyor ve daha cok anlamsiz bir cinayet gibi geliyor.

english: You thought that was a story of heroics?! Come back when you have something worth telling.
translation: Bunun kahramanlik hikayesi oldugunu mu düsündün?! Anlatmaya deger bir seyin oldugunda geri gel.

english: To gain entrance to the resource area, you must first complete the quest 'Dragon Slayer'.
translation: Kaynak alanina girmek icin önce “Ejderha Katili” görevini tamamlamalisin.

english: You tell the tale of how you bested the legendary dragon Elvarg in combat.
translation: Efsanevi ejderha Elvarg'i savasta nasil yendigini anlat.

english: ...And then I cut her head off, so as to make sure she was dead!
translation: ...Ve sonra öldügünden emin olmak icin kafasini kestim!

english: Amazing! A story well worth telling! Please Effendi, enter at your leisure.
translation: Harika! Anlatmaya deger bir hikaye! Lütfen Efendi, istedigin zaman gir.

english: Of course Effendi! You have proved yourself worthy!
Who are you?
Me? I am Haris! Owner of the area north of here, it is has great resources, I assure you.
translation: Ben mi? Ben Haris! Buradan kuzeydeki bölgenin sahibiyim, cok zengin kaynaklari var, emin olun.

english: You own the land? Who did you buy it from?
translation: Bu topraklar sizin mi? Kimden satin aldiniz?

english: Buy? Oh no no no. Do you see this sword, Effendi?
translation: Satin mi? Hayir, hayir, hayir. Bu kilici görüyor musunuz, Effendi?

english: I do.
Well then, that is why it is mine! Hahaha.
translation: O zaman, bu yüzden benim! Hahaha.

english: Oh, so do I pay a toll? 10 coins should do, right?
translation: Oh, yani gecis ücreti mi ödeyecegim? 10 sikke yeter, degil mi?

english: Not quite, while gold can get you to many places, I seek stories of heroics, for my land is only for the worthy.
translation: Tam olarak degil, altinla bircok yere gidebilirsin, ama ben kahramanlik hikayeleri ariyorum, cünkü benim topraklarim sadece layik olanlara aittir.

english: Is the story behind your sword one of heroics?
translation: Kilicinin ardindaki hikaye kahramanlik hikayesi mi?

english: I promise you, the monkey I took it from was big! Hahaha!
translation: Sana söz veriyorum, onu aldigim maymun cok büyüktü! Hahaha!

english: Bye!
Farewell, Effendi!
Hey! I didn't say you could go in there!
Can I go in?
Who are you?
Bye!
Hello there.
I'm rather busy right...
... Wait a minute... you're that adventurer that has been taking on the Colosseum!
translation: Bir dakika... Sen Colosseum'da mücadele eden maceraci degil misin?

english: The Champion!
The Grand Champion!
That's me.
Wow, what are the chances you'd run into a simple farmer like me.
translation: Vay canina, benim gibi basit bir ciftciye rastlama ihtimalin ne kadar yüksek.

english: Quite high actually...
I suppose you might be needing a reliable herb supply if you're planning to continue fighting in the Colosseum?
translation: Colosseum'da savasmaya devam etmeyi planliyorsan, güvenilir bir bitki kaynagina ihtiyacin olabilir mi?

english: I suppose so?
I'll keep an eye on any herbs you plant here. It's the least I can do for someone like you.
translation: Burada ektigin bitkilere göz kulak olacagim. Senin gibi biri icin en azindan bunu yapabilirim.

english: That's a really kind gesture, but aren't you meant to be focusing on growing your own food?
translation: Bu cok nazik bir davranis, ama kendi yiyecegini yetistirmeye odaklanman gerekmiyor mu?

english: It's no trouble. The soil around here is very rich, so it won't need much attention at all. I might even get a reward from the palace for helping such a valiant contender!
translation: Sorun degil. Buradaki toprak cok verimli, bu yüzden fazla ilgi gerektirmez. Böyle cesur bir yarismaciya yardim ettigim icin saraydan ödül bile alabilirim!

english: That's very kind of you.
Best of luck on your journey, Champion!
Best of luck on your journey, Grand Champion!
Hello there.
Hi.
You're the guard that was on duty last night?
translation: Sen dün gece nöbetci olan muhafiz misin?

english: Yeah.
Denulth said that you lost the combination to the equipment room?
translation: Denulth, ekipman odasinin sifresini kaybettigini söyledi?

english: I don't want to talk about it!
What?
I said I didn't want to talk about it!
Can I buy you a drink?
Now you're talking! An Asgarnian Ale please!
translation: Simdi konusuyorsun! Bir Asgarnian Ale lütfen!

english: I'll go and get you one.
You give Harold an Asgarnian ale.
Arrh. That hit the spot!
translation: Arrh. Tam da ihtiyacim olan sey!

english: Where were you when you last had the combination?
I honestly don't know! I've looked everywhere. I've searched the castle and my room!
translation: Gercekten bilmiyorum! Her yere baktim. Kaleyi ve odami aradim!

english: Have you tried looking between here and the castle?
Yeah, I tried that.
I need another beer.
Would you like to gamble?
Good. Good. I have some dice. How much do you want to offer?
translation: Güzel. Güzel. Biraz zarim var. Ne kadar teklif etmek istersin?

english: You have to offer some money.
Woah! Do you think I'm made of money? Max bet is 1000 gold.
