translation: Vay canina! Beni para babasi mi saniyorsun? Maksimum bahis 1000 altin.

english: OK. I'll roll first!
Don't forget that once I start my roll you can't back out of the bet! If you do you lose your stake!
translation: Unutma, ben atmaya basladigimda bahisten vazgecemezsin! Vazgecersen bahisini kaybedersin!

english: Harold has given you your winnings!
You give Harold his winnings.
Sounds good! I normally drink Asgarnian Ale but you know what?
translation: Kulaga hos geliyor! Normalde Asgarnian Ale icerim ama biliyor musun?

english: What?
I really fancy one of those Blurberry Specials! I never get over to the Gnome Stronghold so I haven't had one for ages!
translation: Blurberry Special'lardan bir tane icmek istiyorum! Gnome Stronghold'a hic gitmedigim icin uzun zamandir icmedim!

english: You give Harold a Blurberry Special.
Wow.
Now THAT hit the spot!
'Ello matey!
Hmm...!
What wash the queshtion?
Shure!
Place your betsh pleashe!
*giggle*
Eashy tiger! Max bet ish 1000 coinsh.
translation: Sakin ol kaplan! Maksimum bahis 1000 jeton.

english: Right...er...here goes...
*hic!*
Harold is so drunk he can hardly see, let alone count!
translation: Harold o kadar sarhos ki, saymak bir yana, göremiyor bile!

english: *hic*
I didn't know you could ushe four dishe. Oh well.
Um... not enough money.
Heresh shome of it.
I owe you the resht!
Harold has given you an IOU scribbled on some paper.
translation: Harold sana bir kagida karalanmis bir borc senedi verdi.

english: I fink I've had enough!
I've lost the IOU you gave me.
Oh dear.
I'm shure I had money, not anymore!
translation: Eminim param vardi, ama artik yok!

english: *burp*
You knock on the door.
Come in!
Where were you when you last had the combination?
Would you like to gamble?
Can I buy you a drink?
I guess this will be my last day of blood tithes, one way or another.
translation: Sanirim bu, bir sekilde kan vergisinin son günü olacak.

english: It can't be that hard can it?
translation: O kadar da zor olamaz, degil mi?

english: Soon I will be free!
I'm starting to think I made a mistake coming here.
translation: Buraya gelmekle hata yaptigimi düsünmeye basliyorum.

english: Can't talk. I need to prepare myself.
I will survive the Theatre! Just like Serafina did!
translation: Tiyatro'dan sag cikacagim! Tipki Serafina gibi!

english: Welcome to my humble guild [player name].
Quite a place you've got here.
Indeed we do. Would you like to know more about it?
translation: Gercekten öyle. Daha fazla bilgi ister misin?

english: Tell me about the strength training area.

Ahh the mighty warrior Sloane guards the strength training area. This intriguing little area consists of two shotput lanes for different weights of shot. It's fairly simple, the Referee or Sloane can explain more. You
translation: Ahh, güclü savasci Sloane kuvvet antrenmani alanini koruyor. Bu ilginc kücük alan, farkli agirliklarda atislar icin iki atis pistinden olusuyor. Oldukca basit, hakem veya Sloane daha fazla bilgi verebilir.

english: may find yourself panting for breath though.
Oh? Why?
Well you see my dear [boy/lady], the games there really do sap your energy quite a bit. You can find it just up the stairs behind the bank.
translation: Görüyorsunuz sevgili , buradaki oyunlar gercekten enerjinizi oldukca tüketiyor. Bankanin arkasindaki merdivenlerden yukari cikinca bulabilirsiniz.

english: Tell me about the attack training area.
Ahhh, dummies.
I'm no dummy, I just want to know what is there!
translation: Ben manken degilim, sadece orada ne oldugunu bilmek istiyorum!

english: Oh no my dear [man/lady], I did not mean you at all! The training area has mechanical dummies which pop up out of holes in the floor. The noble dwarf Gamfred invented the mechanism and Ajjat can explain more about what
translation: Oh hayir sevgili , sizi kastetmedim! Antrenman alaninda zemindeki deliklerden cikan mekanik mankenler var. Asil cüce Gamfred bu mekanizmayi icat etti ve Ajjat orada ne yapmaniz gerektigini daha ayrintili olarak aciklayabilir.

english: to do there.
Oh, ok, I'll have to try it out!
You can find it just down the corridor and on your right.
Tell me about the defence training area.
To polish your defensive skills to the very highest level we've employed a most inventive dwarf and a catapult.
translation: Savunma becerilerinizi en üst seviyeye cikarmak icin cok yaratici bir cüce ve bir mancinik kullandik.

english: You're going to throw dwarves at me?
Oh my no! I think Gamfred would object to that most strongly.
translation: Oh hayir! Gamfred buna siddetle karsi cikacaktir.

english: He's an inventor you see and has built a marvellous contraption that can throw all sorts of things at you including magic missiles...
translation: O bir mucit ve sana her türlü seyi firlatabilen muhtesem bir alet yapti, sihirli füzeler dahil...

english: Mmmm?
....spiked iron balls.....
Err....
....spinning slashing blades....
Ummm...
... and even anvils.
ANVILS!?
No need to be afraid, it's all under very controlled conditions! You can find it just up the stairs behind the bank.
translation: Korkmaniza gerek yok, her sey cok kontrollü kosullar altinda gerceklesiyor! Bankanin arkasindaki merdivenlerden yukari cikinca bulabilirsiniz.

english: Tell me about the combat training area.
Ahh yes, our resident magician from foreign lands created a most amazing gadget which can turn your own armour against you! It's really quite intriguing.
translation: Ahh evet, yabanci diyarlardan gelen sihirbazimiz, zirhinizi size karsi kullanabilen muhtesem bir alet yaratti! Gercekten cok ilginc.

english: That sounds dangerous. What if I'm wearing it at the time?
translation: Kulaga tehlikeli geliyor. Ya o sirada zirhimi giyiyorsam?

english: So far that's not happened. You need to speak to Shanomi about the specifics of the process, but as I understand it, putting a suit of armour in one of these devices will make it come to life some how. The better
translation: Simdiye kadar böyle bir sey olmadi. Sürecin ayrintilari icin Shanomi ile konusmaniz gerekiyor, ama anladigim kadariyla, bu cihazlardan birine zirh koymak onu bir sekilde canlandiriyor. Zirh ne kadar iyi

english: the armour, the harder it is to 'kill'.
translation: ise, onu ‘öldürmek’ o kadar zor oluyor.

english: Fighting my own armour, that sounds... weird. I could be killed by it...
translation: Kendi zirhimla savasmak, kulaga... tuhaf geliyor. O tarafindan öldürülebilirim...

english: Indeed we have had a few fatalities from warriors over stretching themselves and not knowing their limits. Start small and work up is my motto! That and go see Lidio for some food if you need it.
translation: Gercekten de, sinirlarini bilmeden kendilerini zorlayan savascilardan birkac ölüm vakasi yasadik. Kücükten baslayip yavas yavas ilerlemek benim sloganimdir! Bir de, ihtiyacin olursa Lidio'ya gidip biraz yemek al.

english: Ok, thanks for the warning.
Tell me about tokens.

Ahh, yes, our token system is designed to allow you an appropriate amount of time with my discovery in the very top floor of the guild. I won't spoil the surprise as to what that is. Go up and see for yourself. Now, the
translation: Ahh, evet, jeton sistemimiz, loncanin en üst katindaki kesfimle uygun miktarda zaman gecirmenizi saglamak icin tasarlanmistir. Bunun ne oldugu konusunda sürprizi bozmayacagim. Yukari cikin ve kendiniz görün. Simdi,

english: amount of tokens you collect from the various activities around the guild will dictate how long Kamfreena will allow you in the enclosure on the very top floor. More tokens equals more time.
translation: lonca cevresindeki cesitli etkinliklerden topladiginiz jeton miktari, Kamfreena'nin sizi en üst kattaki alana ne kadar süreyle alacagina karar verecektir. Daha fazla jeton, daha fazla zaman demektir.

english: So what's up there?
If I told you it would spoil the surprise!
Ok ok... so how do I earn and claim these tokens?
translation: Tamam tamam... Peki bu jetonlari nasil kazanip alabilirim?

english: You can earn them simply by using the training exercises around the guild, the staff will then enter this into a ledger as you play. You can claim them by simply asking any of the staff at the training areas, or
translation: Guild'deki egitim egzersizlerini kullanarak kolayca kazanabilirsiniz, personel de siz oynarken bunu bir deftere kaydeder. Egitim alanlarindaki personelden herhangi birine veya

english: myself.
Sounds easy enough.
Tell me about the strength training area.
Tell me about the attack training area.
Tell me about the defence training area.
Tell me about the combat training area.
Tell me about tokens.
You any good with a sword?
Am I any good with....a sword... Have you any clue who I am?
translation: Kilic kullanmayi biliyor muyum... Kim oldugumu biliyor musunuz?

english: Not really... no.
Why I could best any person alive in a rapier duel!
Try me then!

My dear [sir/lady], I couldn't possibly duel you, I might hurt you and then what would happen to my reputation! Besides, I have this wonderful guild to run. Why don't you take a look at the various activities we
translation: Sevgili , sizinle düello yapamam, size zarar verebilirim ve o zaman itibarim ne olur! Ayrica, yönetmem gereken bu harika bir lonca var. Neden cesitli etkinliklerimize bir göz atmiyorsunuz?

english: have. You might even collect enough tokens to be allowed in to kill the strange beasts from the east!
translation: Dogu'dan gelen garip canavarlari öldürmek icin yeterli jeton bile toplayabilirsiniz!

english: Bye!
Farewell [brave warrior/fair lady], I do hope you enjoy my guild.
translation: Hosca kalin cesur maceraci, umarim loncami begenirsiniz.

english: How are you, Harrallak?
I've lost two of my dear friends, [player name]. This old place doesn't seem to be the same since they're gone.
translation: Iki sevgili arkadasimi kaybettim, Maceraci. Onlar gittiginden beri bu eski yer eskisi gibi degil.

english: I feel responsible.
Nonsense, my friend! They both died bravely fighting against a great evil! There is no blame on you for that.
translation: Sacmalama dostum! Ikisi de büyük bir kötülüge karsi cesurca savasirken öldüler! Bunun icin kendini suclamana gerek yok.

english: Remember them for who they were and what they stood for. Mourn their loss, but never bear the burden of their death, for that is not what they would want.
translation: Onlari kim olduklari ve neyi temsil ettikleri icin hatirla. Onlarin kaybini yas tut, ama asla ölümlerinin yükünü tasimaya calisma, cünkü onlar bunu istemezlerdi.

english: And what about vengeance?
Ah, now that is a topic we could debate for many moons, my friend. Still, regardless of the reason, know that when the time comes, I will fight beside you against Lucien once more.
translation: Ah, bu konu üzerinde aylarca tartisabiliriz dostum. Yine de, nedeni ne olursa olsun, zamani geldiginde Lucien'e karsi bir kez daha senin yaninda savasacagimi bil.

english: Could you tell me more about the Guild?
translation: Bana Lonca hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Of course. What would you like to know about?
translation: Elbette. Ne hakkinda bilgi almak istersin?

english: Quite a place you've got here.
You any good with a sword?
Bye!
How are you, Harrallak?
Could you tell me more about the Guild?
translation: Bana Lonca hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Welcome, you can buy fishing equipment at my store. We'll also give you a good price for any fish that you catch.
translation: Hos geldin, dükkanimdan balikcilik malzemeleri satin alabilirsin. Ayrica, yakaladigin baliklar icin sana iyi bir fiyat verecegiz.

english: Can I get a fish for this bowl?
Sorry, you need to put some seaweed into the bowl first.
translation: Üzgünüm, önce kaseye biraz yosun koyman gerekiyor.

english: Seaweed?
Yes, the fish seem to like it. Come and see me when you have put some in the bowl.
translation: Evet, baliklar onu seviyor gibi görünüyor. Kaseye biraz koyduktan sonra bana gel.

english: Yes you can!
I can see that you have a nicely filled fishbowl there to use, and you can catch a fish from my aquarium if you want.
translation: Kullanmak icin güzelce doldurulmus bir akvaryumun oldugunu görüyorum, istersen akvaryumumdan balik yakalayabilirsin.

english: You will need a special net to do this though, and I sell them for 10 gold.
translation: Bunun icin özel bir aga ihtiyacin olacak ve ben bunlari 10 altin karsiliginda satiyorum.

english: I'll take it!
Here you go!
Well, I'll be happy to give you the net once you have the cash, but not before!
translation: Parayi ödedikten sonra sana agi seve seve veririm, ama önce ödeme yapmalisin!

english: No thanks, later maybe.
Do you have any fishfood?
Sorry, I'm all out. I used up the last of it feeding the fish in the aquarium.
translation: Üzgünüm, bitti. Akvaryumdaki baliklari beslemek icin son kalanini da kullandim.

english: I have some empty boxes though, they have the ingredients written on the back. I'm sure if you pick up a pestle and mortar you will be able to make your own.
translation: Ama bos kutularim var, arkasinda malzemeleri yaziyor. Bir havan ve havaneli alirsaniz kendiniz yapabilirsiniz.

english: Here. I can hardly charge you for an empty box.
translation: Alin. Bos bir kutu icin sizden para alamam.

english: Sorry, I'm not interested.
Let's see what you've got then.
Can I get a fish for this bowl?
I'll take it!
No thanks, later maybe
Do you have any fishfood?
Sorry, I'm not interested.
I don't have time to talk to an outerlander.
Good to see you [Fremennik name].
Good to see you [Fremennik name]. Wanting to go to the Island of Stone?
translation: Seni görmek güzel Dokrak. Tas Adasi'na gitmek ister misin?

english: Player is transported to the Island of Stone
No thank you.
Good to see you [Fremennik name]. Do you wish to return to Rellekka?
translation: Seni görmek ne güzel Dokrak. Rellekka'ya dönmek ister misin?

english: Player is transported to Rellekka
Yes please.
No thank you.
Can I have another ring?
Hatius gives you another ring.
translation: Hatius sana baska bir yüzük verir.

english: Who are you?
I am Hatius Cosaintus, the taskmaster for the Lumbridge & Draynor Achievement Diary.
translation: Ben Hatius Cosaintus, Lumbridge & Draynor Basari Günlügü'nün görev sorumlusuyum.

english: What is the Achievement Diary?

It's a diary that helps you keep track of particular achievements. In the Lumbridge and Draynor area it can help you discover some quite useful things. Eventually, with enough exploration, the inhabitants will
translation: Belirli basarilari takip etmenize yardimci olan bir günlüktür. Lumbridge ve Draynor bölgesinde oldukca yararli seyler kesfetmenize yardimci olabilir. Yeterince kesif yaptiktan sonra, bölge sakinleri sizi

english: reward you.
You can see the list of tasks on the side-panel.
I have a question about my Achievement diary.
translation: Basari Günlügümle ilgili bir sorum var.

english: Well, there are four different Explorer's rings, which match up with the four levels of difficulty. Each has the same rewards as the previous level and some additional benefits too... which tier of rewards would you like to
translation: Dört farkli zorluk seviyesine karsilik gelen dört farkli Kasif Yüzügü vardir. Her biri önceki seviyeyle ayni ödüllere ve bazi ek avantajlara sahiptir... Hangi ödül kademesi hakkinda

english: know more about?
Tell me more about the Easy rewards please!
translation: Kolay ödüller hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin lütfen!

english: If you complete all of the easy tasks in Lumbridge and Draynor, your ring can recharge half of your run energy twice per day and cast low level alchemy without runes 30 times per day.
translation: Lumbridge ve Draynor'daki tüm kolay görevleri tamamlarsaniz, yüzügünüz kosu enerjinizin yarisini günde iki kez sarj edebilir ve günde 30 kez rünsüz düsük seviye simya yapabilir.

english: Thanks!
Tell me more about the Medium rewards please!
translation: Orta seviye ödüller hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin lütfen!

english: In addition to the easy rewards, your ring can restore half of your run energy and teleport you to the Draynor cabbage patch three times per day, there's also a new shortcut available under the Draynor village wall.
translation: Kolay ödüllere ek olarak, yüzügünüz kosu enerjinizin yarisini geri yükleyebilir ve sizi günde üc kez Draynor lahana tarlasina isinlayabilir. Ayrica Draynor köy duvarinin altinda yeni bir kisayol da mevcuttur.

english: Tell me more about the Hard rewards please!
translation: Zor ödüller hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin lütfen!

english: In addition to the easy and medium benefits, the ring will have unlimited cabbage teleports and four charges to restore half your run energy. Collecting Tears of Guthix will provide increased experience and a shortcut
translation: Kolay ve orta seviye avantajlara ek olarak, yüzük sinirsiz lahana teleportu ve kosu enerjinizin yarisini geri yüklemek icin dört sarj saglar. Guthix'in Gözyaslarini topladiginizda daha fazla deneyim kazanirsiniz ve

english: from Lumbridge swamp to the Desert becomes available.
translation: Lumbridge batakligindan Cöle giden bir kisayol kullanabilirsiniz.

english: Tell me more about the Elite rewards please!
translation: Elit ödüller hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin lütfen!

english: In addition to the previous tiers of rewards, you can block an additional slayer target with slayer masters, recharge all of your run energy three times per day and cast high level alchemy thirty times per day. The
translation: Önceki ödül seviyelerine ek olarak, slayer ustalariyla ek bir slayer hedefi engelleyebilir, günde üc kez tüm kosu enerjinizi yeniden sarj edebilir ve günde otuz kez yüksek seviye simya yapabilirsiniz.

english: Culinaromancer's chest is 20% cheaper and you can use Fairy rings without needing a dramen or lunar staff.
translation: Culinaromancer'in sandigi %20 daha ucuzdur ve dramen veya ay asasi olmadan peri halkalari kullanabilirsiniz.

english: How do I claim the rewards?
One should complete the tasks in Lumbridge and Draynor so they're ticked off, then speak to me to be rewarded.
translation: Lumbridge ve Draynor'daki görevleri tamamlayip isaretlemelisiniz, ardindan benimle konusarak ödülünüzü alabilirsiniz.

english: Bye!
Toodles.
I've completed all of the easy tasks in my Lumbridge & Draynor Achievement Diary!
translation: Lumbridge & Draynor Basari Günlügümdeki tüm kolay görevleri tamamladim!

english: Quite... You'll be wanting a reward then.
translation: Anlasildi... O zaman bir ödül isteyeceksiniz.

english: Yes please!
This ring is a symbol of your exploration of Lumbridge and Draynor. It can recharge half of your run energy twice per day and cast low level alchemy without runes 30 times per day.
translation: Bu yüzük, Lumbridge ve Draynor'u kesfettiginin sembolüdür. Günde iki kez kosu enerjinin yarisini yenileyebilir ve günde 30 kez rün kullanmadan düsük seviyeli simya yapabilirsin.

english: Wow, thanks!
If you ever lose your ring, come back to me to reclaim it.
translation: Yüzügünü kaybedersen, geri almak icin bana gel.

english: I've completed all of the medium tasks in my Lumbridge & Draynor achievement diary!
translation: Lumbridge ve Draynor basari günlügümdeki tüm orta zorlukta görevleri tamamladim!

english: I've upgraded your Explorer's ring for you. It can restore half of your run energy and teleport you to the Draynor cabbage patch three times per day.
translation: Kasif yüzügünü senin icin yükselttim. Kosma enerjinin yarisini geri yükleyebilir ve günde üc kez Draynor lahana tarlasina isinlayabilir.

english: Can I have another ring?
Who are you?
I have a question about my Achievement Diary
translation: Basari Günlügümle ilgili bir sorum var.

english: What is the Achievement Diary?
What are the rewards?
Easy Rewards.
Medium Rewards.
Hard Rewards.
Elite Rewards.
How do I claim the rewards?
Bye!
Can I help you today?
Can I go for a ride?
Minecart rides are 20 coins.
Of course.
I'm fine, thanks.
As a loyal customer of the Lovakengj Minecart Network, you're entitled to this.
translation: Lovakengj Maden Arabasi Agi'nin sadik bir müsterisi olarak, buna hakkiniz var.

english: Now, can I help you today?
translation: Simdi, bugün size yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: You're already here, human.
Can I go for a ride?
I'm fine, thanks.
Hello.
It's the meddler! The one who blew Jones' cover! I don't know why you came to this place but it is here that you will die.
translation: Bu, Jones'un kimligini ifsa eden müdahaleci! Neden buraya geldigini bilmiyorum ama burada öleceksin.

english: The adventurer returns! Glory to you for your efforts in bringing about the return of Lord Hazeel!
translation: Maceraci geri döndü! Lord Hazeel'in geri dönüsünü sagladigin icin sana seref olsun!

english: The mage starts to speak but all you hear is:
translation: Büyücü konusmaya baslar ama tek duydugun sudur:

english: Blah. Blah, blah, blah, blah...blah!
You feel very strange - as if Hazelmere has started poking around in your head.
translation: Cok garip hissediyorsun - sanki Hazelmere kafanin icinde dolasmaya baslamis gibi.

english: Well, I never expected to be impressed by a human, but you have done a good deed for the gnomes - even if most gnomes won't recognise it.  You humans are not as stupid as I first thought...
translation: Bir insandan etkilenmeyi hic beklemiyordum, ama sen cüceler icin iyi bir sey yaptin - cogu cüce bunu fark etmese de. Siz insanlar ilk düsündügüm kadar aptal degilsiniz...

english: So you want to know what your crystal seed does?
translation: Kristal tohumunun ne ise yaradigini mi bilmek istiyorsun?

english: How did you.. ? Oh I forgot about this mind meld thing.
translation: Nasil... ? Ah, bu zihin birlestirme olayini unutmusum.

english: The seed is a piece of elven magic, all elven magic comes from the manipulation of seeds of crystal. The elves give it divine properties. Elves sing to their crystals and they form into the desired shape.
translation: Tohum, elflerin büyüsünün bir parcasidir, tüm elf büyüsü kristal tohumlarinin manipülasyonundan gelir. Elfler ona ilahi özellikler verir. Elfler kristallerine sarki söyler ve onlar istenen sekle girer.

english: So how do I turn it into something useful?
translation: Peki onu nasil yararli bir seye dönüstürebilirim?

english: Either talk to an elf or find some other way to sing the crystal. If this came from Oaknock, he must have found a way...
translation: Ya bir elfle konus ya da kristale sarki söylemenin baska bir yolunu bul. Eger bu Oaknock'tan geldiyse, o bir yol bulmus olmali...

english: Thanks, I'll have a look round Oaknock's old workshop. I can have a chat with Brimstail while I'm at it! Thanks!
translation: Tesekkürler, Oaknock'un eski atölyesine bir göz atacagim. Hazir gitmisken Brimstail ile de sohbet edebilirim! Tesekkürler!

english: So you want to know what your crystal saw does?
translation: Kristal testerenin ne ise yaradigini mi ögrenmek istiyorsun?

english: Well, I do remember seeing Oaknock using the saw. He said it allowed him to build devices more complicated that even he was capable of constructing. The device he built must have been very complicated indeed.
translation: Oaknock'un testereyi kullandigini hatirliyorum. Bu testere sayesinde, kendisinin bile yapamayacagi kadar karmasik cihazlar yapabildigini söylemisti. Yaptigi cihaz gercekten cok karmasik olmali.

english: I'd say! Anyway, the saw looks like it could be pretty useful. Thanks.
translation: Kesinlikle! Her neyse, testere oldukca kullanisli görünüyor. Tesekkürler.

english: Hello, Hazelmere.
You're back. Come to disturb me, have you?
translation: Geri dönmüssün. Beni rahatsiz etmeye geldin, degil mi?

english: Ah, good old Hazelmere. Glad to see you're back to your grumpy self.
translation: Ah, eski dost Hazelmere. Huysuz halinle geri döndügünü görmek ne güzel.

english: Do you actually want something from me, or are you simply making my life a misery again?
translation: Benden gercekten bir sey mi istiyorsun, yoksa yine hayatimi zehir mi edeceksin?

english: I just wanted to have a chat. You know, just check how you're doing.
translation: Sadece sohbet etmek istedim. Nasil oldugunu görmek icin.

english: Well I'm fine, thank you. Now leave me in peace.
translation: Ben iyiyim, tesekkürler. Simdi beni rahat birak.

english: You give the bark sample to Hazelmere.
(The bark sample is removed from the player's inventory)
The mage carefully studies the sample.
Blah, blah...Daconia...blah, blah.
Can you write this down and I'll try and translate it?
translation: Bunu yazabilir misin, ben de cevirmeye calisayim?

english: Blah, blah?
You make a writing motion. The mage scribbles something down on a scroll.
translation: Yazma hareketi yaparsin. Büyücü bir parsömene bir seyler karalar.

english: Hazelmere has given you the scroll.
You still can't understand Hazelmere. The mage wrote it down for you on a scroll.
translation: Hala Hazelmere'yi anlayamiyorsun. Büyücü senin icin bir parsömene yazdi.

english: Blah, blah, blah...blah!
What?
Blah, blah.
Hazelmere has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Hazelmere sana bir meydan okuma parsömeni verdi!

english: Blah!
Blah, blah, blah!
Hazelmere has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: Hazir yemekler maalesef ise yaramaz. Aluft Aloft'un müsterileri icin sadece el yapimi Gnome Mutfagi yeterince iyidir.

english: You hand over your delivery of [item] to Hazelmere
*Hazelmere nods his thanks*
You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: Bunu bana ulastirmak icin uzun bir yol kat etmis olmalisin. Iste sana bahsis olarak kücük bir sey.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.'dan ücretsiz teslimat jetonunuzu almayi unutmayin.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: Teslimatiniz cok gec kaldi! Aluft jnr.'a geri dönüp baska bir siparis alin. Artik ihtiyaciniz olmadigi icin teslimat kutunuzu atiyorsunuz.

english: After all that, are you sure I can't convince you to join the union?
translation: Tüm bunlardan sonra, sizi sendikaya katilmaya ikna edemeyecegime emin misiniz?

english: Actually, I was wondering if...
Kuani! I'll need to run and grab my forms, but if you wait there just a moment...
translation: Kuani! Formlarimi almam gerekiyor, ama biraz bekleyebilirseniz...

english: I was going to ask if you had any spare equipment...
translation: Yedek ekipmaniniz var mi diye soracaktim...

english: Spare equipment?
I may have a need to mask my identity again in the future... or perhaps carry a tray around.
translation: Gelecekte kimligimi tekrar gizlemem gerekebilir... ya da belki bir tepsi tasimam gerekebilir.

english: You're certain you don't want to join the union as well?
I'm sure.
I see. In that case, which equipment would you like?
The ram mask.
Thanks!
The wolf mask.
The bird mask.
The jaguar mask.
The snake mask.
The butler's tray.
None of them.
Very well.
Changed your mind about joining the union? Or are you just after more equipment?
translation: Sendikaya katilma konusunda fikrinizi mi degistirdiniz? Yoksa sadece daha fazla ekipman mi istiyorsunuz?

english: Just the equipment please.
I see. In that case, what do you need?
The ram mask.
The wolf mask.
The bird mask.
The jaguar mask.
More options...
The snake mask.
The butler's tray.
None of them.
Previous options...
What do you think you're doing?
Hey! Get your hands off there!
Hello, welcome to the Cooking Guild. Only accomplished chefs and cooks are allowed in here. Feel free to use any of our facilities.
translation: Merhaba, Ascilik Loncasina hos geldin. Buraya sadece yetkin sefler ve ascilar girebilir. Tesislerimizi diledigin gibi kullanabilirsin.

english: Nice cape, you're wearing!
Thank you! It's my most prized possession, it's a Skillcape of Cooking; it shows that I've achieved level 99 Cooking and am one of the best chefs in the land!
translation: Tesekkürler! Bu benim en degerli esyam, Ascilik Beceri Pelerini; 99. seviye Ascilik seviyesine ulastigimi ve bu ülkedeki en iyi seflerden biri oldugumu gösteriyor!

english: If you ever achieve level 99 cookingyou'll get to wear one too and doing so means you'll never burn any food!
translation: Eger 99. seviyeye ulasirsaniz, siz de bir tane takabilirsiniz ve bu sayede hicbir yemegi yakmayacaksiniz!

english: Thanks, bye.
Hello, welcome to the Cooking Guild. It's always great to have such an accomplished chef visit us. Say, would you be interested in a Skillcape of Cooking? They're only available to master chefs.
translation: Merhaba, Ascilik Loncasina hos geldiniz. Böylesine yetenekli bir sefin bizi ziyaret etmesi her zaman harika bir sey. Peki, Ascilik Beceri Pelerini ile ilgilenir misiniz? Bunlar sadece usta sefler icin mevcuttur.

english: No thanks.
Okay, come back to me if you change your mind.
Can I buy a Skillcape of Cooking from you?
translation: Sizden bir Ascilik Beceri Pelerini satin alabilir miyim?

english: Most certainly, by wearing this cape you'll never burn any food, I will have to ask for 99000 gold coins for such a privilege.
translation: Elbette, bu pelerini giydiginizde hicbir yemegi yakmayacaksiniz, ancak böyle bir ayricalik icin 99.000 altin para talep etmek zorundayim.

english: That's much too expensive.
I'm sorry you feel that way.
Sure.
But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: Ama ne yazik ki yanimda yeterince param yok.

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.

Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: Maalesef tüm Skillcapes sadece ücretsiz bir baslik ile satilmaktadir, bu bir beceri promosyonunun parcasidir; bir alana bir bedava, bilirsiniz. Yani size bir tane satabilmem icin önce envanterinizde yer acmaniz gerekecek.

english: Now you can use the title Master Chef.
May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: Cape'im icin baska bir baslik alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
The head chef hands you another hood for your skillcape.
translation: Bas asci size skillcape'iniz icin baska bir baslik verir.

english: You can't come in here unless you're wearing a chef's hat, or something like that.
translation: Sef sapkasi veya benzeri bir sey takmadikca buraya giremezsin.

english: Sorry. Only the finest chefs are allowed in here. Get your cooking level up to 32 and come back wearing a chef's hat.
translation: Üzgünüm. Buraya sadece en iyi sefler girebilir. Yemek pisirme seviyeni 32'ye cikar ve sef sapkasi takarak geri gel.

english: Sorry. Only the finest chefs are allowed in here. Get your cooking level up to 32.
translation: Üzgünüm. Buraya sadece en iyi sefler girebilir. Yemek pisirme seviyeni 32'ye cikar.

english: You have done well, [player name]!
Nice cape you're wearing!
Thanks, bye.
No thanks.
Yes please.
That's much too expensive.
Sure.
Skillcape
Hood
Hello there.
Good day to you my friend, a beautiful one at that. Would you like some groceries? I have all sorts. Alcohol also, if you're partial to a drink.
translation: Iyi günler dostum, ne güzel bir gün. Biraz market alisverisi yapmak ister misin? Her sey var. Alkol de var, eger icki seviyorsan.

english: No thank you.
Ahh well, all the best to you.
I'll have a look.
There's a good human.
Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: Hazir yemekler ise yaramaz korkarim. Aluft Aloft'un müsterileri icin sadece el yapimi Gnome Mutfagi yeterince iyidir.

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Heckel Funch
Hey! Thanks a lot mate. You're a diamond.
translation: Hey! Cok tesekkürler dostum. Sen bir hazinesin.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr'dan ücretsiz teslimat jetonunu almayi unutma.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: Teslimatin cok gec! Aluft jnr'a geri dön ve baska bir siparis al. Artik ihtiyacin olmadigi icin teslimat kutunu atiyorsun.

english: Please do puzzle for me human!
translation: Lütfen benim icin bulmaca cöz insan!

english: No, that's wrong I'm afraid.
Well done, human!
No thank you.
I'll have a look.
Nilsal. Here to pay respects, or just here to appreciate the calmness of this crypt?
translation: Nilsal. Saygilarini sunmak icin mi geldin, yoksa sadece bu mezarin sakinligini takdir etmek icin mi?

english: Just looking around really.
Please do. Many find this a nice place to come from time to time. The bustle of the city can be overwhelming. Here you can contemplate many things in peace, watched over by Ranul himself.
translation: Lütfen bak. Bircok kisi burayi zaman zaman gelmek icin güzel bir yer buluyor. Sehrin karmasasi cok bunaltici olabilir. Burada Ranul'un gözetimi altinda bircok seyi huzur icinde düsünebilirsin.

english: Hello, can I ask you a question?
Oh yes, young fellow? Yes, what do you want?
translation: Tabii, genc adam? Evet, ne istiyorsun?

english: Who's that you're talking to Hegir?
Let me see, he appears to be a human of some sort.
translation: Bir bakayim, bir tür insan gibi görünüyor.

english: What was your name again, human?
[player name].
It's [player name]!
Well ask him what he wants then!
What do you want, human?
Errr... I don't know... A quest, maybe?
He says he's looking for his quest!
What makes him think he lost his quest in here?
What makes you think you lost your quest in here?
No no, I mean, do you have a task of some sort for me?
translation: Hayir hayir, demek istedigim, benim icin bir görev var mi?

english: Now he says he wants a task!
Stop talking to that human and get back in here before I have a task for you!
translation: O insanla konusmayi birak ve sana bir görev vermeden önce buraya geri dön!

english: No need to talk to me like that, Haera.
translation: Bana böyle konusmana gerek yok, Haera.

english: I'll talk to you in whatever way I like!
I think I hear someone calling my name in the distance…
No need to shout!
Calm down dear.
I don't see why.
Yes you did!
I did not!
What did you do that for?
Welcome to the Heroes' Guild!
So do you sell anything good here?
Why yes! We DO run an exclusive shop for our members!
translation: Tabii ki! Üyelerimiz icin özel bir dükkan isletiyoruz!

english: So what can I do here?
Look around... there are all sorts of things to keep our guild members entertained!
translation: Etrafa bak... Lonca üyelerimizi eglendirecek her türlü sey var!

english: So do you sell anything here?
So what can I do here?
Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: Hey, bu Kahraman! Vay canina! Sen harikasin, o iki juvinate ve Gadderank'i nasil alt ettin? Ve kasaba cok güzel, harika bir is cikarmissin!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
I'm Helena, I'm just a kid, but I'll duff you in! You don't look that tough to me!
translation: Ben Helena, sadece bir cocugum, ama seni yenebilirim! Bana o kadar da sert görünmüyorsun!

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: Oh, pek bir sey yok, hepimiz hala vampirlerden saklaniyoruz ve bu korkunc yerde gecimimizi sagliyoruz, umarim yakinda Salve'deki tapinaga yolculuk yapacak kadar gücleniriz.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: Bildigim kadariyla yok, su anda cok yararli olan bazi temel olanaklara sahibiz, hepimiz sana cok minnettariz. Daha önce hic bir kahraman görmedim veya tanimadim, bu yüzden karsilastiracak bir seyim yok, ama sanirim

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: cogu insanin görüsüne göre, sen bir kahramansin! Ben sahsen seninle tanistigima cok memnunum.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Ok, thanks.
Hello there. Did you see that dwarf by the big forge? I think he wanted to talk to you.
translation: Merhaba. Büyük demirhanenin yanindaki cüceyi gördün mü? Sanirim seninle konusmak istiyordu.

english: Hello there.
Hello. Sorry, I'd love to stop and chat, but I have a new find that I need to work on. If you need anything, I'm sure Prescott can help.
translation: Merhaba. Üzgünüm, durup sohbet etmek isterdim, ama üzerinde calismam gereken yeni bir bulgum var. Bir seye ihtiyacin olursa, Prescott yardimci olabilir.

english: Okay, thanks.
Not a problem.
How are you doing?
Great. Ready to take on another of those pesky rats!
translation: Harika. O sinir bozucu sicanlardan birini daha yakalamaya hazirim!

english: How old are you now?
I'm [x] months old. (Month count differs based on kitten's current growth.)
Where do you want to go?
Let's go steal some things from stalls. I do enjoy watching shopkeepers panic!
translation: Tezgahlardan bir seyler calalim. Dükkan sahiplerinin panige kapilmasini izlemek cok eglenceli!

english: What do you want to do now?
I need to crunch something - lets go ratting!
translation: Bir seyler cignemem lazim - hadi fare avina cikalim!

english: Big, mean, and ready to rumble. Just the way I like it.
translation: Büyük, kötü ve kavgaya hazir. Tam da sevdigim gibi.

english: Practically perfect in every way. Ready for world domination.
translation: Her acidan neredeyse mükemmel. Dünya hakimiyetine hazir.

english: Easy there tiger.
I fancy pointing and laughing at some demons. They always make me cackle.
translation: Bazi iblisleri isaret edip gülmek istiyorum. Beni hep güldürürler.

english: Why's that?
Well, have you never noticed how well ghouls and demons get on?
translation: Ghoul'lar ve iblislerin ne kadar iyi anlastigini hic fark etmedin mi?

english: No... Can't say I have.
Yeah... Demons are a ghoul's best friend.
translation: Evet... Iblisler gulyabanilerin en iyi dostudur.

english: Hmm. I'm not sure I understand that. Is it some kind of joke?
translation: Hmm. Anladigimi sanmiyorum. Bu bir tür saka mi?

english: Sigh. I think you're the only joke round here, no-fur.
translation: Sigh. Bence buradaki tek saka sensin, tüysüz.

english: Prey on the weak and injured. Let's try the wilderness!
translation: Zayif ve yaralilari avlayalim. Wildernessyi deneyelim!

english: Yawn. I'm too lazy to even bother answering you.
translation: Esneme. Sana cevap vermek icin bile cok tembelim.

english: Do you mind? I'm trying to clean!
translation: Sakincasi var mi? Temizlik yapmaya calisiyorum!

english: Oi kitty! I'm talking to you!
Go away!!
~From the look in its eyes you decide to leave alone for now.
translation: Gözlerindeki bakistan, simdilik onu rahat birakmaya karar veriyorsun.

english: Anywhere but here. I'm feeling lucky!
translation: Buradan baska herhangi bir yer. Sansli hissediyorum!

english: Let's go to the Emir's Arena, near Al Kharid, and watch some fights!
translation: Al Kharid yakinlarindaki Emir'in Arenasi'na gidip birkac dövüs izleyelim!

english: Content. But a little more attention or rat hunting wouldn't go amiss.
translation: Memnunum. Ama biraz daha ilgi veya fare avi fena olmazdi.

english: We'll see what we can do.
Whoa-oa-oa! I feel good, I knew that I would now.. I feel nice!!
translation: Vay-oa-oa! Kendimi iyi hissediyorum, simdi böyle olacagini biliyordum... Kendimi iyi hissediyorum!!

english: Let's go to the sewers of Varrock.
Anywhere dangerous is good with me!
translation: Tehlikeli herhangi bir yer benim icin uygundur!

english: Sorry human, but what are you wearing?
translation: Üzgünüm insan, ama ne giyiyorsun sen?

english: I got some cat ears made for me, don't they look meeeeeeeooooowvalous.
translation: Kendime kedi kulaklari yaptirdim, cok güzel görünüyorlar, degil mi?

english: The cat looks you dead in the eye, unblinking.
Am I a joke to you?
translation: Ben senin icin bir saka miyim?

english: UwU?
Why are you doing this?
I thought it'd be cute and funny.
It's not, take them off now human, before I get myself a pair of human ears to wear.
translation: Öyle degil, onlari hemen cikar insan, yoksa kendime bir cift insan kulagi takacagim.

english: How are you doing?
How old are you now?
Where do you want to go?
What do you want to do now?
How many souls have you devoured?
None.
Awww p-
Yet.
Oh.
What a cute puppy, how nice to meet you.
translation: Ne sevimli bir köpek yavrusu, tanistigimiza memnun oldum.

english: It'll be nice to meat you too...
translation: Ben de seninle tanistigima memnun oldum...

english: Urk... nice doggy.
Grrrr....
Hell yeah! Such a cute puppy!
translation: Tabii ki! Ne kadar sevimli bir köpek yavrusu!

english: Silence mortal! Or I'll eat your soul.
translation: Sessiz ol ölümlü! Yoksa ruhunu yerim.

english: Would that go well with lemon?
Why were the hot dogs shivering?
Grrrrr...
Because they were served-
GRRRRRR...
-with... chilli?
I wonder if I need to invest in a trowel when I take you out for a walk.
translation: Seni yürüyüse cikardigimda bir kürek almam gerekip gerekmedigini merak ediyorum.

english: More like a shovel.
Grrr... cats.
Soulless object.
Cats smell
Rawr
Wooooof
Grrrrrr!
The spirit looks at you without saying a word. However, as you approach, he offers you some items.
translation: Ruh sana tek kelime etmeden bakar. Ancak, sen yaklasinca sana bazi esyalar sunar.

english: The spirit gives you a strange look. You don't have enough room in your supply bag for what he's offering.
translation: Ruh sana tuhaf bir bakis atar. Onun sundugu seyleri tasimak icin cantanda yeterli yer yoktur.

english: The spirit gives you a strange look. You've clearly claimed all you can for now.
translation: Ruh sana tuhaf bir bakis atar. Su anda alabilecegin her seyi aldigin aciktir.

english: Hello?

You have reached the Lunar Communication Helpline. I'm sorry we can't answer your telekinetic question right now. Our opening times are carefully organised to coincide with you being busy. If you are having an emergency, you have our most profound apologies. Have a nice day. Good bye.
translation: Ay Iletisim Yardim Hattina ulastiniz. Telekinetik sorunuzu su anda cevaplayamadigimiz icin üzgünüz. Calisma saatlerimiz, sizin mesgul oldugunuz zamanlara denk gelecek sekilde özenle düzenlenmistir. Acil bir durumunuz varsa, en icten özürlerimizi sunariz. Iyi günler. Hosca kalin.

english: Typical.
Hello!
You do not have an appointment.
Sorry, what?
Appointment for what?
An appointment to see the Queen.
How do you know that?
First, because it is my job. Second, because she is not in Fortis at the moment.
translation: Birincisi, bu benim isim. Ikincisi, su anda Fortis'te degil.

english: Oh. Well where is she then?
She has important business elsewhere in the kingdom. Perhaps when she returns, you'll be able to see her, or perhaps you won't.
translation: Kralligin baska bir yerinde önemli isleri var. Belki döndügünde onu görebilirsiniz, belki de göremezsiniz.

english: Yes, those generally are the two options.
Now, if there's nothing else, please move along.
translation: Baska bir sey yoksa, lütfen yolunuza devam edin.

english: Hello there. Want to sample my catch of the day? Or maybe you'd prefer to do some fishing yourself? If so, I have all the supplies you'll need.
translation: Merhaba. Bugünkü avimi denemek ister misiniz? Ya da belki kendiniz balik tutmak istersiniz? Öyleyse, ihtiyaciniz olan tüm malzemeler bende var.

english: Let's see what you have.
Nothing for me, thanks.
translation: Benim icin bir sey yok, tesekkürler.

english: As you wish.
Let's see what you have.
Nothing for me, thanks.
translation: Benim icin bir sey yok, tesekkürler.

english: Hello there! If you have any ores to trade I'm always buying.
translation: Merhaba! Takas etmek istediginiz cevher varsa, ben her zaman alirim.

english: Why don't you ever restock your shop?
The only ores I sell are the ones that are sold to me.
translation: Sattigim tek cevher, bana satilan cevherlerdir.

english: Anything else?
See you later.
Until next time.
Let's trade.
Why don't you ever restock your shop?
Goodbye.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu var. Merhaba, selam, merhaba...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her türlü sey! Kuleler görülmeye deger harika bir manzara.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmenizi tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Hello.
What are you doing here?
I'm just wandering around.
You do realise you're wandering around in my house?
Yep.
Well please get out!
Sheesh, keep your wig on!
I was hoping you'd give me some free stuff.
translation: Bana bedava bir seyler verirsin diye umuyordum.

english: No, I jolly well wouldn't! Get out of my house!
Meanie!
Aaaarrgh!
Eeeek!
I'm just wandering around.
I was hoping you'd give me some free stuff.
translation: Bana bedava bir seyler verirsin diye umuyordum.

english: I've come to kill you.
Hello there.
Hmm... You don't seem like a real guard to me. Who are you?
translation: Hmm... Bana gerçek bir gardiyan gibi gelmiyorsun. Kimsin sen?

english: No one important.
You're not a guard. What are you doing in here?
translation: Sen gardiyan degilsin. Burada ne isin var?

english: Nothing important.
If you say so.
Hello there. So Khazard got his hands on you too?
translation: Merhaba. Khazard seni de ele geçirdi mi?

english: Unfortunately so.
Well if you're lucky, you might last as long as me.
translation: Sansliysan, benim kadar uzun süre dayanabilirsin.

english: How long have you been here?
As long as I can remember. I was a child when his men kidnapped me. My whole life has been spent killing and fighting, all in the hope that one day I might escape.
translation: Hatirlayabildigim kadariyla. Adamlari beni kaçirdiginda çocuktum. Tüm hayatim öldürmek ve savasmakla geçti, tek umudum bir gün kaçabilmekti.

english: Don't give up.
Thanks, friend.
Wait... sounds like the guard is coming. Looks like you'll be going back into the arena. Good luck, friend.
translation: Bekle... gardiyan geliyor galiba. Görünüse göre arenaya geri döneceksin. Iyi sanslar dostum.

english: Hello again.
I don't know how you managed to escape, but you may not be as lucky next time. Get out of here while you can.
translation: Nasil kaçtigini bilmiyorum ama bir dahaki sefere bu kadar sansli olmayabilirsin. Firsatin varken buradan git.

english: Sorry, we don't talk to strangers.
Thanks again for helping Uncle Eric. He thinks you're really really brave. I hope he'll visit again soon.
translation: Eric Amca'ya yardim ettigin icin tekrar tesekkürler. Seni cok cesur buluyor. Umarim yakinda tekrar ziyaret eder.

english: Hello.
Oh, hello. If you wish to look around the Carnillean family home, please refrain from touching anything with those grubby hands of yours.
translation: Oh, merhaba. Carnillean ailesinin evini gezmek istiyorsan, lütfen o kirli ellerinle hicbir seye dokunma.

english: Okay...
Hello again adventurer! Since you dealt with those horrible hooligan cultists, things have vastly improved for us around here!
translation: Merhaba maceraci! O korkunc holigan tarikatcilarin icabina baktigindan beri, buradaki durumumuz cok daha iyiye gitti!

english: My pleasure, Lady Henryeta.
translation: Benim icin bir zevkti, Leydi Henryeta.

english: Oh, it's you. I'm very disappointed that you never found those awful cultists. You're quite useless really, aren't you?
translation: Oh, sensin. O korkunc tarikatcilari bulamadigin icin cok hayal kirikligina ugradim. Sen gercekten cok ise yaramazsin, degil mi?

english: Yup, I guess I am.
Are you hungry?
That depends, what have you got?
I'm sure I could knock you up a decent salad.
I'm actually an insectivore.
Oh, but your name suggests that-
I think you'll find I didn't name myself, you humans and your silly puns.
translation: Adimi kendim koymadigimi göreceksin, siz insanlar ve aptal kelime oyunlariniz.

english: No need to PUNish us for our incredible wit.
translation: Inanilmaz zekâmiz icin bizi cezalandirmana gerek yok.

english: Please. Stop.
Have your herbs died?
These old things? I guess they've dried up... I'm getting old and I need caring for. I've chosen you to do that by the way.
translation: Bu eski seyler mi? Sanirim kurumuslar... Yaslaniyorum ve bakima ihtiyacim var. Bu arada, bunu yapmak icin seni sectim.

english: Oh fantastic! I spend all that time training the Farming skill, and now I'm supposed to care for your herbs as well?
translation: Harika! Bütün zamanimi ciftcilik becerisini gelistirmek icin harcadim, simdi de senin otlarina bakmam mi gerekiyor?

english: I could try the next person if you'd prefer?
I'm just joking you old swine!
translation: Sadece saka yapiyorum, seni yasli domuz!

english: So you live in a hole? I would've thought Boars are surface dwelling mammals.
translation: Demek bir delikte yasiyorsun? Domuzlarin yüzeyde yasayan memeliler oldugunu sanirdim.

english: Well, I'm special! I bore down a little so I'm nice and cosy with my herbs exposed to the sun, it's all very interesting.
translation: Ben özelim! Biraz asagi indim, böylece otlarim günese maruz kalirken ben de rahat ve sicak kaliyorum, cok ilginc.

english: Sounds rather... Boring!
How very original...
Tell me... do you like Avacado?
I'm an insectivore, but even if I wasn't I'd hate Avacado!
translation: Ben böcek yiyen bir hayvanim, ama olmasam bile avokadodan nefret ederdim!

english: Why ever not? It's delicious!
I don't know why people like it so much... it tastes a likea ball of chewed up grass.
translation: Insanlarin neden bu kadar sevdigini anlamiyorum... Cignenmis ot topu gibi tadi var.

english: Sometimes you can be such a bore...
When I was a young HERBIBOAR!!
I'm standing right next to you, no need to shout...
I was trying to sing you a song...
Ever tried a butterfly before?
I've never been able to catch one, they've always eluded me.
Herbi chomps excitedly on the butterfly, he seems pleased.
translation: Herbi kelebegi heyecanla cigniyor, memnun görünüyor.

english: Woah! You should try those, they're amazing.
I got you some grubs!
My favorite!
Herbi munches happily on the grubs. It's rather gross.
translation: Herbi kurtcuklari mutlu bir sekilde cigniyor. Oldukca igrenc.

english: How about some wyrms?
I assume you mean worms, not sure I could stomach a wyrm, far too big.
translation: Sanirim solucanlari kastediyorsun, yilan böceklerini yiyebilecegimi sanmiyorum, cok büyükler.

english: Oh yeah, those words don't even sound the same.
translation: Evet, bu kelimeler ayni bile degil.

english: I don't judge you, now hand over those worms!
translation: Seni yargilamiyorum, simdi o solucanlari ver!

english: Herbi hungrily devours the worms, you regret watching him do it.
translation: Herbi solucanlari ac bir sekilde yiyor, onu izledigine pisman oluyorsun.

english: Slimy, yet satisfying.
I got you a spider carcass!
Not really an insect, but admittedly I'm not too fussy.
translation: Aslinda böcek sayilmaz, ama itiraf etmeliyim ki ben cok secici degilim.

english: Herbi gobbles the spider down, several legs fall to the ground around him.
translation: Herbi örümcegi yutar, birkac bacagi etrafina düser.

english: You missed a bit.
I'll save them for later.
Oink!
THEY CALL ME MR. PIIIG!
I'll show you a bacon salad!
Hiya Hermie!
Ah, [player name]! How's the fishing going?
translation: Ah, Maceraci! Balik tutma nasil gidiyor?

english: Still working on it. How's the Colony?
Flourishing, now that the colonists are coming back! Soon all the finest restaurants will be serving monkfish!
translation: Kolonistler geri dönüyor, simdi her sey yolunda! Yakinda en iyi restoranlar deniz maymunu servis edecek!

english: It's a pity those skeletons you brought here haven't gone away again, though. They're in the dormitories, which is rather annoying! So please take a little time to kick 'em around a bit.
translation: Buraya getirdigin iskeletlerin tekrar gitmemis olmasi cok yazik. Yurtlarda duruyorlar, bu da oldukca can sikici! Lütfen biraz zaman ayirip onlari biraz tekmele.

english: Oh, and please don't call me Hermie.
translation: Oh, ve lütfen bana Hermie deme.

english: Whatever you like, Hermie!
Hop inside my mouth if you want to live!
I'm not falling for that... I'm not a fish! I've got more foresight than that.
translation: Buna kanmam... Ben balik degilim! O kadar da saf degilim.

english: Got any Spirit flakes?
I think you may have a problem.
I agree, you don't give me anywhere enough of those. So get to it.
translation: Katiliyorum, bana yeterince vermiyorsun. Hadi basla.

english: Right.
Those look tasty. But I'm looking for a proper feast. Come back to me with 3000 of them.
translation: Bunlar lezzetli görünüyor. Ama ben gercek bir ziyafet ariyorum. 3000 tane getir bana.

english: 3000!? Are you insane?!
Not really, I'm just a little bit peckish.
Good thing you have a beak then!
translation: O zaman iyi ki gagalarin var!

english: Touché.
No thanks. I'm craving a Spirit flake right now.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler. Su anda Ruh pullari istiyorum.

english: You really love those things.
Yup. So get to it.
Righto.
Transmogrify your Heron?
Your pet Heron gobbles up a Spirit flake and turns royal blue.
translation: Evcil hayvanin Heron, Ruh pullarini yiyip kraliyet mavisine dönüsür.

english: What's the big idea? If you're going to offer me a Spirit flake, at least have one to hand!
translation: Bu ne demek oluyor? Bana Ruh pullari sunacaksan, en azindan elinde bir tane olsun!

english: You can unlock the pet Heron transmogrification for 3000 x Spirit flakes.
translation: 3000 x Spirit flakes karsiliginda evcil Heron'un dönüsümünü acabilirsin.

english: Where's the fish? You don't have any!
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
Got any raw fish?
Haven't you already eaten enough Spirit flakes?
Yes, I have. That's why I'm asking you for raw fish.
translation: Evet, yedim. O yüzden senden cig balik istiyorum.

english: Sometimes I wonder whether getting stuck with you was my good luck or yours.
translation: Bazen seninle takilip kalmanin benim icin mi yoksa senin icin mi sans oldugunu merak ediyorum.

english: In a remarkable display of gluttony, your pet Heron consumes 3000 Spirit flakes. It turns blue in front of your very eyes.
translation: Pet Heron'un olaganüstü bir oburluk gösterisiyle 3000 Spirit flakes tüketir. Gözlerinin önünde maviye döner.

english: That really hit the spot! Though I feel a little blue now that there are none left.
translation: Bu gercekten cok iyi geldi! Ama simdi hic kalmadigi icin biraz üzgünüm.

english: You offer your pet Heron a Spirit flake, which it quickly gobbles up.
translation: Evcil hayvanin Heron'a bir Ruh pulunu sunarsin, o da hemen yutar.

english: Oops! That was a mistake, you're already blue. If you give it back, I'll give you a raw fish?
translation: Oops! Bu bir hataydi, sen zaten mavisin. Geri verirsen, sana cig balik veririm?

english: Sorry, no can do. They're just too tasty. You should try one sometime!
translation: Üzgünüm, yapamam. Cok lezzetliler. Bir ara denemelisin!

english: I'll pass.
Your pet Heron gobbles up your [fish name] and turns a magnificent white.
translation: Evcil hayvanin Heron, baligi'ni yutar ve muhtesem bir beyaza dönüsür.

english: Are you trying to annoy me?
I put in a lot of effort cooking this for you.
translation: Bunu senin icin pisirmek icin cok ugrastim.

english: Exactly, you've cooked it! You've ruined a fine delicacy, now go and uncook it!
translation: Aynen, pisirdin! Güzel bir lezzeti mahvettin, simdi gidip pisirmeyi geri al!

english: Uncook? That's not even possible!
translation: Pisirmeyi geri almak mi? Bu imkansiz!

english: I once knew a cat who mastered uncooking. Nice guy, actually. Enough talk, go and get me some more raw fish!
translation: Bir zamanlar pisirmeyi geri almayi basaran bir kedi taniyordum. Aslinda iyi biriydi. Konusmayi birak, gidip bana biraz daha cig balik getir!

english: What is wrong with you?
I'm giving you some fish..
And you think that I can do anything with something charred to the bone?
translation: Ve sen kemiklerine kadar yanmis bir seyle bir sey yapabilecegimi mi saniyorsun?

english: In my culture, these well-cooked fish are considered pretty valuable.
translation: Benim kültürümde, bu iyi pismis baliklar oldukca degerli kabul edilir.

english: It's burnt, you dancing donkey!
Dancing donkey...?
Sushi? Do I look like a commoner to you?
translation: Susi mi? Sana siradan bir insan gibi mi görünüyorum?

english: In Dorgeshuun culture, this is considered a delicacy.
translation: Dorgeshuun kültüründe, bu bir lezzet olarak kabul edilir.

english: In bird culture, this is considered an insult. Get it out of my face at once!
translation: Kus kültüründe ise bu bir hakaret olarak kabul edilir. Hemen önümden cekil!

english: How could a member of my own house say something so horrible?
translation: Kendi evimin bir üyesi nasil bu kadar korkunc bir sey söyleyebilir?

english: Great blue heron - 1 x Spirit flakes
translation: Büyük mavi balikcil - 1 x Ruh pullari

english: Heron - 1 x Raw fish
Not right now.
Yes, it could use a nice snack.
No, I'm not shelling that out for a snack.
translation: Hayir, atistirmalik icin o kadar para veremem.

english: Do you wish to trade?
Why yes, this a jewel shop after all.
translation: Tabii ki, burasi bir mücevher dükkani sonucta.

english: Sorry I don't want to talk to you actually.
Huh! Charming!
You've done it! Have this.
Do you wish to trade?
Sorry I don't want to talk to you actually.
Greetings, human... can I interest you in some fine gems?
translation: Selamlar, insan... güzel mücevherlere ilgi duyar misin?

english: Show me the wares!
No thanks.
Hello! I've got a little quest for you, are you interested?
translation: Merhaba! Sana kücük bir görevim var, ilgilenir misin?

english: Yes, I love quests!
That's the spirit! Now, what I need is [3—5] pieces of [clay/copper ore/tine ore/iron ore/silver ore/coal/gold ore/mithril ore]. And I need them within [13—15] minutes as well.
Not much of a quest, but I'll do it. Just [3—5] pieces of [clay/copper ore/tine ore/iron ore/silver ore/coal/gold ore/mithril ore] in [13—15] minutes.
No, quests are dull and boring.
Don't be so dismissive, you didn't even hear what I wanted to ask you!
translation: Bu kadar kücümseme, sana ne soracagimi bile dinlemedin!

english: I don't want to! I just want to kill things!
translation: Istemiyorum! Ben sadece bir seyler öldürmek istiyorum!

english: Are my [3—5] pieces of [clay/copper ore/tine ore/iron ore/silver ore/coal/gold ore/mithril ore] arriving anytime soon?
Not anytime soon. Or at all. I've given up on looking for them.
translation: Yakinda gelmeyecek. Ya da hic gelmeyecek. Onlari aramaktan vazgectim.

english: Couldn't you decide that in advance? You're certainly lacking in manners!
translation: Bunu önceden karar veremez miydin? Kesinlikle terbiyesizsin!

english: Soon, yes, I hope so.
Good, soon can't be soon enough for me!
translation: Güzel, yakinda benim icin yeterince yakin olamaz!

english: Good news, I got you [3—5] pieces of [clay/copper ore/tine ore/iron ore/silver ore/coal/gold ore/mithril ore]!
And not a minute too late! Great!
translation: Ve bir dakika bile gec kalmadim! Harika!

english: Do you want me to pay you in gold or would you prefer me to teach you a bit about how you can mine more efficiently?
translation: Sana altinla ödeme yapmami mi istersin, yoksa daha verimli madencilik yapmanin yollarini ögretmemi mi tercih edersin?

english: I'd like the gold.
Please teach me that.
That's the spirit! Now, what I need is [3—5] bars of [bronze/iron/silver/steel/gold/mithril]. And I need them within [18—20] minutes as well.
Player: Not much of a quest, but I'll do it. Just [3—5] bars of [bronze/iron/silver/steel/gold/mithril] in [18—20] minutes.
Are my [3—5] bars of [bronze/iron/silver/steel/gold/mithril] arriving anytime soon?
Good news, I got you [3—5] bars of [bronze/iron/silver/steel/gold/mithril]!
Do you want me to pay you in gold or would you like me to show you some smithing tricks?
translation: Sana altinla mi ödeme yapayim, yoksa sana demircilik püf noktalari mi göstereyim?

english: Hands off those gems!
You're the thief! Stop!
Guards, get this filthy human!
Show me the wares!
No thanks.
Yes, I love quests!
No, quests are dull and boring.
Not anytime soon. Or at all.
Soon, yes, I hope so.
I'd like the gold.
Please teach me that.
Even with everything we're going through, I have to admit, that was an impressive fight to behold! I wish I could have joined you, friend. Now, let us return to the Nexus.
translation: Yasadigimiz onca seye ragmen, itiraf etmeliyim ki, bu etkileyici bir dövüstü! Keske sana katilabilseydim dostum. Simdi Nexus'a dönelim.

english: Amascut! She's always been a monster, but she's doing things now I never believed her to be capable of! Had I not let my guard down, she'd surely be regretting her choices by now.
translation: Amascut! O her zaman bir canavardi, ama simdi onun yapabilecegine asla inanmayacagim seyler yapiyor! Eger gardimi düsürmeseydim, simdiye kadar yaptigi secimlerden pisman olurdu.

english: I guess we're lucky you came along when you did, my friend. I think you might have just given us a fighting chance!
translation: Sanirim tam zamaninda geldigin icin sansliyiz, dostum. Bize savasma sansi vermis olabilirsin!

english: I'm glad to have helped, but it's not over yet.
translation: Yardimci olabildigime sevindim, ama henüz bitmedi.

english: Indeed. Were I not still weak, I would gladly deal with her myself, but I fear you will have to face Amascut without me.
translation: Gercekten. Hala zayif olmasaydim, onunla seve seve kendim ilgilenirdim, ama korkarim Amascut ile bensiz yüzlesmen gerekecek.

english: You'll find her on the level below. If you can free the others, we should be able to open the way for you.
translation: Onu bir alt katta bulacaksin. Digerlerini kurtarabilirsen, sana yol acabiliriz.

english: We have opened the way for you, my friend. Any other day, I would have joined you in the fight against Amascut, but this one is up to you. Go now, and show her the error of her ways!
translation: Sana yol actik dostum. Baska bir gün olsaydi, Amascut ile savasinda sana katilirdim, ama bu seferki sana kalmis. Simdi git ve ona hatasini göster!

english: Here he is!
My friend, you managed what few have ever achieved. You overcame Amascut herself! I wish I could have been there to see it!
translation: Dostum, cok az kisinin basardigi bir seyi basardin. Amascut'un kendisini yendin! Keske orada olup bunu görebilseydim!

english: Well I couldn't have done it alone. Speaking of which, where's Scabaras?
translation: Tek basima basaramazdim. Bu arada, Scabaras nerede?

english: Scabaras walks his own path. Do not consider his absence an insult. This is his way.
translation: Scabaras kendi yolunda yürüyor. Onun yoklugunu bir hakaret olarak görme. Bu onun tarzi.

english: Not to mention that he was under Amascut's control far longer than the rest of us. It will take him time to come to terms with his role in her plots.
translation: Amascut'un kontrolü altinda bizimkinden cok daha uzun süre kaldigini da unutma. Onun komplolarindaki rolünü kabullenmesi zaman alacak.

english: Don't worry, he'll be okay. He always is.
translation: Merak etme, o iyi olacak. Her zaman oldugu gibi.

english: Before we go any further... We didn't have much time for conversation back in the tomb. I'm sure you have some questions for us.
translation: Devam etmeden önce... Mezarin icinde konusacak fazla vaktimiz olmadi. Eminim bize soracak sorularin vardir.

english: If you do, now is the time to ask them.
translation: Eger varsa, simdi sormanin tam zamani.

english: I have a question for Apmeken.
What's your role in the Menaphite Pantheon?
I'm Tumeken's avatar of companionship! Tumeken himself was always considered a bit cold, which is a tad ironic when you think about it.
translation: Ben Tumeken'in dostluk avatariyim! Tumeken her zaman biraz soguk biri olarak görülürdü, ki bunu düsündügünde biraz ironik.

english: A cold sun god?
Exactly! Bit odd, right? Still, although he wasn't exactly known for his social side, he still understood the importance of such things. That's why he made me!
translation: Aynen öyle! Biraz tuhaf, degil mi? Yine de, sosyal yönüyle taninmasa da, bu tür seylerin önemini anliyordu. Bu yüzden beni yaratti!

english: My job is to make sure everyone remembers the importance of friendship. After all, we all need a friend or two, or ten, or maybe hundreds! Have as many as you want! I won't judge.
translation: Benim görevim, herkesin dostlugun önemini hatirlamasini saglamak. Sonucta, hepimizin bir ya da iki, ya da on, ya da belki yüzlerce arkadasa ihtiyacimiz var! Istediginiz kadar arkadas edin! Ben yargilamam.

english: Why aren't there more monkeys or apes in the desert?
translation: Cölde neden daha fazla maymun veya goril yok?

english: Ah, you can thank Amascut for that. The desert used to be home to thousands of apes and monkeys, but she targeted them to try and get to me.
translation: Ah, bunun icin Amascut'a tesekkür edebilirsin. Cöl eskiden binlerce goril ve maymuna ev sahipligi yapiyordu, ama o bana ulasmak icin onlari hedef aldi.

english: I'm sorry.
Don't be! Now that I'm back, I know we can turn things around!
translation: Üzülme! Artik geri döndügüme göre, durumu tersine cevirebilecegimizi biliyorum!

english: Actually, I've changed my mind.
Fair enough.
I'll be back soon.
We'll be here when you're ready.
I have a question for Crondis.
I am Tumeken's avatar of resourcefulness.
Meaning?
Meaning my job is to guide the people of the desert not to live lives of excess.
translation: Yani benim görevim, cöl halkina asiri yasamamalari icin rehberlik etmek.

english: Guessing you're not a fan of Menaphos then?
translation: O zaman Menaphos'u pek sevmiyorsun galiba?

english: Much of the desert has forgotten the importance of modesty in my absence, but the situation in Menaphos is definitely the most concerning. Let us hope it can soon be rectified.
translation: Cogu cöl halki benim yoklugumda tevazuun önemini unutmus durumda, ama Menaphos'taki durum kesinlikle en endise verici. Umarim bu durum yakinda düzelir.

english: Why are crocodiles so rude?
Rude? How so.
Well they always try to eat me when I go near them.
translation: Sey, yanlarina yaklastigimda hep beni yemeye calisiyorlar.

english: The life of a crocodile is not an easy one. They must seek food wherever it is available.
translation: Timsahlarin hayati kolay degildir. Yiyecek bulabildikleri her yerde yiyecek aramak zorundadirlar.

english: Besides, I sense you do not speak the whole truth. Did you not befriend a crocodile yourself in times past?
translation: Ayrica, tüm gercegi söylemedigini hissediyorum. Gecmiste bir timsahla arkadas olmadin mi?

english: You mean Roger! I guess he was quite friendly.
translation: Roger'i mi kastediyorsun! Sanirim o oldukca dost canlisiydi.

english: Then perhaps crocodiles are not as rude as you think.
translation: O zaman belki de timsahlar sandigin kadar kaba degildir.

english: As you wish.
We will be here.
I have a question for Het.
I am Tumeken's avatar of health, both physical and mental.
translation: Ben Tumeken'in hem fiziksel hem de zihinsel saglik avatariyim.

english: You talk about strength and fighting a lot. Surely fighting isn't good for someone's health.
translation: Güc ve savasmaktan cok bahsediyorsun. Savasmak birinin sagligi icin iyi degildir.

english: Well when it comes to health, is strength not the ultimate goal? The strongest individual is one who is healthy in both body and mind, and what better way to celebrate that strength than in combat!
translation: Saglik söz konusu oldugunda, güc nihai hedef degil midir? En güclü kisi, hem bedenen hem de zihnen saglikli olandir ve bu gücü kutlamanin savasmaktan daha iyi bir yolu olabilir mi!

english: I guess, but what about those who aren't strong?
translation: Sanirim, ama güclü olmayanlar ne olacak?

english: Well health is not something to be hoarded, is it? Most weaknesses can be overcome, and it is the duty of the strong to help those less fortunate.
translation: Saglik, biriktirilecek bir sey degildir, degil mi? Cogu zayiflik üstesinden gelinebilir ve güclü olanlarin, daha az sansli olanlara yardim etmek görevidir.

english: So they can become strong and healthy themselves?
translation: Böylece onlar da güclü ve saglikli olabilirler mi?

english: Exactly!
An interesting question. Why do you ask?
Considering you have a human appearance, I wondered if that might resonate more with people.
translation: Insan görünümüne sahip oldugunu düsünürsek, bunun insanlara daha cok hitap edip etmeyecegini merak ettim.

english: Not as much as you might think. Believe it or not, in some ways, I'm actually considered a bit boring! Why follow the human when you have a baboon god?
translation: Düsündügün kadar degil. Ister inan ister inanma, bazi yönlerden aslinda biraz sikici bulunuyorum! Babun tanrin varken neden insani takip edesin ki?

english: Especially when the baboon god is so fun to be around!
translation: Özellikle de babun tanrinin yaninda olmak cok eglenceli iken!

english: Of course, people just following one of us was never really the intention anyway. We're a pantheon, and we all have a part to play.
translation: Tabii ki, insanlarin sadece birimizi takip etmesi zaten hicbir zaman amaclanmamisti. Biz bir panteonuz ve hepimizin oynayacagi bir rol var.

english: Now that Amascut is running with her tail between her legs, perhaps we can remind people of that.
translation: Amascut kuyrugunu kistirip kacarken, belki de insanlara bunu hatirlatabiliriz.

english: Very well.
We'll wait for you to return.
I have a question for all of you.
What will happen with Amascut?
I'd say that's up to her. If she doesn't change her ways, her fate won't be pretty.
translation: Bence bu ona bagli. Eger davranislarini degistirmezse, kaderi pek de güzel olmayacak.

english: But it's never too late for redemption. There might still be hope for her.
translation: Ama kurtulus icin asla gec degildir. Hala umut olabilir.

english: Whatever path she takes, we will be ready.
translation: Hangi yolu secerse secsin, biz hazir olacagiz.

english: Do you really think she'd change her ways at this point?
translation: Bu noktada davranislarini degistirecegini gercekten düsünüyor musun?

english: It seems unlikely, but there is one who might be able to change that.
translation: Olasi görünmüyor, ama bunu degistirebilecek biri var.

english: Who?
Icthlarin! If anyone can help Amascut find her way again, it's him!
translation: Icthlarin! Amascut'un yolunu bulmasina yardim edebilecek biri varsa, o da odur!

english: He doesn't seem to have been doing much to help so far.
translation: Simdiye kadar pek yardim etmis gibi görünmüyor.

english: Icthlarin is limited in what he can do. His duties to the dead require constant attention.
translation: Icthlarin'in yapabilecekleri sinirli. Ölüler icin görevleri sürekli dikkat gerektiriyor.

english: Not to mention the pact!
Pact?
That is not for us to discuss.
translation: Bu bizim tartisacagimiz bir konu degil.

english: Oh yes, sorry. Maybe we should talk about something else.
translation: Evet, özür dilerim. Belki baska bir sey hakkinda konusmaliyiz.

english: Are you actually gods?
If you asked a citizen of these lands, I'm sure they'd probably say yes.
translation: Bu topraklardaki bir vatandasa sorsaydin, muhtemelen evet derdi.

english: Indeed, but they would not be truly correct.
translation: Dogru, ama tam olarak dogru olmazdi.

english: How so?
Tumeken made us using his own divine essence! Each of us is a piece of him!
translation: Tumeken bizi kendi ilahi özünü kullanarak yaratti! Her birimiz onun bir parcasiyiz!

english: But that does not make us gods. While great, our power is insignificant compared to a true god. That is why they are gone, and we remain.
translation: Ama bu bizi tanri yapmaz. Gücümüz büyük olsa da, gercek bir tanriya kiyasla önemsizdir. Bu yüzden onlar gitti, biz kaldik.

english: So what are you really?
You might hear some refer to us as the Avatars of Tumeken. We'd consider that a more fitting title.
translation: Bazilari bizi Tumeken'in Avatarlari olarak adlandirir. Biz de bu unvani daha uygun buluyoruz.

english: What about Icthlarin and Amascut?
Tumeken made them too. Difference is, they also have some of Elidinis' divine essence, making them a lot more powerful!
translation: Onlari da Tumeken yaratti. Farki, onlarin Elidinis'in ilahi özünden de bir parca icermeleri, bu da onlari cok daha güclü kiliyor!

english: But again, they are not true gods.
translation: Ama yine de, onlar gercek tanrilar degiller.

english: Amascut was hoping to change that today, but you showed her where to stick that plan!
translation: Amascut bugün bunu degistirmek istiyordu, ama sen ona o plani nereye sokacagini gösterdin!

english: So what happens now?
We are the Avatars of Tumeken, and the Kharidian Desert has been without guidance for too long. It is time we fixed that.
translation: Biz Tumeken'in Avatarlariyiz ve Kharidian Cölü cok uzun süredir rehberlikten yoksun. Bunu düzeltmenin zamani geldi.

english: We're going to get started right away!
But don't worry, we don't intend to miss the fight against Amascut. I hope you'll stand alongside us when that day comes.
translation: Ama merak etme, Amascut'la olan savasi kacirmak niyetinde degiliz. O gün geldiginde bizimle birlikte olacagini umuyorum.

english: For now though, this is goodbye. We will meet again, human.
translation: Simdilik hosca kal. Tekrar görüsecegiz, insan.

english: It was great to meet you. Thank you for helping us!
translation: Tanistigimiza memnun oldum. Yardim ettiginiz icin tesekkürler!

english: The avatars depart.
You're back!
If you have questions, now is the time to ask them.
translation: Sorulariniz varsa, simdi sormak icin uygun zaman.

english: I have a question for Apmeken.
What's your role in the Menaphite Pantheon?
Why aren't there more monkeys or apes in the desert?
translation: Cölde neden daha fazla maymun veya goril yok?

english: Actually, I've changed my mind.
I'll be back soon.
I have a question for Crondis.
Why are crocodiles so rude?
I have a question for Het.
Do you have more followers than the others?
translation: Digerlerinden daha fazla takipcin var mi?

english: I have a question for all of you.
What will happen with Amascut?
Are you actually gods?
So what happens now?
How's your magic coming along?
I'm practicing and slowly getting better.
translation: Pratik yapiyorum ve yavas yavas gelisiyorum.

english: Good, good.
Help! Help!
What has happened here?
We were invited to a house party on an island not far from here... Something felt wrong about the whole thing but we went anyway...
translation: Buraya yakin bir adada bir ev partisine davet edildik... Her seyde bir terslik vardi ama yine de gittik...

english: The house seemed pretty creepy, but everything was going fine, we were all having a good time...
translation: Ev oldukca ürkütücü görünüyordu ama her sey yolunda gidiyordu, hepimiz iyi vakit geciriyorduk...

english: ...and that's when we got attacked...
I... I tried to save her...
Hewey bought me enough time to find an old boat. I went back to get him but it was too late. I'm scared that he won't make it.
translation: Hewey bana eski bir tekne bulmam icin yeterince zaman kazandirdi. Onu almaya geri döndüm ama cok gecti. Kurtulamayacagindan korkuyorum.

english: You have to do something... they can't get away with this!
translation: Bir seyler yapmalisin... Bu isten pacayi kurtaramazlar!

english: What do you want me to do?
I'm not getting involved in this!
That psycho is still out there, you have to bring them to justice.
translation: O psikopat hala disarida, onu adalete teslim etmelisin.

english: The boat we escaped on is just over there, you can use it to get to the island.
translation: Kactigimiz tekne surada, onu kullanarak adaya ulasabilirsin.

english: Okay, I'll see what I can do.
Urgh...I think I may have underestimated you.
You've lost at your own game. And now it is time to see who you really are under that mask!
translation: Kendi oyununda kaybettin. Simdi maskenin altinda gercekte kim oldugunu görme zamani!

english: The player unmasks the killer, revealing Abigale as the culprit.
translation: Oyuncu katilin maskesini cikarir ve Abigale'in suclu oldugunu ortaya cikarir.

english: No! You!? But why!? Why on earth would you kill all your friends!? Why beg me to come here to help them!?
translation: Hayir! Sen mi!? Ama neden!? Neden tüm arkadaslarini öldürdün!? Neden buraya gelip onlara yardim etmem icin yalvardin!?

english: You just don't get it do you?
So big headed. So used to it all being about you. About you saving the day.
translation: Cok kibirli. Her seyin seninle ilgili olmasina alismissin. Her seyi senin kurtarmana.

english: Well I'm sick of it!
What do you mean?
Adventurers! You're all the same. Everything always has to be about you.
translation: Maceracilar! Hepiniz aynisiniz. Her sey her zaman sizinle ilgili olmak zorunda.

english: I don't understand?
Of course you wouldn't! Because you can't see past yourself!
translation: Tabii ki anlamazsin! Cünkü kendi ötesini göremezsin!

english: Believe it or not... I used to be like you.
translation: Ister inan ister inanma... Ben de eskiden senin gibiydim.

english: I'd hear about some damsel in distress and go to help. To have my moment. For me to be the hero, just for once.
