translation: Tehlikede olan bir kiz duydugumda yardima giderdim. Kendi animi yasamak icin. Bir kez olsun kahraman olmak icin.

english: But YOU! You and every other darned adventurer! Every time I get there to help, it's too late. Crisis solved. Disaster averted. Reward claimed. Every time you and those other adventurers steal my moment!
translation: Ama SEN! Sen ve diger tüm lanet olasi maceracilar! Ne zaman yardim etmeye gitsem, cok gec kaliyorum. Kriz cözülmüs oluyor. Felaket önlenmis oluyor. Ödül alinmis oluyor. Her seferinde sen ve diger maceracilar benim animi caliyor!

english: But not this time!
This time, it is all about me! I'm the star of the show! ME ME ME ME ME!
translation: Bu sefer her sey benimle ilgili! Gösterinin yildizi benim! BEN BEN BEN BEN BEN!

english: Well not any longer. The show is over, and there will be no curtain call.
translation: Artik degil. Gösteri bitti ve perde kapanmayacak.

english: Oh, but there is always a curtain call.
Another killer comes out of the closest near the door.
translation: Kapinin yanindaki dolaptan baska bir katil cikar.

english: What!? How!? There was another killer!?
translation: Ne!? Nasil!? Baska bir katil mi vardi!?

english: Of course. Every good show needs a good supporting actor. Now, take off your mask darling. Take a bow. You have earned it.
translation: Tabii ki. Her iyi gösterinin iyi bir yardimci oyuncusu olmasi gerekir. Simdi maskeni cikar sevgilim. Selam ver. Bunu hak ettin.

english: Of course, my love.
The killer unmasks himself, revealing Hewey as the culprit.
translation: Katil maskesini cikarir ve Hewey'in suclu oldugunu ortaya cikarir.

english: You!? But how!? You were almost dead when I saw you! I saw your wounds!
translation: Sen mi!? Ama nasil!? Seni gördügümde neredeyse ölmüstün! Yaralarini gördüm!

english: No, what you watched was what we wanted you to watch. A masterful performance if I do say myself.
translation: Hayir, senin gördügün sey bizim senin görmeni istedigimiz seydi. Kendim söyleyeyim, ustaca bir performansdi.

english: But what is in this for you?
translation: Peki bunun sana ne faydasi var?

english: Everyone loves the limelight, and who better to share it with than my beloved Abigale.
translation: Herkes spot isiklarini sever ve bunu sevgili Abigale'den daha iyi kimle paylasabilirim ki?

english: But your friends?
They didn't deserve to die!
Perhaps not, but neither did I deserve to be cast back into the shadows when I deserve the spotlight!
translation: Belki hak etmediler, ama ben de spot isiklarini hak ettigim halde gölgelere geri atilmayi hak etmedim!

english: Yes, while we deserve the spotlight.
translation: Evet, biz spot isigini hak ediyoruz.

english: And now I have my starring role!
OUR starring role.
Gielinor will forever remember this night and what I have done here.
translation: Gielinor bu geceyi ve burada yaptiklarimi sonsuza kadar hatirlayacak.

english: No, what WE have done!
Quiet Hewey! This is my moment!
translation: Sessiz ol Hewey! Bu benim anim!

english: No, this is supposed to be our moment! It isn't just all about you either! We were in this together!
translation: Hayir, bu bizim animiz olmali! Bu sadece seninle ilgili degil! Biz bu iste birlikteydik!

english: Stop ruining this Hewey! I have worked so hard for this and I'm not going to let you take it away from me!
translation: Bunu mahvetmeyi birak Hewey! Bunun icin cok calistim ve bunu benden almana izin vermeyecegim!

english: Well I'm not going to be pushed aside either, we were both in this as equals!
translation: Ben de kenara itilmeyecegim, ikimiz de esit olarak bu isin icindeydik!

english: We were never equals! How could you possibly compare to me!?
translation: Asla esit olmadik! Sen benimle nasil kiyaslanabilirsin ki?

english: You egotistical, selfish...
Abigale stabs Hewey.
No...my love...
Hewey dies.
No....no...what have I done!?
It wasn't supposed to be like this...but you just couldn't let me have my moment. WHY HEWEY WHY!? I loved you...
translation: Böyle olmamaliydi... ama sen benim animi yasamama izin vermedin. NEDEN HEWEY NEDEN!? Seni seviyordum...

english: This could be my chance to take advantage of the situation...
translation: Bu durumdan yararlanmak icin bir firsat olabilir...

english: What has happened here?
What do you want me to do?
I'm not getting involved.
Welcome to Hickton's Archery Store. Do you want to see my wares?
translation: Hickton'in Okculuk Magazasina hos geldiniz. Ürünlerimi görmek ister misiniz?

english: Can you tell me about your cape?
Certainly! Skillcapes are a symbol of achievement. Only people who have mastered a skill and reached level 99 can get their hands on them and gain the benefits they carry.
translation: Elbette! Beceri pelerinleri basari sembolüdür. Sadece bir beceriyi ustalastirip 99. seviyeye ulasan kisiler bu pelerinleri elde edebilir ve sagladiklari avantajlardan yararlanabilir.

english: The Cape of Fletching can be searched for a mithril grapple and crossbow three times every day. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Okculuk Pelerini'nde her gün üc kez mithril kanca ve tatar yayi aranabilir. Baska yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: No thank you.
No, I prefer to bash things close up.
translation: Hayir, yakin mesafeden vurmayi tercih ederim.

english: I have a question for you.
Please enter the answer to the question.
No, try again.
Correct!
Can you tell me about your cape?
I'd like to view your store please.
No thank you.
Yes, please.
No, I prefer to bash things close up.
translation: Hayir, yakin mesafeden vurmayi tercih ederim.

english: Hey, down there! What is it?
Why are you here?
For the dragons, of course! I've always wanted to slay dragons. I've found they're a bit tough, though, even with all this kit I've got, but I'll slay them one day.
translation: Tabii ki ejderhalar icin! Her zaman ejderhalari öldürmek istemisimdir. Ancak, tüm bu ekipmanlara ragmen biraz zor olduklarini fark ettim, ama bir gün onlari öldürecegim.

english: My little cousin is a Slayer Master, lucky girl. But one day I'll be a mighty dragon-slayer, and they'll give me a job like that too.
translation: Kücük kuzenim bir Avci Ustasi, sansli kiz. Ama bir gün ben de güclü bir ejderha avcisi olacagim ve bana da böyle bir is verecekler.

english: My little brother became a Slayer Master recently. That job should have been mine - he's just a little brat! But one day I'll be a mighty dragon-slayer, and they'll give me a job like that too.
translation: Kücük kardesim yakin zamanda Avci Ustasi oldu. O is benim olmaliydi, o sadece kücük bir velet! Ama bir gün ben de güclü bir ejderha avcisi olacagim ve bana da böyle bir is verecekler.

english: Can I kill the dragons in here?
Yes, certainly, since you've been assigned to do so.
translation: Evet, elbette, cünkü sana bu görev verildi.

english: No, you haven't got an assignment to slay these dragons. Go and train somewhere else.
translation: Hayir, bu ejderhalari öldürmek icin bir görev almadin. Git baska bir yerde antrenman yap.

english: I'll be off.
I'm sure that's not what you're meant to be slaying.
translation: Eminim öldürmen gereken sey bu degildir.

english: Why are you here?
Can I kill the dragons in here?
I'll be off.
Many greetings. Welcome to our fair island.
Enjoy your stay here. May it be spiritually uplifting!
translation: Burada iyi vakit gecir. Ruhen arinman dilegiyle!

english: I've got a message for you from the Wise Old Man in Draynor Village.
translation: Draynor Köyü'ndeki Bilge Yasli Adam'dan sana bir mesajim var.

english: How kind of you to bring me a message to this remote island!
translation: Bu uzak adaya mesajimi getirmene ne kadar da naziksin!

english: I don't have much in the way of wealth, but I can spare you a few coins for your trouble.
translation: Fazla servetim yok ama zahmetin icin sana birkac sikke verebilirim.

english: In the name of Saradomin I shall bless you...
Here, let me give you some herbs.
translation: Iste, sana biraz sifali ot vereyim.

english: The beasts which dwell under this island occasionally drop gems when they die - please take this one as a sign of my gratitude.
translation: Bu adanin altinda yasayan canavarlar öldüklerinde bazen mücevherler birakirlar - lütfen bunu minnettarligimin bir göstergesi olarak kabul et.

english: Hi, I was wondering, can you quickly bless this for me?
translation: Merhaba, acaba bunu benim icin hizlica kutsayabilir misin?

english: A somewhat strange request, but I see no harm in... Wait a moment... is that BLOOD?
translation: Biraz garip bir istek, ama bir zarari yok... Bir dakika... O kan mi?

english: Erm... yes...
Why do you want me to bless a pot full of someones blood???
translation: Neden birinin kaniyla dolu bir kabi kutsamami istiyorsun???

english: Oh, don't worry, it's not 'someones', it's my own!
translation: Oh, merak etme, “birinin” degil, benim kanim!

english: I... see... Well it is an unusual thing, but I see no harm in it. Take this, and walk in peace with Saradomin.
translation: Anliyorum... Bu alisilmadik bir sey, ama bir zarari yok. Al bunu ve Saradomin ile huzur icinde yürü.

english: If the player receives an uncut emerald:
If the player receives an uncut diamond:
If the player receives an uncut red topaz:
If the player receives an uncut sapphire:
Hello again. How can I help you?
How are things going here?
Things are slowly coming back to life in our city of the dead. The bank under the Temple of the Lesser Gods has been restored, and a number of our merchants have reopened their stalls.
translation: Ölüler sehrimizde hayat yavas yavas normale dönüyor. Kücük Tanrilar Tapinagi'nin altindaki banka restore edildi ve bircok tüccar tezgahlarini yeniden acti.

english: What about the plagues?
We're making progress on them. With our citizens back, we had enough people to finally deal with the frogs and locusts that were filling the town up.
translation: Bu konuda ilerleme kaydediyoruz. Vatandaslarimiz geri döndügü icin, sehri dolduran kurbagalar ve cekirgelerle nihayet basa cikacak kadar insanimiz oldu.

english: We worried they'd just come back, but perhaps we have managed to appease whichever god sent them.
translation: Geri döneceklerinden endiseleniyorduk, ama belki de onlari gönderen tanriyi yatistirmayi basardik.

english: The infected cows have been handled as well. The only plague left now is this infuriating pox. Still, at least it isn't contagious.
translation: Enfekte olmus inekler de halledildi. Simdi geriye kalan tek veba, bu sinir bozucu cicek hastaligi. Yine de, en azindan bulasici degil.

english: Any sign of Menaphos opening up again?
translation: Menaphos'un yeniden acilacagina dair bir isaret var mi?

english: They are adamant that their city must remain closed until all the plagues have gone. Until we can get rid of the pox, I can't see their gates opening to us, or to anyone else.
translation: Tüm vebalar ortadan kalkana kadar sehirlerinin kapali kalmasi gerektigi konusunda kararlilar. Cicek hastaligini ortadan kaldirana kadar, kapilarinin bize veya baska birine acilacagini sanmiyorum.

english: Well at least things are moving in the right direction.
translation: En azindan isler dogru yönde ilerliyor.

english: Indeed. Now, is there anything else I can do for you?
translation: Gercekten de öyle. Peki, sizin icin yapabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: Could I have another lamp?
I'm afraid I only had the one.
No. I should get going.
Hello again.
Wonderful! The city of the dead has fully come back to life, and it's all thanks to you!
translation: Harika! Ölüler sehri tamamen hayata döndü ve hepsi senin sayende!

english: Well I'm happy to have helped. Any news from Menaphos?
translation: Yardimci olabildigime sevindim. Menaphos'tan haber var mi?

english: They are continuing their preparations. It will take some time, but the city will soon be open once more.
translation: Hazirliklarina devam ediyorlar. Biraz zaman alacak ama sehir yakinda tekrar acilacak.

english: Great!
Could I have another circlet?
Certainly, though it will cost you 10,000 coins.
Here you go.
You don't seem to have enough money for it.
translation: Bunun icin yeterli paraniz yok gibi görünüyor.

english: Oh...
That's too much.
Fair enough. Let me know if you change your mind.
translation: Anliyorum. Fikrinizi degistirirseniz bana haber verin.

english: I should get going.
Until next time.
Hey, hey, hey! What in the name of sweet suffering Icthlarin are you doing?
translation: Hey, hey, hey! Tatli aci ceken Icthlarin adina ne yapiyorsun?

english: I thought this acne potion might clear up your spots.
translation: Bu sivilce iksiri sivilcelerini temizleyebilir diye düsündüm.

english: All that you'll achieve by pouring that potion on me is to ruin my lovely robes.
translation: O iksiri üzerime dökerek tek basaracagin sey, güzel cüppemi mahvetmek olacak.

english: Sorry, I was just trying to help.
Hey there. I was wondering if you could do me a favour?
translation: Merhaba. Bana bir iyilik yapabilir misin?

english: Oh? What kind of favour?
I know cremation isn't your way, but is there anything you could do with these ashes?
translation: Kremasyon sizin geleneklerinizde yok biliyorum, ama bu küllerle yapabileceginiz bir sey var mi?

english: Well, like you say, it is not really our way. Still, with all you've done for us, I'm willing to try.
translation: Dedigin gibi, bizim geleneklerimizde yok. Yine de, bizim icin yaptiklarindan dolayi denemeye hazirim.

english: That's all I ask. Thank you.
Could I have another lamp?
No. I should get going.
How are things going here?
Could I have another circlet?
Here you go.
That's too much.
I should get going.
Hello again.
Hello, adventurer. Thank you for freeing me from the Devourer. I would be alone now. Scabaras teaches us to remain isolated, and I have much to think about.
translation: Merhaba, maceraci. Beni Yiyici'den kurtardigin icin tesekkürler. Simdi yalniz kalacaktim. Scabaras bize izole kalmayi ögretir ve benim düsünecek cok seyim var.

english: Adventurer... what is this? It looks like a scarab egg, but is unlike any I've seen before.
translation: Maceraci... bu nedir? Bir bokböcegi yumurtasina benziyor, ama daha önce gördüklerime benzemiyor.

english: To be honest, I'm not sure, but I think you should have it. It has more hope of hatching with you than with me.
translation: Dürüst olmak gerekirse, emin degilim, ama bence sen almalisin. Seninle birlikte yumurtadan cikma sansi benimle birlikte oldugundan daha fazla.

english: Thank you, adventurer. I know not what will come of this, but I feel you have done the right thing. May Scabaras continue to guide you.
translation: Tesekkürler, maceraci. Bunun sonucu ne olacak bilmiyorum, ama dogru seyi yaptigini hissediyorum. Scabaras sana rehberlik etmeye devam etsin.

english: Intruder! You are not welcome here!
Fear not! I am here to rescue you!
Kill him!
Wait! Majaan, Manand...
Silence! Champion, protect your High Priest!
Fine. We'll do it your way.
Stay back!
Majaan, Manand, Almuk.
Argh!
What... What happened?
It's alright. You were being controlled by Amascut, but you're free now.
translation: Sorun yok. Amascut tarafindan kontrol ediliyordun, ama artik özgürsün.

english: I... I don't remember.
I've been in your position. Don't worry, your memories will come back in time. Familiar places and objects can help them come back faster.
translation: Ben de senin yerindeydim. Merak etme, zamanla hatiralarin geri gelecektir. Tanidik yerler ve nesneler hatiralarinin daha hizli geri gelmesine yardimci olabilir.

english: This room is familiar... as I look around, I feel something stirring...
translation: Bu oda tanidik geliyor... Etrafa bakindigimda, bir seylerin hareket ettigini hissediyorum...

english: Yes, I can see it now! There are a few gaps, but it's all coming back to me. Thank you, adventurer.
translation: Evet, simdi anliyorum! Bazi bosluklar var ama her sey hatirlamaya basladim. Tesekkürler, maceraci.

english: There is much for me to set right. We have made some terrible mistakes.
translation: Düzeltmem gereken cok sey var. Bazi korkunc hatalar yaptik.

english: I know the feeling. What did she have you do?
translation: O duyguyu bilirim. Sana ne yaptirdi?

english: Many things. I have been under her control my whole life. It was the same for my predecessor, and her predecessor as well. We were all slaves to the Devourer, even our lord himself.
translation: Bircok sey. Hayatim boyunca onun kontrolü altindaydim. Önceki liderim ve onun öncekisi de ayniydi. Hepimiz Yiyici'nin kölesiydik, efendimiz bile.

english: She controls Scabaras?
Yes. She used him as her puppet for centuries, but now she has a new plan for him.
translation: Evet. Onu yüzyillar boyunca kuklasi olarak kullandi, ama simdi onun icin yeni bir plani var.

english: What new plan?
I don't know. She took him into some tomb, along with the others.
translation: Bilmiyorum. Onu digerleriyle birlikte bir mezara götürdü.

english: Osmumten's tomb. Who are these others you speak of?
Apmeken, Crondis and Het. The other avatars of Tumeken.
translation: Apmeken, Crondis ve Het. Tumeken'in diger avatarlari.

english: She has them all?
She does. We helped her capture them. It took many lifetimes, but she was able to fool them all.
translation: Evet. Onlari yakalamasina yardim ettik. Cok uzun zaman aldi, ama hepsini kandirmayi basardi.

english: This isn't good. There're weapons in that tomb that can transfer divine power between beings. She must be planning to use them on the lesser deities.
translation: Bu hic iyi degil. O mezarda, varliklar arasinda ilahi gücü aktarabilen silahlar var. Onlari daha düsük tanrilar üzerinde kullanmayi planliyor olmali.

english: The four of them all came from Tumeken himself. Their power is his power. If she claims that power as her own, she will become a true goddess...
translation: Dördü de Tumeken'in kendisinden geliyor. Onlarin gücü, onun gücüdür. O gücü kendine mal ederse, gercek bir tanrica haline gelecektir...

english: Don't worry, I'll make sure that doesn't happen.
translation: Merak etme, bunun olmamasi icin elimden geleni yapacagim.

english: How can you hope to withstand her power?
translation: Onun gücüne nasil karsi koymayi umuyorsun?

english: I'll find a way. Do you have any other information that can help me?
translation: Bir yolunu bulacagim. Bana yardimci olabilecek baska bir bilgin var mi?

english: We were not the only ones to fall to the Devourer. She has control over Pharaoh Kemesis of Menaphos.
translation: Yiyici'ye yenilenler sadece biz degildik. Menaphos'un Firavunu Kemesis'i de kontrolü altinda tutuyor.

english: We feared as much. Do you know what she wants with him?
translation: Biz de öyle korkuyorduk. Ondan ne istedigini biliyor musun?

english: She needed control over the city, but she kept the reason a secret. She even had us release locusts and frogs into Sophanem so she could have Menaphos locked down.
translation: Sehri kontrol altina almak istiyordu, ama nedenini gizli tuttu. Menaphos'u kapatabilmek icin Sophanem'e cekirge ve kurbaga salmamizi bile sagladi.

english: You caused the plagues? The cows and the pox as well?
translation: Salginlari siz mi yarattiniz? Inekleri ve cicek hastaligini da mi?

english: We did also poison the cows. I know nothing of this pox, though.
translation: Inekleri de zehirledik. Ama cicek hastaligi hakkinda hicbir sey bilmiyorum.

english: Hmm... what will you do now?
I fear many of my people are forever lost, but I will save as many as I can. Together, we will reform the Sect of Scabaras, and right the wrongs of the Devourer.
translation: Korkarim halkimin cogu sonsuza dek kayboldu, ama kurtarabildigim kadarini kurtaracagim. Birlikte Scabaras Tarikati'ni yeniden kuracagiz ve Devourer'in yaptiklarini düzeltecegiz.

english: So you'll help me fight her?
translation: Yani onunla savasmama yardim edecek misin?

english: In our own way. Before the Devourer, we were an isolated people, just as Scabaras taught us to be. We will go back to that way of life.
translation: Kendi yöntemimizle. Yiyici'den önce, Scabaras'in bize ögrettigi gibi izole bir halkdik. O yasam tarzina geri dönecegiz.

english: We may go unseen, but we will be there, fighting the forces of the Devourer wherever they appear.
translation: Görünmez olabiliriz, ama orada olacagiz ve Yiyici'nin gücleriyle nerede ortaya cikarlarsa orada savasacagiz.

english: Good to hear. Now, I'd better head over to Nardah. I have a friend there who needs to hear about all of this.
translation: Bunu duymak güzel. Simdi Nardah'a gitsem iyi olacak. Orada tüm bunlari duymasi gereken bir arkadasim var.

english: Good luck in your fight, adventurer. May Scabaras guide you.
translation: Mücadelenizde bol sans, maceraci. Scabaras size rehberlik etsin.

english: You offered yourself to Zulrah as a sacrifice, yet here you stand before me. Did Zulrah reject you?
translation: Kendini Zulrah'a kurban olarak sundun, ama hala karsimda duruyorsun. Zulrah seni reddetti mi?

english: I kinda left the shrine.
Perhaps you should try offering yourself again, before the mighty Zulrah grows impatient.
translation: Güclü Zulrah sabirsizlanmadan önce kendini tekrar kurban olarak sunmayi denemelisin.

english: I killed Zulrah.
Very funny, human, but I find that hard to believe. Go and offer yourself as a sacrifice again, before the mighty Zulrah grows impatient.
translation: Cok komik, insan, ama buna inanmak zor. Güclü Zulrah sabirsizlanmadan önce gidip kendini tekrar kurban et.

english: Have you any advice for surviving against Zulrah?
translation: Zulrah'a karsi hayatta kalmak icin herhangi bir tavsiyen var mi?

english: I think you have misunderstood the nature of the sacrifice, human. Never mind, the mighty Zulrah will make the matter clear to you.
translation: Sanirim kurbanin dogasini yanlis anladin, insan. Bos ver, güclü Zulrah sana bu konuyu aciklayacaktir.

english: Tell me about Zulrah.
Zulrah is the all-powerful snake god of the southern wastes. He rises from the swamp to show his divine majesty and to accept our homage.
translation: Zulrah, güney cöllerinin tüm gücü elinde tutan yilan tanrisidir. Batakliktan yükselir, ilahi ihtisamini gösterir ve bizim saygimizi kabul eder.

english: Long ago, our forebears came to this place, not realising that they were trespassing in Zulrah's domain. He arose from the swamp in wrath, and many were slain.
translation: Uzun zaman önce, atalarimiz buraya geldiler, Zulrah'in topraklarina izinsiz girdiklerinin farkinda degillerdi. Zulrah öfkeyle batakliktan yükseldi ve bircok kisi öldürüldü.

english: But Zulrah, in his mercy, allowed some of those transgressors to live, sparing them the punishment they deserved, and allowing them the chance to repent.
translation: Ancak Zulrah, merhametiyle, bu ihlalcilerin bir kisminin yasamasina izin verdi, hak ettikleri cezayi onlara vermedi ve tövbe etme sansi tanidi.

english: Then my mother, oldest and wisest of the tribe, dared to intercede with the mighty Zulrah on behalf of her people, and thus a sacred contract was declared.
translation: Sonra kabilenin en yasli ve en bilge üyesi olan annem, halki adina güclü Zulrah'a aracilik etmeye cesaret etti ve böylece kutsal bir anlasma ilan edildi.

english: Zulrah granted us the right to dwell in his lands, and to eat of their bounty. None shall ever drive us out, for Zulrah protects us.
translation: Zulrah bize topraklarinda yasama ve onlarin bereketinden yararlanma hakki verdi. Zulrah bizi korudugu icin kimse bizi buradan kovamaz.

english: All he asks in return is a periodic sacrifice at his sacred shrine. As long as the sacrifices continue, Zulrah will let us live peacefully in his lands.
translation: Karsiliginda tek istedigi, kutsal tapinaginda düzenli olarak kurban sunulmasidir. Kurbanlar devam ettigi sürece, Zulrah topraklarinda baris icinde yasamamiza izin verecektir.

english: Willing volunteers are never hard to find, for their sacrifice buys peace for the tribe, and I grant their families extra rations of food.
translation: Gönüllüler bulmak hic de zor degildir, cünkü onlarin kurbanlari kabileye baris getirir ve ben de ailelerine ekstra yiyecek payi veririm.

english: Who are you all?
The southern wastes are a perilous place where travellers often become lost. Elves from the woodland villages, gnomes from the eastern caves, and many others.
translation: Güney cöller, gezginlerin sik sik kayboldugu tehlikeli bir yerdir. Orman köylerinden gelen elfler, dogudaki magaralardan gelen cüceler ve daha bircoklari.

english: Some find their way here, like my forebears did. They eat of the sacred swamp eels that Zulrah sends, and become one with the tribe.
translation: Bazilari, atalarimin yaptigi gibi buraya gelirler. Zulrah'in gönderdigi kutsal bataklik yilanbaliklarini yerler ve kabileyle bir olurlar.

english: Their original families and tribes shun them as unclean creatures once they have tasted of the sacred swamp eels, so they remain here to worship Zulrah.
translation: Kutsal bataklik yilanbaliklarini tattiktan sonra, aileleri ve kabileleri onlari kirli yaratiklar olarak görür ve dislar, bu yüzden Zulrah'a tapinmak icin burada kalirlar.

english: I'm off.
Do you wish me to tell you more of Zulrah, human?
translation: Zulrah hakkinda daha fazla bilgi vermek ister misin, insan?

english: Why do you bother the High Priestess of Zulrah, human?
translation: Neden Zulrah'in Bas Rahibesini rahatsiz ediyorsun, insan?

english: How do people get chosen as a sacrifice to Zulrah?
translation: Insanlar Zulrah'a kurban olarak nasil seciliyor?

english: Volunteers offer themselves gladly, knowing that their sacrifice is for the good of the tribe. Also, I grant their families extra rations of food.
translation: Gönüllüler, kurbanlarinin kabilenin iyiligi icin oldugunu bilerek seve seve kendilerini sunuyorlar. Ayrica, ailelerine ekstra yiyecek payi veriyorum.

english: The next sacrifice is a brave gnome who has just come of age. He waits by the boat now.
translation: Bir sonraki kurban, resit olmus cesur bir cüce. Su anda teknenin yaninda bekliyor.

english: I won't let you sacrifice him - take me instead!
translation: Onu kurban etmesine izin vermeyecegim - onun yerine beni al!

english: You would offer yourself as a sacrifice in his place? Your dedication to Zulrah must be truly profound to make such an offer...
translation: Onun yerine kendini kurban olarak sunmak mi istiyorsun? Zulrah'a olan bagliligin böyle bir teklifte bulunacak kadar derin olmali......

english: ... and I accept. You shall be our next sacrifice. Board the boat when you are ready, and give glory to Zulrah through your death.
translation: ... ve kabul ediyorum. Sen bizim bir sonraki kurbanimiz olacaksin. Hazir oldugunda gemiye bin ve ölümünle Zulrah'a sükranlarini sun.

english: I see you have not yet offered yourself as a sacrifice to Zulrah, human. Climb into the boat, and the priestess will deliver you to the shrine.
translation: Görüyorum ki henüz Zulrah'a kurban olarak kendini sunmamissin, insan. Gemiye bin, rahibe seni tapinaga götürecek.

english: I kinda left the shrine.
I killed Zulrah.
Have you any advice for surviving against Zulrah?
translation: Zulrah'a karsi hayatta kalmak icin herhangi bir tavsiyen var mi?

english: Tell me about Zulrah.
Who are you all?
I'm off.
How do people get chosen as a sacrifice to Zulrah?
translation: Insanlar Zulrah'a kurban olarak nasil seciliyor?

english: I won't let you sacrifice him - take me instead!
translation: Onu kurban etmenize izin vermeyecegim, onun yerine beni alin!

english: Ah, good day to you, human. It's always a pleasure to have the company of your kind in our city.
translation: Ah, günaydin insan. Sizin gibilerin sehrimizde olmasi her zaman bir zevktir.

english: I'd love to stop and chat with you, but I'm afraid I'm very busy. I have no doubt that you also have plenty of things you need to be doing yourself. Don't let me keep you from them.
translation: Durup sizinle sohbet etmek isterdim, ama maalesef çok mesgulüm. Sizin de yapmaniz gereken birçok isiniz olduguna süphem yok. Sizi bu islerden alikoymayayim.

english: Stand and deliver!
Hi!
Let me at 'em!
Trolls? Schmolls!
The trolls are coming!
The trolls took my baby son!
Welcome to Burthorpe!
Thanks!
Trolls!
Hello stranger.
Go away!
Run!
Hi!
The Imperial Guard can no longer protect us!
The White Knights will soon have control!
translation: Beyaz Sövalyeler yakinda kontrolü ele gecirecek!

english: I heard about what you did, thank you!
The White Knights are still going to take over.
translation: Beyaz Sövalyeler yine de kontrolü ele gecirecek.

english: I hear the Imperial Guard are preparing an attack!
translation: Imparatorluk Muhafizlarinin bir saldiri hazirligi yaptigini duydum!

english: Thank you so much!
Surely we are safe now!
I've lost my enchanted Amulet of Catspeak.
This can be rectified, simply bring me another Amulet of Catspeak and five death runes and I will enchant it for you.
translation: Bu düzeltilebilir, bana baska bir Kedi Dili Tilsimi ve bes ölüm runesi getir, ben de senin icin büyülerim.

english: I don't have the five death runes on me.
Come back to me when you have them.
I have the runes but don't have the amulet on me.
translation: Runes var ama tilsim yanimda degil.

english: Bring me the amulet and I will enchant it for you.
translation: Tilsimi getir, ben de senin icin büyülerim.

english: I have the death runes with me now.
Good. Give me the amulet so that I may perform the enchantment.
translation: Güzel. Büyü yapabilmem icin bana muskayi ver.

english: Using the enchanted amulet is easy; open up the amulet and you'll see a cat's face, use the whiskers to rotate the cats nose. You'll see the nose move and the new direction highlighted. When the nose points in the
translation: Büyülü muskayi kullanmak kolaydir; muskayi actiginda bir kedi yüzü göreceksin, biyiklari kullanarak kedinin burnunu döndür. Burnun hareket ettigini ve yeni yönün vurgulandigini göreceksin. Burun Bob'un bulundugu

english: direction that Bob is in, the eyes will light up and the mouth will open. You'll need to head in that direction and then check the direction again. If you are very close to Bob then the eyes and mouth will animate no
translation: yöne baktiginda, gözler parlayacak ve agiz acilacaktir. O yöne dogru gitmen ve sonra yönü tekrar kontrol etmen gerekecek. Bob'a cok yakinsan, burun hangi yöne bakarsa baksin gözler ve agiz hareket edecektir.

english: matter which way the nose is pointing. That's all there is to it, good luck!
Hello there!
Hello, what's in those boxes?
Aha, interested in my crossbows are you?
translation: Aha, tatar yaylarima ilgi mi duydun?

english: Are they any good?

They're dwarven engineering at its best. If you've got enough skill in crafting, smithing and fletching, you can even make them yourself. You can buy some of the parts here and make the rest yourself.
translation: Cüce mühendisliginin en iyi örnegi. Zanaat, demircilik ve ok yapiminda yeterince becerikliysen, bunlari kendin bile yapabilirsin. Bazi parcalari buradan satin alip geri kalanini kendin yapabilirsin.

english: How do I make one for myself?
Well, firstly you'll need to chop yourself some wood, then use a knife on the wood to whittle out a nice crossbow stock like these here.
translation: Öncelikle biraz odun kesmen, sonra bicakla odunu yontarak bunlara benzer güzel bir tatar yayi gövdesi yapman gerekir.

english: Wood fletched into stock... check.

Then get yourself some metal and a hammer and smith yourself some limbs for the bow, mind that you use the right metals and woods though as some wood is too light to use with some metal and vice versa.
translation: Sonra biraz metal ve cekic alin ve yay icin bazi kollar yapin, ancak bazi ahsaplar bazi metallerle kullanmak icin cok hafif oldugundan ve tersi de gecerli oldugundan dogru metalleri ve ahsaplari kullandiginizdan emin olun.

english: Which goes with which?
Wood and Bronze as they're basic materials, Oak and Blurite, Willow and Iron, Steel and Teak, Mithril and Maple, Adamantite and Mahogany and finally Runite and Yew.
translation: Ahsap ve Bronz temel malzemeler olduklari icin, Mese ve Blurite, Sögüt ve Demir, Celik ve Tik, Mithril ve Akcaagac, Adamantite ve Maun ve son olarak Runite ve Porsuk.

english: Ok, so I have my stock and a pair of limbs... what now?
translation: Tamam, stokum ve bir cift kolum var... simdi ne yapacagim?

english: Simply take a hammer and smack the limbs firmly onto the stock. You'll then need a string, only they're not the same as normal bows. You'll need to dry some large animal's meat to get sinew, then spin that on a spinning
translation: Sadece bir cekic al ve kollari stoga sikica vur. Sonra bir ip gerekecek, ancak bunlar normal yaylardaki gibi degil. Sinir elde etmek icin büyük bir hayvanin etini kurutman, sonra da bunu bir egirme carkinda egirmen gerekecek.

english: wheel, it's the only thing we've found to be strong enough for a crossbow.
translation: Bu, tatar yayi icin yeterince güclü oldugunu gördügümüz tek sey.

english: What about magic logs?

Well.. I don't rightly know... us dwarves don't work with magic, we prefer gold and rock. Much more stable. I guess you could ask the humans at the rangers guild to see if they can do something but I don't want
translation: Sey... Tam olarak bilmiyorum... Biz cüceler sihirle ugrasmayiz, altin ve kayayi tercih ederiz. Cok daha istikrarlidirlar. Sanirim ormancilarin loncasina gidip insanlara bir seyler yapip yapamayacaklarini sorabilirsin, ama ben

english: anything to do with it!
Thanks for telling me. Bye!
Take care, straight shooting.
What about ammo?

You can smith yourself lots of different bolts, don't forget to flight them with feathers like you do arrows though. You can poison any untipped bolt but there's also the option of tipping them with gems then
translation: Kendin icin bircok farkli ok yapabilirsin, ama oklari yaptigin gibi tüylerle donatmayi unutma. Ucu olmayan oklari zehirleyebilirsin, ama uclarina mücevherler takip

english: enchanting them with runes. This can have some pretty powerful effects.
translation: rünlerle büyülü hale getirme secenegi de var. Bu oldukca güclü etkiler yaratabilir.

english: Oh my poor bank, how will I store all those?!
Don't you worry, I have just the thing here, a bolt pouch designed specially for holding 4 different types of crossbow bolt.
translation: Merak etme, tam da bunun icin bir seyim var, 4 farkli tür tatar yayi oku tasimak icin özel olarak tasarlanmis bir ok cantasi.

english: Wow, how much?
Hmm... didn't I see you down here buying one the other day? You can only have one at a time I'm afraid.
translation: Hmm... gecen gün burada bir tane satin alirken görmemis miydim seni? Maalesef bir seferde sadece bir tane alabilirsin.

english: Well let's see now... for you? 1500 gold pieces should do the trick.
translation: Bir bakalim... senin icin? 1500 altin yeterli olur.

english: Yes I'll pay the 1500gp.
Hand it over then.
Oh, I don't have that much on me.
translation: Oh, üzerimde o kadar para yok.

english: Best go make some money then, shouldn't take you too long.
translation: O zaman gidip biraz para kazan, cok uzun sürmez.

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
Halt, thief!
Guards, catch that thief!
How do I make one for myself?
What about magic logs?
Thanks for telling me. Bye!
What about ammo?
Yes I'll pay the 1500gp.
Hello there.
What's through those broken bars?
translation: O kirik parmakliklarin arkasinda ne var?

english: Well, my intrepid friend, through those broken bars lies a most remarkable discovery! I named it Scurrius, The Rat King!
translation: Cesur dostum, o kirik parmakliklarin arkasinda cok önemli bir kesif var! Ona Scurrius, Fare Kral adini verdim!

english: This is no ordinary rat. It is a magnificent creature of evolution, forged by the unwitting contributions of adventurers who entered its cave.
translation: Bu siradan bir fare degil. Magarasina giren maceracilarin farkinda olmadan yaptiklari katkilarla sekillenen, evrimin muhtesem bir ürünü.

english: It absorbed their combat abilities, transforming itself into an obscene monster. Nature's response to intrusion, you might say! How utterly fascinating!
translation: Onlarin savas yeteneklerini emerek kendini igrenc bir canavara dönüstürdü. Doganin izinsiz girise verdigi tepki diyebiliriz! Ne kadar da ilginc!

english: Ahem, anyway you'll be absolutely fine, of course! Your victory awaits, I'm sure. I shall observe your progress with interest... for science, you know.
translation: Ahem, neyse, elbette hicbir sey olmayacak! Zaferin seni bekliyor, eminim. Gelismelerini ilgiyle izleyecegim... bilim adina, bilirsin.

english: Oh, and if you happen to come across Scurrius' spine, please bring it to me.
translation: Oh, ve Scurrius'un omurgasina rastlarsan, lütfen bana getir.

english: Excuse me, can you tell me about Scurrius' spine?
translation: Affedersiniz, Scurrius'un omurgasi hakkinda bilgi verebilir misiniz?

english: Of course! Scurrius spines are invaluable for my research.
translation: Tabii ki! Scurrius omurgalari arastirmam icin cok degerli.

english: I can use them to craft a potent bone weapon which will aid you when battling the Rat King.
translation: Onlari, Fare Kral ile savasirken sana yardimci olacak güclü bir kemik silah yapmak icin kullanabilirim.

english: Although you can create the weapons yourself, provided you have the required expertise and appropriate materials.
translation: Gerekli uzmanlik ve uygun malzemelere sahipsen, silahlari kendin de yapabilirsin.

english: If you don't want a bone weapon, I can also trade you a lamp I found during my research expedition - one for every Scurrius spine you bring to me.
translation: Kemik silah istemiyorsan, arastirma gezim sirasinda buldugum bir lambayi da takas edebilirim - bana getirdigin her Scurrius omurgasi icin bir tane.

english: Can you make a bone weapon for me please?
translation: Benim icin bir kemik silah yapabilir misin lütfen?

english: You'll need to bring a Scurrius spine and either a Rune mace, a Yew shortbow, or a Battlestaff. An additional 1000 chaos runes are needed if you want to create a Bone staff.
translation: Bir Scurrius omurgasi ve bir Rune mace, bir Yew kisa yay veya bir Battlestaff getirmen gerekecek. Kemik asa yapmak istiyorsaniz ek olarak 1000 kaos runesi gereklidir.

english: I'll also charge 50,000 coins to craft the weapon.
translation: Silahi yapmak icin 50.000 sikke de talep edecegim.

english: Come back when you have all the necessary materials.
translation: Gerekli tüm malzemeleri topladiginizda geri gelin.

english: Okay, I'll make you the Bone mace.
Okay, I'll make you the Bone shortbow.
translation: Tamam, size kemik kisa yay yapacagim.

english: Okay, I'll make you the Bone staff.
Goodbye.
Ah, a Scurrius spine! A captivating subject indeed. I'll eagerly take them off your hands, and rest assured, you will be well rewarded.
translation: Ah, bir Scurrius omurgasi! Gercekten büyüleyici bir konu. Onlari seve seve alacagim ve emin ol, iyi bir ödül alacaksin.

english: Ah, I'll need one of Scurrius' spines to do that. Perhaps you could fetch me one?
translation: Ah, bunun icin bir Scurrius omurgasina ihtiyacim var. Belki bana bir tane getirebilirsin?

english: What's through those broken bars?
translation: O kirik parmakliklarin arkasinda ne var?

english: Can you tell me about Scurrius' spine?
Can you make a bone weapon for me please?
translation: Bana bir kemik silah yapabilir misin lütfen?

english: Bone mace.
Bone shortbow.
Bone staff.
Goodbye.
Yes.
No.
Weapon.
Combat lamp.
Hello. What are you doing here?
Duffy's the name. I'm a natural historian from Varrock Museum. My team and I are here to explore this mountain.
translation: Adim Duffy. Varrock Müzesi'nden bir doga tarihcisiyim. Ekibim ve ben bu dagi kesfetmek icin buradayiz.

english: It's just an old mountain isn't it? What natural history are you hoping to find here?
translation: Bu sadece eski bir dag, degil mi? Burada ne tür bir doga tarihi bulmayi umuyorsun?

english: Bahaha, you adventurers are all the same, never seeing past the fights and treasure...
translation: Bahaha, siz maceracilar hep aynisiniz, kavgalar ve hazinelerden baska bir sey görmüyorsunuz...

english: This Mountain is steeped in natural history, but our main focus is to study the lizard creatures that surround this area.
translation: Bu dag dogal tarih acisindan cok zengin, ama bizim asil amacimiz bu bölgeyi cevreleyen kertenkele yaratiklari incelemek.

english: You're studying lizardmen?
Indeed, they're a fascinating species! We're hoping to learn about their origins and how they've evolved.
translation: Evet, cok ilginc bir tür! Onlarin kökenlerini ve nasil evrimlestigini ögrenmeyi umuyoruz.

english: However, we're not very familiar with this region so we've enlisted the help of the Kourend Grand Library to aid us in our research.
translation: Ancak, bu bölgeyi cok iyi tanimadigimiz icin arastirmamiza yardimci olmasi icin Kourend Büyük Kütüphanesi'nden yardim istedik.

english: What have you learned so far?
Well, we have a theory that lizard creatures aren't natural at all, but were created by dark magical experiments.
translation: Sey, kertenkele yaratiklarin hic de dogal olmadiklari, karanlik büyülü deneylerle yaratildiklari teorisi var.

english: Right now we're looking for evidence to prove this theory, but's it's proving somewhat difficult.
translation: Su anda bu teoriyi kanitlayacak deliller ariyoruz, ama bu biraz zor oluyor.

english: Can I help at all?
No thanks adventurer, natural history studies are delicate and precise... but if we ever need something haphazardly destroyed we'll let you know.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler maceraci, doga tarihi calismalari hassas ve titizdir... ama rastgele bir seyin yok edilmesi gerekirse sana haber veririz.

english: Not all adventurers only care about fighting, you know... I was only offering to help.
translation: Bütün maceracilar sadece savasmakla ilgilenmez, biliyorsun... Sadece yardim etmek istedim.

english: We don't need your help. Run along now, go and play in the dungeons with the other adventurers. I hear they're full of monsters to fight!
translation: Yardimina ihtiyacimiz yok. Simdi git, diger maceracilarla birlikte zindanlarda oyna. Duyduguma göre orada savasacak canavarlarla doluymus!

english: Try not to get yourself killed, it would be such a tragedy!
translation: Öldürülmemeye calis, bu cok trajik olur!

english: How are things going?
Good thanks. Now that we've found this cave, we're learning more about the lizardmen than ever before.
translation: Iyi, tesekkürler. Bu magarayi buldugumuz icin, kertenkele adamlar hakkinda hic olmadigi kadar cok sey ögreniyoruz.

english: Hello!
Hello there, welcome to Varrock Museum! Can I help you?
translation: Merhaba, Varrock Müzesi'ne hos geldiniz! Yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: Tell me about the Museum.
Well, as you can see we have recently expanded a great deal to cope with the influx of finds from the Dig Site. Also, of course, to prepare for the new dig we're opening soon.
translation: Gördügünüz gibi, kazi alanindan gelen buluntularin akinina yetismek icin yakin zamanda büyük bir genisleme yaptik. Tabii ki, yakinda acacagimiz yeni kazi icin de hazirlik yapiyoruz.

english: Tell me about the new dig.

Well, we recently had a large chunk of funds donated to us, so we sent out all sorts of explorers - I'm sure you'll meet them as you go around the world. People like Simon down in the desert near the pyramid as well
translation: Kisa süre önce bize büyük miktarda bagis yapildi, bu yüzden her türden kasifleri gönderdik. Dünyayi dolasirken onlarla karsilasacaginizden eminim. Piramidin yakinindaki cölde Simon gibi insanlar,

english: as Aristarchus in Pollnivneach, Varmen and, of course, Anna Jones. Anyway, we think we have discovered an island that has massive archaeological significance. We can't say much beyond that at this point, as we haven't
translation: Pollnivneach'ta Aristarchus, Varmen ve tabii ki Anna Jones. Her neyse, arkeolojik acidan büyük öneme sahip bir ada kesfettigimizi düsünüyoruz. Henüz arastirma yapmadigimiz icin su anda daha fazla bilgi veremiyoruz.

english: researched it. If you have the qualifications and help us out around the museum, I'm sure we could offer you a place on the dig when we're ready to go.
translation: Eger gerekli niteliklere sahipsen ve müzede bize yardim edersen, kaziya hazir oldugumuzda sana bir yer sunabilecegimizden eminim.

english: That would be very nice.
I have some information that might be of use in your displays.
That's grand! We're always glad to have more facts. Now, tell me what you know...
translation: Harika! Daha fazla bilgiye sahip olmaktan her zaman memnun oluruz. Simdi, bildiklerinizi anlatin...

english: Well, I recently defeated Delrith, a demon! I did it by using a sword called Silverlight, which is apparently the only sword that could do it. I can give you a description if you want?
translation: Sey, gecenlerde Delrith adinda bir iblisi yendim! Bunu, görünüse göre bunu yapabilecek tek kilic olan Silverlight adli kilici kullanarak basardim. Isterseniz size bir aciklama yapabilirim.

english: Delrith! Incredible! I am grateful to you for letting me know. Please tell me more about Silverlight and I'll get a display erected. Display number 25, 5th Age, year 20.
translation: Delrith! Inanilmaz! Bana haber verdiginiz icin minnettarim. Lütfen Silverlight hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin, ben de bir sergi düzenleyeyim. Sergi numarasi 25, 5. Cag, 20. yil.

english: Well, I infiltrated one of the gangs here in Varrock...
We have gangs?
Erm, yes...anyway, I managed to get half the shield back.
translation: Evet... Neyse, kalkanin yarisini geri almayi basardim.

english: Only half?
Yes. The gangs had a bit of a tiff, you see. A friend helped me get the other half and I returned it here to get my reward.
translation: Evet. Ceteler arasinda bir anlasmazlik cikti. Bir arkadasim diger yarisini almama yardim etti ve ben de ödülümü almak icin buraya geri getirdim.

english: Yes, yes, we were most pleased to have the shield returned - as was the King, I imagine. This is wonderful news, I shall make sure the display is updated at once! Display number 24, 5th Age, year 700-800.
translation: Evet, evet, kalkanin geri getirilmesinden cok memnun olduk, kral da öyle olmustur herhalde. Bu harika bir haber, serginin hemen güncellenmesini saglayacagim! Sergi numarasi 24, 5. Cag, 700-800 yili.

english: Oh, and before I forget, we found this old lamp lying around...and since you've done such a sterling job, we'd like you to have it.
translation: Oh, unutmadan, bu eski lambayi bulduk... ve cok iyi bir is cikardigin icin sana vermek istiyoruz.

english: Oh, random bits of tat, thank you very much.
translation: Oh, rastgele esyalar, cok tesekkür ederim.

english: You're welcome!
You receive an old lamp.
I helped the Order of Wizards rediscover how to access the Rune Essence Mine.
translation: Büyücüler Tarikati'nin Rune Essence Madeni'ne nasil ulasilacagini yeniden kesfetmesine yardim ettim.

english: Ah, I heard about that. Tell me more.
translation: Ah, bunu duydum. Daha fazla anlatin.

english: Hmm. I can't tell you much, but I do know that this mine is hidden away. You can only get there by teleportation.
translation: Hmm. Fazla bir sey söyleyemem, ama bu madenin gizli oldugunu biliyorum. Oraya sadece teleportasyonla ulasabilirsiniz.

english: Sounds like magic to me! I'll get a display put up immediately. Display number 21, the first display of the 5th Age.
translation: Bana sihir gibi geliyor! Hemen bir sergi hazirlatacagim. Sergi numarasi 21, 5. Cag'in ilk sergisi.

english: I helped to rebuild the Observatory near Ardougne. I had to fight to do it, and learn how to use the telescope too. I can draw you a diagram of the Observatory if it would help.
translation: Ardougne yakinlarindaki Gözlemevi'nin yeniden insasina yardim ettim. Bunun icin savasmak ve teleskop kullanmayi ögrenmek zorunda kaldim. Yardimi olacaksa Gözlemevi'nin bir semasini cizebilirim.

english: That would help immensely. Restored it, eh? And it works, you say? Excellent, perhaps we can get to some real stargazing now! Display number 17, 5th Age, year 70.
translation: Bu cok yardimci olur. Yeniden insa ettin, ha? Ve calisiyor mu diyorsun? Harika, belki artik gercek yildiz gözlemi yapabiliriz! Sergi numarasi 17, 5. Cag, 70. yil.

english: I helped to free the wizard, Merlin, by using Excalibur...
translation: Excalibur'u kullanarak büyücü Merlin'i kurtarmaya yardim ettim...

english: Is that some kind of spell?
No, it's a sword. King Arthur's sword.
translation: Hayir, bir kilic. Kral Arthur'un kilici.

english: What kingdom does he rule then?
Britain...
Where on Gielinor is that?

It's not! That's what I've been trying to tell you. I found that King Arthur and his knights are really biding their time here in Gielinor until they are called back to their own world, when they are needed!
translation: Degil! Sana anlatmaya calistigim da bu. Kral Arthur ve sövalyelerinin, ihtiyac duyuldugunda kendi dünyalarina geri cagrilana kadar Gielinor'da zaman gecirdiklerini ögrendim!

english: That's amazing! So he's really from another world! Well, this is interesting, I'll make sure a display is put up immediately. Well done, [player name]! Display number 9, 5th Age, year 132.
translation: Bu harika! Demek o gercekten baska bir dünyadan! Bu cok ilginc, hemen bir sergi düzenleneceginden emin olacagim. Aferin, Maceraci! Sergi numarasi 9, 5. Cag, 132. yil.

english: I helped to save the gnomes' Grand Tree!
translation: Gnomlarin Büyük Agacini kurtarmaya yardim ettim!

english: Oh? You mean those little green fellows with their gliders?
translation: Oh? Glider'lari olan o kücük yesil yaratiklari mi kastediyorsun?

english: Yes. I uncovered this nasty character called Glough and ended up being ambushed by a black demon...
translation: Evet. Glough adinda kötü bir karakteri ortaya cikardim ve sonunda siyah bir iblis tarafindan pusuya düsürüldüm...

english: A black demon! How did you survive!?
translation: Siyah bir iblis! Nasil hayatta kaldin?

english: Oh, I was fine. After the demon it was downhill all the way, and King Narnode allowed me to use the mine under the Tree, and free passage on gnome gliders.
translation: Oh, ben iyiyim. Iblisten sonra her sey yolunda gitti ve Kral Narnode, Agacin altindaki madeni kullanmama ve cüce planörleriyle serbest gecis yapmama izin verdi.

english: You mean that those flimsy things can fly with more than a gnome in? That is unexpected. I shall update the display immediately. Display number 10, upstairs in the middle of the room!
translation: O dayaniksiz seyler bir cüceden fazlasini tasiyarak ucabiliyor mu demek istiyorsun? Bu beklenmedik bir sey. Sergiyi hemen güncelleyecegim. Sergi numarasi 10, odanin ortasindaki üst katta!

english: Some disturbing and heroic news from Morytania, concerning the River Salve and the Temple Knights.
translation: Morytania'dan, Salve Nehri ve Tapinak Sövalyeleri ile ilgili rahatsiz edici ve kahramanca haberler var.

english: Ahh, the Temple Knights...little is known of them.
translation: Ahh, Tapinak Sövalyeleri... Onlar hakkinda cok az sey biliniyor.

english: Yes, it seems that these seven knights drove back the nasty things coming out of Morytania, and Saradomin blessed the Salve to stop them getting back.
translation: Evet, görünüse göre bu yedi sövalye Morytania'dan cikan kötü seyleri geri püskürttü ve Saradomin, onlarin geri dönmelerini engellemek icin Salve'yi kutsadi.

english: Quite worrying that it's just a bit of water keeping them there, but Saradomin will protect us I've no doubt. Thank you for the information, I'll get a display put up. Display number 23, 4th Age, year 1100-1200.
translation: Onlari orada tutan seyin sadece biraz su olmasi oldukca endise verici, ama Saradomin'in bizi koruyacagindan süphem yok. Bilgi icin tesekkürler, bir ekran hazirlatacagim. Sergi numarasi 23, 4. Cag, 1100-1200 yillari.

english: Some disturbing and heroic news from Morytania concerning the River Salve and the seven priests.
translation: Morytania'dan Salve Nehri ve yedi rahiple ilgili rahatsiz edici ve kahramanca haberler var.

english: Oh?
Yes, it seems that these seven priests were also warriors and drove back the nasty things coming out of Morytania. Then Saradomin blessed the Salve to stop them getting back.
translation: Evet, görünüse göre bu yedi rahip ayni zamanda savasciydi ve Morytania'dan cikan kötü seyleri geri püskürttü. Sonra Saradomin, onlarin geri dönmelerini engellemek icin Salve'yi kutsadi.

english: Quite worrying that it's just a bit of water keeping them there, but Saradomin will protect us, I've no doubt. Thank you for the information, I'll get a display put up. Display number 23, 4th Age, year 1100-1200.
translation: Onlari orada tutan seyin sadece bir parca su olmasi oldukca endise verici, ama Saradomin bizi koruyacaktir, buna hic süphem yok. Bilgi icin tesekkürler, bir sergi düzenleyecegim. Sergi numarasi 23, 4. Cag, 1100-1200 yillari.

english: You know Bob the Cat?
The little black cat that used to wander around sometimes? Sure, I remember him.
translation: Bazen etrafta dolasan kücük siyah kedi? Tabii, onu hatirliyorum.

english: I found out a lot about his background...turns out he was once human and helped to defeat a dragonkin once!
translation: Onun gecmisi hakkinda cok sey ögrendim... Meger bir zamanlar insanmis ve bir ejderha soyunu yenmeye yardim etmis!

english: Dragonkin?
Tell me more!
Well, you see, it started when Bob went missing...and involved a big sphinx in Sophanem, the City of the Dead, and me taking care of Unferth...
translation: Sey, Bob kayboldugunda basladi... Sophanem'deki büyük sfenks, Ölüler Sehri ve benim Unferth'e bakmam da isin icindeydi...

english: This is starting to sound familiar...
It must...you know Reldo, the Varrock librarian - he knows all about Robert the Strong.
translation: Öyle olmali... Varrock kütüphanecisi Reldo'yu tanirsin, o Robert the Strong hakkinda her seyi bilir.

english: You mean that was Bob? Wow... I will get a display erected immediately about the history of this brave warrior. Display number 20, 4th Age, year 1-100.
translation: Yani o Bob muydu? Vay canina... Bu cesur savascinin tarihini anlatan bir sergi hemen hazirlatacagim. Sergi numarasi 20, 4. Cag, yil 1-100.

english: I found out more about King Lathas's ancestors.
translation: Kral Lathas'in atalari hakkinda daha fazla sey ögrendim.

english: Oh? I'd be interested to hear this, we have a painting of him upstairs.
translation: Öyle mi? Bunu duymak isterim, üst katta onun bir resmi var.

english: Indeed, it turns out that there was a big battle in the year 98 of the 5th Age. One of his ancestors became king because he survived it...
translation: Gercekten de, 5. Cag'in 98. yilinda büyük bir savas cikmis. Atalarindan biri bu savastan sag kurtuldugu icin kral olmus...

english: Ahh, is this relating to that small museum near Ardougne?
translation: Ah, bu Ardougne yakinlarindaki kücük müzeyle mi ilgili?

english: Yes!
Ahh yes, we've been meaning to make a display on that for some time. They sent us some information, too; I'm glad you reminded me, I'll get that done now. Display number 46, 5th Age, year 98.
translation: Ah evet, bir süredir bununla ilgili bir sergi acmak istiyorduk. Bize bazi bilgiler de gönderdiler; hatirlattigin icin tesekkürler, hemen halledecegim. Sergi numarasi 46, 5. Cag, 98. yil.

english: Well, I was asked to retrieve the Staff of Armadyl, from the Temple of Ikov, by Lucien, but instead, I helped the guardians of the staff and banished Lucien from this plane of existence, so that he could never again return.
translation: Lucien, Ikov Tapinagi'ndan Armadyl'in Asasi'ni almami istedi, ama ben bunun yerine asanin koruyucularina yardim ettim ve Lucien'i bu varlik düzleminden kovdum, böylece bir daha asla geri dönemeyecek.

english: I saw the staff and can describe it to you if you want?
translation: Asayi gördüm, istersen sana tarif edebilirim.

english: Well, I was asked to retrieve the Staff of Armadyl, from the Temple of Ikov, by Lucien. When I returned it he grew in power unimaginably. I held the staff and can describe it to you if you want?
translation: Lucien, Ikov Tapinagi'ndan Armadyl Asasi'ni geri getirmemi istedi. Asayi geri getirdigimde, Lucien'in gücü hayal edilemeyecek kadar artti. Asayi elime aldim, istersen sana tarif edebilirim.

english: Yes! Please do!
You describe the staff in detail while the historian takes notes.
translation: Tarihci not alirken, asayi ayrintili olarak tarif et.

english: That's excellent, I'll get a display put up straight away! Display number 28, end of the 2nd Age.
translation: Harika, hemen bir sergi hazirlatacagim! Sergi numarasi 28, 2. Cag'in sonu.

english: Well, I found out more about the Staff of Armadyl from a ghost. It seems that Zamorak was a mortal when he got hold of the staff, and he used it to, well...spear Zaros, and somehow ended up becoming a god. It was
translation: Armadyl'in Asasi hakkinda bir hayaletten daha fazla bilgi edindim. Görünüse göre Zamorak, asayi ele gecirdiginde ölümlüydü ve onu, sey... Zaros'u mizraklamak icin kullandi ve bir sekilde tanri oldu.

english: a bit confusing.
Now that is what you call a story. Tell me more so that I can put it up on the display.
translation: Iste buna hikaye denir. Daha fazlasini anlat da sergiye koyayim.

english: You recount the tale of the battle between Zaros and Zamorak as you heard it from the ghostly swordsman.
translation: Hayalet kilic ustasindan duydugun Zaros ve Zamorak arasindaki savasin hikayesini anlat.

english: This is wonderful, I shall have a display made immediately to go with the staff model. Display number 28, end of the 2nd Age.
translation: Bu harika, asa modeliyle birlikte sergiyi hemen hazirlatacagim. Sergi numarasi 28, 2. Cagin sonu.

english: I discovered the truth behind the Carnillean family fortune!
translation: Carnillean ailesinin servetinin ardindaki gercegi kesfettim!

english: Oh? Is that the family over near Ardougne?
translation: Öyle mi? Ardougne yakinlarindaki aile mi?

english: Yes. I got a bit involved in family business...
And?
I found a secret cult in Ardougne and found that the Carnillean family started building the city of Ardougne from a house they'd captured from a Zamorkian lord.
translation: Ardougne'da gizli bir tarikat buldum ve Carnillean ailesinin, Zamorkian lordundan ele gecirdikleri bir evden Ardougne sehrini insa etmeye basladigini ögrendim.

english: The historian pulls out his writing implements and listens while you explain the whole story....
translation: Tarihci yazi gereclerini cikarir ve sen tüm hikayeyi anlatirken dinler...

english: How exciting, I'll get a display put up immediately. Display number 7, 5th Age, year 7.
translation: Ne heyecan verici, hemen bir sergi hazirlatacagim. Sergi numarasi 7, 5. Cag, 7. yil.

english: I discovered a tunnel and a cult of chaos mages here in Varrock!
translation: Varrock'ta bir tünel ve kaos büyücüleri tarikati kesfettim!

english: Oh! Whatever can we do!
Calm down, I have arrested the ringleader.
Oh, thank Saradomin for that. So, tell me the story!
translation: Oh, Saradomin'e sükürler olsun. Hadi, hikayeyi anlatin!

english: Well, I met Rat and he asked me to fill his folder, and I got mixed up with Surok....
translation: Sey, Rat ile tanistim ve bana dosyasini doldurmami istedi, sonra Surok ile karistim...

english: A rat asked you to fill a folder?
translation: Bir fare dosyayi doldurmani mi istedi?

english: No, no, no - Rat Burgiss. But anyway, it turns out that this cult has been trying to get to the King, but I stopped them.
translation: Hayir, hayir, hayir - Rat Burgiss. Neyse, bu tarikat krala ulasmaya calisiyormus, ama ben onlari durdurdum.

english: The historian looks a little overwhelmed, but also skeptical.
translation: Tarihci biraz saskin, ama ayni zamanda süpheci görünüyor.

english: I don't suppose you have any evidence of this cult?
translation: Bu tarikata dair herhangi bir kanitin yok mu?

english: Not with me, but there is a book I can get you from the library.
translation: Yanimda yok, ama kütüphaneden alabilecegim bir kitap var.

english: That sounds good - bring me that and we'll create a display.
translation: Kulaga hos geliyor - onu getir, bir sergi hazirlayalim.

english: The historian is scribbling furiously on his pad, and finally turns to you.
translation: Tarihci defterine hizla bir seyler yaziyor ve sonunda sana dönüyor.

english: Actually, to save you some writing, I have this book here that has lots of information. You can have it if you want...
translation: Aslinda, yazma zahmetinden kurtarmak icin, burada bircok bilgi iceren bir kitabim var. Istersen alabilirsin...

english: Why, thank you... Yes, this is a bit of a revelation! I'll get a display put up immediately. Display number 3, 5th Age, year 70.
translation: Tesekkürler... Evet, bu biraz sasirtici! Hemen bir sergi hazirlatacagim. Sergi numarasi 3, 5. Cag, 70. yil.

english: Well, we got rid of the marauding zombies.
That's handy. Zombies do tend to leave horrible muddy footprints around the place. So what actually happened with them?
translation: Bu cok kullanisli. Zombiler genellikle etrafa korkunc camurlu ayak izleri birakirlar. Peki onlara ne oldu?

english: Well, Zemouregal the Mahjarrat sent his zombie army against Varrock. However, we figured out how to stop him.
translation: Mahjarrat Zemouregal, zombi ordusunu Varrock'a gönderdi. Ancak onu durdurmanin bir yolunu bulduk.

english: I found out that the descendant of the founder of Varrock could use the shield to stop the zombie army. It turns out that Dimintheis was that descendant, so he was able to defeat the zombies.
translation: Varrock'un kurucusunun torununun kalkani kullanarak zombi ordusunu durdurabilecegini ögrendim. Dimintheis o torun oldugu ortaya cikti, böylece zombileri yenebildi.

english: My, my, that is all very interesting. I shall make sure the display is updated at once! Display number 24, 4th Age, year 700-800.
translation: Vay canina, bunlar cok ilginc. Serginin hemen güncellenmesini saglayacagim! Sergi numarasi 24, 4. Cag, 700-800 yili.

english: Oh, and before I forget, we found this old lamp lying around. Since you've done such a sterling job, we'd like you to have it.
translation: Unutmadan, bu eski lambayi da bulduk. Harika bir is cikardigin icin, onu sana vermek istiyoruz.

english: On second thoughts, you seem to have everything I know covered here!
translation: Düsündüm de, burada bildigim her seyi anlatmissin!

english: No matter. I'm sure you'll find more. Look around the Museum, explore the city and maybe do some quests, and I'm sure you'll find out something worth telling.
translation: Önemli degil. Eminim daha fazlasini bulursun. Müzeyi gez, sehri kesfet ve belki bazi görevler yap, eminim anlatmaya deger bir seyler bulursun.

english: Yes, I'll go do some quests or something...
Tell me about other sections of the Museum.
translation: Müzenin diger bölümleri hakkinda bilgi ver.

english: I'd be delighted to; which areas are you interested in?
Tell me about the Natural History exhibit.
translation: Doga Tarihi sergisi hakkinda bilgi ver.

english: Ahh, our newest expansion. The Natural History exhibit in the basement was set up to inform our citizens of the weird and wonderful diversity in our environment today. Indeed, I am sure you will recognise some of
translation: Ahh, en yeni genislememiz. Bodrum katindaki Doga Tarihi sergisi, vatandaslarimiza günümüz cevresindeki tuhaf ve harika cesitliligi anlatmak icin kuruldu. Eminim ki, asagidaki yaratiklardan bazilarini taniyacaksiniz.

english: the creatures down there. Hopefully, our lectures will teach you some things you didn't know about them!
translation: Umarim, konferanslarimiz size onlar hakkinda bilmediginiz bazi seyler ögretir!

english: So where does the 'history' bit come in?
Ahh, I see. The 'history' refers to that of the species - it doesn't necessarily mean it's died out. After all, we have human history and we're still here!
translation: Ahh, anliyorum. “Tarih” kismi türlerin tarihini ifade ediyor - bu, türlerin neslinin tükendigi anlamina gelmiyor. Sonucta, insanlik tarihi var ve biz hala buradayiz!

english: I guess that makes sense.
Tell me about the Dig Site exhibit.
Ahh, those. We're slowly filling them up with the help of people who have their Earth Sciences exams completed at the Dig Site. If you have, feel free to give us a hand. We'd appreciate it.
translation: Ahh, onlar. Kazi Alaninda Yer Bilimleri sinavlarini tamamlayanlarin yardimiyla yavas yavas dolduruyoruz. Eger siz de tamamladiysaniz, bize yardim etmekten cekinmeyin. Cok seviniriz.

english: Tell me about the Dig Site find cleaning area.
translation: Kazi Alani buluntu temizleme alanindan bahsedin.

english: The cleaning area, yes. Well, we have some really good archaeologists on site right now. They're cleaning up the finds that are shipped over from the Dig Site to the east of here. If you have the right qualifications, you can help them clean the finds.
translation: Temizleme alani, evet. Su anda sahada gercekten cok iyi arkeologlar var. Kazi Alani'ndan buraya, doguya gönderilen buluntulari temizliyorlar. Uygun niteliklere sahipseniz, buluntulari temizlemelerine yardimci olabilirsiniz.

english: What qualifications?
Level 3 Earth Science exams. You can take them over at the Exam Centre on the Dig Site.
translation: Seviye 3 Yer Bilimleri sinavlari. Bunlari Kazi Alani'ndaki Sinav Merkezi'nde girebilirsiniz.

english: Oh, I don't have those.
translation: Oh, ben o yeterliliklere sahip degilim.

english: I'm sure you can get them easily enough. Just pop over to the Exam Centre on the Dig Site and speak to one of the examiners there.
translation: Eminim kolayca alabilirsiniz. Kazi Alanindaki Sinav Merkezine gidip oradaki sinav görevlilerinden biriyle konusun.

english: Oh, I'm already working towards those!
translation: Oh, ben zaten o yeterlilikler icin calisiyorum!

english: That's excellent. Keep up the good work and soon you'll be cleaning finds with the best of them.
translation: Harika. Böyle devam edin, yakinda en iyilerle birlikte buluntulari temizliyor olacaksiniz.

english: Oh, I already have those!
translation: Oh, ben zaten o yeterliliklere sahibim!

english: That's excellent. If you feel like helping us out, pop downstairs and clean up some finds for us.
translation: Harika. Bize yardim etmek istersen, asagi kata inip buluntulari temizleyebilirsin.

english: Tell me about the Timeline exhibit.

Ahh, my speciality. Being a historian, matters of the past are my passion. Collated on this floor and the one above are just part of my life's work. I am still working on updating and finding out more everyday, so if you find
translation: Ahh, benim uzmanlik alanim. Tarihci olarak, gecmisle ilgili konular benim tutkumdur. Bu katta ve bir üst katta toplananlar, hayatimin bir parcasidir. Hala her gün güncelleme ve daha fazla bilgi bulma calismalarina devam ediyorum, bu yüzden seyahatlerinde

english: any information on your travels that may be useful, please do let me know.
translation: yararli olabilecek herhangi bir bilgi bulursan, lütfen bana haber ver.

english: You can follow the timeline of the history of Gielinor from the creation of the world to the present day, simply by walking around this display. A wondrous journey, I think you'll agree!
translation: Bu sergiyi gezerek, dünyanin yaratilisindan günümüze kadar Gielinor tarihinin zaman cizelgesini takip edebilirsiniz. Harika bir yolculuk, siz de ayni fikirde olacaksiniz!

english: Wow, that's a lot of information. I'm sure in my travels and quests I'll pick up a few bits of information for you.
translation: Vay canina, cok fazla bilgi var. Seyahatlerim ve görevlerim sirasinda sizin icin birkac bilgi toplayacagimdan eminim.

english: Tell me about the Museum.
Tell me about the new dig.
I have some information which might be of use in your displays.
translation: Sergilerin icin yararli olabilecek bazi bilgilerim var.

english: Tell me about other sections of the Museum.
translation: Müzenin diger bölümleri hakkinda bilgi ver.

english: Natural History exhibit
Dig Site exhibit
Dig Site find cleaning area
Timeline exhibit
Can you tell me why you're here?
Of course. I plan to assist the forces of Saradomin who will come to our aid, and fight against the legions of vampyres that infest this foul place. These brave mercenaries shall need a guide.
translation: Tabii ki. Yardimimiza gelecek olan Saradomin'in güclerine yardim etmeyi ve bu igrenc yeri istila eden vampir ordularina karsi savasmayi planliyorum. Bu cesur parali askerlerin bir rehbere ihtiyaci olacak.

english: When a guide arrives, I will aid the mercenary by holding their wealth for their eventual return. The mercenary will repay the guide by giving him a token for items which I am holding.
translation: Rehber geldiginde, parali askerlere yardim etmek icin onlarin servetlerini geri dönene kadar saklayacagim. Parali askerler rehbere, sakladigim esyalar icin bir jeton vererek ödeme yapacaklar.

english: I shall give such items to the guide as payment for their services once I'm handed the token.
translation: Jetonu aldigimda, rehbere hizmetlerinin karsiligi olarak bu esyalari verecegim.

english: What items will you hold?
Oh, the range of items is very varied. Mercenaries tend to hold raw materials in high esteem and so will deposit those with me. They also seem to be good bartering items.
translation: Esyalarin cesitliligi cok fazla. Parali askerler hammaddelere cok deger verirler ve bunlari bana emanet ederler. Bunlar takas icin de iyi esyalar gibi görünüyor.

english: Generally, things like uncooked lobsters, coal, silver bars, bow strings. Things which are useful! Plus the odd tome of experience, which are considered incredibly useful.
translation: Genelde pismemis istakoz, kömür, gümüs külceler, yay ipleri gibi seyler. Yararli seyler! Ayrica, inanilmaz derecede yararli oldugu düsünülen tuhaf deneyim kitaplari da var.

english: Ok, thanks.
Hello friend. What can I do for you?
translation: Merhaba dostum. Senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: Could you exchange my tokens for me?
translation: Jetonlarimi benim icin takas edebilir misin?

english: No need, friend. You can do that yourself.
translation: Gerek yok dostum. Bunu kendin yapabilirsin.

english: Do you know what these nail beast nails are used for?
translation: Bu civi canavari tirnaklarinin ne icin kullanildigini biliyor musun?

english: Hmmm, not really sure. They do look disgusting though..oh, actually, I remember some other adventurers taking some of these to Sanfew now...something about being able to make a potion with them.
translation: Hmmm, pek emin degilim. Ama igrenc görünüyorlar... oh, aslinda, baska maceracilarin bunlardan bazilarini Sanfew'e götürdügünü hatirliyorum... onlarla bir iksir yapabilmekle ilgili bir seydi.

english: Ok, so perhaps Sanfew knows then?
translation: Tamam, o zaman belki Sanfew bilir?

english: Maybe. It's worth a try. Next time you're in Taverley, pop in and ask him. I think I remember some adventurers saying something about a serum though, some sort of potion that can be made with them.
translation: Belki. Denemeye deger. Bir dahaki sefere Taverley'e geldiginde ugra ve ona sor. Sanirim bazi maceracilar serumdan bahsediyorlardi, bunlarla yapilabilen bir tür iksirden.

english: Of course. These mercenaries are here waiting for someone to take them down to Burgh de Rott. They want to do their bit against the vampyres.
translation: Tabii ki. Bu parali askerler, onlari Burgh de Rott'a götürecek birini bekliyorlar. Vampirlerle savasmak istiyorlar.

english: I hold some items for these good hearted souls so that the guide can be recompensed when the job is done.
translation: Bu iyi kalpli ruhlar icin bazi esyalar sakliyorum, böylece is bittiginde rehber ödüllendirilebilsin.

english: Do you know what these are? Or what they're used for?
translation: Bunlarin ne oldugunu biliyor musun? Ya da ne icin kullanildiklarini?

english: Maybe? It's worth a try. Next time you're in Taverley, pop in and ask him. I think I remember some adventurers saying something about a serum though, some sort of potion that can be made with them.
translation: Belki? Denemeye deger. Bir dahaki sefere Taverley'e gittiginde ugra ve ona sor. Sanirim bazi maceracilar bir serumdan bahsetmisti, onlarla yapilabilecek bir tür iksirden.

english: Oh well done! Thank you for aiding our citizens.
translation: Aferin! Vatandaslarimiza yardim ettiginiz icin tesekkürler.

english: Can you tell me why you're here?
Ok, thanks.
Could you exchange my tokens for me?
Do you know what these nail beast nails are used for?
translation: Bu civi canavari tirnaklarinin ne icin kullanildigini biliyor musunuz?

english: Thank you for all your help in solving the murder.
translation: Cinayeti cözmemde yardim ettiginiz icin tesekkürler.

english: Hello!
What? Oh, hello. I was deep in thought. Did you want me to show you the prices of weapons and armour?
translation: Ne? Oh, merhaba. Düsüncelere dalmistim. Silah ve zirh fiyatlarini göstermemi mi istedin?

english: You seem a bit flustered.
Sorry, I'm just deep in thought. I'm waiting for many deals to complete today.
translation: Üzgünüm, sadece düsüncelere dalmistim. Bugün bircok anlasmanin tamamlanmasini bekliyorum.

english: What sort of things are you selling?
Good old weapons and armour! My people - dwarves, you understand - are hoping I can trade with humans.
translation: Eski silahlar ve zirhlar! Halkim - cüceler, anlarsin ya - insanlarla ticaret yapmami umuyor.

english: It looks like you've come to the right place for that.
translation: Bunun icin dogru yere gelmissin gibi görünüyor.

english: I have indeed, my friend. Now, can I help you?
translation: Aynen öyle dostum. Simdi, nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: Yes, show me the prices of weapons and armour.
translation: Evet, silah ve zirhlarin fiyatlarini göster bana.

english: Can you tell me about the bank's auto-charging services?
translation: Bankanin otomatik ücretlendirme hizmetleri hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Hm? Oh, yes. If you don't want to charge your items yourself, you can have the bank attendant do it for you on withdrawal.
translation: Hm? Oh, evet. Esyalarini kendin ücretlendirmek istemiyorsan, banka görevlisi para cekme islemi sirasinda bunu senin icin yapabilir.

english: How do they know how many charges to add?
You can tell them how many you would like for each item. Or if you'd like, I can let them know a minimum threshold for all items.
translation: Her bir esya icin kac ücret istedigini onlara söyleyebilirsin. Ya da istersen, tüm esyalar icin minimum esigi onlara bildirebilirim.

english: What would you like the withdrawal threshold to be?
translation: Para cekme esiginin ne olmasini istersin?

english: Your chargeable items will be charged with up to [value] charges on withdrawal. You can edit this value for individual items by toggling 'Bank item options' on in the bank settings menu, and right clicking the item.
I don't think that's necessary, but thank you for offering.
translation: Bunun gerekli oldugunu sanmiyorum, ama teklifiniz icin tesekkür ederim.

english: Alright then. Where was I...?
I'll leave you alone.
Thank you, I have much on my mind.
Wow, that's cheap.
Oh. That didn't sell so well.
Hmmm. If I spend twenty thousand on that, then...
translation: Hmmm. Eger buna yirmi bin harcarsam, o zaman...

english: Jackpot! I'm in the money now!
Hahaha! Trading the likes of which I have never seen.
translation: Hahaha! Daha önce hic görmedigim türden bir ticaret.

english: You seem a bit flustered.
Yes, show me the prices of weapons and armour.
translation: Evet, bana silah ve zirhlarin fiyatlarini göster.

english: I'll leave you alone.
Can you tell me about the bank's auto-charging services?
translation: Bankanin otomatik ücretlendirme hizmetleri hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Yes.
Yes, I'm ok with this.
No
No.
Hello.
Woooo wooo wooooo woooo
Hello.
How are you doing?
Wait. You can understand me?
Yes, I can understand ghosts.
Oh how splendid! Every time I come back here I try to talk to people, but no one seems to understand.
translation: Oh, ne harika! Buraya her geldigimde insanlarla konusmaya calisiyorum, ama kimse anlamiyor gibi görünüyor.

english: I was telling my friend Bob this the other day in the afterlife. At least he can relate to the struggle of people not understanding.
translation: Gecen gün öbür dünyada arkadasim Bob'a bunu anlatiyordum. En azindan o, insanlarin anlamamasinin zorlugunu anlayabiliyor.

english: That must be frustrating.
Yes, it really is.
Wait a second. Your friend Bob... does he happen to be a cat?
translation: Bir saniye. Arkadasin Bob... o bir kedi mi?

english: Why, yes, he is! Do you know Bob?
I do! How is he doing?
He's alright, all things considered. He did speak of a human friend he misses though. I suspect that's you.
translation: Her seye ragmen iyi. Özledigi bir insan arkadasindan bahsetmisti. Sanirim o sensin.

english: I miss him too. Could you tell him I said hi? And tell him I'm sorry he got killed. I wish I could have saved him.
translation: Ben de onu özlüyorum. Ona selamimi iletir misin? Ve öldürüldügü icin üzgün oldugumu söyle. Keske onu kurtarabilseydim.

english: I will tell him that you miss him. Regarding his death, he said it was necessary, so please don't feel bad about it.
translation: Onu özledigini söyleyecegim. Ölümüyle ilgili olarak, bunun gerekli oldugunu söyledi, bu yüzden lütfen kendini kötü hissetme.

english: Necessary? What do you mean?
He never explained why, only said that it had to be that way.
translation: Nedenini hic aciklamadi, sadece öyle olmasi gerektigini söyledi.

english: What can you tell me about Eve?
Eve? One of the greatest witches I know. Also the oldest person I know. She's been around for practically forever.
translation: Eve mi? Tanidigim en büyük cadilardan biri. Ayrica tanidigim en yasli kisi. Neredeyse sonsuza kadar yasadi.

english: It is said that when she was alive she was a hard working witch, mastering advanced spells at a very young age.
translation: Hayattayken cok caliskan bir cadi oldugu ve cok genc yasta ileri düzey büyüleri ögrendigi söylenir.

english: Unfortunately she died while still a young adult. That's why she looks so young now, despite being centuries old.
translation: Ne yazik ki genc bir yetiskin iken öldü. Bu yüzden yüzyillar önce yasamis olmasina ragmen simdi cok genc görünüyor.

english: How can she still be around after all these years?
translation: Bunca yil sonra nasil hala hayatta olabilir?

english: Like I said, she mastered spells at a very young age. She took some of that magic with her into the afterlife.
translation: Dedigim gibi, cok genc yasta büyüleri ustalasti. O büyünün bir kismini öbür dünyaya da götürdü.

english: The sad truth about Eve is that she spent all her life working and striving to achieve great things.
translation: Eve hakkindaki üzücü gercek, tüm hayatini calisarak ve büyük seyler basarmak icin cabalayarak gecirdi.

english: But she never got to relax and appreciate how far she had come. That is why she is so obsessed with partying now.
translation: Ama hic rahatlayip, ne kadar yol katettigini takdir etme firsati bulamadi. Bu yüzden simdi partilere bu kadar takintili.

english: I understand. That really makes you think, doesn't it.
translation: Anliyorum. Bu gercekten düsündürücü, degil mi?

english: Indeed. Enjoy the moment while you can, because you may not get another. Take it from me, I'm a ghost.
