translation: Gercekten. Yapabildigin kadar anin tadini cikar, cünkü bir daha böyle bir firsatin olmayabilir. Benden sana tavsiye, ben bir hayaletim.

english: Goodbye.
Goodbye.
What can you tell me about Eve?
Hello.
Hello m'hearty.
I would like a ride on your boat to the fishing platform.
I'm afraid it isn't sea worthy, it's full of holes. To fill the holes I'll need some swamp paste.
translation: Korkarim tekne denize cikmaya uygun degil, delik desik. Delikleri doldurmak icin bataklik macunu lazim.

english: Swamp paste?
Yes, swamp tar mixed with flour and heated over a fire.
translation: Evet, unla karistirilmis ve ateste isitilmis bataklik katrani.

english: Where can I find swamp tar?
Unfortunately the only supply of swamp tar is in the swamps below Lumbridge. It's too far for an old man like me to travel.
translation: Maalesef bataklik katrani sadece Lumbridge'in altindaki batakliklarda bulunur. Benim gibi yasli bir adam icin cok uzak.

english: If you make me some swamp paste I'll give you a ride in my boat.
translation: Bana bataklik macunu yaparsan seni teknemle götürürüm.

english: I'll see what I can do.
Hello there.
Well hello. Beautiful day isn't it.
translation: Merhaba. Güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Not bad I suppose.
Just smell that sea air... beautiful.
translation: Deniz havasini bir kokla... cok güzel.

english: Hmm... lovely...
I don't know what to do without my boat.
Oh, hello.
Hello, what's in those boxes?
Crossbows, are you interested?
Maybe, are they any good?
Are they any good?! They're dwarven engineering at its best!
translation: Iyi mi mi?! Cüce mühendisliginin en iyi örnegi!

english: How do I make one for myself?
Well, firstly you'll need to chop yourself some wood, then use a knife on the wood to whittle out a nice crossbow stock like these here.
translation: Öncelikle biraz odun kesmen gerek, sonra bicakla odunu oyup bunun gibi güzel bir arbalet gövdesi yapmalisin.

english: Wood fletched into stock... check.

Then get yourself some metal and a hammer and smith yourself some limbs for the bow, mind that you use the right metals and woods though as some wood is too light to use with some metal and vice versa.
translation: Sonra biraz metal ve cekic bulup yay icin kol yapmalisin, ancak bazi metaller ve agaclar birbiriyle uyumlu olmadigi icin dogru metal ve agaclari kullandigindan emin ol.

english: Which goes with which?
Wood and Bronze as they're basic materials, Oak and Blurite, Willow and Iron, Steel and Teak, Mithril and Maple, Adamantite and Mahogany and finally Runite and Yew.
translation: Temel malzemeler olan ahsap ve bronz, mese ve blurit, sögüt ve demir, celik ve tik, mithril ve akcaagac, adamantit ve maun ve son olarak runit ve porsuk agaci.

english: Ok, so I have my stock and a pair of limbs... what now?
translation: Tamam, stokum ve bir cift kolum var... simdi ne yapacagim?

english: Simply take a hammer and smack the limbs firmly onto the stock. You'll then need a string, only they're not the same as normal bows. You'll need to dry some large animal's meat to get sinew, then spin that on a spinning
translation: Sadece bir cekic al ve kollari stokun üzerine sikica vur. Sonra bir ip gerekecek, ancak bunlar normal yaylardaki gibi degil. Sinir elde etmek icin büyük bir hayvanin etini kurutman, sonra da bunu bir egirme carkinda egirmen gerekecek.

english: wheel, it's the only thing we've found to be strong enough for a crossbow.
translation: Bu, tatar yayi icin yeterince güclü oldugunu gördügümüz tek sey.

english: What about magic logs?

Well.. I don't rightly know... us dwarves don't work with magic, we prefer gold and rock. Much more stable. I guess you could ask the humans at the rangers guild to see if they can do something but I don't want
translation: Sey... Tam olarak bilmiyorum... Biz cüceler sihirle ugrasmayiz, altin ve kayayi tercih ederiz. Cok daha istikrarlidirlar. Sanirim ormancilarin loncasina gidip insanlara bir seyler yapip yapamayacaklarini sorabilirsin, ama ben

english: anything to do with it!
Thanks for telling me. Bye!
Take care, straight shooting.
What about ammo?

You can smith yourself lots of different bolts, don't forget to flight them with feathers like you do arrows though. You can poison any untipped bolt but there's also the option of tipping them with gems then
translation: Kendin icin bircok farkli ok yapabilirsin, ama oklari yaptigin gibi tüylerle donatmayi unutma. Ucu olmayan oklari zehirleyebilirsin, ama uclarina mücevherler takip

english: enchanting them with runes. This can have some pretty powerful effects.
translation: rünlerle büyülü hale getirme secenegi de var. Bu oldukca güclü etkiler yaratabilir.

english: Oh my poor bank, how will I store all those?!
Find Hirko in Keldagrim, he also sells crossbow parts and I'm sure he has something you can use to store bolts in.
translation: Keldagrim'de Hirko'yu bul, o da tatar yayi parcalari satiyor ve eminim oklari saklayabilecegin bir seyleri vardir.

english: Thanks for the info.
How do I make one for myself?
What about magic logs?
Thanks for telling me. Bye!
What about ammo?
Hi there, you mentioned something about creating monsters...?
Good! I gain know from alchemists and builders. Me make beings.
translation: Güzel! Kimyagerlerden ve insaatcilardan bilgi ediniyorum. Ben varliklar yaratiyorum.

english: Interesting. Tell me if I'm right. By the alchemists and builders creating you, you have inherited their combined knowledge in much the same way that a child might inherit the looks of their parents.
translation: Ilginc. Dogru mu söylüyorum? Kimyagerler ve insaatcilar seni yarattigi icin, bir cocugun ebeveynlerinin görünüsünü miras almasi gibi, onlarin birlesik bilgilerini miras aldin.

english: Yes, you right!
So what do you need me to do?
Inspect symbol of life altars around dungeon. You see item give. Use item on altar. Activate altar to create, you fight.
translation: Zindanin etrafindaki yasam sembolü sunaklarini incele. Esyayi gör. Esyayi sunakta kullan. Sunaklari etkinlestirip yarat, sen savas.

english: Okay. Sounds like a challenge.
translation: Tamam. Zorlu bir görev gibi görünüyor.

english: You no haveee the two materials need.
You haveee materials need. Here goes!
You here for the...stuff?
What stuff?
Look [miss/pal] I got the goods if you have the cash.
We talkin' the same language yet?
What stuff is this again?
The sort of stuff you use in brewing.
translation: Bira yapiminda kullanilan türden bir sey.

english: The sort of stuff the Cooking Guild banned last year.
translation: Gecen yil Ascilar Loncasi'nin yasakladigi türden bir sey.

english: The sort of stuff that (if added to a vat of brewing ingredients just before the hops) has a higher chance of producin' a mature batch of whatever ale you wanted to make.
translation: (Serbetciotu eklenmeden hemen önce bira yapim malzemelerinin bulundugu ficiya eklendiginde) yapmak istedigin bira türünü olgunlastirma sansi daha yüksek olan türden malzemeler.

english: That sort of stuff.
What was that bit about adding it to something?
translation: Bir seye eklemekle ilgili ne demistin?

english: I said, it's the sort of Stuff you add to a brewing vat after you have put the water and barley malt in.
translation: Su ve arpa maltini ficiya koyduktan sonra bira yapim ficisina ekledigin türden malzemeler dedim.

english: THEN you add the sort of stuff I'm talking about, followed by the hops and the yeast.
translation: SONRA bahsettigim türden bir sey ekliyorsun, ardindan serbetciotu ve maya ekliyorsun.

english: Then, when whatever you are making brews it will have a higher chance of being a mature batch of ale.
translation: Sonra, ne yapiyorsan onu mayaladiginda, olgun bir bira elde etme sansin daha yüksek olur.

english: That clear enough for you or am I going to have to start drawin' pictures on the wall of the hut?
translation: Bu yeterince acik mi, yoksa kulübenin duvarina resimler cizmeye mi baslamam gerekiyor?

english: No.
Then sling yer 'ook!
I hear you are the man to talk to about maps.
translation: Haritalar konusunda konusulacak kisi sensin diye duydum.

english: I might be, you got something for me?
translation: Olabilir, benim icin bir seyin var mi?

english: Like what?
Like...5000 Pieces of Eight?
I might have 5000 Pieces of Eight with your name on them if you have a map for me.
translation: Eger benim icin bir haritan varsa, üzerinde adin yazili 5000 sekizli olabilir.

english: Look, I might have a little something for you for that amount of cash, but I'll have to check.
translation: Bak, o kadar paraya senin icin kücük bir seyim olabilir, ama kontrol etmem gerek.

english: You sure you want in on this?
Ok, there you go, now try and keep this to yourself, ok?
translation: Tamam, al bakalim, bunu kendine sakla, tamam mi?

english: Well, no but...
Look, you want something or not?
I have no idea what you are talking about.
Sorry, no hats allowed. Shove it in the deposit box if you want to play.
translation: Üzgünüm, sapka yasak. Oynamak istiyorsan kasaya koy.

english: Why not?
Cos it's one of the rules, you got a problem with rules?
translation: Cünkü kurallardan biri bu, kurallarla sorunun mu var?

english: Yes, I am sort of a pirate after all.
translation: Evet, sonucta ben bir tür korsanim.

english: Good answer!
But still, no hats. They give you a hat to show what team you are on, and if you got a hat on, it might get nicked, see?
translation: Ama yine de sapka takma. Hangi takimda oldugunu göstermek icin sana bir sapka verirler ve sapka takarsan calinabilir, anladin mi?

english: Oh, ok.
Might want to dump that stuff yer holdin'.
translation: Elinde tuttugun seyi atsan iyi olur.

english: What do you mean?
Well, if you are carrying anything in there, then it might get damaged. Burned up, that kind of thing.
translation: Eger orada bir sey tasiyorsan, zarar görebilir. Yanabilir, öyle seyler.

english: You might want to put it in the bank, nice and safe like.
translation: Onlari bankaya koymak isteyebilirsin, güvenli olur.

english: No cats.
Are you sure?
Yep, they might get into the brew, and I know a few pirates that are allergic to them.
translation: Evet, ickiye girebilirler ve onlara alerjisi olan birkac korsan taniyorum.

english: You cannot take your follower into the game.
Hah!
This minigame is unavailable on this world.
translation: Bu mini oyun bu dünyada mevcut degil.

english: You a good cook?
Well, not very...
Then you don't get in. Cooking 40 or over, Cooking Guild regulations, if you catch my drift.
translation: O zaman giremezsin. Ascilik seviyesi 40 ve üzeri, Ascilik Loncasi kurallari, anladin mi?

english: Hello?
Huh, who's there?
It's [player name]. I'm using my magic to communicate to you. Don't worry.
translation: Ben Maceraci. Sizinle iletisim kurmak icin büyümü kullaniyorum. Merak etmeyin.

english: Well, I'm not sayin' anything to anyone unless they have decent cookin' skills.
translation: Sey, iyi ascilik becerileri olmayan kimseye bir sey söylemeyecegim.

english: I figured, seeing as I can see you over there! I don't make deals like this.
translation: Seni orada görebildigime göre anladim! Ben böyle anlasmalar yapmam.

english: The sooner you get out of my head the better. So, you here for the... information?
translation: Kafamdan ne kadar cabuk cikarsan o kadar iyi. Ee, bilgi icin mi geldin?

english: The information?
Look [miss/pal], you interrupted me for a reason, you must be after something.
translation: Bak , beni bir sebepten dolayi rahatsiz ettin, bir seyin pesinde olmalisin.

english: How much time till the next game of Trouble Brewing starts?
translation: Bir sonraki Trouble Brewing oyunu ne zaman baslayacak?

english: Ah, that's information I can help yer with.
translation: Ah, bu konuda sana yardimci olabilirim.

english: A game is ready to start just as soon as there are enough people.
translation: Yeterli sayida kisi toplandiginda oyun baslayacak.

english: And how many people are there?
There are [X] people on Dan's team, and [X] on San's. There needs to be one on each in order for a game to start!
Oh, ok. Thanks.
Anything else?
There's a game on at the moment, and another will be starting in [X] minutes time!
A game has just ended, and another will be starting in [X] minutes time!
How many people are waiting for a game to start?
translation: Oyunun baslamasini bekleyen kac kisi var?

english: No-one's waiting at the moment. Perhaps you can get some people interested.
translation: Su anda bekleyen kimse yok. Belki ilgilenen birkac kisi bulabilirsin.

english: Hmmm... maybe.
There [is/are]] [no one/one person/X people] on Dan's team...
... and there [is/are]] [no one/one person/X people] on San's team. Anything else?
All ready to go, anyone want to join in?
translation: Her sey hazir, katilmak isteyen var mi?

english: Get a move on, these two aim to start in [1-3] minute(s)
translation: Acele edin, bu ikisi [1-3] dakika icinde baslamayi planliyor.

english: Yes, I am here for the stuff.
What stuff is this again?
No.
I hear you are the man to talk to about maps.
Yes
No
Yes, what are you selling?
I have no idea what you mean.
How much time till the next game of Trouble Brewing starts?
translation: Trouble Brewing'in bir sonraki oyunu ne zaman baslayacak?

english: How many people are waiting for a game to start?
translation: Oyunun baslamasini bekleyen kac kisi var?

english: I have no idea what you're talking about.
Good day!
Can't talk now, I'm on duty.
Hail, [Fremennik name]!
Good day! How are you doing?
Pretty good. It's nice to have a day off from troll- killing duty.
translation: Oldukca iyiyim. Trol avlama görevinden bir gün izinli olmak güzel.

english: Have you killed many trolls?
Of course. It's all part of growing up around here. You get used to it.
translation: Tabii ki. Buralarda büyümek bununla birlikte gelir. Alisirsin.

english: See you later.
Good day, jester! Got any new jokes?
translation: Iyi günler, soytari! Yeni sakalarin var mi?

english: No. I only use old, recycled jokes. It's better for the environment.
translation: Hayir. Sadece eski, tekrar kullanilan sakalari kullanirim. Cevre icin daha iyi.

english: HaHa!
Are you here to help with the trolls?
I'm afraid not, I have other things to do.
Well, watch yourself. Those rocks that the trolls throw can take your arm off.
translation: Peki, kendine dikkat et. Trollerin attigi taslar kolunu koparabilir.

english: Hey jester, this area is not a suitable place for civilians to wander about in. Trolls everywhere.
translation: Hey soytari, bu bölge sivillerin dolasmasi icin uygun bir yer degil. Her yer trolllerle dolu.

english: Right you are. I'll be careful.
I hope you're not heading north. There are lots of trolls, very dangerous.
translation: Umarim kuzeye gitmiyorsundur. Orada cok sayida troll var, cok tehlikeliler.

english: Thanks for the warning. I'll keep my eyes peeled.
translation: Uyarin icin tesekkürler. Gözlerimi dört acacagim.

english: Haha!
Hello! Are you Hooknosed Jack?
Depends who's asking. What do you want?
Jimmy Dazzler sent me. He said you could help train my grown cat to catch rats.
translation: Jimmy Dazzler gönderdi. Yetiskin kedimi fare yakalamayi ögretmene yardim edebilecegini söyledi.

english: I expect he wants me to do that for free, does he?
translation: Bunu bedavaya yapmami istiyor herhalde, degil mi?

english: Well, I'm an adventurer. There must be something I can do for you in return.
translation: Ben bir maceraciyim. Karsiliginda senin icin yapabilecegim bir sey olmali.

english: Forget it.
What?
I'm too busy to babysit you and your moggy.
translation: Seni ve kedini bakacak kadar vaktim yok.

english: Oh, come on.
No, really. Me and Pox have too much going on.
translation: Hayir, gercekten. Pox ve benim cok isimiz var.

english: We've got a big job to finish today, I can't teach you how to catch rats on top of that.
translation: Bugün bitirmemiz gereken büyük bir is var, bir de sana fare yakalamayi ögretemem.

english: Well I could be your apprentice! I've already got hands-on experience.
translation: Ben senin ciragin olabilirim! Zaten pratik deneyimim var.

english: Oh yes? What sort of experience?
translation: Öyle mi? Ne tür bir deneyim?

english: I helped the Grime Sisters catch loads of rats in the sewers, and I cleared out a whole mansion in Ardougne for Jimmy Dazzler.
translation: Grime Sisters'in kanalizasyonda bir sürü fare yakalamasina yardim ettim ve Jimmy Dazzler icin Ardougne'daki bir malikaneyi temizledim.

english: I bet you did. Typical Jimmy, leaving the hard work to everyone else.
translation: Eminim öyledir. Tipik Jimmy, zor isi baskalarina birakiyor.

english: So what do you say? Can me and my cat help you out?
translation: Ne dersin? Ben ve kedim sana yardim edebilir miyiz?

english: Oh, alright then. But you'd better not give me or Pox any trouble!
translation: Tamam o zaman. Ama bana veya Pox'a sorun cikarmayin!

english: We won't!
I'd better not regret this...
Right, your first task is to clear out a warehouse south of here.
translation: Tamam, ilk göreviniz buradan güneydeki bir depoyu temizlemek.

english: All you need to do is poison the rat holes with some bait. Can you handle that?
translation: Tek yapmaniz gereken fare deliklerini zehirli yemle zehirlemek. Bunu yapabilir misiniz?

english: I think so. Will any type of poison do?
translation: Sanirim yapabilirim. Herhangi bir zehir olur mu?

english: Are you daft? You need rat poison to kill rats!
translation: Aptal misin? Fareleri öldürmek icin fare zehiri lazim!

english: If you can't mix a batch up for yourself, there's sure to be some lying around here somewhere.
translation: Kendin hazirlayamiyorsan, burada bir yerlerde mutlaka vardir.

english: Would this stuff do?
It certainly will! There's hope for you yet.
Right, to poison the rats you'll need some tasty bait.
translation: Tamam, fareleri zehirlemek icin lezzetli bir yem lazim.

english: They love a bit of cheese, so pour some poison on that and then leave it in the rat holes.
translation: Peyniri cok severler, üzerine biraz zehir döküp fare deliklerine birak.

english: Okay, can do.
Report back to me when you're done.
And no slacking!
Hey!
What?
Can you make me some rat poison?
Have you got the ingredients for me yet?
Get some Kwuarm, Red SpiderEggs and an empty vial. Bring them to me, and I'll make a batch of rat poison for you.
translation: Biraz Kwuarm, Kirmizi Örümcek Yumurtasi ve bos bir sise getir. Onlari bana getir, sana fare zehiri yapayim.

english: Do you see that bar to the south of here? Well, behind that is the warehouse. The rats are on the first floor.
translation: Buranin güneyindeki bari görüyor musun? Arkasinda depo var. Fareler birinci katta.

english: I've finished the job. Now will you teach me more about ratcatching?
translation: Isi bitirdim. Simdi bana fare avciligi hakkinda daha fazla sey ögretir misin?

english: You're pulling my leg!
Who, me?
Yes, you! You think I can't tell you're lying? Now get back to the warehouse and kill those rats!
translation: Evet, sen! Yalan söyledigini anlayamadigimi mi saniyorsun? Simdi depoya geri dön ve o fareleri öldür!

english: I poisoned the rats in the warehouse! Do you have time to teach me about grown cats yet?
translation: Depodaki fareleri zehirledim! Bana yetiskin kediler hakkinda bilgi verecek vaktin var mi?

english: Not right now, [player name].
Are you serious? I've gone and done a job for you, the least you could do is say thanks.
translation: Ciddi misin? Senin icin bir is yaptim, en azindan tesekkür etmelisin.

english: Can't you see I'm upset?
It's my cat, Pox. She's half dead, bless her.
translation: Kedim Pox. Yari ölü durumda, zavalli sey.

english: Oh no! What happened?
They found her at the warehouse you were working at. She must have eaten some of the rats you poisoned.
translation: Senin calistigin depoda bulmuslar. Zehirledigin farelerden bazilarini yemis olmali.

english: Oh no...
Can I help? I feel somewhat responsible...
translation: Yardim edebilir miyim? Kendimi biraz sorumlu hissediyorum...

english: That's kind of you, [player name].
There's an apothecary here in town, he could help. Tell him that the poison was made from red spiderseggs and kwuarm. He should know what to do. Go quickly.
translation: Kasabada bir eczaci var, o yardimci olabilir. Ona zehirin kirmizi örümcek yumurtasi ve kwuarmdan yapildigini söyle. Ne yapmasi gerektigini bilir. Cabuk git.

english: Have you got the anti-poison?
Yes, I've got it right here.
You hand the vial of cat anti-poison to Jack.
translation: Kedi zehir karsiti ilaci Jack'e veriyorsun.

english: Thank you [player name]. Thank you so much.
No worries there, I'd be sorry to see poor Pox come to harm.
translation: Önemli degil, zavalli Pox'un zarar görmesine üzülürdüm.

english: Well, thanks to you, she'll live to see another day.
translation: Senin sayende, bir gün daha yasayacak.

english: I have to have a word with you about the job you did in the warehouse.
translation: Depoda yaptigin is hakkinda seninle konusmam gerek.

english: I did a good job, didn't I?
The thing is, you didn't quite finish the warehouse job.
translation: Sorun su ki, depodaki isi tam olarak bitirmemissin.

english: Wait, but I poisoned all the rat holes just like you said.
translation: Ama sen dedigin gibi tüm fare deliklerini zehirledim.

english: You did, but one rat survived... the biggest, nastiest one of the lot.
translation: Öyle yaptin, ama bir fare hayatta kaldi... en büyük ve en kötü olani.

english: Well, I'm not scared of big, nasty rats.
I hope not, because someone's got to get rid of it, and me and Pox are out of action.
translation: Umarim korkmuyorsundur, cünkü birisi onu ortadan kaldirmali ve ben ve Pox is göremez durumdayiz.

english: Don't worry - we're on the case.
translation: Merak etme, biz bu isi halledecegiz.

english: I really underestimated you, [player name]. Best of luck.
translation: Seni gercekten hafife almisim, Maceraci. Iyi sanslar.

english: Have you killed the King Rat yet?
Umm... no.
Look, you did me and Pox a big favour, but that's not an excuse to slack off.
translation: Bak, bana ve Pox'a büyük bir iyilik yaptin, ama bu tembellik etmek icin bir bahane degil.

english: How's Pox doing anyway?
Oh, she's doing alright...
Oi! You can't distract me like that. Get on with you, and get rid of that rat!
translation: Hey! Beni böyle oyalayamazsin. Isine bak ve o sicani ortadan kaldir!

english: They say you've killed the King Rat.
Just barely! I was getting worried for my cat, but we pulled through.
translation: Zar zor! Kedim icin endiseleniyordum ama basardik.

english: Your cat?
Yes! The King Rat was holed up behind a wall, so I had to send my cat in to get it.
translation: Evet! Kral Sican bir duvarin arkasina saklanmisti, ben de kedimi gönderip onu yakalattim.

english: Well, imagine that. You two must have a great bond. Perhaps I can show you a thing or two after all.
translation: Vay canina, düsünsenize. Ikinizin arasi cok iyi olmali. Belki de size bir iki sey ögretebilirim.

english: See that manhole over there? Climb down it to enter the Varrock Rat Pits.
translation: Suradaki rögar kapagini görüyor musunuz? Oradan asagi inip Varrock Sican Cukurlarina girebilirsiniz.

english: Thank you so much! I imagine my cat will learn a lot in there.
translation: Cok tesekkürler! Kedim orada cok sey ögrenecek sanirim.

english: Just you look after it.
Say, if you want to know more about the ratcatching business, you should seek out Smokin' Joe in Keldagrim. He was a skilled ratcatcher, back in the day.
translation: Sican avciligi hakkinda daha fazla bilgi edinmek istiyorsan, Keldagrim'deki Smokin' Joe'yu bulmalisin. Eskiden cok yetenekli bir sican avcisiydi.

english: Can you tell me where I could find Phingspet and Grimesquit?
The sisters Grime? You'll find them down in the sewers here in Varrock.
translation: Grime kardesler mi? Onlari Varrock'taki kanalizasyonda bulabilirsin.

english: Can you tell me where I could find Jimmy Dazzler?
Pah! There's nothing else he can teach you, I'll tell you that.
translation: Pah! Sana ögretebilecegi baska bir sey yok, bunu sana söyleyebilirim.

english: But where would I find him?
Probably cosying up to the nobles over in Ardougne.
What's your problem with Jimmy, anyway?
He reckons he's too good for the likes of us.
translation: Bizim gibiler icin fazla iyi oldugunu düsünüyor.

english: Are you sure? He spoke very highly of you.
translation: Emin misin? Senin hakkinda cok iyi konustu.

english: I'll believe it when I see it.
Anyway. The Flying Horse, Ardougne. You'll find him there.
translation: Neyse. Ucan At, Ardougne. Onu orada bulursun.

english: Can you tell me where I could find Smokin' Joe?
translation: Smokin' Joe'yu nerede bulabilecegimi söyleyebilir misin?

english: He should be in Keldagrim, the city of the dwarves.
Tell him I said hello, will you? I've been meaning to catch up.
translation: Ona selamimi söyle, olur mu? Uzun zamandir görüsmek istiyordum.

english: Can you tell me where I could find 'The Face'?
She'll be in Port Sarim, scaring people away from the entrance to the pits.
translation: Port Sarim'de, cukurlarin girisinde insanlari korkutuyor.

english: Can you tell me where I could find Felkrash?
Her nibs? She'll be in the rat pits at Port Sarim. Good luck getting in there, though.
translation: Hanimefendi mi? Port Sarim'deki fare cukurlarinda. Oraya girebilmen icin bol sans.

english: Can you tell me more about the pits?
translation: Cukurlar hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Here take this, you might find it useful.
What do you want to know?
Do you have any pointers for me and my cat?
translation: Bana ve kedime verebilecegin bir tavsiye var mi?

english: You should wear an Amulet of Catspeak. It will allow you to organise tactics with your cat.
translation: Kedi Dili Tilsimi takmalisin. Böylece kedinle taktikler belirleyebilirsin.

english: What would be the best tactic to adopt then?
translation: O zaman en iyi taktik ne olur?

english: Well, that depends on your outlook, whether you're ready to risk your cat's life or not and how defensive or aggressive you want your cat to be.
translation: Bu senin bakis acina, kedinin hayatini riske atmaya hazir olup olmadigina ve kedinin ne kadar savunmaci veya saldirgan olmasini istedigine bagli.

english: I will not risk my cat's life.
Well if that's the case then you're left with two choices.
You can adopt an ultra defensive strategy, which increases your cat's hitpoints and defence but causes it to flee sooner.
translation: Kedinin can puanini ve savunmasini artiran, ancak daha cabuk kacmasina neden olan ultra savunma stratejisini benimseyebilirsin.

english: Or you can adopt a less defensive strategy, which will allow your cat to stay in the pit for longer.
translation: Ya da kedinin cukurda daha uzun süre kalmasini saglayan daha az savunma stratejisini benimseyebilirsin.

english: I think I would adopt a very defensive strategy
In that case you should tell your cat: 'Just take care of yourself cat.'
translation: O halde kedine sunu söylemelisin: “Sadece kendine dikkat et kedi.”

english: Thanks for your help.
Do you have any other questions about the pits?
translation: Cukurlarla ilgili baska sorunuz var mi?

english: No thanks.
I think I would adopt a less defensive strategy.
translation: Sanirim daha az savunmaci bir strateji benimseyecegim.

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'Stay in for as long as you can.'
translation: Bu durumda kedinize sunu söylemelisiniz: “Mümkün oldugunca uzun süre kal.”

english: I am willing to risk my cat, if it increases my chances of victory.
translation: Zafer sansimi artiracaksa kedimi riske atmaya hazirim.

english: In that case you are left with two choices.
You could go for all out attack which will boost your cat's attack and strength, but weaken it.
translation: Kedinizin saldiri ve gücünü artiracak, ancak onu zayiflatacak tam saldiri stratejisini secebilirsiniz.

english: Or, go for a less aggressive stance, which will increase your cat's strength and attack to a lesser degree, but carries no defensive penalties.
translation: Ya da kedinizin gücünü ve saldirisini daha az ölcüde artiracak, ancak savunma acisindan herhangi bir dezavantaj getirmeyecek daha az agresif bir tutum sergileyebilirsiniz.

english: I think I would adopt a very aggressive strategy
translation: Ben cok agresif bir strateji benimserdim.

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'Go berserk!'
translation: Bu durumda kedinize sunu söylemelisiniz: “Cilgina dön!”

english: I think I would adopt a less aggressive strategy.
translation: Ben daha az agresif bir strateji benimserdim.

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'No guts, no glory!'
translation: Bu durumda kedinize sunu söylemelisiniz: “Cesaret yoksa zafer de yok!”

english: What benefits does my cat get from training in the pits?
translation: Kedim cukurlarda antrenman yapmaktan ne gibi faydalar elde eder?

english: It depends on what kind of cat you have.
In the Varrock pits, your cat will grow up faster by gaining more experience.
translation: Varrock cukurlarinda kediniz daha fazla deneyim kazanarak daha hizli büyür.

english: Can you show me to the rat pits?
Didn't you hear me? They're through that manhole over there. You can't miss it!
translation: Beni duymadiniz mi? Oradaki kanalizasyon kapagindan geciyorsunuz. Kacirmaniz imkansiz!

english: Hello.
Actually I've got no time for this. I don't want to talk to you.
translation: Aslinda bunun icin vaktim yok. Seninle konusmak istemiyorum.

english: Oh the girls? You'll find them down in the sewers here in Varrock.
translation: Kizlar mi? Onlari Varrock'taki kanalizasyonda bulabilirsin.

english: Can you tell me where I would find Jimmy Dazzler?
That conceited popinjay?
You could call him that. But where would I find him?
translation: Öyle de diyebilirsin. Ama onu nerede bulabilirim?

english: Probably cowering in his apartment at the back of the Flying Horse in Ardougne, praying that I don't go looking for him.
translation: Muhtemelen Ardougne'daki Flying Horse'un arkasindaki dairesinde saklaniyor ve benim onu aramamayi umut ediyor.

english: So you two know each other?
Jack shoots you a look that could rout a regiment of black knights.
translation: Jack sana bir bakis atar ki, bir siyah sövalye alayini bozguna ugratabilir.

english: Can you tell me where I could find Smokin Joe?
Can you tell me where I would find 'The Face'?
She'll be in Port Sarim, scaring people away from the entrance of the pits with her face.
translation: Port Sarim'de, yüzüyle cukurlarin girisinden insanlari korkutup kaciriyor.

english: Can you tell me where I would find Felkrash?
Her nibs? She'll be in the pits of Port Sarim.
Here take this, you might find it useful
Well what do you want to know?
You should wear an amulet of catspeak. It will allow you to organise tactics with your cat.
translation: Kedi dili muskasi takmalisin. Böylece kedinle taktikler planlayabilirsin.

english: Well if that's the case then your are left with two choices.
You can adopt an ultra defensive strategy, which increases your cat's hitpoints and defence, the drawback to this is that your cat will flee sooner.
translation: Kedinin can puanini ve savunmasini artiran ultra savunma stratejisi uygulayabilirsin, ancak bunun dezavantaji kedinin daha cabuk kacmasidir.

english: Your other option is to adopt a less defensive strategy which will allow your cat to stay in the pit for longer.
translation: Diger secenegin ise kedinin cukurda daha uzun süre kalmasini saglayacak daha az savunma stratejisi uygulamaktir.

english: In that case you should tell your cat, 'Just take care of yourself cat.'
translation: Bu durumda kedinize “Sadece kendine dikkat et” demelisiniz.

english: In that case you should tell your cat, 'Stay in for as long as you can.'
translation: Bu durumda kedinize “Mümkün oldugunca uzun süre kal” demelisiniz.

english: You could go for all out attack which will boost your cat's attack and strength, but weaken it
translation: Kedinizin saldiri ve gücünü artiracak, ancak onu zayiflatacak tam saldiri stratejisi uygulayabilirsiniz.

english: or go for a less aggressive stance which will increase your cat's strength and attack to a lesser degree, but carries no defensive penalties.
translation: Ya da kedinizin gücünü ve saldirisini daha az artiracak, ancak savunma acisindan herhangi bir dezavantaj getirmeyecek daha az agresif bir tutum sergileyebilirsiniz.

english: In that case you should tell your cat, 'Go berserk!'
In that case you should tell this to your cat, 'No guts, no glory!'
translation: Bu durumda kedinize “Cesaret yoksa zafer de yok!” demelisiniz.

english: Argh you just don't listen do you? See that manhole yonder? Well climb down and you'll find the pits.
translation: Ah, hic dinlemiyorsunuz, degil mi? Suradaki rögar kapagini görüyor musunuz? Oraya inin, cukurlari bulacaksiniz.

english: Step away from that manhole, you've no business down there.
translation: O rögar kapagindan uzak durun, orada isiniz yok.

english: Can you make me some rat poison?
Where's the warehouse again?
I've finished the job.
Can you tell me where I would find ....
Grimesquit and Phingspet
Jimmy Dazzler
Smokin' Joe
The Face
Felkrash
Can you tell me more about the pits?
translation: Cukurlar hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Do you have any pointers for me and my cat?
translation: Bana ve kedime tavsiyelerin var mi?

english: I will not risk my cat's life.
I think I would adopt a very defensive strategy.
translation: Sanirim cok savunmaci bir strateji izleyecegim.

english: I'd like to ask you...
No thanks
I think I would adopt a less defensive strategy.
translation: Sanirim daha az savunmaci bir strateji izleyecegim.

english: I am willing to risk my cat if it improves my chances.
translation: Sansimi artiracaksa kedimi riske atmaya hazirim.

english: I think I would adopt a very aggressive strategy.
translation: Sanirim cok agresif bir strateji izleyecegim.

english: I think I would adopt a less aggressive strategy.
translation: Sanirim daha az agresif bir strateji izleyecegim.

english: What benefits does my cat get from training in the pits?
translation: Kedim cukurlarda egitimden ne gibi faydalar elde edecek?

english: Can you show me to the rat pits?
The face
Hop please.
Huh?
I was here first...
No you weren't...
I disconnected, I've been here all night.
Can't we share?
Oh, that's not happening, my experience rates are too important to me.
translation: Oh, bu mümkün degil, deneyim puanlarim benim icin cok önemli.

english: Wouldn't hopping yourself and preventing this entire conversation have been better for experience rates?
translation: Kendin atlayip bu konusmayi önlemek deneyim puanlarin icin daha iyi olmaz miydi?

english: Just hop.
Hops don't wanna talk now.
Hello, I'm Horace. Welcome to my shop. Would you like to buy or sell something?
translation: Merhaba, ben Horace. Dükkanima hos geldin. Bir sey satin almak veya satmak ister misin?

english: Who are you?
Hello my friend, my name is Horace! You're in the city of Hosidius. Most everyone round here tends the farms. Without us, Kourend would have no crops at all.
translation: Merhaba dostum, benim adim Horace! Hosidius sehrindesin. Buradaki cogu kisi ciftcilikle ugrasir. Biz olmasak, Kourend'de hic mahsul olmazdi.

english: So, do you need to buy or sell something today?
translation: Peki, bugün bir sey satin almak veya satmak ister misin?

english: Okay, let's trade.
No, I'm fine.
Who are you?
Okay, let's trade.
No, I'm fine.
It's a fine day to be out in the garden isn't it?
translation: Bahcede vakit gecirmek icin güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Yes, it's very nice.
Days like these make me glad to be alive!
translation: Böyle günler hayatta olduguma sükretmemi sagliyor!

english: So... who are you?
My name is Horacio Dobson. I'm the gardener to Lord Handelmort. Take a look around this beautiful garden, all of this is my handiwork.
translation: Adim Horacio Dobson. Lord Handelmort'un bahcivaniyim. Bu güzel bahceye bir bak, hepsi benim eserim.

english: So... do you garden round the back too?
translation: Peki... arka bahcede de bahce isleri yapiyor musun?

english: That I do!
Doesn't all of the security around the house get in your way then?
translation: Evin etrafindaki güvenlik önlemleri isine engel olmuyor mu?

english: Ah, I'm used to all that. I have my keys, the guard dogs know me, and I know the combination to the door lock. It's rather easy, it's his middle name.
translation: Ah, ben bunlara aliskinim. Anahtarlarim var, bekci köpekleri beni taniyor ve kapi kilidinin sifresini biliyorum. Oldukca kolay, onun ikinci adi.

english: Whose middle name?
Hum. I probably shouldn't have said that. Forget I mentioned it.
translation: Hum. Muhtemelen bunu söylememeliydim. Söyledigimi unutun.

english: Do you need any help?
Trying to muscle in on my job eh? I'm more than happy to do this all by myself!
translation: Isime karismaya mi calisiyorsunuz? Bunu tek basima yapmaktan cok mutluyum!

english: Here, have this.
Yes, it's very nice.
So... who are you?
So... do you garden round the back too?
translation: Peki... arka bahcede de bahce isleri yapiyor musunuz?

english: Do you need any help?
Can I help you today?
Can I go for a ride?
Minecart rides are 20 coins.
Of course.
I'm fine, thanks.
As a loyal customer of the Lovakengj Minecart Network, you're entitled to this.
translation: Lovakengj Maden Arabasi Agi'nin sadik bir müsterisi olarak, buna hakkin var.

english: Now, can I help you today?
translation: Simdi, bugün sana yardim edebilir miyim?

english: You're already here, human.
Can I go for a ride?
I'm fine, thanks.
Good day, traveller.
Hey there. What brings you here?
I am researching the Dark Altar. Many of our forefathers spent their lives studying it, though much knowledge was lost over the generations.
translation: Karanlik Sunak'i arastiriyorum. Atalarimizin cogu hayatlarini onu inceleyerek gecirdi, ancak nesiller boyunca bircok bilgi kayboldu.

english: I believe some of their writings would have been stored in this Library, though the Librarian seems unable to help me locate any.
translation: Bazi yazilari bu Kütüphane'de saklaniyor olmali, ancak Kütüphaneci bana yardimci olamiyor.

english: Well good luck in your search.
Excuse me, I do not believe we have any business.
You do not have enough Arceuus favour. Current favour: [0.0% - 19.9%]  - Required: 20.0%
translation: Yeterli Arceuus iyiligi yok. Mevcut iyilik: [0,0% - 19,9%]  - Gerekli: 20,0%

english: I wonder, traveller... Could you assist me?
translation: Merak ediyorum, gezgin... Bana yardim eder misin?

english: What do you need?
I believe many of their writings would have been stored in this Library, though the Librarian seems unable to help me locate any.
translation: Yazilarindan cogunun bu kütüphanede saklandigini düsünüyorum, ancak kütüphaneci bana yardimci olamiyor.

english: In your exploration of the Library, if you should happen to find any manuscripts of this nature, please bring them to me, and you will gain my gratitude.
translation: Kütüphaneyi arastirirken, bu türden herhangi bir el yazmasi bulursan lütfen bana getir, minnettar kalirim.

english: Understood.
Sorry, no.
Do you have any dark manuscripts for me, traveller?
translation: Benim icin karanlik el yazmalari var mi, gezgin?

english: Not at the moment.
Our forefathers studied the Dark Altar for generations. I am sure their knowledge is stored in this Library somewhere. It is a shame that the Librarian seems unable to help me.
translation: Atalarimiz nesiller boyunca Karanlik Sunak'i incelemislerdir. Eminim onlarin bilgileri bu Kütüphane'nin bir yerinde saklidir. Kütüphaneci'nin bana yardim edememesi cok yazik.

english: Thank you very much. In return, I have given you some knowledge that you may perhaps appreciate.
translation: Cok tesekkür ederim. Karsiliginda, belki hosuna gidebilecek bazi bilgiler verdim.

english: What do you need?
Sorry, no.
Hello, do you need any help?
No thanks. I'm just looking around.
Well, come and see me if you're ever in need of armour!
translation: Peki, zirha ihtiyaciniz olursa gelip beni bulun!

english: I've always wondered what would happen if I crushed an air rune. Have this on me.
translation: Hava runesini ezersem ne olacagini hep merak etmisimdir. Alin, benden size hediye.

english: No thanks. I'm just looking around.
Do you want to trade?
Oh, hello again. Want some ore?
I'll have a look.
Not right now.
I'll have a look.
Not right now.
Caw!
Are you a bird?
Roar!
A dragon?
Hiss!
A snake?
Roar! Caw! Hiss!
A dragon snake bird?
*bird noises*
Aren't you a cute litle thing.
*screeches*
My ears!
Hello there traveller. Would you like some groceries? I have a large selection.
translation: Merhaba gezgin. Biraz erzak ister misin? Genis bir ürün yelpazem var.

english: No thank you.
No problem.
I'll have a look.
Great stuff.
No thank you.
I'll have a look.
Hudon can't hear you because of the noise of the waterfall. Perhaps the acoustics would be better from that island?
translation: Hudon selalenin gürültüsünden dolayi seni duyamiyor. Belki o adadan akustik daha iyi olur?

english: Hello son, are you okay? You need help?
translation: Merhaba evlat, iyi misin? Yardima ihtiyacin var mi?

english: It looks like you need the help.
Your mum sent me to find you.
translation: Annen seni bulmam icin beni gönderdi.

english: Don't play nice with me, I know you're looking for the treasure too.
translation: Bana nazik davranma, sen de hazineyi ariyorsun, biliyorum.

english: Where is this treasure you talk of?
Just because I'm small doesn't mean I'm dumb! If I told you, you would take it all for yourself.
translation: Kücük olmam aptal oldugum anlamina gelmez! Söylersem, hepsini kendine alirsin.

english: Maybe I could help.
I'm fine alone.
Hmm... I wonder what this treasure is.
So you're still here.
I'll find that treasure soon, just you wait and see.
translation: O hazineyi yakinda bulacagim, sen bekle ve gör.

english: Hello Hudon.
Oh it's you, trying to find my treasure again are you?
translation: Oh, sensin, yine hazinemi mi ariyorsun?

english: I didn't know it belonged to you.
It will do when I find it. I just need to get into this blasted waterfall I've been washed downstream three times already.
translation: Buldugumda benim olacak. Sadece bu lanet selaleye girmem lazim, üc kez asagiya sürüklendim bile.

english: How are you doing, Hudon?
No luck yet I'm afraid.
Me neither, but I don't give up easily.
translation: Benim de, ama kolay kolay pes etmem.

english: Hello again.
You stole my treasure. I saw you!
I'll make sure it goes to a good cause.
translation: Iyi bir amac icin kullanacagimdan emin olabilirsin.

english: Hmmmm!
Got anymore *hic* wine?
Ummm... No, sorry. Looks like you've had enough anyway.
translation: Ummm... Hayir, üzgünüm. Zaten yeterince icmissin gibi görünüyor.

english: Well, I *hic* ...disagree.
Why are you drinking so much? To forget?
translation: Neden bu kadar cok iciyorsun? Unutmak icin mi?

english: Nope, tastes mighty fine! Any chance you *hic* know where Horses go?
translation: Hayir, tadi cok güzel! Atlarin nereye gittigini biliyor musun?

english: The what?
The Horses!
Ah, the 'Horses'... How unfortunate, the wine has made you delirious. I've no idea what a Horse is my friend.
translation: Ah, “Atlar”... Ne yazik, sarap seni delirtmis. Atin ne oldugunu bilmiyorum dostum.

english: Oh.
You know this *hic* place was built twice?
translation: Bu *hic* yerin iki kez insa edildigini biliyor musun?

english: Ummm... How come?
Storm swept in and erased it, had to be built again from scratch.
translation: Firtina geldi ve yerle bir etti, sifirdan yeniden insa etmek zorunda kaldilar.

english: Huh, what a shame.
They did a better job second time round, but the builder sure was annoyed.
translation: Ikinci sefer daha iyi bir is cikardilar, ama insaatci kesinlikle sinirlenmisti.

english: Who was the builder?
Some *hic* Westener.
Got any *hic* wine?
No, sorry. Do you know of any caves around here?
translation: Hayir, üzgünüm. Buralarda magara biliyor musun?

english: *hic* Crabclaw Caves?
Err maybe?
Big set of caves east *hic* of here.
translation: Buranin dogusunda *hic* büyük bir magara grubu var.

english: That might be them. Thank you.
No *hic* problem. Got *hic* any wine?
Yes? Can I help you?
What do you have for sale?
Only the finest herbal supplies.
No thanks.
Move along then.
What do you have for sale?
No thanks.
Want to go on an adventure?
You think so?
I was thinking the same thing!
Oh, absolutely!
Yeah, me too...
I don't know about that one.
Yes.
No.
Hello.
What are you doing in our village, outlander?
Nothing much.
Bah! Go down to the longhall, and there you will find excitement aplenty! Our finest warrior, Gunthor the Brave, will give you a rousing welcome!
translation: Bah! Uzun salona git, orada bolca eglence bulacaksin! En iyi savascimiz, Cesur Gunthor, sana coskulu bir karsilama yapacak!

english: I'll bear it in mind.
I'm exploring.
Bah! You cannot hope to learn anything of us just by strolling through our village! We are an ancient tribe, our ways date back to the time before Avarrocka was founded!
translation: Bah! Köyümüzde dolasarak bizim hakkimizda bir sey ögrenmeyi umut etmeyin! Biz eski bir kabileyiz, geleneklerimiz Avarrocka kurulmadan önceki zamanlara kadar uzanir!

english: Would you care to tell me more?
translation: Bana daha fazla bilgi vermek ister misiniz?

english: Oh? You are not so ignorant as I thought. Very well, I shall speak of our tribe...
translation: Oh? Sandigim kadar cahil degilsiniz. Pekala, kabilemizden bahsedeyim...

english: Our elders remember that about a century ago we were living in the lands far to the west. We were a large nomadic mountain tribe, settling wherever there was food, moving on when it had run out. As the tribe
translation: Yaslilarimiz, yaklasik bir asir önce batinin uzak topraklarinda yasadigimizi hatirliyor. Biz büyük bir göcebe dag kabilesiydik, yiyecek buldugumuz her yere yerlesir, bittiginde baska yere giderdik. Kabile

english: grew larger, it was hard to find enough food for everyone, and we were forced to shift our camp more and more often. In time, a warrior called Gunnar took his friends and their families and left the larger tribe,
translation: büyüdükce, herkese yetecek kadar yiyecek bulmak zorlasti ve kampimizi giderek daha sik degistirmek zorunda kaldik. Zamanla, Gunnar adinda bir savasci arkadaslarini ve ailelerini alip büyük kabileden ayrildi ve

english: moving south in search of new places. They eventually settled here and built this village, finding that the old nomadic traditions were no longer needed.
translation: yeni yerler aramak icin güneye dogru yola cikti. Sonunda buraya yerlestiler ve bu köyü kurdular, eski göcebe geleneklerinin artik gerekli olmadigini fark ettiler.

english: Our current chieftain, Gunthor the Brave, is a direct- line descendent of Gunnar.
translation: Su anki sefimiz, Cesur Gunthor, Gunnar'in dogrudan soyundan geliyor.

english: However, our ways have changed little in the last century. Although more and more people use magical powers, we do not believe it is wise to take upon oneself the power of the gods in this way. To this day, we fight
translation: Ancak, son yüzyilda geleneklerimiz pek degismedi. Her ne kadar giderek daha fazla insan sihirli gücler kullaniyor olsa da, tanrilarin gücünü bu sekilde üstlenmenin akillica olmadigini düsünüyoruz. Bugüne kadar,

english: with the mighty sword, the vicious axe and the swift arrow on the wind. Some of our young, wishing to try so-called 'civilisation' and the softness of city life, abandon the tribe and move to the cities. It is sad to
translation: güclü kilic, acimasiz balta ve rüzgarda ucan hizli oklarla savasiyoruz. Genclerimizden bazilari, sözde “medeniyet”i ve sehir hayatinin rahatligini denemek isteyerek kabileyi terk edip sehirlere tasiniyor. Onlarin gitmesini görmek üzücü

english: see them go, but we do not prevent them; we live here in our village because we love this life - we do not force it on those whom it does not suit.
translation: ama onlari engellemiyoruz; bu hayati sevdigimiz icin burada, köyümüzde yasiyoruz - bu hayati ona uygun olmayanlara zorla kabul ettirmiyoruz.

english: There, I have said enough.
Thank you.
You look like a load of primitive savages.
translation: Sizler bir grup ilkel vahsi gibi görünüyorsunuz.

english: And you look like an arrogant fool. And you smell like a raccoon's bottom.
translation: Sen ise kibirli bir aptal gibi görünüyorsun. Ve bir rakun kici gibi kokuyorsun.

english: I'm bored.
I came to kill you all!
Ho ho! Brave words indeed from an outerlander! Go down to the longhall and try it!
translation: Ho ho! Bir yabancinin cesur sözleri! Uzun salona in ve dene!

english: Well done.
You've [found a new clue/obtained a casket]!
translation: Yeni bir ipucu buldun/bir tabut elde ettin!

english: Nothing much.
I'm exploring.
Tell me about your tribe.
You look like a load of primitive savages.
I'm bored.
I came to kill you all!
Whoah there, stranger, careful where you're walking. I almost clobbered you there; thought you were a larupia or something.
translation: Hey, yabanci, yürürken dikkatli ol. Az kalsin sana carpiyordum; seni larupia falan sandim.

english: What are you doing here?
Me? Oh, I'm just having some fun, capturing wild animals, living on the edge, stuff like that.
translation: Ben mi? Oh, sadece egleniyorum, vahsi hayvanlari yakaliyorum, tehlikeli seyler yapiyorum, öyle seyler.

english: Hey, want me to teach you how to catch the critters around here? Ain't come across anything yet that I couldn't capture.
translation: Hey, buradaki hayvanlari nasil yakalayacagini ögretmemi ister misin? Henüz yakalayamadigim bir sey olmadi.

english: Ok, where's a good place to start?
translation: Tamam, baslamak icin iyi bir yer neresi?

english: Your easiest bet around here is probably to go for some of the birds. Go for the crimson swifts; they're the bright red ones that hang around near the coast. They're as obliging as can be, or maybe they're just
translation: Buralarda en kolayi muhtemelen kuslari yakalamaktir. Kizil swiftleri yakala; kiyi yakinlarinda dolasan parlak kirmizi olanlar. Cok uysaldirlar, ya da belki de sadece

english: plain dumb, but either way they just seem to throw themselves into traps half the time.
translation: aptaldirlar, ama her halükarda cogu zaman kendilerini tuzaga atiyorlar.

english: What sort of traps should I use?
Just use a standard bird snare and you'll be fine. You can get them in any decent shop that sells Hunter gear.
translation: Standart bir kus tuzagi kullan, sorun olmaz. Avci ekipmanlari satan herhangi bir magazadan alabilirsin.

english: How do they work, then?

Well, they're kind of sneaky, really. You've got a tall post with what appears to be a little perch sticking out the side. Now, the bird will see this as somewhere to sit, but the perch is actually rigged such that when the bird
translation: Aslinda, biraz sinsi bir sistem. Yaninda kücük bir tünek gibi görünen uzun bir direk var. Kus bunu oturmak icin bir yer olarak görür, ama tünek aslinda kus

english: lands on it, it'll drop away.
Further, as the perch drops, it releases a noose that tightens around the bird's feet and captures it. Neat huh?
translation: Ayrica, tünek düserken kusun ayaklarini saran ve onu yakalayan bir ilmek serbest birakir. Harika, degil mi?

english: So, was there anything else you wanted to ask about?
translation: Baska sormak istediginiz bir sey var mi?

english: Thanks for your help.
Not a problem, any time.
What sort of things are there to catch around here?
What're you interested in? You've got anything from birds for beginners up to larupias for the pros, not to mention weasels, butterflies, barb-tails and chinchompas.
translation: Neyle ilgileniyorsunuz? Yeni baslayanlar icin kuslardan profesyoneller icin larupialara kadar her sey var, tabii ki gelincikler, kelebekler, barb-tails ve chinchompas da dahil.

english: How would I go about catching birds?
There are a couple of varieties that you can try your hand at catching around here, but the technique for both is essentially the same. You need to set up a bird snare.
translation: Buralarda yakalamayi deneyebileceginiz birkac tür var, ama her ikisi icin de teknik temelde ayni. Bir kus kapani kurmaniz gerekiyor.

english: Further, as the perch drops, it releases a noose that tightens around the bird's feet and captures it. Neat, huh?
translation: Ayrica, tünek düstügünde, kusun ayaklarini sikistirarak onu yakalayan bir ilmek serbest birakir. Harika, degil mi?

english: How do I get hold of a weasel?

Not with large quantities of rice and treacle as many people would have you believe. Besides, the Feldip weasel isn't technically a weasel, but, as is typical with any sort of colloquial name, it's been called that often enough
translation: Cogu insanin inandirdigi gibi büyük miktarda pirinc ve pekmezle degil. Ayrica, Feldip gelincigi teknik olarak bir gelincik degildir, ancak her türlü halk dilinde oldugu gibi, bu isim o kadar sik kullanildi ki

english: now that it's stuck.
Anyway, the Feldip weasel's main survival technique is in hiding; other than that, it's pretty stupid. So, if you can actually find one, then you've probably got a fairly good chance of catching one.
translation: Her neyse, Feldip gelinciginin ana hayatta kalma teknigi saklanmaktir; bunun disinda oldukca aptaldir. Yani, bir tane bulabilirseniz, muhtemelen onu yakalama sansiniz oldukca yüksektir.

english: And how would I actually go about finding one?
The best place to start would probably be just south of here. You'll find lots of kebbit burrows there. Take a close look at some of them, follow the trails and you can't go far wrong.
translation: Baslamak icin en iyi yer muhtemelen buradan biraz güneyde. Orada bircok kebbit yuvasi bulacaksin. Bazilarini yakindan incele, izleri takip et, yanlis yere gitme ihtimalin cok az.

english: Well, seeing as you seem to like larupias so much...
Ah yes, yes, larupias are fun; just think of them as big kittens.
translation: Evet, evet, larupialar eglencelidir; onlari büyük kediler gibi düsün.

english: Uh huh, big kittens that just want to rip your throat out!
translation: Evet, bogazini parcalamak isteyen büyük kediler!

english: Indeed, and you can use this to your advantage. If a larupia is keen to chase you then let it; that way you can happily lead it straight into your trap without any fuss or waiting around.
translation: Aynen, bunu kendi lehine kullanabilirsin. Bir larupia seni kovalamaya hevesliyse birak kovalasin; böylece onu hic ugrasmadan ve beklemeden dogrudan tuzagina cekebilirsin.

english: Into what sort of trap should I lead it?
translation: Onu ne tür bir tuzaga cekmeliyim?

english: A pit trap should do you. There are some appropriate pits to the east of here that you can use. Cover one with a few logs and branches, tease the kitty and then lead it to the pit. Simple.
translation: Bir cukur tuzagi isini görür. Buradan doguda kullanabilecegin uygun cukurlar var. Birini birkac kütük ve dal ile ört, kedicigi kizdir ve sonra onu cukura cek. Basit.

english: Barb-tails sound interesting.

They do sound interesting, don't they? Unfortunately, they're actually just another type of kebbit; those things get everywhere. Still, the tails of these particular kebbits can be useful for fishing.
translation: Ilginc görünüyorlar, degil mi? Ne yazik ki, aslinda onlar da kebbit türlerinden biri; bu seyler her yerde var. Yine de, bu kebbitlerin kuyruklari balik tutmak icin yararli olabilir.

english: So, how would I go about catching one them?
Just squash them with a boulder, quick and simple.
translation: Bir kaya parcasiyla ez, hizli ve basit.

english: What, you mean just pick up some boulders and start throwing them at kebbits? That doesn't sound simple.
translation: Ne, yani birkac kaya alip kebbitlere atmaya mi baslayayim? Bu pek basit gelmiyor.

english: No silly, you let the creature squash itself. Just use some sticks to hold a boulder in a nice precarious position, place some bait underneath and let the creature knock itself out.
translation: Hayir aptal, yaratigin kendini ezmesine izin ver. Birkac cubukla kayayi dengeli bir pozisyonda tut, altina yem koy ve yaratigin kendini ezmesine izin ver.

english: What on earth is a chinchompa?
Awwww, chinchompas are great. They're highly volatile little balls of fluff. Cute as you like, but for some reason they do have this tendency to spontaneously combust.
translation: Chinchompa'lar harikadir. Cok ucucu, kücük tüy yumagidirlar. Cok sevimli ama nedense kendiliginden yanma egilimleri var.

english: What? Why?
Probably something to do with the fact they'll eat anything and everything, especially spicy food.
translation: Muhtemelen her seyi yemeleriyle ilgili bir sey, özellikle de baharatli yiyecekleri.

english: Anyways, if you want to capture a chinchompa, I suggest using a box trap. That way, if the little fluffball does explode, then at least most of the blast will be contained within the box.
translation: Her neyse, bir chinchompa yakalamak istiyorsan, kutu tuzagi kullanmani öneririm. Böylece, kücük tüy yumagi patlarsa, en azindan patlamanin cogu kutunun icinde kalir.

english: Somehow butterflies don't strike me as your sort of thing.
translation: Nedense kelebekler senin tarzin gibi gelmiyor bana.

english: Not really, but some people like them. The ones around here are at least vaguely interesting, though. The black ones are supposedly magical butterflies.
translation: Pek sayilmaz, ama bazi insanlar onlari sever. Buralardakiler en azindan biraz ilginctir. Siyah olanlar sihirli kelebekler oldugu söylenir.

english: Doesn't that make them harder to catch?
Not particularly; you can still catch them using an ordinary butterfly net. Oh, and you'll probably need some butterfly jars in which to keep them as well.
translation: Özellikle degil; siradan bir kelebek agiyla yakalayabilirsin. Oh, ve muhtemelen onlari saklamak icin kelebek kavanozlarina da ihtiyacin olacak.

english: How can I improve my chances of making a capture?
There are four key factors that will affect your chances: what bait you use, how close to the trap you are, your appearance and your smell.
translation: Sansini etkileyecek dört ana faktör vardir: kullandigin yem, tuzaga ne kadar yakin oldugun, görünüsün ve kokun.

english: How does bait help?

Unfortunately, creatures don't just jump into traps for the fun of it nearly as often as we as Hunters might like. However, it is possible to improve those odds. If you can find the right bait to use on your trap,
translation: Ne yazik ki, yaratiklar avcilar olarak bizim istedigimiz kadar sik sik eglence icin tuzaklara atlamazlar. Ancak, bu olasiligi artirmak mümkündür. Tuzak icin dogru yemi bulabilirseniz,

english: something your prey really craves, then hunger overrides fear and the creature is just that little bit more likely to bounce to its furry little doom.
translation: avinizin gercekten cok istedigi bir sey, o zaman aclik korkuyu bastirir ve yaratik, tüylü kücük kaderine biraz daha yaklasir.

english: Why is it important how close I am to the trap?
translation: Tuzaga ne kadar yakin oldugum neden önemlidir?

english: However well you might be blending in, if you're standing with your nose pressed right up against your own trap, the poor little critters ain't going to go anywhere near it. So, you need to make sure you put
translation: Ne kadar iyi uyum saglasaniz da, burnunuzu kendi tuzaginiza dayamis durursaniz, zavalli kücük yaratiklar tuzaga yaklasmayacaktir. Bu yüzden, kendinizle tuzaginiz arasinda

english: a sensible distance - I'd say at least four strides - between yourself and your trap.
translation: makul bir mesafe birakmaniz gerekir - en az dört adim diyebilirim.

english: Why would the creatures care about my appearance?
translation: Yaratiklar neden benim görünüsümü umursasin ki?

english: You're a human. From the point of view of a lot of creatures, you're big and scary. So, it'd be best if the furry little monsters didn't notice you. You need to blend in like the creatures themselves.
translation: Sen bir insansin. Bircok yaratigin gözünde, sen büyük ve korkutucusun. Bu yüzden, tüylü kücük canavarlarin seni fark etmemesi en iyisi olur. Yaratiklar gibi ortama uyum saglamalisin.

english: And how do I do that?

Easy, dress up like one of them. Even easier, dress up using the furs of the creatures themselves; then you're bound to get the colour right. And, I suppose, if you don't fancy just slinging a dead fur over your
translation: Kolay, onlardan biri gibi giyin. Daha da kolayi, yaratiklarin kendi kürklerini kullanarak giyin; böylece rengi de dogru olur. Ve sanirim, ölü bir kürkü omuzlarina atmak istemiyorsan,

english: shoulders, you can probably get them made into something more appealing. I hear there are tailors in Varrock who are good at that sort of thing.
translation: muhtemelen daha cekici bir sey haline getirebilirsin. Varrock'ta bu tür islerde iyi olan terziler oldugunu duydum.

english: What's wrong with my smell!?

I'm sure there's nothing wrong with your smell...from a human point of view. But to your prey, any trap that you've set up will reek of human, and that's going to work against you if you don't do anything about it.
translation: Kokunda bir sorun olmadigina eminim... insan bakis acisindan. Ama avin icin, kurdugun tuzaklar insan kokacak ve bu konuda bir sey yapmazsan aleyhine calisacaktir.

english: So what should I do?

You need to mask that lovely human scent of yours with something else. Smoke works well. Take a lit torch and waft it around the trap a bit. You'll quickly overpower most of the other smells around the trap.
translation: O güzel insan kokunu baska bir seyle maskelemelisin. Duman iyi sonuc verir. Yanan bir mesale al ve tuzagin etrafinda biraz dolastir. Tuzagin etrafindaki diger kokularin cogunu hizla bastiracaksin.

english: Where can I get clothes and equipment like yours?
translation: Seninki gibi kiyafetleri ve ekipmanlari nereden bulabilirim?

english: Well, the equipment isn't too hard to get hold of. You've got specialist shops like Aleck's in Yanille that'll see you right. He's a bit pricey, mind, but it's pretty decent kit.
translation: Ekipmanlari bulmak cok zor degil. Yanille'deki Aleck's gibi uzman magazalar var, orada bulabilirsin. Biraz pahalidir ama oldukca iyi ekipmanlar satiyor.

english: The clothing is a tad trickier to get hold of, the materials required being rather difficult to seperate from their reluctant owners.
translation: Giysileri bulmak biraz daha zor, cünkü gerekli malzemeleri sahiplerinden almak oldukca zor.

english: But, if you can get the furs, there are shops like the tailor's in east Varrock that can help you.
translation: Ama kürkleri bulabilirsen, Varrock'un dogusundaki terziler gibi sana yardimci olabilecek dükkanlar var.

english: I think I'll give it a miss right now, thanks.
Suit yourself!
What's a larupia?
What's a larupia? You don't know? You mean you really don't recognise the significance of these clothes I'm wearing?
translation: Larupia nedir? Bilmiyor musun? Yani, giydigim bu kiyafetlerin önemini gercekten anlamiyor musun?

english: Well, they're certainly decorative...what about them?
translation: Sey, kesinlikle dekoratifler... ne olmus onlara?

english: Well, these are the furs from a larupia. Caught the creature myself I did, and these make me blend in better, see?
translation: Bunlar larupia'nin kürkleri. Bu yaratigi kendim yakaladim ve bunlar sayesinde ortama daha iyi uyum sagliyorum, anladin mi?

english: If you want to be successful as a hunter you've got to be as stealthy as a kyatt, as quiet as a mouse and blend in like a, well, like a larupia, I guess!
translation: Basarili bir avci olmak istiyorsan, bir kyatt kadar gizli, bir fare kadar sessiz ve bir larupia gibi ortama uyum saglamalisin!

english: What is that cool cape you're wearing?

This? It's a Hunter's Skillcape. It shows that I am a true master of the art of Hunting and provides five daily teleports to either the Feldip Hills or Wilderness Hunter areas. If you ever manage to train your
translation: Bu mu? Bu bir Avci Beceri Pelerini. Bu pelerin, avcilik sanatinda gercek bir usta oldugumu gösterir ve her gün Feldip Tepeleri veya Wilderness Avci alanlarina bes kez isinlanma imkani saglar. Avcilik becerini

english: Hunter skill to its maximum level then I could sell you one.
translation: maksimum seviyeye cikarirsan sana bir tane satabilirim.

english: Ahh, leave me alone you crazy killing person.
translation: Ahh, birak beni rahatca, seni cilgin katil.

english: Heh, well I guess it's not everyone's thing.
Can I buy a Hunter's Skillcape from you?
translation: Senden bir Avci Beceri Pelerini satin alabilir miyim?

english: I would be delighted to recognise you as a master hunter, the cape provides five daily teleports to either the Feldip Hills or Wilderness Hunter areas. I will need 99000 coins to cover the expense of making such a
translation: Seni usta bir avci olarak tanimaktan mutluluk duyarim, pelerin Feldip Hills veya Wilderness Hunter bölgelerine günlük bes kez isinlanma imkani saglar. Böyle pahali bir esyanin üretim masraflarini karsilamak icin 99.000 sikkeye ihtiyacim var.

english: costly item!
99000! That seems a bit expensive.
Actually it's quite reasonable; it's made from the fur of the nearly extinct Raharni wildcat. Well, if you change your mind you know where to find me.
translation: Aslinda oldukca makul bir fiyat; neredeyse nesli tükenmis Raharni yaban kedisinin kürkünden yapilmis. Eger fikrini degistirirsen, beni nerede bulacagini biliyorsun.

english: Certainly, I'm happy to pay that.
translation: Elbette, bu parayi seve seve öderim.

english: But it seems that I don't have enough money with me.
translation: Ama yanimda yeterince para yok gibi görünüyor.

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.
translation: Peki, paran oldugunda tekrar gelip beni gör.

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: Maalesef tüm Skillcapes sadece ücretsiz bir baslik ile satiliyor, bu bir beceri promosyonunun parcasi; bir alana bir bedava, bilirsin. Yani sana bir tane satabilmem icin önce envanterinde yer acman gerekiyor.

english: Now you look like a true hunter!
translation: Simdi gercek bir avci gibi görünüyorsun!

english: What are you doing here?
Okay, where's a good place to start?
What other sorts of things are there to catch around here?
translation: Buralarda baska ne tür seyler avlanabilir?

english: Thanks for your help.
What sort of things are there to catch around here?
How would I go about catching birds?
I'd like to ask about another creature...
translation: Baska bir yaratik hakkinda bir sey sormak istiyorum...

english: How can I improve my chances of making a capture?
Where can I get clothes and equipment like yours?
translation: Seninki gibi kiyafet ve ekipmanlari nereden bulabilirim?

english: How do I get hold of a weasel?
Well, seeing as you seem to like larupias so much...
More...
Barb-tails sound interesting.
What on earth is a chinchompa?
Somehow butterflies don't strike me as your sort of thing.
translation: Kelebekler pek senin tarzin gibi gelmiyor bana.

english: Back...
How does bait help?
Why is it important how close I am to the trap?
translation: Tuzaga ne kadar yakin oldugum neden önemli?

english: Why would the creatures care about my appearance?
translation: Yaratiklar neden görünüsüme önem versin ki?

english: What's wrong with my smell!?
I think I'll give it a miss right now.
What's a larupia?
So, what's good to hunt around here?
translation: Buralarda avlanmak icin ne iyi olur?

english: What is that cool cape you're wearing?
Ahh, leave me alone you crazy killing person.
translation: Ahh, beni rahat birak seni cilgin katil.

english: Skillcape of Hunter.
99000! That seems a bit expensive.
Certainly, I'm happy to pay that.
Hunting.
What is this cave here for?
Ah, a few of the most hunted creatures around here have been captured and secured in this cave to allow the most esteemed hunters to catch them with ease.
translation: Ah, bu civardaki en cok avlanan yaratiklarin birkaci bu magarada yakalanip tutuldu, böylece en saygin avcilar onlari kolayca yakalayabilir.

english: Can I use the cave?
Yes, you can. Head inside to hunt in peace.
translation: Evet, kullanabilirsin. Iceri girip huzur icinde avlanabilirsin.

english: Unfortunately not. Only those who have completed the hard tier of the Western Provinces achievement diary may enter.
translation: Maalesef hayir. Sadece Bati Eyaletleri basari günlügünün zor seviyesini tamamlayanlar girebilir.

english: Come back when you have and I shall allow you entry.
translation: Tamamladiginda geri gel, sana giris izni verecegim.

english: Sorry, but only those who've completed the hard set of the Western Provinces tasks may enter my private hunting ground.
translation: Üzgünüm, ama sadece Bati Eyaletleri görevlerinin zor seviyesini tamamlayanlar benim özel avlanma alanima girebilir.

english: Ah, this is a wonderful area for a spot of hunting, don't you think?
translation: Ah, burasi avlanmak icin harika bir yer, sence de öyle degil mi?

english: I don't know, is it?
Oh absolutely; there's a huge variety of creatures to catch around here. You've got butterflies, polar kebbits, sabre-toothed kebbits, birds and even kyatts! Surely one of those piques your interest?
translation: Tabii ki; buralarda yakalayabilecegin cok cesitli yaratiklar var. Kelebekler, kutup kebbitleri, kilic disli kebbitler, kuslar ve hatta kyattlar var! Bunlardan biri mutlaka ilgini cekmistir, degil mi?

english: Where would I find polar kebbits?
Funnily enough, you've just put your finger right on the problem. With polar kebbits, finding them is the hardest part! You'll have to track them down.
translation: Komik bir sekilde, sorunun tam da özüne parmak bastin. Kutup kebbitlerini bulmak en zor kismi! Onlari takip etmen gerekecek.

english: How would I go about doing that, then?

The easiest way to get started is by looking somewhere you can be sure a kebbit will have been and then working from there. You see the holes around here leading down into the ice? They're kebbit burrows!
translation: Baslamak icin en kolay yol, kebbitlerin mutlaka bulunacagi bir yer aramak ve oradan baslamak. Buralarda buza inen delikler görüyor musun? Onlar kebbit yuvalari!

english: You'll be hard pressed to catch a polar kebbit in its home, but if you search around the entrance to a burrow then you might be able to find a trail.
translation: Kutup kebbitini yuvasinda yakalamak zor olabilir, ama yuvanin girisini arastirirsaniz izlerini bulabilirsiniz.

english: Now, kebbit trails are usually fairly easy to follow once you've found them, but if the trail does peter out, you should try inspecting the surrounding scenery for clues as to where the creature may have gone.
translation: Kebbit izleri genellikle buldugunuzda takip etmesi oldukca kolaydir, ama izler kaybolursa, yaratigin nereye gitmis olabilecegine dair ipuclari bulmak icin cevreyi incelemeye calismalisiniz.

english: Good places to look for clues include hollow logs in which the kebbit may have hidden or vegetation which may have been chewed or damaged.
translation: Ipuclari aramak icin iyi yerler arasinda kebbitlerin saklanmis olabilecegi ici bos kütükler veya cignenmis veya zarar görmüs bitkiler bulunur.

english: There are also tunnels running through the ice here that the kebbits use, so you should check those out as well.
translation: Burada kebbitlerin kullandigi buzun icinden gecen tüneller de vardir, bu yüzden onlari da kontrol etmelisiniz.

english: What's more, these tunnels can often help to shelter a trail from further snow, making it even easier for you to pick them up again.
translation: Dahasi, bu tüneller genellikle izleri daha fazla kardan korumaya yardimci olur, bu da izleri tekrar bulmanizi daha da kolaylastirir.

english: Eventually, of course, the kebbit will have probably hidden somewhere. Polar kebbits don't hang about in the open for long for fear of their natural predators.
translation: Sonunda, elbette, kebbit muhtemelen bir yere saklanmis olacaktir. Kutup kebbitleri, dogal düsmanlarindan korktuklari icin acik alanda uzun süre kalmazlar.

english: If you suspect a kebbit is close by, try looking around for signs of disturbed snow. Polar kebbits will often bury themselves in snow drifts as a means of hiding.
translation: Bir kebbitin yakinlarda oldugunu düsünüyorsaniz, karin bozulmus izleri olup olmadigina bakin. Kutup kebbitleri genellikle saklanmak icin kar yiginlarina gömülürler.

english: If you think you've found a kebbit, use a noose wand to haul the creature out from the snow.
translation: Bir kebbit buldugunuzu düsünüyorsaniz, ilmekli degnek kullanarak yaratigi kardan cikarin.

english: Wow, that's quite a lot to remember.
translation: Vay canina, hatirlanmasi gereken cok sey var.

english: Don't worry; if you find yourself struggling to follow a trail, just come and ask me and I'll see if I can help.
translation: Merak etmeyin, izleri takip etmekte zorlaniyorsaniz gelip bana sorun, size yardimci olmaya calisirim.

english: But remember, the best place to start is by searching around their burrows.
translation: Ama unutmayin, en iyi baslangic noktasi yuvalarinin cevresini aramaktir.

english: Great, thanks.
How do you hunt birds?
Ah, you can get cunning little bird snares for just that. You should be able to find them in specialist Hunter shops. Try to lay them in fairly open areas with lots of birds.
translation: Ah, bunun icin kücük, kurnaz kus tuzaklari alabilirsiniz. Bunlari avci dükkanlarinda bulabilirsiniz. Kuslarin cok oldugu, oldukca acik alanlara yerlestirmeye calisin.

english: Do I need to place any bait on these traps?
translation: Bu tuzaklara yem koymam gerekir mi?

english: No, that's not necessary. The idea is that the bird will see the trap as somewhere to perch. If the bird lands on the trigger stick, it should drop away and a small loop of wire should close around the bird's feet.
translation: Hayir, gerek yok. Buradaki amac, kusun tuzagi tüneme yeri olarak görmesidir. Kus tetik cubuguna konarsa, cubuk düser ve kücük bir tel halkasi kusun ayaklarini sarar.

english: And remember, it's important to collect any captures from your traps fairly quickly; otherwise, you risk losing them to various wild scavengers.
translation: Unutma, tuzaklarindan yakaladiklarini oldukca hizli bir sekilde toplamak önemlidir; aksi takdirde, cesitli yirtici hayvanlara kaptirma riski vardir.

english: How can I improve my chances of capturing a creature?
translation: Bir yaratigi yakalama sansimi nasil artirabilirim?

english: Ah, the key there is concealment, both of yourself and your traps.
translation: Ah, burada anahtar nokta, hem kendinizi hem de tuzaklarinizi gizlemektir.

english: The most obvious point is to stay out of sight of your own traps. If possible, hide around a wall, hedge or similar. Failing that, make sure you're a good few feet away from your trap.
translation: En bariz nokta, kendi tuzaklarinizin görüs alanindan uzak durmaktir. Mümkünse, bir duvar, cit veya benzeri bir seyin arkasina saklanin. Bu mümkün degilse, tuzaginizdan birkac metre uzakta oldugunuzdan emin olun.

english: You can hide yourself even better by wearing clothing appropriate to the area in which you are hunting.
translation: Avlandiginiz bölgeye uygun giysiler giyerek kendinizi daha da iyi gizleyebilirsiniz.

english: Your best bet is to use the skins of creatures native to the area. There is a very good tailor in east Varrock who may be able to help you with making clothing out of such skins.
translation: En iyi secenek, o bölgeye özgü hayvanlarin derilerini kullanmaktir. Dogu Varrock'ta, bu derilerden giysi yapmaniza yardimci olabilecek cok iyi bir terzi var.

english: Finally, a lot of creatures may avoid your traps if they can smell a human scent on them. This is where smoking a trap can be useful.
translation: Son olarak, bircok hayvan, tuzaklarda insan kokusu alirsa tuzaklardan kacabilir. Bu durumda tuzagi tütsülemek faydali olabilir.

english: It takes a bit of practice, but by using the smoke from a torch, you can mask any other scents that may surround a trap.
translation: Biraz pratik gerektirir, ancak bir mesaleyle duman cikararak tuzagin etrafindaki diger kokulari maskeleyebilirsiniz.

english: Wow, thanks for your help.
You're welcome, good luck with the hunting.
What's so special about butterflies?
That depends entirely on the butterfly.
I'll admit that the activities of many butterflies may be of no interest at all. However, we are lucky in having around here some fine examples of rare thaumic butterflies.
translation: Bircok kelebegin faaliyetlerinin hic ilgi cekici olmadigini kabul ediyorum. Ancak, bu civarda nadir bulunan thaumic kelebeklerin güzel örneklerine sahip oldugumuz icin sansliyiz.

english: These butterflies reputedly have magical powers that, when released, can make a person stronger or heal otherwise critical wounds.
translation: Bu kelebeklerin, serbest birakildiklarinda bir kisiyi daha güclü hale getirebilen veya aksi takdirde ölümcül olabilecek yaralari iyilestirebilen sihirli güclere sahip oldugu söylenir.

english: At this point, I should offer a note of caution, however: it is also said that these powers will not manifest themselves if the butterflies are captured for selfish purposes.
translation: Ancak bu noktada bir uyarida bulunmaliyim: Kelebekler bencil amaclarla yakalanirsa bu güclerin ortaya cikmayacagi da söylenir.

english: Rather, they are gifts that must be used by one person to aid another. Of course, you'll have to catch them first.
translation: Aksine, bunlar bir kisinin baska birine yardim etmek icin kullanmasi gereken hediyelerdir. Tabii ki, önce onlari yakalamaniz gerekir.

english: Why, with a butterfly net of course! You should also carry some empty butterfly jars with you in which to keep the butterflies.
translation: Tabii ki kelebek agiyla! Kelebekleri saklamak icin yaninizda bos kelebek kavanozlari da tasimalisiniz.

english: How can I capture a sabre-toothed kebbit?
Ah, now for these creatures I would recommend using a deadfall trap. Deadfalls are quite easy to set up, and yet you can catch some very reasonably sized creatures with them.
translation: Ah, bu yaratiklar icin ölü tuzak kullanmanizi öneririm. Ölü tuzaklar kurmak oldukca kolaydir ve bunlarla oldukca makul büyüklükte yaratiklari yakalayabilirsiniz.

english: Deadfall traps basically work by having a large dead weight, such as a boulder, positioned so as to be delicately balanced above some form of bait.
translation: Deadfall tuzaklari temel olarak, bir kaya parcasi gibi büyük bir agirlik, bir tür yem üzerinde hassas bir sekilde dengelenmis sekilde konumlandirilarak calisir.

english: You will need to make sure you have a knife and some wood with you to create appropriate supports and a trigger for this sort trap.
translation: Bu tür bir tuzak icin uygun destekler ve bir tetikleyici olusturmak icin yaninizda bir bicak ve biraz odun bulundurmaniz gerekir.

english: In the case of sabre-toothed kebbits you should use some form of raw meat to bait your trap, but other animals may prefer other baits, such as fish or vegetables.
translation: Kilic disli kebbitler icin tuzaginizi tuzaklamak icin bir tür cig et kullanmalisiniz, ancak diger hayvanlar balik veya sebze gibi baska yemleri tercih edebilir.

english: Oooh, kyatts soundsinteresting. I want to catch one of those.
