translation: Oooh, kyattlar ilginc görünüyor. Onlardan birini yakalamak istiyorum.

english: Well, you've set your sights high, kyatts are incredibly fearsome creatures, but with determination like that I'm sure you'll make it.
translation: Eh, hedeflerinizi yüksek tutmussunuz, kyattlar inanilmaz derecede korkutucu yaratiklar, ama bu kadar kararliysaniz eminim basaracaksiniz.

english: Now, you're not going to be able to catch a kyatt with just a small box or a noose on a stick. You need a much bigger trap.
translation: Simdi, kücük bir kutu veya bir cubugun ucuna baglanmis bir ilmekle kyatt yakalayamazsin. Cok daha büyük bir tuzak gerekir.

english: Pit traps are a good bet. You'd be best off finding a natural dip in the ground as the basis for your trap. If you dig a pit yourself, you risk creatures noticing the disturbed ground nearby.
translation: Cukur tuzaklari iyi bir secimdir. Tuzak icin temel olarak zeminde dogal bir cukur bulman en iyisidir. Kendin cukur kazarsan, yaratiklarin yakinlardaki bozulmus zemini fark etme riski vardir.

english: Once you've found an appropriate spot, you'll need some logs and a knife. The logs serve two purposes.
translation: Uygun bir yer bulduktan sonra, birkac kütük ve bir bicak gerekir. Kütüklerin iki amaci vardir.

english: Some can be carved into sharp skewers for the bottom of the pit; hopefully the kyatt will die when it falls onto these. Others can be used to conceal the trap.
translation: Bazilari cukurun dibine yerlestirmek icin keskin sisler olarak oyulabilir; umarim kyatt bunlara düstügünde ölür. Digerleri ise tuzagi gizlemek icin kullanilabilir.

english: Of course, even then the pit is going to look suspicious, so you're going to need to lure the kyatt onto the branches in some way. What actually tends to work best for this is, well, yourself!
translation: Tabii ki, o zaman bile cukur süpheli görünecektir, bu yüzden kyatt'i bir sekilde dallara cekmeniz gerekecektir. Bunun icin en iyi sonuc veren sey, aslinda sizsiniz!

english: What? I don't like the sound of that.
Yes, that's the normal response, but I kid you not. If you really want a kyatt to follow you over that pit then just give it a good poke!
translation: Evet, bu normal bir tepki, ama saka yapmiyorum. Kyatt'in sizi cukura kadar takip etmesini istiyorsaniz, ona iyice bir dürtün!

english: Of course, I suggest you use something long to poke it with. Poking a kyatt with your finger is likely to end in unfortunate limb loss.
translation: Tabii ki, onu dürtmek icin uzun bir sey kullanmanizi öneririm. Kyatt'i parmaginizla dürtmek, muhtemelen talihsiz bir uzuv kaybiyla sonuclanacaktir.

english: Fortunately, you can get very good sticks for poking from most Hunter shops.
translation: Neyse ki, cogu avci dükkanindan dürtmek icin cok iyi sopalar bulabilirsiniz.

english: Once you have...got the creature's attention, try to lead it to one of your traps. Make sure to jump the branches when you reach the trap yourself, of course; it would be embarrassing to fall into your own trap.
translation: Yaratigin dikkatini cektiginizde, onu tuzaklarinizdan birine yönlendirmeye calisin. Tabii ki, tuzaga ulastiginizda dallarin üzerinden atladiginizdan emin olun; kendi tuzaginiza düsmek utanc verici olur.

english: Then, if the kyatt is giving you all of its attention, hopefully it won't notice the trap, and with any luck, it will stumble right into the pit.
translation: Sonra, kyatt tüm dikkatini size verirse, umarim tuzagi fark etmez ve sansiniz varsa, cukura düser.

english: That sounds a bit hit or miss, and kind of suicidal too!
translation: Bu biraz sans isi ve intihar gibi de geliyor!

english: Well that's what makes it exciting, isn't it? But honestly, if you want to capture a kyatt, that's your best bet.
translation: Iste bu da onu heyecanli kilan sey, degil mi? Ama dürüst olmak gerekirse, bir kyatt yakalamak istiyorsaniz, en iyi sansiniz bu.

english: Can you teach me how to hunt?
Why certainly. I reached the peak of my abilities some time ago, but I'm more than happy to help newcomers to the field. Was there anything in particular you had in mind?
translation: Elbette. Bir süre önce yeteneklerimin zirvesine ulastim, ama bu alana yeni baslayanlara yardim etmekten mutluluk duyarim. Aklinda özel bir sey var mi?

english: Where's the best place to start?
translation: Baslamak icin en iyi yer neresi?

english: I always say a good starting point is to learn how to follow the creatures you want to capture. Around here, that means practicing on polar kebbits.
translation: Her zaman, yakalamak istedigin yaratiklari takip etmeyi ögrenmenin iyi bir baslangic noktasi oldugunu söylerim. Buralarda bu, kutup kebbitleri üzerinde pratik yapmak anlamina gelir.

english: So how do I track them down, then?
What sort of creatures are there to hunt around here?
translation: Buralarda avlanabilecek ne tür yaratiklar var?

english: Well, there's pretty much anything you could want to hunt. You've got butterflies, polar kebbits, sabre-toothed kebbits, birds and even kyatts! Surely one of those interests you?
translation: Avlamak isteyebilecegin hemen hemen her sey var. Kelebekler, kutup kebbitleri, kilic disli kebbitler, kuslar ve hatta kyattlar! Bunlardan biri ilginizi cekmiyor mu?

english: Sorry, I'm not that keen on hunting.
Really? What a shame, you looked like someone who could have had some promise.
translation: Gercekten mi? Ne yazik, umut vaat eden biri gibi görünüyordun.

english: I don't know, is it?
Where would I find polar kebbits?
How do you hunt birds?
I'd like to ask about another creature.
translation: Baska bir yaratik hakkinda soru sormak istiyorum.

english: How can I improve my chances of capturing a creature?
translation: Bir yaratigi yakalama sansimi nasil artirabilirim?

english: What's so special about butterflies?
How can I capture a sabre-toothed kebbit?
Oooh, kyatts sounds interesting.
Can you teach me how to hunt?
Where's the best place to start?
translation: Baslamak icin en iyi yer neresi?

english: What sort of creatures are there to hunt around here?
translation: Buralarda avlanabilecegim ne tür yaratiklar var?

english: Sorry, I'm not that keen on hunting.
Greetings, fellow hunter. How can I be of help?
translation: Selamlar, avci dostum. Nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: What kinds of food and drink do you serve?
translation: Ne tür yiyecek ve icecekler servis ediyorsunuz?

english: In terms of drinks, we've got a Trapper's Tipple, and for food, a simple hearty stew.
translation: Icecek olarak Trapper's Tipple, yiyecek olarak da basit ve doyurucu bir güvec var.

english: But you don't have room to hold either of them, so you'll have to come back later.
translation: Ama ikisini de tasiyacak yerin yok, o yüzden daha sonra tekrar gelmen gerekecek.

english: Couldn't you just leave it on the ground for me?
translation: Onu benim icin yere birakamaz misin?

english: We don't tend to just... leave things like that around here.
translation: Buralarda öylece bir seyleri birakma aliskanligimiz yok.

english: I'd love a Trapper's Tipple!
That'll be three coins then.
Oh, I can't afford one right now.
Could I grab a stew?
Absolutely! They're 20 coins these days.
Oh, I can't afford that right now.
I'll pass, thanks.
Can we talk about rumours?
Looks like you could do with talking to Verity first, given you're new to this whole business.
translation: Bu ise yeni basladigina göre, önce Verity ile konussan iyi olur.

english: Yes, yes. How can I help you on that front?
translation: Evet, evet. Bu konuda nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: Do you have any new ones for me?
translation: Bana yeni bir sey var mi?

english: Could you check out the validity of this report for me? Someone thinks they've seen a [creature]. Once you find it, bring back one of its [rare parts].
There's been rumours of a rare [creature] coming in. Once you find it, bring back one of its [rare parts].
We've got reports of a slightly different [creature] in the local population. Once you find it, bring back one of its [rare parts].
Looks like we need some information on a unique specimen amongst the local [creature] population. Once you find it, bring back some of its [rare parts].
I've heard rumours of a strange [creature] that you could check out for me. Once you find it, bring back one of its [rare parts].
Another one done? You're really doing a lot for the guild.
translation: Bir tane daha mi bitirdin? Guild icin gercekten cok sey yapiyorsun.

english: Are you up for another?
translation: Bir tane daha yapmaya hazir misin?

english: Thanks for that. I'll mark off that report for you. Would you like another rumour?
translation: Tesekkürler. Raporu senin icin isaretleyecegim. Baska bir söylenti ister misin?

english: Can you remind me which rumour I'm chasing right now?
translation: Su anda hangi söylentinin pesinde oldugumu hatirlatir misin?

english: You're hunting for me at the moment. This rumour was about a [creature]. You'll need to bring back some of its [rare parts].
I can see you're following [Guild Hunter]'s rumour looking for a [creature] at the moment. You'll need to bring back some of its [rare parts].
I seem to remember sending you off to hunt a [creature] and bring back one of its [rare parts]. Would you prefer that one, or a new one entirely?
That was it. I asked you to hunt a [creature] and bring back one of its [rare parts]. Best of luck.
I'm good, thanks.
What kinds of food and drink do you serve?
translation: Ne tür yiyecek ve icecekler servis ediyorsunuz?

english: I'd love a Trapper's Tipple!
Could I grab a stew?
I'll pass, thanks.
Can we talk about rumours?
Yes.
No.
Yes, go back to his old one.
Yes, but with a brand new one.
I'm good, thanks.
'Ello [player name].
Hello, what's that you've got there?
A crossbow. Every now and then I sell the bits to make them.
translation: Bir tatar yayi. Ara sira bunlari yapmak icin gerekli parcalari satarim.

english: But not now?
That's right.
Sorry, I don't have anything to sell to you.
translation: Üzgünüm, sana satacak bir seyim yok.

english: A crossbow, are you interested?
Maybe, are they any good?
Are they any good?! They're dwarven engineering at its best!
translation: Iyi mi mi?! Cüce mühendisliginin en iyi örnegi!

english: How do I make one for myself?
Well, firstly you'll need to chop yourself some wood, then use a knife on the wood to whittle out a nice crossbow stock like these here.
translation: Öncelikle biraz odun kesmen gerek, sonra bicakla odunu oyup bunun gibi güzel bir tatar yayi sapi yapmalisin.

english: Wood fletched into stock... check.

Then get yourself some metal and a hammer and smith yourself some limbs for the bow, mind that you use the right metals and woods though as some wood is too light to use with some metal and vice versa.
translation: Sonra biraz metal ve cekic bulup yay icin kol yapmalisin, ancak bazi metaller ve agaclar birbiriyle uyumlu olmadigi icin dogru metal ve agaclari kullandigindan emin ol.

english: Which goes with which?
Wood and Bronze as they're basic materials, Oak and Blurite, Willow and Iron, Steel and Teak, Mithril and Maple, Adamantite and Mahogany and finally Runite and Yew.
translation: Temel malzemeler olan ahsap ve bronz, mese ve blurit, sögüt ve demir, celik ve tik, mithril ve akcaagac, adamantit ve maun ve son olarak runit ve porsuk.

english: Ok, so I have my stock and a pair of limbs... what now?
translation: Tamam, stokum ve bir cift kolum var... simdi ne yapacagim?

english: Simply take a hammer and smack the limbs firmly onto the stock. You'll then need a string, only they're not the same as normal bows. You'll need to dry some large animal's meat to get sinew, then spin that on a spinning
translation: Sadece bir cekic al ve kollari stoga sikica vur. Sonra bir ip gerekecek, ancak bunlar normal yaylardaki gibi degil. Sinir elde etmek icin büyük bir hayvanin etini kurutman, sonra da bunu bir egirme carkinda egirmen gerekecek.

english: wheel, it's the only thing we've found to be strong enough for a crossbow.
translation: Bu, tatar yayi icin yeterince güclü oldugunu gördügümüz tek sey.

english: What about magic logs?

Well.. I don't rightly know... us dwarves don't work with magic, we prefer gold and rock. Much more stable. I guess you could ask the humans at the rangers guild to see if they can do something but I don't want
translation: Sey... Tam olarak bilmiyorum... Biz cüceler sihirle ugrasmayiz, altin ve kayayi tercih ederiz. Cok daha istikrarlidir. Sanirim ormancilarin loncasina gidip insanlara bir seyler yapip yapamayacaklarini sorabilirsin, ama ben

english: anything to do with it!
Thanks for telling me. Bye!
Take care, straight shooting.
What about ammo?

You can smith yourself lots of different bolts, don't forget to flight them with feathers like you do arrows though. You can poison any untipped bolt but there's also the option of tipping them with gems then
translation: Kendin icin bircok farkli ok yapabilirsin, ama oklari yaptigin gibi tüylerle donatmayi unutma. Ucu olmayan oklari zehirleyebilirsin, ama uclarina mücevherler takip

english: enchanting them with runes. This can have some pretty powerful effects.
translation: rünlerle büyülü hale getirme secenegi de var. Bu oldukca güclü etkiler yaratabilir.

english: Oh my poor bank, how will I store all those?!
Find Hirko in Keldagrim, he also sells crossbow parts and I'm sure he has something you can use to store bolts in.
translation: Keldagrim'de Hirko'yu bul, o da tatar yayi parcalari satiyor ve eminim oklari saklayabilecegin bir seyleri vardir.

english: Thanks for the info.
How do I make one for myself?
What about magic logs?
Thanks for telling me. Bye!
What about ammo?
Hi!
Let me at 'em!
Trolls? Schmolls!
The trolls are coming!
The trolls took my baby son!
Welcome to Burthorpe!
Thanks!
Trolls!
Hello stranger.
Go away!
Run!
Hi!
The Imperial Guard can no longer protect us!
The White Knights will soon have control!
translation: Beyaz Sövalyeler yakinda kontrolü ele gecirecek!

english: I heard about what you did, thank you!
The White Knights are still going to take over.
translation: Beyaz Sövalyeler yine de kontrolü ele gecirecek.

english: I hear the Imperial Guard are preparing an attack!
translation: Imparatorluk Muhafizlarinin bir saldiri hazirligi yaptigini duydum!

english: Thank you so much!
Surely we are safe now!
Hello there, are you interested in buying one of my special capes?
translation: Merhaba, özel pelerinlerimden birini satin almak ister misiniz?

english: What's so special about your capes?

Ahh well they make it less likely that you'll accidently attack anyone wearing the same cape as you and easier to attack everyone else. They also make it easier to distinguish people who're wearing the same cape as you
translation: Ahh, ayni pelerini giyen birine yanlislikla saldirma olasiliginizi azaltir ve diger herkese saldirmanizi kolaylastirir. Ayrica, ayni pelerini giyen kisileri digerlerinden ayirt etmenizi kolaylastirir.

english: from everyone else. They're very useful when out in the wilderness with friends or anyone else you don't want to harm.
translation: Wildernessda arkadaslarinizla veya zarar vermek istemediginiz kisilerle birlikteyken cok kullanislidir. Arkadaslarinizla veya zarar vermek istemediginiz baska kisilerle Wildernessda dolasirken cok kullanislidirlar.

english: So would you like to buy one?
translation: Peki, bir tane satin almak ister misiniz?

english: No thanks.
What's so special about your capes?
Yes please!
No thanks.
Hur hur hur! Well look here, a puny fleshy human!
translation: Hur hur hur! Bakin, zayif, etli bir insan!

english: You should beware of the icy wind that runs through this valley, it will bring a fleshy like you to a cold end indeed!
translation: Bu vadiyi esen buz gibi rüzgardan sakinmalisin, senin gibi etli birini gercekten soguk bir sona götürür!

english: I don't really care for humans in my shop, so you'd better be buying something.
translation: Dükkanimda insanlari pek sevmem, o yüzden bir seyler alsan iyi olur.

english: What are you selling?
Shields.
I'll be on my way then.
Good.
What are you selling?
I'll be on my way then.
Hey, human.
Who are you?
Just a guard. If sneaky humans come in here without permission, I chuck rocks at 'em, knock 'em out and chuck 'em out of Weiss.
translation: Sadece bir muhafiz. Izin almadan buraya gizlice giren insanlara tas atarim, onlari bayilttiktan sonra Weiss'tan disari atarim.

english: I'm familiar with the idea, yeah.
Tell me about this place.
This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: Burasi Weiss. Yillar önce, daha güneydeki magaralardan kovulduktan sonra troller tarafindan insa edildi. Simdi Weiss bizim evimiz.

english: We done pretty good here. Got lots of goat and wolf to eat - they taste kinda boring after all this time, but there not much other choice.
translation: Burada oldukca iyi durumdayiz. Yiyebilecegimiz cok sayida keci ve kurt var - bunca zaman sonra tadi biraz sikici geliyor ama baska secenegimiz yok.

english: Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it. In fact My Arm is an expert on growing the stuff.
translation: Hic gut otu denedin mi? Onu seven troller taniyorum. Aslinda My Arm bu bitkinin yetistirilmesinde uzmandir.

english: Never heard of no gouty weed, no. But it sound like a vegetable, an' Mother not like eating those, so we probably not gonna try it.
translation: Gut otu diye bir sey duymadim, hayir. Ama sebzeye benziyor ve annem sebze yemeyi sevmez, o yüzden muhtemelen denemeyecegiz.

english: Mother not like new ideas much, but he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: Annem yeni fikirleri pek sevmez, ama o cok büyük ve patron, bu yüzden ne derse onu yapariz.

english: I see.
Do you like it here?
Eh, it kinda rough, but it our home. Odd Mushroom say he can make it nicer with fancy fires what he invented, but Mother not interested in that, so Odd Mushroom not allowed to do it.
translation: Eh, biraz zorlu, ama burasi bizim evimiz. Odd Mushroom, icat ettigi süslü ateslerle burayi daha güzel hale getirebilecegini söylüyor, ama annem bununla ilgilenmiyor, bu yüzden Odd Mushroom bunu yapamiyor.

english: Mother only care about stuff to help him fight better. An he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: Annem sadece onun daha iyi savasmasina yardimci olacak seylerle ilgileniyor. O cok büyük ve patron, bu yüzden ne derse onu yapiyoruz.

english: I'll be off.
Hey, friend of Snowflake!
Just a guard. If sneaky human come in here without permission, I chuck rocks at 'em, knock 'em out and chuck 'em out of Weiss.
translation: Sadece bir muhafiz. Izin almadan buraya gizlice giren insanlara tas atip, onlari bayilttiktan sonra Weiss'tan disari atiyorum.

english: It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: Burasi harika, simdi Snowflake ve kocasi troll bize goutweed yetistirmeyi ögretti. Yemekler artik cok daha lezzetli.

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: Eh, biraz zorlu ama gittikce daha iyi oluyor. Snowflake bize gut otu yetistirmeyi ögretti. Keci, kurt, insan, hepsi gut otu ile cok daha lezzetli oluyor.

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: Evet, Weiss yasamak icin iyi bir yer, artik Snowflake sorumlu. Tüm troller Snowflake'i sever. Kocasi biraz tuhaf bir trol ama bu bizim sorunumuz degil.

english: Who are you?
Tell me about this place.
Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it.
translation: Goutweed denedin mi hic? Onu seven troller taniyorum.

english: I see.
Do you like it here?
I'll be off.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu var. Merhaba, selam, selam sana...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her türlü sey! Kuleler harika bir manzara.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmenizi tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Halt human! What are you doing here?
Wait! What was that? What the...
Would you like to buy or sell anything?
translation: Bir sey satin almak veya satmak ister misin?

english: Yes, please.
No, thanks.
Yes, please.
No, thanks.
Hello Iffie!
Sorry, dearie, if I stop to chat I'll lose count. Talk to my sister instead; she likes to chat. You'll find her upstairs in the church.
translation: Üzgünüm canim, durup sohbet edersem sayiyi kaybederim. Onun yerine kiz kardesimle konus; o sohbet etmeyi sever. Onu kilisenin üst katinda bulabilirsin.

english: Hello Iffie, remember our adventure?
Me, forget? Never! I still hear the ringing in my head when I go to sleep sometimes!
translation: Ben, unutmak mi? Asla! Bazen uykuya daldigimda hala kafamda cinlama duyuyorum!

english: From the rolling pin and saucepan?
Yes, it was surprisingly loud doing that.
I don't know if it is that surprising. You were banging a metal saucepan on your head!
translation: O kadar sasirtici oldugunu sanmiyorum. Kafana metal bir tencere vuruyordun!

english: Hello dearie, of course I remember it!
I dream about it sometimes, especially sneaking into the Blue Moon Inn kitchens for the rolling pin and saucepan!
translation: Bazen rüyamda görüyorum, özellikle Blue Moon Inn mutfagina gizlice girip oklava ve tencereyi aldigimiz kismi!

english: Although probably best I don't do that again, I still feel bad for the chef.
translation: Muhtemelen bir daha yapmasam iyi olur, sef icin hala üzülüyorum.

english: Yes, probably best we don't!
I don't only remember it, I remember it fondly, I loved it!
translation: Sadece hatirlamiyorum, sevgiyle hatirliyorum, cok sevmistim!

english: It was a good adventure wasn't it!
Yes, very. I'm so happy that you picked me to help you.
translation: Evet, cok güzeldi. Bana yardim etmek icin beni sectigin icin cok mutluyum.

english: I couldn't have picked anyone else, you were the perfect accomplice!
translation: Baska kimseyi secemezdim, sen mükemmel bir suc ortagiydin!

english: Thank you, dearie!
Of course dearie! How could I ever forget it? I had such a great time.
translation: Tabii ki canim! Nasil unutabilirim ki? Cok eglendim.

english: Are you still adventuring?
I am doing my best to adventure. There are just so many things to do!
translation: Elimden gelenin en iyisini yapiyorum. Yapacak cok sey var!

english: Well keep it up, don't let an old lady like me distract you. I've had my fill of adventure now!
translation: Devam et, benim gibi yasli bir kadinin dikkatini dagitmasina izin verme. Benim macera ihtiyacim artik doydu!

english: There is no way I could forget it. Thank you for letting me come on such an adventure!
translation: Bunu asla unutmam. Böyle bir maceraya katilmama izin verdigin icin tesekkür ederim!

english: It was my pleasure, maybe we could do it again some day!
translation: Benim icin bir zevkti, belki bir gün tekrar yapabiliriz!

english: That would be lovely dearie, but maybe we go on one that doesn't involve climbing trees?
translation: Bu cok güzel olur canim, ama belki agaclara tirmanmak zorunda kalmayacagimiz bir macera olabilir?

english: I'm getting a bit old for that!
How could I not? It was amazing! I see you're still wearing that jumper I knitted you.
translation: Nasil unutabilirim? Harikaydi! Hala sana ördügüm kazagi giyiyorsun.

english: It's lovely, very versatile. Even keeps me warm in the coldest of places!
translation: Cok güzel, cok kullanisli. En soguk yerlerde bile beni sicak tutuyor!

english: That is good to hear. Do you have a favourite way to wear it?
translation: Bunu duymak güzel. En sevdigin giyme sekli var mi?

english: I like the orange version the best!
I like it too! It reminds me of pumpkins and spooky things, just like our adventure!
translation: Ben de seviyorum! Bana kabaklari ve ürkütücü seyleri hatirlatiyor, tipki maceramiz gibi!

english: I like the black version the best!
I like it too! It's pretty scary looking, just like how we saw Death in our adventure!
translation: Ben de seviyorum! Oldukca ürkütücü görünüyor, tipki maceramizda gördügümüz Ölüm gibi!

english: Sorry, dearie, if I stop to chat I'll lose count.
translation: Üzgünüm canim, sohbet etmek icin durursam sayiyi kaybedebilirim.

english: Hello Iffie!
Hello Iffie, remember our adventure?
Orange.
Black.
Can I help you at all?
Who are you?
My name is Ignatius Vulcan. Once I was - like you - an adventurer, but that was before I realised the beauty and power of flame! Just look at this...
translation: Benim adim Ignatius Vulcan. Bir zamanlar ben de senin gibi bir maceraciydim, ama bu, atesin güzelligini ve gücünü fark etmeden önceydi! Suna bir bak...

english: Yeeouch!

Stare into the flame and witness the purity and power of fire! As my attraction to flame grew, so did my skills at firelighting. I began to neglect my combat skills, my Mining skills and my questing. Who needs such
translation: Atese bak ve atesin safligini ve gücünü gör! Atese olan ilgim arttikca, ates yakma becerim de artti. Savas becerilerimi, madencilik becerilerimi ve görevlerimi ihmal etmeye basladim. Atesin gücünü kullanabiliyorken kim bu kadar siradan becerilere ihtiyac duyar ki?

english: mundane skills when one can harness the power of fire? After years of practice I am now the acknowledged Master of Flame! Everything must be purified by fire!
translation: Yillarca pratik yaptiktan sonra, artik taninmis bir Ates Ustasi oldum! Her sey atesle arindirilmali!

english: Okaaaay! Err, I'll be going now. Umm, get better soon.
translation: Tamam! Sey, ben gidiyorum. Umm, gecmis olsun.

english: What is that cape you're wearing?
This is a Skillcape of Firemaking, so bright that wearing it lights up caves! I was given it in recognition of my skill as the greatest firemaker in the lands! I AM the Master of Flame!
translation: Bu, ates yakma becerisi pelerini, o kadar parlak ki giydiginde magaralari aydinlatiyor! Bu pelerin, bu topraklardaki en büyük ates yakici oldugum icin bana verildi! Ben Alev Ustasiyim!

english: Hmm, I'll be going now. Keep a sharp look out for those men with their white jackets!
translation: Hmm, ben gidiyorum. Beyaz ceketli adamlara dikkat et!

english: No, thanks.
Okay, keep the fire burning.
Can I buy a Skillcape of Firemaking?
translation: Ates Yapma Beceri Pelerini satin alabilir miyim?

english: Of course you can. You are already a master of fire, you just need the cape to prove it. The cape is so bright that wearing it will light up dark caves. That'll be 99000 coins, please.
translation: Tabii ki alabilirsin. Sen zaten atesin ustasisin, sadece bunu kanitlamak icin pelerine ihtiyacin var. Pelerin o kadar parlaktir ki, onu giydiginde karanlik magaralari aydinlatir. 99.000 sikke lütfen.

english: No thanks, that's too much.
Sorry to hear that, I'll be here if you change your mind.
Okay, that seems reasonable.
But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: Ama maalesef yanimda yeterince param yok.

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.

Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: Maalesef tüm Skillcapes sadece ücretsiz kapüsonla satiliyor, bu bir beceri promosyonunun parcasi; bir alana bir bedava, bilirsin. Yani size bir tane satabilmem icin önce envanterinizde yer acmaniz gerekiyor.

english: I'm sure you'll look hot in that cape.
translation: Eminim o pelerin size cok yakisacaktir.

english: Who are you?
May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: Pelerinim icin bir kapüson daha alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: You don't appear to have enough space in your inventory, come back and see me when you do.
translation: Envanterinizde yeterince yer yok gibi görünüyor, yer actiginizda tekrar gelin.

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
What is that cape you're wearing?
No, thanks.
Can I buy a Skillcape of Firemaking?
translation: Ates Yakma Beceri Pelerini satin alabilir miyim?

english: No thanks, that's too much.
Okay, that seems reasonable.
Skillcape
Hood
Welcome, [brother/sister/my child].
Er... Are we related?
We are all related, [brother/sister/my child], for we are all children of the flame.
translation: Hepimiz akrabayiz, kardesim, cünkü hepimiz alevin cocuklariyiz.

english: Okayyy...
So what is this place?
You stand before the Doors of Dinh. Behind them lies the prison of the Wintertodt.
translation: Dinh Kapilari'nin önündesin. Arkasinda Wintertodt'un hapishanesi var.

english: What's a Wintertodt?
We do not know what it is. All we know is that it threatens to snuff out every flame in this land and plunge the world into eternal darkness.
translation: Ne oldugunu bilmiyoruz. Tek bildigimiz, bu topraklardaki tüm alevleri söndürerek dünyayi sonsuz karanliga gömmekle tehdit ettigi.

english: Oh dear... We should probably do something about that.
translation: Oh hayir... Bu konuda bir seyler yapmaliyiz.

english: That is why we are here, [brother/sister/my child]. Ever since the Wintertodt was imprisoned, members of the Order of the Sacred Flame, or Pyromancers as we're often known, have stood vigil over this place.
translation: Bu yüzden buradayiz, kardesim. Wintertodt hapsedildiginden beri, Kutsal Alev Tarikati üyeleri, ya da sikca bilindigimiz adiyla Pyromancers, burayi koruyorlar.

english: But alas, despite our best efforts, the Wintertodt is growing in power again.
translation: Ama ne yazik ki, tüm cabalarimiza ragmen, Wintertodt yeniden gücleniyor.

english: Well that's just no good. Is there anything I can do to help?
translation: Bu hic iyi degil. Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Our order searches tirelessly for a way to defeat the Wintertodt. Until we discover it, the Wintertodt must be held at bay.
translation: Tarikatimiz, Wintertodt'u yenmenin bir yolunu bulmak icin yorulmadan calisiyor. Bunu bulana kadar, Wintertodt'u uzak tutmaliyiz.

english: However, I fear your abilities are not great enough to withstand the cold of the Wintertodt. Learn the ways of the sacred flame and then return to me.
translation: Ancak, korkarim ki senin yeteneklerin Wintertodt'un soguguna dayanacak kadar güclü degil. Kutsal alevin yollarini ögren ve sonra bana geri dön.

english: You require at least 50 Firemaking to take on the Wintertodt.
translation: Wintertodt ile savasmak icin en az 50 Ates Yakma becerisine sahip olmalisin.

english: Pass through the Doors of Dinh to the prison within. You will find the finest of our order channeling the power of the sacred flame into the Wintertodt.
translation: Dinh Kapilari'ndan gecerek icerideki hapishaneye gir. Orada, tarikatimizin en iyilerinin kutsal alevin gücünü Wintertodt'a aktardigini göreceksin.

english: Help them keep the holy fires lit so that they can keep the Wintertodt subdued.
translation: Kutsal atesleri yanik tutmalarina yardim edin, böylece Wintertodt'u zaptedebilsinler.

english: How can I do that?
You will find the roots of the great Bruma tree have crept into the prison. Chop the roots and use them to keep the sacred flame alive.
translation: Büyük Bruma agacinin köklerinin hapishaneye sizdigini göreceksiniz. Kökleri kesin ve kutsal atesi canli tutmak icin kullanin.

english: Anything else?
You can use the herbs of the Bruma tree to make Rejuvenation potions. Give these to any of our order who fall to the cold of the Wintertodt before they succumb to the darkness.
translation: Bruma agacinin otlarini genclestirme iksiri yapmak icin kullanabilirsin. Bunlari Wintertodt'un soguguna yenik düsen tarikat üyelerimize, karanliga teslim olmadan önce ver.

english: How else may I be of assistance?
Tell me about the Wintertodt.
Do you feel the winds of winter as they lick across the land? This is the power of the Wintertodt. We know not what it is nor from where it came. Only that it wields the power of Winter itself.
translation: Kis rüzgarlarinin topragi yaladigini hissediyor musun? Bu Wintertodt'un gücüdür. Ne oldugunu ve nereden geldigini bilmiyoruz. Sadece kisin gücünü elinde tuttugunu biliyoruz.

english: The ground on which we stand was once full of light, full of life. But then the Wintertodt came. Now the fires of these lands burn no more.
translation: Üzerinde durdugumuz topraklar bir zamanlar isikla ve yasamla doluydu. Ama sonra Wintertodt geldi. Artik bu topraklarda atesler yanmiyor.

english: Tell me about the Pyromancers.
We are the Order of the Sacred Flame, formed over a thousand years ago when the Wintertodt first threatened Great Kourend.
translation: Bizler, Wintertodt'un Büyük Kourend'i ilk kez tehdit ettigi bin yil önce kurulan Kutsal Alev Tarikati'yiz.

english: We fought against the Wintertodt until we managed to lure it behind Dinh's great Doors. Our task did not end there though, for we always knew that the Wintertodt would rise again.
translation: Wintertodt'u Dinh'in büyük Kapilari'nin arkasina cekmeyi basarana kadar onunla savastik. Ancak görevimiz burada bitmedi, cünkü Wintertodt'un yeniden dirilecegini hep biliyorduk.

english: Tell me about yourself.
I am Ignisia, Grand Master of the Order of the Sacred Flame. I have served our Order faithfully since I passed the Trials of Fire before the Ascent of Arceuus.
translation: Ben Ignisia, Kutsal Alev Tarikati'nin Büyük Üstadiyim. Arceuus'un Yükselisi'nden önce Ates Sinavlarini gectikten sonra tarikatimiza sadakatle hizmet ettim.

english: What can I do to help?
You are not currently strong enough to face the Wintertodt. Learn the ways of the sacred flame and then return here.
translation: Su anda Wintertodt ile yüzlesecek kadar güclü degilsin. Kutsal alevin yollarini ögren ve sonra buraya geri dön.

english: We must hold back the Wintertodt until we can find a way to defeat it. Head into the prison and keep the holy fires lit so that our order may keep the evil at bay.
translation: Onu yenmenin bir yolunu bulana kadar Wintertodt'u geri tutmaliyiz. Hapishaneye git ve kutsal atesleri yanik tut ki tarikatimiz kötülügü uzak tutabilsin.

english: The Wintertodt is no longer growing in strength but it still needs to be held back. Head into the prison and keep the holy fires lit so that our order may keep the evil at bay.
translation: Wintertodt artik güclenmiyor ama yine de durdurulmasi gerekiyor. Hapishaneye git ve kutsal atesleri yanik tut ki tarikatimiz kötülügü uzak tutabilsin.

english: I'm fine thanks.
May the sacred flame guide you, [brother/sister/my child].
translation: Kutsal alev sana rehberlik etsin, kardesim.

english: Welcome back, [brother/sister/my child]. How may I be of assistance?
translation: Hos geldin, kardesim. Nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: I get hayfever. Please take those flowers away.
translation: Saman nezlesi oluyorum. Lütfen o cicekleri uzaklastir.

english: I would not appreciate your traps near the bank. Please take them away.
translation: Banka yakinindaki tuzaklarini istemiyorum. Lütfen onlari uzaklastir.

english: Tell me about the Wintertodt.
Tell me about the Pyromancers.
Tell me about yourself.
What can I do to help?
I'm fine thanks.
So... you're alchemical; does that mean I can turn you into gold?
translation: Demek sen bir simyacisin; bu seni altina dönüstürebilecegim anlamina mi geliyor?

english: No, I like my form as it is.
But... I love gold.
I'll turn to gold when drakes fly.
translation: Ejderhalar uctugunda ben de altina dönüsürüm.

english: How do you ever agree on what to do?
Well I’m in charge.
No, I am.
Nope, I say what we do.
Really I control everything!
translation: Gercekten her seyi ben kontrol ediyorum!

english: Ok then!
So how was that chemical bath?!
Nasty! I don't want to do that again
Which creature is cooler, Drakes, Hydras or Wyrms?
translation: Drakes, Hydras veya Wyrms, hangisi daha havali?

english: I may be biased in this situation... bit silly to ask me isn't it?
translation: Bu konuda önyargili olabilirim... bana sormak biraz sacma degil mi?

english: Alright alright... don't lose your head.
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
*slap*
Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: Hey, kahraman gelmis! Vay canina! Harikasin, o iki juvinate ve Gadderank'i nasil alt ettin? Kasaba da cok güzel, harika bir is cikarmissin!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
Oh, my name's Ileana, I just help out around here, you know, look for food and so on.
translation: Adim Ileana, burada yardim ediyorum, yiyecek ariyorum falan.

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: Oh, pek bir sey yok, hepimiz hala vampirlerden saklaniyoruz ve bu korkunc yerde gecimimizi sagliyoruz, umarim yakinda Salve'deki tapinaga yolculuk yapacak kadar gücleniriz.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: Bildigim kadariyla yok, su anda cok yararli olan bazi temel olanaklara sahibiz, hepimiz sana cok minnettariz. Daha önce hic bir kahraman görmedim veya tanimadim, bu yüzden karsilastirma yapabilecegim bir sey yok, ama sanirim

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: cogu insanin görüsüne göre, sen bir kahramansin! Ben sahsen seninle tanistigima cok memnunum.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Ok, thanks.
Good day, what are you doing all the way out here?
translation: Iyi günler, bu kadar uzakta ne yapiyorsun?

english: I'm just wandering, it's a lovely day for a walk in the woods.
translation: Sadece dolasiyorum, ormanda yürüyüs yapmak icin cok güzel bir gün.

english: It is that.
Well I shouldn't keep you, see you later.
Bye.
Do you remember Oaknock? He was a gnome inventor
translation: Oaknock'u hatirliyor musun? O bir cüce mucitti.

english: Of course! How is the young gnome? I rather liked him he was rather loud, but he had a good soul, and was very interested in elven magic.
translation: Tabii ki! Genc cüce nasil? Onu oldukca severdim, biraz gürültücüydü ama iyi bir kalbi vardi ve elf büyüsüne cok merakliydi.

english: I think Oaknock died of old age some time ago. He must have visited you a few hundred years ago though...
translation: Sanirim Oaknock bir süre önce yasliliktan öldü. Yüzlerce yil önce seni ziyaret etmis olmali...

english: I keep forgetting, a hundred years is a long time for you. He was very interested in illusion magic, and how to prevent it. I gave him some advice and a few bits of equipment to help him.
translation: Unutuyorum, yüz yil senin icin uzun bir süre. Illüzyon büyüsüne ve onu önlemeye cok merakliydi. Ona bazi tavsiyeler ve yardimci olacak birkac ekipman verdim.

english: A seed?
Of course. It grew into an axe. I hope he found it useful.
translation: Tabii ki. Bir baltaya dönüstü. Umarim isine yaramistir.

english: I think he did! Thanks.
Ilfeen smiles serenely.
Hello.
Hey ya, you're the human that helped my friend Islwyn, aren't you? He told me that he'd given you some crystal equipment.
translation: Hey, sen arkadasim Islwyn'e yardim eden insansin, degil mi? Sana kristal ekipman verdigini söyledi.

english: That's right, why?
When it reverts to seed, bring it to me and I'll chant it for you.
translation: Tohuma dönüstügünde bana getir, senin icin büyü yapayim.

english: It just happens I have a seed here, what can you do with it?
translation: Tesadüfen burada bir tohum var, onunla ne yapabilirsin?

english: I can only make shields and bows. I've been trying halberds but so far only Islwyn has succeeded.
translation: Sadece kalkan ve yay yapabiliyorum. Halberd yapmayi denedim ama su ana kadar sadece Islwyn basardi.

english: How much for a shield?
As this is the first one I've made for you it will be 750,000 coins. The cost should get cheaper as I get to know your resonance.
translation: Bu senin icin yaptigim ilk kalkan oldugu icin 750.000 sikke olacak. Senin rezonansini ögrendikce fiyati düsecektir.

english: I'll take it.
Ilfeen hands you a crystal shield.
translation: Ilfeen sana kristal bir kalkan verir.

english: Thanks.
If it helps I have a book here that will tell you about crystal chanting.
translation: Yardimi olacaksa, burada kristal ilahileri hakkinda bilgi veren bir kitap var.

english: I can't afford that.
How much is the bow?
As this is the first one I've made for you it will be 900,000 coins. The cost should get cheaper as I get to know your resonance.
translation: Bu senin icin yaptigim ilk yay oldugu icin 900.000 sikke olacak. Senin rezonansini tanidikca fiyati düsecektir.

english: Ilfeen hands you a crystal bow.
translation: Ilfeen sana bir kristal yay verir.

english: Hello again.
Hey.
Are you still offering to chant seeds?
I am, but you'll need to supply the seed.
translation: Evet, ama tohumlari sen temin etmelisin.

english: I see we have removed some defunct crystal equipment from you recently. I would be happy to replace them for you, unless you want to buy them of course.
translation: Görüyorum ki yakin zamanda bazi kullanilamaz kristal ekipmanlari senden aldik. Tabii ki satin almak istemiyorsan, onlari senin icin yenileriyle degistirmekten memnuniyet duyarim.

english: I can replace for you [amount] crystal bow(s), [amount] crystal shield(s) and [amount] crystal halberd(s).
Which crystal item would you like?
Siphon the ether into a Crystal bow please.
Siphon the ether into a Crystal halberd please.
Siphon the ether into a Crystal shield please.
While I'm here, I have a question for you.
translation: Hazir buradayken sana bir sorum var.

english: Well ask away.
Do you remember Oaknock? He was a gnome inventor.
translation: Oaknock'u hatirliyor musun? O bir cüce mucitti.

english: Of course! How is the young gnome? I rather liked him. He was rather loud, but he had a good soul, and was very interested in elven magic.
translation: Tabii ki! Genc cüce nasil? Onu oldukca severdim. Oldukca gürültücüydü ama iyi bir kalbi vardi ve elf büyüsüne cok ilgi duyuyordu.

english: Including a seed?
Of course. It grew into a saw. I hope he found it useful.
translation: Tabii ki. Tohum bir testereye dönüstü. Umarim isine yaramistir.

english: That sounds great.
You are handed a book
Thanks, I'll read all about it.
Well, good luck.
See you later.
I don't need it, thanks.
How much for a shield?
I'll take it.
I can't afford that.
How much is the bow?
Crystal bow.
Crystal halberd.
Crystal shield.
Nothing.
That sounds great.
I don't need it, thanks.
Hey, how's it going?
Not bad, I'm trying to help an elf named Islwyn consecrate his grandmother's resting place. Do you know of anything that could help me?
translation: Fena degil, Islwyn adinda bir elf'in büyükannesinin mezarini kutsamasina yardim etmeye çalisiyorum. Bana yardimci olabilecek bir sey biliyor musun?

english: Sorry, I know nothing of the consecration process. Eluned will know though, she travels with Islwyn.
translation: Üzgünüm, kutsama süreci hakkinda hiçbir sey bilmiyorum. Eluned bilir, o Islwyn ile birlikte seyahat ediyor.

english: Alright, thanks.
No problem.
Also, while I'm here, I have a question for you.
translation: Bu arada, hazir buradayken sana bir sorum var.

english: (continues with "Do you remember Oaknock?")
I don't know your resonance well enough for that.
translation: Bunun için senin rezonansini yeterince iyi bilmiyorum.

english: Hi!
Ooh. This is exciting!
Yup!
I wouldn't want to be the poor guy that has to clean up after the duels.
translation: Dövüslerden sonra ortaligi temizlemek zorunda kalan zavalli adam olmak istemezdim.

english: Me neither.
My son just won his first duel!
Congratulations!
He ripped his opponent in half!
That's gotta hurt!
He's only 10 as well!
You gotta start 'em young!
Hmph.
My favourite fighter is Mubariz!
The guy at the information kiosk?
Yeah! He rocks!
Takes all sorts, I guess.
Hi! I'm here to watch the duels!
Me too!
Did you know they think this place dates back to the second age?!
translation: Burasi ikinci cagdan kalma oldugunu biliyor muydun?

english: Really?
Yeah. The guy at the information kiosk was telling me.
Can't you see I'm watching the duels?
I'm sorry!
Well. This beats doing the shopping!
Hi!
Knock knock!
Who's there?
Boo.
Boo who?
Don't cry, it's just me!
Why did the skeleton burp?
I don't know?
'Cause it didn't have the guts to fart!
Waaaaassssssuuuuupp?!.
Hello. What do you do here?
Hello. My name is Imerominia and I'm the library horologist.
translation: Merhaba. Benim adim Imerominia ve kütüphanenin saat ustasiyim.

english: Horologist? What does that mean?
translation: Saat ustasi mi? O ne demek?

english: Horology is the study and measurement of time. Specifically, I study how time and dates have been historically recorded.
translation: Saatcilik, zamanin incelenmesi ve ölcülmesidir. Özellikle, zaman ve tarihlerin tarihsel olarak nasil kaydedildigini inceliyorum.

english: For example, the date convention in Great Kourend is to state the number of days and decades since the signing of the Royal Accord of Twill.
translation: Örnegin, Büyük Kourend'de tarih konvansiyonu, Twill Kraliyet Anlasmasi'nin imzalanmasindan bu yana gecen gün ve on yillarin sayisini belirtmektir.

english: Days and decades? That's a bit confusing.
translation: Günler ve on yillar mi? Bu biraz kafa karistirici.

english: Yes, it's an interesting convention. Truth be told, most in the kingdom prefer to use the same date format as you'll find used elsewhere.
translation: Evet, ilginc bir gelenek. Dogrusu, kralligin cogu, baska yerlerde kullanilan tarih formatini kullanmayi tercih ediyor.

english: However, as this is the Historical Archive, we stick to the dates used historically within Kourend.
translation: Ancak, burasi Tarihsel Arsiv oldugu icin, Kourend'de tarihsel olarak kullanilan tarihleri kullanmaya devam ediyoruz.

english: Tell me more about the Royal Accord of Twill.
translation: Twill Kraliyet Anlasmasi hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin.

english: The Royal Accord of Twill was signed by the rulers of each of the houses 139 decades ago, following the great famine.
translation: Twill Kraliyet Anlasmasi, büyük kitligin ardindan 139 on yil önce her hanenin hükümdarlari tarafindan imzalandi.

english: The Accord declared that each house will, in turn, rule the Kingdom of Great Kourend for one decade in rotation, based on lots drawn.
translation: Anlasma, her hanenin kura cekimi ile sirayla on yil boyunca Büyük Kourend Kralligi'ni yönetecegini ilan etti.

english: You may find a book in the Grand Library with further information. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Büyük Kütüphane'de daha fazla bilgi iceren bir kitap bulabilirsiniz. Yardimci olabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: Is the Royal Accord of Twill honoured today?
translation: Twill Kraliyet Anlasmasi bugün hala gecerli mi?

english: Our kingdom has advanced somewhat over the many decades since the Accord. Though some parts of the Accord remain intact, the Kourend Council now rules Great Kourend.
translation: Anlasma'nin imzalanmasindan bu yana gecen on yillar icinde kralligimiz bir miktar ilerleme kaydetti. Anlasma'nin bazi kisimlari hala gecerli olsa da, Kourend Konseyi su anda Büyük Kourend'i yönetmektedir.

english: Was the Accord ever breached?
Indeed it was. In the 13th decade, King Shayzien III seized control of Kourend using the military under his command.
translation: Evet, edildi. 13. on yilda, Kral Shayzien III komutasindaki orduyu kullanarak Kourend'in kontrolünü ele gecirdi.

english: The full set of laws within the Accord haven't been followed since. However, some of them were reinstated in the 47th decade, by King Byrne I.
translation: O zamandan beri Anlasma'daki yasalarin tamami uygulanmamaktadir. Ancak, 47. on yilda Kral Byrne I tarafindan bazi yasalar yeniden yürürlüge kondu.

english: Fascinating. What happened during that time?
translation: Cok ilginc. O dönemde neler oldu?

english: During the 20th decade, King Shayzien VI married the daughter of Lord Hosidius. Four decades later their son was crowned king.
translation: 20. on yilda Kral Shayzien VI, Lord Hosidius'un kiziyla evlendi. Dört on yil sonra ogullari kral olarak tac giydi.

english: He took the name King Hosidius IV in an attempt to distance the family from the breaking of the Royal Accord of Twill.
translation: Ailesini Twill Kraliyet Anlasmasi'nin ihlalinden uzaklastirmak amaciyla Kral Hosidius IV adini aldi.

english: King Hosidius IV followed by his son, King Hosidius V ruled Kourend until the early days of the 33rd decade.
translation: Kral Hosidius IV'ün ardindan oglu Kral Hosidius V, 33. on yilin baslarina kadar Kourend'i yönetti.

english: It was then that King Shayzien VII took control of the kingdom. His rule was a notably violent one.
translation: O zaman Kral Shayzien VII kralligin kontrolünü ele gecirdi. Onun yönetimi oldukca siddetliydi.

english: King Shayzien VII was killed some five decades later during the Battle of the Concourse. He was succeeded by the dark mage, Xeric.
translation: Kral Shayzien VII, yaklasik bes on yil sonra Concourse Savasi sirasinda öldürüldü. Onun yerine karanlik büyücü Xeric gecti.

english: Xeric ruled Kourend for more than ten dark decades using an army of lizardmen. This time period was known as the Age of Strife.
translation: Xeric, kertenkele adamlardan olusan bir orduyla Kourend'i on yildan fazla bir süre karanlik bir sekilde yönetti. Bu dönem, Catisma Cagi olarak bilinir.

english: Xeric was eventually killed during the 47th decade and succeeded by King Byrne I.
translation: Xeric, 47. on yilda öldürüldü ve yerine Kral Byrne I gecti.

english: Can you tell me more about Xeric?
translation: Xeric hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misiniz?

english: Ah, I do not have much more information on him. You should speak to Ektheme, our Xerician expert.
translation: Ah, onun hakkinda fazla bilgim yok. Xeric uzmani Ektheme ile konusmalisiniz.

english: Thanks.
No thanks.

The Royal Accord of Twill no longer plays much part in the rulership of Kourend. It was breached in the 13th decade when King Shayzien III seized control of the kingdom. It hasn't been honoured since.
translation: Twill Kraliyet Anlasmasi artik Kourend'in yönetiminde pek bir rol oynamiyor. 13. on yilda Kral Shayzien III kralligin kontrolünü ele gecirdiginde ihlal edildi. O zamandan beri uygulanmiyor.

english: That said, it was the basis for Rose's Accord, which sets out how the kingdom is currently ruled today. As decreed in Rose's Accord, the Hosidius family are now the royal family of Kourend.
translation: Bununla birlikte, kralligin bugün nasil yönetildigini belirleyen Rose Anlasmasi'nin temelini olusturdu. Rose Anlasmasi'nda belirtildigi gibi, Hosidius ailesi artik Kourend'in kraliyet ailesidir.

english: We have the original Royal Accord of Twill safely stored here. Although it's not available for public viewing, there are copies available within the Grand Library. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Orijinal Twill Kraliyet Anlasmasi burada güvenli bir sekilde saklanmaktadir. Her ne kadar halka acik olmasa da, Büyük Kütüphane'de kopyalari mevcuttur. Baska yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: So what is today's date?
I'm afraid I lose track of which day it is... but we are in the 141st decade.
translation: Korkarim hangi gün oldugunu unuttum... ama 141. on yildayiz.

english: So that means the Accord was signed almost 1,410 years ago?
translation: Yani Anlasma neredeyse 1410 yil önce imzalandi?

english: That is correct. You seem to have understood our time and date format well.
translation: Dogru. Zaman ve tarih formatimizi iyi anlamis görünüyorsunuz.

english: What about the time before the Accord was signed?
Very little is known about those ancient times, but we refer to them as decades 'Before Accord', or 'BA' for short.
translation: O eski dönemler hakkinda cok az sey biliniyor, ama biz onlara “Anlasma Öncesi” on yillari veya kisaca “BA” diyoruz.

english: Goodbye.
Hello, what do you do here?
Have you ever heard of Camorra?
I can't say I have. Who is she?
She's a hero from nearly two thousand years ago. I believe she travelled to Kourend during the Dragonkin Conflicts. I was hoping to learn more about her.
translation: Yaklasik iki bin yil önce yasamis bir kahraman. Sanirim Ejderha Soyu Savaslari sirasinda Kourend'e gelmis. Onun hakkinda daha fazla bilgi edinmek istiyordum.

english: Two thousand years ago? That's long before the founding of Kourend. I'm afraid we have very few records from those times here.
translation: Iki bin yil önce mi? Bu, Kourend'in kurulmasindan cok önce. Maalesef o dönemle ilgili cok az kayit var.

english: Oh. So you can't help me?
translation: Oh. Yani bana yardim edemez misin?

english: I can't but someone might be able to. The five cities of Kourend were founded long before the kingdom itself. Each city has their own historian who might have more information on the early days of their house.
translation: Ben edemem ama baskasi edebilir. Kourend'in bes sehri, kralligin kendisinden cok önce kuruldu. Her sehrin kendi tarihcisi var ve onlar, sehirlerinin kurulus dönemiyle ilgili daha fazla bilgiye sahip olabilirler.

english: Great. Is there a particular city you'd recommend?
translation: Harika. Önerdigin belirli bir sehir var mi?

english: Hosidius and Shayzien were the two cities founded during the Dragonkin Conflicts. They might be the best ones to start with. The other cities were founded much earlier, during the God Wars.
translation: Hosidius ve Shayzien, Ejderha Savaslari sirasinda kurulan iki sehirdir. Baslangic icin en iyisi bunlar olabilir. Diger sehirler cok daha önce, Tanri Savaslari sirasinda kurulmustur.

english: Where can I find the Hosidius and Shayzien historians?
translation: Hosidius ve Shayzien tarihcilerini nerede bulabilirim?

english: Jonathan is the Hosidius historian. He lives west of the Hosidius General Store. Amelia is the Shayzien historian. She lives south west of the Shayzien Pub.
translation: Jonathan, Hosidius tarihcisidir. Hosidius Genel Magazasinin batisinda yasiyor. Amelia, Shayzien tarihcisidir. Shayzien Pub'in güneybatisinda yasiyor.

english: Thanks for the help.
I have not. Did you try talking to the Hosidius and Shayzien historians about her.
translation: Hayir, görmedim. Hosidius ve Shayzien tarihcileriyle onun hakkinda konusmayi denediniz mi?

english: Where can I find them again?
Horologist? What does that mean?
Tell me more about the Royal Accord of Twill.
translation: Twill Kraliyet Anlasmasi hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin.

english: Is the Royal Accord of Twill still honoured today?
translation: Twill Kraliyet Anlasmasi bugün hala gecerli mi?

english: Can you tell me more about Xeric?
translation: Xeric hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misiniz?

english: So what is today's date?
Goodbye.
No thanks.
What about the time before the Accord was signed?
Have you ever heard of Camorra?
Hi there. How's it going?
What do you do here?
I keep the hunters well equipped! I can sell you hunting equipment at a reasonable price.
translation: Avcilari iyi donatiyorum! Sana av malzemelerini uygun fiyata satabilirim.

english: What have you got for sale?
Hunting supplies for every occasion.
Never mind.
What do you do here?
What have you got for sale?
Never mind.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...

This is my home, mundane human! What do you have in your pockets? Something tasty?
translation: Burasi benim evim, siradan insan! Ceplerinde ne var? Lezzetli bir sey mi?

english: Stay out of my pockets! I don't have anything that you want.
translation: Ceplerimden uzak dur! Senin isteyecegin bir sey yok bende.

translation: Ah, ama senin isteyecegin bir sey var mi?

english: Of course I do!
Then you have something that implings want.
translation: O zaman implinglerin isteyecegi bir sey var sende.

english: Eh?
We want things you people want. They are tasty to us! The more you want them, the tastier they are!
translation: Sizin istediginiz seyleri istiyoruz. Onlar bizim icin lezzetli! Ne kadar cok isterseniz, o kadar lezzetli olurlar!

english: So, you collect things that humans want? Interesting... So, what would happen if I caught an impling in a butterfly net?
translation: Yani, insanlarin istedigi seyleri mi topluyorsunuz? Ilginc... Peki, bir kelebek agiyla bir impling yakalasam ne olur?

english: Don't do that! That would be cruel. But chase us, yes! That is good. Implings are not easy to catch. Especially ones with really tasty food.
translation: Bunu yapma! Bu zalimce olur. Ama bizi kovalayabilirsin, evet! Bu iyi. Implingleri yakalamak kolay degildir. Özellikle de gercekten lezzetli yiyecekleri olanlari.

english: So, some of these implings have things that I will really want? Hmm, maybe it would be worth my while trying to catch some.
translation: Yani, bu implinglerin bazilari benim gercekten isteyecegim seylere sahip mi? Hmm, belki de bazilarini yakalamaya calismak zamanimi harcamaya deger.

english: Going so soon?
Yes, get me out of here!
Ah, no I'll hang around a bit longer.
Back where you came from, of course!
So not back to where the crop circle is now?
translation: Yani, su anda ekin cemberinin oldugu yere geri dönmeyecek misin?

english: The aetheric thread connecting you to your own plane leads back to the wheat field where you came from. Obviously. So you will always go back to where you came from! Don't you humans know anything?
translation: Seni kendi düzlemine baglayan eterik iplik, geldigin bugday tarlasina geri götürür. Tabii ki. Yani her zaman geldigin yere geri döneceksin! Siz insanlar hicbir sey bilmiyor musunuz?

english: Evidently not.
You wanna leave?
Here, solve this.
That doesn't look solved to me.
Well done [player name]. Here you go.
You've obtained a [new clue/casket]!
Yes, get me out of here!
Ah, no I'll hang around a bit longer.
Where will I go if I leave?
Hey imp, can you hear me?
Of course I can hear ya, ya great big ape. You know, 'veres not even enuf space to swing Bob about in 'ere. How about a breather? You know, stretch me pins for a bit?
translation: Tabii ki duyuyorum seni, seni koca maymun. Biliyor musun, burada Bob'u sallayacak kadar yer bile yok. Biraz nefes almaya ne dersin? Bacaklarimi biraz esnetmeye ne dersin?

english: No, I'm going to keep you in there. I might keep you as a pet.
translation: Hayir, seni orada tutacagim. Seni evcil hayvan olarak tutabilirim.

english: Pet!! Nah mate. I fink you'd find dat you'd be my pet!! We is not makin good pets.
translation: Evcil hayvan mi? Hayir dostum. Aslinda senin benim evcil hayvanim olacagini göreceksin! Biz iyi evcil hayvanlar degiliz.

english: Really? Why not?
Coz...errr...
We bite! Yeah we is biting and...and...er...
translation: Isiriyoruz! Evet, isiriyoruz ve... ve... sey...

english: We is fire risk! Yeah dat's it! We be burning down your housey and stealin' all ya shiny gems. Oh, and da beads!! Mmmm, beads.
translation: Yangin tehlikesi olustururuz! Evet, aynen öyle! Evinizi yakar ve tüm parlak mücevherlerinizi calariz. Oh, ve boncuklari!! Mmmm, boncuklar.

english: Fire risk? How does that work?
translation: Yangin tehlikesi mi? Nasil oluyor bu?

english: Is those wizzies. Dey don't like de imps so dey make us go BOOOM!!
translation: O sihirbazlar yüzünden. Iblisleri sevmezler, bu yüzden bizi BOOOM!! yaparlar.

english: It's not that bad. You've got four big windows, charming company...er...
translation: O kadar da kötü degil. Dört büyük penceren var, cekici bir arkadasin var... sey...

english: Yeah, we's love tiny, crampt space. It be magical. But I is a busy imp, innit? Dragons needin' ticklin', shiny relics needin' stealin', you know how it goes.
translation: Evet, biz kücük, dar alanlari seviyoruz. Büyülü oluyor. Ama ben mesgul bir cinim, degil mi? Ejderhalari gidiklamak, parlak kalintilari calmak gerekiyor, nasil oldugunu bilirsin.

english: So, if you's know whas good for ya, you'd be lettin' me go, right?
translation: Yani, senin icin neyin iyi oldugunu biliyorsan, beni birakirsin, degil mi?

english: Don't I get three wishes?
Nah, mate. Dunno what you're chirpin' about.
Well, you're a magical creature aren't you? Surely I get some wishes for capturing you, or releasing you, or something?
translation: Sen sihirli bir yaratiksin, degil mi? Seni yakaladigim ya da serbest biraktigim icin bazi dileklerim olmali, degil mi?

english: I'm finking dat you be a bit confoosed. I is an imp, not some namby-pamby genie or some kinda fairy. Ye can tell by the horns.
translation: Bence biraz kafan karisik. Ben bir cinim, yumusak basli bir cin ya da bir tür peri degilim. Boynuzlarimdan anlayabilirsin.

english: Sayin' dat, I don't fancy being cooped up like one of me uncle's pigeons. Tell you what, is there anything you need deliverin' to the bank? I may not be no cunjerer or sommink like dat, but I can get about nice
translation: Bununla birlikte, amcamin güvercinleri gibi kafese kapatilmak hosuma gitmiyor. Bak ne diyecegim, bankaya teslim etmen gereken bir sey var mi? Ben sihirbaz falan olmayabilirim, ama hizli ve iyi hareket edebilirim.

english: an quick like. If you let me scarper, I'll take a couple of fings to the bank for ya. You game?
translation: Beni kacirirsan, senin icin bankaya birkac sey götürürüm. Var misin?

english: Okay, that sounds fair.
Surely it should be three items? Then it's one item per wish.
translation: Üc sey olmasi gerekmez mi? O zaman her dilek icin bir sey.

english: I've already told ya, I ain't no bloomin' fairy. Besides, you know wot dey say, three's a crowd innit? I don't fink I can hop about carryin' more dan 2 fings.
translation: Sana söyledim, ben sihirbaz degilim. Ayrica, ne derler bilirsin, üc kisi kalabalik olur, degil mi? 2 seyden fazlasini tasiyabilecegimi sanmiyorum.

english: I've got nothing I need banking right now.
translation: Su anda bankaya götürmem gereken bir sey yok.

english: Great, just blinkin great, dat is. I'll just sit about countin' zombie sheep then. One...two...two and a bit...three and a bit more... I don't fink sheep 'ave dat many legs...
translation: Harika, gercekten harika. O zaman oturup zombi koyunlari sayacagim. Bir... iki... iki bucuk... üc bucuk... Koyunlarin o kadar cok bacagi oldugunu sanmiyorum...

english: Hey imp, are you still there?
An who's fault is that, eh? EH? I got betta fings to do dan sit ere waitin' for ya. 'Ave ya made up ya mind what else I'm luggin about?
translation: Bu kimin sucu, ha? HA? Burada oturup seni beklemekten daha iyi islerim var. Baska neyi sürükledigime karar verdin mi?

english: Yes I have.
No, I'm afraid you're going to have to wait a bit longer.
translation: Hayir, korkarim biraz daha beklemen gerekecek.

english: Dat's alright guv'nor. I'll get back to me luvverly dream about beads. Big shiny beads. Love it!
translation: Sorun degil patron. Boncuklarla ilgili güzel rüyama geri dönecegim. Büyük, parlak boncuklar. Bayildim!

english: Sorry, guv'nor, I seem to 'ave caught meself; I can't do nuffink right now.
translation: Üzgünüm patron, kendimi kaptirmisim galiba; su anda hicbir sey yapamiyorum.

english: What use would that be in a bank? You'd be better off leaving it in yer house.
translation: Bunun bankada ne faydasi olur ki? Evinde birakman daha iyi olur.

english: Ow! That's hot! Put it in yer bank yerself!
translation: Ah! Bu cok sicak! Kendin bankaya yatir!

english: No way, I can't bank your looting bag.
translation: Olmaz, senin yagma cantani bankaya yatiramam.

english: Nope, between me and you, that toad doesn't look stable.
translation: Hayir, aramizda kalsin, o kurbaga pek saglam görünmüyor.

english: What good is banking that book? Just read it or throw it away!
translation: O kitabi bankaya yatirmanin ne faydasi var? Ya oku ya da at gitsin!

english: I'm no expert, but when a mushroom glows that much, I'm guessing it's dangerous. Keep it away from me.
translation: Uzman degilim ama bir mantar bu kadar parliyorsa, tehlikeli oldugunu tahmin ediyorum. Benden uzak tut.

english: I'm not touching a gnome ball; that's a vicious game! I might die!
translation: Cüce topuna dokunmam; bu tehlikeli bir oyun! Ölebilirim!

english: Don't you know? You can get into trouble for giving alcohol to minors, and I'm pretty small, it has to be said.
translation: Bilmiyor musun? Resit olmayanlara alkol vermekten basin belaya girebilir ve ben oldukca kücügüm, bunu söylemeliyim.

english: There's something weird about those bones; I ain't touching them.
translation: O kemiklerde tuhaf bir sey var; onlara dokunmayacagim.

english: It's a flipping stick; why bother banking that? You humans are crazy sometimes.
translation: O bir cubuk; neden onu bankaya yatirmakla ugrasiyorsun? Siz insanlar bazen cilginsiniz.

english: I know what lamps like that contain; I'm not touching it. I might get hurt.
translation: O tür lambalarin icinde ne oldugunu biliyorum; ona dokunmayacagim. Yaralanabilirim.

english: The imp seems uneasy about teleporting that.
No, I'm going to keep you in there.
It's not that bad.
Don't I get three wishes?
Okay, that sounds fair.
Surely it should be three items?
translation: Kesinlikle üc esya olmali, degil mi?

english: I've got nothing I need banking right now.
translation: Su anda saklamam gereken hicbir seyim yok.

english: Yes I have.
No, I'm afraid you're going to have to wait a bit longer.
translation: Hayir, korkarim biraz daha beklemen gerekecek.

english: Sorry, I'm not going to risk upsetting someone by bundling random holy symbols I don't recognise into bank vaults.
translation: Üzgünüm, tanimadigim rastgele kutsal sembolleri banka kasalarina koyarak birilerini kizdirma riskini göze alamam.

english: If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: Senin kadar cirkin olsaydim, halka acik yerlerde yüzümü göstermeye cesaret edemezdim!

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: Oh! Sey... Az önce bir tane yedim, o yüzden!

english: Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: Hayatina deger veriyorsan bir daha benimle konusma!

english: Get lost!
I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: Sana verecek hicbir seyim yok, birak beni rahat, dilenci.

english: Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
translation: Su anda bununla ugrasacak vaktim yok.

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: Senin gibi zavalli bir et yiginiyla konusmak istemiyorum.

english: Down with rutabagas!
I may be a werewolf, but I do love the smell of frying onions.
translation: Ben bir kurt adam olabilirim, ama kizarmis sogan kokusunu cok seviyorum.

english: Onion skins very thin, mild winter coming in. Onion skins very tough, coming winter very rough.
translation: Sogan kabuklari cok inceyse, kis ilik gecer. Sogan kabuklari cok kalinsa, kis cok sert gecer.

english: Did you know the onion is of genus Allium and species cepa?
translation: Soganin Allium cinsi ve cepa türü oldugunu biliyor muydun?

english: When you cut onions they release a gas that makes you cry.
translation: Sogani kestiginde, seni aglatan bir gaz salar.

english: Maybe I'll start an Onion Guild.
People are like onions. They have lots of layers and sometimes smell quite pungent.
translation: Insanlar sogan gibidir. Bircok katmanlari vardir ve bazen oldukca keskin kokarlar.

english: If you hear an onion ring, answer it!
Life is like an onion...well, sort of.
translation: Hayat sogan gibidir... yani, bir nevi.

english: I might try my hand at farming onions some time.

translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmenizi tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
