What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Ohh, hello there, I see from our records that you've helped us out a bit, and I'd love to give you a bit of a reward for that.
translation: Merhaba, kayitlarimiza göre bize biraz yardim etmissin, bunun icin sana bir ödül vermek istiyorum.

english: My father knew a lot about Prayer, Mining, Crafting, Smithing, Slayer and Hunter, and I learnt some of his tricks... would you like me to share a little of my knowledge?
translation: Babam Dua, Madencilik, Zanaatkarlik, Demircilik, Avcilik ve Avci konusunda cok bilgiliydi ve ben de ondan bazi püf noktalari ögrendim... bilgimi seninle paylasmami ister misin?

english: Yes, teach me something in those skills.
translation: Evet, bana bu becerilerle ilgili bir seyler ögret.

english: You feel more knowledgeable in the Mining skill.
You feel more knowledgeable in the skills Mining and Crafting
translation: Madencilik ve Zanaat becerilerinde daha bilgili hissediyorsun.

english: You feel more knowledgeable in the skills Crafting, Smithing, Slayer, Prayer and Hunter.
translation: Zanaat, Demircilik, Avcilik, Dua ve Avcilik becerilerinde daha bilgili hissediyorsun.

english: You feel more knowledgeable in the skills Mining, Crafting, Smithing, Slayer, Prayer and Hunter.
translation: Madencilik, Zanaat, Demircilik, Avcilik, Dua ve Avcilik becerilerinde daha bilgili hissediyorsun.

english: Wow, thanks.
You're most welcome. Now, is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Rica ederim. Baska yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: No.
I'll come back later.
Okay!
Welcome to Varrock Museum. How can I help you today?
translation: Varrock Müzesi'ne hos geldiniz. Bugün size nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: You reach and take a map of the Museum.
Could you tell me about the Dig Site exhibit please?
translation: Kazi Alani sergisi hakkinda bilgi verebilir misiniz lütfen?

english: Of course. The Dig Site exhibit has several display cases of finds discovered on the Dig Site to the east of Varrock.
translation: Tabii ki. Kazi Alani sergisinde, Varrock'un dogusundaki Kazi Alani'nda bulunan buluntularin sergilendigi birkac vitrin var.

english: Unfortunately, you haven't passed your Earth Science exams, so you aren't qualified to help us on the dig. If you're interested, visit the Education Centre on the Dig Site to the east and talk to the examiners there.
translation: Maalesef, Yer Bilimleri sinavlarini gecemedin, bu yüzden kazi calismalarinda bize yardim edemezsin. Eger ilgileniyorsan, dogudaki Kazi Alani'ndaki Egitim Merkezi'ni ziyaret et ve oradaki sinav görevlileriyle konus.

english: As you've passed your Earth Science exams at the Dig Site, you can go through into the cleaning area and clean off some finds. This will help our Dig Site display floor to give a more accurate view of life back in the
translation: Kazi Alani'ndaki Yer Bilimleri sinavlarini gectigin icin, temizlik alanina girip bazi buluntulari temizleyebilirsin. Bu, Kazi Alani sergi katimizin 3. ve 4. Caglardaki yasami daha dogru bir sekilde yansitmasina yardimci olacak

english: 3rd and 4th Ages, as well as earning you Kudos. If you'd like to know more about cleaning finds, just ask the archaeologists.
translation: ve size Kudos kazandiracaktir. Buluntulari temizleme hakkinda daha fazla bilgi edinmek isterseniz, arkeologlara sorabilirsiniz.

english: I see you've already helped out in the Dig Site exhibit. Our picture of life back in the 3rd and 4th Ages in that old city is really becoming clearer. There are still a few displays that need updating, though. If you'd like to
translation: Görüyorum ki Kazi Alani sergisinde zaten yardim etmissiniz. O eski sehirdeki 3. ve 4. Caglardaki yasamin resmi gercekten daha net hale geliyor. Ancak, hala güncellenmesi gereken birkac sergi var. Buluntulari temizleme hakkinda daha fazla bilgi edinmek isterseniz,

english: know more about cleaning finds, just ask the archaeologists.

You have really helped out a lot. I see all the nice clean finds with their information are in the once empty cases. I'm sure we'll get some more cases in soon for you to fill. For now, perhaps you should investigate the
translation: Gercekten cok yardimci oldunuz. Bir zamanlar bos olan vitrinlerde, temizlenmis ve bilgileriyle birlikte sergilenen buluntulari görüyorum. Yakinda doldurmaniz icin daha fazla vitrin alacagimizdan eminim. Simdilik, müzenin geri kalanini kesfetmelisiniz.

english: rest of the Museum.
Bye.
Have a good day!
translation: Zaman Cizelgesi sergisi hakkinda bilgi verir misiniz?

english: Could you tell me about the Timeline exhibit please?
translation: Zaman Cizelgesi sergisi hakkinda bilgi verir misiniz lütfen?

english: Why, yes. The Timeline exhibit has lots of display cases showing things from the beginning of time right up to the present day.
translation: Tabii ki. Zaman Cizelgesi sergisinde, zamanin baslangicindan günümüze kadar olan dönemi gösteren bircok vitrin var.

english: You could help out in the Timeline exhibit upstairs. By providing information you may have gathered on your travels around the world, you can help to make our displays more comprehensive and earn yourself Kudos
translation: Yukaridaki Zaman Cizelgesi sergisinde yardimci olabilirsiniz. Dünya seyahatlerinizde topladiginiz bilgileri paylasarak, sergilerimizi daha kapsamli hale getirmeye yardimci olabilir ve kendinize de övgü kazanabilirsiniz

english: too.

I know you've helped out a bit in the Timeline exhibit upstairs, but I'm sure you can help more. When you're out on your travels being a brave adventurer, remember that you can come back to the Museum
translation: Yukaridaki Zaman Cizelgesi sergisinde biraz yardim ettiginizi biliyorum, ama eminim daha fazla yardim edebilirsiniz. Cesur bir maceraci olarak seyahatlerinizde, bazi görevlerden sonra müzeye geri dönüp bize önemli tarihi gercekleri anlatabileceginizi unutmayin.

english: after some quests to let us know important historical facts. This will help us to update the displays and make the Museum a more informative place! You'll earn yourself Kudos too.
translation: Bu, sergileri güncellememize ve müzeyi daha bilgilendirici bir yer haline getirmemize yardimci olacaktir! Ayrica Kudos da kazanacaksiniz.

english: I see you have filled up the display cases we have, and given us large amounts of information for the Timeline exhibit. At the moment, you have left us nothing to do ourselves, but I'm sure we'll be getting some new cases
translation: Sergileme vitrinlerimizi doldurdugunuzu ve Zaman Cizelgesi sergisi icin bize cok sayida bilgi verdiginizi görüyorum. Su anda bize yapacak bir sey birakmadiniz, ama eminim yakinda size yardim etmeniz icin yeni vitrinler

english: in soon for you to help us out with! For now, perhaps you should investigate the rest of the Museum.
translation: alacagiz! Simdilik, müzenin geri kalanini kesfetmelisiniz.

english: Okay, thanks. One more question: why are the display numbers all out of sequence?
translation: Tamam, tesekkürler. Bir soru daha: sergi numaralari neden sirasiz?

english: Ahh, that's due to the numbering being done as we were constructing the cases and putting the displays in them, then shuffling them into the right places. We thought rather than renumbering them all - such a
translation: Ahh, bu, vitrinleri insa edip sergileri icine yerlestirirken numaralandirma yaptigimiz ve sonra onlari dogru yerlere yerlestirdigimiz icin. Hepsini yeniden numaralandirmak yerine - etiket yazmak cok sikici bir is - oldugu gibi birakmaya karar verdik.

english: boring job, writing labels - we'd leave it. They all have unique numbers and future displays would mess up the consecutive numbering anyway.
translation: Hepsinin benzersiz numaralari var ve gelecekteki sergiler zaten ardisik numaralandirmayi bozacaktir.

english: Ahhh, I see.
Could you tell me about the Natural History exhibit please?
translation: Dogal Tarih sergisi hakkinda bilgi verebilir misiniz lütfen?

english: Why, yes. The Natural History exhibit has displays of various creatures you can find around Gielinor.
translation: Tabii ki. Dogal Tarih sergisinde Gielinor cevresinde bulabileceginiz cesitli canlilar sergileniyor.

english: Downstairs, in the Natural History exhibit, you can answer quizzes about animals to show us your knowledge and earn Kudos at the same time. Talk to Orlando, I'm sure he'd appreciate your knowledge.
translation: Alt katta, Dogal Tarih sergisinde, hayvanlar hakkinda bilgi yarismalarina katilarak bilgilerinizi gösterip ayni zamanda Kudos kazanabilirsiniz. Orlando ile konusun, eminim bilgilerinizi takdir edecektir.

english: I see you have already demonstrated some of your knowledge of the natural world in the Natural History exhibit, so why not pop down and do some more quizzes with Orlando! You can earn Kudos at the same time.
translation: Dogal Tarih sergisinde dogal dünya hakkindaki bilgilerinizi zaten göstermissiniz, neden asagi inip Orlando ile birkac test daha yapmiyorsunuz? Ayni zamanda Kudos da kazanabilirsiniz.

english: You really know your stuff when it comes to animals, don't you! Orlando tells me you have exceeded his teachings. For now, perhaps you should investigate the rest of the Museum.
translation: Hayvanlar konusunda gercekten cok bilgilisiniz, degil mi? Orlando, onun ögrettiklerinin ötesine gectiginizi söyledi. Simdilik müzenin geri kalanini kesfetmelisiniz.

english: But what's natural history got to do with existing animals?
translation: Ama dogal tarih mevcut hayvanlarla ne alakasi var?

english: The study of natural history is simply the study of the history of the species. The species doesn't necessarily need to be an extinct one.
translation: Dogal tarih, basitce türlerin tarihini inceleyen bilim dalidir. Türlerin mutlaka soyu tükenmis olmasi gerekmez.

english: What is Kudos?
Kudos is a measure of how much you've assisted the Museum. The more information you give us, Dig Site finds that you clean and quizzes you solve, the higher your Kudos.
translation: Kudos, müzeye ne kadar yardimci oldugunuzun ölcüsüdür. Bize ne kadar cok bilgi verirseniz, kazi alanini ne kadar temizlerseniz ve ne kadar cok test cözerseniz, Kudos puaniniz o kadar yüksek olur.

english: But what's it for?

Well, recently we found a rather interesting island to the north of Morytania. We believe that it may be of archaeological significance. I suspect we'll be looking for qualified archaeologists once we have constructed our
translation: Son zamanlarda Morytania'nin kuzeyinde oldukca ilginc bir ada bulduk. Bu adanin arkeolojik acidan önemli olabilecegini düsünüyoruz. Kanal ve mavnamizi insa ettikten sonra nitelikli arkeologlar arayacagimizi tahmin ediyorum.

english: canal and barge. So, we're using Kudos as a measure of who is willing and able to help us here at the Museum, so they can then be invited on our dig on the new island.
translation: Bu nedenle, müzede bize yardim etmeye istekli ve yetenekli kisileri belirlemek icin Kudos'u kullaniyoruz, böylece onlari yeni adadaki kazimiza davet edebilecegiz.

english: Would I qualify, then?
translation: O zaman ben de katilabilir miyim?

english: Unfortunately, you haven't earned enough Kudos yet, so you aren't qualified to help us on the dig. If you're interested in helping us out and getting that Kudos, simply help out around the Museum.
translation: Maalesef, henüz yeterince Kudos kazanmadin, bu yüzden kazi calismalarina yardim etmeye hak kazanamadin. Bize yardim etmek ve Kudos kazanmak istiyorsan, müzede yardim etmen yeterli.

english: Okay, thanks.
Why yes! You've helped us so much around the Museum and you have the necessary qualifications from the Earth Sciences exams you took. When the canal is ready, we'll let you know.
translation: Tabii ki! Müzede bize cok yardimci oldun ve girdigin Yer Bilimleri sinavlarindan gerekli nitelikleri aldin. Kanal hazir oldugunda sana haber verecegiz.

english: Thank you, I'll look forward to it!
Well done! I have new information to share with you.
translation: Aferin! Seninle paylasmak istedigim yeni bilgiler var.

english: Yes, teach me something in those skills.
translation: Evet, bana bu becerilerle ilgili bir seyler ögret.

english: No
Take a map of the Museum
Find out about the Dig Site exhibit.
translation: Kazi Alani sergisi hakkinda bilgi edin.

english: Ask about something else.
Bye
Find out about the Timeline exhibit.
translation: Zaman Cizelgesi sergisi hakkinda bilgi edin.

english: Find out about the Natural History exhibit.
translation: Doga Tarihi sergisi hakkinda bilgi edin.

english: But what's Natural History got to do with existing animals?
translation: Ama Doga Tarihi'nin mevcut hayvanlarla ne ilgisi var?

english: Find out about Kudos.
I cannot speak to you outerlander! Talk to Brundt, the Chieftain!
translation: Seninle konusamam yabanci! Sef Brundt ile konus!

english: You stay away from me outerlander!
They are too suspicious of you for you to get close enough to steal from them.
translation: Sana karsi cok süpheci davraniyorlar, onlardan calacak kadar yaklasamazsin.

english: Hello. I'm looking for a member of the council of elders who will support my application to become an honorary Fremennik.
translation: Merhaba. Onursal Fremennik olmak icin basvurumu destekleyecek bir yaslilar konseyi üyesi ariyorum.

english: I'm a council member.
So can I somehow persuade you to vote for me at the council of elders?
translation: Peki, yaslilar konseyinde bana oy vermen icin seni ikna edebilir miyim?

english: No. Frankly, I don't like you.
But you don't even know me!
You also smell bad. And have stupid hair. And bad breath. And you walk a bit funny.
translation: Ayrica kötü kokuyorsun. Sacin da berbat. Nefesin de kötü kokuyor. Yürüyüsün de biraz tuhaf.

english: I didn't come all the way up here just to be insulted!
translation: Buraya kadar gelip hakaret yemek icin gelmedim!

english: No, I'm quite sure you could have found plenty of people to insult you wherever your home is.
translation: Hayir, eminim ki evinde de sana hakaret edecek bir sürü insan bulabilirdin.

english: You know what? Forget you, you stupid barbarian! I don't need your stupid vote!
translation: Biliyor musun? Unut gitsin, aptal barbar! Senin aptal oyuna ihtiyacim yok!

english: Tch, typical outerlander rudeness. I'm glad I didn't vote for you now.
translation: Tch, tipik bir yabanci kabaligi. Simdi sana oy vermemis olduguma seviniyorum.

english: Hello.
Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: Merhaba kardesim Dokrak. Bugün benden ne istiyorsun? Her zaman yardimima güvenebilirsin!

english: Nothing thanks. I just fancied a chat.
translation: Hicbir sey, tesekkürler. Sadece sohbet etmek istedim.

english: My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
translation: Yardimima ihtiyacin olursa kapim her zaman acik Dokrak.

english: [Fremennik name]... It has been too long since last we met!
translation: Dokrak... Son görüsmemizden bu yana cok zaman gecti!

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: Hos geldin kardesim Dokrak. Seni burada görmek her zaman bir zevk!

english: My apologies [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: Özür dilerim kardesim Dokrak! Burada seninle vakit gecirecek vaktim yok!

english: That's okay, I didn't really want anything.
translation: Sorun degil, aslinda bir sey istememistim.

english: How are you [Fremennik name]? I hope all fares well with you this day!
translation: Nasilsin Dokrak? Umarim bugün her sey yolundadir!

english: I'm fine, thanks, how are you?
All is well with me also!
Hello to you, too!
Hello. Did you want something [Fremennik name]?
translation: Merhaba. Bir sey mi istiyordun Dokrak?

english: No, not really.
Well... okay then!
Always good to see you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].
translation: Seni görmek her zaman güzel kardesim Dokrak.

english: You shame us, [Fremennik name]!
How can you steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
You have betrayed your heritage, [Fremennik name]!
Why would you try to steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
I think the locals are taking a liking to us! One of them hasn't stopped wearing those clothes Arnkel sold her. Much better than those piddly little things she was wearing before!
translation: Sanirim yerliler bizi sevmeye basladi! Iclerinden biri Arnkel'in sattigi kiyafetleri giymeye devam ediyor. Önceden giydigi o önemsiz seylerden cok daha iyi!

english: I think they're piddly because of how warm it is here...
translation: Bence bu kiyafetler önemsiz cünkü burasi cok sicak...

english: Bah! A bit of heat never hurt anyone.
translation: Bah! Biraz sicaklik kimseye zarar vermez.

english: I don't think that's true.
Oh stop your whining, traveller! Now, I think it's time for a drink.
translation: Sizlanmayi kes, gezgin! Simdi icki icme zamani geldi.

english: Oh stop your whining, [Fremennik name]! Now, I think it's time for a drink.
translation: Sizlanmayi kes, Dokrak! Simdi icki icme zamani geldi.

english: Hello.
Good day, your Royal Highness.
Outlander, I have work to be getting on with... Please stop bothering me.
translation: Yabanci, yapmam gereken isler var... Lütfen beni rahatsiz etme.

english: Good afternoon! How do you like our village?
It's lovely. You have a fine collection of goats.
translation: Cok güzel. Cok güzel keci koleksiyonun var.

english: We polish them every day to get them nice and clean.
Hello again! Have you any word from my husband?
translation: Merhaba tekrar! Kocamdan haber var mi?

english: Err, no, not yet. It takes a while for the messages to reach me, you know.
translation: Hayir, henüz yok. Mesajlarin bana ulasmasi biraz zaman aliyor, biliyorsun.

english: Well, when you do, tell him we'll be more than happy to see him again.
translation: Peki, haber aldiginda ona tekrar görüsmekten cok mutlu olacagimizi söyle.

english: Excuse me, but are you Ingrid? The same Ingrid that is married to Olaf Hradson?
translation: Affedersiniz, siz Ingrid misiniz? Olaf Hradson ile evli olan Ingrid?

english: Yes I am. Why do you ask?
I am a friend of your husband. He sent me here with a gift for you.
translation: Kocanizin bir arkadasiyim. Size bir hediye getirmem icin beni buraya gönderdi.

english: An expensive, exotic gift from the far-flung and tropical shores of the Island of Obscurity.
translation: Uzak ve tropikal Obscurity Adasi'ndan pahali, egzotik bir hediye.

english: How wonderful! I assumed from the way the big oaf always referred to the rigging as 'big strings' that he couldn't navigate his way out of a soggy paper bag. So, can I see the gift he sent?
translation: Ne kadar harika! O koca ahmakin donanimi hep “büyük ipler” olarak adlandirmasindan, islak bir kagit torbadan bile cikamayacagini düsünmüstüm. Peki, gönderdigi hediyeyi görebilir miyim?

english: Certainly! Here it is. He sends his best wishes along with it.
translation: Elbette! Iste burada. En iyi dileklerini de gönderdi.

english: I see. It looks like a log with 'Olaf was here' carved in it.
translation: Anliyorum. Üzerine “Olaf buradaydi” yazilmis bir kütük gibi görünüyor.

english: It's tribal! Very tribal! I watched the natives carve it myself.
translation: Kabile tarzi! Cok kabile tarzi! Yerlilerin onu oydugunu kendi gözlerimle gördüm.

english: Well, since you have come such a long way, you can have this. I baked it this morning, so it's still nice and fresh.
translation: Madem bu kadar uzun bir yol geldin, bunu alabilirsin. Bu sabah pisirdim, yani hala taze ve lezzetli.

english: Oh, thank you! Enjoy your Obscurian Tribal Artefact(tm). It has a million-and-one uses!
translation: Oh, tesekkürler! Obscurian Kabile Eseri(tm)'nin tadini cikar. Bin bir türlü kullanimi var!

english: Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu var. Merhaba, selam, merhaba...

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: Bu yine de tek bir selam sayilir!

english: Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her türlü sey! Kuleler görülmeye deger harika manzaralar sunuyor.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmeni tavsiye ederim.

Welcome to the King's Axe inn! What can I help you with?
translation: King's Axe hanina hos geldiniz! Nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: Can I have some beer please?
Go to the bar downstairs. I only deal with residents.
translation: Asagidaki bara gidin. Ben sadece konuklarla ilgileniyorum.

english: Residents? People live here?
No, just guests that stay the night.
Hello.
I can never catch Eoin, he is just too fast, I am always 'It'.
translation: Eoin'i asla yakalayamiyorum, cok hizli, hep ben yakaliyorum.

english: You're the one that saved us, thank you.
Thanks so much for returning my daughter to me. I expect that she will go on another trip soon though. She is the adventurous type... a bit like yourself really! Okay, see you around then!
translation: Kizimi bana geri getirdiginiz icin cok tesekkürler. Ama yakinda yine bir seyahate cikacagini tahmin ediyorum. O maceraci bir tip... aslinda biraz size benziyor! Tamam, görüsürüz o zaman!

english: Hello.
Hello, my name is Irene. I'm a chemist.
We're not entirely sure. I'm here to study it to find out just that.
translation: Tam olarak emin degiliz. Ben de bunu arastirmak icin buradayim.

english: Have you tried....
Well, someone drank it... that didn't turn out so well.
translation: Sey, biri icti... ama sonuc pek iyi olmadi.

english: What happened? Who was it? Are they ok?

Well, she's still alive at the moment. It was my mum, Marie. She's a better chemist than me, but she likes to do things practically. This time it didn't work out so well for her. Lucky I was on hand to help.
translation: Su anda hala hayatta. Annem Marie'ydi. Benden daha iyi bir kimyager ama pratik isleri sever. Bu sefer isler onun icin pek iyi gitmedi. Neyse ki yardim etmek icin yanindaydim.

english: I hope she recovers soon.
Me too.
Ahh yes. Taking samples. We've tried all the methods we can think of, but it seems to, well, change somehow.
translation: Ahh evet. Örnekler aliyoruz. Aklimiza gelen tüm yöntemleri denedik, ama sanki, sey, bir sekilde degisiyor gibi.

english: What changes?
The substance. It's almost like taking a finger off a human and assuming it will stay alive I guess. The sample sort of... goes inert once we take the sample from the main body of the pool.
translation: Madde. Sanki bir insanin parmagini kesip, onun hayatta kalacagini varsaymak gibi bir sey. Örnek, havuzun ana gövdesinden aldigimizda bir nevi... hareketsiz hale geliyor.

english: How awkward.
Yes, we've had a bit of progress there. We've tried adding in a lot of things with varying results. The accident was the best though.
translation: Evet, bu konuda biraz ilerleme kaydettik. Cesitli sonuclar elde etmek icin bircok sey eklemeyi denedik. En iyisi kaza oldu.

english: Irene looks embarassed.
What happened?
Well, I slipped and dropped a fossilised leg bone from something in the pool. It... well it kind of ate it away.
translation: Kaydim ve havuzdaki bir seyin fosillesmis bacak kemigini düsürdüm. O... onu bir nevi yedi.

english: Was there anything left?

Oh yes, it was quite interesting. It's as if it restored some of the biological content of the bone and stripped all the mineralisation of fosilisation away. The bone was, rather floppy though. Like when you remove all the
translation: Evet, oldukca ilgincti. Sanki kemigin biyolojik iceriginin bir kismini geri kazandirmis ve fosillesmenin tüm minerallesmesini ortadan kaldirmis gibi. Kemik oldukca yumusakti. Sanki tüm

english: calcium and phosphate from it.
Have you tried putting calcium in the pool?
Calcium and phosphate are highly reactive - you'd never find just those in any quantity! You could maybe find some within minerals around this island that could work.
translation: Kalsiyum ve fosfat cok reaktif maddelerdir, hicbir yerde bu maddeleri tek basina bulamazsiniz! Belki bu adadaki minerallerde ise yarayabilecek miktarda bulabilirsiniz.

english: Who are you?
What's this pool for?
Drinking it?
Sampling it?
Putting random things in it?
translation: Icine rastgele seyler koymak icin mi?

english: If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: Senin kadar cirkin olsaydim, halka acik yerlerde yüzümü göstermeye cesaret edemezdim!

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: Oh! Sey... Az önce bir tane yedim de ondan!

english: Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: Hayatina deger veriyorsan bir daha benimle konusma!

english: Get lost!
I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: Sana verecek hicbir seyim yok, beni rahat birak, dilenci.

english: Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
translation: Su anda bununla ugrasacak vaktim yok.

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: Senin gibi zavalli bir et yiginiyla konusmak istemiyorum.

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: Cok kötü bir gün... tadini cikar, bitmeden.

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: Eger birini yakalarsan, paylasacagina söz ver.

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
You smell familiar...
Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: Buralarda insan gördün mü? Cok acim.

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: Bana kan tadi seven biri gibi görünüyorsun.

english: Good day to you, my friend.
Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: Bir dakika, dislerime bir sey sikismis...

translation: Yakut yüzükler satiyorum! 2400'den fazla varlik düzleminde en iyi yüzük firsatlari!

Aha! A connoisseur! Check out these beauties!
translation: Aha! Bir uzman! Su güzelliklere bak!

Fair enough.

english: Tell me about Iron[men/women].
When you play as anIron, you do everything for yourself. You don't trade with other players, or take their items, or accept their help.
translation: Demir olarak oynadiginizda, her seyi kendiniz yaparsiniz. Diger oyuncularla ticaret yapmaz, onlarin esyalarini almaz veya yardimlarini kabul etmezsiniz.

english: As anIron, you choose to have these restrictions imposed on you, so everyone knows you're doing it properly.
translation: Demir olarak, bu kisitlamalarin size uygulanmasini secersiniz, böylece herkes bunu dogru bir sekilde yaptiginizi bilir.

english: If you are a daring bunch, you could even tryHardcore Group Ironmen. With Hardcore Group Ironmen you have a set number of lives, when they reach zero, you will become regularGroup Ironmen.
translation: Cesur bir grupsaniz, Hardcore Grup Ironmen'leri bile deneyebilirsiniz. Hardcore Grup Ironmen'lerde belirli sayida caniniz vardir ve bu canlar sifira ulastiginda, normal Grup Ironmen'lere dönüsürsünüz.

english: If you ever decided to invite experienced players to your group, you would becomeUnranked Group Ironmen, which are no longer shown on the Group Ironman hiscores.
translation: Grubunuza deneyimli oyunculari davet etmeye karar verirseniz, artik Grup Ironman yüksek skorlarinda gösterilmeyen Siralamasi Olmayan Grup Ironmen olursunuz.

english: For the ultimate challenge, you can choose to become anUltimate Iron, a game mode inspired by the playerIronNoBank.
translation: En zorlu meydan okuma icin, oyuncu IronNoBank'tan esinlenilen bir oyun modu olan Ultimate Iron olmayi secebilirsiniz.

english: In addition to the standard restrictions,Ultimate Iron[men/women]are blocked from using the bank, and they drop all their items when they die.
translation: Standart kisitlamalara ek olarak, Ultimate Ironadam banka kullanamaz ve öldüklerinde tüm esyalarini düsürürler.

translation: Tutorial Island'da iken, standart Iron, Ultimate Iron, Hardcore Iron, Group Ironman, Hardcore Group Ironman veya normal karakter arasinda serbestce gecis yapabilirsiniz.

english: Once you've left this island, you'll be able to find my colleague Adam in Lumbridge, but he'll only let you switch your restrictions downwards, not upwards.
translation: Bu adadan ayrildiktan sonra, Lumbridge'de meslektasim Adam'i bulabilirsiniz, ancak o size kisitlamalarinizi yukari degil, asagi dogru degistirmenize izin verecektir.

english: So he will letHardcore Iron[men/women]orUltimate Iron[men/women]downgrade tostandard Iron[men/women], and he'll let all types ofIronbecome normal players.

english: I'd like to change my Iron mode.
Make sure you've got your Iron settings all sorted before you leave Tutorial Island. Some things can't be changed later.
translation: Tutorial Island'dan ayrilmadan önce Iron  ayarlarinizi düzenlediginizden emin olun. Bazi seyler daha sonra degistirilemez.

Hey there [Paul/Adam].

If you're interested in the Fresh Start Worlds, you should know that you can't be an Iron Man on those.
translation: Fresh Start Worlds ile ilgileniyorsaniz, bu dünyalarda Iron Man olamayacaginizi bilmelisiniz.

english: What are Fresh Start Worlds?
Fresh Start Worlds are worlds that have a fresh economy to build and fresh hiscores to chase.
translation: Fresh Start Worlds, yeni bir ekonomi kurmak ve yeni rekorlar kirmak icin tasarlanmis dünyalardir.

english: They're a way to experience Old School RuneScape as if it were new, today!
translation: Old School RuneScape'i bugün yeniymis gibi deneyimlemek icin bir yoldur!

english: They will last for 6 months, after which your account will be transferedto the main game and you can carry on playing as normal there.
translation: Bu dünyalar 6 ay sürecek, ardindan hesabiniz ana oyuna aktarilacak ve orada normal sekilde oynamaya devam edebileceksiniz.

english: There is a World First system, which are achievements only obtainable once on all worlds, so you can race against others for these!
translation: Tüm dünyalarda yalnizca bir kez elde edilebilen basarilar iceren bir World First sistemi vardir, bu sayede diger oyuncularla yarisabilirsiniz!

english: If a global race is a bit too much, then there is also an Achievement Point system. You can compete against your friends to get the most points.
translation: Küresel bir yaris biraz fazla geliyorsa, Achievement Point sistemi de vardir. Arkadaslarinizla en cok puani almak icin rekabet edebilirsiniz.

english: Other than that, it's the same Old School experience you know and love, with all the same content as the main game.
translation: Bunun disinda, ana oyundaki tüm iceriklerle birlikte, bildiginiz ve sevdiginiz ayni Old School deneyimi yasarsiniz.

english: Do you still wish to proceed with selecting an Iron Man mode?

english: That's okay. If you change your mind you can find out more about Fresh Start Worlds by speaking to the Magic Instructor, assuming you're not an ironman.
translation: Sorun degil. Fikrinizi degistirirseniz, Ironman degilseniz, Magic Instructor ile konusarak Fresh Start Worlds hakkinda daha fazla bilgi edinebilirsiniz.

english: You'll have to remove any ironman status first by speaking to me.
translation: Önce benimle konusarak Ironman statünüzü kaldirmaniz gerekir.

english: No, Fresh Start Worlds sound like my sort of thing!

translation: Harika! Fresh Start Worlds hakkinda daha fazla bilgi almak icin Magic Instructor ile konusabilirsiniz.

What?
I need you to help me with this.
translation: Bana bu konuda yardim etmen gerekiyor.

english: Please give me your answer!
Correct - I despise snakes!

translation: Hayir, Fresh Start Worlds tam benim tarzim gibi görünüyor!

english: When you play as anIron[man/woman], you do everything for yourself. You don't trade with other players, or take their items, or accept their help.
translation: Ironman olarak oynadiginizda, her seyi kendiniz yaparsiniz. Diger oyuncularla ticaret yapmaz, onlarin esyalarini almaz veya yardimlarini kabul etmezsiniz.

english: As anIron[man/woman], you choose to have these restrictions imposed on you, so everyone knows you're doing it properly.
translation: Ironman olarak, bu kisitlamalari kendinize uygulamanizi seçersiniz, böylece herkes bunu dogru bir sekilde yaptiginizi bilir.

english: If you think you have what it takes, you can choose to become aHardcore Iron[man/woman].
translation: Eger gerekli niteliklere sahip oldugunuzu düsünüyorsaniz, Hardcore Ironman olmayi seçebilirsiniz.

english: For the ultimate challenge, you can choose to become anUltimate Iron[man/woman], a game mode inspired by the playerIronNoBank.
translation: En zorlu meydan okuma için, oyuncu IronNoBank'tan esinlenerek olusturulan bir oyun modu olan Ultimate Ironman olmayi seçebilirsiniz.

english: While you're on Tutorial Island, you can switch freely between being astandard Iron[man/woman], anUltimate Iron[man/woman], aHardcore Iron[man/woman], aGroup Ironman, aHardcore Group Ironmanor a regular character.

Make sure you've got your Iron[man/woman] settings all sorted before you leave Tutorial Island. Some things can't be changed later.
translation: Tutorial Island'dan ayrilmadan önce Ironman ayarlarinizi düzenlediginizden emin olun. Bazi seyler daha sonra degistirilemez.

translation: Tutorial Island'da iken, standart Ironman, Ultimate Ironman, Hardcore Ironman veya normal oyuncu arasinda serbestçe geçis yapabilirsiniz.
