Hello, [player name]. I'm the Iron[man/woman] tutor. What can I do for you?
translation: Merhaba, Maceraci. Ben Ironman ögretmeni. Sizin için ne yapabilirim?

english: You can choose to become anIron[man/woman]while you're on Tutorial Island. Although you can't do that on this account, you might like to bear it in mind for the future.
translation: Tutorial Island'da Ironman olmayi seçebilirsiniz. Bu hesapta bunu yapamazsiniz, ancak gelecekte bunu aklinizda bulundurmak isteyebilirsiniz.

english: You're not an Iron[man/woman]. This armour is only for them.
translation: Sen Ironman degilsin. Bu zirh sadece onlar için.

english: I'd like to change my Iron[man/woman] mode.
I'd like to review my Iron[man/woman] mode.
Hey, what do you do here?
I help the main man over there. He can get a bit cantankerous. Every now and then he'll just start attacking people without warning. I act as a sort of home help...
translation: Suradaki patrona yardim ediyorum. Bazen biraz huysuz olabiliyor. Ara sira hic uyari yapmadan insanlara saldirmaya basliyor. Ben bir nevi ev yardimcisiyim...

english: How do you mean, home help?

Well, sometimes he'll fly right off the handle and just start, you know, 'raising the dead' to do his 'bidding'. That kind of activity is just so anti-social, so it tends to attract a lot of hero types, you know!
translation: Bazen birden sinirlenip, “ölüleri diriltmeye” baslar, “emirlerini yerine getirmeleri” icin. Bu tür faaliyetler cok antisosyal oldugu icin, bircok kahraman tipini kendine cekiyor, anlarsin ya!

english: Yes, yes, I know the sort...full of themselves aren't they.
translation: Evet, evet, o tür insanlari bilirim... Kendilerini cok begenirler, degil mi?

english: Exactly! They come in all, 'Have at thee! ' and 'Death to you evil one', it's all a bit too dramatic for me to be honest.
translation: Aynen öyle! “Gel bakalim!” ve “Ölüm sana, kötü adam!” diye gelirler, acikcasi benim icin biraz fazla dramatik.

english: Anyway, he'll often end up getting killed and nothing get's done around the house while he's awaiting his mortal return.
translation: Her neyse, genellikle öldürülür ve o ölümcül dönüsünü beklerken evde hicbir is yapilmaz.

english: Mortal return? Sounds interesting.
translation: Ölümcül dönüs mü? Kulaga ilginc geliyor.

english: Well, it's kind of interesting the first few times, but it's like falling off a bike...
translation: Ilk birkac sefer ilginc olabilir ama bisikletten düsmek gibi bir sey...

english: What, you graze your knees a lot?
I was going to say that you soon get fed-up with it. I guess it's one of those perks of the job though, ability to raise yourself from the dead.
translation: Yakinda bundan bikacagini söyleyecektim. Sanirim bu isin avantajlarindan biri de, kendini ölümden diriltebilme yetenegi.

english: You'd think he'd do better things with a gift like that, but all he tends to do is get angry at people who come into his house without being invited and then he's off again 'raising the dead'.
translation: Böyle bir yetenegi varken daha iyi seyler yapacagini düsünürsün, ama tek yaptigi, davetsiz misafirleri kizdirmak ve sonra yine “ölüleri diriltmek” icin ortadan kaybolmak.

english: I found this torn page, do you know anything about it?
translation: Bu yirtik sayfayi buldum, bununla ilgili bir sey biliyor musun?

english: Hey...I hope you didn't rip that page out of one of those books, they'll be trouble if it was.
translation: Hey... Umarim o sayfayi o kitaplardan birinden yirtmamissindir, eger öyleyse basin belaya girer.

english: No, it wasn't actually, I got it from somewhere else, do you recognise it?
translation: Hayir, aslinda öyle degil, baska bir yerden aldim, taniyor musun?

english: Hmm, well it certainly looks like text from one of the books. Have you checked at the wizards' guild in Yanille? We sometime loan books to them.
translation: Hmm, kesinlikle kitaplardan birinden alinmis bir metin gibi görünüyor. Yanille'deki büyücüler loncasina baktin mi? Bazen onlara kitap ödünc veriyoruz.

english: Hi, do you know anything about this book?
translation: Merhaba, bu kitap hakkinda bir sey biliyor musun?

english: Hey...that book has been loaned to the wizards' guild in Yanille, I hope you're not returning it in a damaged condition!
translation: Hey... o kitap Yanille'deki büyücüler loncasina ödünc verilmisti, umarim onu hasarli bir sekilde geri getirmiyorsundur!

english: Well, I was just wondering where the book came from actually and try to get some more information about it.
translation: Aslinda kitabin nereden geldigini merak ediyordum ve hakkinda biraz daha bilgi almaya calisiyordum.

english: Well, that book looks as if it's been through the wars...you're not going to return it in that condition. You take it back to the wizards at Yanille, they borrowed it, so it's their responsibility.
translation: Bu kitap savaslardan cikmis gibi görünüyor... onu bu durumda geri vermeyeceksin. Yanille'deki büyücülere geri götür, onlar ödünc almislar, bu onlarin sorumlulugu.

english: Hello, Isadora.
Hello again, funny person. Have you been helping the ents?
translation: Merhaba yine, komik insan. Entlere yardim ediyor musun?

english: Not yet, but I suppose I probably should.
A little bit, yes.
The ents like it when you help. They'll give you more gifts!
translation: Entler yardim ettiginde hoslanirlar. Sana daha fazla hediye verirler!

english: Well, I do always like a gift. I was wondering though, do you know why these totems are so important to the ents?
translation: Sey, ben her zaman hediyeyi severim. Merak ediyordum da, bu totemlerin entler için neden bu kadar önemli oldugunu biliyor musun?

english: Oh... er...
No.
Oh...
But daddy says they're very important. He says the ents need the totems. Without them, the ents would be all sad, and then the whole valley would be all dead and sad!
translation: Ama babam çok önemli olduklarini söylüyor. Entlerin totemlere ihtiyaci oldugunu söylüyor. Onlar olmadan entler çok üzülür ve sonra bütün vadi ölür ve üzülür!

english: That's why we have to help them! Daddy lets me help them sometimes, but I'm only allowed to help them here. Mummy says it's too dangerous for me to go out into the valley on my own. She says there are monsters!
translation: Bu yüzden onlara yardim etmeliyiz! Babam bazen onlara yardim etmeme izin veriyor, ama sadece burada yardim etmeme izin veriyor. Annem tek basima vadiye çikmamin çok tehlikeli oldugunu söylüyor. Orada canavarlar oldugunu söylüyor!

english: I don't know if that's true... I think the ents would stop any monsters! But mummy and daddy get all grumpy if I don't listen.
translation: Bunun dogru olup olmadigini bilmiyorum... Bence entler canavarlari durdurur! Ama annem ve babam sözümü dinlemezsem çok sinirleniyorlar.

english: And I'm sure nobody wants mummy and daddy to be grumpy!
translation: Ve eminim kimse annemle babamin sinirlenmesini istemez!

english: Too right. Anyway, goodbye, funny person. Don't forget to help the ents!
translation: Çok haklisin. Neyse, hosça kal, komik insan. Entlere yardim etmeyi unutma!

english: Be on your guard friend.
Tell me about the Wintertodt.
The Wintertodt terrorised Great Kourend many centuries ago. It destroyed much of this northern land over many years before it was finally driven back into this prison.
translation: Wintertodt, yüzyillar önce Büyük Kourend'i dehsete düsürdü. Yillar boyunca bu kuzey topraklarinin cogunu yok etti, sonunda bu hapishaneye geri sürüldü.

english: Why did it attack Kourend?
No one knows for sure but I have a theory...
translation: Kimse kesin olarak bilmiyor ama benim bir teorim var...

english: Which is?
The Dark Altar. It felt the altar's power and wanted to consume it for itself. It wouldn't be the first time...
translation: Karanlik Sunak. Sunak'in gücünü hissetti ve onu kendine ait yapmak istedi. Bu ilk kez olmuyor...

english: Interesting...
Tell me about yourself.
I'm Ish, one of the navigators of Piscarilius.
What brings a navigator up here?
Lady Piscarilius has sent me here to keep an eye on the situation. She doesn't trust the other houses and believes something sinister is going on.
translation: Lady Piscarilius durumu gözlemlemem icin beni buraya gönderdi. Diger hanelere güvenmiyor ve kötü bir seyler döndügünü düsünüyor.

english: Like what?
I don't know, but I intend to find out.
What do you think of the Pyromancers?
I've heard stories about them and the things they have done over the years. Be careful, they can't be trusted.
translation: Onlar ve yillar boyunca yaptiklari seyler hakkinda hikayeler duydum. Dikkatli ol, onlara güvenilmez.

english: You seem a bit paranoid.
Better to be paranoid than a fool. Anyone with any sense knows that the Pyromancers are trouble. They say even Lord Arceuus doesn't trust them.
translation: Aptal olmaktansa paranoyak olmak daha iyidir. Akli olan herkes Pyromancers'in sorun cikardigini bilir. Lord Arceuus'un bile onlara güvenmedigini söylüyorlar.

english: I have to go.
Stay vigilant friend.
Tell me about the Wintertodt.
Tell me about yourself.
What do you think of the Pyromancers?
I have to go.
Hello, what do you do around here?
The name's Ishmael. I sell fishing supplies, along with some of the local catch.
translation: Adim Ishmael. Balikcilik malzemeleri ve yerel balik satiyorum.

english: Can I take a look at what you have in stock?
translation: Stokta ne var bir bakabilir miyim?

english: Aye.
Why did you set up shop around here? It seems a little run down.
translation: Neden buraya dükkan actin? Biraz bakimsiz görünüyor.

english: Argh... run down it is! But since Tempoross showed up, seadogs from all across Gielinor have been coming to wrangle the beast. It only made sense to sell off our spare resources.
translation: Ah... Evet, harap! Ama Tempoross ortaya ciktigindan beri, Gielinor'un dört bir yanindan denizciler bu canavari yakalamak icin buraya geliyor. Fazla kaynaklarimizi satmak mantikli geldi.

english: I think that's everything. Goodbye.
translation: Sanirim hepsi bu kadar. Hosca kal.

english: Safe travels.
Can I take a look at what you have in stock?
Why did you set up shop around here? Seems a little run down.
translation: Neden buraya dükkan actin? Biraz harap görünüyor.

english: Goodbye.
Welcome to the Grand Library Historical Archive.
translation: Büyük Kütüphane Tarih Arsivine hos geldiniz.

english: What is this place?
This is the Library Historical Archive. Here you'll find historical documents and texts from all eras of Great Kourend's history, dating all the way back to the first decade.
translation: Burasi Kütüphane Tarih Arsivi. Burada, Büyük Kourend'in tarihinin tüm dönemlerine ait tarihi belgeler ve metinler bulabilirsiniz, ilk on yila kadar geriye giden.

english: Are you looking for something in particular?
translation: Özel olarak aradiginiz bir sey var mi?

english: What information do you have on Xeric?
translation: Xeric hakkinda ne tür bilgileriniz var?

english: Ah, Xeric. Our most infamous ruler... We do have extensive records regarding Xeric. You can examine some of the texts here or speak to Ektheme, our Xerician expert.
translation: Ah, Xeric. En kötü söhretli hükümdarimiz... Xeric hakkinda kapsamli kayitlarimiz var. Buradaki metinlerin bazilarini inceleyebilir veya Xeric uzmani Ektheme ile konusabilirsiniz.

english: Is there something else I can help you with?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: What can you tell me about the Wintertodt?
The Wintertodt, or the Winter beast as it was often known at the time, terrorised northern Kourend for five decades.
translation: Wintertodt, ya da o dönemde sikca bilinen adiyla Kis Canavari, elli yil boyunca kuzey Kourend'i dehsete düsürdü.

english: Logios is currently studying the Wintertodt Invasion, and we have various texts from that era.
translation: Logios su anda Wintertodt Istilasi'ni inceliyor ve o döneme ait cesitli metinlerimiz var.

english: What can you tell me about Mount Quidamortem?
Our first records of the mountain date back to the 36th decade where a Shayzien patrol discovered the mountain during a survey of the Kebos Lowlands.
translation: Dagla ilgili ilk kayitlarimiz, Shayzien devriyesinin Kebos Ovalari'ni arastirirken dagi kesfettigi 36. on yila kadar uzaniyor.

english: King Shayzien VII was keen on conquering more land for Kourend and demanded his people explore suitable territories.
translation: Kral Shayzien VII, Kourend icin daha fazla toprak fethetmeye hevesliydi ve halkindan uygun bölgeleri kesfetmelerini istedi.

english: The mountain became known as Mount Quidamortem after it was realised venturing towards the summit resulted in certain death.
translation: Dagin zirvesine dogru ilerlemenin kesin ölümle sonuclandigi anlasildiktan sonra, dag Quidamortem Dagi olarak anilmaya baslandi.

english: Gnosi is our expert on Mount Quidamortem, but I'm afraid she's currently on an expedition to the temple near the summit of the mountain. However, we do have some texts available detailing the great expedition.
translation: Gnosi, Quidamortem Dagi konusunda uzmanimizdir, ancak maalesef su anda dagin zirvesine yakin bir tapinaga kesif gezisinde. Ancak, bu büyük kesif gezisini ayrintili olarak anlatan bazi metinlerimiz var.

english: No thanks.
What do you do here?
My name is Istoria. I'm the chief historian and curator of the Library Historical Archive.
translation: Benim adim Istoria. Tarih Arsivi Kütüphanesi'nin bas tarihcisi ve küratörüyüm.

english: How do I get out of here?
I can teleport you back to the Grand Library. Would you like to leave now?
translation: Seni Büyük Kütüphane'ye geri isinlayabilirim. Simdi gitmek ister misin?

english: Goodbye.
I have a question about King Shayzien VII.
translation: Kral Shayzien VII hakkinda bir sorum var.

english: Well you've come to the right place. What would you like to know?
translation: Dogru yere geldin. Ne bilmek istiyorsun?

english: I'm searching for information on an expedition to Mount Quidamortem during his reign.
translation: Onun hükümdarligi sirasinda Quidamortem Dagi'na yapilan bir kesif gezisi hakkinda bilgi ariyorum.

english: Ah yes, I know of that expedition. King Shayzien VII's reign was quite a violent one according to the history books. The expedition to Quidamortem was part of his aggressive plans to expand Kourend's territory.
translation: Evet, o kesif gezisini biliyorum. Tarih kitaplarina göre Kral Shayzien VII'nin hükümdarligi oldukca siddetli gecmistir. Quidamortem'e yapilan kesif gezisi, Kourend'in topraklarini genisletmek icin yaptigi saldirgan planlarin bir parcasiydi.

english: Unfortunately, the expedition was a failure and the entire party was killed. The king himself died a few years later and was succeeded by the tyrant Xeric. No more expeditions were ordered under his rule.
translation: Maalesef sefer basarisiz oldu ve tüm ekip öldürüldü. Kral da birkac yil sonra öldü ve yerine tiran Xeric gecti. Onun hükümdarligi altinda baska sefer emri verilmedi.

english: Does that help you?
No not really. I have reason to believe that not everyone was killed on that expedition.
translation: Hayir, pek degil. O seferde herkesin öldürülmedigine inanmak icin nedenlerim var.

english: I'm afraid I can't help you there, all the evidence we have tells us that the expedition had no survivors.
translation: Korkarim bu konuda size yardimci olamam, elimizdeki tüm kanitlar seferden sag kurtulan olmadigini gösteriyor.

english: So I'm at a dead end?
It would seem that way. However, if you do want to learn more about King Shayzien VII it might be worth talking to Pagida. He's recently been investigating the kings' additions to the Tower of Magic.
translation: Öyle görünüyor. Ancak, Kral Shayzien VII hakkinda daha fazla bilgi edinmek istiyorsaniz Pagida ile konusmanizda fayda var. Son zamanlarda krallarin Büyü Kulesi'ne yaptiklari eklemeleri arastiriyor.

english: Okay, thanks.
Do you know anything about Camorra? She was a hero who lived around two thousand years ago.
translation: Camorra hakkinda bir sey biliyor musun? O, yaklasik iki bin yil önce yasamis bir kahramandi.

english: I have heard that name, though we have very few records from before the founding of Kourend. Perhaps Imerominia could help you? She is the Horologist of the library; such ancient topics may fall within her purview.
translation: Bu ismi duymustum, ancak Kourend'in kurulusundan önceki döneme ait cok az kayit var. Belki Imerominia sana yardimci olabilir? O, kütüphanenin saat ustasidir; bu tür eski konular onun uzmanlik alanina girebilir.

english: Thanks.
What is this place?
What information do you have on Xeric?
translation: Xeric hakkinda ne gibi bilgileriniz var?

english: What can you tell me about the Wintertodt?
What can you tell me about Mount Quidamortem?
What do you do here?
How do I get out of here?
Yes please.
No thanks.
Goodbye.
I have a question about King Shayzien VII.
translation: Kral Shayzien VII hakkinda bir sorum var.

english: Do you know anything about Camorra?
translation: Camorra hakkinda bir sey biliyor musun?

english: Urgh...
He looks too sick to chat.
Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: Hey, bu Kahraman! Vay canina! Sen harikasin, o iki juvinate ve Gadderank'i nasil alt ettin? Ve kasaba cok güzel, harika bir is cikarmissin!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
I'm Ivan, I'm just a kid, but I'll duff you in! You don't look that tough to me!
translation: Ben Ivan, sadece bir cocugum, ama seni yenebilirim! Bana o kadar da sert görünmüyorsun!

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: Oh, pek bir sey yok, hepimiz hala vampirlerden saklaniyoruz ve bu korkunc yerde gecimimizi sagliyoruz, umarim yakinda Salve'deki tapinaga yolculuk yapacak kadar gücleniriz.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: Bildigim kadariyla yok, su anda cok yararli olan bazi temel olanaklara sahibiz, hepimiz sana cok minnettariz. Daha önce hic bir kahraman görmedim veya tanimadim, bu yüzden karsilastiracak bir seyim yok, ama sanirim

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: cogu insanin görüsüne göre, sen bir kahramansin! Ben sahsen seninle tanistigima cok memnunum.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Ok, thanks.
Is something new and exciting happening?
translation: Yeni ve heyecan verici bir sey mi oluyor?

english: Maybe. Veliaf has asked me to do some work for him. Hopefully it will benefit you all.
translation: Belki. Veliaf benden onun icin bir is yapmami istedi. Umarim bu hepinizin yararina olur.

english: [player name].
Hey Ivan.
How are you doing?
Fine.
Are you sure? You know I'm here if you need anything.
translation: Emin misin? Bir seye ihtiyacin olursa ben buradayim.

english: I'm fine. Did you need something?
Just checking in. I'll leave you be.
translation: Sadece kontrol ediyordum. Seni rahat birakayim.

english: I need another flail.
I have some here, along with a few other things. It will cost you though.
translation: Burada birkac tane var, baska seyler de var. Ama parasi var.

english: I need another Drakan's Medallion.
translation: Bir tane daha Drakan Madalyonu lazim.

english: Sure.
I'd better get going.
[player name]. I have a tome here that I think belongs to you.
translation: Maceraci. Sanirim sana ait bir kitap var burada.

english: Thank you, Ivan.
How are you doing?
I need another flail.
I need another Drakan's Medallion.
translation: Bir tane daha Drakan'in Madalyonu lazim.

english: Just checking in. I'll leave you be.
translation: Sadece kontrol ediyordum. Seni rahat birakayim.

english: I'd better get going.
You look like a man that could use a mace. Finest weapons around! Want to take a look?
translation: Mace kullanabilecek birine benziyorsun. En iyi silahlar burada! Bir bakmak ister misin?

english: Yes, please.
No thanks.
Your loss, I suppose. You won't find a weapon like a mace!
translation: Senin kaybin, sanirim. Mace gibi bir silah bulamazsin!

english: Yes, please.
No thanks.
MMMGHGHGGMH!!!
What's going on ARRGH!
Arrgh! Human! Scary! Go away!
Can I help you?
What's up with him?
Another gift from the sea. Found him on the shore a few days ago.
translation: Denizin bir baska hediyesi. Birkac gün önce kiyida buldum onu.

english: The moon... His face was the moon...
Is he going to be okay?
Maybe. Maybe not. Only time will tell.
translation: Belki. Belki de olmayacak. Zaman gösterecek.

english: Okay... What are you going to do with him?
He'll get the same offer they all do. We don't need mouths to feed if they won't contribute. Once he's up, he can either stick around or ship out, but if he's staying, he has to help.
translation: Digerlerine yaptigimiz gibi ona da ayni teklifi yapacagiz. Katkida bulunmayacaklarsa besleyecek agizlara ihtiyacimiz yok. Ayaklari üzerinde durdugunda, ya burada kalabilir ya da gemiyle gidebilir, ama kalirsa yardim etmek zorunda.

english: Help with what?
Salvage of course. We don't have the luxuries of Fortis out here. We have to make do with what we can find. Luckily for us, there's always plenty to be found thanks to all the wrecks.
translation: Tabii ki enkaz kurtarmaya. Burada Fortis'teki gibi lüksümüz yok. Bulabildigimizle idare etmek zorundayiz. Sansimiza, enkazlar sayesinde her zaman bolca malzeme bulabiliyoruz.

english: I see. Well I hope he gets well soon.
You've returned. Can I help you?
Is he doing any better?
What do you think?
What happens if he doesn't recover?
The sea can have him back.
Harsh.
I told you before, we don't have the luxuries of Fortis out here. The dead are not useful, nor are they worth anything.
translation: Daha önce de söyledim, burada Fortis'teki gibi lüksümüz yok. Ölüler ise yaramaz, hicbir degeri yoktur.

english: If he does live, he will have an opportunity. If he desires, he can have a home here, provided he's willing to contribute.
translation: Eger yasarsa, bir firsati olacak. Istersen, katkida bulunmaya hazirsa, burada bir evi olabilir.

english: Hi there. Would you like to buy a cape?
Yes please.
No thanks.
Suit yourself.
Yes please.
No thanks.
Thanks so much for saving us from those stinky gublinch. They were awful! I hope Shanty gave you somefing cool for your efforts.
translation: Bizi o kokusmus gublinclerden kurtardigin icin cok tesekkürler. Cok korkunclardi! Umarim Shanty cabalarin icin sana güzel bir sey vermistir.

english: Ha Ha Ha  If it isn't Jack Frost. You look smaller than last time I saw you.
translation: Ha ha ha, bu Jack Frost degil mi? Son gördügümden daha kücük görünüyorsun.

english: A-A-Anti Santa!? What are you doing here?
translation: A-A-Anti Noel Baba!? Burada ne isin var?

english: Your father sent me. Apparently, you've been rather naughty this year.
translation: Beni baban gönderdi. Anlasilan bu yil oldukca yaramazlik yapmissin.

english: I'm here to sort you out.
What? My dad sent you? No way, he put me in charge of Christmas.
translation: Ne? Babam mi gönderdi seni? Olamaz, Noel'i bana emanet etti.

english: He did and apparently you're doing such an awful job of it, you've ruined it for everyone...
translation: Öyle yapti ve görünüse göre bu isi cok kötü yapiyorsun, herkesin keyfini kacirdin...

english: When you think about it, are you sure you're not my son?
translation: Düsündügünde, benim oglum olmadigindan emin misin?

english: You're not my father, you're just an ugly bag of bones.
translation: Sen benim babam degilsin, sadece cirkin bir kemik torbasisin.

english: I won't let you stop me. Take this!
translation: Beni durdurmana izin vermeyecegim. Al sunu!

english: Ha Ha Ha. Is that all you've got, Jack?
translation: Ha ha ha. Elinden gelenin hepsi bu mu Jack?

english: Oh come on! How did that not hurt you?
translation: Hadi ama! Bu sana nasil acitmadi?

english: You're weak just like your father.
I'm gonna slap you back to Lumbridge!
Argh!
You're going to need a lot worse to defeat me.
translation: Beni yenmek icin cok daha kötüsünü yapman gerekecek.

english: Good thing I'm not done yet.
I learned this from an old friend of mine.
Ouch!
You cannot stop me Jack.
I'm not finished yet.
Mummy!
I'm getting out of here. This isn't worth it!
Hello.
So how's life as a pirate?
What kind of question is that? How's life as a... I dunno. Whatever it is that you do for a living.
translation: Bu ne bicim bir soru? Nasil gidiyor... Bilmiyorum. Ne is yapiyorsan o.

english: I'm a freelance troubleshooter.
What does that entail then?
Mostly killing things for money and delivering items around the planet for people.
translation: Cogunlukla para karsiliginda bir seyler öldürmek ve insanlar icin dünyanin dört bir yanina esya teslim etmek.

english: I collect stuff.
So how's that life?
Can't complain, can't complain...
Well, there you go.
Aren't you a little short for a pirate?
translation: Korsan icin biraz kisa degil misin?

english: My mother was a gnome. Apparently it was a very painful birth.
translation: Annem bir cüceydi. Anlasilan cok aci verici bir dogum olmus.

english: More info than I wanted, thanks!
Sorry, can't stop, the Captain will have my guts for garters if he catches me slacking off talking to the stowaway.
translation: Üzgünüm, devam edemem, kaptan beni kacak yolcuyla konusurken yakalarsa bagirsaklarimi cikarir.

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard!
translation: Ben kacak yolcu degilim! Gemiye davet edildim!

english: Yeah, whatever [guy/lady], it doesn't really matter who you are I'll get in trouble!
translation: Evet, neyse , kim oldugun önemli degil, basim belaya girecek!

english: You know, I've always wondered what life as a pirate actually entails.
translation: Biliyor musun, korsan olmanin hayati nasil bir sey oldugunu hep merak etmisimdir.

english: Well, at the moment it mostly involves being asked random questions by a stowaway.
translation: Su anda cogunlukla kacak yolcu tarafindan rastgele sorular sorulmakla geciyor.

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard! By Lokar! Ask him!
translation: Ben kacak yolcu degilim! Gemiye davet edildim! Lokar tarafindan! Ona sor!

english: Hey, whatever [love/pal]. Just make sure the captain doesn't catch you, pirates don't like stowaways much.
translation: Hey, neyse . Kaptan seni yakalamasin, korsanlar kacak yolculari pek sevmezler.

english: Ah, good day to you [milady/sirrah]! Your face is unfamiliar, did you perhaps join us aboard the ship at Lunar Isle?
translation: Ah, iyi günler ! Yüzünüz tanidik gelmiyor, Lunar Isle'da gemiye mi bindiniz?

english: No, Lokar offered me a lift in Rellekka actually.
translation: Hayir, Lokar aslinda Rellekka'da beni gemiye davet etti.

english: Oh, really? You don't look like a Fremennik to me!
translation: Oh, gercekten mi? Bana Fremennik gibi görünmüyorsunuz!

english: Well... I kind of am, and I kind of aren't. It's a long story.
translation: Sey... Bir bakima öyleyim, bir bakima degilim. Uzun hikaye.

english: Sorry I don't have time to hear it then! See you around young fremennik-who-is-not-really-a-fremennik!
translation: Üzgünüm, dinleyecek vaktim yok! Görüsürüz, genc Fremennik-ama-aslinda-Fremennik-olmayan!

english: 'Bye.
Brrrr! Its cold up here!
You think this is cold? Up by Acheron it gets so cold that when you talk you see the words freeze in the air in front of you!
translation: Bunun soguk oldugunu mu düsünüyorsun? Acheron'da hava o kadar soguk ki, konustugunda sözcüklerin önündeki havada dondugunu görebilirsin!

english: REALLY?
Nah, not really. I was exaggerating for humourous effect. It is very very cold though!
translation: Hayir, aslinda degil. Komik olsun diye abartiyordum. Ama gercekten cok soguk!

english: Hello to you too.
Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!
translation: Yar! Biz korsaniz, yar! Dur, seni pis kara kurdu!

english: Please don't talk like that, it is extremely irritating.
translation: Lütfen böyle konusma, cok sinir bozucu.

english: Also, please don't call me a lychee, whatever that may be.
translation: Ayrica, lütfen bana ne oldugu belli olmayan bir sey olan “lychee” deme.

english: Oh. Okay. Sorry.
ARGH! SOUND THE ALARM! STOWAWAY ON BOARD! STOWAWAY ON BOARD!
translation: ARGH! ALARMI CALIN! GEMIYE KACAK YOLCU VAR! GEMIYE KACAK YOLCU VAR!

english: No! I'm not a stowaway! Honest! I was invited here!
translation: Hayir! Ben kacak yolcu degilim! Gercekten! Buraya davet edildim!

english: Oh, sorry, my mistake then.
You must admit you do look a lot like a stowaway though.
translation: Ama kacak yolcuya cok benzedigini kabul etmelisin.

english: Why, what do they usually look like?
Erm... I've never actually met one...
Okay then...
Hello.
So... You're a pirate, huh?
It's what it says on my pay-packet at the end of the month.
translation: Ay sonunda maas cekimde öyle yaziyor.

english: How's that working out for you?
Pretty good so far. All the grog and loot that we can plunder, plus full medical including dental.
translation: Su ana kadar oldukca iyi. Yagmalayabildigimiz tüm icki ve ganimetler, ayrica dis tedavisi dahil tam saglik sigortasi.

english: You mean you have insurance?
Not as such. If any of us get sick we kidnap a doctor and don't let him go until we're better.
translation: Öyle sayilmaz. Icimizden biri hastalanirsa, bir doktor kaciririz ve iyilesene kadar onu birakmayiz.

english: You'd be surprised what an incentive for expert health care that is.
translation: Bunun uzman saglik hizmeti icin ne kadar tesvik edici oldugunu bilsen sasirirsin.

english: I can imagine.
Hello there. So what brings you aboard the Lady Zay?
translation: Merhaba. Lady Zay'e ne getiriyor seni?

english: Well, I was planning on visiting the Moon Clan, but I have to say your ship is very impressive.
translation: Aslinda Moon Klani'ni ziyaret etmeyi planliyordum, ama geminizin cok etkileyici oldugunu söylemeliyim.

english: Aye, she's a beauty alright! The Lady Zay has been my home for many hard months, through storm and sun, and she always gets us to here we were headed!
translation: Evet, gercekten cok güzel! Lady Zay, firtinalarda ve günesin altinda gecirdigim zorlu aylar boyunca benim evim oldu ve bizi her zaman hedefimize ulastirdi!

english: Yes, she's certainly one of the finest boats I've seen on my travels!
translation: Evet, seyahatlerim sirasinda gördügüm en güzel teknelerden biri!

english: That she is [lad/lass], that she is.
Arrr, matey!
I'm looking for Redbeard Frank.
Redbeard Frank ye say? He be outside. Says he likes the feel of the wind on his cheeks.
translation: Redbeard Frank mi dedin? Disarida. Yanaklarinda rüzgari hissetmeyi sevdigini söylüyor.

english: Thanks.
What are you doing here?
Drinking.
Fair enough.
Have you got any quests I could do?
Nay, but the barkeep hears most of the news around here. Or Redbeard Frank, he's often spoken of buried treasure. Perhaps ye should be asking them for quests.
translation: Hayir, ama barmen buradaki haberlerin cogunu duyar. Ya da Kizil Sakal Frank, o sik sik gömülü hazineden bahseder. Belki de onlara görev sormalisin.

english: Nay, but Redbeard Frank has often spoken of buried treasure. Perhaps ye should be asking him for a quest.
translation: Hayir, ama Kizil Sakal Frank sik sik gömülü hazineden bahseder. Belki de ona görev sormalisin.

english: Nay, but the barkeep hears most of the news around here. Perhaps ye should be asking him for a quest.
translation: Hayir, ama barmen buradaki haberlerin cogunu duyar. Belki de ona görev sormalisin.

english: Nay, I've nothing for ye to do. But I hear there's an old landlubber in Draynor Village who's always a-looking for a lively [lad/lass] to do him a favour.
translation: Hayir, sana verecek bir görevim yok. Ama Draynor Köyü'nde her zaman kendisine yardim edecek neseli bir delikanli ya da kiz arayan yasli bir karaci oldugunu duydum.

english: Yo ho ho!
So are you pirates?
Aye [laddie/lassie], that we are.
Aye, that we be.
Nay, always ye say it wrong! Tis 'we are', not 'we be'.
translation: Hayir, hep yanlis söylüyorsun! “Öyleyiz” degil, “öyleyiz” denir.

english: I be a pirate, not a scurvy schoolmaster!
translation: Ben korsanim, pis bir ögretmen degil!

english: Ye be a fool, and a disgrace to piracy.
translation: Sen bir aptalsin ve korsanliga leke sürüyorsun.

english: Now ye be saying 'be' too!
Arrr! Tis thy fault.
I think I'll leave you two to sort it out.
I'm looking for Redbeard Frank.
What are you doing here?
Have you got any quests I could do?
Have you had enough fun for now?
Let's play a game!
Everyone copy me!
[Player name] is the winner!
Goodbye!
Yes
No
Greetings warrior, how may I help you?
How long have you worked here?
Oh ever since the Guild opened. I like it here.
Why's that?
Well.. what with all these warriors around, there's not much chance of my bank being robbed is there!
translation: Sey... etrafta bu kadar savasci varken, bankamin soyulma ihtimali pek yok, degil mi?

english: Bye!
Invest your time and money wisely.
I'd like to access my bank account, please.
I'd like to check my PIN settings.
I'd like to collect items.
How long have you worked here?
Bye!
Hi!
Well. This beats doing the shopping!
I wouldn't want to be the poor guy that has to clean up after the duels.
translation: Dövüslerden sonra temizlik yapmak zorunda kalan zavalli adam olmak istemezdim.

english: Me neither.
Hi!
What did the skeleton say before it ate?
I don't know?
Bone-appetit.
Ooh. This is exciting!
Yup!
How can you make a very lively hankerchief?
translation: Nasil cok canli bir mendil yapabilirsiniz?

english: Put a little boogey in it.
Why did the skeleton burp?
'Cause it didn't have the guts to fart!
My son just won his first duel!
Congratulations!
He ripped his opponent in half!
That's gotta hurt!
He's only 10 as well!
You gotta start 'em young!
Can't you see I'm watching the duels?
I'm sorry!
Knock knock!
Who's there?
Boo.
Boo who?
Don't cry, it's just me!
Waaaaassssssuuuuupp?!
Hi! I'm here to watch the duels!
Me too!
My favourite fighter is Mubariz!
The guy at the information kiosk?
Yeah! He rocks!
Takes all sorts, I guess.
Hmph.
Did you know they think this place dates back to the second age?!
translation: Bu yerin ikinci caga kadar uzandigini biliyor muydun?

english: Really?
Yeah. The guy at the information kiosk was telling me.
You got beaten up by a troll!
That monster? If it dares to come here again, I will be ready for it, and it shall taste my spear.
translation: O canavar mi? Eger buraya tekrar gelmeye cesaret ederse, ona hazirlikli olacagim ve mizragimin tadina bakacak.

english: You didn't look so tough when the troll knocked you down.
translation: Trol seni yere serdiginde pek de sert görünmüyordun.

english: Bwana, get knotted.
What do you do here?
Why, it should be clear to even the most ignorant of people that I am a fearless jungle hunter...out of my way you sanitised civilian!
translation: En cahil insan bile benim korkusuz bir orman avcisi oldugumu anlayabilir... yolumdan cekil, steril sivil!

english: Is there anything interesting to do around here?
translation: Buralarda ilginc bir sey var mi?

english: Bwana, if anyone else asks me that question today, I'll explode! Go and ask someone else!
translation: Bwana, bugün baska biri bana bu soruyu sorarsa, patlayacagim! Git baskasina sor!

english: Not that I'm aware of, just sit back and enjoy the sunshine bwana!
translation: Bildigim kadariyla yok, arkana yaslan ve günesin tadini cikar bwana!

english: Sorry Bwana, I'm already busy, why not go and talk to Murcaily! He's around the village somewhere.
translation: Üzgünüm Bwana, ben zaten mesgulüm, neden Murcaily ile konusmuyorsun! Köyün buralarinda bir yerde.

english: Well, I think that there's some work to be done...perhaps Murcaily can help you. He usually tends to the hardwood grove to the east of Trufitus's hut.
translation: Sanirim yapilacak bazi isler var... belki Murcaily sana yardimci olabilir. Genelde Trufitus'un kulübesinin dogusundaki sert agac korusunda calisir.

english: It's just village life as normal around here Bwana, always something interesting to find to occupy your time if you look hard enough.
translation: Buralarda köy hayati normal seyrinde devam ediyor Bwana, yeterince dikkatli bakarsan zamanini gecirecek ilginc seyler bulabilirsin.

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
I've already given you some trading sticks and I don't have any more on me at the moment. Why not go and talk to some of the other villagers and get some contributions?
translation: Sana zaten bazi ticaret cubuklari verdim ve su anda üzerimde baska yok. Neden gidip diger köylülerle konusup biraz katki almiyorsun?

english: Ok, thanks.
You got beaten up by a troll!
What do you do here?
Is there anything interesting to do here?
translation: Burada ilginc bir sey var mi?

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
Ok, thanks.
Hi, who are you guarding here?
Can't say, all very secret. You should get out of here. I am not supposed to talk while I guard.
translation: Söyleyemem, hepsi cok gizli. Buradan gitmelisin. Nöbet tutarken konusmamam gerekiyor.

english: Hey, chill out, I won't cause you trouble. I was just wondering what you do to relax.
translation: Hey, sakin ol, sana sorun cikarmayacagim. Sadece nasil rahatladigini merak ediyordum.

english: You never relax with these people, but it's a good career for a young man.
translation: Bu insanlarla asla rahatlayamazsin, ama genc bir adam icin iyi bir kariyer.

english: I had better leave, I don't want trouble.
translation: Gitsem iyi olacak, sorun cikarmak istemiyorum.

english: Thanks, I appreciate that. Talking on duty can be punishable by having your mouth stitched up. These are tough people, no mistake.
translation: Tesekkürler, minnettarim. Görev basindayken konusmak, agzinin dikilmesiyle cezalandirilabilir. Bunlar sert insanlar, hic süphe yok.

english: Hey, chill out, I won't cause you trouble.
translation: Hey, sakin ol, sana sorun cikarmayacagim.

english: I had better leave, I don't want trouble.
translation: Gitsem iyi olacak, sorun cikarmak istemem.

english: Yo Nib, what's going on?
Nibnib? Kl-Rek Nib?
Jal-Nib-Rek nips you.
What'd you do that for?
Heh Nib get you.
What'd you have for dinner?
Nibblings!
Nibblings of what exactly?
Nib.
Oh no! That's horrible.
Can you speak like a human can Nib?
No, I most definitely can not.
Aren't you speaking like a human right now...?
translation: Su anda insan gibi konusmuyor musun...?

english: Jal-Nib-Rek Nib Kl-Jal, Zuk is mum.
Interesting.
Kl-NibNib!
Nib Jal!
What's up Zuk?
Feeling a bit down to be honest.
translation: Dürüst olmak gerekirse, biraz moralim bozuk.

english: Why's that?
Well...
Not so long ago, I was a big fearsome boss, Now I'm just another pet.
translation: Kisa bir süre önce, korkunc bir patrondum, simdi ise siradan bir evcil hayvanim.

english: Indeed, and you're going to follow me everywhere I go.
translation: Aynen öyle, ve sen de benimle her yere geleceksin.

english: Why have you got lava around your feet?
Keeps me cool.
But... lava is hot?
No no, I wasn't referring to the temperature.
Ah...
You're a lot smaller now, I don't even need this shield.
translation: Artik cok daha kücüksün, bu kalkan bile gerekmiyor.

english: Mere mortal, you only survived my challenge because of that convenient pile of rock.
translation: Siradan bir ölümlü, benim meydan okumamdan sadece o elverisli kaya yigini sayesinde kurtuldun.

english: Well, you couldn't even break that pile of rock to get at me!
translation: Ama o kaya yiginini bile kirip bana ulasamadin!...

english: You're a lot smaller now, I don't even need a shield.
translation: Artik cok daha kücüksün, kalkan bile gerekmiyor.

english: That shield won't protect you forever mortal.
translation: O kalkan seni sonsuza kadar koruyamaz, ölümlü.

english: It might actually.
We shall see about that.
Ouch! What the...
He he.
Kal-Zuk!
Zukkkkkk!
Hey, who are you?
I'm James. It's my job to tell you all there is to know about Old School Bonds.
translation: Ben James. Old School Bonds hakkinda bilmeniz gereken her seyi size anlatmak benim isim.

english: An Old School Bond will allow you to buy membership for your account using in game gold pieces.
translation: Old School Bond, oyun ici altin parcalari kullanarak hesabiniz icin üyelik satin almanizi saglar.

english: My sources have also informed me that due to popular demand, they can now be redeemed for a free name change! Handy!
translation: Kaynaklarim, yogun talep üzerine artik ücretsiz isim degisikligi icin kullanilabilecegini de bildirdi! Cok kullanisli!

english: You can get an Old School Bond from other players or from the Grand Exchange.
translation: Old School Bond'u diger oyunculardan veya Grand Exchange'den alabilirsiniz.

english: Simply click the bond and choose the redeem option.
translation: Tahvili tiklayip kullanma secenegini secmeniz yeterlidir.

english: You get 14 days membership from an Old School Bond.
translation: Old School Bond ile 14 günlük üyelik elde edersiniz.

english: At the moment Old School Bonds can only be redeemed for membership and for display name changes.
translation: Su anda Old School Bond'lar sadece üyelik ve ekran adi degisikligi icin kullanilabilir.

english: Click on the ‘buy a bond’ link on the main page and follow the instructions to buy a bond from our website. You can then give the bond to another player or sell it on the Grand Exchange.
translation: Ana sayfadaki “tahvil satin al” baglantisini tiklayin ve talimatlari izleyerek web sitemizden tahvil satin alin. Ardindan tahvili baska bir oyuncuya verebilir veya Grand Exchange'de satabilirsiniz.

english: What is an Old School Bond?
How do I buy an Old School Bond in game?
translation: Oyunda Old School Bond'u nasil satin alabilirim?

english: How do I turn an Old School Bond into membership?
translation: Old School Bond'u üyelige nasil dönüstürebilirim?

english: How much membership do I get from an Old School bond?
translation: Old School Bond'dan ne kadar üyelik alabilirim?

english: Can I use an Old School Bond to pay for anything else?
translation: Old School Bond'u baska bir sey icin ödeme yapmak icin kullanabilir miyim?

english: How do I buy an Old School Bond to give or sell to another player?
translation: Baska bir oyuncuya vermek veya satmak icin Old School Bond'u nasil satin alabilirim?

english: Hello there. Looking to buy some of my wares? I also have a special item in stock that I reckon you'll love!
translation: Merhaba. Ürünlerimden satin almak ister misiniz? Ayrica stokta cok seveceginizi düsündügüm özel bir ürünüm var!

english: Show me what you have.
Certainly!
What's this special item?
Oh it's fantastic! It's an exclusive item just for you! Consider it a thank you for all you've done for our city.
translation: Oh, harika bir sey! Sadece sana özel bir esya! Sehrimiz icin yaptiklarinin karsiligi olarak düsün.

english: Yes.
No.
How is business?
Slow at the moment. Maybe time will make things better. Perhaps you'd like to help by buying something yourself?
translation: Su anda durgun. Belki zamanla düzelir. Belki sen de bir seyler satin alarak yardimci olmak istersin?

english: I'm good, thanks.
Come back soon!
Show me what you have.
What's this special item?
How is business?
I'm good, thanks.
Today is a good day to be a frog!
translation: Bugün kurbaga olmak icin güzel bir gün!

english: It sure is. Now that we have peace, life is at an all time high!
translation: Kesinlikle öyle. Artik baris saglandigina göre, hayat her zamankinden daha güzel!

english: Hi!
What? Can't you see I'm busy?!
Can you heal me?
Sorry, I'm not on duty.
PLEASE DON'T KILL ME!
I was... looking to be healed.
No way, I'm out of here just as soon as I've packed up my stuff!
translation: Olmaz, esyalarimi toplar toplamaz buradan gidiyorum!

english: You look healthy to me!
Okay, this will hurt you more than it will me.
translation: Tamam, bu sana benden daha cok aci verecek.

english: You must see some gruesome things?
It's a gruesome business and with the tools they give me it gets more gruesome before it gets better!
translation: Bu korkunc bir is ve bana verdikleri aletlerle isler düzelmeden önce daha da korkunc hale geliyor!

english: Why do they call you 'The Butcher'?
'The Butcher'?
Ha!
Would you like me to demonstrate?
Er...I'll give it a miss, thanks.
Here! Now I have work to do!
Jaraah has given you another clue scroll!
translation: Jaraah sana baska bir ipucu parsömeni verdi!

english: Can you heal me?
You must see some gruesome things?
Why do they call you 'The Butcher'?
Hello there.
Who are you?
I'm Jardric. Former boatman and now a researcher for Keldagrim. I'm here with the Varrock Museum to explore this island and discover its secrets.
translation: Ben Jardric. Eskiden kayikciydim, simdi ise Keldagrim icin arastirmaciyim. Varrock Müzesi adina bu adayi kesfetmek ve sirlarini ortaya cikarmak icin buradayim.

english: From boatman to researcher? That's quite the change.
translation: Kayikcidan arastirmaciya mi? Büyük bir degisiklik olmus.

english: Aye that it is. I do miss it sometimes, but I get so many opportunities now that I never used to. Just look at us! We may well be the first to step foot on this island in centuries.
translation: Evet, öyle. Bazen özlüyorum ama simdi eskiden hic sahip olmadigim bircok firsatim var. Bize bir bak! Yüzyillardir bu adaya ayak basan ilk insanlar biz olabiliriz.

english: If that isn't exciting, I don't know what is.
translation: Bu heyecan verici degilse, ne heyecan verici olabilir ki?

english: Very true. See you later.
Goodbye for now.
Hello. Wanting to go to Lithkren?
Yes please.
You board the boat and travel to Lithkren.
The player travels to Lithkren.
Not too bad. I've been working with the museum to investigate the dragonkin. After what happened they now consider me an expert.
translation: Fena degil. Müzeyle birlikte ejderhalari arastiriyorum. Olanlardan sonra artik beni bir uzman olarak görüyorlar.

english: Don't worry though. I've still got enough time to look after this boat for you.
translation: Ama merak etme. Bu tekneyi senin icin bakacak kadar vaktim var.

english: No thank you.
Hello. Wanting to go back to Fossil Island?
translation: Merhaba. Fosil Adasi'na geri dönmek ister misin?

english: You board the boat and travel to Fossil Island.
The player travels to Fossil Island.
How are things with you?
I have a question for you.
Yes please.
How are things with you?
No thank you.
Good day, sir.
What are you doing down here?
I'm waiting to work on the digging.
It's the first excavation I've worked on, and I'm looking forward to it.
translation: Bu benim ilk kazi calismam ve cok heyecanliyim.

english: Good day.
What are you doing down here?
Good day.
Hello!
Can I have another amulet?
Jarr gives you another amulet.
translation: Jarr sana bir muska daha verir.

english: Who are you?
I'm Jarr, the taskmaster for the Kharidian Desert Achievement Diary.
translation: Ben Jarr, Kharidian Cölü Basari Günlügü'nün görev sorumlusuyum.

english: What is the Achievement Diary?

It's a diary that helps you keep track of particular achievements. In the Kharidian Desert it can help you discover some quite useful things. Eventually, with enough exploration, the inhabitants will reward you.
translation: Belirli basarilari takip etmenize yardimci olan bir günlüktür. Kharidian Cölü'nde oldukca yararli seyler kesfetmenize yardimci olabilir. Yeterince kesif yaptiktan sonra, bölge sakinleri sizi ödüllendirecektir.

english: You can see the list of tasks on the side-panel.
I have a question about my Achievement diary.
translation: Basari Günlügümle ilgili bir sorum var.

english: Well, there are four different Desert amulets, which match up with the four levels of difficulty. Each has the same rewards as the previous level and some additional benefits too... which tier of rewards would you like to
translation: Dört farkli cöl muskasi var ve bunlar dört farkli zorluk seviyesine karsilik geliyor. Her biri önceki seviyeyle ayni ödüllere ve bazi ek avantajlara sahiptir... Hangi ödül kademesi hakkinda

english: know more about?
Tell me more about the Easy rewards please!
translation: Kolay ödüller hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin lütfen!

english: If you complete all of the easy tasks in the Desert, you can charge a Pharaoh's sceptre with 10 charges, Simon Templeton will purchase artefacts in banknote form and Desert goat horns are dropped as notes.
translation: Cöldeki tüm kolay görevleri tamamlarsaniz, Firavun'un asasini 10 sarjla doldurabilirsiniz, Simon Templeton banknot seklinde eserler satin alir ve Cöl keci boynuzlari notlar olarak düser.

english: Thanks!
Tell me more about the Medium rewards please!
translation: Orta zorluk seviyesindeki ödüller hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin lütfen!

english: In addition to the easy rewards, you can charge a Pharaoh's sceptre with 25 charges and the amulet will teleport you to Nardah once per day.
translation: Kolay ödüllere ek olarak, Firavun'un asasini 25 sarjla doldurabilirsiniz ve muska sizi günde bir kez Nardah'a isinlayacaktir.

english: Tell me more about the Hard rewards please!
translation: Zor ödüller hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin lütfen!

english: In addition to the easy and medium benefits, you can charge a Pharaoh's sceptre with 50 charges, you can adjust your Camulet to teleport you above the temple and the Nardah herbalist will create unfinished potions
translation: Kolay ve orta seviye avantajlara ek olarak, Firavun asasini 50 sarjla doldurabilir, Camulet'inizi tapinagin üzerine isinlanacak sekilde ayarlayabilir ve Nardah bitki uzmani sizin icin bitmemis iksirler

english: for you, as well as cleaning noted herbs for the usual herb cleaning fee.
translation: hazirlayabilir ve normal bitki temizleme ücreti karsiliginda not edilmis bitkileri temizleyebilir.

english: All your rides on a magic carpet are free, and you can climb through the Al Kharid Palace southern window too, if your Agility level's up to it.
translation: Sihirli haliyla yaptiginiz tüm yolculuklar ücretsizdir ve Agility seviyeniz yeterliyse Al Kharid Sarayi'nin güney penceresinden de tirmanabilirsiniz.

english: Tell me more about the Elite rewards please!
translation: Elit ödüller hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin lütfen!

english: In addition to the previous tiers of rewards, you can charge a Pharaoh's sceptre with 100 charges, the amulet will protect you from desert heat at all times, a shortcut opens up in the Kalphite hive and the amulet will
translation: Önceki ödül kademelerine ek olarak, Firavun'un asasini 100 sarjla doldurabilirsiniz, muska sizi her zaman cöl sicagindan koruyacak, Kalphite kovaninda bir kisayol acilacak ve muska sizi

english: teleport you to Nardah and the kalphite hive to the East of the Shantay Pass as much as you desire. You'll also get completely free passage through the Shantay passes here and at the Ruins of Unkah.
translation: istediginiz kadar Nardah'a ve Shantay Gecidi'nin dogusundaki kalphite kovanina isinlayacak. Ayrica, Shantay gecitlerinden ve Unkah Harabeleri'nden tamamen ücretsiz gecis hakki kazanacaksiniz.

english: How do I claim the rewards?
Just complete the tasks in the Desert so they're ticked off, then come and speak to me for your rewards.
translation: Cöldeki görevleri tamamlayip isaretleyin, sonra ödülleriniz icin benimle konusun.

english: Bye!
See you later.
I've completed all of the easy tasks in my Desert Achievement Diary!
translation: Cöl Basari Günlügümdeki tüm kolay görevleri tamamladim!

english: I can see that, well done! You'll be wanting your reward then!
translation: Görüyorum, aferin! O zaman ödülünü almak istersin herhalde!

english: Yes please!

This amulet is a symbol of your exploration of the Kharidian Desert. You can now charge a Pharaoh's sceptre with 10 charges, Simon Templeton will purchase artefacts in banknote form and Desert goat horns are
translation: Bu muska, Kharidian Cölü'nü kesfettiginin sembolüdür. Artik Firavun'un asasini 10 kez sarj edebilirsin, Simon Templeton eserleri banknot seklinde satin alacak ve Cöl keci boynuzlari

english: dropped as notes.
Wow, thanks!
If you ever lose your amulet, come back to me to reclaim it.
translation: Tilsimini kaybedersen, geri almak icin bana gel.

english: I've completed all of the medium tasks in my Desert achievement diary!
translation: Cöl basari günlügümdeki tüm orta zorlukta görevleri tamamladim!

english: I've upgraded your Desert amulet for you. You can now charge a Pharaoh's sceptre with 25 charges and the amulet will teleport you to Nardah once per day.
translation: Cöl tilsimini senin icin yükselttim. Artik Firavun asasini 25 sarjla doldurabilirsin ve tilsim seni günde bir kez Nardah'a isinlayacak.

english: I've completed all of the hard tasks in my Desert achievement diary!
translation: Cöl basari günlügümdeki tüm zor görevleri tamamladim!

english: I've upgraded your Desert amulet for you. You can now charge a Pharaoh's sceptre with 50 charges, you can adjust your Camulet to teleport you above the temple and the Nardah herbalist will create unfinished
translation: Cöl muskayi senin icin yükselttim. Artik Firavun'un asasini 50 sarjla doldurabilirsin, Camulet'ini tapinagin üzerine isinlanacak sekilde ayarlayabilirsin ve Nardah sifali bitki uzmani senin icin bitmemis

english: potions for you.
All rides on a magic carpet are now free, and you can climb through the Al Kharid Palace southern window too, if your Agility level's up to it.
translation: Sihirli hali ile tüm yolculuklar artik ücretsiz ve Agility seviyen yeterliyse Al Kharid Sarayi'nin güney penceresinden de tirmanabilirsin.

english: Can I have another amulet?
Who are you?
I have a question about my Achievement Diary
translation: Basari Günlügümle ilgili bir sorum var.

english: What is the Achievement Diary?
What are the rewards?
Easy Rewards.
Medium Rewards.
Hard Rewards.
Elite Rewards.
How do I claim the rewards?
Bye!
I've completed all of the elite tasks in my Desert achievement diary!
translation: Çöl basari günlügümdeki tüm elit görevleri tamamladim!

english: You need at least two inventory spaces, make some space and come back.
translation: En az iki envanter alani gerekir, biraz yer aç ve geri gel.

english: I've upgraded your Desert amulet for you. You can now charge a Pharaoh's sceptre with 100 charges, the amulet will protect you from desert heat at all times, a shortcut has been opened in the Kalphite hive and the
translation: Çöl muskayi senin için yükselttim. Artik Firavun'un asasini 100 sarjla doldurabilirsin, muska seni her zaman çöl sicagindan koruyacak, Kalphite kovaninda bir kisayol açildi ve

english: amulet will teleport you to Nardah and the kalphite hive to the East of the Shantay Pass as much as you desire. I've also negotiated completely free passage through the Shantay passes here and at the Ruins of
translation: muska seni istedigin kadar Nardah'a ve Shantay Geçidi'nin dogusundaki Kalphite kovanina isinlayacak. Ayrica Shantay geçitlerinden ve Unkah Harabeleri'nden tamamen ücretsiz geçis için anlasma yaptim.

english: Unkah.
What do you want from me outerlander? It is our policy not to associate with those not of our tribe.
translation: Benden ne istiyorsun yabanci? Kabilemizden olmayanlarla iliski kurmamak bizim politikamizdir.

english: Where is your chieftain? I find it highly discriminatory to refuse to talk to someone on the grounds that they are not part of your tribe.
translation: Sefin nerede? Kabileye ait olmadiklari icin biriyle konusmayi reddetmek bana cok ayrimci geliyor.

english: I don't rightly understand your speech outerlander, but my loyalty is with Chieftain Brundt.
translation: Konusmani tam olarak anlamiyorum yabanci, ama benim sadakatim Sef Brundt'a.

english: He resides in our longhall; it is the large building over there, you should speak to him for he speaks for us all.
translation: O uzun salonumuzda oturuyor; suradaki büyük bina, onunla konusmalisin cünkü o hepimizi temsil ediyor.

english: So what are you doing here?
This should not concern you, outerlander. I am awaiting other Fremenniks to join me on an expedition to Waterbirth Island.
translation: Bu seni ilgilendirmez yabanci. Diger Fremenniklerin Waterbirth Adasi'na yapacagim kesif gezisine katilmasini bekliyorum.

english: It is a small crescent-shaped island just north-west of here, outerlander.
translation: Burasi, buradan kuzeybatida bulunan kücük, hilal seklinde bir ada, yabanci.

english: We have many legends about it, such as the tale of the broken sky, and the day of the green seas.
translation: Bu ada hakkinda, kirik gökyüzü efsanesi ve yesil denizlerin günü gibi bircok efsane var.

english: The reason I am travelling there is more serious Fremennik business, however. I doubt an outerlander would be interested.
translation: Ancak oraya gitmemin nedeni daha ciddi bir Fremennik meselesi. Bir yabancinin ilgisini cekecegini sanmiyorum.

english: Can I come?
An outerlander join us on an honoured hunt???
translation: Bir yabanci, onurlu avimiza katilacak mi?

english: Well.... I guess... I might be able to allow you to join us, although it is a breach of many of our customs...
translation: Sey... Sanirim... Bircok gelenegimizi ihlal etse de, katilmana izin verebilirim...

english: Oh, pleeeeease? I really LOVE killing stuff!
translation: Lütfen? Canlilari öldürmeyi gercekten cok seviyorum!

english: Well... I remain unconvinced that it would be wise to allow an outerlander to join us in such dangerous battle, but your enthusiasm seems genuine enough...
translation: Sey... Bir yabancinin bu kadar tehlikeli bir savasa katilmasinin akillica olacagina hala ikna olmadim, ama hevesin yeterince samimi görünüyor...

english: I will allow you to escort us, but you must pay me a sum of money first.
translation: Bize eslik etmene izin verecegim, ama önce bana bir miktar para ödemelisin.

english: What? That's outrageous, why charge me money? And, uh, how much does it cost me?
translation: Ne? Bu cok sacma, neden benden para istiyorsun? Peki, ne kadar tutacak?

english: Ah, the outerlanders have stolen from my people for many years, in this way you can help my community with a small amount of money...
translation: Ah, yabancilar yillardir halkimdan calmaktadir, bu sekilde kücük bir miktar parayla topluluguma yardim edebilirsin...

english: Let us say... 1,000 coins. Payable in advance, of course.
translation: Diyelim ki... 1.000 sikke. Tabii ki pesin olarak ödenecek.

english: For this I will take you to Waterbirth Island on my boat, and will bring you back here when you have had your fill of the hunt. Assuming you are still alive to wish to leave, of course.
translation: Bunun karsiliginda seni teknemle Waterbirth Adasi'na götürecegim ve avdan doyduktan sonra seni buraya geri getirecegim. Tabii ki, hala hayatta olup gitmek istersen.

english: So do you have the 1,000 coins for my service, and are you ready to leave now?
translation: Peki, hizmetim icin 1.000 sikken var mi ve simdi gitmeye hazir misin?

english: The player sets sail for Waterbirth Island
translation: Oyuncu Waterbirth Adasi'na dogru yelken acar

english: I suggest you head to the cave with some urgency outerlander, the cold air out here might be too much for the likes of you…
translation: Aceleyle magaraya gitsen iyi olur yabanci, buradaki soguk hava senin gibiler icin fazla agir gelebilir...

english: No, actually I have some stuff to do here first.
translation: Hayir, aslinda önce burada yapmam gereken bazi isler var.

english: As you wish. Come and see me when your bloodlust needs sating.
translation: Nasil istersen. Kan dökme arzun tatmin oldugunda gel beni gör.

english: Hey, I have to say, that's a fine looking hat you are wearing there.
translation: Hey, sunu söylemeliyim ki, taktigin sapka cok güzel görünüyor.

english: It is actually a helm, outerlander, but the sentiment is appreciated nonetheless.
translation: Aslinda bu bir migfer, yabanci, ama yine de iltifatin icin tesekkürler.

english: Wow, you Fremenniks sure know how to party. Well, see ya around.
translation: Vay canina, siz Fremennikler parti yapmayi iyi biliyorsunuz. Peki, görüsürüz.

english: Actually, I don't think I have anything to speak to you about…
translation: Aslinda, seninle konusacak bir seyim yok...

english: Ah, you live yet, outerlander!
Have you had your fill of the hunt and wish to return, or are you still feeling the joy of the cull?
translation: Avlanmaktan sikildin ve geri dönmek mi istiyorsun, yoksa hala avlanmanin keyfini mi cikariyorsun?

english: I wish to return to Rellekka.
Then let us away; There will be death to bring here another day!
translation: O zaman gidelim; baska bir gün buraya ölüm getirecegiz!

english: The player is sailed back to Rellekka
I want to stay here.
Ha Ha Ha! A true huntsman at heart!
translation: Ha ha ha! Gercek bir avci!

english: I myself have killed over a hundred of the dagger- mouths, and did not think it too many!
translation: Ben kendim yüzün üzerinde hancer agizli öldürdüm ve cok fazla oldugunu düsünmedim!

english: Hi, I don't suppose you are a member of the council of elders are you?
translation: Merhaba, sen yaslilar konseyinin bir üyesi degilsin, degil mi?

english: No, outerlander, I have never had the honour to be asked.
translation: Hayir, yabanci, bana bu onur hic sunulmadi.

english: I am but a lowly warrior, fighting for my people wherever threats may appear against us...
translation: Ben sadece halkim icin, bize karsi tehdit olusturan her yerde savasan mütevazi bir savasciyim...

english: So what do you want from me, outerlander?
(same as above)
Greetings, [Fremennik name]!
Ah, and what a glorious name that is! Worthy of only the finest warriors!
translation: Ah, ne muhtesem bir isim! Sadece en iyi savascilara layik!

english: Heh. Yup, you're right there.
So what brings you back to fair Rellekka? It has been too long since you have drunk in the longhall with us and sang of your battles!
translation: Seni güzel Rellekka'ya geri getiren nedir? Uzun zamandir bizimle uzun salonda icki icip savaslarini anlatmadin!

english: You have not heard, [Fremennik name]? I am leading an expedition to Waterbirth Island!
translation: Duymadin mi, Dokrak? Waterbirth Adasi'na bir kesif gezisi düzenliyorum!

english: You have not ever travelled to Waterbirth Island, [Fremennik name]? I am surprised, it is a place of outstanding natural beauty.
translation: Waterbirth Adasi'na hic gitmedin mi, Dokrak? Sasirdim, burasi olaganüstü dogal güzellige sahip bir yer.

english: Or at least it used to be! But things have now changed...
translation: En azindan eskiden öyleydi! Ama simdi isler degisti...

english: Changed? How do you mean, changed?
It seems as though the sea-beasts known to us as the dagger-mouths have begun their hatching once again... And there may be others of their ilk there too.
translation: Görünüse göre, bizim bildigimiz adiyla hancer agizli deniz canavarlari yeniden yumurtadan cikmaya basladi... Ve orada onlarin türünden baskalari da olabilir.

english: Dagger-mouths?
Aye, the dagger-mouths! The vile creatures lived near here once, but we had thought them all driven back to the ocean depths many moons past.
translation: Evet, hancer agizlilar! Bu igrenc yaratiklar bir zamanlar buraya yakin bir yerde yasiyordu, ama uzun zaman önce hepsinin okyanusun derinliklerine geri sürüldügünü saniyorduk.

english: I can only imagine a dagger-mouth queen has nested somewhere nearby, and spawned her foul brood under the sea once more, and some of them have migrated to fair Waterbirth Island.
translation: Hancer agizlilarin kralicesinin yakinlarda bir yerde yuva kurdugunu ve bir kez daha deniz altinda igrenc yavrularini dogurdugunu ve bazilarinin güzel Waterbirth Adasi'na göc ettigini tahmin edebiliyorum.

english: So you're scared they might attack Rellekka?
Scared? Ha ha ha!
You wound us with your questioning, [Fremennik name]!
We are glad the dagger-mouths have returned to these shores, for it means we will get the chance to hunt them once again as our ancestors did!
translation: Hancer agizlilarin bu kiyilara geri dönmesine seviniyoruz, cünkü bu, atalarimizin yaptigi gibi onlari bir kez daha avlama sansimiz olacagi anlamina geliyor!

english: When treated in the correct manner, the creatures' remains can be used to make fine battleworthy armour!
translation: Dogru sekilde islendiginde, bu yaratiklarin kalintilari savasa uygun kaliteli zirh yapmak icin kullanilabilir!

english: Of course, [Fremennik name]! Your presence is more than welcome on this cull! You wish to leave now?
translation: Elbette, Dokrak! Bu avda senin varligin cok hos karsilanir! Simdi gitmek mi istiyorsun?

english: Player is transported to Waterbirth Island
Aye, that it is [Fremennik name]! Skulgrimen fashioned it for me from the carcass of one of the monsters on Waterbirth Island after our last hunt!
translation: Evet, öyle Dokrak! Skulgrimen, son avimizdan sonra Waterbirth Adasi'ndaki canavarlardan birinin lesinden bunu benim icin yapti!

english: I hope to kill enough creatures to fashion some fine armour as well when next we leave!
translation: Bir dahaki sefere ayrildigimizda da güzel zirhlar yapmak icin yeterince yaratik öldürmeyi umuyorum!

english: I picked up this, I was wondering if you could tell me about it...
translation: Bunu aldim, bana bunun hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin diye merak ediyordum...

english: Ah yes... The dagger-mouths' skin makes a good basis for many types of armour!
translation: Ah evet... Hancer agizlilarin derisi bircok zirh türü icin iyi bir temel olusturur!

english: Skulgrimen has made many sturdy helms from shells like that!
translation: Skulgrimen bu tür kabuklardan bircok saglam migfer yapti!

english: Skulgrimen once made a fine set of body armour from that kind of shell!
translation: Skulgrimen bir keresinde bu tür kabuklardan güzel bir vücut zirhi seti yapti!

english: Aha! That could be made into some fine leg armour by Skulgrimen, I'll wager!
translation: Aha! Skulgrimen bununla güzel bir bacak zirhi yapabilir, eminim!

english: Hmmmm... I believe Peer could make a fine seers helm with that...
translation: Hmmmm... Peer bununla güzel bir kahin migferi yapabilir...

english: Many moons past, Peer had some fine bodyarmour made from just such bones.
translation: Uzun zaman önce, Peer bu tür kemiklerden güzel bir vücut zirhi yapmisti.

english: Peer could use that to make some mighty robes, I'll wager.
translation: Peer bununla güclü cüppeler yapabilir, eminim.

english: Sigli might be able to make you some sturdy headgear with that!
translation: Sigli bununla sana saglam bir baslik yapabilir!

english: That could make a fine piece of hunting armour, if I know Sigli like I think I do.
translation: Sigli'yi tanidigim kadariyla, bununla güzel bir av zirhi yapilabilir.

english: I'll wager Sigli can make that into some hunting legs for you.
translation: Sigli bununla sana avci bacak zirhi yapabilir, bahse girerim.

english: Ah, it is always a pleasure [Fremennik name]! Now did you want something more from me?
translation: Ah, her zaman bir zevk Dokrak! Baska bir sey ister miydin?

english: Actually, I don't think I have anything to speak to you about...
translation: Aslinda, seninle konusacak bir seyim yok...

english: Ah, [Fremennik name]! Such glorious battle makes you feel glad of life, does it not?
translation: Ah, Dokrak! Böylesine görkemli bir savas, hayatin tadini cikarmayi sagliyor, degil mi?

english: So what say you, stay here for the hunt, or return home to sweet Rellekka to feast and drink with your tribe?
translation: Ee, ne dersin, av icin burada kalacak misin, yoksa tatli Rellekka'ya dönüp kabilenle birlikte ziyafet cekip icki icecek misin?

english: Player is transported to Rellekka
Thank you, but I have no need for that!
Where is your chieftain?
What Jarvald is doing.
Waterbirth Island?
Can I come?
YES
NO
Nice hat!
Ok, 'bye.
Nothing
I wish to return to Rellekka.
I want to stay here.
The animal parts you have collected
Hello, how can I help you?
You can't; I'm beyond help.
translation: Yardimci olamazsin, ben yardima muhtac degilim.

english: I'm okay, thank you.
What are you selling?
You can't; I'm beyond help.
translation: Yardimci olamazsin, ben yardima muhtac degilim.

english: I'm okay, thank you.
Hello there.
Nilsal.
Can you heal me? I'm injured.
Of course.
The teoki whispers a prayer and you suddenly feel a bit better.
translation: Teoki bir dua fisildar ve sen aniden biraz daha iyi hissedersin.

english: What?
The egg that was living at the top of the temple!
Yes, I noticed the tourist had an egg with him... I didn't realise it had a name...
translation: Evet, turistin yaninda bir yumurta oldugunu fark ettim... Bir adi oldugunu bilmiyordum...

english: We need to do something!
Well... it's an egg, iknami. If it's broken, then there isn't much you can do about that.
translation: Sey... o bir yumurta, iknami. Eger kirilmissa, yapabilecegin pek bir sey yok.

english: I'm not giving up without at least trying first.
I see... Well, I don't think I can help you, iknami, but good luck.
translation: Anliyorum... Sanirim sana yardim edemem, iknami, ama iyi sanslar.

english: What are you doing out here?
I am Jatziri, one of the seven teoki in service to Ralos. Along with my counterpart from the Sect of Ranul, I am responsible for the temple of Tal Teok.
translation: Ben Jatziri, Ralos'a hizmet eden yedi teoki'den biriyim. Ranul Tarikati'ndan meslektasimla birlikte Tal Teok tapinagindan sorumluyum.

english: Where is your counterpart?
Tecuani was unfortunately misled by the traitor Metzli. He joined with her cult along with a few other members of the Sect of Ranul.
translation: Tecuani maalesef hain Metzli tarafindan yaniltildi. Ranul Tarikati'nin birkaç üyesiyle birlikte onun tarikatina katildi.

english: I'm sorry to hear that.
Don't be. He is no servant of Ranul. He will die the death of a traitor. Once that happens, a more fitting replacement will be chosen.
translation: Üzülme. O Ranul'un hizmetkari degil. Bir hain olarak ölecek. Bu gerçeklestiginde, daha uygun bir yedek seçilecek.

english: So for now you're here alone? Does that make the work harder?
translation: Yani su anda burada yalniz misin? Bu isini zorlastiriyor mu?

english: Tal Teok is thankfully one of the easier holy sites to look after. That said, there was a small issue recently when some tourist decided to move in and make it their home.
translation: Tal Teok, neyse ki bakimi kolay kutsal yerlerden biri. Bununla birlikte, son zamanlarda bazi turistler buraya tasinmaya ve burayi evleri haline getirmeye karar verdiklerinde küçük bir sorun yasandi.

english: I'll need to handle that at some point, but they don't seem to be causing much trouble, so it is thankfully not a pressing concern.
translation: Bir ara bu konuyla ilgilenmem gerekecek, ama çok fazla sorun çikarmiyorlar, bu yüzden sükürler olsun ki acil bir sorun degil.

english: However, the problem resolved itself in an unexpected way when he sadly fell from atop the temple steps. It seems it was a freak accident.
translation: Ancak, sorun beklenmedik bir sekilde çözüldü, çünkü adam ne yazik ki tapinagin merdivenlerinden düstü. Görünüse göre tuhaf bir kazaydi.

english: Yes, I was actually there to witness it myself. It was horrible.
translation: Evet, ben de orada olup olayi kendim gördüm. Korkunçtu.

english: Let us hope he can at least now find peace with Ranul.
translation: Umalim da en azindan simdi Ranul'un yaninda huzur bulsun.

english: Tal Teok is thankfully one of the easier holy sites to look after. However, there is a small issue at the moment in that some tourist has decided to move in and make it their home.
translation: Tal Teok, neyse ki bakimi kolay kutsal yerlerden biri. Ancak su anda bazi turistlerin buraya tasinip evleri haline getirmeye karar vermeleri nedeniyle küçük bir sorun var.

english: Yes, along with his egg, [egg name], but there's a bit of a problem! [Egg name]'s broken!
I'd better be off.
Timoiva, and may the sun light your way.
Can you heal me? I'm injured.
[Egg name] fell off a wall!
What are you doing out here?
I'd better be off.
Hello there. What are you doing here?
I'm waiting here hoping that someone can guide me to the Paterdomus, the temple on the Salve.
translation: Biri beni Salve'deki Paterdomus tapinagina götürür umuduyla burada bekliyorum.

english: Where is Paterdomus?
Oh, Paterdomus is that rather impressive looking temple on the Salve... I'm sure you must have passed it on your way into Morytania.
translation: Paterdomus, Salve'deki oldukca etkileyici görünümlü tapinak... Morytania'ya giderken oradan gecmis olmalisin.

english: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
I'm hoping to get back to civilisation and see what the lands of Misthalin look like.
translation: Medeniyete geri dönüp Misthalin topraklarinin nasil bir yer oldugunu görmek istiyorum.

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Paterdomus?
translation: Paterdomus'a giderken yol üzerinde düsmanlarla karsilasirsak kendini savunabilir misin?

english: I can defend myself somewhat if we run into trouble...yes, but let's hope that we don't, eh!
translation: Basimiz belaya girerse kendimi bir sekilde savunabilirim... evet, ama umalim da basimiza bela gelmesin, degil mi?

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: Hmmm, görünüse göre bir takipcin var. Kendi basina dolasirsa bu yolculukta kaybolabilir. Takipcin güvende oldugunda yola cikalim.

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: Gercekten mi? Bu harika olur! Hedefe vardigimizda sana kücük bir ödül verecegim.

english: Temple Trekking begins
Ok, which route should we take?
Ok, thanks.
Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: Ah, bana biraz erzak vermek istiyorsun, ha? Sirt cantami acayim.

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than staying in Burgh de Rott.
translation: Oh, bu yolculuktan nefret ediyorum, ama Burgh de Rott'ta kalmaktan iyidir.

english: It's scary here...let's get going!
When are we going to get to Paterdomus?
We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on.
translation: Bütün gün burada durup sohbet edemeyiz, hadi devam edelim.

english: Do you visit Paterdomus often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: Paterdomus'a sik sik gider misin? Rotayi iyi biliyorsun gibi görünüyor.

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...?
Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Burgh de Rott. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: Hay aksi! Burgh de Rott'a geri dönmek zorunda kalacagiz galiba. O köprüyü gecemeyiz!

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
Player completes the bridge event
Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Burgh de Rott.
translation: Bu is bitti... Görünüse göre bu batakliktan gecemeyecegiz. Burgh de Rott'a geri dönmek zorundayiz.

english: Player completes the bog event
Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: Hey... bu harika... harika bir is cikardin... Seni takip edecegim.

english: Whahay...that was great!
But we really should be heading off now.
Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
Player completes the river event
That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: Bu harika! Ben de aynisini yapmaliyim.

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: Whahay! Bu harikaydi! Ama artik gercekten yola cikmaliyiz.

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
This is scary!
Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
Ahhh, two tentacles!
...three tentacles!
I think I'm going to faint!
Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: Vay canina! Su canavara bak! O seyi kendi basina halletmen gerekecek!

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the temple. Here's your reward.
translation: Beni tapinaga güvenle ulastirdigin icin cok tesekkürler. Iste ödülün.

english: Jayene Kliyn gives you a reward token!
translation: Jayene Kliyn sana bir ödül jetonu veriyor!

english: Where is Paterdomus?
Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
I can take you to Paterdomus.
Ok, thanks.
Hello there.
I understand you can take me to the Fishing Platform.
Yes, we can do that.
Will you take me please?
Board the boat and we shall depart.
You arrive at the fishing platform.
Hey, Jeb.
Business here is complete. Do you wish to return to the dry land?
translation: Buradaki isimiz bitti. Karaya dönmek ister misin?

english: No, I'm going to stay a while.
Then stay if that is your wish.
Okay, let's go back.
Then board the rowing boat.
Player is transported to Witchaven.
The boat arrives at Witchaven.
No, I'm going to stay a while.
Okay, let's go back.
Hi!
Ooh. This is exciting!
Yup!
I wouldn't want to be the poor guy that has to clean up after the duels.
translation: Dövüslerden sonra temizlik yapmak zorunda kalan zavalli adam olmak istemezdim.

english: Me neither.
My son just won his first duel!
Congratulations!
He ripped his opponent in half!
That's gotta hurt!
He's only 10 as well!
You gotta start 'em young!
Hmph.
My favourite fighter is Mubariz!
The guy at the information kiosk?
Yeah! He rocks!
Takes all sorts, I guess.
Hi! I'm here to watch the duels!
Me too!
Did you know they think this place dates back to the second age?!
translation: Bu yerin ikinci caga kadar uzandigini biliyor muydun?

english: Really?
Yeah. The guy at the information kiosk was telling me.
Can't you see I'm watching the duels?
I'm sorry!
Well. This beats doing the shopping!
Hi!
Knock knock!
Who's there?
Boo.
Boo who?
Don't cry, it's just me!
Why did the skeleton burp?
I don't know?
'Cause it didn't have the guts to fart!
Waaaaassssssuuuuupp?!.
Tell me, is the guard still watching us?
translation: Söylesene, güvenlik görevlisi hala bizi izliyor mu?

english: Why would you care if there's a guard watching you?
translation: Güvenlik görevlisi seni izliyor olsa ne olur ki?

english: Oh, forget it.
Thanks so much for saving us from those stinky gublinch. They were awful! I hope Shanty gave you somefing cool for your efforts.
translation: Bizi o kokusmus gublinclerden kurtardigin icin cok tesekkürler. Cok korkunclardi! Umarim Shanty cabalarin icin sana güzel bir sey vermistir.

english: Please excuse me, I'm rather busy.
Hey, I'm your contractor from Mahogany Homes, what did you want done?
translation: Merhaba, ben Mahogany Homes'tan müteahhitinizim, ne yaptirmak istiyorsunuz?

I'd like a Wooden bookcase built.

Thank you so much! Would you like a cup of tea before you go?
translation: Cok tesekkür ederim! Gitmeden önce bir fincan cay ister misiniz?

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks, I better be off.
Aaah, nothing like a nice cupppa tea!
translation: Aaah, güzel bir fincan cay gibisi yok!

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks.
