Welcome to Jelly's Kurask cave.
Who are you?
I am Jelly.
When Jelly was just a baby troll, parents left him in Slayer cave... But Jelly is strong, Jelly learn to survive in the cave, and one day Jelly will become great Slayer master!
translation: Jelly henüz bir bebek troldeyken, ailesi onu Slayer magarasina birakti... Ama Jelly güclüdür, Jelly magarada hayatta kalmayi ögrendi ve bir gün Jelly büyük bir Slayer ustasi olacak!

english: Why is this area private?

When the Kurasks finded new treasures, many humans come to the Slayer cave to hunt them... No Kurasks left for Jelly to train on, so Jelly makes a private area just for training. These be Jelly's very own Kurask!
translation: Kurasks yeni hazineler buldugunda, bircok insan onlari avlamak icin Slayer magarasina geliyor... Jelly'nin egitimi icin Kurask kalmadi, bu yüzden Jelly sadece egitim icin özel bir alan olusturdu. Bunlar Jelly'nin kendi Kurask'lari!

english: Not just any human gets to train up here, you has to be on a Kurask Slayer task.
translation: Her insan burada egitim alamaz, Kurask Slayer görevinde olmalisin.

english: What kind of a name is Jelly?
Jelly grew up in this cave, there not much choice around for a hungry troll...
translation: Jelly bu magarada büyüdü, ac bir trol icin fazla secenek yoktu...

english: Thanks, goodbye.
Naughty human! You not hunting the Kurask! Jelly's Kurasks only for people on Slayer tasks.
translation: Yaramaz insan! Kurask avlayamazsin! Jelly'nin Kurask'lari sadece Slayer görevinde olanlar icindir.

english: Who are you?
Why is this area private?
What kind of a name is Jelly?
Thanks, goodbye.
I cannot speak to you outerlander! Talk to Brundt, the Chieftain!
translation: Seninle konusamam yabanci! Sef Brundt ile konus!

english: You stay away from me outerlander!
They are too suspicious of you for you to get close enough to steal from them.
translation: Senden cok süpheleniyorlar, onlara yaklasip hirsizlik yapamazsin.

english: Hello, are you a member of the council?
I am afraid not outerlander. Goodbye.
translation: Korkarim ki degilim yabanci. Hosca kal.

english: Hello.
Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: Merhaba kardesim Dokrak. Bugün benden ne istiyorsun? Her zaman yardimima güvenebilirsin!

english: Nothing thanks. I just fancied a chat.
translation: Hicbir sey, tesekkürler. Sadece sohbet etmek istedim.

english: My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
translation: Yardimima ihtiyacin olursa kapim her zaman acik Dokrak.

english: [Fremennik name]... It has been too long since last we met!
translation: Dokrak... Son görüsmemizden bu yana cok zaman gecti!

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: Hos geldin kardes Dokrak. Seni burada görmek her zaman bir zevk!

english: My apologies [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: Özür dilerim kardes Dokrak! Burada seninle vakit gecirecek vaktim yok!

english: That's okay, I didn't really want anything.
translation: Önemli degil, aslinda bir sey istememistim.

english: How are you [Fremennik name]? I hope all fares well with you this day!
translation: Nasilsin Dokrak? Umarim bugün her sey yolundadir!

english: I'm fine, thanks, how are you?
All is well with me also!
Hello to you, too!
Hello. Did you want something [Fremennik name]?
translation: Merhaba. Bir sey mi istiyordun Dokrak?

english: No, not really.
Well... okay then!
Always good to see you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].
translation: Seni görmek her zaman güzel kardesim Dokrak.

english: You shame us, [Fremennik name]!
How can you steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
You have betrayed your heritage, [Fremennik name]!
Why would you try to steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
Huh.
What?
You don't understand.
Understand what?
Nobody understands.
What don't we understand?
Oh, it doesn't matter. You don't understand. Go away.
translation: Oh, önemli degil. Anlamiyorsun. Git buradan.

english: Do you know what happened to Josef?
He didn't understand!
No, I don't suppose he did.
Do you have the demonic sigil mould?
Huh. So that's all you want. Here it is.
translation: Huh. Demek tek istedigin bu. Al bakalim.

english: Thanks!
What?
Understand what?
What don't we understand?
Do you have the demonic sigil mould?
Do you know what happened to Josef?
What're yer looking for, me luv'?
Let's trade.
Well me luv', I've got some special rations for the soldiers in the fields ou'there; courtesy of the mainland Void Knights. Take a looksie.
translation: Canim, orada savasan askerler icin özel erzaklarim var; anakara Void Knights'in hediyesi. Bir bak.

english: I don't need anything right now.
translation: Su anda bir seye ihtiyacim yok.

english: Let's trade.
I don't need anything right now.
translation: Su anda bir seye ihtiyacim yok.

english: Hello.
So how's life as a pirate?
What kind of question is that? How's life as a... I dunno. Whatever it is that you do for a living.
translation: Bu ne bicim bir soru? Hayatin nasil... Bilmiyorum. Ne is yapiyorsan o.

english: I'm a freelance troubleshooter.
What does that entail then?
Mostly killing things for money and delivering items around the planet for people.
translation: Cogunlukla para karsiliginda bir seyler öldürmek ve insanlara gezegenin dört bir yanina esya teslim etmek.

english: I collect stuff.
So how's that life?
Can't complain, can't complain...
Well, there you go.
Aren't you a little short for a pirate?
translation: Korsan icin biraz kisa degil misin?

english: My mother was a gnome. Apparently it was a very painful birth.
translation: Annem bir cüceydi. Anlasilan cok aci verici bir dogum olmus.

english: More info than I wanted, thanks!
Sorry, can't stop, the Captain will have my guts for garters if he catches me slacking off talking to the stowaway.
translation: Üzgünüm, duramam, kaptan beni kacak yolcuyla konusurken yakalarsa bagirsaklarimi cikarir.

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard!
translation: Ben kacak yolcu degilim! Gemiye davet edildim!

english: Yeah, whatever [guy/lady], it doesn't really matter who you are I'll get in trouble!
translation: Evet, neyse , kim oldugun önemli degil, basim belaya girecek!

english: You know, I've always wondered what life as a pirate actually entails.
translation: Biliyor musun, korsan olmanin hayati nasil bir sey oldugunu hep merak etmisimdir.

english: Well, at the moment it mostly involves being asked random questions by a stowaway.
translation: Su anda cogunlukla kacak yolcunun rastgele sordugu sorularla geciyor.

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard! By Lokar! Ask him!
translation: Ben kacak yolcu degilim! Gemiye davet edildim! Lokar tarafindan! Ona sor!

english: Hey, whatever [love/pal]. Just make sure the captain doesn't catch you, pirates don't like stowaways much.
translation: Hey, neyse . Kaptan seni yakalamasin, korsanlar kacak yolculari pek sevmezler.

english: Ah, good day to you [milady/sirrah]! Your face is unfamiliar, did you perhaps join us aboard the ship at Lunar Isle?
translation: Ah, iyi günler ! Yüzünüz tanidik gelmiyor, Lunar Isle'da gemiye mi bindiniz?

english: No, Lokar offered me a lift in Rellekka actually.
translation: Hayir, Lokar aslinda Rellekka'da beni gemiye davet etti.

english: Oh, really? You don't look like a Fremennik to me!
translation: Oh, gercekten mi? Bana Fremennik gibi gelmedin!

english: Well... I kind of am, and I kind of aren't. It's a long story.
translation: Sey... Bir bakima öyleyim, bir bakima degilim. Uzun hikaye.

english: Sorry I don't have time to hear it then! See you around young fremennik-who-is-not-really-a-fremennik!
translation: Üzgünüm, dinleyecek vaktim yok! Görüsürüz genc Fremennik-ama-aslinda-Fremennik-olmayan!

english: 'Bye.
Brrrr! Its cold up here!
You think this is cold? Up by Acheron it gets so cold that when you talk you see the words freeze in the air in front of you!
translation: Sence burasi mi soguk? Acheron'da hava o kadar soguk ki, konustugunda sözcüklerin havada dondugunu görebiliyorsun!

english: REALLY?
Nah, not really. I was exaggerating for humourous effect. It is very very cold though!
translation: Hayir, aslinda degil. Komik olsun diye abarttim. Ama gercekten cok soguk!

english: Hello to you too.
Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!
translation: Yar! Biz korsaniz, yar! Dur, seni pis kara kurdu!

english: Please don't talk like that, it is extremely irritating.
translation: Lütfen böyle konusma, cok sinir bozucu.

english: Also, please don't call me a lychee, whatever that may be.
translation: Ayrica, lütfen bana lychee deme, o ne demekse.

english: Oh. Okay. Sorry.
ARGH! SOUND THE ALARM! STOWAWAY ON BOARD! STOWAWAY ON BOARD!
translation: ARGH! ALARMI CALIN! GEMIDE KACAK YOLCU VAR! GEMIDE KACAK YOLCU VAR!

english: No! I'm not a stowaway! Honest! I was invited here!
translation: Hayir! Ben kacak yolcu degilim! Gercekten! Buraya davet edildim!

english: Oh, sorry, my mistake then.
You must admit you do look a lot like a stowaway though.
translation: Ama kacak yolcuya cok benzedigini kabul etmelisin.

english: Why, what do they usually look like?
Erm... I've never actually met one...
Okay then...
Hello.
So... You're a pirate, huh?
It's what it says on my pay-packet at the end of the month.
translation: Ay sonunda maas cekimde öyle yaziyor.

english: How's that working out for you?
Pretty good so far. All the grog and loot that we can plunder, plus full medical including dental.
translation: Su ana kadar oldukca iyi. Yagmalayabildigimiz tüm icki ve ganimetler, ayrica dis tedavisi dahil tam saglik sigortasi.

english: You mean you have insurance?
Not as such. If any of us get sick we kidnap a doctor and don't let him go until we're better.
translation: Öyle sayilmaz. Icimizden biri hastalanirsa bir doktor kaciririz ve iyilesene kadar onu birakmayiz.

english: You'd be surprised what an incentive for expert health care that is.
translation: Bunun uzman saglik hizmeti icin ne kadar tesvik edici oldugunu bilsen sasirirsin.

english: I can imagine.
Hello there. So what brings you aboard the Lady Zay?
translation: Merhaba. Lady Zay'e ne getiriyor seni?

english: Well, I was planning on visiting the Moon Clan, but I have to say your ship is very impressive.
translation: Ay Klani'ni ziyaret etmeyi planliyordum, ama geminizin cok etkileyici oldugunu söylemeliyim.

english: Aye, she's a beauty alright! The Lady Zay has been my home for many hard months, through storm and sun, and she always gets us to here we were headed!
translation: Evet, gercekten cok güzel! Lady Zay, firtinalarda ve günesli günlerde, zorlu aylar boyunca benim evim oldu ve bizi her zaman hedefimize ulastirdi!

english: Yes, she's certainly one of the finest boats I've seen on my travels!
translation: Evet, seyahatlerim sirasinda gördügüm en güzel gemilerden biri!

english: That she is [lad/lass], that she is.
Hello.
How's it going?
Good thanks. Just passing by.
Please excuse me, I'm rather busy.
Hey, I'm your contractor from Mahogany Homes, what did you want done?
translation: Merhaba, ben Mahogany Homes'tan müteahhidin, ne yaptirmak istiyordun?

english: I'd like two Wooden drawers built.
I'd like two Wooden cabinets built.
I'd like a Wooden bed built.
I'd like a Wooden table built.
I'd like my clock fixed.
I'd like my bath fixed.
I'd like two Oak drawers built.
translation: Iki adet mese cekmece yaptirmak istiyorum.

english: I'd like two Oak cabinets built.
translation: Iki adet mese dolap yaptirmak istiyorum.

english: I'd like a Oak bed built.
translation: Bir adet mese yatak yaptirmak istiyorum.

english: I'd like a Oak table built.
translation: Bir adet mese masa yaptirmak istiyorum.

english: I'd like two Teak drawers built.
translation: Iki adet tik cekmece yaptirmak istiyorum.

english: I'd like two Teak cabinets built.
translation: Iki adet tik dolap yaptirmak istiyorum.

english: I'd like a Teak bed built.
translation: Bir adet tik yatak yaptirmak istiyorum.

english: I'd like a Teak table built.
I'd like two Mahogany drawers built.
translation: Iki adet maun cekmece yaptirmak istiyorum.

english: I'd like two Mahogany cabinets built.
translation: Iki adet maun dolap yaptirmak istiyorum.

english: I'd like a Mahogany bed built.
I'd like a Mahogany table built.
I've finished with the work you wanted.
Thank you so much! Would you like a cup of tea before you go?
translation: Cok tesekkür ederim! Gitmeden önce bir fincan cay ister misiniz?

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks, I better be off.
Aaah, nothing like a nice cupppa tea!
translation: Aaah, güzel bir fincan cay gibisi yok!

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks.
Hey kid, what's all the shouting about?
translation: Hey cocuk, bu bagirislar da ne?

english: Christmas is ruined!
Again? What's happened this time?
translation: Yine mi? Bu sefer ne oldu?

english: The man in the shop won't give us our Gingerbread Gnomes, he's keeping them for himself.
translation: Dükkândaki adam bize zencefilli kurabiye cücelerimizi vermiyor, kendine sakliyor.

english: That doesn't sound right, are you sure that's really what he's doing?
translation: Bu dogru gelmiyor, gercekten öyle yaptigindan emin misin?

english: Of course he is, why else won't he give us any?
translation: Tabii ki öyle, yoksa neden bize vermesin ki?

english: Something seems off, maybe I should go talk to Santa to find out what's happened.
translation: Bir terslik var, belki de ne oldugunu ögrenmek icin Noel Baba ile konusmaliyim.

english: Do whatever you want, I want my Gingerbread Gnomes!
translation: Ne istersen yap, ben zencefilli kurabiye cücelerimi istiyorum!

english: Where are our Gingerbread Gnomes!
I'm working on it, I'm working on it.
Hurry up!
You've ruined Christmas!
Give us the Gnomes!
Why are you still here? I saved Christmas, you can go home.
translation: Neden hâlâ buradasin? Noel'i kurtardim, eve gidebilirsin.

english: We still have to wait for the delivery to come in, dummy.
translation: Hâlâ teslimatin gelmesini beklememiz gerekiyor, aptal.

english: I'll leave you to it then.
Christmas is Saved!
Hurry up with the delivery!
Nilsal, [player name]. How are things going?
Pretty good, thanks. How about you? Made any more discoveries down here?
translation: Oldukca iyi, tesekkürler. Sen nasilsin? Burada baska kesifler yaptin mi?

english: More than you can count! I've found so much new information on the Old Ones and naguanil. The museum are hoping to include it all in some new exhibits soon!
translation: Sayamayacagin kadar cok! Eski Varliklar ve naguanil hakkinda cok fazla yeni bilgi buldum. Müze yakinda tüm bunlari yeni sergilere dahil etmeyi umuyor!

english: Sounds awesome! I'll be sure to keep an eye out for them. On that note, I'll let you get back to it.
translation: Harika! Onlari mutlaka görecegim. Bu arada, seni isine birakayim.

english: Hello friend.
Hello, what are you doing here?
My name is Jessie. I help look after the forest.
translation: Benim adim Jessie. Ormani korumaya yardim ediyorum.

english: Nice to meet you. You must know this area very well then.
translation: Memnun oldum. O zaman burayi cok iyi biliyorsundur.

english: I do. There're all sorts of interesting creatures around here. Be careful, some of them are not very friendly. A lot of travellers have become their victims.
translation: Evet. Buralarda cok ilginc yaratiklar var. Dikkatli ol, bazilari pek dost canlisi degil. Bircok gezgin onlarin kurbani oldu.

english: I see. Thanks for the warning.
No problem! Safe travels my friend.
Hello, I don't recognise you. We don't get many newcomers around here.
translation: Merhaba, seni tanimiyorum. Buralara pek yeni gelen olmaz.

english: How come?
The plague of course. Not many people want to come to a place like this and the few that do normally get stopped by the mourners.
translation: Tabii ki veba yüzünden. Pek kimse böyle bir yere gelmek istemez ve gelen az sayidaki kisi de genellikle yas tutanlar tarafindan durdurulur.

english: All you'll find here now are the dead and the dying. Even our own king has abandoned us.
translation: Artik burada sadece ölüler ve ölmek üzere olanlar var. Kendi kralimiz bile bizi terk etti.

english: Your king?
Yes, King Tyras of West Ardougne. He's the brother of King Lathas, the ruler of East Ardougne.
translation: Evet, Bati Ardougne Krali Tyras. O, Dogu Ardougne'nin hükümdari Kral Lathas'in kardesi.

english: So where is the king?
Well he's always been a bit of an explorer. He's led multiple expeditions into the uncharted lands to the west.
translation: O her zaman biraz kasif ruhlu olmustur. Batidaki kesfedilmemis topraklara bircok kesif gezisi düzenlemistir.

english: The plague first started when he came back from one of these expeditions. More than a few suspect that some of his men caught it out there and brought it back with them.
translation: Veba, o bu kesif gezilerinden birinden döndügünde basladi. Bircok kisi, adamlarindan bazilarinin orada virüse yakalanip geri getirdiklerini düsünüyor.

english: The king didn't care though. He just left on another expedition to the west. He hasn't been seen since. He left the city warder Bravek in charge but he's no better.
translation: Ancak kral umursamadi. Batiya baska bir kesif gezisine cikti. O zamandan beri görülmedi. Sehir muhafizi Bravek'i sorumlu birakti ama o da daha iyi degil.

english: Anyway, you clearly didn't come here to talk about kings. So tell me, what brings you to West Ardougne?
translation: Her neyse, buraya krallar hakkinda konusmaya gelmedigin belli. Söylesene, seni Bati Ardougne'a getiren nedir?

english: I'm looking for a woman from East Ardougne called Elena.
translation: Dogu Ardougne'dan Elena adinda bir kadin ariyorum.

english: East Ardougnian women are easier to find in East Ardougne. Not many would come to West Ardougne to find one. Although the name is familiar, what does she look like?
translation: Dogu Ardougne'lu kadinlari Dogu Ardougne'da bulmak daha kolaydir. Bati Ardougne'a gelip birini arayan pek fazla kisi olmaz. Ismi tanidik geliyor ama neye benziyor?

english: Um... brown hair... in her twenties...
Hmmm, that doesn't narrow it down a huge amount... I'll need to know more than that, or see a picture?
translation: Hmmm, bu pek bir sey ifade etmiyor... Daha fazla bilgiye ihtiyacim var, ya da bir fotografini görmem gerek.

english: Ah yes. She came over here to help the plague victims. I think she is staying over with the Rehnison family.
translation: Ah evet. Veba kurbanlarina yardim etmek icin buraya geldi. Sanirim Rehnison ailesinin yaninda kaliyor.

english: They live in the small timbered building at the far north side of town. I've not seen her around here in a while, mind.
translation: Kasabanin kuzey ucundaki kücük ahsap binada yasiyorlar. Ama bir süredir onu buralarda görmedim.

english: I don't suppose you could run me a little errand while you're over there? I borrowed this book from them, can you return it?
translation: Oraya giderken benim icin bir is yapabilir misin? Bu kitabi onlardan ödünc aldim, geri götürebilir misin?

english: Yes, I'll return it for you.
Jethick gives you a book
No, I don't have time for that.
Hello. We don't get many newcomers around here.
translation: Merhaba. Buralarda pek yeni gelen olmaz.

english: I'm surprised you're still here. Not many like to stick around this place if they have the choice.
translation: Hala burada olmana sasirdim. Secme sansi olan pek kimse burayi terk etmek istemez.

english: Good to see you friend.
Hey Jethick, how's things?
Not bad, the city is still a mess but we've finally got the chance to change that now the mourners have gone.
translation: Fena degil, sehir hala karisik ama yas tutanlar gittigine göre sonunda bunu degistirebiliriz.

english: Good to hear, all the best.
Let's see if you have what it takes to answer this question.
translation: Bu soruyu cevaplayabilecek misin, bir bakalim.

english: What question?
The one on this scroll.
Jethick has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Jethick sana bir meydan okuma parsömeni verdi!

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
Not even close!
Spot on!
Jethick has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
Yes, I'll return it for you.
No, I don't have time for that.
Hello.
Hello there. Welcome to the Temple of the Lesser Gods.
translation: Merhaba. Kücük Tanrilar Tapinagi'na hos geldin.

english: Could you tell me more about the lesser gods?
translation: Kücük tanrilar hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Of course. The lesser gods, or avatars as some call them, were born from the dreams of Tumeken. They are Apmeken, Het, Crondis and Scabaras.
translation: Elbette. Kücük tanrilar, ya da bazilarinin dedigi gibi avatarlar, Tumeken'in rüyalarindan dogmustur. Bunlar Apmeken, Het, Crondis ve Scabaras'tir.

english: Could you tell me more about Apmeken?
translation: Apmeken hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misiniz?

english: Apmeken is the goddess of companionship. She is known to be the most mischievous, playful and unpredictable of the minor deities. I'd say she's my personal favourite.
translation: Apmeken, arkadasligin tanricasidir. Kücük tanrilar arasinda en yaramaz, en eglenceli ve en öngörülemez olani olarak bilinir. Benim kisisel favorimdir diyebilirim.

english: So I shouldn't trust you then?
Apmeken can appeal to the most erudite scholar or the most barefaced liar. I'd like to be considered amongst the former category.
translation: Apmeken, en bilgili bilginlere de, en yüzsüz yalancilara da hitap edebilir. Ben kendimi ilk kategoriye dahil etmek isterim.

english: I see. What does she look like?
She has the head of a monkey, or sometimes an ape. It changes depending upon what nature she is displaying. For example, the orangutan represents wisdom, while the baboon represents mischief.
translation: Maymun kafasi var, bazen de goril kafasi. Gösteris yaptigi özellige göre degisir. Örnegin, orangutan bilgelik, babun ise yaramazlik anlamina gelir.

english: Could you tell me more about Het?
translation: Het hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Het is the least strange of our deities to foreign eyes, for he looks just like us. I suspect this is why his shrines are particularly targeted by thieves like that infamous Templeton.
translation: Het, yabancilarin gözünde en az tuhaf olan tanrimizdir, cünkü tipki bizim gibi görünür. Sanirim bu yüzden tapinaklari, o kötü söhretli Templeton gibi hirsizlarin özellikle hedef aldigi yerlerdir.

english: What does he represent?
Het is the god of health, both in mind and body. He is quite popular amongst soldiers as a result, especially up in Al Kharid.
translation: Het, hem zihin hem de beden sagliginin tanrisidir. Bu nedenle askerler arasinda, özellikle Al Kharid'de oldukca popülerdir.

english: Just soldiers?
Not at all! Like I said, the wellbeing of the mind is also key to Het. Many great orators also look to him for guidance. I imagine his teachings help with some of their strenuous speeches.
translation: Hic de degil! Dedigim gibi, zihinsel saglik da Het icin cok önemlidir. Bircok büyük hatip de ona rehberlik etmesi icin basvurur. Sanirim onun ögretileri, onlarin yorucu konusmalarinda yardimci oluyor.

english: How did his followers react to the plagues here?
translation: Onun takipcileri buradaki salginlara nasil tepki gösterdi?

english: With many arguments. They really couldn't decide whether it was a punishment from Het, or an affront to him. I stayed out of that debate.
translation: Bircok tartisma cikti. Bunun Het'in bir cezasi mi, yoksa ona bir hakaret mi olduguna karar veremediler. Ben bu tartismanin disinda kaldim.

english: Could you tell me more about Crondis?
translation: Crondis hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misiniz?

english: Crondis is a ferocious lady with the head of a mighty crocodile.
translation: Crondis, güclü bir timsah kafasina sahip vahsi bir kadindir.

english: That must be awkward when buying helmets.
translation: Kask alirken bu durum biraz garip olmali.

english: Luckily for her, I don't think deities have much need for them.
translation: Neyse ki, tanrilarin kasklara pek ihtiyaci oldugunu sanmiyorum.

english: So what is she the goddess of?
Resourcefulness. A word which seems to be open to large interpretation.
translation: Yaraticilik. Bu kelime genis bir yoruma acik gibi görünüyor.

english: How so?
Most consider her to be a teacher of modesty. They say we should be resourceful by only taking and using that which we absolutely need.
translation: Cogu kisi onu alcakgönüllülügün ögretmeni olarak görür. Sadece kesinlikle ihtiyacimiz olani alip kullanarak becerikli olmamiz gerektigini söylerler.

english: But there's others with a different interpretation?
translation: Ama farkli yorumlayanlar da var mi?

english: Some believe she is actually the goddess of pleasure. They claim that the idea of modesty came from a misinterpretation, and that to be resourceful is to take all that you can.
translation: Bazilari onun aslinda zevk tanricasi olduguna inanir. Alcakgönüllülük fikrinin yanlis yorumlamadan kaynaklandigini ve becerikli olmanin alabilecegin her seyi almak oldugunu iddia ederler.

english: That doesn't sound right.
No. It is a more recent take that I suspect was born in Menaphos. There are many in that city with more wealth than they'll ever need. Modesty is not an ideal they'll ever embody.
translation: Hayir. Bu daha yeni bir yorum ve Menaphos'ta ortaya ciktigini düsünüyorum. O sehirde, ihtiyaclarindan fazlasina sahip bircok insan var. Alcakgönüllülük, onlarin asla benimsemeyecegi bir ideal.

english: Could you tell me more about Scabaras?
translation: Scabaras hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: There are many opinions out there on Scabaras, but general knowledge isn't always the most accurate.
translation: Scabaras hakkinda bircok görüs var, ama genel bilgi her zaman en dogru bilgi degildir.

english: Well what are the absolute facts then?
Scabaras is the god of isolation. He takes on the appearance of a man with the head of a scarab. Both he and his followers were driven into hiding long ago.
translation: Scabaras, izolasyon tanrisidir. Bir insanin vücuduna sahip, basi bok böcegi olan bir görünüse sahiptir. Hem o hem de takipcileri uzun zaman önce saklanmak zorunda kaldilar.

english: And?
And that's it. You asked for the absolute facts. Anything beyond that is just speculation.
translation: Ve hepsi bu. Kesin gercekleri sordun. Bunun ötesindekiler sadece spekülasyon.

english: But there must be more. The High Priest told me that Scabaras tried to conquer these lands.
translation: Ama daha fazlasi olmali. Basrahip bana Scabaras'in bu topraklari fethetmeye calistigini söyledi.

english: So it is said, but the written accounts that exist contain many inconsistencies when it comes to what role Scabaras actually played. Of course, most would not know that.
translation: Öyle söyleniyor, ama mevcut yazili kayitlarda Scabaras'in gercekte oynadigi rol konusunda bircok tutarsizlik var. Tabii ki cogu kisi bunu bilmez.

english: How come?
Many of the writings are only available to us priests. That does of course include the new High Priest, but perhaps he is yet to read them. They are definitely... illuminating.
translation: Yazili kayitlarin cogu sadece biz rahiplerin erisimine aciktir. Tabii ki yeni Bas Rahip de buna dahildir, ama belki de henüz okumamistir. Kesinlikle... aydinlaticidirlar.

english: Interesting...
Interesting. Thanks for the information.
I'd better get going.
Hey! You don't have permission to go down there.
Hello Jex.
Hello again.
Could you tell me more about the lesser gods?
translation: Bana kücük tanrilar hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Could you tell me more about Apmeken?
translation: Apmeken hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Could you tell me more about Het?
translation: Het hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Could you tell me more about Crondis?
translation: Crondis hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Could you tell me more about Scabaras?
translation: Scabaras hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Interesting. Thanks for the information.
I'd better get going.
Thanks so much for saving us from those stinky gublinch. They were awful! I hope Shanty gave you somefing cool for your efforts.
translation: Bizi o kokusmus gublinclerden kurtardigin icin cok tesekkürler. Berbatlardi! Umarim Shanty cabalarin icin sana güzel bir sey vermistir.

english: Hello?
Ah... Another wayward traveller.
Excuse me?
You are not the first to make your way down here. Undoubtedly, you will not be the last.
translation: Buraya gelen ilk kisi sen degilsin. Süphesiz, son kisi de olmayacaksin.

english: Who are you?
My aeternal name, given to me long ago, is Jimp.
translation: Uzun zaman önce bana verilen ebedi adim Jimp.

english: Jimp the imp?
Yes, though my many centuries upon this realm have taught me that the newer tongues struggle with its pronounciation.
translation: Evet, ancak bu alemde gecirdigim yüzyillar boyunca, yeni dillerin bu ismi telaffuz etmekte zorlandigini ögrendim.

english: So you may call me Jim.
Okay...
I see you still have questions. Before I answer them, I will need you to swear to secrecy.
translation: Hala sorularin var galiba. Onlara cevap vermeden önce, gizlilik yemini etmeni istiyorum.

english: Hang on... why would I do that?
translation: Bir dakika... Neden bunu yapayim ki?

english: I believe you will find my cooperation helpful. Perhaps I shall find yours helpful one day too.
translation: Isbirligimin sana yardimci olacagini düsünüyorum. Belki bir gün senin isbirligin de bana yardimci olur.

english: I've already entered one dubious contract.
I'm not sure I should be signing any others.
translation: Baska bir sözlesme imzalamamin dogru olup olmadigindan emin degilim.

english: You will find the nature of my contracts refreshing, then. My terms are simple: do not endanger me or take what is mine, and I shall do what I can to help you.
translation: O zaman sözlesmelerimin niteligini ferahlatici bulacaksin. Sartlarim basit: beni tehlikeye atma veya benim olani alma, ben de sana yardim etmek icin elimden geleni yapayim.

english: Okay then, why not.
Excellent. It is a pleasure to make your acquaintance, [player name].
Wait, how do you know my name? Was this a trick?
translation: Bekle, adimi nereden biliyorsun? Bu bir numara miydi?

english: No, friend, you signed it right here.
Oh, right.
Who are you really?
I suppose since you already know my name, you are asking who I am in the context of history and society.
translation: Adimi zaten bildigine göre, tarih ve toplum baglaminda kim oldugumu soruyorsun sanirim.

english: Yes, let's go with that.
I am afraid other agreements bar me from telling you much of my past. Nowadays, I am a humble servant of Yama, existing only to do as he pleases.
translation: Korkarim diger anlasmalarim gecmisim hakkinda fazla bir sey söylememi engelliyor. Su anda Yama'nin mütevazi bir hizmetkariyim, sadece onun isteklerini yerine getirmek icin varim.

english: And what is that?
Mostly fetching records, and dying. When I am not doing that, I rest here. The features of this isle remind me of those I once knew.
translation: Cogunlukla kayitlari getirmek ve ölmek. Bunlari yapmadigim zamanlarda burada dinleniyorum. Bu adanin özellikleri bana bir zamanlar tanidiklariminkini hatirlatiyor.

english: Who do you mean by 'those'?
I already skirt as closely as I can to what I am disallowed from sharing. I apologise, but I cannot answer further.
translation: Paylasmam yasak olan seyleri zaten olabildigince az anlatiyorum. Üzgünüm, ama daha fazla cevap veremem.

english: What is this place?
This isle is a small wonder. The rock formations here bear a slight resemblance to those from my own realm.
translation: Bu ada kücük bir mucize. Buradaki kaya olusumlari benim dünyamdakine biraz benziyor.

english: The rock looks like it's crumbling.
Yes, infernal shale is kept together largely by the pressure from above. Once a piece is broken off, it can easily be broken down with a hammer and chisel.
translation: Evet, cehennem sistleri büyük ölcüde yukaridan gelen basincla bir arada tutulur. Bir parca kirildiginda, cekic ve keskiyle kolayca parcalanabilir.

english: That's good to know. What about the smithy?
translation: Bunu bilmek iyi oldu. Peki ya demirci dükkani?

english: I can say nothing more than that it was not here when I arrived.
So you brought it here?
translation: Yani onu buraya sen mi getirdin?

english: I cannot say.
It's rather hot here.
Yes, the unique composition of this chasm does create a warm environment.
translation: Evet, bu ucurumun benzersiz yapisi sicak bir ortam yaratiyor.

english: I can see my sweat turning to vapour as soon as it appears.
translation: Terimin ortaya cikar cikmaz buharlastigini görebiliyorum.

english: Yes, water is an ineffective coolant at this temperature. Perhaps I could offer an alternative.
translation: Evet, bu sicaklikta su etkili bir sogutucu degildir. Belki bir alternatif önerebilirim.

english: That would be handy.
The liquid will only offer a brief respite from the heat, but I find it can help to apply it frequently between bursts of exertion.
translation: Sivi, sicaktan sadece kisa bir süreligine kurtulmanizi saglar, ancak yogun efor sarf ettiginizde sik sik uygulamanin faydali oldugunu gördüm.

english: I see, thanks. I'll give that a try.
I can see you eyeing the liquid. It is best you do not ask.
translation: Siviya baktigini görüyorum. Sormaman en iyisi.

english: Have another cloth. Remember, it only offers a brief respite from the heat. You'll want to time bursts of exertion right after using it.
translation: Bir bez daha al. Unutma, bu sivi sicaktan sadece kisa bir süreligine rahatlama saglar. Kullanimdan hemen sonra yogun efor sarf etmelisin.

english: Why is there a smithy down here?
translation: Neden burada bir demirci dükkani var?

english: I cannot speak to the purpose the smithy has, but I might be able to shed some light on the purposes it could be given.
translation: Demirci dükkaninin amacini bilmiyorum, ama ne amacla kullanilabilecegi konusunda biraz fikir verebilirim.

english: Go on.
The furnace is capable of extremely high temperatures. Whilst not very helpful for your ores, it can melt metal from our realm.
translation: Firin cok yüksek sicakliklara ulasabilir. Senin cevherlerin icin pek yararli olmasa da, bizim dünyamizdaki metalleri eritebilir.

english: Like the rocks on this isle?
Not quite, though they are necessary to power the furnace. Nobody but Yama has access to the kinds of ores it was designed for.
translation: Tam olarak degil, ama firini calistirmak icin gerekli. Yama disinda kimse, firinin tasarlandigi türdeki cevherlere erisemez.

english: But if I were to get my hands on some, I could work them here?
translation: Ama eger biraz bulabilirsem, burada isleyebilir miyim?

english: Yes. The process is quite involved. Smaller shards must be melted into nuggets for stability, and then combined into chunks.
translation: Evet. Sürec oldukca karmasiktir. Daha kücük parcalar, stabilite icin külcelere eritilmeli ve ardindan parcalar halinde birlestirilmelidir.

english: I see. Maybe I can give that a go.
You're very friendly for a demon.
I am not alone in this amongst my kind, but I understand that I am rare. I have my reasons for being this way.
translation: Türümde bu konuda yalniz degilim, ama nadir oldugumu biliyorum. Böyle olmamin nedenleri var.

english: Well, if there is anything I can do for you, let me know.
translation: Sana yapabilecegim bir sey varsa, bana haber ver.

english: Thank you. There is little I can ask of you given the nature of my other agreements, but watching you work on this isle does bring me some comfort.
translation: Tesekkürler. Diger anlasmalarimin niteligi geregi senden isteyebilecegim cok az sey var, ama bu adada calismani izlemek bana biraz rahatlik veriyor.

english: Goodbye.
Safe travels, [player name].
I've already entered one dubious contract.
Okay then, why not.
Who are you really?
What is this place?
It's rather hot here.
More options...
Why is there a smithy down here?
translation: Neden burada bir demirci dükkani var?

english: You're very friendly for a demon.
Goodbye.
Welcome to the Jungle Store. Can I help you at all?
translation: Jungle Store'a hos geldin. Yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: Yes please. What are you selling?
No thanks.
Yes please. What are you selling
No thanks.
'Ello there.
Tell me about this room?
translation: Bu oda hakkinda bilgi verir misin?

english: Well... s'like thish...
Thish here'sh a shtore room right?
translation: Burasi bir depo odasi, degil mi?

english: A store room you mean?
That'sh what I shaid! *HIC* A shtore room.... Now technic'ly shpeaking, I should be outshide guarding it...
translation: Öyle dedim ya! *HIC* Bir depo odasi... Teknik olarak konusursak, disarida onu korumam gerek...

english: But you just nipped in to have a quick drink?
translation: Ama sen hizlica bir seyler icmek icin iceri mi girdin?

english: Yep... and to practish.
Practish? I mean.. practise what?
translation: Pratik mi? Yani... neyi pratik yapmak icin?

english: Keg balancin. I'm the besht.
Tell me how to balance kegs?
translation: Tell me how to balance kegs?

english: Yer very very shtrange. But.... you pick the keg up, and balance it on yer head, then you pick another keg up and put that on top. S'really very eashy.
translation: Yer very very shtrange. But.... you pick the keg up, and balance it on yer head, then you pick another keg up and put that on top. S'really very eashy.

english: Eashy?
Yesh. Eashy.
But you couldn't ever balansh ash many ash meee!
translation: But you couldn't ever balansh ash many ash meee!

english: That sounds like a challenge, I'll show you!
translation: That sounds like a challenge, I'll show you!

english: May I claim my tokens please?
translation: May I claim my tokens please?

english: Wha'? You ain't earnt any mate!
translation: Wha'? You ain't earnt any mate!

english: Well... err.. ish not offishal or anyfin... but I got the ledger of tokensh 'ere. I'll jus' err.. write it in!
translation: Well... err.. ish not offishal or anyfin... but I got the ledger of tokensh 'ere. I'll jus' err.. write it in!

english: Won't they know?
Nah... hic.... I'm a wizsh at copyin' signaturesh! Jus' ashk an offishal mem'er of shtaff like Shloane fer yer tokensh.
translation: Nah... hic.... I'm a wizsh at copyin' signaturesh! Jus' ashk an offishal mem'er of shtaff like Shloane fer yer tokensh.

english: The rather drunk Jimmy scribbles the tokens you've earned from Keg Balancing in the Ledger so that you can claim them from an official member of training staff.
translation: The rather drunk Jimmy scribbles the tokens you've earned from Keg Balancing in the Ledger so that you can claim them from an official member of training staff.

english: Bye!
Shure you wouldn't like an ickle drinkie fore yer go?
translation: Shure you wouldn't like an ickle drinkie fore yer go?

english: No thanks, got things to do, people to see, tokens to earn...
translation: No thanks, got things to do, people to see, tokens to earn...

english: Ya got no chance o' beatin' me [player name]!
translation: Ya got no chance o' beatin' me [player name]!

english: No one's stronger than me, 'speshly not [player name]!
translation: No one's stronger than me, 'speshly not [player name]!

english: Wow! That'sh bery impr....imp...impresh.... good [player name]! Equalsh my record!
translation: Wow! That'sh bery impr....imp...impresh.... good [player name]! Equalsh my record!

english: Tell me about this room.
Tell me how to balance kegs.
translation: Tell me how to balance kegs.

english: May I claim my tokens please?
translation: May I claim my tokens please?

english: Bye!
Hello.
Ah, you must be [player name]. I've been expectorating you.
translation: Ah, you must be [player name]. I've been expectorating you.

english: You... have?
I have. The Sisters Grime told me you'd be dropping in.
translation: I have. The Sisters Grime told me you'd be dropping in.

english: They said you could teach me a thing or two about ratcatching.
translation: They said you could teach me a thing or two about ratcatching.

english: Well, I could, but I need a little more motivation than that.
translation: Well, I could, but I need a little more motivation than that.

english: I didn't get this far by giving out help freely to every adventurer who came my way.
translation: I didn't get this far by giving out help freely to every adventurer who came my way.

english: Maybe I could help you out with something then?
translation: Maybe I could help you out with something then?

english: I am an adventurer after all.
translation: I am an adventurer after all.

english: Ah, that's mincemeat to my ears!
translation: Ah, that's mincemeat to my ears!

english: Music?
No thank you! Your unrefined caterwauling would only draw attention.
translation: No thank you! Your unrefined caterwauling would only draw attention.

english: How about I test your ratcatching mettle instead?
translation: How about I test your ratcatching mettle instead?

english: Take a good long look at this map.
translation: Take a good long look at this map.

english: A client of mine, a merchant of some repute, is having a sorbet.
translation: A client of mine, a merchant of some repute, is having a sorbet.

english: A what?
A soy - a fancy party. Don't interrupt me again.
translation: A soy - a fancy party. Don't interrupt me again.

english: This client of mine has a problem, a small furry one.
translation: This client of mine has a problem, a small furry one.

english: He'd be better off calling a doctor about that.
translation: He'd be better off calling a doctor about that.

english: No, you fool! A rat problem.
translation: No, you fool! A rat problem.

english: So you want me to go to his place and kill some rats? That sounds easy enough.
translation: So you want me to go to his place and kill some rats? That sounds easy enough.

english: Ah, but it's not that simple. Here's your first lesson - we ratcatchers must be discreet.
translation: Ah, but it's not that simple. Here's your first lesson - we ratcatchers must be discreet.

english: Our wealthier clients would be ruined if word got out that their fancy mansions were filled with vermin.
translation: Our wealthier clients would be ruined if word got out that their fancy mansions were filled with vermin.

english: Oh, I see. So I have to do this covertly?
translation: Oh, I see. So I have to do this covertly?

english: Precisely!
Now just in case, I'm going to cast a spell on you that will allow you carryout this task with some element of safety.
translation: Now just in case, I'm going to cast a spell on you that will allow you carryout this task with some element of safety.

english: Are you going to cast an invisibility spell on me? That should make it easy.
translation: Are you going to cast an invisibility spell on me? That should make it easy.

english: Not quite. If you're spotted, this spell will teleport you a short distance away and render the last few seconds of your discoverer's memory blank.
translation: Not quite. If you're spotted, this spell will teleport you a short distance away and render the last few seconds of your discoverer's memory blank.

english: That's really useful!
Jimmy waves his hands about and mutters something under his breath.
translation: Jimmy waves his hands about and mutters something under his breath.

english: Where'd you learn that spell, anyway?
translation: Where'd you learn that spell, anyway?

english: That's a trade secret, m'afraid.
Well, can you teach me?
Oh my, no. Can you imagine if all the riffraff in Ardougne got wind of this?
translation: Oh my, no. Can you imagine if all the riffraff in Ardougne got wind of this?

english: We already have a serious crime problem.
translation: We already have a serious crime problem.

english: Oh, I see.
But there's plenty more I can teach you about ratcatching... if you complete the task I've set you.
translation: But there's plenty more I can teach you about ratcatching... if you complete the task I've set you.

english: Do you have any tips for me now?
translation: Do you have any tips for me now?

english: Of course! Use a cat to catch the rats.
translation: Of course! Use a cat to catch the rats.

english: That's it?
Don't look a gilt horse in the mouth!
translation: Don't look a gilt horse in the mouth!

english: You mean a gift horse?
I'll gift you no such thing! Now go on, get out of here!
translation: I'll gift you no such thing! Now go on, get out of here!

english: Off I go then...
Ah, you're back. Have you completed your mission?
translation: Ah, you're back. Have you completed your mission?

english: What am I meant to do again?
translation: What am I meant to do again?

english: Read the directions on the map to get to the manor. Once there, eliminate any rats you see with your cat and return to me unseen. Got it?
translation: Read the directions on the map to get to the manor. Once there, eliminate any rats you see with your cat and return to me unseen. Got it?

english: Got it. Thanks for the reminder.
translation: Got it. Thanks for the reminder.

english: Good, good.
Ah [player name], aren't you just the ticket?
translation: Ah [player name], aren't you just the ticket?

english: I am?
A job well done. Confabulations!
No, the job really is done!
translation: No, the job really is done!

english: What?
Never mind. So you'll teach me all about ratcatching now?
translation: Never mind. So you'll teach me all about ratcatching now?

english: Of course! If you want to learn about ratcatching, get yourself to the Rat Pits here in Ardougne.
translation: Of course! If you want to learn about ratcatching, get yourself to the Rat Pits here in Ardougne.

english: It's a great place for training kittens. Just look at Bones here!
translation: It's a great place for training kittens. Just look at Bones here!

english: I think of nothing but murder all day!
translation: I think of nothing but murder all day!

english: He does look good at catching rats. But what about older cats?
translation: He does look good at catching rats. But what about older cats?

english: Ah, well. My good friend Hooknosed Jack can tell you all about those.
translation: Ah, well. My good friend Hooknosed Jack can tell you all about those.

english: He has the oldest cat I've ever seen.
translation: He has the oldest cat I've ever seen.

english: Where do I find this... Hooknosed Jack?
He hangs around in a rather unfashionable part of Varrock. He likes a good scrap, does Jack.
translation: Varrock'un pek de moda olmayan bir bölgesinde takiliyor. Jack kavga etmeyi sever.

english: I'll tell him to look out for you.
Can you tell me more about the Rat Pits?
translation: Rat Pits hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: The pits lie below this very pub.
See that ladder there? That's the way in.
translation: Suradaki merdiveni görüyor musun? Giris oradan.

english: What goes on in these pits then?
I'd have thought it was self-exploratory. Here, have a manual.
translation: Bence bu kendiliginden anlasilir bir sey. Al, bir kilavuz.

english: Here, take this, you might find it useful.
Ah, [player name]. Back for more intonation?
translation: Ah, Maceraci. Daha fazla tonlama icin mi geri geldin?

english: Can you tell me where I can find Phingspet and Grimesquit?
They live in the sewers below Varrock.
Please don't say hello from me.
Can you tell me where I can find Hooknosed Jack?
Can you tell me where I can find Smokin' Joe?
If the old rascal's lungs haven't given up yet, you should find him in Keldagrim.
translation: Eger yasli haydutun cigerleri henüz pes etmediyse, onu Keldagrim'de bulabilirsin.

english: Can you tell me where I might find 'The Face'?
Port Sarim is your best bet.
Can you tell me where I might find Felkrash?
The Boss?
You'll find her in Port Sarim, probably in the Rat Pits there.
translation: Onu Port Sarim'de, muhtemelen Rat Pits'te bulabilirsin.

english: She's your boss?
Well, sort of. She's the unofficial leader of the Ratcatchers.
Nobody elected her or anything.
translation: Kimse onu secmedi ya da öyle bir sey.

english: Got it. She's the boss.
Can you tell me more about the pits?
translation: Pits hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Here take this, you might find it useful.
What do you want to know?
Do you have any pointers for me and my cat?
translation: Bana ve kedime verebilecegin bir tavsiye var mi?

english: You should wear an Amulet of Catspeak. It will allow you to organise tactics with your cat.
translation: Kedi Dili Tilsimi takmalisin. Böylece kedinle taktikler belirleyebilirsin.

english: What would be the best tactic to adopt then?
translation: O zaman en iyi taktik ne olur?

english: Well, that depends on your outlook, whether you're ready to risk your cat's life or not and how defensive or aggressive you want your cat to be.
translation: Bu senin bakis acina, kedinin hayatini riske atmaya hazir olup olmadigina ve kedinin ne kadar savunmaci veya saldirgan olmasini istedigine bagli.

english: I will not risk my cat's life.
Well if that's the case then you're left with two choices.
You can adopt an ultra defensive strategy, which increases your cat's hitpoints and defence but causes it to flee sooner.
translation: Kedinin can puanini ve savunmasini artiran, ancak daha cabuk kacmasina neden olan ultra savunma stratejisi uygulayabilirsin.

english: Or you can adopt a less defensive strategy, which will allow your cat to stay in the pit for longer.
translation: Ya da kedinin cukurda daha uzun süre kalmasini saglayan, daha az savunma stratejisi uygulayabilirsin.

english: I think I would adopt a very defensive strategy
translation: Sanirim cok savunmaci bir strateji benimseyecegim.

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'Just take care of yourself, cat.'
translation: Bu durumda kedinize sunu söylemelisiniz: “Sadece kendine dikkat et, kedi.”

english: Thanks for your help.
Do you have any other questions about the pits?
translation: Cukurlarla ilgili baska sorunuz var mi?

english: No thanks.
I think I would adopt a less defensive strategy.
translation: Sanirim daha az savunmaci bir strateji benimseyecegim.

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'Stay in for as long as you can.'
translation: Bu durumda kedinize sunu söylemelisiniz: “Mümkün oldugunca uzun süre kal.”

english: I am willing to risk my cat, if it increases my chances of victory.
translation: Kazanma sansimi artiracaksa kedimi riske atmaya hazirim.

english: In that case you are left with two choices.
You could go for all out attack which will boost your cat's attack and strength, but weaken it.
translation: Kedinizin saldiri ve gücünü artiracak, ancak onu zayiflatacak tam saldiri stratejisini secebilirsiniz.

english: Or, go for a less aggressive stance, which will increase your cat's strength and attack to a lesser degree, but carries no defensive penalties.
translation: Ya da kedinizin gücünü ve saldirisini daha az artiracak, ancak savunma acisindan herhangi bir dezavantaj getirmeyecek daha az agresif bir tutum sergileyebilirsiniz.

english: I think I would adopt a very aggressive strategy.
translation: Sanirim cok agresif bir strateji benimseyecegim.

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'Go berserk!'
translation: Bu durumda kedinize sunu söylemelisiniz: “Cilgina dön!”

english: I think I would adopt a less aggressive strategy.
translation: Ben daha az agresif bir strateji benimserdim.

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'No guts, no glory!'
translation: Bu durumda kedinize sunu söylemelisiniz: “Cesaret yoksa zafer de yok!”

english: What benefits does my cat get from training in the pits?
translation: Kedim cukurda antrenman yapmaktan ne gibi faydalar elde eder?

english: It depends on what kind of cat you have.
In the Ardougne pits, your kitten will grow up faster whether it wins or loses.
translation: Ardougne cukurlarinda, yavru kediniz kazanirsa da kaybeder de daha hizli büyür.

english: What if it wins then?
It will gain more experience, it'll be happier, and it'll be fed, too.
translation: Daha fazla deneyim kazanacak, daha mutlu olacak ve beslenecek.

english: Can you show me to the Rat Pits?
Thanks.
Good luck!
How do you spell your name again?
J-I-M-M-Y D-A-Z-Z-L-E-R.
Why?
Ever thought about putting a '1' in it?
translation: Icine bir ‘1’ eklemeyi düsündün mü hic?

english: Why on Gielinor would I do that?
Might add a bit of pizzazz, that's all.
Pizzazz, you say? I'll think about it.
What's your name and your business here?
translation: Adin ne ve burada ne isin var?

english: My name is [player name], and I have a couple of questions for you.
translation: Adim Maceraci ve sana birkac sorum var.

english: No.
What do you mean by no?
That just isn't the ticket. I don't know you nor I will not answer any questions.Now get gone from here, you'll attract unwanted attention to me.
translation: Bu hic de uygun degil. Seni tanimiyorum ve hicbir soruya cevap vermeyecegim. Simdi buradan git, bana istenmeyen dikkat cekeceksin.

english: As if those 'clothes' you're wearing wouldn't do that already.
translation: Sanki giydigin o ‘kiyafetler’ bunu zaten yapmiyormus gibi.

english: Ah [player name] aren't you just the ticket?
translation: Ah Maceraci, sen tam da uygunsun, degil mi?

english: Can you tell me where I could find Phingspet and Grimesquit?
translation: Phingspet ve Grimesquit'i nerede bulabilecegimi söyleyebilir misin?

english: You can find those vile harpies in the sewers of Varrock.
translation: O igrenc harpileri Varrock'un kanalizasyonlarinda bulabilirsin.

english: ~Jimmy shudders when he thinks of them.
If you ask me it's too good a place for them.
translation: Bana sorarsan, orasi onlar icin fazla iyi bir yer.

english: Can you tell me where I could find Hooknosed Jack?
translation: Hooknosed Jack'i nerede bulabilecegimi söyleyebilir misin?

english: He should be in the roughest area of Varrock knowing him. He likes a good scrap does Jack.
translation: Onu taniyorsam, Varrock'un en tehlikeli bölgesinde olmali. Jack kavgayi sever.

english: Can you tell me where I could find Smokin Joe?
You won't find him around here. They wouldn't let a filthy old dwarf like him into a civilised town like this.
translation: Onu buralarda bulamazsin. Onun gibi pis, yasli bir cüceyi böyle medeni bir kasabaya almazlar.

english: Well if he's not here where would I find him?
translation: Peki, burada degilse, onu nerede bulabilirim?

english: If the old rascal's lungs haven't given up yet, you should find him in Keldagrim, the city of Dwarves.
translation: Eger yasli haydutun cigerleri henüz pes etmediyse, onu cücelerin sehri Keldagrim'de bulabilirsin.

english: Can you tell me where I would find 'The Face'?
Old pugly, my oh my but did she ever get her comeuppance.
translation: Yasli cirkin, aman tanrim, sonunda hak ettigini buldu.

english: Old pugly?
Pug ugly.
She's worse than that.
She is?
Her looks are the stuff of legend. She's so ugly she ...
translation: Görünüsü efsanevi. O kadar cirkin ki...

english: You guys are really nasty.
Believe me she deserves everything she gets!
What did she do?
I couldn't possibly tell you, but be careful around her.
translation: Sana söyleyemem, ama onun yaninda dikkatli ol.

english: Will you please tell me where I could find her?
translation: Onu nerede bulabilecegimi söyler misin lütfen?

english: She'll be in or around Port Sarim I reckon.
translation: Sanirim Port Sarim'de veya cevresinde olacaktir.

english: Can you tell me where I would find Felkrash?
You'll find her in Port Sarim, probably in the ratpits.
translation: Onu Port Sarim'de, muhtemelen fare cukurlarinda bulursun.

english: Well sort of, she's the unofficial head of the rat catchers.
translation: Bir nevi, o fare avcilarinin gayri resmi basidir.

english: Here take this, you might find it useful
You are handed a manual concerning the ratpits.
translation: Sana fare cukurlariyla ilgili bir kilavuz verilir.

english: Well what do you want to know?
You should wear an amulet of catspeak. It will allow you to organise tactics with your cat.
translation: Kedi dili muskasi takmalisin. Böylece kedinle taktikler planlayabilirsin.

english: Well if that's the case then yourare left with two choices.
You can adopt an ultra defensive strategy, which increases your cat's hitpoints and defence, the drawback to this is that your cat will flee sooner.
translation: Kedinin can puanini ve savunmasini artiran ultra savunma stratejisi uygulayabilirsin, bunun dezavantaji kedinin daha cabuk kacmasidir.

english: Your other option is to adopt a less defensive strategy which will allow your cat to stay in the pit for longer.
translation: Diger secenegin ise kedinin cukurda daha uzun süre kalmasini saglayacak daha az savunma stratejisi uygulamaktir.

english: In that case you should tell your cat, 'Just take care of yourself cat.'
translation: Bu durumda kedine “Sadece kendine dikkat et” demelisin.

english: In that case you should tell your cat, 'Stay in for as long as you can.'
translation: Bu durumda kedine “Mümkün oldugunca uzun süre kal” demelisin.

english: You could go for all out attack which will boost your cat's attack and strength, but weaken it
translation: Kedinizin saldiri ve gücünü artiracak, ancak onu zayiflatacak tam saldiri stratejisini secebilir

english: or go for a less aggressive stance which will increase your cat's strength and attack to a lesser degree, but carries no defensive penalties.
translation: veya kedinizin gücünü ve saldirisini daha az ölcüde artiracak, ancak savunma acisindan herhangi bir dezavantaj getirmeyecek daha az agresif bir tutum sergileyebilirsiniz.

english: I think I would adopt a very aggressive strategy
translation: Ben cok agresif bir strateji benimserdim.

english: In that case you should tell your cat, 'Go berserk!'
In that case you should tell this to your cat, 'No guts, no glory!'
translation: Bu durumda kedinize “Cesaret yoksa zafer de yok!” demelisiniz.

english: In the Ardougne pits your kitten will grow up faster, whether it wins or loses.
translation: Ardougne cukurlarinda, yavru kediniz kazanip kazanmasa da daha hizli büyüyecektir.

english: It will gain more experience and will become happier and will be fed.
translation: Daha fazla deneyim kazanacak, daha mutlu olacak ve beslenecektir.

english: Can you show me to the rat pits?
Can you tell me where I can find...
Grimesquit and Phingspet
Hooknosed Jack
Smokin' Joe
The Face
Felkrash
Can you tell me more about the Rat Pits?
translation: Fare Cukurlari hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misiniz?

english: Do you have any pointers for me and my cat?
translation: Bana ve kedime verebileceginiz tavsiyeler var mi?

english: I will not risk my cat's life.
I think I would adopt an ultra defensive strategy.
I'd like to ask you...
No thanks
I think I would adopt a less defensive strategy.
I am willing to risk my cat if it improves my chances.
translation: Sansimi artiracaksa kedimi riske atmaya hazirim.

english: I think I would adopt a very aggressive strategy.
I think I would adopt a less aggressive strategy.
translation: Daha az agresif bir strateji uygulayacagim.

english: What benefits does my cat get from training in the pits?
translation: Kedim cukurda egitimden ne gibi faydalar elde eder?

english: Can you show me to the Rat Pits?
How do you spell your name again?
Can you tell me where I would find...
translation: Bana sunu nerede bulabilecegimi söyleyebilir misiniz...

english: The face
Can you tell me more about the pits?
translation: Cukurlar hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verir misiniz?

english: I think I would adopt a very defensive strategy.
translation: Sanirim cok savunmaci bir strateji izlerdim.

english: Can you show me to the rat pits?
Hey...who are you?
Oh, just passsing...What're you in for?
We don't talk about why we're in here, we just contemplate the crime we commited...or ways to get out!
translation: Neden burada oldugumuzu konusmayiz, sadece isledigimiz sucu düsünürüz... ya da buradan cikmanin yollarini!

english: Hello mate!
Did you see what happened to my friend?
There was a lot of commotion when they dragged you in here. There was someone else, she was struggling like anything. They said they'd take her outside. Dunno what happened to her then.
translation: Seni buraya sürüklediklerinde büyük bir kargasa cikti. Baska biri daha vardi, deli gibi direniyordu. Onu disari cikaracaklarini söylediler. Ona ne oldu bilmiyorum.

english: Oh no! I've got to find her!
Hey who are you?
I'm Jimmy...Jimmy the Chisel...who are you?
translation: Ben Jimmy... Jimmy the Chisel... sen kimsin?

english: I'm [player name], and I've come to release you....Aggie sent me.
translation: Ben Maceraci, seni kurtarmaya geldim... Aggie gönderdi.

english: So...are you gonna bust me out of here then...
Jail break! Great, how exciting!
translation: Hapisten kacis! Harika, ne heyecan verici!

english: Well, I thought I'd try a more diplomatic solution first...do you know who I have to talk to?
translation: Önce daha diplomatik bir cözüm deneyeyim dedim... kiminle konusmam gerektigini biliyor musun?

english: Oh, pity...well, you could speak to Johanhus...I think he's the leader.
translation: Oh, yazik... Johanhus ile konusabilirsin... Sanirim o lider.

english: Ok, I'll try that.
Hiya...you're Jimmy aren't you?
That's right.
I've made a deal with Johanhus...I need to go sort out some chickens to secure your release.
translation: Johanhus ile bir anlasma yaptim... Serbest birakilman icin birkac tavuk ayarlamam gerekiyor.

english: Blimey...the price of my neck for a few chickens...I'd say that was worth it...
translation: Vay canina... birkac tavuk icin hayatimi riske atmak... Bence buna deger...

english: Yeah...me too...anyway, I'll be back as soon as I've got the deal sorted.
translation: Evet... ben de... neyse, anlasmayi halleder halletmez geri dönecegim.

english: Great...many thanks
Hello!
Arr? Be ye wantin' te go on account with our gang o' fillibusters?
translation: Ne? Bizim haydut cetesine katilmak mi istiyorsun?

english: The powder monkey be takin' a caulk after gettin' rowdy on bumboo, so there be plenty of room for ye.
translation: Barut maymunu bambuda gürültü yaptiktan sonra bir icki icmeye gitti, yani senin icin bolca yer var.

english: Riiiiight...
I'll just be over here if you need me.
Whadda ya want?
Whadda ya got?
We gots grog and we gots food. Here, take a look.
translation: Grog ve yiyecek var. Al, bir bak.

english: Nothing! Honest!
Then stop takin' up me floor space!
I wanted to know where you got that harpoon hand.
translation: O zipkin elini nereden aldigini merak ettim.

english: Yer new in town aintcha?
translation: Bu kasabaya yeni geldin, degil mi?

english: Newish certainly.
Well, if ye wants te hear the story, here goes.
See, I was walkin' along the docks one day, and this fierce storm blew up.
translation: Bir gün rihtimda yürüyordum ve siddetli bir firtina cikti.

english: All of a sudden I turn an there, bearin' down on me is this albatross...
translation: Birden arkami döndüm ve üzerime bir albatros saldirdi...

english: Sorry to interrupt, but I would just like to clear something up.
translation: Böldügüm icin üzgünüm ama bir seyi acikliga kavusturmak istiyorum.

english: What? I was just gettin' to the good bit.
When I said 'I wanted to know where you got that harpoon hand', I meant where did you get it made, or buy it from?
translation: “O zipkin elini nereden aldigini bilmek istiyorum” derken, onu nerede yaptirdigini veya nereden aldigini kastetmistim.

english: If ye don't wants to hear the story then I ain't gonna tell ye!
Whadda ya got?
Nothing! Honest!
I wanted to know where you got that harpoon hand.
translation: O zipkin elini nereden aldigini bilmek istiyorum.

english: Hi, I'm Joe, door guard for Lady Keli.
translation: Merhaba, ben Joe, Leydi Keli'nin kapi bekcisiyim.

english: Hi, who are you guarding here?
Can't say, all very secret. You should get out of here. I am not supposed to talk while I guard.
translation: Söyleyemem, cok gizli. Buradan gitmelisin. Bekcilik yaparken konusmamam gerekiyor.

english: Halt! Who goes there? Friend or foe?
translation: Dur! Kim var orada? Dost mu düsman mi?

english: Hi friend, I am just checking out things here.
translation: Merhaba dostum, sadece etrafi kontrol ediyorum.

english: The Prince got away, I am in trouble. I better not talk to you, they are not sure I was drunk.
translation: Prens kacti, basim belada. Seninle konusmasam iyi olur, sarhos oldugumdan emin degiller.

english: I won't say anything, your secret is safe with me.
translation: Hicbir sey söylemem, sirrin bende güvende.

english: Hello there. Would you like to see the goods I have for sale?
translation: Merhaba. Satilik mallarimi görmek ister misin?

english: Yes please, Jofridr.
No thank you, Jofridr.
Fairthee well.
Why do you have so much wool in your store? I haven't seen any sheep anywhere.
translation: Dükkaninda neden bu kadar cok yün var? Hicbir yerde koyun görmedim.

english: Ah, I have contacts on the mainland. I have a sailor friend who brings me crates of wool on a regular basis.
translation: Ah, anakarada baglantilarim var. Bana düzenli olarak yün kasalari getiren bir denizci arkadasim var.

english: What do you trade for it?
Rope of course! What else can we sell? Fish would go off before it got so far south.
translation: Tabii ki ip! Baska ne satabiliriz ki? Balik bu kadar güneye gelmeden bozulur.

english: Where does all this rope go?
Err, I don't remember the name of the place very well. Dreinna? Drennor? Something like that.
translation: Sey, yerin adini cok iyi hatirlamiyorum. Dreinna? Drennor? Öyle bir seydi.

english: That's very interesting. Thanks Jofridr.
Would you like to see the goods I have for sale?
Yes please, Jofridr
No thank you, Jofridr
Why do you have so much wool in your store?
translation: Dükkaninda neden bu kadar cok yün var?

english: Welcome [Brother/Sister]...to our organisation...ours is a fight for humanity in all its shapes and forms...and to rid mankind of the monsters that exist in our world. We have no quarrel with a fellow [brother/sister].
translation: Hos geldin kardesim... organizasyonumuza... bizimki, insanlik icin her türlü mücadeledir... ve dünyamizda var olan canavarlari insanliktan yok etmek icin. Bizim kardeslerimizle bir sorunumuz yok.

english: What kind of organisation is this?
We're a proactive organisation working towards the cessation of monsters in normal civilised human society. There seems to be no backbone in this land so we're stepping up to the challenge.
translation: Biz, normal medeni insan toplumunda canavarlarin ortadan kaldirilmasi icin calisan proaktif bir organizasyonuz. Bu topraklarda omurga yok gibi görünüyor, bu yüzden biz bu görevi üstleniyoruz.

english: Hmm, how do you propose to do that? I mean, I see people everyday killing goblins around here!
translation: Hmm, bunu nasil yapmayi düsünüyorsunuz? Yani, her gün bu civarda goblinleri öldüren insanlar görüyorum!

english: We're mobilising people and we're starting our own society...cleaning out the caves once inhabited by these foul creatures and defending them so that they can never again shelter sub human species.
translation: Insanlari harekete geciriyoruz ve kendi toplumumuzu kuruyoruz... Bu igrenc yaratiklarin bir zamanlar yasadigi magaralari temizliyor ve bir daha asla insanlik disi türlere barinak saglamamalari icin onlari koruyoruz.

english: That sounds kind of strange, but hey it's your choice.
translation: Kulaga biraz garip geliyor, ama hey, bu senin secimin.

english: Who are you and what do you do here?
translation: Kimsin sen ve burada ne yapiyorsun?

english: My name is Johanhus and I lead these glorious people on a courageous mission called, 'Humans against Monsters', we mean to make this land free of monsters so we can all live in peace.
translation: Adim Johanhus ve bu sanli insanlari “Insanlar Canavarlara Karsi” adli cesur bir görevde yönetiyorum. Bu topragi canavarlardan arindirmak ve hepimizin baris icinde yasayabilmesini saglamak istiyoruz.

english: Okay, thanks.
Hey, I've found this, do you know anything about it?
translation: Hey, bunu buldum, bununla ilgili bir sey biliyor musun?

english: Yes, in fact I do. I wrote many essays for this book, it was a great seller, many people are stirred by the words and feelings in such a tome.
translation: Evet, aslinda biliyorum. Bu kitap icin bircok makale yazdim, cok satti, bircok insan bu kalin kitabin icindeki sözler ve duygulardan etkilendi.

english: Are you planning to do anything about the cave goblins?
translation: Magara goblinleri hakkinda bir sey yapmayi planliyor musun?

english: You should know, [brother/sister]...we don't let ordinary members in on all our plans...but rest assured those foul creatures will be dealt with very soon!
translation: Bilmelisin ki, kardesim... siradan üyelere tüm planlarimizi aciklamayiz... ama emin ol ki, o igrenc yaratiklar cok yakinda halledilecek!

english: Can't you please tell me?
No! That kind of information is for...only senior members of the group. Ordinary members like you must learn to...trust your leaders.
translation: Hayir! Bu tür bilgiler sadece grubun üst düzey üyeleri icin. Senin gibi siradan üyeler liderlerine güvenmeyi ögrenmelidir.

english: No! That kind of information is for...only senior members of the group. Why should I tell it to an...outsider?
translation: Hayir! Bu tür bilgiler sadece grubun üst düzey üyeleri icin. Neden bunu bir yabanciya söyleyeyim ki?

english: Is it really necessary?
How can you even...ask that? Right beneath Lumbridge is a whole cave system full of those creatures! They've got a passage leading right up into the castle kitchen!
translation: Bunu nasil sorabilirsin? Lumbridge'in hemen altinda, bu yaratiklarla dolu bir magara sistemi var! Kale mutfagina giden bir gecitleri var!

english: And I've heard that there's a whole city of those things down there, not that anyone has ever seen it. What have they got in there? What are they planning?
translation: Ve orada, kimsenin görmedigi, bu yaratiklardan olusan bir sehir oldugunu duydum. Orada ne var? Ne planliyorlar?

english: We've got to get them before they get us!
translation: Onlar bizi yakalamadan biz onlari yakalamaliyiz!

english: That's good.
So, you got out of the cell? No matter...your goblin friend has already been dealt with...and Sigmund is on his way to deal with the rest of her foul brood!
translation: Demek hücreden ciktin? Önemli degil... goblin arkadasinla zaten ilgilenildi... ve Sigmund, onun igrenc soyunun geri kalaniyla ilgilenmek icin yolda!

english: I can't hear anything.
Shh! I can hear them.
Good news, brothers! Our tunnel from the water mill cellar has reached the cave goblin tunnels, and the last shipment of machinery is on its way from Keldagrim.
translation: Iyi haberler var kardeslerim! Su degirmeni mahzeninden actigimiz tünel, magara goblinlerinin tünellerine ulasti ve son makine sevkiyati Keldagrim'den yola cikti.

english: Do we have to deal with the dwarves? They may not exactly be monsters but they're still not human.
translation: Cücelerle ugrasmak zorunda miyiz? Onlar tam olarak canavar sayilmazlar ama yine de insan degiller.

english: If it wasn't for the King's tolerance of monsters, we humans would have a better industry than the dwarves!
translation: Kralin canavarlara karsi hosgörülü olmasaydi, biz insanlar cücelerden daha iyi bir sanayiye sahip olurduk!

english: Well said, brother!
I'll need to take some of the low-level members to help unload the machinery at the Lumbridge water mill.
translation: Lumbridge su degirmeninde makineleri bosaltmak icin bazi düsük seviyeli üyeleri götürmem gerekecek.

english: By all means. It's about time that lot made themselves useful.
translation: Tabii ki. Artik o adamlarin kendilerini ise yarar hale getirmelerinin zamani geldi.

english: Soon the mighty River Lum will wash away those evil goblins forever!
translation: Yakinda güclü Lum Nehri o kötü goblinleri sonsuza dek silip süpürecek!

english: Saradomin will surely bless us for destroying those abominations!
translation: Saradomin, o igrenc yaratiklari yok ettigimiz icin bizi kesinlikle kutsayacak!

english: Death to the Dorgeshuun!
Death to the Dorgeshuun!
Death to the Dorgeshuun!
Death to the Dorgeshuun!
Death to the Dorgeshuun!
What kind of organisation is this?
Who are you and what do you do here?
Ok, thanks.
Are you planning to do anything about the cave goblins?
translation: Magara goblinleri hakkinda bir sey yapmayi planliyor musunuz?

english: Can't you please tell me?
Is it really necessary?
That's good.
ZzzzZzzZZzzZZzz.
He's sleeping peacefully. Loudly, but peacefully.
translation: Huzur icinde uyuyor. Gürültülü ama huzur icinde.

english: Hello there!
Who are you?
I'm John, I specialise in archaeology and there's some very interesting ruins in this area.
translation: Ben John, arkeoloji uzmani ve bu bölgede cok ilginc kalintilar var.

english: Is that like fossils and stuff?
Oh my word no. Archaeology is the study of sentient races history through study of artefacts and ruins.
translation: Hayir, hayir. Arkeoloji, eserler ve kalintilar üzerinde calisarak bilincli irklarin tarihini inceleyen bilim dalidir.

english: Weren't fossils sentient?
Well... we have no proof to suggest such.
translation: Sey... bunu gösteren bir kanitimiz yok.

english: What is going on here?
This is our base camp for exploration of this wonderful island.
translation: Burasi bu harika adayi kesfetmek icin kurdugumuz ana kampimiz.

english: Anything I can do to help?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: No, no. You've already helped admirably. Our lives are much more comfortable thank you.
translation: Hayir, hayir. Zaten cok yardimci oldun. Hayatimiz cok daha rahat, tesekkürler.

english: What should I do?
Explore! There's so much here we don't understand.
translation: Kesfet! Burada anlamadigimiz cok sey var.

english: But where?
I've heard there's a pretty spectacular structure up near the mountain, but I haven't gone there yet.
translation: Dagin yakininda oldukca muhtesem bir yapi oldugunu duydum, ama henüz oraya gitmedim.

english: Who are you?
What is going on here?
What should I do?
I am so very tired... Leave me be... to rest...
translation: Cok yorgunum... Beni rahat birak... dinlenmeme izin ver...

english: Hello again. My family now considers you a hero.
translation: Merhaba tekrar. Ailem artik seni bir kahraman olarak görüyor.

english: Maybe because... I am.
Yes well... Is there anything I can help you with?
translation: Evet, peki... Size yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Can you change my gauntlets for me?
Yes certainly, though it will cost you 25,000 coins.
Great thanks!
Johnathon takes your gauntlets from you, and begins a low chant over them. You see them begin to glow and sparkle, before he returns them to you.
translation: Johnathon eldivenlerinizi alir ve üzerlerinde alcak sesle bir ilahi söylemeye baslar. Eldivenler parlamaya ve isildamaya baslar, sonra size geri verir.

english: No that's okay thanks.
No thanks.
I have received word from my father that you assisted us again! I get the feeling you weren't going to stop trying until you did though.
translation: Babamdan, bize yine yardim ettiginizi duydum! Ama sanirim basarana kadar denemekten vazgecmeyecektiniz.

english: If you want, I'll provide you with as many pairs of Chaos gauntlets as you wish to say thanks!
translation: Isterseniz, tesekkür etmek icin istediginiz kadar Kaos eldiveni verebilirim!

english: You will find the power of bolt spells increases substantially whilst wearing these gauntlets.
translation: Bu eldivenleri taktiginizda, yildirim büyülerinin gücü önemli ölcüde artar.

english: Thank you.
Here you go!
You're welcome.
Can you change my gauntlets for me?
Great thanks!
No that's okay thanks.
No thanks.
Could I have another pair of Chaos gauntlets?
translation: Bir cift daha Kaos eldiveni alabilir miyim?

english: You're welcome.
You are unusually helpful for an outerlander, Darkal Dräpare.
translation: Bir yabanci icin alisilmadik derecede yardimseversin, Darkal Dräpare.

english: Ehm, thanks... I guess.
This dish turned out horrendously.
How come?
It... tastes like nothing...
Jon shows you an empty bowl.
translation: Jon sana bos bir kase gösterir.

english: Isn't that bowl empty?
So nothing tastes the same cause nothing is never there?
translation: Hicbir seyin tadi ayni degil cünkü hicbir sey yok mu?

english: I'll be going...
That's probably for the best.
Hello there.
Hello, lovely day we're having.
Same as every day really, the weather is very consistent around here.
translation: Her gün oldugu gibi, buradaki hava cok istikrarli.

english: Hello there. Have you heard of Camorra?
Who?
Camorra. She was a great hero who fought in the Dragonkin Conflicts. I think she travelled to Kourend during the war. I'm trying to find out what happened to her.
translation: Camorra. Ejderha Savaslari'nda savasan büyük bir kahramandi. Sanirim savas sirasinda Kourend'e gitmisti. Ona ne oldugunu ögrenmeye calisiyorum.

english: A hero? Well she wouldn't have had much to do with Hosidius. The early Hosidius settlers were all pacificts, they'd have stayed away from people like her.
translation: Bir kahraman mi? Hosidius'la pek bir ilgisi olmazdi. Hosidius'un ilk yerlesimcileri barisseverdi, onun gibi insanlardan uzak dururlardi.

english: Oh well. Thanks for the help.
Can't stop to talk human. Lady Lovakengj might need me.
translation: Konusmaya vaktim yok insan. Leydi Lovakengj'in bana ihtiyaci olabilir.

english: Hi there.
All is lost!
Sorry?
Don't bother, you're not experienced enough to help me!
translation: Bosuna ugrasma, bana yardim edecek kadar deneyimli degilsin!

english: Just look around you! This great building will soon be in ruin.
translation: Etrafina bir bak! Bu muhtesem bina yakinda harabeye dönecek.

english: Great building?
Of course! This building has a history spanning generations!
translation: Tabii ki! Bu binanin nesiller boyu uzanan bir tarihi var!

english: Ah, I see, a great history. But why will it be in ruin?
translation: Ah, anliyorum, büyük bir tarih. Ama neden yikilacak?

english: It's to be ripped apart to make way for King Lathas' new alchemists' lab.
translation: Kral Lathas'in yeni simyaci laboratuvari icin yikilacak.

english: Does the king not respect the outpost's GREAT history?
translation: Kral, karakolun BÜYÜK tarihine saygi duymuyor mu?

english: Well, actually nobody knows what the history is. But there must be something.
translation: Aslinda kimse tarihini bilmiyor. Ama bir seyler olmali.

english: Wait a minute. You could help me!
Me?
Yes! Uncover the history of this building to convince King Lathas to leave it alone. Do you want to know more?
translation: Evet! Bu binanin tarihini ortaya cikararak Kral Lathas'i onu yikmamaya ikna et. Daha fazla bilgi ister misin?

english: Tell me more.
A cutscene appears.
With many occupants over the years...
translation: Yillar boyunca bircok kisiye ev sahipligi yapan...

english: ...the building has seen much action.
translation: ...bu bina pek cok olaya tanik olmustur.

english: It started life as an outpost...
... its sole purpose being to see invading armies...
... before they saw the city of Ardougne.
The cutscene disappears.
If all goes well, I hope to be able to turn it into a museum as a monument to the area's history. What do you think?
