translation: Her sey yolunda giderse, burayi bölgenin tarihine adanmis bir müzeye dönüstürmeyi umuyorum. Ne dersin?

english: OK, I will make a stand for history!
Oh thank you so much, you really are my saviour!
translation: Cok tesekkür ederim, gercekten benim kurtaricim oldun!

english: But where should I start?
What do I need to do now?
There are three people that may be able to help:
There is a silver trader in East Ardougne called Erin, who I believe can help.
translation: Dogu Ardougne'da Erin adinda bir gümüs tüccari var, onun yardimci olabilecegini düsünüyorum.

english: In what way can he help?
His Great Grandfather lived in this outpost according to the records. He must know something!
translation: Kayitlara göre büyük büyükbabasi bu karakolda yasamis. Bir seyler biliyor olmali!

english: OK, I'll see what he has to say.
I've been told that there's a ghost far off in Port Phasmatys that moans of losing his life to this place.
translation: Port Phasmatys'te, bu yerde hayatini kaybettigi icin inleyen bir hayalet oldugunu duydum.

english: Sounds ominous. Does he have a name?
translation: Kulaga ürkütücü geliyor. Adi var mi?

english: He does indeed. It's Droalak.
I'll track him down.
It might not be so simple! You'll need an amulet of ghostspeak to talk to him!
translation: O kadar kolay olmayabilir! Onunla konusmak icin hayaletlerle konusma tilsimi gerekir!

english: I've conversed with the dead before, that shouldn't be too much of a problem.
translation: Daha önce ölülerle konusmustum, bu cok da sorun olmamali.

english: Up near the mountains, in Rellekka is a warrior called Dron whom I have spoken to in the past. He is always on the lookout for information that can improve his fighting and commanding skills.
translation: Daglarin yakininda, Rellekka'da Dron adinda bir savasci var, onunla daha önce konusmustum. Savasma ve komuta becerilerini gelistirebilecek bilgiler arayisinda.

english: And how's he related to this outpost?
translation: Peki bu karakol ile ne ilgisi var?

english: He isn't directly, but he's studied many wars, and as this used to be an outpost it should have been involved in some war.
translation: Dogrudan bir ilgisi yok, ama bircok savasi incelemis ve burasi eskiden bir karakol oldugu icin bir savasa dahil olmus olmali.

english: That sounds simple enough.
He isn't the easiest person to talk to, so you may need to speak to his brother, Blanin, first.
translation: Konusmasi kolay birisi degil, bu yüzden önce kardesi Blanin ile konusman gerekebilir.

english: What's the story so far?
What do you mean? You've discovered nothing!
translation: Ne demek istiyorsun? Hicbir sey kesfetmedin ki!

english: Got to go, bye!
I don't care about some dusty building.
It's doomed. DOOMED!
Thanks for the help again. Feel free to browse the room next door!
translation: Yardimin icin tekrar tesekkürler. Yan odayi rahatca gezebilirsin!

english: Hello there, I have this master clue he...
translation: Merhaba, elimde bu önemli ipucu var...

english: Stop! I can't help you unless you help me out first.
translation: Dur! Sen bana yardim etmeden ben sana yardim edemem.

english: Okay then, moving on...
Hi Jorral, I have come to ask you to help with something.
translation: Merhaba Jorral, senden bir konuda yardim istemeye geldim.

english: What can I do for you [Player name]?
Ah! Remember that enchanted key you had to use previously?
translation: Ah! Daha önce kullanman gereken büyülü anahtari hatirliyor musun?

english: Yes, I do.
Well this should function much the same, the deeper magic of the key itself is stored within this strange device.
translation: Bu da ayni sekilde calismali, anahtarin derin büyüsü bu garip cihazin icinde sakli.

english: You should feel it, and it will guide you to where you need to go.
translation: Onu hissetmelisin, o da seni gitmen gereken yere götürecektir.

english: You should make some room for it before I can give you it.
translation: Sana vermeden önce bunun icin biraz yer acmalisin.

english: Be careful with it, the raw magic can damage you unexpectedly when you feel it.
translation: Dikkatli ol, ham büyü hissettiginde sana beklenmedik bir sekilde zarar verebilir.

english: No, I don't.
Ah, well the enchanted key can lead you to treasure. The magical nature of the key heats it up or cools it down, depending on your proximity to the treasure.
translation: Ah, büyülü anahtar seni hazineye götürebilir. Anahtarin büyülü yapisi, hazineye olan yakinligina bagli olarak onu isitir veya sogutur.

english: Hey Jorral, I have one of those clue scrolls again, do you have any advice?
translation: Hey Jorral, yine o ipucu parsömenlerinden bir tane buldum, bir tavsiyen var mi?

english: That strange device will guide you in the same way the key did. Feel it, but be careful as it is very powerful. Good luck.
translation: O garip cihaz, anahtarin yaptigi gibi sana yol gösterecektir. Onu hisset, ama cok güclü oldugu icin dikkatli ol. Iyi sanslar.

english: Tell me more.
Yes.
A trader in Ardougne
A ghost in Port Phasmatys
A warrior in Rellekka
What's the story so far?
What do I need to do now?
Got to go, bye!
No.
I don't care about some dusty building
Yes, I do.
No, I don't.
Do you want to trade?
What are you selling?
The finest smiths from all over Gielinor come here to work, and I buy the fruit of their craft. Armour made from the higher metals!
translation: Gielinor'un dört bir yanindan en iyi demirciler buraya calismaya geliyor ve ben onlarin eserlerini satin aliyorum. Yüksek kaliteli metallerden yapilmis zirhlar!

english: Let's have a look then.
No thanks.
You just don't appreciate the beauty of fine metalwork.
translation: Sen kaliteli metal isciliginin güzelligini takdir etmiyorsun.

english: Only the top smiths are allowed in there!
translation: Oraya sadece en iyi demirciler girebilir!

english: What are you selling?
Let's have a look then.
No thanks.
If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: Senin kadar cirkin olsaydim, halka acik yerlerde yüzümü göstermeye cesaret edemezdim!

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: Oh! Sey... Az önce bir tane yedim de ondan!

english: Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: Hayatina deger veriyorsan bir daha benimle konusma!

english: Get lost!
I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: Sana verecek hicbir seyim yok, birak beni rahat, dilenci.

english: Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
translation: Su anda bununla ugrasacak vaktim yok.

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: Senin gibi zavalli bir et yiginiyla konusmak istemiyorum.

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: Cok kötü bir gün... tadini cikarin.

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: Eger birini yakalarsan, paylasacagina söz ver.

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
You smell familiar...
Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: Buralarda insan gördün mü? Cok acim.

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: Bana kan tadi seven biri gibi görünüyorsun.

english: Good day to you, my friend.
Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
translation: Kaleye gidip biraz atistirmak ister misin?

english: Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: Bana bir dakika izin ver, dislerimde bir sey sikismis...

english: I see you managed to escape from those monsters intact!
translation: Görüyorum ki o canavarlardan sag salim kacmayi basarmissin!

english: It seems I was not as injured as I thought I was after all! I must thank you again for all of your help! Now, about that casket you found on that monster's corpse...
translation: Görünüse göre sandigim kadar yaralanmamisim! Yardimlarin icin sana tekrar tesekkür etmeliyim! Simdi, o canavarin cesedinde buldugun tabut hakkinda...

english: I have it here. You said you might be able to tell me something about it...
translation: Burada. Bana onunla ilgili bir seyler söyleyebilecegini söylemistin...

english: I can indeed! Here, let me have a closer look... Yes! There is something written on it!
translation: Tabii ki söyleyebilirim! Dur, bir yakindan bakayim... Evet! Üzerinde bir seyler yaziyor!

english: It is very faint, however... Can you read it?
I think it says... Saradomin...
Are you sure? I mean, are you REALLY sure? Maybe you'd better look again...
translation: Emin misin? Yani, GERCEKTEN emin misin? Belki bir daha bakmalisin...

english: Nope, it definitely says Saradomin.
I think you're right! Hand it here, and let's see what's inside!
translation: Sanirim haklisin! Ver sunu, icinde ne var bir bakalim!

english: Wow! It's a Holy Book of Saradomin! I thought these things had all vanished! Well, it's all yours, I hope you appreciate it.
translation: Vay canina! Bu Saradomin'in Kutsal Kitabi! Bunlarin hepsi yok oldu saniyordum! Artik senin, umarim degerini bilirsin.

english: Nope, it definitely says Zamorak.
Wow! It's an Unholy Book of Zamorak! I thought these things had all vanished! Well, it's all yours, I hope you appreciate it.
translation: Vay canina! Bu Zamorak'in Kutsal Kitabi! Bunlarin hepsinin yok oldugunu saniyordum! Peki, bu senin, umarim begenirsin.

english: Nope, it definitely says Guthix.
Wow! It's Guthix's Book of Balance! I thought these things had all vanished! Well, it's all yours, I hope you appreciate it.
translation: Vay canina! Bu Guthix'in Denge Kitabi! Bunlarin hepsinin yok oldugunu saniyordum! Peki, bu senin, umarim begenirsin.

english: I wish it were one of the other gods. I'd prefer my reward to be aligned to a different god, not Saradomin, Zamorak or Guthix.
translation: Keske diger tanrilardan biri olsaydi. Ödülümün Saradomin, Zamorak veya Guthix degil, baska bir tanriya ait olmasini tercih ederim.

english: The sea's always washing up interesting stuff around my lighthouse. Perhaps I'll find something more suitable for you in future.
translation: Deniz, deniz fenerimin etrafina her zaman ilginc seyler vuruyor. Belki gelecekte sana daha uygun bir sey bulurum.

english: For now, this casket definitely says Saradomin, Zamorak or Guthix. Which do you think it is?
translation: Simdilik, bu sandikta kesinlikle Saradomin, Zamorak veya Guthix yaziyor. Sence hangisi?

english: I think it says... Zamorak...
I think it says... Guthix...
Guthix
I never had any casket from that monster...?
translation: O canavardan hic sandik almadim ki...?

english: Why, of course you did! You dropped it and I picked it up! Now, free up some inventory space so we can see what's inside it.
translation: Tabii ki aldin! Sen düsürdün, ben aldim! Simdi, icinde ne oldugunu görebilmemiz icin envanterinde yer ac.

english: Why, of course you did! You dropped it and I picked it up! I have it right here!
translation: Tabii ki aldin! Sen düsürdün, ben aldim! Burada duruyor!

english: Now let's have a look at it... There is some writing on it, but it is very faint... Can you make it out?
translation: Simdi bir bakalim... Üzerinde bir yazi var, ama cok silik... Okunabiliyor mu?

english: I have it stored safely.
Well, bring it here and let's take a look at it!
translation: Peki, buraya getir de bir bakalim!

english: Ah yes, I wanted to talk to you about the casket you found on that monster's corpse...
translation: Ah evet, o canavarin cesedinde buldugun tabut hakkinda seninle konusmak istiyordum...

english: Hello again, adventurer. What brings you this way?
translation: Merhaba yine, maceraci. Seni buraya ne getirdi?

english: Can I see your wares?
Sure thing! I think you'll find my prices are remarkable!
translation: Tabii ki! Fiyatlarimin cok uygun oldugunu göreceksiniz!

english: Have you found any more prayerbooks?
Have you found any more prayerbooks?
It's amazing how things like that keep washing up on the shore in caskets. Take a look at what I've got...
translation: Bu tür seylerin tabutlar icinde kiyiya vurmaya devam etmesi gercekten sasirtici. Elimdekilere bir bakin...

english: Nothing, really. Good bye.
translation: Hicbir sey yok, gercekten. Hosca kalin.

english: Saradomin
Zamorak
I wish it were one of the other gods.
Can I see your wares?
Nothing, really. Good bye.
translation: Hicbir sey yok, gercekten. Hosca kalin.

english: Hello there. What do you need?
What do you do around here?
I mostly look after the lab equipment and make sure things run as they should.
translation: Cogunlukla laboratuvar ekipmanlarina bakiyorum ve her seyin gerektigi gibi calistigindan emin oluyorum.

english: These days, I'm not much into the production side of things... All that moving up and down, pulling levers, carrying vials... These old bones ain't what they used to be.
translation: Bu günlerde, üretim tarafiyla pek ilgilenmiyorum... Yukari asagi hareket etmek, kollari cekmek, siseleri tasimak... Bu yasli kemikler eskisi gibi degil.

english: Thanks! I'd better be going now.
You alchemists sure wear a lot of safety gear.
translation: Siz kimyagerler gercekten cok fazla güvenlik ekipmani giyiyorsunuz.

english: Of course! Some of the mixtures down here can get pretty nasty in their raw form. Safety first!
translation: Tabii ki! Buradaki bazi karisimlar ham halleriyle oldukca tehlikeli olabilir. Güvenlik önce gelir!

english: Although between you and me... I'm not sure if anything this lab produces can be considered truly safe for human consumption.
translation: Ama aramizda kalsin... Bu laboratuvarin ürettigi hicbir seyin insan tüketimi icin gercekten güvenli oldugunu sanmiyorum.

english: Yikes! I guess I'll not be trying anything then!
translation: Vay canina! O zaman hicbir seyi denemeyecegim!

english: Nothing. I'll be going now.
What do you do around here?
Thanks! I'd better be going now.
You alchemists sure wear a lot of safety gear.
translation: Siz kimyagerler gercekten cok fazla güvenlik ekipmani giyiyorsunuz.

english: Nothing. I'll be going now.
You'll need a weapon to try and attack this beast.
translation: Bu canavari saldirmak icin bir silaha ihtiyacin olacak.

english: The Jubbly Bird is too quick for your melee weapon.
translation: Jubbly Kusu, yakin dövüs silahin icin cok hizli.

english: Magic simply won't affect this beast!
Your ranged weapon isn't powerful enough to hurt the Jubbly bird.
translation: Menzilli silahin Jubbly Kusu'na zarar verecek kadar güclü degil.

english: Sqwark!
Screech!
!!Croak!!
Gobble!
Rawk!
Dragon swords! Here, Dragon swords! Straight from Frenaskrae!
translation: Ejderha kiliclari! Iste, ejderha kiliclari! Frenaskrae'den geldi!

english: Yes please!
No thanks, I'm just browsing.
Yes please.
No thanks, I'm just browsing.
What are you doing here?
I'm blending in. Scopin' out the place.
Are you preparing for a heist? You're only a kid.
translation: Soygun mu hazirliyorsun? Sen daha cocuksun.

english: Let's just say there are some wealthy people about, with full pockets.
translation: Diyelim ki, burada cepleri dolu zengin insanlar var.

english: Any tips? I'm not having much luck myself.
translation: Herhangi bir ipucu var mi? Ben pek sansli degilim.

english: I'm quite sneaky. Every now and then I'll get their attention so their pockets aren't being so carefully watched.
translation: Ben oldukca sinsi biriyim. Arada sirada onlarin dikkatini cekiyorum, böylece ceplerini o kadar dikkatli izlemiyorlar.

english: That is sneaky. I'll keep an eye out for your... distractions.
translation: Bu cok sinsi. Senin... dikkatlerini dagitan seyleri gözlemleyecegim.

english: Now leave me be. I'm already distracting!
translation: Simdi beni rahat birak. Zaten dikkatlerini dagitiyorum!

english: Oh dear! Oh dear! I don't have time to chat!
translation: Oh hayir! Oh hayir! Sohbet edecek vaktim yok!

english: Please leave my husband alone. He's very sick, and I don't want anyone bothering him.
translation: Lütfen kocami rahat birak. Cok hasta ve kimsenin onu rahatsiz etmesini istemiyorum.

english: I'm sorry to hear that. Is there anything I can do?
translation: Bunu duyduguma üzüldüm. Yapabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Thank you, but I just want him to see a priest.
translation: Tesekkürler, ama sadece bir rahip görmesini istiyorum.

english: A priest? Hmmm...
Romeo, Romeo, wherefore art thou Romeo? Bold adventurer, have you seen Romeo on your travels? Skinny guy, a bit wishy washy, head full of poetry.
translation: Romeo, Romeo, neredesin Romeo? Cesur maceraci, seyahatlerinde Romeo'yu gördün mü? Zayif, biraz kararsiz, kafasi siirlerle dolu bir adam.

english: Yes I've met him. He seemed a bit depressed.
translation: Evet, onunla tanistim. Biraz depresif görünüyordu.

english: Yes, that sounds like Romeo. I'd be very grateful if you could deliver a message to him?
translation: Evet, Romeo'ya benziyor. Ona bir mesaj iletirsen cok minnettar olurum.

english: Certainly, I'll do so straight away.
Many thanks! Oh, I'm so very grateful. You may be our only hope.
translation: Cok tesekkürler! Oh, cok minnettarim. Sen bizim tek umudumuz olabilirsin.

english: No, he was a little too weird for me.
translation: Hayir, benim icin biraz fazla tuhafti.

english: Oh dear, that will be the ruin of our love. Well, I will just stay here and worry. You unromantic soul.
translation: Oh, bu askimizin sonu olacak. Peki, ben burada kalip endiselenecegim. Romantik olmayan ruh.

english: No, I think I'd have remembered if I'd met him.
Oh, well that's a shame, I was hoping that you might deliver a message to him for me.
translation: Oh, ne yazik, ona benim icin bir mesaj iletir misin diye umuyordum.

english: Sorry, but I don't even know what he looks like or where he is?
translation: Üzgünüm, ama onun neye benzedigini veya nerede oldugunu bile bilmiyorum.

english: Oh, he's so lovely...in his own soppy and confused way. You should spot him easily! He's usually fending off the advances of the Varrockian market women. Are you sure I couldn't persuade you to deliver my itsy bitsty
translation: Oh, o cok sevimli... kendi duygusal ve kafasi karisik haliyle. Onu kolayca fark edersin! Genelde Varrockian pazarindaki kadinlarin ilgisini savusturur. Romeo'ma kücük bir mesajimi iletmen icin seni ikna edemeyecegime emin misin?

english: widdle message to my Romeo?
translation: Hayir, üzgünüm, yapacak daha önemli islerim var.

english: No, sorry, I have better things to do.
translation: O zaman seni alikoymayacagim. Hosca kal.

english: Then, I will not keep you from them. Goodbye.
I guess I could look for him for you.
Oh, that would be so wonderful of you! I'd be most grateful if you could please deliver a message to him?
translation: Oh, bu cok nazikce olur! Ona bir mesaj iletirsen cok minnettar olurum.

english: I think you could do better than Romeo!
He has his good points, he's not obsessed with fighting, magic and ranging at least.
translation: Iyi yanlari da var, en azindan dövüsmeye, büyüye ve avlanmaya takintili degil.

english: I sat in that cold crypt for ages waiting for Romeo.
translation: O soguk mezarda Romeo'yu bekleyerek saatlerce oturdum.

english: That useless fool never showed up.
translation: O ise yaramaz aptal hic gelmedi.

english: And all I got was indigestion. I am done with men like him.
translation: Ve tek elde ettigim sey hazimsizlik oldu. Onun gibi erkeklerden biktim.

english: Now go away before I call my father!
Juliet, I come from Romeo. He begs me to tell you that he cares still.
translation: Juliet, Romeo'dan geliyorum. Sana hala seni sevdigini söylememi istedi.

english: Oh how my heart soars to hear this news! Please take this message to him with great haste.
translation: Bu haberi duyunca kalbim nasil da costu! Lütfen bu mesaji ona hemen ilet.

english: Well, I hope it's good news...he was quite upset when I left him.
translation: Umarim iyi haberlerdir... Onu biraktigimda oldukca üzgündü.

english: He's quite often upset...the poor sensitive soul. But I don't think he's going to take this news very well, however, all is not lost.
translation: O sik sik üzülür... Zavalli hassas ruh. Ama bu haberi pek iyi karsilamayacagini düsünüyorum, ancak her sey kaybedilmis degil.

english: Everything is explained in the letter, would you be so kind and deliver it to him please?
translation: Her sey mektupta aciklanmis, lütfen ona iletir misin?

english: Hello Juliet!
Hello there...have you delivered the message to Romeo yet? What news do you have from my loved one?
translation: Merhaba... Romeo'ya mesaji ilettiniz mi? Sevgilimden ne haberler var?

english: Oh, sorry, I've not had chance to deliver it yet!
translation: Oh, üzgünüm, henüz iletme firsatim olmadi!

english: Oh, that's a shame. I've been waiting so patiently to hear some word from him.
translation: Oh, ne yazik. Ondan haber almak icin sabirla bekliyordum.

english: Hmmm, that's the thing about messages...they're so easy to misplace...
translation: Hmmm, mesajlar böyledir... cok kolay kaybolurlar...

english: How could you lose that message? It was incredibly important...and it took me an age to write! I used joined up writing and everything!
translation: O mesaji nasil kaybedebildin? Cok önemliydi... yazmak icin cok zaman harcadim! Baglantili yazi kullandim ve her seyi yaptim!

english: Please, take this new message to him, and please don't lose it.
translation: Lütfen bu yeni mesaji ona götür ve lütfen kaybetme.

english: Hi Juliet, I have passed your message on to Romeo..he's scared half out of his wits at the news that your father wants to kill him.
translation: Merhaba Juliet, mesajini Romeo'ya ilettim... babanin onu öldürmek istedigi haberine cok korkmus.

english: Yes, unfortunately my father is quite the hunter, you may have seen some the animal head trophies on the wall. And it would be so awful to see Romeo's head up there with them!
translation: Evet, ne yazik ki babam avcidir, duvardaki hayvan kafasi trofeleri görmüs olabilirsin. Romeo'nun kafasinin da orada olmasini görmek cok korkunc olurdu!

english: I know what you mean...
...his hair colour will clash terribly with the rest of the decoration.
translation: ...sac rengi diger dekorasyonlarla hic uyumlu olmayacak.

english: That's not what I was suggesting at all...
translation: Benim demek istedigim hic de o degildi...

english: I know, I know...I was just kidding.
Anyway, don't worry because I'm on the case. I'm going to get some help from Father Lawrence.
translation: Her neyse, endiselenme, ben bu konuyla ilgileniyorum. Peder Lawrence'tan yardim alacagim.

english: Oh yes, I'm sure that Father Lawrence will come up with a solution. I hope you find him soon.
translation: Evet, eminim Peder Lawrence bir cözüm bulacaktir. Umarim onu cabuk bulursun.

english: Hi Juliet!
Hi [player name], how close am I to being with my true love Romeo?
translation: Merhaba Maceraci, gercek askim Romeo'ya ne kadar yaklastim?

english: Sorry, I still have to get a special potion for you.
translation: Üzgünüm, senin icin özel bir iksir bulmam gerekiyor.

english: Oh, I hope it isn't a love potion because you would be wasting your time. My love for Romeo grows stronger every minute...
translation: Umarim ask iksiri degildir, cünkü zamanini bosa harcarsin. Romeo'ya olan askim her dakika daha da gücleniyor...

english: That must be because you're not with him...
translation: Bu, onunla birlikte olmadigin icin olmali...

english: Oh no! I long to be close to my true love Romeo!
translation: Oh hayir! Gercek askim Romeo'ya yakin olmak istiyorum!

english: Well, ok then...I'll set about getting this potion as quickly as I can!
translation: Peki, tamam o zaman... Bu iksiri olabildigince cabuk bulmaya calisacagim!

english: Fair luck to you, the end is close.
Hi Juliet! I have an interesting proposition for you...suggested by Father Lawrence. It may be the only way you'll be able to escape from this house and be with Romeo.
translation: Merhaba Juliet! Sana ilginc bir teklifim var... Peder Lawrence'in önerisi. Bu evden kacip Romeo'nun yanina gidebilmenin tek yolu bu olabilir.

english: Go on....
I have a Cadava potion here, suggested by Father Lawrence. If you drink it, it will make you appear dead!
translation: Burada Peder Lawrence'in önerdigi bir Cadava iksiri var. Eger icersen, seni ölü gibi gösterecek!

english: Yes...
And when you appear dead...your still and lifeless corpse will be removed to the crypt!
translation: Ve sen ölü gibi göründügünde... hareketsiz ve cansiz cesedin mezarliga götürülecek!

english: Oooooh, a cold dark creepy crypt...
translation: Oooooh, soguk, karanlik, ürkütücü bir mezarlik...

english: ...sounds just peachy!
Then...Romeo can steal into the crypt and rescue you just as you wake up!
translation: Sonra... Romeo mezarliga gizlice girip, sen uyanir uyanmaz seni kurtarabilir!

english: ...and this is the great idea for getting me out of here?
translation: ...ve bu beni buradan cikarmak icin harika bir fikir mi?

english: To be fair, I can't take all the credit...in fact...it was all Father Lawrence's suggestion...
translation: Dürüst olmak gerekirse, tüm övgüyü ben alamam...aslinda...hepsi Peder Lawrence'in önerisiydi...

english: Ok...if this is the best we can do...hand over the potion!
translation: Tamam...eger yapabilecegimizin en iyisi buysa...iksiri ver!

english: You pass the suspicious potion to Juliet.
Wonderful! I just hope Romeo can remember to get me from the crypt.
translation: Harika! Umarim Romeo beni mezardan almayi unutmaz.

english: Please go to Romeo and make sure he understands. Although I love his gormless, lovelorn soppy ways, he can be a bit dense sometimes and I don't want to wake up in that crypt on my own.
translation: Lütfen Romeo'ya gidip anladigindan emin ol. Onun aptal, ask acisi ceken, duygusal tavirlarini seviyorum ama bazen biraz kalin kafali olabiliyor ve o mezarda tek basima uyanmak istemiyorum.

english: A cutscene starts
Oh, here's Phillipa, my cousin...she's in on the plot too!
translation: Oh, iste kuzenim Phillipa... o da komploya dahil!

english: She's going to make it seem even more convincing!
translation: Olayi daha da inandirici hale getirecek!

english: Yes, I'm quite the actress! Good luck dear cousin!
translation: Evet, ben oldukca iyi bir oyuncuyum! Iyi sanslar sevgili kuzenim!

english: Right...bottoms up!
Urk!
Oh no...Juliet has...died!
You might be more believable if you're not smiling when you say it...
translation: Bunu söylerken gülümsemezsen daha inandirici olabilirsin...

english: Oh yeah...you might be right...ok, let's try again.
translation: Oh evet... hakli olabilirsin... tamam, tekrar deneyelim.

english: Oh no...Juliet has...died?
Perhaps a bit louder, like you're upset...that your cousin has died!
translation: Belki biraz daha yüksek sesle, üzgünmüs gibi. ...kuzenin öldü!

english: Right...yes...Ok, ok, I think I'm getting my motivation now. Ok, let's try this again!
translation: Tamam... evet... Tamam, tamam, sanirim simdi motivasyonumu buldum. Tamam, tekrar deneyelim!

english: OH NO...JULIET HAS...DIED?.... Oooooohhhhhh....(sob), (sob).Juliet...my poor dead cousin!
translation: OH HAYIR... JULIET... ÖLDÜ MÜ?.... Oooooohhhhhh.... (hickirik), (hickirik). Juliet... zavalli ölü kuzenim!

english: What's all that screaming?
Oh no! My poor daughter...what has become of you?
translation: Oh hayir! Zavalli kizim... sana ne oldu?

english: Poor Juliet...make preparations for her body to be placed in the Crypt...
translation: Zavalli Juliet... cesedinin mezara konulmasi icin hazirliklar yapin...

english: A cutscene ends
Oh, I just can't be bothered.
What's the matter Juliet?
I've been told I have to throw the birthday party at my place this year, but I don't feel like it, my life is just tragic.
translation: Bu yil dogum günü partisini benim evimde yapmam gerektigi söylendi, ama canim istemiyor, hayatim trajik.

english: I don't care about this party.
Sometimes I think my life's nothing but a comedy, but I don't let it get me down. Why so glum chum?
translation: Bazen hayatimin bir komedi oldugunu düsünüyorum, ama bunun moralimi bozmasina izin vermiyorum. Neden bu kadar somurtuyorsun dostum?

english: Romeo doesn't care for me anymore, the minute he saw Phillipa, he's been all over her. I have no one anymore.
translation: Romeo artik beni umursamiyor, Phillipa'yi gördügü anda ona kapildi. Artik kimsem yok.

english: Oh come on, it can't be that bad. Is Romeo really worth getting this upset over? He's a bit empty headed if you ask me.
translation: Hadi ama, o kadar da kötü olamaz. Romeo gercekten bu kadar üzülmeye deger mi? Bana sorarsan o biraz bos kafali.

english: He was all I had, now the only thing keeping me going is the soft sounds of Gertrude's Cats.
translation: O benim her seyimdi, simdi beni ayakta tutan tek sey Gertrude'un Kedileri'nin yumusak sesleri.

english: I have no-one in my life, I can't be with my love, Romeo. There is nothing for me to wake up to each day, I feel like my life is a repeat of the same day over and over.
translation: Hayatimda kimse yok, askim Romeo ile birlikte olamiyorum. Her gün uyanmak icin bir nedenim yok, hayatim ayni günün tekrari gibi geliyor.

english: You need to get out and enjoy life Juliet, slay some dragons and explore the world.
translation: Disari cikip hayatin tadini cikarmalisin Juliet, birkac ejderha öldür ve dünyayi kesfet.

english: I wouldn't go that far! I'm just tired of being locked in this house with just my cousin, Phillipa.
translation: O kadar da abartma! Sadece kuzenim Phillipa ile bu evde kapali kalmaktan biktim.

english: The only thing that cheers me up is looking over to Gertrude's house and seeing her kittens playing.
translation: Beni neselendiren tek sey Gertrude'un evine bakip kedilerinin oynadigini görmek.

english: Sounds like you need a new friend, would you like me to see if Gertrude will give you one of her kittens?
translation: Yeni bir arkadasa ihtiyacin var gibi görünüyor, Gertrude'un sana yavru kedilerinden birini verip vermeyecegini sormami ister misin?

english: I've asked her before, but we aren't on good standing anymore, ever since I planted lilies in our garden.
translation: Daha önce ona sormustum, ama bahcemize zambak diktigimden beri aramiz pek iyi degil.

english: Why would she be upset about lilies?
translation: Zambaklar neden onu rahatsiz etsin ki?

english: They're quite poisonous to cats, how was I supposed to know, I'm not a cat doctor...
translation: Kediler icin oldukca zehirlidirler, ben de bilemezdim, ben kedi doktoru degilim...

english: Maybe getting you a pet isn't a good idea then, perhaps I should go talk to your cousin for some ideas.
translation: O zaman sana bir evcil hayvan almak iyi bir fikir olmayabilir, belki de kuzeninle konusup fikir almaliyim.

english: I'll be here...alone, waiting for the next adventurer to come along and try to help.
translation: Ben burada... yalniz, bir sonraki maceracinin gelip yardim etmeye calismasini bekleyecegim.

english: Did my heart love till now? Forswear it, sight! For I ne'er saw true beauty till this night.
translation: Kalbim simdiye kadar sevdi mi? Yemin ederim, görme! Cünkü bu geceye kadar gercek güzelligi hic görmemistim.

english: All that glitters is not platinum.
All the world's a stage, And all the men and women merely players. They have their exits and their entrances. And one man in his time plays many parts,
translation: Bütün dünya bir sahne, ve bütün erkekler ve kadinlar sadece oyuncular. Onlarin girisleri ve cikislari var. Ve bir adam hayati boyunca bircok rol oynar,

english: His acts being seven ages.
Doubt thou the stars are fire. Doubt that the sun doth move. Doubt truth to be a liar. But never doubt I love.
translation: Yildizlarin ates oldugunu süphe et. Günesin hareket ettigini süphe et. Gercegin yalan oldugunu süphe et. Ama benim sevgimi asla süphe etme.

english: Double, double, toil and trouble. Fire burn, and cauldron bubble!
translation: Iki kat, iki kat, emek ve sikinti. Ates yan, ve kazan kaynayin!

english: Love's stories written in love's richest books. To fan the moonbeams from his sleeping eyes.
translation: Askin en zengin kitaplarinda yazilmis ask hikayeleri. Uyuyan gözlerinden ay isigini uzaklastirmak icin.

english: What are you mumbling to yourself Juliet?
Oh, I've just been reading a book, it helps me get through the day.
translation: Oh, sadece bir kitap okuyordum, günümü gecirmeme yardimci oluyor.

english: I need to find a way to cheer her up, Phillipa should be able to help, I just can't stand to see her like this.
translation: Onu neselendirmek icin bir yol bulmaliyim, Phillipa yardimci olabilir, onu böyle görmek dayanilmaz.

english: Hello again Juliet, I've got a surprise that might cheer you up.
translation: Merhaba Juliet, seni neselendirecek bir sürprizim var.

english: Where is it? I don't see anything?
Oh damn, where did I put them?
translation: Oh lanet olsun, nereye koydum bunlari?

english: Come back when you have something for me...
translation: Bana bir sey getirdiginde geri gel...

english: Juliet, I've got something for you.
Oh my! What's that on your head?
Since you can't have a cat, I thought I'd be one for you. Meeeeooow...
translation: Kedi sahibi olamadigina göre, ben senin icin kedi olacagim dedim. Miyav...

english: Oh wonderful! Are you going to dance for me then?
translation: Harika! Benim icin dans edecek misin?

english: Of course!
Wow...
Wow shred it dude!
Oh that's absolutely marvellous!
That's really impressive! You must oftrained very hard to pull that off.
translation: Gercekten etkileyici! Bunu basarmak icin cok calismis olmalisin.

english: That's cute, but sorry, you're not my type.
translation: Bu cok sevimli, ama üzgünüm, sen benim tipim degilsin.

english: Yawn, you just did that...
Don't do that.
Interesting.
Uhm...
You're so silly.
I love it!
Wonderful.
That's delightful.
Hehehe.
Why would you do that?
Please Stop.
That was weird.
Please don't do that again.
Wow, thanks [player name], I feel a lot better.
translation: Vay canina, tesekkürler Maceraci, kendimi cok daha iyi hissediyorum.

english: Oh Saradomin, that was embarrassing
translation: Oh Saradomin, bu cok utanc vericiydi.

english: Don't be embarrassed, you've made me feel better. I'm going to throw a big party to say thanks.
translation: Utanma, beni daha iyi hissettirdin. Tesekkür etmek icin büyük bir parti verecegim.

english: Maybe I don't need Romeo after all.
Head downstairs when you're ready. Oh, you can keep the ears as well.
translation: Hazir oldugunda asagi in. Oh, kulaklari da alabilirsin.

english: Hi Juliet, why aren't you downstairs enjoying the party?
translation: Merhaba Juliet, neden asagida partinin tadini cikarmiyorsun?

english: It's a little too loud for me down there, I'd rather stay up here and relax.
translation: Asagisi benim icin biraz fazla gürültülü, burada kalip dinlenmeyi tercih ederim.

english: To each their own, you've thrown a truly amazing party this year.
translation: Herkesin zevki kendine, bu yil gercekten harika bir parti düzenledin.

english: Yes I've met him.
Certainly, I'll do so straight away.
No, he was a little too weird for me.
translation: Hayir, benim icin biraz fazla tuhafti.

english: No, I think I'd have remembered if I'd met him.
Certainly, I will do so straight away.
No, sorry, I have better things to do.
translation: Hayir, üzgünüm, daha önemli islerim var.

english: I guess I could look for him for you.
I think you could do better than Romeo!
Ask about the birthday party.
Something else.
Good day, how may I help you?
What is this place?
This is the Marim branch of the Bank of Gielinor. Now that our people have more contact with the lands overseas, we have new business opportunities. Can I help you?
translation: Burasi Gielinor Bankasi'nin Marim subesi. Artik halkimiz denizasiri ülkelerle daha fazla temas halinde oldugundan, yeni is firsatlarimiz var. Size nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: I'd like to buy more bank slots.
translation: Daha fazla banka yuvasi satin almak istiyorum.

english: Why? You don't use the bank.
Oh yeah... Never mind then.
I can sell you up to [number] additional bank slots in sets of 40. How many are you interested in buying?
[number] slots please.
Buying [number] additional bank slots will cost [number] coins. Be warned, this purchase is not reversible. Are you happy to proceed?
Oh... I don't seem to have enough money for that. Never mind.
translation: Oh... Bunun icin yeterli param yok galiba. Bos verin.

english: Yes, I'm happy with that.
Your additional bank slots have been added.
Actually, I've changed my mind.
I'm fine, thanks.
What is this place?
I'd like to access my bank account, please.
I'd like to check my PIN settings.
I'd like to collect items.
I'd like to buy more bank slots.
translation: Daha fazla banka yuvasi satin almak istiyorum.

english: Yes.
No.
I'm fine, thanks.
Tell me... a story...
Okay...
Perhaps you should empty your hands before you begin.
translation: Belki de baslamadan önce ellerini bosaltmalisin.

english: You tell Juna some stories of your adventures.

Your story has entertained me. But it is a poor sort of adventurer who only tells stories of the past and does not find new stories to tell. I will not let you into the cave again until you have had more adventures!
translation: Hikayen beni eglendirdi. Ama sadece gecmisteki hikayeleri anlatan ve anlatacak yeni hikayeler bulamayan bir maceraci, zavalli bir maceracidir. Daha fazla macera yasamadan seni magaraya bir daha sokmayacagim!

english: You cannot enter the cave again until you have gained either one quest point or [experience due] total XP.
It has not been long since your last visit. Come back [tomorrow/in [amount] days].
I fear you will have no new stories to tell me. Come again when you have had more adventures.
translation: Bana anlatacak yeni hikayelerin olmayacagindan korkuyorum. Daha fazla macera yasadiktan sonra tekrar gel.

english: I fear you will have no new stories to tell me. Come again [tomorrow/in [amount] days] if you have had more adventures by then.
Your stories have entertained me. I will let you into the cave for a short time.
translation: Hikayelerin beni eglendirdi. Seni kisa bir süreligine magaraya alacagim.

english: Collect as much as you can from the blue streams. If you let in water from the green streams, it will take away from the blue. For Guthix is god of balance, and balance lies in the juxtaposition of opposites.
translation: Mavi akarsulardan olabildigince cok su topla. Yesil akarsulardan su girerse, mavi akarsulardan su cekilir. Guthix denge tanrisidir ve denge, zitliklarin bir arada bulunmasinda yatar.

english: The player enters the Tears of Guthix cave
You tell me a story.
The Third Age of the world was a time of great conflict, of destruction never seen before or since, when all the gods save Guthix warred for control.
translation: Dünyanin Ücüncü Cagi, Guthix haric tüm tanrilarin kontrol icin savastigi, daha önce ve sonra hic görülmemis büyük bir catisma ve yikim dönemiydi.

english: The colossal Wyrms, of whom today's dragons are a pale reflection, turned all the sky to fire, while on the ground armies of foot soldiers, goblins and trolls and humans, filled the valleys and plains with blood.
translation: Bugünün ejderhalarinin soluk bir yansimasi olan devasa Wyrms, gökyüzünü atese cevirirken, yerdeki piyade, goblin, trol ve insan ordulari vadileri ve ovalari kanla doldurdu.

english: In time the noise of the conflict woke Guthix from His deep slumber, and He rose and stood in the centre of the battlefield so that the splendour of His wrath filled the world, and He called for the conflict to cease!
translation: Zamanla catismanin gürültüsü Guthix'i derin uykusundan uyandirdi ve O, savas alaninin ortasinda ayaga kalkti, öfkesinin ihtisami dünyayi doldurdu ve catismanin sona ermesini emretti!

english: Silence fell, for the gods knew that none could challenge the power of the mighty Guthix -- for His power is that of nature itself, to which all other things are subject, in the end.
translation: Sessizlik cöktü, cünkü tanrilar, güclü Guthix'in gücüne kimsenin meydan okuyamayacagini biliyorlardi - cünkü O'nun gücü, sonunda tüm diger seylerin tabi oldugu doganin kendisinin gücüdür.

english: Guthix reclaimed that which had been stolen from Him, and went back underground to return to His sleep and continue to draw the world's power into Himself.
translation: Guthix, kendisinden calinan seyi geri aldi ve yeraltina geri dönerek uykusuna devam etti ve dünyanin gücünü kendine cekmeye devam etti.

english: But on His way into the depths of the earth He sat and rested in this cave; and, thinking of the battle-scarred desert that now stretched from one side of His world to the other, He wept.
translation: Ancak yerin derinliklerine inerken bu magarada oturup dinlendi ve dünyasinin bir ucundan diger ucuna uzanan savasin izlerini tasiyan cölü düsünerek agladi.

english: And so great was His sorrow, and so great was His life- giving power, that the rocks themselves began to weep with Him.
translation: Onun kederi o kadar büyüktü ve hayat veren gücü o kadar büyüktü ki, kayalar bile onunla birlikte aglamaya basladi.

english: Later, Guthix noticed that the rocks continued to weep, and that their tears were infused with a small part of His power.
translation: Daha sonra Guthix, kayalarin aglamaya devam ettigini ve gözyaslarinin onun gücünün kücük bir parcasiyla doldugunu fark etti.

english: So He set me, His servant, to guard the cave, and He entrusted to me the task of judging who was and was not worthy to access the tears.
translation: Böylece beni, hizmetkârini, magarayi korumakla görevlendirdi ve gözyaslarina erismeye layik olanlari ve olmayanlari yargilama görevini bana verdi.

english: Tell me about the Tears of Guthix.
I will tell you the story of the light-creatures.
Myriad and beautiful were the creatures and civilizationsof the early ages of the world. Gielinor was a work of art, shaped lovingly over the millennia by the creative mind of Guthix.
translation: Dünyanin ilk caglarinda sayisiz ve güzel yaratiklar ve medeniyetler vardi. Gielinor, Guthix'in yaratici zihni tarafindan binlerce yil boyunca sevgiyle sekillendirilmis bir sanat eseriydi.

english: Only the sturdiest races survived the Godwars, and even then only by abandoning their high culture and gearing their societies towards war. Of the more delicate races there is now no trace, and almost no memory.
translation: Sadece en dayanikli irklar Tanri Savaslari'ndan sag kurtuldu ve o da ancak yüksek kültürlerini terk edip toplumlarini savasa yönlendirerek. Daha hassas irklardan artik hicbir iz kalmadi ve neredeyse hic hatira da yok.

english: One such race had bodies as fragile as snowflakes, yet they built crystal cities that stood for a thousand years.
translation: Bu irklardan biri, kar taneleri kadar kirilgan bedenlere sahipti, ancak bin yil ayakta kalan kristal sehirler insa ettiler.

english: The wind would whisper through the spires and fill them with sweet harmonies, and the rising sun would shine through the precious gems that studded the towers and create inter plays of light as if rainbows were dancing.
translation: Rüzgar, kulelerin sivri uclarindan fisildayarak geciyor ve onlari tatli armonilerle dolduruyordu. Yükselen günes, kuleleri süsleyen degerli taslardan parlayarak, sanki gökkusaklari dans ediyormus gibi isik oyunlari yaratiyordu.

english: Indeed, so marvellous was this light-show at its height that the patterns of light themselves became alive, and great flocks of luminous creatures rode along the gem- cast beams, each drawn to its own colour.
translation: Gercekten de, bu isik gösterisi o kadar muhtesemdi ki, isik desenleri canlaniyor ve büyük isikli yaratik sürülerinin her biri kendi renginden etkilendigi mücevherlerden yayilan isinlar üzerinde süzülüyordu.

english: The creatures you see floating in this chasm are the last sorry remnants of that age. I do not know how they made their way here and survived to this time, but I am grateful for their company.
translation: Bu ucurumda süzülen yaratiklar, o cagin son kalintilaridir. Buraya nasil geldiklerini ve bu zamana kadar nasil hayatta kaldiklarini bilmiyorum, ama onlarin eslik ettikleri icin minnettarim.

english: Tell me about the light-creatures.

Not long after the start of my vigil a party of goblins happened on my cave. These were the ugly brutes of the gods' armies, but their armour bore a faded patch where the symbol of a god had been removed.
translation: Nöbetime basladiktan kisa bir süre sonra bir grup goblin magarama geldi. Bunlar tanrilarin ordularinin cirkin yaratiklariydi, ama zirhlarinda bir tanrinin sembolünün cikarildigi soluk bir yama vardi.

english: They looked around hesitantly, squinting in the light of crude torches, but as soon as they saw me they raised their spears and charged.
translation: Cayir mesalelerinin isiginda tereddütle etrafa bakindilar, ama beni görür görmez mizraklarini kaldirip saldirdilar.

english: No one may access the Tears of Guthix by force. I sent them tumbling into the chasm.
translation: Hic kimse Guthix'in Gözyaslarina zorla ulasamaz. Onlari ucuruma yuvarladim.

english: Two hundred years later another goblin found me. This one was unarmed, and although she was very wary I succeeded in engaging her in conversation.
translation: Iki yüz yil sonra baska bir goblin beni buldu. Bu goblin silahsizdi ve cok temkinli olmasina ragmen onunla konusmayi basardim.

english: Since then I have had many more visits from the descendants of those lost warriors, and over the centuries I have seen them change.
translation: O zamandan beri, o kayip savascilarin torunlari beni bircok kez ziyaret etti ve yüzyillar boyunca onlarin degistigini gördüm.

english: They have become timid rather than aggressive, and I have seen the light of intelligence grow in their bulging eyes.
translation: Saldirgan olmaktan cok cekingen hale geldiler ve siskin gözlerinde zeka isiginin parladigini gördüm.

english: Their stories are repetitive and grim, of scraping a living out of the harsh rock and through ingenuity and toil shaping it into a home.
translation: Hikayeleri tekrarlayici ve kasvetli; sert kayalardan gecimlerini sagliyorlar ve zekâlari ve emekleriyle onu bir yuvaya dönüstürüyorlar.

english: I have followed the progress of their race, but their individual stories hold little interest for me.
translation: Irklarinin gelisimini takip ettim, ancak bireysel hikayeleri beni pek ilgilendirmiyor.

english: Tell me about the Cave Goblins.
I'd like to receive messages prompting me to return here.
translation: Buraya geri dönmemi hatirlatan mesajlar almak istiyorum.

english: Very well, when you are eligible to drink from the Tears, you shall be reminded daily.
translation: Peki, Gözyaslari'ndan icmeye hak kazandiginda, her gün hatirlatma alacaksin.

english: I don't want any messages reminding me to return here.
Very well, it will be up to you to remember when you can return. It is good that you are willing to take responsibility for yourself in this way.
translation: Peki, ne zaman dönebilecegini hatirlamak sana kalmis. Bu sekilde sorumluluk almaya istekli olman iyi bir sey.

english: Can you do something with this icon?
translation: Bu simgeyle bir sey yapabilir misin?

english: So many aeons have passed since these were made. So many mortals have been born, lived their lives, then died as Balancerequires. What stories they must have known!
translation: Bunlar yapildigindan bu yana cok uzun zaman gecti. Cok sayida ölümlü dogdu, hayatlarini yasadi ve Balancerequires'in istedigi gibi öldü. Ne hikayeler biliyor olmalilar!

english: I would be happy to honour the dead by combining such an icon with your Staff of the Dead. Give the items to me, if you wish.
translation: Ölüleri onurlandirmak icin bu simgeyi Ölülerin Asasi ile birlestirmekten mutluluk duyarim. Isterseniz esyalari bana verin.

english: Okay, here you go...

I would happily honour the dead, and all the stories they must have known, by combining your Staff of the Dead with your icon of my master, Guthix. But this cannot be undone; they will be bound forever.
translation: Ölüleri ve onlarin bildigi tüm hikayeleri onurlandirmak icin Ölülerin Asasi'ni ustam Guthix'in simgesi ile birlestirmekten mutluluk duyarim. Ancak bu geri alinamaz; sonsuza kadar birbirlerine bagli kalacaklar.

english: Combine them. I understand it can't be undone.
Juna will offer to make multiple Staves of balance
translation: Juna, birden fazla Denge Asasi yapmayi teklif edecek.

english: No thanks.
Maybe another time.
I would be happy to honour the dead by combining such an icon with a Staff of the Dead, if you bring one to me.
translation: Ölüleri onurlandirmak icin böyle bir simgeyi Ölülerin Asasi ile birlestirmekten mutluluk duyarim, eger bana bir tane getirirseniz.

english: My weapon is sort of like a Staff of the Dead, don't you think?
translation: Silahim Ölülerin Asasi'na benziyor, sence de öyle degil mi?

english: It was, but I appear to have combined it with an icon already.
translation: Öyleydi, ama galiba onu zaten bir simge ile birlestirdim.

english: I cannot combine it with that.
I've got a weapon in my inventory that's sort of like a Staff of the Dead.
translation: Envanterimde Ölülerin Asasi'na benzeyen bir silah var.

english: It is not what I seek.
A Staff of the Dead, you say? Okay, thanks.
translation: Ölülerin Asasi mi dedin? Tamam, tesekkürler.

english: Not now.
I will not permit you to be in the cave for long. Collect as many tears as you can.
translation: Magarada uzun süre kalmana izin vermeyecegim. Mümkün oldugunca cok gözyasi topla.

english: Okay.
I want to get out now.
The player leaves the Tears of Guthix cave
If you wish to tell me more stories, come out here first.
translation: Bana daha fazla hikaye anlatmak istersen, önce buraya gel.

english: A Staff of the Dead! I would happily honour the dead, and all the stories they must have known, by combining your staff with an icon of my master, Guthix.
translation: Ölülerin Asasi! Asani, efendim Guthix'in simgesiyle birlestirerek, ölüleri ve onlarin bildigi tüm hikayeleri onurlandirmaktan mutluluk duyarim.

english: Perhaps you can find such an icon and bring it to me.
translation: Belki böyle bir simge bulup bana getirebilirsin.

english: I would happily honour the dead by combining such an icon with a Staff of the Dead, if you bring one to me.
translation: Bana böyle bir simge getirirsen, onu Ölülerin Asasi ile birlestirerek ölüleri onurlandirmaktan mutluluk duyarim.

english: I can do nothing more with that.
I cannot combine your icon with that weapon.
I do not need that from you.
Hey, I have something for you but you don't have any space for it!
translation: Hey, sana bir seyim var ama bunun icin yerin yok!

english: Your dedication to balance is astounding adventurer.
Here you go.
Okay...
You tell me a story.
Tell me about the Tears of Guthix
Tell me a new story.
Tell me about the light-creatures
Tell me about the Cave Goblins
I'd like to receive messages prompting me to return here.
translation: Buraya geri dönmemi hatirlatan mesajlar almak istiyorum.

english: I don't want any messages reminding me to return here.
Can you do something with this icon?
translation: Bu simgeyle bir sey yapabilir misin?

english: Okay, here you go...
Combine them. I understand it can't be undone.
translation: Onlari birlestir. Bunun geri alinamayacagini anliyorum.

english: No thanks.
Maybe another time.
Not now.
Okay.
I want to get out now.
Hello friend. You're a long way from Lumbridge!
How do I get into the Kharazi Jungle?
Well, I don't recommend just walking in! The last guy I saw try that barely escaped with his life.
translation: Sey, öylece iceri girmeni tavsiye etmem! En son bunu deneyen adam canini zor kurtardi.

english: Apparently he was on a mission to map the area. How foolish is that?
translation: Görünüse göre o bölgeyi haritalandirmak icin bir görevdeymis. Ne kadar aptalca bir sey bu?

english: Actually, I plan to map the jungle myself.
Oh. Oops. Sorry if I sounded rude, it just seems like a really bad idea.
translation: Oh. Pardon. Kaba davrandiysam özür dilerim, ama bu gercekten cok kötü bir fikir gibi görünüyor.

english: I mean it's a noble calling. Lots of people around here could use a proper map to navigate with. But, you know... there's something not quite right about that jungle.
translation: Yani, bu asil bir görev. Buralardaki bircok insan, yolunu bulmak icin düzgün bir haritaya ihtiyac duyabilir. Ama bilirsin... o ormanda bir seyler yolunda degil.

english: Best of luck though... Guthix knows, you'll need it.
translation: Yine de iyi sanslar... Guthix bilir, ihtiyacin olacak.

english: Do you have any other tips about the Kharazi Jungle?
translation: Kharazi Ormani hakkinda baska tavsiyen var mi?

english: Not really. Just be careful - there's a lot of weird stuff going on in there lately.
translation: Pek yok. Sadece dikkatli ol, son zamanlarda orada cok garip seyler oluyor.

english: Are you calling me foolish?
Er... maybe? I'll just be on my way...
translation: Sey... belki? Ben yoluma devam edeyim...

english: What do you do here?
I'm a forester, and I specialise in exotic woods. I haven't gone into the Kharazi myself, but I've found some interesting tree specimens out here.
translation: Ormanciyim ve egzotik agaclar konusunda uzmanim. Kharazi'ye kendim girmedim ama burada bazi ilginc agac örnekleri buldum.

english: If you do find a safe path into the jungle, do come and let me know. I'd love to have a nose around in there.
translation: Ormana güvenli bir yol bulursan gelip bana haber ver. Orayi kesfetmek isterim.

english: Have you seen any Kharazi tribespeople in the jungle?
translation: Ormanda Kharazi kabilesinden kimse gördün mü?

english: Oh yes, I've met loads of them! Lovely lot. I haven't seen many about recently, though.
translation: Evet, bir sürü gördüm! Cok sevimli insanlar. Ama son zamanlarda pek görmedim.

english: If you're looking to say hello, you'll need a Bullroarer. If you swing it above your head it makes a loud noise - that should attract someone's attention.
translation: Onlara merhaba demek istiyorsan, bir boga kükreyisi almalisin. Kafanin üzerinde salladiginda yüksek ses cikarir, bu da birilerinin dikkatini ceker.

english: Do you have a Bullroarer I could borrow?
translation: Ödünc alabilecegim bir boga kükreyisi var mi?

english: I wish I did! But I just have the one, and I've grown fond of it. Besides, I might need it if I ever get lost in the jungle.
translation: Keske olsaydi! Ama sadece bir tane var ve ona cok baglandim. Ayrica, ormanda kaybolursam ihtiyacim olabilir.

english: Will you trade something for it?
translation: Onunla bir sey takas eder misin?

english: Hmm, maybe. Tell you what, you show me something interesting and I'll see if it's worth my Bullroarer. How about that?
translation: Hmm, belki. Bak ne diyecegim, bana ilginc bir sey göster, ben de Bullroarer'imin karsiligini alip almayacagima bakayim. Ne dersin?

english: It's a deal!
Okay, thanks.
You're welcome! See you around...
I have a question about my Achievement Diary.
translation: Basari Günlügümle ilgili bir sorum var.

english: Sorry, I don't do that kind of thing any more. You should go and talk to Pirate Jackie in Brimhaven instead.
translation: Üzgünüm, artik o tür seylerle ilgilenmiyorum. Bunun yerine Brimhaven'daki Korsan Jackie ile konusmalisin.

english: Ugh, it's still raw! You can't serve me that. Take it away!
translation: Ugh, hala cig! Bana bunu servis edemezsin. Götür sunu!

english: I lost my Bullroarer, can I swap this delicious wrap for yours?
translation: Bullroarer'imi kaybettim, bu lezzetli dürümü seninkiyle takas edebilir miyim?

english: Go on then. Forestry is hungry work.
translation: Tamam o zaman. Ormancilik aclik veren bir istir.

english: On second thoughts, I might get hungry.
Sorry, but I have no use for that.
translation: Üzgünüm, ama bunun bana bir faydasi yok.

english: How do I get into the Kharazi Jungle?
Actually, I plan to map the jungle myself.
Do you have any other tips about the Kharazi Jungle?
translation: Kharazi Ormani hakkinda baska tavsiyen var mi?

english: Have you seen any Kharazi Tribesmen in the jungle?
translation: Ormanda Kharazi kabilesi mensuplari gördün mü?

english: Ok thanks.
Are you calling me foolish?
What do you do here?
Have you seen any Kharazi tribespeople in the jungle?
translation: Ormanda Kharazi kabilesi mensuplari gördün mü?

english: Okay, thanks.
Do you have a Bullroarer I could borrow?
translation: Ödünc alabilecegim bir boga borusu var mi?

english: Will you trade something for it?
How do I get into the Kharazi jungle?
I have a question about my Achievement Diary.
translation: Basari Günlügümle ilgili bir sorum var.

english: Yes
No
Hey, I'm Justine. I've got some rewards here for fighters who've done well in Lisa's Last Man Standing game. Wanna see?
translation: Merhaba, ben Justine. Lisa'nin Son Adam Ayakta Kalan oyununda basarili olan savascilar icin bazi ödüllerim var. Görmek ister misin?

english: What have you got?
No thanks.
Sorry, I don't offer refunds on items that people can trade with each other.
translation: Üzgünüm, insanlar arasinda takas edilebilen esyalar icin geri ödeme yapmiyorum.

english: Hey, that door's for staff only!
translation: Hey, o kapi sadece personel icin!

english: Sorry, shop's closed.
What have you got?
No thanks.
Can't you make an exception for me? I'm an Ironman by the way.
translation: Benim için bir istisna yapamaz misin? Bu arada ben bir Ironman'im.

english: My rule applies to the item regardless. Did you think I was going to cater differently to you?
translation: Kuralim her durumda geçerlidir. Sana farkli bir muamele yapacagimi mi sandin?

english: C'mon, almost got it...
Having problems?
Agh! You scared me! Now I've lost my lockpick.
translation: Ah! Beni korkuttun! Simdi de maymuncuklarimi kaybettim.

english: Oh, sorry about that. Do you want one of mine?
translation: Oh, özür dilerim. Benimkilerden birini ister misin?

english: Oh, sorry about that. I'm afraid I don't have one for you.
translation: Oh, özür dilerim. Maalesef sana verecek bir tane yok.

english: Don't worry about it, I brought an extra just in case. Lockpicks really do help with disarming these traps.
translation: Merak etme, ne olur ne olmaz diye fazladan bir tane getirdim. Kilit acma aletleri bu tuzaklari etkisiz hale getirmekte gercekten yardimci oluyor.

english: Oh, that's good to know, thanks for the tip! Out of curiosity, what outfit is that?
translation: Oh, bunu bilmek iyi oldu, ipucu icin tesekkürler! Merakimdan soruyorum, o kiyafet ne?

english: It's called the Rogue's outfit. I got it from the Rogue's Den in Burthorpe. I've found it helps me blend in when pickpocketing people, allowing me to steal more coins from them.
translation: Rogue'un kiyafeti deniyor. Burthorpe'daki Rogue's Den'den aldim. Insanlari yankesicilik yaparken ortama uyum saglamama yardimci oluyor, böylece onlardan daha fazla para calabiliyorum.

english: It looks cool. Does it also help here?
translation: Havali görünüyor. Burada da ise yariyor mu?

english: Ha ha ha, of course not! I don't think the coffin cares whether or not I blend in.
translation: Ha ha ha, tabii ki hayir! Tabutun benim ortama uyum saglamamla ilgilendigini sanmiyorum.

english: Good point. Why are you wearing it though if it doesn't help you get more loot?
translation: Haklisin. Daha fazla ganimet elde etmene yardimci olmuyorsa neden giyiyorsun?

english: Honestly, I just really like how it looks. You've got to look your best while travelling right?
translation: Dürüst olmak gerekirse, görünüsünü cok begeniyorum. Seyahat ederken en iyi sekilde görünmelisin, degil mi?

english: Each to their own I suppose. I'll be off. Best of luck down here.
translation: Herkesin zevki kendine sanirim. Ben gidiyorum. Burada bol sanslar.

english: And the same to you.
Agh, thought I had it that time!
The world begins to fade...
What happened? I rubbed that coin and everything went black!
translation: Ne oldu? O parayi ovusturdum ve her sey karardi!

english: Who are you? You're not the hero I gave my token to!
translation: Sen kimsin? Sen benim jetonumu verdigim kahraman degilsin!

english: How did you get that coin you used to summon me?
translation: Beni cagirmak icin kullandigin o parayi nasil buldun?

english: I took it from the dead body of a black dragon.
translation: Onu ölü bir kara ejderhanin cesedinden aldim.

english: I didn't realise what it would do if I rubbed it.
Who, or what, are you anyway?
My name is K'klik. I am a Fairy Dragon.
translation: Adim K'klik. Ben bir Peri Ejderhasiyim.

english: One of the last surviving members of my race, I fear.
translation: Korkarim, türümün hayatta kalan son üyelerinden biriyim.

english: Enough of that: you summoned me, so how can I help?
translation: Bu kadar yeter: beni cagirdin, nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: I'm afraid I don't understand.
The person who holds my token can summon me by rubbing it.
translation: Tokenimi elinde bulunduran kisi, onu ovusturarak beni cagirabilir.

english: They then have the right to request one thing of me before returning my token.
translation: Ardindan, tokemini geri vermeden önce benden bir sey isteyebilir.

english: So I can ask one thing of you?
translation: Yani senden bir sey isteyebilir miyim?

english: That's right. What do you want?
I'd like a horse, please.
No horses in Gielinor. Try again.
Can I wish for some xp?
Sorry, can't help. You'll have to ask the genie for that.
translation: Üzgünüm, yardimci olamam. Bunun icin cin'e sormalisin.

english: Could I just keep your token for when I really need it, please?
translation: Gercekten ihtiyacim oldugunda kullanmak üzere tokenini saklayabilir miyim lütfen?

english: I suppose that seems fair. Alright, just call me when you need me.
translation: Bu adil görünüyor. Tamam, ihtiyacin oldugunda beni cagir.

english: Please flambe this creme brulee for me.
translation: Lütfen bu crème brûlée'yi benim icin flambé yap.

english: Sure, that's easy.
That brûlée needs some more work before it's ready for flambéing.
translation: Bu brûlée flambé yapilmaya hazir hale gelmesi icin biraz daha calisilmasi gerekiyor.

english: Call me again when it's ready.
I'd like a horse, please.
Can I wish for some xp?
Could I just keep your token for when I really need it, please?
translation: Gercekten ihtiyacim oldugunda kullanmak icin tokenini saklayabilir miyim, lütfen?

english: Please flambe this creme brulee for me.
translation: Lütfen bu krem brüleleri benim icin flambé yap.

english: Human, I disconnected and lost my plastic plate of whatever food you call this. I want my items returned, now!
translation: Insan, baglantim koptu ve senin bu yemege ne dersen de, plastik tabagimi kaybettim. Esyalarimi geri istiyorum, hemen!

english: Woah hold on big fella' I can't do that.
translation: Dur bakalim koca adam, bunu yapamam.

english: Well then, I'll just unsubscribe from the dungeon and stop playing all together. Hrmph....
translation: Öyleyse, zindandan cikip oynamayi tamamen birakacagim. Hrmph....

english: Oh please, you were never really a popular boss anyway. You had to be given extra drops just to incentivise people to find you. Even then, I doubt anyone would notice if you disappeared.
translation: Oh lütfen, zaten hic popüler bir patron degildin. Insanlarin seni bulmasi icin ekstra ödüller verilmesi gerekiyordu. O zaman bile, kaybolsan kimse fark etmezdi.

english: *growls* Enjoy the party... mortal.
Kill them, you cowards!
Zamorak curse them!
Death to Saradomin's dogs!
Rend them limb from limb!
Flay them all!
Attack them, you dogs!
Forward!
Attack!
The Dark One will have their souls!
No retreat!
YARRRRRRR!
How's life in the light?
Burns slightly.
You seem much nicer than your father. He's mean.
translation: Babanizdan cok daha iyi birine benziyorsunuz. O cok kötü.

english: If you were stuck in a very dark cave for centuries you'd be pretty annoyed too.
translation: Yüzyillar boyunca cok karanlik bir magarada mahsur kalsan sen de oldukca sinirli olurdun.

english: I guess.
He's actually quite mellow really.
Uh.... Yeah.
Cower before my evil might!
Zamorak will show you no mercy!
For Zamorak!
*slap*
What?
How do you feel about all the more powerful monsters?
translation: Daha güclü canavarlar hakkinda ne düsünüyorsun?

english: There are no monsters more powerful than us!
We're the top monster of all Gielinor!
No you're not. The Kalphite Queen is more powerful than you!
translation: Hayir, degilsiniz. Kalphite Kralicesi sizden daha güclü!

english: Kalphite Queen? What's that?
translation: Kalphite Kralicesi mi? O da ne?

english: She's a giant insect who lives in the desert.
An insect?
Ha ha ha ha!
No insect could be tougher than us! We're the best!
translation: Hicbir böcek bizden daha güclü olamaz! Biz en iyisiyiz!

english: No, she's way tougher than you!
translation: Hayir, o sizden cok daha güclü!

english: I don't believe it!
And even if this Kalphite Queen is real, which I doubt, second best isn't bad, is it?
translation: Ve bu Kalphite Kralicesi gercek olsa bile, ki ben buna süpheliyim, ikinci olmak fena degil, degil mi?

english: But it's not just the Kalphite Queen. What about the TzTok-Jad?
translation: Ama sadece Kalphite Kralicesi degil. TzTok-Jad ne olacak?

english: Never heard of it!
Or the Dagannoth Rex?
You're making it up!
Or the Chaos Elemental?
Now then, how do you know you're not just making all these monsters up to demoralise us?
translation: Peki, tüm bu canavarlari bizi demoralize etmek icin uydurmadigini nereden biliyoruz?

english: All right then, what about me?
Puny human! You're not a fearsome monster!
translation: Zayif insan! Sen korkunc bir canavar degilsin!

english: I defeated you, didn't I? So I must be stronger than you!
translation: Seni yendim, degil mi? Demek ki senden daha güclüyüm!

english: You got lucky! I'll get you next time!
translation: Sansliydin! Bir dahaki sefere seni yenecegim!

english: Now that you're a stuffed head? I don't think so!
translation: Simdi kafan doldurulmus halde mi? Sanmiyorum!

english: Which of you heads is...
I am!
Shut up! I am!
Don't be silly! It's obvious that I am!
But you don't even know what I was going to say!
It doesn't matter. I'm the strongest, cleverest, and most attractive. Whatever it is, I am the most of it!
translation: Önemli degil. Ben en güclü, en zeki ve en cekiciyim. Ne olursa olsun, en iyisi benim!

english: Just a minute. What if it's something bad?
translation: Bir dakika. Ya kötü bir seyse?

english: Good point. What is it you were going to say? Because if it's something good, I'm it, but if it's something bad then it's one of these two ugly mugs.
translation: Haklisin. Ne söyleyecektin? Cünkü iyi bir seyse benim, ama kötü bir seyse bu iki cirkin suratlidan biri.

english: I've forgotten what I was going to ask now.
Me! I am!
Sorry, just said that on reflex.
Hey, [House owner] killed the King Black Dragon!
translation: Hey, [Ev sahibi] Kara Ejderha Krali öldürdü!

english: No [he/she] didn't!
What? Oh, ah, no, of course [he/she] didn't. We're actually an artificial likeness of the King Black Dragon. No one could really kill the King Black Dragon!
translation: Ne? Oh, ah, hayir, tabii ki öldürmedi. Aslinda biz Kara Ejderha Krali'nin yapay bir kopyasiyiz. Kimse Kara Ejderha Krali'ni öldüremez!

english: No! We're - I mean, it's - far too powerful!
translation: Hayir! Biz... Yani, o... cok güclü!

english: What are you talking about? Of course we're the King Black Dragon!
translation: Neden bahsediyorsun? Tabii ki biz Kral Kara Ejderhasiyiz!

english: Shut up, you idiot!
How do you feel about all the more powerful monsters?
translation: Daha güclü canavarlar hakkinda ne düsünüyorsun?

english: Which of you heads is...
Anyone there?
INTRUDER! Red alert! Batten down the hatches! DIVE, DIVE, DIVE!
translation: IZINSIZ GIRIS! Kirmizi alarm! Kapilari kapatin! DALIS, DALIS, DALIS!

english: Err, maybe I'll call back later.
translation: Sey, belki daha sonra tekrar ararim.

english: Hello.
The fish cannot ride the gravy train.
Sorry?
The cyclops cannot see his inner walrus?
translation: Tek gözlü dev, icindeki morsu göremiyor mu?

english: Is this code?
Waddle into a sunset of flaking mackerel?
translation: Pullanan uskumru baliginin gün batimina dogru yürümek mi?

english: I'm going now.
The sardine is leaving the tin?
There's been a breach! Red alert!
The KGP thinks you are a threat.
translation: KGP seni bir tehdit olarak görüyor.

english: Phew, that was a close call.
Urrrrgh!
Human.
Leave us.
Your presence is not desired.
How friendly.
But I need your help! I was sent by Asteros Arceuus, son of Lord Trobin Arceuus.
translation: Ama yardimina ihtiyacim var! Beni Lord Trobin Arceuus'un oglu Asteros Arceuus gönderdi.

english: Arceuus.
We know that name.
The name of a liar.
Liar?
They came to us. Two of them.
The brother and the husband.
Her time was running out. They wanted to give her more.
translation: Onun zamani dolmak üzereydi. Ona daha fazla zaman vermek istediler.

english: We granted them knowledge. To give her more time.
translation: Onlara bilgi verdik. Ona daha fazla zaman vermek icin.

english: But they misused it. And the world suffered.
translation: Ama onlar bunu kötüye kullandilar. Ve dünya aci cekti.

english: This knowledge? You mean immortality?
translation: Bu bilgi mi? Ölümsüzlük mü demek istiyorsun?

english: In a way. But it was not meant for that.
translation: Bir bakima. Ama bunun icin verilmemisti.

english: Time was what it was meant for. But time still runs out.
translation: Zaman icin verilmisti. Ama zaman yine de doluyor.

english: They put an end to time. They endagered the balance.
translation: Onlar zamana son verdiler. Dengeyi tehlikeye attilar.

english: What balance?
For every death, there must be life.
translation: Her ölüm icin bir yasam olmali.

english: For every life, there must be death.
translation: Her yasam icin bir ölüm olmali.

english: Perfectly balanced.
As all things should be.
We serve this balance.
For without balance, the world burns.
You're very confusing, you know that right?
translation: Cok kafa karistirici konusuyorsun, farkinda misin?

english: Perhaps.
Perhaps our knowledge is beyond your understanding.
translation: Belki de bilgimiz senin anlayisinin ötesindedir.

english: Well thankfully I didn't come here for knowledge. I came here for help. The Dark Altar is failing and the people of Arceuus are in danger. I need you to help me find the cause.
translation: Neyse ki buraya bilgi icin gelmedim. Yardim icin geldim. Karanlik Sunak cöküyor ve Arceuus halki tehlikede. Sebebini bulmama yardim etmelisin.

english: The people of Arceuus have had their time.
This will restore balance.
Why should we help them?
*sigh* It can never be easy can it.
translation: *ic cekis* Asla kolay olamaz, degil mi?

english: Fine. If you help me save the people of Arceuus, then I will help you.
translation: Peki. Arceuus halkini kurtarmama yardim edersen, ben de sana yardim ederim.

english: You assume we need help.
I've done this enough times to know that everyone wants something, even the masters of life and death.
translation: Bunu yeterince kez yaptim, herkesin bir sey istedigini biliyorum, hayat ve ölümün efendileri bile.

english: Interesting. Maybe the human is not as stupid as it looks.
translation: Ilginc. Belki de insan göründügü kadar aptal degildir.

english: Well I've been known to have my moments.
translation: Eh, benim de iyi yanlarim oldugu bilinir.

english: Very well human.
We admit, the Arceuus people do have their uses.
translation: Kabul ediyoruz, Arceuus halkinin yararlari var.

english: Their work with souls has been useful in helping to maintain the balance.
translation: Ruhlarla yaptiklari calismalar dengeyi korumaya yardimci oluyor.

english: We will help them. But first, you will serve us.
translation: Onlara yardim edecegiz. Ama önce bize hizmet edeceksin.

english: Excellent. What do you need from me?
To the south lies a battlefront.
There is a grave there. Within it lies a soul, trapped inside a corpse.
translation: Orada bir mezar var. Icinde bir ruh var, bir cesedin icinde hapsolmus.

english: Free this soul. In return, we will provide our help.
translation: Bu ruhu özgür birak. Karsiliginda sana yardim edecegiz.

english: So you just want me to kill a zombie?
translation: Yani benden bir zombiyi öldürmemi mi istiyorsun?

english: A zombie is soulless. An empty shell, reanimated by magic.
translation: Zombiler ruhsuzdur. Büyüyle yeniden canlandirilmis bos kabuklardir.

english: This is a soul. Trapped in this world, when it should have long departed.
translation: Bu bir ruh. Uzun zaman önce bu dünyadan ayrilmasi gerekirken, bu dünyada hapsolmus durumda.

english: Its existence is an affront to the balance.
Seems pretty simple.
Which is why it falls to you.
translation: Bu yüzden bu görev sana düsüyor.

english: Consider it a test.
If you pass.
We may have further use for you.
Hmmm. Very well, I'll go and free this soul.
translation: Hmmm. Pekala, gidip bu ruhu kurtaracagim.

english: The human returns.
I've dealt with the trapped soul.
You have done well.
The balance has been restored.
And now we shall help you.
While you were busy, so were we.
We have found the cause of your problem.
What is it?
You said the Altar was failing.
This is not correct.
The Altar is fine, but its power has been redirected.
translation: Altar iyi durumda, ama gücü baska bir yere yönlendirildi.

english: Redirected where?
To a construct built by a mortal.
translation: Bir ölümlü tarafindan insa edilen bir yapiya.

english: Right next to the Altar.
Find it. Destroy it.
And Arceuus will be saved.
So I just have to go to the Dark Altar, find this device and then destroy it. Sounds easy enough.
translation: Yani Karanlik Altar'a gidip bu cihazi bulup yok etmem gerekiyor. Kolay gibi görünüyor.

english: Then you have what you need.
translation: O zaman ihtiyacin olan seyi elde ettin.

english: You can leave us.
Go and save your people.
The human returns.
Tell me about yourselves.
We are the Tasakaal.
We serve the balance.
Between life.
And death.
Balance? So you serve Guthix?
A pretender.
We serve another power.
translation: Biz baska bir güce hizmet ediyoruz.

english: A higher power.
What power?
One beyond your understanding.
Why do you serve this power?
The anima of this world, it is fed by life.
Without life, there is no anima.
But life can also destroy. It can endanger the anima.
translation: Ama yasam ayni zamanda yok edebilir. Ruhu tehlikeye atabilir.

english: So life must be kept in check.
translation: Bu yüzden yasam kontrol altinda tutulmalidir.

english: This is our purpose.
And you were given this purpose?
translation: Ve bu amac size verildi mi?

english: Yes.
And no.
Our purpose was to wait. But we saw the world burn.
translation: Amacimiz beklemekti. Ama dünyanin yandigini gördük.

english: We could not stand by and watch.
So we left our people. Left our home.
translation: Bu yüzden halkimizi terk ettik. Evimizi terk ettik.

english: And took on a new purpose.
I'm still not sure I understand.
Maybe you never will.
Why did that soul need freeing?
Upon death, a soul should leave this world.
translation: Ölümle birlikte, ruh bu dünyayi terk etmelidir.

english: And move to the one beyond.
This soul remained.
It endangered the balance.
Was it always there?
No.
The body was of one who died a long time ago.
translation: Beden, uzun zaman önce ölen birine aitti.

english: But the soul was of one who died more recently.
translation: Ama ruh, daha yakin zamanda ölen birine aitti.

english: It possessed this body.
We know not why.
Is this something that often happens?
translation: Bu sik sik olan bir sey mi?

english: No.
It is a concerning occurrence.
We believe a mortal to be involved.
translation: Bir ölümlünün bu ise karistigini düsünüyoruz.

english: Meddling.
Where one should not meddle.
Interesting...
translation: Benden daha fazla yararlanabileceginizi mi söylediniz?

english: You said you might have further use for me?
We did.
What did you mean by that?
The task you performed.
It was a menial one.
Another could have filled your role.
translation: Baska biri de senin rolünü üstlenebilirdi.

english: But you showed promise.
So we tested you.
You passed.
You said it was an important task. Now you say it's a menial one. Which is it?
translation: Önemli bir görev oldugunu söylemistin. Simdi ise önemsiz bir görev oldugunu söylüyorsun. Hangisi dogru?

english: An important task can still be menial.
translation: Önemli bir görev yine de önemsiz olabilir.

english: There is no contradiction here.
Hmmm... If you say so.
So why was it only a small task? Surely saving the Arceuus people was worth more than that.
translation: Öyleyse neden sadece kücük bir görevdi? Arceuus halkini kurtarmak kesinlikle bundan daha degerliydi.

english: You assume it was a trade.
You assume wrong.
But you said I had to do it to save them?
translation: Ama onlari kurtarmak icin bunu yapmam gerektigini söylemistin?

english: Incorrect.
We had already committed to saving Arceuus.
But we needed time to determine the problem.
translation: Ama sorunu belirlemek icin zamana ihtiyacimiz vardi.

english: While we worked, you needed purpose.
translation: Biz calisirken, senin bir amaca ihtiyacin vardi.

english: So we gave you one.
translation: Bu yüzden sana bir amac verdik.

english: I feel a little bit used.
Then you should have paid more attention.
So what is the further use you have for me?
translation: Peki, benim icin baska ne gibi bir kullaniminiz var?

english: None.
For now.
But we will call on you again.
That, we can guarantee.
Why do you hate Lord Arceuus?
We granted them knowledge.
For a specific purpose.
But they misused it.
Them? Who else was there?
Another.
Another?
Another.
I can see we're not going to get anywhere here.
Goodbye.
Farewell human.
The human returns.
What do you know of Xeric?
That name.
It is not welcome here.
Right... sorry. What was it you called him? The great betrayer?
translation: Tamam... özür dilerim. Ona ne demistin? Büyük hain mi?

english: An apt description.
But why? What did he do?
Threatened the balance.
Plenty of people threaten the balance. Why was he especially bad?
translation: Bircok insan dengeyi tehdit ediyor. Neden o özellikle kötüydü?

english: It is not your concern.
What are you hiding? You call him a betrayer... Did he betray you? Did you work with him?
translation: Ne sakliyorsun? Ona hain diyorsun... Sana ihanet mi etti? Onunla mi calisiyordun?

english: It is not your concern.
Do you know anything about this rogue Pyromancer?
translation: Bu haydut Pyromancer hakkinda bir sey biliyor musun?

english: They are one of many.
We can't determine which one.
So you know nothing of them?
translation: Yani onlar hakkinda hicbir sey bilmiyorsun?

english: They have a great strength.
More than many of the others.
They sound dangerous. What do you plan to do?
Nothing.
Nothing?
The Doors of Dinh are safe.
They can do no more harm.
But whoever they are, they're working with Xamphur. Many lives could be at risk.
translation: Ama kim olurlarsa olsunlar, Xamphur ile calisiyorlar. Bircok hayat tehlikede olabilir.

english: Lives are always at risk.
But the balance is what matters.
Until it is threatened.
There is no need for action.
Tell me about yourselves.
Why did that soul need freeing?
You said you might have further use for me?
translation: Beni baska islerde de kullanabileceginizi söylemistiniz?

english: Why do you hate Lord Arceuus?
Goodbye.
What do you know of Xeric?
Do you know anything about this rogue Pyromancer?
