translation: Bu haydut Pyromancer hakkinda bir sey biliyor musunuz?

english: They put an end to time. They endangered the balance.
translation: Zamana son verdiler. Dengeyi tehlikeye attilar.

english: Good day.
Good? It is not good at all. The vampyres increase their efforts to crush us underfoot. These are hard times indeed.
translation: Iyi mi? Hic de iyi degil. Vampirler bizi ezmek icin cabalarini artiriyorlar. Gercekten zor zamanlar.

english: Yesss?
You can speak!?
Of courssse, sssome of usss remember the high ssspeech out old massster ssspoke in.
translation: Elbette, bazilarimiz eski ustamizin konustugu yüksek dili hatirliyoruz.

english: Hmm, I suppose I've never had a chance to speak with most Lizardmen, they're generally quite aggressive.
translation: Hmm, sanirim cogu Lizardman ile konusma firsatim olmadi, genellikle oldukca saldirganlar.

english: Yesss, we ssspeak the language of war far better. It isss the only way we know of.
translation: Evet, savas dilini cok daha iyi konusuyoruz. Bildigimiz tek dil bu.

english: This master you speak of...
I know only what my eldersss passssed down. Very little.
translation: Sadece büyüklerimin bana aktardiklarini biliyorum. Cok az sey.

english: How long ago since this master left you?
translation: Bu efendi sizi terk edeli ne kadar oldu?

english: Many generationsss have come and gone sssince he walked amongssst usss.
translation: O aramizda yürüdügünden beri bircok nesil geldi ve gitti.

english: Do you remember his name?
K'uhul ajaw isss the name we ssspeak. You manfolk ssspeak a different name.
translation: K'uhul ajaw bizim kullandigimiz isim. Siz insanlar farkli bir isim kullaniyorsunuz.

english: Hmmm...
Why are you down here?
Thisss isss our temple, we don't usssually get many visssitorsss... We make sssacrifice, offeringsss to our massster.
translation: Burasi bizim tapinagimiz, genellikle cok fazla ziyaretci almayiz... Efendimize kurbanlar, adaklar sunariz.

english: What kind of... sacrifices?
Thisss and that. Whatever out massster desssiresss.
translation: Su, bu. Efendimizin istedigi her sey.

english: Nevermind, bye.
Ye niauh, human.
You can speak!?
Why are you down here?
Nevermind, bye.
Hello! Who are you?
Hi there, my name is Kai and I'm the keeper of this here ent habitat.
translation: Merhaba, benim adim Kai ve buradaki ent habitatinin bekcisiyim.

english: What exactly is an ent?
Good question! Ents are ancient beings that resemble trees, we believe they draw their energy directly from nature.
translation: Iyi soru! Entler agaclara benzeyen eski varliklardir, enerjilerini dogrudan dogadan aldiklarina inaniyoruz.

english: Where did they come from?
Another good question! We're not sure exactly, we just know they're a very old race.
translation: Bir baska iyi soru! Tam olarak bilmiyoruz, sadece cok eski bir irk olduklarini biliyoruz.

english: I have heard of similar creatures roaming a desolate part of the eastern continent, though.
translation: Ancak, dogu kitasinin issiz bir bölgesinde benzer yaratiklarin dolastigini duydum.

english: Interesting... can I fight them?
Of course! There's no shortage of them residing within the dungeon, and they're a fantastic source of wood.
translation: Tabii ki! Zindanda bolca bulunuyorlar ve harika bir odun kaynagidirlar.

english: Thanks!
Thanks for the information, see you around.
That's nice, see you around.
What exactly is an ent?
Where did they come from?
Interesting... can I fight them?
Thanks for the information, see you around.
That's nice, see you around.
Hello, Bwana, what can I do for you today?
translation: Merhaba Bwana, bugün sizin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: Can you tell me a bit about this place?
Of course, Bwana. You look like a traveler!
translation: Tabii ki Bwana. Bir gezgin gibi görünüyorsunuz!

english: Yes, I am actually!
Well, I am a traveller myself, and I have set up this hostel for adventurers and travellers who are weary from their journey.
translation: Ben de bir gezginim ve yolculuktan yorgun düsen maceracilar ve gezginler icin bu hosteli kurdum.

english: There is a dormitory upstairs if you are tired. It costs 35 coins, which covers the costs of laundry and cleaning.
translation: Yorgunsaniz üst katta bir yatakhane var. Ücreti 35 sikke ve bu fiyata camasir yikama ve temizlik de dahil.

english: Have you anything for sale?
You buy a jug of wine for 1 coin.
translation: 1 jeton karsiliginda bir sürahi sarap satin alabilirsiniz.

english: You purchase a frothy glass of beer for 2 coins.
translation: 2 jeton karsiliginda köpüklü bir bardak bira satin alabilirsiniz.

english: You purchase a ticket to access the dormitory for 35 coins.
translation: 35 jeton karsiliginda yatakhaneye giris bileti satin alabilirsiniz.

english: You purchase five tickets to access the dormitory for 175 coins.
translation: 175 jeton karsiliginda yatakhaneye giris icin bes bilet satin alabilirsiniz.

english: I'm afraid you do not have enough money for that, Bwana.
translation: Korkarim bunun icin yeterli paraniz yok, Bwana.

english: I'm fine, thanks.
I have a question about my Achievement Diary.
translation: Basari Günlügümle ilgili bir sorum var.

english: Sorry, Bwana, I don't do that kind of thing anymore. You should go and talk to Pirate Jackie in Brimhaven instead. Can I help with anything else?
translation: Üzgünüm, Bwana, artik o tür islerle ugrasmiyorum. Bunun yerine Brimhaven'daki Korsan Jackie ile konusmalisin. Baska bir sey yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: I'm getting out of here Bwana, the place is infested with zombies.
translation: Buradan gidiyorum Bwana, burasi zombilerle dolu.

english: Can you tell me a bit about this place?
Have you anything for sale?
I'm fine, thanks.
Buy some wine: 1 coin
Buy some beer: 2 coins
Buy a night's rest: 35 coins
translation: Bir gecelik konaklama satin al: 35 sikke

english: Buy a pack of 5 dorm tickets: 175 coins
translation: 5 adet yatakhane bileti satin al: 175 sikke

english: Cancel
I have a question about my Achievement Diary.
translation: Basari Günlügümle ilgili bir sorum var.

english: Hello there.
I'm on duty, so you'll need to make this quick.
translation: Görev basindayim, bu yüzden cabuk olmalisin.

english: What do you do around here?
I typically hang out in the lab and keep an eye the newbies. Someone needs to make sure no one breaks anything or loses an eye.
translation: Genelde laboratuvarda takiliyorum ve yeni gelenleri gözetliyorum. Kimsenin bir sey kirmamasi veya gözünü kaybetmemesi icin birinin göz kulak olmasi gerekiyor.

english: Last week we had someone trying to churn butter in the agitator. They weren't around for long. I really wish they'd start properly vetting new society members.
translation: Gecen hafta biri karistiricida tereyagi yapmaya calisti. Uzun süre kalamadilar. Keske yeni üyeler daha iyi bir sekilde incelense.

english: Thanks! I'd better be going now.
What's your favourite potion?
For me, its the Anti-leech lotion. I despise leeches.
translation: Benimki, sülük önleyici losyon. Sülüklerden nefret ederim.

english: Oh, that's surprising. I don't think I've seen many around here...
You've obviously never been swimming anywhere in the Tlati Rainforest...
translation: Belli ki Tlati Yagmur Ormani'nda hic yüzmedin...

english: Nothing. I'll be going now.
What do you do around here?
Thanks! I'd better be going now.
What's your favourite potion?
Nothing. I'll be going now.
Hey there.
Yes please! How many do you have?
How many what?
I'll take the lot!
Right...
Hello! I've had a few to drink!
I haven't had that many, have I?
translation: O kadar cok icmedim, degil mi?

english: 'Oh there once was a dwarf named Tonalo! He started a fight with a buffalo!'
translation: “Bir zamanlar Tonalo adinda bir cüce vardi! Bir bufalo ile kavga etmeye basladi!”

english: What?
'He kicked and he punched, it was quite the show! But he tripped on a rock and stubbed his toe!'
translation: “Tekmeledi ve yumrukladi, tam bir gösteriydi! Ama bir kayaya takilip parmagini incitti!”

english: What? I didn't even do it!
Checheche!
What is it with your kind and potato cactus?
translation: Sizin türünüzün patates kaktüsüyle ne alip veremediginiz var?

english: Truthfully?
Yeah, please.
Soup. We make a fine soup with it.
translation: Corba. Onunla güzel bir corba yapiyoruz.

english: Kalphites can cook?
Nah, we just collect it and put it there because we know fools like yourself will come down looking for it then inevitably be killed by my mother.
translation: Hayir, sadece topluyoruz ve oraya koyuyoruz cünkü senin gibi aptallarin onu aramaya gelecegini ve kacinilmaz olarak annem tarafindan öldürülecegini biliyoruz.

english: Evidently not, that's how I got you!
translation: Belli ki öyle degil, yoksa seni nasil yakalardim!

english: Touché.
Hello.
Gotta find a way out. We built this maze for protection but I can't get used to it. I'm always getting lost.
translation: Bir cikis yolu bulmaliyim. Bu labirenti korunmak icin yaptik ama ben alisamadim. Sürekli kayboluyorum.

english: Hello, how are you?
Oh my. I'll never find my way back before Khazard's men come and hunt me down.
translation: Aman tanrim. Khazard'in adamlari gelip beni avlamadan önce asla geri dönüs yolunu bulamayacagim.

english: Hello there.
Oh my, oh my, the village has been pillaged and I'm still lost. Oh dear.
translation: Aman tanrim, aman tanrim, köy yagmalanmis ve ben hala kaybolmus durumdayim. Aman tanrim.

english: Hello little man.
Hello. I hope they come out and find me soon. It's getting cold.
translation: Merhaba. Umarim yakinda gelip beni bulurlar. Hava soguyor.

english: Hello there, you look lost.
Are you trying to be funny?
No.
Hmmm.
Hi there, you okay?
Ooooh, my head... I'm fried.
What's wrong?
Too much of this home brew my friend. We make it from plant roots, but it blows your head off.
translation: Bu ev yapimi ickiden fazla ictin dostum. Bitki köklerinden yapiyoruz ama kafani ucuruyor.

english: You don't wanna put it near any naked flames. I've got a barrel full of it here, want some?
translation: Acik atese yaklastirma. Burada bir fici dolusu var, ister misin?

english: Okay then.
Here you go... Hic!
You take a sip of brew from Kamen's glass...
...it tastes horrific and burns your throat.
Ha ha! I warned you that it's strong stuff. Have a good meal. It may sober you up a bit.
translation: Ha ha! Güclü bir sey oldugunu söylemistim. Afiyet olsun. Biraz ayilmani saglayabilir.

english: Thanks. Enjoy your brew.
Oh I will.
Ha ha! I warned you that it's strong stuff. A good meal may sober you up a bit. I could part with some food for a few coins.
translation: Ha ha! Sana güclü bir sey oldugunu söylemistim. Iyi bir yemek seni biraz ayiltabilir. Birkac sikke karsiliginda biraz yemek verebilirim.

english: 75 coins pleashe.
Oh dear, I haven't enough money...
Sorry, I can't just give it away to anyone that walks past.
No thanks.
Well come back any time.
Your losh... Hic!
Well maybe a good meal? I've got some spare.
translation: Belki iyi bir yemek? Biraz fazlam var.

english: Well maybe a good meal? I could part with some food for a few coins.
translation: Belki iyi bir yemek? Birkac kurus karsiliginda biraz yemek verebilirim.

english: Okay then.
No thanks.
Why hello there! I'm Kamfreena. Like the look of my pets? I think they're eyeing you up.
translation: Merhaba! Ben Kamfreena. Evcil hayvanlarimin görünüsünü begendin mi? Sanirim seni süzüyorlar.

english: That was a really bad pun.
translation: Bu gercekten kötü bir kelime oyunuydu.

english: Sorry... I don't get to see the rest of the guild much, stuck up here. The Cyclopes don't talk much you see.
translation: Üzgünüm... Burada tikilip kaldigim icin guildin geri kalanini pek göremiyorum. Cyclopesler pek konuskan degildirler.

english: Shouldn't that be cyclopses?
Nope! Cyclopes is the plural of cyclops. One cyclops, many cyclopes.
translation: Hayir! Cyclopes, cyclops'un coguludur. Bir cyclops, bircok cyclopes.

english: Oh, right, thanks.
Where are they from?
They're from the far east lands.
How did they get here?
Ahh.. our guildmaster, Harrallak, went on an expedition there. He brought them back with him.
translation: Ahh... guildmasterimiz Harrallak oraya bir kesif gezisine gitti. Onlari da yaninda getirdi.

english: Why are they here?
For the warriors to train on of course! They also drop a rather nice blade.
translation: Tabii ki savascilar icin egitim amacli! Ayrica oldukca iyi bir kilic da birakiyorlar.

english: Oh? What would that be?
Defenders.
Err what are they?
It's a blade you can defend with using your shield hand, like I have.
translation: Benimki gibi, kalkan elinle savunma yapabilecegin bir kilic.

english: Wow!

For every 10 tokens you collect around the guild, you can spend one minute in with my pets. As you get defenders you can show them to me to earn even better ones... but remember if you lose them you'll have
translation: Lonca cevresinde topladigin her 10 jeton icin, evcil hayvanlarimla bir dakika gecirebilirsin. Savunuculari aldikca bana göstererek daha iyilerini kazanabilirsin... ama unutma, onlari kaybedersen

english: to start at bronze again. I'd advise keeping a spare in your bank.
translation: bronz seviyesinden tekrar baslamak zorunda kalirsin. Bankada yedek bir tane bulundurmani tavsiye ederim.

english: Okay!
Oh, by the way, you'll need to earn 100 tokens before I'll let you in!
translation: Oh, bu arada, seni iceri almam icin 100 jeton kazanman gerekiyor!

english: Right, I'd better go play some games then!
translation: Tamam, o zaman gidip biraz oyun oynasam iyi olacak!

english: Bye!
See you back here soon I hope!
Well, since you haven't shown me a defender to prove your prowess as a warrior,
translation: Savasci olarak yetenegini kanitlamak icin bana bir savunmaci göstermedigine göre,

english: I'll release some cyclopes which might drop bronze defenders for you to start off with, unless you show me another. Have fun in there.
translation: baslangic icin bronz savunmacilar düsebilecek bazi sikloplar salacagim, tabii bana baska bir tane göstermezsen. Iceride iyi eglenceler.

english: Ahh I see that you have one of the defenders already! Well done.
translation: Ahh, savunuculardan birine zaten sahip oldugunu görüyorum! Aferin.

english: I'll release some cyclopes which might drop the next defender for you. Have fun in there.
translation: Sana bir sonraki savunucuyu düsürebilecek bazi sikloplar salacagim. Iceride iyi eglenceler.

english: Your time is up, please make your way to the exit.
translation: Süren doldu, lütfen cikisa dogru ilerle.

english: Next time, please leave as soon as your time is up.
translation: Bir dahaki sefere, süren doldugunda hemen cik lütfen.

english: You must keep your attack skillcape or max cape equipped to stay in the area.
translation: Bu alanda kalmak icin saldiri beceri pelerinini veya maksimum pelerini giymis olmalisin.

english: I remember you....
You don't have the defender you earned last time.
translation: Gecen sefer kazandigin savunmaci sende yok.

english: Err... no, don't have it on me. I kind of... lost it.
translation: Sey... hayir, yanimda degil. Ben onu... kaybettim.

english: Sorry, but as you've lost any that you earned before I can only let you in to kill the cyclopes that drop the bronze defenders. Go on in when you're ready.
translation: Üzgünüm, ama daha önce kazandiklarini kaybettigin icin, seni sadece bronz savunmacilari düsüren sikloplari öldürmek icin iceri alabilirim. Hazir oldugunda iceri gir.

english: I have a Bronze defender, please let me in to kill some more Cyclopes!
translation: Bronz savunmacim var, lütfen iceri girip biraz daha Cyclopes öldürmeme izin verin!

english: Bronze eh? The next cyclopes are ready, toddle in when you're ready.
translation: Bronz mu? Bir sonraki Cyclopes hazir, hazir oldugunuzda iceri girin.

english: I have a Iron defender, please let me in to kill some more Cyclopes!
translation: Demir savunmacim var, lütfen iceri girip biraz daha Cyclopes öldürmeme izin verin!

english: Wow, iron eh? The next cyclopes are ready, toddle in when you're ready.
translation: Vay canina, demir mi? Bir sonraki Cyclopes hazir, hazir oldugunuzda iceri girin.

english: I have a Steel defender, please let me in to kill some more Cyclopes!
translation: Celik savunmacim var, lütfen iceri girip biraz daha Cyclopes öldürmeme izin verin!

english: Strong as steel eh? The next cyclopes are ready, toddle in when you're ready.
translation: Celik kadar güclü mü? Siradaki sikloplar hazir, hazir oldugunda iceri gir.

english: I have a Black defender, please let me in to kill some more Cyclopes!
translation: Siyah savunucum var, lütfen iceri girip birkac siklop daha öldürmeme izin verin!

english: Black, hmmm, about half way to Rune then! Keep going! Cyclopes have been released. Enter when you're ready.
translation: Siyah, hmmm, o zaman Rune'a yari yolda sayilir! Devam et! Sikloplar serbest birakildi. Hazir oldugunda iceri gir.

english: I have a Mithril defender, please let me in to kill some more Cyclopes!
translation: Mithril savunucum var, lütfen iceri girip birkac siklop daha öldürmeme izin verin!

english: Mithril? Getting good at this aren't you! Okay, I've released those cyclopes that sometimes drop adamant defenders. Enter when you're ready.
translation: Mithril mi? Bu iste iyilesiyorsun, degil mi? Tamam, bazen adamant savunuculari düsüren o sikloplari serbest biraktim. Hazir oldugunda gir.

english: I have an Adamant defender, please let me in to kill some more Cyclopes!
translation: Adamant savunucum var, lütfen iceri girip birkac Cyclops daha öldürmeme izin verin!

english: An adamant defender eh? Trying for the Rune defender I'm betting. Okay, I've released those cyclopes. Enter when you're ready.
translation: Adamant savunucu mu? Rune savunucusu icin deniyorsun herhalde. Tamam, o sikloplari serbest biraktim. Hazir oldugunda gir.

english: I have a Rune defender, please let me in to kill some more Cyclopes!
translation: Rune savunucum var, lütfen daha fazla Cyclopes öldürmem icin beni iceri al!

english: Well done, you truly are a brilliant warrior! You should speak to my apprentice Lorelai in the basement for an additional challenge.
translation: Aferin, gercekten harika bir savascisin! Ek bir görev icin bodrumdaki ciragim Lorelai ile konusmalisin.

english: If you'd rather stay up here, I've released the cyclopes. Enter when you're ready.
translation: Burada kalmak istersen, Cyclopes'leri serbest biraktim. Hazir oldugunda gir.

english: Ahh I see that you've collected the highest defender I can offer you. Well done.
translation: Ahh, sana sunabilecegim en yüksek savunucuyu topladigini görüyorum. Aferin.

english: There's an old friend of mine named Lorelai in the guild basement. You should go visit her and maybe she'll let you search for a dragon defender.
translation: Guild bodrumunda Lorelai adinda eski bir arkadasim var. Onu ziyaret etmelisin, belki sana bir ejderha savunucusu aramana izin verir.

english: Ahh I see that you have one of the rune defenders already! Well done.
translation: Ahh, görüyorum ki zaten bir rune savunucun var! Aferin.

english: You should speak to my apprentice Lorelai in the basement and test yourself against even stronger Cyclopes!
translation: Bodrumdaki ciragim Lorelai ile konus ve daha da güclü Cyclopes'lere karsi kendini sinamalisin!

english: The Cyclopes up here will continue to have a chance of dropping rune defenders. Have fun in there.
translation: Buradaki Cyclopes'lar rune savunuculari düsürmeye devam edecek. Iyi eglenceler.

english: I have a Dragon defender, please let me in to kill some more Cyclopes!
translation: Bir Dragon savunucum var, lütfen daha fazla Cyclopes öldürmem icin beni iceri al!

english: Well done! You can only get more Dragon defenders from the basement.
translation: Aferin! Dragon savunuculari sadece bodrumdan alabilirsin.

english: If you'd rather stay up here, I've released the cyclopes that can drop rune defenders. Enter when you're ready.
translation: Burada kalmak istersen, rune savunuculari düsürebilen cyclopes'lari serbest biraktim. Hazir oldugunda gir.

english: I see you have one of the dragon defenders already! Well done, but you can only get more dragon defenders from the basement.
translation: Görüyorum ki zaten bir ejderha savunucun var! Aferin, ama daha fazla ejderha savunucuyu sadece bodrumdan alabilirsin.

english: May I claim my tokens please?
May I claim my tokens please?
You don't have space to carry them.
Of course! Here you go, you've earned [number] token[s]!
Thanks!
I'm afraid you have not earned any tokens yet. Try some of the activities around the guild to earn some.
translation: Maalesef henüz jeton kazanmadin. Kazanmak icin guild cevresindeki etkinliklerden bazilarini dene.

english: Ok, I'll go see what I can find.
Life isn't fair, that doesn't mean you can't win.
translation: Hayat adil degildir, ama bu kazanamayacagin anlamina gelmez.

english: Be masterof your mind rather than master by your mind.
translation: Zihninin efendisi ol, zihnin tarafindan yönetilme.

english: A reflection on a pool of water does not reveal its depth.
When you aim for perfection, you discover it's a moving target.
translation: Mükemmelligi hedeflediginizde, bunun hareketli bir hedef oldugunu kesfedersiniz.

english: He who speaks in anger makes his anger heard, but his words forgotten.
translation: Öfkeyle konusan kisi öfkesini duyurur, ama sözleri unutulur.

english: Patience and persistence can bring down the tallest trees.
translation: Sabir ve azim en uzun agaclari bile devirebilir.

english: I don't need that.
Here, have this.
Where are they from?
How did they get here?
Why are they here?
Bye!
Hello youngster!
The child is too busy playing to take any notice.
Hello. I Kangai Mau of the Rantuki tribe.
translation: Merhaba. Ben Rantuki kabilesinden Kangai Mau.

english: I looking for someone brave to go on important mission for me. Someone skilled in thievery and sneaking about. I am told I can find such people in Brimhaven.
translation: Benim icin önemli bir görevi yerine getirecek cesur birini ariyorum. Hirsizlik ve gizlice dolasma konusunda yetenekli birini. Brimhaven'da böyle insanlar bulabilecegimi söylediler.

english: Tell me of this mission.
I need someone to go on a mission to the city of Ardougne. There you will find the house of Lord Handelmort. In his house he has our tribal totem.
translation: Ardougne sehrine bir göreve gidecek birine ihtiyacim var. Orada Lord Handelmort'un evini bulacaksin. Evinde kabilemizin totemi var.

english: We need it back.
Why does he have it?
Lord Handelmort is an Ardougnese explorer which means he think he have the right to come to my tribal home, steal our stuff and put in his private museum.
translation: Lord Handelmort, Ardougnese'li bir kasif, yani kabilemin evine gelip esyalarimizi calma ve özel müzesine koyma hakkina sahip oldugunu düsünüyor.

english: Ok, I will get it back.
Best of luck with that adventurer.
How can I find Handelmort's house? Ardougne is a big place...
translation: Handelmort'un evini nasil bulabilirim? Ardougne büyük bir yer...

english: I don't know Ardougne. You tell me.
Well good luck with that.
Let's hope I find some help soon.
I'm in search of adventure!
Adventure is something I may be able to give.
translation: Macera, sana verebilecegim bir sey olabilir.

english: Who are the Rantuki tribe?
A proud and noble tribe of Karamja. But now we are few, as men come from across sea, steal our land, and settle on our hunting grounds.
translation: Karamja'nin gururlu ve asil bir kabilesi. Ama simdi sayimiz azaldi, cünkü denizden gelen adamlar topraklarimizi caldi ve avlanma alanlarimiza yerlesti.

english: And what are you doing in Brimhaven?
Have you got our totem back?
No, it's not that easy.
Bah, you no good.
Yes I have.
You have??? Many thanks brave adventurer! Here, have some freshly cooked Karamjan fish, caught specially by my tribe.
translation: Aldin mi??? Cok tesekkürler cesur maceraci! Al, kabilem tarafindan özel olarak yakalanan taze pismis Karamjan baligi.

english: You hand over the Tribal Totem.
Congratulations! Quest complete!
Many greetings esteemed thief.
Hey.
Congrats. Here!
And what are you doing in Brimhaven?
Yes.
No.
I'm in search of adventure!
Who are the Rantuki tribe?
Hello there.
What brings you to our holy monument?
Who are you?
We are the druids of Guthix. We worship our god at our famous stone circles. You will find them located throughout these lands.
translation: Biz Guthix'in druidleri. Tanrimizi ünlü tas cemberlerimizde tapiyoruz. Bu topraklarin her yerinde bulabilirsiniz onlari.

english: What about the stone circle full of dark wizards?
translation: Karanlik büyücülerle dolu tas cember ne olacak?

english: That used to be OUR stone circle. Unfortunately, many many years ago, dark wizards cast a wicked spell upon it so that they could corrupt its power for their own evil ends.
translation: O eskiden BIZIM tas cemberimizdi. Ne yazik ki, cok uzun yillar önce, karanlik büyücüler kendi kötü amaclari icin onun gücünü bozmak üzere üzerine kötü bir büyü yaptilar.

english: When they cursed the rocks for their rituals they made them useless to us and our magics. We require a brave adventurer to go on a quest for us to help purify the circle of Varrock.
translation: Ritüelleri icin kayalari lanetlediklerinde, onlari bizim ve büyülerimiz icin kullanilamaz hale getirdiler. Varrock cemberini arindirmak icin bizim icin bir göreve cikacak cesur bir maceraciya ihtiyacimiz var.

english: So what's so good about Guthix?
Guthix is the oldest and most powerful god in Gielinor. His existence is vital to this world. He is the god of balance, and nature; he is also a very part of this world.
translation: Guthix, Gielinor'daki en eski ve en güclü tanridir. Onun varligi bu dünya icin hayati önem tasir. O, denge ve doganin tanrisidir; ayni zamanda bu dünyanin bir parcasidir.

english: He exists in the trees, and the flowers, the water and the rocks. He is everywhere. His purpose is to ensure balance in everything in this world, and as such we worship him.
translation: Agaclarda, ciceklerde, suda ve kayalarda var. Her yerde. Amaci, bu dünyadaki her seyin dengesini saglamaktir ve bu nedenle ona tapiyoruz.

english: He sounds kind of boring...
Some day when your mind achieves enlightenment you will see the true beauty of his power.
translation: Bir gün zihnin aydinlandiginda, onun gücünün gercek güzelligini göreceksin.

english: Well, I'll be on my way now.
translation: Peki, ben simdi yoluma devam edeyim.

english: Goodbye adventurer. I feel we shall meet again.
translation: Hosca kal maceraci. Sanirim tekrar görüsecegiz.

english: I'm in search of a quest.
Hmm. I think I may have a worthwhile quest for you actually. I don't know if you are familiar with the stone circle south of Varrock or not, but...
translation: Hmm. Aslinda sana uygun bir görevim olabilir. Varrock'un güneyindeki tas cemberi biliyor musun bilmiyorum ama...

english: Okay, I will try and help.
Excellent. Go to the village south of this place and speak to my fellow druid, Sanfew, who is working on the purification ritual. He knows what is required to complete it.
translation: Harika. Bu yerin güneyindeki köye git ve arinma ritüeli üzerinde calisan druid arkadasim Sanfew ile konus. O, ritüeli tamamlamak icin ne yapilmasi gerektigini biliyor.

english: Will do.
No, that doesn't sound very interesting.
I will not try and change your mind adventurer. Some day when you have matured you may reconsider your position. We will wait until then.
translation: Fikrini degistirmeye calismayacagim maceraci. Bir gün olgunlastiginda, fikrini yeniden gözden gecirebilirsin. O zamana kadar bekleyecegiz.

english: Did you build this?
What, personally? No, of course I didn't. However, our forefathers did. The first Druids of Guthix built many stone circles across these lands over eight hundred years ago.
translation: Ne, sahsen mi? Hayir, tabii ki ben yapmadim. Ancak atalarimiz yapti. Guthix'in ilk druidleri, sekiz yüz yil önce bu topraklarda bircok tas cember insa etti.

english: Unfortunately we only know of two remaining, and of those only one is usable by us anymore.
translation: Ne yazik ki, sadece ikisinin kaldigini biliyoruz ve bunlardan sadece biri artik bizim icin kullanilabilir durumda.

english: Hello again. How is the Herblore going?
translation: Merhaba tekrar. Bitki bilimi nasil gidiyor?

english: Very well, thank you.
That is good to hear.
I need more practice at it...
Persistence is key to success.
Can you explain the fundamentals again?
Indeed I will...
Herblore is the skill of working with herbs and other ingredients, to make useful potions and poison.
translation: Bitki bilimi, bitkiler ve diger malzemelerle calisarak yararli iksirler ve zehirler yapma becerisidir.

english: First you will need a vial, which can be found or made with the crafting skill.
translation: Öncelikle bir siseye ihtiyacin olacak, bunu bulabilir veya zanaat becerisiyle yapabilirsin.

english: Then you must gather the herbs needed to make the potion you want.
translation: Sonra istedigin iksiri yapmak icin gerekli bitkileri toplamalisin.

english: You must fill your vial with water and add the ingredients you need. There are normally 2 ingredients to each type of potion.
translation: Siseni suyla doldurmali ve gerekli malzemeleri eklemelisin. Her iksir türü icin normalde 2 malzeme gerekir.

english: Bear in mind, you must first clean each herb before you can use it.
translation: Unutma, her bitkiyi kullanmadan önce temizlemelisin.

english: You may also have to grind some ingredients before you can use them. You will need a pestle and mortar in order to do this.
translation: Bazi malzemeleri kullanmadan önce ögütmen gerekebilir. Bunun icin havan ve havaneliye ihtiyacin olacak.

english: Herbs can be found on the ground, and are also dropped by some monsters when you kill them.
translation: Bitkiler yerde bulunabilir ve bazi canavarlari öldürdügünde de düsebilir.

english: Let's try an example Attack potion: The first ingredient is Guam leaf; the next is Eye of Newt.
translation: Bir örnek deneyelim Saldiri iksiri: Ilk malzeme Guam yapragi, ikincisi ise semender gözüdür.

english: Mix these in your water-filled vial, and you will produce an Attack potion. Drink this potion to increase your Attack level.
translation: Bunlari suyla doldurdugunuz sisede karistirdiginizda bir saldiri iksiri elde edersiniz. Bu iksiri icerek saldiri seviyenizi artirabilirsiniz.

english: Different potions also require different Herblore levels before you can make them.
translation: Farkli iksirler, yapabilmeniz icin farkli bitki bilimi seviyeleri gerektirir.

english: Good luck with your Herblore practices, and a good day to you.
translation: Bitki bilimi calismalarinizda basarilar dilerim, iyi günler.

english: Thanks for your help.
What must I do to wear a Herblore skillcape?
translation: Herblore beceri pelerini giymek icin ne yapmaliyim?

english: To earn the right to wear any skillcape you need to have mastered that skill to the highest level possible and it is no different for Herblore.
translation: Herhangi bir beceri pelerini giyme hakkini kazanmak icin, o beceriyi mümkün olan en yüksek seviyeye ulastirmaniz gerekir ve Herblore icin de durum farkli degildir.

english: With the cape equipped the Nardah Herbalist will create unfinished potions for you and you may search the cape for a pestle and mortar. When you have achieved a level of 99, come back and talk to me again.
translation: Pelerin giyildiginde, Nardah Herbalist sizin icin bitmemis iksirler hazirlayacak ve pelerinde havan ve havaneli arayabilirsiniz. 99 seviyesine ulastiginizda, geri gelip benimle tekrar konusun.

english: Most certainly; the Nardah Herbalist will recognize this cape and create unfinished potions for you and it may be searched for a pestle and mortar.
translation: Elbette; Nardah Bitki Uzmani bu pelerini taniyacak ve sizin icin bitmemis iksirler hazirlayacak ve pelerin icinde havan ve havaneli arayabilirsiniz.

english: It has been a pleasure to watch you grow as a herbalist. I am privileged to have been instrumental in your learning, but I must ask for a donation of 99,000 coins to cover the expense of the cape.
translation: Bitki uzmani olarak gelismenizi izlemek benim icin bir zevkti. Ögreniminizde rol oynamis olmaktan onur duyuyorum, ancak pelerinin masraflarini karsilamak icin 99.000 sikke bagisinda bulunmanizi rica ediyorum.

english: I'm afraid that's too much money for me.
translation: Korkarim bu benim icin cok fazla para.

english: Not at all; there are many other adventurers who would love the opportunity to purchase such a prestigious item. You can find me here if you change your mind.
translation: Hic de degil; böyle prestijli bir esyayi satin alma firsatini cok isteyen baska maceracilar da var. Fikrini degistirirsen beni burada bulabilirsin.

english: Okay, here's 99,000 coins.
Good luck to you, [player name].
Most certainly, but I must ask for a donation of 99,000 coins to cover the expense of the cape.
translation: Elbette, ama pelerin masraflarini karsilamak icin 99.000 altin bagislaman gerekiyor.

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood; it's part of a skill promotion deal - buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: Maalesef tüm Beceri Pelerinleri sadece ücretsiz baslikla satiliyor; bu, beceri promosyonunun bir parcasi - bir alana bir bedava, bilirsin. Yani sana bir tane satabilmem icin önce envanterinde yer acman gerekiyor.

english: Can I get a hood for my skillcape, please?
translation: Skillcape'im icin bir baslik alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
You don't appear to have enough space in your inventory, come back and see me when you do.
translation: Envanterinde yeterli yer yok gibi görünüyor, yer actiginda tekrar gelip beni gör.

english: Who are you?
What about the stone circle full of dark wizards?
translation: Karanlik büyücülerle dolu tas cember ne olacak?

english: Yes.
No.
So what's so good about Guthix?
Well, I'll be on my way now.
I'm in search of a quest.
Did you build this?
I'm in search of a quest
Very well, thank you.
I need more practice at it...
Can you explain the fundamentals again?
What must I do to wear a Herblore skillcape?
translation: Herblore skillcape'i giymek icin ne yapmam gerekiyor?

english: May I buy a Herblore skillcape, please
translation: Herblore skillcape satin alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: I'm afraid that's too much money for me.
translation: Korkarim bu benim icin cok pahali.

english: Okay, here's 99,000 coins.
Can I get a hood for my skillcape, please?
translation: Skillcape'im icin bir baslik alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: What do you do here?
Oh, I'm a fisherman by trade and I sometimes help out my father, Safta Doc.
translation: Oh, meslegim balikci ve bazen babam Safta Doc'a yardim ediyorum.

english: Is there anything interesting to do around here?
translation: Buralarda ilginc bir sey var mi?

english: Bwana, if anyone else asks me that question today, I'll explode! Go and ask someone else!
translation: Bwana, bugün baska biri bana bu soruyu sorarsa, patlayacagim! Git baskasina sor!

english: Not that I'm aware of, just sit back and enjoy the sunshine bwana!
translation: Bildigim kadariyla yok, arkaniza yaslanin ve günesin tadini cikarin bwana!

english: Sorry Bwana, I'm already busy, why not go and talk to Murcaily! He's around the village somewhere.
translation: Üzgünüm Bwana, ben zaten mesgulüm, neden Murcaily ile konusmuyorsunuz! Köyün buralarinda bir yerlerde.

english: Well, I think that there's some work to be done...perhaps Murcaily can help you. He usually tends to the hardwood grove to the east of Trufitus's hut.
translation: Sanirim yapilacak bazi isler var... belki Murcaily size yardimci olabilir. Genellikle Trufitus'un kulübesinin dogusundaki sert agac korusunda calisir.

english: It's just village life as normal around here Bwana, always something interesting to find to occupy your time if you look hard enough.
translation: Burada köy hayati normal seyrinde devam ediyor Bwana, yeterince dikkatli bakarsan zamanini gecirecek ilginc seyler bulabilirsin.

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
I've already given you some trading sticks and I don't have any more on me at the moment. Why not go and talk to some of the other villagers and get some contributions?
translation: Sana zaten bazi ticaret cubuklari verdim ve su anda üzerimde baska yok. Neden gidip diger köylülerle konusup biraz katki almiyorsun?

english: Ok, thanks.
Hey, I've seen you working around the village. You've been doing a lot of good work around here for us. Let me give you something for your trouble.
translation: Hey, seni köyde calisirken gördüm. Burada bizim icin cok iyi isler yapiyorsun. Zahmetin icin sana bir sey vereyim.

english: What do you do here?
Is there anything interesting to do here?
translation: Burada ilginc bir sey var mi?

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
Ok, thanks.
You dare disturb my rest!
You dare steal from us!
Would you like to buy a nice kebab? Only one gold.
translation: Güzel bir kebap almak ister misin? Sadece bir altin.

english: I think I'll give it a miss.
Yes please.
Oops, I forgot to bring any money with me.
Come back when you have some.
What do you think of Ali Morrisane?
I don't like him. He makes all these claims about being the best salesman in Gielinor, and he even has some thugs that he's hired to threaten us.
translation: Onu sevmiyorum. Gielinor'un en iyi saticisi oldugunu iddia ediyor ve bizi tehdit etmek icin tuttugu bazi haydutlari bile var.

english: One of them came round here and threatened to cut my head off if I didn't cooperate with them!
translation: Onlardan biri buraya gelip, onlarla isbirligi yapmazsam kafami kesecegini söyledi!

english: I've also heard some rumours about them from my friend Ali in Pollnivneach...
translation: Pollnivneach'taki arkadasim Ali'den de onlar hakkinda bazi söylentiler duydum...

english: What sort of rumours?
Apparently he has men there as well, who have also been threatening people.
translation: Görünüse göre orada da insanlari tehdit eden adamlari var.

english: And it's said that they even intend to steal from the ruler of Al-Kharid himself!
translation: Hatta Al-Kharid hükümdarindan bile hirsizlik yapmayi planladiklari söyleniyor!

english: Really?
That's what I've heard. Anyway, are you sure you wouldn't like a kebab?
translation: Öyle duydum. Neyse, kebap istemedigine emin misin?

english: I've got a little problem for you to solve.
translation: Cözmen gereken kücük bir sorunum var.

english: The salesman has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Satici sana bir meydan okuma parsömeni verdi!

english: Please enter the answer to the riddle.
No that's not right, think again.
translation: Hayir, bu dogru degil, tekrar düsün.

english: Correct!
The salesman has given you another clue scroll!
translation: Satici sana baska bir ipucu parsömeni verdi!

english: I think I'll give it a miss.
Yes please.
What do you think of Ali Morrisane?
Hello there, human! Come in, come in!
translation: Merhaba insan! Iceri gel, iceri gel!

english: Hi, nice to see you!
Tell me, what brings you here?
Well, first I came to this city just for the adventure and excitement, but then I knocked over this statue, you see. Well, I didn't really knock it over myself, I was on this boat.
translation: Sey, ilk basta bu sehre sadece macera ve heyecan icin geldim, ama sonra bu heykeli devirdim, anlarsin ya. Aslinda ben devirmedim, bir teknedeydim.

english: A boat! Fascinating, go on!
translation: Bir tekne! Cok ilginc, devam et!

english: Yes, well, this boatman was a bit rubbish, or there was something wrong with the ship, I don't know. And then I got arrested by the Black Guard.
translation: Evet, sey, tekneci biraz beceriksizdi, ya da gemide bir sorun vardi, bilmiyorum. Sonra Kara Muhafizlar tarafindan tutuklandim.

english: Not the Black Guard!
Yes, and they took me to this Veldaban person, who pretended to be really angry but actually he was really nice and he asked me for my help.
translation: Evet, beni Veldaban adinda birine götürdüler, cok kizgin gibi davraniyordu ama aslinda cok nazikti ve benden yardim istedi.

english: And after a whole lot of running around, I finally managed to get the statue to be rebuilt.
translation: Ve bir sürü kosturmacadan sonra, sonunda heykelin yeniden insa edilmesini sagladim.

english: Such an interesting tale!
Now how did you come to be in Keldagrim again?
translation: Peki, nasil oldu da tekrar Keldagrim'e geldin?

english: Never mind.
Well? Who are you?
I'm player, and you are?
I think you already know the answer to that.
Er... Do I?
Shaw. Kasonde Shaw. Don't go acting like you haven't been following me for some time now.
translation: Shaw. Kasonde Shaw. Beni bir süredir takip etmiyormus gibi davranma.

english: Ah, of course. Those old ruins.
translation: Ah, tabii ya. O eski harabeler.

english: Exactly. Perhaps you took me for a fool, but I was on to you from the start. Considering what we learnt, I knew it was only a matter of time before you showed up.
translation: Aynen öyle. Belki beni aptal yerine koydun, ama ben basindan beri senin pesindeydim. Ögrendiklerimizi düsününce, ortaya cikmanin sadece an meselesi oldugunu biliyordum.

english: You mean soul transference? Not actually something that interests me, to be honest.
translation: Ruh transferinden mi bahsediyorsun? Acikcasi, bu beni pek ilgilendirmiyor.

english: Don't take me for a fool! If you had no interest in the Old Ones' secrets, why would you have followed me to those ruins? And why would you have come here?
translation: Beni aptal yerine koyma! Eski Olanlarin sirlariyla ilgilenmiyorsan, neden beni o harabelere kadar takip ettin? Ve neden buraya geldin?

english: To be honest, I didn't even know what an Old One was. I still don't really. I was just exploring when I found your camp.
translation: Dürüst olmak gerekirse, Eski Varliklarin ne oldugunu bile bilmiyordum. Hala da bilmiyorum. Senin kampini buldugumda sadece kesif yapiyordum.

english: As for why I'm here, I'm looking for information about someone called Vardorvis.
translation: Buraya gelme sebebim ise, Vardorvis adinda birisi hakkinda bilgi ariyorum.

english: Really? You want me to believe that all of this is a coincidence?
translation: Gercekten mi? Bütün bunlarin bir tesadüf olduguna inanmami mi istiyorsun?

english: Well... yes.
You're lying! You're lying and...
Hang on... do you hear that?
Hear what?
The Strangled! Did you disturb any tendrils on your way in here?
translation: Bogulanlar! Buraya gelirken herhangi bir filizi rahatsiz ettin mi?

english: I may have...?
They'll be coming. We've got no chance up here. Head down below! Now!
translation: Geliyorlar. Burada hic sansimiz yok. Asagi inelim! Hemen!

english: That's the lot of them. Let's head back up.
That was too close. You nearly got us both killed!
translation: Cok yakindi. Ikimizi de neredeyse öldürüyordun!

english: I don't understand... What are those things? Are they zombies?
translation: Anlamiyorum... O seyler ne? Zombi mi?

english: You really want me to believe that you don't know anything about this place?
translation: Bu yer hakkinda hicbir sey bilmedigine gercekten inanmami mi istiyorsun?

english: I already told you, I wasn't lying.
Well I don't have any reason to trust that.
translation: Buna inanmam icin hicbir nedenim yok.

english: With how dangerous this place is, do you really have a choice?
translation: Burasi bu kadar tehlikeli iken, baska secenegin var mi?

english: Hmm...
Alright, fine. But I have no desire to see you get us killed, so you'd better wisen up fast.
translation: Tamam, peki. Ama senin yüzünden ölmemizi istemiyorum, o yüzden cabuk akillanman iyi olur.

english: I'm listening.
It all starts with the Old Ones. They lived here long before humans came to these lands, and these ruins here were once their home.
translation: Her sey Eski Varliklar ile basliyor. Insanlar bu topraklara gelmeden cok önce burada yasiyorlardi ve bu harabeler bir zamanlar onlarin eviydi.

english: And these Old Ones discovered soul transference?
translation: Eski Varliklar ruh transferini kesfettiler mi?

english: They did, and they did so long before House Arceuus even existed. It was their final attempt to overcome their extinction, but they failed.
translation: Evet, Arceuus Hanesi daha kurulmadan cok önce kesfettiler. Bu, yok olmalarini önlemek icin son girisimleriydi, ama basarisiz oldular.

english: What you see around you is the result of their failure. It's known as the Strangler.
translation: Etrafinda gördüklerin, onlarin basarisizliginin sonucu. Buna Bogucu deniyor.

english: The Strangler?
It's some sort of parasite. It was presumably meant to play a role in their transference rituals, but instead it destroyed them. It has remained here ever since.
translation: Bir tür parazit. Muhtemelen ruh aktarimi ritüellerinde bir rol oynamasi gerekiyordu, ama bunun yerine onlari yok etti. O zamandan beri burada kaldi.

english: Hence the Strangled?
Exactly. Plenty of unwary fools have fallen victim to the Strangler. If you don't take care, you will share their fate.
translation: Aynen öyle. Pek cok dikkatsiz aptal Bogucu'nun kurbani oldu. Dikkatli olmazsan, onlarin kaderini paylasirsin.

english: So how do we deal with them?
The trick is to maintain your distance. They're relatively passive unless you get too close, but if you disturb one, the rest will quickly come running.
translation: Isin sirri mesafeni korumak. Cok yaklasmadigin sürece nispeten pasifler, ama birini rahatsiz edersen, digerleri hemen kosarak gelir.

english: If you need to fight one, try to do it away from the rest!
translation: Onunla savasman gerekirse, digerlerinden uzaklasmaya calis!

english: And stay off of the tendrils! You'll alert the lot of them to your location! It's like a network.
translation: Ve dallardan uzak dur! Onlara yerini belli edersin! Bir ag gibi calisiyorlar.

english: Keep my distance and stay off the tendrils. I can do that. So what's our next move?
translation: Mesafemi koruyup dallardan uzak durmak. Bunu yapabilirim. Peki, simdi ne yapacagiz?

english: The fact that you're still alive tells me you broke into my home and stole some of the potion I made.
translation: Hala hayatta olman, evime girip yaptigim iksiri caldigini gösteriyor.

english: 'Broke in' is maybe a bit strong...
Call it what you want, it's not important now. What is important is that I believe I can make a more powerful potion using ingredients found here.
translation: Ne dersen de, su anda önemli degil. Önemli olan, burada bulunan malzemelerle daha güclü bir iksir yapabilecegime inanmam.

english: If all goes well, this potion will provide increased immunity against the Strangler. If either of us are to find what we want here, it will be essential.
translation: Her sey yolunda giderse, bu iksir Strangler'a karsi bagisikligi artiracak. Ikimizden biri burada aradigini bulmak istiyorsa, bu cok önemli olacak.

english: So what ingredients do we need?
As you've no doubt seen, the Strangler infects plant life as well. However, I've come across a small number of plants that seem to have developed immunity.
translation: Gördügün gibi, Strangler bitki yasamini da etkiliyor. Ancak, bagisiklik gelistirmis gibi görünen az sayida bitki buldum.

english: First, there's a herb growing atop the cliff just north west of the temple. Second, there are some berries in an old camp on the coast to the south west.
translation: Ilk olarak, tapinagin kuzeybatisindaki ucurumun tepesinde yetisen bir bitki var. Ikincisi, güneybatidaki sahildeki eski bir kampta bazi meyveler var.

english: Alright, I can gather those.
I need to gather some additional ingredients from within the temple. I will meet you back here once I'm done.
translation: Tapinaktan bazi ek malzemeler toplamam gerekiyor. Isimi bitirince burada bulusuruz.

english: Kasonde! Are you okay?
Damn it! Damn it! This can't happen! It can't!
translation: Lanet olsun! Lanet olsun! Bu olamaz! Olamaz!

english: Kasonde?
Kasonde shows you his arm. There's a large bite from one of the Strangled.
translation: Kasonde sana kolunu gösterir. Strangled'lardan biri tarafindan isirilmis.

english: Kasonde...
It's fine! This doesn't change anything.
translation: Sorun yok! Bu hicbir seyi degistirmez.

english: But the infection...
The infection means nothing!
I was a dead man either way...
What are you on about?
Koreps Syndrome. Common among botanists apparently. You'd have thought we'd have put some effort into finding a cure, but I guess no one ever thinks they'll be the unlucky one.
translation: Koreps Sendromu. Botanikciler arasinda yayginmis. Bir care bulmak icin caba sarf edecegimizi düsünürdün, ama sanirim kimse kendisinin sanssiz kisi olacagini düsünmez.

english: Kasonde, I...
Don't. Whatever you have to say, I don't want to hear it. Do you know how many times I've heard the word 'sorry'? Do you know how many times people have told me they understand?
translation: Yapma. Ne söyleyeceksen, duymak istemiyorum. “Üzgünüm” kelimesini kac kez duydugumu biliyor musun? Insanlarin bana kac kez anladiklarini söylediklerini biliyor musun?

english: Well they don't. I spent every day working away, telling myself that one day I'd finally be able to live my life, but it was all a lie. That was my life, and it was all so... meaningless!
translation: Ama anlamiyorlar. Her gün calisarak gecirdim, bir gün sonunda hayatimi yasayabilecegimi söyleyerek kendime, ama hepsi yalandi. Hayatim buydu ve hepsi cok... anlamsizdi!

english: I tried everything. I went to every healer, ever mage, every priest.
translation: Her seyi denedim. Her sifaciya, her büyücüye, her rahibe gittim.

english: I went to House Arceuus, and they turned me away! What gives them the right?!
translation: Arceuus Hanesi'ne gittim ve beni geri cevirdiler! Onlara bu hakki veren ne?

english: So no, this doesn't change anything. The Old Ones are my last hope. I either find their secrets, or...
translation: Yani hayir, bu hicbir seyi degistirmez. Kadim Varliklar benim son umudum. Ya onlarin sirlarini bulacagim ya da...

english: Look, we're wasting time here! There's a ritual site to the west. Presumably it's where the Strangler was unleashed. It's my best hope now, and it may well be where you'll find what you're after as well.
translation: Bak, burada zaman kaybediyoruz! Batida bir ritüel alani var. Muhtemelen Strangler'in serbest birakildigi yer orasi. Su anda en büyük umudum o ve aradigin seyi de orada bulabilirsin.

english: Take this potion and add those ingredients you gathered to it. It should strengthen your immunity against the Strangler. Now go!
translation: Bu iksiri al ve topladigin malzemeleri ona ekle. Strangler'a karsi bagisikligini güclendirmeli. Simdi git!

english: Hello, you must be a traveller.
Well guessed, adventurer.
Are you from Lovakengj?
You are wrong this time, adventurer. I'm actually from Ice Mountain.
translation: Bu sefer yanildin, maceraci. Aslinda Ice Mountain'danim.

english: I always wanted to visit Lovakengj to see the Blast Mine. This year I finally saved up enough to travel here.
translation: Blast Mine'i görmek icin her zaman Lovakengj'i ziyaret etmek istemisimdir. Bu yil sonunda buraya seyahat etmek icin yeterli parayi biriktirdim.

english: However, the war with the lizardmen means Lovakengj is dangerous to get to from here. I'll need to go the long way round.
translation: Ancak, kertenkele adamlarla olan savas nedeniyle Lovakengj'e buradan gitmek tehlikeli. Uzun yoldan gitmem gerekecek.

english: What do you think about this place?
To be honest, Shayzien is a bit boring for visitors. It's all about war and military things.
translation: Dürüst olmak gerekirse, Shayzien ziyaretciler icin biraz sikici. Her sey savas ve askeri konularla ilgili.

english: The only place I would recommend is the Cloak and Stagger. You'll find some pretty good drinks there.
translation: Tavsiye edebilecegim tek yer Cloak and Stagger. Orada oldukca iyi ickiler bulabilirsin.

english: See you later.
Are you from Lovakengj?
How do you feel about this place?
See you later.
Oh dear, oh dear, oh dear...
translation: Oh hayir, oh hayir, oh hayir...

english: Oh dear?
It's terrible!
What's terrible?
Oh, never mind, dearie. What can I do for you?
translation: Oh, bos ver canim. Senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: Can you take me downstream in your boat?
translation: Beni teknenle nehrin asagisina götürebilir misin?

english: Ooh, it's dangerous up there at the moment!
translation: Ooh, su anda orasi cok tehlikeli!

english: I'm not afraid - let's go!
It's dangerous up there for me too, dearie.
translation: Orasi benim icin de tehlikeli canim.

english: Would it help if I gave you some money?
translation: Sana biraz para versem yardimci olur mu?

english: Ooh, that's better! I'll take you up north for 50 shiny coins.
translation: Ooh, bu daha iyi! 50 parlak sikke karsiliginda seni kuzeye götürürüm.

english: Alright, I'll pay.
Kathy Corkat rows you down the river to the sea...
translation: Kathy Corkat seni nehirden denize kadar götürür...

english: Not a chance!
Then you can find your own way north, dearie!
translation: O zaman kuzeye kendi yolunu bul, canim!

english: Dangerous? Nah, forget it!
I don't think I want anything, thanks.
Everybody wants something, dearie!
Huh? Oh, forget it!
I'll be glad to get away from this place, dearie! Fancy a lift up the river?
translation: Bu yerden uzaklasacagima sevinecegim, canim! Nehirde bir tur atmak ister misin?

english: Yes please.
Kathy Corkat rows you up the river...
translation: Kathy Corkat seni nehirde kürek cekerek...

english: No thanks.
Hello dearie. Heading up north to the Fishing Colony, are we?
translation: Merhaba canim. Kuzeydeki Balikci Kolonisi'ne mi gidiyorsun?

english: Are ye wantin' a lift up the river, dearie?
translation: Nehirde bir tur atmak ister misin, canim?

english: Why don't you row right into the Colony? It'd make it much easier to get in there.
translation: Neden Koloni'ye kadar kürek cekmiyorsun? Oraya ulasmak cok daha kolay olur.

english: Oh, Franklin doesn't like it if I take my boat too close. He says I'll damage the nets and scare the fish. But were you wanting a lift up to the river?
translation: Oh, Franklin teknemle cok yaklasmamdan hoslanmaz. Aglara zarar verecegimi ve baliklari korkutacagimi söyler. Ama nehirde bir yere gitmek istiyor muydun?

english: Can you take me downstream in your boat?
translation: Beni teknenle nehrin asagisina götürebilir misin?

english: I'm not afraid - let's go!
Alright, I'll pay.
Not a chance!
Dangerous? Nah, forget it!
I don't think I want anything, thanks.
Yes please.
No thanks.
Why don't you row right into the Colony?
Hello there. How's it going?
Sorry, but I'm busy right now.
Not too bad thanks.
Who are you?
I'm a bold adventurer.
Ah, a very noble profession.
I'm fine, how are you?
Very well, thank you.
Hello!
I'm very well, thank you.
Nilsal!
Hello there! Nice weather we've been having.
Nilsal! I'm pretty good, thank you.
Heya! What can I get you?
What ales are you serving?
Well, we've got Asgarnian Ale, Wizard's Mind Bomb and Dwarven Stout, all for only 3 coins.
translation: Asgarnian Ale, Wizard's Mind Bomb ve Dwarven Stout var, hepsi sadece 3 sikke.

english: One Asgarnian Ale, please.
I said 3 coins! You haven't got 3 coins!
Sorry, I'll come back another day.
Thanks, Kaylee.
I'll try the Mind Bomb.
Can I have a Dwarven Stout?
I don't feel like any of those.
I've got this beer glass...
We'll buy it for a couple of coins if you're interested.
translation: Eger ilgilenirsen, birkac jeton karsiliginda satin aliriz.

english: Okay, sure.
There you go.
Thanks!
No thanks, I like empty beer glasses.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, bos bira bardaklarini seviyorum.

english: I've got these beer glasses...
Ooh, we'll buy those off you if you're interested. 2 coins per glass.
translation: Eger ilgilenirsen, onlari satin aliriz. Bardak basina 2 jeton.

english: What's this about the party room?
Have you heard? Someone's planning a big party!
translation: Duydun mu? Biri büyük bir parti planliyor!

english: What do you mean?
Someone's put something very valuable into the party room drop chest! If you go to the party room and pull the lever you might have a chance to get it!
translation: Birisi parti odasindaki sandiga cok degerli bir sey koymus! Parti odasina gidip kolu cekerseniz, onu alma sansiniz olabilir!

english: It could be your lucky day!
Thanks!
I have a question for you.
Kaylee has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Kaylee sana bir meydan okuma parsömeni verdi!

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
No, try again.
Correct!
Kaylee has given you another clue scroll!
translation: Kaylee sana baska bir ipucu parsömeni verdi!

english: Party! Party!
Something's happening in the party room!
Everyone get to the party room!
What's happening in the party room?
Someone's having a big party!
Get to the party room NOW!
Get to the party room!
Get to the party room quick!
Big value items in the party room now!
translation: Parti odasinda cok degerli esyalar var!

english: Quick! Get to the party room!
What ales are you serving?
One Asgarnian Ale, please.
I'll try the Mind Bomb.
Can I have a Dwarven Stout?
I don't feel like any of those.
I've got this beer glass...
Okay, sure.
No thanks, I like empty beer glasses.
translation: Hayir tesekkürler, bos bira bardaklarini seviyorum.

english: I've got these beer glasses...
What's this about the party room?
Can I help you at all?
No thanks.
Yes please. What are you selling?
No thanks.
You prove you are very strong, little human!
translation: Cok güclü oldugunu kanitladin, kücük insan!

english: What about our deal?
A deal is a deal. We will not be allies with the monkeys.
I'm looking for the head of the city guard...
You found him! What do you want, little human?
translation: Onu buldun! Ne istiyorsun, kücük insan?

english: I know about your deal with the monkeys. I'm here to persuade you not to join their alliance.
translation: Maymunlarla yaptigin anlasmayi biliyorum. Onlarin ittifakina katilmaman icin seni ikna etmeye geldim.

english: Hahaha! Monkeys offer us treasure, land and all the humans we can eat! What do you offer us?
translation: Hahaha! Maymunlar bize hazine, toprak ve yiyebilecegimiz tüm insanlari sunuyor! Sen bize ne sunuyorsun?

english: Perhaps I could offer you more?
I don't think human can offer me cities like the monkey king can!
translation: Insanlarin bana maymun kralinin sunabilecegi gibi sehirler sunabilecegini sanmiyorum!

english: Um... that's not going to work.
I offer to spare your life.
Little human is brave! I think I can offer you a deal...
translation: Kücük insan cesurmus! Sanirim sana bir anlasma teklif edebilirim...

english: If you can defeat me in battle, I will tell my men not to help the monkeys.
translation: Eger beni savasta yenebilirsen, adamlarima maymunlara yardim etmemelerini söyleyecegim.

english: I accept your challenge.
Not right now.
I'm looking for a fight!
Hahaha, human is funny! You will barely fill my stomach, stop wasting my time!
translation: Hahaha, insan komik! Karnimi zar zor doyuracaksin, zamanimi bosa harcama!

english: Nevermind.
Stop! Stop! You prove you are very strong, little human!
translation: Dur! Dur! Cok güclü oldugunu kanitladin, kücük insan!

english: I know about your deal with the monkeys.
Perhaps I could offer you more?
translation: Belki sana daha fazlasini teklif edebilirim?

english: I offer to spare your life.
I accept your challenge.
Not right now.
Nevermind.
I'm looking for a fight!

Oh, hello stranger. If you're new to town you should speak with our ruler, King Gjuki Sorvott IV. He'll want to meet you - he always wants to have a chat with any strangers in town. They could be spies you know.
translation: Merhaba yabanci. Eger bu kasabaya yeni geldiysen, hükümdarimiz Kral Gjuki Sorvott IV ile konusmalisin. Seninle tanismak isteyecektir, kasabaya gelen yabancilarla her zaman sohbet etmek ister. Onlar casus olabilirler, biliyorsun.

english: Spies?
Yes, spies from Neitiznot. They're everywhere. Apparently. That's what the King says anyway.
translation: Evet, Neitiznot'tan casuslar. Her yerdeler. Görünüse göre. En azindan kral öyle diyor.

english: So what do you do here?
Me? I'm a cook. Fish dishes a speciality. I hate fish. But fish is about all we have. Except for yak. But we're not allowed to eat yak.
translation: Ben mi? Asciyim. Balik yemekleri uzmanligimdir. Baligi sevmem. Ama elimizde sadece balik var. Yak haric. Ama yak eti yememize izin verilmiyor.

english: Why not, is yak meat bad for you?
translation: Neden, yak eti sagliga zararli mi?

english: Certainly not! Yak meat is both sweet and delicately flavoured. Yak is juicier than buffalo and elk - but never gamey. It goes wonderfully well with a glass of red wine, and it's healthy too!
translation: Kesinlikle hayir! Yak eti hem tatli hem de lezzetlidir. Yak, bufalo ve geyikten daha suludur ama asla av eti gibi degildir. Kirmizi sarapla harika gider ve sagliklidir da!

english: So why aren't you allowed to eat it?

King's orders. They breed and eat yaks on Neitiznot, so WE'RE not allowed to. It's unjust I tell you! I had a dream last night about a juicy fillet of yak, served on a bed of deep-fried seaweed and topped with a garnish
translation: Kralin emri. Neitiznot'ta yak yetistirip yiyorlar, bu yüzden BIZ yiyemiyoruz. Bu haksizlik, size söylüyorum! Dün gece rüyamda, kizarmis deniz yosunu üzerinde servis edilen ve ufalanmis yak peyniri ile süslenmis

english: of crumbly yak's cheese.
That's a little sad. So do you have any cooked food I could buy?
translation: Bu biraz üzücü. Peki, satin alabilecegim pismis yiyecek var mi?

english: No. It would only be fish anyway. Why would you want to eat fish?
translation: Hayir. Zaten sadece balik olurdu. Neden balik yemek istersin ki?

english: Well, I wouldn't mind a few shark and swordfish steaks as back-up you know.
translation: Sey, yedek olarak birkac köpekbaligi ve kilicbaligi biftekleri fena olmazdi.

english: If you insist. Sorry the stock is so low, but I just can't be bothered to cook any more.
translation: Israr ediyorsan. Stoklarin bu kadar az oldugu icin üzgünüm, ama artik yemek pisirmekle ugrasmak istemiyorum.

english: Go away and let me wallow in self loathing.
translation: Git buradan ve kendimi nefretle bogmama izin ver.

english: Do you want any help with that? I can loathyou as well.
translation: Yardim ister misin? Ben de senden nefret edebilirim.

english: *sigh*
Hello. Who are you?
Hello there. The name's Keith. I'm the farmer here.
You're pretty far out of the way here. How come?
translation: Buraya gelmek icin epey yol katetmissin. Neden?

english: It's a peaceful life. Out here I can avoid the drama and politics of the big settlements.
translation: Huzurlu bir hayat. Burada büyük yerlesim yerlerinin dramlarindan ve politikasindan uzak durabiliyorum.

english: Aren't you worried about how close the lizardmen are though?
translation: Kertenkele adamlarin bu kadar yakin olmasi seni endiselendirmiyor mu?

english: The Shayzien troops keep them busy. They've not tried coming up this way.
translation: Shayzien birlikleri onlari mesgul ediyor. Bu tarafa gelmeye calismadilar.

english: Fair enough. I'll leave you to it.
Are you okay?
Get away! One day we'll have our revenge on you all!
translation: Git buradan! Bir gün hepinizden intikamimizi alacagiz!

english: Spare us your fake pity. I spit on Khazard, and all who do his bidding.
translation: Sahte merhametini bize gösterme. Khazard'a ve onun emirlerini yerine getirenlere tükürüyorum.

english: You're brave coming in here. If the guards get you, you'll be the next one in a cell.
translation: Buraya gelmekle cesur davranmissin. Muhafizlar seni yakalarsa, hücreye giren bir sonraki kisi sen olacaksin.

english: You're not safe here, traveller. Leave while you still can.
translation: Burada güvende degilsin, yolcu. Hala vaktin varken git buradan.

english: Hello.
Huh... Oh sorry, you made me jump. I was miles away, day dreaming.
translation: Huh... Oh pardon, beni korkuttun. Düsüncelere dalmistim.

english: About what may I ask?
I was thinking about the crystal spires of Prifddinas.
It must be beautiful, I've only seen the city walls.
translation: Cok güzel olmali, ben sadece sehir surlarini gördüm.

english: I have never seen it, all I know are the stories. I hope that changes one day.
translation: Ben hic görmedim, sadece hikayelerini biliyorum. Umarim bir gün bu durum degisir.

english: I have never seen it, all I know are the stories. I hope that once this war is over, I'll finally be able to.
translation: Ben hic görmedim, sadece hikayelerini biliyorum. Umarim bu savas bittiginde, sonunda görebilirim.

english: Hey there [player name].
Hey there. How is it being the new Lady Ithell?
translation: Merhaba. Yeni Leydi Ithell olmak nasil bir sey?

english: It's a daunting job, but I have the knowledge of my predecessor to help me.
translation: Zor bir is, ama öncülümün bilgisi bana yardimci oluyor.

english: It's still crazy how fast it all happened. One moment I was a daydreaming elf, who'd never even seen Prifddinas. Now I'm responsible for an entire elf clan.
translation: Her seyin bu kadar hizli olmasi hala inanilmaz. Bir an önce Prifddinas'i hic görmemis, hayal kuran bir elfken, simdi bütün elf klanindan sorumluyum.

english: Well don't worry, I'm sure you're doing great.
translation: Merak etme, eminim harika is cikariyorsundur.

english: Thank you [player name].
What do you think you're doing?
Good day!
She don't speak much, not since the incident.
Oh, what happened? If you don't mind me asking.
I'd prefer not to go into details, but I will say this...
translation: Detaylara girmek istemem ama sunu söyleyebilirim...

english: ...Yeah?
...Demons!
Demons?
Killed 'er 'usband!
Oh, well that's certainly a shame.
Isn't it just.
What are you looking for, outsider?
Let's see what you've got.
I don't need anything.
Let's see what you've got.
I don't need anything.
Hello there, Kennith. How are you today?
Great mister! Thanks again for rescuing me.
translation: Harika, efendim! Beni kurtardiginiz icin tekrar tesekkürler.

english: It was my pleasure Kennith. You take care now.
translation: Benim icin bir zevkti, Kennith. Kendine iyi bak.

english: Sure mister. Goodbye now.
Hello there, [player name]!
Hello again Kent.
I never did get the chance to thank you properly for saving Kennith and myself.
translation: Kennith'i ve beni kurtardigin icin sana hic düzgün bir sekilde tesekkür etme firsati bulamadim.

english: Oh, don't be silly, it was nothing really.
translation: Oh, sacmalama, gercekten önemsiz bir seydi.

english: Play it down if you will. It was a truly brave thing you did.
translation: Istedigin kadar önemsiz göster. Yaptigin sey gercekten cesurcaydi.

english: I only did what anyone would have done in my position. I have to go now, take care.
translation: Ben sadece benim durumumda herkesin yapacagi seyi yaptim. Simdi gitmem gerek, kendine iyi bak.

english: You too, [player name]. Goodbye.
Who goes there? This is no place for a human. You need to leave.
translation: Orada kim var? Burasi insanlara uygun bir yer degil. Gitmelisin.

english: You're starting to scare me man...
I am no man! They changed me and cursed me to remain here...
translation: Ben insan degilim! Beni degistirdiler ve burada kalmam icin lanetlediler...

english: What do you mean they changed you?
I was once a free man, powerful and wealthy. I owned several apothecaries across Kourend and sold the tastiest potions in the land.
translation: Bir zamanlar özgür, güclü ve zengin bir adamdim. Kourend'de birkac eczaneye sahiptim ve ülkedeki en lezzetli iksirleri satiyordum.

english: What happened?

One of my greatest inventions, it was going so well. I spent days finding the right herbs, I travelled across all of Kourend to find the most exotic weeds. Once I had gathered them all, I put them in a potion and mixed in
translation: En büyük icatlarimdan biri, her sey cok iyi gidiyordu. Günlerce dogru bitkileri bulmak icin ugrastim, en egzotik otlari bulmak icin Kourend'in her yerini dolastim. Hepsini topladiktan sonra, onlari bir iksire koydum ve son malzemeyi karistirdim.

english: the final ingredient.
Kourend? Interesting...
Kourend? Oh yeah, I've been there.

Yes, yes... The potion tasted delicious but it was missing a tiny something so I added Magic roots to the potion. It started to pulsate and glow! I took a sip and I felt like a million gold! A few seconds later my eye sight
translation: Evet, evet... Iksir cok lezzetliydi ama kücük bir sey eksikti, ben de iksire sihirli kökler ekledim. Iksir titremeye ve parlamaya basladi! Bir yudum aldim ve kendimi milyonlarca altin gibi hissettim! Birkac saniye sonra görüsüm

english: began to blur, my brain was throbbing. I fell and hit my head on my worktop, then it all went black.
translation: bulaniklasmaya basladi, beynim zonkluyordu. Düstüm ve basimi tezgaha carptim, sonra her sey karardi.

english: Ouch! But, you still haven't said who changed you?
translation: Ah! Ama seni kim degistirdigini hala söylemedin?

english: Will you let me finish?

I woke up screaming in pain. Blue foam streaming out of my mouth, my eye sight worse than before, the only things I could make out were 3 tall figures with green banners - they were of the Arceuus Elders. They
translation: Aci icinde ciglik atarak uyandim. Agzimdan mavi köpükler akiyordu, görüsüm eskisinden daha kötüydü, tek görebildigim yesil bayrakli 3 uzun figürdü - onlar Arceuus Yaslilariydi.

english: muttered to each other in Archaic Language after trying to get up several times. I lost hope and stared at the sky. I had given up when the tallest of the figures bent over and brought his face right to mine and spoke
translation: Birkac kez kalkmaya calistiktan sonra arkaik dilde birbirlerine fisildadilar. Umudumu kaybettim ve gökyüzüne baktim. En uzun boylu olan figür egilip yüzünü benimkine yaklastirdi ve cok yumusak bir sesle konustu.

english: very softly 'We can save you, but it will come at a cost'.
translation: “Seni kurtarabiliriz, ama bunun bir bedeli olacak.”

english: So they saved you?
Yes of course they saved me but look at the cost! I have horns coming out of my head and I'm still blind and stuck here... forever alone.
translation: Tabii ki kurtardilar, ama bedeline bak! Kafamdan boynuzlar cikiyor, hala körüm ve burada sikisip kaldim... sonsuza kadar yalniz.

english: What was the curse?
I have been charged to stay here to prevent the Monstrosity from escaping. Those gates and the winches that operate them are the only thing that stops it breaking free.
translation: Canavarin kacmasini önlemek icin burada kalmakla görevlendirildim. O kapilar ve onlari calistiran vincler, onun kacmasini engelleyen tek sey.

english: What monstrosity? What's behind those gates?
translation: Ne canavari? O kapilarin arkasinda ne var?

english: You really do not want to know. Leave this place human.
translation: Gercekten bilmek istemezsin. Buradan git insan.

english: Hey now, I'm no wimp. What's to stop me from just turning the winch to open the gate and going in?
translation: Hey, ben korkak degilim. Vincleri cevirip kapiyi acip iceri girmemi engelleyen ne var?

english: Me. And of course your quick demise at the mercy of Cerberus, guardian of the river of souls.
translation: Ben. Ve tabii ki ruhlarin nehrinin koruyucusu Cerberus'un merhametine kalmis hizli ölümün.

english: But I can do it!
You are obviously passionate at trying. But only those with great skill at slaying these types of beast may enter.
translation: Denemeye hevesli oldugun belli. Ama bu tür canavarlari öldürmede büyük beceriye sahip olanlar girebilir.

english: THE VOICES! AAAHHHHH! Leave this place human!
I have been charged by the slayer masters to eliminate this type of threat.
translation: Avci ustalari tarafindan bu tür tehditleri ortadan kaldirmakla görevlendirildim.

english: Then you may pass... may your soul not end up consumed and forever condemned to the-
translation: O zaman gecebilirsin... ruhun yok edilip sonsuza kadar lanetlenmesin...

english: Goodbye.
Aretha said you might be able to repair the soul bearer for me.
translation: Aretha, ruh tasiyicisini benim icin onarabilecegini söyledi.

english: The soul bearer! You have the soul bearer! The voices speak of it often. It is from this place, yet it is not of this place.
translation: Ruh tasiyicisi! Ruh tasiyicisi sende! Sesler sik sik ondan bahsediyor. Buradan geliyor, ama buraya ait degil.

english: Will you repair it?
The voices tell me I can. They speak to me!
The Key Master repairs your soul bearer.
The voices say you must use it wisely.
translation: Sesler onu akillica kullanman gerektigini söylüyor.

english: Thanks, I will.
Here you go.
You are handed a torn part of a clue scroll.
translation: Yirtik bir ipucu parsömeni parcasi verilir.

english: What do you mean they changed you?
What was the curse?
Goodbye.
What voices?
Thanks, I will.
Hello there.
Wooo?  Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!
translation: Wooo?  Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!

english: You don't say?
Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!
translation: Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!

english: You don't say!
Wooowoowoooooo.... Woowoowoo? Woooo, wooowoo wooowooowooo!
Well, I guess you didn't say.
Yeah, I don't want to brag, but seriously: I am SOOOO rich....
translation: Evet, övünmek istemem ama cidden: Ben COK zenginim...

english: Yeah, I know they say money doesn't bring you happiness, but sometimes I just like to open my bank account and look at all of the stuff I own and just think to myself:
translation: Evet, paranin mutluluk getirmedigini söylerler ama bazen banka hesabimi acip sahip oldugum her seye bakip kendi kendime söyle düsünüyorum:

english: Wow. I am soooooo rich.
Well, us rich alive people don't want to waste all day spending time with you poor dead people, because I'm just sooooo rich I have to go now, and very possibly make myself even richer.
translation: Eh, biz zengin yasayanlar, tüm günümüzü siz fakir ölülerle gecirmek istemiyoruz, cünkü ben cok zenginim, simdi gitmeliyim ve muhtemelen kendimi daha da zenginlestirmeliyim.

english: See ya around ghosty!
Yeah, I heard about that, ha-ha-ha!
With a MACKEREL? Ouch!
Well, it was fun. Let's do it again sometime.
translation: Eh, eglenceliydi. Bir ara tekrar yapalim.

english: Why, thank you very much!
I know, but what are you going to do?
Well, I guess that's always true in the long run. See you around, weird invisible dead person!
translation: Uzun vadede bu her zaman dogru olur. Görüsürüz, tuhaf görünmez ölü!

english: Yeah it's not bad, but I prefer cooked chicken.
translation: Evet, fena degil, ama ben pismis tavugu tercih ederim.

english: Maybe, but nothing beats a home cooked pie!
translation: Belki, ama ev yapimi turta gibisi yoktur!

english: Man, I love pie!
You don't say? I never knew that. Well, I must be going, see you around.
translation: Öyle mi? Hic bilmiyordum. Gitmem gerek, görüsürüz.

english: We get signal!
Somebody set up us the bomb!
You have no chance to survive make your time.
translation: Hayatta kalma sansin yok, zamanini iyi degerlendir.

english: Woo?
All your base are belong to us.
Hey, don't think you can talk to me like that!
Are you threatening me?
Just because you're already dead, doesn't mean I can't find a way to hurt you ghosty!
translation: Sen zaten öldün diye, sana zarar vermenin bir yolunu bulamayacagim anlamina gelmez hayalet!

english: No, I've never been there in my life and CERTAINLY didn't steal anything when I was!
translation: Hayir, hayatimda oraya hic gitmedim ve oradayken KESINLIKLE hicbir sey calmadim!

english: Are you calling me a liar?!?! I have never stolen a thing in my life, and I resent the implication that I am the kind of morally depraved individual that would steal someone else's hard earned
translation: Bana yalanci mi diyorsun?!?! Hayatimda hicbir sey calmadim ve baskalarinin zor kazandiklari parayi

english: money from their very pockets!
translation: ceplerinden calacak kadar ahlaksiz bir insan oldugumu ima etmene cok kizdim!

english: Or cakes. Or fur. Repeatedly. For long periods at a time.
translation: Ya da kekleri. Ya da kürkleri. Tekrar tekrar. Uzun süreler boyunca.

english: Well if you are going to take that attitude, then I have nothing further to say on the matter, and bid you good day!
translation: Eger bu tavri takinacaksan, bu konuda söyleyecek baska bir seyim yok, iyi günler!

english: Hello. So you must be Kharrim the messenger.
How do you know my name, stranger?
Well now... I had a very interesting chat with Rennard the thief.
translation: Sey... Hirsiz Rennard ile cok ilginc bir sohbetim oldu.

english: It seems you redirected his message regarding a certain god-weapon for your own ends.
translation: Görünüse göre, belirli bir tanri silahiyla ilgili mesajini kendi cikarlarin icin yönlendirdin.

english: So THAT is what this is about... I should have known the deal was too good to have no repercussions...
translation: Demek mesele bu... Anlasmanin cok iyi oldugunu ve bunun bir bedeli olacagini bilmeliydim...

english: It seems as though you might be responsible for this curse that has befallen you by not delivering Rennard's message to the correct person.
translation: Rennard'in mesajini dogru kisiye iletmeyerek basina gelen bu lanetin sorumlusu sen olabilirsin.

english: Ha! That is not a truthful assessment of the story... You might think differently if you had heard my side of events.
translation: Ha! Bu, hikayenin dogru bir degerlendirmesi degil... Benim tarafimi dinleseydin, farkli düsünebilirdin.

english: Please let me hear your side of the story then...
translation: O zaman lütfen hikayenin senin tarafini dinleyeyim...

english: Well, if you have spoken to Rennard, then you will know that he had somehow managed to obtain a very valuable weapon, and was looking for buyers.
translation: Rennard ile konustunsa, onun bir sekilde cok degerli bir silah elde ettigini ve alici aradigini biliyorsundur.

english: What he probably didn't tell you, was that he met me in a drunken stupor in some smoke filled tavern, and I offered to arrange a purchaser for his item, in exchange for a small finders fee.
translation: Muhtemelen sana söylemedigi sey, benimle dumanli bir tavernada sarhos halde tanistigi ve benim de kücük bir komisyon karsiliginda onun esyasi icin bir alici bulmayi teklif ettigimdir.

english: So you knew what the staff was?
translation: Yani asanin ne oldugunu biliyor muydun?

english: The god-staff of Armadyl? Well, of course I did.
translation: Armadyl'in tanri asasi mi? Tabii ki biliyordum.

english: Honestly, you would have to be pretty slow-witted to not recognise a legendary artefact such as that.
translation: Dürüst olmak gerekirse, böyle efsanevi bir eseri tanimamak icin oldukca aptal olmak gerekir.

english: Wait, I don't understand, Rennard said that he had a buyer already in mind, and that you diverted his message to a General Zamorak instead?
translation: Dur, anlamadim, Rennard zaten bir alici buldugunu söyledi, sen de onun mesajini General Zamorak'a yönlendirdin, öyle mi?

english: Ha! Here is a word of advice for you adventurer; Never trust the words of a drunk.
translation: Ha! Sana bir tavsiye vereyim maceraci dostum: Asla sarhoslarin sözlerine güvenme.

english: Whatever he might have thought he was doing with it, in the end all that happened was he left me to arrange a purchaser for the item.
