translation: O ne yapmaya calistigini düsünürse düsünsün, sonunda olan tek sey, o esyanin alicisini bulma isini bana birakmasiydi.

english: So you thought you would offer it to General Zamorak?
translation: Yani onu General Zamorak'a teklif edecegini düsündün?

english: Ah yes, Lord Zamorak. He was merely a mortal back then, you know?
translation: Ah evet, Lord Zamorak. O zamanlar o sadece bir ölümlüydü, biliyor musun?

english: Yet I could see great things in store for him even then. He had a kind of brilliant ruthlessness... And that special kind of vicious streak you see so rarely...
translation: Yine de o zamanlar bile onun icin büyük seyler olacagini görebiliyordum. Onda bir tür parlak acimasizlik vardi... Ve nadiren rastlanan özel bir tür acimasizlik...

english: Well anyway, when given the task of selling a weapon forged by the very gods themselves, I naturally thought of Zamorak as a potential buyer.
translation: Her neyse, tanrilar tarafindan dövülmüs bir silahi satma görevi verildiginde, dogal olarak Zamorak'i potansiyel bir alici olarak düsündüm.

english: I was a messenger in his employ anyway, so it was a mere trifle to find him and deliver the news, and I knew of his particular interest in armour and weaponry of all kinds.
translation: Zaten onun hizmetinde bir uludum, bu yüzden onu bulup haberi iletmek cok kolaydi ve onun her türlü zirh ve silaha özel bir ilgisi oldugunu biliyordum.

english: Yes, he was always quite the connoisseur when it came to weaponry...
translation: Evet, silahlar konusunda her zaman bir uzman olmustur...

english: But I digress. I let Lord Zamorak know that there was some drunken fool with an artefact of incredible power that could probably be bought off with a few jewels and trinkets,
translation: Ama konudan saptim. Lord Zamorak'a, inanilmaz güce sahip bir eserle dolasan sarhos bir aptal oldugunu ve muhtemelen birkac mücevher ve ivir zivirla satin alinabilecegini söyledim.

english: and he escorted me to the tavern and made the purchase there and then.
translation: O da beni tavernaya götürdü ve orada satin aldi.

english: It was a satisfactory deal all around, I got a share of the sale price from Rennard, and I greatly increased my prestige amongst Zamorak and his followers.
translation: Her acidan tatmin edici bir anlasmaydi, Rennard'dan satis fiyatinin bir kismini aldim ve Zamorak ve takipcileri arasindaki prestijimi büyük ölcüde artirdim.

english: But maybe... Perhaps the events that followed were responsible for my cursed state...
translation: Ama belki... Belki de takip eden olaylar benim lanetli durumumun sorumlusuydu...

english: Events that followed?
I can not tell you of them precisely, for I myself was not there to witness them.
translation: Size tam olarak anlatamam, cünkü ben orada degildim ve olanlari görmedim.

english: I am after all, simply a messenger. When... 'it' happened, I was busy elsewhere delivering a message from Zamorak to the rest of his Mahjarrat ilk.
translation: Sonucta ben sadece bir haberciyim. O olay oldugunda, ben baska bir yerde Zamorak'in Mahjarrat soyundan olan digerlerine bir mesaj iletmekle mesguldüm.

english: When 'it' happened? What was 'it'?
As I have explained, I was not there, and I do not know what Zamorak did with the staff, but whatever it was resulted in his banishment by the other gods for many years.
translation: Daha önce de acikladigim gibi, ben orada degildim ve Zamorak'in asayi ne yaptigini bilmiyorum, ama her ne olduysa, diger tanrilar tarafindan uzun yillar sürgüne gönderilmesine neden oldu.

english: The very strange thing was that Saradomin must have known about it, whatever it was, before it even happened...
translation: Cok garip olan sey, Saradomin'in, her ne olduysa, daha gerceklesmeden önce bunu biliyor olmasiydi...

english: Really? Why do you say that?
Well, it was the contents of the message I was returning to Zamorak;
Lucien seemed quite certain that there was a spy for Saradomin somewhere amongst his followers named Lennissa.
translation: Lucien, takipcileri arasinda Lennissa adinda Saradomin icin casusluk yapan biri oldugundan oldukca emindi.

english: If whatever happened to the staff caused this curse to befall me, then it is certain that she too would have been afflicted, because she would have been in the very heart of the action.
translation: Asaya olanlar bu lanetin üzerime cökmesine neden olduysa, o da bu lanetten etkilenmis olmali, cünkü olaylarin tam merkezindeydi.

english: Hmmm....
You have given me much to think on adventurer. I would like to reward you with my sturdy messenger boots, may they aid you in your travels.
translation: Bana düsünmem gereken cok sey verdin maceraci. Sana saglam haberci botlarimla ödüllendirmek istiyorum, umarim seyahatlerinde sana yardimci olurlar.

english: But where can I find this Lennissa?
Ah yes, the whereabouts of the treacherous Lennissa...
translation: Ah evet, hain Lennissa'nin nerede oldugu...

english: Well, we knew little about her or she would have been caught and exposed as a traitor and a spy, but Lucien did mention that he had evidence that she was a great fan of ball games...
translation: Onun hakkinda cok az sey biliyoruz, yoksa yakalanip hain ve casus olarak ifsa edilirdi, ama Lucien onun top oyunlarina büyük bir hayran oldugunu gösteren kanitlari oldugunu söylemisti...

english: Okay, well I'll try and find him for you then.
translation: Tamam, o zaman onu senin icin bulmaya calisacagim.

english: Well, she was always sickeningly obedient to Saradomin, so I would expect her to have run to some great place of worship of him if she was affected by the curse to try and gain his blessing.
translation: Saradomin'e her zaman igrenc bir sekilde itaatkardi, bu yüzden lanetten etkilenmisse, onun kutsamasini kazanmak icin ona tapinan büyük bir yere kacmis olmasini beklerim.

english: According to Lucien's intelligence report, she had been uncovered as a spy by her constant use of ships to ferry information...
translation: Lucien'in istihbarat raporuna göre, sürekli gemileri kullanarak bilgi aktardigi icin casus oldugu ortaya cikmis...

english: It is entirely possible she would be located somewhere coastal to this day!
translation: Bugün bile kiyi seridinde bir yerde olmasi cok olasi!

english: Well, that's all fascinating, but I just don't particularly care. Bye-bye.
translation: Bunlar cok ilginc, ama beni pek ilgilendirmiyor. Hosca kal.

english: Hello again Kharrim.
Can you remind me where to find Lennissa?
Hello.
Could I have more of those ghostly robes you gave me?
translation: Bana verdigin hayalet cüppelerinden biraz daha alabilir miyim?

english: It seems as though the curse that keeps me here extends to my very clothing... which piece do you want?
translation: Beni burada tutan lanet giysilerime de bulasmis gibi görünüyor... Hangi parcayi istiyorsun?

english: Here you go.
Tell me your story
Goodbye then
Ask about Lennissa.
Ask for more ghostly robes.
Hello.
I don't know you, stranger. Get off our land.
There should be some good fights today.
I think I'll head to the bar on my next break.
translation: Bir sonraki molamda bara gidecegim galiba.

english: Keep an eye out for anything suspicious.
translation: Süpheli bir sey görürsen haber ver.

english: Don't bother me while I'm on duty.
What are you doing here? Leave at once!
translation: Burada ne isin var? Hemen git buradan!

english: Hello again. Do you need anything?
translation: Merhaba. Bir seye ihtiyacin var mi?

english: I'm good, thanks.
Well in that case, all the best.
Those damn broavs! Now I'll need to start over again!
translation: Lanet olasi broavlar! Simdi yeniden bastan baslamam gerekecek!

english: Er... Hello?
Oh, sorry, I didn't see you come in.
Is something wrong?
Just the usual sort of nonsense you get around here. One of the guards bought some broavs for tracking, but they keep getting distracted by my laundry and making a mess of it!
translation: Buralarda her zamanki sacmaliklar. Muhafizlardan biri iz sürmek icin broav satin aldi, ama benim camasirlarimla ilgilenip ortaligi dagittilar!

english: Right... Anyway, you don't happen to know someone called Darve do you? Or maybe someone called Movario?
translation: Anladim... Her neyse, Darve adinda birini taniyor musun? Ya da Movario adinda birini?

english: Movario? Oh yes I... Well, actually, I shouldn't really divulge client details. Times are tough enough as it is without me losing customers through gossiping!
translation: Movario mu? Evet, ben... Aslinda, müsteri bilgilerini ifsa etmemem gerekir. Zaten zor zamanlar geciriyoruz, dedikoduyla müsterilerimi kaybetmemeliyim!

english: Would 500 coins change your mind?
Oh... well I suppose so.
Okay, I'll be back shortly with the money.
Now, what can you tell me about Movario?
Well he's a fairly regular customer of mine. In fact, I have some of his clothes here right now.
translation: O benim düzenli müsterilerimden biri. Aslinda, su anda bazi kiyafetleri burada.

english: So does he live somewhere nearby?
I assume so, but I don't know where.
translation: Sanirim öyle, ama nerede oldugunu bilmiyorum.

english: Hmm... I need some way of tracking him down...
translation: Hmm... Onu bulmanin bir yolunu bulmam lazim...

english: Hang on... What was it you were saying earlier about those broavs?
translation: Bir dakika... Az önce broavlar hakkinda ne demistin?

english: Broavs? Well one of the guards bought some for tracking, but they keep getting distracted by the laundry.
translation: Broavlar mi? Muhafizlardan biri iz sürmek icin satin aldi, ama camasirlarin kokusuna dikkatleri dagiliyor.

english: You don't think I'd be able to use one to track Movario, do you?
translation: Movario'yu izlemek icin kullanabilecegimi düsünmüyor musun?

english: I guess so, but they track using smell, so you'd need something that smells like him.
translation: Sanirim evet, ama koku ile iz sürüyorlar, yani onun kokusuna benzeyen bir seye ihtiyacin var.

english: Like his dirty laundry, perhaps?
Oh, I see... I really shouldn't be giving out clothes belonging to customers.
translation: Anliyorum... Müsterilere ait kiyafetleri vermemem gerekir.

english: Surely you have something he won't miss.
translation: Eminim onun özlemeyecegi bir sey vardir.

english: Well... I was thinking that one of his shirts wouldn't last the cleaning process. I suppose you can have it, but Movario can't find out!
translation: Sey... Gömleklerinden birinin temizlik sürecinden sag cikamayacagini düsünüyordum. Alabilirsin, ama Movario ögrenmesin!

english: Thanks. So how would I go about getting myself one of those broavs?
translation: Tesekkürler. Peki bu broavlardan bir tane nasil edinebilirim?

english: I think they came from the Feldip Hills. Apparently there's some hunting expert down there who knows how to catch them.
translation: Sanirim Feldip Tepeleri'nden geliyorlar. Orada onlari yakalamayi bilen bir av uzmani varmis.

english: Perfect! Thanks for all the help.
Okay, fair enough.
You can trust me.
Oh... yes, I suppose I can.
Great! So what can you tell me about Movario?
Hello again. Could you remind me where I can get one of those broavs?
translation: Merhaba tekrar. O broavlardan birini nereden bulabilecegimi hatirlatir misin?

english: Perfect! Thanks for the help.
Would 500 coins change your mind?
Okay, fair enough.
[Charm] You can trust me.
What? How did you manage to get in here.
I've come for the orb.
I'll never let you take it.
Oi! You! Get out of there.
Get off me, ya little pest!
Argh, get the gnome!
You'll regret that!
Hello, how are you?
Don't speak to me you insignificant wretch! Die in the name of Khazard!
translation: Benimle konusma, önemsiz zavalli! Khazard adina öl!

english: Hello there.
You think you're so clever. You know nothing!
translation: Kendini cok akilli saniyorsun. Hicbir sey bilmiyorsun!

english: What?
I'll crush you and those pesky little green men!
translation: Seni ve o sinir bozucu kücük yesil adamlari ezecegim!

english: You there, stop!
Go back to your pesky little green friends.
translation: Sinir bozucu kücük yesil arkadaslarinin yanina dön.

english: I've come for the orbs.
You're out of your depth traveller. These orbs are part of a much larger picture.
translation: Sen bu isin icinden cikamazsin gezgin. Bu küreler cok daha büyük bir planin parcasi.

english: They're stolen goods, now give them here!
translation: Onlar calinti mallar, simdi onlari bana ver!

english: Ha, you really think you stand a chance? I'll crush you.
translation: Ha, gercekten bir sansin oldugunu mu saniyorsun? Seni ezecegim.

english: I thought I killed you?
Fool, warriors blessed by Khazard don't die. You can't kill that which is already dead. However I can kill you!
translation: Aptal, Khazard'in kutsadigi savascilar ölmez. Zaten ölü olani öldüremezsin. Ama seni öldürebilirim!

english: Hello there.
Ooooh, heeellooo! Anyshing a bright dwarf like me can help you with?
translation: Ooooh, merhaba! Benim gibi zeki bir cüce sana yardimci olabilir mi?

english: The only thing you can help me with is finding the nearest place to get a drink, I think...
translation: Bana yardimci olabilecegin tek sey, en yakin icki icebilecegim yeri bulmak, sanirim...

english: That ish shimple! Help yourshelf to the dwarvern shtout! I mean dwarfen! I mean...
translation: Bu cok basit! Cüce sarabindan kendine bir bardak al! Yani cüce sarabi! Yani...

english: I'm not shure what I mean.
translation: Ne demek istedigimi tam olarak bilmiyorum.

english: I'm looking for schematics to modify the dwarven multicannon to fire a human. Can you help?
translation: Cüce coklu topunu insan ateslemek icin modifiye etmek icin semalar ariyorum. Yardimci olabilir misin?

english: Haha, yesh, I have jusht the shing!
translation: Haha, evet, tam da aradigin sey bende var!

english: I've been working on thish deshign for quite a while now!
Never got to test it, love to shee it shoot a real human!
translation: Hic test etme firsatim olmadi, gercek bir insani vurmasini cok isterim!

english: Well, can you give them to me? I'd be willing to try the experiment.
translation: Peki, bana verebilir misin? Deneyi denemek isterim.

english: Oooh, shure, shure... I've only got one part left, though, I gave all the other parts away.
translation: Tabii, tabii... Ama sadece bir parca kaldi, diger parcalari verdim.

english: Who did you give them to?
How should I know? I'm only a shimple dwarf.
translation: Nereden bileyim? Ben sadece basit bir cüceyim.

english: Okay, okay, can I have that one schematic then?
translation: Tamam, tamam, o zaman o semayi alabilir miyim?

english: Of courshe!
Just give me a drink and I'll gladly help you.
translation: Bana bir icki ver, seve seve yardim ederim.

english: No, I've had enough of buying drinks for people!
It's always like this... Sure, I'll help you [player name], just as soon as you get me a drink!
translation: Her zaman böyle... Tabii, sana yardim ederim Maceraci, bana bir icki ismarlarsan!

english: And more often than not they actually want a very special kind of drink that can only be gotten in the next town, or beyond.
translation: Ve cogu zaman, sadece bir sonraki kasabada veya daha uzaklarda bulunabilen cok özel bir icki istiyorlar.

english: And what is wrong with all you people anyway? Sometimes it seems as if half the population of Gielinor are alcoholics!
translation: Sizin neyiniz var böyle? Bazen Gielinor'un yarisi alkolikmis gibi geliyor!

english: So, no, I won't do it anymore, you can get your own drink for once, and I'm just going to stay right here until you've done so!
translation: Yani, hayir, artik yapmayacagim, bir kez olsun kendi ickini kendin al, ben de sen bunu yapana kadar burada bekleyecegim!

english: Pffft, I only wanted a dwarven shtout from that table over there.
translation: Pffft, ben sadece suradaki masadan bir cüce shtout istemistim.

english: Here, have the shtupid schematic, I've gone right off my drink now.
translation: Al, aptal semayi al, ickimden vazgectim.

english: Thanks for that schematic.
Sho have you been shot out of a cannon yet?
translation: Sho, henüz top mermisinden firlatildin mi?

english: No, fortunately not.
MMMGHGHGGMH!!!
What's going on ARRGH!
Arrgh! Human! Scary! Go away!
What? eh? Did you say something?
translation: Ne? Eh? Bir sey mi dedin?

english: Who's there? Hello?
mmmmghmhhmh
Hello?
Who are you?
It doesn't look like this monkey can hear you.
translation: Bu maymun seni duyamiyor gibi görünüyor.

english: Is there somebody there?
It doesn't look like this monkey can see you.
translation: Bu maymun seni göremiyor gibi görünüyor.

english: mmmmghhh mhhhh
It doesn't look like this monkey can... you get the idea...
There's something familiar about you guys...
I'm Mizaru - This is Iwazaru
mmhggmmmhh
He says hello, and this is Kikazaru
translation: Merhaba diyor, ve bu da Kikazaru...

english: Oi, you, pay attention!
Mizaru gives Kikazaru a slap.
What? Oh, Hello who are you? I'm Kikazaru.
translation: Ne? Oh, Merhaba, kimsin sen? Ben Kikazaru.

english: I've already said that.
What? Oh, This is Mizaru and Kikazaru.
translation: Ne? Oh, bunlar Mizaru ve Kikazaru.

english: Mizaru turns and stares at Kikazaru.
I'VE ALREADY SAID THAT.
Not very bright that one.
ggmmhhmm
Iwazaru waves his hands around at Kikazaru in a way that might be monkey sign language.
translation: Iwazaru, Kikazaru'ya maymun isaret diliyle konusuyormus gibi elini salliyor.

english: (sarcastically) Yeah, while you're the clever monkey around here aren't you?
translation: (alayci bir sekilde) Evet, buradaki zeki maymun sensin, degil mi?

english: (Iwazaru waves his arms again. Whatever he said it wasn't very polite.)
translation: (Iwazaru tekrar ellerini salladi. Ne dedigi cok kibar degildi.)

english: Hee Hee Hee, you're so rude.
translation: Hee Hee Hee, cok kaba birisin.

english: Grrr. Do you have any other questions?
That's all for the moment.
So What exactly are you doing here?
translation: Peki, burada tam olarak ne yapiyorsunuz?

english: Oh just monkeying around.
(Iwazaru slaps his forehead)
You look trustworthy, I'll tell you a secret.
translation: Güvenilir görünüyorsun, sana bir sir verecegim.

english: (whispers) We're on a top secret mission, given to us by the King...
translation: (fisildayarak) Kral tarafindan bize verilen cok gizli bir görevdeyiz...

english: We are the exalted Guardians of one of the King's biggest secrets.
translation: Kralin en büyük sirlarindan birinin yüce koruyuculariyiz.

english: Can't say any more than that or the King would go Ape on us.
translation: Daha fazlasini söyleyemem, yoksa Kral bize cok kizar.

english: Oh go on...
No. We will protect the recipe with our lives...
translation: Hayir. Bu tarifi hayatimiz pahasina koruyacagiz...

english: grrmmh fffhmmm (Iwazaru looks disgruntled)
Yeah, I agree with Iwazaru. The king CURSED us!
translation: Evet, Iwazaru'ya katiliyorum. Kral bizi LANETLEDI!

english: How did he curse you?
hmhmhhhh mmgghh
I know, I know, I'll tell him
NO!, I forbid you to tell this stranger anything!
translation: HAYIR! Bu yabanciya hicbir sey söylemene izin vermiyorum!

english: I can't hear you...
Yeah, well hear this gnome-brain! (He slaps Kikazaru)
translation: Evet, dinle bakalim cüce beyinli! (Kikazaru'ya tokat atar)

english: Ow! There was this recipe right.
Stop it!
Mizaru slaps Iwazaru. Iwazaru slaps Mizaru back. They start to fight.
translation: Mizaru, Iwazaru'ya tokat atar. Iwazaru, Mizaru'ya karsilik verir. Kavga etmeye baslarlar.

english: (Oof!) He liked it so much he married the cook! YEAH? Have some of this! (poke!)
translation: (Oof!) O kadar cok sevdi ki asciyla evlendi! ÖYLE MI? Al da bak! (dürtme!)

english: AARGH not in the eye! (kick)
(Oof!) The King thought it was magic and AAAIEEE! He got a priest to curse us to keep quiet. (headbutt!)
translation: (Oof!) Kral bunun sihir oldugunu düsündü ve AAAIEEE! Bir rahip cagirip bizi sessiz kalmamiz icin lanetledi. (kafa atma!)

english: Mizaru slumps to the floor and rolls about in pain.
translation: Mizaru yere yigilir ve aci icinde yuvarlanir.

english: Ha! Serves you right! Anyway, The priest only had enough ingredients for one curse, so when he tried to keep us all from telling anyone the recipe, each of us only got part of the curse. That's why I can't hear anything now.
translation: Ha! Hak ettin! Neyse, rahibin sadece bir lanet icin yeterli malzemesi vardi, bu yüzden hepimizin tarifi kimseye söylememesi icin ugrasirken, her birimize lanetin sadece bir kismi düstü. Bu yüzden simdi hicbir sey duyamiyorum.

english: mmmmghhh (he nods his head)
How do you know about that - It's top secret information you know.
translation: Bunu nereden biliyorsun? Bu cok gizli bir bilgi, biliyorsun.

english: Well, I am also on a top secret mission.
translation: Ben de cok gizli bir görevdeyim.

english: Ah I see, can you tell me what the mission is?
translation: Anliyorum, görevin ne oldugunu söyleyebilir misin?

english: Well, it's on a strict need to know basis. I'm sure you understand.
translation: Bu bilgi sadece gerekli olanlarla paylasilabilir. Eminim anlarsin.

english: Of course, of course.
However, I think I can trust you with sensitive material.
translation: Ancak, sana hassas bilgileri emanet edebilecegimi düsünüyorum.

english: (Iwazaru raises an eyebrow dubiously. You give him a wink.)
translation: (Iwazaru süpheyle kaslarini kaldirir. Sen ona göz kirparsin.)

english: (You whisper in Mizaru's ear) I've been charged with organising a secret party to celebrate the king's birthday, keep it quiet though, don't let a single monkey know.
translation: (Mizaru'nun kulagina fisildarsin) Kralin dogum gününü kutlamak icin gizli bir parti düzenlemekle görevlendirildim, ama bunu kimseye söyleme, tek bir maymun bile bilmemeli.

english: Well, in that case, you definitely do need to know the recipe.
The king has a real soft spot for Roasted Giant Snake stuffed with sliced banana and monkey nut paste.
translation: Kral, dilimlenmis muz ve maymun fistigi ezmesi ile doldurulmus Kizarmis Dev Yilan'a bayilir.

english: GGHHMM! (Iwazaru starts jumping up and down)
Yup, you need to find some bananas, and some monkey nuts and stuff a Giant snake with them. It's as simple as that. Stop hassling me Iwazaru.
translation: Evet, biraz muz ve maymun fistigi bulup dev yilani bunlarla doldurmalisin. Bu kadar basit. Beni rahatsiz etme Iwazaru.

english: Where do I find this stuff then?
Every monkey knows where to get hold of nuts and bananas, but I believe that the snakes live on a nearby island. Never seen one myself.
translation: Her maymun fistik ve muzu nereden bulacagini bilir, ama yilanlar yakinlardaki bir adada yasiyor sanirim. Ben hic görmedim.

english: This feels like the banana, this should do the job.
translation: Bu muz gibi görünüyor, isimizi görür.

english: (Iwazaru Jumps up and down waving his arms and legs about wildly)
translation: (Iwazaru ziplamaya baslar ve kollarini ve bacaklarini cilginca sallamaya baslar)

english: Quiet! Iwazaru.
(Iwazaru grabs you by the arm)
(He shakes his head vigourously)
I think your friend wants to tell me something.
translation: Sanirim arkadasin bana bir sey söylemek istiyor.

english: Oh ignore him, he's clueless.
translation: Onu bos ver, o hicbir seyden anlamiyor.

english: GGGRRRMMHHGG!!
(Iwazaru makes what you suspect was a very rude gesture to Mizaru)
translation: (Iwazaru, Mizaru'ya cok kaba bir hareket yaptigini düsündügün bir hareket yapar)

english: (Iwazaru starts gesturing at Kikazaru)
hmmm...
(Iwazaru gestures some more)
translation: (Iwazaru biraz daha el kol hareketleri yapiyor)

english: Really?
(Iwazaru waves his arms about yet more)
translation: (Iwazaru daha da fazla el kol hareketleri yapiyor)

english: Oh that's very interesting.
Well....
(Iwazaru sighs. And points to you.)
translation: (Iwazaru ic cekiyor. Ve seni isaret ediyor.)

english: What, eh, oh right.
Iwazaru says you have the wrong type of banana.
translation: Iwazaru, yanlis türde muz aldigini söylüyor.

english: You need a red one.
(sigh), I should have guessed that it wouldn't be that easy. A red banana. Don't all bananas taste the same?
translation: (ic ceker), Bu kadar kolay olmayacagini tahmin etmeliydim. Kirmizi muz. Bütün muzlarin tadi ayni degil mi?

english: (Iwazaru looks shocked)
(Mizaru looks astounded)
(Kikazaru looks blankly over your shoulder)
How can a monkey say such a thing!
translation: Bir maymun nasil böyle bir sey söyleyebilir!

english: Oh, you mean RED bananas, yes, of course, I've heard that they are the tastiest. Much tastier than blue bananas. How could I forget. Bah, only a fake monkey wouldn't know that. Ahem.
translation: Oh, kirmizi muzlari kastediyorsun, evet, tabii ki, onlarin en lezzetli oldugunu duymustum. Mavi muzlardan cok daha lezzetli. Nasil unutabilirim. Bah, sadece sahte bir maymun bunu bilmez. Ahem.

english: Blue bananas? There's no such thing. Hey, wait a second where did you say you come from?
translation: Mavi muzlar mi? Öyle bir sey yok. Hey, bir saniye, nereden geldigini söylemistin?

english: Errm I'm not from round here, anyway, moving quickly on, is there a red banana tree nearby?
translation: Errm, ben burali degilim, neyse, hizlica devam edelim, yakinlarda kirmizi muz agaci var mi?

english: (Iwazaru nods enthusiastically and points West)
translation: (Iwazaru coskuyla basini sallar ve batiyi gösterir)

english: Iwazaru says that there is a tree in the West of the Island.
translation: Iwazaru, adanin batisinda bir agac oldugunu söylüyor.

english: Right! I'd better start looking for a red banana tree.
translation: Tamam! Kirmizi muz agaci aramaya baslasam iyi olacak.

english: Ah, monkey nuts. Good work
(Iwazaru is hysterically trying to get your attention)
Stop playing around Iwazaru.
(Iwazaru shakes his head vigourously)
I think Iwazaru is trying to say something.
translation: Sanirim Iwazaru bir sey söylemeye calisiyor.

english: Oh ignore him.
mmmh!! (He quickly makes some signs at Kikazaru)
Ah, I see...
Iwazaru says that you have the wrong kind of monkey nuts. Ordinary Monkeys nuts just won't do.
translation: Iwazaru, yanlis türde maymun fistigi aldigini söylüyor. Siradan maymun fistigi ise yaramaz.

english: There is a special type of monkey nut that grows on the island and has a subtle and distinctive flavour that is highly valued by all monkeys with a sophisticated palate.
translation: Adada yetisen özel bir maymun fistigi türü var ve bu fistik, sofistike damak tadi olan tüm maymunlar tarafindan cok deger verilen ince ve kendine özgü bir tada sahip.

english: They are called Tchiki monkey nuts and require a very particular combination of soil and climate.
translation: Bunlara Tchiki maymun fistigi denir ve cok özel bir toprak ve iklim kombinasyonu gerektirir.

english: They need the minerals and dampness found in hill caves, but also cannot grow without sunlight.
translation: Tepelerdeki magaralarda bulunan minerallere ve neme ihtiyac duyarlar, ancak günes isigi olmadan da yetisemezler.

english: Myth and Legend shrouds the History of the Tchiki Monkey Nut.
translation: Tchiki maymun fistiginin tarihi efsane ve mitlerle örtülüdür.

english: Some say that it is the nut that gave monkeys their superior intelligence!
translation: Bazilari, maymunlara üstün zekalarini verenin bu fistik oldugunu söyler!

english: Others say Tchiki Monkey nuts are the food of the Monkey Gods.
translation: Digerleri ise Tchiki maymun fistiginin maymun tanrilarinin yiyecegi oldugunu söyler.

english: Either way, you will have to find a path through treacherous undergrowth to harvest the Nut of Kings.
translation: Her iki durumda da, Krallarin Findigini hasat etmek icin tehlikeli caliliklar arasindan bir yol bulmaniz gerekecek....

english: ... He said all that?
Yup
I never realised monkey sign language was so... concise. Anywhere, where do I find this plant then?
translation: Maymunlarin isaret dilinin bu kadar... özlü oldugunu hic fark etmemistim. Peki, bu bitkiyi nerede bulabilirim?

english: (Iwazaru nods enthusiastically and points South)
translation: (Iwazaru heyecanla basini sallar ve güneyi gösterir)

english: Look to the hills, south of here.
Right! I'd better start looking for this Tchiki Monkey Nut Bush then...
translation: Tamam! O zaman bu Tchiki Maymun Fistigi Caliligini aramaya baslasam iyi olur...

english: So What exactly are you doing here?
translation: Peki, burada tam olarak ne yapiyorsun?

english: Do you know anything about Awowogei's favourite dish?
translation: Awowogei'nin en sevdigi yemegi biliyor musun?

english: What's... wrong with you?
That's all for the moment.
What are you doing here?
Do you know anything about the King's favourite dish?
translation: Kralin en sevdigi yemegi biliyor musun?

english: Woo, party on bro!
The killer approaches Sid behind his back.
Woah, that wind totally just felt like someone breathing on my neck!
translation: Vay canina, bu rüzgar sanki biri enseme nefesini üflüyor gibi!

english: The killer stabs Sid.
Whoah, not cool bro...
translation: Vay canina, hic hos degil dostum...

english: ...urgh...
...I'm feeling woozy...
...gargh...
...I see the light...
...urrggghhh...
...it's not my time...glurgh
...gargle...urgh...
Sid stumbles forward, drowning in the water barrel.
translation: Sid öne dogru sendeler ve su varilinde bogulur.

english: ...glargh...help...me...
...urgh...hergle...
...flergh.
Sid collapses to the ground in a crumpled mess. As he falls down you spot something shiny fall out of his shirt pocket and into the barrel of water.
translation: Sid yere yigilir. Düserken, gömleginin cebinden parlak bir seyin su ficisina düstügünü görürsünüz.

english: Gosh, that was horrible and so drawn out!
translation: Tanrim, bu korkunc ve cok uzadi!

english: Oh wow, he's still going...
I think he is actually dead this time.
Who are you? Why are you doing this!?
The killer walks away.
Gah! I've got to find a way into that house and stop this maniac!
translation: Gah! O eve girmenin bir yolunu bulmali ve bu manyak adami durdurmaliyim!

english: I wonder what it was that I saw fall into that barrel?
translation: O varile düsen sey neydi acaba?

english: The killer appears from a closet, stabbing Tayten, who is reading a book.
translation: Katil dolaptan cikar ve kitap okuyan Tayten'i bicaklar.

english: Gurgle...
Nooooo!
The killer slips a note under the door, and escapes using the closet.
translation: Katil kapinin altindan bir not uzatir ve dolaptan kacar.

english: What's this? A note? I guess I should read it.
translation: Bu ne? Bir not mu? Sanirim okumaliyim.

english: Please, stop this, just let me go!
We're going to play a game. Do you like to play games?
translation: Bir oyun oynayacagiz. Oyun oynamayi sever misin?

english: No...yes....whatever you say, just don't hurt me!
translation: Hayir... evet... ne derseniz deyin, sadece bana zarar vermeyin!

english: Whether you get hurt or not is entirely up to you. Your fate is in your own hands.
translation: Zarar görüp görmeyecegin tamamen sana bagli. Kaderin senin elinde.

english: What!? What do you mean!?
Leave her alone you monster!
Ah, [player name], how kind of you to join us. Now if you say another word, I will end her right now!
translation: Ah, Maceraci, bize katildigin icin cok naziksin. Simdi bir kelime daha edersen, onu hemen öldürürüm!

english: Sorry, where were we? Ah yes, of course! The game!
translation: Pardon, nerede kalmistik? Ah evet, tabii ki! Oyun!

english: Do you like quests, Lacey?
Ummm, sure, I like quests.
Do you like scary quests?
Uh-huh.
What's your favourite scary quest?
I don't know.
You have to have a favourite.
Umm.....the one with that vampyre in it who lives in a big house.
translation: Hmm... Büyük bir evde yasayan vampir olan.

english: Good, good. And now for that game I spoke about.
translation: Güzel, güzel. Simdi de bahsettigim oyuna gecelim.

english: I am going to ask you one question. Get it wrong and you die, but get it right and you live.
translation: Sana bir soru soracagim. Yanlis cevap verirsen ölürsün, dogru cevap verirsen yasarsin.

english: Oh Guthix please no, please don't, I don't want to die!
translation: Oh Guthix, lütfen hayir, lütfen yapma, ölmek istemiyorum!

english: Then think hard about your answer. You like vampyres so this should be easy for you. The question is this...
translation: O zaman cevabini iyi düsün. Vampirleri seviyorsun, bu yüzden senin icin kolay olmali. Soru su...

english: Who is the Vampyre that resides in South Misthalin?
Urm...
Count Draynor!
Count Check!
Lord Drakan!
This game didn't involve you [player name]! Now her death is on you! Her blood is on your hands you fool!
translation: Bu oyun seninle alakali degildi Maceraci! Simdi onun ölümü senin sucun! Onun kani senin ellerinde, seni aptal!

english: The killer stabs Lacey.
Gargle...urgh...
Oh yes, yes, I know it! Count Draynor!
translation: Oh evet, evet, biliyorum! Kont Draynor!

english: Ha, in your face you masked freak!
Oh Lacey, Lacey, Lacey. I did tell you to think hard about your answer.
translation: Oh Lacey, Lacey, Lacey. Cevabini iyi düsünmeni söylemistim.

english: Count Draynor is in fact a vampyre, and he does reside in his manor in Misthalin.
translation: Kont Draynor aslinda bir vampirdir ve Misthalin'deki malikanesinde yasar.

english: But that manor is in WEST Misthalin! I was talking about Count Check! Thanks for playing!
translation: Ama o malikane BATI Misthalin'de! Ben Kont Check'ten bahsediyordum! Oyuna katildigin icin tesekkürler!

english: No, no you tricked me! This isn't fair, ask me another...
translation: Hayir, hayir, beni kandirdin! Bu adil degil, baska bir soru sor...

english: Lacey dies.
The killer slips a note through the fence, and walks away.
translation: Katil citin arasindan bir not uzatir ve uzaklasir.

english: That monster! I have to stop them! Let's see what that new note says.
translation: O canavar! Onlari durdurmaliyim! Bakalim yeni notta ne yaziyor.

english: Why am I the one who is always left clearing up after everyone?
translation: Neden her zaman herkesin ardindan temizlik yapan ben oluyorum?

english: Hello? Anyone there?
Hello? Lacey? Sid?
Hmm, well I guess I should go check it out. No point staying in this nice, locked room when I could go outside into the creepy darkness.
translation: Hmm, sanirim gidip bir bakmaliyim. Disarida ürkütücü karanlik varken bu güzel, kilitli odada kalmanin bir anlami yok.

english: Seriously!?
The walls and door seem too thick for Mandy to be able to hear you.
translation: Duvarlar ve kapi Mandy'nin seni duyamayacagi kadar kalin görünüyor.

english: Oh, and I don't think there is any need to take this big, shiny weapon with me in order to defend myself. Nothing bad ever happens when people go check out noises in the dark outside of houses!
translation: Oh, ve kendimi savunmak icin bu büyük, parlak silahi yanima almamin bir geregi oldugunu sanmiyorum. Insanlar evlerinin disindaki karanlikta sesleri kontrol etmeye gittiklerinde asla kötü bir sey olmaz!

english: You have got to be kidding...
Ok, well, here I go!
Mandy goes outside to investigate the noises.
translation: Mandy sesleri arastirmak icin disari cikar.

english: Hello, anyone out here?
Mandy looks around.
See, I knew nothing would happen! Must have just been a squirrel or something running about.
translation: Gördün mü, hicbir sey olmayacagini biliyordum! Sadece bir sincap ya da baska bir sey kosusturuyor olmali.

english: Mandy goes back into the kitchen.
Oh well, back to the dishes.
Phew, that was lucky!
The killer comes out of the closet near the exit and stabs Mandy.
translation: Katil, cikisin yanindaki dolaptan cikar ve Mandy'yi bicaklar.

english: No...why...me...
Mandy dies.
That psycho! He was just toying with her!
Another note. This guy really likes playing games, but this is going to be a game he won't win!
translation: Baska bir not. Bu adam oyun oynamayi cok seviyor, ama bu oyunu kazanamayacak!

english: Show yourself you coward!
So we meet at last. I have to say, I'm impressed you worked out my riddles.
translation: Sonunda tanistik. Bulmacalarimi cözdügün icin seni takdir etmeliyim.

english: Well maybe you aren't as smart as you think you are.
translation: Belki de sandigin kadar zeki degilsindir.

english: Oh really? All the dead bodies suggest otherwise. And what did you do to stop them?
translation: Öyle mi? Tüm cesetler aksini gösteriyor. Onlari durdurmak icin ne yaptin?

english: NOTHING!
People think you are some big hero but you're not. All you adventurers are the same. Nothing but opportunists!
translation: Insanlar seni büyük bir kahraman saniyor ama degilsin. Siz maceracilar hep aynisiniz. Firsatcilardan baska bir sey degilsiniz!

english: What are you going on about?
Well, I did have this big speech planned out but quite frankly I don't think you are worth the effort it would take to deliver it.
translation: Aslinda uzun bir konusma hazirlamistim ama acikcasi bunu söylemeye degecek kadar degerli oldugunu düsünmüyorum.

english: So, this is the end of the line for you. It is time for the final act. The showdown. The finale. Let's see if you are up to the challenge!
translation: Yani, senin icin yolun sonu geldi. Son perde zamani. Karsilasma. Final. Bakalim bu mücadeleye hazir misin!

english: Urgh...I think I may have underestimated you.
You've lost at your own game. And now it is time to see who you really are under that mask!
translation: Kendi oyununda kaybettin. Simdi maskenin altinda gercekte kim oldugunu görme zamani!

english: The player unmasks the killer, revealing Abigale as the culprit.
translation: Oyuncu katilin maskesini cikarir ve Abigale'in suclu oldugunu ortaya cikarir.

english: No! You!? But why!? Why on earth would you kill all your friends!? Why beg me to come here to help them!?
translation: Hayir! Sen mi!? Ama neden!? Neden tüm arkadaslarini öldürdün!? Neden buraya gelip onlara yardim etmem icin yalvardin!?

english: You just don't get it do you?
So big headed. So used to it all being about you. About you saving the day.
translation: Cok kibirli. Her seyin seninle ilgili olmasina alismissin. Her seyi senin kurtarmana.

english: Well I'm sick of it!
What do you mean?
Adventurers! You're all the same. Everything always has to be about you.
translation: Maceracilar! Hepiniz aynisiniz. Her sey her zaman sizinle ilgili olmak zorunda.

english: I don't understand?
Of course you wouldn't! Because you can't see past yourself!
translation: Tabii ki anlamazsin! Cünkü kendinden ötesini göremezsin!

english: Believe it or not... I used to be like you.
translation: Ister inan ister inanma... Ben de eskiden senin gibiydim.

english: I'd hear about some damsel in distress and go to help. To have my moment. For me to be the hero, just for once.
translation: Tehlikede olan bir kiz duydugumda yardima giderdim. Kendi animi yasamak icin. Bir kez olsun kahraman olmak icin.

english: But YOU! You and every other darned adventurer! Every time I get there to help, it's too late. Crisis solved. Disaster averted. Reward claimed. Every time you and those other adventurers steal my moment!
translation: Ama sen! Sen ve diger tüm lanet maceracilar! Ne zaman yardima gitsem, cok gec kalmisimdir. Kriz cözülmüs. Felaket önlenmis. Ödül alinmis. Her seferinde sen ve diger maceracilar benim animi caliyorsunuz!

english: But not this time!
This time, it is all about me! I'm the star of the show! ME ME ME ME ME!
translation: Bu sefer her sey benimle ilgili! Ben bu gösterinin yildiziyim! BEN BEN BEN BEN BEN!

english: Well not any longer. The show is over, and there will be no curtain call.
translation: Artik degil. Gösteri bitti ve perde kapanmayacak.

english: Oh, but there is always a curtain call.
Another killer comes out of the closest near the door.
translation: Kapinin yanindaki dolaptan baska bir katil cikar.

english: What!? How!? There was another killer!?
translation: Ne!? Nasil!? Baska bir katil mi vardi!?

english: Of course. Every good show needs a good supporting actor. Now, take off your mask darling. Take a bow. You have earned it.
translation: Elbette. Her iyi sovun iyi bir yardimci oyuncusu olmasi gerekir. Simdi maskeni cikar sevgilim. Selam ver. Bunu hak ettin.

english: Of course, my love.
The killer unmasks himself, revealing Hewey as the culprit.
translation: Katil maskesini cikarir ve Hewey'in suclu oldugunu ortaya cikarir.

english: You!? But how!? You were almost dead when I saw you! I saw your wounds!
translation: Sen mi!? Ama nasil!? Seni gördügümde neredeyse ölmüstün! Yaralarini gördüm!

english: No, what you watched was what we wanted you to watch. A masterful performance if I do say myself.
translation: Hayir, senin gördügün sey bizim senin görmeni istedigimiz seydi. Kendim söyleyeyim, ustaca bir performansdi.

english: But what is in this for you?
translation: Peki bunun sana ne faydasi var?

english: Everyone loves the limelight, and who better to share it with than my beloved Abigale.
translation: Herkes spot isiklarini sever ve bunu sevgili Abigale'den daha iyi kimle paylasabilirim ki?

english: But your friends?
They didn't deserve to die!
Perhaps not, but neither did I deserve to be cast back into the shadows when I deserve the spotlight!
translation: Belki hak etmediler, ama ben de spot isiklarini hak ettigim halde gölgelere geri atilmayi hak etmedim!

english: Yes, while we deserve the spotlight.
translation: Evet, biz spot isigini hak ediyoruz.

english: And now I have my starring role!
OUR starring role.
Gielinor will forever remember this night and what I have done here.
translation: Gielinor bu geceyi ve burada yaptiklarimi sonsuza kadar hatirlayacak.

english: No, what WE have done!
Quiet Hewey! This is my moment!
translation: Sessiz ol Hewey! Bu benim anim!

english: No, this is supposed to be our moment! It isn't just all about you either! We were in this together!
translation: Hayir, bu bizim animiz olmali! Bu sadece seninle ilgili degil! Biz bu iste birlikteydik!

english: Stop ruining this Hewey! I have worked so hard for this and I'm not going to let you take it away from me!
translation: Bunu mahvetmeyi birak Hewey! Bunun icin cok calistim ve bunu benden almana izin vermeyecegim!

english: Well I'm not going to be pushed aside either, we were both in this as equals!
translation: Ben de kenara itilmeyecegim, ikimiz de esit olarak bu isin icindeydik!

english: We were never equals! How could you possibly compare to me!?
translation: Asla esit olmadik! Sen benimle nasil kiyaslanabilirsin ki?

english: You egotistical, selfish...
Abigale stabs Hewey.
No...my love...
Hewey dies.
No....no...what have I done!?
It wasn't supposed to be like this...but you just couldn't let me have my moment. WHY HEWEY WHY!? I loved you...
translation: Böyle olmamaliydi... ama sen benim animi yasamama izin vermedin. NEDEN HEWEY NEDEN!? Seni seviyordum...

english: This could be my chance to take advantage of the situation...
translation: Bu durumdan yararlanmak icin bir firsat olabilir...

english: *shuffle*
*rustle*
*scratch*
Count Draynor
Count Check
Lord Drakan
Say nothing
Hello there.
Hello.
How are you?
Busy.
Hello friend.
It was the bewk that told me ta come here.
What book?
Circles within trees it is. And hopping too.
Are you ok?
I'll find the light, that will see me through.
Oookay then, I'll just go explore then.
translation: Tamam o zaman, ben gidip kesfe cikayim.

english: Jelly shards in the dark.
I'm lost!
I'm lost too!
Welcome to my court. I am King Arthur of the Knights of the Round Table.
translation: Sarayima hos geldin. Ben Yuvarlak Masa Sövalyeleri'nden Kral Arthur.

english: I want to become a Knight of the Round Table!
Really? Well then you will need to go on a quest to prove yourself worthy. My knights all appreciate a good quest.
translation: Gercekten mi? O zaman kendini kanitlamak icin bir göreve cikman gerekecek. Sövalyelerim iyi görevleri cok severler.

english: Unfortunately, our current quest is to rescue Merlin. He recently got himself trapped in some sort of magical crystal. We've moved him from the cave we found him in and now he's upstairs in his tower.
translation: Maalesef, su anki görevimiz Merlin'i kurtarmak. Kendisi kisa süre önce bir tür sihirli kristalin icinde hapsoldu. Onu buldugumuz magaradan cikardik ve su anda kulesinin üst katinda.

english: I will see what I can do then.
translation: O zaman ne yapabilecegime bir bakayim.

english: Talk to my knights if you need any help.
I may come back and try that later.
Be sure that you come speak to me soon then.
translation: O zaman mutlaka gelip benimle konus.

english: So what are you doing in Gielinor?
Well legend says we will return to Britain in its time of greatest need. But that's not for quite a while yet.
translation: Efsaneye göre, Britanya'nin en cok ihtiyac duydugu anda geri dönecegiz. Ama bunun icin henüz zaman var.

english: So we've moved the whole outfit here for now.
translation: Bu yüzden simdilik tüm ekipmanimizi buraya tasidik.

english: We're passing the time in Gielinor!
Thank you very much.
Now I am a knight of the round table, do you have any more quests for me?
translation: Artik yuvarlak masanin sövalyesiyim, benim icin baska görevleriniz var mi?

english: Aha! I'm glad you are here! I am sending out various knights on an important quest. I was wondering if you too would like to take up this quest?
translation: Aha! Buraya geldigine sevindim! Cesitli sövalyeleri önemli bir göreve gönderiyorum. Sen de bu görevi üstlenmek ister misin?

english: Tell me of this quest.
Well, we recently found out that the Holy Grail has passed into Gielinor.
translation: Sey, kisa süre önce Kutsal Kase'nin Gielinor'a geldigini ögrendik.

english: This is most fortuitous!
None of my knights ever did return with it last time. Now we have the opportunity to give it another go, maybe this time we will have more luck!
translation: Gecen sefer sövalyelerimden hicbiri onu geri getiremedi. Simdi tekrar deneme firsatimiz var, belki bu sefer daha sansli oluruz!

english: Before starting this quest, be aware that your combat level is lower than the recommended level of 50.
translation: Bu göreve baslamadan önce, savas seviyenizin önerilen seviye olan 50'den düsük oldugunu unutmayin.

english: I'd enjoy trying that.
Go speak to Merlin. He may be able to give a better clue as to where it is now you have freed him from that crystal.
translation: Merlin ile konusun. Onu kristalden kurtardiginiza göre, Kutsal Kase'nin su anda nerede oldugu konusunda daha iyi bir ipucu verebilir.

english: He has set up his workshop in the room next to the library.
I am weary of questing for the time being...
I am weary of questing for the time being...
Maybe later then?
Maybe so.
Welcome, brave knight. I am always happy to see you back at my court. Please feel free to roam the castle and make use of the training grounds.
translation: Hos geldin, cesur sövalye. Seni sarayimda görmek her zaman mutluluk verici. Lütfen kalede dolasmaktan ve egitim alanlarindan yararlanmaktan cekinme.

english: I want to become a Knight of the Round Table!
Yes.
No.
So what are you doing in Gielinor?
Thank you very much.
Tell me of this quest.
Hello.
Well hello stranger. My name's Bolren, I'm the king of the tree gnomes.
translation: Merhaba yabanci. Benim adim Bolren, agac cücelerinin kraliyim.

english: I'm surprised you made it in, maybe I made the maze too easy.
translation: Iceri girmeyi basardigina sasirdim, belki de labirenti cok kolay yapmisimdir.

english: Maybe.
I'm afraid I have more serious concerns at the moment. Very serious.
translation: Maalesef su anda daha ciddi sorunlarim var. Cok ciddi.

english: I'll leave you to it then.
Ok, take care.
Can I help at all?
I'm glad you asked.
The truth is my people are in grave danger. We have always been protected by the Spirit Tree. No creature of dark can harm us while its three orbs are in place.
translation: Gercek su ki, halkim büyük tehlike altinda. Her zaman Ruh Agaci tarafindan korunuyorduk. Üc küresi yerinde oldugu sürece, karanlik yaratiklar bize zarar veremez.

english: We are not a violent race, but we fight when we must. Many gnomes have fallen battling the dark forces of Khazard to the North.
translation: Siddet yanlisi bir irk degiliz, ama gerektiginde savasiriz. Kuzeydeki Khazard'in karanlik gücleriyle savasirken bircok cüce hayatini kaybetti.

english: We became desperate, so we took one orb of protection to the battlefield. It was a foolish move.
translation: Caresiz kaldik, bu yüzden koruma küresinden birini savas alanina götürdük. Aptalca bir hareketti.

english: Khazard troops seized the orb. Now we are completely defenceless.
translation: Khazard birlikleri küreyi ele gecirdi. Artik tamamen savunmasiz durumdayiz.

english: How can I help?
You would be a huge benefit on the battlefield. If you would go there and try to retrieve the orb, my people and I will be forever grateful.
translation: Savas alaninda cok büyük fayda saglayabilirsin. Oraya gidip küreyi geri almaya calisirsan, halkim ve ben sana sonsuza kadar minnettar kaliriz.

english: I would be glad to help.
Thank you. The battlefield is to the north of the maze. Commander Montai will inform you of their current situation.
translation: Tesekkürler. Savas alani labirentin kuzeyinde. Komutan Montai sana mevcut durumu anlatacaktir.

english: That is if he's still alive.
My assistant shall guide you out. Good luck friend, try your best to return the orb.
translation: Asistanim seni disariya cikaracak. Iyi sanslar dostum, küreyi geri getirmek icin elinden geleni yap.

english: The player is placed at the entrance of the maze.
We're out of the maze now. Please hurry, we must have the orb if we are to survive.
translation: Artik labirentin disindayiz. Lütfen acele et, hayatta kalmak icin küreye ihtiyacimiz var.

english: I'm sorry but I won't be involved.
Ok then, travel safe.
Hello Bolren.
Hello traveller, we must retrieve the orb. It's being held by Khazard troops north of here.
translation: Merhaba gezgin, küreyi geri almaliyiz. Buradan kuzeyde Khazard birlikleri tarafindan tutuluyor.

english: Ok, I'll try my best.
The orb is being held at the battlefield north of the maze.
translation: Küre, labirentin kuzeyindeki savas alaninda tutuluyor.

english: Do you have the orb?
No, I'm afraid not.
Please, we must have the orb if we are to survive.
translation: Lütfen, hayatta kalmak icin küreye ihtiyacimiz var.

english: I have the orb.
Oh my... The misery, the horror!
translation: Aman Tanrim... Bu sefalet, bu korkunc durum!

english: King Bolren, are you OK?
Thank you traveller, but it's too late. We're all doomed.
translation: Tesekkürler gezgin, ama cok gec. Hepimiz mahvolduk.

english: What happened?
They came in the night. I don't know how many, but enough.
translation: Gece geldiler. Kac kisi olduklarini bilmiyorum, ama yeterince coklardi.

english: Who?
Khazard troops. They slaughtered anyone who got in their way. Women, children, my wife.
translation: Khazard askerleri. Önlerine cikan herkesi katlettiler. Kadinlari, cocuklari, karimi.

english: I'm sorry.
They took the other orbs, now we are defenceless.
translation: Diger küreleri de aldilar, artik savunmasiziz.

english: Where did they take them?
They headed north of the stronghold. A warlord carries the orbs.
translation: Kalenin kuzeyine dogru gittiler. Küreleri bir savas lordu tasiyor.

english: I will find the warlord and bring back the orbs.
translation: Savas lordunu bulup küreleri geri getirecegim.

english: You are brave, but this task will be tough even for you. I wish you the best of luck. Once again you are our only hope.
translation: Cesursun, ama bu görev senin icin bile zor olacak. Sana bol sans diliyorum. Bir kez daha tek umudumuz sensin.

english: I will safeguard this orb and pray for your safe return. My assistant will guide you out.
translation: Bu küreyi koruyacagim ve güvenli bir sekilde dönmen icin dua edecegim. Asistanim sana yol gösterecek.

english: Good luck friend.
I'm sorry but I can't help.
I understand, this isn't your battle.
The orbs are gone, taken north of the battlefield by a Khazard warlord. We're all doomed.
translation: Küreler gitti, bir Khazard savas lordu tarafindan savas alaninin kuzeyine götürüldü. Hepimiz mahvolduk.

english: Bolren, I have returned.
You made it back! Do you have the orbs?
Please, we must have the orbs if we are to survive.
translation: Lütfen, hayatta kalmak icin kürelere ihtiyacimiz var.

english: I have them here.
Hooray, you're amazing. I didn't think it was possible but you've saved us.
translation: Yasasin, harikasin. Mümkün oldugunu sanmiyordum ama bizi kurtardin.

english: Once the orbs are replaced we will be safe once more. We must begin the ceremony immediately.
translation: Küreler yerine kondugunda tekrar güvende olacagiz. Törene hemen baslamaliyiz.

english: What does the ceremony involve?
The spirit tree has looked over us for centuries. Now we must pay our respects.
translation: Ruh agaci yüzyillardir bizi korudu. Simdi ona saygimizi göstermeliyiz.

english: The orbs appear above the spirit tree, while the local gnomes alternate paying their respects.
translation: Küreler ruh agacinin üzerinde belirirken, yerel cüceler sirayla saygilarini sunarlar.

english: Su tana.
En tania.
Now at last my people are safe once more. We can live in peace again.
translation: Sonunda halkim yeniden güvende. Yeniden baris icinde yasayabiliriz.

english: I'm pleased I could help.
You are modest brave traveller.
Please, for your efforts take this amulet. It's made from the same sacred stone as the orbs of protection. It will help keep you safe on your journeys.
translation: Lütfen, cabalarin icin bu tilsimi al. Koruma küreleriyle ayni kutsal tastan yapilmistir. Yolculuklarinda seni güvende tutacaktir.

english: Thank you King Bolren.
The tree has many other powers, some of which I cannot reveal. As a friend of the gnome people, I can now allow you to use the tree's magic to teleport to other trees grown from related seeds.
translation: Agacin baska bircok gücü var, bazilarini aciklayamam. Gnome halkinin dostu olarak, artik agacin büyüsünü kullanarak ilgili tohumlardan yetisen diger agaclara isinlanmana izin verebilirim.

english: Congratulations! Quest complete!
Hello again Bolren.
Well hello, it's good to see you again.
translation: Merhaba, seni tekrar görmek ne güzel.

english: I've lost my amulet.
Oh dear. Here, take another. We truly are indebted to you.
translation: Oh, hayir. Al, baska bir tane al. Sana gercekten minnettariz.

english: Here, I think this belongs to you.
Hello there. Any luck in the quest for Arposandra?
translation: Merhaba. Arposandra'yi bulma konusunda sansin yaver gitti mi?

english: Sort of. I think I've worked out where Arposandra is, but my attempt to enter didn't go well. There seems to be quite an extensive set of defences.
translation: Sayilir. Arposandra'nin nerede oldugunu buldum sanirim, ama iceri girme girisimim pek iyi sonuclanmadi. Oldukca kapsamli bir savunma sistemi var gibi görünüyor.

english: Ah, that is a problem. I wish I could offer more help, but the Khazard Army already poses a major threat to us. We can't afford to split ourselves fighting two different enemies.
translation: Ah, bu bir sorun. Keske daha fazla yardim edebilseydim, ama Khazard Ordusu zaten bizim icin büyük bir tehdit olusturuyor. Iki farkli düsmanla savasarak gücümüzü bölmemeliyiz.

english: So we do nothing?
For now, I'm afraid so. Glouphrie is a foe that must be dealt with one day, but that day is not today.
translation: Simdilik, korkarim öyle. Glouphrie bir gün halledilmesi gereken bir düsman, ama o gün bugün degil.

english: Hello again.
Hello there.
How are things here?
I fear the war against the Khazard Army is set to outlive us all. We keep making progress, but for every foe we defeat, Khazard sends two more.
translation: Korkarim Khazard Ordusu ile savas hepimizin ömrünü asacak. Ilerleme kaydediyoruz ama yendigimiz her düsman icin Khazard iki tane daha gönderiyor.

english: Still, we thankfully haven't had any more Glouphrie problems at least.
translation: Yine de, en azindan Glouphrie ile ilgili baska sorun yasamadigimiz icin sükrediyoruz.

english: That's good to hear. All the best.
translation: Bunu duymak güzel. Her sey gönlünce olsun.

english: Congratulations, human!
The king has given you another clue scroll!
translation: Kral sana baska bir ipucu parsömeni verdi!

english: Option: I'll leave you to it then.
translation: Secenek: O zaman seni rahat birakayim.

english: Can I help at all?
I would be glad to help.
I'm sorry but I won't be involved.
I will find the warlord and bring back the orbs.
translation: Savas lordunu bulup küreleri geri getirecegim.

english: I'm sorry but I can't help.
Good day.
What are you doing here? All Mourners should know that if they need to contact me, they need to use the proper channels!
translation: Burada ne yapiyorsun? Tüm Yascilar, benimle iletisime gecmek istediklerinde uygun kanallari kullanmalari gerektigini bilmeliler!

english: Sorry, I'm a new recruit.
Well do not let it happen again.
translation: Bir daha böyle bir sey olmasin.

english: Adventurer! It is good to see you again.
And you too, King. How fares the tree?
The tree? It is fine, as it has always been since we foiled Glough's plans.
translation: Agac mi? Glough'un planlarini bozduktan sonra her zamanki gibi gayet iyi.

english: Good. What ever did happen to Glough?
Oh, I forced him to resign. I have now appointed a new Head Tree Guardian, Daero. He is learning quickly and serves me well.
translation: Onu istifa etmeye zorladim. Simdi yeni bir Agac Koruyucusu atadim, Daero. Hizli ögreniyor ve bana iyi hizmet ediyor.

english: King, you look worried. Is anything the matter?
translation: Kral, endiseli görünüyorsunuz. Bir sorun mu var?

english: Nothing in particular ... Well actually, yes - there is.
translation: Özel bir sey yok... Aslinda, evet, var.

english: What is it?
Well, do you remember Glough's ship building facilities in Karamja?
translation: Karamja'daki Glough'un gemi insa tesislerini hatirliyor musun?

english: Yes, they were on the eastern coast. What of them?
translation: Evet, dogu kiyisindaydi. Ne olmus onlara?

english: After you defeated Glough's demon I sent an envoy of my Royal Guard, the 10th squad, to oversee the decommission of the shipyard. They were ordered to use force if necessary.
translation: Glough'un iblisini yendikten sonra, tersanenin kapatilmasini denetlemek icin Kraliyet Muhafizlarimdan 10. mangayi gönderdim. Gerekirse güc kullanmalari emredilmisti.

english: I see ... Were they successful?
I ... I don't know. I have heard nothing from them. I do not even know if they reached the shipyard!
translation: Ben... Bilmiyorum. Onlardan haber almadim. Tersaneye ulasip ulasmadiklarini bile bilmiyorum!

english: It is a long way...
But I need to know what happened. These are elite soldiers - their disappearance cannot simply be ignored. I cannot wait any longer.
translation: Ama ne oldugunu bilmem gerekiyor. Bunlar seckin askerler, ortadan kaybolmalari öylece görmezden gelinemez. Daha fazla bekleyemem.

english: And so I ask you: would you visit Glough's old shipyard in Karamja and find out if the 10th squad ever managed to reach?
translation: Bu yüzden senden rica ediyorum: Karamja'daki Glough'un eski tersanesini ziyaret edip 10. mangasinin oraya ulasip ulasmadigini ögrenir misin?

english: Ok, I'll do it.
Thank you very much. You may need this Royal Seal to identify yourself as my envoy.
translation: Cok tesekkür ederim. Kendini benim elcim olarak tanitmak icin bu Kraliyet Mührü'ne ihtiyacin olabilir.

english: Please report to me as soon as you have any information.
translation: Herhangi bir bilgi edindiginizde lütfen bana rapor verin.

english: I'm afraid I am too busy right now.
As you wish. Return to me when you have the time.
translation: Nasil isterseniz. Zamaniniz oldugunda bana geri dönün.

english: Are you ready to investigate the shipyard for me?
translation: Benim icin tersaneyi arastirmaya hazir misiniz?

english: What do I have to do?
Go to Glough's old shipyard on the eastern coast of Karamja. Find out what happened to the 10th squad of my Royal Guard.
translation: Karamja'nin dogu kiyisindaki Glough'un eski tersanesine gidin. Kraliyet Muhafizlarimin 10. mangasina ne oldugunu ögrenin.

english: As I said, they were sent to oversee the decommission of the ship building facilities, but I have heard nothing from them.
translation: Dedigim gibi, gemi insa tesislerinin hizmetten cikarilmasini denetlemek icin gönderildiler, ama onlardan hicbir haber almadim.

english: Yes.
(same as above)
Welcome back, adventurer.
What am I meant to do?
(shows previous questions)
How did the 10th squad travel?
How did the 10th squad travel?
They would have each flown a Gnome Glider.
translation: Her biri bir Gnome Glider ile ucmus olmalilar.

english: (previous)
I've lost my copy of the Royal Seal...
I've lost my copy of the Royal Seal...
What?! Do you realise the consequences if it falls into the wrong hands?
translation: Ne?! Yanlis ellere gecerse sonuclarinin farkinda misin?

english: However, this mission is of paramount importance. I shall give you a spare in the meantime.
translation: Ancak bu görev cok önemli. Bu arada sana yedek bir tane verecegim.

english: (other options)
I'll be back later.
I'll be back later.
Hello, King Narnode.
Good to see you again, [player name].
Have you any more Royal Seed Pods?
translation: Baska Kraliyet Tohumu Kabugu var mi?

english: How fares the kingdom today?
All is well in the Stronghold thanks to you, [player name].
translation: Senin sayende, Maceraci, Kale'de her sey yolunda.

english: No.
What am I meant to do?
Have you any more Royal Seed Pods?
translation: Baska Kraliyet Tohumu Kabugu var mi?

english: How fares the kingdom today?
Greetings, your majesty.
Do you have anything of importance to say?
...Not really.
You will have to excuse me, then. I am very busy as I have a kingdom to run!
translation: O zaman izin verin lütfen. Kralligi yönetmekle mesgulüm!

english: Well hello there. What do you want?
Ah, it's you again. Hello there.
Is there a reason for you being here?
translation: Burada olmanin bir nedeni var mi?

english: Well, I'm on a treasure trail...
Oh! Good, then you can answer this question for me!
translation: Oh! Güzel, o zaman bu soruyu cevaplayabilirsin!

english: King Roald has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Kral Roald sana bir meydan okuma parsömeni verdi!

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
Err, that sounds a little wrong to me.
translation: Sey, bu bana biraz yanlis geliyor.

english: Correct!
King Roald has given you another clue scroll!
translation: Kral Roald sana baska bir ipucu parsömeni verdi!

english: Hello there. Would you like to follow me for a minute?
translation: Merhaba. Bir dakika beni takip etmek ister misin?

english: Follow you?! I am the King! I am the followed, not the follower!!
translation: Seni takip etmek mi?! Ben kralim! Ben takip edilenim, takip eden degil!!

english: Well, if you can't be bothered then neither can I.
translation: Peki, sen zahmet etmek istemiyorsan ben de istemem.

english: Suit yourself.
No, you suit yourself.
You're quite argumentative for a peasant.
I'm not the one arguing, you are.
Then why do you keep answering me back?
translation: O zaman neden bana cevap verip duruyorsun?

english: No, you're answering me back.
Well, stop talking and I'll stop answering.
translation: Peki, konusmayi kesersen ben de cevap vermeyi keserim.

english: No, you stop talking.
I have stopped talking.
No you haven't, you're doing it now.
No, I'm just answering what you're saying.
Okay, so if I don't say anything, you won't answer me back.
translation: Tamam, o zaman ben bir sey söylemezsem, sen de bana cevap vermezsin.

english: Suits me.
Go on, then.
No, you first.
King Roald doesn't say anything to you.
translation: Kral Roald sana bir sey söylemiyor.

english: You don't say anything back.
See, that's better.
Yes, much better.
What were you saying about me following you somewhere?
translation: Beni bir yere takip etmemle ilgili ne diyordun?

english: I can't remember, it was such a long time ago.
Ah, that's a shame - I could have done with a breath of fresh air.
translation: Ah, ne yazik - biraz temiz hava alabilirdim.

english: Oh well.
Yes, never mind.
See you around.
Yes, see you later.
I thought you were going.
I was until you spoke to me again.
translation: Sen benimle tekrar konusana kadar gidecektim.

english: I'm sorry, I'll stop speaking to you then.
translation: Üzgünüm, o zaman seninle konusmayi birakacagim.

english: On behalf of everyone in Ardougne, I thank you for your help adventurer. I'm afraid I don't have time to talk, my predecessor has left me with a lot of work to do.
translation: Ardougne'daki herkes adina, yardimlarin icin tesekkür ederim maceraci. Konusacak vaktim yok maalesef, öncülüm bana cok is birakti.

english: Thank you for your work in bringing peace back to these islands, [Fremennik name].
translation: Bu adalara barisi geri getirdigin icin tesekkürler, Dokrak.

english: I hear that the Etceterians have also pledged to give you some of their resources, as thanks for preventing war once again.
translation: Etceterianlar da savasi bir kez daha önledigin icin sana kaynaklarindan bir kismini vermeyi taahhüt ettiklerini duydum.

english: How is the kingdom faring?
Everything is fine, your Majesty.
Remember, speak to Ghrim if you require assistance.
translation: Unutma, yardima ihtiyacin olursa Ghrim ile konus.

english: I think Prince Brand would make the best heir.
translation: Bence Prens Brand en iyi varis olur.

english: Is that your honest opinion after having spent time with my daughter? The Princess might receive the news rather coldly. A broken trust is difficult to mend.
translation: Kizimla vakit gecirdikten sonra da bu görüste misin? Prenses bu haberi pek hos karsilamayabilir. Kirilan güvenin onarilmasi zordur.

english: Yes, Your Majesty.
As you wish. I will pay heed to your recommendation.
No, I changed my mind.
As you wish. I will keep this conversation between us.
translation: Nasil isterseniz. Bu konusmayi aramizda tutacagim.

english: I think Princess Astrid would make the best heir.
translation: Bence Prenses Astrid en iyi varis olur.

english: Is that your honest opinion after having spent time with my son? The Prince might receive the news rather coldly. A broken trust is difficult to mend.
translation: Oglumla vakit gecirdikten sonra dürüstce böyle mi düsünüyorsunuz? Prens bu haberi pek hos karsilamayabilir. Kirilan güvenin onarilmasi zordur.

english: Never mind.
I think Prince Brand would make the best heir.
translation: Bence Prens Brand en iyi varis olur.

english: Yes, Your Majesty.
No, I changed my mind.
I think Princess Astrid would make the best heir.
translation: Bence Prenses Astrid en iyi varis olur.

english: Never mind.
I take it you are [player name]? King Lathas sent this message for you. He's not a man you'd want to keep waiting.
translation: Sen Maceraci misin? Kral Lathas sana bu mesaji gönderdi. Onu bekletmek istemezsin.

english: Please help me. I was transformed into a frog by a well-meaning but sadly frog-obsessed old wizard. Only your touch can turn me back. Will you help me?
translation: Lütfen bana yardim et. Iyi niyetli ama ne yazik ki kurbagalara takintili yasli bir büyücü tarafindan kurbagaya dönüstürüldüm. Sadece senin dokunusun beni eski halime döndürebilir. Bana yardim eder misin?

english: Okay.
Alright.
Sure, I will.
Yeah, okay.
I suppose so, sure.
All right.
Very well, if a touch is all you need, I'll do it.
Yes, I will touch you.
Sure, I'll touch you.
No way, I'm not kissing you.
I'd rather not.
Eww, no way!
I don't want to.
Leave me alone.
A kiss? Not a chance.
It looks better to be a frog. Make me one!
translation: Kurbaga olmak daha iyi görünüyor. Beni kurbaga yap!

english: I'd rather become a frog too!
What if I want to be a frog like you?
translation: Ya ben de senin gibi kurbaga olmak istersem?

english: I would prefer not to, sorry.
I'm sorry, I'd prefer not to do that.
How about if we kiss?
May I kiss you instead?
Would a kiss be acceptable?
Thank you so much, [player name]. I must return to my fairytale kingdom. But take this as a reward. You can exchange it at the Varrock clothes store for a costume.
translation: Cok tesekkürler, Maceraci. Masal kralligima dönmeliyim. Ama bunu ödül olarak al. Varrock giyim magazasinda kostümle takas edebilirsin.

english: Player is transformed into a frog and teleported to Frogland
translation: Oyuncu kurbagaya dönüsür ve Frogland'a isinlanir.

english: Yes!
Thank you so much, [player name]. I must return to my fairytale kingdom. But take this as a reward. You can exchange it at the Varrock clothes store for a costume.
translation: Cok tesekkürler, Maceraci. Masal kralligima dönmeliyim. Ama bunu ödül olarak al. Varrock giyim magazasinda kostümle takas edebilirsin.

english: Hurrah for the frog [prince/princess]!
Don't talk to me! Speak to the frog [prince/princess]!
translation: Benimle konusma! Kurbaga hazretleri ile konus!

english: The frogs do not need your help right now.
translation: Kurbagalarin su anda senin yardimina ihtiyaci yok.

english: Don't look at me, I'm just a frog. Ribbit! Ribbit!
translation: Bana bakma, ben sadece bir kurbagayim. Ribbit! Ribbit!

english: Greetings from the [prince/princess], [player name]!
Talk to the frog [prince/princess], [player name]!
The frog [prince/princess] needs your help, [player name]!
translation: Kurbaga hazretleri yardimina ihtiyac duyuyor, Maceraci!

english: Please respond to the frog [prince/princess], [player name]!
translation: Lütfen kurbaga hazretleri ile konus, Maceraci!

english: Maybe later.
Are you ready to leave now?
Yes, I'd like to leave now.
Player is transformed back and teleported to their initial spot
translation: Oyuncu eski haline dönüsür ve baslangic noktasina isinlanir.

english: No, I'd rather stay.
Okay.
Alright.
Sure, I will.
Yeah, okay.
I suppose so, sure.
All right.
Very well, if a touch is all you need, I'll do it.
translation: Peki, tek ihtiyacin olan bir dokunussa, yaparim.

english: Yes, I will touch you.
Sure, I'll touch you.
No way, I'm not kissing you.
I'd rather not.
Eww, no way!
I don't want to.
Leave me alone.
A kiss? Not a chance.
It looks better to be a frog. Make me one!
translation: Kurbaga olmak daha iyi görünüyor. Beni kurbaga yap!

english: I'd rather become a frog too!
What if I want to be a frog like you?
translation: Ya ben de senin gibi kurbaga olmak istersem?

english: I would prefer not to, sorry.
I'm sorry, I'd prefer not to do that.
How about if we kiss?
May I kiss you instead?
translation: Senin yerine ben seni öpebilir miyim?

english: Would a kiss be acceptable?
Yes, I'd like to leave now.
No, I'd rather stay.
Hello, there!
Hello! The name's Kit. Sir Kit Breaker.
translation: Merhaba! Adim Kit. Sir Kit Breaker.

english: Sir Kit? That's a nice name!
translation: Sir Kit mi? Güzel bir isim!

english: Thank you! I chose it myself!
... Thinking about it, I chose mine as well. I'm [player name], by the way.
translation: Düsündüm de, ben de kendim secmistim. Bu arada, ben Maceraci.

english: Very nice to meet you!
What do you do around here?
I'm helping Gilbert with a project of his, on behalf of the White knights. It will take us a while but I can let you know when we're closer to completion!
translation: Beyaz Sövalyeler adina Gilbert'in bir projesine yardim ediyorum. Biraz zaman alacak ama tamamlanmaya yaklastigimizda sana haber veririm!

english: Sounds good!
Hi there, Sir Kit!
[player name], it's good to see you.
How are you getting on as a White Knight?
It's going well, thank you. Being on loan to Gilbert and the Glade project is giving me good purpose whilst I do all the basic training.
translation: Iyi gidiyor, tesekkürler. Gilbert ve Glade projesine ödünc verilmek, temel egitimi alirken bana iyi bir amac veriyor.

english: Gilbert's not working you too hard is he?
translation: Gilbert seni cok calistirmiyor, degil mi?

english: Not yet at least, until we get started on the land. For now it's mostly tending to the flowers and wandering... Patrolling around!
translation: En azindan simdilik, araziye baslamadan önce. Su anda cogunlukla ciceklerle ilgilenip dolasiyorum... Devriye geziyorum!

english: I can't thank you enough, [player name]. I hope you'll pop by one day as the Glade project progresses. Don't be a stranger!
translation: Sana ne kadar tesekkür etsem azdir, Maceraci. Glade projesi ilerledikce bir gün ugrarsin umarim. Yabancilasma!

english: Hey kitty. What's new?
translation: Selam kedicik. Ne var ne yok?

english: Meow!
How are you doing?
Meeow I'm happy.
How old are you now?
Where do you want to go?
Can we go visit Gertrude, I'd like to see her again, she's very nice.
translation: Gertrude'u ziyaret edebilir miyiz, onu tekrar görmek istiyorum, cok nazik biridir.

english: Let's go to the ratpits in Ardougne. I think I fancy a fight!
translation: Ardougne'daki fare cukurlarina gidelim. Sanirim kavga etmek istiyorum!

english: Can we stay here in the sewers and hunt rats? That would be fun.
translation: Kanalizasyonda kalip fare avlayabilir miyiz? Cok eglenceli olur.

english: What do you want to do now?
I want to chase things.
I'm tired, I'd like to have a nap.
Sorry human, but what are you wearing?
I got some cat ears made for me, don't they look meeeeeeeooooowvalous.
translation: Kendime kedi kulaklari yaptirdim, cok güzel görünüyorlar, degil mi?

english: The cat looks you dead in the eye, unblinking.
Am I a joke to you?
translation: Ben senin icin bir saka miyim?

english: UwU?
Why are you doing this?
I thought it'd be cute and funny.
It's not, take them off now human, before I get myself a pair of human ears to wear.
translation: Degil, hemen cikar onlari insan, yoksa ben de kendime insan kulaklari takacagim.

english: You softly stroke your cat.
Purr...purr...
That cat sure loves to be stroked.
There aren't any vermin around.
I wonder how old you are...
Shoo cat!
Meeeooow!
The cat has run away.
You choose not to shoo away the cat.
Who's Gielinor's most ferocious kitten?
Me me~ Roar.(It sounds like more of a squeak)
translation: Me me~ Kükre. (Daha cok ciyaklama gibi geliyor.)

english: Me! Me!~ Roar!
Aww! So squeaky!
I'm just fed up with you, you're so needy! Can't you just look after yourself for a bit?
translation: Senden biktim artik, cok muhtacsin! Birazcik kendine bakamaz misin?

english: Meeeeow, don't leave me master, I'm sorry, I'll be a good kitty from now on meoooww.
translation: Meeeeow, beni birakma efendim, özür dilerim, bundan sonra iyi bir kedi olacagim meoooww.

english: No I've really had it with you, now scat!
translation: Hayir, senden gercekten biktim, simdi defol!

english: Go on puss...kill that rat!
Your cat cannot get to its prey.
Meeooow!
Miaow!
I think it's hungry!
Your kitten is hungry.
I think it wants some attention.
Your kitten wants attention.
Meeeooow!
Your kitten has grown into a healthy cat that can hunt for itself.
translation: Yavru kediniz kendi basina avlanabilen saglikli bir kediye dönüstü.

english: The kitten gobbles up the fish.
Purr!
That kitten loves to play with that ball of wool. I think it is its favourite.
translation: O yavru kedi o yün topuyla oynamayi seviyor. Sanirim en sevdigi sey bu.

english: How are you doing?
How old are you now?
Where do you want to go?
What do you want to do now?
Stroke
Chase Vermin
Guess age
Shoo away
Yes I am.
No I'm not.
Stroke (prior to August 2024)
Stroke (as of August 2024)
Oh, I do declare! Another perambulating soul traipses through this verdant forest!
translation: Oh, gerçekten! Bir baska gezgin ruh bu yemyesil ormanda dolasiyor!

english: Er... Hello there.
Salutations, my good compatriot! Pray, what curious happenstance is it that brings yourself out to my sylvan domicile?
translation: Selamlar, sevgili yurttasim! Lütfen, sizi benim ormanlik evime getiren bu ilginç tesadüf nedir?

english: Your... domicile?
The rainforest! A most resplendent deviation from the cacophonous tyranny of urban existence.
translation: Yagmur ormani! Kentsel yasamin gürültülü zulmünden en görkemli kaçis.

english: It's certainly more colourful, that's for sure.
Indeed! Out here, one may emancipate themselves amidst blissful tranquility.
translation: Gerçekten! Burada, insan kendini mutluluk verici bir huzur içinde özgürlestirebilir.

english: I see... So how does such a... magniloquent individual... come to be out here?
translation: Anliyorum... Peki, böylesine... görkemli bir kisi... buraya nasil geldi?

english: Well, it commenced when I was merely a youth, and has proceeded uninterrupted ever since.
translation: Sey, bu benim henüz gençken basladi ve o zamandan beri kesintisiz devam etti.

english: You came out here as a child?
I was most fortuitously deposited within this locale by my progenitors, along with this extravagant bundle of novels. Behold this one!
translation: Atalarim tarafindan buraya, bu abartili roman yiginiyla birlikte sans eseri birakildim. Suna bakin!

english: Er... That's a thesaurus.
What an exquisitely scandalous read it was. Now, you seem like someone who appreciates linguistic variety! Would you care to partake in a spot of intellectual cultivation with me?
translation: Ne kadar da skandal bir kitapti. Dil çesitliligini takdir eden biri gibi görünüyorsunuz! Benimle birlikte entelektüel bir gelisim sürecine katilmak ister misiniz?

english: I'm not sure if that's quite...
translation: Bunun pek uygun olup olmadigindan emin degilim...

english: I possess a cornucopia of literary marvels. This one by Di. C. Tionary is captivating.
translation: Benim çok sayida edebi saheserim var. Di. C. Tionary'nin bu eseri çok etkileyici.

english: A dictionary?
No! Di. C. Tionary. She's one of the foremost novelists of our time. Such an unparalleled way with words. I'd love to have an audience with her some day.
translation: Hayir! Di. C. Tionary. O, zamanimizin en önde gelen romancilarindan biri. Kelimeleri kullanma sekli essiz. Bir gün onunla görüsmeyi çok isterim.

english: Tell me, have you met any of the literary greats?
translation: Söylesene, edebiyatin büyük isimlerinden herhangi biriyle tanistin mi?

english: I've not had an opportunity to.
A tragedy, to be unequivocally certain.
Yes... Anyway, I think I need to get going now...
translation: Evet... Her neyse, artik gitmem gerek...

english: Very well! I shan't exasperate you with excessive and superfluous conversation. Besides, my tomes beckon. Farewell.
translation: Peki! Fazla ve gereksiz konusmalarla seni sikmayacagim. Ayrica, kitaplarim beni bekliyor. Hosça kal.

english: See you around.
I have little to say on this object. Congratulations on your ownership of it.
translation: Bu nesne hakkinda söyleyecek pek bir seyim yok. Sahibi oldugun için tebrikler.

english: Ho, [Fremennik name]! The brave warrior returns!
translation: Ho, Dokrak! Cesur savasci geri döndü!

english: It was a hard-fought battle, but we Fremennik prevailed!
translation: Zorlu bir savasti, ama biz Fremennikler galip geldik!

english: I expect we'll be hearing songs about the 'Slayer of the Troll King' for many years to come.
translation: Önümüzdeki yillarda “Trol Krali Katili” hakkinda sarkilar duyacagimizi umuyorum.

english: It would be an honour to be remembered in such a way! Thanks.
translation: Böyle hatirlanmak benim icin bir onurdur! Tesekkürler.

english: Kebabs! Get your kebabs here! One gold each!
translation: Kebab! Kebab alin! Tanesi bir altin!

english: Sure, one kebab please.
Yes? Are you going to give me that one gold coin then?
translation: Evet? O altin parayi bana verecek misin?

english: Sorry, I don't seem to have any money on me.
The bank is Keldagrim-West. Hurry back!
