I'm looking for a drunken dwarf.
Just go out in the streets, they can't be hard to find!
translation: Sokaga cikin, bulmak zor olmasa gerek!

english: No, a specific drunken dwarf, he keeps harassing me.
translation: Hayir, belirli bir sarhos cüce, beni rahatsiz edip duruyor.

english: That's still not very helpful. But let me see. There is one particularly drunken dwarf just to the northeast of here.
translation: Bu da pek yardimci olmadi. Ama bir bakayim. Buradan kuzeydoguda özellikle sarhos bir cüce var.

english: He's scaring away my customers, he says there's something wrong with my kebabs. Quite annoying fellow.
translation: Müsterilerimi kaciriyor, kebaplarimda bir sorun oldugunu söylüyor. Oldukca sinir bozucu bir adam.

english: I don't think that's who I mean.
Well, he does have a relative who wanders all over Gielinor. Comes back from time to time to buy more kebabs. Don't see him very often though.
translation: Gielinor'da dolasan bir akrabasi var. Ara sira kebap almaya gelir. Ama onu pek sik görmüyorum.

english: Do you think I'll have any chance of catching him here?
translation: Onu burada yakalama sansim var mi sence?

english: I think he was back here quite recently, so I doubt he'll be back any time soon.
translation: Sanirim kisa süre önce buradaydi, bu yüzden yakin zamanda geri gelecegini sanmiyorum.

english: I thought you would know plenty!
How do you mean?
Oh come on! You in the Laughing Miner? The whole city knows about you and your dwarven drinking buddies!
translation: Hadi ama! Sen Laughing Miner'da mi calisiyorsun? Bütün sehir seni ve cüce icki arkadaslarini taniyor!

english: Right, right.
Do you have any quests?
Not really! I have a steady supply of meat coming in through the carts and I don't really need anything else!
translation: Aslinda yok! Arabalarla düzenli olarak et tedarik ediliyorum ve baska bir seye ihtiyacim yok!

english: Sure, one kebab please.
I'm looking for a drunken dwarf.
Do you have any quests?
Hello my good man.
Good day to you outsider. You should be careful down here. We're the only ones that haven't yet turned.
translation: Iyi günler yabanci. Burada dikkatli olmalisin. Henüz dönüsmemis tek biz variz.

english: If you're not careful you'll become one of them too!
translation: Dikkatli olmazsan sen de onlardan biri olursun!

english: Who? Iban's followers?
They're not followers, they're slaves, they're the soulless...
What happened to them?
They were normal once, adventurers, treasure hunters. But men are weak, they couldn't ignore the voices.
translation: Bir zamanlar normal insanlardi, maceracilar, hazine avcilari. Ama insanlar zayiftir, sesleri görmezden gelemediler.

english: Now they all seem to think with one conscience... As if they're being controlled by one being...
translation: Simdi hepsi tek bir bilincle düsünüyor gibi görünüyor... Sanki tek bir varlik tarafindan kontrol ediliyorlar...

english: Iban?
Maybe... maybe Zamorak himself. Those who try and fight it are locked in cages, until their minds are too weak to resist.
translation: Belki... belki Zamorak'in kendisi. Buna karsi koymaya calisanlar, zihinleri direnemeyecek kadar zayiflayana kadar kafeslere kapatiliyor.

english: Eventually they all fall to his control...
No wonder their breath is so bad!
translation: Nefeslerinin bu kadar kötü olmasina sasmamali!

english: You think this is funny... Eh?
Not really, just trying to lighten up the conversation.
translation: Aslinda degil, sadece sohbeti hafifletmeye calisiyorum.

english: Anyway, I have something that might help you. I crafted these to protect myself from the teeth of the soulless, their bite is vicious.
translation: Her neyse, sana yardimci olabilecek bir seyim var. Bunlari ruhsuzlarin dislerinden kendimi korumak icin yaptim, isiriklari cok acimasiz.

english: I haven't seen another pair which can withstand their jaws...
translation: Onlarin cenelerine dayanabilecek baska bir cift görmedim...

english: Thank you.
No problem traveller. Good luck.
Hello Klank.
Hello again adventurer, so you're still around?
Still here!
Have you any more gauntlets?
Well..yes, but they're not cheap to make. I'll have to sell you a pair...
translation: Evet, ama yapimi pahali. Sana bir cift satmam gerekecek...

english: How much?
5,000 coins.
5,000, you must be joking!
We don't joke down here friend...
Okay then, I'll take a pair.
translation: Tamam o zaman, bir cift alacagim.

english: There you go... I hope they help.
I'll see you around Klank.
Oh dear, I haven't got enough money...
Sorry, I can't sell them any cheaper than that.
Take care Klank.
You too adventurer...
What happened to them?
No wonder their breath is so bad!
translation: Nefeslerinin bu kadar kötü olmasina sasmamali!

english: Have you anymore gauntlets?
5,000, you must be joking!
Okay then, I'll take a pair.
translation: Tamam o zaman, bir cift alacagim.

english: Take care Klank.
So, are you interested in buying a ship? Now, I'll be straight with you: she's not quite seaworthy right now, but give her a bit of work and she'll be the nippiest ship this side of Port Khazard.
translation: Peki, bir gemi satin almakla ilgileniyor musun? Simdi, sana dürüst olacagim: su anda denize acilabilecek durumda degil, ama biraz calisma ile Port Khazard'in bu tarafindaki en hizli gemi olacak.

english: Do you know when she will be seaworthy?
translation: Ne zaman denize acilabilecek durumda olacak biliyor musun?

english: No, not really. Port Sarim's shipbuilders aren't very efficient so it could be quite a while.
translation: Hayir, pek bilmiyorum. Port Sarim'deki gemi yapimcilari cok verimli degiller, bu yüzden epey zaman alabilir.

english: Would you take me to Crandor when she's ready?
translation: Hazir oldugunda beni Crandor'a götürür müsün?

english: Crandor? You're joking, right?
translation: Crandor mu? Saka yapiyorsun, degil mi?

english: Yes. Ha ha ha!
Crandor's not something we sailors joke about. You can't sail from here to Catherby, or Entrana, or Ardougne without going past that accursed island.
translation: Crandor, biz denizcilerin saka yapacagi bir sey degil. O lanetli adayi gecmeden buradan Catherby'ye, Entrana'ya veya Ardougne'a yelken acamazsin.

english: You can't get close to it because of the reefs, but you can always see it.
translation: Resifler nedeniyle adaya yaklasamazsin, ama her zaman görebilirsin.

english: Sometimes you can see a dark shape in the sky, circling the island. That's when you have to sail on as quick as you can and pray it's not hungry. Every year, more ships are lost to that dragon.
translation: Bazen gökyüzünde adanin etrafinda dönen karanlik bir sekil görebilirsin. O zaman olabildigince hizli yelken acmali ve onun ac olmamasi icin dua etmelisin. Her yil, o ejderha yüzünden daha fazla gemi kayboluyor.

english: No. I want to go to Crandor.
Then you must be crazy.
That island is surrounded by reefs that would rip this ship to shreds. Even if you found a map, you'd need an experienced captain to stand a chance of getting through
translation: O ada, bu gemiyi paramparca edecek resiflerle cevrilidir. Harita bulsan bile, gecebilmek icin deneyimli bir kaptana ihtiyacin var.

english: and, even if I could get to it, there's no way I'm going any closer to that dragon than I have to. They say it can destroy whole ships with one bite.
translation: Ve oraya ulasabilsem bile, o ejderhaya gereginden fazla yaklasmam mümkün degil. Tek bir isirikla bütün gemileri yok edebildigini söylüyorlar.

english: Why is she damaged?
Oh, there was no particular accident. It's just years of wear and tear.
translation: Özel bir kaza olmadi. Yillarin yipratmasi var.

english: The Lady Lumbridge is an old Crandorian fishing ship - the last one of her kind, as far as I know. That kind of ship was always mightily maneuverable, but not too tough.
translation: Lady Lumbridge eski bir Crandorian balikci gemisi, bildigim kadariyla türünün son örnegi. Bu tür gemiler her zaman cok manevra kabiliyetine sahipti, ama cok saglam degillerdi.

english: She happened to be somewhere else when Crandor was destroyed, and she's had several owners since then. Not all of them have looked after her too well,
translation: Crandor yok edildiginde o baska bir yerdeydi ve o zamandan beri birkac sahibi oldu. Hepsi ona cok iyi bakmadi,

english: but once she's patched up, she'll be good as new!
translation: ama tamir edildiginde yeni gibi olacak!

english: I'd like to buy her.
Of course! I'm sure the work needed to do on it wouldn't be too expensive.
translation: Tabii ki! Yapilmasi gereken isler cok pahali olmayacaktir.

english: How does 2,000 gold sound? I'll even throw in my cabin boy, Jenkins, for free! He'll swab the decks and splice the mainsails for you!
translation: 2.000 altin nasil? Hatta kamarotum Jenkins'i de bedavaya veririm! Güverteyi temizler ve ana yelkenleri baglar!

english: Yep, sounds good.
Okey dokey, she's all yours!
(Klarense takes 2000 gp from the player)
...except I don't have that kind of money on me...
I'm not paying that much for a broken boat!
translation: Kirik bir tekneye o kadar para veremem!

english: That's fair enough, I suppose.
Ah well, never mind.
Hello, captain! Here to inspect your new ship? Just a little work and she'll be seaworthy again.
translation: Merhaba, kaptan! Yeni geminizi muayene etmeye mi geldiniz? Biraz calisma ile tekrar denize acilabilir hale gelir.

english: So, what needs fixing on this ship?
translation: Peki, bu gemide neyin tamir edilmesi gerekiyor?

english: Well, the big gaping hole in the hold is the problem. You'll need a few wooden planks hammered in with steel nails to fix it.
translation: Sey, ambarin icindeki büyük delik sorun. Onu tamir etmek icin celik civilerle cakilmis birkac tahta kalas gerekir.

english: So would you like to sail this ship to Crandor for me?
translation: Peki, bu gemiyle benim icin Crandor'a yelken acmak ister misiniz?

english: What are you going to do now you don't have a ship?
Oh, I'll be fine. I've got work as Port Sarim's first lifeguard!
translation: Oh, ben iyiyim. Port Sarim'in ilk cankurtarani olarak isim var!

english: Can I board the ship now?
Sure thing, she's all yours.
Wow! You sure are lucky! Seems the Lady Lumbridge just washed right up into the dock by herself!
translation: Vay canina! Gercekten sanslisiniz! Lady Lumbridge kendi kendine rihtima vurmus gibi görünüyor!

english: She's pretty badly damaged, though...
Hey, that's my ship!
No, it's not. It may, to the untrained eye, at first appear to be the Lady Lumbridge, but it is definitely not. It's my new ship. It just happens to look slightly similar, is all.
translation: Hayir, degil. Egitimli olmayan bir göze ilk bakista Lady Lumbridge gibi görünebilir, ama kesinlikle o degil. Bu benim yeni gemim. Sadece biraz benziyor, hepsi bu.

english: It has Lady Lumbridge painted out and 'Klarense's Cruiser' painted over it!
translation: Üzerinde Lady Lumbridge yazisi silinmis ve yerine “Klarense'in Kruvazörü” yazilmis!

english: Nope, you're mistaken. It's my new boat.
translation: Hayir, yaniliyorsun. Bu benim yeni teknem.

english: Well will you at least take me to Crandor in it?
translation: En azindan beni Crandor'a götürür müsün?

english: Nope. I don't take passengers on my ship.
Argh!
Hey, stay off my ship! That's private property!
translation: Hey, gemimden uzak dur! Orasi özel mülk!

english: Do you know when she will be seaworthy?
translation: Ne zaman denize acilabilir hale gelecek biliyor musun?

english: Would you take me to Crandor when she's ready?
translation: Hazir oldugunda beni Crandor'a götürür müsün?

english: Yes. Ha ha ha!
No. I want to go to Crandor.
Why is she damaged?
I'd like to buy her.
Yep, sounds good.
I'm not paying that much for a broken boat!
translation: Bozuk bir tekneye o kadar para veremem!

english: Ah well, never mind.
So, what needs fixing on the ship?
Would you sail this ship to Crandor for me?
translation: Bu tekneyle beni Crandor'a götürür müsün?

english: What are you going to do now you don't have a ship?
Can I board the ship now?
Thank you, adventurer. You have given my soul some respite.
translation: Tesekkürler, maceraci. Ruhuma biraz huzur verdin.

english: Wait! I want to ask you a question...
translation: Bekle! Sana bir soru sormak istiyorum...

english: Klenter disappears before you can ask him anything.
translation: Klenter, ona bir sey soramadan ortadan kaybolur.

english: He is too busy dancing to talk!
translation: Dans etmekle mesgul oldugu icin konusacak vakti yok!

english: We're Knights of the Party Room
We dance round and round like a loon
Quite often we like to sing
Unfortunately we make a din
Do you like our helmet plumes?
Everyone's happy now we can move
Like a party animal in the groove
The party room is a silly place!
Who are you? What are you doing here in the snow?
translation: Kimsin sen? Karin icinde burada ne yapiyorsun?

english: My name is...Sir Gerry. I am...a member of a secret...society of knights. My time is short and I need...your help.
translation: Adim... Sir Gerry. Ben... gizli bir sövalye toplulugunun üyesiyim. Zamanim azaliyor ve yardimina ihtiyacim var.

english: A secret society of knights? What a surprise! Is there an old charter or decree that says if you're a knight you have to belong to a secret order?
translation: Gizli bir sövalye toplulugu mu? Ne sürpriz! Sövalyeyseniz gizli bir tarikata üye olmaniz gerektigini söyleyen eski bir tüzük veya kararname var mi?

english: I'm sorry, my friend... I do not understand your meaning. Please, time is short... Take this scroll to Sir Tiffy. You will find him in Falador park... You should not...read it... It contains information for his eyes only.
translation: Üzgünüm dostum... Ne demek istedigini anlamadim. Lütfen, zamanim az... Bu parsömeni Sir Tiffy'ye götür. Onu Falador parkinda bulacaksin... Okumamalisin... Sadece onun görebilecegi bilgiler iceriyor.

english: A secret society of knights? You don't mean the Temple Knights, do you?
translation: Gizli bir sövalye toplulugu mu? Tapinak Sövalyeleri'nden bahsetmiyorsun, degil mi?

english: Yes! Praise Saradomin! You...have been sent in...my hour of need. Please, take...this scroll to Sir Tiffy in Falador park... You should not...read it.
translation: Evet! Saradomin'e sükürler olsun! Sen... benim ihtiyacim oldugu anda gönderildin. Lütfen, bu parsömeni Falador parkindaki Sir Tiffy'ye götür... Okumamalisin.

english: Cough... Hey, over here.
He's still alive, but in no condition to talk. He appears to be almost comatose.
translation: Hala hayatta, ama konusacak durumda degil. Neredeyse komada gibi görünüyor.

english: Good day.
Hello there citizen. What can I do for you?
translation: Merhaba vatandas. Sizin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: What's down these stairs?
These stairs lead to the Ardougne Prison. It's home to thieves, murderers and everything in between.
translation: Bu merdivenler Ardougne Hapishanesine cikiyor. Hirsizlar, katiller ve diger suclularin bulundugu yer.

english: Sounds lovely. Can I go in?
I'm afraid not citizen. Only the Knights of Ardougne are allowed into the prison and I can see that you are no knight.
translation: Korkarim ki hayir, vatandas. Sadece Ardougne Sövalyeleri hapishaneye girebilir ve sizin sövalye olmadiginizi görebiliyorum.

english: Hello there fellow knight. Isn't today a wonderful day to be a Knight of Ardougne?
translation: Merhaba sövalye dostum. Bugün Ardougne Sövalyesi olmak icin harika bir gün, degil mi?

english: I mean it's okay I suppose. The constant fear of some random adventurer murdering you and the fact that people are constantly picking your pockets isn't great. But hey ho, at least the benefits are good.
translation: Yani, fena degil sanirim. Rastgele bir maceracinin sizi öldürmesinden sürekli korkmak ve insanlarin sürekli cebinizi karistirmasi pek hos degil. Ama neyse, en azindan avantajlari iyi.

english: That they are fellow knight, that they are.
Anyway, can I go down these stairs?
translation: Neyse, bu merdivenlerden asagi inebilir miyim?

english: Of course you can! You're a Knight of Ardougne! There is no place where you can't go.
translation: Tabii ki inebilirsin! Sen Ardougne Sövalyesisin! Gidemeyecegin yer yok.

english: Yeah... Thanks.
Good to see you [Tim/Sue].
Who's [Tim/Sue]?
You are?
Ah yes, I am [Tim/Sue].
Hmm... Is your head working okay today [Tim/Sue]?
translation: Hmm... Bugün kafan iyi calisiyor mu Tim?

english: Of course, my head has never been better.
translation: Tabii ki, kafam hic bu kadar iyi olmamisti.

english: If you say so...
Ah, nilsal! Hello!
Ah, hello again!
Hello to you too!
Tell me about yourself.
I'm a Knight of Varlamore, the Kingdom of Sun. I venture to Kourend on a mission, one I can say very little of.
translation: Ben Günes Kralligi Varlamore'un sövalyesiyim. Kourend'e bir görev icin geldim, ama bu görev hakkinda cok az sey söyleyebilirim.

english: How come?
I'm afraid you must accept my secrecy adventurer, for who knows what the future holds.
translation: Korkarim gizliligimi kabul etmelisin maceraci, cünkü gelecekte ne olacagini kimse bilemez.

english: I found an ancient sun temple.
Oh, pray tell, where is this temple?
translation: Oh, lütfen söyle, bu tapinak nerede?

english: In a place called the Forthos Ruin to the south-east. I was exploring and discovered symbology to an entity called Ralos.
translation: Güneydogudaki Forthos Harabeleri denen bir yerde. Kesif yaparken Ralos adli bir varligin sembollerini kesfettim.

english: I see. I think I shall check out this Ruin. Thank you for letting me know adventurer.
translation: Anliyorum. Sanirim bu harabeleri kontrol etmeliyim. Bana haber verdigin icin tesekkürler maceraci.

english: No problem... Oh, I don't know your name.
Call me Astra! Now, I must see to this discovery as it may indeed help my mission. May the light shine upon you!
translation: Bana Astra de! Simdi, bu kesfi incelemeliyim, cünkü görevime gercekten yardimci olabilir. Isik senin üzerine parlasin!

english: Where's the Kingdom of Varlamore?
To the south, beyond Mount Quidamortem. It's a glorious land where the sun forever shines.
translation: Güneyde, Quidamortem Dagi'nin ötesinde. Günesin sonsuza kadar parladigi muhtesem bir yer.

english: Sounds wonderful!
I have to go.
Stay vigilant, friend.
Oh... nilsal, adventurer.
Hello!
How are you, Astra?
Not great... Can you believe what they've done?
Done what?
Are you blind? Look what they've done to the altar of Ralos!
translation: Kör müsün? Ralos'un sunagina ne yaptiklarina bak!

english: Oh... I guess it has seen better days.
translation: Oh... Sanirim daha iyi günler görmüs.

english: It was those others! Those undead druids. Blind moon worshippers...
translation: Onlar yapti! O ölümsüz druidler. Kör ay tapicilar...

english: Do you see what they've become? That's what turning your back on the light does. Even as I stand here in this desecrated temple, I feel the light fading from me.
translation: Ne hale geldiklerini görüyor musun? Isiga sirtini dönmenin sonucu budur. Bu kutsal tapinagin icinde dururken bile, icimdeki isigin söndügünü hissediyorum.

english: I suppose it is quite spooky down here.
So you feel it too? A shadow hangs over this place.
translation: Sen de hissediyor musun? Bu yerin üzerinde bir gölge var.

english: What will you do now?
My mission is still a secret, adventurer. Perhaps I'll share it with you one day.
translation: Görevim hala gizli, maceraci. Belki bir gün seninle paylasirim.

english: Tell me about yourself.
I found an ancient sun temple.
Where's the Kingdom of Varlamore?
I have to go.
How are you, Astra?
Who are you?
Woo wooo!
Don't you know? I am a proud Knight of the Lion, serving under the Justiciar of the Lion.
translation: Bilmiyor musun? Ben Aslan'in gururlu bir sövalyesiyim, Aslan'in Yargici'na hizmet ediyorum.

english: And you are the adventurer who disturbed my rest!
translation: Ve sen benim huzurumu bozan maceracisin!

english: Yeah... I'm not really all that sorry about that. I was searching for Hallowed marks. Although I didn't actually intend to disturb you if that's any consolation.
translation: Evet... Bunun icin pek üzgün degilim. Kutsal isaretleri ariyordum. Aslinda seni rahatsiz etmek istememistim, eger bu seni teselli ederse.

english: Hallowed marks? That currency is reserved only for the devout followers of holy Saradomin. Are you a follower, adventurer?
translation: Kutsal isaretler mi? Bu para birimi sadece kutsal Saradomin'in sadik takipcileri icin ayrilmistir. Sen de bir takipcisi misin, maceraci?

english: Yes, I follow Saradomin.
I see! Yes, I can sense that you at least carry some items bearing his symbol. Well met fellow follower! Do tell, what is the Justiciar of the Lion up to these days?
translation: Anliyorum! Evet, en azindan onun sembolünü tasiyan bazi esyalar tasidigini hissedebiliyorum. Tanistigimiza memnun oldum, takipci dostum! Söylesene, Aslan'in Yargici bu günlerde neler yapiyor?

english: The Justiciar of the Lion? I've never heard of them.
translation: Aslan'in Yargici mi? Onlari hic duymadim.

english: By Saradomin's mercy! Are you serious adventurer? You've never heard of her glory?
translation: Saradomin'in merhameti adina! Ciddi misin maceraci? Onun ihtisamini hic duymadin mi?

english: The statue in the south east bears her resemblance. I remember the day it was built in her honour.
translation: Güneydogudaki heykel ona benziyor. Onun onuruna yapildigi günü hatirliyorum.

english: The Justiciar of the Lion is a title bestowed upon the most powerful wizard of our order. She was capable of wiping out an entire army of Zamorakian demons with a single spell!
translation: Aslan'in Yargici, tarikatimizin en güclü büyücüsüne verilen unvandir. Tek bir büyüyle Zamorakian iblislerinin tüm ordusunu yok edebilirdi!

english: I lament that I could not learn more from her in life but I do not regret for a single instant following her to my grave.
translation: Hayattayken ondan daha fazla sey ögrenemedigim icin üzülüyorum ama onu mezara kadar takip ettigim icin bir an bile pisman degilim.

english: I see, she sounds like an inspirational figure indeed. Do you know where I can find her?
translation: Anliyorum, gercekten ilham verici bir figür gibi görünüyor. Onu nerede bulabilirim biliyor musun?

english: I was hoping that you could tell me. Last I heard, she was residing in the college here in Hallowvale.
translation: Senin bana söyleyebilecegini umuyordum. Son duydugumda, Hallowvale'deki kolejde ikamet ediyordu.

english: Oh dear...
Is something wrong adventurer?
Never mind, you don't want to know.
You lie adventurer. I do not sense a single item of holy Saradomin on your person.
translation: Yalan söylüyorsun maceraci. Üzerinde kutsal Saradomin'e ait tek bir esya bile hissetmiyorum.

english: To think that our currency is being handled by non- followers. It's a disgrace! If I weren't dead, I'd incinerate you where you stand for your impudence!
translation: Para birimimizin takipcileri olmayanlar tarafindan yönetildigini düsünmek. Bu bir utanc! Ölmüs olmasaydim, küstahligin icin seni oldugun yerde yakardim!

english: Yeah well, you are dead and I have your currency so you're going to have to... live with that!
translation: Evet, sen öldün ve ben senin parani aldim, bu yüzden bununla yasamak zorundasin!

english: I don't appreciate your attempts at humour, non- follower.
No, I follow another god.
translation: Hayir, ben baska bir tanriya tapiyorum.

english: Woo? Woo wooooooooo!
You dare defile this sacred place? That treasure doesn't belong to you!
translation: Bu kutsal yeri kirletmeye nasil cüret edersin? O hazine sana ait degil!

english: Yes, I follow Saradomin.
No, I follow another god.
translation: Hayir, ben baska bir tanriya tapiyorum.

english: Who are you?
Woo wooo?
Who indeed? I am a wise Knight of the Owl. I serve the Justiciar of the Owl.
translation: Kim mi? Ben bilge Baykus Sövalyesiyim. Baykus'un Yargici'na hizmet ediyorum.

english: Who's this Justiciar of the Owl?
Saradomin's wisest of servants. It surprises me that you've not heard of his many feats.
translation: Saradomin'in en bilge hizmetkari. Onun bircok basarisini duymamis olmana sasirdim.

english: Do you know any?
I know them all.
Care to share?
Of course. Do you see the foliage around you, adventurer?
translation: Elbette. Etrafindaki bitki örtüsünü görüyor musun, maceraci?

english: Yes.
For it to be in such a state means that there is unimaginable evil nearby. These plants were grown personally by Zachariah, the Justiciar of the Owl.
translation: Bu bitki örtüsünün bu durumda olmasi, yakinlarda hayal edilemeyecek kadar büyük bir kötülük oldugu anlamina geliyor. Bu bitkiler, Baykus'un Adaletcisi Zachariah tarafindan bizzat yetistirildi.

english: Anything he plants blossoms with unimaginable vigour. You may have noticed that he has a love for lilies. Perhaps he knew they'd serve multiple purposes in a place like this.
translation: Onun ektigi her sey, hayal edilemeyecek kadar güclü bir sekilde cicek acar. Onun zambaklari sevdigini fark etmis olabilirsin. Belki de bu tür bir yerde bircok amaca hizmet edeceklerini biliyordu.

english: Hmm. Hopefully I'll meet him one day.
translation: Hmm. Umarim bir gün onunla tanisirim.

english: If you do, send my regards.
Do you have a name?
I'm but a loyal watcher, that is all.
translation: Ben sadece sadik bir gözlemciyim, hepsi bu.

english: So, was there anything else?
Wait...
Your helmet looks familiar. I defeated a knight who wore one with a similar design.
translation: Kaskin tanidik geliyor. Benzer bir tasarima sahip bir kask takan bir sövalyeyi yenmistim.

english: This helmet? It is based on the one worn by the Justiciar of the Owl. You mean to say you fought the great Zachariah and lived to tell the tale?
translation: Bu kask mi? Bu, Baykus'un Yargici'nin taktigi kaska benziyor. Yani büyük Zachariah ile savastin ve hayatta kalarak bu hikayeyi anlatabiliyorsun?

english: Well, I suppose so.
This can't be... You killed the great Zachariah?
translation: Bu olamaz... Büyük Zachariah'i öldürdün mü?

english: Hmm, he didn't really die. He just sort of faded away and left behind a glowing magical hand.
translation: Hmm, o gercekten ölmedi. Sadece bir sekilde kayboldu ve arkasinda parlayan sihirli bir el birakti.

english: Strange, when I saw him last he had no magical hand to speak of... I suppose time has changed the world above beyond my recollection...
translation: Garip, onu son gördügümde sihirli bir eli yoktu... Sanirim zaman, yukaridaki dünyayi benim hatirladigimdan cok degistirmis...

english: Yep, it probably has.
What's with the owls?
They are a symbol of the wise. You see, owls can see the light in the darkest of places. Their presence within the sepulchre is one of grave importance.
translation: Onlar bilgeligin sembolüdür. Baykuslar en karanlik yerlerde bile isigi görebilirler. Mezarlikta bulunmalari cok önemlidir.

english: Yes, I saw some down there. They seemed incorporeal in some way, as if they were ghosts...
translation: Evet, asagida birkac tane gördüm. Sanki hayaletler gibi, bir sekilde bedensiz görünüyorlardi...

english: Indeed. These creatures have the blessing of Saradomin and the wisdom of ages long past. They are the watchers of the Hallowed Sepulchre. The last defence against unseen evils.
translation: Gercekten. Bu yaratiklar Saradomin'in kutsamasina ve uzun zaman önce kaybolmus bilgelige sahiptir. Onlar Kutsal Mezar'in bekcileri. Görünmeyen kötülüklere karsi son savunma.

english: Err... past the wolves?
The third floor... Home.
Thank you for freeing me, adventurer. If the owls have already retreated that far back, it's best that I reside here. From this position I can more effectively watch for evil.
translation: Beni kurtardigin icin tesekkürler, maceraci. Baykuslar o kadar geri cekildiyse, en iyisi burada kalayim. Bu konumdan kötülügü daha etkili bir sekilde gözetleyebilirim.

english: Hmm... Perhaps I should steal from graves more often?
translation: Hmm... Belki de mezarlardan daha sik calmaliyim?

english: Excuse me?
Oh, nothing.
I'm off now, goodbye.
Stay watchful.
Woo? Woo wooooooooo!
You dare defile this sacred place? That treasure doesn't belong to you!
translation: Bu kutsal yeri kirletmeye nasil cüret edersin? O hazine sana ait degil!

english: Who's this Justiciar of the Owl?
What's with the owls?
I'm off now, goodbye.
Who are you?
Woo wooo!
I am a holy Knight of the Unicorn. I served under the Archpriest of this place who himself served under the Justiciar of the Unicorn.
translation: Ben kutsal Tek Boynuzlu At Sövalyesiyim. Bu yerin Basrahibi'nin emrinde hizmet ettim, o da Tek Boynuzlu At Yargici'nin emrinde hizmet etti.

english: You don't look like a knight... Don't knights wear plate armour and wield swords and lances and stuff?
translation: Sövalyeye benzemiyorsun... Sövalyeler zirh giyip kilic ve mizrak gibi seyler kullanmazlar mi?

english: The title of knight perhaps has a different meaning to you adventurer. In fact, all of the knights of my order are priests who serve under Saradomin.
translation: Sövalye unvani senin icin farkli bir anlam ifade ediyor olabilir maceraci. Aslinda, benim tarikatimdaki tüm sövalyeler Saradomin'in emrinde hizmet eden rahiplerdir.

english: During my life, I spent my time here consecrating the fallen followers of holy Saradomin. I would perform their final rites before laying them to rest within this place.
translation: Hayatim boyunca, burada kutsal Saradomin'in ölen takipcilerini kutsamakla gecirdim. Onlari buraya defnetmeden önce son ayinlerini gerceklestirirdim.

english: I see. So does this place only contain the bodies of these 'knights' who followed Saradomin?
translation: Anliyorum. Yani bu yer sadece Saradomin'i takip eden bu “sövalyelerin” cesetlerini mi barindiriyor?

english: Not at all. We also provided these rites for all the citizens of Hallowvale. They were mostly laid to rest on the first two floors.
translation: Hic de degil. Hallowvale'in tüm vatandaslari icin de bu törenleri düzenledik. Cogu ilk iki katta defnedildi.

english: Interesting. So who is this Justiciar of the Unicorn you spoke of?
translation: Ilginc. Peki, bahsettigin Unicorn'un Yargici kim?

english: The Justiciar of the Unicorn? Why this title is only bestowed upon the holiest priest of Saradomin.
translation: Unicorn'un Yargici mi? Bu unvan sadece Saradomin'in en kutsal rahibine verilir.

english: The justiciar I followed would spread the teachings of Saradomin everywhere he went, converting the masses to our religion.
translation: Benim takip ettigim yargic, gittigi her yere Saradomin'in ögretilerini yayarak halki bizim dinimize dönüstürürdü.

english: The statue in the north east of this room was created in his likeness when the place was built. I must say though, it does concern me that this is the first you've heard of him and his feats.
translation: Bu odanin kuzeydogusundaki heykel, bu yer insa edildiginde onun benzerinden yapilmistir. Ancak, onun ve basarilarini ilk kez duyuyor olman beni endiselendiriyor.

english: Well I've certainly heard of the word justiciar, but nothing about the Justiciar of the Unicorn.
translation: Yargic kelimesini duymustum ama Unicorn Yargici hakkinda hicbir sey bilmiyordum.

english: That saddens me greatly. I do hope that he is still carrying out Saradomin's will.
translation: Bu beni cok üzdü. Umarim hâlâ Saradomin'in iradesini yerine getiriyordur.

english: Anyway, do tell me adventurer, what brings you to the Hallowed Sepulchre?
translation: Neyse, söyle bana maceraci, seni Kutsal Mezarliga getiren nedir?

english: I found this place within the city of Darkmeyer and that mysterious stranger over there asked me to acquire some Hallowed marks which you and your bretherenwere buried with.
translation: Bu yeri Darkmeyer sehrinde buldum ve suradaki gizemli yabanci, senin ve kardeslerinin gömüldügü Kutsal isaretleri almami istedi.

english: I see. Did you say Darkmeyer? An interesting name, especially when this region is so bright and full of life.
translation: Anliyorum. Darkmeyer mi dedin? Ilginc bir isim, özellikle de bu bölge bu kadar parlak ve hayat dolu iken.

english: When I was alive this place was known as Hallowvale. Do you know why the queen decided to change the name?
translation: Ben hayattayken bu yer Hallowvale olarak biliniyordu. Kralice neden ismi degistirmeye karar verdi biliyor musun?

english: Erm, simply put, the land here is... under new management.
translation: Sey, basitce söylemek gerekirse, bu topraklar... yeni bir yönetim altinda.

english: Hmm, interesting. I wish I could see for myself but unfortunately, I am unable to leave this place. I do wonder if this new 'management' is the reason my spirit did not pass on to the afterlife.
translation: Hmm, ilginc. Keske kendim görebilseydim ama ne yazik ki buradan ayrilamiyorum. Acaba bu yeni ‘yönetim’ ruhumun öbür dünyaya gecememesinin sebebi mi?

english: Perhaps so. However, it's probably best that you can't leave this place. I'm not sure you'd like what you'd find.
translation: Belki de öyledir. Ancak, burayi terk edememeniz muhtemelen en iyisi. Bulacaginiz seyleri begeneceginizi sanmiyorum.

english: I fear you may be right adventurer. The last instruction I was given was to help protect this place from invaders by placing magical enchantments on the statues within.
translation: Korkarim hakli olabilirsiniz maceraci. Bana verilen son talimat, burayi istilacilardan korumak icin icindeki heykellere büyülü büyüler koymakti.

english: I admit, I never dared ask who or what we were protecting it from.
translation: Itiraf ediyorum, kimi veya neyi korudugumuzu sormaya cesaret edemedim.

english: If it's any consolation, the enchantments you placed did prevent the 'invaders' from entering. It's only us human adventurers who enter the Sepulchre.
translation: Eger teselli olacaksa, koydugun büyüler “isgalcilerin” girmesini engelledi. Sepulchre'ye giren sadece biz insan maceracilariz.

english: Although we have been stealing some of your stuff... Sorry about that.
translation: Gerci senin esyalarini caldik... Bunun icin özür dilerim.

english: It's not like I have any use for my stuff anymore. Thanks adventurer, your words do lighten my spirits somewhat.
translation: Artik esyalarimin bir faydasi yok ki. Tesekkürler maceraci, sözlerin ruhumu biraz hafifletiyor.

english: Aren't you all spirit?
Woo? Woo wooooooooo!
You dare defile this sacred place? That treasure doesn't belong to you!
translation: Bu kutsal yeri kirletmeye nasil cüret edersin? O hazine sana ait degil!

english: Who are you?
Woo wooo?
Me? I am a Knight of the Wolf. I serve the fierce Justiciar of the Wolf!
translation: Ben mi? Ben Kurt Sövalyesiyim. Kurt'un siddetli Adaletcisi'ne hizmet ediyorum!

english: Of the Wolf?
Aye, the most loyal and fiercest of Saradomin's followers! We are the bastion against all that is evil.
translation: Evet, Saradomin'in en sadik ve en siddetli takipcileri! Biz tüm kötülüklere karsi bir kaleyiz.

english: Who's this Justiciar of the Wolf?
You haven't heard of...
What happened to her?

I was hoping you could tell me... Ah, the white wolf we called her... For she had the brightest hair you'd ever seen. A silver so bright it could blind. Some said she had icyene blood, but those close to her knew better.
translation: Bana sen anlatirsin diye umuyordum... Ah, ona beyaz kurt derdik... Cünkü gördügün en parlak saclara sahipti. Göz kamastiracak kadar parlak gümüs rengi saclar. Bazilari onun buz kani tasidigini söylerdi, ama ona yakin olanlar gercegi biliyordu.

english: I take it you were close?
Close enough. The white wolf was but a mere human, albeit with astounding prowess on the battlefield... She vied for Saradomin's attention the most out of all the justiciars.
translation: Yeterince yakindik. Beyaz Kurt, savas alaninda sasirtici bir yetenege sahip olsa da, sadece bir insandi... Tüm yargiclar arasinda Saradomin'in dikkatini en cok ceken oydu.

english: Hmm... Why do you think that was?
Ah, well... She always wanted to be stronger and never seemed happy with what she had. There was always more.
translation: Ah, sey... Her zaman daha güclü olmak istiyordu ve sahip olduklariyla asla mutlu görünmüyordu. Her zaman daha fazlasini istiyordu.

english: Was there anything else you wanted?
Any great battles to speak of?
There was this time a great evil swept over Hallowvale...
translation: Bir keresinde Hallowvale'i büyük bir kötülük sarmisti...

english: Ah! The vampyres?
The what?
Y'know? The ones with the wings and all the blood sucking?
translation: Bilirsin ya? Kanatli ve kan emenler?

english: No, don't be so ridiculous. As I was saying... A great evil...
translation: Hayir, sacmalama. Dedigim gibi... Büyük bir kötülük...

english: The common folk called it the Egregore. They said it could shift and change shape at a moments notice into creatures from the deepest abyss...
translation: Halk ona Egregore diyordu. Bir anda sekil degistirip en derin cehennemden gelen yaratiklara dönüsebildigini söylüyorlardi...

english: Sounds terrifying.
These folk, they tend to exaggerate. It wasn't until the nobles started spreading word of its ghoulish features, each more horrible than the last...
translation: Bu insanlar abartmaya meyillidir. Soylular, birbiri ardina daha da korkunc olan korkunc özelliklerini yaymaya baslayana kadar...

english: That was when we took an interest in killing the thing. We are Knights of the Wolf after all! Our duty is to eradicate all evil.
translation: O zaman biz de onu öldürmeye ilgi duymaya basladik. Ne de olsa biz Kurt Sövalyeleriyiz! Görevimiz tüm kötülükleri ortadan kaldirmak.

english: Woah! How does one vanquish such a foe?
translation: Vay canina! Böyle bir düsmani nasil yenebiliriz?

english: Well, we made short work of it. That is what we do.
translation: Biz bu isi cabucak hallettik. Bizim isimiz bu.

english: But, how?
With a big sword of course!
Ah... A favorite method of mine.
Ah... I prefer a carefully placed arrow myself. Each to their own though.
translation: Ah... Ben dikkatlice yerlestirilmis bir ok tercih ederim. Herkesin kendi tercihi.

english: It does the job! Once we had shown the head of the beast to the masses, talk of the Egregore soon died down. At least... for a while.
translation: Isi görüyor! Canavarin kafasini halka gösterdikten sonra, Egregore hakkindaki söylentiler kisa sürede sona erdi. En azindan... bir süreligine.

english: It returned?
Yes. It was strange... As soon as the small folk had forgotten about the Egregore, rumours started to arise that it had returned. And so it had! That was the nature of this beast.
translation: Evet. Garipti... Kücük halk Egregore'u unutur unutmaz, geri döndügüne dair söylentiler cikmaya basladi. Ve gercekten de dönmüstü! Bu canavarin dogasi böyleydi.

english: So it was truly undying?
Does the Egregore still haunt these lands, human?
translation: Egregore hâlâ bu topraklarda dolasiyor mu, insan?

english: Hmm, I can't say I've seen it...
Then you must assume we were quite successful! At least by the time of my passing, the beast hadn't returned. Although, who knows? It could have taken any form by now.
translation: O zaman oldukca basarili oldugumuzu varsaymalisin! En azindan ben öldügümde canavar geri dönmemisti. Ama kim bilir? Simdiye kadar herhangi bir sekle bürünmüs olabilir.

english: Well I can't say for certain, but you look pretty old.
translation: Kesin olarak söyleyemem ama oldukca yasli görünüyorsun.

english: Your humour is wasted on me.
I'm off now, goodbye.
May the light of Saradomin guide you, adventurer.
translation: Saradomin'in isigi sana rehberlik etsin, maceraci.

english: Woo? Woo wooooooooo!
You dare defile this sacred place? That treasure doesn't belong to you!
translation: Bu kutsal yeri kirletmeye nasil cüret edersin? O hazine sana ait degil!

english: Who's this Justiciar of the Wolf?
Any great battles to speak of?
I'm off now, goodbye.
Hey, how's it go...
Sorry my friend, the Skipper has been grindin' me up the wrong way lately. If ye need anythin', talk t' Cap'ain Pudi over by the dock.
translation: Üzgünüm dostum, Kaptan son zamanlarda beni cok zorluyor. Bir seye ihtiyacin olursa, rihtimdaki Kaptan Pudi ile konus.

english: That ungrateful Skipper. How dare he blame me for that freak storm?
translation: Nankör Kaptan. O garip firtinadan beni nasil sorumlu tutar?

english: Why are you angry at the Skipper?
It be a long story.
I've got time. I would love to hear it.
Fine, 'ere be me tale of misfortune.
About a half moon ago, we set sail on our fortnightly fishin' trip. 'Twas smooth sailin' all the way t' our spot.
translation: Yaklasik yarim ay önce, iki haftalik balik avi gezisine ciktik. Rotamiza kadar yolculuk sorunsuz gecti.

english: Caught a load of manta ray an' snappers.
translation: Bir sürü manta vatozu ve snapper yakaladik.

english: What's a snapper?
Ah, I should'a realised you were a landlubber. We on the ship call them snappers, but you lot call 'em lobsters.
translation: Ah, senin denizden anlamadigini anlamaliydim. Biz gemide onlara snapper diyoruz, ama siz onlara istakoz diyorsunuz.

english: Anyway, back to me tale.
After a couple o' days, we pulled up the anchor an' sailed closer t' the Karamjan coast. There is where the big'ns are.
translation: Birkac gün sonra, demir aldik ve Karamjan kiyilarina yaklastik. Büyükler orada.

english: What's a big'n?
You landlubbers... It be a shark.
Oh, how was I supposed to know?
CAN YOU STOP INTERRUPTIN' ME TALE?
Ok...
Good, now where was I...
When we arrived at the spot, the Skipper saw a lack of fish swimmin' in the waters.
translation: Oraya vardigimizda, Kaptan suda baliklarin azaldigini fark etti.

english: I looked yonder onto the horizon an' noticed a storm was a brewin', so we adjusted our course accordin'.
translation: Ufka baktim ve bir firtina kopmak üzere oldugunu gördüm, bu yüzden rotamizi buna göre ayarladik.

english: As if by magic, winds started a blowin' an' the storm started movin' in our direction.
translation: Sanki sihir gibi, rüzgar esmeye basladi ve firtina bizim yönümüze dogru ilerlemeye basladi.

english: Lightnin' struck the boat, an' a piece of wood holdin' up the sail fell an' struck me on the 'ead.
translation: Yildirim tekneye carpti ve yelkeni tutan bir tahta parcasi düsüp kafama carpti.

english: I woke up in a bed an' the Skipper started on me, tellin' me I ruined his ship an' I need t' pay him back.
translation: Bir yatakta uyandim ve Kaptan bana bagirmaya basladi, gemisini mahvettigimi ve ona borcumu ödemem gerektigini söyledi.

english: That's awful. He does not sound like a nice man.
translation: Bu cok kötü. Kulaga pek iyi bir adam gibi gelmiyor.

english: Nay, he usually is. He be upset about his ship, is all.
translation: Hayir, genelde iyidir. Sadece gemisi icin üzülüyor, hepsi bu.

english: Can I help ye with anythin' else?
translation: Baska bir seye yardim edebilir miyim?

english: Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?
translation: Tempoross ile savasmak icin herhangi bir ipucun var mi?

english: Watch out for the waves. If ye get hit by that you could end up lost at sea.
translation: Dalgalara dikkat et. Eger dalgalara kapilirsan denizde kaybolabilirsin.

english: Ye might find tying yourself t' somethin' using a rope t' be a life saver.
translation: Kendini bir iple bir seye baglamak hayat kurtarici olabilir.

english: Or if ye manage to get yer hands on one of them there fancy Spirity Angler outfits, it comes with a built- in rope harness.
translation: Ya da o süslü Spirity Angler kiyafetlerinden birini ele gecirebilirsen, icinde bir ip kosum takimi var.

english: I have to go.
Have a good'n. I know I won't.
translation: Iyi günler. Benim icin iyi olmayacak.

english: Would you care for an egg in this difficult time?
translation: Bu zor zamanda bir yumurta ister misin?

english: Oh, a damp egg! Yes, please!
translation: Oh, nemli bir yumurta! Evet, lütfen!

english: Wait, really?
Aye, I'll add it t' me collection!
You know there's a crate of them you could just help yourself t'...
translation: Biliyorsun, bir kasa dolusu var, istedigin kadar alabilirsin...

english: Hush! Don't let Timallus hear ye speak o' the damp egg crate. It'll set 'im off!
translation: Sus! Timallus nemli yumurta kasasindan bahsettigini duymasin. Sinirlenir!

english: Just pass me the egg.
Thank ye kindly!
...You're welcome.
Oh, thanks.
This is some comfort to be sure.
Why are you angry at the Skipper?
Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?
translation: Tempoross ile savasmak icin herhangi bir ipucun var mi?

english: I have to go.
Hello. What are you up to?
Nothing exciting, just keeping an eye out.
translation: Heyecan verici bir sey yok, sadece göz kulak oluyorum.

english: Hello there, you must be Koftik.
That I am adventurer. King Lathas told me to expect you. I assume he has told you our goal?
translation: Öyleyim, maceraci. Kral Lathas seni beklememi söyledi. Sanirim sana hedefimizi söyledi?

english: He said we need to find a way through the Underground Pass. Shouldn't be too bad, I've travelled through many a cave in my time.
translation: Yeralti Gecidi'nden gecmenin bir yolunu bulmamiz gerektigini söyledi. Cok zor olmamali, hayatim boyunca bircok magaradan gectim.

english: These caves are different... There is a darkness in there unlike any other. You can feel it as you wind your way round the stalagmites... an icy chill that penetrates the very fabric of your being...
translation: Bu magaralar farkli... Iclerinde baska hicbir yerde olmayan bir karanlik var. Stalagmitlerin arasinda dolasirken bunu hissedebilirsin... varliginin en derinlerine isleyen buz gibi bir soguk...

english: You've been in before?
I have. I didn't go far though, nor did I stay for long. People change in these caves...
translation: Girdim. Ama cok uzaga gitmedim, uzun süre de kalmadim. Insanlar bu magaralarda degisiyor...

english: I'll take my chances.
Okay traveller, I'll catch up with you by the bridge.
Tell me more...
I remember one warrior. His name was Randas. He stood tall and proud like an elven king...
translation: Bir savasci hatirliyorum. Adi Randas'ti. Elf krali gibi uzun boylu ve gururluydu...

english: That same pride made him vulnerable. Randas' worthy desire to be a great and mighty warrior also made him corruptible.
translation: Ayni gurur onu savunmasiz hale getirdi. Randas'in büyük ve güclü bir savasci olma arzusu onu yozlasmaya acik hale getirdi.

english: Within the cave, he heard the voice of Zamorak himself...
Zamorak showed him a way to achieve his goals by appealing to that most base and dark nature... One that resides in all of us.
translation: Zamorak, en temel ve karanlik dogaya hitap ederek hedeflerine ulasmanin bir yolunu gösterdi... Hepimizin icinde bulunan dogaya.

english: What happened to him?
No one knows...
Anyway, head on in when you're ready. You'll soon come to a bridge, I will catch up with you there.
translation: Neyse, hazir oldugunda iceri gir. Yakinda bir köprüye varacaksin, orada sana yetisirim.

english: Hi, Koftik.
Hello adventurer. We seem to have a bit of an issue ahead of us. The bridge is up and I can't see another way across.
translation: Merhaba maceraci. Önümüzde kücük bir sorun var gibi görünüyor. Köprü yukarida ve baska bir gecit göremiyorum.

english: Do you know how to get the bridge down?
I'm afraid not. This is the furthest I've ever been. It does look like someone was here before us though, there's the remains of a camp.
translation: Korkarim bilmiyorum. Bu, simdiye kadar geldigim en uzak yer. Ama görünüse göre bizden önce biri buraya gelmis, kamp kalintilari var.

english: I had a look through their things and found some cloth along with the charred remains of some arrows.
translation: Esyalarini karistirdim ve bazi oklarin yanmis kalintilari ile birlikte birkac parca kumas buldum.

english: Charred arrows? They must have been trying to burn something. Or someone!
translation: Kömürlesmis oklar mi? Bir seyi yakmaya calismis olmalilar. Ya da birini!

english: Koftik gives you some cloth. It's coated in an oil substance.
translation: Koftik sana bir parca kumas veriyor. Üzerinde yagli bir madde var.

english: There's plenty more cloth by the fire. I also found the remains of a book...
translation: Atesin yaninda daha fazla kumas var. Ayrica bir kitabin kalintilarini da buldum...

english: Probably just litter.
Well... maybe?
What does it say?
It seems to be written by the adventurer Randas. Have a look.
translation: Görünüse göre maceraci Randas tarafindan yazilmis. Bir bak.

english: Hello Koftik.
Do you hear them? The voices tell me things.
translation: Onlari duyuyor musun? Sesler bana bir seyler söylüyor.

english: Are you OK?
The path of the righteous man is beset on all sides by the iniquitiesof the selfish and the tyranny of evil men.
translation: Dogru kisinin yolu, her taraftan bencil insanlarin kötülükleri ve kötü insanlarin zulmüyle cevrilidir.

english: Tyranny of the righteous? What?
So many paths to choose... Here we must all take our own path.
translation: Secilecek o kadar cok yol var ki... Burada hepimiz kendi yolumuzu secmeliyiz.

english: The voices, they've been telling me things...
Koftik, is everything okay? You're getting me worried.
translation: Koftik, her sey yolunda mi? Beni endiselendiriyorsun.

english: Don't be, friend. Anyway, do you know the definition of insanity?
translation: Endiselenme dostum. Her neyse, deliligin tanimini biliyor musun?

english: Err... what?
The definition of insanity is doing the same thing over and over, expecting things to change.
translation: Deliligin tanimi, ayni seyi tekrar tekrar yapip, bir seylerin degismesini beklemektir.

english: I spent years doing the same thing, day in and day out. I always wanted more but I never got it. Now, I finally see why...
translation: Yillarca ayni seyi yaptim, her gün. Her zaman daha fazlasini istedim ama asla elde edemedim. Simdi, sonunda nedenini anliyorum...

english: You see, once I was insane. But now... now I am finally free...
translation: Görüyorsun, bir zamanlar deliydim. Ama simdi... simdi sonunda özgürüm...

english: Ah, you've arrived. We've been waiting for you.
Koftik, you're still here? You should leave.
Leave? But this is my home now. Home with my lord. He talks to me, he's my friend.
translation: Gitmek mi? Ama burasi artik benim evim. Efendimin evi. Benimle konusuyor, o benim arkadasim.

english: Koftik, you really should leave these caverns.
Not now, we're all the same down here.  There's just you and those dwarves left.
translation: Simdi degil, burada hepimiz ayniyiz.  Sadece sen ve o cüceler kaldiniz.

english: Dwarves?
Foolish dwarves, still believing that they can resist. No one resists Iban.
translation: Aptal cüceler, hala direnebileceklerine inaniyorlar. Kimse Iban'a direnemez.

english: You could help! Deep down you know you want it! I know you already dealt with those Paladins. Now you just need to kill the dwarves!
translation: Sen yardim edebilirsin! Icinde bunu istedigini biliyorsun! O Paladinlerle zaten ilgilendigini biliyorum. Simdi sadece cüceleri öldürmen gerekiyor!

english: Head south and through the tunnel. You'll find the dwarves at the other end. Go slay them. Slay them for our lord!
translation: Güneye dogru ilerle ve tünelden gec. Diger tarafta cüceleri bulacaksin. Onlari öldür. Efendimiz icin onlari öldür!

english: Nice job killing those Paladins. You're much closer to his side now. Perhaps you could kill those dwarves as well. That would really please him.
translation: Paladinleri öldürerek iyi is cikardin. Artik onun tarafina cok daha yakinsin. Belki o cüceleri de öldürebilirsin. Bu onu cok memnun eder.

english: Adventurer, where am I? I can't remember a thing!
We were losing you to Iban's influence.
What? Of course, the voices... But they've stopped. What happened?
translation: Ne? Tabii ki, sesler... Ama artik durdular. Ne oldu?

english: Iban's dead, I destroyed him.
You've done well! Thanks for saving me.
translation: Iyi is cikardin! Beni kurtardigin icin tesekkürler.

english: But what about you, adventurer? Did the voices not affect you?
translation: Peki ya sen, maceraci? Sesler seni etkilemedi mi?

english: Your mind is filled with strange images. A unicorn. A boulder. Some paladins. They seem real... but were they?
translation: Zihnin garip görüntülerle dolu. Bir tek boynuzlu at. Bir kaya. Bazi paladinler. Gercek gibi görünüyorlar... ama öyle miydiler?

english: I... I don't think so...
I see. We must now inform the king. Follow me, I'll lead you out.
translation: Anliyorum. Simdi krala haber vermeliyiz. Beni takip et, seni disari cikaracagim.

english: At last! I've had enough of these caves.
Koftik leads you back through the winding caverns to the entrance. But it feels like part of you has been left behind...
translation: Koftik seni dolambacli magaralardan gecerek girise geri götürür. Ama sanki bir parcan geride kalmis gibi hissediyorsun...

english: Thanks for showing me the way out Koftik.
translation: Cikis yolunu gösterdigin icin tesekkürler Koftik.

english: Always a pleasure. Have you informed the king about Iban?
translation: Her zaman memnuniyetle. Krala Iban'dan haber verdin mi?

english: No, not yet.
This is no time to linger. The king must know that Iban is dead. This is a truly historical event for Ardougne.
translation: Gecikmek icin zaman yok. Kral, Iban'in öldügünü bilmeli. Bu, Ardougne icin gercekten tarihi bir olay.

english: Hello adventurer, how's things?
Not bad, yourself?
I'm good... just keeping an eye out.
I found this by the way. I guess you'll be wanting it back.
translation: Bu arada bunu buldum. Sanirim geri almak istersin.

english: Thanks Koftik.
Hello [player name], how's things?
These traps don't get any easier. But I'm alright, thanks.
translation: Bu tuzaklar hic kolaylasmiyor. Ama ben iyiyim, tesekkürler.

english: Good to hear.
I'll take my chances.
Tell me more...
Probably just litter.
What does it say?
Hello there. What is this place?
Do not waste my time with trivial questions. I am the Great Kolodion, master of battle magic. I have an arena to run.
translation: Önemsiz sorularla vaktimi bosa harcama. Ben Büyük Kolodion, savas büyüsünün ustasiyim. Yönetmem gereken bir arenam var.

english: Can I enter?
Hah! A wizard of your level? Don't be absurd.
translation: Hah! Senin seviyedeki bir büyücü mü? Sacmalama.

english: I am the great Kolodion, master of battle magic, and this is my battle arena. Top wizards travel from all over Gielinor to fight here.
translation: Ben savas büyüsünün ustasi Büyük Kolodion'um ve burasi benim savas arenam. En iyi büyücüler Gielinor'un her yerinden buraya savasmaya gelirler.

english: Can I fight here?
My arena is open to any high level wizard, but this is no game. Many wizards fall in this arena, never to rise again. The strongest mages have been destroyed.
translation: Arenam yüksek seviyeli büyücülere aciktir, ama bu bir oyun degildir. Bircok büyücü bu arenada düser ve bir daha asla ayaga kalkamaz. En güclü büyücüler yok edildi.

english: If you're sure you want in?
Yes indeedy.
Good, good. You have a healthy sense of competition.
translation: Güzel, güzel. Saglikli bir rekabet anlayisin var.

english: Remember, traveller - in my arena, hand-to-hand combat is useless. Your strength will diminish as you enter the arena, but the spells you can learn are amongst the most powerful in all of Gielinor.
translation: Unutma, gezgin - benim arenamda, gögüs gögüse dövüsmek ise yaramaz. Arenaya girdiginde gücün azalacak, ama ögrenebilecegin büyüler Gielinor'un en güclü büyülerinden.

english: Before I can accept you in, we must duel.
translation: Seni kabul etmeden önce, düello yapmaliyiz.

english: Okay, let's fight.
I must first check that you are up to scratch.
translation: Önce senin yeterli olup olmadigini kontrol etmeliyim.

english: You don't need to worry about that.
Not just any magician can enter - only the most powerful and most feared. Before you can use the power of this arena, you must prove yourself against me.
translation: Her büyücü giremez, sadece en güclü ve en korkulanlar girebilir. Bu arenanin gücünü kullanabilmen icin önce bana karsi kendini kanitlamalisin.

english: The player is teleported to the Mage Arena to fight against Kolodion
translation: Oyuncu, Kolodion ile dövüsmek icin Büyücü Arenasina isinlanir.

english: No thanks.
No I don't.
Your loss.
What's the point of that?
We learn how to use our magic to its fullest and how to channel the forces of the cosmos into our world...
translation: Büyümüzü en iyi sekilde kullanmayi ve kozmosun güclerini dünyamiza aktarmayi ögreniyoruz...

english: But mainly, I just like blasting people into dust.
translation: Ama asil olarak, insanlari toza cevirmeyi seviyorum.

english: That's barbaric!
Nope, it's magic. But I know what you mean. So do you want to join us?
translation: Hayir, bu büyü. Ama ne demek istedigini anliyorum. Bize katilmak ister misin?

english: You must prove yourself... now!
This is only the beginning; you can't beat me!
Foolish mortal; I am unstoppable.
Now you feel it... The dark energy.
Aaaaaaaarrgghhhh! The power!
The player is teleported back to the safe zone after defeating Kolodion's final form
translation: Oyuncu, Kolodion'un son formunu yendikten sonra güvenli bölgeye geri isinlanir.

english: Well done, young adventurer; you truly are a worthy battle mage.
translation: Aferin, genc maceraci; sen gercekten degerli bir savas büyücüsüsün.

english: What now?
Step into the magic pool. It will take you to a chamber. There, you must decide which god you will represent in the arena.
translation: Sihirli havuza gir. Seni bir odaya götürecek. Orada, arenada hangi tanriyi temsil edecegine karar vermelisin.

english: Thanks, Kolodion.
That's what I'm here for.
Hello, Kolodion.
Hello, young mage. You're a tough one.
translation: Merhaba, genc büyücü. Sen zorlu birisin.

english: You're not allowed in there. Come downstairs if you want to enter my arena.
translation: Oraya giremezsin. Arenama girmek istiyorsan asagiya gel.

english: Can I fight here?
Yes indeedy.
Okay, let's fight.
No thanks.
No I don't.
What's the point of that?
That's barbaric!
I see we have a new arrival. A bringer of death. Tell me, have you come to serve the balance?
translation: Görüyorum ki yeni bir misafirimiz var. Ölümün habercisi. Söylesene, dengeyi saglamak icin mi geldin?

english: Bringer of death, have you come to serve the balance?
translation: Ölümün habercisi, dengeyi saglamak icin mi geldin?

english: I need another assignment.
You are to bring balance to [amount] [monster] in [area].
Got any tips for me?
Great, thanks!
Can I cancel that task?
Your task has been cancelled.
Okay, great!
Once the balance has been served, return to me.
translation: Denge saglandiktan sonra bana geri dön.

english: Where is that area?
You're still bringing balance to [task monster]; you have [amount] to go. Come back when you're finished.
You're still meant to be bringing balance to [monster] in [area], with [amount] to go.
Bringer of death, I do not feel you are ready for your current task. If you wish, I can cancel it. This will not wipe your task streaks.
translation: Ölümün habercisi, su anki görevin icin hazir olmadigini düsünüyorum. Istersen, görevi iptal edebilirim. Bu, görev serini silmez.

english: Yes, please cancel it.
Very well. If you still wish to maintain the balance, you can get a new assignment.
translation: Peki. Hala dengeyi korumak istiyorsan, yeni bir görev alabilirsin.

english: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
Then I wish you well, bringer of death.
translation: O zaman sana basarilar dilerim, ölümün habercisi.

english: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: Bana verebilecegin bir ödül veya takas edebilecegin bir sey var mi?

english: Those who serve the balance are always rewarded. I can grant these rewards. I can also grant you the equipment needed to serve the balance, for a price of course.
translation: Dengeye hizmet edenler her zaman ödüllendirilir. Bu ödülleri verebilirim. Ayrica, elbette bir bedel karsiliginda, dengeye hizmet etmek icin gerekli ekipmani da verebilirim.

english: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
When tasking you to serve the balance, I do not currently consider your combat level.
translation: Sana dengeye hizmet etmek icin görev verirken, su anda savas seviyeni dikkate almiyorum.

english: That's fine - I can handle any task.
Your zeal is to be commended. Use it well when serving the balance.
translation: Hirsin takdire sayan. Dengeye hizmet ederken bunu iyi kullan.

english: In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: Gelecekte lütfen cok zor görevler vermeyin.

english: As you wish. From now on, your combat level will be taken into account when tasks are assigned.
translation: Nasil istersen. Bundan sonra görevler verilirken savas seviyen dikkate alinacak.

english: When tasking you to serve the balance, I consider your combat level, so you shouldn't get anything too challenging.
translation: Dengeyi korumak icin sana görev verirken savas seviyeni dikkate aliyorum, bu yüzden cok zor görevler almamalisin.

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
translation: Sorun degil, cok zor görevler istemiyorum.

english: Then we will continue on our current path.
translation: O zaman su anki yolumuza devam edecegiz.

english: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: Savas seviyemi kontrol etmeyi birak, her seyi yapabilirim!

english: Your zeal is to be commended. From now on, your combat level will not be considered when tasks are assigned.
translation: Hirsin övgüye deger. Bundan sonra, görevler verilirken savas seviyen dikkate alinmayacak.

english: I'd rather not.
Who are you?
A guardian of life, and a bringer of death. There must always be a balance. My people and I serve this balance. You could serve the balance as well, but you'll need some practice first.
translation: Yasamin koruyucusu ve ölümün habercisi. Her zaman bir denge olmali. Ben ve halkim bu dengeye hizmet ediyoruz. Sen de dengeye hizmet edebilirsin, ama önce biraz pratik yapman gerek.

english: There is a Slayer Master in Burthorpe, he goes by the name of Turael. Learn from him, and you will soon be ready to serve.
translation: Burthorpe'da Turael adinda bir Avci Ustasi var. Ondan ögren, yakinda hizmet etmeye hazir olacaksin.

english: A bringer of death calls from afar. What do you desire?
translation: Ölümün habercisi uzaktan sesleniyor. Ne istiyorsun?

english: Err... Nothing...
Bringer of death, why do you insist on using such magic when I'm right next to you? Come and talk to me.
translation: Ölümün habercisi, ben yanindayken neden böyle bir büyü kullanmakta israr ediyorsun? Gel ve benimle konus.

english: How am I doing so far?
You're currently assigned to bring balance to [monster] in [area]; you have [amount] more to go. Your reward point tally is [amount].
I am Konar quo Maten. Like you, I am a bringer of death. Together, we can serve the balance.
translation: Ben Konar quo Maten. Senin gibi ben de ölümün habercisiyim. Birlikte dengeyi saglayabiliriz.

english: Where are you?
You'll find me on Mount Karuulm. I'll be here when you need a new purpose.
translation: Beni Karuulm Dagi'nda bulabilirsin. Yeni bir amac aradiginda burada olacagim.

english: Nothing really.
I need another assignment.
Got any tips for me?
Can I cancel that task? (30 Points)
translation: Bu görevi iptal edebilir miyim? (30 Puan)

english: Where is that area?
Okay, great!
Yes, please cancel it.
No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: Bana verebilecegin bir ödül veya takas edebilecegin bir sey var mi?

english: Look at rewards.
Look at shop.
Cancel.
Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
That's fine - I can handle any task.
In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: Gelecekte lütfen cok zor görevler vermeyin.

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
translation: Sorun degil, cok zor görevler istemiyorum.

english: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: Savas seviyemi kontrol etmeyi birakin, her seyi yapabilirim!

english: I'd rather not.
Who are you?
Err... Nothing...
How am I doing so far?
Where are you?
Nothing really.
More digging, less talking!
translation: Daha fazla kaz, daha az konus!

english: What's going on here?
I'm digging for saltpetre, of course. Got to have plenty of saltpetre for the farms. You should grab a spade and get to work too - they always need saltpetre.
translation: Tabii ki gühercile ariyorum. Ciftlikler icin bol miktarda gühercileye ihtiyacimiz var. Sen de bir kürek alip ise koyulmalisin - gühercileye her zaman ihtiyac vardir.

english: What can I do with saltpetre?
It's a critical ingredient in a special fertiliser used on the farms here. Just mix it with some compost - ordinary compost, not that super stuff - to make the fertiliser.
translation: Buradaki ciftliklerde kullanilan özel bir gübrenin önemli bir bilesenidir. Kompostla karistirarak gübre yapabilirsin - siradan kompostla, süper kompostla degil.

english: Once you've got fertiliser, you can use it on Farmer Gricoller's fruit farm. Alternatively, Hosidius farmers always want some. You could sell it to them.
translation: Gübreyi yaptiktan sonra, Ciftci Gricoller'in meyve ciftliginde kullanabilirsin. Alternatif olarak, Hosidius ciftcileri de her zaman gübre isterler. Onlara satabilirsin.

english: Have you got a spare spade?
Yes, but you've got no room for it.
Yes, but I can see you don't need it.
I'll leave you to work.
Very well done, now let me get back to digging!
translation: Cok iyi, simdi kazmaya devam edeyim!

english: You've obtained a casket!
What's going on here?
What can I do with saltpetre?
Have you got a spare spade?
I'll leave you to work.
Human. The Drakes through this tunnel are not to be killed without permission. To do so would be an affront to the balance.
translation: Insan. Bu tüneldeki Drake'ler izinsiz öldürülemez. Bunu yapmak dengeyi bozmak anlamina gelir.

english: Human! To attack these creatures would be a threat to the balance. Only those with permission may fight them!
translation: Insan! Bu yaratiklara saldirmak dengeyi bozmak anlamina gelir. Sadece izin alanlar onlarla savasabilir!

english: Hello there. You've come to the right place if you're looking for adventurer's equipment.
translation: Merhaba. Maceraci ekipmani ariyorsan dogru yere geldin.

english: Oh that sounds interesting.
No, sorry, I've come to the wrong place.
Hmph. Well, perhaps next time you'll need something from me?
translation: Hmph. Belki bir dahaki sefere benden bir sey istersin?

english: Oh that sounds interesting.
No, sorry, I've come to the wrong place.
What human need help with?
translation: Bir insanin yardima ihtiyaci ne olabilir ki?

english: Make[sword style]sword.
What's my current commission?
Go make[sword style]sword.
I'm not sure what something does.
translation: Bir seyin ne ise yaradigini bilmiyorum.

english: What do not understand, little one?
How do I use the crucible?
Crucible just a big bucket... We put metal in and it melt it down to make swords.
translation: Potayi sadece büyük bir kova... Icine metal koyup eriterek kilic yapiyoruz.

english: Crucible let us add differing metals... and can store up to 28 metal bar worth, Kovac think.
translation: Potaya farkli metaller ekleyebiliriz... Kovac'in tahminine göre 28 metal cubuk kadar depolayabilir.

english: We can put other metal thing in too, like sword and armour.
translation: Kilic ve zirh gibi baska metal esyalari da koyabiliriz.

english: Need help with anything else?
What does the mould jig do?
Mould jig very handy... It let us make differing type of sword.
translation: Kalip jig cok kullanislidir... Farkli türde kiliclar yapmamizi saglar.

english: We want use mould parts to fit condi... commission... so when setting up mould, find parts that match.
translation: Kalip parcalarini kosullara uygun olarak kullanmak istiyoruz... siparis... bu yüzden kalibi kurarken uygun parcalari bulun.

english: Some match commission better than other... so find best one for job.
translation: Bazilari siparise digerlerinden daha uygun... bu yüzden is icin en uygun olani bulun.

english: How do I control the preform's temperature?
That very easy... If preform too cold, dunk in lava... If preform too hot, hold to waterfall.
translation: Bu cok kolay... Preform cok soguksa lavin icine daldirin... Preform cok sicaksa selaleye tutun.

english: Preform need to be right temperature to work with tool.
translation: Preform, aletle calismak icin dogru sicaklikta olmalidir.

english: Trip hammer need preform to be hot... Grindstone need preform to be warm... Polishing wheel need preform to be cold.
translation: Cekic, preformun sicak olmasini gerektirir... Taslama tasi, preformun ilik olmasini gerektirir... Parlatma tekerlegi, preformun soguk olmasini gerektirir.

english: When should I use a tool?
Hmm... Kovac think it a gut feeling thing...
translation: Hmm... Kovac bunun icgüdüsel bir sey oldugunu düsünüyor...

english: That doesn't help me.
Hmm... that is true.
Progress on your sword can be tracked via the display on screen. You can track which tool you need to use via the completion bar.
translation: Kilicinizin ilerlemesi ekrandaki gösterge ile takip edilebilir. Tamamlanma cubugu ile hangi aleti kullanmaniz gerektigini takip edebilirsiniz.

english: Actually, I'm okay for now.
Okay.
Can I scrap my current commission?
Why want that?
I don't think I'm really feeling it at the moment.
That okay, Kovac will give reward even if sword bad. Maybe you put in storage for working later, but Kovac no scrap swords.
translation: Sorun degil, Kovac kilic kötü olsa bile ödül verecektir. Belki daha sonra calismak icin depoya koyarsiniz, ama Kovac kiliclari cöpe atmaz.

english: I'd like to buy something.
Here's what Kovac have.
I'm okay for now.
Okay friend, Kovac here to help.
translation: Tamam dostum, Kovac yardim etmek icin burada.

english: You no sword to hand over. I give new commission if want?
translation: Teslim edecek kilicin yok. Istersen yeni bir siparis vereyim mi?

english: You no sword to hand over. Kovac give commission already. Go make me[sword style]sword.
Hmm... sword not finished yet. Keep working.
translation: Hmm... kilic henüz bitmedi. Calismaya devam et.

english: Hmm... sword look good. Hand over.
translation: Hmm... kilic iyi görünüyor. Ver sunu.

english: Sword completed in: [time] at quality: [quality]  Best completed in: [best time] at quality: [best quality]  You're awarded: [number] Smithing XP and [number] coins.  Total swords made in the Giants Foundry: [number]
Sword no good. Give it here.
Sword completed in: [time] at quality: 0  Best completed in: [best time] at quality: [best quality]  You're awarded: 30 Smithing XP and 60 coins.  Total swords made in the Giants Foundry: [number]
Kovac give commission already. Go make me[sword style]sword.
Kovac does not want that back. Maybe the smith clothes would be good, if you got any.
translation: Kovac onu geri istemiyor. Eger varsa, demirci kiyafetleri iyi olabilir.

english: No, you keep that or give it to someone else.
translation: Hayir, onu sakla ya da baskasina ver.

english: Can't you make an exception for me? I'm an Ironman by the way.
translation: Benim icin bir istisna yapamaz misin? Bu arada ben Ironman'im.

english: You get treated the same anyway.
You keep that.
Can I get a new commission?
What's my current commission?
I'm not sure what something does.
translation: Bir seyin ne ise yaradigini bilmiyorum.

english: How do I use the crucible?
What does the mould jig do?
How do I control the preform's temperature?
translation: Ön kalibin sicakligini nasil kontrol ederim?

english: When should I use a tool?
Actually, I'm okay for now.
I'm not sure what something does, can you help me?
translation: Bir seyin ne ise yaradigini bilmiyorum, yardim eder misiniz?

english: Can I scrap my current commission?
I'd like to buy something.
I'm okay for now.
Yes.
No.
Accept
Decline
Would you look after my crops for me?
I might - which one were you thinking of?
You don't have any seeds planted in that patch. Plant some and I might agree to look after it for you.
translation: O tarlada ekili tohum yok. Biraz ekin, o zaman bakmayi kabul edebilirim.

english: That patch is already fully grown! I don't know what you want me to do with it!
translation: O tarla zaten tamamen yetismis! Ne yapmami istiyorsun bilmiyorum!

english: That patch is dead - it's too late for me to do anything about it now.
translation: O tarla öldü - artik bir sey yapmam icin cok gec.

english: That patch is diseased - you should cure it before asking me to be responsible for it!
translation: O tarla hastalikli - benden sorumlu olmama izin vermeden önce onu tedavi etmelisin!

english: I don't know what you're talking about - I'm already looking after that patch for you.
translation: Neden bahsettigini bilmiyorum - zaten o tarlaya senin icin bakiyorum.

english: Oh sorry, I forgot.
If you like, but I want 2 buckets of compost for that.
translation: Istersen, ama bunun icin 2 kova kompost istiyorum.

english: I'm afraid I don't have any of those at the moment.
Well, I'm not wasting my time for free.
I'm afraid I don't have enough of those at the moment.
translation: Maalesef su anda elimde yeterince yok.

english: Okay, it's a deal.
That'll do nicely, [sir/madam]. Leave it with me - I'll make sure that patch grows for you.
translation: Bu cok iyi olur, . Bana birakin - o parselin sizin icin yetismesini saglayacagim.

english: No, that's too much.
If you like, but I want one sack of potatoes for that.
translation: Isterseniz, ama bunun icin bir cuval patates istiyorum.

english: If you like, but I want one sack of onions for that.
translation: Isterseniz, ama bunun icin bir cuval sogan istiyorum.

english: If you like, but I want 2 sacks of cabbages for that.
translation: Isterseniz, ama bunun icin 2 cuval lahana istiyorum.

english: If you like, but I want 10 jute fibres for that.
translation: Isterseniz, ama bunun icin 10 jüt lifi istiyorum.

english: If you like, but I want one basket of apples for that.
translation: Isterseniz, ama bunun icin bir sepet elma istiyorum.

english: If you like, but I want 10 curry leaves for that.
translation: Isterseniz, ama bunun icin 10 curry yapragi istiyorum.

english: If you like, but I want 5 jangerberries for that.
translation: Isterseniz, ama bunun karsiliginda 5 jangerberry istiyorum.

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: Bana tarimla ilgili tavsiyelerde bulunabilir misiniz?

english: The only way to cure a bush or tree of disease is to prune away the diseased leaves with a pair of secateurs. For all other crops I would just apply some plant-cure.
translation: Bir cali veya agacin hastaligini tedavi etmenin tek yolu, hastalikli yapraklari bir budama makasi ile budamaktir. Diger tüm mahsuller icin ise bitki ilaci kullanirim.

english: Tree seeds must be grown in a plantpot of soil into a sapling, and then transferred to a tree patch to continue growing to adulthood.
translation: Agac tohumlari, toprak dolu bir saksida fidana dönüstürülmeli ve ardindan yetiskinlige kadar büyümeye devam etmesi icin bir agaclik alana aktarilmalidir.

english: You can put up to ten potatoes, cabbages or onions in vegetable sacks, although you can't have a mix in the same sack.
translation: Sebze cuvallarina en fazla on patates, lahana veya sogan koyabilirsiniz, ancak ayni cuvalda farkli ürünleri karistiramazsiniz.

english: You can buy all the farming tools from farming shops, which can be found close to the allotments.
translation: Tüm tarim aletlerini, tarim dükkanlarindan satin alabilirsiniz. Bu dükkanlar, tarim arazilerinin yakininda bulunur.

english: Bittercap mushrooms can only be grown in a special patch in Morytania, near the Mort Myre swamp. There the ground is especially dank and suited to growing poisonous fungii.
translation: Bittercap mantarlari, Morytania'da Mort Myre batakliginin yakinindaki özel bir alanda yetistirilebilir. Orada toprak özellikle nemlidir ve zehirli mantarlarin yetismesine uygundur.

english: Supercompost is far better than normal compost, but more expensive to make. You need to rot the right type of item; show me an item, and I'll tell you if it's super- compostable or not.
translation: Süper kompost normal komposttan cok daha iyidir, ancak yapimi daha pahalidir. Dogru türdeki ögeyi cürütebilmeniz gerekir; bana bir ögeyi gösterin, süper kompostlanabilir olup olmadigini size söyleyeyim.

english: There is a special patch for growing Belladonna - I believe that it is somewhere near Draynor Manor, where the ground is a tad 'unblessed'.
translation: Belladonna yetistirmek icin özel bir alan vardir - sanirim Draynor Malikanesi yakinlarinda, topragin biraz ‘kutsanmamis’ oldugu bir yerde.

english: Applying compost to a patch will not only reduce the chance that your crops will get diseased, but you will also grow more crops to harvest.
translation: Bir alana kompost uygulamak, mahsulünüzün hastalanma olasiligini azaltmakla kalmaz, ayni zamanda hasat edeceginiz mahsul miktarini da artirir.

english: If you want to grow fruit trees you could try a few places: Catherby, Brimhaven, Gnome Stronghold and the Farming Guild all have fruit tree patches.
translation: Meyve agaclari yetistirmek istiyorsaniz birkac yeri deneyebilirsiniz: Catherby, Brimhaven, Gnome Stronghold ve Farming Guild'de meyve agaclari yetistirilen alanlar vardir.

english: You can fill plantpots with soil from any empty patch, if you have a gardening trowel.
translation: Bahce küreginiz varsa, bos bir alandan aldiginiz toprakla saksilari doldurabilirsiniz.

english: Hops are good for brewing ales. I believe there's a brewery up in Keldagrim somewhere, and I've heard rumours that a place called Phasmatys used to be good for that type of thing. 'Fore they all died, of course.
translation: Serbetciotu, bira yapiminda kullanilir. Keldagrim'de bir bira fabrikasi oldugunu saniyorum ve Phasmatys adli bir yerin eskiden bu tür seyler icin uygun oldugu söylentileri duydum. Tabii ki hepsi ölmeden önce.

english: Vegetables, hops and flowers need constant watering - if you ignore my advice, you will sooner or later find yourself in possession of a dead farming patch.
translation: Sebzeler, serbetciotu ve cicekler sürekli sulanmalidir. Tavsiyemi dikkate almazsaniz, er ya da gec kendinizi ölü bir tarim arazisiyle karsi karsiya bulursunuz.

english: You can put up to five tomatoes, strawberries, apples, bananas or oranges into a fruit basket, although you can't have a mix in the same basket.
translation: Meyve sepetine en fazla bes domates, cilek, elma, muz veya portakal koyabilirsiniz, ancak ayni sepete farkli meyveleri karistiramazsiniz.

english: Don't just throw away your weeds after you've raked a patch - put them in a compost bin and make some compost.
translation: Arazinizi tirmikladiktan sonra yabani otlari cöpe atmayin, kompost kutusuna koyun ve kompost yapin.

english: There are five other Farming areas like this one - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius and Alan's area in the Farming Guild.
translation: Bunun gibi bes tane daha tarim alani vardir - Falador yakinlarindaki Elstan'in alani, Catherby yakinlarindaki Dantaera'nin alani, Morytania'daki Lyra'nin alani, Hosidius'daki Marisi'nin alani ve Tarim Loncasi'ndaki Alan'in alani.

english: There are fiveother Farming areas like this one - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius, Alan's area in the Farming Guild and Oswallt's
