translation: Bunun gibi bes tane daha tarim alani vardir: Falador yakinlarindaki Elstan'in alani, Catherby yakinlarindaki Dantaera'nin alani, Morytania'daki Lyra'nin alani, Hosidius'daki Marisi'nin alani, Tarim Loncasi'ndaki Alan'in alani ve Prifddinas'daki Oswallt'in

english: area in Prifddinas.
If you want to make your own sacks and baskets you'll need to use the loom that's near the Farming shop in Falador. If you're a good enough [craftsman/craftswoman], that is.
translation: Kendi cuvallarinizi ve sepetlerinizi yapmak istiyorsaniz, Falador'daki Tarim dükkaninin yakinindaki dokuma tezgahini kullanmaniz gerekir. Tabii yeterince iyi bir [zanaatkar]saniz.

english: You don't have to buy all your plantpots you know, you can make them yourself on a pottery wheel. If you're a good enough [craftsman/craftswoman], that is.
translation: Tüm saksilarinizi satin almaniz gerekmez, cömlek carkinda kendiniz yapabilirsiniz. Tabii yeterince iyi bir [zanaatkar]saniz.

english: Can you sell me something?
That depends on whether I have it to sell. What is it that you're looking for?
translation: Satacak bir seyim olup olmadigina bagli. Ne ariyorsun?

english: Some plant cure.
Plant cure, eh? I might have some put aside for myself. Tell you what, I'll sell you some plant cure for 25 coins if you like.
translation: Bitki ilaci, ha? Kendim icin bir miktar ayirmis olabilirim. Bak ne diyecegim, istersen sana 25 sikkeye bitki ilaci satarim.

english: I don't have enough money for that, I'm afraid.
translation: Korkarim bunun icin yeterli param yok.

english: Actually, I don't think I'd be able to carry it.
Yes, that sounds like a fair price.
translation: Evet, bu makul bir fiyat gibi görünüyor.

english: No thanks, I can get that much cheaper elsewhere.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, baska bir yerde daha ucuza bulabilirim.

english: A bucket of compost.
A bucket of compost, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 35 coins if you like.
translation: Bir kova kompost, ha? Yedek bir tane olabilir... Bak ne diyecegim, istersen sana 35 sikkeye satarim.

english: A rake.
A rake, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: Tirmik, ha? Yedek bir tane olabilir... Bak ne diyecegim, istersen 15 sikkeye satarim.

english: A plant pot.
Eh, I suppose I can spare you a plant pot, but I'll want 40 coins for it.
translation: Eh, sanirim sana bir saksi verebilirim, ama 40 sikke istiyorum.

english: A watering can.
A watering can, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 25 coins if you like.
translation: Bir sulama kabi, ha? Yedek bir tane olabilir... Bak ne diyecegim, istersen 25 sikkeye satarim.

english: A gardening trowel.
A gardening trowel, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: Bir bahce küregi, ha? Yedek bir tane olabilir... Bak ne diyecegim, istersen 15 sikkeye satarim.

english: A seed dibber.
A seed dibber, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: Bir tohum ekme cubugu, ha? Yedek bir tane olabilir... Bak ne diyecegim, istersen 15 sikkeye satarim.

english: Forget it, you don't have anything I need.
translation: Bos ver, ihtiyacim olan hicbir seyin yok.

english: I'll come back another time.
I'm already looking after that patch for you.
translation: O bahceyi zaten senin icin bakiyorum.

english: I want 2 buckets of compost for that.
I want one sack of potatoes for that.
translation: Bunun icin bir cuval patates istiyorum.

english: I want one sack of onions for that.
translation: Bunun icin bir cuval sogan istiyorum.

english: I want 2 sacks of cabbages for that.
I want 10 jute fibres for that.
I want one basket of apples for that.
translation: Bunun icin bir sepet elma istiyorum.

english: I want 10 curry leaves for that.
I want 5 jangerberries for that.
That looks like something that you can make normal compost out of. Fill up the compost bin with stuff like that, and you'll eventually have a bin full of compost.
translation: Bu normal kompost yapabilecegin bir seye benziyor. Kompost kutusunu bu tür seylerle doldurursan, sonunda kompostla dolu bir kutu elde edersin.

english: That looks like something that you can make supercompost out of. Fill up the compost bin with stuff like that, and you'll eventually have a bin full of supercompost.
translation: Bu, süper kompost yapabilecegin bir seye benziyor. Kompost kutusunu bu tür seylerle doldurursan, sonunda süper kompostla dolu bir kutu elde edersin.

english: Do you have any snowdrop seeds to spare?
No I don't, as it happens. Sorry.
But I was told that you did!
Well, you were told wrong then!
translation: O zaman sana yanlis bilgi vermisler!

english: Goodbye!!
You seem to be a little irritable, my friend.
Oh, you think so?!? And what concern is it of yours?
translation: Öyle mi düsünüyorsun?!? Bu seni ne ilgilendirir ki?

english: I'm not concerned, I just want you to give me some snowdrop seeds.
translation: Umursamiyorum, sadece bana kardelen tohumlari vermeni istiyorum.

english: Is that right?!? Well, I do actually have some snowdrop seeds, but you would be the last person I would give them to.
translation: Öyle mi?!? Aslinda kardelen tohumlarim var, ama onlari verecegim son kisi sensin.

english: I don't like to see a fellow human being so upset.
translation: Bir insanin bu kadar üzülmesini görmek istemiyorum.

english: I must say, you don't often meet people who show concern the way you have done.
translation: Sizin gibi endiselenen insanlarla pek sik karsilasilmaz.

english: I can't take it anymore - just give me the seeds.
And to think I listened to you! I was right after all - there is no kindness between human beings anymore.
translation: Sizi dinledigime inanamiyorum! Sonucta hakliymisim, insanlar arasinda artik nezaket kalmamis.

english: So what ails you, my friend?
All these people, asking me to look after their crops! And no-one ever asking me how I feel, or if there's something they can do for me!
translation: Bütün bu insanlar, bana ekinlerine bakmami istiyorlar! Ve kimse bana nasil hissettigimi ya da benim icin yapabilecekleri bir sey olup olmadigini sormuyor!

english: Oh stop whining, it's not like you do it for free.
translation: Sizlanmayi kes, bunu bedavaya yapmiyorsun ki.

english: Well, is there anything I can do for you?
translation: Peki, senin icin yapabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Oh, that's very kind of you! And there I was, thinking of giving it all up and heading off across the seas to find my fortune!
translation: Oh, cok naziksin! Ben de her seyi birakip denizlere acilip sansimi deneyecektim!

english: Don't let me stop you, there are plenty of ships missing cabin boys.
translation: Seni engellemeyecegim, bircok gemide kabin cocugu araniyor.

english: If you carry on speaking to me like that I might just put this spade to good use, and I'm not talking about digging!
translation: Bana böyle konusmaya devam edersen, bu küregi iyi bir sekilde kullanabilirim, ve kazmaktan bahsetmiyorum!

english: So what can I do for you?
I'd like just for once for somebody to grow something for me. Just something simple; some vegetables would be nice.
translation: Bir kez olsun birinin benim icin bir seyler yetistirmesini istiyorum. Basit bir sey; sebze falan iyi olur.

english: How about some potatoes?
Nah, there's a whole field of them over to the west. I don't have any particular use for onions, so how about cabbages, then?
translation: Hayir, batida bir tarlada bolca var. Sogani pek kullanmam, o zaman lahana nasil olur?

english: Cabbages? Sounds good to me. Where do you want me to grow them?
translation: Lahana mi? Bana uyar. Nerede yetistirmemi istersin?

english: Oh, in one of these allotments here. Plant them from seed, and when they're ready for harvesting let me know, I'll give you your seeds.
translation: Buradaki bahcelerden birinde. Tohumdan yetistir, hasat zamani geldiginde bana haber ver, tohumlarini vereyim.

english: That's a deal - I'll let you know when your cabbages are ready.
translation: Anlastik, lahanalarin hazir oldugunda sana haber veririm.

english: I'm not wasting my time growing cabbages.
And I'm not wasting my seeds on an upstart like you!
translation: Ben de tohumlarimi senin gibi bir sonradan görme icin bosa harcamayacagim!

english: Aarrrrrghhhh! I hate cabbages!!!! Give me the seeds!!!!!
translation: Aarrrrrghhhh! Lahanalardan nefret ediyorum!!!! Tohumlari ver bana!!!!!

english: Give ... you ... the ...
... yes I should ...
... no I won't ...
Not after speaking to me like that you upstart!!! Is it a deal or not?!?
translation: Bana böyle konustuktan sonra olmaz, seni sonradan görme!!! Anlastik mi, anlasmadik mi?!?

english: What did you ask me to do?
You said that you would grow me some cabbages in one of these allotments. When they're ready for harvest come and talk to me, and I'll give you those snowdrop seeds that you're after.
translation: Bu bahcelerden birinde benim icin lahana yetistirecegini söyledin. Hasat zamani geldiginde bana haber ver, istedigin kardelen tohumlarini sana verecegim.

english: I can't believe you're asking me to do that! I asked you to grow some cabbages for me, not for me to look after them for you! No, I won't look after them!
translation: Benden bunu istedigine inanamiyorum! Senden benim icin lahana yetistirmeni istedim, senin icin onlara bakmami degil! Hayir, onlara bakmayacagim!

english: Okay, I've grown those cabbages like you asked.
Yes, I saw - what fine farming prowess! Nobody has ever done anything like that for me before; here you go, these are the seeds you were after I believe.
translation: Evet, gördüm - ne kadar da iyi bir ciftcilik becerisi! Daha önce kimse benim icin böyle bir sey yapmamisti; al bakalim, bunlar istedigin tohumlar sanirim.

english: I would give you some, but you don't appear to have room to carry them.
translation: Sana biraz verirdim ama tasimak icin yerin yok gibi görünüyor.

english: Yes, here you go - I hope they grow for you.
translation: Evet, al bakalim - umarim senin icin büyürler.

english: Are you a member of the Group of Advanced Gardeners?
translation: Ileri Düzey Bahcivanlar Grubu'nun üyesi misin?

english: Why, yes I am. Why do you ask?
Martin has asked me to investigate why all the crops are failing.
translation: Martin, tüm mahsullerin neden bozuldugunu arastirmami istedi.

english: I've already told you everything I suspect.
translation: Süphelendigim her seyi sana anlattim zaten.

english: Ah, Martin sent you, why didn't you say so? I personally think that our problems are all down to the fact that we haven't had enough rain of late. It's plain to see - just look at the levels of the rivers.
translation: Ah, Martin seni göndermis, neden söylemedin? Sahsen, sorunlarimizin hepsinin son zamanlarda yeterince yagmur yagmamasi nedeniyle oldugunu düsünüyorum. Bu cok acik, nehirlerin seviyelerine bakman yeterli.

english: We need more rain. I don't suppose you can do anything about that?
translation: Daha fazla yagmura ihtiyacimiz var. Bu konuda bir sey yapamazsin herhalde?

english: No, I'm afraid not.
Well there you go then. Until you find out how to make it rain you're going to have a hard time solving our problems.
translation: Iste böyle. Yagmur yagdirmanin yolunu bulana kadar sorunlarimizi cözmek zor olacak.

english: Insects! That's what you can tell him! Insects! Stop the insects from eating so many of our crops and we'd get maximum yield, I tell you!
translation: Böcekler! Ona bunu söyle! Böcekler! Böceklerin mahsullerimizi yemesini engelle, o zaman maksimum verim elde ederiz, inan bana!

english: How can you ask such a thing? It's obvious! It's all you adventurers. Every time I get a crop planted, some adventurer comes along and digs it up and plants crops of their own, as if they owned my farming patch!
translation: Nasil böyle bir sey sorarsin? Cok acik! Hepiniz maceracilarsiniz. Ne zaman ekim yapsam, bir maceraci gelip ekimimi söküp kendi ekimini yapiyor, sanki benim tarla benimmis gibi!

english: It's really annoying! You should speak to your friends about their rude behaviour!
translation: Bu cok sinir bozucu! Arkadaslarina bu kaba davranislari hakkinda konusmalisin!

english: But...but...they're not my friends! I've never even spoken to most of them!
translation: Ama... ama... onlar benim arkadasim degil! Coguyla hic konusmadim bile!

english: Don't give me that! You're an adventurer, they're all adventurers. I bet you have some sort of secret guild and you gather there and say things like 'let's annoy the gardeners this week', don't you?
translation: Bana bunu söyleme! Sen bir maceracisin, onlar da maceraci. Eminim gizli bir loncaya üyesin ve orada toplanip “bu hafta bahcivanlari rahatsiz edelim” gibi seyler söylüyorsunuz, degil mi?

english: No, I mean yes. There is a heroes guild, but ...!
translation: Hayir, yani evet. Kahramanlar loncasi var, ama...!

english: Aha, so you admit it then! You should be ashamed of yourselves!
translation: Aha, yani itiraf ediyorsun! Kendinizden utanmalisiniz!

english: Oh, I give up!
Well obviously it's the seasons. They all seem to be out- of-wack these days. Summer comes earlier and earlier each year, but then it simply rushes by!
translation: Acikcasi mevsimler. Son zamanlarda hepsi dengesiz görünüyor. Yaz her yil daha erken geliyor, ama sonra bir anda gecip gidiyor!

english: If you find out what is upsetting the seasons you'll find out what is causing the harvest to fail.
translation: Mevsimleri bozan seyi bulursan, hasadin kötü olmasinin nedenini de bulursun.

english: I don't suppose you have any ideas about what could cause the seasons to be mixed up?
translation: Mevsimlerin karismasina neyin sebep olabilecegi hakkinda bir fikrin var mi?

english: No, sorry, but find that out and you'll get to the root of our problems.
translation: Hayir, üzgünüm, ama bunu bulursaniz sorunlarimizin kaynagina ulasirsiniz.

english: Well I can tell by the look on your face that I'm not the first person you've asked. Why don't you tell me what you've heard from other members of the group so far?
translation: Yüzünüzden, bunu ilk kez bana sormadiginizi anlayabiliyorum. Neden bana grubun diger üyelerinden simdiye kadar ne duydugunuzu anlatmiyorsunuz?

english: Why not? They all seem to be a bunch of loonies anyway.
translation: Neden mi? Zaten hepsi bir grup deli gibi görünüyor.

english: I've been told that it's the lack of rain, plagues of insects and recently I was told that the entire order of seasons is confused!
translation: Yagmur eksikligi, böcek istilasi ve son zamanlarda mevsimlerin sirasinin tamamen karistigi söylendi!

english: I have no idea what to do about any of it. I'm an adventurer, not a weather controller!
translation: Bunlarla ilgili ne yapacagimi bilmiyorum. Ben bir maceraciyim, hava durumu kontrolörü degil!

english: Did you ever consider that all those theories might be correct?
translation: Tüm bu teorilerin dogru olabilecegini hic düsündün mü?

english: But they're all different, how could they all be correct?
translation: Ama hepsi farkli, nasil hepsi dogru olabilir?

english: I'll let you into a little secret that'll explain it all to you. In a word - fairies!
translation: Sana her seyi aciklayacak kücük bir sir verecegim. Tek kelimeyle: periler!

english: Oh no! Not another crack-pot theory!
translation: Olamaz! Yine sacma bir teori mi?

english: I'm serious!
Think it through. There are fairies who control everything natural from the weather to the seasons.
translation: Bir düsün. Hava durumundan mevsimlere kadar dogadaki her seyi kontrol eden periler var.

english: Surely if all of those things have been mentioned as catalysts to our problems it stands to reason that the fairies are actually the cause?
translation: Tüm bu seyler sorunlarimizin katalizörü olarak bahsediliyorsa, perilerin aslinda sorunun kaynagi oldugu mantikli degil mi?

english: Right, well thanks for your input. I'll think over what you said.
translation: Tamam, görüslerin icin tesekkürler. Söylediklerini düsünecegim.

english: I don't think the crops ARE failing, now leave me alone, I have work to do.
translation: Mahsullerin bozuldugunu sanmiyorum, simdi beni rahat birak, isim var.

english: Hello. Could you help me with a quest, please?
translation: Merhaba. Bir görevde bana yardim eder misin lütfen?

english: Yes, certainly. I'll help if I can. Which quest would you like help with?
translation: Evet, tabii ki. Elimden geleni yaparim. Hangi görevde yardim isterdin?

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
The northern allotment
Okay, it's a deal.
No, that's too much.
The southern allotment
Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: Bana tarimla ilgili tavsiyelerde bulunabilir misiniz?

english: Can you sell me something?
Some plant cure.
Yes, that sounds like a fair price.
translation: Evet, bu makul bir fiyat gibi görünüyor.

english: No thanks, I can get that much cheaper elsewhere.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, baska bir yerde daha ucuza bulabilirim.

A rake.

english: Well, normally, I can fix it so that you respawn in Edgeville whenever you die. However, I don't seem to be able to do so right now...

translation: Tek seferlik 5 milyon coin ödeme istiyorum. Daha sonra yeniden dogma yerini degistirirsen ve sonra Edgeville'e geri döndürmemi istersen, sana tekrar fatura kesmeyecegim.

No, I kill you!
UUUHRG! Now I kill you!
How are you going to do that? You're just a head on a wall!
translation: Bunu nasil yapacaksin? Sen sadece duvardaki bir kafasin!

english: Uhhhhrrr...
Why are you so violent?
You kill me! Uuurgh! That make me angry!
translation: Sen beni öldürdün! Uuurgh! Bu beni kizdirdi!

english: You seemed pretty angry before I killed you!
translation: Seni öldürmeden önce de oldukca kizgin görünüyordun!

english: I like angry!
I'm sorry I killed you.
I hate sorry! Makes me more angry! WANT TO KILL YOU!
translation: Üzgün olmaktan nefret ediyorum! Beni daha da kizdiriyor! SENI ÖLDÜRMEK ISTIYORUM!

english: Please try to calm down!
Hate calm! Smash it! Hur hur hur!
translation: Sakin olmaktan nefret ediyorum! Parcala onu! Hur hur hur!

english: I'm not really sorry!
That make me more angry! Uuuurgh!
translation: Bu beni daha da sinirlendiriyor! Uuuurgh!

english: Is there anything that doesn't make you angry?
translation: Seni sinirlendirmeyen bir sey var mi?

english: No! I like angry! Hur hur hur!
translation: Hayir! Sinirlenmeyi seviyorum! Hur hur hur!

english: I killed you really easily!
Yeah! I could kill you again in my sleep! I think I might go off and kill some other kurask!
translation: Evet! Uykumda bile seni tekrar öldürebilirim! Sanirim gidip baska kurasklar da öldürecegim!

english: Uuuurrrrh! Hate you!
What are you going to do about it? Eh? I totally owned you!
translation: Ne yapacaksin? Eh? Seni tamamen yendim!

english: Hate you hate you hate you!!!
translation: Senden nefret ediyorum, senden nefret ediyorum, senden nefret ediyorum!!!

english: What do you think about up there?
Think?
You know, what goes through your tiny stuffed head?
translation: Kücük doldurulmus kafandan neler geciyor biliyor musun?

english: Little bugs...
You have bugs living in you? Eww!
Little bugs! Stomp and crush and stomp!
Yeah! Stomp the bugs!
Stomp crush splat!
Smash! Destroy! Crunch break tear destroy splunch! Hurt wound kill hit punch stab slash kill!
translation: Parcalayin! Yok edin! Ezip gecin, parcalayin, yok edin, parcalayin! Yaralayin, öldürün, vurun, yumruklayin, bicaklayin, öldürün!

english: 'Splunch'? That is not a word!
I HATE WORDS! Kill all words!
translation: KELIMELERI NEFRET EDIYORUM! Bütün kelimeleri öldürün!

english: You said 'kill' twice!
I like kill! Hur hur hur hur!
translation: Öldürmeyi seviyorum! Hur hur hur hur!

english: Yeah! Kill smash destroy!
Kill smash destroy! Hur hur hur!
translation: Öldürün, parcalayin, yok edin! Hur hur hur!

english: What have the bugs done to you?
Skitter skitter through head noise in ears behind eyes.
translation: Kafamin icinde, kulaklarimda, gözlerimin arkasinda vizildiyorlar.

english: HATE THEM! Kill kill kill!
translation: Onlardan nefret ediyorum! Öldür, öldür, öldür!

english: You can't, you've got no feet!
No feet...
Hate lack of feet! Stomp lack of feet! Kill crush destroy smash!
translation: Ayaklarimin olmamasindan nefret ediyorum! Ayaklarimin olmamasini ezip geciyorum! Öldür, ez, yok et, parcala!

english: That makes no sense! You can't destroy the absence of something!
translation: Bu mantiksiz! Yok olan bir seyi yok edemezsin!

english: Hate requirement to make sense! Smash it kill it destroy kill kill!
translation: Mantikli olma zorunlulugundan nefret ediyorum! Parcala, öldür, yok et, öldür, öldür!

english: You can't physically destroy an abstract concept! It's impossible!
translation: Soyut bir kavrami fiziksel olarak yok edemezsin! Bu imkansiz!

english: Hate abstract concepts! Hate impossible! Kill kill kill destroy smash!
translation: Soyut kavramlardan nefret ediyorum! Imkansizliktan nefret ediyorum! Öldür, öldür, yok et, parcala!

english: This is getting both surreal and repetitive.
translation: Bu hem gerceküstü hem de tekrarlayici hale geliyor.

english: Why are you so violent?
You seemed pretty angry before I killed you
translation: Seni öldürmeden önce oldukca kizgin görünüyordun.

english: I'm sorry I killed you
Please try to calm down
I'm not really sorry
I killed you really easily!
What do you think about up there?
Yeah! Stomp the bugs!
'Splunch'? That's not a word!
You said 'kill' twice
Yeah! Kill smash destroy!
What have the bugs done to you?
You can't, you've got no feet!
Hello.
Not infected are you?
I don't think so.
You don't seem very sure. We don't want any infected near the children. Be off with you!
translation: Cok emin görünmüyorsun. Cocuklarin yaninda enfekte olanlar istemiyoruz. Defol git!

english: Whatever it is you're selling, we ain't interested!
But I'm not...
Did you not hear me? Clear off!
Strewth! Nippy little blighters!
Excuse me?
Oh G'day! Sorry, didn't see you there!
That's okay. What seems to be the problem?

Oh, well I wanted to catch some minnows so I could use 'em as bait, but the little blighters are just too quick! I managed to get 'em all rounded up over on my fishing platform, but I still can't catch 'em!
translation: Oh, sey, yem olarak kullanmak icin birkac minnow yakalamak istedim, ama o kücük canavarlar cok hizli! Onlari balikcilik platformumda topladim, ama yine de yakalayamiyorum!

english: Then, to make things worse, any time I do finally catch some, those bloody flying fish jump out at me and gobble up me minnows!
translation: Sonra, isleri daha da kötülestirmek icin, nihayet birkacini yakaladigimda, o lanet olasi ucan baliklar üzerime atlayip minnow'larimi yiyorlar!

english: What I need is someone who can catch 'em for me!
Well, maybe I could help out?

Well I don't know. I don't want to be letting just anyone onto me fishing platform! But I guess if you could show me that you are a worthy fisher than that would be okay. I can even give you shark in exchange
translation: Bilemiyorum. Balik tutma platformuma öyle herkesin girmesini istemem! Ama bana iyi bir balikci oldugunu kanitlayabilirsen sorun olmaz. Yakaladigin minnowlar karsiliginda sana köpekbaligi bile verebilirim,

english: for the minnows you catch, 'cos them I can catch no problem!
Sounds fair. What can I do to show that I am worthy?
translation: Kulaga adil geliyor. Degerli oldugumu göstermek icin ne yapabilirim?

english: Well you should be very experienced in the art of fishing, own the proper attire, and be recognised by your peers as a great fisherman.
translation: Balikcilik sanatinda cok deneyimli olmalisin, uygun kiyafetlere sahip olmalisin ve meslektaslarin tarafindan harika bir balikci olarak taninmalisin.

english: You must have level 82 Fishing, be wearing the complete Angler's outfit and have completed Fishing Contest in order to suitably impress Kylie.
translation: Kylie'yi uygun sekilde etkilemek icin 82 seviye Balikcilik seviyesine sahip olmali, tam Balikci kiyafeti giymeli ve Balikcilik Yarismasini tamamlamis olmalisin.

english: So, how about letting me out onto your fishing platform?
translation: Peki, beni balikcilik platformuna cikarmaya ne dersin?

english: Sorry, but I just don't think you are experienced enough.
translation: Üzgünüm, ama bence yeterince deneyimli degilsin.

english: G'day, only the best fishers are allowed onto the fishing platform. You need a fishing level of 82.
translation: Merhaba, sadece en iyi balikcilar balikcilik platformuna girebilir. 82. seviye balikcilik becerisine sahip olmalisin.

english: I don't think I have given you access to my fishing platform. Come and speak to me if you would like to get access.
translation: Sana balikcilik platformuma erisim izni verdigimi sanmiyorum. Erisim izni almak istiyorsan gelip benimle konus.

english: Please, stop this, just let me go!
We're going to play a game. Do you like to play games?
translation: Bir oyun oynayacagiz. Oyun oynamayi sever misin?

english: No...yes....whatever you say, just don't hurt me!
translation: Hayir... evet... ne derseniz deyin, sadece bana zarar vermeyin!

english: Whether you get hurt or not is entirely up to you. Your fate is in your own hands.
translation: Zarar görüp görmeyeceginiz tamamen size bagli. Kaderiniz kendi ellerinizde.

english: What!? What do you mean!?
Leave her alone you monster!
Ah, [player name], how kind of you to join us. Now if you say another word, I will end her right now!
translation: Ah, Maceraci, bize katildiginiz icin cok naziksiniz. Simdi, bir kelime daha ederseniz, onu hemen öldürürüm!

english: Sorry, where were we? Ah yes, of course! The game!
translation: Pardon, nerede kalmistik? Ah evet, tabii ki! Oyun!

english: Do you like quests, Lacey?
Ummm, sure, I like quests.
Do you like scary quests?
Uh-huh.
What's your favourite scary quest?
I don't know.
You have to have a favourite.
Umm.....the one with that vampyre in it who lives in a big house.
translation: Umm.....büyük bir evde yasayan vampir olan görev.

english: Good, good. And now for that game I spoke about.
translation: Güzel, güzel. Simdi de bahsettigim oyuna gecelim.

english: I am going to ask you one question. Get it wrong and you die, but get it right and you live.
translation: Sana bir soru soracagim. Yanlis cevap verirsen ölürsün, dogru cevap verirsen yasarsin.

english: Oh Guthix please no, please don't, I don't want to die!
translation: Oh Guthix lütfen hayir, lütfen yapma, ölmek istemiyorum!

english: Then think hard about your answer. You like vampyres so this should be easy for you. The question is this...
translation: O zaman cevabini iyi düsün. Vampirleri seviyorsun, bu yüzden senin icin kolay olmali. Soru su...

english: Who is the Vampyre that resides in South Misthalin?
Urm...
Count Draynor!
Count Check!
Lord Drakan!
This game didn't involve you [player name]! Now her death is on you! Her blood is on your hands you fool!
translation: Bu oyun seni ilgilendirmiyordu Maceraci! Simdi onun ölümü senin sucun! Onun kani senin ellerinde, seni aptal!

english: The killer stabs Lacey.
Gargle...urgh...
Oh yes, yes, I know it! Count Draynor!
Ha, in your face you masked freak!
translation: Ha, yüzüne karsi söylüyorum, maskeli ucube!

english: Oh Lacey, Lacey, Lacey. I did tell you to think hard about your answer.
translation: Oh Lacey, Lacey, Lacey. Cevabini iyi düsünmeni söylemistim.

english: Count Draynor is in fact a vampyre, and he does reside in his manor in Misthalin.
translation: Kont Draynor aslinda bir vampirdir ve Misthalin'deki malikanesinde yasar.

english: But that manor is in WEST Misthalin! I was talking about Count Check! Thanks for playing!
translation: Ama o malikane BATI Misthalin'dedir! Ben Kont Check'ten bahsediyordum! Oynadigin icin tesekkürler!

english: No, no you tricked me! This isn't fair, ask me another...
translation: Hayir, hayir, beni kandirdin! Bu adil degil, baska bir soru sor...

english: Lacey dies.
The killer slips a note through the fence, and walks away.
translation: Katil citin arasindan bir not uzatir ve uzaklasir.

english: That monster! I have to stop them! Let's see what that new note says.
translation: O canavar! Onlari durdurmaliyim! Bakalim yeni notta ne yaziyor.

english: Count Draynor
Count Check
Lord Drakan
Say nothing
Seren be with you friend.
Hey there, how are things?
At long last we are back in our city, our home. Here in the light of Seren, we can properly continue our path to enlightenment.
translation: Sonunda sehrimize, evimize geri döndük. Burada, Seren'in isiginda, aydinlanma yolumuza düzgün bir sekilde devam edebiliriz.

english: How do you do that?
We cleanse our minds in prayer, and hone our bodies through agility. You can join us if you like. Feel free to reflect at our altar, or take to the roofs on our agility course.
translation: Dua ederek zihnimizi arindiriyor ve ceviklikle bedenlerimizi gelistiriyoruz. Istersen bize katilabilirsin. Altarimizda meditasyon yapabilir veya ceviklik parkurumuzda catilara cikabilirsin.

english: I might just do that, thanks.
Good to see you again [Player name]. Have you come to marvel at the beauty of Prifddinas?
translation: Seni tekrar görmek güzel Maceraci. Prifddinas'in güzelligine hayran olmak icin mi geldin?

english: It's definietlya sight to behold.
Indeed it is. I love exploring, seeking out the hidden secrets of this world. But nothing will ever compare to this place, to our home.
translation: Gercekten öyle. Bu dünyanin gizli sirlarini kesfetmeyi, arastirmayi seviyorum. Ama hicbir sey burayla, evimizle kiyaslanamaz.

english: I'm very privileged to be able to see it.
And we are very privileged to have you here.
translation: Ve biz de seni burada agirlayabildigimiz icin cok sansliyiz.

english: Who are you? Why are you in my home?
I'm [Vampyre name]. I was just looking around.
You half-breeds are becoming too arrogant for your own good. If you're not careful, someone might call for a good culling. Now get out of my house!
translation: Siz melezler, kendi iyiliginiz icin fazla kibirli olmaya basladiniz. Dikkatli olmazsaniz, biri iyi bir katliam cagrisi yapabilir. Simdi evimden cikin!

english: Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: Insan! Muhafizlari cagirmadan köle kafeslerine geri dön!

english: What do you want?
Tell me about the Saviours of Kourend.

For many years I used my position to fight against the crime and corruption in this city. No matter what I did it was never enough though. I realised that to defeat my enemies I needed to act as they do.
translation: Yillarca konumumu bu sehirdeki suc ve yolsuzlukla mücadele etmek icin kullandim. Ne yaparsam yapayim, hicbir zaman yeterli olmadi. Düsmanlarimi yenmek icin onlarin gibi davranmam gerektigini anladim.

english: That's why I formed the Saviours of Kourend. We take the laws into our own hands and fight against all who would damage this city, no matter who they are.
translation: Bu yüzden Kourend'in Kurtaricilari'ni kurdum. Kanunlari kendi ellerimize aliyoruz ve bu sehre zarar veren herkese, kim olursa olsun, karsi koyuyoruz.

english: What else do you want?
Tell me about Port Piscarilius.
You've been here how long? You should know what we do by now.
translation: Ne zamandir buradasin? Simdiye kadar ne yaptigimizi ögrenmis olmalisin.

english: Port Piscarilius is home to Kourend's fishermen and traders. We are the first port of call for any visitors to Kourend which means Port Piscarilius is home to a wide variety of individuals.
translation: Port Piscarilius, Kourend'in balikcilarinin ve tüccarlarinin evidir. Kourend'e gelen ziyaretcilerin ilk ugradigi liman biziz, bu da Port Piscarilius'un cok cesitli insanlara ev sahipligi yaptigi anlamina geliyor.

english: All people and goods coming to or from Kourend go through Port Piscarilius. This unfortunatly means that we are a centre point for the majority of crime within the city.
translation: Kourend'e gelen veya Kourend'den giden tüm insanlar ve mallar Port Piscarilius'tan gecer. Bu maalesef, sehrin icindeki suclarin cogunun merkezi oldugumuz anlamina gelir.

english: For many years I appealed to the Kourend Council for help in fighting this crime, but they cared little for us. Instead, I decided to beat them at their own game and fight fire with fire.
translation: Yillarca Kourend Konseyi'nden bu sucla mücadele etmek icin yardim istedim, ama onlar bizi pek umursamadilar. Bunun yerine, onlarin kendi oyunlarinda onlari yenmeye ve atese atesle karsilik vermeye karar verdim.

english: Tell me about your plans.
No.
Nothing.
How about you go away then?
Tell me about yourself.
Tell me about the Saviours of Kourend.
Tell me about Port Piscarilius.
Tell me about your plans.
Nothing.
Hi there.
Good to see you [player name]. You're very brave to come see me.
translation: Seni görmek ne güzel Maceraci. Beni görmeye gelmekle cok cesur davranmissin.

english: How come?
Most of the elves around here give me a wide berth. They seem to find me intimidating. How ironic that an old woman is more of a threat to them than the entire Iorwerth clan.
translation: Buradaki elflerin cogu benden uzak durur. Beni korkutucu buluyorlar. Yasli bir kadinin, tüm Iorwerth klanindan daha büyük bir tehdit olmasi ne kadar ironik.

english: You must have seen a fair bit in your time.
Oh yes, I'm the oldest elf still alive. You can thank this exoskeleton for that, one of our finer inventions.
translation: Evet, hayatta olan en yasli elf benim. Bunun icin bu dis iskelete tesekkür edebilirsin, en iyi icatlarimizdan biri.

english: You must have plenty of stories to tell.
Yes, but not the time to tell them. They have plenty of books in the Tower of Voices if you want stories, most of them are from our Grand Library.
translation: Evet, ama anlatacak zamanim yok. Hikayeler istiyorsan Sesler Kulesi'nde bircok kitap var, cogu Büyük Kütüphanemizden.

english: I'd personally recommend the one about Zalcano, a fun tale about how we trapped her beneath the city. She's still here now in fact, feel free to go give her a poke.
translation: Ben sahsen Zalcano hakkindaki kitabi tavsiye ederim, onu sehrin altina nasil hapsettigimizi anlatan eglenceli bir hikaye. Aslinda o hala burada, istersen gidip ona bir bakabilirsin.

english: I'll see about paying her a visit. See you later.
...and he says that it's of the greatest urgency.
Greatest urgency? I don't like urgency. This is quite simply not on.
translation: Cok acil mi? Acil durumlari sevmem. Bu hic de hos degil.

english: Hiya!
Who is this human Councillor Unkar? What are they doing here?
translation: Bu insan Konsey Üyesi Unkar kim? Burada ne ariyor?

english: I'm afraid I don't know.
Oh. Could you make them go away?
Sorry human. We're currently engaging in important official business. You'll need to come back another time.
translation: Üzgünüm insan. Su anda önemli resmi islerle mesgulüz. Baska bir zaman gelmen gerekecek.

english: To start The Forsaken Tower you must meet these requirements:Client of Kourend20% Lovakengj Favour
translation: The Forsaken Tower'i baslatmak icin su gereksinimleri karsilamalisin: Kourend'in müsterisi %20 Lovakengj Iyiligi

english: Oh look, it's the human. Hello human.
Tell me about yourself.
Myself? Oh.
Well I'm Vulcana Lovakengj, the head of Lovakengj House. I rule the city of Lovakengj.
translation: Ben Vulcana Lovakengj, Lovakengj Hanesi'nin reisiyim. Lovakengj sehrini yönetiyorum.

english: Cool.
Anything else?
Oh... No I don't think so.
Huh, fair enough.
Tell me about Lovakengj.
Lovakengj?
Yes! I know a lot about Lovakengj!
translation: Evet! Lovakengj hakkinda cok sey biliyorum!

english: Lovakengj is a city of dwarves. It's the only non-human city in Kourend.
translation: Lovakengj cücelerin sehridir. Kourend'deki tek insan olmayan sehirdir.

english: Lovakengj is very important you know. The resources mined here are used throughout the kingdom. Weapons, armour, tools, buildings...
translation: Lovakengj cok önemlidir, biliyor musun? Burada cikarilan kaynaklar kralligin her yerinde kullanilir. Silahlar, zirhlar, aletler, binalar...

english: All sorts of things come out of Lovakengj.
Tell me about your plans.
My plans? Hmm let me see now...
Ah, I know. I'll have a sherry.
Jorra! Bring me a sherry.
Yes Lady Lovakengj.
Goodbye.
Goodbye human.
Tell me about yourself.
Tell me about Lovakengj.
Tell me about your plans.
Goodbye.
Hello there.
Clear off! Let me drink in peace!
translation: Defol! Birak da huzur icinde iceyim!

english: Okay then.
Hello, I'm Laidee. Welcome to the Warriors' Guild.
translation: Merhaba, ben Laidee. Savascilar Loncasina hos geldin.

english: What are you doing out here?
I'm here to guard the Warrior's Guild and determine who's qualified to enter.
translation: Savascilar Loncasi'ni korumak ve kimlerin girebilecegine karar vermek icin buradayim.

english: So you're Ghommal's replacement?
That I am. Ghommal and I used to adventure together before we joined the Guild. It felt only right that I take over from him. It is... strange not having him around.
translation: Evet. Ghommal ve ben Loncaya katilmadan önce birlikte maceralara atilirdik. Onun yerini almam cok dogru geldi. Onun burada olmamasi... garip.

english: I'm sorry for your loss. He was a great warrior.
translation: Kaybin icin üzgünüm. O harika bir savasciydi.

english: And an even greater friend.
translation: Ve daha da harika bir arkadasti.

english: I'm here to talk about Combat Achievements.
translation: Buraya Savas Basarilari hakkinda konusmaya geldim.

english: Could you explain what they are?
Combat Achievements are a set of tasks for all adventurers to try and accomplish. They range from simple missions to kill various creatures, to challenges that will push you to your limits.
translation: Savas Basarilari, tüm maceracilarin denemesi ve basarmasi gereken bir dizi görevdir. Bunlar, cesitli yaratiklari öldürmek gibi basit görevlerden, sinirlarini zorlayacak zorlu görevlere kadar cesitlilik gösterir.

english: The purpose of these tasks is for you to grow and improve, experience all that Gielinor has to offer, and become stronger in the process.
translation: Bu görevlerin amaci, senin gelisip iyilesmen, Gielinor'un sundugu her seyi deneyimlemen ve bu sürecte daha güclü olman.

english: Is this something that sounds interesting to you?
Yes, tell me about Combat Achievements.
translation: Evet, Savas Basarilari hakkinda bilgi verin.

english: Combat Achievements are broken down into six tiers: Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite, Master and Grandmaster.
translation: Savas Basarilari alti seviyeye ayrilir: Kolay, Orta, Zor, Elit, Usta ve Büyük Usta.

english: As you complete tasks, you'll earn points. Tasks in higher tiers give more points than easier tasks. Your rank depends on how many points you've earned.
translation: Görevleri tamamladikca puan kazanirsiniz. Daha yüksek seviyedeki görevler, daha kolay görevlerden daha fazla puan verir. Siralamaniz, kazandiginiz puanlara baglidir.

english: Whenever new tasks are added to the list, there are more points available to earn, so the threshold needed for each rank will increase. Keep completing tasks to maintain your rank!
translation: Listeye yeni görevler eklendiginde, kazanabileceginiz puanlar da artar, bu nedenle her seviye icin gereken puan esigi yükselir. Siralamanizi korumak icin görevleri tamamlamaya devam edin!

english: I'd recommend you go kill some monsters. Come back to me when you've completed a tier or two. I'll reward you for your efforts.
translation: Gidip birkac canavar öldürmenizi tavsiye ederim. Bir veya iki seviyeyi tamamladiginizda bana geri dönün. Cabalarinizi ödüllendirecegim.

english: Thanks a lot, I'll get going.
Not at the moment, no.
Could I reclaim some rewards?
Of course.
Here you go.
Thanks.
I have to go.
I'd better get going.
What are you doing out here?
I'm here to talk about Combat Achievements.
translation: Savas Basarilari hakkinda konusmak icin buradayim.

english: Could you explain what they are?
Yes, tell me about Combat Achievements.
translation: Evet, Savas Basarilari hakkinda bilgi ver.

english: Not at the moment, no.
Could I reclaim some rewards?
I have to go.
I'd better get going.
Hello there.
Bah! Puny humans always try steal Lallis' golden apples! You go away now!
translation: Bah! Zayif insanlar her zaman Lallis'in altin elmalarini calmaya calisir! Simdi git buradan!

english: Uh.... okay...
Hey human! You not put things in Lalli's food unless Lalli ask you to! It am very impolite, even for human!
translation: Hey insan! Lalli sana sormadan Lalli'nin yemegine bir sey koyma! Bu cok kaba, insan icin bile!

english: Hey human! You not go in my house! It where me keep all my stuff!
translation: Hey insan! Evime girme! Orasi tüm esyalarimi sakladigim yer!

english: Actually, I'm not after your golden apples. I was wondering if I could have some golden wool; I need it to string a lyre.
translation: Aslinda, altin elmalarinin pesinde degilim. Altin yün alabilir miyim diye merak ediyordum; lir yapmak icin ihtiyacim var.

english: Ha! You not fool me human! Me am smart! Other trolls so jealous of how brainy I are, they kick me out of camp and make me live down here in cave! But me have last funny!
translation: Ha! Beni kandiramazsin insan! Ben zekiyim! Diger troller benim zekamdan o kadar kiskaniyorlar ki, beni kamptan kovup burada magarada yasamaya zorladilar! Ama son gülen ben oldum!

english: Me find golden apples on tree and me build wall to stop anyone who not Lalli eating lovely golden apples! Did me not tell you I are smart?
translation: Agacta altin elmalar buldum ve Lalli olmayanlarin bu güzel altin elmalari yemesini engellemek icin bir duvar yaptim! Sana zeki oldugumu söylemedim mi?

english: Yes, yes, you are incredibly clever. Now please can I have some golden wool?
translation: Evet, evet, inanilmaz derecede zekisin. Simdi lütfen biraz altin yün alabilir miyim?

english: Hum, me think you not really think I are clever. Me think you is trying trick Lalli. Me not like you as much as other human. He give me present. I give him wool.
translation: Himm, bence sen benim zeki oldugumu gercekten düsünmüyorsun. Bence Lalli'yi kandirmaya calisiyorsun. Seni diger insanlar kadar sevmiyorum. O bana hediye verdi. Ben ona yün verdim.

english: Other human? You mean someone else has been there and you gave them wool?
translation: Diger insan mi? Yani baska biri daha oradaydi ve ona yün mü verdin?

english: Human call itself Askeladden! It not trick Lalli, Lalli do good deal with human! Stupid human get some dumb wool, but did not get golden apples!
translation: Insan kendine Askeladden diyor! Bu Lalli'yi kandirmak degil, Lalli insanla iyi bir anlasma yapti! Aptal insan aptal yünü aldi, ama altin elmalari alamadi!

english: I see... okay, well, bye!
No, honest, you're REALLY clever. Why, I could not contemplate a mere chicanery with an advanced intellect such as you currently present.
translation: Hayir, gercekten, sen GERCEKTEN zekisin. Senin gibi gelismis bir zekaya sahip birinin basit bir hile yapacagini düsünemezdim.

english: Grrr! Why you insult me stupid human? Me know it are because you jealous of Lalli's huge brain and you try steal apples!
translation: Grrr! Neden beni asagiliyorsun aptal insan? Lalli'nin büyük beynini kiskandigin ve elmalari calmaya calistigin icin oldugunu biliyorum!

english: Can I give you a present? Or maybe exchange you something for some wool?
translation: Sana bir hediye verebilir miyim? Ya da belki yün karsiliginda bir sey takas edebilir miyiz?

english: Ha! You stupid human! You think you trick Lalli? Me know you want my golden apples Well! You not get them! HAHAHA!
translation: Ha! Seni aptal insan! Lalli'yi kandirabilecegini mi saniyorsun? Altin elmalarimi istedigini biliyorum. Pekala! Onlari alamayacaksin! HAHAHA!

english: Erm... okay then.
Wait! I have something that might interest you... a pet rock!
translation: Bekle! Ilgini cekebilecek bir seyim var... bir evcil kaya!

english: Hah! You think me stupid or something human? Me already got one! Me don't want lotta baby rocks either, so me don't want another one around the place!
translation: Hah! Beni aptal falan mi saniyorsun insan? Zaten bir tane var! Bebek kayalari da istemiyorum, bu yüzden baska bir tane daha istemiyorum!

english: Please... all I want is some of your golden wool...
Stupid human think he can trick me into giving away some golden apples! Hah! Golden apples is all me got to eat, you not get them, no way!
translation: Aptal insan, beni kandirip altin elmalarimi verecegimi saniyor! Hah! Altin elmalar benim tek yemegim, onlari alamayacaksin, imkansiz!

english: Hmm... So you're hungry? I think I will have the perfect thing for you to eat... I just need to get myself an onion, a potato and a cabbage...
translation: Hmm... Ac misin? Sanirim sana yemen icin mükemmel bir seyim var... Sadece bir sogan, bir patates ve bir lahana almam lazim...

english: Unless you got tasty food for Lalli. Then I might trade you for it.
translation: Tabii Lalli icin lezzetli bir yemegin yoksa. O zaman seninle takas edebilirim.

english: As a matter of fact I do!
So tell me, Lalli. Have you ever tried a human delicacy known as stone soup?
translation: Söylesene Lalli. Tas corbasi denen insan lezzetini hic denedin mi?

english: What? Me am not stupid human! Everyone know cannot make food from stone!
translation: Ne? Ben aptal insan degilim! Herkes tastan yemek yapilamayacagini bilir!

english: Well, that is where you are wrong. I will now put this rock, into your cauldron over there, and make soup from it.
translation: Iste burada yaniliyorsun. Simdi bu tasi oradaki kazanina koyacagim ve ondan corba yapacagim.

english: Why you need other stuff too then?
translation: O zaman neden baska malzemelere de ihtiyacin var?

english: Ah, that is simply seasoning. Stone soup is delicious by itself, but the taste is really brought out if you use onion, potato and cabbage too.
translation: Ah, onlar sadece baharat. Tas corbasi kendi basina lezzetlidir, ama sogan, patates ve lahana da eklendiginde tadi daha da ortaya cikar.

english: Me have to try this! Me will swap you your wool if you not trick me and really can make soup out of a stone.
translation: Bunu denemeliyim! Beni kandirmazsan ve gercekten tastan corba yapabilirsen, sana yünümü veririm.

english: Actually I don't...
Hah! Me knew it! You human just try trick Lalli into giving away golden apple! Me not as stupid as you look!
translation: Hah! Biliyordum! Siz insanlar Lalli'yi kandirip altin elmayi almaya calisiyorsunuz! Ben göründügün kadar aptal degilim!

english: It am ready now?
Not just yet...
Indeed it is. Try it and see.
Hmm... YUM! That are delicious! Me never know human know to make soup out of stone? It some special stone?
translation: Hmm... YUM! Cok lezzetli! Insanlarin tastan corba yapabildigini bilmiyordum? Özel bir tas mi bu?

english: Indeed it is. But I'm willing to trade it.
translation: Evet, öyle. Ama takas etmeye hazirim.

english: Let me think about that, me like to think.
Your soup very tasty, human! But me still not want trade golden apples for your stone. Me think pet rock get jealous.
translation: Corban cok lezzetli, insan! Ama yine de altin elmalari senin tasinla takas etmek istemiyorum. Evcil tasim kiskanir diye düsünüyorum.

english: I. DON'T. WANT. ANY. GOLDEN. APPLES. ALL. I. WANT. IS. A. GOLDEN. FLEECE.
translation: ALTIN ELMA ISTEMIYORUM. TEK ISTEDIGIM ALTIN POST!

english: Gee, sorry human, all you have do is ask, me not need you to shout. You act like you think Lalli am stupid or something...
translation: Üzgünüm insan, sadece sorman yeterliydi, bagirmana gerek yoktu. Lalli'yi aptal falan saniyormussun gibi davraniyorsun...

english: Here you go. Hah! Me trick you human! All you got is worthless golden fleece! Me got very rare soup-making stone!
translation: Al bakalim. Hah! Seni kandirdim insan! Elinde sadece degersiz altin yün var! Ben cok nadir bulunan corba yapma tasini aldim!

english: Glad you're happy Lalli!
Me would give you golden fleece if me think you have enough room in your invetinary.
translation: Envanterinde yeterince yer oldugunu düsünseydim sana altin yünü verirdim.

english: Ha! Stupid human! You no get any golden apples! Even though me much like stone soup!
translation: Ha! Aptal insan! Altin elma alamayacaksin! Tas corbasini cok sevmeme ragmen!

english: Can I please have some more golden wool?
translation: Biraz daha altin yün alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: Me will sell you some golden wool, but me not sell you any golden apples!
translation: Sana altin yün satarim, ama altin elma satmam!

english: How much for the golden wool?
Me want 1000 coins! You pay or go!
translation: 1000 sikke istiyorum! Öde ya da git!

english: Is that all? Here you go!
Ha! Stupid human think he buy golden apples, but actually get stupid wool! Hahaha!
translation: Ha! Aptal insan altin elma aldigini saniyor, ama aslinda aptal yün aliyor! Hahaha!

english: I don't have that much cash on me...
Well stupid bad trade human don't get no wool then! Or any golden apples!
translation: Aptal, kötü ticaret yapan insan, o zaman yün alamazsin! Ya da altin elma!

english: You no pay, then you go! You no get any golden apples!
translation: Ödeme yapmazsan, git! Altin elma alamazsin!

english: Hey human! You not go back on deal! Me know you stupid at trades but that stone mine now! All soup mine!
translation: Hey insan! Anlasmadan dönemezsin! Ticaret konusunda aptal oldugunu biliyorum ama o tas madeni artik benim! Tüm corba benim!

english: Other human?
No, honest, you're REALLY clever.
Can I give you a present?
Pay
Don't pay
Are you a member of the Group of Advanced Gardeners?
Why, yes I am. Why do you ask?
Martin has asked me to investigate why all the crops are failing.
translation: Martin, tüm mahsullerin neden bozuldugunu arastirmami istedi.

english: No, I'm afraid I don't know anything about that.
translation: Hayir, maalesef bu konuda hicbir sey bilmiyorum.

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
You don't have a sapling planted in that patch. Plant one and I might agree to look after it for you.
translation: O tarlada fidan dikmedin. Bir tane dikersen, sana bakmayi kabul edebilirim.

english: That patch is already fully grown! I don't know what you want me to do with it!
translation: O tarla zaten tamamen yetismis! Ne yapmami istiyorsun bilmiyorum!

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: Bana tarimla ilgili tavsiyelerde bulunabilir misin?

english: Can you sell me something?
That depends on whether I have it to sell. What is it that you're looking for?
translation: Satacak bir seyim olup olmadigina bagli. Ne ariyorsun?

english: I'll come back another time.
I'm too busy with my crops to work on this! Please solve it for me.
translation: Ekinlerimle cok mesgulüm, bununla ugrasamam! Lütfen benim icin cöz.

english: Lammy Langle has given you a puzzle box!
translation: Lammy Langle sana bir bulmaca kutusu verdi!

english: Sorry but you haven't solved the puzzle yet.
Thanks [player name]!
Lammy Langle has given you another clue scroll!
translation: Lammy Langle sana baska bir ipucu parsömeni verdi!

english: Are you a member of the Group of Advanced Gardeners?
translation: Ileri Düzey Bahcivanlar Grubu'nun üyesi misin?

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: Bana tarimla ilgili tavsiyelerde bulunabilir misin?

english: Can you sell me something?
I'll come back another time.
What d'ya want?
Just exploring the far reaches of this wonderful land.
translation: Sadece bu harika topragin uzak köselerini kesfediyorum.

english: Why?
For gold! For glory!
You got gold?
Maybe a little...
Well, I'm a butcher, I'll be 'appy to perhaps trade you, that I would.
translation: Ben kasapim, seninle takas yapmaktan mutluluk duyarim.

english: I don't see any product around here...
Heh, o' course not. I keep it down in the basement, that I do.
translation: Tabii ki görmezsin. Ürünleri bodrumda sakliyorum.

english: What basement?
I think I'll be leaving now.
Heh heh heh, that you should.
Good day, how may I help you?
What is this place?
This is the great Castle Wars arena! Here you can fight for the glory of Saradomin or Zamorak.
translation: Burasi büyük Kale Savaslari arenasi! Burada Saradomin veya Zamorak'in serefi icin savasabilirsiniz.

english: Really, how do I do that?

Easy, you just step through one of the three portals. To join Zamorak, pass through the red portal. To join Saradomin, pass through the blue portal. If you don't mind then pass through the green portal.
translation: Cok kolay, üc portaldan birinden gecmeniz yeterli. Zamorak'a katilmak icin kirmizi portaldan gecin. Saradomin'e katilmak icin mavi portaldan gecin. Sorun yoksa yesil portaldan gecin.

english: Are there any rules?

Of course, there are always rules. Firstly you can't wear a cape as you enter the portal, you'll be given your team colours to wear while in the arena. You're also prohibited from taking non-combat related items in with you. So you should only have equipment, potions, and runes on you. Secondly, attacking your own team or your team's defences isn't allowed. You don't want to be angering your patron god, do you? Other than that, just have fun and enjoy it!
translation: Tabii ki, her zaman kurallar vardir. Ilk olarak, portaldan girerken pelerin giyemezsiniz, arenadayken giymeniz icin takiminizin renkleri verilecektir. Ayrica, savasla ilgili olmayan esyalari yaninizda götürmeniz de yasaktir. Yani yaninizda sadece ekipman, iksir ve rünler olabilir. Ikincisi, kendi takiminiza veya takiminizin savunmasina saldirmak yasaktir. Koruyucu tanrinizi kizdirmak istemezsiniz, degil mi? Bunun disinda, sadece eglenin ve keyfini cikarin!

english: Great! Oh, how do I win the game?
The aim is to get into your opponents' castle and take their team standard. Then bring that back and capture it on your team's standard.
translation: Amac, rakiplerinizin kalesine girip takim bayragini ele gecirmektir. Sonra onu geri getirip takiminizin bayragina takin.

english: What can I win?
Players on the winning team will receive 2 Castle Wars Tickets which you can trade back to me for other items. In the event of a draw every player will get 1 ticket.
translation: Kazanan takimin oyunculari, bana geri verip baska esyalarla takas edebileceginiz 2 Castle Wars Bileti alacaklar. Beraberlik durumunda her oyuncu 1 bilet alacak.

english: Take a look at this dead chicken I've got.
... I'm looking at the dead chicken. Why am I looking at the dead chicken?
translation: Ölü tavuga bakiyorum. Neden ölü tavuga bakiyorum?

english: It's a special device, invented by a friend of mine. If I'm wearing it while ranging, it uses magnets to retrieve some of my ammunition.
translation: Bu, bir arkadasimin icat ettigi özel bir cihaz. Menzil atisi yaparken bunu takarsam, miknatislar sayesinde mühimmatimin bir kismini geri alabilirim.

english: Oh. Gosh. That's clever. So are you wanting to take it into Castle Wars? The gods expect people to fight in the team capes.
translation: Oh. Vay canina. Cok akillica. Peki bunu Castle Wars'a götürmek mi istiyorsunuz? Tanrilar, insanlarin takim pelerinleriyle savasmasini bekliyor.

english: Can they be a bit more flexible, please?
translation: Biraz daha esnek olabilirler mi lütfen?

english: I'll ask. Hold on a minute...
... (Lanthus communes with the gods.)
The gods say they'll protect your ammunition in the same way that the chicken would, while you're fighting in Castle Wars. You won't need to wear the chicken here.
translation: Tanrilar, Castle Wars'ta savasirken tavugun yaptigi gibi mühimmatini koruyacaklarini söylüyor. Burada tavugu takmana gerek yok.

english: Thank you.
I remember you! You showed me this dead chicken device before, but this one is better is it!?
translation: Seni hatirliyorum! Bana daha önce bu ölü tavuk cihazini göstermistin, ama bu daha iyi, degil mi?

english: That's right!
Hold on...
The gods say they'll protect your ammunition in the same way that this better chicken would, while you're fighting in Castle Wars.
translation: Tanrilar, Castle Wars'ta savasirken, bu daha iyi tavugun yaptigi gibi mühimmatini koruyacaklarini söylüyorlar.

english: I remember you. You said your dead chicken could help you save ammunition. The gods agreed that you could have the same bonus in Castle Wars without needing to wear the chicken.
translation: Seni hatirliyorum. Ölü tavugunun mühimmat tasarrufu yapmana yardimci olabilecegini söylemistin. Tanrilar, tavugu giymene gerek kalmadan Castle Wars'ta da ayni bonusu alabilecegini kabul ettiler.

english: Yes, that's right.
So you don't need to keep showing me the dead chicken, do you? Take it away!
translation: O zaman bana ölü tavugu göstermeye devam etmene gerek yok, degil mi? Götür sunu!

english: Do you have a manual? I'd like to learn how to play!
translation: Kullanim kilavuzu var mi? Nasil oynandigini ögrenmek istiyorum!

english: Sure, here you go.
Is there something I can do with these bracelets?
translation: Bu bileziklerle yapabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Yes, if you're wearing one when you enter a game of Castle Wars, it will use one charge to empower your attacks against flag bearers and give you increased healing from bandages.
translation: Evet, Castle Wars oyununa girerken bir tane takarsan, bayrak tasiyicilara karsi saldirilarini güclendirmek ve bandajlardan daha fazla iyilesme saglamak icin bir sarj kullanir.

english: Bear in mind that you only need to be wearing it when you enter the game to get the benefit.
translation: Bu avantajdan yararlanmak icin sadece oyuna girerken takman gerektigini unutma.

english: If you'd prefer, if you give the bracelet to me, I can grant you the buff instead, but I'll only do it once for each charge you give me.
translation: Istersen bilezigi bana verirsen, sana bu güclendirmeyi verebilirim, ama bana verdigin her sarj icin sadece bir kez yaparim.

english: Just show me the bracelet and I'll take it off your hands.
translation: Bilezigi bana gösterin, ben de onu sizden alayim.

english: How many bracelet charges do I have stored?
Currently, I'm storing [#] charges for you. If you hand me more bracelets, I can store more charges for you.
translation: Su anda sizin icin [#] sarj sakliyorum. Bana daha fazla bilezik verirseniz, sizin icin daha fazla sarj saklayabilirim.

english: Can I stop using my stored bracelet charges?
translation: Sakladigim bilezik sarjlarini kullanmayi birakabilir miyim?

english: That seems like a strange thing to ask for, but very well, I'll stop using your stored bracelet charges on you. Talk to me if you want to start using them again.
translation: Bu garip bir istek gibi görünüyor, ama peki, sana sakladigim bileklik sarjlarini kullanmayi birakacagim. Tekrar kullanmak istersen bana söyle.

english: I'd like to use my stored bracelet charges again.
translation: Sakladigim bileklik sarjlarini tekrar kullanmak istiyorum.

english: Ah, that's more like it! Yes, I'll start using your stored bracelet charges on you if you don't have a Castle Wars bracelet equipped when a game starts. Talk to me again if you decide you'd rather not have me do that.
translation: Ah, iste böyle! Evet, oyun basladiginda Castle Wars bilekligi takmamissan, sana sakladigim bileklik sarjlarini kullanmaya baslayacagim. Bunu yapmami istemiyorsan tekrar benimle konus.

english: Nothing interesting happens.
What is this place?
Really, how do I do that?
Are there any rules?
What can I win?
Take a look at this dead chicken I've got.
What do you have for trade?
Do you have a manual? I'd like to learn how to play!
translation: Kullanim kilavuzu var mi? Nasil oynanacagini ögrenmek istiyorum!

english: Is there something I can do with these bracelets?
translation: Bu bileziklerle yapabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: How many bracelet charges do I have stored?
Can I stop using my stored bracelet charges?
translation: Depoladigim bilezik sarjlarini kullanmayi birakabilir miyim?

english: I'd like to use my stored bracelet charges again.
translation: Depoladigim bilezik sarjlarini tekrar kullanmak istiyorum.

english: I cannot speak to you outerlander! Talk to Brundt, the Chieftain!
translation: Seninle konusamam yabanci! Sef Brundt ile konus!

english: You stay away from me outerlander!
They are too suspicious of you for you to get close enough to steal from them.
translation: Sana karsi cok süpheci davraniyorlar, onlara yaklasip hirsizlik yapamazsin.

english: Hello, are you a member of the council?
I am afraid not outerlander. Goodbye.
Hello.
Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: Merhaba kardesim Dokrak. Bugün benden ne istiyorsun? Her zaman yardimima güvenebilirsin!

english: Nothing thanks. I just fancied a chat.
translation: Hicbir sey, tesekkürler. Sadece sohbet etmek istedim.

english: My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
translation: Yardimima ihtiyacin olursa kapim her zaman acik Dokrak.

english: [Fremennik name]... It has been too long since last we met!
translation: Dokrak... Son görüsmemizden bu yana cok zaman gecti!

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: Hos geldin kardesim Dokrak. Seni burada görmek her zaman bir zevk!

english: My apologies [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: Özür dilerim kardesim Dokrak! Burada seninle vakit gecirecek vaktim yok!

english: That's okay, I didn't really want anything.
translation: Sorun degil, aslinda bir sey istememistim.

english: How are you [Fremennik name]? I hope all fares well with you this day!
translation: Nasilsin Dokrak? Umarim bugün her sey yolundadir!

english: I'm fine, thanks, how are you?
All is well with me also!
Hello to you, too!
Hello. Did you want something [Fremennik name]?
translation: Merhaba. Bir sey mi istiyordun Dokrak?

english: No, not really.
Well... okay then!
Always good to see you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].
translation: Seni görmek her zaman güzel kardesim Dokrak.

english: You shame us, [Fremennik name]!
How can you steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
You have betrayed your heritage, [Fremennik name]!
Why would you try to steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
Woooo wooo wooooo woooo
Do you want something, mortal?
Who are you and why are you here?
Once I was a merchant. I worked hard and became wealthy, very wealthy. I was brave too, storing my possessions in two great chests here, where few would dare to interfere with them.
translation: Bir zamanlar tüccardim. Cok calistim ve zengin oldum, cok zengin. Cesurdum da, malimi burada, kimsenin dokunmaya cesaret edemeyecegi iki büyük sandikta sakliyordum.

english: But I was not strong enough. One day a witch allied with the pirates of the north; between their strength and her magic, they killed me. The pirates carried one of my chests away to their ship.
translation: Ama yeterince güclü degildim. Bir gün bir cadi kuzeydeki korsanlarla ittifak kurdu; onlarin gücü ve cadinin büyüsüyle beni öldürdüler. Korsanlar sandiklarimdan birini gemilerine tasidilar.

english: I keep vigil here now, as it interests me to watch adventurers come to raid this little chest, whenever they can find one of my keys.
translation: Simdi burada nöbet tutuyorum, cünkü maceracilar benim anahtarlarimdan birini bulduklarinda bu kücük sandigi yagmalamaya gelmelerini izlemek ilgimi cekiyor.

english: My bigger chest was taken north to the pirates' ship - a brave adventurer may like to raid that one instead, if they can handle the perils of the north. I kept more wealth in that one.
translation: Daha büyük sandigim kuzeydeki korsanlarin gemisine götürüldü - cesur bir maceraci, kuzeyin tehlikeleriyle basa cikabiliyorsa, onu yagmalamak isteyebilir. O sandikta daha fazla servetim vardi.

english: I've got your key.
Well done, adventurer. I have two chests, containing my wealth from the days when I was alive. The smaller one is here, and the bigger one was taken far to the north, to the pirates' ship.
translation: Aferin, maceraci. Hayattayken biriktirdigim servetimin bulundugu iki sandigim var. Kücük olani burada, büyük olani ise kuzeydeki korsanlarin gemisine götürüldü.

english: You can use the key to open either of them. The bigger one, in the pirates' ship, contains more wealth than this small one.
translation: Anahtari kullanarak ikisini de acabilirsin. Korsanlarin gemisindeki büyük sandik, kücük olandan daha fazla servet iceriyor.

english: Can you give me anything?
If you want my worldly goods, open my chests with my keys. Adventurers occasionally find my keys while slaying monsters in the Wilderness, on assignment from the witch Krystilia.
translation: Eger dünyevi mallarimi istiyorsan, anahtarlarimla sandiklarimi ac. Maceracilar, cadi Krystilia'nin görevlendirmesiyle Wilderness'da canavarlari öldürürken ara sira anahtarlarimi bulurlar.

english: I do not know why Krystilia sends adventurers to find my keys instead of looting the chest herself. Perhaps it amuses her to send people into this land to risk their lives.
translation: Krystilia'nin neden sandigi kendisi yagmalamak yerine maceracilari anahtarlarimi bulmaya gönderdigini bilmiyorum. Belki de insanlari bu topraklara hayatlarini riske atmaya göndermek onu eglendiriyordur.

english: I'll leave you to it.
I will be here if you return.
Who are you and why are you here?
I've got your key.
Can you give me anything?
I'll leave you to it.
Oh, thank Armadyl! I am in such a worry... please help me!
translation: Oh, Armadyl'e sükürler olsun! Cok endiseliyim... lütfen yardim et!

english: With what?
Oh... it is terrible... horrible... My boyfriend lives here in this lighthouse, but I haven't seen him the last few days! I think something terrible has happened!
translation: Oh... bu korkunc... berbat... Erkek arkadasim bu deniz fenerinde yasiyor, ama son birkac gündür onu görmedim! Sanirim korkunc bir sey oldu!

english: Look, you can see for yourself that the light has gone out, and the front door is locked up tight! He would NEVER do that!
translation: Bak, isigin söndügünü ve ön kapinin kilitli oldugunu kendin görebilirsin! O ASLA böyle bir sey yapmaz!

english: With the light off this coastline is terribly dangerous to ships! And to lock the front door so that nobody can turn the light back on?
translation: Isik sönükken bu sahil seridi gemiler icin cok tehlikeli! Ve kimse isigi tekrar yakamasin diye ön kapiyi kilitlemek?

english: Maybe he just went on holiday or something? Must be pretty boring living in a lighthouse.
translation: Belki tatile falan cikmistir? Deniz fenerinde yasamak oldukca sikici olmali.

english: That is terribly irresponsible! He is far too thoughtful for that! He would never leave it unattended! He would also never leave without telling me!
translation: Bu cok sorumsuzca! O bunun icin fazla düsünceli biri! Asla deniz fenerini basibos birakmaz! Ayrica bana haber vermeden asla gitmez!

english: Please, I know something terrible has happened to him... I can sense it! Please... please help me adventurer!
translation: Lütfen, ona korkunc bir sey oldugunu biliyorum... Hissedebiliyorum! Lütfen... lütfen bana yardim et maceraci!

english: But how can I help?
Well, we have to do something to get the lighthouse working again! Also, as you may have noticed, the storm that knocked the bridge out
translation: Peki, deniz fenerini tekrar calisir hale getirmek icin bir seyler yapmaliyiz! Ayrica, fark etmis olabileceginiz gibi, köprüyü yikip gecen firtina

english: has trapped me on this causeway! You seem to have got here okay somehow, so if you could go and visit my cousin and get the spare key I left him,
translation: beni bu gecitte mahsur birakti! Siz bir sekilde buraya sorunsuz ulasmis görünüyorsunuz, bu yüzden gidip kuzenimi ziyaret edip ona biraktigim yedek anahtari alabilirseniz

english: as well as fix the bridge enough so that I can go and speak to my family in Rellekka and tell them whats happened, I will be eternally grateful!
translation: ve köprüyü tamir edip Rellekka'daki ailemle konusup onlara olanlari anlatabilirsem size sonsuza kadar minnettar kalirim!

english: Okay, I'll help!
OH! THANK YOU SO MUCH! I know my darling would never have left with the lighthouse lights off and without even telling me where he's gone!
translation: OH! COK TESEKKÜR EDERIM! Sevgilimin deniz fenerinin isiklari sönükken ve bana nereye gittigini söylemeden asla ayrilmayacagini biliyorum!

english: Where is your cousin?
My cousin was always interested in agility. He left our home in Rellekka many moons ago, so that he could pursue this interest.
translation: Kuzenim her zaman ceviklige ilgi duymustu. Bu ilgisini sürdürebilmek icin aylar önce Rellekka'daki evimizden ayrildi.

english: I don't exactly know where he has gone, but I am sure he went somewhere to practise his agility. If you see him, his name is Gunnjorn. Mention my name, he will recognise it.
translation: Nereye gittigini tam olarak bilmiyorum, ama cevikligini gelistirmek icin bir yere gittiginden eminim. Onu görürseniz, adi Gunnjorn. Benim adimi söyleyin, taniyacaktir.

english: How can I fix the bridge?
Well, I am not just some helpless girl! I have pretty good agility, so you will only need to use two planks to make a ledge that I can balance along.
translation: Ben caresiz bir kiz degilim! Cevikligim oldukca iyidir, bu yüzden dengede durabilecegim bir cikinti yapmak icin sadece iki tahta kullanmaniz yeterli.

english: Just use a plank on each side of the bridge. You will need a hammer, and thirty steel nails for each plank you use as well. I believe there are some planks near here...
translation: Köprünün her iki tarafina birer tahta koyun. Bir cekic ve kullandiginiz her tahta icin otuz celik civiye ihtiyaciniz olacak. Sanirim yakinlarda birkac tahta var...

english: I'll see what I can do.
Thank you so much!
Sorry, just passing through.
Oh... my poor darling Jossik... I just know something terrible has happened...
translation: Ah... zavalli sevgilim Jossik... Kötü bir sey oldugunu biliyorum...

english: Oh! Thank you so much for all of your help in rescuing my darling Jossik!
translation: Oh! Sevgili Jossik'i kurtarmada yardim ettigin icin cok tesekkür ederim!

english: I do not know what would have happened to him had you not chanced along this path!
translation: Sen bu yoldan gecmeseydin ona ne olacagini bilmiyorum!

english: Don't worry about it, I was glad to help out.
With what?
But how can I help?
Yes.
Where is your cousin?
How can I fix the bridge?
I'll see what I can do
No.
Sorry, just passing through
I'm looking for an experienced adventurer and you're not it. Come back when you are more capable.
translation: Deneyimli bir maceraci ariyorum ve sen o degilsin. Daha yetenekli oldugunda geri gel.

english: Hello. Do you need any help? I'm looking for a quest.
translation: Merhaba. Yardima ihtiyacin var mi? Bir görev ariyorum.

english: Are you working for them?
Uh, I'm not sure. Who are they?
EXACTLY!
Seriously, what are you talking about?
I think you can be trusted. What do you know about...
translation: Bence sana güvenilebilir. Penguenler hakkinda ne biliyorsun?

english: penguins?
Uh...they live in the cold? That's about all.
translation: Uh... sogukta yasarlar? Hepsi bu kadar.

english: Would you like to learn more about them? I'm conducting a, uh, research project, to, uh, learn about their social habits in their natural environment.
translation: Onlar hakkinda daha fazla bilgi edinmek ister misin? Penguenlerin dogal ortamlarindaki sosyal aliskanliklarini ögrenmek icin bir arastirma projesi yürütüyorum.

english: What do you need my help for?
Well, I need to build a shelter to hide from view, and it's always useful to have an extra pair of eyes, you know, for, uh, observing...Penguins.
translation: Görünmemek icin bir barinak insa etmem gerekiyor ve penguenleri gözlemlemek icin fazladan bir cift gözün olmasi her zaman yararlidir.

english: So, are you up for it?
Okay, why not! But first, who are you and why are you researching penguins?
translation: Tamam, neden olmasin! Ama önce, kimsin ve neden penguenleri arastiriyorsun?

english: I, uh, was a zoo keeper here. But, I, uh, am on leave to go research penguins in their native habitat.
translation: Ben burada hayvanat bahcesi bakicisiydim. Ama penguenleri dogal ortamlarinda arastirmak icin izin aldim.

english: Ok! Okay then. So, what did you need me to do?
translation: Tamam! Peki o zaman. Ne yapmami istiyorsun?

english: Right. I need you to gather materials for the bird hide, while I arrange for our transport.
translation: Tamam. Ben ulasimimizi ayarlarken, sen kus gözlem kulübesi icin malzeme toplamani istiyorum.

english: You need to get 10 oak planks, 10 steel nails, a hammer, and a spade so that we can build a bird hide.
translation: Kus gözlem kulübesi insa edebilmemiz icin 10 mese tahtasi, 10 celik civi, bir cekic ve bir kürek bulman gerekiyor.

english: Once you have those, meet me up by the entrance to Keldagrim, east of Rellekka. I'll be there with a boat to take us to our destination.
translation: Bunlari topladiktan sonra, Rellekka'nin dogusundaki Keldagrim girisinde benimle bulus. Bizi hedefimize götürecek bir tekneyle orada olacagim.

english: Right, oak planks, steel nails, hammer, spade, east of Rellekka. Got it.
translation: Tamam, mese tahtalari, celik civiler, cekic, kürek, Rellekka'nin dogusu. Anladim.

english: You've started a new quest: Cold War
translation: Yeni bir görev baslattin: Soguk Savas

english: I don't think so.
What? Did you come to tell me I'm crazy too?
translation: Ne? Sen de benim deli oldugumu mu söylemeye geldin?

english: No, I...
Oh, I don't have time for your lies. Go away
Sorry, you can't use this boat.
I can't speak right now. I have too much to do. I will contact you when the time is right.
translation: Su anda konusamam. Yapacak cok isim var. Uygun zaman geldiginde seninle iletisime gececegim.

english: On the way I'll tell you the 42 ways penguins can torture you using a feather...
translation: Yolda penguenlerin tüy kullanarak sana iskence edebilecekleri 42 yolu anlatacagim...

english: I've lost the clockwork book, could I have another?
translation: Saatli kitabi kaybettim, baska bir tane alabilir miyim?

english: Well, lucky for you I did make another copy. But be more careful!
translation: Sanslisin, baska bir kopya daha yapmistim. Ama daha dikkatli ol!

english: Can I transport My Arm in your boat?
Well, yes, I'm sure you've transported your arm every time you've used my boat. Isn't it always attached to the rest of your body?
translation: Evet, eminim teknemizi her kullandiginda kolunu da tasimissindir. Kolun her zaman vücudunun geri kalanina bagli degil mi?

english: Never mind, I just need to borrow your boat.
translation: Bos ver, sadece tekneni ödünc almam lazim.

english: Sorry, I distinctly heard you say you wanted to transport your arm in it. Have you had your brain shrunk into a penguin suit too many times? I don't lend my boat to mad people.
translation: Üzgünüm, kolunu tasimak istedigini acikca duydum. Beynin penguen kostümüne cok fazla kücültüldü mü? Deli insanlara teknemizi ödünc vermiyoruz.

english: This kind of thing happens a lot when I take My Arm out to places.
translation: Kolumu disariya cikardigimda bu tür seyler sik sik oluyor.

english: You take your arm out to places? And what the heck is THAT?
translation: Kolunu disariya mi cikariyorsun? Ve o da ne öyle?

english: My Arm approaches the pier.
My Arm: My Arm here!
What are we going to do about the penguins?
I can't speak right now. I have too much to do. I will contact you when the time is right.**
translation: Su anda konusamam. Yapacak cok isim var. Uygun zaman geldiginde seninle iletisime gececegim.

english: Um... I think I must have misheard you, but the only thing I'll let my boat do is travel here to Rellekka, with me in it. I'm not risking getting marooned here.
translation: Sanirim seni yanlis duymus olmaliyim, ama teknemle yapacagi tek sey, benimle birlikte Rellekka'ya seyahat etmek. Burada mahsur kalma riskini göze alamam.

english: Okay, why not!
I don't think so.
I'd like to travel to the iceberg.
I've lost the clockwork book, could I have another?
translation: Saatli kitabi kaybettim, baska bir tane alabilir miyim?

english: Can I transport My Arm in your boat?
My Arm is a troll.
Never mind, I just need to borrow your boat.
translation: Bos ver, sadece tekneni ödünc almam lazim.

english: What are we going to do about the penguins?
Please excuse me, I'm rather busy.
Hey, I'm your contractor from Mahogany Homes, what did you want done?
translation: Merhaba, ben Mahogany Homes'tan müteahhitinizim, ne yaptirmak istiyorsunuz?

english: I'd like my range fixed.
I'd like two Wooden drawers built.
I'd like a Wooden table built.
I'd like my hat stand fixed.
I'd like my clock fixed.
I'd like two Oak drawers built.
I'd like a Oak table built.
I'd like two Teak drawers built.
translation: Iki adet tik cekmece yapilmasini istiyorum.

english: I'd like a Teak table built.
translation: Bir adet tik masa yapilmasini istiyorum.

english: I'd like two Mahogany drawers built.
translation: Iki adet maun cekmece yapilmasini istiyorum.

english: I'd like a Mahogany table built.
translation: Bir adet maun masa yapilmasini istiyorum.

english: I've finished with the work you wanted.
Thank you so much! Would you like a cup of tea before you go?
translation: Cok tesekkür ederim! Gitmeden önce bir fincan cay ister misiniz?

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
translation: Evet, bir fincan cay cok iyi olur.

english: No thanks, I better be off.
Aaah, nothing like a nice cupppa tea!
translation: Ah, güzel bir fincan cay gibisi yok!

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
translation: Evet, bir fincan cay cok iyi olur.

english: No thanks.
Hello there, are you interested in buying one of my special capes?
translation: Merhaba, özel pelerinlerimden birini satin almak ister misiniz?

english: What's so special about your capes?

Ahh well they make it less likely that you'll accidently attack anyone wearing the same cape as you and easier to attack everyone else. They also make it easier to distinguish people who're wearing the same cape as you
translation: Ahh, ayni pelerini giyen birine yanlislikla saldirma olasiliginizi azaltir ve diger herkese saldirmanizi kolaylastirir. Ayrica, ayni pelerini giyen kisileri digerlerinden ayirt etmenizi kolaylastirir.

english: from everyone else. They're very useful when out in the wilderness with friends or anyone else you don't want to harm.
translation: Arkadaslarinizla veya zarar vermek istemediginiz kisilerle Wildernessda gezintiye ciktiginizda cok kullanislidir.

english: So would you like to buy one?
translation: Peki, bir tane satin almak ister misiniz?

english: No thanks.
What's so special about your capes?
Yes please!
Is there something I can help you with?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: I was given a challenge, what now?
translation: Bana bir meydan okuma verildi, simdi ne yapmaliyim?

english: Hand it to me, and we'll get you started.
What is this place?

This is the champions' arena. The champions of various races use it to duel those they deem worthy of the honour. If you find a challenge scroll in your travels, bring it here to face your challenger.
translation: Burasi sampiyonlarin arenasi. Cesitli irklarin sampiyonlari, burayi onurlu bulduklari kisilerle düello yapmak icin kullanir. Seyahatlerinizde bir meydan okuma parsömeni bulursaniz, onu buraya getirin ve meydan okuyucunuzla yüzlesin.

english: Have you any rewards for me?
