translation: Bana verecek bir ödülünüz var mi?

english: No, you've not earned any.
Have a look in the chest by the Wall of Defeated Champions, on the north side of this gallery. I think you'll find something in there for you.
translation: Bu galerinin kuzey tarafindaki Yenilen Sampiyonlar Duvari'nin yanindaki sandiga bir bak. Sanirim orada senin icin bir sey bulacaksin.

english: You're holding it already. Go and rub your lamp.
translation: Zaten elinde tutuyorsun. Git ve lambani ov.

english: I don't think I've got anything more for you.
translation: Sanirim sana verecek baska bir seyim yok.

english: Nothing thanks.
Leon d'Cour has issued you a challenge. He has stated there will be no items allowed except those you're wearing. Do you want to accept the challenge?
translation: Leon d'Cour sana bir meydan okuma gönderdi. Giyindigin esyalar disinda hicbir esyanin izin verilmeyecegini belirtti. Meydan okumayi kabul etmek istiyor musun?

english: Your challenger is ready! Please go down through the trapdoor when you're ready.
translation: Rakibin hazir! Hazir oldugunda lütfen tuzak kapisindan asagi in.

english: No thanks, I'll pass.
Welcome back, champion! Leon d'Cour has granted you his cloak for you to wear as a sign of your accomplishment. Do you want it now? Or do you want something else?
translation: Hos geldin sampiyon! Leon d'Cour, basarini simgelemek icin sana pelerinini verdi. Simdi ister misin? Yoksa baska bir sey mi istersin?

english: Yes, please.
I'm afraid you don't have space to take it.
I'd like another one.
Thank you, and goodbye.
You need to arrange a challenge with me before you enter the arena.
translation: Arenaya girmeden önce benimle bir meydan okuma ayarlamalisin.

english: There's a ladder for a reason.
So you want to accept the challenge huh? Well there are some specific rules for these Champion fights. For this fight you're not allowed to use any Special Attacks. Do you still want to proceed?
translation: Demek meydan okumayi kabul etmek istiyorsun? Bu Sampiyon dövüsleri icin bazi özel kurallar var. Bu dövüste Özel Saldirilar kullanamazsin. Hala devam etmek istiyor musun?

english: So you want to accept the challenge huh? Well there are some specific rules for these Champion fights. For this fight you're only allowed to use Magic attacks, no Melee or Ranged. Do you still want to proceed?
translation: Demek meydan okumayi kabul etmek istiyorsun? Bu Sampiyon dövüsleri icin bazi özel kurallar var. Bu dövüste sadece Büyü saldirilari kullanabilirsin, Yakin Dövüs veya Menzilli saldirilar kullanamazsin. Hala devam etmek istiyor musun?

english: So you want to accept the challenge huh? Well there are some specific rules for these Champion fights. For this fight you're only allowed to use Ranged attacks, no Melee or Magic. Do you still want to proceed?
translation: Meydan okumayi kabul etmek istiyorsun, öyle mi? Bu Sampiyon dövüsleri icin bazi özel kurallar var. Bu dövüste sadece Menzilli saldirilar kullanabilirsin, Yakin dövüs veya Sihirli saldirilar kullanamazsin. Hala devam etmek istiyor musun?

english: I believe I mentioned you're only allowed to use Ranged in this duel.
translation: Bu düelloda sadece Menzilli saldirilar kullanabilecegini söylemistim.

english: So you want to accept the challenge huh? Well there are some specific rules for these Champion fights. For this fight you're not allowed to use any Magic attacks. Do you still want to proceed?
translation: Meydan okumayi kabul etmek istiyorsun, öyle mi? Bu Sampiyon dövüsleri icin bazi özel kurallar var. Bu dövüste Sihirli saldirilar kullanamazsin. Hala devam etmek istiyor musun?

english: So you want to accept the challenge huh? Well there are some specific rules for these Champion fights. For this fight you're only allowed to use Melee attacks, no Ranged or Magic. Do you still want to proceed?
translation: Demek meydan okumayi kabul etmek istiyorsun, ha? Bu Sampiyon dövüsleri icin bazi özel kurallar var. Bu dövüste sadece yakin dövüs saldirilari kullanabilirsin, menzilli veya büyü saldirilari kullanamazsin. Hala devam etmek istiyor musun?

english: So you want to accept the challenge huh? Well there are some specific rules for these Champion fights. For this fight you're not allowed to use any Melee attacks. Do you still want to proceed?
translation: Demek meydan okumayi kabul etmek istiyorsun, ha? Bu Sampiyon dövüsleri icin bazi özel kurallar var. Bu dövüste yakin dövüs saldirilari kullanamazsin. Hala devam etmek istiyor musun?

english: So you want to accept the challenge huh? Well there are some specific rules for these Champion fights. For this fight you're only allowed to take Weapons, no other items are allowed. Do you still want to proceed?
translation: Meydan okumayi kabul etmek istiyorsun demek? Bu Sampiyon dövüsleri icin bazi özel kurallar var. Bu dövüste sadece Silah kullanabilirsin, baska hicbir esya kullanamazsin. Hala devam etmek istiyor musun?

english: So you want to accept the challenge huh? Well there are some specific rules for these Champion fights. For this fight you're not allowed to use any Prayers. Do you still want to proceed?
translation: Meydan okumayi kabul etmek istiyorsun demek? Bu Sampiyon dövüsleri icin bazi özel kurallar var. Bu dövüste Dua kullanamazsin. Hala devam etmek istiyor musun?

english: So you want to accept the challenge huh? Well there are some specific rules for these Champion fights. For this fight you're not allowed to use any Ranged attacks. Do you still want to proceed?
translation: Meydan okumayi kabul etmek istiyorsun demek? Bu Sampiyon dövüsleri icin bazi özel kurallar var. Bu dövüste menzilli saldirilar kullanamazsin. Hala devam etmek istiyor musun?

english: So you want to accept the challenge huh? Well there are some specific rules for these Champion fights. For this fight you're not allowed any Weapons or Armour. Do you still want to proceed?
translation: Meydan okumayi kabul etmek istiyorsun demek? Bu Sampiyon dövüsleri icin bazi özel kurallar var. Bu dövüste silah veya zirh kullanamazsin. Hala devam etmek istiyor musun?

english: You've already defeated this Champion. The challenge is void.
translation: Bu Sampiyonu zaten yendin. Meydan okuma gecersiz.

english: That's great, now go show who's interested.
translation: Harika, simdi kim ilgileniyorsa ona göster.

english: I was given a challenge, what now?
translation: Bana bir meydan okuma verildi, simdi ne yapmaliyim?

english: What is this place?
Have you any rewards for me?
translation: Bana verecek bir ödülün var mi?

english: Nothing thanks.
Yes, let me at him!
translation: Evet, birak da ona bir bakayim!

english: No thanks, I'll pass.
Yes, please.
I'd like another one.
Thank you, and goodbye.
Can I help you today?
Can I go for a ride?
Minecart rides are 20 coins.
Of course.
I'm fine, thanks.
As a loyal customer of the Lovakengj Minecart Network, you're entitled to this.
translation: Lovakengj Maden Arabasi Agi'nin sadik bir müsterisi olarak, buna hakkiniz var.

english: Now, can I help you today?
translation: Simdi, bugün size nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: You're already here, human.
Can I go for a ride?
I'm fine, thanks.
Would you look after my crops for me?
You don't have a sapling planted in that patch. Plant one and I might agree to look after it for you.
translation: O tarlada fidan dikmedin. Bir tane dikersen, sana bakmayi kabul edebilirim.

english: Alright, I'll pay.
That'll do nicely, sir. Leave it with me - I'll make sure that tree grows up good and strong.
translation: Bu yeterli, efendim. Bana birakin, o agacin iyi ve güclü büyümesini saglayacagim.

english: What the heck do you want with THAT?
They're for eating, silly! What else can you do with a monkey bar?
translation: Yemek icin, aptal! Maymun bariyla baska ne yapabilirsin ki?

english: And the Suqah tooth?
Lots of gnomes like a bit of ground-up Suqah tooth. Just don't tell anyone about this, okay?
translation: Bircok cüce ögütülmüs Suqah disini sever. Kimseye bundan bahsetme, tamam mi?

english: Maybe some other time.
That patch is already fully grown! I don't know what you want me to do with it!
translation: O arazi zaten tamamen yetismis! Onunla ne yapmami istiyorsun bilmiyorum!

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: Bana tarimla ilgili tavsiyede bulunabilir misin?

english: You can put up to five tomatoes, strawberries, apples, bananas or oranges into a fruit basket, although you can't have a mix in the same basket.
translation: Meyve sepetine en fazla bes domates, cilek, elma, muz veya portakal koyabilirsin, ancak ayni sepete farkli meyveleri karistiramazsin.

english: Can you sell me something?
That depends on whether I have it to sell. What is it that you're looking for?
translation: Satacak bir seyim olup olmadigina bagli. Ne ariyorsun?

english: Some plant cure.
Plant cure, eh? I might have some put aside for myself. Tell you what, I'll sell you some plant cure for 25 coins if you like.
translation: Bitki ilaci, ha? Kendim icin bir miktar ayirmis olabilirim. Bak ne diyecegim, istersen sana 25 sikkeye bitki ilaci satarim.

english: Yes, that sounds like a fair price.
translation: Evet, bu makul bir fiyat gibi görünüyor.

english: Latlink Fastbell hands over your purchase
translation: Latlink Fastbell satin aldigin ürünü teslim ediyor

english: No thanks, I can get that much cheaper elsewhere.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, baska bir yerden daha ucuza alabilirim.

english: I don't have enough money for that, I'm afraid.
translation: Korkarim bunun icin yeterli param yok.

english: A bucket of compost.
A bucket of compost, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 35 coins if you like.
translation: Bir kova kompost, ha? Yedek bir tane olabilir... Bak ne diyecegim, istersen 35 sikkeye satarim.

english: A rake.
A rake, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: Tirmik, ha? Yedek bir tane olabilir... Bak ne diyecegim, istersen 15 sikkeye satarim.

english: A plant pot.
Eh, I suppose I can spare you a plant pot, but I'll want 40 coins for it.
translation: Eh, sanirim sana bir saksi verebilirim, ama 40 sikke istiyorum.

english: A watering can.
A watering can, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 25 coins if you like.
translation: Bir sulama kabi, ha? Yedek bir tane olabilir... Bak ne diyecegim, istersen 25 sikkeye satarim.

english: A gardening trowel.
A gardening trowel, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: Bir bahce küregi, ha? Yedek bir tane olabilir... Bak ne diyecegim, istersen 15 sikkeye satarim.

english: A seed dibber.
A seed dibber, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you
translation: Bir tohum ekme cubugu, ha? Yedek bir tane olabilir... Bak ne diyecegim, istersen 15 sikkeye satarim.

english: Forget it, you don't have anything I need.
translation: Bos ver, ihtiyacim olan hicbir seyin yok.

english: I'll come back another time.
Would you look after my crops for me?
Alright, I'll pay.
What the heck do you want with THAT?
Maybe some other time
Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: Bana tarimla ilgili tavsiyede bulunabilir misin?

english: Can you sell me something?
Some plant cure.
Yes, that sounds like a fair price.
translation: Evet, bu makul bir fiyat gibi görünüyor.

english: No thanks, I can get that much cheaper elsewhere.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, baska bir yerde daha ucuza bulabilirim.

english: A bucket of compost.
A rake.
A plant pot.
(See more items)
A watering can.
A gardening trowel.
A seed dibber.
(See previous items)
Forget it.
I'll come back another time.
Hey, what are yo...
Sorry, can't talk to ye right now. Busy with paperwork. If ye need anythin', talk t' Captain Pudi over by the dock.
translation: Üzgünüm, su anda konusamam. Evrak isleriyle mesgulüm. Bir seye ihtiyacin olursa, rihtimdaki Kaptan Pudi ile konus.

english: What can I do for ye? I be quite busy with paperwork.
translation: Sizin icin ne yapabilirim? Evrak isleriyle oldukca mesgulüm.

english: I heard about your ship. Can you tell me what happened?
translation: Geminiz hakkinda bir seyler duydum. Ne oldugunu anlatabilir misiniz?

english: Aye, I can tell ye what happened.
We be out on our fortnightly fishin' trip, I was doin' me normal work. Setting up the nets, swabbing the deck and the like.
translation: Iki haftada bir yaptigimiz balik avi gezisine cikmistik, ben normal isimi yapiyordum. Aglari kurmak, güverteyi temizlemek gibi.

english: 'Twas a good hawl t' start, plenty of manta ray and snappers. But we would be movin' on the next day to our deep sea fishin' spot.
translation: Baslangicta iyi bir avdi, bol miktarda manta vatozu ve parlak baligi yakaladik. Ama ertesi gün derin deniz balikciligi yapacagimiz yere gececektik.

english: 'Twas nothin' but smooth sailin' to our deep sea spot near Karamja, but on the way I noticed more debris in the water than usual.
translation: Karamja yakinlarindaki derin deniz balikciligi yapacagimiz yere kadar yolculuk sorunsuz gecti, ama yolda suda normalden fazla enkaz oldugunu fark ettim.

english: What kind of debris? Was it ship debris?
translation: Ne tür enkazlar? Gemi enkazi miydi?

english: Aye, 'twas. Most of the time, it be nets or items people throw off ships that they don't need. This had me worried a bit.
translation: Evet, öyleydi. Cogu zaman, aglar veya gemilerden atilan gereksiz esyalar olur. Bu beni biraz endiselendirdi.

english: There was a lack of fish in the water, 'twas kind of... eerie.
translation: Suda balik yoktu, bu biraz... ürkütücüydü.

english: The next day, Koanee changed the ship's course, but that be because of a storm on the horizon.
translation: Ertesi gün, Koanee geminin rotasini degistirdi, ama bunun nedeni ufukta bir firtina olmasiydi.

english: But the storm seemed t' be... following us. As if it had a mind of its own.
translation: Ama firtina sanki... bizi takip ediyor gibiydi. Sanki kendi iradesi varmis gibi.

english: The wind started a blowin' and the fog started a showin', huge waves crashing against the boat.
translation: Rüzgar esmeye basladi, sis cöktü, dev dalgalar gemiye carpmaya basladi.

english: The ship started fallin' apart. I rushed to the cook's quarters and found 'im layin' on the floor with a plank over 'im.
translation: Gemi parcalanmaya basladi. Ascinin odasina kostum ve onu yerde, üstüne bir tahta parcasi örtülmüs halde buldum.

english: I brought 'im up to the top deck and tied 'im to a piece of loose wood. I did the same t' the Skipper and Navigator.
translation: Onu üst güverteye cikardim ve gevsek bir tahtaya bagladim. Ayni seyi kaptan ve navigatöre de yaptim.

english: Oh my, that's awful! You're very lucky you didn't get hit.
translation: Aman Tanrim, bu korkunc! Vurulmadigin icin cok sanslisin.

english: Aye, it be lucky indeed. But that not be the end of it. As the ship finished sinking, I balanced out the wood so we did not slip.
translation: Evet, gercekten sansliydim. Ama bu kadarla kalmadi. Gemi batarken, kaymamamiz icin tahtayi dengede tuttum.

english: In the distance I saw glowing eyes and a large monster sorta thing in the fog movin' t'wards us.
translation: Uzakta, sisin icinde bize dogru gelen parlayan gözler ve büyük bir canavar gibi bir sey gördüm.

english: But all of a sudden, it vanished. I then had to keep us afloat 'till we made it t' shore by Al Kharid.
translation: Ama birdenbire ortadan kayboldu. Sonra Al Kharid kiyisina ulasana kadar bizi suda tutmak zorunda kaldim.

english: Pudi gathered us up and we went t' the Chancellor as soon as we could stand.
translation: Pudi bizi topladi ve ayaga kalkabildigimiz anda Sansölye'ye gittik.

english: These ruins turned out t' be a great base to research the beast from undisturbed! Bit close to Menaphos though, aye?
translation: Bu harabeler, canavari rahatsiz edilmeden arastirmak icin harika bir üs oldu! Menaphos'a biraz yakin ama, degil mi?

english: That be the end of me story. Can I help ye with anything else?
translation: Hikayem bu kadar. Baska bir seye yardim edebilir miyim?

english: A pirate doing paperwork, that's new.
translation: Bir korsan evrak isleriyle ugrasiyor, bu yeni bir sey.

english: Let me guess, ye thought we be doin' nothing but pluderin' and pillagin'?
translation: Tahmin edeyim, bizim sadece yagmalayip talan ettigimizi mi saniyordun?

english: Is that not what pirates do?
Ye be a funny one.
Glad you can still smile after what happened.
I'm not goin' t' let one bit of bad luck keep me down.
translation: Biraz kötü sansin beni yikmasina izin vermeyecegim.

english: Can I help ye with anything else?
translation: Baska bir konuda yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?
translation: Tempoross ile savasmak icin herhangi bir ipucun var mi?

english: Tempoross can summon clouds that shoot lightnin'. They can cause fires that will block ye from movin' about as freely.
translation: Tempoross, yildirim cakan bulutlar cagirabilir. Bu bulutlar, hareket etmeni engelleyecek yanginlara neden olabilir.

english: Ye best be ready to grab a bucket and douse the fire before it spreads!
translation: Yangin yayilmadan önce bir kova alip söndürmeye hazir olsan iyi olur!

english: Can I help ye with anythin' else?
translation: Baska bir seye yardim edebilir miyim?

english: I have to go.
Stay safe, ye hear?
Would you care for an egg in this difficult time?
translation: Bu zor zamanda bir yumurta ister misin?

english: Um... no, I don't want your damp egg, thanks...
I'll take my eggs elsewhere then.
translation: O zaman yumurtalarimi baska bir yerden alacagim.

english: A damp egg? No thanks.
I'd rather not. Thanks, though.
Oh, thanks.
This is some comfort to be sure.
I heard about your ship, can you tell me what happened?
translation: Geminizle ilgili olanlari duydum, ne oldugunu anlatabilir misiniz?

english: A pirate doing paperwork, that's new.
translation: Bir korsan evrak isleriyle ugrasiyor, bu yeni bir sey.

english: Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?
translation: Tempoross ile savasmak icin herhangi bir ipucunuz var mi?

english: I have to go.
Have I seen you before?
I don't think so... I've just got one of those faces.
translation: Sanmiyorum... Yüzüm öyle bir yüz iste.

english: You're probably right.
I'm rather busy at the moment. I've got to organise my cupboards of jewels.
translation: Su anda oldukca mesgulüm. Mücevher dolaplarimi düzenlemem gerekiyor.

english: Want any help?
Absolutely not! You stay away from my jewels.
Interested in buying a house like mine?
translation: Benimki gibi bir ev satin almak ister misin?

english: Not sure I've got enough coins to do that.
translation: Bunun icin yeterli param oldugundan emin degilim.

english: Silly me! I mistook you for one of us wealthy folk.
translation: Ne aptalim! Seni zenginlerden biri sanmistim.

english: Well that's rude.
You'll catch on.
Hello there. Are you liking the city?
It's beautiful!
It really is.
Huh? Are you an encyclopediasalesman?
No, madam, I'm a burglar. I burgle people.
translation: Hayir, hanimefendi, ben hirsizim. Insanlari soyarim.

english: Hmm... I think you're an encyclopediasalesman?
Not at all. I just want to ransack the place. Honestly.
translation: Hic de degil. Sadece burayi talan etmek istiyorum. Gercekten.

english: Hmm... Alright then.
I've just spent so much money!
Good for you.
Sorry, but I don't have time to chat. I've got important errands to run.
translation: Üzgünüm ama sohbet edecek vaktim yok. Önemli islerim var.

english: I've got something in the back of my mind telling me I should go back home.
translation: Icimden bir ses eve dönmem gerektigini söylüyor.

english: You don't say...
Lovely day for a stroll, wouldn't you say?
translation: Yürüyüs icin güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: It is!
Time to go check how rich I am!
translation: Ne kadar zengin oldugumu kontrol etme zamani!

english: Lovely day for a stroll.
Time to see what's at the bazaar!
You are escorted out of the house as the owner has locked the door.
translation: Ev sahibi kapiyi kilitledigi icin evden disari cikarildin.

english: You hear someone outside spot the homeowner coming back!
translation: Disarida birinin ev sahibinin geri geldigini fark ettigini duyuyorsun!

english: Now where did I put my keys...
Ah, there they are!
It smells funny in here...
There's mud all over the floor!
Something isn't right here...
How did you get in here?
What do you do here?
Oh, I just walk around a bit...I have to help my Mum and Dad a lot though because I'm still only young. I'd love to visit the mainland one day though and get out of this boring village.
translation: Oh, sadece biraz dolasiyorum... Ama henüz cok genc oldugum icin anneme ve babama cok yardim etmem gerekiyor. Bir gün anakarayi ziyaret edip bu sikici köyden cikmak isterim.

english: Is there anything interesting to do around here?
translation: Buralarda ilginc bir sey var mi?

english: Not that I'm aware of, just sit back and enjoy the sunshine bwana!
translation: Bildigim kadariyla yok, sadece arkaniza yaslanin ve günesin tadini cikarin bwana!

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
Yeah, you've been doing a lot of good work around here. Let me give you something for your time and effort.
translation: Evet, burada cok iyi isler yapiyorsun. Zamanin ve emeklerin icin sana bir sey vereyim.

english: You get [amount] trading sticks. You are left with [amount]% favour.
I've already given you some trading sticks and I don't have any more on me at the moment. Why not go and talk to some of the other villagers and get some contributions?
translation: Sana zaten bazi ticaret cubuklari verdim ve su anda üzerimde baska yok. Neden gidip diger köylülerle konusup biraz katki almiyorsun?

english: Ok, thanks.
Ahhhhhhhh - Get away from me you beast!
translation: Ahhhhhhhh - Benden uzak dur seni canavar!

english: What's the problem....oh, I'm wearing this big scary mask! I'd better take it off before I start talking to the natives.
translation: Sorun ne... oh, bu büyük korkunc maskeyi takmisim! Yerlilerle konusmaya baslamadan önce onu cikarsam iyi olacak.

english: Waahhhhh! - It's da evil broodoo beast come ta eat my very soul!
translation: Waahhhhh! - Bu benim ruhumu yemeye gelen kötü broodoo canavari!

english: Ahhhhhhhh - It's a monster!
Ahhhhhhhh!!
What do you do here?
Is there anything interesting to do here?
translation: Burada ilginc bir sey var mi?

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
Ok, thanks.
Well, thank you, adventurer. You've just deprived me of a wonderful chance to learn from one of Zamorak's first followers.
translation: Tesekkürler, maceraci. Zamorak'in ilk takipcilerinden birinden ögrenme firsatini benden aldin.

english: What? What about that treasure you were looking for?
You utter imbecile! Did you think I was looking for gold?
translation: Seni aptal! Altin aradigimi mi sandin?

english: Um... sorry.
'Sorry' won't bring those Mahjarrat back.
*sigh*I might as well stay to study this temple. It has some interesting magical properties.
translation: *ic cekis* Bu tapinagi incelemek icin burada kalabilirim. Bazi ilginc büyülü özellikleri var.

english: Ooh, you're a mage? Can you teach me any spells?
translation: Ooh, sen bir büyücü müsün? Bana büyü ögretir misin?

english: Well...
If you really want to learn my spells, you'll have to dedicate yourself to Zamorak.
translation: Gercekten büyülerimi ögrenmek istiyorsan, kendini Zamorak'a adamalisin.

english: I couldn't do that!
Then you won't be learning any of my spells.
Ha ha ha ha!
You're not very nice, are you?
What did you expect from a Zamorakian mage?
translation: Bir Zamorak büyücüsünden ne bekliyordun ki?

english: Sure, sign me up!
You really thought I would teach you my secrets just like that? Ha ha ha! You are a naive fool.
translation: Gercekten sana sirlarimi öylece ögretecegimi mi sandin? Ha ha ha! Sen saf bir aptalsin.

english: That's not very nice of you.
translation: Bu pek hos bir davranis degil.

english: I'm a mage of Zamorak, after all. What else do you expect?
translation: Sonucta ben Zamorak'in bir büyücüsüyüm. Baska ne bekliyordun ki?

english: How are you and your defective brain doing nowadays, adventurer?
translation: Sen ve kusurlu beynin nasil gidiyor, maceraci?

english: I've lost the amulet that Akthanakos gave me.
You really are an idiot, aren't you? You dropped it in here when you left. Try not to lose it next time.
translation: Sen gercekten bir aptalsin, degil mi? Buradan ayrilirken düsürdün. Bir dahaki sefere kaybetmemeye calis.

english: Hey! That's not very nice.
I'm not very nice. If you want to see who ruined all of my plans, adventurer, just look in a mirror.
translation: Ben pek hos biri degilim. Tüm planlarimi mahveden kisinin kim oldugunu görmek istiyorsan, maceraci, aynaya bak yeter.

english: Suit yourself. At least I got a nice amulet for my trouble.
translation: Sen bilirsin. En azindan zahmetime karsilik güzel bir muska aldim.

english: About that amulet - I might be able to improve it for you, for a fee. Have you got it with you?
translation: O muska hakkinda... Bir ücret karsiliginda onu senin icin iyilestirebilirim. Yaninda mi?

english: Yes, I've got it here.
Yes, it's what I thought. This amulet will run out of charges all the time, if you keep using it. For one million coins I can give it unlimited charges.
translation: Evet, düsündügüm gibi. Bu muska, kullanmaya devam edersen sürekli sarji bitecek. Bir milyon sikke karsiliginda ona sinirsiz sarj verebilirim.

english: Why do you need so much money for it?
translation: Neden bu kadar cok paraya ihtiyacin var?

english: Three reasons. Firstly, I'm a Zamorakian mage - we're not big on charity work. Secondly, I want the money. Finally, in case you need reminding, I hate you.
translation: Üc nedeni var. Birincisi, ben Zamorakian büyücüsüyüm, biz hayir isleriyle pek ilgilenmeyiz. Ikincisi, parayi istiyorum. Son olarak, hatirlatmam gerekirse, senden nefret ediyorum.

english: Right. Well, I haven't got that kind of money on me.
translation: Tamam. Ama o kadar param yok.

english: Okay, here's one million coins.
I'm not interested.
Your loss.
Maybe another time.
And don't forget who gave it unlimited charges for you!
translation: Ve sana sinirsiz güc verenin kim oldugunu unutma!

english: I couldn't do that!
Sure, sign me up!
Why do you need so much money for it?
translation: Neden bunun icin bu kadar cok paraya ihtiyacin var?

english: Okay, here's one million coins.
I'm not interested.
Maybe another time.
How are you doing?
I'm happy.
Really?
Really.
Really, really?
Really, really.
Really, really rea....
Stop right there.
Where?
There.
Here?
No there.
Agghhh!! Now you're at it.
At what?
It.
What's it?
You know... it...
Stop, stop, stop! Right we're going to play a little game now.
translation: Dur, dur, dur! Tamam, simdi kücük bir oyun oynayacagiz.

english: Is it going to be fun? Is it? Is it? Is it?
translation: Eglenceli olacak mi? Olacak mi? Olacak mi? Olacak mi?

english: It's called give the cat some peace.
How do you play?
You gently stroke your cat, then pick it up and finally leave it for an extended snooze in your backpack.
translation: Kedini nazikce oksarsin, sonra onu kucagina alirsin ve sonunda sirt cantanda uzun bir sekerleme yapmasi icin birakirsin.

english: That doesn't sound like much fun. I'd rather spend quality time annoying you.
translation: Bu pek eglenceli gelmiyor. Seni rahatsiz ederek kaliteli zaman gecirmeyi tercih ederim.

english: I'd never have guessed. Well in that case I would be really annoyed if you took me hunting rats.
translation: Hic tahmin edemezdim. Öyleyse beni fare avina götürürsen cok sinirlenirim.

english: AGHHHHH!!!!
How old are you now?
I thought I asked you your age not how you were?
translation: Sana yasini sormustum, nasil oldugunu degil.

english: Oh! My fault, well then to answer your question, I'd like to go to the Varrock sewers.
translation: Oh! Benim hatam, o zaman soruna cevap vermek gerekirse, Varrock kanalizasyonuna gitmek isterim.

english: What? Are you listening to me?
It's a quarter past tuesday.
Are you trying to dodge the question?
I think your amulet might be on the blink. Meoow, Miiiaaoow!
translation: Sanirim tilsimin bozulmus olabilir. Meoow, Miiiaaoow!

english: You examine the amulet of catspeak checking the centre gem for any flaws.
translation: Kedi dili tilsimini inceleyerek merkezdeki mücevherde herhangi bir kusur olup olmadigini kontrol ediyorsun.

english: Strange, it looks ok to me.
Hiss's'sss's.
~Your cat tries to hold in a snigger, but fails miserably.
translation: ~Kediniz kikirdamayi bastirmaya calisiyor, ama basarisiz oluyor.

english: Where do you want to go?
Well one place I don't want to go is the ratpits.
translation: Gitmek istemedigim tek yer fare cukurlari.

english: Why's that?
All the other cats will make fun of me, I'm so badly out of shape. Take me hunting.
translation: Diger kediler benimle dalga gececek, cünkü cok formdan düsmüs durumdayim. Beni ava götür.

english: Don't worry cat, I'll get you back in shape.
translation: Merak etme kedi, seni tekrar forma sokacagim.

english: What do you want to do now?
I'm happy just pottering around.
Do you fancy a bit of hunting?
To be perfectly honest, I'd rather just lay about and groom myself. Looking at the state of your get up I reckon you would do well to follow suit.
translation: Dürüst olmak gerekirse, ben sadece uzanip kendime bakmak istiyorum. Kiyafetinin durumuna bakilirsa, sen de aynisini yapsan iyi olur.

english: There's nothing wrong with how I'm dressed.
That dragon armour you're wearing is so like last year.
translation: Giydigin ejderha zirhi gecen seneki gibi.

english: That thing you're wearing is so like last year.
I refuse to take fashion advice from a cat, a fat lazy one to boot!
translation: Bir kediden, üstelik sisman ve tembel bir kediden moda tavsiyesi almayi reddediyorum!

english: Meeoow! I think someone is a bit touchy todaySSS.
translation: Miyav! Sanirim bugün biri biraz alingan.

english: That's the last time I ask you what you want to do.
translation: Bu sana ne yapmak istedigini sordugum son sefer.

english: I'm content. A little more action might be good, but then again you might ruffle up my fur and then I'd have to groom all over again.
translation: Ben memnunum. Biraz daha hareketlilik iyi olabilir, ama o zaman tüylerim daginik olur ve yeniden timarlamam gerekir.

english: Pah! You're the laziest old bag of fluff I've ever met.
translation: Peh! Sen tanidigim en tembel yasli tüylü yaratiksin.

english: A little older than I was before and not as old as I will be in another bit.
translation: Eskisine göre biraz daha yasliyim ama biraz sonra olacagim kadar yasli degilim.

english: What kind of answer is that?
Well your idea of time and mine are too different for either of us to understand the other.
translation: Senin zaman kavraminla benimki cok farkli, ikimiz de birbirimizi anlayamiyoruz.

english: Umm.. I don't really understand.
Well for one I don't count the time I spend in your bank - which is horribly boring nor in your bag.
translation: Öncelikle, senin bankanda gecirdigim zamani saymiyorum, cünkü cok sikici, cantanda gecirdigim zamani da saymiyorum.

english: Well that's not too complicated.
I'm just getting started. Now there is also a difference in cat years and human years. To approximate time in cat years you take a value in years subtract 1 multiply it by 4 and then add 16.
translation: Daha yeni basladim. Ayrica kedi yasi ile insan yasi arasinda da bir fark var. Kedi yasini yaklasik olarak hesaplamak icin, yas degerinden 1 cikar, 4 ile carp ve 16 ekle.

english: Ummm... so if... a cat is newly born it's already 12 cat years old?
translation: Yani... yeni dogmus bir kedi zaten 12 kedi yasinda mi oluyor?

english: I said approximate not calculate. Anyway it only works once the cat is 1 year old. Anyway the last complication is the discrepancy of rune years and earth years, which to date nobody has worked out.
translation: Yaklasik olarak dedim, hesapla demedim. Zaten bu yöntem sadece kedi 1 yasina geldiginde ise yariyor. Son olarak, rune yillari ile dünya yillari arasindaki fark da bir baska karmasik konudur ve bugüne kadar kimse bunu cözememistir.

english: Umm... anyway back to the question, how old are you in cat years then?
translation: Peki, sorumuza geri dönelim, kedi yasina göre kac yasindasin?

english: Uh.. I don't know. I must be so old now that I've forgotten what age I am.
translation: Bilmiyorum. O kadar yaslandim ki kac yasinda oldugumu unuttum.

english: Hmph!
Somewhere nice and quiet. I'm a bit behind in my snoozing schedule.
translation: Güzel ve sakin bir yer. Uyku programimin biraz gerisinde kaldim.

english: Sleep.
How am I going to get you back in shape if all you want to do is sleep?
translation: Tek istedigin uyumaksa, seni nasil forma sokacagim?

english: Surgery. That's the answer to all our problems.
