Leagues are time-limited challenges that provide a unique twist on the world you know and love.
translation: Ligler, bildiginiz ve sevdiginiz dünyaya benzersiz bir dokunus katan, süre sinirli mücadelelerdir.

english: With each League, you start afresh, with a limited amount of time to progress through the League.
translation: Her Ligde, Ligde ilerlemek icin sinirli bir süre ile yeni bir baslangic yaparsiniz.

english: A fresh start? Why would I want that?
translation: Yeni bir baslangic mi? Neden bunu isteyeyim ki?

english: Glory, gold, and the chance to do things in a different way!
translation: San, söhret, altin ve farkli bir sekilde seyler yapma sansi!

english: First up, the glory. Within a League, you can earn League Points by completing various tasks.
translation: Öncelikle san. Bir Ligde, cesitli görevleri tamamlayarak Lig Puanlari kazanabilirsiniz.

english: The more points you have at the end of the League, the better League Rank you will be given.
translation: Ligin sonunda ne kadar cok puaniniz olursa, o kadar iyi bir Lig Siralamasi alirsiniz.

english: Each League Rank will unlock a trophy for you. These trophies can be used to show off your accomplishments.
translation: Her Lig Siralamasi size bir kupa kazandirir. Bu kupalar, basarilarinizi sergilemek icin kullanilabilir.

english: If that doesn't interest you, how about gold! League Points can be used to buy things from the Leagues Reward Shop.
translation: Bu ilginizi cekmiyorsa, peki ya altin? Lig Puanlari, Lig Ödül Magazasindan alisveris yapmak icin kullanilabilir.

english: You can keep these purchases for yourself or sell them on to others!
translation: Bu satin aldiklarinizi kendiniz icin saklayabilir veya baskalarina satabilirsiniz!

english: And if glory and gold don't interest me?
translation: Peki ya söhret ve altin ilgimi cekmezse?

english: Every League has unique rules and features. It's a very different world from the one you're used to.
translation: Her Lig'in kendine özgü kurallari ve özellikleri vardir. Bu, alistiginiz dünyadan cok farkli bir dünyadir.

english: For one thing, within the Leagues, you can unlock powerful artefacts known as Relics which completely change the way you progress.
translation: Örnegin, Ligler icinde, ilerlemenizi tamamen degistiren Relics olarak bilinen güclü eserlerin kilidini acabilirsiniz.

english: I see, thanks for the information.
My pleasure!
Is there currently a League running?
translation: Su anda devam eden bir Lig var mi?

english: There is currently no League running.
translation: Su anda devam eden bir Lig yok.

english: Can I purchase some League rewards?
Certainly! I have a number of unique rewards which you might be interested in.
translation: Elbette! Ilginizi cekebilecek bir dizi benzersiz ödülüm var.

english: Can we talk about League Trophies?
Of course! What would you like to know?
How do League Trophies work?
League Trophies are a representation of how well you did in a specific League. Performance is judged on the number of League Points you earned.
translation: Lig Kupalari, belirli bir Ligde ne kadar basarili oldugunuzu gösterir. Performans, kazandiginiz Lig Puani sayisina göre degerlendirilir.

english: There are seven tiers of League Trophy: Bronze, Iron, Steel, Mithril, Adamant, Rune and Dragon.
translation: Lig Kupasi'nin yedi seviyesi vardir: Bronz, Demir, Celik, Mithril, Adamant, Rune ve Ejderha.

english: I'd like to claim some League Trophies.
What are the League Point cut-offs for the League Trophies?
translation: Lig Kupalari icin Lig Puani sinirlari nedir?

english: Which League do you want to know about?
translation: Hangi Lig hakkinda bilgi almak istiyorsunuz?

english: Leagues I - Twisted.
The Bronze Trophy cut-off is 10 points. The Iron Trophy cut-off is 80 points. The Steel Trophy cut-off is 510 points.
translation: Bronz Kupa icin gerekli puan 10'dur. Demir Kupa icin gerekli puan 80'dir. Celik Kupa icin gerekli puan 510'dur.

english: The Mithril Trophy cut-off is 1,770 points. The Adamant Trophy cut-off is 5,270 points. The Rune Trophy cut-off is 10,820 points.
translation: Mithril Kupa icin gerekli puan 1.770'dir. Adamant Kupa icin gerekli puan 5.270'dir. Rune Kupa icin gerekli puan 10.820'dir.

english: Finally, the Dragon Trophy cut-off is 20,830 points.
translation: Son olarak, Ejderha Kupasi icin gerekli puan 20.830'dur.

english: You earned 0 League Points in Leagues I: Twisted. Sadly, that means you are not eligible for any Twisted Trophies.
translation: Lig I: Twisted'da 0 Lig Puani kazandiniz. Ne yazik ki, bu Twisted Kupalari icin hak kazanamadiginiz anlamina geliyor.

english: You earned [number] League Points in Leagues I - Twisted. That makes you eligible for the Twisted [type] Trophy and all Twisted Trophies under it!
Leagues II - Trailblazer.
The Bronze Trophy cut-off is 100 points. The Iron Trophy cut-off is 510 points. The Steel Trophy cut-off is 2,000 points.
translation: Bronz Kupa icin gerekli puan 100'dür. Demir Kupa icin gerekli puan 510'dur. Celik Kupa icin gerekli puan 2.000'dir.

english: The Mithril Trophy cut-off is 6,480 points. The Adamant Trophy cut-off is 18,720 points. The Rune Trophy cut-off is 35,680 points.
translation: Mithril Kupa icin gerekli puan 6.480'dir. Adamant Kupa icin gerekli puan 18.720'dir. Rune Kupa icin gerekli puan 35.680'dir.

english: Finally, the Dragon Trophy cut-off is 56,310 points.
translation: Son olarak, Dragon Trophy icin gerekli puan 56.310'dur.

english: You earned 0 League Points in Leagues II: Trailblazer. Sadly, that means you are not eligible for any Trailblazer Trophies.
translation: Leagues II: Trailblazer'da 0 Lig Puani kazandiniz. Ne yazik ki, bu Trailblazer Trophy'leri kazanmaya hak kazanamadiginiz anlamina geliyor.

english: You earned [number] League Points in Leagues II - Trailblazer. That makes you eligible for the Trailblazer [type] Trophy and all Trailblazer Trophies under it!
Leagues III: Shattered Relics.
The Bronze Trophy cut-off is 100 points. The Iron Trophy cut-off is 480 points. The Steel Trophy cut-off is 1,660 points.
translation: Bronz Kupa icin gerekli puan 100'dür. Demir Kupa icin gerekli puan 480'dir. Celik Kupa icin gerekli puan 1.660'dir.

english: The Mithril Trophy cut-off is 5,475 points. The Adamant Trophy cut-off is 15,575 points. The Rune Trophy cut-off is 31,980 points.
translation: Mithril Kupa icin gerekli puan 5.475'tir. Adamant Kupa icin gerekli puan 15.575'tir. Rune Kupasi icin gerekli puan 31.980'dir.

english: Finally, the Dragon Trophy cut-off is 52,545 points.
translation: Son olarak, Dragon Kupasi icin gerekli puan 52.545'tir.

english: You earned 0 League Points in Leagues III: Shattered Relics. Sadly, that means you are not eligible for any Shattered Relics Trophies.
translation: Lig III: Parcalanmis Kalintilar'da 0 Lig Puani kazandiniz. Ne yazik ki, bu Parcalanmis Kalintilar Kupalari icin hak kazanamadiginiz anlamina geliyor.

english: Leagues IV: Trailblazer Reloaded.
The Bronze Trophy cut-off is 2,500 points. The Iron Trophy cut-off is 5,000 points. The Steel Trophy cut- off is 10,000 points.
translation: Bronz Kupa icin gerekli puan 2.500'dür. Demir Kupa icin gerekli puan 5.000'dir. Celik Kupa icin gerekli puan 10.000'dir.

english: The Mithril Trophy cut-off is 18,000 points. The Adamant Trophy cut-off is 28,000 points. The Rune Trophy cut-off is 42,000 points.
translation: Mithril Kupa icin gerekli puan 18.000'dir. Adamant Kupa icin gerekli puan 28.000'dir. Rune Kupa icin gerekli puan 42.000'dir.

english: You earned 0 League Points in Leagues IV: Trailblazer Reloaded. Sadly, that means you are not eligible for any Trailblazer Reloaded Trophies.
translation: Leagues IV: Trailblazer Reloaded'da 0 Lig Puani kazandiniz. Ne yazik ki, bu Trailblazer Reloaded Kupalari icin hak kazanamadiginiz anlamina geliyor.

english: Actually, let's talk about something else.
Very well.
Goodbye.
All the best.
I'm good, thanks.
Very well. I'll be here if you ever need to know anything more.
translation: Peki. Daha fazla bilgiye ihtiyaciniz olursa ben buradayim.

english: Glory, rewards, and the chance to do things in a different way!
translation: Söhret, ödüller ve farkli seyler yapma sansi!

english: The more points you have, the better League Rank you will be given.
translation: Ne kadar cok puaniniz olursa, o kadar iyi Lig Siralamasi alirsiniz.

english: If that doesn't interest you, perhaps another reward might be more appealing? League Points can be used to buy things from the Leagues Reward Shop.
translation: Bu sizi ilgilendirmiyorsa, belki baska bir ödül daha cazip gelebilir? Lig Puanlari, Lig Ödül Magazasindan alisveris yapmak icin kullanilabilir.

english: And if glory and rewards don't interest me?
translation: Peki ya söhret ve ödüller beni ilgilendirmiyorsa?

english: So even if glory and rewards aren't your thing, you'll still find Leagues to be a whole lot of fun!
translation: San ve ödüller ilginizi cekmese bile, Liglerin cok eglenceli oldugunu göreceksiniz!

english: I see. So how do I take part?
Well sadly, only Members are eligible to take part in Leagues. I'll be happy to help once you become one.
translation: Maalesef, sadece Üyeler Liglere katilabilir. Üye oldugunuzda size memnuniyetle yardimci olurum.

english: Do you have anything to trade?
translation: Takas edecek bir seyiniz var mi?

english: Unfortunately I'm unable to trade with non-members. I'll be happy to help once you are one.
translation: Maalesef üye olmayanlarla takas yapamiyorum. Üye oldugunuzda size memnuniyetle yardimci olurum.

english: Yes! The current League is Leagues V: Raging Echoes.
translation: Evet! Su anki Lig, Ligler V: Raging Echoes.

english: This League features powerful boss variants in each region, and Combat Masteries to enhance your chosen combat style's strengths.
translation: Bu Ligde, her bölgede güclü boss varyantlari ve sectiginiz savas stilinin güclü yanlarini gelistiren Savas Ustaliklari bulunuyor.

english: As usual, you are restricted to certain regions around Gielinor - although you'll get to choose which ones.
translation: Her zamanki gibi, Gielinor cevresindeki belirli bölgelerle sinirlisiniz, ancak hangilerini sececeginiz size kalmis.

english: You can also collect powerful artifacts known as Relics. Each one provides a different buff to your League experience.
translation: Ayrica, Relics olarak bilinen güclü eserleri de toplayabilirsiniz. Her biri, Lig deneyiminize farkli bir güclendirme saglar.

english: There's one that lets you keep a kingdom in your pocket, and one that lets you become a Slayer Master!
translation: Biri, cebinizde bir krallik tutmanizi saglarken, digeri ise Slayer Master olmanizi saglar!

english: One other thing. You must participate as an Ironman. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.
translation: Bir sey daha var. Ironman olarak katilmaniz gerekir. Bu, tek basiniza oldugunuz ve diger katilimcilarla ticaret yapamayacaginiz anlamina gelir.

english: Interesting. Maybe I should take part!
I'd highly recommend it!
What's a League?
Is there currently a League running?
translation: Su anda devam eden bir Lig var mi?

english: Can I purchase some League rewards?
Can we talk about League Trophies?
How do League Trophies work?
I'd like to claim some League Trophies.
translation: Bazi Lig Kupalari talep etmek istiyorum.

english: What are the League Point cut-offs for the League Trophies?
translation: Lig Kupalari icin Lig Puani sinirlari nedir?

english: Leagues I - Twisted.
Leagues II - Trailblazer.
Leagues III: Shattered Relics
Leagues IV: Trailblazer Reloaded.
Actually, let's talk about something else.
Goodbye.
I'm good, thanks.
Hello! Do you have any questions for me?
translation: Merhaba! Bana soracaginiz bir sey var mi?

english: What changes have been made for this League?
translation: Bu Lig icin ne gibi degisiklikler yapildi?

english: All sorts of things! I can't recount all of the information for you, but I can give you the basics though.
translation: Her türlü degisiklik yapildi! Size tüm bilgileri anlatamam, ama temel bilgileri verebilirim.

english: During this League, you are initially restricted to the Kingdom of Misthalin. However, as you progress, you'll be able to unlock new areas of your choosing.
translation: Bu Lig sirasinda, baslangicta Misthalin Kralligi ile sinirlisiniz. Ancak ilerledikce, sectiginiz yeni alanlarin kilidini acabileceksiniz.

english: Be warned though - you won't be able to unlock every area, so choose wisely.
translation: Ancak dikkatli olun, her alani acamayacaksiniz, bu yüzden akillica secim yapin.

english: Now, for the entire League, you must participate as an Iron Man. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.
translation: Simdi, tüm Lig boyunca Iron Man olarak katilmalisiniz. Bu, tek basiniza oldugunuz ve diger katilimcilarla ticaret yapamayacaginiz anlamina gelir.

english: And that's not all. Training skills during the League will grant you substantially more experience than you'd normally expect!
translation: Ve hepsi bu kadar degil. Lig sirasinda becerilerinizi gelistirmek, normalde beklediginizden cok daha fazla deneyim kazanmanizi saglayacak!

english: Finally, some quests have been completed for you automatically. Further quests will be completed as you unlock the relevant areas.
translation: Son olarak, bazi görevler sizin icin otomatik olarak tamamlandi. Ilgili alanlari actikca daha fazla görev tamamlanacak.

english: I think that covers the basics. Would you like to see some more in-depth information?
translation: Sanirim temel bilgiler bu kadar. Daha ayrintili bilgi almak ister misiniz?

english: Yes, please.
Not right now.
Fair enough. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Anliyorum. Yardimci olabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: How do tasks work?
In every League, there are a number of tasks for you to complete. Each task has a level of difficulty: Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite and Master.
translation: Her Lig'de tamamlamaniz gereken bir dizi görev vardir. Her görevin bir zorluk seviyesi vardir: Kolay, Orta, Zor, Elit ve Usta.

english: Completing tasks allows you to access new areas. The more tasks completed, the more areas available to unlock.
translation: Görevleri tamamlamak, yeni alanlara erismenizi saglar. Ne kadar cok görev tamamlarsaniz, o kadar cok alanin kilidini acabilirsiniz.

english: Not only that, completing tasks also earns you League Points. The number of points earned is dependent on the difficulty of the task.
translation: Sadece bu da degil, görevleri tamamladiginizda Lig Puanlari da kazanirsiniz. Kazandiginiz puan sayisi, görevin zorluk derecesine baglidir.

english: What do these points do?
Once you have achieved a certain amount of League Points you can unlock a new Relic! These are powerful artefacts to help you in the League.
translation: Belirli bir miktar Lig Puani kazandiginizda, yeni bir Kalinti'nin kilidini acabilirsiniz! Bunlar, Lig'de size yardimci olacak güclü eserlerdir.

english: League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.
translation: Lig Puanlari, Lig Ödül Magazasi'ndan ödüller satin almak icin de kullanilabilir.

english: Right now, you are playing on your Leagues profile. The Leagues Reward Shop can only be opened on your main profile.
translation: Su anda Lig profilinizde oynuyorsunuz. Lig Ödül Magazasi sadece ana profilinizde acilabilir.

english: You can access your main profile by switching to any normal Old School RuneScape world. The world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.
translation: Herhangi bir normal Old School RuneScape dünyasina gecerek ana profilinize erisebilirsiniz. Oturumu kapatma menüsündeki dünya degistirici, dünyalar arasinda gecis yapmak icin kullanilabilir.

english: So how many tasks are there?
More than you'll ever be able to complete, most likely. With so many to choose from, it's up to you which ones you go for.
translation: Muhtemelen tamamlayabileceginizden daha fazla. Secebileceginiz cok fazla görev oldugundan, hangilerini sececeginiz size kalmis.

english: Thanks!
Not a problem. Now, would you like to take a look at the tasks for this League?
translation: Rica ederim. Simdi, bu Lig'in görevlerine bir göz atmak ister misiniz?

english: How does the area system work?
In this League, you are initially locked to the Kingdom of Misthalin and the island of Karamja. However, as you progress, you can unlock more areas.
translation: Bu Lig'de, baslangicta Misthalin Kralligi ve Karamja adasina kilitlisiniz. Ancak ilerledikce daha fazla alanin kilidini acabilirsiniz.

english: There are nine different areas in total. However, you can only unlock a maximum of five, including Misthalin and Karamja, so choose wisely.
translation: Toplamda dokuz farkli alan vardir. Ancak, Misthalin ve Karamja dahil olmak üzere en fazla bes alanin kilidini acabilirsiniz, bu yüzden akillica secim yapin.

english: The first two area unlocks are given to everyone. However, the other three unlocks are unavailable to begin with.
translation: Ilk iki alan kilidi herkese verilir. Ancak, diger üc kilit baslangicta kullanilamaz.

english: You can access these additional area unlocks by completing tasks. The more tasks you've completed, the more areas you can unlock.
translation: Bu ek alan kilitlerine görevleri tamamlayarak erisebilirsiniz. Ne kadar cok görev tamamlarsaniz, o kadar cok alanin kilidini acabilirsiniz.

english: I see. Thanks!
Would you like to take a look at the available areas now?
translation: Simdi mevcut alanlara bir göz atmak ister misiniz?

english: Relics, or Trailblazer Relics to give them their full name, are powerful artefacts that grant unique abilities for the entire League!
translation: Relics, ya da tam adiyla Trailblazer Relics, tüm Lig'e benzersiz yetenekler kazandiran güclü eserlerdir!

english: There are eighteen separate Relics, split across six different tiers. You can only have one Relic from each tier though.
translation: Alti farkli seviyeye ayrilmis on sekiz ayri Relic vardir. Ancak her seviyeden yalnizca bir Relic alabilirsiniz.

english: The first Relic tier is available to everyone. However, the higher tiers are locked to begin with.
translation: Ilk Relic seviyesi herkes tarafindan kullanilabilir. Ancak, daha yüksek seviyeler baslangicta kilitlidir.

english: You can unlock these higher tiers by earning League Points. League Points are earned by completing tasks.
translation: Bu üst seviyeleri Lig Puanlari kazanarak acabilirsiniz. Lig Puanlari, görevleri tamamlayarak kazanilir.

english: Be warned, you'll need to choose carefully when picking a Relic. Once you have selected a Relic, your choice can't be changed for the rest of the League.
translation: Dikkatli olun, Relic secerken dikkatli olmalisiniz. Bir Relic sectikten sonra, Lig'in geri kalaninda seciminizi degistiremezsiniz.

english: Anyway, it looks like you have a Relic available for selection right now! Would you like to take a look?
translation: Her neyse, su anda secebileceginiz bir Relic var gibi görünüyor! Bir göz atmak ister misiniz?

english: Tell me about League rewards.
As well as letting you unlock new areas, completing tasks in the League will earn you League Points. The more League Points you have, the more Trailblazer Relic tiers you have available.
translation: Ligde görevleri tamamlayarak yeni alanlarin kilidini acmanin yani sira Lig Puanlari da kazanirsiniz. Ne kadar cok Lig Puaniniz olursa, o kadar cok Öncü Kalinti kademesine erisebilirsiniz.

english: However, alongside allowing you to unlock Trailblazer Relics, League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.
translation: Ancak Lig Puanlari, Öncü Kalintilarin kilidini acmanin yani sira Lig Ödül Dükkani'ndan ödüller satin almak icin de kullanilabilir.

english: What rewards can I buy?
All sorts of things! There's some new furniture for your house, an alternate animation for your Home Teleport spell and some new stylish outfits, just to name a few.
translation: Her türlü seyi! Eviniz icin yeni mobilyalar, Ev Teleport büyüsü icin alternatif animasyonlar ve yeni sik kiyafetler, bunlardan sadece birkaci.

english: Most of the rewards can be traded with others, so if you want, you can earn some money by selling them on. Of course, you might prefer to keep them for yourself instead.
translation: Ödüllerin cogu baskalariyla takas edilebilir, yani isterseniz bunlari satarak para kazanabilirsiniz. Tabii ki, bunlari kendiniz icin saklamayi tercih edebilirsiniz.

english: I see. That all sounds good to me.
One thing to be aware of is that the Trailblazer rewards won't be available until the League has ended. You can still buy rewards from previous Leagues though.
translation: Dikkat etmeniz gereken bir nokta, Trailblazer ödüllerinin Lig sona erene kadar kullanilamayacagidir. Ancak önceki Liglerden ödüller satin almaya devam edebilirsiniz.

english: Now, alongside the rewards in the Leagues Reward Shop, there's also League Ranks.
translation: Simdi, Lig Ödül Magazasindaki ödüllerin yani sira Lig Siralamalari da var.

english: League Ranks? How do they work?
At the end of the League, you will be given a League Rank. This is based upon the number of League Points you have earned compared to the other participants.
translation: Lig sona erdiginde, size bir Lig Siralamasi verilir. Bu, diger katilimcilara kiyasla kazandiginiz Lig Puani sayisina göre belirlenir.

english: Anyone who earns at least 100 League Points will be eligible for the Bronze rank. The top 80% of participants get the Iron rank. The top 60% get Steel.
translation: En az 100 Lig Puani kazanan herkes Bronz siralamasina hak kazanir. Katilimcilarin en iyi %80'i Demir siralamasina hak kazanir. En iyi %60'i Celik siralamasina hak kazanir.

english: The top 40% get Mithril. The top 20% get Adamant. The top 5% get Rune. The best participants, those who make it to the top 1%, get the Dragon rank!
translation: En iyi %40'i Mithril siralamasina hak kazanir. En iyi %20'si Adamant siralamasina hak kazanir. En iyi %5'i Rune siralamasina hak kazanir. En iyi katilimcilar, yani en iyi %1'e girenler, Ejderha siralamasina hak kazanir!

english: When the League ends, your rank will determine what trophy you get. These trophies symbolise your performance in the League.
translation: Lig sona erdiginde, siralamaniz hangi kupayi alacaginizi belirler. Bu kupalar, Lig'deki performansinizi sembolize eder.

english: Trophies?
That's right. Trophies are items that are given to you after the League. You can use them to show off your League Rank!
translation: Evet, dogru. Kupalar, Lig'in ardindan size verilen ögelerdir. Bunlari, Lig Siralamanizi göstermek icin kullanabilirsiniz!

english: Connected to League Ranks are the League to League rewards. These are unlocked in the next League based upon the League Rank you earn in this one!
translation: Lig Siralamalari ile baglantili olan Ligden Lig'e ödüller vardir. Bunlar, bu Lig'de kazandiginiz Lig Siralamasina göre bir sonraki Lig'de acilir!

english: League Starter Outfits and League Icons are some of things you can unlock for the next League. Also, any pets you earn in this League will transfer over to the next one.
translation: Lig Baslangic Kiyafetleri ve Lig Simgeleri, bir sonraki Lig icin acabileceginiz ögelerden bazilaridir. Ayrica, bu Ligde kazandiginiz tüm evcil hayvanlar bir sonraki lige aktarilir.

english: Finally, on top of the tasks for this League, there are some other activities for which I will recognise the first person who completes them.
translation: Son olarak, bu Ligdeki görevlerin yani sira, ilk tamamlayan kisiyi ödüllendirecegim baska etkinlikler de var.

english: You can view the entire list of activities, as well as whether or not someone has completed them, by reading the board beside me.
translation: Etkinliklerin tam listesini ve bunlarin tamamlanip tamamlanmadigini yanimdaki panodan görebilirsiniz.

english: Not a problem. Now, is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Sorun degil. Baska yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Let's talk about pets.
Can you tell me how pets work in Leagues?
translation: Liglerde evcil hayvanlar nasil calisir, anlatabilir misin?

english: Of course! If you're lucky enough to obtain a pet during a League, it will automatically be insured for you.
translation: Tabii ki! Lig sirasinda sansliysan ve bir evcil hayvan elde edersen, otomatik olarak sigortalanir.

english: This means that if you were to ever lose it, you can talk to me and I'll give it back to you. Insurance and reclaiming is all free!
translation: Bu, onu kaybedersen bana gelip geri alabilecegin anlamina gelir. Sigorta ve geri alma tamamen ücretsizdir!

english: Additionally, each pet you obtain will be transferred to the next League. It'll be waiting with me for you to reclaim it!
translation: Ayrica, elde ettiginiz her evcil hayvan bir sonraki Lig'e aktarilir. Benimle birlikte geri almanizi bekleyecektir!

english: Okay! Thank you.
No worries. Come back to me once you have some pets and you can view your collection! Now, is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Önemli degil. Evcil hayvanlariniz oldugunda bana geri gelin, koleksiyonunuzu görebilirsiniz! Baska yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: You receive some items from the Leagues Tutor.
Very well. I'll be here if you ever need to know anything about Leagues.
translation: Cok iyi. Ligler hakkinda bilmeniz gereken bir sey olursa ben buradayim.

english: Every League has unique rules and features to set it aside from the world you're used to.
translation: Her Lig, alistiginiz dünyadan farkli kilan kendine özgü kurallara ve özelliklere sahiptir.

english: Not only that, but within this League, you can unlock powerful artefacts known as Fragments. Fragments completely change the way you progress through the League!
translation: Sadece bu da degil, bu Ligde Fragment olarak bilinen güclü eserlerin kilidini acabilirsiniz. Fragmentler, Ligde ilerleme seklinizi tamamen degistirir!

english: So even if glory and gold are not for you, you'll still find Leagues to be a whole lot of fun!
translation: Yani san ve söhret sizin icin önemli olmasa bile, Liglerin cok eglenceli oldugunu göreceksiniz!

english: Well sadly you're not eligible to take part in a League right now. I'll be happy to help once you are though.
translation: Maalesef su anda Lig'e katilmaya hak kazanamadiniz. Ancak hak kazandiginizda size memnuniyetle yardimci olacagim.

english: Yes! The current League is Leagues III - Shattered Relics.
translation: Evet! Su anki Lig, Lig III - Parcalanmis Kalintilar'dir.

english: Within this League you are restricted to three skills: Defence, Fishing and Thieving, you can unlock more skills by completing tasks to earn Sage's Renown.
translation: Bu Lig'de üc beceriyle sinirlisiniz: Savunma, Balikcilik ve Hirsizlik. Görevleri tamamlayarak Sage'in Söhretini kazanarak daha fazla beceri acabilirsiniz.

english: Sage's Renown can be used to purchase access to Skills, Bosses and to Auto Complete Quests.
translation: Sage'in Renown'u, Becerilere, Bosslara ve Otomatik Görev Tamamlama'ya erisim satin almak icin kullanilabilir.

english: You can also collect powerful artifacts known as Fragments, each Fragment provides a different buff so be sure to collect them all.
translation: Ayrica, Fragment olarak bilinen güclü eserleri de toplayabilirsiniz. Her Fragment farkli bir güclendirme saglar, bu yüzden hepsini topladiginizdan emin olun.

english: You can level up these Fragments to make them even stronger, you can also bring together different Fragments to activate powerful buffs known as Set Effects.
translation: Bu Fragmentleri seviye atlatarak daha da güclü hale getirebilirsiniz. Ayrica, farkli Fragmentleri bir araya getirerek Set Effects olarak bilinen güclü güclendirmeleri etkinlestirebilirsiniz.

english: I heard there's one that lets you swap between Magic spellbooks whenever you want!
translation: Istediginiz zaman büyü kitaplari arasinda gecis yapmanizi saglayan bir tane oldugunu duydum!

english: Not only that, but you must participate as an Iron Man. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.
translation: Sadece bu da degil, Iron Man olarak katilmaniz gerekiyor. Bu, tek basiniza oldugunuz ve diger katilimcilarla ticaret yapamayacaginiz anlamina gelir.

english: Interesting. Maybe I should take part.
I'd highly recommend it.
The Leagues Reward Shop is temporarily closed.
translation: Lig Ödül Magazasi gecici olarak kapalidir.

english: League Trophies are a representation of how well you did in a specific League. Performance is judged on the number of League Points you earned compared to everyone else who participated.
translation: Lig Kupalari, belirli bir Ligde ne kadar basarili oldugunuzu gösterir. Performansiniz, katilan diger tüm katilimcilara kiyasla kazandiginiz Lig Puani sayisina göre degerlendirilir.

english: Of course!
You have not earned any League trophies. If you want a League trophy you should participate next time a League comes around!
translation: Hic Lig kupasi kazanmadiniz. Lig kupasi istiyorsaniz, bir sonraki Ligde katilmalisiniz!

english: You receive a League trophy from the Leagues Tutor.
You do not have enough space for all the League Trophies available to you. Come back to me when you do.
translation: Kazanabileceginiz tüm Lig Kupalari icin yeterli alaniniz yok. Yeterli alaniniz oldugunda tekrar gelin.

english: Ah! Looks like you have already claimed all of the League Trophies available to you.
translation: Ah! Görünüse göre mevcut tüm Lig Kupalarini zaten aldiniz.

english: You earned 0 League points which does not qualify you for any trophy.
translation: 0 Lig puani kazandiniz, bu da herhangi bir kupa almaya hak kazanamadiginiz anlamina geliyor.

english: Hi there.
Hello. Who are you?
I'm the Tutor for Leagues. If you have any questions about Leagues, I can help you out.
translation: Ben Liglerin Egitmeni'yim. Liglerle ilgili herhangi bir sorunuz varsa size yardimci olabilirim.

english: What changes have been made for this League?
translation: Bu Ligde ne gibi degisiklikler yapildi?

english: Yes, please.
Not right now.
How do tasks work?
How does the area system work?
What are Relics?
Tell me about League rewards.
Let's talk about pets.
Do I have any League items to collect?
Hello! Welcome to the Twisted League. I see you are new here.
translation: Merhaba! Twisted League'e hos geldiniz. Buraya yeni geldiginizi görüyorum.

english: Yes, this is my first League. Can you explain how they work?
translation: Evet, bu benim ilk Ligim. Nasil calistiklarini aciklayabilir misiniz?

english: I'd be happy to!
First of all, I'm your Leagues Tutor. If you have any questions about how Leagues work, you can come to me for help.
translation: Öncelikle, ben senin Lig Egitmeninim. Liglerin nasil calistigiyla ilgili herhangi bir sorunun olursa bana gelip yardim isteyebilirsin.

english: Now, Leagues are time-limited modes that give you a new way to play the game. For this League, you are restricted to the Kourend and Kebos regions, and you play as an Iron Man.
translation: Ligler, oyuna yeni bir oynama sekli sunan, süre sinirli modlardir. Bu Ligde, Kourend ve Kebos bölgeleriyle sinirlisin ve Iron Man olarak oynuyorsun.

english: Let's take a look at all of the information available about this League. There is a new section in the journal tab whilst on a Leagues world. Click on the flashing quest icon to take a look.
translation: Bu Ligle ilgili mevcut tüm bilgilere bir göz atalim. Lig dünyasindayken günlük sekmesinde yeni bir bölüm var. Yanip sönen görev simgesine tiklayarak bir göz atin.

english: Now that you have your journal open, click on the flashing Leagues icon.
translation: Günlügünüzü actiktan sonra, yanip sönen Lig simgesine tiklayin.

english: This is the Leagues menu. Here you can view your progress through the current League. You can also open the various Leagues interfaces from here.
translation: Bu, Lig menüsüdür. Burada mevcut Lig'deki ilerlemenizi görebilirsiniz. Ayrica buradan cesitli Lig arayüzlerini de acabilirsiniz.

english: Your objective in each League is to complete tasks and earn League Points.
translation: Her Lig'deki amaciniz, görevleri tamamlamak ve Lig Puanlari kazanmaktir.

english: Tasks are split into five difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite and Master. The harder the task, the more points awarded.
translation: Görevler bes zorluk seviyesine ayrilmistir: Kolay, Orta, Zor, Elit ve Usta. Görev ne kadar zor olursa, o kadar cok puan kazanirsiniz.

english: Let's have a look at the tasks interface now. Click on the flashing button to open it.
translation: Simdi görev arayüzüne bir göz atalim. Acmak icin yanip sönen dügmeye tiklayin.

english: This is the tasks interface. Here you can see all the tasks available to you in this League. When you are ready to continue, close the interface by clicking on the cross in the corner of it.
translation: Bu, görev arayüzüdür. Burada, bu Lig'de size sunulan tüm görevleri görebilirsiniz. Devam etmeye hazir oldugunuzda, kösedeki carpi isaretine tiklayarak arayüzü kapatin.

english: Earning points during the League will allow you to unlock powerful Twisted Relics. The more League Points you have, the more Relics available to you.
translation: Lig sirasinda puan kazanmak, güclü Twisted Relics'leri acmaniza olanak tanir. Ne kadar cok Lig Puaniniz olursa, o kadar cok Relics'e erisebilirsiniz.

english: League Points are also transferred over to your main profile. There, they can be spent on rewards in the Leagues Reward Shop.
translation: Lig Puanlari da ana profilinize aktarilir. Orada, Lig Ödül Magazasi'ndaki ödüllere harcanabilirler.

english: Now let's have a look at the Twisted Relics. Click on the flashing button to take a look at the Relics interface.
translation: Simdi Twisted Relics'lere bir göz atalim. Yanip sönen dügmeye tiklayarak Relics arayüzüne bakabilirsiniz.

english: This is the Relics interface. Here you can unlock new Twisted Relics to be used during this League. When you are ready to continue, close the interface by clicking on the cross in the corner of it.
translation: Bu, Relics arayüzüdür. Burada, bu Lig sirasinda kullanmak üzere yeni Twisted Relics'lerin kilidini acabilirsiniz. Devam etmeye hazir oldugunuzda, kösesindeki carpi isaretine tiklayarak arayüzü kapatin.

english: There are a few changes to Kourend and Kebos which you may not be used to. You can view all of these changes on the information interface.
translation: Kourend ve Kebos'ta alisik olmadiginiz birkac degisiklik var. Tüm bu degisiklikleri bilgi arayüzünde görebilirsiniz.

english: Right, I think that's everything. If you need reminding of any of this information, you can either talk to me or read the information interface.
translation: Tamam, sanirim hepsi bu kadar. Bu bilgilerden herhangi birini hatirlamaniz gerekirse, benimle konusabilir veya bilgi arayüzünü okuyabilirsiniz.

english: Before you head off though, it's time to pick your first Relic! Choose carefully though, once you've picked a Relic you can't go back and change your decision.
translation: Ancak gitmeden önce, ilk Relic'inizi secme zamani! Dikkatli secin, cünkü bir Relic sectikten sonra geri dönüp kararinizi degistiremezsiniz.

english: Hi there.
Hello, who are you?
I'm the Tutor for Old School Leagues.
Old School Leagues are time-limited game modes that are separate from your main profile.
translation: Eski Okul Ligleri, ana profilinden ayri, zaman sinirli oyun modlaridir.

english: With each League, you start afresh, with a limited amount of time to progress through the game mode.
translation: Her Ligde, oyun modunda ilerlemek icin sinirli bir süre ile yeniden baslarsin.

english: So it's a fresh start? Why would I want that?
translation: Yani yeni bir baslangic mi? Neden bunu isteyeyim ki?

english: Glory, gold, and the chance to play the game in a different way!
translation: San, söhret, altin ve oyunu farkli bir sekilde oynama sansi!

english: Each League Rank will unlock a trophy for you. These trophies can be used to show off how well you did.
translation: Her Lig Siralamasi sana bir kupa acacaktir. Bu kupalar, ne kadar basarili oldugunu göstermek icin kullanilabilir.

english: If that doesn't interest you, how about gold! When you earn League Points, they will be transferred over to your main profile.
translation: Bu sizi ilgilendirmiyorsa, altin nasil olur? Lig Puanlari kazandiginizda, bunlar ana profilinize aktarilir.

english: These points can be used to buy things from the Leagues Reward Shop. You can keep these purchases for yourself or sell them on to other players!
translation: Bu puanlari Lig Ödül Magazasindan alisveris yapmak icin kullanabilirsiniz. Bu satin aldiklarinizi kendiniz icin saklayabilir veya diger oyunculara satabilirsiniz!

english: Leagues aren't just a copy of the normal game. Every League has unique rules and features to set it aside from the game you're used to.
translation: Ligler normal oyunun bir kopyasi degildir. Her Lig, alistiginiz oyundan farkli kilan benzersiz kurallara ve özelliklere sahiptir.

english: Not only that, but within each League, you can unlock powerful artefacts known as Relics. These Relics completely change the way you play the game!
translation: Sadece bu da degil, her Ligde, Relics olarak bilinen güclü eserlerin kilidini acabilirsiniz. Bu Relics, oyunu oynama seklinizi tamamen degistirir!

english: No, The most recent League was the Twisted League. You can now claim your trophies from the Twisted League and purchase rewards using your League points.
translation: Hayir, en son Lig Twisted League idi. Artik Twisted League'den kupalarinizi alabilir ve Lig puanlarinizi kullanarak ödüller satin alabilirsiniz.

english: League trophies are a representation of how well you did in a specific League. Performance is judged on the number of League points you earned compared to everyone else who participated.
translation: Lig kupalari, belirli bir Ligde ne kadar basarili oldugunuzu gösterir. Performans, katilan diger tüm oyunculara kiyasla kazandiginiz Lig puanlarina göre degerlendirilir.

english: There are seven tiers of Trophy: Bronze, Iron, Steel, Mithril, Adamant, Rune and Dragon. Each League trophy has a logo on the front so you can tell which League it was awarded from.
translation: Yedi kademeli kupa vardir: Bronz, Demir, Celik, Mithril, Adamant, Rune ve Ejderha. Her Lig kupasinin ön yüzünde bir logo bulunur, böylece hangi Lig'den verildigini anlayabilirsiniz.

english: What are the League point cut-offs for the Twisted League?
translation: Twisted League icin Lig puani sinirlari nelerdir?

english: Bronze trophy: 10 points, Iron trophy: 80 points, Steel trophy: 510 points, Mithril trophy: 1770 points.
translation: Bronz kupa: 10 puan, Demir kupa: 80 puan, Celik kupa: 510 puan, Mithril kupa: 1770 puan.

english: Adamant trophy: 5270 points, Rune trophy: 10820 points and the Dragon Trophy: 20830 points.
translation: Adamant kupasi: 5270 puan, Rune kupasi: 10820 puan ve Dragon Kupasi: 20830 puan.

english: You earned [number] League points which qualifies you for the all of the Twisted League trophies up to and including the Twisted [type] trophy!
Can I purchase my League rewards?
Certainly, I have a number of unique rewards which you can purchase using points earned competing in a League. Here is what is available.
translation: Elbette, Ligde yarisarak kazandiginiz puanlarla satin alabileceginiz bir dizi benzersiz ödülümüz var. Iste mevcut olanlar.

english: I'd like to claim my League trophies.
Of course, here are the trophies you have earned.
You do not have enough space for all the League trophies you can claim. Come back to me when you have more space.
translation: Alabileceginiz tüm Lig kupalari icin yeterli alaniniz yok. Daha fazla alaniniz oldugunda tekrar gelin.

english: You have already claimed all of the League trophies which you have earned.
translation: Kazanmis oldugunuz tüm Lig kupalarini zaten aldiniz.

english: How do League trophies work?
I'd like to claim my League trophies.
Maybe some other time.
Can I purchase my League rewards?
Hello.
Can I help you?
What do you do here?
Well, I can cure plain cowhides into pieces of leather ready for crafting.
translation: Sade sigir derilerini zanaat icin hazir deri parcalarina dönüstürebilirim.

english: I work with ordinary, hard or dragonhide leather and also snakeskin. What would you like to know about?
translation: Siradan, sert veya ejderha derisi ve ayrica yilan derisi ile calisiyorum. Ne hakkinda bilgi almak istersin?

english: Ordinary leather.
I can work one piece of cow hide into ordinary leather. It only costs one piece of gold.
translation: Bir parca sigir derisini siradan deriye dönüstürebilirim. Sadece bir altin parcasi tutar.

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: Hard leather.
Hard leather is made by specially treating normal leather by wetting and drying several times.
translation: Sert deri, normal deriyi birkac kez islatip kurutarak özel bir islemden gecirerek yapilir.

english: It's then treated with pine oils. It's harder wearing than ordinary leather.
translation: Daha sonra cam yagi ile islenir. Siradan deriden daha dayaniklidir.

english: Snake skins.
I can work one piece of snake hide into a snakeskin. It only costs 15 pieces of gold. Snakeskin armour is great for intermediate level rangers and provides more defence than hard and studded leather.
translation: Bir parca yilan derisini yilan derisine dönüstürebilirim. Sadece 15 altin parcasi tutar. Yilan derisi zirhi, orta seviye okcular icin harikadir ve sert ve civili deriden daha fazla koruma saglar.

english: Dragonhide leather.
Dragon leather is made from dragonhides. One piece of hide can be worked into one piece of dragon leather. It costs 20 coins each piece.
translation: Ejderha derisi, ejderha derilerinden yapilir. Bir parca deri, bir parca ejderha derisine dönüstürülebilir. Her parca 20 altin degerindedir.

english: Dragon leather is hard-wearing and has excellent flexibility. You can make strong and supple armour with this.
translation: Ejderha derisi dayaniklidir ve mükemmel esneklige sahiptir. Bununla güclü ve esnek zirhlar yapabilirsiniz.

english: I'm bored of leather already.
You may be bored now, but an arrow in the backside will soon fix that!
translation: Su anda sikilmis olabilirsiniz, ama kiciniza bir ok saplanirsa bu sikintiniz hemen gecer!

english: No thanks.
Suit yourself.
I'd like you to tan something for me.
translation: Benim icin bir sey tabaklamani istiyorum.

english: What do you do here?
Ordinary leather.
Hard leather.
Snakeskin.
Dragonhide leather.
I'm bored of leather already.
No thanks.
Hello!
May the chaos rot your soul.
Who are you?
My name is Gura.
Nice to meet you Gura, my name is [player name].
translation: Memnun oldum Gura, benim adim Maceraci.

english: Did you want something?
What have you got?
No, I mean... Nevermind.
What do you do here?
I speak the teachings of Zamorak.
So, fire and brimstone?
Amongst other things.
Like?
Well, traveller, if you hadn't already noticed, a foul plague has beset this town. Not only that, but there is talk of a great evil stirring below...
translation: Sey, yolcu, fark etmediysen, bu kasabayi kötü bir veba sarmis durumda. Sadece bu da degil, asagida büyük bir kötülügün uyandigindan söz ediliyor...

english: I see... So is the plague contagious? Because I could be elsewhere, now you mention it.
translation: Anliyorum... Salgin bulasici mi? Cünkü simdi bahsettigine göre baska bir yere gidebilirim.

english: Well, we're taking precautions, but you should be fine. Providing you don't stick your nose where it doesn't belong, that is.
translation: Önlemler aliyoruz, ama sen icin sorun olmaz. Tabii burnunu sokmaman sartiyla.

english: Keep my nose to myself, gotcha!
Bye!
May the flames guide you.
I'm... sure they will.
Who are you?
What do you do here?
Bye!
What are you waiting here for?
That is no concern of yours, adventurer.
Thank you, Al-Kharid will forever owe you for your help. I think that if there is ever anything that needs to be done, you will be someone they can rely on.
translation: Tesekkürler, Al-Kharid yardimin icin sana sonsuza kadar minnettar kalacak. Sanirim yapilacak bir sey olursa, güvenebilecekleri kisi sen olacaksin.

english: Please excuse me, I'm rather busy.
Hey, I'm your contractor from Mahogany Homes, what did you want done?
translation: Merhaba, ben Mahogany Homes'tan müteahhitinizim, ne yaptirmak istiyorsunuz?

english: I'd like two Wooden small tables built.
translation: Iki adet ahsap kücük masa yaptirmak istiyorum.

english: I'd like my sink fixed.
I'd like a Wooden bed built.
I'd like a Wooden table built.
I'd like a Wooden cupboard built.
I'd like my mirror fixed.
I'd like two Oak small tables built.
translation: Iki adet mese agacindan kücük masa yaptirmak istiyorum.

english: I'd like a Oak bed built.
I'd like a Oak table built.
I'd like a Oak cupboard built.
I'd like two Teak small tables built.
translation: Iki adet tik agacindan kücük masa yaptirmak istiyorum.

english: I'd like a Teak bed built.
I'd like a Teak table built.
I'd like a Teak cupboard built.
I'd like two Mahogany small tables built.
translation: Iki adet maun agacindan kücük masa yaptirmak istiyorum.

english: I'd like a Mahogany bed built.
I'd like a Mahogany table built.
I'd like a Mahogany cupboard built.
I've finished with the work you wanted.
Thank you so much! Would you like a cup of tea before you go?
translation: Cok tesekkür ederim! Gitmeden önce bir fincan cay ister misiniz?

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks, I better be off.
Aaah, nothing like a nice cupppa tea!
translation: Aaah, güzel bir fincan cay gibisi yok!

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
translation: Evet, bir fincan cay cok iyi olur.

english: No thanks.
A great adventurer, from afar? How may I help with my repertoire?
translation: Uzaklardan gelen büyük bir maceraci mi? Repertuarimla nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: Let's trade.
I don't need anything right now.
translation: Su anda bir seye ihtiyacim yok.

english: Let's trade.
I don't need anything right now.
translation: Su anda bir seye ihtiyacim yok.

english: ! ! ! Attention ! ! !
Legends' Guild Member Approaching!
Welcome [Sir/Madam]! I hope you enjoy your time in the Legends' Guild.
translation: Hos geldiniz ! Efsaneler Loncasi'nda iyi vakit gecirmenizi dilerim.

english: I hope the quest is going well [sir/madam]
Legends Guild Member Approaching!
Do you wish to serve the balance? You'll need weapons if you do. These, I can provide.
translation: Dengeye hizmet etmek ister misiniz? Eger öyleyse, silahlara ihtiyaciniz olacak. Bunlari ben saglayabilirim.

english: Let's see what you have.
Do you make a lot of money selling weapons?
translation: Silah satarak cok para kazaniyor musunuz?

english: To be a Kahlith is to abandon all attachment. Both physical and emotional. I have no use for money.
translation: Kahlith olmak, tüm baglari terk etmek demektir. Hem fiziksel hem de duygusal. Paraya ihtiyacim yok.

english: So why don't you give out the weapons for free?
translation: O zaman neden silahlari bedava vermiyorsunuz?

english: While we care not for money, your kind still do. While a Kahlith will do anything for the balance, your kind are not so generous.
translation: Biz paraya önem vermiyoruz ama sizin gibiler hala veriyor. Kahlith denge icin her seyi yapar ama sizin gibiler o kadar cömert degildir.

english: So you use the money to pay us for things?
translation: Yani bize ödeme yapmak icin parayi mi kullaniyorsunuz?

english: Exactly. For us to serve the balance, we must trade with your people. That is what the money is for.
translation: Aynen öyle. Dengeyi saglamak icin sizinle ticaret yapmaliyiz. Paranin amaci budur.

english: Anyway, would you like to purchase some weapons?
translation: Neyse, silah satin almak ister misiniz?

english: I'm good thanks.
Let's see what you have.
Do you make a lot of money selling weapons?
translation: Silah satarak cok para kazaniyor musun?

english: I'm good thanks.
Hello there.
Wooo?  Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!
translation: Wooo?  Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!

english: You don't say?
Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!
translation: Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!

english: You don't say!
Wooowoowoooooo.... Woowoowoo? Woooo, wooowoo wooowooowooo!
Well, I guess you didn't say.
Yeah, I don't want to brag, but seriously: I am SOOOO rich....
translation: Evet, övünmek istemem ama cidden: Ben COK zenginim...

english: Yeah, I know they say money doesn't bring you happiness, but sometimes I just like to open my bank account and look at all of the stuff I own and just think to myself:
translation: Evet, paranin mutluluk getirmedigini söylerler ama bazen banka hesabimi acip sahip oldugum her seye bakip kendi kendime söyle düsünüyorum:

english: Wow. I am soooooo rich.
Well, us rich alive people don't want to waste all day spending time with you poor dead people, because I'm just sooooo rich I have to go now, and very possibly make myself even richer.
translation: Biz zengin yasayanlar, tüm günümüzü siz fakir ölülerle gecirmek istemiyoruz, cünkü ben cok zenginim, simdi gitmeliyim ve muhtemelen kendimi daha da zenginlestirmeliyim.

english: See ya around ghosty!
Yeah, I heard about that, ha-ha-ha!
With a MACKEREL? Ouch!
Well, it was fun. Let's do it again sometime.
translation: Ee, eglenceliydi. Bir ara tekrar yapalim.

english: Why, thank you very much!
I know, but what are you going to do?
Well, I guess that's always true in the long run. See you around, weird invisible dead person!
translation: Ee, sanirim uzun vadede bu her zaman dogrudur. Görüsürüz, tuhaf görünmez ölü insan!

english: Yeah it's not bad, but I prefer cooked chicken.
translation: Evet, fena degil, ama ben pismis tavugu tercih ederim.

english: Maybe, but nothing beats a home cooked pie!
translation: Belki, ama ev yapimi turta gibisi yoktur!

english: Man, I love pie!
You don't say? I never knew that. Well, I must be going, see you around.
translation: Öyle mi? Hic bilmiyordum. Pekala, gitmem gerek, görüsürüz.

english: We get signal!
Somebody set up us the bomb!
You have no chance to survive make your time.
translation: Hayatta kalma sansin yok, zamanini iyi degerlendir.

english: Woo?
All your base are belong to us.
Hey, don't think you can talk to me like that!
Are you threatening me?
Just because you're already dead, doesn't mean I can't find a way to hurt you ghosty!
translation: Sirf sen zaten öldün diye, sana zarar verecek bir yol bulamayacagim anlamina gelmez hayalet!

english: No, I've never been there in my life and CERTAINLY didn't steal anything when I was!
translation: Hayir, hayatimda oraya hic gitmedim ve oradayken KESINLIKLE hicbir sey calmadim!

english: Are you calling me a liar?!?! I have never stolen a thing in my life, and I resent the implication that I am the kind of morally depraved individual that would steal someone else's hard earned
translation: Bana yalanci mi diyorsun?!?! Hayatimda hicbir sey calmadim ve baskalarinin zor kazandiklari parayi

english: money from their very pockets!
translation: ceplerinden calacak kadar ahlaksiz bir insan oldugumu ima etmene cok kizdim!

english: Or cakes. Or fur. Repeatedly. For long periods at a time.
translation: Ya da kekleri. Ya da kürkleri. Tekrar tekrar. Uzun süreler boyunca.

english: Well if you are going to take that attitude, then I have nothing further to say on the matter, and bid you good day!
translation: Eger bu tavri takinacaksan, bu konuda söyleyecek baska bir seyim yok, iyi günler!

english: Hello. You would be Lennissa, I take it?
translation: Merhaba. Sen Lennissa olmalisin, degil mi?

english: Who are you? Where did you hear that name? How comes it that you can see and speak to me?
translation: Kimsin sen? O ismi nereden duydun? Beni nasil görüyor ve benimle konusabiliyorsun?

english: Well, a ghost called Kharrim directed me towards you.
translation: Kharrim adinda bir hayalet beni sana yönlendirdi.

english: So that weasel Kharrim has been blighted by this curse too?
translation: Demek o sinsi Kharrim de bu lanetin kurbani oldu?

english: Ha, a good thing too. If anybody deserved such a fate it would be one such as him.
translation: Ha, iyi olmus. Böyle bir kaderi hak eden biri varsa, o da odur.

english: I guess you didn't get along then?
No, evil scum such as he should never have been allowed to walk this world.
translation: Hayir, onun gibi kötü pisliklerin bu dünyada yasamasina izin verilmemeliydi.

english: What lies has he told you to come here? Have you come to try and kill me?
translation: Buraya gelmen icin sana ne yalanlar söyledi? Beni öldürmeye mi geldin?

english: Well, I'm not sure I could if I tried, but that is not why I have come to you.
translation: Sey, denesem bile yapabilir miyim emin degilim, ama bu yüzden gelmedim.

english: Then speak, and speak well, for I may yet be dead, but am still a danger to those who cross me.
translation: O zaman konus, ve iyi konus, cünkü ben ölmüs olabilirim, ama bana karsi gelenler icin hala bir tehlikeyim.

english: Actually, I'm trying to work out why all of you invisible ghosts seem to have been cursed.
translation: Aslinda, siz görünmez hayaletlerin neden lanetlendigini anlamaya calisiyorum.

english: I'm not sure how exactly, but the trail seems to have led me to you...
translation: Tam olarak nasil oldugunu bilmiyorum, ama izler beni sana getirdi...

english: That makes no sense... I served Saradomin faithfully my entire life, then all of a sudden I find myself reduced to this state!
translation: Bu mantikli degil... Hayatim boyunca Saradomin'e sadakatle hizmet ettim, sonra birdenbire kendimi bu durumda buldum!

english: Well, it seems as though that may have been the cause...
translation: Görünüse göre bunun nedeni bu olabilir...

english: What? Explain yourself.
As I understand it, it was something to do with the Staff of Armadyl, and your refusal to tell Saradomin that it had been stolen...
translation: Anladigim kadariyla, bu Armadyl'in Asasi ile ilgili bir seydi ve sen Saradomin'e onun calindigini söylemeyi reddettin...

english: What? But... But that is not how it happened at all!
translation: Ne? Ama... Ama olaylar hic de öyle gelismedi!

english: Then please, go ahead and tell me the events of that day in your own words...
translation: O zaman lütfen, o gün olanlari kendi sözlerinle anlat bana...

english: Let me see... I had been working as a spy for my Lord Saradomin, amongst the forces of... the Empty Lord.
translation: Bir bakalim... Lord Saradomin icin casus olarak calisiyordum, Empty Lord'un ordusunda.

english: 'The Empty Lord'? Who is that?
I will not give you his name, for to do so would give him power here.
translation: Adini söylemeyecegim, cünkü bunu yapmak ona burada güc verecektir.

english: Let us just say that he was a fearsome deity, whose strength was greater than all the gods we knew of on this realm at the time.
translation: Sadece, o zamanlar bu alemde bildigimiz tüm tanrilardan daha güclü, korkunc bir tanri oldugunu söyleyelim.

english: It is probably worth mentioning that at this time we had no knowledge of the mysterious nature god Guthix.
translation: O zamanlar gizemli doga tanrisi Guthix'i tanimadigimizi belirtmek gerekir.

english: So he was stronger than Saradomin?
As Saradomin was, yes. As Saradomin is now? Who can say?
translation: Saradomin'den daha güclüydü, evet. Saradomin'den daha mi güclüydü? Kim bilebilir?

english: I see... Please, continue.
As I say, I was working as a spy within the very camp of my Lord's enemies.
translation: Dedigim gibi, efendimin düsmanlarinin kampinda casus olarak calisiyordum.

english: I knew that should I have been caught, I risked being killed upon the spot, but my combat skills were always formidable, and if truth be told, there was a fair amount of dissent amongst... 'his' followers anyway.
translation: Yakalanirsam, o anda öldürülme riskiyle karsi karsiya oldugumu biliyordum, ama savas becerilerim her zaman müthisti ve dogrusu, “onun” takipcileri arasinda zaten oldukca fazla anlasmazlik vardi.

english: How do you mean 'dissent'?
Ah, to not understand this, you must have led a sheltered life...
translation: Ah, bunu anlamiyorsaniz, korunakli bir hayat sürmüs olmalisiniz...

english: Let me tell you this: Evil will always breed more evil, and will never be satisfied with what it has.
translation: Sunu söyleyeyim: Kötülük her zaman daha fazla kötülük dogurur ve sahip olduklariyla asla yetinmez.

english: The Empty Lord chose to ally himself with the dark creatures of this world, fully aware that their own natures would cause them to rally against his rule, and take every opportunity they could to betray him.
translation: Bos Lord, bu dünyanin karanlik yaratiklariyla ittifak kurmayi secti, onlarin dogalarinin kendi hükümdarligina karsi ayaklanmalarina ve onu ihanet etmek icin her firsati degerlendirmelerine neden olacagini cok iyi biliyordu.

english: This has always been the nature of evil. Perhaps he thought his power could prevent such treachery?
translation: Kötülügün dogasi her zaman böyle olmustur. Belki de gücünün böyle bir ihaneti önleyebilecegini düsündü?

english: This allowed me freedom amongst their camp, for it was always easy to point the finger of suspicion at some unsuspecting necromancer or foolish Mahjarrat if it seemed as though my activities had been discovered.
translation: Bu, onlarin kampinda bana özgürlük sagladi, cünkü faaliyetlerim kesfedilmis gibi görünürse, süpheyi masum bir büyücüye veya aptal bir Mahjarrat'a yöneltmek her zaman kolaydi.

english: Similarly, should I ever be caught in the act of my sabotage, it was all too easy to bribe whoever found me or persuade them into believing it was just some minor treachery of my own, rather than my work for my
translation: Benzer sekilde, sabotajim sirasinda yakalanirsam, beni bulan kisiyi rüsvetle satin almak veya bunun Lord Saradomin icin yaptigim bir is degil, sadece benim kücük bir ihanetim olduguna ikna etmek cok kolaydi.

english: Lord Saradomin.
Okay... Well, that makes sense, but I don't understand what the Staff of Armadyl had to do with this...?
translation: Tamam... Bu mantikli, ama Armadyl'in Asasi'nin bununla ne ilgisi var anlamadim...?

english: As I have told you, the Empty Lord was extremely powerful, but not so powerful that he could rule over the other deities of this world without opposition.
translation: Sana söyledigim gibi, Bos Lord son derece güclüydü, ama bu dünyanin diger tanrilarina karsi direnc göstermeden hükmedecek kadar güclü degildi.

english: Should he have made a move against any other god, then he could still have been easily brought down by the combined efforts of the others.
translation: Baska bir tanriya karsi harekete gecseydi, digerlerinin ortak cabalariyla kolayca yenilebilirdi.

english: The theft of Armadyl's staff changed this however.
translation: Ancak Armadyl'in asasinin calinmasi bunu degistirdi.

english: If he had taken possession of this god-weapon, then his power would have been so great that he could have overthrown all on this world, and made it into his own image!
translation: Bu tanri silahini ele gecirseydi, gücü o kadar büyük olurdu ki, bu dünyadaki herkesi devirebilir ve kendi imajina göre sekillendirebilirdi!

english: I could not allow such a thing to happen!
translation: Böyle bir seyin olmasina izin veremezdim!

english: I went immediately to my comrade Dhalak, the mage, and told him that a message had come to the lair offering this weapon for sale!
translation: Hemen dostum büyücü Dhalak'a gittim ve ona bu silahin satilik oldugunu belirten bir mesajin siginaga geldigini söyledim!

english: I knew that as soon as my Lord Saradomin heard this, he would contact Armadyl to inform them of the theft, and the matter would have been resolved quickly and discreetly.
translation: Lord Saradomin bunu duyar duymaz Armadyl ile iletisime gecip hirsizligi bildirecegini ve meselenin hizli ve gizli bir sekilde cözülecegini biliyordum.

english: So you passed this information to Dhalak instead of taking it to Saradomin yourself?
translation: Yani bu bilgiyi Saradomin'e kendin götürmek yerine Dhalak'a mi ilettin?

english: To my eternal shame, I indeed failed my Lord Saradomin...
translation: Sonsuza kadar utanacagim bir sekilde, Lord Saradomin'i gercekten hayal kirikligina ugrattim...

english: I could not risk taking the message directly, for I feared my disguise had been uncovered.
translation: Mesaji dogrudan götürme riskini alamazdim, cünkü kilik degistirmis oldugumun ortaya cikmasindan korkuyordum.

english: Lucien particularly had been taking an unhealthy interest in my activities, and I had a gut feeling that to make any obvious moves against the Empty Lord would have been my undoing.
translation: Lucien özellikle benim faaliyetlerime sagliksiz bir ilgi gösteriyordu ve icimden bir ses, Bos Lord'a karsi acik bir hamle yapmanin benim sonum olacagini söylüyordu.

english: But Dhalak was a noble man! I cannot believe that he would not have taken my message immediately to Lord Saradomin!
translation: Ama Dhalak asil bir adamdi! Mesajimi hemen Lord Saradomin'e iletmeyecegini düsünemiyorum!

english: Well, it seems like he didn't, but I don't know why not...
translation: Görünüse göre iletmemis, ama nedenini bilmiyorum...

english: Please adventurer, discover what foul fate must have befallen him for him to have neglected his duty!
translation: Lütfen maceraci, görevini ihmal etmesine neden olan kötü kaderi kesfet!

english: I have not much to offer as reward, but for these spare robes I wore while on assignment...
translation: Ödül olarak sunabilecegim pek bir sey yok, ama görev sirasinda giydigim bu yedek cüppeler...

english: Please find him and discover why I am cursed like this!
translation: Lütfen onu bul ve neden böyle lanetlendigimi kesfet!

english: Where would I be able to find this Dhalak then?
Dhalak? I know not where, but he would try and make the most of his situation if he has been cursed, and find a place to lift his spirits!
translation: Dhalak mi? Nerede oldugunu bilmiyorum, ama lanetlendigi takdirde durumundan en iyi sekilde yararlanmaya calisir ve moralini düzeltmek icin bir yer bulur!

english: Okay, well I'll try and find him for you then.
translation: Tamam, o zaman onu senin icin bulmaya calisacagim.

english: Dhalak? Well, he was always a knowlegeable mage, so if this curse has befallen him as well, I would suspect he would be researching how to free himself of it.
translation: Dhalak mi? O her zaman bilgili bir büyücüydü, bu lanet ona da bulastiysa, kendini bu lanetten kurtarmak icin arastirma yapiyordur herhalde.

english: I would look for a library to find him if I were you.
translation: Yerinde olsam onu bulmak icin bir kütüphaneye bakardim.

english: Dhalak? He was always a loyal follower of Saradomin... I think he would have found an altar to Saradomin so that he may pray for this curse to be lifted.
translation: Dhalak mi? O her zaman Saradomin'in sadik bir takipcisiydi... Bu lanetin kalkmasi icin dua edebilmek icin Saradomin'in bir tapinagini bulmus olmali.

english: Well, that's all fascinating, but I just don't particularly care. Bye-bye.
translation: Hepsi cok ilginc, ama beni pek ilgilendirmiyor. Hosca kal.

english: Hello Lennissa. Can you remind me where to find Dhalak?
translation: Merhaba Lennissa. Dhalak'i nerede bulabilecegimi hatirlatir misin?

english: Hello.
Could I have more of those ghostly robes you gave me?
translation: Bana verdigin hayalet cüppelerinden biraz daha alabilir miyim?

english: It seems as though the curse that keeps me here extends to my very clothing... which piece do you want?
translation: Beni burada tutan lanet giysilerime de bulasmis gibi görünüyor... Hangi parcayi istiyorsun?

english: Here you go.
Tell me your story
Goodbye then
Ask about Dhalak.
Ask for more ghostly robes.
As you approach Lenny, he takes something out of his pocket.
translation: Lenny'ye yaklastiginda, cebinden bir sey cikariyor.

english: What'd you take out of that pocket?
Ain't a thing in my pocket...
I know there ain't. You got it in your hand...
I cannot speak to you outerlander! Talk to Brundt, the Chieftain!
translation: Seninle konusamam yabanci! Sef Brundt ile konus!

english: You stay away from me outerlander!
They are too suspicious of you for you to get close enough to steal from them.
translation: Sana karsi cok süpheci davraniyorlar, onlara yaklasip hirsizlik yapamazsin.

english: Hello, are you a member of the council?
I am afraid not outerlander. Goodbye.
Hello.
Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: Merhaba kardesim Dokrak. Bugün benden ne istiyorsun? Her zaman yardimima güvenebilirsin!

english: Nothing thanks. I just fancied a chat.
translation: Hicbir sey, tesekkürler. Sadece sohbet etmek istedim.

english: My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
translation: Yardimima ihtiyacin olursa kapim her zaman acik Dokrak.

english: [Fremennik name]... It has been too long since last we met!
translation: Dokrak... Son görüsmemizden bu yana cok zaman gecti!

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: Hos geldin kardes Dokrak. Seni burada görmek her zaman bir zevk!

english: My apologies [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: Özür dilerim kardes Dokrak! Burada seninle vakit gecirecek vaktim yok!

english: That's okay, I didn't really want anything.
translation: Önemli degil, aslinda bir sey istememistim.

english: How are you [Fremennik name]? I hope all fares well with you this day!
translation: Nasilsin Dokrak? Umarim bugün her sey yolundadir!

english: I'm fine, thanks, how are you?
All is well with me also!
Hello to you, too!
Hello. Did you want something [Fremennik name]?
translation: Merhaba. Bir sey mi istiyordun Dokrak?

english: No, not really.
Well... okay then!
Always good to see you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].
translation: Seni görmek her zaman güzel kardesim Dokrak.

english: You shame us, [Fremennik name]!
How can you steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
You have betrayed your heritage, [Fremennik name]!
Why would you try to steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
How are you today?
**sigh**
That good? Everyone around here seems a little depressed.
translation: O kadar mi iyi? Buradaki herkes biraz depresif görünüyor.

english: And not particularly talkative.
I'll leave you to your sighing. It looks like you have plenty to do.
translation: Seni ic cekislerine birakayim. Yapacak cok isin var gibi görünüyor.

english: It's a bit grey round here, isn't it?
It gets you down after a while, you know. There are 273 shades of grey, you know, and we have them all.
translation: Bir süre sonra insani bunaltiyor, biliyorsun. 273 ton gri var, biliyorsun, ve biz hepsine sahibiz.

english: That's grey-t.
That attempt at humour merely made me more depressed. Leave me alone.
translation: Bu espri denemesi beni daha da depresif yapti. Beni rahat birak.

english: How's the King treating you then?
Like serfs.
Serf?
Yes, you know - peons, plebs, the downtrodden. He treats us like his own personal possessions.
translation: Evet, bilirsin - isci, pleb, ezilenler. Bizi kendi kisisel mülkiyeti gibi görüyor.

english: You should leave this place.
I keep trying to save up enough to leave, but the King keeps taxing us! We have no money left.
translation: Ayrilmak icin para biriktirmeye calisiyorum ama Kral bize sürekli vergi koyuyor! Hic paramiz kalmadi.

english: Oh dear.
Cheer up! It's not the end of the world.
I'd prefer that, if it meant I didn't have to talk to people as inanely happy as you.
translation: Senin gibi aptalca mutlu insanlarla konusmak zorunda kalmayacaksam, bunu tercih ederim.

english: Whoa! I think you need to get out more.
translation: Vay canina! Bence daha fazla disari cikmalisin.

english: Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu var. Merhaba, selam, selam...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her türlü sey! Kuleler görülmeye deger harika bir manzara.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmeni tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Looking for a bit of meat?
I beg your pardon?
Meat! We've got all the good stuff here.
translation: Et! Burada her türlü iyi malzeme var.

english: Show me what you've got.
Why do you have all this meat?
translation: Neden bu kadar cok etin var?

english: Some prefer solids to go with their blood. That, and the werewolf visitors need something to eat too.
translation: Bazilari kanla birlikte kati gidalar tercih eder. Ayrica kurtadam ziyaretciler de bir seyler yemeli.

english: Where does it all come from?
Look around you! There's no shortage of meat in these parts.
translation: Etrafina bir bak! Bu bölgede et sikintisi yok.

english: You know what, I think I've heard enough.
Whatever you say. So, want some meat?
translation: Sen nasil istersen. Et ister misin?

english: I'm good, thanks.
Come back if you ever want some meat!
Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: Insan! Muhafizlari cagirmadan köle kafeslerine geri dön!

english: Show me what you've got.
Why do you have all this meat?
translation: Neden bu kadar cok etin var?

english: I'm good, thanks.
Can you come and help me, [player name]? I've got a problem with some graves.
translation: Gelip bana yardim eder misin, Maceraci? Bazi mezarlarla ilgili bir sorunum var.

english: Okay, I'll help with your graves.
Player is teleported to Leo's graveyard
Sorry, I'm busy.
You have to help me, [player name]! I've put the wrong coffins into these graves.
translation: Bana yardim etmelisin, Maceraci! Bu mezarlara yanlis tabutlari koydum.

english: I need you to pick up the coffin from each grave, see who's inside it, and bury it in the grave with the correct gravestone.
translation: Her mezardan tabutu alip icinde kim oldugunu kontrol etmen ve dogru mezar tasinin oldugu mezara gömmen gerekiyor.

english: I think I've finished!
That's a good attempt, but it's just not right. Try looking in the coffins to learn who is in them, and read the gravestones to see who is supposed to be buried there.
translation: Iyi denemeydi, ama dogru degil. Tabutlarin icine bakip icinde kim oldugunu ögrenmeye calis ve mezar taslarini okuyup kimin gömülmesi gerektigini kontrol et.

english: All right, I'll give it another shot.
Wonderful! That's taken care of them. I'll take you back, and give you your reward.
translation: Harika! Is halloldu. Seni geri götürecegim ve ödülünü verecegim.

english: Remind me what I'm supposed to do.
Pick up the coffins.
Check the body inside.
Find out where they need to be buried.
Put all five coffins in the correct graves.
translation: Bes tabutu da dogru mezarlara koy.

english: You can store items in the mausoleum if you need more
translation: Daha fazla envanter alanina ihtiyaciniz varsa,

english: inventory space.
I want to leave now.
In that case, I'll take you back to where I found you.
translation: Öyleyse, sizi buldugum yere geri götürecegim.

english: Player is teleported to back to the previous location
Welcome back!
What? But how am I still here?
You died, and now you are in a graveyard.
Where did you think you would go?
Sorry, I need help from [player name].
Hello, [player name]?
Please help me, [player name].
I need your help, [player name]!
Can I borrow you for a minute, [player name]?
translation: Bir dakika sana ihtiyacim var, Maceraci?

english: Maybe later.
Okay, I'll help with your graves.
Sorry, I'm busy.
I think I've finished!
Remind me what I'm supposed to do.
I want to leave now.
What are you doing here?
I'm blending in. Scopin' out the place.
Are you preparing for a heist? You're only a kid.
translation: Soygun mu hazirliyorsun? Sen daha cocuksun.

english: Let's just say there are some wealthy people about, with full pockets.
translation: Diyelim ki, burada cepleri dolu zengin insanlar var.

english: Any tips? I'm not having much luck myself.
translation: Herhangi bir ipucu var mi? Ben pek sansli degilim.

english: I'm quite sneaky. Every now and then I'll get their attention so their pockets aren't being so carefully watched.
translation: Ben oldukca sinsi biriyim. Arada sirada onlarin dikkatini cekiyorum, böylece ceplerini o kadar dikkatli izlemiyorlar.

english: That is sneaky. I'll keep an eye out for your... distractions.
translation: Bu cok sinsi bir hareket. Senin dikkat dagitici hareketlerini gözleyecegim.

english: Now leave me be. I'm already distracting!
translation: Simdi beni rahat birak. Zaten dikkat dagiticiyim!

english: You notice an urchin distract a wealthy citizen nearby.
translation: Yakindaki zengin bir vatandasin dikkatini dagitan bir sokak cocugu fark ediyorsun.

english: I've been robbed!
*Sobbing*
My parents are gonna be so mad!
Oh gosh!
What can I do?
That's awful!
I'll keep you company for a moment.
Silly me! I had it in my pocket all along!
translation: Ne aptalim! Bütün bu zaman boyunca cebimdeymis!

english: I can't stop crying!
Wahhhh!
I've lost my parents!
I hope you're okay.
Oh you really brightened my day!
I'm so lost! Someone help!
I can't find my friends
I'm all alone!
I think I see my friends!!
No one can dance like me!
I could do this all day!
Any tips?
Who taught you to move like that?
translation: Böyle dans etmeyi kim ögretti sana?

english: I wish I had moves like that!
translation: Keske ben de böyle dans edebilsem!

english: I'm all danced out!
My leg! Someone please!
Gah! It hurts!
It burns like an inferno!
I think I've broken something!
Woah! My leg has healed!
That was strange.
