What is this place?
This is Aleck's Hunter Emporium. Basically, it's just a shop with a fancy name; you can buy various weapons and traps here.
translation: Burasi Aleck'in Avci Magazasi. Temelde, sadece süslü bir ismi olan bir dükkan; burada cesitli silahlar ve tuzaklar satin alabilirsin.

english: Can I buy some equipment from the shop then?
translation: O zaman dükkandan bazi ekipmanlar satin alabilir miyim?

english: Oh, this isn't my shop; the owner is Aleck over there behind the counter.
translation: Oh, burasi benim dükkanim degil; sahibi, tezgahin arkasindaki Aleck.

english: I experiment with weapon designs. I'm here because I've been trying to convince people to back my research and maybe sell some of my products - like this one I'm holding - in their shops.
translation: Silah tasarimlari üzerinde deneyler yapiyorum. Buradayim cünkü insanlari arastirmami desteklemeleri ve belki de ürünlerimi - elimdeki gibi - dükkanlarinda satmalari icin ikna etmeye calisiyorum.

english: Aleck doesn't seem to be interested, though.
translation: Aleck pek ilgilenmiyor gibi görünüyor ama.

english: Can you tell me about your crossbow?
translation: Arbaletin hakkinda biraz bilgi verebilir misin?

english: It's good, isn't it? I designed it to incorporate the bones of various animals in its construction.
translation: Güzel, degil mi? Tasariminda cesitli hayvanlarin kemiklerini kullandim.

english: It's a fair bit faster than an ordinary crossbow too; it'll take you far less time to reload between shots.
translation: Siradan bir arbaletten de oldukca hizli; atislar arasinda yeniden doldurmak cok daha az zaman aliyor.

english: That's crazy, it'll never work!
That's what they said about my wind-powered mouse traps, too.
translation: Rüzgarla calisan fare tuzaklarim icin de ayni seyi söylemislerdi.

english: And did they work?
Well, they only ran into problems because people kept insisting on trying to use them indoors.
translation: Aslinda, insanlar onlari ic mekanlarda kullanmaya israr ettikleri icin sorun yasadilar.

english: Anyway, I think my crossbow invention is showing a lot more promise.
translation: Her neyse, tatar yayim cok daha umut verici görünüyor.

english: That sounds good. Let's trade.
Tell me about the ammo for your crossbow.
Ah, I admit as a result of its... er... unique construction, it won't take just any old bolts.
translation: Ah, itiraf etmeliyim ki... sey... benzersiz yapisi nedeniyle, herhangi bir eski okla kullanilamaz.

english: If you can supply the materials and a token fee, I'd be happy to make some for you.
translation: Malzemeleri ve sembolik bir ücret saglarsan, senin icin seve seve yaparim.

english: I need kebbit spikes, lots of 'em. Not all kebbits have spikes, mind you. You'll be wanting prickly kebbits or, even better, razor-backed kebbits to get material hard enough.
translation: Kebbit dikenlerine ihtiyacim var, hem de cok. Unutma, tüm kebbitlerin dikenleri yoktur. Yeterince sert malzeme elde etmek icin dikenli kebbitler veya daha da iyisi, sirtinda jilet gibi dikenleri olan kebbitler gerekir.

english: Can't I just make my own?
Yes, I suppose you could, although you'll need a steady hand with a knife and a chisel.
translation: Evet, yapabilirsin, ama bicak ve keski kullanirken elinin sabit olmasi gerekir.

english: The bolts have an unusual diameter, but basically you'll just need to be able to carve kebbit spikes into straight shafts.
translation: Civatalarin capi alisilmadik bir boyutta, ama temel olarak kebbit dikenlerini düz saftlara oyabilmen yeterli.

english: Meanwhile, since you're here, I can make some for you if you have the materials.
translation: Bu arada, madem buradasin, malzemeleri temin edersen sana biraz yapabilirim.

english: Okay, can you make ammo for me?
I'll be off now, excuse me.
Well, if you ever find yourself in need of that innovative edge, you can always find me here.
translation: Eger yenilikci bir avantaj ihtiyacin olursa, beni her zaman burada bulabilirsin....

english: ... thanks.
Oh, hey, you have one of my crossbows! How's it working for you?
translation: Oh, hey, benim tatar yaylarimdan birine sahipsin! Nasil buldun?

english: It's okay, thanks.
What is this place?
Can I buy some equipment from the shop then?
translation: O zaman dükkandan ekipman satin alabilir miyim?

english: Can you tell me about your crossbow?
translation: Tatar yayini hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Tell me about the ammo for your crossbow.
translation: Tatar yayinin icin mermi hakkinda bilgi ver.

english: I'll be off now, excuse me.
That's crazy, it'll never work!
That sounds good. Let's trade.
Can't I just make my own?
Okay, can you make ammo for me?
translation: Tamam, benim icin cephane yapabilir misin?

english: (1) 6 kebbit bolts
(2) 6 long kebbit bolts
It's okay, thanks.
You have done well brave adventurer, but I would test your mettle now. You may arrange the fight with Larxus at your leisure.
translation: Iyi is cikardin cesur maceraci, ama simdi cesaretini sinayacagim. Larxus ile dövüsü istedigin zaman ayarlayabilirsin.

english: Adventurer, you have defeated me in battle! For this, I congratulate you. Please accept my cape as a sign of your accomplishment.
translation: Maceraci, beni savasta yendin! Bunun icin seni tebrik ederim. Basarini simgeleyen pelerinimi kabul et lütfen.

english: Hello!
Can I have another sword?
Jeffery gives you another sword.
translation: Jeffery sana baska bir kilic verir.

english: Who are you?
I'm Jeffery, the taskmaster for the Wilderness Achievement Diary.
translation: Ben Jeffery, Wilderness Basari Günlügü'nün görev sorumlusuyum.

english: What is the Achievement Diary?

It's a diary that helps you keep track of particular achievements. In the Wilderness it can help you discover some quite useful things. Eventually, with enough exploration, the inhabitants will reward you.
translation: Belirli basarilari takip etmene yardimci olan bir günlüktür. Wilderness'da oldukca yararli seyler kesfetmene yardimci olabilir. Yeterince kesif yaptiktan sonra, bölge sakinleri seni ödüllendirecektir.

english: You can see the list of tasks on the side-panel.
I have a question about my Achievement diary.
translation: Basari Günlügümle ilgili bir sorum var.

english: Well, there are four different Wilderness Swords, which match up with the four levels of difficulty. Each has the same rewards as the previous level and some additional benefits too... which tier of rewards would you like to
translation: Dört farkli Wilderness Kilici var ve bunlar dört zorluk seviyesine karsilik geliyor. Her biri önceki seviyeyle ayni ödüllere ve bazi ek avantajlara sahiptir... Hangi ödül kademesi hakkinda

english: know more about?
Tell me more about the Easy rewards please!
translation: Kolay ödüller hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin lütfen!

english: If you complete all of the easy tasks in the Wilderness, you can speak to Lundail at the Mage Arena every day to receive 40 free runes and you can teleport to either Edgeville or Ardougne from the Wilderness lever.
translation: Wilderness'daki tüm kolay görevleri tamamlarsaniz, her gün Mage Arena'daki Lundail ile konusarak 40 ücretsiz rune alabilir ve Wilderness kolundan Edgeville veya Ardougne'a isinlanabilirsiniz.

english: Thanks!
Tell me more about the Medium rewards please!
translation: Orta seviye ödüller hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin lütfen!

english: Tell me more about the Hard rewards please!
translation: Zor ödüller hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin lütfen!

english: In addition to the easy and medium benefits, the sword can teleport you to the Fountain of Rune once per day, you'll get 50% more lava shards when grinding scales and even cheaper access to the Resource Area.
translation: Kolay ve orta seviye avantajlara ek olarak, kilic sizi günde bir kez Rune Cesmesi'ne isinlayabilir, pullari ögütürken %50 daha fazla lav parcasi elde edersiniz ve Kaynak Alani'na daha ucuza erisebilirsiniz.

translation: 5 ekümenik anahtar sahibi olabilir, Lava Dragon Isle'a kisayol erisimi elde edebilir ve Lundail size her gün 120 ücretsiz rune verecektir. Ayrica, Wilderness'daki spawn'lardan Zamorak Sarabi'ni banknot

translation: Elit ödüller hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin lütfen!

english: In addition to the previous tiers of rewards, access to the Resource Area is free and the sword will now give you unlimited teleports to the Fountain of Rune. All dragon bone drops in the Wilderness become noted and

translation: Lundail size her gün 200 ücretsiz rune verir ve Karanlik Yengecleri yakalama oraniniz artar.

english: How do I claim the rewards?
Just complete the tasks in the Wilderness so they're ticked off, then come and speak to me for your rewards.
translation: Wilderness'daki görevleri tamamlayip isaretleyin, sonra gelip benimle konusarak ödüllerinizi alin.

english: Bye!
See you later.
I've completed all of the easy tasks in my Wilderness Achievement Diary!
translation: Wilderness Basari Günlügümdeki tüm kolay görevleri tamamladim!

english: I can see that, well done! You'll be wanting your reward then!
translation: Görüyorum, aferin! O zaman ödülünüzü almak istersiniz herhalde!

english: Yes please!
You need at least two inventory spaces, make some space and come back.
translation: En az iki envanter alani gerekir, biraz yer ac ve geri gel.

english: This sword is a symbol of your exploration of the Wilderness. Speak to Lundail at the Mage Arena every day to receive 40 free runes and you can teleport to either Edgeville or Ardougne from the Wilderness lever.
translation: Bu kilic, Wilderness'i kesfettiginin sembolüdür. Her gün Mage Arena'daki Lundail ile konusarak 40 ücretsiz rune al ve Wilderness kolundan Edgeville veya Ardougne'a isinlanabilirsin.

I've completed all of the medium tasks in my Wilderness Achievement Diary!
translation: Wilderness Basari Günlügümdeki tüm orta zorlukta görevleri tamamladim!

translation: artik 4 ekümenik anahtara sahip olabilirsin ve Lundail'den günde 80 rune alabilirsin.

translation: Wilderness Basari Günlügümdeki tüm zor görevleri tamamladim!

Who are you?
I have a question about my Achievement Diary

english: What is the Achievement Diary?
What are the rewards?
Easy Rewards.
Medium Rewards.
Hard Rewards.
Elite Rewards.
How do I claim the rewards?
Bye!
If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: Senin kadar cirkin olsaydim, yüzümü halka göstermeye cesaret edemezdim!

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: Oh! Sey... Az önce bir tane yedim de ondan!

english: Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: Hayatina deger veriyorsan bir daha benimle konusma!

english: Get lost!
I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: Sana verecek hicbir seyim yok, birak beni rahat, dilenci.

english: Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
translation: Su anda bununla ugrasacak vaktim yok.

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: Senin gibi zavalli bir et yiginiyla konusmak istemiyorum.

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: Cok kötü bir gün... tadini cikar.

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: Eger birini yakalarsan, paylasacagina söz ver.

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
You smell familiar...
Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: Buralarda insan gördün mü? Cok acim.

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: Bana kan tadi seven biri gibi görünüyorsun.

english: Good day to you, my friend.
Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: Bana bir dakika izin ver, dislerime bir sey sikismis...

english: Thanks so much for saving me from being a vampyre. Here, take this certificate, I'm sorry but it's all I can offer as a reward.
translation: Beni vampir olmaktan kurtardigin icin cok tesekkürler. Al, bu sertifikayi al, üzgünüm ama ödül olarak sunabilecegim tek sey bu.

english: Thanks for changing me back, it must have been hard for you. I must be off now.
translation: Beni eski halime döndürdügün icin tesekkürler, senin icin zor olmus olmali. Artik gitmeliyim.

english: Welcome to the Keldagrim library, human traveller!
translation: Keldagrim kütüphanesine hos geldin, insan gezgin!

english: Can you tell me more about the library?
translation: Kütüphane hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Why, certainly, it is one of my favourite subjects!
translation: Elbette, bu benim en sevdigim konulardan biri!

english: I am Hugi, you see, I am the chief librarian here. Hugi, my parents named me that, it means 'personification of thought' in the ancient dwarvish tongue.
translation: Ben Hugi, buradaki bas kütüphaneciyim. Hugi, ailem bana bu ismi verdi, eski cüce dilinde “düsüncenin kisilestirilmesi” anlamina geliyor.

english: Quite like the name myself.
translation: Ben de bu ismi cok seviyorum.

english: The books in this library have been collected for many centuries now, through various generous donations.
translation: Bu kütüphanedeki kitaplar, yüzyillar boyunca cesitli cömert bagislarla toplanmistir.

english: You'll find books dating from many different eras as well, such as the Era of Kings, the Rise of the Consortium and the Era of Prosperity, our current era.
translation: Krallar Cagi, Konsorsiyumun Yükselisi ve su anki cagimiz olan Refah Cagi gibi bircok farkli döneme ait kitaplar bulabilirsiniz.

english: How do these eras correspond with the Ages of the world?
translation: Bu dönemler, dünyanin caglariyla nasil örtüsüyor?

english: Oh, they are quite different, and most of them take place in the Fourth Age.
translation: Oh, oldukca farklilar ve cogu Dördüncü Cag'da geciyor.

english: Since we dwarves hid underground for a long time to sit out the wars that raged above the ground our history books differ slightly from those written by humans.
translation: Biz cüceler, yer üstünde siddetli savaslar sürerken uzun süre yer altinda saklandigimiz icin tarih kitaplarimiz insanlara ait olanlardan biraz farklidir.

english: Thanks for the information!
What do you know about impenetrable rocks?
You're confusing me, what rock exactly are you talking about?
translation: Kafami karistiriyorsun, tam olarak hangi kayadan bahsediyorsun?

english: The big one in the mines south of the city. Dondakan's big rock.
translation: Sehrin güneyindeki madenlerdeki büyük kaya. Dondakan'in büyük kayasi.

english: I see, I see.
I heard there was a demon inside there that you banished.
translation: Orada senin kovdugun bir iblis oldugunu duydum.

english: Yes, what exactly does that mean anyway?
translation: Evet, bu tam olarak ne anlama geliyor?

english: There are some demons that we cannot see properly as mortals. They also cannot be fought with normal weapons.
translation: Ölümlüler olarak bizim göremedigimiz bazi iblisler vardir. Onlarla normal silahlarla da savasilamaz.

english: But sometimes these creatures manifest themselves in a solid form in our world. Their avatar.
translation: Ama bazen bu yaratiklar bizim dünyamizda somut bir sekilde ortaya cikarlar. Avatarlari.

english: When you defeat an avatar, you defeat the actual demon behind it. But they don't die, they are banished to where they came from originally.
translation: Bir avatari yendiginizde, onun arkasindaki gercek iblisi de yenmis olursunuz. Ama onlar ölmezler, geldikleri yere sürülürler.

english: Does that mean I will have to deal with this demon again some time?
translation: Bu, bir gün bu iblisle tekrar ugrasmam gerekecegi anlamina mi geliyor?

english: Doubtful. He will grow stronger and stronger over time, but that's a process that will take a thousand years at least.
translation: Sanmiyorum. Zamanla gittikce güclenecek, ama bu en az bin yil sürecek bir sürec.

english: Even dwarves don't live so long.
translation: Cüceler bile o kadar uzun yasamaz.

english: No, we won't see him again and the mines are safe to dig for gold now. Of course, that might lead to other problems eventually...
translation: Hayir, onu bir daha görmeyecegiz ve madenler artik altin aramak icin güvenli. Tabii ki, bu da sonunda baska sorunlara yol acabilir...

english: Can you tell me more about the library?
translation: Kütüphane hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: What do you know about impenetrable rocks?
Greetings warrior, how can I fill your stomach today?
translation: Selam savasci, bugün karnini nasil doyurabilirim?

english: With food preferably.
Come try my lovely pizza or maybe some fish!
translation: Gel, benim lezzetli pizzami ya da belki biraz balik dene!

english: Stew to fill the belly, on sale here!
Potatoes are filling and healthy too!
Move into position lads! eh? Who are you and what do you want?
translation: Yerlerinize gecin cocuklar! Eh? Sen kimsin ve ne istiyorsun?

english: Who are you then?
Lieutenant Shepbur, commanding officer of the new Armoured Tortoise Regiment.
translation: Tegmen Shepbur, yeni Zirhli Kaplumbaga Alayi'nin komutani.

english: There's only two tortoises here, that's hardly a regiment.
translation: Burada sadece iki kaplumbaga var, bu bir alay sayilmaz.

english: This is just the beginning! Gnome breeders and trainers are already working to expand the number of units. Soon we'll have hundreds of these beauties, nay thousands! And they will not only carry mages and
translation: Bu sadece baslangic! Gnome yetistiricileri ve egitmenleri, birim sayisini artirmak icin simdiden calismaya basladilar. Yakinda bu güzelliklerden yüzlerce, hatta binlerce olacak! Ve bunlar sadece büyücüleri ve okculari tasimayacak,

english: archers but other fiendish weapons of destruction of gnome devising. An army of giant tortoises will march upon this battlefield and rain the fire of our wrath upon all our enemies! Nothing will be able to stop us!
translation: gnomlarin tasarladigi diger seytani yikim silahlarini da tasiyacaklar. Dev kaplumbagalardan olusan bir ordu bu savas alanina yürüyecek ve tüm düsmanlarimiza öfkemizin atesini yagdiracak! Hicbir sey bizi durduramayacak!

english: Oooookayy...... I'll leave you to it then....
translation: Tamam... O zaman sizi rahat birakayim...

english: *hic* G'day! Do ya... ... well, do ya need any help with yer trident? *buuurrrp*
translation: *hic* Merhaba! Yoksa... ... üc catalli mizraginla ilgili yardima ihtiyacin var mi? *buuurrrp*

english: Bit early to be drinking, isn't it?
translation: Icmek icin biraz erken degil mi?

english: Why?! What time *hic* is it?
Hmm, I've no idea.
I can drink to that!
Who are you?
What!? Why I'm the infamous pirate Lieve McCracken! You've not heard of me?
translation: Ne!? Ben ünlü korsan Lieve McCracken'im! Beni duymadin mi?

english: Hmm, can't say I have.
I'm wanted in several *hic* kingdoms - murder, armed robbery and even *hic* flag desecration!
translation: Birkac *hic* krallikta araniyorum - cinayet, silahli soygun ve hatta *hic* bayrak tahribati!

english: Shouldn't you be in hiding?
I'm sorry, but *hic* do ya see anyone here?
translation: Üzgünüm, ama *hic* burada kimseyi görüyor musun?

english: I guess you could call this hiding. If you're some famous pirate, where's you ship?
translation: Sanirim buna saklanmak denebilir. Eger ünlü bir korsansan, gemin nerede?

english: *hic* My last expedition didn't end too well for my boat... or crew *hic*.
translation: *hic* Son seferim gemim ve mürettebatim icin pek iyi sonuclanmadi *hic*.

english: So, what's in the cave?
The fruits o' my labour... and some waterfiends, those were a surprise *hic* to be sure, but a welcome one.
translation: Emeklerimin meyveleri... ve bazi su canavarlari, bunlar kesinlikle sürprizdi *hic*, ama hos bir sürpriz.

english: Umm, fruits?
Oh, not *hic* actual fruits, silly! A relative o' mine wanted a cave full o' Krakens, so here *hic* I am.
translation: Oh, gercek meyveler degil, aptal! Bir akrabam Krakenlerle dolu bir magara istedi, ben de buradayim *hic*.

english: And why are you so drunk?
Well, the Krakens destroyed m' ship, killed m' crew, the rum it's... all I 'ave left.
translation: Krakenler gemimi yok etti, mürettebatimi öldürdü, rom... geriye kalan tek seyim.

english: Sorry about that, so... Can I kill some Krakens?
If you've been assigned some by a slayer master, I don't see *hic* why not.
translation: Eger bir avci ustasi tarafindan görevlendirildiysen, neden olmasin *hic*.

english: And if I havn't been?
Then ya can leave m' Krakens *hic* alone.
Umm... ok then.
Let's talk about tridents.
If ya brings me a trident, I can enhance it for ya. It'll store 20,000 charges, not just 2,500. But I wants payin' fer the job.
translation: Bana bir üc catalli mizrak getirirsen, onu senin icin güclendirebilirim. 2.500 degil, 20.000 sarj depolayabilir. Ama bu is icin ödeme istiyorum.

english: Give me 10 kraken tentacles first. I'll hold onto 'em for ya. Then ya can bring me a trident to enhance, an' I'll get to work for ya.
translation: Önce bana 10 kraken dokunagi ver. Onlari senin icin saklayacagim. Sonra bana güclendirmem icin bir üc catalli mizrak getir, ben de senin icin ise koyulayim.

english: If ya brings me a trident, I can enhance it for ya. It'll store 20,000 charges, not just 2,500. Ya brought me one tentacle so far, but I'll want 10 of 'em to do the job.
translation: Bana bir trident getirirsen, onu senin icin güclendirebilirim. 2.500 degil, 20.000 sarj depolayabilir. Simdiye kadar bana bir tentacle getirdin, ama isi yapmak icin 10 tane istiyorum.

english: Just pass me 9 more tentacles, then give me yer trident an' I'll get to work for ya.
translation: Bana 9 tane daha tentacle getir, sonra tridentini ver, ben de senin icin ise koyulayim.

english: If ya brings me a trident, I can enhance it for ya. It'll store 20,000 charges, not just 2,500. Ya brought me [number] tentacles so far, but I'll want 10 of 'em to do the job.
Just pass me [number] more tentacles, then give me yer trident an' I'll get to work for ya.
If ya brings me a trident, I can enhance it for ya. It'll store 20,000 charges, not just 2,500. Ya brought me 9 tentacles so far, but I'll want 10 of 'em to do the job.
translation: Bana bir trident getirirsen, onu senin icin gelistirebilirim. 2.500 degil, 20.000 sarj depolayabilir. Simdiye kadar bana 9 tentacle getirdin, ama isi yapmak icin 10 taneye ihtiyacim var.

english: Just pass me one more tentacle, then give me yer trident an' I'll get to work for ya.
translation: Bana bir tentacle daha ver, sonra tridentini ver, ben de senin icin ise koyulayim.

english: If ya brings me a trident, I can enhance it for ya. It'll store 20,000 charges, not just 2,500. Ya brought me [number] tentacles; I'll use up 10 of 'em to do the job.
Just pass me yer trident an' I'll get to work for ya.
translation: Bana tridentini ver, senin icin ise koyulayim.

english: I'll be, heh, leaving you now...
Wow, so original.
Oi, I'm Lieve McCracken and I say leave m' Kraken alone!
translation: Hey, ben Lieve McCracken ve Kraken'imi rahat birakmani istiyorum!

english: Lieve McCracken wants you to stick to your Slayer assignments.
translation: Lieve McCracken, Avci görevlerine sadik kalmani istiyor.

english: Oi, I'm Lieve, and I say leave it!
translation: Hey, ben Lieve ve birakmani istiyorum!

english: Ya gotta bring me 10 tentacles before I'll enhance yer tridents for ya. Just hand 'em to me when ye've got 'em.
translation: Üc catalli mizraklarini güclendirmem icin bana 10 dokunac getirmelisin. Buldugunda bana ver.

english: Ya gotta bring me 10 tentacles before I'll enhance yer tridents for ya. So far ya brought me one.
translation: Tridontlarini güclendirmem icin bana 10 tentacle getirmelisin. Simdiye kadar bana bir tane getirdin.

english: Ya gotta bring me 10 tentacles before I'll enhance yer tridents for ya. So far ya brought me [number].
That trident's already been enhanced, ya ninny!
translation: O tridont zaten güclendirildi, seni aptal!

english: I see ya got a tentacle there. Do ya want me to hold onto it for ya? For every 10 ya gives me, I'll enhance a trident for ya.
translation: Orada bir dokunac var galiba. Senin icin saklamami ister misin? Bana her 10 tane getirdiginde, senin icin bir tridenti güclendirecegim.

english: Remember, I won't give 'em back. Once ya gives me a tentacle, I keep it.
translation: Unutma, geri vermeyecegim. Bana bir dokunac verdiginde, onu saklayacagim.

english: Remember, I won't give 'em back. Once ya gives me a tentacle, I keep it. Ya already gave me [number].
Thanks. I've got one tentacle stored for ya now. Once ye've brought me 10, ya can hand me a trident, an' I'll enhance it.
translation: Tesekkürler. Su anda senin icin bir tentacle sakliyorum. Bana 10 tane getirdiginde, bana bir trident verebilirsin, ben de onu güclendirecegim.

english: Thanks. I've got [number] tentacles stored for ya now. Once ye've brought me 10, ya can hand me a trident, an' I'll enhance it.
Thanks. I've got [number] tentacles stored for ya now. For every 10, ya can hand me a trident, an' I'll enhance it.
No, I think I'll hold onto it myself.
I see ya got [number] tentacles there. Do ya want me to hold onto 'em for ya? For every 10 ya gives me, I'll enhance a trident for ya.
No, I think I'll hold onto them myself.
Ugh - what's that? It's got a whip stuck in it! I don't want that! Take it away!
translation: Ugh - o da ne? Icine bir kirbac saplanmis! Onu istemiyorum! Al sunu!

english: No thanks.
Bit early to be drinking, isn't it?
translation: Icmek icin biraz erken degil mi?

english: Who are you?
So, what's in the cave?
Let's talk about tridents.
I'll be, heh, leaving you now...
Give it to her.
Do not give it to her.
Give them to her.
Do not give them to her.
So why are you fighting over that obelisk anyway? Just looks like a bit of old rock to me.
translation: Neden o obelisk icin kavga ediyorsunuz ki? Bana sadece eski bir kaya gibi görünüyor.

english: Puny human! You wouldn't understand.
Yeah, I'm the puny one.
Feel the power of creation!
I will crush you into the dirt!
You will be created anew!
Don't you get hot standing around pools of lava all day?
translation: Bütün gün lav havuzlarinin yaninda durmaktan sicaklanmiyor musun?

english: I care not for equable temperature... only destruction!
translation: Ben esit sicaklik umursamiyorum... sadece yikim!

english: Each to their own, I suppose...
Face destruction!
I will destroy you!
Meet your destruction!
Hey Lil' Zik.
Stop.
Calling.
Me.
Little!
Never!
translation: Biliyorsun... sen diger örümcekler gibi degilsin.

english: You know... you're not like other spiders.
translation: Bunu söylediginde nefret ettigimi biliyorsun... lütfen beni rahat birak.

english: You know I hate it when you say that... please leave me alone.
translation: Ama seni Theatre of Blood'da adil bir sekilde kazandim! Sen benim malimsin....

english: But I earned you fair and square at the Theatre of Blood! You're mine to keep.
translation: Ama seni Theatre of Blood'da adil bir sekilde kazandim! Sen benimimsin.

english: Incy wincy Verzik climbed up the water spout...
translation: Incy wincy Verzik su borusuna tirmandi...

english: Down came the rain and washed poor Verzik out...
translation: Yagmur yagdi ve zavalli Verzik'i yikadi...

english: Out came the Vampyre to put an end to this at once. Humans deserve only one fate!
translation: Vampir ortaya çikti ve buna bir son verdi. Insanlar tek bir kaderi hak ediyor!

english: Wow, calm down. It's just a nursery rhyme.
translation: Sakin ol. Bu sadece bir çocuk sarkisi.

english: I'm not in the mood.
Hi, I'm here for my reward!
Not again...
I'll get you!
This is the end of you!
Today, you die in THIS Theatre.
Have you seen my brother?
I'm not sure, what did he look like?
He was a kind boy, with a bright smile...
translation: Nazik bir çocuktu, parlak bir gülümsemesi vardi...

english: Hmm... Can't say I have I'm afraid.
Oh... I'd very much like to see him again.
translation: Oh... Onu tekrar görmek çok isterdim.

english: Thank you for freeing me...
Freeing you? I didn't know you were trapped.
translation: Seni kurtarmak mi? Kapana kisildigini bilmiyordum.

english: The vampyres... they tricked me...
Oh, you're welcome then!
You'll suffer a terrible fate!
You will never leave THIS Theatre again.
translation: Bu tiyatrodan bir daha asla çikamayacaksin.

english: Maaasteeer?
I suppose I am your master now, I hadn't thought about it.
translation: Sanirim artik senin efendin benim, bunu düsünmemistim.

english: Kill maasteer...
No don't do that!
Do you smell that?
Hnrgh?
*Sniffs* What are you made of Lil'Bloat?
Cccorpsssee...
That would explain the smell...
Hello Lil' Bloat.
...Hhhh-.
Are you trying to talk?
...Hhhhuu-
Are you trying to say Hello? Come on you can do it!
translation: Merhaba mi demek istiyorsun? Hadi, yapabilirsin!

english: ...Hhhuun-
...Hhuunnggrryy.
Oh, of course...
Brrrrr!
Hrrrrrnnngh!
Hungry....
How are you doing little guy?
Chitter-chitter?
You seem happy to be free of the Theatre.
Chitter-chitter!
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
Hello my angry little monster.
Grrrrruff!
You don't mean that, you're just grumpy.
Grrrr...
That's a good girl.
Would you like a treat?
Grruff?
Oh, you don't eat normal food, I'm afraid I don't have any adventurers to feed you.
translation: Oh, normal yemek yemiyorsun, korkarim seni besleyecek maceracilarim yok.

english: Grrrrrr...
I'm sorry! Please don't send me to the shadow realm!
translation: Özür dilerim! Lütfen beni gölge alemine gönderme!

english: *slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
We're not in the Theatre anymore, so no poisoning anyone, got that?
translation: Artik tiyatroda degiliz, kimseyi zehirleme, anladin mi?

english: Scraaa?
I mean it, no spitting poison at people or on the floor.
translation: Ciddiyim, insanlara veya yere zehir tükürme.

english: Scraaa....
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
You okay there, Lil'viathan? You look at little worse for wear.
translation: Iyi misin Lil'viathan? Biraz yipranmis görünüyorsun.

english: **wheeez**
I think you have a smoking problem.
Hello, Lil'viathan.
ROAAAAARRR!
SCREEEEEEE!
HSSSSSSSSS!
Good talk.
Hello there. Welcome to the Grand Library.
Hmm. I thought it was bigger.
Oh it is. While we've opened up the city to other races, we've decided that most of the library will remain a place for elves only.
translation: Öyle. Sehri diger irklara açarken, kütüphanenin çogunun sadece elfler için bir yer olarak kalmasina karar verdik.

english: That said, we still want visitors to get a taste of what the library has to offer. For that reason, we've opened up this small section of it.
translation: Bununla birlikte, ziyaretçilerin kütüphanenin sundugu seyleri tatmalarini istiyoruz. Bu nedenle, kütüphanenin bu küçük bölümünü açtik.

english: Feel free to have a read through the books here. Now that the city is open to visitors, we've had lots of new additions from far and wide.
translation: Buradaki kitaplari rahatça okuyabilirsin. Sehir ziyaretçilere açildigindan beri, uzaklardan ve her yerden birçok yeni kitap eklendi.

english: Sounds great, I'll take a look.
If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: Senin kadar çirkin olsaydim, halka açik yerlerde yüzümü göstermeye cesaret edemezdim!

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: Oh! Sey... Az önce bir tane yedim de ondan!

english: Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: Hayatina deger veriyorsan bir daha benimle konusma!

english: Get lost!
I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: Sana verecek hiçbir seyim yok, beni rahat birak, dilenci.

english: Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
translation: Su anda bunun icin vaktim yok.

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: Senin gibi zavalli bir et yiginiyla konusmak istemiyorum.

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: Cok kötü bir gün... tadini cikarin.

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: Eger birini yakalarsan, paylasacagina söz ver.

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
You smell familiar...
Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: Buralarda insan gördün mü? Cok acim.

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: Bana kan tadi seven biri gibi görünüyorsun.

english: Good day to you, my friend.
Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: Bir saniye, dislerime bir sey sikismis...

english: Hello.
Greetings. No I'm not.
Are you lost?
Possibly.
Hang on, did you just answer my question before I asked it?
translation: Bir dakika, sorumu sormadan önce cevap mi verdin?

english: Absolutely not!
Are you a little... mad?
Uh..... hi... didn't see you there. Can.... I help?
translation: Uh..... merhaba... seni görmedim. Yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: Umm... do you sell potions?
Erm... yes. When I'm not drinking them.
I'd like to see what you have for sale.
Of course...
That's a pretty wall hanging.
Do you think so? I made it myself.
Really? Is that why there's all this cloth and dye around?
translation: Gercekten mi? Bu yüzden mi etrafta bu kadar kumas ve boya var?

english: Yes, it's a hobby of mine when I'm.... relaxing.
Bye!
Have fun and come back soon!
Pink bananas... mmmmmm.
Demons are a Ghoul's best Friend.
It's not an optical illusion, it just looks like one.
translation: Bu bir optik yanilsama degil, sadece öyle görünüyor.

english: Don't look back, they might be gaining on you.
If you don't care where you are, then you ain't lost.
translation: Nerede oldugun umurunda degilse, kaybolmus degilsindir.

english: Madness takes its toll. Please have exact change.
translation: Delilik bedelini alir. Lütfen tam para getirin.

english: I'd like to see what you have for sale.
That's a pretty wall hanging.
Bye!
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu var. Merhaba, selam, selam...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her türlü sey! Kuleler harika bir manzara.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmenizi tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Welcome, are you looking to take part in a game of Last Man Standing?
translation: Hos geldin, Last Man Standing oyununa katilmak mi istiyorsun?

english: Tell me more.
It's simple. Anyone looking to participate enters the relevant waiting area. Once the waiting area has enough people, they are taken to the arena.
translation: Cok basit. Katilmak isteyenler ilgili bekleme alanina girerler. Bekleme alaninda yeterli sayida kisi toplandiginda, arena'ya götürülürler.

english: Arena?
Indeed. We have set up two arenas on another plane. When a game starts, we pick one at random. Once everyone arrives in the arena, the fight for survival begins.
translation: Aynen öyle. Baska bir boyutta iki arena kurduk. Oyun basladiginda, rastgele birini seciyoruz. Herkes arena'ya vardiginda, hayatta kalma mücadelesi basliyor.

english: Now, there's a few important things to be aware of. While in an arena, your physical and mental abilities will be boosted. Also, praying to the gods will not cost you any precious energies.
translation: Simdi, bilmeniz gereken birkac önemli nokta var. Arenadayken fiziksel ve zihinsel yetenekleriniz güclenecek. Ayrica, tanrilara dua etmek size degerli enerjilerinize mal olmayacak.

english: After a game has started, lethal fog will soon start filling the arena. This forces contenders to a designated safe zone and ensures no one escapes the fighting.
translation: Oyun basladiktan sonra, arenayi ölümcül bir sis kaplayacak. Bu, yarismacilari belirlenen güvenli bölgeye zorlayacak ve kimsenin mücadeleden kacmamasini saglayacak.

english: Be aware, you can't take any of your own belongings into the game. Instead, you can use only what you find in the arena, including anything we give you on arrival.
translation: Unutmayin, oyuna kendi esyalarinizi getiremezsiniz. Bunun yerine, arenada buldugunuz her seyi kullanabilirsiniz, varista size verdigimiz her sey dahil.

english: Regarding what you are given on arrival, you have a few options to pick from. Use my supply chest to configure your load-outs for the different battle styles.
translation: Varista size verilenler konusunda, birkac secenek arasindan secim yapabilirsiniz. Farkli savas stilleri icin ekipmaninizi yapilandirmak icin benim erzak sandigimi kullanin.

english: Remember, this is a solo competition! Anyone attempting to form teams for an unfair advantage will be banished from further participation.
translation: Unutmayin, bu tek kisilik bir yarismadir! Haksiz avantaj elde etmek icin takim kurmaya calisanlar, oyundan men edilecektir.

english: Now that you know more, would you like to take part in a game of Last Man Standing?
translation: Artik daha fazla bilgiye sahip oldugunuza göre, Last Man Standing oyununa katilmak ister misiniz?

english: Not right now.
No problem, come back if you happen to change your mind.
translation: Sorun degil, fikrinizi degistirirseniz tekrar gelin.

english: I'd like to play.
Which mode would you like to play?
You do not have enough money in your coffer.
I'm afraid you can't take part in Last Man Standing on this world.
translation: Korkarim bu dünyada Last Man Standing oyununa katilamazsiniz.

english: A casual game will start in the next [60 - 5x] seconds!
translation: Bir casual oyun [60 - 5x] saniye icinde baslayacak!

english: A casual game is starting!
Come on, we need another competitive participant!
translation: Hadi, bir rekabetci katilimciya daha ihtiyacimiz var!

english: Come on, we need [2-24] more competitive participants!
translation: Hadi, [2-24] rekabetci katilimciya daha ihtiyacimiz var!

english: Come on, we need another High Stakes participant!
translation: Hadi, bir High Stakes katilimcisina daha ihtiyacimiz var!

english: Come on, we need [2-24] more High Stakes participants!
translation: Hadi, [2-24] High Stakes katilimcisina daha ihtiyacimiz var!

english: Tell me more.
I'd like to play.
Not right now.

Competitive (free entry)
Casual

Hello, visitor!
Hello. What are you up to?
Ah, I was about to collect some yak's milk to make yak cheese.
translation: Ah, yak peyniri yapmak icin biraz yak sütü toplamak üzereydim.

english: Eughr! Though I am curious. Can I try some?
translation: Egh! Merak ettim. Biraz deneyebilir miyim?

english: Sorry, no. The last outlander who ate my cheese was ill for a month.
translation: Üzgünüm, hayir. Peynirimi yiyen son yabanci bir ay boyunca hastalandi.

english: So why don't you get ill as well?
Well, we eat yak milk products every day, from when we're born. So I suppose we're used to it. Anyway I should stop yakking - haha - and get on with my work.
translation: Biz dogdugumuzdan beri her gün yak sütü ürünleri yiyoruz. Sanirim buna alistik. Neyse, gevezelik etmeyi birakip isime dönmeliyim.

english: I'm glad to see that puns are common everywhere in Gielinor; even here.
translation: Gielinor'da her yerde kelime oyunlarinin yaygin oldugunu görmek güzel, burada bile.

english: I need your help with this!
Thank you, well done!
You've [been given a new clue/obtained a casket]!
Hello there. You look lost, are you okay?
I'm looking for a stronghold or something...
translation: Bir kale ya da ona benzer bir sey ariyorum...

english: Ahh... the Stronghold of Security. It's down there.
Litara point's on the hole in the ground that looks like you could squeeze through.
translation: Litara, sigabilecegin gibi görünen yerdeki deligi isaret ediyor.

english: Looks kind of... deep and dark.
Yeah... tell that to my brother, he still hasn't come back.
translation: Evet... bunu kardesime söyle, o hala geri dönmedi.

english: Your brother?
He's an explorer too. When the miner fell down that hole he'd made and came back babbling about doors, questions and treasure, my brother went to explore. No-one has seen him since.
translation: O da bir kasif. Madenci kendi actigi cukura düstügünde ve kapilar, sorular ve hazine hakkinda gevezelik ederek geri döndügünde, kardesim kesfe cikti. O zamandan beri kimse onu görmedi.

english: Oh... that's not good.
Lots of people have been down there, but none of them have seen him, Let me know if you do, will you?
translation: Oraya bircok kisi indi ama hicbiri onu görmedi. Görürsen bana haber ver, olur mu?

english: I'll certainly keep my eyes open.
I'm fine, just passing through.
I travelled to the bottom of the stronghold, and I emerge victorious!
translation: Kalenin dibine indim ve zaferle ciktim!

english: Well done! You didn't happen to find my brother?
About that...
I sense bad news. It's okay, he's been gone so long. I believe I've moved on.
translation: Kötü haberler hissediyorum. Sorun degil, cok uzun zamandir yok. Sanirim ben hayatima devam ettim.

english: Well, at least he died doing what he loved.
translation: En azindan sevdigi seyi yaparken öldü.

english: True, I will raise a drink for him tonight, he was a good man, even if he was a pacifist.
translation: Dogru, bu gece onun icin kadeh kaldiracagim, barissever olsa da iyi bir adamdi.

english: As will I. See you around, Litara.
translation: Ben de öyle yapacagim. Görüsürüz Litara.

english: Goodbye, [player name].
I am glad the challenges of the stronghold have been overcome; it feels like my brother has somehow been avenged.
translation: Kalenin zorluklarinin üstesinden gelindigine sevindim, sanki kardesim bir sekilde intikamini almis gibi hissediyorum.

english: I'm looking for a stronghold or something...
translation: Bir kale ya da benzeri bir sey ariyorum...

english: I'm fine, just passing through.
Hello!
Greetings, human.
Who are you?
I'm Lithil. Haven't you heard of me?
Can't say I have...
...Oh, well that's no good.
Should I? Did I miss some glorious feat of yours?
translation: Duymali miydim? Senin muhtesem bir basarisini mi kacirdim?

english: You must run in all the wrong circles. It's fine, I won't hold it against you.
translation: Yanlis cevrelerde dolasiyor olmalisin. Sorun degil, sana kizmiyorum.

english: You're a demon! Usually I'm kill-
translation: Sen bir iblissin! Genelde ben öldürürüm...

english: Yes?
Nothing... You're right, wrong circles and all that.
translation: Hicbir sey... Haklisin, yanlis cevreler falan....

english: Why are you here?
Me? Can't a demon have a look around without all the questions?
translation: Ben mi? Bir iblis etrafi sorusuzca gezemez mi?...

english: Alright! I heard there were other demons in Morytania, other than that oaf, Mazchna. I've come looking for them.
translation: Tamam! Morytania'da o ahmak Mazchna disinda baska iblisler oldugunu duydum. Onlari aramaya geldim.

english: Not a fan of the slayer master?
If he truly is as great as he says, he'd fight me.
translation: Eger gercekten söyledigi kadar büyükse, benimle dövüsür.

english: He didn't want to prove himself?
Ugh, of course not. The fool says he won't fight a woman. That demon thinks he's a pillar of chivalry.
translation: Tabii ki hayir. Aptal, bir kadinla dövüsmeyecegini söylüyor. O iblis kendini sövalyeligin temeli saniyor.

english: That is a little suspicious.
Yes. Anyway, to fully answer your initial question, I found demons here to the north and some lesser demons to the east.
translation: Evet. Her neyse, ilk soruna tam olarak cevap vermek gerekirse, kuzeyde iblisler ve doguda daha kücük iblisler buldum.

english: What are they doing here?

Demons tend to stay where they were summoned. You see, once they're done eating the stupid wizard that thought it could control a demon, they're pretty much stuck until someone else decides to summon them.
translation: Iblisler genellikle cagirildiklari yerde kalirlar. Iblisi kontrol edebilecegini düsünen aptal büyücüyü yedikten sonra, baska biri onlari cagirmaya karar verene kadar orada kalirlar.

english: Summoning, aye? Sounds like a dangerous skill to practise.
translation: Cagirmak, ha? Uygulamasi tehlikeli bir beceri gibi görünüyor.

english: Be even warier of the imps. They'll steal the boots from your feet if you give 'em the chance.
translation: Implere daha da dikkat et. Firsat verirsen ayakkabilarini calacaklar.

english: I don't see how that's worse than being eaten, but thanks, I'll keep an eye out.
translation: Bunun yenilmekten daha kötü oldugunu sanmiyorum ama tesekkürler, dikkatli olacagim.

english: Bye!
See you 'round, human.
Who are you?
Why are you here?
Bye!
Nilsal, my child. I hope you are enjoying your time in the valley.
translation: Nilsal, çocugum. Umarim vadide iyi vakit geçiriyorsundur.

english: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
Sorry, but I cannot.
I could, but you don't appear to actually need healing right now.
translation: Yapabilirim, ama su anda iyilesmeye ihtiyacin yok gibi görünüyor.

english: Of course.
The teoki whispers a prayer and you suddenly feel a bit better.
translation: Teoki bir dua fisildar ve sen aniden biraz daha iyi hissedersin.

english: What's the giant tree stump all about?
translation: Dev agaç kütügü ne anlama geliyor?

english: Ah, it is quite a sad story I'm afraid. You should speak to my counterpart if you wish to hear it. He tells it better than I.
translation: Ah, korkarim ki oldukça üzücü bir hikaye. Dinlemek istersen meslektasimla konusmalisin. O benden daha iyi anlatir.

english: I'd better be off.
May the sun light your way, my child.
Can you heal me? I'm injured.
What's the giant tree stump all about?
translation: Dev agaç kütügü ne anlama geliyor?

english: I'd better be off.
You eat dreams right?
Well... not exact-
What do dreams taste like?
I don't eat dre-
I bet they taste like strawberries! I love strawberries!
translation: Eminim cilek gibi tadi vardir! Cilegi cok severim!...

english: If you're a nightmare, would a male version of you be a nighthorse?
translation: Eger sen bir kabussan, erkek versiyonun gece ati mi olur?

english: What's a horse?
I have no idea.
What's up b?
Bzz.
I see.
Face me!
Face your nightmare!
There are no sweet dreams here!
So what's got you then?
You inspect the body...
A few cuts and scrapes... No stab wound... Poison perhaps?
translation: Birkac kesik ve siyrik... Bicak yarasi yok... Zehir olabilir mi?

english: Hi.
Hey! What can I do for ya' today?
translation: Hey! Bugün senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: Who are you?
I'm Lleidr, a simple forest dweller.
translation: Ben Lleidr, basit bir orman sakini.

english: It's nice to meet you Lleidr, I'm [player name].
translation: Tanistigimiza memnun oldum Lleidr, ben Maceraci.

english: Great.
What do you do here?
Currently, I'm fishing.
Anything else?
Avoid idle chit-chat.
Alright, I get the hint.
That's nice to hear, see you around.
...Bye.
Bye!
Farewell, adventurer.
Who are you?
What do you do here?
Bye!
You look like a  that could use an overly expensive crown. Finest clothes around! Want to take a look?
translation: Asiri pahali bir tac takacak bir  gibi görünüyorsun. En kaliteli kiyafetler burada! Bir göz atmak ister misin?

english: Yes, please.
No thanks.
Your loss, I suppose.
Yes, please.
No thanks.
You look like a [man/woman] that could use an overly expensive crown. Finest clothes around! Want to take a look?
translation: Asiri pahali bir taç takabilecek birisi gibi görünüyorsun. En kaliteli kiyafetler burada! Bir göz atmak ister misin?

english: Can I interest you in any herbal equipment? Any supplies, perhaps?
translation: Bitkisel ekipmanlarla ilgilenir misin? Belki bazi malzemeler?

english: Let's see what you've got.
translation: Ne var ne yok bir bakalim.

english: No thanks.
Well whenever you're looking to mix a potion or two, I've got what you need!
translation: Ne zaman bir iki iksir karistirmak istersen, ihtiyacin olan her sey bende var!

english: Let's see what you've got.
No thanks.
Hello.
Lardi dee, lardi da.
Are you alright?
Hee hee, lardi da, lardi dee.(The gnome appears to be singing.)
translation: Hee hee, lardi da, lardi dee. (Cüce sarki söylüyor gibi görünüyor.)

english: Hello little man.
Little man stronger than big man. Hee hee, lardi dee, lardi da.
translation: Kücük adam büyük adamdan daha güclüdür. Hee hee, lardi dee, lardi da.

english: Hi.
Must save the orbs and kill the Khazard warlord. That will be fun, hee hee.
translation: Küreleri kurtarmali ve Khazard savas lordunu öldürmeliyiz. Bu cok eglenceli olacak, hee hee.

english: Hello gnome.
Soon we're gonna have the sacred ceremony and boy am I going to party. Lock up your daughters. Hee hee.
translation: Yakinda kutsal tören yapilacak ve ben de parti yapacagim. Kizlarinizi kilitleyin. Hee hee.

english: You're the best!
Thanks.
Well I'm better. Hee hee.
Hello, can I help you?
Let's trade.
Where am I?
This is the marketplace of Hosidius. To the north west there's my sister's pub, and in the south is my grandfather's fruit farm. Do you need to buy anything while you're here?
translation: Burasi Hosidius pazari. Kuzeybatida kiz kardesimin pubi var, güneyde ise büyükbabamin meyve ciftligi. Burada bir sey satin almak ister misin?

english: No, I'm okay.
Hey! You're that thief! Get away from my stall.
translation: Hey! Sen o hirsizsin! Tezgahimdan uzak dur.

english: Let's trade.
Where am I?
No, I'm okay.
Hello. What are you doing here?
I'm studying the Invasion of the Wintertodt.
Tell me more about the Wintertodt.
translation: Wintertodt hakkinda daha fazla bilgi ver.

english: The Wintertodt is a fiercely cold being, capable of freezing entire areas with its mere presence. We do not know what exactly the Wintertodt is, nor where it came from.
translation: Wintertodt, varligiyla tüm bölgeleri dondurma gücüne sahip, siddetli sogukluga sahip bir varliktir. Wintertodt'un tam olarak ne oldugunu ve nereden geldigini bilmiyoruz.

english: When the Wintertodt first attacked, it was feared that all of Kourend would be lost. Fortunately, the Order of the Sacred Flame and Dinh the Master Smith were able to stop it.
translation: Wintertodt ilk saldirdiginda, tüm Kourend'in yok olacagi korkusu vardi. Neyse ki, Kutsal Alev Tarikati ve Usta Demirci Dinh onu durdurmayi basardilar.

english: How did they stop the Wintertodt?
Dinh was a great smith and engineer. He uncovered the power of the Bruma tree. Using bark from the tree and various metal compounds, Dinh forged the doors of the prison that hold the Wintertodt.
translation: Dinh, büyük bir demirci ve mühendisti. Bruma agacinin gücünü kesfetti. Agac kabugu ve cesitli metal bilesikleri kullanarak, Dinh Wintertodt'u tutsak eden hapishanenin kapilarini dövdü.

english: In addition, the Order of the Sacred Flame utilised the Bruma tree in firemaking. They heated the environment to subdue Wintertodt.
translation: Ayrica, Kutsal Alev Tarikati ates yakmak icin Bruma agacini kullandi. Ortami isitarak Wintertodt'u bastirdilar.

english: Tell me more about the invasion.
translation: Istila hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin.

english: More than 137 decades ago, seemingly from nowhere, the Wintertodt began terrorising the lands north of Kourend, freezing everything within its path.
translation: 137 yildan fazla bir süre önce, Wintertodt birdenbire ortaya cikarak Kourend'in kuzeyindeki topraklari terörize etmeye basladi ve yoluna cikan her seyi dondurdu.

english: After five decades of this terror, the people of Kourend were able to quell the beast, containing it in an icy prison.
translation: Bes yil süren bu terörün ardindan, Kourend halki canavari bastirmayi basardi ve onu buzlu bir hapishaneye hapsetti.

english: The Wintertodt remained subdued until very recently, when it began to threaten Kourend once more.
translation: Wintertodt, cok yakin zamana kadar bastirilmis halde kaldi, ancak son zamanlarda Kourend'i bir kez daha tehdit etmeye basladi.

english: Fortunately, the Order of the Sacred Flame is able to contain the Wintertodt and prevent another attack.
translation: Neyse ki, Kutsal Alev Tarikati Wintertodt'u hapsetmeyi basardi ve baska bir saldiriyi önledi.

english: Goodbye.
Tell me more about the Wintertodt.
translation: Wintertodt hakkinda daha fazla bilgi ver.

english: How did they stop the Wintertodt?
Tell me more about the invasion.
translation: Istila hakkinda daha fazla bilgi ver.

english: Goodbye.
I'm going to stop looking for temple, sun and moon pages.
translation: Tapinak, günes ve ay sayfalarini aramayi birakacagim.

english: As you wish adventurer.
You will no longer have a chance to receive temple, sun and moon pages from creatures in the Forthos Dungeon.
translation: Artik Forthos Zindani'ndaki yaratiklardan tapinak, günes ve ay sayfalarini alma sansin olmayacak.

english: Now shhhh!
I'm going to start looking for temple, sun and moon pages.
translation: Tapinak, günes ve ay sayfalarini aramaya baslayacagim.

english: You will now have a chance to receive temple, sun and moon pages from creatures in the Forthos Dungeon.
translation: Artik Forthos Zindani'ndaki yaratiklardan tapinak, günes ve ay sayfalarini alma sansin olacak.

english: Shhhh!
Tell me about the Library.
What do you do here?
Do you help people find books?
translation: Insanlarin kitap bulmasina yardim mi ediyorsun?

english: Can you stop shushing me?
translation: Bana susma diye bagirmayi keser misin?

english: Do you do anything useful at all?
translation: Hic yararli bir sey yapiyor musun?

english: What is wrong with you?
What is the point in you being here?
How can I get a job like yours?
translation: Senin gibi bir isi nasil bulabilirim?

english: You're an utterly useless person.
HOW ABOUT I SHOUT REALLY LOUD THEN?
translation: O ZAMAN COK YÜKSEK SESLE BAGIRAYIM MI?

english: Sorry.
That's better.
You show Logosia the tome.
I have not seen this before. Your donation to the library is appreciated.
translation: Bunu daha önce görmemistim. Kütüphaneye yaptigin bagis icin tesekkür ederiz.

english: You can have this tome which I discovered aswell.
translation: Benim de kesfettigim bu kitabi alabilirsin.

english: You hand Logosia the tome.
You can have these tomes which I discovered aswell.
translation: Benim de kesfettigim bu kitaplari alabilirsin.

english: You hand Logosia the tomes.
Again, your donation to the library is appreciated
translation: Tekrar söylüyorum, kütüphaneye yaptiginiz bagis icin tesekkür ederiz.

english: Your contributions to the library have been noticed. We would like to reward you for your assistance.
translation: Kütüphaneye yaptiginiz katkilar fark edildi. Yardimlariniz icin sizi ödüllendirmek istiyoruz.

english: You receive an experience lamp as a reward.
translation: Ödül olarak bir deneyim lambasi aliyorsunuz.

english: If you find any spare pages for these books I would be willing to give you 1,000 gold for each one. Duplicate sources of information are always useful.
translation: Bu kitaplarin eksik sayfalarini bulursaniz, her biri icin size 1.000 altin vermeye hazirim. Cift bilgi kaynaklari her zaman yararlidir.

english: I'll keep an eye out.
Enough talk now, Shhhh!
Here you go.
I'm going to stop looking for temple, sun and moon pages.
translation: Tapinak, günes ve ay sayfalarini aramayi birakacagim.

english: I'm going to start looking for temple, sun and moon pages.
translation: Tapinak, günes ve ay sayfalarini aramaya baslayacagim.

english: Something else.
Tell me about the Library.
What do you do here?
Do you help people find books?
translation: Insanlarin kitap bulmasina yardim ediyor musunuz?

english: Can you stop shushing me?
Do you do anything useful at all?
translation: Hic yararli bir sey yapiyor musunuz?

english: What is wrong with you?
What is the point in you being here?
How can I get a job like yours?
translation: Senin gibi bir isi nasil bulabilirim?

english: You're an utterly useless person.
HOW ABOUT I SHOUT REALLY LOUD THEN.
translation: O ZAMAN COK YÜKSEK SESLE BAGIRAYIM MI?

english: Sorry.
Can I help you today?
Can I go for a ride?
Minecart rides are 20 coins.
Of course.
I'm fine, thanks.
As a loyal customer of the Lovakengj Minecart Network, you're entitled to this.
translation: Lovakengj Minecart Network'ün sadik bir müsterisi olarak, buna hakkiniz var.

english: Now, can I help you today?
translation: Simdi, bugün size nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: You're already here, human.
Can I go for a ride?
I'm fine, thanks.
Hello there.
Don't talk to me! I don't have time for the likes of you!
translation: Benimle konusma! Senin gibilere ayiracak vaktim yok!

english: You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Lunar Diplomacy quest.
translation: Lunar Diplomacy görevine baslamak icin gerekli tüm sartlari saglamiyorsun.

english: Hey! Don't call me outerlander! I'm known as the mighty [Fremennik name]!
translation: Hey! Bana yabanci deme! Ben güclü Dokrak olarak bilinirim!

english: Can't say I've heard of you. So they let your sort into the clan nowadays? Wow. Things have really changed since I've been gone...
translation: Seni hic duymadim. Demek artik senin gibileri klana kabul ediyorlar? Vay canina. Ben yokken isler gercekten degismis...

english: You don't look like a Fremennik yourself...
Yes, I suppose that's true... I have been gone such a long time...
translation: Evet, sanirim haklisin... Cok uzun zamandir yoktum...

english: (shows previous options)
You've been away from these parts a while?
translation: Bu bölgeden uzun zamandir uzak miydin?

english: Oh, you haven't heard of the infamous Lokar, scourge of the northern seas?
translation: Oh, kuzey denizlerinin belasi, kötü söhretli Lokar'i duymadin mi?

english: Erm... no... That's you then, is it?
translation: Erm... hayir... O sensin, degil mi?

english: Forgotten already? Tch! I have no regrets about why I left!
translation: Unuttun mu? Tch! Gittigim icin pisman degilim!

english: Why did you leave?
As a young man, I learnt that the Fremennik way of life was too slow for me...
translation: Genc bir adam olarak, Fremennik yasam tarzinin benim icin cok yavas oldugunu anladim...

english: Oh, sure, every so often we got to go on big raiding parties, looting and pillaging the weaker islands around here for food and profit, but...
translation: Oh, tabii, ara sira büyük yagma partilerine katilir, buradaki zayif adalari yiyecek ve kâr icin yagmalar ve talan ederdik, ama...

english: Well, after a while, that was all I looked forward to doing.
translation: Bir süre sonra, tek istedigim sey bu olmustu.

english: Growing crops, milking cows, catching and cooking food, the day to day activities of our life...
translation: Ekin ekme, inek sagma, avlanma ve yemek pisirme, hayatimizin günlük faaliyetleri...

english: THEY'RE SO BORING!
No, I knew what I wanted to do, and that was attack innocent people going about their daily business, steal all their money, then spend it on wine, women and song!
translation: Hayir, ne yapmak istedigimi biliyordum, o da günlük islerini yapan masum insanlara saldirmak, tüm paralarini calmak ve sonra onu sarap, kadinlar ve sarkilara harcamakti!

english: Oh.... Kaaaaay....
So I ran away from Rellekka to become a PIRATE! It's way more fun. Plus you get to see the world!
translation: Ben de Rellekka'dan kacip KORSAN oldum! Cok daha eglenceli. Ayrica dünyayi görebiliyorsun!

english: Was the world good then? Only, you seem to have returned to Rellekka after all.
translation: O zamanlar dünya güzel miydi? Ama sonucta Rellekka'ya geri dönmüssün.

english: Yes, I have returned here, but that's only because we're short on supplies.
translation: Evet, buraya döndüm, ama bunun tek nedeni erzakimizin azalmasi.

english: I see. So where are you and your scurvy sea-dogs headed to next? Arrr shiver-me timbers!
translation: Anliyorum. Peki, sen ve senin cürümüs deniz kurtlari simdi nereye gidiyorsunuz? Arrr, titremeye basladim!

english: You're trying my patience...
Sorry, got caught up in the moment.
Indeed. Well, the rest of the group are at Lunar Isle at the moment. It's where the Moon Clan live.
translation: Gercekten. Su anda grubun geri kalani Lunar Isle'da. Ay Klani'nin yasadigi yer.

english: The Moon Clan... I think I've heard of them...
I'd be surprised if you hadn't, they're the Fremenniks' most hated enemy!
translation: Duymamis olmana sasirirdim, onlar Fremenniklerin en nefret ettigi düsmanlari!

english: They've been at war with them for hundreds of years!
Hmmm. Actually, that might be a problem for you then.
translation: Hmmm. Aslinda, bu senin icin bir sorun olabilir.

english: A problem?
Yeah, they're a really powerful race of mages. They'd read your mind and see that you're a Fremennik straight away, then probably turn you inside out and feed you to the birds.
translation: Evet, onlar gercekten cok güclü bir büyücü irki. Zihnini okuyup senin bir Fremennik oldugunu hemen anlarlar, sonra muhtemelen seni tersyüz edip kuslara yem ederler.

english: Cosmic.
But you went there okay?
Yeah, but I think the Fremenniks are a bunch of losers. They probably picked up on that.
translation: Evet, ama bence Fremennikler bir grup ezik. Muhtemelen bunu fark etmislerdir.

english: Look, I know a way you'll be able to travel there without, you know, getting killed and that, if you fancy a trip!
translation: Bak, oraya öldürülmeden gidebilecegin bir yol biliyorum, eger bir geziye cikmak istersen!

english: Why not, I've always wondered what the state of my innards are!
translation: Neden olmasin, ic organlarimin ne durumda oldugunu hep merak etmisimdir!

english: That's the spirit!
Well, what you want to do is go and talk to Brundt the Chieftain and get a Seal of Passage from him.
translation: Yapman gereken sey, Sef Brundt ile konusup ondan Gecis Mührü almak.

english: A Seal of Passage? What's that?
translation: Gecis Mührü mü? O da ne?

english: Well, it shows that you're a diplomat for the Fremennik, so you'll have immunity from being killed and stuff.
translation: Fremennik'in diplomati oldugunu gösterir, böylece öldürülmekten ve benzeri seylerden muaf olursun.

english: It's an ancient tradition not to attack anyone bearing a Seal of Passage, because they're probably on a diplomatic mission. Or well connected with powerful allies. Either way, killing them is usually a bad idea.
translation: Gecis Mührü tasiyan kimseye saldirmamak eski bir gelenektir, cünkü muhtemelen diplomatik bir görevdedirler. Ya da güclü müttefiklerle baglantilari vardir. Her iki durumda da, onlari öldürmek genellikle kötü bir fikirdir.

english: So I have to try and bring peace to two warring nations who have been fighting for centuries?!?!
translation: Yani yüzyillardir savasan iki ülkeye baris getirmem mi gerekiyor?!?!

english: What? I never said you had to bother trying to do that, you just have to pretend like you might.
translation: Ne? Bunu yapmaya calisman gerektigini hic söylemedim, sadece yapiyormus gibi davranman gerekiyor.

english: No skin off my nose if those losers want to get slaughtered by the Moon Clan, just more stuff for me to loot when they're all dead.
translation: O ezikler Ay Klani tarafindan katledilmek istiyorlarsa, benim icin bir sakincasi yok, hepsi öldügünde yagmalayacagim daha fazla sey olur.

english: Well I will try. I am the mighty [Fremennik name] after all!
translation: Peki, deneyecegim. Sonucta ben güclü Dokrak'yim!

english: Yes....
So I just have to go talk to Brundt the Chieftain and tell him I want a Seal of Passage?
translation: Yani sadece Sef Brundt ile konusup ona Gecis Mührü istedigimi söylemem mi gerekiyor?

english: That's it? Because in my experience simple tasks like that always seem to take longer than I expect...
translation: Hepsi bu mu? Cünkü benim tecrübelerime göre bu tür basit görevler her zaman bekledigimden daha uzun sürer...

english: Yeah, just go over and talk to the chief loser. You might have to tell him some rubbish he wants to hear, but that's it.
translation: Evet, gidip sef ezikle konus. Ona duymak istedigi sacmaliklari söylemen gerekebilir, ama hepsi bu.

english: Come back here when you got it, my supplies are loaded and I'm good to head back to our ship.
translation: Aldiginda buraya geri gel, malzemelerimi yükledim ve gemimize dönmeye hazirim.

english: Okay, I'll be right back.
No thanks, I'd like to live.
Oh, so you're a loser like the rest of the Fremenniks then? See ya around, loser.
translation: Demek sen de diger Fremennikler gibi bir eziksin? Görüsürüz ezik.

english: Well, 'bye then.
You won't make many friends on Lunar Isle without your Seal of Passage.
translation: Gecis Mührün olmadan Lunar Isle'da pek arkadas edinemezsin.

english: That's fine, I'm just going to Pirates' Cove.
translation: Sorun degil, ben sadece Korsan Koyu'na gidiyorum.

english: Player is transported to Pirates' cove
Oh, I'd better go back and get it.
Hi Lokar, can you take me back to your ship?
translation: Merhaba Lokar, beni gemine geri götürebilir misin?

english: Sheesh, make your mind up [pal/lady], I'm not a taxi service!
translation: Haydi ama, kararini ver dostum, ben taksi hizmeti vermiyorum!

english: Actually, I've changed my mind. Again. I don't want to go.
translation: Aslinda, fikrimi degistirdim. Yine. Gitmek istemiyorum.

english: You are possibly the most indecisive person I have ever met...
translation: Sen muhtemelen tanidigim en kararsiz insansin...

english: Hello again Lokar.
Hi again [Fremennik name]! What can I do for you?
translation: Merhaba Dokrak! Senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: Do I still need the Seal of Passage?
translation: Gecis Mührü'ne hala ihtiyacim var mi?

english: Yeah, why?
I lost it.
Silly you. You'll have to go back to Brundt the Chieftain to get another before you can go on to Lunar Isle.
translation: Aptal sey. Lunar Isle'a gitmeden önce, baska bir tane almak icin Sef Brundt'a geri dönmen gerekecek.

english: Can you take me back to Rellekka please?
translation: Beni Rellekka'ya geri götürebilir misin lütfen?

english: Hey, if you want to go back to loserville with all the losers, who am I to stop you?
translation: Hey, tüm eziklerle birlikte eziklerin diyarina geri dönmek istiyorsan, ben kimim ki seni durdurayim?

english: Player is transported to Rellekka
Nothing thanks! I just saw you here and thought I'd say hello!
translation: Hicbir sey, tesekkürler! Seni burada gördüm ve merhaba demek istedim!

english: Hey, I knew you seemed cool when I met you [Fremennik name]!
translation: Hey, seni ilk gördügümde havali birine benziyordun Dokrak!

english: You don't look like a Fremennik yourself...
You've been away from these parts a while?
translation: Bu bölgeden uzun süredir uzaktasin, degil mi?

english: Why did you leave?
Yes.
No.
'Bye then.
That's fine, I'm just going to Pirates' Cove.
translation: Sorun degil, ben sadece Korsan Koyu'na gidiyorum.

english: Oh, I'd better go back and get it.
Go now.
Don't go.
Can you take me back to Rellekka?
Nothing thanks.
Greetings human.
Hello, who are you?
Lokraa quo Sihar. I am one of the mystics of the Kahlith. Are you here to serve the balance?
translation: Lokraa quo Sihar. Ben Kahlith'in mistiklerinden biriyim. Dengeyi saglamak icin mi buradasin?

english: Yes.
Then you should speak to Konar quo Maten. She will guide you.
translation: O zaman Konar quo Maten ile konusmalisin. O sana yol gösterecektir.

english: No.
A shame. You are a bringer of death, you could be of great use to the balance.
translation: Yazik. Sen ölümün habercisiisin, denge icin cok yararli olabilirsin.

english: I'm not sure.
Then you should speak with Xorrah quo Sihar. He will show you the way.
translation: O zaman Xorrah quo Sihar ile konusmalisin. O sana yolu gösterecektir.

english: Yes.
No.
I'm not sure.
Arrr, matey!
I'm looking for Redbeard Frank.
Redbeard Frank ye say? He be outside. Says he likes the feel of the wind on his cheeks.
translation: Kizil Sakal Frank mi dedin? Disarida. Yanaklarinda rüzgari hissetmeyi sevdigini söylüyor.

english: Thanks.
Why are you called Longbow Ben?
translation: Neden sana Uzun Yay Ben deniyor?

english: Arrr, that's a strange yarn.
I was to be marooned, ye see. A scurvy troublemaker had taken my ship, and he put me ashore on a little island.
translation: Ben terk edilecektim, anlarsin ya. Alcak bir bas belasi gemimi ele gecirmis ve beni kücük bir adaya birakmisti.

english: Gosh, how did you escape?
Arrr, ye see, he made one mistake! Before he sailed away, he gave me a bow and one arrow so that I wouldn't have to die slowly.
translation: Arrr, anlarsin ya, o bir hata yapti! Denize acilmadan önce, yavas yavas ölmemem icin bana bir yay ve bir ok verdi.

english: So I shot him and took my ship back.
translation: Ben de onu vurdum ve gemimi geri aldim.

english: Right...
Have you got any quests I could do?
translation: Yapabilecegim herhangi bir görev var mi?

english: Nay, but the barkeep hears most of the news around here. Or Redbeard Frank, he's often spoken of buried treasure. Perhaps ye should be asking them for quests.
translation: Hayir, ama barmen buradaki haberlerin cogunu duyar. Ya da Kizil Sakalli Frank, o sik sik gömülü hazinelerden bahseder. Belki de onlara görevler sormalisin.

english: Nay, but Redbeard Frank has often spoken of buried treasure. Perhaps ye should be asking him for a quest.
translation: Hayir, ama Kizil Sakalli Frank sik sik gömülü hazinelerden bahseder. Belki de ona görevler sormalisin.

english: Nay, but the barkeep hears most of the news around here. Perhaps ye should be asking him for a quest.
translation: Hayir, ama barmen buradaki haberlerin cogunu duyar. Belki de ona görev sormalisin.

english: Nay, I've nothing for ye to do. But I hear there's an old landlubber in Draynor Village who's always a-looking for a lively [lad/lass] to do him a favour.
translation: Hayir, sana verecek bir görevim yok. Ama Draynor Köyü'nde her zaman kendisine yardim edecek neseli bir delikanli ya da kiz arayan yasli bir karaci oldugunu duydum.

english: Arrr, matey!
Yo ho ho!
So are you pirates?
Aye laddie, that we are.
Aye, that we be.
Nay, always ye say it wrong! Tis 'we are', not 'we be'.
translation: Hayir, hep yanlis söylüyorsun! “Öyleyiz” degil, “öyleyiz” denir.

english: I be a pirate, not a scurvy schoolmaster!
translation: Ben korsanim, pis bir ögretmen degil!

english: Ye be a fool, and a disgrace to piracy.
translation: Sen bir aptalsin ve korsanliga leke sürüyorsun.

english: Now ye be saying 'be' too!
Arrr! Tis thy fault.
I think I'll leave you two to sort it out.
I'm looking for Redbeard Frank.
Why are you called Longbow Ben?
Have you got any quests I could do?
Hey, outerlander. You can't go through there. Talent only, backstage.
translation: Hey, yabanci. Oradan gecemezsin. Sadece yetenekli olanlar sahne arkasina girebilir.

english: Get lost, outerlander. Performers only past this point.
translation: Defol, yabanci. Bu noktadan sonra sadece sanatcilar gecebilir.

english: But I am a performer!
Oh, really? So where's your instrument?
Um... I'm an acapella bard?
Oh, really? You won't mind singing me a quick song then.
translation: Oh, gercekten mi? O zaman bana kisa bir sarki söyleseniz sorun olmaz.

english: Tie me chompy bird down, Rantz Tie me chompy bird down! Me stickers don't get no quicker, So tie me chompy bird down!
translation: Chompy kusumu bagla, Rantz Chompy kusumu bagla! Cikartmalarim daha hizli olmuyor, O yüzden chompy kusumu bagla!

english: (continues below)
Murphy row the boat ashore... We are siiiiinking...
My old man's a miner, Spends all day mining ore, He wears a dragon ammy, And lives in Falador - Oi!
translation: Babam madenci, bütün gün madencilik yapiyor, ejderha zirhi giyiyor ve Falador'da yasiyor - Oi!

english: Elvarg the magic dragon... Lives by the sea... He spends all his days eating folk, And dies occasionally...
translation: Elvarg, sihirli ejderha... Deniz kenarinda yasiyor... Bütün günlerini insanlari yiyerek geciriyor ve ara sira ölüyor...

english: That was a pile of tosh. Get lost, outerlander. You're a bard like I'm a goblin. Do I look stupid to you?
translation: Bu tam bir sacmalikti. Defol git, yabanci. Sen benim goblin oldugum kadar ozan degilsin. Sana aptal mi görünüyorum?

english: Well, actually...
I said, get lost.
You have an instrument now, huh? Go on through the door.
translation: Artik bir enstrümanin var, ha? Kapidan gec.

english: Yeah, you're good to go through. Olaf tells me you're some kind of outerlander bard here on tour. I doubt you're worse than Olaf is.
translation: Evet, gecebilirsin. Olaf bana senin burada turneye cikmis bir yabanci ozan oldugunu söyledi. Olaf'tan daha kötü oldugunu sanmiyorum.

english: You can't go through there. Talent only, backstage.
translation: Oradan gecemezsin. Sadece yetenekli olanlar sahne arkasina girebilir.

english: But I'm a Bard!
No you're not. I saw your performance. I was paid well to keep you from ever setting foot on stage here again.
translation: Hayir, degilsin. Performansini gördüm. Bir daha bu sahneye adimini atmamak icin iyi para aldim.

english: Tie Me Chompy Bird Down
Murphy Row The Boat Ashore
My Old Man's A Miner
Elvarg The Magic Dragon
Hello there.
Hello, Longramble. How goes the hunt for the edge of the world?
translation: Merhaba, Longramble. Dünyanin kenarini aramak nasil gidiyor?

english: Truth be told, I've found myself getting a bit side- tracked. The potential discovery of Arposandra is quite an exciting one!
translation: Dogrusu, biraz dikkatim dagildi. Arposandra'nin kesfedilme olasiligi oldukca heyecan verici!

english: And also quite dangerous.
Yes, that's why I've not dared go inside again. It's much safer out here. Slightly less smelly as well.
translation: Evet, bu yüzden tekrar iceri girmeye cesaret edemedim. Burasi cok daha güvenli. Biraz daha az kokulu da.

english: Slightly being the key word there.
Hello there. How goes the hunt for Arposandra?
translation: Merhaba. Arposandra'yi bulma arayisin nasil gidiyor?

english: I think I've found an entrance to the city, but it's too well defended. There's all these traps, and some talking terrorbird guards!
translation: Sanirim sehre bir giris buldum, ama cok iyi korunuyor. Bir sürü tuzak var ve konusan terör kusu muhafizlar!

english: Talking terrorbirds? There must be some strange magic being practised in there. What do you plan to do?
translation: Konusan terör kuslari mi? Orada garip bir büyü yapiliyor olmali. Ne yapmayi planliyorsun?

english: I don't know. I think I've hit a dead end for now.
translation: Bilmiyorum. Su an icin cikmaza girdim galiba.

english: That's a shame. Still, you've made a big discovery. It will be quite the tale to tell... assuming anyone believes a story about talking terrorbirds, that is.
translation: Cok yazik. Yine de büyük bir kesif yaptin. Anlatacak cok ilginc bir hikaye olacak... tabii konusan terör kuslari hakkindaki bir hikayeye kimse inanirsa.

english: What do you want?
What are you guarding?
This path leads to the Doors of Dinh. You should be careful if you wish to travel any further.
translation: Bu yol Dinh Kapilari'na cikiyor. Daha ileri gitmek istiyorsan dikkatli olmalisin.

english: Tell me about the Doors of Dinh.
They're to keep the Wintertodt at bay. No-one knows what it really is, but centuries ago it came out of the northern wastes to terrorise the kingdom.
translation: Wintertodt'u uzak tutmak icin yapilmislar. Kimse onun gercekte ne oldugunu bilmiyor, ama yüzyillar önce kuzeydeki corak topraklardan cikip kralligi dehsete düsürdü.

english: The Doors were created by Dinh, a master smither, to imprison the Wintertodt.
translation: Kapilar, Wintertodt'u hapsetmek icin usta demirci Dinh tarafindan yaratildi.

english: Now we keep a watch on the pass, so that the armies can be summoned if the Wintertodt ever escapes.
translation: Simdi gecidi gözetliyoruz, böylece Wintertodt kacarsa ordular cagrilabilir.

english: Okay, thanks for the warning.
Who are you?
I'm the duty look-out on the northern pass. It's the worst assignment there is.
translation: Ben kuzey gecidinde nöbetci olarak görev yapiyorum. Bu, en kötü görevdir.

english: As if the cold weren't bad enough, the snooty Arceuus magi always look down their noses at the Shayzien armies, just because we use muscle and steel rather than fancy magicks.
translation: Soguk yeterince kötü degilmis gibi, kibirli Arceuus büyücüleri, sirf biz süslü büyüler yerine kas gücümüzü ve celigimizi kullandigimiz icin Shayzien ordularina her zaman burun kivirirlar.

english: I'll leave you alone now.
What are you guarding?
Tell me about the Doors of Dinh.
Okay, thanks for the warning.
Who are you?
I'll leave you alone now.
You! You're the one that lost me my tithes. Get out before I have you killed!
translation: Sen! Benim vergilerimi kaybettiren sensin. Seni öldürmeden önce defol git!

english: Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: Insan! Muhafizlari cagirmadan önce köle kafeslerine geri dön!

english: You there. Who are you?
[Vampyre Name]
Tell me, [player vampyre name], what blood tastes the best?
Err... Human?
You misunderstand me, I mean what kind of human?
translation: Yanlis anladin, ne tür bir insan demek istedim?

english: One with a face?
What? I mean, yes. But what else?
translation: Ne? Evet, öyle. Ama baska ne?

english: I don't know... What's the actual answer?
Love. Blood tastes best when it comes from one who loves.
translation: Ask. Kan, seven birinden geldiginde en lezzetli olur.

english: Too many around here treat their tithes with discontentment. When they do, they miss out on the full potential blood has to offer.
translation: Buralarda cok fazla kisi vergilerini hosnutsuzlukla ödüyor. Böyle yaptiklarinda, kanin sunabilecegi tüm potansiyeli kaciriyorlar.

english: Treat your tithes with respect instead. They will come to love you, and their blood becomes so much better as a result.
translation: Vergilerini saygiyla öde. Seni sevmeye baslayacaklar ve sonuc olarak kanlari cok daha lezzetli hale gelecek.

english: I see. I'll keep that in mind.
Baxtorian.
[player name].
How are things?
The city is flourishing, largely thanks to you. There's still some mistrust for the Iorwerth clan, but overall I'd say it's been over a thousand years since our people were doing this well.
translation: Sehir, büyük ölcüde senin sayende gelisiyor. Iorwerth klanina karsi hala biraz güvensizlik var, ama genel olarak halkimizin bu kadar iyi durumda oldugu son bin yildir ilk kez oldugunu söyleyebilirim.

english: That's great to hear. What about you though?
translation: Bunu duymak cok güzel. Peki ya sen?

english: I still mourn Glarial every day, until the end of time a part of me will be missing, never to be replaced.
translation: Hala her gün Glarial'in yasini tutuyorum, sonsuza kadar bir parcam eksik kalacak ve asla yerine konamayacak.

english: But I know now that I can't let that impact the elves here. Many of them never even knew their former queen. My grief is mine alone, they need not bear it.
translation: Ama artik bunun buradaki elfleri etkilemesine izin veremeyecegimi biliyorum. Bircogu eski kralicelerini hic tanimadi bile. Acim sadece bana ait, onlar bunu tasimak zorunda degil.
