english: To them, I'm trying my best to be a leader they deserve, to correct the mistakes of the past. Lord Iorwerth believed we were nothing without Seren. We need to prove that we have a future with her gone.
translation: Onlar icin, gecmisteki hatalari düzeltmek icin hak ettikleri bir lider olmak icin elimden geleni yapiyorum. Lord Iorwerth, Seren olmadan hicbir sey olmadigimiza inaniyordu. Onun yoklugunda da bir gelecegimiz oldugunu kanitlamaliyiz.

english: Thankfully I have the other elders to help this time. Ruling is not as hard when you share out the responsiblities.
translation: Neyse ki bu sefer diger yaslilar da bana yardim ediyor. Sorumluluklari paylastiginizda yönetmek o kadar da zor olmuyor.

english: Well I'm glad to hear things are going well.
And we are glad to have you here with us. None of this would have been possible without you.
translation: Biz de senin burada olmana seviniyoruz. Sen olmasaydin bunlarin hicbiri mümkün olmazdi.

english: Are you alright?
You may speak.
Oh, yes yes, I'm fine.
You look a little beat up.
These scratches? Don't worry, just a disagreement with a thorn bush.
translation: Bu cizikler mi? Merak etme, sadece dikenli bir caliyla anlasmazlik yasadim.

english: Sure...
Is there something you wanted, bloodbag?
translation: Bir sey mi istiyordun, kan torbasi?

english: Just looking around.
Well, I'd prefer you did it elsewhere, Crombwick is busy entertaining his guests.
translation: Baska bir yerde yapmani tercih ederim, Crombwick misafirlerini agirlamakla mesgul.

english: Strange bunch of guests...
Hello.
What want you, with the Lord of the Kinshra? Speak!
Erm, nothing actually.
Then begone knave, before I have my Knights put you to the sword!
translation: O zaman git buradan, yoksa sövalyelerime seni kilictan gecirtirim!

english: Greetings [player name].
Hey Iestin. So they made you the new Lord Iorwerth?
translation: Selam Iestin. Seni yeni Lord Iorwerth yaptilar mi?

english: Indeed. Apart from Morvran, I am the closest living relative of the previous Lord Iorwerth.
translation: Evet. Morvran disinda, önceki Lord Iorwerth'in hayattaki en yakin akrabasi benim.

english: Did Morvran not want the role?
No. That's probably for the best though. Morvran was very close to my predecessor. It would have made many uncomfortable if he had taken on the role.
translation: Hayir. Ama muhtemelen böylesi daha iyi. Morvran, öncülümle cok yakindi. O bu görevi üstlenseydi, bircok kisi rahatsiz olurdu.

english: How have things been since the city was reformed?
translation: Sehir yeniden düzenlendiginden beri isler nasil gidiyor?

english: The others still hold a lot of mistrust for our clan. It will take a long time for those rifts to be repaired. We are on the right path though.
translation: Digerleri hala klanimiza karsi büyük bir güvensizlik duyuyor. Bu ucurumlarin kapanmasi uzun zaman alacak. Ama dogru yoldayiz.

english: That's good to hear. All the best.
translation: Bunu duymak güzel. Her sey gönlünce olsun.

english: Likewise.
Good day [player name]. Have you come to hear the song of the elves?
translation: Iyi günler Maceraci. Elflerin sarkisini dinlemeye mi geldin?

english: What do you mean?
Do you not hear it? The sounds of a city in harmony. It is the song of the elves, the story of our people.
translation: Duymuyor musun? Sehrin uyum icindeki sesleri. Bu elflerin sarkisi, halkimizin hikayesi.

english: The last few verses were dark and quiet, but now our city is restored, we find ourselves singing a new verse, one of joy and light.
translation: Son birkac dize karanlik ve sessizdi, ama simdi sehrimiz yeniden insa edildi ve kendimizi yeni bir dize, nese ve isik dolu bir dize söylerken buluyoruz.

english: I see. I guess I've never been the type to reflect on that sort of thing.
translation: Anliyorum. Sanirim ben bu tür seyleri düsünen biri degilim.

english: More of a fighter? We have a song for that too. If you wish to sing it, head to the Gauntlet and put yourself to the test.
translation: Daha cok savasci misin? Bunun icin de bir sarkimiz var. Eger söylemek istersen, Gauntlet'e git ve kendini sinava tabi tut.

english: I might just give it a shot. Thanks.
Hello.
Hello there.
Tell me about yourself.
I am Kandur Hosidius and I am the lord of Hosidius, the city of farmers and chefs. I live here with my wife, Elena, and my two sons, Artur and Pandur.
translation: Ben Kandur Hosidius ve ciftciler ve ascilarin sehri Hosidius'un lorduyum. Burada esim Elena ve iki oglum Artur ve Pandur ile yasiyorum.

english: My family and I have a peaceful existence here. That's mainly because I care not for the politics of the other houses. I instead devote my time to more meaningful pursuits.
translation: Ailem ve ben burada huzurlu bir hayat sürüyoruz. Bunun sebebi, diger hanelerin politikasiyla ilgilenmememdir. Bunun yerine, zamanimi daha anlamli ugraslara adiyorum.

english: Such as?
Ensuring that Kourend is well fed. We may live in gentle times now but who knows how long it will be that way. Sooner or later another war or long winter will hit us. History has proven that.
translation: Kourend'in iyi beslenmesini saglamak. Su anda huzurlu zamanlar yasiyor olabiliriz, ama bu durumun ne kadar sürecegi belli degil. Er ya da gec baska bir savas ya da uzun bir kis bizi vuracak. Tarih bunu kanitlamistir.

english: Anything else I can help you with?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: Tell me about Hosidius.
Hosidius is home to the farmers and chefs of Kourend. We are the main food supplier to the kingdom and we ensure that her people are fed.
translation: Hosidius, Kourend'in ciftcilerinin ve ascilarinin evidir. Kralligin ana gida tedarikcisiyiz ve halkinin beslenmesini sagliyoruz.

english: We also own more land than the other Kourend houses. We need the extra space for all of our crops.
translation: Ayrica diger Kourend hanedanlarindan daha fazla topraga sahibiz. Tüm mahsullerimiz icin ekstra alana ihtiyacimiz var.

english: Do the other houses not get annoyed at how much land you have?
translation: Diger evler, sahip oldugunuz topraklarin büyüklügünden rahatsiz olmuyor mu?

english: Sometimes. They know it is necessary though. There was once a time when the land was shared equally. But then the great famine came, and Kourend did not have the food to last through it.
translation: Bazen. Ama bunun gerekli oldugunu biliyorlar. Bir zamanlar topraklar esit olarak paylasiliyordu. Ancak büyük kitlik geldiginde, Kourend'de kitligi atlatacak kadar yiyecek yoktu.

english: After that, more space was given to Hosidius. We've had the most land ever since.
translation: Ondan sonra Hosidius'a daha fazla toprak verildi. O zamandan beri en fazla topraga sahip olan biziz.

english: Tell me about your plans.
Plans? My only plan is to keep providing food to this kingdom.
translation: Planlarim mi? Tek planim bu kralliga yiyecek saglamaya devam etmek.

english: But what of the Royal Accord of Twill? You must have kept it for a reason.
translation: Peki ya Twill Kraliyet Anlasmasi? Bir nedeni oldugu icin saklamis olmalisin.

english: I did. The Accord has the potential to be a powerful weapon, for words cut deeper than a blade ever can. However, I have no need to use this weapon, not unless the other houses give me reason to.
translation: Öyle. Anlasma, kelimelerin bir kilictan daha derin kesebildigi icin güclü bir silah olma potansiyeline sahip. Ancak, diger hanedanlar bana bir neden vermedikce bu silahi kullanmaya ihtiyacim yok.

english: Goodbye.
Until next time.
Tell me about yourself.
Tell me about Hosidius.
Tell me about your plans.
Goodbye.
Good day!
Isn't it just!
What brings you down here?
This and that... But mostly, I'm looking for a good place to mobilise my army.
translation: Su bu... Ama cogunlukla ordumu seferber etmek icin iyi bir yer ariyorum.

english: That's awfully specific, you sure this is a good place for it?
translation: Bu cok spesifik, burasinin bunun icin iyi bir yer oldugundan emin misin?

english: I don't see why not!
I'm not sure there's enough land, to be honest.
translation: Dürüst olmak gerekirse, yeterli arazi oldugundan emin degilim.

english: Tish tosh! I'm importing sand from Al Kharid, there'll be a base camp here in no time, do not fret!
translation: Sacmalik! Al Kharid'den kum ithal ediyorum, cok gecmeden burada bir ana kamp kurulacak, endiselenme!

english: Oh. Okay then.
The tithes are growing weak. That werewolf needs to do a better job of keeping them fed.
translation: Vergiler zayifliyor. O kurt adam onlari daha iyi beslemeli.

english: What do you feed them?
There's no shortage of corpses around here. The dead can still have some uses.
translation: Buralarda ceset sikintisi yok. Ölüler hala ise yarayabilir.

english: You're feeding them corpses? No wonder they're becoming weak. That meat must have all sorts of problems.
translation: Onlara ceset mi yediriyorsun? Zayiflamalarina sasmamali. O etin bir sürü sorunu olmali.

english: What else would you have me feed them? If I give them nicer food, I'm wasting more money than if I were to just kill them and buy some more.
translation: Onlara baska ne yedireyim? Onlara daha iyi yemek verirsem, onlari öldürüp yenilerini satin almaktan daha fazla para harcamis olurum.

english: I... I suppose.
Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: Insan! Muhafizlari cagirmadan köle kafeslerine geri dön!

english: Hello.
Hello there young one. Interested in getting your hands dirty?
translation: Merhaba genc adam. Ellerini kirletmek ister misin?

english: Err... maybe?
Ah don't worry, it's nothing sinister. We leave that kind of thing to clan Iorwerth. I speak in a more literal sense, of the ground beneath us and the trees over us.
translation: Merak etme, kötü bir sey degil. O tür isleri Iorwerth klanina birakiyoruz. Ben daha gercek anlamda, altimizdaki topragi ve üstümüzdeki agaclari kastediyorum.

english: Oh, I see. So it's your clan that looks after the plants of the city?
translation: Anliyorum. Yani sehrin bitkilerini sizin klaniniz mi bakiyor?

english: Indeed. We maintain the farms and manage the trees. The produce we grow goes to the Meilyr clan to feed the city and the wood we provide is used by the Ithell clan in construction.
translation: Aynen öyle. Ciftlikleri koruyor ve agaclari yönetiyoruz. Yetistirdigimiz ürünler Meilyr klanina gidip sehri besliyor ve sagladigimiz odunlar Ithell klani tarafindan insaatlarda kullaniliyor.

english: Feel free to join us. Our farming patches are open to you, as is our sawmill.
translation: Bize katilmaktan cekinme. Tarim alanlarimiz ve kereste fabrikamiz sana acik.

english: Awesome, thank you.
How goes it, friend?
I stole the Ring of Charos from Fenkenstrain.
I saw him climb up into the Tower to hide it. It doesn't matter - soon the werewolves will come for him, and his experiments will be forever ceased.
translation: Onu saklamak icin Kule'ye tirmanirken gördüm. Önemli degil, yakinda kurtadamlar onun icin gelecek ve deneyleri sonsuza kadar sona erecek.

english: Do you want the ring back? It is yours after all.
translation: Yüzügü geri ister misin? Sonucta senin.

english: No, you keep it, my friend. Werewolves hunger for the scent of live flesh - I have no need for the ring. I have my castle back, if not my soul.
translation: Hayir, sende kalsin dostum. Kurtadamlar canli etin kokusuna aclar, yüzüge ihtiyacim yok. Ruhumu kaybetmis olsam da kalemi geri aldim.

english: Hello.
Tell me about yourself.
Well citizen, you are speaking to Lord Shiro Shayzien. I am the ruler of Shayzien and the commander-in-chief of the Shayzien Army.
translation: Vatandasim, Lord Shiro Shayzien ile konusuyorsun. Ben Shayzien'in hükümdari ve Shayzien Ordusu'nun baskomutaniyim.

english: How long have you held this position?
Since my father passed away four years ago. He was a good man who took the defence of Kourend very seriously. I have been working hard to continue his legacy.
translation: Dört yil önce babam vefat ettiginden beri. O, Kourend'in savunmasini cok ciddiye alan iyi bir adamdi. Onun mirasini sürdürmek icin cok calisiyorum.

english: Anything else I can help you with citizen?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim baska bir sey var mi, vatandas?

english: Tell me about Shayzien.
Most citizens of Shayzien are part of the Shayzien Army in some form or other. We are responsible for defending Kourend against external and internal threats.
translation: Shayzien'in cogu vatandasi, bir sekilde Shayzien Ordusu'nun bir parcasidir. Kourend'i dis ve ic tehditlere karsi savunmakla sorumluyuz.

english: What are the current threats against Kourend?
Externally, we have recently beingdealing with increased lizardman activity. We've also been keeping a close eye on Varlamore to the south, just in case they try anything.
translation: Dis tehditler acisindan, son zamanlarda kertenkele adamlarin faaliyetlerinde artis yasiyoruz. Ayrica, herhangi bir girisimde bulunmalari ihtimaline karsi güneydeki Varlamore'u da yakindan takip ediyoruz.

english: Internally, we have seen a rise in gang crime across the kingdom. It seems to be especially prevalent in Port Piscarilius.
translation: Ic tehditler acisindan, krallik genelinde cete suclarinda artis görüyoruz. Bu suclar özellikle Port Piscarilius'ta yaygin görünüyor.

english: How do you tackle these issues?
By doing what we do best citizen. There's no threat that can't be defeated by a Shayzien soldier with a sword in their hand.
translation: En iyi yaptigimiz seyi yaparak, vatandasim. Elinde kilici olan bir Shayzien askeri tarafindan yenilemeyecek hicbir tehdit yoktur.

english: Tell me about your plans.
Our war plans? I'm afraid most of that is confidential.
translation: Savas planlarimiz mi? Maalesef bunlarin cogu gizlidir.

english: What I can tell you is that our main focus right now is the lizardman threat. We've moved a great number of troops into the Kebos Lowlands to combat the issue.
translation: Size söyleyebilecegim tek sey, su anda ana odak noktamizin kertenkele adam tehdidi oldugu. Bu sorunu cözmek icin Kebos Ovalari'na cok sayida asker gönderdik.

english: Is that going well?
Absolutely, we've pushed the lizardmen back to the point where we're finally able to allow citizens such as yourself into the region.
translation: Kesinlikle, kertenkele adamlari geri püskürttük ve sonunda sizin gibi vatandaslarin bölgeye girmesine izin verebilecek duruma geldik.

english: Apart from the lizardman, we are also preparing to support the King in the hunt for his father's killer. Once we know who they are, they will face the full might of the Shayzien Army.
translation: Kertenkele adamlarin yani sira, Kral'in babasinin katilini bulma cabalarina da destek olmaya hazirlaniyoruz. Kim olduklarini ögrendigimizde, Shayzien Ordusu'nun tüm gücüyle karsi karsiya kalacaklar.

english: Goodbye.
Farewell citizen.
Can't talk right now citizen. I'm very busy.
translation: Su anda konusamam vatandas. Cok mesgulüm.

english: Tell me about yourself.
Tell me about Shayzien.
Tell me about your plans.
Goodbye.
Good day friend.
Tell me about yourself.
I am Trobin Arceuus, lord of Arceuus. It's a position I've held for a thousand years, ever since the Ascent of Arceuus.
translation: Ben Trobin Arceuus, Arceuus'un lorduyum. Arceuus'un Yükselisi'nden bu yana bin yildir bu pozisyondayim.

english: That's a long time. I guess you've seen quite a bit.
translation: Bu cok uzun bir süre. Sanirim cok sey görmüssündür.

english: Indeed. I've been present at some of the most notable moments in Kourend's history.
translation: Gercekten de öyle. Kourend tarihinin en önemli anlarina tanik oldum.

english: I was there when King Agata IV was deposed, I was there when Kharedst the Builder opened Kourend Castle and I was there when Emperor Imafore was executed.
translation: Kral Agata IV'ün tahttan indirildigi sirada oradaydim, Kharedst the Builder'in Kourend Kalesi'ni actigi sirada oradaydim ve Imparator Imafore'nin idam edildigi sirada da oradaydim.

english: I tend to keep out of public affairs these days though. My presence is often more of a distraction than a benefit. It also means I can focus on my work in peace.
translation: Ancak son zamanlarda kamu islerinden uzak durmaya calisiyorum. Varligim genellikle fayda saglamaktan cok dikkat dagitici oluyor. Bu sayede isime huzur icinde odaklanabiliyorum.

english: Your work?
The freeing of souls. There are many souls that find themselves trapped here after death. My people and I do our best to release them.
translation: Ruhlari özgürlestirmek. Ölümden sonra burada hapsolmus bircok ruh var. Halkim ve ben onlari özgürlestirmek icin elimizden geleni yapiyoruz.

english: Tell me about Arceuus.

If you find something magical in Kourend, chances are it came from Arceuus. Our people have lived for a thousand years. The knowledge we've gained in that time has resulted in many a magical discovery.
translation: Kourend'de sihirli bir sey bulursaniz, muhtemelen Arceuus'tan gelmistir. Halkimiz bin yildir yasiyor. Bu süre zarfinda edindigimiz bilgiler, bircok sihirli kesfe yol acti.

english: Most of our discoveries start with the Dark Altar. It is the source of our immortality and our people dedicate their lives to studying it.
translation: Kesiflerimizin cogu Karanlik Sunak'tan baslar. O, ölümsüzlügümüzün kaynagidir ve halkimiz hayatlarini onu incelemek icin adar.

english: Our people also serves an important role in the wider world. We work to free trapped souls so that they may pass on to the next world. It is a crucial task that the Dark Altar helps us to perform.
translation: Halkimiz daha genis dünyada da önemli bir rol oynar. Sikisip kalmis ruhlari kurtarmak icin calisiriz, böylece onlar öbür dünyaya gecebilirler. Karanlik Sunak bu önemli görevi yerine getirmemize yardimci olur.

english: Was the Dark Altar always here?
Impossible to say. The Dark Altar has been mentioned in records dating back to the earliest days of Kourend. Before then, who knows.
translation: Bunu söylemek imkansiz. Karanlik Sunak, Kourend'in en eski günlerine ait kayitlarda bahsedilmektedir. Ondan önce ne oldugunu kim bilir.

english: You weren't around back then?
No. The Ascent of Arceuus didn't occur until after Xeric's Age of Strife, hundreds of years after Kourend was formed.
translation: Hayir. Arceuus'un Yükselisi, Kourend'in kurulmasindan yüzlerce yil sonra, Xeric'in Catisma Cagi'ndan sonra gerceklesti.

english: Tell me about the Ascent of Arceuus.
It was a thousand years ago, during the time of King Byrne II. I went to my people and shared the secrets of immortality with them.
translation: Bin yil önce, Kral Byrne II'nin dönemindeydi. Halkimin yanina gidip ölümsüzlügün sirlarini onlarla paylastim.

english: Not all of them accepted this gift of course, as was their right. Those that did, were granted new bodies to house their souls. These bodies are sustained by the Dark Altar.
translation: Elbette hepsi bu hediyeyi kabul etmedi, bu onlarin hakkiydi. Kabul edenlere, ruhlarini barindiracak yeni bedenler verildi. Bu bedenler Karanlik Sunak tarafindan ayakta tutuluyor.

english: It wasn't you that discovered this secret though was it?
translation: Bu sirri kesfeden sen degildin, degil mi?

english: No. It was granted to us by the Tasakaal. They are ancient beings, ones that make us seem like mere children.
translation: Hayir. Bu sir bize Tasakaal tarafindan verildi. Onlar, bizi cocuk gibi gösteren kadim varliklar.

english: Their age and experience have granted them knowledge over life and death that we can only dream of.
translation: Yaslari ve deneyimleri, bize sadece hayal edebilecegimiz yasam ve ölüm bilgisini kazandirdi.

english: The Tasakaal don't like you very much. They called you a liar and claimed you misused the knowledge.
translation: Tasakaal seni pek sevmiyor. Sana yalanci dediler ve bilgileri kötüye kullandigini iddia ettiler.

english: The events that led to the Ascent of Arceuus are more complicated than even the Tasakaal know. But that is a story for another day.
translation: Arceuus'un Yükselisine yol acan olaylar, Tasakaal'in bildiginden bile daha karmasiktir. Ama bu baska bir günün hikayesi.

english: Tell me about your plans.
I had one of my people recover the remains of that device. The one that was absorbing the Dark Altars power.
translation: Adamlarimdan birine o cihazin kalintilarini bulmasini söyledim. Karanlik Sunaklarin gücünü emen cihazi.

english: We're performing tests to see if we can learn more about it. We haven't made any meaningful progress yet though.
translation: Cihaz hakkinda daha fazla bilgi edinmek icin testler yapiyoruz. Ancak henüz anlamli bir ilerleme kaydetmedik.

english: Once we've learnt more about it, we'll be in a better position to determine our next move.
translation: Cihaz hakkinda daha fazla bilgi edindigimizde, bir sonraki adimimizi daha iyi belirleyebilecegiz.

english: I admit, the idea of someone sabotaging the Altar is more than a bit concerning. I hope we can make some progress soon.
translation: Kabul ediyorum, birinin Altar'i sabote etmesi fikri biraz endise verici. Umarim yakinda bir ilerleme kaydedebiliriz.

english: Now that we know Xamphur was responsible for the device that was absorbing power from the Dark Altar, we're hoping we can use it to help locate him.
translation: Xamphur'un Karanlik Altar'in gücünü emen cihazdan sorumlu oldugunu ögrendigimize göre, onu bulmak icin bu bilgiyi kullanabilecegimizi umuyoruz.

english: Alas, so far we've had no luck. We're also scanning for energy that matches what we observed during that earthquake he caused, but again, nothing has been discovered so far.
translation: Ne yazik ki, su ana kadar sansimiz yaver gitmedi. Ayrica, onun neden oldugu deprem sirasinda gözlemledigimiz enerjiyi de tariyoruz, ancak su ana kadar yine hicbir sey kesfedilmedi.

english: It seems this work will take time. I assure you though, we will find him and his master.
translation: Bu isin zaman alacagi anlasiliyor. Ancak sizi temin ederim ki, onu ve efendisini bulacagiz.

english: What about that Pyromancer?
We've begun an investigation into their order, but we have little to go on. Hopefully we find a good lead soon.
translation: Onlarin tarikati hakkinda bir sorusturma baslattik, ama elimizde cok az ipucu var. Umarim yakinda iyi bir ipucu buluruz.

english: Well just let me know if you need my help.
I will, thank you.
Goodbye.
Farewell.
Tell me about yourself.
Tell me about Arceuus.
Tell me about the Ascent of Arceuus.
Tell me about your plans.
Goodbye.
Hello! I'm Lorelai. Welcome to the Warriors' Guild basement!
translation: Merhaba! Ben Lorelai. Savascilar Loncasi'nin bodrumuna hos geldin!

english: What are you doing down here?
I'm training this group of special Cyclopes to be stronger and more powerful for Kamfreena.
translation: Kamfreena icin bu özel Cyclopes grubunu daha güclü ve daha kuvvetli hale getirmek icin egitiyorum.

english: What's special about these Cyclopes?
They have a chance of dropping a new, more powerful defender. Kamfreena doesn't want just anyone getting their hands on one so she moved them down here and tasked me with training them.
translation: Yeni ve daha güclü bir savunmaci elde etme sanslari var. Kamfreena, bunlarin herkesin eline gecmesini istemiyor, bu yüzden onlari buraya tasidi ve bana onlari egitme görevini verdi.

english: With a punishing routine of combat, fighting and the odd death!
translation: Zorlu bir savas, dövüs ve tuhaf ölümler rutiniyle!

english: So, you just let them fight each other and hope they get stronger?
translation: Yani, onlari birbirleriyle dövüstürüyorsun ve güclenmelerini umuyorsun?

english: Of course not, that would just be cruel! Kamfreena and I only allow the most worthy of adventurers to fight these cyclopes.
translation: Tabii ki hayir, bu cok zalimce olurdu! Kamfreena ve ben, sadece en degerli maceracilarin bu Cyclopes'larla dövüsmesine izin veriyoruz.

english: I am a mighty adventurer! Can I fight them?
translation: Ben güclü bir maceraciyim! Onlarla savasabilir miyim?

english: You'll need to display your skills as a Warrior before I can allow you to enter the room.
translation: Odaya girmenize izin vermeden önce bir savasci olarak yeteneklerinizi göstermeniz gerekiyor.

english: How can I do that?
Bring me a Rune Defender and I shall unlock the door for you, this shows me you have dedicated enough time to fighting the Cyclops upstairs.
translation: Bana bir Rune Defender getirin, ben de kapiyi sizin icin acayim. Bu, yukaridaki tek gözlü devlerle savasmaya yeterince zaman ayirdiginizi gösterir.

english: I have a Rune Defender here, please let me in!
translation: Burada bir Rune Defender var, lütfen beni iceri alin!

english: And the Wise Old Man is my Dad... come back when you have the Rune Defender!
translation: Ve Bilge Yasli Adam benim babam... Rune Defender'i aldiginda geri gel!

english: Very well, I've unlocked the door but you'll still need 100 tokens from upstairs before you can enter as well as 10 for every minute you want to stay inside. Have fun in there!
translation: Pekala, kapiyi actim ama iceri girebilmek icin üst kattan 100 jeton ve iceride kalmak istedigin her dakika icin 10 jeton daha alman gerekiyor. Iceride iyi eglenceler!

english: Yes, you have already proved yourself to me, the door is unlocked.
translation: Evet, kendini bana kanitladin, kapi acildi.

english: Bye!
See you around.
I see you have a worthy defender! I'll release some cyclops to help you get an upgrade. They are quite mean and strong though...
translation: Görüyorum ki degerli bir savunucun var! Yükseltme almana yardimci olmasi icin birkac tek gözlü dev salacagim. Ama oldukca kötü ve güclüler...

english: You've already proved yourself to me, the door is unlocked.
Congratulations you've found a Dragon defender! You're welcome to go back inside and try to get more.
translation: Tebrikler, bir Ejderha savunucusu buldun! Iceri girip daha fazlasini almaya calisabilirsin.

english: Your time is up, please make your way to the exit.
translation: Süreniz doldu, lütfen cikisa dogru ilerleyin.

english: Next time, please leave as soon as your time is up.
translation: Bir dahaki sefere, süreniz doldugunda lütfen hemen cikin.

english: You must keep your attack skillcape or max cape equipped to stay in the area.
translation: Bu alanda kalmak icin saldiri beceri pelerininizi veya maksimum pelerininizi takili tutmalisiniz.

english: May I claim my tokens please?
You don't have space to carry them.
Of course! Here you go, you've earned [number] token[s]!
Thanks!
I'm afraid you have not earned any tokens yet. Try some of the activities around the guild to earn some.
translation: Maalesef henüz jeton kazanmadiniz. Kazanmak icin lonca cevresindeki etkinliklerden bazilarini deneyin.

english: Ok, I'll go see what I can find.
Ahh I see you've met Rory. As a young Cyclops he's not ready for combat yet so he keeps me company.
translation: Ahh, Rory ile tanismissiniz. Genc bir Cyclops olarak henüz savasmaya hazir degil, bu yüzden bana eslik ediyor.

english: What's special about these Cyclopes?
How exactly are you training them?
Can I fight them?
I have a Rune Defender here.
Bye!
I can't believe we've finally arrived, I can't wait to explore!
translation: Sonunda vardigimiza inanamiyorum, kesfetmek icin sabirsizlaniyorum!

english: So much to see, I don't know where to start!
translation: Görülecek o kadar cok sey var ki, nereden baslayacagimi bilemiyorum!

english: A whole new continent to explore... what a time to be
translation: Kesfedilecek yepyeni bir kita... Ne harika bir zaman!

english: Are you the tour guide?
Nope, I'm just as lost as you.
translation: Hayir, ben de senin kadar kayboldum.

english: I overheard someone mention there are pirates and thieves here, be careful!
translation: Burada korsanlar ve hirsizlar oldugunu duydum, dikkatli olun!

english: Hey, wanna buy some armour?
What have you got?
I provide items to help you keep your legs!
translation: Bacaklarinizi korumak icin gerekli esyalari sagliyorum!

english: No, thank you.
This is just what I needed for my special secret... err... I've said too much! Take this and get out of here quickly!
translation: Bu tam da benim özel sirrim icin ihtiyacim olan sey... sey... Fazla konustum! Al sunu ve hemen buradan git!

english: Hi! I have this money off voucher!
So I see! Unfortunately it seems to have expired yesterday! Nevermind.
translation: Anliyorum! Maalesef dün süresi dolmus gibi görünüyor! Önemli degil.

english: But I only just got it!
I'm sorry, there's nothing I can do.
Goodbye.
What have you got?
No, thank you.
Thank you for all your help in solving the murder.
translation: Cinayeti cözmemde yardim ettigin icin tesekkürler.

english: Hello again. How are you?
What's that? How do I chew? With my teeth of course. You humans are odd.
translation: O ne? Nasil cignerim? Tabii ki dislerimle. Siz insanlar tuhafsiniz.

english: No, no I said HOW ARE YOU?
No need to shout, I'm not deaf. I'm good thank you.
translation: Bagirmana gerek yok, sagir degilim. Iyiyim, tesekkürler.

english: Here you go.
Hey, I have something for you but you don't have any space for it!
translation: Hey, sana bir seyim var ama bunun icin yerin yok!

english: Welcome to Lowe's Archery Emporium. Do you want to see my wares?
translation: Lowe's Archery Emporium'a hos geldin. Ürünlerimi görmek ister misin?

english: I have this voucher for completing the combat Adventure Path, it says to come talk to you about claiming my Adventure Path reward.
translation: Savas Macera Yolu'nu tamamladigim icin bu kuponum var, Macera Yolu ödülümü almak icin seninle konusmam gerektigi yaziyor.

english: I will be able to give you your reward when you have some space for it.
translation: Bunun icin yerin oldugunda ödülünü verebilirim.

english: Why yes, here are some high-quality iron arrows.
translation: Evet, iste yüksek kaliteli demir oklar.

english: I do have more rewards for you, but you need to be on a members world for me to give you the reward. Maybe there is something else I can help you with.
translation: Senin icin daha fazla ödülüm var ama ödülü verebilmem icin üye dünyasinda olman gerekiyor. Belki baska bir konuda yardimci olabilirim.

english: Since you are a member, I'll also give you extra arrows and one of my finest bows.
translation: Üye oldugun icin sana ekstra oklar ve en iyi yaylarimdan birini de verecegim.

english: I sell a variety of range equipment in my shop if you wanted to take a look.
translation: Dükkanimda cesitli menzil ekipmanlari satiyorum, bakmak istersen.

english: Is there anything else I can do for you?
translation: Sana baska bir konuda yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: I do have more rewards for you, but you need some free space for me to give you the rewards.
translation: Sana daha fazla ödülüm var, ama ödülleri verebilmem icin biraz bos alanin olmasi gerekiyor.

english: Can I help you with anything else?
translation: Baska bir konuda yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: Why yes, here is one of my finest bows and some high- quality iron arrows.
translation: Evet, iste en iyi yaylarimdan biri ve bazi yüksek kaliteli demir oklar.

english: No, I prefer to bash things close up.
translation: Hayir, yakin mesafeden vurmayi tercih ederim.

english: Humph, philistine.
Here you go!
Yes, please.
No, I prefer to bash things close up.
translation: Hayir, yakin mesafeden vurmayi tercih ederim.

english: Watch where you're going, young whippersnapper!
translation: Nereye gittigine dikkat et, genc züppe!

english: I wasn't going anywhere...
Well then go away from here!
What's a whippersnapper?
It's a whip. Which snaps. Like me. Now leave!
translation: Kirbac demek. Catlayan. Benim gibi. Simdi git!

english: I am Lubufu - the only fisherman who knows the secret of the Karambwan!
translation: Ben Lubufu - Karambwan'in sirrini bilen tek balikci!

english: What's a Karambwan?
What a foolish question! Now leave!
translation: Ne aptalca bir soru! Simdi git!

english: I said go away!
Ok, I'm going...
You deceived me you confoundering dolt! Because of you, my entire business is ruined! Get out of my sight!
translation: Beni aldattin seni aptal! Senin yüzünden tüm isim mahvoldu! Gözümün önünden kaybol!

english: I wasn't going anywhere...
What's a whippersnapper?
Who are you?
Hello there.
Hello. A fine day for stealing, wouldn't you say?
translation: Merhaba. Hirsizlik icin güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: I suppose so, just as long as you're not planning to steal from me.
translation: Sanirim öyle, tabii benden calmayi planlamiyorsan.

english: *whistle*
I could do with some information on houses.
translation: Evler hakkinda biraz bilgiye ihtiyacim var.

english: I'd better get going.
I thought I killed you?!
Ha! Ha! Ha!
You can not kill me human!
I've lost the pendant you gave me.
Have another, it will remind you of my power!
translation: Baska bir tane al, sana gücümü hatirlatacak!

english: Hi! I'm Lucy. Welcome to the Party Room!
translation: Merhaba! Ben Lucy. Parti Odasina hos geldiniz!

english: One beer please Lucy!
Coming right up [sir/ma'am]! That's two gold please.
I'm sorry but I don't have enough money!
Coming right up [sir/ma'am]! As part of the birthday bash, you get your first 2 beers free!
translation: Hemen geliyor ! Dogum günü partisi kapsaminda, ilk 2 bira bedava!

english: Lucy has given you a beer.
You have 1 free beer left from either me or Megan!
translation: Benden veya Megan'dan 1 bedava bira hakkin kaldi!

english: That's your last free beer [username]!
Good day, Your Royal Highness.
Good day. What are you doing?
I'm cutting down maple trees for their wood. It's a living.
translation: Akcaagaclari odun icin kesiyorum. Bu benim gecim kaynagim.

english: Good luck with that.
Thank you, Your Royal Highness.
Can you tell me how the kingdom approves of me?
translation: Kralligin beni nasil onayladigini söyleyebilir misiniz?

english: [amount]% of people approve of you.
The storerooms are full, your Highness. You should talk to Advisor Ghrim to collect what we've gathered for you.
translation: Depolar dolu, Majesteleri. Danisman Ghrim ile konusup sizin icin topladiklarimizi almalisiniz.

english: Thanks!
Hello?
Moooooo.
Hey, I know you can talk!
Moooo.
Stop ignoring me!
Look, mate. Leave me alone!
You talked! You talked!
I think I'll have some beef tonight.
I lost that amulet you gave me.
Not to worry. I found it again.
However, you'll need to make space for it before I can give it to you.
translation: Ancak, sana vermeden önce onun icin yer acman gerekecek.

english: Thanks. I'll try not to lose it this time.
Any time.
Greetings, adventurer. I am Phileas, the Lumbridge Guide. I am here to give information and directions to new players. Is there anything I can help you with?
translation: Merhaba, maceraci. Ben Phileas, Lumbridge Rehberi. Yeni oyunculara bilgi ve yol tarifi vermek icin buradayim. Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Where can I find a quest to go on?
I'm afraid I can't think of any more quests for you. Don't worry though, there'll be plenty more out there. You'll just need to find them.
translation: Maalesef senin icin baska görev aklima gelmiyor. Ama merak etme, disarida daha pek cok görev var. Onlari bulman yeterli.

english: Is there anything else you need help with?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: Yes please.
No thank you.
Well, I've heard my friend the cook is in need of a spot of help. He'll be in the kitchen of this here castle. Just talk to him and he'll set you off.
translation: Arkadasim ascinin yardima ihtiyaci oldugunu duydum. Bu kalenin mutfaginda olacak. Onunla konus, seni görevine yönlendirecektir.

english: Well, I heard that Father Aereck could use a hand. You'll find him in the church just here. Talk to him and he'll give you the details.
translation: Peder Aereck'in yardima ihtiyaci oldugunu duydum. Onu buradaki kilisede bulabilirsin. Onunla konus, sana ayrintilari anlatacaktir.

english: Well, I heard that a chap called Veos needs help finding some treasure. Last I heard, he was looking for assistance in the pub just north of here. Talk to him and see if you can help.
translation: Veos adinda birinin hazine bulmak icin yardima ihtiyaci oldugunu duydum. Son duydugumda, buradan kuzeydeki barda yardim ariyordu. Onunla konus ve yardim edebilecek misin bir bak.

english: Well, I heard that Farmer Fred could use some help. You'll find him on the farm just north of here. Talk to him and see if he needs a hand.
translation: Ciftci Fred'in yardima ihtiyaci oldugunu duydum. Onu buradan kuzeydeki ciftlikte bulabilirsin. Onunla konus ve yardima ihtiyaci var mi bir bak.

english: Well, I heard there was some commotion in the swamp to the south. Might be worth looking into.
translation: Güneydeki bataklikta bir kargasa oldugunu duydum. Bir göz atmaya deger olabilir.

english: Well, I believe the Duke of Lumbridge requires an errand running for him. You can find him upstairs in the castle. Just talk to him to get the details.
translation: Sanirim Lumbridge Dükü'nün bir isi var. Onu kalenin üst katinda bulabilirsin. Ayrintilari ögrenmek icin onunla konus.

english: I heard you were already helping the cook. Are you sure you need another quest?
translation: Zaten asciya yardim ettigini duydum. Baska bir göreve ihtiyacin oldugundan emin misin?

english: I heard you were already helping Father Aereck. Are you sure you need another quest?
translation: Zaten Peder Aereck'e yardim ettigini duydum. Baska bir göreve ihtiyacin oldugundan emin misin?

english: I heard you were already helping Veos. Are you sure you need another quest?
translation: Zaten Veos'a yardim ettigini duydum. Baska bir göreve ihtiyacin oldugundan emin misin?

english: I heard you were already helping Farmer Fred. Are you sure you need another quest?
translation: Ciftci Fred'e yardim ettigini duydum. Baska bir göreve ihtiyacin oldugundan emin misin?

english: I heard you were already investigating the issue in the swamp. Are you sure you need another quest?
translation: Bataklikta sorunu arastirdigini duydum. Baska bir göreve ihtiyacin oldugundan emin misin?

english: I heard you were already helping the Duke. Are you sure you need another quest?
translation: Dük'e yardim ettigini duydum. Baska bir göreve ihtiyacin oldugundan emin misin?

english: I want another quest.
I’m not too sure what to do.
Well if you need a reminder, try having a look at your quest journal.
translation: Hatirlatma gerekiyorsa, görev günlügüne bir göz at.

english: Actually, I’m fine.
Actually, I'm fine.
What monsters should I fight?
It's going to be tough fighting monsters without a weapon. I suggest you find one of those first.
translation: Silahsiz canavarlarla savasmak zor olacak. Önce bir silah bulmani öneririm.

english: How can I get a weapon?
Well you can either make them, find them or buy them.
translation: Silahlari yapabilir, bulabilir veya satin alabilirsin.

english: Where can I find a weapon?

If you visit the combat tutors south of the general store they may be able to help you with that. Failing that there are a few cheap weapons lying around in the world. For example, you can get an iron dagger if you
translation: Genel magazanin güneyindeki savas egitmenlerini ziyaret edersen sana yardimci olabilirler. Bu olmazsa, dünyada birkac ucuz silah bulabilirsin. Örnegin, köprüyü gecip goblinlerin yasadigi kücük kulübeye bakarsan

english: cross the bridge and look in the little hut where some goblins live. If it's not there it probably means someone else has taken it. If you wait a while a new one should appear. As you explore you may find other weapons,
translation: demir bir hancer bulabilirsin. Orada yoksa, muhtemelen baska biri almistir. Biraz beklersen yeni bir tane ortaya cikacaktir. Kesif yaparken baska silahlar da bulabilirsin

english: too.
I'd like to know about something else.
translation: Baska bir sey hakkinda bilgi almak istiyorum.

english: Well, what would you like to know?
How do I make a weapon?
You already have a reasonable Smithing level, so I think you know that already.
translation: Zaten makul bir Demircilik seviyen var, bu yüzden bunu zaten biliyorsundur.

english: The Smithing skill allows you to make armour and weapons. Talk to the boy who smelts metal in the furnace, I'm sure he can help.
translation: Demircilik becerisi, zirh ve silah yapmani saglar. Firinda metal eriten cocukla konus, eminim sana yardimci olabilir.

english: Where can I smith?
You will find a helpful Smithing tutor in the west of Varrock - that's north of here. Follow the path across the river and head north.
translation: Varrock'un batisinda, buradan kuzeyde, sana yardimci olacak bir demircilik ögretmeni bulabilirsin. Nehri gecen yolu takip et ve kuzeye git.

english: I suggest you go and mine some ore; find the Mining symbol - with the guide symbol near it - in the swamp south of here. The Mining guide there can teach you how to mine ore.
translation: Biraz cevher cikarmayi öneririm; buradan güneydeki bataklikta, yaninda rehber sembolü olan madencilik sembolünü bul. Oradaki madencilik rehberi sana cevher cikarmayi ögretebilir.

english: Where can I buy a weapon?

You can get a weapon free from the combat tutors if they think you need it. Failing that, the nearest shop that would sell you something of that nature is Bob's Brilliant Axes in this very town. If you want a bigger
translation: Savas ögretmenleri ihtiyacin oldugunu düsünürlerse sana ücretsiz silah verebilirler. Bu olmazsa, bu tür bir sey satabilecek en yakin dükkan bu kasabadaki Bob's Brilliant Axes'tir. Daha fazla secenek istiyorsan

english: choice I suggest you head to one of the big cities. If you follow the road east over the bridge and then head north you will eventually reach Varrock, where you can buy all manner of things. You can use the world map
translation: büyük sehirlerden birine gitmeni öneririm. Köprüyü gecip doguya dogru yolu takip edip kuzeye gidersen sonunda Varrock'a varirsin, orada her türlü seyi satin alabilirsin. Yolunuzu bulmak icin dünya haritasini

english: to help you find your way.
Could I get a staff like yours?
translation: Sizin gibi bir asa alabilir miyim?

english: There is no other staff like this in all the land. It's a very important staff. It shows who holds the job as the Lumbridge Guide, and that's me.
translation: Bütün ülkede bunun gibi baska bir asa yok. Bu cok önemli bir asa. Lumbridge Rehberi görevini kimin üstlendigini gösterir ve o kisi benim.

english: Yes, but what should I fight once I have got a weapon?
translation: Evet, ama silahimi aldiktan sonra neyle savasacagim?

english: There's lots of beasts to fight in the woods around here, especially to the west. There are certainly some goblins and spiders that are pests and could do with being cleared out. There's also a chicken farm or two up the
translation: Buralardaki ormanlarda, özellikle batida, savasacak cok sayida canavar var. Kesinlikle bazi goblinler ve örümcekler var, bunlar zararlidir ve ortadan kaldirilmalari gerekir. Ayrica yolun yukarisinda bir veya iki tavuk ciftligi var,

english: road for some fairly easy pickings. Non-player characters usually appear as yellow dots on your minimap, although there are some that you won't be able to fight, such as myself. A monster's combat level is
translation: bunlar oldukca kolay avlardir. Oyuncu olmayan karakterler genellikle mini haritada sari noktalar olarak görünür, ancak benim gibi savasamayacaginiz bazi karakterler de vardir. Bir canavarin savas seviyesi

english: shown next to their 'Attack' option. If that level is coloured green it means the monster is weaker than you. If it is red, it means that the monster is tougher than you.
translation: “Saldiri” seceneginin yaninda gösterilir. Bu seviye yesil renkteyse, canavar sizden daha zayiftir. Kirmizi renkteyse, canavar sizden daha güclüdür.

english: Remember, you will do better if you have better armour and weapons and it's always worth carrying a bit of food to heal yourself.
translation: Unutmayin, daha iyi zirh ve silahlara sahip olursaniz daha iyi performans gösterirsiniz ve kendinizi iyilestirmek icin her zaman biraz yiyecek tasimakta fayda vardir.

english: Where can I get food to heal myself?
translation: Kendimi iyilestirmek icin yiyecek nereden bulabilirim?

english: There are many different foods in the game such as cabbage, fish, meat and many more. Which do you wish to hear about?
translation: Oyunda lahana, balik, et ve daha bircok farkli yiyecek vardir. Hangisi hakkinda bilgi almak istersiniz?

english: How do I get cabbages?
There is a field a little distance to the north of here packed full of cabbages which are there for the picking.
translation: Buranin biraz kuzeyinde, toplanmaya hazir lahanalarla dolu bir tarla var.

english: You could also farm your own cabbages; there's a Farming patch just south of Falador.
translation: Kendi lahanalarinizi da yetistirebilirsiniz; Falador'un hemen güneyinde bir tarla var.

english: No thank you.
How do I fish?
I am confused. You are already an experienced fisher. You should know the answer to that already.
translation: Kafam karisti. Sen zaten deneyimli bir balikcisin. Bunun cevabini zaten biliyor olmalisin.

english: Fishing spots require different levels and equipment to use. To start Fishing, you'll want to talk to the Fishing tutor who can be found in the swamps south of here. He will also give you a small fishing net if you don't
translation: Balik tutmak icin farkli seviyeler ve ekipmanlar gerekir. Balik tutmaya baslamak icin, buradan güneydeki batakliklarda bulunan balikcilik ögretmeni ile konusmalisin. Eger henüz bir balik agina sahip degilsen, sana kücük bir balik agi da verecektir.

english: own one already.
Where could I find one of those?

You can get them from a Fishing shop or our Fishing Tutor south of here in the swamp. There is a Fishing shop in Port Sarim; you can find it on the world map. Port Sarim is some way to the west of here, beyond
translation: Balikcilik dükkanindan veya buradan güneydeki bataklikta bulunan Balikcilik Ögretmenimizden alabilirsiniz. Port Sarim'de bir balikcilik dükkani var; dünya haritasinda bulabilirsiniz. Port Sarim, buradan batiya dogru, Draynor köyünün ötesinde

english: the village of Draynor.
Where can I find meat?

I suggest you go and kill some chickens. The roads on either side of this river eventually go past a chicken farm. When you have killed some chickens, cook them. You could either make a fire or use a range.
translation: Gidip birkac tavuk öldürmeni öneririm. Bu nehrin her iki yanindaki yollar sonunda bir tavuk ciftliginin önünden gecer. Birkac tavuk öldürdükten sonra onlari pisir. Ates yakabilir ya da ocak kullanabilirsin.

english: There is a range at the southern end in this town and a Cooking tutor in south Lumbridge near Bob's Brilliant Axes shop.
translation: Bu kasabanin güney ucunda bir ocak ve Bob's Brilliant Axes dükkaninin yakininda, Lumbridge'in güneyinde bir Ascilik ögretmeni var.

english: Well, you can make them, buy them or talk to the combat tutors just west of here.
translation: Onlari yapabilir, satin alabilir ya da buradan batiya dogru savas ögretmenleriyle konusabilirsin.

english: Okay, thanks, I will go and kill things.
translation: Tamam, tesekkürler, gidip bir seyler öldürecegim.

english: Can I kill other players?

Well, you can go to the Wilderness. That is the area for killing other players. Just keep heading north and eventually you will be bound to reach it. Be very careful, though. Player-killing is not for the unprepared.
translation: Wilderness'a gidebilirsin. Orasi diger oyunculari öldürmek icin ayrilmis bir alan. Kuzeye dogru ilerlemeye devam et, sonunda oraya varacaksin. Ama cok dikkatli ol. Oyuncu öldürmek hazirliksizlar icin uygun degildir.

english: I'd suggest that you leave any items you don't want to lose in the bank and take a good supply of food with you.
translation: Kaybetmek istemedigin esyalari bankada birakmani ve yanina bol miktarda yiyecek almani öneririm.

english: You're strong enough to work out what monsters to fight for yourself now, but the combat tutors might help you with any questions you have about the skills; they're just over there to the south of the general store.
translation: Artik hangi canavarlarla savasacagini kendin belirleyecek kadar güclüsün, ama savas ögretmenleri becerilerle ilgili sorularinda sana yardimci olabilirler; genel magazanin güneyinde bulunuyorlar.

english: Where can I make money?
There are many ways to make money in the game. I would suggest either killing monsters or doing a trade skill such as Smithing or Fishing.
translation: Oyunda para kazanmanin bircok yolu var. Canavarlari öldürmeyi veya demircilik veya balikcilik gibi bir ticaret becerisi yapmayi öneririm.

english: Please don't try to get money by begging off other players. It will make you unpopular. Nobody likes a beggar. It is very irritating to have other players asking for your hard-earned cash.
translation: Lütfen diger oyunculardan dilenerek para kazanmaya calismayin. Bu sizi sevimsiz yapar. Kimse dilencileri sevmez. Diger oyuncularin sizin zor kazandiginiz parayi istemesine cok sinir bozucu bir durumdur.

english: Where can I find more information?

What you'll want is the OSRS Wiki! I've taken the liberty of opening the useful links section of the account management tab for you. Here you can find a link to the wiki. There's information and guides on almost
translation: Ihtiyaciniz olan sey OSRS Wiki! Hesap yönetimi sekmesinin faydali baglantilar bölümünü sizin icin actim. Burada wiki'ye bir baglanti bulabilirsiniz. Neredeyse her sey hakkinda bilgi ve kilavuzlar var,

english: everything, all easily searched and it's even written and maintained by players.
translation: hepsi kolayca aranabilir ve hatta oyuncular tarafindan yazilmis ve güncelleniyor.

english: I'd like to know more about security.
translation: Güvenlik hakkinda daha fazla bilgi almak istiyorum.

english: First I must warn you to take every precaution to keep your RuneScape password and PIN secure. The most important thing to remember is to never give your password to, or share your account with, anyone.
translation: Öncelikle, RuneScape sifrenizi ve PIN kodunuzu güvende tutmak icin her türlü önlemi almanizi tavsiye ederim. Unutmamaniz gereken en önemli sey, sifrenizi asla kimseye vermemek ve hesabinizi kimseyle paylasmamaktir.

english: I can also tell you about password security, avoiding item scamming and in-game moderation. I can also tell you about a place called the Stronghold of Security, where you can learn more about account security and
translation: Sifre güvenligi, esya dolandiriciligindan kacinma ve oyun ici moderasyon hakkinda da bilgi verebilirim. Ayrica, hesap güvenligi hakkinda daha fazla bilgi edinebileceginiz ve

english: have a bit of an adventure at the same time.
translation: ayni zamanda biraz macera yasayabileceginiz Stronghold of Security adli bir yerden de bahsedebilirim.

english: I'd like to know about password security.
translation: Sifre güvenligi hakkinda bilgi almak istiyorum.

english: Well, the first thing to remember with password security, which I can't stress enough, is to never tell your password, bank PIN or authenticator details to anyone, not even if they claim to be Jagex staff. Real
translation: Sifre güvenligi konusunda hatirlamaniz gereken ilk sey, sifrenizi, banka PIN kodunuzu veya kimlik dogrulama bilgilerinizi asla kimseye vermemenizdir. Jagex calisani oldugunu iddia eden kisilere bile. Gercek

english: Jagex staff will NEVER ask for your password. Sharing your account is a very bad idea, even if you think that you know and trust the person you are sharing with. Players have lost items and even their
translation: Jagex calisanlari ASLA sifrenizi sormazlar. Hesabinizi paylasmak cok kötü bir fikirdir, paylastiginiz kisiyi tanidiginizi ve güvendiginizi düsünseniz bile. Oyuncular bu sekilde esyalarini ve hatta hesaplarini kaybetmislerdir.

english: account this way. Sharing accounts is also against the rules.
Is there anything else to be aware of?
translation: Dikkat edilmesi gereken baska bir sey var mi?

english: Yes, also be careful where you enter your password. Be aware that fake Old School RuneScape websites exist. These are sites that claim to give things such as item/stat upgrades, free items, beta testing and
translation: Evet, sifrenizi girdiginiz yere de dikkat edin. Sahte Old School RuneScape web siteleri oldugunu unutmayin. Bu siteler, esya/istatistik yükseltmeleri, ücretsiz esyalar, beta testleri ve

english: moderator applications. Jagex do not offer any of these services.
translation: moderatör basvurulari gibi seyler sundugunu iddia eder. Jagex bu hizmetlerin hicbirini sunmaz.

english: Also be aware of trojans and keyloggers. These nasty programs can send everything you type into your device back to the computers of malicious people, so you can lose more than just your Old School RuneScape
translation: Truva atlari ve keylogger'lara da dikkat edin. Bu zararli programlar, cihaziniza yazdiginiz her seyi kötü niyetli kisilerin bilgisayarlarina gönderebilir, bu sekilde Old School RuneScape

english: password in this way. To avoid getting these on your device, be very wary of what you download, especially when it comes to downloading third party software. Also be very wary of email attachments and instant
translation: sifrenizden daha fazlasini kaybedebilirsiniz. Bunlarin cihaziniza girmesini önlemek icin, özellikle ücüncü taraf yazilimlari indirirken indirdiginiz dosyalara cok dikkat edin. Ayrica, bu tür seyleri icerebilecek e-posta eklerine ve anlik

english: messenger file transfers, which can contain such things.
translation: mesajlasma dosya transferlerine de cok dikkat edin.

english: Finally, remember the game doesn't censor your password or bank PIN when you type them; anyone who tells you otherwise is probably trying to steal your character or items.
translation: Son olarak, oyunu oynarken sifrenizi veya banka PIN kodunuzu yazdiginizda bunlarin sansürlenmedigini unutmayin; aksini söyleyenler muhtemelen karakterinizi veya esyalarinizi calmaya calisiyorlardir.

english: I'd like to know more about avoiding item scamming.
translation: Esya dolandiriciligindan kacinmak hakkinda daha fazla bilgi almak istiyorum.

english: There are many nice and helpful players in Old School RuneScape; unfortunately, as in real life, there are some who aren't so honest. Some people may try to trick you out of your items. Try not to fall for this as
translation: Old School RuneScape'te bircok iyi ve yardimsever oyuncu vardir; ne yazik ki, gercek hayatta oldugu gibi, dürüst olmayanlar da vardir. Bazi kisiler esyalarinizi calmak icin sizi kandirmaya calisabilir. Buna kanmayin, cünkü

english: Jagex policy is to never return lost items to players that have been scammed. Doing so just encourages users to claim they lost items they never had to gain an unfair advantage. However, people carrying out such
translation: Jagex'in politikasi, dolandirilan oyunculara kaybolan esyalari asla iade etmemektir. Bunu yapmak, kullanicilari hic sahip olmadiklari esyalari kaybettigini iddia ederek haksiz avantaj elde etmeye tesvik eder. Ancak, bu tür

english: scams will get banned as it is against the rules.
translation: dolandiricilik yapan kisiler kurallara aykiri oldugu icin yasaklanacaktir.

english: When trading, you have a second trade confirmation screen. Always double check that you are getting the items you expect on this page as some people may try and change what they are trading at the last minute on
translation: Ticaret yaparken, ikinci bir ticaret onay ekrani vardir. Bazi kisiler ilk ticaret ekraninda son anda ticaret yaptiklari esyalari degistirmeye calisabileceginden, bu sayfada beklediginiz esyalari aldiginizi her zaman iki kez kontrol edin.

english: the first trade screen. Remember when you have clicked accept on the second trade screen, the trade is not reversible.
translation: Ikinci ticaret ekraninda kabul dügmesine tikladiginizda, ticaretin geri alinamayacagini unutmayin.

english: Try and find out from someone else what an item is before spending a lot of money on it. Not all merchants are honest about the rarity or the uses of their wares. For example, some people try to pass off spinach rolls as
translation: Bir esyaya cok para harcamadan önce, baska birinden o esyanin ne oldugunu ögrenmeye calisin. Tüm saticilar, ürünlerinin nadirligi veya kullanim alanlari konusunda dürüst degildir. Örnegin, bazi kisiler ispanak rulolarini nadirmis gibi göstermeye calisir,

english: rare when in fact they're as common as cabbages!
translation: oysa bunlar aslinda lahana kadar yaygindir!

english: Be wary of people offering to improve your items. For example, some people will claim they can add a trim to your armour or upgrade your sword to a more powerful one. This is not possible and they are trying
translation: Esyalarinizi iyilestirmeyi teklif eden kisilere karsi dikkatli olun. Örnegin, bazi kisiler zirhiniza süs ekleyebileceklerini veya kilicinizi daha güclü bir kilica yükseltebileceklerini iddia ederler. Bu mümkün degildir ve onlar

english: to steal your hard-earned equipment.
I'd like to know more about in-game moderation.
translation: Oyun ici moderasyon hakkinda daha fazla bilgi almak istiyorum.

english: You will, from time to time, see moderator characters in game. Remember: a real staff member will never ask for your password or any other personal information. There are two types of moderator. You may see Jagex
translation: Zaman zaman oyunda moderatör karakterleri göreceksiniz. Unutmayin: gercek bir personel asla sifrenizi veya diger kisisel bilgilerinizi istemez. Iki tür moderatör vardir. Oyunda Jagex

english: staff characters in game - these can be identified by a gold crown next to their name and are the people who work in the Jagex offices. They might be from Customer Support, or they might be a tester or a
translation: personel karakterleri görebilirsiniz - bunlar isimlerinin yaninda altin tac ile tanimlanabilir ve Jagex ofislerinde calisan kisilerdir. Bunlar Müsteri Destek ekibinden olabilir veya test uzmani ya da

english: programmer. You may also see player moderators - these can be identified by a silver crown next to their name. Player moderators are trusted players of Old School RuneScape that help keep in-game behaviour in
translation: programci olabilir. Oyuncu moderatörleri de görebilirsiniz - bunlar isimlerinin yaninda gümüs bir tac ile taninabilir. Oyuncu moderatörleri, Old School RuneScape'in güvenilir oyuncularidir ve oyun ici davranislarin

english: line with the Old School RuneScape rules.
translation: Old School RuneScape kurallarina uygun olmasini saglarlar.

english: How do I become a player moderator?

The only way to become a player moderator is to know and play by the rules laid down by Jagex. Report those who break the rules, help players who need it and one day you might find an invite to become a moderator in
translation: Oyuncu moderatörü olmanin tek yolu, Jagex tarafindan belirlenen kurallari bilmek ve bu kurallara uymaktir. Kurallari ihlal edenleri rapor edin, ihtiyaci olan oyunculara yardim edin ve bir gün Old School RuneScape gelen kutunuzda moderatör olmaya davet edileceksiniz.

english: your Old School RuneScape inbox. Note that Jagex will never contact you in game or by email to become a player moderator.
translation: Jagex, oyuncu moderatörü olmaniz icin oyun icinde veya e-posta yoluyla sizinle asla iletisime gecmez.

english: I'd like to know about the Stronghold of Security.
translation: Güvenlik Kalesi hakkinda bilgi almak istiyorum.

english: An exciting new discovery has been made in the Barbarian Village. Soon after they started mining in the middle of the village, one of the miners got caught in a cave.
translation: Barbar Köyü'nde heyecan verici yeni bir kesif yapildi. Köyün ortasinda madencilik calismalarina basladiktan kisa bir süre sonra, madencilerden biri bir magarada mahsur kaldi.

english: Sounds painful, did he fall on his head?
translation: Aci verici bir durum gibi görünüyor, kafasini mi vurdu?

english: No, but it turned out that he had discovered a place unlike any other.
translation: Hayir, ama o, baska hicbir yere benzemeyen bir yer kesfetti.

english: How so?

Well an explorer went to look down there, it's full of new and exciting creatures and other surprises on top of that. It turns out this place can also help you to secure your account more effectively.
translation: Bir kasif oraya bakmaya gitti ve orada yeni ve heyecan verici yaratiklar ve bunun yani sira baska sürprizler de buldu. Bu yerin, hesabinizi daha etkili bir sekilde güvence altina almaniza da yardimci olabilecegi ortaya cikti.

english: Wow, that sounds good. Where can I find the explorer to learn more?
translation: Vay canina, kulaga hos geliyor. Daha fazla bilgi almak icin kasifi nerede bulabilirim?

english: Sadly the explorer went missing and has not been found. However, here is some information to get you started on securing your account. You can find the Barbarian Village north of Falador and west of Varrock.
translation: Maalesef kasif kayboldu ve bulunamadi. Ancak, hesabinizi güvence altina almak icin baslayabileceginiz bazi bilgiler var. Barbar Köyü'nü Falador'un kuzeyinde ve Varrock'un batisinda bulabilirsiniz.

english: Where can I find a bank?
You'll find a bank upstairs in Lumbridge Castle - go right to the top.
translation: Lumbridge Kalesi'nin üst katinda bir banka bulabilirsiniz - en üst kata cikin.

english: The minimap in the top right corner of the game screen has various icons showing the locations of things. This icon to the left shows where banks are.
translation: Oyun ekraninin sag üst kösesindeki mini haritada, cesitli nesnelerin konumlarini gösteren simgeler bulunur. Soldaki bu simge, bankalarin yerini gösterir.

english: No, I can find things myself thank you.
Hello!
What, who's that?
Hehe... ahem...
This is the voice of your conscience! You've been a very naughty boy haven't you?
translation: Bu senin vicdaninin sesi! Cok yaramaz bir cocuk oldun, degil mi?

english: What? No I haven't!
You know what I'm talking about! Don't lie!
translation: Ne demek istedigimi biliyorsun! Yalan söyleme!

english: Okay, okay! I'm sorry, I'll never do it again!
translation: Tamam, tamam! Özür dilerim, bir daha yapmayacagim!

english: If you do it again, you'll be in deep trouble.
translation: Bir daha yaparsan, basin büyük belaya girer.

english: I'm supposed to be the local source of knowledge, but I cannot even solve this puzzle! Do me a favour and solve it for me.
translation: Buralarin bilgi kaynagi olmam gerekirken, bu bulmacayi bile cözemiyorum! Bana bir iyilik yap ve benim icin cöz.

english: Sorry but you haven't solved the puzzle yet.
Thanks [player name]!
Does the name 'Philly' mean anything to you by chance?
translation: “Philly” adi sana bir sey ifade ediyor mu?

english: That locket! Where did you get it?
I found it in a magical rift. Does it belong to you?
translation: Sihirli bir yarikta buldum. Sana mi ait?

english: Not exactly... It's a long and sad story.
translation: Tam olarak degil... Uzun ve hüzünlü bir hikaye.

english: It's okay, I have time to listen.
Well, if you're sure then.
It all started in my youth when I was part of the Order of Wizards. I frequently spent time travelling across Gielinor, which kept me away from my beloved who worked here in Lumbridge.
translation: Her sey gencligimde, Büyücüler Tarikati'nin bir üyesi oldugum zamanlarda basladi. Sik sik Gielinor'u dolasarak zaman gecirirdim, bu da beni Lumbridge'de calisan sevgilimden uzak tutardi.

english: Due to being apart, I would often send her gifts. This locket was one of them.
translation: Ayri oldugumuz icin ona sik sik hediyeler gönderirdim. Bu madalyon da onlardan biriydi.

english: I see... I'm not sure I like where this story is going. How come I found the locket in a magic rift then?
translation: Anliyorum... Bu hikayenin gidisatini pek begenmedim. O zaman bu madalyonu neden sihirli bir yariktan buldum?

english: As I said, my research often kept me away from home. During one of my trips away, our house was robbed. My dear Thenia tried to stop them, but they took her life in return. The locket was taken in the robbery.
translation: Dedigim gibi, arastirmalarim beni sik sik evden uzak tutuyordu. Bir seyahatim sirasinda evimiz soyuldu. Sevgili Thenia onlari durdurmaya calisti, ama onlar onun canini aldi. Madalyon da soygun sirasinda calindi.

english: Oh my... I'm so sorry for your loss.
translation: Oh, cok üzüldüm... Kaybiniz icin cok üzgünüm.

english: I appreciate your kind words, but this was a long time ago. The pain of losing a loved one never fades, but in time you come to live with it.
translation: Nazik sözlerin icin tesekkür ederim, ama bu cok uzun zaman önceydi. Sevdigini kaybetmenin acisi asla gecmez, ama zamanla bununla yasamayi ögrenirsin.

english: Anyway, after that I stepped down from the Order of Wizards. I now spend my days offering guidance to those who come through Lumbridge.
translation: Her neyse, o olaydan sonra Büyücüler Tarikati'ndan ayrildim. Simdi günlerimi Lumbridge'e gelenlere rehberlik ederek geciriyorum.

english: I'm still curious to know how it ended up in some rift. Do you have any theories?
translation: Hala onun nasil bir yarikta son buldugunu merak ediyorum. Herhangi bir teorin var mi?

english: Well... where was this rift?
In an ancient temple. Most things in the rift came from the Abyss.
translation: Eski bir tapinakta. Yarikta bulunan cogu sey Abyss'ten gelmisti.

english: The Abyss? I wasn't aware anyone had ever been to the Abyss.
translation: Abyss mi? Abyss'e giden kimse oldugunu bilmiyordum.

english: They hadn't until recently, but the Z.M.I. found a way there.
translation: Yakin zamana kadar yoktu, ama Z.M.I. oraya giden bir yol buldu.

english: The Z.M.I.? But could that mean...
translation: Z.M.I. mi? Ama bu demek oluyor ki...

english: What?
Oh, nothing to worry about. Just me being a silly old man. Tell me more about this temple.
translation: Oh, endiselenecek bir sey yok. Sadece ben aptal bir ihtiyarim. Bana bu tapinaktan biraz daha bahset.

english: It's called the Temple of the Eye. It was built by Saradominist wizards long ago to house a powerful artefact.
translation: Adi Göz Tapinagi. Uzun zaman önce Saradominist büyücüler tarafindan güclü bir eseri barindirmak icin insa edildi.

english: The Eye?
You've heard of it?
Only stories, of which there are very few. Still, I always believed them to be real. After all, why else would an eye be the symbol of the Order of Wizards?
translation: Sadece cok az sayida hikayeden. Yine de, bunlarin gercek olduguna hep inandim. Sonucta, büyücülerin tarikatinin sembolü neden bir göz olsun ki?

english: Ah, but that reminds me, I was not the first in my family to join the order. This amulet was passed down from generation to generation.
translation: Ah, ama bu bana hatirlatti, ailemde tarikata katilan ilk kisi ben degildim. Bu muska nesilden nesile aktarildi.

english: That looks just like the amulet that led us to the temple!
translation: Bu, bizi tapinaga götüren muska gibi görünüyor!

english: As soon as you mentioned it, I wondered if there might be a connection.
translation: Bunu söyledigin anda, bir baglanti olup olmadigini merak ettim.

english: The origin of this amulet was something I spent much time puzzling over when I was younger. I'm glad you have answered the question I couldn't.
translation: Bu muskanin kökeni, gencken üzerinde cok kafa yordugum bir konuydu. Benim cevaplayamadigim soruyu cevapladigin icin mutluyum.

english: I'd be happy to give you this amulet in return for that locket. I have no use for it, but that locket is something which holds a lot of sentimental value to me.
translation: O madalyon karsiliginda bu muskayi sana vermekten mutluluk duyarim. Benim icin bir anlami yok, ama o madalyon benim icin cok duygusal bir degeri var.

english: Of course you can have the locket.
Thank you for returning this to me. I wish you the best of luck on the rest of your adventures.
translation: Bunu bana geri verdigin icin tesekkür ederim. Geri kalan maceralarinda sana bol sans dilerim.

english: Thanks, Phileas. I wish you luck also.
translation: Tesekkürler, Phileas. Sana da bol sans dilerim.

english: Oh, I see. I guess I can't really force you to hand it over. The offer still stands if you ever change your mind.
translation: Anliyorum. Sanirim seni zorla vermeye ikna edemem. Fikrini degistirirsen teklifim hala gecerli.

english: Never mind then. I have to go.
You're back. Would you consider giving me that locket? It holds a lot of sentimental value to me. I'll give you that amulet in return.
translation: Geri dönmüssün. Bana o madalyonu verir misin? Benim icin cok manevi degeri var. Karsiliginda sana o tilsimi veririm.

english: Ask about the Amulet of the Eye
Something else
Where can I find a quest to go on?
Yes please.
I want another quest.
What monsters should I fight?
How can I get a weapon?
Where can I find a weapon?
I'd like to know more about getting weapons.
translation: Silah edinme hakkinda daha fazla bilgi istiyorum.

english: I’d like to know about something else.
translation: Baska bir sey hakkinda bilgi almak istiyorum.

english: How do I make a weapon?
Where can I buy a weapon?
Could I get a staff like yours?
translation: Seninki gibi bir asa alabilir miyim?

english: Yes, but what should I fight once I have got a weapon?
translation: Evet, ama silahi aldiktan sonra neyle savasmaliyim?

english: Where can I get food to heal myself?
translation: Kendimi iyilestirmek icin yiyecek nereden bulabilirim?

english: How do I get cabbages?
I'd like to know about other food.
translation: Diger yiyecekler hakkinda bilgi almak istiyorum.

english: I'd like to know about something else.
translation: Baska bir sey hakkinda bilgi almak istiyorum.

english: How do I fish?
Where can I find meat?
Where can I get better armour and weapons?
translation: Daha iyi zirh ve silahlari nereden bulabilirim?

english: Okay, thanks, I will go and kill things.
Can I kill other players?
I'd like to know more about combat.
translation: Savas hakkinda daha fazla bilgi almak istiyorum.

english: Where can I make money?
Where can I smith?
Where can I find more information?
More options...
I'd like to know more about security.
translation: Güvenlik hakkinda daha fazla bilgi almak istiyorum.

english: I'd like to know about password security.
translation: Sifre güvenligi hakkinda bilgi almak istiyorum.

english: Tell me more about security.
translation: Güvenlik hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin.

english: I'd like to know more about avoiding item scamming.
translation: Ögelerin dolandiriciligindan kacinmak hakkinda daha fazla bilgi edinmek istiyorum.

english: I'd like to know more about in-game moderation.
translation: Oyun ici moderasyon hakkinda daha fazla bilgi edinmek istiyorum.

english: I'd like to know about the Stronghold of Security.
translation: Güvenlik Kalesi hakkinda bilgi edinmek istiyorum.

english: I'd like to know more about something else.
translation: Baska bir sey hakkinda daha fazla bilgi edinmek istiyorum.

english: No, thank you.
Yes, please.
Where can I find a bank?
I don't need any help.
Previous options...
It's okay, I have time to listen.
Of course you can have the locket.
I'd rather keep the locket for myself.
Never mind then. I have to go.
Hello?
Baaaa.
Huh? Okay.
Baa, baaa. BAA!
Baaa?
Hi!
Who are you?
I am...
...Lumiere.
It's nice to meet you, Lumiere.
...It is?
Yeah?
Why are you here?
I... light the candles...
Oh, I've always wondered who did that. It doesn't sound like much fun...
translation: Oh, bunu kimin yaptigini hep merak etmisimdir. Pek eglenceli bir is gibi gelmiyor...

english: I... did not choose this fate...
Punishment?
Yes... for my sins.
Tough break.
It is not too bad... There has been plenty of blood... Although stocks are frighteningly low...
translation: O kadar da kötü degil... Bolca kan var... Stoklar korkutucu derecede az olsa da...

english: Good thing the sanctuary was unsealed. Plenty of adventurer folk you could grab some blo-
translation: Iyi ki siginak mühürlenmemis. Bolca maceraci var, onlardan biraz kan alabilirsin...

english: Suddenly Lumieres' face brightens.
You are... not imaginary?
Oh... no... I'd better go.
Stay... we have so much to discuss.
Bye!
Who are you?
Why are you here?
Bye!
Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: Hey, bu Kahraman! Vay canina! Harikasin, o iki juvinate ve Gadderank'i nasil alt ettin? Ve kasaba cok güzel, harika bir is cikarmissin!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
Oh hi, I'm Luminata, I hunt mostly...rats...Speaking of which, this rat tastes awful - but it's the only food we have!
translation: Merhaba, ben Luminata, cogunlukla... sican avliyorum... Bu arada, bu sican tadi berbat ama elimizdeki tek yiyecek bu!

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: Oh, pek bir sey yok, hepimiz hala vampirlerden saklaniyoruz ve bu korkunc yerde gecimimizi sagliyoruz, umarim yakinda Salve'deki tapinaga yolculuk yapacak kadar gücleniriz.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: Bildigim kadariyla yok, su anda cok yararli olan bazi temel olanaklara sahibiz, hepimiz sana inanilmaz derecede minnettariz. Daha önce hic bir kahraman görmedim veya tanimadim, bu yüzden karsilastiracak bir seyim yok, ama sanirim

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: Cogu insanin görüsüne göre, sen bir kahramansin! Ben sahsen seninle tanistigima cok memnunum.

english: Ok, thanks.
Here, solve this.
Luminata hands you a [light puzzle/puzzle] box.
translation: Luminata sana bir [isik bulmacasi/bulmaca] kutusu uzatir.

english: That doesn't look solved to me.
Well done [player name]. Here you go.
You've obtained a [new clue/casket]!
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Ok, thanks.
What's going on here?
We've secured the crash site, you've proven that you can handle yourself against these demonic gorillas, so feel free to head down to the cavern whenever you like.
translation: Kaza yerini güvenlik altina aldik, bu seytani gorillere karsi kendinizi savunabileceginizi kanitladiniz, bu yüzden istediginiz zaman magaraya inebilirsiniz.

english: Wow. I swear we've seen him 5 times already.
translation: Vay canina. Yemin ederim onu 5 kez gördük.

english: Oh my god - he's been through here 10 times now.
translation: Aman Tanrim, simdiye kadar 10 kez buradan gecti.

english: And which god would that be, eh?
You know what I mean...
Okay, let's trade.
No, I'm fine.
Fair enough.
Okay, let's trade.
No, I'm fine.
Hello there. How can I help you, brave adventurer?
translation: Merhaba. Nasil yardimci olabilirim, cesur maceraci?

english: What are you selling?
I sell rune stones. I've got some good stuff, some really powerful little rocks. Take a look.
translation: Rune taslari satiyorum. Cok iyi ürünlerim var, gercekten güclü kücük taslar. Bir bak.

english: What's that big old building above us?
translation: Üstümüzdeki o büyük eski bina ne?

english: That, my friend, is the mage battle arena. Top mages come from all over Gielinor to compete in the arena.
translation: O, dostum, büyücü savas arenasi. Gielinor'un her yerinden en iyi büyücüler bu arenada yarismak icin geliyorlar.

english: Wow.
Few return, most get fried, hence the smell.
translation: Cok azi geri dönüyor, cogu kizariyor, bu yüzden bu koku var.

english: Hmmm.. I did notice.
You'll need to have completed the Easy Wilderness Achievement Diary to qualify for free runes.
translation: Ücretsiz rünlere hak kazanmak icin Kolay Wilderness Basari Günlügünü tamamlamis olman gerekiyor.

english: You need more free space before you can claim your free runes.
translation: Ücretsiz rünleri alabilmek icin daha fazla bos alana ihtiyacin var.

english: There you go. Come back tomorrow for some more!
translation: Al bakalim. Yarin tekrar gel de biraz daha al!

english: Lundail hands you [amount] free [type] runes.
You've already claimed your free runes today. Come back tomorrow for some more.
translation: Bugün ücretsiz rünlerini zaten aldin. Yarin tekrar gel de biraz daha al.

english: What are you selling?
What's that big old building above us?
translation: Üstümüzdeki o büyük eski bina ne?

english: Claim free runes.
Buying cabbage am I, not have such thing where I from. Will pay money much handsome for wondrous object, cabbage you called.
translation: Lahana satin aliyorum, benim geldigim yerde böyle bir sey yok. Harika bir nesne olan lahanaya cok güzel bir para ödeyecegim.

english: Say I 100 gold coins each fair price to be giving yes?
translation: Her biri 100 altin sikke makul bir fiyat mi?

english: Alas, I have no cabbages either...
translation: Ne yazik ki, benim de lahanam yok...

english: Pity be that, I want badly do.
Yes, I'll sell you all my cabbages.
Business good doing with you! Please, again come, buying always.
translation: Seninle is yapmak cok güzel! Lütfen tekrar gel, her zaman satin al.

english: No, I will keep my cabbbages.
Yes, I will sell you all my cabbages.
No, I will keep my cabbbages.
Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: Hey, bu Kahraman! Vay canina! Sen harikasin, o iki genc ve Gadderank'lari nasil alt ettin? Ve kasaba cok güzel, harika bir is cikarmissin!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
Well met! My name's Luscion, I do a bit of this, a bit of that. Just try to survive really, there's nothing much else we can do.
translation: Merhaba! Benim adim Luscion, biraz sundan, biraz bundan yapiyorum. Aslinda sadece hayatta kalmaya calisiyoruz, baska yapabilecegimiz pek bir sey yok.

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: Oh, pek bir sey yok, hepimiz hala vampirlerden saklaniyoruz ve bu korkunc yerden gecimimizi sagliyoruz, umarim yakinda Salve'deki tapinaga yolculuk yapacak kadar gücleniriz.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: Bildigim kadariyla yok, su anda cok yararli olan bazi temel olanaklara sahibiz, hepimiz sana inanilmaz derecede minnettariz. Daha önce hic bir kahraman görmedim veya tanimadim, bu yüzden karsilastiracak bir seyim yok, ama sanirim
