english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: cogu insanin görüsüne göre, sen bir kahramansin! Ben sahsen seninle tanistigima cok memnunum.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Ok, thanks.
Hello I'm Luthas, I run the banana plantation here.
translation: Merhaba, ben Luthas, burada muz plantasyonunu isletiyorum.

english: Could you offer me employment on your plantation?
Yes, I can sort something out. There's a crate ready to be loaded onto the ship.
translation: Evet, bir seyler ayarlayabilirim. Gemiye yüklenmeye hazir bir sandik var.

english: You wouldn't believe the demand for bananas from Wydin's shop over in Port Sarim. I think this is the third crate I've shipped him this month..
translation: Port Sarim'deki Wydin'in dükkanindan gelen muz talebini inanamazsin. Sanirim bu ay ona gönderdigim ücüncü sandik.

english: If you could fill it up with bananas, I'll pay you 30 gold.
That customs officer is annoying isn't she?
translation: Gümrük memuru can sikici, degil mi?

english: Well I know her pretty well. She doesn't cause me any trouble any more.
translation: Onu oldukca iyi taniyorum. Artik bana sorun cikarmiyor.

english: She doesn't even search my export crates any more. She knows they only contain bananas.
translation: Artik ihracat kasalarimi bile aramiyor. Iclerinde sadece muz oldugunu biliyor.

english: Really? How interesting. Whereabouts do you send those to?
translation: Gercekten mi? Ne ilginc. Onlari nereye gönderiyorsun?

english: There is a little shop over in Port Sarim that buys them up by the crate. I believe it is run by a man called Wydin.
translation: Port Sarim'de kasalar halinde satin alan kücük bir dükkan var. Sanirim sahibi Wydin adinda bir adam.

english: Have you completed your task yet?
What did I have to do again?
There's a crate ready to be loaded onto the ship. If you could fill it up with bananas, I'll pay you 30 gold.
translation: Gemiye yüklenecek bir kasa hazir. Onu muzla doldurursaniz size 30 altin öderim.

english: No, the crate isn't full yet...
Well come back when it is.
So where are these bananas going to be delivered to?
I sell them to Wydin who runs a grocery store in Port Sarim.
translation: Port Sarim'de bir bakkal isleten Wydin'e satiyorum.

english: I've filled a crate with bananas.
Well done, here's your payment.
Will you pay me for another crate full?
translation: Bir sandik daha doldurursam bana ödeme yapar misin?

english: Yes certainly.
If you go outside you should see the old crate has been loaded on to the ship, and there is another empty crate in its place.
translation: Disari cikarsan eski sandigin gemiye yüklendigini ve yerine baska bir bos sandik konuldugunu göreceksin.

english: Thank you, I'll be on my way.
Congratulations.
Could you offer me employment on your plantation?
That customs officer is annoying isn't she?
translation: O gümrük memuru cok sinir bozucu, degil mi?

english: What did I have to do again?
No, the crate isn't full yet.
So where are these bananas going to be delivered to?
Will you pay me for another crate full?
Thank you, I'll be on my way
Hello!
Greetings.
Who are you?
Well, friend, I'm Arls Lutwidge of the Moonlight Broadsword! Renowned all over Gielinor!
translation: Arkadasim, ben Moonlight Broadsword'dan Arls Lutwidge! Gielinor'un her yerinde taninirim!

english: Can't say I've heard of you before.
You haven't... heard of... That's madness!
translation: Duymadin mi... Duymadin mi... Bu delilik!

english: Surely you've heard of my feats, but perhaps not the name?
translation: Elbette basarilarimi duymussundur, ama belki adimi duymamissindir?

english: Perhaps.
And yourself?
An adventurer mostly, but I've slain some dragons and I've conquered some nightmares.
translation: Cogunlukla bir maceraciyim, ama birkac ejderha öldürdüm ve birkac kabusu yendim.

english: Very good, young one! Very good indeed!
translation: Cok iyi, genc adam! Gercekten cok iyi!

english: So... where's this famous sword of yours?
Gone. I gave it to a fledgling when I retired and the damned fool went and died fighting some great monster in a far off land.
translation: Yok oldu. Emekli oldugumda onu bir acemiye verdim ve o aptal, uzak bir ülkede büyük bir canavarla savasirken öldü.

english: Say... if you find it, could you bring it to me? I won't pay you, as holding such a magnificent weapon should be payment enough.
translation: Söylesene... onu bulursan bana getirir misin? Sana para vermeyecegim, cünkü böylesine muhtesem bir silahi elinde tutmak yeterli bir ödeme olmali.

english: I think you need to work on your bartering skills.
Perhaps.
What grand feats are you known for?
I peaked rather early and most know me for my first act of heroism when I defeated the Moonfly. It may sound cute, but it killed many of the smallfolk and their livestock, for it was a vile creature.
translation: Zirveye oldukca erken ulastim ve cogu kisi beni Moonfly'i yendigim ilk kahramanligimla taniyor. Kulaga sevimli gelebilir, ama o igrenc bir yaratikti ve bircok kücük insani ve hayvanlarini öldürdü.

english: Where'd it come from?
It was I that discovered the creature. I pulled it from the Lum during a fishing trip of mine.
translation: O yaratigi kesfeden bendim. Balik tutarken Lum'dan cikardim.

english: As young and foolish as I was, I dropped it down a dried up well and went for help. However, upon my return, the creature was gone.
translation: Genc ve aptal oldugum icin onu kurumus bir kuyuya attim ve yardim cagirmaya gittim. Ancak geri döndügümde yaratik gitmisti.

english: And then what happened?
Many years passed until suddenly there were sightings of a winged demon around the River Lum. Some claimed it was an overly large heron and that it was nothing to be worried about.
translation: Yillar gecti ve birdenbire Lum Nehri cevresinde kanatli bir iblis görülmeye basladi. Bazilari onun asiri büyük bir balikcil oldugunu ve endiselenecek bir sey olmadigini iddia etti.

english: As time went on, folk started to go missing and I knew I had to return home and face this demon.
translation: Zaman gectikce, insanlar kaybolmaya basladi ve ben eve dönüp bu iblisle yüzlesmem gerektigini anladim.

english: You left?
I had wars to fight, glory to be won and all that rubbish. Upon my return I spoke to an old crone who lived in the swamps and she gave me some advice.
translation: Savasmam gereken savaslar, kazanmam gereken zaferler ve tüm o sacmaliklar vardi. Döndügümde bataklikta yasayan yasli bir kadina konustum ve o bana bazi tavsiyelerde bulundu.

english: She told me to spike my armour and described how to lure the creature toward me.
translation: Zirhimi sivriltmemi ve yaratigi kendime cekmek icin nasil yapmam gerektigini anlatti.

english: And you defeated it? The Moonfly?
Some bard wrote a poem of the events. The telling of the battle is a little embellished and rife with errors. The poem can be found in this library somewhere, providing it has been returned.
translation: Bir ozan bu olaylari anlatan bir siir yazdi. Savasin anlatimi biraz abartili ve hatalarla dolu. Siir, geri getirilmisse, bu kütüphanede bir yerlerde bulunabilir.

english: And did I defeat the creature? I wouldn't be here if I hadn't!
translation: Ve yaratigi yendim mi? Yenmeseydim burada olmazdim!

english: I'll be sure to keep an eye out.
Please do! And come to me if you have any burning questions about it.
translation: Lütfen öyle yap! Ve bu konuda merak ettigin bir sey olursa bana gel.

english: Sure thing.
Why are you here?
I've grown old, friend. Heroes need to know when to throw in the towel, so they say. I've always enjoyed a good book, so it seemed fitting to stay here as librarian for the guild.
translation: Yaslandim dostum. Kahramanlar ne zaman pes etmeleri gerektigini bilmeliler, öyle derler. Her zaman iyi kitaplari sevmisimdir, bu yüzden burada guildin kütüphanecisi olarak kalmak uygun göründü.

english: Hmm... the books are very interesting. I thought there would be more though...
translation: Hmm... kitaplar cok ilginc. Ama daha fazlasi olacagini düsünmüstüm...

english: Well, that's why I'm here! So many of you adventurers help yourself to any old book and never return the damn things!
translation: Iste bu yüzden buradayim! Siz maceracilar, eski kitaplari alip bir daha geri getirmiyorsunuz!

english: If I could have it my way, you wouldn't be allowed to wander off with them, but I'm not the guildmaster, as Alec likes to remind me.
translation: Eger bana kalsaydi, kitaplari alip gitmenize izin vermezdim, ama Alec'in sürekli hatirlattigi gibi, ben guildmaster degilim.

english: Certainly sounds like you have a problem.
Well fear not. I'm working on it!
Bye!
I'll see you around.
Yes! Fantastic! Did you enjoy it?
Yeah it was alright. Some of these words are a bit odd though. Did you really cover your sword in sheep blood?
translation: Evet, fena degildi. Ama bazi kelimeler biraz tuhaf. Kilicini gercekten koyun kaniyla mi kapladin?

english: Ah, a slight misunderstanding... I soaked it in sap from a yew tree, but I guess blood is a bit more dramatic.
translation: Ah, kücük bir yanlis anlasilma... Onu porsuk agacinin özsuyuna batirdim, ama kan biraz daha dramatik olurdu herhalde.

english: Why?
The crone, long dead now, I suppose... She claimed to be from the same world as the creature and knew of the ritual to summon it.
translation: Uzun zaman önce ölen yasli kadin, sanirim... O yaratikla ayni dünyadan oldugunu ve onu cagirmak icin gerekli ritüeli bildigini iddia ediyordu.

english: The poem does mention sheep though, at the end?
translation: Siirin sonunda koyunlardan bahsediliyor, degil mi?

english: Perhaps some locals claimed to have lost some sheep, but my guess is that the bard was searching for a rhyme. Either way, I doubt it's a detail worth fretting over.
translation: Belki bazi yerliler koyunlarini kaybettigini iddia etmislerdir, ama benim tahminim ozan bir kafiye ariyordu. Her halükarda, bunun üzerinde durmaya deger bir ayrinti oldugunu sanmiyorum.

english: Who are you?
What grand feats are you known for?
Why are you here?
Bye!
Hello.
The man glances at you and grunts something unintelligible.
translation: Adam sana bir bakis atar ve anlasilmaz bir sey mirildanir.

english: Who are you?
Mac. What's it to you?
Only trying to be friendly.
What do you have in your sack?
None of yer bis'ness.
How rude! I was only being curious.
S'me cape.
Your cape?
What does your cape do?
All the things other skillcapes do.
translation: Diger yetenek pelerinlerinin yaptigi her seye.

english: Can you tell me what they are?
Fine... Ajjat gave me unlimited teleports to his Warrior's guild and Kamfreena lets me fight her Cyclopes without needing those annoying tokens.
translation: Tamam... Ajjat bana Savasci loncasina sinirsiz teleport sagladi ve Kamfreena, o sinir bozucu jetonlara ihtiyac duymadan onun Cyclopes'leriyle savasmama izin veriyor.

english: Melee combat tutor added a ring of life function and the armour salesman at the Ranging guild added a magnet and undead chicken thing.
translation: Yakin dövüs ögretmeni bir yasam halkasi islevi ekledi ve Menzil loncasi zirh saticisi bir miknatis ve ölümsüz tavuk seyi ekledi.

english: Brother Jered attached a holy wrench and Wizard Sinina enchanted the cape so I can change me spellbook.
translation: Kardes Jered kutsal bir Ingiliz anahtari ekledi ve Büyücü Sinina pelerini büyülü hale getirdi, böylece büyü kitabimi degistirebiliyorum.

english: Aubury attached all of the runecrafting tiaras, an estate agent sold me some teleports and one of the nurses at the Emir's Arena made it give me faster hitpoints.
translation: Aubury tüm runecrafting taclarini ekledi, bir emlakci bana bazi teleportlar satti ve Emir'in Arenasi'ndaki hemsirelerden biri pelerinin bana daha hizli can puani kazandirmasini sagladi.

english: Agility Arena guy with a Parrot pet made it lighter for me and Kaqemeex convinced the Nardah herbalist to make potions for me if I wear it and he attached a pestle and mortar, toos.
translation: Papagan evcil hayvani olan Agility Arena adami onu benim icin daha hafif hale getirdi ve Kaqemeex, Nardah sifali bitki uzmanini, onu giyersem benim icin iksir yapmaya ikna etti ve o da havan ve havaneli ekledi.

english: Martin Thwait made the cape better for being sneaky and the Master Crafter added a teleport to his guild before Hickton attached some grapples and a crossbow.
translation: Martin Thwait pelerini gizlilik icin daha iyi hale getirdi ve Usta Zanaatkar, Hickton bazi kancalar ve bir tatar yayi eklemeden önce guildine bir teleport ekledi.

english: Duradel convinced all Slayer masters to give me a chance at repeating an assignment and the Hunting Expert added some useful teleports, too.
translation: Duradel tüm Slayer ustalarini bana bir görevi tekrar etme sansi vermeleri icin ikna etti ve Avcilik Uzmani da bazi yararli teleportlar ekledi.

english: A dwarf gave it a chance to give me extra ores and another dwarf made it give more experience when making gold bars and the Master Chef stopped it from burning any food.
translation: Bir cüce bana ekstra cevherler verme sansi verdi ve baska bir cüce altin külceleri yaparken daha fazla deneyim kazandirmasini sagladi ve Usta Asci yiyeceklerin yanmasini engelledi.

english: Ignatius Vulcan added a torch for lighting up caves and the Woodcutting tutor made it easier to find bird's nests and Martin the Master Farmer made it yield more herbs.
translation: Ignatius Vulcan magaralari aydinlatmak icin bir mesale ekledi, Odun Kesme ögretmeni kus yuvalarini bulmayi kolaylastirdi ve Usta Ciftci Martin daha fazla ot vermesini sagladi.

english: So yeah all of that.
Can I have it?
Nah. Not got space.
Mebe.
I'm sure I could make it worth your while.
translation: Eminim senin icin degerli hale getirebilirim.

english: How much?
How about [amount of coins in inventory] gold?
S'not enuff.
How about 2277000 gold?
Hello?
Huh, who's there?
It's Dionysius here. I'm using my magic to communicate to you. Don't worry.
translation: Ben Dionysius. Seninle iletisim kurmak icin büyümü kullaniyorum. Merak etme.

english: What are you doing in my head?
I just wanted to say congratulations [player name]. I've been watching you in your adventures - very well done.
translation: Sadece tebrik etmek istedim Maceraci. Maceralarini izliyordum, cok iyi is cikardin.

english: Oh very well done [player name]. Taken you a while, but I knew you could do it.
translation: Cok iyi is cikardin Maceraci. Biraz zaman aldi ama basarabilecegini biliyordum.

english: Ahhh [player name], I knew you had potential when I first met you. My compliments on reaching the pinnacle of your achievements.
translation: Ahhh Maceraci, ilk tanistigimizda potansiyelin oldugunu biliyordum. Basarilarinin zirvesine ulastigin icin tebrikler.

english: Meow!
Oh most excellently done old chap!
translation: Oh, cok iyi is cikarmissin dostum!

english: Why do you keep it in a sack?
Get it dirty.
Why are you so dirty?
Bath XP waste.
Bye.
Yip. Show me the goods. I pay 80%.
Nah. Need more space.
Yip. No cost. What cape do you want a hood for?
translation: Evet. Ücretsiz. Hangi pelerin icin kapüson istiyorsun?

english: You don't have that cape. Choose another.
translation: O pelerin sende yok. Baska bir tane sec.

english: Mac hands you another hood for your cape.
translation: Mac, pelerinine baska bir baslik verir.

english: Show cape.
That's XP waste.
Who are you?
What do you have in your sack?
What does your cape do?
Can you tell me what they are?
Can I have it?
Why do you keep it in a sack?
Yes, pay the man.
No.
Why are you so dirty?
Bye.
Can I sell my max cape back to you?
translation: Maksimum pelerinimi sana geri satabilir miyim?

english: Yes - receive 1,821,600gp.
No, I've changed my mind.
Can I have another hood for my cape?
translation: Pelerinim icin baska bir baslik alabilir miyim?

english: Hey there! Do you have a grapple I can borrow?
translation: Merhaba! Ödünc alabilecegim bir kanca var mi?

english: I might have one, but I need it myself. Why do you need a grapple?
translation: Bir tane olabilir, ama benim de ihtiyacim var. Neden kancaya ihtiyacin var?

english: I need it to grapple to that pillar over there and get some treasure of course. What else could I need it for?
translation: Suradaki sütuna tutunmak ve tabii ki hazine almak icin lazim. Baska ne icin lazim olabilir ki?

english: I mean that makes sense I suppose. How did you end up here?
Well, I made my way to Morytania in search of a place called the Ba... Barlows? I've heard it's a great way to earn gold.
translation: Morytania'ya, Ba... Barlows adinda bir yer aramak icin gittim. Orada altin kazanmanin harika bir yolu oldugunu duydum.

english: Barrows.
Yeah, that's what I said!
Anyways, I got lost on the way here and was abducted by some vampyres! However, I'm so sneaky I managed to escape and find this place.
translation: Neyse, buraya gelirken yolumu kaybettim ve bazi vampirler tarafindan kacirildim! Ancak, o kadar sinsi biriyim ki kacmayi basardim ve burayi buldum.

english: The weird hooded guy at the top said that if I get him some hollow marks, he'll help me escape.
translation: Tepedeki garip kapüsonlu adam, ona bazi oyuk isaretler getirirsem kacmama yardim edecegini söyledi.

english: You mean Hallowed marks.
Yeah, that's what I said. Don't you listen?
translation: Evet, ben de öyle dedim. Dinlemiyor musun?

english: *sigh*
So, can I borrow a grapple?
translation: Peki, bir kanca ödünc alabilir miyim?

english: No, I don't have a grapple on me.
Well, you're clearly a noob then.
translation: O zaman sen acikca bir acemisin....

english: Yes, I do have a spare grapple. I'm not sure you'd be able to use it to get across that gap though, what is your Ranged level?
translation: Evet, yedek bir kanca var. Ama o boslugu gecmek icin onu kullanabileceginden emin degilim, Menzil seviyen kac?

english: Pfft,I'm level 50 Ranged. Over half-way to 99, getting over there will be a breeze.
translation: Pfft, Menzil seviyem 50. 99'un yarisindan fazlasini gectin, oraya gecmek cocuk oyuncagi olacak.

english: You need 62 Ranged to make it across that gap.
translation: O boslugu gecmek icin 62 Ranged seviyesine ihtiyacin var.

english: Maybe you do with that attitude.
Yes, I do have a spare grapple, although I spent a lot of Hallowed marks to obtain it so you can't have it.
translation: Evet, yedek bir kanca var, ama onu almak icin cok fazla Hallowed mark harcadim, o yüzden sana veremem.

english: Keep your grapple then noob. I can make that jump without it anyway.
translation: Kancani kendine sakla acemi. Onsuz da o atlayisi yapabilirim.

english: Oh yeah? What's your agility level?
None of your business.
What, you gots the crystal...
Oh, okay then.
You be on your way, then.
Ah, greetings. What can I do for you?
translation: Ah, merhaba. Senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: Who are you?
I'm Madam Sikaro.
...Is that it?
Why shouldn't it be? You asked who I was, and I answered.
translation: Neden olmasin? Kim oldugumu sordun, ben de cevap verdim.

english: I was hoping to learn something about you, like what you were doing here...!
translation: Senin hakkinda bir seyler ögrenmek istiyordum, mesela burada ne yaptigini...!

english: Well, perhaps next time you'll ask a more direct question.
translation: Belki bir dahaki sefere daha dogrudan bir soru sorarsin.

english: What are you doing here?
Making a wizard hideout.
A wizard... hideout?
A wizard hideout! You know how some wizards have their own towers? Think that but underground.
translation: Bir büyücü siginagi! Bazi büyücülerin kendi kuleleri oldugunu biliyor musun? Onu düsün, ama yeraltinda.

english: So why not just get a tower?
translation: O zaman neden bir kule almiyorsun?

english: Land price. Kingdoms want you to pay an extortionate amount of money to build on 'their' land, it turns out.
translation: Arazi fiyatlari yüzünden. Kralliklar, “kendi” arazileri üzerinde insaat yapmak icin fahis fiyatlar talep ediyorlarmis.

english: So instead you ended up in the basement of a tavern.
translation: Sen de bunun yerine bir tavernanin bodrumunda buldun kendini.

english: Yep. Camarst said I could have it as long as I don't hurt any of his customers too badly.
translation: Evet. Camarst, müsterilerine cok fazla zarar vermedigim sürece burayi kullanabilecegimi söyledi.

english: Not that I actually plan to hurt any of his customers.
translation: Aslinda müsterilerine zarar vermeyi planladigimdan degil tabii.

english: I have this part that looks like it's from a weapon...
translation: Elimde silah parcasi gibi görünen bir sey var...

english: Ah yes, that does look like a part of a particularly powerful weapon.
translation: Evet, bu gercekten cok güclü bir silahin parcasi gibi görünüyor.

english: Can I do anything with it?
You? Perhaps not, though if you could bring me all three pieces, I suspect I could put it back together for you.
translation: Sen mi? Muhtemelen hayir, ama bana üc parcayi da getirirsen, senin icin bir araya getirebilirim.

english: There should be a hilt, a blade and a conduit gemstone. Oh, and I'll want 500,000 coins as payment as well. Good hunting!
translation: Bir kabza, bir kilic ve bir kanal mücevheri olmali. Oh, ve ödeme olarak 500.000 sikke istiyorum. Iyi avlar!

english: Do you know where I could find the other parts?
translation: Diger parcalari nerede bulabilirim biliyor musun?

english: I suspect the Wilderness would be a good place to start. There are monsters out there that have grown immense over time.
translation: Wilderness iyi bir baslangic noktasi olabilir. Orada zamanla devasa boyutlara ulasan canavarlar var.

english: Seeking out the strongest of them is where I'd start, anyway.
translation: En güclüsünü aramakla baslardim ben olsam.

english: I have these parts of a weapon, do you think you could assemble it for me?
translation: Elimde bir silahin parcalari var, benim icin birlestirebilir misin?

english: Hmm... yes, these are the parts of a particularly powerful weapon indeed. I can reassemble it... for a fee, of course. 500,000 coins, no less.
translation: Hmm... evet, bunlar gercekten de cok güclü bir silahin parcalari. Onu birlestirebilirim... tabii ki bir ücret karsiliginda. En az 500.000 sikke.

english: I don't have that much on me...
Well, if you come across some more, come find me again.
translation: Peki, biraz daha bulursan, tekrar bana gel.

english: Actually, I've changed my mind.
Curious, you come to me with all of the parts and the coin, yet you change your mind at the last second.
translation: Merak ediyorum, tüm parcalar ve sikkelerle bana geldin, ama son anda fikrini degistirdin.

english: I do rather get the feeling you're toying with me. Very well, I shall do my part in playing with you.
translation: Beni oyuna getirdigin hissine kapiliyorum. Pekala, ben de seninle oynamaya devam edecegim.

english: You feel the contents of your inventory shift slightly.
Now, do talk to me again if you'd like to proceed more sensibly.
translation: Simdi, daha mantikli bir sekilde devam etmek istiyorsan, benimle tekrar konus.

english: What are you doing with the money from combining the Voidwaker?
translation: Voidwaker'i birlestirerek elde ettigin parayla ne yapacaksin?

english: I'll spend some of it improving the hideout. The rest on general expenses.
translation: Bir kismini siginagi iyilestirmek icin harcayacagim. Gerisini genel giderler icin.

english: What kind of expenses?
Living isn't free, you know? A woman my age has expenses. Food, clothing, protection... It all adds up.
translation: Yasamak bedava degil, biliyorsun. Benim yasimdaki bir kadinin masraflari vardir. Yemek, giyecek, korunma... Hepsi birikiyor.

english: Goodbye.
You walked up to me just to say goodbye? Ok, sure, goodbye.
translation: Sadece hosca kal demek icin mi yanima geldin? Tamam, hosca kal.

english: So what exactly is this sword, anyway?
translation: Peki bu kilic tam olarak nedir?

english: Well, that largely depends on who you ask and when you ask it. The sword is not unique, but many like it have been referenced in folktales.
translation: Bu, kime ve ne zaman sorduguna bagli. Kilic benzersiz degil, ama halk hikayelerinde buna benzer bircok kilictan bahsediliyor.

english: Some tell of great and prideful warriors roaming the lands, cutting down all who oppose them in great crashes of lightning.
translation: Bazilari, topraklarda dolasan, kendilerine karsi cikan herkesi büyük simseklerle kesen büyük ve gururlu savascilardan bahseder.

english: Others tell of lovers, one bound by oath, the other free as the wind, cruely torn apart by fate.
translation: Digerleri, biri yeminle bagli, digeri rüzgar kadar özgür olan, kader tarafindan acimasizca ayrilan asiklardan bahseder.

english: Others still tell of three great beasts that alone were powerful, but combined could destroy Gielinor.
translation: Digerleri ise tek baslarina güclü olan, ancak bir araya geldiklerinde Gielinor'u yok edebilecek üc büyük canavardan bahseder.

english: Are we still talking about the sword?
Amazingly, yes. In all of these tales, the sword is there, potential shining through the metal, thunder rolling in its wake.
translation: Sasirtici bir sekilde, evet. Tüm bu hikayelerde kilic var, metalden parildayan potansiyel, ardinda yankilanan gök gürültüsü.

english: Are any of these tales... true?
translation: Bu hikayelerin herhangi biri... gercek mi?

english: Oh, I'm sure there are elements of the truth buried in there, but folklore being what it is, I'm inclined to not believe any of it.
translation: Oh, eminim icinde gercek unsurlar vardir, ama folklor neyse o, ben hicbirine inanmama egilimliyim.

english: Aside from the bit where it can summon lightning. It can absolutely do that.
translation: Yildirim cagirabildigi kismi haric. O kesinlikle yapabilir.

english: What about the name? You called it Voidwaker?
translation: Peki ya adi? Ona Voidwaker mi dedin?

english: Well, in a lot of these tales, it's only ever refferedto as someone's sword. Like, [player name]'s sword.
translation: Sey, bu masallarin cogunda, sadece birinin kilici olarak bahsediliyor. Mesela, Maceraci'nin kilici.

english: So, I chose a name for it.
translation: Ben de ona bir isim sectim.

english: And you chose... Voidwaker? Why?
translation: Ve sen... Voidwaker mi sectin? Neden?

english: There are multiple reasons. I suppose you could say the sword is so powerful that it leaves a void in its wake.
translation: Birkac nedeni var. Sanirim kilicin o kadar güclü oldugunu söyleyebiliriz ki, ardinda bir bosluk birakiyor.

english: That makes sense.
No thank you, I'm currently on a diet.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, su anda diyet yapiyorum.

english: Who are you?
What are you doing here?
I have this part that looks like it's from a weapon...
Yes
No
What are you doing with the money?
Goodbye.
Hello!
Good morrow, adventurer.
I guess so.
You guess? The sun is shining, the sea breeze is salty, what's not to enjoy?
translation: Öyle mi? Günes parliyor, deniz esintisi tuzlu, neyin tadini cikarmayacaksin ki?

english: I don't know... The sand? It's coarse and rough and irritating, and it gets everywhere.
translation: Bilmiyorum... Kum mu? Kaba, sert ve rahatsiz edici, her yere giriyor.

english: Hmm, well my spa isn't quite ready yet, but when it is, I'm sure that'll solve all of your sand related issues!
translation: Hmm, spa'm henüz hazir degil ama hazir oldugunda, kumla ilgili tüm sorunlarini cözeceginden eminim!

english: Okay.
Who are you?
I am Madame Caldarium! A pirate's life was for me, but lately I've been looking to expand my business, I'm getting old, ya see.
translation: Ben Madam Caldarium! Korsanlik hayati bana göreydi, ama son zamanlarda isimi genisletmek istiyorum, yaslaniyorum da.

english: A spa business? Do you really think these Corsairs are the washing type?
translation: Spa isi mi? Bu korsanlarin yikanan tipler oldugunu mu düsünüyorsun?

english: Ha! That's what the Rum is for!
I'm more concerned of their laziness, 'Can't work today Madame, I'm cursed!'. Bunch of idiots, the lot of 'em.
translation: Ben daha cok tembelliklerinden endiseleniyorum, “Bugün calisamam Madam, lanetlendim!” Bir sürü aptal, hepsi de.

english: Surely you never expected this lot to be any different... They're either stealing, killing or both!
translation: Bu adamlarin farkli olmasini beklememistin herhalde... Ya caliyorlar, ya öldürüyorlar, ya da ikisini birden yapiyorlar!

english: Yes... I have plans adventurer, the local cave dwelling population are... Let's say, sorting something out.
translation: Evet... Planlarim var maceraci, yerel magara sakinleri... Diyelim ki, bir seyi cözüyorlar.

english: Interesting, I'm sure that'll be an entertaining turn of events.
translation: Ilginc, eminim bu eglenceli bir gelisme olacak.

english: We'll see...
Goodbye!
Farewell, adventurer.
I have a question for you.
Please enter the answer to the question.
No, try again.
Correct!
I guess so.
Who are you?
Goodbye!
Hi.
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Isn't it wonderful? So many books, so much knowledge to be absorbed!
translation: Harika degil mi? Okunacak o kadar cok kitap, ögrenilecek o kadar cok sey!

english: You're right, it is.
Where did I see that book? It can't be far...
translation: O kitabi nerede görmüstüm? Uzakta olamaz...

english: Uh... Hello?
I'm sure it was around here somewhere...
Okay... Maybe later...
What can I do for ya?
Got any good books to recommend?
I've always found Prifddinas' History to be fascinating!
translation: Prifddinas'in Tarihi'ni her zaman büyüleyici bulmusumdur!

english: I've always found The Journal of Randas to be fascinating!
translation: Rendas'in Günlügü'nü her zaman büyüleyici bulmusumdur!

english: I've always found Big Book of Bangs to be fascinating!
translation: Büyük Patlama Kitabi'ni her zaman büyüleyici bulmusumdur!

english: I've always found The Great Divide to be fascinating!
translation: Büyük Bölünme kitabini her zaman büyüleyici bulmusumdur!

english: I've always found Ode to Eternity to be fascinating!
translation: Sonsuzluga Övgü kitabini her zaman büyüleyici bulmusumdur!

english: Thanks!
Nothing.
Got any good books to recommend?
translation: Önerdiginiz iyi bir kitap var mi?

english: Nothing.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu var. Merhaba, selam, merhaba...

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: Bu yine de tek bir selam sayilir!

english: Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her türlü sey! Kuleler görülmeye deger harika bir manzara.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmenizi tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Hello!
Hello friend. I wish to slay evil and avail them of their loot! Take me to Burgh de Rott!
translation: Merhaba dostum. Kötülügü yok etmek ve ganimetlerini ele gecirmek istiyorum! Beni Burgh de Rott'a götür!

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
I think so? At least my heart knows courage and that should be sufficient for the meantime. I expect that when we get to Burgh de Rott, we'll be able to purchase suitable provisions.
translation: Sanirim öyle. En azindan kalbim cesaret dolu ve bu simdilik yeterli olmali. Burgh de Rott'a vardigimizda uygun erzak satin alabilecegimizi umuyorum.

english: But you do realise that the vampyres in Morytania are immune to everything except silver?
translation: Ama Morytania'daki vampirlerin gümüs disinda her seye karsi bagisik olduklarini biliyor musun?

english: Er...well, I've not heard mention of that fact, but I have faith that Saradomin will provide the means to furnish me with suitable weapons when I reach Burgh de Rott.
translation: Sey... Bu konuda bir sey duymadim, ama Burgh de Rott'a vardigimda Saradomin'in bana uygun silahlar saglayacagina inaniyorum.

english: And if we happen to run into some vampyres on the journey down there?

I trust that you will help us to avoid them. You are a guide after all, aren't you? Anyway, you look like you can handle yourself. I presume you've fought such creatures before and won? How hard can it be?
translation: Onlardan kacinmamiza yardim edecegine inaniyorum. Sonucta sen bir rehbersin, degil mi? Her neyse, kendini savunabilecek gibi görünüyorsun. Daha önce bu tür yaratiklarla savasip kazandin mi? Ne kadar zor olabilir ki?

english: It can be pretty difficult, actually. But you're right, I'll be your guide so I should be able to handle the situation.
translation: Aslinda oldukca zor olabilir. Ama haklisin, ben senin rehberin olacagim, bu yüzden durumu halledebilmeliyim.

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Neden Burgh de Rott'a gitmek istiyorsun?

english: I'm going down there to teach those vampyres a lesson or two. I've heard about the terrible conditions down there and I intend to put a stop to it.
translation: Oradaki vampirleri bir ders vermek icin gidiyorum. Oradaki korkunc kosullari duydum ve buna bir son vermek niyetindeyim.

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Burgh de Rott'a giderken yol üzerinde düsmanlarla karsilasirsak kendini savunabilir misin?

english: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of enemies. You don't need to worry about that.
translation: Diyelim ki biraz tecrübeliyim ve düsmanlarla savasmaktan cekinmem. Bu konuda endiselenmene gerek yok.

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: Hmmm, görünüse göre bir takipcin var. Kendi basina dolasirsa bu yolculukta kaybolabilir. Takipcin güvende oldugunda yola cikalim.

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: Gercekten mi? Bu harika olur! Hedefe vardigimizda sana kücük bir ödül verecegim.

english: Burgh de Rott Ramble begins
Ok, which route should we take?
Ok, thanks.
Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: Ah, bana biraz erzak vermek istiyorsun, ha? Sirt cantami acayim.

english: This place is a bit grim. How can people live here?
translation: Burasi biraz kasvetli. Insanlar burada nasil yasayabiliyor?

english: Do you visit Burgh de Rott often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: Burgh de Rott'a sik sik gider misin? Rotayi iyi biliyorsun gibi görünüyor.

english: When are we going to get to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Burgh de Rott'a ne zaman varacagiz?

english: We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on. I have loot to get.
translation: Bütün gün burada durup sohbet edecek vaktimiz yok, hadi devam edelim. Yagmalayacak mallar var.

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than the opulet life styles forced on us adventurer types. I'd much rather be up to my eyes in mud and having a good fight!
translation: Bu yolculuktan nefret ediyorum, ama maceraperest tiplere dayatilan lüks yasam tarzindan daha iyidir. Gözlerime kadar camura batip iyi bir kavga etmeyi tercih ederim!

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...
Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Paterdomus. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: Hay aksi! Görünüse göre Paterdomus'a geri dönmek zorundayiz. O köprüyü gecemeyiz!

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
Player completes the bridge event
Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Paterdomus.
translation: Bu is bitti... Görünüse göre bu batakliktan gecemeyecegiz. Paterdomus'a geri dönmek zorundayiz.

english: Player completes the bog event
Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: Hey... bu harika... harika bir is cikardin... Seni takip edecegim.

english: Whahay...that was great!
But we really should be heading off now.
Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
Player completes the river event
That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: Bu harika! Ben de aynisini yapmaliyim.

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: Vay canina! Harikaydi! Ama artik gercekten yola cikmaliyiz.

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
This is scary!
Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
Ahhh, two tentacles!
...three tentacles!
I think I'm going to faint!
Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: Vay canina! Su canavara bak! O seyi kendi basina halletmen gerekecek!

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the Burgh de Rott. Here's your reward.
translation: Beni Burgh de Rott'a güvenle ulastirdigin icin cok tesekkürler. Iste ödülün.

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: Oradaki kötülükle savasmaya yeterince hazir misin?

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Neden Burgh de Rott'a gitmek istiyorsun?

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
Ok, thanks.
This isn't the place to talk. Visit me in Varrock's Chaos Temple if you have something to discuss. Unless you're here to teleport or buy something?
translation: Burasi konusmak icin uygun bir yer degil. Konusacak bir seyin varsa Varrock'un Kaos Tapinagi'nda beni ziyaret et. Tabii teleport olmak ya da bir sey satin almak icin burada degilsen?

english: Let's see what you're selling.
Could you teleport me to the Abyss?
Veniens! Sallakar! Rinnesset!
Player is teleported to the Abyss.
Alright, I'll go.
Ah, you again. What do you want?
About that incantation your initiate gave me...
Ah yes, the one to trace that amulet. Don't think I didn't notice that you modified the transmission spell I put on it. Next time you need help, we might not be so willing.
translation: Ah evet, o tilsimi izlemek icin olan. Üzerine koydugum aktarim büyüsünü degistirdigini fark etmedigimi sanma. Bir dahaki sefere yardim istersen, bu kadar istekli olmayabiliriz.

english: Well maybe you should have asked first! Besides, you wouldn't have got anything useful out of it. In tracing that amulet, we accidently managed to open an uncontrollable rift to the Abyss.
translation: Belki de önce sormaliydin! Ayrica, ondan yararli bir sey elde edemezdin. O muskayi takip ederken, kazara Abyss'e kontrol edilemeyen bir gecit actik.

english: And does this 'we' include the Order of Wizards?
translation: Bu “biz” sihirbazlar tarikatini da kapsiyor mu?

english: Maybe...
I knew it! It's just like them to play with magic they don't understand. First they burnt down the Wizards' Tower, now they're opening uncontrollable abyssal rifts!
translation: Biliyordum! Anlamadiklari sihirle oynamak tam da onlarin yapacagi bir sey. Önce Sihirbazlar Kulesi'ni yaktilar, simdi de kontrol edilemeyen abyss gecitleri aciyorlar!

english: Perhaps the fools should leave the dangerous magic to us next time!
translation: Belki de bu aptallar bir dahaki sefere tehlikeli büyüyü bize birakmalilar!

english: Oh, that reminds me. That incantation didn't appear to be written on parchment. What was it?
translation: Oh, bu bana bir seyi hatirlatti. O büyü parsömen üzerine yazilmis gibi görünmüyordu. Neydi o?

english: Hmm... probably the flesh of an abyssal creature. Why do you ask?
translation: Hmm... muhtemelen bir Abyss yaratiginin eti. Neden soruyorsun?

english: Oh, I just thought it might be human flesh. I'm relieved it wasn't!
translation: Oh, sadece insan eti olabilecegini düsündüm. Öyle olmadigina sevindim!

english: You've been spending too much time with your friends in the Order of Wizards! I know that we Zamorakians have a bad reputation, but do you really think we'd be so barbaric?
translation: Büyücüler Tarikati'ndaki arkadaslarinla cok fazla zaman geciriyorsun! Zamorakianlarin kötü bir üne sahip oldugunu biliyorum, ama gercekten bu kadar barbar olabilecegimizi düsünüyor musun?

english: Ah yes, the one that led those fools in the Order of Wizards to open an uncontrollable abyssal rift! Perhaps they should leave the dangerous magic to us next time!
translation: Ah evet, Büyücüler Tarikati'ndaki o aptallari kontrol edilemeyen bir ucurum yarigi acmaya yönlendiren! Belki de bir dahaki sefere tehlikeli büyüyü bize birakmalilar!

english: Not to mention that they tried to convince you that we wrote that incantation on human flesh! Their lies never cease to amaze me!
translation: Onlarin, o büyüyü insan eti üzerine yazdigimizi sana inandirmaya calistiklarini söylemeye gerek bile yok! Yalanlari beni her zaman sasirtiyor!

english: Right...
Can you tell me more about the Abyss?
translation: Abyss hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: It is a hard place to describe. We often refer to it as another plane, but that isn't quite accurate. If anything, it is more like a plane that sits between all other planes.
translation: Tarif etmesi zor bir yer. Genellikle baska bir boyut olarak adlandiriyoruz, ama bu tam olarak dogru degil. Daha cok, diger tüm boyutlarin arasinda yer alan bir boyut gibi.

english: Right... And what does it have to do with runecrafting?
translation: Anladim... Peki bunun runecrafting ile ne ilgisi var?

english: In truth, nothing at all. However, it has everything to do with teleportation. You see, time and space work differently in the Abyss.
translation: Aslinda hicbir ilgisi yok. Ancak, teleportasyon ile her seyi ilgisi var. Abyss'te zaman ve uzay farkli isliyor.

english: For example, you can travel to the Abyss, walk a few steps and then exit, only to find yourself somewhere completely different from where you entered. You might even find yourself on a different plane.
translation: Örnegin, Abyss'e gidip birkac adim attiktan sonra cikarsan, girdigin yerden tamamen farkli bir yerde bulursun kendini. Hatta farkli bir boyutta bile bulabilirsin.

english: You can also enter the Abyss and spend days there, but on your return, only moments have passed.
translation: Ayrica Abyss'e girip orada günler gecirebilirsiniz, ancak geri döndügünüzde sadece birkac dakika gecmis olur.

english: This is why the Abyss is so useful. It can be used as an effective hub for teleportation. In fact, all teleportation that we know of uses the Abyss, you just don't realise it.
translation: Bu yüzden Abyss cok kullanislidir. Isinlanma icin etkili bir merkez olarak kullanilabilir. Aslinda, bildigimiz tüm isinlanma islemleri Abyss'i kullanir, sadece siz bunun farkinda degilsiniz.

english: Wait... So when I teleport, I'm actually travelling through the Abyss?
translation: Bekle... Yani isinlandigimda, aslinda Abyss'ten geciyorum mu?

english: In some ways, I suppose you are. Whenever you use a teleport spell, that spell is actually travelling through the Abyss and using it to link two places together.
translation: Bir bakima, öyle diyebiliriz. Isinlanma büyüsü kullandiginizda, bu büyü aslinda Abyss'ten gecerek iki yeri birbirine baglar.

english: So did you discover the Abyss?
No. Knowledge of the Abyss has existed for a long time, hence it being used for teleportation. However, we believe we may be the first to have properly gained access in centuries.
translation: Hayir. Abyss hakkinda bilgiler uzun zamandir var, bu yüzden isinlanma icin kullaniliyor. Ancak, yüzyillardir Abyss'e dogru sekilde erisim saglayan ilk kisiler oldugumuza inaniyoruz.

english: How did you manage it?
By complete accident. One of our initiates was performing a routine teleportation experiment when something went wrong. Instead of ending up at their destination, they found themselves in the Abyss.
translation: Tamamen tesadüfen. Yeni üyelerimizden biri rutin bir teleportasyon deneyi yaparken bir seyler ters gitti. Hedeflerine ulasmak yerine, kendilerini Abyss'te buldular.

english: Now, did you want something else?
Can you tell me more about your group?
translation: Grubunuz hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misiniz?

english: I suppose you have proven yourself trustworthy. We are a group of mages in service to Zamorak. Our group is called the Zamorak Magical Institute, or Z.M.I. for short.
translation: Sanirim güvenilir oldugunuzu kanitladiniz. Biz Zamorak'a hizmet eden bir büyücü grubuyuz. Grubumuzun adi Zamorak Büyü Enstitüsü, kisaca Z.M.I.

english: Few actually know of us. Saradominist groups like the Order of Wizards hold sway over these lands, so we are forced to work in the shadows. However, make no mistake, our power far exceeds theirs.
translation: Bizi cok az kisi taniyor. Büyücü Tarikati gibi Saradominist gruplar bu topraklarda hakimiyet kurmus durumda, bu yüzden gölgede calismak zorundayiz. Ancak süpheniz olmasin, bizim gücümüz onlarinkinden cok daha fazla.

english: You don't seem to like the Order of Wizards very much.
And why would we? Did you know that the Order of Wizards wasn't always a Saradominist group? Once they allowed mages of all faiths to study with them, but they became greedy.
translation: Neden sevelim ki? Büyücüler Tarikati'nin her zaman Saradominist bir grup olmadigini biliyor muydun? Bir zamanlar tüm inanclardan büyücülerin kendileriyle birlikte ögrenim görmesine izin veriyorlardi, ama sonra acgözlü oldular.

english: What happened?
They started to desire more control. They banned Zamorakian wizards from certain areas of study, claiming them to be too dangerous. In reality, they just wanted that knowledge for themselves.
translation: Daha fazla kontrol sahibi olmak istediler. Zamorakci büyücüleri, cok tehlikeli olduklarini iddia ederek belirli alanlarda ögrenim görmelerini yasakladilar. Aslinda, o bilgiyi kendileri icin istiyorlardi.

english: It all went wrong for them, of course. A Zamorakian wizard made a great breakthrough in teleportation magic, but the Saradominists stole his research.
translation: Tabii ki her sey ters gitti. Bir Zamorakci büyücü, isinlanma büyüsünde büyük bir atilim yapti, ama Saradoministler onun arastirmasini caldi.

english: They used it to perform a ritual, but their lack of understanding caused it to go wrong. The entire Wizards' Tower burnt down. Many were killed, and years of research was destroyed.
translation: Onu bir ritüel gerceklestirmek icin kullandilar, ama anlamadiklari icin ritüel ters gitti. Büyücü Kulesi tamamen yandi. Bircok kisi öldü ve yillarin arastirmasi yok oldu.

english: Naturally, they blamed the Zamorakians. Claimed we intentionally burnt the tower down. After the tower was rebuilt, we were banished from the Order of Wizards and forced underground.
translation: Tabii ki Zamorakcilari sucladilar. Kuleyi kasten yaktigimizi iddia ettiler. Kule yeniden insa edildikten sonra, Büyücüler Tarikati'ndan kovulduk ve yeraltina inmek zorunda kaldik.

english: And that's how the Z.M.I. was formed?
Exactly.
Nothing. I'm just looking around.
Very well.
Here you go.
You are handed a torn part of a clue scroll.
translation: Sana bir ipucu parsömeninin yirtik bir parcasi verilir.

english: Ah! You have chosen some quite fantastic attire. Maybe you are not such a fool after all.
translation: Ah! Oldukca fantastik bir kiyafet secmissin. Belki de o kadar da aptal degilsin.

english: Let's see what you're selling.
Could you teleport me to the Abyss?
Alright, I'll go.
About that incantation your initiate gave me...
Can you tell me more about the Abyss?
translation: Abyss hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Can you tell me more about your group?
translation: Grubun hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Nothing. I'm just looking around.
What's that ladder next to the altar for?
An...archeological dig. Yeah, a dig.
Why?
Next to a Chaos Altar? That's a bit odd. Can I go down and have a look?
translation: Kaos Altari'nin yaninda mi? Bu biraz tuhaf. Asagi inip bakabilir miyim?

english: Well...I suppose. See, we found this ancient altar, but it was pretty broken so the Z.M.I. sent some of its researchers to try and repair it.
translation: Sey... Sanirim. Bak, bu eski altari bulduk, ama oldukca hasarliydi, bu yüzden Z.M.I. onu onarmaya calismak icin bazi arastirmacilarini gönderdi.

english: How'd that work out for them?
Pretty well - only one died. Still, they got it working...sort of. This ancient technology can be tricky.
translation: Oldukca iyi - sadece biri öldü. Yine de, onu calisir hale getirdiler... bir nevi. Bu eski teknoloji biraz alengirli olabilir.

english: What do you mean, 'sort of'? Altars either work or don't work.
translation: “Bir nevi” ne demek? Sunaklar ya calisir ya da calismaz.

english: This one works, just not as you'd expect. You put pure essence in, but get random runes back. Some of them we don't even know how to craft!
translation: Bu calisiyor, ama bekledigin gibi degil. Icine saf öz koyuyorsun, ama rastgele runlar geri aliyorsun. Bazilarini nasil yapacagimizi bile bilmiyoruz!

english: Sounds like a pretty good deal. Can I give it a go?
translation: Oldukca iyi bir anlasma gibi görünüyor. Bir deneyeyim mi?

english: I don't think so. The mages don't like outsiders going in; they'll probably attack you. They only patrol the short path, though, so if you used the long path, through a tunnel near the entrance, you'd probably be safe.
translation: Sanmiyorum. Büyücüler yabancilar girmesinden hoslanmazlar; muhtemelen sana saldiracaklar. Ancak sadece kisa yolu devriye geziyorlar, bu yüzden girisin yakinindaki tünelden gecen uzun yolu kullanirsan muhtemelen güvende olursun.

english: Thanks.
Hello.
Good day, newcomer. My name is Terrova. I'm here to tell you about Magic. Let's start by opening your magic interface.
translation: Iyi günler, yeni gelen. Benim adim Terrova. Sana Büyü hakkinda bilgi vermek icin buradayim. Büyü arayüzünü acarak baslayalim.

english: All you have to do is open the magic interface by clicking on the flashing icon.
translation: Tek yapman gereken, yanip sönen simgeye tiklayarak büyü arayüzünü acmak.

english: Currently you can only cast one offensive spell called Wind Strike. Let's try it out on one of those chickens.
translation: Su anda sadece Wind Strike adli tek bir saldiri büyüsü yapabilirsin. Hadi bunu tavuklardan birinde deneyelim.

english: Sorry, I don't have any more runes just now. But I see you have plenty.
translation: Üzgünüm, su anda baska runum yok. Ama senin bolca runun var.

english: Well, you're all finished here now. I'll give you a reasonable number of runes when you leave.
translation: Peki, burada isin bitti. Ayrilirken sana makul miktarda run verecegim.

english: When you get to the mainland you will find yourself in the town of Lumbridge. If you want some ideas on where to go next, talk to my friend Adventurer Jon. You can't miss him; he's wearing light blue armour with
translation: Anakaraya vardiginizda kendinizi Lumbridge kasabasinda bulacaksiniz. Bir sonraki adimda nereye gideceginiz konusunda fikir almak isterseniz, arkadasim Maceraci Jon ile konusun. Onu kacirmaniz imkansiz; acik mavi zirh giyiyor ve

english: a huge sword. There are also many tutors willing to teach you about the many skills you could learn.
translation: kocaman bir kilici var. Ayrica size ögrenebileceginiz bircok beceriyi ögretmeye istekli bircok ögretmen var.

english: Prepare yourself!
Were you planning to become an Iron, by the way?
translation: Bu arada, Demir Adam/Kadin olmayi mi planliyordunuz?

english: What's an Iron?
If you're interested in that, you should go and ask the Iron tutor before you leave this island. He's standing outside my house.
translation: Eger ilgileniyorsan, bu adadan ayrilmadan önce Demir Adam/Kadin ögretmeni ile konusmalisin. Evimin önünde duruyor.

english: Thanks, I'd better go and find him.
translation: Tesekkürler, gidip onu bulsam iyi olacak.

english: Yes, I do want to become an Iron.
No, I'm not planning to do that.

When you get to the mainland you will find yourself in the town of Lumbridge. If you want some ideas on where to go next, talk to my friend the Lumbridge Guide. You can't miss him; he's holding a big staff with
translation: Anakaraya vardiginda kendini Lumbridge kasabasinda bulacaksin. Bir sonraki adimin ne olacagi konusunda fikir almak istersen, arkadasim Lumbridge Rehberi ile konus. Onu kacirman imkansiz; ucunda soru isareti olan büyük bir asa tutuyor.

english: a question mark on the end. He also has a white beard and carries a rucksack full of scrolls. There are also many tutors willing to teach you about the many skills you could learn.
translation: Ayrica beyaz sakali var ve sirt cantasinda bir sürü parsömen tasiyor. Ayrica sana ögrenebilecegin bircok beceriyi ögretmek isteyen bircok ögretmen var.

english: Yes.
What's an Iron?
Yes, I do want to become an Iron.
No, I'm not planning to do that.
No.
Were you planning to become an Iron[man/woman], by the way?
translation: Bu arada, Ironman olmayi planliyor muydun?

english: What's an Iron[man/woman]?
If you're interested in that, you should go and ask the Iron[man/woman] tutor before you leave this island. He's standing outside my house.
translation: Eger ilgileniyorsan, bu adadan ayrilmadan önce Ironman ögretmenine sorman gerekir. Evimin önünde duruyor.

english: Yes, I do want to become an Iron[man/woman].
What's an Iron[man/woman]?
Yes, I do want to become an Iron[man/woman].
Hello there adventurer, I am the Magic combat tutor. Would you like to learn about magic combat, or perhaps how to make runes?
translation: Merhaba maceraci, ben sihirli savas ögretmeni. Sihirli savas hakkinda bilgi edinmek ister misin, yoksa rün yapmayi mi ögrenmek istersin?

english: Tell me about magic combat please.
translation: Lütfen bana sihirli savas hakkinda bilgi ver.

english: This is your spell book, this contains all the spells you can cast. To cast a spell, you will need to have the required magic level and have the right amount of the runes used to cast the spell.
translation: Bu senin büyü kitabin, icinde kullanabilecegin tüm büyüler var. Bir büyü yapmak icin gerekli büyü seviyesine sahip olman ve büyüyü yapmak icin gerekli miktarda runa sahip olman gerekir.

english: To check the level and runes required to cast a spell, hover your mouse cursor over the spell.
translation: Bir büyüyü yapmak icin gerekli seviyeyi ve runalari kontrol etmek icin fare imlecini büyünün üzerine getir.

english: If you have the right amount of runes and the magic level the spell will light up, meaning you will be able to cast it.
translation: Dogru miktarda runeniz ve büyü seviyeniz varsa, büyü parlayacak ve onu kullanabileceksiniz.

english: When you have a combat spell available, click on it once, then select your target. A good target would be a monster that is below your combat level.
translation: Kullanabileceginiz bir savas büyüsü varsa, üzerine bir kez tiklayin ve hedefinizi secin. Iyi bir hedef, savas seviyenizin altinda olan bir canavardir.

english: Try rats in the castle or, if you're feeling brave, the goblins to the west have been causing a nuisance of themselves.
translation: Kalede fareleri deneyin ya da cesursaniz, batida bulunan goblinler de bas belasi oluyorlar.

english: Nemarti, the Ranged Combat tutor and I both give out items every 30 minutes, however you must choose whether you want runes or ranged equipment.
translation: Menzilli Savas ögretmeni Nemarti ve ben her 30 dakikada bir esya dagitiyoruz, ancak rün mü yoksa menzilli ekipman mi istediginizi secmelisiniz.

english: To claim runes, right-click on me and choose Claim, to claim ranged equipment right-click on the Ranged Combat tutor and select Claim.
translation: Rünleri almak icin bana sag tiklayin ve Al'i secin, menzilli ekipmani almak icin Menzilli Savas ögretmenine sag tiklayin ve Al'i secin.

english: If you need some more advice, you should talk to Adventurer Jon about Adventure paths. He may even have a handy starter kit you can use.
translation: Daha fazla tavsiyeye ihtiyaciniz varsa, Maceraci Jon ile Macera yollari hakkinda konusmalisiniz. Kullanabileceginiz kullanisli bir baslangic kiti bile olabilir.

english: Is there anything else you would like to know?
translation: Baska bilmek istediginiz bir sey var mi?

english: Of course [player name]! As a rule of thumb, if you cast the highest spell of which you're capable, you'll get the best experience possible.
translation: Tabii ki Maceraci! Genel bir kural olarak, yapabileceginiz en yüksek büyüyü yaparsaniz, mümkün olan en iyi deneyimi elde edersiniz.

english: Superheat Item and the Alchemy spells are good ways to level magic if you are not interested in the combat aspect of magic.
translation: Sicaklik Artirma Esyasi ve Simya büyüler, büyünün savas yönüyle ilgilenmiyorsaniz, büyü seviyenizi yükseltmek icin iyi yollardir.

english: There's always the Magic Training Arena. You can find it north of the Emir's Arena, north-east of Al Kharid. You will be able to earn some special rewards there by practicing your magic there.
translation: Her zaman Magic Training Arena vardir. Al Kharid'in kuzeydogusunda, Emir's Arena'nin kuzeyinde bulabilirsiniz. Orada büyünüzü pratik yaparak bazi özel ödüller kazanabilirsiniz.

english: If you want a challenge, Kolodion, the master of battle magic, has set up an arena deep in the Wilderness. There you will have the chance to learn some extremely powerful spells.
translation: Zorlu bir meydan okuma istiyorsaniz, savas büyüsünün ustasi Kolodion, Wilderness'nin derinliklerinde bir arena kurmustur. Orada son derece güclü büyüler ögrenme sansiniz olacak.

english: You should investigate the treasure in the desert, you may find great benefit to your magic.
translation: Cöldeki hazineyi arastirmalisiniz, büyünüze büyük fayda saglayabilir.

english: Speak to the Archaeologist in the Bedabin Camp, south- west of the Shantay Pass. But be careful, this quest is not for the faint of heart and can be very dangerous.
translation: Shantay Gecidi'nin güneybatisindaki Bedabin Kampi'ndaki Arkeolog ile konusun. Ancak dikkatli olun, bu görev cesaretsizler icin uygun degildir ve cok tehlikeli olabilir.

english: I see you already have access to the ancient magicks. Well done, these will aid you greatly.
translation: Görüyorum ki eski büyülere zaten erisiminiz var. Aferin, bunlar size cok yardimci olacak.

english: I see you have already met Kolodion, you should keep practicing those spells. Maybe you will be able to use them outside the arena after practicing them enough times.
translation: Görüyorum ki Kolodion ile tanismissiniz, bu büyüler üzerinde calismaya devam etmelisiniz. Yeterince pratik yaptiktan sonra belki arenanin disinda da kullanabilirsiniz.

english: How do I make runes?
There are a couple of things you will need to make runes, rune essence and a talisman to enter the temple ruins.
translation: Rünleri yapmak icin birkac seye ihtiyacin olacak: rün özü ve tapinak kalintilarina girmek icin bir tilsim.

english: To get rune essence you will need to gather them somehow. You should talk to the Duke of Lumbridge, he may be able to help you with that. Alternatively, other players may sell you the essence.
translation: Rün özünü elde etmek icin bir sekilde onlari toplamalisin. Lumbridge Dükü ile konusmalisin, o sana bu konuda yardimci olabilir. Alternatif olarak, diger oyuncular da sana özü satabilir.

english: As you're fairly new to runecrafting you should start with air runes and mind runes.
translation: Rune yapiminda oldukca yeni oldugunuz icin hava runeleri ve zihin runeleri ile baslamalisiniz.

english: You will need a talisman for the rune you would like to create. You can right-click on it and select the Locate option. This will tell you the rough location of the altar.
translation: Yapmak istediginiz rune icin bir tilsima ihtiyaciniz olacak. Tilsimi sag tiklayip Bul secenegini secebilirsiniz. Bu, sunakin yaklasik konumunu size söyleyecektir.

english: When you find the ruined altar, use the talisman on it to be transported to a temple where you can craft your runes.
translation: Harabe halindeki sunagi buldugunuzda, tilsimi kullanarak runelerinizi yapabileceginiz bir tapinaga tasinabilirsiniz.

english: Clicking on the temple's altar will imbue your rune essence with the altar's magical property.
translation: Tapinagin sunaklarina tiklarsaniz, run özünüze sunaklarin büyülü özelligi asilanir.

english: If you want to save yourself an inventory space, you could always try binding the talisman to a tiara.
translation: Envanterinizde yer kazanmak istiyorsaniz, tilsimi bir tacla birlestirebilirsiniz.

english: To make one, take a tiara and talisman to the ruins and use the tiara on the temple altar. This will bind the talisman to your tiara.
translation: Bunu yapmak icin, bir tac ve tilsimi harabelere götürün ve taci tapinagin sunaklarinda kullanin. Bu, tilsimi taciniza baglayacaktir.

english: I see you have some experience already in Runecrafting. Perhaps you should try crafting some runes which you can then use in magic.
translation: Görüyorum ki run yapiminda zaten biraz deneyimin var. Belki de sihirde kullanabilecegin bazi runlar yapmayi denemelisin.

english: Check the skill guide to see which runes you can craft.
translation: Hangi runlari yapabilecegini görmek icin beceri kilavuzuna bak.

english: To get rune essence you will need to gather them in the essence mine. You can get to the mine by talking to Aubury who owns the runes shop in south east Varrock.
translation: Rune özü elde etmek icin öz madeninde onlari toplamalisin. Madene, Varrock'un güneydogusundaki run dükkaninin sahibi Aubury ile konusarak ulasabilirsin.

english: Let's discuss how my runes act when I pick them up.
When you pick up runes from the ground, if you're carrying a rune pouch that contains matching runes, I can make the runes you've picked up go straight into the pouch, provided there's space.
translation: Yerden runeleri topladiginda, eslesen runeler iceren bir rune kesesi tasiyorsan, topladigin runeleri kesede yer varsa dogrudan kesenin icine koyabilirim.

english: Alternatively, you can let them go into your inventory like normal.
translation: Alternatif olarak, normalde oldugu gibi envanterinize koyabilirsiniz.

english: Certainly! Runes will go straight to your rune pouch when you pick them up, if it contains matching runes.
translation: Elbette! Rünleri topladiginizda, eslesen rünler varsa dogrudan rün cantaniza giderler.

english: Certainly! Runes will go to your inventory when you pick them up, rather than going into a rune pouch.
translation: Elbette! Rünleri topladiginizda, rün cantaniza degil, envanterinize giderler.

english: You can also control this option via the Settings menu, rather than having to return to this Tutor in future.
translation: Bu secenegi, gelecekte bu Ögretmene geri dönmek yerine Ayarlar menüsünden de kontrol edebilirsiniz.

english: Is there anything else I can do for you?
translation: Sizin icin yapabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: Goodbye.
Can you teach me the basics please?
translation: Bana temel bilgileri ögretir misiniz lütfen?

english: Why certainly! You already know a little about creating runes I see.
translation: Elbette! Rün olusturma konusunda zaten biraz bilginiz var gibi görünüyor.

english: You can cast different spells according to what runes you have in your inventory. To begin, you'll need mind runes and air runes. These will allow you to cast Wind Strike like you did in the tutorial.
translation: Envanterinizde bulunan rünlere göre farkli büyüler yapabilirsiniz. Baslamak icin zihin rünleri ve hava rünlerine ihtiyaciniz olacak. Bunlar, ögreticide yaptiginiz gibi Rüzgar Darbesi büyüsünü yapmanizi saglayacaktir.

english: Check the spellbook side-panel to see which spells you can cast. If you have the correct runes for a spell, it will light up.
translation: Hangi büyüler yapabilecegini görmek icin büyü kitabinin yan panelini kontrol et. Bir büyü icin dogru runlara sahipsen, büyü parlayacaktir.

english: Nemarti, the Ranged Combat tutor and I both give out items every 30 minutes, however you must choose whether you want runes or ranged equipment. To claim runes, right-click on me and choose Claim, to claim
translation: Uzaktan Savas ögretmeni Nemarti ve ben her 30 dakikada bir esya dagitiyoruz, ancak runlari mi yoksa uzaktan savas ekipmanini mi istedigini secmelisin. Runlari almak icin bana sag tikla ve Al'i sec, uzaktan savas ekipmanini almak icin

english: ranged equipment right-click on the Ranged Combat tutor and select Claim.
translation: uzaktan savas ögretmenine sag tikla ve Al'i sec.

english: Teach me about making runes.
I see that you've already found out about the Rune Essence mines from my friend Aubury in Varrock. So you need to turn that essence into runes, eh?
translation: Varrock'taki arkadasim Aubury'den Rün Özü madenlerini zaten ögrendigini görüyorum. Yani o özü rünlere dönüstürmen gerekiyor, degil mi?

english: You'll need a mind or air talisman before you can begin. This will enable you to find and use the ruins of the altars.
translation: Baslamadan önce bir zihin veya hava tilsimi almalisin. Bu, sunak kalintilarini bulup kullanmani saglayacaktir.

english: I heard that goblins occasionally drop air talismans when they die - they must be stealing them from somewhere!
translation: Goblinlerin öldüklerinde bazen hava tilsimi düsürdüklerini duydum - bunlari bir yerden caliyor olmalilar!

english: Mind talismans can occasionally be found on imps, if you can kill such a fast-moving creature.
translation: Zihin tilsimlari bazen imp'lerde bulunabilir, tabii bu kadar hizli hareket eden yaratiklari öldürebilirsen.

english: When you have your talisman, right-click on it and select the Locate option. It will point you in the direction of the ruined altar.
translation: Tilsimi aldiginda, üzerine sag tikla ve Bul secenegini sec. Bu, sana yikik sunaklarin yerini gösterecektir.

english: You'll need some Rune Essence with you before you go looking. When you find the ruined altar, use the talisman on it to be transported to a temple where you can craft your runes.
translation: Aramaya cikmadan önce yaninda biraz Rune Essence bulundurmalisin. Yikik sunaklari buldugunda, tilsimi kullanarak runelerini yapabilecegin bir tapinaga ulasabilirsin.

english: You have some mind runes in your bank.
You have some air runes in your bank.
You have some runes in your bank. Climb the stairs in Lumbridge Castle until you see this icon on your minimap. There you will find a bank.
translation: Bankada bazi runeler var. Lumbridge Kalesi'ndeki merdivenleri, mini haritada bu simgeyi görene kadar tirmanin. Orada bir banka bulacaksiniz.

english: You already have some air runes.
If you had enough space in your inventory I'd give you some air runes, come back when you do.
translation: Envanterinde yeterince yer olsaydi sana hava runeleri verirdim, yer acildiginda geri gel.

english: Mikasi gives you 30 air runes.
You already have some mind runes.
If you had enough space in your inventory I'd give you some mind runes, come back when you do.
translation: Envanterinde yeterince yer olsaydi sana zihin runeleri verirdim, yer acildiginda geri gel.

english: Mikasi gives you 30 mind runes.
I work with the Ranged Combat tutor to give out consumable items that you may need for combat such as arrows and runes. However we have had some cheeky people try to take both!
translation: Menzilli Savas ögretmeni ile birlikte calisarak, oklar ve runeler gibi savasta ihtiyac duyabileceginiz tüketim malzemelerini dagitiyoruz. Ancak bazi küstah kisiler ikisini de almaya calisti!

english: So, every half an hour, you may come back and claim either arrows OR runes, but not both. Come back in a while for runes, or simply make your own.
translation: Bu nedenle, her yarim saatte bir geri gelip oklari VEYA runeleri alabilirsiniz, ancak ikisini birden alamazsiniz. Runeler icin bir süre sonra geri gelin veya kendiniz yapin.

english: I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun! Pleased to meet you!
translation: Ben Dorgeshuun'dan Zanik! Tanistigimiza memnun oldum!

english: Greetings Zanik! You look like someone who might know something about spells!
translation: Merhaba Zanik! Büyüler hakkinda bir seyler bilen biri gibi görünüyorsun!

english: Actually I don't know anything about spells.
translation: Aslinda büyüler hakkinda hicbir sey bilmiyorum.

english: Well, if you have some air runes and mind runes you can cast Wind Strike...
translation: Eger hava runeleri ve zihin runeleri varsa, Rüzgar Darbesi büyüsünü yapabilirsin...

english: How?
You can't even cast Wind Strike?
translation: Rüzgar Darbesi büyüsünü bile yapamiyor musun?

english: We Dorgeshuun don't have any magical knowledge at all.
translation: Biz Dorgeshuun'lar büyü hakkinda hicbir sey bilmiyoruz.

english: Well, if you don't know the basics at all it'll take a long time to teach you...
translation: Peki, temel bilgileri hic bilmiyorsan sana ögretmek uzun zaman alacak...

english: Perhaps some other time then.
translation: O zaman baska bir zaman belki.

english: How about you, [player name]? Do you want any help?
translation: Ya sen, Maceraci? Yardim ister misin?

english: Tell me about magic combat please.
translation: Bana büyü savasi hakkinda bilgi ver lütfen.

english: How do I make runes?
Let's discuss how my runes act when I pick them up.
Automatically send to rune pouch.
Place them in my inventory.
Goodbye.
Can you toggle my runes to equip when I pick them up please?
translation: Rünleri aldigimda donatmak icin acip kapatabilir misin lütfen?

english: Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu var. Merhaba, selam, merhaba...

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: Bu yine de tek bir selam sayilir!

english: Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her türlü sey! Kuleler görülmeye deger harika manzaralar sunuyor.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmenizi tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Oh! Please hire me, [sir/madam]! I'm very good, well, I'm not bad, and my fee's only 1000 coins.
translation: Oh! Lütfen beni ise alin, ! Cok iyiyim, yani, fena degilim ve ücretim sadece 1000 sikke.

english: What can you do?
Well, I can, um. I can cook meals and make tea and everything, and I can even take things to and from the bank for you. I won't make any mistakes this time and everything will be fine!
translation: Sey, ben, um. Yemek pisirebilirim, cay yapabilirim ve her seyi yapabilirim, hatta sizin icin bankaya gidip gelebilirim. Bu sefer hata yapmayacagim ve her sey yolunda gidecek!

english: Tell me about your previous jobs.

Oh! Oh! I, well, I, er. It wasn't really my fault, I mean, it was, but not really. I mean, how was I to know that that plate was so valuable? It was just lying around and I don't know art, it just looked like a pretty pattern and
translation: Oh! Oh! Ben, sey, ben, sey. Aslinda benim hatam degildi, yani, benim hatamdi ama aslinda degildi. Yani, o tabakin bu kadar degerli oldugunu nereden bilebilirdim ki? Öylece ortalikta duruyordu ve ben sanattan anlamam, sadece güzel bir desen gibi görünüyordu ve

english: I just had to use it because there weren't enough plates. And no one had told me that Dennis was off sick and hadn't fed the dogs so I wasn't expecting them to jump up at me when I was carrying the food and it, it
translation: yeterli tabak olmadigi icin onu kullanmak zorunda kaldim. Ve kimse bana Dennis'in hasta oldugunu ve köpekleri beslemedigini söylememisti, bu yüzden yemekleri tasirken üzerime atlayacaklarini beklemiyordum ve

english: went all over the place, gravy and potatoes and bits of fine porcelain and I'm so sorry. It won't happen again, I promise.
translation: her yer sos, patates ve ince porselen parcalariyla doldu, cok üzgünüm. Bir daha olmayacak, söz veriyorum.

english: Oh! Oh dear! I'm terribly sorry, [sir/madam], but I'm not allowed to work for anyone unless they have level 25 Construction. If a house is poorly made I might damage it by mistake!
translation: Oh! Oh hayir! Cok üzgünüm, , ama seviye 25 Insaat becerisi olmayanlar icin calismam yasak. Ev kötü yapilmissa, yanlislikla zarar verebilirim!

english: You already have a servant.
You need a second bedroom with a bed for your servant to sleep in.
translation: Hizmetcinizin yatabilecegi ikinci bir yatak odasina ihtiyaciniz var.

english: You're hired... well, I don't have the money on me, but can I owe you? I'm good for it, honest.
translation: Ise alindiniz... Sey, üzerimde para yok, ama size borclanabilir miyim? Ödeyecegim, gercekten.

english: Oh... I'm terribly sorry, [sir/madam], but I'd really prefer to be paid before I start work.
translation: Oh... Cok üzgünüm, , ama calismaya baslamadan önce ödeme almayi tercih ederim.

english: You're hired!
Oh! Oh, thank you [sir/madam], thank you!
What can you do?
Tell me about your previous jobs
You're hired!
Hello.
Who are you?
I'm Mairin, one of the many merfolk here.
translation: Ben Mairin, buradaki bircok deniz insanindan biriyim.

english: Many? I don't see that many...
translation: Bircok mu? Ben o kadar cok görmüyorum...

english: Just because you don't see us, doesn't mean we're not there.
translation: Bizi görmemen, bizim burada olmadigimiz anlamina gelmez.

english: That's kind of creepy. What do you actually do?
translation: Bu biraz ürkütücü. Aslinda ne yapiyorsun?

english: Mostly stop people entering beyond this wreck with those horrid fishbowls.
translation: Cogunlukla, o korkunc akvaryumlarla bu enkazin ötesine giren insanlari durduruyorum.

english: How do I breathe underwater without a helmet.
translation: Kask olmadan su altinda nasil nefes alabilirim?

english: Just find some bubbles, or other sources of air.
translation: Biraz baloncuk ya da baska hava kaynagi bul.

english: Other sources?
Yes, some fish can be a good source of air too..
translation: Evet, bazi baliklar da iyi bir hava kaynagi olabilir...

english: Is there anything I can do to help you?
translation: Sana yardim edebilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Yes! You can collect the tears of my poor trapped sister.
translation: Evet! Zavalli, kapana kisilmis kiz kardesimin gözyaslarini toplayabilirsin.

english: What? Tears? But, they're water, surely underwater they would...
translation: Ne? Gözyaslari mi? Ama onlar su, su altinda kesinlikle...

english: She's a mermaid, like me. Didn't you know our tears are the pearls of the sea? You humans.
translation: O da benim gibi bir denizkizi. Gözyaslarimizin denizin incileri oldugunu bilmiyor muydun? Siz insanlar.

english: Ok, keep your scales on. Where would I find these tears?
translation: Tamam, pullarini cikarma. Bu gözyaslarini nerede bulabilirim?

english: They usually end up secreted in clams or other places.
translation: Genellikle istiridye veya baska yerlerde saklanirlar.

english: What do I get out of it?
Well, I have access to a lot of old stuff that's fallen down under the water, so I'm sure I could reward you in some way.
translation: Su altinda kalmis bircok eski esyaya erisimim var, bu yüzden sana bir sekilde ödül verebilecegime eminim.

english: If you find any special glistening tears, I can teach you some useful Agility and Thieving techniques too. So will you help me?
translation: Özel parildayan gözyaslari bulursan, sana bazi yararli Ceviklik ve Hirsizlik teknikleri de ögretebilirim. Bana yardim edecek misin?

english: Yes, I'll help.
Nah. Not for me.
What have you got to trade?
Bye.
Who are you?
How do I breathe underwater without a helmet
translation: Kask olmadan su altinda nasil nefes alabilirim?

english: Is there anything I can do to help you?
translation: Sana yardim edebilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Yes, I'll help.
Nah. Not for me.
What have you got to trade?
Bye.
You're back! I just had an interesting chat with a group of lesser gods. Seems you dealt a heavy blow to the Devourer and made some powerful new friends in the process.
translation: Geri dönmüssün! Az önce bir grup kücük tanri ile ilginc bir sohbet yaptim. Görünüse göre Devourer'a agir bir darbe indirdin ve bu sürecte bazi güclü yeni arkadaslar edindin.

english: It didn't go perfectly. Amascut still escaped, and she'd already gained a fair amount of power by that point.
translation: Her sey mükemmel gitmedi. Amascut yine de kacti ve o noktada zaten oldukca fazla güc kazanmisti.

english: True, but things could have wound up going a lot worse. You're right though, this is clearly far from over.
translation: Dogru, ama isler cok daha kötüye gidebilirdi. Haklisin, bu isin sonu henüz gelmedi.

english: Where do you think she'll have gone? Menaphos?
translation: Sence nereye gitmis olabilir? Menaphos'a mi?

english: Most likely. She didn't go to all the effort of causing those plagues for nothing. This tomb was clearly only part of her plan.
translation: Büyük olasilikla. O kadar ugrasip o salginlari bosuna yaratmadi. Bu mezar, planinin sadece bir parcasiydi.

english: Still, she'll need to reconsider her strategy after her defeat. We have a little time now.
translation: Yine de, yenilgisinden sonra stratejisini yeniden gözden gecirmesi gerekecek. Su anda biraz zamanimiz var.

english: Hopefully time for the city to reopen again. What will you do in the meantime?
translation: Umarim sehir yeniden acilana kadar. Bu arada sen ne yapacaksin?

english: The lesser gods were under the Devourer's control for a long time, and a lot's changed since they disappeared. I've offered to help them where I can.
translation: Kücük tanrilar uzun süre Yiyici'nin kontrolü altindaydi ve ortadan kaybolduktan sonra cok sey degisti. Elimden geldigince onlara yardim etmeyi teklif ettim.

english: Then I guess this is goodbye for now.
Indeed, but before I go, I have something for you.
translation: Evet, ama gitmeden önce sana bir sey verecegim.

english: Thanks!
Don't mention it. Now, take care of yourself out there.
translation: Önemli degil. Simdi, disarida kendine iyi bak.

english: And you.
Maisa departs.
Hello there! I am known as the Makeover Mage! I have spent many years researching magics that can change your physical appearance!
translation: Merhaba! Ben Makeover Mage olarak bilinirim! Yillardir fiziksel görünüsünüzü degistirebilecek büyüler üzerinde arastirma yapiyorum!

english: I can alter your physical form with my magic, there's no fee. Would you like me to perform my magics upon you?
translation: Büyülerimle fiziksel görünüsünüzü degistirebilirim, ücret almiyorum. Size büyülerimi uygulamami ister misiniz?

english: Tell me more about this 'make-over'.
translation: Bu “makyaj” hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin.

english: Why, of course! Basically, and I will try and explain this so that you will understand it correctly,
translation: Tabii ki! Temel olarak, dogru anlayabilmen icin aciklamaya calisacagim,

english: I use my secret magical technique to melt your body down into a puddle of its elements.
