translation: gizli sihirli teknigimi kullanarak vücudunu eritip birikintisine dönüstürüyorum.

english: When I have broken down all trace of your body, I then rebuild it into the form I am thinking of!
translation: Vücudunun tüm izlerini yok ettikten sonra, onu düsündügüm sekle yeniden insa ediyorum!

english: Or, you know, somewhere vaguely close enough anyway.
translation: Ya da, bilirsin, en azindan ona yakin bir sekle.

english: Uh... that doesn't sound particularly safe to me...
translation: Uh... bu bana pek güvenli gelmiyor...

english: It's as safe as houses! Why, I have only had thirty-six major accidents this month!
translation: Ev kadar güvenli! Bu ay sadece otuz alti büyük kaza gecirdim!

english: So what do you say? Feel like a change? There's no fee.
translation: Ee, ne dersin? Degisiklik ister misin? Ücretsiz.

english: Sure, I'll have a makeover.
Good choice, good choice. You wouldn't want to carry on looking like that, I'm sure!
translation: Iyi secim, iyi secim. Eminim öyle görünmeye devam etmek istemezsin!

english: Woah!
What?
You still look human!
Uh... Thanks, I guess.
Hmm... you didn't feel any unexpected growths anywhere around your head just then did you?
translation: Hmm... Az önce kafanin cevresinde beklenmedik bir büyüme hissetmedin, degil mi?

english: Good, good! I was worried for a second there!
translation: Güzel, güzel! Bir an icin endiselendim!

english: Whew! That was lucky!
What was?
Nothing! It's all fine! You seem alive anyway!
translation: Hicbir sey! Her sey yolunda! Yine de hayatta görünüyorsun!

english: Two arms... two legs... one head... it seems that spell finally worked okay!
translation: Iki kol... iki bacak... bir kafa... Görünüse göre büyü sonunda ise yaradi!

english: Cool amulet! Can I have one?
translation: Güzel tilsim! Ben de bir tane alabilir miyim?

english: No problem, but please remember that the amulet I will sell you is only a copy of my own. It contains no magical powers, and as such will only cost you 100 coins.
translation: Sorun degil, ama lütfen sana satacagim tilsimin sadece benimkinin bir kopyasi oldugunu unutma. Hicbir sihirli güc icermiyor ve bu nedenle size sadece 100 sikkeye mal olacak.

english: Oh, I don't have enough money for that.
translation: Oh, bunun icin yeterli param yok.

english: Anyway, would you like me to alter your physical form? For you, I'll do it for free!
translation: Her neyse, fiziksel formunuzu degistirmemi ister misiniz? Senin icin bunu bedavaya yaparim!

english: No way! That's far too expensive.
That's fair enough, my jewellery is not to everyone's taste.
translation: Bu yeterince adil, mücevherlerim herkesin zevkine göre degil.

english: Sure, here you go.
I don't have room to hold it. Maybe another time.
translation: Onu tutacak yerim yok. Belki baska zaman.

english: No thanks.
Ehhh... suit yourself.
Ahah!
Ooh!
Tell me more about this 'make-over'.
translation: Bana bu ‘makyaj’ hakkinda daha fazla bilgi ver.

english: Sure, I'll have a makeover.
Cool amulet! Can I have one?
translation: Güzel tilsim! Ben de bir tane alabilir miyim?

english: Sure, here you go.
No way! That's far too expensive.
translation: Olmaz öyle sey! Bu cok pahali.

english: No thanks.
Be lucky I have let you live, meat. Our deal is done, I wish no further dealing with you.
translation: Yasamana izin verdigim icin sanslisin, et. Anlasmamiz bitti, seninle daha fazla ugrasmak istemiyorum.

english: M-my lord Malak, what brings you here?
translation: Lordum Malak, sizi buraya getiren nedir?

english: Hmmm? You know very well that your tithe is due, Roavar.
translation: Hmmm? Ondalik vermen gerektigini cok iyi biliyorsun, Roavar.

english: I am here to collect it this time.
translation: Bu sefer onu almak icin buradayim.

english: Y-yes of course, sire, but surely your graciousness is too important to perform such menial duties such as this himself?
translation: Evet, elbette efendim, ama zat-i aliniz bu gibi önemsiz görevleri bizzat yerine getiremeyecek kadar önemli degil mi?

english: Is this not Gadderanks job, your most high beneficence?
translation: Bu Gadderanks'in isi degil mi, yüce lütfunuz?

english: Indeed it is Roavar, but I cannot find that incompetent fool. And assuming you are not the one who wishes to tell Lord Drakan that his tithe has not been collected, I saw
translation: Gercekten de öyle Roavar, ama o beceriksiz aptali bulamiyorum. Lord Drakan'a ösrünün tahsil edilmedigini söylemek isteyenin siz olmadiginizi varsayarak,

english: fit to take on the duty myself this time.
translation: bu görevi bu kez kendim üstlenmeyi uygun gördüm.

english: Of course my lord, I meant no disrespect.
So you have the tithe ready for me?
translation: Yani ösrü benim icin hazirladiniz mi?

english: Of course my lord, I trust you will find it all there and in good order.
translation: Elbette lordum, hepsini orada ve iyi bir düzende bulacaginiza inaniyorum.

english: Hmmm. Well, for your sake you had better hope that indeed it is.
translation: Hmmm. Kendi iyiliginiz icin gercekten öyle olmasini umsaniz iyi olur.

english: The mood I am in for having to come to this wolfen cesspit means any shortfall is coming from you directly.
translation: Bu kurt lagimina gelmek zorunda kaldigim icin icinde bulundugum ruh hali, herhangi bir eksikligin dogrudan sizden kaynaklandigi anlamina geliyor.

english: Then again... perhaps this was not a total waste of my time after all.
translation: Sonra tekrar... belki de bu tamamen zaman kaybi degildi.

english: You there!
M-me?
Yes, you. Your bearing suggests you are not one of the usual peasants, and your stench suggests you are not one of these filthy wolfen folk.
translation: Evet, sen. Durusun her zamanki köylülerden biri olmadigini, kokun da bu pis kurt adamlardan biri olmadigini gösteriyor.

english: Come here, I would like to know what you are doing in these lands.
translation: Buraya gel, bu topraklarda ne aradigini bilmek istiyorum.

english: A human, eh? Don't think that silly little ring of yours will fool me. Give me one good reason why I should not just take you to Lord Drakan now.
translation: Bir insan, ha? O kücük aptal yüzügünün beni kandiracagini sanma. Seni Lord Drakan'a götürmemem icin bana iyi bir sebep söyle.

english: A human, eh? Give me one good reason why I should not just take you to Lord Drakan now.
translation: Bir insan, ha? Seni Lord Drakan'a götürmemem icin bana iyi bir sebep söyle.

english: You had better make it a good one too, or you will not survive the night, I'll wager.
translation: Iyi bir sebep olsa iyi olur, yoksa bu gece hayatta kalamazsin, bahse girerim.

english: I am here to worship the almighty Zamorak! Yay! Go Zamorak!
translation: Yüce Zamorak'a tapinmak icin buradayim! Yasasin! Bastir Zamorak!

english: I see. You are a moron. You have probably settled right in with the rest of the idiots in this pathetic excuse for a village.
translation: Anliyorum. Sen bir moronsun. Muhtemelen bu zavalli köydeki diger aptallarin arasina karismissindir.

english: Unfortunately for you, that is not a good enough reason to explain your presence here.
translation: Ne yazik ki senin icin bu, buradaki varligini aciklamak icin yeterli bir sebep degil.

english: Now tell me the reason for your coming here, or I will ensure you suffer a horrible fate indeed.
translation: Simdi bana buraya gelis nedenini söyle, yoksa gercekten korkunc bir kadere maruz kalmani saglayacagim.

english: I am here only to serve the mighty Drakan. Yup, Drakan, he's the man.
translation: Buraya sadece kudretli Drakan'a hizmet etmek icin geldim. Evet, Drakan, adamimiz o.

english: I see. I would perhaps be more inclined to believe you if I could not smell the death blood of his brother Draynor upon you.
translation: Anliyorum. Kardesi Draynor'un ölüm kaninin kokusunu almasaydim belki de sana inanmaya daha meyilli olurdum.

english: What are your real intentions here?
Really? That is interesting, that you would want to give your life by trespassing in this land for such an unbelievable reason.
translation: Gercekten mi? Böyle inanilmaz bir sebep icin bu topraklara izinsiz girerek canini vermek istemen cok ilginc.

english: Now speak, what is your purpose in coming here?
translation: Simdi konus, buraya gelme amacin nedir?

english: I came here looking for you, oh mighty Malak, so that I might serve your glory!
translation: Buraya seni aramaya geldim, ey kudretli Malak, sanina hizmet edebilmek icin!

english: Please. Do not think that I am so vain and foolish as to allow you to avoid my question with such obvious sycophancy.
translation: Lütfen. Sorumu böylesine bariz bir dalkavuklukla gecistirmene izin verecek kadar kibirli ve aptal oldugumu düsünme.

english: Now tell me the reason behind your being here, or I will ensure that you suffer.
translation: Simdi bana burada bulunma sebebini söyle, yoksa aci cekmeni saglarim.

english: I am here to kill Lord Drakan, and every stinking one of his vampyre brood!
translation: Lord Drakan'i ve onun kokusmus vampir yavrularinin her birini öldürmek icin buradayim!

english: Hah! Most entertaining, human!
Now tell me the reason you are here, or we shall soon see who will be killing whom.
translation: Simdi bana burada olma sebebini söyle, yoksa yakinda kimin kimi öldürecegini görecegiz.

english: I am here looking for a special diamond... I have reason to believe it is somewhere in this vicinity, and it is probably in the possession of a warrior of Zamorak.
translation: Buraya özel bir elmasi aramaya geldim. Bu civarda bir yerde olduguna ve muhtemelen Zamorak'tan bir savascinin elinde olduguna inanmak icin sebeplerim var.

english: I'm fairly sure it will have some kind of magical aura or something too. I don't suppose you've seen it, or know where it might be?
translation: Bir cesit büyülü auraya sahip oldugundan da oldukca eminim. Onu gördügünüzü ya da nerede olabilecegini bildiginizi sanmiyorum.

english: Interesting... Well perhaps we can come to a little... arrangement, human.
translation: Ilginc. Belki kücük bir anlasmaya varabiliriz, insan.

english: I may have information that may assist you, but you in turn will have to do something for me. What do you say? Do you think we could come to some form of
translation: Sana yardimci olabilecek bilgilere sahip olabilirim, ama karsiliginda senin de benim icin bir seyler yapman gerekecek. Ne dersin? Sence bir cesit

english: agreement?
Well, what kind of something? No offence, but you're not exactly the trustworthy type...
translation: Ne tür bir sey? Alinma ama pek güvenilir bir tip degilsin.

english: Ah, you have a healthy sense of paranoia, I see. It is not a particularly unfair request on my part...
translation: Gördügüm kadariyla saglikli bir paranoya anlayisiniz var. Bu benim acimdan haksiz bir istek degil.

english: All I ask is that you ensure that the current owner of the diamond is killed. For my part, I will let you know his whereabouts, and how exactly to kill him.
translation: Tek istedigim elmasin su anki sahibinin öldürüldügünden emin olman. Kendi adima, nerede oldugunu ve onu tam olarak nasil öldüreceginizi size bildirecegim.

english: When he is dead, you may take the diamond from his corpse and do with it what you will. I have no interest in such baubles.
translation: Öldügünde, cesedinden elmasi alabilir ve onunla istedigini yapabilirsin. Böyle mücevherlerle ilgilenmiyorum.

english: So what say you? A life for a diamond. As a mark of good faith, I will give you some information free:
translation: Ne diyorsun peki? Bir elmas icin bir hayat. Iyi niyet göstergesi olarak, size bazi bilgileri bedava verecegim:

english: The current owner of this diamond is named Dessous.
translation: Bu elmasin su anki sahibinin adi Dessous.

english: I don't trust you, or anything you say. I'm afraid I have to decline.
translation: Sana ya da söyledigin hicbir seye güvenmiyorum. Korkarim ki reddetmek zorundayim.

english: As you wish human. I doubt anybody near here knows of the diamond you seek, however.
translation: Nasil istersen insan. Ancak buralarda aradiginiz elmasi bilen birileri oldugundan süpheliyim.

english: If you wish to claim it as your own, you have little choice but to accept my bargain. I will wait here until such time as you change your mind.
translation: Eger kendinin oldugunu iddia etmek istiyorsan, pazarligimi kabul etmekten baska secenegin yok. Fikrinizi degistirene kadar burada bekleyecegim.

english: Well... I can't see any drawback. Okay, I accept your offer. Now tell me what you know.
translation: Sey... Herhangi bir sakinca göremiyorum. Tamam, teklifini kabul ediyorum. Simdi bana ne bildigini söyle.

english: What I know? Hah! After you have been alive for as long as I, the things I know are enough to fill a library.
translation: Ne mi biliyorum? Hah! Benim kadar uzun süre hayatta kaldiktan sonra, bildiklerim bir kütüphaneyi doldurmaya yeter.

english: I'm afraid you will need to be a little more specific.
translation: Korkarim biraz daha spesifik olmaniz gerekecek.

english: I don't see exactly how this bargain benefits you... Why exactly do you want Dessous killed anyway?
translation: Bu pazarligin sana ne faydasi var anlamiyorum. Dessous'un öldürülmesini tam olarak neden istiyorsun?

english: That is an impertinent question to demand from myself.
translation: Bu kendimden talep ettigim küstahca bir soru.

english: However, if it will help seal our deal, I will let you know some of the details.
translation: Ancak, anlasmamizi saglamlastirmaya yardimci olacaksa, bazi detaylari size bildirecegim.

english: As you may or may not know, myself and my blood kin are the rulers of this land, all serving under Lord Drakan. However, we tend not to die of old age or similar
translation: Bildiginiz ya da bilmediginiz üzere, ben ve kan bagim bu topraklarin yöneticileriyiz ve hepsi de Lord Drakan'a hizmet ediyor. Bununla birlikte, yasliliktan ya da benzeri

english: natural causes, which means that to gain another Lords title or land, there often need to be...
translation: dogal nedenlerden ölme egiliminde degiliz, bu da baska bir Lord unvani ya da toprak kazanmak icin genellikle...

english: Unnatural causes of death involved. Let us just say, that Dessous is in control of some land that I myself would like some say in, and that it is not in my interest to be seen to be responsible for the
translation: Dogal olmayan ölüm nedenleri söz konusu. Diyelim ki Dessous benim de söz sahibi olmak istedigim bazi topraklarin kontrolünü elinde tutuyor ve bir Lord'un ölümünden

english: death of a fellow Lord.
It would however be extremely advantageous to myself should some random human adventurer take it upon themself to remove this rival for me... Do you understand?
translation: Bununla birlikte, rastgele bir insan maceraperestin bu rakibi benim icin ortadan kaldirmayi kendine görev edinmesi benim icin son derece avantajli olacaktir... Anliyor musunuz?

english: Yes... I think so...
Good, we understand each other then. We will both benefit from the death of Dessous.
translation: Güzel, o zaman birbirimizi anliyoruz. Dessous'un ölümünden ikimiz de faydalanacagiz.

english: Where can I find this Dessous?
He currently resides in a graveyard to the South-East of here. You will not be able to move the gravestone which he lies beneath however, you will need to find some way to
translation: Su anda buranin güneydogusundaki bir mezarlikta ikamet ediyor. Altinda yattigi mezar tasini yerinden oynatamazsiniz, ancak

english: lure him out from his tomb.
translation: onu mezarindan cikarmanin bir yolunu bulmaniz gerekecek.

english: And how exactly would I go about doing that?
translation: Peki bunu tam olarak nasil yapacagim?

english: Well, he is a vampyre, so fresh blood would almost certainly entice him out.
translation: O bir vampir, bu yüzden taze kan onu kesinlikle disari cekecektir.

english: However, even though he is a frail and decrepit example of our species, he will be able to kill a weakling human such as yourself extremely easily. Having him in a bloodlust as he does so, will not make
translation: Bununla birlikte, türümüzün zayif ve yipranmis bir örnegi olmasina ragmen, sizin gibi zayif bir insani son derece kolay bir sekilde öldürebilir. Bunu yaparken kana susamis olmasi

english: your job any easier.
So what advice can you give me on killing Dessous?
translation: Peki Dessous'u öldürmem icin bana ne tavsiye edebilirsin?

english: As ancient and weak as Dessous is, he is still more than a match for the likes of you.
translation: Dessous ne kadar yasli ve zayif olursa olsun, yine de sizin gibilerle boy ölcüsemez.

english: That is, assuming you were to fight him fairly.
translation: Tabii onunla adil bir sekilde dövüsecegini varsayarsak.

english: My proposal would be for you to even the odds up a little bit...
translation: Benim önerim olasiliklari biraz daha esitlemen.

english: How would I go about doing that?
Well, my plan would be as follows. First, take a silver bar to the man living in the sewers in Draynor. He was an assistant to Count Draynor in some of his...
translation: Planim su sekilde olacak. Ilk olarak, Draynor'daki kanalizasyonda yasayan adama gümüs bir cubuk götür. Yillar önce Kont Draynor'un bazi...

english: more interesting experiments many years past. Tell him you need a sacrificial offering pot. He will know what you speak of, it is a unique type of container used in various ancient vampiric ceremonies.
translation: daha ilginc deneylerinde yardimcisiydi. Ona bir kurban kabina ihtiyacin oldugunu söyle. Neden bahsettiginizi bilecektir, cesitli eski vampir törenlerinde kullanilan benzersiz bir kap türüdür.

english: Then take that pot to Entrana, and get it blessed by the Head Monk. This will lend the pot some holy power.
translation: Sonra o kabi Entrana'ya götürün ve Bas Kesis tarafindan kutsanmasini saglayin. Bu cömlege kutsal bir güc katacaktir.

english: If you then bring that silver pot back to me, I will provide you with some fresh blood, to put into it. To that pot of blood, you will add some crushed garlic, and some spice to disguise the smell.
translation: Eger o gümüs kabi bana geri getirirsen, icine koyman icin sana biraz taze kan verecegim. O kan kabina biraz ezilmis sarimsak ve kokusunu gizlemek icin biraz baharat ekleyeceksin.

english: Use that pot of blood upon Dessous' tomb, and he will be unable to resist rising and drinking from it.
translation: Bu kan kabini Dessous'un mezarinda kullan, o da kalkip kan kabindan icmeye karsi koyamayacaktir.

english: The combination of garlic, silver, and blessings from Saradomin will act upon him as a poison, and allow you to kill him.
translation: Sarimsak, gümüs ve Saradomin'in kutsamalarinin birlesimi ona zehir gibi etki edecek ve onu öldürmenizi saglayacaktir.

english: This is just my suggestion of course, you may ignore it if you wish, although I offer no guarantees of your ability to defeat him otherwise.
translation: Elbette bu sadece benim önerim, dilerseniz göz ardi edebilirsiniz, ancak baska türlü onu yenebileceginize dair hicbir garanti vermiyorum.

english: Was there anything else you wanted?
translation: Istediginiz baska bir sey var miydi?

english: Never mind, I will figure out all I need to know by myself.
translation: Bos ver, bilmem gereken her seyi kendi basima cözecegim.

english: As you wish. Come and see me when you have managed to kill Dessous.
translation: Nasil isterseniz. Dessous'u öldürmeyi basardiginda gel ve beni gör.

english: I found Ruantun in Draynorssewers. He made me this pot, now where can I get some fresh blood to fill it with?
translation: Ruantun'u Draynorssewers'da buldum. Bana bu cömlegi yapti, simdi onu doldurmak icin nereden taze kan bulabilirim?

english: Malak bites the player, dealing light non-lethal damage.
translation: Malak oyuncuyu isirir ve ölümcül olmayan hafif bir hasar verir.

english: Ow!
There you go.As fresh as it gets.
Thanks for nothing.
Come and speak to me again when you have managed to kill Dessous.
translation: Dessous'u öldürmeyi basardiginda gel ve benimle tekrar konus.

english: Why are you still here?I notice Dessous still lives.
translation: Neden hala buradasin? Dessous'un hala yasadigini fark ettim.

english: Ah, the wandering hero returns! I take it you have dispatched poor old Dessous for me?
translation: Ah, gezgin kahraman geri döndü! Anladigim kadariyla zavalli Dessous'u benim icin göndermissin.

english: Quit playing games with me, Malak. I want that diamond, and I want it now!
translation: Benimle oyun oynamayi birak, Malak. O elmasi istiyorum ve hemen istiyorum!

english: Do not take that tone of voice with me, meat. You should be thankful I have allowed you your life.
translation: Benimle bu ses tonuyla konusma, et. Sana hayatini bagisladigim icin minnettar olmalisin.

english: Here, take your precious little bauble.

I will take that silver pot from you as well, humans are not meant to possess such artefacts. Now get out of my sight, our deal is complete, and if I see you here again I will not hesitate to take you to
translation: O gümüs kabi da senden alacagim, insanlar böyle eserlere sahip olmak icin yaratilmamistir. Simdi gözümün önünden kaybol, anlasmamiz tamamlandi ve seni bir daha burada görürsem

english: Lord Drakan.
He will be extremely pleased to meet the murderer of poor Dessous, I suspect.
translation: Zavalli Dessous'un katiliyle tanistigina cok memnun olacak sanirim.

english: I am here to worship Zamorak
I am here to praise Lord Drakan
I am here to worship you, oh mighty Malak
translation: Sana tapinmak icin buradayim, ey yüce Malak

english: I am here to kill Lord Drakan
I am looking for a special Diamond...
No
Yes
Why do you want Dessous dead?
Where can I find Dessous?
How can I kill Dessous?
Actually, I don't need to know anything.
translation: Aslinda, hicbir sey bilmeme gerek yok.

english: Your animals don't look too healthy.
It's that fountain thingy in the temple to the east. It's turned them all into zombies.
translation: Dogudaki tapinakta bir cesme var. Hepsini zombiye cevirdi.

english: What use are zombie animals?
translation: Zombi hayvanlar ne ise yarar ki?

english: None at all, mate, except that those worshippers at that temple keep comin' and killin' 'em all for their bones. Don't ask me why.
translation: Tapinaktaki ibadet edenlerin gelip kemikleri icin hepsini öldürmeleri disinda hicbir ise yaramazlar dostum. Bana nedenini sorma.

english: But you're a ghost - surely you know something about it.
translation: Ama sen bir hayaletsin, bu konuda bir seyler biliyorsundur.

english: I don't know nuthin' about nuthin'. Oim a simple ghost with simple needs. All I know is, years ago, that temple started glowing green and, a few months later, I woke up dead. That's all there is to it.
translation: Hicbir sey hakkinda hicbir sey bilmiyorum. Basit ihtiyaclari olan basit bir hayaletim. Tek bildigim, yillar önce o tapinagin yesil renkte parlamaya basladigi ve birkac ay sonra ölü olarak uyandigim. Hepsi bu kadar.

english: Hey leave me alone, can't you see that I'm busy?
translation: Beni rahat birak, mesgul oldugumu görmüyor musun?

english: Oohh, my arms.
Work, work, work, that's all I ever do.
translation: Calis, calis, calis, tek yaptigim bu.

english: I feel so weak, I could faint.
I'm so tired, I could sleep standing up.
What I wouldn't give for a good night's rest.
translation: Iyi bir gece uykusu icin neler vermezdim.

english: Ooh, my back.
I'm rich in experience, poor in wealth.
translation: Tecrübe bakimindan zenginim, zenginlik bakimindan fakirim.

english: I can't think straight I'm so tired.
I'm sick of this place.
Beware the rowdies, they're spoiling for a fight.
translation: Kabadayilara dikkat et, kavga icin simariyorlar.

english: One day I'm gonna get out of here.
I need a new pick axe.
Work, work work, that's all I ever do!
translation: Calis, calis, calis, tek yaptigim bu!

english: Good luck to ya, you're gonna need it.
translation: Sana iyi sanslar, buna ihtiyacin olacak.

english: So, [player name], your curiosity leads you to speak to me?
translation: Ee, Maceraci, merakin seni benimle konusmaya mi yönlendirdi?

english: About those enchanted secateurs again...
translation: Yine su büyülü budama makasi hakkinda.

english: What now, [player name], can't you just leave me alone to practice my art?
translation: Simdi ne var, Maceraci, sanatimi icra etmem icin beni yalniz birakamaz misin?

english: Can I get another set of enchanted secateurs?
translation: Baska bir büyülü budama makasi seti alabilir miyim?

english: Well I guess it's your lucky day! Since your last visit I've been thinking, I never use my enchanted secateurs anymore, I could sell them to you, if you like.
translation: Sanirim bugün sansli günün! Son ziyaretinizden beri düsünüyordum da, büyülü budama makaslarimi artik hic kullanmiyorum, isterseniz onlari size satabilirim.

english: That's great!
How much would they cost?
I could let you have them for a mere 40,000 gp.
40,000! That's outrageous!
Well, that's my price. If you change your mind, you can come back and talk to me. Good day.
translation: Benim fiyatim bu. Fikrini degistirirsen, geri gelip benimle konusabilirsin. Iyi günler.

english: That's too expensive for me I'm afraid.
translation: Korkarim bu benim icin cok pahali.

english: Ok, great.
A pleasure doing business with you, [player name].
translation: Sizinle is yapmak bir zevkti, Maceraci.

english: You don't have room to hold them. Stop wasting my time.
translation: Onlari tutacak yeriniz yok. Vaktimi bosa harcamayi birak.

english: You don't have 40,000 gp with you! Do you take me for a fool?
translation: Yaninda 40,000 gp yok! Beni aptal mi saniyorsun?

english: Sorry, I didn't realise. I'll have to visit a bank.
translation: Üzgünüm, fark etmedim. Bir bankaya gitmem gerekecek.

english: Fine, I might see you later then.
Sorry to have bothered you.
That's ok, I shouldn't have been so abrupt with you.
translation: Sorun degil, sana karsi bu kadar kaba olmamaliydim.

english: Could you spare me a brown apron?
translation: Bana kahverengi bir önlük verebilir misiniz?

english: Oh, if you must.
Can I have some more bone seeds?
translation: Biraz daha kemik tohumu alabilir miyim?

english: You fetch me a pot with a lid first.
translation: Önce bana kapakli bir tencere getir.

english: Fortunately I do have another pot with a lid.
translation: Neyse ki kapakli baska bir tencerem var.

english: Yes, yes, have fun with them!
Who are you and what are you doing here?
translation: Sen kimsin ve burada ne yapiyorsun?

english: I am the great Malignius Mortifer, wielder of strange and terrible powers. These lowly followers of mine are dedicated students of the magical arts. Their business is to follow me and learn all they can.
translation: Ben büyük Malignius Mortifer, garip ve korkunc güclerin sahibiyim. Bu alcakgönüllü takipcilerim kendilerini büyü sanatlarina adamis ögrencilerdir. Isleri beni takip etmek ve ögrenebilecekleri her seyi ögrenmek.

english: They don't look very tough.
You may believe that, but even if you strike one down, another will rise up within minutes.
translation: Buna inanabilirsin, ama birini yere indirsen bile, birkac dakika icinde bir baskasi ortaya cikacaktir.

english: Yeah, right.
Each of my followers is a master of his chosen element. His life becomes bound to that element in a way you could not hope to understand.
translation: Takipcilerimin her biri sectigi elementin ustasidir. Hayati, anlamayi umamayacaginiz bir sekilde o elemente bagli hale gelir.

english: And what do you do?
I am mastering a branch of magic that few dare to attempt: Necromancy! The fools in the Guild of Wizards shun anyone who practices this art, but there are a few in this land who know the rudiments.
translation: Cok az kisinin denemeye cesaret ettigi bir büyü dalinda ustalasiyorum: Ölü cagirma! Büyücüler Loncasi'ndaki aptallar bu sanati uygulayan herkesten uzak dururlar ama bu topraklarda temellerini bilen cok az kisi vardir.

english: Grayzag, Invrigar, Sithik... Even Melzar studied the methods of necromancy, until an accident affected his mind. Now his spells tend to result in...
translation: Grayzag, Invrigar, Sithik. Melzar bile bir kaza zihnini etkileyene kadar büyücülük yöntemleri üzerine calismisti. Simdi yaptigi büyüler...

english: ... well, let us simply say that he does NOT raise armies of undead minions.
translation: ... basitce söyleyelim, ölümsüz kölelerden olusan ordular KURMUYOR.

english: Is this like Summoning? Can you teach me?
translation: Bu cagirma gibi bir sey mi? Bana ögretebilir misin?

english: The obscure magical art of necromancy has nothing to do with Summoning.
translation: Karanlik büyücülük sanatinin Cagirma ile hicbir ilgisi yoktur.

english: Through necromancy, I may resurrect the bodies of those who have fallen, and bend them to my will, and even command them to tell me hidden knowledge.
translation: Ölü cagirma yoluyla, ölenlerin bedenlerini diriltebilir, onlari istedigim gibi yönlendirebilir ve hatta bana gizli bilgileri anlatmalarini emredebilirim.

english: I shall not pass on my secrets lightly to any passer-by!
translation: Sirlarimi yoldan gecen hic kimseye kolay kolay vermeyecegim!

english: Even a mighty hero like me?
translation: Benim gibi güclü bir kahramana bile mi?

english: Perhaps one day you shall learn ways to summon creatures to your side, but my own work is of a different sort.
translation: Belki bir gün yaratiklari kendi tarafina cekmenin yollarini ögrenirsin ama benim isim farkli.

english: What happened to Melzar?
The forces required to wield power over the dead are very difficult to control. Melzar's concentration slipped, and his spell rebounded upon him.
translation: Ölüler üzerinde güc kullanmak icin gereken gücleri kontrol etmek cok zordur. Melzar'in konsantrasyonu bozuldu ve büyü ona geri döndü.

english: Although he did not die, his mind broke. Now he dwells amidst the beasts that fill his strange home, and when he attempts to do magic he gets... amusing results.
translation: Ölmemesine ragmen zihni bozuldu. Simdi garip evini dolduran canavarlarin arasinda yasiyor ve büyü yapmaya calistiginda... eglenceli r

english: Why do you keep making fungi appear?
translation: Neden mantarlari ortaya cikarmaya devam ediyorsun?

english: Necromancy is... still not fully understood. So few people dare to study it. Although my spells usually raise whichever undead creature I desire, they sometimes misfire. As Melzar has learnt!
translation: Ölü cagirma... hala tam olarak anlasilabilmis degil. Bu yüzden cok az insan onu incelemeye cesaret ediyor. Büyülerim genellikle istedigim ölümsüz yaratigi diriltiyor olsa da, bazen tekliyor. Melzar'in ögrendigi gibi!

english: Thanks, I'll be off now.
I am sure your curiosity will eventually draw you to speak to me again, [player name].
translation: Eminim merakiniz sizi eninde sonunda benimle tekrar konusmaya cekecektir, Maceraci.

english: Can you teach me something about magic?
translation: Bana büyü hakkinda bir seyler ögretebilir misin?

english: Ah, you are an inquisitive fellow. I shall speak of the great Wizards' Tower, destroyed by fire many years ago...
translation: Ah, merakli bir adamsin. Yillar önce yanginla yok olan büyük Büyücü Kulesi'nden bahsedecegim.

english: Many say it was the greatest building in the history of Gielinor, a magnificent monument to human ingenuity.
translation: Bircoklari onun Gielinor tarihindeki en büyük bina, insan yaraticiliginin muhtesem bir aniti oldugunu söyler.

english: Yet when humans are offered great power, they so often buy it at the cost of their principles.
translation: Yine de insanlara büyük bir güc sunuldugunda, cogu zaman bunu ilkeleri pahasina satin alirlar.

english: Wizards who claimed allegiance to Saradomin began to insist that magic be restricted to the few they deemed 'worthy' of such powers.
translation: Saradomin'e bagliliklarini iddia eden büyücüler, büyünün bu tür güclere ‘layik’ gördükleri birkac kisiyle sinirlandirilmasi konusunda israr etmeye basladilar.

english: Before long, those who did not share their fatuous obsession with Saradomin were excluded from the Tower completely. This state of affairs could not continue.
translation: Cok gecmeden, onlarin Saradomin'e olan sacma saplantilarini paylasmayanlar Kule'den tamamen dislandi. Bu durum böyle devam edemezdi.

english: One dark night, a brave band of magi loyal to the great Lord Zamorak stormed the Tower. Despite heavy losses, they fought their way up the levels until they reached the Great Library.
translation: Karanlik bir gecede, yüce Lord Zamorak'a sadik cesur bir büyücü grubu Kule'ye saldirdi. Agir kayiplar vermelerine ragmen, Büyük Kütüphane'ye ulasana kadar katlari tirmanmak icin savastilar.

english: Alas, they were trapped and could not steal the precious records. But before they could be defeated, the bravest of them took it upon himself to blast the writings into nothingness, destroying the library.
translation: Ne yazik ki kapana kisilmislardi ve degerli kayitlari calamadilar. Fakat yenilmelerine firsat kalmadan, iclerinden en cesur olani yazilari patlatarak kütüphaneyi yok etmeyi kendine görev edindi.

english: The ensuing fire raced through the tower, and none escaped its fury. Some say that Lord Zamorak himself fanned the flames to ensure the destruction of his enemies!
translation: Ardindan cikan yangin kuleyi sarmis ve kimse alevlerden kacamamis. Bazilari Lord Zamorak'in düsmanlarinin yok olmasini saglamak icin alevleri bizzat körükledigini söyler!

english: Much of that knowledge was lost, and some has never yet been rediscovered. Still, your efforts on behalf of my colleagues have not been wasted! Once again, the forces of Zamorak can create unlimited runestones!
translation: Bu bilginin cogu kayboldu ve bir kismi da henüz yeniden kesfedilmedi. Yine de, meslektaslarim adina gösterdiginiz cabalar bosa gitmedi! Zamorak'in gücleri bir kez daha sinirsiz rün tasi yaratabilir!

english: May the world cower in its boots!
I see...
I bid you farewell for now.
About those skeletal magi in the Colony - why don't they disappear now the Colony's safe?
translation: Koloni'deki iskelet büyücüler hakkinda - Koloni güvende olduguna göre neden ortadan kaybolmuyorlar?

english: HAHAHA! I never specified how long they'd stay there!
translation: HAHAHA! Orada ne kadar kalacaklarini hic belirtmedim!

english: So when will they go away? They're in the dormitories, and that's a real nuisance for the colonists!
translation: Peki ne zaman gidecekler? Yatakhanelerdeler ve bu koloniciler icin gercek bir bas belasi!

english: HAHAHA!
So you're not going to get rid of them?
Oh, forget I asked.
Where can I get clothes like those?
Bah! Our garments are an outward sign of our dominance of the magical arts. You cannot simply buy them in a shop!
translation: Bah! Giysilerimiz büyü sanatlarindaki hakimiyetimizin disa vurumudur. Onlari öylece bir dükkandan satin alamazsin!

english: What happens if I kill you and take them?
translation: Seni öldürüp onlari alirsam ne olur?

english: Try it and see!
How about if you teach me enough about magic so I can wear those clothes too?
translation: O kiyafetleri giyebilmem icin bana büyü ögretmeye ne dersin?

english: How about if I turn you into a mushroom to make you stop bothering me?
translation: Beni rahatsiz etmeyi birakman icin seni bir mantara dönüstürmeme ne dersin?

english: MMMmmph!
Actually, I don't want to talk to you.
You should take that pot a bit further away from me before you open it!
translation: O tencereyi acmadan önce benden biraz daha uzaga götürmelisin!

english: Da mihi potentiam!
Veni, cohortes malefici!
Curses - more fungi!
Blast - fungi again!
DUUUHHH
OooOOOooooOOOOooo
Krrrrsssss
Krrrrsssss
Oi - stop waving your items at me!
About those enchanted secateurs again...
Can I get another set of enchanted secateurs?
translation: Bir set daha büyülü budama makasi alabilir miyim?

english: 40,000! That's outrageous!
That's too expensive for me I'm afraid.
Ok, great.
Sorry to have bothered you.
Could you spare me a brown apron?
translation: Bana kahverengi bir önlük verebilir misiniz?

english: Can I have some more bone seeds?
translation: Biraz daha kemik tohumu alabilir miyim?

english: ... MORE ...
Who are you and what are you doing here?
translation: Sen kimsin ve burada ne yapiyorsun?

english: Is this like Summoning?
translation: Cagirma gibi bir sey mi bu?

english: What happened to Melzar?
Why do you keep making fungi appear?
Thanks, I'll be off now.
Can you teach me something about magic?
translation: Bana büyü hakkinda bir seyler ögretebilir misin?

english: About those skeletal magi in the Colony...
Where can I get clothes like those?
Hello!
Arr? Be ye wantin' te go on account with our gang o' fillibusters?
translation: Arr? Fillibusters cetemizle hesaplasmaya gitmek ister misin?

english: The powder monkey be takin' a caulk after gettin' rowdy on bumboo, so there be plenty of room for ye.
translation: Toz maymunu bumboo'da kabadayilik yaptiktan sonra bir kalafat aliyor, bu yüzden sizin icin bolca yer var.

english: Riiiiight...
I'll just be over here if you need me.
Hello stranger, you come for a drink?
translation: Merhaba yabanci, bir seyler icmeye mi geldin?

english: What sort of drinks do you have?
We got some cold beers, some warm stews and some 'rum'.
translation: Soguk biralarimiz, sicak yahnilerimiz ve romumuz var.

english: Not, Captain Braindeath's 'rum'?
Yes! There was some sorta problem at the brewery, but they got it all sorted out now.
translation: Evet! Bira fabrikasinda bir sorun vardi ama simdi hallettiler.

english: You wanna buy something?
What do you do here?
I's been cooking up some roasted spiders....I can show you how to make 'em if you like?
translation: Kizarmis örümcek pisiriyorum.... Istersen nasil yapildigini gösterebilirim.

english: Errrr..yuck, roasted spiders, that sounds gross!
translation: Igrenc, kizarmis örümcek, kulaga igrenc geliyor!

english: Well, you can suit yourself my friend, but I have to tell you they're delicious!
translation: Sen bilirsin dostum, ama cok lezzetli olduklarini söylemeliyim!

english: Mmmm, mmm, mmmmmm!
Hmm, I guess it could be considered a delicacy, so yes please?
translation: Hmm, sanirim bu bir lezzet olarak kabul edilebilir, yani evet lütfen?

english: Ok my friend, you simply need to get a suitable stick to skewer the spider carcass on and then roast it on a fire!
translation: Tamam dostum, örümcek gövdesini sislemek icin uygun bir sopa bulman ve sonra ateste kizartman gerekiyor!

english: What sort of stick and where would I get one?
translation: Ne tür bir cubuk ve nereden bulabilirim?

english: Well, I prefer to use a skewer stick, you can make one from a thatching spar using a machete. Or, if you're stuck, you could always use an arrow shaft, though they tend to be useless once you've finished eating the
translation: Ben sis sopa kullanmayi tercih ediyorum, siz de bir pala kullanarak sazdan bir tane yapabilirsiniz. Ya da sikisirsaniz, her zaman bir ok sapi kullanabilirsiniz, ancak

english: spider.
translation: örümcegini yemeyi bitirdikten sonra ise yaramaz olma egilimindedirler.

english: Ok, thanks!
Sorry, I have to go.
Is there anything interesting to do around here?
translation: Buralarda yapacak ilginc bir sey var mi?

english: Bwana, if anyone else asks me that question today, I'll explode! Go and ask someone else!
translation: Bwana, bugün bana baska biri bu soruyu sorarsa, patlarim! Git ve baskasina sor!

english: Not that I'm aware of, just sit back and enjoy the sunshine bwana!
translation: Bildigim kadariyla yok, sadece arkana yaslan ve günesin tadini cikar bwana!

english: Sorry Bwana, I'm already busy, why not go and talk to Murcaily! He's around the village somewhere.
translation: Üzgünüm Bwana, ben zaten mesgulüm, neden gidip Murcaily ile konusmuyorsun? Köyün buralarinda bir yerlerde.

english: Well, I think that there's some work to be done...perhaps Murcaily can help you. He usually tends to the hardwood grove to the east of Trufitus's hut.
translation: Sey, sanirim yapilacak bazi isler var... belki Murcaily sana yardimci olabilir. Genellikle Trufitus'un kulübesinin dogusundaki sert agaclik alanda calisir.

english: It's just village life as normal around here Bwana, always something interesting to find to occupy your time if you look hard enough.
translation: Burada köy hayati normal seyrinde devam ediyor Bwana, yeterince dikkatli bakarsan zamanini gecirecek ilginc seyler bulabilirsin.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
Errrr..yuck, roasted spiders, that sounds gross!
translation: Eee... igrenc, kizarmis örümcek, kulaga cok kötü geliyor!

english: Hmm, I guess it could be considered a delicacy, so yes please?
translation: Hmm, sanirim bu bir lezzet olarak kabul edilebilir, o zaman evet lütfen?

english: I'd like to ask another question.
Sorry, I have to go.
Is there anything interesting to do here?
translation: Burada ilginc bir sey var mi?

english: Ok, thanks.
Hello, how's it going?
Not too bad, but I'm a little worried about the increase of goblins these days.
translation: Fena degil, ama son günlerde goblinlerin sayisinin artmasi beni biraz endiselendiriyor.

english: Don't worry, I'll kill them.
How can I help you?
Do you want to trade?
No, I have nothing I wish to get rid of. If you want to do some trading, there are plenty of shops and market stalls around though.
translation: Hayir, elden cikarmak istedigim bir sey yok. Ticaret yapmak istiyorsan, etrafta bircok dükkan ve pazar tezgahi var.

english: I'm in search of a quest.
I'm sorry I can't help you there.
I'm in search of enemies to kill.
I've heard there are many fearsome creatures that dwell under the ground...
translation: Yeraltinda bircok korkunc yaratik yasadigini duydum...

english: Get out of my way, I'm in a hurry!
I'm fine, how are you?
Very well thank you.
Hello there! Nice weather we've been having.
I'm very well thank you.
Who are you?
I'm a bold adventurer.
Ah, a very noble profession.
Do I know you? I'm in a hurry!
I think we need a new king. The one we've got isn't very good.
translation: Bence yeni bir krala ihtiyacimiz var. Simdiki kral pek iyi degil.

english: Not too bad thanks.
Are you asking for a fight?
The man attacks the player
I'm busy right now.
Hello.
None of your business.
Do you wish to trade?
No I don't have any spare change.
I'm a little worried - I've heard there's lots of people going about, killing citizens at random.
translation: Biraz endiseliyim - bircok insanin rastgele vatandaslari öldürdügünü duydum.

english: No, I don't want to buy anything!
That is classified information.
Have this flyer...
Yo, wassup!
Hello.
Excuse me!
Oh sorry, what did I do?
Can't you see I'm on the toilet?
Wait a minute... a toilet?
Yeah. A toilet.
Riiiight. Oh, man, you didn't wipe your hands?
translation: Tamam. Oh, dostum, ellerini silmedin mi?

english: Get over it.
What are you doing in my house?
I was just exploring.
You're exploring my house?
You don't mind, do you?
But... why are you exploring in my house?
Oh, I don't know, I just wandered in, saw you and thought it'd be fun to speak to you.
translation: Bilmiyorum, sadece iceri girdim, seni gördüm ve seninle konusmak eglenceli olur diye düsündüm....

english: ... you are very strange...
Perhaps I should go now.
Yes, please go away now.
NPC backs away from the player
[Good day, sir/Good day, madam/Good day]. What brings you to this end of town?
translation: Iyi günler. Bu kasabanin bu ucuna ne isin getirdi seni?

english: Well, what is there to do around here?
If you're into Mining, plenty! The dwarves have one of the largest mines in the world just under our feet. There's an entrance in the building just north-east of my house.
translation: Madencilikle ilgileniyorsan, cok sey var! Cüceler, ayaklarimizin altinda dünyanin en büyük madenlerinden birine sahipler. Evimin kuzeydogusundaki binada bir giris var.

english: If you'd rather enjoy yourself, there's the party room just north of here! Or you might like to climb up onto the city wall - you can get a good view of Falador from there.
translation: Eglenmek istersen, buradan kuzeye dogru parti odasi var! Ya da sehir surlarina tirmanmak isteyebilirsin, oradan Falador'un güzel manzarasini seyredebilirsin.

english: Thanks.
... whassup?
Are you alright?
... see... two of you... why there two of you?
There's only one of me, friend.
... no, two of you... you can't count... ... maybe you drunk too much...
translation: hayir, ikiniz... sayamiyorsun... ... belki de cok ictin...

english: Whatever you say, friend.
... giant hairy cabbages...
Molten lava! MOLTEN LAVA!
Snakes! Snakes! Ohhhh, there are snakes!
Why don't I have a 'Teleport Home to Lumbridge' button like everyone else?
translation: Neden herkes gibi benim de “Lumbridge'e Teleport” dügmem yok?

english: Too many monkeys - I can't stand it!
I should have stayed in Port Sarim.
So... many... trees...
I can't take the heat!
Party! Party!
Something's happening in the party room!
Everyone get to the party room!
What's happening in the party room?
Someone's having a big party!
Get to the party room NOW!
Get to the party room!
Get to the party room quick!
Big value items in the party room now!
translation: Parti odasinda cok degerli esyalar var!

english: Quick! Get to the party room!
Do you want to trade?
I'm in search of a quest.
I'm in search of enemies to kill.
Can I get past please?
Not just yet. The swamp has flooded the roads again, it's unsafe to pass.
translation: Henüz olmaz. Bataklik yollari yine sular altinda birakti, gecmek güvenli degil.

english: So how long will the road be blocked for?
translation: Yol ne kadar süre kapali kalacak?

english: Who can tell? It's one of the drawbacks to living in a swamp. You get used to it after a while.
translation: Kim bilir? Bataklikta yasamanin dezavantajlarindan biri bu. Bir süre sonra alisirsiniz.

english: DON'T EAT ME!
Umm, I'm not going to eat you. Are you ok?
She said she would return after the second fork.
translation: Ikinci cataldan sonra geri dönecegini söyledi.

english: Fork?
You can't eat jelly with a fork. Are you mad?
Ummm... no... I'll just leave you to it.
Green tongue snakes.
Occupied!
I've seen that one before. It's yours now.
translation: Onu daha önce görmüstüm. Artik senin.

english: That's very kind of you, but no thanks.
I want the adventure to end.
Thank you.
The man takes 99 damage, killing him.
It stinks down here.
Can't you just leave me alone.
I don't trust that fish monger.
Lighting fires in an enclosed space is probably not a good idea. Oh well.
translation: Kapali bir alanda ates yakmak iyi bir fikir degil. Neyse.

english: I guess it's not all bad down here. At least we have a pub.
translation: Burasi o kadar da kötü degilmis. En azindan bir pub var.

english: I'll leave this place one day. You'll see.
Hello there.
Go away. People from the outside shut us in like animals. I have nothing to say to you.
translation: Git buradan. Disaridakiler bizi hayvanlar gibi buraya kapattilar. Sana söyleyecek hicbir seyim yok.

english: An outsider! Can you get me out of this hell hole?
translation: Bir yabanci! Beni bu cehennem cukurundan cikarabilir misin?

english: Sorry, that's not what I'm here to do.
Nilsal.
Hello there. You don't seem too happy.

It's far too cold up here. Ralos' Rise is cold, but this is something else! I have to be here though. If this beast has any connections to the Old Ones, it might also have connections to Ralos and Ranul!
translation: Burasi cok soguk. Ralos' Rise soguktur ama burasi bambaska! Yine de burada olmak zorundayim. Bu canavar Eski Tanrilarla bir baglantisi varsa, Ralos ve Ranul ile de baglantisi olabilir!

english: Me being here also keeps the dwarves a bit happier as well. They keep claiming they're the ones doing all the work and that there needs to be more humans up here helping.
translation: Benim burada olmam cüceleri de biraz mutlu ediyor. Tüm isi kendilerinin yaptigini ve burada daha fazla insanin yardim etmesi gerektigini söyleyip duruyorlar.

english: Is that true?
I don't think so. I've seen plenty of people come up here and get involved. The dwarves don't actually do any of the fighting anyway. They just go in and do some mining once the danger has passed.
translation: Sanmiyorum. Buraya gelip ise karisan bircok insan gördüm. Cüceler aslinda savasin hicbir kisminda yer almiyor. Tehlike gectikten sonra iceri girip madencilik yapiyorlar.

english: I can't imagine they'd be happy to hear you say that.
Good point. Forget I said anything.
Who are you and what is this place?
My name is Mandrith.
I collect valuable resources and pawn off access to them to foolish adventurers, like yourself.
translation: Degerli kaynaklari topluyorum ve senin gibi aptal maceracilara erisim hakki satiyorum.

english: You should take a look inside my arena. There's an abundance of valuable resources inside.
translation: Arenama bir göz atmalisin. Icinde bol miktarda degerli kaynak var.

english: And I can take whatever I want?
translation: Ve istedigim her seyi alabilir miyim?

english: It's all yours. All I ask is you pay the upfront fee.
translation: Hepsi senin. Tek istedigim ön ödemeyi yapman.

english: Will others be able to kill me inside?
Yes. These walls will only hold them back for so long.
translation: Evet. Bu duvarlar onlari sadece bir süreligine engelleyebilir.

english: You'll stop them though, right?
translation: Ama sen onlari durdurursun, degil mi?

english: Haha! For the right price, I won't deny any one access to my arena. Even if their intention is to kill you.
translation: Haha! Dogru fiyati verirlerse, kimseyi arenama almayi reddetmem. Niyetleri seni öldürmek olsa bile.

english: Right...
My arena holds many treasures that I've acquired at great expense, adventurer. Their bounty can come at a price.
translation: Arenamda, büyük masraflarla edindigim bircok hazine var, maceraci. Bunlarin bedeli olabilir.

english: One day, adventurer, I will boast ownership of a much larger, much more dangerous arena than this. Take advantage of this offer while it lasts.
translation: Bir gün, maceraci, bundan cok daha büyük ve cok daha tehlikeli bir arenanin sahibi olacagim. Bu teklif gecerliyken yararlan.

english: Answer this, please.
Well done.
You've been given a [new clue/casket]!
Here, solve this.
Mandrith hands you a [light box/puzzlebox]!
That doesn't look solved to me.
Well done [player name]. Here you go.
Why am I the one who is always left clearing up after everyone?
translation: Neden her zaman herkesin ardindan temizlik yapan ben oluyorum?

english: Hello? Anyone there?
Hello? Lacey? Sid?
Hmm, well I guess I should go check it out. No point staying in this nice, locked room when I could go outside into the creepy darkness.
translation: Hmm, sanirim gidip bir bakmaliyim. Disaridaki ürkütücü karanliga cikabilecekken, bu güzel, kilitli odada kalmanin bir anlami yok.

english: Seriously!?
The walls and door seem too thick for Mandy to be able to hear you.
translation: Duvarlar ve kapi, Mandy'nin seni duyamayacagi kadar kalin görünüyor.

english: Oh, and I don't think there is any need to take this big, shiny weapon with me in order to defend myself. Nothing bad ever happens when people go check out noises in the dark outside of houses!
translation: Oh, ve kendimi savunmak icin bu büyük, parlak silahi yanimda götürmeme gerek oldugunu sanmiyorum. Insanlar evlerinin disindaki karanlikta sesleri kontrol etmeye gittiklerinde asla kötü bir sey olmaz!

english: You have got to be kidding...
Ok, well, here I go!
Mandy goes outside to investigate the noises.
translation: Mandy sesleri arastirmak icin disari cikar.

english: Hello, anyone out here?
Mandy looks around.
See, I knew nothing would happen! Must have just been a squirrel or something running about.
translation: Gördün mü, hicbir sey olmayacagini biliyordum! Sadece bir sincap ya da baska bir sey kosusturuyor olmali.

english: Mandy goes back into the kitchen.
Oh well, back to the dishes.
Phew, that was lucky!
The killer comes out of the closet near the exit and stabs Mandy.
translation: Katil, cikisin yanindaki dolaptan cikar ve Mandy'yi bicaklar.

english: No...why...me...
Mandy dies.
That psycho! He was just toying with her!
The killer slips a note under the door, and escapes using the closet.
translation: Katil, kapinin altindan bir not uzatir ve dolaptan kacar.

english: Another note. This guy really likes playing games, but this is going to be a game he won't win!
translation: Baska bir not. Bu adam oyun oynamayi gercekten seviyor, ama bu kazanamayacagi bir oyun olacak!

english: You'll never escape me!
In the background, Mandy gets up.
You dare try and ruin my moment!
Mandy walks toward the Bandos godsword on the table.
translation: Mandy masanin üzerindeki Bandos tanri kilicina dogru yürür.

english: Hewey is dead because of you!
Mandy picks up the Bandos godsword and enters the closet.
translation: Mandy Bandos tanri kilicini alir ve dolaba girer.

english: Now it is time for you to join him!
Mandy comes out of the closet behind Mandy.
You're not killing anyone else!
Mandy uses the sword's special attack on Abigale.
translation: Mandy, kilicin özel saldirisini Abigale'e kullanir.

english: No....this can't be it....
Abigale dies.
Wow, that was close!
Mandy, how are you alive!? I watched you get stabbed through the heart!
translation: Mandy, nasil hayattasin? Kalbinden bicaklandigini gördüm!

english: I did get stabbed, but I was born with a rare condition called Dextrocardia.
translation: Bicaklandim, ama ben dogustan Dextrocardia adli nadir bir rahatsizligim var.

english: Dextrowhat?
Dextrocardia. It means that my heart is on the right side of my chest, not the left like most people.
translation: Dextrocardia. Bu, kalbimin cogu insan gibi sol tarafta degil, sag tarafta oldugu anlamina geliyor.

english: So when the killer thought they stabbed you in the heart, they actually missed?
translation: Yani katil seni kalbinden bicakladigini sandiginda, aslinda iskalamis mi oldu?

english: Well, missed the heart yes.
I did still get stabbed though, and am actually feeling pretty woozy...
translation: Yine de bicaklandim ve aslinda kendimi oldukca sersemlemis hissediyorum...

english: Oh, yes, right! You should go sort yourself out!
translation: Oh, evet, dogru! Gidip kendini toparlamalisin!

english: I will wait outside the house after seeing to this stab wound. You should come talk to me there.
translation: Bu bicak yarasini tedavi ettikten sonra evin disinda bekleyecegim. Oraya gelip benimle konusmalisin.

english: Oh hi, [player name].
Hi Mandy. How are you feeling now?
Much better thanks, and lucky to be alive, thanks to you in no small part.
translation: Cok daha iyi, tesekkürler, ve hayatta oldugum icin sansliyim, bunun büyük bir kismi senin sayende.

english: Well we saved the day as a team, so thank you too.
translation: Takim olarak günü kurtardik, o yüzden ben de sana tesekkür ederim.

english: I found some stuff in the wardrobe when I was seeing to my wound. You need [[3/2] more space(s)/another space] in your inventory to take it all.
translation: Yarami kontrol ederken gardiropta bazi seyler buldum. Hepsini almak icin envanterinde [[3/2] daha fazla yer/baska bir yer] olmasi gerekiyor.

english: Here, I found these in the wardrobe when I was seeing to my wound. I don't want them so please, take them...
translation: Al, yarami kontrol ederken gardiropta bunlari buldum. Ben istemiyorum, lütfen al...

english: Congratulations! Quest complete!
Thanks again for your help, [player name]. Stay safe.
translation: Yardimin icin tekrar tesekkürler, Maceraci. Kendine dikkat et.

english: You too, Mandy.
*shuffle*
*rustle*
*scratch*
Hello there!
Do not think me rude outerlander, but our customs forbid me talking to you. All contact with outerlanders must be vetted by our chieftain, Brundt.
translation: Kaba bir yabanci oldugumu düsünme, ama geleneklerimiz seninle konusmami yasakliyor. Yabancilarla tüm temaslar sefimiz Brundt tarafindan onaylanmalidir.

english: Where is this Brundt?
He is standing just over there. He will speak for the tribe.
Hello outerlander. I overheard your conversation with Brundt just now. You wish to become a member of the Fremennik?
translation: Merhaba yabanci. Az önce Brundt ile konusmanizi duydum. Fremennik'in bir üyesi olmak mi istiyorsunuz?

english: That's right! Why, are you on the council?
translation: Aynen öyle! Neden, siz konsey üyesi misiniz?

english: Do not let my drink-soused appearance fool you, I earnt my place on the council many years past. I am always glad to see new blood enter our tribe, and will happily vote for you.
translation: Ickili görünüsüm sizi yaniltmasin, konseydeki yerimi yillar önce kazandim. Kabilemize yeni kanin girmesinden her zaman memnun olurum ve size seve seve oy veririm.

english: Great!
...Providing you can pass a little test for me. As a Fremennik, you will need to show cunning, stamina, fortitude, and an iron constitution. I know of only one way to test all of these.
translation: ...Tabii benim icin kücük bir testi gecerseniz. Bir Fremennik olarak kurnazlik, dayaniklilik, metanet ve demir gibi bir vücut göstermen gerekecek. Bunlarin hepsini test etmenin tek bir yolu var.

english: And what's that?
Why, a drinking contest!
The task is simple enough! You versus me, a stiff drink each, last man standing wins the trial. So what say you?
translation: Görev cok basit! Sen ve ben, her birimiz sert bir icki icecegiz, ayakta kalan son kisi yarisi kazanacak. Ne dersin?

english: A drinking contest? Easy. Set them up, and I'll knock them back.
translation: Icki yarismasi mi? Kolay. Sen hazirla, ben de iceyim.

english: When you are ready to begin, go and pick up a keg from that table over there, and come back here.
translation: Baslamaya hazir oldugunda, suradaki masadan bir fici al ve buraya geri gel.

english: We start when you have your keg of beer with you, and finish when one of us can drink no more and yields.
translation: Fici birayi aldiginda baslayacagiz ve ikimizden biri daha fazla icemeyip pes ettiginde bitecek.

english: I don't think drinking myself into a stupor is a very good way of testing my worthiness.
translation: Kendimi sarhos etmek, degerimi test etmek icin cok iyi bir yol oldugunu sanmiyorum.

english: Well, perhaps it's not, but it's my way. If you want my vote at the council, I'm afraid you're going to have to drink me under the table.
translation: Belki de degildir, ama benim yolum bu. Konseyde benim oyumu istiyorsan, korkarim beni masanin altina icmek zorunda kalacaksin.

english: I'm going to find someone else to vote for me then.
translation: O zaman bana oy verecek baska birini bulacagim.

english: As you wish, outerlander.
What do I have to do to earn your vote again?
translation: Senin oyunu tekrar kazanmak icin ne yapmam gerekiyor?

english: Beat me in a drinking contest! Grab a keg of beer from that table near the bar, and come back here with it.
translation: Icki yarismasinda beni yen! Barin yanindaki masadan bir fici bira al ve buraya geri gel.

english: Oh yeah. Okay, I will do.
Hey outerlander! I don't take kindly to people coming here and stealing my beer!
translation: Hey, yabanci! Buraya gelip birami calan insanlari hos karsilamam!

english: You already have a keg of beer.
Ah, I see you have your keg of beer. Are we ready to drink against each other?
translation: Ah, bir fici bira aldin. Birbirimize karsi icmeye hazir miyiz?

english: Yes, let's start this drinking contest!
As you wish outerlander; I will drink first, then you will drink.
translation: Nasil istersen, yabanci; önce ben icecegim, sonra sen iceceksin.

english: (cutscene plays. The screen sways after your character drinks, but becomes stable after Manni talks about rematch.)
translation: (Kesme sahnesi oynatilir. Karakteriniz ictikten sonra ekran sallanir, ancak Manni rövans hakkinda konustuktan sonra sabit hale gelir.)

english: The Fremennik drinks from his tankard first. He staggers a little bit.
translation: Fremennik önce kendi kadehinden icer. Biraz sendeler.

english: You drink from your keg. You feel extremely drunk...
translation: Siz de ficinizdan icersiniz. Kendinizi cok sarhos hissedersiniz...

english: Ish no' fair! (hic) I canna drink another drop! I alsho feel veddy, veddy ill...
translation: Bu haksizlik! (hickirik) Bir damla daha icemem! Ben de cok, cok hasta hissediyorum...

english: I guessh I win then ouddaladder! (hic) Niche try, anyway!
translation: Sanirim ben kazandim o zaman dostum! (hickirik) Yine de iyi denemeydi!

english: Come back if'n you fanshy a rematch! (hic) Jusht let me have a coffee firsht...
translation: Rövans istiyorsan geri gel! (hickirik) Önce bir kahve iceyim...

english: I'm not quite ready yet...
Want to line your stomach with some food or something, huh outerlander? Come back to me when you're ready to drink.
translation: Mideni biraz yemekle doldurmak ister misin, yabanci? Icmeye hazir oldugunda geri gel.

english: Thinking of cheating my test, outerlander? I don't think so! You drink that keg fairly, or not at all! Don't let me catch you cheating!
translation: Testimi kopya cekmeyi mi düsünüyorsun, yabanci? Sanmiyorum! O ficiyi adil bir sekilde ic ya da hic icme! Seni kopya cekerken yakalamayayim!

english: I'm going to have to find some way to distract this guy while I cheat...
translation: Hile yaparken bu adamin dikkatini dagitmanin bir yolunu bulmam gerekecek...

english: (drinking ensues, but this time the player doesn't get drunk and finished the entire keg without any issues)
translation: (icmeye devam edilir, ancak bu sefer oyuncu sarhos olmaz ve ficiyi sorunsuz bir sekilde bitirir)

english: You drink from your keg. You don't feel drunk at all.
Aaaah, lovely stuff. So you want to get the next round in, or shall I? You don't look so good there!
translation: Aaaah, ne güzel bir sey. Bir sonraki turu sen mi icmek istersin, yoksa ben mi iceyim? Pek iyi görünmüyorsun!

english: Wassha? Guh? You drank that whole keg! But it dinna affect you at all! I conshede! You can probably outdrink me!
translation: Ne? Ne? Bütün ficiyi ictin! Ama hic etkilenmedin! Itiraf ediyorum! Muhtemelen benden daha fazla icebilirsin!

english: I jusht can't (hic) believe it! Thatsh shome mighty fine drinking legs you got! Anyone who can drink like THAT getsh my vote atta consh.. counsh... gets my vote!
translation: Buna inanamiyorum! Cok iyi iciyorsun! Böyle icebilen herkes benim oyumu alir...

english: Congratulations! You have completed the Revellers' trial
No
(same as previously)
So I can rely on your vote at the council?
Absholutely! (hic) You're one mighty drinker!
I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a token to allow a seat at the champions table, do you?
translation: Sampiyonlar masasinda oturmak icin bir jeton bulabilecegim bir yer biliyor musun?

english: As a matter of fact, I do. I have one right here. I earnt my place here at the longhall for surviving over 5000 battles and raiding parties.
translation: Aslinda var. Burada bir tane var. 5000'den fazla savasta ve baskinda hayatta kaldigim icin bu salonda yerimi kazandim.

english: Due to my contribution to the tribe, I am now permitted to spend my days here in the longhall listening to the epic tales of the bard, and drinking beer.
translation: Kabileye yaptigim katkilardan dolayi, artik günlerimi bu salonda ozanlarin destansi hikayelerini dinleyerek ve bira icerek gecirebiliyorum.

english: Cool. That sounds pretty sweet! So I guess you don't want to give it away?
translation: Harika. Kulaga cok hos geliyor! Yani bunu vermek istemiyorsun, degil mi?

english: I think it sounds better than it actually is outerlander. I miss my glory days of combat on the battlefield. And to tell you the truth, the beer here isn't great, and the bards' music is lousy.
translation: Aslinda sandigindan daha iyi degil, yabanci. Savas alanindaki sanli günlerimi özlüyorum. Ve dogrusunu söylemek gerekirse, buradaki bira pek iyi degil ve ozanlarin müzigi berbat.

english: I would happily give up my token if it were not for the one thing that keeps me here. Our barkeep is one of the best in the world, and has worked in taverns across the land.
translation: Beni burada tutan tek sey olmasaydi, jetonumu seve seve verirdim. Barmenimiz dünyanin en iyilerinden biri ve ülkenin dört bir yanindaki tavernalarda calismis.

english: When she was younger, she experimented a lot with her drinks, and invented a cocktail so alcoholic and tasty that it has become something of a legend to all who enjoy a drink.
translation: Gencken ickilerle cok fazla deney yapti ve o kadar alkollü ve lezzetli bir kokteyl icat etti ki, icki sevenler icin bir efsane haline geldi.

english: Unfortunately, she decided that cocktails were not a suitable drink for Fremennik warriors, and vowed to never again make it.
translation: Ne yazik ki, kokteyllerin Fremennik savascilari icin uygun bir icecek olmadigina karar verdi ve bir daha asla yapmayacagina yemin etti.

english: I have been here every day since she returned, hoping that someday she might change her mind and I might try this legendary cocktail for myself. Alas, it has never come to pass...
translation: O geri döndügünden beri her gün buraya geliyorum, bir gün fikrini degistirip bu efsanevi kokteyli deneme sansim olacagini umuyorum. Ne yazik ki, bu hic gerceklesmedi...

english: If you can persuade her to make me her legendary cocktail, I will be happy to never let another drop of alcohol pass my lips, and will give you my champions token.
translation: Onu efsanevi kokteylini yapmaya ikna edebilirsen, bir daha agzima alkol damlasi sokmayacagim ve sana sampiyonluk jetonumu verecegim.

english: That's all?
That's all.
I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find the longhall barkeeps' legendary cocktail, do you?
translation: Longhall barmeninin efsanevi kokteylini nerede bulabilecegimi biliyor musun?

english: Uh... yes, the longhall barkeep has it. So could you get me my drink now please?
translation: Evet, Longhall barmeni yapiyor. Simdi ickimi alabilir misin lütfen?

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a written promise from Askeladden to stay out of the Longhall?
translation: Askeladden'in Longhall'dan uzak duracagina dair yazili bir sözünü nerede bulabilecegimi biliyor musun?

english: Uh... call it a crazy hunch, but did you even try asking Askeladden about that?
translation: Uh... cilgin bir önsezi diyelim, ama Askeladden'a bunu sordun mu?

english: Hey. I got your cocktail for you.
...It is true! The legendary cocktail! I have waited for this day ever since I first started drinking!
translation: ...Gercekten! Efsanevi kokteyl! Icmeye basladigimdan beri bu günü bekliyordum!

english: Here outerlander, you may take my token. I will happily give up my place at the longhalls table of champions just for a taste of this exquisite beverage!
translation: Al, yabanci, jetonumu alabilirsin. Bu enfes icecegi tatmak icin Longhall'un sampiyonlar masasindaki yerimden memnuniyetle vazgecerim!

english: It's just a drink...
No, it is an artform. A drink such as this should be appreciated, and admired. It is like a fine painting, or a tasteful sculpture.
translation: Hayir, bu bir sanat eseri. Böyle bir icki takdir edilmeli ve hayranlik duyulmali. Güzel bir tablo veya zevkli bir heykel gibi.

english: If what I hear is true, then all other drinks become like unpalatable water in comparison to this!
translation: Duydugum dogruysa, diger tüm ickiler bunun yaninda tatsiz su gibi kalir!

english: I guess you're happy with the trade then!
translation: O zaman takastan memnun kaldin demektir!

english: So it doesn't bother you at all that you just gave up your place here for one drink?
translation: Yani, bir icecek icin buradaki yerinden vazgecmis olman hic rahatsiz etmiyor mu?

english: Ah, but it was not just any drink... It was the finest cocktail ever created! Now that I have tasted it, I need never drink again, for my tastebuds will never be so excited!
translation: Ah, ama bu siradan bir icecek degildi... Simdiye kadar yaratilmis en iyi kokteyldi! Artik onu tattigima göre, bir daha asla icki icmem gerekmeyecek, cünkü damak tadim bir daha asla bu kadar heyecanlanmayacak!

english: So it was nice?
It was... exquisite!
What did it taste of, then?
Mostly tomato juice.
Howdy!
Hey! It's [Fremennik name]! Let me buy you a drink!
translation: Hey! Bu Dokrak! Sana bir icki ismarlayayim!

english: There ya go! Anyone who can drink like you earns my respect!
translation: Al bakalim! Senin gibi icebilen herkes benim saygimi kazanir!

english: Yes
Ask about the Merchant's trial
Ask about becoming a Fremennik
Hello!
You! I bet you're with them!
translation: Sen! Eminim sen de onlarla birliktesin!

english: Them?
The frogs!
Frogs? What are you on about?
Ah, I see. So you're going to play dumb are you? Well I won't fall for your lies!
translation: Ah, anliyorum. Demek aptal rolü yapacaksin, öyle mi? Ama ben senin yalanlarina kanmayacagim!

english: I promise I have no idea what you're on about. If you explain, maybe I can help you?
translation: Yemin ederim, neden bahsettigini hic anlamadim. Aciklarsan, belki sana yardimci olabilirim?

english: It's those frogs on the other side of the oasis! They're out to get us! All of us! If someone doesn't kill them all, we'll be living our lives as their slaves!
translation: Oasis'in diger tarafindaki kurbagalar! Bizi yakalamak istiyorlar! Hepimizi! Biri onlari öldürmezse, hayatimizi onlarin kölesi olarak yasayacagiz!

english: I see... How about I head over there and take a look?
translation: Anliyorum... Oraya gidip bir bakayim mi?

english: You want to go near them? Well then you're a fool! I will watch from a safe distance as they dine on your corpse!
translation: Onlara yaklasmak mi istiyorsun? O zaman sen bir aptalsin! Senin cesedini yerken ben güvenli bir mesafeden izleyecegim!

english: Okay then... Well provided that doesn't happen, I'll be back shortly to let you know what I've found.
translation: Tamam o zaman... Tabii bu olmazsa, buldugum seyi sana söylemek icin kisa süre sonra geri dönecegim.

english: I think I'm just going to go now. You clearly have some... issues that you need to get on top of.
translation: Sanirim simdi gidecegim. Acikca görülüyor ki, halletmen gereken bazi... sorunlarin var.

english: That's it! You walk away! Just remember, I know the truth!
translation: Yeter! Git buradan! Unutma, gercegi biliyorum!

english: Hello again. You helped forge my alliance with the frogs against those disgusting flies. Please feel free to use my farming patch in return. It's the least I can do.
translation: Merhaba tekrar. Igrenc sineklerle savasmak icin kurbagalarla ittifak kurmama yardim ettin. Karsiliginda ciftligimi kullanabilirsin. En azindan bunu yapabilirim.

english: Yes.
No.
Would you look after my crops for me?
Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: Bana tarimla ilgili tavsiyelerde bulunabilir misin?

english: Can you sell me something?
I'll come back another time.
Hello there.
Hello. Here for a drink? You've picked the right place if so.
translation: Merhaba. Bir içki içmek için mi geldiniz? Öyleyse dogru yere geldiniz.

english: Hello.
Hi there. So much to see here!
translation: Merhaba. Burada görülecek cok sey var!

english: Yep, could be looking all day!
Updated any displays yet?
Yes, I just learned more about some priestly warriors and a staff of the gods.
translation: Evet, rahip savascilar ve tanrilarin asalari hakkinda daha fazla sey ögrendim.

english: Sounds fun, how did you do that?
translation: Kulaga eglenceli geliyor, bunu nasil yaptin?

english: Ahh, I'm big on quests me, love questing. So when I've done one, I check here with 'Historian' Minas to see if I can help the Museum out with some information. Sometimes they already know it, or don't want to know,
translation: Ahh, ben görevlere bayilirim, görevleri cok severim. Bir görevi tamamladigimda, “Tarihci” Minas'a gelip müzeye bilgi konusunda yardimci olup olamayacagimi sorarim. Bazen zaten biliyorlar ya da bilmek istemiyorlar,

english: and sometimes it earns me a reward or two.
translation: bazen de bir iki ödül kazaniyorum.

english: That sounds really good. Perhaps I should do the same!
translation: Kulaga cok iyi geliyor. Belki ben de aynisini yapmaliyim!

english: You should, as well as everything else there is here in the Museum. Did you know they have a really fun- looking display down in the basement? I love monkeys.
translation: Yapmalisin, müzede bulunan diger her seyi de yapmalisin. Bodrumda cok eglenceli görünen bir sergi oldugunu biliyor muydun? Maymunlari severim.

english: I'll check it out. Got to get going now, nice talking to you.
translation: Bir bakacagim. Simdi gitmem gerek, seninle konusmak güzeldi.

english: Have a good day!
Hi there!
Hello, what are you doing here?
Oh, just taking a look at these displays. I'm a bit of a history buff.
translation: Sadece sergileri geziyorum. Tarih meraklisiyim da.

english: Really? Tell me something I didn't know!
translation: Gercekten mi? Bilmedigim bir sey söyle!

english: Well, did you know that Bob the Cat is... no, no... you'd never believe me anyway.
translation: Peki, Bob the Cat'in... hayir, hayir... zaten bana inanmazsin.

english: He's what? Tell me!
No, no. Couldn't possibly ruin the surprise.
ARG! Tell me!
If you really want to know, go talk to Unferth in his house in Burthorpe.
translation: Gercekten bilmek istiyorsan, Burthorpe'daki evinde Unferth ile konus.

english: Hi!
Oh, hello. I was just looking at this display here.
Anything interesting?
Yes, one I just updated by talking to 'Historian' Minas. I'm a bit of a quester you see.
translation: Evet, ‘Tarihci’ Minas ile konusarak güncelledigim bir tane var. Ben biraz maceraci biriyim de.

english: Okay, I'll let you get on then.
Hmm, yes. Okay. Don't forget to check out the Natural History exhibit - you could learn a lot.
translation: Hmm, evet. Tamam. Doga Tarihi sergisini de mutlaka gör, cok sey ögrenebilirsin.

english: Right, bye!
Hmm... 3rd Age.... No, no...maybe 4th...
translation: Hmm... 3. Cag... Hayir, hayir... belki 4. cag...

english: Hello?
Yes, that's it, just like that. Mustn't forget the map either....hmm...what else?
translation: Evet, iste böyle, aynen böyle. Haritayi da unutmamaliyim... hmm... baska ne var?

english: HELLO! Are you there?
Oh, hello there. Sorry, was a bit engrosed in updating this display. I've just been out questing and thought I'd stop off here you see. It's quite rewarding too.
translation: Merhaba. Özür dilerim, bu sergiyi güncellemeye dalmistim. Görevden dönüyordum ve buraya ugrayayim dedim. Oldukca tatmin edici bir is.

english: Yes, well, no need to ignore me.
translation: Evet, beni görmezden gelmene gerek yok.

english: No offence intended, my dear chap. Just very interested in this history stuff, that's all.
translation: Alinma, sevgili dostum. Sadece tarihle cok ilgileniyorum, hepsi bu.

english: Okay. Have you seen the Natural History exhibit in the basement?
translation: Tamam. Bodrumdaki Doga Tarihi sergisini gördün mü?

english: Oh, yes, marvellous isn't it! I particularly like the wyvern, very interesting considering they've never found a live specimen. And to think they could possibly have been flapping around at one time!
translation: Oh, evet, harika degil mi! Özellikle wyvern'i cok begendim, canli bir örnegi hic bulunmamis olmasi cok ilginc. Bir zamanlar etrafta ucuyor olabileceklerini düsünmek bile!

english: A bit like the crazy gnomes and their gliders. Have you seen the model they have upstairs?
translation: Cilgin cüceler ve planörleri gibi. Üst kattaki modeli gördün mü?

english: Yes, very intricate isn't it? Worrying to think some people risk their lives in them! You wouldn't catch me up in one. Had a chat with Jacques while I was up there, the art critic...he's a bit funny in the head.
translation: Evet, cok karmasik, degil mi? Bazi insanlarin hayatlarini tehlikeye attigini düsünmek endise verici! Beni bir tanesine bindiremezsin. Oradayken sanat elestirmeni Jacques ile sohbet ettim... Biraz kafasi karisik biri.

english: That's not very nice!
Well, he thinks he's going to get an entire portrait gallery to himself!
translation: Sey, kendisi icin bütün bir portre galerisi yaptiracaklarini düsünüyor!

english: Who knows, the Museum just got really big and appears to have cash. They might entertain him with his very own floor - we'll see.
translation: Kim bilir, müze cok büyüdü ve parasi var gibi görünüyor. Kendisine ait bir katla onu memnun edebilirler, görecegiz.

english: I guess so. Wonder what poetry he'll come up with then! Still, I must get on with this display. See you around I hope!
translation: Sanirim öyle. O zaman ne tür siirler yazacak merak ediyorum! Yine de, bu sergiye devam etmeliyim. Görüsürüz umarim!

english: Bye!
Hello!
Hi, have you seen the Dig Site displays?
translation: Merhaba, Kazi Alani sergisini gördün mü?

english: Yes, good aren't they! Have you done the quest?
translation: Evet, cok güzel, degil mi? Görevi tamamladin mi?

english: Not yet.
Oh you should, it lets you get into that bit where they clean the finds, and you can join in!
translation: Tamamlamalisin, buluntulari temizledikleri yere girebilir ve sen de katilabilirsin!

english: Sounds fun, I should probably check it out.
I do not speak to outlanders.
Maybe you should speak with Rellekka's Chieftain.
translation: Belki de Rellekka'nin Sefi ile konusmalisin.

english: Please excuse me, I'm rather busy.
Hey, I'm your contractor from Mahogany Homes, what did you want done?
translation: Merhaba, ben Mahogany Homes'tan müteahhitinizim, ne yaptirmak istiyorsunuz?

english: I'd like a Wooden table built.
I'd like my sink fixed.
I'd like a Wooden shelf built.
I'd like a Wooden cupboard built.
I'd like a Wooden bed built.
I'd like two Wooden small tables built.
translation: Iki adet ahsap kücük masa yaptirmak istiyorum.

english: I'd like my hat stand fixed.
I'd like a Oak table built.
I'd like a Oak shelf built.
I'd like a Oak cupboard built.
I'd like a Oak bed built.
I'd like two Oak small tables built.

english: I'd like a Teak table built.
I'd like a Teak shelf built.
I'd like a Teak cupboard built.
I'd like a Teak bed built.
translation: Tik agacindan bir yatak yaptirmak istiyorum.

english: I'd like two Teak small tables built.
translation: Iki adet tik agacindan kücük masa yaptirmak istiyorum.

english: I'd like a Mahogany table built.
translation: Maun agacindan bir masa yaptirmak istiyorum.

english: I'd like a Mahogany shelf built.
translation: Maun agacindan bir raf yaptirmak istiyorum.

english: I'd like a Mahogany cupboard built.
translation: Maun agacindan bir dolap yaptirmak istiyorum.

english: I'd like a Mahogany bed built.
translation: Maun agacindan bir yatak yaptirmak istiyorum.
