translation: Iki adet maun agacindan kücük masa yaptirmak istiyorum.

english: I've finished with the work you wanted.
Thank you so much! Would you like a cup of tea before you go?
translation: Cok tesekkür ederim! Gitmeden önce bir fincan cay ister misiniz?

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks, I better be off.
Aaah, nothing like a nice cupppa tea!
translation: Aaah, güzel bir fincan cay gibisi yok!

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks.
Are you a member of the Group of Advanced Gardeners?
translation: Ileri Düzey Bahcivanlar Grubu'nun üyesi misiniz?

english: Why, yes I am. Why do you ask?
Martin has asked me to investigate why all the crops are failing.
translation: Martin, tüm mahsullerin neden bozuldugunu arastirmami istedi.

english: No, I'm afraid I don't know anything about that.
translation: Hayir, maalesef bu konuda hicbir sey bilmiyorum.

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
I might - which patch were you thinking of?
You don't have any seeds planted in that patch. Plant some and I might agree to look after it for you.
translation: O tarlaya tohum ekmediniz. Tohum ekin, o zaman bakmayi kabul edebilirim.

english: That patch is already fully grown! I don't know what you want me to do with it!
translation: O tarla zaten tamamen yetismis! O tarlayla ne yapmami istiyorsunuz bilmiyorum!

english: That patch is dead - it's too late for me to do anything about it now.
translation: O tarla öldü, artik bir sey yapmam icin cok gec.

english: That patch is diseased - you should cure it before asking me to be responsible for it!.
translation: O tarla hastalikli, bana sorumluluk vermeden önce onu tedavi etmelisin!

english: I don't know what you're talking about - I'm already looking after that patch for you.
translation: Neden bahsettigini anlamadim, o tarlaya zaten bakiyorum.

english: Oh sorry, I forgot.
I want 2 buckets of compost for that.
I want one sack of potatoes for that.
translation: Bunun icin bir cuval patates istiyorum.

english: I want one sack of onions for that.
translation: Bunun icin bir cuval sogan istiyorum.

english: I want 2 sacks of cabbages for that.
I want 10 jute fibers for that.
I want one basket of apples for that.
translation: Bunun icin bir sepet elma istiyorum.

english: I want 10 curry leaves for that.
I want 5 jangerberries for that.
I'm afraid I don't have any of those at the moment.
Well I'm not wasting my time for free.
I'm afraid I don't have enough of those at the moment.
translation: Maalesef su anda elimde yeterince yok.

english: Okay, it's a deal.
That'll do nicely, [sir/madam]. Leave it with me - I'll make sure that patch grows for you.
translation: Bu yeterli, . Bana birakin, o araziyi sizin icin yetistirecegim.

english: No, that's too much.
Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: Bana tarimla ilgili tavsiyelerde bulunabilir misiniz?

english: The only way to cure a bush or tree of disease is to prune away the diseased leaves with a pair of secateurs. For all other crops I would just apply some plant-cure.
translation: Bir cali veya agacin hastaligini tedavi etmenin tek yolu, hastalikli yapraklari bir budama makasi ile kesmektir. Diger tüm mahsuller icin ise bitki ilaci kullanirim.

english: Tree seeds must be grown in a plantpot of soil into a sapling, and then transferred to a tree patch to continue growing to adulthood.
translation: Agac tohumlari, toprak dolu bir saksida fidana dönüstürülmeli ve ardindan yetiskinlige kadar büyümeye devam etmesi icin bir agac tarlasina aktarilmalidir.

english: You can put up to ten potatoes, cabbages or onions in vegetable sacks, although you can't have a mix in the same sack.
translation: Sebze cuvallarina en fazla on adet patates, lahana veya sogan koyabilirsiniz, ancak ayni cuvalda farkli türleri karistiramazsiniz.

english: You can buy all the farming tools from farming shops, which can be found close to the allotments.
translation: Tüm tarim aletlerini, bahcelerin yakininda bulunan tarim dükkanlarindan satin alabilirsiniz.

english: Bittercap mushrooms can only be grown in a special patch in Morytania, near the Mort Myre swamp. There the ground is especially dank and suited to growing poisonous fungii.
translation: Aci mantarlari sadece Morytania'daki Mort Myre batakligi yakinindaki özel bir alanda yetistirilebilir. Oradaki toprak özellikle nemli ve zehirli mantarlarin yetismesine uygundur.

english: Supercompost is far better than normal compost, but more expensive to make. You need to rot the right type of item; show me an item, and I'll tell you if it's super- compostable or not.
translation: Süper kompost normal komposttan cok daha iyidir, ancak yapimi daha pahalidir. Dogru türdeki ögeyi cürütebilmeniz gerekir; bana bir ögeyi gösterin, süper kompostlanabilir olup olmadigini size söyleyeyim.

english: There is a special patch for growing Belladonna - I believe that it is somewhere near Draynor Manor, where the ground is a tad 'unblessed'.
translation: Belladonna yetistirmek icin özel bir alan vardir - sanirim Draynor Malikanesi yakinlarinda, topragin biraz ‘kutsanmamis’ oldugu bir yerde.

english: Applying compost to a patch will not only reduce the chance that your crops will get diseased, but you will also grow more crops to harvest.
translation: Bir alana kompost uygulamak, mahsulünüzün hastalanma olasiligini azaltmakla kalmaz, ayni zamanda hasat edeceginiz mahsul miktarini da artirir.

english: If you want to grow fruit trees you could try a few places: Catherby, Brimhaven, Gnome Stronghold and the Farming Guild all have fruit tree patches.
translation: Meyve agaclari yetistirmek istiyorsaniz birkac yeri deneyebilirsiniz: Catherby, Brimhaven, Gnome Stronghold ve Farming Guild'de meyve agaclari yetistirilen alanlar vardir.

english: You can fill plantpots with soil from any empty patch, if you have a gardening trowel.
translation: Bahce küreginiz varsa, bos bir alandan aldiginiz toprakla saksilari doldurabilirsiniz.

english: Hops are good for brewing ales. I believe there's a brewery up in Keldagrim somewhere, and I've heard rumours that a place called Phasmatys used to be good for that type of thing. 'Fore they all died, of course.
translation: Serbetciotu, bira yapiminda kullanilir. Keldagrim'de bir bira fabrikasi oldugunu saniyorum ve Phasmatys adli bir yerin eskiden bu tür seyler icin uygun oldugu söylentileri duydum. Tabii ki hepsi ölmeden önce.

english: Vegetables, hops and flowers need constant watering - if you ignore my advice, you will sooner or later find yourself in possession of a dead farming patch.
translation: Sebzeler, serbetciotu ve cicekler sürekli sulanmalidir. Tavsiyemi dikkate almazsaniz, er ya da gec kendinizi ölü bir tarim arazisiyle karsi karsiya bulursunuz.

english: You can put up to five tomatoes, strawberries, apples, bananas or oranges into a fruit basket, although you can't have a mix in the same basket.
translation: Meyve sepetine en fazla bes domates, cilek, elma, muz veya portakal koyabilirsiniz, ancak ayni sepete farkli meyveleri karistiramazsiniz.

english: Don't just throw away your weeds after you've raked a patch - put them in a compost bin and make some compost.
translation: Arazinizi tirmikladiktan sonra yabani otlari cöpe atmayin, kompost kutusuna koyun ve kompost yapin.

english: There are five other Farming areas like this one - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius and Alan's area in the Farming Guild.
translation: Bunun gibi bes tane daha tarim alani vardir - Falador yakinlarindaki Elstan'in alani, Catherby yakinlarindaki Dantaera'nin alani, Morytania'daki Lyra'nin alani, Hosidius'daki Marisi'nin alani ve Tarim Loncasi'ndaki Alan'in alani.

english: There are fiveother Farming areas like this one - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius, Alan's area in the Farming Guild and Oswallt's
translation: Bunun gibi bes tane daha tarim alani var: Falador yakinlarindaki Elstan'in alani, Catherby yakinlarindaki Dantaera'nin alani, Morytania'daki Lyra'nin alani, Hosidius'daki Marisi'nin alani, Tarim Loncasi'ndaki Alan'in alani ve Prifddinas'daki Oswallt'in

english: area in Prifddinas.
If you want to make your own sacks and baskets you'll need to use the loom that's near the Farming shop in Falador. If you're a good enough [craftsman/craftswoman], that is.
translation: Kendi cuvallarinizi ve sepetlerinizi yapmak istiyorsaniz, Falador'daki Tarim dükkaninin yakinindaki dokuma tezgahini kullanmaniz gerekir. Tabii yeterince iyi bir [zanaatkar]saniz.

english: You don't have to buy all your plantpots you know, you can make them yourself on a pottery wheel. If you're a good enough [craftsman/craftswoman], that is.
translation: Tüm saksilarinizi satin almaniz gerekmez, cömlek carkinda kendiniz yapabilirsiniz. Tabii yeterince iyi bir [zanaatkar]saniz.

english: Can you sell me something?
That depends on whether I have it to sell. What is it that you're looking for?
translation: Satacak bir seyim olup olmadigina bagli. Ne ariyorsun?

english: Some plant cure.
Plant cure, eh? I might have some put aside for myself. Tell you what, I'll sell you some plant cure for 25 coins if you like.
translation: Bitki ilaci, ha? Kendim icin bir kenara ayirdigim olabilir. Bak ne diyecegim, istersen sana 25 sikkeye bitki ilaci satarim.

english: A bucket of compost.
A bucket of compost, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 35 coins if you like.
translation: Bir kova kompost, ha? Yedek bir tane olabilir... Bak ne diyecegim, istersen 35 sikkeye satarim.

english: A rake.
A rake, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: Tirmik, ha? Yedek bir tane olabilir... Bak ne diyecegim, istersen 15 sikkeye satarim.

english: A plant pot.
Eh, I suppose I can spare you a plant pot, but I'll want 40 coins for it.
translation: Eh, sanirim sana bir saksi verebilirim, ama 40 sikke istiyorum.

english: A watering can.
A watering can, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 25 coins if you like.
translation: Bir sulama kabi, ha? Yedek bir tane olabilir... Bak ne diyecegim, istersen 25 sikkeye satarim.

english: A gardening trowel.
A gardening trowel, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: Bir bahce küregi, ha? Yedek bir tane olabilir... Bak ne diyecegim, istersen 15 sikkeye satarim.

english: A seed dibber.
A seed dibber, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: Bir tohum ekme cubugu, ha? Yedek bir tane olabilir... Bak ne diyecegim, istersen 15 sikkeye satarim.

english: Forget it, you don't have anything I need.
translation: Bos ver, ihtiyacim olan bir seyin yok.

english: I don't have enough money for that, I'm afraid.
translation: Korkarim bunun icin yeterli param yok.

english: Actually, I don't think I'd be able to carry it.
Yes, that sounds like a fair price.
translation: Evet, bu makul bir fiyat gibi görünüyor.

english: No thanks, I can get that much cheaper elsewhere.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, baska yerde daha ucuza bulabilirim.

I have a question for you.
Please enter the answer to the question.
No, try again.
Correct!

english: I'll come back another time.
Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: Hey, bu Kahraman! Vay canina! Sen harikasin, o iki juvinate ve Gadderank'i nasil alt ettin? Ve kasaba cok güzel, harika bir is cikarmissin!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
I'm a little ill. My wife looks after me though. I help as much as I'm able, but as you can see, I'm bed ridden. Hopefully I'll get better soon.
translation: Biraz hastayim. Karim bana bakiyor. Elimden geldigince yardim ediyorum, ama gördügün gibi yatalak durumdayim. Umarim yakinda iyilesirim.

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: Oh, pek bir sey yok, hepimiz hala vampirlerden saklaniyoruz ve bu korkunc yerde gecimimizi sagliyoruz, umarim yakinda Salve'deki tapinaga yolculuk yapacak kadar gücleniriz.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: Bildigim kadariyla yok, su anda cok yararli olan bazi temel olanaklara sahibiz, hepimiz sana inanilmaz derecede minnettariz. Daha önce hic bir kahraman görmedim veya tanimadim, bu yüzden karsilastiracak bir seyim yok, ama sanirim

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: cogu insanin görüsüne göre, sen bir kahramansin! Ben sahsen seninle tanistigima cok memnunum.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Ok, thanks.
Hello there; I see you're qualified. Come to help us out?
translation: Merhaba, nitelikli oldugunu görüyorum. Bize yardim etmeye mi geldin?

english: Hello! You're that student who recently finished all three Earth Sciences exams, aren't you? Come to help us out?
translation: Merhaba! Sen yakin zamanda üc Earth Sciences sinavini da bitiren ögrenci, degil mi? Bize yardim etmeye mi geldin?

english: Greetings, my dear [sir/madam]. Have you come to give us a hand?
translation: Merhaba, sevgili . Bize yardim etmeye mi geldin?

english: Yes, how can I help out?

Well, you'll need to get your equipment first - it's all there on the tool rack. Use what you learned from your Earth Sciences exams. You'll need to be wearing your leather gloves and boots as well as have access to
translation: Önce ekipmanlarini almalisin - hepsi alet rafinda. Yer Bilimleri sinavlarinda ögrendiklerini kullan. Deri eldivenlerini ve botlarini giymeli ve

english: your trowel, rock pick and specimen brush.
translation: kürek, kaya kazma ve numune fircasina erisebilmelisin.

english: I see you have your equipment - well done.

To really give us a hand, you could clean some finds for us. They're mostly done - just some fine work to finish off. Take a find from the pile that the workmen are bringing in, then there are spare tables over there
translation: Bize gercekten yardim etmek istiyorsaniz, buluntulari temizleyebilirsiniz. Cogu isleri bitti, sadece son rötuslar kaldi. Iscilerin getirdigi yigindan bir buluntu alin, temizlemek icin orada bos masalar var.

english: to clean them on. If you find anything interesting, let us know and we'll see if it's good enough to go on display.
translation: Ilginc bir sey bulursaniz bize haber verin, sergilenmeye deger olup olmadigini kontrol edelim.

english: I found something interesting.
Oh? Let's take a look...
I found this pretty necklace.
Interesting...yes...yes...hmmm.... It looks like it's enchanted.
translation: Ilginc... evet... evet... hmmm.... Sihirli gibi görünüyor.

english: With what?

Oh, I think it's just a benign teleportation spell. I tinker in magic when I'm not doing archaeology. I can teach you how to make more necklaces like this. Amazing that they had this kind of knowledge back then.
translation: Oh, sanirim sadece zararsiz bir isinlanma büyüsü. Arkeolojiyle ugrasmadigim zamanlarda büyüyle ugrasirim. Sana bunun gibi daha fazla kolye yapmayi ögretebilirim. O zamanlar bu tür bilgilere sahip olmalari sasirtici.

english: That would be good. Where is the teleport to?
Hmm...all the indications are that it's somewhere to the east of us, but I'm not sure how far. Perhaps it was a teleport back to Saranthium. Let me just take a closer look.
translation: Hmm... tüm isaretler bunun bizim dogumuzda bir yere oldugunu gösteriyor, ama ne kadar uzak oldugunu bilmiyorum. Belki de Saranthium'a geri götüren bir teleporttu. Bir daha yakindan bakayim.

english: So I just make a ruby necklace and use five fire runes and one cosmic rune to enchant it.
translation: Yani bir yakut kolye yapip, bes ates runesi ve bir kozmik runesi kullanarak onu büyülüyorum.

english: Yes, indeed. Well done, youngster, thanks for helping us.
translation: Evet, aynen öyle. Aferin genc adam, yardim ettigin icin tesekkürler.

english: I've cleaned this old coin - is it of any use?
translation: Bu eski parayi temizledim, bir ise yarar mi?

english: Oh my! What a wonderful find! If this is what I believe it to be, it would allow us to date the Dig Site city.
translation: Vay canina! Ne harika bir buluntu! Eger tahmin ettigim gibi ise, kazi alanindaki sehrin tarihini belirlememizi saglayacak.

english: And look here, it has the name of the city too! Saranthium! That must be during the Saradominist occupation. This is a wonderful find. Please take it and place it in display case 45.
translation: Bakin, üzerinde sehrin adi da yaziyor! Saranthium! Saradominist isgali sirasinda olmali. Bu harika bir buluntu. Lütfen al ve 45 numarali vitrine koy.

english: Right, display case 45 it is...
Back again? Have you put the old coin in display case 45 yet?
translation: Yine mi geldin? Eski parayi 45 numarali vitrine koydun mu?

english: No, I'll go do that now
You've already shown me one of those, but it was in better condition. It's in the display case over there. You can pop this one in the finds crate over in the corner.
translation: Bana bunlardan birini göstermistin, ama o daha iyi durumdaydi. Suradaki vitrinde. Bunu kösedeki buluntu sandigina koyabilirsin.

english: I found this really old coin - is it of any use?
translation: Cok eski bir sikke buldum, bir ise yarar mi?

english: What have we here?

Oh! This is very interesting...and confusing at the same time. This coin means that the city that we're excavating on the Digsite - Saranthium - was actually inhabited much, much earlier by followers of Zamorak,
translation: Oh! Bu cok ilginc... ama ayni zamanda kafa karistirici. Bu sikke, kazi alaninda kazi yaptigimiz sehir olan Saranthium'un aslinda cok daha önceden Zamorak'in takipcileri tarafindan iskan edildigini gösteriyor.

english: at which time, the city was known as Senntisten.
translation: O zamanlar sehir Senntisten olarak biliniyordu.

english: This is a most remarkable discovery, as we have other evidence indicating that Zarosian followers were resident before the Saradominists took over, but it also seems that Zamorakian forces used it during a battle of some
translation: Bu cok önemli bir kesif, cünkü Saradoministlerin yönetimi ele gecirmeden önce Zaros'un takipcilerinin burada yasadigini gösteren baska kanitlar da var, ama ayni zamanda Zamorak'in güclerinin bir tür savas sirasinda burayi kullandigi da anlasiliyor.

english: sort. Still, it allows us to roughly date when the city changed from following Zaros and Zamorak to following Saradomin. Put it in display case 44.
translation: Yine de, bu kesif, sehrin Zaros ve Zamorak'tan Saradomin'e gectigi tarihi yaklasik olarak belirlememizi sagliyor. 44 numarali vitrine koyun.

english: Case 44 it is!
Back again? Have you put the ancient coin in display case 44 yet?
translation: Yine mi geldin? Eski parayi vitrin 44'e koydun mu?

english: No, I'll go do that now.
I found this crumbly old decoration - is it of any use?
translation: Bu ufalanmis eski süslemeyi buldum, bir ise yarar mi?

english: Ahh... That looks like an altar piece. Hmm, yes...from the early Saradominist worshippers by the looks of it. Quite delicate, too. Put it in display case 37.
translation: Ahh... Bu bir sunak parcasi gibi görünüyor. Hmm, evet... Görünüse göre Saradoministlerin ilk takipcilerine ait. Oldukca narin de. Vitrin 37'ye koy.

english: Case 37 it is!
Back again? Have you put the ancient symbol in display case 37 yet?
translation: Yine mi geldin? Eski sembolü 37 numarali vitrine koydun mu?

english: I found this really old decoration - is it of any use?
translation: Bu cok eski bir süsleme buldum, ise yarar mi?

english: Wow!
That's in rather good condition, isn't it? An old altar decoration by the looks of things, from the Saradominist city no doubt. Put it in display case 36.
translation: Durumu oldukca iyi, degil mi? Görünüse göre eski bir sunak süslemesi, süphesiz Saradominist sehirden. 36 numarali vitrine koy.

english: Case 36 it is!
Back again? Have you put the old symbol in display case 36 yet?
translation: Yine mi geldin? Eski sembolü 36 numarali vitrine koydun mu?

english: I found this piece of pottery - is it of any use?
translation: Bu cömlek parcasini buldum, bir ise yarar mi?

english: Ahh... Oh! Hmm...yes...made by Zaros worshippers, by the looks of it. Beautifully-shaped. It looks as if this would go nicely in display case 22. This piece reinforces our evidence that the city was occupied by
translation: Ahh... Oh! Hmm... evet... görünüse göre Zaros'a tapanlar tarafindan yapilmis. Cok güzel sekilli. 22 numarali vitrine cok yakisacak gibi görünüyor. Bu parca, sehrin Saradoministlerden önce Zaros'a tapanlar tarafindan isgal edildigine dair kanitlarimizi güclendiriyor.

english: Zarosians before Saradominists.
Case 22 it is!
translation: Zaroslular tarafindan isgal edildigine dair kanitimizi güclendiriyor.

english: Back again? Have you put the pottery in display case 22 yet?
translation: Yine mi geldin? Cömlegi 22 numarali vitrine koydun mu?

english: I found these old arrowheads.
Ahh, yes, we find lots of those - they're not important. We already have some in our display. Just add it to the crate of finds over near the door.
translation: Ahh, evet, bunlardan cok buluyoruz - önemli degiller. Vitrinde zaten var. Kapinin yanindaki buluntular sandigina koy.

english: If there is anything already in the crate, feel free to take it as a reward for your work.
translation: Kutuda zaten bir sey varsa, calismanin karsiligi olarak alabilirsin.

english: Oh, okay.
Take a look at this...
I found these old necklaces.
An interesting find... Here, let me offer you something in return.
translation: Ilginc bir buluntu... Al, sana karsiliginda bir sey vereyim.

english: Oh! Okay.
I cleaned up this old vase.
Ah, the vases... I've lost count of how many we've found of those... The only completely intact one is in the display case already. Just add it to the crate of finds over near the door.
translation: Ah, vazolar... Kac tane buldugumuzu sayamadim bile... Tamamen saglam olan tek vazo zaten vitrinde. Kapinin yanindaki buluntu sandigina ekleyin.

english: Right.
Err... I seem to have lost it. Sorry.
Sounds like you never had it, [lad/lass]!
No, just here to watch.
Thank you, but I don't need that
Yes, how can I help out?
I found something interesting.
No thanks.
Cheryl where is our crate? We can't leave without our luggage!
translation: Cheryl, sandigimiz nerede? Bagajimiz olmadan gidemeyiz!

english: You pet the dog...
He rolls over a little bit so you can pet his belly.
Hey! Get your hands off there!
Gumbo!
Frogspawn gumbo!
Nice chewy frogspawn gumbo!
Get your frogspawn gumbo!
Fresh frogspawn gumbo!
Hello, human. Something you need?
translation: Merhaba, insan. Bir seye mi ihtiyacin var?

english: What are you doing up here?
Why, I'm ensuring everyone stays well fed and hydrated, of course! Fighting monsters is hard work, as I'm sure you know.
translation: Tabii ki herkesin iyi beslenip susuz kalmamasini sagliyorum! Canavarlarla savasmak zor bir istir, biliyorsundur.

english: Say, when was the last time you drank some water?
translation: Söylesene, en son ne zaman su ictin?

english: Uh, I suppose I am a bit thirsty...
Off you go and refresh yourself! Don't want you collapsing in front of the Hueycoatl now, do we?
translation: Git ve kendini tazele! Hueycoatl'in önünde bayilmani istemeyiz, degil mi?

english: Oh, thank you! I'll make good use of this most versatile, nutritious and delicious ingredient!
translation: Oh, tesekkürler! Bu cok yönlü, besleyici ve lezzetli malzemeyi iyi degerlendirecegim!

english: Take a look at this.
Is this a joke, human?
What? No! I-
We were warned not to trust your kind, and I can see why.
translation: Sizin türünüze güvenmememiz gerektigi konusunda uyarildik ve nedenini anliyorum.

english: What a horrible thing to do to someone.
I didn't mean anyth-
And to mar the egg in the first place?! I'm shaken to my core!
translation: Ve önce yumurtayi bozmak mi?! Cok sarsildim!

english: I found it like this!
The dwarf is too busy cooking and grumbling to hear you.
translation: Cüce yemek pisirmekle ve söylenmekle mesgul oldugu icin seni duymuyor.

english: Weird, isn't it? Definitely not what I would consider gourmet cooking, but to each their own...
translation: Tuhaf, degil mi? Benim gurme yemek olarak kabul edecegim bir sey degil, ama herkesin zevki kendine...

english: Hello, Marla!
Hello! Something you need?
translation: Merhaba! Bir seye mi ihtiyacin var?

english: Why, I'm ensuring everyone stays well fed and hydrated, of course! Fighting monsters is hard work, as I'm sure you know.
translation: Tabii ki, herkesin iyi beslenip susuz kalmamasini sagliyorum! Canavarlarla savasmak zor bir is, biliyorsundur.

english: Say, when was the last time you drank some water?
translation: Söylesene, en son ne zaman su ictin?

english: Off you go and refresh yourself! Don't want you collapsing in front of the Hueycoatl now, do we?
translation: Git ve kendini tazele! Hueycoatl'in önünde bayilmani istemeyiz, degil mi?

english: I have a request from the guard over there.
And you are?
[player name]!
Well, [player name], what is Viero's request?
He wants to try sunlight antelope cooked with redberries.
translation: Kirmizi meyvelerle pisirilmis günes isigi antilopunu denemek istiyor.

english: He wants what?! The altitude must be sending him loopy!
translation: Ne istiyor?! Yükseklik onu cildirtmis olmali!

english: Ah well, he works hard and this is a rough post so I'll indulge him.
translation: Ah, neyse, cok calisiyor ve bu zor bir görev, o yüzden istegini yerine getirecegim.

english: I'll need a nice piece of raw sunlight antelope and some redberries to create the dish. Return when you have the ingredients.
translation: Yemegi hazirlamak icin güzel bir parca cig günes isigi antilopu ve biraz kirmizi meyveye ihtiyacim var. Malzemeleri buldugunda geri gel.

english: I have all the ingredients here.
Okay, let's see...
Perhaps it would work best as a berry marinade...
translation: Belki de en iyisi meyve sosuyla marine etmek olur...

english: Or maybe a delicate jus...
translation: Ya da belki de hafif bir sos...

english: Marla concentrates intently as she works with the ingredients.
translation: Marla malzemelerle calisirken yogun bir sekilde konsantre oluyor.

english: That should do it... I think. It smells pretty good, but I'm not convinced. See what Viero thinks.
translation: Bu yeterli olmali... Sanirim. Kokusu oldukca iyi ama emin degilim. Viero'nun ne düsündügüne bakalim.

english: No, never mind.
Hello, [player name]! Looking for something to eat?
translation: Merhaba, Maceraci! Yiyecek bir sey mi ariyorsun?

english: I'm fine, thanks.
Suit yourself.
Viero thought the redberry antelope was 'interesting and complex'.
translation: Viero, kirmizi meyveli antilobun “ilginc ve karmasik” oldugunu düsündü.

english: Hah! That's certainly one way to put it!
translation: Hah! Bu da bir bakis acisi!

english: What are you doing up here?
I have a request from the guard over there.
No, never mind.
I need another redberry antelope.
translation: Bir kirmizi meyveli antilop daha lazim.

english: I'm fine, thanks.
Viero thought the redberry antelope was 'interesting and complex'.
translation: Viero, kirmizi meyveli antilobun “ilginc ve karmasik” oldugunu düsündü.

english: Hello there!
He doesn't seem too interested in talking to you.
translation: Seninle konusmak pek ilgisini cekmiyor gibi.

english: Hey there. Would you happen to be Marley?
I could be. Depends on who's asking? If you're with the Varrock City Guard, I had nothing to do with the robbery at the museum. I don't even know what I'd do with some Wizard robes.
translation: Olabilirim. Kime sorduguna bagli. Varrock Sehir Muhafizlari'ndan biriysen, müzedeki soygunla hicbir ilgim yok. Büyücü cüppesi ile ne yapacagim da bilmiyorum.

english: Uhm, no? What robbery? Wizard robes?
translation: Hayir? Ne soygunu? Büyücü cüppesi mi?

english: Robbery? Sorry [sir/miss], first I've heard of a robbery.
translation: Soygun mu? Üzgünüm , soygun hakkinda ilk kez duyuyorum.

english: Look, I'm not here with the city guard, Willow sent me to find you. She needs your help.
translation: Bak, ben sehir muhafizlarindan degilim, Willow seni bulmam icin gönderdi. Senin yardimina ihtiyaci var.

english: Willow? Hmm... I'm afraid I don't recall a Willow.
translation: Willow mu? Hmm... Willow adinda birini hatirlamiyorum.

english: Are you sure? She said you were old pals.
translation: Emin misin? Eski arkadas oldugunuzu söylemisti.

english: Nope, I'm sure. Only Willow I know of is a type of tree.
translation: Hayir, eminim. Tek bildigim Willow agac türüdür.

english: But, then again, my memory is a bit hazy, due to how hungry I am.
translation: Ama ac oldugum icin hafizam biraz bulanik.

english: You're too hungry... to remember your friend?
Yep... been a while since I had a nice hot meal.
translation: Evet... Uzun zamandir sicak bir yemek yemedim.

english: *Sighs*... would you like me to get you something to eat, to help jog your memory?
translation: *Ic ceker*... Hafizani canlandirmak icin sana bir seyler getirmemi ister misin?

english: Oh what a kind offer! I couldn't say no.
translation: Ne kadar nazik bir teklif! Reddedemem.

english: Fine, I'll be back in a...
Woah woah woah, hold your horses there friend! I can't just eat anything. I have very specific dietary requirements.
translation: Dur dur dur, acele etme dostum! Her seyi yiyemem. Cok özel beslenme gereksinimlerim var....

english: Don't be like that! I don't want nothing fancy, just a Steak sandwich from the Blue Moon Inn, in Varrock.
translation: Öyle yapma! Özel bir sey istemiyorum, sadece Varrock'taki Blue Moon Inn'den bir biftek sandvic istiyorum.

english: Why don't you go and get one then?
translation: O zaman neden gidip bir tane almiyorsun?

english: Slight problem there, friend. I've been barred and the chef won't make me another one. Something about stealing from punters. I can't remember...
translation: Kücük bir sorun var dostum. Oraya girmem yasaklandi ve sef bana bir tane daha yapmayacak. Müsterilerden calmakla ilgili bir seydi. Hatirlayamiyorum...

english: *Sighs*... Fine. If I go get you this sandwich, will you help Willow?
translation: *Ic ceker*... Tamam. Sana bu sandvici getirirsem Willow'a yardim eder misin?

english: Of course! Oh, by the way, don't bother with the bartender. Just talk to the chef. Trust me.
translation: Tabii ki! Bu arada, barmenle ugrasma. Sadece sefe konus. Güven bana.

english: Alright. I'll be back momentarily with your sandwich.
Have you got the sandwich yet?
I'm still working on it. Where did you say you got them from?
The Blue Moon Inn, in Varrock. They have the best cook around!
translation: Varrock'taki Blue Moon Inn'den. Oradaki asci en iyisidir!

english: I'll go speak to them, then.
So I spoke with the Chef.
Excellent! So you have my sandwich? Pass it over.
translation: Harika! Sandvicimi aldin mi? Ver sunu bana.

english: Well, slight issue there... He said he'll never make you another sandwich again.
translation: Sey, ufak bir sorun var... Bir daha sana sandvic yapmayacagini söyledi.

english: Oh... bit of an overreaction, in my opinion.
translation: Oh... Bence biraz abartili bir tepki.

english: But he did give me the recipe to make them.
translation: Ama bana sandvic yapmanin tarifini verdi.

english: Well what are you waiting for? Go and make one then!
translation: Ne bekliyorsun? Git de bir tane yap!

english: Hey Marley. I've managed to get your Steak sandwich.
translation: Hey Marley. Sana biftekli sandvic getirdim.

english: Ah, just in time for my afternoon snack. Pass it over.
translation: Ah, ögleden sonra atistirmaligim icin tam zamaninda. Ver sunu bana.

english: You give the steak sandwich to Marley.
Marley eats the steak sandwich.
Aaah... not quite as good as the usual, but it hit the spot.
translation: Aaah... her zamanki kadar iyi degil ama isimi gördü.

english: Are you finally done?
Yes [sir/miss] I am. I'll honour my side of the deal and head off to find Willow.
translation: Evet , bitti. Anlasmamizin benim tarafini yerine getirecegim ve Willow'u bulmaya gidecegim.

english: Finally! You can find her on the west side of Ice Mountain.
translation: Sonunda! Onu Buz Dagi'nin bati tarafinda bulabilirsin.

english: Excellent! I'll be on my way then.
translation: Harika! O zaman ben de yola cikayim.

english: Screen fades to black and Marley disappears.
Marley is certainly an interesting character. Hopefully the next team member is more respectable.
translation: Marley kesinlikle ilginc bir karakter. Umarim bir sonraki takim üyesi daha saygin olur.

english: Hello again Marley.
Ah, my new favourite chef. Have you got another sandwich for me?
translation: Ah, yeni favori sefim. Bana baska bir sandvic var mi?

english: No!
Woah! Alright there, calm down. Was only a joke.
translation: Woah! Tamam, sakin ol. Sadece sakaydi.

english: I don't find being your errand [boy/girl] very funny.
translation: Senin ayakcin olmak pek komik gelmiyor.

english: You need to lighten up a little, my friend.
That's everyone gathered. Interesting company for an archaeologist to keep...
translation: Herkes toplandi. Bir arkeolog icin ilginc bir arkadas grubu...

english: *Shrugs* How many archaeologists do you actually know?
translation: *Omuz silkiyor* Kac tane arkeolog taniyorsun ki?

english: Well I-
Exactly. So who are you to judge? Anyway, we're all here and ready to break in... Um, I mean excavate... the entrance.
translation: Aynen. Sen kimsin ki yargiliyorsun? Neyse, hepimiz buradayiz ve iceri girmeye haziriz... Yani, kazmaya... girise.

english: Are you ready? Who knows what's inside the ruins?
translation: Hazir misin? Harabelerin icinde ne oldugunu kim bilir?

english: I'm ready as I'll ever be. Let's head in.
Fade into the cutscene of Willow setting the plan in motion.
translation: Willow'un plani harekete gecirdigi kesme sahnesine gec.

english: Right, that's everyone gathered. Thank you, [player name], for all your help.
translation: Tamam, herkes toplandi. Yardimlarin icin tesekkürler, Maceraci.

english: Oh it was no pro...
Okay everyone, we've wasted enough time. Let's crack this door open. Burntof, you're up!
translation: Tamam millet, yeterince zaman kaybettik. Hadi bu kapiyi acalim. Burntof, sira sende!

english: Try not to blow the entire mountain up this time...
translation: Bu sefer tüm dagi havaya ucurmamaya calis...

english: Yesh ma'am, let'sh get this rock out the way.
translation: Evet efendim, hadi bu kayayi ortadan kaldiralim.

english: Burntof walks up to the door and plants his explosive and fade out.
translation: Burntof kapiya yaklasir, patlayiciyi yerlestirir ve sahne kararir.

english: Jusht got to plashe thish here...
... little bit of dyn-*hic*-amite here...
... and there we go!
Now we light the fushe!
Fade in to the explosive about to go off and everyone running away.
translation: Patlayici patlamak üzereyken ve herkes kacarken ekrana girer.

english: What are you doin' standin' there?!
What do you mean?
Everyone'sh ran for cover [lad/lass]. You'd best do the shame.
translation: Herkes siginaklara kostu . Sen de aynisini yapsan iyi olur.

english: Wait, what?!
Clock'sh ticking [lad/lass]!
There are explosions at the door. Fade out.
Fade in to a broken door blocked with debris
translation: Enkazla tikanmis kirik bir kapiya gecis yap.

english: Bloomin' 'eck, Burntof!
That was a tad too explosive I think.
My ears are still ringing!
Quit yer moanin', it did the job didnae it?
translation: Sizlanmayi kes, isini yapti, degil mi?

english: He's right, the rock's been broken up. Checkal, it's your turn.
translation: Hakli, kaya parcalandi. Checkal, sira sende.

english: Of course ma'am, I will get to work.
Checkal picks up and removes all of the debris. Fade out.
translation: Checkal enkazi toplar ve kaldirir. Fade out.

english: Checkal sets to work clearing out the rubble...
Fade in.
The work is done, Willow. My apologies if it took too long.
translation: Is bitti Willow. Cok uzun sürdügü icin özür dilerim.

english: Don't be sorry, Checkal. Gotta put those muscles to use somehow.
translation: Özür dileme Checkal. O kaslari bir sekilde kullanmak lazim.

english: Alright Marley, in you go. Let us know if you find anything.
translation: Tamam Marley, sen gir. Bir sey bulursan bize haber ver.

english: Right, in I go. Wish me luck [player name].
translation: Tamam, ben giriyorum. Bana sans dile Maceraci.

english: Try not to die...
Fade out, then in to the inside of the dungeon to Marley disarming traps.
translation: Fade out, sonra zindanin icine Marley'nin tuzaklari etkisiz hale getirdigi sahneye gec.

english: Right, let's see what hidden surprises you have in store for me.
translation: Tamam, bakalim benim icin ne sürprizler sakliyorsun.

english: Hmm...
That would have been nasty.
Is that it? I thought this place would be better protected.
translation: Bu mu? Burasi daha iyi korunur saniyordum.

english: Now to disarm it...
Maybe this will work?
That got it!
Alright guys! It's safe to come in! I think...
Fade out, then in to everyone inside of the dungeon.
translation: Fade out, sonra zindanin icindeki herkese gecis.

english: Wow, this place is amazing. I can't believe this was hidden away.
translation: Vay canina, burasi muhtesem. Bunun gizli kaldigina inanamiyorum.

english: I wonder how long it's been left untouched for.
translation: Ne kadar zamandir dokunulmamis merak ediyorum.

english: You're impressed? There's nothing here but dust and fallen rocks.
translation: Etkilendin mi? Burada toz ve düsmüs kayalardan baska bir sey yok.

english: Yaaa*hic*aawn
You don't find it exciting? As an archaeologist, I thought you would be thrilled at this discovery?
translation: Heyecanlanmadin mi? Bir arkeolog olarak, bu kesiften heyecanlanacagini düsünmüstüm?

english: Thrilled? What's there to be excited about? I don't see any gold, diamonds, rare gems or piles of lost treasure!
translation: Heyecanlanmak mi? Heyecanlanacak ne var ki? Altin, elmas, nadir mücevherler veya kayip hazineler görmüyorum!

english: It's not about the money though, right? We've potentially discovered the long lost ruins of an ancient civilisation!
translation: Ama mesele para degil, degil mi? Uzun zamandir kayip olan eski bir medeniyetin kalintilarini kesfetmis olabiliriz!

english: Of course it's about the money. It's always been about money, you fool.
translation: Tabii ki parayla ilgili. Her zaman parayla ilgili olmustur, seni aptal.

english: I don't understand...
Burntof walks over to the undisturbed golem.
Theshe markings look familiar...
We're not a team of archaeologist, you idiot. We're grave robbers looking for their next score.
translation: Biz arkeolog ekibi degiliz, seni aptal. Biz bir sonraki ganimetimizi arayan mezar soygunculariyiz.

english: So this entire time, you've just been using me to help break into these ruins in hopes of finding someone else's treasures.
translation: Yani bunca zaman, baskalarinin hazinelerini bulmak umuduyla bu kalintilara girmek icin beni kullandin.

english: Yep, and you were surprisingly easy to convince. I'll admit, you have been a tremendous help, [player name].
translation: Evet, ve seni ikna etmek sasirtici derecede kolaydi. Kabul ediyorum, cok büyük yardimin dokundu, Maceraci.

english: But your usefulness has come to an end I'm afraid. I can't simply let you leave here.
translation: Ama korkarim ki, senin yararin sona erdi. Seni buradan öylece birakamam.

english: Why not?
Burntof walks away from the undisturbed golem to a different wall.
translation: Burntof, rahatsiz edilmemis golemin yanindan uzaklasip baska bir duvara dogru yürür.

english: I've sheen thish before...
I can't risk you running to the authorities and telling them about our little gang. We're wanted in quite a few large cities across Gielinor.
translation: Yetkililere kosup bizim kücük cetemizi anlatma riskini göze alamam. Gielinor'daki bircok büyük sehirde araniyoruz.

english: I'm afraid this is the end of the road for you, [player name]. This ruin is about to become your tomb.
translation: Korkarim bu senin icin yolun sonu, Maceraci. Bu harabe senin mezarin olacak.

english: Burntof walks into the centre yellow-marked stone trap.
translation: Burntof, ortadaki sari isaretli tas tuzaga dogru yürür.

english: *hic* Woops...
What was that noise?
Uh... it wasn't me!
The dungeon begins to quake, with rocks falling from the ceiling.
translation: Zindan sarsilmaya baslar ve tavandan kayalar düser.

english: Whats happening?!
It feels like the quaking has finally stopped...
The golem stands up.
Holy Zamorak! What is that thing?! Checkal, take it down!
translation: Kutsal Zamorak! O sey de ne?! Checkal, onu indir!

english: I'm a muscle man, not a fighter.
translation: Ben kasli bir adamim, savasci degil.

english: I think we should get out of here, Willow!
You're right, Marley. Burntof, we're leaving!
Fade out.
I can't believe they ran so quickly. I suppose I should take care of this thing.
translation: Bu kadar cabuk kactiklarina inanamiyorum. Sanirim bu seyi halletmeliyim.

english: I need a little bit more time to prepare.
translation: Hazirlanmak icin biraz daha zamana ihtiyacim var.

english: Hurry up then! We've waited long enough.
translation: O zaman acele et! Yeterince bekledik.

english: Wow, the desert really suits you Marley.
translation: Vay canina, cöl sana cok yakismis Marley.

english: [player name] my old pal! How are you doing?
Better now I don't have to deal with you. Enjoying life in the desert?
translation: Artik seninle ugrasmak zorunda olmadigim icin daha iyiyim. Cölde hayatin tadini cikariyor musun?

english: Not really. I'm not suited to such harsh climates. No steak sandwiches here either...
translation: Pek sayilmaz. Bu kadar sert iklimlere uygun degilim. Burada biftekli sandvic de yok...

english: Oh what a shame! Poor Marley's going to starve as he doesn't have anyone to make his sandwiches... So sad.
translation: Ne yazik! Zavalli Marley, sandviclerini yapacak kimsesi olmadigi icin acliktan ölecek... Cok üzücü.

english: Tsssss...
Yes
No
Hello there.
Aye? Who's that, what do you want?
Who are you?
Marten.
Oh, straight to the point.
I got betta' things to do than waste my time talkin' to you.
translation: Seninle konusarak zamanimi bosa harcamaktansa yapacak daha iyi islerim var.

english: You're rather rude aren't you?
Fine, wanna know more 'bout canoes?
translation: Peki, kanolar hakkinda daha fazla bilgi mi istiyorsun?

english: No thanks, not from you at least.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, en azindan senden degil.

english: Then get out of here and stop botherin' me.
translation: O zaman git buradan ve beni rahatsiz etme.

english: Could you teach me about canoes?
translation: Bana kanolar hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Hahaha! Sorry mate, you'll not be able to make any canoes outta that tree there. You'll need to get a bit more skilled at the craft of Woodcuttin'.
translation: Hahaha! Üzgünüm dostum, o agactan kano yapamazsin. Agac kesme becerini biraz daha gelistirmelisin.

english: But once you get a bit betta', you'll be able to make a canoe and ride the river.
translation: Ama biraz daha iyi olunca, kano yapip nehirde gezinebileceksin.

english: It's not 'ard mate, you just gotta chop that tree o'er there down.
translation: Zor degil dostum, sadece suradaki agaci kesmen gerekiyor.

english: Then cut it down into a canoe. So simple a gobbo could do it.
translation: Sonra onu kano seklinde kes. O kadar basit ki bir cüce bile yapabilir.

english: But you got no chance of turning it into a beautiful canoe.
translation: Ama onu güzel bir kano haline getirme sansin yok.

english: Why's that?
I can tell by lookin' at ya! You ain't a woodcutter, most you'd be able to do is sail to the next stop on a log.
translation: Sana bakarak anlayabiliyorum! Sen oduncu degilsin, en fazla bir kütük üzerinde bir sonraki duraga yelken acabilirsin.

english: Hmm, s'pose you could make a decent canoe with your skills. you'll be able to make a dugout, I reckons.
translation: Hmm, becerilerinle iyi bir kano yapabilirsin. Bir kano yapabilirsin bence.

english: How far will I be able to go in a dugout canoe?
translation: Bir kano ile ne kadar uzaga gidebilirim?

english: Err, probably about two stops before it sinks on ya.
Could that take me back to Lumbridge?
translation: Bu beni Lumbridge'e geri götürebilir mi?

english: Pah, I don't think so. You'll be lucky to make it past Varrock.
Well bless me axe, you're almost as good a woodchopper as meself! You'll have no issue craftin' the best of the best, the waka canoe.
translation: Vay canina, neredeyse benim kadar iyi oduncu olmussun! En iyinin en iyisi olan waka kanoyu yapmakta hicbir sorun yasamayacaksin.

english: One of those beauties can take you up further in the Wilderness. Beautiful place that.
translation: Bu güzelliklerden biri seni Wilderness'in daha da iclerine götürebilir. Orasi cok güzel bir yer.

english: Great, thank you.
Who are you?
Yes
No
Can you teach me about canoes?
translation: Bana kanolar hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Hi, I hear a woman called Elena is staying here.
translation: Merhaba, Elena adinda bir kadinin burada kaldigini duydum.

english: Yes she was staying here, but slightly over a week ago she was getting ready to go back. However she never managed to leave.
translation: Evet, burada kaliyordu, ama bir hafta kadar önce geri dönmeye hazirlaniyordu. Ancak hic ayrilmayi basaramadi.

english: My daughter Milli was playing near the west wall when she saw some shadowy figures jump out and grab her. Milli is upstairs if you wish to speak to her.
translation: Kizim Milli bati duvarinin yakininda oynarken, gölgeli figürlerin atlayip onu yakaladigini gördü. Milli yukarida, onunla konusmak istersen.

english: Any luck finding Elena yet?
Not yet...
I wish you luck, she did a lot for us.
translation: Sana sans diliyorum, bizim icin cok sey yapti.

english: Yes, she is safe at home now.
That's good to hear, she helped us a lot.
translation: Bunu duyduguma sevindim, bize cok yardim etti.

english: Good day friend.
What's all this about?
Ah, hello and welcome. I'm Martin Holt, leader of Kourend's Royal Society. This is our little protest against the Kourend Council.
translation: Merhaba ve hos geldin. Ben Martin Holt, Kourend Kraliyet Dernegi'nin lideriyim. Bu, Kourend Konseyi'ne karsi kücük bir protesto.

english: Pleased to meet you. I'm [player name]. So, what's wrong with the Council?
translation: Tanistigimiza memnun oldum. Ben Maceraci. Peki, Konsey'in nesi var?

english: Now there's a question! I have a better one. What's right with the Council?
translation: Iste bu iyi bir soru! Benim daha iyi bir sorum var. Konsey'in nesi iyi?

english: I bet you didn't know that the Council was originally only temporary. After the last King died, they were only supposed to rule until his daughter came of age.
translation: Konsey'in aslinda gecici oldugunu bilmiyordun herhalde. Son kral öldükten sonra, sadece kizi resit olana kadar yönetmeleri gerekiyordu.

english: However, according to the Council, the King's daughter went mad. Such a wonderful convenience for them of course. With her out of the picture, the Council became permanent.
translation: Ancak Konsey'e göre, kralin kizi delirdi. Tabii ki bu onlar icin cok uygun bir durumdu. O ortadan kalktiktan sonra, Konsey kalici hale geldi.

english: Interesting. What else don't you like about the Council?
translation: Ilginc. Konsey hakkinda baska neyi sevmiyorsun?

english: Democracy! That's meant to be the big thing for the Council. Funny thing is, although they're meant to be elected by the people, the same four people have won every single election. Little odd, no?
translation: Demokrasi! Konsey icin en önemli sey bu olmali. Komik olan sey, halk tarafindan secilmeleri gerekirken, her secimde ayni dört kisi kazaniyor. Biraz tuhaf, degil mi?

english: That is a bit suspicious, I suppose.
Indeed it is. So, do you want to join our protest?
translation: Gercekten öyle. Peki, protestomuza katilmak ister misin?

english: Not right now. But thanks for the information.
translation: Su anda degil. Ama bilgi icin tesekkürler.

english: You do not meet all of the requirements to start the A Kingdom Divided quest.
translation: A Kingdom Divided görevini baslatmak icin gerekli tüm sartlari saglamiyorsun.

english: Good to see you friend.
Hello Martin. Now here's somewhere I wouldn't have expected to find you.
translation: Merhaba Martin. Seni burada bulmayi hic beklemiyordum.

english: Indeed. I never thought I'd be back here.
translation: Gercekten. Buraya geri dönecegimi hic düsünmemistim.

english: So why are you here?
We won! The Council are out, and we have what Kourend really needed. We have a king!
translation: Kazandik! Konsey devrildi ve Kourend'in gercekten ihtiyaci olan seye kavustuk. Bir kralimiz var!

english: Of course, King Artur ended up taking the throne from his father a little faster than anyone expected, so he needs plenty of guidance. That's where I come in!
translation: Tabii ki, Kral Artur babasindan tahti herkesin beklediginden biraz daha hizli aldi, bu yüzden cok fazla rehberlige ihtiyaci var. Iste burada devreye giriyorum!

english: So you're helping to advise the King?
Exactly! When the people voted on Rose's Accord, they voted for the Hosidius family to become the new royal family. From a technical standpoint that means they voted for King Artur.
translation: Aynen öyle! Halk Rose'un Anlasmasi'ni oyladiginda, Hosidius ailesinin yeni kraliyet ailesi olmasini oyladi. Teknik acidan bu, Kral Artur'u oyladiklari anlamina geliyor.

english: But in reality it was his father they expected to rule.
translation: Ama gercekte, hüküm sürmesini bekledikleri kisi babasiydi.

english: Precisely. My job is to advise King Artur and ensure his actions have a positive impact on the people that he now rules.
translation: Aynen öyle. Benim görevim Kral Artur'a danismanlik yapmak ve onun eylemlerinin, su anda hüküm sürdügü halk üzerinde olumlu bir etki yaratmasini saglamak.

english: And how's that going?
Not too bad. While he lacks experience, the King has a good heart. He wants to do the right thing, and he has the support needed to do it.
translation: Fena degil. Kral deneyimsiz olsa da iyi bir kalbi var. Dogru seyi yapmak istiyor ve bunu yapmak icin gerekli destege sahip.

english: Mind you, he could do with listening to his mother less. She's always whispering things in his ear. She forgets that he's the one in charge, not her.
translation: Tabii, annesini daha az dinlese iyi olur. Annem sürekli kulagina bir seyler fisildiyor. Yetkili olanin kendisi oldugunu, annesi olmadigini unutuyor.

english: Still, I'm sure he just needs time to adjust. I have no doubt that under King Artur, Kourend will prosper like never before.
translation: Yine de, eminim ki sadece alismak icin zamana ihtiyaci var. Kral Artur'un yönetiminde Kourend'in hic olmadigi kadar refah icinde olacagina süphem yok.

english: I'm sure you're right. See you around Martin.
Until next time.
Only a king can right the wrongs of the Council! And only you can make that happen!
translation: Sadece bir kral Konsey'in yanlislarini düzeltebilir! Ve bunu gerceklestirebilecek tek kisi sensin!

english: How long will you keep your eyes closed? Their corruption surrounds you!
translation: Ne kadar daha gözlerini kapali tutacaksin? Yolsuzluklari etrafini sarmis durumda!

english: This kingdom will never be safe while the Council rule!
translation: Konsey hüküm sürerken bu krallik asla güvende olmayacak!

english: You deserve the truth! They won't give it to you!
translation: Gercegi hak ediyorsun! Onlar sana gercegi söylemeyecek!

english: The Council have wronged you! It's time to make things right!
translation: Konsey sana haksizlik etti! Artik isleri düzeltme zamani!

english: Together, we can bring an end to the treachery of the Council!
The Council care only for themselves! It's time for a ruler who cares for you!
translation: Konsey sadece kendini düsünüyor! Artik seni düsünen bir hükümdarin zamani geldi!

english: Kourend is a kingdom! A kingdom needs a king, not a council!
translation: Kourend bir kralliktir! Bir kralligin krala ihtiyaci vardir, konseye degil!

english: Democracy? What democracy? It's all a facade!
translation: Demokrasi mi? Ne demokrasisi? Hepsi bir maskaraliktir!

english: People of Kourend, you have been lied to!
Democracy? What democracy? It's all a façade!
translation: Demokrasi mi? Ne demokrasisi? Hepsi bir maskaraliktan ibaret!

english: You know it's sometimes funny how things work out, I lose some gold but find an item, or I lose an item and find some gold... no-one ever knows what's gone where ya know.
translation: Bazen islerin nasil yürüdügü komik olabiliyor, bazen altin kaybedip bir esya buluyorum, bazen de bir esya kaybedip altin buluyorum... Kimse neyin nereye gittigini bilmiyor, anlarsin ya.

english: Sorry, mate. Train up your Thieving skill to at least 50 and I might be able to help you out.
translation: Üzgünüm dostum. Hirsizlik becerini en az 50'ye cikarirsan sana yardimci olabilirim.

english: Sorry, mate. Train up your Agility skill to at least 50 and I might be able to help you out.
translation: Üzgünüm dostum. Ceviklik becerini en az 50'ye cikarirsan sana yardimci olabilirim.

english: Can you tell me about your cape?
Certainly! Skillcapes are a symbol of achievement. Only people who have mastered a skill and reached level 99 can get their hands on them and gain the benefits they carry.
translation: Elbette! Beceri pelerinleri basari sembolüdür. Sadece bir beceriyi ustalastirip 99. seviyeye ulasan kisiler bu pelerinleri elde edebilir ve sagladiklari avantajlardan yararlanabilir.

english: The Cape of Thieving provides a nice boost to your chances of pickpocketing when worn. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Hirsizlik Pelerini giyildiginde yankesicilik sansini artirir. Baska yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: No thank you.
Okay... I'll be going now.
Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to answer this for me.
Please enter the answer to the question.
How can that be? Go check again!
translation: Bu nasil olabilir? Tekrar kontrol et!

english: Spot on!
Yeah I know what you mean, found anything recently?
translation: Evet, ne demek istedigini anliyorum, son zamanlarda bir sey buldun mu?

english: Can you tell me about your cape?
Have you found anything recently?
translation: Son zamanlarda bir sey buldun mu?

english: No thank you.
Okay... I'll be going now.
What is that cape you're wearing?
This is a Skillcape of Farming, isn't it incredible? It's a symbol of my ability as the finest farmer in the land and wearing it increases my herb yield!
translation: Bu bir Tarim Beceri Pelerini, inanilmaz degil mi? Bu, bu topraklardaki en iyi ciftci oldugumun sembolü ve onu giydigimde bitki verimim artiyor!

english: Can I buy a Skillcape of Farming from you?
translation: Senden bir Tarim Beceri Pelerini satin alabilir miyim?

english: Of course, fellow farmer. If you wear this cape you'll receive increased yields from your herbs. That'll be 99000 coins.
translation: Tabii ki, ciftci dostum. Bu pelerini giyersen bitkilerinden daha fazla verim alirsin. 99.000 sikke olacak.

english: I'm not paying that.
No skin off my teeth, but if you change your mind, the price will still be the same.
translation: Benim icin sorun degil, ama fikrini degistirirsen fiyat yine ayni olacak.

english: Sure, not many people own one.
translation: Elbette, pek cok kisi buna sahip degil.

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: Ama ne yazik ki, yanimda yeterince para yok.

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.
translation: Peki, paran oldugunda tekrar gelip beni gör.

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: Ne yazik ki tüm Beceri Pelerinleri sadece ücretsiz bir baslik ile satiliyor, bu bir beceri promosyonunun parcasi; bir alana bir bedava, bilirsin. Yani sana bir tane satabilmem icin önce envanterinde yer acman gerekecek.

english: That's true; us Master Farmers are a unique breed.
translation: Dogru, biz usta ciftciler essiz bir türüz.

english: May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: Pelerinim icin bir baslik daha alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: Martin hands you another hood for your skillcape.
translation: Martin, beceri pelerinine uygun bir baslik daha verir.

english: Hello.
I can't chat right now, I have too many things to worry about.
translation: Su anda sohbet edemem, kafamda cok fazla sey var.

english: You do not meet the requirements to start the Fairytale I - Growing Pains quest.
translation: Fairytale I - Growing Pains görevini baslatmak icin gerekli sartlari saglamiyorsun.

english: Anything I can help with?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: I certainly could do with some help.
So tell me about your problems.
It all seemed to start about a month ago. I grow roses, you know?
translation: Her sey yaklasik bir ay önce basladi. Ben gül yetistiriyorum, biliyor musun?

english: Um, you seem to be getting side-tracked already.
translation: Sey, simdiden konudan sapmaya basladin galiba.

english: What? Oh sorry.
As I was saying about a month ago I noticed that the yield on my prize rose bushes had dropped slightly. I immediately suspected Crown Gall, a disease that can be fatal to a Mister Lincoln.
translation: Dedigim gibi, yaklasik bir ay önce, ödüllü gül calilarimin veriminin biraz düstügünü fark ettim. Hemen Mister Lincoln icin ölümcül olabilecek bir hastalik olan Crown Gall'dan süphelendim.

english: You're not making much sense. Who's Mister Lincoln?
translation: Söylediklerin pek mantikli gelmiyor. Mister Lincoln kim?

english: Sorry, Mister Lincoln's are the variety of roses that I specialise in. None of the plants showed any other symptoms of the disease though. Then I noticed a reduced yield occurring in most of my other crops too.
translation: Üzgünüm, Mister Lincoln benim uzmanlastigim gül cesididir. Ancak hicbir bitki bu hastaligin baska belirtilerini göstermiyordu. Sonra diger mahsullerimin cogunda da verim düsüsü oldugunu fark ettim.

english: I spoke to other gardeners that I know, and they had all noticed similar problems.
translation: Tanidigim diger bahcivanlarla konustum ve hepsi de benzer sorunlar fark etmislerdi.

english: Vegetable patches are growing fewer vegetables, bushes are producing fewer berries and everything that is planted seems to be more prone to disease!
translation: Sebze tarlalarinda daha az sebze yetisiyor, calilar daha az meyve veriyor ve ekilen her sey hastaliga daha yatkin görünüyor!

english: You've done some farming, haven't you noticed a decrease in the amount of produce you are getting lately?
translation: Sen de biraz ciftcilik yapiyorsun, son zamanlarda ürün miktarinda bir azalma fark etmedin mi?

english: Now that I think about it, you're right!
I know I am. Depressing isn't it?
translation: Ben fark ettim. Üzücü, degil mi?

english: No, can't say that I have.
That's not very observant of you.
translation: Bu pek dikkatli bir davranis degil.

english: So what do you want me to do?
I'd like you to find out what is causing this terrible problem and to try and rectify whatever the problem is.
translation: Bu korkunc sorunun nedenini bulmani ve sorunu ne olursa olsun düzeltmeye calismani istiyorum.

english: Do you have any ideas where I should start?
translation: Nereden baslamam gerektigi konusunda bir fikrin var mi?

english: If I were you I would start by speaking to some of the other gardeners.
translation: Senin yerinde olsam, diger bahcivanlarla konusarak baslardim.

english: This doesn't sound like something I can help with. Good luck.
translation: Bu, benim yardimci olabilecegim bir sey gibi görünmüyor. Iyi sanslar.

english: Oh dear. I hope you can sort them out by yourself.
translation: Oh, hayir. Umarim kendi basina cözebilirsin.

english: I'm not sure if I can, but I guess I have to try.
translation: Yapabilir miyim emin degilim, ama denemem gerek sanirim.

english: What is the banner for?
That banner is the emblem of the Group of Advanced Gardeners. We're a loosely affiliated group of gardeners that are united in our concern for declining vegetable production.
translation: Bu afis, Ileri Düzey Bahcivanlar Grubu'nun amblemi. Biz, sebze üretiminin azalmasi konusunda endiselenen, gevsek bir sekilde birbirine bagli bir bahcivanlar grubuyuz.

english: Err, of course you are.
Say, you're a brave adventurer, would you be interested in trying to get to the root of our woes? There would be a cash reward if you could help us.
translation: Sen cesur bir maceracisin, sorunlarimizin kaynagini bulmaya calismak ister misin? Bize yardim edersen nakit ödül alacaksin.

english: Of course I'll help.
I'm so glad to hear it.
You don't look it.
Sorry, what was that?
Oh, nothing. Don't worry about it.
Sorry, I have better things to do.
Oh. Oh dear. Oh well, if there's nothing I can do to make you change your mind...
translation: Oh. Oh, hayir. Peki, fikrini degistirmene yardimci olacak bir sey yapamiyorsam...

english: No, nothing. My mind is made up.
Well come back and chat to me if you change it.
Have you spoken to any other members of the Gardening Group yet?
translation: Bahcecilik Grubu'nun diger üyeleriyle konustun mu?

english: No, I haven't had a chance yet.
Well please hurry, otherwise I won't be able to make enough produce to feed my 13 children soon.
translation: Lütfen acele et, yoksa yakinda 13 cocugumu besleyecek kadar ürün yetistiremeyecegim.

english: I have spoken to one of your members and they reckon that it's the lack of rain that we've had recently.
translation: Üyelerinizden biriyle konustum ve son zamanlarda yagmur yagmamasi nedeniyle böyle oldugunu düsünüyorlar.

english: I'm afraid that can't be the problem. It never rains on the farming patches, that's why we have to water the crops.
translation: Korkarim sorun bu olamaz. Tarim alanlarinda hic yagmur yagmaz, bu yüzden ekinleri sulamak zorundayiz.

english: Oh yeah. I hadn't thought of that.
Go chat to some other group members. Maybe somebody has a different idea.
translation: Diger grup üyeleriyle konusun. Belki baska bir fikri olan vardir.

english: Hello again, [player]. How are you getting on with solving the Gardening Group's problems?
translation: Merhaba tekrar, maceraci. Bahcecilik Grubu'nun sorunlarini cözme konusunda nasil gidiyorsun?

english: (Same as above, the player goes through what the gardeners have told them.)
To be honest I'm worried about the sort of person you let join your organisation.
translation: Dürüst olmak gerekirse, organizasyonuna kabul ettigin türden insanlardan endise duyuyorum.

english: Why is that?
I've heard theories ranging from climate change to fairies from your members.
translation: Üyelerinden iklim degisikliginden perilere kadar cesitli teoriler duydum.

english: Hmm, that's an interesting idea. Now that I think about it that does make some sense. Yes, maybe you should talk to a fairy about it.
translation: Hmm, ilginc bir fikir. Simdi düsündüm de, mantikli geliyor. Evet, belki de bir periyle konusmalisin.

english: O-kay! You're the boss, any idea which flower I should look under to find a fairy?
translation: Tamam! Patron sensin, periyi bulmak icin hangi cicegin altina bakmam gerektigini biliyor musun?

english: No, sorry, but I did hear that there were some adventurers with a similar problem in the swamps near Lumbridge. Just don't mention my name if you talk to them, they're trying to keep it a secret, but everybody
translation: Hayir, üzgünüm, ama Lumbridge yakinlarindaki batakliklarda benzer bir sorunu olan bazi maceracilar oldugunu duydum. Onlarla konusursan benim adimi sakin verme, bunu sir olarak saklamaya calisiyorlar ama aslinda herkes

english: actually knows what they're up to.
Yes, I've spoken to them before.
Hello again, [player]. Our crops are still failing. Please do something fast or we will all go out of business.
translation: Merhaba tekrar, maceraci. Mahsullerimiz hala kötü gidiyor. Lütfen bir an önce bir seyler yap yoksa hepimiz iflas edecegiz.

english: Don't worry, I'm working on it.
Please hurry. Things are getting dire!
translation: Lütfen acele et. Durum gittikce kötülesiyor!

english: I've solved your problems! I've returned the Fairy Queen's magical essence!
translation: Sorunlarinizi cözdüm! Peri Kralicesi'nin sihirli özünü geri getirdim!

english: What are you talking about?

The Fairy Queen was in an enchanted sleep, because the Tanglefoot had taken the secateurs that contained her magic. I fought and killed it the Tanglefoot and have given the Godfather the Fairy Queen's secateurs. She'll
translation: Peri Kralicesi, Tanglefoot onun sihrini iceren budama makasini aldigi icin büyülü bir uykudaydi. Tanglefoot ile savasip onu öldürdüm ve Peri Kralicesi'nin budama makasini Godfather'a verdim.

english: wake up now and everything will get back to normal.
translation: Simdi uyanacak ve her sey normale dönecek.

english: I'm glad to hear it, but if you don't mind I'll go and plant some seeds now and wait until they grow before I give you the reward that I promised.
translation: Bunu duyduguma sevindim, ama sakincasi yoksa simdi gidip biraz tohum ekecegim ve büyümelerini bekleyecegim, sonra sana söz verdigim ödülü verecegim.

english: I guess it does sound rather far-fetched. Ok, I'll come back and see you after your crops have had a chance to grow.
translation: Sanirim bu biraz abartili geliyor. Tamam, ekinlerin büyüdükten sonra gelip seni görecegim.

english: Great! I'll see you soon then.
So, have your vegetables grown yet?
Stop being so impatient, [player]. They'll grow in their own good time - come back later.
translation: Sabirsizlanma, maceraci. Kendi zamanlarinda büyüyecekler, daha sonra tekrar gel.

english: Hello Martin, you must be the slowest gardener in the world! I don't suppose those crops have grown yet?
translation: Merhaba Martin, sen dünyadaki en yavas bahcivan olmalisin! O ekinler henüz büyümedi herhalde?

english: Well, you've got a nerve showing up around here again!
What? What are you talking about?
You told me that you'd solved the problems of the Gardening Group's members, well I've planted loads of seeds since then and there's no doubt that even more plants are dying!
translation: Bahcecilik Grubu üyelerinin sorunlarini cözdügünü söylemistin, o zamandan beri bir sürü tohum ektim ve daha fazla bitkinin öldügüne süphe yok!

english: But I gave Fairy Queen's secateurs back to Godfather, things should be growing again.
translation: Ama Peri Kralicesi'nin budama makasini Godfather'a geri verdim, her sey tekrar büyümeye baslamali.

english: Yeah, sure, whatever. You know, I didn't believe you when you told me a story about 'the fairies' in the first place. You'd just better solve this problem, when people get hungry, they get angry and when you're the
translation: Tabii, neyse. Biliyorsun, bana “periler” hakkinda hikaye anlattiginda sana inanmamistim. Bu sorunu cözsen iyi olur, insanlar aciktiklarinda sinirlenirler ve her seyin yoluna girecegini söyleyen kisi sen oldugun icin

english: person who said that everything would be all right, so you're the person who they'll get angry with!
I suppose I'd better go and see what the problem is then.
translation: O zaman gidip sorunun ne oldugunu baksam iyi olacak.

english: I've done enough for you, sort it out yourself!
translation: Senin icin yeterince sey yaptim, kendin hallet!

english: Hello again, [player]. Our crops are still failing. Please do something fast, the food reserves are starting to fail. People will start to realise that there is an imminent food crisis soon!
translation: Merhaba tekrar, maceraci. Mahsullerimiz hala yetersiz. Lütfen cabuk bir seyler yap, gida rezervleri tükenmeye basladi. Insanlar yakinda bir gida krizi olacagini fark etmeye baslayacaklar!

english: Okay, this time I've really solved your problems! I've woken up the Fairy Queen!
translation: Tamam, bu sefer sorunlarinizi gercekten cözdüm! Peri Kralicesini uyandirdim!

english: Hmm, right. You'll forgive me if I reserve judgement on this until I actually have some crops grow.
translation: Hmm, tamam. Mahsullerim yetisene kadar bu konuda kararimi sakli tutarsam beni affedersin.

english: Of course. The problem was the Godfather, he wanted to take control of Zanaris himself, so he didn't give Fairy Nuff the Queen's secateurs!
translation: Tabii ki. Sorun Godfather'di, Zanaris'i kendisi kontrol etmek istedigi icin Fairy Nuff'a Kralicenin budama makasini vermedi!

english: Godfather...Fairy Nuff...the Queen, I don't know what you're talking about and I don't care. I just want my crops to start growing again. Come back and claim your reward once they've had a chance to grow.
translation: Godfather... Peri Nuff... Kralice, neden bahsettigini bilmiyorum ve umurumda da degil. Sadece mahsulümün tekrar büyümeye baslamasini istiyorum. Mahsulün büyüdükten sonra geri gelip ödülünü al.

english: Cor blimey mate, what are ye doing in me pockets?
translation: Haydi ama dostum, cebimde ne yapiyorsun?

english: You're the thief who stole from me!
Guards, guards!
Ask about the Skillcape of Farming.
translation: Ciftcilik Beceri Örtüsü hakkinda soru sor.

english: Skillcape
I'm not paying that!
Sure, not many people own one.
translation: Elbette, pek cok kisi buna sahip degil.

english: Hood
Ask about the quest.
Anything I can help with?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Now that I think about it, you're right!
No, can't say that I have.
Yes.
No.
Oh dear. I hope you can sort them out by yourself.
translation: Oh hayir. Umarim kendi basina halledebilirsin.

english: What is the banner for?
Of course I'll help.
Sorry, I have better things to do.
Hi.
Hello! What can I do for you today?
translation: Merhaba! Bugün senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: Who are you?
I'm Marwolaeth, bringer of prophecy.
It's nice to meet you Marwolaeth, I'm [player name].
translation: Tanistigimiza memnun oldum Marwolaeth, ben Maceraci.

english: And it's great to meet you, [player name].
translation: Ve seninle tanistigima cok memnun oldum, Maceraci.

english: What do you do here?
I'm the local wisdom, my dreams are those of prophecy. Would you care for a reading?
translation: Ben bu bölgenin bilgesi, rüyalarim kehanet niteliginde. Bir fal bakmami ister misin?

english: Yes, tell me of my future...
I see a blinding light! A fire so big the heavens can see it; all those who look upon the great flame struggle to look away.
translation: Kör edici bir isik görüyorum! Göklerin görebilecegi kadar büyük bir ates; bu büyük alevi gören herkes gözlerini baska yere cevirmekte zorlaniyor.

english: I see a darkness so thick, light fails to escape it - A shadow world where up is down and right is wrong.
translation: Isigin kacamadigi kadar yogun bir karanlik görüyorum - Yukarisi asagi, dogruyu yanlisin oldugu bir gölge dünyasi.

english: I see peace and prosperity - The air is filled with wonderous bird song and the scent of earth and river.
translation: Baris ve refah görüyorum - Hava, muhtesem kus sesleri ve toprak ile nehrin kokusuyla dolu.

english: What's that supposed to mean?
It isn't my place to derive meaning. Allow my foretelling to guide your future but do not rely upon it happening all by itself. We are the arbiters of our own destiny.
translation: Anlamini cikarmak bana düsmez. Kehanetim gelecegine rehberlik etsin ama her seyin kendiliginden olacagina güvenme. Kendi kaderimizin hakemi biziz.

english: That's really quite vague, do you just say this to everyone?
translation: Bu gercekten cok belirsiz, bunu herkese mi söylüyorsun?

english: It's your choice to believe, not mine.
Oh, alright... Thanks, I suppose.
You're most welcome, [player name].
Was there anything else you wanted?
Hmm, no thanks...
Are you sure?
I'd prefer to stay ignorant... Who knows what that knowledge could do to a person...
translation: Cahil kalmayi tercih ederim... O bilgi bir insana ne yapabilir kim bilir...

english: A blissful existence may be the correct path.
translation: Mutlu bir yasam dogru yol olabilir.

english: Can you tell me about this place?
I can! This is the quaint town of Gwenith. All those who have been granted access to the great crystal city of Prifddinas are welcome here.
translation: Tabii! Burasi sirin Gwenith kasabasi. Büyük kristal sehir Prifddinas'a giris izni verilen herkes buraya gelebilir.

english: What's with that creepy mountain?
Ah... It is expected for an outsider like yourself to notice the mountain wonder how we exist in its shadow.
translation: Ah... Senin gibi bir yabancinin dagi fark etmesi ve gölgesinde nasil yasadigimizi merak etmesi normaldir.

english: We leave the mountain alone and it lets us live peacefully, out of sight of any passing boats.
translation: Dagi rahat birakirsak, o da bizi rahat birakir ve gecen teknelerden uzak, huzur icinde yasamamiza izin verir.

english: It? The mountain is conscious?
Of course! At the very top of the mountain sits a ruin. Whatever calamity happened there; their ghosts remain.
translation: Elbette! Dagin en tepesinde bir harabe var. Orada ne felaket yasandiysa, hayaletleri hala orada.

english: G-g-ghosts?!
Yes. Explore at your own peril, [player name]. There are those who have looked for answers from these mynydd spirits. They never return.
translation: Evet. Kendi sorumlulugunda kesfet, Maceraci. Bu mynydd ruhlarindan cevap arayanlar var. Onlar asla geri dönmüyorlar.

english: That doesn't necessarily mean they died... They may have found the meaning that they desired and have gone elsewhere.
translation: Bu mutlaka öldükleri anlamina gelmez... Belki de aradiklari anlami bulmuslar ve baska bir yere gitmislerdir.

english: Elsewhere? Indeed... As I said, [player name], explore at your own peril. Was there anything else you wanted?
translation: Baska bir yere mi? Evet... Dedigim gibi, Maceraci, kendi sorumlulugunda kesfet. Baska bir sey var miydi?

english: Bye!
Farewell, adventurer.
Who are you?
What do you do here?
Yes, tell me of my future...
Hmm, no thanks...
Can you tell me about this place?
Bye!
Is it over?
I can't hear anything? It might be?
translation: Hicbir sey duymuyorum? Öyle olabilir mi?

english: Is someone in there?
N-n-n-no... go away...
Oh okay, fair enough.
Wait! Come back, we need your help.
translation: Bekle! Geri gel, yardimina ihtiyacimiz var.

english: Jack Frost locked us in here when he stormed into our bakery. We tried to stop him from messing up our production, but he got grumpy.
translation: Jack Frost firinimiza saldirdiginda bizi buraya kilitledi. Üretimimizi bozmasini engellemeye calistik ama sinirlendi.

english: I ran into one of your bakers outside, he said you were in trouble.
translation: Disarida firincilarinizdan birine rastladim, basinizin dertte oldugunu söyledi.

english: Oh Remy is still alive! We thought Jack fed him to the Icelord.
translation: Remy hala hayatta! Jack'in onu Buz Lordu'na yem yaptigini saniyorduk.

english: Where's the key? The door looks locked to me.
I thought you had it, Mary.
Well I thought you had it, Paul.
translation: Ben de senin oldugunu saniyordum Paul.

english: Don't you think I'd have opened the door if I had it?
translation: Eger bende olsaydi kapiyi acmaz miydim sence?

english: Don't you think I would have opened the door as well!
translation: Ben de kapiyi acmaz miydim sence!

english: Great, now I'm locked in here with you for the rest of my life.
translation: Harika, simdi hayatimin geri kalanini seninle burada kilitli kalacagim.

english: Woah calm down! If it's not in there, it must be out here. Let me look for it.
translation: Sakin ol! Eger iceride degilse, disarida olmali. Ben bakayim.

english: RAAAAAAAAAAAWR
The Icelord sees you trying to enter their cage and blasts you backwards.
translation: Buz Lordu, kafesine girmeye calistigini görüyor ve seni geriye dogru firlatiyor.

english: Ooooh that sounds like it hurt!
Are you okay dear? That sounded quite nasty.
Well, I found the key.
That's great, come on let us out then.
Yes hurry up, we need to get back on schedule.
translation: Evet, acele et, programa yetismemiz lazim.

english: That's going to be a problem, it's in the cage with the Icelord.
translation: Bu sorun olacak, anahtar Buz Lordu'nun kafesinde.

english: I've got no way to get it with the Icelord there.
translation: Buz Lordu oradayken anahtari almamin imkani yok.

english: Did you try telegrabbing it?
I'm stumped, I can't find the key.
You've looked around the bakery and no luck?
If it's not in here or in the back room, it must be in the cage with the Icelord.
translation: Burada ya da arka odada degilse, Icelord'un kafesinde olmali.

english: It wouldn't be safe to go in there.
Could you try telegrabbing it?
That won't work, the Icelord's magic will interfere.
translation: Bu ise yaramaz, Icelord'un büyüsü engel olur.

english: Hmm... You're going to need a way to protect yourself from the Icelord.
translation: Hmm... Icelord'dan kendini korumak icin bir yol bulmalisin.

english: Don't suppose you have an Anti-Icelord Shield lying around here then?
translation: Burada Anti-Icelord Kalkani falan yok mu?

english: I don't, do you Paul?
No I don't...
But I do have a genius idea, we'll use Gingerbread!
translation: Ama harika bir fikrim var, zencefilli kurabiyeyi kullanacagiz!...

english: Before Jack locked us up, I saw him using the Icelord to ice his Gingerbread Gnomes. They did a great job of absorbing his breath.
translation: Jack bizi kilitlemeden önce, Icelord'u zencefilli kurabiye cücelerini dondurmak icin kullandigini gördüm. Nefesini emmek icin harika bir is cikardilar.

english: You'll need to make a Gingerbread Gnome big enough to absorb the Icelord's breath.
translation: Icelord'un nefesini emecek kadar büyük bir Zencefilli Cüce yapmalisin.

english: How am I going to do that?
Our usual recipe uses: one cinnamon, one ginger, one flour and one egg, we put them into that big machine you see to your left.
translation: Her zamanki tarifimizde bir adet tarcin, bir adet zencefil, bir adet un ve bir adet yumurta kullaniyoruz, bunlari solunda gördügün büyük makineye koyuyoruz.

english: Try using more of each ingredient till you get the right combination? Possibly tripling the amount of each ingredient might work.
translation: Dogru kombinasyonu bulana kadar her malzemeyi daha fazla kullanmayi dene. Her malzemenin miktarini üc katina cikarmak ise yarayabilir.

english: This is such a ridiculous idea, guess I have no choice....
translation: Bu cok sacma bir fikir, sanirim baska secenegim yok...

english: Come back to us if you need some more help.
