translation: Daha fazla yardima ihtiyacin olursa bize gel.

english: I found the key!
That's great! Now hurry up and open the door.
translation: Harika! Simdi acele et ve kapiyi ac.

english: You release the bakers and give back their key...
translation: Firincilari serbest birak ve anahtarlarini geri ver...

english: There you go, unlocked without an issue.
translation: Iste oldu, sorunsuz bir sekilde kilit acildi.

english: Wow, you managed to do that so quickly! Without any help from us.
translation: Vay canina, bunu cok cabuk basardin! Bizim yardimimiz olmadan.

english: You're very impressive, what a coincidence that you knew to make a giant piece of gingerbread to protect yourself.
translation: Cok etkileyicisin, kendini korumak icin dev bir zencefilli kurabiye yapmayi bilmen ne tesadüf.

english: Ha ha, yeah, it was no problem.
Well, thanks for freeing us!
I can't believe that actually worked....
...Me too, I thought you'd be turned into icing for sure.
translation: ...Ben de, kesin sekerleme haline gelecegini düsünmüstüm.

english: So you're telling me you weren't even sure it would!?
translation: Yani ise yarayacagindan emin degildin, öyle mi?

english: It worked out didn't it? We're free to continue making Gingerbread Gnomes.
translation: Ise yaradi, degil mi? Zencefilli kurabiye cüceleri yapmaya devam edebiliriz.

english: That was extremely reckless, Paul, but you're right, it did work out in the end.
translation: Bu cok pervasizcaydi Paul, ama haklisin, sonunda ise yaradi.

english: ...fine. I should go tell Santa the good news, the bakery is back in operation.
translation: ...tamam. Noel Baba'ya iyi haberi vermeliyim, firin yeniden faaliyete gecti.

english: We'll be back in full production in no time!
translation: Kisa sürede tam kapasite üretime gececegiz!

english: What do we do about the Icelord in the cage?
Maybe Jack was onto something by using it to ice the Gingerbread Gnomes.
translation: Belki Jack, zencefilli kurabiye cüceleri buzlamak icin onu kullanarak bir sey bulmustur.

english: You should take the giant piece of gingerbread you made and show it to Santa, he'll know we're back in business then.
translation: Yaptigin dev zencefilli kurabiyeyi Noel Baba'ya göstermelisin, o zaman islerimizin yeniden basladigini anlar.

english: Alright, time for you to go, we need to get back into production.
translation: Tamam, gitme zamani, üretime geri dönmeliyiz.

english: Hello there. Is this your home?
It is. What brings you here?
I'm just looking around.
Well you won't find anything too exciting here I'm afraid. Just farming.
translation: Korkarim burada cok heyecan verici bir sey bulamazsiniz. Sadece ciftcilik yapiyoruz.

english: Well you have fun with it.
Well I have to say that mounted head looks awful.
translation: Sey, o kafanin duvara asilmasi cok kötü görünüyor.

english: Sorry.
Not to worry. If it keeps Gordon happy, so be it. Anyway, thank you for keeping our farm safe. With the beast dealt with, I've been able to get back to tanning again.
translation: Endiselenmeyin. Gordon mutlu oluyorsa, sorun yok. Her neyse, ciftligimizi güvende tuttugunuz icin tesekkürler. Canavarla isimiz bittigine göre, tekrar tabaklamaya baslayabilirim.

english: Could you tan something for me?
translation: Benim icin bir sey tabaklayabilir misin?

english: Of course.
Happy to have helped. All the best.
translation: Yardimci olabildigime sevindim. Her sey gönlünce olsun.

english: Good to see you again! Anything I can do for you?
translation: Seni tekrar görmek güzel! Senin icin yapabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: I'm good.
Could you tan something for me?
translation: Benim icin bir sey tabaklayabilir misin?

english: Happy to have helped. All the best.
translation: Yardimci olabildigime sevindim. Her sey gönlünce olsun.

english: I'm good.
Thank you for all your help in solving the murder.
translation: Cinayeti cözmemde yardim ettigin icin tesekkürler.

english: Ah! Welcome, newcomer. I am the Master Chef, Lev. It is here that I will teach you how to cook food truly fit for a king.
translation: Ah! Hos geldin, yeni gelen. Ben usta asci Lev. Burada sana bir krala layik yemekleri pisirmeyi ögretecegim.

english: I already know how to cook. Brynna taught me just now.
translation: Ben zaten yemek pisirmeyi biliyorum. Brynna az önce ögretti.

english: Hahahahahaha! You call THAT cooking? Some shrimp on an open log fire? Oh, no, no, no. I am going to teach you the fine art of cooking bread.
translation: Hahahahahaha! Sen buna yemek pisirme mi diyorsun? Acik ateste karides mi? Oh, hayir, hayir, hayir. Sana ekmek pisirme sanatini ögretecegim.

english: Time for you to learn the fine art of cooking bread.
Do you need something?
Tell me about making dough again.
It's quite simple. Just use a pot of flour on a bucket of water, or vice versa, and you'll make dough. You can fill a bucket with water at any sink.
translation: Oldukca basit. Bir kova suya bir tencere un ekle ya da tersini yap, hamurunu hazirla. Herhangi bir lavaboda kovayi suyla doldurabilirsin.

english: Do you need anything else?
translation: Baska bir seye ihtiyacin var mi?

english: Tell me about range cooking again.
translation: Bana tekrar ocakla yemek pisirmeyi anlat.

english: The range is the only place you can cook a lot of the more complex foods in Gielinor. To cook on a range, all you need to do is click on it. You'll need to make sure you have the required items in your inventory though.
translation: Ocak, Gielinor'da daha karmasik yemekleri pisirebilecegin tek yerdir. Ocakta yemek pisirmek icin tek yapman gereken üzerine tiklamaktir. Ancak, gerekli malzemelerin envanterinde oldugundan emin olmalisin.

english: Nothing thanks.
Tell me about making dough again.
Tell me about range cooking again.
translation: Bana tekrar ocakla yemek pisirmeyi anlat.

english: Nothing thanks.
Hello, and welcome to the Crafting Guild. Accomplished crafters from all over the land come here to use our top notch workshops.
translation: Merhaba, Crafting Guild'e hos geldiniz. Ülkenin dört bir yanindan yetenekli zanaatkarlar, birinci sinif atölyelerimizi kullanmak icin buraya gelirler.

english: Hey, what is that cape you're wearing? I don't recognise it.
translation: Hey, giydigin o pelerin nedir? Tanimiyorum.

english: This? This is a Skillcape of Crafting. It is a symbol of my ability as master of the Crafting Guild and it provides unlimited teleports here.
translation: Bu mu? Bu, Crafting Skillcape. Crafting Guild'in ustasi olarak yetenegimin sembolüdür ve buraya sinirsiz teleport saglar.

english: If you should ever achieve level 99 Crafting come and talk to me and we'll see if we can sort you out with one.
translation: Eger zanaatkarlik seviyen 99'a ulasirsa gelip benimle konus, sana bir tane ayarlayabilir miyiz bakalim.

english: Are you the person I need to talk to about buying a Skillcape of Crafting?
translation: Zanaatkarlik Beceri Pelerini satin almak icin konusmam gereken kisi sen misin?

english: I certainly am, and I can see that you are definitely talented enough to own one! The cape has a built-in teleport back to us at the guild too!
translation: Kesinlikle öyleyim ve senin bir tane sahibi olacak kadar yetenekli oldugunu görebiliyorum! Pelerin, loncaya geri isinlanma özelligine de sahip!

english: Unfortunately, being such a prestigious item, they are appropriately expensive. I'm afraid I must ask you for 99000 gold.
translation: Ne yazik ki, bu kadar prestijli bir esya oldugu icin fiyati da oldukca yüksek. 99.000 altin ödemeniz gerekiyor.

english: 99000 gold! Are you mad?
Not at all; there are many other adventurers who would love the opportunity to purchase such a prestigious item! You can find me here if you change your mind.
translation: Hic de degil; böyle prestijli bir esyayi satin alma firsatini kacirmak istemeyen bircok maceraci var! Fikrini degistirirsen beni burada bulabilirsin.

english: That's fine.
But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: Ama ne yazik ki, yanimda yeterince param yok.

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.
translation: Peki, paran oldugunda tekrar gelip beni gör.

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: Maalesef tüm Skillcapes sadece ücretsiz bir baslik ile satiliyor, bu bir beceri promosyonunun parcasi; bir alana bir bedava, bilirsin. Yani sana bir tane satabilmem icin önce envanterinde yer acman gerekiyor.

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: Harika! O pelerini gururla giy dostum.

english: May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: Pelerinim icin bir baslik daha alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
Where's your brown apron? You can't come in here unless you're wearing one.
translation: Kahverengi önlügün nerede? Önlügün yoksa buraya giremezsin.

english: Err... I haven't got one.
Welcome to the Guild of Master Craftsmen.
Yeah?
Hello.
Whassup?
So... are you here to give crafting tips?
translation: Yani... zanaat ipuclari vermek icin mi buradasin?

english: Dude, do I look like I wanna talk to you?
translation: Dostum, seninle konusmak istermisim gibi mi görünüyorum?

english: I suppose not.
Right on!
Yes.
No.
Skillcape
99000 gold! Are you mad?
That's fine.
Hood
Cor blimey mate, what are ye doing in me pockets?
translation: Haydi ama dostum, cebimde ne isin var sen?

english: Stuns the player, dealing 3 damage.
Hello there. How's it going?
Well the work is going well, so I'm very good, thank you.
translation: Isler iyi gidiyor, ben de cok iyiyim, tesekkürler.

english: Not too bad thanks.
I'm fine, how are you?
Very well, thank you.
Nilsal! I'm pretty good, thank you. It's always nice to be out in the sun.
translation: Nilsal! Ben gayet iyiyim, tesekkürler. Güneste olmak her zaman güzeldir.

english: Hello there! Nice weather we've been having. Perfect for a day outdoors!
translation: Merhaba! Hava cok güzel. Disarida gecirmek icin mükemmel bir gün!

english: Well, the work is going well, so I'm very good, thank you.
Hey newbie! I'm the Master Navigator - let's teach you how to get around.
translation: Selam caylak! Ben Usta Navigatörüm, sana burayi nasil gezebilecegini ögreteyim.

english: I can already walk around...
Ha. You've worked your way around to me, but this island is bigger than you think! I will show you by teaching you how to use the world map. First things first, you will need to open your world map.
translation: Ha. Bana kadar gelmeyi basardin, ama bu ada sandigindan daha büyük! Sana dünya haritasini nasil kullanacagini ögreterek gösterecegim. Öncelikle, dünya haritasini acman gerekiyor.

english: You can find this in the top right side of the screen, look for the flashing globe icon.
translation: Bunu ekranin sag üst kösesinde, yanip sönen küre simgesinde bulabilirsin.

english: Well done, you have found your world map.
The world map can show where you are in the world, as well as where other places are. You can find where you are by looking for the yellow X icon.
translation: Dünya haritasi, dünyada nerede oldugunu ve diger yerlerin nerede oldugunu gösterebilir. Sari X simgesini arayarak nerede oldugunu bulabilirsin.

english: You may have noticed all the icons on the map, these icons have a meaning behind each one. You can find out what the icon means by looking at the map key.
translation: Haritada tüm simgeleri fark etmis olabilirsin, bu simgelerin her birinin bir anlami vardir. Simgenin ne anlama geldigini harita anahtarindan ögrenebilirsiniz.

english: To open or close the map key you will have to click the scroll looking icon in the bottom left part of the map.
translation: Harita anahtarini acmak veya kapatmak icin haritanin sol alt kismindaki kaydirma simgesine tiklamaniz gerekir.

english: Once opened, you will see a list of all the different icons on the map, as well as some text next to the icon telling you what the icon is. You can click on an icon in the key.
translation: Anahtar acildiginda, haritadaki tüm farkli simgelerin bir listesini ve simgenin ne oldugunu aciklayan simgenin yanindaki metni göreceksiniz. Anahtardaki bir simgeye tiklayabilirsiniz.

english: Every icon that is the same as the one you just selected, will start to flash.
translation: Sectiginiz simgeyle ayni olan tüm simgeler yanip sönmeye baslayacaktir.

english: Lastly, next to the key you will see there is a search bar. You can click on the search bar and type in a location. You can then press enter and the map will move to the specified location.
translation: Son olarak, anahtarin yaninda bir arama cubugu göreceksiniz. Arama cubuguna tiklayip bir konum yazabilirsiniz. Ardindan Enter tusuna basarsaniz harita belirtilen konuma gidecektir.

english: Now you know the basics of the world map, I am going to task you with making your way to the Quest Guide. You can find him just north of here. Go out the door to the west and follow the path.
translation: Artik dünya haritasinin temellerini ögrendiginize göre, size Görev Rehberi'ne gitme görevi verecegim. Onu buradan biraz kuzeyde bulabilirsiniz. Bati kapisindan cikin ve yolu takip edin.

english: Remember that your world map is just a larger version of your mininmap, with the difference that you can click on your minimap to navigate around. You will also see icons on your minimap as well, just like the world map.
translation: Dünya haritanizin, mini haritanizin daha büyük bir versiyonu oldugunu unutmayin. Aradaki fark, mini haritanizi tiklayarak gezinebilmenizdir. Mini haritanizda da dünya haritasinda oldugu gibi simgeler göreceksiniz.

english: Thanks for the lesson, I'll go find the Quest Guide now.
translation: Ders icin tesekkürler, simdi Görev Rehberi'ni bulmaya gidecegim.

english: Hey newbie, can I help you at all?
Tell me about the world map again.
Why do you have a meat cleaver?
*Sigh*
That's kind of a sore subject. But if you must know, I used to be a chef here on the island.
translation: Bu biraz hassas bir konu. Ama bilmek istiyorsan, eskiden bu adada asciydim.

english: But people thought that learning how to cook bread after cooking shrimp was useless. So now I teach players how to navigate the world instead.
translation: Ama insanlar, karides pisirdikten sonra ekmek pisirmeyi ögrenmenin gereksiz oldugunu düsündüler. Simdi ise oyunculara dünyayi nasil gezineceklerini ögretiyorum.

english: Is there anything else you would like to grill me on?
translation: Bana soracagin baska bir sey var mi?

english: Nope, I'm ready to move on!
Get moving then.
Tell me about the world map again.
Why do you have a meat cleaver?
Nope, I'm ready to move on!
Hello, I'm afraid only the top fishers are allowed to use our premier fishing facilities.
translation: Merhaba, maalesef sadece en iyi balikcilar birinci sinif balikcilik tesislerimizi kullanabilir.

english: Hello, welcome to the fishing guild.  Please feel free to make use of any of our facilities.
translation: Merhaba, balikcilik loncasina hos geldiniz. Lütfen tesislerimizi dilediginiz gibi kullanin.

english: Can you tell me about that skillcape you're wearing?
I'm happy to, my friend. This beautiful cape was presented to me in recognition of my skills and experience as a fisherman and I was asked to be the head of this guild at the same time.
translation: Seve seve, dostum. Bu güzel pelerin, balikci olarak becerilerim ve tecrübem nedeniyle bana hediye edildi ve ayni zamanda bu loncaya baskan olmam istendi.

english: As the best fisherman in the guild it is my duty to control who has access to the guild and to say who can buy similar skillcapes and the cape can even teleport you right inside the guild.
translation: Loncanin en iyi balikcisi olarak, loncaya kimlerin girebilecegini kontrol etmek ve benzer beceri pelerinlerini kimlerin satin alabilecegini belirlemek benim görevimdir. Bu pelerin sizi loncaya isinlayabilir.

english: I'm happy to say that being such a fine fisher yourself, I'm happy to offer you the opportunity to purchase a fine skillcape just like this one, it can even teleport you right inside the guild. Are you interested? It would cost
translation: Sizin de cok iyi bir balikci oldugunuzu görmekten mutluluk duyuyorum. Size de bunun gibi güzel bir beceri pelerini satin alma firsati sunmaktan mutluluk duyarim. Bu pelerin sizi loncaya isinlayabilir. Ilgilendiginiz var mi? Fiyati

english: 99000 coins.
Yes, please.
But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: Ama maalesef yanimda yeterince param yok.

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.
translation: Peki, paran oldugunda tekrar gelip beni gör.

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: Maalesef tüm Skillcapes sadece ücretsiz bir baslik ile satiliyor, bu bir beceri promosyon anlasmasinin parcasi; bir alana bir bedava, bilirsin. Yani sana bir tane satabilmem icin önce envanterinde yer acman gerekecek.

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: Harika! O pelerini gururla giy dostum.

english: No, thanks.
Okay, suit yourself.
Yes
No
Yes.
No.
Hello.
Well met! Are you interested in hearing about the art of smithing?
translation: Tanistigimiza memnun oldum! Demircilik sanati hakkinda bilgi almak ister misin?

english: How can I train my smithing?
To be able to smith anything, you're going to need one of these beauties.
translation: Herhangi bir seyi demircilikle yapabilmek icin bu güzelliklerden birine ihtiyacin olacak.

english: I see you already have a hammer. Nice one.
translation: Görüyorum ki zaten bir cekicin var. Güzelmis.

english: You're going to need to get your hand on some metal bars. You could do this by mining your own ores and smelting them at a furnace.
translation: Biraz metal cubuk bulman gerekecek. Bunu kendi cevherlerini cikararak ve bir firinda eriterek yapabilirsin.

english: There is a furnace located in Lumbridge, just north of the castle opposite the general store.
translation: Lumbridge'de, kalenin hemen kuzeyinde, genel magazanin karsisinda bir firin var.

english: If you are looking for some ore, there is a mine east of Varrock. There you can find some copper and tin ore. Don't forget to bring a pickaxe.
translation: Cevher ariyorsan, Varrock'un dogusunda bir maden var. Orada bakir ve kalay cevheri bulabilirsin. Kazma getirmeyi unutma.

english: When you have your bars, bring them to an anvil to open the smithing interface. If the item name is in black, this means you do not have the level to smith the item.
translation: Cubuklarinizi aldiginizda, bunlari bir örsün üzerine getirerek demircilik arayüzünü acin. Esya adi siyah renkteyse, bu esyayi demircilik yapmak icin gerekli seviyeye sahip olmadiginiz anlamina gelir.

english: If the item name is in white, this means you do have the level to smith the item. You will see the bars required to smith the item underneath the name of the item.
translation: Esya adi beyaz renkteyse, bu esyayi demircilik yapmak icin gerekli seviyeye sahip oldugunuz anlamina gelir. Esyanin adinin altinda, esyayi demircilik yapmak icin gerekli cubuklari göreceksiniz.

english: If the number of bars is in orange, this means you do not have enough bars to smith the item. If it is in green, this means you have enough bars for the item.
translation: Cubuklarin sayisi turuncu renkteyse, bu, ögeyi dövmek icin yeterli cubugunuz olmadigi anlamina gelir. Yesil renkteyse, bu, öge icin yeterli cubugunuz oldugu anlamina gelir.

english: Thanks for the advice.
Is there anything else you would like to know?
translation: Baska bilmek istediginiz bir sey var mi?

english: You might find it beneficial to keep a nice stack of bars in your bank before you start smithing. Unless you like to jump from task to task of course.
translation: Dövmeye baslamadan önce bankanizda güzel bir cubuk yigini bulundurmaniz faydali olabilir. Tabii ki, bir görevden digerine atlamayi sevmiyorsaniz.

english: If you want to smith something that you may not have the level for, you could try gaining some temporary knowledge in smithing from a boost.
translation: Seviye yetersizliginden dolayi dövmek istediginiz bir sey varsa, bir güclendirme ile gecici olarak dövme konusunda bilgi edinebilirsiniz.

english: You can buy a Dwarven stout at the Rising Sun Inn in Falador.
translation: Falador'daki Rising Sun Inn'de bir Dwarven stout satin alabilirsiniz.

english: If you are looking for a quest, you should talk to the squire in the courtyard of the white knight's castle. He is looking for a bit of help with something. I would recommend you be a little experienced with combat
translation: Bir görev ariyorsaniz, beyaz sövalyenin kalesinin avlusundaki silahtarla konusmalisiniz. Bir konuda biraz yardima ihtiyaci var. Ancak, savas konusunda biraz deneyimli olmanizi tavsiye ederim.

english: though.
Cor blimey, I don't think there is anything I can teach you, but I'll do my best.
translation: Vay canina, size ögretebilecegim bir sey oldugunu sanmiyorum, ama elimden geleni yapacagim.

english: As you get better you'll find you will be able to smith Mithril and eventually Adamantite and even Runite. This can be very lucrative but very expensive on the coal front.
translation: Daha iyi hale geldikce, Mithril ve sonunda Adamantite ve hatta Runite dövme yetenegi kazanacaksiniz. Bu cok kazancli olabilir, ancak kömür acisindan cok pahalidir.

english: It may be worth you stockpiling coal for a while before attempting these difficult metals or even sticking to good old reliable iron by the bucket load.
translation: Bu zor metallerle ugrasmaya baslamadan önce bir süre kömür stoklamaniz veya hatta eski, güvenilir demiri kova kova kullanmaya devam etmeniz faydali olabilir.

english: If you want to stop yourself from failing to smith iron, I suggest purchasing some rings of forging. Be aware that they will break after a certain number of bars are smelted.
translation: Demir dövmede basarisiz olmaktan kacinmak istiyorsan, dövme yüzükleri satin almani öneririm. Belirli sayida cubuk eritildikten sonra kirilacaklarini unutma.

english: If you want to save on coal, you could try smithing your bars over at the Blast Furnace in Keldagrim.
translation: Kömürden tasarruf etmek istiyorsan, cubuklarini Keldagrim'deki Yüksek Firin'da dövmeyi deneyebilirsin.

english: If you are looking for something more interesting to smith, you could talk to Otto Godblessed about smithing hastae.
translation: Daha ilginc bir sey dövmek istiyorsaniz, Otto Godblessed ile hastae dövme hakkinda konusabilirsiniz.

english: Though he may ask you to complete some tasks for him. You can find him south of the barbarian outpost and west of the whirlpool.
translation: Ancak size onun icin bazi görevleri tamamlamanizi isteyebilir. Onu barbar karakolunun güneyinde ve girdabin batisinda bulabilirsiniz.

english: What kind of things can I smith?
There are many things you can make, from weapons to your good old fashioned armour.
translation: Silahlardan eski moda zirhlara kadar bircok sey yapabilirsiniz.

english: Weapons are the cheapest to smith. They range from a measly one bar, all the way to three bars.
translation: Silahlar demircilik icin en ucuz esyalardir. Fiyatlari bir cubuktan üc cubuga kadar degisir.

english: Armour can be the costliest item to smith, the cost of each item ranges from a measly one bar all the way up to a whopping five bars.
translation: Zirhlar demircilik icin en pahali esyalardir, her birinin fiyati bir cubuktan bes cubuga kadar degisir.

english: Some weapons and armour, such as darts, will require you to have gained knowledge on how to smith them. This is due to the complex nature of the weapon.
translation: Dart gibi bazi silah ve zirhlar, bunlari demircilik icin gerekli bilgileri edinmis olmanizi gerektirir. Bunun nedeni, bu silahlarin karmasik yapisidir.

english: You might find that other items don't require conventional bars you would gather. Some may require you to piece blades back together or even infuse a crystal into a piece of armour.
translation: Diger esyalar icin topladiginiz geleneksel cubuklara ihtiyac duymayabilirsiniz. Bazilari bicaklari bir araya getirmenizi veya hatta bir zirh parcasina kristal eklemenizi gerektirebilir.

english: Is there anything else you want to know?
translation: Baska bilmek istediginiz bir sey var mi?

english: Not right now, thank you.
Well, just come back any time you want to know anything!
translation: Peki, ne zaman bir sey ögrenmek isterseniz gelin!

english: How can I train my smithing?
What kind of things can I smith?
Not right now, thank you.
Hello. Are you Josef's replacement?
Yes, I suppose I am.
It just goes to show how little Denath values us.
translation: Bu, Denath'in bize ne kadar az deger verdigini gösteriyor.

english: What do you mean?
Denath told us we would learn the secrets of demonic magic, but all we've done is memorize one incantation. And now he replaces poor Josef with the next person who comes along!
translation: Denath bize seytani büyünün sirlarini ögrenecegimizi söylemisti, ama tek yaptigimiz bir büyüyü ezberlemek oldu. Ve simdi zavalli Josef'in yerine ilk gelen kisiyi koyuyor!

english: Do you have the demonic sigil mould?
No, I think Jennifer has it.
Do you know what happened to Josef?
Shh! Listen, Denath doesn't know this...
When we joined him, Denath told us we were going to learn all the secrets of demonic magic, but we still don't know anything.
translation: Ona katildigimizda, Denath bize seytani büyünün tüm sirlarini ögrenecegimizi söyledi, ama hala hicbir sey bilmiyoruz.

english: The others, they just think they're terribly evil, with their sigils and the incantation they learned by rote. But Josef and I wanted more - we wanted to know how it worked.
translation: Digerleri, ögrendikleri mühürler ve büyülerle kendilerini cok kötü saniyorlar. Ama Josef ve ben daha fazlasini istiyorduk - nasil calistigini bilmek istiyorduk.

english: Josef was more curious than me. Last night, he secretly read a book that Denath was keeping from us. He didn't know I was awake, but I saw what happened.
translation: Josef benden daha merakliydi. Dün gece, Denath'in bizden sakladigi bir kitabi gizlice okudu. Benim uyanik oldugumu bilmiyordu, ama olanlari gördüm.

english: I saw him read it, and then his face turned white, and he took the book and ran through the portal.
translation: Onu okurken gördüm, sonra yüzü bembeyaz oldu, kitabi alip portaldan kacti.

english: But Denath was waking up, and when he saw Josef was gone he went through the portal to look for him. A bit later Denath returned, without Josef or the book.
translation: Ama Denath uyaniyordu ve Josef'in gittigini görünce onu aramak icin portaldan gecti. Biraz sonra Denath geri döndü, ama Josef ve kitap yoktu.

english: Josef didn't have money for the magic carpet, and he can't have got far in the desert at night with that heavy book.
translation: Josef'in sihirli hali icin parasi yoktu ve o agir kitapla geceleyin cölde cok uzaga gidemezdi.

english: Josef must have hidden the book somewhere in the ruins, before Denath followed him. If you could find it, we'd know what it was that frightened him. We'd know what Denath is really up to!
translation: Josef, Denath onu takip etmeden önce kitabi harabelerin bir yerine saklamis olmali. Eger kitabi bulabilirsen, onu korkutan seyin ne oldugunu ögrenebiliriz. Denath'in gercekte neyin pesinde oldugunu ögrenebiliriz!

english: Did you find that book?
I really want to know what's in it. I think Denath is hiding something from us, but we won't know what unless we read that book!
translation: Icinde ne oldugunu gercekten bilmek istiyorum. Bence Denath bizden bir sey sakliyor, ama o kitabi okumadan ne oldugunu bilemeyiz!

english: Yes. The golem saw Josef hide it in one of the broken kilns in the city.
translation: Evet. Golem, Josef'in onu sehirdeki kirik firinlardan birine sakladigini gördü.

english: Did the golem see what happened to Josef?
translation: Golem Josef'e ne oldugunu gördü mü?

english: It said Denath killed him.
Oh no!
I knew Denath was a dark wizard but I didn't think he'd kill one of his disciples.
translation: Denath'in karanlik bir büyücü oldugunu biliyordum ama ögrencilerinden birini öldürecegini düsünmemistim.

english: Let me look at the book then.
I don't understand. What's in here that Denath thought was worth killing over? Josef must have worked something out - but what?
translation: Anlamiyorum. Denath'in öldürmeye deger buldugu sey bu kitapta ne var? Josef bir sey bulmus olmali, ama ne?

english: But look at the incantation in the book. The words are in the reverse order to the order that Denath taught us.
translation: Ama kitaptaki büyüyü bir bak. Kelimeler Denath'in bize ögrettigi siranin tersi sirada.

english: The incantation in the book is backwards?
More likely the book has the correct incantation and the one Denath taught us was backwards. But what does that mean?
translation: Daha cok kitapta dogru büyü var ve Denath'in bize ögrettigi tersmis gibi görünüyor. Ama bu ne anlama geliyor?

english: Player, I'm not happy about this ritual. I don't think Agrith-Naar is going to grant all our wishes, I think he's going to kill us all. But if I try to stop it, Denath will kill me like he did Josef!
translation: Oyuncu, bu ritüelden hic hosnut degilim. Agrith-Naar'in tüm dileklerimizi yerine getirecegini sanmiyorum, bence hepimizi öldürecek. Ama bunu engellemeye calisirsam, Denath Josef'i öldürdügü gibi beni de öldürecek!

english: Don't worry. I'm here to kill the demon!
translation: Merak etme. Ben buradayim, iblisi öldürecegim!

english: This is the demon-slaying sword Silverlight, the only weapon that can kill Agrith-Naar!
translation: Bu, Agrith-Naar'i öldürebilecek tek silah olan iblis katili kilic Silverlight!

english: Thank goodness! I think Denath is nearly ready for the ritual. We must prepare!
translation: Tanriya sükür! Sanirim Denath ritüel icin neredeyse hazir. Hazirlanmaliyiz!

english: Oh my gods!
He disappeared!
Where'd he go?
Of course! How could we be so stupid?
translation: Tabii ya! Nasil bu kadar aptal olabildik?

english: What happened?
What do you get when you perform a summoning ritual backwards?
translation: Cagirma ritüelini tersine yaparsan ne olur?

english: Denath was Agrith-Naar all along! We've just helped him return to his own dimension!
translation: Denath basindan beri Agrith-Naar'di! Onun kendi boyutuna dönmesine yardim ettik!

english: What was that?!
Look! The portal's closing!
I'm getting out of here!
No, don't leave!
Who knows what Denath could do now?
translation: Denath simdi ne yapabilir kim bilir?

english: We've got to perform the ritual again so you can kill Agrith-Naar. But we need eight people!
translation: Agrith-Naar'i öldürebilmen icin ritüeli tekrar yapmaliyiz. Ama sekiz kisiye ihtiyacimiz var!

english: Quick, Player, you've got to get those three to come back! And you'd better take Denath's sigil and find one more person to help.
translation: Cabuk, Oyuncu, o ücünü geri getirmelisin! Denath'in mührünü alip yardim edecek bir kisi daha bulsan iyi olur.

english: We've got to perform the ritual again, forwards this time, so you can kill Agrith-Naar. I'll prepare for it here while you find four more people.
translation: Agrith-Naar'i öldürebilmen icin ritüeli tekrar yapmaliyiz, bu sefer ileriye dogru. Sen dört kisi daha bulurken ben burada hazirliklari yapacagim.

english: I don't understand what happened!
Denath must have been Agrith-Naar all along!
Ellemar's book said that Agrith-Naar can only use his powerful magics from the demon plane.
translation: Ellemar'in kitabinda Agrith-Naar'in güclü büyülerini sadece iblis düzleminde kullanabilecegi yaziyordu.

english: Ellemar must have trapped him in human form to stop him using his magics. That must be what the last pages of the book said.
translation: Ellemar, onun büyülerini kullanmasini engellemek icin onu insan formunda hapsetmis olmali. Kitabin son sayfalarinda böyle yaziyor olmali.

english: So the reason he assembled us was to send him back to his own plane, where he would be much more powerful! That's why the ritual was backwards!
translation: Yani bizi bir araya getirmesinin sebebi, onu kendi boyutuna geri göndermekti, orada cok daha güclü olacakti! Bu yüzden ritüel tersine yapildi!

english: He's already started to close the portal to trap us. Who knows what else he could do?
translation: Bizi hapsetmek icin portali kapatmaya basladi bile. Baska neler yapabilir kim bilir?

english: But if we can perform the ritual forwards then you can kill him using Silverlight and end his evil magics once and for all!
translation: Ama ritüeli dogru sekilde yapabilirsek, Silverlight'i kullanarak onu öldürebilir ve kötü büyülerine sonsuza kadar son verebilirsiniz!

english: Okay!
Hurry!
We've got eight people now. Are you ready to summon Agrith-Naar and slay him?
translation: Su anda sekiz kisiyiz. Agrith-Naar'i cagirip onu öldürmeye hazir misiniz?

english: No.
Do hurry! We haven't got much time!
Yes.
*gulp*  Okay, here we go...
Yes, I suppose I am.
Do you have the demonic sigil mould?
Do you know what happened to Josef?
Not yet.
I don't understand what happened!
Okay.
No.
Yes.
Hello there.
Greetings. Can I help you at all?
Do you have any quests I could do?
A quest? What a strange notion. Do you normally go around asking complete strangers for quests?
translation: Görev mi? Ne garip bir fikir. Normalde yabancilara görevler mi soruyorsun?

english: Er, yes, now you come to mention it.
translation: Sey, evet, simdi sen söyleyince aklima geldi.

english: Oh, ok then. Well, no, I don't; sorry.
translation: Oh, tamam o zaman. Hayir, yok, yok; üzgünüm.

english: What is this place?
A good question; straight and to the point.
translation: Iyi bir soru; dogrudan ve net.

english: My name is Matthias, I am a falconer, and this is where I train my birds.
translation: Benim adim Matthias, ben bir sahin avcisiyim ve burasi kuslarimi egittigim yer.

english: That sounds like fun; could I have a go?
translation: Kulaga eglenceli geliyor; ben de deneyebilir miyim?

english: Training falcons is a lot of work and I doubt you're up to the task. However, I suppose I could let you try hunting with one.
translation: Sahinleri egitmek cok zor bir istir ve senin bu görevi basarabilecegini sanmiyorum. Ancak, bir tanesiyle avlanmayi denemene izin verebilirim.

english: I have some tamer birds that I occasionally lend to rich noblemen who consider it a sufficiently refined sport for their tastes, and you look like the kind who might appreciate a good hunt.
translation: Zaman zaman, bunu zevklerine uygun bir spor olarak gören zengin soylulara ödünc verdigim bazi evcil kuslarim var ve sen iyi bir avi takdir edecek türden birine benziyorsun.

english: I'd have to request a small fee, mind you; how does 500 gold pieces sound?
translation: Kücük bir ücret talep etmem gerekecek, unutma; 500 altin nasil olur?

english: I'm afraid I don't have that much with me.
Ok, that seems reasonable.
Good, however you really need both hands free. I'd suggest that you put away your weapons and gloves before we start.
translation: Güzel, ancak iki elinin de serbest olmasi gerekiyor. Baslamadan önce silahlarini ve eldivenlerini cikarmani öneririm.

english: Good, however you really need both hands free. I'd suggest that you take off some of that kit you're wearing before we start.
translation: Güzel, ancak iki elinin de serbest olmasi gerekiyor. Baslamadan önce giydigin bazi esyalari cikarmani öneririm.

english: The falconer gives you a large leather glove and brings one of the smaller birds over to land on it.
translation: Sahin avcisi sana büyük bir deri eldiven verir ve daha kücük kuslardan birini eldivenin üzerine konmasi icin getirir.

english: Don't worry; I'll keep an eye on you to make sure you don't upset it too much.
translation: Merak etme, seni gözetim altinda tutacagim, böylece onu cok fazla rahatsiz etmezsin.

english: I'm not interested then, thanks.
Well, you're welcome to come back if you change your mind.
Absolutely, are you ready?
I am!
That doesn't sound like my sort of thing.
translation: Bu benim tarzim bir sey gibi gelmiyor.

english: Fair enough; it does require a great deal of patience and skill, so I can understand if you might feel intimidated.
translation: Haklisin; bu is cok sabir ve beceri gerektirir, bu yüzden cekindigini anlayabiliyorum.

english: What's this falconry thing all about then?
Well, some people see it as a sport, although such a term does not really convey the amount of patience and dedication required to be proficient at the task.
translation: Bazilari bunu bir spor olarak görür, ancak bu terim bu isi ustaca yapmak icin gereken sabir ve özveriyi tam olarak yansitmaz.

english: Putting it simply, it is the training and use of birds of prey in hunting quarry.
translation: Basitce söylemek gerekirse, av hayvanlarini avlamak icin yirtici kuslari egitmek ve kullanmaktir.

english: So it's like keeping a pet then?
translation: Yani evcil hayvan beslemek gibi bir sey mi?

english: Not exactly, no. Such a bird can never really be considered tame in the same way that a dog can.
translation: Tam olarak degil. Bu tür kuslar, köpekler gibi evcillestirilemez.

english: They can be trained to associate people or places with food though, and, as such, a good falconer can get a trained bird to do as he wishes.
translation: Ancak insanlari veya yerleri yiyecekle iliskilendirmek icin egitilebilirler ve bu sayede iyi bir sahin avcisi, egitilmis bir kusu istedigi gibi yönlendirebilir.

english: Could I have a go with your bird?
Could I invest in your setup here?
If you'd like to put money forward for training more falcons, be my guest!
translation: Daha fazla sahin yetistirmek icin para yatirmak istersen, buyur!

english: Would I get any benefit from this?
I suppose I could let you use my falcons for free if you stump up enough cash. How does 500,000 coins sound?
translation: Yeterince para yatirirsan, sahinlerimi ücretsiz kullanmana izin verebilirim. 500.000 altin nasil?

english: Ah, I don't have that much on me right now.
translation: Ah, su anda o kadar param yok.

english: Hmm, that seems a little steep. I'll think on it.
I appreciate that you want to invest more, but I really don't need it right now!
translation: Daha fazla yatirim yapmak istemenizi takdir ediyorum, ama su anda buna gercekten ihtiyacim yok!

english: Hello again.
Ah, you're back. How are you getting along with [him/her] then?
translation: Ah, geri dönmüssünüz. o ile nasil gidiyor?

english: It's certainly harder than it looks.
Sorry, but I was talking to the falcon, not you. But yes it is; have you had enough yet?
translation: Üzgünüm, ama sahinle konusuyordum, sizinle degil. Ama evet, zor; yeterince denediniz mi?

english: Actually, I'd like to keep trying a little longer.
Ok then, just come talk to me when you're done.
translation: Tamam o zaman, isin bittiginde gelip benimle konus.

english: I think I'll leave it for now.
You give the falcon and glove back to Matthias.
translation: Sahini ve eldiveni Matthias'a geri veriyorsun.

english: Do you have any quests I could do?
translation: Yapabilecegim herhangi bir görev var mi?

english: What is this place?
That sounds like fun; could I have a go?
translation: Kulaga eglenceli geliyor, ben de deneyebilir miyim?

english: Ok, that seems reasonable.
I'm not interested then, thanks.
That doesn't sound like my sort of thing.
translation: Bu benim tarzim bir sey degil.

english: What's this falconry thing all about then?
Could I have a go with your bird?
Could I invest in your setup here?
Yes
No
Actually, I'd like to keep trying a little longer.
I think I'll leave it for now.
Hello.
Hmm, yes... Hello!
...Are you busy?
Oh umm, no and yes. I'm forever observing, you see.
translation: Oh, hayir ve evet. Ben sürekli gözlem yaparim.

english: Observing what?
Oh, erm, birds! Yes, those feathery little flittery things.
translation: Oh, sey, kuslari! Evet, su tüylü, kücük, ucan seyleri.

english: Yes, I know what a bird is.
Do you though? The subtleties between different species of birds is quite incredible, you see-
translation: Öyle mi? Farkli kus türleri arasindaki incelikler oldukca inanilmaz, anlarsin ya...

english: But how could I attract them? Y'know, so I could observe them a little closer.
translation: Ama onlari nasil cekebilirim? Bilirsin, onlari biraz daha yakindan gözlemleyebilmek icin.

english: Ah yes, well, of course! I've travelled around this island and found the best spots for bird watching. I placed a ring of stones at these locations!
translation: Ah evet, tabii ki! Bu adayi dolastim ve kus gözlemlemek icin en iyi yerleri buldum. Bu yerlere taslardan bir halka yerlestirdim!

english: So those would be the best locations to place my traps...
translation: Yani tuzaklarimi yerlestirmek icin en iyi yerler bunlar...

english: Traps?! Preposterous! These fine exotic Birds are to be watched and not harmed in any way!
translation: Tuzaklar mi?! Sacma! Bu güzel egzotik kuslar gözlemlenmeli, hicbir sekilde zarar verilmemelidir!

english: Did I say traps? Oh, I meant, umm, feeding them! Yes! I could feed them.
translation: Tuzak mi dedim? Oh, demek istedigim, umm, onlari beslemek! Evet! Onlari besleyebilirim.

english: You should not interfere with the birds, just watch, no feeding them anything! Not even seeds!
translation: Kuslara müdahale etmemelisin, sadece gözlemle, onlara hicbir sey verme! Tohum bile verme!

english: Seeds you say...
You seem a little, twitchy...
Yes, well, perhaps a bit! There are new exotic birds everywhere on this island! I guess I'm getting a little over-excited.
translation: Evet, belki biraz! Bu adada her yerde yeni egzotik kuslar var! Sanirim biraz fazla heyecanlandim.

english: Yeah, there sure are a lot of birds... For now.
translation: Evet, gercekten cok fazla kus var... Simdilik.

english: It's my fathers fault entirely, constantly talking about falconry...
translation: Bu tamamen babamin sucu, sürekli sahin avciligi hakkinda konusuyor...

english: Your father is a hunter? Does he know anything about hunting birds?
translation: Baban avci mi? Kus avciligi hakkinda bir sey biliyor mu?

english: Umm, well of course, falcons ARE hunting birds, they mostly catch varying types of kebbits, it's rather mundane.
translation: Tabii ki, sahinler av kuslaridir, cogunlukla cesitli türlerde kebbit avlarlar, oldukca siradan bir seydir.

english: And mice?
Hmmm...
Goodbye.
...Oh, you're still here. What was that? Oh yes, bye for now!
translation: ...Oh, hâlâ buradasin. Ne dedin? Oh evet, simdilik hosca kal!

english: Observing what?
You seem a little, twitchy...
Goodbye.
I am proud that the helm of my ancestors will be worn in battle. I thank you on behalf of all my kinsmen, [Fremennik name].
translation: Atalarimin migferinin savasta giyilecek olmasindan gurur duyuyorum. Tüm akrabalarim adina sana tesekkür ederim, Dokrak.

english: I thank you again for presenting me with such a helm.
translation: Bana böyle bir migfer hediye ettigin icin tekrar tesekkür ederim.

english: Have you got any more of those helms?
What, the priceless heirloom that I gave to you as a sign of my trust and gratitude?
translation: Ne, sana güvenimin ve minnettarligimin bir göstergesi olarak verdigim paha bicilmez aile yadigari mi?

english: Err yes, that one. I may have mislaid it.
It's a good job I have alert and loyal men who notice when such a precious item is left laying around, and who pick it up.
translation: Neyse ki, böyle degerli bir esyanin ortada kaldigini fark eden ve onu alan uyanik ve sadik adamlarim var.

english: I'm afraid I'm going to have to charge you a 50,000 coin handling cost.
translation: Korkarim sana 50.000 sikke tutarinda bir islem ücreti talep etmek zorundayim.

english: Well, yes, I do. But I'm going to have to charge you 50,000 coins - these are precious, you know!
translation: Evet, var. Ama sana 50.000 sikke talep etmek zorundayim - bunlar cok degerli, biliyorsun!

english: Very well, I accept.
I don't think I can afford that, sorry.
Well, come back when you can.
You have done well, [player name]!
I thank you again for presenting me with such a helm.
translation: Bana böyle bir migfer sundugunuz icin tekrar tesekkür ederim.

english: Have you got any more of those helms?
Very well, I accept.
I don't think I can afford that, sorry.
Those children are nothing but trouble - if I did not watch them all the time, Seren knows what trouble they would get in to!
translation: Bu cocuklar bas belasi - onlari sürekli gözetlemesem, Seren bilir ne belaya bulasirlar!

english: They look old enough to look after themselves.
They are only 34 and 38, far too young to be left unsupervised.
translation: Sadece 34 ve 38 yasindalar, gözetimsiz birakilmak icin cok gencler.

english: Only!?! How old does that make you?
translation: Sadece!?! O zaman sen kac yasindasin?

english: Has no one told you it is rude to ask a lady her age?
translation: Bir bayana yasini sormak kabalik oldugunu kimse sana söylemedi mi?

english: Sorry, I wasn't thinking. Anyway... I'd better stop distracting you.
translation: Üzgünüm, düsünmeden konustum. Neyse... Seni daha fazla rahatsiz etmemeliyim.

english: Okay, See you some other time.
I can't thank you enough for what you did. My children might be dead if not for you.
translation: Yaptigin sey icin ne kadar tesekkür etsem azdir. Sen olmasaydin cocuklarim ölebilirdi.

english: It's not a problem.
You're a hero and all of us here know it. Again, thank you.
translation: Sen bir kahramansin ve buradaki hepimiz bunu biliyoruz. Tekrar tesekkürler.

english: Here, have this.
You've obtained a [new clue/casket]!
What do you think you're doing?
'Ello, and what are you after then?
I need another assignment.
You're actually very strong, are you sure you don't want Chaeldar in Zanaris to assign you a task?
translation: Aslinda cok güclüsün, Zanaris'teki Chaeldar'dan görev almak istemediginden emin misin?

english: No that's okay, I'll take a task from you.
translation: Hayir, sorun degil, senden bir görev alacagim.

english: Oh okay then, I'll go talk to Chaeldar.
translation: Tamam o zaman, Chaeldar ile konusacagim.

english: Excellent, you're doing great. Your new task is to kill [amount] [task monster].
Got any tips for me?
translation: Bana verebilecegin bir ipucu var mi?

english: Great, thanks!
Okay, great!
Good luck! Don't forget to come back when you need a new assignment.
translation: Iyi sanslar! Yeni bir görev istediginde geri gelmeyi unutma.

english: You're still hunting [task monster], you have [amount] to go. Come back when you've finished your task.
You're still hunting [monster], with [amount] to go.
I don't think that's a suitable task for you. Shall I cancel it? This will not wipe your task streaks.
translation: Bence bu görev sana uygun degil. Iptal edeyim mi? Bu, görev serini silmez.

english: Yes, please cancel it.
Alright, consider the task cancelled. You can now get a new assignment when you want one.
translation: Tamam, görev iptal edildi. Istediginiz zaman yeni bir görev alabilirsiniz.

english: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
Good luck with that.
Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: Bana verebileceginiz bir ödül veya takas edebileceginiz bir sey var mi?

english: I have quite a few rewards you can earn, and a wide variety of Slayer equipment for sale.
translation: Kazanabileceginiz pek cok ödül ve satilik cok cesitli Avci ekipmanlari var.

english: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
The Slayer Masters may currently assign you any task in our lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: Slayer Ustalar su anda savas seviyeniz ne olursa olsun listemizdeki herhangi bir görevi size verebilir.

english: That's fine - I can handle any task.
That's the spirit.
In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: Gelecekte lütfen cok zor görevler vermeyin.

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: Tamam, bundan sonra tüm Slayer Ustalar size görev secerken savas seviyenizi dikkate alacak, böylece cok zor görevler almayacaksiniz.

english: The Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: Avci Ustalar, size görev secerken savas seviyenizi dikkate alacaklar, bu yüzden cok zor görevler almayacaksiniz.

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
translation: Sorun degil, cok zor görevler istemiyorum.

english: Okay, we'll keep checking your combat level.
translation: Tamam, savas seviyenizi kontrol etmeye devam edecegiz.

english: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: Savas seviyemi kontrol etmeyi birakin, her seyi yapabilirim!

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will assign you anything from their lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: Tamam, bundan sonra tüm Avci Ustalar, savas seviyenize bakilmaksizin size listelerinden herhangi bir görev verecekler.

english: Er... Nothing...
'Ello, can I help you?
Hello?
'Ello, who's that?
I'm [player name]. I'm using my magic to communicate with you.
translation: Ben Maceraci. Sizinle iletisim kurmak icin büyümü kullaniyorum.

english: Bizarre, go on, what do you want then?
I need another assignment.
No that's okay, I'll take a task from you.
translation: Hayir, sorun degil, senden bir görev alacagim.

english: Oh okay then, I'll go talk to Chaeldar.
translation: Tamam o zaman, Chaeldar ile konusacagim.

english: Got any tips for me?
translation: Bana verebilecegin bir ipucu var mi?

english: Okay, great!
Yes, please cancel it.
No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: Bana verebilecegin bir ödül veya takas edebilecegin bir sey var mi?

english: Look at rewards.
Look at shop.
Cancel.
Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
That's fine - I can handle any task.
In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: Gelecekte lütfen cok zor görevler verme.

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
translation: Sorun degil, cok zor görevler istemiyorum.

english: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: Savas seviyemi kontrol etmeyi birak, her seyi yapabilirim!

english: Er... Nothing...
Err... Nothing...
Well done on releasing me. Would you like to try another maze?
translation: Beni serbest biraktigin icin tebrikler. Baska bir labirenti denemek ister misin?

english: Yes please!
No thanks.
Very well. Talk to me if you want to move onto the next maze, or you can return to the entrance hall through the portal.
translation: Peki. Bir sonraki labirente gecmek istersen bana söyle, ya da portaldan giris salonuna geri dönebilirsin.

english: Yes please!
No thanks.
Nice weather we're having today!
Hello [player name], fine day today!
translation: Merhaba Maceraci, bugün güzel bir gün!

english: Please leave me alone, a parrot stole my banana.
translation: Lütfen beni rahat birak, bir papagan muzumu caldi.

english: Are you me? Am I you?
translation: Sen ben misin? Ben sen miyim?

english: Leave me alone... Me...
You've got an outrageous accent, you silly thing!
translation: Agzindan cikanlar cok sacma, seni aptal sey!

english: How dare you! You know you're so ugly!
translation: Bu ne cüret! Cok cirkin oldugunu biliyorsun!

english: Call that an attack? Try this on for size!
translation: Buna saldiri mi diyorsun? Sunu bir dene bakalim!

english: Stop hitting yourself, stop hitting yourself!
translation: Kendine vurmayi birak, kendine vurmayi birak!

english: Oooo. Get you! Strong words from such a weed!
translation: Oooo. Yakaladim seni! Böyle bir otculdan sert sözler!

english: If I'm a weed what does that make you?
Hey! That's my line!
Do I look bothered?
You do know those clothes make you look fat!
translation: O kiyafetlerin seni sisman gösterdigini biliyor musun?

english: Hello!
'ello sail her!
Who are you?
I glamorous weather girl. I get weather numbers to learn how weather work.
translation: Ben göz alici hava durumu kiziyim. Hava durumunun nasil isledigini ögrenmek icin hava durumu rakamlarini aliyorum.

english: An unusual aspiration for a troll.
translation: Bir trol icin alisilmadik bir istek.

english: I like weather since I got my name. My first food gave me shiny weather number getter.
translation: Adimi aldigimdan beri hava durumunu seviyorum. Ilk yemegim bana parlak hava durumu rakamlari getirdi.

english: Can I help you with collecting weather data?
translation: Hava durumu verilerini toplamanda yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: You already get me weather number here. Was very tasty!
translation: Burada hava durumu rakamlarini zaten aldin. Cok lezzetliydi!

english: Goodbye!
Bye sail her!
Numbers so tasty. Weather here must be really good!
translation: Rakamlar cok lezzetli. Buradaki hava durumu gercekten cok iyi olmali!

english: Troll scientists really do operate on a higher level don't they?
translation: Trol bilim adamlari gercekten daha yüksek bir seviyede calisiyorlar, degil mi?

english: Soon I be smart enough to speak to rocks!
translation: Yakinda kayalarla konusacak kadar akilli olacagim!

english: Who are you?
Can I help you with collecting weather data?
translation: Hava durumu verilerini toplamanda yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: Goodbye!
Hi.
Hey! What can I do for ya' today?
translation: Hey! Bugün senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: Who are you?
I'm Meddwl, a simple forest dweller.
translation: Ben Meddwl, basit bir orman sakiniyim.

english: It's nice to meet you Meddwl, I'm [player name].
translation: Tanistigimiza memnun oldum Meddwl, ben Maceraci.

english: And it's great to meet you, [player name].
translation: Ben de tanistigimiza memnun oldum, Maceraci.

english: What do you do here?
I'm new here, I recently left my home of Gwenith.
translation: Buraya yeni geldim, kisa süre önce Gwenith'teki evimden ayrildim.

english: How come?
Gwenith may be in the forest, it is not part of the forest. I desired to be closer to nature.
translation: Gwenith ormanda olabilir, ama ormanin bir parcasi degil. Dogaya daha yakin olmak istedim.

english: A lovely idea, how's it going?
It's a harder living without the protection of four walls and a roof, but the peace is a wonderful thing to behold. Just listen...
translation: Dört duvar ve bir cati olmadan yasamak daha zor, ama huzur harika bir sey. Dinle...

english: Isn't it lovely?
It is! I feel almost lighter.
That's your demons flittering away, taken by the cool breeze of nature.
translation: Bu, doganin serin esintisiyle uzaklasan seytanlarin.

english: Any who, was there anything else you wanted?
translation: Neyse, baska bir sey ister miydin?

english: Bye!
Farewell, adventurer.
Who are you?
What do you do here?
Bye!
So what do you do?
I breed Terrorbirds.
Why are they called Terrorbirds?
Well, they're supposed to look terrifying but I think they are rather cute.
translation: Sey, korkutucu görünmeleri gerekiyor ama bence oldukca sevimliler.

english: I'm sure they are cute, unless they are biting your arm off.
translation: Eminim sevimlidirler, tabii kolunu isirmadiklari sürece.

english: Oh they'd never do that - unless I tell them to, of course.
translation: Oh, asla böyle bir sey yapmazlar - tabii ben söylemedikce.

english: I'd better stay on your good side then!
Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: Hazir yemekler maalesef ise yaramaz. Aluft Aloft'un müsterileri icin sadece el yapimi Cüce Mutfagi yeterince iyidir.

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Dalila
Ah, just in time for a break. Thank you.
translation: Ah, tam da mola zamani. Tesekkürler.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.'dan ücretsiz teslimat jetonunuzu almayi unutmayin.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: Teslimatiniz cok gec! Aluft jnr.'a geri dönüp baska bir siparis alin. Artik ihtiyaciniz olmadigi icin teslimat kutunuzu atiyorsunuz.

english: Hi! I'm Megan. Welcome to the Party Room!
translation: Merhaba! Ben Megan. Parti Odasina hos geldiniz!

english: One beer please Megan!
Coming right up [sir/ma'am]! That's two gold please.
I'm sorry but I don't have enough money!
Can you dance, Megan?
Can I dance?!
CAN I dance?!!
Dance with me Megan!
The player and Megan simultaneously dance and cheer, then end in a bow.
translation: Oyuncu ve Megan ayni anda dans edip tezahürat yapar, sonra selam vererek bitirir.

english: Do you have any news?
Not at the moment. I've heard that the known world is expanding as new places are discovered.
translation: Su anda yok. Yeni yerler kesfedildikce bilinen dünyanin genisledigini duydum.

english: These are exciting times indeed!
One beer please Megan!
Can you dance, Megan?
Do you have any news?
Hello?
The spirit looks at you for a moment, before you suddenly hear a voice echoing in your head.
translation: Ruh bir anligina sana bakar, sonra aniden kafanda bir ses yankilanir.

english: Curious... It has been a long time since I've spoken to another. The last time was when my body still had form. Tell me, stranger, what brings you to my tomb?
translation: Ilginc... Baska biriyle konusmayali uzun zaman oldu. En son konusmam, bedenim hala bir sekle sahipken olmustu. Söylesene yabanci, seni mezarima getiren nedir?

english: I was looking for some scabarites.
Ah, yes. The fallen remnants of my once great sect. You will find plenty of them here. Why do you seek them?
translation: Ah, evet. Bir zamanlar büyük olan tarikatimin düsmüs kalintilari. Burada bolca bulabilirsin. Neden onlari ariyorsun?

english: Do you know of Amascut, the Devourer?
All too well.
There's an old tomb south of here. Amascut has been excavating the entrance, and the scabarites have been helping her. She's looking for something inside, but I don't know what.
translation: Buranin güneyinde eski bir mezar var. Amascut girisi kaziyor ve skabaritler ona yardim ediyor. Iceride bir sey ariyor ama ne oldugunu bilmiyorum.

english: I see. If you are an enemy of the Devourer and her corrupt scabarites, then you are a friend to me. I am Mehhar, and I can help you.
translation: Anliyorum. Eger Yiyici ve onun yozlasmis scabaritlerinin düsmaniysan, o zaman benim dostumsun. Ben Mehhar, sana yardim edebilirim.

english: You can help? Do you know of this tomb?
translation: Yardim edebilir misin? Bu mezari biliyor musun?

english: Even when I still lived, the desert hid many secrets. Now, centuries later, it hides even more. Of all those secrets, few are greater than the ones hidden in that tomb.
translation: Ben hayattayken bile cöl bircok sir sakliyordu. Simdi, yüzyillar sonra, daha da fazlasini sakliyor. Tüm bu sirlarin arasinda, o mezarda saklananlardan daha büyük olan cok azi var.

english: Whose tomb is it?
It is the resting place of my father, Osmumten. He was once Pharaoh of these lands. My destiny was to succeed him, but the usurpers saw an end to that.
translation: Bu, babam Osmumten'in dinlenme yeri. O bir zamanlar bu topraklarin firavunuydu. Kaderim onun yerine gecmekti, ama gaspcilar buna son verdi.

english: And what are the secrets in his tomb?
Being a Pharaoh offers many luxuries, both in life and in death. Many strive only for these luxuries. They forget that being a Pharaoh also comes with responsibility.
translation: Firavun olmak, hem hayatta hem de ölümde bircok lüks sunar. Bircogu sadece bu lüksler icin cabalar. Firavun olmanin sorumluluk da getirdigini unuturlar.

english: My father had a responsibility greater than most. At the time of his rule, our people were locked in a great war. To hold back the Ruinous Powers, our gods granted us immensely powerful weapons.
translation: Babamin sorumlulugu cogundan daha büyüktü. Onun hükümdarligi döneminde halkimiz büyük bir savasin icindeydi. Yikici Gücleri durdurmak icin tanrilarimiz bize cok güclü silahlar verdi.

english: When the war was over, my father was tasked with hiding those weapons, lest they fall into nefarious hands. Two of them were buried with him. They will be what the Devourer seeks.
translation: Savas bittiginde babam, bu silahlarin kötü ellere gecmemesi icin onlari saklamakla görevlendirildi. Iki tanesi onunla birlikte gömüldü. Yiyici'nin aradigi seyler bunlar olacak.

english: What are these weapons?
I trust you are aware of what the Devourer desires?
Souls?
Yes. When the war ended and the Devourer rose from the ashes, she did so with only one goal. She will not stop until every soul, living or dead, has been destroyed.
translation: Evet. Savas bittiginde ve Yiyici küllerinden yeniden dogdugunda, tek bir amaci vardi. Yasayan ya da ölü tüm ruhlar yok edilene kadar durmayacakti.

english: And these weapons can help her?
translation: Ve bu silahlar ona yardim edebilir mi?

english: Many would call the Devourer a god, but they speak only half truths. She is a demi-goddess of limited power, and does not possess the means to devour souls on a mass scale.
translation: Bircok kisi Yiyici'yi tanri olarak adlandirir, ama onlar sadece yari gercegi söylüyorlar. O, sinirli güce sahip bir yari tanricadir ve ruhlari toplu olarak yutacak güce sahip degildir.

english: The weapons in my father's tomb can be used to drain a being of divine energy and transfer that energy to another. If used correctly, they would grant the Devourer true godhood.
translation: Babamin mezarindaki silahlar, bir varligin ilahi enerjisini emip baska birine aktarmak icin kullanilabilir. Dogru kullanildiklarinda, Yiyici'ye gercek tanrisallik kazandiracaklardir.

english: Then I need to get into that tomb and stop her.
translation: O zaman o mezara girip onu durdurmam gerek.

english: Before you leave, I ask that you remember your original purpose here.
translation: Gitmeden önce, buraya gelme amacini hatirlamani rica ediyorum.

english: The scabarites?
Yes. They have made their home here in my tomb, disturbing my rest. From the chamber above, the High Priest of Scabaras commands them.
translation: Evet. Onlar benim mezarimda yuva kurmuslar ve huzurumu bozuyorlar. Yukaridaki odadan Scabaras'in Bas Rahibi onlara emir veriyor.

english: He believes he does so in the name of Scabaras. He does not realise that he is actually a puppet of the Devourer.
translation: O, bunu Scabaras adina yaptigini saniyor. Aslinda Devourer'in bir kuklasi oldugunun farkinda degil.

english: Free him of her control, and the Devourer will be without a powerful resource. It will also allow me to rest once more.
translation: Onu onun kontrolünden kurtarirsan, Yiyici güclü bir kaynagini kaybedecek. Bu da benim tekrar huzur bulmami saglayacak.

english: He might also know more about what Amascut is planning. I did free a guard from Amascut's control through combat. I could try that again.
translation: Amascut'un planlari hakkinda daha fazla bilgiye sahip olabilir. Amascut'un kontrolünden bir muhafizi savasarak kurtardim. Bunu tekrar deneyebilirim.

english: When the Devourer first emerged, Icthlarin himself taught us an incantation to free an individual from her control. I would suggest you use it, rather than risking harm to the High Priest.
translation: Yiyici ilk ortaya ciktiginda, Icthlarin bize onun kontrolünden birini kurtarmak icin bir büyü ögretti. Yüksek Rahibe zarar verme riskine girmek yerine, bu büyüyü kullanmani öneririm.

english: Ah, that seems wise. What's this incantation?
translation: Ah, bu akillica görünüyor. Bu büyü nedir?

english: 'Majaan, Manand, Almuk.' Be warned, while it will work on those she has hypnotised, it will have no effect on her corrupted akhs. They are sadly beyond saving.
translation: “Majaan, Manand, Almuk.” Dikkatli ol, bu büyü onun hipnotize ettigi kisiler üzerinde ise yarayacak, ama onun yozlasmis akh'lari üzerinde hicbir etkisi olmayacak. Ne yazik ki onlar kurtarilamaz durumdalar.

english: I see. Thank you, Mehhar.
You will find a key to the upper chamber in an urn to the back of this room. Now go, with the blessing of Scabaras.
translation: Bu odanin arkasindaki bir küpün icinde üst odanin anahtarini bulacaksin. Simdi git, Scabaras'in kutsamasiyla.

english: Tell me more about yourself.
In life I was Mehhar, son of Osmumten. To me, my death was mere moments ago. To you on the other hand, I am surely considered ancient.
translation: Hayattayken ben Mehhar, Osmumten'in ogluydum. Benim icin ölümüm sadece birkac dakika önceydi. Ama sana göre ben kesinlikle cok eski sayilirim.

english: How ancient?
I sense that the gods have long since departed this world, but when I lived, they still walked among us.
translation: Tanrilarin bu dünyadan coktan ayrildigini hissediyorum, ama ben hayattayken, onlar hala aramizda dolasiyorlardi.

english: And your father, Osmumten? You said he was the Pharaoh. What happened?
translation: Peki ya baban Osmumten? Onun firavun oldugunu söylemistin. Ne oldu?

english: My father ruled during the great war. While the war was eventually won, many considered the cost too great. My father led us with the support of the gods, yet he was the one people blamed.
translation: Babam büyük savas sirasinda hüküm sürdü. Savas sonunda kazanildi, ama bircok kisi bedelinin cok büyük oldugunu düsündü. Babam tanrilarin destegiyle bizi yönetti, ama insanlar onu sucladi.

english: So they killed him?
Him, and the rest of my family. I would have died as well, were it not for the bravery of my father's servants. They gave their lives, so that I might live.
translation: Onu ve ailemin geri kalanini. Babamin hizmetkarlarinin cesareti olmasaydi ben de ölmüs olacaktim. Benim yasamam icin kendi hayatlarini feda ettiler.

english: And then you came here?
To Ullek? Yes. I found solace here with a group dedicated to Scabaras. In time, I became their leader, and the Sect of Scabaras was formed.
translation: Ullek'e mi? Evet. Burada Scabaras'a adanmis bir grupta huzur buldum. Zamanla onlarin lideri oldum ve Scabaras Tarikati kuruldu.

english: There's not much left of Ullek now, or the sect.
translation: Ullek'ten ve tarikattan geriye pek bir sey kalmadi.

english: That is no surprise. Such is the fate of all things. Still, while the sect would have eventually decayed, it was the Devourer's corruption that quickened its demise.
translation: Bu sasirtici degil. Her seyin kaderi böyledir. Yine de, tarikat er ya da gec cürüyecekti, ama yok olusunu hizlandiran, Yiyici'nin yozlasmasiydi.

english: I'm sorry.
Don't be. You have a chance to free the High Priest of Scabaras. If you do, the sect may yet be reborn.
translation: Önemli degil. Scabaras'in Bas Rahibini kurtarma sansin var. Bunu basarirsan, tarikat yeniden dogabilir.

english: What do you know about Amascut?
The one you call Amascut died long ago. In her place, the Devourer was born.
translation: Amascut dedigin kisi uzun zaman önce öldü. Onun yerine Yiyici dogdu.

english: How did it happen?
Only Icthlarin himself knows the true answer to that question.
translation: Bu sorunun gercek cevabini sadece Icthlarin biliyor.

english: Okay... but you must have some idea?
During the great war, our forces were decimated by the servants of the Ruinous Powers. To turn the tide, Icthlarin and Amascut sought powerful allies to aid us.
translation: Büyük savas sirasinda, güclerimiz Yikici Güclerin hizmetkarlari tarafindan yok edildi. Durumu tersine cevirmek icin, Icthlarin ve Amascut bize yardim edecek güclü müttefikler aradilar.

english: They found them far from here, in a place beyond this world. A powerful race of faceless ones. They became Icthlarin's Stern Judges.
translation: Onlari buradan cok uzaklarda, bu dünyanin ötesinde bir yerde buldular. Güclü, yüzsüz bir irk. Onlar Icthlarin'in Sert Yargiclari oldular.

english: What's that got to do with Amascut?
translation: Bunun Amascut ile ne ilgisi var?

english: Upon her return, Amascut vanished. She played no further part in the war. Only when the fighting was over did she reappear, but it wasn't really her at all.
translation: Amascut geri döndügünde ortadan kayboldu. Savasta daha fazla rol almadi. Savas bittiginde yeniden ortaya cikti, ama o aslinda o degildi.

english: So you think it had something to do with the Stern Judges?
translation: Yani bunun Sert Yargiclarla bir ilgisi oldugunu mu düsünüyorsun?

english: It seems highly likely.
Tell me more about the war you mentioned.
translation: Bahsettigin savas hakkinda daha fazla bilgi ver.

english: It started during the rule of my grandmother. An ever-expanding empire to the north set their sights on our lands. War soon broke out.
translation: Savas, büyükannemin hükümdarligi sirasinda basladi. Kuzeyde sürekli genisleyen bir imparatorluk, topraklarimiza göz dikmisti. Kisa süre sonra savas cikti.

english: The armies of the Ruinous Powers were far stronger than our own. That was until Icthlarin's Stern Judges joined the fray. Thanks to them, the war was seemingly won.
translation: Yikici Güclerin ordulari bizimkinden cok daha güclüydü. Ta ki Icthlarin'in Stern Yargiclari savasa katilana kadar. Onlar sayesinde savas kazanilmis gibi görünüyordu.

english: It wasn't really though, was it?
No. Among the Stern Judges, there was a serpent. After my father became Pharaoh, this serpent convinced the others to abandon us.
translation: Hayir. Stern Yargiclari arasinda bir yilan vardi. Babam firavun olduktan sonra, bu yilan digerlerini bizi terk etmeye ikna etti.

english: They joined the enemy?
They did. We were powerless against a force of that might. Nothing could stop their advance.
translation: Evet. O kadar güclü bir güce karsi gücsüzdük. Hicbir sey onlarin ilerleyisini durduramadi.

english: So how did the war end?
It was Tumeken himself. He sacrificed himself to annihilate the enemy. The cost was great, but the war was won.
translation: Tumeken'in kendisiydi. Düsmani yok etmek icin kendini feda etti. Bedeli agirdi, ama savas kazanildi.

english: So Tumeken died?
That's a matter of perspective. I died long ago, and yet we are still having this conversation.
translation: Bu bakis acisina bagli. Ben uzun zaman önce öldüm, ama yine de bu konusmayi yapiyoruz.

english: That doesn't really answer my question.
translation: Bu benim sorumu tam olarak cevaplamiyor.

english: While Tumeken himself may be gone, he lives on through his four avatars. While they walk among us, Tumeken will always be at our side.
translation: Tumeken kendisi ölmüs olabilir, ama dört avatari araciligiyla yasamaya devam ediyor. Onlar aramizda dolastikca, Tumeken daima yanimizda olacak.

english: I'd better get going.
Scabaras be with you.
Hello, Mehhar.
I sense that the Devourer's corruption has been lessened. I trust you were successful?
translation: Yiyicinin yozlasmasinin azaldigini hissediyorum. Basarili oldun umarim?

english: The High Priest is free.
You have my thanks.
Does this mean you can rest now?
translation: Bu, artik dinlenebileceginiz anlamina mi geliyor?

english: That was my hope, but while the High Priest is free, many scabarites have been lost to the Devourer. As you will have seen, they have descended on my tomb, hoping to reclaim it.
translation: Öyle umuyordum, ama Basrahip serbest kalirken, bircok scabarite Devourer'a yenik düstü. Gördügünüz gibi, mezarimi geri almak icin oraya saldirdilar.

english: Is there anything I can do to help?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Continue your fight against the Devourer. Only with her defeat, will we finally find freedom.
translation: Devourer'a karsi mücadelenizi sürdürün. Onu yenerek ancak özgürlük kazanabiliriz.

english: Welcome back, adventurer.
Tell me more about yourself.
What do you know about Amascut?
Tell me more about the war you mentioned.
translation: Bahsettigin savas hakkinda daha fazla bilgi ver.

english: I'd better get going.
It can't be that hard can it?
translation: O kadar da zor olamaz, degil mi?

english: I guess this will be my last day of blood tithes, one way or another.
translation: Sanirim bu, bir sekilde kan vergisinin son günü olacak.

english: I will survive the Theatre! Just like Serafina did!
translation: Tiyatro'dan sag cikacagim! Tipki Serafina gibi!

english: Soon I will be free!
I'm starting to think I made a mistake coming here.
translation: Buraya gelmekle hata yaptigimi düsünmeye basliyorum.

english: Can't talk. I need to prepare myself.
What? What's wrong?
Nothing, I just need to ask a couple of questions.
translation: Hicbir sey, sadece birkac soru sormak istiyorum.

english: Oh, hello. How's everything?
Not too bad thanks, but I wanted to ask a question.
translation: Fena degil, tesekkürler, ama bir soru sormak istiyorum.

english: Hello?
Hello, I wonder if I could ask some questions.
translation: Merhaba, birkac soru sorabilir miyim acaba?

english: Hey, don't sneak up on me like that!
Sorry, didn't mean to scare you. I just wanted to ask a question.
translation: Üzgünüm, seni korkutmak istemedim. Sadece bir soru sormak istedim.

english: Well, I guess so.
What do you do here?
I'm barely surviving...
When I'm not being drained of blood, the vyrewatch force me to repair the walls.
translation: Kanim emilmediginde, vyrewatch duvarlari onarmam icin beni zorluyor.

english: When I'm not being drained of blood I'm fixing up the ghetto.
I just try to make a living the best way I can. You haven't got some food have you?
translation: Elimden gelen en iyi sekilde gecinmeye calisiyorum. Yiyecegin yok, degil mi?

english: Like everyone else, I just survive here. Just try to keep alive till after the next blood tithe. That's when they feed us.
translation: Herkes gibi, ben de burada hayatta kalmaya calisiyorum. Bir sonraki kan vergisi ödenene kadar hayatta kalmaya calisiyorum. O zaman bize yemek veriyorlar.

english: Why do you wanna know?
Just curious, that's all.
I dunno. I don't know if I can trust you...
translation: Bilmiyorum. Sana güvenebilir miyim, emin degilim...

english: I'm lost... Can you help me?
Well, you're in sector [one/two/three/four/five/six], but if you were hoping for any other help then I'm very sorry. I find it hard enough to help myself.
Life's so very hard here. Before too long they'll be wanting to have another blood tithing and then I'll feel just awful again.
translation: Burada hayat cok zor. Cok gecmeden yine kan vergisi isteyecekler ve ben yine kendimi cok kötü hissedecegim.

english: What's a blood tithing?
You must be new here, else you'd know for sure. It's where we have to give a blood tithe to the vampyres. They do it on a weekly basis, a different sector each week so they don't kill us all off.
translation: Buraya yeni gelmis olmalisin, yoksa bunu bilirdin. Vampirlerimize kan vergisi ödemek zorunda oldugumuz zaman. Bunu haftada bir yapiyorlar, her hafta farkli bir sektörde, böylece hepimizi öldürmüyorlar.

english: Do you know about the Myreque?
It's probably best not to talk about that, friend.
translation: Bunun hakkinda konusmamak en iyisi, dostum.

english: I need to make contact with them. Please don't worry - I'm on their side.
translation: Onlarla iletisime gecmem gerekiyor. Lütfen endiselenme, ben onlarin tarafindayim.

english: As are we all, but I really can't talk about them. It's not a subject easily broached here.
translation: Hepimiz öyleyiz, ama onlar hakkinda konusamam. Burada kolayca acilabilecek bir konu degil.

english: The Myreque are gone. Do not speak of them, it will do you no good.
translation: Myreque yok oldu. Onlar hakkinda konusma, sana bir faydasi olmaz.

english: Can you tell me about the Sanguinesti region?
translation: Sanguinesti bölgesi hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Yep, that's where we are at the moment. This place, Meiyerditch, is just one large ghetto.
translation: Evet, su anda oradayiz. Burasi, Meiyerditch, kocaman bir getto.

english: The city is sectioned off so that the vampyres can collect blood tithes on a rotational basis. That way they don't kill us all off in one go.
translation: Sehir, vampirlerin dönüsümlü olarak kan vergisi toplayabilmeleri icin bölümlere ayrilmis. Böylece hepimizi bir kerede öldürmüyorlar.

english: What do you know about the vampyres?

They're monsters, I know that much. I've never known anything else, but I have a feeling it might be nice to not have to live in fear the whole time. Worrying if I'm going to make the next blood tithe quota.
translation: Onlar canavarlar, bunu biliyorum. Baska bir sey bilmiyorum, ama sürekli korku icinde yasamak zorunda olmamak güzel olabilir diye düsünüyorum. Bir sonraki kan vergisi kotasini karsilayabilecek miyim diye endiselenmek zorunda kalmamak.

english: I know that the juveniles are the lowest form of the vampyres. Apparently they were human once, converted by the vampyres.
translation: Genclerin vampirlerin en alt tabakasi oldugunu biliyorum. Görünüse göre bir zamanlar insanmislar, vampirler tarafindan dönüstürülmüsler.

english: Then you have juvinates. They're initiated juveniles who've had some training and are starting to get some powers.
translation: Sonra juvinatlar var. Bunlar, biraz egitim almis ve bazi gücler kazanmaya baslayan genc vampirlerdir.

english: After that you have the vyres. They're nasty... really nasty.
translation: Sonra da vyreler var. Onlar cok kötü... gercekten cok kötü.

english: What do you know about Drakan?
Drakan? Which one: Ranis or Vanescula?
translation: Drakan mi? Hangisi: Ranis mi, Vanescula mu?

english: Well, I was referring to the main Drakan, you know, the overlord of Morytania.
translation: Ben asil Drakan'dan bahsediyordum, bilirsin, Morytania'nin hükümdari.

english: Hmm, nothing has been seen of him for many years now. Some people say they occasionally see Ranis or Vanescula flying about, but it's not too often.
translation: Hmm, onu yillardir kimse görmedi. Bazilari ara sira Ranis veya Vanescula'yi ucarken gördüklerini söylüyor, ama cok sik degil.

english: Vanescula?
Hmm, nothing has been seen of him for many years now. Some people say they occasionally see Vanescula flying about, but it's not too often.
translation: Hmm, onu yillardir kimse görmedi. Bazilari ara sira Vanescula'yi ucarken gördüklerini söylüyor, ama cok sik degil.

english: No one had seen anything of him for years, they say he's back now though. We shouldn't talk of him any more though, the vyrewatch might not like it.
translation: Yillardir kimse onu görmemis, ama simdi geri döndügünü söylüyorlar. Onun hakkinda daha fazla konusmamaliyiz, vyrewatch bundan hoslanmayabilir.

english: What is there to do around here?
To do? Around here? Survive! Eke out an existence and just live for another day, that's it really.
translation: Yapmak mi? Buralarda mi? Hayatta kalmak! Hayatta kalmak ve bir gün daha yasamak, hepsi bu.

english: The juvinates organise work crews to mine the daeyalt, fix the walls, the castles and so on. If we refuse to do the work, they put us on double tithes and you can't do that for long before you dry up.
