translation: Juvinatlar, daeyalt madenciligi yapmak, duvarlari, kaleleri onarmak vb. icin calisma ekipleri organize ediyor. Eger isi yapmayi reddedersek, bize iki kat vergi koyuyorlar ve bunu uzun süre yapamazsin, yoksa kurursun.

english: If you want to escape, there's only one way. Anyone who survives in the theatre gets to leave. It's pointless though. No one survives.
translation: Kacmak istiyorsan, tek bir yol var. Tiyatroda hayatta kalan herkes gidebilir. Ama bunun bir anlami yok. Kimse hayatta kalamiyor.

english: Is there anything I can do to help?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: It's very nice of you to offer, my friend, but I shouldn't expect that you could do anything. The vampyres are just too powerful to overcome.
translation: Teklifin cok nazik, dostum, ama senin bir sey yapabilecegini sanmiyorum. Vampirler yenilemeyecek kadar güclüler.

english: They say this place once had a Saradominist Queen. Even she could not withstand the vampyres. Anyone who has challenged their power in the past has come undone.
translation: Buranin bir zamanlar Saradominist bir kralicesi oldugunu söylüyorlar. O bile vampirlerin gücüne karsi koyamadi. Gecmiste onlarin gücüne meydan okuyan herkes yok oldu.

english: Okay, thanks.
What're you doin' in here? You don't belong here! Go back to where you came from, 'fore the vyrewatch sees ya.
translation: Burada ne yapiyorsun? Buraya ait degilsin! Vyrewatch seni görmeden geldigin yere geri dön.

english: Hello.
Oh... Sorry, we're not meant to talk to the nobles.
What do you do here?
I'm lost... Can you help me?
Do you know about the Myreque?
- More questions -
Can you tell me about the Sanguinesti region?
translation: Sanguinesti bölgesi hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: What do you know about the vampyres?
What do you know about Drakan?
What is there to do around here?
Is there anything I can do to help?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Okay, thanks.
- Initial questions -
Hello there.
Oh, hello, you must be new here.
translation: Oh, merhaba, buraya yeni gelmis olmalisin.

english: Where are we?
What, you can't tell from your surroundings that you're in a mine? You must have been hit hard on the head to not notice that.
translation: Ne, cevreden bir madende oldugunu anlayamiyor musun? Fark etmemek icin kafana sert bir darbe almis olmalisin.

english: What do you do here?

We're miners, perhaps that might give you a clue! We're forced to mine for those stinking vyres. Once we've filled the cart, they sometimes let us go back to Meiyerditch, but then we get tithed. Don't know if I
translation: Biz madencileriz, belki bu sana bir ipucu verir! O kokusmus vyreler icin madencilik yapmak zorunda kaliyoruz. Arabayi doldurdugumuzda bazen Meiyerditch'e dönmemize izin veriyorlar, ama sonra vergimizi aliyorlar. Burada mi yoksa disarida mi

english: prefer it in here or out there!
Do you have a spare pick?
Sure, got one here you can use.
translation: Tabii, burada kullanabilecegin bir tane var.

english: The miner hands you a rustic-looking pickaxe.
translation: Madenci sana rustik görünümlü bir kazma uzatir.

english: How do you get out of here?
They can't keep you in here forever because they have to tithe you, so once you've filled the cart, they let you go. Takes about fifteen loads to get the cart filled.
translation: Seni sonsuza kadar burada tutamazlar cünkü senden vergi almalari gerekiyor, bu yüzden arabayi doldurdugunda seni birakirlar. Arabayi doldurmak icin yaklasik on bes yük gerekir.

english: What is it that you're mining?

We're mining for daeyalt. Don't rightly know what it does - we don't ask too many questions - but I've been doing it since I was a kid. The carts keep getting filled, and they keep going along the tracks. Goes to some
translation: Daeyalt madenciligi yapiyoruz. Ne ise yaradigini tam olarak bilmiyoruz - cok fazla soru sormuyoruz - ama ben cocuklugumdan beri bunu yapiyorum. Arabalar sürekli dolduruluyor ve raylar üzerinde ilerliyorlar.

english: huge refinery place, it does - massive, like another city under the earth.
translation: Devasa bir rafineriye gidiyorlar - yeraltinda baska bir sehir gibi devasa bir yer.

english: What? Have you seen this place?
Not myself, like, but other people I know of have seen it and they wouldn't lie!
translation: Ben görmedim ama tanidigim diger insanlar gördü ve yalan söylemezler!

english: You two shut up and get back to work!
translation: Siz ikiniz susun ve isinize dönün!

english: Okay, thanks.
Hello.
Oh... Sorry, we're not meant to talk to the nobles.
I feel so weak I could faint.
translation: O kadar zayif hissediyorum ki bayilabilirim.

english: I'm sick of this place.
I hate those Vyres.
Work work work, that's all I ever do.
translation: Calismak, calismak, calismak, tek yaptigim sey bu.

english: I can't think strait, I'm so tired.
Ohh, my arms.
Ohh, my back.
I'm rich in experience, poor in wealth.
I'm so tired, I could sleep standing up.
translation: O kadar yorgunum ki ayakta uyuyabilirim.

english: What I wouldn't give for a good night's rest.
translation: Iyi bir gece uykusu icin neler vermezdim.

english: Where are we?
What do you do here?
Do you have a spare pick?
How do you get out of here?
What is it that you're mining?
Okay, thanks.
Good to see you safe friend.
Why wouldn't I be safe?
The Vyrewatch are getting more ferocious by the day. You're doing well if you can get from one side of Meiyerditch to the other without getting attacked!
translation: Vyrewatch her gecen gün daha da vahsilesiyor. Meiyerditch'in bir ucundan diger ucuna saldiriya ugramadan gecebilirsen iyi is cikarmissin demektir!

english: Hello there.
Hi. Welcome to the general store. How might I help you?
translation: Merhaba. Genel magazaya hos geldiniz. Nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: What can you sell me?
I have a question...
About magic of course.
Sorry?
I said about magic of course. You know, in response to your question.
translation: Tabii ki büyüyle ilgili dedim. Soruna cevap olarak.

english: But I didn't ask anything yet.
translation: Ama ben henüz bir sey sormadim ki.

english: Yes, but you were thinking of asking me how I was floating.
translation: Evet, ama bana nasil uctugumu sormayi düsünüyordun.

english: That's true!
How could you possibly know that?
Don't you realise we can read your mind.
Oh, of course. How do you manage to do that?

It's quite simple, everyone has a resonance that is responded to by the moon. This resonance changes depending on what we are thinking. You can tune yourself in to listen to this resonance with practice - it's
translation: Oldukca basit, herkesin ayin yanit verdigi bir rezonansi vardir. Bu rezonans, düsündüklerimize göre degisir. Pratik yaparak bu rezonansi dinlemek icin kendinizi ayarlayabilirsiniz - bu, Ay Klani üyeleri icin

english: a life long quest for the members of the Moon Clan, but its especially easy to read with outsiders like yourself, as you are far louder and unguarded.
translation: ömür boyu süren bir arayistir, ama sizin gibi yabancilarla okumak özellikle kolaydir, cünkü sizler cok daha gürültülüsünüz ve korunmasizsiniz.

english: I see. I best be careful with what I think of then.
translation: Anliyorum. O zaman ne düsündügüme dikkat etsem iyi olur....

english: That's disgusting!
Sorry.
I'm good thanks, bye.
What can you sell me?
I have a question...
I'm good thanks, bye.
Greetings adventurer, I am the Melee combat tutor. Is there anything I can do for you?
translation: Merhaba maceraci, ben yakin dövüs ögretmeni. Sizin icin yapabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Tell me about melee combat.
Well adventurer, the first thing you will need is a sword and a shield appropriate for your level.
translation: Maceraci dostum, ilk olarak seviyenize uygun bir kilic ve kalkan edinmelisiniz.

english: Make sure to equip your sword and shield. Click on them in your inventory, they will disappear from your inventory and move to your worn items. You can see your worn items in the worn items tab here.
translation: Kilic ve kalkaninizi mutlaka kusanin. Envanterinizde üzerlerine tiklayin, envanterinizden kaybolup giydiginiz esyalar bölümüne gececekler. Giydiginiz esyalari buradaki giydiginiz esyalar sekmesinden görebilirsiniz.

english: When you are wielding your sword you will then be able to see the correct options in the combat interface.
translation: Kilicinizi kullandiginizda, savas arayüzünde dogru secenekleri görebileceksiniz.

english: There are four different melee styles. Accurate, aggressive, defensive and controlled. Not all weapons will have all four styles though.
translation: Dört farkli yakin dövüs stili vardir. Hassas, agresif, savunmaci ve kontrollü. Ancak tüm silahlar bu dört stili de icermez.

english: Interesting, what does each style do?
translation: Ilginc, her stil ne ise yarar?

english: Well I am glad you asked. The accurate style will give you experience points in your Attack skill, you will also find you will deal damage more frequently as a result of being, well, more accurate.
translation: Sordugunuz icin tesekkürler. Hassas stil, Saldiri becerinizde deneyim puani kazandirir, ayrica daha isabetli oldugunuz icin daha sik hasar vereceginizi fark edeceksiniz.

english: Next we have the aggressive style. This style will give you experience points in your Strength skill. When using this style you will notice that your attacks will hit a little harder.
translation: Sirada agresif stil var. Bu stil, Güc becerinizde deneyim puani kazandirir. Bu stili kullandiginizda, saldirilarinizin biraz daha sert vurdugunu fark edeceksiniz.

english: Now for the defensive style, this style will give you experience points in your Defensive skill. When using this style you will notice that you get hit less often.
translation: Savunma stiline gelince, bu stil size Savunma becerinizde deneyim puani kazandirir. Bu stili kullandiginizda, daha az siklikta vuruldugunuzu fark edeceksiniz.

english: Finally, we have the controlled style. This style will give you the same amount of experience as the other styles would but shared across all three of the combat skills.
translation: Son olarak, kontrollü stil var. Bu stil, diger stillerle ayni miktarda deneyim puani kazandirir, ancak bu puan üc savas becerisinin tümüne dagitilir.

english: If you were using the training sword for example, there are four different attack types. Stab, lunge, slash and block.
translation: Örnegin, egitim kilicini kullaniyorsaniz, dört farkli saldiri türü vardir. Bicaklama, hamle, kesme ve bloklama.

english: Each type uses one of the attack styles. Stab uses accurate, lunge and slash use aggressive and block uses defensive.
translation: Her tür, saldiri stillerinden birini kullanir. Bicaklama isabetli, hamle ve kesme agresif, bloklama ise savunmacidir.

english: To find out which style an attack type uses, hover your mouse cursor over the style button.
translation: Bir saldiri türünün hangi stili kullandigini ögrenmek icin, fare imlecini stil dügmesinin üzerine getirin.

english: If you need some more advice, you should talk to Adventurer Jon about Adventure paths. He may even have a handy starter kit you can use.
translation: Daha fazla tavsiyeye ihtiyaciniz varsa, Maceraci Jon ile Macera yollari hakkinda konusmalisiniz. Hatta kullanabileceginiz kullanisli bir baslangic kiti bile olabilir.

english: Is there anything else you would like to know?
translation: Bilmek istediginiz baska bir sey var mi?

english: What if I wanted to fight something a bit more... human.
translation: Ya biraz daha... insan gibi bir seyle savasmak istersem?

english: Well adventurer, there are a few places you might be able to do this.
translation: Maceraci, bunu yapabileceginiz birkac yer var.

english: You could try your luck at castle wars. Here, two teams fight each other to defend their respective flags. To win the game you will need to get the other team's flag and return it to your flag stand.
translation: Kale savaslarinda sansinizi deneyebilirsiniz. Burada, iki takim kendi bayraklarini savunmak icin birbirleriyle savasir. Oyunu kazanmak icin diger takimin bayragini alip kendi bayrak diregine geri götürmen gerekir.

english: Capture the flag, sounds like a lot of fun.
translation: Bayragi ele gecirmek, cok eglenceli görünüyor.

english: If you are in a clan, you should gather some clan members and try out clan wars. There you can see which clan is better than the other by fighting each other in an arena.
translation: Bir klana üyeysen, klan üyelerini toplayip klan savaslarini deneyebilirsin. Orada, arenada birbirleriyle savasarak hangi klanin daha iyi oldugunu görebilirsin.

english: Both activities are safe minigame, which means if you die you will not loose any of your items. You can get to them by using the teleport option in your minigames tab.
translation: Her iki aktivite de güvenli mini oyunlardir, yani ölürsen esyalarini kaybetmezsin. Mini oyunlar sekmesindeki isinlanma secenegini kullanarak bu oyunlara ulasabilirsiniz.

english: There is also the wilderness. The wilderness is north of Varrock and you can fight other players there. But barein mind if you die to another player in the wilderness you will lose your stuff.
translation: Ayrica Wilderness da var. Wilderness Varrock'un kuzeyinde ve orada diger oyuncularla savasabilirsiniz. Ancak Wildernessda baska bir oyuncu tarafindan öldürülürseniz esyalarinizi kaybedeceginizi unutmayin.

english: But this also means that if you kill another player you will be able to take their stuff too.
translation: Ancak bu, baska bir oyuncuyu öldürürseniz onun esyalarini da alabileceginiz anlamina gelir.

english: Only go into the wilderness with items you are willing to lose and pay attention to the wilderness level you are in. The higher the level you go, more player will be able to attack you.
translation: Wildernessya sadece kaybetmeyi göze alabileceginiz esyalarla girin ve bulundugunuz Wilderness seviyesine dikkat edin. Seviye ne kadar yüksekse, o kadar cok oyuncu size saldirabilir.

english: You can find which player can attack you by checking your combat level.
translation: Hangi oyuncunun size saldirabilecegini, savas seviyenizi kontrol ederek ögrenebilirsiniz.

english: Minus the wilderness level from your combat level to find the lowest level that you can attack, then add the wilderness level to your combat level to find the highest level that you can attack.
translation: Savas seviyenizden Wilderness seviyesini cikararak saldirabileceginiz en düsük seviyeyi bulun, ardindan Wilderness seviyesini savas seviyenize ekleyerek saldirabileceginiz en yüksek seviyeyi bulun.

english: Tell me about different weapon types I can use.
translation: Kullanabilecegim farkli silah türleri hakkinda bilgi verin.

english: Tell me about different weapon types I can use
translation: Kullanabilecegim farkli silah türleri hakkinda bilgi verin

english: Well let me see now...There are stabbing type weapons such as daggers, then you have swords which are slashing, maces that have great crushing abilities, battle axes which are powerful.
translation: Bir bakalim... Hancer gibi bicaklama tipi silahlar var, sonra kesme tipi kiliclar, büyük ezme gücüne sahip mizraklar ve güclü savas baltalari var.

english: It depends a lot on how you want to fight. Experiment and find out what is best for you. Never be scared to try out a new weapon; you never know, you might like it!
translation: Bu, nasil savasmak istedigine baglidir. Denemeler yap ve sana en uygun olani bul. Yeni bir silah denemekten asla korkma; kim bilir, belki de seversin!

english: While I tried all of them for a while, I settled on this rather good sword.
translation: Hepsini bir süre denedikten sonra, bu oldukca iyi kilici sectim.

english: You might also find that different weapon types are more accurate against different monsters.
translation: Farkli silah türlerinin farkli canavarlara karsi daha etkili oldugunu da fark edebilirsin.

english: Tell me about skillcapes
Tell me about skillcapes.
Of course. Skillcapes are a symbol of achievement. Only people who have mastered a skill and reached level 99 can get their hands on them and gain the benefits they carry.
translation: Tabii ki. Skillcapes basari sembolüdür. Sadece bir beceriyi ustalastirmis ve seviye 99'a ulasmis kisiler bunlari elde edebilir ve sagladiklari avantajlardan yararlanabilir.

english: The Cape of Defence will act as ring of life, saving you from combat if your hitpoints become low.
translation: Defence Cape, can yüzügü gibi calisir ve can puaniniz düstügünde sizi savastan kurtarir.

english: I'd like a training sword and shield.
You already have a training sword and shield. Save some for the other adventurers.
translation: Zaten bir egitim kiliciniz ve kalkaniniz var. Diger maceracilar icin de biraz birakin.

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: There you go, use it well.
Goodbye.

Ah, but I can see you're already a master in the fine art of Defence. Perhaps you have come to me to purchase a Skillcape of Defence, and thus join the elite few who have mastered this exacting skill?
translation: Ah, ama görüyorum ki savunma sanatinda zaten ustasiniz. Belki de bana Savunma Beceri Pelerini satin almak icin geldiniz ve böylece bu zor beceriyi ustalasmis seckin azinliga katilmak istiyorsunuz?

english: In recognition of your defensive abilities, when you have it equipped it will act as ring of life, saving you from combat if your hitpoints become low.
translation: Savunma yeteneklerinizi takdir ederek, bunu taktiginizda yasam halkasi görevi görecek ve can puaniniz düstügünde sizi savastan kurtaracaktir.

english: May I buy a Skillcape of Defence, please?
translation: Savunma Beceri Pelerini satin alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: You wish to join the elite defenders of this world? I'm afraid such things do not come cheaply - in fact they cost 99000 coins, to be precise!
translation: Bu dünyanin seckin savunucularina katilmak mi istiyorsunuz? Korkarim ki böyle seyler ucuz degildir - aslinda tam olarak 99.000 sikkeye mal olurlar!

english: 99000 coins? That's much too expensive.
Not at all; there are many other adventurers who would love the opportunity to purchase such a prestigious item! You can find me here if you change your mind.
translation: Hic de degil; böyle prestijli bir ürünü satin alma firsatini kacirmak istemeyecek bircok maceraci var! Fikrini degistirirsen beni burada bulabilirsin.

english: I think I have the money right here, actually.
But, unfortunately, I was mistaken.
Well, come back and see me when you do.
translation: Peki, parayi buldugunda tekrar gelip beni gör.

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: Maalesef tüm Skillcapes sadece ücretsiz bir baslik ile satiliyor, bu bir beceri promosyonunun parcasi; bir alana bir bedava, bilirsin. Yani sana bir tane satabilmem icin önce envanterinde yer acman gerekiyor.

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: Harika! O pelerini gururla giy dostum.

english: Tell me about melee combat.
translation: Bana yakin dövüs hakkinda bilgi ver.

english: What if I wanted to fight something a bit more... human.
translation: Ya biraz daha... insan gibi bir seyle dövüsmek istersem?

english: Tell me about skillcapes.
I'd like a training sword and shield.
Goodbye.
Yes, please sell me a Skillcape of Defence.
translation: Evet, bana Savunma Beceri Pelerini sat lütfen.

english: 99000 coins? That's much too expensive.
I think I have the money right here, actually.
Can you tell me about different weapon types I can use?
translation: Kullanabilecegim farkli silah türleri hakkinda bilgi verir misin?

english: Ssssh! I'm trying to study.
Sorry, but could...
Ssssh!
But I...
SSHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!
I can't believe we've finally arrived, I can't wait to explore!
translation: Sonunda vardigimiza inanamiyorum, kesfetmek icin sabirsizlaniyorum!

english: So much to see, I don't know where to start!
translation: Görülecek o kadar cok sey var ki, nereden baslayacagimi bilemiyorum!

english: A whole new continent to explore... what a time to be alive!
translation: Kesfedilecek yepyeni bir kita... Ne harika bir zaman!

english: Are you the tour guide?
Nope, I'm just as lost as you.
translation: Hayir, ben de senin kadar kayboldum.

english: I overheard someone mention there are pirates and thieves here, be careful!
translation: Burada korsanlar ve hirsizlar oldugunu duydum, dikkatli ol!

english: By the power of custard!
Feel the wrath of my feet!
Let me drink my tea in peace.
translation: Cayimi huzur icinde icmeme izin ver.

english: Leave me alone, I need to feed my pet rock.
translation: Beni rahat birak, evcil tasimi beslemem lazim.

english: I'll not get through these gates; they're too heavily boarded up!
translation: Bu kapilardan gecemeyecegim, cok agir tahta kapilar!

english: ...And these walls don't look very climbable at all.
translation: ...Ve bu duvarlar hic de tirmanilabilir görünmüyor.

english: That's right, clear off. You're not welcome here!
Hello.
What do you want?
Nothing really, I'm new to town and wanted to get to know the locals.
translation: Aslinda bir sey istemiyorum, bu kasabaya yeni geldim ve yerlileri tanimak istedim.

english: I'm too busy for chitchat. Come back if you have some business to discuss with us.
translation: Sohbet etmek icin cok mesgulüm. Bizimle görüsecek bir isin varsa geri gel.

english: Yeah, what do you want?
What is this place?
It's none of your business now get lost.
Perhaps five gold coins will make it my business?
Don't try to fool me, you don't have five gold coins! Before you try to bribe someone, make sure you have the money effendi!
translation: Beni kandirmaya calisma, bes altin sikken yok! Birine rüsvet vermeye calismadan önce, paran oldugundan emin ol efendi!

english: Guards!! Guards!
Let's see how good you are with Desert Survival techniques.
translation: Cöl Hayatta Kalma tekniklerinde ne kadar iyi oldugunu görelim.

english: You're bundled into the back of a cart and blindfolded...
translation: Bir arabanin arkasina baglanip gözlerin baglanir...

english: Sometime later you wake up in the desert.
You won't be needing that water anymore!
The guards move off leaving you stranded in the desert.
Well, it certainly will help...-- The guard takes the five gold coins. --Now then, what did you want to know?
translation: Sey, bu kesinlikle yardimci olacaktir...-- Muhafiz bes altin parayi alir. --Peki, ne bilmek istiyordunuz?

english: It's just a mining camp. Prisoners are sent here from Al-Kharid. They serve out their sentence by mining. Most prisoners will end their days here, surrounded by desert.
translation: Burasi sadece bir maden kampi. Mahkumlar Al-Kharid'den buraya gönderiliyor. Cezalarini madencilik yaparak cekiyorlar. Cogu mahkum, cölün ortasinda, burada hayatlarini sonlandiriyor.

english: So you could almost say that they got their ... 'Just Desserts'
You could say that...-- There is an awkward pause --
translation: Öyle de denebilir...- - Garip bir sessizlik olur...

english: But it wouldn't be very funny.
When they talk about 'the silence of the desert', this must be what they mean.
translation: “Cölün sessizligi”nden bahsettiklerinde, kastettikleri sey bu olmali.

english: Can I take a look around the place?
Not really. The Captain won't let you in the compound. He's the only one who has the key to the gate. And if you talk to him, he'll probably just order us to kill you. Unless...
translation: Hayir. Kaptan seni tesise almaz. Kapinin anahtari sadece onda. Ve onunla konusursan, muhtemelen bizi seni öldürmemiz icin emir verecektir. Tabii...

english: Unless what?
Unless he has a use for you. He's been trying to track down someone called 'Al Zaba Bhasim'. You could offer to catch him and that might put you in his good books?
translation: Tabii seni kullanabilecegi bir sey yoksa. “Al Zaba Bhasim” adinda birini bulmaya calisiyor. Onu yakalamayi teklif edersen, gözüne girebilirsin.

english: Where would I find this Al Zaba Bhasim?
translation: Bu Al Zaba Bhasim'i nerede bulabilirim?

english: Well, he could be anywhere. He's a nomadic desert dweller. However, they say that he's frequently to be found to the west in the hospitality of the tenti's.
translation: Her yerde olabilir. O, göcebe bir cöl sakini. Ancak, sik sik batida, tenti'lerin misafirperverliginde görüldügü söyleniyor.

english: The Tenti's, who are they?
Well, we're not really sure what their proper name is. But they live in tents so we call them the 'Tenti's'.
translation: Aslinda, gercek adlarinin ne oldugunu tam olarak bilmiyoruz. Ama cadirlarda yasadiklari icin onlara “Tenti'ler” diyoruz.

english: Is Al Zaba Bhasim very tough?
translation: Al Zaba Bhasim cok sert biri mi?

english: Well, I'm not sure, but by all accounts, he is a slippery fellow. The Captain has been trying to capture him for years. A bit of a waste of time if you ask me. Anyway, I have to get going, I do have work to do.
translation: Emin degilim, ama tüm anlatilanlara göre, kaypak bir adam. Kaptan yillardir onu yakalamaya calisiyor. Bana sorarsan biraz zaman kaybi. Neyse, gitmem gerek, isim var.

english: What are you guarding?
Well, if you have to know, we're making sure that no prisoners get out.-- The guard gives you a disapproving look. --And to make sure that unauthorised people don't get in.
translation: Eger bilmek istiyorsan, mahkumlarin kacmamasini sagliyoruz. -- Gardiyan sana onaylamayan bir bakis atar. -- Ve yetkisiz kisilerin iceri girmediginden emin oluyoruz.

english: -- The guard looks around nervously. --You'd better go soon before the Captain orders us to kill you.
translation: -- Muhafiz gergin bir sekilde etrafina bakiniyor. --Kaptan bize seni öldürmemizi emretmeden önce gitsen iyi olur.

english: Does the Captain order you to kill a lot of people?
translation: Kaptan size cok fazla insani öldürmenizi emrediyor mu?

english: -- The guard snorts. --*Snort* Just about anyone who talks to him.
translation: -- Muhafiz burun kiviriyor. --*Burun kivirma sesi* Onunla konusan hemen hemen herkesi.

english: Unless he has a use for you, he'll probably just order us to kill you. And it's such a horrible job cleaning up the mess afterwards.
translation: Senden bir faydasi olmadigi sürece, muhtemelen bize seni öldürmemizi emredecektir. Ve sonrasinda ortaligi temizlemek cok korkunc bir is.

english: Not to mention the senseless waste of human life.
translation: Insan hayatinin anlamsizca israf edilmesinden bahsetmiyorum bile.

english: Huh? Them's your words, not mine.
translation: Ha? Bunlar senin sözlerin, benim degil.

english: It doesn't sound as if you respect your Captain much.
-- The guard looks around conspiratorially. --

Well, to be honest. We think he's not exactly as brave as he makes out. But we have to follow his orders. If someone called him a coward, or managed to trick him into a one-on-one duel many of us bet that he'd be
translation: Dürüst olmak gerekirse. Onun göründügü kadar cesur olmadigini düsünüyoruz. Ama emirlerine uymak zorundayiz. Biri ona korkak dese ya da onu teke tek düelloya cekse, cogumuz onun yenilecegine bahse gireriz.

english: beaten.
And how could I trick him into a one-on-one duel?
translation: Onu teke tek düelloya nasil cekebilirim ki?

english: Like all cowards, he likes to be made to feel important. If anyone insults him outright, he just gets us to do his dirty work. However, if he thinks he's better than you, if you compliment him, he may feel that he can defeat
translation: Tüm korkaklar gibi, o da kendini önemli hissetmekten hoslanir. Biri onu acikca asagilarsa, kirli islerini bize yaptirir. Ancak, senden daha iyi oldugunu düsünürse, ona iltifat edersen, seni yenebilecegini hissedebilir.

english: you. And if he initiated a duel, all the men agreed that they wouldn't intervene. We think he'd be slaughtered in double quick time.
translation: Ve eger o düelloyu baslatirsa, tüm adamlar müdahale etmeyecekleri konusunda anlastilar. Onun cok kisa sürede katledilecegini düsünüyoruz.

english: Can I have a bet on that?
Sorry, we've already taken your bet, wouldn't want any cheating now. Anyway, I have to get back to work. See ya around...
translation: Üzgünüm, bahsinizi zaten kabul ettik, hile yapilmasini istemeyiz. Neyse, isime dönmem gerek. Görüsürüz...

english: Well, if you think you stand a chance, sure. But remember, if he gives us an order, we have to obey.
translation: Eger sansin oldugunu düsünüyorsan, tabii ki. Ama unutma, bize emir verirse, itaat etmek zorundayiz.

english: I'll bet 5 gold that I win.
Huh! It looks like you're betting with money you don't have.
translation: Huh! Görünüse göre sahip olmadigin parayla bahis yapiyorsun.

english: Great, I'll take that bet.
Ok, if you win, you'll get 6 gold back. Anyway, I have to get going, I do have work to do.-- The guard walks off. --
translation: Tamam, kazanirsan 6 altin geri alacaksin. Neyse, gitmem lazim, isim var. -- Muhafiz uzaklasir. --

english: I'll bet 10 gold that I win.
Ok, if you win, you'll get 12 gold back. Anyway, I have to get going, I do have work to do.-- The guard walks off. --
translation: Tamam, kazanirsan 12 altin geri alirsin. Neyse, gitmem gerek, isim var. -- Muhafiz uzaklasir. --

english: I'll bet 15 gold that I win.
Ok, if you win, you'll get 19 gold back. Anyway, I have to get going, I do have work to do.-- The guard walks off. --
translation: Tamam, kazanirsan 19 altin geri alirsin. Neyse, gitmem gerek, isim var. -- Muhafiz uzaklasir. --

english: I'll bet 20 gold that I win.
Ok, if you win, you'll get 30 gold back. Anyway, I have to get going, I do have work to do.-- The guard walks off. --
translation: Tamam, kazanirsan 30 altin geri alirsin. Neyse, gitmem lazim, isim var. -- Muhafiz uzaklasir. --

english: Okay, thanks.
Yeah, whatever!
Get lost before I chop off your head!
Perhaps five gold coins will sweeten your mood?
translation: Belki bes altin sikke ruh halini düzeltir?

english: Well, it certainly will help!
Now then, what did you want to know?
I'm looking for a woman called Ana, have you seen her?
translation: Ana adinda bir kadin ariyorum, onu gördün mü?

english: Hmm, well, we get a lot of people in here. But not many women though... Saw one come in last week....
translation: Hmm, buraya cok insan gelir. Ama kadin pek gelmez... Gecen hafta bir tane gördüm...

english: But I don't know if it's the woman you're looking for?
translation: Ama aradigin kadin o mu bilmiyorum?

english: No, now get lost!
Perhaps five gold coins will help you remember?
translation: Belki bes altin sikke hatirlamana yardimci olur?

english: This mercenary looks very fierce. Are you sure you want to attack him?
translation: Bu parali asker cok vahsi görünüyor. Onu saldirmak istediginden emin misin?

english: You decide not to fight the Mercenary.
Hey, I've come to collect my bet!
Well, I guess congratulations are in order.
Thanks!
And we'll only charge the paltry sum of... erm...
translation: Ve biz sadece cüzi bir miktar talep edecegiz... sey...

english: The guards starts to do some mental calculations. You can see his brow furrow and he starts to sweat profusely.
translation: Muhafizlar zihinsel hesaplamalar yapmaya baslar. Alninin kiristigini ve terlemeye basladigini görebilirsin.

english: Five gold for cleaning up the mess. You have won 1 Gold piece! Well done..! Ha, ha, ha ha!-- The guards walk off chuckling to themselves. --
translation: Daginikligi temizlemek icin bes altin. 1 altin kazandin! Aferin...! Ha, ha, ha ha!-- Muhafizlar kendi kendilerine gülerek uzaklasirlar. --

english: 10 gold for cleaning up the mess. You have won 2 Gold pieces! Well done..! Ha, ha, ha ha!-- The guards walk off chuckling to themselves. --
translation: Daginikligi temizlemek icin 10 altin. 2 altin kazandin! Aferin...! Ha, ha, ha ha!-- Muhafizlar kendi kendilerine gülerek uzaklasirlar. --

english: 15 gold for cleaning up the mess. You have won 4 Gold pieces! Well done..! Ha, ha, ha ha!-- The guards walk off chuckling to themselves. --
translation: Daginikligi temizlemek icin 15 altin. 4 altin kazandiniz! Aferin..! Ha, ha, ha ha!-- Muhafizlar kendi kendilerine gülerek uzaklasirlar. --

english: 20 gold for cleaning up the mess. You have won 10 Gold pieces! Well done..! Ha, ha, ha, ha!-- The guards walk off chuckling to themselves. --
translation: Daginikligi temizlemek icin 20 altin. 10 altin kazandiniz! Aferin..! Ha, ha, ha, ha!-- Muhafizlar kendi kendilerine gülerek uzaklasirlar. --

english: What is this place?
Perhaps five gold coins will make it my business?
translation: Belki bes altinla bu is benim isim olur?

english: Can I take a look around the place?
Does the Captain order you to kill a lot of people?
translation: Kaptan sana cok insan öldürmeni emrediyor mu?

english: Unless what?
Where would I find this Al Zaba Bhasim?
translation: Bu Al Zaba Bhasim'i nerede bulabilirim?

english: The Tenti's, who are they?
Okay, thanks.
Is Al Zaba Bhasim very tough?
translation: Al Zaba Bhasim cok sert biri mi?

english: What are you guarding?
Not to mention the senseless waste of human life.
translation: Insan hayatinin anlamsizca israf edilmesinden bahsetmiyorum bile.

english: It doesn't sound as if you respect your Captain much.

I'll bet 10 gold that I win.
I'll bet 15 gold that I win.

translation: Ana adinda bir kadin ariyorum, onu gördün mü?

english: Perhaps five gold coins will help you remember?
translation: Belki bes altin sikke hatirlamana yardimci olur?

english: Yes, I can take him on!
Er, no thanks, I've had second thoughts about it.
Hand me a banknote, and I'll try to convert it to an item.
translation: Bana bir banknot ver, onu bir esyaya dönüstürmeye calisayim.

english: Yes
No
What are you doing here?
We're getting ready to test our mettle in the Theatre. Most people go in alone but if we do it as a team, we should have no problem.
translation: Tiyatroda cesaretimizi sinamaya hazirlaniyoruz. Cogu kisi tek basina girer ama biz takim olarak girersek sorun yasamayiz.

english: Well good luck with that.
Why, hello there, young'un. Did my boy Percy say you could come up here?
translation: Merhaba genc adam. Oglum Percy buraya gelebilecegini söyledi mi?

english: Yes, I had to pay him to get access to this area.
translation: Evet, bu alana girmek icin ona para ödemek zorunda kaldim.

english: Ah, that's my Percy alright. I raised him well.
translation: Ah, benim Percy'm iste. Onu iyi yetistirdim.

english: You shouldn't be up here!
I don't think you should be using that without speaking to Percy first.
Welcome to the Games Zone!
How do I play board games?
You can challenge someone to a game anywhere in the Games Zone (except on a PvP or Deadman world) by using the right click option.
translation: Oyun Alaninda (PvP veya Deadman dünyasi haric) sag tiklama secenegini kullanarak herhangi birine oyun icin meydan okuyabilirsin.

english: Choose the type of game and then choose the options you want such as time per move.
translation: Oyun türünü secin ve ardindan hamle basina süre gibi istediginiz secenekleri secin.

english: If your opponent accepts the challenge you will be taken to one of the tables around where you will play your game of choice.
translation: Rakibiniz meydan okumayi kabul ederse, sectiginiz oyunu oynayacaginiz masalardan birine yönlendirileceksiniz.

english: Once you have finished your game you will come back here where you can challenge again! We also have tables in a few pubs around the world!
translation: Oyunu bitirdikten sonra buraya geri dönüp tekrar meydan okuyabilirsiniz! Ayrica dünyanin cesitli yerlerindeki birkac barda da masalarimiz var!

english: What games can I play?
Currently we offer Draughts, Runelink, Runesquares, and Runeversi.
translation: Su anda Draughts, Runelink, Runesquares ve Runeversi oyunlarini sunuyoruz.

english: Draughts?
Draughts uses standard rules, apart from: a draw is declared if no piece has been taken or promoted for forty moves.
translation: Draughts, asagidaki durum haric standart kurallari kullanir: Kirk hamle boyunca hicbir tas alinmaz veya terfi ettirilmezse beraberlik ilan edilir.

english: Runelink?
Yup, you have to get four runes in row.
translation: Evet, dört runu arka arkaya dizmeniz gerekir.

english: Runesquares?
Yes, you take it in turns to add a line with the goal of making squares. Everytime you make a square you take another turn.
translation: Evet, sirayla kareler olusturmak amaciyla bir cizgi ekliyorsunuz. Her kare olusturdugunuzda bir tur daha oynuyorsunuz.

english: Runeversi?
Yep, the aim is to have more of your runes on the board than your opponent. You can take your opponents pieces by trapping them between your own.
translation: Evet, amac rakibinizden daha fazla runenizi tahtaya yerlestirmektir. Rakibinizin taslarini kendi taslarinizla sikistirarak alabilirsiniz.

english: Can I buy a drink please?
I'm afraid I don't sell drinks.
Thanks!
Unfortunately we do not offer board game playing on this world. Try logging onto a non-PvP or Deadman world!
translation: Maalesef bu dünyada masa oyunu oynama imkani sunmuyoruz. PvP olmayan veya Deadman dünyasina giris yapmayi deneyin!

Hello. King Arthur has sent me on a quest for the Holy Grail. He thought you could offer some assistance.
translation: Merhaba. Kral Arthur beni Kutsal Kase'yi bulmak icin bir göreve gönderdi. Sizin yardim edebileceginizi düsündü.

english: Ah yes... the Holy Grail...
That is a powerful artefact indeed. Returning it here would help Camelot a lot.
translation: O gercekten de cok güclü bir eser. Onu buraya geri getirmek Camelot'a cok yardimci olur.

english: Due to its nature the Holy Grail is likely to reside in a holy place.
translation: Dogasi geregi Kutsal Kase muhtemelen kutsal bir yerde bulunuyordur.

english: Any suggestions?
I believe there is a holy island somewhere not far away... I'm not entirely sure... I spent too long inside that crystal! Anyway, go and talk to someone over there.
translation: Sanirim cok uzak olmayan bir yerde kutsal bir ada var... Tam emin degilim... O kristalin icinde cok uzun süre kaldim! Her neyse, gidip oradaki biriyle konus.

english: I suppose you could try speaking to Sir Galahad?
He returned from the quest many years after everyone else. He seems to know something about it, but he can only speak about those experiences cryptically.
translation: O, digerlerinden yillar sonra görevden döndü. Bu konuda bir seyler biliyor gibi görünüyor, ama deneyimlerini sadece gizemli bir sekilde anlatabiliyor.

english: Thank you for the advice.
Where can I find Sir Galahad?
Galahad now lives a life of religious contemplation. He lives somewhere west of McGrubor's Wood I think.
translation: Galahad su anda dini bir hayat sürüyor. Sanirim McGrubor Ormani'nin batisinda bir yerde yasiyor.

english: Oh dear, did Morgan capture you too?
translation: Oh hayir, Morgan seni de mi yakaladi?

english: Err, no. It was all part of my brilliant plan. I allowed her to capture me so I could find out where she was keeping all of you.
translation: Hayir, hayir. Hepsi benim parlak planimin bir parcasiydi. Beni yakalamasina izin verdim, böylece hepinizin nerede tutuldugunu ögrenebildim.

english: Eh, is that so? Very clever. Now that you've found us, what is your plan, oh brilliant leader?
translation: Öyle mi? Cok zekice. Bizi bulduguna göre, planin nedir, ey parlak lider?

english: Hey, why do I have to do all the thinking here? You're the brilliant wizard.
translation: Hey, neden tüm düsünme isini ben yapiyorum? Parlak büyücü sensin.

english: Well, all great plans start with knowledge. Let me bring you up to speed with the situation. What do you want to know?
translation: Tüm büyük planlar bilgiyle baslar. Size durumu özetleyeyim. Ne bilmek istiyorsunuz?

english: Where is King Arthur now? he's not in the jail cell with us.
translation: Kral Arthur su anda nerede? Bizimle ayni hücrede degil.

english: As the final blow to our morale, Morgan turned Arthur into a granite statue before our very eyes. He was taken away by the Black Knights, for what purposes I know not.
translation: Moralimizi tamamen bozmak icin Morgan, Arthur'u gözlerimizin önünde granit bir heykele dönüstürdü. Kara Sövalyeler tarafindan götürüldü, ama ne amacla, bilmiyorum.

english: What is the connection between Morgan Le Faye and the Sinclairs?
translation: Morgan Le Faye ile Sinclair'ler arasindaki baglanti nedir?

english: Morgan le Faye has been itching to get revenge upon Arthur and myself for some time. When she heard of the murder of old Sinclair, she learned that she was not the only one with a vendetta against Camelot.
translation: Morgan le Faye bir süredir Arthur ve benden intikam almak icin can atiyordu. Yasli Sinclair'in öldürüldügünü duydugunda, Camelot'a karsi intikam pesinde olan tek kisinin kendisi olmadigini anladi.

english: The Sinclairs have wanted to get their slimy hands on Camelot since their father's death. With Morgan's cunning and their riches, they make a formidable team. They brought the services of the Black Knights from
translation: Sinclair'ler, babalarinin ölümünden beri Camelot'u ele gecirmek istiyorlardi. Morgan'in kurnazligi ve onlarin zenginligi ile müthis bir ekip olusturuyorlar. Lord Daquarius'tan Kara Sövalyelerin hizmetlerini satin aldilar ve Camelot'u ele gecirdiler.

english: Lord Daquarius and overran Camelot. We were outnumbered and taken by surprise.
The Sinclairs stole our home, but Morgan struck the greater blow by stealing the Holy Grail, Arthur's most prized possession.
translation: Sinclair ailesi evimizi caldi, ama Morgan, Arthur'un en degerli varligi olan Kutsal Kase'yi calarak daha büyük bir darbe vurdu.

english: So what's the plan of escape? Are you going to teleport us all away? Turn us into fish and swim to sea?
translation: Peki kacis plani nedir? Hepimizi teleport mu edeceksin? Bizi baliga dönüstürüp denize mi yüzdüreceksin?

english: During the battle at Camelot, Morgan cast a spell against me which appears to have stripped me of my powers. I must admit, the loss of my magic has left me befuddled, making it difficult to create a plan.
translation: Camelot'taki savas sirasinda Morgan bana bir büyü yapti ve bu büyü benim güclerimi elimden aldi. Itiraf etmeliyim ki, sihrimi kaybetmek beni saskina cevirdi ve bir plan yapmami zorlastirdi.

english: Well, I'm sure if we put our heads together we will think of something.
translation: Eminim kafalarimizi bir araya getirirsek bir seyler bulabiliriz.

english: Let's talk about a plan of escape.
Escape is only a short-term plan. We should discuss the long-term goals as well.
translation: Kacis sadece kisa vadeli bir plan. Uzun vadeli hedefleri de tartismaliyiz.

english: How will we go about reclaiming Camelot?
I think I could reclaim Camelot from the Sinclairs on my own.
translation: Camelot'u Sinclair'lerden tek basima geri alabilirim.

english: How do you plan to do that? You couldn't even defend it from them.
translation: Bunu nasil yapmayi planliyorsun? Onlardan savunamadin bile.

english: They don't know I've lost my magic. Besides, I've got a few tricks up my sleeves. For all their snobberies, they're still just spoiled brats. It shouldn't be difficult, but time is of the essence. I need you to break me out
translation: Sihir gücümü kaybettigimi bilmiyorlar. Ayrica, birkac numaram var. Tüm kibirlerine ragmen, onlar hala simarik veletler. Zor olmamali, ama zaman cok önemli. Beni buradan hizli ve sessizce kacirman gerekiyor,

english: of here quickly and quietly, so Morgan cannot alert them.
So to reclaim Camelot, I need to break you out of jail quietly.
translation: Yani Camelot'u geri almak icin seni hapisten sessizce kacirmam gerekiyor.

english: Precisely.
How do I retrieve the Holy Grail? Do you know where it is?
translation: Kutsal Kase'yi nasil geri alacagim? Nerede oldugunu biliyor musun?

english: Morgan always keeps things of power near her. So the grail will be somewhere in Keep Le Faye. However, it will most likely be disguised and booby-trapped. Morgan has a thing about transmogrifying.
translation: Morgan, güclü seyleri her zaman yaninda tutar. Yani Kase, Le Faye Kalesi'nde bir yerde olacaktir. Ancak, büyük olasilikla gizlenmis ve bubi tuzagiyla donatilmis olacaktir. Morgan, sekil degistirmeye meraklidir.

english: The last time I was in Keep Le Faye, it was pretty well guarded. I don't think I'll be able to sneak in quietly.
translation: Le Faye Kalesi'ne son gittigimde, oldukca iyi korunuyordu. Sessizce iceri sizabilecegimi sanmiyorum.

english: No, that won't work. Better to break out of the jail with all of the Round Table Knights. Let them deal with the guards while you retrieve the Grail.
translation: Hayir, bu ise yaramaz. Yuvarlak Masa Sövalyeleri ile birlikte hapishaneden kacmak daha iyi olur. Sen Kutsal Kase'yi alirken, onlar muhafizlarla ilgilensinler.

english: So, I need to break eight knights out of jail? That could be troublesome.
translation: Yani sekiz sövalyeyi hapishaneden kacirmam mi gerekiyor? Bu zor olabilir.

english: Often the most complicated things have the simplest answers. Try leaving through the door.
translation: Cogu zaman en karmasik seylerin en basit cevaplari vardir. Kapidan cikmayi dene.

english: But it's locked.
When has that ever stopped an intrepid adventurer such as yourself?
translation: Bu, senin gibi cesur bir maceraciyi ne zaman durdurdu ki?

english: Assuming I can escape from this jail, how can I save King Arthur?
translation: Bu hapishaneden kacabilecegimi varsayarsak, Kral Arthur'u nasil kurtarabilirim?

english: I believe he's been taken to the headquarters of the Black Knights. I'm afraid I'm not well travelled on that side of the world, so I don't know its exact location. However, it's trickier than just finding Arthur. You'll
translation: Sanirim Kara Sövalyeler'in karargahina götürüldü. Maalesef o bölgede pek gezmedim, bu yüzden tam yerini bilmiyorum. Ancak, Arthur'u bulmaktan daha zor bir is bu. Onu granit heykele dönüstüren büyüyü bozman

english: need to free him of the spell that turned him into a granite statue.
And how do I go about doing that?
I have no idea.
WHAT?

Let me finish. I may have no idea, but a wizard friend of mine should. His name is Wizard Cromperty, and he's very experienced in freeing people from stone since he keeps teleporting them into it. Speak to him in East
translation: Birak da bitireyim. Benim hicbir fikrim olmayabilir, ama bir büyücü arkadasimin olabilir. Adi Büyücü Cromperty ve insanlari tastan kurtarma konusunda cok deneyimli, cünkü onlari sürekli tasa dönüstürüyor. Dogu

english: Ardougne, he'll help you.
translation: Ardougne'da onunla konus, sana yardim edecektir.

english: Never mind.
Well done, young adventurer. You truly are a worthy knight.
translation: Aferin, genc maceraci. Sen gercekten degerli bir sövalyesin.

english: You receive access to the prayers Chivalry and Piety and 20,000 XP in your Hitpoints, Strength, Attack, and Defence skills. You may also speak to Merlin to set your respawn point to Camelot.
translation: Sövalyelik ve Dindarlik dualarina erisim ve Hitpoints, Strength, Attack ve Defence becerilerinde 20.000 XP kazaniyorsun. Ayrica Merlin ile konusarak yeniden dogma noktani Camelot olarak ayarlayabilirsin.

english: Hello.
Excuse me for rushing off like this, but I must get back to my workroom.
translation: Böyle aceleyle gittigim icin özür dilerim, ama atölyeme geri dönmem gerekiyor.

english: Thank you for the advice.
Where can I find Sir Galahad?
Tell me where King Arthur is.
Tell me about Morgan Le Faye and the Sinclairs.
translation: Morgan Le Faye ve Sinclair'ler hakkinda bana bilgi verin.

english: What do we do now?
Reclaim Camelot
Retreive the Holy Grail
Save King Arthur
Never mind.
Oh, hello! Children, say hello to the surface-dweller.
translation: Merhaba! Cocuklar, yüzey sakinine merhaba deyin.

english: Haha! You look funny!
I'm sure you look just as funny to the surface-dweller!
translation: Eminim sen de yüzey sakinine komik görünüyorsundur!

english: You smell!
There's no need to be rude!
I'm sorry about that, surface-dweller.
Are you really from the surface?
Yes I am.
Are you [player name]? Did you help Zanik save the city?
translation: Sen Maceraci misin? Zanik'in sehri kurtarmasina yardim ettin mi?

english: Just because [he's/she's] a surface-dweller, doesn't mean [he's/she's] [player name]! There are lots of surface-dwellers!
translation: Sirf yüzey sakini diye Maceraci oldugu anlamina gelmez! Cok sayida yüzey sakini var!

english: Actually I am [player name].
[Player name]? Really?
Zanik told me about you! I'm so pleased to meet you!
translation: Zanik bana senden bahsetti! Seninle tanistigima cok memnun oldum!

english: Shan't!
Well don't blame me if he doesn't want to talk to you either!
translation: O da seninle konusmak istemezse beni suclama!

english: Sorry about that.
I don't think I should just do that with no reasoning... perhaps they are going to try something sneaky. Then I can kick to my heart's content.
translation: Bunu sebepsiz yere yapmamaliyim... belki de sinsi bir sey yapmaya calisacaklardir. O zaman istedigim kadar tekmeleyebilirim.

english: Noo don't put that in there!
I've got all the bad ones just for you!
translation: Senin icin tüm kötü olanlari aldim!

english: Curse you!
How's life now the curse has been lifted?
Much better thanks to you. We're all very impressed.
translation: Senin sayende cok daha iyi. Hepimiz cok etkilendik.

english: Hello there. I have a message for you.
Hello there. I have a message for you, but you'll need to make some room for it.
translation: Merhaba. Sana bir mesajim var, ama bunun icin biraz yer acman gerekecek.

english: Sorry, I don't have anything for you right now.
translation: Üzgünüm, su anda sana verecek bir seyim yok.

english: [player name]?
Are you there [player name]?
[player name]? I have a message for you.
[player name]? You've been sent a message.
Maybe another time.
I have a letter for you. I'm told it's quite important. Please read it when you get a chance.
translation: Sana bir mektup var. Oldukca önemli oldugu söylendi. Firsat buldugunda lütfen oku.

english: Apparently you destroyed that last letter I gave you without reading it, or something like that. The sender doesn't appreciate that sort of thing, so I've got another one for you.
translation: Görünüse göre sana verdigim son mektubu okumadan yok etmissin, ya da öyle bir sey. Gönderen böyle seyleri hos karsilamiyor, bu yüzden sana bir tane daha getirdim.

english: Look, you can destroy that letter as many times as you want, but it won't change anything. The sender isn't the kind of individual who takes no for an answer, so for both of our sakes, please just read it.
translation: Bak, o mektubu istedigin kadar yok edebilirsin, ama bu hicbir seyi degistirmeyecek. Gönderen, hayir cevabini kabul eden türden biri degil, bu yüzden ikimizin de iyiligi icin lütfen oku.

english: Please... don't keep doing this. You don't know who you're dealing with...
translation: Lütfen... bunu yapmaya devam etme. Kiminle ugrastigini bilmiyorsun...

english: Take me to your leader.
Wot?
Isn't that what you're supposed to say when you meet a new race of people?
translation: Yeni bir irkla karsilastiginda böyle demen gerekmez mi?

english: Well, mate, we don't av no leader, so I ain't gonna take ya to um. We auw av eqwuw right's un stuff, yeah? But if ya wont an intro go live it up wiv da Onerimancer.
translation: Dostum, bizim liderimiz yok, bu yüzden seni ona götüremeyecegim. Hepimizin esit haklari var, degil mi? Ama bir tanitim istiyorsan, Onerimancer'a git.

english: OK. Is he rich and powerful?
translation: Tamam. O zengin ve güclü mü?

english: No man, SHE, is dead-wise yeah? She is responsible for initiation wituals an stuff.
translation: Hayir dostum, O, ölümsüz, tamam mi? O, inisiyasyon törenlerinden ve diger seylerden sorumlu.

english: Great. Thanks. And where is she?
She angs out int souf east of ouw island.
Okey dokey....yeah.
Huh?
Yeah? Need something?
What do you have?
Rock. Lots of it.
What brings you here?
Rock. This here is Stonecutter Outpost. We get rock, cut it, then sell it.
translation: Kaya. Burasi Stonecutter Outpost. Kaya cikariyor, kesiyor ve satiyoruz.

english: So you're pretty far from home then?
What? No. We go back to Cam Torum sometimes, but this is home.
translation: Ne? Hayir. Bazen Cam Torum'a geri dönüyoruz, ama burasi bizim evimiz.

english: Fair enough.
Need something else?
translation: Baska bir seye ihtiyacin var mi?

english: I'm good.
Then why you keep staring? Get gone!
translation: O zaman neden bakip duruyorsun? Git buradan!

english: What do you have?
What brings you here?
I'm good.
Oh... Nilsal. Unusual to see someone up here. What can I do for you?
translation: Oh... Nilsal. Burada birini görmek alisilmadik bir sey. Senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: What do you do around here?
I used to work downstairs... but I started using the lab after hours for my own projects and the supervisor found out. Now I've been assigned to rooftop duty to look after the plants.
translation: Eskiden asagida calisiyordum... ama mesai saatleri disinda kendi projelerim icin laboratuvari kullanmaya basladim ve amirim bunu ögrendi. Simdi bitkilere bakmak icin cati görevine atandim.

english: Do you have any tips for potion production?
translation: Iksir üretimi icin herhangi bir ipucun var mi?

english: Yes... Make good use of the digweed once they're ready to pick. Choose which potion you use it on wisely!
translation: Evet... Toplanmaya hazir olduklarinda digweed'i iyi kullan. Hangi iksirde kullanacagini akillica sec!

english: Oh, and the processing tables can be sped up a bit if you use them correctly. You might need to do some experimenting to figure that out.
translation: Oh, ve isleme masalarini dogru kullanirsan biraz hizlandirabilirsin. Bunu anlamak icin biraz deneme yapman gerekebilir.

english: Thanks! I'd better be going now.
What do you do around here?
Do you have any tips for potion production?
translation: Iksir üretimi icin herhangi bir ipucun var mi?

english: Thanks! I'd better be going now.
Hello, you look worried.
My husband is serving near the Lizardman Canyon. I'm worried that something might happen to him.
translation: Kocam Lizardman Kanyonu yakinlarinda görev yapiyor. Ona bir sey olacagindan endiseleniyorum.

english: And I lost my job last week. I need to find another one before my savings run out.
translation: Ve gecen hafta isimi kaybettim. Birikimlerim bitmeden baska bir is bulmam gerekiyor.

english: Oh, that is bad. I'm sorry to hear that.
translation: Oh, bu cok kötü. Bunu duyduguma üzüldüm.

english: Well, it's a difficult time for a lot of people I guess. The war with the lizardmen never ends.
translation: Sanirim bircok insan icin zor bir dönem. Lizardmenlerle savas hic bitmiyor.

english: Thanks so much for saving me from being a vampyre. Here, take this certificate, I'm sorry but it's all I can offer as a reward.
translation: Beni vampir olmaktan kurtardigin icin cok tesekkürler. Al, bu sertifikayi al, üzgünüm ama ödül olarak sunabilecegim tek sey bu.

english: Thanks for changing me back, it must have been hard for you. I must be off now.
translation: Beni eski halime döndürdügün icin tesekkürler, senin icin zor olmus olmali. Artik gitmeliyim.

english: Hello!
Oh, hello there. I'm afraid I don't have time to talk right now. I'm rather busy. Come back some other time please.
translation: Merhaba. Maalesef su anda konusacak vaktim yok. Oldukca mesgulüm. Lütfen baska bir zaman tekrar gel.

english: Ok, sorry.
Thanks again for finding my pendant. I felt so lost without it.
translation: Kolyeyi buldugun icin tekrar tesekkürler. Onsuz kendimi cok kaybolmus hissediyordum.

english: You're welcome. Goodbye.
Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: Hey, bu Kahraman! Vay canina! Sen harikasin, o iki juvinate ve Gadderank'i nasil alt ettin? Ve kasaba cok güzel, harika bir is cikarmissin!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
I'm Mihail, I'm trying to stay warm by this fire.
translation: Ben Mihail, bu atesin yaninda isinmaya calisiyorum.

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: Oh, pek bir sey yok, hepimiz hala vampirlerden saklaniyoruz ve bu korkunc yerde gecimimizi sagliyoruz, umarim yakinda Salve'deki tapinaga yolculuk yapacak kadar gücleniriz.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: Bildigim kadariyla yok, su anda cok yararli olan bazi temel olanaklara sahibiz, hepimiz sana cok minnettariz. Daha önce hic bir kahraman görmedim veya tanimadim, bu yüzden karsilastiracak bir seyim yok, ama sanirim

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: cogu insanin görüsüne göre, sen bir kahramansin! Ben sahsen seninle tanistigima cok memnunum.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Ok, thanks.
Hello!
Arr? Be ye wantin' te go on account with our gang o' fillibusters?
translation: Ne? Bizim korsan cetesine katilmak mi istiyorsun?

english: The powder monkey be takin' a caulk after gettin' rowdy on bumboo, so there be plenty of room for ye.
translation: Barutcu, bambuda gürültü yaptiktan sonra bir süre dinlenmeye cekildi, yani senin icin bolca yer var.

english: Riiiiight...
I'll just be over here if you need me.
Wanna buy some clothes? Good quality, none of yer rags.
translation: Biraz kiyafet almak ister misin? Kaliteli, pacavra degil.

english: I'll take a look.
No thanks.
Then what are you doin' in my shop? Move along.
translation: O zaman dükkanimda ne isin var? Git buradan.

english: Why does that shirt have a hole in it?
It's to put your head through.
In the stomach? Isn't that an odd place for a neck hole?
translation: Mide mi? Boyun deligi icin garip bir yer degil mi?

english: Oh! It seems as if I must have slipped while cleaning it and put a bit of a hole in the front.
translation: Oh! Temizlerken kaymis olmaliyim ve ön tarafina kücük bir delik acmisim.

english: Silly me.
What were you cleaning it with, a blood-covered scimitar?
translation: Neyle temizliyordun, kanli bir kilicla mi?...

english: If I say yes will you buy it?
No.
Then no, I was not cleaning it with a blood-covered scimitar.
translation: O zaman hayir, kanli bir kilicla temizlemiyordum.

english: Where do you get these clothes?
Found em.
You found a bunch of slashed up clothing, some of which has been shoddily cleaned and stitched together?
translation: Bir sürü kesik kiyafet mi buldun, bazilari da özensizce temizlenip dikilmis mi?

english: Yes.
Look, do you want in on this or not?
translation: Bak, bu ise girmek istiyor musun, istemiyor musun?

english: Where did that pillar come from?
You wanna buy it?
Is it for sale?
Would you buy it if it was?
If it was could you sell it to me?
If I couldn't would you still give me the money?
translation: Satamazsam yine de bana parayi verir misin?

english: Where did this pillar come from?
Dunno. There are a load of islands out this way, and a lot of them have little bits and pieces like this scattered around.
translation: Bilmiyorum. Bu tarafta bir sürü ada var ve cogunda bunun gibi kücük parcalar daginik halde duruyor.

english: The way I see it, there must have been some people out here at one point, then they went away.
translation: Bana kalirsa, bir zamanlar burada bazi insanlar yasamis, sonra da gitmisler.

english: Where?
Search me.
I'd rather not.
I'll take a look.
No thanks.
Why does that shirt have a hole in it?
Where did that pillar come from?
Thank you, I hope you like your present. I must be leaving now though.
translation: Tesekkürler, umarim hediyenizi begenirsiniz. Artik gitmem gerek.

english: I must be leaving now.
Sorry, but I'm trying to talk to [other player's display name], but [he/she] seems to be ignoring me.
translation: Üzgünüm, su gerizekali ile konusmaya calisiyorum ama o beni görmezden geliyor gibi.

english: Greetings [player name], I need your help.
Talk to me, [player name]!
Hello, [player name], are you there?
I'd like to talk to you, [player name]!
ehem... Hello [player name], please talk to me!
translation: Ehem... Merhaba Maceraci, lütfen konus benimle!

english: Maybe later.
If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: Senin kadar cirkin olsaydim, yüzümü halka göstermeye cesaret edemezdim!

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: Oh! Sey... Az önce bir tane yedim de ondan!

english: Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: Hayatina deger veriyorsan bir daha benimle konusma!

english: Get lost!
I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: Sana verecek hicbir seyim yok, birak beni rahat, dilenci.

english: Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
translation: Su anda bununla ugrasacak vaktim yok.

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: Senin gibi zavalli bir et yiginiyla konusmak istemiyorum.

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: Cok kötü bir gün... tadini cikarin.

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: Eger birini yakalarsan, paylasacagina söz ver.

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
You smell familiar...
Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: Buralarda insan gördün mü? Cok acim.

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: Bana kan tadi seven biri gibi görünüyorsun.

english: Good day to you, my friend.
Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: Bir dakika izin ver, dislerime bir sey sikismis...

english: Hello. Your parents say you saw what happened to Elena...
translation: Merhaba. Ailen, Elena'ya olanlari gördügünü söyledi...

english: *sniff* Yes I was near the south east corner when I saw Elena walking by. I was about to run to greet her when some men jumped out. They shoved a sack over her head and dragged her into a building.
translation: *koklama* Evet, Elena'nin gectigini gördügümde güneydogu kösesindeydim. Ona kosup selam vermek üzereydim ki birkac adam ortaya cikti. Basina bir cuval gecirip onu bir binaya sürüklediler.

english: Which building?
It was the boarded up building with no windows in the south east corner of West Ardougne.
translation: West Ardougne'nin güneydogu kösesindeki penceresiz, tahtalarla kapatilmis binaydi.

english: Have you found Elena yet?
No, I'm still looking.
I hope you find her. She was nice.
Yes, she's safe at home.
I hope she comes and visits sometime.
Maybe.
I hope Elena comes to visit soon.
Hello Adventurer. Welcome to Mill Lane Mill. Can I help you?
translation: Merhaba Maceraci. Mill Lane Mill'e hos geldin. Yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: Who are you?
I'm Miss Millicent Miller the Miller of Mill Lane Mill. Our family have been milling flour for generations.
translation: Ben Mill Lane Mill'in degirmeni Millicent Miller. Ailemiz nesillerdir un degirmenciligi yapiyor.

english: It's a good business to be in. People will always need flour.
translation: Iyi bir is. Insanlar her zaman una ihtiyac duyar.

english: How do I mill flour?
What is this place?
This is Mill Lane Mill. Millers of the finest flour in Gielinor, and home to the Miller family for many generations
translation: Burasi Mill Lane Mill. Gielinor'un en kaliteli ununu üreten degirmenciler ve nesillerdir Miller ailesinin evi.

english: We take grain from the field nearby and mill into flour.
translation: Yakindaki tarlalardan tahil alip un haline getiriyoruz.

english: Making flour is pretty easy. First of all you need to get some grain. You can pick some from wheat fields. There is one just outside the Mill, but there are many others scattered across Gielinor. Feel free to pick wheat
translation: Un yapmak oldukca kolaydir. Öncelikle tahil bulmaniz gerekir. Bugday tarlalarindan toplayabilirsiniz. Degirmenin hemen disinda bir tane var, ama Gielinor'da baska tarlalar da var. Tarlamizdan bugday toplamaktan cekinmeyin!

english: from our field! There always seems to be plenty of wheat there.
translation: Orada her zaman bol miktarda bugday bulunur.

english: Then I bring my wheat here?

Yes, or one of the other mills in Gielinor. They all work the same way. Just take your grain to the top floor of the mill (up two ladders, there are three floors including this one) and then place some grain into the hopper.
translation: Evet, ya da Gielinor'daki diger degirmenlerden birine. Hepsi ayni sekilde calisir. Tahilinizi degirmenin en üst katina götürün (iki merdiven cikin, bu kat dahil olmak üzere üc kat vardir) ve ardindan hazneye biraz tahil koyun.

english: Then you need to start the grinding process by pulling the hopper lever. You can add more grain, but each time you add grain you have to pull the hopper lever again.
translation: Sonra hazne kolunu cekerek ögütme islemini baslatmalisin. Daha fazla tahil ekleyebilirsin, ancak her tahil eklediginde hazne kolunu tekrar cekmen gerekir.

english: So where does the flour go then?
The flour appears in this room here, you'll need a pot to put the flour into. One pot will hold the flour made by one load of grain
translation: Un bu odada ortaya cikiyor, unu koymak icin bir tencereye ihtiyacin olacak. Bir tencere, bir yük tahildan elde edilen unu alabilir.

english: And that's it! You now have some pots of finely ground flour of the highest quality. Ideal for making tasty cakes or delicous bread. I'm not a cook so you'll have to ask a cook to find out how to bake things.
translation: Hepsi bu kadar! Artik en yüksek kalitede ince ögütülmüs un iceren birkac tencereniz var. Lezzetli kekler veya nefis ekmekler yapmak icin ideal. Ben asci degilim, bu yüzden pisirme yöntemlerini ögrenmek icin bir asciya sormaniz gerekecek.

english: Great! Thanks for your help.
I'm fine, thanks.
Hello Adventurers. Welcome to Mill Lane Mill. Can I help you?
translation: Merhaba maceracilar. Mill Lane Mill'e hos geldiniz. Yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun! What is this place?
What's flour?
It's the stuff we get from milling the grain. We use it to make bread and cakes and things.
translation: Tahili ögüterek elde ettigimiz sey. Ekmek, kek ve benzeri seyler yapmak icin kullaniriz.

english: We don't have any of those things in Dorgesh-Kaan! They sound so interesting!
translation: Dorgesh-Kaan'da bunlardan hicbiri yok! Cok ilginc görünüyorlar!

english: Who are you?
What is this place?
How do I mill flour?
I'm fine, thanks.
Do you want to buy a lamp, surface-dweller?
translation: Lamba almak ister misin, yüzey sakini?

english: Yes please.
No thanks.
Suit yourself.
Can you fill a lamp with oil please?
You can do that yourself! Just put some swamp tar in the lamp oil still here and then use the lamp on the still.
translation: Bunu kendin yapabilirsin! Buradaki lamba yagi damiticisina biraz bataklik katrani koy ve damiticiyi kullan.

english: How do the lamps around the city work?
They work by our very own Dorgeshuun magic!
Sometimes they don't work very well, though. The light orbs blow and they have to be replaced.
translation: Ancak bazen cok iyi calismazlar. Isik küreleri patlar ve degistirilmeleri gerekir.

english: If you ever see a lamp that's gone out, you can fix it by replacing the light orb. You can make new light orbs out of glass, and use a piece of wire on them to add the filament.
translation: Sönmüs bir lamba görürsen, isik küresini degistirerek onu tamir edebilirsin. Camdan yeni isik küreleri yapabilir ve üzerlerine bir parca tel takarak filamenti ekleyebilirsin.

english: There's a machine in the south of the city that makes the wire you need.
translation: Sehrin güneyinde ihtiyacin olan teli üreten bir makine var.

english: Lamps!
Lanterns!
Tinderboxes!
Torches!
Lamp oil!
Yes please.
No thanks.
Can you fill a lamp with oil please?
How do the lamps around the city work?
Gah! Trolls everywhere. There's no escape!
translation: Gah! Her yer trollerle dolu. Kacis yok!

english: You could just leave the mine.
Oh, I'd never thought of that.
This place rocks!
No it doesn't, it stays perfectly still.
translation: Hayir, öyle degil, tamamen sabit duruyor.

english: Bah! Be quiet, pedant.
High hoe, high hoe!
Why are you singing about farming implements at altitude?
translation: Neden yüksekte tarim aletleri hakkinda sarki söylüyorsun?

english: I don't know, I've never thought about it. Ask my Dad, he taught me the song.
translation: Bilmiyorum, hic düsünmedim. Babama sor, sarkiyi o ögretti.

english: How's your prospecting going?
Mine's going pretty well.
Mine? Mine...you get it?
Oh, I got it. That doesn't make it funny though.
Suit yourself.
I've been here for two days straight. When I close my eyes I see rocks.
translation: Iki gündür buradayim. Gözlerimi kapattigimda kayalar görüyorum.

english: Why would anyone stay here for so long?
translation: Neden biri bu kadar uzun süre burada kalmak istesin ki?

english: I fear the outside. I fear the big light.
Oh dear. Being underground for so long may have driven you mad.
translation: Ah canim. Bu kadar uzun süre yeraltinda kalmak seni delirtmis olabilir.

english: My back is killing me!
Could be worse, it could be the trolls killing you.
translation: Daha kötüsü de olabilirdi, troller seni öldürebilirdi.

english: How very droll.
No, troll.
Bah! I resist your attempts at jollity.
Pay-dirt!
Ow!
Exchuse me... I am trying to tell my verrry good friends 'bout my uncle's bushy beard.
translation: Affedersiniz... Cok iyi arkadaslarima amcamin gür sakalindan bahsetmeye calisiyorum.

english: Exchuse me... I am lishning to my good friend.
He could hardly climb a ladder without tripping.
Such a long beard it reached the floor!
translation: Sakal o kadar uzundu ki yere kadar uzaniyordu!

english: The beard wasn't so clean after meals.
translation: Yemeklerden sonra sakali pek temiz olmazdi.

english: His beard used to get into everyone's dinner.
It was like a jungle on his chin!
In the summer he didn't need clothes.
I mean, he needed to clean it more.
translation: Yani, sakalini daha sik temizlemesi gerekiyordu.

english: He had the bushiest beard ever!
He was the hairiest dwarf in town.
His wife could use it for a blanket.
Pearls of wisdom!
Ah, tell it!
Best times ever!
Right you are.
Great days!
I'm going to be sick!
You're right.
You're so right.
Those were the days!
Not like nowadays.
Good day, Your Royal Highness.
Good day. What are you doing?
I'm mining coal. It's pretty tough going.
translation: Kömür cikariyorum. Oldukca zor bir is.

english: Good luck with that.
Thank you, Your Royal Highness.
Can you tell me how the kingdom approves of me?
translation: Kralligin beni nasil onayladigini söyleyebilir misin?

english: [amount]% of people approve of you.
The storerooms are full, your Highness. You should talk to Advisor Ghrim to collect what we've gathered for you.
translation: Depolar dolu, Majesteleri. Danisman Ghrim ile konusup senin icin topladiklarimizi almalisin.

english: Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to answer this for me.
Miner Magnus has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Madenci Magnus sana bir meydan okuma parsömeni verdi!

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
How can that be? Go check again!
translation: Bu nasil olabilir? Tekrar kontrol et!

english: Spot on!
Miner Magnus has given you another clue scroll!
translation: Madenci Magnus sana baska bir ipucu parsömeni verdi!

english: Oi! Where d'you think you're going? Come and speak to me before you go wondering through there. You'll get yourself killed!
translation: Hey! Nereye gittigini saniyorsun? Oraya gitmeden önce gel de benimle konus. Kendini öldüreceksin!

english: Oi, get yer hands off that! It's reserved for survivors of the Colosseum.
translation: Hey, ellerini ondan cek! O, Colosseum'dan sag kurtulanlar icin ayrilmis.

english: You do not have enough Glory to use that.
translation: Onu kullanmak icin yeterli San'in yok.

english: Hello there.
Welcome, Rookie.
What is this place?
This place...? Why, This is the great Fortis Colosseum!
translation: Burasi mi...? Burasi muhtesem Fortis Colosseum!

english: Adventurers come from near and far to test their might within these walls.
translation: Maceracilar, bu duvarlar icinde güclerini sinamak icin uzaklardan geliyorlar.

english: That sounds exciting!
Indeed it is. If you are victorious in the Colosseum, the whole of Varlamore shall hear of your name.
translation: Gercekten de öyle. Kolezyum'da galip gelirsen, tüm Varlamore adini duyacak.

english: I imagine itsquite the challenge then?
translation: O zaman oldukca zorlu bir mücadele olacak sanirim?

english: It'll put your skills to the test alright.
translation: Beceri ve yeteneklerinizi sinayacak bir mücadele olacak.

english: How do I participate?
Just head through that tunnel behind me and we'll get the show started! Make sure you've got everything you need. Once you're in you can't leave until the end of a wave!
translation: Arkamdaki tünelden gecin, gösteri baslasin! Ihtiyaciniz olan her seyi aldiginizdan emin olun. Iceri girdikten sonra, dalga bitene kadar cikamazsiniz!

english: Come and ask if you have any other questions.
Can you tell me about modifiers?
translation: Modifiye ediciler hakkinda bilgi verir misiniz?

english: Yes! After all, they were my idea...
Oh...
Every time you complete a wave, I'll offer you a choice of three modifiers.
translation: Her dalgayi tamamladiginizda size üc modifiye edici secenegi sunacagim.

english: Each modifier will increase the challenge for the rest of the run - So choose wisely!
translation: Her modifiye edici, geri kalan bölümlerde zorlugu artiracak, bu yüzden akillica secin!

english: Some modifiers can be offered multiple times, with the effects then growing in power!
translation: Bazi modifiye ediciler birden fazla kez sunulabilir ve etkileri giderek güclenir!

english: Thanks for the heads up!
Was there anything else?
How do I get rewarded?
Well it's a bit different to just killing monsters and picking up items, as I'm sure you're used to...
translation: Bu, senin aliskin oldugun gibi sadece canavarlari öldürmek ve esyalari toplamaktan biraz farkli...

english: How so?
After each wave inside the Colosseum, I'll show you the rewards you have earned, as well as what you'll earn from the next wave...
translation: Colosseum'daki her dalganin ardindan, kazandigin ödülleri ve bir sonraki dalgadan kazanacaklarini gösterecegim...

english: If you aren't confident that you can complete the next wave, you can claim your existing rewards and exit early.
translation: Bir sonraki dalgayi tamamlayabileceginden emin degilsen, mevcut ödüllerini alip erken cikabilirsin.

english: However, if you're confident you can beat the next wave, you can risk your whole reward pile to get even more!
translation: Ancak, bir sonraki dalgayi gecebileceginden eminsen, tüm ödülünü riske atarak daha fazlasini kazanabilirsin!

english: Be careful though. If you die or leave the arena before claiming your loot from me, you will lose all of the rewards you've earned.
translation: Ama dikkatli ol. Benden ganimetinizi almadan ölürsen veya arenadan ayrilirsan, kazandigin tüm ödülleri kaybedersin.

english: So I'm guessing the higher the wave, the better the rewards?
translation: Yani dalga ne kadar yüksekse, ödüller de o kadar iyi mi?

english: Oh, you're good. Exactly that!
Even better - if you manage to finish all of the waves and the final challenge, then you'll be awarded with Dizana's Quiver.
translation: Daha da iyisi, tüm dalgalari ve son mücadeleyi tamamlamayi basarirsan, Dizana'nin Ok Cantasi ile ödüllendirileceksin.

english: It's a handy piece of kit that you wear on your back to store extra bolts or arrows.
translation: Bu, ekstra ok veya yaylari saklamak icin sirtina taktigin kullanisli bir ekipman.

english: That does sound handy! Thanks for explaining all of that.
translation: Kulaga kullanisli geliyor! Her seyi acikladigin icin tesekkürler.

english: Anytime, Rookie. Anything else?
translation: Ne zaman istersen, caylak. Baska bir sey var mi?

english: What is Glory?
It's the measure of your progress inside the Colosseum.
Speak to Gloria over there if you want to know the details.
translation: Detaylari ögrenmek istiyorsaniz suradaki Gloria ile konusun.

english: Thanks.
What do you do around here?
I'm Minimus. It's not my real name of course, but it seems to have stuck. I started out competing here as a gladiator when I was a young'n. After that I became one of the lanistas.
translation: Ben Minimus. Tabii ki bu benim gercek adim degil, ama artik bu isim bana yapisti. Gencken burada gladyatör olarak yarismaya basladim. Sonra lanistalarin bir üyesi oldum.

english: Lanistas?
The ones responsible for overseeing the selecting and training of the gladiators.
translation: Gladyatörlerin secilmesi ve egitilmesinden sorumlu olanlar.

english: Eventually, the kingdom gave me the role of Colosseum Master. I still make sure to fit some fighting in, but now I have the honorof managing the fights themselves.
translation: Sonunda krallik bana Kolezyum Ustasi rolünü verdi. Hala dövüsmeye devam ediyorum, ama artik dövüsleri yönetme onuruna sahibim.

english: So are you not training like the rest of the gladiators?
translation: Yani diger gladyatörler gibi antrenman yapmiyorsun?

english: I have no need! I'm already one of the greatest fighters to grace this arena.
translation: Gerek yok! Ben zaten bu arenayi sereflendiren en büyük dövüscülerden biriyim.

english: Are you at a disadvantage because of your height?
No! How dare you even suggest that! Those spindly human bodies are unfit to go toe to toe with a fine dwarf like myself!
translation: Hayir! Nasil böyle bir sey söyleyebilirsin! O siska insan vücutlari benim gibi mükemmel bir cüceyle boy ölcüsmeye uygun degil!

english: Now, did you need anything else?
Goodbye.
Farewell, Rookie.
Welcome, [rank].
A [rank] approaches!
Let me know when you want to begin.
translation: Ne zaman baslamak istersen haber ver.

english: I have a spare Dizana's quiver (uncharged).
translation: Yedek bir Dizana'nin ok kilifi (sarjsiz) var.

english: You want to offer it for some Sunfire splinters? I could also try to convince Smol Heredit to follow you.
translation: Bunu Günes Atesi kiymiklari karsiliginda vermek ister misin? Smol Heredit'i de seninle gelmesi icin ikna edebilirim.

english: But be aware, you will not get the quiver back.
translation: Ama unutma, ok kilifini geri alamayacaksin.

english: Very well, Grand Champion. Keep your trophy.
