It doesn't actually look like you have enough space to carry 4,000 Sunfire splinters. Come back when you have room.
translation: Aslinda 4.000 Günes Atesi kiymigi tasimak icin yeterli yerin yok gibi görünüyor. Yer acildiginda geri gel.

english: He doesn't want to go with you. Sorry.
He seems to like you. Smol heredit is yours.
translation: Senden hoslaniyor gibi görünüyor. Smol Heredit senin.

english: You want to offer it for some Sunfire splinters?
translation: Bunu Günes Atesi kiymiklari karsiliginda teklif etmek ister misin?

english: I'm afraid you can only offer spare uncharged versions of the quiver to me.
translation: Korkarim bana sadece yedek, sarjsiz ok kiliflarini teklif edebilirsin.

english: Can you tell me about modifiers?
translation: Modifiye ediciler hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: How do I get rewarded?
What is Glory?
What do you do around here?
Goodbye.
Can we talk about modifiers?
How can I get rewards?
Yes, Trade it for 4,000 Sunfire Splinters
translation: Evet, 4.000 Günes Atesi Parcacigi ile takas et.

english: No, keep Dizana's quiver.
Yes, exchange Dizana's quiver for 4,000 Sunfire splinters?
translation: Evet, Dizana'nin ok kilifini 4.000 Günes Atesi Parcacigi ile takas et.

english: Gamble for a Smol Heredit.
translation: Smol Heredit icin kumar oynayalim mi?

english: Yes, gamble for a Smol Heredit?
translation: Evet, Smol Heredit icin kumar oynayalim mi?

english: No, keep it.
Hi there. You must be new around here. So what do I call you? 'Newcomer' seems so impersonal, and if we're going to be working together, I'd rather call you by name.
translation: Merhaba. Buralara yeni gelmis olmalisin. Sana ne diye hitap edeyim? “Yeni gelen” cok kisisel olmayan bir isim gibi geliyor ve birlikte calisacaksak, sana isminle hitap etmeyi tercih ederim.

english: You can call me [player name].
Ok then, [player name]. My name is Dezzick and I'm a miner by trade. Let's teach you how to mine.
translation: Tamam o zaman, Maceraci. Benim adim Dezzick ve meslegim madenci. Sana madencilik yapmayi ögreteyim.

english: Mining is very simple, all you need is a pickaxe. The rocks around here contain tin and copper. Why don't you get started by mining some?
translation: Madencilik cok basit, tek ihtiyacin olan bir kazma. Buradaki kayalar kalay ve bakir iceriyor. Neden biraz madencilik yapmaya baslamiyorsun?

english: The rocks around here contain tin and copper. You should try mining some.
translation: Buradaki kayalar kalay ve bakir iceriyor. Biraz madencilik yapmayi denemelisin.

english: Now that you have some ore, you should smelt it into a bronze bar. You can use the furnace over there to do so.
translation: Artik biraz cevherin olduguna göre, onu eritip bronz cubuk haline getirmelisin. Bunu yapmak icin suradaki firini kullanabilirsin.

english: I have a bronze bar. What now?
translation: Bronz cubugum var. Simdi ne yapacagim?

english: Now that you've got a bar, you can smith it into a weapon. To smith something, you need a hammer and an anvil. There's some anvils just here that you can use. See if you can make a bronze dagger.
translation: Artik cubugun olduguna göre, onu döverek silah haline getirebilirsin. Bir seyi dövmek icin cekic ve örs gerekir. Burada kullanabilecegin birkac örs var. Bronz hancer yapmayi dene.

english: See if you can use the anvil here to make a bronze dagger.
translation: Buradaki örsü kullanarak bronz bir hancer yapabilir misin?

english: Would you like me to recap anything?
Tell me about mining again.
Certainly. To mine you need a pickaxe. Different pickaxes let you mine more efficiently.
translation: Tabii ki. Madencilik yapmak icin bir kazmaya ihtiyacin var. Farkli kazmalarla daha verimli madencilik yapabilirsin.

english: Earlier I gave you a bronze pickaxe, which is the most inefficient pickaxe available, but is perfect for a beginner.
translation: Daha önce sana bronz bir kazma verdim, bu mevcut en verimsiz kazma ama yeni baslayanlar icin mükemmel.

english: To mine, simply click on a rock that contains ore while you have a pickaxe with you, and you will keep mining the rock until you manage to get some ore, or until it is empty.
translation: Madencilik yapmak icin, elinde kazma varken cevher iceren bir kayaya tikla ve cevher elde edene kadar veya kaya bosalana kadar madencilige devam et.

english: The better the pickaxe you use, the faster you will get ore from the rock you're mining.
translation: Kullandigin kazma ne kadar iyi olursa, madenciligini yaptigin kayadan o kadar hizli cevher elde edersin.

english: You will be able to buy better pickaxes from the Dwarven Mine when you reach the mainland, but they can be expensive.
translation: Anakaraya ulastiginda Cüce Madeninden daha iyi kazmalar satin alabilirsin, ancak bunlar pahali olabilir.

english: Also, the better the pickaxe the higher the Mining level required to use it will be. Was there anything else you wanted to hear?
translation: Ayrica, kazma ne kadar iyi olursa, onu kullanmak icin gereken Madencilik seviyesi de o kadar yüksek olur. Baska sormak istedigin bir sey var mi?

english: Tell me about smelting again.
Smelting is very easy. Simply take the ores required to make a metal to a furnace, then use the ores on the furnace to smelt them into a bar of metal.
translation: Eritme islemi cok kolaydir. Metal yapmak icin gereken cevherleri firina götür, sonra firinda cevherleri kullanarak onlari metal cubuk haline erit.

english: Furnaces are expensive to build and maintain, so there are not that many scattered around the world. I suggest when you find one you remember its location for future use.
translation: Firinlarin yapimi ve bakimi pahalidir, bu nedenle dünyada cok fazla firin bulunmaz. Bir firin buldugunuzda, ileride kullanmak üzere yerini hatirlamanizi öneririm.

english: An alternative to using a furnace to smelt your ore is to use high-level magic to do it.
translation: Cevherinizi eritmek icin firin kullanmanin bir alternatifi, yüksek seviyeli büyü kullanmaktir.

english: As well as letting you smelt ore anywhere, it has a guaranteed success rate in smelting all ores.
translation: Bu yöntemle cevheri istediginiz yerde eritebilirsiniz ve tüm cevherleri eritmede basari orani garantilidir.

english: Some metals, such as iron, contain impurities and can be destroyed during the smelting process in a traditional furnace, but magical heat does not destroy them.
translation: Demir gibi bazi metaller saf olmayan maddeler icerir ve geleneksel bir firinda eritme islemi sirasinda yok olabilir, ancak büyülü isi bunlari yok etmez.

english: Anything else?
Tell me about Smithing again.
translation: Bana tekrar demircilik hakkinda bilgi verin.

english: When you have acquired enough bars of the metal you wish to work with, you are ready to begin smithing.
translation: Calismak istediginiz metalden yeterli miktarda külce elde ettiginizde, demircilik yapmaya hazirsiniz demektir.

english: Take the hammer I gave you, or buy a new one from a general store, and proceed to a nearby anvil.
translation: Size verdigim cekici alin veya bir magazadan yeni bir tane satin alin ve yakindaki bir örsün yanina gidin.

english: By using a metal bar on an anvil you will be presented with a screen showing the objects you are able to smith at your current level.
translation: Örs üzerinde metal cubugu kullanarak, mevcut seviyende demircilik yapabilecegin nesneleri gösteren bir ekran karsina cikacaktir.

english: It's a pretty straightforward skill as I'm sure you discovered while making me that lovely bronze dagger.
translation: Bana o güzel bronz hanceri yaparken kesfettigin gibi, bu oldukca basit bir beceridir.

english: The higher Smithing level you are, the better quality the metal you can work with. You start off on bronze and work your way up as your smithing skills increase.
translation: Demircilik seviyen ne kadar yüksekse, o kadar kaliteli metallerle calisabilirsin. Bronzla baslarsin ve demircilik becerilerin arttikca seviye atlarsin.

english: Anything else?
Nope, I'm ready to move on!
Okay then.
Tell me about Mining again.
Tell me about smelting again.
Tell me about Smithing again.
Nope, I'm ready to move on!
Can you teach me the basics of mining please?
translation: Bana madencilikle ilgili temel bilgileri ögretir misin lütfen?

english: As you're already here, have a pick so that you can mine the rocks around me.
translation: Madem buradasin, etrafimdaki kayalari kazabilmen icin sana bir kazma vereyim.

english: I'd give you a pick to mine the rocks around me, but you don't have room in your inventory.
translation: Cevremdeki kayalari kazman icin sana bir kazma verirdim, ama envanterinde yer yok.

english: As you already have a pick, you can mine the rocks around me.
translation: Zaten bir kazman oldugu icin cevremdeki kayalari kazabilirsin.

english: You can tell the ore you'll get from a rock by looking at it. The colour of the rock helps, too.
translation: Bir kayadan elde edecegin cevheri, kayaya bakarak anlayabilirsin. Kayalarin rengi de yardimci olur.

english: To mine, simply click on the rock to mine it, while you've got a pickaxe with you.
translation: Kazmak icin, yaninda bir kazma varken kayaya tiklaman yeterlidir.

english: When you have a full inventory, take it to the bank. There's a bank on the roof of the castle in Lumbridge.
translation: Envanterin doldugunda, bankaya götür. Lumbridge'deki kalenin catisinda bir banka var.

english: I already know about the basics of mining, got any tips?
translation: Madencilikle ilgili temel bilgileri zaten biliyorum, baska ipucu var mi?

english: You can get different rocks in different places throughout the land, explore and find them.
translation: Ülkenin farkli yerlerinde farkli kayalar bulabilirsin, kesfet ve onlari bul.

english: You could start by traveling to the Al Kharid mine. Follow the path north and pay the 10 coins toll to go through the gate. Head north after passing through the gate and you will find the mine.
translation: Al Kharid madenine gitmekle baslayabilirsin. Kuzeydeki yolu takip et ve kapidan gecmek icin 10 sikke gecis ücreti öde. Kapidan gectikten sonra kuzeye dogru ilerleyin, madeni bulacaksiniz.

english: Be careful though, the scorpions in the mine will attack you.
translation: Ancak dikkatli olun, madendeki akrepler size saldiracaktir.

english: I could show you where Al Kharid mine is on your map if you like?
translation: Isterseniz Al Kharid madeninin haritada nerede oldugunu gösterebilirim.

english: Yes please.
No thanks.
Any advice for an advanced miner?
translation: Ileri düzey madenciler icin tavsiyeniz var mi?

english: Investigate the mining guild, the entrance to this is in the east of Falador down some steps. It could be most useful to you!
translation: Madencilik loncasina bakin, girisi Falador'un dogusunda, birkac basamak asagida. Size cok faydali olabilir!

english: You might also like to check out the coal mine west of Seers' village. This will enable you to use the coal trucks.
translation: Seers köyünün batisindaki kömür madenini de kontrol etmek isteyebilirsiniz. Bu sayede kömür kamyonlarini kullanabilirsiniz.

english: Thank you, I'll remember that.
I could show you where either of the places are on your map if you like?
translation: Isterseniz haritada bu yerlerin yerini gösterebilirim.

english: Can you show me where the mining guild is?
Can you show me where the coal mine is?
I could show you where the mining guild is on your map if you like?
translation: Isterseniz haritada madencilik loncasi nerede oldugunu gösterebilirim.

english: Oh yes, if you haven't already, speak to Doric who can be found around the anvils north of Falador. I'm sure he can help you out.
translation: Evet, henüz yapmadiysaniz, Falador'un kuzeyindeki örslerin yaninda bulunan Doric ile konusun. Eminim size yardimci olacaktir.

english: You could investigate the Dig Site east of Varrock, I'm sure you'll find something rewarding there.
translation: Varrock'un dogusundaki Kazi Alani'ni arastirabilirsiniz, eminim orada degerli bir seyler bulacaksiniz.

english: Tell me about different rocks and picks.
translation: Bana farkli kayalar ve kazmalar hakkinda bilgi verin.

english: Ok then.. here goes....
You can make all sorts of things from clay, if you have the crafting skill. Rune Essence is used for magic to cast spells.
translation: Zanaat beceriniz varsa, kilden her türlü seyi yapabilirsiniz. Rune Essence, büyü yapmak icin kullanilir.

english: Goodbye.
I'm giving Zanik here a tour of Lumbridge.
I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun! Pleased to meet you!
translation: Ben Dorgeshuun'dan Zanik! Tanistigimiza memnun oldum!

english: Hello there, Zanik! You look like you know your iron from your silver!
translation: Merhaba Zanik! Demirden gümüsü ayirt edebilecek gibi görünüyorsun!

english: Of course I do! I've mined lots of iron and silver in the Dorgeshuun mines!
translation: Tabii ki ayirt edebilirim! Dorgeshuun madenlerinde cok fazla demir ve gümüs cikardim!

english: You don't look like you need any help, then. What about you, [player name]?
translation: O zaman yardima ihtiyacin yok gibi görünüyor. Peki ya sen, Maceraci?

english: Can you teach me the basics of mining please?
translation: Bana madencilikle ilgili temel bilgileri ögretir misin lütfen?

english: I already know about the basics of mining, got any tips?
translation: Madencilikle ilgili temel bilgileri zaten biliyorum, herhangi bir ipucun var mi?

english: Yes please.
No thanks.
Any advice for an advanced miner?
translation: Ileri düzey madenciler icin herhangi bir tavsiyen var mi?

english: Can you show me where the mining guild is?
translation: Bana madencilik loncasi nerede oldugunu gösterir misin?

english: Can you show me where the coal mine is?
translation: Bana kömür madeni nerede oldugunu gösterir misin?

english: Are there any mining related quests?
translation: Madencilikle ilgili herhangi bir görev var mi?

english: Tell me about different rocks and picks.
translation: Farkli kayalar ve kazma türleri hakkinda bilgi ver.

english: Rocks and Ores.
Clay and Rune Essence.
Teach me about mining.
Teach me about different rocks.
translation: Bana farkli kayalar hakkinda bilgi ver.

english: Copper and Tin.
Iron and Coal.
More...
Silver and Gold.
Mithril, Adamantite and Runite.
Back...
Pickaxes.
Bronze, Iron and Steel.
Goodbye.
Oh look, a human!
A human? Can we eat it?
translation: Bir insan mi? Onu yiyebilir miyiz?

english: No, you rock brain! Humans are our friends!
translation: Hayir, seni kaya beyinli! Insanlar bizim dostlarimizdir!

english: Hello, excuse me...
Not sure if I would call them our friends... Not enemies either, of course.
translation: Onlari dostlarimiz olarak adlandirabilir miyim emin degilim... Tabii ki düsmanlarimiz da degiller.

english: Not like the trolls. We hate trolls.
translation: Troller gibi degil. Trolleri nefret ederiz.

english: Excuse me, I just want to-
Nothing's worse than a troll.
Except discovering that your pickaxe's gone blunt just as you-
translation: Tipki senin de kazmanin körelmis oldugunu kesfetmen gibi...

english: Excuse me!!!
Why, hello, yes, what is it?
I er... well, who are you?
I'm Derni.
I'm Dernu.
And I'm Miodvetnir. These are my brothers. And who might you be?
translation: Ve ben Miodvetnir. Bunlar benim kardeslerim. Peki siz kimsiniz?

english: My name is Player.
Pleased to meet you, Player!
I say, we don't get to see a hummon down here very often!
It's a human, you metal head! You should pay more attention!
translation: O bir insan, seni metal kafali! Daha dikkatli olmalisin!

english: So, can I ask you dwarves a few questions?
Of course, we love answering questions!
translation: Tabii ki, sorulari cevaplamayi cok seviyoruz!

english: We're very good at answering questions!
Fire away!
Hello again, Player!
Are you lost down here?
Or were you just stopping by for a chat?
translation: Yoksa sadece sohbet etmek icin mi ugradin?

english: Just stopping by for a chat.
What's down this river?
Oh, you don't know?
[He/She] doesn't know?
[He/She] doesn't know!
Can't you just tell me?
It is our glorious city!
The grand city of the dwarves!
Sparkling jewel of the mountain!
Keldagrim, our home!
Can you take me there?
Oh no, we can't do that.
We're far too busy.
You have to keep busy, you see.
Always keep busy, is what our good father used to say.
translation: Her zaman mesgul ol, bizim iyi babamiz böyle derdi.

english: Besides, there's been some weird going ons in the city.
translation: Ayrica, sehirde bazi garip olaylar oluyor.

english: Don't tell [him/her] that! None of [his/her] business!
Only fair if [he/she] wants to go into the city.
translation: Eger sehre gitmek istiyorsa, bu adil olur.

english: Oh yes, they only just cleaned up the mess from the last little incident.
translation: Evet, son olaydan sonra ortaligi yeni temizlediler.

english: So watch out if you ever do manage to travel to the city! Weird things could happen!
translation: Eger sehre gitmeyi basarirsan, dikkatli ol! Garip seyler olabilir!

english: Any good spots to fish around here?
translation: Buralarda balik tutmak icin iyi yerler var mi?

english: Fish?
Fish?
What are fish?
No fish around here.
Say, you're the Fishing Champion, aren't you?
That must be why you were talking about fish then...
translation: O zaman baliklar hakkinda konusmanin sebebi bu olmali...

english: But this water here, you see, it comes dripping down from above.
Molten snow, you see.
Oh, they're these small wriggly things that live in the water.
translation: Oh, bunlar suda yasayan kücük, kivrimli seyler.

english: But they're not all small! Some can be large!
translation: Ama hepsi kücük degil! Bazilari büyük olabilir!

english: And they don't breathe air.
But [player name] could tell you all about it! After all, [he's/she's] the Fishing Champion!
translation: Ama Maceraci sana her seyi anlatabilir! Sonucta, o Balikcilik Sampiyonu!

english: Maybe later...
What are these mines used for?
What does it look like they're used for?
Isn't it obvious?
For mining of course!
These mines are actually the territory of one of the eight major companies of the mining Consortium.
translation: Bu madenler aslinda madencilik konsorsiyumunun sekiz büyük sirketinden birinin arazisi.

english: Mining companies? Where are they at then?
translation: Madencilik sirketleri mi? Peki nerede bulunuyorlar?

english: Oh, they all have their headquarters in the city.
First floor of the palace.
No need to give [him/her] directions.
translation: Ona yol tarifi vermenize gerek yok.

english: We haul all our goods to the city by ship, you see.
translation: Tüm mallarimizi gemi ile sehre tasiyoruz.

english: Since the mine carts don't come here.
But because the river goes right to the city, this is just as easy.
translation: Ama nehir dogrudan sehre gittigi icin bu da ayni derecede kolay.

english: Can you help me with this rock down in the mines?
translation: Madenlerdeki bu kayayi kaldirmama yardim eder misin?

english: It seems to be unbreakable. I need to know why.
translation: Kirilmaz gibi görünüyor. Nedenini bilmem gerekiyor.

english: Say, is that Dondakan's rock?
That big unbreakable rock?
That's what [he/she] said, isn't? Pay more attention!
translation: Öyle demisti, degil mi? Daha dikkatli ol!

english: Yes, yes, that's the one.
Oh, you're not going to get through there I'm afraid.
It's unbreakable, you see.
Dondakan's been there for...
How long would you say he's been there, Miotvednir?
Eighteen years, Derni, and not a year shorter!
translation: On sekiz yildir, Derni, bir yil bile eksik degil!

english: That's some dedication!
But look at what it got him.
Nothing, that's what.
Never mind.
What material would break that rock? You know, the impenetrable one?
translation: O kayayi hangi malzeme kirabilir? Bilirsin, gecilmez olani?

english: Well... have you tried a rune pickaxe?
An adamantite tool?
What about a bronze pickaxe?
A bronze pickaxe??
What good would that do?
Well, you never know...
Don't you think that's the first thing they tried?
translation: Sence ilk denedikleri sey bu degil miydi?

english: Hey, it was just a suggestion!
Do you know anyone named Rolad? Some kind of a dwarven scholar?
translation: Rolad adinda birini taniyor musun? Bir tür cüce bilgin mi?

english: Sorry, doesn't ring a bell.
Oh yes, I know Rolad!
Oh, stop winding up the human, Dernu!
Do you know where he is right now?
translation: Su anda nerede oldugunu biliyor musun?

english: No idea, why?
Dondakan wants to shoot me out of a cannon!
Oh dear!
How awful!
That's terrible!
He thinks I'm actually going to fly through it and land on the other side.
translation: Benim gercekten ucup diger tarafa inecegimi düsünüyor.

english: That sounds a bit daft.
How would that work?
I think you're going to hurt your head.
Old Dondakan might have finally lost it.
translation: Yasli Dondakan sonunda aklini kacirmis olabilir.

english: He was always obsessed with that rock.
And gold.
Right, and gold.
Any tips on how to defeat an evil demon?
translation: Kötü bir iblisi yenmek icin herhangi bir ipucu var mi?

english: An evil demon, you say?
I'd run away if I ever ran into an evil demon.
Don't be such a coward, Dernu!
Well, what would you do then?
I don't know, I've never encountered an evil demon.
translation: Bilmiyorum, hic kötü bir iblisle karsilasmadim.

english: I once met a good demon though.
translation: Ama bir keresinde iyi bir iblisle karsilasmistim.

english: Oh yes, what did he say?
He gave me a puzzle box and then went off again.
translation: Bana bir bulmaca kutusu verdi ve sonra tekrar gitti.

english: I think you must have had too much dwarven stout in you.
translation: Sanirim cok fazla cüce birasi icmis olmalisin.

english: Could be, could be, but there's no telling, is there?
translation: Olabilir, olabilir, ama kim bilir, degil mi?

english: I defeated the spirit of the rock!
That's amazing!
That's fantastic!
What rock was that again?
Pay attention for once, Dernu! It's Dondakan's rock!
translation: Bir kez olsun dikkatini ver, Dernu! Dondakan'in kayasi!

english: That's quite impressive, Player. How did you manage to do that?
translation: Bu oldukca etkileyici, Oyuncu. Bunu nasil basardin?

english: Well, you see, I just-
What kind of question is that to ask? With [his/her/their] great might of course!
translation: Bu ne bicim bir soru? Tabii ki Onlarin büyük gücüyle!

english: Or vast magical skills!
No, you're more a ranger, aren't you Player?
translation: Hayir, sen daha cok bir okcusun, degil mi Oyuncu?

english: Actually, I-
Anyway, this calls for a celebration.
Oh yes, we should go down into Keldagrim to celebrate.
Tonight, of course, not now. We're on duty now.
translation: Tabii ki bu gece, simdi degil. Su anda görev basindayiz.

english: Right... and I'm sure traffic here will pick up soon with that rock broken.
translation: Dogru... ve o kaya kirildigina göre buradaki trafik yakinda yogunlasacaktir.

english: I heard there's vast amount of gold inside!
translation: Icinde cok fazla altin oldugunu duydum!

english: The company is going to be rich!
Now don't you go and discuss company business in front of this human, Dernu.
translation: Simdi bu insanin önünde sirket islerini tartisma, Dernu.

english: Right. Let's get back to work.
Anything else you wanted, Player?
translation: Baska bir sey ister misin, Oyuncu?

english: I need some help with this statue... King Alvis' statue, to be precise.
translation: Bu heykel icin yardima ihtiyacim var... Kral Alvis'in heykeli, daha dogrusu.

english: Oh yes, what's the problem then?
It was knocked down, remember? Parts of it nearly landed on our heads?
translation: Yikilmisti, hatirladin mi? Parcalari neredeyse kafalarimizin üzerine düsecekti?

english: A terrible noise it made too!
This sculptor has got me looking for a lot of items, you see.
translation: Bu heykeltiras beni bir sürü esya aramaya zorladi, anlarsin ya.

english: Items eh?
We love items.
Can't get enough of them.
Well, can you he-
I got this puzzle box once, you know.
translation: Bir keresinde bir bulmaca kutusu almistim.

english: Oh, not that story again.
You have told that story before, Dernu.
translation: Bu hikayeyi daha önce anlatmistin, Dernu.

english: Well forget about it then. I'll shut up if you don't want to hear about it.
translation: O zaman unut gitsin. Duymak istemiyorsan susarim.

english: Well, the sculptor only needs to build the head now. But I need to get the Consortium to help me with that.
translation: Heykeltirasin artik sadece kafayi yapmasi gerekiyor. Ama bunun icin Konsorsiyum'un yardimina ihtiyacim var.

english: The Consortium, you say?
You're going to talk to the Consortium?
My, you're certainly moving up in the dwarven world, aren't you?
translation: Vay canina, cüce dünyasinda gercekten yükseliyorsun, degil mi?

english: What do you need us for then?
translation: O zaman bize neden ihtiyacin var?

english: We are but simple dwarves.
Especially you, Dernu.
Now now, Derni, there was no need for that.
translation: Haydi ama Derni, buna gerek yoktu.

english: I have rebuilt the statue for the [company name]!
What, really?
Of course, really! Player wouldn't have said it otherwise, would [he/she/they]?
translation: Tabii ki, gercekten! Oyuncu öyle olmasaydi söylemezdi, degil mi?

english: And didn't you see Blasidar working on the statue?
translation: Blasidar'in heykel üzerinde calistigini görmedin mi?

english: Oh yes, he was out there for quite a while.
That must have been a huge task.
Nothing's too difficult for old Blasidar.
translation: Yasli Blasidar icin hicbir sey zor degildir.

english: He truly is a master builder.
We can all take an example to his hard work and dedication.
translation: Hepimiz onun caliskanligi ve adanmisligindan örnek alabiliriz.

english: Speaking of, shouldn't we get back to work ourselves?
translation: Bu arada, biz de isimize dönsek iyi olmaz mi?

english: Quite right. Anything else you wanted, Player?
translation: Haklisin. Baska bir sey var mi, Oyuncu?

english: Do you know about this drunken dwarf...?
Drunken dwarf?
Yeah, we know a drunken dwarf!
In fact we know plenty!
There's this one really annoying dwarf though, he sometimes throws rocks at me for no reason.
translation: Ama cok sinir bozucu bir cüce var, bazen sebepsiz yere bana tas atiyor.

english: Yeah, tell me about it.
The one I mean is his relative, living in the northeast of Keldagrim. I wonder if you could help me with him.
translation: Benim bahsettigim, Keldagrim'in kuzeydogusunda yasayan akrabasi. Onunla ilgili bana yardim edebilir misin acaba?

english: Ah yes, him.
Such a sad case, poor fellow.
Who is he?
Don't you know anything?
Now now, there's no reason to get angry.
I suppose you're right. Well, he's a drunk dwarf that talks about kebabs a lot.
translation: Sanirim haklisin. Kebaplardan cok bahseden sarhos bir cüce.

english: Has some pretty odd tales to tell too.
And I understand he's the relative of that dwarf I mentioned earlier.
translation: Anladigim kadariyla, daha önce bahsettigim cücenin akrabasi.

english: I hope that helped, Player?
I have this unforgettable tale to tell you!
A tale!
We love tales!
We live for tales!
Like, there was this one time when I lost my spanner in the mines...
translation: Mesela, bir keresinde madenlerde Ingiliz anahtarimi kaybetmistim...

english: Player wants to tell a tale!
But my spanner... it's a very interesting tale you know.
translation: Ama Ingiliz anahtarim... Cok ilginc bir hikaye, biliyor musun?

english: I think we've heard it before.
It was pretty forgettable.
Excuse me, do you want to hear my tale or not?
translation: Affedersiniz, hikayemi dinlemek istiyor musunuz, istemiyor musunuz?

english: Happy to.
Would love to hear it.
As long as it's better than my spanner story.
translation: Tabii benim Ingiliz anahtari hikayemden daha iyiyse.

english: So, what's your tale like?
Ah, I errrr...
I seem to have forgotten.
Must have been pretty forgettable as well then.
translation: O zaman o da unutulabilir bir hikaye olmali.

english: I must be off now, thanks for the chat.
No problem!
Glad to be of service!
Come back any time!
What's down this river?
Any good spots to fish around here?
translation: Buralarda balik tutmak icin iyi yerler var mi?

english: What are these mines used for?
Can you help me with this rock?
translation: Bu kayayi kaldirmama yardim eder misin?

english: What material would break that rock?
Do you know anyone named Rolad?
Dondakan wants to shoot me out of a cannon!
Any tips on how to defeat an evil demon?
translation: Kötü bir iblisi yenmek icin herhangi bir ipucu var mi?

english: I defeated the spirit of the rock!
I need some help with this statue...
translation: Bu heykel icin yardima ihtiyacim var...

english: I have rebuilt the statue for the [company name]!
Do you know about this drunken dwarf...?
I have this unforgettable tale to tell you!
I must be off now, thanks for the chat.
Can I help you today?
Can I go for a ride?
Minecart rides are 20 coins.
Of course.
I'm fine, thanks.
As a loyal customer of the Lovakengj Minecart Network, you're entitled to this.
translation: Lovakengj Maden Arabasi Agi'nin sadik bir müsterisi olarak, buna hakkiniz var.

english: Now, can I help you today?
translation: Simdi, bugün size yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: You're already here, human.
Hello, human. Can I help you?
What is this place?
This is the principal station of the Lovakengj Minecart Network. Once it's running, our people will be able to travel rapidly all across the city.
translation: Burasi Lovakengj Maden Arabasi Agi'nin ana istasyonu. Calismaya basladiginda, halkimiz sehir genelinde hizli bir sekilde seyahat edebilecek.

english: Can I ride your minecart?
The network is for the citizens of Lovakengj only, though I'll let you use it if you help me first. Free up some inventory space if you're interested.
translation: Ag sadece Lovakengj vatandaslari icindir, ancak önce bana yardim edersen kullanmana izin veririm. Ilgileniyorsan, envanterinde yer ac.

english: The network is for the citizens of Lovakengj only, though I'll let you use it if you help me first.
translation: Ag sadece Lovakengj vatandaslari icin, ama önce bana yardim edersen kullanmana izin veririm.

english: Alright, what do you need me to do?
The workers at the other stations got incorrect versions of the control scrolls, so they can't operate the minecarts. Please take these updated scrolls to them.
translation: Diger istasyonlardaki isciler yanlis versiyonlu kontrol parsömenleri aldilar, bu yüzden maden arabalarini calistiramiyorlar. Lütfen bu güncellenmis parsömenleri onlara götür.

english: That's one scroll each for the Arceuus station, the Shayzien station, the Hosidius station, the Piscarilius station and the Quidamortem station.
translation: Arceuus istasyonu, Shayzien istasyonu, Hosidius istasyonu, Piscarilius istasyonu ve Quidamortem istasyonu icin birer parsömen var.

english: Where do I need to go?
The Arceuus station is just next to the Arceuus Library, in the north of the city.
translation: Arceuus istasyonu, sehrin kuzeyinde, Arceuus Kütüphanesi'nin hemen yaninda.

english: The Shayzien station is east of the Shayzien Encampment.
The Hosidius station is north of the Woodcutting Guild.
translation: Hosidius istasyonu, Agac Kesme Loncasi'nin kuzeyinde.

english: The Piscarilius station is south of the city, next to a small mine.
translation: Piscarilius istasyonu, sehrin güneyinde, kücük bir madenin yaninda.

english: The Quidamortem station is at the peak of the mountain, deep in the Kebos Lowlands.
translation: Quidamortem istasyonu, Kebos Ovalari'nin derinliklerinde, dagin zirvesinde.

english: Can I go for a ride now?
No, you haven't unlocked any of the other stations yet.
translation: Hayir, diger istasyonlarin kilidini henüz acmadin.

english: Do I have to pay every time I use the carts?
translation: Arabalari her kullandigimda ödeme yapmak zorunda miyim?

english: Hmmm... We normally charge 50 coins per ride. For 100,000 coins, you'll never have to pay again.
translation: Hmmm... Normalde her yolculuk icin 50 sikke aliyoruz. 100.000 sikke ödersen, bir daha asla ödeme yapmak zorunda kalmazsin.

english: 100,000 coins is a rip-off!
Take it or leave it, human! You may enjoy being about to ride our carts without having to carry coins every time.
translation: Kabul et ya da etme, insan! Her seferinde sikke tasimadan arabalarimizi kullanmanin keyfini cikarabilirsin.

english: I'd rather not, thanks.
Can I do anything else for you, human?
translation: Senin icin baska bir sey yapabilir miyim, insan?

english: I'll get on with it.
I'm not interested.
Some of my stations still require control scrolls.
translation: Bazi istasyonlarim hala kontrol parsömenlerine ihtiyac duyuyor.

english: Have you got any more scrolls?
Yes, but you don't have room in your inventory.
Here you go, human.
No thanks, I don't want it back.
Thanks for delivering those control scrolls, human. What can I do for you today?
translation: Kontrol parsömenlerini getirdigin icin tesekkürler, insan. Bugün senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: Can I go for a ride?
I'm fine, thanks.
What is this place?
Can I ride your minecart?
Alright, what do you need me to do?
Where do I need to go?
Can I go for a ride now?
Do I have to pay every time I use the carts?
translation: Arabalari her kullandigimda ödeme yapmak zorunda miyim?

english: 100,000 coins is a rip-off!
Okay, I'll pay.
I'd rather not, thanks.
I'll get on with it.
I'm not interested.
Have you got any more scrolls?
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu var. Merhaba, selam, selam...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her türlü sey! Kuleler görülmeye deger harika manzaralar sunuyor.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmenizi tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
You are excused. And you are welcome.
Excuse me...er...thanks.
We are the Order of the Dagon'hai.
Who are you?
Through my magic, I can see a short way into the future.
How do you seem to know what I'm going to say? ...Er...oh.
translation: Neden söyleyecegim seyi biliyormussunuz gibi görünüyor? ... Sey... oh.

english: These are the Tunnels of Chaos.
What is...uh...aha! I'm not going to ask that. So you got it wrong!
translation: Bu ne... sey... aha! Bunu sormayacagim. Yani yanildin!

english: Indeed. You are very clever.
So I won!
Yes.
So, what is this place?
I mean...Argh! How do you do that?
I can tell that your mind is not suited to the paradoxicalities of precognition.
translation: Zihninin önsezi paradokslarina uygun olmadigini söyleyebilirim.

english: My what does what now?
You get confused very easily.
I knew that.
Of course you did. Speak to one of my order here. They will be able to explain in a manner more suited to your understanding.
translation: Elbette biliyordun. Buradaki tarikatimdan biriyle konus. Senin anlayisina daha uygun bir sekilde aciklayabilirler.

english: You are welcome, [player name]. There is a bed around here if you wish.
translation: Hos geldin, Maceraci. Istersen burada bir yatak var.

english: Thanks. My name's [player name], by the w...uh...okay, I think I need to lie down.
translation: Tesekkürler. Benim adim Maceraci, bu arada... uh... tamam, sanirim uzanmam gerek.

english: Oooh, my dear, have you heard the news?
Ok, tell me about the news.
It's terrible, absolutely terrible! Those poor people!
Ok, yeah.
And who'd have ever thought such a sweet old gentleman would do such a thing?
translation: Ve kim böyle tatli bir yasli beyefendinin böyle bir sey yapacagini düsünürdü ki?

english: Are we talking about the bank robbery?
Oh yes, my dear. It was terrible! TERRIBLE!
But tell me - have you been around here before, or are you new to these parts?
translation: Ama söyle bana, daha önce buralarda bulundun mu, yoksa buraya yeni mi geldin?

english: I'm quite new.
Aah, perhaps you missed the excitement. It's that old man in this house here. Do you know him?
translation: Aah, belki de heyecani kacirdin. Bu evdeki yasli adam. Onu taniyor musun?

english: Well, I know of him.
When he first moved here, he didn't bring much. From the window you could see he just had some old furniture and a few dusty ornaments.
translation: Buraya ilk tasindiginda, pek bir sey getirmedi. Pencereden bakinca, sadece birkac eski mobilya ve tozlu süs esyasi oldugunu görebiliyordun.

english: Here, look at this picture:
Also he always seemed so poor. When I went round to collect donations for the Draynor Manor Restoration Fund, he couldn't spare them a penny!
translation: Ayrica her zaman cok fakir görünüyordu. Draynor Malikanesi Restorasyon Fonu icin bagis toplamaya gittigimde, bir kurus bile veremedi!

english: So he's redecorated?
translation: Yani evini yeniden dekore mi etti?

english: Well, just you look in there now!
You see? It's full of jewellery and decorations! And all those expensive things appeared just after the bank got robbed.
translation: Gördün mü? Mücevherler ve süs esyalariyla dolu! Ve tüm bu pahali esyalar banka soyulduktan hemen sonra ortaya cikti.

english: He changed his hat too - he used to wear a scruffy old black thing, but suddenly he was wearing that party hat!
translation: Sapkasini da degistirmis - eskiden eski püskü siyah bir sapka takardi, ama birdenbire o parti sapkasini takmaya basladi!

english: So that's why you're telling people he was the bank robber?
translation: Bu yüzden mi insanlara onun banka soyguncusu oldugunu söylüyorsun?

english: Oooh, my dear, I'm SURE of it! I went upstairs in his house once, while he was out walking, and do you know what I found?
translation: Oooh, canim, bundan EMINIM! Bir keresinde o yürüyüse cikmisken evinin üst katina ciktim ve ne buldum biliyor musun?

english: A sign saying 'Trespassers will be prosecuted'?
translation: “Izinsiz girenler yargilanacaktir” yazan bir tabela mi?

english: No, it was a telescope! It was pointing right at the bank! He was spying on the bankers, planning the big robbery!
translation: Hayir, bir teleskop! Tam da bankayi gösteriyordu! Bankacilari gözetliyordu, büyük soygunu planliyordu!

english: I bet if you go and look through it now, you'll find it's pointing somewhere different now he's finished with the bank.
translation: Eminim simdi gidip bakarsan, banka isini bitirdigi icin artik baska bir yeri gösteriyor oldugunu göreceksin.

english: I'd like to go now.
Oh, really? Well, do keep an eye on him - I just KNOW he's planning something...
translation: Oh, gercekten mi? Peki, ona göz kulak ol - bir seyler planladigini biliyorum...

english: I've been around here for ages.
Ah, so you'd have seen the changes here. It's that old man in this house here. Do you know him?
translation: Ah, o zaman buradaki degisiklikleri görmüssündür. Bu evdeki yasli adam. Onu taniyor musun?

english: I've had enough of talking to you.
Maybe another time, my dear.
Who are you?

I, my dear, am a concerned citizen of Draynor Village. Ever since the Council allowed those farmers to set up their stalls here, we've had a constant flow of thieves and murderers through our fair village, and I decided
translation: Ben, canim, Draynor Köyü'nün endiseli bir vatandasiyim. Konsey, ciftcilerin buraya tezgahlarini kurmasina izin verdiginden beri, güzel köyümüzü hirsizlar ve katiller istila etti ve ben de

english: that someone HAD to stand up and keep an eye on the situation.
translation: birinin ayaga kalkip durumu gözlemesi gerektigine karar verdim.

english: I also do voluntary work for the Draynor Manor Restoration Fund. We're campaigning to have Draynor Manor turned into a museum before the wet- rot destroys it completely.
translation: Ayrica Draynor Malikanesi Restorasyon Fonu icin gönüllü olarak calisiyorum. Draynor Malikanesi'nin cürümeden tamamen yok olmadan önce müzeye dönüstürülmesi icin kampanya yürütüyoruz.

english: Right...
I'm not talking to you, you horrible woman.
Oooh.
Oooh! I have new information to share with you.
translation: Oooh! Seninle paylasacagim yeni bilgilerim var.

english: Ok, tell me about the news.
I'm quite new.
I've been around here for ages.
I've had enough of talking to you.
Who are you?
I'm not talking to you, you horrible woman.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu var. Merhaba, selam, merhaba...

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: Bu yine de tek bir selam sayilir!

english: Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her türlü sey! Kuleler görülmeye deger harika bir manzara.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmeni tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
MMMGHGHGGMH!!!
What's going on ARRGH!
Arrgh! Human! Scary! Go away!
Do you seek guidance, traveller?
Sure, gimme your best advice.
*sigh*
You flesh-temples always assume you can receive guidance merely by asking someone for it. But in this land there is a power that can teach us far more than any mere teacher could.
translation: Siz etten tapinaklar, sadece birinden yardim isteyerek rehberlik alabileceginizi düsünürsünüz. Ama bu topraklarda, herhangi bir ögretmenden cok daha fazlasini bize ögretebilecek bir güc var.

english: I speak of the Dark Altar. For generations our wisest scholars have studied it, yet still it has capacities beyond our comprehension.
translation: Karanlik Sunaktan bahsediyorum. Nesiller boyunca en bilge akademisyenlerimiz onu inceledi, ama yine de bizim anlayabilecegimizin ötesinde yetenekleri var.

english: The Dark Altar can distort the dimensions, warping the fabric of reality as you perceive it, and even bridging the gap between life and death.
translation: Karanlik Sunak boyutlari bozabilir, algiladiginiz gercekligin dokusunu carpitabilir ve hatta yasam ile ölüm arasindaki ucurumu kapatabilir.

english: But you are still a flesh-temple; you require a corporeal body to house your soul, and you perform disgusting bodily functions to maintain it.
translation: Ama siz hala bir beden tapinagisiniz; ruhunuzu barindirmak icin bedensel bir bedene ihtiyaciniz var ve onu korumak icin igrenc bedensel islevler gerceklestiriyorsunuz.

english: We of Arceuus have learnt, through the power of the Dark Altar, to move beyond the need for such a flesh- temple to house our souls.
translation: Biz Arceuus'lular, Karanlik Sunak'in gücü sayesinde, ruhlarimizi barindirmak icin böyle bir beden tapinagina ihtiyac duymadan yasayabilmeyi ögrendik.

english: In the crypt below us, we freed our souls from the flesh-temples that had imprisoned them, and we took the form you see now.
translation: Altimizdaki mezar odasinda, ruhlarimizi onlari hapseden etten tapinaklardan kurtardik ve su anda gördügün sekli aldik.

english: Perhaps, if you allow the Dark Altar to work on your mind, one day you too will be able to ascend to our higher form.
translation: Belki Karanlik Sunak'in zihninde calismasina izin verirsen, bir gün sen de bizim yüksek formumuza yükselebilirsin.

english: Thank you for explaining that.
I fear you are far from comprehending it. Now, is there anything I can do for you?
translation: Korkarim bunu anlamaktan cok uzaksin. Simdi, senin icin yapabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: No thanks, I like having a body. It's fun.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, bedenim olmasini seviyorum. Eglenceli.

english: How disgusting - a flesh-temple that worships itself. Now, do you want anything?
translation: Ne igrenc - kendini tapan bir beden tapinagi. Simdi, bir sey ister misin?

english: What god do you worship?
You sound like the Saradominist peasants from Hosidius, always assuming they must serve one god above all others.
translation: Hosidius'taki Saradominist köylüler gibi konusuyorsun, her zaman digerlerinden üstün bir tanriya hizmet etmeleri gerektigini varsayiyorlar.

english: While the gods are useful for tedious matters such as granting prayers during combat, we of Arceuus have long moved beyond the need to pay them homage.
translation: Tanrilar, savas sirasinda dualari kabul etmek gibi sikici konularda yararli olsa da, biz Arceuus'lular uzun zamandir onlara saygi gösterme ihtiyacini astik.

english: This is a place of meditation, where a novice may contemplate the mysteries of the Dark Altar - without venturing too close to its power.
translation: Burasi, acemilerin Karanlik Sunak'in gizemlerini, onun gücüne cok yaklasmadan düsünebilecekleri bir meditasyon yeri.

english: Saradomin is popular with many uneducated citizens of Kourend, but you may use our church to worship any god you prefer. That would be an ecumenical matter.
translation: Saradomin, Kourend'in egitimsiz vatandaslari arasinda popülerdir, ama sen kilisemizi istedigin tanriya tapinmak icin kullanabilirsin. Bu ekümenik bir mesele olur.

english: Now, do you require anything of me?
translation: Simdi, benden bir sey istiyor musun?

english: No, I'm fine.
Sure, gimme your best advice.
translation: Tabii, en iyi tavsiyeni ver bana.

english: Thank you for explaining that.
No thanks, I like having a body. It's fun.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, bedenim olmasi hosuma gidiyor. Eglenceli.

english: What god do you worship?
No, I'm fine.
Erm, what are you?
Who are you.
I'm [player name]. Nice to meet you.
You misunderstand. Your question should've been 'who are you?', not 'what are you?'. The latter is significantly more offensive.
translation: Yanlis anladin. Sorun “kimsin sen?” olmaliydi, “nesin sen?” degil. Ikincisi cok daha kirici.

english: Oh... erm.... I didn't mean to offend.
I see. Well I am Mofina, a citizen of Arceuus.
Nice to meet you Mofina. Erm...
Yes?
Where exactly are you from, Mofina? I haven't heard of Arceuus and I haven't seen anyone else who is dressed like you around here.
translation: Tam olarak nerelisin Mofina? Arceuus'u hic duymadim ve buralarda senin gibi giyinen baska kimseyi görmedim.

english: You are learning. That question is significantly less offensive.
translation: Ögreniyorsun. Bu soru cok daha az kirici.

english: Arceuus is one of five cities in the Kingdom of Great Kourend, found on the continent to the west.
translation: Arceuus, Büyük Kourend Kralligi'nin bati kitasinda bulunan bes sehirden biridir.

english: Okay, and how can I get to Kourend?
I believe Veos, one of your portmasters in Port Sarim, can help assist in such matters.
translation: Port Sarim'deki liman müdürlerinden biri olan Veos bu konuda sana yardimci olabilir.

english: I never expected to see one of your kind outside of Kourend. I guess the Duke invited you to the party for the same reason he invited the others?
translation: Kourend disinda senin gibileri görecegimi hic beklemiyordum. Dük, digerlerini davet ettigi gibi seni de partiye davet etti sanirim?

english: We... never expected to see any of your kind from across the sea either, but yes, you would be correct. The Duke did ask for a representative from Kourend and I was selected to attend.
translation: Biz de... denizlerin ötesinden senin gibi birini görmeyi hic beklemiyorduk, ama evet, haklisin. Dük, Kourend'den bir temsilci istedi ve ben katilmak üzere secildim.

english: Sorry, that came across a little ruder than I intended. I just wasn't entirely sure what term to use for citizens of Arceuus.
translation: Üzgünüm, bu biraz kaba oldu. Arceuus vatandaslari icin hangi terimi kullanmam gerektigini tam olarak bilemedim.

english: Citizens of Arceuus would have been fine.
Now if you excuse me, this conversation is... tiring. Being away from the Dark Altar has taken a greater toll on me than I expected.
translation: Simdi izin verirseniz, bu konusma... yorucu oldu. Karanlik Sunak'tan uzak olmak, bekledigimden daha fazla yordu beni.

english: I hope you still enjoy the party!
Why, what brings you to my house, young [man/lady]?
translation: Neden, sizi benim evime getiren nedir, genc ?

english: Who are you?
Me? Well, let's see... I live here. So I suppose I'm your host, as long as you're in my house.
translation: Ben mi? Sey, bir bakalim... Ben burada yasiyorum. Yani, benim evimde oldugun sürece, ben senin ev sahibin sayilirim.

english: I used to work down at the beach, running the charcoal furnaces, but I've handed all that business to my son now. He's a good boy.
translation: Eskiden sahilde kömür firinlarini isletiyordum, ama artik tüm isi ogluma devrettim. O iyi bir cocuk.

english: Anyway, retiring isn't too bad. There's plenty of warmth from the lava pits, and my boy helps me carry my shopping from Munty's shop. I'll be alright.
translation: Her neyse, emekli olmak o kadar da kötü degil. Lav cukurlarindan bolca isi geliyor ve oglum Munty'nin dükkanindan alisverislerimi tasimama yardim ediyor. Ben iyiyim.

english: But you've never told me what you're doing in my house, young [man/lady]. Don't think I've forgotten!
translation: Ama bana evimde ne isin oldugunu hic söylemedin, genc . Unuttugumu sanma!

english: Have you got anything to trade?
translation: Takas edecek bir seyin var mi?

english: Oh, are you a door-to-door [salesman/saleswoman]? My boy said I shouldn't let people like you into the house, and to call the guards if you bothered me.
translation: Oh, sen kapi kapi dolasan satici misin? Oglum, senin gibi insanlari eve almamami ve beni rahatsiz ederseniz muhafizlari cagirmami söyledi.

english: That won't be necessary.
So why are you in my house anyway?
I'm just wandering around.
Be a dear and just wander off now.
Who are you?
Have you got anything to trade?
translation: Takas edecek bir seyin var mi?

english: I'm just wandering around.
Human scare all da fishies!
I smack you good!
Da boom-boom kill all da fishies!
Tasty human!
Smash stupid human!
I get you!
Human hit me on the head!
Silly fishy! You lookin' like likkle Mogre wid your likkle arms an' wid your likkle legs!
translation: Aptal balik! Kücük kollarin ve kücük bacaklarinla kücük Mogre'ye benziyorsun!

english: Swim along silly round head fishy!
translation: Yüzmeye devam et aptal yuvarlak kafali balik!

english: Dont let dem big skippies eat you!
translation: Büyük skippylerin seni yemesine izin verme!

english: Hey! Nung says no fishies...
I just spoke to Nung, he said it was ok.
translation: Az önce Nung ile konustum, sorun olmadigini söyledi.

english: Well...if Nung say it ok, den go ahead.
translation: Peki... Nung sorun olmadigini söylüyorsa, devam et.

english: The player enters the crab pen
Can I help you today?
Can I go for a ride?
Minecart rides are 20 coins.
Of course.
I'm fine, thanks.
As a loyal customer of the Lovakengj Minecart Network, you're entitled to this.
translation: Lovakengj Maden Arabasi Agi'nin sadik bir müsterisi olarak, buna hakkiniz var.

english: Now, can I help you today?
translation: Simdi, bugün size nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: You're already here, human.
Sorry, human, you can't use the Lovakengj Minecart Network. Speak to Miriam, at the main station by the southern Lovakengj bank, if you've got any questions.
translation: Üzgünüm, insan, Lovakengj Maden Arabasi Agi'ni kullanamazsin. Sorun varsa, güney Lovakengj kiyisindaki ana istasyonda Miriam ile konus.

english: Sorry, human, the Lovakengj Minecart Network is for citizens of Lovakengj only.
translation: Üzgünüm, insan, Lovakengj Maden Arabasi Agi sadece Lovakengj vatandaslari icindir.

english: I've got this control scroll for you.
Thanks, human. I guess it's okay for you to ride my carts after all. So, can I help you?
translation: Tesekkürler, insan. Sanirim benim arabalarimi kullanabilirsin. Peki, sana yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: Thanks again for bringing me that control scroll. Can I help you today?
translation: Kontrol parsömenini getirdigin icin tekrar tesekkürler. Bugün sana yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: No thanks, you've already given me one of those.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, zaten bir tane verdin.

english: Can I go for a ride?
I'm fine, thanks.
Wait! Do you know what you're doing here?
translation: Bekle! Burada ne yaptigini biliyor musun?

english: Yes, I know, I've been here before.
translation: Evet, biliyorum, daha önce buraya geldim.

english: Well good luck then!
Erm, no I don't actually.
Well, come on over and I'll fill you in on what happened.
Thanks for coming!
What's the problem then?
It's my evil twin sister! She's been galavanting around Gielinor committing crimes and now I'm getting the blame!
translation: Kötü ikiz kardesim! Gielinor'da dolasip suc isliyor ve simdi suc bana atiliyor!

english: Well what's all this got to do with me then?
translation: Peki bunun benimle ne ilgisi var?

english: I'm glad you asked!
Through that door is a room with a cage and a control panel that operates a giant mechanical claw.
translation: O kapinin ardinda bir kafes ve dev bir mekanik penceyi calistiran bir kontrol paneli var.

english: I lured my sister into the room so I could imprison her in the cage by using the claw. The problem is my sister managed to herd some innocent civilians in there with her.
translation: Kiz kardesimi odaya cekip penceyle kafese hapsetmek istedim. Sorun su ki, kiz kardesim masum sivilleri de oraya sürükledi.

english: So what do you need me to do?
I need you to go next door and use the claw to catch my sister.
translation: Yan odaya gidip penceyi kullanarak kiz kardesimi yakalamani istiyorum.

english: Once she's in prison, she won't be causing me anymore bother!
translation: Hapse girdiginde artik bana sorun cikarmayacak!

english: Sounds easy enough to me.
Fabulous! Now take a good long look at me because the door will be locked behind you. My twin looks exactly like me, even her clothes!
translation: Harika! Simdi bana iyice bak cünkü kapi arkandan kilitlenecek. Ikizim bana tipatip benziyor, kiyafetleri bile!

english: One more thing to make your life difficult; the magic powering the claw is running low so you'll only have two attempts to catch her.
translation: Hayatini zorlastiracak bir sey daha var; penceyi calistiran sihirli güc azaliyor, bu yüzden onu yakalamak icin sadece iki denemen olacak.

english: I'll do my best then!
By the way, would you like me to run through the controls for you, or do you think you'll manage?
translation: Bu arada, kontrolleri sana anlatmami ister misin, yoksa basarabilecegini düsünüyor musun?

english: Yes please. I mean, it's always best to be prepared, right?
translation: Evet, lütfen. Yani, hazirlikli olmak her zaman en iyisidir, degil mi?

english: Ok, when you turn the machine on you'll see the glowing mark on the floor where the claw is currently aiming, and you'll see a lever and button on the right hand side of your screen.
translation: Tamam, makineyi actiginizda, pencenin su anda hedefledigi yerde zeminde parlayan bir isaret göreceksiniz ve ekraninizin sag tarafinda bir kol ve dügme göreceksiniz.

english: To move the claw's current location, click on the direction you want it to move in, as indicated on the right hand panel.
translation: Pencenin su anki konumunu degistirmek icin, sag panelde gösterildigi gibi hareket etmesini istediginiz yöne tiklayin.

english: You'll know which way the claw will go as the lever will point that way to show you.
translation: Kol o yöne isaret ederek pencenin hangi yöne gidecegini size gösterecektir.

english: When you see someone on top of the glowing mark, then hit the button on the right hand panel, as this will send the claw down to pick them up.
translation: Parlayan isaretin üzerinde birini gördügünüzde, sag paneldeki dügmeye basin, bu penceyi asagi indirip onu yakalamasini saglayacaktir.

english: Do be careful and make sure that there is someone on the mark, and not just walking past it.
translation: Dikkatli olun ve isaretin üzerinde birinin oldugundan emin olun, sadece yanindan gecip gitmediginden emin olun.

english: Oh, and make sure that the person is my sister, so you don't end up catching a random civilian.
translation: Oh, ve o kisinin benim kiz kardesim oldugundan emin olun, böylece rastgele bir sivili yakalamamis olursunuz.

english: Does that help?
Yes, that covers everything. Thanks!
Good luck!
No, thanks. I should be able to work it out.
I want to leave.
Fine. And there I was thinking you'd help.
translation: Peki. Ben de yardim edeceksin sanmistim.

english: The player is teleported back to their initial location
What do I have to do again?
One more time then.
Through that door is a room with cage and a control panel that operates a giant mechanical claw.
translation: O kapinin ardinda, kafes ve dev bir mekanik penceyi calistiran kontrol paneli bulunan bir oda var.

english: I lured my sister into the room so I can imprison her in the cage by using the claw. The problem is my sister managed to herd some innocent civilians in there with her.
translation: Kiz kardesimi odaya cekip penceyle kafese hapsetmek istedim. Sorun su ki, kiz kardesim masum sivilleri de oraya sürükledi.

english: Once she's in prison she wont be causing me anymore bother!
translation: Hapse girince artik bana sorun cikarmayacak!

english: You need to finish grabbing my twin before you come back through!
translation: Geri dönmeden önce ikizimi yakalaman gerekiyor!

english: Okay.
But I want to leave.
You need to use the control panel to use the claw!
translation: Penceyi kullanmak icin kontrol panelini kullanmalisin!

english: Well, you tried your best I suppose. Come next door and talk to me.
translation: Eh, elinden geleni yaptin sanirim. Yan odaya gel ve benimle konus.

english: Err, sorry. I seem to have messed it up a little.
Such incompetence! I should never have asked a baboon like you to do a complex task like this!
translation: Ne beceriksizlik! Senin gibi bir maymuna böyle karmasik bir görevi vermemeliydim!

english: Get out of my sight!
Well done! You managed to catch my sister!
Come next door and talk to me.
translation: Yan odaya gel ve benimle konus.

english: Well, I've managed to get her into the cage.
Fantastic! For so many years I've had to put up with her and now she's locked up for good.
translation: Harika! Yillardir ona katlanmak zorunda kaldim ve simdi sonsuza kadar kilit altinda.

english: Thank you for all your help. Take this as a reward.
translation: Yardimin icin tesekkürler. Bunu ödül olarak kabul et.

english: Player is teleported back to their initial location
Yes, I know.
Erm, no I don't actually.
I want to leave.
Yes please.
No thanks.
Okay.
But I want to leave.
Who's a good doggy!
Woof!
Thbbbbt!
Whine!
Woof woof!
You give the dog a nice piece of meat. It gobbles it up.
translation: Köpege güzel bir parca et veriyorsun. O da onu yutuyor.

english: Grrrr!
That's disgusting - you can't give it to the poor dog!
translation: Bu igrenc - zavalli köpege bunu veremezsin!

english: The dog doesn't seem interested in that.
Greetings traveller.
Can you heal me? I'm injured.
Ok.
Sorry, no.
Isn't this place built a bit out of the way?
translation: Burasi biraz uzak bir yere insa edilmemis mi?

english: We like it that way actually! We get disturbed less. We still get rather a large amount of travellers looking for sanctuary and healing here as it is!
translation: Aslinda biz böyle seviyoruz! Böylelikle daha az rahatsiz ediliyoruz. Yine de burada siginak ve sifa arayan oldukca fazla gezgin var!

english: How do I get further into the monastery?
You'll need to talk to Abbot Langley about that. He's usually to be found walking the halls of the monastery.
translation: Bunun icin Abbot Langley ile konusman gerek. Genellikle manastirin koridorlarinda dolasir.

english: Only members of our order can go up there. You'll need to talk to Abbot Langley if you want to explore the monastery further.
translation: Sadece tarikatimizin üyeleri oraya cikabilir. Manastiri daha fazla kesfetmek istiyorsan Abbot Langley ile konusman gerek.

english: What are you doing here?
We offer sanctuary to those seeking the guidance of Saradomin.
What if I want guidance from another god?
translation: Baska bir tanridan rehberlik istersem ne olur?

english: If Saradomin's not good enough for you, those otherworldly freaks from Arceuus are probably your kind of people.
translation: Saradomin sana yetmiyorsa, Arceuus'tan gelen o öteki dünyadan gelen ucubeler muhtemelen senin tarzin insanlardir.

english: They're always looking for hidden knowledge about souls and spirits, when any sensible person would just trust in Saradomin.
translation: Onlar her zaman ruhlar ve ruhlar hakkinda gizli bilgiler ararlar, oysa akli basinda herhangi bir insan Saradomin'e güvenir.

english: I see.
Thanks.
Peace brother
*yawn*
Can't wait for the party!
Party!
Woop!
Yeah!
Let's boogie!
Oh baby!
GO!
Get down!
Feel the rhythm!
Dance!
Oh my!
Watch me go!
You go!
*hic* What a party! Wow!
Can you heal me? I'm injured.
Isn't this place built a bit out of the way?
translation: Burasi biraz uzak bir yere insa edilmemis mi?

english: How do I get further into the monastery?
What are you doing here?
What if I want guidance from another god?
translation: Ya baska bir tanridan rehberlik istersem?

english: Thanks.
Pray for salvation!
Protect our home!
Save our monastery!
Say no to Oziach!
Spook, don't spend!
We're the only Monk robe spawn in the world!
translation: Dünyada tek kesis cüppesi üreten biziz!

english: Hello! What is going on here?
We're protesting of course!
Yes, I can see that. What are you protesting about?
Our home! It's under attack! We must save it!
Under attack?!
Under attack by Oziach! He's trying to buy it!
translation: Oziach'in saldirisi altinda! Onu satin almaya calisiyor!

english: Buy it? Buy the entire monastery?
translation: Satin almaya mi? Tüm manastiri mi?

english: Yes! He's trying to buy our home, we need to stop him!
translation: Evet! Evimizi satin almaya calisiyor, onu durdurmaliyiz!

english: Will you help us?
Of course I will help!
The player starts the 2021 Halloween event.
Thank you! Maybe we still have a chance!
translation: Tesekkürler! Belki hala bir sansimiz vardir!

english: You should talk to Brother Jered at the monastery. He's organising everything from there.
translation: Manastirdaki Jered Kardes ile konusmalisin. Her seyi oradan organize ediyor.

english: His office is on the ground floor, north-west corner.
I'll head over there right away!
I'd like to, but I'm a bit busy right now.
translation: Gitmek isterdim ama su anda biraz mesgulüm.

english: Oh, okay, well I need to get back to protesting.
translation: Tamam, peki, ben de protestoya geri dönmeliyim.

english: If you change your mind, we'll be here.
Hello! How are the protests going?
Slowly, but surely. We're holding on!
Have you spoken to Brother Jered yet?
Not yet, I'm heading there now.
Good! His office is on the ground floor of the monastery, north-west corner. Be quick, I don't know how long we have!
translation: Güzel! Ofisi manastirin zemin katinda, kuzeybati kösesinde. Acele et, ne kadar vaktimiz var bilmiyorum!

english: Hi there!
Hello! I saw your friend heading up towards the monastery. She was carrying some kitchen equipment!
translation: Merhaba! Arkadasinin manastira dogru gittigini gördüm. Mutfak esyalari tasiyordu!

english: Hello!
Hi! Thank you for agreeing to help us, we've been protesting for ages!
translation: Merhaba! Bize yardim etmeyi kabul ettigin icin tesekkürler, uzun zamandir protesto ediyoruz!

english: Of course I will help!
I'd like to, but I'm a bit busy right now.
translation: Isterdim ama su anda biraz mesgulüm.

english: Excuse me... Oh, wait, I thought you were someone else.
translation: Affedersiniz... Oh, bekleyin, sizi baskasiyla karistirdim.

english: No problem. Have a good day!
And yourself.
You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Devious Minds quest.
translation: Devious Minds görevini baslatmak icin gerekli tüm sartlari saglamiyorsun.

english: I knew you would save us! Bless you, my child!
translation: Bizi kurtaracagini biliyordum! Tanri seni korusun, evladim!

english: Thanks! Just stay indoors while those zombies are still prowling around.
translation: Tesekkürler! Zombiler etrafta dolasirken iceride kal.

english: May Saradomin's light shine upon you!
Tell him to save it for when I manage to defeat those zombies!
translation: O zombileri yenene kadar bunu saklasin!

english: Saradomin smile upon you! You've saved us all!
All in a day's work, brother.
Your name will forever be listed amongst the virtuous!
translation: Adin sonsuza kadar erdemli kisiler listesinde yer alacak!

english: I'll remember that the next time I go drinking...
translation: Bir dahaki sefere icmeye gittigimde bunu hatirlayacagim...

english: Why are all of you standing around here?
None of your business. Get lost.
Have you found the tree with the leprechaun yet?
No, we've looked for ages but haven't... Hey! Wait a minute! How did you know about that?
translation: Hayir, uzun zamandir ariyoruz ama bulamadik... Hey! Bir dakika! Bunu nereden biliyorsun?

english: Thanks for the information!
...You tricked me. I'm not talking to you anymore.
I already told you. I'm not talking to you anymore.
Do you seek passage to holy Entrana? If so, you must leave your weaponry and armour behind. This is Saradomin's will.
translation: Kutsal Entrana'ya gecmek mi istiyorsun? Öyleyse, silahlarini ve zirhini birakmalisin. Bu Saradomin'in istegi.

english: No, not right now.
Very well.
Yes, okay, I'm ready to go.
Very well. One moment please.
The monk quickly searches you.
[I'm sorry, sir,/I'm sorry, madam,/I'm sorry,] but no weapons or armour may be worn on Entrana. This rule even forbids items dedicated to Saradomin.
translation: Üzgünüm ama Entrana'da silah veya zirh giyilemez. Bu kural Saradomin'e adanmis esyalari bile yasaklar.

english: NO WEAPONS OR ARMOUR are permitted on holy Entrana AT ALL. We will not allow you to travel there in breach of mighty Saradomin's edict.
translation: Kutsal Entrana'da SILAH VEYA ZIRH giyilmesi KESINLIKLE yasaktir. Güclü Saradomin'in emrini ihlal ederek oraya seyahat etmenize izin vermeyecegiz.

english: Do not try and deceive us again. Come back when you have laid down your Zamorakian instruments of death.
translation: Bizi bir daha aldatmaya calismayin. Zamorak'in ölüm aletlerini biraktiktan sonra geri gelin.

english: What's in this strange impling jar then?
translation: Bu garip impling kavanozunun icinde ne var?

english: I don't know. It could be anything.
Well, I will assume that 'anything' includes weapons and armour. So come back when you've got rid of them.
translation: Peki, “her sey”in silah ve zirhlari da icerdigini varsayacagim. Onlari attiktan sonra geri gelin.

english: What's in this strange crate then?
translation: Bu garip sandigin icinde ne var peki?

english: All is satisfactory. You may board the boat now.
translation: Her sey yolunda. Artik gemiye binebilirsin.

english: The player takes the boat to Entrana
The ship arrives at Entrana.
Do you wish to leave holy Entrana?
Yes, I'm ready to go.
Okay, let's board...
The player takes the boat back to Port Sarim
translation: Oyuncu gemiyle Port Sarim'e geri döner.

english: The ship arrives at Port Sarim.
Not just yet.
Here you go.
You are handed a torn part of a clue scroll.
translation: Sana bir ipucu parcasinin yirtik bir kismi verilir.

english: No, not right now.
Yes, okay, I'm ready to go.
Yes, I'm ready to go.
Not just yet.
So, are any of you zombies gonna break me out?
translation: Peki, siz zombiler beni buradan cikaracak misiniz?

english: Ha! Mash those guards!
Oi, zombies! Care to let me out?
translation: Hey, zombiler! Beni disari cikarir misiniz?

english: Hey, zombies! I'm on your side!
Let me out! I'll help with your invasion!
Let me out! I'm a bad guy too!
translation: Cikarin beni! Ben de kötü biriyim!

english: Who's a cute little monkey?
Ukkuk oook! Eeek aka, ahh aka gonk.
translation: Ukkuk oook! Eeek aka, ahh aka gonk.

english: Who's an ugly human? Give me a banana!
translation: Kim bu cirkin insan? Bana muz ver!

english: What's up with you?
Stupid human! Give monkey a banana!
Sorry monkey, I don't have any bananas.
Aghhh. You're a rubbish human, get monkey a banana now.
translation: Aghhh. Sen berbat bir insansin, maymuna hemen muz ver.

english: Ha ha! Smelly human gave monkey a banana.
translation: Ha ha! Kokusmus insan maymuna muz verdi.

english: Wow you're one nasty piece of work. Have you ever heard of gratitude?
translation: Vay canina, sen gercekten igrenc birisin. Nankörlük diye bir sey duydun mu hic?

english: Hey baldy, give monkey another banana!
translation: Hey kel, maymuna bir muz daha ver!

english: Just because I'm not covered in fur doesn't make me bald, you cheeky monkey.
translation: Tüylerle kapli olmamam beni kel yapmaz, seni küstah maymun.

english: Monkey wants another banana now! Give me, give me!
translation: Maymun simdi bir muz daha istiyor! Ver, ver!

english: Look I've had it with you, you little degenerate.
translation: Bak, senden biktim, seni kücük dejenere.

english: I'll not give you a banana until you learn manners.
translation: Terbiye ögrenene kadar sana muz vermeyecegim.

english: Give the monkey a banana.
Don't give it a banana.
Eeekeek ookeek!
Arr! Yer messin with me monkey plunder!
translation: Arr! Benimle dalga geciyorsun maymun yagmacisi!

english: What?
Are ye here for...the stuff?
translation: Buraya... o sey icin mi geldin?

english: You know...the 'special' bananas?
No...why do you ask?
No reason. Have a nice day.
Arr!
Arr!
Bored now...
Let me go, can't ye hear them? Howlin' in the dark...
translation: Birak beni, duymuyor musun? Karanlikta uluyorlar...

english: What do you mean?
I'm not hangin' around te be killed!
The Horrors, the Horrors!
I'm not goin' back in that brewery, not fer all the Bitternuts I can carry!
translation: O bira fabrikasina geri dönmeyecegim, tüm Bitternuts'lari tasiyabilsem bile!

english: Oook! Oook!
The monkey deftly avoids your melee attack! You aren't going to score a hit in hand-to-hand combat.
translation: Maymun, yakin dövüs saldirini ustaca kaciriyor! Yakin dövüste ona vurus yapamazsin.

english: Ook! Oook! Ook!
Oook! Oook! Oook!
Oook! Ook!
Ook! Ook!
Ook! Ah Ah Ah!
Ook!
I won't say!
Ah Ah Ah! Ook! Ook!
Oook! Ook! Ook!
Ook! Oook! Oook!
Joooogre bones! Ook!
You can't catch me!
Ook! Ah Ah Ah! Ook!
Ah Ah Ah! Ah Ah Ah!
translation: Ah Ah Ah! Ah Ah Ah!

english: Ook! Ook! Ah Ah AH!
Oook! Ook! Oook!
Can't hit! Can't hit!
Ook! Oook!
Ah Ah Ah! Ook!
Ook! Ook! Oook!
After years of planning, the humans are going to get what they deserve.
translation: Yillarca süren planlamanin ardindan, insanlar hak ettiklerini alacaklar.

english: Hmm, I don't think this is quite right.
translation: Hmm, bunun pek dogru oldugunu sanmiyorum.

english: I wish Kruk would do his own dirty work.
translation: Keske Kruk kendi kirli islerini kendisi yapsaydi.

english: This looks like a good spot.
translation: Burasi iyi bir yer gibi görünüyor.

english: The time of monkeys is almost upon us.
You! Get out of my way!
Hello there little monkey.
Hello big-big. Aunty told me not to talk to strangers.
translation: Merhaba koca adam. Teyzem bana yabancilarla konusmamami söyledi.

english: Oh I'm not a stranger...
You look strange to me!
Hello again little monkey.
You're strange! Go away!
I'm not a stranger...!
Then what are you?
I'm a monkey's brother!
Ook! But I don't have any brothers!
I knew your sister's mother!
But I don't have any sisters! Ook Ook!
translation: Ama benim kiz kardesim yok ki! Ook Ook!

english: I'm just a monkey lover!
Aunty told me not to talk to monkey lovers! Ook!
translation: Teyzem maymun severlerle konusmamami söyledi! Ook!

english: Well I'll be a monkey's uncle!
translation: O zaman ben maymunun amcasi olurum!

english: Uh ah! You do look like my uncle!
You never said what you were!
I'm a monkey's brother!
I knew your sister's mother!
I'm just a monkey lover!
Well I'll be a monkey's uncle!
translation: O zaman ben maymunun amcasi olurum!

english: You look a lot bigger than last time, Uncle!
translation: Gecen seferkinden cok daha büyük görünüyorsun amca!

english: I've been ... eating more bananas... just like you should be!
translation: Ben... daha fazla muz yiyorum... tipki senin yapman gerektigi gibi!

english: I'm bored.
Why are you bored?
Aunty told me to pick loads of bananas. She said if, I got bananas, she'd give me a new toy!
translation: Teyzem bana bir sürü muz toplamami söyledi. Muz toplarsam bana yeni bir oyuncak verecegini söyledi!

english: What kind of toy did Aunty say she'd give you?
translation: Teyzen sana ne tür bir oyuncak verecegini söyledi?

english: She said it would be something from the magic shop!
translation: Sihirli dükkandan bir sey olacagini söyledi!

english: How many bananas did Aunty want?
How many bananas did Aunty want?
Twenty! But I can't count! It's very mean of her, isn't it Uncle?
translation: Yirmi! Ama ben sayamiyorum! Bu cok kötü, degil mi amca?

english: Yes, very mean ... do you want me to get the bananas for you?
translation: Evet, cok kötü... Muzlari senin icin getirmemi ister misin?

english: Ok! Ook Ook!
But only if you promise to let me borrow your toy...
translation: Ama sadece oyuncagini ödünc verecegine söz verirsen...

english: What kind of toy did Aunty say she'd give you?
translation: Teyzen sana ne tür bir oyuncak verecegini söyledi?

english: Did you get any bananas, Uncle?
No, not yet. I'm still trying to get them.
translation: Hayir, henüz almadim. Hala almaya calisiyorum.

english: Yes, I have some here.
That doesn't look like 20 bananas Uncle! Aunty will be so angry with me!
translation: Bu 20 muz gibi görünmüyor amca! Teyzem bana cok kizacak!

english: Don't worry, I'll get some more.
Wow that's a lot of bananas! Are there twenty?
translation: Vay canina, ne kadar cok muz var! Yirmi tane var mi?

english: Yes, of course there are.
Aunty will be so happy!
Has Aunty given you the toy yet?
Yeah - it's really neat!
Can I borrow it now then?
But I only just got it!
Please?
Ok then...
How are you today?
I'm good, uncle! I'd quite like my toy back now...
translation: Iyiyim amca! Simdi oyuncagimi geri istiyorum...

english: I've lost that toy you gave me...
You lost it!? What am I going to play with now?
I'm feeling a bit better now...
It's good to see you've cheered up then.
Yes - Aunty gave me a new toy!
translation: Evet, teyzem bana yeni bir oyuncak verdi!

english: That's really sweet of her!
Wow - can I borrow it?
Only if you promise to give it back...
Ok, I promise!
The monkey child gives you some kind of talisman.
translation: Maymun cocuk sana bir tür tilsim verir.

english: Actually, I don't really need it.
Hello there, uncle!
Thank you uncle - I love you!
The monkey child gives you a hug!
Thank you uncle, but I don't want one!
I don't want that - it looks really scary!
I have no use for that.
How are you today?
I've lost that toy you gave me...
That's really sweet of her!
Wow - can I borrow it?
Ok, I promise!
Actually, I don't really need it.
Hello?
Hi there, is something wrong?
Oh wow you can understand me!
I happen to be proficient in many languages... anyway, what are you doing here in Varrock?
translation: Bircok dili akici bir sekilde konusabiliyorum... Neyse, Varrock'ta ne isin var?

english: Well my uncle Daga's shop has been a bit slow recently, and we just got some new stock in so I decided to help and advertise a bit.
translation: Amcam Daga'nin dükkani son zamanlarda biraz durgun, yeni mal geldigi icin yardim etmeye ve biraz reklam yapmaya karar verdim.

english: What new stock's that then?
Oh just more scimitars, we got a few of there weird red ones too... dra-something...
translation: Sadece daha fazla kilic, birkac tane garip kirmizi olanlardan da var... dra-bilmem ne...

english: Dragon?!
Yeah that's the one, are they valuable?
Um... no... not really... I'll be right back...
translation: Sey... hayir... pek degil... Hemen dönerim...

english: Oh you bought one of those dra-whatever things, I was told they're not much good.
translation: O dra-bilmem ne seylerden bir tane mi aldin, bana pek iyi olmadiklari söylendi.

english: Oh no it's excellent!
Well I'll be a monkey's nephew, I'm such a noob!
translation: Vay canina, ben bir maymunun yegeni olacagim, ne kadar da acemiyim!

english: Don't you think this is all a bit cruel?
translation: Sence de bu biraz acimasiz degil mi?

english: What do you mean?
Keeping so many monkeys locked up in that crowded pen. I bet they dream of being back in the jungle...
translation: O kalabalik kafeste bu kadar cok maymunu tutmak. Eminim ormana geri dönmeyi hayal ediyorlardir...

english: Don't you ever dream?
I ... er ... used to dream to be a Monkey Minder when I was young boy...
translation: Ben... sey... kücükken maymun bakicisi olmayi hayal ederdim...

english: And look at you now ... all grown up having achieved your dreams! Would you deny me my dreams? Would you deny a monkey its dreams?
translation: Ve simdi haline bak... büyümüs, hayallerini gerceklestirmissin! Benim hayallerimi reddedebilir misin? Bir maymunun hayallerini reddedebilir misin?

english: Er, look, stop wasting my time.
I -
Leave me alone now. Some of us have work to do.
translation: Beni rahat birak. Bazilarimizin isi var.

english: I've just thought of a way to solve your little monkey problem...
translation: Senin kücük maymun problemini cözmenin bir yolunu buldum...

english: Oh, what's that then?
Well, you have too many monkeys, don't you?
translation: Sey, cok fazla maymunun var, degil mi?

english: Yes...
Well, you could give away your monkeys to people who would look after them. You could even start with me!
translation: Maymunlarini onlara bakacak insanlara verebilirsin. Hatta benimle baslayabilirsin!

english: I'm sorry, I don't think I'm allowed to do that. I've just been ordered to not let any monkeys escape.
translation: Üzgünüm, bunu yapmaya iznim yok. Maymunlarin kacmasina izin vermemem emredildi.

english: Hello there.
Hello, sir.
I haven't seen Monkey Minders here before...
translation: Burada daha önce Maymun Bakicilari görmemistim...

english: Yes, you wouldn't have. We have newly been posted here.
translation: Evet, görmemis olmalisiniz. Buraya yeni atandik.

english: But why do we need Monkey Minders?
translation: Ama neden Maymun Bakicilarina ihtiyacimiz var?

english: It's entirely necessary: just take a look at the monkeys. They've been multiplying out of control!
translation: Bu kesinlikle gerekli: maymunlara bir bakin. Kontrolsüz bir sekilde cogaliyorlar!

english: Every time we turn our backs another one of them tries to break free. It's almost as if they're plotting to escape!
translation: Ne zaman arkamizi dönsek, bir tanesi daha kacmaya calisiyor. Sanki kacmak icin komplo kuruyorlar!

english: Why have the monkeys been multiplying?
We just don't know. Perhaps it's the weather. Perhaps it's something in the food. Perhaps it's just that time of year.
translation: Bilmiyoruz. Belki hava kosullaridir. Belki yiyeceklerdedir. Belki de yilin bu zamanidir.

english: Your guess is as good as ours.
translation: Sizin tahmininiz de bizimki kadar iyi.

english: What are you going to do about the monkeys?
