We're going to post enough men here to be able to contain the monkeys in case they manage to escape.
translation: Kacmalari durumunda maymunlari kontrol altinda tutabilmek icin buraya yeterli sayida adam görevlendirecegiz.

english: Is that very likely?
Stranger things have happened in Ardougne.
translation: Ardougne'da daha garip seyler de oldu.

english: Why do you monkeys keep trying to escape? Good thing I've caught you before you got away, you little scoundrel.
translation: Siz maymunlar neden kacmaya calisiyorsunuz? Kacmadan önce yakaladigim iyi oldu, seni kücük haydut.

english: Ook!
Let's put you back in your cage where you belong...
translation: Seni ait oldugun kafese geri koyalim...

english: Ok!
What??
Err ... Ook?
I must be imagining things ... monkeys can't talk.
Player is relocated to the monkey cage
Ook Ook!
I don't know what kind of monkey you think you are, but you're not getting anywhere near my monkeys!
translation: Ne tür bir maymun oldugunu bilmiyorum ama maymunlarima yaklasamazsin!

english: Stop hassling me!
Be quiet, you monkey!
My word - what are you doing in there?
I ... er ... I don't know! One minute I was asleep, and the next minute I was here surrounded by monkeys!
translation: Ben... sey... bilmiyorum! Bir dakika önce uyuyordum, bir dakika sonra maymunlarla cevriliydim!

english: Well, don't worry. We'll have you out of there shortly.
translation: Merak etme. Seni hemen oradan cikaracagiz.

english: Player is relocated outside the monkey cage
Thank you.
No problem.
Why have the monkeys been multiplying?
What are you going to do about the monkeys?
Try to convince the minder to let the monkeys escape...
translation: Bakiciyi maymunlari kacirmaya ikna etmeye calis...

english: Ask the minder for a monkey...
I do not speak to outlanders.
Maybe you should speak with Rellekka's Chieftain.
translation: Belki de Rellekka'nin sefi ile konusmalisin.

english: Please please help us, bold adventurer!
translation: Lütfen, lütfen bize yardim et, cesur maceraci!

english: What's the problem?
Our little village has been dreadfully ravaged by an evil vampyre! He lives in the basement of the manor to the north, we need someone to get rid of him once and for all!
translation: Kücük köyümüz kötü bir vampir tarafindan korkunc bir sekilde tahrip edildi! Kuzeydeki malikanenin bodrumunda yasiyor, onu bir kez ve sonsuza kadar ortadan kaldiracak birine ihtiyacimiz var!

english: Okay, I'm up for an adventure.

I think first you should seek help. I have a friend who is a retired vampyre hunter, his name is Dr. Harlow. He may be able to give you some tips. He can normally be found in the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock, he's a bit
translation: Öncelikle yardim almalisin. Emekli bir vampir avcisi olan bir arkadasim var, adi Dr. Harlow. Sana bazi ipuclari verebilir. Genellikle Varrock'taki Blue Moon Inn'de bulunur, son zamanlarda biraz

english: of an old soak these days. Mention his old friend Morgan, I'm sure he wouldn't want me killed by a vampyre.
translation: icki düskünü oldu. Eski arkadasi Morgan'dan bahset, eminim bir vampir tarafindan öldürülmemi istemez.

english: I'll look him up then.
No, vampyres are scary!
I don't blame you.
I have slain the foul creature!
Thank you, thank you! You will always be a hero in our village!
translation: Tesekkürler, tesekkürler! Köyümüzde her zaman bir kahraman olacaksin!

english: Very well done, take this.
Yes.
No.
Afternoon. I'm Morgiana, and by all means, let yourself in...
translation: Iyi günler. Ben Morgiana, buyurun iceri girin...

english: Oh, hey! The door was open...
... Yes?
That armour looks mighty fancy!
Indeed! A family heirloom of mine, passed down from my father.
translation: Gercekten! Babamdan miras kalan bir aile yadigari.

english: Oh? Are you from a family of famous knights?
translation: Oh? Ünlü sövalyelerden olusan bir aileden mi geliyorsunuz?

english: You could say that...
What's wrong?
Oh, nothing... it's just... old memories. I'm getting old, as you can probably see. My family have all died to war. This is meant to be my retirement.
translation: Oh, hicbir sey... sadece... eski anilar. Gördügün gibi yaslaniyorum. Ailem savasta öldü. Bu benim emekliligim olacak.

english: Retirement? Then why still wear the armour? Especially with how hot it is here.
translation: Emeklilik mi? O zaman neden hala zirh giyiyorsun? Özellikle de burasi bu kadar sicakken.

english: I find it's best to be prepared in this region. Bandits regularly visit this fine oasis, and they ask fewer questions when they see me in armour.
translation: Bu bölgede hazirlikli olmak en iyisi. Haydutlar bu güzel vahayi sik sik ziyaret ediyorlar ve beni zirhli gördüklerinde daha az soru soruyorlar.

english: I see.
How's the tea here?
Hmm...
Umm...
Well... I think it's quite nice! I prefer a warm cup of Saradomin's Wisdom, a special recipe of mine.
translation: Sey... Bence oldukca güzel! Benim özel tarifim olan sicak bir fincan Saradomin'in Bilgeligi'ni tercih ederim.

english: Oh? How's it made?
Bit of a family secret. A fine blend of herbs that are quite magical.
translation: Aile sirri sayilir. Oldukca sihirli olan bitkilerin güzel bir karisimi.

english: Alright then. Keep your secrets.
I'd best be off.
Quite. Perhaps I'll see you around...
Ah, hello again.
That armour looks mighty fancy!
How's the tea here?
I'd best be off.
Hello Mori.
Hello there. Thank you for helping us, you are a good friend to the people of Arceuus.
translation: Merhaba. Bize yardim ettigin icin tesekkürler, Arceuus halkinin iyi bir dostusun.

english: It's not a problem. What brings you here?
translation: Sorun degil. Seni buraya ne getirdi?

english: I come here quite often now. This is a nice quiet place for me to think and reflect. It's my way of remembering Thana.
translation: Artik buraya sik sik geliyorum. Burasi düsünmek ve derinlemesine düsünmek icin güzel ve sakin bir yer. Thana'yi anmak icin benim yöntemim bu.

english: I'll leave you in peace then.
Thank you friend.
Hello there. Did you manage to get that device hidden?
Oh yes. Got it all done with no problems at all.
Good. Hopefully Kourend will have no more issues with the Disciples of Yama.
translation: Güzel. Umarim Kourend, Yama'nin Müritleri ile artik sorun yasamaz.

english: Oh I feel much better for that super serum,  I really hate it when I'm afflicted!
translation: O süper serum sayesinde kendimi cok daha iyi hissediyorum,  hasta oldugum zamanlardan gercekten nefret ediyorum!

english: The afflicted turns into a Mort'ton local
translation: Hasta olan kisi Mort'ton yerlisi haline gelir

english: Oh... thank you, you used the serum on me. Here have something for your trouble.
translation: Oh... tesekkürler, bana serumu kullandin. Zahmetin icin al sana bir sey.

english: The local gives you [reward].
Oh... thank you, you used the permanent serum on me. Here have something for your trouble.
translation: Oh... tesekkürler, bana kalici serumu kullandin. Zahmetin icin al sana bir sey.

english: Good day to you.
Hello. What are you up to?
Ah, today is a surströmming day! The herring I buried six months ago is ready to be dug up.
translation: Ah, bugün surströmming günü! Alti ay önce gömdügüm ringa baligi cikmaya hazir.

english: Eughr! What are you going to do with it?
Eat it, of course! It will be fermented just-right by now.
translation: Tabii ki yiyecegim! Simdiye kadar tam kivaminda fermente olmustur.

english: Fermented? You eat rotten fish?
translation: Fermente mi? Cürümüs balik mi yiyorsun?

english: Hmmm, tasty. I'm guessing you don't want to come round and try it?
translation: Hmmm, lezzetli. Sanirim gelip denemek istemiyorsun?

english: You guess correctly.
Are you the human by the name of [player name]?
Yes that's me.
Good... We've been expecting you. King Lathas sent word of your coming.
translation: Güzel... Seni bekliyorduk. Kral Lathas senin gelecegini haber verdi.

english: Well look who it is! The hero of Prifddinas!
Why do I feel like you're being sarcastic?
That's likely due to the fact that I am being sarcastic.
Well you're no hero either. You blindly served Lord Iorwerth right to the very end. You're lucky the other elves pardoned you.
translation: Sen de kahraman degilsin. Sonuna kadar körü körüne Lord Iorwerth'e hizmet ettin. Diger elfler seni affettigi icin sanslisin.

english: You seem upset by that. I served Lord Iorwerth because I didn't have a choice. The other elves realised that, hence the pardon.
translation: Bu seni üzmüse benziyor. Lord Iorwerth'e hizmet ettim cünkü baska secenegim yoktu. Diger elfler bunu anladilar, bu yüzden affettiler.

english: We always have a choice.
Do we?
I did.
Yes, but you're a mercenary. You're lucky enough to be able to side with the highest bidder. Not all of us are so privileged.
translation: Evet, ama sen bir parali askersin. En yüksek teklifi verene taraf olabilecek kadar sanslisin. Hepimiz bu kadar ayricalikli degiliz.

english: I was born into the Iorwerth clan, Lord Iorwerth was my uncle. Do you think I had a say in what my life would be? Do you think any of us did?
translation: Ben Iorwerth klaninda dogdum, Lord Iorwerth amcamdi. Sence hayatimin nasil olacagi konusunda söz hakkim var miydi? Sence herhangi birimizin var miydi?

english: We served Lord Iorwerth because he was our leader. We may not have agreed with all that he did, but that didn't matter. He was in charge and we were not.
translation: Lord Iorwerth'e hizmet ettik cünkü o bizim liderimizdi. Yaptigi her seye katilmamis olabiliriz, ama bu önemli degildi. O sorumluydu, biz degil.

english: Had I been born into the Cadarn clan, I'd be considered a hero right now. But I wasn't, so instead I am the villain.
translation: Cadarn klaninda dogmus olsaydim, su anda bir kahraman olarak kabul edilirdim. Ama öyle olmadi, bunun yerine bir kötü adam oldum.

english: You can make excuses, but Iestin served Lord Iorwerth and he switched sides.
translation: Mazeretler uydurmak serbest, ama Iestin Lord Iorwerth'e hizmet etti ve taraf degistirdi.

english: He did. Iestin was brave, I respect that. His bravery has rewarded him with leadership over our clan. But bravery comes easy when you have nothing left to lose.
translation: Öyle yapti. Iestin cesurdu, buna saygi duyuyorum. Cesaretinin karsiliginda klanimizin liderligi ile ödüllendirildi. Ama kaybedecek hicbir seyin kalmadiginda cesaret etmek kolaydir.

english: But I can see I will not change your mind. That's fine, I don't need to.
translation: Ama fikrini degistirmeyecegimi anliyorum. Sorun degil, gerek de yok.

english: That said, you'd do well to remember that the actions of Lord Iorwerth should not be used to judge our entire clan.
translation: Bununla birlikte, Lord Iorwerth'ün eylemlerinin tüm klanimizi yargilamak icin kullanilmamasi gerektigini unutmaman iyi olur.

english: Hmm.
Stand back citizen, do not approach me.
Hello.
What are you up to?
Nothing.
I don't trust you.
You don't have to.
If I find you attempting to cross the wall I'll make sure you never return.
translation: Duvari gecmeye calistigini görürsem, bir daha geri dönmemen icin gerekeni yaparim.

english: Hmmm, how did you get over here? You're not one of this rabble. Ah well, you'll have to stay. Can't risk you going back now.
translation: Hmmm, buraya nasil geldin? Sen bu ayaktakimindan degilsin. Neyse, kalmak zorundasin. Simdi geri dönmene izin veremem.

english: So what's a mourner?
We're working for King Lathas of East Ardougne. He has tasked us with containing the accursed plague sweeping West Ardougne.
translation: Dogu Ardougne Krali Lathas icin calisiyoruz. Bize, Bati Ardougne'yi kasip kavuran lanetli vebayi kontrol altina almayi görevlendirdi.

english: We also do our best to ease these people's suffering. We're nicknamed mourners because we spend a lot of time at plague victim funerals, no one else is allowed to risk attending.
translation: Ayrica bu insanlarin acilarini hafifletmek icin elimizden geleni yapiyoruz. Veba kurbanlarinin cenazelerinde cok zaman gecirdigimiz icin bize yas tutanlar lakabi takildi, baska hic kimse cenazelere katilma riskini göze alamiyor.

english: It's a demanding job, and we get little thanks from the people here.
translation: Bu zorlu bir is ve buradaki insanlar bize pek tesekkür etmiyor.

english: I haven't got the plague though...
Can't risk you being a carrier. That protective clothing you have isn't regulation issue. It won't meet safety standards.
translation: Tasiyici olma riskini göze alamam. Giydiklerin koruyucu giysiler yönetmeliklere uygun degil. Güvenlik standartlarini karsilamiyor.

english: I'm looking for a woman named Elena.
Ah yes, I've heard of her. A healer I believe. She must be mad coming over here voluntarily.
translation: Evet, onu duydum. Bir sifaci sanirim. Buraya gönüllü olarak gelmis olmasi delilik.

english: I hear rumours she has probably caught the plague now. Very tragic, a stupid waste of life.
translation: Muhtemelen vebaya yakalandigina dair söylentiler duydum. Cok trajik, aptalca bir hayat kaybi.

english: But I think a kidnap victim is in here.
translation: Ama sanirim burada bir kacirilma kurbani var.

english: Sounds unlikely, even kidnappers wouldn't go in there. Even if someone is in there, they're probably dead by now.
translation: Olasi görünmüyor, kaciranlar bile oraya girmez. Orada biri olsa bile, muhtemelen simdiye kadar ölmüstür.

english: Good Point.
I want to check anyway.
You don't have clearance to go in there.
How do I get clearance?
Well you'd need to apply to the head mourner, or I suppose Bravek the city warder.
translation: Bas yas tutana basvurman gerekir, ya da sanirim sehir bekcisi Bravek'e.

english: I wouldn't get your hopes up though.
I fear not a mere plague.
That's irrelevant. You don't have clearance to go in there.
translation: Bu konuyla alakasiz. Oraya girmek icin iznin yok.

english: Thanks for the warning.
I'd stand away from there. That black cross means that house has been touched by the plague.
translation: Oradan uzak dururdim. O siyah hac, o evin vebaya maruz kaldigi anlamina geliyor.

english: I have a warrant from Bravek to enter here.
translation: Bravek'ten buraya girmek icin izin belgem var.

english: This is highly irregular. Please wait...
translation: Bu cok olagan disi bir durum. Lütfen bekleyin...

english: You wait until the mourner's back is turned and sneak into the building.
translation: Yas tutan kisinin arkasini dönmesini bekleyin ve binaya gizlice girin.

english: Hey... I've got someone here with a warrant from Bravek, what should we do?
translation: Hey... Bravek'ten izin belgesi olan biri var, ne yapmaliyiz?

english: So what's a mourner?
I haven't got the plague though...
I'm looking for a woman named Elena.
But I think a kidnap victim is in here.
translation: Ama sanirim kacirilan bir kurban burada.

english: I want to check anyway.
I fear not a mere plague.
Thanks for the warning.
Hello there.
Do you have a problem traveller?
No, I just wondered why you're wearing that outfit... Is it fancy dress?
translation: Hayir, sadece neden o kiyafeti giydigini merak ettim... Kostüm mü?

english: No! It's for protection.
Protection from what?
The plague of course…
What do you want?
Who are you?
I'm a mourner. It's my job to help heal the plague victims of West Ardougne and to make sure the disease is contained.
translation: Ben bir yas tutanim. West Ardougne'daki veba kurbanlarini iyilestirmek ve hastaligin yayilmasini önlemek benim isim.

english: Very noble of you.
If you come down with any symptoms such as flu or nightmares let me know immediately.
translation: Grip veya kabus gibi herhangi bir semptom görürseniz hemen bana haber verin.

english: Nothing, just being polite.
Hmmm, ok then. Be on your way.
translation: Hmmm, tamam o zaman. Yolunuza devam edin.

english: Are you ok?
Yes, I'm fine thanks.
Have you experienced any plague symptoms?
What are the symptoms?
First you'll come down with heavy flu, this is usually followed by horrifying nightmares.
translation: Önce siddetli grip gecirirsin, bunu genellikle korkunc kabuslar izler.

english: I used to have nightmares when I was younger.
Not like these I assure you. Soon after a thick black liquid will seep from your nose and eyes.
translation: Bunlar gibi degil, emin ol. Kisa süre sonra burnundan ve gözlerinden kalin siyah bir sivi sizmaya baslar.

english: Yuck!
When it gets to that stage there's nothing we can do for you.
translation: O asamaya geldiginde sizin icin yapabilecegimiz hicbir sey kalmaz.

english: No, I feel fine.
Well if you take a turn for the worse let me know straight away.
translation: Durumunuz kötülesirse hemen bana haber verin.

english: Can you cure it then?
No... But you will have to be treated.
Treated?
We have to take measures to contain the disease. That's why you must let us know immediately if you take a turn for the worse.
translation: Hastaligi kontrol altina almak icin önlemler almamiz gerekiyor. Bu yüzden durumunuz kötülesirse hemen bize haber verin.

english: No, but can you tell me where the plague came from?
translation: Hayir, ama salginin nereden geldigini söyleyebilir misiniz?

english: It all started when King Tyras of West Ardougne came back from one of his visits to the lands west of here.
translation: Her sey, Bati Ardougne Krali Tyras'in buradan batiya yaptigi ziyaretlerden birinden döndügünde basladi.

english: Some of his men must have unknowingly caught it out there and brought it back with them
translation: Adamlarindan bazilari farkinda olmadan orada hastaliga yakalanmis ve geri getirmis olmalilar.

english: What are you up to with old man Edmond?
Nothing, we've just been chatting.
What about his daughter?
Oh, you know about that then?
We know about everything that goes on in Ardougne. We have to if we are to contain the plague.
translation: Ardougne'da olan biten her seyi biliyoruz. Vebayi kontrol altina almak icin bilmemiz gerekiyor.

english: Have you see his daughter recently?
I imagine she's caught the plague. Either way she won't be allowed out of West Ardougne, the risk is too great.
translation: Sanirim o da vebaya yakalanmis. Her halükarda West Ardougne'dan cikmasina izin verilmeyecek, risk cok büyük.

english: Been digging have we?
What do you mean?
Your hands are covered in mud.
Oh that...
Funny, you don't look like the gardening type.
Oh no, I love gardening! It's my favorite pastime.
translation: Oh hayir, bahceciligi severim! En sevdigim hobimdir.

english: Can I help you?
What are you doing?
I'm guarding the border to West Ardougne. No one except we mourners can pass through.
translation: West Ardougne sinirini koruyorum. Biz yas tutanlar disinda kimse gecemez.

english: Why?
The plague of course. We can't risk cross contamination.
translation: Tabii ki veba yüzünden. Capraz bulasma riskini göze alamayiz.

english: What brought the plague to Ardougne?
It's all down to King Tyras of West Ardougne. It started came back from one of his visits to the lands west of here.
translation: Hepsi Bati Ardougne Krali Tyras'in sucu. Buradan batiya yaptigi ziyaretlerden birinden döndükten sonra basladi.

english: Does he know how bad the situation is now?
translation: Durumun ne kadar kötü oldugunu biliyor mu?

english: If he did he wouldn't care. I believe he wants his people to suffer, he's an evil man.
translation: Bilsen bile umursamazdi. Halkinin aci cekmesini istiyor, o kötü bir adam.

english: Isn't that treason?
He's not my king.
What are the symptoms of the plague?
The first signs are typical flu symptoms. These tend to be followed by severe nightmares, horrifying hallucinations which drive many to madness.
translation: Ilk belirtiler tipik grip belirtileridir. Bunlari genellikle siddetli kabuslar ve bircok kisiyi deliye ceviren korkunc halüsinasyonlar izler.

english: Sounds nasty.
It gets worse. Next the victim's blood changes into a thick black tar-like liquid, at this point they're past help.
translation: Daha da kötüsü var. Sonra kurbanin kani kalin, siyah, katran benzeri bir siviya dönüsür ve bu noktada artik yardim edilemez.

english: Their skin is cold to the touch, the victim is now brain dead. Their body however lives on driven by the virus, roaming like a zombie, spreading itself further wherever possible.
translation: Ciltleri dokunuldugunda soguktur, kurban artik beyin ölümü gerceklesmistir. Ancak vücutlari virüsün etkisiyle yasamaya devam eder, zombi gibi dolasir ve mümkün olan her yere yayilir.

english: I think I've heard enough.
Okay then, see you around.
Maybe…
Who are you?
Nothing, just being polite.
What are the symptoms?
No, I feel fine.
No, but can you tell me where the plague came from?
translation: Hayir, ama vebanin nereden geldigini söyleyebilir misin?

english: What brought the plague to Ardougne?
What are the symptoms of the plague?
Okay then, see you around.
What's the device saying now?
I don't know. It's giving strange readings...
I'm not even sure it's working any more.
This is a wild goose chase! We trek halfway across the world and there's nothing down here but this bunch of useless goblins!
translation: Bu bosuna bir arayis! Dünyanin yarisini dolastik ve burada bu ise yaramaz goblinlerden baska bir sey yok!

english: I am sure my triangulation calculations indicated that the source of power was in this rough area...
translation: Ücgenleme hesaplamalarim, gücün kaynaginin bu bölgede oldugunu gösteriyordu...

english: I find it encouraging that it's pointed to somewhere where there actually are caves.
translation: Gercekten magaralarin oldugu bir yeri isaret etmesi umut verici.

english: This part of the world is riddled with caves! It's hard not to hit a cave around here! Are you sure you're not just picking up these goblin lanterns or something stupid?
translation: Bu bölgede magaralar cok fazla! Burada magaraya rastlamamak zor! Goblin fenerlerini falan algilamiyor musun?

english: You should have more faith in my skills as a mage! I've been working on this for years-
translation: Büyücü olarak yeteneklerime daha fazla güvenmelisin! Yillardir bunun üzerinde calisiyorum...

english: Gah! We have an eavesdropper! Buzz off, adventurer - go talk to the goblins or something.
translation: Gah! Dinleyen biri var! Defol git, maceraci - git goblinlerle falan konus.

english: Okay, I won't bother you.
That's what I like to see: a polite adventurer! Now, where was I...
translation: Iste görmek istedigim sey bu: kibar bir maceraci! Simdi, nerede kalmistim...

english: What are you looking for?
None of your business!
Hey, I'm one of you guys! See this pendant?
translation: Hey, ben de sizden biriyim! Bu kolyeyi görüyor musun?

english: Where did you come from? Who sent you? I'll have you know I'm the mage's bodyguard for this job. We don't need anyone else!
translation: Nereden geldin? Seni kim gönderdi? Bilmeni isterim ki ben bu is icin büyücünün korumasiyim. Baska kimseye ihtiyacimiz yok!

english: No one sent me, I'm just nosy.
Well stick your nose somewhere else!
translation: O zaman burnunu baska yere sok!

english: I'm sorry, but pendant or no pendant, this is a secret. I'm sure you understand.
translation: Üzgünüm, kolye olsun ya da olmasin, bu bir sir. Eminim anlarsin.

english: Lucien sent me.
He did not! If he had, I would be aware of it!
Don't try to lie to us! Now go away!
translation: Bize yalan söylemeye calisma! Simdi git buradan!

english: I'm sure you're a much better bodyguard than me, but perhaps I can help in some non-bodyguarding way?
translation: Eminim sen benden cok daha iyi bir korumalisin, ama belki koruma disinda baska bir sekilde yardimci olabilirim?

english: Well, we don't know how big this thing is. If we find it, I suppose we might need someone else to help us carry it.
translation: Bu seyin ne kadar büyük oldugunu bilmiyoruz. Bulursak, tasimak icin baska birinin yardimina ihtiyacimiz olabilir.

english: So, what are we looking for?
You're not very well briefed, are you?
To be honest I'm still a bit hazy on that point too.
translation: Dürüst olmak gerekirse, ben de bu konuda hala biraz kafam karisik.

english: *sigh*
Lucien has asked us to search for artefacts that give off a very specific type of energy. After many years of research, I think I'm finally drawing near.
translation: Lucien, cok özel bir enerji yayan eserleri aramamizi istedi. Yillarca süren arastirmalardan sonra, sonunda hedefe yaklasiyorum galiba.

english: You don't sound very sure.
Bah! My detection device is totally shot. I don't understand it.
translation: Bah! Algilama cihazim tamamen bozuldu. Anlamiyorum.

english: I wouldn't hang around for now, adventurer. It could be a long while before I can get a clear reading.
translation: Simdilik burada kalma, maceraci. Net bir okuma alabilmem uzun zaman alabilir.

english: Okay, I'll be on my way.
Okay, I won't bother you.
What are you looking for?
Hey, I'm one of you guys! See this pendant?
translation: Hey, ben de sizlerden biriyim! Bu kolyeyi görüyor musun?

english: No one sent me, I'm just nosy.
Lucien sent me.
(Charm) I'm sure you're a much better bodyguard than me...
translation: (Etkile) Eminim sen benden cok daha iyi bir korumalisin...

english: Euat ami! Euat chua tepat!
Uh huh...
Zema ami iknil! Zema lini euat tal miki!
translation: Zema ami iknil! Zema lini euat tal miki!

english: If you say so...
Zema ikam!
Zema ates! Euat achi!
I'm listening, honest.
Euat tepat antil! Euat tepat kuhu! Euat rani!
translation: Euat tepat antil! Euat tepat kuhu! Euat rani!

english: That's very interesting...
Tepat!
Euat!
Ami!
Ah, it's you [player name]. You've been slacking in your studies, so it's time for an exam.
translation: Ah, sensin Maceraci. Derslerinde tembellik ediyorsun, bu yüzden sinav zamani geldi.

english: There are two types of question. One type requires you to find the next object in a pattern.
translation: Iki tür soru var. Birinci türde, bir dizideki bir sonraki nesneyi bulman gerekiyor.

english: In the second type I will present you with fifteen cards and a hint. Discover three cards related to the hint, select them and confirm.
translation: Ikinci türde ise sana on bes kart ve bir ipucu sunacagim. Ipucu ile ilgili üc karti bul, onlari sec ve onayla.

english: Let's continue your exam. There are two types of question: In one question you must discover the logical object to come next in a pattern.
translation: Sinava devam edelim. Iki tür soru var: Bir soruda, bir dizideki bir sonraki mantikli nesneyi bulmalisin.

english: Pick the object that should come next in the pattern.
No. No, that's not right at all. Okay, next question.
translation: Hayir. Hayir, bu hic dogru degil. Tamam, sonraki soru.

english: Remember, the goal here is to find the pattern. Look for objects that would have a connection to each other.
translation: Unutmayin, buradaki amac deseni bulmaktir. Birbiriyle baglantili nesneleri arayin.

english: That's WRONG. Take your time and think about the next question.
translation: Bu YANLIS. Acele etmeyin ve bir sonraki soruyu düsünün.

english: No, no, no... That's WRONG! Okay, next question.
translation: Hayir, hayir, hayir... Bu YANLIS! Tamam, sonraki soru.

english: How unfortunate, you FAILED. You'd better hit the books and study up for next time.
translation: Ne yazik, BASARISIZ oldunuz. Bir dahaki sefere kitaplara gömülüp calissaniz iyi olur.

english: To exit, use any of the doors in this room.
translation: Cikmak icin bu odadaki kapilardan herhangi birini kullanin.

english: Wonderful! Keep up the good work. Next question.
translation: Harika! Böyle devam et. Sonraki soru.

english: Finally, a pupil using [his/her/their] brains rather than trying to eat them. Next question.
translation: Sonunda, beynini yemek yerine kullanan bir ögrenci. Sonraki soru.

english: That's correct! Next question.
WELL DONE! You've proven your aptitude for pattern recognition. You'll receive a book once you leave the classroom. It is a Book of Knowledge to further your education.
translation: Aferin! Desen tanima yetenegini kanitladin. Siniftan ciktiginda bir kitap alacaksin. Bu, egitiminizi ilerletmek icin bir Bilgi Kitabi.

english: WELL DONE! You've proven your aptitude for pattern recognition.
Hmm, you already appear to have a Book of Knowledge. You should read that! Still, I will reward you for your work once you leave the room.
translation: Hmm, görünüse göre zaten bir Bilgi Kitabi'na sahipsin. Onu okumalisin! Yine de, odadan ciktiginda calisman icin seni ödüllendirecegim.

english: Examine the hint on the right and find three objects that are related to it.
translation: Sagdaki ipucunu incele ve onunla ilgili üc nesne bul.

english: Welcome to the Emir's Arena! What can I do for you?
translation: Emir'in Arenasi'na hos geldin! Senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: What is this place?
This is the Emir's Arena, recently renovated with his coin. Here, you can fight for glory and prestige in individual duels and tournaments.
translation: Burasi Emir'in Arenasi, kisa süre önce onun parasiyla yenilenmistir. Burada, bireysel düellolar ve turnuvalarda san ve söhret icin savasabilirsiniz.

english: Where did this Arena come from?
The original building was excavated by the Varrock Museum a while ago. It dated back to the Second Age!
translation: Orijinal bina bir süre önce Varrock Müzesi tarafindan kazilmistir. Ikinci Cag'a kadar uzanmaktadir!

english: When the archaeologists moved out, a group of warriors, headed by myself, bought the land and converted it to a set of arenas for duels. The best fighters from around the world would come here to fight!
translation: Arkeologlar tasindiktan sonra, benim basini cektigim bir grup savasci bu araziyi satin aldi ve düellolar icin bir dizi arenaya dönüstürdü. Dünyanin en iyi dövüscüleri buraya dövüsmeye geliyordu!

english: More recently, the Emir of Al Kharid acquired the Arena and had it renovated to the state it's in now. He's kept me on to handle day-to-day running, though.
translation: Daha yakin zamanda, Al Kharid Emiri Arena'yi satin aldi ve su anki haline getirmek icin yeniletti. Ancak günlük isleri yürütmem icin beni görevde birakti.

english: What would the Emir want to do with a bunch of fight pits?
translation: Emir bir grup dövüs cukuruyla ne yapmak istiyor olabilir?

english: Something about a rowdy group of match-fixers, so I heard. I think the guards would know more about it than I would.
translation: Duyduguma göre, maclara hile karistiran bir grup haydutla ilgili bir sey. Sanirim muhafizlar bu konuda benden daha fazla bilgi sahibidir.

english: How do I get a fight?
You can participate in Duels and Tournaments. These may be ranked, if you want rewards and prestige, or unranked if you're just fighting your friends for fun.
translation: Düellolara ve turnuvalara katilabilirsiniz. Ödül ve prestij istiyorsaniz siralamali, sadece eglence icin arkadaslarinizla dövüsmek istiyorsaniz siralamasiz olabilir.

english: Ranked Duels and Tournaments take place on designated worlds, with stats and items provided to you on those worlds.
translation: Siralamali düellolar ve turnuvalar belirli dünyalarda gerceklesir ve bu dünyalarda size istatistikler ve esyalar saglanir.

english: Win or lose, you'll earn Reward Points for taking part in ranked Duels and Tournaments. You can trade your points here for supplies that might help in the Wilderness, or such places.
translation: Kazan ya da kaybet, siralamali Düellolara ve Turnuvalara katildigin icin Ödül Puanlari kazanirsin. Puanlarini burada, Wilderness'da veya benzeri yerlerde yardimci olabilecek malzemelerle takas edebilirsin.

english: Now, if you want to choose your opponents, you can have an unranked Duel or Tournament instead, just for the fun of beating them.
translation: Simdi, rakiplerini secmek istiyorsan, sadece onlari yenmenin keyfi icin siralamaya dahil olmayan bir Düello veya Turnuva yapabilirsin.

english: Use the recruitment boards outside the hospital to set up your own unranked tournament, or to apply to an existing one.
translation: Hastane disindaki ise alim panolarini kullanarak kendi siralamaya dahil olmayan turnuvani düzenleyebilir veya mevcut bir turnuvaya basvurabilirsin.

english: For an unranked Duel, look around the Arena for someone you wish to fight, and challenge them...
translation: Siralamaya dahil olmayan bir Düello icin, Arena'da dövüsmek istediginiz birini bulun ve ona meydan okuyun...

english: You'll see a 'Challenge' option when you right-click other people around the Arena. Use that to set up an unranked Duel.
translation: Arena'daki diger kisilere sag tikladiginizda “Meydan Oku” secenegi görünecektir. Bunu kullanarak siralamaya dahil olmayan bir Düello düzenleyin.

english: On PvP Arena worlds the Arena will supply stats and items for your fight. You'll get to choose your load-out from a menu.
translation: PvP Arena dünyalarinda Arena, dövüsünüz icin istatistikler ve ögeler saglayacaktir. Menüden ekipmaninizi secebilirsiniz.

english: On other worlds, like this one, you must bring your own items, and fight with your own stats.
translation: Bu dünya gibi diger dünyalarda ise kendi esyalarinizi getirmeniz ve kendi istatistiklerinizle savasmaniz gerekir.

english: I challenge you!
Ho! Ho! Ho!
What kind of fights are happening today?
Every week, we'll rotate the active build, meaning you'll have access to a different set of stats and items. This week, the active build is [Zerker/1 Def Pure/Max/Med].
Can I see your shop?
I'll be off.
See you in the Arena!
What is this place?
Where did this Arena come from?
How do I get a fight?
What kind of fights are happening today?
Can I see your shop?
I'll be off.
I challenge you!
Who's the cutest little nightmare-spawn in all of Gielinor?
translation: Gielinor'daki en sevimli kücük kabus yaratigi kim?

english: Is it you?!
Yes, it's you my little Muphin!
Stop this at once.
Can you teach me how to do that thing where you teleport around really quickly?
translation: Senin gibi cok hizli bir sekilde teleport olmayi bana ögretebilir misin?

english: That requires moving between realms... Your simple form would not withstand it.
translation: Bunun icin alemler arasinda gecis yapmak gerekir... Senin basit formun buna dayanamaz.

english: You'd be surprised.
You know... if you were bite-sized, I reckon you'd be quite nutritious.
translation: Biliyor musun... Eger isirik büyüklügünde olsaydin, oldukca besleyici olurdun.

english: Do NOT eat me, human.
Bleugh!
Hisssss!
Sssssssss!
What do you do here?
Well, I tend the hardwood grove nearby, you can enter if you like and harvest some of the very fine hardwood that grows within.
translation: Sey, yakindaki sert agac korusuna bakiyorum, istersen iceri girip icinde yetisen cok kaliteli sert agaclardan biraz toplayabilirsin.

english: Apart from that I'm a simple Tai Bwo Wannai villager...I like to try and find out what's going on in the mainland and the rest of the known world.
translation: Onun disinda ben basit bir Tai Bwo Wannai köylüsüyüm... Ana karada ve bilinen dünyanin geri kalaninda neler olup bittigini ögrenmeyi seviyorum.

english: Is there anything interesting to do around here?
translation: Buralarda ilginc bir sey var mi?

english: Apart from cutting back the jungle and repairing the fence, I think we've got most things covered now Bwana.
translation: Ormani kesmek ve citi onarmak disinda, sanirim su anda her seyi hallettik Bwana.

english: Do I get anything for doing this?
translation: Bunu yaptigim icin bir sey kazanacak miyim?

english: Yes Bwana, you gain experience in woodcutting. In addition many members of the community will reward you with trading sticks, our local currency, for your efforts.
translation: Evet Bwana, odun kesme konusunda deneyim kazanacaksin. Ayrica, toplulugun bircok üyesi cabalarin karsiliginda sana yerel para birimimiz olan ticaret cubuklari ile ödüllendirecek.

english: Trading sticks?
Correct Bwana, trading sticks! It's our form of local currency! Everything you do to help out in the village will give you some favour, but there's a maximum limit!
translation: Dogru Bwana, ticaret cubuklari! Bu bizim yerel para birimimiz! Köyde yardim etmek icin yaptiginiz her sey size biraz iyilik kazandirir, ancak bir üst sinir vardir!

english: When you've reached one hundred percent, you cannot gain any more favour, you need to cash in your favour for trading sticks before you can increase your favour again.
translation: Yüzde yüze ulastiginizda, daha fazla iyilik kazanamazsiniz, iyiliginizi ticaret cubuklarina cevirmeniz gerekir, ancak o zaman iyiliginizi tekrar artirabilirsiniz.

english: Who do I get trading sticks from?
Well Bwana, there's a good ten villagers I know of who would show their appreciation for your effort. Who do you want to ask about?
translation: Bwana, cabalariniz icin size minnettarligini gösterecek en az on köylü taniyorum. Kime sormak istersiniz?

english: Sharimika is married to Mamma Bufetta, Bwana. They live in the houses just in front of the tribal statue.
translation: Sharimika, Mamma Bufetta ile evli, Bwana. Kabile heykelinin hemen önündeki evlerde yasiyorlar.

english: Mamma Bufetta lives with her family in the building that faces the stone statue, she lives there with her husband Sharimika and her daughter Layleen.
translation: Mamma Bufetta, ailesiyle birlikte tas heykelin karsisindaki binada yasiyor, orada kocasi Sharimika ve kizi Layleen ile birlikte yasiyor.

english: Layleen is a young girl, the daughter of Mamma Bufetta and Sharimika, she lives with her parents.
translation: Layleen, Mamma Bufetta ve Sharimika'nin kizi olan genc bir kiz, ailesiyle birlikte yasiyor.

english: Karaday is a young man and his chosen profession is fishing, he follows after his father Safta Doc in that respect. You can find him usually around the center of the village, that is when he's not off fishing.
translation: Karaday genc bir adam ve sectigi meslek balikcilik, bu konuda babasi Safta Doc'un izinden gidiyor. Genellikle köyün merkezinde bulabilirsiniz, tabii balik tutmaya cikmadigi zamanlarda.

english: Safta Doc used to be a fisherman, but he's just about retired now. He has an interesting profession which you might like to talk to him about. You'll find him usually near the building with the anvil in it.
translation: Safta Doc eskiden balikciydi, ama simdi emekli olmak üzere. Ilginc bir meslegi var, onunla bu konuda konusmak isteyebilirsiniz. Genellikle örsün bulundugu binanin yakininda bulabilirsiniz.

english: It's just slightly north of the village statue.
translation: Bu bina, köy heykelinin biraz kuzeyinde yer almaktadir.

english: Gabooty is a bit of a mystery, no one's sure where he came from! He's quite helpful though, you can find him in the middle of the village enclosure, to the south of Sharimika's house.
translation: Gabooty biraz gizemli biridir, kimse onun nereden geldigini bilmiyor! Ancak oldukca yardimseverdir, onu Sharimika'nin evinin güneyinde, köyün ortasinda bulabilirsiniz.

english: Fanellaman was a fisherman, he's retired now, but he'll try and regale you with tales of his salty sea dog days. He's often walking up and down the western beach.
translation: Fanellaman eskiden balikciydi, simdi emekli oldu, ancak size denizci günlerinden hikayeler anlatarak sizi eglendirmeye calisacaktir. Genellikle bati sahilinde dolasir.

english: Jagbakoba is a wild hunter. He can be a bit aggressive but he'll reward anyone who helps to keep the village in good order. You'll find him to the south of the enclosure, near the fires.
translation: Jagbakoba vahsi bir avcidir. Biraz agresif olabilir ama köyün düzenini korumaya yardimci olan herkesi ödüllendirir. Onu citin güneyinde, ateslerin yaninda bulabilirsiniz.

english: Ah Rionasta! He's an enterprising man! Had a very good idea and is now much in demand, you'll find him between the blacksmith's and Timfraku's hut.
translation: Ah Rionasta! O girisimci bir adamdir! Cok iyi bir fikri vardi ve simdi cok ragbet görüyor, onu demircinin ve Timfraku'nun kulübesi arasinda bulabilirsiniz.

english: Murcaily! That's me! Well, what do you want to know?! I look after the teak and mahogany trees and make sure that we get payment of anyone who uses the facility. And I'm usually standing just about here!
translation: Murcaily! O benim! Ne bilmek istiyorsunuz? Tik ve maun agaclarina bakiyorum ve tesisi kullanan herkesin ödemesini aldigindan emin oluyorum. Genelde burada duruyorum!

english: Hey, I've seen you working around the village. You've been doing a lot of good work around here for us. Let me give you something for your trouble.
translation: Hey, seni köyde calisirken gördüm. Burada bizim icin cok iyi isler yapiyorsun. Zahmetin icin sana bir sey vereyim.

english: Where can I get a machete from?

You can purchase a standard machete from Jiminua's store. Gabooty has a selection of local items which you may like to purchase, including better machetes. Also, you may like to chat to Safta Doc, he may have a deal
translation: Jiminua'nin dükkanindan standart bir pala satin alabilirsin. Gabooty'de daha iyi palalar da dahil olmak üzere satin almak isteyebilecegin cesitli yerel ürünler var. Ayrica Safta Doc ile konusmak isteyebilirsin, ilginc bir teklifte bulunabilir.

english: you'll find interesting.
Where is this jungle?
You'll find much of it to the southern end of Tai Bwo Wannai, outside of the village. Some is tougher than others so you may have difficulties cutting it back.
translation: Tai Bwo Wannai'nin güney ucunda, köyün disinda büyük bir kismini bulabilirsiniz. Bazilari digerlerinden daha sert oldugundan keserken zorlanabilirsiniz.

english: Beware though Bwana, those bushes can conceal a great many dangers or trophies, it could be the death... or the making of you!
translation: Dikkatli olun Bwana, bu calilar bircok tehlikeyi veya ganimeti gizleyebilir, bu sizin ölümünüz... veya basariniz olabilir!

english: What do you mean by that?
It means that you may find something you wish you hadn't but then discover something you never thought you could! If you find me too vague, go and have a chat with Sharimika about it!
translation: Yani, keske bulmasaydim diyecegin bir sey bulabilirsin, ama sonra hic düsünmedigin bir sey kesfedebilirsin! Eger beni cok belirsiz buluyorsan, gidip Sharimika ile konus!

english: Where is the fence that needs to be repaired?
This is to the South Bwana, you should see that there are sections which are rotten, but some other passers-by sometimes help out repairing it.
translation: Güneyde Bwana, cürümüs bölümler oldugunu göreceksin, ama bazen diger yoldan gecenler onarmaya yardim ediyor.

english: You'll need some thatching spars and a machete in order to repair the fence though Bwana.
translation: Citi onarmak icin sazlik cubuklari ve bir pala gerekir, Bwana.

english: Ok, thanks.
I've been doing some work around the village.
I've already given you some trading sticks and I don't have any more on me at the moment. Why not go and talk to some of the other villagers and get some contributions?
translation: Sana zaten bazi ticaret cubuklari verdim ve su anda üzerimde baska yok. Neden gidip diger köylülerle konusup biraz katki almiyorsun?

english: Hey there, you wanna go in there to chop da special wood, for you my friend, it's free!
translation: Merhaba, özel odunu kesmek icin oraya girmek ister misin? Senin icin dostum, ücretsiz!

english: The player enters the Hardwood Grove.
Nah thanks, I'll give it a miss at the moment I think.
translation: Hayir tesekkürler, simdilik pas gececegim sanirim.

english: Fair enough, pop back if you change your mind.
What do you do here?
Is there anything interesting to do here?
translation: Burada ilginc bir sey var mi?

english: Ask about cutting back the jungle.
Do I get anything for doing this?
translation: Bunu yaptigimda bir sey kazanacak miyim?

english: Who do I get trading sticks from?
Sharimika.
Mamma Bufetta.
Layleen.
Karaday.

Safta Doc.
Gabooty.
Fanellaman.
Jagbakoba.

* Ask another question *
-- Villager Menu 1 --
Where can I get a machete from?
Where is this jungle?
Where is the fence that needs to be repaired?
Ok, thanks.
I've been doing some work around the village.
I'll enter for free.
Nah thanks, I'll give it a miss at the moment I think.
Hello.
Hello, how can I help you?
What's in this cave?
Creatures known as ents inhabit the depths of the hills, rumour has it they reside there due to the presence of the ancient redwood trees on the hills.
translation: Entler olarak bilinen yaratiklar tepelerin derinliklerinde yasiyor, söylentilere göre tepelerde bulunan eski sekoya agaclari nedeniyle orada yasiyorlar.

english: If you're as skilled a fighter as you are a woodcutter, you may enter the caves. You should find Kai once you are inside, he can give you some more information.
translation: Oduncu kadar yetenekli bir savasciysan magaralara girebilirsin. Iceri girdiginde Kai'yi bulmalisin, sana daha fazla bilgi verebilir.

english: I was just passing through.
What's in the cave?
I was just passing through.
Arrr, what is it that ye be wantin? I can tell ye all about the prices of runes, or perhaps I could combine the charges on yer teleport jewellery.
translation: Arrr, ne istiyorsun? Sana rünlerin fiyatlarini söyleyebilirim, ya da belki teleport mücevherlerinin ücretlerini birlestirebilirim.

english: What's a pirate doing here?
By my sea-blistered skin, I could ask the same of you!
translation: Denizden kabarmis derim üzerine yemin ederim, ayni soruyu sana da sorabilirim!

english: But... I'm not a pirate?
No? Then what's that smell? The smell o' someone spent too long at sea without a bath!
translation: Degil misin? O zaman bu koku da ne? Denizde cok uzun süre banyo yapmadan kalmis birinin kokusu!

english: I think that's probably you.
Har har har! We've got a stern landlubber 'ere! Well, let me tell ye, I'm here for the Grand Exchange! Gonna cash in me loot!
translation: Har har har! Burada sert bir kara adamimiz var! Sunu söyleyeyim, ben Büyük Borsa icin buradayim! Ganimetimi paraya cevirecegim!

english: Don't you just want to sell it in a shop or trade it to someone specific?
translation: Onu bir dükkanda satmak ya da belirli birine takas etmek istemiyor musun?

english: By my wave-battered bones! Not when I can sell to the whole world from this very spot!
translation: Dalgalarin yiprattigi kemiklerim üzerine yemin ederim! Bu noktadan tüm dünyaya satabilecegim varken neden öyle yapayim?

english: You pirates are nothing but trouble! Why, once I travelled to Lunar Isle with a bunch of your type, and spent days sailing around in circles!
translation: Siz korsanlar bas belasisiniz! Bir keresinde sizin gibilerle Lunar Isle'a seyahat ettim ve günlerce daireler cizerek dolastim!

english: Then ye must know me brother! Murky Pat!
translation: O zaman beni taniyor olmalisin kardesim! Murky Pat!

english: Hmmm. Not so sure I remember him.
Well, 'e be on that ship for sure. And I remember 'im tellin' me about some [guy/gal] like ye, getting all mixed up with curses and cabin boys.
translation: O gemide oldugu kesin. Ve bana senin gibi birinden bahsettigini hatirliyorum, lanetler ve gemici cocuklarla karismis birinden.

english: Yes! That was me!
Ye sure be a different character.
Tell me about the prices of runes.
Combine the charges on my teleport jewellery, please.
Arrr, ye've got nothing that I can combine.
Arrr, ye've nothing I can combine. Maybe ye needs to take yer stuff up to the Wilderness and charge it on the Fountain of Rune. It be more powerful than me.
translation: Arrr, birlestirebilecegim bir seyin yok. Belki esyalarini Wilderness'a götürüp Rune Cesmesi'nde sarj etmelisin. O benden daha güclüdür.

english: Arrr, I think ye be a bit short of inventory space.
translation: Arrr, sanirim envanter alanin biraz dar.

english: Arr, all done.
I hear you deal in rings of forging?
Arrrr, bring me yer ruby rings to enchant.
translation: Arrrr, bana büyülemek icin yakut yüzüklerini getir.

english: Arrrr, but they arrre 250gp per ring.
Arrr, 250gp per ring. How many would ye like me to enchant?
translation: Arrr, yüzük basina 250 altin. Kac tanesini büyülememi istersin?

english: Arrr, be seeing ya.
Arrr, pleasure doin' business with ya.
translation: Arrr, seninle is yapmak bir zevkti.

english: I got to go, erm, swab some decks! Yarr!
translation: Gitmem gerek, sey, güverteyi temizlemem lazim! Yarr!

english: Defer your speech right there! Quit this derogatory and somewhat narrow-minded allusion that all folks of sea voyage are only concerned with washing the decks, looking after parrots and drinking rum. I'll have ye
translation: Konusmani kes! Deniz yolculuguna cikanlarin tek ilgilendigi seyin güverteyi temizlemek, papaganlara bakmak ve rom icmek oldugu seklindeki bu asagilayici ve biraz da dar görüslü imalari kes. Bilmeni isterim ki

english: know there is much more to a pirate than meets the eye.
Aye-aye, captain!
Oh, come on! Lighten up!
Arrr, what is it that ye be wantin? I can tell ye all about the prices of runes.
translation: Arrr, ne istiyorsun? Rünlerin fiyatlari hakkinda sana her seyi anlatabilirim.

english: No! Me prices, they be goin' down!
Arrr! Another good sale!
I'm lovin' this Grand Exchange! Arrr!
Sure be a busy place, today.
Yarrr! I'm gonna be rich, I tell ye!
What's a pirate doing here?
Tell me about the prices of runes.
Combine the charges on my teleport jewellery, please.
I got to go, erm, swab some decks! Yarr!
translation: Gitmem lazim, sey, güverteyi temizlemem lazim! Yarr!

english: I hear you deal in rings of forging?
Hello.
So how's life as a pirate?
What kind of question is that? How's life as a... I dunno. Whatever it is that you do for a living.
translation: Bu ne bicim bir soru? Hayat nasil... Bilmiyorum. Ne is yapiyorsan o.

english: I'm a freelance troubleshooter.
What does that entail then?
Mostly killing things for money and delivering items around the planet for people.
translation: Cogunlukla para karsiliginda bir seyler öldürmek ve insanlar icin gezegenin dört bir yanina esya teslim etmek.

english: I collect stuff.
So how's that life?
Can't complain, can't complain...
Well, there you go.
Aren't you a little short for a pirate?
translation: Korsan icin biraz kisa degil misin?

english: My mother was a gnome. Apparently it was a very painful birth.
translation: Annem bir cüceydi. Anlasilan cok aci verici bir dogum olmus.

english: More info than I wanted, thanks!
Sorry, can't stop, the Captain will have my guts for garters if he catches me slacking off talking to the stowaway.
translation: Üzgünüm, durmam gerek, kaptan beni kacak yolcuyla konusurken yakalarsa bagirsaklarimi cikarir.

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard!
translation: Ben kacak yolcu degilim! Gemiye davet edildim!

english: Yeah, whatever [guy/lady], it doesn't really matter who you are I'll get in trouble!
translation: Evet, neyse , kim oldugun önemli degil, basim belaya girecek!

english: You know, I've always wondered what life as a pirate actually entails.
translation: Biliyor musun, korsan olmanin hayati nasil bir sey oldugunu hep merak etmisimdir.

english: Well, at the moment it mostly involves being asked random questions by a stowaway.
translation: Su anda cogunlukla kacak yolcu tarafindan rastgele sorular sorulmakla geciyor.

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard! By Lokar! Ask him!
translation: Ben kacak yolcu degilim! Gemiye davet edildim! Lokar tarafindan! Ona sor!

english: Hey, whatever [love/pal]. Just make sure the captain doesn't catch you, pirates don't like stowaways much.
translation: Hey, neyse . Kaptan seni yakalamasin, korsanlar kacak yolculari pek sevmezler.

english: Ah, good day to you [milady/sirrah]! Your face is unfamiliar, did you perhaps join us aboard the ship at Lunar Isle?
translation: Ah, iyi günler ! Yüzünüz tanidik gelmiyor, Lunar Isle'da gemiye mi bindiniz?

english: No, Lokar offered me a lift in Rellekka actually.
translation: Hayir, Lokar aslinda Rellekka'da beni gemiye davet etti.

english: Oh, really? You don't look like a Fremennik to me!
translation: Oh, gercekten mi? Bana Fremennik gibi görünmüyorsunuz!

english: Well... I kind of am, and I kind of aren't. It's a long story.
translation: Sey... Bir bakima öyleyim, bir bakima degilim. Uzun hikaye.

english: Sorry I don't have time to hear it then! See you around young fremennik-who-is-not-really-a-fremennik!
translation: Üzgünüm, dinleyecek vaktim yok! Görüsürüz, genc Fremennik-ama-aslinda-Fremennik-olmayan!

english: 'Bye.
Brrrr! Its cold up here!
You think this is cold? Up by Acheron it gets so cold that when you talk you see the words freeze in the air in front of you!
translation: Bunun soguk oldugunu mu düsünüyorsun? Acheron'da hava o kadar soguk ki, konustugunda sözcüklerin havada dondugunu görebilirsin!

english: REALLY?
Nah, not really. I was exaggerating for humourous effect. It is very very cold though!
translation: Hayir, degil. Komik olsun diye abarttim. Ama gercekten cok soguk!

english: Hello to you too.
Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!
translation: Yar! Biz korsaniz, yar! Dur, seni pis kara kurdu!

english: Please don't talk like that, it is extremely irritating.
translation: Lütfen öyle konusma, cok sinir bozucu.

english: Also, please don't call me a lychee, whatever that may be.
translation: Ayrica, lütfen bana lychee demeyin, o ne demekse.

english: Oh. Okay. Sorry.
ARGH! SOUND THE ALARM! STOWAWAY ON BOARD! STOWAWAY ON BOARD!
translation: ARGH! ALARM CALIN! GEMIDE KACAK YOLCU VAR! GEMIDE KACAK YOLCU VAR!

english: No! I'm not a stowaway! Honest! I was invited here!
translation: Hayir! Ben kacak yolcu degilim! Gercekten! Buraya davet edildim!

english: Oh, sorry, my mistake then.
You must admit you do look a lot like a stowaway though.
translation: Ama kacak yolcuya cok benzedigini kabul etmelisin.

english: Why, what do they usually look like?
Erm... I've never actually met one...
Okay then...
Hello.
So... You're a pirate, huh?
It's what it says on my pay-packet at the end of the month.
translation: Ay sonunda maas cekimde öyle yaziyor.

english: How's that working out for you?
Pretty good so far. All the grog and loot that we can plunder, plus full medical including dental.
translation: Su ana kadar oldukca iyi. Yagmalayabildigimiz tüm icki ve ganimetler, ayrica dis tedavisi dahil tam saglik sigortasi.

english: You mean you have insurance?
Not as such. If any of us get sick we kidnap a doctor and don't let him go until we're better.
translation: Öyle sayilmaz. Icimizden biri hastalanirsa bir doktor kaciririz ve iyilesene kadar onu birakmayiz.

english: You'd be surprised what an incentive for expert health care that is.
translation: Bunun uzman saglik hizmeti icin ne kadar tesvik edici oldugunu bilsen sasirirsin.

english: I can imagine.
Hello there. So what brings you aboard the Lady Zay?
translation: Merhaba. Lady Zay'e ne getiriyor sizi?

english: Well, I was planning on visiting the Moon Clan, but I have to say your ship is very impressive.
translation: Aslinda Moon Klani'ni ziyaret etmeyi planliyordum, ama geminizin cok etkileyici oldugunu söylemeliyim.

english: Aye, she's a beauty alright! The Lady Zay has been my home for many hard months, through storm and sun, and she always gets us to here we were headed!
translation: Evet, gercekten cok güzel! Lady Zay, firtinalarda ve günesin altinda gecirdigim zorlu aylar boyunca benim evim oldu ve bizi her zaman hedefimize ulastirdi!

english: Yes, she's certainly one of the finest boats I've seen on my travels!
translation: Evet, kesinlikle seyahatlerim sirasinda gördügüm en güzel gemilerden biri!

english: That she is [lad/lass], that she is.
Good day to you Sir.
Well hello my brave adventurer.
What are you up to?
Getting ready to go fishing of course. There's no time to waste!
translation: Tabii ki balik tutmaya hazirlaniyorum. Kaybedecek zaman yok!

english: I've got all the supplies I need from the shop at the end of the pier. They sell good rope, hammers and axes although their bailing buckets aren't too effective.
translation: Iskelenin sonundaki dükkandan ihtiyacim olan tüm malzemeleri aldim. Iyi halat, cekic ve balta satiyorlar, ancak kova cok etkili degil.

english: What fish do you catch?
I get all sorts, anything that lies on the sea bed, you never know what you're going to get until you pull up the net!
translation: Her türden, deniz dibinde ne varsa, agi cekene kadar ne yakalayacagini bilemezsin!

english: Your boat doesn't look too safe.
That's because it's not, the darn thing's full of holes.
translation: Cünkü güvenli degil, lanet sey delik desik.

english: Oh, so I suppose you can't go out for a while?
translation: Oh, o zaman bir süre denize acilmayacaksin herhalde?

english: Oh no, I don't let a few holes stop an experienced sailor like me. I could sail these seas in a barrel, I'll be going out soon enough.
translation: Oh hayir, birkac delik benim gibi deneyimli bir denizciyi durduramaz. Bu denizlerde bir ficiyla bile yelken acabilirim, yakinda denize acilacagim.

english: Could I help?
Well of course you can! I'll warn you though, the seas are merciless and without fishing experience you won't catch much.
translation: Tabii ki edebilirsin! Ama seni uyarayim, denizler acimasizdir ve balikcilik deneyimin yoksa fazla bir sey yakalayamazsin.

english: You need a fishing level of 15 or above to catch any fish on the trawler.
translation: Trol teknesinde balik tutmak icin balikcilik seviyen 15 veya üzerinde olmali.

english: On occasions the net rips, so you'll need some rope to repair it.
translation: Bazen ag yirtilabilir, bu yüzden onu onarmak icin biraz ip gerekir.

english: Repairing the net is difficult in the harsh conditions so you'll find it easier with a higher crafting level.
translation: Zorlu kosullarda agi onarmak zordur, bu yüzden zanaat seviyen yüksekse daha kolay olur.

english: Right...ok.
There's also a slight problem with leaks.
Leaks?!
Nothing some swamp paste won't fix...
translation: Bataklik macunu ile halledilemeyecek bir sey degil...

english: Swamp paste?
Also, there's the small matter of the Kraken.
translation: Ayrica, Kraken ile ilgili kücük bir sorun var.

english: You have got to be kidding me?
Occupational hazard. I usually whack it with an axe a few time and fix the damage with hammer once it's gone.
Oh, and one more thing... I hope you're a good swimmer?
translation: Oh, bir sey daha... Umarim iyi bir yüzücüsündür?

english: Actually, I think I'll leave it.
Bloomin' land lovers!!!
I'll be fine, let's go.
Aye aye! Meet me on board the trawler. I just need to get a few things together.
translation: Emredersiniz! Trol teknesinde bulusalim. Birkac sey hazirlamam lazim.

english: Aye aye! Meet me on board the trawler.
Oh hang on. I'm already on a fishing trip with someone. You'll have to try back in a few minutes.
translation: Oh, bekle. Zaten biriyle balik tutmaya cikmistim. Birkac dakika sonra tekrar denemelisin.

english: How can you be here and on board the boat?!
translation: Nasil hem burada hem de teknede olabiliyorsun?!

english: That's Game Magic, [lass/son].
What?!
Never mind. Just try back later OK?
translation: Bos ver. Daha sonra tekrar dene, tamam mi?

english: What's swamp paste?
Swamp tar mixed with flour which is then heated over a fire.
translation: Unla karistirilan bataklik katrani ateste isitilir.

english: Where can I find swamp tar?
Unfortunately the only supply of swamp tar is in the swamps below Lumbridge.
translation: Maalesef bataklik katrani sadece Lumbridge'in altindaki batakliklarda bulunur.

english: Hello again Murphy.
Good day to you land lover. Fancy hitting the high seas again?
translation: Iyi günler, kara sever. Yine acik denizlere acilmak ister misin?

english: No thanks, I still feel ill from last time.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler. Gecen seferki yolculuktan hala midem bulaniyor.

english: Hah! ...Softy.
We keep sinking! Can you give me some advice?
translation: Batmaya devam ediyoruz! Bana bir tavsiye verebilir misin?

english: Aye aye matey! We'll soon get you ship shape!
translation: Tabii ki dostum! Gemini kisa sürede düzeltiriz!

english: Ah yes, got it.
Don't say!
Also, bring a good axe and a hammer in case of Kraken attacks.
translation: Ayrica, Kraken saldirisi ihtimaline karsi iyi bir balta ve cekic getir.

english: I thought I'd heard it all!
Right so I need lots of swamp paste and plenty of rope, an axe and a hammer. Thanks Murphy!
translation: Tamam, o zaman cok fazla bataklik macunu, bolca ip, bir balta ve bir cekic lazim. Tesekkürler Murphy!

english: If all else fails use a bailing bucket or three!
translation: Her sey basarisiz olursa, bir veya üc kova kullan!

english: Yes, let's do it!
Murphy, what can you tell me about giant crabs?
translation: Murphy, dev yengecler hakkinda ne söyleyebilirsin?

english: Giant Crabs? Why, I used to haul up a few of those whenever I set my nets around Rimmington.
translation: Dev Yengecler mi? Neden, Rimmington civarinda aglarimi kurdugumda birkac tane yakalardim.

english: Why the interest?
I need to get some Giant Crab Meat and Kelp. Can you tell me where I can get some?
translation: Biraz Dev Yengec Eti ve Yosun almam lazim. Nereden bulabilecegimi söyleyebilir misin?

english: Well, the only thing I can think to do is to go down there and look to see if there are any left.
translation: Aklima gelen tek sey oraya gidip kalan var mi diye bakmak.

english: Go down there? What do you mean?
translation: Oraya gitmek mi? Ne demek istiyorsun?

english: As in under the water!
Tell me, can you get your hands on a fishbowl?
I'm sure I will be able to if I put my mind to it, why do you ask?
translation: Eger kafama koyarsam bulabilirim, neden soruyorsun?

english: Well, I know how to rig up a handy set of breathing gear that can allow you to keep air inside the fishbowl.
translation: Akvaryumun icindeki havayi tutmani saglayacak kullanisli bir solunum cihazi yapmayi biliyorum.

english: You just put the barrel of air on your back, with the fishbowl over your head, and then dive over the side.
translation: Sirtina hava tüpünü tak, akvaryumu basina gecir ve dal.

english: It should hold enough air to keep you alive for quite some time.
translation: Bu, seni bir süre hayatta tutacak kadar hava tutacaktir.

english: That sounds pretty dangerous...
Not at all. I'll even weigh anchor with the chain somewhere easy to reach so you can climb out easily enough if you run into trouble.
translation: Hic de degil. Hatta zinciri kolayca ulasabilecegin bir yere baglayacagim, böylece bir sorunla karsilasirsan kolayca disari cikabilirsin.

english: I'm still not happy about this...
Well, I can't think of any other way to check. If you come up with a better plan then feel free to tell me.
translation: Baska bir yol aklima gelmiyor. Daha iyi bir planin varsa, bana söylemekten cekinme.

english: In the meantime I'll wait, and if you want me to take you diving I'll be ready.
translation: Bu arada ben bekleyecegim, dalmaya gitmek istersen ben hazirim.

english: By the way, why are you so interested in crabs all of a sudden?
translation: Bu arada, neden birdenbire yengeclere bu kadar ilgi duymaya basladin?

english: I can't tell you I'm afraid. The very fabric of space and time could collapse!
translation: Korkarim sana söyleyemem. Uzay ve zamanin dokusu cökebilir!

english: Well, I guess some people will do anything for a bit of fresh seafood.
translation: Sanirim bazi insanlar taze deniz ürünleri icin her seyi yaparlar.

english: Ahoy there! All set for a dive?
I certainly am.
Great! I'll sort that fishbowl out for you.
translation: Harika! Senin icin o akvaryumu ayarlayayim.

english: There you go.
Are you sure this is safe?
Sure! It's as sound as my ship!
Want me to take you out now?
Well I can't take you out until you are properly geared up.
translation: Uygun ekipmanlarini giyene kadar seni götüremem.

english: Ok, let's be off then.
Cutscene begins onboard the boat.
Ok, see you soon Murphy!
Good luck, I'll weigh anchor. Climb up the chain to get aboard.
translation: Iyi sanslar, ben demir alacagim. Zinciri tirmanarak gemiye bin.

english: Not just yet.
Ok, well I'll be here if you change your mind.
Murphy, can I get another diving helmet?
translation: Murphy, baska bir dalis kaski alabilir miyim?

english: Sure, here you go. Try not to lose this one, I'm not a very good glassblower.
translation: Tabii, al bakalim. Bunu kaybetmemeye calis, ben cok iyi bir cam üfleyici degilim.

english: What do you mean?
Well, the bowls I make tend to shatter under pressure into razor-sharp shards of lethal, face shredding shrapnel.
translation: Sey, yaptigim kaseler basinc altinda keskin, yüzünü parcalayan ölümcül sarapnel parcalarina ayriliyor.

english: Don't let it bother you, I think I know what I'm doing wrong now.
translation: Endiselenme, sanirim neyi yanlis yaptigimi anladim.

english: Hello Murphy. Do you have a spare diving backpack?
translation: Merhaba Murphy. Yedek dalis sirt cantan var mi?

english: Sure, I have plenty after the...little incident.
translation: Tabii, o... kücük olaydan sonra bir sürü var.

english: What 'little incident'?
Nothing to worry yourself about.
Here, have this one. Only dropped once!
translation: Al, bunu al. Sadece bir kez düsürdüm!

english: Is that blood?
No, no.
Well, yes.
But seriously, what are the chances of getting a jellyfish jammed in there again?
translation: Ama cidden, oraya tekrar bir denizanasi sikismasi ihtimali ne kadar?

english: Yes, Let's go diving.
Well let's be...
Err, how do you plan on swimming with your hands full?
translation: Ee, ellerin dolu halde nasil yüzmeyi planliyorsun?

english: Well, when you hit the water you will start swimming. If you can't free up your hands by putting everything away then you will sink like a stone.
translation: Suya girdiginde yüzmeye baslayacaksin. Eger her seyi kaldirarak ellerini serbest birakamazsan, tas gibi batarsin.

english: All you have to do is have 2 spaces to store the items and you are good to go.
translation: Tek yapman gereken, esyalari saklamak icin 2 bosluk ayirmak, sonra hazirsin.

english: Even if you aren't carrying a shield or weapon it's always handy to have some free space for an emergency.
translation: Kalkan veya silah tasimiyor olsan bile, acil durumlar icin bos alanin olmasi her zaman kullanislidir.

english: See you then!
Now, do you have a gomeball on you?
Yes, I do, why do you ask?
Well you will need to leave them on the surface. They are so full of air that they will stop you diving properly.
translation: Onlari yüzeyde birakman gerekecek. Hava ile o kadar dolu ki, düzgün dalmani engelleyecekler.

english: Right, I'll go put it in the bank.
Now, do you have a hand egg on you?
translation: Simdi, yaninda el yumurtasi var mi?

english: You want that cat of yours to drown or something?
You mean you can't make them an adorable set of tiny diving gear?
translation: Onlara sevimli bir dalis ekipmani seti yapamaz misin?

english: No. Just...no.
I'm not taking you out for a dive with that cat following you.
translation: O kedi pesindeyken seni dalisa götürmem.

english: I'm not a cat person, and it'd have to stay on the ship while you were down.
translation: Ben kedi sever biri degilim ve sen dalis yaparken o gemide kalmak zorunda kalacak.

english: You know, I can see your cat right there.
I'm looking right at it. See, it's just there in your bag!
translation: Tam karsimda duruyor. Bak, cantanda duruyor!

english: I'm not taking you out with that cat. I'm not some sort of cat-sitter, so go and put it somewhere safe, then come back.
translation: O kedi varken seni dalisa götürmem. Ben kedi bakicisi degilim, git onu güvenli bir yere birak, sonra geri gel.

english: O'kay...
I still think I should get some cat-sized diving gear…
translation: Yine de kedi boyunda dalis ekipmani almaliyim...

english: I'm not taking you out for a dive with that pet following you. It'll get wet.
translation: O hayvan senin pesindeyken seni dalisa götürmem. Islanacak.

english: I'm not taking you out for a dive with that pet in your bag. It'll get wet.
translation: Cantanda o evcil hayvan varken seni dalisa götürmem. Islanacak.

english: We lost three diving parties that way!
translation: Bu sekilde üc dalis grubunu kaybettik!

english: Ok, well I'll just put my diving helmet and diving backpack on.
translation: Tamam, o zaman dalis kaskimi ve dalis sirt cantami giyecegim.

english: Well that's the sort of spirit I like to see. However you are far too heavy to go diving right now.
translation: Iste bu tür bir ruhu görmek isterim. Ancak su anda dalis yapmak icin cok agirsin.

english: Well, I can't take you diving if you are carrying more than 27kg worth of equipment.
translation: 27 kg'dan fazla ekipman tasiyorsan seni dalisa götüremem.

english: We arrived at that number through trial and error, and the errors were not pretty let me assure you.
translation: Bu rakama deneme yanilma yoluyla ulastik ve yanilmalarin hic de hos olmadigini garanti ederim.

english: So what can I do?
Well, if you pop over to a bank and leave all your heavy equipment behind then I'll take you out.
translation: Bir bankaya gidip tüm agir ekipmanlarini birakirsan seni götürürüm.

english: A brief cutscene plays of Murphy and the player standing on the trawler’s deck at sea.
translation: Murphy ve oyuncunun denizde trol teknesinin güvertesinde durduklari kisa bir kesit gösterilir.

english: How did it go?
Not too bad.
Great, I'll take us back in.
The player is transported back to Port Khazard.
The ship's ready to depart.
By the way, would you like me to remind you how the trawler works once the trip starts?
translation: Bu arada, yolculuk basladiktan sonra balikci teknesinin nasil calistigini hatirlatmami ister misin?

english: By the way, would you like me to keep reminding you how the trawler works once the trip starts?
translation: Bu arada, yolculuk basladiktan sonra balikci teknesinin nasil calistigini hatirlatmami ister misin?

english: You've got it!
No worries! Let me know if you change your mind!
translation: Merak etme! Fikrini degistirirsen bana haber ver!

english: The ship's at sea at the moment. This is some kind of paradox.
translation: Gemi su anda denizde. Bu bir tür paradoks.

english: Whoooahh sailor!
I've had enough, take me back.
Hah! .. the soft land lovers lost their sea legs have they?
translation: Hah! ... Yumusak toprak severler deniz ayaklarini mi kaybettiler?...

english: ...Something like that.
We're too far out now, It'd be dangerous.
translation: Su anda cok uzagiz, tehlikeli olur.

english: I insist Murphy, take me back.
translation: Israr ediyorum Murphy, beni geri götür.

english: Ok, ok, I'll try, but don't say I didn't warn you…
translation: Tamam, tamam, deneyecegim, ama beni uyarmadin deme...

english: Murphy attempts to sharply turn the large ship.
translation: Murphy büyük gemiyi keskin bir dönüs yapmaya calisir.

english: Save yourself! We're going down!
The fishing trawler is wrecked at sea.
Okay then Murphy, just keep us afloat.
translation: Tamam o zaman Murphy, bizi suda tutmaya devam et.

english: That's the attitude sailor...Aaaaar!
How you doing Murphy?
Get those fishies!
I think i'm feeling a bit sea sick!
It's a fierce sea today traveller, you best hold on tight.
translation: Bugün deniz cok dalgali gezgin, siki tutun.

english: Hello there
What the...?
Don't worry, Murphy. My name's [player name] and I'm using magic to contact you!
translation: Merak etme Murphy. Benim adim Maceraci ve seninle iletisim kurmak icin sihir kullaniyorum!

english: That's so rude when you may as well just speak to me in person!
translation: Bu cok kaba, benimle yüz yüze konusabilirsin!

english: Well I never! Technology these days. Beyond me. So how might I help you?
translation: Hic de bile! Günümüz teknolojisi. Anlayamiyorum. Nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: I was just wondering if there is anyone down there helping you out on the trawler?
translation: Orada, balikci teknesinde sana yardim eden biri var mi diye merak ediyordum.

english: The boat has just left actually! Perhaps when it comes back you can join them in another run?
translation: Tekne az önce ayrildi! Belki geri döndügünde bir sonraki seferde onlara katilabilirsin?

english: Sounds like a plan.
There seems to be someone on-board.
Just one person?
Yep, just one.
Ok, maybe I'll join them.
No, there are [number] at the moment.
The boat is just sitting waiting for someone to join. How about it?
translation: Tekne birinin katilmasini bekliyor. Ne dersin?

english: Maybe I'll come have a look. I'll catch you later!
translation: Belki gelip bir bakarim. Sonra görüsürüz!

english: Ok mate, bye!
The ship is back in port!
The ship will leave in 1 minute!
The ship will leave in [50/40/30/20/10] seconds!
The ship has just left port!
The ship will be back in [5/4/3/2/1] minute[s]!
The ship will be back in under 1 minute!
translation: Gemi 1 dakikadan az bir süre sonra geri dönecek!

english: Looks like the ship’s not going after all!
The ship has sunk! I'll get another one.
translation: Gemi batti! Baska bir tane bulayim.

english: Let’s get this net full with fishies!
Arrh! Check that net!
Doom! The Kraken is attacking!
Hurrah! The Kraken is no more!
You’ll need to start bailing soon!
Blistering barnacles!
The water is coming in matey!
We’ll all end up in a watery grave!
Land lubbers!
It’s a fierce sea today traveller.
My mother could bail better than that!
translation: Annem bile senden daha iyi su bosaltir!

english: Noooooo!
We’re going under!
We’re all doomed!
Mummy!
You’ll need all your strength!
To make it back to shore.
No fishies for you today!
Arrrgh! We’ve sunk!
Keep your head above water shipmate.
You’ll be joining Davey Jones!
What fish do you catch?
Your boat doesn't look too safe.
Could I help?
Actually, I think I'll leave it.
I'll be fine, let's go.
What's swamp paste?
No thanks, I still feel ill from last time.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, gecen seferki halimden dolayi hala kendimi iyi hissetmiyorum.

english: We keep sinking! Can you give me some advice?
translation: Batmaya devam ediyoruz! Bana bir tavsiye verebilir misin?

english: Yes, let's do it!
Talk about Recipe for Disaster.
Talk about something else.
Yes, Let's go diving.
Not just yet.
Go Diving.
Yes
No
I've had enough, take me back.
I insist Murphy, take me back.
translation: Israr ediyorum Murphy, geri götür beni.

english: Okay then Murphy, just keep us afloat.
translation: Tamam o zaman Murphy, bizi su üstünde tutmaya devam et.

english: How you doing Murphy?
Good day, Muruwoi.
Well done on retrieving the captive, visitor. Awowogei was impressed.
translation: Esiri kurtardigin icin tebrikler, ziyaretci. Awowogei cok etkilendi.

english: Sorry, you can't come in here.
Hello there! Sorry, I can't stop to talk. I'm guarding this workman's gate. I'm afraid you can't come through here - you'll need to find another way around.
translation: Merhaba! Üzgünüm, konusmak icin duramam. Bu isci kapisini koruyorum. Maalesef buradan gecemezsiniz, baska bir yol bulmaniz gerekecek.

english: You need 153 kudos to pass through here.
translation: Buradan gecmek icin 153 kudos'a ihtiyaciniz var.

english: Hello there! Sorry, I can't stop to talk. I'm guarding this workman's gate. As a friend of the museum, you may pass through as you wish.
translation: Merhaba! Üzgünüm, konusmak icin duramam. Bu isci kapisini koruyorum. Müzenin bir dostu olarak, istediginiz gibi gecebilirsiniz.

english: You're not permitted in this area.
Welcome! Would you like to go into the Dig Site archaeology cleaning area?
translation: Hos geldiniz! Kazi Alani arkeoloji temizlik alanina girmek ister misiniz?

english: No thanks, I'll take a look around out here.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, burada etrafa bir bakacagim.

english: Hello there. Come to see the new museum?
translation: Merhaba. Yeni müzeyi görmeye mi geldiniz?

english: Yes, how do I get in?
Well, the main entrance is 'round the front. Just head west then north slightly, you can't miss it!
translation: Ana giris ön tarafta. Batiya, sonra biraz kuzeye dogru ilerleyin, kacirmaniz imkansiz!

english: What about these doors?
They're for the workmen bringing finds from the Dig Site; sorry, but you can't go through.
translation: Bunlar Kazi Alanindan buluntulari getiren isciler icindir; üzgünüm, ama buradan gecemezsiniz.

english: Sorry, you can't come in here unless you've completed the Dig Site quest.
translation: Üzgünüm, Kazi Alani görevini tamamlamadiginiz sürece buraya giremezsiniz.

english: They're primarily for the workmen bringing finds from the Dig Site, but you can go through if you want.
translation: Bunlar öncelikle Kazi Alanindan buluntulari getiren isciler icindir, ama isterseniz gecebilirsiniz.

english: Okay, thanks.
Hold up there, workman coming through! You'll have to wait a moment; don't want to fall into that wheelbarrow!
translation: Durun, isci geciyor! Biraz beklemelisiniz, el arabasina düsmek istemezsiniz!

english: Sorry - workman's gate only.
Yes, I'll go in!
No thanks, I'll take a look around out here.
Hello there, human.
Do you have any news?
The Red Axe has departed the city recently. Ill omens.
translation: Kizil Balta kisa süre önce sehirden ayrildi. Kötü alametler.

english: How is that? Do you know anything about this?
translation: Nasil yani? Bu konuda bir sey biliyor musun?

english: No, it's just that no company has ever willingly left the Consortium before.
translation: Hayir, sadece daha önce hicbir sirket Konsorsiyum'dan kendi istegiyle ayrilmamisti.

english: Companies have been forced out of the Consortium then?
Oh yes. It hasn't happened for a long while now, but sometimes a company goes bankrupt. Or the value of the company becomes so low that it's relegated to being a minor company.
translation: Evet. Uzun zamandir böyle bir sey olmadi ama bazen bir sirket iflas eder. Ya da sirketin degeri o kadar düser ki, kücük bir sirket haline gelir.

english: I see, thank you.
Do you have any quests?
Let me think for a moment...
No, I have nothing that I could possible want doing. Try the shops or the market instead.
translation: Hayir, yapmak isteyebilecegim hicbir sey yok. Dükkanlari veya pazari dene.

english: See you later!
Perhaps!
Do you have any news?
Do you have any quests?
See you later!
I'll leave you to it.
I have something for you.
You're looking very shady.
I'm here for good reason, [player name].
translation: Buraya iyi bir sebepten geldim, Maceraci.

english: How do you know my name?
You and I share a common friend.
Azzanadra?
Indeed.
Why are you here?
Ever heard of criminals returning to the scene of the crime? Thatswhy.
translation: Suclularin suc mahalline geri döndüklerini duymus muydun? Iste bu yüzden.

english: I'm not sure this one is going to return any time soon.
translation: Bunun yakin zamanda geri dönecegini sanmiyorum.

english: Well never say never, [player name]. Now be on your way.
translation: Asla asla deme, Maceraci. Simdi yoluna devam et.

english: Azzanadra offered me a ring...
translation: Azzanadra bana bir yüzük teklif etti...

english: And you need me to give it to you?
translation: Ve onu sana vermemi mi istiyorsun?

english: Pretty much.
Take good care of that. It's very poweful.
I need another ring.
Very well, but it will cost you...
translation: Peki, ama bunun bir bedeli olacak...

english: I'd best get going.
Until next time, [player name].
translation: Bir dahaki sefere görüsmek üzere, Maceraci.

english: Hello again, [player name]. Azzanadra asked me to give you this.
translation: Merhaba tekrar, Maceraci. Azzanadra bunu sana vermemi istedi.

english: Hello again, [player name].
Don't you get bored down here?
Not really. I like the peace and quiet. It's also a far more reasonable temperature than outside.
translation: Pek sayilmaz. Huzur ve sükûneti seviyorum. Ayrica disariya göre cok daha makul bir sicaklik var.

english: Good points.
Azzanadra gave me a ring...
And you need me to replace it?
