translation: Ve sen onu degistirmemi mi istiyorsun?

english: It'll cost you.
How much we talking?
75,000 of your finest gold coins.
Yes.
Seems I don't have enough coins...
Well off you go then.
You will need some space to hold it first.
translation: Önce onu saklayacak bir yere ihtiyacin olacak.

english: Why are you here?
Azzanadra offered me a ring...
I need another ring.
I'd best get going.
Azzanadra gave me a ring...
No.
[player name]! Hand over the medallion!
[player name]! You have something that I want!
translation: Maceraci! Istedigim bir sey sende var!

english: [player name]! I want that medallion!
Sandwiches, [player name]!
Not who you expected, [player name]? Give me the medallion!
translation: Bekledigin kisi degil mi, Maceraci? Madalyonu ver!

english: You can't dismiss me, [player name]! Give me the medallion!
Enough of this, [player name]! Give me the medallion!
Welcome home, [player name]. Now, give me the medallion!
translation: Hos geldin, Maceraci. Simdi madalyonu ver!

english: Nice house, [player name]. Now, give me the medallion!
translation: Güzel ev, Maceraci. Simdi madalyonu ver!

english: Welcome back, [player name]. Now, give me the medallion!
translation: Hos geldin, Maceraci. Simdi madalyonu ver!

english: I'm still here, [player name]! Now give me the medallion!
translation: Hala buradayim, Maceraci! Simdi madalyonu ver!

english: Going somewhere, [player name]? We have unfinished business!
translation: Bir yere mi gidiyorsun, Maceraci? Bitmemis islerimiz var!

english: Come on! Show me a challenge!
That's more like it!
You can do better than that!
Now we're getting somewhere!
Is that all you have to give?!
Better! Much better!
I don't know how you lasted this long!
translation: Bu kadar uzun süre nasil dayandin bilmiyorum!

english: Yes! Show me what you've got!
Some fighter you are!
Finally, a proper challenger!
Really? Is that it?
Good! Now keep it up!
A worthy foe...
Pathetic!
Mediocre!
Disappointing!
Pitiful!
Sit down!
Hey, [player name], would you like to come and perform in a mime show?
translation: Hey, Maceraci, gelip pandomim gösterisinde yer almak ister misin?

english: Yeah, I'd love to do a mime show.
translation: Evet, pandomim gösterisinde yer almayi cok isterim.

english: Player is teleported to the mime show random event.
translation: Oyuncu, pandomim gösterisi rastgele olayina isinlanir.

english: You need to copy the mime's performance, then you'll be returned to where you were.
translation: Pandomimcinin performansini taklit etmelisin, sonra bulundugun yere geri dönersin.

english: Sorry, I'm busy.
Hey, [player name], would you like to come and solve a maze for me?
translation: Hey, Maceraci, gelip benim icin bir labirenti cözmek ister misin?

english: Sure, I like exploring mazes.
Reach the maze centre as fast as possible. The faster you are, the better your reward.
translation: Mümkün oldugunca cabuk labirentin merkezine ulas. Ne kadar hizli olursan, ödülün o kadar iyi olur.

english: Ah, so you are there. I hoped you would talk to me, I get so lonely. Here, have a present! I must be going now though.
translation: Ah, demek buradasin. Benimle konusmani umuyordum, cok yalniz hissediyorum. Al, sana bir hediye! Ama simdi gitmem gerek.

english: Your reward is [Reward] - it has been placed on the ground.
Sorry, I'm trying to speak to someone else, but he/she/they seems to be ignoring me.
translation: Üzgünüm, baska biriyle konusmaya calisiyorum ama o beni görmezden geliyor.

english: Goodbye.
[player name]!
Hello? [player name]?
Talk to me, [player name]!
[player name]? Are you there?
I'd like to talk to you, [player name]!
Maybe later.
I'm sorry, but you are no use to me.
translation: Üzgünüm, ama bana bir faydan yok.

english: Here, take this. But tell no one I was here.
translation: Al, bunu al. Ama kimseye burada oldugumu söyleme.

english: Well done! I have new information to share with you.
translation: Aferin! Seninle paylasacagim yeni bilgilerim var.

english: Yeah, I'd love to do a mime show.
Sorry, I'm busy.
Sure, I like exploring mazes.
Hey. Over here.
You look like someone who can handle themselves. Are you intending to partake in the Theatre of Blood?
translation: Kendini idare edebilecek biri gibi görünüyorsun. Kan Tiyatrosu'na katilmayi mi düsünüyorsun?

english: Maybe?
You're wondering what's in it for you I suppose. The citizens of Meiyerditch come here looking for freedom, but I can tell you're no citizen.
translation: Sanirim bunun sana ne faydasi olacagini merak ediyorsun. Meiyerditch vatandaslari buraya özgürlük aramak icin gelirler, ama senin vatandas olmadigini anlayabiliyorum.

english: Don't worry, you're not the first to sneak in. The guards here turn a blind eye to that sort of thing. Outsiders generally perform better in the Theatre, so make for more interesting entertainment.
translation: Merak etme, gizlice giren ilk kisi sen degilsin. Buradaki muhafizlar bu tür seylere göz yumuyorlar. Yabancilar genellikle Tiyatro'da daha iyi performans gösterir, bu yüzden daha ilginc bir eglence sunarlar.

english: Even the outsiders don't survive though. No one does. You however, might just have what it takes.
translation: Ancak yabancilar bile hayatta kalamaz. Kimse kalamaz. Sen ise, gerekli niteliklere sahip olabilirsin.

english: Where are you going with this?
You're strong enough to survive the Theatre, but you need a reason to try. I have a little proposition for you.
translation: Tiyatro'da hayatta kalacak kadar güclüsün, ama denemek icin bir nedene ihtiyacin var. Sana kücük bir teklifim var.

english: Go on...
The Theatre is owned by Lady Verzik Vitur, a vampyre noble. I represent a party that has certain... interests in Verzik.
translation: Tiyatro, vampir soylu Lady Verzik Vitur'a aittir. Ben, Verzik'te belirli... cikarlari olan bir grubu temsil ediyorum.

english: Enter the Theatre and beat the challenges within. Doing so would be quite the embarrassment for Verzik, something that my associates would very much appreciate.
translation: Tiyatroya girin ve icindeki zorluklari asin. Bunu basarmaniz Verzik icin oldukca utanc verici olacak ve bu, is arkadaslarimin cok hosuna gidecektir.

english: So you just need me to embarrass her? Doesn't sound too bad.
translation: Yani sadece onu utandirmami mi istiyorsunuz? Kulaga fena gelmiyor.

english: Be aware, this will be no easy challenge. I doubt you'll succeed alone. However, the guards will let you enter in a group of up to five. I suggest you take advantage of this.
translation: Unutmayin, bu kolay bir görev olmayacak. Tek basiniza basarabileceginizi sanmiyorum. Ancak, muhafizlar bes kisilik gruplarin girmesine izin veriyor. Bundan yararlanmanizi öneririm.

english: You can use the notice board to find suitable allies with whom to enter the Theatre.
translation: Tiyatroya girmek icin uygun müttefikler bulmak icin ilan panosunu kullanabilirsiniz.

english: Have you any advice to help me?
translation: Bana yardimci olacak bir tavsiyen var mi?

english: Actually, I do. Verzik's magic prevents most forms of teleportation. However, there is a special crystal with the power to overcome this restriction.
translation: Aslinda var. Verzik'in büyüsü, cogu teleportasyon türünü engelliyor. Ancak, bu kisitlamayi asma gücüne sahip özel bir kristal var.

english: I have... acquired some shards of the crystal. Do not ask me how. If you take one into the Theatre, you can use it to teleport to safety in an emergency.
translation: Ben... bu kristalin bazi parcalarini elde ettim. Nasil oldugunu sorma. Tiyatroya bir parca götürürsen, acil durumda onu kullanarak güvenli bir yere teleport olabilirsin.

english: I can sell you some of these shards if you wish.
Very well, I'll do my best.
I don't think so.
As you wish. Return to me if you change your mind.
translation: Nasil istersen. Fikrini degistirirsen bana geri dön.

english: Any luck in the Theatre?
What am I meant to be doing again?
Enter the Theatre and beat the challenges within. Doing so would cause great embarrassment to Verzik and my associates would very much appreciate it.
translation: Tiyatroya girip icindeki zorluklari asman gerekiyordu. Bunu basarirsan Verzik büyük bir utanc yasayacak ve arkadaslarim sana minnettar kalacak.

english: I've managed to defeat her! I survived every single one of Verzik's challenges!
translation: Onu yenmeyi basardim! Verzik'in tüm zorluklarini astim!

english: Really?
No.
I suggest you don't waste my time.
At the end, she even chose to face me herself. I couldn't fully defeat her though, she just transformed into a bat and flew away.
translation: Sonunda, kendisi benimle yüzlesmeyi secti. Ama onu tamamen yenemedim, yarasaya dönüsüp ucup gitti.

english: Impressive. Don't stop there though, return to the Theatre and embarrass her again. Keep it up and you will be rewarded.
translation: Etkileyici. Ama burada durma, Tiyatroya geri dön ve onu tekrar utandir. Böyle devam edersen ödüllendirileceksin.

english: You again. My master is very impressed with your work. On his behalf, allow me to reward you.
translation: Yine sen. Efendim senin calismandan cok etkilendi. Onun adina, sana bir ödül vermek istiyorum.

english: You should be careful around here friend. If I can tell you don't belong here, they probably can as well.
translation: Buralarda dikkatli olmalisin dostum. Ben senin buraya ait olmadigini anlayabiliyorsam, onlar da anlayabilir.

english: Yes.
Have you any advice to help me?
translation: Bana yardimci olacak bir tavsiyen var mi?

english: Go and buy teleport crystals.
translation: Git ve teleport kristalleri satin al.

english: Enter the Theatre without any teleport crystals.
Very well, I'll do my best.
No.
Welcome adventurer, to the Hallowed Sepulchre. Are you here to claim some of the treasure within? It seems like the kind of activity one like you would appreciate.
translation: Hos geldin maceraci, Kutsal Mezar'a. Icindeki hazineleri almak icin mi buradasin? Senin gibi birinin hosuna gidecek bir aktivite gibi görünüyor.

english: Treasure? What treasure? And what do you mean by 'one like me'?
translation: Hazine mi? Ne hazinesi? “Senin gibi biri” derken neyi kastediyorsun?

english: I mean you're not one of the inhabitants of this city. We could use someone of your talents.
translation: Demek istedigim, sen bu sehrin sakinlerinden biri degilsin. Senin yeteneklerine ihtiyacimiz var.

english: I mean you're not one of the inhabitants of this city... although you do smell and look like one. We could use someone of your talents.
translation: Demek istedigim, sen bu sehrin sakinlerinden biri degilsin... ama kokun ve görünüsün öyle. Senin yeteneklerine ihtiyacimiz var.

english: Oh? I can't say I'm not interested. What do you propose?
translation: Öyle mi? Ilgilenmedigimi söyleyemem. Ne öneriyorsun?

english: This place was built long before the city of Darkmeyer existed, back when this land was known as Hallowvale.
translation: Burasi Darkmeyer sehri kurulmadan cok önce, bu topraklar Hallowvale olarak bilindigi zamanlarda insa edildi.

english: The Sepulchre was used as a resting place for Hallowvale's loyal followers of Saradomin.
translation: Mezarlik, Hallowvale'deki Saradomin'in sadik takipcilerinin dinlenme yeri olarak kullaniliyordu.

english: Before they were driven out by the vampyres, the Saradominists used their magic to safeguard this place.
translation: Vampirler tarafindan kovulmadan önce, Saradoministler burayi korumak icin büyülerini kullandilar.

english: Safeguard how?
The dead here were buried with the wealth they had in life. To protect these riches, the Saradominists enchanted the statues within the Sepulchre to create various defences.
translation: Buradaki ölüler, hayattayken sahip olduklari servetle gömüldüler. Bu zenginlikleri korumak icin Saradoministler, Mezarlik'taki heykelleri cesitli savunma mekanizmalari olusturmak icin büyülediler.

english: Many have tried and failed to obtain the prizes buried here.
translation: Bircogu burada gömülü hazineleri ele gecirmek icin denedi ama basarisiz oldu.

english: Okay... So I presume you want me to get some of this treasure for you? How should I go about doing it?
translation: Tamam... Sanirim bu hazinelerden bazilarini senin icin almami istiyorsun? Bunu nasil yapacagim?

english: We don't care for a lot of what is kept here. We are only interested in the old currency of this land.
translation: Burada saklanan seylerin cogu bizi ilgilendirmiyor. Biz sadece bu topraklardaki eski para birimiyle ilgileniyoruz.

english: The mysterious stranger pulls a coin out of his pocket and shows it to you.
translation: Gizemli yabanci cebinden bir sikke cikarir ve sana gösterir.

english: If you find any of these Hallowed marks, I'd be willing to take them off your hands. In exchange, I can provide tools that can help you within the Hallowed Sepulchre.
translation: Bu kutsal isaretlerden herhangi birini bulursan, onlari senden almaya hazirim. Karsiliginda, Kutsal Mezar'da sana yardimci olabilecek araclar saglayabilirim.

english: You can keep whatever else you find for yourself.
translation: Buldugun diger her seyi kendine saklayabilirsin.

english: You should know, only the most agile of adventurers will have success down there. You'll need to use your reflexes to overcome the traps within.
translation: Bilmelisin ki, sadece en cevik maceracilar orada basarili olabilir. Icerideki tuzaklari asmak icin reflekslerini kullanman gerekecek.

english: The Sepulchre has five floors in total, each more dangerous than the last. I hope you prove competent enough to make it all the way down.
translation: Mezar toplamda bes katli ve her kat bir öncekinden daha tehlikeli. Umarim tüm katlari gecebilecek kadar yetenekli oldugunu kanitlarsin.

english: Do you have any information about what kind of traps I can expect?
translation: Ne tür tuzaklar bekleyebilecegim hakkinda herhangi bir bilgin var mi?

english: The statues have been enchanted to shoot fire, lightning and arrows. Some also throw swords. There are also tiles that when stepped on, will teleport you somewhere else.
translation: Heykeller ates, simsek ve ok atacak sekilde büyülü. Bazilari kilic da firlatiyor. Üzerine basildiginda seni baska bir yere isinlayan fayanslar da var.

english: Sounds like the perfect challenge for me! Is there anything else I should know?
translation: Benim icin mükemmel bir meydan okuma gibi görünüyor! Bilmem gereken baska bir sey var mi?

english: Yes... It seems that there is another safeguard which prevents anyone from spending too long within the Sepulchre.
translation: Evet... Mezarlikta kimsenin cok uzun süre kalmasini engelleyen baska bir güvenlik önlemi var gibi görünüyor.

english: You'll only have so much time before the magic within seals both the coffins and the stairs leading to the next floor.
translation: Sihir, tabutlari ve bir sonraki kata cikan merdivenleri mühürlemeden önce cok az zamanin olacak.

english: Hang on a second... If the doors to the next floor close, then how will I escape?
translation: Bir saniye... Bir sonraki kata cikan kapilar kapanirsa, nasil kacacagim?

english: The priests who built this place had a teleportation system. The magical obelisks they used can be found at the end of each floor. These obelisks can be used to transport you back here.
translation: Burayi insa eden rahipler bir isinlanma sistemi kurmuslar. Kullandiklari sihirli dikilitaslar her katin sonunda bulunabilir. Bu dikilitaslar seni buraya geri getirmek icin kullanilabilir.

english: However, we have found that the obelisks only respond to those they perceive to be followers of Saradomin. I'd strongly advise against wearing items of any other god.
translation: Ancak, obelisklerin yalnizca Saradomin'in takipcileri olarak algiladiklari kisilere yanit verdiklerini tespit ettik. Baska bir tanrinin esyalarini giymenizi kesinlikle önermiyorum.

english: I see, but what if I'm in the middle of a floor and can't make it to an obelisk?
translation: Anliyorum, ama ya bir katin ortasindaysam ve obeliske ulasamiyorsam?

english: I see you are cautious adventurer. That is wise. You can use any teleport spell to escape from the Hallowed Sepulchre. However, you may also find these of use.
translation: Dikkatli bir maceraci oldugunuzu görüyorum. Bu akillica. Kutsal Mezar'dan kacmak icin herhangi bir teleport büyüsü kullanabilirsiniz. Ancak, bunlar da isinize yarayabilir.

english: These teleport crystals were enchanted using the magic of the obelisks. They can be used to teleport to this lobby. I can sell you more when you run out.
translation: Bu teleport kristalleri obelisklerin büyüsüyle büyülendi. Bu lobide teleport olmak icin kullanilabilirler. Bittiginde size daha fazlasini satabilirim.

english: Thanks! I'll make sure to put them to good use.
translation: Tesekkürler! Onlari iyi bir sekilde kullanacagim.

english: Thanks for the information. I'll keep an eye out for some of those Hallowed marks.
translation: Bilgi icin tesekkürler. Kutsal isaretlere dikkat edecegim.

english: That would be... appreciated.
Tell me about yourself.
Like you, I am not from here. I represent a group who are very interested in the Hallowed marks found within the Hallowed Sepulchre.
translation: Senin gibi ben de buradan degilim. Kutsal Mezar'da bulunan Kutsal isaretlerle cok ilgilenen bir grubu temsil ediyorum.

english: You know, I helped out a very similar individual to yourself over at the Theatre of Blood. Any connection?
translation: Biliyorsun, Kan Tiyatrosu'nda sana cok benzeyen birine yardim etmistim. Bir baglanti var mi?

english: So you're the one who the master spoke of. I am aware of your contributions. Helping us out here will earn yourself further favour with him.
translation: Demek ustanin bahsettigi kisi sensin. Katkilarini biliyorum. Bize burada yardim edersen, onun gözünde daha da deger kazanirsin.

english: How do I know that's something I even want?
translation: Bunun istedigim bir sey oldugunu nereden bilecegim?

english: That is for you to decide. I have told you all that I have to share.
translation: Buna sen karar verirsin. Sana söylemem gereken her seyi söyledim.

english: That is all you need to know.
All right then, keep your secrets.
I'd like to trade in some Hallowed marks.
translation: Bazi Kutsal isaretleri takas etmek istiyorum.

english: Of course.
Do you have any of my items?
I do not. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: Yok. Eger senin esyalarin olsaydi, ama sen onlari almadan önce öldüysen, artik kaybolmuslardir.

english: I do have some of your items here. Try not to get hit by the traps next time.
translation: Burada senin esyalarindan bazilari var. Bir dahaki sefere tuzaklara carpmamaya calis.

english: I'd like to access your tool storage.
Is there any way I could have private access to the Sepulchre? The other adventurers in there keep activating traps and messing up my timing.
translation: Mezara özel erisimim olabilir mi? Oradaki diger maceracilar sürekli tuzaklari etkinlestirip zamanlamami bozuyorlar.

english: An interesting problem. But... I suppose I could grant you private access to the Hallowed Sepulchre... for a fee.
translation: Ilginc bir sorun. Ama... Sanirim sana Kutsal Mezar'a özel erisim izni verebilirim... bir ücret karsiliginda.

english: How much?
200 Hallowed marks.
I don't have that many marks on me...
Then I'm afraid that, for now, you will have to contend with your peers activating traps for you.
translation: O zaman korkarim ki, simdilik, arkadaslarinizin sizin icin tuzaklari etkinlestirmesiyle basa cikmak zorunda kalacaksiniz.

english: Very well. You should now find that when you enter the Hallowed Sepulchre, you will end up in different chambers to your peers.
translation: Peki. Artik Kutsal Mezar'a girdiginizde, arkadaslarinizdan farkli odalarda bulacaginizi göreceksiniz.

english: Speak to me again if you like this effect rescinded.
translation: Bu etkinin kaldirilmasini isterseniz, benimle tekrar konusun.

english: No thanks.
Very well. I shall be here if you change your mind.
I'd better get going.
I see you're still alive adventurer. Do you have any Hallowed marks for me?
translation: Hâlâ hayattasin maceraci. Bana kutsal isaretler getirdin mi?

english: Tell me more about this place.
translation: Bana bu yer hakkinda daha fazla bilgi ver.

english: Is there anything else you need?
translation: Baska bir seye ihtiyacin var mi?

english: Can I go back to looting with other people?
translation: Digerleriyle birlikte yagmalamaya geri dönebilir miyim?

english: I can remove your private access for now, if you're sure.
translation: Eger emin isen, simdilik özel erisiminizi kaldirabilirim.

english: Very well. You should now find that when you enter the Hallowed Sepulchre, your peers will join you.
translation: Peki. Artik Kutsal Mezarliga girdiginde, arkadaslarin da sana katilacak.

english: Speak to me again if you would like this effect restored.
translation: Bu etkinin geri yüklenmesini istiyorsan tekrar benimle konus.

english: On second thoughts, I've changed my mind.
translation: Bir daha düsündüm de, fikrimi degistirdim.

english: Can I go back to looting on my own?
translation: Tek basima yagmalamaya devam edebilir miyim?

english: I can restore your private access for you, if you're sure.
Sorry, I need to go.
I do not have anything for you. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: Sana verecek bir seyim yok. Eger senin esyalarin bende olsaydi, ama sen onlari almadan önce öldüysen, artik kaybolmuslardir.

english: I have some of your things. You should come get them before you enter the Hallowed Sepulchre.
translation: Senin bazi esyalarin bende. Kutsal Mezar'a girmeden önce gelip almalisin.

english: Tell me about yourself.
I'd like to trade in some Hallowed marks.
translation: Bazi Kutsal isaretleri takas etmek istiyorum.

english: Do you have any of my items?
I'd like to access your tool storage.
Ask about private access.
I'd better get going.
Tell me more about this place.
translation: Bana bu yer hakkinda daha fazla bilgi ver.

english: More options...
Previous options...
Sorry, I need to go.
What was I talking about, now?
Weren't you going to tell me about the rumour?
translation: Bana söylenti hakkinda bilgi vermeyecek miydin?

english: Oh yeah, that was it!
Carry on.
It's about the new family.
That joined our horde?
The very same!
Oh my! Do tell.
I were hangin' out me washin'.
Yes...
And I looked over at-
I'm listening.
Wait, we're being watched!
We are?
Yes, a person over there.
Where?
No! Don't make eye contact.
Oh my!
They're listening to us.
A goblin folk?
Oh no! It's one of those tall people.
translation: Olamaz! O uzun boylu insanlardan biri.

english: Bizarre creatures for sure.
Makes my skin crawl to see them.
translation: Onlari görmek tüylerimi diken diken ediyor.

english: Why?
So tall and neat.
For sure, my dear.
I hope it doesn't come to speak with us.
What a horrid thought!
Horrid indeed, my dear.
What should we do?
Let us carry on our conversation.
Let's!
So...
Yes?
Are you in need of some runes?
Yes please.
Where do you get your runes from?
That is not the kind of information I intend to give to a human.
translation: Bu, bir insana vermek istedigim türden bir bilgi degil.

english: Why?
Because before the Varlamorians decided to open their lands up to visitors, Cam Torum was the sole supplier of runes to the entire region.
translation: Cünkü Varlamorlular topraklarini ziyaretcilere acmaya karar vermeden önce, Cam Torum tüm bölgeye rün tedarik eden tek yerdi.

english: Okay... But that's not the case anymore. With the kingdom open, they can just get their runes from the mainland.
translation: Tamam... Ama artik durum öyle degil. Krallik acildigindan beri, rünleri anakaradan temin edebiliyorlar.

english: A fact I'm all too aware of, especially given the impact it is having on my prices.
translation: Bu gercegin cok iyi farkindayim, özellikle de fiyatlarim üzerindeki etkisini düsünürsek.

english: Nevertheless, there is still a benefit to having a source of runes closer to home, and I do not intend to share any information on that source.
translation: Yine de, evime daha yakin bir rune kaynagina sahip olmanin bir avantaji var ve bu kaynakla ilgili herhangi bir bilgiyi paylasmak niyetinde degilim.

english: Fair enough.
Now, are you in need of some runes?
You can trust me. I won't tell anyone else.
You display the typical arrogance of a human. I am a Dwarf of Cam Torum. My people have mastered Smithing and Magic in equal measure.
translation: Tipik bir insan kibirini sergiliyorsun. Ben Cam Torum'lu bir cüceyim. Halkim demircilik ve büyücülügü esit derecede ustalikla yapar.

english: That little trinket of yours may well work wonders on a lesser mind, but you will find it to be of little use here.
translation: O kücük biblon daha zayif zihinlerde harikalar yaratabilir, ama burada pek ise yaramayacagini göreceksin.

english: Oh...
No thanks.
Then we have nothing more to discuss.
translation: O zaman konusacak baska bir seyimiz yok.

english: Yes please.
Where do you get your runes from?
Fair enough.
[Charm] You can trust me. I won't tell anyone else.
No thanks.
Good day, how may I help you?
What is this place?
This is a branch of the Bank of Gielinor. We have branches in many towns.
translation: Burasi Gielinor Bankasi'nin bir subesi. Bircok kasabada subemiz var.

english: And what do you do?
We will look after your items and money for you. Leave your valuables with us if you want to keep them safe.
translation: Esyalarinizi ve paranizi sizin icin sakliyoruz. Degerli esyalarinizi güvende tutmak istiyorsaniz bize birakabilirsiniz.

english: I'd like to access my bank account, please.
translation: Banka hesabimi kontrol etmek istiyorum, lütfen.

english: I'd like to check my PIN settings.
I'd like to collect items.
What is this place?
Psst... wanna buy some weapons?
What have you got?
Well, first up there's the normal bone club and bone spear. Good, solid frog-bone, and the spear has an iron tip. Can withstand a lot of punishment, if you know what I mean!
translation: Öncelikle normal kemik sopa ve kemik mizrak var. Saglam kurbaga kemiginden yapilmis ve mizragin ucu demir. Anlarsin ya, cok dayaniklidir!

english: But if you're after something a bit fancier, a bit more sophisticated, there's the bone crossbow and dagger.
translation: Ama biraz daha süslü, biraz daha sofistike bir sey ariyorsaniz, kemik arbalet ve hancer var.

english: These are specially good for getting your prey unawares, but you're not going to get the best out of them unless you've been taught the special technique.
translation: Bunlar avinizi hazirliksiz yakalamak icin özellikle iyidir, ancak özel teknigi ögrenmedikce bunlardan en iyi sekilde yararlanamazsiniz.

english: So, you interested?
I might be.
What is this special technique?
Special aiming technique. If you hit an enemy with it their defence will get weaker so you can hit them again!
translation: Özel nisan alma teknigi. Düsmani bununla vurursan savunmasi zayiflar ve onu tekrar vurabilirsin!

english: Plus, if you use this technique on an enemy who isn't expecting it, you'll always hit them! Pretty good, eh?
translation: Ayrica, bu teknigi beklemeyen bir düsmana kullanirsan, onu her zaman vurabilirsin! Oldukca iyi, degil mi?

english: 'Course, there's only a few people who know it, so unless you can get someone to show you you won't be able to do it.
translation: Tabii ki, bunu bilen cok az kisi var, bu yüzden sana gösteren biri olmazsa bunu yapamazsin.

english: Zanik showed me how to do it!
Good for you! So, are you interested?
No thanks.
Yeah, you stay out of trouble.
Why are you whispering?
Well, y'know, it's not the most reputable profession, is it? Selling weapons?
translation: Bilirsin, bu pek saygin bir meslek degil, degil mi? Silah satmak?

english: Why not?
Well, they're used to hurt people, aren't they? That's not considered very, y'know, respectable. Even though the guards use them, and the hunters, they're still considered a bit, y'know, dirty.
translation: Insanlara zarar vermek icin kullaniliyorlar, degil mi? Bu pek saygin bir meslek sayilmaz. Muhafizlar ve avcilar da kullaniyor olsa da, yine de biraz kirli bir meslek olarak görülüyor.

english: Isn't it like that where you come from?
translation: Senin geldigin yerde de öyle degil mi?

english: No, on the surface weapon-making is considered a noble profession.
translation: Hayir, yüzeyde silah yapimi asil bir meslek olarak görülüyor.

english: I don't know, you surface people are strange!
What have you got?
I might be.
No thanks.
What is this special technique?
Why are you whispering?
That's a funny name you've got.
'Narf'? You think that's funny? At least I don't call myself [player name]! Where did you get a name like that?
translation: “Narf” mi? Komik mi sence? En azindan ben kendime Maceraci demiyorum! Böyle bir adi nereden buldun?

english: It seemed like a good idea at the time!
translation: O zaman iyi bir fikir gibi gelmisti!

english: Bah!
Nice one! I have new information to share with you.
translation: Güzel! Seninle paylasacagim yeni bilgilerim var.

english: Yes?
What are you doing out here?
Sometimes I like to take a walk out to these shores and look for losers to laugh at.
translation: Bazen bu kiyilara yürüyüse cikip gülünecek ezikler ararim.

english: And look, I found one!
Hahahah!
Charming.
Do you have a quest for me?
translation: Bana verecek bir görevin var mi?

english: Why, yes! I do have a quest for you! I've hidden some goodies around Varlamore! Haha!
translation: Evet, var! Sana verecek bir görevim var! Varlamore'un cevresine bazi hediyeler sakladim! Haha!

english: Bring them all to me and I'll give you a nasty little surprise!
translation: Hepsini bana getir, sana kötü bir sürpriz yapayim!

english: A treasure hunt? That's exciting! Any tips to get me started?
translation: Hazine avi mi? Cok heyecanli! Baslamak icin bir ipucu var mi?

english: No.
Oh... I guess I'll be on my way then.
I've found some strange tokens.
Oh, really? Show me.
You utter fool! You have failed to acquire all the tokens I desire! Now scuttle away from here, loser!
translation: Seni aptal! Istedigim tüm jetonlari toplamayi basaramadin! Simdi buradan defol, ezik!

english: You're not a very nice man...
Nothing. I'll be going now.
Yes, yes... This does appear to be all of them!
translation: Evet, evet... Bunlar hepsi gibi görünüyor!

english: Would you like to trade them for a nasty little suprise? I bet you would, wouldn't you?!
translation: Onlari kötü bir sürprizle takas etmek ister misin? Isterim, degil mi?!

english: Sure, why not?
No, actually.
Oh...
What? I don't want that.
What are you doing out here?
Do you have a quest for me?
I've found some strange tokens.
Nothing. I'll be going now.
Sure, why not?
No, actually.
Hey there. Have you seen Frank?
Frank?
Yes, Frank. He's my pet bloodveld. He runs off a lot so I was wondering if you'd seen him.
translation: Evet, Frank. O benim evcil kanli bozkir hayvanim. Sik sik kacar, onu gördün mü diye merak ettim.

english: Frank doesn't seem like a very fitting name for a bloodveld.
translation: Frank, bir kan tarlasi icin pek uygun bir isim gibi görünmüyor.

english: Oh, he was named after my last pet. That one wasn't a bloodveld though, that one was a human.
translation: Oh, adi son evcil hayvanimin adindan geliyor. O bir kan tarlasi degildi, bir insandi.

english: You had a pet human?
Yes! A pet human called Frank.
translation: Evet! Frank adinda bir evcil insan.

english: Frank was great. He died though. Mother said it was my fault, that I didn't feed him properly. I'm not allowed pet humans now.
translation: Frank harikaydi. Ama öldü. Annem benim hatam oldugunu, onu dogru düzgün beslemedigimi söyledi. Artik evcil insan beslememe izin verilmiyor.

english: It's okay though. Now I have Frank the bloodveld. He's great. I don't need to feed him. He feeds himself.
translation: Ama sorun degil. Artik Frank adinda bir kan tarlam var. Harika bir hayvan. Onu beslememe gerek yok. Kendi kendine besleniyor.

english: What a nice happy ending.
Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: Insan! Muhafizlari cagirmadan köle kafeslerine geri dön!

english: Hello there.
Hello! You must be the adventurer that helped us get out of Menaphos. Thank you.
translation: Merhaba! Sen bizi Menaphos'tan kurtaran maceraci olmalisin. Tesekkürler.

english: Don't mention it.
What do you have for sale?
Take a look.
What were things like in Menaphos?
Not great. I'd just gone over there to purchase some goods from the market. When I got back to the gates, they'd been sealed shut.
translation: Iyi degildi. Pazardan bazi mallar satin almak icin oraya gitmistim. Kapilara geri döndügümde, kapilar kapatilmisti.

english: So the guards wouldn't let you back?
translation: Yani muhafizlar seni geri almadi mi?

english: They were still allowing citizens from Sophanem to return at that point, but I foolishly chose to stay. I was scared of catching the pox.
translation: O sirada Sophanem'den gelen vatandaslarin geri dönmesine izin veriyorlardi, ama ben aptalca kalmayi tercih ettim. Cicek hastaligina yakalanmaktan korkuyordum.

english: By the time I'd changed my mind, they'd stopped letting anyone through. Thankfully, I had some friends there with a spare bed.
translation: Fikrimi degistirdigimde, artik kimseyi gecirmemeleri baslamisti. Neyse ki, orada yedek yatagi olan bazi arkadaslarim vardi.

english: I guess not everyone was as lucky?
translation: Herkes o kadar sansli degildi herhalde?

english: No. Many didn't have anywhere to go. Violence broke out in some parts of the city.
translation: Hayir. Bircogunun gidecek yeri yoktu. Sehrin bazi bölgelerinde siddet olaylari cikti.

english: They quickly put a stop to it in the Imperial and Merchant quarters, but there was still some unrest in the Workers district when I was finally able to leave.
translation: Imparatorluk ve Tüccar mahallelerinde bunu cabucak durdurdular, ama ben nihayet ayrilabildigimde Isci mahallesinde hala bazi karisikliklar vardi.

english: I'm sorry you had go through all of that. Menaphos definitely took a hard stance on the plagues.
translation: Bütün bunlari yasadigin icin üzgünüm. Menaphos, salginlara karsi kesinlikle sert bir tutum sergiledi.

english: They were brutal. They even shut off the port from the rest of the city over fears of the plague getting in that way. Many of their own citizens are still trapped there.
translation: Acimasizdilar. Salginin bu yolla sehre girmesinden korktuklari icin limani sehrin geri kalanindan bile kapattilar. Kendi vatandaslarinin cogu hala orada mahsur durumda.

english: Anyway, let's not talk any more of this. Is there anything else I can do for you.
translation: Neyse, bu konuyu daha fazla konusmayalim. Senin icin yapabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: I'd better get going.
Until next time.
Hello again! It's so nice to be out of Menaphos. Once again, thank you.
translation: Merhaba tekrar! Menaphos'tan cikmak cok güzel. Tekrar tesekkürler.

english: What do you have for sale?
What were things like in Menaphos?
I'd better get going.
Hello.
I've lost my notes... Dufft, have you seen my notes?
translation: Notlarimi kaybettim... Dufft, notlarimi gördün mü?

english: My wife will kill me if I don't take her back a souvenir.
I've had such a terrible headache since we arrived on this mountain.
translation: Bu daga geldigimizden beri basim cok agriyor.

english: Thank Saradomin for that mountain guide. We couldn't have made it here without him!
translation: O dag rehberine Saradomin'e sükürler olsun. O olmasaydi buraya gelemezdik!

english: I can't find my rock pick!
Hello there and welcome to the Natural History exhibit of the Varrock Museum!
translation: Merhaba ve Varrock Müzesi'nin Doga Tarihi sergisine hos geldiniz!

english: Hello. So what is it you do here?
Well, we look after all of the research in this section.
translation: Bu bölümdeki tüm arastirmalari biz yürütüyoruz.

english: When I'm not doing that, I'm teaching people like yourself about how wonderful the natural world is.
translation: Bunu yapmadigim zamanlarda ise sizin gibi insanlara doga dünyasinin ne kadar harika oldugunu anlatiyorum.

english: Nice. So then, I've got a few questions for you.
translation: Güzel. O zaman size birkac sorum var.

english: Well, fire away and I'll give you an insight into the exciting world of animals.
translation: Sorun, ben de size hayvanlarin heyecan verici dünyasi hakkinda bilgi vereyim.

english: Hello again, [sir/madam], how can I help you on this fine day?
translation: Merhaba tekrar, , bu güzel günde size nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: I was hoping you could tell me about something.
translation: Bana bir sey anlatabilir misiniz diye umuyordum.

english: Tell me about lizards.
Ahh lizards, the scaly carnivores.
If you just follow me to the display case I shall explain all about them.
translation: Beni vitrine kadar takip ederseniz, size onlar hakkinda her seyi anlatirim.

english: The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the lizard display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolboy.
translation: Oyuncu ve doga tarihcisi, bir ögretmen, ögrenci ve okul cocugu ile birlikte kertenkele vitrininin önündeki bir kesit sahnesine isinlanir.

english: Contrary to popular belief, even though most lizards have a yellow belly, they are not in fact cowardly. Most Gielinor lizards will not shy away from a good fight and can be very tough.
translation: Popüler inanisin aksine, cogu kertenkelenin karni sari olsa da, aslinda korkak degildirler. Gielinor kertenkelelerinin cogu iyi bir kavgadan kacinmaz ve cok sert olabilirler.

english: The natural historian poses as a lizard...
This is due to a very thick and tough hide, made from thousands of thick scales. Most people who claim to be hunters have a very hard time trying to dispatch lizards.
translation: Bunun nedeni, binlerce kalin puldan olusan cok kalin ve sert bir deriye sahip olmalaridir. Avci oldugunu iddia eden cogu insan, kertenkeleleri öldürmek icin cok ugrasir.

english: In fact, the only people to successfully discern how to kill these tough little squamatas are the five legendary Slayer masters, although we assume they must have some kind of natural predator.
translation: Aslinda, bu sert kücük sürüngenleri nasil öldüreceklerini basariyla anlayan tek insanlar, bes efsanevi Slayer ustasidir, ancak bunlarin bir tür dogal avcisi oldugunu varsayiyoruz.

english: Interestingly enough, these scales are made from the same substance that your hair is comprised of. This substance is called keratin.
translation: Ilginctir ki, bu pullar sacinizin bileseniyle ayni maddeden yapilmistir. Bu madde keratin olarak adlandirilir.

english: Lizards have a very well developed sense of vision and hearing. Some people think that some lizards have a third eye!
translation: Kertenkeleler cok gelismis bir görme ve isitme duyusuna sahiptir. Bazi insanlar bazi kertenkelelerin ücüncü bir gözü oldugunu düsünür!

english: A tiny, light-sensitive, transparent structure on top of the head that helps them regulate how long they stay in the sun.
translation: Baslarinin üstünde, güneste ne kadar kalacaklarini düzenlemelerine yardimci olan kücük, isiga duyarli, seffaf bir yapi vardir.

english: This is vital for the cold-blooded lizards who have no means to regulate their internal temperature.
translation: Bu, ic sicakliklarini düzenleme imkani olmayan sogukkanli kertenkeleler icin hayati önem tasir.

english: Like many cold-blooded creatures, if they are subjected to a sudden decrease in temperature, they will become sluggish and sleepy.
translation: Bircok sogukkanli canli gibi, ani bir sicaklik düsüsüne maruz kalirlarsa, halsiz ve uykulu hale gelirler.

english: And this concludes my short lecture on lizards. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: Ve bu, kertenkelelerle ilgili kisa dersimi sonlandiriyor. Umarim keyif almissinizdir.

english: End cutscene
Tell me about the tortoises.
Ahh tortoises, the armoured ancients.
The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the tortoise display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolgirl.
translation: Oyuncu ve doga tarihcisi, bir ögretmen, ögrenci ve kiz ögrencinin bulundugu kaplumbaga vitrininin önündeki bir kesit sahnesine isinlanir.

english: The tortoise is a very well defended beast. It uses an armoured shell just like its aquatic cousins the terrapin and the turtle.
translation: Kaplumbaga, kendini cok iyi koruyan bir hayvandir. Sucul kuzenleri olan su kaplumbagasi ve deniz kaplumbagasi gibi zirhli bir kabuk kullanir.

english: The natural historian poses as a tortoise...
Tortoises can vary in size from about as long as your hand to as big as a unicorn. Most land tortoises eat nothing but plants in the wild.
translation: Kaplumbagalarin boyutu, elinizin uzunlugu kadar kücükten tek boynuzlu at kadar büyük olana kadar degisebilir. Cogu kara kaplumbagasi Wildernessda sadece bitki yer.

english: Did you know you can tell how old a tortoise is by the number of rings in its shell, just like a tree.
translation: Kaplumbaganin yasini, tipki agaclarda oldugu gibi kabugundaki halkalarin sayisindan anlayabileceginizi biliyor muydunuz?

english: Most land-based tortoises eat plants, feeding on grazing grasses, weeds, leafy greens, flowers, and cabbages.
translation: Cogu kara kaplumbagasi bitki yer, otlar, yabani otlar, yaprakli yesillikler, cicekler ve lahanalarla beslenir.

english: Tortoises generally live as long as people, and some individual ones are known to have lived longer than 300 years.
translation: Kaplumbagalar genellikle insanlar kadar uzun yasar ve bazilarinin 300 yildan fazla yasadigi bilinmektedir.

english: Because of this, they symbolise longevity within some cultures, such as gnomes who also breed them for battle.
translation: Bu nedenle, bazi kültürlerde uzun ömürlülügü simgelerler, örnegin savas icin onlari yetistiren cüceler gibi.

english: The oldest tortoise ever recorded was Mibbiwocket, who was presented to the King Healthorg the Great, by the famous explorer Admiral Bake, shortly after its birth.
translation: Kaydedilen en yasli kaplumbaga, dogumundan kisa bir süre sonra ünlü kasif Amiral Bake tarafindan Büyük Kral Healthorg'a sunulan Mibbiwocket'tir.

english: Mibbiwocket is still in the care of the gnomish royal family.
translation: Mibbiwocket hala cüce kraliyet ailesinin bakimindadir.

english: And this concludes my short lecture on tortoises. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: Ve bu, kaplumbagalar hakkindaki kisa dersimi sonlandiriyor. Umarim keyif almissinizdir.

english: Tell me about dragons.
Ahh dragons, the mighty hunters of the sky.
The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the dragon display case with a teacher and pupil.
translation: Oyuncu ve doga tarihcisi, bir ögretmen ve ögrencisiyle birlikte ejderha vitrininin önündeki bir kesit sahnesine isinlanir.

english: The dragons of Gielinor are a most confusing species. Standing at approximately twelve feet tall, these imposing predators strike fear into the hearts and minds of most sane folk.
translation: Gielinor ejderhalari en kafa karistirici türlerden biridir. Yaklasik 3,6 metre boyunda olan bu heybetli avcilar, cogu akli basinda insanin kalbine ve zihnine korku salar.

english: The natural historian poses as a dragon...
translation: Doga tarihcisi bir ejderha gibi davranir...

english: However, if you delve a little deeper into their history and lifestyle, a few things stick out as very unusual.
translation: Ancak, tarihlerine ve yasam tarzlarina biraz daha derinlemesine bakildiginda, birkac sey cok sira disi olarak göze carpar.

english: With most species there is a line, an ancestry if you will, whereby you can track how a creature has come to be in its present form.
translation: Cogu türde, bir yaratigin nasil bugünkü haline geldigini izleyebileceginiz bir cizgi, bir soy vardir.

english: For instance, you can trace the ancestry of the common house cat back to the same creature that became the sabre-toothed kyatt.
translation: Örnegin, siradan ev kedisinin soyunu, kilic disli kyatt'a dönüsen ayni yaratiga kadar izleyebilirsiniz.

english: However, with the dragon, no such root ancestor can be found.
translation: Ancak ejderhalarda böyle bir kök ataya rastlanmaz.

english: There are many forms of dragon, such as the common coloured and the metallic, or ferrous, dragon.
translation: Ejderhalarin bircok türü vardir, örnegin siradan renkli ejderhalar ve metalik veya demir ejderhalar.

english: They colonise many areas of Gielinor, though most notably, sites of ancient battles and small dank caves.
translation: Gielinor'un bircok bölgesinde koloniler kurarlar, ancak en cok eski savas alanlarinda ve kücük nemli magaralarda görülürler.

english: Eating habits tend to vary, with the majority of their food being meat. However, it has also been noted that they can consume metals just as easily, with runite being thought of as a delicacy.
translation: Beslenme aliskanliklari degisiklik gösterir, ancak besinlerinin cogu etten olusur. Ancak, metalleri de ayni kolaylikla tüketebildikleri ve runitin bir lezzet olarak kabul edildigi de bilinmektedir.

english: Throughout history, dragons have appeared in myth and legend as fearsome adversaries and cunning creatures.
translation: Tarih boyunca ejderhalar, mit ve efsanelerde korkunc düsmanlar ve kurnaz yaratiklar olarak yer almistir.

english: However, modern evidence does not support this. Most young dragons are largely creatures of instinct with a strong vicious streak.
translation: Ancak, modern kanitlar bunu desteklememektedir. Cogu genc ejderha, büyük ölcüde icgüdüsel ve siddet egilimli yaratiklardir.

english: The lifespan of the common dragon is as yet unknown, as no dragon has ever been observed dying of old age.
translation: Siradan ejderhalarin ömrü henüz bilinmemektedir, cünkü hicbir ejderhanin yasliliktan öldügü gözlemlenmemistir.

english: Although, it has been mooted that spontaneous combustion could be considered a natural cause of death for this species.
translation: Bununla birlikte, kendiliginden yanmanin bu türün dogal ölüm nedeni olarak kabul edilebilecegi tartisilmistir.

english: And this concludes my short lecture on dragons. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: Ve bu, ejderhalar hakkindaki kisa dersimi sonlandiriyor. Umarim keyif almissinizdir.

english: Tell me about the wyverns.
Ahh, wyverns. The extinct lizards.
The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the wyvern display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolgirl.
translation: Oyuncu ve doga tarihcisi, bir ögretmen, ögrenci ve kiz ögrencinin bulundugu wyvern vitrininin önündeki bir kesit sahnesine isinlanir.

english: The wyverns' tale is a sad one. This now extinct species is presumed in some way to be related to the dragon.
translation: Wyvernlerin hikayesi üzücü bir hikaye. Bu soyu tükenmis türün ejderhalarla bir sekilde iliskili oldugu düsünülmektedir.

english: The natural historian poses as a wyvern...
In that they are both large flying reptiles. The wyvern stands much shorter than the adult dragon and only has two legs as opposed to the dragon's four.
translation: Her ikisi de büyük ucan sürüngenler olduklari icin. Wyvern, yetiskin ejderhalardan cok daha kisadir ve ejderhalarin dört bacagina karsilik sadece iki bacagi vardir.

english: Much of the evidence for wyvern behaviour comes from the reconstruction of old bones in the icy mountains of Asgarnia.
translation: Wyvernlerin davranislarina dair kanitlarin cogu, Asgarnia'nin buzlu daglarinda bulunan eski kemiklerin yeniden yapilandirilmasindan elde edilmistir.

english: One is that Asgarnia was at one time a much more temperate climate than it is now. The other is that wyverns could generate fire internally in much the same way as dragons.
translation: Bunlardan biri, Asgarnia'nin bir zamanlar simdikinden cok daha iliman bir iklime sahip oldugudur. Digeri ise, wyvernlerin ejderhalar gibi iclerinde ates üretebildikleridir.

english: If they follow the dragon paradigm, then they would have been carnivores, feeding on cows, sheep and other livestock animals.
translation: Ejderhalarin paradigmasini takip ederlerse, o zaman etoburlar olurlar ve inekler, koyunlar ve diger ciftlik hayvanlariyla beslenirlerdi.

english: How and why the wyverns became extinct is something of a mystery. Though if you consider the theory that the climate of Asgarnia changed suddenly, then this could provide an explanation.
translation: Wyvernlerin nasil ve neden nesli tükendigi bir gizemdir. Ancak Asgarnia'nin ikliminin aniden degistigi teorisini dikkate alirsaniz, bu bir aciklama saglayabilir.

english: There are some inconsistencies in the findings we have for the wyverns, such as the odd wear patterns of some of bones, which really could only have happened after the creature died.
translation: Wyvernlerle ilgili bulgularimizda bazi tutarsizliklar vardir, örnegin bazi kemiklerin tuhaf asinma izleri, bu da ancak yaratik öldükten sonra gerceklesebilirdi.

english: Also the bones we have collected remain a little below room temperature wherever they are kept.
translation: Ayrica topladigimiz kemikler, nerede saklanirsa saklansin oda sicakliginin biraz altinda kalir.

english: They have also been shown to radiate a very weak magical aura.
translation: Ayrica cok zayif bir büyülü aura yaydiklari da görülmüstür.

english: I'm sure that in due time, these mysteries will be solved.
translation: Eminim ki zamani geldiginde bu gizemler cözülecektir.

english: And this concludes my short lecture on wyverns. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: Wyvernler hakkindaki kisa dersim burada sona eriyor. Umarim keyif almissinizdir.

english: That's enough education for one day.
Nonsense! There's always room for more.
translation: Sacma! Her zaman daha fazlasi icin yer vardir.

english: And remember, science isn't dull!
Tell me about snails.
Ahh snails, the gelatinous gastropods.
The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the snail display case with a schoolboy and schoolgirl.
translation: Oyuncu ve doga tarihcisi, bir erkek ve bir kiz ögrencinin bulundugu salyangoz vitrininin önündeki bir kesit sahnesine isinlanir.

english: Snails move like worms by squishing up and stretching out, very, very slowly. They also make a lot of slime, in order to aid moving by reducing friction.
translation: Salyangozlar, solucanlar gibi cok yavas bir sekilde sikisip gerilerek hareket ederler. Ayrica sürtünmeyi azaltarak hareket etmelerine yardimci olmak icin cok fazla sümük üretirler.

english: The natural historian poses as a snail...
translation: Dogal tarihci salyangoz gibi poz verir...

english: They also use slime for protection. For instance, snails can use their slime to crawl over razor-blades without being hurt. It also helps keep away dangerous insects like ants.
translation: Ayrica sümügü korunmak icin de kullanirlar. Örnegin, salyangozlar sümüklerini kullanarak jiletlerin üzerinden zarar görmeden gecebilirler. Ayrica karincalar gibi tehlikeli böcekleri uzak tutmaya da yardimci olur.

english: When they hide in their shells, snails secrete a special type of slime, which dries to cover the entrance of their shells like a 'trapdoor'. This is called an operculum.
translation: Kabuklarina saklandiklarinda, salyangozlar özel bir tür sümük salgilarlar ve bu sümük kuruyarak kabuklarinin girisini bir “kapak” gibi kapatir. Buna operculum denir.

english: The snails of Morytania are the most malignant molluscs ever to have been studied.
translation: Morytania salyangozlari, simdiye kadar incelenen en kötü huylu yumusakcalardir.

english: They are broken down into two distinct species: achatina acidia and achatina acidia giganteus or, as they are more commonly known, the acid-spitting snail and the giant acid-spitting snail.
translation: Iki farkli türe ayrilirlar: achatina acidia ve achatina acidia giganteus veya daha yaygin olarak bilinen adlariyla asit tüküren salyangoz ve dev asit tüküren salyangoz.

english: Both of these varieties are voracious carnivores, using their mutated mouthpieces to spit a glob of powerful acid to kill their foe.
translation: Bu iki tür de obur etoburlardir ve mutasyona ugramis agiz parcalarini kullanarak güclü bir asit topu tükürerek düsmanlarini öldürürler.

english: They then simply have to wait, whilst the digestive juices make short work of the poor creature. Then, they simply slurp up what remains.
translation: Ardindan, sindirim sivilari zavalli yaratigi kisa sürede parcalarken, onlar sadece beklerler. Sonra da geriye kalanlari yutarlar.

english: How these strange creatures came to be is still something of a mystery. The most prevalent theory suggests that they mutated, as a reaction to an 'as yet unknown' pollutant that has appeared in the swamps.
translation: Bu garip yaratiklarin nasil ortaya ciktigi hala bir gizemdir. En yaygin teori, batakliklarda ortaya cikan ‘henüz bilinmeyen’ bir kirleticiye tepki olarak mutasyona ugradiklarini öne sürmektedir.

english: The local populace has capitalised on the appearance of these strange species, using their shells to fashion a rudimentary helm that is fairly resistant to the snails acid.
translation: Yerel halk, bu garip türlerin ortaya cikisindan yararlanarak, kabuklarini salyangoz asidine oldukca dayanikli basit bir migfer yapmak icin kullanmaktadir.

english: Other known uses of snail by-products include a tasty local delicacy and a fireproof oil.
translation: Salyangoz yan ürünlerinin diger bilinen kullanim alanlari arasinda lezzetli bir yerel lezzet ve yanmaz yag bulunmaktadir.

english: And this concludes my short lecture on snails. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: Ve bu, salyangozlar hakkindaki kisa dersimi sonlandiriyor. Umarim keyif almissinizdir.

english: Tell me about monkeys.
Ahh monkeys, the simian collective.
The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the monkey display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolboy.
translation: Oyuncu ve doga tarihcisi, bir ögretmen, ögrenci ve okul cocugu ile birlikte maymun vitrininin önündeki bir kesit sahnesine isinlanir.

english: A monkey is a member of either of two known groupings of simian primates. These two known groupings are the Karamja monkeys and the 'harmless' monkeys.
translation: Maymun, simian primatlarinin bilinen iki grubundan birine aittir. Bu iki grup, Karamja maymunlari ve “zararsiz” maymunlardir.

english: The natural historian poses as a monkey...
Because of their similarity to monkeys, apes such as chimpanzees and gibbons are often called monkeys by accident.
translation: Maymunlara benzerlikleri nedeniyle, sempanzeler ve gibonlar gibi maymunlar genellikle yanlislikla maymun olarak adlandirilir.

english: Though some natural historians don't consider them to be monkeys. Also, a few monkey species have the word 'ape' in their common name.
translation: Ancak bazi dogal tarihciler onlari maymun olarak kabul etmez. Ayrica, birkac maymun türünün ortak adinda “maymun” kelimesi gecmektedir.

english: The Karamja monkeys are rumoured to be fairly cunning and intelligent creatures, although rumours that they have learned human speech is anecdotal at best.
translation: Karamja maymunlarinin oldukca kurnaz ve zeki yaratiklar oldugu söylenir, ancak insan dilini ögrendiklerine dair söylentiler en iyi ihtimalle anekdot niteligindedir.

english: In appearance, they stand much shorter than a human and tend to move in a hunched fashion. Karamja monkeys also sport a red mohawk, though it is unknown whether this is an affectation or not.
translation: Görünüs olarak, insanlardan cok daha kisadirlar ve kambur bir sekilde hareket etme egilimindedirler. Karamja maymunlari ayrica kirmizi bir mohawk sac stiline sahiptir, ancak bunun bir gösteris olup olmadigi bilinmemektedir.

english: They are very fond of bananas and bitternuts, eating them in huge quantities whenever they can get their paws on them.
translation: Muz ve bitter findigi cok severler ve ellerine gecirdikleri anda büyük miktarlarda yerler.

english: The harmless monkeys of Mos Le'Harmless are a very similar, but in some ways entirely different, breed. They stand roughly the same size but are a lighter colour.
translation: Mos Le'Harmless'in zararsiz maymunlari cok benzer, ancak bazi yönlerden tamamen farkli bir türdür. Boylari yaklasik olarak aynidir, ancak renkleri daha aciktir.

english: Interestingly, Karamaja monkeys have a deep dislike of seaweed, though this may stem from the actions of a number of irresponsible people.
translation: Ilginc bir sekilde, Karamaja maymunlari deniz yosununu cok sevmezler, ancak bu, bir dizi sorumsuz insanin eylemlerinden kaynaklaniyor olabilir.

english: And this concludes my short lecture on monkeys. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: Maymunlar hakkindaki kisa dersim burada sona eriyor. Umarim keyif almissinizdir.

english: Tell me about the sea slugs.
Ahh sea slugs, the cute crustaceans.
The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the sea slug display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolgirl.
translation: Oyuncu ve doga tarihcisi, bir ögretmen, ögrenci ve kiz ögrencinin bulundugu deniz salyangozu vitrininin önündeki bir kesit sahnesine isinlanir.

english: The term 'sea slug' is something of a misnomer. Whilst these small creatures have a soft body like that of a slug, they also possess a very hard shell like a snail.
translation: “Deniz salyangozu” terimi biraz yanlis bir isimdir. Bu kücük yaratiklar salyangoz gibi yumusak bir vücuda sahip olmakla birlikte, salyangoz gibi cok sert bir kabuklari da vardir.

english: The natural historian poses as a sea slug...
translation: Dogal tarihci deniz salyangozu gibi poz verir...

english: Very little is actually known about the sea slug, as we have, as yet, been unable to procure a sample for observation and study.
translation: Deniz salyangozu hakkinda cok az sey bilinmektedir, cünkü henüz gözlem ve arastirma icin bir örnek elde edemedik.

english: For some reason all expeditions we have sent have either vanished mysteriously, or those on the expedition have sent letters back announcing their desire to leave the Museum and go on to other things.
translation: Nedense, gönderdigimiz tüm kesif ekipleri ya gizemli bir sekilde ortadan kayboldu ya da kesif ekibindeki kisiler müzeden ayrilip baska islere yönelmek istediklerini belirten mektuplar gönderdi.

english: It is presumed that the species is native to the very deep waters around the eastern Ardougne coastline.
translation: Bu türün, Ardougne'nin dogu kiyi seridindeki cok derin sularda yasadigi tahmin edilmektedir.

english: There must be some natural resource in the area that the sea slugs are using, as the underwater habitat there is much the same around many coastal areas on Gielinor.
translation: Gielinor'daki bircok kiyi bölgesinde su alti habitati hemen hemen ayni oldugundan, deniz salyangozlarinin kullandigi bazi dogal kaynaklar bu bölgede bulunmalidir.

english: Through looking at similar species we have determined that the sea slug is a harmless little creature. It spends much of its life grazing on seaweed and other plant life.
translation: Benzer türleri inceleyerek, deniz salyangozunun zararsiz kücük bir canli oldugunu belirledik. Hayatinin cogunu deniz yosunu ve diger bitkilerle beslenerek gecirir.

english: There are reports that these reclusive animals have two large fangs at their front, though this is assumed to be either for decorative or defensive purposes.
translation: Bu cekingen hayvanlarin önlerinde iki büyük dis oldugu bildirilmistir, ancak bunlarin dekoratif veya savunma amacli oldugu düsünülmektedir.

english: If they do follow the same pattern as other similar creatures, the shell will be nigh on impervious to most attacks. The exposed soft skin may have a number of nematocysts, or stinging organs, similar to jellyfish.
translation: Diger benzer canlilarla ayni modeli izliyorlarsa, kabuklari cogu saldiriya karsi neredeyse dayanikli olacaktir. Acikta kalan yumusak derilerinde, denizanasina benzer bir dizi nematosist veya igneli organ bulunabilir.

english: It is typical of prey animals such as these to develop some kind of unique defence mechanism that allows them to survive.
translation: Bu tür av hayvanlarinin hayatta kalmalarini saglayan benzersiz bir savunma mekanizmasi gelistirmeleri tipiktir.

english: If only we could acquire one for study. I'm sure we would find this mechanism to be truly unique.
translation: Keske bir tanesini arastirma icin elde edebilsek. Eminim bu mekanizmanin gercekten benzersiz oldugunu görecegiz.

english: And this concludes my short lecture on sea slugs. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: Deniz salyangozlari hakkindaki kisa dersim burada sona eriyor. Umarim keyif almissinizdir.

english: Tell me about snakes.
Ahh snakes, the slithering squamata.
The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the snake display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolgirl.
translation: Oyuncu ve doga tarihcisi, bir ögretmen, ögrenci ve kiz ögrencinin bulundugu yilan vitrininin önündeki bir kesit sahnesine isinlanir.

english: Serpentes, or ophidia, is the suborder under squamata that snakes belong to, like a big family.
translation: Serpentes veya ophidia, yilanlarin ait oldugu squamata alt takiminin büyük bir ailesi gibidir.

english: The natural historian poses as a snake...
Unlike lizards, snakes have no limbs whatsoever; not that this limits them. Snakes live in or near every habitat in the world.
translation: Kertenkelelerden farkli olarak, yilanlarin hic uzuvlari yoktur; ancak bu onlari sinirlamaz. Yilanlar dünyadaki her habitatin icinde veya yakininda yasar.

english: Found in nice tropical forests, temperate lattitudes and even in the ocean - some have adapted specialised stomach juices that they inject into their prey as venom, while others prefer to grab and crush their food.
translation: Güzel tropikal ormanlarda, iliman enlemlerde ve hatta okyanusta bulunurlar - bazilari avlarina zehir olarak enjekte ettikleri özel mide sivilarina adapte olmusken, digerleri avlarini yakalayip ezmeyi tercih eder.

english: While others still are fast hunters who use speed and strength to overcome their prey.
translation: Digerleri ise hiz ve güclerini kullanarak avlarini alt eden hizli avcilardir.

english: The sense of smell in snakes has been enhanced in an amazing way. With most animals, like you and me, tiny particles are filtered through the nose.
translation: Yilanlarin koku alma duyusu inanilmaz bir sekilde gelismistir. Sizin ve benim gibi cogu hayvanlarda, kücük parcaciklar burun tarafindan filtrelenir.

english: However, instead of using just their nose, these animals use their tongues as well. When a lizard or a snake wants to smell it's surroundings, it will wave its tongue around and pick up the particles in the air.
translation: Ancak bu hayvanlar sadece burunlarini degil, dillerini de kullanirlar. Bir kertenkele veya yilan cevresini koklamak istediginde, dilini sallayarak havadaki parcaciklari toplar.

english: The tongue then returns to the mouth and the tips of the tongue are pushed up against two tiny pits in the roof of the snake's mouth.
translation: Dil daha sonra agza geri döner ve dilin uclari yilanin agzinin tavanindaki iki kücük cukura bastirilir.

english: Since these pits are split apart from each other, the tongue itself also has to split. This is why snakes have forked tongues.
translation: Bu cukurlar birbirinden ayrik oldugundan, dilin kendisi de ayrilmak zorundadir. Bu nedenle yilanlarin dilleri catallidir.

english: So the next time you see a snake sticking it's tongue out at you, remember, it's sniffing the air, not trying to bite you.
translation: Bir dahaki sefere bir yilanin size dilini cikardigini gördügünüzde, onun sizi isirmaya calismadigini, havayi kokladigini unutmayin.

english: And this concludes my short lecture on snakes. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: Ve bu da yilanlar hakkindaki kisa dersimi sonlandiriyor. Umarim keyif almissinizdir.

english: Tell me about natural history.
translation: Bana doga tarihi hakkinda bilgi verin.

english: Well, the field of natural history covers a wide range of sciences.
translation: Dogal tarih alani cok genis bir bilim yelpazesini kapsar.

english: So we use biology, the study of living things, botany, the study of plants and zoology, the study of animals.
translation: Bu nedenle biyolojiyi, yani canlilari inceleyen bilimi, botanik, yani bitkileri inceleyen bilimi ve zoolojiyi, yani hayvanlari inceleyen bilimi kullaniriz.

english: Though the field is growing all the time and we're also using techniques from magic, astrology and numerology.
translation: Bu alan sürekli gelismektedir ve biz de büyü, astroloji ve numeroloji tekniklerini kullaniyoruz.

english: A person interested in natural history is known as a naturalist.
translation: Dogal tarihle ilgilenen kisiye doga bilimci denir.

english: Tell me about the terrorbirds.
Ahh terrorbirds, the fastest bird on two legs.
translation: Ahh terör kuslari, iki ayak üzerinde en hizli kuslar.

english: The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the terrorbird display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolgirl.
translation: Oyuncu ve dogal tarihci, bir ögretmen, ögrenci ve kiz ögrencinin bulundugu terör kusu vitrininin önündeki bir kesit sahnesine isinlanir.

english: Terrorbirds live in nomadic groups of between five and fifty birds that often travel together with other grazing animals.
translation: Terör kuslari, genellikle diger otlayan hayvanlarla birlikte seyahat eden bes ila elli kusluk göcebe gruplar halinde yasar.

english: The natural historian poses as a terrorbird...
translation: Dogal tarihci bir terör kusu gibi davranir...

english: They mainly feed on seeds and other plants. They also eat insects such as locusts if they can catch them.
translation: Terör kuslari cogunlukla tohumlar ve diger bitkilerle beslenir. Yakalayabilirlerse cekirge gibi böcekleri de yerler.

english: They have no teeth to chew with, so they swallow pebbles that help to grind the swallowed foods in the gizzard.
translation: Cignemek icin disleri olmadigi icin, yuttuklari yiyecekleri taslikta ögütmeye yardimci olan cakil taslarini yutarlar.

english: They can go without water for a long time, exclusively living off the water in the plants. However, they enjoy water and frequently take baths when they can.
translation: Bitkilerdeki suyla beslenerek uzun süre susuz kalabilirler. Ancak suyu severler ve firsat buldukca sik sik banyo yaparlar.

english: Terrorbirds are known to eat almost anything, particularly in captivity, where opportunity is increased.
translation: Terör kuslarinin, özellikle firsatlarin daha fazla oldugu esaret altinda, neredeyse her seyi yedikleri bilinmektedir.

english: Terrorbirds usually weigh a little less than a small unicorn. The feathers of adult males are mostly green, with some white on the wings and tail.
translation: Terör kuslari genellikle kücük bir tek boynuzlu attan biraz daha hafiftir. Yetiskin erkeklerin tüyleri cogunlukla yesil renktedir, kanatlarinda ve kuyruklarinda biraz beyaz vardir.

english: There are claws on two of the wings' fingers and their strong legs have no feathers. The bird stands on two toes, with the bigger one resembling a hoof. Its feet have no claws.
translation: Kanatlarinin iki parmaginda penceler vardir ve güclü bacaklarinda tüy yoktur. Kus, iki parmagi üzerinde durur, büyük olani toynak gibidir. Ayaklarinda pence yoktur.

english: This is an adaptation unique to terrorbirds that appears to aid in running. Their legs are powerful enough to kill even large animals.
translation: Bu, terör kuslarina özgü bir adaptasyondur ve kosmaya yardimci oldugu görülmektedir. Bacaklari, büyük hayvanlari bile öldürebilecek kadar güclüdür.

english: The gnomes in particular, prize the terrorbird for its fast running speed, using them as mounts whenever possible.
translation: Özellikle cüceler, terör kuslarini hizli kosma hizlari nedeniyle cok degerlidir ve mümkün oldugunca onlari binek olarak kullanirlar.

english: There are a number of recorded incidents of people being attacked and killed. Big males can be very territorial and aggressive, and can attack and kick very powerfully with their legs.
translation: Insanlarin saldiriya ugradigi ve öldürüldügü bircok olay kaydedilmistir. Büyük erkekler cok bölgesel ve agresif olabilirler ve bacaklariyla cok güclü bir sekilde saldirip tekme atabilirler.

english: A terrorbird is so fast, it can easily outrun any human athlete.
translation: Terör kusu o kadar hizlidir ki, herhangi bir insan atleti kolayca gecebilir.

english: And this concludes my short lecture on terrorbirds. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: Ve bu, terör kuslari hakkindaki kisa dersimi sonlandiriyor. Umarim keyif almissinizdir.

english: Tell me about the Kalphite Queen.
Ahh kalphites, the insectoid eating machines.
The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the Kalphite Queen display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolgirl.
translation: Oyuncu ve doga tarihcisi, bir ögretmen, ögrenci ve kiz ögrenci ile birlikte Kalphite Kralicesi vitrininin önündeki bir kesit sahnesine isinlanir.

english: The kalphites, otherwise known as the kalphiscarabeinae, are perhaps the largest species of insect on the face of Gielinor. Their queen is called kalphiscarabeinae pasha.
translation: Kalphiscarabeinae olarak da bilinen kalphitler, Gielinor'daki belki de en büyük böcek türüdür. Kralicelerinin adi kalphiscarabeinae pasha'dir.

english: The natural historian poses as the Kalphite Queen...
translation: Dogal tarihci, Kalphite Kralicesi rolünü oynar...

english: Most of the early documentation and research on this fearsome predatory species was performed by the noted bug hunter Iqbar Ali-Abdula.
translation: Bu korkunc yirtici türle ilgili ilk belgeler ve arastirmalarin cogu, ünlü böcek avcisi Iqbar Ali-Abdula tarafindan yapilmistir.

english: This, of course, was before he was driven insane by his research and ran off into the desert, screaming.
translation: Tabii ki bu, arastirmalari yüzünden deliye dönüp ciglik atarak cöle kacmadan önceydi.

english: Kalphites are related to beetles and scorpions; they are mainly green in colour. Some have remarkable antennae which can detect the slightest movement. Their carapace is composed of armoured plates called lamellae.
translation: Kalphitler, böcekler ve akreplerle akraba olup, cogunlukla yesil renklidirler. Bazilari en ufak hareketi bile algilayabilen olaganüstü antenlere sahiptir. Kabuklari, lamellae adi verilen zirhli plakalardan olusur.

english: This shell can be compressed into a ball or fanned out like leaves, in order to sense odours. The front legs are adapted for digging the enormous tunnel systems that serve as their nests.
translation: Bu kabuk, kokulari algilamak icin top seklinde sikistirilabilir veya yapraklar gibi acilabilir. Ön bacaklari, yuvalari olarak kullandiklari devasa tünel sistemlerini kazmak icin uyarlanmistir.

english: They exist in a caste-based society, with the soft shelled larvae at the bottom, up through the workers, soldiers and finally the queen.
translation: Kast temelli bir toplumda yasarlar; en altta yumusak kabuklu larvalar, ortada isciler, askerler ve en üstte kralice bulunur.

english: Voracious carnivores, a pack of adult workers can strip the flesh from a full grown camel in a matter of seconds, leaving nothing but a few bones and strips of fur for other scavengers to pick over.
translation: Vahsi etoburlar olan yetiskin isciler, birkac saniye icinde yetiskin bir devenin etini siyirip, diger les yiyicilerin toplamasi icin sadece birkac kemik ve kürk parcasi birakabilirler.

english: They typically live in large nests marked by the rock hard pillars found in hot, arid deserts, such as the one south-west of Al Kharid, which rise out of the sands like the tombs of desert pharaohs.
translation: Genellikle, Al Kharid'in güneybatisindaki gibi sicak ve kurak cöllerde bulunan, cöl firavunlarinin mezarlari gibi kumlardan yükselen kaya gibi sert sütunlarla isaretlenmis büyük yuvalarda yasarlar.

english: Indeed, there is some relationship between the Kalphite Queen and the desert god Scabaras, but no one is really sure what.
translation: Gercekten de, Kalphite Kralicesi ile cöl tanrisi Scabaras arasinda bir iliski vardir, ancak kimse bunun ne oldugunu tam olarak bilmiyor.

english: During the early part of the fourth age, Scabaras proclaimed himself omnipotent and outlawed worship of all other gods save him.
translation: Dördüncü cagin baslarinda, Scabaras kendini her seye kadir ilan etti ve kendisi disinda tüm tanrilarin ibadetini yasakladi.

english: When the people eventually revolted against his repressive rule and banished Scabaras, it is said his blood washed over the scarabs and transformed them into the kalphites we know today.
translation: Halk sonunda onun baskici yönetimine karsi ayaklandi ve Scabaras'i sürgüne gönderdiginde, kaninin bok böceklerini yikadigi ve onlari bugün bildigimiz kalphitlere dönüstürdügü söylenir.

english: Of course, any right-minded scientist discounts these myths as mere stories, with no historical basis in fact.
translation: Elbette, akli basinda herhangi bir bilim adami bu mitleri, tarihsel temeli olmayan basit hikayeler olarak görmezden gelir.

english: And this concludes my short lecture on kalphites. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: Kalfitler hakkindaki kisa dersim burada sona eriyor. Umarim keyifli vakit gecirmissinizdir.

english: Tell me about camels.
Ahh camels, the ships of the desert.
The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the camel display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolgirl.
translation: Oyuncu ve doga tarihcisi, bir ögretmen, ögrenci ve kiz ögrencinin bulundugu deve vitrininin önündeki bir kesit sahnesine isinlanir.

english: The term camel refers to either of the two known species of camelid.
translation: Deve terimi, bilinen iki deve türünden herhangi birini ifade eder.

english: The natural historian poses as a camel...
translation: Doga tarihcisi bir deve gibi poz verir...

english: There is the bactrian, which has two humps and can be found throughout Al Kharid. It also refers to the Ugthanki, or one-humped camel.
translation: Iki hörgüclü ve Al Kharid'in her yerinde bulunan baktriya deve vardir. Ayrica Ugthanki veya tek hörgüclü deve de bu terimle ifade edilir.

english: Camels are ill-tempered beasts at the best of times, requiring a great deal of time and effort to tame.
translation: Develer en iyi zamanlarinda bile huysuz hayvanlardir ve evcillestirmek icin cok zaman ve caba gerektirir.

english: This would explain why used camel salesmen are in such a hurry to be rid of them.
translation: Bu, kullanilmis deve saticilarinin onlardan kurtulmak icin neden bu kadar acele ettiklerini acikliyor.

english: In the wild, camels have been known to lie in wait and ambush hapless travellers, before devouring them.
translation: Wildernessda, develerin talihsiz yolculari pusuya düsürüp yedikleri bilinmektedir.

english: This is quite surprising, as most domestic camels are happy eating nothing but vegetables.
translation: Bu oldukca sasirticidir, cünkü cogu evcil deve sadece sebze yemekten mutludur.

english: Camel milk is much more nutritious than cow milk and goes well in the strong desert drink akin to tea.
translation: Deve sütü, inek sütünden cok daha besleyicidir ve caya benzeyen güclü cöl icecegiyle iyi gider.

english: Another useful camel by-product is dung. Their dung is very dry, due to the highly efficient metabolism of the camel.
translation: Develerin bir baska yararli yan ürünü de gübresidir. Develerin metabolizmasi cok verimli oldugu icin gübreleri cok kurudur.

english: Scientific research has also shown that chilli has a disastrous effect on a camel's digestive system, which produces toxic dung.
translation: Bilimsel arastirmalar, aci biberin develerin sindirim sistemi üzerinde felaket etkisi yarattigini ve zehirli gübre ürettigini göstermistir.

english: And this concludes my short lecture on camels. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: Develerle ilgili kisa dersim burada sona eriyor. Umarim keyif almissinizdir.

english: Tell me about leeches.
Ahh leeches, the haemophagic parasites.
The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the leech display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolgirl.
translation: Oyuncu ve doga tarihcisi, bir ögretmen, ögrenci ve kiz ögrencinin bulundugu sülük vitrininin önündeki bir kesit sahnesine isinlanir.

english: Leeches are fascinating creatures and are very similar to worms in most respects.
translation: Sülükler büyüleyici yaratiklardir ve cogu acidan solucanlara cok benzerler.

english: The natural historian poses as a leech...
translation: Dogal tarihci bir sülük gibi davranir...

english: They like to inhabit streams, rivers and seas, but their preference is for stagnant pools of water.
translation: Akarsularda, nehirlerde ve denizlerde yasamayi severler, ancak durgun su birikintilerini tercih ederler.

english: One of the most common misconceptions is that all leeches feed on blood.
translation: En yaygin yanilgilardan biri, tüm sülüklerin kanla beslendigidir.

english: Most leeches are meat eaters, feeding on a variety of invertebrates such as worms, snails, insect larvae and snails.
translation: Cogu sülük etoburdur ve solucanlar, salyangozlar, böcek larvalari ve salyangozlar gibi cesitli omurgasizlarla beslenir.

english: Those that do feed on blood have developed an amazing method of doing so. Firstly they latch onto the skin using a ring of tiny teeth, before injecting their prey with an anaesthetic.
translation: Kanla beslenenler ise bunu yapmak icin sasirtici bir yöntem gelistirmistir. Öncelikle, kücük dislerden olusan bir halka ile cilde tutunurlar, ardindan avlarina anestezik enjekte ederler.

english: Then they bite into the skin using a Y-shaped mouthpiece and introducing a chemical that stops the blood from clotting.
translation: Daha sonra Y seklindeki agizliklarini kullanarak cildi isirir ve kanin pihtilasmasini engelleyen bir kimyasal madde enjekte ederler.

english: They will then feed until they are completely full, sometimes doubling in size!
translation: Ardindan tamamen doyana kadar beslenirler ve bazen boyutlari iki katina cikar!

english: Most leeches are very small, measuring no more than the length of your middle finger. An exception to these are the leeches of Morytania, which can reach the size of a dog.
translation: Cogu sülük cok kücüktür, orta parmaginizin uzunlugundan daha büyük degildir. Bunlarin istisnasi, bir köpek büyüklügüne ulasabilen Morytania sülükleridir.

english: They are much more mobile than their smaller cousins and are able to jump rather high when attacking.
translation: Bunlar, daha kücük akrabalarina göre cok daha hareketlidir ve saldirirken oldukca yüksege ziplayabilirler.

english: Quite how these leeches came to be so big is something of a mystery.
translation: Bu sülüklerin nasil bu kadar büyüdügü bir gizemdir.

english: All we can assume is that there is some kind of environmental influence, which has governed their immense growth.
translation: Tek tahmin edebilecegimiz, onlarin muazzam büyümesini etkileyen bir tür cevresel etkenin oldugu.

english: And this concludes my short lecture on leeches. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
