translation: Ve bu da sülükler hakkindaki kisa dersimi sonlandiriyor. Umarim keyif almissinizdir.

english: Tell me about moles.
Ahh moles, the mammalian mountain makers.
The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the mole display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolgirl.
translation: Oyuncu ve doga tarihcisi, bir ögretmen, ögrenci ve kiz ögrencinin bulundugu köstebek vitrininin önündeki bir kesit sahnesine isinlanir.

english: Now, moles are small mammals of the talpidae family. These subterranean burrowers mainly live on a diet of slugs, snails and insects.
translation: Köstebekler, talpidae familyasina ait kücük memelilerdir. Bu yeralti kazicilari, cogunlukla sümüklü böcekler, salyangozlar ve böceklerle beslenir.

english: The natural historian poses as a mole...
translation: Dogal tarihci bir köstebek gibi davranir...

english: They vary greatly in habitat and can be found in almost every part of Gielinor. Some species have even known to be aquatic!
translation: Yasam alanlari büyük farkliliklar gösterir ve Gielinor'un hemen hemen her yerinde bulunurlar. Bazi türlerin suda yasadigi bile bilinmektedir!

english: Male moles are known as boars with the females called sows. Should you come across a group of moles, you would call them a labour.
translation: Erkek köstebekler domuz, disiler ise disi domuz olarak bilinir. Bir grup köstebekle karsilasirsaniz, onlara “isci” dersiniz.

english: Moles are considered to be an agricultural pest in most places, digging up the ground and leaving molehills all over the place.
translation: Köstebekler cogu yerde tarim zararlisi olarak kabul edilir, cünkü topragi kazip her yere köstebek yuvalari birakirlar.

english: This has been highlighted in Falador by Wyson the Gardener who, after using some Malignus Mortifer's Super Ultra Flora Growth Potion, managed to create Gielinor's only known species of giant mole.
translation: Bu durum Falador'da bahcivan Wyson tarafindan vurgulanmistir. Wyson, Malignus Mortifer'in Süper Ultra Flora Büyüme Iksiri'ni kullandiktan sonra, Gielinor'da bilinen tek dev köstebek türünü yaratmayi basarmistir.

english: This fearsome beast has huge claws, wicked teeth and a penchant for shiny objects. It is a very tough animal with a thick protective hide and an ill temperament.
translation: Bu korkunc canavar, devasa pencelere, keskin dislere ve parlak nesnelere karsi bir düskünlüge sahiptir. Kalin koruyucu derisi ve kötü mizaciyla cok dayanikli bir hayvandir.

english: That said, they do benefit the soil by aerating and tilling it, adding to its fertility. Contrary to popular belief, moles don't eat plant roots.
translation: Bununla birlikte, topragi havalandirip sürerek verimliligini artirarak topraga fayda saglarlar. Yaygin inanisin aksine, köstebekler bitki köklerini yemezler.

english: And this concludes my short lecture on moles. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: Köstebekler hakkindaki kisa dersim burada sona eriyor. Umarim keyif almissinizdir.

english: Tell me about penguins.
Ahh penguins, the cunning birds of the sea.
The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the penguin display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolgirl.
translation: Oyuncu ve doga tarihcisi, bir ögretmen, ögrenci ve kiz ögrencinin bulundugu penguen vitrininin önündeki bir kesit sahnesine isinlanir.

english: This often-maligned aquatic bird is known to be native to the ice fields of Etceteria, although they have been known to live as far as the fields of Lumbridge.
translation: Sik sik kötülenen bu su kusu, Etceteria'nin buz alanlarina özgü oldugu bilinmektedir, ancak Lumbridge'in tarlalarina kadar uzanan alanlarda da yasadiklari bilinmektedir.

english: The natural historian poses as a penguin...
These aquatic birds seem to spend the majority of their time eating and fostering their young.
translation: Bu su kuslari zamanlarinin cogunu yemek yiyerek ve yavrularini besleyerek geciriyor gibi görünüyor.

english: For creatures with such small brains, they do seem to have a disproportionate capacity for forward thinking and planning. As this serves no natural purpose, scholars are divided as to how this evolved.
translation: Bu kadar kücük beyinleri olan yaratiklar icin, ileriyi düsünme ve planlama konusunda orantisiz bir kapasiteye sahip görünüyorlar. Bunun dogal bir amaci olmadigi icin, bilim adamlari bunun nasil evrimlestigi konusunda fikir ayriligi icindedir.

english: Their diet consists mainly of fish, squid and a small shrimp-like creature called krill. However, some have developed a taste for the mushrooms that grow around fairy rings.
translation: Beslenmeleri cogunlukla balik, kalamar ve krill adi verilen kücük karides benzeri bir yaratiktan olusur. Ancak bazilari peri halkalari cevresinde yetisen mantarlara da ilgi duymaya baslamistir.

english: Penguins primarily rely on their vision while hunting. What we don't know is how penguins locate prey in the darkness, or at great depths.
translation: Penguenler avlanirken öncelikle görme duyularina güvenirler. Bilmedigimiz sey, penguenlerin karanlikta veya derin sularda avlarini nasil bulduklaridir.

english: Some theories suggest that penguins are helped by some sort of extra sensory perception; perhaps even precognition.
translation: Bazi teoriler, penguenlerin bir tür ekstra duyusal algi, hatta belki de önsezi gibi bir yetenekle yardim aldiklarini öne sürer.

english: Penguins spend a long time going without food when they are breeding. In fact, they won't even leave their nests if they can help it.
translation: Penguenler üreme döneminde uzun süre yemek yemeden gecirirler. Hatta, mümkünse yuvalarindan bile ayrilmazlar.

english: Fortunately, most penguins build up a layer of fat to keep them warm and provide energy until the moult is over.
translation: Neyse ki, cogu penguen tüy dökümü bitene kadar kendilerini sicak tutmak ve enerji saglamak icin bir yag tabakasi olusturur.

english: And this concludes my short lecture on penguins. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: Ve bu da penguenler hakkindaki kisa dersimi sonlandiriyor. Umarim keyif almissinizdir.

english: Hmm, I'm afraid I don't allow pets in my lectures, the demonstrations can scare them.
translation: Hmm, maalesef derslerimde evcil hayvanlara izin vermiyorum, gösteriler onlari korkutabilir.

english: Tell me about lizards.
Tell me about tortoises.
Tell me about dragons.
Tell me about wyverns.
That's enough education for one day.
Tell me about snails.
Tell me about monkeys.
Tell me about sea slugs.
Tell me about snakes.
Tell me about natural history.
Tell me about terrorbirds.
Tell me about the Kalphite Queen.
Tell me about camels.
Tell me about leeches.
Tell me about moles.
Tell me about penguins.
What is this place?
Speak to me again and I will rend the soul from your flesh.
translation: Bir daha benimle konusursan ruhunu bedeninden ayiririm.

english: Nobody speaks to me unless I speak to them!!!
I do not answer questions, mortal fool!!
I will answer questions when you are dead!!
You dare to speak to me??? Have you lost your wits????
translation: Bana konusmaya cüret mi ediyorsun??? Aklini mi kacirdin????

english: What happened to everyone here?
How do I get into the town?
Told you I'd defeat you, Necrovarus. My advice to you is to pass over to the next world yourself with everybody else.
translation: Seni yenecegimi söylemistim Necrovarus. Sana tavsiyem, digerleriyle birlikte öbür dünyaya gecmen.

english: I should fry you for what you have done...
Quiet, evil priest!! If you try anything I will command you again, but this time it will be throw yourself into the Endless Void for the rest of eternity.
translation: Sessiz ol, kötü rahip! Bir sey yapmaya kalkisirsan sana tekrar emir verecegim, ama bu sefer sonsuza kadar Sonsuz Bosluga atilacaksin.

english: Please no! I will do whatever you say!!
What is this place?
What happened to everyone here?
How do I get into the town?
Hello there! Looking to take advantage of the Mistrock mines? If so, I'm happy to buy any ores from you. I can also sell you some tools if needed.
translation: Merhaba! Mistrock madenlerinden yararlanmak mi istiyorsun? Öyleyse, senden herhangi bir cevher satin almaktan memnuniyet duyarim. Gerekirse sana bazi aletler de satabilirim.

english: Let's trade.
Great!
What can you tell me about this place?
translation: Bana bu yer hakkinda ne söyleyebilirsin?

english: Mistrock? It's a mining outpost. It was set up by Cam Torum after you humans went and had another of your wars. We lost some good mines and needed to find new ones.
translation: Mistrock mu? Burasi bir maden karakolu. Siz insanlar bir baska savasa girdikten sonra Cam Torum tarafindan kuruldu. Bazi iyi madenlerimizi kaybettik ve yenilerini bulmamiz gerekiyordu.

english: Why here?
It wasn't the first choice, but both humans and dwarves alike were pretty poor after the fighting ended, so we all had to learn lessons in how to compromise.
translation: Ilk tercihimiz degildi, ama savas bittikten sonra hem insanlar hem de cüceler oldukca fakirlesmisti, bu yüzden hepimiz uzlasma konusunda dersler cikarmak zorunda kaldik.

english: Still, it ended up not being too bad in the end. We found there was a reasonable supply of coal and iron here, along with some silver and gold.
translation: Yine de, sonucta o kadar da kötü olmadi. Burada makul miktarda kömür ve demir, ayrica biraz gümüs ve altin bulduk.

english: The location ended up being quite appealing for some as well. It makes for a nice change of scenery for those that appreciate that sort of thing.
translation: Konumu da bazilari icin oldukca cazipti. Bu tür seyleri sevenler icin hos bir degisiklik oldu.

english: So what was here before Mistrock?
translation: Peki Mistrock'tan önce burada ne vardi?

english: Nothing much of note. The land here was owned by the Moonrise Brewery and Winery, but they found it wasn't much good for growing grapes.
translation: Önemli bir sey yoktu. Bu arazi Moonrise Brewery and Winery'ye aitti, ama üzüm yetistirmek icin pek uygun olmadigini fark ettiler.

english: So they were happy to give it up?
translation: Yani burayi seve seve biraktilar mi?

english: Very happy. They saw an opportunity for a new business relationship. In return for giving us the land, we now give them favourable rates on what we mine here.
translation: Cok seve seve. Yeni bir is iliskisi icin bir firsat gördüler. Bize bu araziyi verdikleri karsiliginda, biz de burada cikardigimiz madenleri onlara uygun fiyatlarla satiyoruz.

english: Does a winery have much need for metal?
translation: Bir saraphanenin metale cok ihtiyaci olur mu?

english: Apparently so. I guess they use it to make and maintain all their fancy brewing and winemaking equipment.
translation: Görünüse göre öyle. Sanirim, tüm o süslü bira ve sarap üretim ekipmanlarini yapmak ve bakimini yapmak icin kullaniyorlar.

english: But anyway, enough about that. Are you interested in buying or selling some ores?
translation: Neyse, bu kadar yeter. Bazi cevherleri satin almak veya satmak ister misin?

english: I'm good, thanks.
Well you know where I am if you change your mind.
Let's trade.
What can you tell me about this place?
I'm good, thanks.
Hello again, [lad/lass]. Something I can help you with? Want to buy some rope perhaps?
translation: Merhaba . Yardimci olabilir miyim? Ip satin almak ister misin?

english: Well, I was a sailor. I've not been able to get work at sea these days, though. They say I'm too old.
translation: Eskiden denizciydim. Ama son zamanlarda denizde is bulamiyorum. Yasli oldugumu söylüyorlar.

english: Sorry, where was it you said you wanted to go?
To the island of Crandor.
Crandor?
But... It would be a chance to sail a ship once more. I'd sail anywhere if it was a chance to sail again.
translation: Ama... Bir kez daha gemi kullanma sansi olurdu. Tekrar denize acilma sansi olsaydi, nereye olursa olsun giderdim.

english: Then again, no captain in his right mind would sail to that island...
translation: Ama akli basinda hicbir kaptan o adaya gitmez...

english: Ah, you only live once! I'll do it!
translation: Ah, hayat bir kez yasanir! Yapacagim!

english: So, where's your ship?
It's the Lady Lumbridge, in Port Sarim.
That old pile of junk? Last I heard, she wasn't seaworthy.
translation: O eski hurda yigini mi? Son duydugumda denize elverisli degildi.

english: I fixed her up!
You did? Excellent!
Just show me the map and we can get ready to go!
translation: Bana haritayi göster, yola cikmaya hazirlanalim!

english: Here you go.
Excellent! I'll meet you at the ship, then.
Will you take me to Crandor now, then?
I said I would and old Ned is a man of his word! I'll meet you on board the Lady Lumbridge in Port Sarim.
translation: Götürecegimi söyledim ve yasli Ned sözünün eri bir adamdir! Port Sarim'deki Lady Lumbridge'de bulusuruz.

english: Ah, it's good to be on board a ship again! No matter how long I live on land, a ship will always seem better. Are you ready to depart?
translation: Ah, tekrar bir gemide olmak ne güzel! Karada ne kadar uzun yasarsam yasayayim, gemi her zaman daha iyi gelir. Kalkisa hazir misin?

english: Yes, let's go!
No, I'm not quite ready yet.
Well, you go do whatever you need to do. I'll wait here for you until you're ready.
translation: Sen git, ne yapman gerekiyorsa yap. Ben hazir olana kadar burada seni bekleyecegim.

english: Ah, it's good to feel the salt spray on my face once again!
translation: Ah, yüzüme tuzlu su sicramasini tekrar hissetmek ne güzel!

english: And this is a mighty fine ship. She don't look much, but she handles like a dream.
translation: Ve bu cok güzel bir gemi. Görünüsü pek iyi degil ama sürüsü rüya gibi.

english: How much longer until we reach Crandor?
Not long now! According to the chart, we'd be able to see Crandor if it wasn't for those clouds on the horizon.
translation: Cok az kaldi! Haritaya göre, ufuktaki bulutlar olmasaydi Crandor'u görebilirdik.

english: Clouds surround the ship.
Looks like there's a storm coming up, cap'n. Soon we won't be able to see anything!
translation: Firtina geliyor gibi görünüyor, kaptan. Yakinda hicbir sey göremeyecegiz!

english: Oh, well. The weather had been so good up until now.
translation: Oh, neyse. Simdiye kadar hava cok iyiydi.

english: Did you see that?
See what?
I thought I saw something up above us.
It's the dragon!
We're going to sink!
Look! Land ahead!
We're going to crash!
CRASH!
You are knocked unconscious and later awake on an ash-strewn beach.
translation: Bilincini kaybedersin ve daha sonra külle kapli bir kumsalda uyanirsin.

english: Now I see why all the other captains said I'd be mad to go near Crandor. It looks like we're stranded.
translation: Diger kaptanlarin Crandor'a yaklasmanin delilik oldugunu söylemelerinin nedenini simdi anliyorum. Görünüse göre mahsur kaldik.

english: Don't worry about that. I found a secret passage in the dragon's lair that leads off the island!
translation: Endiselenme. Ejderhanin ininde adadan cikmaya yarayan gizli bir gecit buldum!

english: Oh, that's good. I'll be able to get back to Draynor somehow,
translation: Oh, bu iyi. Bu adadaki tüm iskeletleri ve iblisleri atlatabilirsem,

english: if I can sneak past all the skeletons and demons on this island!
Hello again, lad. Something I can help you with? Want to buy some rope perhaps?
translation: Merhaba tekrar, delikanli. Yardimci olabilir miyim? Belki biraz ip almak istersin?

english: How did you get back from Crandor?
I got towed back by a passing friendly whale.
translation: Gecen dost canlisi bir balina beni geri cekti.

english: Anyway, would you like me to make some rope while you're here?
translation: Neyse, buradayken sana ip yapmami ister misin?

english: Can you take me back to Crandor again?
Aye, that I could. I'll meet you at the Port Sarim docks again. I'll try to steer a little better this time!
translation: Evet, götürebilirim. Port Sarim limaninda tekrar bulusuruz. Bu sefer biraz daha iyi dümen tutmaya calisacagim!

english: Why, hello there, [lad/lass]. Me friends call me Ned. I was a man of the sea, but it's past me now. Could I be making or selling you some rope?
translation: Merhaba, . Arkadaslarim bana Ned der. Eskiden denizciydim, ama artik o günler geride kaldi. Sana ip yapabilir miyim, yoksa satabilir miyim?

english: Yes, I would like some rope.
Well, I can sell you some rope for 15 coins. Or I can be making you some if you gets me 4 balls of wool. I strands them together I does, makes em strong.
translation: 15 sikke karsiliginda sana ip satabilirim. Ya da bana 4 top yün getirirsen sana ip yapabilirim. Ipleri birbirine baglayarak daha saglam hale getiriyorum.

english: You make rope from wool?
Of course you can!
I thought you needed hemp or jute.
Do you want some rope or not?
You don't have enough coins to buy any rope!
translation: Ip almak icin yeterli paran yok!

english: Okay, please sell me some rope.
There you go, finest rope in Gielinor.
translation: Al bakalim, Gielinor'un en kaliteli ipi.

english: You hand Ned 15 coins. Ned gives you a coil of rope.
translation: Ned'e 15 sikke veriyorsun. Ned sana bir bobin ip veriyor.

english: Thanks. Hmmm, do you know something? This rope has a funny smell.
translation: Tesekkürler. Hmmm, biliyor musun? Bu ip garip kokuyor.

english: Really?
Yes, It reminds me of...yaks. I was travelling in the Fremennik Isles recently and, do you know what? They made rope out of yak's hair.
translation: Evet, bana yaklari hatirlatiyor. Gecenlerde Fremennik Adalari'nda seyahat ediyordum ve biliyor musun? Orada yak kilindan ip yapiyorlar.

english: What a coincidence?
There was a lady over there who sold wool, she said she traded rope for the wool.
translation: Orada yün satan bir kadin vardi, yünü ip ile takas ettigini söyledi.

english: Who would have thought it?
I don't think you make rope at all. I think you trade balls of wool for rope.
translation: Bence sen ip yapmiyorsun. Yün yumaklarini ip ile takas ediyorsun.

english: Oh, I confess. You have found the truth. I used to make the rope myself, but my fingers aren't as nimble as they used to be and so many people wanted my rope. Demand was so high I had to find another
translation: Oh, itiraf ediyorum. Gercegi buldun. Eskiden ipi kendim yapardim, ama parmaklarim eskisi kadar cevik degil ve cok fazla kisi ipi istiyordu. Talep o kadar yüksekti ki baska bir kaynak bulmak zorunda kaldim.

english: source. But I couldn't tell anyone since Ned's Handmade Rope (100% Wool) is a high profile brand now.
translation: Ama Ned'in El Yapimi Halatlari (100% Yün) artik taninmis bir marka oldugu icin kimseye söyleyemedim.

english: Yes, well, the wool is still pretty good, though yak hair makes fine rope. I don't suppose any harm will come of it.
translation: Evet, yün hala oldukca iyi, ama yak kili da iyi halat yapar. Sanirim bundan bir zarar gelmez.

english: Thanks. Here take this, a free sample! Please, don't tell anyone.
translation: Tesekkürler. Al, bu ücretsiz bir numune! Lütfen kimseye söyleme.

english: Well, it's always good to keep on the good side of a sailor. Your secret is safe with me.
translation: Denizcilerin iyi tarafinda olmak her zaman iyidir. Sirrin bende güvende.

english: Oh, if you're in the Isles again, tell Jofridr that her Neddie will be there soon.
translation: Oh, tekrar Adalara gelirsen, Jofridr'a Neddie'nin yakinda orada olacagini söyle.

english: I will do that!
I have some balls of wool. Could you make me some rope?
translation: Biraz yünüm var. Bana ip yapabilir misin?

english: Sure I can.
You hand over 4 balls of wool. Ned gives you a coil of rope.
translation: 4 top yün verirsin. Ned sana bir rulo ip verir.

english: That's a little more than I want to pay.
Well, if you ever need rope that's the price. Sorry. An old sailor needs money for a little drop o' rum.
translation: Eger ipe ihtiyacin olursa, fiyati budur. Üzgünüm. Yasli bir denizci, biraz rom almak icin paraya ihtiyac duyar.

english: I will go and get some wool.
Aye, you do that. Remember, it takes 4 balls of wool to make strong rope.
translation: Evet, öyle yap. Unutma, saglam bir ip yapmak icin 4 top yün gerekir.

english: No thanks Ned, I don't need any.
Well, old Neddy is always here if you do. Tell your friends. I can always be using the business.
translation: Eger ihtiyacin olursa, yasli Neddy her zaman burada. Arkadaslarina söyle. Isime her zaman yarar.

english: Well done!
You've been given another clue!
Good work! I have new information to share with you. Listen carefully, now!
translation: Aferin! Seninle paylasacagim yeni bilgilerim var. Simdi dikkatlice dinle!

english: A place 65 steps forward and 17 to the right needs an inspection. The weather vane up high will guide you in the right direction.
translation: 65 adim ileri ve 17 adim saga bir yer inceleme gerektiriyor. Yukaridaki rüzgar gülü sana dogru yönü gösterecek.

english: Under the ground lies the next clue you seek. Getting it out requires a little technique.
translation: Aradigin bir sonraki ipucu yerin altinda. Onu cikarmak icin biraz teknik gerekiyor.

english: You're a sailor? Could you take me to Crandor?
translation: Sen denizci misin? Beni Crandor'a götürebilir misin?

english: Yes, I would like some rope.
No thanks, Ned. I don't need any.
Will you take me to Crandor now, then?
translation: O zaman beni Crandor'a götürür müsün?

english: Yes, let's go!
No, I'm not quite ready yet.
How did you get back from Crandor?
Can you take me to Crandor again?
No thanks Ned, I don't need any.
Okay, please sell me some rope.
translation: Tamam, lütfen bana biraz ip sat.

english: I have some balls of wool. Could you make me some rope?
translation: Biraz yün yumaklarim var. Bana biraz ip yapabilir misin?

english: That's a little more than I want to pay.
I will go and get some wool.
I'm sorry to bother you, but could you spare me a little dung?
translation: Rahatsiz ettigim icin özür dilerim, ama bana biraz gübre verebilir misin?

english: The camel didn't seem to appreciate that question.
translation: Deve bu soruyu pek begenmedi gibi görünüyor.

english: Mmm... looks like that camel would make a nice kebab.
translation: Mmm... bu deve güzel bir kebap olur gibi görünüyor.

english: If I go near that camel, it'll probably bite my hand off.
translation: O deveye yaklasirsam, muhtemelen elimi isirir.

english: I wonder if that camel has fleas...
The camel tries to stamp on your foot, but you pull it back quickly.
translation: Deve ayagina basmaya calisir, ama sen ayagini cabucak cekersin.

english: The camel turns its head and glares at you.
translation: Deve basini cevirip sana öfkeyle bakar.

english: The camel spits at you, and you jump back hurriedly.
translation: Deve sana tükürür ve sen aceleyle geri atlarsin.

english: Are you serious?
Oh yes. If you'd be so kind...
Well, just you close your eyes first. I'm not doing it while you're watching me!
translation: Önce gözlerini kapat. Sen izlerken yapmam!

english: I hope that's what you wanted!
Ohhh yes. Lovely.
What was that?
Er, nothing important.
Wait, you're a human, aren't you? Have you come from outside this town?
translation: Bekle, sen insansin, degil mi? Bu kasabanin disindan mi geldin?

english: Yes, I have.
Oh, how wonderful! Does that mean I can finally leave this place and see the world outside?
translation: Oh, ne harika! Bu, sonunda burayi terk edip dis dünyayi görebilecegim anlamina mi geliyor?

english: Wouldn't your master have to take you?
translation: Efendin seni götürmek zorunda degil mi?

english: The plagues mean that my master isn't allowed to leave. It's so boring here, and I'd like to travel.
translation: Vebalar yüzünden efendim burayi terk edemiyor. Burasi cok sikici ve ben seyahat etmek istiyorum.

english: My master has no interest in leaving. It's so boring here, and I'd like to travel.
translation: Efendim buradan ayrilmakla ilgilenmiyor. Burasi cok sikici, seyahat etmek istiyorum.

english: Travelling's what camels do best, you know.
translation: Seyahat etmek develerin en iyi yaptigi seydir, biliyorsun.

english: I don't suppose you could take me with you, could you?
How do I know you're not ill as well?
translation: Senin de hasta olmadigini nereden bilecegim?

english: Well, I haven't turned funny colours yet, so I'm probably not. Will you take me with you?
translation: Henüz garip renkler almadim, muhtemelen hasta degilimdir. Beni de yanina alir misin?

english: I don't really have space for a camel, sorry.
Oh well. Come back some time, and bring me news of the rest of the world.
translation: Peki. Bir ara tekrar gel ve bana dünyanin geri kalanindan haberler getir.

english: Ask the camel about its dung.
Say something unpleasant.
Neither - I'm a polite person.
translation: Ikisi de degil, ben kibar biriyim.

english: Hello there, are you interested in buying one of my special capes?
translation: Merhaba, özel pelerinlerimden birini satin almak ister misin?

english: What's so special about your capes?

Ahh well they make it less likely that you'll accidently attack anyone wearing the same cape as you and easier to attack everyone else. They also make it easier to distinguish people who're wearing the same cape as you
translation: Ahh, ayni pelerini giyen birine yanlislikla saldirma olasiligini azaltir ve diger herkese saldirmayi kolaylastirir. Ayrica, ayni pelerini giyen kisileri digerlerinden ayirt etmeyi kolaylastirir.

english: from everyone else. They're very useful when out in the wilderness with friends or anyone else you don't want to harm.
translation: Arkadaslarinizla veya zarar vermek istemediginiz kisilerle Wildernessda dolasirken cok kullanislidir.

english: So would you like to buy one?
translation: Bir tane satin almak ister misiniz?

english: No thanks.
What's so special about your capes?
Yes please!
No thanks.
Hello. What's your name?
I shouldn't talk to strangers.
Well, my name is [player name] and I'm pleased to meet you. So, now that I'm not a stranger anymore, what's your name?
translation: Benim adim Maceraci ve seninle tanistigima memnun oldum. Artik yabanci olmadigimiza göre, adin ne?

english: Hmm... Nice to meet you, [player name]. I'm Neite.
translation: Hmm... Tanistigimiza memnun oldum, Maceraci. Ben Neite.

english: How come you're the only cat around here?
Oh there's far more than just me. The others are just shy. We do also get visitors from outside the city sometimes, like that Bob. He's quite a handsome beast...
translation: Oh, benden baska cok daha fazlasi var. Digerleri sadece utangac. Bazen sehir disindan da ziyaretciler geliyor, mesela Bob gibi. Oldukca yakisikli bir hayvan...

english: Oh, I see. Romance is in the air, is it?
Well, life here in the desert can be a lonely existence, even with all my busy work... Still, to be honest, he worries me.
translation: Sey, cölde yasamak, islerim cok yogun olsa da, yalnizlik dolu bir hayat olabilir... Yine de, dürüst olmak gerekirse, o beni endiselendiriyor.

english: In what way?
Well, I pride myself on my knowledge of the family lines of cats. Obviously, Bob features quite heavily in most family trees, but he himself has none!
translation: Sey, kedilerin soylari hakkindaki bilgimle gurur duyarim. Acikcasi, Bob cogu soy agacinda oldukca önemli bir yere sahiptir, ama kendisinin hic soy agaci yok!

english: What do you mean?
Nobody is sure where he came from. Not even the Sphinx knows. It's just one of those mysteries.
translation: Kimse onun nereden geldigini bilmiyor. Sfenks bile bilmiyor. Bu da o gizemlerden biri.

english: Interesting...
What are you doing?
I'm hunting frogs and locusts.
Why? Do they taste good?
Yuck! No, I would never debase myself to eat such filth.
translation: Igrenc! Hayir, kendimi böyle pislikleri yiyerek kücük düsürmem.

english: I see you're a cat of taste then.
I am a cat of high breeding! My family tree dates back before those of any ruler on Gielinor.
translation: Ben soylu bir kediyim! Soy agacim Gielinor'daki tüm hükümdarlarinkinden daha eskiye dayanir.

english: What do you do with the frogs and locusts?
What do you mean by 'do'?
Well, seeing as you're hunting them, I thought you'd eat them too.
translation: Onlari avladigini gördügüm icin, onlari yiyecegini düsündüm.

english: No, no, I just hunt them, play with them for a bit and then kill them.
translation: Hayir, hayir, sadece avliyorum, biraz onlarla oynuyorum ve sonra öldürüyorum.

english: Isn't that a little evil?
What's evil about a little destruction?
What isn't? You destroy and take away life. What good is there in that?
translation: Nesi kötü degil ki? Hayati yok edip aliyorsun. Bunun ne yarari var?

english: Life can come from destruction too. Take a volcano. It will destroy all life that surrounds it, but it will also fertilise and enrich the surrounding earth.
translation: Yikimdan da hayat dogabilir. Volkanlari ele alalim. Volkanlar cevrelerindeki tüm yasami yok eder, ama ayni zamanda cevredeki topragi gübreler ve zenginlestirir.

english: From that earth, more life will spring forth than there was in the first place.
translation: O topraktan, baslangicta oldugundan daha fazla yasam dogar.

english: How do you compare killing frogs to a volcano? A volcano has no choice about whether it explodes or not, but you do have a choice.
translation: Kurbagalari öldürmeyi volkanla nasil karsilastirirsin? Volkan patlayip patlamamayi secemez, ama sen secebilirsin.

english: I disagree. It's in my nature to prey on smaller life forms in the same way as it is in the volcanoes nature to explode.
translation: Katilmiyorum. Daha kücük yasam formlarini avlamak benim dogamda var, tipki volkanlarin patlamasinin dogasinda oldugu gibi.

english: Don't they sometimes call the Devourer the goddess of destruction? You seem to have a lot in common with a goddess that your kind oppose.
translation: Yok Edici'ye bazen yikimin tanricasi demiyorlar mi? Senin türünün karsi ciktigi bir tanrica ile cok ortak yönün var gibi görünüyor.

english: That is not too surprising. A long time ago, I served her. Her form has changed a lot since then, just as mine has.
translation: Bu cok da sasirtici degil. Uzun zaman önce ona hizmet ettim. O zamandan beri onun sekli de benimki gibi cok degisti.

english: You mean you weren't always a cat?
No, I used to be human. At the time when Amascut became the Devourer, I was one of her chief priestesses.
translation: Hayir, eskiden insandim. Amascut Yiyici oldugunda, onun bas rahibelerinden biriydim.

english: So you stopped serving her because of that change?
translation: O degisim yüzünden ona hizmet etmeyi biraktin mi?

english: Not initially. Many of us tolerated her new habits for some time. She went too far though, so we took action.
translation: Baslangicta hayir. Bircogumuz bir süre onun yeni aliskanliklarini tolere ettik. Ama o cok ileri gitti, biz de harekete gectik.

english: What did you do?
The last of her priestesses gathered and cursed her. Unfortunately, she also cast a spell of her own, condemning us to an eternity of walking Gielinor in her form.
translation: Son rahibeleri bir araya gelip ona lanet okudular. Ne yazik ki o da kendi büyüsünü yapti ve bizi sonsuza kadar Gielinor'da onun seklinde dolasmaya mahkum etti.

english: So she's a cat then?
She's as much of a cat as Icthlarin is a dog.
translation: O, Icthlarin'in köpek oldugu kadar kedi.

english: What curse did you cast upon her?
translation: Ona ne tür bir lanet yaptiniz?

english: We trapped her in a human form, limiting her power. We also cursed her to never be willing worshipped again, though I fear that curse has started to wane.
translation: Onu insan seklinde hapsettik ve gücünü sinirladik. Ayrica bir daha asla tapinilmayacagina dair lanetledik, ama korkarim bu lanet etkisini kaybetmeye basladi.

english: So that's why she's scared of cats?
Indeed. There are fewer of us priestesses left now, but we still hold enough power to be quite the problem for her.
translation: Aynen öyle. Artik cok az rahibe kaldik, ama ona sorun cikaracak kadar gücümüz hala var.

english: Do you talk to the Sphinx much?
Not really. She is normally too wrapped up in preserving her immortality to be making conversation.
translation: Pek degil. Normalde ölümsüzlügünü korumakla mesgul oldugu icin sohbet edecek vakti yok.

english: So you don't like her then?
Nothing of the sorts. I have nothing but respect for her.
translation: Hic de degil. Ona sadece saygi duyuyorum.

english: Why is that?
Well, because her immortality is based on the fact that she keeps us cats safe. Her whole existence is dedicated to protecting us.
translation: Cünkü onun ölümsüzlügü, bizi kedileri güvende tutmasina dayaniyor. Tüm varligi bizi korumaya adanmis.

english: That doesn't seem like much of a life.
True. Life shouldn't be hoarded, but lived. Of course, don't tell her I said that, otherwise I'd have to be on the lookout for a new guardian.
translation: Dogru. Hayat biriktirilmek icin degil, yasanmak icindir. Tabii bunu ona söyleme, yoksa yeni bir koruyucu aramak zorunda kalirim.

english: Tell me about you and the Devourer.
translation: Sen ve Yiyici hakkinda bana biraz bahset.

english: Before she was the goddess of destruction, she was Amascut, the goddess of rebirth. Back then, I was human, and I served as one of her chief priestesses.
translation: Yikimin tanricasi olmadan önce, Amascut, yeniden dogusun tanricasiydi. O zamanlar ben insandim ve onun bas rahibelerinden biriydim.

english: When she became the Devourer, many of us tolerated her new habits for some time. After all, destruction was key to being the goddess of rebirth, so it was something we were comfortable with.
translation: O Yiyici oldugunda, cogumuz bir süre onun yeni aliskanliklarini tolere ettik. Sonucta, yikim yeniden dogusun tanricasi olmanin anahtariydi, bu yüzden bizim icin sorun degildi.

english: But she went too far?
translation: Ama o cok mu ileri gitti?

english: Yes, so we took action. The last of her priestesses gathered and cursed her. Unfortunately, she also cast a spell of her own, condemning us to an eternity of walking Gielinor in her form.
translation: Evet, bu yüzden harekete gectik. Son rahibeleri bir araya gelip onu lanetledik. Ne yazik ki o da kendi büyüsünü yapti ve bizi sonsuza kadar Gielinor'da onun seklinde dolasmaya mahkum etti.

english: Our curse trapped her in a human form, limiting her power. We also cursed her to never be willing worshipped again, though I fear that curse has started to wane.
translation: Lanetimiz onu insan seklinde hapsetti ve gücünü sinirladi. Ayrica bir daha asla tapinilmamak üzere onu lanetledik, ama korkarim bu lanet etkisini kaybetmeye basladi.

english: I'll leave you to it.
Hello again, Neite.
Hello.
Where's Bob?
Out gallivanting. I think he's hunting noobs in the Wilderness this time. You know what he's like.
translation: Disarida dolasiyor. Sanirim bu sefer Wilderness'da acemileri avliyor. Onun nasil biri oldugunu bilirsin.

english: So, why aren't you out there with him?
translation: Peki, neden sen de onunla birlikte disarida degilsin?

english: I like to roam as much as the next cat, but, every so often, I do like to come home.
translation: Diger kediler gibi ben de dolasmayi severim, ama ara sira eve dönmeyi de severim.

english: So, you and Bob haven't had an argument?
translation: Yani, sen ve Bob hic tartismadiniz mi?

english: Who told you that?
Er... nobody.
He's meant to be with you. You haven't lost him have you?
translation: Seninle olmasi gerekiyor. Onu kaybetmedin, degil mi?

english: I don't think so.
Well keep an eye on him for me.
translation: Benim icin ona göz kulak ol.

english: How come you're the only cat around here?
What are you doing?
Do you talk to the Sphinx much?
Where's Bob?
Tell me about you and the Devourer.
translation: Sen ve Yiyici hakkinda bana anlat.

english: I'll leave you to it.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu var. Merhaba, selam, selam...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her türlü sey! Kuleler görülmeye deger harika bir manzara.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmeni tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Nilsal, traveller.
Can you heal me? I'm injured.
Sorry, but I cannot.
Of course.
The nelta whispers a prayer and you suddenly feel a bit better.
translation: Nelta bir dua fisildar ve aniden kendini biraz daha iyi hissedersin.

english: So what do you do?
I am a nelta in service to Ralos.
What's a nelta?
We are the faithful servants of Ralos. We serve in a variety of roles across the Church of Ralos.
translation: Ralos'un sadik hizmetkarlariyiz. Ralos Kilisesi'nde cesitli görevlerde hizmet ediyoruz.

english: So kind of like a priest?
Yes, I believe that would be the closest comparison to the Church of Saradomin, though I am no expert on their practices.
translation: Evet, Saradomin Kilisesi'ne en yakin karsilastirma bu olur sanirim, ancak onlarin uygulamalari konusunda uzman degilim.

english: Above us mere neltas are the teoki, leaders of the key temples across the kingdom. And of course, above them you have the Teokan himself.
translation: Biz siradan nelta'larin üstünde, kralligin önemli tapinaklarinin liderleri olan teoki'ler var. Ve tabii ki onlarin üstünde de Teokan'in kendisi var.

english: What is this place?
This is the Teomat, home to both the Church of Ralos and the Sect of Ranul. The first and only time that Ralos appeared to us, he did so here on Ralos' Rise. The Teomat was built here as a result.
translation: Burasi Teomat, hem Ralos Kilisesi'nin hem de Ranul Tarikati'nin evi. Ralos bize ilk ve tek kez burada, Ralos'un Yükselisi'nde göründü. Teomat da bunun sonucunda buraya insa edildi.

english: I'd best get going.
May the sun light your way.
Can you heal me? I'm injured.
So what do you do?
What is this place?
I'd best get going.
Adventurer.
Can you heal me? I'm injured.
I would suggest you seek out a member of the Church of Ralos for that sort of thing. We are more concerned with the dead than the living.
translation: Böyle bir sey icin Ralos Kilisesi'nden birini bulmani öneririm. Biz yasayanlardan cok ölülerle ilgileniriz.

english: So what do you do?
I am a nelta of the Sect of Ranul.
What's a nelta?
Both the Church of Ralos and the Sect of Ranul has neltas. For those of us dedicated to Ranul, our primary duty is to care for the dead and prepare them for their journey through the Gates of Mictl.
translation: Hem Ralos Kilisesi'nde hem de Ranul Tarikati'nda neltaslar vardir. Ranul'a adanmis olanlar olarak, bizim öncelikli görevimiz ölüleri bakmak ve onlari Mictl Kapilari'ndan gececekleri yolculuga hazirlamaktir.

english: What is this place?
This is the Teomat. Both the Church of Ralos and the Sect of Ranul are based here, though given us being atop Ralos' Rise, the location holds far more importance to the Church than it does to us.
translation: Burasi Teomat. Hem Ralos Kilisesi hem de Ranul Tarikati burada bulunuyor, ancak Ralos'un Yükselisi'nin tepesinde oldugumuz icin, bu yer Kilise icin bizden cok daha önemli.

english: I'd best get going.
Farewell.
Can you heal me? I'm injured.
So what do you do?
What is this place?
I'd best get going.
Nilsal, adventurer. I'm afraid I have a lot of work to do, so I can't stop to talk. Preparing for the Gathering is a large task at the best of times, never mind after recent events.
In that case, I'll leave you to it.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu var. Merhaba, selam, selam...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her türlü sey! Kuleler görülmeye deger harika manzaralar sunuyor.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmenizi tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Hello! What's this then?
How can you not know? YOU MUST KNOW! It is of course the shrine!
translation: Nasil bilmezsin? BILMEN GEREKIR! Tabii ki tapinak!

english: Okay... what is the purpose of said shrine?
Do you not listen? It is the shrine to almighty one! BWAAAAAAAK!
translation: Dinlemiyor musun? Bu, yüce olanin tapinagi! BWAAAAAAAK!

english: You know, you're making me worried, are you okay?
DO NOT defy him! Give him your eggs! So colourful! So beautiful!
translation: Ona karsi gelme! Yumurtalarini ver ona! Ne kadar renkli! Ne kadar güzel!

english: I'm going to leave you alone now.
No, no, no! I won't get back to training. Leave me alone!
translation: Hayir, hayir, hayir! Egitime geri dönmeyecegim. Beni rahat birak!

english: Oh, you're not the drill sergeant. Please don't tell her I'm hiding over here.
translation: Oh, sen talim cavusu degilsin. Lütfen ona burada saklandigimi söyleme.

english: Why are you hiding?
When I was growing up, all I ever wanted to be was a fisherman. I wanted to go and live in Port Piscarilius and sail the vast oceans.
translation: Büyürken tek istedigim balikci olmakti. Port Piscarilius'a gidip yasamak ve engin okyanuslarda yelken acmak istiyordum.

english: My parents though... they hate the people of Piscarilius. They said I had to become a soldier and bring honour to Shayzien.
translation: Ama ailem... Piscarilius halkindan nefret ediyorlar. Asker olup Shayzien'e seref getirmem gerektigini söylediler.

english: I just can't handle it though. The training is too intense, and my heart's just not in it. That's why I'm out here. I'm not going back until the drill sergeant finishes her session.
translation: Ama ben buna dayanamiyorum. Egitim cok yogun ve kalbim bu iste degil. Bu yüzden buradayim. Drill sergeant egitimini bitirene kadar geri dönmeyecegim.

english: That's awful! If I were you, I wouldn't let my dreams stay as dreams. You should go to Port Piscarilius and be the fisherman you always wanted to be!
translation: Bu cok kötü! Senin yerinde olsam, hayallerimin hayal olarak kalmasina izin vermezdim. Port Piscarilius'a gidip hep olmak istedigin balikci olmalisin!

english: Besides, otherwise you're probably going to be waiting an awfully long time for that drill sergeant to be done...
translation: Ayrica, aksi takdirde o talim cavusunun isini bitirmesini cok uzun süre beklemek zorunda kalacaksin...

english: I'm going to have to tell the sergeant about this.
All the other soldiers are out there doing their best to train so that they're ready to protect and serve all of Great Kourend! Yet here you are, just wandering around.
translation: Diger tüm askerler, Büyük Kourend'i korumak ve hizmet etmek icin ellerinden gelenin en iyisini yapiyorlar! Ama sen burada dolasip duruyorsun.

english: Please, please! I'll do anything. Please don't tell the sergeant! I'll be the laughing stock of the whole kingdom.
translation: Lütfen, lütfen! Ne istersen yaparim. Lütfen cavusa söyleme! Bütün kralligin alay konusu olurum.

english: Anything? Hmm... how about 2,147,483,647 coins?
translation: Ne istersem mi? Hmm... 2.147.483.647 sikke nasil?

english: I don't have that much! I'll give you all I can for you to keep quiet. How is one gold coin?
translation: O kadar param yok! Sessiz kalman icin elimden geleni yaparim. Bir altin sikke nasil?

english: Ha! I was just kidding. You can keep your money and I'll keep your secret to myself. See you around.
translation: Ha! Saka yapiyordum. Parani alabilirsin, ben de sirrini saklayacagim. Görüsürüz.

english: Here, solve this.
New Recruit Tony hands you a [light puzzle box/puzzlebox]!
You've been given a [new clue/casket]!
Please make yourself some space, I have something for you.
translation: Lütfen yer acin, size bir sey verecegim.

english: Why are you hiding?
I'm going to have to tell the sergeant about this.
AT LAST!
Fumus!
Umbra!
Cruor!
Glacies!
Fill my soul with smoke!
Let the virus flow through you!
There is...
NO ESCAPE!
Fumus, don't fail me!
Darken my shadow!
Fear the shadow!
Embrace darkness!
Umbra, don't fail me!
Flood my lungs with blood!
A siphon will solve this!
I demand a blood sacrifice!
Cruor, don't fail me!
Infuse me with the power of ice!
Contain this!
Die now, in a prison of ice!
Glacies, don't fail me!
NOW, THE POWER OF ZAROS!
Taste my wrath!
Flood my lungs with blood!
Now that just sounds plain unhealthy.
You're not meant to take it literally.
Oh, fair enough.
Fill my soul with smoke!
Fumus! Umbra! Cruor! Glacies! Don't fail me!
translation: Fumus! Umbra! Cruor! Glacies! Beni hayal kirikligina ugratmayin!

english: Err...
Fumus? Where is Fumus?
You know they're not here, right?
translation: Onlarin burada olmadigini biliyorsun, degil mi?

english: But... Cruor?
Darken my shadow!
Infuse me with the power of ice!
Hey! Tell me something I don't know.
Seasons come and go, but I will never change.
translation: Mevsimler gelir gecer, ama ben asla degismem.

english: What is that supposed to mean?
I am the Spirit of the Sea, not a writer. No need to overanalyse!
translation: Ben Deniz Ruhuyum, yazar degil. Fazla analiz yapmaya gerek yok!

english: I'm sorry, you're right. Writing with those arms can't be easy anyway.
translation: Üzgünüm, haklisin. O kollarla yazmak kolay olamaz zaten.

english: What would you like to know?
What is Deadman mode?
Deadman mode is an incredibly dangerous survival game mode. Anyone can attack anyone, anywhere. Death comes at a huge cost and killing other players can be extremely lucrative.
translation: Deadman modu, inanilmaz derecede tehlikeli bir hayatta kalma oyun modudur. Herkes, her yerde herkese saldirabilir. Ölümün bedeli cok yüksektir ve diger oyunculari öldürmek son derece kazancli olabilir.

english: Lucrative, you say?

Killing a player will earn you all of the items they had on them, plus the 10 most valuable items from their bank. The unfortunate soul will also lose half of their experience in most skills, or a quarter if they were not skulled. Regardless, it's quite the set-back.
translation: Bir oyuncuyu öldürürsen, üzerinde bulunan tüm esyalari ve bankasindaki en degerli 10 esyayi kazanirsin. Talihsiz ruh, cogu becerideki deneyiminin yarisini, kafatasi isareti yoksa dörtte birini kaybeder. Her halükarda, bu oldukca büyük bir gerilemedir.

english: Wow, that is brutal!
It is, but it is no simple task to kill someone in Deadman mode.
translation: Öyle, ama Deadman modunda birini öldürmek kolay bir is degildir.

english: Very high level guards patrol every major city and bank. They will kill anyone who has a skull. Getting yourself a kill is only half the battle.
translation: Cok yüksek seviyeli muhafizlar tüm büyük sehirleri ve bankalari devriye geziyor. Kafatasi olan herkesi öldürüyorlar. Birini öldürmek savasin sadece yarisidir.

english: How do I play Deadman mode?
You can log into Deadman mode by selecting a Deadman mode world from the world list before you log in.
translation: Giris yapmadan önce dünya listesinden bir Deadman modu dünyasi secerek Deadman moduna giris yapabilirsiniz.

english: So I don't need a new account to play Deadman mode?
translation: Yani Deadman modunu oynamak icin yeni bir hesaba ihtiyacim yok mu?

english: Nope! You can use your existing account on a Deadman world, providing you have membership.
translation: Hayir! Üyeliginiz varsa, mevcut hesabinizi Deadman dünyasinda kullanabilirsiniz.

english: Do my stats and items transfer over to Deadman mode?
translation: Istatistiklerim ve esyalarim Deadman moduna aktarilir mi?

english: No, they do not. Your Deadman mode progress is completely separate from normal Old School worlds.
translation: Hayir, aktarilmaz. Deadman modundaki ilerlemeniz, normal Old School dünyalarindan tamamen ayridir.

english: What happens when I die in Deadman mode?
If you die to a player you will lose the 10 most valuable stacks of items from your bank, all items that you have on your person and half of the experience you have gained in any unprotected skills.
translation: Bir oyuncu tarafindan öldürülürseniz, bankanizdaki en degerli 10 esya yigini, üzerinizdeki tüm esyalar ve korumasiz becerilerde kazandiginiz deneyimin yarisini kaybedersiniz.

english: If you die to a monster when you have a PK skull you will lose the 10 most valuable stacks of items from your bank, all items that you have on your person and half of the experience you have gained in any unprotected skills.
translation: PK kafatasi varken bir canavara yenik düserseniz, bankanizdaki en degerli 10 esya yigini, üzerinizdeki tüm esyalar ve korumasiz becerilerde kazandiginiz deneyimin yarisini kaybedersiniz.

english: If you die to a monster when you do not have a PK skull you will lose all of the items on your person except for the 3 most valuable. You will not lose experience or any items from your bank.
translation: PK kafatasi olmadan bir canavara yenik düserseniz, üzerinizdeki en degerli 3 esya haric tüm esyalarinizi kaybedersiniz. Deneyiminizi veya bankanizdaki esyalarinizi kaybetmezsiniz.

english: What happens when I kill a player in Deadman mode?
translation: Deadman modunda bir oyuncuyu öldürdügümde ne olur?

english: When you kill a player you will receive any items they have on their person and you will also be given a key. You can use this key on Deadman chests found in various banks across the map. Within the chest you will
translation: Bir oyuncuyu öldürdügünüzde, o oyuncunun üzerinde bulunan tüm esyalari alirsiniz ve ayrica bir anahtar verilir. Bu anahtari, harita üzerindeki cesitli bankalarda bulunan Deadman sandiklarinda kullanabilirsiniz. Sandigin icinde

english: How can I protect my items in Deadman mode?

You can protect up to 10 items by placing them in your safe deposit box. Items in your safe deposit box will not be lost to a player who kills you, unlike those found in your bank. Remember that you can only place 10 single items into your safe deposit box, no stacks.
translation: Kasa kutunuza en fazla 10 esya koyarak bunlari koruyabilirsiniz. Kasa kutunuzdaki esyalar, bankanizdakilerin aksine, sizi öldüren oyuncu tarafindan alinamaz. Kasa kutunuza yalnizca 10 adet tekli esya koyabileceginizi, yigin halinde esya koyamayacaginizi unutmayin.

english: How can I protect my stats in Deadman mode?
You can protect your levels in up to 2 combat skills and 3 non-combat skills. You can choose which by opening your items lost on death interface found in your equipment tab. Choose wisely!
translation: En fazla 2 savas becerisi ve 3 savas disi becerideki seviyelerini koruyabilirsin. Ekipman sekmesinde bulunan ölümde kaybedilen esyalar arayüzünü acarak hangilerini koruyacagini secebilirsin. Akillica secim yap!

english: What are safe zones in Deadman mode?

Safe zones are areas patrolled by very high level guards which can be found in various places across the map. The guards watch out for any player with a PK skull and will attack them if they're spotted. It is still possible to be attacked inside safe zones but the person doing the attacking will not stand a chance of making it out alive.
translation: Güvenli bölgeler, haritanin cesitli yerlerinde bulunan ve cok yüksek seviyeli muhafizlar tarafindan devriye gezilen alanlardir. Muhafizlar, PK kafatasi olan oyunculari gözetler ve onlari gördüklerinde saldirir. Güvenli bölgelerin icinde saldiriya ugramak hala mümkündür, ancak saldiran kisi hayatta kalma sansi yoktur.

Don't stay too long traveller. Iban's calls will soon penetrate your delicate human mind.
translation: Cok uzun kalma gezgin. Iban'in cagrilari yakinda narin insan zihnine nüfuz edecek.

english: You'll also become one of his minions... You must go and find the witch Kardia. She holds the secret to Iban's destruction. She lives on the platforms above.
translation: Sen de onun usaklarindan biri olacaksin... Gidip cadi Kardia'yi bulmalisin. Iban'i yok etmenin sirri onda. Yukaridaki platformlarda yasiyor.

english: Niloof, I found the witch's house.
And...?
I found a strange doll.
Ah, I've heard about these dolls. This here be dark magic traveller. They say the witch resurrected Iban from death. She must have used this doll to do it.
translation: Ah, bu bebekleri duymustum. Bu karanlik büyü, gezgin. Cadinin Iban'i ölümden dirilttigi söyleniyor. Bunu yapmak icin bu bebegi kullanmis olmali.

english: If this doll created Iban, it can also be his end. Find out what process the witch used to revive him and reverse it. Once that's done, cast it into the Well of Voyage. Iban will be destroyed with it.
translation: Bu bebek Iban'i yarattiysa, onun sonu da olabilir. Cadinin onu diriltmek icin kullandigi yöntemi bul ve tersine cevir. Bunu yaptiktan sonra, onu Yolculuk Kuyusu'na at. Iban da onunla birlikte yok olacak.

english: Where is the well?
On the platforms above. Within Iban's foul temple.
translation: Yukaridaki platformlarda. Iban'in igrenc tapinaginin icinde.

english: I found this old book by the way. It seems to detail how Iban was resurrected. It might hold the information you need to destroy him.
translation: Bu arada bu eski kitabi buldum. Iban'in nasil diriltildigini ayrintili olarak anlatiyor gibi görünüyor. Onu yok etmek icin ihtiyacin olan bilgileri icerebilir.

english: Thanks Niloof.
Hi Niloof.
Traveller, thank the stars you're still around! I thought your time had come.
translation: Gezgin, hala hayatta olduguna sükret! Senin zamaninin geldigini sanmistim.

english: I've still a few years in me yet. So what are you still doing down here?
translation: Hala birkac yilim var. Sen neden hala buradasin?

english: Well with Iban and his lot gone, we've been left with a great cavern filled with resources. We thought we'd actually do what we came here for and get mining.
translation: Iban ve adamlari gittigine göre, elimizde kaynaklarla dolu büyük bir magara kaldi. Aslinda buraya gelme amacimizi yerine getirip madencilik yapmaya karar verdik.

english: Well Iban and his lot are gone and Lord Iorwerth is no longer an issue. That means we've been left with a great cavern filled with resources. We thought we'd actually do what we came here for and get mining.
translation: Iban ve adamlari gittigine ve Lord Iorwerth artik sorun teskil etmedigine göre, elimizde kaynaklarla dolu büyük bir magara kaldi. Aslinda buraya gelme amacimizi yerine getirip madencilik yapmaya karar verdik.

english: Fair enough. Well you take care of yourselves.
And you.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu var. Merhaba, selam, selam...

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: O da tek bir selam sayilir!

english: Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her türlü sey! Kuleler görülmeye deger harika bir manzara.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmenizi tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Hi.
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Isn't it wonderful? So many books, so much knowledge to be absorbed!
translation: Harika degil mi? O kadar cok kitap, ögrenilecek o kadar cok sey!

english: You're right, it is.
Where did I see that book? It can't be far...
translation: O kitabi nerede görmüstüm? Uzakta olamaz...

english: Uh... Hello?
I'm sure it was around here somewhere...
Okay... Maybe later...
What can I do for ya?
Got any good books to recommend?
I've always found Prifddinas' History to be fascinating!
translation: Prifddinas'in Tarihi'ni her zaman büyüleyici bulmusumdur!

english: I've always found The Journal of Randas to be fascinating!
translation: Rendas'in Günlügü'nü her zaman büyüleyici bulmusumdur!

english: I've always found Big Book of Bangs to be fascinating!
translation: Büyük Patlama Kitabi'ni her zaman büyüleyici bulmusumdur!

english: I've always found The Great Divide to be fascinating!
translation: Büyük Bölünme'yi her zaman büyüleyici bulmusumdur!

english: I've always found Ode to Eternity to be fascinating!
translation: Sonsuzluga Övgü'yü her zaman büyüleyici bulmusumdur!

english: Thanks!
Nothing.
Got any good books to recommend?
Nothing.
Ga ga?
Heeheehee!
*cough*
*gurgle*
*hic*
It still shocks me that the spirits of the river would put such a nasty curse on us for something so small.
translation: Nehir ruhlarinin bu kadar kücük bir sey icin bize bu kadar kötü bir lanet koymasi hala beni sok ediyor.

english: Well strange are the ways of ancient beings such as them.
translation: Onlar gibi eski varliklarin yollari gercekten garip.

english: Please excuse me, I'm rather busy.
Hey, I'm your contractor from Mahogany Homes, what did you want done?
translation: Merhaba, ben Mahogany Homes'tan müteahhitinizim, ne yaptirmak istiyorsunuz?

english: I'd like a Wooden dresser built.
I'd like a Wooden cupboard built.
I'd like my hat stand fixed.
I'd like my mirror fixed.
I'd like a Wooden drawer built.
I'd like two Wooden tables built.
I'd like my clock fixed.
I'd like a Oak dresser built.
I'd like a Oak cupboard built.
I'd like a Oak drawer built.
I'd like two Oak tables built.
translation: Iki adet mese masa yaptirmak istiyorum.

english: I'd like a Teak dresser built.
I'd like a Teak cupboard built.
I'd like a Teak drawer built.
I'd like two Teak tables built.
translation: Iki adet tik masa yaptirmak istiyorum.

english: I'd like a Mahogany dresser built.
I'd like a Mahogany cupboard built.
I'd like a Mahogany drawer built.
I'd like two Mahogany tables built.
translation: Iki adet maun masa yaptirmak istiyorum.

english: I've finished with the work you wanted.
Thank you so much! Would you like a cup of tea before you go?
translation: Cok tesekkür ederim! Gitmeden önce bir fincan cay ister misiniz?

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks, I better be off.
Aaah, nothing like a nice cupppa tea!
translation: Ah, güzel bir fincan cay gibisi yok!

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks.
I have a wide variety of crafting tools on offer, care to take a look?
translation: Cok cesitli zanaat aletleri sunuyorum, bakmak ister misiniz?

english: Yes please!
No thanks.
Hey you, hands off that!
Thief! You stole from me!
Guards, guards!
Yes please!
No thanks.
Excuse me, what is this place?
What is this place? This is Soul Wars, a glorious battleground where you must fight to crush the souls of your enemies!
translation: Burasi neresi mi? Burasi Soul Wars, düsmanlarinizin ruhlarini ezmek icin savasmaniz gereken muhtesem bir savas alani!

english: Really? Are souls easy to crush?
translation: Gercekten mi? Ruhlar ezilmesi kolay mi?

english: Easier than you'd imagine.
I see. So how does it all work?
I can give you a demonstration if you're interested?
Let's do it.
Hmm, you're not looking so great. You should cure yourself of poison before I give you the demonstration.
translation: Hmm, pek iyi görünmüyorsun. Gösteriyi yapmadan önce zehirlenmeni tedavi etmelisin.

english: Hmm, you don't look so good. You should cure yourself of disease before I give you the demonstration.
translation: Hmm, pek iyi görünmüyorsun. Gösteriyi yapmadan önce hastaligini tedavi etmelisin.

english: Hmm, it looks like you have some restricted items with you. You should put them somewhere safe before we continue. Food, potions, capes, followers and non-combat items are all restricted.
translation: Hmm, yaninizda bazi kisitli esyalar var gibi görünüyor. Devam etmeden önce onlari güvenli bir yere koymalisiniz. Yiyecekler, iksirler, pelerinler, takipciler ve savas disi esyalar kisitlidir.

english: Hmm, it looks like you're not actually ready for a demonstration right now.
translation: Hmm, su anda gösteriye hazir degilsiniz gibi görünüyor.

english: You are not allowed to take part in the Soul Wars demonstration while skulled on a Deadman mode world.
translation: Deadman modunda bir dünyada kafatasiniz varken Soul Wars gösterisine katilamazsiniz.

english: Very well. Let's get started.
Actually, I'm good.
So be it. You know where to find me if you change your mind.
translation: Öyle olsun. Fikrini degistirirsen beni nerede bulacagini biliyorsun.

english: Ah, you again. Are you ready for that demonstration?
translation: Ah, yine sen. Gösterime hazir misin?

english: I'll pass.
Ah, you again. If you're here to crush some souls then I'm afraid you won't be able to. I can still help with anything else you need though.
translation: Ah, yine sen. Eger buraya ruhlari ezmeye geldiysen, korkarim bunu yapamayacaksin. Yine de ihtiyacin olan baska bir sey varsa yardimci olabilirim.

english: The Soul Wars minigame is not enabled on this world. You can switch to a Soul Wars world by using the World Switcher in the Logout Menu.
translation: Soul Wars mini oyunu bu dünyada etkinlestirilmemistir. Cikis Menüsündeki Dünya Degistiriciyi kullanarak Soul Wars dünyasina gecebilirsin.

english: Ah, you again. Are you here to crush some souls? Just head into a waiting area if you want to get started.
translation: Ah, yine sen. Ruhlari ezmeye mi geldin? Baslamak istiyorsan bekleme alanina git.

english: Can you tell me more about Soul Wars?
translation: Soul Wars hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Well I've given you the demonstration. Best thing now is to head into a waiting area and get started. That said, you won't be able to do that at the moment.
translation: Sana gösterimi yaptim. Simdi en iyisi bekleme alanina gidip baslaman. Ancak su anda bunu yapamazsin.

english: I can give you the demonstration again if you want? I also have a book that might be useful.
translation: Istersen sana tekrar tanitim yapabilirim. Ayrica faydali olabilecek bir kitabim da var.

english: Well I've given you the demonstration. Best thing now is to head into a waiting area and get started. That said, I can give you the demonstration again if you want? I also have a book that might be useful.
translation: Sana tanitimi yaptim. Simdi en iyisi bekleme alanina gidip baslamak. Bununla birlikte, istersen sana tekrar tanitim yapabilirim. Ayrica faydali olabilecek bir kitabim da var.

english: Could you give me the demonstration again?
Hmm, you're not looking so great. You should cure yourself of disease before I give you the demonstration.
translation: Hmm, pek iyi görünmüyorsun. Sana gösterimi yapmadan önce hastaligini tedavi etmelisin.

english: Could I have the book?
It looks like you already have one.
translation: Görünüse göre zaten bir tane var.

english: Oh, alright then.
Is there something else you need?
translation: Baska bir seye ihtiyacin var mi?

english: Of course. Here you go.
Nomad gives you a book.
Now, is there something else you need?
translation: Baska bir seye ihtiyacin var mi?

english: I'm good.
So be it.
Can we talk about rewards?
Certainly! I sell various rewards to those who have earned Zeal from Soul Wars battles.
translation: Elbette! Soul Wars savaslarinda Zeal kazananlara cesitli ödüller satiyorum.

english: What kinds of rewards are there?
I can offer you some of my knowledge in various skills, I can use my abilities to imbue some of your items with additional power, and I also have some items I have found on my travels.
translation: Cesitli becerilerim hakkinda sana bilgi verebilirim, yeteneklerimi kullanarak bazi esyalariniza ek güc katabilirim ve seyahatlerim sirasinda buldugum bazi esyalar da var.

english: Would you like to see?
Yes please.
No thanks.
Very well. Is there something else you need?
translation: Peki. Baska bir seye ihtiyacin var mi?

english: Can we talk about ammunition?
How are the new capes working out for you?
Just fine, thanks!
Great, now get back in there and crush some souls!
translation: Harika, simdi geri dön ve birkac ruhu ez!

english: Yes, right away!
Not bad. But I was wondering if they could be improved any further?
translation: Fena degil. Ama daha da gelistirilebilir mi diye merak ediyordum?

english: Well if you show me a better device I might be able to sort something out for you.
translation: Daha iyi bir cihaz gösterirsen, senin icin bir seyler ayarlayabilirim.

english: How about this one?
You've already shown me this deadchicken. I don't really need to see it again. I might be able to do something if you show me a better one, though.
translation: Bunu bana zaten gösterdin, ölü tavuk. Tekrar görmeme gerek yok. Ama daha iyisini gösterirsen bir seyler yapabilirim.

english: Hmm, very interesting. Let's see what we can do.
translation: Hmm, cok ilginc. Bakalim ne yapabiliriz.

english: There we go! It's not quite the same, but it should work out just fine for you.
translation: Iste oldu! Tam olarak ayni degil, ama senin icin gayet iyi olacaktir.

english: Bear in mind that the enchantment is bound to my power and so will only work for you while you are in a Soul Wars battle.
translation: Büyü benim gücümle baglantili oldugu icin, sadece Soul Wars savasindayken ise yarayacagini unutma.

english: Great! Thanks for the help!
I don't really have time to discuss the finer points of Fletching, you know.
translation: Okculugun inceliklerini tartisacak vaktim yok, biliyorsun.

english: No, not like that! You see, I helped create a device which returns my ammunition.
translation: Hayir, öyle degil! Bak, mühimmatimi geri getiren bir cihazin yapimina yardim ettim.

english: Really? If you could show it to me, I might be able to sort something out for you.
translation: Gercekten mi? Bana gösterirsen, senin icin bir seyler ayarlayabilirim.

english: I don't want to talk to you.
Huh?
Yikes!
Oh boy.
Welcome to Soul Wars! Let's get started.
So, what's this place all about?
To the south you will have seen an avatar. You must fight to protect your team's avatar, and defeat the opposing team's avatar.
translation: Güneyde bir avatar göreceksin. Takiminin avatarini korumak icin savasmali ve rakip takimin avatarini yenmelisin.

english: Are you crazy? Have you seen the size of it?
translation: Delirdin mi? Onun büyüklügünü gördün mü?

english: You're here to fight, not whine.
But how am I supposed to take on one of those?
translation: Ama onlardan biriyle nasil basa cikacagim?

english: By capturing the Soul Obelisk, which lies at the centre of the battleground, and offering it soul fragments.
translation: Savas alaninin ortasinda bulunan Ruh Obeliski'ni ele gecirip ona ruh parcalari sunarak.

english: Let's head towards the Obelisk now. I can point out some of the important landmarks on the way. Meet me to the north when you are ready to learn more.
translation: Simdi Obelisk'e dogru gidelim. Yolda önemli yerleri gösterebilirim. Daha fazla bilgi almak icin hazir oldugunda kuzeyde bulusalim.

english: The screen fades to black and Nomad teleports northwards.
translation: Ekran kararir ve Nomad kuzeye isinlanir.

english: Hey! Where are you going?
Only the red team may enter this graveyard.
translation: Bu mezarliga sadece kirmizi takim girebilir.

english: Hey! You don't need those. You're not in a real battle yet.
translation: Hey! Onlara ihtiyacin yok. Henüz gercek bir savasta degilsin.

english: You've got no reason to bother that poor imp.
translation: O zavalli iblisi rahatsiz etmek icin hicbir nedenin yok.

english: Hey! Don't attack those. You're not in a real battle yet.
translation: Hey! Onlara saldirma. Henüz gercek bir savasta degilsin.

english: To continue the demonstration, come speak to me. I'm by the avatar in the south-west of the battleground.
translation: Gösteriye devam etmek icin gelip benimle konus. Savas alaninin güneybatisindaki avatarin yanindayim.

english: This is one of the graveyards that your team can capture.
translation: Burasi, takiminin ele gecirebilecegi mezarliklardan biri.

english: For the purposes of this demonstration, however, I have kept it inactive.
translation: Ancak bu gösterinin amaci dogrultusunda, mezarligi aktif hale getirmedim.

english: You might find this little area behind me useful for defending your avatar. There's one in the other team's base, too.
translation: Arkamdaki bu kücük alan, avatarini savunmak icin yararli olabilir. Diger takimin üssünde de bir tane var.

english: During battle, you can gather supplies here to aid you and your teammates.
translation: Savas sirasinda, burada kendinize ve takim arkadaslariniza yardimci olacak malzemeler toplayabilirsiniz.

english: The Soul Obelisk is just a little way from here. Let's continue on; I'll meet you to the east.
translation: Ruh Obeliski buradan biraz uzakta. Devam edelim; doguda bulusuruz.

english: The screen fades to black and Nomad teleports eastwards.
translation: Ekran kararir ve Nomad doguya isinlanir.

english: Now, to have a chance against an avatar, you are going to need souls. Lots of souls.
translation: Simdi, bir avatara karsi sansiniz olmasi icin ruhlara ihtiyaciniz olacak. Cok sayida ruha.

english: What am I going to do with souls?
The Soul Obelisk is immensely powerful and, by channelling souls into it, you can weaken the enemy avatar.
translation: Ruh Obeliski cok güclüdür ve ruhlari ona aktararak düsman avatarini zayiflatabilirsin.

english: How does that work?
All I know is that it does, and that you should do it. Lots.
translation: Tek bildigim, ise yaradigi ve bunu yapman gerektigi. Hem de cok.

english: So, where do I get these souls from?
You can kill the souls that inhabit the arena ruins and harvest their soul fragments.
translation: Arena harabelerinde yasayan ruhlari öldürüp ruh parcalarini toplayabilirsin.

english: For the purposes of this demonstration however, we will use my minion Zimberfizz.
translation: Ancak bu gösterim icin benim minyonum Zimberfizz'i kullanacagiz.

english: Zimberfizz! Heel!
Zimberfizz appears.
When you kill a creature in Soul Wars, they will leave a soul fragment behind, which you can use to charge the Soul Obelisk.
translation: Soul Wars'ta bir yaratigi öldürdügünüzde, geride bir ruh parcasi birakir ve bunu Ruh Obeliski'ni sarj etmek icin kullanabilirsiniz.

english: Zimberfizz has such a soul fragment. Why don't you kill him and take it?
translation: Zimberfizz'de böyle bir ruh parcasi var. Onu öldürüp almaya ne dersiniz?

english: You want me to kill him?
Yes!
Come on! Kill him already and get that soul fragment.
translation: Hadi! Onu öldür ve ruh parcasini al.

english: Good job! Let's carry on to the Soul Obelisk and channel this soul fragment into it. It's just to the east, over a bridge and on a small island.
translation: Aferin! Ruh Obeliski'ne gidip bu ruh parcasini oraya aktaralim. Dogu tarafinda, köprünün ötesinde, kücük bir adada.

english: Good job! Now, you've got that soul fragment, right?
translation: Aferin! Ruh parcasini aldin, degil mi?

english: About that...
You've lost it? You're lucky you're not in a real battle yet!
translation: Kaybettin mi? Henüz gercek bir savasta olmadigin icin sanslisin!

english: Here, have this one. Just look after it this time.
translation: Al, bunu al. Bu sefer ona iyi bak.

english: Make some space and I'll give you one. Just look after it this time.
translation: Yer ac da sana bir tane vereyim. Bu sefer ona iyi bak.

english: I'll try...
Now! Let's carry on to the Soul Obelisk and channel this soul fragment into it. It's just to the east, over a bridge and on a small island.
translation: Simdi! Ruh Obeliski'ne gidip bu ruh parcasini icine aktaralim. Dogu tarafinda, köprünün ötesinde, kücük bir adada.

english: Here we are at the Soul Obelisk. Now, you've got that soul fragment, right?
translation: Ruh Obeliski'ne geldik. Simdi, o ruh parcasini aldin, degil mi?

english: Here we are at the Soul Obelisk. Now, to reap the full benefit of the soul fragment, you will need to first be in control of the Obelisk.
translation: Iste Ruh Obeliski'ne geldik. Simdi, ruh parcasinin tüm faydalarindan yararlanmak icin önce Obelisk'i kontrol altina almalisin.

english: How do I do that?
Various areas of the battleground can come under your team's control. To gain control, you must have more team members than the opposing team in these areas.
translation: Savas alaninin cesitli bölgeleri takiminin kontrolüne girebilir. Kontrolü ele gecirmek icin, bu bölgelerde rakip takimdan daha fazla takim üyenin olmasi gerekir.

english: If you outnumber the enemy, you will gradually take control. Let's try it out now.
translation: Düsmandan sayica üstünseniz, yavas yavas kontrolü ele gecireceksiniz. Simdi deneyelim.

english: We shall use Zimberfizz to represent an enemy team member.
translation: Zimberfizz'i düsman takim üyesini temsil etmek icin kullanacagiz.

english: Minion! Heel!
Zimberfizz appears again.
Come on, give him a good kick.
translation: Hadi, ona iyi bir tekme at.

english: I thought he was dead? Didn't we kill him earlier?
translation: Onun öldügünü saniyordum? Onu daha önce öldürmemis miydik?

english: Ha! He wishes! No, his service to me is far from over.
translation: Ha! O öyle istiyor! Hayir, bana hizmet etmesi daha bitmedi.

english: Poor little guy.
Ha! I'm sure he loves the attention, right Zimberfizz?
translation: Ha! Eminim ilgiyi seviyordur, degil mi Zimberfizz?

english: Zimberfizz appears yet again.
Right, now that Zimberfizz is no longer in the Obelisk's capturable area, you outnumber the enemy! The Soul Obelisk will now begin to fall under your control.
translation: Tamam, artik Zimberfizz Obelisk'in ele gecirilebilir alaninda olmadigina göre, sayica düsmandan üstünsünüz! Ruh Obelisk'i artik kontrolünüz altina almaya baslayacak.

english: Right. Now, go and charge the Obelisk with that soul fragment and see what happens.
translation: Tamam. Simdi gidin ve o ruh parcasini Obelisk'e yükleyin ve ne olacagini görün.

english: Go on, use the soul fragment on the Obelisk.
You charge the Soul Obelisk and weaken the enemy avatar.
translation: Ruh Obelisk'e saldirip düsman avatarini zayiflatiyorsun.

english: Good job! Now that you have charged the Obelisk, the enemy avatar will have been weakened.
translation: Aferin! Obelisk'e saldirdigin icin düsman avatari zayiflamis olacak.

english: Note the display in the top-left of the screen. See how the red avatar's strength has decreased.
translation: Ekranin sol üst kösesindeki göstergeye dikkat et. Kirmizi avatarin gücünün nasil azaldigini gör.

english: The number shown here represents the percentage of your damage that the avatar will block.
translation: Burada gösterilen sayi, avatarin engelleyecegi hasarin yüzdesini temsil eder.

english: So, once I've charged the Obelisk, can I just kick back and wait for the end of the game?
translation: Peki, Obelisk'i sarj ettikten sonra, arkaniza yaslanip oyunun bitmesini bekleyebilir miyim?

english: Ha! I think not! I'm not about to reward those who don't put the effort in!
translation: Ha! Sanmiyorum! Caba göstermeyenleri ödüllendirmek niyetinde degilim!

english: Note the orange bar in the top-left of the screen. This bar represents how active you have been during the game.
translation: Ekranin sol üst kösesindeki turuncu cubuga dikkat edin. Bu cubuk, oyun sirasinda ne kadar aktif oldugunuzu gösterir.

english: Over the course of the battle, the bar will slowly drain. Should the bar drain completely you will be removed from the game due to your inactivity.
translation: Savas boyunca cubuk yavas yavas bosalacaktir. Cubuk tamamen bosalirsa, aktif olmadiginiz icin oyundan cikarilacaksiniz.

english: You can refill the bar by performing actions in the game, such as dealing damage or charging the Obelisk.
translation: Oyunda hasar vermek veya Obelisk'i sarj etmek gibi eylemler gerceklestirerek cubugu yeniden doldurabilirsiniz.

english: Oh well. Say, do you think the enemy avatar minds us weakening it like this?
translation: Peki. Sence düsman avatari, onu bu sekilde zayiflatmamizi umursar mi?

english: Hmm, why don't we go find out?
The screen fades to black. The player and Nomad are now by the red team's avatar area.
translation: Ekran karardi. Oyuncu ve Nomad simdi kirmizi takimin avatar alanindalar.

english: So, here we are in the enemy base.
Is that the enemy avatar over there?
Yeah, and it looks like you made it pretty mad.
translation: Evet, ve onu oldukca kizdirmissin gibi görünüyor.

english: What? You're the one that told me to weaken it!
Ha! Don't worry - I won't let it kill you.
translation: Ha! Merak etme, seni öldürmesine izin vermeyecegim.

english: Phew!
Of course, that doesn't mean I won't kill you.
translation: Tabii bu, seni öldürmeyecegim anlamina gelmez.

english: What did you say?
Argh!
Wooooooooooo!
What?
Woooooo! Woooooo!
Sorry, I don't speak ghost.
There we go! Much better.
Hey! You killed me.
At least it wasn't permanent! Think of it as an opportunity to learn.
translation: En azindan kalici degildi! Bunu bir ögrenme firsati olarak düsün.

english: How so?
The other team will be after you and any soul fragments you have collected, after all.
translation: Sonucta diger takim senin ve topladigin ruh parcalarinin pesinde olacak.

english: I needed to show you what happens when you fall in battle.
translation: Savasta düstügünde ne olacagini sana göstermem gerekiyordu.

english: Did you turn me into a ghost?
Not exactly. The Soul Obelisk tried to claim your soul, as it does with all who perish in the battleground.
translation: Tam olarak degil. Ruh Obelisk, savas alaninda ölen herkes gibi senin ruhunu da almaya calisti.

english: Only my power brought you here, and returned you to life.
translation: Sadece benim gücüm seni buraya getirdi ve hayata döndürdü.

english: Erm, thanks, I guess.
You're more useful to me alive... for now.
translation: Simdilik, hayatta olman benim icin daha yararli...

english: Are there any other painful things to learn about this place?
translation: Bu yer hakkinda ögrenmem gereken baska aci verici seyler var mi?

english: There is much more to this place, but you don't need to know about it yet.
translation: Bu yer hakkinda ögrenmen gereken cok sey var, ama simdilik bilmen gerekmiyor.

english: If you want to learn more, I can give you a Soul Wars guide upon our return to the waiting area.
translation: Daha fazla bilgi edinmek istersen, bekleme alanina döndügümüzde sana Ruh Savaslari rehberi verebilirim.

english: Use the large blue portal at the back of this graveyard to return to the waiting area. Why not sign up for a battle while you're there?
translation: Bu mezarligin arkasindaki büyük mavi portali kullanarak bekleme alanina dönebilirsin. Oradayken bir savasa kaydolmaya ne dersin?

english: Use the portal over there to return to the waiting area. I'll see you on the other side!
translation: Suradaki portali kullanarak bekleme alanina dönebilirsin. Öbür tarafta görüsürüz!

english: Here we are. The waiting areas are just south of here, but you won't be able to join a battle right now.
translation: Iste geldik. Bekleme alanlari buradan biraz güneyde, ama su anda savasa katilamazsin.

english: Here we are. Just head south to the waiting areas if you want to join a battle.
