translation: Iste geldik. Savasa katilmak istiyorsan güneydeki bekleme alanlarina git.

english: That's all well and good, but what do I get out of all of this?
translation: Hepsi cok güzel, ama ben bundan ne kazanacagim?

english: I can offer you experience in various skills, and items I have found on my travels.
translation: Size cesitli becerilerde deneyim ve seyahatlerim sirasinda buldugum esyalar sunabilirim.

english: I have a copy of the Soul Wars guide here. It contains information that I didn't have time to cover.
translation: Burada Soul Wars rehberinin bir kopyasi var. Icinde zamanim yetmedigi icin anlatamadigim bilgiler var.

english: You don't need to know it all to get started, but the section on burying bones could be useful.
translation: Baslamak icin hepsini bilmenize gerek yok, ama kemikleri gömme bölümü faydali olabilir.

english: Did you want to take it and read it in your own time?
translation: Alip kendi zamaninizda okumak ister misiniz?

english: Yes,please.
Hmm, it looks like you already have one.
translation: Hmm, görünüse göre zaten bir tane var.

english: Oh, alright then.
Here you go.
Thanks!
Okay, thanks.
Check out this deadchicken!
You've already shown me this deadchicken. I don't really need to see it again.
translation: Bana bu ölü tavugu zaten göstermistin. Tekrar görmeme gerek yok.

english: Fair enough.
Nomad won't consider looking at Ava's devices until you've completed Animal Magnetism
translation: Nomad, Animal Magnetism'i tamamlayana kadar Ava'nin cihazlarina bakmayi düsünmeyecek.

english: Hmm, very interesting.
I was wondering if you could maybe make your capes do something similar to what this does?
translation: Pelerinlerinize bunun yaptigina benzer bir sey yapabilir misiniz acaba?

english: Let's see what we can do.
Nomad mutters an incantation and enchants your Soul Wars capes!
translation: Nomad bir büyü mirildanir ve Soul Wars pelerinlerinizi büyüler!

english: There we go. It's not quite the same, but it should work out just fine for you.
translation: Iste oldu. Tam olarak ayni degil, ama sizin icin gayet iyi olacaktir.

english: Hmm, very interesting. This one seems more powerful than the last one you showed me.
translation: Hmm, cok ilginc. Bu, bana gösterdiginiz sonuncusundan daha güclü görünüyor.

english: That's right. I was wondering if you could maybe upgrade your capes again?
translation: Dogru. Pelerinlerinizi tekrar yükseltebilir misiniz acaba?

english: The time is now! Crush their souls!
translation: Simdi tam zamani! Ruhlarini ezip gecin!

english: Well I'm still getting things set up right now. Once everything is ready, return to me and I'll give you a demonstration.
translation: Su anda hala hazirliklar devam ediyor. Her sey hazir oldugunda bana geri dönün, size bir gösteri yapayim.

english: The Soul Wars minigame will be released on the 6th January 2021.
translation: Soul Wars mini oyunu 6 Ocak 2021'de yayinlanacak.

english: Here to crush some souls? Just head into a waiting area to the south to get started.
translation: Ruhlari ezip gecmek icin mi buradasiniz? Baslamak icin güneydeki bekleme alanina gidin.

english: Let's do it.
Actually, I'm good.
I'll pass.
Can you tell me more about Soul Wars?
translation: Soul Wars hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Could you give me the demonstration again?
translation: Bana tekrar bir gösteri yapabilir misin?

english: Could I have the book?
Can we talk about rewards?
Can we talk about ammunition?
I'm good.
Yes please.
No thanks.
Yes, right away!
Fair enough.
Great! Thanks for the help!
I see. I'll be back later.
I don't want to talk to you.
Hello little one.
I may be small but at least I'm perfectly formed.
translation: Kücük olabilirim ama en azindan mükemmel bir vücuda sahibim.

english: What's your favourite rock?
You're going tufa with that question. That's personal.
translation: Bu soruyla cok sert davraniyorsun. Bu kisisel bir konu.

english: Was just trying to make light conversation, not trying to aggregate you.
translation: Sadece hafif bir sohbet etmek istemistim, seni rahatsiz etmek icin degil.

english: Metaphorically speaking, do you have a heart of stone?
translation: Mecazi olarak konusursak, tastan bir kalbin mi var?

english: Yes, but you're not having it.
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
Hello little other one.
Other?
Yes, don't you have a sister?
translation: Evet, bir kiz kardesin yok mu?

english: I don't want to chalk about it.
Sometimes I'm worried you'll attack me whilst my back is turned.
translation: Bazen arkami döndügümde bana saldiracagindan korkuyorum.

english: Are you petrified of my tuffness?
Not really, but your puns are awful.
translation: Pek sayilmaz, ama kelime oyunlarin berbat.

english: I thought they were clastic.
I feel like our relationship is slowly eroding away.
translation: Iliskimizin yavas yavas erozyona ugradigini hissediyorum.

english: Geode willing.
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
You new here? I don't recognise you.
That's right, I'm [Vampyre name].
Well, [Vampyre name], welcome to the essence mine.
Essence mine?
That's right. Here, we use the slaves to mine daeyalt essence.
translation: Aynen öyle. Burada köleleri kullanarak daeyalt esansi cikariyoruz.

english: Daeyalt essence? Is that connected to daeyalt ore?
translation: Daeyalt esansi mi? Daeyalt cevheriyle bir ilgisi var mi?

english: Indeed it is. Daeyalt ore is a weaker form of daeyalt essence. It still has uses, hence why we have the slaves mine it. The essence here is far more powerful though.
translation: Evet, var. Daeyalt cevheri, daeyalt esansinin daha zayif bir formudur. Yine de kullanimi vardir, bu yüzden köleleri onu cikarmalari icin kullaniyoruz. Ancak buradaki esans cok daha güclüdür.

english: Where did it come from?
They say that an object of great power was once stored in this very cave. Apparently, the presence of this object created the daeyalt deposits.
translation: Eskiden bu magarada cok güclü bir nesne saklaniyormus. Görünüse göre, bu nesnenin varligi daeyalt yataklarini olusturmus.

english: I see. What is the daeyalt used for?
Its main use is as a key component in the vampyrification process. There's other uses though. It can be used to create runes, for example.
translation: Ana kullanimi, vampirlilik sürecinde anahtar bilesen olarak kullanilmasidir. Ancak baska kullanimlari da var. Örnegin, runeler olusturmak icin kullanilabilir.

english: Am I allowed some?
The essence mined by the slaves is reserved. If you want some, you'll have to mine your own.
translation: Köleler tarafindan cikarilan öz ayrilmistir. Eger biraz istiyorsan, kendin cikarmalisin.

english: If you do choose to mine the deposits, you should know that the daeyalt shards you'll get are useless on their own. They'll need converting into essence to be used.
translation: Eger yataklari cikarmaya karar verirsen, elde edecegin daeyalt parcalarinin tek basina ise yaramadigini bilmelisin. Kullanilabilmeleri icin öz haline dönüstürülmeleri gerekir.

english: How do I do that?
Luckily for you, I can provide that service.
translation: Sanslisin ki, bu hizmeti ben saglayabilirim.

english: Whenever you have shards to convert, bring them to me. Normally I'd send the converted essence straight to your bank, but as you seem to carry all of your belongings yourself, I'll just give it right to you instead.
translation: Dönüstürmek istedigin parcalar oldugunda, bana getir. Normalde dönüstürülen özü dogrudan bankaniza gönderirdim, ama tüm esyalarinizi kendiniz tasidiginiz icin, size dogrudan verecegim.

english: Whenever you have shards to convert, bring them to me. I will send the converted essence straight to your bank.
translation: Dönüstürmek istediginiz parcalar oldugunda, bana getirin. Dönüstürülen özü dogrudan bankaniza gönderecegim.

english: Great! Thanks for the help.
Oh, one other thing. The daeyalt almost seems to have a mind of its own. Only one deposit will be active at a time. You'll need to pay attention to which one it is.
translation: Oh, bir sey daha var. Daeyalt neredeyse kendi zihni varmis gibi görünüyor. Her seferinde sadece bir yatak aktif olacak. Hangisi oldugunu dikkat etmen gerekecek.

english: I see. I'll bear that in mind.
Need something?
Could you convert some shards for me?
translation: Benim icin bazi parcalari dönüstürebilir misin?

english: As you wish. I'll give any shards I convert straight to you. How many would you like me to convert?
translation: Nasil istersen. Dönüstürdügüm parcalari dogrudan sana verecegim. Kac tanesini dönüstürmemi istersin?

english: As you wish. Once I convert these shards, I will send them to your bank. How many would you like me to convert?
translation: Nasil istersen. Bu parcalari dönüstürdükten sonra, onlari bankana gönderecegim. Kac tanesini dönüstürmemi istersin?

english: No. You don't have any.
Tell me about daeyalt.
It comes in two forms, essence and ores. Both have their uses, but the essence is far more powerful.
translation: Iki formda bulunur: öz ve cevher. Her ikisinin de kullanimi vardir, ancak öz cok daha güclüdür.

english: And it's only found here?
Yes. They say that an object of great power was once stored in this very cave. Apparently, the presence of this object created the daeyalt deposits.
translation: Evet. Bir zamanlar bu magarada cok güclü bir nesne saklandigini söylüyorlar. Görünüse göre, bu nesnenin varligi daeyalt yataklarini olusturmus.

english: The main use of daeyalt is as a key component in the vampyrification process. There's other uses though. The essence can be used to create runes, for example.
translation: Daeyalt'in ana kullanimi, vampirlilik sürecinde anahtar bilesen olarak kullanilmasidir. Ancak baska kullanimlari da vardir. Örnegin, özü runeler olusturmak icin kullanilabilir.

english: And I'm allowed to mine it?
Indeed. However, you should know that the daeyalt shards you'll get are useless on their own. They'll need converting into essence to be used. That is a service I can provide.
translation: Elbette. Ancak, elde edeceginiz daeyalt parcalarinin tek basina hicbir ise yaramadigini bilmelisiniz. Kullanilabilmeleri icin öz haline dönüstürülmeleri gerekir. Bu hizmeti ben saglayabilirim.

english: I see. Thanks for the information.
Do you need something else?
translation: Baska bir seye ihtiyacin var mi?

english: I'm good.
You're not one of the slaves assigned to this mine! Go back to the pens before I call the guards!
translation: Sen bu madene atanan kölelerden biri degilsin! Muhafizlari cagirmadan önce agillara geri dön!

english: Could you convert some shards for me?
translation: Benim icin bazi parcalari dönüstürebilir misin?

english: Tell me about daeyalt.
I'm good.
Hello.
Quickly, tell me - is it still there?
Is what still where?
The THING, the THING! It was just outside my house! Has it gone away yet? Or is it still lurking out there, waiting for me to go outside?
translation: O SEY, o SEY! Evimin hemen disindaydi! Henüz gitmedi mi? Yoksa hala disarida gizlenip benim disari cikmami mi bekliyor?

english: I didn't see any THING out there, just a couple of guards. What did it look like?
translation: Orada hicbir SEY görmedim, sadece birkac muhafiz vardi. Neye benziyordu?

english: Ohhhh, it was HORRIBLE! It was an enormous THING, with TEETH and EYES and... and... and THINGS!
translation: Ohhhh, KORKUNCTU! Disleri, gözleri ve... ve... ve SEYLERI olan devasa bir SEYDI!

english: Um... would you care to be more specific?
translation: Um... biraz daha ayrintili anlatabilir misin?

english: I can't. I only saw it in the dark.
You only saw this THING in the dark?
translation: Bu SEY'i sadece karanlikta mi gördün?

english: I was sleeping peacefully one night, when suddenly I woke up and saw it through the window. It was LOOKING at me! I haven't dared go out since then. It's had me trapped in here for days! I've packed my
translation: Bir gece huzur icinde uyuyordum, birden uyandim ve pencereden onu gördüm. Bana BAKIYORDU! O zamandan beri disari cikmaya cesaret edemiyorum. Beni günlerdir burada tutsak ediyor! Kacmak icin

english: bags so I can escape, but the THING's still out there waiting for me to come out! If I have to stay in here much longer I'll go mad! MAD!! MAD!!!
translation: valizlerimi hazirladim, ama SEY hala disarida benim cikmami bekliyor! Burada daha fazla kalmak zorunda kalirsam delirecegim! DELIRECEGIM!! DELIRECEGIM!!!

english: There's no THING outside. Just come out and get some fresh air before you go funny in the head.
translation: Disarida hicbir SEY yok. Kafan karismadan önce disari cik da biraz temiz hava al.

english: You want me to go outside?
I think you might just have dreamed about the THING.
translation: Bence o SEY'i rüyanda görmüs olabilirsin.

english: You want me to believe that it's not real?
translation: Onun gercek olmadigini mi inanmami istiyorsun?

english: Please come outside!
No! No! I know what you are! You're in league with the THING! It keeps sending people in here to trick me into going outside! They keep stealing from me too! GO AWAY!
translation: Hayir! Hayir! Ne oldugunu biliyorum! O SEY ile isbirligi icindesin! Beni disari cikarmak icin buraya sürekli insanlari gönderiyor! Ayrica benden sürekli bir seyler caliyorlar! GIT BURADAN!

english: I'm not trying to trick you!
Get thee gone, trickster!
Sheesh...
Party! Party!
Something's happening in the party room!
Everyone get to the party room!
What's happening in the party room?
Someone's having a big party!
Get to the party room NOW!
Get to the party room!
Get to the party room quick!
Big value items in the party room now!
translation: Parti odasinda cok degerli esyalar var!

english: Quick! Get to the party room!
Hey wanna trade? I'll give the best deals you can find.
translation: Hey, takas yapmak ister misin? Bulabilecegin en iyi fiyatlari veririm.

english: No thanks.
How can you afford to give such good deals?
translation: Nasil bu kadar iyi fiyatlar verebiliyorsun?

english: The general stores in Asgarnia and Misthalin are heavily taxed. It really makes it hard for them to run an effective business. For some reason taxmen don't visit my store.
translation: Asgarnia ve Misthalin'deki genel magazalar agir vergilere tabidir. Bu da onlarin etkili bir sekilde is yapmalarini gercekten zorlastiriyor. Nedense vergi memurlari benim magazami ziyaret etmiyor.

english: Yes please.
No thanks.
How can you afford to give such good deals?
translation: Nasil bu kadar iyi fiyatlar verebiliyorsun?

english: Hi there!
Greetings, iknami. It's good to see so many who are willing to contribute to the Final Dawn. The word of the Augur has changed everything. The time to act is now.
translation: Selamlar, iknami. Final Dawn'a katkida bulunmak isteyen bu kadar cok insan görmek güzel. Augur'un sözleri her seyi degistirdi. Harekete gecme zamani geldi.

english: Augur?
You have not heard? She is the one who now leads the Emissaries. She has taken this once helpless collective and turned them into the ones who will guide us all to Mokhaiotl.
translation: Duymadin mi? Artik Elcileri o yönetiyor. Bir zamanlar caresiz olan bu toplulugu, hepimizi Mokhaiotl'a götürecek olanlara dönüstürdü.

english: How do you know all this? You're not even a member yet.
translation: Bunlari nereden biliyorsun? Henüz üye bile degilsin.

english: I was once. In my time of need, I turned to the Emissaries, but they were even more helpless than I was.
translation: Bir zamanlar üyeydim. Zor durumda kaldigimda Elcilere basvurdum, ama onlar benden daha caresizdi.

english: Now though, she has changed everything. Now it is my duty to rejoin their ranks so that we may bring about the Final Dawn.
translation: Ama simdi o her seyi degistirdi. Simdi benim görevim, Son Safak'i gerceklestirebilmemiz icin onlarin saflarina yeniden katilmak.

english: I see. Thanks for the information.
Hello.
Hello traveller, how's things?
Not bad thanks, yourself?
I'm good, just working hard as usual...
I was hoping you might sell me a cannon.
translation: Bana bir top satabilir misin diye umuyordum.

english: Hmmmmmm...
I shouldn't really, but as you helped us so much, well, I could sort something out. I'll warn you though, they don't come cheap!
translation: Aslinda satmamam gerekir, ama bize cok yardim ettigin icin, bir seyler ayarlayabilirim. Ama seni uyarayim, ucuz degiller!

english: How much?
For the full setup, 750,000 coins. Or I can sell you the separate parts... but it'll cost extra!
translation: Tam set icin 750.000 sikke. Ya da ayri parcalari satabilirim... ama ekstra ücret ödersin!

english: That's not cheap!
Okay, I'll take a cannon please.
Okay then, but keep it quiet... This thing's top secret!
translation: Tamam o zaman, ama kimseye söyleme... Bu sey cok gizli!

english: You give the Cannon engineer 750,000 coins...
He gives you the four parts that make the cannon, plus an ammo mould and an instruction manual.
translation: O da sana topu olusturan dört parcayi, bir mühimmat kalibi ve kullanim kilavuzunu verir.

english: There you go, you be careful with that thing.
translation: Al bakalim, o seye dikkat et.

english: Will do, take care mate.
Take care adventurer.
Oops, I don't have enough money.
Sorry, I can't go any lower than that.
Can I look at the separate parts please?
translation: Parcalari ayri ayri görebilir miyim lütfen?

english: Of course!
Sorry, that's too much for me.
translation: Üzgünüm, bu benim icin cok fazla.

english: Fair enough, it's too much for most of us.
Have you any ammo or instructions to sell?
translation: Satacak mühimmatin veya talimatin var mi?

english: Well, take care of yourself then.
translation: Peki, kendine iyi bak o zaman.

english: Indeed I will adventurer.
I want to know more about the cannon.
translation: Top hakkinda daha fazla bilgi istiyorum.

english: There's only so much I can tell you, adventurer. We've been working on this little beauty for some time now.
translation: Sana söyleyebilecegim cok fazla sey yok, maceraci. Bir süredir bu kücük güzelligi gelistiriyoruz.

english: Is it effective?
In short bursts it's very effective, the most destructive weapon to date. The cannon automatically targets monsters close by. You just have to make the ammo and let rip.
translation: Kisa patlamalarda cok etkili, bugüne kadarki en yikici silah. Top, yakindaki canavarlari otomatik olarak hedef alir. Sen sadece mermiyi yapip ates etmelisin.

english: I've lost my cannon.
That's unfortunate... but don't worry, I can sort you out.
translation: Bu cok talihsiz... ama merak etme, ben hallederim.

english: Keep that quiet or I'll be in real trouble!
translation: Bunu kimseye söyleme yoksa basim belaya girer!

english: Of course.
Oh dear, I'm only allowed to replace cannons that were stolen in action. I'm sorry, but you'll have to buy a new set.
translation: Ah, ne yazik ki sadece savasta calinan toplari degistirebiliyorum. Üzgünüm ama yeni bir set satin alman gerekecek.

english: I was hoping you might sell me a cannon?
translation: Bana bir top satabilir misin diye umuyordum?

english: Okay, I'll take a cannon please.
Can I look at the separate parts please?
translation: Parcalari ayri ayri görebilir miyim lütfen?

english: Sorry, that's too much for me.
translation: Üzgünüm, bu benim icin cok fazla.

english: Have you any ammo or instructions to sell?
translation: Satilik mühimmat veya talimatiniz var mi?

english: Well, take care of yourself then.
translation: Peki, kendine iyi bak o zaman.

english: I want to know more about the cannon.
translation: Top hakkinda daha fazla bilgi istiyorum.

english: I've lost my cannon.
What is it, human? I'm working.
How do I use the furnace?
Put your ore on the conveyor belt to get it smelted. We'll stoke the boiler and operate the rest of the machinery for you.
translation: Eriyebilmesi icin cevherini konveyör bandina koy. Kazani yakip geri kalan makineleri senin icin calistiracagiz.

english: You'll have to help repair the furnace whenever a pipe blows, though. Just hit it with a hammer - that usually works.
translation: Ancak, bir boru patladiginda firini onarmaya yardim etmelisin. Cekicle vurman yeterlidir, genellikle ise yarar.

english: You'll have to put money in the coffer to pay for our services. We charge 72,000 coins per hour; money is deducted as long as you're in this room with us.
translation: Hizmetlerimizin bedelini ödemek icin kasaya para koymalisin. Saat basina 72.000 sikke aliyoruz; bu odada bizimle birlikte oldugun sürece para kesilir.

english: Gosh, you're a remarkably big dwarf.
translation: Vay canina, sen gercekten cok büyük bir cücesin.

english: My brothers and I have a rare genetic condition affecting our growth. Rather than treating us as freaks, you might like to appreciate how useful it is that we can operate the machinery.
translation: Kardeslerim ve ben, büyümemizi etkileyen nadir bir genetik rahatsizliga sahibiz. Bizi ucube olarak görmek yerine, makineleri calistirabilmemizin ne kadar yararli oldugunu takdir etmelisin.

english: Sorry.
That's ok, human. You're not the first to comment on it. Now, did you need anything? I've got work to do here.
translation: Sorun degil, insan. Bu konuda yorum yapan ilk kisi sen degilsin. Simdi, bir seye ihtiyacin var mi? Burada yapmam gereken isler var.

english: Are you sure you're really a dwarf?
translation: Gercekten bir cüce olduguna emin misin?...

english: ... look, do you want help with something, or did you just come here to be rude? I've got work to do.
translation: bak, bir seye yardim mi istiyorsun, yoksa sadece kaba davranmak icin mi buraya geldin? Yapmam gereken isler var.

english: I'll let you get on with it.
How do I use the furnace?
Gosh, you're a remarkably big dwarf.
translation: Vay canina, sen gercekten büyük bir cücesin.

english: Sorry.
I'll let you get on with it.
Are you sure you're really a dwarf?
Hey fishy. If you's a good fishy I might sell yous bitses of skippy skin clothes.
translation: Hey balikci. Eger iyi bir balikciysan, sana skippy derisinden yapilmis giysiler satabilirim.

english: But Nung needs time to makes them first.
translation: Ama Nung'un önce onlari yapmasi icin zamana ihtiyaci var.

english: Hey, silly fishy wit da round head!
Ya! What kinda fishy you's tinkin you are?
translation: Evet! Sen ne tür bir balik oldugunu saniyorsun?

english: I'm not any kind of fishy, err, fish.
Well what you doin' here if you's no a fishy?
translation: Peki balik degilsen burada ne isin var?

english: Well I'm trying to get some Giant Crab meat.
Dis fishy is a funny fishy!
Whats this fishy wanting?
You see those big crabs? I want one of those.
translation: Su büyük yengecleri görüyor musun? Onlardan bir tane istiyorum.

english: You's here to stealin' my big crunchy claws?
translation: Benim büyük citir citir kiskaclarimi calmak icin mi buradasin?

english: Nung should smash your stoopid round head!
translation: Nung senin aptal yuvarlak kafani ezmeli!

english: Always the big nettings was taking my big crunchy claws, I put them in the cages, and now you's come to get them.
translation: Büyük aglar hep benim büyük citir citir kiskaclarimi aliyordu, ben de onlari kafeslere koydum, simdi de sen gelip onlari almak istiyorsun.

english: Swim away little fishy or I eat you till you's dead!
translation: Yüz git kücük balik, yoksa seni yiyip bitiririm!

english: Wait, could I buy some of the crab meat?
translation: Bekle, biraz yengec eti satin alabilir miyim?

english: Silly round head fishy want to swaps big crunchy claws?
translation: Aptal yuvarlak kafali balik, büyük citir citir kiskaclari takas etmek mi istiyor?

english: Naaah...you no real deal. I bet you no do Nung big favour.
translation: Hayir... sen gercek bir anlasma degilsin. Eminim Nung'a büyük bir iyilik yapmazsin.

english: Seriously, I need to get that meat. I'll do your big favour if you want.
translation: Cidden, o eti almam lazim. Istersen sana büyük bir iyilik yaparim.

english: Hah! Silly round head fishy! If you get Nung 5 big skippy skins, den maybe Nung thinking you ok.
translation: Hah! Aptal yuvarlak kafali balik! Nung'a 5 büyük skippy derisi getirirsen, belki Nung seni iyi biri olarak görür.

english: Big skippy skins?
Ya, da big skippies live over dere.
You need lotsa big big stones to get down dere. Den you kill da big skippies and bring da skins to Nung.
translation: Oraya inmek icin cok büyük taslara ihtiyacin var. Sonra büyük skippy'leri öldür ve derilerini Nung'a getir.

english: You do dis, den maybe Nung let you swaps da big crunchy claws.
translation: Bunu yaparsan, belki Nung büyük citir citir penceleri takas etmene izin verir.

english: Nung, I have your mudskipper hides.
translation: Nung, senin camur ziplayici derilerini getirdim.

english: What you say? Has da silly round headed fishy got da big skippy skins?
translation: Ne diyorsun? Aptal yuvarlak kafali balik büyük skippy derilerini mi getirdi?

english: Sigh...
Yes, I have the big skippy skins.
Silly round head fishy done good!  Gimme!
translation: Aptal yuvarlak kafali balik iyi is cikarmis! Ver bana!

english: Ya, da round head fishy does a good big favour for Nung.
translation: Evet, yuvarlak kafali balik Nung'a büyük bir iyilik yapti.

english: I am thinkin you's ok enough to swaps the giant crunchy claws now.
translation: Artik dev citir citir penceleri takas etmek icin yeterince iyi oldugunu düsünüyorum.

english: Great! How much do you want for them?
translation: Harika! Onlar icin ne kadar istiyorsun?

english: You's gotta get me somefing to make dese hides to a cloak and flippers and hat, den I lets you have all the big crunchy claws you can get.
translation: Bu derileri pelerin, palet ve sapka yapmak icin bana bir seyler bulmalisin, o zaman sana alabilecegin tüm büyük citir citir penceleri veririm.

english: But it not be easy
Well I'll do it. What do I need? An item of ancient power? Something from the deepest, darkest dungeon in the world?
translation: Peki, yapacagim. Neye ihtiyacim var? Eski bir güc ögesi mi? Dünyanin en derin, en karanlik zindanindan bir sey mi?

english: What sort of monsters will I need to fight? I'd best grab myself some potions too.
translation: Ne tür canavarlarla savasmam gerekecek? Birkac iksir de alsam iyi olur.

english: Will there be traps? Should I bring cakes?
translation: Tuzaklar olacak mi? Kek getirmeli miyim?

english: Ya, it real dangerous for a fishy.
You's gotta go up to da topsies, and your gotta get a needly-thing and some wirey stuff.
translation: Tepeye cikip, igne gibi bir sey ve tel gibi bir sey bulmalisin.

english: A needle.
Ya.
And bronze wire.
Ya. Tree wirey stuffs.
So, all I have to do is bring you three rolls of bronze wire and a needle, and I can have all the Giant Crabs I can kill?
translation: Yani, sana üc rulo bronz tel ve bir igne getirmem yeterli, sonra öldürebildigim kadar dev yengec alabilir miyim?

english: Ya, but be a sneaky round head fishy. Da topsies has not water for a little fishy like you to breathing.
translation: Evet, ama sinsi bir yuvarlak kafali balik ol. Tepelerde senin gibi kücük bir baligin nefes alabilecegi su yok.

english: It REAL dangerous.
Yeah, sounds it.
Nung, I have the needle and wire.
Nung thinks this is a useful fishy he finds. Gimme!
translation: Nung, buldugu bu baligin yararli oldugunu düsünüyor. Ver bana!

english: Nung have all da wiry stuff and needly things he needs to make da biggestest skippy skin hat ever!
translation: Nung, simdiye kadarki en büyük ziplayan deri sapkayi yapmak icin ihtiyac duydugu tüm tel ve igne malzemelerine sahip!

english: You's a good little fishy, you eat as many big crunchy claws as you want.
translation: Sen iyi bir baliksin, istedigin kadar büyük citir citir kiskaclari yiyebilirsin.

english: Maybe you get big and strong like Nung!
translation: Belki Nung gibi büyük ve güclü olursun!

english: Thanks!
Greetings and welcome to my pickaxe shop. Do you want to buy my premium quality pickaxes?
translation: Selamlar ve kazma dükkanima hos geldiniz. Premium kalitedeki kazmalarimi satin almak ister misiniz?

english: No, thank you.
Are your pickaxes better than other pickaxes, then?
translation: Kazmalariniz diger kazmalardan daha mi iyi?

english: Of course they are! My pickaxes are made of higher grade metal than your ordinary bronze pickaxes, allowing you to mine that ore just a little bit faster than normal.
translation: Tabii ki öyle! Kazmalarim, siradan bronz kazmalardan daha yüksek kaliteli metalden yapilmistir, bu sayede cevheri normalden biraz daha hizli cikarabilirsiniz.

english: Hi Nurmof, I found this earlier...
translation: Merhaba Nurmof, bunu daha önce buldum...

english: Oh, a dragon pickaxe! And a broken one at that. I haven't seen one of those in a while.
translation: Oh, bir ejderha kazmasi! Üstelik kirik. Uzun zamandir böyle bir sey görmemistim.

english: Can you fix it for me? I was told you're the dwarf to see!
translation: Onu benim icin tamir edebilir misin? Senin bu konuda uzman bir cüce oldugunu duydum!

english: I did indeed fix pickaxes in the past, many years ago. They were a lot more common back then.
translation: Evet, yillar önce kazmalari tamir ederdim. O zamanlar cok daha yaygindilar.

english: In fact, this is the first broken pickaxe I've seen in a very long time!
translation: Aslinda, bu cok uzun zamandir gördügüm ilk kirik kazma!

english: Why were there so many broken pickaxes back then?
translation: O zamanlar neden bu kadar cok kirik kazma vardi?

english: Ore rocks used to be quite unstable. They would randomly explode when you were mining them.
translation: Maden kayalari oldukca dengesizdi. Madencilik yaparken rastgele patliyorlardi.

english: That sounds terrifying!
It was. But then one day, the explosions just... stopped. As if someone flipped an off switch somewhere.
translation: Öyleydi. Ama bir gün, patlamalar birdenbire... durdu. Sanki biri bir yerlerde bir anahtari kapatmis gibi.

english: I've not seen a broken pickaxe since then!
translation: O zamandan beri kirik kazma görmedim!

english: Will you still be able to fix mine for me?
I should think so. I'll need to buy some new tools.
translation: Sanirim edebilirim. Yeni aletler almam gerekecek.

english: They're quite expensive, but they will get the job done. The pickaxe will be as good as new when I've finished with it.
translation: Oldukca pahalilar, ama isi halledecekler. Kazma, isim bittiginde yeni gibi olacak.

english: The cost will be about...
...let me see. I need another one of these, and I can reuse that if I replace the drill bit from there...
translation: ...bir bakayim. Bunlardan bir tane daha lazim, ve suradaki matkap ucunu degistirirsem bunu tekrar kullanabilirim...

english: ...hmm, and this needs a full clean, oh and I don't have one of those anymore...
translation: ...hmm, ve bu tamamen temizlenmeli, oh ve ondan artik yok...

english: ...okay! It'll cost about 2,500,000 GP, give or take a few coins. Would you like me to fix it for you?
translation: ...tamam! Yaklasik 2.500.000 GP tutacak, birkac kurus farkla. Onarimi yapmami ister misin?

english: Yes, let's do it.
Lovely! Okay, give me a moment. It may take a little while, it's a tough metal to work with.
translation: Harika! Tamam, bir dakika bekleyin. Biraz zaman alabilir, calismasi zor bir metal.

english: Nurmof goes into a nearby hidden room, and from within, you hear the sound of a hammer striking metal.
translation: Nurmof yakindaki gizli bir odaya girer ve iceriden metalin üzerine cekic vurulma sesi duyulur.

english: ..he did say it would take a little while.
There you go, good as new, just like I said!
translation: Iste oldu, dedigim gibi, yeni gibi!

english: Thank you very much. I'll take good care of it.
translation: Cok tesekkür ederim. Ona iyi bakacagim.

english: Oh, I actually don't have enough coins on me! I'll come back with more.
translation: Oh, aslinda üzerimde yeterince para yok! Daha fazla para getirip geri gelecegim.

english: I'll be here!
That's rather expensive...
It is! But you can't cheap out on quality. If a job's worth doing, do it well.
translation: Öyle! Ama kaliteden ödün veremezsin. Yapmaya deger bir is varsa, iyi yap.

english: I'm also the only one who can repair pickaxes these days, so you don't really have much choice!
translation: Ayrica bu günlerde kazma tamir edebilen tek kisi benim, yani pek secenegin yok!

english: Okay then, let's do it.
I'll think about it.
Yes, please.
No, thank you.
Are your pickaxes better than other pickaxes, then?
translation: Kazmalariniz diger kazmalardan daha mi iyi?

english: Yes, let's do it.
That's rather expensive...
Okay then, let's do it.
I'll think about it.
Patients, patients everywhere! We need to get these soldiers up and fighting again!
translation: Her yerde hastalar var! Bu askerleri ayaga kaldirip tekrar savasmaya hazirlamaliyiz!

english: I don't have time to chat, I have patients to attend to.
translation: Sohbet edecek vaktim yok, bakmam gereken hastalar var.

english: I can't take much more of this. As soon as we help one patient, another comes in!
translation: Buna daha fazla dayanamayacagim. Bir hastaya yardim eder etmez, bir baskasi geliyor!

english: Patients, patients everywhere! We need all the help we can get to get these soldiers up and fighting again. Can you help us?
translation: Her yer hasta, her yer hasta! Bu askerleri ayaga kaldirip tekrar savasmaya hazir hale getirmek icin tüm yardima ihtiyacimiz var. Bize yardim eder misin?

english: Sure, what do you need me to do?
Firstly, you're going to need to gather some medpacks. There should be plenty of boxes around here with some in.
translation: Öncelikle, birkac ilk yardim cantasi toplaman gerekecek. Burada icindeki kutular bolca olmali.

english: After you've got some, we have several tents full of soldiers who've been hurt in the battle against the lizardmen.
translation: Biraz topladiktan sonra, kertenkele adamlarla savasta yaralanan askerlerle dolu birkac cadirimiz var.

english: Good, you have already found some medpacks. Now, we have several tents full of soldiers who've been hurt in the battle against the lizardmen.
translation: Güzel, zaten birkac ilk yardim cantasi bulmussun. Simdi, kertenkele adamlarla savasta yaralanan askerlerle dolu birkac cadirimiz var.

english: If you could help them out with those medpacks, that would be a massive help.
translation: Onlara bu ilk yardim cantalariyla yardim edersen, cok büyük bir yardim etmis olursun.

english: The people of Shayzien will thank you.
Thank you, I will get right to it.
No, I'm sorry but I've got better things to be doing.
translation: Hayir, üzgünüm ama daha önemli islerim var.

english: Sure, what do you need me to do?
No, I'm sorry but I've got better things to be doing.
translation: Hayir, üzgünüm ama daha önemli islerim var.

english: Patients, patients everywhere! We need to get these soldiers up and fighting again!
translation: Her yerde hastalar var! Bu askerleri ayaga kaldirip tekrar savasmaya hazir hale getirmeliyiz!

english: I don't have time to chat, I have patients to attend to.
translation: Sohbet edecek vaktim yok, bakmam gereken hastalar var.

english: I can't take much more of this. As soon as we help one patient, another comes in!
translation: Buna daha fazla dayanamayacagim. Bir hastaya yardim eder etmez, bir baskasi geliyor!

english: I hope we can stop the lizardmen, I can't take much more of this. As soon as we help one patient, another comes in.
translation: Umarim kertenkele adamlari durdurabiliriz, buna daha fazla dayanamayacagim. Bir hastaya yardim eder etmez, bir baskasi geliyor.

english: Argh! Where are the bandages? I've got to get on with my job, please leave me be.
translation: Ah! Bandajlar nerede? Isime devam etmeliyim, lütfen beni rahat birakin.

english: Either help out or get out of the way!
translation: Ya yardim et ya da yolumdan cekil!

english: Hello nurse.
I don't know how much longer I can cope here.
translation: Burada daha ne kadar dayanabilirim bilmiyorum.

english: What? Is the plague getting to you?
translation: Ne? Veba sana da mi bulasti?

english: No, strangely enough the people here don't seem to be affected. It's just the awful living conditions that is making people ill.
translation: Hayir, garip bir sekilde buradaki insanlar etkilenmemis gibi görünüyor. Insanlari hasta eden sadece berbat yasam kosullari.

english: I was under the impression that everyone here was affected.
Me too, but that doesn't seem to be the case.
translation: Ben de, ama durum öyle görünmüyor.

english: Hello there.
Hello my dear, how are you feeling?
I'm okay thanks.
Well in that case I'd better get back to work. Take care.
translation: Öyleyse isime dönsem iyi olacak. Kendine iyi bak.

english: You too.
Patients, patients everywhere! We need to get these soldiers up and fighting again!
translation: Her yer hasta, hasta! Bu askerleri ayaga kaldirip tekrar savasmaya hazirlamaliyiz!

english: I don't have time to chat, I have patients to attend to.
translation: Sohbet edecek vaktim yok, bakmam gereken hastalar var.

english: I can't take much more of this. As soon as we help one patient, another comes in!
translation: Buna daha fazla dayanamayacagim. Bir hastaya yardim eder etmez, bir baskasi geliyor!

english: Please help me with this!
Well done!
You've been given a [new clue/casket]!
I hope we can stop the lizardmen, I can't take much more of this. As soon as we help one patient, another comes in.
translation: Umarim kertenkele adamlari durdurabiliriz, buna daha fazla dayanamayacagim. Bir hastaya yardim eder etmez, bir baskasi geliyor.

english: Argh! Where are the bandages? I've got to get on with my job, please leave me be.
translation: Ah! Bandajlar nerede? Isime devam etmeliyim, lütfen beni rahat birak.

english: Either help out or get out of the way!
translation: Ya yardim et ya da yolumdan cekil!

english: Good day, adventurer.
Who are you?
I am Lord D'rows, leader of the Oathbreakers. Yourself?
translation: Ben Lord D'rows, Yemin Bozanlar'in lideriyim. Sen kimsin?

english: I'm [player name]. That sounds pretty important.
translation: Ben Maceraci. Kulaga oldukca önemli bir sey gibi geliyor.

english: It is a job I do not take lightly.
So what's this oath that you're all so proud of breaking?
translation: Peki, bozdugunuz icin bu kadar gurur duydugunuz yemin nedir?

english: Pride? There is no pride in what we've done.
translation: Gurur mu? Yaptigimiz seyde gurur duyulacak bir sey yok.

english: Which was?
We Oathbreakers were all once monks of Saradomin but have since seen that his light is false. The founder of this sanctuary had a similar story and that is why we follow in her footsteps.
translation: Yemin Bozanlar olarak hepimiz bir zamanlar Saradomin'in rahipleriydik, ancak onun isiginin sahte oldugunu gördük. Bu siginagin kurucusunun da benzer bir hikayesi vardi ve bu yüzden onun izinden gidiyoruz.

english: What caused your faith in Saradomin to wane?
translation: Saradomin'e olan inancinizin azalmasina ne sebep oldu?

english: How can order and wisdom prevail in a land where chaos and destruction reign supreme? That, and a few too many muggings during my travels. If you can't beat them, become them.
translation: Kaos ve yikimin hüküm sürdügü bir ülkede düzen ve bilgelik nasil hakim olabilir? Bu ve seyahatlerim sirasinda yasadigim cok sayida soygun. Onlari yenemiyorsan, onlardan biri ol.

english: I see.
Was there anything else?
Why are you here?
We've been keeping an eye on Slepe lately. We could sense a darkness building as the citizens fell into their endless slumber.
translation: Son zamanlarda Slepe'yi gözlemliyorduk. Vatandaslar sonsuz uykularina dalarken, bir karanligin olustugunu hissedebiliyorduk.

english: Once we'd heard that the sanctuary had been broken into, we came here posthaste.
translation: Kutsal alanin zorla girildigini duyunca, hemen buraya geldik.

english: Broken into?
Indeed. This place was sealed, only to be reopened once Mother had awoken from her deep sleep.
translation: Evet. Burasi mühürlenmisti ve ancak Anne derin uykusundan uyandiginda yeniden acilacakti.

english: This nightmarish creature that the siren warned us of has made a home here. That was reason enough for her to unseal the entrance.
translation: Siren'in bizi uyardigi bu kabus gibi yaratik, burayi mesken tutmus. Bu, onun girisi acmasi icin yeterli bir sebepti.

english: Oh, um, whose mother? Yours?
translation: Oh, um, kimin annesi? Seninki mi?

english: Oh, not my actual mother, you fool. Phosani, the founder of this sanctuary went by the title of 'Mother' while her followers adopted the title of 'Sister'. I'm sure you've seen them around.
translation: Oh, gercek annem degil, aptal. Bu kutsal mekanin kurucusu Phosani, “Anne” unvanini kullanirken, takipcileri “Kardes” unvanini benimsemisti. Onlari etrafta görmüssündür.

english: I have. I suspect you're quite bothered about the sudden influx of visitors?
translation: Gördüm. Ani ziyaretci akini seni oldukca rahatsiz ediyor sanirim?

english: Well, yes, but that fish woman claims every warrior is needed to defeat the Nightmare and that everyone asleep here is at risk.
translation: Evet, ama o balik kadin, Kabusu yenmek icin her savascinin gerekli oldugunu ve burada uyuyan herkesin tehlikede oldugunu iddia ediyor.

english: We must be strong, adventurer. Be strong for Mother.
translation: Güclü olmaliyiz, maceraci. Anne icin güclü ol.

english: Okay... Does this creature have treasure? That's kind of a sticking point for me.
translation: Tamam... Bu yaratigin hazinesi var mi? Bu benim icin önemli bir nokta.

english: Treasure? This sanctuary is full of old trinkets which the hag has claimed as her own. Kill her and take them, as is the Zamorakian way.
translation: Hazine mi? Bu siginak, cadalozun kendine ait oldugunu iddia ettigi eski ivir zivirlarla dolu. Onu öldür ve Zamorakian gelenegine göre onlari al.

english: Oh yes, the iron price. My specialty.
translation: Oh evet, demir fiyati. Benim uzmanlik alanim.

english: Your friends are a quiet bunch.
They took a vow of silence. I speak for them.
translation: Sessizlik yemini ettiler. Onlar adina ben konusuyorum.

english: Oh, how come?
It is the way. When I fall, one of them will take my place as the Oath Lord.
translation: Gelenek böyle. Ben düstügümde, iclerinden biri Yemin Lordu olarak benim yerimi alacak.

english: No disagreements, that must be nice.
I never claimed that they can't communicate. They know a rudimentary hand-talk to vent their frustrations with my leadership. Making decisions is easier when no one can shout at you.
translation: Onlarin iletisim kuramadiklarini hic söylemedim. Benim liderligimden duyduklari hosnutsuzlugu ifade etmek icin basit bir el dili biliyorlar. Kimse sana bagirmadiginda karar vermek daha kolaydir.

english: Huh, I can imagine.
Bye!
Stay strong, adventurer.
Who are you?
Why are you here?
Your friends are a quiet bunch.
Bye!
Hello!
They don't seem willing to talk.
Hello!
They don't seem willing to talk.
Hello!
They don't seem willing to talk.
Welcome to Obli's General Store Bwana! Would you like to see my items?
translation: Obli'nin Genel Magazasina hos geldin Bwana! Ürünlerimi görmek ister misin?

english: Yes please!
No, but thanks for the offer.
I'm getting out of here Bwana, the place is infested with zombies.
translation: Buradan gidiyorum Bwana, burasi zombilerle dolu.

english: Yes please!
No, but thanks for the offer.
Hi, are you busy?
Me? I'm always busy.
translation: Ben mi? Ben her zaman mesgulüm.

english: See that man there? That's the professor. If he had his way, I think he'd never let me sleep!
translation: Suradaki adami görüyor musun? O profesör. Eger ona kalsaydi, sanirim beni hic uyutmazdi!

english: Anyway, how might I help you?
I was wondering what you do here.
translation: Burada ne is yaptigini merak ediyordum.

english: Glad you ask. This is the Observatory reception.
Up on the cliff is the Observatory dome, from which you can view the heavens.
translation: Kayaligin üzerinde, gökyüzünü izleyebilecegin Gözlemevi kubbesi var.

english: Usually...
What do you mean, 'usually'?
*Ahem*. Back to work, please.
I'd speak with the professor. He'll explain.
What's that board for?
The one behind me? We use it to keep track of fallen stars and those that find them.
translation: Arkamdaki mi? Düsen yildizlari ve onlari bulanlari takip etmek icin kullaniyoruz.

english: Fallen stars?
That's right. From time to time, stars fall from the sky and land somewhere in Gielinor.
translation: Evet. Zaman zaman yildizlar gökyüzünden düser ve Gielinor'un bir yerine iner.

english: Whenever one does, we make a note on the board. If someone finds it, we note their name as well.
translation: Ne zaman bir yildiz düsse, tahtaya not ediyoruz. Birisi onu bulursa, onun adini da not ediyoruz.

english: I see. And how do people find them?
translation: Anliyorum. Peki insanlar onlari nasil buluyor?

english: There's a lot of amateur astronomers out there. Many of them have small telescopes in their homes. They use them to work out when a star is going to fall.
translation: Disarida bircok amatör astronom var. Bircogunun evinde kücük teleskoplar var. Onlari kullanarak yildizlarin ne zaman düsecegini hesapliyorlar.

english: Could I do that?
I imagine so. Just get yourself a telescope and look out for stars.
translation: Sanirim yapabilirsin. Kendine bir teleskop al ve yildizlari ara.

english: Awesome. I might just give it a go.
Good luck. If you're interested, I hear there's a dwarf at the Mining Guild who's keen on gathering stardust. If you find some, he might be willing to trade with you.
translation: Iyi sanslar. Eger ilgilenirsen, Madencilik Loncasi'nda yildiz tozu toplamaya merakli bir cüce oldugunu duydum. Eger bulursan, seninle takas yapmaya razi olabilir.

english: Good to know. Thanks.
Oh yes. I've seen one of those before.
translation: Evet. Daha önce bir tane görmüstüm.

english: You're very lucky. They are quite rare. Anyway, whenever one falls, we make a note on the board. If someone finds it, we note their name as well.
translation: Cok sanslisin. Oldukca nadirdirler. Neyse, ne zaman bir yildiz düsse, tahtaya not ediyoruz. Birisi bulursa, onun adini da yaziyoruz.

english: I'd better be off.
Just looking around, thanks.
Okay, just don't break anything. If you need any help, let me know.
translation: Tamam, bir sey kirma yeter. Yardima ihtiyacin olursa, bana haber ver.

english: Can I have a look through that telescope?
You can. You won't see much though.
translation: Kullanabilirsin. Ama pek bir sey göremezsin.

english: And that's because?
Just talk to the professor. He'll fill you in.
Hi assistant.
Wait a minute, what's your real name?
My real name?
I only know you as the professor's assistant. What's your actual name?
translation: Seni sadece profesörün asistani olarak taniyorum. Gercek adin ne?

english: Patrick.
Hi, Patrick, I'm [player name].
Well, hello again, and thanks for helping out the professor.
translation: Merhaba, tekrar hos geldin ve profesöre yardim ettigin icin tesekkürler.

english: Oh, and, believe it or not, his name is Mambo-duna- roona, but don't tell him I told you.
translation: Oh, ve inan ya da inanma, onun adi Mambo-duna-roona, ama ona söyledigimi söyleme.

english: You made that up!
No, honest! Anyways, you've made my life much easier. Have a drink on me!
translation: Hayir, gercekten! Her neyse, hayatimi cok kolaylastirdin. Bir icki ismarlayayim!

english: Thanks very much.
No problem. Scorpius would be proud.
translation: Önemli degil. Scorpius seninle gurur duyardi.

english: Sorry?
You may want to check out the book on the table, and perhaps look around for a grave...
translation: Masadaki kitaba bir göz atip, mezarlari aramak isteyebilirsin...

english: Oh, sorry, I can't carry anything else.
Well, then, please come back when you do.
translation: O zaman, tasiyabildiginde tekrar gel lütfen.

english: How was the wine?
That was good stuff, *hic*! Wheresh the professher?
The professor? He's up in the Observatory. Since the bridge was ruined, you will have to travel through the dungeon under the goblins' settlement.
translation: Profesör mü? Gözlemevinde. Köprü yikildigi icin, goblinlerin yerlesim yerinin altindaki zindandan gecmen gerekecek.

english: That was good stuff! Where's the professor?
Look what I have.
Good for you. As much as I want to admire your possessions, I do have work to do.
translation: Aferin sana. Esyalarini hayranlikla incelemek istesem de, yapmam gereken isler var.

english: Oh, right. Sorry.
What do you think of this?
I'd rather you show me the actual item, as opposed to the note form.
translation: Not yerine gercek esyayi göstermeni tercih ederim.

english: I was wondering what you do here.
What's that board for?
Can I have a look through that telescope?
I'd better be off.
Just looking around, thanks.
Wait a minute, what's your real name?
Hello.
Hi, I was...
Welcome to the magnificent wonder of the Observatory, where wonder is all around you, where the stars can be clutched from the heavens!
translation: Gözlemevinin muhtesem harikasina hos geldin, burada her yer mucizeyle dolu, yildizlar gökyüzünden koparilabilir!

english: Wow, nice intro.
Why, thanks! How might I help you?
Lost? It must have been those pesky goblins that led you astray.
translation: Kayboldunuz mu? Sizi yoldan saptiran o sinir bozucu goblinler olmali.

english: Head north-east to find the city of Ardougne.
translation: Ardougne sehrini bulmak icin kuzeydoguya dogru gidin.

english: I'm sure I'll find the way.
Thanks for all your help.
No problem at all. Come and visit again!
The professor carries on with his studies.
An Observatory?
Of course. We have a superb telescope up in the Observatory, on the hill.
translation: Tabii ki. Tepedeki gözlemevinde muhtesem bir teleskopumuz var.

english: A truly marvellous invention, the likes of which you'll never behold again.
translation: Gercekten muhtesem bir icat, bir daha asla böyle bir sey göremeyeceksiniz.

english: Well, it would be if it worked.
Don't interrupt!
What? It doesn't work?
Oh, no, no, no. Don't listen to him, he's joking. Aren't you, my FAITHFUL assistant?
translation: Hayir, hayir, hayir. Onu dinlemeyin, saka yapiyor. Degil mi, sadik yardimcim?

english: Nope, dead serious. Hasn't been working for a long time.
translation: Hayir, cok ciddiyim. Uzun zamandir calismiyor.

english: Arghhh! Get back to work and stop sticking your nose in!
translation: Ah! Isine dön ve burnunu sokmayi birak!

english: So, it's broken. How come?
Oh, I suppose there's no use keeping it secret. Did you see those houses outside?
translation: Oh, sanirim bunu gizlemenin bir anlami yok. Disaridaki evleri gördün mü?

english: Up on the hill? Yes, I've seen them.
It's a horde of goblins.
Since they moved here they have caused nothing but trouble.
translation: Buraya tasindiklarindan beri basimiza beladan baska bir sey acmadilar.

english: Last week, my telescope was tampered with.
Now, parts need replacing before it can be used again. They've even been messing around in the dungeons under this area. Something needs to be done.
translation: Simdi tekrar kullanabilmek icin bazi parcalari degistirmem gerekiyor. Bu bölgenin altindaki zindanlarda bile ortaligi karistiriyorlar. Bir seyler yapmamiz gerekiyor.

english: Strikes me that this visitor could help us.
translation: Bu ziyaretcinin bize yardim edebilecegini düsünüyorum.

english: Stop being so rude.
Although, he has a point. What do you say?
translation: Ama hakli bir noktaya degindi. Ne dersin?

english: What, me?
Sounds interesting, what can I do for you?
translation: Kulaga ilginc geliyor, senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: Oh, thanks so much.
I shall need some materials for the telescope, so it can be used again.
translation: Teleskobu tekrar kullanabilmek icin bazi malzemelere ihtiyacim var.

english: Let's start with three planks of wood for the telescope base. My assistant will help with obtaining these, won't you?
translation: Teleskopun tabani icin üc tahta parcasiyla baslayalim. Asistanim bunlari temin etmeme yardim edecek, degil mi?

english: As if I don't have enough work to do. Seems I don't have a choice.
translation: Sanki yeterince isim yokmus gibi. Baska secenegim yok gibi görünüyor.

english: Go talk to him if you need some advice.
translation: Tavsiyeye ihtiyacin varsa gidip onunla konus.

english: Okay, I'll be right back.
Oh, sorry, I don't have time for that.
translation: Oh, üzgünüm, bunun icin vaktim yok.

english: Oh dear. I really do need some help.
translation: Oh, hayir. Gercekten yardima ihtiyacim var.

english: If you see anyone who can help then please send them my way.
translation: Yardim edebilecek birini görürsen lütfen bana gönder.

english: I'm just passing through.
Fair enough. Not everyone is interested in this place, I suppose.
Welcome back! How can I help you today?
translation: Hos geldin! Bugün nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: Can you teach me to solve treasure trail clues?
translation: Hazine avi ipuclarini cözmeyi ögretir misiniz?

english: Ah, I get asked about treasure trails all the time! Listen carefully and I shall tell you what I know...
translation: Ah, bana sürekli hazine avlari hakkinda sorular sorulur! Dikkatlice dinleyin, size bildiklerimi anlatayim...

english: Lots of clues havedegreesandminuteswritten on them. These are the coordinates of the place where the treasure is buried.
translation: Bircok ipucunda derece ve dakika yaziyor. Bunlar hazinenin gömüldügü yerin koordinatlaridir.

english: You have to walk to the correct spot, so that your coordinates are exactly the same as the values written on the clue scroll.
translation: Koordinatlariniz ipucu parsömeninde yazan degerlerle tam olarak ayni olacak sekilde dogru noktaya yürümelisiniz.

english: To do this, you must use asextant, awatchand achartto find your own coordinates.
translation: Bunu yapmak icin, kendi koordinatlarini bulmak icin bir sekstant, bir saat ve bir harita kullanmalisin.

english: Once you know the coordinates of the place where you are, you know which way you have to walk to get to the place where the treasure is!
translation: Bulundugun yerin koordinatlarini ögrendikten sonra, hazinenin bulundugu yere ulasmak icin hangi yöne yürümek gerektigini bilirsin!

english: Riiight. So where do I get those items from?
translation: Tamam. Peki bu esyalari nereden bulabilirim?

english: I think Murphy, the owner of the fishing trawler moored south of Ardougne, might be able to spare you a sextant. Then the nearest Clock Tower is south of Ardougne - you could probably get a watch there. I've
translation: Ardougne'nin güneyinde demirlemis balikci teknesinin sahibi Murphy sana bir sekstant verebilir. En yakin Saat Kulesi Ardougne'nin güneyinde, muhtemelen oradan bir saat alabilirsin.

english: got plenty of charts myself, here have one.
translation: Benim bir sürü haritam var, al sana bir tane.

english: Thanks, I'll see you later.
You don't have enough space for the chart. Come back to me when you do.
translation: Harita icin yeterli yerin yok. Yeterli yerin oldugunda bana geri gel.

english: Um... Are you sure? I think you've got one stored somewhere.
translation: Emin misin? Sanirim bir yerlerde sakladigin bir tane var.

english: I've lost my chart.
That's not a problem, I've got lots of copies.
translation: Sorun degil, bende bircok kopyasi var.

english: Certainly. It's not difficult.
Welcome back.
Thanks for all your help with the telescope. What can I do for you?
translation: Teleskop konusunda yardimin icin tesekkürler. Senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: Not right now,
but the stars may hold a secret for you.
translation: ama yildizlar senin icin bir sir sakliyor olabilir.

english: Is it true your name is Mambo-duna-roona?
How do you know tha-
I mean, of course not, what a silly idea.
translation: Yani, tabii ki degil, ne sacma bir fikir.

english: Nothing, thanks.
Okay, no problem. See you again.
What do you see now?
I can see a constellation through the telescope. It looks like Scorpio.
translation: Teleskopla bir takimyildizi görebiliyorum. Akrep takimyildizi gibi görünüyor.

english: Scorpio? Interesting. How very fitting.
translation: Akrep mi? Ilginc. Ne kadar uygun.

english: What do you mean?
Scorpius, the founder of all we know relating to astronomy. There's a book about him in the reception. Perhaps you should check it out, you might learn something.
translation: Scorpius, astronomi ile ilgili bildigimiz her seyin kurucusu. Resepsiyonda onunla ilgili bir kitap var. Belki bir göz atmalisin, bir seyler ögrenebilirsin.

english: Then perhaps I shall.
What do you think of this!
Wonderful. You must be very proud to have it.
translation: Harika. Buna sahip oldugun icin cok gurur duyuyor olmalisin.

english: What do you think of this?
I'd rather you show me the actual item, as opposed to the note form.
translation: Not seklinde degil, gercek esyayi göstermeni tercih ederim.

english: Talk about the Observatory quest.
I'm totally lost.
An Observatory?
Yes.
No.
I'm just passing through.
Talk about Treasure Trails.
I've lost my chart.
How do these work again?
Do you need any more help with the telescope?
translation: Teleskopla ilgili baska yardima ihtiyacin var mi?

english: Is it true your name is Mambo-duna-roona?
Nothing, thanks.
Hi!
Let me at 'em!
Trolls? Schmolls!
The trolls are coming!
The trolls took my baby son!
Welcome to Burthorpe!
Thanks!
Trolls!
Hello stranger.
Go away!
Run!
Hi!
The Imperial Guard can no longer protect us!
The White Knights will soon have control!
translation: Beyaz Sövalyeler yakinda kontrolü ele gecirecek!

english: I heard about what you did, thank you!
The White Knights are still going to take over.
translation: Beyaz Sövalyeler yine de kontrolü ele gecirecek.

english: I hear the Imperial Guard are preparing an attack!
translation: Imparatorluk Muhafizlarinin bir saldiri hazirligi yaptigini duydum!

english: Thank you so much!
Surely we are safe now!
Have you ever wondered what sort of a tree leaves a stump this large?
translation: Hiç bu kadar büyük bir kütük birakan agacin ne tür bir agaç oldugunu merak ettiniz mi?

english: What if it was an ancient ent that grew too big? Can you imagine that walking around?
translation: Ya bu çok büyümüs eski bir ent olsaydi? Onun etrafta dolastigini hayal edebiliyor musunuz?

english: Imagine...
Can I help you with something?
Well, err...who are you, and what are all these bones doing here?
translation: Sey, sen kimsin ve bu kemikler burada ne ariyor?

english: Errr...
Mumblemumble
I'm an archaeologist. I work with the museum.
An archaeologist?
Yes.
Well that explains the bones...sort of...but what are you doing all the way out here?
translation: Bu kemikleri acikliyor... bir nevi... ama bu kadar uzakta ne isin var?

english: Mumblemumble. Mumblemumblemumble.
I'm collecting bones for the museum.
They have asked me to rig up some displays of second and third age creatures using their bones, so that people can come and...well, look at them.
translation: Ikinci ve ücüncü cag yaratiklarinin kemiklerini kullanarak bazi sergiler hazirlamami istediler, böylece insanlar gelip... sey, onlari görebilsinler.

english: I need to get them into some sort of order before I begin, but I've run into a bit of a snag.
translation: Baslamadan önce onlari bir tür siraya koymam gerekiyor, ama bir sorunla karsilastim.

english: What sort of a snag?
Well, I need to have all the bones I'm going to use here, and placed into some sort of order.
translation: Kullanacagim tüm kemikleri burada bir araya getirip bir siraya koymam gerekiyor.

english: However, I seem to have discovered I am a few short.
translation: Ancak, birkac tanesinin eksik oldugunu fark ettim.

english: Anything I can do to help?
There is something you could do for me. I'm going to be busy...err...
translation: Bana yardim edebilecegin bir sey var. Ben mesgul olacagim... sey...

english: Mumble
Sorting, yes, sorting these bones out ready for the museum, but I need a few more.
translation: Bu kemikleri müzeye hazirlamak icin siralamaya calisacagim, ama birkac tane daha lazim.

english: Will you help me out by grabbing some?
translation: Birazini getirerek bana yardim eder misin?

english: Yes. I'll give you a hand.
You will? Excellent!
Snicker.
Where do you need me to dig?
Dig?
Oh, you must have got the wrong end of the stick.
I need some fresh, whole bones to replace ones that have become damaged.
translation: Hasar görmüs olanlarin yerine yeni, saglam kemiklere ihtiyacim var.

english: What?
Err...
Mumblemumblemumblemumblemumble. Mumblemumblemumblemumble. Mumble.
translation: Mumblemumblemumblemumblemumble. Mirildanma mirildanma mirildanma mirildanma. Mirildanma.

english: Excuse me...
Shhh!
Sorry...
Ok, got it.
Ok, here is the thing. While sorting out what bones I do have I managed to lose or damage a few. If you can get me some fresh, unbroken bones to use as replacements then I can get on with things.
translation: Tamam, durum su. Elimde olan kemikleri ayirirken birkacini kaybettim veya hasar verdim. Bana yenilerini, kirilmamis kemikleri getirirseniz, isime devam edebilirim.

english: That make things clearer?
Well, it makes some sense I suppose...
Great. If you can get me a bone from a Goblin, a Bear, a Big Frog, a Ram, a Unicorn, a Monkey, a Giant rat and a Giant Bat then I'll be able to move on with the...
translation: Harika. Bana bir Goblin, bir Ayi, bir Büyük Kurbaga, bir Koc, bir Tek Boynuzlu At, bir Maymun, bir Dev Sican ve bir Dev Yarasa kemigi bulabilirseniz, isime devam edebilirim...

english: Displays...
So you just want me to bring you these bones and that will be that?
translation: Yani sadece bu kemikleri getirmemi istiyorsun, hepsi bu mu?

english: Well, I wouldn't mind you sticking them in a pot and boiling them in vinegar first, if you don't mind.
translation: Eger sakincasi yoksa, önce onlari bir tencereye koyup sirke icinde kaynatirsan sevinirim.

english: There is a Wine Merchant in Draynor called Fortunato that sells the stuff you'll need.
translation: Draynor'da Fortunato adinda bir sarap tüccari var, ihtiyacin olan malzemeleri orada bulabilirsin.

english: You can even use my pot-boiler if you want.
Why do I need to boil them in vinegar?
It gets them bright and sparking white.
translation: Böylece parlak ve piril piril beyaz olurlar.

english: It's an archaeologist thing.
Just put the bone in a pot of vinegar, throw some logs on the fire, put the pot in the holder and light the logs.
translation: Kemikleri sirke dolu bir tencereye koy, atese birkac odun at, tencereyi tutucuya koy ve odunlari yak.

english: It takes a while for the vinegar to evaporate, but the bone will be nice and clean in the end.
translation: Sirkenin buharlasmasi biraz zaman alir, ama sonunda kemikler güzel ve temiz olur.

english: All right, I'll be back later.
Bye!
No.
Oh...I see.
Well, never mind me young man, I'll just stagger over here under my massive burden, and continue my thankless task.
translation: Bos ver beni genc adam, ben bu agir yükün altinda sendeleyerek buraya gelip, nankör görevime devam edecegim.

english: Unaided and alone...
Wow, trying a guilt trip much?
translation: Vay canina, sucluluk duygusu uyandirmaya mi calisiyorsun?

english: Well good luck with that!
Thanks stranger!
What a polite young man...
Well, back to work!
Where is that mumbling coming from?
What mumbling?
Anyway, I have enough problems of my own without dealing with a delusional adventurer.
translation: Her neyse, hayalperest bir maceraci ile ugrasmadan da yeterince sorunum var.

english: Sniggersnigger
Hello there!
I was just passing and I wondered if you still needed someone to help with the bones?
translation: Geciyordum da, kemiklerle ilgili yardima ihtiyacin var mi diye merak ettim?

english: Have you brought me any bones?
Not at the moment. Can you just give me a run down on which bones I have left to get?
translation: Su anda yok. Hangi kemikleri getirmem gerektigini bana söyleyebilir misin?

english: Sure.
You still need to bring me a Goblin bone.
Goblins are relatively common. I hear there is a house full of them around Lumbridge in fact.
translation: Goblinler nispeten yaygindir. Aslinda Lumbridge civarinda onlarla dolu bir ev oldugunu duydum.

english: You still need to bring me a Bear bone.
I heard that there are some Bears over by the Legends' Guild, near Ardougne.
translation: Ardougne yakinlarindaki Efsaneler Loncasi'nda bazi Ayilar oldugunu duydum.

english: You still need to bring me a Big Frog bone.
translation: Bana hala bir Büyük Kurbaga kemigi getirmelisin.

english: This might be a little tricky as you will need to go into the Lumbridge Swamp caves. You will need a light source! Never forget your light source down there!
translation: Bu biraz zor olabilir, cünkü Lumbridge Batakligi magaralarina girmen gerekecek. Bir isik kaynagina ihtiyacin olacak! Orada isik kaynagini asla unutma!

english: You still need to bring me a Ram bone.
translation: Bana hala bir Koc kemigi getirmelisin.

english: I'm sure you will be able to find a ram wherever there are sheep.
translation: Koyunlarin oldugu her yerde koc bulabileceginden eminim.

english: You still need to bring me a Unicorn bone.
translation: Bana hala bir Tek Boynuzlu At kemigi getirmelisin.

english: I seem to remember that there were Unicorns south of Varrock, I think they might be there still.
translation: Varrock'un güneyinde tek boynuzlu atlar oldugunu hatirliyorum, sanirim hala oradadirlar.

english: You still need to bring me a Monkey bone.
translation: Bana bir maymun kemigi daha getirmelisin.

english: Monkeys tend to live in Jungle areas, like Karamja. I think they are pretty plentiful there if I remember correctly.
translation: Maymunlar Karamja gibi ormanlik alanlarda yasarlar. Hatirladigim kadariyla orada oldukca fazla var.

english: You still need to bring me a Giant Rat bone.
translation: Bana bir dev sican kemigi daha getirmelisin.

english: If you can't find one in a sewer, then you might want to try looking in some caves.
You still need to bring me a Giant Bat bone.
translation: Bana dev yarasa kemigi de getirmelisin.

english: Giant bats tend to live underground, but I have heard there are a few near the Coal Pits.
translation: Dev yarasalar genellikle yer altinda yasarlar, ama kömür ocaklarinin yakininda birkac tane oldugunu duydum.

english: Did you get all that?
Yes. I'll get right on it.
Don't forget to boil them in vinegar first.
Just chuck some logs into the pit, put the bone in the pot of vinegar and drop it onto the pot-boiler. Then light the logs and wait for the the vinegar to boil away.
translation: Ocaga birkac odun at, kemigi sirke dolu tencereye koy ve tencereyi ocagin üzerine koy. Sonra odunlari yakin ve sirkenin kaynamasini bekleyin.

english: Ok, I'll remember.
I have some bones for you.
Great! Let me take a look at them.
That's the last of them!
The museum will be thrilled to know I've completed the collection.
translation: Müze, koleksiyonu tamamladigimi ögrenince cok sevinecek.

english: Well I'm just glad I could help.
Well you've been a big help and no mistake.
I'm always on the lookout for fresh bones, so if you see some bring them right over.
translation: Her zaman taze kemik ariyorum, eger görürsen hemen getir.

english: No problem, I'll be sure to bring anything you might like over if I find something.
translation: Sorun degil, bulursam istedigin her seyi getiririm.

english: I can't wait to see the displays once they are finished.
Quest complete!
Can I have a replacement helm? I managed to lose the last one.
translation: Yeniden bir migfer alabilir miyim? Sonuncusunu kaybettim.

english: No problem. I have plenty after all.
Thanks!
Can I have a replacement bonesack? I managed to lose the last one.
translation: Yedek kemik cantasi alabilir miyim? Sonuncusunu kaybettim de.

english: How's the sorting going?
Oh, the 'sorting' is going very well, very well indeed.
translation: Oh, “siralama” cok iyi gidiyor, gercekten cok iyi.

english: I'm glad to hear it!
Can I exchange this helm for the bonesack?
translation: Bu migferi kemik cantasiyla degistirebilir miyim?

english: I don't see why not.
There you go.
Come up and see me if you want to swap back.
translation: Geri degistirmek istersen gel beni gör.

english: Could I have a bonesack as well?
translation: Ben de bir kemik cuvali alabilir miyim?

english: I... do have many of each. I suppose it wouldn't be a problem.
translation: Her ikisinden de cok var. Sanirim sorun olmaz.

english: Come up and see me if you lose it.
Where was that mumbling coming from anyway?
You must be hearing things. I think you need to have a lie down.
translation: Kulaklarin cinliyor galiba. Bence biraz uzanmalisin.

english: Can I exchange this bonesack for the helm?
translation: Bu kemik cuvalini migferle degistirebilir miyim?

english: Could I have a helm as well?
translation: Ben de bir migfer alabilir miyim?

english: Hello.
Hello?
I found this amulet. Do you know what it is?
translation: Bu tilsimi buldum. Ne oldugunu biliyor musunuz?

english: It doesn't look like anything I've seen in the past, I don't think I'll have a use for it.
translation: Daha önce gördügüm hicbir seye benzemiyor, sanirim benim icin bir faydasi olmayacak.

english: Ahem!
Although actually, thinking about it, I can take it off your hands if you'd like?
For free? I've helped the museum enough, do you have anything I could exchange it for?
translation: Bedavaya mi? Müzeye yeterince yardim ettim, bununla takas edebilecegim bir seyiniz var mi?

english: I could give you 30 big bones per amulet, I've built up quite a collection recently.
translation: Tilsim basina 30 büyük kemik verebilirim, son zamanlarda epey bir koleksiyon olusturdum.

english: Here's 30 big bones, come back if you find another amulet.
translation: Iste 30 büyük kemik, baska tilsim bulursan tekrar gel.

english: No thank you. maybeanother time.
Here's [input * 30] big bones, come back if you find another amulet.
Anything I can do to help?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Yes
No
Well, good luck with that.
Where is that mumbling coming from?
Could I exchange this helm for the bonesack?
translation: Bu migferi kemik cuvaliyla takas edebilir miyim?

english: Could I have a bonesack as well?
translation: Ben de bir kemik cuvali alabilir miyim?

english: Where was that mumbling coming from anyway?
Could I exchange this bonesack for the helm?
translation: Bu kemik cuvalini migferle takas edebilir miyim?

english: Could I have a helm as well?
translation: Ben de bir migfer alabilir miyim?

english: Hey, human.
Who are you?
I am Odd Stone. Got named after some odd stone thing I found in the snowfields south of Weiss.
translation: Ben Odd Stone. Adimi, Weiss'in güneyindeki karli arazide buldugum tuhaf bir tastan aldim.

english: An odd stone thing?
Yeah, it were made of stone, and it were odd. Some weird bone-head human saw me trying to nibble it, an' he got really upset an' chased me away. He kinda scary.
translation: Evet, tastan yapilmisti ve garipti. Garip bir kemik kafali insan beni onu kemirmeye calisirken gördü, cok sinirlendi ve beni kovaladi. Biraz korkutucuydu.

english: Anyway, my parents they named me Odd Stone after that, and now we trolls not go anywhere near the place. Bone-head human was, like, really scary! And probably magic.
translation: Neyse, ailem bana o olaydan sonra Odd Stone adini verdi ve simdi biz troller o yere yaklasmiyoruz bile. Kemik kafali insan gercekten cok korkutucuydu! Ve muhtemelen sihirliydi.

english: Can I go looking for the odd stone?
No, we trolls blocked all routes to snowfields from here. Don't want scary bone-head human coming to Weiss.
translation: Hayir, biz troller buradan karli alanlara giden tüm yollari kapattik. Korkutucu kemik kafali insanin Weiss'a gelmesini istemiyoruz.

english: Thanks, that's interesting.
Tell me about this place.
This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: Burasi Weiss. Troller yillar önce, daha güneydeki magaralardan kovulduktan sonra burayi insa etti. Simdi Weiss bizim evimiz.

english: We done pretty good here. Got lots of goat and wolf to eat - they taste kinda boring after all this time, but there not much other choice.
translation: Burada oldukca iyi durumdayiz. Yemek icin bolca keci ve kurt var - bunca zamandan sonra tadi biraz sikici geliyor ama baska secenegimiz yok.

english: Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it. In fact My Arm is an expert on growing the stuff.
translation: Hic gut otu denedin mi? Onu seven troller taniyorum. Aslinda My Arm bu bitkinin yetistirilmesinde uzmandir.

english: Never heard of no gouty weed, no. But it sound like a vegetable, an' Mother not like eating those, so we probably not gonna try it.
translation: Gut otu diye bir sey duymadim. Ama sebzeye benziyor ve annem sebze yemeyi sevmez, o yüzden muhtemelen denemeyecegiz.

english: Mother not like new ideas much, but he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: Annem yeni fikirleri pek sevmez, ama o cok büyük ve patron, o yüzden ne derse onu yapariz.

english: I see.
Do you like it here?
Eh, it kinda rough, but it our home. Odd Mushroom say he can make it nicer with fancy fires what he invented, but Mother not interested in that, so Odd Mushroom not allowed to do it.
translation: Eh, biraz zorlu ama burasi bizim evimiz. Odd Mushroom, icat ettigi süslü ateslerle burayi daha güzel hale getirebilecegini söylüyor ama annem bununla ilgilenmiyor, bu yüzden Odd Mushroom bunu yapamiyor.

english: Mother only care about stuff to help him fight better. An he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: Annem sadece onun daha iyi savasmasina yardimci olacak seylerle ilgileniyor. O cok büyük ve patron, bu yüzden ne derse onu yapiyoruz.

english: I'll be off.
Hey, friend of Snowflake!
I am Odd Stone. Got named after some odd stone thing I found in snowfields south of Weiss.
translation: Ben Odd Stone. Adimi, Weiss'in güneyindeki karli arazilerde buldugum tuhaf bir tastan aldim.

english: Anyway, my parents, they named me Odd Stone after that, and now we trolls not go anywhere near the place. Bone-head human was, like, really scary! And probably magic.
translation: Neyse, ailem bana Odd Stone adini verdi ve simdi biz troller o yere yaklasmiyoruz bile. Kemik kafali insan gercekten cok korkutucuydu! Ve muhtemelen sihirliydi.

english: It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: Burasi harika, simdi Snowflake ve kocasi troll bize goutweed yetistirmeyi ögretti. Yemekler artik cok daha lezzetli.

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: Eh, biraz zor ama gittikce iyilesiyor. Snowflake bize goutweed yetistirmeyi ögretti. Keci, kurt, insan, goutweed ile cok daha lezzetli oluyor.

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: Evet, Weiss yasamak icin iyi bir yer, simdi Snowflake sorumlu. Tüm troller Snowflake'i seviyor. Kocasi biraz tuhaf ama bu bizim sorunumuz degil.

english: Who are you?
Can I go looking for the odd stone?
Thanks, that's interesting.
Tell me about this place.
Ever tried goutweed?
I see.
Do you like it here?
I'll be off.
What to buy? What to buy?
Oh, hello human.
Anything I can help you with?
Only if you can help me make a suggestion on what to buy.
translation: Ne alacagim konusunda bana öneride bulunabilirsen.

english: I smell a quest!
No, not really. I just need some advice on what to buy, that's all.
translation: Hayir, aslinda degil. Sadece ne alacagim konusunda tavsiyeye ihtiyacim var, hepsi bu.

english: You should buy some new clothes. You can't go around town wearing what you're wearing.
translation: Yeni kiyafetler almalisin. Su anda giydigin kiyafetlerle sehirde dolasamazsin.

english: You're right, this is a little drab. I shouldn't really go around Keldagrim-West wearing this, should I?
translation: Haklisin, bu biraz sikici. Keldagrim-West'te bunu giyerek dolasmamaliyim, degil mi?

english: Of course I still don't know what colour I should get. I don't want to accidentally offend the wrong company of course.
translation: Tabii ki hala hangi rengi alacagimi bilmiyorum. Yanlislikla yanlis bir grubu gücendirmek istemem tabii ki.

english: Never mind.
You should get yourself a big mighty warhammer.
translation: Kendine büyük ve güclü bir savas cekici almalisin.

english: I don't think so. The warhammer shop is run by the Red Axe. I'd rather stay out of there.
translation: Sanmiyorum. Savas cekici dükkani Kizil Balta tarafindan isletiliyor. Oradan uzak durmayi tercih ederim.

english: You don't like the Red Axe?
They're all a lot of bullies if you ask me.
But I thought they left the city?
They may have, but I still think that shopkeeper is in league with them, banners or no.
translation: Öyle olabilir, ama yine de o dükkan sahibinin onlarla isbirligi icinde oldugunu düsünüyorum, bayraklari olsun ya da olmasin.

english: Get yourself a long piece of rope.
What would I do with a rope?
I don't know. I generally find a rope useful while adventuring.
translation: Bilmiyorum. Genelde macera sirasinda ip kullanisli oluyor.

english: I don't do a lot of adventuring to be honest.
translation: Dürüst olmak gerekirse, pek macera yasamam.

english: An oversized hat. In a ridiculous colour.
translation: Büyük boy sapka. Komik bir renkte.

english: No one is selling hats here, that's not a very helpful suggestion at all.
translation: Burada sapka satan yok, bu hic de yararli bir öneri degil.

english: Nothing. You should buy absolutely nothing.
translation: Hicbir sey. Kesinlikle hicbir sey almamalisin.

english: Now that's the best idea I've heard all day.
translation: Bu, bugün duydugum en iyi fikir.

english: I thought so! Now why don't you give me some of the money I saved you?
translation: Ben de öyle düsündüm! Simdi, sana kazandirdigim paranin bir kismini bana vermeye ne dersin?

english: No, I don't think so. I think I'd rather buy something with my money after all.
translation: Hayir, sanmiyorum. Sonucta paramla bir seyler satin almayi tercih ederim.

english: New clothes.
A warhammer.
A piece of rope.
An oversized hat.
Nothing.
Well met, fellow adventurer! How can I help you?
translation: Merhaba, maceraci dostum! Nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: Who are you?
How frightfully rude of me, my dear [chap/girl]. My name is Odovacar and I work for that excellent enterprise, the Bank of Gielinor.
translation: Ne kadar kaba davrandim. Adim Odovacar ve mükemmel bir kurulus olan Gielinor Bankasi'nda calisiyorum.

english: If you work for the bank, what are you doing here?
translation: Bankada calisiyorsan, burada ne isin var?

english: As part of our ongoing service to provide you, the customer, with an absolutely world-class banking experience, we are investigating the option of opening a chain of travelling banks. These will provide you, our
translation: Müsterilerimize dünya standartlarinda bir bankacilik deneyimi sunmak icin sürdürdügümüz hizmetimizin bir parcasi olarak, gezici bankalar zinciri acma secenegini arastiriyoruz. Bu bankalar, siz

english: esteemed customer, with the convenience of having banking facilities where they will be of optimum use to you. Such as here!
translation: degerli müsterilerimize, bankacilik hizmetlerini en uygun sekilde kullanabileceginiz yerlerde bu hizmetleri sunma kolayligi saglayacaktir. Mesela burada!

english: Huh?
I am the first of a new generation of travelling bankers that will wander the perilous areas of the world to provide you, the valued customer, with a bank when you need it most!
