translation: Ben, degerli müsterilerimize en cok ihtiyac duyduklari anda banka hizmetleri sunmak icin dünyanin tehlikeli bölgelerinde dolasacak yeni nesil gezici bankacilar arasinda ilk kisiyim!

english: So I can access my bank account simply by talking to you?
translation: Yani sizinle konusarak banka hesabima erisebilir miyim?

english: Absolutely correct, dear [sir/lady]. I must warn you, however, that due to the significantly increased overheads of an enterprise such as this, there is a small bank charge of 100gp every time you want to access your account.
translation: Kesinlikle dogru, sevgili . Ancak, böyle bir girisimin önemli ölcüde artan genel giderleri nedeniyle, hesabiniza her erismek istediginizde 100 gp tutarinda kücük bir banka ücreti alinacagini belirtmeliyim.

english: I don't have the money. Can I get it from my bank?
It's not that I don't trust you to pay afterwards, old [chap/girl], but as the old adage goes, 'money comes before friends'.
translation: Sonradan ödeyeceginize güvenmedigimden degil, eski dostum, ama eski bir atasözünde de söylendigi gibi, “para dostluktan önce gelir”.

english: That's preposterous! I'm not paying to withdraw my own money!
translation: Bu sacmalik! Kendi parami cekmek icin para ödeyemem!

english: I'm sorry to hear that, [sir/madam]. If you should reconsider, because I believe this service offers excellent value for money, do not hesitate to contact me.
translation: Bunu duyduguma üzüldüm, . Bu hizmetin paranizin karsiligini fazlasiyla verdigine inandigim icin, fikrinizi degistirirseniz, lütfen benimle iletisime gecmekten cekinmeyin.

english: I'm afraid you don't have the necessary funds with you at this time so I can't allow you to access your account. Please come again, when you have 100 gold to cover the fee.
translation: Maalesef su anda gerekli paraya sahip degilsiniz, bu yüzden hesabiniza erismenize izin veremem. Ücreti karsilayacak 100 altininiz oldugunda lütfen tekrar gelin.

english: I'd like to check my PIN settings.
I'd like to collect items.
I'm afraid you don't have the necessary funds with you at this time so I can't allow you to collect your items. Please come again, when you have 100 gold to cover the fee.
translation: Maalesef su anda gerekli paraya sahip degilsiniz, bu yüzden ögelerinizi almaniza izin veremem. Ücreti karsilayacak 100 altininiz oldugunda lütfen tekrar gelin.

english: How frightfully rude of me, my dear [chap/lady]. My name is Odovacar and I work for that excellent enterprise, the Bank of Gielinor.
translation: Ne kadar kaba davrandim, sevgili . Benim adim Odovacar ve mükemmel bir kurulus olan Gielinor Bankasi'nda calisiyorum.

english: My services will cost you 100 coins.
Here's 100 coins. Let me access my account now.
As an Ultimate Iron  you cannot use the bank.
Here's 100 coins. Let me collect my items now.
I'd like to access my bank account, please.
Sorry, I don't perform that service.
Who are you?
If you work for the bank, what are you doing here?
translation: Bankada calisiyorsaniz, burada ne isiniz var?

english: I don't have the money. Can I get it from my bank?
That's preposterous! I'm not paying to withdraw my own money!
translation: Bu sacmalik! Kendi parami cekmek icin para ödemeyecegim!

english: I'd like to access my bank account, please.
I'd like to check my PIN settings.
I'd like to collect items.
Here's 100 coins. Let me access my account now.
Here's 100 coins. Let me collect my items now.
translation: Iste 100 jeton. Simdi esyalarimi almak istiyorum.

english: As an Ultimate Iron [Man/Woman] you cannot use the bank.
Dad says you can get a lift to Karamja with us if you want? But you's gives us two chompy first!
translation: Babam, istersen Karamja'ya bizimle birlikte gidebilecegini söylüyor. Ama önce bize iki chompy ver!

english: You's got no chompies...no boatsie trips!
translation: Chompy'lerin yoksa... tekne gezisi de yok!

english: Player is transported west of Tai Bwo Wannai.
translation: Oyuncu Tai Bwo Wannai'nin batisina tasinir.

english: The barely sea-worthy log arrives at Karamja beach.
translation: Denize pek uygun olmayan kütük Karamja sahiline varir.

english: No thanks.
Dad says you can get a lift back with us if you want? But you's gives us two glug-glugs herbies first!
translation: Baban, istersen bizimle geri dönebilirsin diyor. Ama önce bize iki glug-glug herbies ver!

english: Dad sez yous not bringin' da rummy stuff...das bad stuffsies un we get in big bads.
translation: Baban, rom gibi seyler getirme diyor... onlar kötü seyler ve basimizi belaya sokarlar.

english: You's got no glug-glugs herbies...no boatsie trips!
translation: Glug-glug herbies'in yoksa... tekne gezisi de yok!

english: You hand over two herbs and accept a ride from Fycie and Bugs on the makeshift boat.
translation: Iki bitki verip Fycie ve Bugs'in gecici teknesiyle gitmeyi kabul ediyorsun.

english: Player is transported to eastern Feldip Hills.
The barely sea-worthy log arrives at the Feldip Hills.
translation: Denize cikmaya pek uygun olmayan kütük Feldip Tepeleri'ne variyor.

english: Yes please, I'll get a lift to Karamja with you.
No thanks.
Yes please, I'll get a lift back with you.
Hey yous tryin' not to get da sickies else yous be da sick-un and mebe get to be a dead-un if yous be da unlucky fing.
translation: Hey, hasta olmamaya calisin, yoksa hasta olursunuz ve sanssizsaniz ölürsünüz.

english: Don't worry, I know how to take care of myself.
Yeah, whats yous wants creatures?
What are you doing here?

I's is guardin' da coffins-ies- make sure no fieves nick stuff from 'em. If dey's do, dey get's bashed and shoved down da big 'ole and get deaded by da zogries in da deadies place. So yous creature be wares...ok!
translation: Tabutlari koruyorum, kimse onlardan bir sey calmasin diye. Eger calarsa, dövülür ve büyük delige itilir ve ölülerin yerinde zogries tarafindan öldürülür. Yani siz yaratiklar dikkatli olun... tamam mi!

english: What's going on around here?
Da Zogries comes from da deadies place - deys attacking all da jig-dancers wot do da god stuff... jiggin an all. Dem zogries gonna dead all on us wiv da sickies.
translation: Zogries ölülerin yerinden geliyor - tanri isleri yapan tüm jig danscilarina saldiriyorlar... jig dansi falan. Zogries, hepimizi hastalarla öldürecek.

english: What are these coffins doing here?
We's grabbed da closes dead-uns to stop da zogries gettin' em..de'se dead-uns coffins got da old-uns boneses and older-stuff in 'em, Grish seys we's needs to guard 'em...I's does what Grish seys.
translation: Zogries'in onlari almasini engellemek icin en yakin ölüleri aldik... Bu tabutlarda yaslilarin kemikleri ve daha eski seyler var, Grish onlari korumamiz gerektigini söylüyor... Ben Grish'in dediklerini yaparim.

english: Are you always angry?
Me's was born angry....me's wantin' to dead many peples...is what ogries meant to do...
translation: Ben kizgin dogdum... bircok insani öldürmek istiyorum... ogrelerin yapmasi gereken budur...

english: Sorry, I have to go.
Stop, creature! Only ogres and their friends allowed in this city. Show me a sign of companionship, like a lost relic or somefing, and you may pass.
translation: Dur, yaratik! Bu sehre sadece ogreler ve onlarin dostlari girebilir. Bana dostlugunun bir isaretini göster, kayip bir kalinti falan, o zaman gecebilirsin.

english: Until then, back to whence you came!
translation: O zamana kadar, geldigin yere geri dön!

english: Halt! You cannot pass here.
I am a friend to ogres.
You will be my friend only with gold. Bring me a bar of pure gold and I will let you pass.
translation: Sadece altinla benim dostum olabilirsin. Bana bir külce saf altin getir, seni gecireyim.

english: Creature, did you bring me the gold?
No, I don't have it.
No gold, no passage. Get out of this city!
translation: Altin yoksa, gecis yok. Bu sehirden defol!

english: Here it is!
It's brought it! On your way.
What are you doing here?
What's going on around here?
What are these coffins doing here?
Are you always angry?
Sorry, I have to go.
So much blood flows through these lands.
translation: Bu topraklarda cok fazla kan akiyor.

english: Where does the blood come from?
Throughout the generations, countless people of this land have perished in times of strife, with their bodies left to rot where they fell.
translation: Nesiller boyunca, bu topraklardaki sayisiz insan catismalarda can verdi ve bedenleri düstükleri yerde cürümeye terk edildi.

english: Some were slain by the deadly creatures that roam the land; others perished at the hands of their fellow citizens during the wars of this land.
translation: Bazilari bu topraklarda dolasan ölümcül yaratiklar tarafindan öldürüldü; digerleri ise bu topraklardaki savaslar sirasinda kendi vatandaslarinin elinde can verdi.

english: Their blood flowed into the soil, pooling and percolating unseen in the dark, as the power of the Altar drew it to this sacred place to form the River.
translation: Kanlari topraga akip karanlikta görünmeden birikip süzüldü, Altar'in gücü onu bu kutsal yere cekerek Nehri olusturdu.

english: Why are you here?
The blood is the blood of Kourend's citizens. It is fitting that we honour their memory.
translation: Bu kan, Kourend vatandaslarinin kani. Onlarin anisini onurlandirmamiz uygun olur.

english: Also, it smells so good.
I'll leave you to enjoy the view.
translation: Manzaranin tadini cikarman icin seni yalniz birakacagim.

english: I see the river foaming with much blood.
Where does the blood come from?
Why are you here?
I'll leave you to enjoy the view.
translation: Manzaranin tadini cikarman icin seni yalniz birakacagim.

english: Hello there. So you're a bard?
I am afraid I cannot speak to outerlanders. Besides, I am busy composing an epic.
translation: Korkarim ki yabancilarla konusamam. Ayrica, bir destan bestelemekle mesgulüm.

english: Hello? Yes? You want something, outerlander?
translation: Merhaba? Evet? Bir sey mi istiyorsun, yabanci?

english: Are you a member of the council?
Why, indeed I am, outerlander! My talents as an exemplary musician made it difficult for them not to accept me! Why do you wish to know this?
translation: Evet, öyleyim, yabanci! Örnek bir müzisyen olarak yeteneklerim, beni kabul etmemelerini zorlastirdi! Neden bilmek istiyorsun?

english: Well, I ask because I am currently doing the Fremennik trials so as to join your clan. I need seven of the twelve council of elders to vote for me.
translation: Su anda klaniniza katilmak icin Fremennik denemelerini yapiyorum da ondan soruyorum. On iki yasli konsey üyesinden yedisinin bana oy vermesi gerekiyor.

english: Ahhh... and you wish to earn my vote? I will gladly accept you as a Fremennik should you be able to prove yourself to have a little musical ability!
translation: Ahhh... benim oyumu mu istiyorsun? Biraz müzik yetenegin oldugunu kanitlayabilirsen, seni Fremennik olarak kabul etmekten memnuniyet duyarim!

english: So how would I do that?
Why, by playing in our longhall! All you need to do is impress the revellers there with a few verses of an epic of your own creation!
translation: Neden mi? Uzun salonumuzda calarak! Tek yapman gereken, kendi yarattigin bir destanin birkac dizesiyle oradaki eglence severleri etkilemek!

english: So what say you outerlander? Are you up for the challenge?
translation: Ee, ne dersin yabanci? Bu meydan okumaya var misin?

english: Sure! This certainly sounds pretty easy to accomplish - I'll have your vote in no time!
translation: Tabii ki! Bu kesinlikle basarmasi oldukca kolay bir sey gibi görünüyor - oyunuzu hemen alacagim!

english: That is great news outerlander! We always need more music lovers here!
translation: Bu harika bir haber yabanci! Burada her zaman daha fazla müzik severlere ihtiyacimiz var!

english: Forget it! This all sounds like way too much work for a stupid vote at a meeting! I'll find someone else instead.
translation: Unut gitsin! Bunlarin hepsi, toplantida aptalca bir oy icin cok fazla is gibi geliyor! Baska birini bulacagim.

english: So how would I go about writing this epic?
Well, first of all you are going to need an instrument. Like all true bards you are going to have to make this yourself.
translation: Öncelikle bir enstrümana ihtiyacin olacak. Tüm gercek ozanlar gibi, bunu kendin yapman gerekecek.

english: How do I make an instrument?
Well, it is a long and drawn-out process. Just east of this village there is an unusually musical tree that can be used to make very high quality instruments.
translation: Bu uzun ve zahmetli bir sürec. Bu köyün dogusunda, cok kaliteli enstrümanlar yapmak icin kullanilabilecek, alisilmadik derecede müzikal bir agac var.

english: Cut a piece from it, and then carve it into a special shape that will allow you to string it. Using a knife as you would craft any other wooden object would be best for this.
translation: Ondan bir parca kes ve onu telleri takabilecegin özel bir sekle oy. Bunun icin en iyisi, diger ahsap nesneleri yaparken kullandigin bicagi kullanmak.

english: Then what do I need to do?
Next you will need to string your lyre. There is a troll to the South-east who has some golden wool. I would not recommend using anything else to string your lyre with.
translation: Sonra lirine telleri takman gerekecek. Güneydoguda altin yünü olan bir trol var. Liranizi tellemek icin baska bir sey kullanmanizi önermem.

english: Anything else?
Well, when you have crafted your lyre you will need the blessing of the Fossegrimen to tune your lyre to perfection before you even consider a public performance.
translation: Liranizi yaptiktan sonra, halka acik bir performans düsünmeden önce, liranizi mükemmel bir sekilde akort etmek icin Fossegrimen'in kutsamasini almaniz gerekecek.

english: Who or what is Fossegrimen?
Fossegrimen is a lake spirit that lives just a little way South-west of this village. Make her an offering of fish, and you will then be ready for your performance.
translation: Fossegrimen, bu köyün biraz güneybatisinda yasayan bir göl ruhudur. Ona balik sunarsan, performansina hazir olursun.

english: Make sure you give her a suitable offering however. If the offering is found to be unworthy, then you may find yourself unable to play your lyre with any skill at all!
translation: Ancak ona uygun bir sunum yaptigindan emin ol. Sunumun degersiz oldugu anlasilirsa, lirini hic beceriyle calamayabilirsin!

english: So what would be a worthy offering?
translation: Peki, degerli bir sunum ne olabilir?

english: A raw shark, manta ray, or sea turtle should be sufficient as an offering.
translation: Cig köpekbaligi, manta vatozu veya deniz kaplumbagasi sunum olarak yeterli olacaktir.

english: Okay, what else do I need to do?
When you have crafted your lyre and been blessed by Fossegrimen, then you will finally be ready to make your performance to the revellers at the longhall.
translation: Lirini yaptin ve Fossegrimen'in kutsamasini aldiktan sonra, nihayet uzun salondaki eglencecilere performansini sergilemeye hazir olacaksin.

english: Head past the bouncers and onto the stage, and then begin to play. If all goes well, you should find the music spring to your mind and sing your own epic on the spot.
translation: Kapi görevlilerini gecip sahneye cik ve calmaya basla. Her sey yolunda giderse, müzik aklina gelmeli ve kendi destanini o anda söylemelisin.

english: I will observe both you and the audience, and if you show enough talent, I will happily vote in your favour at the council of elders.
translation: Hem seni hem de seyircileri gözlemleyecegim ve yeterince yetenekli oldugunu gösterirsen, yaslilar konseyinde senin lehine oy kullanmaktan mutluluk duyarim.

english: Is that clear enough, outerlander? Would you like me to repeat anything?
translation: Yeterince acik mi, yabancim? Tekrar etmemi ister misin?

english: Can you remind me about making a lyre again, please Olaf?
translation: Lir yapimini tekrar hatirlatir misin lütfen Olaf?

english: There are three parts to making the lyre; First you need to cut some special wood from the special musical tree which can be found just east of Rellekka.
translation: Lir yapiminda üc asama vardir: Öncelikle, Rellekka'nin dogusunda bulunan özel müzik agacindan özel bir agac kesmelisin.

english: When you have the wood, you will need to use a knife to craft it into a Lyre. When you have an unstrung lyre, you will need to string it before you can play it.
translation: Ahsabi aldiktan sonra, bir bicak kullanarak onu lir haline getirmelisin. Telli olmayan bir lir elde ettiginde, onu calabilmek icin telleri takman gerekir.

english: I would not use anything other than the golden string of Lalli, a troll who lives in a cave just to the South-east.
translation: Güneydogudaki bir magarada yasayan trol Lalli'nin altin tellerinden baska bir sey kullanmam.

english: Can you remind me about getting a blessing from Fossegrimen again?
translation: Fossegrimen'den kutsama almayi tekrar hatirlatir misin?

english: Certainly outerlander! Fossegrimen is a lake spirit who lives in the lake just to the South-west of here. She will bless you so that you may play your lyre,
translation: Elbette yabanci! Fossegrimen, buradan güneybatiya dogru bulunan gölde yasayan bir göl ruhudur. Ona layik bir adak sunarsan, lirini calabilmen icin seni kutsayacaktir.

english: if you give her a worthy offering. She will only accept raw fish, so place a raw fish on her pedestal, and she will bless you. The better the offering, the longer
translation: O sadece cig balik kabul eder, bu yüzden kaidesine cig balik koyarsan seni kutsayacaktir. Adak ne kadar iyi olursa,

english: the amount of time you will be blessed for. You will not be able to perform on stage without the blessing of the Fossegrimen.
translation: kutsama süresi de o kadar uzun olur. Fossegrimen'in kutsamasi olmadan sahnede performans sergileyemezsin.

english: (shows previous options)
Can you remind me about how to perform at the longhall again please?
translation: Lütfen uzun salonda nasil performans sergileyecegimi tekrar hatirlatir misin?

english: Not a problem outerlander. When you have your lyre and have been blessed, you will be able to pass the bouncer at the stage entrance of the longhall.
translation: Sorun degil, yabanci. Lirani aldiginda ve kutsandiginda, uzun salonun sahne girisindeki kapi görevlisini gecebileceksin.

english: He will not let you pass unless he believes you are ready to perform on stage. Simply go past him and onto the stage and use your lyre, and you will
translation: Sahneye cikmaya hazir olduguna inanmadikca seni gecmesine izin vermeyecektir. Onu gecip sahneye cik ve lirini kullan,

english: begin to play to entertain the revellers. If all has gone well, you will feel the music come to your mind, unbidden, as you sing an epic of your exploits.
translation: eglenenleri eglendirmek icin calmaya baslayacaksin. Her sey yolunda giderse, kahramanliklarini anlatan bir destan söylerken, müzik zihnine kendiliginden gelecektir.

english: I will watch your performance from backstage, and also study how much the crowd likes you, and if I believe you have enough talent, then I will vote for you at the council.
translation: Perde arkasindan performansini izleyecegim ve kalabaligin seni ne kadar sevdigini inceleyecegim. Yeterli yetenegin olduguna inanirsam, konseyde sana oy verecegim.

english: No thanks, I think that's all pretty straight forward. I'll go and make my lyre now.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, bence her sey oldukca acik. Simdi gidip lirimi yapacagim.

english: Congratulations! You have completed the Bard's Trial!
As you finished playing you felt Fossegrimen's power leave you...
translation: Calmayi bitirdiginde, Fossegrimen'in gücünün senden ayrildigini hissettin...

english: Wow! That was awesome! You are one of the greatest bards I have ever had the pleasure of watching performing!
translation: Vay canina! Harikaydi! Sen, izlemekten zevk aldigim en büyük bardlardan birisin!

english: You have certainly earned my vote! I hope we can duet together soon!
translation: Oyumu kesinlikle hak ettin! Umarim yakinda birlikte düet yapabiliriz!

english: So can I rely on your vote with the council of elders in my favour?
translation: Yani, yaslilar konseyinde oyumu sana verebilirim, degil mi?

english: You have a truly poetic soul! Anyone who can compose such a beautiful epic, and then perform it so flawlessly can only bring good to our clan!
translation: Gercekten siirsel bir ruhun var! Böylesine güzel bir destan besteleyip, onu bu kadar kusursuz bir sekilde icra edebilen biri, klanimiza sadece iyilik getirebilir!

english: Erm... so that's a yes, then?
Absolutely! We must collaborate together on a duet sometime, don't you think?
translation: Kesinlikle! Bir ara birlikte düet yapmaliyiz, sence de öyle degil mi?

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a love ballad, do you?
translation: Ask baladini nerede bulabilecegimi biliyor musun?

english: Well, as official Fremennik bard, it falls within my remit to compose all music for the tribe. I am fully versed in all the various types of romantic music.
translation: Sey, resmi Fremennik ozani olarak, kabile icin tüm müzikleri bestelemek benim görevimdir. Romantik müzigin tüm türlerinde oldukca bilgiliyim.

english: Great! Can you write me one then?
translation: Harika! O zaman bana bir tane yazabilir misin?

english: Well... normally I would be thrilled at the chance to show my skill as a poet in composing a seductively romantic ballad...
translation: Sey... normalde, bastan cikarici romantik bir balad besteleyerek sairlik yetenegimi gösterme firsati beni cok heyecanlandirirdi...

english: let me guess; here comes the 'but'.
...but unfortunately I cannot concentrate fully upon my work recently.
translation: ...ama ne yazik ki son zamanlarda isime tam olarak konsantre olamiyorum.

english: Why is that then?
It is these old worn out shoes of mine... As a bard I am expected to wander the lands, singing of the glorious battles of our warriors.
translation: Bu eski, yipranmis ayakkabilarim yüzünden... Bir ozan olarak, topraklari dolasip savascilarimizin sanli savaslarini sarkilarla anlatmam beklenir.

english: If you can find me a pair of sturdy boots to replace these old worn out ones of mine, I will be happy to spend the time on composing you a romantic ballad.
translation: Eski, yipranmis ayakkabilarimin yerine saglam bir cift bot bulabilirsen, sana romantik bir balad yazmak icin seve seve zamanimi harcayacagim.

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find some custom sturdy boots, do you?
translation: Özel yapim saglam botlari nerede bulabilecegimi biliyor musun?

english: I'm sorry outerlander... If I did, I would not trouble you to go and find them for me, would I?
translation: Üzgünüm yabanci... Bilseydim, seni benim icin bulmaya zahmet ettirmezdi, degil mi?

english: Hello Olaf. Do you have a beautiful love song written for me?
translation: Merhaba Olaf. Benim icin güzel bir ask sarkisi yazdin mi?

english: That depends outerlander... Do you have some new boots for me? My feet get so tired roaming the land...
translation: Bu sana bagli yabanci... Bana yeni botlar getirdin mi? Ayaklarim bu topraklari dolasmaktan cok yoruldu...

english: As a matter of fact - I do!
Oh! Superb! Those are great! They're just what I was looking for! Here, take this song with my compliments! It is one of my finest works yet!
translation: Oh! Harika! Bunlar mükemmel! Tam da aradigim sey! Al, bu sarkiyi sana hediye ediyorum! Bu benim en iyi eserlerimden biri!

english: So you think this song is pretty good then?
translation: Yani bu sarkiyi oldukca iyi buluyorsun?

english: Ahhh.... outerlander... it is the most beautiful romantic ballad I have ever been inspired to write...
translation: Ahhh... yabanci... Bu, yazmak icin ilham aldigim en güzel romantik balad...

english: Only a woman with a heart of icey stone could fail to be moved by its beauty!
translation: Sadece buz gibi bir kalbi olan bir kadin bu sarkinin güzelliginden etkilenmez!

english: Thanks! That sounds perfect!
Hello again to you [Fremennik name]. Us bards should stick together, what?
translation: Merhaba Dokrak. Biz ozanlar birbirimize destek olmaliyiz, degil mi?

english: About the Music Cape...
I believe you are the person to talk to if I want to get a Music Cape?
translation: Müzik Pelerini almak istersem seninle konusmam gerekir, degil mi?

english: That's right! If you know that then you'll also know that they cost 99000 coins.
translation: Dogru! Bunu biliyorsan, fiyatinin 99.000 sikke oldugunu da biliyorsundur.

english: No, I hadn't heard that.
Well, they do.
Have fun with it.
I don't have that much at the moment.
translation: Su anda o kadar param yok.

english: Save up some more then!
Yes, I know.
May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: Pelerinim icin baska bir baslik alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
The bard hands you another hood for your cape.
translation: Ozan, pelerin icin baska bir baslik verir.

english: Yes, but you don't know all of the music in the land.
translation: Evet, ama bu topraklardaki tüm müzikleri bilmiyorsun.

english: Do you know any great stories about Basilisk Jaws?
translation: Basilisk Jaws hakkinda harika hikayeler biliyor musun?

english: Why do you ask?
Oh my! This must be the jaw of a legendary Basilisk Knight. There's a great song about how the Fremennik warriors of old would use these jaws to enhance their helmets.
translation: Aman Tanrim! Bu efsanevi Basilisk Sövalyesinin cenesi olmali. Eski Fremennik savascilarinin bu ceneleri migferlerini güclendirmek icin kullandiklari hakkinda harika bir sarki var.

english: I see. I have a nice helmet that Neitiznot's Burgher gave to me. I bet it would work well with that.
translation: Anliyorum. Neitiznot'un Burgher'inin bana verdigi güzel bir migferim var. Eminim bununla iyi gider.

english: I'm sure it would, [Fremennik name]. Now, do you want to hear the song?
translation: Eminim ki öyle olur, Dokrak. Simdi, sarkiyi dinlemek ister misin?

english: Err... I think I'll pass. Thanks for the help though.
translation: Sey... Sanirim pas gececegim. Yine de yardimin icin tesekkürler.

english: I was wondering... Can I learn to play my lyre again?
translation: Merak ediyordum da... Lirimi tekrar calmayi ögrenebilir miyim?

english: Well, that is an interesting question. Let me let you into a little secret. If you make another offering to Fossegrimen you will learn a secret melody.
translation: Bu ilginc bir soru. Sana kücük bir sir vereyim. Fossegrimen'e bir kez daha adak adarsan, gizli bir melodi ögreneceksin.

english: What kind of melody?
It is the song of Rellekka. When you play it, it will bring you back to this town wherever you are in this world.
translation: Rellekka'nin sarkisi. Onu caldiginda, dünyanin neresinde olursan ol, seni bu kasabaya geri getirecek.

english: We often go adventuring with bards for precisely this reason; No matter where we have ended up we can return safe and sound to home.
translation: Biz de tam bu nedenle sik sik ozanlarla maceraya cikariz; nereye gidersek gidelim, sag salim evimize dönebiliriz.

english: Thanks Olaf!
Yes
No
Remind me about crafting a lyre
Remind me about Fossegrimen
Remind me about playing on stage
I don't need a reminder
Ask about the Merchant's trial
Ask about becoming a Fremennik
About the Music Cape...
Cape
No, I hadn't heard that!
Ok, I'll pay.
I'm not paying that!
Yes, I do.
Hood
Do you know any great stories about Basilisk Jaws?
translation: Basilisk Jaws hakkinda harika hikayeler biliyor musun?

english: Can I learn to play my lyre again?
It's mine. You can't have it, we found it!
translation: O benim. Onu alamazsin, biz bulduk!

english: What have you found?
Not dragonstones. I like dragonstones, that's why I came here. However, I found a valuable coin instead, it speaks to me... but you can't have it! It's precious to me!
translation: Ejderha taslari degil. Ejderha taslarini severim, bu yüzden buraya geldim. Ancak onun yerine degerli bir sikke buldum, bana sesleniyor... ama onu alamazsin! O benim icin cok degerli!

english: I don't want it, I have something better.
What is it? Is it dragonstones? I like dragonstones!
translation: Nedir o? Ejderha taslari mi? Ejderha taslarini severim!

english: Ask it for five! It looks rich!
Five? Will it give us five?
translation: Bes mi? Bize bes tane verir mi?

english: No. I don't have five dragonstones.
Well then we are not interested!
Yes. I have five dragonstones, tell you what, I'll trade you them for that coin you found.
translation: Evet. Bes ejderha tasim var, bak ne diyecegim, buldugunuz o sikkeyle takas edelim.

english: Yes! Yes! We'll trade it for the dragonstones.
translation: Evet! Evet! Ejderha taslariyla takas edelim.

english: No we will not! It is too precious!
But why? I like dragonstones...
It is trying to trick us! Evil, nasty creature it is. Do not listen to it!
translation: Bizi kandirmaya calisiyor! Kötü, igrenc bir yaratik. Onu dinlemeyin!

english: But it seems nice enough...
I am standing right here, you know? You really are crazy. Yes, I'll give you five! Do we have a deal or not?
translation: Ben buradayim, biliyor musun? Sen gercekten delisin. Evet, size bes tane verecegim! Anlastik mi, anlasmadik mi?

english: Yes! Yes!
You give Olbertus a dragonstone and receive a very worn coin in return.
translation: Olbertus'a bir ejderha tasi veriyorsun ve karsiliginda cok yipranmis bir sikke aliyorsun.

english: Thanks for helping me, I'm not sure what would have happened if I had continued to listen to the voices in my head.
translation: Yardim ettigin icin tesekkürler, kafamdaki sesleri dinlemeye devam etseydim ne olurdu bilmiyorum.

english: I took that coin from the Stone Relief in the Crypt of the Moon and trapped my friend Eodan in a secret room behind the relief. Could you return the coin to the relief and set him free?
translation: O sikkeyi Ay Mezarindaki Tas Kabartmadan aldim ve arkadasim Eodan'i kabartmanin arkasindaki gizli odaya hapsettim. Sikkeyi kabartmaya geri koyup onu serbest birakabilir misin?

english: On second thoughts, I'll keep it for myself.
translation: Bir daha düsündüm de, kendim saklayacagim.

english: Since it's valuable, I think I'll just just kill you for it.
translation: Degerli oldugu icin, onu almak icin seni öldürecegim.

english: Please! No!
This is a dangerous fight, you will lose your items on death.
translation: Bu tehlikeli bir dövüs, öldügünde esyalarini kaybedeceksin.

english: Foolish decision!
I require this one alive human!
Just kidding!
You're crazy!
Thanks for killing that creature.
It appears that when I stole the coin, the creature possessed me.
translation: Görünüse göre parayi caldigimda yaratik beni ele gecirdi.

english: I'm glad I no longer have that coin. I'm not sure what would have happened if I had continued to listen to the voices in my head.
translation: Artik o madeni paraya sahip olmadigim icin mutluyum. Kafamdaki sesleri dinlemeye devam etseydim ne olacagini bilmiyorum.

english: For some reason the coin returned to me. Here, take it before it corrupts me again!
translation: Nedense madeni para bana geri döndü. Al, beni tekrar yozlastirmadan önce al!

english: I'm glad I no longer have that coin. I'm not sure what would have happened if I had continued to listen the voices in my head.
translation: Artik o madeni paraya sahip olmadigim icin mutluyum. Kafamdaki sesleri dinlemeye devam etseydim ne olacagini bilmiyorum.

english: What have you found?
I don't want it, I have something better.
translation: Istemiyorum, daha iyi bir seyim var.

english: Yes, give him your dragonstones.
No, don't give him your dragonstones.
Since it's valuable, I think I'll just just kill you for it.
translation: Degerli oldugu icin, sanirim onu almak icin seni öldürecegim.

english: Attack Olbertus.
Just kidding.
You're crazy!
Hello again!
Hmph!
What do you do here?
Hmph! Why? What do I know? I'm just an old man; what would anyone want with an old man?
translation: Hmph! Neden? Ne bileyim? Ben sadece yasli bir adamim; kimse yasli bir adamdan ne ister ki?

english: I'm lost... Can you help me?
Hmph! Who says I'm not lost, eh? Ever think of that, did you?
translation: Hmph! Kim demis ben kaybolmadim diye, ha? Hic bunu düsündün mü?

english: In a rush to find out all the answers, not thinking for a second that someone else might be just as lost, if not more lost, than you! And what do you care about them, huh?
translation: Tüm cevaplari bulmak icin acele ediyorsun, bir saniye bile baskalarinin da en az senin kadar kaybolmus olabilecegini düsünmüyorsun! Onlari neden umursuyorsun ki?

english: Do you know about the Myreque?
Hmph! Why should I know about the Myreque, eh? What use have they ever been to me, huh? I ask you!
translation: Hmph! Myreque'yi neden bileyim ki? Bana ne faydasi var ki? Sana soruyorum!

english: Can you help me?
Hmph! What makes you think that I can help you, eh? Do I look like a fountain of knowledge, eh? Do I?
translation: Hmph! Neden sana yardim edebilecegimi düsünüyorsun, ha? Bilgi kaynagi gibi mi görünüyorum, ha? Öyle mi?

english: Well, you've helped me before! You said something about symbols? To find the Myreque!
translation: Ama daha önce bana yardim etmistin! Sembollerden bahsetmistin! Myreque'yi bulmak icin!

english: Hmph! Yes of course, that's how to get to them. Follow the symbols.
translation: Hmph! Evet, tabii ki, onlara ulasmanin yolu bu. Sembolleri takip et.

english: Which symbols?
The symbol of the Myreque - the silver sickle!
Oh, and where would that be then?
Around and about; it should be an aid.
Okay, thanks
But they live right under your house?
translation: Ama senin evinin altinda mi yasiyorlar?

english: Hmph! Suppose they do. Stupid Myreque...
Well, you've helped me before! You helped me find the Myreque!
translation: Daha önce bana yardim etmistin! Myreque'yi bulmama yardim etmistin!

english: Hmph! Yes of course, follow the symbols and all that. Pointless now though, they're right below us. Hmph!
translation: Hmph! Evet, tabii ki, sembolleri takip et ve digerlerini. Ama artik anlamsiz, bizim altimizda yasiyorlar. Hmph!

english: Okay, thanks.
Hmph! Dead! That's what I know about the Myreque. You're lucky to not be dead as well. Don't talk about them any more!
translation: Hmph! Ölü! Myreque hakkinda bildigim tek sey bu. Sen de ölmedigin icin sanslisin. Onlar hakkinda daha fazla konusma!

english: Hmph! Yes of course, follow the symbols and all that. Pointless now though, they're all dead! Hmph!
translation: Hmph! Evet, tabii ki, sembolleri takip et ve digerlerini. Ama artik anlamsiz, hepsi öldü! Hmph!

english: Ah! vampyre!
It's okay. It's just me.
Here, solve this.
Please make yourself some space, I have something for you.
translation: Lütfen biraz yer ac, sana bir sey verecegim.

english: That doesn't look solved to me.
Well done [Player name]. Here you go.
You've obtained [another clue scroll/a casket]!
What do you do here?
I'm lost... Can you help me?
Do you know about the Myreque?
Can you help me?
Okay, thanks
Okay, thanks.
What brings you here, young [man/lady/one]?
I'm just wandering around.
Oh, that's nice. I used to wander around, back when my legs were better. So long ago.
translation: Oh, ne güzel. Ben de eskiden, bacaklarim daha iyiyken dolasirdim. Cok uzun zaman önceydi.

english: Nothing, really.
That's the trouble with young people these days. Not my boy, though. He's a good boy, always working. That's why he never visits. Run along now, young [man/lady/one].
translation: Bugünün genclerinin sorunu da bu. Ama benim oglum öyle degil. O iyi bir cocuk, hep calisiyor. Bu yüzden hic ziyaret etmiyor. Hadi git artik, genc .

english: Marlo sent me to fix your furniture.
translation: Marlo beni mobilyalarini tamir etmem icin gönderdi.

english: My boy Marlo sent you? Oh yes, you've come to help with my furniture. It's in a terrible state. You'll want to start by removing all the tatty old furniture.
translation: Oglum Marlo mu gönderdi seni? Evet, mobilyalarimi tamir etmeye geldin. Berbat durumdalar. Önce eski, yipranmis mobilyalari kaldirmalisin.

english: There are two stools, two tables, a chair and a rotten carpet to replace. I need a better bed too. Let me know when you've removed all the old furniture.
translation: Iki tabure, iki masa, bir sandalye ve cürümüs bir hali var. Daha iyi bir yataga da ihtiyacim var. Eski mobilyalari kaldirdiginda bana haber ver.

english: Ah, young [man/lady/one], how's the redecoration coming on?
translation: Ah, genc maceraci, dekorasyon nasil gidiyor?

english: What am I supposed to be doing again?
You'll want to start by removing all the tatty old furniture. There are two stools, two tables, a chair and a rotten carpet to remove, as well as the campbed. Let me know when you've done that.
translation: Önce eski, yipranmis mobilyalari kaldirmalisin. Iki tabure, iki masa, bir sandalye ve cürümüs bir hali ile kamp yatagini kaldirmalisin. Isin bittiginde bana haber ver.

english: I've been removing the old furniture.
You still need to remove: - A broken stool in the kitchen - A broken stool in the bedroom - A broken chair in the bedroom
translation: Hala kaldirman gerekenler: - Mutfaktaki kirik tabure - Yatak odasindaki kirik tabure - Yatak odasindaki kirik sandalye

english: - A broken table in the kitchen - The old campbed - The rotten carpet
translation: - Mutfaktaki kirik masa - Eski kamp yatagi - Cürümüs hali

english: I've finished removing all the old furniture.
Jolly good, young [man/lady/one]. Now, we'll need to have a talk about what you'll build for me to replace it.
translation: Cok iyi, genc . Simdi, bunlarin yerine ne yapacagini konusmamiz gerekiyor.

english: You see, I used to be a carpenter myself, before the arthritis got me. Such wonderful things I could build. Let me tell you about the things Construction can do for you...
translation: Görüyorsun, artritim baslamadan önce ben de marangozdum. Ne kadar harika seyler yapabilirdim. Insaatin senin icin neler yapabilecegini anlatayim...

english: Is this necessary? I've got a house of my own, in [city], and I've been learning about Construction for a while.
A cutscene plays in which Old Man Yarlo is in a newly purchased player-owned house.
translation: Yarlo Amca'nin yeni satin aldigi oyuncuya ait evde gecen bir kesit oynatilir.

english: As a builder, in your own house, you can create your own rooms full of furniture. A house may start out very basic...
translation: Bir insaatci olarak, kendi evinde, mobilyalarla dolu kendi odalarini yaratabilirsin. Bir ev baslangicta cok basit olabilir......

english: ... but in Building Mode, you'll see what you can add to it...
translation: ama Insaat Modunda, ona neler ekleyebilecegini göreceksin...

english: Old Man Yarlo builds a fully furnished parlour.
translation: Yarlo Amca tamamen mobilyali bir salon insa ediyor....

english: ... with fancier options available as your Construction level rises.
translation: Insaat seviyen yükseldikce daha lüks secenekler de mevcut.

english: Old Man Yarlo removes several furniture and builds fancier ones.
translation: Yarlo Amca birkac mobilyayi kaldirip daha lüks olanlari insa ediyor.

english: You can add lots more rooms, and build their furniture too, unlocking really handy features.
translation: Daha fazla oda ekleyebilir ve bunlarin mobilyalarini da insa ederek gercekten kullanisli özelliklerin kilidini acabilirsiniz.

english: The camera shifts and Old Man Yarlo is now seen in a fully furnished home fitted with the highest-level furniture.
translation: Kamera kayar ve Yasli Yarlo artik en üst düzey mobilyalarla donatilmis, tamamen mobilyali bir evde görülür.

english: For example, in a study, you could build a lectern for creating spell tablets, powerful items that can cast spells without runes. You could sell your tablets to other people too.
translation: Örnegin, bir calisma odasinda, runes olmadan büyü yapabilen güclü ögeler olan büyü tabletleri olusturmak icin bir kürsü insa edebilirsiniz. Tabletlerinizi baskalarina da satabilirsiniz.

english: A Teleport Nexus can take you to a huge range of destinations, making your home a powerful travel hub.
translation: Bir Teleport Nexus sizi cok cesitli yerlere götürebilir ve evinizi güclü bir seyahat merkezi haline getirebilir.

english: Show your dedication to the gods by building an altar, where you can sacrifice bones for bonus Prayer XP.
translation: Bonus Dua XP icin kemik kurban edebileceginiz bir sunak insa ederek tanrilara bagliliginizi gösterin.

english: With a regeneration pool, you can get healed quickly, before you teleport back to the action.
translation: Rejenerasyon havuzu ile, aksiyona geri teleport olmadan önce hizli bir sekilde iyilesebilirsiniz.

english: The Estate Agents can redecorate your house in different styles, if you want something a bit more impressive.
translation: Emlakcilar, biraz daha etkileyici bir sey istiyorsaniz evinizi farkli tarzlarda yeniden dekore edebilir.

english: And, of course, to make your house feel truly like a home, you can fill it with adorable critters...
translation: Ve tabii ki, evinizi gercekten bir yuva gibi hissettirmek icin, onu sevimli yaratiklarla doldurabilirsiniz......

english: ... and drop your guests into the monster pit beneath your throne room.
translation: ve misafirlerinizi taht odanizin altindaki canavar cukuruna atabilirsiniz.

english: All this could be yours, if you train Construction!
translation: Insaat becerisini gelistirirseniz, tüm bunlar sizin olabilir!

english: Now, I was just getting round to telling you about the furniture I want you to build for me. For a start, I'd like two new stools, two new tables and a new chair.
translation: Simdi, sana benim icin yapmani istedigim mobilyalardan bahsetmek üzereydim. Öncelikle, iki yeni tabure, iki yeni masa ve bir yeni sandalye istiyorum.

english: Some basic wooden planks and some nails should do, for those. I won't ask for anything more fancy - it'd only get stolen anyway, in this neighbourhood.
translation: Bunlar icin basit tahta kalaslar ve civiler yeterli olacaktir. Daha süslü seyler istemeyecegim, bu mahallede zaten calinir.

english: I'll want a new carpet too. They can really change the atmosphere of a room, you know! You can buy cloth at the sawmill to make one.
translation: Yeni bir hali da istiyorum. Halilar odanin atmosferini gercekten degistirebilir, biliyorsun! Kereste fabrikasindan kumas alip hali yapabilirsin.

english: Now, for the bed, I've got something special in mind. This town's quite damp, and I don't want the moisture rising up the bed into my blankets. But I've found some wood that resists water.
translation: Simdi, yatak icin aklimda özel bir sey var. Bu kasaba oldukca nemli ve nemin yataga yükselip battaniyelerime ulasmasini istemiyorum. Ama suya dayanikli bir agac buldum.

english: Those abandoned crates in the kitchen were here when I moved in, and I found they contain waxwood logs. Waxwood isn't much used in carpentry, but it resists water, so I want a bed made from that.
translation: Mutfaktaki terk edilmis kasalar buraya tasindigimda buradaydi ve iclerinde balmumu agaci kütükleri oldugunu gördüm. Balmumu agaci marangozlukta pek kullanilmaz, ama suya dayaniklidir, bu yüzden ondan yapilmis bir yatak istiyorum.

english: You'll have to take three logs from the crate to the sawmill. The chap there will turn them into planks if you mention my name - I've known his family for years.
translation: Sandiktan üc kütügü kereste fabrikasina götürmelisin. Oradaki adam benim adimi söylersen onlari tahtaya cevirir - ailesini yillardir taniyorum.

english: I think that's everything - two stools, two tables, a chair, a bed and a carpet. Off you trot, young [man/lady/one]. I'll be here if you have any questions.
translation: Sanirim hepsi bu kadar - iki tabure, iki masa, bir sandalye, bir yatak ve bir hali. Hadi git bakalim, genc . Sorun olursa ben buradayim.

english: You young people are always rushing around trying to optimise the fun out of life. There are other ways to enjoy the world, you know! But I'm sure you know best.
translation: Siz gencler her zaman hayatin tadini cikarmak icin kosturup duruyorsunuz. Dünyanin tadini cikarmak icin baska yollar da var, biliyorsunuz! Ama en iyisini siz bilirsiniz.

english: Do you need some help with the building work, young [man/lady/one]?
translation: Insaat islerinde yardima ihtiyacin var mi, genc ?

english: How do I build furniture?
Ah. Look in the place where the new furniture will go...
translation: Ah. Yeni mobilyalarin yerlestirilecegi yere bak...

english: A talented builder will see a vision there of the furniture they could build. Interact with that, and you should find you can build furniture.
translation: Yetenekli bir marangoz, orada yapabilecegi mobilyalarin hayalini görür. Onunla etkilesime gec, mobilyalari yapabilecegini göreceksin.

english: You'll need a hammer and saw. I can supply those if you need them.
translation: Cekic ve testereye ihtiyacin olacak. Ihtiyacin olursa ben temin edebilirim.

english: Where do I get planks, nails and cloth?
translation: Tahtalari, civileri ve kumasi nereden bulabilirim?

english: From the sawmill! They sell nails and cloth at reasonable prices. You'd have to take your own logs there, though, to get planks, but there are plenty of trees to chop nearby.
translation: Kereste fabrikasindan! Orada civi ve kumasi uygun fiyatlara satiyorlar. Ancak tahtalari almak icin kendi kütüklerinizi oraya götürmeniz gerekir, ama yakinlarda kesebileceginiz bol miktarda agac var.

english: Watch out, though - nails can bend, if you're not careful. You should probably get some spares, just in case.
translation: Dikkatli olun, dikkatli olmazsaniz civiler bükülebilir. Her ihtimale karsi yedek civi almaniz iyi olur.

english: Look on your World Map to find the sawmill.
translation: Dünya Haritasina bakarak kereste fabrikasini bulun.

english: You've got a hammer and a saw. I wouldn't be able to offer you anything else.
translation: Cekic ve testereniz var. Size baska bir sey sunamam.

english: I need some tools.
Would you like a [hammer/saw]? I can spare one.
translation: Cekic,testere ister misin? Bir tane verebilirim.

english: Yes please.
Yarlo gives you a [hammer/saw].
No thanks.
Tell me about the waxwood for the bed.
translation: Yatak icin balmumu agaci hakkinda bilgi ver.

english: This town's quite damp, and I don't want the moisture rising up the bed into my blankets. But I've found some wood that resists water.
translation: Bu kasaba oldukca nemli ve nemin yataktan battaniyelerime yükselmesini istemiyorum. Ama suya dayanikli bir agac buldum.

english: You'll have to take three logs from the crate to the sawmill. The chap there will turn them into planks if you mention my name.
translation: Sandiktan üc kütügü kereste fabrikasina götürmelisin. Oradaki adam benim adimi söylersen onlari tahtaya cevirir.

english: I'll get on with it.
That's everything! Thank you so much, young [man/lady/one]. Trot off back to my boy Marlo, now. He'll have something for you.
translation: Hepsi bu kadar! Cok tesekkür ederim, genc. Simdi oglum Marlo'nun yanina git. Sana bir sey verecektir.

english: Okay, I'll head back to Marlo.
Hello again, young [man/lady/one]. Has my boy Marlo rewarded you yet?
translation: Merhaba tekrar, genc . Oglum Marlo sana ödülünü verdi mi?

english: Not yet. I'll get round to visiting him soon.
translation: Henüz degil. Yakinda onu ziyaret edecegim.

english: Yes, you should do that. You've earned it.
Hello again, young [man/lady/one]. You really did wonders for my little home. I feel so much happier living here now.
translation: Merhaba tekrar, genc . Kücük evime gercekten harikalar yarattin. Artik burada yasamaktan cok daha mutluyum.

english: That's good to hear. Goodbye now.
Tell me about more things I can do with Construction.
translation: Insaat ile yapabilecegim diger seyleri anlat bana.

english: Thank you!
I'm just wandering around.
Nothing, really.
Listen to Yarlo.
Skip Yarlo's lecture. He'll offer it later if you like.
translation: Yarlo'nun dersini atla. Istersen daha sonra tekrar anlatir.

english: How do I build furniture?
Where do I get planks, nails and cloth?
translation: Tahtalari, civileri ve kumasi nereden bulabilirim?

english: I need some tools.
Yes please.
No thanks.
Tell me about the waxwood for the bed.
translation: Yatak icin balmumu agaci hakkinda bilgi ver bana.

english: I'll get on with it.
That's good to hear. Goodbye now.
Tell me about more things I can do with Construction.
translation: Insaat ile yapabilecegim diger seyleri anlatin.

english: I'm here about Necrovarus.
Good news - the enchantment worked!
translation: Iyi haberler var, büyü ise yaradi!

english: So Necrovarus has let the ghosts go free.... You have achieved many wonderful things, my young friend.
translation: Demek Necrovarus hayaletleri serbest birakti... Bircok harika sey basardin genc dostum.

english: I'm here about the farmers east of here.
Hello there, just dropping in to thank you again. It all went perfectly. Alice and her husband can communicate again.
translation: Merhaba, tekrar tesekkür etmek icin ugradim. Her sey mükemmel gitti. Alice ve kocasi tekrar iletisim kurabiliyorlar.

english: I can't help but shed a tear about my own family. My sisters are so vile, I refuse to talk to them these days.
translation: Kendi ailem icin gözyaslarimi tutamiyorum. Kiz kardeslerim o kadar kötü ki, son günlerde onlarla konusmayi reddediyorum.

english: Sorry to hear that.
Never mind; we've reunited a happy family of farmers; that's enough for me.
translation: Önemli degil; mutlu bir ciftci ailesini yeniden bir araya getirdik; bu benim icin yeterli.

english: Answer this, please.
You've been given a challenge scroll!
translation: Size bir meydan okuma parsömeni verildi!

english: Well done.
You've been given a new clue!
I'm here about Necrovarus.
I'm here about the farmers east of here.
Alright?
I've been better...
What happened to your foot?
I was minding my own business in that abandoned shack for the night and suddenly I could hear...
translation: O terk edilmis kulübede gece kendi isime bakiyordum ve aniden bir ses duydum...

english: A g-g-g-ghost?!
No... Don't interrupt!
Where was I?
That was it... a faint sound... wind chimes...
translation: Öyleydi... zayif bir ses... rüzgar canlari...

english: Please don't tell me you were attacked by the wind.
What did I say about interruptions?
Sorry.

The chiming grew louder and started to sound like the knocking of bones. I was in the bed hiding under the moth-eaten sheet - ignorance is bliss, y'know? - and suddenly the sheet was pulled off of me and there was
translation: Can sesi giderek yükseldi ve kemiklerin carpismasi gibi bir sese dönüstü. Yatagimda, güve yemis carsafin altinda saklaniyordum - cehalet mutluluktur, bilirsin - ve aniden carsaf üzerimden cekildi ve karsimda

english: a-
A skeleton!
I SAID NO INTER- Oh yes, that's correct... Skeletons. Two of the blighters.
translation: DEDIM KI KESME... Evet, dogru... Iskeletler. Iki tane.

english: Well, you seem to have got away in one piece!
translation: Görünüse göre tek parca halinde kurtulmussun!

english: One piece?! Do you not-
THE BONEY BLIGHTER BIT MY FOOT!
Sorry... You didn't leave anything behind did you? I'm a brave adventurer! I'm sure I can pry whatever it is from their malicious mitts.
translation: Üzgünüm... Geride bir sey birakmadin, degil mi? Ben cesur bir maceraciyim! Onlarin kötü niyetli ellerinden her ne varsa alabilecegime eminim.

english: A few pots, but without my tools they won'ydo me any good.
translation: Birkac cömlek, ama aletlerim olmadan bana bir faydasi olmaz.

english: Who are you?
Me? Just a tinker with nothing to trade.
translation: Ben mi? Sadece takas edecek hicbir seyi olmayan bir tamirci.

english: What happened to your wares?
A tinker doesn't get the respect that they used to... Gah! A thief took my bag in the night, they took everything.
translation: Tamirciler eskisi gibi saygi görmüyor... Gah! Gece bir hirsiz cantami caldi, her seyi aldi.

english: Sorry to hear you've had some bad luck of late, did you lose much?
translation: Son zamanlarda sanssizlik yasadigina üzüldüm, cok sey kaybettin mi?

english: Bits and pieces, nothing too important I s'pose... An old pan flute, a dirty book and a charred skull.
translation: Ufak tefek seyler, cok önemli seyler degil sanirim... Eski bir pan flüt, kirli bir kitap ve kömürlesmis bir kafatasi.

english: Hmm.
That's all in the past now, anyway... I'm afraid I can't help you.
translation: Her neyse, hepsi gecmiste kaldi... Korkarim sana yardim edemem.

english: That's alright, I need no help.
Didn't someone send you for the pots?
translation: Seni cömlekleri almaya kimse göndermedi mi?

english: Nope, just exploring...
Well, if anyone asks... I'm dead!
Bye.
Are you the tinker this entry mentions?
translation: Bu giriste bahsedilen tamirci sen misin?

english: You show him 'Jewellery of Jubilation'.
Oh, me? Oh my... Goodness gracious what...
translation: Oh, ben mi? Oh tanrim... Aman Tanrim, ne...

english: A life?
What? No...
Well, I s'pose that was me...
What's so surprising?
How did you find me!? Was it you?
Was it me what? I just found this journal... I didn't write it.
translation: Ben mi neydim? Bu günlügü buldum... Ben yazmadim.

english: I remember this day... How could I forget.
translation: Bu günü hatirliyorum... Nasil unutabilirim ki.

english: Are you saying the man I sold those trinkets to was the king?!
translation: O biblolari sattigim adamin kral oldugunu mu söylüyorsun?

english: Yeah... You didn't know?
Those were dark objects, corrupted with powerful magic. Dark magic.
translation: Onlar güclü büyüyle kirlenmis karanlik nesnelerdi. Karanlik büyü.

english: Well, it's all in the past now. I don't think there's any reason to worry about it.
translation: Artik hepsi gecmiste kaldi. Endiselenecek bir sey yok bence.

english: No, no, no... this ain't good. They'll find me.
translation: Hayir, hayir, hayir... Bu iyi degil. Beni bulacaklar.

english: Who will find you?
You already know too much. But you don't know my name. Good. Let's keep it that way.
translation: Zaten cok sey biliyorsun. Ama benim adimi bilmiyorsun. Iyi. Öyle kalsin.

english: Well if I find out anything useful, I'll come let you know, alright?
translation: Eger yararli bir sey ögrenirsem, sana haber veririm, tamam mi?

english: If you can find me.
Deal...
You hand over your [item name].
Thanks!
Wait, what?
THANKS!
No, I didn't mean for you to keep it.
Then why are you handing it to me?
Someone made me do it!
Who?
It's alright mate! We've all been there.
translation: Sorun degil dostum! Hepimiz o yollardan gectik.

english: Existential Crisis?
It'll pass! Anyhow, I'll be seeing you.
Yeah...
I'm not sure...
I'm afraid I've nothing to trade for that.
translation: Korkarim bunun karsiliginda verecek hicbir seyim yok.

english: What happened to your foot?
Who are you?
Bye.
Someone made me do it!
I'm not sure...
Hello there.
Hello traveller, do you know what this is?
translation: Merhaba gezgin, bunun ne oldugunu biliyor musun?

english: It looks like a monument.
Yes. I served in the military for 30 years. This monument always reminds me of my days in the army.
translation: Evet. 30 yil orduda görev yaptim. Bu anit bana her zaman ordudaki günlerimi hatirlatir.

english: Oh, hello! I was just trying to discover the properties of these magical stones you call 'runes', and trying to make some devices to harness their power.
translation: Merhaba! Ben de sizin “rune” dediginiz bu sihirli taslarin özelliklerini kesfetmeye ve onlarin gücünü kullanmak icin bazi cihazlar yapmaya calisiyordum.

english: What have you discovered?
Oh, it's terribly exciting! Let me explain...
translation: Oh, bu cok heyecan verici! Aciklayayim...

english: Oldak lectures you on the construction of runes and you find yourself thinking about Runecrafting with greater clarity.
translation: Oldak size runelerin yapisi hakkinda ders verir ve siz de Runecrafting hakkinda daha net düsünmeye baslarsiniz.

english: Oh, I see!
Oldak lectures you on the magical energies stored within runes and you find yourself thinking about Magic with greater clarity.
translation: Oldak sana runelerin icinde depolanan büyülü enerjiler hakkinda ders verir ve sen kendini büyü hakkinda daha net düsünürken bulursun.

english: Oldak lapses into technical jargon and you don't understand a word.
translation: Oldak teknik jargona dalar ve sen tek kelime bile anlamazsin.

english: Oh... How interesting.
Oldak lectures you on the contruction of runes, but you find yourself greatly confused about Runecrafting.
translation: Oldak sana runelerin yapimi hakkinda ders verir, ama sen kendini runecrafting hakkinda cok kafan karisik bulursun.

english: What?
Oldak lectures you on the magical energies stored within runes, but you find yourself greatly confused about Magic.
translation: Oldak sana runelerin icinde depolanan büyülü enerjiler hakkinda ders verir, ama sen kendini büyü hakkinda cok kafan karisik bulursun.

english: What have you made?
The only thing I've been able to make so far is this. I call it the moving-over-distance sphere.
translation: Su ana kadar yapabildigim tek sey bu. Buna “uzaktan hareket eden küre” adini verdim.

english: What is it?
Well, I was experimenting with these blue runes, the ones you call 'law' runes. They have a strange property of being able to move instantly from one place to another.
translation: Sey, senin “yasa” runeleri dedigin mavi runelerle deneyler yapiyordum. Bu runeler, bir yerden baska bir yere aninda hareket edebilme gibi garip bir özellige sahipler.

english: I know; I couldn't believe it either!
I found that whenever I prepared powdered law runes in a certain way and then threw them on the ground, I would appear somewhere else in the city.
translation: Toz halindeki yasa runelerini belirli bir sekilde hazirlayip yere attigimda, sehrin baska bir yerinde ortaya ciktigimi fark ettim.

english: I asked Zanik to test it, and she said that wherever she was in the caves, even if she went to the surface, whenever she smashed the sphere on the ground she would appear back in the city!
translation: Zanik'ten bunu denemesini istedim ve o da magaralarin neresinde olursa olsun, yüzeye ciksa bile, küreyi yere vurdugunda sehirde ortaya ciktigini söyledi!

english: I can see how it might be useful, but I wish I knew more about how it worked...
translation: Bunun ne kadar yararli olabilecegini anliyorum, ama nasil calistigi hakkinda daha fazla bilgi sahibi olmak isterdim...

english: Can I buy one?
Oh, I can make one for you if you like. You'll need to give me two law runes and a piece of molten glass.
translation: Istersen sana bir tane yapabilirim. Bana iki kanun runesi ve bir parca erimis cam vermen gerekecek.

english: I'll have to go and get some then.
translation: O zaman gidip biraz almam gerekecek.

english: Goodbye
Goodbye!
Oh, er, goodbye. Now, where was I...
translation: Oh, sey, hosca kal. Simdi, nerede kalmistim...

english: Where do you want a sphere to?
Dorgesh-Kaan.
You'll need to get me two law runes and a piece of molten glass.
translation: Bana iki kanun runesi ve bir parca erimis cam getirmelisin.

english: I have the right materials here!
Excellent! Now, just a minute...
You're quite welcome! Now, where was I...
I have %NUMBER% law runes and %NUMBER% pieces of molten glass here!
translation: Burada %NUMBER% hukuk runesi ve %NUMBER% erimis cam parcasi var!

english: Excellent! I can make you %NUMBER% moving-over-distance spheres with them! How many do you want?
translation: Harika! Bunlarla sana %NUMBER% mesafe asan küre yapabilirim! Kac tane istiyorsun?

english: Thank you!
Goblin Village.
The Plain of Mud
Nowhere.
Hmm...
I wonder...
That's funny...
What if I...
No, that's not right...
But that means...
Aha!
Ah! I was wrong about it all along!
I wonder what happens if...
What have you discovered?
What have you made?
What is it?
Can I buy one?
Goodbye!
Dorgesh-Kaan.
Goblin Village.
The Plain of Mud
Nowhere.
What are you doing out here on your own?
I'm not alone! Me and my mates run these streets. You'd better watch your pockets, stranger.
translation: Yalniz degilim! Ben ve arkadaslarim bu sokaklari yönetiyoruz. Ceplerine dikkat etsen iyi olur, yabanci.

english: What do you mean you run the streets?
You see those fancy houses?
I think so?
We keep a lookout to see when the owners leave and come back. Once they're out, we can break in and steal all their stuff!
translation: Sahiplerinin ne zaman cikip ne zaman geri dönecegini gözetliyoruz. Onlar disari ciktiginda, iceri girip tüm esyalarini calabiliriz!

english: That sounds risky don't you think? There are guards everywhere.
translation: Bu riskli bir plan, sence de öyle degil mi? Her yerde güvenlik görevlileri var.

english: No one suspects us street urchins. Hidden in plain sight, as they say.
translation: Kimse biz sokak cocuklarini süpheli görmez. Herkesin gözü önünde gizliyiz, dedikleri gibi.

english: I can give you some info on which houses are free if you like...
translation: Istersen hangi evlerin bos oldugunu sana söyleyebilirim...

english: I'm alright for now.
Suit yourself.
Hello there.
Hello. Have you met our crew leader yet?
I don't think I have...
Go chat to them! They should be near the bank... naturally.
translation: Git onlarla konus! Bankanin yakinlarinda olmalilar... dogal olarak.

english: I'll head over there soon.
Happy thieving, stranger.
I could do with some information on houses.
translation: Evler hakkinda biraz bilgiye ihtiyacim var.

english: You don't have any house keys, do you? You won't find yourself getting very far without any. Maybe come back later?
translation: Ev anahtarin yok, degil mi? Anahtarin olmadan cok uzaga gidemezsin. Belki daha sonra tekrar gelmelisin?

english: I'd better get going.
Hello. A fine day for stealing, wouldn't you say?
translation: Merhaba. Hirsizlik icin güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: I suppose so, just as long as you're not planning to steal from me.
translation: Sanirim öyle, tabii benden calmayi planlamiyorsan.

english: *whistle*
Thanks! That sure is tasty!
Do you want some... more?
No, I'm not greedy!
Sounds good.
I'm alright for now.
I could do with some information on houses.
translation: Evler hakkinda biraz bilgiye ihtiyacim var.

english: I'd better get going.
Would you like to trade in seeds?
No, thanks.
Where do I get rarer seeds from?
The Master Farmers usually carry a few rare seeds around with them, although I don't know if they'd want to part with them for any price to be honest.
translation: Usta ciftciler genellikle yanlarinda birkac nadir tohum tasirlar, ama dürüst olmak gerekirse, herhangi bir fiyata onlardan ayrilmak isteyeceklerini sanmiyorum.

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
You're the one who stole something from me!
Guardsguards!
Yes
No
Where do I get rarer seeds from?
I'm sorry to bother you, but could you spare me a little dung?
translation: Rahatsiz ettigim icin özür dilerim, ama bana biraz gübre verebilir misin?

english: The camel didn't seem to appreciate that question.
If I go near that camel, it'll probably bite my hand off.
translation: O deveye yaklasirsam, muhtemelen elimi isirir.

english: Mmm... looks like that camel would make a nice kebab.
translation: Mmm... o deve güzel bir kebap olur gibi görünüyor.

english: I wonder if that camel has fleas...
Are you serious?
Oh yes. If you'd be so kind...
Well, just you close your eyes first. I'm not doing it while you're watching me!
translation: Önce gözlerini kapat. Sen izlerken yapmam!

english: I hope that's what you wanted!
Ohhh yes. Lovely.
What did you say?
Er, nothing important.
Ah, a human. Do you know anything about flying?
translation: Ah, bir insan. Ucmak hakkinda bir sey biliyor musun?

english: Flying?
Yes, flying. It's a wonderful thing. I've seen this glider fly, and it's so elegant and fast.
translation: Evet, ucmak. Harika bir sey. Bu planörün uctugunu gördüm, cok zarif ve hizli.

english: If I could fly, I wouldn't want to do anything else! I'd just fly around all day, swooping and soaring.
translation: Ucabilseydim, baska hicbir sey yapmak istemezdim! Bütün gün ucup, süzülüp, yükselirdim.

english: Ask the camel about its dung.
Say something unpleasant.
Neither - I'm a polite person.
translation: Ikisi de degil - ben kibar biriyim.

english: Hee hee! What shall we talk about, human?
translation: Hee hee! Ne hakkinda konusalim, insan?

english: Where do creatures like you come from?
From eggs, of course! You can't make an olmlet without breaking an egg.
translation: Tabii ki yumurtadan! Yumurtayi kirmadan omlet yapamazsin.

english: That's... informative. Thank you.
Hee hee! What's next, human?
translation: Hee hee! Sirada ne var, insan?

english: You look like a dragon.
And humans look like monkeys. Badly shaved monkeys. What's your point, human?
translation: Insanlar da maymunlara benziyor. Kötü tiraslanmis maymunlara. Ne demek istiyorsun, insan?

english: Are you related to dragons?
My sire was an olm. I'm an olm. I don't go around asking you about your parents' species, do I?
translation: Babam bir olm'du. Ben de bir olm'um. Ben senin ebeveynlerinin türünü sormuyorum, degil mi?...

english: ... no, I suppose you don't.
Hee hee! Let's change the subject before someone gets insulted. What shall we talk about instead, human?
translation: Hee hee! Birisi kirilmadan konuyu degistirelim. Ne hakkinda konusalim, insan?

english: Can you tell me secrets about your home?
Ooh, it was lovely. I lived in an eggshell. I was safe in there, dreaming of the life I would lead when I hatched, and the caverns I could rule.
translation: Ooh, cok güzeldi. Bir yumurta kabugunda yasiyordum. Orada güvendeydim, yumurtadan ciktigimda yasayacagim hayati ve hükmedebilecegim magaralari hayal ediyordum.

english: Then suddenly I felt a trembling of the ground, and my shell shattered.
translation: Sonra aniden yerin titredigini hissettim ve kabugum parcalandi.

english: Through its cracks I saw the world for the first time, just in time to watch my sire die.
translation: Catlaklardan dünyayi ilk kez gördüm, tam da babamin ölümünü izlemek icin.

english: It was a terrible shock for a newly hatched olmlet, but I try not to let it affect my mood. So what else shall we talk about, human?
translation: Yeni yumurtadan cikmis bir olmlet icin korkunc bir soktu, ama bunun ruh halimi etkilemesine izin vermemeye calisiyorum. Peki baska ne hakkinda konusalim, insan?

english: Maybe another time.
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
What lovely teeth you have!
All the better for chomping stuff.
translation: Bir seyleri cignemek icin daha iyi.

english: WOW! No chill?
Hey, itsa dog-eat-dogadile world out there!
Want to play fetch?
Play meat!
No, fetch... you know, I throw stick and you bring it back?
translation: Hayir, topu yakalamak... bilirsin, ben sopayi atarim, sen geri getirirsin?

english: You fetch meat.
It doesn't just grow on trees you know!
Om nom nom good meat.
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
You look hot.
Heat required for forge.
What are you making?
Heat.
Well, forge ahead then.
What are you-
STOP!
HAMMER TIME!
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
Learn ye of the Judgement of the Vanguard. The form we have taken.
But you're so little and cute!
translation: Ama sen cok kücük ve sevimlisin!

english: Learn ye this form was not given from the grace of our Lord Xeric. He does not forgive those who choose poorly.
translation: Bu seklin, Lord Xeric'in lütfu ile verilmedigini ögrenin. Kötü secim yapanlari affetmez.

english: *slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
The Dark Altar! The power it has given. Xeric, you cannot comprehend!
translation: Karanlik Sunak! Ona verdigi güc. Xeric, sen anlayamazsin!

english: Excuse me?
I will take Kourend for myself, for I am no longer the priest. I am the god!
translation: Kourend'i kendime alacagim, cünkü artik rahip degilim. Ben tanriyim!

english: What have I done...
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
Hello
Bzzzzt!
Bzzz bzzz bzz?
Buzz off human.
It's you that's following me! Maybe I should invest in a large flyswat...
translation: Beni takip eden sensin! Belki de büyük bir sinek sinekligi almaliyim...

english: *slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
Where do creatures like you come from?
You look like a dragon.
Can you tell me secrets about your home?
Maybe another time.
Hello there.
Hello.
How are you?
Fine thanks.
You're one to talk! I paid plenty for that little encounter!
translation: Sen mi söylüyorsun bunu! O kücük karsilasma icin cok para ödedim!

english: One eye doesn't equal two of my best men!
translation: Bir göz, benim en iyi iki adamima bile denk gelmez!

english: We gave you plenty of chances to flee!
translation: Sana kacman icin bolca firsat verdik!

english: If I ran away from you, I'd never hear the end of it!
Really? Then what about that fight in Turtle Basin?
translation: Gercekten mi? Peki ya Turtle Basin'deki kavga neydi?

english: That wasn't fleeing! It was a tactical repositioning! Besides, you're conveniently forgetting what happened at Brimhaven!
translation: O kacmak degildi! Taktiksel bir yeniden konumlanmaydi! Ayrica, Brimhaven'da olanlari da unutmussun!

english: A boring fight! I had better things to do.
translation: Sikici bir kavgaydi! Yapacak daha iyi islerim vardi.

english: Well, we'll have to make things more entertaining next time then!
translation: O zaman bir dahaki sefere daha eglenceli hale getirmeliyiz!

english: I look forward to it, but for now, let's drink!
Indeed! Cheers!
Hello there. What do you want to talk about?
Hi, how are things going?

Well hopefully a lot better now that you've initiated the calm between the Moon Clan and the Fremenniks. Remember, if you want to use our Lunar Spells at any time, pray at the altar beside me and you can modify
translation: Umarim Moon Klani ile Fremennikler arasinda barisi sagladigin icin simdi cok daha iyidir. Unutma, istedigin zaman Ay Büyülerimizi kullanmak istersen, yanimdaki sunakta dua et ve bilgilerini degistirebilirsin!

english: your knowledge!
I've misplaced my staff.
I knew you'd do that, and I used my magic to teleport it back to me.
translation: Bunu yapacagini biliyordum ve büyümü kullanarak onu bana geri isinladim.

english: Erm, that doesn't sound too realistic. Thanks!
translation: Erm, bu pek gercekci gelmiyor. Tesekkürler!

english: Look, do you want it or not?
Sorry, yes. Yes please.
Actually, I'll have to come back when I have a space to carry one.
translation: Aslinda, tasimak icin yerim oldugunda geri gelmem gerekecek.

english: But it's going to cost you! It will be 30000 coins!
translation: Ama bu sana pahaliya mal olacak! 30.000 sikke olacak!

english: Yeah, I'll pay that!
Sorry dear, you don't have enough coins for that.
translation: Üzgünüm canim, bunun icin yeterli sikken yok.

english: Oh, ok...
No thanks.
I've lost my Lunar [item].
Oh dear, good job I pre-empted you!
translation: Oh canim, iyi ki önceden tahmin ettim!

english: I already knew that. I got one especially.
translation: Bunu zaten biliyordum. Özel olarak bir tane aldim.

english: Well of course, I know that already, so I got a backup for you.
translation: Tabii ki, bunu zaten biliyorum, bu yüzden sana yedek aldim.

english: I know. Good job I knew you would drop it!
translation: Biliyorum. Iyi ki düsürecegini tahmin ettim!

english: Unfortunately I don't have space to carry it.
But it's going to cost you! It will be [number] coins!
Hello again. Seen Cyrisus recently?
translation: Merhaba tekrar. Son zamanlarda Cyrisus'u gördün mü?

english: As you mention it, yes. He wanted to create more astral runes.
translation: Söyledigin gibi, evet. Daha fazla astral rün yaratmak istiyordu.

english: Interesting.
He said something about fighting kalphites, whatever they are.
translation: Kalphitlerle savasmakla ilgili bir seyler söyledi, her neyseler.

english: Sounds like his fear of combat really is a problem of the past!
translation: Görünüse göre savastan korkmasi artik gecmiste kalmis!

english: You've done well. Very well.
Hi.
Hello there. I hear that Cyrisus is no longer with us.
translation: Merhaba. Cyrisus'un artik aramizda olmadigini duydum.

english: He died fighting for a good cause. He'll be remembered as a great hero.
translation: Iyi bir amac ugruna savasirken öldü. Büyük bir kahraman olarak hatirlanacak.

english: I suppose the good do die young.
Answer this, please.
Well done.
You've [been given a new clue/obtained a casket]!
The state of the island.
Yeah, I'll pay that!
No thanks.
Cyrisus.
Nothing.
Would you like to buy or sell any javelins?
translation: Mizrak satin almak veya satmak ister misiniz?

english: Yes, please.
No, thanks.
Could you sell me some dragon javelins?
Dragon javelins? Haha, you'll be a chief advisor to the King before you ever hold a dragon javelin!
translation: Ejderha mizragi mi? Haha, ejderha mizragini eline almadan önce kralin bas danismani olursun!

english: Yes, please.
No, thanks.
Could you sell me some dragon javelins?
How can I help you, human?
Have you any ore for me?
Here you go. That's all the ore I have for you.
translation: Al bakalim. Senin icin sahip oldugum tüm cevher bu.

english: None of the ore here is yours, sorry.
translation: Buradaki cevherlerin hicbiri senin degil, üzgünüm.

english: How do I mine in this place?
Okay, first you need dynamite. That's got three ingredients...
translation: Tamam, önce dinamit lazim. Bunun üc malzemesi var...

english: Once you've got dynamite, use a chisel to excavate a cavity in the hard rock walls, so you can put the dynamite in, then light the fuse.
translation: Dinamiti aldiktan sonra, keskiyle sert kaya duvarlarinda bir oyuk ac, böylece dinamiti icine koyup fitili atesleyebilirsin.

english: The dynamite blows ore out of the hard rock. It's very unstable, so you don't have long to get it cleaned before it disintegrates.
translation: Dinamit, sert kayadan cevheri cikarir. Cok dengesizdir, bu yüzden parcalanmadan önce temizlemek icin fazla zamanin yoktur.

english: Just deposit it into the sack upstream, and my colleague will get it cleaned safely. You can collect your cleaned ore from me.
translation: Sadece yukaridaki cuvala koy, meslektasim onu güvenli bir sekilde temizleyecektir. Temizlenmis cevherini benden alabilirsin.

english: Who are you?
I work here, in the blast mine. It's a valuable source of minerals for the kingdom, so our work is very important.
translation: Ben burada, patlayici madeninde calisiyorum. Burasi krallik icin degerli bir mineral kaynagi, bu yüzden isimiz cok önemli.

english: What is this machine?
The ore from the blast mines is unstable, and needs washing quickly before it disintegrates, so the Lovakengj engineers invented this machine to clean it.
translation: Patlayici madenlerinden cikarilan cevher kararsizdir ve parcalanmadan önce hizlica yikanmasi gerekir, bu yüzden Lovakengj mühendisleri onu temizlemek icin bu makineyi icat etti.

english: The design's a secret; even if someone tried to copy it, they'd never get it quite right. I bet their machine would break down all the time.
translation: Tasarimi gizlidir; biri onu kopyalamaya calissa bile, asla tam olarak basaramaz. Eminim onlarin makinesi sürekli bozulur.

english: I'll be off.
Have you any ore for me?
How do I mine in this place?
Who are you?
What is this machine?
I'll be off.
I seek a piece of the map to the island of Crandor.
translation: Crandor adasina giden haritanin bir parcasini ariyorum.

english: The map's behind a door below, but entering is rather tough. This is what you need to know: You must use the following stuff.
translation: Harita asagidaki kapinin arkasinda, ama iceri girmek oldukca zor. Bilmen gerekenler sunlar: Asagidaki malzemeleri kullanmalisin.

english: First, a drink used by a mage. Next, some worm string, changed to sheet. Then, a small crustacean cage. Last, a bowl that's not seen heat.
translation: Ilk olarak, bir büyücü tarafindan kullanilan bir icecek. Sonra, tabaka haline getirilmis solucan ipi. Ardindan, kücük bir kabuklu hayvan kafesi. Son olarak, isi görmemis bir kase.

english: (same as below)
Can you impart your wise knowledge to me, O Oracle?
translation: Bilge bilgini benimle paylasir misin, ey Kahin?

english: Capes are always in fashion!
The light at the end of the tunnel is the demon-infested lava pit.
translation: Tünelin sonundaki isik, iblislerin istila ettigi lav cukuru.

english: Beware the cabbage: it is both green AND leafy.
translation: Lahana dikkat et: hem yesil hem de yaprakli.

english: They say that ham does not mix well with other kinds of meat.
translation: Jambonun diger et türleriyle iyi karismadigini söylerler.

english: A woodchuck does not chuck wood.
No. I'm not in the mood.
It's not you; it's me.
Too many cooks spoil the anchovy pizza.
translation: Cok fazla asci, hamsi pizzasini mahveder.

english: The God Wars are over...as long as the thing they were fighting over remains hidden.
translation: Tanri Savaslari bitti... kavga ettikleri sey gizli kaldigi sürece.

english: He who uses the power of custard mixes it with his tears.
translation: Krema gücünü kullanan kisi, onu gözyaslariyla karistirir.

english: Nothing like a tasty fish.
Don't judge a book by its cover - judge it on its' grammar and, punctuation.
translation: Bir kitabi kapagina göre yargilama, gramerine ve noktalama isaretlerine göre yargila.

english: Yes, I can. But I'm not going to.
A bird in the hand can make a tasty snack.
translation: Elindeki kus lezzetli bir atistirmalik olabilir.

english: Pies...they're great, aren't they?
Who guards the guardsmen?
The great snake of Guthix guards more than she knows.
translation: Guthix'in büyük yilani, bildiginden daha fazlasini korur.

english: Do not fear the dragons...fear their kin.
Everyone you know will one day be dead.
If a tree falls in the forest and no one is around, then nobody gets Woodcutting xp.
translation: Orman icinde bir agac devrilirse ve etrafta kimse yoksa, kimse Odun Kesme XP kazanamaz.

english: Sometimes you get lucky, sometimes you don't.
The chicken came before the egg.
Is it time to wake up? I am not sure...
When in Asgarnia, do as the Asgarnians do.
An answer is unimportant; it is the question that matters.
translation: Cevap önemli degil; önemli olan sorudur.

english: The goblins will never make up their minds on their own.
translation: Goblinler asla kendi baslarina karar veremezler.

english: Jas left a stone behind.
Many secrets are buried under this land.
translation: Bu topragin altinda bircok sir gömülü.

english: There are no crisps at the party.
Help wanted? Enquire within.
I've got a little challenge for you.
translation: Sana kücük bir meydan okuma var.

english: OK...
Can you answer this for me please.
The Oracle has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Kahin sana bir meydan okuma parsömeni verdi!

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
That's wrong I'm afraid.
That's right, well done!
The Oracle has given you another clue scroll!
translation: Kahin sana baska bir ipucu parsömeni verdi!

english: I've got a message for you from the Wise Old Man who lives in Draynor Village.
translation: Draynor Köyü'nde yasayan Bilge Yasli Adam'dan sana bir mesajim var.

english: Many do my wisdom seek; few do their own wisdom to me send!
translation: Bircogu benim bilgeligimi arar; cok azi kendi bilgeligini bana gönderir!

english: It doesn't look like you have space for your reward. Come back later when you do.
translation: Ödülün icin yerin yok gibi görünüyor. Yer acildiginda tekrar gel.

english: New life from these shall perchance spring!
I seek a piece of the map to the island of Crandor.
translation: Crandor Adasi'nin haritasinin bir parcasini ariyorum.

english: Can you impart your wise knowledge to me, O Oracle?
