translation: Bilge bilgini benimle paylasir misin, Ey Kahin?

english: Are you here to smith? Do you want to buy some ore?
translation: Demirci olmak icin mi buradasin? Cevher satin almak ister misin?

english: No thanks.
Well don't waste my time then!
Thanks, I'll send them to storage.
Thanks.
Yes please.
No thanks.
Hello.
You look a bit shady, if I do say so myself.
translation: Kendimi söylemek gerekirse, biraz süpheli görünüyorsun.

english: Well that's the nicest thing anyone has ever said to me!
translation: Bu, simdiye kadar bana söylenen en güzel sey!

english: The name's Oriana. Nice to meet ya!
Oriana shakes your hand with a strong and aggressive grip. She also tries to get inside your pockets...
translation: Oriana elini güclü ve agresif bir sekilde sikiyor. Ayrica cebine uzanmaya calisiyor...

english: Hey, I saw that!
Sorry... Force of 'abit.
Right... Well I'm [player name]. What is it you do around here?
translation: Tamam... Ben Maceraci. Burada ne is yapiyorsun?

english: Well I'm the best thief to ever live, ain't I.
translation: Ben gelmis gecmis en iyi hirsizim, degil mi?

english: This place is filled to the brim with wealthy folk with lots of pricey stuff. It's all prime for the takin'.
translation: Burasi pahali esyalara sahip zengin insanlarla dolu. Hepsi calinmaya hazir.

english: Now what can I do for you?
Do you know what these keys are for?
translation: Bu anahtarlarin ne icin oldugunu biliyor musun?

english: Let me take a look.
Those are keys to the houses round 'ere.
Oh, so I can just waltz right in?
Essentially yes! Though the keys you showed me look a bit old. I'd try to find as many as you can just in case they break.
translation: Esasen evet! Ama bana gösterdigin anahtarlar biraz eski görünüyor. Kirilma ihtimaline karsi mümkün oldugunca cok anahtar bulmaya calisirdim.

english: Can you tell me more about these rich folk?
translation: Bu zenginler hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Yes I can. Some 'ave got houses full of loot, while others spend their days at the bazaar. What do you want to know?
translation: Evet, verebilirim. Bazilari evlerini ganimetlerle doldururken, digerleri günlerini carsida geciriyor. Ne bilmek istiyorsun?

english: Tell me about the houses.
Some of them round here are filled with loot for sure. They've got so many bits and bobs, trinkets and doodads, that they 'ardly ever notice they've been robbed.
translation: Buradaki evlerin bazilari kesinlikle ganimetlerle dolu. O kadar cok ivir zivir, biblo ve ivir zivirlari var ki, soyulduklarini neredeyse hic fark etmiyorlar.

english: You rob them?
Oh yes.
How do you manage that?
First we get keys for these houses, which are always conveniently under the doormat.
translation: Önce bu evlerin anahtarlarini aliyoruz, ki bunlar her zaman kapi paspasinin altinda oluyor.

english: Are you serious? It's that easy?
translation: Ciddi misin? Bu kadar kolay mi?

english: Ha... No. I was just pulling your leg.
You'll 'ave to steal the house keys from the citizens.
All these wealthy folk buy and sell property like it's nothing, so they 'ave plenty of spare keys to go round.
translation: Tüm bu zenginler mülk alip satiyorlar sanki hicbir sey degilmis gibi, bu yüzden yedek anahtarlari bolca var.

english: So how do you steal them?
We pick their pockets of course. I 'ave some of my crew in the bazaar. If you fancy gettin' involved, they might help you out every now and then.
translation: Tabii ki ceplerini bosaltiyoruz. Bazaar'da birkac adamim var. Eger katilmak istersen, ara sira sana yardim edebilirler.

english: Once you 'ave a key, you can break into a house. Not any ol' house though. It must be one that's ready to be robbed.
translation: Anahtari aldiginda, eve girebilirsin. Ama herhangi bir eve degil. Soyulmaya hazir bir ev olmali.

english: The street urchins that roam the streets keep tabs on which houses are vulnerable.
translation: Sokaklarda dolasan sokak cocuklari, hangi evlerin savunmasiz oldugunu takip ederler.

english: Once you know a house is vulnerable, wait for the owner to leave. Then just simply use your key to get in and steal to your heart's content!
translation: Bir evin savunmasiz oldugunu ögrendikten sonra, sahibinin evden cikmasini bekle. Sonra anahtarini kullanarak iceri gir ve istedigin kadar cal!

english: But whatever you do, dont get caught!
So... steal keys, use keys on the houses that are ready to be robbed, make buckets of cash and don't be caught?
translation: Yani... anahtarlari cal, calinmaya hazir evlerde anahtarlari kullan, bolca para kazan ve yakalanma mi?

english: That's it!
If you're not sure where to begin, chat to the urchins in my crew posted round the houses. They'll help you find the next one to plunder.
translation: Nereden baslayacaginizi bilmiyorsaniz, evlerin etrafinda görevli olan ekibimdeki sokak cocuklariyla konusun. Size bir sonraki soygun hedefini bulmaniza yardimci olacaklar.

english: Though it might come at a price.
Tell me about the bazaar.
Some of the wealthiest citizens in Varlamore shop in the bazaar and nearby. A perfect place to pick some pockets!
translation: Varlamore'un en zengin vatandaslarindan bazilari bazaar ve cevresinde alisveris yapar. Cep calmaya mükemmel bir yer!

english: Surely it's not so easy though?
translation: Ama bu kadar kolay olamaz, degil mi?

english: You'd be right about that. If it were easy to steal from 'em, they wouldn't be so rich, would they?
translation: Haklisin. Onlardan calmak bu kadar kolay olsaydi, bu kadar zengin olmazlardi, degil mi?

english: Sounds like you might have some tips?
Some of the street urchins in my crew hang around in the bazaar and on the outskirts. They might be able to provide some sort of distraction.
translation: Ekibimdeki bazi sokak cocuklari carsi ve cevresinde takiliyor. Onlar bir cesit dikkat dagitici olabilirler.

english: They do it just out of the goodness of their heart?
translation: Bunu sadece iyilik olsun diye mi yapiyorlar?

english: You're funny, [player name].
They get a cut in all the wealth we make.
Can I get a cut?
Cheeky! You're lucky I don't steal from you right now!
translation: Küstah! Su anda senden calmadigim icin sanslisin!

english: I'd better get going.
See you later.
Do you work alone?
Nah! I 'ave a network of spies and pickpockets that roam the city. You might've seen 'em?
translation: Hayir! Sehirde dolasan casuslar ve yankesicilerden olusan bir agim var. Onlari görmüs olabilirsin?

english: Seen them? Not sure I have.
Hidden in plain sight. Perfect! Well it's all the street urchins of course. You can tell if they are part of my crew by the purple sash around their waist.
translation: Göz önünde saklaniyorlar. Mükemmel! Tabii ki hepsi sokak cocuklari. Belindeki mor kusagi görürsen benim ekibimden olduklarini anlarsin.

english: Most of them lost their parents to the Colosseum, hoping to get glory for their family. The Colosseum 'owever, had other plans...
translation: Cogu, ailelerine san getirmek umuduyla Colosseum'da anne babalarini kaybetmis. Ancak Colosseum'un baska planlari vardi...

english: That's awful.
It really is. They had nowhere to go and no food to eat, so I offered them a home, food, and all the gold they would ever need to 'ave a good life.
translation: Gercekten öyle. Gidecek yerleri ve yiyecekleri yoktu, ben de onlara bir ev, yiyecek ve iyi bir hayat sürmeleri icin ihtiyac duyacaklari tüm altini teklif ettim.

english: No one suspects them, which makes them perfect spies.
translation: Kimse onlardan süphelenmiyor, bu da onlari mükemmel casuslar yapiyor.

english: Can they help me in anyway?
translation: Bana herhangi bir sekilde yardimci olabilirler mi?

english: Yes they can! Some in the residential area will point out houses free to rob, and some will be in and around the bazaar, distracting the wealthy citizens.
translation: Evet, olabilirler! Bazilari yerlesim bölgesinde soyulabilecek evleri gösterecek, bazilari ise carsi ve cevresinde zengin vatandaslarin dikkatini dagitacak.

english: Well that's handy.
It sure is, but give them any trouble, and I'll throw you in the Colosseum myself.
translation: Kesinlikle öyle, ama onlara sorun cikarirsan, seni Colosseum'a atarim.

english: Understood.
What's your story?
Not much to tell really.
I was an orphan, much like these street urchins you see around the city. I spent my days running around scrounging for food and struggling to find somewhere to sleep.
translation: Ben de sehirde gördügün bu sokak cocuklari gibi yetimdim. Günlerimi yiyecek bulmak ve uyuyacak bir yer aramakla gecirdim.

english: Eventually, I turned to a life of crime and thievery. Turns out I'm quite good at it.
translation: Sonunda suc ve hirsizlik hayatina döndüm. Meger bu iste oldukca iyiymisim.

english: I took refuge in a small spot in the north east of the city. Out of sight, out of mind.
translation: Sehrin kuzeydogusundaki kücük bir yere sigindim. Gözden uzak, akildan uzak.

english: There I met with other orphans just like me. We all wanted payback. Payback on the city for forgetting about us.
translation: Orada benim gibi diger yetimlerle tanistim. Hepimiz intikam almak istiyorduk. Bizi unutan sehirden intikam almak.

english: I'm sure there are better places for you and your crew to find refuge outside of the city. Even outside of Varlamore.
translation: Sen ve ekibin icin sehir disinda, hatta Varlamore disinda bile daha iyi siginacak yerler olduguna eminim.

english: That may be the case, [player name], but I can't in good conscience leave any of the folk here who are struggling. I swore to help anyone in need.
translation: Öyle olabilir Maceraci, ama vicdanim, burada mücadele eden insanlari burada birakmama izin vermiyor. Ihtiyaci olan herkese yardim etmeye yemin ettim.

english: While the Colosseum still stands, family greed for glory will cost people. Some just their livelihoods, others their lives!
translation: Colosseum hala ayakta dururken, ailenin söhret hirsi insanlara pahaliya mal olacak. Bazilari sadece gecim kaynaklarini, bazilari ise hayatlarini kaybedecek!

english: So you really want to make a difference?
translation: Gercekten bir fark yaratmak mi istiyorsun?

english: Well don't get me wrong, I still want to get filthy stinking rich as well!
translation: Yanlis anlama, ben de hala pislik gibi zengin olmak istiyorum!

english: Don't we all...
Managed to steal anything yet?
I have actually! I've found these valuables from some of the houses.
translation: Aslinda evet! Bazi evlerden bu degerli esyalari buldum.

english: Want some coin for those? I'll give you a good deal... One coin a piece.
translation: Onlar icin biraz para ister misin? Sana iyi bir fiyat veririm... Tanesi bir para.

english: One measly coin? That hardly seems worth it.
translation: Bir kurus mu? Hic degmez ki.

english: The thing is, you won't be able to sell those yourself, making them worthless. Still, how 'bout five coins a piece?
translation: Mesele su ki, bunlari kendin satamayacaksin, bu yüzden degersizler. Yine de, tanesi bes kurusa ne dersin?

english: That's crazy! Ever 'eard of inflation. It affects us thieves too...
translation: Bu delilik! Enflasyonu duydun mu hic? Hirsizlari da etkiliyor...

english: 30 coins. No higher.
55 coins is my final offer.
65 coins is my final offer. I've even throw in a little extra as you seem to be the talk of the town, [rank].
translation: 65 kurus son teklifim. Sen kasabanin gündeminde oldugun icin biraz ekstra da ekledim

english: I suppose that's better than nothing.
Good. Do you want to trade them in now?
translation: Güzel. Simdi takas etmek ister misin?

english: Sure thing.
There ya go! Don't spend it all at once.
Not at the moment.
Suit yourself. What to chat 'bout something else?
translation: Sen bilirsin. Baska bir sey hakkinda konusmak ister misin?

english: How's it going, [Player name]?
You don't seem to anything to trade in to me.
translation: Bana takas edecek bir seyin yok gibi görünüyor.

english: Do you know what these keys are for?
translation: Bu anahtarlarin ne icin oldugunu biliyor musun?

english: Can you tell me more about these rich folk?
translation: Bu zengin insanlar hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Tell me about the houses.
Tell me about the bazaar.
I'd better get going.
Do you work alone?
What's your story?
Sure thing.
Not at the moment.
Uh, you guys aren't fairies - what are you doing here?
translation: Sizler peri degilsiniz, burada ne isiniz var?

english: Grunt! Smelly, stinky human! Urgh! Leave us alone before we hurt you.
translation: Grunt! Kokusmus, pis insan! Urgh! Canini yakmadan bizi rahat birak.

english: G'day there, mate.
Good day. Are you alright? You look a little lost.
translation: Iyi günler. Iyi misin? Biraz kaybolmus görünüyorsun.

english: Well, mate, to tell you the truth, I think I've come a gutser with these displays.
translation: Sey, dostum, dogruyu söylemek gerekirse, bu sergilerle basimi belaya soktum galiba.

english: Come a what?
Gutser and no mistake. Me boss asked me to put together a quiz for the visitors.
translation: Basimi belaya soktum, hic süphesiz. Patronum ziyaretciler icin bir quiz hazirlamami istedi.

english: But to be deadset with you, I wasn't paying much attention to me boss over there and I've done a bit of a rush job.
translation: Ama acikcasi, patronuma pek dikkat etmedim ve isi biraz aceleye getirdim.

english: You mean the natural historian?
Yep, that's the bloke. Say, mate, you do me a favour?
translation: Evet, o adam. Dostum, bana bir iyilik yapar misin?

english: Perhaps. What do you need?
Well, you look like a pretty smart cobber. Could you take a look at the display plaques and give 'em a runthrough?
translation: Sey, sen oldukca zeki birine benziyorsun. Sergi panellerine bir göz atip gözden gecirir misin?

english: Sure thing.
Bonza, mate! I reckon three questions per case should be bang to rights.
translation: Harika, dostum! Her vitrin icin üc soru yeterli olur diye düsünüyorum.

english: Take a gander at each case and I'll look over your shoulder to give some advice.
translation: Her vitrine bir göz at, ben de arkandan bakip sana tavsiyelerde bulunayim.

english: Will do.
No thanks. I'm too busy.
Fair dinkum mate. I'm sure I'll get someone else to help me.
translation: Tamam dostum. Baska birinden yardim alirim.

english: G'day there, mate. How're the display cases coming along?
I haven't had the chance to take a look yet.
No worries, mate; just have a go when you can.
translation: Sorun degil dostum, firsatin oldugunda bakarsin.

english: Hmm, I don't think that's right, mate. Try again.
translation: Hmm, bence bu dogru degil dostum. Tekrar dene.

english: Nice job, mate. That looks about right.
translation: Aferin dostum. Bu dogru gibi görünüyor.

english: Bonza, mate! I think that's all of them.
translation: Harika dostum! Sanirim hepsi bu kadar.

english: Well done, mate. You finished all of the displays.
Come over and have a chat with me. I might have something for you.
translation: Gel de benimle biraz konusalim. Senin icin bir seyim olabilir.

english: I'm getting there. I still have a few left to do.
translation: Bitirmek üzereyim. Hala birkac tane kaldi.

english: Bonza, mate. You're doing a great job so far.
translation: Harika dostum. Simdiye kadar harika bir is cikardin.

english: Righty ho! I'll get back and finish the rest.
translation: Tamamdir! Geri dönüp geri kalanini bitirecegim.

english: Good luck!
All done. I've corrected the mistakes.
Beaut' mate! That's the best news I've had all day.
translation: Harika dostum! Bugün duydugum en iyi haber bu.

english: Glad I could help.
Right, I'll have a chat to me boss over there and let him know you've helped me out.
translation: Tamam, suradaki patronumla konusup bana yardim ettigini söyleyecegim.

english: You know, with all this new information you've absorbed, I reckon you can say you're more experienced in Slaying and Hunting now.
translation: Biliyorsun, ögrendigin tüm bu yeni bilgilerle, artik Slaying ve Hunting konusunda daha deneyimli oldugunu söyleyebilirsin.

english: Oh, thank you very much.
No worries, mate. You take care now.
translation: Önemli degil dostum. Kendine iyi bak.

english: Goodbye.
Thanks for all your help, mate. Hope you enjoy the museum!
translation: Yardimin icin tesekkürler dostum. Müzeyi begenirsin umarim!

english: Sure thing.
No thanks I'm too busy.
Hello, can I help?
Yes please. What are you selling?
No thanks.
Answer this, please.
Well done.
You've been given a [new clue/casket]!
Yes please. What are you selling?
No thanks.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu var. Merhaba, selam, selam...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her türlü sey! Kuleler görülmeye deger harika bir manzara.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmenizi tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu vardir. Merhaba, selam, selam...

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: Ama bunlar tek bir selam sayilir!

english: Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her türlü sey! Kuleler muhtesem bir manzara sunuyor.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmenizi tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Human.
What are you doing here?
This passage leads to the lair of what your kind call the Alchemical Hydra. It is an ancient beast, the only one of its kind.
translation: Bu gecit, sizin türünüzün Alkimya Hidrasi dedigi canavarin inine cikar. Bu, türünün tek örnegi olan eski bir canavardir.

english: I am here to protect it. For protecting it will protect the balance. I make sure that only those who have permission can fight it.
translation: Onu korumak icin buradayim. Cünkü onu korumak, dengeyi koruyacaktir. Sadece izinli olanlarin onunla savasabilmesini sagliyorum.

english: How do I get permission?
Only Konar quo Maten can grant permission to fight the Alchemical Hydra. She will rarely grant this permission when the beast needs calming.
translation: Sadece Konar quo Maten, Alkimik Hidra ile savasma izni verebilir. Canavarin sakinlestirilmesi gerektiginde nadiren bu izni verir.

english: Thanks for the information.
Do you have any of my items?
I do not. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: Yok. Eger esyalarindan varsa, ama sen onlari almadan önce öldüysen, artik kaybolmuslardir.

english: I do. I suppose you want them back.
I have to go.
I don't have anything for you human. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: Senin icin bir seyim yok insan. Eger esyalarin bende olsaydi, ama sen onlari almadan önce öldüysen, artik kaybolmuslardir.

english: Human! To attack that creature would be a threat to the balance. Only those with permission may fight it!
translation: Insan! O yaratiga saldirmak dengeyi tehdit eder. Sadece izin alanlar onunla savasabilir!

english: I have some items of yours here human. I'd recommend you collect them before returning to the lair.
translation: Burada senin bazi esyalarin var insan. Yuvaya dönmeden önce onlari almani tavsiye ederim.

english: What are you doing here?
Do you have any of my items?
Thanks for the information.
I have to go.
Enter the lair and risk losing those items.
translation: Iceri girersen o esyalari kaybetme riskin var.

english: No - stay out.
Hi there, friend!
Hello! You're not one of the hunters too, are you?
translation: Merhaba! Sen de avcilardan biri degilsin, degil mi?

english: Oh no, but as someone that makes small soft versions of creatures, this is the place to be.
translation: Hayir, ama kücük yumusak yaratiklar yapan biri olarak burasi tam da benim icin uygun bir yer.

english: These books and the hunters' reports all contain lovely details about my subject matter. I might never leave!
translation: Bu kitaplar ve avcilarin raporlari, benim ilgilendigim konu hakkinda cok güzel ayrintilar iceriyor. Buradan hic ayrilmayabilirim!

english: I'd imagine this is the place to be for materials too. These hunters seem to find everything!
translation: Burasi malzemeler icin de ideal bir yer olmali. Bu avcilar her seyi buluyorlar!

english: The cat is a great way to stress test some of the stitching too. He loves having something to play with!
translation: Kedi, dikisleri test etmek icin de harika bir yol. Oynamak icin bir sey bulmayi cok seviyor!

english: Silver! Silver! Best prices for buying and selling in all Prifddinas!
translation: Gümüs! Gümüs! Prifddinas'ta alim satim icin en iyi fiyatlar!

english: No thank you.
You stole from me. Talk to me when you've considered your actions!
translation: Benden caldin. Yaptiklarini düsündükten sonra benimle konus!

english: You're the one who stole something from me!
Guards guards!
Yes please.
No thank you.
Hello, I am Osman. With what can I assist you?
translation: Merhaba, ben Osman. Nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: You don't seem very tough. Who are you?
I am in the employ of the Emir. That is all you need to know.
translation: Emir'in hizmetindeyim. Bilmen gereken tek sey bu.

english: I hear wild rumours about a prince.
translation: Bir prens hakkinda cilgin söylentiler duyuyorum.

english: The prince is not here. He is...away. If you can be trusted, speak to the chancellor, Hassan.
translation: Prens burada degil. O... uzakta. Güvenilir biriysen, basbakan Hassan ile konus.

english: I am just being nosy.
That bothers me not. The secrets of Al-Kharid protect themselves.
translation: Bu beni rahatsiz etmez. Al-Kharid'in sirlari kendilerini korur.

english: Well done. A great rescue. I will remember you if I have anything dangerous to do.
translation: Aferin. Harika bir kurtarma operasyonu. Tehlikeli bir isim olursa seni hatirlayacagim.

english: I want to talk to you about Sophanem.
Hi, Osman! How are you doing?
My wounds are healing slowly but I think I'll make a full recovery.
translation: Yaralarim yavas yavas iyilesiyor ama tamamen iyilesecegimi düsünüyorum.

english: How is Maisa? Is she back in Al Kharid?
translation: Maisa nasil? Al Kharid'e döndü mü?

english: Maisa is fine. Where she is or what she's doing, I couldn't possibly tell you.
translation: Maisa iyi. Nerede oldugunu veya ne yaptigini sana söyleyemem.

english: One piece of espionage gossip I can tell you is that I won't be returning to Sophanem or Menaphos any time soon.
translation: Sana söyleyebilecegim tek casusluk dedikodusu, yakin zamanda Sophanem veya Menaphos'a dönmeyecegim.

english: Is there anything else with which I can help you?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: I've heard that some of the shopkeepers have been threatened!
translation: Bazi dükkan sahiplerinin tehdit edildigini duydum!

english: We are aware of this. The elite guard will protect them from any harm.
translation: Bunun farkindayiz. Seckin muhafizlar onlari her türlü zarardan koruyacak.

english: Glad to hear it.
Do you know anything about Keris, the dagger I recovered in the course of my last mission?
translation: Son görevimde ele gecirdigim Keris hanceri hakkinda bir sey biliyor musun?

english: We discovered a stash of them in some of our investigations. As far as we have been able to determine, it was created by worshippers of Elidinis in order to smite the followers of Scabaras.
translation: Bazi arastirmalarimizda bir sürü Keris hanceri bulduk. Anladigimiz kadariyla, bu hancerler Elidinis'in tapinanlar tarafindan Scabaras'in takipcilerini öldürmek icin yapilmis.

english: So what is so good about them?

They are specially enchanted against both scarab creatures and kalphites...which is odd, since we thought the two races to be entirely different. Any more details you'll have to discover yourself by using it in the field.
translation: Bu hancerler, hem bokböcekleri hem de kalphitlere karsi özel bir büyüyle donatilmistir... Bu garip, cünkü bu iki irkin tamamen farkli oldugunu saniyorduk. Daha fazla ayrinti icin, onu sahada kullanarak kendin kesfetmelisin.

english: Thanks.
I have some sq'irk juice for you.
Osman imparts some Thieving advice to you ([amount] Thieving experience points) as a reward for the sq'irk juice.
Thank you very much [player name]. If you get some more sq'irks be sure to come back.
translation: Cok tesekkürler Maceraci. Eger daha fazla sq'irk bulursan mutlaka geri gel.

english: I will. It's been a pleasure doing business with you.
translation: Gelirim. Seninle is yapmak bir zevkti.

english: I'd like to talk about sq'irks.
Where am I meant to find sq'irks?
There is a sorceress near the south-eastern edge of Al Kharid who grows them. Once upon a time, we considered each other friends.
translation: Al Kharid'in güneydogu ucunda onlari yetistiren bir büyücü var. Bir zamanlar birbirimizi arkadas olarak görürdük.

english: What happened?
We fell out, and now she won't give me any more fruit.
translation: Kavga ettik ve simdi bana meyve vermiyor.

english: So all I have to do is ask her for some fruit for you?
translation: Yani tek yapmam gereken ona senin icin meyve istemek mi?

english: I doubt it will be that easy. She is not renowned for her generosity and is very secretive about her garden's location.
translation: O kadar kolay olacagini sanmiyorum. Cömertligiyle taninmaz ve bahcesinin yerini cok gizli tutar.

english: Oh come on, it should be easy enough to find.
translation: Hadi ama, bulmak o kadar da zor olmamali.

english: Her garden has remained hidden even to me - the chief spy of Al Kharid. I believe her garden must be hidden by magical means.
translation: Bahcesi, Al Kharid'in bas casusu olan benim icin bile gizli kalmistir. Bahcesinin sihirli yöntemlerle gizlendigini düsünüyorum.

english: This should be an interesting task. How many sq'irks do you want?
translation: Bu ilginc bir görev olacak. Kac tane sq'irk istiyorsun?

english: I'll reward you for as many as you can get your hands on, but could you please squeeze the fruit into a glass first?
translation: Eline gecirebildigin kadarini ödüllendirecegim, ama önce meyveyi bir bardaga sikabilir misin?

english: I've another question about sq'irks.
translation: Sq'irklerle ilgili baska bir sorum var.

english: What would you like to know?
Thanks for the information.
Why can't you get the sq'irks yourself?
I may have mentioned that I had a falling out with the Sorceress. Well, unsurprisingly, she refuses to give me any more of her garden's produce.
translation: Büyücüyle kavga ettigimi söylemis olabilirim. Sasirtici olmayan bir sekilde, bahcesinin ürünlerini bana vermeyi reddediyor.

english: How should I squeeze the fruit?
Use a pestle and mortar to squeeze the sq'irks. Make sure you have an empty glass with you to collect the juice.
translation: Sq'irkleri sikmak icin havan ve havaneli kullanin. Meyve suyunu toplamak icin yaninizda bos bir bardak bulundurun.

english: Is there a reward for getting these sq'irks?
translation: Bu sq'irkleri topladigimda bir ödül alacak miyim?

english: Of course there is. I am a generous man. I'll teach you the art of Thieving for your troubles.
translation: Elbette alacaksiniz. Ben cömert bir adamim. Size zahmetinizin karsiliginda Hirsizlik sanatini ögretecegim.

english: How much training will you give?
That depends on the quantity and ripeness of the sq'irks you put into the juice.
translation: Bu, meyve suyuna koydugun sq'irklerin miktarina ve olgunluguna bagli.

english: That sounds fair enough.
What's so good about sq'irk juice then?
translation: Sq'irk meyve suyunun nesi bu kadar iyi?

english: Ah it's sweet, sweet nectar for a thief or spy; it makes light fingers lighter, fleet feet flightier and comes in four different colours for those who are easily amused.
translation: Ah, hirsizlar ve casuslar icin tatli, tatli bir nektar; parmaklari daha hafif, ayaklari daha cevik hale getirir ve kolayca eglenenler icin dört farkli renkte gelir.

english: Osman starts salivating at the thought of sq'irk juice.
translation: Osman, sq'irk meyve suyunu düsününce agzi sulanmaya baslar.

english: It wouldn't have addictive properties, would it?
translation: Bagimlilik yapici özellikleri yoktur, degil mi?

english: It only holds power over those with poor self-control, something which I have an abundance of.
translation: Sadece özdenetim zayif olanlar üzerinde etkisi vardir, ki benim özdenetimim oldukca yüksektir.

english: I see.
Well done. I have new information to share with you.
translation: Aferin. Seninle paylasacagim yeni bilgilerim var.

english: You don't seem very tough. Who are you?
I hear wild rumours about a prince.
translation: Bir prens hakkinda cilgin söylentiler duydum.

english: I am just being nosy.
I'd like to talk about sq'irks.
I want to talk to you about Sophanem.
Where do I get sq'irks?
I've another question about sq'irks.
translation: Sq'irk'lerle ilgili baska bir sorum var.

english: Thanks for the information.
Why can't you get the sq'irks yourself?
How should I squeeze the fruit?
Is there a reward for getting these sq'irks?
translation: Bu sq'irk'leri bulursam ödül var mi?

english: What's so good about sq'irk juice then?
translation: Sq'irk suyunun nesi bu kadar iyi?

english: As you approach the spirit, you hear a voice echoing in your head.
translation: Ruhun yaklastikca, kafanda bir ses yankilaniyor.

english: You. You fought against the Devourer. Her influence here has been lessened as a result. You are to be commended for your strength.
translation: Sen. Sen Devourer'a karsi savastin. Sonuc olarak, onun buradaki etkisi azaldi. Gücün icin övgüye layiksin.

english: I take it you're Osmumten?
Once, but who I was in life means nothing. Vengeance is all that matters now. The Devourer may be gone, but my home has been corrupted. This corruption must be destroyed.
translation: Bir zamanlar öyleydim, ama hayattayken kim oldugumun bir önemi yok. Artik tek önemli olan intikam. Devourer gitmis olabilir, ama evim kirletildi. Bu kirlenme yok edilmeli.

english: Can I help?
You can. Take your prize and leave, but when you are ready, return here. The Devourer's thralls will soon be back. You must fight them.
translation: Edebilirsin. Ödülünü al ve git, ama hazir oldugunda buraya geri dön. Yiyici'nin köleleri yakinda geri dönecek. Onlarla savasmalisin.

english: I'll do what I can.
We shall see if it is enough.
Yes.
No.
The Devourer's thralls will be back, but they have been weakened because of you. Your prize awaits.
translation: Yiyici'nin köleleri geri dönecek, ama senin sayende zayiflamislar. Ödülün seni bekliyor.

english: You have done well, but it is time for you to leave. The Devourer's thralls will soon return.
translation: Iyi is cikardin, ama artik gitme vaktin geldi. Yiyen'in köleleri yakinda geri dönecek.

english: You fought well. The Devourer's influence here has lessened, but it will soon be restored. It is time for you to leave.
translation: Iyi savastin. Yiyen'in buradaki etkisi azaldi, ama yakinda yeniden güclenecek. Artik gitme vaktin geldi.

english: We are done here, but the Devourer's thralls are everywhere. They must be removed.
translation: Burada isimiz bitti, ama Yiyen'in köleleri her yerde. Onlar ortadan kaldirilmali.

english: The player gets relocated to the tombs' nexus.
Shhh! I'm waiting for the show!
YOU ARE A TERRIBLE BARD!
Don't give up your day job outerlander!
I thought somebody was murdering a cat!
You know, I actually quite liked that verse...
That's kind of catchy. Irritating. But catchy.
translation: Kulaga hos geliyor. Sinir bozucu ama hos.

english: Hey, I've done that quest too!
translation: Hey, ben de o görevi yaptim!

english: I have produced better sounds in the outhouse!
Your song makes no sense outerlander!
What kind of bard are you anyway?
translation: Sen ne bicim bir ozan sensin?

english: I have met cows more musical than you!
When do you get to the good parts?
would torture us so, outerlander?
translation: Bizi bu kadar iskenceye sokacak misin, yabanci?

english: Truly, this is the worst sound I have ever heard!
translation: Gercekten, bu duydugum en kötü ses!

english: looting and drinking part?
Please tell me that was the last verse...
translation: Lütfen bunun son dize oldugunu söyle...

english: Please... Kill me now...
You call THAT singing?
Never before have mine ears been so offended!
translation: Daha önce hic bu kadar rahatsiz olmamistim!

english: Worst. Bard. EVER.
Please, ye gods! Make it stop!
If you stopped singing
The screams of my dying comrades sound better!
translation: Ölen yoldaslarimin cigliklari daha iyi geliyor!

english: My grandmother could do better, and she is dead!
translation: Büyükannem bile daha iyisini yapardi, o da öldü!

english: I do such feats before breakfast!
translation: Ben kahvaltidan önce bile böyle seyler yaparim!

english: Is your singing some kind of outerlander weapon?
translation: Sarki söylemen bir tür yabanci silah mi?

english: Welcome, traveller. Are you looking to represent one of the houses of Great Kourend?
translation: Hos geldin, gezgin. Büyük Kourend'in evlerinden birini temsil etmek mi istiyorsun?

english: Tell me more.
As you are probably aware, Great Kourend is a vast kingdom. Many adventurers choose to wear special clothing which allows them to explore swiftly and with elegance.
translation: Muhtemelen bildigin gibi, Büyük Kourend genis bir kralliktir. Bircok maceraci, hizli ve zarif bir sekilde kesif yapabilmelerini saglayan özel kiyafetler giymeyi tercih eder.

english: As official tailor for Kourend, I can recolour this clothing, allowing adventurers to represent the city to which they are most loyal.
translation: Kourend'in resmi terzisi olarak, bu kiyafetlerin rengini degistirebilir ve maceracilarin en sadik olduklari sehri temsil etmelerini saglayabilirim.

english: If you are interested, I would be more than happy to offer my tailoring services in exchange for Marks of Grace.
translation: Eger ilgilenirsen, Grace Marklari karsiliginda terzilik hizmetlerimi sunmaktan mutluluk duyarim.

english: I'd like to recolour my graceful clothing.
Fantastic, simply pass me the items of clothing you would like recoloured, and we can get started.
translation: Harika, rengini degistirmek istedigin kiyafetleri bana ver, hemen baslayalim.

english: Not right now.
Actually, I just wanted to buy some clothes.
Oh, certainly. My assistant over there, Robyn, will be happy to help you.
translation: Tabii ki. Suradaki asistanim Robyn sana memnuniyetle yardimci olacaktir.

english: Are you sure you want to recolour that piece of graful clothing? It will cost 15 marks of grace.
translation: Bu zarif giysinin rengini degistirmek istediginizden emin misiniz? 15 Grace Mark'a mal olacak.

english: That seems reasonable.
Which city would you like to represent?
I want the colours you're wearing.
Actually, forget it.
Actually, forget it.
Sorry, you don't appear to have enough Marks of Grace. I charge 15 for my services.
translation: Üzgünüm, yeterli Grace Mark'iniz yok gibi görünüyor. Hizmetim icin 15 Mark aliyorum.

english: I can remove that item's colours free of charge. Alternatively I can recolour it to represent a city of Kourend for a fee of 15 Marks of Grace.
translation: O parcanin renklerini ücretsiz olarak kaldirabilirim. Alternatif olarak, 15 Grace Mark karsiliginda Kourend sehrini temsil edecek sekilde yeniden renklendirebilirim.

english: I'd like to remove the colours.
Are you sure you want to revert that piece of clothing? You'll have to pay again if you want it recoloured.
translation: O giysiyi geri döndürmek istediginizden emin misiniz? Yeniden renklendirmek isterseniz tekrar ödeme yapmaniz gerekecek.

english: Yes, I'm sure.
I'd like to represent a different city.
translation: Farkli bir sehri temsil etmek istiyorum.

english: Not right now.
Tell me more.
I'd like to recolour my graceful clothing.
Actually, I just wanted to buy some clothes.
translation: Aslinda, sadece giysi satin almak istiyordum.

english: That seems reasonable.
I want the colours you're wearing.
I'd like to remove the colours.
Yes, I'm sure.
I'd like to represent a different city.
translation: Farkli bir sehri temsil etmek istiyorum.

english: Hello.
Good day, your Royal Highness.
Welcome to the Miscellania food store. We've only opened recently.
translation: Miscellania gida magazasina hos geldiniz. Daha yeni acildik.

english: Would you like to buy anything, your Royal Highness?
translation: Bir sey satin almak ister misiniz, Majesteleri?

english: Could you show me what you have for sale?
No thank you, I don't need food just now.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, su anda yiyecege ihtiyacim yok.

english: What's it like living down here?
The town's thriving. I'm sure it'll soon be as busy as Rellekka!
translation: Kasaba gelisiyor. Eminim yakinda Rellekka kadar kalabalik olacak!

english: Could you show me what you have for sale?
No thank you, I don't need food just now.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, su anda yiyecege ihtiyacim yok.

english: What's it like living down here?
'Ello there [lad/lassy]! What can I be getting you?
I'd like to order a drink, please.
translation: Bir icki siparis etmek istiyorum, lütfen.

english: Of course, what would you like?
Got anything special on tap?
We're always running a keg of our locally-brewed ale, Lizardkicker.
translation: Her zaman yerel olarak üretilen Lizardkicker birasini satiyoruz.

english: I will warn you though, its an acquired taste.
translation: Ama sizi uyarmaliyim, bu biranin tadi aliskanlik gerektirir.

english: What's in it?
Oh, the usual... Wheat, hops, yeast...
translation: Her zamanki seyler... Bugday, serbetciotu, maya...

english: ...reptile scales...
Scales?!
Don't worry about the scales.
Was there anything else?
What is this place?
This here is the Cloak and Stagger. The finest drinking establishment in the whole of Shayzien.
translation: Burasi Cloak and Stagger. Shayzien'in en iyi icki mekani.

english: Isn't it the only pub in the city?
translation: Bu sehirdeki tek pub degil mi?

english: Like I say, the finest in all of Shayzien!
Most of our patrons are soldiers returning on leave from the frontlines. We do get a few regular folk in too though.
translation: Müsterilerimizin cogu cepheden izinli olarak dönen askerler. Ama birkac tane de düzenli müsterimiz var.

english: By the way, its generally considered polite to buy a drink if you're going to stand around and chat.
translation: Bu arada, burada durup sohbet edecekseniz, bir icki ismarlamak genel olarak nezaket geregidir.

english: ...With that said, is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: ...Bununla birlikte, size yardimci olabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: Burada herhangi bir söylenti duydunuz mu?

english: Apparently Veos is looking for some help with something. He hangs around the docks of Port Piscarilius.
translation: Görünüse göre Veos bir konuda yardim ariyor. Port Piscarilius limaninda takiliyor.

english: They say there's trouble in Port Piscarilius. Something about gangs uniting. Might be worth looking into.
translation: Port Piscarilius'ta sorunlar oldugu söyleniyor. Cetelerin birlestigi ile ilgili bir sey. Arastirmaya deger olabilir.

english: I hear that Lord Hosidius has misplaced one of his sons. The Hosidius family might pay a lot to see him returned safely.
translation: Lord Hosidius'un ogullarindan birini kaybettigini duydum. Hosidius ailesi, oglunun sag salim geri dönmesi icin cok para ödeyebilir.

english: Phileas Rimor has supposedly been looking for some assistance with something in Shayzien. Maybe worth investigating.
translation: Phileas Rimor'un Shayzien'de bir konuda yardim aradigi söyleniyor. Arastirmaya deger olabilir.

english: I hear that the rulers of Lovakengj have some work available. You'll find them in the Lovakengj Assembly.
translation: Lovakengj'in yöneticilerinin bazi isleri oldugunu duydum. Onlari Lovakengj Meclisi'nde bulabilirsiniz.

english: Apparently there's been some commotion in the middle of Arceuus. Might be worth checking out.
translation: Görünüse göre Arceuus'un ortasinda bir kargasa var. Bir göz atmaya deger olabilir.

english: That protest outside Kourend Castle is starting to attract some attention. Could be worth taking a look.
translation: Kourend Kalesi'nin disindaki protesto dikkat cekmeye basladi. Bir göz atmaya deger olabilir.

english: No, it hasn't been very busy lately.
translation: Hayir, son zamanlarda cok yogun degildi.

english: Actually, I think I need to be going.
Safe travels!
I'd like to order a drink, please.
translation: Bir icki siparis etmek istiyorum, lütfen.

english: Got anything special on tap?
What is this place?
Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: Burada herhangi bir söylenti duydun mu?

english: Actually, I think I need to be going.
Good day to you, hearty warrior! May the spirits guide you.
translation: Iyi günler, cesur savasci! Ruhlar sana yol göstersin.

english: Welcome back, friend of the spirits. I am humbled in your presence. You are no longer the apprentice, but the master. Seek to inspire all with your daring deeds and legendary feats.
translation: Hos geldin, ruhlarin dostu. Senin huzurunda kendimi kücük hissediyorum. Artik cirak degil, ustasin. Cesur eylemlerin ve efsanevi basarilarinla herkese ilham ver.

english: Do you have anything for me?
translation: Benim icin bir seyin var mi?

english: I see you have free space and no way to record any information you may recover from the caverns. Please take this book as a record of your researches.
translation: Bos alanin var ama magaralardan elde edebilecegin bilgileri kaydetmenin bir yolu yok. Lütfen bu kitabi arastirmalarinin kaydi olarak al.

english: What kind of information are you thinking of?
Those who have previously entered the cavern have not all returned. Some of them seemed intent upon research and discovery as much as loot and daring deeds.
translation: Daha önce magaraya girenlerin hepsi geri dönmedi. Bazilari ganimet ve cesur eylemler kadar arastirma ve kesiflere de merakli görünüyordu.

english: It would be a shame if you were to recover any of their notes and be unable to record them handily. I hope the new book will give you space for such discoveries.
translation: Onlarin notlarini bulup da bunlari kolayca kaydedememek yazik olur. Umarim yeni kitap bu tür kesifler icin sana yeterli alan saglar.

english: Can you help me with hastae?
translation: Hastae konusunda bana yardim edebilir misin?

english: Perhaps. What do you need?
Can you forge anything from this broken-looking hasta?
translation: Bu kirik görünümlü hastadan bir sey yapabilir misin?

english: Yes, I can work with this, but remember, you cannot comprehend how to wield a hasta until you have learned to create one by following my teachings.
translation: Evet, bununla calisabilirim, ama unutma, benim ögretilerimi takip ederek bir hasta yapmayi ögrenmeden, bir hastayi nasil kullanacagini anlayamazsin.

english: ~ WARNING ~ You do not have the requirements to wield a hasta!
translation: ~ UYARI ~ Bir hasta kullanmak icin gerekli sartlara sahip degilsin!

english: Actually, forget it.
As you wish.
Yes, I can work with this.
Actually, forget I asked.
Can you convert Zamorakian spears into hastae?
Yes, I can convert a Zamorakian spear into a hasta. The spirits require me to request 300,000 coins from you for this service.
translation: Evet, Zamorakian mizragini hastae dönüstürebilirim. Ruhlar bu hizmet icin senden 300.000 sikke talep etmemi istiyor.

english: I can't afford that. Maybe another time.
translation: Bunu karsilayamam. Belki baska bir zaman.

english: Can you convert Zamorakian hastae into spears?
Yes, I can convert a Zamorakian hasta into a spear. I do not charge for this service.
translation: Evet, Zamorakian hasta'yi mizraga dönüstürebilirim. Bu hizmet icin ücret almiyorum.

english: I'd like to smash my pots when planting trees again.
translation: Agac dikerken saksilarimi tekrar kirmak istiyorum.

english: Consider it done.
I'd like to be calmer and not smash my pots.
translation: Daha sakin olmak ve saksilarimi kirmamak istiyorum.

english: Could you tell me more of these spirits you continually refer to?
translation: Sürekli bahsettigin bu ruhlar hakkinda bana daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Certainly, though it is quite simple - they are the barbarians of the past who have died in the passing of the years. There are three categories which learned sages claim may describe all spirits encountered.
translation: Elbette, ama oldukca basit - onlar yillar icinde ölen gecmisin barbarlari. Bilge bilgeler, karsilasilan tüm ruhlari tanimlayabilecegini iddia ettigi üc kategori vardir.

english: The majority are at peace, having died with their ambitions sated, even if this ambition was as simple as a glorious death. They can contact those in our world in order to spur us on to glory.
translation: Cogunlugu, bu hirslari görkemli bir ölüm kadar basit olsa bile, hirslarini tatmin ederek ölmüs ve huzur icindedir. Bizi zafere tesvik etmek icin bizim dünyamizdakilerle iletisim kurabilirler.

english: Of course, they cannot or will not contact all inhabitants of these lands, for not all are worthy.
translation: Tabii ki, bu topraklardaki tüm sakinlerle iletisim kuramazlar veya kurmazlar, cünkü hepsi buna layik degildir.

english: So those are the spirits who give us guidance. What of the other sorts?
translation: Yani bunlar bize rehberlik eden ruhlar. Peki ya diger türler?

english: A second category of spirit is made up of those who are not yet at peace. However, all that is needed is for their mortal remains to be laid to rest and they will join the peaceful majority.
translation: Ikinci ruh kategorisi, henüz huzur icinde olmayanlardan olusur. Ancak, tek gereken, ölü bedenlerinin topraga verilmesi ve onlar da huzur icindeki cogunluga katilacaklardir.

english: I can see the pyres serve this purpose. The final category is also restless?
translation: Ateslerin bu amaca hizmet ettigini görebiliyorum. Son kategori de huzursuz mu?

english: Alas, there is a small minority who will never be at rest. These have been slain in moments of insanity by their brothers or by adventurers.
translation: Ne yazik ki, asla huzur bulamayacak kücük bir azinlik var. Bunlar, delilik anlarinda kardesleri veya maceracilar tarafindan öldürülmüslerdir.

english: They are not at rest and will attack those they blame for their tortured state. They are not known, however, for being able to determine this blame with any great accuracy, so should be considered dangerous to all.
translation: Huzur bulamamislardir ve iskence gördükleri durumdan sorumlu tuttuklari kisilere saldirirlar. Ancak, bu sucu büyük bir dogrulukla belirleyebildikleri bilinmemektedir, bu nedenle herkes icin tehlikeli olarak kabul edilmelidirler.

english: Thank you Otto. It makes a bit more sense now.
translation: Tesekkürler Otto. Simdi biraz daha mantikli geliyor.

english: I'd better get going.
I have further training for you.
translation: Senin icin daha fazla egitimim var.

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
Wrong! Focus your thoughts.
Correct, you've completed this part of your training.
Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to answer this for me.
Please tell me your answer.
Nope, Go check again!
Spot on!
Let's talk about my training.
Do you have anything for me?
translation: Benim icin bir seyin var mi?

english: Can you help me with hastae?
translation: Hastae konusunda bana yardim edebilir misin?

english: Can you forge anything from this broken-looking hasta?
translation: Bu kirik görünümlü hastadan herhangi bir sey yapabilir misin?

english: Yes
No
Yes.
No.
Can you convert Zamorakian spears into hastae?
Can you convert Zamorakian hastae into spears?
Actually, forget it.
I'd like to smash my pots when planting trees again.
translation: Agac dikerken saksilarimi tekrar kirmak istiyorum.

english: I'd like to be calmer and not smash my pots.
translation: Daha sakin olmak ve saksilarimi kirmamak istiyorum.

english: Could you tell me more of these spirits you continually refer to?
translation: Sürekli bahsettigin bu ruhlar hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: I'd better get going.
Please feel free to look around, just try to keep your hands off the apparatus!
translation: Lütfen etrafa bakin, ama aletlere dokunmayin!

english: What are you doing?
I'm trying to carry out very important research, but these so-called 'wizards' from the eastern lands keep meddling with my equipment.
translation: Cok önemli bir arastirma yapmaya calisiyorum, ama dogu topraklarindan gelen bu sözde “büyücüler” ekipmanlarima karisip duruyorlar.

english: I'll let you get back to your work.
Farewell, traveller.
How are you doing?
If you don't stop talking to me, I'll never get my slouching time for the day done.
translation: Benimle konusmayi kesmezsen, günün geri kalaninda tembellik yapamayacagim.

english: How old are you now?
I'm old and fat if that's what you're driving at. What, are you thinking of trading me in for a younger model after all the adventuring we've done together? Is that it?
translation: Eger kastettigin buysa, yasli ve sismanim. Ne, birlikte yasadigimiz onca maceradan sonra beni daha genc bir modelle takas mi edeceksin? Öyle mi?

english: No nothing of the sort. I was just trying to make conversation, that's all.
translation: Hayir, öyle bir sey yok. Sadece sohbet etmeye calisiyordum, hepsi bu.

english: Sure, I know your game. Gonna trade me in for some death runes were ya? Eh?
translation: Tabii, oyununu biliyorum. Beni ölüm rünleriyle takas edeceksin, degil mi? Ha?

english: What!! How do you know about that?
I would have thought you would have worked that out by now. Us cats are as wise as that sphinx.
translation: Simdiye kadar bunu anlamis olacagini düsünmüstüm. Biz kediler sfenks kadar bilgeyizdir.

english: Where do you want to go?
I'd just like to go somewhere nice and warm.
translation: Sadece güzel ve sicak bir yere gitmek istiyorum.

english: What do you want to do now?
I want to have a snooze, all this talking has made me sleepy.
translation: Biraz kestirmek istiyorum, bu kadar konusmak beni uykulu yapti.

english: Gosh you're a bit dull and boring.
translation: Tanrim, biraz sikici ve sikici birisin.

english: I suppose that's what you become once you pass your 9th birthday.
translation: Sanirim 9. yas gününü gectikten sonra böyle olursun.

english: Sorry human, but what are you wearing?
I got some cat ears made for me, don't they look meeeeeeeooooowvalous.
translation: Kendime kedi kulaklari yaptirdim, cok güzel görünüyorlar, degil mi?

english: The cat looks you dead in the eye, unblinking.
translation: Kedi gözlerinin icine bakiyor, gözlerini kirpmadan.

english: Am I a joke to you?
UwU?
Why are you doing this?
I thought it'd be cute and funny.
It's not, take them off now human, before I get myself a pair of human ears to wear.
translation: Degil, hemen cikar onlari insan, yoksa ben de bir cift insan kulagi takacagim.

english: How are you doing?
How old are you now?
Where do you want to go?
What do you want to do now?
Human. You seem to have found your way into Mistrock. What are you doing here?
translation: Insan. Mistrock'a girmissin. Burada ne isin var?

english: Am I not allowed to be here?
Your kind have managed to establish dominion over the vast majority of these lands. Will you not even let us have our small corner in peace?
translation: Senin türün bu topraklarin büyük cogunlugu üzerinde hakimiyet kurmayi basardi. Bize kücük bir kösede huzur icinde yasamamiza bile izin vermeyecek misin?

english: Is that a no?
Hmph! I can't stop you being here, but I don't have to enjoy your presence.
translation: Hmph! Burada olmani engelleyemem, ama senin varligindan hoslanmak zorunda da degilim.

english: Is there anything that I can do to change that?
translation: Bunu degistirmek icin yapabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: No. Now if this conversation is over, I'm going to have a drink.
translation: Hayir. Bu konusma bittiyse, ben bir icki icecegim.

english: Is there anything that I can do to change that? I've already been quite helpful over in Cam Torum.
translation: Bunu degistirmek icin yapabilecegim bir sey var mi? Cam Torum'da zaten oldukca yardimci oldum.

english: One act of charity will not excuse years of subjugation.
translation: Tek bir hayirseverlik eylemi, yillarca süren boyundurugu mazur göstermez.

english: Subjugation? That seems like a bit of an over- exaggeration.
translation: Boyunduruk mu? Bu biraz abartili bir ifade gibi görünüyor.

english: Call it what you will. The end result is the same. Your kind prosper at the expense of ours, and you act like it's not even happening.
translation: Ne dersen de. Sonuc ayni. Sizin türünüz bizim türümüzün sirtindan geciniyor ve sanki hicbir sey olmamis gibi davraniyorsunuz.

english: I've seen Cam Torum. You don't seem to be doing too badly.
translation: Cam Torum'u gördüm. Durumunuz o kadar da kötü görünmüyor.

english: And here you prove my point. One city! One! You see that one city and consider it somehow equal to your many.
translation: Iste bu da benim dedigimi kanitliyor. Tek bir sehir! Tek! O tek sehri görüp, onu sizin bircok sehrinizle esit sayiyorsunuz.

english: Well what about this place?
A mere mining outpost. It hardly compares to those villas elsewhere on the island.
translation: Sadece bir madencilik karakolu. Adadaki diger villalarla kiyaslanamaz bile.

english: Not all humans are the same though. It's not just Cam Torum. I've actually worked with your kind a few times.
translation: Ama tüm insanlar ayni degildir. Sadece Cam Torum degil. Aslinda sizin türünüzle birkac kez calistim.

english: Such as?
Well there was this one time when I helped the dwarves of Keldagrim with a bit of a statue issue. Another time I worked with one of the last surviving Imcando dwarves to create a blurite sword.
translation: Bir keresinde Keldagrim cücelerine bir heykel sorununda yardim ettim. Bir baska seferinde ise hayatta kalan son Imcando cücelerinden biriyle blurite kilic yapmak icin calistim.

english: Imcando?
Yes! You know about them?
Of course I know about them! The Imcando were our ancestors, but I thought they were long dead.
translation: Tabii ki taniyorum! Imcando'lar bizim atalarimizdi, ama uzun zaman önce öldüklerini saniyordum.

english: Not quite.
Hmph! It's still going to take more than that to get me to like you.
translation: Hmph! Beni sevmen icin bundan daha fazlasi lazim.

english: Well if liking is out of the question, how about tolerate?
translation: Sevmek söz konusu degilse, hos görmek nasil olur?

english: Fine. Consider yourself tolerated. Now, did you actually want something?
translation: Peki. Kendini hos görüldügünü düsün. Simdi, gercekten bir sey mi istiyordun?

english: What do you do here?
I'm the overseer for Mistrock. I make sure everything around here is running as it should be.
translation: Mistrock'un denetcisiyim. Buradaki her seyin olmasi gerektigi gibi yürüdügünden emin oluyorum.

english: And you do that from the pub?
Am I not allowed a break from time to time?
translation: Ara sira mola vermem yasak mi?

english: I suppose.
Hmph!
You said the Imcando were your ancestors?
That's right. The Lovakengj dwarves were born from the Imcando and we were born from the Lovakengj. If you want to know more, find a historian.
translation: Dogru. Lovakengj cüceleri Imcando'lardan, biz de Lovakengj'lerden dogduk. Daha fazlasini ögrenmek istiyorsan bir tarihci bul.

english: Not really.
Then be on your way so that I can have a drink.
translation: O zaman yoluna devam et de ickimi iceyim.

english: Human. You seem to have returned. Did you want something?
translation: Insan. Geri dönmüssün. Bir sey mi istiyordun?

english: Is there anything that I can do to change your opinion on me?
translation: Hakkimdaki fikrini degistirmek icin yapabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: No. Now leave me be so that I can have a drink.
translation: Hayir. Simdi beni rahat birak da ickimi iceyim.

english: What do you do here?
You said the Imcando were your ancestors?
Not really.
Hoot! Hoot!
Marvelous!
Hello. What are you doing?
I'm the rat keeper, it's my job to look after these here rats.
translation: Ben fare bakicisiyim, buradaki farelere bakmak benim isim.

english: You do know that there are some rats running loose?
Some nibble their way out from time to time. Don't worry there's enough cats down here to sort anything that gets out.
translation: Bazilari zaman zaman kaciyor. Merak etme, burada kacanlari yakalayacak kadar kedi var.

english: So how do these rat pits work?
translation: Peki bu fare cukurlari nasil calisiyor?

english: The Keldagrim pits cater for those with the larger variety of cats.
translation: Keldagrim cukurlari, daha büyük kedilere sahip olanlar icin.

english: If you have an overgrown cat and a couple of coins you can challenge someone else who also has an overgrown cat and some spare change.
translation: Eger büyük bir kedin ve birkac madalyonun varsa, büyük bir kedisi ve biraz bozuk parasi olan baska birine meydan okuyabilirsin.

english: That sounds simple enough so far.
You then agree on a wager. It's rumoured that some ratcatchers can talk to their own cats and give them tactics to aid them.
translation: Sonra bir bahis üzerinde anlasirsiniz. Bazi fare avcilarinin kedileriyle konusup onlara yardimci olacak taktikler verdigi söyleniyor.

english: So then how do you win the challenge?
I was just getting to that. Both the challengers' cats are placed inside the arena, and whichever kills 9 rats first wins.
translation: Tam da oraya geliyordum. Iki meydan okuyanin kedileri arenaya yerlestirilir ve 9 fareyi ilk öldüren kazanir.

english: That sounds vile and cruel.
It's a cruel world and the pits are no exception.
translation: Dünya zalim bir yer ve cukurlar da bir istisna degil.

english: Each to their own, I say.
It sounds a little dangerous for my cat.
translation: Kedim icin biraz tehlikeli gibi geliyor.

english: I agree. Cats have been known to be killed in fights.
Oh how terrible. Is there nothing you can do to save your cat?
translation: Ne kadar korkunc. Kedinizi kurtarmak icin yapabileceginiz hicbir sey yok mu?

english: Of course there is, you can instruct it to be cautious, and it will leave once it feels as if it is in danger.
translation: Elbette var, ona dikkatli olmasini söyleyebilirsiniz, tehlike hissettiginde oradan ayrilacaktir.

english: Oh that sounds quite wise.
That depends on how you value your cat.
translation: Bu, kedinize ne kadar deger verdiginize bagli.

english: Sorry, I don't follow.
Well if your cat dies or it runs away you lose.
So the longer it stays in the fight the better chance you have of winning.
translation: Yani kavgada ne kadar uzun kalirsa, kazanma sansiniz o kadar artar.

english: Wow that sounds like fun!
I don't know about that.
One thing I know though is that it's a quick way to make and lose money.
translation: Bildigim tek sey, bu hizli para kazanmanin ve kaybetmenin bir yolu oldugu.

english: Is there a limit to how much you can bet?
translation: Bahis miktarinda bir sinir var mi?

english: Hmmm... let me think. I don't think that's ever arisen but I think it's 20,000.
translation: Hmmm... bir düsüneyim. Hic böyle bir durum olmadi ama sanirim 20.000.

english: Hmm, that sounds like a silly amount of money to bet on a cat fight.
translation: Hmm, kedi dövüsüne bahis yapmak icin sacma bir miktar gibi geliyor.

english: You'd be surprised what some people would be willing to bet.
translation: Bazi insanlarin ne kadar bahis yapmaya razi olduklarini görsen sasirirsin.

english: There is a minimum bet of 100 coins too.
Can I challenge you and your cat?
translation: Sana ve kedine meydan okuyabilir miyim?

english: No, not now, we don't really bet with outsiders.
translation: Hayir, su anda olmaz, disaridan gelenlerle bahis yapmiyoruz.

english: But I'm not an outsider, am I not inside in the pits now?
translation: Ama ben disaridan gelen biri degilim, su anda cukurlarin icinde degil miyim?

english: I don't know, maybe once you've done something to win over my trust.
translation: Bilmiyorum, belki güvenimi kazanacak bir sey yaptiginda.

english: Can it be bought?
What?
Your trust.
No. Regular townsfolk don't like us, which leads us to distrust them and anyone else.
translation: Hayir. Siradan kasaba halki bizi sevmez, bu da bizim onlara ve diger herkese güvenmememize neden olur.

english: Thanks for your help.
That sounds vile and cruel.
translation: Bu cok kötü ve zalimce geliyor.

english: One more thing...
Thanks for your help.
It sounds a little dangerous for my cat.
translation: Kedim icin biraz tehlikeli gibi geliyor.

english: Wow that sounds like fun.
Is there a limit to how much you can bet?
translation: Bahis miktarinda bir sinir var mi?

english: Can I challenge you and your cat?
translation: Sana ve kedine meydan okuyabilir miyim?

english: Aye, 'tis a fair day my friend.
translation: Evet, bugün güzel bir gün dostum.

english: I'm not your friend.
I'm surprised if you're anyone's friend with those kind of manners.
translation: Bu tavirlarla kimsenin arkadasi olabiliyorsan sasiririm.

english: Yes, it's a very nice day.
translation: Evet, bugün cok güzel bir gün.

english: Aye, may the gods walk by yer side. Now leave me alone.
translation: Evet, tanrilar senin yaninda olsun. Simdi beni rahat birak.

english: Can you sell me a rune platebody?
translation: Bana bir rune platebody satabilir misin?

english: So, how does thee know I 'ave some?
The Guildmaster of the Champions' Guild told me.
Yes, I suppose he would, wouldn't he? He's always sending you fancy-pants 'heroes' up to bother me. Telling me I'll give them a quest or sommat like that.
translation: Evet, öyle olurdu herhalde, degil mi? Sürekli sana süslü püslü “kahramanlar” gönderip beni rahatsiz ediyor. Onlara bir görev verecegimi falan söylüyor.

english: Well, I'm not going to let just anyone wear my rune platemail. It's only for heroes. So, leave me alone.
translation: Benim rune zirhimi herkes giyemez. Sadece kahramanlar giyebilir. Simdi beni rahat birak.

english: I am a master detective.
Well, however you found out about it, I'm not going to let just anyone wear my rune platemail. It's only for heroes. So leave me alone.
translation: Nasil ögrendigin önemli degil, benim rune zirhimi herkes giyemez. O sadece kahramanlar icindir. Beni rahat birak.

english: I thought you were going to give me a quest.
*Sigh*
All right, I'll give ye a quest. I'll let you wear my rune platemail if ye...
translation: Tamam, sana bir görev verecegim. Eger...

english: Slay the dragon of Crandor!
translation: Crandor'un ejderhasini öldürürsen, rune zirhimi giyebilirsin!

english: A dragon, that sounds like fun!
Hah, yes, you are a typical reckless adventurer, aren't you? Now go kill the dragon and get out of my face.
translation: Hah, evet, sen tipik bir pervasiz maceracisin, degil mi? Simdi git ejderhayi öldür ve gözümün önünden kaybol.

english: But how can I defeat the dragon?
Go to the Guildmaster in the Champions' Guild. He'll help ye out if yer so keen on doing a quest. I'm not going to be handholding any adventurers.
translation: Sampiyonlar Loncasi'ndaki Lonca Ustasi'na git. Eger bir görev yapmak istiyorsan, o sana yardim edecektir. Ben maceracilari elinden tutup götürmeyecegim.

english: I may be a champion, but I don't think I'm up to dragon-killing yet.
translation: Ben bir sampiyon olabilirim, ama henüz ejderha öldürebilecek durumda oldugumu sanmiyorum.

english: Yes, I can understand that. Yer a coward.
translation: Evet, bunu anlayabiliyorum. Sen bir korkaksin.

english: That's a pity, I'm not a hero.
translation: Ne yazik, ben bir kahraman degilim.

english: Aye, I ken tell!
Have ye slayed that dragon yet?
Um... no.
Be off with ye then.
I'm not sellin' ye anything till you've slayed that dragon! Now be off wi' ye.
translation: O ejderhayi öldürene kadar sana hicbir sey satmayacagim! Simdi git buradan.

english: Yes, I have!
I have its head here.
You actually did it?
I underestimated ye, adventurer. I apologise.
translation: Seni hafife almisim, maceraci. Özür dilerim.

english: Yer a true hero, and I'd be happy to sell ye rune platebodies.
translation: Sen gercek bir kahramansin ve sana rune zirh satmaktan mutluluk duyarim.

english: QUEST COMPLETED!
(missing, presumably the store is opened)
Thank you.
Yer welcome.
Aye, 'tis a fair day, my mighty dragon-slaying friend.
translation: Evet, güzel bir gün, benim güclü ejderha avcisi dostum.

english: Can I buy a rune platebody now please?
translation: Simdi rune zirh satin alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: Can I have another key to Melzar's Maze?
translation: Melzar'in Labirenti'ne baska bir anahtar alabilir miyim?

english: It's the Guildmaster in the Champions' Guild who hands those keys out now. Go talk to him. No need to bother me if you don't need armour.
translation: Artik o anahtarlari Sampiyonlar Loncasi'nin Lonca Baskani veriyor. Gidip onunla konus. Zirha ihtiyacin yoksa beni rahatsiz etme.

english: I see ye've got one of them anti-dragon shields there. I've got an idea about them things.
translation: Görüyorum ki orada ejderha karsiti kalkanlardan bir tane var. Onlarla ilgili bir fikrim var.

english: What's your idea about anti-dragon shields?
translation: Ejderha karsiti kalkanlarla ilgili fikrin nedir?

english: See, when ye uses them to fight a dragon, they absorb the fire. The shield must be storing the dragonfire, and just letting it radiate away.
translation: Bak, onlari ejderhayla savasmak icin kullandiginda, atesi emiyorlar. Kalkan ejderha atesini depoluyor ve sonra yayiyor olmali.

english: Now, if there was only a way to get the dragonfire out again...
translation: Simdi, ejderha atesini tekrar disari cikarmak icin bir yol olsaydi...

english: What use would that be?
Why, ain't it obvious? Ye could project blasts of dragonfire from yer shield!
translation: Neden, belli degil mi? Kalkanindan ejderha atesini firlatabilirsin!

english: Ye know, I think there might be a way.
What way?
I've heard legends of a thing called a 'draconic visage'. It was made by the dragonkin themselves apparently.
translation: “Ejderha yüzü” denen bir seyin efsanesini duydum. Görünüse göre ejderhalar tarafindan yapilmis.

english: This 'draconic visage' had the power to channel dragonfire. Now, if I could attach the visage to the front of this shield...
translation: Bu “ejderha yüzü” ejderha atesini yönlendirme gücüne sahipmis. Simdi, bu yüzü kalkanin önüne takabilirsem...

english: I will look for this draconic visage!
Good luck wi' that. They're mighty rare, so yer quest will take some time. If any monsters have them, it'll be the dragons.
translation: Iyi sanslar. Cok nadir bulunurlar, bu yüzden arayisin biraz zaman alacaktir. Eger bir canavarda varsa, o da ejderhalardir.

english: Look at this visage.
Amazin'! Ye can almost feel it pulsing with draconic power!
translation: Inanilmaz! Ejderha gücünün nabzini neredeyse hissedebiliyorsun!

english: Now, if ye bring me this and the anti-dragonbreath shield, I reckon I could combine them into something pretty special!
translation: Simdi, bana bunu ve ejderha nefesine karsi kalkani getirirsen, ikisini birlestirip cok özel bir sey yapabilirim!

english: Now, if ye want me to, I could attach this to yer anti-dragonbreath shield and make something pretty special.
translation: Eger istersen, bunu ejderha nefesine karsi kalkanina takip cok özel bir sey yapabilirim.

english: I'll charge 1,250,000 coins to construct it. What d'ye say?
translation: Bunu yapmak icin 1.250.000 altin alacagim. Ne dersin?

english: Yes please!
There ye go. Now, the more dragonfire the shield absorbs, the more powerful it'll become.
translation: Al bakalim. Artik kalkan ne kadar ejderha atesi emerse, o kadar güclü olacak.

english: No, thanks.
Suit yerself.
That's a bit expensive!
Yes it is. But I'm a master smith so I reckon I can charge what I like. Unless ye've got level 90 Smithing too, which I doubt!
translation: Evet, öyle. Ama ben usta bir demirciyim, bu yüzden istedigim fiyati talep edebilirim. Tabii sen de 90. seviye Demircilik becerisine sahip degilsen, ki buna süpheliyim!

english: No, I don't have level 90 Smithing.
I thought not. I'm the master smith of Misthalin! So, shall I construct the shield for you?
translation: Öyle düsünmüstüm. Ben Misthalin'in usta demircisiyim! Peki, senin icin kalkani yapayim mi?

english: Actually, I have got level 90 Smithing.
Oh! Well, I suppose ye don't need me for this then.
translation: Oh! O zaman sanirim bana ihtiyacin yok.

english: The solving of this puzzle could be the key to your treasure.
translation: Bu bulmacayi cözmek, hazinenin anahtari olabilir.

english: That isn't right, keep trying.
translation: Bu dogru degil, denemeye devam et.

english: Well done, traveller.
I'm not your friend.
Yes, it's a very nice day.
Can you sell me a rune platebody?
translation: Bana bir rune platebody satabilir misin?

english: The Guildmaster of the Champions' Guild told me.
I am a master detective.
I thought you were going to give me a quest.
A dragon, that sounds like fun.
I may be a champion, but I don't think I'm up to dragon-killing yet.
translation: Ben bir sampiyon olabilirim, ama henüz ejderha öldürmeye hazir oldugumu sanmiyorum.

english: That's a pity, I'm not a hero.
Can I buy a rune platebody now please?
translation: Simdi bir rune platebody satin alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: Thank you.
Can I buy a rune platebody now, please?
translation: Simdi bir rune platebody satin alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: Can I have another key to Melzar's Maze?
translation: Melzar'in Labirenti'ne bir anahtar daha alabilir miyim?

english: What's your idea about anti-dragon shields?
translation: Ejderha karsiti kalkanlar hakkinda ne düsünüyorsun?

english: What use would that be?
What way?
I will look for this draconic visage!
Look at this visage.
Yes, please!
No, thanks.
That's a bit expensive!
Is this place haunted?
I don't think so. Would it matter if it was?
translation: Sanmiyorum. Öyle olsa ne fark eder ki?

english: Maybe, it depends how haunted. I'm not a big fan of ghosts.
translation: Belki, ne kadar hayaletli olduguna bagli. Hayaletleri pek sevmem.

english: Well, let's hope it's not haunted!
Have you thought about painting the building?
I'm thinking a nice bold red, like the dragon armour.
translation: Ejderha zirhi gibi güzel, koyu kirmizi bir renk düsünüyorum.

english: Or maybe a green, in memory of Elvarg, a very mean dragon.
translation: Ya da belki cok kötü bir ejderha olan Elvarg'in anisina yesil.

english: I think green would look great, it would match the surroundings, too!
translation: Yesil harika olur, cevreye de uyum saglar!

english: Could I get one of those rune platebodies?
translation: O rune zirhlarindan bir tane alabilir miyim?

english: Well, normally you'd have to slay a dragon for me...
translation: Normalde bunun icin bir ejderha öldürmen gerekir...

english: ...but maybe I can make an exception once I've moved in here.
translation: ...ama buraya tasindiktan sonra bir istisna yapabilirim.

english: As a little thank you for the help!
translation: Yardimin icin kücük bir tesekkür olarak!

english: That would be great! Let's get this deal done quickly.
translation: Harika olur! Hadi bu isi cabuk halledelim.

english: I can't wait to complete the purchase!
It's almost done Oziach, not much longer.
translation: Neredeyse bitti Oziach, cok az kaldi.

english: Do you have any plans for it?
I have a few. I might convert the top floor into a bar!
translation: Birkac tane var. En üst kati bara cevirebilirim!

english: It'll be for all dragon slayers I know, there's a lot of us!
translation: Tanidigim tüm ejderha avcilari icin olacak, sayimiz cok fazla!

english: Interesting use of such a beautiful property!
translation: Böyle güzel bir mülkü ilginc bir sekilde kullanacaksin!

english: OoooOooOoOoOoooooooo!
Ah!! Why did you do that?
That scared me!
I'm sorry! I was just pretending to be a ghost.
Don't do that! I don't like ghosts.
Hello Oziach.
Sorry [player name], I'm talking to the estate agent right now.
translation: Üzgünüm Maceraci, su anda emlakciyla konusuyorum.

english: I'm going to head back to the office.
Alright, I'll see you later. Can't wait to move in!
translation: Tamam, sonra görüsürüz. Tasinmak icin sabirsizlaniyorum!

english: I know, it's a lovely place! See you!
translation: Biliyorum, cok güzel bir yer! Görüsürüz!

english: The estate agent leaves.
Ahhh... soon to be mine.
The cutscene ends.
Oziach is alone! Seems like the perfect time to scare him.
translation: Oziach yalniz! Onu korkutmak icin mükemmel bir zaman gibi görünüyor.

english: I just need to climb this tree and blow on the bottle, that should do it.
translation: Bu agaca tirmanip siseye üflemem yeterli.

english: I see you there, what are you doing?!
Oziach caught me. I should try to be a bit faster next time.
translation: Oziach beni yakaladi. Bir dahaki sefere biraz daha hizli olmaliyim.

english: I should talk to Brother Jered about trying this again.
translation: Bunu tekrar denemek icin Jered kardesle konusmaliyim.

english: OOOoOOOooOOooOOOOoOOOO
The player shakes the evergreen tree slightly.
translation: Oyuncu yaprak dökmeyen agaci hafifce sallar.

english: What was that? A ghost?!
Hello?? Is that a ghost?
ONE ghost? Haha, ONE ghost can't spook me!
translation: Tek bir hayalet mi? Haha, tek bir hayalet beni korkutamaz!

english: The player returns to Brother Jered.
Seems like I wasn't very scary. Oziach said ONE ghost isn't enough!
translation: Görünüse göre pek korkutucu degildim. Oziach tek bir hayalet yetmez dedi!

english: I need to find another ghost, to scare Oziach from the trees on the other side of the path. That would work!
translation: Oziach'i yolun diger tarafindaki agaclardan korkutmak icin baska bir hayalet bulmam lazim. Bu ise yarayabilir!

english: I should talk to Brother Jered about this. Maybe he can help.
translation: Bunu Jered Kardes'le konusmaliyim. Belki o yardimci olabilir.

english: The estate agent should be back soon.
What a wonderful day!
It's quite the step up from my little humble house!
translation: Benim mütevazi evimden cok daha iyi!

english: I am slightly worried about the ghost...
Hello!
What are you doing here?
I'm buying the monastery, so I'm just having a look around.
translation: Manastiri satin alacagim, bu yüzden etrafa bakiniyorum.

english: Did you find anything interesting?
Yes! But there is ONE ghost around. It's a little bit scary but ONE ghost isn't enough to scare me properly.
translation: Evet! Ama etrafta bir hayalet var. Biraz korkutucu ama bir hayalet beni korkutmaya yetmez.

english: Would TWO ghosts be enough to scare you?
translation: Iki hayalet seni korkutmaya yeter mi?

english: I don't know, maybe, depends how scary they are.
translation: Bilmiyorum, belki, ne kadar korkutucu olduklarina bagli.

english: Why are you asking?
I'm just interested in ghosts, they're fascinating!
Hello there!
How are you?
I'm very well thank you. Very excited as I'm about to finish buying the monastery!
translation: Cok iyiyim, tesekkürler. Manastiri satin almaya cok heyecanliyim!

english: Did the ghosts not scare you off?
No, there was only ONE, so it wasn't that scary.
translation: Hayir, sadece bir tane vardi, o kadar korkutucu degildi.

english: Only ONE ghost? I thought there were loads!
translation: Sadece bir hayalet mi? Bir sürü oldugunu saniyordum!

english: I've only found ONE. If there are more, then I might have to rethink my purchase.
translation: Sadece bir tane buldum. Daha fazlasi varsa, satin almayi yeniden düsünmem gerekebilir.

english: Interesting.
Why is that interesting?
I just thought there were lots of ghosts, but maybe there is only ONE!
translation: Sadece bir sürü hayalet oldugunu saniyordum, ama belki de sadece bir tane vardir!

english: Hi, [player name].
What is going on here?
I'm just admiring the monastery, I'm going to purchase it!
Are you going to live there?
Yes! I'm going to turn it into a cool house, maybe add a swimming pool.
translation: Evet! Orayi havali bir eve dönüstürecegim, belki bir yüzme havuzu da eklerim.

english: I see. What are the monks going to do?
I don't know, find somewhere else to live!
Was that you hiding by the tree earlier?
translation: Az önce agacin arkasinda saklanan sen miydin?

english: Nope, wasn't me! Must have been someone else.
translation: Hayir, ben degildim! Baska biri olmali.

english: They looked a lot like you.
I have quite a familiar face!
I saw you by that tree earlier, what were you doing?
translation: Az önce o agacin yaninda seni gördüm, ne yapiyordun?

english: I don't think that was me!
Why were you sneaking around the trees earlier?
translation: Neden az önce agaclarin arasinda gizleniyordun?

english: That wasn't me, I've only just got here!
translation: O ben degildim, daha yeni geldim!

english: I'll keep an eye out for them though, they sound suspicious!
translation: Yine de onlari gözetleyecegim, süpheli görünüyorlar!

english: Oziach spotted us! We'll have to try again. Talk to me when you're ready to try again.
translation: Oziach bizi gördü! Tekrar denemeliyiz. Tekrar denemeye hazir oldugunda bana haber ver.

english: Don't be too long though, the saucepan is quite heavy on my head! I'll be here.
translation: Ama cok uzun sürmesin, tencere kafamda oldukca agir! Ben burada olacagim.

english: The player climbs the first tree.
BANG CLANG BANG
Ghosts?! More than ONE?! Stay away from me!
translation: Hayaletler mi?! Birden fazla mi?! Benden uzak durun!

english: Cutscene ends.
Oziach seemed pretty scared after that! Time to go to the next tree along the path.
translation: Oziach bundan sonra oldukca korkmus görünüyordu! Yoldaki bir sonraki agaca gitme zamani.

english: The player climbs the second tree.
BONG DING CLONG
ooOO ooooOOO OOOooo OOOOooo oooOoO oooOOOoo
translation: ooOO ooooOOO OOOooo OOOOooo oooOoO oooOOOoo

english: Ah! How many ghosts are there??
It's working! Scaring Oziach one more time should do it!
translation: Ise yariyor! Oziach'i bir kez daha korkutmak yeterli olmali!

english: The player climbs the third tree.
Help! Somebody help! The ghosts are chasing me!
translation: Yardim edin! Biri yardim etsin! Hayaletler beni kovaliyor!

english: A cutscene starts. The estate agent arrives, and approaches Oziach.
translation: Bir kesme sahnesi baslar. Emlakci gelir ve Oziach'a yaklasir.

english: So many ghosts... I need some help!
translation: Bu kadar cok hayalet... Yardima ihtiyacim var!

english: Oziach! Are you okay? I heard shouting!
Hello! It's not going well. There are a lot of ghosts here!
translation: Merhaba! Isler iyi gitmiyor. Burada cok fazla hayalet var!

english: That's not good at all!
Do you still want to go ahead with the purchase?
