Of course! TWO ghosts is scary, but not that scary!
translation: Tabii ki! Iki hayalet korkutucu ama o kadar da degil!

english: I'll hire myself one of those slayers we see everywhere.
translation: Her yerde gördügümüz avcilardan birini tutacagim.

english: They will help with the ghost problem!
Phew, that is lovely news! I thought it was all over, then.
translation: Vay canina, bu harika bir haber! Her seyin bittigini sanmistim.

english: I'll head back to the office, meet me there shortly.
translation: Ofise geri dönecegim, birazdan orada bulusalim.

english: I'll be doing the final paperwork.
We've failed. Oziach still wants to buy the monastery.
translation: Basaramadik. Oziach hala manastiri satin almak istiyor.

english: I thought TWO ghosts would be enough!
Maybe we need more ghosts? A THIRD ghost?
translation: Belki daha fazla hayalet lazimdir? Ücüncü bir hayalet?

english: I guess so. Let's go and place another advert in the Herald.
translation: Sanirim öyle. Gidip Herald'a bir ilan daha verelim.

english: Wait...
A portal opens in front of Oziach, and Death appears before him.
translation: Oziach'in önünde bir portal acilir ve Ölüm onun karsisina cikar.

english: ...what is that??
It is I, Death!
Oh my...
The scariest. The immortal. The terrifying. Me!
translation: En korkunc. Ölümsüz. Dehset verici. Ben!

english: Where are [player name] and Iffie? I must prove my scariness.
translation: Maceraci ve Iffie nerede? Korkunclugumu kanitlamaliyim.

english: They will regret not picking me!
Death?!
TOO SCARY!
i'm off. You can keep the monastary!
I'm off. You can keep the monastery!
What? I don't want the monastery...?
Oziach walks away from Death.
I don't want to die!
Mummmmmmmyyyy!
What a strange mortal being...
What do you want?
Oh, nothing in particular really.
Well stop distracting me then. I'm meant to be guarding this sacred statue from the temple of Marimbo.
translation: O zaman dikkatimi dagitma. Marimbo tapinagindaki bu kutsal heykeli korumam gerekiyor.

english: Where is the temple of Marimbo?
You're not from around here are you?
Actually, I'm not. I'm a visitor from foreign lands.
translation: Aslinda degilim. Yabanci topraklardan gelen bir ziyaretciyim.

english: Very well. The temple is to the east of the village.
What is the statue of?
It's of Marimbo, you cretin!
Ah yes. How stupid of me not to see the likeness.
translation: Ah evet. Benzerligi görmemem ne kadar aptalca.

english: I'll be back later.
I wouldn't count on it.
What!?
Oh, nothing.
Where is the temple of Marimbo?
What is the statue of?
I'll be back later.
Hello there, what can I do for you?
I don't know, what can you do for me?
Well, I am somewhat of an expert in the field of magical traps.
translation: Sey, ben sihirli tuzaklar konusunda biraz uzmanim.

english: Magical traps? What does that have to do with the Historical Archive?
translation: Sihirli tuzaklar mi? Bunun Tarih Arsivi ile ne ilgisi var?

english: A good question. The Archive is actually part of the Tower of Magic, and was repurposed many decades ago.
translation: Iyi bir soru. Arsiv aslinda Sihir Kulesi'nin bir parcasi ve onlarca yil önce yeniden düzenlendi.

english: Unfortunately, we don't possess full understanding of the Tower of Magic and its many enchantments, so we often discover remnants of traps.
translation: Ne yazik ki, Sihir Kulesi ve onun bircok büyüsünü tam olarak anlamis degiliz, bu yüzden sik sik tuzak kalintilarini kesfediyoruz.

english: The task has fallen to me to investigate and study what we can of these enchantments in the hopes of understanding their magical power.
translation: Bu büyüler hakkinda elimizden geldigince arastirma ve inceleme yapma görevi bana düstü, umarim onlarin sihirli gücünü anlayabiliriz.

english: What exactly is the Tower of Magic?
The Tower of Magic is a uniquely enchanted building located just west of the library, though many levels and rooms are hidden from sight.
translation: Sihir Kulesi, kütüphanenin hemen batisinda bulunan, bircok kati ve odasi görünmeyen, essiz bir büyülü yapidir.

english: I have dedicated my life to studying the powerful enchantments that conceal the many levels of the Tower, though it proves difficult at times.
translation: Hayatimi, Kulenin bircok katini gizleyen güclü büyüler üzerinde calismaya adadim, ancak bu bazen zor olabiliyor.

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: Tell me about the history of the Tower.
The Tower was constructed by King Rada III. We don't know exactly when, since dates were not recorded before the Twill Accord.
translation: Kule, Kral Rada III tarafindan insa edildi. Twill Anlasmasi'ndan önce tarihler kaydedilmediginden, tam olarak ne zaman insa edildigini bilmiyoruz.

english: Following the rebellion of the five houses against King Rada III, the Council of Elders was formed. They used the Tower as a meeting place for the Council.
translation: Bes hanenin Kral Rada III'e karsi isyaninin ardindan, Yaslilar Konseyi kuruldu. Konsey, Kule'yi toplanti yeri olarak kullandi.

english: Since then, it has mostly been used as a residence by the various rulers of the kingdom, with each ruler using the Tower however they saw fit.
translation: O zamandan beri, Kule cogunlukla kralligin cesitli hükümdarlari tarafindan konut olarak kullanildi ve her hükümdar Kule'yi uygun gördügü sekilde kullandi.

english: Eventually, after Kourend Castle was built, ownership of the Tower was passed over to Lord Arceuus.
translation: Sonunda, Kourend Kalesi insa edildikten sonra, Kule'nin mülkiyeti Lord Arceuus'a gecti.

english: This room is part of the Tower?
translation: Bu oda Kule'nin bir parcasi mi?

english: Indeed. During the invasion of the Wintertodt, it was feared that all of Kourend might be lost to the cold. In order to preserve the history of the kingdom, this archive was created during the fifth decade.
translation: Evet. Wintertodt'un istilasi sirasinda, Kourend'in tamaminin soguktan yok olacagi korkusu vardi. Kralligin tarihini korumak icin, bu arsiv besinci on yilda olusturuldu.

english: Unfortunately, as it is a former chamber of the Tower, and we do not fully understand the magic that conceals it, we often discover strange enchantments that we believe to be old traps.
translation: Ne yazik ki, burasi kulenin eski bir odasi oldugu ve onu gizleyen büyüyü tam olarak anlamadigimiz icin, eski tuzaklar oldugunu düsündügümüz garip büyülerle sik sik karsilasiyoruz.

english: Just recently we lost a scholar when she accidentally activated a portal and fell through it.
translation: Kisa bir süre önce, bir akademisyen yanlislikla bir portali etkinlestirip icine düstügü icin hayatini kaybetti.

english: Was she okay?
Yes, she turned up a few days later, a little confused but physically fine. It happens every now and then, but most people turn up eventually.
translation: Evet, birkac gün sonra ortaya cikti, biraz kafasi karisik ama fiziksel olarak iyiydi. Bu ara sira olur, ama cogu insan sonunda ortaya cikar.

english: I guess I'd better be careful then.
translation: O zaman dikkatli olsam iyi olur.

english: Just be cautious of walking into walls. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Duvarlara carpmamaya dikkat et. Baska yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Goodbye.
I have a question about King Shayzien VII.
translation: Kral Shayzien VII hakkinda bir sorum var.

english: What do you wish to know?
I'm trying to find out more about the expedition he ordered to Mount Quidamortem.
translation: Quidamortem Dagi'na düzenledigi kesif gezisi hakkinda daha fazla bilgi edinmeye calisiyorum.

english: I'm afraid I don't have any information on that expedition. You're probably better off talking to one of the others.
translation: Maalesef o kesif gezisi hakkinda hicbir bilgim yok. Muhtemelen digerlerinden biriyle konussaniz daha iyi olur.

english: I could tell you about the kings' work on the Tower of Magic though.
translation: Ama krallarin Sihir Kulesi'ndeki calismalari hakkinda size bilgi verebilirim.

english: Well it's either this or buying rubbish at the Grand Exchange, fire away.
translation: Ya bunu yapacagim ya da Büyük Borsa'da cöp satin alacagim, sor bakalim.

english: Well it's either this or running around telling everyone I'm an Ironman.
translation: Ya bunu yapacagim ya da herkese Ironman oldugumu anlatacagim.

english: During the time of King Shayzien VII, the Tower of Magic was the seat of power in Kourend. The king spent a lot of his time at the Tower, more than any other king.
translation: Kral Shayzien VII döneminde, Sihir Kulesi Kourend'in iktidar merkeziydi. Kral, diger krallardan daha fazla zamanini Kulede gecirdi.

english: In fact, he oversaw the construction of various new sections, most notably the prison.
translation: Hatta, en önemlisi hapishane olmak üzere, cesitli yeni bölümlerin insasini denetledi.

english: When was this?
Well now that I think about it, it was around the same time as the expedition you were asking about. I doubt the two are connected though.
translation: Simdi düsündüm de, sordugun kesif gezisiyle ayni zamana denk geliyordu. Ama ikisinin birbiriyle baglantili oldugunu sanmiyorum.

english: I see. Would it be possible to visit the prison?
translation: Anliyorum. Hapishaneyi ziyaret etmek mümkün mü?

english: Well the prison is abandoned and has been for many years so I suppose there's no harm in letting you see it.
translation: Hapishane yillardir terk edilmis durumda, bu yüzden görmende bir sakinca yok sanirim.

english: Be aware that the magic in that part of the tower is a bit unstable so any items left in the prison will be lost. Would you like me to teleport you there now?
translation: Kulenin o bölümündeki büyü biraz dengesiz, bu yüzden hapishanede biraktiginiz esyalar kaybolacaktir. Sizi simdi oraya isinlamami ister misiniz?

english: Very well, prepare yourself.
I'll be here if you change your mind.
What exactly is the Tower of Magic?
Tell me about the history of the Tower
This room is part of the Tower?
translation: Bu oda kulenin bir parcasi mi?

english: Goodbye.
I don't know, what can you do for me?
I have a question about King Shayzien VII.
translation: Kral Shayzien VII hakkinda bir sorum var.

english: Yes please.
No thanks.
What's going on?
Speaking would certainly help your case.
Well, okay then.
Hello there.
Ohh, I know you. You're the one that helped father take the throne! Of course, now it's my brothers throne instead.
translation: Ohh, seni taniyorum. Babamin tahta cikmasina yardim eden sensin! Tabii ki, simdi tahta kardesim gecti.

english: Which I'm guessing makes you the new Lord Hosidius? How's that going?
translation: Bu da seni yeni Lord Hosidius yapar herhalde? Nasil gidiyor?

english: Boring! Things were much more fun when my only job was to taste the wine and get drunk.
translation: Sikici! Tek isim sarabi tatmak ve sarhos olmakken her sey cok daha eglenceliydi.

english: You still seem to be enjoying the wine just fine.
translation: Hala sarabi gayet iyi seviyor gibisin.

english: Yes, but now I have to do other things as well.
translation: Evet, ama simdi baska seyler de yapmak zorundayim.

english: It must be very hard for you.
It is. Now, if you'll excuse me, I'm going to have another drink.
translation: Öyle. Simdi izin verirsen, bir icki daha alacagim.

english: Hello, who are you?
Hello, I am the panning guide. I'm here to teach you how to pan for gold.
translation: Merhaba, ben altin arama rehberiyim. Size altin aramayi ögretmek icin buradayim.

english: Excellent!
Let me explain how panning works. First you need a panning tray. Use the tray in the panning points in the water and then search your tray.
translation: Altin aramanin nasil yapildigini aciklayayim. Öncelikle bir altin arama tepsisine ihtiyaciniz var. Tepsiyi sudaki altin arama noktalarinda kullanin ve ardindan tepsinizi inceleyin.

english: If you find any gold, take it to the archaeological expert up in the museum storage facility. He will calculate its value for you.
translation: Altin bulursaniz, onu müze depo tesisindeki arkeoloji uzmanina götürün. O size altin degerini hesaplayacaktir.

english: Can you tell me more about the tools an archaeologist uses?
translation: Arkeologlarin kullandigi aletler hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misiniz?

english: Of course! Let's see now... Rock picks are for splitting rocks or scraping away soil; you can get one from a cupboard in the Education Centre.
translation: Tabii ki! Bir bakalim... Kaya kazma, kayalari kirmak veya topragi kazimak icin kullanilir; Egitim Merkezi'ndeki dolaptan bir tane alabilirsiniz.

english: What about sample jars?
I think you'll find them scattered about pretty much everywhere, but I know you can get one from a cupboard somewhere in the Education Centre, just like the rock pick!
translation: Sanirim her yerde bulabilirsiniz, ama Egitim Merkezi'ndeki bir dolaptan, kaya kazmasi gibi, bir tane alabilirsiniz!

english: Okay, what about a specimen brush?
We have a bit of a shortage of those at the moment. You could try borrowing one from a workman on the site... but I don't think they'd give it willingly.
translation: Su anda biraz sikintimiz var. Santiyedeki iscilerden birinden ödünc alabilirsiniz... ama isteyerek vereceklerini sanmiyorum.

english: Sounds like I'll need to be sneaky to get one of those, then... Okay - trowel?
translation: O zaman bir tane almak icin kurnaz davranmam gerekecek gibi görünüyor... Peki, mala?

english: Ahh... that you must earn by passing your exams! The examiner holds those.
translation: Ahh... onu sinavlari gecerek kazanmalisiniz! Sinav görevlisi elinde bulunduruyor.

english: Anything else?
If you need something identified or are not sure about something, give it to Terry; he's the archaeological expert in the next room.
translation: Bir seyi tanimlamaniz gerekiyorsa veya bir seyden emin degilseniz, Terry'ye verin; o yan odadaki arkeoloji uzmanidir.

english: Ahh, ok thanks.
Thank you!
Can you tell me more about the tools an archaeologist uses?
translation: Arkeologlarin kullandigi aletler hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misiniz?

english: Thank you!
Hey there.
Hi hi.
Can't talk too long. I've got to go fast.
Why do you need to go fast?
Fast is better.
You might go a little faster if you put down that giant clock.
translation: O dev saati birakirsan biraz daha hizli gidebilirsin.

english: Then how would I check the time?
translation: O zaman saati nasil kontrol edecegim?

english: That's a good point.
I don't think you'll be going anywhere at this rate. That goose hasn't moved an inch.
translation: Bu hizla hicbir yere varamazsin bence. O kaz bir milim bile kipirdamadi.

english: Be patient [player name], geese always move and cause mischief. If not, I know what we can serve for dinner in the pub.
translation: Sabirli ol Maceraci, kazlar her zaman hareket eder ve yaramazlik yapar. Eger yapmazlarsa, pub'da aksam yemeginde ne servis edecegimizi biliyorum.

english: Oh my.
I'll leave you to it then! Good luck!
translation: O zaman seni rahat birakayim! Iyi sanslar!

english: You too!
Aha! Are you here to parley?
I don't think so.
Oh, that's a shame.
Do you parley here often?
translation: Burada sik sik müzakere yapar misin?

english: I parley everywhere! I haven't encountered a single problem I've not been able to parley my way out of.
translation: Her yerde müzakere yaparim! Müzakereyle cözemedigim tek bir sorun bile olmadi.

english: Really? That just works?
translation: Gercekten mi? Bu ise yariyor mu?

english: That's right! Whenever I run into trouble, I just shout parley! To be honest with you, I don't know the first thing about actually being a pirate. All my wealth just comes from parleying all the time.
translation: Aynen öyle! Ne zaman bir sorunla karsilassam, müzakere diye bagiririm! Dürüst olmak gerekirse, korsanlik hakkinda hicbir sey bilmiyorum. Tüm servetim sürekli müzakere etmekten geliyor.

english: I see. It really feels like that's going to go horribly wrong for you at some point.
translation: Anliyorum. Bir gün bunun senin icin cok kötü sonuclanacagina benziyor.

english: Nonsense! At the rate I'm going, I'm going to be the greatest pirate ever to have lived! Parley! Parley! Parley!
translation: Sacma! Bu gidisle, gelmis gecmis en büyük korsan olacagim! Müzakere! Müzakere! Müzakere!

english: Awk! Awk! Rum's done! Rum's done!
translation: Awk! Awk! Rom bitti! Rom bitti!

english: Awk! More ingredients! More ingredients!
translation: Awk! Daha fazla malzeme! Daha fazla malzeme!

english: Awk! Feed the fires! Feed the fires!
Awk! Gimme a cracker!
Polly, what should we do?
Good day, good day. Come to admire the new parrot aviary have we?
translation: Iyi günler, iyi günler. Yeni papagan kafesini hayranlikla izlemeye mi geldiniz?

english: It's very nice.
Isn't it just?
When did you add it?
Just recently. It would have been sooner, but some wretch thought it would be amusing to replace their drinking water with vodka. The vet had to nurse them back to health for weeks!
translation: Kisa bir süre önce. Daha önce ekleyecektim ama bazi alcaklar icme suyunu votka ile degistirmek eglenceli olur diye düsündü. Veteriner haftalarca onlari iyilestirmek icin ugrasti!

english: What do you feed them?
Well, fruit and grain mostly. I try to give them a balanced diet, but their favourite treat is pineapple chunks.
translation: Cogunlukla meyve ve tahil. Dengeli beslenmelerini saglamaya calisiyorum ama en sevdikleri sey ananas parcalari.

english: Hey! What are you doing with that parrot?
Nothing.
It looks drunk! You should NEVER feed alcohol to a parrot!
translation: Sarhos gibi görünüyor! Papagana ASLA alkol vermemelisin!

english: Well, good thing I found it! I'll just take it to the vet for you, shall I?
translation: Iyi ki bulmusum! Onu senin icin veterinere götüreyim mi?

english: Oh, thank you! We're ever so busy here at the Zoo.
translation: Oh, tesekkürler! Hayvanat bahcesinde cok mesgulüz.

english: It's very nice.
When did you add it?
What do you feed them?
Hi! I'm Party Pete. Welcome to the Party Room!
translation: Merhaba! Ben Party Pete. Parti Odasina hos geldin!

english: So what's this room for?
This room is for partying the night away!
translation: Bu oda gece boyu parti yapmak icin!

english: How do you have a party in Gielinor?
Get a few mates round, get the beers in and have fun!
translation: Birkac arkadasini topla, bira al ve eglen!

english: Some players organise parties so keep an eye open!
translation: Bazi oyuncular parti düzenliyor, gözünü acik tut!

english: Woop! Thanks Pete!
What's the big lever over there for?
Simple. With the lever you can do some fun stuff.
translation: Basit. Bu kolla eglenceli seyler yapabilirsin.

english: What kind of stuff?

A balloon drop costs 1000 gold. For this you get 200 balloons dropped across the whole of the party room. You can then have fun popping the balloons! If there are items in the Party Drop Chest they will be inside
translation: Balon düsürme 1000 altin. Bunun icin parti odasinin her yerine 200 balon düsürülür. Sonra balonlari patlatarak eglenebilirsiniz! Parti Düsürme Sandigi'nda esyalar varsa, bunlar balonlarin icinde olur!

english: the balloons! For 500 gold you can summon the Party Room Knights who will dance for your delight.
translation: 500 altin karsiliginda, sizin eglenceniz icin dans edecek Parti Odasi Sövalyeleri'ni cagirabilirsiniz.

english: Their singing isn't a delight though!
translation: Ancak sarkilari pek de eglenceli degil!

english: What's the gold chest for?
Any items that are in the chest will be dropped inside the balloons when you pull the lever!
translation: Sandigin icindeki tüm esyalar, kolu cektiginizde balonlarin icine düsecek!

english: Cool! Sounds like a fun way to do a drop party!
translation: Harika! Drop partisi yapmak icin eglenceli bir yol gibi görünüyor!

english: Exactly!
A word of warning though. Any items that you put into the chest can't be taken out again and it costs 1000 gold pieces for each balloon drop.
translation: Ancak bir uyarida bulunmak istiyorum. Sandiga koydugunuz esyalar tekrar cikarilamaz ve her balon düsürme icin 1000 altin gerekir.

english: Have you always been here in Falador?

We used to be in Seers' Village, far to the west, but we had to move - the seers were complaining about the noise level, and the knights of Camelot got it into their heads that the Party Room knights were making fun of
translation: Eskiden batida, Seers Köyü'ndeydik, ama tasinmak zorunda kaldik. Kahinler gürültüden sikayet ediyorlardi ve Camelot sövalyeleri, Parti Odasi sövalyelerinin onlarla dalga gectigini düsünüyorlardi.

english: them.
We're doing well here, though. The people of Falador are happy we're here, and we've hardly ever had the White Knights telling us to keep the noise down.
translation: Burada isler iyi gidiyor. Falador halki burada olmamizdan memnun ve Beyaz Sövalyeler neredeyse hic gürültüyü azaltmamizi söylemiyor.

english: We're going to turn Falador into the party capital of Gielinor!
I wanna party!
I've won the Dance Trophy at the Kandarin Ball three years in a trot!
translation: Kandarin Balosu'nda üc yil üst üste Dans Kupasi'ni kazandim!

english: Show me your moves Pete!
Party Pete dances and cheers, then ends in a bow.
translation: Parti Pete dans edip tezahürat yapar, sonra selam vererek bitirir.

english: You've come to the right place!
Party Pete has given you another clue scroll!
translation: Parti Pete sana baska bir ipucu parsömeni verdi!

english: So what's this room for?
What's the big lever over there for?
What's the gold chest for?
Have you always been here in Falador?
I wanna party!
By Ralos! Itsthe Grand Champion!
Itsreally you, isn't it? This is my best day ever!
translation: Gercekten sensin, degil mi? Bu benim en güzel günüm!

english: Have you spoken to the minotaur? What's he like in real life?
translation: Minotaur ile konustun mu? Gercek hayatta nasil biri?

english: You really stuck it to that Sol guy! He's not so tough now.
translation: Sol denen adama gercekten haddini bildirdin! Artik o kadar da sert degil.

english: Can we get a portrait together?
Can you get me into the arena? They banned me after last time...
translation: Beni arenaya sokabilir misin? Gecen seferden sonra beni yasakladilar...

english: Can I shine your boots? Maybe polish your blade?
translation: Botlarini parlatabilir miyim? Belki kilicini da cilalayabilirim?

english: Can I get an autograph?
You're so dreamy.
You smell like victory.
I've been thinking, we should hang out. You'd like me if you got to know me!
translation: Düsündüm de, birlikte takilmaliyiz. Beni tanirsan beni seversin!

english: Are you free this weekend? I'm free this weekend. We should hang out!
translation: Bu hafta sonu bos musun? Ben bosum. Birlikte takilmaliyiz!

english: Wowee!
Hello there! Can I sew ye somethin' tegether?
translation: Merhaba! Sana bir seyler dikebilir miyim?

english: What do you mean?
Well, ye see it works like this; I can sew yer eye patches onto yer pirate hats or pirate bandanas.
translation: Söyle ki, göz bandajlarini korsan sapkasina veya korsan bandanasina dikebilirim.

english: Just pirate bandanas mind ye, I hate the feel of snakeskin. (Shudder)
translation: Sadece korsan bandanasina dikebilirim, yilan derisinin dokunusunu sevmiyorum. (Titreme)

english: It costs 500 gold te do it, and 600 gold te get them separated.
translation: Bunu yapmak 500 altin, ayirmak ise 600 altin.

english: Ok, why does it cost more to get them separated than put together?
translation: Peki, neden ayirmak birlestirmekten daha pahali?

english: Wear and tear on scissors.

On another note, I also sew crab claw gauntlets on to pirate hooks, highwayman masks to black cavaliers, mime masks to black berets, partyhats to glasses and monocles to top hats if ye have them with ye.
translation: Ayrica, korsan kancalarina yengec pencesi eldivenleri, kara süvarilere haydut maskeleri, siyah berelere pandomim maskeleri, gözlüklere parti sapkalari ve sapkalara tek gözlükler dikebilirim, eger yaninizda varsa.

english: If ye also have some flippers and suitably evil lookin' claws, I can probably put them together too.
translation: Eger paletleriniz ve uygun sekilde kötü görünümlü penceleriniz varsa, onlari da birlestirebilirim.

english: So, do ye have anything ye wants doin?
translation: Peki, yapmak istediginiz bir sey var mi?

english: Yes please!
Sure, but remember I charge 500 coins, so if you don't have them you'll have to come back later!
translation: Tabii, ama 500 sikke aliyorum, unutma, eger yoksa daha sonra tekrar gelmen gerekecek!

english: No.
Fair enough. See you around!
Yes
No
Oh no... what do I do?
It's all gone wrong...
What's wrong?
I'm supposed to be cooking a cake for the Cake Off but my prized tin has broken!
translation: Cake Off icin pasta pisirmem gerekiyor ama degerli kalibim kirildi!

english: What's the Cake Off?
Oh, you don't know about the Great Gielinor Cake Off? It's Party Pete's newest idea!
translation: Oh, Büyük Gielinor Cake Off'u bilmiyor musun? Party Pete'in en yeni fikri!

english: He's invited representatives from across the world to have their baking skills judged.
translation: Dünyanin dört bir yanindan temsilcileri davet etti ve onlarin pasta yapma becerilerini degerlendirecek.

english: Who are you?
Oh! I'm Patty Seer, a wandering cook! I'm traveling the world learning everything I can about food.
translation: Oh! Ben Patty Seer, gezgin bir asciyim! Dünyayi dolasarak yemeklerle ilgili her seyi ögreniyorum.

english: Your prized tin?
Yes, I use it for every cake I bake. It brings me luck.
translation: Evet, pisirdigim her kekte onu kullanirim. Bana sans getirir.

english: What's happened to it?
I'm not sure how, but it's broken in two... Do you think you might be able to help me?
translation: Nasil oldu bilmiyorum ama ikiye kirilmis... Bana yardim edebilir misin?

english: I'm sure I can find someone to fix it!
translation: Onu tamir edecek birini bulabilecegime eminim!

english: What about Bob?
Do you think he can fix it?
Yes, I'd imagine he can! Not to mention, he owes me one!
translation: Evet, edebilir diye düsünüyorum! Üstelik bana bir borcu var!

english: Take this to him, it should cover the cost of the repair. You should be able to find him in his shop to the south.
translation: Bunu ona götür, tamir masrafini karsilar. Onu güneydeki dükkaninda bulabilirsin.

english: I'm afraid I can't help you right now.
translation: Maalesef su anda sana yardim edemem.

english: Oh... thank you for the offer but I'm not interested in that.
translation: Oh... teklifin icin tesekkürler ama ilgilenmiyorum.

english: What's the Cake Off?
Who are you?
Your prized tin?
Yes
No
I don't think I can help you right now...
Is it over?
I can't hear anything? It might be?
translation: Hicbir sey duyamiyorum? Öyle olabilir mi?

english: Is someone in there?
N-n-n-no... go away...
Oh okay, fair enough.
Wait! Come back, we need your help.
translation: Bekle! Geri gel, yardimina ihtiyacimiz var.

english: Jack Frost locked us in here when he stormed into our bakery. We tried to stop him from messing up our production, but he got grumpy.
translation: Jack Frost firinimiza saldirdiginda bizi buraya kilitledi. Üretimimizi bozmasini engellemeye calistik ama sinirlendi.

english: I ran into one of your bakers outside, he said you were in trouble.
translation: Disarida firincilarinizdan birine rastladim, basinizin dertte oldugunu söyledi.

english: Oh Remy is still alive! We thought Jack fed him to the Icelord.
translation: Oh, Remy hala hayatta! Jack'in onu Buz Lordu'na yem yaptigini saniyorduk.

english: Where's the key? The door looks locked to me.
I thought you had it, Mary.
Well I thought you had it, Paul.
translation: Ben de sende oldugunu saniyordum, Paul.

english: Don't you think I'd have opened the door if I had it?
translation: Eger bende olsaydi kapiyi acmaz miydim sence?

english: Don't you think I would have opened the door as well!
Great, now I'm locked in here with you for the rest of my life.
translation: Harika, simdi hayatimin geri kalanini seninle burada kilitli kalacagim.

english: Woah calm down! If it's not in there, it must be out here. Let me look for it.
translation: Sakin ol! Orada degilse, burada olmali. Ben bakayim.

english: RAAAAAAAAAAAWR
The Icelord sees you trying to enter their cage and blasts you backwards.
translation: Buz Lordu, kafesine girmeye calistigini görür ve seni geriye dogru firlatir.

english: Ooooh that sounds like it hurt!
Are you okay dear? That sounded quite nasty.
translation: Iyi misin canim? Oldukca kötü görünüyordu.

english: Well, I found the key.
That's great, come on let us out then.
Yes hurry up, we need to get back on schedule.
translation: Evet, acele et, programa yetismemiz lazim.

english: That's going to be a problem, it's in the cage with the Icelord.
translation: Bu sorun olacak, anahtar Icelord'un kafesinde.

english: I've got no way to get it with the Icelord there.
translation: Icelord oradayken anahtari almamin imkani yok.

english: Did you try telegrabbing it?
I'm stumped, I can't find the key.
You've looked around the bakery and no luck?
If it's not in here or in the back room, it must be in the cage with the Icelord.
translation: Burada ya da arka odada degilse, Icelord'un kafesinde olmali.

english: It wouldn't be safe to go in there.
Could you try telegrabbing it?
That won't work, the Icelord's magic will interfere.
translation: Bu ise yaramaz, Icelord'un büyüsü engel olur.

english: Hmm... You're going to need a way to protect yourself from the Icelord.
translation: Hmm... Icelord'dan kendini korumak icin bir yol bulmalisin.

english: Don't suppose you have an Anti-Icelord Shield lying around here then?
translation: Burada Anti-Icelord Kalkani falan yok mu?

english: I don't, do you Paul?
translation: Bende yok, sende var mi Paul?

english: No I don't...
But I do have a genius idea, we'll use Gingerbread!
translation: Ama harika bir fikrim var, zencefilli kurabiye kullanacagiz!...

english: Before Jack locked us up, I saw him using the Icelord to ice his Gingerbread Gnomes. They did a great job of absorbing his breath.
translation: Jack bizi kilitlemeden önce, Icelord'u Gingerbread Gnomes'u dondurmak icin kullandigini gördüm. Onun nefesini emmek icin harika bir is cikardilar.

english: You'll need to make a Gingerbread Gnome big enough to absorb the Icelord's breath.
translation: Icelord'un nefesini emecek kadar büyük bir Gingerbread Gnome yapmalisin.

english: How am I going to do that?
Our usual recipe uses: one cinnamon, one ginger, one flour and one egg, we put them into that big machine you see to your left.
translation: Her zamanki tarifimizde bir tarcin, bir zencefil, bir un ve bir yumurta kullaniyoruz, bunlari solunda gördügün büyük makineye koyuyoruz.

english: Try using more of each ingredient till you get the right combination? Possibly tripling the amount of each ingredient might work.
translation: Dogru kombinasyonu bulana kadar her malzemeyi daha fazla kullanmayi dene. Her malzemenin miktarini üc katina cikarmak ise yarayabilir.

english: This is such a ridiculous idea, guess I have no choice....
translation: Bu cok sacma bir fikir, sanirim baska secenegim yok...

english: Come back to us if you need some more help.
translation: Daha fazla yardima ihtiyacin olursa bize gel.

english: What ingredients did I need again?
You'll need ginger, cinnamon, flour and eggs. We usually only use one of each, maybe tripling the amount of each will work.
translation: Zencefil, tarcin, un ve yumurtaya ihtiyacin olacak. Genelde her birinden sadece bir tane kullaniriz, belki her birinin miktarini üc katina cikarmak ise yarayabilir.

english: Great thanks, I'll see what I can do.
So I made the shield, now what?
Fantastic! Now you need to enter the Icelord's cage.
translation: Harika! Simdi Icelord'un kafesine girmen gerekiyor.

english: Don't worry, I'm sure this idea will work, just make sure to equip it before you go in.
translation: Merak etme, bu fikir ise yarayacaktir, iceri girmeden önce kalkani takmayi unutma.

english: I found the key!
That's great! Now hurry up and open the door.
translation: Harika! Simdi acele et ve kapiyi ac.

english: You release the bakers and give back their key...
translation: Firincilari serbest birak ve anahtarlarini geri ver...

english: There you go, unlocked without an issue.
Wow, you managed to do that so quickly! Without any help from us.
translation: Vay canina, bunu cok cabuk basardin! Bizim yardimimiz olmadan.

english: You're very impressive, what a coincidence that you knew to make a giant piece of gingerbread to protect yourself.
translation: Cok etkileyicisin, kendini korumak icin dev bir zencefilli kurabiye yapmayi bilmen ne tesadüf.

english: Ha ha, yeah, it was no problem.
Well, thanks for freeing us!
I can't believe that actually worked....
...Me too, I thought you'd be turned into icing for sure.
translation: ... Ben de, kesinlikle sekerleme haline gelecegini düsünmüstüm.

english: So you're telling me you weren't even sure it would!?
translation: Yani bunun ise yarayacagindan emin degildin, öyle mi?

english: It worked out didn't it? We're free to continue making Gingerbread Gnomes.
translation: Ise yaradi, degil mi? Zencefilli kurabiye cüceleri yapmaya devam etmekte özgürüz.

english: That was extremely reckless, Paul, but you're right, it did work out in the end.
translation: Bu cok pervasizcaydi Paul, ama haklisin, sonunda ise yaradi.

english: ...fine. I should go tell Santa the good news, the bakery is back in operation.
translation: ...tamam. Noel Baba'ya iyi haberi vermeliyim, firin yeniden faaliyete gecti.

english: We'll be back in full production in no time!
translation: Kisa sürede tam kapasite üretime gececegiz!

english: What do we do about the Icelord in the cage?
Maybe Jack was onto something by using it to ice the Gingerbread Gnomes.
translation: Belki Jack, zencefilli kurabiye cüceleri buzlamak icin onu kullanarak bir sey kesfetmistir.

english: You should take the giant piece of gingerbread you made and show it to Santa, he'll know we're back in business then.
translation: Yaptigin dev zencefilli kurabiyeyi Noel Baba'ya göstermelisin, o zaman isimize geri döndügümüzü anlar.

english: Alright, time for you to go, we need to get back into production.
translation: Tamam, gitme zamani, üretime geri dönmeliyiz.

english: Go away, we're busy trying to catch up.
Just quickly, Santa said you shouldn't use the Icelord to ice your gnomes.
translation: Kisa bir sey söyleyecegim, Noel Baba Icelord'u cüceleri buzlamak icin kullanmamanizi söyledi.

english: Why not?
Something about Icelord saliva not being safe to eat.
translation: Icelord'un salyasinin yenilmesinin güvenli olmadigiyla ilgili bir sey.

english: Oh, thanks for telling us, we'll go back to using normal icing.
translation: Oh, söyledigin icin tesekkürler, normal buzlamaya geri dönecegiz.

english: Hello there.
Ah, a stranger to our island. What brings you here?
translation: Ah, adamiza yabanci birisi. Buraya ne getiriyor?

english: Well, I've actually come here on a diplomatic mission. I want to try and settle some of the disputes between the Fremenniks and your clan.
translation: Aslinda diplomatik bir görev icin geldim. Fremennikler ile klaniniz arasindaki bazi anlasmazliklari cözmeye calismak istiyorum.

english: The Rremenniks? Pah! They are just too ignorant and stubborn to listen to anything we have to say - how can we possibly associate with a race that won't listen?
translation: Rremennikler mi? Pah! Onlar cok cahil ve inatci, bizim söylediklerimizi dinlemiyorlar - dinlemeyen bir irkla nasil iliski kurabiliriz ki?

english: I think they are very eager to listen, but they feel like you are keeping secrets from them.
translation: Bence dinlemeye cok istekli, ama sizden sir sakladiginizi düsünüyorlar.

english: Secrets?
Yes, as in your magic ways. To be honest, I think it is fear of the unknown.
translation: Evet, sizin sihirli yöntemleriniz gibi. Dürüst olmak gerekirse, bence bu bilinmeyene karsi duyulan korkudan kaynaklaniyor.

english: Well, when the day comes that a Fremennik can prove they have the patience and interest in learning our ways, then we will perhaps share our secrets.
translation: Fremennikler sabirli olduklarini ve yöntemlerimizi ögrenmeye istekli olduklarini kanitladiklari gün, belki o zaman sirlarimizi paylasiriz.

english: I'm hoping I might be able to achieve that.
Good luck. It's far from simple.
translation: Iyi sanslar. Bu hic de kolay bir is degil.

english: I'm on the lookout for ceremonial clothing so I can visit my dreams. I don't suppose you could help me out?
translation: Rüyalarimi ziyaret edebilmek icin tören kiyafeti ariyorum. Bana yardim edebilir misin?

english: Ah, I know the ceremony very well. Maybe I can help. I do have a cape, but why would I want to give it so some random person off the streets?
translation: Ah, töreni cok iyi biliyorum. Belki yardimci olabilirim. Bir pelerinim var, ama neden onu sokaktaki rastgele birine vereyim ki?

english: Because you're a kind person and like helping people in need?
translation: Cünkü sen iyi bir insansin ve ihtiyaci olan insanlara yardim etmeyi seviyorsun?

english: Nice try. But I am always glad to help a person in need, if they can demonstrate some insight.
translation: Iyi deneme. Ama ihtiyaci olan birine yardim etmekten her zaman memnuniyet duyarim, tabii biraz anlayis gösterirlerse.

english: I'm listening...
How about you try and guess my name!
translation: Sen benim adimi tahmin etmeye ne dersin!

english: Hmmm.
Bob?
How rude!
Well you do seem to have a moustache growing.
Get out of my sight!
Pauline
Ah, you'd think so, but no. That is my alias. I want you to tell me my REAL name! I have one first name, and a triple barrel surname!
translation: Ah, öyle sanirsin, ama hayir. O benim takma adim. Bana GERCEK adimi söylemeni istiyorum! Bir ilk adim ve üclü soyadim var!

english: Oh no. Can't you give me some kind of clue?
translation: Oh hayir. Bana bir ipucu veremez misin?

english: Let's see...
Ok. Change a letter from the word Dane to get my first name. The first part of my surname rhymes with wood, the third part rhymes with spade and the second rhymes with magic.
translation: Tamam. Dane kelimesindeki bir harfi degistirerek ilk ismimi bulabilirsin. Soyadimin ilk kismi wood ile, ücüncü kismi spade ile ve ikinci kismi magic ile kafiyeli.

english: Jane Blud-Hagic-Maid.
That's it! Well done.
Woo hoo! Not the most normal name is it?
translation: Woo hoo! Pek normal bir isim degil, degil mi?

english: It's not my fault my parents had an over active imagination.
translation: Ailemin hayal gücü fazla aktif olmasi benim sucum degil.

english: Sounds like they were totally insane.
Do you want this cape or not?
translation: Bu pelerini istiyor musun, istemiyor musun?

english: Sorry, yes please.
Tina?
Ha! Nice try, but no.
Bob?
Pauline?
Tina?
I'm terribly sorry, but I don't have time to talk right now, the Duke might need me.
translation: Cok üzgünüm, ama su anda konusacak vaktim yok, Dük'ün bana ihtiyaci olabilir.

english: Hey, do you know what's going on with the Duke?
translation: Hey, Dük'e ne oldugunu biliyor musun?

english: It's that cursed egg.
He does have a strange relation with it... He does know it's an inanimate object, right?
translation: Onunla garip bir iliskisi var... Onun cansiz bir nesne oldugunu biliyor, degil mi?

english: The Duke is a little, different, he's never been very good at making decisions.
translation: Dük biraz farklidir, karar vermekte hic iyi degildir.

english: But ever since this egg came along, he has let it make all the decisions for him.
translation: Ama bu yumurta ortaya ciktigindan beri, tüm kararlari onun adina o veriyor.

english: What does it do? He just seemed to ask it questions and shake it.
translation: Ne yapiyor? Sadece ona sorular sorup salliyor gibi görünüyor.

english: I don't know how it works, but I know it's wrong.
translation: Nasil calistigini bilmiyorum, ama bunun yanlis oldugunu biliyorum.

english: I managed to sneak in and ask it a question one night, I asked: 'Magic Egg, are we puppets to a being we cannot comprehend?', it responded with almost certainly.
translation: Bir gece gizlice iceri girip ona bir soru sordum: “Sihirli Yumurta, bizler anlayamadigimiz bir varligin kuklalari miyiz?” diye sordum, o da neredeyse kesin bir sekilde cevap verdi.

english: That's a very strange thing to ask a talking egg.
translation: Konusan bir yumurtaya sorulacak cok garip bir soru.

english: I had a couple forest carrots that night and was feeling a bit off.
translation: O gece birkac orman havucu yedim ve kendimi biraz kötü hissediyordum....

english: ... Uh... alright then.
We need to do something, the magician on the other side of the por....
translation: Bir seyler yapmaliyiz, kapinin diger tarafindaki sihirbaz...

english: I mean, who knows where that portal leads to, rabbits might be hopping to their death!
translation: Yani, o kapinin nereye ciktigini kim bilir, tavsanlar ölümlerine zipliyor olabilirler!

english: I agree, I've hatched a plan that could save rabbits from certain doom.
translation: Katiliyorum, tavsanlari kesin ölümden kurtarabilecek bir plan yaptim.

english: I'm all ears.
We're going to make an egg similar to his one, but it only replies negatively.
translation: Onunkine benzer bir yumurta yapacagiz, ama sadece olumsuz cevaplar verecek.

english: How am I going to make that? I've only got two very small paws and no thumbs.
translation: Bunu nasil yapacagim? Sadece iki kücük pencem var ve basparmagim yok.

english: You'll need three things: a conch shell, if you whisper into it, it will echo back whatever you say, you should be able to find one on the beach.
translation: Üc seye ihtiyacin olacak: bir deniz kabugu, icine fisildadiginda söyledigin her seyi yankilar, sahilde bulabilirsin.

english: Next you'll need an egg to put it in. To make it look like the real one in his room.
translation: Sonra icine koymak icin bir yumurta lazim. Onun odasindaki gercek yumurtaya benzemesi icin.

english: Finally, you'll need to paint it gold. Luckily, we've done some redecorating on the top floor of the castle, you should find some paint there.
translation: Son olarak, onu altin rengine boyamaniz gerekecek. Neyse ki, kalenin en üst katini yeniden dekore ettik, orada boya bulabilirsiniz.

english: Good luck, if you have any more questions let me know.
translation: Iyi sanslar, baska sorunuz olursa bana haber verin.

english: How are you getting along with making the  replacement egg?
translation: Yedek yumurtayi yapma isi nasil gidiyor?

english: I can't remember what I needed.
Good luck, if you have anymore questions let me know.
translation: Iyi sanslar, baska sorunuz olursa bana haber verin.

english: That's great, you're almost there, you just need to paint it now.
translation: Harika, neredeyse bitti, simdi sadece boyamaniz gerekiyor.

english: Where am I supposed to find some paint?
There should be some left over paint on the roof of the castle, we were repainting some of it.
translation: Kalenin catisinda biraz boya kalmis olmali, bir kismini yeniden boyuyorduk.

english: Hello Paws, I managed to make a replacement egg.
translation: Merhaba Paws, yedek yumurtayi yapmayi basardim.

english: Perfect and it only gives negative answers?
translation: Mükemmel ve sadece olumsuz cevaplar mi veriyor?

english: Yep, I tested it myself.
Great, all that's left to do is the switch, you need to convince him that this egg is the real one.
translation: Harika, geriye sadece degistirme isi kaldi, ona bu yumurtanin gercek oldugunu ikna etmelisin.

english: How do you suppose I do that?
You could get him to ask the real one if it is real and hope it says no.
translation: Ona gercek yumurtaya gercek olup olmadigini sordurtabilir ve hayir demesini umabilirsin.

english: And if it says it is the real egg.
translation: Peki ya gercek yumurta oldugunu söylerse?...

english: -Shrugs-
Fine, I'll see what I can do.
Somehow your plan worked.
Of course it would, the egg told me.
translation: Tabii ki ise yarayacakti, yumurta bana söyledi.

english: Woe is me! Our crops are all failing... how shall I feed myself this winter?
translation: Vah benim halime! Mahsulümüz tamamen mahvoldu... Bu kis kendimi nasil besleyecegim?

english: Oh happy day! Suddenly our crops are growing again! It'll be a bumper harvest this year!
translation: Ne mutlu bir gün! Birdenbire mahsulümüz tekrar büyümeye basladi! Bu yil rekor bir hasat olacak!

english: Hey, human.
Who are you?
Just a guard. If sneaky humans come in here without permission, I chuck rocks at 'em, knock 'em out and chuck 'em out of Weiss.
translation: Sadece bir muhafiz. Izin almadan buraya gizlice giren insanlara tas atarim, onlari bayilttirip Weiss'tan atarim.

english: I'm familiar with the idea, yeah.
Tell me about this place.
This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: Burasi Weiss. Yillar önce, daha güneydeki magaralardan kovulduktan sonra troller insa etti. Simdi Weiss bizim evimiz.

english: We done pretty good here. Got lots of goat and wolf to eat - they taste kinda boring after all this time, but there not much other choice.
translation: Burada oldukca iyi durumdayiz. Yemek icin bolca keci ve kurt var - bu kadar zaman gectikten sonra tadi biraz sikici geliyor, ama baska secenegimiz yok.

english: Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it. In fact My Arm is an expert on growing the stuff.
translation: Hic gut otu denedin mi? Onu seven troller taniyorum. Aslinda My Arm bu bitkinin yetistirilmesinde uzmandir.

english: Never heard of no gouty weed, no. But it sound like a vegetable, an' Mother not like eating those, so we probably not gonna try it.
translation: Gut otu diye bir sey duymadim, hayir. Ama sebzeye benziyor ve annem sebze yemeyi sevmez, bu yüzden muhtemelen denemeyecegiz.

english: Mother not like new ideas much, but he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: Annem yeni fikirleri pek sevmez, ama o cok büyük ve patron, bu yüzden ne derse onu yapariz.

english: I see.
Do you like it here?
Eh, it kinda rough, but it our home. Odd Mushroom say he can make it nicer with fancy fires what he invented, but Mother not interested in that, so Odd Mushroom not allowed to do it.
translation: Eh, biraz zorlu ama burasi bizim evimiz. Odd Mushroom, icat ettigi süslü ateslerle burayi daha güzel hale getirebilecegini söylüyor ama annem bununla ilgilenmiyor, bu yüzden Odd Mushroom bunu yapamiyor.

english: Mother only care about stuff to help him fight better. An he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: Annem sadece onun daha iyi savasmasina yardimci olacak seylerle ilgileniyor. O cok büyük ve patron, bu yüzden ne derse onu yapiyoruz.

english: I'll be off.
Hey, friend of Snowflake!
Just a guard. If sneaky human come in here without permission, I chuck rocks at 'em, knock 'em out and chuck 'em out of Weiss.
translation: Sadece bir muhafiz. Izin almadan buraya gizlice giren insanlar olursa, onlara tas atip bayilttiktan sonra Weiss'tan disari atiyorum.

english: It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: Burasi harika, simdi Snowflake ve kocasi troll bize goutweed yetistirmeyi ögretti. Artik yemekler cok daha lezzetli.

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: Eh, biraz zorlu ama gittikce iyilesiyor. Snowflake bize goutweed yetistirmeyi ögretti. Keci, kurt, insan, hepsi goutweed ile cok daha lezzetli oluyor.

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: Evet, Weiss yasamak icin iyi bir yer, simdi Snowflake sorumlu. Tüm troller Snowflake'i sever. Kocasi biraz tuhaf bir trol, ama bu bizim sorunumuz degil.

english: Who are you?
Tell me about this place.
Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it.
translation: Goutweed denedin mi hic? Onu seven troller taniyorum.

english: I see.
Do you like it here?
I'll be off.
I have no interest in talking to you just now outerlander.
translation: Su anda seninle konusmak istemiyorum, yabanci.

english: Hello there. I have some wallasalki bone fragments, and I understand you may be able to use them to make some armour for me...?
translation: Merhaba. Bende biraz wallasalki kemik parcalari var, bunlari kullanarak bana zirh yapabilir misin?

english: I see great things in your future outerlander, but I will not go against the wishes of the tribe, and will not make armour for an outerlander.
translation: Geleceginde büyük seyler görüyorum yabanci, ama kabilenin isteklerine karsi gelmeyecegim ve bir yabanciya zirh yapmayacagim.

english: You may try and gain a dispensation from Chieftain Brundt, but I suspect you will be unsuccessful...
translation: Sef Brundt'tan izin almayi deneyebilirsin, ama basarili olacagini sanmiyorum...

english: Hey! Outerlander! That is my house! Who do you think you are to just barge into my home without asking?
translation: Hey! Yabanci! O benim evim! Kim oldugunu saniyorsun da izinsiz evime giriyorsun?

english: Um... My name is [player name].
It was a rhetorical question, outerlander. Now get lost. I do not appreciate intruders in my home.
translation: Bu retorik bir soruydu, yabanci. Simdi defol. Evime izinsiz girenleri sevmem.

english: Hello outerlander. What do you want?
Hello. I'm looking for members of the council of elders to vote for me to become a Fremennik.
translation: Merhaba. Fremennik olmak icin bana oy verecek yaslilar konseyi üyelerini ariyorum.

english: Are you now? Well that is interesting. Usually outerlanders do not concern themselves with our ways like that.
translation: Öyle mi? Bu ilginc. Genelde yabancilar bizim geleneklerimizle bu kadar ilgilenmezler.

english: I am one of the members of the council of elders, and should you be able to prove to me that you have something to offer my clan
translation: Ben yaslilar konseyi üyelerinden biriyim ve klanima bir sey sunabilecegini kanitlayabilirsen

english: I will vote in your favour at the next meeting.
translation: bir sonraki toplantida senin lehine oy verecegim.

english: How can I prove that to you?
Well, I have but a simple test. This building behind me is my house. Inside I have constructed a puzzle.
translation: Peki, basit bir testim var. Arkamdaki bu bina benim evim. Icinde bir bulmaca hazirladim.

english: As a Seer to the clan, I value intelligence very highly, so you may think of it as an intelligence test of sorts.
translation: Klanin kahini olarak zekayi cok önemsiyorum, bu yüzden bunu bir tür zeka testi olarak düsünebilirsiniz.

english: An intelligence test? I thought barbarians were stupid!
translation: Zeka testi mi? Barbarlarin aptal oldugunu saniyordum!

english: That is the opinion that outerlanders usually hold of my people, it is true. But that is because people often confuse knowledge with wisdom.
translation: Disaridakiler genellikle halkim hakkinda böyle düsünür, bu dogru. Ama bunun nedeni, insanlarin bilgi ile bilgeligi karistirmasidir.

english: My puzzle tests not what you know, but what you can work out. All members of our clan have been tested when they took their trials.
translation: Bulmacam, ne bildiginizi degil, ne yapabileceginizi test eder. Klanimizin tüm üyeleri, sinavlarina girerken bu teste tabi tutulurlar.

english: So what exactly does this puzzle consist of, then?
translation: Peki bu bulmaca tam olarak nelerden olusuyor?

english: Well, firstly you must enter my house with no items, weapons or armour. Then it is a simple matter of entering through one door and leaving by the other.
translation: Öncelikle, evime hicbir esya, silah veya zirhla girmemelisiniz. Sonra tek yapmaniz gereken, bir kapidan girip diger kapidan cikmak.

english: I can't take anything in there with me?
That is correct outerlander. Everything you need to complete the puzzle you will find inside the building. Nothing more.
translation: Dogru, yabancim. Bulmacayi tamamlamak icin ihtiyacin olan her seyi binanin icinde bulacaksin. Baska bir sey yok.

english: So what say you outerlander? You think you have the wit to earn yourself my vote?
translation: Ne dersin, yabancim? Oyumu kazanacak kadar zeki oldugunu mu düsünüyorsun?

english: Yes, I accept your challenge. I have one small question, however...
translation: Evet, meydan okumani kabul ediyorum. Ancak kücük bir sorum var...

english: Yes, outerlander?
Well... you say I can bring nothing with me when I enter your house...
translation: Sey... evine girerken yanimda hicbir sey getiremeyecegimi söyledin...

english: Well.....
Where is the nearest bank?
Ah, I see your problem outerlander. The nearest bank to here is the place known to outerlanders as the Seers Village. It is some way South.
translation: Ah, sorunun ne oldugunu anliyorum, yabanci. Buraya en yakin banka, yabancilar tarafindan Seers Köyü olarak bilinen yer. Biraz güneyde.

english: I do however have an alternative, should you wish to take it.
translation: Ancak, istersen baska bir alternatifim var.

english: And what is that?
I can store all the weapons, armour and items that you have upon you directly into your bank account.
translation: Üzerinde bulunan tüm silahlari, zirhlari ve esyalari dogrudan banka hesabina depolayabilirim.

english: This will tax what little magic I possess however, so you will have to manually travel to the bank to withdraw them again.
translation: Ancak bu, sahip oldugum az miktardaki büyüyü tüketecektir, bu yüzden onlari tekrar cekmek icin bankaya manuel olarak gitmen gerekecek.

english: What say you outerlander? you wish me to do this for you?
translation: Ne dersin yabanci? Bunu senin icin yapmami ister misin?

english: Yes
No thanks. Nobody touches my stuff but me!
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler. Benim esyalarima benden baska kimse dokunamaz!

english: As you wish, outerlander.
You may attempt my little task when you have deposited your equipment in the bank.
translation: Esyalarini bankaya yatirdiktan sonra benim kücük görevimi deneyebilirsin.

english: No, thinking about stuff isn't really my 'thing'. I'd rather go kill something. I'll find someone else to vote for me.
translation: Hayir, esyalari düsünmek pek benim “isim” degil. Bir seyleri öldürmeyi tercih ederim. Benim icin oy verecek baska birini bulurum.

english: So I can bring nothing with me when I enter your house?
translation: Yani evine girdigimde yanimda hicbir sey getiremeyecegim?

english: That is correct outerlander, but as I say, I can use my small skill in magic to send your items directly into your bank account from here.
translation: Dogru, yabanci, ama dedigim gibi, kücük büyü yetenegimi kullanarak esyalarini buradan dogrudan banka hesabina gönderebilirim.

english: You will need to manually go to the bank to withdraw them again however. Would you like me to perform this small spell upon you, outerlander?
translation: Ancak, bunlari tekrar cekmek icin bankaya manuel olarak gitmen gerekecek. Bu kücük büyüyü senin icin yapmami ister misin, yabanci?

english: Yes, thank you!
I am sorry outerlander, the spell is not working.
(same as above)
So I just have to enter by one door of your house, and leave by the other?
translation: Yani evine bir kapidan girip, diger kapidan cikmam mi gerekiyor?

english: That is correct outerlander. Be warned it is not as easy as it may at first sound...
translation: Dogru yabanci. Ilk basta kulaga geldigi kadar kolay olmadigini unutma...

english: Incredible! To have solved my puzzle so quickly! I have no choice but to vote in your favour!
translation: Inanilmaz! Bulmacami bu kadar cabuk cözdün! Senin lehine oy vermekten baska secenegim yok!

english: So you will vote for me at the council?
translation: Yani konseyde bana oy verecek misin?

english: Absolutely, outerlander. Your wisdom in passing my test marks you as worthy in my eyes.
translation: Kesinlikle, yabanci. Testimi gecerek gösterdigin bilgelik, benim gözümde seni degerli kiliyor.

english: I don't really fancy going through that annoying puzzle room again now that I have the Seer's vote.
translation: Gören'in oyunu aldigim icin, o sinir bozucu bulmaca odasindan tekrar gecmek istemiyorum.

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a weather forecast from the Fremennik Seer do you?
translation: Fremennik Kahin'in hava tahminini nereden bulabilecegimi biliyor musun?

english: Er.... Yes, because I AM the Fremennik Seer.
translation: Sey... Evet, cünkü ben Fremennik Kahin'im.

english: Can I have a weather forecast then please?
translation: O zaman hava tahminini alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: You require a divination of the weather? This is a simple matter for me, but I will require something in return from you for this small service.
translation: Hava tahminine mi ihtiyacin var? Bu benim icin basit bir is, ama bu kücük hizmetin karsiliginda senden bir sey isteyecegim.

english: I knew you were going to say that...
Do not fret, outerlander; it is a fairly simple matter. I require a bodyguard for protection. Find someone willing to offer me this service.
translation: Endiselenme, yabanci; oldukca basit bir sey. Korunmak icin bir koruma istiyorum. Bana bu hizmeti sunmak isteyen birini bul.

english: That's all?
That is all.
(non-quest dialogue)
I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a brave and powerful warrior to act as a bodyguard?
translation: Cesur ve güclü bir savasci bulabilecegim bir yer biliyor musun?

english: If I did, then I would simply have asked them myself now, wouldn't I, outerlander?
translation: Olsa, simdi kendim sorardim, degil mi, yabanci?

english: Can I have a weather forecast now please?
translation: Hava durumu tahminini alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: I have already told you outerlander; You may have a reading from me when I have a signed contract from a warrior guaranteeing my protection.
translation: Sana zaten söyledim yabanci; bir savascidan korumami garanti eden imzali bir sözlesme aldigimda sana hava durumu tahminini verebilirim.

english: Yeah, I know; I have one right here from Thorvald.
translation: Evet, biliyorum; Thorvald'dan bir tane var burada.

english: You have not only persuaded one of the Fremennik to act as a servant to me, but you have enlisted the aid of mighty Thorvald himself???
translation: Sadece Fremenniklerden birini bana hizmetci olarak ikna etmekle kalmadin, ayni zamanda güclü Thorvald'in yardimini da aldin mi?

english: You may take this forecast with my blessing outerlander. You have offered me the greatest security I can imagine.
translation: Bu kehaneti benim rizamla alabilirsin, yabanci. Bana hayal edebilecegim en büyük güvenligi sagladin.

english: So, about this forecast...
I still don't know why you didn't just let me have one anyway in the first place. Surely it means nothing to you?
translation: Hala neden bana en basindan beri bir tane vermedin bilmiyorum. Senin icin hicbir anlami yok mu?

english: That is not true, outerlander. Although I see glimpses of the future all of the time, using my powers brings the attention of the gods to me.
translation: Bu dogru degil, yabanci. Her zaman gelecegi görebiliyorum, ancak güclerimi kullanmak tanrilarin dikkatini üzerime cekiyor.

english: Some of the gods are spiteful and cruel, and I fear if I use my powers too much then I will meet with unpredictable accidents. This is why I needed protection.
translation: Bazi tanrilar kindar ve acimasizdir, güclerimi cok fazla kullanirsam öngörülemeyen kazalarla karsilasmaktan korkuyorum. Bu yüzden korumaya ihtiyacim vardi.

english: Okay... I... think I understand...
Hello there outerlander. I hear you are attempting to become a member of our tribe?
translation: Merhaba, yabanci. Kabilemizin üyesi olmaya calistigini duydum.

english: Should you prove successful come back and see me, and I will make you some fine armour.
translation: Basarili olursan geri gel ve beni gör, sana güzel bir zirh yapayim.

english: Begone exile, before I call the Fremennik guards!
translation: Git buradan, sürgün, yoksa Fremennik muhafizlarini cagiririm!

english: Leave exile, before I alert the guards.
translation: Git buradan, sürgün, yoksa muhafizlari uyaririm.

english: Leave now, before I get rid of you myself.
translation: Git buradan, yoksa seni kendim kovarim.

english: I'm sorry, you are our [brother/sister] no more. I cannot help you. Leave, before I must call the guards.
translation: Üzgünüm, artik bizim kardesimiz degilsin. Sana yardim edemem. Muhafizlari cagirmadan git buradan.

english: Begone exile, you're no [brother/sister] to me.
translation: Git buradan sürgün, sen benim kardesim degilsin.

english: Though I appreciate your efforts in our trials, I'm afraid I can't speak to you [Fremennik name].
translation: Denemelerimizdeki cabalarini takdir ediyorum, ama korkarim seninle konusamam Dokrak.

english: Please, Seer! I'm on a mission for Brundt.
translation: Lütfen, Kahin! Brundt icin bir görevdeyim.

english: Hmm... If the Chieftain can still trust you, so can I. How may I be of assistance?
translation: Hmm... Sef sana hala güveniyorsa, ben de güvenebilirim. Nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: It's a bit of a sensitive subject...
You can tell me anything, [Fremennik name]. What's the matter?
translation: Bana her seyi anlatabilirsin, Dokrak. Sorun nedir?

english: I can't bring myself to boil my pet rock!
translation: Evcil tasimi kaynatmaya gönlüm el vermiyor!...

english: I know, I'm a horrible person! Please help me, I can't bring myself to do it.
translation: Biliyorum, ben korkunc biriyim! Lütfen yardim et, bunu yapmaya gönlüm el vermiyor.

english: Are you serious? I'm a busy man...
translation: Ciddi misin? Ben mesgul bir adamim...

english: Please Seer, you're my only hope!
translation: Lütfen Kahin, sen benim tek umudumsun!

english: Very well. I'll clear your mind of any memories you have of your...
*cough*
pet rock...
translation: evcil tasinla ilgili tüm anilari silecegim...

english: I won't be able to speak with you after this. The others might start to get suspicious.
translation: Bundan sonra seninle konusamayacagim. Digerleri süphelenmeye baslayabilir.

english: I understand.
Concussio! Forgessan! Geodeus!
Thank you, Seer! I'll head back to the mountains now.
translation: Tesekkürler, Kahin! Simdi daglara geri dönecegim.

english: Now be gone with you, exile!
I know it's just an act... but that hurt.
translation: Bunun sadece bir oyun oldugunu biliyorum... ama canimi yakti.

english: Hello Peer.
Greetings to you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! What brings you to see me again?
translation: Selamlar kardesim Dokrak! Beni tekrar görmeye ne getirdi?

english: I was wondering if you could give me a reading on my future...?
translation: Bana gelecegimi okuyabilir misin diye merak ediyordum...?

english: Ah, you would like a prediction? I do not see that that would be so difficult... wait a moment...
translation: Ah, bir kehanet mi istiyorsun? Bunun cok zor olacagini sanmiyorum... bir dakika bekle...

english: Here is your prediction: The enemy called [fire giant/ghost/goblin/green dragon/hobgoblin/lesser demon/moss giant/ogre/skeleton/zombie] is your lucky totem this day.
Here is your prediction: The stars tell me that you should use a [battleaxe/crossbow/dagger/javelin/long sword/mace/scimitar/short sword/spear/warhammer] in combat today.
Here is your prediction: The place called [Al Kharid/Ardougne/Burthorpe/Canifis/Falador/Karamja/Varrock/The Wilderness/Yanille] will be worth your time to visit.
Here is your prediction: You would be wise to train the skill [Agility/Cooking/Crafting/Fishing/Fletching/Herblore/Mining/Runecrafting/Smithing/Thieving] today.
Here is your prediction: The colour [black/blue/brown/cyan/green/pink/purple/red/white/yellow] will bring you luck this day.
Here is your prediction: You will find luck today with the number [one/two/three/four/five/six/seven/eight/nine/ten].
Can you bank my stuff?
Nothing really, I just stopped by to say hello.
translation: Önemli bir sey yok, sadece merhaba demek icin ugradim.

english: Well, hello to you too!
As you wish, [Fremennik name]. What kind of armour were you thinking of exactly?
translation: Nasil istersen, Dokrak. Tam olarak ne tür bir zirh düsünüyordun?

english: I am afraid it will cost you 5,000 coins to make that for you... Is that okay?
translation: Korkarim bunu yapmak sana 5.000 sikkeye mal olacak... Sorun olur mu?

english: YES
Ah, a helm to make any seer proud! Did you want me to make you another while I am at it?
translation: Ah, herhangi bir kahini gururlandiracak bir migfer! Hazir baslamisken sana bir tane daha yapmami ister misin?

english: My apologies [Fremennik name], but I will need you to bring me 1 piece of dark dagger-mouth hide, 1 skull piece and 5,000 coins before I can make this helm for you.
translation: Özür dilerim Dokrak, ama bu migferi yapabilmem icin bana 1 adet karanlik hancer agizli deri, 1 adet kafatasi parcasi ve 5.000 sikke getirmen gerekiyor.

english: I am afraid it will cost you 10,000 coins to make that for you... Is that okay?
translation: Korkarim bunun yapimi sana 10.000 sikkeye mal olacak... Sorun olur mu?

english: The seers of legend all wore just such armour! Did you want me to craft you another piece?
translation: Efsanevi kahinlerin hepsi böyle zirhlar giyerdi! Sana bir tane daha yapmami ister misin?

english: I am sorry [Fremennik name], but I need 3 pieces of dark dagger-mouth hide, 1 ribcage piece and 10,000 coins to make you this armour...
translation: Üzgünüm Dokrak, ama bu zirhi yapmak icin 3 parca koyu renkli hancer agzi derisi, 1 parca gögüs kafesi ve 10.000 sikkeye ihtiyacim var...

english: I am afraid it will cost you 7,500 coins to make that for you... Is that okay?
translation: Korkarim bunun yapimi sana 7.500 sikkeye mal olacak... Sorun olur mu?

english: Ah, I used to wear just such a piece of armour to battle in my youth... Do you want me to make you another pair of legs while I am doing it anyway?
translation: Ah, gencligimde savaslarda tam da böyle bir zirh giyerdim... Hazir baslamisken sana bir cift bacak daha yapmami ister misin?

english: I am very sorry [Fremennik name], but I will require 2 pieces of dark dagger-mouth hide, 1 fibula piece and 7,500 coins to make this type of leg armour.
translation: Cok üzgünüm Dokrak, ama bu tür bir bacak zirhi yapmak icin 2 parca koyu renkli hancer agzi derisi, 1 parca fibula ve 7.500 sikkeye ihtiyacim olacak.

english: Actually, I don't want anything.
ASyou wish.
Could you help me with combining some items?
translation: Bazi esyalari birlestirmeme yardim eder misin?

english: Combining items? What items?
You show the icon to Peer the Seer.
I have this icon from a ring. I was hoping to make something new with it.
translation: Bu simge bir yüzükten cikti. Onunla yeni bir sey yapmak istiyordum.

english: Surely a smith would be better placed to help you with that?
translation: Bunun icin bir demirci daha uygun olmaz mi?

english: Well I thought maybe you'd be able to help, given these are magic rings. The good magic that is... not the... whatever magic it is you don't like.
translation: Bunlar sihirli yüzükler oldugu icin belki sen yardimci olabilirsin diye düsündüm. Iyi sihir olanlardan... senin sevmedigin sihirlerden degil.

english: Hmm... So the things you're planning to make are totally above board?
translation: Hmm... Yani yapmayi planladigin seyler tamamen yasal mi?

english: When you say above board, where would making new rings by combining the icons with ancient vestiges from a long forgotten empire sit?
translation: Yasal derken, simgeleri uzun zamandir unutulmus bir imparatorlugun kalintilari ile birlestirerek yeni yüzükler yapmak ne kadar yasal olur?

english: What kind of empire?
Er... Definitely not one known for using dark and forbidden magic.
translation: Sey... Kesinlikle karanlik ve yasak büyü kullanmasiyla bilinen bir imparatorluk degil.

english: Ah, well as long as it's not one of those kind of empires, then I see no problems.
translation: Ah, o tür imparatorluklardan biri olmadigi sürece sorun yok.

english: Great!
Now it's quite simple really...
Peer the Seer shows you how to combine ring icons with ancient vestiges.
translation: Peer the Seer sana yüzük simgelerini eski kalintilarla birlestirmeyi gösterir.

english: Thanks!
Not a problem.
I cannot do that for you until you have completed the easy tier of the Fremennik achievement diary.
translation: Fremennik basari günlügünün kolay seviyesini tamamlayana kadar bunu senin icin yapamam.

english: Wallasalki Bone Armour
The Fremennik Trials
No
Ask about the Merchant's trial
Ask about becoming a Fremennik
Ask about depositing your equipment
Can you tell my future?
Can you bank my stuff?
Nothing really.
A fine helm
NO
Sturdy bodyarmour
Powerful leg armour
Nothing
Could you help me with combining some items?
translation: Bazi esyalari birlestirmede bana yardim eder misin?

english: wooooo ooo woo-woo
Sneaky one! Don't touch these unless you have a Slayer task to kill them.
translation: Sinsi sey! Onlari öldürmek icin Slayer görevin yoksa bunlara dokunma.

english: Are you interested in buying or selling a helmet?
translation: Migfer satin almak veya satmak ister misin?

english: No, I'll pass on that.
Well, come back if you change your mind.
I've heard you have a small scorpion in your possession.
translation: Kücük bir akrep sahibi oldugunu duydum.

english: Now how could you know about that, I wonder? Mind you, I don't have it anymore.
translation: Bunu nereden biliyorsun acaba? Ama artik bende yok.

english: I gave it as a present to my brother Ivor when I visited our outpost northwest of Camelot.
translation: Camelot'un kuzeybatisindaki karakolumuzu ziyaret ettigimde kardesim Ivor'a hediye ettim.

english: Well, actually I hid it in his bed so it would nip him. It was a bit of a surprise gift.
translation: Aslinda, onu isirmasi icin yatagina sakladim. Biraz sürpriz bir hediyeydi.

english: I could be, yes.
No, I'll pass on that.
I've heard you have a small scorpion in your possession.
translation: Kücük bir akrep sahibi oldugunuzu duydum.

english: Hi there. How can I help you today?
What do you do here?
I'm just a fur trader. I come across from the city most days.
translation: Ben sadece kürk tüccariyim. Cogu gün sehirden buraya gelirim.

english: Are you a hunter too?
Oh no, that life isn't for me. I'm just a tailor.
translation: Hayir, o hayat bana göre degil. Ben sadece terziyim.

english: What's brought you out here anyway?
I'm just exploring.
Oh, enjoy yourself then!
I'm here to work with the guild.
translation: Ben lonca ile calismak icin buradayim.

english: That's exciting! I expect I'll be turning some furs into clothes for you soon then?
translation: Bu cok heyecan verici! O zaman yakinda senin icin bazi kürkleri giysiye dönüstürecegim, degil mi?

english: That depends on how much I manage to catch.
Do you sell anything?
Why yes I do. Here's what I have available.
Can you do much with animal furs?
translation: Hayvan kürkleriyle cok sey yapabilir misin?

english: Of course! Why don't you take a look?
translation: Tabii ki! Bir bakmaya ne dersin?

english: Can you make some armour for me?
Can you make some armour for me?
A mixed hide top.
Here you go. Enjoy it.
You don't have the required items for me to make a mixed hide top for you. You need 20,000 coins and two sunlight antelope fur.
translation: Sana karisik deri üst yapmak icin gerekli malzemelerin yok. 20.000 sikke ve iki günes isigi antilop kürküne ihtiyacin var.

english: Some mixed hide legs.
You don't have the required items for me to make some mixed hide legs for you. You need 20,000 coins and three fox fur.
translation: Karisik deriden pantolon yapmak icin gerekli malzemeler sende yok. 20.000 altin ve üc tilki kürküne ihtiyacin var.

english: Some mixed hide boots.
You don't have the required items for me to make some mixed hide boots for you. You need 17,500 coins and one sunlight antelope fur
translation: Karisik deriden bot yapmak icin gerekli malzemeler sende yok. 17.500 altin ve bir günes isigi antilop kürküne ihtiyacin var.

english: A mixed hide cape.
You don't have the required items for me to make a mixed hide cape for you. You need 20,000 coins and one jaguar fur.
translation: Karisik deri pelerin yapmak icin gerekli malzemeler sende yok. 20.000 sikke ve bir jaguar kürküne ihtiyacin var.

english: Nothing.
Fair enough.
Never mind.
What do you do here?
I'm just exploring.
I'm here to work with the guild.
Do you sell anything?
Can you do much with animal furs?
translation: Hayvan derileriyle pek bir sey yapabilir misin?

english: A mixed hide top.
Some mixed hide legs.
Some mixed hide boots.
A mixed hide cape.
Nothing.
Never mind.
Of all the high gamble rewards I could have won, I won you...
translation: Kazanabilecegim tüm yüksek bahis ödülleri arasinda, seni kazandim...

english: Keep trying, human. You'll never win that Dragon Chainbody.
translation: Denemeye devam et, insan. O Ejderha Zincir Zirhini asla kazanamayacaksin.

english: Of all the lucky dip rewards I could have won, I won you...
translation: Kazanabilecegim tüm sans ödülleri arasinda, seni kazandim...

english: Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
*slap*
Chomp, chomp.
Blughhhh.
Urghhh!
Raaa!
Hi!
Let me at 'em!
Trolls? Schmolls!
The trolls are coming!
The trolls took my baby son!
Welcome to Burthorpe!
Thanks!
Trolls!
Hello stranger.
Go away!
Run!
Hi!
The Imperial Guard can no longer protect us!
The White Knights will soon have control!
translation: Beyaz Sövalyeler yakinda kontrolü ele gecirecek!

english: I heard about what you did, thank you!
The White Knights are still going to take over.
translation: Beyaz Sövalyeler yine de kontrolü ele gecirecek.

english: I hear the Imperial Guard are preparing an attack!
translation: Imparatorluk Muhafizlarinin bir saldiri hazirligi yaptigini duydum!

english: Thank you so much!
Surely we are safe now!
Have you come to torture me again?
translation: Yine bana iskence etmeye mi geldin?

english: What?
Oh, you may look human, but I know you're not. I've heard stories.
translation: Oh, insan gibi görünebilirsin, ama senin insan olmadigini biliyorum. Hikayeleri duydum.

english: How you Mahjarrat can take on any form, and use magic to inflict pain without any weapons.
translation: Mahjarrat'larin herhangi bir sekle girebildigini ve silah kullanmadan büyüyle aci verebildigini duydum.

english: I, er... what?
I have no idea what you're talking about, but I'm just as human as you are.
translation: Neden bahsettigini bilmiyorum, ama ben de senin kadar insanim.

english: You'll never get what you want from me. I'm a soldier of Avarrocka, and will stand strong!
translation: Benden istedigini asla elde edemeyeceksin. Ben Avarrocka'nin bir askeriyim ve güclü kalacagim!

english: Look, I'm not going to hurt you!
Besides, I am already wounded, and have been so for many years, thanks to this spell you cast on me. And hungry. So very, very hungry.
translation: Ayrica, zaten yaraliyim ve yillardir öyleyim, bana yaptigin büyü yüzünden. Ve acim. Cok, cok acim.

english: I've got some food you can have. It's quite tasty.
translation: Sana verebilecegim biraz yiyecek var. Oldukca lezzetlidir.

english: Here, try this. It should fill you up.
Have some of this food. It's really good, I promise!
translation: Bu yiyeceklerden biraz ye. Gercekten cok lezzetli, söz veriyorum!

english: My daughter was learning to cook this when I left.
translation: Ben ayrildigimda kizim bunu pisirmeyi ögreniyordu.

english: I haven't remembered her in so long... thank you for reminding me of her.
translation: Onu cok uzun zamandir hatirlamiyordum... onu bana hatirlattigin icin tesekkür ederim.

english: A cake? There's nothing to celebrate, is there?
translation: Kek mi? Kutlayacak bir sey yok ki?

english: So many years gone by. My children must have grown up and left home.
translation: Yillar gecti. Cocuklarim büyümüs ve evden ayrilmis olmalilar.

english: I haven't remembered them in so long... thank you for reminding me of them.
translation: Onlari cok uzun zamandir hatirlamiyordum... onlari bana hatirlattigin icin tesekkür ederim.

english: Are you feeling better now?
Yes, thank you.
The food you gave me healed my wounds, and it also reminded me of my family; that helped me to remember who I was.
translation: Bana verdigin yemekler yaralarimi iyilestirdi ve ailemi hatirlamami sagladi; bu da kim oldugumu hatirlamama yardimci oldu.

english: I'm afraid that I'm trapped here, but I still remember something of this floor of the temple.
translation: Korkarim burada mahsur kaldim, ama tapinagin bu katini hala biraz hatirliyorum.

english: If you need any hints about the rooms nearby, I can give you some help.
translation: Yakindaki odalar hakkinda ipucu ihtiyacin olursa, sana yardimci olabilirim.

english: When we came to the temple, that fountain was frosted with ice.
translation: Tapinaga geldigimizde, o cesme buzla kapliydi.

english: Even chipping at it with swords or lighting fires under it didn't do anything.
translation: Kilicla vurmak ya da altina ates yakmak bile ise yaramadi.

english: My guess is that some sort of magic is keeping it that way.
translation: Tahminimce, bir tür büyü onu öyle tutuyor.

english: Tell me about the room with the furnace.
I tried to go in there, but the smoke was so thick I could barely see the furnace.
translation: Oraya girmeye calistim, ama duman o kadar yogundu ki firini zar zor görebiliyordum.

english: It may be that it's blocked, in which case you'll have to clear it out.
translation: Belki de tikanmistir, o zaman temizlemen gerekir.

english: A good breeze should do the trick.
Tell me about the dark room.
I never went in there myself, but I peered through the door.
translation: Ben hic girmedim ama kapidan iceri baktim.

english: There seemed to be fires of some sort all around the room, but they were burning low.
translation: Odanin her yerinde bir tür ates vardi ama cok zayifti.

english: I'd imagine they've gone out by now.
It's okay, I don't need any help.
Tell me about the room with the fountain.
Tell me about the room with the furnace.
Tell me about the dark room.
It's okay, I don't need any help.
Are you hunting animals, then?
I'm exploring the region for the good of the gnome people.
You're not tracking down huge beasts to kill - you look equipped for it.
translation: Öldürmek icin devasa canavarlari takip etmiyorsun, ama bunun icin donanimli görünüyorsun.

english: Well, if I find anything interesting I'll try and bring it back to the King. That might include animals, I suppose. I'd rather not kill it, though - most animals are more useful alive.
translation: Ilginc bir sey bulursam, onu Kral'a götürmeye calisirim. Buna hayvanlar da dahil olabilir sanirim. Ama onlari öldürmek istemem, cogu hayvan canliyken daha faydalidir.

english: How would you get it home, then?
translation: O zaman onu eve nasil götüreceksin?

english: Never underestimate the ingenuity of a gnome, friend.
translation: Bir cücenin yaraticiligini asla kücümseme, dostum.

english: Have you found anything else interesting around here?
translation: Buralarda baska ilginc bir sey buldun mu?

english: I've heard strange rumours about something the locals call the Broodoo. I haven't quite worked out what they are but they seem to be some sort of undead whose ghastly fate depends on the way they were killed.
