translation: Yerel halkin Broodoo dedigi bir sey hakkinda tuhaf söylentiler duydum. Ne olduklarini tam olarak anlayamadim ama öldürüldükleri sekle bagli olarak korkunc bir kadere sahip bir tür ölümsüz gibi görünüyorlar.

english: I think they may be sacrifice victims - but I'm not sure why they are sacrificed. Either way the locals seem to be very scared of them.
translation: Sanirim kurban edilmis kurbanlar olabilirler ama neden kurban edildiklerini bilmiyorum. Her halükarda yerel halk onlardan cok korkuyor gibi görünüyor.

english: That's interesting. Thanks.
What does this mint cake do?
translation: Bu nane keki ne ise yarar?

english: Gnomish mint cake is a great source of energy for the gnome traveller. It will give you that extra bit of zip when you are running out of steam.
translation: Gnomish nane keki, gnome gezginler icin harika bir enerji kaynagidir. Enerjiniz tükendiginde size ekstra bir güc verir.

english: Ooh, that might come in very handy. Do you have any spare?
translation: Ooh, bu cok isime yarayabilir. Fazladan var mi?

english: I need all the mint cake I have, I'm afraid.
translation: Korkarim, elimdeki tüm nane kekine ihtiyacim var.

english: What does this seed pod do?
translation: Bu tohum kabugu ne ise yarar?

english: Ah, the seed pod of the Grand Tree is a fascinating spirit artefact. It is a very useful thing, though one must treat it with respect, since the Grand Tree has a connection with all of its parts, however distant they
translation: Ah, Büyük Agac'in tohum kabugu büyüleyici bir ruh eseri. Cok kullanisli bir seydir, ancak Büyük Agac tüm parcalariyla baglantili oldugu icin, ne kadar uzak olursa olsun, ona saygi ile davranmak gerekir.

english: may be. How do you think the Spirit Trees work?
translation: Ruh Agaclari nasil calisir sence? Eger tohumlarini uzak bir yere firlatirsan, agacin hayatta kalmasina yardim etmis olursun, böylece büyük agac, tohum patlamasini (gökyüzünü isaret eden) ve biraz sihir kullanarak bir gnome planör pilotunun seni bulmasina yardim eder.

english: If you launch its seeds in a far flung location, you will be helping the tree survive, so the grand tree will help a gnome glider pilot find you, using the seed burst itself (which marks the sky) and a little magic, and bring you
translation: Tohumlarini uzak bir yere firlatirsan, agacin hayatta kalmasina yardimci olursun, böylece Büyük Agac, tohum patlamasini (gökyüzünü isaretler) ve biraz sihir kullanarak bir cüce planör pilotunun seni bulmasina yardimci olur ve

english: back home as an act of gratitude. Budding farmers will also find their link with plants to be just a little bit better than before.
translation: minnettarlik göstergesi olarak seni eve geri getirir. Yeni baslayan ciftciler de bitkilerle olan baglarinin eskisinden biraz daha iyi oldugunu göreceklerdir.

english: However, it takes time for a pilot to find you, and if you are in a real hurry, and I mean a real emergency, you can just squash the seed pod. The Grand Tree doesn't like this, but will pull you back
translation: Ancak, pilotun sizi bulmasi zaman alir ve gercekten aceleniz varsa, yani gercek bir acil durum varsa, tohum kabugunu ezebilirsiniz. Büyük Agac bundan hoslanmaz, ancak sizi hemen

english: home straight away. Don't do this if you need to do anything with plants straight away, though - your fingers will be considerably less green for a while after using the seed pod this way, and the journey is not
translation: eve geri götürür. Ancak, bitkilerle hemen bir sey yapmaniz gerekiyorsa bunu yapmayin - tohum kabugunu bu sekilde kullandiktan sonra parmaklariniz bir süre icin oldukca yesil olmayacak ve yolculuk da

english: very pleasant...
Wow, that's very interesting. Thanks.
translation: Vay canina, bu cok ilginc. Tesekkürler.

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: Hazir yemekler maalesef ise yaramaz. Aluft Aloft'un müsterileri icin sadece el yapimi Cüce Mutfagi yeterince iyidir.

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food item] to Penwie.
At last a taste of home!
Now that I have some proper food, I won't need this any more.
translation: Artik dogru düzgün yemek yedigime göre, buna artik ihtiyacim yok.

english: Here, take these Grand Seed pods. Very useful in emergencies!
translation: Al, bu Büyük Tohum Kabuklarini al. Acil durumlarda cok kullanislidir!

english: I traded with some of the locals for this - maybe you'll find it useful.
translation: Bunu bazi yerlilerle takas ettim - belki senin icin de yararli olur.

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: Bunu bana getirmek icin uzun bir yol kat etmis olmalisin. Iste sana bahsis olarak kücük bir sey.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr'dan ücretsiz teslimat jetonunu almayi unutma.

english: Are you hunting animals then?
What does this mint cake do?
translation: Bu nane keki ne ise yarar?

english: What does this seed pod do?
translation: Bu tohum kabugu ne ise yarar?

english: It seems you're missing out on some valuable experience. Would you like it?
translation: Görünüse göre bazi degerli deneyimleri kaciriyorsun. Ister misin?

english: You are owed the following: [list of experience the player can claim]
Yes please.
There you go.
No thanks.
Fair enough.
Hello. I've found some stuff that I think is yours. You can pay me with cash you're carrying, or I can take payments from your bank. Would you like to buy anything from me?
translation: Merhaba. Sanirim sana ait bazi esyalar buldum. Yaninda bulunan nakit parayla ödeme yapabilirsin ya da banka hesabindan ödeme alabilirim. Benden bir sey satin almak ister misin?

english: Why do you charge for returning lost items?
translation: Kayip esyalari iade etmek icin neden ücret aliyorsunuz?

english: You could get your stuff back elsewhere, sure. Now, maybe it'd be free, or maybe you'd have to pay someone, but you'd definitely have to go on a journey to get it back.
translation: Esyalarinizi baska yerlerden de geri alabilirsiniz, elbette. Belki ücretsiz olabilir, belki birine ödeme yapmaniz gerekebilir, ama geri almak icin kesinlikle bir yolculuga cikmaniz gerekir.

english: So I'm earning my fee by saving you a trip. Do you want to have a look?
translation: Bu yüzden, size bir yolculuktan kurtararak ücretimi kazaniyorum. Bakmak ister misiniz?

english: Show me what you've found.
About items that break when people kill me...
translation: Insanlar beni öldürdügünde kirilan esyalar hakkinda...

english: Oh yes, some items do break specially when you're killed by your rivals. And if you die in the deep Wilderness, they vanish altogether.
translation: Evet, bazi esyalar özellikle rakipleriniz tarafindan öldürüldügünüzde kirilir. Ve derin Wilderness'da ölürseniz, tamamen yok olurlar.

english: Can you fix them?
For a fee, yes. Just show me the broken item.
translation: Ücret karsiliginda, evet. Bana kirilan esyayi gösterin.

english: Can you stop them vanishing in deep Wilderness?
translation: Derin Wilderness'da yok olmalarini engelleyebilir misiniz?

english: I can lock them to you so they won't vanish on death in deep Wilderness, yes. I'll want some money for my services, though, and you'll need to bring me a Trouver Parchment.
translation: Onlari sana kilitleyebilirim, böylece derin Wilderness'da öldügünde yok olmazlar, evet. Ancak hizmetlerim icin biraz para isteyecegim ve bana bir Trouver Parsömeni getirmen gerekecek.

english: You'll find her in Ferox Enclave, where people play a game called Last Man Standing. Bring the parchment here, then show me the item you want to lock.
translation: Onu, insanlarin Last Man Standing adli bir oyun oynadiklari Ferox Enclave'de bulabilirsin. Parsömeni buraya getir, sonra kilitlemek istedigin esyayi bana göster.

english: I've got the parchment.
Not bad for a human! Okay, show me the item you want to protect, and I'll see what I can do.
translation: Bir insan icin fena degil! Tamam, korumak istedigin esyayi göster, ne yapabilecegime bakayim.

english: I can lock that item so that it won't vanish if you die in deep Wilderness, but I'll need a Trouver parchment.
translation: O esyayi kilitleyebilirim, böylece derin Wilderness'da öldügünde kaybolmaz, ama bir Trouver parsömeni lazim.

english: You'll find her in Ferox Enclave, where people play a game called Last Man Standing. Bring the parchment here, then show me the item again.
translation: Onu, insanlarin Last Man Standing adli bir oyun oynadiklari Ferox Enclave'de bulabilirsin. Parsömeni buraya getir, sonra esyayi tekrar göster.

english: I can lock that item so that it won't vanish if you die in deep Wilderness. It'll cost you 500,000 coins and a Trouver parchment.
translation: O esyayi kilitleyebilirim, böylece derin Wilderness'ta ölürsen kaybolmaz. Bunun icin 500.000 sikke ve bir Trouver parsömeni ödemen gerekecek.

english: I've locked that item to you so that it won't vanish if you're killed in deep Wilderness. I can unlock it again, returning your parchment and 475,000 coins.
translation: O esyayi sana kilitledim, böylece derin Wilderness'ta öldürülürsen kaybolmaz. Kilidi tekrar acabilirim, parsömeni ve 475.000 sikkeyi geri veririm.

english: If you want me to lock an item to you so that it won't vanish if you're killed in deep Wilderness, show me the item.
translation: Derin Wilderness'da öldürülürsen kaybolmamasi icin bir ögeyi sana kilitlememi istiyorsan, bana o ögeyi göster.

english: I have something for you. You lost your Echo boots. Would you like it back?
translation: Sana bir seyim var. Echo botlarini kaybettin. Geri ister misin?

english: Ah! I have something for you. You lost your banner. Would you like it back?
translation: Ah! Sana bir seyim var. Sancagini kaybettin. Geri ister misin?

english: You seem lost, but luckily I know where to send you. A breach is occurring[location 1] (single). Another breach is occuring[location 2] (multi).
You have[time left]remaining. Otherwise...
Yes please.
No thanks.
Why do you charge for returning lost items?
translation: Kayip esyalari geri vermek icin neden ücret aliyorsun?

english: Show me what you've found.
About items that break when people kill me...
translation: Insanlar beni öldürdügünde kirilan esyalar hakkinda...

english: Can you fix them?
Can you stop them vanishing in deep Wilderness?
Lock item ([used item])
Cancel
Yes
No
Ooh, lovely view, dear.
Yes dear.
I hope the food's better here than it was last time.
translation: Umarim buradaki yemekler gecen seferkinden daha iyidir.

english: I'm sure it will be, dear.
Sorry to disturb you, but what are you two doing here?
translation: Rahatsiz ettigim icin özür dilerim, ama siz ikiniz burada ne yapiyorsunuz?

english: Perrdur and I are having a nice romantic dinner, aren't we dear?
translation: Perrdur ve ben romantik bir aksam yemegi yiyoruz, degil mi canim?

english: We are celebrating the anniversary of our marriage, aren't we dear?
translation: Evlilik yildönümümüzü kutluyoruz, degil mi canim?

english: And we are having a very enjoyable time, aren't we dear?
translation: Ve cok keyifli vakit geciriyoruz, degil mi canim?

english: Clearly. I'll let you two lovebirds carry on, then.
translation: Elbette. O zaman siz iki ask kusu devam edin.

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: Hazir yemekler maalesef ise yaramaz. Aluft Aloft'un müsterileri icin sadece el yapimi Cüce Mutfagi yeterince iyidir.

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Perrdur
Thank you dear, This looks as if it might be edible for a change!
translation: Tesekkürler canim, bu sefer yenilebilir gibi görünüyor!

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.'dan ücretsiz teslimat jetonunuzu almayi unutmayin.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: Teslimatiniz cok gec! Aluft jnr.'a geri dönüp baska bir siparis alin. Artik ihtiyaciniz olmadigi icin teslimat kutunuzu atiyorsunuz.

english: Hey, adventurer. Do you want to buy any axes?
translation: Hey, maceraci. Balta almak ister misin?

english: Who are you?
I'm Perry, and I sell axes here. Or sometimes I buy them, if someone's offering a good deal. Anyway, do you want to trade?
translation: Ben Perry, burada balta satiyorum. Bazen de iyi bir teklif gelirse aliyorum. Neyse, takas yapmak ister misin?

english: Okay, let's trade.
No, I'm fine.
Who are you?
Okay, let's trade.
No, I'm fine.
A cutscene shows the player being caught
translation: Bir kesit sahnede oyuncunun yakalandigi gösterilir

english: And we'll move this little penguin here...and KABLOOM! Heee hee.
translation: Ve bu kücük pengueni buraya tasiyacagiz... ve KABLOOM! Heee hee.

english: It appears we have a visitor!
Haa haa! I am glad we installed that ant-magic security. What have we here?
translation: Haa haa! Karinca büyüsü güvenligini kurdugumuz icin mutluyum. Burada ne var?

english: What an ingenious little device. This will solve all our problems. Scientists! Come examine this; we have much work to do.
translation: Ne kadar zekice bir cihaz. Bu tüm sorunlarimizi cözecek. Bilim adamlari! Gelin bunu inceleyin; yapacak cok isimiz var.

english: What about me?
Hmm, take that human to the Ice Lords. They'll enjoy the exercise.
translation: Hmm, bu insani Buz Lordlarina götürün. Egzersiz yapmaktan hoslanacaklardir.

english: You are caught.
End of cutscene
Got any sigils for me?
translation: Benim icin herhangi bir mühür var mi?

english: The Core shakes its head.
Damnit Core-al!
Let's bounce!
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
I'm hungry!
How hungry?
I'm empty to the core!
Would an apple do?
What is apple?
Something where you eat the outside and throw the core away!
translation: Disini yiyip cekirdegini attigin bir sey!

english: Blargle!
Flarg!
Rawrrr!
Who's a good rock then? Yes you are... You're such a good rock... ooga booga googa.
translation: Kim iyi bir kaya? Evet, sensin... Sen cok iyi bir kayasin... ooga booga googa.

english: Your rock seems a little happier.
Your pet rock ignores you. You are an exile of the Fremennik Province.
translation: Evcil tasin seni görmezden geliyor. Fremennik Eyaleti'nden sürgün edildin.

english: Not you too!
Your pet rock continues to ignore you.
translation: Evcil tasin seni görmezden gelmeye devam ediyor.

english: Aw...
Hey little snake!
Soon, Zulrah shall establish dominion over this plane.
translation: Yakinda Zulrah bu düzlem üzerinde hakimiyet kuracak.

english: Wanna play fetch?
Submit to the almighty Zulrah.
Walkies? Or slidies...?
Zulrah's wilderness as a God will soon be demonstrated.
translation: Zulrah'in bir tanri olarak Wildernesssi yakinda ortaya cikacak.

english: I give up...
*slither*
Hisssss!
Specs!
Sssssssss!
What can I do around here?
There's a list pinned up on the camp notice board, near the toilet. Have a look there for useful things you could do. I've got some rewards if you do them all!
translation: Tuvaletin yanindaki kamp ilan panosunda bir liste asili. Orada yapabilecegin yararli seyler var mi bir bak. Hepsini yaparsan sana ödül verecegim!

english: I see. Thank you.
I see you've finished building the camp for us.
All in a day's work!
Thank you so much for your help! Here, take these fossils. I found them while panning! They're everywhere on this island... A quick clean up by the benches you built should help identify them.
translation: Yardimin icin cok tesekkürler! Al, bu fosilleri al. Altin ararken buldum! Bu adada her yerde var... Kurdugun banklarin yanini temizlersen onlari tanimlamak daha kolay olur.

english: Thanks!
Can I talk to you for a moment about the fossils I find on this island?
translation: Bu adada buldugum fosiller hakkinda seninle biraz konusabilir miyim?

english: Sure, would you like to talk about? Normal or rare fossils?
translation: Tabii, ne hakkinda konusmak istersin? Normal fosiller mi, nadir fosiller mi?

english: Let's talk about rare fossils, if that's okay.
translation: Sorun yoksa nadir fosiller hakkinda konusalim.

english: Oh definitely! Did you find a new type of fossil?!
translation: Tabii ki! Yeni bir fosil türü mü buldun?

english: Not quite... I'd like you to stop rare fossils showing up on the island.
translation: Tam olarak degil... Adada nadir fosillerin ortaya cikmasini engellemeni istiyorum.

english: Oh..., I can do that for you, if you really want me to.
translation: Oh..., Eger gercekten istiyorsan, bunu senin icin yapabilirim.

english: Yes I'm sure.
So be it, I'll spread the word, rare fossils won't drop for you anymore. Come back to me if you change your mind.
translation: Öyle olsun, haber yayacagim, artik nadir fosiller senin icin düsmeyecek. Fikrini degistirirsen bana geri gel.

english: Actually, I've changed my mind, I'll keep collecting them.
translation: Aslinda, fikrimi degistirdim, onlari toplamaya devam edecegim.

english: Oh wonderful! Rare fossils are so hard to find, I'd hate for you to miss out on one.
translation: Oh, harika! Nadir fosiller bulmak cok zordur, bir tanesini bile kacirmani istemem.

english: So you've changed your mind then? I knew you would, who can resists the hidden knowledge found in rare fossils?
translation: Yani fikrini degistirdin? Degistirecegini biliyordum, nadir fosillerde sakli olan bilgiye kim karsi koyabilir ki?

english: Yes I know, can you just do it for me.
translation: Evet, biliyorum, bunu benim icin yapabilir misin?

english: If that's what you really want.
Of course you are! I'll get the word out and you'll start to see rare fossils drop again.
translation: Tabii ki istiyorsun! Haber yayacagim ve nadir fosiller tekrar düsmeye baslayacak.

english: Eh, nevermind.
Fine, just let me know if you actually change your mind.
translation: Peki, fikrini gercekten degistirirsen bana haber ver.

english: Let's talk about normal fossils, if that's okay.
translation: Normal fosiller hakkinda konusalim, olur mu?

english: Of course, I'm always up for an exciting discussion about fossils.
translation: Tabii, fosiller hakkinda heyecan verici bir tartismaya her zaman varim.

english: Is it possible that you could stop normal fossils being given to me on the island.
translation: Adada bana normal fosillerin verilmesini engelleyebilir misin?...

english: ... Why would you want that?
I've found every fossil I want and well, I'm just not interested in them anymore.
translation: Istedigim tüm fosilleri buldum ve artik onlarla ilgilenmiyorum.

english: Oh... I guess can see what I can do, Only if you're sure of course.
translation: Oh... Ne yapabilecegime bir bakayim, tabii emin oldugun sürece.

english: Fine... I'll spread the word, you won't see fossils dropped on the island anymore... Come back to me if you change your mind.
translation: Tamam... Haber yayacagim, artik adada fosil düsmeyecek... Fikrini degistirirsen bana gel.

english: Really?! That's fantastic! Fossils are so much fun, you'd be missing out!
translation: Gercekten mi?! Bu harika! Fosiller cok eglencelidir, cok sey kaciracaksin!

english: Oh yes... I remember, you asked me to stop fossils dropping for you on the island.
translation: Oh evet... Hatirladim, adada sana fosil düsmemesini istemistin.

english: Yes, well, I need you to let them drop again.
Really? Are you sure?
Of course you are! I'll get the word out and you'll start to see fossils drop again.
translation: Tabii ki öylesin! Haber yayacagim ve fosiller tekrar düsmeye baslayacak.

english: Okay... let me know if you actually change your mind.
translation: Tamam... Fikrini degistirirsen bana haber ver.

english: That has been done, rare fossils won't drop for you anymore. Come back to me if you change your mind.
translation: Tamamdir, artik nadir fosiller senin icin düsmeyecek. Fikrini degistirirsen bana gel.

english: Excellent, you'll start to see rare fossils showing up on the island again.
translation: Harika, adada tekrar nadir fosiller görmeye baslayacaksin.

english: Fine, regular fossils won't drop for you anymore. Come back to me if you change your mind
translation: Tamam, normal fosiller artik sana düsmeyecek. Fikrini degistirirsen bana gel.

english: Great! You'll start to see fossils showing up on the island again.
translation: Harika! Adada tekrar fosiller görmeye baslayacaksin.

english: Talk about the island camp.
Talk about fossils.
Let's talk about rare ones.
Yes I'm sure.
Actually, I've changed my mind.
Nevermind
Let's talk about normal ones.
Rare.
Normal.
Oh thank goodness you released me...how long have I been stuck in that gloomy wall?
translation: Oh, sükürler olsun ki beni serbest biraktin... O kasvetli duvarda ne kadar süre sikisip kaldim?

english: Oh, not so long...I don't think...
I mean...that is... I'm not so sure...at all...in fact.
translation: Yani... Bu... Hic emin degilim... Aslinda.

english: Well, at least I'm ok...thanks to you! Last time I get involved with that Cromperty lunatic...in fact I have some words to say to that man!
translation: En azindan ben iyiyim... senin sayende! Bir daha o Cromperty delisiyle isim olmaz... Aslinda o adama söyleyeceklerim var!

english: Well actually, I think that some of the people at the Seers Village are worried about you. That's how I came to find you here, Phantuwti sent me.
translation: Aslinda, Seers Köyü'ndeki bazi insanlar senin icin endiseleniyorlar. Bu yüzden seni burada bulmaya geldim, Phantuwti beni gönderdi.

english: Oh, right, yes, well I guess I'd better go back there and let them all know that I'm safe then..Ok, thanks...I'll be off now and once again thanks for your help.
translation: Oh, tamam, evet, sanirim oraya geri dönüp onlara güvende oldugumu haber versem iyi olacak... Tamam, tesekkürler... Simdi gidiyorum, yardimin icin tekrar tesekkürler.

english: No problem...I'll probably see you back at the Seers Village.
translation: Sorun degil... Muhtemelen Seers Köyü'nde görüsürüz.

english: Hi there Pete.
Argh! Who be there?
Oh, it's just the adventurer, phew! Things can be scary around here, I've seen some weeeeeiiiird stuff in that cavern.
translation: Oh, sadece maceraciymis, phew! Buralar biraz ürkütücü olabilir, o magarada cok tuhaf seyler gördüm.

english: What is in the cavern?
Oh no, now I'm thinking about it again!*screams*
translation: Oh hayir, simdi yine aklima geldi! *ciglik atar*

english: Okay okay, calm down! Why are you guarding it? What is the purpose of this cavern?
translation: Tamam tamam, sakin ol! Neden onu koruyorsun? Bu magaranin amaci nedir?

english: It's a mine. It's special but dangerous, things move around and the mine could collapse at any moment!.
translation: Bu bir maden. Özel ama tehlikeli, her sey hareket ediyor ve maden her an cökebilir!

english: I'd say you'll need at least level 50 Mining to be capable.
translation: Bence en az 50 seviye Madencilik becerisine sahip olmalisin.

english: I'm not quite up to scratch then...
translation: O zaman ben pek uygun degilim...

english: Well sounds like I am capable then!
The main idea is to chip down the big boulders, in order to find the fragments inside. Deliver them to me and I'll show you some minin' tips to help you get better at it.
translation: Ana fikir, icindeki parcalari bulmak icin büyük kayalari parcalamak. Onlari bana getir, sana bu iste daha iyi olmani saglayacak bazi madencilik ipuclari göstereyim.

english: How do I traverse the mine? Isn't it full of lava?
translation: Madeni nasil gececegim? Lavla dolu degil mi?

english: I have a handy supply of heat-proof water containers. I'll give them out to anyone going in with bit of water inside. They only hold so much though.
translation: Isiya dayanikli su kaplarim var. Icine biraz su koyup iceri giren herkese verecegim. Ama cok fazla su almiyorlar.

english: I reckon you could harden the lava with it! Just throw a bit of water on it. Make yourself a path, but be careful, they won't last forever.
translation: Bence lavlari bununla sertlestirebilirsin! Üzerine biraz su dök yeter. Kendine bir yol ac, ama dikkatli ol, sonsuza kadar dayanmazlar.

english: Anything else?
Uh oh, there is one more thing, but it hurts. My backside has never felt the same since, one of the reasons I don't dare go in there anymore. There are some gas holes around, just feel 'em.
translation: Uh oh, bir sey daha var, ama aci veriyor. O zamandan beri sirtim eskisi gibi degil, bu yüzden artik oraya girmeye cesaret edemiyorum. Etrafta bazi gaz delikleri var, dokunarak hissedebilirsin.

english: How do I keep the mine stable?
Don't let it collapse!! It's petrifying, it will stick with you forever. The rumbles create a flashback in my mind, arghhh.
translation: Cökmesine izin verme! Cok korkutucu, sonsuza kadar aklindan cikmayacak. Gürültüler zihnimde bir flashback yaratiyor, ahhh.

english: There are some vents and chambers in there. Do better than I did with them, you want around a 50% gas level in each chamber.
translation: Iceride bazi havalandirma delikleri ve odaciklar var. Benim yaptigimdan daha iyisini yap, her odacikta yaklasik %50 gaz seviyesi olmasini istiyorsun.

english: There are 3 in total, we spent awhile coming up with names, such as 'Vent west of the pillar near the entrance on the left hand side', but decided A, B and C would be easier.
translation: Toplamda 3 tane var, isim bulmak icin biraz zaman harcadik, örnegin “sol taraftaki giristeki sütunun batisindaki havalandirma” gibi, ama A, B ve C'nin daha kolay olacagina karar verdik.

english: Presumably, a western chamber, central chamber and eastern chamber?
translation: Muhtemelen bati odasi, orta oda ve dogu odasi mi?

english: Yep! That's right. Block the chamber to let gas build up, unblock 'em to let gas out. Any creatures in there will cause instability too.
translation: Evet! Dogru. Odayi kapatarak gazin birikmesini saglayin, acarak gazin cikmasini saglayin. Icerideki herhangi bir canli da istikrarsizliga neden olur.

english: Oh, also, if you have more than one rock to mine, keep them going at roughly the same pace too. Everything gets a bit wobbly if you proceed too quickly down one channel.
translation: Ayrica, kazacak birden fazla kaya varsa, hepsini yaklasik olarak ayni hizda kazmaya devam edin. Bir kanalda cok hizli ilerlerseniz, her sey biraz sallanmaya baslar.

english: Explain the dangers for me.
It is bad, very bad in there. If you're not prepared, you will be done for. Wouldn't catch me in there.
translation: Orasi cok kötü, cok kötü. Hazirlikli degilseniz, isiniz biter. Beni orada yakalayamazsiniz.

english: Okay, so how do I prepare?
Look out for the Lava beasts, they'll throw projectiles at anyone they see. You'll have stalacmitesfalling on you, fire jumping out the lava towards you. Seriously, you're insane.
translation: Lav canavarlarina dikkat et, gördükleri herkese mermi atarlar. Üzerine sarkitlar düser, lavdan sana dogru ates sicrar. Cidden, sen delisin.

english: Thanks, I'll keep that in mind.
Can I go inside?
There are some crazy things down there, I don't think you're capable.
translation: Orada cilgin seyler var, senin yapabilecegini sanmiyorum.

english: You need at least 50 Mining to enter the Volcanic Mine.
translation: Volkanik Madene girmek icin en az 50 Madencilik seviyesine sahip olmalisin.

english: Well luckily for you, or rather, unlucky for you, I'll let you go inside as you've definitely got the mining skills.
translation: Sanslisin, ya da daha dogrusu sanssizsin, madencilik becerilerin oldugu kesin oldugu icin iceri girmana izin verecegim.

english: I'll have to charge you though - upkeep of this place ain't cheap and cheerful. I'll need 30 Numulites for one visit or 3,000 for unlimited trips.
translation: Ama senden ücret almam gerekecek, burayi isletmek ucuz ve keyifli degil. Bir ziyaret icin 30 Numulite, sinirsiz ziyaret icin 3.000 Numulite istiyorum.

english: I don't have 30 Numulites with me unfortunately.
Thanks [player name]. That will grant you access to the mine. You're a crazy one.
translation: Tesekkürler Maceraci. Bu sana madene giris hakki verecektir. Sen delisin.

english: You can now enter the Volcanic Mine. Should you leave, Pete would expect payment again.
translation: Artik Volkanik Madene girebilirsin. Ayrilirsan, Pete tekrar ödeme isteyecektir.

english: Thanks [player name]. That will grant you permanent access to the mine. You're a crazy one.
translation: Tesekkürler Maceraci. Bu sana madene kalici erisim hakki verecektir. Sen delisin.

english: You can now enter the Volcanic Mine. Pete will not ask you for payment again.
translation: Artik Volkanik Madene girebilirsin. Pete senden tekrar ödeme istemeyecektir.

english: You've already paid the entrance fee too, so you can head right on in.
translation: Giris ücretini de zaten ödedigin icin hemen iceri girebilirsin.

english: I've got some of your stuff that you left here earlier. You'd better deal with it before trying to go into the cavern again.
translation: Daha önce burada biraktigin esyalarin var. Magaraya tekrar girmeden önce onlarla ilgilenmen iyi olur.

english: Have you anything to trade?
translation: Takas edecek bir seyin var mi?

english: Have you picked up anything I left in the mine?
Sorry, I've got nothing for you. I'm not sure what you'd have been doing in there anyway, since I wouldn't expect to let you in.
translation: Üzgünüm, sana verecek bir seyim yok. Zaten seni iceri almayacagimi bildigim icin, orada ne yapardin bilmiyorum.

english: Sorry, I've got nothing for you. If I had some of your stuff earlier, but you died before collecting it, it'd be lost.
translation: Üzgünüm, sana verecek bir seyim yok. Daha önce esyalarini almis olsaydim, ama sen onlari almadan önce ölseydin, kaybolurlardi.

english: I'll leave you be.
There are some crazy things down there, I don't think you're capable so I'll let you keep your Numulites.
translation: Orada bazi cilgin seyler var, senin yapabilecegini sanmiyorum, bu yüzden Numulite'lerini alabilirsin.

english: It doesn't look like you have 30 Numulites with you unfortunately.
translation: Maalesef, yaninizda 30 Numulite yok gibi görünüyor.

english: You've already paid up! You can head right on in. Better you than me...
translation: Ödemeyi zaten yaptiniz! Hemen iceri girebilirsiniz. Benim yerime siz girseniz daha iyi olur...

english: Sorry, I'll need paying before I can return your stuff.
translation: Üzgünüm, esyalarinizi iade etmeden önce ödeme yapmaniz gerekiyor.

english: Sorry [player name], you won't last a minute in there. You got to prove yourself as a capable archeologist, and be good at the minin'.
translation: Üzgünüm Maceraci, orada bir dakika bile dayanamazsiniz. Kendinizi yetenekli bir arkeolog olarak kanitlamali ve madencilikte iyi olmalisiniz.

english: Sorry [player name] I can't let people head in mid way through a mine out session. It's not safe and will cause mine collapse!
translation: Üzgünüm Maceraci, maden cikarma seansi devam ederken kimsenin iceri girmesine izin veremem. Bu güvenli degil ve madeni cökertir!

english: Pete quickly hands you a heat-proof vessel filled with some water.
translation: Pete sana hizlica su dolu isiya dayanikli bir kap uzatir.

english: The mine is currently dormant, and will awaken within the next 30 seconds.
translation: Maden su anda uykuda ve 30 saniye icinde uyanacak.

english: Sorry [player name], I cannot allow someone to go in there without paying first. Come see me.
translation: Üzgünüm Maceraci, önce ödeme yapmadan kimsenin iceri girmesine izin veremem. Bana gel.

english: You should probably pick up the stuff you left in there earlier before you return. Come and see me.
translation: Geri dönmeden önce, daha önce orada biraktigin esyalari almalisin. Gel beni gör.

english: Well why am I going to reward you for that?! Might wanna contribute next time. I am not standin' out here for nothin'.
translation: Peki, bunun icin sana neden ödül vereyim ki? Bir dahaki sefere katkida bulunmak isteyebilirsin. Burada bosuna durmuyorum.

english: I'll give you a bit of minin' trainin' and I'll remember the contribution you've made.
translation: Sana biraz madencilik egitimi verecegim ve yaptigin katkiyi unutmayacagim.

english: I'll quickly take those fragments off your hands [player name], thank you! I'll give you a bit of minin' trainin' and I'll remember the contribution you've made.
translation: Bu parcalari hemen alayim Maceraci, tesekkürler! Sana biraz madencilik egitimi verecegim ve yaptigin katkiyi unutmayacagim.

english: [player name] has started up a mine! Join [him/her] down there now!
translation: Maceraci bir maden acti! Hemen oraya git ve ona katil!

english: Hi Pete, I found this in one of my ore packs...
translation: Merhaba Pete, bunu cevher paketlerimden birinde buldum...

english: Woah, what is that you've got there?!
translation: Vay canina, elinde ne var öyle?!

english: It's... a pickaxe, a broken one.
translation: Bu... bir kazma, kirik bir kazma.

english: That's not just any broken pickaxe, it's a dragon one! They're really rare!
translation: Bu siradan bir kirik kazma degil, bir ejderha kazmasi! Bunlar cok nadirdir!

english: I have no idea how that ended up in your ore pack, but you can keep it, it's broken anyway.
translation: Bunun cevher paketine nasil girdigini bilmiyorum, ama kirik oldugu icin sende kalabilir.

english: Maybe you can find someone to help you repair it! I've heard tales that some dwarves used to fix pickaxes.
translation: Belki onu tamir etmene yardim edecek birini bulabilirsin! Bazi cücelerin kazmalari tamir ettigini duymustum.

english: One of them was called Nurmof. I think he used to reside in the Falador mines. If you're lucky, he could still be there.
translation: Onlardan birinin adi Nurmof'tu. Sanirim Falador madenlerinde yasiyordu. Sansliysan, hâlâ orada olabilir.

english: Nice one, [player name]! I'll give you twice as much water when you're starting a run.
translation: Aferin, Maceraci! Kosmaya basladiginda sana iki kat fazla su verecegim.

english: Sorry [player name], this a Deadman world. People are fighting all over the shop. No one gets in the mine here!
translation: Üzgünüm Maceraci, burasi Deadman dünyasi. Herkes birbiriyle kavga ediyor. Kimse bu madene giremez!

english: What is in the cavern?
How do I traverse the mine?
How do I keep the mine stable?
Explain the dangers for me.
Can I go inside?
I'll leave you be.
Pay 30 Numulites for one visit.
Pay 3,000 Numulites for permanent access.
Keep your Numulites.
Have you anything to trade?
translation: Takas edecek bir seyin var mi?

english: Have you picked up anything I left in the mine?
translation: Madende biraktigim bir seyi aldin mi?

english: Pay the fee.
Yes, pay 150 x Numulite.
Yes, pay 150 x Numulite and don't ask me again..
translation: Evet, 150 Numulite öde ve bir daha sorma.

english: No, don't pay.
Wow, didn't expect to find a scientist out here.
translation: Vay canina, burada bir bilim adami bulmayi beklemiyordum.

english: I'm out here on a mission, do you think I chose to hang around these lowlifes?
translation: Burada bir görevim var, sence bu serserilerle takilmayi ben mi sectim?

english: I'm not one to judge.
What is this 'mission' you mentioned?
I'm out here to conduct research, I've been told a giant spider lurks in the heart of the Wilderness.
translation: Arastirma yapmak icin buradayim, Wildernessnin kalbinde dev bir örümcek yasadigini duydum.

english: Her venom is priceless and it would aid me greatly in my research.
translation: Zehri paha bicilemez ve arastirmamda bana cok yardimci olacak.

english: Research? What could you possibly want with a giant spider's venom?
translation: Arastirma mi? Dev bir örümcegin zehrini ne yapacaksin ki?

english: Venenatis is the last of her kind. Lots of giant spiders used to dwell deep in the mountains until the savage dwarves killed them all.
translation: Venenatis, türünün son örnegi. Vahsi cüceler hepsini öldürene kadar, daglarin derinliklerinde bircok dev örümcek yasiyordu.

english: She is the last one left and I must have a sample of her venom.
translation: O son kalan ve ben onun zehrinden bir örnek almaliyim.

english: What I want with the specimen however, is none of your business!
translation: Ancak bu örnekle ne yapacagim seni ilgilendirmez!

english: Woah sorry, didn't mean to touch a nerve. Fighting a giant spider sounds like a great idea.
translation: Üzgünüm, seni kizdirmak istemedim. Dev bir örümcekle savasmak harika bir fikir gibi görünüyor.

english: I've tried to put it off for as long as I could, but this is the final component needed for my research.
translation: Mümkün oldugunca ertelemeye calistim ama bu, arastirmam icin gerekli son bilesen.

english: Then what are you waiting around here for? Go out there and fight her.
translation: O zaman burada ne bekliyorsun? Cik disari ve onunla savas.

english: Are you sure you're equipped to take it down? I've had the displeasure of dealing with Venenatis, she will not go down easily.
translation: Onu alt edebilecek donanima sahip olduguna emin misin? Venenatis ile ugrasmak zorunda kaldim, kolay kolay yenilmez.

english: It will not be easy, but if I can get her when she's wounded in her lair, it should be a fairer fight.
translation: Kolay olmayacak, ama yuvasinda yaraliyken onu yakalayabilirsem, daha adil bir savas olur.

english: I didn't know she had a lair. I thought she just roamed the Wilderness.
translation: Onun bir yuvasi oldugunu bilmiyordum. Sadece Wilderness'da dolastigini saniyordum.

english: She only returns there to lick her wounds and rest, I need to be patient.
translation: Oraya sadece yaralarini sarmak ve dinlenmek icin dönüyor, sabirli olmam lazim.

english: So that explains why you're waiting here.
I would go out and fight her now, but I must admit, I am also a little scared. I've never been in a fight before.
translation: Simdi gidip onunla savasmak isterdim, ama itiraf etmeliyim ki, biraz da korkuyorum. Daha önce hic savasmadim.

english: I'm sure you'll be alright, it's just a gigantic spider!
translation: Eminim bir sey olmaz, sadece devasa bir örümcek!

english: Thanks for your words of confidence...
Hey. Do you know anything about this?
translation: Hey. Bunun hakkinda bir sey biliyor musun?

english: Well, would you look at that. Most fascinating.
Could you tell me what's so fascinating?
translation: Neden bu kadar ilginc oldugunu söyleyebilir misin?

english: It's a rare Zamorakian artifact. I haven't seen any quite like this one before.
translation: Bu nadir bulunan bir Zamorakian eseri. Daha önce böyle bir sey görmemistim.

english: If you look closely, you can see that it has a socket where you can place an item to increase its power.
translation: Yakindan bakarsan, gücünü artirmak icin bir esya yerlestirebilecegin bir yuva oldugunu görebilirsin.

english: Interesting! I'll be on the lookout for that.
So it's real. Magnificent.
You've seen this before?
No, but I have heard tales of the mighty Vet'Ion.
translation: Hayir, ama güclü Vet'Ion hakkinda hikayeler duydum.

english: It is said his skull can power a certain Zamorakian weapon.
translation: Kafatasinin belirli bir Zamorak silahina güc verebilecegi söylenir.

english: Oh, like this skull?
Yes, like that one! That looks powerful indeed. I think that would do quite nicely.
translation: Evet, aynen öyle! Gercekten de cok güclü görünüyor. Bence bu isimizi görür.

english: A skilled crafter can combine the two. If you wish, I could do it for you... For a price, that is.
translation: Yetenekli bir zanaatkar ikisini birlestirebilir. Isterseniz, bunu sizin icin yapabilirim... Tabii bir bedel karsiliginda.

english: I don't have the money for that.
Feel free to come back when you do.
There we go! All done.
No thanks.
No, I'm afraid not.
Oh. Do you know someone who might know more?
translation: Oh. Daha fazla bilgi sahibi olabilecek birini taniyor musun?

english: Andros Mai is a very... Devoted man. If you can see past that, he may be able to help you.
translation: Andros Mai cok... Sadik bir adamdir. Bunu görmezden gelebilirsen, sana yardimci olabilir.

english: Thanks!
Yes! Those belong to Venenatis!
Ah, but they contain no more venom. That is disappointing.
translation: Ah, ama artik zehir icermiyorlar. Bu hayal kirici.

english: So you're saying they're useless?
To me? Yes. But maybe not to you.
translation: Benim icin mi? Evet. Ama senin icin degil belki.

english: I've seen that Derse Venator guy over there handle similar items. Perhaps he knows more.
translation: Suradaki Derse Venator denen adamin benzer esyalari kullandigini gördüm. Belki o daha fazla bilir.

english: Downstairs there's a strange looking person. I don't know what that item is, but if anyone would, I reckon she would.
translation: Asagida tuhaf görünümlü bir kisi var. O esyanin ne oldugunu bilmiyorum, ama bilen biri varsa, o da odur herhalde.

english: I think she said her name was Madam Sikaro.
You look ready for combat.
Ask about rare item.
Yes
No
Hello, what is this place?
This is Seers Village! We're an organisation of mystically gifted people with the power of foresight...we see things that have yet to come to pass.
translation: Burasi Seers Köyü! Bizler, öngörü gücü olan mistik yeteneklere sahip insanlarin olusturdugu bir organizasyonuz... Henüz gerceklesmemis olaylari görebiliyoruz.

english: What do you do here?
A lot of our time is spent addressing everyday sorts of things, plus we meditate a lot and enhance our powers of mystical foresight.
translation: Zamanimizin cogunu gündelik islerle ugrasarak geciriyoruz, ayrica cok meditasyon yapiyoruz ve mistik öngörü gücümüzü gelistiriyoruz.

english: Do you have any quests?
Unfortunately no, sorry, but if adventure is what you seek, try checking through your quest list!
translation: Maalesef hayir, üzgünüm, ama macera ariyorsaniz, görev listenizi kontrol edin!

english: Ok, thanks.
Thank you, all I need to do is figure out how to get these logs into that vial, but that's my problem. Take this as a reward.
translation: Tesekkürler, tek yapmam gereken bu kütükleri siseye nasil koyacagimi bulmak, ama bu benim sorunum. Bunu ödül olarak kabul edin.

english: Hello, what is this place?
What do you do here?
Do you have any quests?
Ok, thanks.
Hello. Do you wish me to exchange banknotes for you? I charge only 5 coins for each banknote.
translation: Merhaba. Banknotlarinizi degistirmemi ister misiniz? Her banknot icin sadece 5 sikke aliyorum.

english: Yes please.
Hand me the banknotes you wish me to exchange.
Who are you?
I am Phials. I can exchange banknotes for real items. Do you want any banknotes converted?
translation: Ben Phials. Banknotlari gercek esyalarla degistirebilirim. Banknotlarinizi degistirmek ister misiniz?

english: No thanks.
Yes please.
Who are you?
No thanks.
Good day.
Hello there. Not very often I get visitors. What brings you here?
translation: Merhaba. Cok sik ziyaretci almam. Buraya neden geldin?

english: Who are you?
The name's Phileas Rimor. I was once a soldier in the Shayzien Army but now I'm retired.
translation: Adim Phileas Rimor. Eskiden Shayzien Ordusu'nda askerdim ama simdi emekli oldum.

english: Do you need help with anything?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: I'm fine thank you. Thanks for asking though.
translation: Tesekkürler, ben iyiyim. Yine de sordugun icin tesekkürler.

english: You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Tale of the Righteous quest.
translation: Tale of the Righteous görevini baslatmak icin gerekli tüm sartlari saglamiyorsun.

english: Nothing.
Oh, okay then.
Who are you?
Do you need help with anything?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Nothing.
Hello there.
What have you brought me? I want some more toys!
translation: Bana ne getirdin? Daha fazla oyuncak istiyorum!

english: I'm afraid I don't have any toys.
Toys! I want toys!
Hello youngster.
Daddy says you don't like Mr. Jones. Mr. Jones is nice. He brings me toys and sweets.
translation: Baban, Bay Jones'u sevmedigini söylüyor. Bay Jones iyi biridir. Bana oyuncak ve seker getirir.

english: Jones is a bad man, Philipe.
You're a bad [man/lady]! I don't like you!
translation: Sen kötü bir sin! Seni sevmiyorum!

english: I'll try and console myself about that disappointment somehow.
translation: Bu hayal kirikligini bir sekilde telafi etmeye calisacagim.

english: Hello, who are you?
Hi, I'm Phillipa! Juliet's cousin? I like to keep an eye on her, make sure that dashing young Romeo doesn't just steal away from here under our plain old noses!
translation: Merhaba, ben Phillipa! Juliet'in kuzeni mi? Onu gözetim altinda tutmak istiyorum, yakisikli genc Romeo'nun burnumuzun dibinden kacip gitmemesi icin!

english: He'd do it you know... he's ever so dashing, and cavalier, in a wet blanket sort of way.
translation: O bunu yapardi, bilirsin... O cok cesur ve atilgan, ama ayni zamanda biraz da sikici biridir.

english: Romeo? Where would I find him then?
translation: Romeo mu? Onu nerede bulabilirim peki?

english: Well, that's a good question! Who knows where his head's at most of the time... in the clouds most likely!
translation: Bu iyi bir soru! Kim bilir cogu zaman kafasi nerede... Muhtemelen bulutlarda!

english: Hello, I seem to be getting on really well with that dashing lovely dovely, Romeo... Pity about poor Juliet... she missed out there I reckon!
translation: Merhaba, o cesur, sevimli Romeo ile cok iyi anlasiyoruz... Zavalli Juliet icin üzülüyorum... bence o bir firsati kacirdi!

english: Hello
Oh, hello... Juliet has told me what you're doing for her and Romeo and I have to say, I'm very grateful to you. Juliet deserves a bit of happiness in her life.
translation: Oh, merhaba... Juliet bana onun ve Romeo icin yaptiklarinizi anlatti ve size cok minnettarim. Juliet hayatinda biraz mutlulugu hak ediyor.

english: And I'm sure Romeo is just the sort of jester to make her laugh out loud...hysterically you might say. He always brings a tear to my eyes...tears of happiness at his foolish antics!
translation: Ve eminim Romeo onu kahkahalara bogacak türden bir soytaridir... Histerik diyebilirsin. O her zaman gözlerimi yasartir... Onun aptalca sakalariyla mutluluk gözyaslari!

english: Oh, thanks...I like to do my cupid bit.
translation: Oh, tesekkürler... Cupid rolünü oynamayi seviyorum.

english: Oh, hello again! How was I...do you think I was convincing?
translation: Oh, tekrar merhaba! Nasil buldun... Sence ikna edici miydim?

english: Oh, yes, totally!
Ohhh good! I do hope Juliet will be pleased as well! That dashing young Romeo must be beside himself with excitement! Have you told him the good news yet?
translation: Ohhh, güzel! Umarim Juliet de memnun olur! O yakisikli genc Romeo heyecandan kendini kaybetmis olmali! Ona iyi haberi verdin mi?

english: Not yet, but soon!
Good, good...you lucky thing, I can't wait to see the look on his face!
translation: Güzel, güzel... sanslisin, yüzündeki ifadeyi görmek icin sabirsizlaniyorum!

english: Hey Phillipa, we need to do something about Juliet.
translation: Hey Phillipa, Juliet icin bir seyler yapmaliyiz.

english: Hi [player name], good to see you again, how are you?
translation: Merhaba Maceraci, seni tekrar görmek ne güzel, nasilsin?

english: Hi... I'm good thanks.
Oh that's great! Romeo and I are also doing great thanks for asking, we've been having the best time since you introduced me to him.
translation: Oh, bu harika! Romeo ve ben de cok iyiyiz, sordugun icin tesekkürler, sen bizi tanistirdigindan beri harika zaman geciriyoruz.

english: I'm not here to find out how you and Romeo are getting on, I'm here to help Juliet.
translation: Buraya sen ve Romeo'nun nasil gittigini ögrenmeye gelmedim, Juliet'e yardim etmeye geldim.

english: Typical, what is she upset about this time?
translation: Her zamanki gibi, bu sefer neye üzülüyor?

english: Her father put her in charge of the birthday party this year, but she's not feeling up to it, recent events have got her feeling quite down.
translation: Babasi bu yilki dogum günü partisini ona emanet etti, ama o kendini buna hazir hissetmiyor, son zamanlarda olanlar onu oldukca üzdü.

english: Why don't you try cheering her up?
I offered to get her one of Gertrude's cats, but she told me there's little chance of that happening.
translation: Ona Gertrude'un kedilerinden birini almayi teklif ettim, ama bunun pek mümkün olmadigini söyledi.

english: Hmm, why don't you try dressing up as one, you could be her emotional support human.
translation: Hmm, neden kedi kiligina girmeyi denemiyorsun, onun duygusal destekcisi olabilirsin.

english: That sounds like a terrible idea...
translation: Bu korkunc bir fikir gibi geliyor...

english: Surely there's something less... weird... I can do instead?
translation: Bunun yerine yapabilecegim daha az... tuhaf... bir sey yok mu?

english: Got any better ideas?
translation: Daha iyi bir fikrin var mi?...

english: Thought not, so since she loves cats, why don't you dress up as one and dance for her.
translation: Ben de öyle düsünmüstüm, kedileri sevdigine göre, neden kedi kiligina girip onun icin dans etmiyorsun?

english: I'm not going to dress up as a cat...
Fine, but what about just the ears?
translation: Peki, ama kulaklari taksan nasil olur?...

english: ... I suppose I can do that.
Where am I supposed to find some? I'm not about to take some off a cat.
translation: Nereden bulacagim? Bir kediden almayacagim ya.

english: I'm sure Iffie in town could put something together for you, she stays in the clothing store by Varrock Square.
translation: Sehirdeki Iffie sana bir seyler hazirlayabilir, Varrock Meydani'ndaki giyim magazasinda calisiyor.

english: Fine, I'll go have a word.
How are you getting on with your cat costume?
Still working on it, who did you say could help me with it?
translation: Hala üzerinde calisiyorum, kim yardim edebilir demistin?

english: Iffie should be able to help, she runs the clothing store by Varrock Square.
translation: Iffie yardim edebilir, Varrock Meydani'ndaki giyim magazasini isletiyor.

english: Alright Phillipa, I've got the cat ears, now what do you want me to do?
translation: Tamam Phillipa, kedi kulaklarini aldim, simdi ne yapmami istiyorsun?

english: Aww, they're so adorable!
Okay, you need to go talk to Juliet and try cheer her up, do a dance for her or something, do you have any good moves?
translation: Tamam, Juliet ile konusup onu neselendirmen gerekiyor, ona dans et ya da baska bir sey yap, iyi dans hareketlerin var mi?

english: I know a couple, okay let me try.
Thanks for cheering up Juliet, you've saved the party.
translation: Juliet'i neselendirdigin icin tesekkürler, partiyi kurtardin.

english: It's okay, I'm used to it at this point.
Ask about the birthday party.
translation: Dogum günü partisi hakkinda soru sor.

english: Something else.
Hello youngster!
The child is too busy playing to take any notice.
translation: Cocuk oynamakla mesgul, seni fark etmiyor.

english: 'Ello 'Ello!
Who's this then?
I don't know any more than you do!
Well ask them!
You ask them!
No! I'm not talking to some stranger in a sewer.
Go away, weirdo! We're busy!
Would you look at that!
At what?
It's [player name] again!
What do you want?
Where can I find Jimmy Dazzler again?
Didn't you find him in Ardougne?
He's normally in the Flying Horse Inn.
Give him a kiss from me!
I will absolutely not be doing that.
Can you tell me where I can find Hooknosed Jack?
He's here in Varrock!
Who 'nose' where, though!
Ha! I'm sure you can 'scent' him out, [player name]
translation: Ha! Eminim onu koklayarak bulabilirsin, Maceraci

english: Hahahaha!
Come on, it's not that funny.
translation: Hadi ama, o kadar komik degil.

english: You think our nose jokes are bad? Well...
translation: Burun sakalarimizi kötü mü buluyorsun? Sey...

english: Our eye jokes are even cornea!
Can you tell me where I can find Smokin' Joe?
Last we heard he was in Keldagrim.
Can you tell me where I can find the Face?
She was in Port Sarim last we heard.
You can't miss her!
Can you tell me where I can find Felkrash?
We shouldn't say, but-
She's got a secret den in Port Sarim!
translation: Port Sarim'de gizli bir siginagi var!

english: Not secret now, is it?!
Eh? Would you credit da.
Wha?
It's [player name] again init?
[player name] has come back again.
S' wha does 'ey want?
Oh come on, stop the act. It's just not funny anymore.
translation: Hadi ama, numara yapmayi birak. Artik komik degil.

english: Ya it is.
Ha! Ha!
Ha! Ha!
Can you tell me where I would find Jimmy Dazzler?
'Ees in Ardougne. In ee?
'e is, e is. He stays in the Flying Horse dun 'e?
translation: Evet, orada. Flying Horse'da kaliyor, degil mi?

english: Tell 'im we said 'ello. Will ye?She then breaks out in a burst of girly giggles.
translation: Ona selam söyle. Tamam mi? Sonra kiz gibi kikirdamaya baslar.

english: Can you tell me where I would find Hooknosed Jack?
Da big ugly's ere in Vu'rock.
Da big ugly! Ha that's a good one. 'E is big n ugly though isn't e, serve him right for all the fights e get's in.
translation: Koca cirkin! Ha, bu iyiydi. O koca ve cirkin, degil mi? Tüm kavgalarindan dolayi hak ettigini buluyor.

english: Ha! I nose the truth when I 'ears it! Get it? Get it? Nose the truth?
translation: Ha! Gercegi duydugumda anlarim! Anladin mi? Anladin mi? Gercegi anlarim?

english: Ha, ha, ha ah ha.....
You leave the sisters grime mid cackle.
Can you tell me where I would find Smokin' Joe?
Short stuff's out in Keldagrime.
Can you tell me where I would find the Face?
Hey features? Where is she?
Port Sarim last I 'eard.
Can you tell me where I would find Felkrash?
She's travels about a bit, but I reckon Port Sarim.
translation: Biraz seyahat ediyor, ama sanirim Port Sarim'de.

english: Jimmy Dazzler
Hooknosed Jack
Smokin' Joe
The Face
Felkrash
The face
So... The Pyromancers, they're cool, right?
translation: Yani... Pyromancers, onlar havali, degil mi?

english: We share a common goal.
Which is?
Keeping the cinders burning and preventing the long night from swallowing us all.
translation: Küllerin yanmaya devam etmesini saglamak ve uzun gecenin hepimizi yutmasini önlemek.

english: That sounds scary.
As long as we remain vigilant and praise the Sun, all will be well.
translation: Uyanik kaldigimiz ve Günes'i övdügümüz sürece her sey yolunda gidecek....

english: ... What are you staring at?
The great Sol Supra.
Is that me?
No mortal. The Sun, as you would say.
Do you worship it?
It is wonderous... If only I could be so grossly incandescent.
translation: O muhtesem... Keske ben de o kadar parlak olabilsem.

english: Who's a pretty birdy?
The phoenix gives you a smouldering look.
translation: Anka kusu sana yakici bir bakis atiyor.

english: One day I will burn so hot I'll become Sacred Ash.
translation: Bir gün o kadar sicak yanacagim ki Kutsal Küle dönüsecegim.

english: Aww, but you're so rare, where would I find another?
translation: Ah, ama sen cok nadirsin, baska bir taneyi nereden bulabilirim?

english: Do not fret mortal, I will rise from the Sacred Ash greater than ever before.
translation: Endiselenme ölümlü, Kutsal Külden her zamankinden daha güclü olarak yükselecegim.

english: So you're immortal?
As long as the Sun in the sky gives me strength.
translation: Gökyüzündeki Günes bana güc verdigi sürece.

english: ...Sky?
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
Hey there. Here to do some fishing? It's a great place for it. Or are you looking to buy some fishing supplies?
translation: Merhaba. Balik tutmaya mi geldin? Burasi balik tutmak icin harika bir yer. Yoksa balikcilik malzemeleri mi almak istiyorsun?

english: Let's see what you're selling.
Do you get many customers out here?
Not so much out here, but I sell plenty of fish to merchants in the capital. If you buy any fish there, there's a good chance it came from me.
translation: Burada pek yok, ama baskentin tüccarlarina bol bol balik satiyorum. Oradan balik alirsan, büyük ihtimalle benden gelmistir.

english: So anyway, looking to buy some fishing supplies?
translation: Neyse, balikcilik malzemeleri mi almak istiyorsun?

english: Just passing through.
Fair enough.
Let's see what you're selling.
Do you get many customers out here?
Just passing through.
Thank you for all your help in solving the murder.
translation: Cinayeti cözmemde yardim ettigin icin tesekkürler.

english: Welcome to my private little wyvern area.
translation: Benim kücük wyvern alanima hos geldin.

english: Who are you?
I'm Pieve. My big brother Steve made this training area, but he's gone off to be a Slayer Master to replace our cousin Nieve, so this area's mine now.
translation: Ben Pieve. Bu egitim alanini agabeyim Steve yapti, ama o kuzenimiz Nieve'nin yerine Slayer Master olmak icin gitti, bu yüzden bu alan artik benim.

english: Why is this wyvern area private?
My brother, Steve, carved the steps to get up here. He was jealous of our cousin, Nieve, because she'd got a huge training cave where she could boss people around. So he made this place.
translation: Agabeyim Steve buraya cikmak icin merdivenleri oydu. Kuzenimiz Nieve'yi kiskaniyordu, cünkü onun insanlara emir verebilecegi büyük bir egitim magarasi vardi. Bu yüzden burayi yapti.

english: So are you a Slayer Master?
No, I'm not. My brother Steve is a Slayer Master. He took over the job from our cousin Nieve. All he has to do is tell people to kill stuff - he says it's easy!
translation: Hayir, degilim. Kardesim Steve Slayer Master. Kuzenimiz Nieve'nin yerine bu görevi devraldi. Tek yapmasi gereken insanlara bir seyleri öldürmelerini söylemek - cok kolay diyor!

english: Thanks, goodbye.
That's not your assigned Slayer target. Up here, I expect people to focus on their Slayer training.
translation: Bu sana verilen Slayer hedefi degil. Burada insanlarin Slayer egitimine odaklanmalarini bekliyorum.

english: Who are you?
Why is this wyvern area private?
So are you a Slayer Master?
Thanks, goodbye.
Squawk!
Hello. I can convert items to banknotes, for 50 coins per item. Just hand me the items you'd like me to convert.
translation: Merhaba. Esyalari banknotlara dönüstürebilirim, esya basina 50 sikke karsiliginda. Dönüstürmemi istediginiz esyalari bana verin yeter.

english: Who are you?
I'm Piles. I lived in Draynor Village when I was young, where I saw three men working in the market, converting items to banknotes.
translation: Ben Piles. Gencken Draynor Köyü'nde yasiyordum, orada pazarda üc adamin esyalari banknotlara dönüstürdügünü gördüm.

english: Their names were Niles, Miles and Giles. I'm trying to be like them, so I've changed my name and started this business here.
translation: Adlari Niles, Miles ve Giles'ti. Onlar gibi olmak istiyorum, bu yüzden adimi degistirdim ve burada bu isi kurdum.

english: Thanks.
Here you go.
Who are you?
Thanks.
Dey got me in da belly, mees gutsies feel like had a dead dead dog dinner.
translation: Karnimi vurdular, bagirsaklarim ölü bir köpek yemisi gibi hissediyorum.

english: Oh, nilsal, fellow traveller. You don't see many other people out here.
translation: Oh, nilsal, yol arkadasim. Burada pek fazla insan görmüyorum.

english: Hello there! Where are you heading to?
The Proudspire of course! I'm walking the Pilgrim Path.
translation: Tabii ki Proudspire'a! Hacilar Yolu'nda yürüyorum.

english: What's the Pilgrim Path?
It is a sacred pilgrimage between the Teomat and the Proudspire. I do it every year, as do many others.
translation: Teomat ve Proudspire arasindaki kutsal bir hac yoludur. Her yil bircok kisi gibi ben de bu yolu yürürüm.

english: The hardest part is the last bit: Reaching the summit of the Proudspire. Only upon touching the obelisk at the top is your journey complete.
translation: En zor kismi son bölümdür: Proudspire'in zirvesine ulasmak. Sadece zirvedeki dikili tasi dokundugunda yolculugun tamamlanmis olur.

english: I see. Well good luck with your journey.
Thank you, traveller. May the sun light your way.
Good luck with your journey.
Nilsal to you once more, fellow traveller.
translation: Bir kez daha Nilsal, yolcu dostum.

english: Hello again! How are things going?
I'm still on route to the Proudspire, but I'm having a bit of a break to enjoy the scenery. Walking the Pilgrim Path can be long and arduous.
translation: Hala Proudspire'a dogru yol aliyorum, ama manzaranin tadini cikarmak icin biraz mola verdim. Hac Yolu'nu yürümek uzun ve zorlu olabilir.

english: What's the Pilgrim Path?
Good luck with your journey.
Hello.
Hi, I'm looking for an architect?
I am indeed, fastest builder in Kourend and a dab hand at sculpture. How can I help?
translation: Benim, Kourend'in en hizli insaatcisi ve heykeltiraslikta da ustayim. Nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: I wondered if you would be interested in helping to build a statue.
translation: Bir heykelin yapimina yardim etmek ister misin diye merak ettim.

english: Maybe. What of?
An enormous statue of King Rada I in the centre of Kourend.
translation: Kourend'in merkezinde Kral Rada I'in devasa bir heykeli.

english: Oh really? Who was he then?
He was your founding ruler! Surely you know your history?
translation: Sizin kurucu hükümdariniz! Tarihinizi biliyorsunuzdur herhalde?

english: Of course I do, just pulling your leg. Sounds like a great idea, though I am only good at doing arms and hands on big statues - is that of use?
translation: Tabii ki biliyorum, sadece sizi takiliyorum. Harika bir fikir gibi görünüyor, ancak ben sadece büyük heykellerin kollari ve ellerini yapmada iyiyim - bu isinize yarar mi?

english: Yes it is, I can find someone else to work on the other bits. See you at the site!
translation: Evet, yarar, diger kisimlari yapacak baska birini bulabilirim. Santiyede görüsürüz!

english: Yes, yes, I'm on my way, just collecting my things! I'll be there shortly.
translation: Evet, evet, geliyorum, sadece esyalarimi topluyorum! Birazdan orada olacagim.

english: How are we doing on the statue?
We can't start till we have someone to build all the parts.
translation: Tüm parcalari yapacak birini bulana kadar baslayamayiz.

english: I guess I have to go find some more architects then!
translation: O zaman gidip birkac mimar daha bulmam gerekecek!

english: You're under arrest! I've come to lock you up.
Okay, guv, I'll come quietly.
I'm not coming.
Hmmph!
I'm here to arrest [player name].
[player name], you're under arrest!
I've come to arrest you, [player name]!
Come and be locked up, [player name]!
Report to me for punishment, [player name]!
translation: Cezan icin bana rapor ver, Maceraci!

english: Maybe later.
Okay, guv, I'll come quietly.
I'm not coming.
Brother [player name] - welcome to the Realm of Memories.
translation: Kardes Maceraci - Anilar Diyari'na hos geldin.

english: What did you do before you came here?
I worked in a chapel dedicated to our lord, Saradomin. My task was to light the chapel candles, but I couldn't reach them myself and I kept getting dazzled by the light whenever I tried.
translation: Efendimiz Saradomin'e adanmis bir sapelde calisiyordum. Görevim sapeldeki mumlari yakmakti, ama onlara kendim ulasamiyordum ve her denedigimde isik gözlerimi kamastiriyordu.

english: I'd call adventurers from across the world, summoning them to my chapel to do the task for me. I needed them to light the tall candles, but not the short ones.
translation: Dünyanin dört bir yanindan maceracilari cagirip, benim icin bu görevi yapmalari icin sapele cagirirdim. Uzun mumlari yakmalarini istiyordum, ama kisa mumlari degil.

english: However, adventurers got confused, and thought they should light the short candles as well as the tall candles, so I made them try again. And again.
translation: Ancak maceracilar kafalari karismis ve kisa mumlari da uzun mumlar gibi yakmalari gerektigini düsünmüslerdi, ben de onlara tekrar denemelerini söyledim. Ve tekrar.

english: Eventually my chapel was closed down. They said I'd trapped adventurers there for too long. All I wanted was for them to light the tall candles without lighting the short candles!
translation: Sonunda sapelim kapatildi. Maceracilari orada cok uzun süre tuttugumu söylediler. Tek istedigim, kisa mumlari yakmadan uzun mumlari yakmalariydi!

english: Anyway, now I live here, and remember the good old days. It is nice to meet you, [player name].
translation: Neyse, simdi burada yasiyorum ve eski güzel günleri hatirliyorum. Tanistigimiza memnun oldum, Maceraci.

english: Goodbye.
So your name is Pete?
Yes, it is a common name. I also know of Party Pete, Parroty Pete, Postie Pete, Pirate Pete, Petrified Pete and 'Picarron' Pete. The Makeover Mage has used the name Pete too.
translation: Evet, yaygin bir isim. Party Pete, Parroty Pete, Postie Pete, Pirate Pete, Petrified Pete ve ‘Picarron’ Pete'i de taniyorum. Makeover Mage de Pete ismini kullanmis.

english: Although we are not related, the shared bond of that name can be a comfort in dark times.
translation: Akrabaligimiz olmasa da, bu ismin ortak bagi karanlik zamanlarda rahatlatici olabilir.

english: What did you do before you came here?
So your name is Pete?
Goodbye.
Hello!
Yo ho ho and bottle of alcopop!
translation: Yo ho ho ve bir sise alkollü icecek!

english: Oooh arrh!
No wait. That's a farmer.
Good day to you my dear sir!
Arrh be off with ye!
3 days at port for resupply then out on the high sea!
translation: 3 gün limanda ikmal yapip sonra acik denize acilacagiz!

english: Arrh arrh!
Arrh ye scurvy sea dog!
A pox on ye!
Arrh! I be in search of buried treasure!
Ahoy there!
Avast me hearties!
Shiver me timbers!
You'll be joining Davey Jones in his locker!
Arrrh ye lily livered landlubber!
Arrh!
Avast behind!
I'm not that fat!
Batton down the hatches there's a storm a brewin!
All hands on deck!
Yo ho ho me hearties!
Man overboard!
Keel haul them I say!
I think ye'll be taking a long walk off a short plank!
translation: Sanirim kisa bir tahtadan uzun bir yürüyüs yapacaksin!

english: Splice the mainbrace!
I'm the scourge of the seven seas!
Yo ho ho and a bottle of rum!
translation: Yo ho ho ve bir sise rom!

english: Pieces of eight! pieces of eight!
Oh wait that's the parrot's line.
Great blackbeard's beard!
I'm the scourge of the six seas!
Don't you mean seven seas?
Arrh I'll keel haul ye!
Hello.
Arrr?
What are you doing down here?
You can't have me treasure!
What treasure?
Where's the treasure? Who told ye about me treasure?
translation: Hazine nerede? Kim sana hazinemden bahsetti?

english: I don't know, you said something about treasure.
translation: Bilmiyorum, hazine hakkinda bir seyler söyledin.

english: Ain't no treasure down 'ere.
So why are you here?
Takin' a walk, gettin' some air.
Riiiiight.
Arr? Be ye wantin' te go on account with our gang o' fillibusters?
translation: Arr? Bizim korsan cetesine katilmak mi istiyorsun?

english: The powder monkey be takin' a caulk after gettin' rowdy on bumboo, so there be plenty of room for ye.
translation: Barut maymunu, bambuda gürültü yaptiktan sonra tuvalete gitti, yani sana yer var.

english: Riiiiight...
I'll just be over here if you need me.
What's a landlubber like ye doin' here?
translation: Senin gibi bir kara adami burada ne ariyor?

english: Helping Cap'n Teach shoot his way through a little blockade.
translation: Kaptan Teach'in kücük bir ablukayi asmasina yardim ediyorum.

english: Well done to ye. I'll see ye around.
Why is this place walled off?
Well [lad/lass], it's 'cos there be foul things in the jungle beyond.
translation: Cünkü ormanin icinde igrenc seyler var.

english: What sort of foul things?
Big 'uns, nasty 'uns. You name it, we got it.
translation: Büyük, kötü seyler. Ne ararsan var.

english: There be Jungle Horrors in the jungles, and Cave Horrors in the caves.
translation: Ormanda Orman Korkulari, magaralarda Magara Korkulari var.

english: Tis no place te be havin' a picnic and no mistake.
translation: Burasi piknik yapilacak bir yer degil, hic süphesiz.

english: Watch where yer goin'!
I was!
Then it must have been my fault and I apologise [lad/lass].
translation: O zaman benim hatam olmali, özür dilerim .

english: And I accept your apology. Good day.
Aye, good day te ye too.
Arr!
Arr?
Arr?
Arr!
Arr...
Arr.
Good morning!
I suppose it is. What of it?
I was just striking up a conversation.
Well...why would ye do a thing like that?
translation: Peki... neden böyle bir sey yaptin?

english: No reason.
What ship did ye pull in on, stranger?
The Adventurous.
That's a good ship, that it be.
Keep yer voice down [lass/lad], can't ye see I'm busy?
translation: Sesini alcalt mesgul oldugumu görmüyor musun?

english: First off, it's [lad/lass], and second, other than busy being drunk I can't see what you are talking about.
translation: Sarhos olmak disinda ne demek istedigini anlayamiyorum.

english: I can't feel me brains no more...
Wait...I recognise that smell. You've been drinking 'rum' haven't you?
translation: Bekle... Bu kokuyu taniyorum. Rom ictin, degil mi?

english: Arr...ye shufflin' muffle burble...
I think that can be filed as a 'yes'.
Are ye here for...you know...the stuff...
translation: Buraya... bilirsin... o sey icin mi geldin?

english: The what?
The stuff...you know...the stuff?
I'm not sure I follow you.
Aren't ye Toothless [Kevin/Lisa]?
No.
Sorry, sorry, my mistake!
Ain't ye the scurvy curr that killed my brother?
translation: Sen benim kardesimi öldüren alcak herif degil misin?

english: Well I'm not sure.
I kill so many things on a daily basis that it all tends to blur together.
translation: Her gün o kadar cok sey öldürüyorum ki, hepsi birbirine karisiyor.

english: Tell me, did they have any unusual features that would help me to recall them?
translation: Söylesene, onlari hatirlamama yardimci olacak herhangi bir olagandisi özellikleri var miydi?

english: How many things de ye have te kill in a day te lose count?
translation: Bir günde kac tane sey öldürüyorsun da sayisini kaybediyorsun?

english: I don't know, if I did I wouldn't have lost count!
Now, about your brother...
Never mind! I never liked him that much anyway!
translation: Bos ver! Zaten onu pek sevmezdim!

english: It's rather quiet around here for a pirate haven isn't it?
translation: Buralar bir korsan cenneti icin oldukca sessiz, degil mi?

english: Arr, we like te keep the peace around here.
Some of the older pirates don't like it, but Mos Le'Harmless be a hive of sense and civility.
translation: Bazi yasli korsanlar bundan hoslanmaz, ama Mos Le'Harmless akil ve medeniyetin merkezi.

english: How nice!
Arr, that it be.
What's yer business?
I was wondering who you are.
Well, I'm one of the militia, we try and keep the rest of the pirates in line.
translation: Ben milislerden biriyim, diger korsanlari hizada tutmaya calisiyoruz.

english: Well, as in line as we reckon they need to be.
translation: Tabii, bizim gerekli gördügümüz ölcüde hizada.

english: So how do you decide who becomes a member of the militia?
translation: Peki milis üyesi olmaya kimler karar veriyor?

english: Well, if yer ship is in need of repairs and yer in port, then yer a member, simple as that.
translation: Eger gemin onarima ihtiyac duyuyorsa ve limandaysan, o zaman üyesin, bu kadar basit.

english: See, those of us that are here for a long haul tend to want to keep things peaceful, so we keep an eye on everyone else as and when they come in.
translation: Uzun süre burada kalanlar genellikle ortami sakin tutmak isterler, bu yüzden gelen herkesi gözlemleriz.

english: Given the number of skirmishes we have with customs, there is never a shortage of repairs needed.
translation: Gümrükle yasadigimiz catismalarin sayisi göz önüne alindiginda, onarim ihtiyaci hic bitmez.

english: Thanks, that was very informative.
Just passing through.
See to it ye keeps outs trouble, stranger.
Just looking about.
Well good luck with that, landlubber.
Adventuring!
Adventurin' eh...that sounds like customs and excise work to my ears.
translation: Maceraya mi... Kulagima gümrük ve vergi isleri gibi geliyor.

english: No, no, I'm a pirate, honest. I have the book and everything.
translation: Hayir, hayir, ben korsanim, gercekten. Kitabim ve her seyim var.

english: I'll have me eye on ye, customs [boy/girl]. One step out of line and bam.
translation: Gözüm üzerinde olacak, Bir adim bile atarsan, bam.

english: They won't find enough of ye to feed a hungry sea slug.
translation: Ac bir deniz salyangozunu besleyecek kadar bile seni bulamazlar.

english: Just looking around. What is there to do here?
translation: Sadece etrafa bakiniyorum. Burada ne yapabilirim?

english: Well, if yeve got some coins in yer purse ye can head over to Joe's house of 'Rum' and get yerself drunk.
translation: Cüzdaninda biraz para varsa Joe'nun “Rum” evine gidip sarhos olabilirsin.

english: Anything else?
Well, Smithin' Smith and Dodgy Mike have some stuff to sell, and ye can always try grabbin' some fish from Two Feet Charley if yer hungry.
translation: Smithin' Smith ve Dodgy Mike'in satacak bazi esyalari var ve acsan Two Feet Charley'den balik kapabilirsin.

english: Is that it?
Well, ye can head out to the brewery and have a word with Fancy Dan or San Fan. They always need a hand out there.
translation: Bira fabrikasina gidip Fancy Dan veya San Fan ile konusabilirsin. Orada her zaman yardima ihtiyaclari vardir.

english: Doing what?
Doin' each others heads in most of the time.
What is your business?
Nothing much, just passing through.
translation: Önemli bir sey degil, sadece geciyordum.

english: Well have a good day, [sir/miss].
I'm sorry, but you don't sound much like a pirate, how did you come to be here?
translation: Üzgünüm ama korsan gibi konusmuyorsunuz, buraya nasil geldiniz?

english: I used to be a language tutor, teaching in a small school just outside of Lumbridge.
translation: Eskiden dil ögretmeniydim, Lumbridge'in hemen disindaki kücük bir okulda ders veriyordum.

english: However the place closed down due to ill attendance, and so I was forced to take up piracy.
translation: Ancak okul, düsük katilim nedeniyle kapandi ve ben de korsanliga baslamak zorunda kaldim.

english: Wasn't that a bit of a big jump in careers?
translation: Kariyerinizde büyük bir sicrama olmadi mi?

english: Not really, I made my way through via a short stint as a lawyer.
translation: Aslinda hayir, kisa bir süre avukatlik yaptim.

english: Well, that makes sense.
I must return to my duties. Have a nice day!
You too!
What's yours?
I asked first!
And very rudely too I might add.
translation: Ve cok kaba bir sekilde eklemeliyim.

english: Fine! Go about yer 'business'!
I will!
Whaz yer bushinessssss...ssss?
Are you drunk on duty?
I'm not drunk! I'll knock down any man as sayin' I'm been having a drinking on my duties!
translation: Sarhos degilim! Görev basinda icki ictigimi söyleyen her adami yere sererim!

english: Well, I think you'll have a hard time explaining your slurred speech, odd behaviour, bitter, nostril dissolving stench and rolling, bloodshot eyes if your not drunk.
translation: Eger sarhos degilsen, peltek konusmani, tuhaf davranislarini, burnunu yakip gözlerini kanatan kokunu ve yuvarlanan, kan canagina dönmüs gözlerini aciklamakta zorlanacaksin.

english: Arrr, ye got me. I just can't leave the stuff alone.
translation: Arrr, yakaladin beni. Bu seyi birakamiyorum.

english: Cap'n Braindeath's Ten X With Added Cattle Medication just keeps singin' its siren song to me.
translation: Kaptan Braindeath'in Sigir Ilaci Katilmis Ten X'i bana sürekli siren sarkisi söylüyor.

english: Would ye care fer a drop?
No.  I would most certainly not.
Suit yerself.
None of yours.
Fair enough. Off ye go.
I'm just helping out a friend.
Which friend?
Bill Teach.
Bill hired you eh? He must have been scrapin' the barrel and no mistake.
translation: Bill seni ise mi aldi? Kesinlikle caresiz kalmis olmali.

english: Hey! I resent that!
Hello!
Arrh I'll keel haul ye!
Pieces of eight! pieces of eight!
Oh wait that's the parrot's line.
You'll be joining Davey Jones in his locker!
Batton down the hatches there's a storm a brewin!
A pox on ye!
Arrrh ye lily livered landlubber!
Arrh arrh!
Avast me hearties!
Shiver me timbers!
3 days at port for resupply then out on the high sea!
translation: 3 gün limanda ikmal yapip sonra acik denize acilacagiz!

english: I think ye'll be taking a long walk off a short plank!
translation: Sanirim kisa bir tahtadan uzun bir yürüyüs yapacaksin!

english: Ahoy there!
Keel haul them I say!
Splice the mainbrace!
Great blackbeard's beard!
I'm the scourge of the six seas!
Don't you mean seven seas?
I'm the scourge of the seven seas!
Good day to you my dear sir!
Man overboard!
I don't think Mr Grip will like you opening that. That's his private drinks cabinet.
translation: Bay Grip'in bunu acmaniza izin verecegini sanmiyorum. Orasi onun özel icki dolabi.

english: He won't notice me having a quick look.
Stay out of my drinks cabinet!
Grip walks into the room
You find a bottle of whiskey in the cupboard.
Ok, I'll leave it.
He won't notice me having a quick look.
Ok, I'll leave it.
Ahoy!
What is this place?
Welcome to the Brimhaven Agility Arena!
If ye want to know more talk to Cap'n Izzy, he found it!
translation: Daha fazla bilgi almak isterseniz Kaptan Izzy ile konusun, burayi o buldu!

english: What do you do?
I be the Jack o' Tickets. I exchange the tickets ye collect in the Agility Arena for more stuff. Ye can obtain more agility experience or some items ye won't find anywhere else!
translation: Ben Jack o' Tickets'im. Agility Arena'da topladiginiz biletleri daha fazla sey ile degistiriyorum. Daha fazla agility deneyimi veya baska hicbir yerde bulamayacaginiz bazi esyalar elde edebilirsiniz!

english: Sounds good!
I'd like to trade in my tickets, please.
Aye, ye be on the right tack.
I have a question about my Achievement Diary.
translation: Basari Günlügümle ilgili bir sorum var.

english: I've done all the easy tasks in my Karamja Achievement Diary.
translation: Karamja Basari Günlügümdeki tüm kolay görevleri tamamladim.

english: Arr, ye have that, I see yer list. I s'pose ye'll be wantin' yer reward then!
translation: Anliyorum, listeni gördüm. Sanirim ödülünü almak istiyorsun!

english: Arrr, ye'll 'ave ta come back when ye has more space in yer pack.
translation: Cantan daha fazla yer acildiginda geri gelmelisin.

english: These 'ere Karamja gloves be a symbol of yer explorin' on the island. I'll 'ave a word with some of the seafarin' folk who sail to Port Sarim and Ardougne, so they'll take ye on board half price if ye be wearin' them.
translation: Bu Karamja eldivenleri, adadaki kesiflerinin sembolüdür. Port Sarim ve Ardougne'a yelken acan denizcilerle konusacagim, böylece bu eldivenleri giyersen seni yari fiyatina gemiye alacaklar.

english: I've done all the medium tasks in my Karamja Achievement Diary.
translation: Karamja Basari Günlügümdeki tüm orta zorlukta görevleri tamamladim.

english: Arr, so ye have. I s'pose ye'll be wantin' yer reward upgraded then!
translation: Öyle mi? O zaman ödülünün yükseltilmesini isteyeceksin herhalde!

english: Yes please.
