The enchantment on these 'ere Karamja gloves be a symbol of yer further explorin' on the island. Cap'n Izzy's arranged it so ye get a little extra benefit in our Agility Arena, an' ye can use the stepping stone in
translation: Bu Karamja eldivenlerindeki büyü, adadaki kesiflerinin devaminin sembolüdür. Kaptan Izzy, Agility Arena'da biraz ekstra avantaj elde etmen icin ayarladi, ayrica Shilo Köyü'ndeki basamak tasini da kullanabilirsin.

english: Shilo Village. Ye can have this lamp too.
Wow, thanks!
I've done all the hard tasks in my Karamja Achievement Diary.
translation: Karamja Basari Günlügümdeki tüm zor görevleri tamamladim.

english: Arr, so ye have. I s'pose ye'll be wantin' yer reward upgraded again!
translation: Öyle mi? Sanirim ödülünün yeniden yükseltilmesini isteyeceksin!

english: The enchantment on these 'ere Karamja gloves be a symbol of yer exhaustive explorin'. They'll take ye to a mine under Shilo Village now infinitely, an' all the merchants will give ye discounts. Ye can have this lamp
translation: Bu Karamja eldivenlerindeki büyü, senin yorucu kesiflerinin bir sembolüdür. Artik seni Shilo Köyü'nün altindaki madene sonsuza kadar götürecekler ve tüm tüccarlar sana indirim yapacaklar. Bu lambayi da alabilirsin.

english: too.
translation: Karamja Basari Günlügümdeki tüm elit görevleri tamamladim.

english: I've done all the elite tasks in my Karamja Achievement Diary.
translation: Karamja Basari Günlügümdeki tüm elit görevleri tamamladim.

english: Arr, that be an incredible achievement, so it be! I suppose ye'll be wanting yer reward upgraded again.
translation: Vay canina, bu inanilmaz bir basari! Sanirim ödülünün tekrar yükseltilmesini isteyeceksin.

english: The enchantment on these 'ere Karamja gloves be the ultimate symbol of yer exhaustive explorin'. Ye'll now get double TokKul from the Fight Cave, Inferno an' TzHaar-Ket-Rak's Challenges.
translation: Bu Karamja eldivenlerindeki büyü, senin kapsamli kesiflerinin en üst düzey sembolüdür. Artik Dövüs Magarasi, Inferno ve TzHaar-Ket-Rak'in Meydan Okumalarindan iki kat TokKul kazanacaksin.

english: Ye'll have a chance for double tickets in our Agility Arena 'ere. Ye can resurrect in the Fight Cave once per day, an' use some more shortcuts around the island, an' even enter some places fer free.
translation: Agility Arena'da iki kat bilet kazanma sansin olacak. Fight Cave'de günde bir kez dirilebilecek, adada bazi kisayollari kullanabilecek ve hatta bazi yerlere ücretsiz girebileceksin.

english: I can make the metal dragons under Brimhaven give ye bars as banknotes too, if ye likes.
translation: Istersen Brimhaven'in altindaki metal ejderhalarin sana banknot olarak külceler vermesini de saglayabilirim.

english: Ye can have that lamp too.
What is the Achievement Diary?
Arrr, it be a diary that tracks yer achievements on Karamja. Once ye've explored enough, I give ye some enchanted gloves, an' the people of Karamja reward ye for yer hard work.
translation: Karamja'daki basarilarinizi takip eden bir günlük. Yeterince kesif yaptiktan sonra size büyülü eldivenler veririm ve Karamja halki da emekleriniz icin sizi ödüllendirir.

english: What are the rewards?
Arrr, that depends what tier ye wants to know about.
translation: Bu, hangi seviyeyi bilmek istediginize bagli.

english: Ye gets a pair of special Karamja gloves. The seafarin' folk who sail to Port Sarim and Ardougne will take ye on board half price if ye be wearin' them.
translation: Özel bir cift Karamja eldiveni alirsin. Port Sarim ve Ardougne'a yelken acan denizciler, bu eldivenleri giyersen seni yari fiyatina gemiye alirlar.

english: Arrr, I upgrade the Karamja gloves so ye gets a little extra benefit in our Agility Arena with 'em on. Ye can use the stepping stone in Shilo Village, an ye still gets the easy rewards too.
translation: Arrr, Karamja eldivenlerini yükseltirim, böylece onlari giydiginde Agility Arena'da biraz ekstra avantaj elde edersin. Shilo Köyü'ndeki basamak tasini kullanabilirsin ve yine de kolay ödülleri de alirsin.

english: Arrr, I upgrade the Karamja gloves so they can take ye to a special mine under Shilo Village. Ye still gets the easy and medium rewards too.
translation: Arrr, Karamja eldivenlerini yükseltirim, böylece sizi Shilo Köyü'nün altindaki özel bir madene götürebilirler. Hala kolay ve orta ödülleri de alabilirsiniz.

english: Arrr, ye can get double TokKul from the Fight Cave an' Inferno, an' have a chance for double tickets in our Agility Arena 'ere. Ye can resurrect in the Fight Cave once per day, an' use a lot of shortcuts around the
translation: Arrr, Fight Cave ve Inferno'dan iki kat TokKul alabilir ve Agility Arena'da iki kat bilet kazanma sansiniz olur. Fight Cave'de günde bir kez dirilebilir, adanin cevresindeki bircok kisayolu kullanabilir

english: island, an' even enter some places fer free. I can make the metal dragons under Brimhaven give ye bars as banknotes too, if ye likes. Ye still gets the easy, medium an' hard rewards too.
translation: ve hatta bazi yerlere ücretsiz girebilirsin. Istersen, Brimhaven'in altindaki metal ejderhalarin sana banknot olarak külceler vermesini saglayabilirim. Hala kolay, orta ve zor ödülleri de alabilirsin.

english: Can I have another set of Karamja gloves?
translation: Bir cift Karamja eldiveni daha alabilir miyim?

english: Pirate Jackie gives you another pair of gloves.
translation: Korsan Jackie sana bir cift eldiven daha verir.

english: Arrr, those metal dragons under Brimhaven will drop their bars as banknotes for ye.
translation: Arrr, Brimhaven'in altindaki metal ejderhalar sana banknot olarak külcelerini düsürecek.

english: Arrr, those metal dragons under Brimhaven will drop their bars as normal items for ye.
translation: Arrr, Brimhaven'in altindaki metal ejderhalar sana normal esya olarak külcelerini düsürecek.

english: What potions do these new herbs make?
translation: Bu yeni otlar hangi iksirleri yapiyor?

english: I be no herbalist but I were given the recipes to go with these herbs...
translation: Ben bitki uzmani degilim ama bu otlarla yapilacak tarifler verildi...

english: Toadflax + toad legs = Agility potion.
Snapdragon + red spiders' eggs = Super restore potion.
translation: Aslanagzi + kirmizi örümcek yumurtalari = Süper iyilestirme iksiri.

english: Thanks!
See you later.
Ahoy! Yer want to swap these old tickets for some vouchers?
translation: Ahoy! Bu eski biletleri kuponlarla degistirmek ister misin?

english: Pirate Jackie the Fruit converts [number] Agility Arena Tickets into Agility Arena Vouchers
What is this place?
What do you do?
I'd like to trade in my tickets, please.
New Shop
Old Shop
I have a question about my Achievement Diary.
translation: Basari Günlügümle ilgili bir sorum var.

english: What is the Achievement Diary?
What are the rewards?
See you later.
Can I have another set of Karamja gloves?
translation: Bir set daha Karamja eldiveni alabilir miyim?

english: Easy rewards
Medium rewards
Hard rewards
Elite rewards
Cancel
Can I change the metal dragons' bar drops?
translation: Metal ejderhalarin bar düsüslerini degistirebilir miyim?

english: MORE
What potions do these new herbs make?
translation: Bu yeni otlar hangi iksirleri yapar?

english: BACK
Convert [number] tickets to vouchers
Don't convert.
Hello there!
Mornin'.
Hey...you're an adventurer, right?
translation: Hey... sen bir maceracisin, degil mi?

english: Yes I am!
Got any quests for me?
translation: Bana verebilecegin bir görev var mi?

english: Yeah, I do, as a matter of fact!
(Ahem.)
I am a poor, dispossessed nobleman, forced by circumstance to lurk in the middle of nowhere, soliciting help from passers-by.
translation: Ben zavalli, mülksüz bir asilzadeyim, kosullar beni issiz bir yerde saklanmaya ve yoldan gecenlerden yardim istemeye zorladi.

english: You see, my fiendish half-brother has seized my estates and forced me into exile.
translation: Görüyorsun, seytani üvey kardesim mülklerimi ele gecirdi ve beni sürgüne zorladi.

english: The simple lemon farmers suffer under his tyrannous yoke, and only a brave adventurer can lift his iron boot from the neck of the poor.
translation: Sade limon ciftcileri onun zalim boyundurugu altinda aci cekiyor ve sadece cesur bir maceraci onun demir botunu fakirlerin boynundan kaldirabilir.

english: To reclaim my lands I will need to have my family sword returned to me so that I may present it as proof of my rulership.
translation: Topraklarimi geri almak icin, hükümdarligimin kaniti olarak sunabilmem icin aile kilicimin bana iade edilmesi gerekiyor.

english: Will you help me find my family sword?
translation: Aile kilicimi bulmama yardim eder misin?

english: Yes.
Yes! Your uncorroborated sob story has touched my heart. When do we set off?
translation: Evet! Dogrulanmamis acikli hikayen kalbimi etkiledi. Ne zaman yola cikiyoruz?

english: You'll help! Wonderful!
But, alas, my half brother has a powerful ally, the mighty demon...
translation: Ama ne yazik ki üvey kardesim güclü bir müttefike sahip, o da güclü iblis...

english: Err...
Err...Barrelor!
Yes, the mighty, fearsome, tall, deadly, oaken, round demon Barrelor the Destroyer.
translation: Evet, güclü, korkutucu, uzun boylu, ölümcül, mese gibi, yuvarlak iblis Barrelor the Destroyer.

english: Barrelor?
That's what I said!
Barrelor is an awesome opponent, and to reclaim my family sword you will need to defeat him, for he guards it within the deadly Trapped Pit of Barrelor.
translation: Barrelor müthis bir rakip ve ailemin kilicini geri almak icin onu yenmen gerekecek, cünkü o kilici ölümcül Barrelor'un Tuzagi Cukuru'nda koruyor.

english: Wanna give it a shot?
Of course, I fear no demon!
Of course, I fear no demon!
Atta [boy/girl]!
When I am reinstated in my rightful place, I will not be a very wealthy man, as my half-brother has squandered my family fortune.
translation: Hak ettigim yere geri döndügümde, üvey kardesim aile servetini carcur ettigi icin cok zengin bir adam olmayacagim.

english: However, I will gladly give you every bent penny of what is left, and starve in the gutter with my many, many adorable children, if you say you will help me.
translation: Ancak, bana yardim edecegini söylersen, kalan her kurusunu seve seve sana veririm ve cok sayida sevimli cocugumla birlikte sokaklarda acliktan ölürüm.

english: Not a chance, this sounds too dangerous.
Look, I think I'll wait here for someone a little more... you know...
translation: Bak, sanirim burada biraz daha... bilirsin...

english: ...heroic.
No, I don't think I'll help you out this time.
translation: Hayir, bu sefer sana yardim etmeyecegim.

english: Had any luck finding someone to slay the demon?
What?
Oh! Yes! The demon, with the oppression and stuff!
translation: Oh! Evet! Iblis, baski ve diger seyler!

english: No, not yet. Why?
Because I came to offer to help.
Because I came to offer to help.
Atta boy!
Nonsense! Keep the money!
Nonsense! Keep the money! I will dispose of this evil half-brother of yours and leave you what little money is left to feed your family.
translation: Sacmalik! Parayi al! Senin bu kötü üvey kardesini ortadan kaldiracagim ve aileni beslemek icin kalan az parayi sana birakacagim.

english: Wonderful! Just pick up your diversion and we'll leave!
translation: Harika! Sen dikkatini baska yöne cek, biz de gidelim!

english: What diversion?
(cutscene starts)
Great, I'll take the cash in used coins please.
translation: Harika, parayi kullanilmis madeni paralarla alayim lütfen.

english: Great, I'll take the cash in used coins please.
translation: Harika, parayi kullanilmis madeni paralarla alayim lütfen.

english: Er...
No reason.
No reason. I was just in the area and I thought I would ask.
translation: Sebebi yok. Bu civardaydim ve sormak istedim.

english: I see...
Hello again!
Oh, it's you again.
So, what brings you down here today?
I've decided to help you for free! I will dispose of this evil half-brother of yours and leave you what little money is left to feed your family.
translation: Sana bedavaya yardim etmeye karar verdim! Senin bu kötü üvey kardesini ortadan kaldiracagim ve aileni beslemek icin kalan az parayi sana birakacagim.

english: (cutscene plays)
(same as above)
Do I know you?
Yes, you owe me some money.
Want a lift to Braindeath Island?
Well, possibly, but could I go to Mos Le'Harmless instead?
translation: Olabilir, ama Mos Le'Harmless'a gidebilir miyim?

english: Nope. It's Braindeath island or nothing. Interested?
translation: Hayir. Ya Braindeath Adasi ya da hicbir yer. Ilgileniyor musun?

english: Want a lift to Port Phasmatys?
Okay!
All right. I'll need to use my Magical Teleporting Bottle.
translation: Peki. Sihirli Isinlanma Sisemi kullanmam gerekecek.

english: Magical Teleporting Bottle?
Yes. Just turn around three times, then clap your hands and say the place you want to go.
translation: Evet. Üc kez dön, sonra ellerini cirp ve gitmek istedigin yeri söyle.

english: This I have to see.
Oh well, here goes.
One...
Would you like a hand with your stuff? You seemed to have dropped something.
translation: Esyalarini tasimanda yardim ister misin? Bir sey düsürmüs gibisin.

english: Where?
All right. You know that it's going to cost extra to take your friend as well, right?
translation: Tamam. Arkadasini da götürmenin ekstra ücrete tabi oldugunu biliyorsun, degil mi?

english: What friend?
Certainly. By the way, you have a spider in your hair.
translation: Elbette. Bu arada, sacinda bir örümcek var.

english: Oh no! Get it out, get it out!
Sure, turn around and I'll get it for you.
Thanks!
Well I'll be more than happy to...
Egad! Did you see that?
What? Where?
OW!
Ooooh... my head...
Are you ok? You, errr...
...missed your mouth while drinking from a bottle. Hence the bottle-shaped bruises.
translation: ...siseden icerken agzini iskaladin. Bu yüzden sise seklinde morluklar olustu.

english: ...slipped and slid into a brick wall.
...managed to fall onto my boot while I was practicing kicking.
...hit your head on my oars while I was rowing over.
Twice.
Wow... I'm lucky I wasn't seriously hurt!
translation: Vay canina... Ciddi bir sekilde yaralanmadigim icin sansliyim!

english: Not now.
I'm getting an awful headache talking to you. Any idea why?
translation: Seninle konusurken basim cok agriyor. Neden acaba?

english: No idea whatsoever.
Why do I get a headache every time I see you?
translation: Neden seni her gördügümde basim agriyor?

english: Well, it's possibly the weight of all of your expensive items giving you a sore back.
translation: Muhtemelen pahali esyalarinin agirligi sirtini agritiyordur.

english: As a doctor I can tell you that sometimes a bad back can manifest as a headache.
translation: Bir doktor olarak sana sunu söyleyebilirim ki, bazen sirt agrisi bas agrisi olarak ortaya cikabilir.

english: You're a doctor?
I'm on a break.
Regardless, I can tell you that if you hand me your most expensive items, then the pain will disappear.
translation: Her neyse, sana sunu söyleyebilirim ki, en pahali esyalarini bana verirsen, agrin gececektir.

english: CoughonceyouturnaroundagainCough!
What was that last bit?
Nothing...
Are you any relation to Party Pete?
Yes I am, he's my cousin.
Well, you don't sound too happy about it. What happened?
translation: Bundan pek memnun görünmüyorsun. Ne oldu?

english: Well, I arranged with all my friends to have a party at his place.
translation: Tüm arkadaslarimla onun evinde bir parti düzenlemistim.

english: But then I humiliated myself by trying to dance with the knights.
translation: Ama sonra sövalyelerle dans etmeye calisirken kendimi rezil ettim.

english: All of them collapsed on me in a horrific, jangling pile.
translation: Hepsi üzerime cökerek korkunc, gürültülü bir yigin olusturdu.

english: I tried to salvage the night by having all the balloons come down...
translation: Tüm balonlari indirerek geceyi kurtarmaya calistim...

english: So what happened?
I didn't know that someone had swapped the balloons with cannonballs!
translation: Birinin balonlari top mermileriyle degistirmis oldugunu bilmiyordum!

english: The casualties were horrific...
That was the worst fifth birthday party in the history of the world.
translation: Bu, dünya tarihindeki en kötü besinci dogum günü partisiydi.

english: I'm sure it wasn't that bad.
translation: O kadar da kötü degildi eminim.

english: Not according to the Official History of Gielinor!
translation: Gielinor'un Resmi Tarihi'ne göre öyle degil!

english: Every edition... the pictures bring it all back...
translation: Her baski... resimler her seyi geri getiriyor...

english: Ouch...
Please solve this for me. I have other things to be thinking about.
translation: Lütfen bunu benim icin cöz. Düsünmem gereken baska seyler var.

english: Sorry but you haven't solved the puzzle yet.
Thanks [player name]!
Not a chance, this sounds too dangerous.
No.
I've decided to help you for free.
translation: Sana bedavaya yardim etmeye karar verdim.

english: Okay!
Not now
Why do I get a headache every time I see you?
translation: Neden seni her gördügümde basim agriyor?

english: Are you any relation to Party Pete?
translation: Party Pete ile bir alakan var mi?

english: Erm, excuse me Mr Progress Hat?
Mr Progress Hat... sir?
Mr Progress Hat? Hello?
Hello... Mr Progress Hat?
Can't you see I'm busy?
But you're just a hat? Can you tell me my Pizazz Point totals?
translation: Ama sen sadece bir sapkasisin? Bana Pizazz Puanimin toplamini söyleyebilir misin?

english: I suppose you want to know your Pizazz Points.
That would be nice, yes.
What do you want?
Do you think you could tell me my Pizazz Points?
That's me, why are you bothering me human?
translation: Benim, neden beni rahatsiz ediyorsun insan?

english: Sorry, but do you think you could tell me my Pizazz Points?
translation: Üzgünüm, ama bana Pizazz Puanlarimi söyleyebilir misiniz?

english: Ok, I suppose it's my job. You have: [number] Telekinetic, [number] Alchemist, [number] Enchantment, and [number] Graveyard Pizazz Points.
Thank you!
Awww, look at the poor sick cow. We'd never make a burger out of you.
translation: Ah, zavalli hasta inege bakin. Senden asla hamburger yapmayiz.

english: Don't worry cow, I'm sure somebody will find a cure for this plague soon.
translation: Merak etme inek, eminim yakinda biri bu salginin tedavisini bulacaktir.

english: Come here little fox!
I'll just pop this here...
This'll get that mangy fox!
Hey, you're not a fox!
Hey, don't touch that!
Oi, leave those traps alone!
You win this time!
Let's get out of here!
We'll get you next time, fox!
translation: Bir dahaki sefere seni yakalayacagiz, tilki!

english: We've got you now, fox!
Maybe I'll make a nice new hat!
Its pelt will fetch a nice price!
I hear you're pretty smart to have solved the Sinclair Murder!
translation: Sinclair Cinayetini cözdügün icin oldukca zeki oldugunu duydum!

english: Hello.
Howdy! Thanks for buying all that low alcohol beer from me! Now I have the funds to whip up a new batch of my patented multipurpose poison!
translation: Merhaba! Benden tüm bu düsük alkollü biralari satin aldiginiz icin tesekkürler! Artik patentli cok amacli zehrimin yeni bir partisini hazirlamak icin gerekli paraya sahibim!

english: Maybe I can take your name and add it to my mailing list for potential purchasers of Peter Potter's patented multipurpose poison?
translation: Belki adinizi alip Peter Potter'in patentli cok amacli zehrinin potansiyel alicilari icin posta listeme ekleyebilirim?

english: Thanks, but no thanks.
Howdy! You seem like someone with discerning taste! Howsabout you try my brand new range of alcohol?
translation: Merhaba! Sen zevk sahibi biri gibi görünüyorsun! Yeni alkol ürünlerimi denemeye ne dersin?

english: Didn't you used to sell poison?
That I did, indeed! Peter Potter's Patented Multipurpose poison! A miracle of modern apothecarys! My exclusive concoction has been test on...
translation: Evet, satiyordum! Peter Potter'in patentli cok amacli zehiri! Modern eczaciligin mucizesi! Özel karisimim test edildi...

english: Uh, yeah, I've already heard the sales pitch.
Sorry stranger, old habits die hard I guess.
translation: Üzgünüm yabanci, eski aliskanliklar kolay kolay degismiyor galiba.

english: So you don't sell poison any more?
Well, I would, but I ran out of stock. Business wasn't helped with that stuff that happened up at the Sinclair Mansion much either, I'll be honest.
translation: Satmak isterdim ama stoklarim bitti. Sinclair Malikanesi'nde olanlar da isleri pek iyi etkilemedi, dürüst olmak gerekirse.

english: So, being the man of enterprise that I am I decided to branch out a little bit!
translation: Bu yüzden, girisimci bir adam olarak biraz cesitlilik yapmaya karar verdim!

english: Into alcohol?
Absolutely! The basic premise between alcohol and poison is pretty much the same, after all! The difference is that my alcohol has a unique property others do not!
translation: Kesinlikle! Alkol ve zehir arasindaki temel fark pek de büyük degil sonucta! Farki, benim alkolümün digerlerinde olmayan benzersiz bir özelligi olmasi!

english: And what is that?
The salesman takes a deep breath.
Ever been too drunk to find your own home? Ever wished that you could party away all night long, and still wake up fresh as a daisy the next morning?
translation: Hic eve dönüs yolunu bulamayacak kadar sarhos oldun mu? Hic bütün gece parti yapip ertesi sabah taze cicekler gibi uyanmak istedigin oldu mu?

english: Thanks to the miracles of modern magic we have come up with just the solution you need! Peter Potter's Patented Party Potions!
translation: Modern sihrin mucizeleri sayesinde tam da ihtiyacin olan cözümü bulduk! Peter Potter'in Patentli Parti Iksirleri!

english: It looks just like beer! It tastes just like beer! It smells just like beer! But... it's not beer!
translation: Görünüsü tipki bira gibi! Tadi tipki bira gibi! Kokusu tipki bira gibi! Ama... bu bira degil!

english: Our mages have mused for many moments to bring you this miracle of modern magic! It has all the great tastes you'd expect, but contains absolutely no alcohol!
translation: Büyücülerimiz, size modern sihrin bu mucizesini sunmak icin uzun süre kafa yordular! Beklediginiz tüm harika tatlara sahip, ama kesinlikle alkol icermiyor!

english: That's right! You can drink Peter Potters Patented Party Potion as much as you want, and suffer absolutely no ill effects whatsoever!
translation: Aynen öyle! Peter Potter'in Patentli Parti Iksirini istediginiz kadar icebilirsiniz ve kesinlikle hicbir yan etkisi olmaz!

english: The clean fresh taste you know you can trust, from the people who brought you; Peter Potters Patented multipurpose poison, Peter Potters peculiar paint packs
translation: Güvenebileceginiz temiz ve taze tadi, size Peter Potters Patentli cok amacli zehir, Peter Potters tuhaf boya paketleri

english: and Peter Potters paralysing panic pins. Available now from all good stockists! Ask your local bartender now, and experience the taste revolution of the century!
translation: ve Peter Potters felc edici panik igneleri sunan kisilerden geliyor. Simdi tüm iyi stokculardan temin edilebilir! Hemen yerel barmeninize sorun ve yüzyilin lezzet devrimini yasayin!

english: He seems to have finished for the time being.
So... when you say 'all good stockists'...
Yes?
How many inns actually sell this stuff?
translation: Kac tane han bu ürünü satiyor?

english: Well... nobody has actually bought any yet. Everyone I try and sell it to always asks me what exactly the point of beer that has absolutely no effect on you is.
translation: Sey... henüz kimse satin almadi. Satmaya calistigim herkes bana, üzerinde hicbir etkisi olmayan biranin ne anlami oldugunu soruyor.

english: So what is the point?
Well... Um... Er... Hmmm. You, er, don't get drunk.
I see...
Aw man... You don't want any now do you? I've really tried to push this product, but I just don't think the world is ready for beer that doesn't get you drunk.
translation: Hay aksi... Sen de istemiyorsun, degil mi? Bu ürünü gercekten satmaya calistim, ama bence dünya sarhos etmeyen biraya henüz hazir degil.

english: I'm a man ahead of my time I tell you! It's not that my products are bad, it's that they're too good for the market!
translation: Ben zamanimin ötesinde bir adamim, inan bana! Ürünlerim kötü degil, sadece pazar icin fazla iyi!

english: Actually, I would like some. How much do you want for it?
translation: Aslinda ben isterim. Ne kadar istiyorsun?

english: Y-you would??? Um, okay! I knew I still had the old salesman skills going on!
translation: Gercekten mi??? Tamam! Eski satis becerilerimin hala ise yaradigini biliyordum!

english: I'll sell you a keg of it for only 250 gold pieces! So what do you say?
translation: Sana bir fici birayi sadece 250 altin karsiliginda satarim! Ne dersin?

english: Sorry pal, we do not offer credit for any purchases made of Peter Potter's patented party potion! Come back when you have the cash!
translation: Üzgünüm dostum, Peter Potter'in patentli parti iksiri icin kredi vermiyoruz! Paran oldugunda tekrar gel!

english: No, not really.
I understand you have some low alcohol beer for sale...?
translation: Anladigim kadariyla düsük alkollü bira satiyorsunuz...?

english: That I do, and sales are rocketing upwards as word of mouth spreads of it's clean taste and cool flavour! So... you want to buy some?
translation: Evet, satiyorum ve temiz tadi ve serin lezzeti hakkinda kulaktan kulaga yayilan söylentiler sayesinde satislar hizla artiyor! Ee... almak ister misin?

english: Maybe I can take your name and add it to my mailing list for potential purchasers of Peter Potter’s patented multipurpose poison?
translation: Belki adini alip Peter Potter'in patentli cok amacli zehrinin potansiyel alicilari icin posta listeme ekleyebilirim?

english: Talk about the Murder Mystery Quest
Talk about the Fremennik Trials
Yes
No
Squawk! Who's a pretty bird?
Squawk! Leave me alone, bird! I'm trying to have a drink!
translation: Gak! Beni rahat birak kus! Icki icmeye calisiyorum!

english: Squawk! She's pecking my peg leg!
Squawk! Ow! That was my finger! Stupid bird!
translation: Gak! Ah! O benim parmagimdi! Aptal kus!

english: Squawk! Steve! That bird is trying to drink the grog again!
translation: Gak! Steve! O kus yine icki icmeye calisiyor!

english: Squawk! Please stop! I'm sorry I called you a pigeon!
translation: Gak! Lütfen dur! Sana güvercin dedigim icin özür dilerim!

english: Hey, how's it going?
Not so good. It's great to see you're helping us out though.
translation: Pek iyi degil. Ama bize yardim ettigin icin cok mutluyum.

english: Hey there. It's great of you to do all this work for Veliaf. I've heard him say some good things about you. Keep up the good work and I'm sure you'll be invited to become a full member of the Myreque!
translation: Merhaba. Veliaf icin tüm bu isleri yapman harika. Senin hakkinda iyi seyler söyledigini duydum. Böyle devam et, eminim Myreque'nin tam üyesi olmaya davet edileceksin!

english: Hey there. It's brilliant that you've been made into a full member of the Myreque!
translation: Merhaba. Myreque'nin tam üyesi olman harika!

english: Keep up the good work, I'm sure Veliaf appreciates it.
translation: Iyi is cikarmaya devam et, eminim Veliaf bunu takdir edecektir.

english: Thanks. Speaking of Veliaf, where is he?
He's out on business. Don't worry, he knows how to take care of himself.
translation: Is gezisinde. Merak etme, kendini korumayi bilir.

english: I cannot speak to you outerlander! Talk to Brundt, the Chieftain!
translation: Seninle konusamam yabanci! Sef Brundt ile konus!

english: You stay away from me outerlander!
They are too suspicious of you for you to get close enough to steal from them.
translation: Sana karsi cok süpheci davraniyorlar, onlardan bir sey calacak kadar yaklasamazsin.

english: Hello.
Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: Merhaba kardesim Dokrak. Bugün benden ne istiyorsun? Her zaman yardimima güvenebilirsin!

english: Nothing thanks. I just fancied a chat.
translation: Hicbir sey, tesekkürler. Sadece sohbet etmek istedim.

english: My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
translation: Yardimima ihtiyacin olursa kapim her zaman acik Dokrak.

english: [Fremennik name]... It has been too long since last we met!
translation: Dokrak... Son görüsmemizden bu yana cok zaman gecti!

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: Hos geldin kardesim Dokrak. Seni burada görmek her zaman bir zevk!

english: My apologies [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: Özür dilerim kardesim Dokrak! Burada seninle vakit gecirecek vaktim yok!

english: That's okay, I didn't really want anything.
translation: Sorun degil, aslinda bir sey istememistim.

english: How are you [Fremennik name]? I hope all fares well with you this day!
translation: Nasilsin Dokrak? Umarim her sey yolundadir.

english: I'm fine, thanks, how are you?
All is well with me also!
Hello to you, too!
Hello. Did you want something [Fremennik name]?
translation: Merhaba. Bir sey mi istiyordun Dokrak?

english: No, not really.
Well... okay then!
Always good to see you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].
translation: Seni görmek her zaman güzel kardesim Dokrak.

english: You shame us, [Fremennik name]!
How can you steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
You have betrayed your heritage, [Fremennik name]!
Why would you try to steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
Stop! Who ever passes this bridge must answer me these questions three.
translation: Dur! Bu köprüden gecen herkes bana bu üc soruyu cevaplamali.

english: Ask me the questions, bridgemaster. I am not afraid.
What... is your name?
My name is '[player name] of Lumbridge'.
What... is your quest?
To cross this bridge!
What... is your favoritecolour?
Blue!
Right. Off you go.
So can I go by?
No.
Huh?
Well, perhaps. You should speak to Alec the Guildmaster, he sorts out that kind of thing. You'll find him up on a small island north of the guild.
translation: Sey, belki. Lonca baskani Alec ile konusmalisin, o bu tür isleri halleder. Onu guild'in kuzeyindeki kücük bir adada bulabilirsin.

english: Oh okay! I'll go do that. Bye.
Fare thee well.
Oh go on then. I suppose you have proven yourself worthy.
Blue. No yel—ARGHHH!
Why are you screaming?
Oh, ummm... I thought I was going to die.
Why?
I don't know. So can I go by?
I don't have one.
There's always someone who wants to be difficult, off with you!
translation: Her zaman zorluk cikarmak isteyen biri vardir, git buradan!

english: My name is '[player name] of Varrock'.
What... is the capital of Kandarin?
I don't know that! ARGHHH!
...So can I go by?
Umm, Ardougne?
Perhaps!
So... Can I go by?
How can a single kingdom have multiple kings?
translation: Tek bir krallikta nasil birden fazla kral olabilir?

english: That's...
A fair point.
May I pass?
My name is '[player name] of Falador'.
What... is the air-speed velocity of an unladen chompy?
translation: Yüksüz bir chompy'nin hava hizi ne kadardir?

english: What do you mean? A Feldip chompy or one from Karamja?
translation: Ne demek istiyorsun? Feldip chompy mi, Karamja chompy mi?

english: Huh? I-- I don't know that. ARGHHH!
Why are you screaming?
Internal self-doubt and the crippling feeling of everyone hating me.
translation: Icsel kendime güven eksikligi ve herkesin benden nefret ettigi hissi.

english: Ooookay then, perhaps I should go past.
translation: Tamam o zaman, belki de gecmeliyim.

english: Can chompies even fly?
I'm sure I've seen them fly before, but it could've been falling gracefully.
translation: Onlari ucarken gördügüme eminim, ama zarif bir sekilde düsüyor olabilirdi.

english: Chompy or Jubbly?
Chompy.
11 meters per second, or 24 miles an hour.
translation: Saniyede 11 metre, ya da saatte 24 mil.

english: Great!
My name is '[player name] of Lumbridge'.
Blue!
Blue. No, yel-- ARGHHH!
I don't have one.
My name is '[player name] of Varrock'.
I don't know that! ARGHHH!
Umm, Ardougne?
"How can a single kingdom have multiple kings?"
translation: “Tek bir krallikta nasil birden fazla kral olabilir?”

english: My name is '[player name] of Falador'.
What do you mean? A Feldip chompy or one from Karamja?
translation: Ne demek istiyorsun? Feldip chompy mi yoksa Karamja'dan mi?

english: Can chompies even fly?
Chompy or Jubbly?
Hey there, is this where you live?
translation: Merhaba, burasi senin yasadigin yer mi?

english: Yes it is! Don't look down your nose at me. I have to put up with an awful lot to earn my living, life is a daily struggle.
translation: Evet, öyle! Bana tepeden bakma. Gecimimi saglamak icin cok sey katlanmak zorundayim, hayat her gün bir mücadele.

english: Sorry, I am just curious. Why is life so difficult here?
translation: Üzgünüm, sadece merak ettim. Neden burada hayat bu kadar zor?

english: Just look at the place, rats, flies and all sorts just swarming the area. Doesn't help that I stink but ain't no one who likes using those tin baths right in public view.
translation: Etrafa bir bak, fareler, sinekler ve her türlü hasarat burayi istila etmis. Kokmam da isleri zorlastiriyor ama kimse herkesin gözü önünde olan teneke küvetleri kullanmak istemiyor.

english: It is difficult to make ends meet. There are just so many skilled fishermen here that the competition is too much! Leaves no room for someone like me.
translation: Gecimini saglamak zor. Burada o kadar cok yetenekli balikci var ki rekabet cok fazla! Benim gibi birine yer kalmiyor.

english: Thieves! Thieves everywhere. Come to think of it, they always look remarkably like you! Adventurers running about stealing our things, get out of my sight.
translation: Hirsizlar! Her yerde hirsizlar var. Düsündüm de, hep sana cok benziyorlar! Esyalarimizi calan maceracilar, gözümün önünden kaybolun.

english: Look, this is none of your business, I'd appreciate it if you left me to it. I don't want to see another fancy adventurer again!
translation: Bak, bu seni ilgilendirmez, beni rahat birakirsan sevinirim. Bir daha sik maceraci görmek istemiyorum!

english: Okay okay! I'll be off now.
Gang crime is everywhere! I see them sometimes... it makes me very uneasy. It becomes difficult to sleep at night, never mind the draft in here.
translation: Cete suclari her yerde! Bazen onlari görüyorum... bu beni cok tedirgin ediyor. Geceleri uyumak zorlasiyor, buradaki cereyani bos ver.

english: I've heard about those gangs! The Shayzien soldiers do a lot of work to put an end to it.
translation: O ceteleri duydum! Shayzien askerleri buna son vermek icin cok calisiyor.

english: Don't talk to me about those soldiers, all they ever do is blitz onto these docks with not a care in the world for us folk.
translation: Bana o askerlerden bahsetme, tek yaptiklari bu limana saldirmak ve biz halki hic umursamamak.

Yes it is! Don't look down your nose at me. I have to put up with an awful lot to earn my living, life is a daily struggle.

translation: Bana o askerlerden bahsetme, tek yaptiklari bu limana saldirmak ve biz halki hic umursamamak.

english: Hello! What are you doing here?
Hello, I'm keeping this berth free for the return of Lady Piscarilius.
translation: Merhaba, Lady Piscarilius'un dönüsü icin bu rihtimi bos tutuyorum.

english: Lady Piscarilius is out at sea?
Indeed, Asa keen seafarer Lady Piscarilius often leads voyages herself.
translation: Evet, denizci Lady Piscarilius sik sik kendisi seyahatlere cikar.

english: Is she expected to return soon?
Lady Piscarilius did not reveal how long she may be at sea for nor where she intended to explore.
translation: Lady Piscarilius ne kadar süre denizde kalacagini ve nereyi kesfetmeyi planladigini aciklamadi.

english: Ok, thanks.
Hello.
Hi there. How can I help you?
What do you do around here?
I'm the port master. It's my job to keep everything around here running nice and smoothly for all the vessels coming and going.
translation: Ben liman müdürüyüm. Buradaki her seyin, gelen ve giden tüm gemiler icin sorunsuz ve düzgün bir sekilde islemesini saglamak benim isim.

english: Sounds like quite a challenging job. I'd best not distract you.
translation: Oldukca zor bir is gibi görünüyor. Sizi rahatsiz etmemem daha iyi olur.

english: I'm afraid I can't help you with that at the moment. You'll have to come back later.
translation: Maalesef su anda size yardimci olamam. Daha sonra tekrar gelmeniz gerekecek.

english: You need to complete the Pandemonium quest to fully access the Sailing skill.
translation: Yelkencilik becerisine tam erisim icin Pandemonium görevini tamamlamaniz gerekiyor.

english: Go away, I'm busy!
HEY PETE, WHAT ARE YOU DOING HERE?
translation: HEY PETE, NE ISIN VAR BURADA?

english: Shhhh! It's a library you know!
Oh, sorry! So, what's new?
translation: Oh, pardon! Ee, ne var ne yok?

english: Not much, just doing some research on Dwarvern Culture. Did you know that Keldagrim was originally constructed by a long lost clan who embraced the power of magic, and used it to aid with glorious buildings like
translation: Pek bir sey yok, sadece Cüce Kültürü üzerine arastirma yapiyorum. Keldagrim'in aslinda uzun zaman önce kaybolmus, büyünün gücünü benimseyen ve onu kraliyet sarayi gibi görkemli binalarin yapiminda kullanan bir klan tarafindan insa edildigini biliyor muydun?

english: the royal palace?
Really??
Yes. They even stayed down there for 1000 years or more, in a time they call 'The age of Kings'.
translation: Evet. Hatta “Krallarin Cagi” olarak adlandirdiklari dönemde 1000 yil veya daha uzun süre orada kaldilar.

english: WOW!
Shhhh! That's enough history for one day I think!
translation: Ssss! Sanirim bugünlük bu kadar tarih yeter!

english: Pete, what are you doing out here in the deep wilderness?
translation: Pete, bu derin Wildernessda ne yapiyorsun?

english: Shhh!! Don't let the others see me here! I'm on a top secret mission for the Burth..., no, nothing. Never mind. Oooo, look, the chaos elemental!! Quick, run!!
translation: Ssss! Digerleri beni burada görmesin! Burth icin cok gizli bir görevdeyim... Hayir, önemli degil. Bos ver. Oooo, bak, kaos elementali! Cabuk, kos!

english: Argh!! Where?
Hey Postie. Howstricks? Who are you interviewing here?
translation: Selam Postaci. Nasil gidiyor? Burada kiminle röportaj yapiyorsun?

english: Everyone deserves ahicbreak you know. It gets pretty tiring luggingburpletters about all day.
translation: Herkes bir mola hak eder, biliyorsun. Bütün gün mektuplari tasimak oldukca yorucu oluyor.

english: I see. Can I join you?
Why, am Ihiccoming apart?
You've been here a while, haven't you?
Maybe I haves, maybe I haves. It all goes straight to my head you see.
translation: Belki de, belki de. Her sey kafama takiliyor, anlarsin ya.

english: Yes... I can see that. Bye Pete!
Hey Pete what you doing here?
Just doing a quick survey on famous people and their favourite colour. It's a special feature for 'West Wyverns Women's Weekly'.
translation: Ünlülerin en sevdikleri renkler hakkinda kisa bir anket yapiyorum. “West Wyverns Women's Weekly” dergisi icin özel bir haber.

english: Can I get a copy?
Can you speak Wyvern?
No. Can you?
Well obviously.
Go on then.
Here! Are you mad? No, 'fraid I can't do that. Could cause all sorts of trouble.
translation: Al! Delirdin mi? Hayir, korkarim bunu yapamam. Her türlü soruna yol acabilir.

english: You're a bit mad really aren't you?
translation: Sen gercekten biraz delisin, degil mi?

english: So would you be if you could speak over 1000 languages. I bet it's bliss being ignorant of this world's trouble! I'm off!
translation: 1000'den fazla dil konusabilseydin sen de öyle olurdun. Bu dünyanin sorunlarindan habersiz olmak ne kadar da güzel olmali! Ben gidiyorum!

english: Hi Pete, how's things?
Just chatting to my big brother Pete. Hee heee!!
translation: Agabeyim Pete ile sohbet ediyorum. Hee heee!!

english: What's so funny?
Just a joke that he told me. Care to hear it?
translation: Bana anlattigi bir saka. Duymak ister misin?

english: Yes, go on then.
2 Parrots sit on a perch. One says to the other 'Can you smell fish'? Hee heheee he ho ho.
translation: 2 papagan bir dalda oturuyor. Biri digerine “Balik kokusu aliyor musun?” diyor. Hee heheee he ho ho.

english: And so what did the other one say?
Sigh. 2 Parrots sit on a perch. One says to the other 'Can you smell fish'? Hee heheee he ho ho.
translation: Sigh. 2 papagan bir dalda oturuyor. Biri digerine “Balik kokusu aliyor musun?” diyor. Hee heheee he ho ho.

english: I see. So... what did the other one say?
You're serious aren't you. Listen again. 2 Parrots sit on a perch. One says to the other 'Can you smell fish'.
translation: Ciddi misin sen? Bir daha dinle. 2 papagan bir dalda oturuyor. Biri digerine “Balik kokusu aliyor musun?” diyor.

english: Fish, right. So, what was the reply?
ARGH!! 2 PARROTS. ON A PERCH. SMELLS FISHY.
translation: ARGH!! 2 PAPAGAN. BIR DALDA. BALIK KOKUYOR.

english: No, still lost. Is one of them a penguin?
translation: Hayir, hala anlamadim. Biri penguen mi?

english: You're doing it on purpose now aren't you? Please leave me alone!
translation: Bunu bilerek yapiyorsun, degil mi? Lütfen beni rahat birak!

english: Hey Pete, what you doing here?
Just chatting to my brother Pete. He keeps Parrots.
translation: Kardesim Pete ile sohbet ediyorum. Papagan besliyor.

english: Doesn't sound too tough. What's the pay like?
translation: Cok zor bir is gibi görünmüyor. Maasi nasil?

english: Not very good I'm afraid. His bosses are pretty cheep.
translation: Korkarim cok iyi degil. Patronlari oldukca cimri.

english: Groan. Don't give up the day job Pete.
Arrrr. Avast shipmate. Arrr. I Likes the cut of your gibb. Arrr. That it be.
translation: Arrrr. Dur bakalim gemi arkadasi. Arrr. Kiyafetini begendim. Arrr. Öyle olsun.

english: Arrr?
Arrrr.
I have a strange feeling of Deja Vu. I must go now.
translation: Garip bir Deja Vu hissi var icimde. Artik gitmeliyim.

english: Hey Postie! What you doing all the way up here?
translation: Hey Postaci! Burada ne isin var?

english: I was just trying to get some wise words of wisdom from the Oracle. You know, she's been here a long, long time.
translation: Oracle'dan bilgece sözler almaya calisiyordum. Bilirsin, o cok uzun zamandir burada.

english: Yes, I thought as much. What did she have to say?
translation: Evet, ben de öyle düsünmüstüm. Ne dedi?

english: First she said 'I am the Oracle, And when I open my lips, let no dog bark!'
translation: Önce “Ben Oracle'im ve agzimi actigimda hicbir köpek havlamasin!” dedi.

english: I see. And then what?
I didn't know she was familiar with the works of Shakespeare. So I said 'Et tu, brute?'
translation: Shakespeare'in eserlerini bildigini bilmiyordum. Ben de “Et tu, brute?” dedim.

english: And then?
Well, she started leaping about and pointing to Ardougne, shouting something about betrayal. She was really angry.
translation: Sey, ziplamaya basladi ve Ardougne'yi isaret ederek ihanetle ilgili bir seyler bagirdi. Gercekten cok kizgindi.

english: Cripes! What do you think it means?
translation: Hay aksi! Sence bu ne anlama geliyor?

english: Who knows. Always cryptic to the last. See you around.
translation: Kim bilir. Her zamanki gibi gizemli. Görüsürüz.

english: Anyone got post?
Reldo, have you found that book I was looking for yet?
No, not yet... but I know I have seen it somewhere...
translation: Hayir, henüz bulamadim... ama bir yerde gördügümü biliyorum......

english: ... come back later.
Sure, no problems. See you later.
Bye! Say hi to the other Petes for me.
translation: Hosca kal! Diger Petes'lere selam söyle.

english: Will do. Farewell!
Psssst! How is the plan going?
Perfectly. Everyone is prepared.
Great. Now don't forget - nobody does anything until I give the word! OK?
translation: Harika. Unutma, ben emir verene kadar kimse bir sey yapmasin! Tamam mi?

english: Sure no problem. We'll be waiting.
'Till next time. Farewell.
translation: Bir dahaki sefere görüsürüz. Hosca kal.

english: 4 Pints of your finest please.
4 Pints coming right up. Are you expecting guests?
translation: 4 pint hemen geliyor. Misafir mi bekliyorsunuz?

english: Just a few old friends.
You want me to put it on your tab?
That would be great, thanks. Oh cripes! I've left a fire burning! I'll be back in a mo.
translation: Harika olur, tesekkürler. Hay aksi! Atesi acik birakmisim! Hemen dönerim.

english: Fight! Fight!.. Fight!!
Easy Pete, calm down. Don't lose your head!
translation: Sakin ol Pete, sakin ol. Kafani kaybetme!

english: Cheeky!! If you're not careful I'll get you cursed too!
translation: Küstah! Dikkatli olmazsan seni de lanetleyecegim!

english: You wouldn't catch me double-crossing a witch!
translation: Bir cadiyi ihanet etmekle yakalayamazsin beni!

english: But which witch is which! Anyway, I'm late for an appointment with the oracle.
translation: Ama hangi cadi hangisi! Neyse, kahinle randevuma gec kaldim.

english: Take care and say hi to the kids for me.
translation: Kendine iyi bak ve cocuklara selam söyle.

english: Hey, bro! How's the party business?
translation: Selam kardesim! Parti isi nasil gidiyor?

english: Great, thanks!
Celebrating weddings and drop partys...
...and getting paid for it!
Nice. Well, I'm here to talk to some White Knights.
translation: Güzel. Ben buraya Beyaz Sövalyelerle konusmaya geldim.

english: Want to take some cake with you?
No thanks, I'm still dieting!
Just seafood for me.
Hi Pete!
Mum wants to know if you're coming round for tea.
translation: Annem cay icin gelecek misin diye soruyor.

english: No, I've got another late night here.
translation: Hayir, yine gec saatlere kadar burada kalacagim.

english: Ol' bluebeak's got the flu again!
translation: Yasli mavi gagali yine grip olmus!

english: Oh dear. Nothing too serious I hope.
translation: Oh hayir. Umarim ciddi bir sey degildir.

english: Well, as long as he hasn't caught anything from that evil chicken.
translation: Su kötü tavuktan bir sey kapmamissa sorun yok.

english: Got a taste for parrots now too has he?
translation: Simdi de papaganlari mi sevmeye basladi?

english: *Sigh.* Will nothing sacred be safe?
translation: *Ic cekis.* Kutsal hicbir sey güvende degil mi?

english: Hey Pete. Any news from the fleet?
translation: Selam Pete. Filodan haber var mi?

english: No yo ho bruv.
'Tis all quiet on the eastern front.
Good good.
Well, you know what to do if something goes wrong.
translation: Bir sorun cikarsa ne yapacagini biliyorsun.

english: Aye, that I do bruv.
Holler like a bosun without a bottle.
That's it brother, and we'll come a running!
translation: Aynen öyle kardesim, biz de kosarak geliriz!

english: Well, I'm back. And he said no. Again.
translation: Geri döndüm. Ve yine hayir dedi.

english: Lemons? Both of them?
Lemons? What are you talking about?
Fragile! Do not bend!
I swear you get stranger every time.
translation: Yemin ederim her seferinde daha da gariplesiyorsun.

english: Ok, I'll ask again.
I'd better head off.
Now, how's this thing work again...?
Hello [player name]. I've got a message for you from Molly. She needs your help urgently. Will you assist her now?
translation: Merhaba Maceraci. Molly'den sana bir mesajim var. Acilen yardimina ihtiyaci var. Ona yardim edecek misin?

english: Sure, anything for Molly.
translation: Tabii, Molly icin her seyi yaparim.

english: Player is teleported to the Evil twin claw machine place
translation: Oyuncu, Evil twin claw machine yerine isinlanir.

english: Tell her to get stuffed.
Sorry, I don't have any messages for you.
Goodbye.
Message for you, [player name]!
Hello, [player name]?
Urgent message for you, [player name]?
Someone needs your help, [player name]!
Will you accept the message, [player name]?
Maybe later.
Sure, anything for Molly.
translation: Tabii, Molly icin her seyi yaparim.

english: Tell her to get stuffed.
Hi cat!
Miaooow!
Hello.
What are you doing?
I think I'll go hunting soon, there's a warehouse with some rats in it nearby.
translation: Sanirim yakinda avlanmaya gidecegim, yakinlarda farelerin oldugu bir depo var.

english: Happy hunting.
The cat is too sick to respond.
Hello [player name].
How are you feeling now?
Still a bit below purrrr. Thank you for fetching the medicine for me.
translation: Hala biraz kötü. Ilacimi getirdigin icin tesekkürler.

english: No problem, I hope you get better soon.
Good day, sister.
Greetings, [player name]. Can I help you with anything, today?
translation: Merhaba, Maceraci. Bugün sana yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: How can I train my prayer?
I think you should be teaching me a thing or two, shouldn't you?
translation: Bana bir iki sey ögretmen gerekmez mi?

english: Well, if you really want my advice...
The most common way to train prayer is by either burying bones, or offering them to the gods at some kind of an altar.
translation: Dua etmeyi ögrenmenin en yaygin yolu, kemikleri gömmek ya da bir tür sunakta tanrilara sunmaktir.

english: Lots of adventurers build such altars in their own homes, or there are a few frequent places of worship around the world.
translation: Bircok maceraci kendi evlerinde bu tür sunaklar insa eder ya da dünya capinda sikca ziyaret edilen birkac ibadet yeri vardir.

english: Different kinds of bones will help you to train faster. Generally speaking, the bigger they are and the more frightening a creature they come from, the better they are for it.
translation: Farkli türdeki kemikler daha hizli ögrenmene yardimci olur. Genel olarak, kemikler ne kadar büyükse ve hangi yaratiga aitse o kadar iyidir.

english: Is there anything else you would like to know?
translation: Baska bilmek istedigin bir sey var mi?

english: What is prayer useful for?
The gods look kindly upon their devout followers. There are all kinds of benefits they may provide, if you pray for them!
translation: Tanrilar, kendilerine sadik olan takipcilerine sefkatle bakar. Onlara dua edersen, sana her türlü fayda saglayabilirler!

english: Really? What kind of benefits?
They could help you in combat, help your wounds to heal more quickly, protect your belongings... There's a lot they can do for you!
translation: Savasta sana yardim edebilirler, yaralarinin daha hizli iyilesmesine yardimci olabilirler, esyalarini koruyabilirler... Senin icin yapabilecekleri cok sey var!

english: You can find out more by looking in your prayer book.
translation: Dua kitabina bakarak daha fazla bilgi edinebilirsin.

english: Wow! That sounds great.
You need to be careful that your prayers don't run out, though. You can get prayer potions to help you recharge, or you can pray at an altar whenever one's nearby.
translation: Ancak dualarinizin bitmemesine dikkat etmelisiniz. Yeniden sarj olmaniza yardimci olacak dua iksirleri alabilir veya yakinlarda bir sunak varsa orada dua edebilirsiniz.

english: No, thank you.
Very well. Saradomin be with you!
How can I train my prayer?
What is prayer useful for?
No, thank you.
Hello! Glad to see you're okay. I was worried you might have gone and got stuck down that hole.
translation: Merhaba! Iyi oldugunuza sevindim. O delige girip sikismis olabileceginden endiselenmistim.

english: No need to worry. I'm mostly quite capable when it comes to these kinds of things!
translation: Endiselenmenize gerek yok. Bu tür konularda genellikle oldukca yetenekliyimdir!

english: Good to hear!
Hello there. Did you see that dwarf by the big forge? I think he wanted to talk to you.
translation: Merhaba. Büyük demirhanenin yanindaki cüceyi gördün mü? Sanirim seninle konusmak istiyordu.

english: Hello there.
Hello! Look at this place. Isn't it amazing?
translation: Merhaba! Su yere bak. Harika degil mi?

english: It sure is! Not every day you find yourself in a lost city.
translation: Kesinlikle! Her gün kayip bir sehirde bulamazsin kendini.

english: So what can I do for you?
Does the name Lassar mean anything to you? It was an old fortress that once existed here, long before Camdozaal. I'm wondering if there might still be some traces left down here.
translation: Lassar adi size bir sey ifade ediyor mu? Camdozaal'dan cok önce burada var olan eski bir kaleydi. Burada hala bazi izler kalmis olabilir mi diye merak ediyorum.

english: A ruin within a ruin? How exciting! We have found the odd thing that doesn't seem to be dwarven in origin, but it's still early days for us here, so we haven't been able to learn much yet.
translation: Harabelerin icinde bir harabe mi? Ne heyecan verici! Cüce kökenli olmadigi anlasilan tuhaf bir sey bulduk, ama burada henüz cok yeni oldugumuz icin henüz fazla bir sey ögrenemedik.

english: One that was particularly interesting was this strange icon I found in the mine.
translation: Özellikle ilginc olani, madende buldugum bu garip simgeydi.

english: Could be a lot more to find over there, but I must admit, I haven't been back since... well...
translation: Orada bulunacak cok daha fazla sey olabilir, ama itiraf etmeliyim ki, o zamandan beri oraya geri dönmedim... sey...

english: Since what?
It's probably nothing, but there's this big sinkhole on the other side of the mine. I'm probably just being silly, but I'm sure I heard a voice coming from inside.
translation: Muhtemelen önemsiz bir sey, ama madenin diger tarafinda büyük bir cukur var. Muhtemelen aptalca davraniyorum, ama icinden bir ses geldigini duyduguma eminim.

english: Interesting... And if I wanted to go down this hole?
translation: Ilginc... Peki ya bu cukura inmek istersem?

english: Go down the hole?! You're far braver than I am! There's plenty of rocks around there. I'm sure you could tie a rope to one of them. You'd need a pretty long rope though. Here, you can use mine.
translation: Cukura inmek mi?! Sen benden cok daha cesursun! Orada cok sayida kaya var. Eminim birine ip baglayabilirsin. Ama oldukca uzun bir ipe ihtiyacin olacak. Al, benimkini kullanabilirsin.

english: Thanks!
Hi.
Hello! What can I do for you today?
translation: Merhaba! Bugün sizin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: Who are you?
I'm Preswylwyr.
It's nice to meet you Preswylwyr, I'm [player name].
translation: Tanistigimiza memnun oldum Preswylwyr, ben Maceraci.

english: And it's great to meet you, [player name].
translation: Ben de tanistigimiza memnun oldum Maceraci.

english: What do you do here?
I'm Gwerin's partner, he runs the mill while it's my job to use up all the flour he produces.
translation: Gwerin'in ortagiyim, o degirmeni isletiyor, benim isim ise onun ürettigi unu tüketmek.

english: You bake? So that's what the wonderful smell is.
translation: Firincilik mi yapiyorsun? Demek harika koku buradan geliyor.

english: Ha ha! Would you care for some bread? There should be some on the table.
translation: Ha ha! Biraz ekmek ister misin? Masada biraz olmali.

english: Really? That's very nice of you, thanks!
No problem! Was there anything else you wanted?
translation: Sorun degil! Baska bir sey ister misin?

english: Bye!
Farewell, adventurer.
Who are you?
What do you do here?
Bye!
Hello.
Greetings. May the blessings of Icthlarin rest on your tired shoulders and set you at ease during these strange times.
translation: Selamlar. Icthlarin'in kutsamalari yorgun omuzlarina konup bu garip zamanlarda sana huzur versin.

english: Good day, adventurer.
What do you know about the necropolis to the south?
Not too much. It's been abandoned for a long time. In fact, you couldn't even access most of it until fairly recently.
translation: Fazla bir sey bilmiyorum. Uzun zamandir terk edilmis durumda. Aslinda, yakin zamana kadar coguna erismek bile mümkün degildi.

english: How come?
It was mostly buried under the sand until a storm came in from the south.
translation: Güneyden bir firtina gelene kadar cogu kismi kum altinda gömülüydü.

english: Interesting... Do you know if many people have been there since it was uncovered?
translation: Ilginc... Aciga ciktigindan beri oraya cok kisi gitti mi?

english: Not as many as you'd think. There's a lot of superstition about the place. People say that even the sand is marked by death.
translation: Düsündügün kadar cok degil. O yerle ilgili bircok batil inanc var. Insanlar kumun bile ölümle isaretlendigini söylüyor.

english: You sound like you don't believe them.
Not really. The sand is probably that colour due to the amount of salt in it. Still, if it keeps people from robbing the dead, that's no bad thing.
translation: Pek sayilmaz. Kumun rengi muhtemelen icindeki tuz miktarindan kaynaklaniyor. Yine de, bu sayede insanlar ölüleri soymazlarsa, bu kötü bir sey degildir.

english: I see. Thanks for the information.
Any time, adventurer.
Good day.
Hey, hey, hey! What in the name of sweet suffering Icthlarin are you doing?
translation: Hey, hey, hey! Tatli aci ceken Icthlarin adina, ne yapiyorsun sen?

english: I thought this acne potion might clear up your spots.
translation: Bu sivilce ilaci sivilcelerini temizleyebilir diye düsündüm.

english: All that you'll achieve by pouring that potion on me is to ruin my lovely robes.
translation: O iksiri üzerime dökerek tek basaracagin sey, güzel cüppemi mahvetmek olacak.

english: Sorry, I was just trying to help.
What do you know about the necropolis to the south?
Good day.
Hello there.
It's going to take a lot of work to fix the damage done to this city.
translation: Bu sehre verilen zarari düzeltmek cok zaman alacak.

english: You left the shrine. Did Zulrah reject your sacrifice?
translation: Tapinagi terk ettin. Zulrah kurbanini reddetti mi?

english: I killed Zulrah.
Is that what you think? Board the boat again, and I am sure you will find Zulrah has overcome whatever pitiful attacks you used against him.
translation: Öyle mi düsünüyorsun? Tekneye tekrar bin, eminim Zulrah'in senin ona karsi yaptigin zavalli saldirilari kolayca atlattigini göreceksin.

english: Remind me how this ritual works.
translation: Bu ritüelin nasil isledigini hatirlat bana.

english: Once I have brought you to the shrine, I will leave you there as an offering to Zulrah. You cannot use the boat to return.
translation: Seni tapinaga götürdügümde, seni Zulrah'a kurban olarak orada birakacagim. Tekneyle geri dönemezsin.

english: You can use your magical powers to flee from Zulrah's grasp, though that would defeat the point of the sacrifice, and you'll have to try again.
translation: Zulrah'in elinden kacmak icin sihirli güclerini kullanabilirsin, ancak bu kurbanin anlamini yitirir ve tekrar denemen gerekir.

english: When Zulrah inevitably kills you, I may be able to retrieve your dropped possessions. If so, I will hold them here.
translation: Zulrah seni kacinilmaz olarak öldürdügünde, düsürdügün esyalarini geri alabilirim. Öyle olursa, onlari burada saklayacagim.

english: Now board the boat and prepare to be sacrificed.
translation: Simdi gemiye bin ve kurban edilmeye hazirlan.

english: I'm off.
Leave me, human, I have a sacrifice to prepare. If you wish for information, go and see the High Priestess.
translation: Beni rahat birak, insan, bir kurban hazirlamam gerekiyor. Bilgi istiyorsan, gidip Basrahibe'yi gör.

english: The sacrificial boat is not for you! Begone, and do not meddle in our sacred rites.
translation: Kurban teknesi senin icin degil! Git buradan ve kutsal ayinlerimize karisma.

english: But I really want to ride the boat!
translation: Ama ben gercekten o tekneye binmek istiyorum!

english: You display complete ignorance of our sacred rites. Perhaps the High Priestess will consent to enlighten you.
translation: Kutsal ayinlerimiz hakkinda hicbir sey bilmiyorsun. Belki Basrahibe seni aydinlatmayi kabul eder.

english: The High Priestess said I could offer myself as a sacrifice to Zulrah.
translation: Basrahibe, kendimi Zulrah'a kurban olarak sunabilecegimi söyledi.

english: It is rare for a traveller to make such an offer! Very well, I shall explain the ritual to you...
translation: Bir gezginin böyle bir teklifte bulunmasi nadirdir! Pekala, sana töreni aciklayayim...

english: Are you ready to face Zulrah?
Yes, let's go.
I shall now transport you to Zulrah's shrine and offer your life on behalf of our tribe.
translation: Simdi seni Zulrah'in tapinagina götürecegim ve kabilemiz adina hayatini sunacagim.

english: No, I've changed my mind.
I've been there, but I left.
Well, board the boat and let me take you there again quickly, before Zulrah becomes impatient!
translation: Peki, tekneye bin ve Zulrah sabirsizlanmadan seni tekrar oraya götüreyim!

english: I'm afraid I don't have anything for you to collect. If I had any of your items, but you died before collecting them from me, I'd lose them.
translation: Korkarim senin icin toplayabilecegim bir sey yok. Eger senin esyalarin bende olsaydi ama sen onlari almadan önce ölseydin, onlari kaybederdim.

english: You left some stuff at Zulrah's shrine when you left earlier. I've returned it to you now.
translation: Daha önce ayrilirken Zulrah'in tapinaginda bazi esyalar birakmistin. Simdi sana geri verdim.

english: You left some stuff at Zulrah's shrine when you left earlier. Clear some more inventory space and I'll give you the rest.
translation: Daha önce ayrilirken Zulrah'in tapinaginda bazi esyalar birakmissin. Envanterinde biraz yer ac, geri kalanini da vereyim.

english: You left some stuff at Zulrah's shrine when you left earlier. Clear some inventory space and I'll give it back.
translation: Daha önce ayrilirken Zulrah'in tapinaginda bazi esyalar birakmissin. Envanterinde biraz yer ac, geri vereyim.

english: You left some stuff at Zulrah's shrine when you left earlier. You'd better deal with it before returning.
translation: Daha önce ayrilirken Zulrah'in tapinaginda bazi esyalar birakmissin. Dönmeden önce halletsen iyi olur.

english: I killed Zulrah.
Remind me how this ritual works.
translation: Bu ritüelin nasil yapildigini hatirlatir misin?

english: I'm off.
But I really want to ride the boat!
translation: Ama ben gercekten tekneye binmek istiyorum!

english: Yes, let's go.
No, I've changed my mind.
I've been there, but I left.
Yes.
No.

Hello. Interested in learning about some potions?
translation: Merhaba. Bazi iksirler hakkinda bilgi edinmek ister misin?

english: Hello. Need anything?
translation: Merhaba. Bir seye ihtiyacin var mi?

english: Let's trade.
What kind of potions?
Here's one I think you'll like. I found this recipe whilst exploring some old frozen ruins.
translation: Iste hosuna gidecegini düsündügüm bir tane. Bu tarifi eski donmus kalintilari kesfederken buldum.

english: The herbalist teaches you how to make Super antifire potions.
translation: Bitki uzmani sana Süper Ates Önleyici Iksir yapmayi ögretir.

english: Thanks!
Don't mention it. Would you like to buy any herblore supplies?
translation: Önemli degil. Bitki bilimi malzemeleri satin almak ister misin?

english: I'm good, thanks.
Here, solve this.
Primula hands you a [light/puzzle] box!
That doesn't look solved to me.
Well done [player name]. Here you go.
You've obtained a [new clue/casket]!
Let's trade.

Yes please.
I'm good, thanks.

translation: Bir prensin sadece iki kafasi olmasi gerekmez mi?

english: Why is that?
Well, a standard Black dragon has one, the King has three so inbetweenmust have two?
translation: Standart bir Kara ejderhanin bir kafasi var, Kralin ise üc kafasi var, o halde ikisinin arasinda iki kafasi olmali, degil mi?

english: You're overthinking this.
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
I hear you made peace between our kingdom and Etceteria once more. Well done, [Fremennik name].
translation: Kralligimiz ile Etceteria arasinda bir kez daha baris sagladigini duydum. Aferin, Dokrak.

english: I hear you made peace between our kingdom and Etceteria once more. Well done, dear friend.
translation: Kralligimiz ile Etceteria arasinda bir kez daha baris sagladigini duydum. Aferin, sevgili dostum.

english: Prince Brand, will you marry me?
Oh, my darling, you've made me the happiest person alive.
translation: Oh, sevgilim, beni dünyanin en mutlu insani yaptin.

english: Is that a yes?
Yes! We'll have to put off the actual ceremony until we can find a priest, but I will tell my father I have agreed to marry you.
translation: Evet! Rahip bulana kadar dügünü ertelemek zorunda kalacagiz, ama babama seninle evlenmeyi kabul ettigimi söyleyecegim.

english: I hear you made peace between our kingdom and Etceteria once more. Well done, darling.
translation: Kralligimiz ile Etceteria arasinda bir kez daha baris sagladigini duydum. Aferin, sevgilim.

english: Have you found a priest for our marriage yet?
translation: Evliligimiz icin bir rahip buldun mu?

english: I'm afraid not, darling. I don't think there is one to be had on these islands for love nor money...
translation: Maalesef hayir, sevgilim. Bu adalarda ne para ne de ask icin bulunabilecek bir rahip oldugunu sanmiyorum...

english: Do not fear, though; I shall call for you as soon as one is found.
translation: Ama korkma, bulur bulmaz seni arayacagim.

english: I'm having second thoughts about the wedding. This marriage would change things, with an increase in responsibilities and duties you were keen to avoid.
translation: Dügün hakkinda ikinci kez düsünüyorum. Bu evlilik, kacinmak istedigin sorumluluk ve görevlerin artmasiyla birlikte bazi seyleri degistirecektir.

english: While I want to support the kingdom, I don't want that to end up impacting your life negatively. Maybe it's too soon to make this kind of decision.
translation: Kralligi desteklemek istiyorum ama bunun senin hayatini olumsuz etkilemesini istemiyorum. Belki de böyle bir karar vermek icin henüz cok erken.

english: You're right, I am not interested in more responsibilities. I would have less time for poetry! Is that your final decision?
translation: Haklisin, daha fazla sorumluluk almak istemiyorum. Siir yazmak icin daha az zamanim kalir! Bu kesin kararin mi?

english: Yes, I think it's for the best.
I think you'll make a great Thane for our kingdom.
translation: Bence kralligimiz icin harika bir Thane olacaksin.

english: Maybe not. It it hard, for I am so very fond of you. Let's leave it as it is for now and see what the future holds.
translation: Belki de olmaz. Bu cok zor, cünkü seni cok seviyorum. Simdilik oldugu gibi birakalim ve gelecek ne getirecek görelim.

english: Agreed.
No thank you, [Fremennik name].
You've already given me some, but thank you.
You've already given me one, but thank you.
You've already given me one, remember?
translation: Bana zaten bir tane verdin, hatirladin mi?

english: No thank you, [darling/dear friend].

Hey, Itzla. How are things going?
Father should make a full recovery, though given that his would-be killers are still out there, that's not anywhere near as much comfort as it should be.
translation: Babam tamamen iyilesecek gibi görünüyor, ancak onu öldürmek isteyenler hâlâ disarida oldugu icin bu durum pek de rahatlatici degil.

english: I've sent word to mother about what happened here, but I've not heard back yet. However, in the meantime, I've devised a little plan for how we might go about dealing with our cultist problem.
translation: Anneme burada olanlari haber verdim, ama henüz cevap almadim. Ancak bu arada, tarikatci sorunumuzu nasil cözecegimize dair kücük bir plan yaptim.

english: What is it?
We're going to go... undercover!
Undercover? What do you mean?
translation: Gizli göreve mi? Ne demek istiyorsun?

english: The Twilight Emissaries of course! If they are the ones responsible for what is now two attempts on my father's life, their deaths will be swift and brutal.
translation: Tabii ki Alacakaranlik Elcileri! Eger babamin hayatina iki kez suikast düzenleyenler onlarsa, ölümleri hizli ve acimasiz olacak.

english: However, given we're somewhat civilised people, we can't exactly start executing cultists without definitive proof. How do we get that? By joining up of course!
translation: Ancak, bizler medeni insanlar oldugumuz icin, kesin kanit olmadan tarikatcilari infaz edemeyiz. Peki bu kaniti nasil elde edecegiz? Tabii ki onlara katilarak!

english: You want us to join the cult?
Exactly! Quite a clever plan, if I do say so myself.
translation: Aynen öyle! Kendim söylemek gerekirse, oldukca akillica bir plan.

english: Right...
Prepare for the arrival of Queen Zyanyi Arkan!
Ah... This should be fun.
I'd love to hear it, but I have some things I need to do first.
translation: Bunu duymak isterdim, ama önce yapmam gereken bazi isler var.

english: Very well. I'll be here when you're ready.
Yes.
No.
Hey, Itzla.
How are you doing?
Well, now that the local cult of murderers is no longer trying to kill me or my father, I'd say things are looking up.
translation: Sey, artik yerel katil tarikati beni ya da babami öldürmeye çalismadigina göre, isler yoluna giriyor diyebilirim.

english: I'm also finding I've got a bit more time on my hands now that things are all sorted. I suggested to mother I spend that time in the Colosseum. I don't know if she was totally convinced.
translation: Ayrica, her sey yoluna girdigine göre artik biraz daha bos zamanim oldugunu fark ettim. Anneme bu zamani Kolezyum'da geçirmeyi önerdim. Tamamen ikna oldu mu bilmiyorum.

english: I can't imagine why...
Anyway, I won't keep you, iknami. I'm sure you've got plenty more adventures to go on. Timoiva, my friend.
translation: Neyse, seni alikoymayacagim iknami. Eminim daha birçok maceran vardir. Timoiva, dostum.

english: You don't happen to have another sword do you?
translation: Baska bir kilicin yok, degil mi?

english: I'm afraid not, iknami. You'll have to go and find where you left the one I gave you. I'm sure you won't have lost it. After it, it's a one of a kind family heirloom.
translation: Korkarim yok, iknami. Sana verdigim kilici biraktigin yeri bulman gerekecek. Eminim kaybetmemissindir. Sonuçta, o essiz bir aile yadigari.

english: Right... yes... I'll go see if I can find it.
Well, iknami, as luck would have it, someone came along trying to sell a sword that perfectly matches the one I gave you. He claimed he just found it on the ground!
translation: Sans eseri, iknami, sana verdigim kilica tipatip uyan bir kiliç satmaya çalisan biri geldi. Onu yerde buldugunu iddia etti!

english: How odd...
Indeed. I'm sure it can't be the same one. After all, that was a one of a kind family heirloom, so you'd definitely have taken good care of it.
translation: Gerçekten. Ayni kiliç olamaz. Sonuçta, o essiz bir aile yadigariydi, sen de ona çok iyi bakmissindir.

english: Yeah... definitely...
Anyway, I had to pay 75,000 coins to buy this one, so if you want it, that's how much I'll have to charge you.
translation: Her neyse, bunu almak için 75.000 altin ödemek zorunda kaldim, yani istersen sana da bu kadarini ödemen gerekecek.

english: Ah, I don't have enough. I'll be back shortly.
translation: Ah, yeterince param yok. Birazdan dönerim.

english: I'd better get going.
Timoiva, my friend.

english: I'm having second thoughts about the wedding. This marriage would change things, with an increase in responsibilities and duties that would overshadow the activities you like.

english: While I want to support you and the kingdom, I don't want that to end up impacting your life negatively. Maybe it's too soon to make this kind of decision.

english: My darling, that is very thoughtful of you and you make a convincing point. Are you... absolutely sure?
translation: Sevgilim, cok düsüncelisin ve ikna edici bir noktaya degindin. Emin misin?

english: Yes, I think it's for the best.
I think you'll make a great Thane for our kingdom.
