Captured?
Yes, Evil Bob captured me and stuck me in this prison.
translation: Evet, Evil Bob beni yakaladi ve bu hapishaneye atti.

english: How do I get out of here? I can't be held captive by a cat!
translation: Buradan nasil cikabilirim? Bir kedi tarafindan esir tutulmam!

english: Some of these balloon animals have keys in them, and if you pull the big lever it tells you which shape animal contains the correct key, but I can never find it.
translation: Bu balon hayvanlarin bazilarinin icinde anahtar var ve büyük kolu cektiginde hangi sekilli hayvanin dogru anahtari icerdigini söylüyor, ama ben hic bulamiyorum.

english: You need to pull the lever to find out which shape animal contains the key, then pop that sort of animal to get the key.
translation: Hangi sekilli hayvanin anahtari icerdigini ögrenmek icin kolu cekmelisin, sonra o tür hayvani patlatarak anahtari almalisin.

english: Bring me any keys you get and I'll try them on the doors.
translation: Buldugun anahtarlari bana getir, kapilarda deneyeyim.

english: Okay.
Oh. Well I guess you can leave but I'll still be stuck here.
translation: Oh. Sanirim sen gidebilirsin ama ben hala burada sikisip kalacagim.

english: You leave the prison.
The player leaves the prison through the east hallway.
You're meant to pull the lever to find out which sort of animal to pop!
translation: Hangi hayvani patlatacagini ögrenmek icin kolu cekmen gerekiyor!

english: What is this place?
Don't you remember? This is ScapeRune's prison. Evil Bob caught you and brought you here.
translation: Hatirlamiyor musun? Burasi ScapeRune'un hapishanesi. Evil Bob seni yakaladi ve buraya getirdi.

english: What gives him the right to lock me up? I demand to see a lawyer! I know my rights!
translation: Beni hapsetmeye hakki nereden geliyor? Avukat görmek istiyorum! Haklarimi biliyorum!

english: Evil Bob doesn't care about people's rights. He's cruel and utterly merciless. He's a cat.
translation: Evil Bob insanlarin haklarini umursamaz. O acimasiz ve merhametsizdir. O bir kedidir.

english: No thanks, I don't want that just now.
That's right, pull it. Then remember what kind of animal shape you see. That's the animal that contains the right key.
translation: Dogru, cek onu. Sonra gördügün hayvanin seklini hatirla. Dogru anahtari iceren hayvan odur.

english: Great, now you've got a key! Bring it to me so I can try it on the doors.
translation: Harika, artik bir anahtarin var! Bana getir de kapilarda deneyim.

english: Ooh, thanks! I'll see if it's the right one...
translation: Ooh, tesekkürler! Dogru anahtar mi bakayim...

english: Aww, that was the wrong key! You must have popped the wrong sort of animal. Try the big lever again - it'll tell you which animal to pop.
translation: Aww, yanlis anahtardi! Yanlis hayvani secmis olmalisin. Büyük kolu tekrar dene, hangi hayvani secmen gerektigini söyleyecektir.

english: Hooray, you got the right one! Now pull the lever again and let's get the next portal unlocked!
translation: Yasasin, dogru anahtari buldun! Simdi kolu tekrar cek ve bir sonraki kapiyi acalim!

english: You did it, you got all the keys right! Thank you! You're my friend FOREVER!
translation: Basardin, tüm anahtarlari dogru buldun! Tesekkürler! Sen benim sonsuza kadar arkadasimsin!

english: Let's get out of here before that cat notices.
Oi! we'll be using the exit that's over here.
Oi! No dropping stuff in the exit! Chuck it somewhere else!
translation: Hey! Cikisa bir seyler atma! Baska bir yere at!

english: You quickly escape the prison with Pete.
translation: Pete ile birlikte hizla hapishaneden kacarsiniz.

english: Thanks a lot for your help! Here, have a present:
translation: Yardimin icin cok tesekkürler! Al, sana bir hediye:

english: Thanks! See you around!
Okay.
But I want to leave now.
Yes.
No.
What is this place?
How do I get out of here?
Hello there!
How are you doing in there?
Oh I'm great. Lord Jovkai takes good care of us.
translation: Oh, ben cok iyiyim. Lord Jovkai bize cok iyi bakiyor.

english: So you don't want to escape?
Why would I want to do that? I'm very happy as I am.
translation: Neden kacmak isteyeyim ki? Ben böyle cok mutluyum.

english: If you say so.
Hi, soldier.
Why, hello there!
You seem like a jolly chap.
And why not? 'Tis a greeeaat day!
translation: Neden olmasin? Bugün harika bir gün!

english: Well, I suppose it is.
Hi.
Shhh. Don't talk to me.
What? Why?
If I'm seen slacking off by talking to you, I'll be in deep trouble!
translation: Seninle konusurken tembellik ettigim görülürse basim büyük belaya girer!

english: Oh... Sorry.
Hi there.
Don't suppose you've seen a battleaxe around here?
translation: Buralarda bir savas baltasi görmedin mi?

english: A battleaxe? Nope, afraid not.
The captain is going to kill me if he finds out I've lost my weapon.
translation: Silahimi kaybettigimi ögrenirse kaptan beni öldürür.

english: Hello. So you're just a private?
translation: Merhaba. Sen sadece bir er misin?

english: Show some respect! It's more than you'll achieve.
translation: Biraz saygi göster! Seninkinden daha fazlasini elde edemezsin.

english: I beg to differ. I'm in perfect shape!
translation: Ayni fikirde degilim. Ben mükemmel durumdayim!

english: Prove it!
How?
Give me five star-jumps!
The player begins to do star-jumps
Five sit-ups.
The player begins to do sit-ups
Run on the spot!
The player begins to run in place
Okay. Maybe you have what it takes. Best you speak with the captain.
translation: Tamam. Belki de gerekli niteliklere sahipsin. En iyisi kaptanla konus.

english: Welcome to the pet insurance bureau. How can I help you?
translation: Evcil hayvan sigorta bürosuna hos geldin. Nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: Can you tell me about pets and pet insurance?
translation: Evcil hayvanlar ve evcil hayvan sigortasi hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Certainly! You can find pets while out on your adventures. They're very rare, but you may be lucky enough to find one.
translation: Elbette! Maceralarinda evcil hayvanlar bulabilirsin. Cok nadirdirler, ama sansliysan bir tane bulabilirsin.

english: You have a chance to find them when defeating bosses, playing minigames, and taking part in skilling activities.
translation: Bosslari yenerek, mini oyunlar oynayarak ve beceri etkinliklerine katilarak onlari bulma sansin var.

english: If you do find one, they will be automatically insured against loss, for free!
translation: Eger bir tane bulursan, kaybolma ihtimaline karsi otomatik olarak ücretsiz sigortalanirlar!

english: If you then somehow lose your pet, you can reclaim it here for one reclaim token. Reclaim tokens cost 1,000,000 coins each.
translation: Eger evcil hayvaninizi bir sekilde kaybederseniz, burada bir geri alma jetonu karsiliginda geri alabilirsiniz. Geri alma jetonlarinin her biri 1.000.000 jeton degerindedir.

english: I see, thank you.
I've lost a pet. Have you got it?
translation: Bir evcil hayvanimi kaybettim. Sizde mi?

english: If you've lost your pet, it will be reclaimable here!
translation: Eger evcil hayvaninizi kaybettiyseniz, burada geri alabilirsiniz!

english: Let's have a look...
I have a pet that I'd like to insure.
translation: Sigortalatmak istedigim bir evcil hayvanim var.

english: You don't need to pay to insure your pet with me. They're automatically insured for free as soon as you find them!
translation: Evcil hayvaninizi sigortalatmak icin bana ödeme yapmaniz gerekmez. Onlari buldugunuz anda otomatik olarak ücretsiz olarak sigortalanirlar!

english: If you lose a pet somehow, you can come here and reclaim them for one reclaim token. Reclaims tokens cost 1,000,000 coins each.
translation: Evcil hayvaninizi bir sekilde kaybederseniz, buraya gelip bir geri alma jetonu karsiliginda geri alabilirsiniz. Geri alma jetonlarinin her biri 1.000.000 jeton degerindedir.

english: What pets have I insured?
Every pet you've ever found is automatically insured here!
translation: Buldugunuz her evcil hayvan burada otomatik olarak sigortalanir!

english: Here, take a look...
Maybe another time.
This is a pet insurance bureau. I'm not insuring that.
translation: Burasi bir evcil hayvan sigorta bürosu. Onu sigortalamiyorum.

english: Can you tell me about pets and pet insurance?
translation: Evcil hayvanlar ve evcil hayvan sigortasi hakkinda bilgi verebilir misiniz?

english: I've lost a pet. Have you got it?
translation: Bir evcil hayvanimi kaybettim. Onu buldunuz mu?

english: I have a pet that I'd like to insure.
translation: Sigortalatmak istedigim bir evcil hayvanim var.

english: What pets have I insured?
Maybe another time.
If you keep waving money at me, I might take it!
I didn't realise gnomes were interested in magic.
Gnomes are interested in everything, [lad/lass].
Of course.
We have a saying, 'Curiosity killed the cat'. But cats aren't clever enough to understand what they find. Gnomes are.
translation: “Merak kediyi öldürdü” diye bir deyimimiz var. Ama kediler bulduklarini anlayacak kadar zeki degiller. Cüceler ise zekidir.

english: Hey! Some of my best friends are cats!
translation: Hey! En iyi arkadaslarimdan bazilari kedidir!

english: I think that says more about you than cats.
translation: Bence bu kedilerden cok senin hakkinda bir sey söylüyor.

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: Hazir yemekler maalesef ise yaramaz. Aluft Aloft'un müsterileri icin sadece el yapimi Cüce Mutfagi yeterince iyidir.

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Professor Imblewyn
Hmmm, I wonder... Oh. My order. Thank you - mind you don't get any food or drink on the books.
translation: Hmmm, acaba... Oh. Siparisim. Tesekkürler - kitaplarin üzerine yiyecek veya icecek dökmemeye dikkat et.

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: Bunu bana ulastirmak icin uzun bir yol kat etmis olmalisin. Iste sana bahsis olarak kücük bir sey.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.'dan ücretsiz teslimat jetonunuzu almayi unutmayin.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: Teslimatiniz cok gec! Aluft jnr.'a geri dönüp baska bir siparis alin. Artik ihtiyaciniz olmadigi icin teslimat kutunuzu atiyorsunuz.

english: Fascinating, fascinating. It's remarkable what these young dwarves have managed to create. Oh, hello young .
translation: Büyüleyici, büyüleyici. Bu genc cücelerin basardiklari sey gercekten olaganüstü. Merhaba genc .

english: Hello, what's a gnome like you doing in a place like this?
translation: Merhaba, senin gibi bir cüce böyle bir yerde ne ariyor?

english: Ah, well I have been sent by King to talk with the dwarves here and find out more about their recent advances in technology.
translation: Kral tarafindan buradaki cücelerle konusmak ve son teknolojik gelismeler hakkinda daha fazla bilgi edinmek icin gönderildim.

english: Found anything interesting?
The rideable carts are a very handy way to get to mining sites, and the Blast Furnace is a magnificent beast of a machine.
translation: Binilebilir arabalar maden sahalarina ulasmak icin cok kullanisli ve yüksek firin muhtesem bir makine.

english: I'll have a look, thanks.
You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food item] to Professor Manglethorp.
Just what I need. Dwarven cuisine is a bit ... solid for my tastes.
translation: Tam da ihtiyacim olan sey. Cüce mutfagi benim zevkime göre biraz... agir.

english: Here, take these Grand Seed pods. Very useful in emergencies!
translation: Al, bu Büyük Tohum kabuklarini al. Acil durumlarda cok kullanislidir!

english: Here have this, I traded for it with some of the dwarves.
You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: Bunu bana getirmek icin uzun bir yol kat etmis olmalisin. Iste bahsis olarak kücük bir sey.

english: You are given [a/some] [reward item(s)] as a tip.
translation: Bahsis olarak bazi ödül ögesi verilir.

english: Fascinating, fascinating. It's remarkable what these young dwarves have managed to create. Oh, hello young [man/woman].
Be careful in here, there's lots of dangerous equipment.
translation: Burada dikkatli ol, cok sayida tehlikeli ekipman var.

english: What does this machine do?
Nothing at the moment... It's broken. It's meant to be a transmutation machine.
translation: Su anda hicbir seye... Bozuk. Aslinda bir dönüsüm makinesi olmasi gerekiyordu.

english: It has also spent time as a time travel machine, and a dramatic lightning generator, and a thing for generating monsters.
translation: Ayni zamanda zaman makinesi, dramatik bir yildirim jeneratörü ve canavarlar üretmek icin kullanilan bir sey olarak da kullanildi.

english: Is this your house?
No, I'm just one of the tenants. It belongs to the count who lives in the basement.
translation: Hayir, ben sadece kiracilardan biriyim. Burasi bodrumda yasayan kontun evi.

english: I'm looking for a guy called Ernest.
Ah Ernest, top notch bloke. He's helping me with my experiments.
translation: Ah Ernest, birinci sinif bir adam. Deneylerimde bana yardim ediyor.

english: So you know where he is then?
translation: O zaman nerede oldugunu biliyor musun?

english: He's that chicken over there.
Ernest is a chicken...? Are you sure?
Oh, he isn't normally a chicken, or at least he wasn't until he helped me test my pouletmorph machine.
translation: Oh, normalde tavuk degil, en azindan benim pouletmorph makinemizi test etmeme yardim edene kadar degildi.

english: It was originally going to be called a transmutation machine. But after testing pouletmorph seems more appropriate.
translation: Aslinda baslangicta transmutasyon makinesi olarak adlandirilacakti. Ama testlerden sonra pouletmorph daha uygun göründü.

english: I'm glad Veronica didn't actually get engaged to a chicken.
Who's Veronica?
Ernest's fiancee. She probably doesn't want to marry a chicken.
translation: Ernest'in nisanlisi. Muhtemelen bir tavukla evlenmek istemez.

english: Ooh I dunno. She could have free eggs for breakfast.
I think you'd better change him back.
Umm... It's not so easy...
My machine is broken, and the house gremlins have run off with some vital bits.
translation: Makinem bozuldu ve evdeki gremlinler bazi önemli parcalari caldilar.

english: Well I can look for them.
That would be a help. They'll be somewhere in the manor house or its grounds, the gremlins never get further than the entrance gate.
translation: Bu cok yardimci olur. Malikanenin icinde veya bahcesinde bir yerlerde olmalilar, gremlinler giris kapisindan öteye gecmezler.

english: I'm missing the pressure gauge and a rubber tube. They've also taken my oil can, which I'm going to need to get this thing started again.
translation: Basinc göstergesi ve lastik hortum kayip. Ayrica, bu seyi tekrar calistirmak icin ihtiyacim olan yag tenekesini de almislar.

english: Change him back this instant!
Have you found anything yet?
I'm afraid I don't have any of them yet!
I need a rubber tube, a pressure gauge and a can of oil. Then your friend can stop being a chicken.
translation: Lastik hortum, basinc göstergesi ve yag tenekesi lazim. O zaman arkadasin tavuk olmaktan kurtulabilir.

english: I've only got the rubber tube so far.
translation: Su ana kadar sadece lastik hortumu buldum.

english: It's a good start, but I'll need my pressure gauge and oil can too.
translation: Iyi bir baslangic, ama basinc göstergesi ve yag tenekesi de lazim.

english: Ok, I'll go and look for them.
I've only got the pressure gauge so far.
translation: Su ana kadar sadece basinc ölcer buldum.

english: It's a good start, but I'll need my oil can and rubber tube too.
translation: Iyi bir baslangic, ama yag tenekesi ve lastik tüp de lazim.

english: I've only got the oil can so far.
translation: Su ana kadar sadece yag tenekesi buldum.

english: It's a good start, but I'll need my pressure gauge and rubber tube too.
translation: Iyi bir baslangic, ama basinc ölcer ve lastik tüp de lazim.

english: I've got the rubber tube and the pressure gauge.
translation: Lastik tüp ve basinc ölcer buldum.

english: That's good, but I still need my oil can.
translation: Güzel, ama hala yag tenekesi lazim.

english: Ok, I'll go and look for it.
I've got the oil can and the rubber tube.
translation: Yag kabini ve lastik hortumu aldim.

english: That's good, but I still need my pressure gauge.
translation: Bu iyi, ama hala basinc ölcere ihtiyacim var.

english: I've got the oil can and the pressure gauge.
translation: Yag kabini ve basinc ölceri aldim.

english: That's good, but I still need my rubber tube.
translation: Bu iyi, ama hala lastik hortuma ihtiyacim var.

english: I have everything!
Give 'em here then.
You give the rubber tube, a pressure gauge, and a can of oil to the professor.
translation: Profesöre lastik hortumu, basinc ölceri ve bir kutu yagi ver.

english: Oddenstein starts up the machine.
The machine hums and shakes.
Machine pouletmorphs Ernest back to human form!
translation: Makine Ernest'i tekrar insan formuna dönüstürür!

english: What does the portal machine do?
Ah, an interesting question! I believe it should create a rift in the very fabric of space! Opening a portal to some, hitherto undiscovered plane that exists parallel to our own.
translation: Ah, ilginc bir soru! Sanirim uzayin dokusunda bir yarik yaratmali! Bizimkine paralel olarak var olan, simdiye kadar kesfedilmemis bir düzleme acilan bir portal.

english: Huh?
It's a teleport machine.
Errr, just before you go through there...
What's the problem?
That portal opens into a plane populated with some very shocking creatures. You should wear some kind of insulated armour before going there.
translation: O portal, cok sok edici yaratiklarin yasadigi bir düzleme aciliyor. Oraya gitmeden önce bir tür yalitimli zirh giymelisin.

english: Where can I get insulated armour from?
Well there were some pretty tough people here last week. Said they were Slayer Masters. They were planning on making some protective boots. You should speak to one of them.
translation: Gecen hafta burada oldukca sert insanlar vardi. Slayer Masters olduklarini söylediler. Koruyucu botlar yapmayi planliyorlardi. Onlardan biriyle konusmalisin.

english: Thanks, I'll do that.
No problem. See you later.
I don't want to run around after Slayer Masters, I'm going through.
translation: Avci Ustalarinin pesinden kosmak istemiyorum, gececegim.

english: Fair enough, just don't say I didn't warn you
Thanks, I think I'll stay here for a while then.
translation: Tesekkürler, o zaman bir süre burada kalacagim.

english: Thanks for the warning, but I'm not scared of any monster.
translation: Uyarin icin tesekkürler, ama ben canavarlardan korkmuyorum.

english: Ok. Just don't say I didn't warn you

[Player name] before you go through there I must warn you that there are flashing lights and strobe effects on the other side. If you are an epilepsy sufferer you must NOT enter! Do you still want to go through?
translation: Maceraci, oraya gecmeden önce seni uyarmaliyim, diger tarafta yanip sönen isiklar ve stroboskop efektleri var. Epilepsi hastasiysan iceri girmemelisin! Hala gecmek istiyor musun?

english: Yes I still want to go in.
All right. Good luck then.
Yes I want to go in and don't show me this message again.
translation: Evet, girmek istiyorum ve bu mesaji bir daha gösterme.

english: No, I dont want to go in.
That's a good decision, if you ask me.
translation: Bana sorarsan, bu iyi bir karar.

english: What does this machine do?
Is this your house?
I'm looking for a guy called Ernest.
I'm glad Veronica didn't actually get engaged to a chicken.
Change him back this instant!
What does the portal machine do?
Where can I get insulated armour from?
Thanks, I'll do that.
I don't want to run around after Slayer Masters, I'm going through.
translation: Slayer Masters'in pesinden kosmak istemiyorum, gececegim.

english: Thanks, I think I'll stay here for a while then.
translation: Tesekkürler, o zaman bir süre burada kalacagim.

english: Thanks for the warning, but I'm not scared of any monster.
translation: Uyarin icin tesekkürler, ama ben canavarlardan korkmuyorum.

english: Yes I still want to go in.
Yes I want to go in and don't show me this message again.
translation: Evet, girmek istiyorum ve bu mesaji bir daha gösterme.

english: No, I dont want to go in.
Do you live here too?
Oh no, I come from the Gnome Stronghold. I've been sent here by King Narnode to learn about human magics.
translation: Hayir, ben Gnome Stronghold'dan geliyorum. Kral Narnode tarafindan insan büyülerini ögrenmem icin buraya gönderildim.

english: So where's this Gnome Stronghold?
It's in the North West of the continent - a long way away. You should visit us there some time. The food's great, and the company's delightful.
translation: Kitanin kuzeybatisinda, cok uzaklarda. Bir ara bizi ziyaret etmelisin. Yemekler harika, arkadaslar da cok keyifli.

english: I'll try and make time for it. Sounds like a nice place.
translation: Zaman ayirmaya calisirim. Güzel bir yere benziyor.

english: Well, it's full of gnomes. How much nicer could it be?
translation: Gnome'larla dolu bir yer. Daha ne kadar güzel olabilir ki?

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: Hazir yemekler ise yaramaz korkarim. Aluft Aloft'un müsterileri icin sadece el yapimi Gnome mutfagi yeterince iyidir.

english: You hand over your delivery of [item] to Professor Onglewip
Ah, now that's a familiar smell. Thank you.
translation: Ah, bu tanidik bir koku. Tesekkürler.

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: Bunu bana getirmek icin uzun bir yol kat etmis olmalisin. Iste bahsis olarak kücük bir ek ödeme.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.'dan ücretsiz teslimat jetonunuzu almayi unutmayin.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: Teslimatiniz cok gec! Aluft jnr.'a geri dönüp baska bir siparis alin. Artik ihtiyaciniz olmadigi icin teslimat kutunuzu atiyorsunuz.

english: Git back ter work, ye young varmint! There's treasure in them walls, and it's not gonna mine itself while ye stand here yappin'.
translation: Ise geri dön, seni genc haydut! O duvarlarda hazine var ve sen burada gevezelik ederken kendi kendine cikmayacak.

english: How do I mine here?
Git ahold of yer pickaxe, find a vein of ore, and set to work. If ye got a bit of skill, ye'll have a pocket o' pay- dirt in no time.
translation: Kazmani al, maden damarini bul ve ise koyul. Biraz becerin varsa, kisa sürede bir cep dolusu altin tozu elde edersin.

english: I've built me a contraption to wash the pay-dirt. Just drop yer pay-dirt in the hopper, an' wait fer it at the other end.
translation: Altin tozunu yikamak icin bir alet yaptim. Altini hazneye at ve diger tarafta bekle.

english: I won't charge ye fer usin' my contraption, but ye'd better fix it yerself when it breaks. A good whack with a hammer usually settles it.
translation: Cihazimi kullanman icin senden para almayacagim, ama bozuldugunda kendin tamir etsen iyi olur. Genelde bir cekicle iyice vurmak sorunu cözer.

english: Now will ye be gettin' to work now, or are ye gonna keep yappin' like a doggone galoot?
translation: Simdi ise koyulacak misin, yoksa lanet olasi bir ahmak gibi gevezelik etmeye devam mi edeceksin?

english: Would you like to trade?
If ye've found yerself some golden nuggets in this 'ere mine, I'll do you a swap, yeah.
translation: Bu madende altin parcalari bulduysan, takas yapabiliriz, evet.

english: Tell me about yourself.
Why, I'm Percy. Prospector Percy, the roughest, toughest, gruffest miner in the land. I've been pannin' fer gold since I were a young-un, and here's where I've struck it lucky.
translation: Ben Percy. Madenci Percy, bu topraklardaki en sert, en dayanikli, en huysuz madenci. Gencligimden beri altin ariyorum ve iste burada sansim yaver gitti.

english: Excuse me, but what language are you speaking?
Don't ye give me any of yer lip, ye dern varmint! Young'uns these days got no respect.
translation: Bana laf atma, seni lanet olasi hasarat! Günümüz gencleri hic saygi duymuyor.

english: Do go on.
This here's the richest seam of ore I've found in all my days. After I built a contraption for washing the pay- dirt, the dwarves let me run things down here.
translation: Burasi, hayatim boyunca buldugum en zengin maden damari. Madeni yikamak icin bir alet yaptiktan sonra, cüceler burayi yönetmeme izin verdiler.

english: Now, have ye any more idjit questions, or are ye ready to do some real work?
translation: Simdi, baska aptalca sorularin var mi, yoksa gercek is yapmaya hazir misin?

english: You discovered this mine?
Is there anything else I can unlock here?
translation: Burada acabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: Let me have a think...
If ye've got level 57 Mining, ye could pay to use my restricted mine, up the ladder. 100 nuggets gives unlimited access.
translation: Madencilik seviyen 57 ise, merdivenin yukarisindaki kisitli madenimi kullanmak icin ödeme yapabilirsin. 100 külce ile sinirsiz erisim hakki kazanirsin.

english: How would ye like it if the sack were bigger? I'll let ye have more ore in there if ye pays me 200 nuggets.
translation: Cuval daha büyük olsa hosuna gider mi? Bana 200 nugget ödersen, cuvala daha fazla cevher koymana izin veririm.

english: I can give ye access to a special hopper in the restricted mine for 50 nuggets, but you'll need access to the restricted mine first.
translation: 50 nugget karsiliginda, kisitli madendeki özel bir hazneye erisim izni verebilirim, ama önce kisitli madene erisim izni alman gerekiyor.

english: I'd like to buy access to the restricted mine, please.
translation: Kisitli madene erisim izni almak istiyorum, lütfen.

english: Right, ye can go up there whenever ye likes. Just behave yerself, or my Ma will tan yer hide.
translation: Tamam, istediginiz zaman oraya cikabilirsiniz. Ama uslu durun, yoksa annem sizi dövür.

english: Ye'll need level 57 Mining first. An' don't think ye can fool me with yer potions and fancy stat-boosts. Get yer level up for real.
translation: Önce 57. seviye Madencilik seviyesine ulasmaniz gerekir. Ve iksirlerinizi ve süslü istatistik güclendirmelerinizle beni kandirabileceginizi sanmayin. Seviyenizi gercekten yükseltin.

english: That'll be 100 nuggets. If ye ain't got enough, ye'd better do some more mining - that's how ye gets stuff round here!
translation: 100 nugget olacak. Yeterli paran yoksa, biraz daha madencilik yapmalisin - buradaki her seyi bu sekilde elde edersin!

english: I'd like to get the bigger sack, please.
translation: Daha büyük cuvali almak istiyorum, lütfen.

english: That'll be 200 nuggets. If ye ain't got enough, ye'd better do some more mining - that's how ye gets stuff round here!
translation: 200 nugget olacak. Yeterli paran yoksa, biraz daha madencilik yapmalisin - buradaki her seyi bu sekilde elde edersin!

english: Ye can already climb the ladder to the restricted mine. But how would ye like it if the sack were bigger? I'll let ye have more ore in there if ye pays me 200 nuggets.
translation: Zaten kisitli madene merdivenle cikabilirsin. Ama cuval daha büyük olsa nasil olur? Bana 200 nugget ödersen icine daha fazla cevher koyarim.

english: I can give ye access to a special hopper in the restricted mine for 50 nuggets, it connects to the hopper down here.
translation: 50 nugget karsiliginda kisitli madendeki özel bir hazneye erisim izni verebilirim, bu hazne buradaki hazneye bagli.

english: Ye can now use that fancy new hopper in the restricted mine.
translation: Artik kisitli madende o sik yeni hazneyi kullanabilirsiniz.

english: Well, now, I think ye've got everything already. Ye can already go climb the ladder to the restricted mine, ye've got the bigger sack capacity too and ye have access to that restricted hopper.
translation: Sey, sanirim artik her seye sahipsiniz. Kisitli madene tirmanmak icin merdiveni kullanabilirsiniz, daha büyük cuval kapasitesine sahipsiniz ve kisitli hazneye erisiminiz var.

english: That'll be 50 nuggets. If ye ain't got enough, ye'd better do some more mining - that's how ye gets stuff round here!
translation: Bu 50 nugget eder. Yeterli paraniz yoksa, biraz daha madencilik yapmalisiniz - buradaki esyalari bu sekilde elde edersiniz!

english: Well, now, I think ye've got everything already. Ye can already go climb the ladder to the restricted mine, and ye've got the bigger sack capacity too.
translation: Simdi, sanirim her seye sahipsiniz. Artik kisitli madene giden merdiveni tirmanabilirsiniz ve daha büyük cuval kapasitesine de sahipsiniz.

english: I'll leave you alone.
Dern straight ye will.
Oi, git yerself out of that hole!It's not safe in there.
translation: Hey, o delikten cikin! Orasi güvenli degil.

english: You must complete the Medium Tier tasks from the Falador Achievement Diary before Percy will let you use that tunnel.
translation: Percy o tüneli kullanmana izin vermeden önce Falador Basari Günlügü'ndeki Orta Seviye görevleri tamamlamalisin.

english: We got us a jammed wheel!
Ye'd better fix that wheel!
translation: O tekerlegi tamir etsen iyi olur!

english: Git yer hammer an' fix that wheel!
translation: Cekicini al ve o tekerlegi tamir et!

english: That water ain't flowing!
Both them wheels be jammed!
Git yer hammer an' fix them wheels!
translation: Cekicini al ve o tekerlekleri tamir et!

english: How do I mine here?
Would you like to trade?
Tell me about yourself.
Excuse me, but what language are you speaking?
You discovered this mine?
Is there anything else I can unlock here?
translation: Burada acabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: Restricted mine access: 100 nuggets
Bigger sack: 200 nuggets
Cancel
Restricted hopper: 50 nuggets
I'll leave you alone.
Power for the people!
The Council must answer us!
The Council is corrupt!
Down with the Council!
Democracy is a lie!
We want answers!
We won't be denied!
We want a King!
It's time for a King!
A King for Kourend!
What is it, human? I'm working.
How do I use the furnace?
Put your ore on the conveyor belt to get it smelted. We'll stoke the boiler and operate the rest of the machinery for you.
translation: Cevherini konveyör bandina koy, eritilsin. Kazani yakip geri kalan makineleri senin icin calistiracagiz.

english: You'll have to help repair the furnace whenever a pipe blows, though. Just hit it with a hammer - that usually works.
translation: Ancak, bir boru patladiginda firini onarmaya yardim etmelisin. Cekicle vurman yeterli, genellikle ise yarar.

english: You'll have to put money in the coffer to pay for our services. We charge 72,000 coins per hour; money is deducted as long as you're in this room with us.
translation: Hizmetlerimizin bedelini ödemek icin kasaya para koymalisin. Saat basina 72.000 sikke aliyoruz; bu odada bizimle birlikte oldugun sürece para kesilir.

english: Gosh, you're a remarkably big dwarf.
translation: Vay canina, sen gercekten cok büyük bir cücesin.

english: My brothers and I have a rare genetic condition affecting our growth. Rather than treating us as freaks, you might like to appreciate how useful it is that we can operate the machinery.
translation: Kardeslerim ve ben, büyümemizi etkileyen nadir bir genetik rahatsizliga sahibiz. Bizi ucube olarak görmek yerine, makineleri calistirabilmemizin ne kadar yararli oldugunu takdir etmelisin.

english: Sorry.
That's ok, human. You're not the first to comment on it. Now, did you need anything? I've got work to do here.
translation: Sorun degil, insan. Bu konuda yorum yapan ilk kisi sen degilsin. Simdi, bir seye ihtiyacin var mi? Burada yapmam gereken isler var.

english: Are you sure you're really a dwarf?
... look, do you want help with something, or did you just come here to be rude? I've got work to do.
translation: bak, bir seye yardim mi istiyorsun, yoksa sadece kaba davranmak icin mi buraya geldin? Yapacak isim var.

english: I'll let you get on with it.
How do I use the furnace?
Gosh, you're a remarkably big dwarf.
translation: Vay canina, sen gercekten cok büyük bir cücesin.

english: Sorry.
I'll let you get on with it.
Are you sure you're really a dwarf?
translation: Gercekten bir cüce olduguna emin misin?

english: That's no use!
No need! I'm fine thanks.
Looks like it's quiet for now. I don't need help, but thank you.
translation: Su an icin ortalik sakin görünüyor. Yardima ihtiyacim yok, ama tesekkürler.

english: Light this brazier!
Yemalo shi cardito!
Fix this brazier!
Arg, it got me!
Mummy!
My flame burns low.
We are doomed.
I think I'm dying.
Ugh, help me!
We can rest for a time.
Good day [sir/miss]. I'm the quartermaster for this camp. We have a little we could trade here.
translation: Iyi günler . Ben bu kampin levazim subayiyim. Burada takas edebilecegimiz birkac sey var.

english: We should be getting a new stock soon. Would you like a look at what we do have?
translation: Yakinda yeni stok gelmesi bekleniyor. Elimizdeki mallara bakmak ister misiniz?

english: Yes please. What are you selling?
No thanks.
We have a new stock of dragon halberds. Would you like a look at what we have?
translation: Yeni ejderha mizraklarimiz var. Elimizdekileri görmek ister misiniz?

english: Yes please. What are you selling?
No thanks.
Hey - what are you doing with that patch, peasant?!? One demands that you speak to one's self immediately!!
translation: Hey, o yamayla ne yapiyorsun, köylü?!? Hemen konusmani istiyoruz!!

english: [Roughly translated, this means that Queen Ellamaria would like a word.]
translation: [Kabaca cevirisi, Kralice Ellamaria sizinle konusmak istiyor anlamina gelir.]

english: What's going on here? I see a lot of farming patches with nothing growing in them.
translation: Burada neler oluyor? Hicbir sey yetismeyen bircok tarla görüyorum.

english: No, one has just had them installed. One has had the most marvellous idea to bring renewed happiness to one's own dearest husband.
translation: Hayir, biri onlari yeni taktirdi. Biri, sevgili kocasina yeniden mutluluk getirmek icin harika bir fikir buldu.

english: One? I'm not sure I understand you-
Oh dear - the common classes, oh how they fill one with intolerable levels of exasperation, I swear to be most true.
translation: Ah canim, alt siniflar, insani ne kadar dayanilmaz bir öfkeyle dolduruyorlar, yemin ederim ki bu cok dogru.

english: Ri-ight ... if you say so, my lady. I'll be off then, if you don't mind-
translation: Tamam... siz öyle diyorsaniz, hanimefendi. Sakincasi yoksa ben gidiyorum...

english: Yes, be off with you, before I call the guards.
translation: Evet, git hadi, yoksa muhafizlari cagiririm.

english: No problem, sorry to have bothered you.
translation: Sorun degil, rahatsiz ettigim icin özür dilerim.

english: Peasant - WAIT!!!
Are you speaking to me?
Who else would I be speaking to, you funny little man? Of course you.
translation: Baska kime söyleyeyim, komik kücük adam? Tabii ki sana.

english: Well for a moment there I thought there was a dog around here somewhere...
translation: Bir an icin burada bir köpek oldugunu sandim...

english: Oh yes, sarcasm - how amusing. No, no, peasant - I have a question to ask of you, and you are required to answer.
translation: Oh evet, alaycilik - ne eglenceli. Hayir, hayir, köylü - sana bir soru sormak istiyorum ve cevap vermen gerekiyor.

english: Well, seeing as you put it so nicely...
translation: Peki, madem bu kadar nazikce söylüyorsun...

english: Do you know of anyone who might have some degree of horticultural experience?
translation: Bahcecilik konusunda biraz deneyimi olan birini taniyor musun?

english: Oh, marvellous! Peasant, I hereby order you to assist me with a little project I have planned.
translation: Oh, harika! Köylü, sana planladigim kücük bir projede bana yardim etmeni emrediyorum.

english: You'll have to ask me nicely first.
Oh, what I have to deal with these days - to think this is what being a Queen has become. Very well then: would you ... good sir help me with a little project of mine?
translation: Oh, bu günlerde ugrasmak zorunda oldugum seyler - kralice olmanin bu hale geldigini düsünmek. Pekala o zaman: benim kücük projemde bana yardim eder misin, sayin beyefendi?

english: I would be happy to help someone who is so in touch with the people.
translation: Halkla bu kadar yakin olan birine yardim etmekten mutluluk duyarim.

english: Ah, more sarcasm - wonderful. Well, it is nice to have a master of the fine art of gardening to assist me; in the absence of any such person, I gladly accept your service.
translation: Ah, yine alaycilik - harika. Bahcecilik sanatinda usta birinin bana yardim etmesi cok güzel; böyle bir kisi olmadigina göre, hizmetinizi memnuniyetle kabul ediyorum.

english: I'm not sure if that's a compliment or not. Anyway, what would you like me to do, and what do I get out of it?
translation: Bunun bir iltifat olup olmadigindan emin degilim. Her neyse, ne yapmami istersiniz ve karsiliginda ne alacagim?

english: To answer your first question, you have noticed the new farming patches that we have had installed around us. We wish to grow many varied and exotic plants in them, to bring happiness back to my husband.
translation: Ilk soruna cevap vermek gerekirse, cevremize kurdugumuz yeni tarim alanlarini fark etmissindir. Orada cok cesitli ve egzotik bitkiler yetistirerek kocama mutlulugu geri kazandirmak istiyoruz.

english: King Roald?

The very same, and that's 'His Most Royal Majesty' to you. Now we come to the plants that one wishes you to grow in these patches. I would tell you all at once, but I fear that your small mind would not cope.
translation: Aynen öyle, ve sana göre o “Majesteleri”dir. Simdi bu alanlarda yetistirmeni istedigimiz bitkilere gelelim. Hepsini birden söylemek isterdim, ama kücük zihninin bunu kaldiramayacagindan korkuyorum.

english: Thanks, I'm sure. So tell me Queeny, how do I know which plants I am to get for you?
translation: Tesekkürler, eminim. Peki söyle bana Kralice, sana hangi bitkileri getirecegimi nasil bilecegim?

english: I have given you a list of the items that I need in each patch. One is sure that you will know how to use the list with each patch to find out what needs to go in each one. There is one more thing, though.
translation: Her tarlada ihtiyacim olan esyalarin listesini sana verdim. Her tarlada neye ihtiyac oldugunu bulmak icin listeyi nasil kullanacagini bildiginden eminim. Ama bir sey daha var.

english: (player receives the list called... List.)
One listens with bated breath...
Obtaining the seeds may prove difficult if you go about it by hacking and slashing everything that moves. No, to gather these items you will need to employ a finer tactic; the art of persuasion.
translation: Hareket eden her seyi kesip bicerek tohumlari elde etmek zor olabilir. Hayir, bu esyalari toplamak icin daha ince bir taktik kullanman gerekecek: ikna sanati.

english: You must go at once and converse with the wise old man who is said to dwell in Draynor Village; he may guide you in mastering this delicate and sophisticated ability.
translation: Hemen Draynor Köyü'nde yasadigi söylenen bilge yasli adamla konusmalisin; o sana bu hassas ve sofistike yetenegi ustalastirmada rehberlik edebilir.

english: I'd rather jump off the docks at Port Sarim.
translation: Port Sarim'deki rihtimdan atlamayi tercih ederim.

english: Well don't allow one to delay you - it is probably the most constructive thing you could do with your life, to be honest.
translation: Kimsenin sizi geciktirmesine izin vermeyin - dürüst olmak gerekirse, bu muhtemelen hayatinizda yapabileceginiz en yapici sey.

english: How am I supposed to move statues all the way here?
What I am supposed to be getting again?
Will these patches need much in the way of watering?
translation: Bu bitkiler cok sulanmaya ihtiyac duyacak mi?

english: Can I have another list?
Take better care with this one.
These parties are always a bore.
Come on, it's not too bad, you just need to loosen up!
translation: Hadi ama, o kadar da kötü degil, biraz gevsemen lazim!

english: No thank you, I don't want to make a fool of myself, one has to keep up appearances.
translation: Hayir tesekkürler, kendimi rezil etmek istemiyorum, görünüsü korumak lazim.

english: Yes.
No.
Can I have another list?
Can I use this garden for my own farming?
translation: Bu bahçeyi kendi çiftligim için kullanabilir miyim?

english: What, you want to dig up the plants that took one so long to grow? Don't be ridiculous, you silly little fool.
translation: Ne, bu kadar uzun sürede yetisen bitkileri kazip çikarmak mi istiyorsun? Saçmalama, seni aptal küçük ahmak.

english: All right then, sorry I asked.
translation: Tamam o zaman, sordugum için özür dilerim.

english: Impertinent peasant! Oh, if you promise to leave one alone then feel free to pick fruit from the White Tree. One is told that they are a great natural energy restorative.
translation: Küstah köylü! Oh, bir tanesini birakacagina söz verirsen, Beyaz Agaç'tan meyve toplamakta özgürsün. Bunlarin harika bir dogal enerji kaynagi oldugu söylenir.

english: Hello.
Er...Hello, Your Majesty.
Have you come for a particular reason? I am a busy Queen, you know. I had to attend the opening of a new orphanage this morning.
translation: Özel bir neden icin mi geldiniz? Ben cok mesgul bir kraliceyim, biliyorsunuz. Bu sabah yeni bir yetimhanenin acilisina katilmak zorundaydim.

english: Yes, I...
And this afternoon I shall be receiving the Embassador of Karamja and accompanying him on his week-long tour of Etceteria.
translation: Ve bu ögleden sonra Karamja Büyükelcisini kabul edip, onun bir haftalik Etceteria turuna eslik edecegim.

english: Er, I...
Then this evening we shall be putting on a grand ball! All of the kingdom's nobility will be present!
translation: Sonra bu aksam büyük bir balo verecegiz! Kralligin tüm soylulari orada olacak!

english: If I m...
Oh, who am I kidding...nothing ever happens here. I always wanted to be a princess when I was a girl. If I'd been told it would be like this, I wouldn't have bothered.
translation: Oh, kimi kandiriyorum... burada hicbir sey olmuyor ki. Kücükken hep prenses olmak istemistim. Böyle olacagini bilseydim, hic ugrasmazdim.

english: Your Majesty!
Yes? Did you want something?
...actually, no.
Your Majesty...
Vargas, you irritating fool. 'Warmongering harpy', indeed!
translation: Vargas, seni sinir bozucu aptal. “Savas cigirtkani harpiye”ymis, tabii ya!

english: Sorry?
Oh, I apologise. I was merely thinking out loud.
translation: Oh, özür dilerim. Sadece yüksek sesle düsünüyordum.

english: How is your kingdom faring?
It could be better. Now, if you don't mind, I'm rather busy.
translation: Daha iyi olabilirdi. Simdi, sakincasi yoksa, oldukca mesgulüm.

english: Very well, your Majesty.
Well, look who it is!
Good to see you Martin.
Can you believe it? The coronation of a king! Truth be told, there were times I wondered if this day would ever come.
translation: Inanabiliyor musun? Bir kralin tac giyme töreni! Dogrusu, bu günün gelip gelmeyecegini merak ettigim zamanlar oldu.

english: And is it everything you hoped for?
translation: Ve her sey umdugun gibi mi?

english: Everything and more, my friend. And to think they even let us vote on it as well! Fantastic!
translation: Her sey ve daha fazlasi, dostum. Ve bize oy kullanma hakki bile verdiler! Harika!

english: Well the King certainly seems to have attracted plenty of guests.
translation: Kral pek cok konugu cekmis görünüyor.

english: Indeed. Seems that everyone wants to congratulate him... Or maybe they're just here for the food.
translation: Gercekten. Herkes onu tebrik etmek istiyor gibi... Ya da belki de sadece yemek icin buradadirlar.

english: Either way, this will be an event for the ages.
translation: Her halükarda, bu unutulmaz bir olay olacak.

english: Are all the leaders here as well?
Most of them. Lord Shayzien was here earlier but he left. To be honest, he didn't look to be enjoying himself.
translation: Cogu burada. Lord Shayzien az önce buradaydi ama gitti. Dürüst olmak gerekirse, pek egleniyor gibi görünmüyordu.

english: That's not too suprising. Things weren't exactly straightforward between him and the King when this was all arranged.
translation: Bu pek de sasirtici degil. Bu etkinlik düzenlendiginde, Kral ile aralarinda pek iyi olmayan bir durum vardi.

english: Yes, I heard there was a bit of drama here and there. Still, that's Kourend for you.
translation: Evet, burada orada biraz drama yasandigini duydum. Yine de, Kourend iste böyle bir yer.

english: Now, I'll let you go and mingle. I'm sure the King himself will want a word with you at some point as well.
translation: Simdi, seni birakayim da digerleriyle sohbet et. Eminim Kral da bir ara seninle konusmak isteyecektir.

english: Alright. Have fun Martin.
The player walks towards Lord Arceuus.
Hello Lord Arceuus.
Good to see you friend.
Any word on Xamphur?
Nothing yet. However, we did manage to search his lair in Molch.
translation: Henüz yok. Ancak Molch'taki siginagini aramayi basardik.

english: Find anything interesting?
Most of it had been cleared out before we arrived. There was some research left behind though. Notes on potential new spells.
translation: Biz varmadan önce cogu sey temizlenmisti. Ancak bazi arastirmalar geride kalmisti. Potansiyel yeni büyülerle ilgili notlar.

english: Some are far too dangerous to use, but others we've found to be safe. We're preparing a tome of all the ones that are suitable. I'll make sure you get a copy once we're done.
translation: Bazilari kullanmak icin cok tehlikeli, ancak digerleri güvenli. Uygun olanlarin hepsini bir kitapta topluyoruz. Bitirince sana bir kopyasini verecegim.

english: That's very kind of you.
It's the least we can do after all you have done for us. Anyway, I won't keep you. Enjoy the coronation.
translation: Senin bizim icin yaptiklarindan sonra en azindan bunu yapabiliriz. Neyse, seni alikoymayayim. Tac giyme töreninin tadini cikar.

english: The player walks towards Commander Fullore.
There you are! I was worried you'd miss all the fun.
translation: Iste buradasin! Tüm eglenceyi kaciracaksin diye endiselendim.

english: No chance. It's not every day you crown a new king.
translation: Olmaz. Her gün yeni bir kral tac giymez ya.

english: You can say that again. You should have seen all the preperations needed. Food, drinks, entertainment, invitations... The list goes on.
translation: Haklisin. Hazirliklar icin ne kadar ugrastigimizi görmeliydin. Yemek, icecek, eglence, davetiyeler... Liste uzayip gidiyor.

english: You'd think security would be one of the hard parts, but I actually reckon our bit is pretty straightforward in comparison.
translation: Güvenlik en zor kisimlardan biri gibi görünebilir, ama aslinda bizim isimiz digerlerine kiyasla oldukca basit.

english: On that note, how does it feel to be serving a king now?
translation: Bu arada, artik bir krala hizmet etmek nasil bir duygu?

english: I don't think it's quite sunk in yet. It still feels like it was only this morning that Councillor Hughes escaped. So much has happened in such a short time.
translation: Henüz tam olarak idrak edemedim. Hala, Meclis Üyesi Hughes'un kacisinin bu sabah oldugu gibi geliyor. Cok kisa sürede cok sey oldu.

english: Tell me about it. Had I known how this would go when Martin first recruited me, I'd have probably considered running for the hills as fast as possible.
translation: Bana mi söylüyorsun? Martin beni ilk ise aldiginda bunun böyle olacagini bilseydim, muhtemelen olabildigince cabuk kacmayi düsünürdüm.

english: Well, I for one am glad you didn't. We'd have never reached this point without your help.
translation: Ben kacmadigin icin memnunum. Senin yardimin olmasaydi bu noktaya asla gelemezdik.

english: It wouldn't have been possible without you or Martin either. Have you two spoken yet?
translation: Sen ve Martin olmasaydiniz bu mümkün olmazdi. Ikiniz konustunuz mu?

english: Oh, I'm going to need a lot to drink before I'm ready for that conversation.
translation: Oh, o konusmaya hazir olmak icin cok fazla icki icmem gerekecek.

english: Fair enough.
Anyway, have you seen our special guest?
The scene pans towards the front banquet table.
translation: Kamera öndeki ziyafet masasina dogru kayiyor.

english: It's a pleasure to finally welcome you to Great Kourend, Queen Zyanyi. You are very welcome here.
translation: Sizi nihayet Büyük Kourend'e hos geldiniz demek büyük bir zevk, Kralice Zyanyi. Buraya hos geldiniz.

english: The pleasure is all mine. From today, the sun will shine on our two kingdoms once more. The mistakes of the past are now behind us.
translation: O zevk bana ait. Bugünden itibaren günes iki kralligimizi bir kez daha aydinlatacak. Gecmisteki hatalar artik geride kaldi.

english: Who is she?
Zyanyi Arkan, the Sun Queen. She's the ruler of Varlamore, the kingdom in the south. This is her first visit to Kourend.
translation: Zyanyi Arkan, Günes Kralicesi. Güneydeki Varlamore kralliginin hükümdari. Kourend'e ilk kez geliyor.

english: First visit?
Indeed. The King personally invited her. He's keen to put an end to the animosity between the two kingdoms. Rumor has it she feels the same way.
translation: Evet. Kral onu bizzat davet etti. Iki krallik arasindaki düsmanligi sona erdirmek istiyor. Söylentilere göre o da ayni sekilde düsünüyor.

english: Who are the knights with her?
Her royal guard, the Kualti.
They look fancy.
They do. If the stories are true, they're the best fighters in Varlamore.
translation: Öyle. Söylentiler dogruysa, Varlamore'un en iyi savascilari onlar.

english: Not jealous are you?
Not of that armour, that's for sure. It looks very uncomfortable.
translation: O zirhlara degil, orasi kesin. Cok rahatsiz görünüyorlar.

english: Queen Zyanyi Arkan and her Kualti begin to leave.
translation: Kralice Zyanyi Arkan ve Kualti'leri ayrilmaya baslar.

english: Ah, looks like they're done. You should go and see the King. He was pretty keen to speak to you.
translation: Ah, görünüse göre isleri bitti. Krali görmeye gitmelisin. Seninle konusmak icin cok hevesliydi.

english: Okay. I'll see you later.
The player approaches King Kandur Hosidius.
Good to see you, Your Majesty. Congratulations on your coronation.
translation: Sizi görmek ne güzel, Majesteleri. Tac giyme töreniniz icin tebrikler.

english: Thank you my friend. Of course, none of this would have been possible without you. Let it be known that you will always be a friend of this kingdom.
translation: Tesekkürler dostum. Tabii ki, sen olmasaydin bunlarin hicbiri mümkün olmazdi. Bilin ki, sen her zaman bu kralligin dostu olacaksin.

english: Thank you, I'm very honoured.
As am I. In fact, I think this calls for a toast.
translation: Ben de öyle. Aslinda, bence bu bir kadeh kaldirmayi gerektirir.

english: Gather around honoured guests! It's time for me to bore you all with a speech!
translation: Saygideger konuklar, toplanin! Sizi bir konusma ile sikma zamani geldi!

english: The guests approach King Kandur Hosidius.
translation: Konuklar Kral Kandur Hosidius'un yanina yaklasir.

english: Friends, thank you all for joining me on this special day. This is the beginning of a new chapter for Kourend, and I could not be more grateful to have you all here to celebrate with me.
translation: Dostlar, bu özel günde benimle birlikte oldugunuz icin hepinize tesekkür ederim. Bu, Kourend icin yeni bir sayfanin baslangici ve hepinizin benimle birlikte kutlama yapmaya geldiginiz icin ne kadar minnettar oldugumu kelimelerle ifade edemem.

english: Still, let us not forget the hard road that led us here, nor those who were brave enough to walk along it.
translation: Yine de, bizi buraya getiren zorlu yolu ve bu yolu cesurca yürüyenleri unutmayalim.

english: Martin Holt, Lydia Fullore, [player name]. Without you, we would all still be living in ignorance. You opened our eyes to the truth, and ensured a strong future for Kourend.
translation: Martin Holt, Lydia Fullore, Maceraci. Sizler olmasaydiniz, hepimiz hala cehalet icinde yasiyor olurduk. Gözlerimizi gercege actiniz ve Kourend'in güclü bir gelecegi olmasini sagladiniz.

english: Now, let us all raise our glasses to these three. We are forever in their debt.
translation: Simdi, hepimiz bu üc kisiye kadehlerimizi kaldiralim. Onlara sonsuza kadar minnettariz.

english: The scene fades to black, and transitions to one with King Kandur Hosidius and the player alone behind Kourend's throne.
translation: Sahne karartilir ve Kral Kandur Hosidius ile oyuncunun Kourend'in tahtinin arkasinda yalniz kaldigi bir sahneye gecer.

english: Ah, there you are.
You wanted to speak to me?
I did. Sorry to take you away from the festivities. With everyone else celebrating, I thought it would be a good chance to talk in private. Don't worry. It won't take long.
translation: Evet. Seni kutlamalardan uzaklastirdigim icin üzgünüm. Herkes kutlama yaparken, özel olarak konusmak icin iyi bir firsat olacagini düsündüm. Merak etme. Uzun sürmeyecek.

english: It's not a problem. What did you want to discuss?
translation: Sorun degil. Ne hakkinda konusmak istemistin?

english: The councillors are behind bars and Kourend has a new ruler. On the surface, all is well again. Of course, that's not quite the case in reality.
translation: Meclis üyeleri hapiste ve Kourend'in yeni bir hükümdari var. Görünüste her sey yeniden yoluna girmis gibi. Tabii ki gercekte durum pek de öyle degil.

english: You mean Xamphur?
Yes. The Council did not act alone. In fact, they weren't even the true orchestrators in this. We need to find and deal with the real foe before it's too late.
translation: Evet. Meclis tek basina hareket etmedi. Aslinda bu olayin gercek mimarlari onlar bile degildi. Cok gec olmadan gercek düsmani bulup onunla hesaplasmaliyiz.

english: I'd be happy to help in any way I can. Xamphur and I have unfinished business.
translation: Elimden gelen her türlü yardimi seve seve yaparim. Xamphur ile benim aramda yarim kalan bir is var.

english: I was hoping you'd say that. This is a serious threat we're facing, and I need people I can trust.
translation: Bunu söylemeni umuyordum. Karsi karsiya oldugumuz ciddi bir tehdit ve güvenebilecegim insanlara ihtiyacim var.

english: So, what do you need me to do?
Nothing for now. I just wanted to make sure you were on board. Once we have more information on Xamphur, I will let you know.
translation: Simdilik hicbir sey. Sadece senin de bizimle oldugunu bilmek istedim. Xamphur hakkinda daha fazla bilgi edindigimizde sana haber verecegim.

english: Now, we should head back downstairs before we are missed.
translation: Simdi, kimse bizi aramaya baslamadan asagi inmeliyiz.

english: A knife is launched at the king's back.
Is everything alright, Your Majesty?
I... I can't...
The king falls, and an assassin is revealed to the player.
translation: Kral yere düser ve suikastci oyuncuya görünür.

english: Kandur Hosidius. You have been marked for death.
The assassin teleports away, and the cutscene ends.
translation: Suikastci uzaklasir ve kesme sahnesi sona erer.

english: Hey Lydia. How are you doing?

It's been a rough few days since the coronation, as you can probably imagine. One moment we were crowning a new king, that next we were burying him. I'm doing okay, though. Work is a good distraction.
translation: Tahmin edebilecegin gibi, tac giyme töreninden bu yana zorlu birkac gün gecirdik. Bir an yeni krali taclandiriyorduk, bir an sonra onu gömüyorduk. Ama ben iyiyim. Is, dikkatimi dagitmak icin iyi geliyor.

english: And how's that going?
Well Artur Hosidius is now the King of Great Kourend. I'm sorry you couldn't be there for the ceremony. After what happened, they felt something small would be best.
translation: Artur Hosidius artik Büyük Kourend'in krali. Törene katilamadigin icin üzgünüm. Olanlardan sonra, kücük bir törenin daha uygun olacagini düsündüler.

english: That's fine. I think one coronation was enough for me. Any word on the killer?
translation: Sorun degil. Bence bir tac giyme töreni benim icin yeterliydi. Katil hakkinda bir haber var mi?

english: There's no shortage of potential suspects, but nothing solid. We've had the murder weapon sent over to Lovakengj to be examined. They have a theory, but want to do more work before they confirm it.
translation: Potansiyel süpheliler bol ama somut bir sey yok. Cinayet silahini inceleme icin Lovakengj'e gönderdik. Bir teorileri var ama bunu dogrulamak icin daha fazla calisma yapmak istiyorlar.

english: Well let me know once they have something. I want to find whoever did this.
translation: Bir sey bulduklarinda bana haber verin. Bunu yapani bulmak istiyorum.

english: We will.
Anything else I can do in the meantime?
translation: Bu arada yapabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: I don't think so. Lord Arceuus is trying to find out more about Xamphur, but he doesn't have anything yet. For now, all we can do is wait.
translation: Sanmiyorum. Lord Arceuus, Xamphur hakkinda daha fazla bilgi edinmeye calisiyor, ama henüz bir sey bulamadi. Su anda yapabilecegimiz tek sey beklemek.

english: And on that note, I wanted to give you a little something to thank you for all that you've done. Not just for Kourend, but for me as well.
translation: Bu arada, yaptiklarin icin sana kücük bir hediye vermek istiyorum. Sadece Kourend icin degil, benim icin de.

english: This is a bad situation we're in, but without you things would be a whole lot worse. Lord Arceuus also sent something over for you. He said you'd know what to do with it.
translation: Kötü bir durumdayiz, ama sen olmasaydin isler cok daha kötü olurdu. Lord Arceuus da sana bir sey gönderdi. Ne yapacagini bildigini söyledi.

english: Now, I'll let you get going. Thanks again, for everything.
translation: Simdi, seni birakayim. Her sey icin tekrar tesekkürler.

english: Congratulations! Quest complete!
Ah. Welcome, adventurer. I'm here to tell you all about quests. Let's start by opening your quest list.
translation: Ah. Hos geldin, maceraci. Sana görevler hakkinda her seyi anlatacagim. Görev listeni acarak baslayalim.

english: Have you not opened that menu yet?
Now that you have the quest list open, you can see all the quests within it. Clicking one of these quests will display some more information on it.
translation: Görev listesini actiginda, icindeki tüm görevleri görebilirsin. Bu görevlerden birine tikladiginda, onunla ilgili daha fazla bilgi görüntülenir.

english: If you haven't started the quest, it will tell you where to begin and what requirements you need. If the quest is in progress, it will remind you what to do next.
translation: Görevi henüz baslatmadiysan, nereden baslayacagin ve hangi gereksinimlerin oldugunu sana söyler. Görev devam ediyorsa, bir sonraki adimda ne yapman gerektigini hatirlatir.

english: Clicking a quest in the journal will display some more information on it. If you haven't started the quest, it will tell you where to begin and what requirements you need.
translation: Günlükteki bir görevi tikladiginizda, o görevle ilgili daha fazla bilgi görüntülenir. Görevi henüz baslatmadiysaniz, nereden baslayacaginiz ve hangi gereksinimlerin gerekli oldugu size bildirilir.

english: It's very easy to find quest start points. Just look out for the quest icon on your minimap. You should see one marking this house.
translation: Görev baslangic noktalarini bulmak cok kolaydir. Minik haritada görev simgesini aramaniz yeterlidir. Bu evi isaretleyen bir simge görmelisiniz.

english: The quests themselves can vary greatly from collecting beads to hunting down dragons. Completing quests will reward you with all sorts of things, such as new areas and better weapons!
translation: Görevler, boncuk toplamaktan ejderha avlamaya kadar cok cesitli olabilir. Görevleri tamamladiginizda, yeni alanlar ve daha iyi silahlar gibi cesitli ödüller kazanirsiniz!

english: There's not a lot more I can tell you about questing. You have to experience the thrill of it yourself to fully understand.
translation: Görevler hakkinda size anlatabilecegim cok fazla sey yok. Tam olarak anlamak icin bu heyecani kendiniz yasamalisiniz.

english: Would you like to hear about quests again?
translation: Görevler hakkinda tekrar bilgi almak ister misin?

english: Yes!
Within your quest list, you'll unsurprisingly find a list of quests. Clicking one of these quests will display some more information on it.
translation: Görev listende, tahmin edebilecegin gibi bir görev listesi bulacaksin. Bu görevlerden birine tikladiginda, görevle ilgili daha fazla bilgi görüntülenir.

english: Nope, I'm ready to move on!
Okay then.
Yes!
Nope, I'm ready to move on!
Can I bother you for a moment?
Oh yes?
Do you ever think you'd rather have one of my larger friends to be your companion? I can't carry you like they can.
translation: Hic benim daha iri arkadaslarimdan birinin senin arkadasin olmasini tercih eder miydin? Ben seni onlar gibi tasiyamam.

english: I'm actually glad to have you with me! You may even grow up to be giant one day. Maybe then you could carry me everywhere.
translation: Aslinda seninle birlikte oldugum icin cok mutluyum! Belki bir gün sen de dev gibi olursun. O zaman beni her yere tasiyabilirsin.

english: Except towards volcanoes... We birds aren't so good in those conditions.
translation: Volkanlara dogru haric... Biz kuslar o kosullarda pek iyi degiliz.

english: Eeeep!
*Whistle*
It's your lucky day, [player name]! You've got a chance to win big prizes in my quiz show. Would you like to play?
translation: Bugün sansli günün, Maceraci! Benim bilgi yarismamda büyük ödüller kazanma sansin var. Oynamak ister misin?

english: Yes please, I'm so excited!
WELCOME to the GREATEST QUIZ SHOW in the entire of Gielinor!
translation: Gielinor'un en büyük bilgi yarismasina HOS GELDIN!

english: ODD!ONE!OUT!
Please welcome our newest contestant:[player name]! Four questions right, and then you win! You know the rules, so let's begin!
translation: En yeni yarismacimizi alkislayalim: Maceraci! Dört soruyu dogru cevaplayin, kazanin! Kurallari biliyorsunuz, hadi baslayalim!

english: Sorry, it's [player name] that's having the lucky day.
WRONG! That's just WRONG! Okay, next question!
translation: YANLIS! Bu YANLIS! Tamam, sonraki soru!

english: BZZZZZZZ! WRONG! Okay, next question!
No, you're WRONG! Okay, next question!
No, sorry. Try harder! Okay, next question!
translation: Hayir, üzgünüm. Daha cok cabala! Tamam, sonraki soru!

english: Better luck next time! Okay, next question!
translation: Bir dahaki sefere daha sansli olursun! Tamam, sonraki soru!

english: Nope, that's not it. Okay, next question!
translation: Hayir, bu degil. Tamam, sonraki soru!

english: Huh...? Didn't you know that one? Okay, next question!
translation: Ha...? Bunu bilmiyor muydun? Tamam, sonraki soru!

english: No, no, no... That's completely WRONG! Okay, next question!
translation: Hayir, hayir, hayir... Bu tamamen YANLIS! Tamam, sonraki soru!

english: WRONG WRONG WRONG! Okay, next question!
translation: YANLIS YANLIS YANLIS! Tamam, sonraki soru!

english: DING DING DING! That's RIGHT! Good for you! Okay, next question!
translation: DING DING DING! Dogru! Aferin! Tamam, sonraki soru!

english: Absolutely RIGHT! Keep going for the win! Okay, next question!
translation: Kesinlikle dogru! Kazanmak icin devam et! Tamam, sonraki soru!

english: COR-RECT! Okay, next question!
Hey, you're good at this! CORRECT! Okay, next question!
translation: Hey, bu konuda cok iyisin! Dogru! Tamam, sonraki soru!

english: Wow, you're a smart one! You're absolutely RIGHT! Okay, next question!
translation: Vay canina, cok zekisin! Kesinlikle dogru! Tamam, sonraki soru!

english: YES! You're RIGHT! Okay, next question!
CONGRATULATIONS! You are aWINNER! Please choose yourPRIZE!
Hey [player name]! It's your lucky day!
Wakey-wakey, [player name]!
You're in for a treat, [player name]!
Come along with me, [player name]!
Maybe later.
Yes please, I'm so excited!
Quiz shows are stupid. Go away.
1000 Coins
Mystery Box
How am I supposed to get past this?
Gah!
If I'd been any slower, I would've lost my head!
translation: Biraz daha yavas olsaydim, kafami kaybedecektim!

english: Buying that ring was definitely a wise investment.
translation: O yüzügü satin almak kesinlikle akillica bir yatirimdi.

english: Well, the door to the next floor has already closed. Might as well take a break.
translation: Eh, bir sonraki kata acilan kapi coktan kapandi. Biraz mola versek iyi olur.

english: 96... 97... 98... 99 Hallowed marks! Almost enough for that grapple!
translation: 96... 97... 98... 99 Kutsal isaretler! Neredeyse o kanca icin yeterli!

english: I can't wait until I have enough Hallowed marks to obtain a dark graceful outfit.
translation: Karanlik zarif kiyafeti almak icin yeterli Kutsal isaretleri biriktirene kadar sabirsizlaniyorum.

english: I prefer this floor. Those owls on the next one creep me out!
translation: Bu kati tercih ederim. Bir sonraki kattaki baykuslar beni ürkütüyor!

english: Who's a cute bunny!
-sniff sniff-
Hello there.
No time to talk, another time perhaps.
translation: Konusacak vaktim yok, belki baska bir zaman.

english: Hello fellow bunny, how's it hanging?
Hello friend, no time to talk, the early rabbit gets the carrot as they say.
translation: Merhaba dostum, konusacak vaktim yok, erken kalkan tavsan havuc alir derler.

english: Hop along then.
Hey.
The rabbit starts sniffing you.
The rabbit keeps sniffing you.
I'm going to go.
Hi there.
I'm late, I'm late for a very important date.
translation: Gec kaldim, cok önemli bir randevuya gec kaldim.

english: You seem to be having an eggsistential crisis.
You're not funny, it's rabbits like you that give us a bad name.
translation: Komik degilsin, senin gibi tavsanlar bizim adimizi kötüye cikariyor.

english: Hello friend, would you like to hear a joke?
translation: Merhaba dostum, bir fikra dinlemek ister misin?

english: Not really.
What's a rabbit's favoritedance style?
translation: Tavsanlarin en sevdigi dans stili nedir?

english: Hip-Hop!
You hear the distant sound of a drum set going off.
Fellow rabbit...
What are you up to?
I'm just pondering.
About what?
Did the Wise Old Rabbit ever tell you about Duke Harrous the dumb.
translation: Bilge Yasli Tavsan sana aptal Duke Harrous'tan bahsetmis miydi?

english: No, I don't think he did?
Hmph, not a story he would ever tell you, it's a rabbit legend, but perhaps another time.
translation: Hmph, sana asla anlatmayacagi bir hikaye, bu bir tavsan efsanesi, ama belki baska bir zaman.

english: Isn't this wonderful, coming out here and looking out over the sea.
translation: Buraya gelip denizi seyretmek ne kadar harika.

english: I could stay here with you forever...
They look a little pre-occupied.
I could really do with your help, but the Duke hasn't given me permission to talk to you.
translation: Senin yardimina gercekten ihtiyacim var, ama Dük seninle konusmama izin vermedi.

english: What am I to do?
What's wrong?
Oh bother, oh bother, oh bother, I'm in a terrible terrible mess! It's the annual Egg Descendance Day tomorrow, and I should be making him a big carrot cake.
translation: Oh, ne sikinti, ne sikinti, ne sikinti, basim cok büyük belada! Yarin yillik Yumurta Inis Günü ve ona büyük bir havuclu kek yapmam gerekiyor.

english: I've forgotten to buy the ingredients. I'll never get them in time now. The duke will turn me into soup! What will I do? I have 12 children to look after. Would you help me? Please?
translation: Malzemeleri almayi unuttum. Artik zamaninda alamayacagim. Dük beni corbaya cevirecek! Ne yapacagim? Bakmam gereken 12 cocugum var. Bana yardim eder misin? Lütfen?

english: Yes, I'll help you.
Oh thank you, thank you. I need a carrot, a cabbage and a cake. I'd be very grateful if you can get them for me.
translation: Oh tesekkürler, tesekkürler. Havuc, lahana ve kek lazim. Bunlari benim icin alirsan cok minnettar olurum.

english: I have all of those ingredients on me already!
translation: Bu malzemelerin hepsi bende var zaten!

english: That's an odd coincidence... Were you planning on making a carrot cake too?
translation: Ne garip bir tesadüf... Sen de havuclu kek yapmayi mi planliyordun?

english: Not exactly. I just had an odd feeling you might be needing these ingredients. If I see a rabbit cook, I presume there's food of some kind! Lucky guess I suppose.
translation: Tam olarak degil. Sadece bu malzemelere ihtiyacin olabilecegini hissettim. Tavsan asci görürsem, bir cesit yemek oldugunu varsayarim! Sansli bir tahmin sanirim.

english: Well thank you! Hand them over, please.
You hand the cook all of the ingredients.
You've brought me everything I need! I am saved! Thank you!
translation: Ihtiyacim olan her seyi getirdin! Kurtuldum! Tesekkürler!

english: So do I get to go to the Descendance Day dinner?
translation: Peki, Descendance Günü yemegine gidebilecek miyim?

english: I'm afraid not, only the big carrots get to dine with the egg.
translation: Korkarim ki hayir, sadece büyük havuclar yumurtayla birlikte yemek yiyebilir.

english: Sounds lame anyway, I didn't want to be invited.
translation: Zaten sikici bir sey gibi geliyor, davet edilmek istemiyordum.

english: How dare you.
Quest complete!
So where do I find these ingredients then?
It's something rabbits are constantly munching on, have a look in some of the houses nearby.
translation: Tavsanlar sürekli bunlari cigniyorlar, yakindaki evlere bir bak.

english: Won't they be annoyed I'm nicking their carrots?
Who cares, Descendance day is far more important than their needs.
translation: Kimin umurunda, Descendance günü onlarin ihtiyaclarindan cok daha önemli.

english: I normally get my cabbage from the fields, on the other side of the river.
translation: Genelde lahanayi nehrin diger tarafindaki tarlalardan alirim.

english: There are rabbit farmers too!? How cute.
translation: Tavsan ciftcileri de mi var? Ne kadar sevimli.

english: That you'll have to have a nosey round for, rabbits around here are always celebrating something.
translation: Bunu bulmak icin etrafi iyice arastirman gerekecek, buradaki tavsanlar her zaman bir seyleri kutluyorlar.

english: Lots of theft in the rabbit realm...
translation: Tavsan diyarinda cok fazla hirsizlik var...

english: You gotta do what you gotta do.
I've got all the information I need. Thanks.
translation: Ihtiyacim olan tüm bilgileri aldim. Tesekkürler.

english: Actually, I know where to find this stuff.
translation: Aslinda, bu malzemeleri nerede bulabilecegimi biliyorum.

english: No, I don't feel like it, maybe later.
Fine. I always knew you Adventurer types were callous rabbits. Go on, hop off!
translation: Peki. Maceraci tiplerin duygusuz tavsanlar oldugunu hep biliyordum. Hadi, git buradan!

english: You don't look very happy.
No, I'm not. The world is caving in around me - I am overcome by dark feelings of impending doom.
translation: Hayir, mutlu degilim. Dünya basima yikiliyor - yaklasan kiyametin karanlik duygulari beni ele geciriyor.

english: I'd take the rest of the day off if I were you.
translation: Senin yerinde olsam günün geri kalaninda izin alirdim.

english: No, that's the worst thing I could do. I'd get in terrible trouble.
translation: Hayir, bu yapabilecegim en kötü sey. Basim büyük belaya girer.

english: Well maybe you need to take a drink...
That would be nice, but the great round one has banned all consumption of Cabbage flavoured drinks.
translation: Bu iyi olurdu, ama büyük yuvarlak olan, lahana aromali iceceklerin tüketimini yasakladi.

english: Hmm, why not something that doesn't taste of cabbage?
translation: Hmm, neden lahana tadi olmayan bir sey denemiyorsun?

english: Have you tried Onion beer? It's disgusting.
translation: Sogan birasini denedin mi? Igrenc bir tadi var.

english: I'm afraid I've run out of ideas.
I know I'm doomed.
Nice hat!
Err thank you, it's a pretty ordinary rabbit cook's hat, really.
translation: Tesekkürler, aslinda oldukca siradan bir tavsan asci sapkasi.

english: Still, suits you. I didn't know rabbits could wear trousers either.
translation: Yine de sana yakisiyor. Tavsanlarin pantolon giyebilecegini de bilmiyordum.

english: It's all standard rabbit cook issue uniform...

I'd take the rest of the day off if I were you.

You can challenge someone to a game anywhere in the games rooms by using the right click option. Choose the type of game and then choose the options you want such as time per move. If you want to play a particular
translation: Oyun odalarinin herhangi bir yerinde sag tiklama secenegini kullanarak birine oyun teklifinde bulunabilirsin. Oyun türünü sec ve ardindan hamle basina süre gibi istedigin secenekleri sec. Belirli bir oyunu oynamak istiyorsan

translation: deneyim kazandiginizda, birinci kattaki meydan okuma odalarini kullanabileceksiniz! Rakibiniz meydan okumayi kabul ederse, ana odadaki masalardan birine götürülecek ve sectiginiz oyunu oynayacaksiniz.

translation: Oyunu bitirdiginizde, tekrar meydan okuma odasina geri dönecek ve tekrar meydan okuyabileceksiniz!

english: What games can I play?
Currently we offer Draughts, Runelink, Runesquares, and Runeversi.
translation: Su anda Dama, Runelink, Runesquares ve Runeversi oyunlari sunuyoruz.

english: Draughts?
Draughts uses standard rules, apart from: a draw is declared if no piece has been taken or promoted for forty moves. To play Draughts go to the challenge room in the SW corner.
translation: Dama, asagidaki istisna disinda standart kurallara göre oynanir: Kirk hamle boyunca hicbir tas alinmaz veya terfi ettirilmezse beraberlik ilan edilir. Dama oynamak icin güneybati kösesindeki meydan okuma odasina gidin.

english: Runelink?
Yup, you have to get four runes in row. The challenge room for Runelink is in the SE corner.
translation: Evet, dört runu arka arkaya dizmeniz gerekir. Runelink icin meydan okuma odasi güneydogu kösesindedir.

english: Runesquares?
Yes, you take it in turns to add a line with the goal of making squares. Everytime you make a square you take another turn. The challenge room for Runesquares is in the SW corner.
translation: Evet, sirayla kareler olusturmak amaciyla bir cizgi ekliyorsunuz. Her kare olusturdugunuzda bir tur daha oynuyorsunuz. Runesquares icin meydan okuma odasi güneybati kösesinde.

english: Runeversi?
Yep, the aim is to have more of your runes on the board than your opponent. You can take your opponents pieces by trapping them between your own. The challenge room for Runeversi is in the SE corner.
translation: Evet, amac rakibinizden daha fazla runenizi tahtaya yerlestirmek. Rakibinizin taslarini kendi taslarinizla sikistirarak alabilirsiniz. Runeversi icin meydan okuma odasi güneydogu kösesinde.

english: Can I buy a drink please?
Certainly [sir/miss], our speciality is Asgarnian Ale, we also serve Wizard's Mind Bomb and Dwarven Stout.
translation: Elbette , spesiyalitemiz Asgarnian Ale, ayrica Wizard's Mind Bomb ve Dwarven Stout da servis ediyoruz.

translation: Hey, artik kendi palalarini satin almanin zamani geldi bence. Karamja'da sana palanizi satabilecek bir orman yerlisi mutlaka vardir.

Radimus Erkle hands you a puzzlebox!

Well done [player name]. Here you go.

It's legendary.

english: Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: Hey, kahraman gelmis! Vay canina! Harikasin, o iki juvinate ve Gadderank'i nasil alt ettin? Kasaba da cok güzel olmus, harika bir is cikarmissin!

What do you do here?
Oh, my name's Radu, I just help out around here, you know, look for food and so on.
translation: Adim Radu, burada yardim ediyorum, yiyecek ariyorum falan.

It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: Oh, pek bir sey yok, hepimiz hala vampirlerden saklaniyoruz ve bu korkunc yerde gecimimizi sagliyoruz, umarim yakinda Salve'deki tapinaga yolculuk yapacak kadar gücleniriz.

translation: cogu insanin görüsüne göre, sen bir kahramansin! Ben sahsen seninle tanistigima cok memnunum.

Of course.

Sorry, human, you can't use the Lovakengj Minecart Network. Speak to Miriam, at the main station by the southern Lovakengj bank, if you've got any questions.

translation: Üzgünüm, insan, Lovakengj Maden Arabasi Agi sadece Lovakengj vatandaslari icindir.

Thanks, human. I guess it's okay for you to ride my carts after all. So, can I help you?
translation: Tesekkürler, insan. Sanirim benim arabalarimi kullanabilirsin. Peki, sana nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: Thanks again for bringing me that control scroll. Can I help you today?
translation: Kontrol parsömenini getirdigin icin tekrar tesekkürler. Bugün sana nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: No thanks, you've already given me one of those.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, zaten bir tane verdin.

I thought this acne potion might help ease your spots.

They whisper of a dream to climb across the moon supreme, I know, I know, oh oh oh
