english: To visit their watery hall, answer their call, embrace the fall and save us all!
translation: Sulu salonlarini ziyaret etmek, cagrisina cevap vermek, düsüsü kucaklamak ve hepimizi kurtarmak icin!...

english: ... I'll be going now.
Can I 'elp you, [monsieur/mademoiselle]?
You've got an interesting accent!

Oui, I 'ave perfected zis accent for when I worked for my father in Ardougne. He is a baker in ze market, and 'e believes ze customers will think ze bread of higher quality if it is made by a foreigner.
translation: Evet, Ardougne'da babam icin calisirken bu aksani mükemmellestirdim. O pazarda firinci ve müsterilerin yabanci birinin yaptigi ekmegin daha kaliteli oldugunu düsüneceklerine inaniyor.

english: And does that work?
Perhaps. I do not care for ze bread; it is ze fish zat shall be my future.
translation: Belki. Ben ekmegi umursamiyorum; benim gelecegim balikta.

english: Good luck with that!
Why do you work in a fishing colony?
Ahh, it is because I love ze sea. Ze rushing waters, ze endless horizon - it is beautiful! Also, I like ze fresh fish.
translation: Ahh, cünkü denizi seviyorum. Akintili sular, sonsuz ufuk - cok güzel! Ayrica taze baligi da seviyorum.

english: It seems like rather hard work - can't you just get a beach house on Karamja?
translation: Oldukca zor bir is gibi görünüyor - Karamja'da bir sahil evi alamaz misiniz?

english: Zat, I am afraid, is not for me an option. Besides, I 'ave read of ze island of Karamja - it is full of ze big green spiders, and I like zem not!
translation: Korkarim bu benim icin bir secenek degil. Ayrica, Karamja adasi hakkinda okudum - büyük yesil örümceklerle dolu ve ben onlari sevmiyorum!

english: Fair enough.
No thanks, I'm alright.
Ahh, farewell.
You've got an interesting accent!
Why do you work in a fishing colony?
No thanks, I'm alright.
Hello again.
Ah, [player name]. You made it.
So, tell me about this proposal of yours.
Camdozaal is a shadow of what it once was. We Imcando Dwarves were the finest artisans in the world, but now I am all that remains. Today, you'll only find echoes of our once great city.
translation: Camdozaal eskiden oldugu gibi degil artik. Biz Imcando Cüceleri dünyanin en iyi zanaatkarlariydik, ama simdi geriye sadece ben kaldim. Bugün, eskiden büyük olan sehrimizin sadece yankilarini bulabilirsin.

english: But that which was once great can still be great again! We Imcando Dwarves know that better than most. There is hope for the future of Camdozaal. But I need help.
translation: Ama eskiden büyük olan sey yine büyük olabilir! Biz Imcando Cüceleri bunu herkesten daha iyi biliriz. Camdozaal'in gelecegi icin umut var. Ama yardima ihtiyacim var.

english: What do you need?
We have a Sacred Forge. You will find none other like it in all the world. Some of the greatest weapons of legend started life here.
translation: Kutsal Demirci Ocagimiz var. Dünyada bunun gibisini baska hicbir yerde bulamazsin. Efsanevi en büyük silahlarin bazilari burada üretildi.

english: The Forge could be the key to Camdozaal's future, but it's going out. If it does, I fear it will never be lit again. I can no longer gather the fuel it needs. But perhaps you can?
translation: Demirci Ocagi, Camdozaal'in geleceginin anahtari olabilir, ama sönmek üzere. Eger sönerse, bir daha asla yakilamayacagindan korkuyorum. Artik ona gerekli yakiti toplayamiyorum. Ama belki sen toplayabilirsin?

english: Fuel?
Barronite. You'll only find it in these ruins. If you can gather some for me, I can use it to keep the Forge lit. In return, I'll let you take what you want from our Great Vault.
translation: Barronit. Sadece bu harabelerde bulabilirsin. Bana biraz toplarsan, Dökümhanenin yanik kalmasi icin kullanabilirim. Karsiliginda, Büyük Mahzenimizden istedigini almana izin verecegim.

english: I no longer have use for anything in the Vault. Besides, material possessions mean nothing compared to the fire of the Sacred Forge.
translation: Mahzendeki hicbir seye artik ihtiyacim yok. Ayrica, maddi varliklar Kutsal Dökümhanenin atesine kiyasla hicbir sey ifade etmiyor.

english: So I find barronite in the ruins and bring it to you? Doesn't sound too difficult. Where should I start?
translation: Yani harabelerde barronit bulup sana getireyim mi? Cok zor degil gibi görünüyor. Nereden baslamaliyim?

english: Anywhere you like. The ruins are filled with barronite, so anything you do here should yield some. If you need more information on specific things you can do, just let me know.
translation: Istedigin yerden. Harabeler barronit ile dolu, bu yüzden burada yaptigin her seyden biraz elde edebilirsin. Yapabilecegin belirli seyler hakkinda daha fazla bilgiye ihtiyacin olursa, bana haber ver.

english: I'll see you later.
Ah [player name]. I'm sure you have plenty of questions. I will do my best to answer them.
translation: Ah Maceraci. Eminim bircok sorunuz vardir. Onlari cevaplamak icin elimden geleni yapacagim.

english: What can I do here?

As you can see, Camdozaal isn't the city it once was. That said, there are still a few things around here that might interest you. There's the golem workshop, the barronite mine and the offering altar.
translation: Gördügün gibi, Camdozaal eskisi gibi bir sehir degil. Yine de, burada ilgini cekebilecek birkac sey var. Golem atölyesi, barronit madeni ve adak sunagi var.

english: Tell me more about the golem workshop.
translation: Golem atölyesi hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin.

english: You'll find it to the east. It was once the forefront of our technological advances. Sadly, it was also one of the major factors that led to our doom.
translation: Dogu tarafinda bulabilirsiniz. Bir zamanlar teknolojik ilerlemelerimizin öncüsüydü. Ne yazik ki, ayni zamanda sonumuzu getiren en önemli faktörlerden biri de oydu.

english: What were you doing there?
Camdozaal was built upon the ruins of an older civilization. Little trace of them remained by the time we arrived. However, when building the city, ancient golems were discovered.
translation: Camdozaal, eski bir medeniyetin kalintilari üzerine insa edildi. Biz geldigimizde onlardan cok az iz kalmisti. Ancak sehri insa ederken eski golemler kesfedildi.

english: These golems were very crude. They were mostly made from clay, of all things. We used our advanced Smithing knowledge to improve their form. Eventually, we were able to get them working again.
translation: Bu golemler cok ilkeldi. Cogu, inanilmaz bir sekilde kilden yapilmisti. Gelismis demircilik bilgimizi kullanarak formlarini iyilestirdik. Sonunda, onlari tekrar calisir hale getirebildik.

english: We kept pushing with the golems. Many of them we imbued with magical energies. We started with mind and body energy, but eventually moved on to chaos as well.
translation: Golemler üzerinde calismaya devam ettik. Bircoguna büyülü enerjiler asiladik. Zihin ve beden enerjisiyle basladik, ancak sonunda kaosa da gectik.

english: Alas, the influence of chaos had grave results. We lost control of many. Those that became corrupt had to be locked away, but by then it was already too late.
translation: Ne yazik ki, kaosun etkisi ciddi sonuclar dogurdu. Bircogunun kontrolünü kaybettik. Yozlasanlari kilitlemek zorunda kaldik, ama o zaman cok gec olmustu.

english: The barbarians had learnt of our experimentation, and were determined to destroy all traces of it.
translation: Barbarlar deneyimlerimizi ögrenmislerdi ve tüm izlerini yok etmeye kararliydilar.

english: Ironically, locking them away meant the golems were among the few things to survive the barbarians. If you fancy a bit of combat, you might want to go take a look.
translation: Ironik olarak, onlari kilitlemek, golemlerin barbarlardan kurtulan az sayidaki seyden biri olmasini sagladi. Biraz savasmak isterseniz, gidip bir bakabilirsiniz.

english: They're largely made of barronite now, so they're a good source of the stuff.
translation: Artik büyük ölcüde barronitten yapilmislar, bu yüzden bu maddenin iyi bir kaynagidirlar.

english: Their cores are also very interesting. Apparently, the dwarves of the golem workshop once used old cores to craft runes. Maybe you could do the same.
translation: Cekirdekleri de cok ilginctir. Görünüse göre, golem atölyesinin cüceleri bir zamanlar eski cekirdekleri runeler yapmak icin kullanmislar. Belki sen de aynisini yapabilirsin.

english: Tell me more about the barronite mine.
translation: Bana barronit madeninden biraz daha bahset.

english: You'll find it to the north west. Unsurprisingly, it's the best place to find barronite in the city.
translation: Kuzeybatida bulabilirsin. Sasirtici olmayan bir sekilde, sehirde barronit bulmak icin en iyi yer orasidir.

english: At one time, our miners would work all through the day there to gather the barronite needed to power the Sacred Forge. That was a long time ago.
translation: Bir zamanlar madencilerimiz, Kutsal Demirci Ocagi'na güc saglamak icin gerekli barroniti toplamak icin bütün gün orada calisirlardi. Bu cok uzun zaman önceydi.

english: If you're lucky, you might find other things while mining there. We were not the first to build a home beneath this mountain. Sometimes traces of an older civilization can be found.
translation: Sansliysan, orada madencilik yaparken baska seyler de bulabilirsin. Bu dagin altinda ev insa eden ilk biz degildik. Bazen daha eski bir medeniyetin izleri bulunabilir.

english: What kind of traces?
You might find some ancient relics encased within barronite. If you do, you can use the anvils here to crack open the deposits.
translation: Barronitin icinde bazi eski kalintilar bulabilirsin. Bulursaniz, buradaki örsleri kullanarak yataklari kirabilirsiniz.

english: The relics are of no interest to me. Maybe some of your race would find them interesting.
translation: Eski kalintilar beni ilgilendirmiyor. Belki sizin irkinizdan bazilari onlari ilginc bulabilir.

english: Tell me more about the offering altar.
translation: Kurban sunaklari hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin.

english: You'll find it to the south west. It's not something that ever interested me, but most of my kind were followers of Saradomin - the god of order and wisdom.
translation: Onu güneybatida bulabilirsiniz. Beni hic ilgilendirmedi, ama benim türümün cogu düzen ve bilgelik tanrisi Saradomin'in takipcileriydi.

english: Many of my kin would visit the altar to make offerings in his name.
translation: Soyumdan pek cogu, onun adina adak sunmak icin sunaklari ziyaret ederdi.

english: First, they'd catch fish from the nearby reservoir. Next, they'd ritually prepare them at tables by the altar. Finally, they'd use the altar to offer the fish.
translation: Önce, yakindaki rezervuardan balik tutarlardi. Sonra, sunaklarin yanindaki masalarda ritüel olarak onlari hazirlarlardi. Son olarak, sunaklari kullanarak baliklari adak olarak sunarlardi.

english: There's plenty of barronite to be found within the reservoir, so it might be worth checking out. Be warned though: worshipping gods never did my kind any good.
translation: Rezervuarda bol miktarda barronit bulunur, bu yüzden bir göz atmaya deger olabilir. Ancak sunu unutma: tanrilara tapinmak benim soyuma hicbir zaman fayda saglamadi.

english: Let's talk about something else.
Very well.
I have something I'd like you to examine.
translation: Sana incelemeni istedigim bir sey var.

english: Well hand it over and I'll take a look.
Use an item on Ramarno for him to examine it.
translation: Ramarno'ya bir esya kullanarak onu incelemesini sagla.

english: What happened to the other Imcando Dwarves?
Ah... It's a tough tale to tell. Even though it's been many years since the last of my kin died out, the memory is still fresh.
translation: Ah... Anlatmasi zor bir hikaye. Soyumun son üyesi öleli yillar gecmesine ragmen, hatirasi hala taze.

english: You don't have to tell me if the memory hurts too much.
translation: Anilarin cok aci vericiyse anlatmak zorunda degilsin.

english: No, I will. The legacy of my kin must live on.
translation: Hayir, anlatacagim. Soyumun mirasi yasamaya devam etmeli.

english: As you can see around you, Camdozaal was once a great city. Alive with the hum of activity. We dug deep into the mountain and reaped the rewards.
translation: Etrafina baktiginda görebilecegin gibi, Camdozaal bir zamanlar büyük bir sehirdi. Faaliyetlerin ugultusuyla doluydu. Dagin derinliklerine kazdik ve bunun karsiligini aldik.

english: Our methods would often differ from other dwarves. Whereas they just used traditional smithing techniques, we would combine them with magic as well.
translation: Yöntemlerimiz diger cücelerin yöntemlerinden farkliydi. Onlar sadece geleneksel demircilik tekniklerini kullanirken, biz bunlari büyüyle birlestirirdik.

english: Alas, that was ultimately our undoing. We learned of a horde of barbarians pillaging across the land, hunting down and killing anyone who dared use magic.
translation: Ne yazik ki, bu bizim sonumuz oldu. Barbarlarin ülkeyi yagmaladigini, büyü kullanmaya cesaret eden herkesi avlayip öldürdügünü ögrendik.

english: We underestimated them. We believed our weapons would be enough to keep us safe. We were wrong.
translation: Onlari hafife aldik. Silahlarimizin bizi güvende tutmaya yetecegini düsündük. Yanilmistik.

english: The barbarians brought ruin upon Camdozaal. Most of my kind died as the city collapsed around them. Only a few of us survived until the end. Now, only I remain.
translation: Barbarlar Camdozaal'i yikima ugratti. Cogumuz sehir cökerken öldük. Sadece birkacimiz sonuna kadar hayatta kaldi. Simdi sadece ben kaldim.

english: The world has changed a lot, Ramarno. Magic is practiced freely. Those barbarians failed to wipe it from Gielinor.
translation: Dünya cok degisti Ramarno. Büyü serbestce kullaniliyor. O barbarlar Gielinor'dan büyüyü silmeyi basaramadilar.

english: I'm glad they didn't win, I suppose. But it doesn't change much for me. I am still the last Imcando Dwarf.
translation: Kazanamadiklarina sevindim sanirim. Ama bu benim icin pek bir sey degistirmiyor. Hâlâ son Imcando Cücesi benim.

english: Well... that isn't completely true.
What do you mean?
While adventuring, I met another Imcando Dwarf called Thurgo.
translation: Macera sirasinda Thurgo adinda baska bir Imcando Cücesi ile tanistim.

english: An Imcando Dwarf survived outside the city?
translation: Bir Imcando Cücesi sehir disinda hayatta mi kaldi?

english: Yes. He looks to be doing quite well for himself. In fact, he seems to be a master of Smithing.
translation: Evet. Durumu oldukca iyi görünüyor. Aslinda, demircilik ustasi gibi görünüyor.

english: I can't believe it. I hope to meet him one day. He must be a truly amazing smith to reach such heights.
translation: Inanamiyorum. Bir gün onunla tanismayi umuyorum. Böyle bir seviyeye ulasmissa, gercekten harika bir demirci olmali.

english: Well he's certainly an interesting dwarf.
Thank you, [player name]! You've given me hope that my kin can live on. If you need help with anything else, let me know.
translation: Tesekkürler, Maceraci! Soyumun devam edebilecegine dair umut verdin bana. Baska bir seye ihtiyacin olursa haber ver.

english: Can I use the Forge?
I'm afraid not. The Sacred Forge is like none other in existence. Only an Imcando Dwarf could use it correctly.
translation: Korkarim ki hayir. Kutsal Demirci Ocagi, var olan diger ocaklara benzemez. Sadece bir Imcando Cücesi onu dogru sekilde kullanabilir.

english: What makes it so special?
translation: Onu bu kadar özel kilan nedir?

english: Truth be told, I don't fully know. It's far older than I am. It was supposedly built in the earliest days of the city.
translation: Dogrusu, tam olarak bilmiyorum. Benden cok daha eskidir. Sehrin ilk günlerinde insa edildigi söylenir.

english: What I do know is that it's been imbued with powerful magic - some said that of the gods themselves. The Forge powers the entire city, or what's left of it at least.
translation: Bildigim tek sey, güclü bir büyüyle donatilmis oldugu - bazilari tanrilarin kendilerinin büyüsü oldugunu söyler. Demirci ocagi tüm sehre, ya da en azindan geriye kalanlarina güc saglar.

english: I've been doing my best to keep it lit over the years. It's not a job I'm capable of any more though. That's why I'm hoping you can help.
translation: Yillardir onu yanik tutmak icin elimden geleni yapiyorum. Ancak artik bu isi yapabilecek durumda degilim. Bu yüzden yardimini umuyorum.

english: Bring me any barronite you find. In return, I can channel enough power from the Forge into the city or even open the Great Vault.
translation: Buldugun tüm barroniti bana getir. Karsiliginda, Forge'dan sehre yeterli gücü aktarabilir, hatta Büyük Mahzen'i acabilirim.

english: What will powering the city do?
From what I can tell, my ancestors linked the Forge to the entire city.
translation: Anladigim kadariyla, atalarim Forge'u tüm sehre baglamislar.

english: It truly is the heart of this place. From it, I can channel any barronite you have into empowering different aspects of the city.
translation: Burasi gercekten de bu yerin kalbi. Oradan, sahip oldugun tüm barronite'i sehrin farkli alanlarini güclendirmek icin aktarabilirim.

english: What will that do?
The Sacred Forge is a strange beast, but with its arcane power, you'll see an improvement to the various activities you can do in the city.
translation: Kutsal Forge garip bir yaratik, ama onun gizemli gücüyle, sehirde yapabilecegin cesitli aktivitelerde bir iyilesme göreceksin.

english: Would you like to take a look?
Yes please.
No thanks.
Very well. Anything else you'd like to talk about?
translation: Peki. Konusmak istedigin baska bir sey var mi?

english: What is the Great Vault?
It's one of the many marvels of this city. We used it to store our greatest creations, along with our most interesting finds.
translation: Bu sehrin bircok harikasindan biridir. En büyük yaratimlarimizi ve en ilginc buluntularimizi orada saklardik.

english: Of course, I have no use for those treasures myself. I'd happily give them up to keep the Sacred Forge alive.
translation: Tabii ki, bu hazinelerin bana bir faydasi yok. Kutsal Demirci'yi hayatta tutmak icin onlari seve seve veririm.

english: Now be warned - I won't be able to channel much power into the Vault. I can't afford to waste too much barronite. You'll only have a limited amount of time in there.
translation: Simdi sizi uyariyorum: Mahzene cok fazla güc aktaramayacagim. Cok fazla barronit israf edemem. Orada sinirli bir süre kalabilirsiniz.

english: Not only that, there's an automatic security system that activates if power to the Vault is lost. If that happens, you'll be removed. I imagine any treasures would be lost as well.
translation: Sadece bu da degil, Mahzenin gücü kesildiginde devreye giren otomatik bir güvenlik sistemi var. Böyle bir durumda, oradan cikarilirsiniz. Sanirim hazineler de kaybolur.

english: How much barronite do you need to power it?
translation: Güc saglamak icin ne kadar barroniteye ihtiyacin var?

english: Hmm, for a minute, I suppose 750 barronite shards should do the trick.
translation: Hmm, bir dakika, sanirim 750 barronite parcasi yeterli olur.

english: If you do go in, I'd suggest heading to the back first. That's where the most valuable things are kept.
translation: Iceri girersen, önce arkaya gitmeni öneririm. En degerli seyler orada saklaniyor.

english: Is there anything else you wanted to talk about?
translation: Konusmak istedigin baska bir sey var mi?

english: Never mind, I have no questions for now.
I'll be here if you change your mind. Take care [player name].
translation: Fikrini degistirirsen ben buradayim. Kendine iyi bak Maceraci.

english: Can you make me a knight's sword?
translation: Bana bir sövalye kilici yapabilir misin?

english: A sword? Why do you need me to make you one?
translation: Kilic mi? Neden benim yapmami istiyorsun?

english: I was told to find a Imacando dwarf to make a sword for me.
translation: Bana bir kilic yapmasi icin bir Imacando cücesi bulmam söylendi.

english: I'm afraid there's not much I can do to help you [player name]. My lack of vision means I can't work an anvil like I used to.
translation: Korkarim sana yardimci olabilecegim pek bir sey yok Maceraci. Görme yetenegimin olmamasi nedeniyle eskisi gibi örsü kullanamiyorum.

english: Oh... that's a shame.
They were probably talking about someone else anyway. I don't think many surface dwellers remember the dwarves who lived in Camdozaal.
translation: Muhtemelen baska birinden bahsediyorlardi. Yüzeyde yasayanlarin cogu Camdozaal'da yasayan cüceleri hatirlamiyor sanirim.

english: Right, I'll see if I can find someone else to make one for me then.
translation: Tamam, o zaman bana kilic yapacak baska birini bulmaya calisayim.

english: I found this encased within some barronite.
Ah, that looks like one of the relics from the civilization that lived here before Camdozaal was built.
translation: Ah, bu Camdozaal insa edilmeden önce burada yasayan medeniyetin kalintilarindan biri gibi görünüyor.

english: Do you want it?
I have no use for it. Maybe one of your kind would find it interesting.
translation: Benim icin bir faydasi yok. Belki senin türünden biri bunu ilginc bulur.

english: Hmm. Maybe.
I found one of these deposits while mining.
translation: Madencilik yaparken bu yataklardan birini buldum.

english: Ah, a barronite deposit. You can use the anvils here to crack it open. If you're lucky, it might have something inside.
translation: Ah, bir barronit yatagi. Buradaki örsleri kullanarak onu kirabilirsin. Sansliysan, icinde bir sey olabilir.

english: I have some barronite shards.
I could feed those shards into the Sacred Forge now, and keep their power for you to use later if you'd like?
translation: Bu parcalari simdi Kutsal Demirci Ocagi'na atabilirim ve istersen daha sonra kullanman icin güclerini saklayabilirim.

english: What can I use the power from the Forge for?
translation: Demirci Ocagi'nin gücünü ne icin kullanabilirim?

english: Well there's a few things we could do with that.
Well just bring it back if you change your mind.
I found this bit of barronite.

That looks like part of a weapon. Hmm, I might be able to make something out of it. You'll need to have all the right pieces... and 1,500 barronite shards or if you'd prefer, I can smelt it down for Barronite shards?
translation: Bir silah parcasi gibi görünüyor. Hmm, bundan bir seyler yapabilirim belki. Tüm parcalara ihtiyacin olacak... ve 1.500 barronit parcasi ya da istersen, barronit parcalari icin eritebilirim?

english: You need a Barronite [piece] and 1500 barronite shards.
Come back with all the parts, and I'll happily knock something up for you.
translation: Tüm parcalari getir, ben de senin icin bir seyler yapayim.

english: You have all the parts I need. Give me a second, and I'll fix it up for you.
translation: Ihtiyacim olan tüm parcalar sende var. Bana bir saniye ver, senin icin tamir edeyim.

english: There you go, one Barronite Mace. Should come in handy when killing the golems around here.
translation: Iste, bir Barronit Mace. Buradaki golemleri öldürürken isine yarayacaktir.

english: Alright then, I can smelt that down for 100 Barronite shards.
translation: Tamam o zaman, bunu eritip 100 barronit parcasi yapabilirim.

english: There you go. I can add those shards straight to the Forge as well if you'd like.
translation: Iste oldu. Isterseniz bu parcalari dogrudan Forge'a da ekleyebilirim.

english: Go ahead, that'd be great.
There you go, that's all done.
No thanks I'll hold onto them.
No problem, come back to me if you find anything else of interest.
translation: Sorun degil, baska ilginc bir sey bulursaniz bana gelin.

english: No thank you, I'll hold onto it.
I'll hold onto it for now.
What's this mace good for?
I reckon you could give one of those golems a nasty whack with that thing.
translation: Sanirim o sey ile o golemlerden birine sert bir darbe vurabilirsin.

english: I found this broken hammer within a barronite deposit.
translation: Bu kirik cekici bir barronit yataginda buldum.

english: Ah, the Imcando Hammer. A very useful tool for Smithing and Construction. I could repair it for 1,250 barronite shards if you like or if you'd prefer, I can smelt it down for Barronite shards?
translation: Ah, Imcando Cekici. Demircilik ve insaat icin cok kullanisli bir alet. Istersen 1.250 barronit parcasi karsiliginda tamir edebilirim ya da istersen barronit parcalari icin eritebilirim.

english: You need 1250 barronite shards.
Come back with the necessary items, and I'll happily repair the Imcando Hammer for you.
translation: Gerekli esyalari getir, Imcando Cekici'ni seve seve tamir ederim.

english: Give me a second, and I'll fix it up for you.
All done! Here is your Imcando Hammer.
Alright then, I can smelt that down for 350 Barronite shards.
translation: Tamam o zaman, onu 350 barronit parcasi karsiliginda eritebilirim.

english: The Imcando Hammer, one of my favourite tools for Smithing and Construction.
translation: Imcando Cekici, demircilik ve insaat icin en sevdigim aletlerden biri.

english: If you have no use for it, I could smelt it down for some Barronite shards?
translation: Eger kullanmayacaksan, onu eritip Barronite parcalari yapabilirim.

english: Alright then, I can smelt that down for 500 Barronite shards.
translation: Tamam o zaman, onu 500 Barronite parcasi karsiliginda eritebilirim.

english: No thanks I'll hold onto it.
I've brought you a redberry pie.
Why?
Imcando dwarves love redberry pies. I thought you'd like one too.
translation: Imcando cüceleri kirmizi meyveli turtayi severler. Senin de sevecegini düsündüm.

english: Can't say I've ever had one.
Oh, well why don't you try it?
So, what did you think?
This is delicious! Where did you find such a excellent cuisine!
translation: Bu cok lezzetli! Böyle mükemmel bir yemegi nereden buldun?

english: I made it myself.
You're an brilliant cook [player name]! Just don't bring me too many of these, I'm trying to watch my weight.
translation: Sen harika bir ascisin Maceraci! Ama bana cok fazla getirme, kiloma dikkat ediyorum da.

english: Ah, [player name]. I'm sure you have plenty of questions. I will do my best to answer them.
translation: Ah, Maceraci. Eminim bircok sorunuz vardir. Elimden geldigince cevaplamaya calisacagim.

english: What can I do here?
I have something to tell you. It's about another dwarf.
translation: Sana söylemem gereken bir sey var. Baska bir cüceyle ilgili.

english: Another dwarf? An Imcando Dwarf?
translation: Baska bir cüce mi? Imcando cücesi mi?

english: Yes. I encountered someone I believed to be a dwarf, but it was a lie. It was a Mahjarrat in disguise as someone called Ketla.
translation: Evet. Cüce oldugunu sandigim biriyle karsilastim, ama yalandi. Ketla adinda birine kilik degistirmis bir Mahjarrat'ti.

english: Ketla...
You knew her?
I did, long ago. Is she...
She's gone, Ramarno. I'm so sorry.
I see...
I'm sorry, [player name], but let us not speak of this further. To learn of the death of another of my kin is no surprise, but it pains me all the same. I would prefer to focus my thoughts elsewhere.
translation: Üzgünüm, Maceraci, ama bu konuyu daha fazla konusmayalim. Akrabalarimdan birinin daha öldügünü ögrenmek sürpriz degil, ama yine de canimi yakiyor. Düsüncelerimi baska bir seye odaklamak istiyorum.

english: Of course.
I have something I'd like you to examine.
translation: Sana incelemeni istedigim bir sey var.

english: What happened to the other Imcando Dwarves?
Can I use the Forge?
I'll see you later.
Tell me more about the golem workshop.
translation: Golem atölyesi hakkinda daha fazla bilgi ver.

english: Tell me more about the barronite mine.
translation: Barronit madeni hakkinda daha fazla bilgi ver.

english: Tell me more about the offering altar.
translation: Adak sunagi hakkinda daha fazla bilgi ver.

english: Let's talk about something else.
What will powering the city do?
Yes please.
No thanks.
What is the Great Vault?
Never mind, I have no questions for now.
Can you make me a knight's sword?
translation: Bana bir sövalye kilici yapabilir misin?

english: Yes.
No.
Construct the weapon.
Convert into Barronite Shards.
Nothing.
Repair the Imcando hammer.
I have something to tell you. It's about another dwarf.
translation: Sana söyleyecek bir seyim var. Baska bir cüceyle ilgili.

english: What do you want? I am busy supervising!
What is this place?
This is the Hosidius Kitchen. Here, under my expert eye, we prepare the food that feeds most of the population.
translation: Burasi Hosidius Mutfagi. Burada, benim uzman gözetimimde, nüfusun cogunu besleyen yiyecekleri hazirliyoruz.

english: Much of the income of Hosidius derives from trade in cooked food, so our work is vital.
translation: Hosidius'un gelirinin cogu pismis yiyecek ticaretinden geliyor, bu yüzden isimiz cok önemli.

english: Can I cook here?
Yes, you are most welcome to cook here. You may find you burn food less often under my supervision.
translation: Evet, burada yemek pisirebilirsin. Benim gözetimimde yemekleri daha az yakarsin.

english: Why don't you do some work yourself?
Excuse me? My cooking level is higher than you could imagine - I have already done my share of the work. Now, with my expertise, I am guiding future generations of chefs.
translation: Anlamadim? Yemek pisirme seviyem senin hayal edebileceginden daha yüksek - ben payima düsen isi zaten yaptim. Simdi, uzmanligimla gelecek nesil sefleri yetistiriyorum.

english: I'll leave you alone.
Get more fish!
Good, very good!
Now cook it!
Try not to burn this one.
What is this place?
Can I cook here?
Why don't you do some work yourself?
I'll leave you alone.
Do you want to buy any armoured skirts? Designed especially for ladies who like to fight.
translation: Zirhli etek satin almak ister misin? Savasmayi seven bayanlar icin özel olarak tasarlanmistir.

english: No thank you, that's not my scene.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, bu benim tarzim degil.

english: Well done.
You've [found a new clue/obtained a casket]!
translation: Yeni bir ipucu buldun/bir kutu elde ettin!

english: Hi! I have this money off voucher!
So I see! Unfortunately it seems to have expired yesterday! Nevermind.
translation: Anliyorum! Maalesef dün süresi dolmus gibi görünüyor! Önemli degil.

english: But I only just got it!
I'm sorry, there's nothing I can do. Goodbye.
translation: Üzgünüm, yapabilecegim bir sey yok. Hosca kal.

english: Yes please.
No thank you, that's not my scene.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, bu benim tarzim degil.

english: Welcome to my stall! Come and buy some tasty bread, freshly baked just 2 months ago!
translation: Tezgahima hos geldiniz! Gelin ve 2 ay önce taze pismis lezzetli ekmeklerden alin!

english: Sounds delicious!
I think I'll pass.
Hey! Get your hands off there!
You just stole something from me!
translation: Az önce benden bir sey caldin!

english: Guardsguards!
Sounds delicious!
I think I'll pass.
Hey there adventurer, I am the Ranged combat tutor. Is there anything you would like to know?
translation: Merhaba maceraci, ben Menzilli Savas Egitmeni. Bilmek istediginiz bir sey var mi?

english: How can I train my Ranged?
To start with you'll need a bow and arrows, you were given a Shortbow and some arrows when you arrived here from Tutorial island.
translation: Baslangic olarak bir yay ve oklar gerekir, Tutorial adasindan buraya geldiginizde size bir kisa yay ve birkac ok verildi.

english: Alternatively, you can claim a training bow and some arrows from me.
translation: Alternatif olarak, benden bir egitim yayi ve birkac ok alabilirsiniz.

english: Mikasi, the Magic Combat tutor and I both give out items every 30 minutes, however you must choose whether you want runes or ranged equipment.
translation: Mikasi, Sihirli Savas ögretmeni ve ben her 30 dakikada bir esya dagitiyoruz, ancak rünler mi yoksa menzilli ekipman mi istediginizi secmelisiniz.

english: To claim the Training bow and arrows, right-click on me and choose Claim, to claim runes right-click on the Magic Combat tutor and select Claim.
translation: Egitim yayi ve oklarini almak icin bana sag tiklayin ve Al'i secin, runeleri almak icin Sihirli Savas ögretmeni'ne sag tiklayin ve Al'i secin.

english: Not all bows can use every type of arrow, most bows have a limit. You can find out your bows limit by checking the Ranged skill guide.
translation: Tüm yaylar her tür oku kullanamaz, cogu yayin bir siniri vardir. Yayinizin sinirini Menzilli Beceri kilavuzuna bakarak ögrenebilirsiniz.

english: If you do decide to use the Training bow, you will only be able to use the Training arrows with it. Remember to pick up your arrows, re-use them and come back when you need more.
translation: Egitim yayini kullanmaya karar verirseniz, onunla sadece Egitim oklarini kullanabilirsiniz. Oklarinizi topladiginizi, yeniden kullandiginizi ve daha fazlasina ihtiyaciniz oldugunda geri geldiginizi unutmayin.

english: Once you have your bow and arrows, equip them by selecting their Wield option in your inventory.
translation: Yay ve oklarinizi aldiktan sonra, envanterinizdeki Kullan secenegini secerek bunlari donatin.

english: You can change the way you attack by going to the combat options tab. There are three attack styles for bows. Those styles are Accurate, Rapid and Longrange.
translation: Saldiri seklinizi, savas secenekleri sekmesine giderek degistirebilirsiniz. Yaylar icin üc saldiri stili vardir. Bu stiller Dogru, Hizli ve Uzun Menzillidir.

english: Accurate increases your bows attack accuracy. Rapid will increase your attack speed with the bow. Longrange will let you attack your enemies from a greater distance.
translation: Dogru, yayinizin saldiri dogrulugunu artirir. Hizli, yayla saldiri hizinizi artirir. Uzun Menzil, düsmanlariniza daha uzak mesafeden saldirmaniza olanak tanir.

english: If you need some more advice, you should talk to Adventurer Jon about Adventure paths. He may even have a handy starter kit you can use.
translation: Daha fazla tavsiyeye ihtiyaciniz varsa, Maceraci Jon ile Macera yollari hakkinda konusmalisiniz. Hatta kullanabileceginiz kullanisli bir baslangic kiti bile olabilir.

english: You should know the basics of ranged combat by now, but if you are looking for somewhere to test your skills and make some money, you should try hunting Moss giants in Varrock sewers.
translation: Simdiye kadar menzilli savasin temellerini ögrenmis olmalisiniz, ancak becerilerinizi test etmek ve biraz para kazanmak icin bir yer ariyorsaniz, Varrock kanalizasyonlarinda Yosun devlerini avlamayi denemelisiniz.

english: If you are lucky you might find a Mossy key, with this key you will be able to enter Bryophyta's lair. Make sure to bring plenty of food and good armour and weapons when you fight her as you will need it.
translation: Sansliysaniz, Bryophyta'nin inine girebileceginiz Mossy anahtari bulabilirsiniz. Onunla savasirken ihtiyaciniz olacak bol miktarda yiyecek, iyi zirh ve silah getirmeyi unutmayin.

english: If yourlucky you might snag some goodies that you can sell for a decent profit.
translation: Sansliysaniz, iyi bir kârla satabileceginiz bazi esyalar elde edebilirsiniz.

english: If you are looking to do something different, visit the ranging guild over near Hemenster, there you can practice your archery and earn tickets for it at the same time.
translation: Farkli bir sey yapmak istiyorsaniz, Hemenster yakinlarindaki okculuk loncasina gidin. Orada okculuk becerilerinizi gelistirebilir ve ayni zamanda bilet kazanabilirsiniz.

english: You can then hand those tickets in for a variety of goods you can use to train your Ranged skill.
translation: Bu biletleri, Menzilli Beceri'nizi gelistirmek icin kullanabileceginiz cesitli esyalarla takas edebilirsiniz.

english: If you are ever in the market for a new bow or some arrows, you should head on over to Lowe's Archery Emporium in Varrock. I can show you where the shop is if you like.
translation: Yeni bir yay veya ok satin almak istiyorsaniz, Varrock'taki Lowe's Archery Emporium'a gitmelisiniz. Isterseniz size dükkanin yerini gösterebilirim.

english: No thanks
Is there anything else you want to know?
translation: Baska bilmek istediginiz bir sey var mi?

english: Ahh the art of fletching. Fletching is used to create your own bow and arrows.
translation: Ahh, ok yapimi sanati. Ok yapimi, kendi yayinizi ve oklarinizi olusturmak icin kullanilir.

english: To create your bow and arrows you would need to gather some wood, feathers, arrow heads and bow string. The wood would be to make arrow shafts which can be turned into unstrung bows and arrow shafts.
translation: Yayinizi ve oklarinizi olusturmak icin biraz odun, tüy, ok ucu ve yay ipi toplamaniz gerekir. Odun, yay ve ok saplarina dönüstürülebilen ok saplari yapmak icin kullanilir.

english: Unfortunately, Fletching is a member only skill so you will have to get your ranging supplies from shops or other players.
translation: Ne yazik ki ok yapimi sadece üyelere özel bir beceridir, bu yüzden okculuk malzemelerini dükkanlardan veya diger oyunculardan temin etmeniz gerekecektir.

english: It's quite simple really. You'll need an axe to cut some logs from trees and a knife. Knives can be found in and around the Lumbridge castle and in the Varrock General store upstairs.
translation: Aslinda oldukca basittir. Agaclardan kütük kesmek icin bir balta ve bir bicak gerekir. Bicaklar Lumbridge kalesi ve cevresinde ve Varrock Genel magazasinin üst katinda bulunabilir.

english: Use your knife on the logs. This will bring up a menu listing items you can fletch.
translation: Kütükler üzerinde bicaginizi kullanin. Bu, yapabileceginiz oklari listeleyen bir menü acacaktir.

english: For arrows you will need to smith some arrow heads and kill some chickens for feathers.
translation: Oklar icin bazi ok uclari dövmeniz ve tüyler icin bazi tavuklari öldürmeniz gerekecektir.

english: Add the feathers to your Arrow shafts to make Headless arrows, then use your chosen arrow heads on the Headless arrows to make your arrows.
translation: Tüyleri ok saplarina ekleyerek bassiz oklar yapin, ardindan sectiginiz ok uclarini bassiz oklarin üzerine kullanarak oklarinizi yapin.

english: Now for making bows. When accessing the fletching menu, instead of choosing Arrows shafts, you can make an unstrung bow instead.
translation: Simdi yay yapmaya gecelim. Ok yapimi menüsüne girdiginizde, ok saplari yerine gerilmemis bir yay yapabilirsiniz.

english: To complete the bow you will need to get your hands on a Bow string.
translation: Yayi tamamlamak icin bir yay ipi bulmaniz gerekecektir.

english: First you will need to get some flax from a flax field. There's one south of Seers' Village. Gather flax, then spin it on a spinning wheel, there's one in Seers' Village too.
translation: Öncelikle keten tarlasindan biraz keten elde etmelisiniz. Seers Köyü'nün güneyinde bir tane var. Keten toplayin, ardindan Seers Köyü'nde de bulunan bir egirme carkinda egirin.

english: This makes bow strings which you can then use on the unstrung bows to make a working bow!
translation: Böylece yay ipleri elde edersiniz ve bunlari gerilmemis yaylarda kullanarak calisan bir yay yapabilirsiniz!

english: Brilliant. If I forget anything I'll come talk to you again.
translation: Harika. Bir sey unutursam tekrar sizinle konusurum.

english: Certainly. If you pick up ammo that is the same ammo you are currently using, I can make that ammo automatically equip for you, providing you have space of course!
translation: Elbette. Su anda kullandiginiz mühimmatla ayni mühimmati alirsaniz, elbette yeriniz varsa, o mühimmati otomatik olarak sizin icin donatabilirim!

english: Or you can leave it to going into your inventory like normal.
translation: Ya da normalde oldugu gibi envanterinize ekleyebilirsiniz.

english: There you go! Your ammo will now automatically be equipped when you pick it up.
translation: Iste oldu! Artik mühimmatinizi aldiginizda otomatik olarak donatilacaktir.

english: There you go! Your ammo will now go to your inventory when you pick it up.
translation: Iste oldu! Artik mühimmatinizi aldiginizda envanterinize eklenecektir.

english: Goodbye.
I work with the Magic tutor to give out consumable items that you may need for combat such as arrows and runes. However we have had some cheeky people try to take both!
translation: Magic ögretmeniyle birlikte calisarak, oklar ve rünler gibi savasta ihtiyac duyabileceginiz tüketim malzemelerini dagitiyorum. Ancak bazi küstah kisiler ikisini de almaya calisti!

english: So, every half an hour, you may come back and claim either arrows OR runes, but not both. Come back in a while for arrows, or simply buy some.
translation: Bu nedenle, her yarim saatte bir geri gelip oklar VEYA rünler alabilirsiniz, ancak ikisini birden alamazsiniz. Bir süre sonra oklar icin geri gelin veya satin alin.

english: If you had any room in your pack I'd give you a training bow. That's a shame. Come back when you do.
translation: Cantanizda yer olsaydi size bir egitim yayi verirdim. Cok yazik. Yer acildiginda geri gelin.

english: You already have some training arrows.
If you had enough space in your inventory I'd give you some training arrows, come back when you do.
translation: Envanterinizde yeterince yer olsaydi size bazi egitim oklari verirdim, yer acildiginda geri gelin.

english: You already have a training bow.

If you had any room in your pack I'd give you a training bow. That's a shame. Come back when you do. If you had enough space in your inventory I'd give you some training arrows, come back when you do.
translation: Cantanizda yer olsaydi size bir egitim yayi verirdim. Cok yazik. Yer acildiginda geri gelin. Envanterinizde yeterince yer olsaydi size egitim oklari verirdim, yer acildiginda geri gelin.

english: How can I train my Ranged?
Yes please.
No thanks.
How do I create a bow and arrows?
Can you toggle my ammo to equip when I pick it up please?
translation: Mermilerimi aldigimda donatmak icin acip kapatabilir misiniz lütfen?

english: Automatically equip it.
Place it in my inventory.
Hello!
Hello friend. I wish to slay evil and avail them of their loot! Take me to Burgh de Rott!
translation: Merhaba dostum. Kötülügü yok etmek ve ganimetlerini almak istiyorum! Beni Burgh de Rott'a götür!

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: Oradaki kötülükle savasmaya yeterince hazir misin?

english: I think so? At least my heart knows courage and that should be sufficient for the meantime. I expect that when we get to Burgh de Rott, we'll be able to purchase suitable provisions.
translation: Sanirim öyle. En azindan kalbim cesaretli ve bu simdilik yeterli olmali. Burgh de Rott'a vardigimizda uygun erzak satin alabilecegimizi umuyorum.

english: But you do realise that the vampyres in Morytania are immune to everything except silver?
translation: Ama Morytania'daki vampirlerin gümüs disinda her seye karsi bagisik oldugunu biliyor musun?

english: Er...well, I've not heard mention of that fact, but I have faith that Saradomin will provide the means to furnish me with suitable weapons when I reach Burgh de Rott.
translation: Sey... Bu konuda bir sey duymadim, ama Burgh de Rott'a vardigimda Saradomin'in bana uygun silahlar saglayacagina inaniyorum.

english: And if we happen to run into some vampyres on the journey down there?
translation: Ya oraya giderken yolda vampirlerle karsilasirsak?

english: I trust that you will help us to avoid them. You are a guide after all, aren't you? Anyway, you look like you can handle yourself. I presume you've fought such creatures before and won? How hard can it be?
translation: Onlardan kacinmamiza yardim edecegine inaniyorum. Sonucta sen bir rehbersin, degil mi? Her neyse, kendini savunabilecek gibi görünüyorsun. Daha önce bu tür yaratiklarla savasip kazandin mi? Ne kadar zor olabilir ki?

english: It can be pretty difficult, actually. But you're right, I'll be your guide so I should be able to handle the situation.
translation: Aslinda oldukca zor olabilir. Ama haklisin, ben senin rehberin olacagim, bu yüzden durumu halledebilmeliyim.

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Neden Burgh de Rott'a gitmek istiyorsun?

english: I'm going down there to teach those vampyres a lesson or two. I've heard about the terrible conditions down there and I intend to put a stop to it.
translation: Oradaki vampirleri bir ders vermek icin gidiyorum. Oradaki korkunc kosullari duydum ve buna bir son vermek niyetindeyim.

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Burgh de Rott'a giderken yol üzerinde düsmanlarla karsilasirsak kendini savunabilir misin?

english: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of enemies. You don't need to worry about that.
translation: Diyelim ki biraz tecrübeliyim ve düsmanlarla savasmaktan cekinmem. Bu konuda endiselenmene gerek yok.

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: Hmmm, görünüse göre bir takipcin var. Kendi basina dolasmaya birakilirsa bu yolculukta kaybolabilir. Takipcin güvende oldugunda yola cikalim.

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: Gercekten mi? Bu harika olur! Hedefe vardigimizda sana kücük bir ödül verecegim.

english: Burgh de Rott Ramble begins
Ok, which route should we take?
Ok, thanks.
Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: Ah, bana biraz erzak vermek istiyorsun, ha? Sirt cantami acayim.

english: This place is a bit grim. How can people live here?
translation: Burasi biraz kasvetli. Insanlar burada nasil yasayabiliyor?

english: Do you visit Burgh de Rott often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: Burgh de Rott'a sik sik gelir misin? Rotayi iyi biliyorsun gibi görünüyor.

english: When are we going to get to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Burgh de Rott'a ne zaman varacagiz?

english: We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on. I have loot to get.
translation: Bütün gün burada durup sohbet edemeyiz, hadi devam edelim. Yagmalayacak seyler var.

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than the opulet life styles forced on us adventurer types. I'd much rather be up to my eyes in mud and having a good fight!
translation: Oh, bu yolculuktan nefret ediyorum, ama maceraperest tiplere dayatilan lüks yasam tarzindan daha iyidir. Gözlerime kadar camura batip iyi bir kavga etmeyi tercih ederim!

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...
Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Paterdomus. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: Vay canina! Görünüse göre Paterdomus'a geri dönmek zorundayiz. O köprüden gecemeyiz!

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
Player completes the bridge event
Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Paterdomus.
translation: Bu is bitti... Görünüse göre bu batakliktan gecemeyecegiz. Paterdomus'a geri dönmek zorundayiz.

english: Player completes the bog event
Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: Hey... bu harika... harika bir is cikardin... Seni takip edecegim.

english: Whahay...that was great!
But we really should be heading off now.
Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
Player completes the river event
That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: Bu harika! Ben de aynisini yapmaliyim.

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: Vay canina! Harikaydi! Ama artik gercekten yola cikmaliyiz.

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
This is scary!
Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
Ahhh, two tentacles!
...three tentacles!
I think I'm going to faint!
Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: Vay canina! Su canavara bak! O seyi kendi basina halletmen gerekecek!

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the Burgh de Rott. Here's your reward.
translation: Beni Burgh de Rott'a güvenle ulastirdigin icin cok tesekkürler. Iste ödülün.

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: Oradaki kötülükle savasmaya yeterince hazir misin?

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Neden Burgh de Rott'a gitmek istiyorsun?

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
Ok, thanks.
Hello there.
Greetings. If you are an experienced archer, you may want to visit the guild here...
translation: Selamlar. Eger deneyimli bir okcuysan, buradaki loncayi ziyaret etmek isteyebilirsin...

english: Hey you can't come in here. You must be a level 40 ranger to enter.
translation: Hey, buraya giremezsin. Girmek icin seviye 40 bir okcu olmalisin.

english: Hello.
Good day.
Good day, Your Royal Highness.
Oi!
Rahr!
No!
Grr!
Aargh!
I'm a gonner!
It's no use, I'm done for!
Uggh!
Erm.. Da's very kindly of you creature!
Hey you creature! Make me some stabbers! I wanna hunt da chompy?
translation: Hey sen, yaratik! Bana bicak yap! Chompy avlamak istiyorum?

english: Stabbers?
For da stabbie chucker, I's wanna hunt da chompy! Da chompy is der bestest yummies for Rantz, Fycie and Bugs! Creature knows what Rantz wants... flyin' to stabbie da chompy!
translation: Chompy avlamak icin bicak istiyorum! Chompy, Rantz, Fycie ve Bugs icin en lezzetli yiyecek! Yaratik, Rantz'in ne istedigini biliyor... Chompy'yi bicaklamak icin ucmak!

english: I think I understand. You want me to make some arrows for you?
translation: Sanirim anladim. Sana ok yapmami mi istiyorsun?

english: Yeah, is what Rantz sayed, make da stabbers for da stabby chucker!
translation: Evet, Rantz öyle dedi, bicak atici icin bicak yap!

english: OK, I'll make you some 'stabbers'.
Good you creature, you need sticksies from achey tree and stabbies from dog bones.
translation: Aferin yaratik, agriyan agactan sopalar ve köpek kemiklerinden bicaklar lazim.

english: Er, make you're own 'stabbers'!
When I make 'stabbers', I pretend you chompy and practice on you!
translation: “Bicaklari” yaptigimda, senin cigneyen oldugunu hayal edip üzerinde pratik yapacagim!

english: Hey deyr, t'anks for da chompy, it was scrumbly!
translation: Hey, cigneyen icin tesekkürler, cok lezzetliydi!

english: Hey, I hear you're giving away free hats!
Huh, dat's a true thing but you's godda be da good shooter wiv da stabbie chucker and stick lotsa chompies for da hatsie.
translation: Evet, dogru ama sapka almak icin bicak aticiyla iyi bir atici olman ve cok sayida cigneyen yakalaman gerekiyor.

english: What are the hats like?
Huh der is this many colours...~ Rantz holds up six fingers.~ And der is dis many different hatsies... ~ Rantz holds up three fingers.~
translation: Huh, bu kadar renk var... ~ Rantz alti parmagini kaldirir.~ Ve bu kadar farkli sapka var... ~ Rantz üc parmagini kaldirir.~

english: Ok you's creature, here's da hatsies!~ Rantz shows you the hats. ~
translation: Tamam yaratik, iste sapkalar! ~ Rantz sana sapkalari gösterir. ~

english: Huh der is this many colours:~ Rantz holds up six fingers. ~ And der is dis many different hatsies: ~ Rantz holds up three fingers. ~
translation: Huh, bu kadar cok renk var: ~ Rantz alti parmagini kaldirir. ~ Ve bu kadar cok farkli sapka var: ~ Rantz üc parmagini kaldirir. ~

english: How do I get a hat?
If you creature shows me da bow wiv da notches on it, I'll give ya a flapper hat... is dat simple enough for you's creature?
translation: Eger yaratik bana üzerinde centikler olan yayi gösterirse, sana flapper sapka veririm... Bu senin icin yeterince basit mi yaratik?

english: How many Chompies do I have to stick?
We'll dat's da fing wiv da hatsies, dey's many hatsies for da many chompies dat you stick. But you's godda get at least this many for a hat.~ Rantz flashes fingers at you, you think he means 30. ~
translation: Sapkalarla ilgili durum su, yapistirdigin Chompies sayisi kadar sapka var. Ama bir sapka almak icin en az bu kadarini yapistirmalisin.~ Rantz parmaklarini sana gösterir, sen 30 demek istedigini düsünürsün. ~

english: Can I have a hat please?
You's creature show me da bow den!
Sorry Rantz, I don't have the bow.
Dat's da shame thing dat is! No flapper hat for you den!
translation: Bu cok yazik! O zaman sana sapka yok!

english: Sorry, but der's no new hats for you this time! Go shoot some more chompies.
translation: Üzgünüm, ama bu sefer sana yeni sapka yok! Git biraz daha chompies vur.

english: Hey, yous creature needs to hunt da chompie  if you's wants der's flappy hat!
translation: Hey, yaratik, sapka istiyorsan chompie avlaman lazim!

english: Hey, yous creature needs to hunt more chompies if you's wants der's flappy hat!
translation: Hey, flapper sapka istiyorsan daha fazla chompies avlaman lazim!

english: Hey, you did good wiv da stabbie chucker, der's a flappy hat for ya.
translation: Hey, bicak aticiyla iyi is cikardin, sana flapper sapka var.

english: You's person has too much junk for da flappy hat... Rantz keeps it insteads! ~ Rantz chuckles to himself. ~
translation: Senin kiside flapper sapka icin cok fazla cöp var... Rantz onu sakliyor! ~ Rantz kendi kendine gülüyor. ~

english: Ok, thanks.
No space 'uman. Make some for da stabbies.
translation: Yer yok insan. Bicaklar icin yer ac.

english: Hav' da stabbies. More toe'morrow if you come see Rantz.
translation: Bicaklari al. Yarin Rantz'i görmeye gelirsen daha fazlasini alabilirsin.

english: You's already claimed da stabbies today 'uman. Come toe'morrow for mor'
translation: Bugün bicaklari zaten aldin insan. Yarin daha fazlasini almak icin gel.

No.

How do I get a hat?
How many chompies do I have to stick?
Can I have a hat please?
Ok, thanks.
Hello! Who are you?
Hi! My name is Raqueel. I work as a barmaid here in the clan hall. My friend, Gem, over there works here too.
translation: Merhaba! Benim adim Raqueel. Klan salonunda barmen olarak calisiyorum. Arkadasim Gem de burada calisiyor.

english: Really? I don't recall hiring you.
translation: Gercekten mi? Seni ise aldigimi hatirlamiyorum.

english: Wait, seriously? I could have sworn someone did. Oh no, Gem won't take this well.
translation: Bir dakika, ciddi misin? Birinin seni ise aldigini hatirliyorum. Olamaz, Gem bunu pek hos karsilamayacak.

english: Either way, I have beer! Would you like to buy some?
translation: Her neyse, biram var! Biraz almak ister misin?

english: I'd like to buy some beer.
No thank you.
That's alright. Just make sure your friends buy plenty of beer. If you're not paying my wages, we'll have to rely on commission!
translation: Sorun degil. Arkadaslarinin bol bol bira almasini sagla yeter. Maasimi sen ödemiyorsan, komisyondan kazanmamiz gerekecek!

english: I'll keep that in mind.
Hi again, Raqueel.
Oh hii! I just finished telling Gem about this time I was working with some geese. Ah, how time has flown since then. Anyway, what can I help you with?
translation: Merhaba! Gem'e kazlarla calistigim zamanlari anlatiyordum. Ah, o zamandan beri ne kadar zaman gecti. Neyse, nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: Oh hii! I was in the middle of singing this new song to Gem. She doesn't seem to like it much. Anyway, what can I do for you?
translation: Merhaba! Gem'e yeni bir sarki söylüyordum. Pek begenmedi galiba. Neyse, nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: Oh hii! I just thinking how I wish I had a pork and blue cheese pie right now. Mm-mmm. Anyway, how can I help?
translation: Merhaba! Su anda domuz eti ve mavi peynirli turta yiyebilmeyi ne kadar istedigimi düsünüyordum. Mm-mmm. Neyse, nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: Yay! That will be 5 coins, please.
Oh dear, I don't seem to have enough money.
translation: Oh hayir, yeterince param yok galiba.

english: That's alright. Come back when you do.
translation: Önemli degil. Paran oldugunda tekrar gel.

english: No way, that's too expensive.
Look, I don't choose the prices here. I'm just trying to make a living selling beer.
translation: Bak, fiyatlari ben belirlemiyorum. Ben sadece bira satarak gecimimi saglamaya calisiyorum.

english: That's fair enough.
Tell me more about yourself.
You want to know about me? Oh where do I begin. Let's see...
translation: Hakkimda mi bilmek istiyorsun? Nereden baslasam? Bir bakalim...

english: Gem, my friend over there, isn't actually called Gem. I came up with that name for her. It suits her, don't you think?
translation: Suradaki arkadasim Gem'in gercek adi Gem degil. Bu adi ona ben taktim. Ona yakisiyor, sence de öyle degil mi?

english: Fascinating. Thank you for sharing.
Sometimes, when the hall is empty, I like to stand up on the railing and pretend I'm singing at a stage in front of many people.
translation: Bazen salon bos oldugunda, korkuluga cikip bircok insanin önünde sahnede sarki söylüyormus gibi yapmayi seviyorum.

english: My favourite colour is purple!
I used to work with geese. One day they attacked me and since then I have had serious trust issues with them.
translation: Eskiden kazlarla calisiyordum. Bir gün bana saldirdilar ve o günden beri onlara karsi ciddi güven sorunlarim var.

english: I have to go. Good bye.
See you later!
Yes - buy beer.
No thank you.
I'd like to buy some beer.
Buy beer for 5 coins.
No way, that's too expensive.
Tell me more about yourself.
I have to go. Good bye.
Greetings friend. I am Rasolo, the famous merchant. Would you care to see my wares?
translation: Selam dostum. Ben Rasolo, ünlü tüccar. Mallarimi görmek ister misin?

english: No, not really.
As you wish. I will travel wherever the business takes me.
translation: Nasil istersen. Isim beni nereye götürürse oraya giderim.

english: Many thanks for returning my heirloom to me, adventurer. Would you like to buy something?
translation: Yadigârimi bana geri verdigin icin cok tesekkürler, maceraci. Bir sey satin almak ister misin?

english: I lost that ring you gave me...
Are you sure? I don't have it anymore...
Well, should you need a replacement, I suggest you free up some inventory room first...
translation: Peki, yenisini almak istersen, önce envanterinde yer acmani öneririm...

english: Then by all means, take another. Only a foolish merchant would give away his only stock!
translation: O zaman, tabii ki, bir tane daha al. Sadece aptal bir tüccar tek stokunu baskasina verir!

english: Now, can I offer you anything else?
What's with the furniture in this place?
Perhaps you refer to the lack of barstools and chairs. My customers have moved well beyond such trivial needs. However there are beds upstairs for the benefit of fleshy travellers.
translation: Belki de bar tabureleri ve sandalyelerin eksikliginden bahsediyorsun. Müsterilerim bu tür önemsiz ihtiyaclarin cok ötesine gectiler. Ancak, sisman yolcular icin üst katta yataklar var.

english: Now, can I offer you anything?
Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: Burada herhangi bir söylenti duydun mu?

english: Apparently Veos is looking for some help with something. He hangs around the docks of Port Piscarilius.
translation: Görünüse göre Veos bir konuda yardim ariyor. Port Piscarilius limaninda takiliyor.

english: They say there's trouble in Port Piscarilius. Something about gangs uniting. Might be worth looking into.
translation: Port Piscarilius'ta sorunlar oldugunu söylüyorlar. Cetelerin birlestigi ile ilgili bir sey. Arastirmaya deger olabilir.

english: I hear that Lord Hosidius has misplaced one of his sons. The Hosidius family might pay a lot to see him returned safely.
translation: Lord Hosidius'un ogullarindan birini kaybettigini duydum. Hosidius ailesi onu sag salim geri getirmek icin cok para ödeyebilir.

english: Phileas Rimor has supposedly been looking for some assistance with something in Shayzien. Maybe worth investigating.
translation: Phileas Rimor'un Shayzien'de bir konuda yardim aradigi söyleniyor. Arastirmaya deger olabilir.

english: I hear that the rulers of Lovakengj have some work available. You'll find them in the Lovakengj Assembly.
translation: Lovakengj'in yöneticilerinin bazi isleri oldugunu duydum. Onlari Lovakengj Meclisi'nde bulabilirsin.

english: Apparently there's been some commotion in the middle of Arceuus. Might be worth checking out.
translation: Görünüse göre Arceuus'un ortasinda bazi karisikliklar olmus. Bir göz atmaya deger olabilir.

english: That protest outside Kourend Castle is starting to attract some attention. Could be worth taking a look.
translation: Kourend Kalesi'nin disindaki protesto dikkat cekmeye basladi. Bir göz atmaya deger olabilir.

english: No, it hasn't been very busy lately.
translation: Hayir, son zamanlarda cok yogun degildi.

english: Nothing.
Can I have a beer, please?

Hello there!
Oh, hello. I'd love to chat right now, but I'm a bit busy. Perhaps you could come back and chat another time?
translation: Merhaba. Su anda sohbet etmek isterdim ama biraz mesgulüm. Belki baska bir zaman gelip sohbet edebiliriz?

english: Of course. Sorry to bother you!
translation: Tabii ki. Rahatsiz ettigim icin özür dilerim!

english: Not at all! Farewell!
Hello!
No problem! Say, have you been to see the wizard'stower in the south yet? It's an amazing sight! You should go and see it!
translation: Sorun degil! Bu arada, güneydeki büyücünün kulesini gördün mü? Muhtesem bir manzara! Gidip görmelisin!

english: Thanks! I will!
Welcome to the ratpit bar, human traveller.
translation: Ratpit bar'a hos geldin, insan gezgin.

english: I'd like a beer please.
That'll be 2 gold coins.
Sorry, I don't have 2 coins on me.
Thanks for your custom.
Sorry, I changed my mind.
I'd like some food please.
I can make you a stew for 20 gold coins.
translation: 20 altin karsiliginda sana bir güvec yapabilirim.

english: Sorry, I don't have 20 coins on me.
I have to go.
I'd like a beer please.
Pay.
Don't pay.
I'd like some food please.
I have to go
Wooooo! Ooooooooooohh!
Hmm, I wonder if there's something I could use to communicate with him.
translation: Hmm, onunla iletisim kurmak icin kullanabilecegim bir sey var mi acaba?

english: Aaah! What are you doing down here!?
Hey, keep it down! I've come to slay the monsters down here.
translation: Hey, sesini alcalt! Buradaki canavarlari öldürmeye geldim.

english: Oh, that's ok then. These vile creatures do make an awful racket.
translation: Oh, o zaman sorun yok. Bu igrenc yaratiklar gercekten cok gürültü yapiyorlar.

english: You should hear it upstairs! Those Aberrant Spectres are just the worst.
translation: Yukarida da duyarsin! O Aberrant Spectres en kötüleridir.

english: Who are you anyway?
I'm Raulyn. Once servant to the great Viggora who built this place centuries ago.
translation: Ben Raulyn. Yüzyillar önce burayi insa eden büyük Viggora'nin hizmetkariydim.

english: This was, of course, before the building started to sink into the swamp...
translation: Tabii bu, bina batakliga batmaya baslamadan önceydi...

english: Oh, and the darn Zamorakian mages. They didn't help matters. Always making a mess.
translation: Oh, ve lanet Zamorakian büyücüleri. Onlar da isleri zorlastirdi. Her zaman ortaligi dagitirlar.

english: I've been here ever since. You're the first person I've spoken to in over 200 years.
translation: O zamandan beri buradayim. 200 yildir konustugum ilk kisisin.

english: Don't you ever get lonely?
Sometimes, but it's not all that bad. I hope you stop by more often!
translation: Bazen, ama o kadar da kötü degil. Umarim daha sik ugrarsin!

english: Hopefully! I should be going now, speak to you later.
Goodbye stranger.
wooooo ooo woo-woo
I don't think that's what you're meant to be slaying.
translation: Sanirim öldürmen gereken sey bu degil.

english: Oh, hello again. Want to buy some armour?
translation: Merhaba, tekrar. Zirh almak ister misin?

english: I'll have a look.
Not right now.
I'll have a look.
Not right now.
Oh, look! A raven!
Nope, we're not doing that again!
Wait... What? Doing what?
The serum works...but it's not too fresh, make some yourself and then it might work for longer.
translation: Serum ise yariyor... ama cok taze degil, kendin yaparsan daha uzun süre ise yarayabilir.

english: Ah, it's you, how's it going?
Can you open a store for me?
translation: Benim icin bir magaza acabilir misin?

english: Sure, which store do you wanna see?
Ok, thanks
Well done...I feel this serum is really working on me. I think you've cracked it my friend!  I'd like to give you something for your trouble!
translation: Aferin... Bu serumun bende gercekten ise yaradigini hissediyorum. Sanirim sorunu cözdün dostum! Zahmetin icin sana bir sey vermek istiyorum!

english: You've already used the permanent serum on me, you don't need to use that any more.
translation: Bana kalici serumu zaten kullandin, artik ona ihtiyacin yok.

english: Can I see the general store please?
Can I see the building store please?
Ok, thanks.
Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: Hey, bu Kahraman! Vay canina! Harikasin, o iki juvinate ve Gadderank'i nasil alt ettin? Ve kasaba cok güzel, harika bir is cikarmissin!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
Huh! I'm Razvan, ravaging after food is what I mostly do...occasionally I'll happen across a rat...and that's a good day...just like today!
translation: Huh! Ben Razvan, cogunlukla yiyecek pesinde kosuyorum... ara sira bir fareye rastlarim... ve o gün güzel bir gündür... tipki bugün gibi!

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: Oh, pek bir sey yok, hepimiz hala vampirlerden saklaniyoruz ve bu korkunc yerden gecimimizi sagliyoruz, umarim yakinda Salve'deki tapinaga yolculuk yapacak kadar gücleniriz.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: Bildigim kadariyla yok, su anda cok yararli olan bazi temel olanaklara sahibiz, hepimiz size cok minnettariz. Daha önce hic bir kahraman görmedim veya tanimadim, bu yüzden karsilastiracak bir seyim yok, ama sanirim

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: cogu insanin görüsüne göre, siz bir kahramansiniz! Ben sahsen sizinle tanistigima cok memnunum.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Ok, thanks.
Citizens of West Ardougne! King Tyras needs you for his Royal Army! Who will join this noble cause?
translation: Bati Ardougne vatandaslari! Kral Tyras, Kraliyet Ordusu icin size ihtiyac duyuyor! Bu asil davaya kimler katilacak?

english: Plague bringer!
King Tyras is scum!
Tyras will be informed of these words of treason!
translation: Tyras bu ihanet sözlerinden haberdar edilecek!

english: Someone throws a tomato at the recruiter.
translation: Biri askere alma görevlisine domates atiyor.

english: Don't bother me!
Arr, Matey!
I'm in search of treasure.
Arr, treasure you be after eh? Well I might be able to tell you where to find some... For a price...
translation: Hazine mi ariyorsun? Nerede bulabilecegini söyleyebilirim... Bir bedel karsiliginda...

english: What sort of price?
Well for example if you can get me a bottle of rum... Not just any rum mind...
translation: Örnegin, bana bir sise rom getirirsen... Herhangi bir rom degil...

english: I'd like some rum made on Karamja Island. There's no rum like Karamja Rum!
translation: Karamja Adasi'nda üretilmis rom istiyorum. Karamja Romu gibisi yoktur!

english: Would some Braindeath 'Rum' do?
Gadzooks, that swill! Not a chance!
translation: Haydi ama, o pislik! Hayatta olmaz!

english: It's Karamja Rum or no deal.
translation: Karamja Romu ya da anlasma yok.

english: Ok, I will bring you some rum.
Yer a saint, although it'll take a miracle to get it off Karamja.
translation: Sen bir azizsin, ama Karamja'dan onu almak icin bir mucize gerekir.

english: What do you mean?
The Customs office has been clampin' down on the export of spirits. You seem like a resourceful young [lad/lass], I'm sure ye'll be able to find a way to slip the stuff past them.
translation: Gümrük idaresi alkollü iceceklerin ihracatini siki bir sekilde denetliyor. Sen becerikli bir genc  gibi görünüyorsun, eminim onlari atlatmanin bir yolunu bulabilirsin.

english: Well I'll give it a shot.
Arr, that's the spirit!
Not right now.
Fair enough. I'll still be here and thirsty whenever you feel like helpin' out.
translation: Anlasildi. Ne zaman yardim etmek istersen ben hala burada ve susuz olacagim.

english: Arr!
Arr!
Do you have anything for trade?
translation: Takas edecek bir seyin var mi?

english: Nothin' at the moment, but then again the Customs Agents are on the warpath right now.
translation: Su anda yok, ama gümrük memurlari su anda savas modundalar.

english: Thanks fer the thought, but I still have to finish this bottle.
translation: Düsüncen icin tesekkürler, ama yine de bu siseyi bitirmem lazim.

english: I'm in search of treasure.
Yes.
No.
Do you have anything for trade?
translation: Takas edecek bir seyin var mi?

english: Hello.
Welcome, traveller.
Could you tell me about crystal singing?
translation: Bana kristal sarki söyleme hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Of course! We elves learned the art long ago, allowing us to form crystals in any way we would like, using just our voices.
translation: Tabii ki! Biz elfler bu sanati uzun zaman önce ögrendik, sadece sesimizi kullanarak istedigimiz sekilde kristaller olusturabiliyoruz.

english: It's allowed us to make weapons, armour and tools using the finest crystals.
translation: Bu sayede en kaliteli kristallerden silahlar, zirhlar ve aletler yapabiliyoruz.

english: Wow. Is there any way I could do it?
translation: Vay canina. Ben de yapabilir miyim?

english: You might be able to with the help of the crystal bowl over there. As long as you've got the right knowledge of what you're trying to craft.
translation: Suradaki kristal kase yardimiyla yapabilirsin. Tabii ne yapmaya calistigini dogru bir sekilde biliyorsan.

english: Could you do it for me?
You do not have all of the required materials and requirements to make anything.
translation: Herhangi bir sey yapmak icin gerekli tüm malzemelere ve kosullara sahip degilsin.

english: Thanks!
Of course! Would you like me to craft something for you? For some crystal shards, of course.
translation: Tabii ki! Senin icin bir sey yapmami ister misin? Tabii ki kristal parcalari karsiliginda.

english: Yes please.
No, thank you. I'd just like to hear you sing.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler. Sadece sarki söylemeni dinlemek istiyorum.

english: Reese sings you a beautiful song of the elves.
translation: Reese sana elflerin güzel bir sarkisini söyler.

english: Wow! Thank you.
Could you tell me about crystal singing?
translation: Bana kristal sarki söyleme hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Could you do it for me?
Thanks!
Could you sing a song for me?
translation: Benim icin bir sarki söyler misin?

english: Yes please.
No, thank you. I'd just like to hear you sing.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler. Sadece sarki söylemeni dinlemek istiyorum.

english: I cannot speak to you outerlander! Talk to Brundt, the Chieftain!
translation: Seninle konusamam yabanci! Sef Brundt ile konus!

english: Hello, are you a member of the council?
I am afraid not outerlander. Goodbye.
Hello.
Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: Merhaba kardesim Dokrak. Bugün benden ne istiyorsun? Her zaman yardimima güvenebilirsin!

english: Nothing thanks. I just fancied a chat.
translation: Hicbir sey, tesekkürler. Sadece sohbet etmek istedim.

english: My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
translation: Yardimima ihtiyacin olursa kapim her zaman acik Dokrak.

english: [Fremennik name]... It has been too long since last we met!
translation: Dokrak... Son görüsmemizden bu yana cok zaman gecti!

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: Hos geldin kardesim Dokrak. Seni burada görmek her zaman bir zevk!

english: My apologies [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: Özür dilerim kardesim Dokrak! Burada seninle vakit gecirecek vaktim yok!

english: That's okay, I didn't really want anything.
translation: Önemli degil, aslinda bir sey istememistim.

english: How are you [Fremennik name]? I hope all fares well with you this day!
translation: Nasilsin Dokrak? Umarim bugün her sey yolundadir!

english: I'm fine, thanks, how are you?
All is well with me also!
Hello to you, too!
Hello. Did you want something [Fremennik name]?
translation: Merhaba. Bir sey mi istiyordun Dokrak?

english: No, not really.
Well... okay then!
Always good to see you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].
translation: Seni görmek her zaman güzel kardesim Dokrak.

english: Greetings [Madam/Sir].
Tell me about the Shot Put area.
Of course [Madam/Sir]. There are two different weights of shot...
translation: Tabii ki . Iki farkli agirlikta shot var...

english: Shot?
Yes [Madam/Sir]. Shot. The iron spheres that are propelled by the chemical energy stored in your body.
translation: Evet . Gülle. Vücudunuzda depolanan kimyasal enerjiyle firlatilan demir küreler.

english: The... what?
Your strength [Madam/Sir]. The stronger you are, the further you can throw the shot, but there are other factors of course, like your technique.
translation: Gücünüz . Ne kadar güclüyseniz, gülle o kadar uzaga firlatabilirsiniz, ama elbette teknik gibi baska faktörler de var.

english: What's that then?
The style of the shot [Madam/Sir].
Iron has style??
The Referee sighs, rolls his eyes and continues....
translation: Hakem ic ceker, gözlerini devirir ve devam eder...

english: [Madam/Sir], the style in which you throw the shot, not the style of the iron.
translation: , demirin stili degil, atisi yaptiginiz stil.

english: Oh! You mean the spinny round thing or the chuck it straight?
translation: Oh! Yani dönen yuvarlak sey mi, yoksa düz atis mi?

english: Crudely put [Madam/Sir], but yes. Some are more difficult than others. Experiment and see which you prefer.
translation: Kaba bir ifadeyle , ama evet. Bazilari digerlerinden daha zordur. Deneme yapin ve hangisini tercih ettiginizi görün.

english: Thanks for the help!
You are welcome [Madam/Sir].
May I claim my tokens please?
Of course! Here you go, you've earned [X] tokens!
Thanks!
You don't have space to carry them.
I'm afraid you have not earned any tokens yet. Try some of the activities around the guild to earn some.
translation: Maalesef henüz jeton kazanmadiniz. Lonca cevresindeki etkinliklerden bazilarini deneyerek jeton kazanabilirsiniz.

english: Ok, I'll go see what I can find.
Do you have any tips for me?
translation: Bana verebileceginiz bir ipucu var mi?

english: Tips [Madam/Sir]?
Yes, like how can I do better than everyone else.
translation: Evet, digerlerinden daha iyi performans gösterebilmek icin.

english: [Madam/Sir] may find that a fine powder applied to the hands may give one an advantage when putting the shot.
translation: , ellerinize ince bir toz sürerseniz atis yaparken avantaj saglayabilecegini göreceksiniz.

english: You mean if I grind something up and put dust on my hands I'll chuck the ball further?
translation: Yani bir seyi ögütüp ellerime toz sürersem topu daha uzaga atabilir miyim?

english: Yes [Madam/Sir].
Bye!
Good luck [Madam/Sir].
Well done. You threw the shot [1-14] yards!
Hey! You can't take that, it's guild property. Take one from the pile.
translation: Hey! Onu alamazsin, o lonca mali. Yigindan bir tane al.

english: Oi! Watch where you're throwing that [player name]!
translation: Hey! Nereye attigina dikkat et Maceraci!

english: Tell me about the Shot Put area.
May I claim my tokens please?
Do you have any tips for me?
translation: Bana verebileceginiz bir ipucu var mi?

english: Bye!
What do you require, traveller? I deal in many things.
translation: Neye ihtiyacin var, yolcu? Bircok seyle ugrasirim.

english: Let's see what you've got.
Who are you?
My name is Regath, traveller.
What is this place?
This place is a union of the mystical and the mundane, where the magical realm reaches out to touch the humdrum world of commerce.
translation: Burasi mistik ve siradan olanin birlestigi, büyülü alemin siradan ticaret dünyasina uzandigi bir yer.

english: Or, in terms that you may understand more easily, this place is a shop that sells magic stuff for money. Though I also trade in various other items.
translation: Ya da daha kolay anlayabilecegin bir ifadeyle, burasi para karsiliginda büyülü esyalar satan bir dükkan. Ama baska cesitli esyalar da satiyorum.

english: I don't need anything.
I have a question for you.
Nice work!
You've [been given a new clue/obtained a casket]!
Let's see what you've got.
Who are you?
I don't need anything.
That sounds really boring.
What does?
Whatever you plan on saying.
Oh.
I'll one day be the very best.
Oh yeah?
That no was ever was.
...Uh huh.
To catch th-
I'm just going to stop you right there...
That's probably for the best.
Who are you?
I'm... Me.
Hi me.
Why, hello you!
...I'm not you.
Who are you?
Me.
I'm me too!
But you're not the real you.
Woah.
Nilsal, adventurer. The name is Regulus Cento, one of the quetzal keepers for the Royal Family of Varlamore.
translation: Nilsal, maceraci. Adim Regulus Cento, Varlamore Kraliyet Ailesi'nin quetzal bekcilerinden biriyim.

english: Quetzal? What's a quetzal?
Well just look here to my dear companion, Primio, and you'll have your answer. Varlamore is a large and diverse kingdom, but thanks to our quetzals, navigating it is as straightforward as can be.
translation: Sevgili arkadasim Primio'ya bak, cevabi orada bulacaksin. Varlamore büyük ve cesitlilik dolu bir kralliktir, ama quetzallarimiz sayesinde bu krallikta yolunu bulmak cok kolaydir.

english: Sounds exciting!
You're not wrong there. Nothing beats taking to the skies.
translation: Haklisin. Gökyüzüne cikmaktan daha güzel bir sey yoktur.

english: Speaking of which, Crown Prince Itzla Arkan has asked Primio and I to escort you to our capital city of Civitas illa Fortis, or Fortis as we prefer to call it. Is that something you'd be interested in?
translation: Bu arada, Veliaht Prens Itzla Arkan, Primio ve benden seni baskentimiz Civitas illa Fortis'e, ya da bizim tercih ettigimiz adiyla Fortis'e götürmemizi istedi. Bu senin ilgini ceker mi?

english: Of course!

Excellent! Now, I know Prince Itzla is very keen to meet with you once we reach the capital, so he's sending the Tullus twins to greet you on arrival. I'll be sure to point them out to you once we're there.
translation: Harika! Prens Itzla, baskente vardigimizda sizinle tanismak icin cok hevesli, bu yüzden Tullus ikizlerini sizi karsilamaya gönderiyor. Oraya vardigimizda size onlari gösterecegim.

english: Sounds good.
So, ready for your first journey to Varlamore?
translation: Peki, Varlamore'a ilk seyahatinize hazir misiniz?

english: Let's do it!
