Kuani! We will depart at once.
Well, here we are! Welcome to Fortis!
It's beautiful!
I'm glad you think so! Now, I'm sure you're keen to get exploring, but Prince Itzla is very keen to meet with you first.
translation: Öyle düsünmenize sevindim! Simdi, kesfetmeye can atiyorsunuzdur ama Prens Itzla önce sizinle tanismak istiyor.

english: You mentioned he'd be sending some people to meet with me?
translation: Beni karsilamak icin birkac kisi gönderecegini söylemistin, degil mi?

english: Yes, the Tullus twins. That's them just to the west, by the stairs up to the palace. Why don't you head on over and introduce yourself?
translation: Evet, Tullus ikizleri. Saraya cikan merdivenlerin batisinda duruyorlar. Gidip kendini tanitsan nasil olur?

english: There's something I need to do first.
translation: Önce yapmam gereken bir sey var.

english: Very well. I will wait for you here.
Nilsal, adventurer. Are you ready for your first journey to Varlamore?
translation: Nilsal, maceraci. Varlamore'a ilk seyahatin icin hazir misin?

english: Nilsal, adventurer. Do you wish to travel to Fortis?
translation: Nilsal, maceraci. Fortis'e gitmek ister misin?

english: Yes please.
Then we will depart at once.
No thanks.
Very well.
Look'slike you won’t be taking to the skies just yet though…
Nilsal, adventurer. Do you wish to return to Varrock?
translation: Nilsal, maceraci. Varrock'a dönmek ister misin?

english: Let's do it!
There's something I need to do first.
translation: Önce yapmam gereken bir sey var.

english: Yes please.
No thanks.
Welcome to my home. Is there anything you wanted?
translation: Evime hos geldin. Bir sey ister misin?

english: Nothing in particular. Got any sightseeing tips?
translation: Özel bir sey yok. Gezi icin önerin var mi?

english: No, I'm just a factory worker. Don't do tours.
translation: Hayir, ben sadece bir fabrika iscisiyim. Tur yapmiyorum.

english: This doesn't look like a factory.
This is my home. I'm off-duty.
That idiot Armod should never have burned his diary!
Good day, traveller.
And to you.
Good to see you, [Fremennik name]!
Hello there. You're a long way from home.
Well what sort of Fremennik are you if you don't travel! Besides, we heard this was the land to visit for breaking skulls and spilling blood!
translation: Seyahat etmeyen bir Fremennik ne ise yarar ki! Ayrica, burasinin kafalari kirip kan dökmek icin ziyaret edilmesi gereken bir yer oldugunu duyduk!

english: Of course! Have you not visited the Colosseum? You won't regret it if you do.
translation: Tabii ki! Kolezyum'u ziyaret etmedin mi? Gidersen pisman olmazsin.

english: Hmm... I might have to check it out.
Ha! As if you didn't know! We've heard about your exploits in the Colosseum! Maybe you'll see us next time you're there!
translation: Ha! Sanki bilmiyormussun gibi! Kolezyum'daki kahramanliklarini duyduk! Belki bir dahaki sefere oraya gittiginde bizi görürsün!

english: Armour!
Get your leather armour here!
Leather!
Frog-leather!
Hello stranger.
I'm in search of a quest.
Hmmm. I don't... believe there are any here...
Let me think actually...
Ah yes. I know. If you look in a book called 'The Shield of Arrav', you'll find a quest in there.
translation: Ah evet. Biliyorum. “Arrav'in Kalkani” adli kitaba bakarsan, orada bir görev bulacaksin.

english: I'm not sure where the book is mind you... but I'm sure it's around here somewhere.
translation: Kitabin nerede oldugunu bilmiyorum ama eminim buralarda bir yerdedir.

english: Thank you.
The Wise Old Man of Draynor Village sent you this message.
translation: Draynor Köyü'nün Bilge Yasli Adami sana bu mesaji gönderdi.

english: Ah, I am always delighted to hear from him. You would not imagine the depths of his wisdom!
translation: Ah, ondan haber almak her zaman beni cok mutlu eder. Onun bilgeliginin derinligini hayal bile edemezsin!

english: I'd give you a reward, but you don't seem to have any space for it. Come back when you do.
translation: Sana bir ödül vermek isterdim, ama bunun icin yerin yok gibi görünüyor. Yer acildiginda tekrar gel.

english: King Roald has been very generous with my salary, so I can spare you some coins for your trouble.
translation: Kral Roald maasimda cok cömert davrandi, bu yüzden zahmetin icin sana biraz para verebilirim.

english: These little things seem to be everywhere these days! Perhaps you'd like them?
translation: Bu kücük seyler son zamanlarda her yerde görünüyor! Belki sen de istersin?

english: My old friend Aubury sent me some runes in return for some books he wanted. Perhaps you'd like them?
translation: Eski dostum Aubury, istedigi kitaplar karsiliginda bana bazi runeler gönderdi. Belki sen de istersin?

english: Do you have anything to trade?
translation: Takas edecek bir seyin var mi?

english: Only knowledge.
How much do you want for that then?
translation: O zaman bunun icin ne kadar istiyorsun?

english: No, sorry, that was just my little joke. I'm not the trading type.
translation: Hayir, üzgünüm, sadece saka yapiyordum. Ben takas eden biri degilim.

english: Ah well.
What do you do?
I am the palace librarian.
Ah. That's why you're in the library then.
translation: Ah. O zaman bu yüzden kütüphanedesin.

english: Yes.
Although I would probably be in here even if I didn't work here. I like reading. Someday I hope to catalogue all of the information stored in these books so all may read it.
translation: Ama burada calismasam da muhtemelen yine de burada olurdum. Okumayi severim. Bir gün bu kitaplarda bulunan tüm bilgileri kataloglayip herkesin okuyabilmesini umuyorum.

english: About that book... where is it again?
I'm not sure where it is exactly... but I'm sure it's around here somewhere.
translation: Tam olarak nerede oldugunu bilmiyorum... ama eminim buralarda bir yerdedir.

english: Ok. I've read the book. Do you know where I can find the Phoenix Gang?
translation: Tamam. Kitabi okudum. Phoenix Cetesi'ni nerede bulabilirim biliyor musun?

english: No, I don't. I think I know someone who might however.
translation: Hayir, bilmiyorum. Ama bilen birini taniyorum.

english: If I were you I would talk to Baraek, the fur trader in the market place. I've heard he has connections with the Phoenix Gang.
translation: Yerinde olsam, pazardaki kürk tüccari Baraek ile konusurdum. Phoenix Cetesi ile baglantilari oldugunu duydum.

english: Thanks, I'll try that!
What do you know about the Imcando dwarves?
The Imcando dwarves, you say?
Ah yes... for many hundreds of years they were the world's most skilled smiths. They used secret smithing knowledge passed down from generation to generation.
translation: Ah evet... Yüzlerce yil boyunca dünyanin en yetenekli demircileriydiler. Nesilden nesile aktarilan gizli demircilik bilgilerini kullanirlardi.

english: Unfortunately, about a century ago, the once thriving race was wiped out during the barbarian invasions of that time.
translation: Ne yazik ki, yaklasik bir asir önce, bir zamanlar gelisen bu irk, o dönemdeki barbar istilalari sirasinda yok edildi.

english: So are there any Imcando left at all?
I believe a few of them survived, but with the bulk of their population destroyed their numbers have dwindled even further.
translation: Sanirim birkac tanesi hayatta kaldi, ama nüfuslarinin büyük bir kismi yok edildigi icin sayilari daha da azaldi.

english: They tend to keep to themselves, and they tend not to tell people they're descendants of the Imcando, which is why people think the tribe is extinct. However...
translation: Kendilerine saklanma egilimindedirler ve Imcando'nun torunlari olduklarini insanlara söylemezler, bu yüzden insanlar bu kabilenin soyunun tükendigini düsünür. Ancak...

english: ... you could try taking them some redberry pie. They REALLY like redberry pie. I believe I remember a couple living in Asgarnia near the cliffs on the Asgarnian southern peninsula.
translation: ... onlara kirmizi meyveli turta götürebilirsin. Kirmizi meyveli turtayi COK severler. Asgarnia'nin güney yarimadasindaki kayaliklarin yakininda yasayan bir cift hatirliyorum.

english: What can you tell me about this brooch?
I've never seen that symbol before. Where did you find it?
translation: Bu sembolü daha önce hic görmedim. Nerede buldun?

english: In a cave beneath Lumbridge.
Very odd. Have you any idea how it got there?
translation: Cok garip. Oraya nasil geldigi hakkinda bir fikrin var mi?

english: A goblin might have dropped it.
I've never heard of a goblin carrying a brooch like this. But just a minute...
translation: Böyle bir bros tasiyan bir goblin duymadim hic. Ama bir dakika...

english: The other day I filed a book about ancient goblin tribes. It's somewhere at the west end of the library, I think. Maybe that will be of some use.
translation: Gecen gün eski goblin kabileleri hakkinda bir kitap dosyaladim. Kütüphanenin bati ucunda bir yerde, sanirim. Belki bir faydasi olur.

english: I've come from Hugi, he suggested that I speak to you.
Hugi? I haven't seen him for a long time! He's still in Keldagrim, is he?
translation: Hugi mi? Onu uzun zamandir görmedim! Hala Keldagrim'de, degil mi?

english: Perhaps I should go there again some day, now that humans are allowed in again.
translation: Artik insanlar oraya girebiliyorsa, belki bir gün tekrar oraya gitmeliyim.

english: I've come to ask you about the Imcando dwarves. Hugi says you might know something about them.
translation: Imcando cüceleri hakkinda sana bir sey sormaya geldim. Hugi, senin onlar hakkinda bir seyler bildigini söyledi.

english: Ah yes... the master smiths among the dwarves. They used secret smithing knowledge passed down from generation to generation.
translation: Ah evet... cüceler arasinda usta demirciler. Nesilden nesile aktarilan gizli demircilik bilgilerini kullanirlardi.

english: I believe I remember a couple living in Asgarnia near the cliffs on the Asgarnian southern peninusla, but they DO tend to keep to themselves.
translation: Asgarnia'nin güney yarimadasindaki kayaliklarin yakininda yasayan bir cift hatirliyorum, ama onlar kendilerine saklanan tiplerdir.

english: They tend not to tell people that they're the descendants of the Imcando, which is why people think that the tribe has died out totally, but you may well have more luck talking to them if you bring them some
translation: Imcando'nun torunlari olduklarini kimseye söylemezler, bu yüzden insanlar bu kabilenin tamamen yok oldugunu düsünür, ama onlara biraz

english: redberry pie. They REALLY like redberry pie.
translation: kirmizi meyveli turta götürürseniz, onlarla konusmak daha kolay olabilir. Kirmizi meyveli turtayi COK severler.

english: Hello.
Hello Reldo.
Go on. Ask him.
Ok, ok. I'm on it.
Do you know anything about Robert the Strong?
translation: Güclü Robert hakkinda bir sey biliyor musun?

english: Hmm... wow... let me see... there is a mention of him in one of my books on the history of Gielinor.
translation: Hmm... vay canina... bir bakayim... Gielinor tarihi ile ilgili kitaplarimdan birinde ondan bahsediliyor.

english: Fourth Age... Popular Lore... Ah here we are, Robert the Strong! 'Not much is known about the hero called by the people of Asgarnia: Robert the Strong. Most folk tales describe him as being taller than the tallest human
translation: Dördüncü Cag... Popüler Bilgelik... Ah, iste burada, Güclü Robert! "Asgarnia halkinin Güclü Robert olarak adlandirdigi kahraman hakkinda pek bir sey bilinmiyor. Cogu halk hikayesi onu en uzun insandan daha uzun

english: and far stronger than the strongest man. He wields a six foot tall longbow and travels with his faithful panther Odysseus. He is said to have had a personal crusade against the Dragonkin...'
translation: ve en güclü adamdan cok daha güclü olarak tanimliyor. Alti fit uzunlugunda bir yay kullaniyor ve sadik panteri Odysseus ile seyahat ediyor. Dragonkin'e karsi kisisel bir hacli seferi yaptigi söyleniyor..."

english: Well that's everything we know about him and that is from folk tales.
translation: Onun hakkinda bildigimiz her sey bu ve bunlar halk hikayelerinden alinmis bilgiler.

english: Dragonkin?

I'm coming to that. 'The stories tell of the Dragonkin being an intelligent race of bird like creatures that walked rather than used their wings. They are said to be immortal but cannot reproduce, because of this they
translation: O konuya da gelecegim. "Hikayeler, ejderhalarin kanatlarini kullanmak yerine yürüyen, kus benzeri yaratiklardan olusan zeki bir irk oldugunu anlatir. Ölümsüz olduklari söylenir, ancak üreyemezler, bu nedenle

english: became very afraid of death and shunned all other races. The Dragonkin supposedly made corrupted versions of themselves for protection, what we now know as dragons.'
translation: ölümden cok korkarlar ve diger tüm irklardan uzak dururlar. Ejderhalar, korunmak icin kendilerinin bozulmus versiyonlarini yaratmislardir, bugün ejderhalar olarak bildigimiz yaratiklari."

english: Doesn't sound very believable.

Very little is known about this early part of Gielinor, but unlike many scholars, I believe that folk tales are based on events that actually happened. It is the way history has been passed down generations before we had
translation: Gielinor'un bu erken dönemleri hakkinda cok az sey biliniyor, ancak bircok akademisyenin aksine, halk hikayelerinin gercekte yasanmis olaylara dayandigini düsünüyorum. Bu, tarihi kayit altina alabilme imkanimiz olmadan önce, tarih nesiller boyunca aktarilma sekliydi.

english: a way of recording it.
Thank you Reldo, you've been most... helpful.
That was a nice tale for mothers to tell their children but I don't see how this helps Bob?
translation: Bu, annelerin cocuklarina anlatmasi icin güzel bir masal, ama bunun Bob'a nasil yardimci olacagini anlamiyorum?

english: Don't you think it's odd that no one knows where Bob came from?
translation: Bob'un nereden geldigini kimsenin bilmemesi tuhaf degil mi sence?

english: I guess, but he's just a cat... right?
translation: Sanirim, ama o sadece bir kedi... degil mi?

english: I'd hoped you would've understood by now that there's more to cats than humans believe!
translation: Kedilerin, insanlarin inandigindan daha fazlasi oldugunu simdiye kadar anlamis olmani umuyordum!

english: Ok, ok! I get your point, after all I'm being dragged round Gielinor by... my cat!
translation: Tamam, tamam! Anliyorum, sonucta Gielinor'da beni sürükleyen... kedim!

english: I wouldn't say dragged... let's call it a partnership!
Ok!
Bob?!
Let's ask Bob!
Let's go!
Hello. I was wondering if you could help me with something.
translation: Merhaba. Bana bir konuda yardim edebilir misiniz diye merak ediyordum.

english: What do you need?
I'm looking for information on a Fourth Age hero. His name was Tristan and he fought alongside Robert the Strong.
translation: Dördüncü Cag'in bir kahramani hakkinda bilgi ariyorum. Adi Tristan'di ve Robert the Strong ile birlikte savasmisti.

english: Ah you must mean Tristan Corvo. I can't remember anyone ever asking about him before, most prefer to hear about the bigger heroes like Arrav or Robert.
translation: Ah, Tristan Corvo'yu kastediyorsunuz herhalde. Daha önce kimse onun hakkinda soru sormamisti, cogu kisi Arrav veya Robert gibi daha büyük kahramanlari duymayi tercih ediyor.

english: But you know about Tristan?
Oh yes. What was it you wanted to learn?
I'd like to learn about his descendants. I know they lived in this area.
translation: Onun soyundan gelenler hakkinda bilgi almak istiyorum. Bu bölgede yasadiklarini biliyorum.

english: Well we do have census records which date back to when the city was still called Avarrocka. I'm afraid we don't have anything from before that time though.
translation: Sehrin adi hala Avarrocka iken yapilan nüfus sayimi kayitlari var. Ama o dönemden öncesine ait hicbir seyimiz yok maalesef.

english: Hmmm. It might still be worth a look. Where can I find this information?
translation: Hmmm. Yine de bakmaya deger olabilir. Bu bilgileri nerede bulabilirim?

english: I have a book around here somewhere with all of the details, why don't you see if you can find it. It's red if I remember right.
translation: Buralarda tüm detaylarin bulundugu bir kitap var, bir bakin bakalim bulabilir misiniz. Hatirladigim kadariyla kirmizi renkteydi.

english: Have you found that book yet?
I have it here.
Wonderful, let's have a look.
So what does the book say?
Okay let's see... The Corvo family... Here we are! According to this there was a family by the name of Corvo living in Avarrocka for most of the Fourth Age.
translation: Tamam, bir bakalim... Corvo ailesi... Iste burada! Buna göre, Dördüncü Cag'in büyük bir bölümünde Avarrocka'da Corvo adinda bir aile yasiyordu.

english: The last entry is from the year 1770 of the Fourth Age.
translation: Son kayit Dördüncü Cag'in 1770 yilina ait.

english: What happened to them?
Impossible to say for sure but it was around that time that many people left Misthalin to settle in Morytania. It's possible that the Corvo family was among them.
translation: Kesin olarak söylemek imkansiz, ancak o dönemde bircok insan Misthalin'i terk edip Morytania'ya yerlesmisti. Corvo ailesi de onlarin arasinda olabilir.

english: I'm afraid that's all the help I can provide. Port Phasmatys is where most of the Morytania settlers wound up. Perhaps you'll find what you're looking for there.
translation: Maalesef size yardimci olabilecegim tek sey bu. Morytania'ya yerlesenlerin cogu Port Phasmatys'e yerlesmistir. Belki aradiginiz seyi orada bulabilirsiniz.

english: Okay, thanks Reldo.
I found it but then I lost it.
You lost it?
I'm sorry. I'm a terrible person.
Well you'd better find it again. These books are very valuable.
translation: Tekrar bulsan iyi olur. Bu kitaplar cok degerli.

english: Not yet.
I know it's around here somewhere. It's red if I remember right.
translation: Buralarda bir yerde oldugunu biliyorum. Hatirladigim kadariyla kirmiziydi.

english: Hello.
Did you have any luck finding the Corvo family?
Port Phasmatys might be a good place to look. It's where most of the Morytania settlers wound up.
translation: Port Phasmatys aramak icin iyi bir yer olabilir. Morytania'dan gelen yerlesimcilerin cogu oraya yerlesmisti.

english: Hi Reldo, I have come to ask you to help with something.
translation: Merhaba Reldo, senden bir konuda yardim istemeye geldim.

english: What can I do for you [player name]?
You show Reldo your clue scroll.
Ah! Do you know about hot and cold clues?
translation: Ah! Sicak ve soguk ipuclarini biliyor musun?

english: Yes, I do.
Well then use this strange device to feel where your destination is and dig.
translation: O zaman bu garip cihazi kullanarak hedefine ulasmak icin kaz.

english: You should make some room for it before I can give you it.
translation: Sana vermeden önce bunun icin yer acmalisin.

english: No, I don't.
Ah, you use a strange device to tell you how far away you are from the place you need to be. When you get to your destination you dig.
translation: Ah, garip bir cihaz kullanarak gitmen gereken yerden ne kadar uzakta oldugunu ögrenebilirsin. Hedefine ulastiginda kazmaya basla.

english: Hey Reldo, I have one of those clue scrolls again, do you have any advice?
translation: Hey Reldo, yine o ipucu parsömenlerinden bir tane buldum, bir tavsiyen var mi?

english: That strange device will guide you in the same way the key did. Feel it, but be careful as it is very powerful. Good luck.
translation: O garip cihaz, anahtarin yaptigi gibi sana yol gösterecek. Hisset, ama cok güclü oldugu icin dikkatli ol. Iyi sanslar.

english: I'm in search of a quest.
The Wise Old Man of Draynor Village sent you this message.
translation: Draynor Köyü'nün Bilge Yasli Adami sana bu mesaji gönderdi.

english: If the player receives coins:
If the player receives seeds:
If the player receives runes:
Do you have anything to trade?
translation: Takas edecek bir seyin var mi?

english: What do you do?
What do you know about the Imcando dwarves?
Ask about the brooch.
Talk about something else.
Ask about Imcando dwarves.
Ask about Robert the Strong.
Ask about Tristan.
Yes, I do.
No, I don't.
Hello, my friend. Would you like me to show you the prices of logs?
translation: Merhaba dostum. Sana kütüklerin fiyatlarini göstereyim mi?

english: You look like you've travelled a fair distance.
translation: Uzun bir yol kat etmissin gibi görünüyorsun.

english: What gave me away?
I don't mean to be rude, but the clothing and hair, for starters.
translation: Kaba olmak istemem ama öncelikle kiyafetlerin ve saclarin.

english: Ah, yes. I'm from Shilo Village on Karamja, it's a style I've had since I was little.
translation: Ah, evet. Karamja'daki Shilo Köyü'ndenim, bu tarzi kücüklügümden beri benim.

english: Then tell me, why are you so far from home?
translation: O zaman söyle bana, neden evinden bu kadar uzaktasin?

english: This Grand Exchange! Isn't it marvellous! I've never seen anything like it in my life.
translation: Bu Büyük Borsa! Harika degil mi! Hayatimda böyle bir sey görmedim.

english: My people were saddened when I chose to leave home and travel here, but I hope to make some serious profit, then return to my tribe.
translation: Evimi terk edip buraya gelmeye karar verdigimde halkim üzüldü, ama umarim ciddi bir kâr elde edip kabileme geri dönebilirim.

english: So, what are you selling?
Logs! Of all kinds! That's my plan, at least. Living in the jungle as we do, my people understand exotic wood very well indeed.
translation: Tomruk! Her türden! En azindan planim bu. Bizim gibi ormanda yasayan insanlar egzotik agaclari cok iyi anlarlar.

english: Okay, show me the prices of logs.
Sorry, I need to be making tracks.
Okay, nice talking to you!
Just one more offer! One more!
translation: Sadece bir teklif daha! Bir tane daha!

english: Such a joy it is to be in this building.
translation: Bu binada olmak ne büyük bir mutluluk.

english: Yes! Yet another great deal.
My people shall be so proud!
Hmmm. These numbers don't quite add up.
translation: Hmmm. Bu rakamlar pek tutarli degil.

english: You look like you've travelled a fair distance.
translation: Uzun bir yol kat etmissin gibi görünüyorsun.

english: Okay, show me the prices of logs.
Sorry, I need to be making tracks.
Hello.
Well done, well done. Not many find their way in here.
translation: Aferin, aferin. Buraya cok az kisi gelir.

english: I'm Remsai, a tree gnome. We live in this maze for our protection. Have a look around and enjoy.
translation: Ben Remsai, bir agac ciniyim. Korunmak icin bu labirentte yasiyoruz. Etrafa bakin ve keyfini cikarin.

english: Oh my, oh my!
What's wrong?
The orb, they have the orb. It must be returned or we're doomed.
translation: Küre, küre onlarin elinde. Geri alinmali, yoksa mahvoluruz.

english: Hello Remsai.
Hello, did you find the orb?
No, I'm afraid not.
Please, we must have the orb if we are to survive.
translation: Lütfen, hayatta kalmak icin küreye ihtiyacimiz var.

english: I have it here.
You're our saviour.
Are you ok?
Khazard's men came. Without the orb we were defenceless. They killed many and then took our last hope, the other orbs.
translation: Khazard'in adamlari geldi. Küre olmadan savunmasizdik. Bircogumuzu öldürdüler ve son umudumuz olan diger küreleri de aldilar.

english: Now surely we're all doomed. Without them the spirit tree is useless.
translation: Artik hepimiz mahvolduk. Onlar olmadan ruh agaci ise yaramaz.

english: I've returned.
You're back, well done brave adventurer. Now the orbs are safe we can perform the ritual for the spirit tree. We can live in peace once again.
translation: Geri dönmüssün, aferin cesur maceraci. Artik küreler güvende, ruh agaci icin ritüeli gerceklestirebiliriz. Tekrar huzur icinde yasayabiliriz.

english: Hi there traveller.  You're a legend around these parts.
translation: Merhaba gezgin. Bu bölgede bir efsanesin.

english: Thanks Remsai.
Hello there.
Wooo?  Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!
translation: Wooo? Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!

english: You don't say?
Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!
translation: Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!

english: You don't say!
Wooowoowoooooo.... Woowoowoo? Woooo, wooowoo wooowooowooo!
Well, I guess you didn't say.
Yeah, I don't want to brag, but seriously: I am SOOOO rich....
translation: Evet, övünmek istemem ama cidden: Ben COK zenginim...

english: Yeah, I know they say money doesn't bring you happiness, but sometimes I just like to open my bank account and look at all of the stuff I own and just think to myself:
translation: Evet, paranin mutluluk getirmedigini söylerler, ama bazen banka hesabimi acip sahip oldugum her seye bakip kendi kendime söyle düsünüyorum:

english: Wow. I am soooooo rich.
Well, us rich alive people don't want to waste all day spending time with you poor dead people, because I'm just sooooo rich I have to go now, and very possibly make myself even richer.
translation: Biz zengin yasayan insanlar, tüm günümüzü siz fakir ölülerle gecirmek istemiyoruz, cünkü ben cok zenginim ve simdi gitmeliyim, muhtemelen kendimi daha da zenginlestirmeliyim.

english: See ya around ghosty!
Yeah, I heard about that, ha-ha-ha!
With a MACKEREL? Ouch!
Well, it was fun. Let's do it again sometime.
translation: Evet, eglenceliydi. Bir ara tekrar yapalim.

english: Why, thank you very much!
I know, but what are you going to do?
Well, I guess that's always true in the long run. See you around, weird invisible dead person!
translation: Evet, uzun vadede bu her zaman dogrudur. Görüsürüz, garip görünmez ölü insan!

english: Yeah it's not bad, but I prefer cooked chicken.
translation: Evet, fena degil, ama ben pismis tavugu tercih ederim.

english: Maybe, but nothing beats a home cooked pie!
translation: Belki, ama ev yapimi turta gibisi yoktur!

english: Man, I love pie!
You don't say? I never knew that. Well, I must be going, see you around.
translation: Öyle mi? Bunu bilmiyordum. Peki, gitmem gerek, görüsürüz.

english: We get signal!
Somebody set up us the bomb!
You have no chance to survive make your time.
translation: Hayatta kalma sansin yok, zamanini iyi degerlendir.

english: Woo?
All your base are belong to us.
Hey, don't think you can talk to me like that!
Are you threatening me?
Just because you're already dead, doesn't mean I can't find a way to hurt you ghosty!
translation: Sen zaten öldün diye, sana zarar vermenin bir yolunu bulamayacagim anlamina gelmez hayalet!

english: No, I've never been there in my life and CERTAINLY didn't steal anything when I was!
translation: Hayir, hayatimda oraya hic gitmedim ve oradayken KESINLIKLE hicbir sey calmadim!

english: Are you calling me a liar?!?! I have never stolen a thing in my life, and I resent the implication that I am the kind of morally depraved individual that would steal someone else's hard earned
translation: Bana yalanci mi diyorsun?!?! Hayatimda hicbir sey calmadim ve baskalarinin zor kazandiklari parayi

english: money from their very pockets!
translation: ceplerinden calacak kadar ahlaksiz bir insan oldugumu ima etmene cok kizdim!

english: Or cakes. Or fur. Repeatedly. For long periods at a time.
translation: Ya da kekleri. Ya da kürkleri. Tekrar tekrar. Uzun süreler boyunca.

english: Well if you are going to take that attitude, then I have nothing further to say on the matter, and bid you good day!
translation: Eger bu tavri takinacaksan, bu konuda söyleyecek baska bir seyim yok, iyi günler!

english: Hello. You must be Rennard.
What be this? You both see me and hear me, and also know my name?
translation: Bu da ne böyle? Beni görüyor ve duyuyorsunuz, ayrica adimi da biliyorsunuz?

english: Tell me what devilry brings you here, and be quick about it afore I gut you like a fish!
translation: Beni buraya getiren seytani seyi söyle, yoksa seni balik gibi deserim!

english: Well, apart from the fact I ain't scared of no ghost, I am here because I have spoken to Valdez.
translation: Hayaletlerden korkmadigim gercegi bir yana, buraya Valdez ile konustugum icin geldim.

english: Valdez? Who be that? Some foul necromancer?
translation: Valdez mi? O kim? Kötü bir büyücü mü?

english: No, he was a ghost I met near Glarial's tomb.
translation: Hayir, Glarial'in mezarinin yakininda tanistigim bir hayalet.

english: He seems convinced that the artefact you stole from him is responsible for him becoming cursed to be an invisible ghost.
translation: Senden caldigin eser yüzünden görünmez bir hayalet olarak lanetlendigine inaniyor gibi görünüyor.

english: Seems like he might be onto something too, given the state of you.
A curse ye say... Aye, that makes sense...
And there was I thinking my fate be the fault of the thieving and murdering I spent me life a-doing...
translation: Ben de hayatim boyunca yaptigim hirsizlik ve cinayetlerin yüzünden bu kaderi hak ettigimi düsünüyordum... .

english: So it all began the day I stole that staff, ye say? Aye, that be a story I have never told another soul...
translation: Yani her sey o asayi caldigim gün basladi, öyle mi? Evet, bu hic kimseye anlatmadigim bir hikaye...

english: Why don't you tell me what happened? I might be able to help...
translation: Neden bana ne oldugunu anlatmiyorsun? Belki yardimci olabilirim...

english: Well, I was making me merry way along, having just pulled off a glorious jewellery heist from a bunch of stinking dwarves...
translation: Sey, bir grup kokusmus cüceden muhtesem bir mücevher hirsizligi yaptiktan sonra keyifle yoluma devam ediyordum...

english: Hey, that's no way to talk about dwarves! Some of my best friends are short!
translation: Hey, cücelere böyle konusulmaz! En iyi arkadaslarimdan bazilari kisa boylu!

english: Ah, yer misunderstand me [lad/lass], I wasn't generalising about the whole dwarf species, I had just stolen a bundle of jewels from a very specific group of dwarves who happened to have an odious stench about them!
translation: Ah, beni yanlis anladin , tüm cüce türünü genellestirmiyordum, sadece cok kötü kokan belirli bir grup cüceden bir sürü mücevher calmistim!

english: Oh. Well I guess that's okay then. Please continue.
translation: Oh. Öyleyse sorun yok. Lütfen devam et.

english: Well, as I headed on me merry way, hoping the foul odours that lingered in me nostrils would soon pass, I see in front of me this explorer fella, all decked out in in his fine clothing, and carrying some long package
translation: Ne burnumda kalan kötü kokularin bir an önce gecmesini umarak neseyle yoluma devam ederken, önümde güzel kiyafetler giymis ve pacavralara sarilmis uzun bir paket tasiyan bir kasif gördüm.

english: bundled in rags.
So I says to meself, 'Rennard', I says, 'Rennard, why would some fella all dressed in his finery be carrying something wrapped in dirty rags?'.
translation: Kendime dedim ki, “Rennard, neden bu kadar sik giyinmis bir adam kirli pacavralarla sarilmis bir sey tasiyor?”

english: So I thinks to meself a little more, 'Rennard', I thinks, 'Rennard, maybe that fella has something valuable in there, and he covered it in dirty rags so it don't look so valuable'.
translation: Biraz daha düsündüm ve dedim ki, “Rennard, belki de o adamin icinde degerli bir sey vardir ve degerli görünmemesi icin kirli pacavralarla örtmüstür.”

english: So I coshed this fella round the back of his head with me bag of jewels, picked up his package and was on me merry way afore he comes to.
translation: Sonra bu adamin kafasinin arkasina mücevher cantamla vurdum, paketini aldim ve o kendine gelmeden neseyle yoluma devam ettim.

english: So what happened then?
Well, I makes me way to the closest tavern I knew of that catered to my sort of people...
translation: En yakin, benim gibi insanlara hizmet veren tavernaya gittim...

english: You mean thieves?
Right ye are, so I makes me way to the nearest friendly tavern, and unwraps the bundle to see what it had inside.
translation: Aynen öyle, en yakin dostane tavernaya gittim ve paketi acip icinde ne oldugunu görmek icin actim.

english: The Staff of Armadyl?
Was it? Ah, I never knew that...
Anysways, I unwraps this staff, and sees it be a god- weapon; I may be just a common thief, but I recognises a weapon not made by mortal hands when I sees one.
translation: Neyse, asayi actim ve onun bir tanri silahi oldugunu gördüm; ben siradan bir hirsiz olabilirim, ama ölümlülerin elinden cikmamis bir silahi gördügümde tanirim.

english: So what did you do then?
Well, I knew such a weapon would be of great value to...
translation: Böyle bir silahin büyük bir degeri olacagini biliyordum...

english: Now that's funny. Can't remember his name, now. The powerful god, lived in the North-east. Took the Mahjarrat away from under Icthlarin's
translation: Bu cok komik. Adini hatirlayamiyorum simdi. Güclü tanri, kuzeydoguda yasiyordu. Mahjarrat'i Icthlarin'in kontrolünden kurtardi.

english: control.
Anyway, I hired me a messenger to go off and let him know I had something I was prepared to sell that I thought he'd be interested in...
translation: Neyse, bir ulak tutarak ona, ilgisini cekecegini düsündügüm satmak istedigim bir sey oldugunu haber verdim...

english: Now WHY can't I remember his name? Very odd that...
So you sold the staff to this god you can't remember?
translation: Yani, adini hatirlayamadigin bu tanriya asayi sattin?

english: Well, that's the other funny thing... He never showed up, he sent some General or other instead.
translation: Aslinda, bu da komik olan diger sey... O gelmedi, yerine bir general falan gönderdi.

english: Hmmm... You know... Thinking back on that, I'm getting the feeling that messenger did a little doublecross of his own, and took
translation: Hmmm... Biliyor musun... Simdi düsününce, o haberci kendi basina bir oyun oynadi ve

english: me message to the wrong fella.
So what was this General's name?
His name was Zamorak. I remember thinking at the time it was odd, because the fella was a mighty powerful warrior, but was never fully trusted by...
translation: Adi Zamorak'ti. O zamanlar bunun tuhaf oldugunu düsünmüstüm, cünkü adam cok güclü bir savasciydi, ama kimse ona tam olarak güvenmiyordu...

english: WHY can't I remember his name???
So you suspect the messenger might have taken the message to the wrong person? So you think it was an accident or deliberate?
translation: Yani haberci mesaji yanlis kisiye götürmüs olabileceginden süpheleniyorsun? Bunun bir kaza mi yoksa kasitli mi oldugunu düsünüyorsun?

english: Well that I can't tell ya, but if something happened to get me cursed, it's likely the messenger would know what more than me.
translation: Bunu sana söyleyemem, ama bana bir lanet geldiyse, haberci benden daha fazla sey biliyor olabilir.

english: His name was Kharrim, and if he caused me to be stuck like this, I'm gonna fillet him like a dog, ghost or no!
translation: Adi Kharrim'di ve eger beni bu hale getirdiyse, hayalet olsun ya da olmasin, onu bir köpek gibi parcalayacagim!

english: I tell ye what, you've given me much to think about so I'd like to offer yer a gift; Here, take these, they were the gloves I stole me first cake with, they might bring yer some luck.
translation: Bak ne diyecegim, bana düsünmem gereken cok sey verdin, bu yüzden sana bir hediye vermek istiyorum. Al sunu, bu eldivenlerle ilk pastami caldim, sana sans getirebilir.

english: Where can I find this Kharrim then?
Kharrim the messenger... Well, he was always a devoted follower of old General Zamorak, and if I remember rightly Zamorak set up a small base in an old temple near Dareeyak...
translation: Haberci Kharrim... O, eski General Zamorak'in sadik bir takipcisiydi ve dogru hatirliyorsam Zamorak, Dareeyak yakinlarindaki eski bir tapinakta kücük bir üs kurmustu...

english: You might want to check around there.
translation: Orayi bir kontrol etsen iyi olur.

english: Okay, well I'll try and find him for you then.
translation: Tamam, o zaman onu senin icin bulmaya calisacagim.

english: Kharrim the messenger... Last I'd heard of him, he'd headed off to Carrallagar to seek his fortune. Ya might want to check around there somewhere.
translation: Haberci Kharrim... Onun hakkinda son duydugumda, servetini aramak icin Carrallagar'a gitmisti. Orayi bir kontrol etsen iyi olur.

english: Kharrim the messenger... The last I'd heard of that weasel he was claiming he'd found some underground deposit of runite ore guarded by demons and dragons.
translation: Haberci Kharrim... O sinsi herif hakkinda son duydugumda, iblisler ve ejderhalar tarafindan korunan bir yeralti runit cevheri yatagi buldugunu iddia ediyordu.

english: I suspect he was pulling some scam or other, but if you know of such a place, that might be a good place to start checking.
translation: Bir tür dolandiricilik yaptigini saniyorum, ama böyle bir yer biliyorsan, oradan arastirmaya baslamak iyi olabilir.

english: Well, that's all fascinating, but I just don't particularly care. Bye-bye.
translation: Hepsi cok ilginc, ama beni pek ilgilendirmiyor. Hosca kal.

english: Hello again Rennard.
Ah, it be you again! What can I do fer ya?
Can you tell me where I can find Kharrim again?
Could I have more of those ghostly robes you gave me?
translation: Bana verdigin hayalet cüppelerinden biraz daha alabilir miyim?

english: It seems as though the curse that keeps me here extends to my very clothing... which piece do you want?
translation: Beni burada tutan lanet giysilerime de bulasmis gibi görünüyor... Hangi parcayi istiyorsun?

english: Here you go.
The endless tragedy of fate... Why must you torment me so?
translation: Kaderin sonsuz trajedisi... Neden bana bu kadar eziyet ediyorsun?

english: Alright, alright, calm down, calm down. All I said was 'hello'!
translation: Tamam, tamam, sakin ol, sakin ol. Ben sadece “merhaba” dedim!

english: You can see me?
Uh... yes?
And you understand my words?
Well, most of them...
This is incredible! How can such a thing have come to pass?
translation: Bu inanilmaz! Böyle bir sey nasil olabilir?

english: What can I say? I'm a professional.
translation: Ne diyebilirim ki? Ben bir profesyonelim.

english: Hello back at you.
So what's a nice ghost like you doing in a place like this?
translation: Peki, senin gibi hos bir hayalet böyle bir yerde ne ariyor?

english: I suppose you think that's funny?
Well... Mildly amusing I guess.
I don't think I want to talk to you anymore.
Hello stranger. It is rare indeed that I meet one who can see my presence, let alone one who can understand my words.
translation: Merhaba yabanci. Benim varligimi görebilen biriyle karsilasmak cok nadirdir, sözlerimi anlayabilen biriyle karsilasmak ise daha da nadirdir.

english: Soooo.... Is it fun being a ghost?
Does it look like fun to you?
Erm... Well, yes actually.
Then you are a fool, and I will waste no more words upon you.
translation: O zaman sen bir aptalsin ve sana daha fazla laf etmem.

english: What, not even 'goodbye'?
Sheesh, what a grouch. You'd think you'd have more of a sense of humour being dead and all.
translation: Hay aksi, ne huysuzsun. Ölü oldugun halde daha fazla mizah anlayisin olmasi gerekirdi.

english: Mortal... Take heed of my example, and waste not your life, lest you may suffer the same fate as myself...
translation: Ölümlü... Benim örnegimi dikkate al ve hayatini bosa harcamayin, yoksa benimle ayni kaderi paylasirsin...

english: Huh? You mean someone did this to you?
translation: Ne? Yani bunu sana biri mi yapti?

english: You have ascertained the truth in my words...
So who did it to you? And why?
translation: Peki bunu sana kim yapti? Ve neden?

english: Events of moons past, I remember not clearly...
translation: Aylar önceki olaylari net olarak hatirlamiyorum...

english: Fine help you are then.
Hello stranger.
So.... Invisible ghost haunting the same place for thousands of years, huh?
translation: Demek... Binlerce yildir ayni yerde dolasan görünmez bir hayalet, ha?

english: You have no idea...
Well, bad luck and all that. See ya around!
Hello.
So you're a ghost, huh?
Apparently.
In which case I only have one thing to say to you:
translation: O halde sana tek bir sey söyleyecegim:

english: ...what?
Guess you don't have the amulet of humanspeak, huh?
translation: Sanirim insan dili muskasi yok sende, ha?

english: ...huh?
Yeah, that's right. WOO! WOOOWOOO WOO WOOOOWOO! Got no comeback for that, have you?
translation: Evet, dogru. WOO! WOOOWOOO WOO WOOOOWOO! Buna cevap veremiyorsun, degil mi?

english: You are very strange...
Tell me your story
Goodbye then
Ask about Kharrim.
Ask for more ghostly robes.
Hey!
Welcome to our camp, adventurer.
That sounds lovely, what tune is that?
translation: Kulaga hos geliyor, bu melodi ne?

english: Oh, this? It's just the beginning of something, still a lot more to come.
translation: Oh, bu mu? Bu sadece bir baslangic, daha cok sey gelecek.

english: Does it have a name?
I s'pose the working title is...'The Doors of Dinh'.
Where are you from?
We come from Varlamore... We're students of the College of Bards.
Oh...
Or did you want to know where I'm from specifically? My home was destroyed long ago by an evil saltwater deity.
translation: Yoksa tam olarak nereden geldigimi mi bilmek istedin? Evim uzun zaman önce kötü bir tuzlu su tanrisi tarafindan yikildi.

english: Well, that's certainly a dark and tortured backstory. Say, have you slain any dragons? Wooed a beautiful princess? Sought revenge on the fiend who killed your family?
translation: Bu gercekten karanlik ve aci dolu bir gecmis. Hic ejderha öldürdün mü? Güzel bir prensesi tavladin mi? Aileni öldüren canavardan intikam aldin mi?

english: ...Dragons? Slain. Princesses? Wooed... but revenge, that's still brewing.
translation: ...Ejderhalar? Öldürdüm. Prensesler? Tavladim... ama intikam, o hala olgunlasiyor.

english: Huh, well... Fair enough.
I have to go.
See you around, adventurer.
That sounds lovely, what tune is that?
translation: Kulaga hos geliyor, bu ne melodisi?

english: Where are you from?
I have to go.
Here lies Viktor, the goat, gone but not forgotten.
translation: Burada Viktor yatiyor, keci, öldü ama unutulmadi.

english: The ground beneath the gravestone looks disturbed.
translation: Mezar tasinin altindaki toprak karistirilmis gibi görünüyor.

english: Baaaaaaah! Baaaaah!
Aaah! It's a ghost goat!
Baaaaaaah!
Aww, poor goat, I don't think it meant to scare me.
translation: Ah, zavalli keci, beni korkutmak istememisti herhalde.

english: Baah?
If only I had a goat speak amulet...
You notice the ghost goat is missing one of its horns.
translation: Hayalet kecinin boynuzlarindan birinin eksik oldugunu fark ediyorsun.

english: Hmm, one of your horns is missing...
Baaah! Baaaaah!
It seems like it wants me to help recover its lost horn...
translation: Kayip boynuzunu bulmama yardim etmemi istiyor gibi görünüyor...

english: The ghost goat seems very excited when you mention its lost horn.
translation: Hayalet keci, kayip boynuzundan bahsettiginde cok heyecanlaniyor.

english: Hmm, how am I going to find this goat's horn?
translation: Hmm, bu kecinin boynuzunu nasil bulacagim?

english: Baaaaaah!!!
The ghost goat head butts the wall, I think he's pointing east...
translation: Hayalet keci duvara kafasini vuruyor, sanirim doguyu gösteriyor...

english: Alright then, I'll go have a look...that way...
translation: Tamam o zaman, gidip bir bakayim... o tarafa...

english: Hey goat, where did you baa where your horn was?
translation: Hey keci, boynuzunun nerede oldugunu bagirdin mi?

english: Right, got it, thanks goat.
Hello my goat friend, I have brought you a gift.
translation: Merhaba keci dostum, sana bir hediye getirdim.

english: Baaaah!
You show the ghost goat the horn.
Baaaah! Baaaaaaah! Baaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!
I think this might be the right one.
You bury the horn with the rest of the goat skeleton.
translation: Boynuzu keci iskeletinin geri kalaniyla birlikte gömersin.

english: Quest complete!
Inspect the grave closer?
translation: Mezari daha yakindan incelemek ister misin?

english: Viktor is resting peacefully now...
Yes.
No.
Wooooo! Ooooooh!
I can't understand a word you are saying. Maybe Father Aereck will be able to help.
translation: Söylediklerinin tek kelimesini bile anlamiyorum. Belki Peder Aereck yardimci olabilir.

english: Hello ghost, how are you?
Wooo wooo wooooo!
Sorry, I don't speak ghost.
Woo woo?
Nope, still don't understand you.
WOOOOOOOOO!
Never mind.
Ooh, THAT'S interesting.
Woo wooo. Woooooooooooooooooo!
Did he really?
Woo.
My brother had EXACTLY the same problem.
Woo Wooooo!
Wooooo Woo woo woo!
You'll have to give me the recipe some time...
Wooooooo woo woooooooo.
Yeah, that's what I thought.
Wooo woooooooooooooo...
Goodbye. Thanks for the chat.
Wooo wooo?
Hmm... I'm not so sure about that.
Wooo woo?
Well, if you INSIST.
Wooooooooo!
Ah well, better be off now...
translation: Ah, peki, artik gitsem iyi olacak...

english: Bye.
Any hints where I can find some treasure?
translation: Hazineyi nerede bulabilecegime dair bir ipucu var mi?

english: Wooooooo woo! Wooooo woo wooooo woowoowoo woo Woo wooo. Wooooo woo woo? Woooooooooooooooooo!
translation: Wooooooo woo! Wooooo woo wooooo woowoowoo woo Woo wooo. Wooooo woo woo? Woooooooooooooooooo!

english: Thank you. You've been very helpful.
Wooooooo.
Not very good actually.
What's the problem then?
Did you just understand what I said???
Yep, now tell me what the problem is.
translation: Evet, simdi sorunun ne oldugunu söyle.

english: WOW! This is INCREDIBLE! I didn't expect anyone to ever understand me again!
translation: Vay canina! Bu inanilmaz! Kimsenin beni bir daha anlayacagini sanmiyordum!

english: Ok, Ok, I can understand you!
But have you any idea WHY you're doomed to be a ghost?
translation: Ama neden hayalet olmaya mahkum oldugunu biliyor musun?

english: Well, to be honest... I'm not sure.
I've been told a certain task may need to be completed so you can rest in peace.
translation: Huzur icinde yatabilmen icin belirli bir görevi yerine getirmen gerektigi söylendi.

english: I should think it is probably because a warlock has come along and stolen my skull. If you look inside my coffin there, you'll find my corpse without a head on it.
translation: Muhtemelen bir büyücü gelip kafatasimi caldigi icindir. Suradaki tabutumun icine bakarsan, kafasi olmayan cesedimi göreceksin.

english: Do you know where this warlock might be now?
translation: Bu büyücünün su anda nerede olabilecegini biliyor musun?

english: I think it was one of the warlocks who lives in the big tower by the sea south-west from here.
translation: Sanirim buradan güneybatiya, deniz kenarindaki büyük kulede yasayan büyücülerden biriydi.

english: Ok. I will try and get the skull back for you, then you can rest in peace.
translation: Tamam. Kafatasini geri almaya calisacagim, böylece huzur icinde yatabilirsin.

english: Ooh, thank you. That would be such a great relief!
translation: Ooh, tesekkürler. Bu cok büyük bir rahatlama olur!

english: It is so dull being a ghost...
No, you sound like you're speaking nonsense to me.
translation: Hayir, bana sacma sapan konusuyormussun gibi geliyor.

english: Oh that's a pity. You got my hopes up there.
Yeah, it is a pity. Sorry about that.
Hang on a second... you CAN understand me!
No I can't.
Great.
The first person I can speak to in ages...
..and they're a moron.
Yep, clever aren't I?
I'm impressed. You must be very powerful. I don't suppose you can stop me being a ghost?
translation: Etkilendim. Cok güclü olmalisin. Hayalet olmami engelleyemezsin herhalde?

english: Yes, ok. Do you know WHY you're a ghost?
translation: Evet, tamam. Neden hayalet oldugunu biliyor musun?

english: Nope. I just know I can't do much of anything like this!
translation: Hayir. Sadece bu sekilde pek bir sey yapamayacagimi biliyorum!

english: No, you're scary!
..and they're an idiot.
Wow, this amulet works!
translation: Vay canina, bu tilsim ise yariyor!

english: Oh! It's your amulet that's doing it! I did wonder. I don't suppose you can help me? I don't like being a ghost.
translation: Oh! Bunu yapan senin tilsimin! Merak ediyordum. Bana yardim edemezsin herhalde? Hayalet olmak hosuma gitmiyor.

english: How are you doing finding my skull?
Sorry, I can't find it at the moment.
Ah well. Keep on looking.
I'm pretty sure it's somewhere in the tower south-west from here. There's a lot of levels to the tower, though. I suppose it might take a little while to find.
translation: Buradan güneybatiya dogru kulede bir yerde olduguna eminim. Ama kulede cok fazla kat var. Bulmak biraz zaman alabilir.

english: I have found it!
Hurrah! Now I can stop being a ghost! You just need to put it in my coffin there, then I'll be free!
translation: Yasasin! Artik hayalet olmaktan kurtulabilirim! Onu tabutuma koyman yeterli, sonra özgür olacagim!

english: Release! Thank you stranger...
The spirit flies into the River Lum.
Congratulations! Quest complete!
Sorry, I don't speak ghost.
Ooh, THAT'S interesting.
Did he really?
My brother had EXACTLY the same problem.
Goodbye. Thanks for the chat.
You'll have to give me the recipe some time...
Hmm... I'm not so sure about that.
Yeah, that's what I thought.
Hmm I'm not sure about that.
Any hints where I can find some treasure?
translation: Hazineyi nerede bulabilecegime dair bir ipucu var mi?

english: Thank you. You've been very helpful.
Yep, now tell me what the problem is.
translation: Evet, simdi sorunun ne oldugunu söyle.

english: No, you sound like you're speaking nonsense to me.
translation: Hayir, bana sacma sapan konusuyormussun gibi geliyor.

english: No I can't.
Yep, clever aren't I?
Yes, ok. Do you know WHY you're a ghost?
translation: Evet, tamam. Neden hayalet oldugunu biliyor musun?

english: No, you're scary!
Wow, this amulet works!
translation: Vay canina, bu tilsim ise yariyor!

english: Yes, ok. Do you know why you're a ghost?
translation: Evet, tamam. Neden hayalet oldugunu biliyor musun?

english: Do you have something you'd like to trade, young ?
translation: Takas etmek istedigin bir sey var mi, genc ?

english: What kind of trade can you offer?
translation: Ne tür bir takas teklif edebilirsin?

english: Well, we find a lot of soaked pages in our nets. If you've got something we really want, I could swap it for 25 soaked pages.
translation: Sey, aglarimizda cok sayida islak sayfa buluyoruz. Eger gercekten istedigimiz bir seyin varsa, onu 25 islak sayfa ile takas edebilirim.

english: What is this place?
Just a little place where we Spirit Anglers can store things, young . I used to be the chief mate on one of our ships, but now I just watch over the stores from the land.
translation: Sadece biz Ruh Balikcilarinin esyalarini saklayabilecegi kücük bir yer, genc . Eskiden gemilerimizden birinde bas gemiciydim, ama simdi karadan depolari gözetliyorum.

english: Maybe you'd like to do a trade, though, while you're here?
translation: Belki de buradayken bir takas yapmak istersiniz?

english: No.
The sailor will exchange certain reward items for 25 soaked pages each.
translation: Denizci, belirli ödül ögelerini her biri 25 islak sayfa karsiliginda takas edecektir.

english: You don't have any [item] to exchange.
No thank you.
What kind of trade can you offer?
translation: Ne tür bir takas teklif edebilirsiniz?

english: What is this place?
No.
Do you have something you'd like to trade, young [man/woman]?
Just a little place where we Spirit Anglers can store things, young [man/woman]. I used to be the chief mate on one of our ships, but now I just watch over the stores from the land.
translation: Sadece biz Ruh Balikçilarinin esyalarini saklayabilecegi küçük bir yer. Eskiden gemilerimizden birinde bas zabitlik yapiyordum, ama simdi karadan depolari gözetliyorum.

english: Hi.
Greetings. What wisdom do you seek?
translation: Selamlar. Ne tür bir bilgelik ariyorsunuz?

english: Who are you?
Me? I'm here to grant you rewards for any of the Pizazz Points you may have earned in this training arena. Like my fellow Guardians, I am part of the arena and live to ensure its safe running.
translation: Ben mi? Bu egitim arenasinda kazandiginiz Pizazz Puanlari icin size ödül vermek icin buradayim. Diger Muhafizlar gibi ben de arenanin bir parcasiyim ve arenanin güvenli bir sekilde calismasini saglamak icin yasiyorum.

english: I see.
Can I trade my Pizazz Points please?
translation: Pizazz Puanlarimi takas edebilir miyim lütfen?

english: Why of course.
Got anything else I can buy?
translation: Satin alabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: Well, we do stock a special book that you may be interested in, which provides a comprehensive guide to this training arena. It costs 200 coins. Would you like one?
translation: Bu egitim arenasi hakkinda kapsamli bir rehber iceren, ilginizi cekebilecek özel bir kitabimiz var. Fiyati 200 jeton. Ister misin?

english: That sounds useful. Yes please.
Very good, that'll be 200 coins please!
Thank you.
Sorry, I don't have enough money.
I don't want some dusty old book.
It's not old and it certainly isn't dusty, but suit yourself.
translation: Eski degil ve kesinlikle tozlu da degil, ama sen bilirsin.

english: No thanks, I already have one.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, zaten bir tane var.

english: Let me know if you lose it.
Thanks, bye!
Use what you've learned, young one.
Greetings. Have you spoken to my fellow Guardian downstairs?
translation: Merhaba. Asagidaki Guardian arkadasimla konustun mu?

english: Nope.
Well, you need to talk to him first.
Who are you?
Can I trade my Pizazz Points please?
translation: Pizazz Puanlarimi takas edebilir miyim lütfen?

english: Got anything else I can buy?
translation: Satin alabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: That sounds useful. Yes please.
I don't want some dusty old book.
Thanks, bye!
Hello.
Oh, hellow adventurer. Can I help you with anything?
What is this place?
This is the prison of Zalcano.
Zalcano?
That's right. She's a powerful demon, one bearing an ancient curse.
translation: Evet. O, eski bir lanet tasiyan güclü bir iblis.

english: A curse? That doesn't sound good.
translation: Lanet mi? Kulaga pek iyi gelmiyor.

english: Don't worry, the curse only affects her. Because of it, her entire body has been turned to stone.
translation: Merak etme, lanet sadece onu etkiliyor. Bu yüzden tüm vücudu tasa dönüsmüs.

english: I see. So why is she here?
She came to our lands long ago, before the curse had fully taken hold. We imprisoned her here for study, so that we might learn more about her affliction.
translation: Lanet tam olarak etkisini göstermeden cok uzun zaman önce bizim topraklarimiza geldi. Onun hakkinda daha fazla bilgi edinmek icin onu burada hapsettik.

english: If you want to learn more, you should be able to find a book in the Grand Library about her.
translation: Daha fazla bilgi edinmek istersen, Büyük Kütüphane'de onunla ilgili bir kitap bulabilirsin.

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: What can I do here?
Well we could always use some help in keeping Zalcano under control.
translation: Zalcano'yu kontrol altinda tutmak icin her zaman yardima ihtiyacimiz var.

english: How would I do that?
Zalcano is formed completely from stone. Because of this, normal weapons won't work on her.
translation: Zalcano tamamen tastan olusuyor. Bu yüzden normal silahlar ona etki etmiyor.

english: That said, when she's vulnerable, you can still do some damage to her if you use a pickaxe.
translation: Ancak, savunmasiz oldugu zamanlarda, kazma kullanarak ona zarar verebilirsin.

english: When she's vulnerable? How do I make her vulnerable?
translation: Savunmasiz oldugunda mi? Onu nasil savunmasiz hale getirebilirim?

english: The ore found within these caverns can be rather volatile, especially when heated. We've found that when imbued, this ore can damage her armour.
translation: Bu magaralarda bulunan cevher, özellikle isitildiginda oldukca ucucu olabilir. Bu cevherin, asilandiginda onun zirhina hasar verebilecegini kesfettik.

english: You'll want to head on in and mine the ore from the rocks around the prison. Once you have some, you can heat it using the furnace and then imbue it using the altar.
translation: Iceri girip hapishanenin etrafindaki kayalardan cevheri cikarmalisin. Cevheri elde ettikten sonra, firinda isitip sunakta asilayabilirsin.

english: Once you've got some imbued ore, just give it a throw her way and she'll definitely feel it.
translation: Emdirilmis cevheri aldiktan sonra, onu ona firlatin, kesinlikle hissedecektir.

english: What do I get for helping out here?
translation: Burada yardim ettigim icin ne alacagim?

english: Well assuming you are successful of subdueingZalcano, she has accumulated a lot of ores and magical runes from her time as a demon.
translation: Zalcano'yu alt etmeyi basardiginizi varsayarsak, o iblis oldugu zamanlarda cok fazla cevher ve büyülü rün biriktirmistir.

english: Not bad, what if I didn't want these resources? Is there anything you can give me instead?
translation: Fena degil, peki ya bu kaynaklari istemiyorsam? Bana bunun yerine baska bir sey verebilir misiniz?

english: Well we would always appreciate these resources, in exchange we could bestow upon you our elven knowledge for mining.
translation: Bu kaynaklari her zaman memnuniyetle kabul ederiz, karsiliginda sana elflerin madencilik bilgisini verebiliriz.

english: We wouldn't be asking for anything special though, just the common resources are what we require.
translation: Özel bir sey istemeyiz, sadece genel kaynaklara ihtiyacimiz var.

english: We won't take any resources from your successes, the resources are all your own.
translation: Basarilarindan hicbir kaynak almayacagiz, kaynaklarin hepsi senin.

english: We will automatically collect the resources and bestow you with our elven mining knowledge.
translation: Kaynaklari otomatik olarak toplayip sana elflerin madencilik bilgisini verecegiz.

english: No thanks.
What is this place?
What can I do here?
What do I get for helping out here?
translation: Burada yardim ettigim icin ne kazanacagim?

english: Resource focused
XP Focused.
No thanks.
Hi.
Hey! What can I do for ya' today?
translation: Selam! Bugün senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: Who are you?
I'm Rhoddwr, a simple forest dweller.
translation: Ben Rhoddwr, basit bir orman sakiniyim.

english: It's nice to meet you Rhoddwr, I'm [player name].
translation: Tanistigimiza memnun oldum Rhoddwr, ben Maceraci.

english: And it's great to meet you, [player name].
translation: Ben de tanistigimiza memnun oldum Maceraci.

english: What do you do here?
I'm the leader of this small camp. We live amongst the trees, at one with the forest.
translation: Bu kücük kampin lideriyim. Agaclarin arasinda, ormanla bütünlesmis bir sekilde yasiyoruz.

english: That sounds relaxing.
That's because it is! This is where we belong, this is where we began.
translation: Cünkü öyle! Burasi bizim ait oldugumuz yer, basladigimiz yer.

english: A nice sentiment, but we can't all live off the land.
translation: Güzel bir düsünce, ama hepimiz topraktan gecinemeyiz.

english: Very true! As we expand and grow, nature refuses to adjust to our ways. The only other option is to destroy it to make room for growth.
translation: Cok dogru! Biz genisleyip büyüdükce, doga bizim yasam tarzimiza uyum saglamayi reddediyor. Tek secenek, büyüme icin yer acmak amaciyla onu yok etmek.

english: Hopefully nature understands the necessity of it all.
History shows again and again that nature points out the folly of man.
translation: Tarih, doganin insanin aptalligini defalarca göstermistir.

english: Which is why we should learn from the past and avoid making such mistakes.
translation: Bu yüzden gecmisten ders almali ve bu tür hatalari yapmamaliyiz.

english: Indeed, although some mistakes have lasting effects that cannot be undone. Is there anything else you wanted to know?
translation: Gercekten de, bazi hatalarin geri alinamaz kalici etkileri vardir. Baska bilmek istediginiz bir sey var mi?

english: Bye!
Farewell, adventurer.
Who are you?
What do you do here?
Bye!
Ahoy, young whippersnapper. Have you come to hear a tale from old Ribs?
translation: Selam, genc zipcikti. Yasli Ribs'in hikayesini dinlemeye mi geldin?

english: Could you tell me about Barnacle Barnaby?
translation: Barnacle Barnaby hakkinda bana biraz bilgi verir misin?

english: He was a cruel and vicious pirate. Orchestrator of the Driftwood Massacre and unleasher of the Plague of Black Mists. He believed himself untouchable, but his arrogance was his undoing.
translation: O acimasiz ve zalim bir korsandi. Driftwood Katliami'nin mimari ve Kara Sis Salgini'nin baslangiciydi. Kendini dokunulmaz saniyordu, ama kibiri onun sonunu getirdi.

english: Despite the warnings of many, Barnacle Barnaby attempted to plunder the Skullhorde, but his only reward was a deadly curse. It destroyed the Crimson Kraken, condemning all on board to a watery grave.
translation: Bircok kisinin uyarilarina ragmen Barnacle Barnaby, Skullhorde'u yagmalamaya calisti, ama tek ödülü ölümcül bir lanetti. Bu lanet, Crimson Kraken'i yok etti ve gemideki herkesi suya gömdü.

english: And you had a map leading to the wreck of the Kraken?
translation: Ve Kraken'in enkazina giden bir haritan mi vardi?

english: Aye! I purchased the map from Ulrich the Unfortunate, the sole survivor of the Kraken, but I had no intention of using it. I knew that no good would ever come from seeking the Kraken.
translation: Evet! Haritayi Kraken'in tek kurtulani olan Ulrich the Unfortunate'dan satin aldim, ama onu kullanmak gibi bir niyetim yoktu. Kraken'i aramanin hicbir iyi sonuc getirmeyecegini biliyordum.

english: Then why not destroy the map?
translation: O zaman neden haritayi yok etmedin?

english: And risk the wrath of Barnaby's ghost? No. I thought it better the map be locked away, so that neither it nor the curse could harm anyone else, but those young fools put an end to that.
translation: Barnaby'nin hayaleti tarafindan lanetlenme riskini mi göze alacaktim? Hayir. Haritanin kilitli tutulmasinin daha iyi olacagini düsündüm, böylece ne harita ne de lanet baska kimseye zarar veremezdi, ama o genc aptallar buna son verdi.

english: Now, we can only hope that someone puts a stop to them before it's too late. Who knows, perhaps it will be you who does so.
translation: Simdi, cok gec olmadan birinin onlari durdurmasini umut etmekten baska caremiz yok. Kim bilir, belki de bunu yapan sen olursun.

english: Well, on that note, I'd best be getting off. Until next time, Ribs.
translation: Peki, bu durumda, ben gitsem iyi olacak. Bir dahaki sefere görüsürüz, Ribs.

english: I don't think so.
As you wish, but you would be wise to learn from your elders. My tales might one day save you from a one- way trip to see Davey Jones!
translation: Nasil istersen, ama büyüklerinden ders alman akillica olur. Anlattiklarim bir gün seni Davey Jones'a tek yönlü bir yolculuktan kurtarabilir!

english: Could you tell me about Barnacle Barnaby?
translation: Barnacle Barnaby hakkinda bilgi verebilir misiniz?

english: I don't think so.
Hello. How can I help you?
Can you give me any Farming advice?
translation: Bana tarimla ilgili tavsiyelerde bulunabilir misiniz?

english: Yes - ask a gardener.
I'm okay, thank you.
What are you selling?
Can you give me any Farming advice?
translation: Bana tarimla ilgili tavsiyelerde bulunabilir misiniz?

english: I'm okay, thank you.
What can I get you?
What are you serving?
What is this place?
My pub's called The Golden Field. It's where all the local workers come to relax and unwind after a hard day. I try to keep it really nice here for them. Anyway, are you drinking?
translation: Barimin adi The Golden Field. Buraya tüm yerel isciler zor bir günün ardindan dinlenmek ve rahatlamak icin gelirler. Onlar icin burayi gercekten güzel tutmaya calisiyorum. Neyse, icecek misin?

english: Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: Burada herhangi bir söylenti duydun mu?

english: Apparently Veos is looking for some help with something. He hangs around the docks of Port Piscarilius.
translation: Görünüse göre Veos bir konuda yardim ariyor. Port Piscarilius limaninda takiliyor.

english: They say there's trouble in Port Piscarilius. Something about gangs uniting. Might be worth looking into.
translation: Port Piscarilius'ta sorunlar oldugunu söylüyorlar. Cetelerin birlestigi ile ilgili bir sey. Arastirmaya deger olabilir.

english: I hear that Lord Hosidius has misplaced one of his sons. The Hosidius family might pay a lot to see him returned safely.
translation: Lord Hosidius'un ogullarindan birini kaybettigini duydum. Hosidius ailesi, oglunun sag salim geri dönmesi icin cok para ödeyebilir.

english: Phileas Rimor has supposedly been looking for some assistance with something in Shayzien. Maybe worth investigating.
translation: Phileas Rimor'un Shayzien'de bir konuda yardim aradigi söyleniyor. Arastirmaya deger olabilir.

english: I hear that the rulers of Lovakengj have some work available. You'll find them in the Lovakengj Assembly.
translation: Lovakengj'in yöneticilerinin bazi isler icin eleman aradigini duydum. Onlari Lovakengj Meclisi'nde bulabilirsin.

english: Apparently there's been some commotion in the middle of Arceuus. Might be worth checking out.
translation: Görünüse göre Arceuus'un ortasinda bir kargasa var. Bir göz atmaya deger olabilir.

english: That protest outside Kourend Castle is starting to attract some attention. Could be worth taking a look.
translation: Kourend Kalesi'nin disindaki protesto dikkat cekmeye basladi. Bir göz atmaya deger olabilir.

english: No, it hasn't been very busy lately.
translation: Hayir, son zamanlarda cok yogun degildi.

english: I'd better not.
I like a customer who knows when to stop.
translation: Ne zaman durmasi gerektigini bilen müsterileri severim.

english: What are you serving?
What is this place?
I'd better not.
Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: Burada herhangi bir söylenti duydun mu?

english: Hello there, are you interested in buying one of my special capes?
translation: Merhaba, özel pelerinlerimden birini satin almak ister misin?

english: What's so special about your capes?

Ahh well they make it less likely that you'll accidently attack anyone wearing the same cape as you and easier to attack everyone else. They also make it easier to distinguish people who're wearing the same cape as you
translation: Ahh, ayni pelerini giyen birini yanlislikla saldirma olasiligini azaltir ve diger herkese saldirmayi kolaylastirir. Ayrica, ayni pelerini giyen kisileri digerlerinden ayirt etmeyi kolaylastirir.

english: from everyone else. They're very useful when out in the wilderness with friends or anyone else you don't want to harm.
translation: Arkadaslarinla veya zarar vermek istemedigin kisilerle Wildernessda birlikteyken cok kullanislidir. Arkadaslarinizla veya zarar vermek istemediginiz baska kisilerle Wildernessda dolasirken cok kullanislidirlar.

english: So would you like to buy one?
translation: Peki, bir tane satin almak ister misiniz?

english: No thanks.
What's so special about your capes?
Yes please!
No thanks.
'Allo mate! Got a job going? Only 500 coins!
translation: Selam dostum! Is var mi? Sadece 500 sikke!

english: What can you do?
I'm a great cook, me! I used to work with a rat-catcher, I used to cook for him. There's a dozen different ways you can cook rat!
translation: Ben harika bir asciyim! Eskiden bir fare avcisiyla calisiyordum, ona yemek pisirirdim. Fareyi pisirmenin bir düzine farkli yolu var!

english: Tell me about your previous jobs.
Well, city warder Bravek once threw a chair at me and yelled at me to get him a hangover cure. So I made it and I think it worked, 'cause then he threw another chair at me and that one hit!
translation: Sey, sehir bekcisi Bravek bir keresinde bana bir sandalye firlatti ve ona aksamdan kalma ilaci bulmam icin bagirdi. Ben de ilaci hazirladim ve sanirim ise yaradi, cünkü sonra bana baska bir sandalye firlatti ve o sandalye isabet etti!

english: Sorry mate, but I'm not allowed to work for anyone without level 20 Construction. It's a safety 'azard!
translation: Üzgünüm dostum, ama seviye 20 Insaat olmadan kimse icin calismam yasak. Güvenlik riski var!

english: You already have a servant.
You need a second bedroom with a bed for your servant to sleep in.
translation: Hizmetcinin uyuyacagi ikinci bir yatak odasina ihtiyacin var.

english: You're hired... well, I don't have the money on me, but can I owe you? I'm good for it, honest.
translation: Ise alindin... Sey, üzerimde para yok, ama sana borclanabilir miyim? Ödeyecegim, söz veriyorum.

english: Nice try, mate, but I don't start work without cash up front.
translation: Iyi denemeydi dostum, ama önceden nakit ödeme olmadan ise baslamam.

english: You're hired!
Cheers, mate! Look forward to working with you!
translation: Tesekkürler dostum! Seninle calismayi dört gözle bekliyorum!

english: What can you do?
Tell me about your previous jobs
You're hired!
Hey there, Rick.
Hello, [player name]. It's nice to see you again!
translation: Merhaba Maceraci. Seni tekrar görmek ne güzel!

english: How are you feeling?
Better now that my head's back in place. Thanks again for helping me with that!
translation: Kafam yerine oturdugu icin simdi daha iyiyim. Yardim ettigin icin tekrar tesekkürler!

english: You're very welcome. It was a night to remember, that's for sure.
translation: Rica ederim. Unutulmaz bir geceydi, orasi kesin.

english: Indeed. How are you finding the helm that I gave you? Does the headless illusion still work?
translation: Gercekten. Sana verdigim migferi nasil buldun? Kafasiz illüzyonu hala ise yariyor mu?

english: Yes it does. I've been told it looks terrifying - especially when I eat or drink.
translation: Evet, yariyor. Cok korkutucu göründügü söylendi, özellikle de yemek yerken veya icerken.

english: I can imagine!
Do you have anything to sell?
As a matter of fact, I do! I was recently doing some research on cabbages. I was able to extract their essence and combine it with a t-
translation: Aslinda var! Son zamanlarda lahana üzerine arastirma yapiyordum. Onlarin özünü cikarip bir t-

english: You're not a very good salesman, are you? Just tell me what you're selling!
translation: Cok iyi bir satici degilsin, degil mi? Ne sattigini söyle yeter!

english: Oh. Right! I have these crystal shards that will let you escape from particularly dangerous situations. They only work in certain places. I call them Escape crystal.
translation: Oh. Dogru! Özellikle tehlikeli durumlardan kacmani saglayacak kristal parcalarim var. Bunlar sadece belirli yerlerde ise yariyor. Ben onlara Kacis Kristali diyorum.

english: Why would I want that?
Sometimes you get caught in places that won't let you teleport out by normal means. These crystals are specially crafted to let you escape those scenarios.
translation: Bazen normal yollarla teleport olamayacagin yerlere sikisip kalirsin. Bu kristaller, bu tür durumlardan kacmani saglamak icin özel olarak üretilmistir.

english: So, would you like to buy one? They cost 75000 gold each!
translation: Peki, bir tane satin almak ister misin? Tanesi 75.000 altin!

english: Sure - I'd like to buy a crystal.
It looks like you can't afford any Escape crystals. They cost 75000 each.
translation: Kacis kristallerini karsilayamayacak gibi görünüyor. Tanesi 75.000 altin.

english: Which places can the Escape crystal teleport me out of?
translation: Kacis kristali beni hangi yerlerden isinlayabilir?

english: The crystals currently work in the Theatre of Blood, the Chambers of Xeric, TzHaar-Ket-Rak's Challenges, the Inferno, Pest Control, Barbarian Assault and the Tombs of Amascut.
translation: Kristaller su anda Kan Tiyatrosu, Xeric'in Odalari, TzHaar-Ket-Rak'in Meydan Okumalari, Cehennem, Hasere Kontrolü, Barbar Saldirisi ve Amascut'un Mezarlari'nda calisiyor.

english: No way, that's too expensive!
Well, there's a lot that goes into it to drive the price up that high. But I understand why you feel that way.
translation: Fiyati bu kadar yüksek yapan bircok faktör var. Ama neden böyle hissettigini anliyorum.

english: What are you up to now that your head is back where it belongs?
translation: Kafan yerine oturduguna göre simdi ne yapiyorsun?

english: I still study. I'm changing my field of study though. Hopefully if I don't mess up more spells, one day I can become the head wizard.
translation: Hala calisiyorum. Ama calisma alanimi degistiriyorum. Umarim daha fazla büyü yapmazsam, bir gün bas büyücü olabilirim.

english: I think that would suit you very well!
Goodbye, Rick.
Take care, [player name].
Hey there.
Hello.
Who are you?
My name is Rick. I'm a wizard student. I used to study magical farming, but I don't like it anymore.
translation: Adim Rick. Büyücü ögrencisiyim. Eskiden büyülü tarim ögreniyordum ama artik sevmiyorum.

english: Why don't you like it anymore?
It's a bit embarassing, but... I got my head swapped with a pumpkin. Luckily an adventurer came along and helped me get it back in place.
translation: Biraz utanc verici ama... Kafam bir balkabagiyla degistirildi. Neyse ki bir maceraci gelip kafami yerine koymama yardim etti.

english: That is indeed lucky.
Oh. Right! I have these crystal shards that will let you escape from particularly dangerous situations. They only work in certain places. I call them Escape crystals.
translation: Oh. Dogru! Özellikle tehlikeli durumlardan kacmani saglayacak kristal parcalarim var. Sadece belirli yerlerde ise yariyorlar. Onlara Kacis kristalleri diyorum.

english: Sometimes you get caught in places that won't let you teleport out by normal means. These crystals are specifically crafted to let you escape those scenarios.
translation: Bazen normal yollarla teleport olamayacagin yerlerde sikisip kalirsin. Bu kristaller, bu tür durumlardan kacmani saglamak icin özel olarak üretildi.

english: The Members objects I'm selling are quite delicate. I'd feel more comfortable selling them on a member's world.
translation: Sattigim üye nesneleri oldukca hassastir. Onlari üye dünyasinda satmak daha rahat olur.

english: What are you doing here?
I'm a student here at the tower. I don't know what I'll do now. Maybe I'll go home to Ardougne. Or maybe I'll pick up a new magical field to study.
translation: Ben bu kulede ögrenciyim. Simdi ne yapacagim bilmiyorum. Belki Ardougne'a eve dönerim. Ya da belki yeni bir sihir alani secip onu calisirim.

english: What kinds of magical fields are we talking about?
Anything but pumpkin fields.
Goodbye.
Bye.
How are you feeling?
Talk about what Rick is doing.
Goodbye.
Do you have anything to sell?
Sure - I'd like to buy a crystal.
Which places can the Escape crystal teleport me out of?
translation: Kacis kristali beni hangi yerlerden teleport edebilir?

english: No way, that's too expensive!
What are you up to?
Talk about how Rick is feeling.
Who are you?
What are you doing here?
It's a bit embarrassing, but... I got my head swapped with a pumpkin. Luckily an adventurer came along and helped me get it back in place.
translation: Biraz utanc verici ama... Kafam bir balkabagiyla degistirildi. Neyse ki bir maceraci gelip kafami yerine koymama yardim etti.

english: Can I buy an Escape crystal?
Yes! Of course.
It looks like you can't afford any crystals. They cost 75000 coins each.
translation: Kristalleri karsilayamayacak gibi görünüyorsun. Her biri 75.000 coin.

english: Can I buy an Members object?
The crystals I'm selling are quite delicate. I'd feel more comfortable selling them on a members' world.
translation: Sattigim kristaller oldukca hassastir. Onlari üye dünyasinda satmak daha rahat olur.

english: Although you cannot technically take them into the Gauntlet, if you enable the feature that teleports you if you zone out and have a crystal on you when entering, it will continue to work within.
translation: Teknik olarak onlari Gauntlet'e götüremezsin, ama bölge disina ciktiginda seni teleport eden özelligi etkinlestirirsen ve girerken üzerinde kristal varsa, iceride de calismaya devam eder.

english: Wonderful!
Which places can the Members object teleport me out of?
translation: Üye nesnesi beni hangi yerlerden teleport edebilir?

english: What kind of magical fields are we talking about?
Oh. Right! I have these crystal shards that will let you escape from particularly dangerous situations. They only work in certain places. I call them Members objects.
translation: Oh. Dogru! Özellikle tehlikeli durumlardan kacmaniza izin veren kristal parcalarim var. Bunlar sadece belirli yerlerde calisir. Ben onlara Üye nesneleri diyorum.

english: Sometimes you get caught in places that won't let you teleport out by normal means. These crystals are specially crafted to let you escape those scenarios. I've recently enhanced them as well!
translation: Bazen normal yollarla teleport olamayacaginiz yerlerde sikisip kalirsiniz. Bu kristaller, bu tür durumlardan kacmanizi saglamak icin özel olarak üretilmistir. Son zamanlarda onlari da gelistirdim!

english: Have you ever found yourself zoning out, and come back to reality to find yourself under attack and on the brink of death? Well you can configure them to teleport you to safety if !
translation: Hic bölgeden ciktiginizda, geri döndügünüzde saldiri altinda ve ölümün esiginde oldugunuzu gördünüz mü? Eger öyleyse, sizi güvenli bir yere isinlamak icin bunlari yapilandirabilirsiniz!

english: It does mean they are likely to trigger in combat, although I'm working on that. But they should let you run through a dangerous area as long as you don't stop in the middle.
translation: Bu, savas sirasinda tetiklenme olasiliklari oldugu anlamina gelir, ancak bunun üzerinde calisiyorum. Ancak, ortada durmadiginiz sürece tehlikeli bir bölgeden gecmenize izin vermelidirler.

english: They also now work in any place a ring of life would. Talking about rings of life, they can also act just like one if you configure them to be so.
translation: Artik yasam halkasinin calistigi her yerde calisiyorlar. Yasam halkasindan bahsetmisken, bunlari öyle yapilandirirsaniz, onlar da tipki bir yasam halkasi gibi davranabilirler.

english: Can I buy an Escape crystal?
Yes
No
Can I buy an Members object?
Which places can the Members object teleport me out of?
translation: Üye nesnesi beni hangi yerlerden teleport edebilir?

english: Can I buy a Escape crystal?
Today is your lucky day, [sirrah/madam/my liege]! I am donating to the victims of crime to atone for my past actions!
translation: Bugün sansli gününüz, efendim! Gecmisteki eylemlerimin kefareti olarak suc magdurlarina bagis yapiyorum!

english: 'Twas a pleasure to work with you [sirrah/ma'am/my liege]!
It is someone else with whom I desire to speak, but he seems to be preoccupied.
translation: Konusmak istedigim baska biri var, ama o mesgul görünüyor.

english: Good day to you, [milord/milady/my liege] [player name].
I seek a moment of your time, [sirrah/ma’am/my liege]!
[Milord/Milady/My liege] [player name], please speak to me!
Maybe later.
I must leave you now, [sirrah/ma'am/my liege]!
Sorry I can't let you through, find some bunny else to bother, I'm busy.
translation: Üzgünüm, seni geciremem, baska birini bulup rahatsiz et, ben mesgulüm.

english: Can you see your own rift?
No. From time to time I feel it shift and change inside me though. It is an odd feeling.
translation: Hayir. Ama zaman zaman icimde bir degisim ve dönüsüm hissediyorum. Garip bir his.

english: Where would you like me to take you today Rifty?
translation: Bugün seni nereye götürmemi istersin Rifty?

english: Please do not call me that... we are a species of honour, [player name].
translation: Lütfen bana öyle deme... Biz onurlu bir türüz, Maceraci.

english: Sorry.
Hey! What's that!
You quickly poke your hand through the rift guardian's rift.
translation: Elini hizla yarik bekcisinin yarigina sokuyorsun.

english: Huh, what?! Where?
