Not the best guardian it seems.
translation: Pek iyi bir bekci degil galiba.

english: About your colour-changing...
If you take me to a Runecrafting Altar, I will adopt the altar's colour as you bind essence there.
translation: Beni bir Rün Yapimi Sunakina götürürsen, sen orada özü baglarken sunakin rengini alacagim.

english: I want you to stay this colour instead.
translation: Bunun yerine bu rengi korumani istiyorum.

english: Very well, I will remain locked to this colour, even if you bind essence at a Runecrafting Altar.
translation: Peki, Rün Yapimi Sunakinda özü baglasan bile bu renkte kalacagim.

english: Okay, carry on adopting the colour of altars.
translation: Tamam, sunaklarin rengini almaya devam et.

english: Very well, I will adopt the altar's colour next time you bind essence at a Runecrafting Altar.
translation: Peki, bir dahaki sefere Runecrafting Altar'da öz bagladiginda sunaklarin rengini alacagim.

english: Even if you bind essence at a Runecrafting Altar, I will remain locked to this colour.
translation: Runecrafting Altar'da öz baglasan bile bu renkte kalacagim.

english: I'd like you to adopt the altar's colour next time.
translation: Bir dahaki sefere sunaklarin rengini almani istiyorum.

english: Okay, please stay locked to this colour.
Actually, never mind.
How are you doing today?
The power of the Abyss grows. I fear for what will happen if our defence against it fails.
translation: Abyss'in gücü büyüyor. Savunmamiz basarisiz olursa ne olacagindan korkuyorum.

english: The Guardians of the Rift have things under control. You don't need to worry.
translation: Rift'in Muhafizlari her seyi kontrol altinda tutuyor. Endiselenmene gerek yok.

english: Let us hope you are correct.
Feel my wrath!
Get out of my altar!
Feel the power of my rift!
I'll convert your very essence into runes.
Can you see your own rift?
Where would you like to go today, Rifty?
Hey! What's that?
About your colour-changing...
I want you to stay this colour instead.
Okay, carry on adopting the colour of altars.
translation: Tamam, sunaklarin rengini almaya devam et.

english: I'd like you to adopt the altar's colour next time.
translation: Bir dahaki sefere sunaklarin rengini almani istiyorum.

english: Okay, please stay locked to this colour.
Actually, never mind.
How are you doing today?
Hello there, what are you doing here?
I... am the sculptor's associate.
His associate? What does that mean?
translation: Yardimcisi mi? Bu ne anlama geliyor?

english: Are you going to say anything meaningful at all?
No, apparantly not.
I'm glad I don't have to talk to you anymore!
translation: Artik seninle konusmak zorunda olmadigim icin mutluyum!

english: Hrm.
Hello there.
Welcome to the clothes store. How might I help you?
translation: Giysi magazasina hos geldiniz. Nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: It's a very interesting island you have here.
translation: Burada cok ilginc bir ada var.

english: Why thank you. It's been our haven for a great many generations.
Everything seems to have a magical feel to it.
translation: Her sey sihirli bir havaya sahip gibi görünüyor.

english: Of course. We integrate magic into all areas of our lives. It is a part of everyone, so why deny it? It's best to make the most of this innate gift we have all been given.
translation: Elbette. Sihri hayatimizin her alanina entegre ediyoruz. Herkesin bir parcasi, neden inkar edelim ki? Hepimize verilmis olan bu dogustan gelen yetenegi en iyi sekilde kullanmak en iyisidir.

english: What sort of things do you use your magic for?
translation: Sihirinizi ne tür seyler icin kullaniyorsunuz?

english: Take a look around. We use it in our day to day lives, from making a cup of tea, to travelling around the island. You see our ancestors were the ones that found the first rune essence and put it to use! The various
translation: Etrafa bir bakin. Günlük hayatimizda, bir fincan cay yapmakten adada seyahat etmeye kadar her seyde kullaniyoruz. Atalarimiz ilk rune özünü bulan ve onu kullanmaya baslayanlardi! Özün nasil kullanilmasi gerektigi konusunda farkli fikirleri olan insanlar (bazi durumlarda kullanilmamasi gerektigini düsünenler de vardi!) sonunda cesitli

english: factions were eventually created, with people having different ideas on how the essence should be used (or not in some cases!)
What has kept you so secluded on this island?
translation: Sizi bu adada bu kadar izole tutan nedir?

english: It may be a bit beyond you, but although magic comes from within, we are all very strongly linked to the moon and the effects it has on us cannot be denied!
translation: Bu sizin icin biraz zor olabilir, ama sihir icimizden gelse de, hepimiz ay ile cok güclü bir baga sahibiz ve ayin üzerimizdeki etkisi yadsinamaz!

english: It can't?
Of course not. This very island has a great link to our moon, which helps us understand ourselves - especially our dreams, which is the path to understanding magic.
translation: Tabii ki hayir. Bu ada, ay ile cok güclü bir bagi var ve bu da kendimizi anlamamiza yardimci oluyor - özellikle de sihir anlamanin yolu olan rüyalarimizi.

english: I think I will just have to take your word on that.
translation: Sanirim bu konuda sana inanmak zorundayim.

english: I'm good thanks, bye.
What can you sell me?
It's a very interesting island you have here.
translation: Burada cok ilginc bir adan var.

english: I'm good thanks, bye.
Come to visit my garden then, have you, human?
translation: O zaman bahcemi ziyarete gel, degil mi insan?

english: This is your garden?
No no, not quite. But I do look after it. It's the palace garden, you see. I keep it tidy, keep it living.
translation: Hayir, hayir, tam olarak degil. Ama ona bakiyorum. Burasi saray bahcesi, anlarsin ya. Düzenli tutuyorum, canli kalmasini sagliyorum.

english: It's hard to grow much on these hard rocks deep beneath these mountains, you know.
translation: Bu daglarin derinliklerindeki sert kayalarda cok fazla sey yetistirmek zor, bilirsin.

english: I can imagine. Where do you get all your food from? Or even the soil for this garden?
translation: Tahmin edebiliyorum. Yiyeceklerini nereden buluyorsun? Ya da bu bahce icin topragi?

english: We can grow a little food underground, but most of it comes from the extensive steamcart network that runs beneath the earth.
translation: Yeraltinda biraz yiyecek yetistirebiliyoruz, ama cogu yeraltinda calisan genis buharli araba agindan geliyor.

english: In the Era of Kings, many centuries ago, it was harder of course. Our steam technology was not developed as far yet and getting fresh supplies of food was always a problem.
translation: Yüzyillar önce, Krallar Cagi'nda, tabii ki daha zordu. Buhar teknolojimiz henüz o kadar gelismemisti ve taze yiyecek temin etmek her zaman bir sorundu.

english: Oh, I'm not boring you, am I?
Not at all! Please, go on!
translation: Hic de degil! Lütfen devam edin!

english: Oh yes, as I was saying, it was difficult to make a decent living here. I'm afraid this garden was rather neglected during that time.
translation: Evet, dedigim gibi, burada düzgün bir yasam sürmek zordu. Korkarim bu bahce o dönemde oldukca ihmal edildi.

english: Why did you dwarves stay so deep under ground, then? Why not simply go above ground?
translation: O zaman neden siz cüceler yerin bu kadar derinliklerinde kaldiniz? Neden yer üstüne cikmadiniz?

english: What, with the wars raging up there?
We dwarves went underground a long time ago, see. For a while the city of Keldagrim was completely cut off from the rest of Gielinor simply waiting out the wars of the humans and the gods.
translation: Biz cüceler uzun zaman önce yerin altina indik. Bir süre Keldagrim sehri, Gielinor'un geri kalanindan tamamen kopuk kaldi ve sadece insanlarin ve tanrilarin savaslarinin bitmesini bekledi.

english: This made it hard, though, to determine when the wars above the ground were over. Perhaps Keldagrim had remained hidden for far too long.
translation: Ancak bu, yer üstündeki savaslarin ne zaman bittigini belirlemeyi zorlastirdi. Belki de Keldagrim cok uzun süre gizli kalmisti.

english: Only when King Alvis heroically defended the city against an invasion of trolls did we dare to venture out and see how much the world had changed.
translation: Ancak Kral Alvis, trollerin istilasina karsi sehri kahramanca savundugunda, disari cikip dünyanin ne kadar degistigini görmeye cesaret edebildik.

english: Of course, after that...
Ah well, enough history lessons I should say. I must really get back to my gardening.
translation: Neyse, tarih dersleri bu kadar yeter. Bahcemle ilgilenmem gerek.

english: Thanks for the info!
A little, yes. I don't really know what all this has to do with anything.
translation: Biraz, evet. Bunlarin neyle ilgisi oldugunu gercekten bilmiyorum.

english: I suppose it doesn't, really, it's just the mumblings of an old dwarf.
translation: Sanirim ilgisi yok, sadece yasli bir cücenin mirildanmalari.

english: Not really, no.
Oh, alright then.
I need some help.
Yes, [player name]? What can a humble gardener like myself help you with?
translation: Evet, Maceraci? Benim gibi mütevazi bir bahcivan sana nasil yardimci olabilir?

english: I have four Kelda seeds here, but need some advice on growing them.
translation: Burada dört Kelda tohumu var, ama onlari yetistirmek icin biraz tavsiyeye ihtiyacim var.

english: Marvelous, those seeds are quite scarce don't you know!
translation: Harika, bu tohumlar oldukca nadirdir, bilmiyor musun?

english: First of all, you must remember that these seeds only grow underground. Sunlight is harmful to them, for some strange reason.
translation: Öncelikle, bu tohumlarin sadece yer altinda yetistigini unutma. Garip bir nedenden dolayi günes isigi onlara zararlidir.

english: There is a patch in the palace garden that you're more than welcome to use.
translation: Saray bahcesinde kullanabilecegin bir alan var.

english: Thanks! Is there anything else I need to know?
translation: Tesekkürler! Bilmem gereken baska bir sey var mi?

english: Just take care of the weed in the patch and plant your seeds. They'll grow into hops very quickly, if you're lucky. Kelda seeds have a remarkably fast grow rate.
translation: Sadece bahcedeki yabani otlari temizle ve tohumlarini ek. Sansliysan, cok cabuk hop haline gelirler. Kelda tohumlari oldukca hizli büyür.

english: Also, if you need a rake, you'll find one just south of here, I left it there 5 minutes ago.
translation: Ayrica, tirmik ihtiyacin olursa, 5 dakika önce buradan biraz güneyde biraktim.

english: Thank you! Your advice is much appreciated!
I think I need some more help with this whole farming business.
translation: Sanirim bu ciftcilik isinde biraz daha yardima ihtiyacim var.

english: Just get rid of the weeds in the patch, plant your seeds and wait for the hops to grow. The miracle of nature will do the rest!
translation: Tarladaki yabani otlari temizle, tohumlarini ek ve serbetciotunun büyümesini bekle. Gerisini doganin mucizesi halleder!

english: Do I have to wait here all this time then?
translation: O zaman tüm bu süre boyunca burada beklemem mi gerekiyor?

english: Yea and no. Yes, you do have to wait, but no, you don't have to stay here. You can help out people in the city, for instance, there's always someone who needs help with an urgent job.
translation: Evet ve hayir. Evet, beklemelisin, ama hayir, burada kalman gerekmiyor. Sehirdeki insanlara yardim edebilirsin, örnegin, her zaman acil bir iste yardima ihtiyaci olan biri vardir.

english: You mean the mining companies? I did jobs for them, they're not very profitable.
translation: Maden sirketlerini mi kastediyorsun? Onlar icin isler yaptim, pek karli degiller.

english: No no, just people like shopkeepers and such, they're quite willing to teach you things in exchange for the jobs as well. But here, tell you what, I'll give you some seeds if you can deliver this letter to a friend in Falador.
translation: Hayir hayir, sadece dükkan sahipleri gibi insanlar, is karsiliginda sana bir seyler ögretmeye de oldukca istekliler. Ama bak ne diyecegim, bu mektubu Falador'daki bir arkadasina ulastirirsan sana biraz tohum verecegim.

english: Do I have to do that? I just want to grow my hops and get on with my quest for Veldaban.
translation: Bunu yapmak zorunda miyim? Ben sadece serbetciotumu yetistirmek ve Veldaban'a olan görevime devam etmek istiyorum.

english: Oh no, you don't have to do it all, I just thought you wanted something to do while you were waiting.
translation: Hayir, hepsini yapmak zorunda degilsin, sadece beklerken yapacak bir sey ariyorsundur diye düsündüm.

english: Alright, I'll deliver that letter for you.
translation: Tamam, mektubu senin icin teslim edecegim.

english: Happy to hear that! His name is Elstan, he lives just south of Falador.
translation: Bunu duyduguma sevindim! Adi Elstan, Falador'un hemen güneyinde yasiyor.

english: I'll be right back!
I'd rather just sit here and stare at this patch, thanks.
translation: Ben burada oturup bu tarlaya bakmayi tercih ederim, tesekkürler.

english: Very well. That can be quite relaxing, actually, I often do it myself.
translation: Peki. Aslinda bu oldukca rahatlatici olabilir, ben de sik sik yaparim.

english: Hello again, [player name]! Have you been able to deliver that letter yet?
translation: Merhaba tekrar, Maceraci! Mektubu teslim edebildin mi?

english: No, I haven't been to Falador yet, but I will soon.
translation: Hayir, Falador'a henüz gitmedim, ama yakinda gidecegim.

english: Much appreciated, Player!
No, sorry, I lost your letter.
That's a little clumsy, Player! Here, I've got a copy, please deliver this one instead.
translation: Bu biraz sakarlik oldu, Oyuncu! Al, bir kopyasi var, lütfen bunun yerine bunu teslim et.

english: No, I've decided not to deliver it after all.
translation: Hayir, sonucta teslim etmemeye karar verdim.

english: Oh, I'm sad to hear that.
Oh well, I'll see if I can find someone else instead.
translation: Oh, peki, baska birini bulmaya calisayim.

english: I've delivered your letter to Elstan, he told me to give you his regards.
translation: Mektubunu Elstan'a teslim ettim, sana selamlarini iletmemi söyledi.

english: Wonderful, that's just wonderful! Here, have these two seeds as a reward. They may not be Kelda hop seeds, but you should be able to grow a decent amount of herbs with them.
translation: Harika, bu harika! Al, ödül olarak bu iki tohum. Kelda hop tohumlari olmayabilirler, ama onlarla yeterli miktarda ot yetistirebilirsin.

english: How are you getting along with growing your seeds into hops, [player name]?
translation: Tohumlarini serbetciotuna dönüstürme isi nasil gidiyor, Maceraci?

english: Hmm, I'm not sure... let me check the patch.
I've grown my seeds into hops, but I have no idea what to do with them. Can you turn them into stout for me please?
translation: Tohumlarimi serbetciotuna dönüstürdüm, ama onlarla ne yapacagimi bilmiyorum. Onlari benim icin stout haline getirebilir misin lütfen?

english: Haha, it doesn't quite work like that, I'm afraid!
translation: Haha, korkarim ki isler öyle yürümüyor!

english: You will need to bring your hops to a brewery.
translation: Serbetciotunu bir bira fabrikasina götürmen gerekecek.

english: Where's the nearest brewery then?
translation: En yakin bira fabrikasi nerede peki?

english: Oh, there's one in Keldagrim-East, upstairs in the Laughing Miner. They brew their own beer, they do.
translation: Keldagrim-East'te, Laughing Miner'in üst katinda bir tane var. Kendi biralarini üretiyorlar.

english: How does it work though?
I'm sure someone there will be able to help you out, it's not my specialty you see.
translation: Orada biri sana yardimci olacaktir, bu benim uzmanlik alanim degil.

english: Alright, thanks a lot!
I've grown my seeds into hops, but I seem to have mislaid them.
translation: Tohumlarimi serbetciotu olarak yetistirdim, ama galiba onlari kaybettim.

english: Ah! Fortunately I found some hops after your recent harvest. Here, I believe this belongs to you.
translation: Ah! Neyse ki son hasadindan sonra biraz serbetciotu buldum. Al, sanirim bu sana ait.

english: I'm brewing my hops into Kelda stout, but it seems to be taking an awfully long time.
translation: Serbetciotumu Kelda stout olarak mayaliyorum, ama cok uzun sürüyor gibi görünüyor.

english: Just have patience, my young friend! Have a wander around town, see if anyone has jobs for you!
translation: Sabirli ol, genc dostum! Kasabada dolas, sana is verecek biri var mi bak!

english: I'm just so angry, my hops aren't fermenting at all. I want my Kelda stout!
translation: Cok sinirliyim, serbetciotum hic mayalanmiyor. Kelda stout'umu istiyorum!

english: Now now, my young human friend! Are you sure about that?
translation: Sakin ol, genc dostum! Emin misin?

english: Perhaps you should go back to the brewery, I wouldn't be surprised if your stout has fermented by now.
translation: Belki de bira fabrikasina geri dönmelisin, stout'un simdiye kadar mayalanmis olsa sasirmam.

english: This is your garden?
Not at all!
A little, yes.
Not really, no.
Alright, I'll deliver that letter for you.
translation: Tamam, mektubu senin icin teslim edecegim.

english: I'd rather just sit here and stare at this patch, thanks.
translation: Burada oturup bu bahceye bakmayi tercih ederim, tesekkürler.

english: No, I haven't been to Falador yet, but I will soon.
translation: Hayir, Falador'a henüz gitmedim, ama yakinda gidecegim.

english: No, sorry, I've lost your letter.
No, I've decided not to deliver it after all.
translation: Hayir, sonunda teslim etmemeye karar verdim.

english: Hello.
Howdy.
What are you doing here?
Same as you I'd wager, lookin' fer that big ol' bunny.
translation: Seninle ayni seyi, o kocaman tavsani ariyorum.

english: Well we've found him.
That we have kid, that we have.
Do you know what raisins are?
Raisins? Talk to Glanton, kid. He's your raisin man.
translation: Kuru üzüm mü? Glanton'la konus evlat. O senin kuru üzüm adamin.

english: Oh, okay then!
Thanks for helping with the raisins.
translation: Kuru üzüm konusunda yardim ettigin icin tesekkürler.

english: It was no skin off my nose, any time kid.
translation: Benim icin sorun degildi, ne zaman istersen cocuk.

english: Good work with those raisins kid, you've got real moxy. Tell me, do you like games?
translation: Kuru üzümlerle iyi is cikardin cocuk, gercekten cesursun. Söylesene, oyunlari sever misin?

english: Games? Like Runelink?
Runelink! Hah! I mean real games, games with a wager. Pride or humiliation. Stakes worth fighting for.
translation: Runelink! Hah! Ben gercek oyunlari kastediyorum, bahisli oyunlari. Gurur ya da asagilanma. Savasmaya deger bahisler.

english: Sounds risky.
There you have it, risk indeed.
Ever been to the wilderness?
Real evil haunts that place...
translation: Orasi gercek kötülügün kol gezdigi bir yer...

english: ...And we haunt the evil right back.
What say ye? Come hasten the reckoning of the horrible legions what dwell up there with us sometime?
translation: Ne dersin? Bir ara bizimle birlikte orada yasayan korkunc ordularin hesaplasmasini hizlandirmaya ne dersin?

english: Ehh, I'll think about it.
It won't catch on, Glanton.
Ah don't be like that Rinder, how will we know till we try?
translation: Ah, böyle olma Rinder, denemeden nasil bilecegiz?

english: Alright gents, what's going on here then?
I've had this great idea see.
Does it have anything to do with long walks in the desert again?
translation: Yine cölde uzun yürüyüslerle mi ilgili?

english: Well y'see thats the beauty of it.
It's a lot easier to melt chocolate than dry out grapes.
translation: Cikolatayi eritmek, üzümleri kurutmaktan cok daha kolay.

english: Chocolate? You've piqued my interest!
Exactly! See Rinder, [player name] doesn't even know half the idea yet and wants in!
translation: Aynen! Gördün mü Rinder, Maceraci fikrin yarisini bile bilmiyor ama katilmak istiyor!

english: It still seems terribly messy.
Okay so, what we do is use our connections with the Easter Bunny to acquire a lot of chocolate.
translation: Tamam, o zaman, Paskalya Tavsani ile olan baglantilarimizi kullanarak cok fazla cikolata elde edecegiz.

english: And give it to me for my outstanding contributions to the preservation of Easter?
translation: Ve Paskalya'nin korunmasina yaptigim olaganüstü katkilarim icin bana mi vereceksiniz?

english: No.
And we melt it all up, and put it in a fountain.
translation: Ve hepsini eritecegiz ve bir cesmeye koyacagiz.

english: And then I get to have it all?
translation: Ve sonra hepsini ben mi alacagim?

english: No then we sell people the right to take a couple of small fruits to dip in the fountain and eat!
translation: Hayir, sonra insanlara cesmeye batirip yemek icin birkac kücük meyve alma hakki satacagiz!

english: That sounds delicious!
Yes.
But I can get some for free?
See the amount people would pay for just a taste of chocolate is so much higher than we'd have to pay to source a lot of the stuff.
translation: Insanlarin cikolatayi tatmak icin ödeyecekleri miktar, bizim cikolatayi temin etmek icin ödeyecegimiz miktardan cok daha fazla.

english: Well, I'm not interested if I have to pay.
I saved Easter...
... Again!
I think I'll go see if the Easter Bunny has some more eggs for me...
translation: Gidip Paskalya Tavsani'nin benim icin baska yumurtalari var mi diye bakayim...

english: Be seeing you!
What do you do here?
Well, it's funny you should ask that actually, I run the local parcel service to the mainland.
translation: Aslinda bunu sorman cok komik, ben anakaraya yerel paket servisi yapiyorum.

english: Parcel service?
Yes, we sometimes get asked to send items back to the mainland. We can send items to individuals' bank accounts, for a small fee of course.
translation: Evet, bazen anakaraya esya göndermemiz istenir. Tabii ki kücük bir ücret karsiliginda esyalari bireylerin banka hesaplarina gönderebiliriz.

english: How much does it cost?
It costs 10 trading sticks per item, unfortunately, even stackable items cost the same.
translation: Maalesef, her esya icin 10 ticaret cubugu ücret aliyoruz, istiflenebilir esyalar da ayni ücrete tabi.

english: What are trading sticks and how do I get some?
translation: Ticaret cubuklari nedir ve nasil elde edebilirim?

english: Trading sticks are our local currency, you could perhaps earn some trading sticks by doing some work around the village.
translation: Ticaret cubuklari bizim yerel para birimimizdir, köyde bazi isler yaparak ticaret cubuklari kazanabilirsiniz.

english: Have a chat with Murcaily, I think he was looking for someone to help him, he works near the hardwood grove to the east of Trufitus' hut.
translation: Murcaily ile konusun, sanirim kendisine yardim edecek birini ariyordu, Trufitus'un kulübesinin dogusundaki sert agac korusunda calisiyor.

english: Ok, thanks.
Can I send a parcel please?
It costs at least 10 trading sticks to use this service. Sorry but you don't have enough.
translation: Bu hizmeti kullanmak icin en az 10 ticaret cubugu gerekiyor. Üzgünüm ama yeterli miktarda yok.

english: Of course...which items would you like to send to your bank?
translation: Tabii ki...hangi esyalari bankana göndermek istersin?

english: Is there anything interesting to do here?
translation: Burada ilginc bir sey var mi?

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
Yeah, you've been doing a lot of good work around here. Let me give you something for your time and effort.
translation: Evet, burada cok iyi isler yapiyorsun. Zamanin ve emeklerin icin sana bir sey vereyim.

english: I've already given you some trading sticks and I don't have any more on me at the moment. Why not go and talk to some of the other villagers and get some contributions?
translation: Sana zaten birkac ticaret cubugu verdim ve su anda üzerimde baska yok. Neden gidip diger köylülerle konusup biraz katki almiyorsun?

english: Ok, thanks.
Hey, I've seen you working around the village. You've been doing a lot of good work around here for us. Let me give you something for your trouble.
translation: Hey, seni köyde calisirken gördüm. Buraya bizim icin cok iyi isler yapiyorsun. Zahmetin icin sana bir sey vereyim.

english: What do you do here?
How much does it cost?
What are trading sticks and how do I get some?
translation: Ticaret cubuklari nedir ve nasil alabilirim?

english: Can I send a parcel please?
I've been doing some work around the village.
Fishies be mine, leave dem fishies!
Would you like to buy some fishing equipment, or sell some fish?
translation: Balikcilik ekipmani satin almak veya balik satmak ister misin?

english: No thank you.
Yes please.
No thank you.
Hello there!
Greetings traveller. Welcome to 'The Hair Of The Dog' Tavern. What can I do for you?
translation: Selamlar gezgin. “The Hair Of The Dog” Tavernasina hos geldin. Senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: Can I buy a beer?
Well that's my specialty! The local brew's named 'Moonlight Mead' and will set you back 5 gold. Whaddya say? Fancy a pint?
translation: Bu benim uzmanlik alanim! Yerel bira “Moonlight Mead” adinda ve 5 altin. Ne dersin? Bir pint ister misin?

english: Yes please.
I don't have the money on me right now though... can I start a tab?
translation: Ama su anda üzerimde para yok... Hesap acabilir miyim?

english: You see that sign behind me there?
The one that says; 'Please Do Not Ask For Credit As Being Attacked By A Large Angry Werewolf Inn Keeper Often Offends'?
translation: Üzerinde “Lütfen kredi istemeyin, cünkü büyük ve öfkeli bir kurt adam tarafindan saldiriya ugramak genellikle tavernacilari rahatsiz eder” yazan tabelayi?

english: Bingo
Here ya go pal. Enjoy!
Actually, no thanks.
Eh, suit yourself. You're missing out on a genuine taste experience.
translation: Eh, sen bilirsin. Gercek bir lezzet deneyimini kaciriyorsun.

english: Can I hear some gossip?
Well, I dunno... The village is kind of on the fringe out here, I dunno how up to date the stuff I hear about is...
translation: Sey, bilmiyorum... Köy biraz kenarda kalmis, duydugum seylerin ne kadar güncel oldugunu bilmiyorum...

english: Tell me about this village.
You want to know about Canifis? I dunno why, not a lot happens here. We're just your typical everyday down at earth werewolf folk, after all...
translation: Canifis'i mi bilmek istiyorsun? Neden bilmiyorum, burada pek bir sey olmuyor. Sonucta biz siradan, ayaklari yere basan kurtadamlariz...

english: So... everyone here is a werewolf?
translation: Yani... buradaki herkes kurt adam mi?

english: Yep. We are as Zamorak made us!
You mentioned Zamorak...
Yeah, he's great isn't he? Every year we hold a big festival to give thanks to Zamorak for keeping us well fed and happy here.
translation: Evet, harika biri, degil mi? Her yil Zamorak'a bizi burada tok ve mutlu tuttugu icin tesekkür etmek icin büyük bir festival düzenliyoruz.

english: I hear over in the West they worship Saradomin, but I dunno why! What's he ever done to help out us werewolves, huh?
translation: Bati'da Saradomin'e taptiklarini duydum, ama nedenini bilmiyorum! O kurtadamlara ne yardim etti ki?

english: I hear he has all these crazy followers who say things like we shouldn't kill people and eat them! What's up with that?
translation: Duyduguma göre, insanlari öldürmememiz ve yemememiz gerektigini söyleyen cilgin takipcileri varmis! Bu da ne demek oluyor?

english: ...So when is this festival?
Aaah, not for a good few months yet. Come and ask me again nearer to the time, I'll keep some extra meat and mead pack from the rest for ya pal.
translation: Aaah, birkac ay var daha. Yaklastiginda tekrar gelip sor, senin icin fazladan et ve bal likörü ayiririm dostum.

english: Tell me about the land of Morytania.

Well, I don't know what to tell you really... This village is called Canifis and lies on the border between Morytania and Misthalin... so we're kind of on the front line if those Saradominists to the west ever decide to attack us... South East of here is the castle of Lord Drakan, our master.
translation: Sey, sana ne anlatacagimi bilmiyorum... Bu köyün adi Canifis ve Morytania ile Misthalin arasindaki sinirda bulunuyor... yani batidaki Saradoministler bize saldirmaya karar verirlerse, biz cephe hattinda sayiliriz... Buradan güneydoguda, efendimiz Lord Drakan'in kalesi var.

english: Lord Drakan? Who is that?
Ahh... you must be new to these parts if you haven't heard of Lord Draken! He's the lord of this land, and we all pledge allegiance to him.
translation: Ahh... Lord Draken'i duymamissan bu bölgede yeni olmalisin! O bu topragin efendisi ve hepimiz ona baglilik yemini ettik.

english: In return for our allegiance, and the tithe of course, he keeps our land safe from any invaders and the Saradominists who want to kill us all.
translation: Bagliligimizin ve tabii ki vergilerimizin karsiliginda, o da topraklarimizi isgalcilerden ve hepimizi öldürmek isteyen Saradoministlerden koruyor.

english: Tithe? What do you mean?

Ah, well, in return for his protection, we have to give Lord Drakan a share of blood every week. If we don't have any to spare from our hunts, then we need to pick a member of the village to give their life in return
translation: Ah, sey, onun korumasi karsiliginda, Lord Drakan'a her hafta bir miktar kan vermek zorundayiz. Avlarimizdan artan kanimiz yoksa, köyden birini secip onun hayatini kan karsiliginda feda etmeliyiz

english: for the blood so that the tithe is fulfilled.
translation: böylece vergi yükümlülügümüz yerine getirilmis olur.

english: You mean you kill someone you know in order to meet the tithe?
translation: Yani, ondaligi yerine getirmek icin tanidiginiz birini öldürüyor musunuz?

english: That's right, but only if we haven't managed to get enough spare blood from our hunts. It's kind of severe if you look at it that way, but frankly, I think the price is fair for his protection and his tolerance of
translation: Evet, ama sadece avlarimizdan yeterince kan elde edemedigimizde. Bu sekilde bakildiginda biraz agir bir sey gibi görünüyor, ama acikcasi, onun korumasi ve köyümüze karsi gösterdigi hosgörü icin bu bedel adil bence.

english: our village. He could probably kill us all if he wanted us gone, so keeping on his good side is worth the sacrifice to us. Lucky we're not human really!
translation: Eger bizi ortadan kaldirmak isteseydi, muhtemelen hepimizi öldürebilirdi, bu yüzden onunla iyi gecinmek bizim icin bu fedakarliga deger. Insan olmadigimiz icin sansliyiz!

english: Why's that?
He hates humans! Apparently long ago his brother Draynor was trapped in Misthalin and lost much of his powers, and was recently killed by some human!
translation: O insanlardan nefret ediyor! Anlasilan uzun zaman önce kardesi Draynor Misthalin'de mahsur kalmis ve güclerinin cogunu kaybetmis, ve yakin zamanda bir insan tarafindan öldürülmüs!

english: He hates humans! Apparently long ago his brother Draynor was trapped in Misthalin, and adventurous little human wannabe-heroes keep trying to kill him!
translation: O insanlardan nefret ediyor! Anlasilan uzun zaman önce kardesi Draynor Misthalin'de mahsur kalmis, ve maceraci kücük insan kahraman adaylari onu öldürmeye calisip duruyorlar!

english: Man, I'd hate to be a human around here, that's for sure. Drakan would really enjoy hunting them down and killing them!
translation: Dostum, bu civarda insan olmak istemezdim, orasi kesin. Drakan onlari avlayip öldürmekten büyük zevk alirdi!

english: Uh... thanks for the info...
Tell me about the shopkeepers here.
translation: Buradaki dükkan sahipleri hakkinda bilgi ver bana.

english: Hmmm? Why, who did you want to hear the gossip about?
translation: Hmmm? Neden, kimin dedikodularini duymak istiyorsun?

english: Tell me what you know about Sbott the Tanner.
translation: Sbott the Tanner hakkinda bildiklerini anlat bana.

english: Hey, I won't hear a word said bad about that guy! He's an honest and hard-working wolf if I ever met one! He charges a lot for his job, but he's one of the best tanners I've ever seen - and I'm over four hundred
translation: Hey, o adam hakkinda kötü bir sey duymak istemiyorum! O, tanidigim en dürüst ve caliskan kurt! Isine cok para istiyor, ama gördügüm en iyi tabakcilardan biri - ve ben dört yüz yasindayim!

english: years old! You need stuff tanning, I recommend him!
translation: Tabaklama isin varsa, onu tavsiye ederim!

english: Know anything interesting about Rufus the food seller?
translation: Yiyecek saticisi Rufus hakkinda ilginc bir sey biliyor musun?

english: Ah, yeah... good old Rufus... He's kind of getting on in years and doesn't like to come out of his wolf form so often, but let me tell you this: that guy is a hunter through and through. You seen how much food he
translation: Ah, evet... eski dost Rufus... Yaslanmaya basladi ve kurt formundan cok sik cikmak istemiyor, ama sunu söyleyeyim: o adam tam bir avci. Günde ne kadar yiyecek

english: catches a day? That takes real dedication! Some of the young pups think just because a wolf has a bit of grey in his fur then he's past it, but I've seen him put those pups to shame in a hunt! He's a real inspiration to us all!
translation: avladigini gördün mü? Bu gercek bir adanmislik gerektirir! Bazi genc yavrular, bir kurtun kürkünde biraz gri var diye onun artik isinin bittigini düsünüyor, ama ben onun avda o yavrulari utandirdigini gördüm! O hepimiz icin gercek bir ilham kaynagi!

english: Got anything to share about Barker the clothes seller?
translation: Giysi saticisi Barker hakkinda paylasacak bir seyin var mi?

english: Eh, I don't like the guy much, but you can't knock the quality of his stock. They're some fine quality threads you can get yourself there.
translation: Eh, onu pek sevmem, ama ürünlerinin kalitesini yadsiyamazsin. Oradan kaliteli giysiler alabilirsin.

english: What's wrong with him?
Eh... I can't really tell you to be honest. Something about the guy just gets my hackles up everytime he opens his yap, know what I mean?
translation: Eh... Dürüst olmak gerekirse, tam olarak bilmiyorum. Adam agzini her actiginda beni sinirlendiren bir sey var, anliyor musun?

english: No, not really.
Lucky for you. I can't really explain it, I just don't like the guy. Does great clothes though, you got to give him that.
translation: Sanslisin. Tam olarak aciklayamiyorum, sadece onu sevmiyorum. Ama harika giysiler yapiyor, bunu kabul etmelisin.

english: I bet you have some juicy gossip about Fidelio the general store owner.
translation: Eminim genel magaza sahibi Fidelio hakkinda ilginc dedikodular biliyorsundur.

english: That nut job? Oh sure, we all know about him. He was a real firebrand daredevil when he was younger, always taking risks to make himself a quick buck... he got himself caught up in the smuggling trade, sneaking over
translation: O deli mi? Tabii, hepimiz onu taniyoruz. Gencken cok cesur ve atilgandi, hizli para kazanmak icin her zaman risk alirdi... kacakcilik isine bulasti,

english: the border into Misthalin and pretending to be a human so he could buy exotic items to sell.
translation: siniri gecip Misthalin'e gizlice girip insan gibi davranarak egzotik esyalar satin alip satardi.

english: Exotic items? From Misthalin? Like what?
translation: Egzotik esyalar mi? Misthalin'den mi? Ne gibi?

english: Oh man, you name it! Flour... buckets... tinderboxes... chisels... he could get the lot! He's been doing it so long now though, his nerves are shot.
translation: Her sey var! Un... kovalar... cakmaktasi kutulari... keski... her seyi bulabiliyordu! Ama bunu o kadar uzun süredir yapiyor ki, sinirleri bozuldu.

english: Nowadays he's a disgrace, he can barely string a sentence together and jumps at his own shadow. Makes you feel ashamed to be a werewolf.
translation: Simdiyse bir utanc kaynagi, zar zor cümle kurabiliyor ve kendi gölgesinden bile korkuyor. Kurt adam olmaktan utaniyorsun.

english: Tell me about the temple to the west.
Well, I'm not old enough to remember the full story behind it, but it was a terrible day for our kingdom when it was built there.
translation: Sey, onun arkasindaki hikayenin tamamini hatirlayacak kadar yasli degilim, ama oraya insa edildigi gün kralligimiz icin korkunc bir gündü.

english: Apparently Morytania had a once strong kingdom, with lands spreading far further west than they do today, and south into the desert, until the day when a sneak attack by the hated human forces who worship
translation: Görünüse göre Morytania bir zamanlar güclü bir krallikti, topraklari bugün oldugundan cok daha batiya ve güneye, cöle kadar uzaniyordu, ta ki nefret edilen, Saradomin'e tapan insan güclerinin gizli saldirisi

english: Saradomin burned our villages and slaughtered our peoples in mass.
translation: köylerimizi yakip halkimizi toplu halde katletene kadar.

english: They then cursed the river, so that it would burn our kind should we touch it! Can you imagine??? To make an entire river poisonous to us???
translation: Sonra nehri lanetlediler, böylece nehre dokunursak yanacaktik! Düsünebiliyor musun? Bütün bir nehri bizim icin zehirli hale getirmek!

english: Luckily they seem to have calmed down somewhat recently, and tend to stay away on their side of the river... but the wrong they have done my people will never be forgotten, and will never be forgiven. What is worse is
translation: Neyse ki son zamanlarda biraz sakinlesmis görünüyorlar ve nehrin kendi taraflarinda kalmaya calisiyorlar... ama halkima yaptiklari kötülük asla unutulmayacak ve asla affedilmeyecek. Daha da kötüsü,

english: that they then had the nerve to build that gigantic statue on the river mouth to mock the slaughter of our people and the poisoning of our river! I can understand Lord Drakan's hatred for them even if I do not share
translation: nehrin agzina, halkimizin katledilmesini ve nehrimizin zehirlenmesini alay etmek icin o devasa heykeli dikmeye cüret ettiler! Lord Drakan'in onlara olan nefretini, onun kadar olmasa da

english: it to his extent.
So you hate humans too?
translation: Yani sen de insanlardan nefret ediyorsun?

english: Absolutely! If I ever met one I would gobble him up where he stands! And then chew the bones for dessert!
translation: Kesinlikle! Eger bir insanla karsilasirsam, onu oldugu yerde yutarim! Sonra da kemiklerini tatli olarak cignerim!

english: : ...Um, okay, thanks, bye.
Can I hear a story?
A story??? Heh, well the only one I can think of right now is my dear old mammy told me as a pup...
translation: Hikaye mi??? Heh, su anda aklima gelen tek hikaye, sevgili annemin bana yavruyken anlattigi...

english: Now how did it go... Ah yes!

Once upon a time a brave young wolf was walking through a forest, when he came upon a human dressed all in red. 'Aha!' he thought to himself, 'Here's a nice easy meal!' But the human talked to him, and as he was
translation: Bir zamanlar cesur bir genc kurt ormanda yürüyüs yaparken, bastan asagi kirmizi giyinmis bir insanla karsilasti. “Aha!” diye düsündü kendi kendine, “Iste kolay bir yemek!” Ama insan onunla konustu ve o da

english: always taught to be a polite wolf, he spoke back to it.
translation: her zaman kibar bir kurt olmasi ögretildigi icin, ona cevap verdi.

english: Well, this cunning human told him that there was a better meal that would not run away in a house in the woods. As the brave young wolf could see that this human was not fully grown, he figured maybe he'd
translation: Bu kurnaz insan ona, ormandaki bir evde kacmayacak daha iyi bir yemek oldugunu söyledi. Cesur genc kurt, bu insanin henüz tam olarak büyümemis oldugunu gördügü icin, belki de

english: better get a better meal at this house, so he ran as fasta as his paws could varry him to the house the human told him about... inside he found an old human lying in bed, and although the meat was a little tough, as the
translation: bu evde daha iyi bir yemek bulabilecegini düsündü ve insaninin söyledigi eve, pencelerinin onu götürebilecegi kadar hizli kostu... Iceride yatakta yatan yasli bir insan buldu ve et biraz sert olsa da,

english: human was older than he thought, he had a good meal and decided to sleep it off in the house for awhile. He had not been asleep long though, when he was woken by a knocking at the door. The human in red had followed
translation: insan düsündügünden daha yasli oldugu icin, iyi bir yemek yedi ve bir süre evde uyumaya karar verdi. Ancak cok uzun süre uyumamisti ki, kapinin calinmasiyla uyandi. Kirmizi giysili insan onu

english: him to the house! Suspecting a human trap, the brave young wolf put on the old humans clothes and jumped into the bed, so that he could pretend to be a human and escape from this terrible trap! Well now, this human
translation: eve kadar takip etmisti! Bir insan tuzagi oldugundan süphelenen cesur genc kurt, yasli insanin kiyafetlerini giyip yataga atladi, böylece insan gibi davranip bu korkunc tuzaktan kacabilecekti! Kirmizi giysili insan

english: dressed in red came into the house, and pretended to believe the brave wolf was really a human, and began to talk to him. But then the human started asking strange questions of the wolf, because the human knew that it
translation: eve girdi ve cesur kurdun gercekten insan olduguna inaniyormus gibi davranarak onunla konusmaya basladi. Ama sonra insan kurda garip sorular sormaya basladi, cünkü onun

english: was not a human at all! The brave young wolf decided to try and escape, for it was only a young human, and not very strong, so the brave young wolf said he would eat the human if they did not let him escape! As he said
translation: insan olmadigini biliyordu! Cesur genc kurt kacmaya karar verdi, cünkü o sadece genc bir insandi ve cok güclü degildi, bu yüzden cesur genc kurt, kacmasina izin vermezlerse insani yiyecegini söyledi! Ancak bunu söylediginde,

english: this however, the human in red shouted out at him: 'Aha! You are a wolf!' and as the human shouted this, another bigger human ran into the room from outside! This bigger human was much stronger and was
translation: kirmizi giysili insan ona bagirdi: “Aha! Sen bir kurtsun!” ve insan bunu bagirirken, disaridan baska bir daha büyük insan odaya kostu! Bu daha büyük insan cok daha güclüydü ve

english: carrying an axe, and the poor young wolf died in this terrible trap made for him by the humans.
translation: bir balta tasiyordu ve zavalli genc kurt, insanlar tarafindan onun icin kurulan bu korkunc tuzakta öldü.

english: And do you know what the moral of this story is?
translation: Bu hikayenin ahlaki dersi nedir biliyor musun?

english: Um... no, not really.
It's 'Never trust humans' of course! My dear old mammy told me that story when I was a pup, and I'm still alive and well to tell it to you today!
translation: Tabii ki “Insanlara asla güvenme”! Sevgili yasli annem bu hikayeyi bana yavruyken anlatmisti ve ben hala hayattayim ve bugün sana anlatabiliyorum!

english: Pretty good story huh?
Um... yeah. It was great. Really.
Nothing thanks.
...I don't know why you talked to me if you don't want anything then...
translation: ...Bir sey istemiyorsan neden benimle konustun ki...

english: Here you go!
Can I buy a beer?
Yes please.
Actually, no thanks.
Can I hear some gossip?
Tell me about this village.
Tell me about the land of Morytania.
Tell me about the shopkeepers here.
Sbott the Tanner.
Rufus the food seller.
Barker the clothes seller.
Fidelio the general store owner.
Tell me about the temple to the west.
Can I hear a story?
Nothing thanks.
Talk to the tree, make friends with it.
But I can't reach it...
You can do anything you want to do. This is your world.
translation: Ne istersen yapabilirsin. Burasi senin dünyan.

english: That tree looks lonely...
I'll give him a friend! Like I always say, everyone needs a friend!
translation: Ona bir arkadas verecegim! Her zaman dedigim gibi, herkesin bir arkadasa ihtiyaci vardir!

english: Will you be my friend?
Well of course! Right after I finish this painting.
translation: Tabii ki! Bu resmi bitirir bitirmez.

english: I don't make mistakes, just happy accidents.
translation: Ben hata yapmam, sadece mutlu kazalar olur.

english: How very positive!
So, still here then?
Do you want another game of Runedraw?
translation: Bir Runedraw oyunu daha oynamak ister misin?

english: No!
Sorry, my orders are that I can only give slime to those who have completed the Morytania medium, hard or elite diaries.
translation: Üzgünüm, emirlerim geregi sadece Morytania orta, zor veya elit günlüklerini tamamlayanlara slime verebilirim.

english: Can I have these bones converted into bonemeal with the promised amount of slime, please?
translation: Bu kemikleri söz verdigin miktarda slime ile kemik ununa dönüstürebilir misin lütfen?

english: You do not have enough space for both bonemeal and slime. Come back to me when you have space.
translation: Kemik unu ve slime icin yeterli alanin yok. Alanin oldugunda tekrar gel.

english: You do not have any bones for me to convert for you.
As THE Master Bowman, I am quite impressed by your equipment, but it's not the sort I'd recommend myself. Try more conventional forms of accuracy enhancement.
translation: Usta Okcu olarak, ekipmanindan oldukca etkilendim, ama ben olsam bunu tavsiye etmezdim. Daha geleneksel isabetlilik artirma yöntemlerini dene.

english: Here you go.
You are handed a torn part of a clue scroll.
translation: Yirtik bir ipucu parsömeni parcasi verilir.

english: As THE Master Bowman, I am most impressed by your equipment, peasant.
translation: Usta Okcu olarak, ekipmanindan cok etkilendim, köylü.

english: There's a diary master in Canifis, go and speak to her.
translation: Canifis'te bir günlük ustasi var, gidip onunla konusun.

english: Hello there! Is there anything I can help you with?
I'd like to buy something.
How's business going?
Its a little slow... There's a lot of soldiers around these parts, so many people just wear a uniform.
translation: Biraz durgun... Bu civarda cok fazla asker var, bu yüzden cogu insan üniforma giyiyor.

english: Although, I'm just happy to be here! Osten recently took me on as his assistant, you see. I've always wanted to work in fashion!
translation: Yine de, burada oldugum icin mutluyum! Osten beni asistani olarak ise aldi. Her zaman moda sektöründe calismak istemisimdir!

english: Anyway, enough about me... Was there something I could help you with? Perhaps a new cape? ...Or a nice new chef's hat?
translation: Neyse, benden bu kadar... Size yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi? Belki yeni bir pelerin? ...Ya da güzel bir sef sapkasi?

english: No thanks, I'm just browsing.
I'll be right here if you need anything!
I'd like to buy something.
How's business going?
No thanks, I'm just browsing.
So you're made entirely of rocks?
Not quite, my body is formed mostly of minerals.
translation: Tam olarak degil, vücudum cogunlukla minerallerden olusuyor.

english: Aren't minerals just rocks?
No, rocks are rocks, minerals are minerals. I am formed from minerals.
translation: Hayir, taslar tastir, mineraller mineraldir. Ben minerallerden olusuyorum.

english: But you're a Rock Golem...
Yes, I am. This conversation seems to be confusing you; perhaps you should stop.
translation: Evet, öyleyim. Bu konusma kafani karistiriyor gibi görünüyor; belki de durmalisin.

english: I feel strangely emotionless and empty. Maybe I should feel sad about it, but I can't.
translation: Garip bir sekilde duygusuz ve bos hissediyorum. Belki bunun icin üzülmeliyim, ama yapamiyorum.

english: You can't feel sad?
Correct. Now, if I only had a heart...
I'm not sure it works like that around here.
I have an idea for a song.
Oh?
Copper-copper-copper Cophelia - you come and go, you come and go...
translation: Bakir-bakir-bakir Cophelia - gelip gidiyorsun, gelip gidiyorsun...

english: Mmmhmm.
Truth is, I am Iron Golem.
translation: Gercek su ki, ben Demir Golem'im.

english: I can see that.
I'm blue, da-ba-dee da-ba-da.
Oh dear, I've gone all pale.
Are you okay?
It must be something I ate.
Did you ever hear the tragedy of Queen Efaritay the Fair?
translation: Güzel Kralice Efaritay'in trajedisini duydun mu hic?

english: No?
I thought not.
It's not a story the Myreque would tell you.
translation: Myreque'lerin sana anlatacagi bir hikaye degil.

english: So near and yet so far... if my atoms were arranged a little differently, I could be diamond.
translation: O kadar yakin ve o kadar uzak... Atomlarim biraz farkli düzenlenseydi, elmas olabilirdim.

english: Would you enjoy being a diamond?
I expect I would, until someone tried chipping bits off me with a chisel. I'm probably safer as coal.
translation: Sanirim giderdi, ta ki biri beni keskiyle parcalamaya calisana kadar. Kömür olarak daha güvendeyim galiba.

english: I am so in my element right now.
translation: Su anda kendimi cok rahat hissediyorum.

english: Sigh...
I'm totally showing the bling today.
That's nice for you.
A little. Though sometimes I just feel like I'm being used as a status symbol, and no-one appreciates me for me.
translation: Biraz. Ama bazen statü sembolü olarak kullaniliyormusum gibi hissediyorum ve kimse beni oldugum gibi takdir etmiyor.

english: Oh dear.
Don't worry. At least I look good.
translation: Merak etme. En azindan iyi görünüyorum.

english: No-one appreciates granite.
Why do you say that?
I know how it works. No-one actually wants granite. They just chop us up and throw our pieces on the floor.
translation: Nasil isledigini biliyorum. Kimse graniti gercekten istemiyor. Bizi parcalayip parcalarimizi yere atiyorlar.

english: Oh, I can see that must be upsetting for you.
translation: Oh, bunun senin icin üzücü oldugunu anlayabiliyorum.

english: When you've seen your relatives cut into pieces, with their severed limbs cast aside like junk, THEN you will understand how I feel.
translation: Akrabalarinin parcalara ayrildigini, kesik uzuvlarinin cöp gibi bir kenara atildigini gördügünde, o zaman nasil hissettigimi anlayacaksin.

english: I'll bear it in mind.
I feel sad today. Very blue.
No-one understands me.
Why not?
Because argle gargle gooble goop.
... I don't understand you either.
*sigh*
So how do you pronounce Lovakengj?
Silly human, it's pronounced Lova-Kane.
translation: Aptal insan, Lova-Kane olarak telaffuz ediliyor.

english: How did you not know that?
You know, it really isn't that obvious.
translation: Biliyorsun, bu o kadar da acik degil.

english: I may be green, but I'm not an environmentalist.
There's no need. Whatever you may have read, even coal is a renewable energy source - just wait a minute and the rocks respawn.
translation: Gerek yok. Ne okumus olursan ol, kömür bile yenilenebilir bir enerji kaynagidir - bir dakika bekle ve kayalar yeniden ortaya cikar.

english: You can burn as much as you like, too, without needing to worry about it affecting the climate - we don't have a lot of weather here.
translation: Iklimi etkileyeceginden endiselenmeden istedigin kadar yakabilirsin - burada hava durumu pek yok.

english: That's handy.
Yes, I pity anyone whose world doesn't work like this one. I don't know how they can possibly cope.
translation: Evet, dünyasi böyle olmayanlara aciyorum. Nasil basa cikabiliyorlar bilmiyorum.

english: I'm confused. It takes incredible skill to smith anything from my ore, yet the items you'd get are terribly mediocre.
translation: Kafam karisti. Benim cevherimden bir sey yapmak inanilmaz bir beceri gerektiriyor, ama elde ettiginiz esyalar cok siradan.

english: Is that something that worries you?
It just feels like my world doesn't make sense, sometimes. But I suppose it's always been like this, and I've got used to it.
translation: Bazen benim dünyamin mantikli gelmedigini hissediyorum. Ama sanirim her zaman böyleydi ve ben buna alistim.

english: Your world is amazing. I truly am in awe.
Did you just make an ore joke?
translation: Az önce cevher sakasi mi yaptin?

english: Maybe...
Well it was awful.
Ha! Now you're making them as well.
Are we really doing this? Amethyst isn't an ore anyway.
translation: Gercekten bunu mu yapiyoruz? Ametist zaten cevher degil ki.

english: I can dream, [player name]!
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
*Whistles*
You slip your hand into Rocky's pocket.
OY!! You're going to have to do better than that! Sheesh, what an amateur.
translation: OY!! Bundan daha iyisini yapmalisin! Hayret, ne amatörsün.

english: Is there much competition between you raccoons and the magpies?
translation: Siz rakunlar ve kargalar arasinda rekabet var mi?

english: Magpies have nothing on us! They're just interested in shinies.
translation: Kargalar bize rakip olamaz! Onlar sadece parlak seylerle ilgileniyorlar.

english: Us raccoons have a finer taste, we can see the value in anything, whether it shines or not.
translation: Biz rakunlar daha ince bir zevke sahibiz, parlak olsun olmasin her seyin degerini görebiliriz.

english: Hey Rocky, do you want to commit a bank robbery with me?
translation: Hey Rocky, benimle banka soygunu yapmak ister misin?

english: If that is the level you are at, I do not wish to participate in criminal acts with you [player name].
translation: Eger seviyen buysa, seninle suc islerine karismak istemiyorum Maceraci.

english: Well what are you interested in stealing?
The heart of a lovely raccoon called Rodney.
translation: Rodney adinda sevimli bir rakunun kalbini.

english: I cannot really help you there I'm afraid.
translation: Korkarim bu konuda sana yardimci olamam.

english: Hi Rocky, how are you?
Your shoe laces are untied!
Rocky jumps into your backpack...
The master thief strikes again! Here you go, have it back.
translation: Usta hirsiz yine is basinda! Al, geri veriyorum.

english: Rocky flicks the coin back into your backpack
translation: Rocky parayi sirt cantana geri atar.

english: I better keep my eyes on you...
translation: Sana göz kulak olsam iyi olur...

english: Get robbed mate.
Watch your pockets!
Watch out! Rocky coming at ya!
Hey Ziggy, do you have any relation to a raccoon named Rocky?
translation: Hey Ziggy, Rocky adinda bir rakunla bir iliskin var mi?

english: Who me? No, me and Rocky are not related.
translation: Ben mi? Hayir, Rocky ile bir iliskim yok.

english: Really? But you look so similar.
That's because a Tanuki is a master of disguise! I could pretend to be a human if I wanted to.
translation: Cünkü Tanuki kilik degistirme ustasidir! Istersem insan gibi davranabilirim.

english: Wow! Why don't you do it now then?
translation: Vay canina! O zaman neden simdi yapmiyorsun?

english: I said if I wanted to, I don't want to.
Hey Ziggy, *giggles* do you happen to know any good plumbers?
translation: Hey Ziggy, *kikirdar* iyi bir tesisatci taniyor musun?

english: Well that's a bit of a silly question isn't it.
translation: Bu biraz sacma bir soru degil mi?

english: What do you mean?
Why would I, a Tanuki, know any good plumbers?
translation: Ben bir Tanuki olarak neden iyi bir tesisatci taniyayim ki?

english: I don't know, you might have come across one before.
translation: Bilmiyorum, belki daha önce bir taneyle karsilasmissindir.

english: Well, clearly not, since I spend most of my time following you around.
translation: Tabii ki hayir, cünkü zamanimin cogunu seni takip ederek geciriyorum.

english: Ziggy! I've got a treat for you!
Really! Where! Let me have it!
translation: Gercekten mi! Nerede! Ver sunu bana!

english: You hold out your fist.
Why are you hiding it? Let me have it! Please, please, please!
translation: Neden sakliyorsun? Ver sunu bana! Lütfen, lütfen, lütfen!

english: You open your fist... there is no treat.
Oh, where did the treat go? Did you drop it?
translation: Oh, sürpriz nereye gitti? Düsürdün mü?

english: Yeah, I must have dropped it, sorry about that Ziggy.
Rrowl!
Hiss!
Ssss!
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
Have you ever seen a blue panda before?
Blue Panda? That's ridiculous, there's only one type of panda and it is a beautiful red.
translation: Mavi panda mi? Bu cok sacma, tek bir tür panda var ve o da güzel kirmizi renkte.

english: Hey Red, howsit going?
Hi! Want to see me do a really fast cartwheel?
translation: Merhaba! Cok hizli bir takla atmami görmek ister misin?

english: Uh, yeah, sure go ahead.
Nothing happens...
Want to see me do it again?
Huh? Nothing happened...
To your eyes...
Do you know a raccoon called Dufresne?
translation: Dufresne adinda bir rakun taniyor musun?

english: No, I don't believe I have.
Rrowl!
Hiss!
Ssss!
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
Hello there youngster.
Who are you calling youngster??
Why you. Unless you have seen the small village of Falador grow into a heaving city like I have of course!
translation: Sana tabii ki. Tabii ki Falador'un kücük bir köyden kalabalik bir sehre dönüsmesini benim gördügüm gibi görmediysen!

english: Err... no...
Well then! Enjoy your stay in our mountain home.
translation: Öyleyse! Dag evimizde iyi vakit gecir.

english: Hello again, youngster.
How's your son getting on, now that I've rescued him from the time bubble and the culinaromancer?
translation: Oglun nasil, onu zaman balonundan ve mutfak büyücüsünden kurtardigim icin?

english: My son's fine. I'm not so sure about you, though. Maybe you should lay down in a dark room until the babbling stops.
translation: Oglum iyi. Ama senin durumundan emin degilim. Belki de gevezelik etmeyi birakana kadar karanlik bir odada uzanmalisin.

english: You're already carrying one.
Aye, I've still got enough ingredients from before, but I'll want 100 coins.
translation: Evet, daha önceden kalan malzemelerim var ama 100 sikke istiyorum.

english: Maybe later.
I'm not doing it for less, even for a mate.
translation: Daha azina yapmam, dostum olsa bile.

english: About your son...
Can I have another rock cake?
translation: Bir tane daha kaya keki alabilir miyim?

english: Yes, but I want another one.
translation: Evet, ama ben de bir tane daha istiyorum.

english: Forget it.
Okay, 100 coins will be fine.
No thanks.
Come one, come all, buy my amazing choc ice invention here! Chocolate on the outside. Iced cream on the inside. Oh I also have some chocolate left over from making choc ices which I'm selling too.
translation: Gelin, gelin, benim muhtesem cikolatali dondurma icadimi satin alin! Disinda cikolata. Icinde dondurma. Oh, cikolatali dondurma yaparken artan cikolata da var, onu da satiyorum.

english: No thanks, I'm not interested.
How do you stop your icy snacks melting? The middle of the desert is the last place I'd expect to see ice.
translation: Buzlu atistirmaliklarin erimesini nasil önlüyorsun? Cölün ortasi, buz görmeyi bekleyecegim son yer.

english: It's quite a surprise, isn't it, my friend. I actually have this special magic box of ice, which I bought for a princely sum, from a strange man while adventuring in lands far away. He said it is imbued with some sort of
translation: Oldukca sasirtici, degil mi dostum? Aslinda, uzak diyarlarda macera yasarken garip bir adamdan yüksek bir fiyata satin aldigim özel bir sihirli buz kutum var. Adam, kutunun her zaman soguk kalmasini saglayan bir tür

english: powerful ice magic which keeps it cold all the time. I had never seen any ice magic before, it's clearly very rare and powerful, so I felt I had to buy it.
translation: güclü buz büyüsü ile donatildigini söyledi. Daha önce hic buz büyüsü görmemistim, acikca cok nadir ve güclü bir sey, bu yüzden satin almam gerektigini hissettim.

english: I am trying to find out the cause of this town's curse.
translation: Bu kasabanin lanetinin nedenini bulmaya calisiyorum.

english: I really have no idea. It's most regrettable. Fortunately my innovation with my choc ice invention is helping people stay at least slightly cool.
translation: Gercekten hicbir fikrim yok. Cok üzücü. Neyse ki cikolatali dondurma icadim sayesinde insanlar en azindan biraz serin kalabiliyorlar.

english: How's business, now that the curse has gone?
translation: Lanet ortadan kalktigina göre isler nasil gidiyor?

english: Ohh as good as ever. The people of Nardah seem to have taken well to the taste of chocolate and iced cream combined and, with the curse gone, all my friends are much happier too, so it's all good.
translation: Her zamanki gibi iyi. Nardah halki cikolata ve dondurmanin birlesiminden hoslanmis görünüyor ve lanet ortadan kalktigina göre tüm arkadaslarim da cok daha mutlu, yani her sey yolunda.

english: Cool I'd like to buy some.
translation: Harika, ben de biraz almak istiyorum.

english: No thanks, I'm not interested.
How do you stop your icy snacks melting?
I am trying to find out the cause of this town's curse.
translation: Bu kasabanin lanetinin nedenini bulmaya calisiyorum.

english: How's business, now that the curse has gone?
translation: Lanet ortadan kalktigina göre isler nasil gidiyor?

english: Oh, hello... do I know you?
Ehm... well... my name is [player name], if that rings any bell?
translation: Sey... benim adim Maceraci, hatirladin mi?

english: No, never heard of you.
Can you leave me alone please? I'm trying to study.
translation: Beni rahat birakir misin lütfen? Calismaya calisiyorum.

english: Hello there. What are you doing here?
I'm waiting here hoping that someone can guide me to the Paterdomus, the temple on the Salve.
translation: Biri beni Salve'deki Paterdomus tapinagina götürür diye burada bekliyorum.

english: Where is Paterdomus?
Oh, Paterdomus is that rather impressive looking temple on the Salve... I'm sure you must have passed it on your way into Morytania.
translation: Oh, Paterdomus Salve'deki oldukca etkileyici görünümlü tapinak... Morytania'ya giderken oradan gecmis olmalisin.

english: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
I'm hoping to get back to civilisation and see what the lands of Misthalin look like.
translation: Medeniyete geri dönüp Misthalin topraklarinin nasil bir yer oldugunu görmek istiyorum.

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Paterdomus?
translation: Paterdomus'a giderken yol üzerinde düsmanlarla karsilasirsak kendini savunabilir misin?

english: What sort of guide are you? I'm pretty healthy, but you'll have to protect me else I'll be sure to die... Oh, I do hope you can manage that.
translation: Ne tür bir rehbersin sen? Ben oldukca saglikliyim ama beni korumak zorundasin, yoksa kesinlikle ölecegim... Oh, umarim bunu basarabilirsin.

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: Hmmm, görünüse göre bir takipcin var. Kendi basina dolasirsa bu yolculukta kaybolabilir. Takipcin güvende oldugunda yola cikalim.

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: Gercekten mi? Bu harika olur! Hedefe vardigimizda sana kücük bir ödül verecegim.

english: Temple Trekking begins
Ok, which route should we take?
Ok, thanks.
Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: Ah, bana biraz erzak vermek istiyorsun, ha? Sirt cantami acayim.

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than staying in Burgh de Rott.
translation: Oh, bu yolculuktan nefret ediyorum, ama Burgh de Rott'ta kalmaktan iyidir.

english: It's scary here...let's get going!
When are we going to get to Paterdomus?
We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on.
translation: Bütün gün burada durup sohbet edemeyiz, hadi devam edelim.

english: Do you visit Paterdomus often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: Paterdomus'a sik sik gider misin? Rotayi iyi biliyorsun gibi görünüyor.

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...?
Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Burgh de Rott. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: Hay aksi! Görünüse göre Burgh de Rott'a geri dönmek zorundayiz. O köprüyü gecemeyiz!

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
Player completes the bridge event
Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Burgh de Rott.
translation: Bu is bitti... Görünüse göre bu batakligi gecemeyiz. Burgh de Rott'a geri dönmek zorundayiz.

english: Player completes the bog event
Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: Hey... bu harika... harika bir is cikardin... Seni takip edecegim.

english: Whahay...that was great!
But we really should be heading off now.
Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
Player completes the river event
That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: Bu inanilmaz! Ben de aynisini yapmaliyim.

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: Whahay! Harikaydi! Ama artik gercekten yola cikmaliyiz.

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
This is scary!
Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
Ahhh, two tentacles!
...three tentacles!
I think I'm going to faint!
Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: Vay canina! Su canavara bak! O seyi kendi basina halletmen gerekecek!

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the temple. Here's your reward.
translation: Beni tapinaga güvenle ulastirdigin icin cok tesekkürler. Iste ödülün.

english: Rolayne Twickit gives you a reward token!
translation: Rolayne Twickit sana bir ödül jetonu veriyor!

english: Where is Paterdomus?
Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
I can take you to Paterdomus.
Ok, thanks.
I heard Juliet had died. Terrible business.
translation: Juliet'in öldügünü duydum. Cok kötü bir olay.

english: Her cousin and I are getting on well though. Thanks for your help.
translation: Ama kuzeni ve ben iyi anlasiyoruz. Yardimin icin tesekkürler.

english: Why are you waving that around at me as if it's something important?
translation: Neden bana sanki önemli bir seymis gibi onu salliyorsun?

english: Romeo approaches you...
Blub! Blub...where is my Juliet? Have you seen her?
translation: Blub! Blub... Juliet'im nerede? Onu gördün mü?

english: Looking for a blonde girl, goes by the name of Juliet..quite pretty...haven't seen her have you?
translation: Juliet adinda sarisin bir kiz ariyorum... oldukca güzel... onu görmedin, degil mi?

english: Juliet, Juliet, wherefore art thou Juliet? Have you seen my Juliet?
translation: Juliet, Juliet, neredesin Juliet? Juliet'imi gördün mü?

english: Oh woe is me that I cannot find my Juliet! You haven't seen Juliet have you?
translation: Juliet'imi bulamadigim icin ne kadar da üzgünüm! Juliet'i görmedin, degil mi?

english: Sadness surrounds me now that Juliet's father forbids us to meet. Have you seen my Juliet?
translation: Juliet'in babasi bizim görüsmemizi yasakladigi icin simdi üzüntü icindeyim. Juliet'imi gördün mü?

english: What is to become of me and my darling Juliet, I cannot find her anywhere, have you seen her?
translation: Ben ve sevgili Juliet'imin akibeti ne olacak, onu hicbir yerde bulamiyorum, gördün mü?

english: Yes, I have seen her actually!
At least, I think it was her... Blonde? A bit stressed?
translation: En azindan, onun oldugunu saniyorum... Sarisin mi? Biraz stresli mi?

english: Golly...yes, yes...you make her sound very interesting!
translation: Vay canina... evet, evet... onu cok ilginc birine benzetiyorsun!

english: And I'll bet she's a bit of a fox!
translation: Ve eminim ki biraz da seksi biridir!

english: Well, I guess she could be considered attractive...
I'll bet she is! Wooooooooo!
Sorry, all that jubilation has made me forget what we were talking about.
translation: Üzgünüm, tüm bu sevinc, ne hakkinda konustugumuzu unutturdu.

english: You were asking me about Juliet? You seemed to know her?
translation: Bana Juliet'i mi soruyordun? Onu taniyor gibiydin?

english: Oh yes, Juliet!
The fox...could you tell her that she is the love of my long and that I life to be with her?
translation: Seksi olan... ona, benim hayatimin aski oldugunu ve onunla birlikte olmak icin yasadigimi söyleyebilir misin?

english: What? Surely you mean that she is the love of your life and that you long to be with her?
translation: Ne? Elbette, onun hayatinin aski oldugunu ve onunla birlikte olmak istedigini demek istedin herhalde?

english: Oh yeah...what you said...tell her that, it sounds much better! Oh you're so good at this!
translation: Oh evet... senin dedigin gibi... ona öyle söyle, kulaga cok daha iyi geliyor! Oh, bu iste cok iyisin!

english: Yes, ok, I'll let her know.
Oh great! And tell her that I want to kiss her a give.
translation: Oh harika! Ve ona onu öpmek istedigimi söyle.

english: You mean you want to give her a kiss!
translation: Ona bir öpücük vermek istedigini mi demek istiyorsun!

english: Oh you're good...you are good!
I see I've picked a true professional...!
translation: Görüyorum ki gercek bir profesyonel secmisim...!

english: Where can I find Juliet?
Why do you ask?
So that I can try and find her for you!
translation: Senin icin onu bulmaya calisayim diye!

english: Ah yes....quite right. Hmmm, let me think now.
translation: Ah evet... cok haklisin. Hmmm, bir düsüneyim.

english: She may still be locked away at her Father's house on the sest vide of Warrock.
translation: Hala Warrock'un sest vide bölgesindeki babasinin evinde kilitli olabilir.

english: Oh, I remember how she loved it when I would sing up to her balcony! She would reward me with her own personal items...
translation: Oh, balkonuna sarki söyledigimde ne kadar sevindigini hatirliyorum! Bana kendi kisisel esyalarini ödül olarak verirdi...

english: What, she just gave you her stuff?
Well, not exactly give...more like 'throw with considerable force'...she's always a kidder that Juliet!
translation: Sey, tam olarak vermek degil... daha cok ‘büyük bir gücle firlatmak’ gibi... Juliet her zaman sakaci biridir!

english: Is there anything else you can tell me about Juliet?
translation: Juliet hakkinda bana söyleyebilecegin baska bir sey var mi?

english: Oh, there is so much to tell...she is my true love, we intend to spend together forever...I can tell you so much about her..
translation: Oh, anlatacak cok sey var... o benim gercek askim, sonsuza kadar birlikte olmayi planliyoruz... sana onun hakkinda cok sey anlatabilirim...

english: Great!
Ermmm.....
So much can I tell you...
Yes..
So much to tell...why, where do I start!
translation: Anlatacak cok sey var... neden, nereden baslasam!

english: Yes..yes! Please go on...don't let me interrupt...
translation: Evet..evet! Lütfen devam et... seni bölmeyeyim...

english: You can't remember can you?
Not a thing sorry....
Ok, thanks.
Sorry Romeo, I've got better things to do right now but maybe later?
translation: Üzgünüm Romeo, su anda daha önemli islerim var ama belki sonra?

english: Oh, ok, well, I guess my Juliet and I can spend some time apart. And as the old saying goes, 'Absinthe makes the heart glow longer'.
translation: Oh, tamam, sanirim Juliet'imle biraz ayri kalabiliriz. Ve eski bir deyisin dedigi gibi, “Absinthe kalbi daha uzun süre parlatir”.

english: Don't you mean that, 'Absence makes the...
Actually forget it...
Ok!
No sorry, I haven't seen her.
Oh...well, that's a shame...I was rather hoping you had.
translation: Oh... peki, bu cok yazik... Görmüs olmani umuyordum.

english: Why? Is she a fugitive? Does she owe you some money or something?
translation: Neden? O bir kacak mi? Sana borcu mu var yoksa?

english: Hmmm, she might do? Perhaps she does? How do you know?
translation: Hmmm, olabilir mi? Belki de vardir? Nereden biliyorsun?

english: I don't know? I was asking 'YOU' how 'YOU' know Juliet!
translation: Bilmiyorum? Sana Juliet'i nasil tanidigini soruyordum!

english: Ahh, yes Juliet, she's my one true love. Well, one of my one true loves! If you see her, could you tell her that she is the love of my long and that I life to be with her?
translation: Ahh, evet Juliet, o benim tek gercek askim. Sey, tek gercek asklarimdan biri! Onu görürsen, ona benim hayatimin aski oldugunu ve onunla birlikte olmak icin yasadigimi söyler misin?

english: What? Surely you mean that 'she is the love of your life and that you long to be with her?'
translation: Ne? Elbette “o senin hayatinin aski ve onunla birlikte olmak icin can attigini” demek istedin herhalde?

english: Perhaps I can help find her for you? What does she look like?
translation: Belki onu bulmana yardim edebilirim? Neye benziyor?

english: Oh would you? That would be great! She has this sort of hair...
translation: Gercekten mi? Bu harika olur! Saclari söyle...

english: Hair...check..
...and she these...great lips...
Lips...right.
Oh and she has these lovely shoulders as well..
translation: Oh, bir de cok güzel omuzlari var...

english: Shoulders...right, so she has hair, lips and shoulders...that should cut it down a bit.
translation: Omuzlar... tamam, yani saclari, dudaklari ve omuzlari var... bu biraz isimizi kolaylastirir.

english: Oh yes, Juliet is very different...please tell her that she is the love of my long and that I life to be with her?
translation: Oh evet, Juliet cok farkli... lütfen ona, onun benim uzun zamandir askim oldugunu ve onunla birlikte olmak icin yasadigimi söyle?

english: Hello again, remember me?
Of course, yes....how are.. you....ermmm...
You haven't got a clue who I am do you?
Not a clue my friend, but you seem to have a friendly face...a little blood stained, and perhaps in need of a wash, but friendly none the less.
translation: Hicbir fikrim yok dostum, ama yüzün dostca görünüyor... biraz kan lekeli ve belki yikanmaya ihtiyaci var, ama yine de dostca.

english: You asked me to look for Juliet for you!
Ah yes, Juliet...my sweet darling...what news?
translation: Ah evet, Juliet... benim tatli sevgilim... ne haber?

english: Nothing so far, but I need to ask a few questions?
translation: Su ana kadar bir sey yok, ama birkac soru sormam gerekiyor.

english: Romeo...great news...I've been in touch with Juliet!
translation: Romeo... harika haberler var... Juliet'le görüstüm!

english: Oh great! That is great news! Well done...well done... what a total success!
translation: Oh harika! Bu harika bir haber! Aferin... aferin... ne büyük bir basari!

english: Yes, and she gave me a message to give you...
translation: Evet, sana iletmem icin bir mesaj verdi...

english: Ohhh great! A message....wow!
translation: Ohhh harika! Bir mesaj... vay canina!

english: Yes!
A message...oh, I can't wait to read what my dear Juliet has to say....
translation: Bir mesaj... Ah, sevgili Juliet'in ne yazdigini okumak icin sabirsizlaniyorum...

english: I know...it's exciting isn't it...?
Yes...yes...
You've lost the message haven't you?
Yep, haven't got a clue where it is.
Romeo...great news...I've been in touch with Juliet! She's written a message for you...
translation: Romeo... harika haberlerim var... Juliet ile görüstüm! Sana bir mesaj yazmis...

english: Oh, a message! A message! I've never had a message before...
translation: Oh, bir mesaj! Bir mesaj! Daha önce hic mesaj almamistim...

english: Really?
No, no, not one!
Oh, well, except for the occasional court summons.
translation: Oh, sey, ara sira gelen mahkeme celpleri haric.

english: But they're not really 'nice' messages. Not like this one! I'm sure that this message will be lovely.
translation: Ama onlar pek de ‘hos’ mesajlar sayilmaz. Bu mesaj gibi degil! Eminim bu mesaj cok hos olacaktir.

english: Well are you going to open it or not?
Oh yes, yes, of course! 'Dearest Romeo, I am very pleased that you sent [player name] to look for me and to tell me that you still hold affliction...', Affliction! She thinks I'm diseased?
translation: Oh evet, evet, tabii ki! ‘Sevgili Romeo, Maceraci'ni beni aramaya ve hala bana karsi aci duydugunu söylemeye gönderdigin icin cok memnunum...’, Aci! Beni hasta mi saniyor?

english: 'Affection?'
Ahh yes...'still hold affection for me. I still feel great affection for you, but unfortunately my Father opposes our marriage.'
translation: Ahh evet... 'Hala bana karsi sevgi besliyorsun. Ben de sana karsi hala büyük bir sevgi besliyorum, ama ne yazik ki babam evliligimize karsi cikiyor.'

english: Oh dear...that doesn't sound too good.
translation: Oh hayir... bu pek iyiye isaret degil.

english: What? '...great affection for you. Father opposes our..
translation: Ne? '...sana karsi büyük bir sevgi duyuyor. Babam bizim...

english: '...marriage and will...
...will kill you if he sees you again!'
I have to be honest, it's not getting any better...
translation: Dürüst olmak gerekirse, durum hic de iyiye gitmiyor...

english: 'Our only hope is that Father Lawrence, our long time confidant, can help us in some way.'
translation: “Tek umudumuz, uzun zamandir sirdasimiz olan Peder Lawrence'in bize bir sekilde yardim edebilmesi.”

english: Well, that's it then...we haven't got a chance...
translation: Öyleyse, bu kadar... Hic sansimiz yok...

english: What about Father Lawrence?
...our love is over...the great romance, the life of my love...
...or you could speak to Father Lawrence!
Oh, my aching, breaking, heart...how useless the situation is now...we have no one to turn to...
translation: Ah, acili, kirik kalbim... durum ne kadar da umutsuz... siginacak kimsemiz yok...

english: FATHER LAWRENCE!
Father Lawrence?

Oh yes, Father Lawrence...he's our long time confidant, he might have a solution! Yes, yes, you have to go and talk to Lather Fawrence for us and ask him if he's got any suggestions for our predicament?
translation: Evet, Peder Lawrence... O bizim uzun zamandir güvendigimiz biridir, bir cözümü olabilir! Evet, evet, bizim icin Peder Lawrence ile konusup, bizim durumumuz icin herhangi bir önerisi olup olmadigini sormalisin.

english: Where can I find Father Lawrence?
Lather Fawrence! Oh he's...
You know he's not my 'real' Father don't you?
translation: Onun benim “gercek” babam olmadigini biliyorsun, degil mi?

english: I think I suspected that he wasn't.
Well anyway...he tells these song, loring bermons...and keeps these here Carrockian vitizens snoring in his church to the East North.
translation: Neyse... O sarkilar söyler, loring bermons... ve buradaki Carrockian vatandaslarini kuzeydogudaki kilisesinde uyutur.

english: How are you?
Not so good my friend...I miss Judi..., Junie..., Joopie...
translation: Pek iyi degilim dostum... Judi'yi özlüyorum..., Junie'yi..., Joopie'yi...

english: Juliet?
Juliet! I miss Juliet, terribly!
Hmmm, so I see!
Have you heard anything from Juliet?
Sadly not my friend! And what's worse, her Father has threatened to kill me if he sees me. I mean, that seems a bit harsh!
translation: Maalesef hayir dostum! Daha da kötüsü, babasi beni görürse öldürecegini söyledi. Bence bu biraz sert!

english: Well, I shouldn't worry too much...you can always run away if you see him...
I just wish I could remember what he looks like! I live in fear of every man I see!
translation: Keske onun neye benzedigini hatirlayabilsem! Gördügüm her erkekten korkuyorum!

english: Hey again Romeo!
Hello again Romeo!
Ooh did you manage to survive one of Lather Fawrences sermons? I bet not, you were ages! I bet you snoozed on the welcome mat just as soon as you heard his voice!
translation: Lather Fawrences'in vaazlarindan birini atlatabildin mi? Eminim atlatamadin, cok uzun sürdü! Eminim onun sesini duyar duymaz hos geldin paspasinda uyuyakaldin!

english: Did not!
Oh, come on, come on, what did he say?
He wants me to go to the Apothecary!
The Apothecary?
Yeah, I think so...but the word potion-ey doesn't exist.
Well, you just used it...so I guess it does exist!
translation: Az önce kullandin... yani var galiba!

english: It doesn't matter...do you know where the Apothecary is?
translation: Önemli degil... Eczaci nerede biliyor musun?

english: Why should I tell you?
Because I'm doing you a favour!
Right, yes...of course! Well, I think the potion-ey place is Wouth Sest of here and near a sword shop.
