translation: Dogru, evet... tabii ki! Sanirim iksirci dükkani buradan güneyde, kilic dükkaninin yakininda.

english: He seems very keen for you to marry Juliet.
translation: Juliet ile evlenmeni cok istiyor gibi görünüyor.

english: Me too! I can't wait! Do you think it will be soon?
translation: Ben de! Sabirsizlaniyorum! Sence yakinda olur mu?

english: I don't know, but I'll do what I can. It just seems a bit odd that Father Lawrence is so keen for you to marry?
translation: Bilmiyorum, ama elimden geleni yapacagim. Peder Lawrence'in evlenmeni bu kadar istemesi biraz garip degil mi?

english: I can't imagine why he's so keen? Though, he was our messenger before you. Of course, he had a lot more hair back then...and I think we may have gone to school together...
translation: Neden bu kadar istekli oldugunu anlayamiyorum. Gerci, senden önce bizim haberciydi. Tabii o zamanlar saclari cok daha fazlaydi... ve sanirim birlikte okula gitmistik...

english: What, since you were kids?
Yeah! Thinking about it now, we called him 'Diddy Dorrence' back then!
translation: Evet! Simdi düsününce, ona o zamanlar “Diddy Dorrence” derdik!

english: So, maybe, he just wants a bit of peace? And when you two are married, he won't have to traipse around delivering your messages anymore?
translation: Belki de sadece biraz huzur istiyor? Ve siz ikiniz evlendiginizde, artik sizin mesajlarinizi iletmek icin ortalikta dolasmak zorunda kalmayacak?

english: Yes, the years haven't been good to him.
translation: Evet, yillar ona pek iyi davranmadi.

english: Hi Romeo!
Oh hello, have you seen Lather Fawrence?
Yes, he's given me details of a potion which should help resolve this situation. The Apothecary is helping me prepare it.
translation: Evet, bu durumu cözmeye yardimci olacak bir iksirin ayrintilarini bana verdi. Eczaci onu hazirlamama yardim ediyor.

english: Ooooh, it all sounds horribly complicated?
All I can say is I'll be glad when Juliet's finally in that crypt!
translation: Tek söyleyebilecegim, Juliet sonunda o mezara girdiginde cok mutlu olacagim!

english: Spoken like a true lover!
Ooohh, that's the potion is it? Rather you than me!
translation: Ooohh, bu iksir mi? Benim yerime sen icsen iyi olur!

english: I'm not drinking it! It's for Juliet!
Well, I mean...it's probably delicious...and not dangerous at all. And you quite often see harmless drinks in a glowing sort of pink colour.
translation: Yani, muhtemelen lezzetlidir... ve hic tehlikeli degildir. Ve parlak pembe renkli zararsiz icecekleri sik sik görürsün.

english: Hmm, I'm not convinced...maybe you ought to try some before I give it to Juliet?
translation: Hmm, ikna olmadim... belki Juliet'e vermeden önce sen denemelisin?

english: Urgh! No way! Not in a million years!
Ok...but you know what to do when I've given this to Juliet?
translation: Tamam... ama bunu Juliet'e verdigimde ne yapacagini biliyorsun, degil mi?

english: Oh, yeah...sure Lather Fawrence explained all that to me...
translation: Oh, evet... tabii, Lather Fawrence bana her seyi anlatti...

english: Romeo, it's all set. Juliet has drunk the potion and has been taken down into the Crypt...now you just need to pop along and collect her.
translation: Romeo, her sey hazir. Juliet iksiri icti ve mezara indirildi... simdi sen gidip onu alman gerekiyor.

english: Ah right, the potion! Great...
What potion would that be then?
The Cadava potion...you know, the one which will make her appear dead! She's in the crypt, pop along and claim your true love.
translation: Cadava iksiri... bilirsin, onu ölü gibi gösterecek olan! O mezarda, gidip gercek askini al.

english: But I'm scared...will you come with me?
A cutscene starts
Oh , ok...come on! I think I saw the entrance when I visited there last...
translation: Oh, tamam... hadi! En son oraya gittigimde girisi görmüstüm sanirim...

english: This is pretty scary...
Oh , be quiet...
We're here. Look, Juliet is over there!
You go over to her...and I'll go and wait over here...
translation: Sen ona git... ben de burada bekleyecegim...

english: Ohhh, ok then...
Hey...Juliet...
Juliet....?
Oh dear...you seem to be dead.
Hi Romeo...I'm Phillipa!
Wow! You're a fox!
It's a shame about Juliet...but perhaps we can meet up later?
translation: Juliet icin cok üzücü... ama belki daha sonra bulusabiliriz?

english: Who's Juliet?
A cutscene ends
Yes, I have seen her actually!
Yes, ok, I'll let her know.
Where can I find Juliet?
Is there anything else you can tell me about Juliet?
translation: Juliet hakkinda bana söyleyebilecegin baska bir sey var mi?

english: Ok, thanks.
Sorry Romeo, I've got better things to do right now but maybe later?
translation: Üzgünüm Romeo, su anda daha önemli islerim var ama belki daha sonra?

english: No sorry, I haven't seen her.
Perhaps I could help to find her for you?
How are you?
Where can I find Father Lawrence?
Have you heard anything from Juliet?
He wants me to go to the Apothecary!
He seems keen for you to marry Juliet.
translation: Juliet ile evlenmeni cok istiyor gibi görünüyor.

english: Hello.
Hello traveller. Have a look at my latest range of gnome fashion. Rometti is the ultimate label in gnome high society.
translation: Merhaba gezgin. En son gnome moda koleksiyonuma bir göz at. Rometti, gnome yüksek sosyetesinin en prestijli markasidir.

english: Really.
Pastels are all the rage this season.
translation: Pastel renkler bu sezon cok moda.

english: I've no time for fashion.
Hmm... I did wonder.
OK then, let's have a look.
Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you!   You need a [gnome food/drink]!
translation: Müsterini bulmus olsan da, dogru yiyecegi getirmis görünmüyorsun!   [Cüce yiyecegi/icecegi] lazim!

english: You hand over your delivery of a [gnome food/drink] to Rometti
Ooh, Thank you darling.
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number]] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
I've no time for fashion.
OK then, let's have a look.
Hello and welcome to my pie shop, how can I help you?
translation: Merhaba ve pasta dükkanima hos geldiniz, nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: Do you need any help?
Actually I could, you see I'm running out of stock and I don't have time to bake any more pies. Would you be willing to bake me some pies? I'll pay you well for them.
translation: Aslinda var, stoklarim bitiyor ve daha fazla pasta pisirecek vaktim yok. Bana pasta pisirir misiniz? Size iyi para öderim.

english: Sure, what do you need?
Great, can you bake me [amount] [pie type] Pies please.
Sorry, I can't help you.
I've got those pies you wanted.
Doesn't look like you have any of the [amount] [pie type] Pies I requested.
Thank you, if you could bring me the other [amount] that'd be great!
Thank you very much!
I'm good thanks.
I'd like to buy some pies.
Do you need any help?
Sure, what do you need?
Sorry, I can't help you.
I've got those pies you wanted.
I'm good thanks.
Would you like to buy some crafting equipment?
translation: Biraz zanaat ekipmani satin almak ister misiniz?

english: No thanks; I've got all the Crafting equipment I need.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler; ihtiyacim olan tüm zanaat ekipmanlari bende var.

english: Okay. Fare well on your travels.
No thanks, I've got all the Crafting equipment I need.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, ihtiyacim olan tüm zanaat ekipmanlari bende var.

english: Let's see what you've got, then.
translation: O zaman neyin var bir bakalim.

english: Hey, human.
Who are you?
I am Root.
Is that all you have to say about yourself?
translation: Kendin hakkinda söyleyeceklerin bu kadar mi?

english: Oh well, I suppose that's enough for some people.
translation: Eh, sanirim bazilari icin bu kadari yeterlidir.

english: Tell me about this place.
This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: Burasi Weiss. Yillar önce, güneydeki magaralardan kovulduktan sonra troller insa etti. Simdi Weiss bizim evimiz.

english: We done pretty good here. Got lots of goat and wolf to eat - they taste kinda boring after all this time, but there not much other choice.
translation: Burada oldukca iyi durumdayiz. Yemek icin bolca keci ve kurt var - bunca zamandan sonra tadi biraz sikici geliyor ama baska secenegimiz yok.

english: Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it. In fact My Arm is an expert on growing the stuff.
translation: Hic gut otu denedin mi? Onu seven troller taniyorum. Aslinda My Arm bu bitkinin yetistirilmesinde uzmandir.

english: Never heard of no gouty weed, no. But it sound like a vegetable, an' Mother not like eating those, so we probably not gonna try it.
translation: Gut otu diye bir sey duymadim. Ama sebzeye benziyor ve annem sebze yemeyi sevmez, o yüzden muhtemelen denemeyecegiz.

english: Mother not like new ideas much, but he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: Annem yeni fikirleri pek sevmez, ama o cok büyük ve patron, bu yüzden ne derse onu yapariz.

english: I see.
Do you like it here?
Eh, it kinda rough, but it our home. Odd Mushroom say he can make it nicer with fancy fires what he invented, but Mother not interested in that, so Odd Mushroom not allowed to do it.
translation: Eh, biraz zorlu, ama burasi bizim evimiz. Odd Mushroom, icat ettigi süslü ateslerle burayi daha güzel hale getirebilecegini söylüyor, ama annem bununla ilgilenmiyor, bu yüzden Odd Mushroom bunu yapamiyor.

english: Mother only care about stuff to help him fight better. An he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: Annem sadece onun daha iyi savasmasina yardimci olacak seylerle ilgileniyor. O cok büyük ve patron, bu yüzden ne derse onu yapiyoruz.

english: I'll be off.
Hey, friend of Snowflake!
It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: Burasi harika, simdi Snowflake ve kocasi troll bize goutweed yetistirmeyi ögretti. Yemekler artik cok daha lezzetli.

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: Eh, biraz zorlu ama gittikce daha iyi oluyor. Snowflake bize gut otu yetistirmeyi ögretti. Keci, kurt, insan, hepsi gut otu ile cok daha lezzetli oluyor.

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: Evet, Weiss yasamak icin iyi bir yer, simdi Snowflake sorumlu. Tüm troller Snowflake'i sever. Kocasi biraz tuhaf bir trol, ama bu bizim sorunumuz degil.

english: Who are you?
Tell me about this place.
Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it.
translation: Gut otu denedin mi hic? Onu seven troller taniyorum.

english: I see.
Do you like it here?
I'll be off.
Mooom!
Rawr
I'm hungry!
: Hello, how's it going?
: No, I don't want to buy anything!
Hello, how's it going?
I'm busy right now.
I'm fine, how are you?
: Very well thank you.
Not too bad thanks.
: I'm very well thank you.
:  Who are you?
: I'm a bold adventurer.
: I suppose someone has to do it.
: I'm  a little worried I've heard there's lots of people going about, killing citizens at random.
translation: : Biraz endiseliyim, etrafta dolasip rastgele vatandaslari öldüren bircok insan oldugunu duydum.

english: : Get out of my way, I'm in a hurry!
: That is classified information.
: Do you require any assistance?
: No, I have nothing I wish to get rid of. If you want to do some trading, there are plenty of shops and market stalls around though.
translation: : Hayir, atmak istedigim bir sey yok. Ticaret yapmak istersen, etrafta bircok dükkan ve pazar tezgahi var.

english: : I'm sorry I cant help you there.
: I've heard there are many fearsome creatures that dwell under the ground...
translation: : Yeraltinda bircok korkunc yaratik yasadigini duydum...

english: Hey, I'm your contractor from Mahogany Homes, what did you want done?
translation: Merhaba, ben Mahogany Homes'tan müteahhitinizim, ne yaptirmak istiyorsunuz?

english: I'd like my range fixed.
I'd like two Wooden drawers built.
translation: Iki adet ahsap cekmece yaptirmak istiyorum.

english: I'd like a Wooden bed built.
I'd like my hat stand fixed.
I'd like my mirror fixed.
I'd like two Oak drawers built.
translation: Iki adet mese cekmece yaptirmak istiyorum.

english: I'd like a Oak bed built.
I'd like two Teak drawers built.
translation: Iki adet tik cekmece yapilmasini istiyorum.

english: I'd like a Teak bed built.
translation: Bir adet tik yatak yapilmasini istiyorum.

english: I'd like two Mahogany drawers built.
translation: Iki adet maun cekmece yapilmasini istiyorum.

english: I'd like a Mahogany bed built.
translation: Bir adet maun yatak yapilmasini istiyorum.

english: I've finished with the work you wanted.
Thank you so much! Would you like a cup of tea before you go?
translation: Cok tesekkür ederim! Gitmeden önce bir fincan cay ister misiniz?

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks, I better be off.
Aaah, nothing like a nice cupppa tea!
translation: Aaah, güzel bir fincan cay gibisi yok!

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks.
Daddy I'm tired.
I know son, it was a long journey. I just need to work out where we're going.
translation: Biliyorum oglum, uzun bir yolculuktu. Sadece nereye gidecegimizi belirlemem gerekiyor.

english: Get OUT of my WAY!
Hold on a second there, I need your help!
translation: Bir saniye bekle, yardimina ihtiyacim var!

english: Help, from me? You musht be more drunk than I am.
translation: Benden yardim mi? Benden daha sarhos olmalisin.

english: No, I try not to get drunk, it's not good for you. But I do need help in brewing some beer.
translation: Hayir, sarhos olmamaya calisiyorum, sagliga iyi gelmiyor. Ama bira yapmak icin yardima ihtiyacim var.

english: Mmmm, beer.
I need to brew Kelda stout, but I haven't got enough seeds to grow the hops.
translation: Kelda stout bira yapmak istiyorum ama serbetciotu yetistirmek icin yeterli tohumum yok.

english: Mmmm, Kelda stout.
Do you know where I can find any seeds?
translation: Tohum bulabilecegim bir yer biliyor musun?

english: I might... oh yesh, I jusht might have a sheed like that.
translation: Belki... evet, öyle bir tohumum olabilir.

english: But you're not going to just give it to me, are you?
translation: Ama bana öylece vermeyeceksin, degil mi?

english: No.
Alright then, what do you want for it?
translation: Peki o zaman, karsiliginda ne istiyorsun?

english: Lemme think... oh yesh. Get me... [a random item].
What?? Where am I going to get that!
You can at least make the effort.
Sure, let me just get that from the bank!
Do you have any Kelda seeds?
Where's my ehm... What wash it again? Oh yesh... [a random item].
I'm still looking for that.
Look a little harder!
I really don't know where to look for that.
You humans are jusht sho thick. Alright, shtop looking for it then, get me shomething else...
translation: Siz insanlar cok kalin kafalisiniz. Tamam, aramayi birak o zaman, bana baska bir sey getir...

english: Look, I've got it here!
Shplendid! Give that to me please!
Now how about those seeds?
Well, I've got a Kelda hop seed right here! Pashed down generation after generation in my family...
translation: Sey, burada bir Kelda hop tohumu var! Ailemde nesilden nesile aktarilan...

english: Wow, really?
Nah, I'm just kidding! Here, have the seed, you won't catch me farming in shome dirt patch anyway!
translation: Hayir, sadece saka yapiyorum! Al, tohum senin olsun, zaten beni bir toprak parcasinda ciftcilik yaparken yakalayamazsin!

english: I suppose you wouldn't ever have a proper job or do some decent hard work, no.
translation: Sanirim sen asla düzgün bir is bulamayacak ya da düzgün bir is yapamayacaksin, hayir.

english: What wash that?
Nothing...
I'm still looking for that.
I really don't know where to look.
Good day sir. Could I interest you in one of our finest Bloody Bracers? It's a local speciality.
translation: Iyi günler efendim. En iyi Bloody Bracers ürünlerimizden birine ilgi duyar misiniz? Bu, yerel bir spesiyalitedir.

english: One Bloody Bracer please.
That will be 99 coins.
I don't have that much.
Then for now, our business is at an end.
Here you go.
You buy a Bloody Bracer.
Enjoy.
Thanks.
I'm not paying that!
What happened to Carl?
Carl?
The old barkeep.
Oh yes, Carl!
He had to leave I'm afraid. Fear not though. I have taken over things here.
translation: Korkarim ayrilmak zorunda kaldi. Ama merak etmeyin. Buradaki isleri ben devraldim.

english: And you are?
Roy is the name. Now, could I interest you in one of our finest Bloody Bracers?
translation: Adim Roy. Simdi, en iyi Kanli Bilekliklerimizden birine ilgi duyar misiniz?

english: I'm not thirsty.
One Bloody Bracer please.
Here you go.
I'm not paying that!
What happened to Carl?
I'm not thirsty.
Hi, I'm Roy jr!
Is that Roy over there then?
Nope, that's Red, we're on an adventure!
translation: Hayir, o Red, biz maceraya ciktik!

english: Oh really? Where are you heading?
To the west, to explore the Kebos Lowlands.
I've heard it's dangerous over there...
Well, my dad has gone that way, he's a knight!
translation: Babam da o tarafa gitti, o bir sövalye!

english: I hope you find him, young one. I best be off.
translation: Umarim onu bulursun, genc adam. Ben gitmeliyim.

english: Something's different.
Nope, seems pretty much the same to me.
Hmm...
My favourite colour is green!
Great! How uncreative!
It's the colour of my little duck friend.
Indeed it is.
Come on... Something here has to work...
translation: Hadi... Burada bir seyler ise yaramali...

english: Care for any assistance?
Absolutely! I can't seem to find a way into that crevice to continue my scientific endeavour. I don't suppose you could have a dig around?
translation: Tabii ki! Bilimsel calismalarimi sürdürmek icin o yariga giremiyorum. Biraz kazabilir misin?

english: A scientific dig... Where have I heard of that before?
translation: Bilimsel bir kazi... Bunu daha önce nerede duymustum?

english: Don't dwell on it too long. There are things I must learn about our world!
translation: Fazla üzerinde durma. Dünyamiz hakkinda ögrenmem gereken seyler var!

english: I found a ruby in the ground.
Wondrous! A good sign to be sure! You may keep it, while I will keep the knowledge of what may be here.
translation: Harika! Kesinlikle iyiye isaret! Sen onu saklayabilirsin, ben de burada ne olabilecegine dair bilgimi saklayacagim.

english: Okay...
So I'm here... That's there... Then how do we get down there?
translation: Demek buradayim... Orada... Peki oraya nasil inebiliriz?

english: Chatting to yourself?
Ah, hello there! I'm just pondering on the wonders of geography.
Anything I can help you out with?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Most certainly. Perhaps you could dig around near the mouth of that nearby cave and elucidate its nature for me.
translation: Elbette. Belki de yakinlardaki magaranin agzinin yakininda kazi yapip bana onun dogasini aciklayabilirsin.

english: Will I get anything for helping?
translation: Yardim ettigim icin bir sey alacak miyim?

english: The feeling of satisfaction after helping a scientist in need?
translation: Ihtiyaci olan bir bilim insanina yardim ettikten sonra duyacagin tatmin duygusu mu?

english: Fair enough.
I found a sapphire nearby.
Outstanding! This can only be seen as a positive! I shall add the knowledge to my reserves. You may keep the gem.
translation: Harika! Bu sadece olumlu bir sey olarak görülebilir! Bu bilgiyi birikimlerime ekleyecegim. Mücevheri alabilirsin.

english: Alright...
Are you lost?
No, my good friend, but I am in a bit of a pickle.
translation: Hayir, dostum, ama biraz zor durumdayim.

english: A pickle?
Perhaps a jam... Those bandits over there are in the way of scientific discovery!
translation: Belki de cikmaz sokak... Suradaki haydutlar bilimsel kesiflerin önünü kesiyor!

english: Would you like me to deal with them?
Well, I'm not averse to a little academic collaboration. I just need some proof that there's something strange here.
translation: Sey, kücük bir akademik isbirligine karsi degilim. Sadece burada garip bir seyler olduguna dair kanita ihtiyacim var.

english: Is there any chance you could dig near the mouth of that cave for me? Let me know if you find anything.
translation: O magaranin agzinin yakininda benim icin kazabilir misin? Bir sey bulursan bana haber ver.

english: What should I do with the bandits?
I have no qualms with you doing what you must on that front.
translation: Bu konuda yapman gerekeni yapmandan cekinmem.

english: I found an emerald in the earth.
Stupendous! Combined with the other locations, I suspect there may be more to this than meets the eye.
translation: Harika! Diger yerlerle birlestirince, bu isin göründügünden daha fazlasi oldugunu düsünüyorum.

english: Right...
Keep the gem for yourself, as payment for your assistance.
Come on... Something here has to work...
translation: Hadi ama... Burada bir seyler ise yaramali...

english: Good day!
Hello there! What are you doing out here?
I've been tracking gemstones, and I think I've found a potential source for them!
translation: Mücevherleri takip ediyordum ve sanirim potansiyel bir kaynak buldum!

english: You have?
Yes! A large crab!
It moves around a bit, but I believe it's currently to the south!
translation: Biraz hareket ediyor ama su anda güneyde oldugunu düsünüyorum!

english: Hello again! Look! That large crab is here!
translation: Merhaba tekrar! Bak! O büyük yengeç burada!

english: Hello again!
Do you happen to know where that large crab is?
translation: O büyük yengecin nerede oldugunu biliyor musun?

english: I believe it's currently to the north!
I believe it's currently to the north east!
I believe it's currently to the north west!
I believe it's currently to the south!
I believe it's currently to the south east!
I believe it's currently to the south west!
Strange... I've lost track of it. I'm sure I'll pick up the trail shortly.
translation: Garip... Izini kaybettim. Eminim yakinda izini bulacagim.

english: I believe the crab is currently to the south east!
Hello.
You ssshould not be down here...
Who are you?
My name isss unimportant... I live only to ssserve my massster.
translation: Adim önemli degil... Ben sadece efendime hizmet etmek icin yasiyorum.

english: Um... Okay then.
Why are you down here?
Thisss isss where I belong... Beingsss sssuch as myssself cannot abide in the light... It is in the darknesss where we find our homesss...
translation: Benim yerim burasi... Benim gibi varliklar isikta yasayamaz... Karanlikta evimizi buluruz...

english: Uh... Okay then.
Can I use your anvil?
Of courssse you may... I have very little ussse for it nowadaysss...
translation: Tabii ki kullanabilirsin... Artik pek kullanmiyorum...

english: Uh... Thanks, I guess.
Are you an assistant to Count Draynor?
I used to have that honour...Why do you ssseek me?
translation: Eskiden o serefe nail olmustum... Neden beni ariyorsun?

english: I understand that you can make me a 'sacrificial offering pot' if I bring you a bar of silver?
translation: Sana bir gümüs külce getirirsem bana bir ‘kurban sunusu cömlegi’ yapabilecegini duydum?

english: And where did you hear thisss?
It was from Malak in Canifis.
Ah, I sssee...Yesss, I know how to make sssuch an item...It has been many yearsss sssince I have needed to however...
translation: Ah, anliyorum... Evet, böyle bir esyayi nasil yapacagimi biliyorum... Ancak bunu yapmamin üzerinden yillar gecti...

english: It is not my wisssh to quessstion your desssire for sssuch an item, I wasss merely sssurprisssed that one sssuch as you would make sssuch a requessst...
translation: Böyle bir esyaya olan isteginizi sorgulamak istemem, sadece sizin gibi birinin böyle bir istekte bulunmasina sasirdim...

english: I will happily make you thisss pot, but you mussst bring me a bar of sssilver...Alasss, I can no longer collect my own ingredientsss, and mussst remain here...
translation: Bu tencereyi seve seve yaparim, ama bana bir gümüs külcesi getirmen gerekiyor... Ne yazik ki artik kendi malzemelerimi toplayamiyorum ve burada kalmak zorundayim...

english: I have a silver bar with me, I was wondering if you could make it into a 'sacrificial offering pot' for me?
translation: Yanimda bir gümüs külcesi var, bunu benim icin bir ‘kurban sunusu tenceresi’ yapabilir misin acaba?

english: Yesss, of courssse...There you are, put it to good usssse...
translation: Evet, tabii ki... Al bakalim, iyi kullan. ..

english: Who are you?
Why are you down here?
Can I use your anvil?
Hi!
Grrreetings frrriend! Welcome to my worrrld famous food emporrrium! All my meats are so frrresh you'd swear you killed them yourrrself!
translation: Selam dostum! Dünyaca ünlü yemek magazama hos geldin! Bütün etlerim o kadar taze ki, onlari kendin öldürmüssün gibi hissedeceksin!

english: Why do you only sell meats?
What? Why, what else would you want to eat? What kind of lycanthrrrope are you anyway?
translation: Ne? Baska ne yemek istersin ki? Sen ne tür bir kurt adamsin ki?

english: ...A vegetarian one?
Vegetarrrian...?
Never mind.
Do you sell cooked food?
Cooked food? Who would want that? You lose all the flavourrr of the meat when you can't taste the blood!
translation: Pismis yemek mi? Kim ister ki? Kanin tadini alamayinca etin tüm lezzeti kaybolur!

english: Can I buy some food?
Cerrrtainly!
Why do you only sell meats?
Do you sell cooked food?
Can I buy some food?
Hello there.
Hello. A fine day for stealing, wouldn't you say?
translation: Merhaba. Hirsizlik icin güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: I suppose so, just as long as you're not planning to steal from me.
translation: Sanirim öyle, tabii benden hirsizlik yapmayi planlamiyorsan.

english: You don't have any house keys, do you? You won't find yourself getting very far without any. Maybe come back later?
translation: Ev anahtarin yok, degil mi? Anahtarin olmadan cok uzaga gidemezsin. Belki daha sonra tekrar gel?

english: You don't have any valuables worth my time. Come back when you do!
translation: Benim zamanimi harcayacak kadar degerli bir seyin yok. Varsa tekrar gel!

english: Looks like [Caius/Lavinia/Victor] is returning to [his/her] house. You'll have to wait a moment until we get word of the next house.
translation: Görünüse göre [Caius/Lavinia/Victor] evine dönüyor. Bir sonraki evin haberini alana kadar biraz beklemelisin.

english: I hear that [Caius/Lavinia/Victor] might be leaving [his/her] house soon.
Looks like [Caius/Lavinia/Victor] isn't home right now. Go quickly!
translation: Görünüse göre [Caius/Lavinia/Victor] su anda evde degil. Cabuk git!

english: Already forgotten? Head over to [Caius/Lavinia/Victor]'s house.
His house is north of here.
Her house is east of here.
I'll find my own way.
I'll pass for now.
Suit yourself.
I'd better get going.
I could do with some information on houses.
translation: Evler hakkinda biraz bilgi alabilir miyim?

english: Yes.
Yes please.
I'll find my own way.
Yes, don't ask me again.
No.
Ahoy there, sailor! Can't stop to talk right now, I'm afraid. You'll need to come back later.
translation: Selam denizci! Su anda konusacak vaktim yok, üzgünüm. Daha sonra tekrar gelmelisin.

english: You need to complete the Pandemonium quest to fully access the Sailing skill.
translation: Yelkencilik becerisine tam erisim icin Pandemonium görevini tamamlaman gerekiyor.

english: Ahoy there sailor and welcome to Storm Tempor!
translation: Selam denizci, Storm Tempor'a hos geldin!

english: Welcome? This place doesn't look very welcoming to me.
translation: Hos geldin mi? Burasi bana pek hos gelmedi.

english: What do you mean? We've got the fresh sea breeze, the spray of the ocean water, a supply of the finest rum this side of the Unquiet ocean and one of the fiercest storms in Gielinor to contend with.
translation: Ne demek istiyorsun? Taze deniz esintisi, okyanus suyunun sicramalari, Unquiet okyanusunun bu tarafindaki en iyi rom ve Gielinor'daki en siddetli firtinalardan biri var.

english: What's not to love?
Yeah, it's contending with that storm that worries me.
translation: Evet, beni endiselendiren o firtinayla mücadele etmek.

english: Ye'd be right to fear the storm, it's bested many a sailor around these parts. That's what makes it so exciting though!
translation: Firtinadan korkmakta haklisin, bu bölgedeki bircok denizciyi yendi. Ama bu onu cok heyecanli kiliyor!

english: Us Barracudas live for the rush and we trust that our skills will save us a trip to the locker.
translation: Biz Barracudalar heyecan icin yasiyoruz ve becerilerimizin bizi mezara gitmekten kurtaracagina inaniyoruz.

english: I'm always up for a challenge, but what's the point? Why not take the safer route around the storm?
translation: Ben her zaman zorluklara hazirim, ama ne anlami var? Neden firtinayi dolasarak daha güvenli yolu secmiyoruz?

english: Well you see, there's value in sailors with skills like us. Most common folk would think like you and avoid the storm, but that takes time and as them merchants say, 'time is money'.
translation: Görüyorsun, bizim gibi becerikli denizcilerin degeri var. Cogu insan sizin gibi düsünür ve firtinadan kacinir, ama bu zaman alir ve tüccarlarin dedigi gibi, “zaman paradir”.

english: That's where we come in! Those merchant folk sail up to the south-end of the storm, drop off their shipments to one of our boats down there and we make sure it gets to the Pandemonium!
translation: Iste burada devreye giriyoruz! Tüccarlar firtinanin güney ucuna yelken acar, mallarini oradaki teknelerimizden birine birakir ve biz de Pandemonium'a ulasmasini saglariz!

english: Makes sense to me, what's in it for you guys?
translation: Bana mantikli geliyor, peki sizin cikariniz ne?

english: Why, the thrill of the sport! Sailing isn't just about going places, it's about mastery of the boat, the pull of the sails, the feeling of the tiller in your hand and the taste of rum in your mouth! *hic
translation: Tabii ki, bu sporun heyecani! Yelkencilik sadece bir yerlere gitmek degildir, tekneyi ustaca kullanmak, yelkenleri cekmek, elinizdeki dümenin hissini ve agzinizdaki romun tadini hissetmektir! *hic

english: Sailing as a sport? How does that work? What are the rules?
translation: Yelkencilik bir spor mu? Nasil oluyor bu? Kurallari nedir?

english: Sailing as a sport is what us Barracudas do, we have trials setup all across the sea where you can test your mettle against the clock.
translation: Yelkencilik bir spor olarak Barracuda'larin yaptigi seydir, denizde zamanla yarisabileceginiz denemeler düzenliyoruz.

english: I'm in charge of this here trial, the Tempor Tantrum.
translation: Ben bu denemenin, Tempor Tantrum'un sorumlusuyum.

english: The objective is simple: Sail south, collect a rum shipment from our boat south of Tempoross and deliver it back to this boat here.
translation: Amac basit: Güneye yelken acin, Tempoross'un güneyindeki teknemizden rom yükünü alin ve bu tekneye geri getirin.

english: While you're out there, keep an eye out for any lost supplies aswell as they also determine your rank.
translation: Disaridayken, siralamanizi belirleyen kayip malzemelere de dikkat edin.

english: If you can deliver all the rum shipments and collect all the lost supplies in the time given, ye'll be awarded a barracuda rank!
translation: Verilen sürede tüm rom sevkiyatlarini teslim edip kayip malzemeleri toplarsaniz, barracuda siralamasina girersiniz!

english: Each trial has three ranks, Swordfish, Shark or Marlin and each rank is harder than the last.
translation: Her denemede üc siralama vardir: Swordfish, Shark veya Marlin ve her siralama bir öncekinden daha zordur.

english: For this trial you'll be asked to fetch additional rum shipments and collect even more lost supplies as the rank increases.
translation: Bu denemede, siralama yükseldikce ek rom sevkiyatlari getirmeniz ve daha fazla kayip malzeme toplamaniz istenir.

english: You can't attempt the next rank until you beat the one before it. You can also try unranked if you'd rather warm up your hands beforehand.
translation: Bir önceki rütbeyi gecmeden bir sonraki rütbeye gecemezsiniz. Önceden isinmak isterseniz, rütbesiz deneme yapabilirsiniz.

english: That said, with your Sailing experience I'd suggest sailing elsewhere for now and coming back when you've learned a thing or two.
translation: Bununla birlikte, denizcilik deneyiminizle, simdilik baska bir yere yelken acmanizi ve bir iki sey ögrendikten sonra geri dönmenizi öneririm.

english: Thanks for the advice, I'll bear that in mind.
translation: Tavsiyeniz icin tesekkürler, bunu aklimda tutacagim.

english: Do you have any tips or tricks for me?
translation: Bana verebilecegin herhangi bir ipucu veya püf noktasi var mi?

english: Sure do sailor!
First up! You're going to need a boat with at least an oak mast built in order to withstand the storm. Boats as good as a goner without that.
translation: Ilk olarak! Firtinaya dayanabilmek icin en azindan mese direkli bir tekneye ihtiyacin olacak. Bu özellik olmadan tekneler mahvolur.

english: Second! Your boat will also need to have at least an oak hull to withstand the rapids, but those that do will experience a burst of speed from travelling through them.
translation: Ikincisi! Teknenin akintilara dayanabilmesi icin en azindan mese gövdesi olmasi gerekir, ancak bu özellige sahip tekneler akintilardan gecerken hizlanma yasarlar.

english: The more rapids you go through without letting your speed drop off the faster you'll go!
translation: Hizini düsürmeden nehir akintilarindan ne kadar cok gecersen, o kadar hizli gidersin!

english: Third! Avoid all lightning clouds and try to move as fast as you can, even with a strong mast they'll still slow you down.
translation: Ücüncüsü! Yildirim bulutlarindan uzak dur ve olabildigince hizli hareket etmeye calis, güclü bir direk olsa bile seni yavaslatirlar.

english: Fourth! Keep your sails trimmed to gain even more speed. This aint no shipwreck salvaging, go fast or go home.
translation: Dördüncüsü! Daha da hiz kazanmak icin yelkenlerini düzgün ayarla. Bu bir gemi enkazi kurtarma operasyonu degil, ya hizli ol ya da eve dön.

english: Finally watch out for those rocks, hitting them will kill all of your boats momentum immediately.
translation: Son olarak kayalara dikkat edin, onlara carparsaniz teknenizin tüm ivmesi aninda kaybolur.

english: Who are you?
Who are the Barracudas?
I'd like to attempt the Tempor Tantrum.
More options...
Would you like to try some fine Miscellanian ale, your Royal Highness?
translation: Miscellanian birasi denemek ister misiniz, Majesteleri?

english: Well, I say Miscellanian, but it's actually brewed on the mainland.
translation: Miscellanian diyorum ama aslinda anakarada üretiliyor.

english: Would you like to try some anyway?
Yes, please.
No, thank you.
What's it like living down here?
Business is booming!
Now, if only I hadn't taken a loss with the beer I sold to those teenagers.
translation: Keske o genclere sattigim bira yüzünden zarar etmeseydim.

english: Yes, please.
No, thank you.
What's it like living down here?
Pay-dirt!
Ow!
Hello.
Good day, your Royal Highness.
Here, solve this.
Runolf hands you a puzzlebox!
translation: Runolf sana bir bulmaca kutusu uzatiyor!

english: That doesn't look solved to me.
Well done [player name]. Here you go.
You've been given a [new clue/casket]!
Oh, leave an old dwarf in peace will you?
translation: Oh, yasli bir cüceyi rahat birakir misin?

english: Why, what's wrong?
Ninenty years down in the mines, and this is all I got out of it. All my life wasted away.
translation: Madenlerde doksan yil gecirdim ve elde ettigim tek sey bu. Hayatim bosa gitti.

english: You've still got a nice house, don't you?
translation: Hala güzel bir evin var, degil mi?

english: A crummy old house in East, that's all my life amounts to.
translation: Dogu'da eski, döküntü bir ev, hayatimin tümü bu kadar.

english: I'll leave you alone then.
Ninentyyears down in the mines, and this is all I got out of it. All my life wasted away.
translation: Madenlerde doksan yil geçirdim ve elde ettigim tek sey bu. Hayatim bosa gitti.

english: Hello again, old cheesecake! Wonderful to see you.
translation: Merhaba yine, yasli peynirli kek! Seni görmek ne güzel.

english: How are the investigations going?
Thanks to you freeing me, very well! I have much more to do of course, but now I am free, I can continue where I left off.
translation: Senin beni kurtardigin icin cok iyi! Tabii ki daha yapacak cok isim var, ama artik özgürüm, kaldigim yerden devam edebilirim.

english: That's great news!
Have you another helmet like the one you gave me?
translation: Bana verdigin gibi baska bir kaskin var mi?

english: You might be in luck, old bellybutton fluff - I have made replacements. You could have one for 60,000 coins - for the materials, you understand.
translation: Sanslisin, eski göbek deligi tüyü - yenilerini yaptim. 60.000 sikke karsiliginda bir tane alabilirsin - malzeme icin, anlarsin ya.

english: I don't think I can afford that, sorry.
No problem! Come back and see me any time, old garters.
translation: Sorun degil! Istedigin zaman gelip beni gör, eski jartiyer.

english: How are the investigations going?
Have you another helmet like the one you gave me?
translation: Bana verdigin gibi baska bir kaskin var mi?

english: Okay, that sounds fair.
I don't think I can afford that, sorry.
Hello there!
I say! Where on Gielinor did that voice come from?
translation: Hey! Gielinor'da bu ses nereden geliyor?

english: Uh...hello there! Can you hear me?
Why yes. Yes I can. My word. Is that...is that one of the gods? Guthix perhaps? Saradomin?
translation: Evet, duyabiliyorum. Tanrim. Bu... bu tanrilardan biri mi? Guthix olabilir mi? Saradomin?

english: No, no. I'm not either of them.
translation: Hayir, hayir. Ben ikisi de degilim.

english: Egad! You're not...Zamorak...are you? I mean, uh...begging your pardon of course, my Lord. No offence intended!
translation: Aman Tanrim! Sen... Zamorak... degil misin? Yani, uh... affedersin tabii ki, efendim. Alinmak istemezdim!

english: Ha ha! No, I'm speaking to you through the pipe here! I'm at the bottom of your tower.
translation: Ha ha! Hayir, sana bu borudan sesleniyorum! Kulenin dibindeyim.

english: Oh. Oh I see! Oh, yes. How clever! Remarkable idea! How ever did you think of that? Good show, old bean!
translation: Oh. Oh anladim! Oh, evet. Ne zekice! Harika bir fikir! Bunu nasil düsündün? Aferin, dostum!

english: Who are you?
Rupert the Beard. At your service, old fruit.
Rupert the Beard?
Yes, old turnip. On account of my wonderfully long bearded chin, you see.
translation: Evet, dostum. Muhtesem uzun sakalimdan dolayi, anlarsin ya.

english: So what are you doing up there exactly? And how come you talk so strangely?
translation: Peki, orada tam olarak ne yapiyorsun? Ve neden bu kadar garip konusuyorsun?

english: What am I doing? Well, I guess I'm stuck in a matter of speaking. Dear me, yes! I'm stuck. And I speak in the King's speech, I'll have you know.
translation: Ne mi yapiyorum? Sey, sanirim bir nevi sikisip kaldim. Evet, sikisip kaldim. Ve bilgin olsun, kralin dilini konusuyorum.

english: Really? Which king?
Which K...? Why, THE King old spud! THE King! Only one worth mentioning in my opinion.
translation: Hangi kral mi? Tabii ki kral, yasli patates! Kral! Bence bahsetmeye deger tek kisi o.

english: Hey, you're not related to Sir Tiffy by any chance are you?
translation: Hey, sen Sir Tiffy ile akraba degilsin, degil mi?

english: What? That namby pamby nincompoop? Not on your nelly! More fluff in the ears than sense, that man!
translation: Ne? O zayif, aptal herif mi? Hayir, tabii ki hayir! O adamin kulaklarinda mantiktan çok tüy var!

english: I see. Well is there anything I can do to help you up there?
translation: Anliyorum. Peki, sana yardim edebilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Hmmm. No, no, I can't think of anything at the moment. I'm a bit stuck. Let me know if you get any ideas though.
translation: Hmmm. Hayir, hayir, su anda aklima bir sey gelmiyor. Biraz sikistim. Bir fikrin olursa bana haber ver.

english: I'll do my best!
Hiya. Are you carrying anything valuable?
translation: Merhaba. Yaninda degerli bir sey tasiyor musun?

english: Why are you asking?
Um... It's a quiz. I'm asking everyone I meet if they're carrying anything valuable.
translation: Sey... Bu bir test. Karsilastigim herkese degerli bir sey tasiyip tasimadiklarini soruyorum.

english: What would you do if I said I had loads of expensive items with me?
translation: Yanimda bir sürü pahali esya oldugunu söylersem ne yaparsin?

english: Ooh, do you? It's been ages since anyone said they'd got anything worth stealing.
translation: Öyle mi? Uzun zamandir kimse calinmaya deger bir sey oldugunu söylememisti.

english: 'Anything worth stealing'?
Um... Not that I'd dream of stealing anything!
translation: Um... Calmayi hayal ettigimden degil tabii!

english: Well, I'll say I'm not carrying anything valuable at all.
translation: Peki, ben de degerli bir sey tasimadigimi söyleyecegim.

english: Oh, what a shame.
Hello!
Why won't people leave me alone?!
Hello.!
What?!
I'm looking for the guard that was on duty at the castle last night.
translation: Dün gece kalede görevli olan muhafizi ariyorum.

english: Who?!
Buzz off!
Do you know of another way up Death Plateau?
translation: Ölüm Platosu'na cikan baska bir yol biliyor musun?

english: Why would I want to go up there? I just want to be left in peace!
translation: Neden oraya cikmak isteyeyim ki? Sadece rahat birakilmak istiyorum!

english: It used to be just humans trampling past my cave and making a racket. Now there's those blasted trolls too! Not only do they stink and argue with each other loudly but they are always fighting the humans.
translation: Eskiden sadece insanlar magaramin önünden gecip gürültü yaparlardi. Simdi de o lanet troller var! Sadece kokuyorlar ve birbirleriyle yüksek sesle tartisiyorlar, ayni zamanda insanlarla da sürekli kavga ediyorlar.

english: I just want to be left in peace!
Ah... I might be able to help you.
How?!
I'm trying to help the...er...humans to reclaim back Death Plateau. If you help me then at least you'd be rid of the trolls.
translation: Ben... sey... insanlarin Ölüm Platosu'nu geri almalarina yardim etmeye calisiyorum. Bana yardim edersen en azindan trollerden kurtulursun.

english: Hmph.
Let me see...
I've only been up Death Plateau once to complain about the noise but those pesky trolls started throwing rocks at me!
translation: Ölüm Platosu'na sadece bir kez gürültüden sikayet etmek icin gittim ama o sinir bozucu troller bana tas atmaya basladilar!

english: Before the trolls came there used to be a nettlesome Sherpa that took humans exploring or something equally stupid. Perhaps he'd know another way.
translation: Troller gelmeden önce, insanlari kesfe ya da onun gibi aptalca seylere götüren sinir bozucu bir Sherpa vardi. Belki o baska bir yol bilir.

english: Where does this Sherpa live?
I don't know but it can't be far as he used to be around all the time!
translation: Bilmiyorum ama her zaman buralarda oldugu icin cok uzak olamaz!

english: Nothing, sorry!
Hello.
Have you got rid of those pesky trolls yet?
translation: O sinir bozucu trollerden kurtuldun mu?

english: Where did you say this Sherpa was?
I dunno but he must live around here somewhere!
translation: Bilmiyorum ama buralarda bir yerde yasiyor olmali!

english: I'm working on it!
Grr!
They will be gone soon! The Imperial Guard will use a secret way that starts from the back of the Sherpa's hut to destroy the troll camp!
translation: Yakinda yok olacaklar! Imparatorluk Muhafizlari, Sherpa'nin kulübesinin arkasindan baslayan gizli bir yolu kullanarak troll kampini yok edecek!

english: I shall have peace again at last!
If those pesky humans don't start trampling all over Death Plateau again that is!
translation: Tabii o sinir bozucu insanlar tekrar Ölüm Platosu'nu cignemeye baslamazlarsa!

english: I'm afraid there's been some trouble...
You told me you'd get rid of the trolls!
I'm sure the Imperial Guard will deal with them in due course.
translation: Imparatorluk Muhafizlari zamani gelince onlarla ilgilenecektir.

english: Hmph! They'd better!
Here! Now leave me alone!
I'm looking for the guard that was on last night.
translation: Dün gece nöbet tutan muhafizi ariyorum.

english: Do you know of another way up Death Plateau?
translation: Ölüm Platosu'na cikan baska bir yol biliyor musun?

english: Nothing, sorry!
Hi!
Well. This beats doing the shopping!
I wouldn't want to be the poor guy that has to clean up after the duels.
translation: Düellolarin ardindan temizlik yapmak zorunda kalan zavalli adam olmak istemezdim.

english: Me neither.
Hi!
What did the skeleton say before it ate?
I don't know?
Bone-appetit.
Ooh. This is exciting!
Yup!
How can you make a very lively hankerchief?
translation: Nasil cok canli bir mendil yapabilirsiniz?

english: Put a little boogey in it.
Why did the skeleton burp?
'Cause it didn't have the guts to fart!
My son just won his first duel!
Congratulations!
He ripped his opponent in half!
That's gotta hurt!
He's only 10 as well!
You gotta start 'em young!
Can't you see I'm watching the duels?
I'm sorry!
Knock knock!
Who's there?
Boo.
Boo who?
Don't cry, it's just me!
Waaaaassssssuuuuupp?!
Hi! I'm here to watch the duels!
Me too!
My favourite fighter is Mubariz!
The guy at the information kiosk?
Yeah! He rocks!
Takes all sorts, I guess.
Hmph.
Did you know they think this place dates back to the second age?!
translation: Bu yerin ikinci caga kadar uzandigini biliyor muydun?

english: Really?
Yeah. The guy at the information kiosk was telling me.
Hi!
Hi. How can I help?
Can you heal me?
Sorry, I'm not on duty.
PLEASE DON'T KILL ME!
I was... looking to be healed.
No way, I'm out of here just as soon as I've packed up my stuff!
translation: Olmaz, esyalarimi toplar toplamaz buradan gidiyorum!

english: You look healthy to me!
Of course!
Do you see a lot of injured fighters?
translation: Cok fazla yarali dövüscü görüyor musun?

english: Yes I do. Thankfully we can cope with almost anything. Jaraah really is a wonderful surgeon, his methods are a little unorthodox but he gets the job done.
translation: Evet, görüyorum. Neyse ki neredeyse her seyle basa cikabiliyoruz. Jaraah gercekten harika bir cerrah, yöntemleri biraz alisilmadik ama isini iyi yapiyor.

english: I shouldn't tell you this but his nickname is 'The Butcher'.
translation: Bunu sana söylememem gerekir ama lakabi “Kasap”tir.

english: That's reassuring.
Do you come here often?
I work here, so yes!
You're silly!
Can you heal me?
Do you see a lot of injured fighters?
Do you come here often?
The High Priestess says you're to be the sacrifice instead of me. I was so looking forward to meeting Zulrah.
translation: Yüce Rahibe, benim yerime senin kurban edilecegini söyledi. Zulrah ile tanismayi cok istiyordum.

english: Don't you understand that I've saved your life?
In death, the nutrients of my lowly body were destined to nourish the mighty Zulrah. I would have become one with my god.
translation: Ölümde, benim önemsiz bedenimin besinleri, güclü Zulrah'i beslemek icin kaderindeydi. Tanrimla bir olacaktim.

english: Still, it is nice to live a little longer. Thank you for what you have done.
translation: Yine de, biraz daha yasamak güzel. Yaptiklarin icin tesekkür ederim.

english: I'm sorry.
While I am saddened that my destiny has not been fulfilled, it is nice to live a little longer. Thank you for what you have done.
translation: Kaderimin gerceklesmemesi beni üzdü, ama biraz daha uzun yasamak güzel. Yaptiklarin icin tesekkür ederim.

english: I am the chosen one. Soon I shall meet Zulrah face-to- face, and my sacrifice shall fulfil the sacred contract that protects our tribe.
translation: Ben secilmis kisiyim. Yakinda Zulrah ile yüz yüze gelecegim ve fedakarligim, kabilemizi koruyan kutsal sözlesmeyi yerine getirecek.

english: Don't you care that you're going to die?
In death, the nutrients of my lowly body shall nourish the mighty Zulrah. I shall become one with my god.
translation: Öldügümde, benim zavalli bedenimin besinleri, güclü Zulrah'i besleyecek. Tanrimla bir olacagim.

english: Can I go and confront Zulrah myself?
The High Priestess has chosen me. I don't know how she decides these things, but perhaps you should ask her.
translation: Yüksek Rahibe beni secti. Bu tür seyleri nasil karar verdigini bilmiyorum, ama belki ona sormalisin.

english: I'm off.
Here, solve this.
Sacrifice hands you a [light puzzle box/puzzlebox]!
That doesn't look solved to me.
Well done [player name]. Here you go.
You've been given [a casket/a new clue]!
Don't you understand that I've saved your life?
I'm sorry.
Don't you care that you're going to die?
Can I go and confront Zulrah myself?
I'm off.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu var. Merhaba, selam, selam...

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: Ama bunlar tek bir selam sayilir!

english: Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her türlü sey! Kuleler görülmeye deger harika manzaralar sunuyor.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmeni tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
What do you do here?
I's been making da machetes for Gabooty's shop Bwana!
translation: Gabooty'nin dükkani icin pala yapiyorum Bwana!

english: If you want me to make you a machete we can do a deal if you like.
translation: Sana bir pala yapmami istersen, istersen anlasabiliriz.

english: Yes, I'd like to get a machete.
Ok Bwana, here's the deal. There are three gem bladed machete types, in order of quality and hacking proficiency, they're ordered from low to high as follows.
translation: Tamam Bwana, anlasma söyle. Üc tür mücevher bicakli machete var, kalite ve kesme becerisi sirasina göre, düsükten yüksege dogru su sekilde siralanmislar.

english: Ok Bwana, if you want to order the opal machete, I need 3 opals, either cut or uncut, 1 gout plant tuber and 300 trading sticks please.
translation: Tamam Bwana, opal machete siparis etmek istersen, 3 opal, kesilmis veya kesilmemis, 1 gut bitkisi yumrusu ve 300 ticaret cubugu lütfen.

english: I don't have enough trading sticks, sorry.
Ok Bwana, come back when you have them.
translation: Tamam Bwana, eline gecince tekrar gel.

english: Ok Bwana, if you want to order the Jade machete, I need 3 jades, either cut or uncut, 1 gout plant tuber and 600 trading sticks please.
translation: Tamam Bwana, yesim bicagi siparis etmek istiyorsan, kesilmis veya kesilmemis 3 yesim tasi, 1 gut bitkisi yumrugu ve 600 ticaret cubugu lütfen.

english: Ok Bwana, if you want to order the Red Topaz machete, I need 3 Red Topaz, either cut or uncut, 1 gout plant tuber and 1200 trading sticks please.
translation: Tamam Bwana, Kirmizi Topaz palasini siparis etmek istiyorsan, kesilmis veya kesilmemis 3 adet Kirmizi Topaz, 1 adet gut bitkisi yumrusu ve 1200 adet ticaret cubugu lütfen.

english: So Bwana, do you like the look of the machetes?
translation: Peki Bwana, palalarin görünüsünü begendin mi?

english: Why do you need gems?
They're tougher than just metal on its own, plus it's the only such resource naturally available in this region.
translation: Sadece metalden daha dayaniklidirlar, ayrica bu bölgede dogal olarak bulunan tek kaynak budur.

english: Why do you need a gout plant tuber?
translation: Neden gut bitkisi yumruguna ihtiyaciniz var?

english: It's one of the harder to find resources which I mix with other ingredients in order to bind the ground down gem dust to the surface of the metal bladed machete.
translation: Bu, bulmasi zor kaynaklardan biri ve ben onu diger malzemelerle karistirarak ögütülmüs mücevher tozunu metal bicakli machete'nin yüzeyine yapistiriyorum.

english: You can sometimes, if you're lucky, find the plant if you hack away at the jungle around here. You'll need to find a way to dig up the tubers though, they're the important part of the plant.
translation: Sansliysaniz, buradaki ormani keserek bazen bu bitkiyi bulabilirsiniz. Ancak yumrulari kazip cikarmak icin bir yol bulmaniz gerekir, cünkü bitkinin önemli kismi yumrularidir.

english: Why is it so expensive?

Expensive bwana, it's quite reasonably priced if you ask me. I can make it cheaper than Gabooty charges for it, that's for sure. And after all, I have to earn a living around here as well you know, I have children to feed!
translation: Pahali mi bwana, bana sorarsan fiyati oldukca makul. Gabooty'nin fiyatindan daha ucuza yapabilirim, orasi kesin. Sonucta ben de burada gecimimi saglamaliyim, beslemem gereken cocuklarim var!

english: Ok, thanks.
No thanks, I have to go.
Is there anything interesting to do around here?
translation: Buralarda ilginc bir sey var mi?

english: Not that I'm aware of, just sit back and enjoy the sunshine bwana!
translation: Bildigim kadariyla yok, arkaniza yaslanin ve günesin tadini cikarin bwana!

english: Bwana, if anyone else asks me that question today, I'll explode! Go and ask someone else!
translation: Bwana, bugün baska biri bana bu soruyu sorarsa, patlayacagim! Gidip baskasina sorun!

english: It's just village life as normal around here Bwana, always something interesting to find to occupy your time if you look hard enough.
translation: Buralarda normal köy hayati var bwana, yeterince dikkatli bakarsaniz zamaninizi gecirecek ilginc seyler bulabilirsiniz.

english: Sorry Bwana, I'm already busy, why not go and talk to Murcaily! He's around the village somewhere.
translation: Üzgünüm Bwana, ben zaten mesgulüm, neden gidip Murcaily ile konusmuyorsun! Köyün buralarinda bir yerlerde.

english: Well, I think that there's some work to be done...perhaps Murcaily can help you. He usually tends to the hardwood grove to the east of Trufitus's hut.
translation: Sanirim yapilacak bazi isler var... belki Murcaily sana yardimci olabilir. Genellikle Trufitus'un kulübesinin dogusundaki sert agac korusunda calisir.

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
I've already given you some trading sticks and I don't have any more on me at the moment. Why not go and talk to some of the other villagers and get some contributions?
translation: Sana zaten bazi ticaret cubuklari verdim ve su anda üzerimde baska yok. Neden gidip diger köylülerle konusup biraz katki almiyorsun?

english: What do you do here?
Yes, I'd like to get a machete.
Opal machete.
Order the Opal machete.
Go back to machete descriptions
Jade machete.
Order the Jade machete.
Red Topaz machete.
Order the Red Topaz machete.
Talk to Safta-doc
Why do you need gems?
Why do you need a gout plant tuber?
translation: Neden gut bitkisi yumrularina ihtiyacin var?

english: Why is it so expensive?
Let me see the machetes again.
Ok, thanks.
No thanks, but I'd like to ask another question.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, ama baska bir soru sormak istiyorum.

english: No thanks, I have to go.
Is there anything interesting to do here?
translation: Burada ilginc bir sey var mi?

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
Hello.
Hi, can I help you with something?
You're not from around here are you?
Why do you say that?
Well your accent for one sounds a little funny, and you seem to have a little more colour than most dwarves.
translation: Öncelikle aksanin biraz komik geliyor ve cogu cüceden biraz daha renkli görünüyorsun.

english: Living under a mountain isn't the best way to get a tan. No I'm not from around here. I was born and worked most my life in the desert.
translation: Dagin altinda yasamak bronzlasmak icin en iyi yol degil. Hayir, burali degilim. Cölde dogdum ve hayatimin cogunu orada calistim.

english: Just even thinking of the place makes me thirsty. Now can I help you with anything?
translation: Orayi düsünmek bile beni susatiyor. Size yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: So how do these rat pits work?
The Keldagrim pits cater for those with the larger variety of cats.
translation: Keldagrim cukurlari, daha büyük kedileri olanlara hizmet veriyor.

english: If you have an overgrown cat and a couple of coins you can challenge someone else who also has an overgrown cat and some spare change.
translation: Eger büyük bir kediniz ve birkac madeni paraniz varsa, büyük bir kedisi ve biraz bozuk parasi olan baska birine meydan okuyabilirsiniz.

english: That sounds simple enough so far.
translation: Su ana kadar kulaga basit geliyor.

english: You then agree on a wager. It's rumoured that some ratcatchers can talk to their own cats and give them tactics to aid them.
translation: Sonra bir bahis üzerinde anlasirsiniz. Bazi fare avcilarinin kedileriyle konusup onlara yardimci olacak taktikler verdigi söyleniyor.

english: So then how do you win the challenge?
I was just getting to that. Both the challengers' cats are placed inside the arena, and whichever kills 9 rats first wins.
translation: Tam da oraya geliyordum. Iki meydan okuyanin kedileri arenaya yerlestirilir ve ilk 9 fareyi öldüren kazanir.

english: That sounds vile and cruel.
It's a cruel world and the pits are no exception.
translation: Dünya zalim bir yer ve cukurlar da bir istisna degil.

english: Each to their own, I say.
Thanks for your help.
It sounds a little dangerous for my cat.
translation: Kedim icin biraz tehlikeli gibi geliyor.

english: I agree. Cats have been known to be killed in fights.
Oh how terrible. Is there nothing you can do to save your cat?
translation: Ne kadar korkunc. Kedinizi kurtarmak icin yapabileceginiz hicbir sey yok mu?

english: Of course there is, you can instruct it to be cautious, and it will leave once it feels as if it is in danger.
translation: Elbette var, ona dikkatli olmasini söyleyebilirsiniz, tehlike hissettiginde oradan ayrilacaktir.

english: Oh that sounds quite wise.
That depends on how you value your cat.
translation: Bu, kedinize ne kadar deger verdiginize bagli.

english: Sorry, I don't follow.
Well if your cat dies or it runs away you lose.
So the longer it stays in the fight the better chance you have of winning.
translation: Yani kavgada ne kadar uzun kalirsa, kazanma sansiniz o kadar artar.

english: Wow that sounds like fun!
I don't know about that.
One thing I know though is that it's a quick way to make and lose money.
translation: Bildigim tek sey, bu hizli para kazanmanin ve kaybetmenin bir yolu oldugu.

english: Is there a limit to how much you can bet?
translation: Bahis miktarinda bir sinir var mi?

english: Hmmm... let me think. I don't think that's ever arisen but I think it's 20,000.
translation: Hmmm... bir düsüneyim. Hic böyle bir durum olmadi ama sanirim 20.000.

english: Hmm, that sounds like a silly amount of money to bet on a cat fight.
translation: Hmm, kedi kavgasina bahis yapmak icin sacma bir miktar gibi geliyor.

english: You'd be surprised what some people would be willing to bet.
translation: Bazi insanlarin ne kadar bahis yapmaya razi olduklarini görsen sasirirsin.

english: There is a minimum bet of 100 coins too.
Can I challenge you and your cat?
translation: Sana ve kedine meydan okuyabilir miyim?

english: No, not now, we don't really bet with outsiders.
translation: Hayir, su anda olmaz, disaridan gelenlerle bahis yapmiyoruz.

english: But I'm not an outsider, am I not inside in the pits now?
translation: Ama ben disaridan gelmiyorum, su anda ringin icinde degil miyim?

english: I don't know, maybe once you've done something to win over my trust.
translation: Bilmiyorum, belki güvenimi kazanacak bir sey yaparsan.

english: Can it be bought?
What?
Your trust.
No. Regular townsfolk don't like us, which leads us to distrust them and anyone else.
translation: Hayir. Siradan kasaba halki bizi sevmiyor, bu da bizim onlara ve diger herkese güvenmememize neden oluyor.

english: That sounds vile and cruel.
One more thing...
Thanks for your help.
It sounds a little dangerous for my cat.
translation: Kedim icin biraz tehlikeli gibi görünüyor.

english: Wow that sounds like fun.
Is there a limit to how much you can bet?
translation: Bahis miktarinda bir sinir var mi?

english: Can I challenge you and your cat?
translation: Sana ve kedine meydan okuyabilir miyim?

english: Hiya.
Don't talk to me outerlander. I need to fix this longboat. Go talk to the chieftain.
translation: Benimle konusma yabanci. Bu kayigi tamir etmem lazim. Sefle konus.

english: Hi. Are you a member of the council?
Nope. I'm just a sailor.
Fair enough.
I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a rare flower from across the sea, do you?
translation: Denizin ötesinden gelen nadir bir cicegi nerede bulabilecegimi biliyor musun?

english: Ah! Even the outerlanders have heard of my mysterious flower! I found it in a country far far away from here!
translation: Ah! Yabancilar bile benim gizemli cicegimi duymus! Onu buradan cok uzak bir ülkede buldum!

english: Can I buy it from you?
I'm afraid not, outerlander. There is a woman in this village whose heart I seek to capture, and I think giving her this strange flower might be my best bet with her.
translation: Korkarim ki hayir, yabanci. Bu köyde kalbini kazanmak istedigim bir kadin var ve ona bu garip cicegi vermek en iyi sansim olabilir.

english: Maybe you could let me have the flower and do something else to impress her?
translation: Belki cicegi bana verip onu etkilemek icin baska bir sey yapabilirsin?

english: Hmm... that is not a totally stupid idea outerlander. I know she is a lover of music, and a romantic ballad might be just the thing with which to woo her.
translation: Hmm... bu tamamen aptalca bir fikir degil, yabanci. Onun müziksever oldugunu biliyorum ve romantik bir balad onu etkilemek icin tam da uygun olabilir.

english: Unfortunately I don't have a musical bone in my entire body, so someone else will have to write it for me.
translation: Maalesef benim müzik kulagim yok, bu yüzden baskasi benim icin yazmak zorunda.

english: So if I can find someone to write you a romantic ballad, you will give me your flower?
translation: Yani sana romantik bir balad yazacak birini bulursam, bana cicegini verir misin?

english: That sounds like a fair deal to me, outerlander.
translation: Bana adil bir anlasma gibi geliyor, yabanci.

english: Ask about the Merchant's trial
I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a love ballad, do you?
translation: Ask baladini nerede bulabilecegimi biliyor musun?

english: Well, the only musician I know of in these parts would be that terrible bard Olaf... ask him.
translation: Bu bölgede tanidigim tek müzisyen, o berbat ozan Olaf... ona sor.

english: You'll be glad to know I have had a love song written just for you by Olaf. So can I have that flower of yours now?
translation: Olaf'in senin icin bir ask sarkisi yazdigini bilmek seni mutlu edecektir. Simdi o cicegi alabilir miyim?

english: Oh. It's by Olaf? Hmm. Well, a deal's a deal. I just hope it's better than the usual rubbish he comes up with, or my chances are worse than ever.
translation: Oh. Olaf mi yazmis? Hmm. Anlasma anlasmadir. Umarim her zamanki sacmaliklarindan daha iyidir, yoksa sansim hic olmadigi kadar kötü olur.

english: so tell me... who is this woman that you are trying to impress anyway?
translation: Söylesene... Etkilemek istedigin bu kadin kim?

english: It's Thora, the longhall barkeep. Please don't tell her though. She's not like the rest of the Fremennik girls, she has a secret desire to see the world.
translation: Longhall'daki barmen Thora. Lütfen ona söyleme. O diger Fremennik kizlari gibi degil, dünyayi görmek gibi gizli bir arzusu var.

english: Being a sailor, I can really relate to that.
translation: Bir denizci olarak, bunu cok iyi anlayabiliyorum.

english: Hello. Can I get a ride on your ship?
Hello again, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. If you're ready to jump aboard, we're all ready to set sail with the tide!
translation: Merhaba tekrar, kardesim Dokrak. Eger gemiye atlamaya hazirsan, biz de gelgitle birlikte yelken acmaya haziriz!

english: Let's go!
You board the longship...
The ship arrives at Miscellania.
The ship arrives at Rellekka.
Actually, no.
Okay. Suit yourself.
Ask about becoming a Fremennik
Let's go!
Actually, no.
Ahoy there! Ye best talk t' the Captain, she'll get ye up t' speed on the moist beastie ye'll be facin'!
translation: Selam! Kaptanla konussan iyi olur, karsilasacagin nemli canavarla ilgili seni bilgilendirir!

english: Arr! Watch fer the Captain's orders - she'll 'ave us underway in two shakes of a marlinspike.
translation: Arr! Kaptanin emirlerini bekle - bizi iki saniyede yola cikaracak.

english: Hello there. How's it going?
Sorry, but I'm busy right now.
Okay, but it will be better once we're back on board.
translation: Tamam, ama gemiye döndügümüzde daha iyi olacak.

english: Not too bad, but there's still a lot that needs doing today.
translation: Fena degil, ama bugün hala yapilacak cok is var.

english: Sorry, but I have lots of work to do before we head back out to sea.
translation: Üzgünüm, ama denize acilmadan önce yapmam gereken cok is var.

english: Well I could do with a good rest, but fine otherwise.
translation: Iyi bir dinlenme iyi gelirdi, ama yoksa da sorun degil.

english: Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu var. Merhaba, selam, merhaba...

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: Bu yine de tek bir selam sayilir!

english: Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her türlü sey! Kuleler harika bir manzara.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmenizi tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Looking to protect yourself?
Let's see what you have.
No thanks.
Be careful you don't regret it.
Let's see what you have.
No thanks.
Hello there.
We don't get many visitors here. Are you sure you wouldn't rather be somewhere else?
translation: Buraya pek ziyaretci gelmez. Baska bir yerde olmak istemez misin?

english: I'm happy enough here.
Fair enough.
You lost?
I don't think so.
If you say so.
Who are you?
I'm a bold adventurer.
Strange place for you to be then. I doubt there's much adventurer to be had here.
translation: O zaman burasi senin icin garip bir yer. Burada pek maceraci olacagini sanmiyorum.

english: I wouldn't stick around if I were you. Nothing here for a tourist to be interested in.
translation: Yerinde olsam burada kalmazdim. Burada turistlerin ilgisini cekecek hicbir sey yok.

english: Traveller.
Welcome to the Burthorpe Games Rooms!
How do I play board games?

You can challenge someone to a game anywhere in the games rooms by using the right click option. Choose the type of game and then choose the options you want such as time per move. If you want to play a particular
translation: Oyun odalarinin herhangi bir yerinde sag tiklama secenegini kullanarak birine oyun teklifinde bulunabilirsin. Oyun türünü sec ve ardindan hamle basina süre gibi istedigin secenekleri sec. Belirli bir oyunu oynamak istiyorsan

english: game there are challenge rooms dedicated to that game. In the challenge rooms you can see other players ranks by right clicking them, their skill will be displayed instead of their combat level. Once you have enough
translation: o oyuna özel meydan okuma odalari var. Meydan okuma odalarinda diger oyunculari sag tiklayarak siralamalarini görebilirsin, savas seviyeleri yerine beceri seviyeleri gösterilir. Yeterli

english: experience you will be able to use the challenge rooms on the first floor! If your opponent accepts the challenge you will be taken to one of the tables in the main room where you will play your game of choice.
translation: deneyim kazandiginizda, birinci kattaki meydan okuma odalarini kullanabileceksiniz! Rakibiniz meydan okumayi kabul ederse, ana odadaki masalardan birine götürülecek ve sectiginiz oyunu oynayacaksiniz.

english: Once you have finished your game you will go back to the challenge room where you can challenge again!
translation: Oyunu bitirdiginizde, tekrar meydan okuma odasina geri dönecek ve tekrar meydan okuyabileceksiniz!

english: What games can I play?
Currently we offer Draughts, Runelink, Runesquares, and Runeversi.
translation: Su anda Dama, Runelink, Runesquares ve Runeversi oyunlari sunuyoruz.

english: Draughts?
Draughts uses standard rules, apart from: a draw is declared if no piece has been taken or promoted for forty moves. To play Draughts go to the challenge room in the SW corner.
translation: Dama, asagidaki durum haric standart kurallara göre oynanir: Kirk hamle boyunca hicbir tas alinmaz veya terfi ettirilmezse beraberlik ilan edilir. Dama oynamak icin güneybati kösesindeki meydan okuma odasina gidin.

english: Runelink?
Yup, you have to get four runes in row. The challenge room for Runelink is in the SE corner.
translation: Evet, dört runu arka arkaya dizmeniz gerekir. Runelink icin meydan okuma odasi güneydogu kösesindedir.

english: Runesquares?
Yes, you take it in turns to add a line with the goal of making squares. Everytime you make a square you take another turn. The challenge room for Runesquares is in the SW corner.
translation: Evet, sirayla kareler olusturmak amaciyla bir cizgi ekliyorsunuz. Her kare olusturdugunuzda bir tur daha oynuyorsunuz. Runesquares icin meydan okuma odasi güneybati kösesinde.

english: Runeversi?
Yep, the aim is to have more of your runes on the board than your opponent. You can take your opponents pieces by trapping them between your own. The challenge room for Runeversi is in the SE corner.
translation: Evet, amac rakibinizden daha fazla runenizi tahtaya yerlestirmek. Rakibinizin taslarini kendi taslarinizla sikistirarak alabilirsiniz. Runeversi icin meydan okuma odasi güneydogu kösesinde.

english: Can I buy a drink please?
Certainly miss, our speciality is Asgarnian Ale, we also serve Wizard's Mind Bomb and Dwarven Stout.
translation: Elbette hanimefendi, spesiyalitemiz Asgarnian Ale, ayrica Wizard's Mind Bomb ve Dwarven Stout da servis ediyoruz.

english: Thanks!
How do I play board games?
What games can I play?
Draughts?
Runelink?
Runesquares?
Runeversi?
Can I buy a drink please?
Thanks!
Hello there, are you interested in buying one of my special capes?
translation: Merhaba, özel pelerinlerimden birini satin almak ister misiniz?

english: What's so special about your capes?

Ahh well they make it less likely that you'll accidently attack anyone wearing the same cape as you and easier to attack everyone else. They also make it easier to distinguish people who're wearing the same cape as you
translation: Ahh, ayni pelerini giyen birine yanlislikla saldirma olasiliginizi azaltir ve diger herkese saldirmanizi kolaylastirir. Ayrica, ayni pelerini giyen kisileri digerlerinden ayirt etmenizi kolaylastirir.

english: from everyone else. They're very useful when out in the wilderness with friends or anyone else you don't want to harm.
translation: Wildernessda arkadaslarinizla veya zarar vermek istemediginiz kisilerle birlikteyken cok kullanislidir. Arkadaslarinizla veya zarar vermek istemediginiz baska kisilerle Wildernessda dolasirken cok kullanislidirlar.

english: So would you like to buy one?
translation: Peki, bir tane satin almak ister misiniz?

english: No thanks.
What's so special about your capes?
Yes please!
No thanks.
Hey you, you here for a reason or do you just like hanging around?
translation: Hey sen, burada bir amac icin mi varsin yoksa sadece takilmak icin mi?

english: I would like to join your crew.
Well you say that now, but I wonder if you can measure up.
translation: Simdi öyle diyorsun ama acaba bu ise uygun musun?

english: Well, for a start off, come and see me when you don't have that thing on your head.
translation: Öncelikle, kafandaki o seyi cikardiginda gel beni gör.

english: Why can't I help out while wearing this?
I need to know you aren't a spy for the other crew, so you'll need to wear a blue bandana.
translation: Diger ekibin casusu olmadigini bilmem gerekiyor, bu yüzden mavi bir bandana takman gerekecek.

english: If you still want to join my crew then go deposit it in the deposit box and come back without anything on your head.
translation: Hala ekibime katilmak istiyorsan, onu emanet kutusuna birak ve kafanda hicbir sey olmadan geri gel.

english: Hah, think that I'm going to assign you the easy tasks eh?
translation: Hah, sana kolay görevler verecegimi mi saniyorsun?

english: What do you mean?
Well, I can see you have some items in your inventory. If you want to join my crew you will need all of it free so you are able to work as hard as everyone else.
translation: Envanterinde bazi esyalar oldugunu görüyorum. Mürettebatima katilmak istiyorsan, digerleri kadar siki calisabilmen icin hepsini bosaltman gerekecek.

english: There is a bank deposit box next to that greasy oaf Jimmy's stall, go and use it and then come back.
translation: Yagli serseri Jimmy'nin tezgahinin yaninda bir banka kasasi var, gidip onu kullan ve sonra geri gel.

english: You seem keen enough, but I have plenty of people on my crew.
translation: Yeterince hevesli görünüyorsun, ama ekibimde yeterince insan var.

english: If that idiot Dan tries to pressgang more pirates I'll be glad to even the numbers out with you though.
translation: Eger o aptal Dan daha fazla korsan zorla ekibe almaya calisirsa, seninle sayilari esitlemek icin seve seve yardim ederim.

english: Ok, fair enough.
That's quite a nice cat. Is it yours?
translation: Cok güzel bir kedi. Senin mi?

english: Yes, why do you ask?
I'm a bit of a cat person myself. That's why I'll have to ask you to leave it outside.
translation: Ben de kedileri severim. Bu yüzden onu disarida birakmani rica etmek zorundayim.

english: There's likely to be quite a lot of stuff going on fire in there, and I don't want to see it get hurt.
translation: Orada pek cok sey yanabilir ve kedinin zarar görmesini istemem.

english: You cannot take your follower into the game.
Heh, ok, well we'll get you sorted out. Welcome to the crew.
translation: Heh, tamam, senin icin bir cözüm buluruz. Ekibe hos geldin.

english: Go wait in the waiting room. I'll call you when we are ready to start.
translation: Bekleme odasinda bekle. Baslamaya hazir oldugumuzda seni cagiririm.

english: Who are you, and what is this place?
Well, well, looks like someone is fresh off the boat and no mistake!
translation: Vay vay, görünüse göre biri gemiden yeni inmis, hic süphe yok!

english: A little while ago we had some real problem shipping 'rum' in the island. The Braindeath crew said it had something to do with zombies and the like.
translation: Kisa bir süre önce adaya “rom” getirmekte ciddi sorunlar yasadik. Braindeath ekibi bunun zombiler ve benzeri seylerle ilgili oldugunu söyledi.

english: All the pirates on the island got together and decided to make our own still, but of course things got a little out of hand, and now we have two.
translation: Adadaki tüm korsanlar bir araya gelip kendi damitma cihazimizi yapmaya karar verdik, ama tabii ki isler biraz cigirindan cikti ve simdi iki tane var.

english: So with two stills you have plenty of 'rum' right?
translation: Iki damitma makinesi varken bol bol romunuz var, degil mi?

english: Well we would do, if that scurvy, whelk-eating foppish dog wouldn't keep trying to burn our still to the ground!
translation: O pis, deniz salyangozu yiyen züppe köpek damitma makinemizi yakmaya calismasaydi, olurdu!

english: I say!
Neither of us can really corner the 'rum' market at the moment, but we are giving it our best shot.
translation: Su anda ikimiz de rom pazarini tekelimize alamiyoruz, ama elimizden geleni yapiyoruz.

english: The code of the island says that we can't attack each other, but after consulting with our fearsome pirate lawyers, we have discovered that destroying each other's property is fine.
translation: Adanin kurallarina göre birbirimize saldiramayiz, ama korkunc korsan avukatlarimizla görüstükten sonra, birbirimizin mülkünü yok etmenin sorun olmadigini ögrendik.

english: Hence, that sniveling, hat-wearing cur keeps trying to burn down my still.
translation: Bu yüzden, o sizlanan, sapka takan köpek damitma cihazimi yakmaya calisip duruyor.

english: Of course he claims I started this whole thing, but who would trust him anyway?
translation: Tabii ki tüm bunlari benim baslattigimi iddia ediyor, ama ona kim inanir ki?

english: Can I help out?
Yes, probably. I have a bunch of jobs that need doing, if you feel up to it.
translation: Evet, muhtemelen. Yapilmasi gereken bir sürü isim var, eger istersen.

english: What would you like to know about?
How do I help you brew 'Rum'?
Well the stills we have set up are based on the ones on Braindeath island... well roughly at any rate.
translation: Kurdugumuz damitma cihazlari Braindeath adasindakine benziyor... en azindan kabaca.

english: All you have to do is help put the ingredients into the hoppers and keep the boilers burning.
translation: Tek yapman gereken malzemeleri haznelere koymak ve kazanlari yakmak.

english: If you add enough ingredients to the hoppers then you have the ability to pick up a single bottle of rum when it brews.
translation: Haznelere yeterince malzeme eklersen, demlendiginde bir sise rom alabilirsin.

english: So, if ye add 5 buckets of water to the hoppers, then ye get access to one bottle. If you add 3 bowls of coloured water you get access to one bottle, and if you add one of anything else you get access to one bottle.
translation: Yani, haznelere 5 kova su eklersen, bir sise alabilirsin. 3 kase renkli su eklersen bir sise alabilirsin, baska herhangi bir sey eklersen bir sise alabilirsin.

english: This is cumulative, meaning that if you add (for example) 10 buckets of water, 3 sweetgrubs and 6 bowls of coloured water, then you have a chance to collect 7 bottles of rum for the team.
translation: Bu birikimlidir, yani (örnegin) 10 kova su, 3 tatli kurtcuk ve 6 kase renkli su eklerseniz, takim icin 7 sise rom toplama sansiniz olur.

english: The boilers are easy as pie to sort out. You just put some logs in, light them with a tinderbox, and then keep putting logs in until they are good and hot.
translation: Kazanlari düzenlemek cok kolaydir. Icine birkac odun koyun, cakmaktasiyla atesleyin ve iyice isinana kadar odun eklemeye devam edin.

english: Three logs should do it, but it's best to keep heaping them in just in case.
translation: Üc odun yeterli olacaktir, ancak her ihtimale karsi odunlari yigmaya devam etmek en iyisidir.

english: The ingredients are; Bitternuts, Scrapey Tree Bark, Sweetgrubs, Buckets of Water and some Coloured Water.
translation: Malzemeler sunlardir: Bitternuts, Scrapey Tree Bark, Sweetgrubs, Buckets of Water ve biraz Coloured Water.

english: Where can I get Bitternuts?
