There are plenty of Bitternut trees inside this walled off area. The problem is that the trees are too tricky for a human to climb.
translation: Bu duvarla cevrili alanda cok sayida Bitternut agaci vardir. Sorun, agaclarin bir insanin tirmanmasi icin cok zor olmasidir.

english: You will need to catch a monkey and send it up the tree to get the nut for you.
translation: Bir maymun yakalayip agaca göndererek findigi almasini saglamalisiniz.

english: Send it up the tree? How does that work?
translation: Agaca göndermek mi? Bu nasil olacak?

english: Well, if you were a monkey, and some random person grabbed you, dumped some dye in your fur and shoved you up a tree, you would hurl the closest heavy object at them too.
translation: Eger bir maymun olsaydiniz ve rastgele birisi sizi yakalayip, kürkünüze boya döküp agaca firlatsaydi, siz de en yakin agir nesneyi ona firlatirdiniz.

english: Wait a second, dye?
Yes, you'll need to get a bowl of coloured water and pour it on the monkey. Otherwise you won't be able to tell which team the monkey belongs too.
translation: Evet, bir kase renkli su alip maymunun üzerine dökmeniz gerekecek. Aksi takdirde maymunun hangi takima ait oldugunu anlayamazsiniz.

english: That makes sense...I think...
Anything else?
Where can I get Scrapey tree bark...and why do I get the feeling I won't like the answer?
translation: Scrapey agac kabugunu nereden bulabilirim... ve neden cevabi begenmeyecegim hissine kapiliyorum?

english: Inside this walled area there are a few Scrapey trees. They are the big, ill looking ones, you can't miss them.
translation: Bu duvarla cevrili alanin icinde birkac Scrapey agaci var. Bunlar büyük, cirkin görünümlü agaclar, gözden kacirmaniz imkansiz.

english: Basically, you cut them down and then carve the bark off with a knife.
translation: Temel olarak, bunlari kesip bicakla kabugunu soyuyorsunuz.

english: It's pretty simple, except the sap tends so make people feel kind off ill if they get any on themselves.
translation: Oldukca basit, ancak özsu insanlara bulastiginda onlari biraz hasta hissettiriyor.

english: How ill?
Don't worry, we aren't talking deadly ill or anything.
translation: Merak etmeyin, ölümcül bir hastaliktan bahsetmiyoruz.

english: It's more like you'll feel quite dizzy and weak for a bit.
translation: Daha cok, bir süre basiniz dönecek ve kendinizi zayif hissedeceksiniz.

english: Joy...
Sweetgrubs? What are they?
Well, lacking any sluglings in the area, we add these little grubs called Sweetgrubs. If you ignore the gag- inducing aftertaste, they are quite sweet.
translation: Bu bölgede sümüklü böcek bulunmadigindan, Sweetgrubs adi verilen bu kücük kurtcuklari ekliyoruz. Tiksindirici tadi görmezden gelirseniz, oldukca tatlidirlar.

english: How... how can you drink this stuff?
Quite easily!
Pirates are renowned as being tough for a reason.
translation: Korsanlar bir nedenden dolayi sert olarak bilinirler.

english: So where do I get these grubs from anyway?
Well, there are a few sweetgrub mounds inside there. We have a handful of rat meat that you can use on the mounds to draw the grubs to the surface.
translation: Iceride birkac sweetgrub yuvasi var. Grublari yüzeye cikarmak icin yuvalarin üzerine kullanabileceginiz bir avuc fare eti var.

english: Mind your fingers though, they are voracious little things.
translation: Parmaklariniza dikkat edin, bunlar cok acgözlü kücük yaratiklar.

english: And here was me thinking that nothing could be more disgusting than Braindeath 'Rum'.
translation: Ben de Braindeath 'Rum'dan daha igrenc bir sey olamaz diye düsünüyordum.

english: Arr, that's where ye'd be wrong [lad/lass], 'cos new, improved Braindeath 'Rum' Classic is now 200% more disgustin' than any leadin' competitor!
translation: Ah, iste burada yaniliyorsun , cünkü yeni, gelistirilmis Braindeath ‘Rum’ Classic artik önde gelen rakiplerinden %200 daha igrenc!

english: Legal disclaimer; the dangerous amount of disgustin' in new Braindeath 'Rum' Classic be too much for pregnant women, donkeys and anyone with more than seven letters in their last name.
translation: Yasal uyari: Yeni Braindeath ‘Rum’ Classic'teki tehlikeli miktarda igrenclik hamile kadinlar, esekler ve soyadinda yedi harften fazla olanlar icin fazla olabilir.

english: What was that?
What was what?
Is there anything else?
How do I get...
Wait, no, that question makes me sound like I haven't a clue what I'm doing.
translation: Dur, hayir, bu soru sanki ne yaptigimi bilmiyormusum gibi gösteriyor.

english: Where can I get buckets in there?
There are a few lying about. Help yourself.
translation: Etrafta birkac tane var. Kendin al.

english: There is a pump in the still, so long as it's working you should have almost unlimited water.
translation: Damitma cihazinda bir pompa var, calistigi sürece neredeyse sinirsiz su alabilirsin.

english: Hold on, do I have to add anything disgusting and/or potential lethal to the water before I pour it in?
translation: Bir dakika, suyu dökmeden önce icine igrenc ve/veya potansiyel olarak ölümcül bir sey eklemem gerekiyor mu?

english: Perish the thought!
Ok, just checking.
What sort of coloured water are we talking about here?
translation: Burada ne tür renkli sudan bahsediyoruz?

english: Well, the other still has an area of waste ground with a flower growing on it. If you go and grab one of the flowers and jam it in the kettle, the water will boil out the colour.
translation: Diger damitma cihazinin yaninda ciceklerin yetistigi bir atik alan var. Oradan bir cicek alip su isiticisina koyarsan, su kaynarken rengini alir.

english: We use the colour to keep our rum easily identifiable.
translation: Rengi, romumuzu kolayca ayirt edebilmek icin kullaniyoruz.

english: So I just empty the kettle into the hopper, right?
translation: Yani su isiticisini hazneye bosaltmam yeterli, degil mi?

english: No, no, you'll need to take an empty bowl and fill it from the kettle.
translation: Hayir, hayir, bos bir kase alip su isiticisindan doldurman gerekiyor.

english: That way you can use the stuff on a monkey if you need to.
Use it on a monkey...of course.
Can I ask about something else?
Ok, what else?
How do I repair the still?
Well, assuming those scurvy dogs have managed to set any of it on fire, then you'll need to tip a bucket of water on it before you can repair it.
translation: Eger o alcaklar onu atese vermisse, tamir etmeden önce üzerine bir kova su dökmen gerekir.

english: Then, it all comes down to what part of it was damaged.
translation: Sonra, hangi kisminin hasar gördügüne bagli.

english: How can I repair hoppers?
Well, assuming that they are not on fire, all you need to do is use the heavy lumber patches. They are big enough to cover most holes.
translation: Eger yanmamislarsa, tek yapman gereken agir kereste yamalari kullanmak. Cogu deligi kapatacak kadar büyükler.

english: Will I need a hammer?
No, just shove it into place and whack it until it lines up.
translation: Hayir, yerine itip hizalanana kadar vurmaniz yeterlidir.

english: How do I repair pipes and the pump?
Well, if you use a pipe section on the damaged part you should be able to replace it easily.
translation: Hasarli kisma bir boru parcasi kullanirsaniz, kolayca degistirebilirsiniz.

english: No, likely you'll just need to whack the old one out and slot the new one in with your hands.
translation: Hayir, muhtemelen eskisini cikarmaniz ve yenisini ellerinizle yerine yerlestirmeniz gerekecektir.

english: How do I repair bridges?
Well, we have these handy bridge sections you can use to repair the bridges.
translation: Köprüleri onarmak icin kullanabileceginiz kullanisli köprü parcalarimiz var.

english: The main problem is, while a still will keep working if a bit of it is only damaged, the bridges are completely out of commission if they are even slightly damaged.
translation: Asil sorun su ki, damitma cihazi bir kismi hasar görse bile calismaya devam ederken, köprüler en ufak bir hasarda bile tamamen kullanilamaz hale geliyor.

english: Is that going to be a problem? I mean, I can jump across I think.
translation: Bu bir sorun olur mu? Yani, sanirim atlayarak gecebilirim.

english: Don't try that! Our lawyers tell us we aren't covered for injuries sustained while jumping over burned bridges.
translation: Bunu denemeyin! Avukatlarimiz, yanmis köprülerin üzerinden atlarken meydana gelen yaralanmalarin sigorta kapsamina girmedigini söylüyor.

english: Seriously, just keep off the bridges until they are fixed.
translation: Cidden, tamir edilene kadar köprülerden uzak durun.

english: Where do I get all this stuff anyway?
We have a load of items already on a table inside the still. You can also make new ones if you grab some logs.
translation: Damitma cihazinin icindeki masada bir sürü malzeme var. Ayrica, biraz odun toplarsan yenilerini de yapabilirsin.

english: How does that work?
We have a work table set up in the still. If you use the logs in it you can craft up a handy replacement for part of the still.
translation: Damitma cihazinda bir calisma masasi var. Oradaki odunlari kullanirsan, damitma cihazinin bir kismi icin kullanisli bir yedek parca yapabilirsin.

english: Don't worry about them fitting, the things are held together by nails, replacement parts and soot by now.
translation: Uyum konusunda endiselenme, parcalar civi, yedek parcalar ve kurumla bir arada tutuluyor.

english: Well...how sanitary...
Ok, I think I've heard enough.
Fine. Glad I could help.
So...how would I go about sabotaging the enemy still?
translation: Peki... düsmanin damitma cihazini nasil sabote edebilirim?

english: Ok, here's what you need to do.
The wood around here is really dry and flammable, so take one of the torches, light it up, and then go and attack the enemy still with it.
translation: Buradaki odunlar cok kuru ve yanici, bu yüzden mesalelerden birini al, yak ve düsmanin damitma cihazina saldir.

english: That's it?
Most of their still is soaked in 'alcohol' and made from tinder dry wood.
translation: Damitma cihazlarinin cogu “alkol” ile islatilmis ve kuru odunlardan yapilmis.

english: Essentially, if it isn't ours, try using a torch on it and see what happens.
translation: Esasen, bizim degilse, üzerinde bir mesale kullan ve ne olacagini gör.

english: Ok, I get you.
So what will you give me for helping out?
translation: Peki, yardim ettigim icin bana ne vereceksin?

english: Hahahaha! What a mercenary attitude! You'll do fine here.
translation: Hahahaha! Ne kadar cikarci bir tavir! Burada basarili olacaksin.

english: Well, for each bottle that your team produces, I'll give you one piece of eight.
translation: Ekibin ürettigi her sise icin sana bir sekizli verecegim.

english: If you manage to set something on fire then I'll toss in another, same for repairing the still.
translation: Bir seyi atese verirsen bir tane daha ekleyecegim, damitma cihazini tamir edersen de aynisi gecerli.

english: What can I use these pieces of eight for?
See Honest Jimmy there? He'll trade you some pretty nice stuff for them.
translation: Suradaki Dürüst Jimmy'yi görüyor musun? Onlarla sana cok güzel seyler verecektir.

english: Great!
Hah!
This minigame is unavailable on this world.
translation: Bu mini oyun bu dünyada mevcut degil.

english: Sorry, I don't take anyone that can't cook.
Why not?
Aside from anything else, if you have less than 40 Cooking, then you don't have much of an idea of health and safety when it comes to food.
translation: Her sey bir yana, Yemek Pisirme becerin 40'in altindaysa, yemeklerle ilgili saglik ve güvenlik konusunda pek bir fikrin yok demektir.

english: Oh yeah, Saradomin forbid that the 'rum' made from whatever is lying around gets a bit of hair in it.
translation: Tabii ya, Saradomin, etrafta bulunan her seyden yapilan “rom”un icine biraz sac karismasini yasaklasin.

english: Anyone lookin' fer work?
Arr! Looking fer good pirates!
Come join me crew!
Don't join them, join us!
Free(ish) rum fer all!
Join the winnin' team now!
Need pirates fer brewin'!
Recruiting!
Roll up, roll up!
We have dental!
I would like to join your crew.
Who are you, and what is this place?
Brewing 'Rum'
Where can I get Bitternuts?
Where can I get Scrapey Tree Bark?
Where can I get Sweetgrubs?
Where can I get buckets of water?
Where can I get coloured water?
Can I ask about something else?
Repairing the Still
How do I repair Hoppers?
How do I repair Pipes and the pump?
How do I repair Bridges?
How do I get repair items
Ok, I think I've heard enough
Sabotaging the Still
What will you pay me?
San Tojalon: Prepare yourself...
San Tojalon will test your mettle.
You have proved yourself of the honour.
San Tojalon: You have proved yourself of the honour.
A chunk of crystal forms mid-air and falls to the floor. You place the crystal chunk into your inventory.
translation: Havada bir kristal parcasi olusur ve yere düser. Kristal parcasini envanterine koyarsin.

english: You have fought the good fight this day.
Prepare yourself...
Good day to you bwana.
Can you ferry me to that island?
Most certainly, but my services come at a price... of 10,000 coins
translation: Elbette, ama hizmetimin bir bedeli var... 10.000 sikke.

english: I don't have that sort of money!
Then you do not belong on my island.
translation: O zaman benim adama ait degilsin.

english: Fine!
Bye bye bwana.
Ok, here's the ridiculous sum of money...
translation: Tamam, iste bu sacma sapan para...

english: Never mind.
Why so much? You'd get more business if you charged less.
translation: Neden bu kadar cok? Daha az ücret alirsan daha cok is yaparsin.

english: The price is to keep the island quiet, bwana. It's a great place to train, but competing with others can be a hassle and so, for a price, you train in peace!
translation: Bunun bedeli, adanin sessizligini korumaktir, bwana. Burasi antrenman yapmak icin harika bir yer, ama digerleriyle rekabet etmek zahmetli olabilir, bu yüzden bir bedel karsiliginda huzur icinde antrenman yapabilirsiniz!

english: Most certainly, but my services come at a price... of 5,000 coins
translation: Elbette, ama hizmetlerimin bir bedeli var... 5.000 sikke.

english: You pay Sandicrahb 5,000 coins and depart for Crabclaw Isle.
translation: Sandicrahb'a 5.000 sikke ödersiniz ve Crabclaw Adasi'na dogru yola cikarsiniz.

english: That's too much for me.
Of course! I won't even charge you for the privilege.
translation: Tabii ki! Bu ayricalik icin sizden ücret bile almayacagim.

english: Sure.
Sandicrahb transports you to Crabclaw Isle for free thanks to your completion of the Kourend & Kebos Medium diary.
translation: Kourend & Kebos Medium günlügünü tamamladiginiz icin Sandicrahb sizi Crabclaw Isle'a ücretsiz olarak götürür.

english: Who are you?
Why bwana, I'm Sandicrahb! I travel far over the ocean from the tropical land of Karamja.
translation: Bwana, ben Sandicrahb! Tropikal Karamja topraklarindan okyanusu asarak buraya geldim.

english: How come you're charging so much?
translation: Neden bu kadar cok ücret aliyorsun?

english: The gold is for a good cause, I promise bwana.
translation: Altin iyi bir amac icin, söz veriyorum bwana.

english: Uh huh, that's a mighty fine gold necklace you have.
translation: Uh huh, cok güzel bir altin kolyen var.

english: Well bwana, of course I take a cut, but the funds keep these beaches clean and tidy, I promise!
translation: Tabii ki bir pay aliyorum bwana, ama bu fonlar bu plajlari temiz ve düzenli tutuyor, söz veriyorum!

english: If you say so...
Good day to you too.
That's a nice boat! Would be a shame if something were to happen to it.
translation: Güzel bir tekne! Ona bir sey olursa cok yazik olur.

english: Made from the wood of the Fyburglars tree, strong and light weight! Perhaps if it went missing, I'd find you.
translation: Fyburglar agacinin odunundan yapilmis, saglam ve hafif! Belki kaybolursa, seni bulurum.

english: Perhaps.
Shall I return you to the beach?
Yes please, I'm done here.
Actually, I've not quite finished yet, I'll stay.
translation: Aslinda, henüz tam olarak bitirmedim, kalacagim.

english: Very well bwana.
Can you ferry me to that island?
Ok, here's the ridiculous sum of money...
translation: Tamam, iste bu sacma sapan para...

english: Never mind.
Why so much? You'd get more business if you charged less.
translation: Neden bu kadar cok? Daha az ücret alirsan daha cok is yaparsin.

english: That's too much for me.
Sure.
Who are you?
Good day to you too.
That's a nice boat!
Yes please, I'm done here.
Actually, I've not quite finished yet, I'll stay.
You look hungry to me. I tell you what - have a [food option] on me.
Hope that fills you up!
Hey, I didn't say you could have that!
I'd best be going - lots more sandwiches to deliver!
translation: Gitsem iyi olacak, teslim etmem gereken daha cok sandvic var!

english: This is for [player name], not you.
translation: Bu Maceraci icin, senin icin degil.

english: Sandwiches, [player name]!
Did you hear me, [player name]?
Sandwich delivery for [player name]!
You think I made these just for fun?!!?
translation: Bunlari sirf eglence icin mi yaptigimi saniyorsun?

english: All types of sandwiches, [player name].
Come on [player name], I made these specially!!
translation: Hadi ama Maceraci, bunlari özel olarak yaptim!!

english: Maybe later.
Hello?
What do ya want for tea? And it better not be a baguette!
translation: Cay icin ne istersin? Baget olmasa iyi olur!.....

english: Don't ignore me, [player name]!
Why won't people talk to me?
I'll beat you up!
Uhh, urr, a sandwich please?
Okay then, my dear! Toodle-oo!
translation: Tamam o zaman, canim! Hosca kal!

english: Nice day for sand isn't it?
translation: Kum icin güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Sand is yellow, Sand is grand, Sand puts money, In my hand!
translation: Kum saridir, kum harikadir, kum parayi getirir, elime!

english: I'm Sandy of Sandy's Sand Corp, are you in the sand business?
translation: Ben Sandy's Sand Corp'tan Sandy, kum isinde misin?

english: Errrr... no.
Then go away!
What can I do for you young 'un?
translation: Senin icin ne yapabilirim genc adam?

english: So... I've heard you druids might be able to teach me herblore...
translation: Sey... Druidlerin bana bitki bilgisi ögretebilecegini duydum...

english: Herblore eh? You're probably best off talking to Kaqemeex about that; he's the best herblore teacher we currently have. I believe at the moment he's at out stone circle just North of here.
translation: Bitki bilgisi mi? Bu konuda Kaqemeex ile konussan iyi olur; o su anda elimizdeki en iyi bitki bilgisi ögretmeni. Sanirim su anda buradan kuzeydeki tas cemberimizde.

english: Thanks.
Actually, I don't need to speak to you.
Well, we all make mistakes sometimes.
Have you any more work for me, to help reclaim the circle?
translation: Cemberi geri kazanmak icin bana verebilecegin baska is var mi?

english: Have you any more work for me, to help reclaim the circle?
translation: Cemberi geri kazanmak icin bana verebilecegin baska is var mi?

english: Not just yet, young 'un.
You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Eadgar's Ruse quest.
translation: Eadgar'in Hilesi görevine baslamak icin gerekli tüm sartlari yerine getirmiyorsun.

english: Actually, I don't need to speak to you.
Have you any more work for me to help reclaim the stone circle?
translation: Cemberi geri kazanmam icin bana verebileceginiz baska bir görev var mi?

english: Ah, you've come just in time. I need a certain herb for the next part of the purification ritual...
translation: Ah, tam zamaninda geldin. Arinma ritüelinin bir sonraki asamasi icin belirli bir bitkiye ihtiyacim var...

english: It used to be quite common, but nowadays only the trolls know where to find it. They use it in their cooking, you see. It's a very prized ingredient.
translation: Eskiden oldukca yaygindi, ama günümüzde sadece troller nerede bulabilecegini biliyor. Onlar bu bitkiyi yemeklerinde kullaniyorlar. Cok degerli bir malzeme.

english: And what exactly do you want me to do?
translation: Peki tam olarak ne yapmami istiyorsun?

english: Journey to the north into the land of the trolls, and find the secret of the herb the trolls call 'goutweed'.
translation: Kuzeye, trollerin ülkesine git ve trollerin “goutweed” adini verdikleri bitkinin sirrini bul.

english: My friend Eadgar lives in the area, and he may be able to help you. Bring some goutweed back and I will teach you something useful.
translation: Arkadasim Eadgar o bölgede yasiyor, sana yardimci olabilir. Biraz goutweed getir, sana yararli bir sey ögreteyim.

english: I'll do it.
Thank you, adventurer!
No thanks.
Oh well. No doubt some other adventurer will eventually come who can help me.
translation: Neyse. Süphesiz baska bir maceraci gelip bana yardim edecektir.

english: Hey there, can you tell me something about this Sanfew Serum, like how do I make it, and what does it do?
translation: Merhaba, bu Sanfew Serumu hakkinda bana biraz bilgi verebilir misin? Nasil yapilir ve ne ise yarar?

english: Certainly. It was after all, my creation, and mine alone. If anyone should know how to make it, it should be me!
translation: Elbette. Sonucta bu benim icadim, sadece benim. Nasil yapildigini bilen biri varsa, o da benim!

english: Can't fault that logic!
translation: Bu mantiga karsi cikmak mümkün degil!

english: Ok, essentially this potion is a mixture of a cure poison, cure disease and restore stats all rolled into one! Very handy for the adventurers with an eye on conserving inventory space.
translation: Tamam, bu iksir temelde zehir tedavisi, hastalik tedavisi ve istatistikleri geri yükleme özelliklerinin hepsini bir arada barindiran bir karisimdir! Envanter alanini korumak isteyen maceracilar icin cok kullanislidir.

english: Ok, I'm sold... How do you make it?

Well, it's very easy really. You take a standard super stat restore potion. Add some ground unicorn horn. Then, add some snake weed from the island of Karamja. Finally, add some nail beast nails. You can
translation: Aslinda cok kolay. Standart bir süper istatistik geri yükleme iksiri al. Biraz ögütülmüs tek boynuzlu at boynuzu ekle. Sonra Karamja adasindan biraz yilan otu ekle. Son olarak, biraz tirnak canavari tirnagi ekle. Bunlari

english: only get these from the area of Morytania, specifically, if you go deep in the Mort Myre swamp.
translation: sadece Morytania bölgesinden, özellikle Mort Myre batakliginin derinliklerinden elde edebilirsin.

english: How do you mean, deep into the Mort Myre swamp?
translation: Mort Myre batakliginin derinlikleri ne demek?

english: Well, most adventurers avoid the deep Mort Myre swamp, whereas the Paterdomus trek and the Burgh de Rott trek take you through the most interesting areas. These area's often allow the quickest, but potentially
translation: Cogu maceraci Mort Myre batakliginin derinliklerinden kacinirken, Paterdomus ve Burgh de Rott yürüyüsleri sizi en ilginc bölgelerden gecirir. Bu bölgeler genellikle Mort Myre'den gecmek icin en hizli, ancak potansiyel olarak

english: more dangerous routes through Mort Myre. This is where you're likely to encounter a Nail beast.
translation: daha tehlikeli rotalardir. Burasi tirnak canavariyla karsilasma olasiliginizin en yüksek oldugu yerdir.

english: Are they very dangerous?

They can be pretty dangerous. They'll defend for a long time, then attack suddenly and seemingly without warning, landing three visciousattacks at once. This can be pretty lethal. However, the nail beasts themselves
translation: Oldukca tehlikeli olabilirler. Uzun süre savunma yaparlar, sonra aniden ve görünüste uyari vermeden saldirirlar ve bir seferde üc siddetli saldiri yaparlar. Bu oldukca ölümcül olabilir. Ancak, civi canavarlari

english: are curiously wounded from the Sanfew Serum itself...very bizzare,that a potion made from their claws should have such a pronounced effect on them.
translation: Sanfew Serumundan garip bir sekilde yaralanirlar... Cok tuhaf, onlarin pencelerinden yapilan bir iksirin onlar üzerinde bu kadar belirgin bir etkisi olmasi.

english: Ok, that's very helpful. Many thanks for your assistance.
translation: Tamam, bu cok yardimci oldu. Yardiminiz icin cok tesekkürler.

english: Did you say you needed more goutweed?
translation: Daha fazla gut otu ihtiyacin oldugunu mu söyledin?

english: I don't need any more goutweed for the ritual, but it's still quite difficult for me to get. If you ever come across some, bring it to me; I'll exchange it for some other herbs.
translation: Ritüel icin daha fazla gut otuna ihtiyacim yok, ama yine de bulmasi oldukca zor. Eger bulursan bana getir, baska otlarla takas ederim.

english: Well, not right now I don't think young 'un. In fact, I need to make some more preparations myself for the ritual. Rest assured, if I need any more help I will ask you again.
translation: Su anda yok sanirim genc adam. Aslinda, ritüel icin kendim de biraz daha hazirlik yapmam gerekiyor. Merak etme, yardima ihtiyacim olursa sana tekrar sorarim.

english: I've heard you druids might be able to teach me herblore.
translation: Druidlerin bana bitki bilgisi ögretebilecegini duydum.

english: Ask about Sanfew Serum.
Ask general questions.
Yes.
No.
Did you say you needed more goutweed?
translation: Daha fazla goutweed'e ihtiyacin oldugunu mu söyledin?

english: Good day to you, Bwana.
Can I go through that door please?
Most certainly, you have already given me lots of nice coins.
translation: Elbette, bana zaten cok güzel paralar verdin.

english: Most certainly, but I must charge you the sum of 875 coins first.
translation: Elbette, ama önce senden 875 para almaliyim.

english: I haven't got that much money with me.
I'll want 875 coins to let you enter; this is a dungeon for the more wealthy discerning adventurer. Begone with you, riff raff.
translation: Girmen icin 875 para istiyorum; burasi daha zengin ve secici maceracilar icin bir zindan. Defol git, serseri.

english: Okay, here's 875 coins.
Many thanks. You may now pass the door. May your death be a glorious one!
translation: Cok tesekkürler. Artik kapidan gecebilirsin. Ölümün serefli olsun!

english: Why is it worth the entry cost?
translation: Giris ücreti neden bu kadar yüksek?

english: It leads to a huge fearsome dungeon, populated by giants and strange dogs. Adventurers come from all around to explore its depths.
translation: Devler ve garip köpeklerin yasadigi devasa ve korkunc bir zindana aciliyor. Maceracilar, derinliklerini kesfetmek icin her yerden geliyorlar.

english: I know not what lies deeper in myself, for my skills in agility and woodcutting are inadequate, but I hear tell of even greater dangers deeper in.
translation: Benim becerilerim yetersiz oldugu icin daha derinlerde ne oldugunu bilmiyorum, ama daha derinlerde daha büyük tehlikeler oldugunu duydum.

english: Can I pay you for permanent access?
translation: Sana kalici erisim icin ödeme yapabilir miyim?

english: I suppose so, yes. My employer will let you in for free, forever, in exchange for 1,000,000 coins.
translation: Sanirim evet. Isverenim 1.000.000 sikke karsiliginda seni sonsuza kadar ücretsiz olarak iceri alacaktir.

english: I haven't got 1,000,000 coins with me.
Then perhaps you would rather pay 875 coins for one visit.
translation: O zaman belki de bir ziyaret icin 875 sikke ödemek istersiniz.

english: Okay, here's 1,000,000 coins.
Many thanks. You may now pass the door as many times as you wish, and I will not charge you again. May your death be a glorious one!
translation: Cok tesekkürler. Artik kapidan istediginiz kadar gecebilirsiniz, sizden tekrar ücret almayacagim. Ölümünüz serefli olsun!

english: Never mind.
Where does this strange entrance lead?
To a huge fearsome dungeon, populated by giants and strange dogs. Adventurers come from all around to explore its depths.
translation: Devler ve garip köpeklerin yasadigi devasa ve korkutucu bir zindana. Maceracilar, derinliklerini kesfetmek icin her yerden geliyorlar.

english: I know not what lies deeper in myself, for my skills in agility and woodcutting are inadequate.
translation: Benim becerilerim yetersiz oldugu icin, daha derinde ne oldugunu bilmiyorum.

english: I'm impressed, that tree is growing on that shed.
translation: Etkilendim, o agac kulübenin üzerinde büyüyor.

english: My employer tells me it is an uncommon sort of tree called the Fyburglars tree.
translation: Isverenim, bunun Fyburglars agaci adinda nadir bir agac türü oldugunu söyledi.

english: Good day to you too.
You have already given me lovely coins, so you may go in, and may your death be a glorious one!
translation: Bana zaten güzel paralar verdin, iceri girebilirsin, ölümün serefli olsun!

english: Okay, thanks.
You have already given me lots of nice coins, you may go in.
translation: Bana zaten cok güzel paralar verdin, iceri girebilirsin.

english: You're not done yet! Do this for me!
translation: Henüz isin bitmedi! Bunu benim icin yap!

english: My guard dogs can do puzzles better than that!
translation: Bekci köpeklerim bile bundan daha iyi bulmaca cözüyor!

english: Excellent work!
Can I go through that door please?
I haven't got that much money with me.
Can I pay you for permanent access?
translation: Kalici erisim icin ödeme yapabilir miyim?

english: Okay, here's 875 coins.
Why is it worth the entry cost?
translation: Giris ücreti neden bu kadar pahali?

english: Never mind.
Okay, here's 1,000,000 coins.
Where does this strange entrance lead?
I'm impressed, that tree is growing on that shed.
translation: Etkilendim, o agac kulübenin üzerinde büyüyor.

english: Good day to you too.
Yes
No
Pay 875 coins to enter once
translation: Bir kez girmek icin 875 jeton ödeyin.

english: Pay 1,000,000 coins for permanent access
Cancel
Okay, thanks.
Hello Santa, long time no see!
translation: Merhaba Noel Baba, uzun zaman oldu!

english: Ho Ho Hello [player name], it certainly has been a long time.
translation: Ho Ho Merhaba Maceraci, gercekten uzun zaman oldu.

english: Quick question, why are you hanging out with a bunch of angry children?
translation: Kisa bir soru, neden bir grup kizgin cocukla takiliyorsun?

english: Christmas is ruined! My son, Jack Frost, has messed it all up!
translation: Noel mahvoldu! Oglum Jack Frost her seyi mahvetti!

english: I put him in charge of this year's Christmas to learn some much needed responsibility.
translation: Ona bu yilki Noel'i yönetme görevini verdim, böylece cok ihtiyac duydugu sorumluluk duygusunu ögrenebilsin diye.

english: All he does is sit at home, eating my mince pies, drinking my eggnog and throwing snowballs at my elves.
translation: Ama tek yaptigi evde oturup mince pies'imi yemek, eggnog'umu icmek ve elflerime kartopu atmak.

english: So why has that caused a problem with the Gingerbread Gnomes?
translation: Peki bu neden Gingerbread Gnomes ile bir sorun yaratti?

english: A major part of my job is overseeing Gingerbread Gnome production here in Varrock. I like to... ensure production is top quality... and do some taste testing from time to time.
translation: Isimin büyük bir kismi Varrock'ta Gingerbread Gnome üretimini denetlemek. Üretimin en yüksek kalitede olmasini saglamak ve zaman zaman tat testleri yapmak hosuma gidiyor.

english: As soon as he stepped in, production came to a stand still. I need my Gingerbread Gnomes, it's part of my balanced diet.
translation: O devreye girer girmez üretim durdu. Zencefilli kurabiyelerime ihtiyacim var, dengeli beslenmemin bir parcasi.

english: So why don't you go help him out instead of standing around Varrock?
translation: O zaman neden Varrock'ta durup durmak yerine gidip ona yardim etmiyorsun?

english: I'm trying a new parenting technique, he needs to learn from his mistakes.
translation: Yeni bir ebeveynlik teknigi deniyorum, hatalarindan ders almasi gerekiyor.

english: But in the mean time, could you go and have a word with him? The bakery is south of the Apothecary here in Varrock.
translation: Ama bu arada, gidip onunla konusabilir misin? Firin, Varrock'ta eczanenin güneyinde.

english: Great, now this is my problem, thanks Santa.
translation: Harika, simdi bu benim sorunum oldu, tesekkürler Noel Baba.

english: Have you managed to solve the problem at the Bakery yet?
In case you forgot, the bakery is just south of the Apothecary here in Varrock.
translation: Unuttuysan, firin Varrock'ta eczanenin hemen güneyinde.

english: I'm still working on it.
Hurry it along would you, I'm getting quite hungry.
Hello again Santa.
Ho Ho Hello [player name], have you managed to sort out my son?
translation: Ho Ho Merhaba Maceraci, oglumu halledebildin mi?

english: Not yet, I found the bakery and it appears Jack has thrown a tantrum....
translation: Henüz degil, firini buldum ve Jack bir kriz gecirmis gibi görünüyor...

english: Oh dear, what has he done?
Well he's locked the bakers up and brought in an Icelord.
translation: Firincilari kilitleyip bir Buz Lordu getirmis.

english: One of the bakers managed to escape and is outside.
translation: Firincilardan biri kacmayi basarmis ve disarida.

english: Where did I go wrong... Jack used to be such a happy young boy.
translation: Nerede hata yaptim... Jack eskiden cok mutlu bir cocuktu.

english: Looks like I'm going to need to step in if we're going to save Christmas.
translation: Noel'i kurtarmak icin müdahale etmem gerekecek gibi görünüyor.

english: Great! So you're going to go and talk to him?
Ho Ho Ho, of course not [player name], I've got a better idea.
translation: Ho Ho Ho, tabii ki hayir Maceraci, daha iyi bir fikrim var.

english: Fantastic... and that is?
You're going to bring Anti-Santa to sort him out, Jack is terrified of him.
translation: Onu halletmesi icin Anti-Noel Baba'yi getireceksin, Jack ondan cok korkuyor.

english: Anti-Santa?! No way am I freeing him after all that work a few years ago.
translation: Anti-Noel Baba mi?! Birkac yil önceki onca cabadan sonra onu serbest birakmam mümkün degil.

english: Don't you think I know that! We have no choice I'm afraid.
translation: Bunu bilmedigimi mi saniyorsun! Korkarim baska secenegimiz yok.

english: I'm sure we can come up with something better than freeing him.
translation: Onu serbest birakmaktan daha iyi bir cözüm bulabilecegimize eminim.

english: Well if you have a better idea, spit it out.
translation: Daha iyi bir fikrin varsa, söyle bakalim....

english: Thought so, now I'm going to need you to free him from his prison in ScapeRune.
translation: Tahmin ettigim gibi, simdi onu ScapeRune'daki hapishanesinden kurtarmani istiyorum.

english: How am I going to do that? Evil Bob took him away....
translation: Bunu nasil yapacagim? Evil Bob onu götürdü...

english: Yes, but we don't need Evil Bob's help this time, I can teleport you into his cell.
translation: Evet, ama bu sefer Evil Bob'un yardimina ihtiyacimiz yok, seni onun hücresine isinlayabilirim.

english: You'll still need to convince him to help us though.
translation: Yine de onu bize yardim etmesi icin ikna etmen gerekecek.

english: Anti-Santa? Never heard of him, sound'slike an edgy version of you.
translation: Anti-Noel Baba mi? Hic duymadim, senin gergin bir versiyonun gibi geliyor.

english: He certainly has his... unique aspects to his personality.
translation: Kisiliginde kesinlikle... kendine özgü yönleri var.

english: But he'll be very useful for scaring Jack. There aren't many things Jack's afraid of, but that giant skeleton is one of them.
translation: Ama Jack'i korkutmak icin cok yararli olacak. Jack'in korktugu pek cok sey yok, ama o dev iskelet onlardan biri.

english: Where can I find Anti-Santa? I've never come across him in my travels.
translation: Anti-Noel Baba'yi nerede bulabilirim? Seyahatlerimde hic rastlamadim.

english: A few years ago, Evil Bob locked him away in ScapeRune.
translation: Birkac yil önce, Evil Bob onu ScapeRune'da hapsetti.

english: Great, I'm sure if we wait long enough, Evil Bob will appear out of nowhere....
translation: Harika, yeterince beklersek, Evil Bob birdenbire ortaya cikacaktir...

english: We don't have time for that, he trusted me to look after him. Evil Bob was tired of dealing with his dirty laundry.
translation: Bunun icin vaktimiz yok, bana onu korumam icin güvendi. Evil Bob onun kirli camasirlariyla ugrasmaktan bikmisti.

english: I'll teleport you right into his cell, you're going to need to convince him to help us.
translation: Seni onun hücresine isinlayacagim, onu bize yardim etmesi icin ikna etmen gerekecek.

english: Surely he'll still be angry about last time?
translation: Eminim gecen seferki olaydan dolayi hala kizgindir?

english: Most likely, but if you tell him that I'm considering setting him free, he'll change his tune.
translation: Büyük olasilikla, ama ona onu serbest birakmayi düsündügümü söylersen, fikrini degistirir.

english: Take this as well. After you've convinced him to help, you can use this to teleport both of you to the bakery.
translation: Bunu da al. Onu yardim etmeye ikna ettikten sonra, bunu kullanarak ikinizi firina isinlayabilirsin.

english: You've got too much on you, come back when you've got some free space.
translation: Üzerinde cok fazla sey var, biraz bos alan actiginda geri gel.

english: Santa gives you a teleport tablet to teleport you to the bakery.
translation: Noel Baba, seni firina isinlamak icin bir isinlanma tableti verir.

english: Ah [player name], you've returned, have you managed to sort out the bakery?
translation: Ah Maceraci, geri dönmüssün, firini halledebildin mi?

english: Hello again Santa, yes I've managed to sort out the bakery and stop your son.
translation: Merhaba Noel Baba, evet firini halledip oglunu durdurmayi basardim.

english: Ho Ho Ho, that's perfect and what of the Anti-Santa?
translation: Ho Ho Ho, bu harika, peki Anti-Noel Baba ne oldu?

english: Uhm... well... there was a slight problem when we returned from ScapeRune.
translation: Sey... ScapeRune'dan döndügümüzde ufak bir sorun cikti.

english: What happened?
He sort of beat up Jack then escaped when Jack fled.
translation: Jack'i dövdü ve Jack kacarken o da kacti.

english: Uh... that wasn't supposeto happen. Do you know where they went?
translation: Uh... bu olmamaliydi. Nereye gittiklerini biliyor musun?

english: I'm afraid not, Jack teleported out and Anti-Santa followed him.
translation: Korkarim bilmiyorum, Jack isinlandi ve Anti-Noel Baba onu takip etti.

english: That's going to come back and bite me in the future... Oh well, problem for another year I suppose, did you manage to make any Gingerbread Gnomes for me?
translation: Bu gelecekte basima bela olacak... Neyse, sanirim bir yil daha sorun olacak, benim icin zencefilli kurabiye cüceleri yapabildin mi?

english: I'm afraid I didn't, although I do have this giant one I used to protect myself from the Icelord, the bakers are going to use the Icelord from now on to ice their gnomes.
translation: Maalesef yapamadim, ama kendimi Icelord'dan korumak icin kullandigim devasa bir tane var, firincilar bundan sonra cücelerini buzlamak icin Icelord'u kullanacaklar.

english: Oh, that wouldn't be edible at all, Icelord saliva isn't safe to eat, you better keep that one and maybe go tell the bakers later as well.
translation: Oh, o hic yenilebilir olmaz, Icelord'un salyasi yemek icin güvenli degil, onu saklasan iyi olur ve belki daha sonra firincilara da söylersin.

english: Ho Ho Ho, well thank you for all your help this year [player name], I'm sure I'll see you again soon.
translation: Ho Ho Ho, bu yilki yardimlarin icin tesekkürler Maceraci, eminim yakinda tekrar görüsürüz.

english: Yeah... looking forward to it....
Why are you still here?
Ho Ho Ho, I'm still waiting for the delivery to come in!
translation: Ho Ho Ho, hâlâ teslimatin gelmesini bekliyorum!

english: I'll leave you to it then.
Well hello there [player name].
Hello.
What can I do for you on this fine winter day?
translation: Bu güzel kis gününde senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: I was hoping to enter into your festive games!
Ah, splendid! Another contender.
Now I must warn you, the games will put you to the test. They may even break you.
translation: Sunu söylemeliyim ki, oyunlar seni sinayacak. Hatta seni yikabilirler.

english: Failing the games will put you on the Naughty List until the end of time.
translation: Oyunlarda basarisiz olursan, sonsuza kadar Yaramazlar Listesi'ne girersin.

english: Do you accept these conditions?
Uh... I guess so.
Excellent!
Santa tells you your game time.
translation: Noel Baba sana oyun saatini söyler.

english: Thanks! Can I also ask a favour?
It depends, have you been nice this year?
translation: Duruma bagli, bu yil uslu muydun?

english: Absolutely.
Very well, I trust you. What do you desire?
A Gilded Scimitar.
A Twisted Bow.
Wait no... Sorry ignore that. Instinct kicked in.
translation: Dur, hayir... Pardon, bunu dikkate almayin. Icgüdülerim devreye girdi.

english: Could I get another entry time? My friend has been caught up re-homing lost kittens and would love a chance to enter the games.
translation: Baska bir katilim zamani alabilir miyim? Arkadasim kayip kedileri yeni evlere yerlestirmeye calisirken yakalandi ve oyunlara katilmak icin bir sans istiyor.

english: What a delightful friend you have there. Of course.
translation: Ne kadar hos bir arkadasin var. Tabii ki.

english: Santa tells you Guss' game time.
translation: Noel Baba sana Guss'in oyun zamanini söyler.

english: My time and my friend's time are different?
translation: Benim zamanim ve arkadasimin zamani farkli mi?

english: That's the rules I'm afraid, we can't have any funny business going on.
translation: Korkarim kurallar böyle, hileye yer yok.

english: Oh uh... Fair enough.
Your game time is coming up, better get ready!
I'll be back in a jiffy. I just need to chat to my... friend.
translation: Hemen dönerim. Sadece arkadasimla konusmam lazim.

english: Before you go in, you'll need to solve a Christmas riddle...
translation: Girmeden önce, bir Noel bilmecesini cözmen gerekiyor...

english: Oh gosh.
What was that?
It's nothing sorry. Speaking to myself.
translation: Önemli degil, özür dilerim. Kendi kendime konusuyordum.

english: So, on to the riddle...
What do you get when you meet a vampyre in the winter?
translation: Kisin bir vampirle karsilastiginda ne olur?

english: Killed.
A nice seafood dinner for two.
translation: Iki kisilik güzel bir deniz ürünleri yemegi.

english: Frostbite.
Ho Ho oh no, that's not quite right... How about this one? I'm feeling kind today.
translation: Ho Ho oh hayir, bu pek dogru degil... Peki ya bu? Bugün nazik hissediyorum.

english: I am a plant seen every Christmas which people hang up above, they stand beneath me and kiss someone they love.
translation: Her Noel'de görülen, insanlarin üstüme astigi, altinda durup sevdiklerini öptügü bir bitkiyim.

english: Mistletoe.
Wreath.
Stocking.
Gosh you really want to enter these games after failing two easy riddles?
translation: Tanrim, iki kolay bilmeceyi cözemeden bu oyunlara katilmak mi istiyorsun?

english: They're gonna eat you alive in there, but best of luck!
translation: Seni orada canli canli yiyecekler, ama iyi sanslar!

english: Ho ho happy days! Well done that's the right answer.
translation: Ho ho mutlu günler! Aferin, dogru cevap.

english: You may now enter into the Festive Games!
I'll bring you out a beer when Guss wins!
Guss??
I mean when I win, ha ha. Slip of the tongue.
translation: Yani ben kazandigimda, ha ha. Dilim sürctü.

english: Would you like to enter the games?
I'll enter soon, there's just something I need to do.
translation: Yakinda katilacagim, sadece yapmam gereken bir sey var.

english: I'll be here all Christmas.
Amazing job in the games [player name], you and Guss really made a great show.
translation: Oyunlarda harika is cikardin Maceraci, sen ve Guss gercekten harika bir gösteri yaptiniz.

english: You... saw?
I see all.
You really think I didn't see yours and Guss's little plan?
translation: Sen ve Guss'in kücük planinizi görmedigimi mi saniyorsun?

english: I don't think I've ever seen such dedication to The Nutcracker from anyone. Guss earned it.
translation: Hic kimseyi Findikkiran'a bu kadar bagli görmemistim. Guss bunu hak etti.

english: Guss thinks they're on the naughty list! I can't wait to tell them.
translation: Guss onlarin yaramazlar listesinde oldugunu düsünüyor! Onlara söylemek icin sabirsizlaniyorum.

english: I'm afraid that'll have to be our little secret [player name].
translation: Korkarim bu bizim kücük sirrimiz olacak Maceraci.

english: Oh crumbs.
Have a happy holidays [player name]!
Yes
No
Hello there.
Ho Ho HoMerry Xmas, [player name]! Have you been a good [boy/girl] this year?
translation: Ho Ho HoMutlu Noeller, Maceraci! Bu yil uslu biri oldun mu?

english: Yes I have, Santa!
Ho Ho HoThen take this present, and have a merry Xmas!
translation: Ho Ho HoO zaman bu hediyeyi al ve mutlu Noeller!

english: Ho Ho HoIf you lose your yo-yo, don't forget you can get a replacement from Diango in Draynor!
translation: Ho Ho Ho Yo-yo'nu kaybedersen, Draynor'daki Diango'dan yenisini alabilecegini unutma!

english: I lost my Yo-yo Santa...
Ho Ho HoYou've already had your Xmas present this year!
translation: Ho Ho Ho Bu yil Noel hediyeni coktan aldin!

english: Ho Ho HoThen you may have another!Don't forget you can get your Yo-yo returned from Diango in Draynor!
translation: Ho Ho Ho O zaman bir tane daha alabilirsin! Draynor'daki Diango'dan yo-yo'nu geri alabilecegini unutma!

english: Merry Xmas!
Come talk to Santa!
I love Xmas
Ho Ho Ho
Hello [player name]!
Hello.
So, you want to be on the Nice List huh?
translation: Demek iyi cocuklar listesine girmek istiyorsun, ha?

english: If that's what it takes to get into that pub, absolutely.
translation: Eger o bara girmek icin gerekliyse, tabii ki.

english: That's the spirit.
So let me tell you about the first game.
translation: O zaman sana ilk oyunu anlatayim.

english: There are other non-player ch... I mean competitors in here, who will also be trying to offload their coal.
translation: Burada baska oyuncular da var... Yani rakipler de var, onlar da kömürlerini bosaltmaya calisacaklar.

english: Simply pick up the coal and hand it out to your opponents to eliminate them.
translation: Kömürü al ve rakiplerine vererek onlari eleme.

english: The large piles contain 40 pieces of coal. The small piles contain 20 pieces of coal.
translation: Büyük yiginlarda 40 parca kömür var. Kücük yiginlarda ise 20 parca kömür var.

english: Be careful not to carry too much or you might get caught out and eliminated.
translation: Cok fazla tasimamaya dikkat et, yoksa yakalanip elenebilirsin.

english: Are you ready to start the first game?
Yes.
I think I want to take a look around first.
Fair enough, I'll be waiting!
Congrats on winning the game! You've done a smashing job!
translation: Oyunu kazandigin icin tebrikler! Harika bir is cikardin!

english: Come and speak to me when you're ready to advance to the next game.
translation: Bir sonraki oyuna gecmeye hazir oldugunda gelip benimle konus.

english: A riddle.
Their body is round, with a carrot for a nose. They love to be cold, from their head to their toes.
translation: Vücutlari yuvarlaktir ve burunlari havuc seklindedir. Baslarindan ayak parmaklarina kadar sogugu severler.

english: Reindeer.
Snow angel.
Witch.
That's not quite right, I'm afraid.
Snowman?
Brilliant! On to the next challenge!
Amazing job in my game [player name].
translation: Oyunumda harika bir is cikardin Maceraci.

english: Thanks!
Do you enjoy being a host in these games?
translation: Bu oyunlarda sunucu olmak hosuna gidiyor mu?

english: It's jolly good fun. Part of me wishes I could join in.
translation: Cok eglenceli. Bir yanim da katilabilmeyi diliyor.

english: Do you get anything for being a host?
translation: Sunucu olmak sana bir sey kazandiriyor mu?

english: A free pass onto the Nice List!
translation: Iyi Cocuklar Listesi'ne ücretsiz giris hakki!

english: Plus I'm very judgemental so the job is quite fitting.
translation: Ayrica cok yargilayici biriyim, bu yüzden bu is bana cok uygun.

english: What's your story?
Well, before all this I was a Judge in a very prestigious court.
translation: Bütün bunlar olmadan önce cok prestijli bir mahkemede yargictim.

english: That's very fitting.
Indeed.
I loved all the opportunities to help people in Gielinor.
translation: Gielinor'daki insanlara yardim etme firsatlarini cok seviyordum.

english: Alas, that was a long time ago. I've since passed away.
translation: Ne yazik ki, bu cok uzun zaman önceydi. O zamandan beri vefat ettim.

english: Wait, you're dead?
Oh we all are here! Santa gave us the opportunity to stay here in this sanctuary.
translation: Oh, hepimiz buradayiz! Noel Baba bize bu siginakta kalma firsati verdi.

english: But you don't look particularly ghostly, or zombie-like?
translation: Ama sen pek hayalet ya da zombi gibi görünmüyorsun?

english: That's just the thing, while we are in here we can keep our mortal body with Santa's magic.
translation: Mesele de bu, burada oldugumuz sürece Noel Baba'nin büyüsüyle ölümlü bedenlerimizi koruyabiliyoruz.

english: Amazing, but also kind of scary at the same time.
translation: Inanilmaz, ama ayni zamanda biraz da korkutucu.

english: Where did you think the ghosts of Christmas past, present and future go?
translation: Gecmis, simdiki ve gelecekteki Noel hayaletleri nereye gitti sence?

english: To the pub of course!
Do you happen to know if I'm on the Naughty List or Nice List?
translation: Benim yaramazlar listesinde miyim, uslu cocuklar listesinde miyim biliyor musun?

english: Let me see...
The scribe twists round to look on her back.
Looks like you are on the...
Naughty List... That's unfortunate.
Nice List! Congratulations.
Happy Holidays!
You too [player name].
No.
Snowman.
Do you enjoy being a festive game host?
translation: Bayram oyun sunucusu olmak hosuna gidiyor mu?

english: Am I on the nice list?
Happy Holidays!
Welcome, human, to the Quality Weapons Shop! Can I interest you in a purchase?
translation: Hos geldin insan, Kaliteli Silah Dükkani'na! Satin almak ister misin?

english: Yes, I'm looking for some weapons.
No thanks.
Yes, I'm looking for some weapons.
No thanks.
For Saradomin!
Hey there, what's this all about?
Our Lord Saradomin needs your help!
Oh great, what is it this time?
You're needed at Castle Wars, our forces are weakening and we need you as reinforcements.
translation: Castle Wars'ta sana ihtiyacimiz var, güclerimiz zayifliyor ve takviye olarak sana ihtiyacimiz var.

english: Sure, I'll play some Castle Wars.
Praise Saradomin, I'll send you there right away!
translation: Saradomin'e sükürler olsun, seni hemen oraya gönderecegim!

english: Some items are stopping you from entering the Castle Wars waiting room. See the chat for details.
translation: Bazi ögeler Castle Wars bekleme odasina girmeni engelliyor. Ayrintilar icin sohbete bak.

english: Hmm, I'm alright actually, I don't want to play Castle Wars right now.
translation: Hmm, aslinda ben iyiyim, su anda Castle Wars oynamak istemiyorum.

english: I urge you to reconsider, before it's too late.
translation: Cok gec olmadan tekrar düsünmeni tavsiye ederim.

english: Sorry, you can't play Castle Wars on this world. Try world 334 for the official world.
translation: Üzgünüm, bu dünyada Castle Wars oynayamazsin. Resmi dünya icin 334 numarali dünyayi dene.

english: Fight for the greater good today!
translation: Bugün daha büyük bir iyilik icin savas!

english: Fight for Saradomin today!
The light of Saradomin is fading, he needs your help!
translation: Saradomin'in isigi sönüyor, senin yardimina ihtiyaci var!

english: Zamorak is a false god who is a stain on this world, Saradomin will guide you forward.
translation: Zamorak bu dünyayi lekeleyen sahte bir tanridir, Saradomin sizi ileriye götürecektir.

english: Yes.
No.
Hello. How can I help you?
What are you selling?
Can you give me any Farming advice?
translation: Bana tarimla ilgili tavsiyelerde bulunabilir misiniz?

english: Yes - ask a gardener.
Can you tell me how to use the loom?
translation: Dokuma tezgahini nasil kullanacagimi söyleyebilir misiniz?

english: Well, it's actually my loom, but I don't mind you using it, if you like. You can use it to weave sacks and baskets in which you can put vegetables and fruit.
translation: Aslinda bu benim dokuma tezgahim, ama isterseniz kullanabilirsiniz. Sebze ve meyveleri koyabileceginiz cuvallar ve sepetler dokumak icin kullanabilirsiniz.

english: What do I need to weave sacks?
translation: Cuvallar dokumak icin neye ihtiyacim var?

english: Well, the best sacks are made with jute fibres; you can grow jute yourself in a hops patch. I'd say about 4 jute fibres should be enough to weave a sack.
translation: En iyi cuvallar jüt liflerinden yapilir; jütü kendiniz bir serbetciotu tarlasinda yetistirebilirsiniz. Bir cuval dokumak icin yaklasik 4 jüt lifi yeterli olacaktir.

english: Thank you, that's very kind.
What do I need to weave baskets?
translation: Sepetler dokumak icin neye ihtiyacim var?

english: Well, the best baskets are made with young branches cut from a willow tree. You'll need a very young willow tree; otherwise, the branches will have grown too thick to be able to weave. I suggest growing your own.
translation: En iyi sepetler, sögüt agacindan kesilen genc dallarla yapilir. Cok genc bir sögüt agacina ihtiyaciniz olacak; aksi takdirde dallar dokumak icin cok kalinlasmis olacaktir. Kendi agacinizi yetistirmenizi öneririm.

english: You can cut the branches with a standard pair of secateurs. You will probably need about 6 willow branches to weave a complete basket.
translation: Dallari standart bir budama makasiyla kesebilirsiniz. Tam bir sepet dokumak icin muhtemelen yaklasik 6 sögüt dalina ihtiyaciniz olacak.

english: I'm okay, thank you.
I've come about the bounty.
Oh thank Saradomin! It's about time someone responded, something needs to be done!
translation: Oh, Saradomin'e sükürler olsun! Artik birinin cevap vermesi gerekiyordu, bir seyler yapilmali!

english: Can you explain what happened?
Of course. I was making my monthly delivery to The Sheared Ram in Lumbridge, heading east near the Draynor Village crossroads.
translation: Tabii ki. Lumbridge'deki The Sheared Ram'a aylik teslimatimi yapiyordum, Draynor Köyü kavsaginin yakininda doguya dogru gidiyordum.

english: Suddenly, out of the trees came a hulking monster! It chased me for a short distance, but luckily Rosie managed to spook it enough to give me a headstart.
translation: Aniden, agaclarin arasindan devasa bir canavar cikti! Beni kisa bir mesafe kovaladi, ama sans eseri Rosie onu yeterince korkutup bana bir avantaj sagladi.

english: Sounds like it must have given you quite the scare!
It certainly did. I even lost my cart full of farm produce!
translation: Kesinlikle öyle. Hatta ciftlik ürünleriyle dolu arabami bile kaybettim!

english: What did this monster look like?
I didn't get a very good look at it I'm afraid. It was getting dark and as soon as I saw it charging at me, I ran.
translation: Maalesef cok iyi göremedim. Hava kararmaya baslamisti ve bana saldirdigini görür görmez kactim.

english: I can still hear the sound, though. A horrible grunting... squealing...
translation: Ama sesini hala duyabiliyorum. Korkunc bir homurtu... ciyaklama...

english: Is there anything else you wanted?
Any tips on finding this thing?
translation: Bu seyi bulmak icin herhangi bir ipucu var mi?

english: Tips...? You're supposed to be the professional monster slayer!
translation: Ipucu mu...? Sen profesyonel canavar avcisi olmalisin!

english: Although, I suppose a good place to start would be checking the area I was attacked. See if you can find the remains of my cart.
translation: Yine de, baslamak icin iyi bir yer, saldiriya ugradigim bölgeyi kontrol etmek olabilir. Arabamin kalintilarini bulabilir misin?

english: Ok, yes that could work.
Whereabouts were you attacked again?
I remember being somewhere near the crossroads, north of Draynor Village.
translation: Draynor Köyü'nün kuzeyindeki kavsak yakinlarinda oldugumu hatirliyorum.

english: Sorry that I'm not much help. It happened so fast, the whole thing is a bit of a blur.
translation: Yardimci olamadigim icin üzgünüm. Her sey cok hizli oldu, biraz bulanik hatirliyorum.

english: That's okay. Crossroads north of Draynor... At least I have somewhere to start.
translation: Sorun degil. Draynor'un kuzeyindeki kavsak... En azindan baslangic noktasi var.

english: You mentioned that Rosie spooked the monster. Who's that?
translation: Rosie'nin canavari korkuttugunu söyledin. O kim?

english: Oh, that'll be our lady over there by the fire. She's such a good dog, always accompanies me on deliveries.
translation: Surada atesin yaninda duran bayan. Cok iyi bir köpek, teslimatlarda hep bana eslik eder.

english: You can pet her if you like. She's very friendly.
translation: Isterseniz onu sevebilirsiniz. Cok dost canlisidir.

english: I think that'll be all for now.
Excellent! Best of luck to you, I'll be waiting right here with your reward.
translation: Harika! Size bol sans, ödülünüzle burada bekliyor olacagim.

english: That monster certainly won't be troubling you from now on.
translation: O canavar artik size sorun cikarmayacaktir.

english: Oh that's fantastic news! I'm so relie-
translation: Bu harika bir haber! Cok rahatladim...

english: Wait, how do I know you're not just saying that to get the bounty?
translation: Bir dakika, bunu sadece ödülü almak icin söylemediginizi nereden bilecegim?

english: How about this as proof?
translation: Bunu kanit olarak kabul eder misiniz?

english: You pull the foot out of your backpack and show it to Sarah.
translation: Sirt cantanizdan ayagi cikarir ve Sarah'ya gösterirsiniz.

english: Eugh! Yes, that certainly looks about right!
translation: Igrenc! Evet, kesinlikle dogru gibi görünüyor!

english: Indeed, the smell is... something quite special.
I'll probably just give it to the dog.
I'm glad you made it back. Some strange woman in a hood came asking about the job shortly after you left. I didn't really want her back in here.
translation: Geri döndügüne sevindim. Sen gittikten kisa bir süre sonra, kapüsonlu garip bir kadin is hakkinda soru sormaya geldi. Onu buraya geri getirmek istemedim.

english: Anyway, thank you so much! Here's your reward.
translation: Her neyse, cok tesekkür ederim! Iste ödülün.

english: Sarah hands you a heavy pouch of 5,000 coins.
translation: Sarah sana 5.000 sikkelik agir bir kese uzatir.

english: Perhaps I should speak with Spria and tell her that the monster's been dealt with.
translation: Belki de Spria ile konusup canavarin halledildigini söylemeliyim.

english: You've been given another clue!
You've obtained a casket!
What are you selling?
Can you give me any Farming advice?
translation: Bana ciftcilik konusunda tavsiyede bulunabilir misin?

english: Can you tell me how to use the loom?
translation: Dokuma tezgahini nasil kullanacagimi söyleyebilir misin?

english: What do I need to weave sacks?
translation: Cuval dokumak icin neye ihtiyacim var?

english: What do I need to weave baskets?
translation: Sepet dokumak icin neye ihtiyacim var?

english: Thank you, that's very kind.
I'm okay, thank you.
Talk about the bounty.
What did the monster look like?
Any tips on finding this thing?
translation: Bu seyi bulmak icin herhangi bir ipucu var mi?

english: Whereabouts were you attacked again?
You mentioned Rosie. Who's that?
I think that'll be all for now.
Please excuse me, I'm rather busy.
Hey, I'm your contractor from Mahogany Homes, what did you want done?
translation: Merhaba, ben Mahogany Homes'tan müteahhitinizim, ne yaptirmak istiyorsunuz?

english: I'd like a Wooden table built.
I'd like a Wooden bed built.
I'd like a Wooden dresser built.
I'd like a Wooden small table built.
I'd like my range fixed.
I'd like a Wooden shelf built.
I'd like a Oak table built.
I'd like a Oak bed built.
I'd like a Oak dresser built.
I'd like a Oak small table built.
I'd like a Oak shelf built.
I'd like a Teak table built.
I'd like a Teak bed built.
I'd like a Teak dresser built.
I'd like a Teak small table built.
I'd like a Teak shelf built.
I'd like a Mahogany table built.
I'd like a Mahogany bed built.
I'd like a Mahogany dresser built.
I'd like a Mahogany small table built.
I'd like a Mahogany shelf built.
I've finished with the work you wanted.
Thank you so much! Would you like a cup of tea before you go?
translation: Cok tesekkür ederim! Gitmeden önce bir fincan cay ister misiniz?

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks, I better be off.
Aaah, nothing like a nice cupppa tea!
translation: Aaah, güzel bir fincan cay gibisi yok!

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks.
I can't find my husband, we got seperated as we disembarked the ship.
What do you want, mortal?
I'm not sure - what can you offer?
Not much, I'm dead.
translation: Fazla bir sey yok, ben öldüm.

english: Fair enough.
You're the one who stopped Necrovarus. Our people are forever grateful to you, even if we don't always show it.
translation: Necrovarus'u durduran sensin. Halkimiz sana sonsuza kadar minnettar, her ne kadar bunu her zaman gösteremiyor olsak da.

english: Hello.
Are you Sarah Corvo?
That's me. Not many people interested in visiting me these days. What brings you here?
translation: Evet, benim. Bu günlerde beni ziyarete gelen pek kimse yok. Seni buraya ne getirdi?

english: I'm on the hunt for the piece of a key. It was once in the possession of your ancestor, Tristan Corvo.
translation: Bir anahtar parcasini ariyorum. Bir zamanlar atan Tristan Corvo'nun elindeydi.

english: I see. I'm afraid I can't help you. The key is gone.
translation: Anliyorum. Korkarim sana yardimci olamayacagim. Anahtar kayboldu.

english: Gone?

Yes gone. When my father passed the key down to me he told me that I must keep it safe no matter what. When the vampyres came to Port Phasmatys I buried it out in the swamps to stop them from getting it.
translation: Evet, kayboldu. Babam anahtari bana verirken, ne olursa olsun onu güvende tutmam gerektigini söylemisti. Vampirler Port Phasmatys'e geldiginde, anahtari ele gecirmelerini engellemek icin batakliga gömdüm.

english: But how do I get it back?
You don't. The key is gone and it's safer that way. I never liked looking after that lump of metal anyway.
translation: Alamazsin. Anahtar kayboldu ve bu sekilde daha güvende. Zaten o metal parcasini korumaktan hic hoslanmazdim.

english: Metal?
Yes, a strange red metal.
Hmm. I think I might know just the scientist to help me out with this. Time for me to visit Draynor Manor.
translation: Hmm. Sanirim bu konuda bana yardimci olabilecek bir bilim adami taniyorum. Draynor Malikanesi'ni ziyaret etmenin zamani geldi.

english: What was that?
Oh nothing. I'd best be off, thank you for your time.
translation: Oh, hicbir sey. Gitsem iyi olacak, zaman ayirdigin icin tesekkürler.

english: Hello.
You again. You're not still after that key are you?
translation: Yine sen. Hâlâ o anahtari ariyor musun?

english: Nope, just stopping by to say hello.
translation: Hayir, sadece merhaba demek icin ugradim.

english: Well that was great. See you later.
This gnome lady appears to be singing ... to her toads.
translation: Bu cüce bayan kurbagalarina sarki söylüyor gibi görünüyor.

english: La La La, toadies in their holeys! ..Oh hello, I didn't notice you.
translation: La La La, deliklerdeki kurbagaciklar! Merhaba, seni fark etmemisim.

english: Hello, Whatdo you do here?
I look after the toads and worms. They are very useful in gnome cooking, don't you know.
translation: Kurbagalara ve solucanlara bakiyorum. Cüce mutfaginda cok kullanislilar, bilmiyor musun?

english: Does singing to the toads help them grow?
translation: Kurbagalara sarki söylemek onlarin büyümesine yardimci oluyor mu?

english: Don't be silly, I just sing to pass the time while looking after them!
translation: Sacmalama, sadece onlara bakarken zaman gecirmek icin sarki söylüyorum!

english: Of course...
Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: Hazir yemekler maalesef ise yaramaz. Aluft Aloft'un müsterileri icin sadece el yapimi Cüce Mutfagi yeterince iyidir.

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Sarble
Thank you kindly, you might want to grab some toads and worms while you are here.
translation: Tesekkürler, buradayken kurbaga ve solucan da alabilirsin.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.'dan ücretsiz teslimat jetonunuzu almayi unutmayin.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: Teslimatiniz cok gec! Aluft jnr.'a geri dönüp baska bir siparis alin. Artik ihtiyaciniz olmadigi icin teslimat kutunuzu atiyorsunuz.

english: Welcome to my store, human! Are you interested in buying anything?
translation: Magazama hos geldin, insan! Bir sey satin almak ister misin?

english: Yes, I'm looking for some armour.
No thanks.
Yes, I'm looking for some armour.
No thanks.
I cannot speak to you outerlander! Talk to Brundt, the Chieftain!
translation: Seninle konusamam, yabanci! Sef Brundt ile konus!

english: You stay away from me outerlander!
They are too suspicious of you for you to get close enough to steal from them.
translation: Sana karsi cok süpheci davraniyorlar, onlara yaklasip hirsizlik yapamazsin.

english: Do you know any council members?
I know that I am one.
Great! Can you vote for me at the council of elders for me to become a Fremennik?
translation: Harika! Yaslilar konseyinde Fremennik olmam icin bana oy verir misin?

english: Sure. On one condition.
(sigh) What condition?
Actually there is no condition! I don't want to vote for you! You seem too gullible to be a Fremennik!
translation: Aslinda sart yok! Sana oy vermek istemiyorum! Fremennik olmak icin fazla saf görünüyorsun!

english: It's kind of mean to trick me like that...
What do I care? I am a Fremennik and you are just some stupid outerlander! You stupid outerlander!
translation: Ne umurumda? Ben bir Fremennik'im ve sen sadece aptal bir yabancisin! Seni aptal yabanci!

english: Hello.
Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: Merhaba kardesim Dokrak. Bugün benden ne istiyorsun? Her zaman yardimima güvenebilirsin!

english: Nothing thanks. I just fancied a chat.
translation: Hicbir sey, tesekkürler. Sadece sohbet etmek istedim.

english: My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
translation: Yardimima ihtiyacin olursa kapim her zaman acik Dokrak.

english: [Fremennik name]... It has been too long since last we met!
translation: Dokrak... Son görüsmemizden bu yana cok zaman gecti!

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: Hos geldin kardes Dokrak. Seni burada görmek her zaman bir zevk!

english: My apologies [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: Özür dilerim kardes Dokrak! Burada seninle vakit gecirecek vaktim yok!

english: That's okay, I didn't really want anything.
translation: Önemli degil, aslinda bir sey istememistim.

english: How are you [Fremennik name]? I hope all fares well with you this day!
translation: Nasilsin Dokrak? Umarim bugün her sey yolundadir!

english: I'm fine, thanks, how are you?
All is well with me also!
Hello to you, too!
Hello. Did you want something [Fremennik name]?
translation: Merhaba. Bir sey mi istiyordun Dokrak?

english: No, not really.
Well... okay then!
Always good to see you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].
translation: Seni görmek her zaman güzel kardesim Dokrak.

english: You shame us, [Fremennik name]!
How can you steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
You have betrayed your heritage, [Fremennik name]!
Why would you try to steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
How are you today?
**sigh**
That good? Everyone around here seems a little depressed.
translation: O kadar mi iyi? Buradaki herkes biraz depresif görünüyor.

english: And not particularly talkative.
I'll leave you to your sighing. It looks like you have plenty to do.
translation: Ic cekisine devam et. Yapacak cok isin var gibi görünüyor.

english: It's a bit grey round here, isn't it?
It gets you down after a while, you know. There are 273 shades of grey, you know, and we have them all.
translation: Bir süre sonra insani bunaltiyor, biliyorsun. 273 farkli gri tonu var, biliyorsun, ve biz hepsine sahibiz.

english: That's grey-t.
That attempt at humour merely made me more depressed. Leave me alone.
translation: Bu espri denemesi beni daha da depresif yapti. Beni rahat birak.

english: How's the King treating you then?
Like serfs.
Serf?
Yes, you know - peons, plebs, the downtrodden. He treats us like his own personal possessions.
translation: Evet, bilirsin - isci, pleb, ezilenler. Bizi kendi kisisel mülkiyeti gibi görüyor.

english: You should leave this place.
I keep trying to save up enough to leave, but the King keeps taxing us! We have no money left.
translation: Ayrilmak icin para biriktirmeye calisiyorum ama Kral bize sürekli vergi koyuyor! Hic paramiz kalmadi.

english: Oh dear.
Cheer up! It's not the end of the world.
I'd prefer that, if it meant I didn't have to talk to people as inanely happy as you.
translation: Senin gibi aptalca mutlu insanlarla konusmak zorunda kalmayacaksam, bunu tercih ederim.

english: Whoa! I think you need to get out more.
translation: Vay canina! Bence daha fazla disari cikmalisin.

english: What's with the bucket on your head?
If I can't see my enemies, they can't see me.
translation: Düsmanlarimi göremezsem, onlar da beni göremez.

english: Are you sure about that?
Don't doubt me stranger. This pub will be mine.
translation: Benden süphe etme yabanci. Bu pub benim olacak.

english: I hope you can flex your way to victory.
I think I heard Santa saying we aren't allowed things on your back in the games, by the way.
translation: Bu arada, Noel Baba'nin oyunlarda sirtinda bir sey tasimamamiz gerektigini söyledigini duydum.

english: Does it look like I play by the rules?
Uh...
I make my own rules.
Do you want me to make some planks for you? I can make planks from wood, oak, teak and mahogany logs. Or would you like to buy some other housing supplies?
translation: Sana birkac tahta yapmami ister misin? Mese, tik ve maun kütüklerinden tahta yapabilirim. Yoksa baska ev malzemeleri mi satin almak istersin?

english: Yes, please make me some planks.
translation: Evet, lütfen bana birkac tahta yap.

english: You'll need to bring me some more logs.
Those planks cost 1500 coins. You don't have enough money for all of them.
translation: Bu tahtalar 1500 sikkeye mal oluyor. Hepsini alacak kadar paran yok.

english: I can make planks from wood, oak, teak and mahogany. I don't make planks from other woods as they're no good for making furniture.
translation: Ahsap, mese, tik ve maun agacindan tahtalar yapabilirim. Diger agaclardan tahtalar yapmiyorum cünkü mobilya yapimina uygun degiller.

english: Wood and oak are all over the place, but teak and mahogany can only be found in a few places like Karamja and Etceteria.
translation: Ahsap ve mese her yerde bulunur, ancak tik ve maun agaci sadece Karamja ve Etceteria gibi birkac yerde bulunur.

english: Nothing, thanks.
Well come back when you want some. You can't get good quality planks anywhere but here!
translation: Istediginiz zaman tekrar gelin. Kaliteli tahtalari baska hicbir yerde bulamazsiniz!

english: Yes, please make me some planks.
translation: Evet, lütfen bana birkac tahta yap.

english: What kind of planks can you make?
Can I buy some housing supplies?
translation: Biraz ev malzemesi satin alabilir miyim?

english: Nothing, thanks
Do you want me to make some planks for you? I can make planks from wood, oak, teak and mahogany logs. Or would you like to buy some other housing supplies?
translation: Sana birkac tahta yapmami ister misin? Mese, tik ve maun kütüklerinden tahta yapabilirim. Yoksa baska ev malzemeleri mi satin almak istersin?

english: I need some waxwood planks for Old Man Yarlo.
translation: Yarlo Amca icin balmumu agaci tahtalarina ihtiyacim var.

english: That old geezer? Oh, alright. I won't charge for this, since it's for him.
translation: O yasli moruk mu? Tamam, peki. Onun icin oldugu icin ücret almayacagim.

english: I need some waxwood planks for Old Man Yarlo.
translation: Yarlo Amca icin balmumu agaci tahtalarina ihtiyacim var.

english: Yes, please make me some planks.
translation: Evet, lütfen bana birkac tahta yapin.

english: Can I buy some housing supplies?
Nothing, thanks
Hello stranger. Would you like me to tan any hides for you?
translation: Merhaba yabanci. Senin icin deri tabaklamak ister misin?

english: Soft leather - 2 gp per hideHard leather - 5 gp per hideSnakeskins - 25 gp per hideDragon leather - 45 gp per hide.
translation: Yumusak deri - deri basina 2 gp Sert deri - deri basina 5 gp Yilan derisi - deri basina 25 gp Ejderha derisi - deri basina 45 gp.

english: Why are you so expensive? The tanner in Al-Kharid is almost half the price!
translation: Neden bu kadar pahali? Al-Kharid'deki tabakci neredeyse yari fiyatina yapiyor!

english: Hey, I charge more because I'm worth it! I deal in bulk, and I work extremely quickly. You'll see for yourself!
translation: Hey, daha fazla ücret aliyorum cünkü buna degerim! Toplu satis yapiyorum ve cok hizli calisiyorum. Kendin göreceksin!

english: You got a lot of hides you want tanning quickly? I'm your guy!
translation: Hizli bir sekilde tabaklamak istediginiz cok sayida deriniz mi var? Ben tam size göreyim!

english: So you got hides for me to tan, or are you just gonna bust my chops about prices all day?

english: Until I need some fur to throw.
translation: Ta ki atmak icin kürk lazim olana kadar.

english: Or I have to cast a bolt of electricity.

What?
We like cheese. Just cheese.
I'm going to keep an eye on you. You've got a bad rattitude.
translation: Sana göz kulak olacagim. Kötü bir tavirin var.

english: Got any cheese?
Maybe I'll give you some cheese if you're a good rat and don't eat me.

That means deal in rat speak.

Welcome, adventurer. Are you looking for a sublime staff? I'm afraid a little issue with some ents means I don't have any battlestaffs for sale, but other than that, I'm sure I'll have what you need.
translation: Hos geldin, maceraci. Muhtesem bir asa mi ariyorsun? Maalesef, bazi entlerle ilgili küçük bir sorun nedeniyle satilik savas asam yok, ama bunun disinda ihtiyacin olan her seyi bulabileceginden eminim.

english: I'll have a look.

Unfortunately, we had someone new handling the delivery and they accidently left the cart in the way of the ents. I think the ents must have then considered both the cart and its contents to be a gift for them.
translation: Maalesef, teslimati yeni birisi yapiyordu ve yanlislikla arabayi entlerin yoluna birakmis. Sanirim entler arabayi ve içindekileri kendilerine hediye olarak görmüs olmalilar.

english: They stole them?
I wouldn't say stole. I just think they misunderstood why the cart had been left there.
translation: Çaldilar diyemem. Sadece arabayi neden oraya biraktigimizi yanlis anlamis olmalilar.

english: Could you not ask for them back?
I'm sure the courier tried, but I suspect the ents didn't really understand him.
translation: Eminim kurye denemistir, ama sanirim ents onu pek anlamamislardir.

english: Anyway, would you like to buy a staff?
translation: Neyse, bir asa almak ister misin?

english: No thanks.
Tetamo, iknami! I hope you change your mind soon!
translation: Tetamo, iknami! Umarim fikrini yakinda degistirirsin!

english: I'll have a look.
What was the issue?
No thanks.
What brings you here?
Who are you?
I'm a security guard. Long ago I used to wander the world, teaching people how to protect themselves from security threats, and giving out books of advice.
translation: Ben bir güvenlik görevlisiyim. Uzun zaman önce dünyayi dolasir, insanlara güvenlik tehditlerinden nasil korunacaklarini ögretir ve tavsiye kitaplari dagitirdim.

english: I've retired now. They tell me there's some flashy poser in a vampyre outfit doing my old job now, and even giving out prizes to people he thinks are worthy!
translation: Artik emekli oldum. Bana, vampir kiyafeti giymis gösterisli bir pozörün benim eski isimi yaptigini ve hatta layik gördügü insanlara ödüller dagittigini söylediler!

english: In my day, people didn't need prizes for taking security seriously! Honestly, I don't know what's the matter with young people these days...
translation: Benim zamanimda, insanlar güvenligi ciddiye almak icin ödüle ihtiyac duymazlardi! Acikcasi, bu günlerde genclerin nesi var bilmiyorum......

english: ... but if fear of XP waste is what people need to make them protect themselves properly, I suppose that's how it'll have to be.
translation: ama insanlarin kendilerini dogru düzgün korumak icin XP kaybi korkusuna ihtiyaclari varsa, sanirim öyle olmak zorunda.

english: It's nice to meet someone who takes this stuff seriously! Alright, I'll have a look over your account...
translation: Bu konuyu ciddiye alan biriyle tanismak güzel! Tamam, hesabina bir bakayim...

english: Firstly, make sure you've upgraded to a Jagex Account to get the latest protection. Visit the RuneScape website and log in to update your Account settings.
translation: Öncelikle, en son korumayi almak icin Jagex Hesabina yükselttiginden emin ol. RuneScape web sitesini ziyaret et ve oturum acarak Hesap ayarlarini güncelle.

english: Jagex Accounts protect you via two-factor authentication - anyone trying to steal your Jagex Account would need get past that second check too, rather than just learning your password.
translation: Jagex Hesaplari, iki faktörlü kimlik dogrulama ile seni korur - Jagex Hesabini calmaya calisan herkes, sadece sifreni ögrenmekle kalmayip, ikinci kontrolü de gecmek zorunda kalir.

english: For additional protection, you can use a mobile authenticator and backup codes too.
translation: Ek koruma icin, mobil kimlik dogrulayici ve yedek kodlari da kullanabilirsin.

english: Make sure you keep your email account properly secure too, though - good email providers will offer two- factor authentication options.
translation: E-posta hesabinizi da uygun sekilde güvende tuttugunuzdan emin olun. Iyi e-posta saglayicilari iki faktörlü kimlik dogrulama secenekleri sunar.

english: Well, you're off to a good start - I see you have a Jagex Account, so you should have the latest protection.
translation: Iyi bir baslangic yaptiniz. Jagex Hesabiniz oldugunu görüyorum, bu nedenle en son korumaya sahip olmalisiniz.

english: Aside from that, I see you don't have a Bank PIN. Next time you visit a bank, talk to a banker and ask to check your PIN settings.
translation: Bunun disinda, banka PIN kodunuzun olmadigini görüyorum. Bir dahaki sefere bankaya gittiginizde, bir banka görevlisiyle konusun ve PIN ayarlarinizi kontrol etmesini isteyin.

english: Aside from that, I see you have a Bank PIN.
translation: Bunun disinda, banka PIN kodunuz oldugunu görüyorum.

english: Here's a security book for you.
I'll be off now.
Stay safe!
Who are you?
If you're a security guard, let's talk about security.
translation: Eger güvenlik görevlisiysen, güvenlik hakkinda konusalim.

english: I'll be off now.
