I buy and sell adventurer's equipment, do you want to trade?
translation: Maceraci ekipmanlari alip satiyorum, takas etmek ister misin?

english: No thank you.
Yes please.
No thank you.
Many greetings.
Many greetings.
Remember, whenever you set out to do something, something else must be done first.
translation: Unutma, bir sey yapmaya karar verdiginde, önce baska bir sey yapman gerekir.

english: I seek knowledge and power!
Knowledge comes from experience, power comes from battleaxes.
translation: Bilgi deneyimden gelir, güc savas baltalarindan gelir.

english: I need to locate some scorpions.
Well you have come to the right place. I am a master of animal detection.
translation: Dogru yere geldin. Ben hayvanlari bulma ustasiyim.

english: Do you need to locate any particular scorpion? Scorpions are a creature somewhat in abundance.
translation: Belirli bir akrebi mi ariyorsun? Akrepler oldukca bol bulunan yaratiklardir.

english: I'm looking for some lesser Kharid scorpions. They belong to Thormac the Sorcerer.
translation: Daha kücük Kharid akrepleri ariyorum. Büyücü Thormac'a aitler.

english: Let me look into my looking glass.
The seer produces a small mirror
The seer gazes into the mirror
The seer smoothes his hair with his hand
I can see a scorpion that you seek. It would appear to be near some nasty spiders. I can see two coffins there as well.
translation: Aradigin akrebi görebiliyorum. Kötü örümceklerin yaninda gibi görünüyor. Orada iki tabut da görüyorum.

english: The scorpion seems to be going through some crack in the wall. It's gone into some sort of secret room.
translation: Akrep duvardaki bir catlaktan geciyor gibi görünüyor. Bir tür gizli odaya girmis.

english: Well see if you can find that scorpion then, and I'll try and get you some information on the others.
translation: O zaman o akrebi bulmaya calis, ben de digerleri hakkinda biraz bilgi bulmaya calisayim.

english: Where did you say that scorpion was again?
I've retrieved the scorpion from near the spiders.

Well, I've checked my looking glass. There seems to be a kharid scorpion in a little village to the east, surrounded by lots of uncivilised-looking warriors. Some kind of merchant there seems to have picked it up.
translation: Aynami kontrol ettim. Doguya dogru kücük bir köyde, medeniyetsiz görünümlü savascilarla cevrili bir kharid akrebi var gibi görünüyor. Oradaki bir tüccar onu almis gibi görünüyor.

english: That's all I can tell you about that scorpion.
translation: Bu akrep hakkinda sana söyleyebilecegim tek sey bu.

english: Any more scorpions?
It's good that you should ask. I have information on the last scorpion for you.
translation: Iyi ki sordun. Son akrep hakkinda da bilgim var.

english: It seems to be in some sort of upstairs room. There seems to be some sort of brown clothing lying on a table.
translation: Bir tür üst kat odasinda gibi görünüyor. Masada kahverengi bir giysi var gibi görünüyor.

english: I've retrieved the second scorpion.
That's lucky because I've got some information on the last scorpion for you.
translation: Sanslisin, cünkü son akrep hakkinda sana bilgi verebilirim.

english: I seek knowledge and power!
I need to locate some scorpions.
Where did you say that scorpion was again?
I've retrieved the scorpion from near the spiders.
I've retrieved the second scorpion.
Yes?
What are you doing?
Browsing.
What for?
In a magic shop? Magical items, oddly enough.
translation: Sihirli bir dükkanda mi? Garip bir sekilde, sihirli esyalar icin.

english: Anything in particular?
Whatever Highseer Vandra requires.
translation: Yüksek Görüslü Vandra'nin istedigi her seyi.

english: Highseer Vandra?
Enough questions. Leave me to browse in peace.
translation: Yeterince soru sordun. Beni rahat birak da göz atayim.

english: Excuse me.
What is it, human?
What are you doing up here? It doesn't seem very safe.
translation: Burada ne yapiyorsun? Burasi pek güvenli görünmüyor.

english: On the contrary, it would not be safe if we were not up here!
You see, that creature up there has a powerful divine energy about it. That energy is used to protect itself and interfere with our own divine capabilities.
translation: Görüyorsun, yukaridaki yaratigin güclü bir ilahi enerjisi var. Bu enerji kendini korumak ve bizim ilahi yeteneklerimizi engellemek icin kullaniliyor.

english: Divine capabilities? You mean praying to the gods?
translation: Ilahi yetenekler mi? Tanrilara dua etmek mi demek istiyorsun?

english: Praying? Yes. To the gods? That is open to interpretation.
translation: Dua etmek mi? Evet. Tanrilara mi? Bu yoruma acik bir konu.

english: It is?
I do not have the time nor desire to explain the advanced concepts of theology to you, but you should know that the Dwarves of Cam Torum take a different approach to worship than your kind.
translation: Sana teolojinin ileri kavramlarini aciklamak icin ne zamanim ne de istegim var, ama Cam Torum Cüceleri'nin ibadet konusunda senin türünden farkli bir yaklasimi oldugunu bilmelisin.

english: Anyway, the point is that without experienced seers to aid you, you may find yourself unable to utilise your prayers as you normally would.
translation: Her neyse, önemli olan nokta, deneyimli kahinlerin yardimi olmadan, dualarini normalde yaptigin gibi kullanamayabilirsin.

english: Interesting. So we need to work together to subdue this creature?
translation: Ilginc. Yani bu yaratigi alt etmek icin birlikte calismamiz mi gerekiyor?

english: Indeed, just follow our lead and you'll be fine... probably.
translation: Aynen öyle, bizim liderligimizi takip et, her sey yolunda gidecektir... muhtemelen.

english: Great! I'm happy to help!
Good. If you have any further questions about your role here, speak to Taala.
translation: Güzel. Buradaki rolünle ilgili baska sorunun varsa Taala ile konus.

english: I will, thank you.
Could I trade some tomes in?
Very well.
You can't trade in zero of an item.
translation: Sifir adet olan bir esyayi takas edemezsin.

english: Let's make this beastie move!
Block its attacks with your prayers!
Let's convince that beastie to move!
translation: Bu canavari hareket ettirmeye ikna edelim!

english: Let's go!
Nicely done!
Steady now!
We need to charge all of the pillars using our prayers!
translation: Dualarimizi kullanarak tüm sütunlari sarj etmeliyiz!

english: Keep praying to charge the pillars!
translation: Sütunlari sarj etmek icin dua etmeye devam et!

english: Keep praying to bolster your strength!
translation: Gücünü artirmak icin dua etmeye devam et!

english: Excellent! The pillars are boosting your strength!
Well done! The power of the pillars is yours!
It's shielded itself! You need to break its concentration!
Watch out for its slam!
Go for the tail! It's a weakspot!
Well done! Now, let's weaken it a little more!
translation: Aferin! Simdi onu biraz daha zayiflatin!

english: We did it! Well done!
Oof!
What are you doing up here? It doesn't seem very safe.
translation: Burada ne yapiyorsun? Burasi pek güvenli görünmüyor.

english: Could I trade some tomes in?
Yes.
No.
Forgive me, my child, but I have little time to talk. There is always plenty of Ranul's work to be done here in the Colosseum.
translation: Affet beni cocugum, ama konusacak vaktim yok. Colosseum'da Ranul'un yapmasi gereken cok is var.

english: Can you tell me a bit about your people?
translation: Halkin hakkinda biraz bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Ok. Like what?
How about the values of the Moon clan!
Let me see... We value knowledge of self because it is this that gives us our strength! It is most important!
translation: Bir bakalim... Kendimizi tanimayi önemsiyoruz cünkü bize gücümüzü veren budur! Bu cok önemlidir!

english: Well... I know things about myself. I know I like hot chocolate!
translation: Sey... Kendim hakkinda bazi seyler biliyorum. Sicak cikolatayi sevdigimi biliyorum!

english: I was meaning something a little deeper than that. We also like to see someone listen. You know how they say a wise man listens?
translation: Ben biraz daha derin bir sey kastetmistim. Ayrica birinin bizi dinlemesini de severiz. Bilge adamin dinledigini söylerler, bilirsin?

english: Did you hear me?
.... I'm listening.
Most wise.
Huh?
Hi, I...
What are you doing here, Fremennik?!
I have a seal of pass...
No you do not! Begone!
Ooops. Suppose I need a seal of passage when I'm walking around that island.
translation: Oops. Sanirim o adada dolasirken gecis iznine ihtiyacim var.

english: You're not Osman. Who are you?
My name is Selim. Osman is currently on a diplomatic visit. I expect to be filling in for him for the forseeable future.
translation: Adim Selim. Osman su anda diplomatik bir ziyarette. Öngörülebilir gelecekte onun yerine gececegim.

english: Okay... But where is he really?
I have told you all that I can.
But who should I take my sq'irk juice to now?
translation: Ama simdi sq'irk suyumu kime götürecegim?

english: I am partial to that juice myself. I will happily take any off your hands.
translation: Ben de o suyu cok severim. Senden memnuniyetle alirim.

english: Now, do you need something?
translation: Simdi, bir seye ihtiyacin var mi?

english: Do you need something?
Like my master, I am partial to juice from the sq'irk fruit. I would appreciate it if you could bring me some.
translation: Efendim gibi ben de sq'irk meyvesinden yapilan meyve suyunu cok severim. Bana biraz getirirsen cok sevinirim.

english: I'd like to talk about sq'irks.
I have some sq'irk juice for you.
Thank you very much. If you get some more sq'irks be sure to come back.
translation: Cok tesekkür ederim. Baska sq'irk bulursan mutlaka tekrar gel.

english: I will. It's been a pleasure doing business with you.
translation: Gelirim. Seninle is yapmak bir zevkti.

english: Of course. What would you like to know?
Where do I get sq'irks?
There is a sorceress near the south eastern edge of Al Kharid who grows them. She used to be friends with Osman, but they fell out.
translation: Al Kharid'in güneydogu ucunda onlari yetistiren bir büyücü var. Eskiden Osman'in arkadasiydi, ama aralari acildi.

english: What happened?
I don't know. All I know is she won't give us any more fruit.
translation: Bilmiyorum. Tek bildigim, bize artik meyve vermeyecegi.

english: So all I have to do is ask her for some fruit for you?
translation: Yani tek yapmam gereken, ona senin icin meyve istemek mi?

english: I doubt it will be that easy. She is not renowned for her generosity and is very secretive about her garden's location.
translation: O kadar kolay olacagini sanmiyorum. Cömertligiyle taninmaz ve bahcesinin yerini cok gizli tutar.

english: Oh come on, it should be easy enough to find.
translation: Hadi ama, bulmak o kadar da zor olmamali.

english: Her garden has remained hidden even from Osman. I believe it must be hidden by magical means.
translation: Bahcesi Osman'dan bile gizli kalmistir. Bence sihirli bir yöntemle gizlenmistir.

english: I see. And why can't you do this yourself?
translation: Anliyorum. Peki bunu neden kendin yapamiyorsun?

english: My work requires that I remain here.
Okay. This should be an interesting task.
translation: Tamam. Bu ilginc bir görev olacak.

english: How should I squeeze the fruit?
Use a pestle and mortar. Make sure you have an empty glass with you to collect the juice.
translation: Havan ve havaneli kullan. Meyve suyunu toplamak icin yaninda bos bir bardak bulundur.

english: Is there a reward for getting these sq'irks?
translation: Bu sq'irkleri getirmenin bir ödülü var mi?

english: Of course. I'll train you in the art of Thieving for your troubles.
translation: Elbette. Zahmetin karsiliginda sana hirsizlik sanatini ögretecegim.

english: How much training will you give?
That depends on the quantity and ripeness of the sq'irks you put into the juice.
translation: Bu, meyve suyuna koydugun sq'irklerin miktarina ve olgunluguna bagli.

english: That sounds fair enough.
What's so good about sq'irk juice?
translation: Sq'irk suyunun nesi bu kadar iyi?

english: It is a sweet nectar for a thief or spy. It makes light fingers lighter, fleet feet flightier and comes in four different colours for those who are easily amused.
translation: Hirsizlar ve casuslar icin tatli bir nektar. Hirsizlarin ellerini daha hafif, ayaklarini daha cevik hale getirir ve kolayca eglenenler icin dört farkli renkte bulunur.

english: Selim starts salivating at the thought of sq'irk juice.
translation: Selim, sq'irk suyunu düsününce agzi sulanmaya baslar.

english: It wouldn't have addictive properties, would it?
translation: Bagimlilik yapici özellikleri yoktur, degil mi?

english: It only holds power over those with poor self-control. Something which I have an abundance of.
translation: Sadece özdenetim zayif olanlar üzerinde etkisi vardir. Benim ise özdenetimim cok güclüdür.

english: I see.
I should go.
Could you sell me another Keris?
translation: Bana bir Keris daha satabilir misin?

english: Would you like a dagger or a partisan?
translation: Hancer mi, yoksa partizan mi istersin?

english: A dagger.
That will be 20,000 coins.
I'll take one.
Actually, I don't seem to have enough money on me.
translation: Aslinda, üzerimde yeterince para yok gibi görünüyor.

english: That's too much.
Well you know where I am if you reconsider.
A partisan.
That will be 60,000 coins.
Actually, I'm good.
I'm good, thanks.
Well done. I have new information to share with you.
translation: Aferin. Seninle paylasmak istedigim yeni bilgiler var.

english: I'd like to talk about sq'irks.
Could you sell me another Keris?
translation: Bana bir Keris daha satabilir misin?

english: I'm good, thanks.
Is there anything I can help you with?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Where do I get sq'irks?
How should I squeeze the fruit?
Is there a reward for getting these sq'irks?
translation: Bu sq'irks'leri aldigimda bir ödül var mi?

english: What's so good about sq'irk juice?
translation: Sq'irk suyunun nesi bu kadar iyi?

english: I should go.
A dagger.
I'll take one.
That's too much.
A partisan.
Actually, I'm good.
Hello
Hello Bwana. Are you interested in buying a ticket for the 'Lady of the Waves'?
translation: Merhaba Bwana. “Dalgalarin Hanimi” icin bilet almak ister misiniz?

english: Yes, that sounds great!
Sorry Bwana, you don't have enough money. Come back when you have 25 coins.
translation: Üzgünüm Bwana, paran yetmiyor. 25 sikke oldugunda tekrar gel.

english: Great, nice doing business with you.
No thanks.
Fair enough Bwana, let me know if you change your mind.
translation: Anlasildi Bwana, fikrini degistirirsen bana haber ver.

english: It's a ship that can take you to either Port Sarim or Port Khazard. The ship lies west of Shilo Village and south of Cairn Island. The tickets cost 25 coins. Would you like to purchase a ticket Bwana?
translation: Bu gemi sizi Port Sarim veya Port Khazard'a götürebilir. Gemi, Shilo Köyü'nün batisinda ve Cairn Adasi'nin güneyinde bulunuyor. Biletler 25 sikke. Bilet almak ister misiniz Bwana?

english: I'm getting out of here Bwana, the place is infested with zombies.
translation: Buradan gidiyorum Bwana, burasi zombilerle dolu.

english: Yes, that sounds great!
No thanks.
Tell me more about the ship.
I want to see you sweat soldier!
Yes sir!
Put your back into it soldier!
That dummy is the enemy. Kill it!
Keep it up soldier!
Good work soldier!
You're not out for a sunday stroll soldier!
Work it!
My daughter can hit harder than that!
translation: Kizim bile senden daha sert vurur!

english: Push it!
Well done soldier!
Hello. What are you doing here?
We're here to keep the farmers safe from the lizardmen.
translation: Ciftcileri kertenkele adamlardan korumak icin buradayiz.

english: There's not many of you though.
Luckily the lizardmen have been focusing their efforts elsewhere. They haven't tried to come up here yet.
translation: Neyse ki kertenkele adamlar baska yerlere odaklanmis durumda. Henüz buraya gelmeye calismadilar.

english: If they do, we can quickly call in reinforcements if required.
translation: Gelirlerse, gerekirse hemen takviye kuvvet cagirabiliriz.

english: I see. Well I'd better let you get on then.
Hello. Do you know anything about the beast causing trouble around here?
translation: Merhaba. Buralarda sorun cikaran canavarla ilgili bir sey biliyor musun?

english: The farmers mentioned it. We haven't seen anything though. Our focus is on the lizardmen.
translation: Ciftciler bahsetti. Ama biz bir sey görmedik. Bizim odak noktamiz kertenkele adamlar.

english: Surely you'd notice a big beast wondering around though?
translation: Büyük bir canavarin etrafta dolastigini fark etmez misiniz?

english: The farmers said it came at night. We're not on shift then.
translation: Ciftciler gece geldigini söylediler. O saatlerde nöbetimiz yok.

english: But then who's guarding the farm at night?
That's not our problem. We're just here to follow orders.
translation: Bu bizim sorunumuz degil. Biz sadece emirleri yerine getiriyoruz.

english: Fine. I'll find the beast myself.
Hello. I'm looking for Sophia Hughes.
Sophia Hughes? The councillor?
translation: Sophia Hughes mu? Meclis üyesi mi?

english: That's right. I think she might have come here at some point.
translation: Evet. Sanirim bir ara buraya gelmis olabilir.

english: Well, if she did it wasn't recently. We'd have noticed a councillor.
translation: Gelmisse de yakin zamanda degil. Meclis üyesini fark ederdik.

english: I see. Thanks for the help.
Private [player name], atten-SHUN! You've been recommended for my corps. Do you think you can be the best?
translation: Er Maceraci, dikkat! Benim birligime tavsiye edildin. En iyisi olabilecegini düsünüyor musun?

english: Sir, yes sir!
No thanks, I'm not interested.
Move yourself, Private! Follow my orders and you may, just may, leave here in a fit state for my corps!
translation: Kipirda, er! Emirlerimi yerine getirirsen, belki, sadece belki, birligime uygun bir durumda buradan ayrilabilirsin!

english: I haven't given you the order yet, worm!
(continues with the dialogue below)
I want to see you on that mat doing star jumps, private!
translation: Seni o matta yildiz ziplamasi yaparken görmek istiyorum, er!

english: Okay.
I want to leave.
Pathetic. Get out of here then.
Drop and give me push ups on that mat, private!
translation: Yere yat ve o matta sinav cek, er!

english: Get yourself over there and jog on that mat, private!
translation: Oraya git ve o matta kos, er!

english: Get on that mat and give me sit ups, private!
translation: O matta otur ve mekik cek, er!

english: Well I'll be, you actually did it, Private. Now take this and get out of my sight.
translation: Vay canina, gercekten yaptin, er. Simdi bunu al ve gözümün önünden kaybol.

english: The player is teleported back to their original position.
Wrong exercise, worm! Drop and give me push ups on that mat, private!
translation: Yanlis egzersiz, solucan! Yere yat ve o matta sinav cek, er!

english: Wrong exercise, worm! I want to see you on that mat doing star jumps, private!
translation: Yanlis egzersiz, solucan! Seni o matta yildiz ziplamasi yaparken görmek istiyorum, er!

english: Wrong exercise, worm! Get on that mat and give me sit ups, private!
translation: Yanlis egzersiz, solucan! O matin üzerine cik ve bana mekik cek, er!

english: Wrong exercise, worm! Get yourself over there and jog on that mat, private!
translation: Yanlis egzersiz, solucan! Oraya git ve o matta kos, er!

english: As you were, soldier.
Private [player name], atten-SHUN!
Stop day-dreaming, Private [player name]!
Get your rear in gear, Private [player name]!
I want you for my corps, Private [player name]!
translation: Seni benim birligime istiyorum, Er Maceraci!

english: Maybe later.
Sir, yes sir!
No thanks, I'm not interested.
Okay.
I want to leave.
Adventurer, if you're looking to head back in there, I'd suggest you reconsider.
translation: Maceraci, oraya geri dönmek istiyorsan, bir daha düsünmeni öneririm.

english: Why?
There is a horror within that has already claimed the lives of some of our soldiers.
translation: Orada, bazi askerlerimizin hayatina mal olan bir korku var.

english: Horror? What horror?
A nightmare that should not exist. A phantom of the beast that Jhallan took the form of. General Khazard called it a muspah.
translation: Var olmamasi gereken bir kabus. Jhallan'in aldigi seklin hayaletidir. General Khazard ona muspah diyordu.

english: A phantom? So it's not actually real?
translation: Hayalet mi? Yani gercek degil mi?

english: It is, and it isn't. Truth be told, I don't fully understand it myself. General Khazard called it a remnant of dark energy. Raw magic released from the prison that has taken form.
translation: Hem gercek hem de degil. Dogrusu, ben de tam olarak anlamis degilim. General Khazard ona karanlik enerjinin kalintisi diyordu. Hapishaneden serbest kalan ham büyü, bir sekil almisti.

english: All I know is that whatever it is, real or otherwise, it's very dangerous.
translation: Tek bildigim, gercek ya da degil, her ne ise cok tehlikeli oldugu.

english: So I can't go in?
I won't stop you, but if it all goes wrong, don't expect me to come and save you either.
translation: Seni durdurmayacagim, ama isler ters giderse, gelip seni kurtarmami bekleme.

english: I'll keep that in mind. Thanks for the information.
Be on your guard, adventurer. This place is dangerous.
translation: Tetikte ol, maceraci. Burasi tehlikeli bir yer.

english: Ah, hello! Isn't it a wonderful day?
translation: Ah, merhaba! Ne harika bir gün, degil mi?

english: You seem happy.
And why wouldn't I be? I'm part of the best fighting force in the world! The Shayzien Army!
translation: Neden mutlu olmayayim ki? Dünyanin en iyi savas gücü olan Shayzien Ordusu'nun bir parcasiyim!

english: The best?
Of course!
So the Shayzien Army has no weaknesses at all?
translation: Yani Shayzien Ordusu'nun hic zayifligi yok mu?

english: Well... I suppose we don't really have any magical capabilities. That's more an Arceuus thing. Though of course, they're mostly pacifists. Apparently they didn't even properly fight in the War of the Five Houses.
translation: Sey... Sanirim gercekten sihirli yeteneklerimiz yok. Bu daha cok Arceuus'un özelligi. Tabii ki onlar cogunlukla pasifisttir. Görünüse göre Bes Hanedan Savasi'nda bile düzgünce savasmamislar.

english: Still, I guess 'War of the Four Houses while House Arceuus watched' isn't as catchy a name.
translation: Yine de, “Arceuus Hanedani'nin izledigi Dört Hanedan Savasi” pek akilda kalici bir isim degil.

english: Right... But apart from magic, the Shayzien Army has no weaknesses?
translation: Dogru... Ama sihir disinda Shayzien Ordusu'nun hicbir zayifligi yok mu?

english: Well... we are just an army. We don't have a navy, so can't really deal with any threats at sea. Lady Piscarilius is meant to be in charge of the Kourend Navy. Problem is, it doesn't actually exist.
translation: Sey... biz sadece bir orduyuz. Donanmamiz yok, bu yüzden denizdeki tehditlerle basa cikamiyoruz. Leydi Piscarilius, Kourend Donanmasi'nin basinda olmasi gerekiyor. Sorun su ki, donanma aslinda yok.

english: How come?
Lady Piscarilius has little interest in that sort of thing. Lord Shayzien wants to establish a Shayzien Navy instead, but there's a lot of pushback from the rest of the kingdom.
translation: Leydi Piscarilius bu tür seylere pek ilgi duymuyor. Lord Shayzien, bunun yerine Shayzien Donanmasi'ni kurmak istiyor, ama kralligin geri kalanindan büyük bir direnc var.

english: They worry about Shayzien having too much power. It does mean we'll have big problems against any enemy navy, but on their heads be it I suppose.
translation: Shayzien'in cok fazla güce sahip olmasindan endise ediyorlar. Bu, herhangi bir düsman donanmasina karsi büyük sorunlar yasayacagimiz anlamina geliyor, ama bu onlarin sorunu sanirim.

english: Anyway, apart from those minor issues, the Shayzien Army has absolutely no weaknesses!
translation: Her neyse, bu kücük sorunlar disinda, Shayzien Ordusu'nun kesinlikle hicbir zayifligi yok!

english: If you say so. See you later.
Goodbye!
Hi there; what is this room?
Glad you asked. The first thing you will notice on trying to enter the room is that you will be asked to choose either the Attacker, Defender, Collector, Healer or 'any' role.
translation: Sordugunuz icin tesekkürler. Odaya girmeye calistiginizda ilk fark edeceginiz sey, Saldirgan, Savunmaci, Toplayici, Sifaci veya ‘herhangi bir’ rol secmeniz istenecek olmasidir.

english: Okay. I'm following so far.
Well, the idea with this room is that we will set up a game for you, choosing some other people from within the room. If there are enough players around we will start a game for you.
translation: Bu odanin amaci, odadaki diger kisilerden bazilarini secerek sizin icin bir oyun hazirlamaktir. Yeterli sayida oyuncu varsa, sizin icin bir oyun baslatacagiz.

english: I see. So I just have to wait around for a game?
translation: Anladim. Yani sadece oyun icin beklemem mi gerekiyor?

english: If you want, or you can look around the other rooms and see if there is anyone waiting around.
translation: Istersen, diger odalara bakip bekleyen biri var mi diye bakabilirsin.

english: Good to see you, adventurer. Hope everything is going well for you out there.
translation: Seni görmek güzel, maceraci. Umarim her sey yolundadir.

english: Not bad, thanks.
Glad to hear it.
Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: Hey, bu Kahraman! Vay canina! Sen harikasin, o iki juvinate ve Gadderank'i nasil alt ettin? Ve kasaba cok güzel, harika bir is cikarmissin!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
Not that it makes much difference but my name's Sergiu. Like all the other survivors here, I just try to make do and get through each day at a time.
translation: Cok fark etmez ama benim adim Sergiu. Buradaki diger tüm hayatta kalanlar gibi, ben de idare etmeye ve her günü tek tek atlatmaya calisiyorum.

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: Oh, pek bir sey yok, hepimiz hala vampirlerden saklaniyoruz ve bu korkunc yerde gecimimizi sagliyoruz, umarim yakinda Salve'deki tapinaga yolculuk yapacak kadar gücleniriz.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you.
translation: Bildigim kadariyla yok, su anda cok yararli olan bazi temel olanaklara sahibiz, hepimiz size cok minnettariz.

english: I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: Daha önce hic bir kahraman görmedim veya tanimadim, bu yüzden karsilastirma yapabilecegim bir sey yok, ama cogu insanin yargisina göre, siz bir kahramansiniz! Ben sahsen sizinle tanistigima cok memnunum.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Ok, thanks.
Hello!
I'm not sure I should be here. Maybe all this was a bad idea.
translation: Burada olmamam gerektigini düsünüyorum. Belki de tüm bunlar kötü bir fikirdi.

english: What makes you say that?
I want to help... I want to believe... I really do! It's just all so intimidating...
translation: Yardim etmek istiyorum... Inanmak istiyorum... Gercekten istiyorum! Ama her sey cok korkutucu...

english: I'm sure it will be fine.
I hope so.
Hi!
Hi!
Look, I'd better not talk. I'll get in trouble.
translation: Bak, konusmasam daha iyi. Basim belaya girer.

english: If you want someone to show you round the castle ask Eohric, the Head Servant.
translation: Kaleyi gezdirecek biri istiyorsan bas usak Eohric'e sor.

english: I need help, I've been kidnapped by an evil cat!
translation: Yardima ihtiyacim var, kötü bir kedi tarafindan kacirildim!

english: Meow! Errr... I c-c-c-can't help you... He'll kill us all!
translation: Miyav! Eee... S-s-sana yardim edemem... Hepimizi öldürür!

english: Now you listen to me! He's just a little cat! There must be something I can do!
translation: Simdi beni dinle! O sadece kücük bir kedi! Yapabilecegim bir sey olmali!

english: F-f-f-fish... give him the f-f-f-fish he likes and he might f- f-f-fall asleep.
translation: B-b-b-balik... ona sevdigi b-b-b-baligi ver, belki u-u-u-uykuya dalar.

english: Look... over t-t-there! That fishing spot c-c-contains the f-f-f-fish he likes.
translation: Bak... s-s-suraya! O balik tutma yerinde sevdigi b-b-b-balik var.

english: A cutscene starts, showing where to catch the fish that Evil Bob likes.
translation: Evil Bob'un sevdigi baligi nerede yakalayabilecegini gösteren bir kesit baslar.

english: Evil Bob has fallen asleep, come quickly!
translation: Evil Bob uykuya daldi, cabuk gel!

english: Come? Come where?
Away from this place! To Gielinor!
You go, [player name], I don't belong there... I belong here, in ScapeRune. This is the only place I can ever go...
translation: Sen git, Maceraci, ben oraya ait degilim... Ben buraya, ScapeRune'a aidim. Gidebilecegim tek yer burasi...

english: But I love you!
Our love can never be, sweet [player name].
Go now! Go, and don't look back!
translation: Git simdi! Git ve arkana bakma!

english: Oh, alright then, I'll be off! See you around!
translation: Tamam o zaman, ben gidiyorum! Görüsürüz!

english: Meow!!!
What? Why are you meowing?
I mean... L-l-l-leave me alone!
I just want to talk to you, that's all.
translation: Sadece seninle konusmak istiyorum, hepsi bu.

english: No, he's insane! He'll kill us all! Like he killed the others!
translation: Hayir, o deli! Hepimizi öldürecek! Digerlerini öldürdügü gibi!

english: Evil Bob is sleeping! You can escape!
Escape? Escape where?
No, Evil Bob will track us down eventually and when he does...
translation: Hayir, Kötü Bob eninde sonunda bizi bulacak ve buldugunda...

english: No, I dare not leave this place.
Suit yourself then.
But I love you!
Oh, alright then.
Nilsal, my child. I imagine you're hoping for word on our plans for rescuing Itzla. I'm afraid nothing has been decided yet, but once that changes, I am sure you will have a part to play.
translation: Nilsal, çocugum. Itzla'yi kurtarma planlarimizla ilgili haber bekledigini tahmin ediyorum. Maalesef henüz bir karar verilmedi, ama durum degisirse, eminim senin de bu konuda bir rolün olacak.

english: : I see. Thank you, Servius.
Do not lose heart, my child. May the sun light your way.
translation: Umudunu kaybetme, çocugum. Günes yolunu aydinlatsin.

english: M'arnin'....going to milk me cowsies!
What are you?
You can see me!?
No matter. This creature will soon be corrupted and then I will finally have a pawn of my own to manipulate in this world!
translation: Önemli degil. Bu yaratik yakinda yozlasacak ve sonunda bu dünyada manipüle edebilecegim bir piyonum olacak!

english: So... Sorry for killing you?
translation: Yani... Seni öldürdügüm icin üzgün müsün?

english: Insolent human! You have merely delayed my return to this world. I will find another puppet soon...
translation: Küstah insan! Sen sadece bu dünyaya dönüsümü geciktirdin. Yakinda baska bir kukla bulacagim...

english: Yeah Yeah, world domination, that's great and all but do you see that altar you cursed? Could you undo that? I'd like to use it for training down here.
translation: Evet, evet, dünya hakimiyeti, bu harika ama lanetledigin o sunagi görüyor musun? Onu geri alabilir misin? Burada egitim icin kullanmak istiyorum.

english: Ha!Ha!Ha! You are bold adventurer, but this altar will remain a lingering memento of your decision to challenge me!
translation: Ha! Ha! Ha! Sen cesur bir maceracisin, ama bu sunak, bana meydan okuma kararinin kalici bir hatirasi olarak kalacak!

english: Sigh...
I am the void in the universe. I am the answer to all things that cry out for destruction. I am the destroyer of worlds. I am the darkness that swallows the light. Ally to...
translation: Ben evrendeki boslukum. Yikim isteyen her seyin cevabi benim. Ben dünyalarin yok edicisiyim. Isigi yutan karanlik benim. Müttefik...

english: Ok.
BEGONE!
Hey! Yer big elephant! Don't go choppin' down me house, now!
translation: Hey! Seni koca fil! Evimi yikma simdi!

english: Ay yer big elephant! Yer've caught me, to be sure! What would an elephant like yer be wanting wid ol' Shamus then?
translation: Hey, seni koca fil! Beni yakaladin, kesin! Senin gibi bir fil, yasli Shamus'tan ne istiyor olabilir ki?

english: I'm not sure.
Well you'll have to be catchin' me again when yer are, elephant!
translation: Öyleyse, beni tekrar yakalaman gerekecek, fil!

english: The leprechaun magically disappears.
translation: Leprechaun sihirli bir sekilde ortadan kaybolur.

english: I want to find Zanaris.
Zanaris is it now? Well well well... Yer'll be needing to be going to that funny little shed out there in the swamp, so you will.
translation: Zanaris mi simdi? Vay vay vay... Bataklikta bulunan o komik kücük kulübeye gitmen gerekecek.

english: ...but... I thought... Zanaris was a city...?
Aye that it is!
...How does it fit in a shed then?
Ah yer stupid elephant! The city isn't IN the shed! The doorway to the shed is being a portal to Zanaris, so it is.
translation: Ah, seni aptal fil! Sehir kulübenin icinde degil! Kulübenin kapisi Zanaris'e acilan bir gecit, o kadar.

english: So I just walk into the shed and end up in Zanaris then?
translation: Yani kulübeye girip Zanaris'e mi varacagim?

english: Oh, was I fergetting to say? Yer need to be carrying a Dramenwood staff to be getting there! Otherwise Yer'll just be ending up in the shed.
translation: Oh, söylemeyi unuttum mu? Oraya gitmek icin Dramenwood asasi tasiman gerekiyor! Aksi takdirde kulübede kalirsin.

english: So where would I get a staff?
Dramenwood staffs are crafted from branches of the Dramen tree, so they are. I hear there's a Dramen tree over on the island of Entrana in a cave
translation: Dramenwood asalari Dramen agacinin dallarindan yapilir. Entrana adasindaki bir magarada Dramen agaci oldugunu duydum.

english: or some such. There would probably be a good place for an elephant like yer to be starting looking I reckon.
translation: Senin gibi bir filin aramaya baslamasi icin iyi bir yer olabilir.

english: The monks are running a ship from Port Sarim to Entrana, I hear too. Now leave me alone yer elephant!
translation: Kesisler Port Sarim'den Entrana'ya bir gemi isletiyorlarmis. Simdi beni rahat birak, seni fil!

english: I've been in that shed. I didn't see a city.
translation: O kulübeye girdim. Bir sehir görmedim.

english: Ha! Look at yer! Look at the stupid elephant who tries to go catching a leprechaun when he don't even be knowing what he wants!
translation: Ha! Su haline bak! Ne istedigini bile bilmeden leprikon yakalamaya calisan aptal fil!

english: How do I get to Zanaris again?
Yer stupid elephant! I'll tell yer again! Yer need to be entering the shed in the middle of the swamp while holding a dramenwood staff! Yer can make the Dramen staff
translation: Aptal fil! Bir daha söyleyecegim! Batakligin ortasindaki kulübeye dramenwood asasi tutarak girmelisin! Dramen asasini

english: from a dramen tree branch, and there's a Dramen tree on Entrana! Now leave me alone yer great elephant!
translation: dramen agacinin dalindan yapabilirsin ve Entrana'da dramen agaci var! Simdi beni rahat birak, seni koca fil!

english: How does it fit in a shed then?
I've been in that shed, I didn't see a city.
I'm not sure.
How do I get to Zanaris again?
Greetings [player name]. Welcome you are in the test of combat.
translation: Merhaba Maceraci. Hos geldin, savas sinavindasin.

english: What do I do here?

A spare suit of plate armour need you will. Full helm, plate leggings and platebody yes? Placing it in the centre of the magical machines you will be doing. KA- POOF! The armour, it attacks most furiously as if
translation: Yedek bir zirh takimina ihtiyacin olacak. Tam migfer, zirhli tozluk ve zirhli gövde, tamam mi? Onu sihirli makinelerin ortasina yerlestireceksin. KA- POOF! Zirh, sanki canliymis gibi cok siddetli saldiriyor!

english: alive! Kill it you must, yes.
So I use a full set of plate armour on the centre plate of the machines and it will animate it? Then I have to kill my own armour... how bizarre!
translation: Yani makinelerin ortasindaki plakaya tam bir zirh takarsam canlanacak mi? O zaman kendi zirhimi öldürmem gerekecek... Ne tuhaf!

english: Yes. It is as you are saying. For this earn tokens you will. Also gain experience in combat you will. Trained long and hard here have I.
translation: Evet. Dedigin gibi. Bunun icin jeton kazanacaksin. Ayrica savasta deneyim kazanacaksin. Burada uzun ve zorlu bir egitim aldim.

english: You're not from around here are you...?
It is as you say.
So will I lose my armour?
Lose armour you will if damaged too much it becomes. Rare this is, but still possible. If kill you the armour does, also lose armour you will.
translation: Cok fazla hasar görürse zirhini kaybedersin. Bu nadir olur, ama yine de mümkündür. Zirh seni öldürürse, zirhini da kaybedersin.

english: So, occasionally I might lose a bit because it's being bashed about and I'll obviously lose it if I die... that it?
translation: Yani, bazen zirhim hasar gördügü icin biraz kaybedebilirim ve ölürsem tabii ki kaybederim... öyle mi?

english: Where do the machines come from?
Make them I did, with magics.
Magic, in the Warrior's Guild?
A skilled warrior also am I. Harrallak mistakes does not make. Potential in my invention he sees and opportunity grasps.
translation: Ben de yetenekli bir savasciyim. Harrallak hata yapmaz. Icatlarimdaki potansiyeli görüyor ve firsatlari degerlendiriyor.

english: I see, so you made the magical machines and Harrallak saw how they could be used in the guild to train warrior's combat... interesting. Harrallak certainly is an intelligent guy.
translation: Anliyorum, yani sen büyülü makineleri yaptin ve Harrallak bunlarin loncada savascilarin egitimi icin nasil kullanilabilecegini gördü... ilginc. Harrallak kesinlikle zeki bir adam.

english: May I claim my tokens please?
No space you have carry them for.
Right, I need space in my pack for them. I'll be back!
translation: Dogru, cantamda onlara yer acmam lazim. Geri gelecegim!

english: Yes yes! Earned you have [number] token[s]!
Thanks!
No tokens earned have you. In training activities participate you must.
translation: Hic jeton kazanmadin. Egitim faaliyetlerine katilmalisin.

english: Okay, I'll go see what I can find to do around here to earn some tokens.
translation: Tamam, burada jeton kazanmak icin ne yapabilecegime bakacagim.

english: Bye!
Health be with you travelling.
My armour disappeared!
Correct you are. Not killed it was. Collected your armour I did.
Excellent, may I have it so I can try the machine again?
translation: Harika, makineyi tekrar denemek icin alabilir miyim?

english: Space you will need in your pack.
Okay, I'll go make some room in my inventory and come back.
translation: Tamam, cantamda yer acip geri gelecegim.

english: Plain full plate armour in those machines only you may use, of appropriate materials. When other items used, bad things happen, yes!
translation: O makinelerde sadece uygun malzemelerden yapilmis düz tam zirh kullanabilirsin. Baska esyalar kullanilirsa, kötü seyler olur, evet!

english: Okay, so I can only use plain full plate armour of appropriate materials, no trimmed armour or unusual kit?
translation: Tamam, yani sadece uygun malzemelerden yapilmis düz tam zirh kullanabilirim, süslemeli zirh veya sira disi ekipman kullanamam?

english: Those things which cannot be seen, perceive them.
Do nothing which is of no use.
Think not dishonestly.
The Way in training is.
Gain and loss between you must distinguish.
translation: Kazanc ve kayip arasinda ayrim yapmalisin.

english: Trifles pay attention even to.
Way of the warrior this is.
Acquainted with every art become.
Ways of all professions know you.
Judgment and understanding for everything develop you must.
translation: Her sey icin yargi ve anlayis gelistir.

english: What do I do here?
Where do the machines come from?
May I claim my tokens please?
Bye!
My armour disappeared!
Hello effendi, I am Shantay.
I see you're new. Please read the billboard poster before going into the desert. It'll give yer details on the dangers you can face.
translation: Yeni geldiginizi görüyorum. Cöle girmeden önce lütfen ilan panosundaki afisi okuyun. Karsilasabileceginiz tehlikelerle ilgili ayrintili bilgi verecektir.

english: There is a heartbroken mother just past the gates and in the desert. Her name is Irena and she mourns her lost daughter. Such a shame.
translation: Kapilarin hemen ötesinde, cölde kalbi kirik bir anne var. Adi Irena ve kaybettigi kizinin yasini tutuyor. Ne yazik.

english: Hello again friend. Please read the billboard poster before going into the desert. It'll give yer details on the dangers you can face.
translation: Merhaba dostum. Cöle girmeden önce lütfen ilan panosunu okuyun. Karsilasabileceginiz tehlikeler hakkinda ayrintili bilgi verecektir.

english: What is this place?
This is the pass of Shantay. I guard this area with my men. I am responsible for keeping this pass open and repaired.
translation: Burasi Shantay Gecidi. Adamlarimla birlikte bu bölgeyi koruyorum. Bu gecidi acik ve bakimli tutmaktan sorumluyum.

english: My men and I prevent outlaws from getting out of the desert. And we stop the inexperienced from a dry death in the sands. Which would you say you were?
translation: Adamlarim ve ben, kanun kacaklarinin cölden cikmasini engelliyoruz. Ve deneyimsizlerin kumlarda susuzluktan ölmesini önlüyoruz. Sen hangisisin?

english: I am definitely an outlaw, prepare to die!
translation: Ben kesinlikle bir haydutum, ölmeye hazir ol!

english: Ha, very funny.....
Guards arrest [him/her]!
The guards arrest you and place you in the jail.
translation: Muhafizlar seni tutuklar ve hapse atar.

english: The player is put in the Shantay Pass jail.
You'll have to stay in there until you pay the fine of five gold pieces. Do you want to pay now?
translation: Bes altin para cezayi ödeyene kadar orada kalmak zorundasin. Simdi ödemek ister misin?

english: Yes, okay.
Good, I see that you have come to your senses.
Great Effendi, now please try to keep the peace.
translation: Harika Effendi, lütfen simdi sükuneti koru.

english: You hand over five gold pieces to Shantay.
Shantay unlocks the door to the cell.
You don't have that kind of cash on you I see.
translation: Görüyorum ki üzerinde o kadar nakit yok.

english: You are to be transported to a maximum security prison in Port Sarim.
translation: Port Sarim'deki maksimum güvenlikli hapishaneye nakledileceksin.

english: I hope you've learnt an important lesson from this.
translation: Umarim bundan önemli bir ders almissindir.

english: I would transport you to a maximum security prison in Port Sarim. However since you haven't unlocked access to Asgarnia consider yourself lucky.
translation: Seni Port Sarim'deki maksimum güvenlikli hapishaneye naklederdim. Ancak Asgarnia'ya erisim izni almadigin icin kendini sansli say.

english: But perhaps you have some in your bank? Or would you prefer the maximum security prison in Port Sarim.
translation: Ama belki bankanda biraz vardir? Yoksa Port Sarim'deki maksimum güvenlikli hapishaneyi mi tercih edersin?

english: Which is it going to be?
I'll pay the fine.
Okay then..., you'll need access to your bank.
translation: Tamam o zaman... Bankana erisim izni alman gerekecek.

english: No thanks, you're not having my money.
Very well, I grow tired of you, you'll be taken to a new jail in Port Sarim.
translation: Peki, senden biktim, Port Sarim'deki yeni hapishaneye götürüleceksin.

english: The player is transported to the "Maximum security prison" in Port Sarim.
translation: Oyuncu, Port Sarim'deki “Maksimum güvenlikli hapishaneye” nakledilir.

english: You have a choice. You can either pay five gold pieces or... You can be transported to a maximum security prison in Port Sarim.
translation: Bir secenegin var. Ya bes altin ödersin ya da... Port Sarim'deki maksimum güvenlikli hapishaneye nakledilirsin.

english: Will you pay the five gold pieces?
You find yourself in a prison.
I am a little inexperienced.
Can I recommend that you purchase a full waterskin and a knife! These items will no doubt save your life. A waterskin will keep water from evaporating in the desert.
translation: Tam bir su tulumu ve bir bicak satin almani tavsiye ederim! Bu esyalar süphesiz hayatini kurtaracaktir. Su tulumu, cölde suyun buharlasmasini önler.

english: And a keen woodsman with a knife can extract the juice from a cactus. Before you go into the desert, it's advisable to wear desert clothes. It's very hot in the desert and you'll surely cook if you wear armour.
translation: Ve bicagi olan usta bir oduncu, kaktüsten suyu cikarabilir. Cöle gitmeden önce cöl kiyafetleri giymen tavsiye edilir. Cöl cok sicaktir ve zirh giyersen kesinlikle pisersin.

english: To keep the pass bandit free, we charge a small toll of five gold pieces. You can buy a desert pass from me, just ask me to open the shop. You can also use our free banking services by clicking on the chest.
translation: Gecidi haydutlardan korumak icin bes altinlik kücük bir gecis ücreti aliyoruz. Benden cöl gecis izni satin alabilirsiniz, dükkani acmami isteyin yeter. Sandigi tiklayarak ücretsiz bankacilik hizmetlerimizi de kullanabilirsiniz.

english: Why do I have to pay to go into the desert?
translation: Neden cöle girmek icin para ödemek zorundayim?

english: Effendi, you insult me! I am not interested in making a profit from you! I merely seek to cover my expenses in keeping this pass open.
translation: Efendi, beni asagiliyorsunuz! Sizden kar elde etmekle ilgilenmiyorum! Sadece bu gecidi acik tutmak icin masraflarimi karsilamaya calisiyorum.

english: There is repair work to carry out and also the men's wages to consider. For the paltry sum of 5 Gold pieces, I think we offer a great service.
translation: Yapilmasi gereken onarim isleri ve calisanlarin maaslari da var. 5 altin gibi cüzi bir miktar karsiliginda, bence harika bir hizmet sunuyoruz.

english: Er, neither, I'm an adventurer.
translation: Ikisi de degil, ben bir maceraciyim.

english: Great, I have just the thing for the desert adventurer. I sell desert clothes which will keep you cool in the heat of the desert. I also sell waterskins so that you won't die in the desert.
translation: Harika, cöl maceracilari icin tam da uygun bir seyim var. Cölün sicaginda serin tutacak cöl kiyafetleri satiyorum. Ayrica cölde ölmemeniz icin su tulumlari da satiyorum.

english: A waterskin and a knife help you survive from the juice of a cactus. Use the chest to store your items, we'll take them to the bank. It's hot in the desert, you'll bake in all that armour.
translation: Su tulumu ve bicak, kaktüsün özsuyuyla hayatta kalmaniza yardimci olur. Esyalarinizi sandikta saklayin, biz onlari bankaya götürürüz. Cöl cok sicaktir, o zirhin icinde pisersiniz.

english: To keep the pass open we ask for 5 gold pieces. And we give you a Shantay Pass, just ask to see what I sell to buy one.
translation: Gecidi acik tutmak icin 5 altin istiyoruz. Size bir Shantay Gecidi veriyoruz, satin almak icin sattigim ürünleri görmek isterseniz söyleyin.

english: You should be in jail! Well, no doubt the authorities in Port Sarim know what they're doing. But if you get into any more trouble, you'll be stuck back in jail.
translation: Hapiste olmalisin! Süphesiz Port Sarim yetkilileri ne yaptiklarini biliyorlar. Ama basini daha fazla belaya sokarsan, tekrar hapse girersin.

english: Can I see what you have to sell please?
Absolutely Effendi!
I must be going.
So long...
I want to buy a Shantay pass for 5 gold coins.
translation: 5 altin karsiliginda bir Shantay gecis karti satin almak istiyorum.

english: Sorry effendi, I can't offer this service right now.
translation: Üzgünüm efendi, su anda bu hizmeti sunamiyorum.

english: Sorry friend, the Shantay Pass is 5 gold coins. You don't seem to have enough money!
translation: Üzgünüm dostum, Shantay Gecis Karti 5 altin. Yeterli paran yok gibi görünüyor!

english: Sorry friend, you'll need more inventory space to buy a pass.
translation: Üzgünüm dostum, gecis karti satin almak icin daha fazla envanter alanina ihtiyacin var.

english: The door is locked.
Shantay saunters over to talk with you.
translation: Shantay seninle konusmak icin yanina geliyor.

english: If you want to be let out, you have to pay a fine of five gold. Do you want to pay now?
translation: Disari cikmak istiyorsan, bes altin para cezasi ödemen gerekiyor. Simdi ödemek ister misin?

english: Well done.
You've [found a new clue/obtained a casket]!
translation: Yeni bir ipucu buldun/bir tabut elde ettin!

english: What is this place?
I am definitely an outlaw, prepare to die!
translation: Ben kesinlikle bir kanun kacagiyim, ölmeye hazir ol!

english: Yes, okay.
I'll pay the fine.
No thanks, you're not having my money.
No, do your worst!
I am a little inexperienced.
Can I see what you have to sell please?
I must be going.
Why do I have to pay to go into the desert?
translation: Neden cöle girmek icin para ödemek zorundayim?

english: Er, neither, I'm an adventurer.
translation: Ikisi de degil, ben bir maceraciyim.

english: I want to buy a Shantay pass for 5 gold coins.
translation: 5 altin karsiliginda bir Shantay gecis karti satin almak istiyorum.

english: Go talk to Shantay. I'm on duty and I don't have time to talk to the likes of you!
translation: Shantay ile konus. Ben görevdeyim ve senin gibilerle konusacak vaktim yok!

english: Hello there! What can I do for you?
I'd like to go into the desert please.
You'll need a Shantay pass to go through the gate into the desert. See Shantay, he'll sell you one for a very reasonable price.
translation: Cöle girmek icin Shantay gecis kartina ihtiyacin var. Shantay'a git, sana cok uygun bir fiyata satacaktir.

english: Nothing thanks.
Okay then, have a nice day.
I'd like to go into the desert please.
Nothing thanks.
Why is there a Shantay Pass here?
translation: Neden burada Shantay Gecis Karti var?

english: There's been an influx of new business to these ruins. Shantay sent us out here to make some money.
translation: Bu harabelere yeni isler akin etti. Shantay bizi buraya para kazanmamiz icin gönderdi.

english: Shantay once told me that he's not interested in profit!
translation: Shantay bir keresinde bana kârla ilgilenmedigini söylemisti!

english: Have you seen the state of this place? We're helping to provide vital repair costs to the people!
translation: Bu yerin durumunu gördün mü? Insanlara hayati onarim masraflarini karsilamaya yardim ediyoruz!

english: I see.
Not really our fault if they spend their cut on fancy outfits!
translation: Kârlarini lüks kiyafetlere harcamalari bizim sucumuz degil!

english: I must be going.
Safe travels, friend.
Can I see what you have to sell please?
Absolutely, friend.
I want to buy a Shantay pass for 5 gold coins.
translation: 5 altin karsiliginda bir Shantay gecis karti satin almak istiyorum.

english: You purchase a Shantay Pass.
translation: Bir Shantay gecis karti satin aldin.

english: Sorry friend, the Shantay Pass is 5 gold coins. You don't seem to have enough money!
translation: Üzgünüm dostum, Shantay gecis karti 5 altin. Yeterli paran yok gibi görünüyor!

english: Why is there a Shantay Pass here?
translation: Neden burada Shantay gecis karti var?

english: Can I see what you have to sell please?
I must be going.
I want to buy a Shantay pass for 5 gold coins.
translation: 5 altin sikke karsiliginda bir Shantay gecis karti satin almak istiyorum.

english: Can I see what you have to sell please
What do you do here?
I's not doing a great deal now Bwana, as I'm no spring chicken. I do my fair share around the village bwana, though, I could tell you a thing or two about the jungle slashing.
translation: Artik pek bir sey yapmiyorum Bwana, cünkü genc degilim. Köyde üzerime düsen görevi yapiyorum Bwana, ama sana orman kesimi hakkinda bir iki sey söyleyebilirim.

english: Ok, tell me about jungle slashing!
Ok Bwana, I will! To begin with you'll need a machete in order to hack your way through the jungle. There are some better gem edged weapons which you may be able to purchase from Gabooty.
translation: Tamam Bwana, anlatayim! Öncelikle, ormanda yolunuzu acmak icin bir pala gerekir. Gabooty'den satin alabileceginiz daha iyi mücevher kenarli silahlar da var.

english: Safta Doc makes them for him. You should be aware that hacking away at the jungle is not without its dangers though Bwana. Many times you may find some scary creatures lurking inside.
translation: Safta Doc bunlari onun icin yapiyor. Ancak, ormanda yolunuzu acmanin tehlikesiz olmadigini bilmelisiniz Bwana. Cogu zaman, icinde korkutucu yaratiklar gizleniyor olabilir.

english: What sort of creatures?
Ok, to start with there are spiders! These are pretty tough but if you defeat it, you can get a good meal from it, if you know how to cook it that is. My wife cooks them to a turn - Mmmm, delicious.
translation: Tamam, öncelikle örümcekler var! Bunlar oldukca zordur, ancak onlari yenerseniz, nasil pisireceginizi biliyorsaniz, onlardan iyi bir yemek elde edebilirsiniz. Karim onlari cok iyi pisirir - Mmmm, lezzetli.

english: Ok go on!

Yes Bwana, of course. Then there are snakes...these are dangerous because they're poisonous - so be prepared! However, they're not without their uses. A bush snake is large enough to have a useful hide.
translation: Evet Bwana, elbette. Sonra yilanlar var... bunlar zehirli olduklari icin tehlikelidir - bu yüzden hazirlikli olun! Ancak, yararlari da yok degil. Cali yilani, yararli bir deri elde etmek icin yeterince büyüktür.

english: Once the hide is tanned you get a snakeskin and you're able to make things from it, the same way that mainlanders use normal leather! However, it's actually still quite small.
translation: Deri tabaklandiktan sonra yilan derisi elde edersiniz ve bununla, anakaralilarin normal deriyi kullandigi gibi cesitli seyler yapabilirsiniz! Ancak, aslinda hala oldukca kücüktür.

english: You may need several skins in order to make something useful.
translation: Yararli bir sey yapmak icin birkac deriye ihtiyaciniz olabilir.

english: Hmm, sounds interesting!

Then there are giant mosquitoes bwana, they're fast and agile. You'll need to be quick if you're to hit them at all! However, it certainly does train your reactions. They're not very tough, just difficult to hit.
translation: Bir de dev sivrisinekler var bwana, cok hizli ve ceviktirler. Onlari vurmak icin cok hizli olmaniz gerekir! Ancak, bu kesinlikle tepki hizinizi gelistirir. Cok dayanikli degiller, sadece vurmasi zorlar.

english: I also believe that their proboscis is useful in someway, I believe Timfraku's sons sometimes use them for hunting.
translation: Ayrica, hortumlarinin da bir sekilde yararli oldugunu düsünüyorum, Timfraku'nun ogullari bazen avlanmak icin kullaniyorlar.

english: Ok, that sounds helpful...anything else?
translation: Tamam, bu yararli görünüyor... baska bir sey var mi?

english: Yes Bwana, much much more! What next...Oh yes, the tribesmen...you've probably seen them scouting around the village, sometimes sneaking inside the enclosure to steal our chickens!
translation: Evet Bwana, cok daha fazlasi var! Sirada ne var... Ah evet, kabile üyeleri... muhtemelen onlari köyün cevresinde kesif yaparken görmüssündür, bazen citlerin icine gizlice girip tavuklarimizi caliyorlar!

english: They sometimes hide in the jungle bushes waiting for an opportunity to strike when we least expect it! Take care Bwana, these treacherous jungle natives use poison on their spears!
translation: Bazen orman calilarinin arasinda saklanip, en beklemedigimiz anda saldirmak icin firsat kolluyorlar! Dikkatli ol Bwana, bu hain orman yerlileri mizraklarina zehir sürüyorlar!

english: Right Ok, good advice... 'poison on spears....' Anything else I should know about?
translation: Tamam, iyi bir tavsiye... ‘mizraklara zehir...’ Bilmem gereken baska bir sey var mi?

english: Yes Bwana... and this is serious... The jungle is very ancient and many unspeakable acts have been witnessed on these lands. Bizarre supernatural curses were placed on criminals and then they were buried alive!
translation: Evet Bwana... ve bu cok ciddi... Orman cok eskidir ve bu topraklarda bircok tarif edilemez olay yasanmistir. Suclulara tuhaf dogaüstü lanetler konmus ve sonra canli canli gömülmüslerdir!

english: These strange creatures have the curse of the Broodoo on them! They'll rise from their grave with their heads in their chests and move like crazy spirits of the afterlife.
translation: Bu garip yaratiklar Broodoo'nun lanetine maruz kalmislar! Kafalari gögüslerinde mezarlarindan kalkacaklar ve öbür dünyadan gelen cilgin ruhlar gibi hareket edecekler.

english: If they're disturbed they will attack anything in the area with their magical abilities! They suffer little from being attacked as they seem to be protected by some form of defence.
translation: Rahatsiz edildiklerinde, sihirli gücleriyle bölgedeki her seye saldiracaklar! Bir tür savunma mekanizmasi tarafindan korunduklari icin saldirilara karsi cok az zarar görürler.

english: However... it is said that the means of their death provides the clue to their destruction. So far three distinct Broodoo have been identified. The Broodoo with a green hued skin is said to have died from poison.
translation: Ancak... ölümlerinin nedeni, yok edilmelerinin ipucunu saglar. Simdiye kadar üc farkli Broodoo tanimlanmistir. Yesil renkli derisi olan Broodoo'nun zehirden öldügü söylenir.

english: There is a broodoo of yellow hue and a pale skinned broodoo, but little is known of these two!
translation: Sari renkli ve soluk tenli bir Broodoo daha vardir, ancak bu ikisi hakkinda cok az sey bilinmektedir!

english: Erk! Well that sounds pretty scary!
Yes Bwana...
Ok, thanks a lot....
Wait Bwana, there's more!
More... Blimey! Ok carry on...
translation: Daha... Vay canina! Tamam, devam et...

english: Some of the local villagers have found strange plants which grow here-abouts. If you cut away at the jungle and find one, it's considered a blessing, though the useful part of the plant is usually buried underground.
translation: Bazi yerel köylüler bu civarda yetisen garip bitkiler bulmuslar. Ormani kesip bir tane bulursan, bu bir lütuf olarak kabul edilir, ancak bitkinin yararli kismi genellikle yer altinda gömülüdür.

english: And also, you may find an uncommon rock type which is impregnated with mineral wealth! Well that concludes all the help I can give you regarding the jungle in Tai Bwo Wannai!
translation: Ayrica, mineral zengini nadir bir kaya türü de bulabilirsiniz! Tai Bwo Wannai'deki ormanla ilgili size verebilecegim tüm bilgiler bu kadar!

english: I have to say, that's quite a lot of information...thanks very much!
translation: Söylemeliyim ki, bu oldukca fazla bilgi... cok tesekkürler!

english: You're more than welcome bwana!
Is there anything interesting to do around here?
translation: Buralarda ilginc bir seyler var mi?

english: Bwana, if anyone else asks me that question today, I'll explode! Go and ask someone else!
translation: Bwana, bugün baska biri bana bu soruyu sorarsa, patlayacagim! Git baskasina sor!

english: Not that I'm aware of, just sit back and enjoy the sunshine bwana!
translation: Bildigim kadariyla yok, arkana yaslan ve günesin tadini cikar bwana!

english: Sorry Bwana, I'm already busy, why not go and talk to Murcaily! He's around the village somewhere.
translation: Üzgünüm Bwana, ben zaten mesgulüm, neden Murcaily ile konusmuyorsun! Köyün buralarinda bir yerlerde.

english: Well, I think that there's some work to be done...perhaps Murcaily can help you. He usually tends to the hardwood grove to the east of Trufitus's hut.
translation: Sanirim yapilacak bazi isler var... belki Murcaily sana yardimci olabilir. Genellikle Trufitus'un kulübesinin dogusundaki sert agac korusunda calisir.

english: It's just village life as normal around here Bwana, always something interesting to find to occupy your time if you look hard enough.
translation: Burada köy hayati normal seyrinde devam ediyor Bwana, yeterince dikkatli bakarsan zamanini gecirecek ilginc seyler bulabilirsin.

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
Yeah, you've been doing a lot of good work around here. Let me give you something for your time and effort.
translation: Evet, burada cok iyi isler yapiyorsun. Zamanin ve emeklerin icin sana bir sey vereyim.

english: You get [amount] trading sticks. You are left with [amount]% favour.
I've already given you some trading sticks and I don't have any more on me at the moment. Why not go and talk to some of the other villagers and get some contributions?
translation: Sana zaten bazi ticaret cubuklari verdim ve su anda üzerimde baska yok. Neden gidip diger köylülerle konusup biraz katki almiyorsun?

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
Ok, tell me about jungle slashing!
Previous questions.
Is there anything interesting to do here?
translation: Burada yapilacak ilginc bir sey var mi?

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
Ok, thanks.
Greetings!
Oh hello there, I'm an architect.
I wondered if you might have some time to help...?
So sorry, too busy at the moment.
Hello again. How are you?
Great! Since working on that statue, everyone wants a miniature - very handy for business!
translation: Harika! O heykel üzerinde calismaya basladigimdan beri herkes minyatürünü istiyor, is icin cok kullanisli!

english: Quiet! I'm here observing the lizardmen shamans, try not to blow my cover.
translation: Sessiz ol! Buraya kertenkele adam samanlarini gözlemlemeye geldim, kimligimi aciga cikarmaya calisma.

english: You don't seem to be hiding very well.
As if you could do better!
Riiiight, anyways, can I attack these lizardmen shaman?
translation: Tamam, neyse, bu kertenkele adam samanlarina saldirabilir miyim?

english: Absolutely not! Do you want to get me killed? Now get out of here and stop trying to blow my cover!
translation: Kesinlikle hayir! Beni öldürmek mi istiyorsun? Simdi buradan git ve kimligimi aciga cikarmaya calismayi birak!

english: Well I don't like the idea of you risking my cover. You are trusted by the Shayzien people though, so I suppose you can. Just be careful.
translation: Kimligimi riske atma fikri hosuma gitmiyor. Shayzien halki sana güveniyor, o yüzden sanirim yapabilirsin. Sadece dikkatli ol.

english: Baa!
I can't speak to the penguins when I'm not in my disguise.
Hello, I've just finished composing my latest poem. Would you like to hear it?
translation: Merhaba, en son siirimi yazmayi bitirdim. Dinlemek ister misin?

english: Yes, please.
Excellent! The humansan aficionado! Make yourself comfortable and I'll begin...
translation: Harika! Insan sever! Rahatina bak, ben baslayayim...

english: Twinkle, twinkle little egg Wouldn't you like to grow some legs?And run around, on grass so green arguing with the milk and cream.
translation: Parilda, parilda kücük yumurta Bacaklarin olsun ister misin? Ve yesil cimlerde kosmak, süt ve krema ile tartismak.

english: T'was brillig and the slithey toathes Did gyre and gimbol in the wabe All mimsy were the borrowgroves And the mome raths outgrabe.
translation: T'was brillig ve slithey toathes Wabe'de gyre ve gimbol yaptilar Tüm mimsy borrowgroves ve mome raths outgrabe idi.

english: That's not even your poem, you idiotic, animated ball of wool!
translation: Bu senin siirlerin bile degil, seni aptal, canlanmis yün yumagi!

english: How now foolish cow? Do you read poetry, instead of pulling a plow?
translation: Ne var aptal inek? Saban cekmek yerine siir mi okuyorsun?

english: I'm not talking to you any more, you're nasty.
Oh no! Cow's not talking to me!
Do I look like I care?
I wish I was a cow My life would be so simple I could lie around just eating grass And wonder if I was a pimple.
translation: Keske bir inek olsaydim Hayatim cok basit olurdu Cimlerde uzanip ot yiyebilirdim Ve sivilce olup olmadigimi merak ederdim.

english: Hahaha, I don't think!
Well I thought it was funny.
How goes it, blade of grass? I'm glad you're not any thinner You should invite your friends around So I can have my dinner!
translation: Nasil gidiyor, cim yapragi? Daha zayif olmadigin icin mutluyum. Arkadaslarini davet etmelisin, böylece aksam yemegimi yiyebilirim!

english: No thanks.
Huh, the cow's right. You humans have absolutely no understanding of art!
translation: Huh, inek hakli. Siz insanlar sanattan hic anlamiyorsunuz!

english: Do you know what these strange marks mean?
translation: Bu garip isaretlerin ne anlama geldigini biliyor musun?

english: The humans found some symbolsAnd doesn't know what they meanSo now it's cross-examining meAnd spoiling my routine!
translation: Insanlar bazi semboller buldular ve ne anlama geldiklerini bilmiyorlar, simdi de beni sorguya cekiyorlar ve rutinimi bozuyorlar!

english: You give me a hair-cut and then expect me to talk to you? I think not!
translation: Sacimi kesiyorsun ve sonra benimle konusmami mi bekliyorsun? Sanmiyorum!

english: Yes, please.
No thanks.
Hey, who're you?
I'm Sherlock, master of clues and challenges.
translation: Ben Sherlock, ipuclari ve zorluklarin ustasi.

english: Clues and challenges?
If you find a scroll that requires my attention, bring it to me and I shall handle it.
translation: Dikkatimi gerektiren bir parsömen bulursan, onu bana getir, ben hallederim.

english: I will! but...
You're not wearing a shirt?
Yeah, no shirt Sherlock.....
Ah, just what I was looking for. I have a challenge for you. If you complete it, I'll give you something.
translation: Ah, tam da aradigim sey. Sana bir meydan okuma var. Eger basarirsan, sana bir sey verecegim.

english: Fantastic! Here, have this.
Welcome to the Cloak and Stagger! Anything I can get you?
translation: Cloak and Stagger'a hos geldin! Ne alirsin?

english: I'd like to order a drink, please.
translation: Bir icki siparis etmek istiyorum, lütfen.

english: Of course, what would you like?
Got anything special on tap?
We're always running a keg of our locally-brewed ale, Lizardkicker.
translation: Her zaman yerel olarak üretilen Lizardkicker birasini sunuyoruz.

english: I will warn you though, its an acquired taste.
translation: Ama sunu söylemeliyim, bu biranin tadi aliskanlik gerektirir.

english: What's in it?
Oh, the usual... Wheat, hops, yeast...
translation: Her zamanki gibi... Bugday, serbetciotu, maya...

english: ...reptile scales...
Scales?!
Don't worry about the scales.
Was there anything else?
What is this place?
This here is the Cloak and Stagger. The finest drinking establishment in the whole of Shayzien.
translation: Burasi Cloak and Stagger. Shayzien'in en iyi icki mekani.

english: Isn't it the only pub in the city?
translation: Bu sehirdeki tek pub degil mi?

english: Like I say, the finest in all of Shayzien!
Most of our patrons are soldiers returning on leave from the frontlines. We do get a few regular folk in too though.
translation: Müsterilerimizin cogu cepheden izinli olarak dönen askerler. Ama birkac tane de düzenli müsterimiz var.

english: By the way, its generally considered polite to buy a drink if you're going to stand around and chat.
translation: Bu arada, burada durup sohbet edecekseniz, bir icki ismarlamak genel olarak nezaket geregidir.

english: ...With that said, is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: ...Bununla birlikte, size yardimci olabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: Burada herhangi bir söylenti duydunuz mu?

english: Apparently Veos is looking for some help with something. He hangs around the docks of Port Piscarilius.
translation: Görünüse göre Veos bir konuda yardim ariyor. Port Piscarilius limaninda takiliyor.

english: They say there's trouble in Port Piscarilius. Something about gangs uniting. Might be worth looking into.
translation: Port Piscarilius'ta sorunlar oldugu söyleniyor. Cetelerin birlestigi ile ilgili bir sey. Arastirmaya deger olabilir.

english: I hear that Lord Hosidius has misplaced one of his sons. The Hosidius family might pay a lot to see him returned safely.
translation: Lord Hosidius'un ogullarindan birini kaybettigini duydum. Hosidius ailesi, oglunun sag salim geri dönmesi icin cok para ödeyebilir.

english: Phileas Rimor has supposedly been looking for some assistance with something in Shayzien. Maybe worth investigating.
translation: Phileas Rimor'un Shayzien'de bir konuda yardim aradigi söyleniyor. Arastirmaya deger olabilir.

english: I hear that the rulers of Lovakengj have some work available. You'll find them in the Lovakengj Assembly.
translation: Lovakengj'in yöneticilerinin bazi isleri oldugunu duydum. Onlari Lovakengj Meclisi'nde bulabilirsiniz.

english: Apparently there's been some commotion in the middle of Arceuus. Might be worth checking out.
translation: Görünüse göre Arceuus'un ortasinda bir kargasa var. Bir göz atmaya deger olabilir.

english: That protest outside Kourend Castle is starting to attract some attention. Could be worth taking a look.
translation: Kourend Kalesi'nin disindaki protesto dikkat cekmeye basladi. Bir göz atmaya deger olabilir.

english: No, it hasn't been very busy lately.
translation: Hayir, son zamanlarda cok yogun degildi.

english: Actually, I think I need to be going.
Safe travels!
I'd like to order a drink, please.
translation: Bir icki siparis etmek istiyorum, lütfen.

english: Got anything special on tap?
What is this place?
Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: Burada herhangi bir söylenti duydun mu?

english: Actually, I think I need to be going.
Hello there.
Greetings adventurer.
What's with all the shields?
Although archers like myself like to keep distance from our enemies, it's always good to have a bit of protection.
translation: Benim gibi okcular düsmanlarindan uzak durmayi severler, ama biraz koruma olmasi her zaman iyidir.

english: Very sensible! Did you make these yourself?
translation: Cok mantikli! Bunlari kendin mi yaptin?

english: I am a bit of a craftsman, I indeed made all these shields.
translation: Ben biraz zanaatkarim, evet, tüm bu kalkanlari ben yaptim.

english: How do you make them?
It's very simple! First you'll need to be skilled in crafting and fletching, the exact details you can find in your skill guide.
translation: Cok basit! Öncelikle zanaat ve ok yapiminda yetenekli olmalisin, ayrintilari beceri kilavuzunda bulabilirsin.

english: For every shield, you'll require some tools! A knife for fletching the wood and a hammer for crafting the shield.
translation: Her kalkan icin bazi aletlere ihtiyacin olacak! Ahsabi kesmek icin bir bicak ve kalkani yapmak icin bir cekic.

english: As for resources, you'll need 2 logs, 2 pieces of tanned leather and 15 nails.
translation: Kaynak olarak ise 2 kütük, 2 parca tabaklanmis deri ve 15 civiye ihtiyacin olacak.

english: Where can I find out more information about the resources needed?
translation: Gerekli kaynaklar hakkinda daha fazla bilgiyi nereden bulabilirim?

english: I have a flyer! It details all the shields and the resources needed for them.
translation: Elimde bir brosür var! Tüm kalkanlar ve bunlar icin gerekli kaynaklar ayrintili olarak anlatiliyor.

english: May I have a resource flyer?
Of course! The more you know, the better!
translation: Tabii ki! Ne kadar cok bilirsen o kadar iyi!

english: The Shield Master hands you 'Leather Shields - Resource information flyer'.
translation: Kalkan Ustasi sana “Deri Kalkanlar - Kaynak bilgileri brosürü”nü verir.

english: Thanks!
You already have a flyer, I've only so many left.
translation: Zaten bir brosürün var, bende cok az kaldi.

english: Fair enough.
Who are you?
My name is William! And I'll tell you this, I'm the best crossbowman this side of White Wolf Mountain.
translation: Adim William! Ve sunu söyleyeyim, Beyaz Kurt Dagi'nin bu tarafindaki en iyi tatar yaycisi benim.

english: Who's better than you on the other side of the mountain?
translation: Dagin diger tarafinda senden daha iyi kim var?

english: Couldn't tell you that myself, never been there.
translation: Bunu ben bilemem, oraya hic gitmedim.

english: Oh... How did you come across that crossbow then?
translation: Oh... O tatar yayini nasil buldun peki?

english: Oh this? Some wandering merchant came by recently, told me it was the stealthiest crossbow there was.
translation: Oh, bunu mu? Gecenlerde bir gezgin tüccar geldi, bunun en gizli tatar yayi oldugunu söyledi.

english: Is it?
Well, he told me it was his last one too, so I figured I'd give it a try.
translation: Bana son kalani oldugunu söyledi, ben de denemeye karar verdim.

english: It was nice meeting you William.
I bet!
Bye!
Stay protected adventurer, for it's dangerous out there.
translation: Kendine dikkat et maceraci, disarisi tehlikeli.

english: What's with all the shields?
Who are you?
May I have a resource flyer?
Bye!
Hello youngster!
[I/We] don't talk to strange old people.
Hey who you calling old?! And strange?!
translation: Hey, kime yasli diyorsun?! Ve yabanci?!

english: Hello again.
You think you're tough do you?
Pardon?
I can beat anyone up!
He can you know!
Really?
The boy begins to jump around with his fists up. You decide it's best not to kill him just yet.
translation: Cocuk yumruklarini kaldirip ziplamaya baslar. Onu henüz öldürmemenin en iyisi olduguna karar verirsin.

english: Hello there, I've been looking for you.
I didn't mean to take it! I just forgot to pay.
What? I'm trying to help your mum find Fluffs.
translation: Ne? Annen Fluffs'i bulmasina yardim etmeye calisiyorum.

english: Ohh...well, in that case I might be able to help. Fluffs followed me to my secret play area, I haven't seen her since.
translation: Ohh... o zaman ben de yardimci olabilirim. Fluffs beni gizli oyun alanima kadar takip etti, o zamandan beri onu görmedim.

english: Where is this play area?
If I told you that, it wouldn't be a secret.
Tell me sonny, or I will hurt you.
translation: Söyle bana evlat, yoksa canini yakarim.

english: W..wh..what?! Y..you wouldn't! A young lad like me! I'd have you behind bars before nightfall!
translation: N... ne... ne?! Yapmazsin! Benim gibi genc bir delikanliya! Aksam olmadan seni parmakliklar arkasina tikarim!

english: You decided it's best not to hurt the boy.
translation: Cocuga zarar vermemenin en iyisi olduguna karar verdin.

english: What will make you tell me?
Well...now you ask, I am a bit short on cash.
translation: Sey... madem soruyorsun, biraz nakit sikintim var.

english: How much?
10 coins.
10 coins?!
I'll handle this.
100 coins should cover it.
100 coins! Why should I pay you?
translation: 100 sikke! Neden sana para vereyim ki?

english: You shouldn't, but we won't help otherwise. We never liked that cat anyway, so what do you say?
translation: Yapmamalisin, ama aksi takdirde yardim etmiyoruz. Zaten o kediyi hic sevmedik, ne dersin?

english: I'm not paying you a penny.
Okay then, I'll find another way to make money.
translation: Tamam o zaman, para kazanmanin baska bir yolunu bulurum.

english: Okay then, I'll pay.
You give the lad 100 coins.
There you go, now where did you see Fluffs ?
I play at an abandoned lumber mill to the north east. Just beyond the Jolly Boar Inn. I saw Fluffs running around in there.
translation: Kuzeydogudaki terk edilmis kereste fabrikasinda oynuyorum. Jolly Boar Inn'in hemen ötesinde. Fluffs'i orada kosustururken gördüm.

english: Anything else?
Well, you'll have to find the broken fence to get in. I'm sure you can manage that.
translation: Iceri girmek icin kirik citi bulman gerekecek. Eminim basarabilirsin.

english: Well, never mind, it's Fluffs' loss.
I'm sure my mum will get over it.
Where did you say you saw Fluffs?
Weren't you listening? I saw the flea bag in the old lumber mill just north east of here. Just walk past the Jolly Boar Inn and you should find it.
translation: Dinlemiyor muydun? Bu yerin kuzeydogusundaki eski kereste fabrikasinda o pire torbasini gördüm. Jolly Boar Inn'i gecince bulabilirsin.

english: Tell me sonny, or I will hurt you.
translation: Söyle bana evlat, yoksa canini yakarim.

english: What will make you tell me?
I'm not paying you a penny.
translation: Sana bir kurus bile ödeme yapmayacagim.

english: Okay then, I'll pay.
Well never mind, it's Fluffs' loss.
Greetings! What can I do for you?
Hello there. What do you do around here?
I'm a shipwright. I supply boats of all kinds to anyone with the money to afford them.
translation: Ben bir gemi ustasiyim. Parasi olan herkese her türlü tekne sagliyorum.

english: Interesting... Would I be able to buy one?
translation: Ilginc... Bir tane satin alabilir miyim?

english: Sorry, but I don't have any ready for sale right now. I'm sure I will soon, so keep checking back.
translation: Üzgünüm, ama su anda satilik teknem yok. Yakinda olacak, tekrar kontrol et.

english: Okay, fair enough.
You need to complete the Pandemonium quest to fully access the Sailing skill.
translation: Yelkencilik becerisine tam erisim icin Pandemonium görevini tamamlaman gerekiyor.

english: I'd like to buy a new boat.
translation: Yeni bir tekne satin almak istiyorum.

english: Of course! Which one would you like?
I'd like to customise a boat.
Not a problem. Just let me know which boat you want to customise and I'll get things set up for you.
translation: Sorun degil. Hangi tekneyi özellestirmek istedigini söyle, ben senin icin hazirlayayim.

english: I'd like to retrieve a boat.
Certainly! Let me know which boat you want retrieving and I'll call in a port wizard to teleport it over.
translation: Elbette! Hangi tekneyi geri almak istediginizi söyleyin, liman sihirbazini cagirip tekneyi buraya isinlatayim.

english: (boat retrieval interface opens)
That boat currently dockedat [boat location]. It'd normally cost [x] coins for retrieval but I'll waive the cost this time since I'm in a good mood.
That boat is lost at sea. A port wizard would normally retrieve it for you for [x] coins but I'll waive the cost this time since I'm in a good mood.
Right, time to call in the port wizard.
Another retrieval? This won't take long...
translation: Baska bir geri getirme mi? Bu uzun sürmez...

english: All done! The boat is now docked here at [location].
Need a retrieval? One moment please...
translation: Geri getirme mi lazim? Bir saniye lütfen...

english: Retrieval is it? Right, give me a moment...
translation: Kurtarma mi? Tamam, bir dakika bekleyin...

english: Sorry, but I'm not paying that.
translation: Üzgünüm, ama bunu ödemeyi kabul etmiyorum.

english: Fair enough. Come back if you change your mind.
Nothing, thanks.
Fair enough.
I'm afraid I can't help you with that at the moment. You'll have to come back later.
translation: Maalesef su anda size yardimci olamam. Daha sonra tekrar gelmeniz gerekecek.

english: I'd like to buy a new boat.
translation: Yeni bir tekne satin almak istiyorum.

english: I'd like to customise a boat.
I'd like to retrieve a boat.
Yes, pay [x] coins.
No, don't pay.
Nothing, thanks.
Greetings! What can I do for you?
I'd like to buy a new boat.
translation: Yeni bir tekne satin almak istiyorum.
