english: Of course! Which one would you like?
(Boat Emporium interface opens.)
I'd like to customise a boat.
Not a problem. Just let me know which boat you want to customise and I'll get things set up for you.
translation: Sorun degil. Hangi tekneyi özellestirmek istediginizi söyleyin, ben sizin icin her seyi ayarlayayim.

english: (boat customisation interface opens)
I'd like to retrieve a boat.
I'm afraid I can't help you with that as you don't have permission to use the docks here.

Tell me about the Nightmare.
From the moment I was born, all I ever knew was the Nightmare. Every night she would feast upon us, filling our minds with horrors beyond comprehension.
translation: Dogdugum andan itibaren tek bildigim sey Kabus'tu. Her gece bizi yiyip bitirir, zihnimizi akil almaz korkularla doldururdu.

english: By day, our warriors would enter her lair in the caves beneath the island. We could not hope to defeat her, we knew that, but our survival was dependent on ensuring she didn't grow too strong.
translation: Gündüzleri savascilarimiz adanin altindaki magaralarda bulunan yuvasina girerdi. Onu yenebilecegimizi umut edemezdik, bunu biliyorduk, ama hayatta kalabilmemiz onun cok güclenmemesini saglamaya bagliydi.

english: Here's the thing though. Even now, we know little about her. Before she claimed them, my parents would sometimes tell me a story of her origin.
translation: Ama sorun su ki, su anda bile onun hakkinda cok az sey biliyoruz. Onu ele gecirmeden önce, ailem bazen bana onun kökeniyle ilgili bir hikaye anlatirdi.

english: They told me of a group of shamans who performed an unknown ritual in the hope of gaining great power. The ritual went wrong, though, and instead, they unleashed the Nightmare on this world.
translation: Bana, büyük bir güc elde etmek umuduyla bilinmeyen bir ritüel gerceklestiren bir grup samanin hikayesini anlatirlardi. Ancak ritüel ters gitti ve bunun yerine, Kabus'u bu dünyaya saliverdiler.

english: Do you believe the story?
I'm not sure to be honest. I suppose it doesn't matter though. We'll likely never know her true origin. But as long as we can defeat her, we don't need to.
translation: Dürüst olmak gerekirse emin degilim. Ama sanirim bunun bir önemi yok. Onun gercek kökenini muhtemelen asla ögrenemeyecegiz. Ama onu yenebildigimiz sürece, buna gerek de yok.

english: Defeat her? Using the totems?
translation: Onu yenmek mi? Totemleri kullanarak mi?

english: Exactly. Thanks to the Nightmare, the caves beneath our home are mostly unexplored. There's all sorts of things down there, provided you're brave enough to enter.
translation: Aynen öyle. Kabus sayesinde, evimizin altindaki magaralar cogunlukla kesfedilmemis durumda. Oraya girecek kadar cesursaniz, asagida her türlü sey var.

english: I found the totems deep within the caves. Someone far smarter than you or I had worked out how to make them. But they perished before they could use them against her.
translation: Totemleri magaralarin derinliklerinde buldum. Sen ve benden cok daha zeki biri onlari nasil yapacagini bulmustu. Ama ona karsi kullanamadan öldüler.

english: I managed to recover them, and with them, we finally drove her off the island.
translation: Onlari kurtarmayi basardim ve onlarla onu sonunda adadan kovduk.

english: But she came here.
Yes. And thanks to the Sleeper Plague, she's far stronger than ever before.
translation: Evet. Ve Uyuyan Veba sayesinde, eskisinden cok daha güclü.

english: Do you know where the Sleeper Plague came from?
translation: Uyuyan Veba'nin nereden geldigini biliyor musun?

english: No. It was here long before the Nightmare apparently. It resurfaced shortly before she arrived. Probably the work of the vampyres.
translation: Hayir. Görünüse göre Kabus'tan cok önce buradaydi. O gelmeden kisa bir süre önce yeniden ortaya cikti. Muhtemelen vampirlerin isi.

english: Is there anything else you need?
translation: Baska bir seye ihtiyacin var mi?

english: Tell me about yourself.
The name's Shura. I come from an island called Ashihama, in the Pincers.
translation: Adim Shura. Pincers'daki Ashihama adasindan geliyorum.

english: The Pincers?
It's a group of islands within the Wushanko Isles, a large archipelago to the far east. Over here I think the area is more commonly known as the Eastern Lands.
translation: Wushanko Adalari'nda, uzak dogudaki büyük bir takimada icindeki bir grup ada. Buralarda bu bölge daha cok Dogu Topraklari olarak biliniyor sanirim.

english: And you're a siren, right?
That's right. We rarely come this far to the west, the climate is too cold for our tastes. Although while the Nightmare lives, the climate is the least of my worries.
translation: Dogru. Nadiren bu kadar batiya geliriz, iklim bizim zevkimize göre cok soguk. Ama Nightmare hayatta oldugu sürece, iklim en son endiselenecegim sey.

english: Back home on the other hand, our numbers equal the humans. Sirens live on pretty much every island in the archipelago.
translation: Öte yandan, memleketimizde sayimiz insanlarla esittir. Sirenler, takimadalarin hemen hemen her adasinda yasar.

english: So why were you the only one to come here?
translation: Peki neden buraya sadece sen geldin?

english: We took up arms against the Nightmare because we had to, not because we wanted to. We are a peaceful race, and most were all too eager to lay down their weapons once the Nightmare was gone.
translation: Kabus'a karsi silahlandik cünkü mecburduk, istedigimiz icin degil. Biz bariscil bir irkiz ve cogumuz Kabus ortadan kalktiginda silahlarimizi birakmaya cok hevesliydik.

english: So why didn't you?
My kind believe in something called Mo Kal. It means that anything bad that could happen, will happen. The others may have forgotten this, but I have not.
translation: Bizim türümüz Mo Kal denen bir seye inanir. Bu, olabilecek her kötü seyin olacagi anlamina gelir. Digerleri bunu unutmus olabilir, ama ben unutmadim.

english: The Nightmare may have left my home, but I won't rest until I know for sure that she can never return.
translation: Kabus evimden gitmis olabilir, ama onun asla geri dönemeyeceginden emin olana kadar rahat etmeyecegim.

english: Do you have any of my items?
Doesn't look like it. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: Öyle görünmüyor. Eger senin esyalarin bende olsaydi, ama sen onlari almadan önce öldüysen, artik kaybolmuslardir.

english: I do. Try to be more careful with them next time.
translation: Var. Bir dahaki sefere onlara daha dikkatli olmaya calis.

english: I'd better get going.
Good luck.
Hey! Don't just go poking her without knowing what you're up against. Come talk to me first.
translation: Hey! Neyle karsi karsiya oldugunu bilmeden ona dokunma. Önce benimle konus.

english: What's going on here?
Nothing good. This dungeon is tainted and has become the new home of the Nightmare.
translation: Hic iyi bir sey yok. Bu zindan kirlenmis ve Kabus'un yeni evi haline gelmis.

english: The Nightmare?
A being of pure darkness. No living creature is safe from her hunger. She feasts upon her victims while they sleep, draining their energy without even needing to touch them.
translation: Saf karanligin varligi. Hicbir canli onun acligindan kurtulamaz. Kurbanlarini uyurken yiyip bitirir, onlara dokunmasina bile gerek kalmadan enerjilerini emer.

english: Those that she feeds upon experience horrifying nightmares, unlike anything you could possibly imagine. Eventually, they become too weak to even wake. Death claims them soon after.
translation: Onun beslendigi kisiler, hayal edebilecegin hicbir seye benzemeyen korkunc kabuslar görürler. Sonunda, uyanamayacak kadar zayif düserler. Kisa süre sonra ölüm onlari alir.

english: Nightmares? Hence the name?
translation: Kabuslar mi? Adi da buradan mi geliyor?

english: Indeed. Our kind are not always the most creative.
translation: Evet. Bizim türümüz her zaman yaratici degildir.

english: So how did she end up here?
For generations, she terrorised the island of Ashihama, my home. I lost a lot of good friends to her. Sometimes, I even thought I would lose myself. For some, the nightmares become too much to bear.
translation: Nesiller boyunca, benim evim olan Ashihama adasini terörize etti. Onun yüzünden bircok iyi arkadasimi kaybettim. Bazen kendimi de kaybedecegimi düsündüm. Bazilari icin kabuslar dayanilmaz hale geliyor.

english: Some of us refused to give in though. Everything has a weakness, including the Nightmare, and eventually we found it. We drove her off the island, but she managed to endure.
translation: Ancak bazilarimiz pes etmeyi reddetti. Her seyin bir zayifligi vardir, Kabus da dahil, ve sonunda biz de onun zayifligini bulduk. Onu adadan kovduk, ama o dayanmayi basardi.

english: The people here are ill, suffering from a deep sleep from which few wake. They call it the Sleeper Plague. The illness made these people easy prey for the Nightmare, so she made this place her new home.
translation: Buradaki insanlar hasta, derin bir uykudan muzdarip ve cok azi uyanabiliyor. Buna Uyuyan Veba diyorlar. Bu hastalik, bu insanlari Kabus icin kolay bir av haline getirdi, bu yüzden o da burayi yeni evi yapti.

english: And you followed her here?
translation: Ve sen onu buraya kadar takip ettin?

english: While she still exists, my home will never be truly safe. Thanks to the Sleeper Plague, her power has grown faster than it ever did on Ashihama. If she is allowed to grow too strong, there won't be any way to stop her.
translation: O hala var oldugu sürece, evim asla gercekten güvenli olmayacak. Uyuyan Veba sayesinde, gücü Ashihama'da oldugundan daha hizli büyüdü. Eger cok güclenmesine izin verirsek, onu durdurmanin bir yolu kalmayacak.

english: I've managed to contain her within this section of the dungeon. She has no desire to leave for the moment. She has no need to, after all.
translation: Onu zindanin bu bölümünde tutmayi basardim. Su anda ayrilmak gibi bir niyeti yok. Sonucta buna ihtiyaci da yok.

english: But make no mistake, I won't be able to stop her if she decides to move on.
translation: Ama süphesiz, eger ayrilmaya karar verirse onu durduramayacagim.

english: She doesn't look too dangerous at the moment.
Looks can be deceiving. The battle with the Nightmare is a mental one, not a physical one. If you try to take her on, she will pull you into her dream - one where she makes the rules.
translation: Görünüs aldatici olabilir. Kabusla olan savas fiziksel degil, zihinsel bir savastir. Onunla savasmaya kalkisirsan, seni kendi rüyasina cekecek - kurallari onun koydugu bir rüyaya.

english: But if it's a dream, how can it be dangerous?
translation: Ama rüya ise, nasil tehlikeli olabilir?

english: It's her dream, not yours. Dying in her dream will destroy your mind, killing you in this world as well.
translation: Onun rüyasi, senin degil. Onun rüyasinda ölürsen zihnin yok olur ve bu dünyada da ölürsün.

english: Sounds lovely. So how can we stop her?
translation: Kulaga hos geliyor. Peki onu nasil durdurabiliriz?

english: If you're willing to help, enter her dream and fight to keep her at bay. Our only hope is to prevent her from growing too strong.
translation: Yardim etmek istiyorsan, onun rüyasina gir ve onu uzak tutmak icin savas. Tek umudumuz, onun cok güclenmesini engellemek.

english: You can go in alone, but I wouldn't recommend it. The more support you have, the better your chances.
translation: Yalniz basina girebilirsin ama bunu tavsiye etmem. Ne kadar cok destek alirsan, sansin o kadar artar.

english: How do I keep her at bay?

There are four totems in the area that can be used to harm her. First, you'll need to take down her shield for the totems to have an effect. Once her shield is down, use your energy to charge up the totems.
translation: Bölgede ona zarar vermek icin kullanilabilecek dört totem var. Öncelikle, totemlerin etkili olabilmesi icin kalkanini yikman gerekiyor. Kalkani yikildiktan sonra, enerjini kullanarak totemleri sarj et.

english: She won't sit about while you do this though, so you'll need to take care if you want to survive.
translation: Ancak o bu sirada bos durmayacak, hayatta kalmak istiyorsan dikkatli olmalisin.

english: And what's in it for me if I do survive?
translation: Hayatta kalirsam benim icin ne kazanc var?

english: You mean apart from saving the world? She's claimed many victims over the years. I'm sure she's claimed many items as well. Maybe some of them will be of value to you.
translation: Dünyayi kurtarmak disinda mi demek istiyorsun? Yillar boyunca bircok kurban aldi. Eminim bircok esya da ele gecirmistir. Belki bazilari senin icin degerli olabilir.

english: Works for me. I'd better get started then.
translation: Bana uyar. O zaman baslasam iyi olacak.

english: Good luck. Return to me if you need more information.
translation: Iyi sanslar. Daha fazla bilgiye ihtiyacin olursa bana geri dön.

english: Sorry, but I don't have anything for you. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: Üzgünüm, ama sana verecek bir seyim yok. Eger esyalarindan herhangi birine sahip olsaydim, ama sen onlari almadan önce öldüysen, artik kaybolmuslardir.

english: I think Sister Senga has your possessions instead, actually.
Hey! I have some of your things. You should come get them before fighting the Nightmare.
translation: Hey! Senin bazi esyalarin bende. Kabusla savasmadan önce gelip onlari almalisin.

english: The Nightmare pulls you into her dream as you approach her.
translation: Kabus, ona yaklastikca seni rüyasina cekiyor.

english: Tell me about the Nightmare.
Tell me about yourself.
Do you have any of my items?
I'd better get going.
Yes.
No.
Hello.
Do you need something?
No.
Well I have lots to do, so good day.
translation: Yapacak cok isim var, iyi günler.

english: Hello, Siamun?
What?
So you are Siamun then?
Yes now what do you want?
Wow, are you this friendly to everyone?
translation: Vay canina, herkese bu kadar dostca davraniyor musun?

english: Just you. Now what do you want?
A mutual friend of ours, Ali Morrisane, wants you to supply his stall in Al Kharid with your garments.
translation: Ortak bir arkadasimiz olan Ali Morrisane, Al Kharid'deki tezgahina senin giysilerini tedarik etmeni istiyor.

english: Now why would I do that?
Well for one, you'd probably sell more clothes and once the people of Al Kharid see your amazing works of tailoring, I'm sure they'd spread the word of your clothes far and wide.
translation: Birincisi, muhtemelen daha fazla giysi satarsin ve Al Kharid halki senin muhtesem terzilik calismalarini gördükten sonra, giysilerinin ününü her yere yayacaklarindan eminim.

english: Interesting, but I would need more materials to accomplish what you ask of me.
translation: Ilginc, ama istediginizi yapmak icin daha fazla malzemeye ihtiyacim var.

english: Well then what do you need?
Either get me 3 pots of dye, or 3 animal pelts of the same variety and whatever you do, don't bring me any certs.
translation: Bana 3 tencere boya ya da ayni türden 3 hayvan derisi getir, ama ne yaparsan yap, bana sertifika getirme.

english: What do you mean by animal pelt?
Just get me 3 cowhides, 3 wolf or snake skins or the shearings of 3 sheep. Simpler still get me 3 pots of dye and whatever you do, don't bring me any certs.
translation: Bana 3 adet inek derisi, 3 adet kurt veya yilan derisi ya da 3 adet koyun yünü getir. Daha da basit, bana 3 kavanoz boya getir ve ne yaparsan yap, bana sertifika getirme.

english: Ok, I'll get you the materials.
Unless you've got the materials on you?
Ummm.. No.
Keh! Come back when you have what I need.
translation: Keh! Ihtiyacim olan seyi getirdiginde geri gel.

english: Yup, I've got what you want with me.
You give the merchant the [dye/animal pelts].
Thank you adventurer. I will get my goods up to that merchant thief - Ali Morrisane as quickly as possible.
translation: Tesekkürler maceraci. Mallarimi o tüccar hirsiz Ali Morrisane'ye mümkün oldugunca cabuk ulastiracagim.

english: Think nothing of it. I'm looking forward to seeing what you've produced for the Al Kharid market.
translation: Önemli degil. Al Kharid pazari icin ürettigin ürünleri görmek icin sabirsizlaniyorum.

english: Hello Siamun.
Have you got what I asked for yet?
A hello would have been nice.
Look I'm not nice, now did you get what I asked for or not?
translation: Bak, ben hos biri degilim, istedigim seyi aldin mi almadin mi?

english: Umm... What do you need again?
Just get me 3 cowhides, 3 wolf or snake skins or the shearings of 3 sheep. Simpler still just get me 3 pots of dye and whatever you do, don't bring me any certs.
translation: Bana 3 inek derisi, 3 kurt veya yilan derisi ya da 3 koyun yünü getir. Daha da basit, bana 3 tencere boya getir ve ne yaparsan yap, bana sertifika getirme.

english: Ok.
You give the merchant the [dye/hides].
Hello adventurer. Have you checked with Ali M whether my garments are selling or not?
translation: Merhaba maceraci. Ali M'ye giysilerimin satilip satilmadigini sordun mu?

english: Not yet, I have a few things to do first.
translation: Henüz sormadim, önce yapmam gereken birkac is var.

english: Well I would be very much obliged if you could have a talk with him sooner rather than later, I'm not all that sure of the trustworthiness of those carpet men.
translation: Onunla bir an önce konusursan cok minnettar olurum, hali saticilarinin güvenilirliginden pek emin degilim.

english: Don't worry, I'll get to it.
Hello adventurer. How are sales going?
Not too bad, Ali was well impressed by the reaction and demand they had initially but he's a little concerned about how the sales have dropped off of recent.
translation: Fena degil, Ali ilk basta gösterilen tepki ve talepten cok etkilendi ama son zamanlarda satislarin düsmesinden biraz endiseli.

english: Hmmm... Maybe I could produce a different range of products.
I tell you what, get me 3 animal pelts of the same variety and I'll change the shipments around and whatever you do, don't bring me any certs.
translation: Bak ne diyecegim, bana ayni türden 3 hayvan derisi getir, ben de sevkiyatlari degistiririm ama ne yaparsan yap, bana sertifika getirme.

english: I'll tell you what, get me 3 pots of dye and I'll change the type of garments I'm sending to Ali and whatever you do, don't bring me any certs.
translation: Bak ne diyecegim, bana 3 kavanoz boya getir, ben de Ali'ye gönderdigim giysilerin türünü degistireyim, ama ne yaparsan yap, bana sertifika getirme.

english: What are you doing?
I thought this acne potion might help ease your itching.
translation: Bu sivilce ilaci kasintini hafifletebilir diye düsündüm.

english: Get away from me! I don't want your strange potions!
translation: Cekil basimdan! Senin garip ilaclarini istemiyorum!

english: Sorry.
What do you mean by animal pelt?
Ok, I'll get you the materials.
Umm... What do you need again?
Ok.
Hey! You look like quite the sharp shooter. Can I interest you in a new bow?
translation: Hey! Keskin nisanci gibi görünüyorsun. Yeni bir yay ister misin?

english: Let's see what you've got.
No thanks.
Well, if ya change your mind, I'll be right here.
Let's see what you've got.
No thanks.
Woo, party on bro!
The killer approaches Sid behind his back.
Woah, that wind totally just felt like someone breathing on my neck!
translation: Woah, bu rüzgar sanki biri enseme nefesini üflüyor gibi!

english: The killer stabs Sid.
Whoah, not cool bro...
...urgh...
...I'm feeling woozy...
...gargh...
...I see the light...
...urrggghhh...
...it's not my time...glurgh
...gargle...urgh...
Sid stumbles forward, drowning in the water barrel.
translation: Sid öne dogru sendeler ve su varilinde bogulur.

english: ...glargh...help...me...
...urgh...hergle...
...flergh.
Sid collapses to the ground in a crumpled mess. As he falls down you spot something shiny fall out of his shirt pocket and into the barrel of water.
translation: Sid yere yigilir. Düserken, gömleginin cebinden parlak bir seyin su ficisina düstügünü görürsünüz.

english: Gosh, that was horrible and so drawn out!
translation: Tanrim, bu korkunc ve cok uzadi!

english: Oh wow, he's still going...
I think he is actually dead this time.
Who are you? Why are you doing this!?
The killer walks away.
Gah! I've got to find a way into that house and stop this maniac!
translation: Gah! O eve girmenin bir yolunu bulmali ve bu manyak adami durdurmaliyim!

english: I wonder what it was that I saw fall into that barrel?
translation: O varile düsen sey neydi acaba?

english: Hello there and welcome to the shop of useful items. Can I help you at all?
translation: Merhaba, kullanisli esyalar satan dükkânimiza hos geldiniz. Size yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: What are you selling?
Take a look.
Do you sell Silverlight?
Silverlight? No, Sir Prysin of Varrock explained that that was a unique sword and told us to stop selling it. If you want Silverlight, but don't have it, you should speak to him.
translation: Silverlight mi? Hayir, Varrock'tan Prysin Bey bunun essiz bir kilic oldugunu ve satmayi birakmamizi söyledi. Silverlight istiyorsaniz ama elinizde yoksa, onunla konusmalisiniz.

english: So would you like to see what else I have?
translation: Baska neyim var görmek ister misiniz?

english: No thanks.
Okay. Well, if you change your mind, do pop back.
What are you selling?
Do you sell Silverlight?
No thanks.
I'd be very careful going down there friend.
translation: Oraya inerken cok dikkatli olmalisin dostum.

english: Why what's down there ?
Salarin the twisted. One of Kandarin's most dangerous chaos druids. I tried to take him on, then suddenly felt immensely weak.
translation: Salarin the twisted. Kandarin'in en tehlikeli kaos druidlerinden biri. Onunla savasmaya calistim, sonra aniden kendimi cok zayif hissettim.

english: I hear he's susceptible to attacks from the mind. However I have no idea what that means, so it's not much help to me.
translation: Zihinsel saldirilara karsi savunmasiz oldugunu duydum. Ancak bunun ne anlama geldigini bilmiyorum, bu yüzden bana pek yardimi dokunmuyor.

english: Fear not, I am very strong
You might find you are not so strong shortly...
translation: Kisa süre sonra o kadar da güclü olmadigini fark edebilirsin...

english: Why what's down there?
Fear not, I am very strong
Hello!
Can I help you?
I was just curious as to what you do around here.
I protect other travellers from monsters, both animal and human kind.
translation: Diger gezginleri hayvan ve insan türündeki canavarlardan koruyorum.

english: Human? Can't say I've seen many human shaped monsters in the Wilderness.
translation: Insan mi? Wilderness'da insan sekilli canavarlar gördügümü söyleyemem.

english: When you've been in the Wilderness as long as I have, you learn that not all monsters show themselves on the outside.
translation: Benim kadar uzun süre Wilderness'da kaldiginda, tüm canavarlarin kendilerini disarida göstermedigini ögrenirsin.

english: Uhm... alright then, I'll leave you to your duties.
translation: Peki, o zaman görevine devam et.

english: Watch yourself out there, it can be hard to tell friend from foe in these lands.
translation: Disarida kendine dikkat et, bu topraklarda dostu düsmani ayirt etmek zor olabilir.

english: Well done! I have new information to share with you.
translation: Aferin! Seninle paylasacagim yeni bilgilerim var.

english: I do not speak to outerlanders. If you have anything of import to say, go and speak to the Chieftain.
translation: Disaridan gelenlerle konusmam. Önemli bir sey söyleyeceksen, gidip Sefle konus.

english: Hello there. I have some spined dagannoth hides, and believe you might be able to make an armour of them for me...?
translation: Merhaba. Biraz dikenli dagannoth derisi var, bunlardan bana bir zirh yapabilir misin acaba...?

english: My apologies outerlander, but we are forbidden by decree to communicate with those not of our tribe, and this includes making armour for you.
translation: Özür dilerim yabanci, ama kararnameye göre kabilemizden olmayanlarla iletisim kurmamiz yasak, bu senin icin zirh yapmak da dahil.

english: I suggest you speak to Brundt, our chieftain. He resides in the longhall and speaks for us all.
translation: Sefimiz Brundt ile konusmani öneririm. Uzun salonda oturur ve hepimizi temsil eder.

english: What do you want outerlander?
Are you a member of the council?
The Fremennik council of elders? I am pleased to say that I am. My value as a huntsman is recognised by my position there.
translation: Fremennik yaslilar konseyi mi? Evet, öyleyim. Avci olarak degerim, konseydeki konumumla taninmaktadir.

english: I was wondering if I could persuade you to vouch for me as a member of your clan?
translation: Seni, klaninin bir üyesi olarak bana kefil olmaya ikna edebilir miyim diye merak ediyordum.

english: You? ... well... I am not totally against the idea outerlander. If you can demonstrate some hunting skills then perhaps I may offer my vote.
translation: Sen mi? ... Sey... Bu fikre tamamen karsi degilim, yabanci. Avcilik becerilerini kanitlayabilirsen, belki oyumu verebilirim.

english: How can I prove my hunting skills to you? I can go kill, like, a hundred chickens for you right now!
translation: Avcilik becerilerimi sana nasil kanitlayabilirim? Hemen simdi senin icin yüz tane tavuk öldürebilirim!

english: Chickens? You think that would impress me?
translation: Tavuk mu? Bunun beni etkileyecegini mi saniyorsun?

english: Cows then? I can kill cows until, er, the cows come home.
translation: O zaman inekler? Inekler eve dönene kadar inekleri öldürebilirim.

english: No. The prey I have in mind for you to prove your worth to me is something far more dangerous. Far more difficult. Far more deadly.
translation: Hayir. Bana degerini kanitlaman icin aklimdaki av, cok daha tehlikeli bir sey. Cok daha zor. Cok daha ölümcül.

english: Not... Giant Rats?!?!
I suspect you are mocking me outerlander. You will need to prove your skill as a hunter to me by tracking and defeating... The Draugen.
translation: Beni alay ediyorsun sanirim, yabanci. Avcilik becerini bana kanitlaman gerekecek. Draugen'i takip edip yenerek...

english: What's a Draugen? Some kind of cheap barbarian rip- off of a dragon?
translation: Draugen nedir? Ucuz bir barbarin ejderhayi taklit ettigi bir sey mi?

english: Hmmm. No, the words are slightly similar I suppose, but they are very different creatures.
translation: Hmmm. Hayir, kelimeler biraz benzer olabilir ama cok farkli yaratiklar.

english: The Draugen is an evil ghost from Fremennik mythology, that devours the souls of those brave warriors who meet their ends at sea.
translation: Draugen, Fremennik mitolojisinden gelen kötü bir hayalettir ve denizde hayatlarini kaybeden cesur savascilarin ruhlarini yutar.

english: It stalks the coastlines, invisible to all. It brings us bad fortunes, and curses our journeys across the seas. It is also unkillable by normal means.
translation: Kiyi seridinde dolasir ve kimse tarafindan görülmez. Bize kötü sans getirir ve denizdeki yolculuklarimizi lanetler. Ayrica normal yollarla öldürülemez.

english: ...Let me get this straight; You want me to hunt an unkillable, invincible, and invisible enemy? How am I supposed to do that?
translation: ...Sunu bir netlestirelim; Öldürülemez, yenilmez ve görünmez bir düsmani avlamami mi istiyorsun? Bunu nasil yapacagim?

english: Well outerlander, should you accept my challenge I will show you a special hunter's trick that will help you. Do you accept the challenge?
translation: Peki, yabanci, eger meydan okumami kabul edersen, sana yardimci olacak özel bir avci hilesi gösterecegim. Meydan okumayi kabul ediyor musun?

english: Well, I need every vote I can get in the council of elders, but this certainly sounds impossible to do...
translation: Peki, yaslilar konseyinde alabilecegim her oy bana lazim, ama bu kesinlikle imkansiz gibi görünüyor...

english: Not at all outerlander. The Draugen is indeed impossible to kill, but that is not the same as being impossible to fight against.
translation: Hic de degil, yabanci. Draugen'i öldürmek gercekten imkansiz, ama bu onunla savasmanin imkansiz oldugu anlamina gelmez.

english: Every time he takes a Fremennik life, he gains in power, so to keep it from becoming too powerful we hunters hunt it and steal its life force.
translation: Her Fremennik'in canini aldiginda gücü artar, bu yüzden cok güclü hale gelmesini önlemek icin biz avcilar onu avlayip yasam gücünü caliyoruz.

english: We do this with a special talisman. Here, take it; it will let you track the Draugen while it's invisible, and when you defeat it will absorb its essence.
translation: Bunu özel bir tilsimla yapiyoruz. Al, bunu kullanarak Draugen'i görünmezken takip edebilirsin ve onu yendiginde özünü emeceksin.

english: I want you to track the Draugen, defeat it, and store its essence in that talisman for me. If you can do this important task for my clan, I will vote for you.
translation: Draugen'i takip etmeni, onu yenmeni ve özünü benim icin o tilsimda saklamani istiyorum. Klanim icin bu önemli görevi yerine getirirsen, sana oy verecegim.

english: Take care of the talisman, and see me when you have completed this task.
translation: Tilsima iyi bak ve görevi tamamladiginda bana gel.

english: Forget it! This all sounds like way too much work for a stupid vote at a meeting! I'll find someone else instead.
translation: Unut gitsin! Bunlar, toplantida aptalca bir oylama icin cok fazla is gibi geliyor! Baska birini bulacagim.

english: Hello again outerlander. Have you managed to hunt down the terrible Draugen yet?
translation: Merhaba yine, yabanci. Korkunc Draugen'i avlamayi basardin mi?

english: Not yet...
Hmmm. Laziness is not a trait that I admire. I suggest you go and do so if you wish me to vouchsafe for you to our council of elders.
translation: Hmmm. Tembellik, takdir ettigim bir özellik degildir. Eger yaslilar konseyine seni tavsiye etmemi istiyorsan, gidip bunu yapmani öneririm.

english: Not yet... I lost the talisman you gave me.
translation: Henüz degil... Bana verdigin tilsimi kaybettim.

english: Your inventory is too full to accept another Talisman.
translation: Envanterin baska bir tilsim kabul edemeyecek kadar dolu.

english: I defeated the draugen, but I have lost the talisman to prove I did.
translation: Draugen'i yendim, ama bunu kanitlayacak tilsimi kaybettim.

english: An amateurish mistake, outerlander. Any hunt without the proof of it is naught but empty boasting. Take this and try once more.
translation: Amatörce bir hata, yabanci. Kaniti olmayan av, bos bir övünmeden baska bir sey degildir. Al bunu ve bir kez daha dene.

english: I saw the entire hunt. Let me take that talisman from you; I would be honoured to speak out for you to our council of elders after such a hunt, outerlander.
translation: Avin tamamini gördüm. O tilsimi senden alayim; böyle bir avdan sonra yaslilar konseyinde senin icin konusmaktan onur duyarim, yabanci.

english: Thanks!
So can I rely on your vote with the council of elders in my favour?
translation: Yani yaslilar konseyinde benim lehime oy verecegine güvenebilir miyim?

english: Absolutely outerlander! Anyone brave enough to hunt and defeat the Draugen will be a great addition to our clan!
translation: Elbette, yabanci! Draugen'i avlayip yenebilecek kadar cesur olan herkes klanimiza büyük katki saglayacaktir!

english: Greetings outerlander.
I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a map to unspoiled hunting grounds, do you?
translation: Bozulmamis avlanma alanlarinin haritasini nerede bulabilecegimi biliyor musun?

english: Well, of course I do. I wouldn't be much of a huntsman if I didn't know where to find my prey now, would I outerlander?
translation: Tabii ki var. Avimi nerede bulacagimi bilmesem, avci olarak pek bir ise yaramazdim, degil mi yabanci?

english: No, I guess not. So can I have it?
translation: Hayir, sanirim öyle. Peki, haritayi alabilir miyim?

english: Directions to my hunting grounds could mean the end of my livelihood. The only way I would be prepared to give them up would be...
translation: Av alanima giden yol, gecim kaynagimin sonu anlamina gelebilir. Onu vermek icin tek sartim...

english: What? Power? Money? Women? Wine?
...a new string for my hunting bow. Not just any bowstring; I need a custom bowstring, balanced for my bow precisely to keep my hunt competitive.
translation: ...av yayim icin yeni bir yay ipi. Siradan bir yay ipi degil; avimin rekabetci olmasini saglamak icin yayimla tam olarak dengeli, özel yapim bir yay ipi lazim.

english: Only in this way would I allow the knowledge of my hunting grounds to be passed on to strangers.
translation: Ancak bu sekilde av alanlarimin bilgisini yabancilara aktarmaya razi olabilirim.

english: So where would I get that?
I have no idea. But then again, I'm happy with my old bowstring and being the only person who knows where my hunting ground is.
translation: Hicbir fikrim yok. Ama yine de eski yay ipimden memnunum ve av alanimin yerini bilen tek kisi olmaktan mutluyum.

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a finely balanced custom bowstring, do you?
translation: Iyi dengelenmis özel bir yay ipi bulabilecegim bir yer biliyor musun?

english: If I knew I would not have asked you to go and get me one, now would I?
translation: Bilseydim, senden gidip bana bir tane getirmeni istemezdim, degil mi?

english: Here. I have your bowstring. Give me your map to the hunting grounds.
translation: Al. Yay ipini getirdim. Bana avlanma alanlarinin haritasini ver.

english: Well met, outerlander. I see some hunting potential within you. Here, take my map, I was getting too dependent on it for my skill anyway.
translation: Tanistigimiza memnun oldum, yabancim. Sende avlanma potansiyeli görüyorum. Al, haritami al, zaten becerilerim icin ona cok bagimli hale gelmistim.

english: So you really don't mind giving this away to me?
translation: Bunu bana vermekten gercekten rahatsiz olmuyor musun?

english: No outerlander... it is hard to explain. That map makes my role as huntsman too easy. I fear my skills are becoming dulled. Now I must track my prey once more.
translation: Hayir, yabanci... aciklamasi zor. Bu harita avci olarak görevimi cok kolaylastiriyor. Becerilerimin körelmesinden korkuyorum. Artik avimi bir kez daha takip etmeliyim.

english: To begin again from scratch... I feel this may keep me sharp.
translation: Sifirdan baslamak... Bu beni zinde tutabilir diye düsünüyorum.

english: Hello again Sigli.
Hello again to you [Fremennik name]. How goes the hunt?
The hunt? I've already done your task! That's why I'm a Fremennik now!
translation: Av mi? Senin görevini coktan tamamladim! Bu yüzden artik bir Fremennik oldum!

english: You think so do you? The Draugen is always out there, just as I and my hunters are always on its trail to keep it at bay.
translation: Öyle mi düsünüyorsun? Draugen her zaman disarida, tipki ben ve avcilarimin onu uzak tutmak icin her zaman pesinde oldugumuz gibi.

english: The hunt will never end until I do.
translation: Ben bitirene kadar av asla bitmeyecek.

english: That is fine, [Fremennik name]. What type of armour were you looking for?
translation: Sorun degil, Dokrak. Ne tür bir zirh ariyordun?

english: It will cost you 5,000 coins to make that for you. Is that acceptable?
translation: Bunu yapmak sana 5.000 sikkeye mal olacak. Kabul edilebilir mi?

english: Sorry, [Fremennik name]. I will need 1 piece of dark dagger-mouth hide, 1 circular light dagger-mouth hide and 5,000 coins to make you a hunter's helmet.
translation: Üzgünüm, Dokrak. Sana bir avci kaski yapmak icin 1 adet koyu renkli hancer agzi derisi, 1 adet dairesel acik renkli hancer agzi derisi ve 5.000 sikkeye ihtiyacim olacak.

english: When you have them, I will still be here.
translation: Onlari getirdiginde, ben hala burada olacagim.

english: It will cost you 10,000 coins to make that for you. Is that acceptable?
translation: Bunu yapmak icin 10.000 sikke ödeyeceksin. Kabul ediyor musun?

english: I'm sorry, but I need 3 pieces of dark dagger-mouth hide, 1 flattened hide and 10,000 coins to make you some hunter's body armour.
translation: Üzgünüm, ama sana avci zirhi yapmak icin 3 adet koyu renkli hancer agizli deri, 1 adet düzlestirilmis deri ve 10.000 sikkeye ihtiyacim var.

english: I will still be here when you have obtained it.
translation: Sen onu elde ettiginde ben hala burada olacagim.

english: It will cost you 7,500 coins to make that for you. Is that acceptable?
translation: Bunu yapmak sana 7.500 sikkeye mal olacak. Kabul edilebilir mi?

english: That should do for any hunter! Did you want another set of hunters legs?
translation: Bu herhangi bir avci icin yeterli olmali! Baska bir avci bacak seti ister misin?

english: My apologies but I will need 2 pieces of dark dagger-mouth hide, 1 stretched hide and 7,500 coins to make you some leg armour...
translation: Özür dilerim ama sana bacak zirhi yapmak icin 2 parca koyu renkli hancer agizli deri, 1 gerilmis deri ve 7.500 sikkeye ihtiyacim olacak...
