Can I help you?
Do you have any quests for me?
translation: Bana verebileceginiz bir görev var mi?

english: I hear the Duke has a task for an adventurer. Otherwise, if you want to make yourself useful, there are always evil monsters to slay.
translation: Dük'ün bir maceraciya görevi oldugunu duydum. Aksi takdirde, kendinizi ise yarar hale getirmek istiyorsaniz, her zaman öldürülecek kötü canavarlar vardir.

english: Okay, I might just do that.
Who are you?
I'm the Duke's advisor.
Can you give me any advice then?
translation: O zaman bana bir tavsiye verebilir misiniz?

english: I only advise the Duke. But if you want to make yourself useful, there are evil goblins to slay on the other side of the river.
translation: Ben sadece Dük'e danismanlik yaparim. Ama kendinizi ise yarar hale getirmek istiyorsaniz, nehrin diger tarafinda öldürülecek kötü goblinler var.

english: Do you have any quests for me?
translation: Bana verebilecegin bir görev var mi?

english: Who are you?
Hiya.
Hello outerlander. By the laws of our tribe, I am afraid I may not speak to you without the express permission of the chieftain.
translation: Merhaba yabanci. Kabilemizin kanunlarina göre, sefimizin acik izni olmadan seninle konusamam.

english: Hello there!
Hello outerlander.
Are you a member of the council?
That I am outerlander; it is a position that brings my family and I pride.
translation: Evet, yabanci; bu, ailem ve benim icin gurur verici bir konum.

english: I was wondering if I can count on your vote at the council of elders?
translation: Yaslilar konseyinde oyuna güvenebilir miyim acaba?

english: You wish to become a Fremennik? I may be persuaded to swing my vote to your favour, but you will first need to do a little task for me.
translation: Fremennik olmak mi istiyorsun? Oyumu senin lehine kullanmaya ikna edilebilirim, ama önce benim icin kücük bir görev yapman gerekiyor.

english: How did I know it wouldn't be that simple for your vote?
translation: Oyunun bu kadar kolay olmayacagini nereden bilebilirdim ki?

english: Calm yourself outerlander. It is but a small task really... I simply require a flower.
translation: Sakin ol yabanci. Aslinda cok kücük bir görev... Sadece bir cicek istiyorum.

english: A flower? What's the catch?
translation: Bir cicek mi? Püf noktasi ne?

english: The catch? Well... it is not just any flower. Someone in this town has an extremely rare flower from a far off land that they picked up on their travels.
translation: Püf noktasi mi? Sey... Bu siradan bir cicek degil. Bu kasabada, seyahatleri sirasinda uzak diyarlardan getirdikleri cok nadir bir cicege sahip biri var.

english: I would like you to demonstrate your merchanting skills to me, by persuading them to part with it, and then give it to me for my vote.
translation: Ticari becerilerini bana göstererek, onu ikna edip cicegi bana vermesini saglamani istiyorum.

english: Well... I guess that doesn't sound too hard...
translation: Sey... Sanirim bu cok zor degil...

english: Excellent! You will obtain this rare flower for me then?
translation: Harika! O zaman bu nadir cicegi benim icin bulacak misin?

english: Okay. I don't think this will be too difficult. Any suggestions on where to start looking for this flower?
translation: Tamam. Bunun cok zor olacagini sanmiyorum. Bu cicegi aramaya nereden baslamam gerektigi konusunda bir önerin var mi?

english: Ah, well outerlander, if I knew where to start looking I would simply do it myself!
translation: Ah, yabanci, nereden baslamam gerektigini bilseydim, bunu kendim yapardim!

english: No help at ALL?
We are a very insular clan, so I would not expect you to have to leave this town to find whatever you need.
translation: Biz cok kapali bir klaniz, bu yüzden ihtiyacin olan seyi bulmak icin bu kasabadan ayrilmani beklemiyorum.

english: You know what? No. This all sounds like a lot of hassle to me, and frankly I just can't be bothered with it right now.
translation: Biliyor musun? Hayir. Bana cok zahmetli geliyor ve acikcasi su anda bununla ugrasmak istemiyorum.

english: I'll go get someone else to vote for me.
translation: Baska birine oy vermesi icin gidecegim.

english: As you wish outerlander. If you change your mind, come and see me again; I am very interested in getting my hands on that flower.
translation: Nasil istersen yabanci. Fikrini degistirirsen, tekrar bana gel; o cicegi elde etmekle cok ilgileniyorum.

english: So... how goes it outerlander? Did you manage to obtain my flower for me yet? Or do you lack the necessary merchanting skills?
translation: Ee... nasil gidiyor yabanci? Cicegimi bulabildin mi? Yoksa gerekli ticaret becerilerinden yoksun musun?

english: I'm still working on it... Do you have any suggestion where to start looking for it?
translation: Hala üzerinde calisiyorum... Nereden aramaya baslamam gerektigi konusunda bir önerin var mi?

english: I suggest you ask around the other Fremennik in the town. A good merchant will find exactly what their customer needs somewhere.
translation: Kasabadaki diger Fremenniklere sormani öneririm. Iyi bir tüccar, müsterisinin ihtiyaci olan seyi mutlaka bir yerlerde bulur.

english: Here's that flower you wanted.
Incredible! Your merchanting skills might even match my own! I have no choice but to recommend you to the council of elders!
translation: Inanilmaz! Ticaret becerilerin benimkilerle eslesebilir! Seni yaslilar konseyine tavsiye etmekten baska secenegim yok!

english: Hello again outerlander! I am amazed once more at your apparent skill at merchanting!
translation: Merhaba yine yabanci! Ticaret becerilerinize bir kez daha hayran kaldim!

english: So I can count on your vote at the council of elders?
translation: Yani yaslilar konseyinde oyunuzu alabilir miyim?

english: Absolutely, outerlander. Your merchanting skills will be a real boon to the Fremennik.
translation: Elbette, yabanci. Ticaret becerileriniz Fremennikler icin gercek bir nimet olacak.

english: Greetings again brother [Fremennik name]! What can I do for you this day?
translation: Merhaba yine kardesim Dokrak! Bugün sizin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: Can I see your wares?
Certainly, [Fremennik name].
Nothing thanks.
Well, feel free to stop by anytime that you wish [Fremennik name]. You are always welcome here!
translation: Istedigin zaman ugra Dokrak. Buraya her zaman hos geldin!

english: Yes
No
Can I see your wares?
Nothing thanks.
We didn't mean it to go wrong, you know...
Hello there.
Ha Ha! Hello!
Who are you?
I'm Sigurd the Great and Brainy.
Why do they call you the Great and Brainy?
translation: Neden sana Büyük ve Zeki diyorlar?

english: Because I invented the Log Canoe!
Log Canoe?
Yeash! Me and my cousins were having a great party by the river when we decided to have a game of 'Smack The Tree'
translation: Evet! Kuzenlerimle nehir kenarinda harika bir parti yaparken “Agaci Vur” oyunu oynamaya karar verdik.

english: Smack the Tree?
It's a game were you take it in turnsh shmacking a tree. First one to uproot the tree winsh!
translation: Bu, sirayla bir agaci tokatladiginiz bir oyundur. Agaci kökünden söken ilk kisi kazanir!

english: Anyway, I won the game with a flying tackle. The tree came loose and down the river bank I went, still holding the tree.
translation: Her neyse, ben ucan bir hamle ile oyunu kazandim. Agac kökünden söküldü ve ben hala agaci tutarken nehir kiyisina düstüm.

english: I woke up a few hours later and found myself several miles down river. And thatsh how I invented the log canoe!
translation: Birkac saat sonra uyandigimda kendimi nehrin birkac mil asagisinda buldum. Ve iste böylece kütük kanoyu icat ettim!

english: So you invented the 'Log Canoe' by falling into a river hugging a tree?
translation: Yani bir agaca sarilmis halde nehre düserek 'Kütük Kano'yu icat ettin?

english: Well I refined the design from the original you know!
I cut all the branches off to make it more comfortable. I could tell you how to if you like?
translation: Daha rahat olmasi icin tüm dallari kestim. Istersen nasil yapildigini anlatabilirim?

english: No thanks, not right now.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, su anda gerek yok.

english: Can you teach me about canoes?
translation: Bana kanolar hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Well, you don't look like you have the skill to make a canoe.
translation: Sey, kano yapma becerisine sahip gibi görünmüyorsun.

english: You need to have at least level 12 woodcutting.
translation: En az 12. seviye odun kesme becerisine sahip olmalisin.

english: Once you are able to make a canoe it makes travel along the river much quicker!
translation: Kano yapmayi ögrendiginde nehirde cok daha hizli seyahat edebilirsin!

english: It's really quite simple. Just walk down to that tree on the bank and chop it down.
translation: Gercekten cok basit. Kiyida duran agaca dogru yürü ve onu kes.

english: Then take your axe to it and shape it how you like!
translation: Sonra baltani al ve istedigin sekli ver!

english: You can make a log canoe like mine! It'll get you 1 stop down the river.
translation: Benimki gibi bir kütük kano yapabilirsin! Nehirde 1 durak ilerleyebilirsin.

english: There's some snooty fella down near the Champions Guild who reckons his canoes are better than mine. He's never said it to my face though.
translation: Sampiyonlar Loncasi'nin yakininda, kanolarinin benimkinden daha iyi oldugunu düsünen kibirli bir adam var. Ama bunu yüzüme karsi hic söylemedi.

english: You could make a Dugout canoe with your woodcutting skill, but I don't see why you would want to.
translation: Odun kesme becerinizle bir kütük kano yapabilirsiniz, ama bunu neden yapmak isteyeceginizi anlamiyorum.

english: Well, you're pretty handy with an axe!
You could make Stable Dugout canoes, like that snooty fella Tarquin.
translation: Kibirli Tarquin gibi, saglam kütük kanolar yapabilirsiniz.

english: He reckons his canoes are better than mine. He's never said it to my face though.
translation: O, kendi kanolarinin benimkilerden daha iyi oldugunu düsünüyor. Ama bunu yüzüme karsi hic söylemedi.

english: You look like you know your way around a tree, you can make a Waka canoe.
translation: Agaclarla aran iyi görünüyor, Waka kanosu yapabilirsin.

english: What's a Waka?
I've only ever seen Hari using them. People say he's found a way to canoe the river underground and into the Wilderness
translation: Sadece Hari'nin kullandigini gördüm. Insanlar onun nehrin altindan gecip Wilderness'ya ulasmanin bir yolunu buldugunu söylüyor.

english: Hari hangs around up near Edgeville
He's a nice bloke.
Who are you?
Yes
No
Can you teach me about Canoeing?
Hello there.
Can't you see that I'm busy here?
Oh. Sorry, you don't look very busy.
Don't look busy? I've got a lot of important work to do here.
translation: Mesgul görünmüyor muyum? Burada yapmam gereken cok önemli isler var.

english: Really? What do you do?
That doesn't concern you. What are you doing here anyway?
translation: Seni ilgilendirmez. Sen burada ne yapiyorsun ki?

english: I'm not actually sure.
Hmph! Well I can tell you what you ARE doing.
translation: Hmph! Ne yaptigini ben sana söyleyebilirim.

english: What's that?
Wasting my time! Now go away! If you must speak to someone, speak to one of the other monks around here!
translation: Zamanimi bosa harciyorsun! Simdi git buradan! Biriyle konusmak istiyorsan, buradaki diger rahiplerden biriyle konus!

english: I'm on an important quest!
Really...
Yes! Do you want to know what my quest is?
translation: Evet! Görevimin ne oldugunu bilmek ister misin?

english: Let me see...you helped out a trader who in turn asked you to deliver something for him, and then you had to journey to some palace to see someone and they said thanks by sending you somewhere else.
translation: Bir bakalim... Bir tüccara yardim ettin, o da senden bir sey teslim etmeni istedi, sonra bir saraya gidip birini görmen gerekti ve onlar da sana tesekkür etmek icin seni baska bir yere gönderdiler.

english: Uhh...
So, now you've ended up down here, bothering me?
translation: Yani, simdi buraya gelip beni rahatsiz ediyorsun?

english: Uh, yes, that's about right.
Lucky me...
Sorry about that. I'll leave you alone, then.
translation: Kusura bakma. Seni rahat birakayim o zaman.

english: None of your business!
Of course it isn't, but you were the one who came here bothering me! So, unless you want something, be off with you!
translation: Tabii ki ilgilendirmez, ama beni rahatsiz eden sensin! Yani, bir sey istemiyorsan, git buradan!

english: I am looking for something.
And what are you looking for exactly?
The Chaos Altar, I think.
Hmph! Well, it's just a bit further down. Now, if you don't mind, I'm very busy here!
translation: Hmph! Sey, biraz daha asagida. Simdi, sakincasi yoksa, cok mesgulüm!

english: I'm the leader of the Dagon'hai. Bow before me!
You? Leader of the Dagon'hai? Hah! I've never heard of such rubbish! You call yourself a mage?
translation: Sen mi? Dagon'hai'nin lideri mi? Hah! Böyle bir sacmalik duymadim! Kendine büyücü mü diyorsun?

english: I'm a very powerful mage!
Really?
Yes! Be afraid! Be very afraid! Ha ha ha!
translation: Evet! Kork! Cok kork! Ha ha ha!

english: I see. Well then, let's see how you handle this!
translation: Anliyorum. Öyleyse, bakalim bunu nasil halledeceksin!

english: The player either dances, headbangs or jumps for joy
translation: Oyuncu sevincten dans eder, basini sallar veya ziplar.

english: Argh! I can't stop [dancing/headbanging/jumping]!
Hah! I knew you were no mage! Let that be a lesson to you! Now, please leave.
translation: Hah! Senin büyücü olmadigini biliyordum! Bu sana ders olsun! Simdi lütfen git.

english: Argh!
So! You are a good mage! You deflected my spell.
translation: Demek! Sen iyi bir büyücüsün! Büyümü savusturdun.

english: Hah! Yes. I told you so! Now, I have work to be done.
translation: Hah! Evet. Sana söylemistim! Simdi, yapmam gereken isler var.

english: Of course. Goodbye!
No, you're right. I'm not a mage.
I didn't think so! Now go away. As I said, I'm very busy!
translation: Ben de öyle düsünmüstüm! Simdi git buradan. Dedigim gibi, cok mesgulüm!

english: Hello.
Oh, it's you again. What are you doing here?
translation: Oh, yine sen. Burada ne isin var?

english: I'm not actually sure.
I'm on an important quest!
None of your business!
I am looking for something.
I'm the leader of the Dagon'hai. Bow before me!
I'm a very powerful mage!
No, you're right. I'm not a mage.
You! Time for some questions.
Why did you join the Emissaries?
I always knew people were wrong about me. I knew I would serve a higher purpose. I never cared what it was. I only cared that in doing so, I would be serving the will of Ralos.
translation: Insanlarin benim hakkimda yanildiklarini hep biliyordum. Daha yüksek bir amaca hizmet edecegimi biliyordum. Ne oldugu umurumda degildi. Tek umurumda olan, bunu yaparak Ralos'un iradesine hizmet edecegimdi.

english: I always knew people were wrong about me. I knew I would serve a higher purpose. I never cared what it was. I only cared that in doing so, I would be granted a place in Mictl.
translation: Insanlarin benim hakkimda yanildiklarini hep biliyordum. Daha yüksek bir amaca hizmet edecegimi biliyordum. Ne oldugu umurumda degildi. Tek umurumda olan, bunu yaparak Mictl'de bir yer kazanacaktim.

english: Who do you worship?
I have served Ralos my whole life. I am his humble servant. It was he who guided me here so that I may serve his will.
translation: Hayatim boyunca Ralos'a hizmet ettim. Ben onun alcakgönüllü hizmetkariyim. Beni buraya, onun iradesine hizmet etmem icin yönlendiren oydu.

english: Tell me about the Final Dawn.
The Final Dawn is an end, but also a beginning. It is when Ralos will use his holy fire to destroy this world so that he and Ranul can build a new one.
translation: Son Safak bir son, ama ayni zamanda bir baslangic. Ralos'un kutsal atesini kullanarak bu dünyayi yok edecegi ve Ranul ile birlikte yeni bir dünya kuracagi zamandir.

english: The Final Dawn is an end, but also a beginning. It is when Ralos will use his holy fire to destroy this world. Then he and Ranul will guide us to Mictl.
translation: Son Safak bir son, ama ayni zamanda bir baslangictir. Ralos'un kutsal atesini kullanarak bu dünyayi yok edecegi zamandir. Sonra o ve Ranul bizi Mictl'e götürecekler.

english: Why did you join the Emissaries?
Who do you worship?
Tell me about the Final Dawn.
Nilsal. Looking to buy some fine silks?
translation: Nilsal. Güzel ipekler mi almak istiyorsun?

english: Yes please.
No thanks.
You're missing out, but suit yourself.
You're the one who stole from me! Guards! Guards!
Yes please.
No thanks.
I buy silk. If you ever want to sell any silk, bring it here.
translation: Ipek aliyorum. Eger ipek satmak istersen, buraya getir.

english: Hello. I have some fine silk from far away to sell to you.
translation: Merhaba. Size uzaklardan getirdigim kaliteli ipeklerim var.

english: Ah I may be interested in that. What sort of price were you looking at per piece of silk?
translation: Ah, ilgilenebilirim. Bir ipek parcasi icin ne kadar fiyat düsünüyorsunuz?

english: 20 coins.
Ok suits me.
80 coins.
80 coins? That's a bit steep! How about 40 coins?
translation: 80 sikke mi? Bu biraz fazla! 40 sikkeye ne dersin?

english: Ok, 40 sounds good.
50, and that's my final price.
Done.
No, that is not enough.
120 coins.
You'll never get that much for it. I'll be generous and give you 50 for it.
translation: Bunu asla o fiyata satamazsin. Cömert davranip sana 50 verecegim.

english: Ok, I guess 50 will do.
I'll give it to you for 60.
You drive a hard bargain, but I guess that will have to do.
translation: Sert pazarlik ediyorsun, ama sanirim bu kadari yeterli.

english: 200 coins.
Don't be ridiculous! That is far too much. You insult me with that price.
translation: Sacmalama! Bu cok fazla. Bu fiyatla beni asagiliyorsun.

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
You're the one who stole something from me!
Guards guards!
20 coins.
80 coins.
Ok, 40 sounds good.
50, and that's my final price.
No, that is not enough.
120 coins.
Ok, I guess 50 will do.
I'll give it to you for 60.
200 coins.
Do you want to buy any fine silks?
How much are they?
3 gp.
No. That's too much for me.
translation: Hayir. Bu benim icin cok fazla.

english: 2 gp and that's as low as I'll go.
translation: 2 altin ve bu en düsük fiyatim.

english: I'm not selling it for any less. You'll probably go and sell it in Varrock for a profit, anyway.
translation: Daha ucuza satmam. Muhtemelen gidip Varrock'ta kâr etmek icin satacaksin zaten.

english: 2 gp sounds good.
Oh dear. I don't have enough money.
Well, come back when you do have some money!
No, really. I don't want it.
Okay, but that's the best price you're going to get.
translation: Tamam, ama alabilecegin en iyi fiyat bu.

english: Okay, that sounds good.
No. Silk doesn't suit me.
I'm in search of a man named Avan Fitzharmon.
translation: Avan Fitzharmon adinda bir adam ariyorum.

english: Can't say as I've seen him... I'm sure if he's been to Al-Kharid recently someone around here will have though.
translation: Onu gördügümü söyleyemem... Son zamanlarda Al-Kharid'e gelmisse, buralarda gören biri mutlaka vardir.

english: How much are they?
No. That's too much for me.
translation: Hayir. Bu benim icin cok fazla.

english: 2 gp sounds good.
No, really. I don't want it.
Okay, that sounds good.
No. Silk doesn't suit me.
I'm in search of a man named Avan Fitzharmon.
translation: Avan Fitzharmon adinda bir adam ariyorum.

english: Silver! Silver! Best prices for buying and selling in all Kandarin!
translation: Gümüs! Gümüs! Kandarin'deki en iyi alim satim fiyatlari!

english: Yes please.
No thank you.
Are you Erin?
That I am. What do you want? You realise I'm working here.
translation: Evet, benim. Ne istiyorsun? Burada calistigimi biliyorsun.

english: This shouldn't take too long. I just want to ask you a bit about your great Grandfather, the one who lived in the outpost?
translation: Cok uzun sürmez. Sadece büyük büyükbaban hakkinda birkac soru sormak istiyorum, öncü karakolda yasayan adam.

english: What's it to you?
I'm doing some research for a man called Jorral. Apparently the King is going to make the outpost into his very own alchemists' lab.
translation: Jorral adinda bir adam icin arastirma yapiyorum. Anlasilan kral öncü karakolu kendi kimya laboratuvari yapmak istiyor.

english: That can only cause chaos! Well, my great Grandfather lived and died there according to my mother, but even she knows very little about him.
translation: Bu sadece kaosa neden olur! Annem, büyük büyükbabamin orada yasadigini ve öldügünü söylüyor, ama o bile onun hakkinda cok az sey biliyor.

english: I see.
The only thing I have of his is a key. It's a strange key, it changes temperature by itself as you walk around. I'm afraid I don't know what it's for though.
translation: Ondan kalan tek sey bir anahtar. Garip bir anahtar, etrafta dolastikca kendi kendine sicakligini degistiriyor. Ne ise yaradigini bilmiyorum maalesef.

english: No idea at all?
Well, I imagine it's to some sort of chest of his belongings as it's too small for a door. Perhaps if you find some of his belongings you will discover some clues amongst them.
translation: Kapi icin cok kücük oldugu icin, sanirim onun esyalarinin bulundugu bir sandik icin. Belki onun esyalarini bulursan, aralarinda bazi ipuclari kesfedersin.

english: It's better than nothing. Will you lend it to me then?
translation: Hic yoktan iyidir. O zaman bana ödünc verir misin?

english: Why not. I can't use it anyway. Try feeling its change in temperature as you walk around.
translation: Neden olmasin. Zaten kullanamiyorum. Etrafta dolasirken sicaklik degisimini hissetmeye calis.

english: Wait, look how much you're carrying! You can't carry this too.
translation: Dur, ne kadar cok sey tasidigini bir bak! Bunu da tasiyamazsin.

english: I haven't found anything yet.
Keep trying. Have you noticed that the key changes temperature as you walk around?
translation: Denemeye devam et. Etrafta dolasirken anahtarin sicakliginin degistigini fark ettin mi?

english: I'll see what I can find once I take it off my key ring.
That's kind of hard because I lost the key.
translation: Anahtari kaybettigim icin bu biraz zor.

english: Liar. You stored it somewhere, didn't you!
translation: Yalanci. Bir yere sakladin, degil mi!

english: I was waiting for you to say that because I just found it! Take it and don't lose it.
translation: Senin bunu söylemeni bekliyordum cünkü az önce buldum! Al ve kaybetme.

english: I found a chest, but I lost it and any contents it had.
translation: Bir sandik buldum ama onu ve icindekileri kaybettim.

english: Well I suggest you go back to where you found it.
I was waiting for you to say that because I just found it!
translation: Senin bunu söylemeni bekliyordum cünkü az önce buldum!

english: I found a chest
I wonder what is inside.
Would you like to see the journal I have found?
Let's have a look.
Erin reads the journal.
Very interesting. Best you show it to Jorral at the outpost.
translation: Cok ilginc. En iyisi onu karakoldaki Jorral'a göster.

english: I was just about to. Do you want the key back?
translation: Ben de tam bunu yapacaktim. Anahtari geri ister misin?

english: Keep it, it may come in handy.
Hello again.
Hello, I hope Jorral was pleased with that Journal.
I'm sure it's been a valuable find.
translation: Eminim cok degerli bir buluntu olmustur.

english: What I came to ask was: I lost that key you gave me.
translation: Sormak istedigim sey su: Bana verdigin anahtari kaybettim.

english: Oh dear, luckily I found it, but it'll cost you 500gp as I know it's valuable.
translation: Oh hayir, neyse ki buldum, ama degerli oldugunu bildigim icin sana 500 altin ödeyeceksin.

english: You don't have enough money, sorry.
You don't have the space to carry it! Empty some space in your inventory.
translation: Onu tasiyacak yerin yok! Envanterinde biraz yer ac.

english: Thank you, enjoy!
No thanks.
You know you can use that enchanted key you have on your keyring all over Gielinor. Who knows what you might find?
translation: Anahtarliginda bulunan o büyülü anahtari Gielinor'un her yerinde kullanabilecegini biliyor musun? Kim bilir ne bulabilirsin?

english: You know you can use that enchanted key you've got stored? You can use it all over Gielinor. Who knows what you might find?
translation: Sakladigin o büyülü anahtari kullanabilecegini biliyor musun? Gielinor'un her yerinde kullanabilirsin. Kim bilir ne bulabilirsin?

english: You know you can use that enchanted key you have all over Gielinor. Who knows what you might find?
translation: Gielinor'un her yerinde sahip oldugun o büyülü anahtari kullanabilecegini biliyor musun? Kim bilir ne bulabilirsin?

english: Oh, You know that key you gave me?
translation: Oh, bana verdigin anahtar var ya?

english: Yes?
It dissolved!
Really? I suppose it served its purpose.
I'm here to tell you about some new taxes.
translation: Sana yeni vergiler hakkinda bilgi vermek icin geldim.

english: New taxes? What are you on about?
The king has called for a tax on luxury items. Your stall is included.
translation: Kral lüks esyalara vergi koydu. Senin tezgahin da buna dahil.

english: Well that is unacceptable! I will have to increase my prices. I've produced silver for the king himself before but don't expect me to do that again!
translation: Bu kabul edilemez! Fiyatlarimi artirmak zorunda kalacagim. Daha önce kral icin gümüs üretmistim ama bunu tekrar yapmami bekleme!

english: As you wish, but you'll still need to pay. Your first instalment will be collected soon.
translation: Nasil istersen, ama yine de ödeme yapman gerekecek. Ilk taksit yakinda tahsil edilecek.

english: The king wouldn't send a mourner to tell me this. Clear off!
translation: Kral bunu bana söylemesi icin bir cenazeci göndermez. Defol!

english: The king wouldn't send a citizen to tell me this. Clear off!
translation: Kral bunu bana söylemesi icin bir vatandas göndermez. Defol!

english: Yes please.
No thank you.
Ask about the outpost.
No thanks.
I'm here to tell you about some new taxes.
translation: Sana yeni vergiler hakkinda bilgi vermek icin buradayim.

english: Hello there, are you interested in buying one of my special capes?
translation: Merhaba, özel pelerinlerimden birini satin almak ister misin?

english: What's so special about your capes?

Ahh well they make it less likely that you'll accidently attack anyone wearing the same cape as you and easier to attack everyone else. They also make it easier to distinguish people who're wearing the same cape as you
translation: Ahh, ayni pelerini giyen birine yanlislikla saldirma olasiligini azaltir ve diger herkese saldirmayi kolaylastirir. Ayrica, sizinle ayni pelerini giyen kisileri digerlerinden ayirt etmeyi kolaylastirir.

english: from everyone else. They're very useful when out in the wilderness with friends or anyone else you don't want to harm.
translation: Arkadaslarinizla veya zarar vermek istemediginiz kisilerle Wildernessda dolasirken cok kullanislidir.

english: So would you like to buy one?
translation: Peki, bir tane satin almak ister misiniz?

english: No thanks.
What's so special about your capes?
Yes please!
No thanks.
I can't believe we've finally arrived, I can't wait to explore!
translation: Sonunda vardigimiza inanamiyorum, kesfetmek icin sabirsizlaniyorum!

english: So much to see, I don't know where to start!
translation: Görülecek o kadar cok sey var ki, nereden baslayacagimi bilemiyorum!

english: A whole new continent to explore... what a time to be
translation: Kesfedilecek yepyeni bir kita... Ne harika bir zaman!

english: Are you the tour guide?
Nope, I'm just as lost as you.
translation: Hayir, ben de sizin kadar kayboldum.

english: I overheard someone mention there are pirates and thieves here, be careful!
translation: Burada korsanlar ve hirsizlar oldugunu duydum, dikkatli olun!

english: Hello.
G'day, mate. I'm Simon - Simon Templeton. Who are you?
translation: Merhaba dostum. Ben Simon - Simon Templeton. Sen kimsin?

english: I'm [player name]. What are you doing all the way out here?
translation: Ben Maceraci. Buralarda ne isin var?

english: I've been contracted to retrieve artefacts from the top of this magnificent pyramid.
translation: Bu muhtesem piramidin tepesinden eserleri almak icin sözlesme imzaladim.

english: So, why are you down here and not up there then?
translation: Peki, neden yukarida degil de asagidasin?

english: Well, it's me back - an old injury I picked up in Sophanem has come back to haunt me. I was working for the Museum of Varrock, and the gold I had been given wasn't enough to pay for the carpet rides, let
translation: Sey, benim eski bir sakatligim var, Sophanem'de aldigim bir yara tekrar nüksetti. Varrock Müzesi icin calisiyordum ve bana verilen altin, hali sirtinda yolculuk masraflarini karsilamaya yetmiyordu,

english: alone any decent equipment. But that was a long time ago... I can't even lift a chisel right now. There's no way I can climb all the way up there.
translation: düzgün bir ekipman almaya ise hic yetmiyordu. Ama bu cok uzun zaman önceydi... Su anda bir keski bile kaldiramiyorum. Oraya tirmanmam imkansiz.

english: How on earth did you get down the cliff face, then?
translation: O zaman bu kayaliktan nasil indin?

english: That's what set off the injury. I was fine before I scrabbled down that pesky slope. I think it will be a while before I can climb back up again; I must be getting old.
translation: Yaralanmamin sebebi de buydu. O sinir bozucu yamaci tirmanmadan önce gayet iyiydim. Tekrar tirmanabilmem icin biraz zaman gecmesi gerekecek galiba; yaslaniyorum galiba.

english: Hang on a second... You look like you're pretty agile and up for a challenge. How about you retrieve it for me?
translation: Bir saniye... Oldukca cevik ve zorlu görevlere hazir görünüyorsun. Onu benim icin getirmeye ne dersin?

english: I'll tell you what, I'll give you 10000 coins for every artefact you get for me.
translation: Bak ne diyecegim, bana getirdigin her eser icin sana 10.000 sikke verecegim.

english: I'll see what I can do.
Good on ya, mate!
Hello, Simon.
G'day, [player name].
How's it going?
Not bad, mate, not bad at all. Got any artefacts for me?
translation: Fena degil dostum, hic fena degil. Benim icin herhangi bir eser var mi?

english: No, I haven't.
Try harder, mate! It won't be long till some other critter turns up and snatches them out from under your eyes.
translation: Daha cok cabala dostum! Baska bir yaratik gelip onlari gözünün önünden kapip götürmesi cok uzun sürmez.

english: I will, goodbye.
Bye, cobber.
Ripper! Thanks a bundle, mate! Thanks to you I can fulfill me contract. You're a true blue! The boss will be pleased.
translation: Harika! Cok tesekkürler dostum! Sayende sözlesmemi yerine getirebilecegim. Sen gercek bir dostsun! Patron cok sevinecek.

english: Glad I was able to help... but who is your boss? I thought you worked for the museum?
translation: Yardimci olabildigime sevindim... ama patronun kim? Müze icin calistigini saniyordum?

english: Mind your own bizzo, mate. But if you get any more, you know where I am!
translation: Kendi isine bak dostum. Ama baska bir sey bulursan, beni bulabilirsin!

english: I have one, but I want to keep it for now.
translation: Bir tane var ama simdilik saklamak istiyorum.

english: Careful, mate, people might come looking for a thing like that!
translation: Dikkatli ol dostum, insanlar böyle bir seyi aramaya gelebilir!

english: Thanks for the advice, but I'll hang onto it for now.
translation: Tavsiyen icin tesekkürler, ama simdilik saklayacagim.

english: I have some, but I want to keep them for now.
translation: Bende var, ama simdilik saklamak istiyorum.

english: G'day, mate. Got any new pyramid artefacts for me?
translation: Merhaba dostum. Benim icin yeni piramit eserleri var mi?

english: Well, keep my offer in mind if you do find one.
I will. Goodbye, Simon.
Bye, mate.
I have some interesting artefacts I'd like you to look at.
translation: Sana bakmani istedigim bazi ilginc eserler var.

english: Bonzer! Let's have a Butcher's mate.
Do you want to flog the lot of 'em?
Yes, show me the money.
Fair Dinkum mate, Bonzer doing business with you mate.
translation: Gercekten dostum, seninle is yapmak harika dostum.

english: You sellin' me this gold coloured stick thing. Looks fake to me.I'll give you 100 gold for it.
translation: Bana bu altin renkli cubuk seyi satiyorsun. Bana sahte gibi görünüyor. Sana 100 altin veririm.

english: What! This is a genuine pharaoh's sceptre - made out of solid gold and finely jewelled with precious gems by the finest craftsmen in the area.
translation: Ne! Bu gercek bir firavun asasi - bölgedeki en iyi zanaatkarlar tarafindan saf altindan yapilmis ve degerli taslarla süslenmis.

english: Strewth! I can tell a pile of croc when I hear it! You've got the patter mate, but I'm no mug. That's a fake.
translation: Haydi ama! Sacmaligi hemen anlarim! Konusma yetenegin var dostum, ama ben aptal degilim. Bu sahte.

english: It has magical powers!
Oh, magical powers ... yeah, yeah, yeah.  Heard it all before mate. I'll give you a 100 gold, or some 'magic beans'. Take it or leave it.
translation: Oh, büyülü gücler... evet, evet, evet.  Bunlari daha önce de duydum dostum. Sana 100 altin ya da biraz “sihirli fasulye” veririm. Kabul et ya da etme.

english: I don't think so! I'll find someone who'll give me what it's worth.
translation: Sanmiyorum! Bana degerini verecek birini bulacagim.

english: Suit yerself.. You wanna sell the other artefacts you have?
translation: Sen bilirsin... Diger eserlerini de satmak ister misin?

english: Yes, as long as I get a decent price for them.
Nah, I've changed my mind.
No, let me think about it.
No probs mate. Just give me the items you want to sell and we can do them one by one.
translation: Sorun degil dostum. Satmak istedigin esyalari bana ver, tek tek hallederiz.

english: You wanna sell that mate?
Cheers mate!
No, I think I'll keep it.
That's a nice looking artefact you got there mate. Gimme a chat and lemme explain what these are all about first!
translation: Elindeki eser cok güzel görünüyor dostum. Biraz konusalim, önce bunlarin ne oldugunu aciklayayim!

english: Oh, magical powers ... yeah, yeah, yeah. Heard it all before mate. I'll give you a 100 gold, or some 'magic beans'. Take it or leave it.
translation: Oh, sihirli gücler... evet, evet, evet. Bunlari daha önce de duydum dostum. Sana 100 altin ya da biraz “sihirli fasulye” veririm. Kabul et ya da etme.

english: Suit yerself..
Sell it.
Keep it.
Sell them.
Keep them.
Yes, show me the money.
Yes, as long as I get a decent price for them.
Nah, I've changed my mind.
No, let me think about it.
No, I think I'll keep it.
Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: Hey, bu Kahraman! Vay canina! Harikasin, o iki juvinate ve Gadderank'i nasil alt ettin? Ve kasaba cok güzel, harika bir is cikarmissin!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
I'm Simona, I'm trying to stay warm by this fire.
translation: Ben Simona, bu atesin yaninda isinmaya calisiyorum.

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: Oh, pek bir sey yok, hepimiz hala vampirlerden saklaniyoruz ve bu korkunc yerde gecimimizi sagliyoruz, umarim yakinda Salve'deki tapinaga yolculuk yapacak kadar gücleniriz.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: Bildigim kadariyla yok, su anda cok yararli olan bazi temel olanaklara sahibiz, hepimiz sana cok minnettariz. Daha önce hic bir kahraman görmedim veya tanimadim, bu yüzden karsilastiracak bir seyim yok, ama sanirim

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: cogu insanin görüsüne göre, sen bir kahramansin! Ben sahsen seninle tanistigima cok memnunum.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Ok, thanks.
Augh! Your sins! They BLIND me!
I'm looking for the Sin Seer.
Are you another one of those 'holier than thou' fools wanting to redeem themselves?
translation: Sen de kendini kurtarmak isteyen ‘kendini kutsal gören’ aptallardan misin?

english: Uh, no actually, I'm trying to join a really evil guy's team.
translation: Aslinda hayir, gercekten kötü bir adamin ekibine katilmaya calisiyorum.

english: Really? Finally, something worthwhile.
translation: Gercekten mi? Sonunda, degerli bir sey.

english: It was fun messing with those devotees the first few times but, after a while, condemning people to an eternity of damnation gets a bit dull.
translation: Ilk birkac sefer o adanmislarla ugrasmak eglenceliydi ama bir süre sonra insanlari sonsuza kadar lanetlemeye mahkum etmek biraz sikici oluyor.

english: So, whom are you trying to hook up with? Dark priest? Warlord? Penguin?
translation: Peki, kiminle baglanti kurmaya calisiyorsun? Karanlik rahip? Savas lordu? Penguen?

english: Uh, I want to prove to General Khazard I'm trustworthy.
translation: General Khazard'a güvenilir oldugumu kanitlamak istiyorum.

english: Oh, that old fart? Is he still around? Humph. I dunno if I can be bothered.
translation: Oh, o yasli moruk mu? Hala buralarda mi? Humph. Ugrasmak isteyecegimi sanmiyorum.

english: What if I pay you for the trouble - would you then? I can't imagine you make much money, seeing people's sins and all.
translation: Eger sana zahmetin icin para versem, yapar misin? Insanlarin günahlarini görmekten cok para kazandigini sanmiyorum.

english: Oh, there's money in it. I just don't get invited to many parties.
translation: Oh, bu isten para kazaniliyor. Sadece pek partiye davet edilmiyorum.

english: You got me all excited about evil plots, and now it's just a matter of trust. I really can't be bothered to strain myself on that account.
translation: Beni kötü planlarla heyecanlandirdin, simdi sadece güven meselesi kaldi. Bu konuda kendimi zorlamak istemiyorum.

english: Fine, you don't actually have to see my sins, just pronounce me to be trustworthy. I'll pay you and be on my way.
translation: Tamam, günahlarimi görmen gerekmez, sadece güvenilir oldugumu ilan et. Sana ödeme yapip yoluma devam ederim.

english: He'll know it's a lie. But I do need the cash, so I'll do it. Gimme 40 gold coins and you'll be as trustworthy as a newborn.
translation: Yalan oldugunu anlayacaktir. Ama paraya ihtiyacim var, o yüzden yapacagim. Bana 40 altin ver, yeni dogmus bir bebek kadar güvenilir olacaksin.

english: Here's the money.
Fine. I declare you trustworthy, if you consider bribing a seer a trustworthy transaction.
translation: Tamam. Bir kahine rüsvet vermeyi güvenilir bir islem olarak görüyorsan, seni güvenilir ilan ediyorum.

english: Give this note to Khazard, it will prove you have been to see me.
translation: Bu notu Khazard'a ver, bu benimle görüstügünü kanitlayacaktir.

english: PLEASE! I want to know what he's up to.
translation: LÜTFEN! Neyin pesinde oldugunu bilmek istiyorum.

english: Ooooh, you're going to learn of his plans and stab him in the back?
translation: Ooooh, planlarini ögrenip onu sirtindan bicaklayacak misin?

english: Absolutely.
Fine, give me 40 gold coins and I'll take a look at your sins.
translation: Peki, bana 40 altin ver, günahlarina bir bakayim.

english: You have done many great deeds...but many terrible deeds. Sometimes you do them by accident, but are still sins. No, I would not trust you to walk my dog.
translation: Bircok büyük is basardin... ama bircok korkunc is de yaptin. Bazen kazara yapiyorsun, ama yine de günah. Hayir, köpegimi gezdirmen icin sana güvenmem.

english: Whatcha lookin' at chicken legs? Don't you have a General you should speak to?
translation: Ne bakiyorsun tavuk bacagi? Konusman gereken bir generalin yok mu?

english: I lost the note.
You already have one. Get on with you!
translation: Zaten bir tane var. Devam et!

english: Here ya go. Take more care of it this time.
translation: Al bakalim. Bu sefer daha dikkatli ol.

english: Bribe
Here's the money.
Never mind.
Plead
Yes, I should get to that.
BARK
Hello there; I see you're qualified. Come to help us out?
translation: Merhaba, görüyorum ki niteliklisin. Bize yardim etmeye mi geldin?

english: Hello! You're that student who recently finished all three Earth Sciences exams, aren't you? Come to help us out?
translation: Merhaba! Sen yakin zamanda üc Earth Sciences sinavini da bitiren ögrenci, degil mi? Bize yardim etmeye mi geldin?

english: Greetings, my dear [sir/madam]. Have you come to give us a hand?
translation: Merhaba, sevgili . Bize yardim etmeye mi geldin?

english: Yes, how can I help out?

Well, you'll need to get your equipment first - it's all there on the tool rack. Use what you learned from your Earth Sciences exams. You'll need to be wearing your leather gloves and boots as well as have access to
translation: Önce ekipmanlarini almalisin, hepsi alet rafinda. Yer Bilimleri sinavlarinda ögrendiklerini kullan. Deri eldivenlerini ve botlarini giymeli, ayrica

english: your trowel, rock pick and specimen brush.
translation: kürek, kaya kazma ve numune fircasina erisimin olmali.

english: I see you have your equipment - well done.

To really give us a hand, you could clean some finds for us. They're mostly done - just some fine work to finish off. Take a find from the pile that the workmen are bringing in, then there are spare tables over there
translation: Bize gercekten yardim etmek istiyorsaniz, buluntulari temizleyebilirsiniz. Cogu isleri bitti, sadece son rötuslar kaldi. Iscilerin getirdigi yigindan bir buluntu alin, temizlemek icin orada bos masalar var.

english: to clean them on. If you find anything interesting, let us know and we'll see if it's good enough to go on display.
translation: Ilginc bir sey bulursaniz bize haber verin, sergilenmeye deger olup olmadigini kontrol edelim.

english: I found something interesting.
Oh? Let's take a look...
I found this pretty necklace.
Interesting...yes...yes...hmmm.... It looks like it's enchanted.
translation: Ilginc... evet... evet... hmmm.... Büyülü gibi görünüyor.

english: With what?

Oh, I think it's just a benign teleportation spell. I tinker in magic when I'm not doing archaeology. I can teach you how to make more necklaces like this. Amazing that they had this kind of knowledge back then.
translation: Oh, sanirim sadece zararsiz bir isinlanma büyüsü. Arkeolojiyle ugrasmadigim zamanlarda büyüyle ugrasirim. Sana bunun gibi daha fazla kolye yapmayi ögretebilirim. O zamanlar bu tür bilgilere sahip olmalari sasirtici.

english: That would be good. Where is the teleport to?
Hmm...all the indications are that it's somewhere to the east of us, but I'm not sure how far. Perhaps it was a teleport back to Saranthium. Let me just take a closer look.
translation: Hmm... tüm isaretler bunun bizim dogumuzda bir yer oldugunu gösteriyor, ama ne kadar uzak oldugunu bilmiyorum. Belki de Saranthium'a geri isinlanma icindi. Bir daha yakindan bakayim.

english: So I just make a ruby necklace and use five fire runes and one cosmic rune to enchant it.
translation: Yani bir yakut kolye yapip, bes ates runesi ve bir kozmik runesi kullanarak onu büyülüyorum.

english: Yes, indeed. Well done, youngster, thanks for helping us.
translation: Evet, aynen öyle. Aferin genc adam, yardim ettigin icin tesekkürler.

english: I've cleaned this old coin - is it of any use?
translation: Bu eski parayi temizledim, bir ise yarar mi?

english: Oh my! What a wonderful find! If this is what I believe it to be, it would allow us to date the Dig Site city.
translation: Vay canina! Ne harika bir buluntu! Eger tahmin ettigim gibi ise, kazi alanindaki sehrin tarihini belirlememizi saglayacak.

english: And look here, it has the name of the city too! Saranthium! That must be during the Saradominist occupation. This is a wonderful find. Please take it and place it in display case 45.
translation: Bakin, üzerinde sehrin adi da yaziyor! Saranthium! Saradominist isgali sirasinda olmali. Bu harika bir buluntu. Lütfen al ve 45 numarali vitrine koy.

english: Right, display case 45 it is...
Back again? Have you put the old coin in display case 45 yet?
translation: Yine mi geldin? Eski parayi 45 numarali vitrine koydun mu?

english: No, I'll go do that now
You've already shown me one of those, but it was in better condition. It's in the display case over there. You can pop this one in the finds crate over in the corner.
translation: Bana onlardan birini göstermistin, ama o daha iyi durumdaydi. Suradaki vitrinde. Bunu kösedeki buluntu sandigina koyabilirsin.

english: I found this really old coin - is it of any use?
translation: Cok eski bir sikke buldum, bir ise yarar mi?

english: What have we here?

Oh! This is very interesting...and confusing at the same time. This coin means that the city that we're excavating on the Digsite - Saranthium - was actually inhabited much, much earlier by followers of Zamorak,
translation: Oh! Bu cok ilginc... ama ayni zamanda kafa karistirici. Bu sikke, kazi alaninda kazi yaptigimiz sehir olan Saranthium'un aslinda cok daha önceden Zamorak'in takipcileri tarafindan iskan edildigini gösteriyor.

english: at which time, the city was known as Senntisten.
translation: O zamanlar sehir Senntisten olarak biliniyordu.

english: This is a most remarkable discovery, as we have other evidence indicating that Zarosian followers were resident before the Saradominists took over, but it also seems that Zamorakian forces used it during a battle of some
translation: Bu cok önemli bir kesif, cünkü Saradoministlerin yönetimi ele gecirmeden önce Zaros'un takipcilerinin burada yasadigini gösteren baska kanitlar da var, ama ayni zamanda Zamorak'in güclerinin bir tür savas sirasinda burayi kullandigi da anlasiliyor.

english: sort. Still, it allows us to roughly date when the city changed from following Zaros and Zamorak to following Saradomin. Put it in display case 44.
translation: Yine de, bu kesif, sehrin Zaros ve Zamorak'tan Saradomin'e gectigi tarihi yaklasik olarak belirlememizi sagliyor. 44 numarali vitrine koyun.

english: Case 44 it is!
Back again? Have you put the ancient coin in display case 44 yet?
translation: Yine mi geldin? Eski parayi vitrin 44'e koydun mu?

english: No, I'll go do that now.
I found this crumbly old decoration - is it of any use?
translation: Bu ufalanmis eski süslemeyi buldum, bir ise yarar mi?

english: Ahh... That looks like an altar piece. Hmm, yes...from the early Saradominist worshippers by the looks of it. Quite delicate, too. Put it in display case 37.
translation: Ahh... Bu bir sunak parcasi gibi görünüyor. Hmm, evet... Görünüse göre Saradoministlerin ilk takipcilerine ait. Oldukca narin de. Vitrin 37'ye koy.

english: Case 37 it is!
Back again? Have you put the ancient symbol in display case 37 yet?
translation: Yine mi geldin? Eski sembolü 37 numarali vitrine koydun mu?

english: I found this really old decoration - is it of any use?
translation: Bu cok eski bir süsleme buldum, ise yarar mi?

english: Wow!
That's in rather good condition, isn't it? An old altar decoration by the looks of things, from the Saradominist city no doubt. Put it in display case 36.
translation: Durumu oldukca iyi, degil mi? Görünüse göre eski bir sunak süslemesi, süphesiz Saradominist sehirden. 36 numarali vitrine koy.

english: Case 36 it is!
Back again? Have you put the old symbol in display case 36 yet?
translation: Yine mi geldin? Eski sembolü 36 numarali vitrine koydun mu?

english: I found this piece of pottery - is it of any use?
translation: Bu cömlek parcasini buldum, bir ise yarar mi?

english: Ahh... Oh! Hmm...yes...made by Zaros worshippers, by the looks of it. Beautifully-shaped. It looks as if this would go nicely in display case 22. This piece reinforces our evidence that the city was occupied by
translation: Ahh... Oh! Hmm... evet... görünüse göre Zaros'a tapanlar tarafindan yapilmis. Cok güzel sekilli. 22 numarali vitrine cok yakisacak gibi görünüyor. Bu parca, sehrin Saradoministlerden önce Zaros'a tapanlar tarafindan isgal edildigine dair kanitlarimizi güclendiriyor.

english: Zarosians before Saradominists.
Case 22 it is!
translation: Zaroslular tarafindan isgal edildigine dair kanitimizi güclendiriyor.

english: Back again? Have you put the pottery in display case 22 yet?
translation: Yine mi geldin? Cömlegi 22 numarali vitrine koydun mu?

english: I found these old arrowheads.
Ahh, yes, we find lots of those - they're not important. We already have some in our display. Just add it to the crate of finds over near the door.
translation: Ahh, evet, bunlardan cok buluyoruz - önemli degiller. Vitrinde zaten var. Kapinin yanindaki buluntular sandigina koy.

english: If there is anything already in the crate, feel free to take it as a reward for your work.
translation: Sandikta zaten bir sey varsa, calismanin karsiligi olarak alabilirsin.

english: Oh, okay.
Take a look at this...
I found these old necklaces.
An interesting find... Here, let me offer you something in return.
translation: Ilginc bir buluntu... Al, sana karsiliginda bir sey vereyim.

english: Oh! Okay.
I cleaned up this old vase.
Ah, the vases... I've lost count of how many we've found of those... The only completely intact one is in the display case already. Just add it to the crate of finds over near the door.
translation: Ah, vazolar... Kac tane buldugumuzu sayamadim bile... Tek saglam olani zaten vitrinde. Kapinin yanindaki buluntularin oldugu sandiga ekle.

english: Right.
Err... I seem to have lost it. Sorry.
Sounds like you never had it, [lad/lass]!
No, just here to watch.
Thank you, but I don't need that
Yes, how can I help out?
I found something interesting.
No thanks.
Who are you?
My name iz Vlad. I come from far avay, vere the sun iz not so bright.
translation: Adim Vlad. Günesin cok parlak olmadigi uzak bir yerden geldim.

english: You're a vampyre aren't you?
Just because I can't stand ze smell ov garlic und I don't like bright sunlight doesn't necessarily mean I'm ein vampyre!
translation: Sarimsak kokusuna dayanamiyorum ve parlak günes isigini sevmiyorum diye vampir oldugum anlamina gelmez!

english: Is it nice there?
It is vonderful! Ze beautiful und ze nights are long!
translation: Harika! Cok güzel ve geceler uzun!

english: So... you like fishing?
My doctor told me to take up ein velaxing hobby. Vhen I  am stressed I tend to get ein little...
translation: Doktorum bana rahatlatici bir hobi edinmemi söyledi. Stresli oldugumda biraz...

english: ..thirsty.
If you get thirsty you should drink something.
I tsink I may do zat soon...
Well, good luck with the fishing.
Luck haz notsing to do vith it it iz all in ze technique.
translation: Sansin bununla bir ilgisi yok, her sey teknikte bitiyor.

english: I think you will find that is my spot.
Can't you go to another spot?
I like this place. I like to savour the aroma coming from these pipes.
translation: Bu yeri seviyorum. Bu borulardan gelen kokuyu tatmak hosuma gidiyor.

english: Arghh! WHAT is that GHASTLY smell??? I think I will mover over here instead...
translation: Ahhh! Bu korkunc koku da ne??? Sanirim ben buraya gececegim...

english: Uurrggh! Get zat horrible tsing avay from me! How do people like to eat zat stuff? I can't stand even to be near it for tsen zeconds!
translation: Uurrggh! O igrenc kokuyu benden uzaklastir! Insanlar nasil o seyi yiyebiliyor? On saniye bile yaninda duramiyorum!

english: Umm... sorry
Who are you?
You're a vampyre aren't you?
Is it nice there?
So you like fishing?
So... you like fishing?
If you get thirsty you should drink something.
Well, good luck with the fishing.
Hello Sir Amik.
Hello, friend!
Well [player name], now that you are a White Knight, I expect you should be out there hunting Black Knights for us!
translation: Peki Maceraci, artik bir Beyaz Sövalye olduguna göre, bizim icin Kara Sövalyeleri avlaman gerektigini düsünüyorum!

english: Sadly we are not as rich as we once were, and there are many White Knights who foolishly lose their combat equipment.
translation: Ne yazik ki eskisi kadar zengin degiliz ve bircok Beyaz Sövalye aptalca savas ekipmanlarini kaybediyor.

english: We do not think it fair to make a profit from our brethren, so we will sell you equipment at cost, and rebuy it at the same cost, but we will only sell equipment to those we consider responsible enough to
translation: Kardeslerimizden kar elde etmenin adil olmadigini düsünüyoruz, bu yüzden sana ekipmani maliyetine satacagiz ve ayni maliyetle geri alacagiz, ancak ekipmani sadece dogru sekilde kullanabilecek kadar sorumlu oldugunu düsündügümüz kisilere satacagiz.

english: wield it correctly.
translation: Siyah Sövalyeleri öldürerek bizim nezdindeki itibarini artiracaksin, Beyaz Sövalyeleri öldürerek ise elbette seni daha az takdir edecegiz.

english: By killing Black Knights, you will increase your reputation with us, by killing White Knights we will obviously think less of you.
translation: Beyaz Sövalye itibar seviyeni, Araniyor! görevinin görev günlügüne bakarak kontrol edebilirsin veya ekipman satin almaya gittiginde Sör Vyvin sana hangi seviyede oldugunu söyleyecektir.

english: You can check your White Knight reputation level by looking at your quest journal for the Wanted! Quest, or Sir Vyvin will let you know what level you are at when you go to purchase equipment.
translation: Beyaz Sövalye itibar seviyenizi, görev günlügünüzdeki “Araniyor!” görevine bakarak kontrol edebilirsiniz veya Sir Vyvin, ekipman satin almaya gittiginizde size seviyenizi söyleyecektir.

english: Sir Vyvin can be found in Falador Castle, and he will sell you any equipment appropriate to your reputation level.
translation: Sir Vyvin, Falador Kalesi'nde bulunur ve size itibar seviyenize uygun ekipman satar.

english: Have fun, and go kill some Black Knights for me!
translation: Iyi eglenceler, gidip benim icin birkac Kara Sövalye öldürün!

english: Okay Amik, thanks for explaining!
Okay, bye!
Okay, 'bye then Amik!
Can you explain the White Knight honour system again?
translation: Beyaz Sövalye onur sistemini tekrar aciklayabilir misin?

english: May I help you?
I'm really just looking for a quest...
Fortune favours us both then adventurer. I suggest you go and speak to King Arthur.
translation: O zaman sans ikimize de gülüyor maceraci. Kral Arthur ile konusmani öneririm.

english: Merlin's in a crystal. Little help?
translation: Merlin kristalin icinde. Biraz yardim eder misin?

english: That is what we were hoping for from you, adventurer!
translation: Biz de senden bunu umuyorduk maceraci!

english: Hmmm. Well, ok, thanks anyway.
translation: Hmmm. Peki, tamam, yine de tesekkürler.

english: I don't suppose you have any idea how to break into Mordred's fort do you?
translation: Mordred'in kalesine nasil girebilecegimizi biliyor musun?

english: I am afraid not. Would that we could! Mordred and his cronies have been thorns in our side for far too long already!
translation: Korkarim ki hayir. Keske bilseydik! Mordred ve yandaslari cok uzun zamandir basimizin belasi oldular!

english: Ok. Thanks. See you later!
Take care adventurer, Mordred is an evil and powerful foe.
translation: Kendine dikkat et maceraci, Mordred kötü ve güclü bir düsmandir.

english: Know anything about Excalibur?
translation: Excalibur hakkinda bir sey biliyor musun?

english: Um... it's a really good sword?
translation: Sey... cok iyi bir kilic mi?

english: Know where I can find it?
Nope, sorry.
All Knights of the Round thank you for your assistance in this trying time for us.
translation: Yuvarlak Masa Sövalyeleri, bu zor zamanimizda yardimin icin tesekkür ederiz.

english: You are looking for the Grail now adventurer?
translation: Simdi Kutsal Kase'yi mi ariyorsun maceraci?

english: Absolutely.
The best of luck to you! Make the name of Camelot proud, and bring it back to us.
translation: Sana bol sans! Camelot'un adini gururlandir ve onu bize geri getir.

english: How did you let a bunch of Black Knights get the better of you? I thought you guys were the toughest knights around.
translation: Bir grup Kara Sövalye'nin sizi yenmesine nasil izin verdiniz? Sizin en sert sövalyeler oldugunuzu saniyordum.

english: We are true knights who fight for honour. Those Black Knights didn't fight fair, so we were unprepared. Most unchivalrous of them.
translation: Biz onur icin savasan gercek sövalyeleriz. O Kara Sövalyeler adil savasmadilar, bu yüzden hazirliksiz yakalandik. Hic sövalyece davranmadilar.

english: If we break out of this cell, do you reckon you can take on the Black Knights in the keep?
translation: Bu hücreden kacarsak, kaledeki Kara Sövalyelerle basa cikabilir misin?

english: You just let me at them. We'll see how they like surprise attacks.
translation: Beni onlara birakin. Sürpriz saldirilari nasil bulacaklarini görelim.

english: How are you going to get all of us out of here?
I'm not sure yet. Have you got any useful objects in your pockets?
translation: Henüz emin degilim. Cebinde kullanisli bir sey var mi?

english: Thanks.
I already gave you everything I had in my pockets.
translation: Cebimde olan her seyi sana verdim.

english: Let me out! Let me out, I say!
Give me an R. Give me an O. Give me a U..
translation: Bana bir R ver. Bana bir O ver. Bana bir U ver...

english: In the amount of time it will take you to spell out Round Table Knights, you could have found the Grail.
translation: Yuvarlak Masa Sövalyeleri'ni hecelemek icin harcayacagin sürede Kutsal Kase'yi bulabilirdin.

english: What am I supposed to do with that?
Thank you for your assistance in our time of need.
translation: Zor zamanimizda yardim ettiginiz icin tesekkürler.

english: You're welcome.
Hello Paladin. I wasn't expecting to see anyone else down here.
translation: Merhaba Paladin. Burada baska birini görmeyi beklemiyordum.

english: Nor were we traveller. What are you doing in this most unholy place?
translation: Biz de öyle, yolcu. Bu kutsal olmayan yerde ne yapiyorsun?

english: I'm looking for a safe route through these caverns, under order of King Lathas.
translation: Kral Lathas'in emriyle bu magaralardan güvenli bir yol ariyorum.

english: Ah, the king tasked us with the same mission. Alas, a little further on lies the great doors of Iban. We've tried everything, but we cannot enter.
translation: Ah, kral bize de ayni görevi verdi. Ne yazik ki, biraz ileride Iban'in büyük kapilari var. Her seyi denedik, ama iceri giremiyoruz.

english: Anyway, you've done well to get this far traveller. Here eat...
translation: Her neyse, buraya kadar gelmekle iyi ettin gezgin. Al, ye...

english: Great, thanks a lot.
Hello again traveller. You should consider leaving this place. Let us handle things here.
translation: Merhaba gezgin. Buradan ayrilmayi düsünmelisin. Birak burayi biz halledelim.

english: You again... die Zamorakian scum!
Good day to you [sir/madam]!
Good day.
Know you of any quests sir knight?
translation: Herhangi bir görev biliyor musunuz sövalye bey?

english: The king is the man to talk to if you want a quest.
I think you've done the main quest we were on right now...
translation: Sanirim su anda üzerinde calistigimiz ana görevi tamamladiniz...

english: Good day.
Know you of any quests sir knight?
translation: Herhangi bir görev biliyor musunuz sövalye bey?

english: Hello Paladin. I wasn't expecting to see anyone else down here.
translation: Merhaba Paladin. Burada baska birini görmeyi beklemiyordum.

translation: Biz de öyle, yolcu. Bu kutsal olmayan yerde ne yapiyorsun?

translation: Kral Lathas'in emriyle bu magaralardan güvenli bir yol ariyorum.

translation: Ah, kral bize de ayni görevi verdi. Ne yazik ki, biraz ileride Iban'in büyük kapilari var. Her seyi denedik, ama iceri giremiyoruz.

translation: Her neyse, buraya kadar gelmekle iyi ettin, yolcu. Al, ye...

english: Great, thanks a lot.
Hello again traveller. You should consider leaving this place. Let us handle things here.
translation: Merhaba tekrar, gezgin. Buradan ayrilmayi düsünmelisin. Birak burayi biz halledelim.

english: You again... die Zamorakian scum!
Hello Paladin. I wasn't expecting to see anyone else down here.
translation: Merhaba Paladin. Burada baska birini görmeyi beklemiyordum.

english: Nor were we traveller. What are you doing in this most unholy place?
translation: Biz de öyle, gezgin. Bu kutsal olmayan yerde ne isin var?

english: I'm looking for a safe route through these caverns, under order of King Lathas.
translation: Kral Lathas'in emriyle bu magaralardan güvenli bir yol ariyorum.

english: Ah, the king tasked us with the same mission. Alas, a little further on lies the great doors of Iban. We've tried everything, but we cannot enter.

translation: Her neyse, buraya kadar gelmekle iyi ettin gezgin. Al, ye...
