Hello again traveller. You should consider leaving this place. Let us handle things here.
translation: Merhaba gezgin. Buradan ayrilmayi düsünmelisin. Birak burayi biz halledelim.

english: You again... die Zamorakian scum!
Good morrow [madam/sirrah]!
Morning. Know where an adventurer has to go to find a quest around here?
translation: Günaydin. Buralarda bir maceraci bir görev bulmak icin nereye gitmesi gerektigini biliyor musun?

english: An adventurer eh? There is no service finer than serving the bountiful King Arthur, and I happen to know there's an important quest to fulfill.
translation: Maceraci ha? Cömert Kral Arthur'a hizmet etmekten daha güzel bir hizmet yoktur ve ben de yerine getirilmesi gereken önemli bir görev oldugunu biliyorum.

english: Sir Knight! Many thanks for your assistance in restoring Merlin to his former freedom!
translation: Sör Sövalye! Merlin'i eski özgürlügüne kavusturmak icin yardim ettiginiz icin cok tesekkürler!

english: We owe you a great debt for freeing us from that dungeon.
translation: Bizi o zindandan kurtardiginiz icin size büyük bir borcumuz var.

english: Awww, shucks. It was nothing.
A valiant effort!
I have a question for you.
Please enter the answer to the question.
No, try again.
Correct!
Greetings! I am Sir Lancelot, the greatest Knight in the land! What do you want?
translation: Selamlar! Ben bu ülkenin en büyük sövalyesi Sir Lancelot! Ne istiyorsunuz?

english: You're a little full of yourself aren't you?
I have every right to be proud of myself.
My prowess in battle is world renowned!
I seek a quest!
Leave questing to the professionals.
Such as myself.
Sir Knight! Many thanks for your assistance in restoring Merlin to his former freedom!
translation: Sör Sövalye! Merlin'i eski özgürlügüne kavusturdugunuz icin cok tesekkürler!

english: Humph. You are indeed a better knight than I first suspected.
translation: Humph. Ilk düsündügümden daha iyi bir sövalyesin.

english: Gee, it was nothing saving you all from the clutches of Morgan Le Faye and freeing your King.
translation: Sizi Morgan Le Faye'nin pencesinden kurtarmak ve kralinizi özgürlestirmek hic de zor degildi.

english: You're a little full of yourself aren't you?
I seek a quest!
AH-HA HA HA! You can NEVER defeat ME! I am blessed by Saradomin himself! NO BLADE MAY DEFEAT ME!
translation: AH-HA HA HA! Beni ASLA yenemezsin! Saradomin'in kendisi beni kutsadi! HICBIR KILIC BENI YENEMEZ!

english: No blade may defeat me!
Hello there adventurer.
I'm looking for a quest...
Talk to the King then adventurer. He is always looking for men of bravery to aid him in his actions.
translation: O zaman kral ile konus maceraci. O, eylemlerinde kendisine yardim edecek cesur adamlar ariyor.

english: Congratulations on freeing Merlin!
That was a grand adventure. I can see why you make it your profession.
translation: Bu büyük bir maceraydi. Neden bunu meslegin yaptigini anlayabiliyorum.

english: I think you should stick to being a knight.
Hello there adventurer, what do you want of me?
I'd like some advice on finding a quest.
translation: Bir görev bulmak icin tavsiye istiyorum.

english: I do not know of any myself... but it would perhaps be worth your while asking the King if he has any tasks for you.
translation: Benim bildigim bir görev yok... ama belki Kral'a sana verebilecegi bir görev olup olmadigini sormak faydali olabilir.

english: After your help freeing Merlin, my help is the least I can offer as a man of honour.
translation: Merlin'i kurtarmama yardim ettikten sonra, onurlu bir adam olarak en azindan bu kadarini yapabilirim.

english: Nothing right now, but I'll bear it in mind. Thanks.
translation: Su anda yok, ama aklimda tutacagim. Tesekkürler.

english: I was glad to get my revenge on those knights in the keep. They were no match for us.
translation: Kale'deki sövalyelere intikamimi aldigim icin mutluyum. Bize rakip olamazlardi.

english: Makes you wonder how they kidnapped you in the first place.
translation: Ilk basta seni nasil kacirdiklarini merak ediyorsun.

english: Greetings adventurer and welcome to the museum!
The museum has been constructed thanks to the efforts of adventurers across Gielinor, feel free to explore this floor or one below at your leisure.
translation: Müze, Gielinor'daki maceracilarin cabalariyla insa edildi. Bu kati veya bir alt kati diledigin gibi kesfedebilirsin.

english: Can you tell me about this museum?
translation: Bu müze hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Certainly.
This museum was built as a monument to Gielinor and contains exhibits which showcase the wonders of the world brought to light by adventurers such as yourself.
translation: Bu müze, Gielinor'a adanmis bir anit olarak insa edildi ve senin gibi maceracilarin ortaya cikardigi dünyanin harikalarini sergileyen eserler iceriyor.

english: This floor was built some time ago but due to popular demand and some recent contributions the floor below has also been opened up for display.
translation: Bu kat bir süre önce insa edildi, ancak yogun talep ve son zamanlarda yapilan bazi katkilar nedeniyle bir alt kat da sergiye acildi.

english: While we no longer require any contributions we'll happily take any unwanted excess that you may have.
translation: Artik katkiya ihtiyacimiz yok, ancak sahip oldugunuz fazla esyalari memnuniyetle kabul ederiz.

english: I'd like to contribute towards the museum.
Hmm, it appears you don't have anything on you to contribute. Come back if you do.
translation: Hmm, görünüse göre katkida bulunacak bir seyiniz yok. Varsa tekrar gelin.

english: Could you tell me the current progress towards finishing the museum?
translation: Müzenin tamamlanmasina yönelik mevcut ilerlemeyi bana söyleyebilir misiniz?

english: The museum is finished! Feel free to enter if you have the time.
translation: Müze tamamlandi! Vaktiniz varsa iceri girin.

english: Feel free to explore this floor at your leisure while the floor below is under construction.
translation: Alt kat insaat halindeyken bu kati dilediginiz gibi kesfedebilirsiniz.

english: This floor was built some time ago and is not as accurate as it once was.
translation: Bu kat bir süre önce insa edildi ve eskisi kadar dogru degil.

english: Now, due to popular demand, the knights of Falador have decided to expand upon the displays to ensure that it includes all discoveries which have been made in recent years.
translation: Simdi, yogun talep üzerine, Falador sövalyeleri son yillarda yapilan tüm kesifleri icerecek sekilde sergileri genisletmeye karar verdiler.

english: Unfortunately we lack the man power to acquire all of the resources required to build the displays.
translation: Ne yazik ki, sergileri insa etmek icin gerekli tüm kaynaklari elde etmek icin yeterli insan gücümüz yok.

english: We'd appreciate it if you could donate any materials you find on your adventures.
translation: Maceralarinizda buldugunuz malzemeleri bagislarsaniz cok seviniriz.

english: I'd be happy to help. I'll keep an eye out for any useful materials.
translation: Seve seve yardim ederim. Yararli malzemeler bulursam size haber veririm.

english: The knights of Falador appreciate your support.
I'll pass, I don't have time to help.
I understand, you adventurers are busy folk. If you change your mind make sure to let me know.
translation: Anliyorum, maceracilar cok mesgul insanlar. Fikrinizi degistirirseniz bana haber verin.

english: Marvelous! What would you like to contribute?
translation: Harika! Ne tür bir katki yapmak istersiniz?

english: You make a contribution to the museum expansion.
We appreciate your contribution. Do make sure to come back once the museum has been expanded and check out the exhibits!
translation: Katkiniz icin tesekkür ederiz. Müze genisletildikten sonra mutlaka tekrar gelip sergileri ziyaret edin!

english: Of course. Here's the progress made so far.
translation: Tabii ki. Iste simdiye kadar kaydedilen ilerleme.

english: Ask about the museum.
Hand-in materials.
Check Progress.
I'd be happy to help.
I'll pass, I don't have time to help.
translation: Pas geciyorum, yardim edecek vaktim yok.

english: Greetings to the court of King Arthur!
Hello. I'm looking for a quest. Who should I talk to?
translation: Merhaba. Bir görev ariyorum. Kiminle konusmaliyim?

english: King Arthur will let you know. I believe he has a quest at the moment.
translation: Kral Arthur size söyleyecektir. Sanirim su anda bir görevi var.

english: You are a very talented Knight indeed to have freed Merlin so quickly. You have all of our gratitude.
translation: Merlin'i bu kadar cabuk kurtardiginiz icin gercekten cok yetenekli bir sövalyesiniz. Hepimizin minnettarligini kazanmis bulunuyorsunuz.

english: I am proud to have you as a member of the Round Table.
translation: Sizi Yuvarlak Masa'nin bir üyesi olarak görmekten gurur duyuyorum.

english: Thank you.
You missed all the excitement!
I got here and agreed to take over duties as king here, then before my eyes the most miraculous changes occured here... grass and trees were growing outside before our very eyes!
translation: Buraya geldim ve buradaki kralin görevlerini üstlenmeyi kabul ettim, sonra gözlerimin önünde en mucizevi degisiklikler oldu... cimler ve agaclar gözlerimizin önünde büyümeye basladi!

english: Thank you very much for showing me the way home.
translation: Bana eve giden yolu gösterdiginiz icin cok tesekkür ederim.

english: Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to answer this for me.
Please tell me your answer.
Nope, Go check again!
Spot on!
Hello. I've heard you stopped the demon, well done.
Yes, that's right.
A good job well done then.
Thank you.
Yes, although I'm afraid I've lost Silverlight.
Yes, news of your carelessness is almost as widespread as knowledge of your victory. Fortunately for you, Silverlight has come back into my possession.
translation: Evet, dikkatsizliginizin haberi, zaferinizin haberi kadar yaygin. Neyse ki Silverlight tekrar benim elime gecti.

english: Phew, that's a relief.
Is there any chance of me borrowing it again?
I'm not going to give it away that easily again, it's far too important to be treated so disrespectfully. Especially now its powers have increased after your fight with Agrith-Naar!
translation: Onu bir daha o kadar kolay vermeyecegim, o kadar önemli ki, ona saygisizca davranilamaz. Özellikle de Agrith-Naar ile savastiktan sonra gücü artti!

english: If you wish to make use of Silverlight again, it will cost you 1000 gold pieces. Maybe that will encourage you to look after it.
translation: Silverlight'i tekrar kullanmak istiyorsan, sana 1000 altin parcasi mal olacak. Belki bu, ona daha iyi bakmani saglar.

english: No way, it's not worth that much.
Ok, I'll pay.
May you make good use of it.
But I don't have that much money.
You don't even have enough free space to carry it. Stop wasingmy time!
translation: Onu tasiyacak kadar bos alanin bile yok. Zamanimi bosa harcama!

english: Hello, who are you?
I am a mighty adventurer, who are you?
translation: Ben güclü bir maceraciyim, sen kimsin?

english: I am Sir Prysin. A bold and famous knight of the realm.
translation: Ben Sir Prysin. Kralligin cesur ve ünlü sövalyesiyim.

english: I was hoping you could tell me.
Well I've never met you before.
Aris said I should come and talk to you.
translation: Aris gelip seninle konusmam gerektigini söyledi.

english: Aris? Is she still alive? I remember her from when I was pretty young. Well what do you need to talk to me about?
translation: Aris mi? Hala hayatta mi? Onu cok gencken hatirliyorum. Peki benimle ne konusmak istiyorsun?

english: I need to find Silverlight.
What do you need to find that for?
I need it to fight Delrith.
Delrith? I thought the world was rid of him, thanks to my great-grandfather.
translation: Delrith mi? Büyük büyükbabam sayesinde dünyadan silindigini saniyordum.

english: Well Aris' crystal ball seems to think otherwise.
translation: Aris'in kristal küresi öyle düsünmüyor galiba.

english: Well if the ball says so, I'd better help you.
translation: Küre öyle diyorsa, sana yardim etsem iyi olur.

english: The problem is getting Silverlight.
You mean you don't have it?
Oh I do have it, but it is so powerful that the king made me put it in a special box which needs three different keys to open it. That way it won't fall into the wrong hands.
translation: Var ama o kadar güclü ki kral onu acmak icin üc farkli anahtar gereken özel bir kutuya koymami istedi. Böylece yanlis ellere gecmeyecek.

english: So give me the keys!
Um, well, it's not so easy.
I kept one of the keys. I gave the other two to other people for safe keeping.
translation: Anahtarlardan birini kendime sakladim. Diger ikisini güvenli bir yerde saklamalari icin baskalarina verdim.

english: One I gave to Rovin, the captain of the palace guard.
translation: Birini saray muhafizlarinin komutani Rovin'e verdim.

english: I gave the other to the wizard Traiborn.
Can you give me your key?
Well there's a problem there as well.
I managed to drop the key in the drain just outside the palace kitchen. It is just inside and I can't reach it.
translation: Anahtari saray mutfaginin hemen disindaki kanalizasyona düsürdüm. Iceride ve ulasamiyorum.

english: So what does the drain connect to?
It is the drain for the drainpipe running from the sink in the kitchen down to the palace sewers.
translation: Mutfaktaki lavabodan sarayin kanalizasyonuna giden borunun kanalizasyonu.

english: Well I'd better go key hunting.
Ok, goodbye.
Where can I find Captain Rovin?
Captain Rovin lives at the top of the guards' quarters in the north-west wing of this palace.
translation: Yüzbasi Rovin, sarayin kuzeybati kanadindaki muhafizlarin odalarinin en üst katinda yasiyor.

english: Where does the wizard live?
Wizard Traiborn?
He is one of the wizards who lives in the tower on the little island just off the south coast. I believe his quarters are on the first floor of the tower.
translation: O, güney kiyisinin hemen aciklarindaki kücük adadaki kulede yasayan büyücülerden biri. Sanirim odasi kulenin birinci katinda.

english: And why is this a problem?
He's back and unfortunately I've got to deal with him.
translation: Geri döndü ve maalesef onunla ugrasmak zorundayim.

english: You don't look up to much. I suppose Silverlight may be good enough to carry you through though.
translation: Pek umutlu görünmüyorsun. Sanirim Silverlight seni bu durumdan kurtarabilir.

english: Yes she is still alive. She lives right outside the castle!
translation: Evet, o hala hayatta. Satonun hemen disinda yasiyor!

english: Oh, is that the same Aris? I would have thought she would have died by now. She was pretty old when I was a lad.
translation: Oh, ayni Aris mi? Simdiye kadar ölmüs olacagini düsünmüstüm. Ben cocukken oldukca yasliydi.

english: Anyway, what can I do for you?
So how are you doing with getting the keys?
I haven't found any of them yet.
Can you remind me where all the keys were again?
translation: Anahtarlarin nerede oldugunu tekrar hatirlatir misin?

english: I'm still looking.
Ok, tell me when you've got them all.
translation: Tamam, hepsini buldugunda bana haber ver.

english: I've got the key from Captain Rovin and the one that you dropped down the drain.
translation: Kaptan Rovin'den anahtari ve senin kanalizasyona düsürdügün anahtari aldim.

english: I've got all three keys!
Excellent! Now I can give you Silverlight.
That sword belonged to my great-grandfather. Make sure you treat it with respect!
translation: Bu kilic büyük büyükbabamindi. Ona saygili davran!

english: Now go kill that demon!
Have you sorted that demon out yet?
Not yet. And I, um, lost Silverlight.
translation: Henüz degil. Ve ben, sey, Silverlight'i kaybettim.

english: Yes, I know, someone returned it to me. Take better care of it this time.
translation: Evet, biliyorum, biri bana geri getirdi. Bu sefer ona daha iyi bak.

english: Where did all these zombies come from?
It's an invasion by Zemouregal.
The gods preserve us!
Don't worry, I'm working on a plan to get rid of them.
translation: Merak etme, onlardan kurtulmak icin bir plan yapiyorum.

english: We're doomed!
You've come to the right place, well done!
Yes, that's right.
Yes, although I'm afraid I've lost Silverlight.
Phew, that's a relief.
Is there any chance of me borrowing it again?
No way, it's not worth that much.
Ok, I'll pay.
I am a mighty adventurer. Who are you?
translation: Ben güclü bir maceraciyim. Sen kimsin?

english: I'm not sure, I was hoping you could tell me.
translation: Emin degilim, sen bana söyleyebilirsin diye umuyordum.

english: Aris said I should come and talk to you.
I need to find Silverlight.
Well, Aris' crystal ball seems to think otherwise.
translation: Aris'in kristal küresi öyle düsünmüyor gibi.

english: So give me the keys!
Can you give me your key?
So what does the drain lead to?
Where can I find Captain Rovin?
Where does the wizard live?
Well I'd better go key hunting.
And why is this a problem?
He's back and unfortunately I've got to deal with him.
translation: Geri döndü ve maalesef onunla ilgilenmem gerek.

english: Yes, she is still alive.
Can you remind me where all the keys were again?
I'm still looking.
Hello!
Can I have another shield?
Sir Rebral gives you another shield.
translation: Sir Rebral sana baska bir kalkan veriyor.

english: Who are you?
I'm Sir Rebral of the White Knights and taskmaster for the Falador Achievement Diary.
translation: Ben Beyaz Sövalyeler'den Sir Rebral ve Falador Basari Günlügü'nün görev sorumlusuyum.

english: What is the Achievement Diary?

It's a diary that helps you keep track of particular achievements. In Falador and the surrounding area it can help you discover some quite useful things. Eventually, with enough exploration, the inhabitants will
translation: Belirli basarilari takip etmene yardimci olan bir günlük. Falador ve cevresinde oldukca yararli seyler kesfetmene yardimci olabilir. Yeterince kesif yaptiginizda, bölge sakinleri sizi

english: reward you.
You can see the list of tasks on the side-panel.
I have a question about my Achievement diary.
translation: Basari Günlügümle ilgili bir sorum var.

english: Well, there are four different shields of Falador, which match up with the four levels of difficulty. Each has the same rewards as the previous level and some additional benefits too... which tier of rewards would you like to
translation: Falador'da dört farkli kalkan vardir ve bunlar dört farkli zorluk seviyesine karsilik gelir. Her biri bir önceki seviyenin ödüllerinin aynisini ve bazi ek avantajlari da icerir... Hangi ödül seviyesini

english: know more about?
Tell me more about the Easy rewards please!
translation: Kolay ödüller hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin lütfen!

english: If you complete all of the easy tasks in Falador, the shield can restore one quarter of your prayer points once per day and you can access a shortcut to the Chaos temple from Burthorpe.
translation: Falador'daki tüm kolay görevleri tamamlarsaniz, kalkan günde bir kez dua puanlarinizin dörtte birini geri yükleyebilir ve Burthorpe'dan Kaos tapinagina giden bir kisayola erisebilirsiniz.

english: Thanks!
Tell me more about the Medium rewards please!
translation: Orta zorlukta ödüller hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin lütfen!

english: In addition to the easy rewards, the shield can restore half of your prayer points once per day and provides a 10% experience boost at Falador farm. You'll get an increased chance of finding a clue scroll from a Guard
translation: Kolay ödüllere ek olarak, kalkan günde bir kez dua puanlarinizin yarisini geri yükleyebilir ve Falador ciftliginde %10 deneyim artisi saglar. Bir muhafizdan ipucu parsömeni bulma sansiniz artar

english: and can access a shortcut within the Motherlode Mine
Tell me more about the Hard rewards please!
translation: Zor ödüller hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin lütfen!

english: In addition to the easy and medium benefits, the shield will restore all of your prayer points once per day, you can access a bank deposit box at the crafting guild and a shortcut to the Heroes' Guild fountain. The Giant
translation: Kolay ve orta seviye avantajlara ek olarak, kalkan günde bir kez tüm dua puanlarinizi geri yükler, zanaatkarlar loncasi'ndaki banka kasasina ve Kahramanlar Loncasi cesmesine giden kisayola erisebilirsiniz. Dev

translation: Elit ödüller hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin lütfen!

english: In addition to the previous tiers of rewards, the tree patch in Falador park will never become diseased and the shield will restore all of your prayer points twice per day in addition to an increased chance at higher level
translation: Önceki ödül kademelerine ek olarak, Falador parkindaki agac yamasi asla hastalanmaz ve kalkan, Pay-dirt'i temizleyerek daha yüksek seviyeli

english: ores from cleaning Pay-dirt.
translation: cevherler bulma sansinizi artirmanin yani sira, günde iki kez tüm dua puanlarinizi geri yükler.

english: How do I claim the rewards?
Just complete the tasks in the Falador area so they're ticked off, then come and speak to me for your rewards.
translation: Falador bölgesindeki görevleri tamamlayip isaretleyin, sonra gelip ödüllerinizi almak icin benimle konusun.

english: Bye!
See you later.
I've completed all of the easy tasks in my Falador Achievement Diary!
translation: Falador Basari Günlügümdeki tüm kolay görevleri tamamladim!

english: I can see that, well done! You'll be wanting your reward then!
translation: Görüyorum, aferin! Ödülünüzü almak istersiniz herhalde!

english: Yes please!
This shield is a symbol of your exploration of Falador. It can restore one quarter of your prayer points once per day and you can now access a shortcut to the Chaos temple from Burthorpe.
translation: Bu kalkan, Falador'u kesfettiginin sembolüdür. Günde bir kez dua puanlarinin dörtte birini geri yükleyebilir ve artik Burthorpe'dan Kaos tapinagina giden kisayola erisebilirsin.

english: Wow, thanks!
If you ever lose your shield, come back to me to reclaim it.
translation: Kalkanini kaybedersen, geri almak icin bana gel.

english: I've completed all of the medium tasks in my Falador achievement diary!
translation: Falador basari günlügümdeki tüm orta zorlukta görevleri tamamladim!

english: I've upgraded your Falador shield for you. It can restore half of your prayer points once per day and provides a 10% experience boost at Falador farm. You've got an increased chance of finding a clue scroll
translation: Falador kalkanini senin icin yükselttim. Günde bir kez dua puanlarinin yarisini geri yükleyebilir ve Falador ciftliginde %10 deneyim artisi saglar. Bir muhafizdan ipucu parsömeni bulma sansin artti

english: from a Guard and can access a shortcut within the Motherlode Mine.
translation: ve Motherlode Madeni'nde bir kisayola erisebilirsin.

english: I've completed all of the hard tasks in my Falador achievement diary!
translation: Falador basari günlügümdeki tüm zor görevleri tamamladim!

english: I've upgraded your Falador shield for you. It will restore all of your prayer points once per day, you can now access a bank deposit box at the crafting guild and a shortcut to the Heroes' Guild fountain. The Giant
translation: Falador kalkanini senin icin yükselttim. Günde bir kez tüm dua puanlarinizi geri yükler, artik zanaatkarlar loncasi'ndaki banka kasasina ve Kahramanlar Loncasi cesmesine giden kisayola erisebilirsiniz. Dev

english: mole should now be easier to locate and it will drop noted skins and claws.
translation: köstebek artik daha kolay bulunabilir ve notlu deriler ve penceler düsürür.

english: I've completed all of the elite tasks in my Falador achievement diary!
translation: Falador basari günlügümdeki tüm elit görevleri tamamladim!

english: I can see that, well done! You've completed all of the tasks in Falador! Here's your reward!
translation: Görüyorum, aferin! Falador'daki tüm görevleri tamamladiniz! Iste ödülünüz!

english: I've upgraded your Falador shield for you. The tree patch in Falador park will now never become diseased and the shield will restore all of your prayer points twice per day in addition to an increased chance at
translation: Falador kalkanini senin icin yükselttim. Falador parkindaki agac yamasi artik asla hastalanmayacak ve kalkan, Pay-dirt'i temizleyerek

Who are you?
I have a question about my Achievement Diary
translation: Basari Günlügümle ilgili bir sorum var.

What are the rewards?
Easy Rewards.
Medium Rewards.
Hard Rewards.
Elite Rewards.
How do I claim the rewards?
Bye!
Hmm? What's that, young ? What can I do for you?
translation: Hmm? Ne var, genc ? Senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: I don't know, what can you do for me?
Hmm, well, mmm, do you have a family crest? I keep track of every Gielinor family, you know, so I might be able to find yours.
translation: Hmm, sey, mmm, aile arman var mi? Gielinor'daki tüm aileleri takip ediyorum, belki seninkini bulabilirim.

english: I'm also something of an, mmm, a painter. If you've met any important persons or visited any nice places I could paint them for you.
translation: Ayrica ben bir nevi, mmm, ressamim. Önemli kisilerle tanistiysan veya güzel yerler ziyaret ettiysen, onlari senin icin resmedebilirim.

english: Can you see if I have a family crest?
translation: Aile armam var mi bakabilir misin?

english: What is your name?
[player name].
Mmm, [player name], let me see...
According to my records, your crest is [current family crest].
Mmm, very well. Changing your crest will cost 5,000 coins.
translation: Mmm, cok iyi. Aranizi degistirmek 5.000 sikkeye mal olacak.

english: I'll have to go get some.
Ah yes, the shield that you helped to retrieve. You have certainly earned the right to wear its symbol.
translation: Ah evet, geri almamiza yardim ettiginiz kalkan. Bu sembolü takma hakkini kesinlikle kazandiniz.

english: Ah, splendid, splendid. There is no better symbol than that of our fair land!
translation: Ah, harika, harika. Güzel ülkemizin sembolünden daha iyisi olamaz!

english: Hmm, have you ever even met the Dorgeshuun? I don't think you should wear their symbol until you have made contact with that lost tribe.
translation: Hmm, Dorgeshuun'larla hic tanistin mi? O kayip kabileyle temas kurmadan onlarin sembolünü takmamalisin bence.

english: Ah yes, our new neighbours under Lumbridge. I hear you were the one who made contact with then, jolly good.
translation: Ah evet, Lumbridge'in altindaki yeni komsularimiz. Onlarla temasi kuran seninmis, cok iyi.

english: I see you are a mighty dragon-slayer! You have certainly earned the right to wear a dragon symbol.
translation: Görüyorum ki sen güclü bir ejderha avcisisin! Ejderha sembolünü takma hakkini kesinlikle kazandin.

english: Hmm, mmm, yes, everyone likes pretty fairies.
translation: Hmm, mmm, evet, herkes güzel perileri sever.

english: You do not seem to be very devoted to any god. I will not let you have a divine symbol unless you have level 70 prayer.
translation: Hicbir tanriya cok bagli görünmüyorsun. 70. seviye dua yetenegin olmadan sana ilahi bir sembol vermeyecegim.

english: Guthix, god of balance! I'm a Saradominist myself, you know, but we all find meaning in our way, what?
translation: Guthix, denge tanrisi! Ben Saradoministim, biliyorsun, ama hepimiz kendi yolumuzda anlam buluruz, degil mi?

english: Hmm, I'm not sure I like that HAM group, their beliefs are a little extreme for me. But if that's what you want.
translation: Hmm, o HAM grubunu sevdigimden emin degilim, inanclari benim icin biraz asiri. Ama sen öyle istiyorsan.

english: A horse? I know people talk about them, but I'm not at all sure they ever existed. I don't think I could let you use one as your symbol unless you can fetch me some kind of model of one.
translation: Bir at mi? Insanlarin onlardan bahsettigini biliyorum, ama onlarin gercekten var olduklarindan emin degilim. Bana bir modelini getirmedikce, onu sembolün olarak kullanmana izin veremem.

english: A Jungle Ogre, eh? Odd beast, very odd.
translation: Bir Orman Ogre'si, ha? Garip bir yaratik, cok garip.

english: Our neighbours in the west? Very good, very good.
translation: Batidaki komsularimiz mi? Cok iyi, cok iyi.

english: Ah, the fair land of Lumbridge and Varrock.
translation: Ah, Lumbridge ve Varrock'un güzel topraklari.

english: You wish to represent yourself by a moneybag? I think to make that meaningful I should increase the price to 500,000 coins. Do you agree?
translation: Kendini bir para cuvaliyla mi temsil etmek istiyorsun? Bunun anlamli olmasi icin fiyati 500.000 sikkeye cikarmam gerektigini düsünüyorum. Katiliyor musun?

english: All right.
But I'll have to go and fetch the money.
No way!
Well we can't have just any pauper using a money-bag as a symbol, can we? You'll have to choose a different symbol.
translation: Herhangi bir fakirin para cuvalini sembol olarak kullanmasina izin veremeyiz, degil mi? Baska bir sembol secmelisin.

english: Ah, the great god Saradomin! May he smile on your house as you adorn it with his symbol!
translation: Ah, yüce tanri Saradomin! Onun sembolüyle evini süsledigin icin sana gülümsesin!

english: A symbol of death? You do not seem like a killer to me; perhaps some other symbol would suit you better.
translation: Ölümün sembolü mü? Bana katil gibi gelmiyorsun; belki baska bir sembol sana daha uygun olur.

english: Of... of course you can have a skull symbol, sir/madam!
translation: Tabii ki kafatasi sembolünü alabilirsin, bayim/bayan!

english: Ah, Varrock, a fine city!
translation: Ah, Varrock, ne güzel bir sehir!

english: The god of Chaos? It is a terrible thing to worship that evil being. But if that is what you wish...
translation: Kaos tanrisi mi? O kötü varliga tapmak korkunc bir sey. Ama eger istediginiz buysa...

english: Thanks!
You're welcome, my [boy/girl].
Can I buy a painting?
Would you like a portrait or an, mmm, a landscape? Or a map, maybe?
translation: Portre mi, yoksa manzara mi istersiniz? Ya da belki bir harita?

english: A portrait please.
Mmm, well, there are a few portraits I can paint. I can only let you have one if you've got some connection with that person though. Who would you like?
translation: Mmm, birkac portre cizebilirim. Ancak o kisiyle bir baglantiniz varsa size bir tane verebilirim. Kimi istersiniz?

english: That will be, mmm, 1000 coins please.
I don't have that much money on me.
There you go.
No thanks.
Well, mmm, maybe some other time, mmm?
translation: Peki, mmm, belki baska bir zaman, mmm?

english: A landscape please.
Mmm, well, I can paint a few places. Where have you had your adventures?
translation: Mmm, birkac yer cizebilirim. Maceralarinizi nerede yasadiniz?

english: That will be, mmm, 2000 coins please.
A map please.
Mmm, yes, ah, I have painted maps of the known world on several different sizes of parchment.  Which size would you like?
translation: Evet, ah, bilinen dünyanin haritalarini cesitli boyutlarda parsömenlere cizdim. Hangi boyutu istersiniz?

english: Nothing thanks.
Mmm, well, see you some other time maybe.
translation: Peki, belki baska bir zaman görüsürüz.

english: I don't know, what can you do for me?
Can you see if I have a family crest?
translation: Aile armam var mi bakabilir misiniz?

english: I don't like that crest. Can I have a different one?
translation: Bu armayi sevmedim. Baska bir tane alabilir miyim?

english: Hey Tiffy, I lost my CommOrb...
Very careless of you, what? Here, take another, but be careful of this one!
translation: Cok dikkatsizsin, degil mi? Al, baska bir tane al, ama buna dikkat et!

english: Good day, Proselyte. I heard from Akrisae what happened with that Lucien business. Be sure to keep your chin up. We'll get the old boy sooner or later.
translation: Iyi günler, Proselyte. Akrisae'den Lucien meselesinde olanlari duydum. Moralini bozma. Er ya da gec o yasli adami yakalayacagiz.

english: Thanks, Tiffy.
Don't mention it, old bean. Now, is there anything I can do for you?
translation: Önemli degil, dostum. Simdi, senin icin yapabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Good day Proselyte. Is there anything I can do for you?
translation: Iyi günler, Proselyte. Senin icin yapabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Sorry old bean but we are still in the process of organising.
translation: Üzgünüm dostum, ama hala düzenleme asamasindayiz.

english: I'm sure that we will have something for you soon, so please feel free to check back later. Anything else I can do for you in the meantime?
translation: Yakinda senin icin bir seyler hazirlayacagimizdan eminim, bu yüzden lütfen daha sonra tekrar kontrol et. Bu arada senin icin yapabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: I have news on that assassin who attacked Entrana.
translation: Entrana'ya saldiran suikastci hakkinda haberlerim var.

english: I have news on that assassin who attacked Entrana.
translation: Entrana'ya saldiran suikastci hakkinda haberlerim var.

english: Ah yes, you've been helping out the Ardougne authorities I hear.
translation: Ah evet, duyduguma göre Ardougne yetkililerine yardim ediyormussun.

english: You knew?
Of course! Knowledge is my business, old bean, and it pays to know what's happening across the other kingdoms.
translation: Tabii ki! Bilgi benim isim dostum ve diger kralliklarda neler olup bittigini bilmek cok önemli.

english: Now, as for your assassin, quite messy stuff, what? We've been trying to track him down ever since the Entrana incident, but he's proven quite the tricky one to pin down. Curious him showing up in Ardougne.
translation: Simdi, suikastciya gelince, oldukca karmasik bir durum, degil mi? Entrana olayindan beri onu bulmaya calisiyoruz ama onu yakalamak oldukca zor. Ardougne'da ortaya cikmasi ilginc.

english: What are your plans?
Sadly, very little. Until we can learn more about what he's up to, we don't have much to go on. You have nothing to fear though, we'll find him sooner or later!
translation: Maalesef, pek bir sey yok. Neyin pesinde oldugunu ögrenene kadar, elimizde pek bir sey yok. Ama korkacak bir sey yok, er ya da gec onu bulacagiz!

english: Now, anything else you need, [milady/sirrah]?
translation: Baska bir seye ihtiyacin var mi, ?

english: Well did you also know he was a Mahjarrat?
translation: Onun bir Mahjarrat oldugunu da biliyor muydun?

english: A Mahjarrat! You must be pulling on my leg, what?
translation: Bir Mahjarrat! Dalga geciyorsun herhalde, ne?

english: His name is Sliske. Have you heard of him?
Sliske, hmm? We have dossiers on many Mahjarrat, but I must confess, this is a new name to me. Poor show! I'll have to see what we have hiding in the archives.
translation: Sliske, hmm? Bircok Mahjarrat hakkinda dosyamiz var, ama itiraf etmeliyim ki bu isim bana yeni geliyor. Kötü durum! Arsivlerde ne var bakmam gerekecek.

english: While you're there, it might be worth looking up something called the Elder Horn. It's an artefact that Sliske has now claimed. One that has the ability to control minds.
translation: Oradayken, Elder Horn adinda bir seyi arastirmanizda fayda var. Sliske'nin ele gecirdigi bir eser. Zihinleri kontrol etme yetenegi olan bir eser.

english: A mind controlling artefact you say? Sounds like I'll need to report this to the top brass. Can't see them being too thrilled about it. Thank you for the update, old bean.
translation: Zihin kontrolü yapan bir eser mi dedin? Bunu üst düzey yetkililere bildirmem gerekecek gibi görünüyor. Bu konuda pek heyecanlanacaklarini sanmiyorum. Bilgi icin tesekkürler, dostum.

english: A mind controlling artefact you say? First Lucien and the Stone, and now this! The top brass will need to be made aware. Can't see them being too thrilled about it. Thank you for the update, old bean.
translation: Zihin kontrolü yapan bir eser mi dedin? Önce Lucien ve Tas, simdi de bu! Üst düzey yetkililer bu konudan haberdar olmali. Bu konuda pek heyecanlanacaklarini sanmiyorum. Bilgi icin tesekkürler, dostum.

english: I don't really understand this 'Gaze of Saradomin' thing... Do you think you could explain what it does for me?
translation: Bu “Saradomin'in Bakisi” olayini pek anlamadim... Ne ise yaradigini bana aciklayabilir misin?

english: Certainly [milady/sirrah]! As you know, we Temple Knights are personally favoured by Saradomin himself.
translation: Elbette ! Bildiginiz gibi, Tapinak Sövalyeleri Saradomin'in kisisel olarak gözdesi.

english: And when I say personally favoured, I don't mean that sometime off in the future he's going to buy us all a drink!
translation: Kisisel olarak gözdesi derken, gelecekte bize icki ismarlayacak demek istemiyorum!

english: He watches over each of us, and when we die he catches us as we fall, and ensures we arrive back at Falador castle safe and sound.
translation: O, her birimizi korur ve öldügümüzde düserken bizi yakalar ve Falador kalesine sag salim ulasmamizi saglar.

english: We usually lose some equipment when he does so, but it's a small price to pay to be hale and hearty again, what?
translation: Bunu yaparken genellikle bazi ekipmanlarimizi kaybederiz, ama tekrar saglikli ve zinde olmak icin ödenmesi gereken kücük bir bedel, degil mi?

english: Some lucky fellows have a similar system going already, but when they die they spawn in that squalid little swamp village Lumbridge.
translation: Bazi sansli arkadaslar da benzer bir sisteme sahip, ama öldüklerinde o sefil kücük bataklik köyü Lumbridge'de yeniden doguyorlar.

english: Yeah, what kind of person would want to spawn there... Certainly not me, and I never have! Honest!
translation: Evet, kim orada yeniden dogmak ister ki... Ben kesinlikle istemem ve hic istemedim! Gercekten!

english: Well, you should be glad that we offer you a step up then! Falador is clearly a far superior town to spend your time in!
translation: O zaman size bir adim öne gecme firsati sundugumuz icin mutlu olmalisiniz! Falador, zaman gecirmek icin acikca cok daha üstün bir kasaba!

english: Was there something else you wanted to ask good old Tiffy, [milady/sirrah]?
translation: Sevgili Tiffy'ye sormak istediginiz baska bir sey var mi, ?

english: Can I buy some armour?
Of course old bean. I can sell you up to Proselyte level items only I'm afraid.
translation: Tabii ki dostum. Maalesef sadece Proselyte seviyesine kadar olan esyalari satabilirim.

english: Can I switch respawns, please?
translation: Yeniden dogma yerini degistirebilir miyim lütfen?

english: Ah, so you'd like to respawn in Falador, the good old homestead! Are you sure?
translation: Ah, yani eski güzel Falador'da yeniden dogmak istiyorsun! Emin misin?

english: Yes, I want to respawn in Falador.
Top-hole, what? Good old Fally is definitely the hot-spot nowadays!
translation: Harika, degil mi? Eski güzel Fally su siralar kesinlikle en popüler yer!

english: Actually, no thanks. I like my respawn point.
translation: Aslinda, hayir tesekkürler. Ben respawn noktami seviyorum.

english: As you wish, what? Ta-ta for now.
translation: Nasil istersen, ne? Simdilik hosca kal.

english: What? You're saying you want to respawn in Lumbridge? Are you sure?
translation: Ne? Lumbridge'de respawn olmak mi istiyorsun? Emin misin?

english: Yes, I want to respawn in Lumbridge.
Why anyone would want to visit that smelly little swamp village of oiks is quite beyond me, I'm afraid, but the deed is done now.
translation: Neden birisi o kokusmus kücük bataklik köyünü ziyaret etmek istesin, ben anlamiyorum ama artik karar verildi.

english: Well, see you around Tiffy.
Ta-ta for now, old bean!
Sir Tiffy! I got this scroll from a knight near Trollheim. He said I should deliver it to you urgently.
translation: Sir Tiffy! Bu parsömeni Trollheim yakinlarindaki bir sövalyeden aldim. Size acilen teslim etmemi söyledi.

english: What ho, old [boy/gal/bean]. Well, hand it over and let's have a look, shall we?
translation: Selam, dostum. Ver de bir bakalim, olur mu?

english: Now, let's see what is so urgent. Hmmm...
translation: Bakalim bu kadar acil olan sey nedir. Hmmm...

translation: Büyük Tanri Savaslari sirasinda, kötü gaspci Zamorak, amacina ulasmak icin bircok eski kalinti ve ordu topladi. Onun gücü karsisinda tek basina durabilecek kadar güclü kimse yoktu, bu yüzden sanli Lord Saradomin

english: Surely, one of the groups would have gained the upper hand by now? After all, it's been thousands of years since that battle.
translation: Simdiye kadar gruplardan biri üstünlük saglamis olmali, degil mi? Sonucta, o savasin üzerinden binlerce yil gecti.

english: Apparently not. It appears that a millennia-old battle is still being fought beneath the ruins of the temple, and the prize for winning the battle is the Godsword! Hmm... Well, thank you very much, old [boy/gal/bean]. You've been a

Is that it, then? Aren't we going to do something?
translation: Hepsi bu mu? Bir sey yapmayacak miyiz?

english: Yes, yes. All in good time. I'll have to consult my commanding officer first. Thank you, old [boy/gal/bean], you're dismissed.
translation: Evet, evet. Her seyin bir zamani var. Önce komutanima danismam gerek. Tesekkürler, gidebilirsin.

english: Now, let's see what is so urgent. Hmm... I see that this scroll has been tampered with! The wax seal is broken.
translation: Simdi, bu kadar acil olan seyi görelim. Hmm... Bu parsömenin kurcalandigini görüyorum! Mum mührü kirilmis.

english: Err, yes. It was that way when I got it.
I see. Anyway, let's see what it says.
Oh dear. Well, thank you very much, old [boy/gal/bean]. You've been a great help. I shall pass it on to my superiors.
translation: Oh hayir. Cok tesekkürler, eski dostum. Cok yardimci oldun. Bunu üstlerime iletecegim.

english: Is that it then? Aren't we going to do something?
translation: Hepsi bu mu? Bir sey yapmayacak miyiz?

english: Do you have any jobs for me yet?
translation: Bana verebileceginiz bir is var mi?

english: Can you explain the Gaze of Saradomin to me?
Can I buy some armour?
Can I switch respawns please?
translation: Yeniden dogma noktasini degistirebilir miyim lütfen?

english: Yes, I want to respawn in Falador.
Actually, no thanks. I like my respawn point.
translation: Aslinda, hayir tesekkürler. Yeniden dogma noktamdan memnunum.

english: Yes, I want to respawn in Lumbridge.
Goodbye.
Hail Arthur, King of the Britons!
Um... Hello.
I'm looking for adventure! More specifically, some sort of quest.
translation: Macera ariyorum! Daha spesifik olarak, bir tür görev.

english: ...Then hail Arthur, King of Britons, like I just said.
translation: ...O zaman Britanya Krali Arthur'a selam olsun, az önce dedigim gibi.

english: Oh. Ok.
I thought you just had a weird way of saying hello is all.
translation: Sadece tuhaf bir selamlama sekliniz var sandim.

english: Thanks for freeing Merlin.
No problem. It was easy.
You are indeed a mighty knight. I hope your adventuring goes well.
translation: Gercekten de güclü bir sövalyesiniz. Maceralarinizin iyi gecmesini dilerim.

english: Thank you.
Hello.
Greetings traveller.
Do you have anything to trade?
translation: Takas edecek bir seyin var mi?

english: No, I'm sorry.
Well, maybe I do, but you need to prove yourself worthy as a White Knight before I will sell you anything.
translation: Belki vardir, ama sana bir sey satmadan önce Beyaz Sövalye olarak kendini kanitlaman gerekiyor.

english: And how can I do that?
Kill Black Knights and make sure you don't kill any White Knights!
translation: Kara Sövalyeleri öldür ve Beyaz Sövalyeleri öldürmediginden emin ol!

english: Well, okay then.
And it is so very rare that I see any White Knight who has reached Adept level!
translation: Adept seviyesine ulasmis bir Beyaz Sövalye görmek cok nadirdir!

english: Well of course! I AM the White Knights armourer after all!
translation: Tabii ki! Sonucta ben Beyaz Sövalyelerin zirhcisiyim!

english: And for a dedicated White Knight to have reached Master level like yourself, you get only the very best of all equipment available!
translation: Ve senin gibi Usta seviyesine ulasmis adanmis bir Beyaz Sövalyeye, mevcut en iyi ekipmanlar verilir!

english: Why are there so many knights in this city?
translation: Bu sehirde neden bu kadar cok sövalye var?

english: We are the White Knights of Falador. We are the most powerful order of knights in the land. We are helping the king Vallance rule the kingdom as he is getting old and tired.
translation: Biz Falador'un Beyaz Sövalyeleriyiz. Bu topraklardaki en güclü sövalye tarikatiyiz. Yaslanan ve yorulan Kral Vallance'a kralligi yönetmesinde yardim ediyoruz.

english: Can I just talk to you very slowly for a few minutes, while I distract you, so that my friend over there can do something while you're busy being distracted by me?
translation: Senin dikkatini dagitirken, birkac dakika boyunca cok yavas konusabilir miyim, böylece sen benimle mesgulken, suradaki arkadasim bir seyler yapabilir?...

english: I'm... not sure what you're asking me... you want to join the White Knights?
translation: Ben... ne istedigini anlamadim... Beyaz Sövalyelere katilmak mi istiyorsun?

english: Nope. I'm just trying to distract you.
... ...you are very odd.
So can I distract you some more?
... ...I don't think I want to talk to you anymore.
Ok. My work here is done. 'Bye!
translation: Tamam. Buradaki isim bitti. Hosca kal!

english: Excellent work! I have new information to share with you.
translation: Harika is cikardin! Seninle paylasacagim yeni bilgilerim var.

english: You're not done yet! Do this for me!
translation: Henüz isin bitmedi! Bunu benim icin yap!

english: The black knights can do puzzles better than that!
translation: Kara sövalyeler bundan daha iyi bulmaca cözebilir!

english: Excellent work!
Here you go.
You are handed a torn part of a clue scroll.
translation: Sana bir ipucu parcasinin yirtik bir kismi verilir.

english: Your commitment to the white knights is fantastic [player name].
translation: Beyaz sövalyelere olan bagliligin harika Maceraci.

english: Do you have anything to trade?
translation: Takas edecek bir seyin var mi?

english: Why are there so many knights in this city?
translation: Bu sehirde neden bu kadar cok sövalye var?

english: Can I just distract you for a minute?
Good day, how may I help you?
I'd like to access my bank account, please.
I'd like to check my PIN settings.
I'd like to collect items.
What is this place?
This is a branch of the Bank of Gielinor. We have branches in many towns.
translation: Burasi Gielinor Bankasi'nin bir subesi. Bircok kasabada subemiz var.

english: And what do you do?
We will look after your items and money for you. Leave your valuables with us if you want to keep them safe.
translation: Esyalarinizi ve paranizi sizin icin sakliyoruz. Degerli esyalarinizi güvende tutmak istiyorsaniz bize birakabilirsiniz.

english: Hi, I...
What are you doing here, Fremennik?!
I have a Seal of pass...
No You do not! Begone!
I'd like to access my bank account, please.
I'd like to check my PIN settings.
I'd like to collect items.
What is this place?
Hello!
Greetings, traveller.
What's with all these Oathbreakers?
translation: Bu Yemin Bozanlar da neyin nesi?

english: Gah! A bunch of fanatical cultists. Nothing more.
translation: Gah! Bir grup fanatik tarikatci. Baska bir sey degil.

english: You don't sound impressed?
No! Well I wouldn't be, would I? I've spent my whole life dedicated to my sect. I dreamed of one day entering the Sanctuary and finally meeting Mother!
translation: Hayir! Etkilenmemem normal, degil mi? Hayatimi tarikatima adadim. Bir gün Kutsal Mekan'a girip nihayet Anne'yle tanismayi hayal ettim!

english: Yet instead I'm greeted by this condescending 'Lord' who feels I could try being 'a little more chaotic' for once.
translation: Ama bunun yerine, bir kez olsun “biraz daha kaotik” olabilecegimi düsünen bu kücümseyen “Lord” tarafindan karsilandim.

english: I see...
And to top it all off, Mother hasn't awoken at all. I fear she is probably being held captive by this Nightmare, or worse.
translation: Üstüne üstlük, Anne hic uyanmadi. Muhtemelen bu Kabus tarafindan esir tutuluyor ya da daha kötüsü.

english: The only things these oafs are breaking is my head with their silent stares and furious hand-talk.
translation: Bu ahmaklarin tek kirdigi sey, sessiz bakislari ve öfkeli el hareketleriyle kafam.

english: I'm sorry your day hasn't been going well.
Ah... Thank you, traveller. Are you here to fight the Nightmare?
translation: Ah... Tesekkürler, yolcu. Kabusla savasmak icin mi buradasiniz?

english: We'll see. Sounds pretty tough.
I'll pray for you.
They seem to be carrying dangerous weapons.
Indeed. Speaking of weapons, I assume you have heard of the immensely powerful orbs the Nightmare is protecting?
translation: Gercekten. Silahlardan bahsetmisken, Nightmare'in korudugu son derece güclü küreleri duymussundur herhalde?

english: Yes I have. In fact, I've managed to beat the Nightmare myself.
translation: Evet, duydum. Aslinda, Nightmare'i kendim yenmeyi basardim.

english: Anyway, as you've heard of the orbs I assume you've also heard of the even stronger Bashyhammer of Ashihama?
translation: Her neyse, küreleri duymus olduguna göre, daha da güclü olan Ashihama'nin Bashyhammer'ini da duymussundur herhalde?

english: The what?
The Smashyhammer of Ashihama.
But you just said...
...Trashyhammer of Ashihama. Yes, I know what I said.
translation: ...Ashihama'nin Trashyhammer'i dedin. Evet, ne dedigimi biliyorum.

english: Wha-
Slashyhammer?
That doesn't even make sense.
Dashyhammer? Mashyhammer?
Flashyhammer?
Too far. I'm done.
What's with the mask?
These are the masks of the Sisterhood. While symbolic, they also have practical uses.
translation: Bunlar Kardeslik'in maskeleri. Sembolik olmalarinin yani sira pratik kullanimlari da var.

english: Oh really? What like?
Herbs can be stored within the beak, masking the smell of death and preventing us from becoming infected.
translation: Gaga kisminda otlar saklanabilir, ölüm kokusunu maskeler ve enfeksiyon kapmamizi önler.

english: That sounds handy. Can I have one?
translation: Kulaga kullanisli geliyor. Ben de bir tane alabilir miyim?

english: You ask too many questions.
Is that a yes?
It's a no. To wear a mask of the Sisterhood, you need to join the Sisterhood.
translation: Hayir demek. Kardeslik'in maskesini takmak icin Kardeslik'e katilman gerekir.

english: What is the Sisterhood?
An ancient order, born right here in Slepe.
Well sign me up!
You lack the qualities we're currently looking for. Perhaps another time.
translation: Su anda aradigimiz niteliklere sahip degilsin. Belki baska bir zaman.

english: Tell me more about the Sisterhood.
translation: Kardeslik hakkinda daha fazla bilgi ver.

english: Many years ago, the Sisterhood were a group of healers dedicated to Saradomin.
translation: Yillar önce, Kardeslik Saradomin'e adanmis bir grup sifaciydi.

english: However, our leader, a justiciar known as Phosani, saw the truth in Saradomin's teachings and turned away from his false light.
translation: Ancak liderimiz, Phosani adinda bir yargic, Saradomin'in ögretilerindeki gercegi gördü ve onun sahte isigindan uzaklasti.

english: Phosani embraced the glory of Zamorak and most of our order did the same. After that, she became known as the Inquisitor, though our order refers to her as 'Mother'.

english: After the order reached enlightenment through Zamorak, we made our home in an abandoned hermitage. Over time, that hermitage grew into the town you see today.
translation: Tarikat Zamorak sayesinde aydinlanmaya ulastiktan sonra, terk edilmis bir inziva yerine yerlestik. Zamanla, o inziva yeri bugün gördügünüz kasabaya dönüstü.

english: What happened to those that refused to turn away from Saradomin?
They were shown the error of their ways through fire and blood.
How wonderful.
Bye!
Be safe, traveller.
What's with all these Oathbreakers?
translation: Bu Yemin Bozanlar da neyin nesi?

english: What's with the mask?
Tell me more about the Sisterhood.

english: Bye!
Hello!
Greetings, traveller.
What are you doing?
Exploring. Isn't it exciting?
Isn't it just! Found anything interesting?
translation: Tabii ki! Ilginc bir sey buldunuz mu?

english: This sanctuary has been sealed for centuries and it's full to the brim with history of my sect... Everything is interesting!
translation: Bu kutsal alan yüzyillardir kapaliydi ve benim mezhebimin tarihi ile dolu... Her sey ilginc!

english: How do you even know where to begin?
I... Don't. It might explain the aimless wandering.
translation: Ben... Bilmiyorum. Bu, amacsiz dolasmayi aciklayabilir.

english: Huh, I've always wondered why so many people do that.
translation: Huh, neden bu kadar cok insanin bunu yaptigini hep merak etmisimdir.

english: What's with the mask?
These are the masks of the Sisterhood. While symbolic, they also have practical uses.
translation: Bunlar Kardeslik'in maskeleri. Sembolik olmalarinin yani sira pratik kullanimlari da var.

english: Oh really? What like?
Herbs can be stored within the beak, masking the smell of death and preventing us from becoming infected.
translation: Kus gagasi icinde otlar saklanabilir, ölüm kokusunu maskeler ve enfeksiyon kapmamizi önler.

english: That sounds handy. Can I have one?
translation: Kulaga kullanisli geliyor. Bir tane alabilir miyim?

english: You ask too many questions.
Is that a yes?
It's a no. To wear a mask of the Sisterhood, you need to join the Sisterhood.
translation: Hayir demek. Kardeslik'in maskesini takmak icin Kardeslik'e katilman gerekir.

english: What is the Sisterhood?
An ancient order, born right here in Slepe.

translation: Su anda aradigimiz niteliklere sahip degilsin. Belki baska bir zaman.

english: Bye!
Welcome to my little chapel. Can I help you?
translation: Kücük sapeliime hos geldin. Yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: Why are you here?
I built this chapel here so that fighters could come and pray before battle. A fighter who ignores their spiritual needs may as well have stabbed themselves in the foot.
translation: Bu sapeli, savascilar savastan önce dua edebilsinler diye insa ettim. Ruhani ihtiyaclarini göz ardi eden bir savasci, kendi ayagina bicak saplamis gibi olur.

english: People keep claiming they're not interested in religion, but as soon as they're under attack they're yelling for 'Protect from Melee'. Sad, really.
translation: Insanlar dinle ilgilenmediklerini söyleyip duruyorlar, ama saldiriya ugradiklari anda “Yakin dövüsten koru” diye bagiriyorlar. Gercekten üzücü.

english: So is there something I can do for you?
translation: Peki, senin icin yapabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: So whose sister are you?
Ahahahahahaha, very funny! With jokes like that, you should become a banker.
translation: Ahahahahahaha, cok komik! Böyle esprilerle bankaci olmalisin.

english: But no I am a sister to the broken and down trodden, I heard talk of this enclave being built and knew that my skills could be put to good use.
translation: Ama hayir, ben kirik ve ezilmislerin kiz kardesiyim. Bu yerlesim yerinin insa edildigini duydum ve becerilerimin burada ise yarayacagini düsündüm.

english: I've found a worthy cause here running my little chapel, so I'm happy enough. Now, can I help you with something?
translation: Burada kücük sapelimi isleterek degerli bir amac buldum, bu yüzden yeterince mutluyum. Simdi, sana yardim edebilir miyim?

english: I'm fine, thanks.
Actually, that's a bit of a sore point. Asgarnia has a building full of monks, all living happily as a community of brothers, but they don't let women join.
translation: Aslinda, bu biraz hassas bir konu. Asgarnia'da rahiplerle dolu bir bina var, hepsi kardesler toplulugu olarak mutlu bir sekilde yasiyorlar, ama kadinlarin katilmalarina izin vermiyorlar.

english: I'd heard rumours that there was an Abbey up here somewhere, which sounded marvellous, but I seem to be in the wrong place.
translation: Burada bir yerde bir manastir oldugu söylentilerini duymustum, kulaga harika geliyordu, ama galiba yanlis yerdeyim.

english: Anyway, I've found a worthy cause here, running my little chapel, so I'm happy enough. Now, can I help you with something?
translation: Her neyse, burada kücük sapelimi isleterek degerli bir amac buldum, bu yüzden yeterince mutluyum. Simdi, size yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: Why are you here?
So whose sister are you?
I'm fine, thanks.
Greetings, traveller.
Tell me about the Nightmare.
You're better off speaking with the Siren, that is her area of expertise. All I know is that the beast poses a huge risk to Mother.
translation: Siren ile konussaniz daha iyi olur, bu onun uzmanlik alani. Tek bildigim, canavarin Annem icin büyük bir tehlike olusturdugu.

english: At least for the moment, Mother is not in any direct danger. I fear it is only a matter of time before the beast enters her mind again though.
translation: En azindan simdilik, Anne dogrudan bir tehlike altinda degil. Ama canavarin tekrar zihnine girmesinin sadece an meselesi oldugunu korkuyorum.

english: What's with the mask?
These are the masks of the Sisterhood. While symbolic, they also have practical uses.

english: Oh really? What like?

english: That sounds handy. Can I have one?
translation: Kulaga kullanisli geliyor. Bana da bir tane verebilir misin?

english: No. To wear a mask of the Sisterhood, you need to join the Sisterhood.
translation: Hayir. Kardeslik'in maskesini takmak icin Kardeslik'e katilman gerekir.

english: Well sign me up!
I'm afraid you lack the qualities we're currently looking for. Perhaps another time.
translation: Korkarim su anda aradigimiz niteliklere sahip degilsin. Belki baska bir zaman.

english: Do you have any of my items?
Sorry, but I don't have anything for you. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: Üzgünüm, ama sana verecek hicbir seyim yok. Eger esyalarin varsa da, sen onlari almadan önce öldüysen, artik kaybolmuslardir.

english: I do, traveller. You should be more cautious with them.
translation: Evet, gezgin. Onlara daha dikkatli davranmalisin.

english: I'd better get going.
Be safe, traveller.
I would advise against doing that, traveller. You do not yet know what you are up against.
translation: Bunu yapmamani tavsiye ederim, gezgin. Neyle karsi karsiya oldugunu henüz bilmiyorsun.

english: What are you doing up here?
Keeping an eye on Mother.
Mother?
Phosani, the founder of our sect and creator of this sanctuary. She is our mother, and always will be.
translation: Phosani, tarikatimizin kurucusu ve bu siginagin yaraticisi. O bizim annemiz ve her zaman öyle kalacak.

english: I see... So where is she?
She lies in this coffin.
Oh... So she's dead?
Dead? No. She sleeps the everlasting slumber.
Right. The coffin looks pretty secure to me. Why do you need to keep an eye on her.
translation: Anladim. Tabut bana oldukca güvenli görünüyor. Neden ona göz kulak olman gerekiyor?

english: The creature down there, the one that Siren calls the Nightmare. It has been invading Mother's mind, feeding on her.
translation: Asagidaki yaratik, Siren'in Kabus dedigi yaratik. Annenin zihnini istila ediyor, ondan besleniyor.

english: Mother is strong, but not strong enough to fight it off alone. She needs help.
translation: Annen güclüdür, ama tek basina onunla savasacak kadar güclü degildir. Yardima ihtiyaci var.

english: Needs help does she? Maybe I could be of assistance?
translation: Yardima mi ihtiyaci var? Belki ben yardimci olabilirim?

english: The offer is appreciated. Luckily for us though, the Nightmare is not present in Mother's mind at the moment.
translation: Teklifin icin tesekkürler. Neyse ki, Kabus su anda annenin zihninde degil.

english: Fair enough. If that changes, I'm more than willing to help.
translation: Anlasildi. Eger durum degisirse, seve seve yardim ederim.

english: The offer is appreciated. I fear you do not have the abilities to take on that sort of challenge though.
translation: Teklifin icin tesekkürler. Ama korkarim ki, bu tür bir mücadeleye girisecek yeteneklere sahip degilsin.

english: What abilities do I need?
The horror that has manifested itself in Mother's mind is far stronger than the one fought in the Nightmare's dream.
translation: Annemin zihninde ortaya cikan korku, Kabus'un rüyasinda savastigindan cok daha güclü.

english: If you hope to have a chance, you'll want to take on the weaker form first. That Siren down there can help you.
translation: Bir sansin olmasini istiyorsan, önce daha zayif olanla mücadele etmelisin. Asagidaki Siren sana yardim edebilir.

english: Fair enough. I'll be back once I have more experience.
translation: Anlasildi. Daha fazla deneyim kazandiktan sonra geri gelecegim.

english: That would be appreciated, traveller. You can use the pool here to enter Mother's mind and take on the Nightmare within.
translation: Cok makbule gecer, gezgin. Buradaki havuzu kullanarak Annenin zihnine girip icindeki Kabusla mücadele edebilirsin.

english: Be warned though. If you enter, you enter alone. No one else can help you with this one.
translation: Ama dikkatli ol. Girersen, yalniz girersin. Bu konuda kimse sana yardim edemez.

english: I see. I'll have to be careful then.
Indeed. Good luck, traveller.

I'd better get going.

He's not looking great, is he? We fear he is a victim of the Sleeper Plague.
translation: Iyi görünmüyor, degil mi? Onun Uyuyan Veba'nin kurbani oldugundan korkuyoruz.

english: Sleeper Plague?
Many years ago, this village was beset by a terrible plague. Those infected fell into a deep sleep, never to wake. Now we fear the plague has returned.
translation: Yillar önce, bu köy korkunc bir veba salginina maruz kaldi. Enfekte olanlar derin bir uykuya daldilar ve bir daha uyanamadilar. Simdi salginin geri döndügünden korkuyoruz.

english: Do you any theories on why it's come back?
translation: Neden geri döndügüne dair bir teorin var mi?

english: Well, there's the strange man being accused out in the centre, but personally I think he's innocent.
translation: Sey, merkezde suclanan garip bir adam var, ama sahsen onun masum oldugunu düsünüyorum.

english: Hmm, so how long has the old man been asleep?
translation: Hmm, yasli adam ne kadar süredir uyuyor?

english: Oh, I can't recall exactly, but at least a few weeks. He has spoken a few times though, in his sleep.
translation: Oh, tam olarak hatirlamiyorum, ama en az birkac haftadir. Uykusunda birkac kez konustu.

english: What did he say?
It was nonsense, but I recall the words 'Inyetat' and 'Coshmar', whatever those means.
translation: Sacma sapan seylerdi, ama “Inyetat” ve “Coshmar” kelimelerini hatirliyorum, ne anlama geldiklerini bilmiyorum.

english: How peculiar.
How are things with the Sleeper Plague?
The one responsible was found out and executed. We haven't had any new cases since.

english: I see... And what of those still ill?

english: Well now that the cause has been dealt with, we can focus more heavily on a cure.
translation: Artik nedeni ortadan kaldirildigina göre, tedaviye daha fazla odaklanabiliriz.

english: And how long will that take?
Well that depends...
On what?
On how things progress... down below.

english: Lord Crombwick?
The ruler of this place. He lives in his manor, to the north.

english: Where's the Lord? Surely he should be down here with his wife?
translation: Lord nerede? Karisi yanindayken burada olmasi gerekmez mi?

english: Still in his manor. He hasn't left since she fell ill.
translation: Hâlâ malikanesinde. Karisi hastalandigindan beri oradan cikmadi.

english: Why?
No one knows. The place looks like a mess and some say they've seen vampyres lurking.
translation: Kimse bilmiyor. Burasi darmadagin görünüyor ve bazilari vampirlerin dolastigini söylüyor.

english: How mysterious.
