english: The one responsible was found out and executed. We haven't had any new cases since.
translation: Sorumlu kisi bulundu ve idam edildi. O zamandan beri yeni vaka olmadi.

english: I see... And what of those still ill?
translation: Anliyorum... Peki hala hasta olanlar ne olacak?

english: Well now that the cause has been dealt with, we can focus more heavily on a cure.
translation: Artik nedeni ortadan kaldirildigina göre, tedaviye daha fazla odaklanabiliriz.

english: And how long will that take?
Well that depends...
On what?
On how things progress... down below.
Bye!
Be safe, traveller.
What's with the mask?
Tell me more about the Sisterhood.
translation: Kardeslik hakkinda daha fazla bilgi ver.

english: What's wrong with that woman?
How are things with the Sleeper Plague?
Bye!
Hello!
Greetings, traveller.
What's with the mask?
These are the masks of the Sisterhood. While symbolic, they also have practical uses.
translation: Bunlar Kardeslik'in maskeleri. Sembolik olmalarinin yani sira pratik kullanimlari da var.

english: Oh really? What like?
Herbs can be stored within the beak, masking the smell of death and preventing us from becoming infected.
translation: Gaga icinde otlar saklanabilir, bu da ölüm kokusunu maskeler ve enfeksiyon kapmamizi önler.

english: That sounds handy. Can I have one?
translation: Kulaga kullanisli geliyor. Bir tane alabilir miyim?

english: You ask too many questions.
Is that a yes?
It's a no. To wear a mask of the Sisterhood, you need to join the Sisterhood.
translation: Hayir demek. Kardeslik'in maskesini takmak icin Kardeslik'e katilman gerekir.

english: What is the Sisterhood?
An ancient order, born right here in Slepe.
Well sign me up!
You lack the qualities we're currently looking for. Perhaps another time.
translation: Su anda aradigimiz niteliklere sahip degilsin. Belki baska bir zaman.

english: Tell me more about the Sisterhood.
translation: Kardeslik hakkinda daha fazla bilgi ver.

english: Many years ago, the Sisterhood were a group of healers dedicated to Saradomin.
translation: Yillar önce, Kardeslik Saradomin'e adanmis bir grup sifaciydi.

english: However, our leader, a justiciar known as Phosani, saw the truth in Saradomin's teachings and turned away from his false light.
translation: Ancak liderimiz, Phosani adinda bir yargic, Saradomin'in ögretilerindeki gercegi gördü ve onun sahte isigindan uzaklasti.

english: Phosani embraced the glory of Zamorak and most of our order did the same. After that, she became known as the Inquisitor, though our order refers to her as 'Mother'.
translation: Phosani, Zamorak'in ihtisamini benimsedi ve tarikatimizin cogu da ayni seyi yapti. Bundan sonra, o “Inquisitor” olarak tanindi, ancak tarikatimiz ona “Anne” diye hitap ediyor.

english: After the order reached enlightenment through Zamorak, we made our home in an abandoned hermitage. Over time, that hermitage grew into the town you see today.
translation: Tarikatimiz Zamorak araciligiyla aydinlanmaya ulastiktan sonra, terk edilmis bir inziva yerine yerlestik. Zamanla, o inziva yeri bugün gördügünüz kasabaya dönüstü.

english: What happened to those that refused to turn away from Saradomin?
They were shown the error of their ways through fire and blood.
How wonderful.
What's going on here?
With this strange tattooed man? He is on trial.
translation: Bu garip dövmeli adamla mi? Yargilaniyor.

english: For what crime?
It is suspected he might have caused the return of the Sleeper Plague.
translation: Sleeper Plague'in geri dönüsüne neden oldugu süpheleniliyor.

english: Sleeper Plague?
Yes. A long time ago, Slepe was beset by an illness called the Sleeper Plague. Those infected fell into a deep sleep, never to wake.
translation: Evet. Uzun zaman önce, Slepe Uyuyan Veba adli bir hastalikla bogusuyordu. Enfekte olanlar derin bir uykuya daldilar ve bir daha uyanamadilar.

english: But now it's back?
It would appear so. This man showed up in town around the same time the first victim fell ill. We fear this is no coincidence.
translation: Öyle görünüyor. Bu adam, ilk kurban hastalandigi siralarda kasabaya geldi. Bunun bir tesadüf olmadigini düsünüyoruz.

english: That doesn't make him guilty though.
No. That is for the trial to determine.
What happened to the tattooed man?
His trial has concluded. The citizens have passed their judgement.
translation: Mahkeme sona erdi. Vatandaslar kararini verdi.

english: And?
The accused was found guilty of causing the return of the Sleeper Plague. He has now been executed.
translation: Sanik, Uyuyan Vebasi'nin geri dönüsüne neden olmakla suclu bulundu. Simdi idam edildi.

english: Executed? That's pretty dark.
Morytania is a dark place, traveller. If you wished for light, you should have picked a better holiday destination.
translation: Morytania karanlik bir yer, gezgin. Isik istiyorsan, daha iyi bir tatil yeri secmeliydin.

english: So that's it?
Since the execution, we have had no new occurrences of the Sleeper Plague. So yes, that's it.
translation: Idamdan bu yana, Uyuyan Veba'nin yeni vakalari görülmedi. Evet, hepsi bu.

english: Bye!
Be safe, traveller.
What's with the mask?
Tell me more about the Sisterhood.
translation: Kardeslik hakkinda daha fazla bilgi ver.

english: What's going on here?
What happened to the tattooed man?
Bye!
Hey! What do you think you're doing? Leave my tea alone!
translation: Hey! Ne yaptigini saniyorsun? Cayimi rahat birak!

english: Hey! What do you think you're doing? Don't go casting that kind of spell anywhere near my tea!  Leave my tea alone you telegrabbing fiend!
translation: Hey! Ne yaptigini saniyorsun? Cayimin yanina yaklasip öyle büyü yapma! Cayimi rahat birak, seni telgraf hirsizi!

english: Oh, so you're back then, come to gloat have you?
translation: Demek geri döndün, gelip sevincten havalara ucmak icin mi?

english: Nope, I've just come to ask you a couple of questions.
translation: Hayir, sadece sana birkac soru sormaya geldim.

english: How do I get rid of the undead ogres?
Haven't I already explained this to you once before?
translation: Bunu sana daha önce aciklamamis miydim?

english: Humour me!

Ok, similar spells have been cast before and the only way to deal with the resulting creatures is to cordon off the area and not go in there again. The undead creatures usually manifest some sort of disease so it's
translation: Tamam, daha önce de benzer büyüler yapilmisti ve ortaya cikan yaratiklarla basa cikmanin tek yolu, alani kordon altina almak ve bir daha oraya girmemek. Ölümsüz yaratiklar genellikle bir tür hastalik yayarlar, bu yüzden

english: best to attack them from a distance with a ranged weapon.
translation: onlara uzaktan menzilli silahlarla saldirmak en iyisidir.

english: Normal missiles like arrows and darts do very little damage to them because they're designed to destroy internal organs. This is a waste of time with undead creatures like undead ogres.
translation: Ok ve dart gibi normal füzeler, ic organlari yok etmek icin tasarlandiklari icin onlara cok az zarar verir. Bu, ölümsüz ogreler gibi ölümsüz yaratiklar icin zaman kaybidir.

english: Yeah, clearly so what should we use?
translation: Evet, acikca öyle, peki ne kullanmaliyiz?

english: From my research it looks like a flat ended arrow was designed called a 'Brutal arrow'. This does large amounts of crushing damage to the creature.
translation: Arastirmalarima göre, “Brutal arrow” adi verilen düz uclu bir ok tasarlanmis gibi görünüyor. Bu ok, yaratiga büyük miktarda ezici hasar verir.

english: You can make them by using larger arrows, I think some Ogre hunters make them. But instead of adding an arrow tip, you hammer a large nail into the end of the shaft.
translation: Daha büyük oklar kullanarak bunlari yapabilirsiniz, sanirim bazi ogre avcilari bunlari yapiyor. Ancak ok ucunu eklemek yerine, okun ucuna büyük bir civi cakiyorsunuz.

english: How do I get rid of the disease?
Haven't I already explained this disease thing to you once before?
translation: Bu hastalik konusunu sana daha önce aciklamamis miydim?

english: Just tell me again or else I'll turn you back into an ogre!
translation: Bana tekrar söyle, yoksa seni tekrar ogreye dönüstürürüm!

english: No...noo...please, I'll tell you.
My research shows that two jungle based herbs can be used, one is found near river tributaries and looks like a vine, the other is found in caves and grows on the wall.
translation: Arastirmalarim, iki tür orman bitkisinin kullanilabilecegini gösteriyor. Biri nehir kollari yakininda bulunur ve asma gibi görünür, digeri ise magaralarda bulunur ve duvarlarda yetisir.

english: It's quite well camouflaged so it's unlikely that you'll find it.
translation: Oldukca iyi kamufle oldugu icin bulmaniz pek olasi degil.

english: We'll see about that!
Sorry, I have to go.
How do I get rid of the undead ogres?
How do I get rid of the disease?
Sorry, I have to go.
Krrrrsssss
Krrrrsssss
Are you all right? You seem a little...incoherent.
Inc'hearnt? Inc'herant! You...you...with yer fancy book- lernin' words. You'd be more than inc'herant if youd seen...
translation: Tutarsiz mi? Tutarsiz! Sen... sen... o süslü kitaplardan ögrendigin kelimelerle. Onlari görseydin, tutarsizdan da öte olurdun...

english: (Dramatic pause)
THEM!
I'm sure I would as well.
I'm going over here to talk to non-crazy people now.
translation: Simdi buraya gelip deli olmayan insanlarla konusacagim.

english: Yeah? Yeah? Well when THEY come floppin' into your house and eat your furniture you'll be sorry!
translation: Öyle mi? Öyle mi? Peki, ONLAR senin evine girip mobilyalarini yediginde pisman olacaksin!

english: Who are
(Dramatic pause)
THEY?
They! Those bloodthirsty, flesh-tearing devils! They are the reason I'm out here every day hurlin' bottles into the sea!
translation: Onlar! O kana susamis, eti parcalayan seytanlar! Onlar yüzünden her gün buraya gelip denize sise firlatiyorum!

english: They are the reason I've lost everything, except the horrifying memory of what THEY look like...
translation: Onlar yüzünden her seyimi kaybettim, onlarin neye benzedigine dair korkunc anilarim haric...

english: And what do THEY look like?
Mudskippers!
Mudskippers?
Aye, Mudskippers! Those ferocious, ravening, evil, beady-eyed terrors of the deep!
translation: Evet, camur ziplayicilari! O vahsi, acgözlü, kötü, kücük gözlü derinlerin dehsetleri!

english: I...see...
I was ambushed by them way back, see. They got the drop on me...I can't remember where, somewhere around here though.
translation: Uzun zaman önce onlar tarafindan pusuya düsürüldüm. Beni yakaladilar... Nerede oldugunu hatirlamiyorum, ama buralarda bir yerdeydi.

english: These would be the mudskippers, right?
Aye! The mudskippers! Huge they were! Ten feet of glistening, muddy flesh floppin' towards me with white foam flying from their gnashing fangs!
translation: Evet! Camur ziplayicilari! Kocamanlardi! Üc metrelik parlak, camurlu bedenleri bana dogru sicrarken, dislerini gicirdatarak beyaz köpükler saciyorlardi!

english: I fought them up and down the beach, with the tide rising and more of them leaping towards me with cutlasses drawn!
translation: Gelgit yükselirken ve daha fazlasi kiliclarini cekip bana dogru atlarken, sahilde onlarla savastim!

english: This is fascinating, but I have to be...
Shut yer' word-hole and listen! I can't remember all the details, as I'm sure they must have hit me quite hard, but the last thing I remember before it all went black...
translation: Kapa ceneni ve dinle! Ayrintilari hatirlamiyorum, cünkü eminim bana cok sert vurmus olmalilar, ama her sey kararmadan önce hatirladigim son sey...

english: ...was one of those devils rearing over me, its eyes glowin' red with the fires of hell!
translation: ...o seytanlardan birinin üzerime egildigi ve gözlerinin cehennem atesiyle kirmizi parladigiydi!

english: Fires of hell...right. I believe you.
No you don't! You think I'm crazy, like all the rest! Well, if I'm crazy, how did I get these?
translation: Hayir, inanmiyorsun! Digerleri gibi sen de benim deli oldugumu düsünüyorsun! Peki, deliysem, bunlari nasil aldim?

english: Get what?
Skippy shows you what appears to be massive bite scars on his legs. You're no expert, but they look like... giant mudskipper bites!
translation: Skippy, bacaklarinda büyük isirik izleri oldugunu gösteriyor. Uzman degilsin, ama bunlar... dev camur ziplayici isiriklari gibi görünüyor!

english: Giant mudskipper bites! Where did you get those?
translation: Dev camur ziplayici isiriklari! Bunlari nereden aldin?

english: I can't remember... I've been drinking to forget the horror, and all I seem to have forgotten is where it all happened...
translation: Hatirlamiyorum... Bu dehseti unutmak icin iciyordum ve tek unuttugum sey, tüm bunlarin nerede oldugu...

english: Hmmm...I suppose if I sober you up you may well start to recall.
translation: Hmmm... Sanirim seni ayiklarsam hatirlamaya baslayabilirsin.

english: You'll have a job. I've been drinking this for a week.
translation: Bu zor olacak. Bir haftadir bunu iciyorum.

english: 'Captain Braindeath's Extra Strength Rum/Drain Cleaner. Now 50% more debilitating'?
translation: “Kaptan Braindeath'in Ekstra Güclü Rom/Kanal Temizleyici. Simdi %50 daha zayiflatici”?

english: It's the extra sheep tranquilizers that gives it that added kick!
translation: Ekstra koyun sakinlestiricileri ona bu ek gücü veriyor!

english: Stay here and I'll be right back. Try not to move. Or go near any open flames.
translation: Burada kal, hemen dönecegim. Hareket etmemeye calis. Veya acik atese yaklasma.

english: You know, I could shock him out of it if I could find some cold water...
translation: Biliyorsun, soguk su bulabilirsem onu soklayabilirim...

english: Hey, Skippy.
Hey you!
How do I annoy the Mogres again?
Go south to Mudskipper Point and lob a Fishing Explosive into the sea. You can grab them from the Slayer masters.
translation: Güneydeki Mudskipper Point'e git ve denize bir Balikcilik Patlayicisi at. Bunlari Slayer ustalarindan alabilirsin.

english: Thanks! So, what are you going to do now?
Well, I was planning on continuing my hobby of wandering up and down this bit of coastline, bellowing random threats and throwing bottles.
translation: Sey, bu sahil seridinde dolasip, rastgele tehditler savurup sise firlatma hobimi sürdürmeyi planliyordum.

english: And you?
I was planning on wandering up and down the landscape, bugging people to see if they had mindblowingly dangerous quests for me to undertake.
translation: Ben de manzarayi dolasip, insanlari rahatsiz ederek benim icin akillara durgunluk verecek kadar tehlikeli görevler olup olmadigini ögrenmeyi planliyordum.

english: Well, good luck with that!
You too!
Weirdo...
Loony...
I think he's sober enough. And I don't want to use another bucket of water.
translation: Bence yeterince ayik. Ve baska bir kova su kullanmak istemiyorum.

english: Thanks! Now I have two right boots!
translation: Tesekkürler! Artik iki sag botum var!

english: Do you wanna skip the Tutorial?
Send me to the mainland now.
Right on. I'll read you the official messages first, then send you on your way. Ahem...
translation: Tamam. Önce resmi mesajlari okuyacagim, sonra yoluna devam edeceksin. Ahem...

english: I am now going to teleport you to Kourend Castle where your journey in the Twisted League will begin. Once you arrive, the Leagues Tutor will fill you in on how the Twisted League works. Good luck!
translation: Seni simdi Twisted League'deki yolculugunun baslayacagi Kourend Kalesi'ne isinlayacagim. Oraya vardiginda, Lig Egitmeni sana Twisted League'in nasil isledigini anlatacak. Iyi sanslar!

english: Prepare yourself!
Who are you?
My name's Skippy. Normally I live down by Rimmington.
Although I guess you won't be able to get to Rimmington on this League world...
translation: Ama sanirim bu Lig dünyasinda Rimmington'a ulasamayacaksin...

english: Just lately the Council wants to let people skip the Tutorial, so - ha ha ha - they dump the job on Skippy. Bah!
translation: Son zamanlarda Konsey, insanlarin Tutorial'i atlamasina izin vermek istiyor, bu yüzden - ha ha ha - isi Skippy'ye yüklediler. Bah!

english: So, anyway, do you want to skip the Tutorial?
Can I decide later?
Sure. You'll find me all over this island. Ask me again any time you like.
translation: Tabii. Beni bu adanin her yerinde bulabilirsin. Istedigin zaman tekrar sorabilirsin.

english: I'll stay here for the Tutorial.
Good choice. Let me know if you change your mind.
translation: Iyi secim. Fikrini degistirirsen bana haber ver.

english: When you arrive on the mainland you will be a Deadman. If you die when skulled, or if you are killed by another Deadman you will lose the most valuable items from your bank.
translation: Anakaraya vardiginda bir Deadman olacaksin. Kafatasi simgesi varken ölürsen veya baska bir Deadman tarafindan öldürülürsen, bankandaki en degerli esyalarini kaybedersin.

english: To help you get started, you'll have 12 hours of immunity before anyone can attack you. Speak to the Doomsayer in Lumbridge to waive your immunity and get on with the killing!
translation: Baslamana yardimci olmak icin, kimse sana saldirmadan önce 12 saatlik bir dokunulmazlik süresi verilecek. Lumbridge'deki Doomsayer ile konusarak dokunulmazligindan vazgec ve öldürmeye devam et!

english: For more information, speak to Nigel in the Lumbridge graveyard. You may choose where to begin - where would you like to start?
translation: Daha fazla bilgi icin Lumbridge mezarligindaki Nigel ile konusun. Nereden baslayacaginizi secebilirsiniz - nereden baslamak istersiniz?

english: You are teleported to your preferred starting location
My name's Skippy. Normally I live down by Rimmington. You should come and see me when you're passing.
translation: Benim adim Skippy. Normalde Rimmington'da yasiyorum. Gecerken beni ziyarete gelmelisiniz.

english: I'm sure I would as well.
Who are (Dramatic pause) THEY?
Send me to the mainland now.
Who are you?
Can I decide later?
I'll stay here for the Tutorial.
Lumbridge
Varrock
Falador
East Ardougne
Gnome Stronghold
:Gar mulno ful taglo!
I do not thinke thou understand the depths of the darkness you have unleashed upon the world. To dub it in such a scintillant manner is offensive to mine being.
translation: Dünyaya saliverdigin karanligin derinligini anladigini sanmiyorum. Bunu bu kadar parlak bir sekilde ifade etmek benim varligima hakaret niteligindedir.

english: So why are you following me around?
Dark forces of which ye know nought have deemed that this is my geas.
translation: Senin hic bilmedigin karanlik gücler bunun benim kaderim olduguna karar verdiler.

english: Your goose?
*Sighs* Nae. But thine is well and truly cooked.
translation: *Ic ceker* Hayir. Ama seninki gercekten de pismis durumda.

english: I am spawned of darkness. I am filled with darkness. I am darkness incarnate and to darkness I will return.
translation: Ben karanliktan dogdum. Karanlikla doluyum. Ben karanligin vücut bulmus haliyim ve karanliga dönecegim.

english: Sounds pretty... dark.
Knowest thou not of the cursed place? Knowest thou not about the future yet to befall your puny race?
translation: Lanetli yeri bilmiyor musun? Zayif irkinin basina gelecekleri bilmiyor musun?

english: Oh yes, I've heard that before.
Then it is good that ye can laugh in the face of the end.
translation: O zaman sonun karsisinda gülebilmen iyi bir sey.

english: The end has a face? Which end?
translation: Sonun bir yüzü mü var? Hangi son?

english: *Sighs* The darkness giveth, and the darkness taketh.
translation: *Ic cekis* Karanlik verir ve karanlik alir.

english: Nothing. Ye are already tainted in my sight by the acts of light. However there may be some hope for you if you continue to aid the darkness.
translation: Hicbir sey. Benim gözümde, isigin eylemleriyle zaten lekelenmissiniz. Ancak karanliga yardim etmeye devam ederseniz, sizin icin biraz umut olabilir.

english: I do have a lantern around here somewhere.
translation: Buralarda bir yerde bir fenerim var.

english: Do not bring that foul and repellant thing near mine self.
translation: O igrenc ve itici seyi bana yaklastirma.

english: A book of darkness? I don't usually read, but that seems like a good book!
translation: Karanligin kitabi mi? Genelde okumam ama bu iyi bir kitap gibi görünüyor!

english: I told thee to keep thy filthy light away from me!
translation: Sana pis isigini benden uzak tutmani söyledim!

english: Darkness take ye.
Rest in darkness.
Let the darkness come forth.
You look cute.
Where did you come from?
What can you do for me?
Hello.
Good day.
Hey! Get your hands off there!
Good day, Your Royal Highness.
Oi!
Rahr!
No!
Grr!
Aargh!
I'm a gonner!
It's no use, I'm done for!
Uggh!
Hello!
Sorry. I can't sell weapons to outerlanders. Wouldn't be right. Against our beliefs.
translation: Üzgünüm. Yabancilara silah satamam. Dogru olmaz. Inanclarimiza aykiri.

english: Only Fremenniks may purchase weapons and armour here.
translation: Burada sadece Fremennikler silah ve zirh satin alabilir.

english: Are you a member of the council of elders?
No. Weapons are my speciality. Not politics.
translation: Hayir. Benim uzmanlik alanim silahlar, siyaset degil.

english: Okay, thanks.
I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a finely balanced custom bowstring, do you?
translation: Iyi dengelenmis özel yapim bir yay ipi bulabilecegim bir yer biliyor musunuz?

english: Aye, I have a few in stock. What would an outerlander be wanting with equipment like that?
translation: Evet, stokta birkac tane var. Bir yabanci neden böyle bir ekipmana ihtiyac duyar ki?

english: It's for Sigli. It needs to be weighted precisely to suit his hunting bow.
translation: Sigli icin. Av yayina tam olarak uyacak sekilde hassas bir sekilde agirliklandirilmasi gerekiyor.

english: For Sigli eh? Well, I made his bow in the first place, so I'll be able to select the right string for you... just one small problem.
translation: Sigli icin mi? Aslinda, onun yayini ben yaptim, bu yüzden sana uygun ipi secebilirim... ama kücük bir sorun var.

english: What's that?
This string you'll be wanting... Very rare. Take a lot of time to recreate. Not sure you have the cash for it.
translation: Istedigin bu ip... Cok nadir bulunur. Yeniden yapmak cok zaman alir. Paran yetmez mi acaba?

english: Then maybe you'll accept something else...?
translation: O zaman baska bir sey kabul eder misin?

english: Heh. Good thinking outerlander. Well, it's true, there is more to life than just making money. Making weapons is good money, but it's not why I do it.
translation: Heh. Iyi düsündün yabanci. Dogru, hayatta para kazanmaktan daha önemli seyler var. Silah yapmak iyi para kazandirir, ama ben bunu para icin yapmiyorum.

english: I'll tell you what. I heard a rumour that one of the fishermen down by the docks caught some weird looking fish as they were fishing the other day.
translation: Sana sunu söyleyeyim. Limandaki balikcilardan birinin gecen gün balik tutarken tuhaf görünümlü bir balik yakaladigina dair bir söylenti duydum.

english: From what I hear this fish is unique. Nobody's ever seen its like before. This intrigues me. I'd like to have it for myself. Make a good trophy.
translation: Duyduguma göre bu balik essizmis. Kimse daha önce böyle bir sey görmemis. Bu beni meraklandirdi. Onu kendim icin istiyorum. Iyi bir ganimet olur.

english: You get me that fish, I give you the bowstring. What do you say? We got a deal?
translation: Bana o baligi getirirsen, sana yay ipini veririm. Ne dersin? Anlastik mi?

english: Sounds good to me.
I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find an exotic and extremely rare fish, do you?
translation: Egzotik ve cok nadir bir baligi nerede bulabilecegimi biliyor musun?

english: What? There's another one?
translation: Ne? Baska bir tane mi var?

english: Er... no, it's the one for you that I'm looking for...
translation: Hayir, senin icin aradigim balik bu...

english: Ah. I see. I already told you. Some guy down by the docks was bragging. Best ask there, I reckon.
translation: Anliyorum. Sana zaten söyledim. Limanda bir adam övünüyordu. Ona sorsan iyi olur.

english: Hi there. I got your fish, so can I have that bowstring for Sigli now?
translation: Merhaba. Baligini getirdim, Sigli icin yay ipini alabilir miyim?

english: Ohh... That's a nice fish. Very pleased. Here. Take the bowstring. You fulfilled agreement. only fair I do same. Good work outerlander.
translation: Ohh... Güzel bir balik. Cok memnunum. Al. Yay ipini al. Anlasmayi yerine getirdin. Ben de aynisini yapmam gerek. Iyi is cikardin yabanci.

english: Thanks!
So about this bowstring... was it hard to make or something?
translation: Bu yay ipi hakkinda... Yapmasi zor muydur?

english: Not hard. Just a trick to it. Takes skill to learn, but when learnt, easy. Sigli will be happy. Finest bowstring on continent. Will suit his needs perfectly.
translation: Zor degil. Sadece bir püf noktasi var. Ögrenmesi beceri gerektirir, ama ögrendikten sonra kolaydir. Sigli mutlu olacak. Kitadaki en iyi yay ipi. Ihtiyaclarina mükemmel uyacak.

english: Hello again [Fremennik name]. Come to see what's for sale?
translation: Merhaba Dokrak. Satilik olanlari görmeye mi geldin?

english: Ask about the Merchant's trial
Ask about becoming a Fremennik
Oh, hello again. Want to buy some weapons?
translation: Merhaba. Silah satin almak ister misin?

english: I'll have a look.
Not right now.
I'll have a look.
Not right now...
I think I'll give the Skullball Course a go.
What are the instructions for using the skullball course?
translation: Skullball sahasini kullanmak icin talimatlar nelerdir?

english: The skullball comes out of one of these four spawnholes. Just kick the ball through the middle of each goal, through the skeleton's feet.
translation: Skullball, bu dört delikten birinden cikar. Topu, her bir kalenin ortasindan, iskeletin ayaklarinin arasindan gecirin.

english: There are 10 goals, which you must complete in order, and one final goal.
translation: Sirayla tamamlamaniz gereken 10 kale ve bir final kale vardir.

english: An arrow will point to your ball, just in case lots of people are using the course at the same time as yourself.
translation: Ayni anda bircok kisi sahayi kullaniyorsa, topunuzu gösteren bir ok olacaktir.

english: The better your time, the more agillity XP you will be awarded. The timer starts when you score your first goal.
translation: Zamaniniz ne kadar iyi olursa, o kadar fazla ceviklik XP kazanirsiniz. Zamanlayici, ilk golünüzü attiginizda baslar.

english: I seem to have lost my ball - can I have another one?
translation: Topumu kaybetmisim galiba, baska bir tane alabilir miyim?

english: No problem, here's another one. You'll have to start from the beginning again, but the timer will be restarted too.
translation: Sorun degil, iste baska bir tane. Bastan baslamaniz gerekecek, ama zamanlayici da yeniden baslatilacak.

english: I give up, I can't do it - take my ball away.
Oh dear, such a defeatist.
translation: Ah canim, ne kadar da yenilgiyi kabul ediyorsun.

english: Grrr - you don't belong in here, human!
translation: Grrr - sen buraya ait degilsin, insan!

english: I would like to do the skullball course.
What are the instructions for the skullball course?
What are the instructions for using the skullball course?
translation: Skullball kursunu kullanmak icin talimatlar nelerdir?

english: I seem to have lost my ball - can I have another one?
translation: Topumu kaybetmisim galiba - baska bir tane alabilir miyim?

english: I give up, I can't do it - take my ball away.
You have truly gifted paws!
I've never seen anything like it!
You need a few more skullball lessons.
translation: Birkac kafatasi topu dersi daha almalisin.

english: Keep it up!
Don't give up the day job!
Look at [her/him] go!
Pathetic!
What - a - goal !!!
That was just plain lucky.
[He/She] shoots - [He/She] scores!!!!!
Humans play skullball worse than puppies!
translation: Insanlar skullball'u köpek yavrularindan daha kötü oynuyor!

english: The human's scored!
What is this place?
This is the Skullball Course.
Eyup. They call me Skully. I run this Wilderness Loot Chest. What can I do for you?
translation: Evet. Bana Skully derler. Bu Wilderness Loot Chest'i ben isletiyorum. Senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: Well, you know how when you kill someone all of their stuff just ends up in a pile on the floor and it's really hard to pick it all up quickly?
translation: Sey, birini öldürdügünde tüm esyalari yerde bir yigin halinde kalir ve hepsini hizlica toplamak gercekten zordur, degil mi?

english: Actually, I've never killed anyone else.
...Oh. Well, when you do, all of their stuff just ends up in a pile on the floor and it's really hard to pick it all up quickly.
translation: ...Oh. Sey, öldürdügünüzde, tüm esyalari yerde bir yigin halinde kalir ve hepsini hizlica toplamak gercekten zordur.

english: Yeah?
So, I made an enchantment that teleports the loot to another dimension instead!
translation: Bu yüzden, ganimeti baska bir boyuta isinlayan bir büyü yaptim!

english: How does that help?
Well, instead of getting a pile of rubbish, you get a single key. You just take the key to this chest and BAM! There's your loot!
translation: Sey, bir yigin cöp yerine tek bir anahtar elde edersin. Bu anahtari sandiga götürürsün ve BAM! Ganimetlerin karsinda!

english: So the loot is safe in this other dimension?
translation: Yani ganimetler bu baska boyutta güvende mi?

english: Eh, seems like it. As long as they've had the key, I've never had anyone unable to get the stuff back out. Though if you lose the key, you can't get the stuff out.
translation: Eh, öyle görünüyor. Anahtari aldiklari sürece, hic kimsenin esyalarini geri alamadigini görmedim. Ama anahtari kaybedersen, esyalari geri alamazsin.

english: Oh, and be careful running about with too many keys on you. Other people will know you've got them, and I'm not gonna stop them opening the chest!
translation: Oh, ve üzerinde cok fazla anahtar tasirken dikkatli ol. Diger insanlar senin anahtarlarin oldugunu bilecekler ve ben onlarin sandigi acmalarini engellemeyecegim!

english: So if I kill someone and take their keys, I can use them myself?
translation: Yani birini öldürüp anahtarlarini alirsam, onlari kendim kullanabilir miyim?

english: ...Eh, if you wanna think about it that way, sure.
I got nothing better to do, so I'll keep track of the value of the stuff you unlock.
translation: Yapacak baska isim yok, o yüzden kilidini actigin esyalarin degerini takip edecegim.

english: And anything you don't want, you can have the chest destroy it.
translation: Istemedigin her seyi sandik yok edebilir.

english: Except the food. I'll eat that instead.
Now, if you want your own keys instead of relying on the misfortune of others, I can put the enchantment on you as well, but it's gonna cost ya.
translation: Baskalarinin talihsizligine güvenmek yerine kendi anahtarlarini istiyorsan, sana da büyü yapabilirim, ama bunun bir bedeli var.

english: Can I have access to the chest?
So, if you have keys from someone else, you're more than welcome to put them in the chest and see what comes out.
translation: Baskasindan aldigin anahtarlar varsa, onlari sandiga koyup ne cikacagini görebilirsin.

english: If you want the enchantment that makes the keys, I'm afraid it's gonna cost you 1 million coins.
translation: Anahtarlari yapan büyüyü istiyorsan, korkarim sana 1 milyon sikkeye mal olacak.

english: Sure, I'll pay for that.
Are you sure? 1 million is a lot of coins, and you won't get them back!
translation: Emin misin? 1 milyon cok para ve geri alamayacaksin!

english: Hmm... I don't think you have enough money on you there, mate.
translation: Hmm... Sanirim üzerinde yeterince para yok dostum.

english: Ok, let me just... and a bit of... and we're done! You'll now get loot keys whenever you kill someone in the Wilderness. Talk to me again if you have any questions.
translation: Tamam, bir saniye... ve biraz da... Tamamdir! Artik Wilderness'ta birini öldürdügünde ganimet anahtarlari alacaksin. Sorun olursa tekrar gel.

english: Fair enough mate, talk to me again if you change your mind.
translation: Tamam dostum, fikrini degistirirsen tekrar gel.

english: Not right now, thanks.
Fair enough mate, want to talk about something else?
translation: Tamam dostum, baska bir sey mi konusmak istiyorsun?

english: How much?!
1 million coins.
Why do you charge so much?!
Runes. People don't wanna deliver across the Wilderness, and I'm in no shape to go to them, so I have to pay through the nose.
translation: Rünler. Insanlar Wilderness'a teslimat yapmak istemiyor ve ben de onlara gidemeyecek durumdayim, bu yüzden cok pahaliya mal oluyor.

english: I make maybe a couple hundred coins of profit, which at least lets me buy a few beers.
translation: Belki birkac yüz sikke kar ediyorum, bu da en azindan birkac bira almama yetiyor.

english: Why is the beer so cheap if it's so expensive to get deliveries out here?
translation: Buraya teslimat yapmak bu kadar pahaliysa, bira neden bu kadar ucuz?

english: The barman makes it himself with whatever scraps he can get his hands on.
translation: Barmen, eline gecirebildigi her türlü artigi kullanarak kendisi yapiyor.

english: You'd think it'd turn out horrible, but compared to every other 2 coin beer out there, it's not half bad.
translation: Korkunc bir sey olacagini düsünürsün, ama diger 2 sikkelik biralarla karsilastirildiginda, o kadar da kötü degil.

english: But enough about beer. If you want access to the loot keys, it's gonna cost you 1 million coins.
translation: Ama bira hakkinda bu kadar yeter. Ganimet anahtarlarina erismek istiyorsan, sana 1 milyon sikkeye mal olacak.

english: Can I change how these loot keys work?
translation: Bu ganimet anahtarlarinin calisma seklini degistirebilir miyim?

english: Well, I can turn the enchantment that creates the loot keys on and off for you. Won't cost you anything to turn it back on again, either.
translation: Yagma anahtarlarini olusturan büyüyü sizin icin acip kapatabilirim. Tekrar acmak da size hicbir seye mal olmaz.

english: If you'd like it so stuff like food and potions stay out of the keys so you can use them yourself, I can do that too.
translation: Yiyecek ve iksir gibi seylerin anahtarlara girmesini istemiyorsaniz, bunlari kendiniz kullanabilmeniz icin bunu da yapabilirim.

english: And if you like the feeling of picking up valuables, I can make it so that anything above a certain value hits the floor as well.
translation: Ve degerli esyalari toplamanin verdigi hissi seviyorsaniz, belirli bir degerin üzerindeki her seyin yere düsmesini saglayabilirim.

english: Ok, whenever you kill someone else now, their items will go to the floor like normal. Just remember, they could have loot keys on them, and they'll still go to your inventory!
translation: Tamam, artik birini öldürdügünüzde, esyalari normal sekilde yere düsecek. Unutmayin, üzerlerinde ganimet anahtarlari olabilir ve bunlar yine de envanterinize gidecek!

english: Ok, you'll now get loot keys when you kill another person in the Wilderness.
translation: Tamam, artik Wilderness'ta baska birini öldürdügünüzde ganimet anahtarlari alacaksiniz.

english: Ok, food and potions will now be dropped to the floor instead of stored in a loot key.
translation: Tamam, yiyecek ve iksirler artik ganimet anahtarinda saklanmak yerine yere düsecek.

english: Ok, food and potions will now be sent to your loot keys.
translation: Tamam, yiyecek ve iksirler artik ganimet anahtarlarina gönderilecek.

english: Ok, valuable items will now be dropped to the floor instead of stored in a loot key.
translation: Tamam, degerli esyalar artik ganimet anahtarinda saklanmak yerine yere düsecek.

english: Ok, valuable items will now be sent to your loot keys.
translation: Tamam, degerli esyalar artik ganimet anahtarlarina gönderilecek.

english: Currently, if you were to have valuable items drop to the floor, they'd need to be worth at least [number]gp. What do you want to change that value to?
Hmph. Yeah, real funny, wise guy.
translation: Hmph. Evet, cok komik, akilli cocuk.

english: Ok, now items worth at least [entered amount]gp will drop to the floor.
How much loot have I claimed?
Well, seeing as you haven't claimed a key yet, I reckon you've claimed a total of 0gp worth of loot.
translation: Henüz bir anahtar almadiginiza göre, toplamda 0gp degerinde ganimet aldiginizi tahmin ediyorum.

english: You've claimed 1 key, containing loot worth about [number]gp. I haven't seen you destroy anything of value yet, though.
You've claimed 1 key, containing loot worth about [number]gp, and you destroyed everything of value.
You've claimed [number] keys, containing loot worth about [number]gp. I haven't seen you destroy anything of value yet, though.
You've claimed [number] keys, containing loot worth about [number]gp. You've destroyed [number]gp worth of it.
You've claimed [number] keys, containing loot worth about [number]gp, and you destroyed everything of value.
Who are you, exactly?
Ah, used to be an adventurer like you, I guess. Used to roam the world, killing monsters for a living. 'Cept then, I discovered the Wilderness.
translation: Ah, eskiden senin gibi bir maceraciydim sanirim. Dünyayi dolasir, canavarlari öldürerek gecimimi saglardim. Ama sonra Wilderness'yi kesfettim.

english: Used to take on anyone and everyone who stood in me way, and made myself a small fortune doing it too.
translation: Yoluma cikan herkesi alt ederdim ve bu sayede kücük bir servet edindim.

english: It's how I got the name, used to go anywhere and everywhere with a skull over my head!
translation: Bu yüzden bu ismi aldim, kafamda bir kurukafa ile her yere giderdim!

english: So how'd you end up like... this?
Ah, you live a life feeding on others, eventually something higher up the food chain finds you.
translation: Ah, baskalarini sömürerek yasarsan, sonunda besin zincirinin üstünde olan biri seni bulur.

english: I used to have a hidden outpost out near the Bone Yard, somewhere to keep my stuff in an emergency. One day all I come back to is a smouldering pile of rubble.
translation: Bone Yard yakinlarinda gizli bir karakolum vardi, acil durumlarda esyalarimi saklayabilecegim bir yer. Bir gün geri döndügümde, geriye sadece yanan bir enkaz yigini kalmisti.

english: Next thing I know, someone's snuck up behind me and has put a spear through my back.
translation: Sonra birdenbire biri arkamdan yaklasip sirtima bir mizrak sapladi.

english: And you survived?!
Always carry a ring of life, friend! Never know when you'll need it.
translation: Her zaman bir yasam yüzügü tasi, dostum! Ne zaman ihtiyacin olacagini asla bilemezsin.

english: Still, the damage was done. Everything I ever owned up in smoke, and even though the wound's fully healed, I can still feel that spear in my back to this day.
translation: Yine de, hasar coktan verilmisti. Sahip oldugum her sey duman oldu ve yaralarim tamamen iyilesmis olsa da, o mizragi sirtimda hissetmeye devam ediyorum.

english: Thankfully, Ferox was kind enough to take me in, and I managed to repurpose some of my old storage magic for adventurers like you.
translation: Neyse ki, Ferox beni kabul etti ve eski depolama büyülerimin bir kismini senin gibi maceracilar icin yeniden kullanmayi basardim.

english: But why come back to the Wilderness?
What, go lifea normal life behind a shop counter so I can pedalswamp paste for a living instead? I'll pass!
translation: Ne, dükkan tezgahinin arkasinda normal bir hayat sürmek icin mi, pedal camuru satarak gecimimi saglamak icin mi? Hayir, tesekkürler!

english: Anyhow, enough about me. What can I do for you?
translation: Neyse, benden bu kadar. Senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: Goodbye.
I'll be here if you need anything.
Don't waste my time trying to change settings on a thing you haven't bought yet!
translation: Henüz satin almadigin bir seyin ayarlarini degistirmeye calisarak zamanimi bosa harcama!

english: I know you Iron people are weird about taking other people's stuff, so if you just wanna have the chest destroy it all, that's fine by me.
translation: Siz Demir halkinin baskalarinin esyalarini almaya karsi tuhaf davrandiginizi biliyorum, bu yüzden sandigi istiyorsaniz hepsini yok edin, benim icin sorun yok.

english: Except the food. I'm eating that instead.
Sorry mate, can't run the Loot Chest on a Deadman World.
translation: Üzgünüm dostum, Deadman World'de Loot Chest calistirilamaz.

english: How does the chest work?
Can I have access to the chest?
Sure, I'll pay for that.
Yes, pay 1 million coins!
No, I've changed my mind!
Not right now, thanks.
How much?!
Can I change how these loot keys work?
translation: Bu ganimet anahtarlarinin calisma seklini degistirebilir miyim?

english: Turn loot keys off
Turn loot keys on
Drop food to floor
Send food to loot key
Drop valuables to floor
Send valuables to loot key
Change valuable item threshold
How much loot have I claimed?
Who are you, exactly?
Goodbye.
Hello.
Eating me... they keep eating me! Eating me from the inside! Please stop them! I can feel them wriggling around inside me right now... please stop them!
translation: Beni yiyorlar... Beni yemeye devam ediyorlar! Beni icimden yiyorlar! Lütfen onlari durdurun! Su anda icimde kivrildiklarini hissedebiliyorum... Lütfen onlari durdurun!

english: Hi.
Blood, blood... never enough blood to go round. When I lift up my arm like this, it all pours back into my body.
translation: Kan, kan... Asla yeterli kan yok. Kolumu böyle kaldirdigimda, hepsi vücuduma geri akiyor.

english: I hope it remembers to go back inside my arm. And don't even ask me about my legs... how much blood are they going to need?
translation: Umarim koluma geri dönmeyi unutmaz. Bacaklarimdan bahsetmeyin bile... Ne kadar kana ihtiyaclari olacak?

english: Blood is important. We must offer it to Zamorak every day as proof of our devotion. I just hope I don't run out!
translation: Kan önemlidir. Zamorak'a bagliligimizin kaniti olarak her gün ona kan sunmaliyiz. Umarim kanim bitmez!

english: Hello, are you okay?
Oh yes, you're a fine one. Nice red cheeks, shiny hair.
translation: Oh evet, sen cok güzelsin. Güzel kirmizi yanaklar, parlak saclar.

english: Let's see now, some potatoes, some cabbage... Maybe half a clove of garlic...
translation: Bir bakalim, biraz patates, biraz lahana... Belki yarim dis sarimsak...

english: Yes I think you'd make a fine soup. You don't mind do you?
translation: Evet, bence güzel bir corba olursun. Sakincasi yok, degil mi?

english: Actually I do.
You're welcome to have some with me of course...
Hello there.
Mwaarrr fnnntchh. Gbpp dng sktd delp?
translation: Mwaarrr fnnntchh. Gbpp dng sktd delp?

english: Pardon?
Kjp lar falut: Gbpp dng sktd delp?
translation: Kjp lar falut: Gbpp dng sktd delp?

english: Sorry, I don't under..
Mwaarrr fnnntchh. Gbpp dng sktd delp? GBPP DNG SKTD DELP!
translation: Mwaarrr fnnntchh. Gbpp dng sktd delp? GBPP DNG SKTD DELP!

english: Hello...
Kill the villagers, burn them all... every last one! I want nothing to survive... nothing but the sweet smell of burning flesh...
translation: Köylüleri öldürün, hepsini yakin... sonuncusuna kadar! Hicbir seyin hayatta kalmasini istemiyorum... sadece yanan etin tatli kokusu disinda...

english: You're ill!
What's that? You've never smelt it before? Well, let's just say that it's an acquired taste...
translation: Ne? Daha önce hic koklamadin mi? Sey, diyelim ki bu aliskanlik gerektiren bir tat...

english: Danger, everywhere danger! But not from man nor beast! This is the danger that is inside you.
translation: Tehlike, her yerde tehlike! Ama ne insandan ne de hayvandan! Bu tehlike senin icinde.

english: Bring it out, nurture it, cherish it. Stroke it like you would stroke a wounded bird... then strangle it before it takes hold of your very being. Don't say I didn't warn you.
translation: Onu ortaya cikar, besle, deger ver. Yarali bir kusu oksar gibi oksa... sonra senin varligini ele gecirmeden onu bog. Beni uyarmadin deme.

english: What's that... Is that a dagger I see before me? Why should I bear the slings and arrows of outrageous fortune.
translation: O ne... Önümde bir hancer mi görüyorum? Neden bu cilgin kaderin oklarini ve taslarini cekeyim ki?

english: For what is a man but this quintessence of dust? And so I say goodnight sweet prince. The rest is silence.
translation: Insan, tozun özünden baska nedir ki? Ve ben de iyi geceler tatli prens diyorum. Gerisi sessizlik.

english: Hello. Are you here for my black dragons?
translation: Merhaba. Kara ejderhalarim icin mi geldin?

english: I have a Slayer assignment to kill those, yes.
translation: Onlari öldürmek icin Slayer görevi aldim, evet.

english: Fair enough. Do what you have to do.
They're not my Slayer target.
Oh, good. In that case you're welcome to go and admire them, but don't get any ideas about killing them.
translation: Oh, iyi. O halde gidip onlari hayranlikla seyredebilirsin, ama onlari öldürmek gibi bir fikre kapilma.

english: Why are you here asking about that?
Because I like my black dragons, and I had to work hard to get access to their lair, and I don't want people using them for training without a reason.
translation: Cünkü siyah ejderhalarimi seviyorum ve onlarin yuvasina girmek icin cok ugrastim ve insanlarin onlari sebepsiz yere egitim icin kullanmasini istemiyorum.

english: So if one of the Slayer Masters sent you to slay black dragons, that's fine, but otherwise you should go and train elsewhere.
translation: Yani Avci Ustalarindan biri seni siyah ejderhalari öldürmen icin gönderdiyse sorun yok, ama aksi takdirde gidip baska bir yerde egitim almalisin.

english: I'd rather people didn't train on my dragons at all, but I've got a distant cousin who's a Slayer Master, so I've got to support the family business.
translation: Insanlarin ejderhalarimla hic antrenman yapmamasini tercih ederim, ama uzak bir kuzenim Slayer Ustasi oldugu icin aile isini desteklemem gerekiyor.

english: Excuse me, I've got to go.
Hey, go and train somewhere else! I'm not having people mess with my dragons unless a Slayer Master's told them to do it.
translation: Hey, gidip baska bir yerde antrenman yap! Slayer Ustasi söylemedikce, insanlarin ejderhalarimla ugrasmasina izin vermiyorum.

english: I have a Slayer assignment to kill those, yes.
translation: Evet, onlari öldürmek icin bir Slayer görevi aldim.

english: They're not my Slayer target.
Why are you here asking about that?
Excuse me, I've got to go.
Ah don' talk to humans! Yous wanna talk, talk to da boss!
translation: Insanlarla konusma! Konusmak istiyorsan patronla konus!

english: He's too busy playing some succulent beats to stop and talk.
translation: O, lezzetli ritimler calmakla mesgul, durup konusacak zamani yok.

english: Ahhh, hello there, [player name].
Can you tell me a bit about skillcapes?
translation: Skillcapes hakkinda biraz bilgi verebilir misiniz?

english: Sure. You can buy a skillcape when you reach level 99 in a skill. Apart from boosting your statistics in that skill, they can also be used to perform some pretty amazing emotes!
translation: Tabii. Bir beceride 99. seviyeye ulastiginizda skillcape satin alabilirsiniz. Bu becerideki istatistiklerinizi artirmanin yani sira, oldukca etkileyici emote'lar yapmak icin de kullanilabilirler!

english: The Cape of Strength also provides you with unlimited teleports to our guild. Is there anything else you would like to know?
translation: Cape of Strength ayrica guildimize sinirsiz teleport imkani saglar. Baska bilmek istediginiz bir sey var mi?

english: What can I do here?
Ahh, the shot put is a great test of strength and can be quite rewarding. Mind you do it properly though, you might want to dust your hands with some powdery substance first. It'll give better grip.
translation: Ahh, gülle atma gücü test etmek icin harika bir spor ve oldukca tatmin edici olabilir. Ancak dogru sekilde yaptiginizdan emin olun, önce ellerinize biraz tozlu bir madde sürmek isteyebilirsiniz. Böylece daha iyi tutus saglar.

english: I'll remember that. What should I use?
I personally prefer ground ashes, it makes a nice fine powder and gives some really good grip.
translation: Ben sahsen ögütülmüs külü tercih ederim, güzel bir toz olusturur ve gercekten iyi tutus saglar.

english: Ok, what else?
Basically you'll need to go in there, make sure you've got nothing cluttering up your hands, pick up a shot and throw it.... depending upon your technique, you can get quite long throws.
translation: Temel olarak oraya gitmelisin, ellerinde hicbir seyin olmadigini kontrol et, bir gülle al ve firlat... Teknigine bagli olarak, oldukca uzun atislar yapabilirsin.

english: What was your best?
Ahh that would be telling...
That's a big axe!
Yes indeed it is. Have to be mighty strong to wield it too.
translation: Evet, gercekten öyle. Onu kullanmak icin cok güclü olmak gerekir.

english: But you don't look that strong!
Maybe, maybe not, but I still had to beat a Barbarian to get it. Mind you, usually they don't part with them. This was an unusual circumstance.
translation: Belki, belki de degil, ama yine de onu almak icin bir barbari yenmek zorunda kaldim. Unutma, genellikle onlardan ayrilmazlar. Bu olagandisi bir durumdu.

english: Oh?
I bet him he couldn't catch a squirrel whilst still holding his axe but that I could... and that if I won I'd get his axe.
translation: Ona, baltasini tutarken bir sincap yakalayamayacagina, ama benim yakalayabilecegime dair iddiaya girdim... ve kazanirsam baltasini alacaktim.

english: What happened?

He went running after the squirrel... nearly caught it too... it shot up a tree and he tried to climb up it, only got a bit tangled up with his axe cause he couldn't hang on to it at the same time... he fell out of the tree and it
translation: Sincabi kovalamaya basladi... neredeyse yakaliyordu da... sincap bir agaca tirmandi ve o da agaca tirmanmaya calisti, ama baltasini tutamadigi icin baltasi agaca takildi... agactan düstü ve sira bana geldi...

english: was my turn....

I simply went and chopped the tree down with this big old axe, still holding it. The squirrel was so petrified it simply jumped straight out of the tree onto me, I won the axe and let the poor creature go!
translation: Ben de gidip bu büyük eski baltayla agaci kestim, hala baltayi tutuyordum. Sincap o kadar korkmustu ki, agactan atlayip bana dogru geldi, ben baltayi kazandim ve zavalli yaratigi serbest biraktim!

english: I sense a moral in there somewhere.
translation: Bunda bir ders var gibi geliyor bana.

english: Aye indeed. Brawn isn't all you need to wield a big axe, brains are required too!
translation: Evet, kesinlikle. Büyük bir baltayi kullanmak icin sadece kas gücü yetmez, zeka da gerekir!

english: May I claim my tokens please?
I'm afraid you have not earned any tokens yet. Try some of the activities around the guild to earn some.
translation: Korkarim henüz jeton kazanmadiniz. Jeton kazanmak icin guild cevresindeki etkinliklerden bazilarini deneyin.

english: Ok, I'll go see what I can find.
You don't have space to carry them.
Of course! Here you go, you've earned [amount] tokens!
Thanks!
Bye!
Be well, warrior [player name].
Ah, but I can see you are already as strong as is possible! Perhaps you have come to me to purchase a Cape of Strength, and thus join the elite few who have mastered this exacting skill?
translation: Ah, ama görüyorum ki zaten olabildigince güclüsün! Belki de bana Güc Pelerini satin almak icin geldin ve böylece bu zorlu beceriyi ustalasmis seckin birkac kisiye katilmak istiyorsun?

english: As an additional recognition of your achievement, the Cape of Strength can teleport you to our guild.
translation: Basarini takdir etmek icin, Güc Pelerini seni guildimize isinlayabilir.

english: May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: Pelerinim icin baska bir baslik alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: You don't appear to have enough space in your inventory, come back and see me when you do.
translation: Envanterinde yeterince yer yok gibi görünüyor, yer acildiginda tekrar gelip beni gör.

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
May I buy a Skillcape of Strength, please?
translation: Güc Pelerini satin alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: Hmm, yes, you certainly look strong enough. That'll be 99000 gold coins, please.
translation: Hmm, evet, kesinlikle yeterince güclü görünüyorsun. 99.000 altin lütfen.

english: Sorry, that's just too much to pay.
Not at all; there are many other adventurers who would love the opportunity to purchase such a prestigious item! You can find me here if you change your mind.
translation: Hic de degil; böyle prestijli bir ürünü satin alma firsatini kacirmak istemeyen bircok maceraci var! Fikrini degistirirsen beni burada bulabilirsin.

english: Sure.
But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: Ama maalesef yanimda yeterince param yok.

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.
translation: Peki, paran oldugunda tekrar gelip beni gör.

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: Maalesef tüm Skillcapes sadece ücretsiz bir baslik ile satiliyor, bu bir beceri promosyonunun parcasi; bir alana bir bedava, bilirsin. Yani sana bir tane satabilmem icin önce envanterinde yer acman gerekiyor.

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: Harika! O pelerini gururla giy dostum.

english: Can you tell me a bit about skillcapes?
translation: Bana Skillcapes hakkinda biraz bilgi verebilir misin?

english: What can I do here?
That's a big axe!
May I claim my tokens please?
Bye!
May I buy a Skillcape of Strength, please?
translation: Güc Skillcape satin alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: Skillcape
Hood
Sorry, that's just too much to pay.
Sure.
Hello.
Hello.
Not very talkative are you?
Nope.
I'll be off then.
Yup.
The blue fish leap northwards at dawn..
translation: Mavi baliklar safakta kuzeye dogru atlarlar.

english: Oranges are not the only fruit.
The cabbages bloom in the spring.
My cows produce milk in the evening.
I bought an aardvark from Ardougne market.
Yellow balloons are heavier in boxes.
...err...sprockets wangle burps in the forked flan.
You have no idea what you are talking about do you?
No, not really.
It rains frogs during the Winter in Neitiznot.
(continues with "Oranges are not the only fruit")
translation: (“Portakallar tek meyve degildir” ile devam eder)

english: Free stuff please.
Ah, Operative Budgie. Welcome to the island.
translation: Ah, Ajan Budgie. Adaya hos geldin.

english: Budgie? That's not my name, you can call me-
translation: Budgie mi? Bu benim adim degil, bana söyle diyebilirsin...

english: Shh!
No names! Names are unnecessary. Loose lives cost tongues.
translation: Isim yok! Isimler gereksizdir. Dikkatsiz yasamlar diline mal olur.

english: Shouldn't that be...never mind. So Mr Hemli-
translation: Bu... bos ver. Peki Bay Hemli...

english: Shhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!
Sorry, no names. I forgot.
Call me Operative Nighthawk.
How come you get the cool name, and I get called Budgie? Can't I be called Operative Panther? Yeah I like that, panthers are cool. Rarrrr!
translation: Nasil oluyor da sen havali bir isim aliyorsun da bana Budgie diyorlar? Ben de Operatif Panther olamaz miyim? Evet, bunu sevdim, panterler havalidir. Rarrrr!

english: This is not a democracy, Operative! Panther already exists and he's working on a mission in Al Kharid. It's my way or the highway.
translation: Burasi demokrasi degil, Operatif! Panther zaten var ve Al Kharid'de bir görevde calisiyor. Ya benim dedigim olur ya da gider.

english: Fine, whatever, I don't care anyway.
To business. Here are the details of your operation. You will infiltrate Burgher Burowgar's hall, deep undercover as a travelling entertainer. Burgher Burowgar and his men are known to relax in the
translation: Ise bakalim. Iste operasyonunun detaylari. Burgher Burowgar'in salonuna, gezgin bir eglenceci kiligina girerek sizacaksin. Burgher Burowgar ve adamlari, bir soytari ve birkac fici bira esliginde rahatladiklari bilinir.

english: presence of a jester - and a few barrels of beer. To get the information required from the court of Burgher Burowgar you must entertain him.
translation: Burgher Burowgar'in sarayindan gerekli bilgileri almak icin onu eglendirmelisin.

english: While you are obeying the Burgher's instructions you should listen in on the conversations of his council and make note of what they discuss.
translation: Burgher'in talimatlarina uyarken, konseyinin konusmalarini dinlemeli ve tartistiklari konulari not almalisin.

english: When you return I shall ask you a few questions about what you have learned.
translation: Döndügünde, ögrendiklerin hakkinda sana birkac soru soracagim.

english: Very well.
You must wear all four pieces of the jester costume without anything in your hands, as the Burgher's guards will search you thoroughly.
translation: Burgher'in muhafizlari seni iyice arayacaklari icin, elinde hicbir sey olmadan dört parcali soytari kostümünü giymelisin.

english: Are you ready to begin?
I am ready.
Not dressed like that you're not! You'd better get the rest of your kit, or empty your hands if you have anything in them.
translation: O kiyafetle olmaz! Kalan parcalari da giyin ya da elinde bir sey varsa bosalt.

english: I just need to visit the bank.
Hurry back; we must know what Neitiznot's ruler is planning.
translation: Cabuk dön, Neitiznot'un hükümdarinin planlarini ögrenmeliyiz.

english: I shall return soon.
Colourless green ideas sleep furiously.
Have you infiltrated the Burgher's leisure quarters?
Not yet. I'll do that now.
Shhh. Go away. I'm not allowed to talk to you.
translation: Sss. Git buradan. Seninle konusmam yasak.

english: Fine, whatever ...
The blue fish leap northwards at dawn.
translation: Mavi baliklar safakta kuzeye dogru atlar.

english: It rains frogs during the Winter in Neitiznot.
Free stuff please.
I am ready.
I just need to visit the bank.
Colourless green ideas sleep furiously.
Hi there.
Hey, ids me matesh!
Sorry, have we met?
Yeah! you wazsh wiv me in dat pub overy by hill!
translation: Evet! Sen benimle tepedeki o barda birlikteydin!

english: I have no idea what you're going on about.
Glad yeeash remembers.
Doh ray meeee laa doh faaa!
translation: Doh ray meeee laa doh faaa!

english: La la la! Do di dum dii!
translation: La la la! Do di dum dii!

english: Hello there. What are you doing here?
I'm waiting here hoping that someone can guide me to the Paterdomus, the temple on the Salve.
translation: Biri beni Salve'deki Paterdomus tapinagina götürür diye burada bekliyorum.

english: Where is Paterdomus?
Oh, Paterdomus is that rather impressive looking temple on the Salve... I'm sure you must have passed it on your way into Morytania.
translation: Paterdomus, Salve'deki oldukca etkileyici bir tapinak... Morytania'ya giderken oradan gecmis olmalisin.

english: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
I'm hoping to get back to civilisation and see what the lands of Misthalin look like.
translation: Medeniyete geri dönüp Misthalin topraklarinin nasil bir yer oldugunu görmek istiyorum.

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Paterdomus?
translation: Paterdomus'a giderken düsmanlarla karsilasirsak kendini savunabilir misin?

english: What sort of guide are you? I'm pretty healthy, but you'll have to protect me else I'll be sure to die... Oh, I do hope you can manage that.
translation: Ne tür bir rehbersin sen? Sagligim oldukca iyi ama beni korumak zorundasin, yoksa kesinlikle ölecegim... Oh, umarim bunu basarabilirsin.

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: Hmmm, görünüse göre bir takipcin var. Bu yolculukta kendi basina dolasirsa kaybolabilir. Takipcin güvende oldugunda yola cikalim.

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: Oh, gercekten mi? Bu harika olur! Hedefe vardigimizda sana kücük bir ödül verecegim.

english: Ok, which route should we take?
Ok, thanks.
Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: Ah, bana biraz erzak vermek istiyorsun, ha? Sirt cantami acayim.

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than staying in Burgh de Rott.
translation: Oh, bu yolculuktan nefret ediyorum, ama Burgh de Rott'ta kalmaktan iyidir.

english: It's scary here...let's get going!
When are we going to get to Paterdomus?
We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on.
translation: Bütün gün burada durup sohbet edemeyiz, hadi devam edelim.

english: Do you visit Paterdomus often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: Paterdomus'a sik sik gider misin? Rotayi iyi biliyorsun gibi görünüyor.

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...?
Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Burgh de Rott. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: Hay aksi! Görünüse göre Burgh de Rott'a geri dönmek zorunda kalacagiz. O köprüden gecemeyiz!

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
Player completes the bridge event
Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Burgh de Rott.
translation: Bu is bitti... Görünüse göre bu batakliktan gecemeyecegiz. Burgh de Rott'a geri dönmek zorundayiz.

english: Player completes the bog event
Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: Hey... bu harika... harika bir is cikardin... Seni takip edecegim.

english: Whahay...that was great!
But we really should be heading off now.
Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
Player completes the river event
That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: Bu harika! Ben de aynisini yapmaliyim.

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: Vay canina! Harikaydi! Ama artik gercekten yola cikmaliyiz.

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
This is scary!
Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
Ahhh, two tentacles!
...three tentacles!
I think I'm going to faint!
Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: Vay canina! Su canavara bak! Bu isi kendi basina halletmen gerekecek!

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the temple. Here's your reward.
translation: Beni tapinaga güvenle ulastirdigin icin cok tesekkürler. Iste ödülün.

english: Smiddi Ryak gives you a reward token!
translation: Smiddi Ryak sana bir ödül jetonu veriyor!

english: Where is Paterdomus?
Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
I can take you to Paterdomus.
Ok, thanks.
Hello!
Arr? Be ye wantin' te go on account with our gang o' fillibusters?
translation: Ne? Bizim korsan cetesine katilmak mi istiyorsun?

english: The powder monkey be takin' a caulk after gettin' rowdy on bumboo, so there be plenty of room for ye.
translation: Barut maymunu, bambuda gürültü yaptiktan sonra uykuya daldi, yani sana yer var.

english: Riiiiight...
I'll just be over here if you need me.
Yer standin' in me light stranger. Can I sell ye somethin' that'll make ye move?
translation: Isigimi kapatiyorsun yabanci. Seni hareket ettirecek bir sey satabilir miyim?

english: Probably, let's see what you have.
I doubt it.
Then move on stranger.
translation: O zaman yoluna devam et yabanci.

english: That depends on if you have any cutlasses.
translation: Elinde kilic varsa, o zaman olabilir.

english: Cutlasses! Think yer a pirate now [lad/lass]?
Well, yes.
Well, I have some cutlasses.
I have Brass Hand Harry's Cutlass. Well, a load of them to be honest.
translation: Brass Hand Harry'nin Kilici var. Aslinda, bir sürü var.

english: Then there's Unlucky Jenkins' Lucky Cutlass. Lovely blade that.
translation: Bir de Unlucky Jenkins'in Sansli Kilici var. Cok güzel bir kilic.

english: I've also got Gentleman Mallard's Rapier. Not a cutlass I know, but the finest blade ever wielded by a privateer.
translation: Ayrica Gentleman Mallard'in Rapier'i de var. Kilicin degil, ama bir korsan tarafindan kullanilan en iyi kilic.

english: Now, which would ye like to hear about?
Brass Hand Harry's Cutlass.
A good choice!
Ye may end up meeting Brass Hand Harry if ye hang around long enough.
translation: Yeterince uzun süre burada kalirsan, Brass Hand Harry ile tanisabilirsin.

english: He lost his left arm to a canister round, but that didn't stop him much.
translation: Sol kolunu bir top mermisiyle kaybetmis, ama bu onu pek durdurmamis.

english: Then he lost his right hand at the wrist fightin' the excise men off the coast of Karamja.
translation: Sonra Karamja kiyilarinda vergi memurlariyla savasirken sag elini bileginden kaybetmis.

english: Not bein' the sort to lie about mopin', he asked me to make him a cutlass with a brass gauntlet fixed to the handle, and rig it up with a load of straps so he could keep fightin'.
translation: Mizmizlanacak biri olmadigi icin, sapina pirinc eldiven takili bir kilic yapmami ve savasmaya devam edebilmesi icin bir sürü kayis takmami istedi.

english: He's a great man is Harry, but he keeps snappin' the straps while he's at sea, so he sells the cutlasses back to me in exchange for a new one.
translation: Harry harika bir adamdir, ama denizdeyken kayislari sürekli kopariyor, bu yüzden kiliclari bana geri satip yenisini aliyor.

english: It's quite a good blade, but the big, brass gauntlet is what makes it worthwhile. It's big enough to fit over even a real gauntlet, so ye get extra protection to yer sword hand.
translation: Oldukca iyi bir kilic, ama asil degerli kilan büyük pirinc eldiveni. Gercek bir eldivene bile sigacak kadar büyük, böylece kilic elinize ekstra koruma sagliyor.

english: I can sell ye one fer 1040 coins.
Interested?
Yes.
Smart [lad/lass]! Come and see me when ye have the coins fer it.
translation: Akilli ! Paran oldugunda gel beni gör.

english: Here ye go. I've got a load of these left over if ye need more.
translation: Al bakalim. Daha fazlasina ihtiyacin olursa, bunlardan bir sürü var.

english: No.
Well I'll still be here if ye change yer mind.
translation: Fikrini degistirirsen, ben hala burada olacagim.

english: Unlucky Jenkins' Lucky Cutlass.
Arr, tis a sad tale to this sword.
Jenkins was the lookout on the Jonah, a cursed vessel if there ever was one.
translation: Jenkins, lanetli bir gemi olan Jonah'in gözcüsüydü.

english: One day his ship were attacked by another group of pirates durin' a fierce storm. One of their bowmen took a shot at the Cap'n of the vessel, but it were deflected off his compass and hit Jenkins in the back.
translation: Bir gün, siddetli bir firtina sirasinda gemisi baska bir korsan grubu tarafindan saldiriya ugradi. Onlarin okcularindan biri geminin kaptanina ok atti, ama ok pusuladan sekip Jenkins'in sirtina isabet etti.

english: How unlucky!
That weren't the worst of it [lad/lass]. He survived the fight, and the ship's surgeon was trying to get the arrow out when...
translation: En kötüsü bu degildi . Savastan sag kurtuldu ve geminin cerrahi oku cikarmaya calisirken...

english: Are ye familiar with the spell bones to bananas?
Yes, why?
Well, due to a blow to the head he took in the fight, the surgeon cast that spell, thinking it was some sort of new healing spell.
translation: Savasta basina aldigi darbe nedeniyle cerrah, bunun yeni bir sifa büyüsü oldugunu düsünerek bu büyüyü yapti.

english: And he did so while touching Jenkins' ribs.
translation: Ve bunu Jenkins'in kaburgalarina dokunarak yapti.

english: And that killed him?
No [lad/lass]!
See, he survived, his bones turned to bananas, as a huge storm blew up and the crew debated what to do with him.
translation: Gördügün gibi, hayatta kaldi, kemikleri muzlara dönüstü, büyük bir firtina cikti ve mürettebat onunla ne yapacaklarini tartisti.

english: But you see, the storm was actually the tail end of a hurricane that had swept the nearby jungle islands, and when it approached the ship it petered out, droppin' all manner of strange things onto the deck and into the
translation: Ama görüyorsun, firtina aslinda yakindaki orman adalarini süpüren bir kasirganin son kismiydi ve gemiye yaklastiginda zayifladi, güverteye ve okyanusa her türlü garip seyi düsürdü.

english: ocean.
The worst part was when the ship was bombarded with ravenous, hunger-crazed monkeys, the majority of which landed on Jenkins as he lay recoverin'.
translation: En kötüsü, geminin acliktan cildirmis maymunlar tarafindan bombardimana tutulmasiydi ve bunlarin cogu, Jenkins'in üzerinde yatarken üzerine düstü.

english: See, what happened next, after the monkeys had had their way with him was...
translation: Sonra, maymunlar onunla istediklerini yaptiktan sonra olan sey...

english: Look, I don't want to hear any more. Why would I want to buy his cutlass?
translation: Bak, daha fazla dinlemek istemiyorum. Neden onun kilicini almak isteyeyim ki?

english: Well, after the poor man passed on...
In a final, terrifying, mashed potato coated tragedy...
translation: Sonunda, korkunc, patates püresi kapli bir trajedi yasandi...

english: His shipmates found his cutlass was completely untouched.
translation: Gemideki arkadaslari, kilicinin tamamen dokunulmamis oldugunu gördüler.

english: See, having been exposed to all the bad luck that Jenkins went through, the thing is unlikely to ever see anything that bad again.
translation: Görüyorsunuz, Jenkins'in basina gelen tüm kötü sanslara maruz kaldigi icin, bu kilicin bir daha bu kadar kötü bir sey görmesi pek olasi degil.

english: Hence, it must be lucky.
Ye can have it fer 2560 coins.
Here ye go. I hope it brings you luck.
translation: Alin bakalim. Umarim size sans getirir.

english: Gentleman Mallard's Rapier.
Well, I'll tell ye the story, but it'll take a great deal of convincin' for me to sell you this rapier.
translation: Size hikayesini anlatacagim, ama bu rapier'i size satmam icin sizi ikna etmek cok zor olacak.

english: See, gentleman Mallard is a legend in these parts. His family had been rich, shipping all sorts of goods up and down the coast.
translation: Beyefendi Mallard bu bölgede bir efsanedir. Ailesi zengindi ve kiyi boyunca her türlü mali naklediyordu.

english: Then their rivals got together and had their ships sunk, one after the other, and his business partners were all either bought off or had...accidents.
translation: Sonra rakipleri bir araya gelip gemilerini birbiri ardina batirdilar ve is ortaklarinin hepsi ya satin alindi ya da... kazalar gecirdi.

english: With no money and only one ship left, he took to the life of a pirate, but no brigand was he.
translation: Parasi kalmamis ve tek bir gemisi kalmis olan adam, korsan hayatina atildi, ama o bir haydut degildi.

english: He took only from those men that had brought about his downfall, was fair with his men, and generous with his loot.
translation: Sadece onun düsüsüne neden olan adamlardan caldi, adamlarina adil davrandi ve ganimetini cömertce paylastirdi.

english: Why, this island would have been wiped out by the shakes if he hadn't turned over his stash to buy medicine.
translation: Eger zulalarini ilac almak icin satmasaydi, bu ada depremlerle yok olacakti.

english: One day his ship was attacked by a huge sea creature that swept the decks of men with its tentacles.
translation: Bir gün gemisi, tentakülleriyle güvertedeki adamlari süpüren devasa bir deniz canavari tarafindan saldiriya ugradi.

english: The crew took to the lifeboats, and the last they saw of him the gentleman was stabbin' at the thing as it hauled the ship under the water.
translation: Mürettebat cankurtaran botlarina bindi ve onu son gördüklerinde, beyefendi gemiyi suya ceken canavari bicakliyordu.

english: A week later about ten foot of tentacle washed up on the beach, with his rapier embedded in it to the hilt.
translation: Bir hafta sonra, yaklasik üc metrelik bir tentacle sahile vurdu ve icinde kilici sapina kadar saplanmisti.

english: I took it, cleaned it up, and I've been lookin' after it ever since.
translation: Onu aldim, temizledim ve o zamandan beri ona bakiyorum.

english: I can't let it go for less than 25600 coins, and even then that's a bargain.
translation: 25.600 sikeden azina satamam, o da zaten cok ucuz.

english: Ye think ye have what it takes to wield it?
translation: Onu kullanacak kadar yetenekli oldugunu mu düsünüyorsun?

english: I hope yer worthy enough to wield this, stranger. I'd hate te think Gentleman Mallard would be disappointed in me fer sellin' it to ye.
translation: Umarim bunu kullanacak kadar layik birisin, yabanci. Beyefendi Mallard'in bunu sana sattigim icin benden hayal kirikligina ugramasini istemem.

english: Probably, let's see what you have.
I doubt it.
That depends on if you have any cutlasses.
Brass Hand Harry's Cutlass.
Yes.
No.
Unlucky Jenkins' Lucky Cutlass.
