Can you teach me the basics of smelting please?
translation: Bana eritmenin temellerini ögretir misin lütfen?

english: You'll need to have mined some ore to smelt first. Go see the mining tutor to the south if you're not sure how to do this.
translation: Önce eritmek icin biraz cevher cikarmalisin. Nasil yapilacagini bilmiyorsan güneydeki madencilik ögretmenine git.

english: I see you have some ore with you to smelt, so let's get started.
translation: Görüyorum ki eritmek icin biraz cevherin var, hadi baslayalim.

english: Click on the furnace to bring up a menu of metal bars you can try to make from your ore.
translation: Firini tiklayarak cevherinden yapabilecegin metal cubuklarin menüsünü ac.

english: When you have a full inventory, take it to the bank, you can find it on the roof of the castle in Lumbridge.
translation: Envanterin doldugunda, onu bankaya götür. Banka, Lumbridge'deki kalenin catisinda bulunur.

english: If you have a hammer with you, you can smith the bronze bars into equipment on the anvil outside.
translation: Yaninda cekic varsa, bronz cubuklari disaridaki örs üzerinde ekipman haline getirebilirsin.

english: I'm afraid the weather over the years has rusted it down, so it can only be used to work bronze.
translation: Maalesef, yillar boyunca hava kosullari nedeniyle paslanmis, bu yüzden sadece bronz islemek icin kullanilabilir.

english: Alternatively you can run up to Varrock. Look for my Master, the Smithing Tutor, in the west of the city, he can help you smith better gear.
translation: Alternatif olarak Varrock'a gidebilirsiniz. Sehrin batisinda bulunan ustam, Demircilik Ögretmeni'ni bulun, o size daha iyi ekipmanlar dövmenize yardimci olabilir.

english: I already know about the basics of smelting, got any tips?
translation: Eritmenin temellerini zaten biliyorum, herhangi bir ipucunuz var mi?

english: I find it useful to stockpile my ore before smelting it in one go, or even do it on the way to the bank in such places as Al Kharid or Falador. But you can do it anyway you want, one load at a time is fine too!
translation: Cevherimi eritmeden önce stoklamak veya Al Kharid veya Falador gibi yerlerde bankaya giderken eritmek faydali oluyor. Ama istedigin gibi yapabilirsin, tek seferde bir yük de olur!

english: Not too much can go wrong with smelting.
You will lose some iron when smelting that ore, but a Ring of Forging or the Superheat Item spell will soon solve that.
translation: Cevheri eritirken biraz demir kaybedersin, ama Ring of Forging veya Superheat Item büyüsü bu sorunu cabucak cözer.

english: You should also investigate Keldagrim, the dwarven city, you may find better places to smelt your ore with friends.
translation: Cüce sehri Keldagrim'i de arastirmalisin, arkadaslarinla cevherini eritmek icin daha iyi yerler bulabilirsin.

english: What do I do after smelting the ore?
Ahh you'll need to learn to smith. Go to Varrock, that's where my master, the Smithing Tutor, plies his trade. Ask him to teach you how to smith.
translation: Ahh, demircilik ögrenmen gerekecek. Varrock'a git, ustam Demircilik Ögretmeni orada calisiyor. Ondan demircilik ögretmesini iste.

english: Smelt some ore and store it in the bank. Grab a hammer from the general store before you go too!
translation: Biraz cevher erit ve bankada sakla. Gitmeden önce genel magazadan bir cekic al!

english: Are you here to make juniper charcoal?
translation: Ardic kömürü yapmak icin mi buradasin?

english: Tell me about juniper charcoal.
They use it in the blast mine, out near Lovakengj. It's powerful stuff, more volatile than the regular charcoal you get elsewhere.
translation: Lovakengj yakinlarindaki patlayici madeninde kullaniyorlar. Cok güclü bir malzeme, baska yerlerde bulunan normal kömürden daha ucucu.

english: To make juniper charcoal, put some juniper logs in my furnaces, then set them alight. I'll keep an eye on it for a fee of 600 coins.
translation: Ardic kömürü yapmak icin firinlarima ardic kütükleri koy ve atese ver. 600 sikke karsiliginda göz kulak olurum.

english: Tell me about yourself.
Juniper charcoal is my trade, always has been, ever since my mum taught me. She's retired now, and returned to Lovakengj - that's where we're from.
translation: Ardic kömürü benim meslegim, annem bana ögrettiginden beri hep öyle oldu. Annem artik emekli oldu ve Lovakengj'e döndü, orasi bizim memleketimiz.

english: I just live out here in the Hosidius farmlands because it's handy for the juniper trees.
translation: Ben sadece ardic agaclarina yakin oldugu icin Hosidius tarim arazilerinde yasiyorum.

english: What can you do for me?
For a small fee, I watch the charcoal furnace so that you can make charcoal here. Also, I do a great back- rub, if you're ever in the mood.
translation: Kücük bir ücret karsiliginda kömür firinini gözetirim, böylece burada kömür yapabilirsin. Ayrica, canin isterse harika sirt masaji da yaparim.

english: Have you got a spare tinderbox?
Yup, but I'll keep it for someone who needs it.
translation: Evet, ama ihtiyaci olan biri icin saklayacagim.

english: Yup, but you can't hold it.
Sure, you can have it.
I'll be off.
Tell me about juniper charcoal.
Tell me about yourself.
What can you do for me?
Have you got a spare tinderbox?
I'll be off.
Are you safe to keep as a pet?
Yes, human.
So where's the fire?
I don't have a fire.
No smoke without fire!
Please stop, human.
So you don't cause lung disease?
We're safe if you don't inhale.
Good to know.
So you don't leave soot everywhere?
Would you defecate on the floor like a camel? Neither would I. So no, I do not leave soot everywhere.
translation: Deve gibi yere diski yapar misin? Ben de yapmam. Yani hayir, her yere is birakmam.

english: That's nice of you.
Never mind.
Your kind comes in three different sizes?
translation: Senin türün üc farkli boyutta mi?

english: Four, actually.
Wow. Whoever created you wasn't very creative. You're just resized versions of one another!
translation: Vay canina. Seni yaratan kisi pek yaratici degilmis. Birbirinizin boyutlari degistirilmis halleri gibisiniz!

english: Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
*slap*
Skrrr!
Kssss!
Hissss!
So where's the fire?
So you don't cause lung disease?
So you don't leave soot everywhere?
Never mind.
Hello!
Hello?
Hey!
Smokin' Joe ignores you.
Hi! What are you doing?
Isn't it obvious?
No, not really.
Bluaaghhaha! Ahem. Sorry.
I'm trying to smoke these pesky rats out. Ahem-hem-hem.
translation: Bu sinir bozucu fareleri dumanla disari cikarmaya calisiyorum. Ahem-hem-hem.

english: Are you alright?
I'll - ugh - I'll be fine, youngin'. My lungs just aren't up for ratcatchin' like they used to be.
translation: Ben... ugh... Iyiyim, genc adam. Akcigerlerim eskisi gibi fare avlamaya uygun degil.

english: Bluaaghhaha!
Ratcatching, you say?
I could help you. I'm young-ish and my lungs are doing fine so far.
translation: Sana yardim edebilirim. Ben genc sayilirim ve akcigerlerim su ana kadar iyi durumda.

english: That's-
Bluaaaghhaha!
-kind of you, youngin'.
What's up with your lungs anyway?
Years of blowin' smoke into rat holes, youngin'.
translation: Yillarca fare deliklerine duman üfledim, genc adam.

english: Oh dear. Speaking of rats...
You offered to help me out.
That's right! Me and my cat have been learning from the best of the best.
translation: Dogru! Ben ve kedim en iyilerden ögrendik.

english: The Sisters Grime, Jimmy Dazzler, Hooknosed Jack...
translation: Grime Kardesler, Jimmy Dazzler, Hooknosed Jack...

english: Blimey, that's my old crew! How are they all?
translation: Vay canina, bunlar benim eski ekibim! Hepsi nasil?

english: Better now that I've helped them out, I think.
translation: Onlara yardim ettigim icin simdi daha iyiler, sanirim.

english: Now, how should I get rid of these rats?
translation: Peki, bu sicanlari nasil yok edebilirim?

english: That's sim-
bluaaghhaha...
simple. Take this pot, light the contents, and blow the smoke into the hole.
translation: basit. Bu tencereyi al, icindekileri yak ve dumani delige üfle.

english: Er... this pot specifically?
Aye, this pot. What's wrong with it?
It's a bit... phlegmy...
You'd better make your own then. A-hem-hem.
Just take a simple pot and stick some ordinary garden weeds in it. Then light the pot and use it on a rat hole.
translation: Basit bir tencere al ve icine siradan bahce otlari koy. Sonra tencereyi yak ve fare deligine kullan.

english: Great. I'll get to it.
Have you got that job done yet, youngin'?
No, not yet.
How's your cough?
Aheeh - hoo.
Better with you helpin' me out, youngin'.
translation: Senin yardiminla daha iyi, genc adam.

english: Say, when the job's done, how about I show you to the Rat Pits here in Keldagrim?
translation: Is bittiginde, sana Keldagrim'deki Fare Cukurlarini göstersem nasil olur?

english: That seems a fair deal. But I'd appreciate any pointers you could give me.
translation: Bu adil bir anlasma gibi görünüyor. Ama bana verebilecegin her türlü ipucu icin minnettar olurum.

english: An extra pair of eyes or set of claws can often come in handy.
translation: Ekstra bir cift göz veya pence genellikle ise yarayabilir.

english: Do you have any more straightforward hints?
Bluaaaghhaha! Hurk-!
Never mind, I'll figure it out!
I got the rats.
Well good - ahem - good show.
I'd better show you our rat pits here in Keldagrim.
Great stuff. Let's go.
They're nice, but the ones they have in Port Sarim are even better.
translation: Güzel yerler ama Port Sarim'dekiler daha da iyi.

english: They have rat pits in Port Sarim?
translation: Port Sarim'de fare cukurlari mi var?

english: Oh yes! It's the best place to train your wily cat.
translation: Evet! Kurnaz kedini egitmek icin en iyi yer orasi.

english: Wily cats?
Well, I suppose there's no harm tellin' you.
translation: Sanirim sana söylemenin bir zarari yok.

english: A-hem!
Look for 'The Face' in Port Sarim. She'll show you.
translation: Port Sarim'de “The Face”i ara. O sana gösterir.

english: So where are the Keldagrim rat pits then?
Down the stairs to the basement of the 'Laughing Miner'. Get yourself a drink, too, you've earned it.
translation: “Laughing Miner”in bodrumuna inen merdivenlerden asagida. Kendine bir icki de al, hak ettin.

english: Can you tell me where I could find Phingspet and Grimesquit?
Ah, the sisters Grime, as strange a pair as you're ever likely to meet.
translation: Ah, Grime kardesler, karsilasabilecegin en tuhaf ikili.

english: You'll find them in the sewers of Varrock.
Can you tell me where I could find Jimmy Dazzler?
Ah, young Jimmy, he must be a made man by now.
translation: Ah, genc Jimmy, simdiye kadar basarili olmus olmali.

english: I remember when he was a lad...
Do you remember where to find him, too?
translation: Onu nerede bulabilecegimi de hatirliyor musun?

english: Hrmph! His old waterin' hole was the Flying Horse in Ardougne.
translation: Hrmph! Eskiden Ardougne'daki Flying Horse'da takilirdi.

english: Can you tell me where I could find Hooknosed Jack?
translation: Hooknosed Jack'i nerede bulabilecegimi söyleyebilir misin?

english: That old brawler? Is he still knockin' about?
translation: O yasli kavgaci mi? Hala ortalikta dolasiyor mu?

english: Well, your best bet would be somewhere on the east side of Varrock. It's rough around there though, be careful.
translation: En iyi ihtimalle Varrock'un dogu tarafinda bir yerlerde olabilir. Orasi biraz tehlikeli bir yer, dikkatli ol.

english: Can you tell me where I could find 'The Face'?
translation: The Face'i nerede bulabilecegimi söyleyebilir misin?

english: You'll find her in Port Sarim.
Can you tell me where I could find Felkrash?
Ah, the boss herself. You'll probably find her in the Port Sarim rat pits.
translation: Ah, patronun kendisi. Onu muhtemelen Port Sarim'deki fare cukurlarinda bulabilirsin.

english: Can you tell me more about the pits?
translation: Cukurlar hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Here take this, you might find it useful.
What do you want to know?
Do you have any pointers for me and my cat?
translation: Bana ve kedime verebileceginiz herhangi bir tavsiye var mi?

english: You should wear an Amulet of Catspeak. It will allow you to organise tactics with your cat.
translation: Kedi Dili Tilsimi takmalisiniz. Bu, kedinizle taktikler belirlemenizi saglayacaktir.

english: What would be the best tactic to adopt then?
translation: O zaman en iyi taktik ne olur?

english: Well, that depends on your outlook, whether you're ready to risk your cat's life or not and how defensive or aggressive you want your cat to be.
translation: Bu, bakis aciniza, kedinizin hayatini riske atmaya hazir olup olmadiginiza ve kedinizin ne kadar savunmaci veya saldirgan olmasini istediginize baglidir.

english: I will not risk my cat's life.
Well if that's the case then you're left with two choices.
You can adopt an ultra defensive strategy, which increases your cat's hitpoints and defence but causes it to flee sooner.
translation: Kedinizin can puanini ve savunmasini artiran, ancak daha cabuk kacmasina neden olan ultra savunma stratejisini uygulayabilirsiniz.

english: Or you can adopt a less defensive strategy, which will allow your cat to stay in the pit for longer.
translation: Ya da kedinizin cukurda daha uzun süre kalmasini saglayan, daha az savunma odakli bir strateji uygulayabilirsiniz.

english: I think I would adopt a very defensive strategy
translation: Sanirim cok savunmaci bir strateji benimseyecegim.

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'Just take care of yourself, cat.'
translation: Bu durumda kedinize sunu söylemelisiniz: “Sadece kendine dikkat et, kedi.”

english: Thanks for your help.
Do you have any other questions about the pits?
translation: Cukurlarla ilgili baska sorunuz var mi?

english: No thanks.
I think I would adopt a less defensive strategy.
translation: Sanirim daha az savunmaci bir strateji benimseyecegim.

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'Stay in for as long as you can.'
translation: Bu durumda kedinize sunu söylemelisiniz: “Mümkün oldugunca uzun süre kal.”

english: I am willing to risk my cat, if it increases my chances of victory.
translation: Kazanma sansimi artiracaksa kedimi riske atmaya hazirim.

english: In that case you are left with two choices.
You could go for all out attack which will boost your cat's attack and strength, but weaken it.
translation: Kedinizin saldiri ve gücünü artiracak, ancak onu zayiflatacak tam saldiri stratejisini secebilirsiniz.

english: Or, go for a less aggressive stance, which will increase your cat's strength and attack to a lesser degree, but carries no defensive penalties.

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'Go berserk!'
translation: Bu durumda kedinize sunu söylemelisiniz: “Cilgina dön!”

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'No guts, no glory!'

translation: Kedim cukurlarda antrenman yapmaktan ne gibi faydalar elde eder?

english: It depends on what kind of cat you have.
In the Keldagrim pits, your cat will grow wiser by gaining more experience.
translation: Keldagrim cukurlarinda kediniz daha fazla deneyim kazanarak daha akilli hale gelir.

Down the stairs into the basement of the 'Laughing Miner'. A grand waterin' hole it is. Just look for The Beast, you'll find it.
translation: “Laughing Miner”in bodrumuna inen merdivenlerden asagi. Harika bir su birikintisi var. The Beast'i ararsan bulursun.

How you doing, Smol Heredit?
I'm still disappointed that my father failed against you. I will suffer in humiliation alongside him for the rest of time.
translation: Babamin sana karsi basarisiz olmasina hala üzülüyorum. Onunla birlikte sonsuza kadar utanc icinde yasayacagim.

english: Understandable.
Hello, Smol Heredit.
Mankind's variation frightens me.
The way they saw this universe, their modes of impression, differed so greatly from one another that to read their stories, to know their lives, is to wonder if they were not many species in one.
translation: Bu evreni görme sekilleri, izlenim alma bicimleri birbirinden o kadar farkliydi ki, hikayelerini okumak, hayatlarini bilmek, onlarin tek bir türde bircok tür olup olmadigini merak etmeye neden oluyor.

english: It was as if they had ranged across the actions of a thousand species and taken them for their own.
translation: Sanki binlerce türün eylemlerini kendilerine mal etmislerdi.

english: For nearly two thousand years they dreamed in a creative mania without antecedent.
translation: Neredeyse iki bin yil boyunca, esi benzeri görülmemis bir yaratici cilginlikla hayal kurdular.

english: They looked into the eyes and minds of other species and with their own intellect superseded them.
translation: Diger türlerin gözlerine ve zihinlerine baktilar ve kendi zekalariyla onlari geride biraktilar.

english: They destroyed many, coopted others, and in the space between necessity and carelessness, left some to grow as untended as any species could in the wake of their ubiquity.
translation: Bircogunu yok ettiler, digerlerini kendilerine katip, gereklilik ve dikkatsizlik arasindaki boslukta, bazilarini her türün yapabilecegi gibi, her yerde bulunmalarinin ardindan bakimsiz bir sekilde büyümelerine izin verdiler.

english: They swarmed across the continents and oceans of a Gielinor they called their own, and shattered it into a billion imbricate worlds.
translation: Kendi olarak adlandirdiklari Gielinor'un kitalarina ve okyanuslarina akin ettiler ve onu milyarlarca ic ice gecmis dünyaya parcaladilar.

english: And they were, by the twisted jungles of their slaughterhouses, ruthless and aloof beyond measure.
translation: Ve katliamhanelerinin carpik ormanlarinda, ölcülemeyecek kadar acimasiz ve soguktular.

english: The worst of us.
A superpredator.
A bringer of mass extinction.
All mountains move and all giants are mountains.
translation: Tüm daglar hareket eder ve tüm devler dagdir.

english: We rest upon their shoulders.
The world has grown older, senescent.
We are chimpanzee, we are gorilla, we are orangutan, and we are baboon and more.
translation: Biz sempanzeyiz, goriliz, orangutaniz, babunuz ve daha fazlasiyiz.

english: We are, whether we like it or not, the blood legatees of humanity.
translation: Hosumuza gitse de gitmese de, biz insanligin kan mirascilariyiz.

english: We are the children of men, but our mistakes will not be their mistakes.
translation: Biz insanlarin cocuklariyiz, ama bizim hatalarimiz onlarin hatalari olmayacak.

english: We are telling a story.
We are telling a story of life, of what it means to live together in this universe, with vastly different modes of being, of seeing, of knowing.
translation: Hayatin hikâyesini, bu evrende birlikte yasamanin ne anlama geldigini, cok farkli var olma, görme ve bilme bicimleriyle.

english: Of sharing our own internal worlds with each other and making the universe we live in better for it. The empathy of a mind speaking to another mind, a vastly different mind, and yet each understanding each.
translation: Kendi ic dünyalarimizi birbirimizle paylasmanin ve yasadigimiz evreni bunun icin daha iyi hale getirmenin hikâyesini. Bir zihnin baska bir zihne, cok farkli bir zihne hitap etmesinin empatiyi, ama yine de her birinin birbirini anlamasini.

english: And if not, if the barriers seem too great, then striving to overcome them.
translation: Ve eger degilse, engeller cok büyük görünüyorsa, o zaman onlari asmak icin cabalamayi.

english: Sorrow in what humanity did to this world, in the horrors they unleashed, in their cataclysm of despair, in the tens of thousands of species that will never walk or swim or fly again.
translation: Insanligin bu dünyaya yaptiklarindan, ortaya cikardiklari dehsetten, umutsuzluk felaketinden, bir daha asla yürüyemeyecek, yüzemeyecek veya ucamayacak on binlerce türden duyulan üzüntü.

english: Extinctions abounded in their wake, and yet look now at this sunbright land, at the joys we have brought to it, to have bound the chaotic climate to our will.
translation: Onlarin ardindan yok oluslar yasandi, ama simdi bu günesli topraklara, ona getirdigimiz sevinclere, kaotik iklimi irademize bagladigimiza bakin.

english: To have thought deeply of the future of this world, a sense of respect, of shared reverence for it and all who live within it.
translation: Bu dünyanin gelecegini derinlemesine düsünmüs, ona ve icinde yasayan herkese saygi ve ortak bir hürmet duygusu beslemis olmaktan.

english: We have strung the close sky with life.
Be proud.
And empathy, once limited only to mankind and some few species, now extends across all lands, across all time.
translation: Ve bir zamanlar sadece insanlik ve birkac türle sinirli olan empati, artik tüm topraklara, tüm zamanlara yayiliyor.

english: I'm sorry, but what?!
Gah
Ha!
Hng!
How much did you pay for your ring of stone?
translation: Tas yüzügün icin ne kadar ödedin?

english: What are you talking about?
They're so expensive, but so much fun!
Right...
So why do they call you Zalcano?
Well....
Is it because you're like a vol-
translation: Sen bir vol gibi oldugun icin mi?

english: Don't say it!
Hiss!
Meow!
Rrowl!
Ssss!
Eat stone!
Bow down to me.
Let the pain run through you.
Another contender for the podium!
There's a podium?
Sadly not, I just say that because it sounds cool.
translation: Maalesef yok, sadece kulaga hos geldigi icin söyledim.

english: Let's wait a bit for the other games to finish up.
translation: Diger oyunlar bitene kadar biraz bekleyelim.

english: You wait around in the snow, the temptation to do snow angels is almost unbearable.
translation: Karda beklerken, kar melekleri yapma istegi neredeyse dayanilmaz hale geliyor.

english: Now they are starting to trickle in, the game will start shortly!
translation: Simdi yavas yavas gelmeye basladilar, oyun birazdan baslayacak!

english: Hey, haven't we met before?
No, no, must have been another dwarf, plenty round these parts.
translation: Hayir, hayir, baska bir cüce olmali, buralarda cok var.

english: Hmm... Well I hope you both brought your snow boots, it's going to be carnage.
translation: Hmm... Umarim ikiniz de kar botlarinizi getirmissinizdir, katliam olacak.

english: Pssssst [player name].
PSSSST [player name].
Let's talk strategy, come here.
I don't hear any foul play going on, do I?
No of course not, I'm just playing mind games with poor [player name]. They have no chance.
translation: Tabii ki hayir, sadece zavalli Maceraci ile zihin oyunlari oynuyorum. Hic sanslari yok.

english: You cheeky little...
We are down to our last two finalists.
This calls for one thing and one thing only...
Sudden.
Death.
Snowball.
I'm so very scared of [player name].
Guss waves at you.
The rules are as follows.
You each get one snowball each to throw.
translation: Her biriniz atmak icin birer kar topu alacaksiniz.

english: Whomever get's hit first, is out.
Do you both understand the rules?
Guss?
Yes!
[player name]?
Yes sir.
Coming at you [player name].
Oh no...
What are you playing at dwarf! I haven't even started the countdown.
translation: Ne yapiyorsun cüce! Geri sayima bile baslamadim.

english: My bad... I'm just very eager.
Also, you didn't even go for [player name]. What's that about?
Honestly... I'm just an awful shot.
Could've sworn a dwarf in a previous festive games final did the same thing and knocked me clean out.
translation: Önceki bayram oyunlari finalinde bir cücenin ayni seyi yapip beni tamamen eledigine yemin edebilirim.

english: Then proceeded to sneak into the pub.
Ha, you don't say.
Moving on...
I'll ignore you ever did that.
On the count of three, you will both be able to throw a snowball.
translation: Üc deyince, ikiniz de kar topu atabileceksiniz.

english: One...
Two...
Three!
Snowball!
Is that a golden sn-
translation: O altin bir kar topu mu?

english: Oof!
Wooo!
There we have it folks!
Our Festive Games champion!
Guss...
Mmmmistletoad!
Who are you talking to?
That's not important. You just won the Festive games!
translation: Bu önemli degil. Festival oyunlarini kazandin!

english: Oh my!
I don't know what to say.
You now get access to...
The Nutcracker pub!
Alongside your win, you also get a free plus one to take into the pub with you!
translation: Kazandigin icin, puba yaninda bir kisi daha ücretsiz olarak girebilirsin!

english: Did you hear that [player name]?
[player name] we can go into the pub together!
[player name]...?
Ehem, [player name]...?
Oh dear.
Fancy a pint?
I though't you'd never ask.
You wake up after being dragged into what seems like a pub.
translation: Pub gibi bir yere sürüklendikten sonra uyaniyorsun.

english: Gosh, my head hurts.
I better see how Guss is getting on.
How's it going [player name]?
I'm alright, but I'm rather chilly round this part of the pub.
translation: Iyiyim, ama pub'in bu kismi biraz soguk.

english: You'll get used to it.
Do you enjoy doing all this?
Eh... It's alright I suppose.
You don't really like it then?
It's not that I don't like it, moreso that I'm on a journey of redemption.
translation: Sevmedigimden degil, daha cok kefaret yolculugundayim da ondan.

english: Oh yeah?
I wasn't the most friendly Fremennik before I came here.
translation: Buraya gelmeden önce pek dost canlisi bir Fremennik degildim.

english: I did many awful things...
Shoo-ing away stray dogs.
Sacrificing cats in West Ardougne.
Stealing snow and making my own snowcone business.
translation: Kar caldim ve kendi kar külahi isimi kurdum.

english: The list goes on.
I hope you didn't sell the golden snowballs.
Also... You did WHAT to stray dogs?!
translation: Ayrica... Sokak köpeklerine ne yaptin sen?!

english: Sorry.. I didn't mean to snap. You are on your journey to redeem yourself.
translation: Üzgünüm... Sinirlenmek istemedim. Kendini affettirme yolculugundasin.

english: That I am, [player name]
Tell me about yourself.
Well, there's not much to tell really.
translation: Aslinda anlatacak pek bir sey yok.

english: I used to take part in great big snowball tournaments around Gielinor.
translation: Eskiden Gielinor cevresinde düzenlenen büyük kar topu turnuvalarina katilirdim.

english: I won every single one.
I was unstoppable.
Some might say there was snow stopping you.
translation: Bazilari seni durduranin kar oldugunu söyleyebilir.

english: Oh dear...
I was an awful person back then... Didn't make time for anyone. It was all about winning.
translation: O zamanlar berbat bir insandim... Kimseye zaman ayirmazdim. Tek önemli olan kazanmakti.

english: I missed my pet rock's first birthday, what kind of person does that?
translation: Evcil tasimin ilk dogum gününü kacirdim, ne tür bir insan böyle bir sey yapar?

english: I was a monster...
The last thing I remember before getting this gig with Santa was me trying to help someone.
translation: Noel Baba'nin yaninda bu isi almadan önce hatirladigim son sey, birine yardim etmeye calistigimdi.

english: Apparently I tried to save some Gnome children from a catastrophic avalanche to the north.
translation: Görünüse göre kuzeyde felaket niteliginde bir cigdan bazi Gnome cocuklarini kurtarmaya calismisim.

english: Next thing I knew, I was talking to Santa and he asked me to come to The Nutcracker.
translation: Sonra bir baktim, Noel Baba ile konusuyordum ve bana Findikkiran'a gelmemi söyledi.

english: Wow, so now you're on your journey to be a better person?
translation: Vay canina, simdi daha iyi bir insan olmak icin yolculuga mi ciktin?

english: Yup, though I do get thorough enjoyment watching people being pelted with snowballs.
translation: Evet, ama insanlara kar topu atilmasini izlemekten büyük keyif aliyorum.

english: Happy Holidays!
You too [player name].
Dodge the attack.
Let the ball hit you.
Do you enjoy being a festive game host?
translation: Bayram oyunu sunucusu olmak hosuna gidiyor mu?

english: What's your story?
Happy Holidays!
Thank you for getting our herb patches to work. Now Boulder can grow goutweed for my people, and they are very happy.
translation: Bitki bahcemizi calisir hale getirdigin icin tesekkürler. Artik Boulder halkim icin gut otu yetistirebiliyor ve cok mutlular.

english: Can I have another copy of that book?
translation: O kitabin bir kopyasini daha alabilir miyim?

english: Yes, I have another copy for you.
translation: Evet, senin icin bir kopyam daha var.

english: Thanks.
How are you two doing?
Snowflake an' My Arm very happy. Maybe new herbie patch not da only place where new life gonna be growin' soon!
translation: Snowflake ve My Arm cok mutlu. Belki de yeni bitki tarlasi, yakinda yeni hayatin yeserecegi tek yer olmayacak!

english: Let's not get ahead of ourselves, dear! But the town is thriving; my people are much happier now they are no longer terrified of Father.
translation: Hemen sevinmeyelim canim! Ama kasaba gelisiyor; halkim artik Babamdan korkmadigi icin cok daha mutlu.

english: Dem trolls likin' da goutweed too!
That's nice.
Can you note my basalt for me?
You aren't carrying any basalt.
I'll be off.
You will always be welcome back.
Here, solve this.
My Arm hands you a puzzlebox!
translation: My Arm sana bir bulmaca kutusu uzatiyor!

english: That doesn't look solved to me.
Well done [player name]. Here you go.
You've been given a [new clue/casket]!
Can I have another copy of that book?
translation: O kitabin bir kopyasini daha alabilir miyim?

english: How are you two doing?
Can you note this basalt for me?
translation: Bu bazalti benim icin not alabilir misin?

english: I'll be off.
Kuani! Someone's come to visit the birds!
I've spotted you working hard to help the guild. How would you like a basic quetzal whistle blueprint to help you get back here in the future?
translation: Guild'e yardim etmek icin cok calistigini gördüm. Gelecekte buraya geri dönmene yardimci olacak temel bir quetzal düdügü plani ister misin?

english: I'd love one!
You'll need to use the blueprint to craft a whistle from a willow log. Make sure it works for you. There's no standard size whistle nowadays.
translation: Plani kullanarak sögüt kütügünden bir düdük yapman gerekecek. Sana uygun oldugundan emin ol. Günümüzde standart boyutta düdük yok.

english: When you want to charge your whistle, be sure to bring some of those lovely meats you're gathering up here for the birds. If they eat well you'll get a lot more use out of them!
translation: Düdügünü sarj etmek istediginde, kuslar icin burada topladigin o güzel etlerden biraz getirmeyi unutma. Iyi beslenirlerse, onlardan cok daha fazla faydalanabilirsin!

english: Not right now, thanks.
Who are you?
I'm Pitri, though most of the others call me birdbrain.
translation: Ben Pitri, ama cogu kisi bana kus beyinli der.

english: On account of the...?
The birds, yes. I just feel so at home amongst them... Though I am more partial to cooked food than the raw stuff they get.
translation: Kuslar yüzünden, evet. Onlarin arasinda kendimi cok rahat hissediyorum... Gerci ben onlarin yedigi cig yiyeceklerden cok pismis yiyecekleri tercih ediyorum.

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: Can you teach me about the birds?
translation: Bana kuslar hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Absolutely! Like many in Varlamore, we here at the guild use quetzals to help us move people and reports throughout the entire network of transport nodes.
translation: Tabii ki! Varlamore'daki bircok kisi gibi, biz de guild'de quetzallari kullanarak insanlari ve raporlari tüm ulasim aginda tasiyoruz.

english: We also have these handy quetzal whistles that allow us to call for one to take us back to the guild. They're pretty magical and work at very long ranges.
translation: Ayrica, bizi loncaya geri götürmesi icin cagirmamizi saglayan kullanisli quetzal düdüklerimiz de var. Oldukca sihirli ve cok uzun mesafelerde calisiyorlar.

english: Could I get my hands on one of those whistles?
translation: O düdüklerden bir tane alabilir miyim?

english: Once you've become more settled in with us at the guild, absolutely.
Sure! I have a blueprint set aside for you to grab when you're ready.
translation: Tabii! Hazir oldugunda alabilmen icin bir plan hazirladim.

english: So how do you motivate the birds?
Food, mostly. They're big fans of the raw meats that the hunters bring back with them. I'm worried they may be waiting to eat us, quite honestly!
translation: Cogunlukla yiyecekle. Avcilarin getirdigi cig etleri cok seviyorlar. Acikcasi, bizi yemek icin bekliyor olabileceklerinden endiseleniyorum!

english: Well, they're certainly big enough to try.
Can you recharge my whistle?
Doesn't look like you've got anything I can feed to the birds here. You'll want to get some of the raw meats that the hunters bring back with them.
translation: Burada kuslara verebilecegim bir sey yok gibi görünüyor. Avcilarin getirdigi cig etlerden almalisin.

english: Sure thing!
Looks like the birds are all full for now. Make them work a bit before feeding them again!
translation: Görünüse göre kuslar simdilik doymus. Onlari tekrar beslemeden önce biraz calistir!

english: There you go. Some whistle charges for you!
translation: Al bakalim. Senin icin birkac düdük sarji!

english: How do I get my hands on more whistles?
I can produce another blueprint for you, for a small cost.
translation: Kücük bir ücret karsiliginda sana baska bir plan cizimi yapabilirim.

english: What sort of small cost?
500 coins. These blueprints are my art, and before you say anything, 'exposure' is the last thing I want out here in the savannah.
translation: 500 sikke. Bu plan cizimleri benim sanatim ve sen bir sey söylemeden önce, bu savanada en son istedigim sey “ifsa olmak”.

english: Here you go, one whistle blueprint.
translation: Al bakalim, bir düdük plan cizimi.

english: I'd better be off.
Odd. You don't seem to have a whistle I can recharge.
translation: Tuhaf. Sarj edebilecegim bir düdügün yok gibi görünüyor.

english: Please solve this for me. I have other things to be thinking about.
translation: Lütfen bunu benim icin cöz. Düsünmem gereken baska seyler var.

english: Sorry but you haven't solved the puzzle yet.
Thanks [player name]!
Yes.
No.
Who are you?
Can you teach me about the birds?
translation: Bana kuslar hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Can you recharge my whistle?
How do I get my hands on more whistles?
I'd better be off.
If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: Senin kadar cirkin olsaydim, halka acik yerlerde yüzümü göstermeye cesaret edemezdim!

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: Oh! Sey... Az önce bir tane yedim de ondan!

english: Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: Hayatina deger veriyorsan bir daha benimle konusma!

english: Get lost!
I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: Sana verecek hicbir seyim yok, birak beni rahat, dilenci.

english: Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
translation: Su anda bununla ugrasacak vaktim yok.

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: Senin gibi zavalli bir et yiginiyla konusmak istemiyorum.

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: Cok kötü bir gün... tadini cikar, bitmeden.

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: Eger birini yakalarsan, paylasacagina söz ver.

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
You smell familiar...
Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: Buralarda insan gördün mü? Cok acim.

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: Bana kan tadi seven biri gibi görünüyorsun.

english: Good day to you, my friend.
Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
translation: Kaleye gidip atistirmalik bir seyler yemeye ne dersin?

english: Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: Bana bir dakika izin ver, dislerimde bir sey sikismis...

english: By Ralos, we finally have a worthy challenger.
translation: Ralos adina, sonunda layik bir rakip bulduk.

english: You've torn through multiple waves of combatants and you're still standing. I'm almost impressed.
translation: Bircok savasci dalgasini yendin ve hala ayaktasin. Neredeyse etkilenmisim.

english: Now let's see how you handle a real foe...
translation: Simdi gercek bir düsmanla nasil basa ciktigini görelim...

english: Sol Heredit jumps down from his seat...
You're back so soon? A lesser combatant would've retired in shame after the show you put on last time...
translation: Bu kadar cabuk mu döndün? Daha zayif bir savasci, gecen seferki gösterinden sonra utanc icinde emekli olurdu...

english: But you're clearly different. Let's see what you have this time...
translation: Ama sen acikca farklisin. Bakalim bu sefer ne yapacaksin...

english: What is it they say? Third time's the charm? Let's see if that's true.
translation: Ne derler? Ücüncü seferde sans gelir mi? Bakalim dogru mu.

english: To arms!
You might be an incapable fighter, but at least you're persistent. Shall we?
translation: Yeteneksiz bir savasci olabilirsin, ama en azindan israrcisin. Baslayalim mi?

english: Let's start by testing your footwork.
Not bad. Let's try something else...
translation: Fena degil. Baska bir sey deneyelim...

english: Impressive. Let's see how you handle this...
You can't win!
Ralos guides my hand!
LET'S END THIS!
Sol Heredit doesn't take kindly to your eager prayer.
translation: Sol Heredit, hevesli duani hos karsilamiyor.

english: I'LL BREAK YOURBACK!
I'LL CRUSH YOURBODY!
I'LL TWIST YOURHANDSOFF!
I'LL BREAK YOURLEGS!
I'LL CUT YOURFEETOFF!
Sol Heredit grabs hold of your [body part/item] and deals massive damage!
You defended the wrong body part!
You successfully defend your [body part] from Sol Heredit's grapple!
You perfectly parry Sol Heredit's grapple!
translation: Sol Heredit'in tutusunu mükemmel bir sekilde savusturdun!

english: Your light shines... brightly...
A worthy... opponent...
Ralos has smiled upon you...
My compliments, champion...
How disappointing...
I knew you weren't the one.
You had me excited for a moment.
Your lack of coordination is concerning.
Your light shines no more.
Maybe next time...
Pathetic, really...
I was just getting into my rhythm...
Hello.
Hello.
Are you in charge of this squad?
Yes. We're guarding this entrance against demonic excursions.
translation: Evet. Bu girisi seytani saldirilara karsi koruyoruz.

english: How's that going?
Not super well, I'm afraid. It's a nerve wracking post, and it's taking its toll on my soldiers.
translation: Korkarim pek iyi degil. Sinir bozucu bir görev ve askerlerim üzerinde olumsuz etkiler yaratiyor.

english: Can I do anything to help?
Not in any official capacity. Making any sort of move might spark a chain reaction.
translation: Resmi olarak hayir. Herhangi bir hareket, zincirleme reaksiyonlara neden olabilir.

english: But unofficially...
It would be good to know what's going on down there. If you can handle yourself, and you can keep an eye on the demons, you might be able to help.
translation: Orada neler olup bittigini bilmek iyi olur. Kendinizi idare edebiliyorsaniz ve seytanlari gözetleyebiliyorsaniz, yardimci olabilirsiniz.

english: We just need to know if it looks like they're preparing for anything. But if you do this, you're on your own. If anything happens, I won't be able to send help.
translation: Sadece bir sey hazirladiklari var mi diye bakmamiz gerekiyor. Ama bunu yaparsaniz, kendi basinizasiniz. Bir sey olursa, yardim gönderemem.

english: Understood. Well, if I see anything suspicious, I'll be sure to casually mention it.
translation: Anladim. Süpheli bir sey görürsem, bunu rahatca dile getirecegim.

english: Thank you.
What wrong with your soldiers?
Some of them are afraid, others impatient. That's the biggest problem actually. They're all having different reactions. It's making it difficult to work as a unit.
translation: Bazilari korkuyor, bazilari sabirsiz. Aslinda en büyük sorun bu. Hepsi farkli tepkiler gösteriyor. Bu da bir birim olarak calismayi zorlastiriyor.

english: Do they usually have this problem?
No, they're good soldiers. I suspect it has something to do with those cultists and their little chats.
translation: Hayir, onlar iyi askerlerdir. Sanirim bu, o tarikatcilar ve onlarin kücük sohbetleriyle ilgili bir sey.

english: Not that we can do much about that. We can't afford to initiate hostilities. There's a lot at stake, and I'm honestly not sure we could handle a direct confrontation.
translation: Bu konuda yapabilecegimiz pek bir sey yok. Düsmanlik baslatmayi göze alamayiz. Cok sey söz konusu ve dürüst olmak gerekirse, dogrudan bir catismayi kaldirabilecegimizden emin degilim.

english: That does sound like a difficult situation to be in.
translation: Bu gercekten zor bir durum gibi görünüyor.

english: Goodbye.
Goodbye.
Can I do anything to help?
What's wrong with your soldiers?
Goodbye.
Hello.
What are you doing here?
Not a lot.
That's a big chasm you're standing by.
translation: Yaninda durdugun büyük bir ucurum var.

english: Yep.
What did you think of the coronation?
Pretty good.
That's a nice looking axe. Is it heavy?
Thanks. Not really.
Interested in doing any trading?
I've got everything I need.
I have vital information pertaining to the cult of Yama.
translation: Yama kültüyle ilgili cok önemli bilgilerim var.

english: You should speak to the lieutenant.
That's it!
What?
Why don't you want to talk to me!
I'm confused.
I've been trying to make conversation with you and I feel like I'm getting nowhere.
translation: Seninle sohbet etmeye calisiyorum ama bir yere varamiyorum.

english: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to make you feel that way. I'm not a very chatty person.
translation: Üzgünüm. Seni böyle hissettirmek istemedim. Cok konuskan bir insan degilim.

english: Your feelings are valid, and you deserve to be heard. That said, it might be good to examine your reaction.
translation: Hislerin hakli ve dinlenilmeyi hak ediyorsun. Bununla birlikte, tepkini incelemek iyi olabilir.

english: Thank you. What do you mean?
Would you agree that people aren't under any obligation to talk to anyone else?
translation: Insanlarin baskalariyla konusmak zorunda olmadiklari konusunda hemfikir misin?

english: I suppose so.

Hello.
I've been posted here to guard this chasm.
translation: Bu ucurumu korumak icin buraya atandim.

english: And how's that going?
Not great. There's constant bursts of hot air, demon roars and strange lights coming from inside.
translation: Pek iyi degil. Iceriden sürekli sicak hava patlamalari, iblis kükremeleri ve garip isiklar geliyor.

english: And then there's the cultists. They just climb out like it's normal to be down there. Try to talk to you like it's business as usual.
translation: Bir de tarikat üyeleri var. Sanki orada olmak normalmis gibi tirmaniyorlar. Sanki her sey normalmis gibi seninle konusmaya calisiyorlar.

english: That does sound stressful.
How long are you posted here?
translation: Ne kadar süre burada görevli kalacaksin?

english: Indefinitely. We don't know what the cult is up to and we don't want to be caught unprepared.
translation: Sonsuza kadar. Tarikatin neyin pesinde oldugunu bilmiyoruz ve hazirliksiz yakalanmak istemiyoruz.

english: Have you considered quitting?
No. I signed up to to protect Kourend, even if that means standing outside of a demon nest. Besides, it's not like any demons have come out of it yet.
translation: Hayir. Kourend'i korumak icin bu göreve yazildim, bu seytan yuvasinin disinda beklemek anlamina gelse bile. Ayrica, henüz hicbir seytan disari cikmadi.

english: Well, good luck.
Thanks.
What do you want? Are you with those cultists?
translation: Ne istiyorsun? O tarikatcilarla mi birliktesin?

english: What? No.
Good. I've had enough of their games.
Games? What do you mean?
They start off polite, but before you know it, they're trying to get you to agree to something.
translation: Baslangicta kibar davraniyorlar, ama farkina varmadan seni bir seye ikna etmeye calisiyorlar.

english: They're not fooling me though. The next one that crosses me is going to regret it!
translation: Ama beni kandiramazlar. Bir daha yoluma cikan olursa pisman olacak!

english: About the cultists... What sort of things do they ask you to agree to?
translation: Kültcüler hakkinda... Seni ne tür seylere ikna etmeye calisiyorlar?

english: Usually they want you to follow them somewhere private. Some of the bolder ones try to get you to join them inside the chasm.
translation: Genellikle seni özel bir yere götürmek istiyorlar. Cesur olanlar ise seni ucurumun icine katilmaya ikna etmeye calisiyor.

english: If it were up to me, we'd launch a sortie right now. See how they like it if we come down on our own terms.
translation: Bana kalsaydi, hemen bir saldiri baslatirdim. Kendi sartlarimizla saldirirsak nasil tepki vereceklerini görürdük.

english: Aren't you worried about the demons?
You sound like the lieutenant.
You sound eager to fight.
I am. If you ask me we should be out fighting lizardmen. That means we need to go on the offensive and wrap this chasm business up.
translation: Öyleyim. Bana sorarsan, kertenkele adamlarla savasmaliyiz. Bu da saldiriya gecip bu ucurum meselesini halletmemiz gerektigi anlamina geliyor.

english: I take it the rest of your squad aren't as keen.
translation: Anladigim kadariyla takiminin geri kalani senin kadar hevesli degil.

english: You'd be right. The lieutenant is too cautious and the rest are too timid. The way some of them speak you'd think they had demon families.
translation: Haklisin. Tegmen cok temkinli, geri kalanlar ise cok cekingen. Bazilarinin konusma tarzina bakilirsa seytan aileleri varmis gibi sanirsin.

english: If you see any cultists lurking around, let me know.
translation: Etrafta gizlenen kültistler görürsen bana haber ver.

english: You look comfortable.
I might as well be if we're going to continue this performance.
translation: Bu oyunu sürdürecekseniz, rahat olsam da olur.

english: What do you mean?
There are no demons coming out of this chasm. If there were, we wouldn't last long.
translation: Bu ucurumdan seytanlar cikmiyor. Cikarsa, uzun süre dayanamayiz.

english: You think the demons would overrun you?
translation: Seytanlarin sizi ele gecirecegini mi düsünüyorsunuz?

english: Demons don't die the same way we do. We could hold back a few of them, but not an endless stream.
translation: Seytanlar bizim gibi ölmez. Birkacini durdurabiliriz, ama sonsuz bir akini durduramayiz.

english: You seem to know a lot about them.
translation: Onlar hakkinda cok sey biliyorsunuz galiba.

english: I do, which means I know that guarding the chasm is a pointless endeavour. Not that the lieutenant cares what I think.
translation: Evet, bu yüzden ucurumu korumak anlamsiz bir caba oldugunu biliyorum. Tegmen benim düsüncelerimi umursamiyor ama.

english: Launching an attack into the chasm would also be pointless. That leaves us with only one other option.
translation: Ucuruma saldirmak da anlamsiz olur. Bu durumda tek bir secenek kaliyor.

english: Fleeing?
No. We should talk to them. Try to reach an understanding.
translation: Hayir. Onlarla konusmaliyiz. Anlasmaya varmaya calismaliyiz.

english: Somehow I don't think negotiating with demons will end well.
translation: Seytanlarla pazarlik yapmanin iyi sonuclanacagini sanmiyorum.

english: If you have a better idea, go ahead.
translation: Daha iyi bir fikrin varsa, söyle.

english: Aren't you a bit too calm about this?
translation: Bu konuda biraz fazla sakin degil misin?

english: No. If they wanted to, Yama and his demons could overrun this little squad.
translation: Hayir. Eger isteselerdi, Yama ve iblisleri bu kücük ekibi kolayca yok edebilirdi.

english: The fact they haven't means they're probably not interested in doing so. As a matter of fact, they seem quite polite.
translation: Bunu yapmamis olmalari, muhtemelen böyle bir niyetleri olmadigi anlamina gelir. Aslinda, oldukca kibar görünüyorlar.

english: You've spoken to them?
I didn't say that, But there's evidence to suggest that Yama and his cult can be reasoned with.
translation: Öyle demedim, ama Yama ve tarikatinin mantikli davranabilecegine dair kanitlar var.

english: If Lord Shayzien is interested in diffusing the threat, he should consider trying to reach an agreement with them.
translation: Lord Shayzien bu tehdidi ortadan kaldirmak istiyorsa, onlarla bir anlasmaya varmayi düsünmelidir.

english: I've met Lord Shayzien. He doesn't seem like the type to compromise.

english: You've met Lord Shiro Shayzien?

english: Yes, I've met the leaders of all of the houses. Even King Artur Hosidius himself.
translation: Evet, tüm hanelerin liderleriyle tanistim. Hatta Kral Artur Hosidius ile bile.

english: I imagine he's quite busy at the moment.

translation: Zirhimin bir parcasi icin benimle dövüsmeyi umuyorsan, önce 4. seviye zirhin tam setine sahip olmalisin. Astimla dövüsmeyi dene.

english: Fancy a fight? The combat practice would be good for me. I'll give you a piece of my armour if you win.
translation: Dövüsmek ister misin? Savas pratigi bana iyi gelir. Kazanirsan zirhimin bir parcasini sana veririm.

english: Sure, let's fight.
To the arena!
No thanks.
I'll be here if you ever change your mind. I love a good fight.
translation: Fikrini degistirirsen ben buradayim. Iyi bir dövüsü severim.

english: Fancy another fight? The combat practice is good for me. I'll give you some more of my armour if you win.
translation: Bir dövüs daha ister misin? Savas pratigi bana iyi gelir. Kazanirsan zirhimin bir parcasini daha sana veririm.

english: Don't you already have a set of my armour?
translation: Zirhimin bir parcasini zaten almadin mi?

english: Let's fight again - I don't mind duplicates.
translation: Tekrar dövüselim, aynisindan olsa da umurumda degil.

english: Okay, I guess I needn't fight you again.
translation: Tamam, sanirim seninle tekrar dövüsmeme gerek yok.

english: I'll be here if you ever change your mind.
Focus on your fight!
Don't expect me to deal with the likes of you.
You do not have enough Shayzien favour. Current favour: [current favour in %] - Required: 100.0%
Sure, let's fight.
No thanks.
Let's fight again - I don't mind duplicates.
translation: Tekrar dövüselim - aynisi olsa da umurumda degil.

english: Okay, I guess I needn't fight you again.
translation: Tamam, sanirim seninle tekrar dövüsmeme gerek yok.

english: Would you like to buy or sell some food?
translation: Yiyecek satin almak veya satmak ister misin?

english: Yes, please.
No, thanks.
Yes, please.
No, thanks.
Can you hear me?
Of course! I'm wearing an amulet of ghostspeak.
translation: Tabii ki! Hayalet konusma tilsimi takiyorum.

english: ...I can, but I'm not wearing an amulet of ghostspeak... A-am I dead?
translation: ...Duyabiliyorum, ama hayalet konusma tilsimi takmiyorum... Ö-Öldüm mü?

english: ...I can. Are you a ghost?
I'm no ghost! I'm a spirit, I'm injecting my thoughts into your head.
translation: Hayalet degilim! Ben bir ruhum, düsüncelerimi kafana enjekte ediyorum.

english: Oh, that's... interesting. Also rather disturbing...
translation: Oh, bu... ilginc. Ayrica oldukca rahatsiz edici...

english: Try not to think about it.
Could you imbue my sceptre?
Of course I can... But first, you must show me whatever treasure lies within that cradle and make sure that your account is safe.
translation: Tabii ki yapabilirim... Ama önce, o besigin icindeki hazineyi bana göster ve hesabinin güvenli oldugundan emin olmalisin.

english: Is my account safe?
To make sure your account is secured, please turn on the authenticator. Simply visit the support link on the oldschool.runescape.com website.
translation: Hesabinin güvenli oldugundan emin olmak icin lütfen kimlik dogrulayiciyi ac. Oldschool.runescape.com web sitesindeki destek baglantisini ziyaret etmen yeterli.

english: Oh, that sounds like a great idea, I'll go do that.
translation: Oh, bu harika bir fikir, gidip yapayim.

english: It seems you have the authenticator set up, that's perfect! Now just show me the treasure.
translation: Kimlik dogrulayiciyi kurmussunuz, harika! Simdi bana hazineyi gösterin.

english: Is this the treasure?
Oh marvellous! If only I had corporeal form I'd be able to wear them, but alas...
translation: Oh, muhtesem! Keske maddi bir bedenim olsaydi, onlari takabilirdim, ama ne yazik ki...

english: So could you imbue my sceptre?
It seems your account isn't as secure as it could be, I'm afraid I can't imbue your sceptre.
translation: Hesabiniz olmasi gerektigi kadar güvenli degil gibi görünüyor, ne yazik ki asaniza güc katamam.

english: Oh.
Of course, of course! In fact if you have more than one I'll imbue all of them!
translation: Tabii, tabii! Aslinda birden fazla varsa hepsine güc katarim!

english: There you go, now that I've imbued all of your sceptres, once they run out of charges they will no longer break and they can be charged with any piece of the sceptre you find.
translation: Iste oldu, tüm asalarina güc kattim, sarjlari bittiginde artik kirilmayacaklar ve buldugunuz herhangi bir asa parcasiyla sarj edilebilecekler.

english: Thank you very much! How many charges does each piece give?
translation: Cok tesekkür ederim! Her parca kac sarj sagliyor?

english: Most of them give 3, although the left skull gives 5. Each completed tier of the Varrock achievement diary will get you one extra charge per piece and allow your sceptre to hold 4 more charges.
translation: Cogu 3 sarj sagliyor, ancak sol kafatasi 5 sarj sagliyor. Varrock basari günlügünün tamamlanan her seviyesi, parca basina bir ekstra sarj saglar ve asanin 4 sarj daha tutmasini saglar.

english: You can use a chisel to break a sceptre piece into fragments, then use those to charge the sceptre instead. More flexible if you ask me.
translation: Bir keski kullanarak asa parcasini parcalara ayirabilir, ardindan bunlari asayi sarj etmek icin kullanabilirsiniz. Bana sorarsaniz daha esnek bir yöntem.

english: Finally, be warned that if you disable your authenticator, the imbue on the sceptre will be removed.
translation: Son olarak, kimlik dogrulayicinizi devre disi birakirsaniz, asanin üzerindeki güc kaldirilacaktir.

english: Fantastic! It's best I keep my authenticator activated then. Good byeSolztun!
translation: Harika! O zaman kimlik dogrulayicimi etkin tutsam iyi olur. Hosca kal Solztun!

english: Stay safe, adventurer.
Who are you?
As I said, I am Solztun, the greatest barbarian explorer! I came to explore this place, but unfortunately I died long before I made it to the treasure.
translation: Dedigim gibi, ben Solztun, en büyük barbar kasif! Burayi kesfetmeye geldim, ama ne yazik ki hazineye ulasamadan cok önce öldüm.

english: Nobody came to help?!
Oh no, they had no idea I was hurt, I guess they assumed I'd found the treasure and made a new life for myself.
translation: Hayir, yaralandigimi bilmiyorlardi, sanirim hazineyi buldugumu ve yeni bir hayat kurdugumu düsündüler.

english: Were you not a fan of the barbarian life style?
It was all death and pillaging, I prefer the finer things in life, like exploration and discovery!
translation: Her sey ölüm ve yagmalamadan ibaretti, ben kesif ve kesif gibi hayatin daha güzel yanlarini tercih ederim!

english: Ah, I too enjoy those.
Why are you here?
I came for treasure!
Oh right, you were looking for what's in that cradle?
translation: Ah, dogru ya, besikte ne oldugunu mu ariyordun?

english: Yes, but alas, I'm dead.
translation: Evet, ama ne yazik ki öldüm.

english: I guess I could show you... for a price.
translation: Sanirim sana gösterebilirim... bir bedel karsiliginda.

english: Hmm... I don't have much to offer, but if you happen upon a skull sceptre, I could make it stronger.
translation: Hmm... Sunabilecegim pek bir sey yok, ama bir kafatasi asasi bulursan, onu daha güclü hale getirebilirim.

english: Stronger you say... In what way?
translation: Daha güclü mü dedin... Ne sekilde?

english: Currently the sceptre is fragile, it breaks once all charges have been used. Show me the treasure and I could imbue it so it can be recharged with any sceptre piece.
translation: Su anda asa kirilgan, tüm sarjlar bittiginde kiriliyor. Bana hazineyi göster, ben de onu herhangi bir asa parcasiyla sarj edilebilecek sekilde güclendireyim.

english: You, my dead friend, have a deal!
Bye!
No, that's not it.
But I didn't show you anything.
I sense that you don't have the treasure.
Could you imbue my sceptre?
Is my account safe?
Is this the treasure?
Who are you?
Why are you here?
Bye!
Hmm... You're not my usual kind of customer, but I reckon I can still make this work. What will it be? Haircut or a shave?
translation: Hmm... Sen benim normal müsterilerimden degilsin, ama yine de bu isi halledebilirim. Ne olacak? Sac kesimi mi, tiras mi?

english: I'd like a haircut please.
Then let's get to it.
I'd like a shave please.
I'm good, thanks.
Suit yourself.
I'd like a haircut please.
I'd like a shave please.
I'm good, thanks.
Sorry, I can't chat while I'm on duty. I have to keep alert.
translation: Üzgünüm, görev basindayken sohbet edemem. Dikkatli olmam gerekiyor.

english: How can I help you?
What are you doing down here?
We're here to guard the bank and make sure no one tries anything.
translation: Bankayi korumak ve kimsenin bir sey yapmadigindan emin olmak icin buradayiz.

english: Do you have a tinderbox?
I have one I could sell you for 50 coins.
I'll take it.
Actually, I don't seem to have enough money on me.
translation: Aslinda, üzerimde yeterince para yok gibi görünüyor.

english: Sorry, that's too expensive.
No problem. Come back if you change your mind.
translation: Sorun degil. Fikrini degistirirsen geri gel.

english: I do, but I'd like to hold on to it for now.
That's okay; I've one with me anyway.
translation: Sorun degil, zaten benim de bir tane var.

english: Do you have a torch?
I'll sell you an unlit one for 200 coins.
How come you're not spotty?
Ah, the pox. We weren't here when the outbreak took place. We were out of town trying to catch an antiques thief called Simon Templeton. We've only just got back.
translation: Ah, cicek hastaligi. Salgin basladiginda burada degildik. Simon Templeton adinda bir antika hirsizini yakalamak icin sehir disindaydik. Daha yeni döndük.

english: Aren't you afraid you'll fall ill as well?
The only reason we've been let back into the city is because the High Priest believes the pox isn't contagious.
translation: Sehre geri dönmemizin tek nedeni, Basrahibin cicek hastaliginin bulasici olmadigina inanmasi.

english: Besides, Sophanem is my home. It will take a lot more than the threat of a few spots to keep me away.
translation: Ayrica, Sophanem benim evim. Beni uzak tutmak icin birkac sivilceden cok daha fazlasi gerekir.

english: You can't. I'd better go.
Be careful down there!
What are you doing down here?
Do you have a tinderbox?
I'll take it.
Sorry, that's too expensive.
Do you have a torch?
How come you're not spotty?
You can't. I'd better go.
Hello.
You! You're the reason I'm in here.
translation: Sen! Benim burada olmamin sebebi sensin.

english: Yeah... Sorry about that. This is what happens when you make poor life choices though.
translation: Evet... Üzgünüm. Hayatinda kötü secimler yaptiginda böyle olur.

english: I hope you enjoy this moment, it won't last.
translation: Umarim bu anin tadini cikarirsin, uzun sürmeyecek.

english: Soon he will descend on this miserable lands and everything you know will be ash!
translation: Yakinda bu sefil topraklara inecek ve bildigin her sey küle dönüsecek!...

english: Well that just sounds great. See you later.
Who are you and what do you want?
None of your business!
I go where I like and do what I like.
translation: Nereye istersem oraya giderim ve ne istersem onu yaparim.

english: Not in my house. Be gone!
Be gone, intruder!
I'm here to kill you!
I think not!
Can I have some sq'irks please?
What do you want them for?
Someone asked me to bring them some.
Who?
Osman.
In that case I'm sorry, but you can't. I have had a falling out with him recently and would rather not oblige him.
translation: O halde üzgünüm, ama alamazsin. Son zamanlarda onunla aramiz bozuldu ve ona iyilik yapmak istemiyorum.

english: Selim.
In that case I'm sorry, but you can't. I have had a falling out with his master recently and would rather not oblige him.
translation: Öyleyse üzgünüm, ama yapamam. Son zamanlarda onun efendisiyle kavga ettim ve ona iyilik yapmak istemiyorum.

english: I'm just passing by.
None of your business!
I'm here to kill you!
Can I have some sq'irks please?
I'm just passing by.
Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: Hey, bu Kahraman! Vay canina! Sen harikasin, o iki juvinate ve Gadderank'i nasil alt ettin? Ve kasaba cok güzel, harika bir is cikarmissin!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
Not that it makes much difference but my name's Sorin. Like all the other survivors here, I just try to make do and get through each day at a time.
translation: Fark etmez ama benim adim Sorin. Buradaki diger tüm hayatta kalanlar gibi, ben de idare etmeye ve her günü tek tek atlatmaya calisiyorum.

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: Oh, pek bir sey yok, hepimiz hala vampirlerden saklaniyoruz ve bu korkunc yerde gecimimizi sagliyoruz, umarim yakinda Salve'deki tapinaga yolculuk yapacak kadar gücleniriz.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: Bildigim kadariyla yok, su anda cok yararli olan bazi temel olanaklara sahibiz, hepimiz size cok minnettariz. Daha önce hic bir kahraman görmedim veya tanimadim, bu yüzden karsilastirma yapabilecegim bir sey yok, ama sanirim

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: cogu insanin görüsüne göre, siz bir kahramansiniz! Ben sahsen sizinle tanistigima cok memnunum.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Ok, thanks.
I hate this job. All the other staff are so happy all the time. It depresses me.
translation: Bu isi sevmiyorum. Diger calisanlar hep cok mutlu. Bu beni depresyona sokuyor.

english: Why don't you get a new job?
I can't find any other work. I wanted to be a Gnomeball player but I wasn't big enough.
translation: Baska is bulamiyorum. Gnomeball oyuncusu olmak istedim ama yeterince iri degildim.

english: That's a shame. I'd better let you get on with your work.
translation: Cok yazik. Isine devam etsen iyi olur.

english: OK, whatever.
Aren't you going to wish me a nice day?
Have a day. It can be nice if you can be bothered. I know I can't.
translation: Iyi günler. Eger zahmetine girersen iyi olabilir. Ben giremem....

english: ... nice.
Good day.
I have no interest in speaking with you. You should bring your cat to me again. The two of us have much to discuss.
translation: Seninle konusmak istemiyorum. Kedini tekrar bana getirmelisin. Ikimizin konusacak cok seyi var.

english: The Sphinx ignores you.
Ah, how interesting... a cat. Come here to me, kitty.
translation: Ah, ne ilginc... bir kedi. Buraya gel kedicik.

english: Meow.
Your cat and the Sphinx converse in a yeowling language for a short time.
translation: Kediniz ve Sfenks kisa bir süre miyavlayarak konusuyorlar.

english: Do you think that you'll be able to communicate with me at a deeper level because you're wearing that amulet of catspeak?
translation: Kedi dili muskasini taktigin icin benimle daha derin bir düzeyde iletisim kurabilecegini mi saniyorsun?

english: Er, yes?
How very foolish.
So, what do you need human?
What do you need human?
Can you tell me about the gods of the Menaphites?
translation: Menaphitlerin tanrilari hakkinda bana bilgi verebilir misin?

english: If you wish to know about the lesser gods, you should speak with Jex at the Temple of the Lesser Gods. I suppose I could spare a moment or two to tell you about the main four though.
translation: Kücük tanrilar hakkinda bilgi almak istiyorsan, Kücük Tanrilar Tapinagi'ndaki Jex ile konusmalisin. Ama sana dört ana tanri hakkinda bilgi vermek icin bir iki dakika ayirabilirim.

english: Tell me about Tumeken.
Tumeken is the god of light and husband to Elidinis. He is the leading god of the Menaphite Pantheon.
translation: Tumeken, isigin tanrisi ve Elidinis'in kocasidir. Menaphite panteonunun bas tanrisidir.

english: People don't seem to talk about him much. I'd have thought being the leading god would make him more popular.
translation: Insanlar onun hakkinda pek konusmuyor gibi görünüyor. Bas tanri olmasi onu daha popüler yapar diye düsünürdüm.

english: A common saying about Tumeken is that you see him wherever you look, but never actually notice him.
translation: Tumeken hakkinda sikca söylenen bir söz vardir: onu her yerde görürsün, ama aslinda hic fark etmezsin.

english: Okay... And what kind of god is he? The desert is a harsh place, so does that make him harsh as well?
translation: Tamam... Peki o ne tür bir tanridir? Cöl zorlu bir yerdir, bu onu da zorlu yapar mi?

english: In some ways. You humans sometimes say that 'you have to be cruel to be kind'. That seems a fitting way to describe Tumeken.
translation: Bazi yönlerden. Siz insanlar bazen “iyi olmak icin acimasiz olmak gerekir” dersiniz. Bu, Tumeken'i tanimlamak icin uygun bir ifade gibi görünüyor.

english: So he's harsh, but for good reasons?
translation: Yani o zorlu, ama iyi nedenlerden dolayi mi?

english: Indeed.
Tell me about Elidinis.
Elidinis is the goddess of fertility. The River Elid is named in her honour, for it brings life to the whole region.
translation: Elidinis bereket tanricasidir. Elid Nehri, tüm bölgeye hayat verdigi icin onun onuruna bu isimle adlandirilmistir.

english: There are some who even believe the river to be Elidinis herself.
translation: Hatta nehrin Elidinis'in kendisi olduguna inananlar bile vardir.

english: That's an interesting take. I guess being a bringer of life makes her quite popular?
translation: Ilginc bir bakis acisi. Hayat veren biri olmasi onu oldukca popüler yapiyor olmali?

english: More so than many others in the pantheon, but not as much as she once was.
translation: Panteondaki diger tanrilardan daha popüler, ama eskisi kadar degil.

english: Why not?
Humans are fickle. Perhaps they grew bored of her?
translation: Insanlar vefasizdir. Belki de ondan sikildilar?

english: That sounds unlikely.
Well if you're after the human take on things, you'd be better off asking a human.
translation: Eger insanlarin bakis acisini merak ediyorsan, bir insana sorsan daha iyi olur.

english: Tell me about Icthlarin.
Icthlarin is the god of the dead. He is the son of Tumeken and Elidinis, and brother to the Devourer. As this is the city of the dead, he's quite popular here.
translation: Icthlarin, ölülerin tanrisidir. Tumeken ve Elidinis'in oglu ve Yiyici'nin kardesidir. Burasi ölülerin sehri oldugu icin, burada oldukca popülerdir.

english: So are you a follower of Icthlarin?
Nothing of the sort. I have no interest in the gods or their followers. Instead, Icthlarin and I have an understanding.
translation: Hic de degil. Tanrilar veya onlarin takipcileriyle ilgilenmiyorum. Bunun yerine, Icthlarin ve benim bir anlasmamiz var.

english: Cats play a significant role when it comes to guarding the dead from the Devourer. As such, they are great allies to Icthlarin.
translation: Kediler, ölüleri Devourer'dan korumak konusunda önemli bir rol oynar. Bu nedenle, Icthlarin'in büyük müttefikleridir.

english: As a thank you for looking after them, Icthlarin grants me eternal life.
translation: Onlara baktigim icin tesekkür olarak, Icthlarin bana sonsuz yasam bahseder.

english: Tell me about the Devourer.
translation: Yiyici hakkinda bana biraz bilgi ver.

english: I'd have thought you'd be more than familiar with her by now.
translation: Simdiye kadar onu cok iyi tanidigini düsünmüstüm.

english: I'm interested in hearing your take.
Very well. The Devourer is the goddess of destruction. As such, she is commonly considered an evil goddess, but this is an oversimplification.
translation: Peki. Yiyici, yikimin tanricasidir. Bu nedenle, genellikle kötü bir tanrica olarak kabul edilir, ancak bu cok basitlestirilmis bir görüs.

english: How so?
Not everything that destroys is evil. Destruction is often a necessity.
translation: Yok eden her sey kötü degildir. Yikim cogu zaman bir gerekliliktir.

english: Isn't that also an oversimplification? Amascut is doing far more than just destroying. She's a murderer!
translation: Bu da asiri basitlestirme degil mi? Amascut sadece yok etmekle kalmiyor. O bir katil!

english: Is causing death enough to make one evil? Icthlarin is the god of the dead. By your argument, surely he is the most evil of them all.
translation: Ölümüne neden olmak birini kötü yapmaya yeter mi? Icthlarin ölülerin tanrisidir. Senin argümanina göre, o kesinlikle hepsinden daha kötüdür.

english: Icthlarin doesn't actually kill people though. He just looks after those that have died.
translation: Icthlarin aslinda insanlari öldürmez. Sadece ölenlerin ruhlarina bakar.

english: You clearly know little of Icthlarin and his past. Are you aware of the Mahjarrat? They once served Icthlarin, before they left him for Zamorak.
translation: Icthlarin ve gecmisi hakkinda cok az sey biliyorsun. Mahjarrat'i biliyor musun? Bir zamanlar Icthlarin'e hizmet ediyorlardi, sonra Zamorak'a gectiler.

english: Or was it the Empty Lord they left him for... I forget.
translation: Yoksa Empty Lord'a mi gectiler... Unuttum.

english: Regardless, they are a race that have regularly associated themselves with gods considered evil. Interesting company for one such as Icthlarin to keep.
translation: Her neyse, onlar düzenli olarak kötü olarak kabul edilen tanrilarla iliski kuran bir irktir. Icthlarin gibi birinin arkadaslik etmesi ilginc bir durum.

english: How does that make Amascut good though?
translation: Peki bu Amascut'u nasil iyi yapar?

english: I never said it did. I'm just saying that things are often not as straightforward as they seem, especially when it comes to Icthlarin and the Devourer.
translation: Öyle oldugunu hic söylemedim. Sadece, özellikle Icthlarin ve Yiyici söz konusu oldugunda, islerin genellikle göründügü kadar basit olmadigini söylüyorum.

english: If you say so...
Let's talk about something else.
Very well. What do you want to dicuss?
Nothing. I should go.
Do you have a spare amulet of catspeak?
translation: Yedek bir kedi dili muskasi var mi?

english: Well, I suppose I do. Seeing as you're such a good guardian of cats, I'll give you one. Be careful with it, though.
translation: Sanirim var. Kedilerin bu kadar iyi bir koruyucusu olduguna göre, sana bir tane verecegim. Ama ona dikkat et.

english: The Sphinx hands you an amulet of catspeak.
translation: Sfenks sana bir kedi dili muskasi uzatir.

english: Paw-don me, I have something to show mew.
translation: Affedersin, sana gösterecek bir seyim var.

english: Human, you make a mockery of my kin.
translation: Insan, sen benim soyumu alay konusu yapiyorsun.

english: Come on, don't be such a sour puss.
translation: Hadi ama, bu kadar somurtkan olma.

english: You should leave, before I deliver retribution for your actions.
translation: Senin yaptiklarinin cezasini vermeden önce gitmelisin.

english: Can you tell me about the gods of the Menaphites?
translation: Menaphitlerin tanrilari hakkinda bana bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Tell me about Tumeken.
Tell me about Elidinis.
Tell me about Icthlarin.
Tell me about the Devourer.

translation: Bir nesneyi kaybetmek kolaydir, yerine yenisini almak da. Ama Rabbimizin sevgisini kaybetmek affedilemez.

translation: Gercekten, göklerin uzak yerlerini gördügünü hissediyorum.

english: Greetings, brave knight!
Hello. What's through that door?
translation: Merhaba. O kapinin arkasinda ne var?

english: That door leads to the training ground for the Knights of the Round Table.
translation: O kapi Yuvarlak Masa Sövalyeleri'nin egitim alanina aciliyor.

english: Can I go in there?
Of course, my lord. But I must tell you the rules first. Would you like to hear them now?
translation: Elbette, efendim. Ama önce kurallari anlatmaliyim. Simdi dinlemek ister misin?

english: Yes please.
The training ground is a melee combat area only. Merlin has cast a spell over the grounds to prevent anyone using Prayer, Ranged or Magic.
translation: Egitim alani sadece yakin dövüs alanidir. Merlin, bu alanda kimse Dua, Menzilli veya Büyü kullanamasin diye bir büyü yapmistir.

english: Upon entering the grounds, you will fight each of the Round Table Knights in turn. Each knight is more skilled than the last, but all have different attack styles that can be exploited. There are eight knights in all, and
translation: Alana girdiginizde, Yuvarlak Masa Sövalyeleri ile sirayla dövüseceksiniz. Her sövalye bir öncekinden daha yeteneklidir, ancak hepsinin farkli saldiri stilleri vardir ve bunlari kullanabilirsiniz. Toplamda sekiz sövalye vardir ve

english: each will do damage not only to your hitpoints, but also your combat stats. If you should die in the grounds, Merlin will teleport you back here. You will not lose any of your items.
translation: her biri sadece can puaniniza degil, savas istatistiklerinize de zarar verecektir. Eger alanda ölürseniz, Merlin sizi buraya geri isinlayacaktir. Hicbir esyanizi kaybetmeyeceksiniz.

english: If you feel you cannot complete the battle, you may exit the training grounds. However, if you exit or die, you will have to start over with the first knight the next time you enter.
translation: Savasi tamamlayamayacaginizi düsünüyorsaniz, egitim alanindan cikabilirsiniz. Ancak, cikarsaniz veya ölürseniz, bir dahaki sefere girdiginizde ilk sövalyeyle bastan baslamaniz gerekecektir.

english: If you are a great warrior and defeat Sir Lancelot, mightiest of all knights, you will receive great rewards. Two new prayers will become available to you and your respawn point will be set to Camelot, as well as 20,000
translation: Eger büyük bir savasciysaniz ve tüm sövalyelerin en güclüsü olan Sir Lancelot'u yenerseniz, büyük ödüller alacaksiniz. Iki yeni dua kullanabileceksiniz ve yeniden dogma noktaniz Camelot olarak belirlenecek, ayrica her bir savas istatistiginize 20.000

english: XP in to each of your combat stats.
If you do not want your respawn set to Camelot, Merlin can change it for you.
translation: Yeniden dogma noktanizin Camelot olarak belirlenmesini istemiyorsaniz, Merlin bunu sizin icin degistirebilir.

english: Would you like me to repeat any of that for you?
Tell me about the training ground.
Only melee combat is allowed within the training grounds. Merlin will prevent the use of Prayer, Ranged and Magic.
translation: Egitim sahasinda sadece yakin dövüse izin verilir. Merlin, Dua, Menzilli ve Büyü kullanimini engelleyecektir.

english: Why?
These grounds are for only the best knights of the land. It is not just testing your combat ability, but your honour and your chivalry. You must face your enemy head on, honourably and bravely.
translation: Bu alanlar, ülkedeki en iyi sövalyeler icindir. Burada sadece savas yeteneginiz degil, onurunuz ve sövalyeliginiz de sinanir. Düsmaninizla yüz yüze, onurlu ve cesurca karsi karsiya gelmelisiniz.

english: Be watchful of your stats, as the Knights can do damage to your combat stats as well as your hitpoints.
translation: Istatistiklerinize dikkat edin, cünkü Sövalyeler savas istatistiklerinize ve can puanlariniza zarar verebilir.

english: Tell me about dying or leaving the grounds.
translation: Ölüm veya sahadan ayrilma hakkinda bilgi verin.

english: As these are only training grounds, we keep our knights safe. If you should die, you will be teleported back to here and all of your items will be safe.
translation: Burasi sadece bir egitim sahasi oldugu icin sövalyelerimizin güvenligini sagliyoruz. Ölürseniz, buraya geri isinlanacaksiniz ve tüm esyalariniz güvende olacak.

english: However, leaving the training grounds, in anyway, will mean you will have to start from the beginning the next time you enter. These grounds do not favour cowards.
translation: Ancak, egitim sahasindan herhangi bir sekilde ayrilirsaniz, bir dahaki sefere girdiginizde bastan baslamaniz gerekecek. Bu saha korkaklari hos görmez.

english: I have to start again? What do you mean?
translation: Yeniden baslamak zorunda miyim? Ne demek istiyorsunuz?

english: You fight each knight of the Round Table, starting with Sir Bedivere and finishing with Sir Lancelot. Leaving means you will have to begin fighting Sir Bedivere again and work your way back up.
translation: Yuvarlak Masa Sövalyeleri'nin her biriyle savasirsiniz, Sir Bedivere ile baslayip Sir Lancelot ile bitirirsiniz. Ayrilmak, Sir Bedivere ile yeniden savasmaya baslamaniz ve yeniden yolunuzu bulmaniz gerektigi anlamina gelir.

english: What if I log out during the fights?
translation: Savas sirasinda oturumu kapatirsam ne olur?

english: If you log out during a fight, upon logging back in you will fight the knight you were fighting when you logged out.
translation: Savas sirasinda oturumu kapatirsaniz, yeniden oturum actiginizda, oturumu kapattiginizda savastiginiz sövalye ile savasmaya devam edersiniz.

english: Tell me about the rewards.

King Arthur believes in rewarding his knights for their chivalry. Having proven yourself in combat against his knights, and in your services rendered to Camelot, you will be rewarded with two new prayers, and a new
translation: Kral Arthur, sövalyelerinin sövalyeliklerine karsilik ödüllendirilmesine inanir. Sövalyeleriyle savasta kendinizi kanitladiktan ve Camelot'a hizmet ettikten sonra, iki yeni dua ve Camelot'ta yeni bir

english: respawn at Camelot, as well as 20,000 XP in to each of your combat stats.
translation: yeniden dogusun yani sira her bir savas istatistiginize 20.000 XP ile ödüllendirileceksiniz.

english: What do the new prayers do?
Ah, patience is a virtue in knights, my lord. Fight in the training ground and earn your reward to find out!
translation: Ah, sabir sövalyeler icin bir erdemdir, lordum. Egitim alaninda savas ve ödülünü kazanarak ögren!

english: Then tell me about the respawn - how will it work?
translation: O zaman yeniden dogus hakkinda bana bilgi ver - nasil isleyecek?

english: Ah, Merlin has offered, as a reward for your help, to let yourrespawn in the safety of Camelot, should you befall misfortune elsewhere in the world. Should you wish to change your respawn back to Lumbridge, simply
translation: Ah, Merlin, yardimin karsiliginda, dünyanin baska bir yerinde talihsiz bir olayla karsilasirsan, Camelot'un güvenli ortaminda yeniden dogmani teklif etti. Yeniden dogusunu Lumbridge'e geri degistirmek istersen,

english: speak to Merlin.
No, thank you.

translation: Sövalye Dalgalari'nda basarili oldugunuz icin tebrikler, lordum.
