translation: Üzgünüm, ama yapacak cok isim var.

english: Not too bad, but the work is definitely tiring.
translation: Fena degil, ama is kesinlikle yorucu.

english: Well I could do with a good rest, but fine otherwise.
translation: Iyi bir dinlenmeye ihtiyacim var, ama onun disinda iyiyim.

english: What do you want?
I'm Vicks, squire to Sir Culler Flife. He's away on a surveillance mission to Burthorpe, so he sent me down here to do some cleaning.
translation: Ben Vicks, Sir Culler Flife'in sövalyesiyim. O, Burthorpe'a gözetleme görevine gittigi icin beni buraya temizlik yapmam icin gönderdi.

english: Don't tell the knights, but I'm just not in the mood for it! I've served for years, and worked really hard, but they're not even thinking of making me a knight.
translation: Sövalyelere söyleme ama hic havamda degilim! Yillardir hizmet ediyorum ve cok calisiyorum ama beni sövalye yapmayi bile düsünmüyorlar.

english: I don't know what the problem is. At my last review, I heard the examiner muttering something about my name, but I've no idea what he meant by that.
translation: Sorun ne bilmiyorum. Son degerlendirmemde, sinav görevlisinin adimla ilgili bir seyler mirildandigini duydum, ama ne demek istedigini anlamadim.

english: Keeping an eye on those Imperial Guard. We can't trust 'em, you know. But I shouldn't talk about his mission.
translation: Imparatorluk Muhafizlarini gözetle. Onlara güvenemeyiz, biliyorsun. Ama onun görevinden bahsetmemeliyim.

english: Tell me about this place.
This place? It's the castle crypt. The greatest White Knights are buried here, after a lifetime in the service of Saradomin. At least, that's how it used to be.
translation: Burasi mi? Burasi kalenin mezarligi. En büyük Beyaz Sövalyeler, Saradomin'e ömür boyu hizmet ettikten sonra buraya gömülürler. En azindan eskiden öyleydi.

english: When I was a new recruit, they brought me here and told me that if I served Saradomin faithfully, and with distinction, maybe I'd earn the honour of burial in this place too.
translation: Ben yeni askere alindigimda, beni buraya getirdiler ve Saradomin'e sadakatle ve basariyla hizmet edersem, belki ben de buraya gömülme serefine nail olabilecegimi söylediler.

english: But if you think about it, that's never going to happen - there just isn't space for more tombs! Anyway, my plan is to avoid dying, and maybe marry one of the barmaids when I retire.
translation: Ama düsünürsen, bu asla olmayacak - daha fazla mezar icin yer yok! Her neyse, benim planim ölmemek ve emekli oldugumda barmenlerden biriyle evlenmek.

english: What's with the glowing portal thing?
It's because of something the Temple Knights have, called the Gaze of Saradomin. They get the option of being brought to Falador when they die, so Death has to maintain a presence in the area.
translation: Tapinak Sövalyeleri'nin sahip oldugu Saradomin'in Bakisi adli bir sey yüzünden. Öldüklerinde Falador'a götürülme secenegi var, bu yüzden Ölüm bu bölgede varligini sürdürmek zorunda.

english: That portal takes you to Death's own realm. He's got portals in all the places where people go when they die - Lumbridge, Edgeville and the rest. I hate it - the thing's terrifying!
translation: O portal sizi Ölüm'ün kendi alemine götürür. Insanlarin öldüklerinde gittikleri tüm yerlerde portallari var - Lumbridge, Edgeville ve digerleri. Nefret ediyorum - o sey cok korkutucu!

english: I'll leave you alone.

You don't seem to be cleaning much.
What's your master doing in Burthorpe?

translation: Imparatorluk Muhafizlarini gözetliyor, . Onlara güvenemeyiz, biliyorsunuz. Ama onun görevinden bahsetmemeliyim, sizin gibi bir sövalyeye bile.

translation: Yillar icinde düzen oldukca bozuldu, Void Knight'in becerilerini ögrenmek cok uzun bir sürec. Son zamanlarda baska bir yerden bizim alemimize ihlaller oldu ve garip yaratiklar

english: have been pouring through. We can't let that happen, and we'd be very grateful if you'd help us.
translation: akin akin geliyor. Bunun olmasina izin veremeyiz, bize yardim ederseniz cok minnettar oluruz.

english: Sorry, you'll need to speak to one of the Knights about that. I'm just a humble squire with years of training still to undergo!

translation: Bu ada yabancilar tarafindan istila ediliyor ve suradaki Void Knight, portallari yok etmek icin bir ritüel kullaniyor. Void Knight'i ne pahasina olursa olsun savunmaliyiz, ancak firsat bulursaniz portallari kendiniz yok edebilirsiniz.

english: You're already here, human.
Sorry, human, you can't use the Lovakengj Minecart Network. Speak to Miriam, at the main station by the southern Lovakengj bank, if you've got any questions.
translation: Üzgünüm insan, Lovakengj Maden Arabasi Agi'ni kullanamazsin. Sorun varsa, güney Lovakengj kiyisindaki ana istasyonda Miriam ile konus.

english: Sorry, human, the Lovakengj Minecart Network is for citizens of Lovakengj only.
translation: Üzgünüm insan, Lovakengj Maden Arabasi Agi sadece Lovakengj vatandaslari icindir.

english: I've got this control scroll for you.
Thanks, human. I guess it's okay for you to ride my carts after all. So, can I help you?
translation: Tesekkürler insan. Sanirim arabalarimi kullanabilirsin. Peki, yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: Thanks again for bringing me that control scroll. Can I help you today?
translation: Kontrol parsömenini getirdigin icin tekrar tesekkürler. Bugün yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: No thanks, you've already given me one of those.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, zaten bir tane verdin.

english: Can I go for a ride?
I'm fine, thanks.
What is it, human? I'm working.
How do I use the furnace?
Put your ore on the conveyor belt to get it smelted. We'll stoke the boiler and operate the rest of the machinery for you.
translation: Cevherini konveyör bandina koy, eritilsin. Kazani yakip, geri kalan makineleri sizin icin calistiracagiz.

english: You'll have to help repair the furnace whenever a pipe blows, though. Just hit it with a hammer - that usually works.
translation: Ancak, bir boru patladiginda firini onarmaya yardim etmeniz gerekecek. Cekicle vurmaniz yeterli, genellikle ise yarar.

english: You'll have to put money in the coffer to pay for our services. We charge 72,000 coins per hour; money is deducted as long as you're in this room with us.
translation: Hizmetlerimizin bedelini ödemek icin kasaya para koymaniz gerekecek. Saat basina 72.000 sikke aliyoruz; bu odada bizimle birlikte oldugunuz sürece para kesilir.

english: Gosh, you're a remarkably big dwarf.
translation: Vay canina, sen gercekten cok büyük bir cücesin.

english: My brothers and I have a rare genetic condition affecting our growth. Rather than treating us as freaks, you might like to appreciate how useful it is that we can operate the machinery.
translation: Kardeslerim ve ben, büyümemizi etkileyen nadir bir genetik rahatsizliga sahibiz. Bizi ucube olarak görmek yerine, makineleri calistirabilmemizin ne kadar yararli oldugunu takdir etmelisin.

english: Sorry.
That's ok, human. You're not the first to comment on it. Now, did you need anything? I've got work to do here.
translation: Sorun degil, insan. Bu konuda yorum yapan ilk kisi sen degilsin. Simdi, bir seye ihtiyacin var mi? Burada yapmam gereken isler var.

english: Are you sure you're really a dwarf?
... look, do you want help with something, or did you just come here to be rude? I've got work to do.
translation: bak, bir seye yardim mi istiyorsun, yoksa sadece kaba olmak icin mi buraya geldin? Yapacak isim var.

english: I'll let you get on with it.
How do I use the furnace?
Gosh, you're a remarkably big dwarf.
translation: Vay canina, sen gercekten cok büyük bir cücesin.

english: Sorry.
I'll let you get on with it.
Are you sure you're really a dwarf?
translation: Gercekten bir cüce olduguna emin misin?

english: Shhh! I'm waiting for the show!
YOU ARE A TERRIBLE BARD!
Don't give up your day job outerlander!
I thought somebody was murdering a cat!
You know, I actually quite liked that verse...
That's kind of catchy. Irritating. But catchy.
translation: Kulaga hos geliyor. Sinir bozucu ama hos.

english: Hey, I've done that quest too!
translation: Hey, ben de o görevi yaptim!

english: I have produced better sounds in the outhouse!
Your song makes no sense outerlander!
What kind of bard are you anyway?
translation: Sen ne bicim bir ozan sensin?

english: I have met cows more musical than you!
When do you get to the good parts?
would torture us so, outerlander?
translation: Bizi bu kadar iskenceye sokacak misin yabanci?

english: Truly, this is the worst sound I have ever heard!
translation: Gercekten, bu duydugum en kötü ses!

english: looting and drinking part?
Please tell me that was the last verse...
translation: Lütfen bunun son dize oldugunu söyle...

english: Please... Kill me now...
You call THAT singing?
Never before have mine ears been so offended!
translation: Kulaklarim hic bu kadar rahatsiz olmamisti!

english: Worst. Bard. EVER.
Please, ye gods! Make it stop!
If you stopped singing
The screams of my dying comrades sound better!
translation: Ölen arkadaslarimin cigliklari daha iyi geliyor!

english: My grandmother could do better, and she is dead!
translation: Büyükannem bile daha iyisini yapardi, o da öldü!

english: I do such feats before breakfast!
translation: Ben kahvaltidan önce bile böyle seyler yaparim!

english: Is your singing some kind of outerlander weapon?
translation: Sarki söylemen bir tür yabanci silah mi?

english: Look who it is!
Hello again. How are things going?
Amazing! We get paid to eat all day, and our payment is more food. Life has never been better!
translation: Harika! Bütün gün yemek yiyip para aliyoruz, ve ödememiz daha fazla yemek. Hayat hic bu kadar güzel olmamisti!

english: Too right, Gary! This is much better than being on strike!
translation: Cok haklisin Gary! Bu grev yapmaktan cok daha iyi!

english: Glad to hear it.
Welcome to my fishing shop. Are you looking for anything specific?
translation: Balikçilik dükkanima hos geldiniz. Özel bir sey mi ariyorsunuz?

english: Let's see what you have.
translation: Ne var ne yok bir bakalim.

english: I'm good, thanks.
Very well.
Let's see what you have.
translation: Ne var ne yok bir bakalim.

english: I'm good, thanks.
Can you leave me alone please? I'm trying to get a bit of rest.
translation: Beni yalniz birakir misin lütfen? Biraz dinlenmeye calisiyorum.

english: Sorry, I'm busy!
I want some bread!
Yes dad.
I'll be right back.
What's your father want now?
What'll it be, son?
A loaf of bread please.
Thanks.
Cheers.
I need more bread!
I need some silver ore!
What's your father want now?
What'll it be, son?
A piece of silver please.
Only one piece of silver? I need more!
translation: Sadece bir parca gümüs mü? Daha fazlasina ihtiyacim var!

english: I need some new clothes!
What's your father want now?
What'll it be, son?
Some silk please.
These clothes are awful, get me some others!
translation: Bu kiyafetler berbat, bana baska kiyafetler getir!

english: My chisel's gone blunt, buy me one!
translation: Keski körelmis, bana yeni bir tane al!

english: What's your father want now?
What'll it be, son?
A chisel please.
This chisel's rubbish, get me another!
translation: Bu keski cöp, bana baska bir tane getir!

english: Hello there.
I've not seen your face before. Given they let you come down here, I'm assuming you've been allowed to join the Alchemical Society?
translation: Yüzünü daha önce görmedim. Buraya gelmene izin verdiklerine göre, Kimya Dernegi'ne katilmana izin verildigini varsayiyorum?

english: That's right!
Well in that case, just through there is the lab we use to produce potions for the kingdom. However, before you head in and get started, there's a couple of things to note.
translation: Öyleyse, suradan gecerek krallik icin iksir üretmek icin kullandigimiz laboratuvara ulasabilirsin. Ancak, iceri girip ise baslamadan önce dikkat etmen gereken birkac sey var.

english: First, I can see you're not from around here, so I'll point out that Varlamorian Alchemy is a little different from the Druidic Herblore that you'll be familiar with.
translation: Ilk olarak, burali olmadigini görüyorum, bu yüzden Varlamorian Simyasinin, senin asina oldugun Druid Bitki Bilimi'nden biraz farkli oldugunu belirtmek isterim.

english: How so?
We discovered that the majority of herbs in the world can be broken down into three alchemical reagents: Mox, Aga and Lye.
translation: Dünyadaki bitkilerin cogunun üc simya reaktifine ayrilabilecegini kesfettik: Mox, Aga ve Lye.

english: When mixed in the correct way, these three components produce drastically different results. As such, in the lab you will be using these components to create various potions.
translation: Bu üc bilesen dogru sekilde karistirildiginda, cok farkli sonuclar ortaya cikar. Bu nedenle, laboratuvarda bu bilesenleri kullanarak cesitli iksirler hazirlayacaksiniz.

english: What potions do I need to make?
That depends. We get orders in from across the kingdom. You'll need to keep an eye out for what potions are currently desired and ensure you're making the right ones.
translation: Bu duruma göre degisir. Kralligin dört bir yanindan siparisler aliyoruz. Su anda hangi iksirlere talep oldugunu takip etmeli ve dogru iksirleri hazirladiginizdan emin olmalisiniz.

english: Let's do that run through.
Very well... Listen closely.
The scene cuts to each part of the laboratory as they are discussed
translation: Sahne, tartisilan laboratuvarin her bir bölümüne gecer.

english: Start by breaking down herbs or unfinished potions over at theRefiner. This will give you your reagents:Mox,Aga, andLyepaste. The type you get will depend on the quality of what you put in.
translation: Refiner'da bitkileri veya bitmemis iksirleri parcalamakla baslayin. Bu size reaktiflerinizi verecektir: Mox, Aga ve Lyepaste. Elde edeceginiz tür, koydugunuz malzemenin kalitesine bagli olacaktir.

english: Insert the paste into theHopperand it will become available to use in theMixer.
translation: Macunu Hopper'a koyun, böylece Mixer'da kullanima hazir hale gelecektir.

english: From here, you'll need to pull theMixer Leversto create the right combination of reagents.
translation: Buradan, dogru reaktif kombinasyonunu olusturmak icin karistirici kolunu cekmeniz gerekecek.

english: But how do I know what the combinations are?
translation: Ama kombinasyonlarin ne oldugunu nasil bilecegim?

english: I see you've already found our book of lab notes. That'll give you the formulas for our various products.
translation: Görüyorum ki laboratuvar notlari kitabimizi bulmussunuz. Bu kitap size cesitli ürünlerimizin formüllerini verecektir.

english: Have a look on the bookshelf for a book of lab notes. That'll give you the formulas for our various products.
translation: Kitap rafinda laboratuvar notlari kitabini arayin. Bu kitap size cesitli ürünlerimizin formüllerini verecektir.

english: To know what needs making, you'll need to check the order list. There will always be three orders to choose from. You can work on just one or them, or multiple. It's up to you.
translation: Neyin yapilmasi gerektigini ögrenmek icin siparis listesini kontrol etmelisin. Her zaman üc siparis arasindan secim yapabilirsin. Bunlardan sadece birini veya birkacini calisabilirsin. Bu sana kalmis.

english: Just be aware that demand shifts fast here. Every time you fulfil one or more orders, a new set will come through.
translation: Burada talebin hizla degistigini unutma. Bir veya daha fazla siparisi yerine getirdiginde, yeni bir siparis seti gelecektir.

english: Now, once you have set your desired combination of reagents, collect the unfinished mixture from theMixingVessel. This will then need to be processed on one of the three tables to finish it off.
translation: Simdi, istedigin reaktif kombinasyonunu ayarladiktan sonra, karistirma kabindan bitmemis karisimi topla. Bu karisimi tamamlamak icin üc masadan birinde islemden gecirmelisiniz.

english: TheAlembicwillCrystalisethe mixture.
TheAgitatorwillHomogenisethe mixture.
And finally, theRetortwillConcentratethe mixture.
translation: Ve son olarak, Retort, karisimi konsantre eder.

english: After processing, place the finished mixture on theConveyor Beltand move on to the next order.
translation: Islemden sonra, bitmis karisimi Conveyor Belt'e yerlestirin ve bir sonraki siparise gecin.

english: What if I get an order wrong, or am unable to fulfil any of the orders?
translation: Siparisi yanlis alirsam veya siparislerin hicbirini yerine getiremezsem ne olur?

english: We always have need for spares, so fulfilling an incorrect order will still grant you a small reward and will refresh the orders.
translation: Her zaman yedeklere ihtiyacimiz vardir, bu nedenle yanlis bir siparisi yerine getirseniz bile kücük bir ödül kazanirsiniz ve siparisler yenilenir.

english: One final thing to mention... We have someDigweedgrowing in the lab.
translation: Son olarak belirtilmesi gereken bir sey daha var... Laboratuvarda biraz Digweed yetistiriyoruz.

english: These rare herbs will occasionally come into maturity for a short period of time. Harvest them while you can!
translation: Bu nadir bitkiler ara sira kisa bir süre icin olgunlasir. Firsat varken hasat edin!

english: Mixing some into your product will increase its potency and grant you bonus rewards.
translation: Bunlari ürününüze karistirmak, ürünün etkisini artiracak ve size bonus ödüller kazandiracaktir.

english: Bonus rewards?

That's right. As you produce potions, you'll find yourself collecting three types ofResin. The types obtained depend on what reagents are used, with the quantities being determined by the complexity of the
translation: Dogru. Iksir üretirken, üc tür Recine topladiginizi göreceksiniz. Elde edilen türler, kullanilan reaktiflere baglidir ve miktarlari iksirin karmasikligina göre belirlenir.

english: potion.
Potions usingDigweedwill reward additionalResin, as will handing in multiple potions in one go.
translation: kullanilan iksirler ek Recine ödülü verir, ayni anda birden fazla iksir teslim etmek de öyle.

english: Got it! So, refine herbs, deposit into the hopper, mix some products, process them, and then throw them on the conveyor. Seems easy enough!
translation: Anladim! Yani, otlari rafine edin, hazneye koyun, bazi ürünleri karistirin, isleyin ve sonra konveyöre atin. Kolay görünüyor!

english: I'm sure I can work it out.
Suit yourself. I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: Nasil istersen. Fikrini degistirirsen ben buradayim.

english: What is it?
Can you explain how to make potions?
Can I have some rewards?
As you wish.
Can you tell me more about the Alchemical Society?
translation: Bana Kimya Dernegi hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Can't imagine there's much to tell beyond what you already know. We exist to bring about advancements in Herblore, but in truth, a lot of what we produce doesn't directly contribute to that.
translation: Zaten bildigin seylerin ötesinde anlatacak cok sey oldugunu sanmiyorum. Biz, Bitki Bilimi'nde ilerleme saglamak icin variz, ama gercekte, ürettigimiz seylerin cogu buna dogrudan katkida bulunmuyor.

english: Instead, many of the potions we make here are simply to sell. Doing so is what provides the funding we need to further our true goals.
translation: Bunun yerine, burada ürettigimiz iksirlerin cogu sadece satilmak icin. Bunu yapmak, gercek hedeflerimizi ilerletmek icin ihtiyacimiz olan fonu sagliyor.

english: Makes sense. So how did the society first get established?
translation: Mantikli. Peki, dernek ilk olarak nasil kuruldu?

english: For a long time, it was just a couple of us operating out of a makeshift lab we'd built in my garden. Our big break came when the Moonrise Brewery and Winery learnt about us.
translation: Uzun bir süre, sadece birkacimiz benim bahcemde kurdugumuz gecici bir laboratuvarda calisiyorduk. Büyük cikisimiz, Moonrise Brewery and Winery bizi kesfettiginde gerceklesti.

english: They provided us with some initial funding to properly get things going, but more importantly, they provided this lab space. This was actually one of their old wine cellars before we moved in.
translation: Isleri düzgün bir sekilde yürütmemiz icin bize baslangic fonu sagladilar, ama daha da önemlisi, bu laboratuvar alanini sagladilar. Aslinda burasi, biz tasinmadan önce onlarin eski sarap mahzenlerinden biriydi.

english: Why were they so interested in your work?
translation: Neden calismalariniza bu kadar ilgi gösterdiler?

english: They never properly said why, just that they were very keen to see us grow. Maybe they're hoping our work can help them create new beers and wines.
translation: Nedenini hic söylemediler, sadece büyümemizi cok istediklerini söylediler. Belki de calismalarimizin yeni bira ve saraplar yaratmalarina yardimci olacagini umuyorlardir.

english: I see. I suppose that makes sense.
Nothing, I'll be going now.
Hey! I haven't given you permission to do that!
translation: Hey! Sana bunu yapma izni vermedim!

english: To know what needs making, you'll need to check the order list. There will always be three orders to choose from. Demand shifts fast here so every time you fulfil an order, a new set will come through.
translation: Ne yapilmasi gerektigini ögrenmek icin siparis listesini kontrol etmelisin. Her zaman üc siparis arasindan secim yapabilirsin. Burada talep hizla degisir, bu yüzden her siparisi yerine getirdiginde yeni bir siparis gelir.

english: Let's do that run through.
I'm sure I can work it out.
Can you explain how to make potions?
Can I have some rewards?
Can you tell me more about the Alchemical Society?
translation: Bana Kimya Dernegi hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Nothing, I'll be going now.
Veldaban told me about your involvement in the rebuilding of the statue. Congratulations.
translation: Veldaban, heykelin yeniden insasina katildigini söyledi. Tebrikler.

english: Thank you!
Who are you?
I am Bisi. I am the Supreme Commander of the Black Guard.
I thought Veldaban was in command?
Only of our regiment in Keldagrim, and a most honourable position it is as well.
translation: Sadece Keldagrim'deki alayimizin komutani, ki bu da cok onurlu bir pozisyon.

english: But the Black Guard has many regiments across the dwarven realm. All the Commanders of those regiments report to me.
translation: Ama Kara Muhafizlarin cüce kralligi genelinde bircok alayi var. Bu alaylarin tüm komutanlari bana rapor veriyor.

english: Oh yes, I helped Commander Lawgof once, in his fight against the goblins.
translation: Evet, bir keresinde Komutan Lawgof'a goblinlerle savasinda yardim etmistim.

english: That's good to hear.
What news have you?
Apart from you helping to rebuild the statue for the Purple Pewter?
translation: Mor Kalay icin heykelin yeniden insasina yardim etmen disinda?

english: Well, I heard that you helped Veldaban's father in the mines to the south. That's caused quite a bit of an upset in the Consortium, so I understand.
translation: Veldaban'in babasina güneydeki madenlerde yardim ettigini duydum. Anladigim kadariyla bu, Konsorsiyum'da epey bir karisikliga neden olmus.

english: How so?
The amount of wealth that goldmine is generating might cause some distortion in the balance of power in the Consortium. But we'll see.
translation: O altin madeninin ürettigi servet, Konsorsiyum'daki güc dengesini bozabilir. Ama görecegiz.

english: Apart from that there seems to be some general unrest in the city. Trouble is brewing in Keldagrim.
translation: Bunun disinda sehirde genel bir huzursuzluk var gibi görünüyor. Keldagrim'de sorunlar bas gösteriyor.

english: But I'm sure Commander Veldaban is on top of it. He's a very capable officer, and I'm starting to get too old for this sort of thing.
translation: Ama eminim Komutan Veldaban bu konuyla ilgileniyordur. O cok yetenekli bir subay ve ben bu tür isler icin artik yaslanmaya basladim.

english: I must go now.
Then I bid you farewell, human.
Who are you?
What news have you?
I must go now.
Hi!
Hi. How can I help?
Can you heal me?
Sorry, I'm not on duty.
PLEASE DON'T KILL ME!
I was... looking to be healed.
No way, I'm out of here just as soon as I've packed up my stuff!
translation: Olmaz, esyalarimi toplar toplamaz buradan gidiyorum!

english: You look healthy to me!
Of course!
Surgeon General Tafani heals you for 21 Hitpoints.
translation: Bashekim Tafani sana 21 can puani kazandirir.

english: Do you see a lot of injured fighters?
translation: Cok sayida yarali savasci görüyor musun?

english: Yes I do. Thankfully we can cope with almost anything. Jaraah really is a wonderful surgeon, his methods are a little unorthodox but he gets the job done.
translation: Evet, görüyorum. Neyse ki neredeyse her seyle basa cikabiliyoruz. Jaraah gercekten harika bir cerrah, yöntemleri biraz alisilmadik ama isini iyi yapiyor.

english: I shouldn't tell you this but his nickname is 'The Butcher'.
translation: Bunu sana söylememem gerekir ama lakabi “Kasap”tir.

english: That's reassuring.
Do you come here often?
I work here, so yes!
You're silly!
Can you tell me about your cape?
Certainly! Skillcapes are a symbol of achievement. Only people who have mastered a skill and reached level 99 can get their hands on them and gain the benefits they carry.
translation: Elbette! Beceri pelerinleri basari sembolüdür. Sadece bir beceriyi ustalastirmis ve 99. seviyeye ulasmis kisiler bu pelerinleri elde edebilir ve sagladiklari avantajlardan yararlanabilir.

english: The Cape of Hitpoints doubles the speed of your hitpoints replenishing when worn. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Hitpoints Pelerini giyildiginde, hitpointlerin yenilenme hizini iki katina cikarir. Baska yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Can I buy a Skillcape of Hitpoints from you?
translation: Senden Hitpoints Beceri Pelerini satin alabilir miyim?

english: Sorry, I'm under orders to not sell capes right now.
translation: Üzgünüm, su anda pelerin satmamam emredildi.

english: You cannot do that on this game world.
Why, certainly my friend. However, owning such an item makes you part of an elite group and wearing it will double the speed of your hitpoints replenishing.
translation: Elbette dostum. Ancak, böyle bir esyaya sahip olmak sizi seckin bir grubun parcasi yapar ve onu giydiginizde hitpointlerinizi yenileme hiziniz iki katina cikar.

english: Such a privilege will cost you 99,000 coins.
Sorry, that's much too pricey.
I'm sorry you feel that way. Still if you change your mind...
translation: Öyle düsündügünüz icin üzgünüm. Yine de fikrinizi degistirirseniz...

english: Sure, that's not too expensive for such a magnificent cape.
translation: Tabii, böylesine muhtesem bir pelerin icin bu fiyat cok pahali degil.

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: Ama maalesef yanimda yeterince param yok.

english: Well come back and see me when you do.
translation: Peki, paran oldugunda tekrar gelip beni gör.

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: Maalesef tüm Skill pelerinleri sadece ücretsiz bir baslik ile satiliyor, bu bir beceri promosyonunun parcasi; bir alana bir bedava, bilirsin. Yani sana bir tane satabilmem icin önce envanterinde yer acman gerekiyor.

english: Wear this cape in good health, my friend.
translation: Bu pelerini saglikli bir sekilde giy, dostum.

english: May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: Pelerinim icin baska bir baslik alabilir miyim, lütfen?

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
Tafani hands you another hood for your skillcape.
translation: Tafani, beceri pelerinine baska bir baslik verir.

english: Can you heal me?
Do you see a lot of injured fighters?
translation: Cok sayida yarali savasci görüyor musun?

english: Do you come here often?
Can you tell me about your cape?
Can I buy a Skillcape of Hitpoints from you?
translation: Senden Hitpoints beceri pelerini satin alabilir miyim?

english: Skillcape
Sorry, that's much too pricey.
Sure, that's not too expensive for such a magnificent cape.
translation: Tabii, bu kadar muhtesem bir pelerin icin cok pahali degil.

english: Hood
He's too busy playing some succulent beats to stop and talk.
translation: O, lezzetli ritimler calmakla mesgul, durup konusacak zamani yok.

english: Excuse me...
What do you want? ...Oh, wait. I know! You're probably just like all the others, aren't you? After some fancy spell or potion from me, I bet!
translation: Ne istiyorsunuz? ...Oh, durun. Biliyorum! Muhtemelen digerleri gibi siz de, degil mi? Benden süslü bir büyü veya iksir istiyorsunuz, eminim!

english: What? No! At least, I don't think so. What sort of spells do you have?
translation: Ne? Hayir! En azindan, sanmiyorum. Ne tür büyüleriniz var?

english: Hah! I knew it! I expect you want my Aphro-Dizzy- Yak spell! Want someone to fall madly in love with you, eh?
translation: Hah! Biliyordum! Aphro-Dizzy-Yak büyümü istiyorsun! Birinin sana deli gibi asik olmasini istiyorsun, degil mi?

english: That spell sounds very interesting, but I didn't mean to disturb you!
translation: Bu büyü cok ilginc geliyor, ama seni rahatsiz etmek istemedim!

english: Well, I see that you do have some manners. I'm glad to see that you use them.
translation: Görüyorum ki biraz terbiye sahibisin. Bunu görmekten memnunum.

english: Now, if it's all the same, I am very busy at the moment. Unless you want something specific, please come back another time.
translation: Simdi, sakincasi yoksa, su anda cok mesgulüm. Özel bir istegin yoksa, lütfen baska bir zaman gel.

english: Yes, of course. Goodbye!
Ummm...
Oh, it's you again! Well, what is it this time?
translation: Oh, yine sen! Bu sefer ne var?

english: Do you have any jobs or quests that I could do for you?
translation: Senin icin yapabilecegim bir is veya görev var mi?

english: Hah! There are plenty of things I need done, but something tells me you're not quite ready for them right now. Come back another time!
translation: Hah! Yapilmasi gereken cok sey var, ama icimden bir ses su anda senin icin henüz hazir olmadigini söylüyor. Baska bir zaman gel!

english: Okay.
Can't you see I'm very busy here? Be off with you!
translation: Cok mesgul oldugumu görmüyor musun? Git buradan!

english: Oh. Sorry.
Hello there, newcomer. My name is Brynna. My job is to teach you about the skills you can use to survive in this world.
translation: Merhaba, yeni gelen. Benim adim Brynna. Benim görevim, bu dünyada hayatta kalmak icin kullanabilecegin becerileri sana ögretmek.

english: The first skill we're going to look at is Fishing. There's some shrimp in this pond here. Let's try and catch some.
translation: Ilk olarak balikcilik becerisine bakacagiz. Bu gölette bazi karidesler var. Hadi biraz yakalayalim.

english: Hello again. First up, we're going to do some fishing. There's some shrimp in this pond here. Let's try and catch some.
translation: Merhaba tekrar. Ilk olarak balik tutacagiz. Bu gölette bazi karidesler var. Hadi biraz yakalayalim.

english: Hello again. You should take a look at that menu before we continue.
translation: Merhaba tekrar. Devam etmeden önce o menüye bir göz atmalisin.

english: I've managed to catch some shrimp.
Excellent work. Now that you have some shrimp, you're going to want to cook them. To do that, you'll need a fire. This brings us on to the Woodcutting and Firemaking skills.
translation: Harika is cikardin. Artik karideslerin olduguna göre, onlari pisirmek isteyeceksin. Bunun icin atese ihtiyacin olacak. Bu da bizi Odun Kesme ve Ates Yakma becerilerine getiriyor.

english: Next up you need to make a fire. First, you'll need to cut down a tree to get some logs.
translation: Sirada ates yakman gerekiyor. Öncelikle, odun elde etmek icin bir agac kesmen gerekecek.

english: Now that you have some shrimp, you're going to want to cook them. To do that, you'll need a fire.
translation: Artik karideslerin var, onlari pisirmek isteyeceksin. Bunun icin atese ihtiyacin olacak.

english: Now that you have some shrimp, you're going to want to cook them. All you need to do is use them on a fire.
translation: Artik karideslerin var, onlari pisirmek isteyeceksin. Tek yapman gereken onlari ateste kullanmak.

english: Hello again. Is there something you'd like to hear more about?
translation: Merhaba tekrar. Daha fazla bilgi almak istedigin bir konu var mi?

english: Tell me about my skills again.
Every skill is listed in the skills menu. Here you can see what your current levels are and how much experience you have.
translation: Her beceri beceri menüsünde listelenmistir. Burada mevcut seviyenizi ve ne kadar deneyiminiz oldugunu görebilirsiniz.

english: As you move your mouse over the various skills the small yellow popup box will show you the exact amount of experience you have and how much is needed to get to the next level.
translation: Farenizi cesitli becerilerin üzerine getirdiginizde, kücük sari acilir pencere size tam olarak ne kadar deneyiminiz oldugunu ve bir sonraki seviyeye gecmek icin ne kadar deneyim gerektigini gösterir.

english: You can also click on a skill to open up the relevant skillguide. In the skillguide, you can see all of the unlocks available in that skill.
translation: Ayrica bir beceriye tiklayarak ilgili beceri kilavuzunu acabilirsiniz. Beceri kilavuzunda, o beceride kullanilabilir olan tüm kilit acma seceneklerini görebilirsiniz.

english: Is there anything else you'd like to hear more about?
translation: Baska ögrenmek istediginiz bir sey var mi?

english: Tell me about Woodcutting again.
translation: Odun kesme hakkinda tekrar bilgi verin.

english: Woodcutting, eh? Don't worry, newcomer, it's really very easy. Simply equip your axe and click on a nearby tree to chop away.
translation: Odun kesme, ha? Merak etmeyin, yeni gelen, bu gercekten cok kolay. Baltanizi kusanin ve yakindaki bir agaca tiklayarak kesmeye baslayin.

english: As you explore the mainland you will discover many different kinds of trees that will require different Woodcutting levels to chop down.
translation: Anakara'yi kesfederken, kesmek icin farkli odun kesme seviyeleri gerektiren bircok farkli agac türü kesfedeceksiniz.

english: Logs are not only useful for making fires. Many archers use the skill known as Fletching to craft their own bows and arrows from trees.
translation: Tomruklar sadece ates yakmak icin kullanisli degildir. Bircok okcu, Fletching adli beceriyi kullanarak agaclardan kendi yaylarini ve oklarini yapar.

english: Tell me about Firemaking again.
translation: Ates yakma hakkinda tekrar bilgi verin.

english: Certainly, newcomer. When you have logs simply use your tinderbox on them. If successful, you will start a fire.
translation: Elbette, yeni gelen. Tomruklariniz oldugunda, üzerlerine tinderbox'inizi kullanin. Basarili olursaniz, ates yakarsiniz.

english: You can also set fire to logs you find lying on the floor already, and some other things can also be set alight...
translation: Yerde buldugunuz tomruklari da atese verebilirsiniz, ayrica baska seyler de atese verilebilir...

english: A tinderbox is always a useful item to keep around!
translation: Cakmaktasi kutusu her zaman yaninizda bulundurmaniz gereken kullanisli bir esyadir!

english: Tell me about Fishing again.
Ah, yes. Fishing! Fishing is undoubtedly one of the more popular hobbies here in Gielinor!
translation: Ah, evet. Balikcilik! Balikcilik, Gielinor'da süphesiz en popüler hobilerden biridir!

english: Whenever you see sparkling waters, you can be sure there's probably some good fishing to be had there!
translation: Parlayan sular gördügünüzde, orada muhtemelen iyi bir balik avi olacagina emin olabilirsiniz!

english: Not only are fish absolutely delicious when cooked, they will also heal lost health.
translation: Baliklar pisirildiginde cok lezzetli olmakla kalmaz, ayni zamanda kaybedilen sagligi da iyilestirir.

english: I would recommend everybody has a go at Fishing at least once in their lives!
translation: Herkese hayatinda en az bir kez balikciligi denemesini tavsiye ederim!

english: Tell me about Cooking again.
Yes, the most basic of survival techniques. Most simple foods can be used on a fire to cook them. If you're feeling a bit fancier, you can also use a range to cook the food instead.
translation: Evet, en temel hayatta kalma tekniklerinden biri. Cogu basit yiyecek ateste pisirilebilir. Biraz daha sofistike bir sey istiyorsan, yemekleri ocakta da pisirebilirsin.

english: Eating cooked food will restore lost health. The harder something is to cook, the more it will heal you.
translation: Pismis yiyecekler kaybedilen sagligi geri kazandirir. Pisirmesi ne kadar zor olan yiyecekler, o kadar fazla iyilestirir.

english: Nothing thanks.
Tell me about my skills again.
Tell me about Woodcutting again.
Tell me about Firemaking again.
Tell me about Fishing again.
Tell me about Cooking again.
Nothing thanks.
You're putting me in prison?!
Hello there. What are you doing here?
That's not really any of your business, is it?
Fair enough.
This person seems far too alert for you to be able to plant anything on them.
translation: Bu kisi, ona bir sey yerlestirebilmek icin cok fazla uyanik görünüyor.

english: Hello!
Is everything okay?
*mumble mumble*
I didn't catch that.
Right... Well, have a nice day.
*mumble*
If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: Senin kadar cirkin olsaydim, halka acik yerlerde yüzümü göstermeye cesaret edemezdim!

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: Oh! Sey... Az önce bir tane yedim de ondan!

english: Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: Hayatina deger veriyorsan bir daha benimle konusma!

english: Get lost!
I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: Sana verecek hicbir seyim yok, birak beni rahat, dilenci.

english: Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
translation: Su anda bununla ugrasacak vaktim yok.

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: Senin gibi zavalli bir et yiginiyla konusmak istemiyorum.

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: Cok kötü bir gün... tadini cikar.

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: Eger birini yakalarsan, paylasacagina söz ver.

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
You smell familiar...
Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: Buralarda insan gördün mü? Cok acim.

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: Bana kan tadi seven biri gibi görünüyorsun.

english: Good day to you, my friend.
Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
translation: Kaleye gidip atistirmalik bir seyler yemeye ne dersin?

english: Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: Bana bir dakika izin ver, dislerimde bir sey sikismis...

english: Yessss, adventurer?
You smell funky.
As do you, adventurer.
How come you live with the lizardmen?
They are my sssaviours, I owe them my life.
translation: Onlar benim kurtaricilarim, onlara hayatimi borcluyum.

english: What did they save you from? Is it to do with your eye?
translation: Seni neyden kurtardilar? Gözünle mi ilgili?

english: Why, yesss it isss... Many yearsss ago now. 30? 40? I've lost count.
translation: Evet, öyle... Yillar önceydi. 30? 40? Sayisini unuttum.

english: I wasss a Captain of the Shayzien Army, Captain Reynard Koil, ssstationed up on Shayziens' wall.
translation: Ben Shayzien Ordusu'nun komutaniydim, Yüzbasi Reynard Koil, Shayzien duvarinda görevliydim.

english: We were told to attack the lizardmen, for they were apparently attacking usss. I led the charge.
translation: Kertenkele adamlara saldirmamiz emredildi, cünkü görünüse göre onlar bize saldiriyordu. Saldiriyi ben yönettim.

english: Apparently? Were they attacking?
Alasss, I took an arrow to the eye and missed the battle. I woke up here, worried for my life.
translation: Ne yazik ki, gözüme bir ok saplandi ve savasi kacirdim. Burada uyandim, hayatim icin endiseleniyordum.

english: The lizardmen took you prisoner?
translation: Kertenkele adamlar seni esir mi aldi?

english: At first, that isss what I thought, but they tended my woundsss and fed me well.
translation: Ilk basta öyle düsündüm, ama yaralarimi tedavi ettiler ve beni iyi beslediler.

english: I assssumed my people would come for me once they sssaw my body wasn't amongssst the dead, but they never did.
translation: Halkim, cesedimin ölüler arasinda olmadigini görünce beni almaya gelecegini düsündüm, ama gelmediler.

english: Would the lizardmen let you leave?
Oh yesss, once my ssstrength returned, I went and ssspoke to the Shayzien Army.
translation: Evet, gücüm geri geldiginde Shayzien Ordusu'na gidip konustum.

english: ...And?
They thought I wasss a lizardman and fired arrowsss at me, ssso I returned here.
translation: Beni bir kertenkele adam sandilar ve bana ok attilar, ben de buraya döndüm.

english: What is that you're wearing?
I found these in thisss shrine. I guesss they belonged to sssome long dead priest.
translation: Bunlari bu tapinakta buldum. Sanirim uzun zaman önce ölmüs bir rahibe aitti.

english: What would a priest be doing in this gross swamp?
translation: Bir rahip bu igrenc bataklikta ne yapardi ki?

english: This grossss ssswamp is my home. You sssure do ask a lot of questionsss, adventurer.
translation: Bu igrenc bataklik benim evim. Cok soru soruyorsun, maceraci.

english: What is the symbol on the shrine?
You do not recognissse it, adventurer? It would ssseem hissstory is written by the winnersss, for that isss the sssymbol of the Great Lord Xeric.
translation: Tanilamadin mi, maceraci? Tarih kazananlar tarafindan yazilir, cünkü bu Büyük Lord Xeric'in sembolü.

english: Or at leassst, that isss what the lizardmen tell me...
translation: En azindan kertenkele adamlar bana öyle söyledi...

english: Goodbye, swampy man.
Goodbye, adventurer.
Are you the 'Rey' this entry mentions?
You show him 'The Fisher's Flute'.
Oh, that wasss a lifetime ago... Sssuch a wonderful little one.
translation: Oh, o cok uzun zaman önceydi... Ne kadar da harika bir cocuktu.

english: So you've not seen her recently?
Lassst I heard, her mind had cracked. Her father died and...
translation: Son duydugumda, akli karismisti. Babasi öldü ve...

english: And?
Gone.
Oh, how mysterious.
You smell funky.
How come you live with the lizardmen?
What is that you're wearing?
What is the symbol on the shrine?
Goodbye, swampy man.
Ribbit
Croak
You manage to catch the toad and inflate it with swamp gas.
Come here toady!
You add the bloated toad to your inventory.
One of your bloated toads manages to escape.
Ribbitt!
Hissss....
The air seems too thin to stay in the toad.
translation: Hava kurbagada kalmak icin cok ince görünüyor.

english: Perhaps you need something thicker than air.
translation: Belki de havadan daha kalin bir seye ihtiyacin vardir.

english: You release the toad[s] and see [it/them] hop off into the distance.
translation: Kurbagalari serbest birakirsin ve onlarin uzaklara zipladigini görürsün.

english: Free the fatsy toady!
Ribbet!
Croak!
Hello!
Hello outerlander. This is my home, I would be grateful if you would leave.
translation: Merhaba yabanci. Burasi benim evim, gitmenizi rica ediyorum.

english: Oh. Okay.
I am sorry outerlander, I will not offer you hospitality until my Chieftain has vouched for your honesty. This is our way.
translation: Üzgünüm yabanci, Sefim senin dürüstlügünü onaylayana kadar sana misafirperverlik göstermeyecegim. Bizim gelenegimiz budur.

english: I am trying to become a member of the Fremennik clan! The Chieftain told me that I may be able to gain your vote at the council of elders?
translation: Fremennik klaninin bir üyesi olmaya calisiyorum! Sef, yaslilar konseyinde senin oyunu alabilecegimi söyledi.

english: You wish to stop being an outerlander? I can understand that! I have no reason why I would prevent you becoming a Fremennik...
translation: Yabanci olmaktan vazgecmek mi istiyorsun? Seni anliyorum! Fremennik olmani engellemek icin hicbir nedenim yok...

english: ...but you must first pass a little test for me to prove you are worthy.
translation: ...ama önce layik oldugunu kanitlamak icin kücük bir testi gecmelisin.

english: What kind of test?
Well, I serve our clan as a navigator. The seas can be a fearful place when you know not where you are heading.
translation: Ben klanimiza navigatör olarak hizmet ediyorum. Nereye gittigini bilmediginde denizler korkutucu bir yer olabilir.

english: Should something happen to me, all members of our tribe have some basic sense of direction so that they may always return safely home.
translation: Bana bir sey olursa, kabilemizin tüm üyeleri temel yön duygusuna sahip olduklari icin her zaman güvenli bir sekilde evlerine dönebilirler.

english: If you are able to demonstrate to me that you too have a good sense of direction then I will recommend you to the rest of the council of elders immediately.
translation: Senin de iyi bir yön duygusuna sahip oldugunu bana kanitlayabilirsen, seni hemen yaslilar konseyinin diger üyelerine tavsiye ederim.

english: Well, how would I go about showing that?
Ah, a simple task! Below this building I have constructed a maze; should you be able to walk from one side to the other that will be proof to me.
translation: Ah, cok basit bir görev! Bu binanin altinda bir labirent insa ettim; bir uctan diger uca yürüyebilirsen, bu benim icin yeterli bir kanit olacaktir.

english: You wish to try my challenge?
A maze? Is that all? Sure, it sounds simple enough.
translation: Bir labirent mi? Hepsi bu mu? Tabii, kulaga oldukca basit geliyor.

english: I will warn you outerlander, this maze was designed by myself, and is of the most fiendish complexity!
translation: Seni uyariyorum yabanci, bu labirent benim tarafimdan tasarlandi ve son derece karmasik!

english: Oh really? Watch and learn...
No thanks. I think I can get someone else to vouch for me to the council of elders, without going through a stupid maze like some lab rat.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler. Sanirim yaslilar konseyine, laboratuvar faresi gibi aptal bir labirentten gecmeden, baska birinin kefil olmasini saglayabilirim.

english: Well, I am sorry you feel that way outerlander. I cannot vouch for you until you prove to me you have some skill that will benefit our clan somehow.
translation: Öyle düsündügün icin üzgünüm, yabanci. Klanimiza bir sekilde fayda saglayacak bir becerinin oldugunu kanitlayana kadar sana kefil olamam.

english: What exactly is a 'lab rat' anyway?
Ah, forget it.
Have you no manners outerlander? This is my home, you will show me the due respect!
translation: Terbiye yok mu senin, yabanci? Burasi benim evim, bana saygi göster!

english: Erm.... sorry I guess.
Man, your maze is pretty tough!
Hahahaha it is the most complex route I have ever devised! I am truly a genius at navigation! The world will remember my name!
translation: Hahahaha, bu simdiye kadar tasarladigim en karmasik rota! Navigasyon konusunda gercekten bir dahiyim! Dünya benim adimi hatirlayacak!

english: Can't I do something else for your vote at the council of elders?
translation: Yaslilar konseyinde oyun icin baska bir sey yapamaz miyim?

english: No, you cannot. It is my maze, or nothing.
translation: Hayir, yapamazsin. Ya benim labirentim ya da hicbir sey.

english: Decided you could not solve my labyrinth after all, did you outerlander? Too tricky for you?
translation: Sonunda labirentimi cözemeyecegine karar verdin, degil mi yabanci? Senin icin cok mu zor?

english: Yeah, it is really confusing down there...
translation: Evet, asagisi gercekten cok kafa karistirici...

english: Hahaha! Don't worry outerlander, you are not the first to fail its puzzle!
translation: Hahaha! Merak etme yabanci, bu bulmacayi cözemeyen ilk kisi sen degilsin!

english: Outerlander! You have finished my maze! I am genuinely impressed!
translation: Yabanci! Labirentimi bitirdin! Gercekten cok etkilendim!

english: So does that mean I can rely on your vote at the council of elders to allow me into your village?
translation: Bu, yaslilar konseyinde beni köyünüze kabul etmeleri icin oyuna güvenebilecegim anlamina mi geliyor?

english: Of course outerlander! I am nothing if not a man of my word!
translation: Tabii ki yabanci! Ben sözümün eriyim!

english: Thanks!
Greetings again outerlander! I must say, I am still impressed with the way you moved through my maze!
translation: Merhaba yine, yabanci! Senin labirentimde ilerleyisinden hala cok etkilendigimi söylemeliyim!

english: Thanks. So I can rely on your vote in my favour at the council of elders?
translation: Tesekkürler. Öyleyse, yaslilar konseyinde benim lehime oy verecegine güvenebilir miyim?

english: Absolutely! You will be an asset to the clan!
translation: Elbette! Sen klan icin cok degerli olacaksin!

english: No way am I doing that maze again!
translation: O labirenti bir daha asla gecmeyecegim!

english: Greetings outerlander.
I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a map of deep sea fishing spots do you?
translation: Derin deniz balikciligi icin bir harita bulabilecegim bir yer biliyor musun?

english: Hmmm? Why of course! As the navigator for the Fremennik I keep all of our maps secure right here.
translation: Hmmm? Tabii ki! Fremennik'in navigatörü olarak tüm haritalarimizi burada sakliyorum.

english: Great! Can I have it?
Have it? Just like that? I think not outerlander. This map shows all of the prime fishing locations nearby.
translation: Almak mi? Öylece mi? Sanmiyorum, yabanci. Bu harita, yakinlardaki tüm önemli balikcilik yerlerini gösteriyor.

english: It is very valuable to our clan. I am afraid I can not just give it away.
translation: Klanimiz icin cok degerli. Korkarim öylece veremem.

english: Perhaps I can trade you something for it?
A trade? For a map of the best fishing spots in a hundred leagues? I will trade it for no less than a weather forecast from our Seer.
translation: Takas mi? Yüz mil icindeki en iyi balik tutma yerlerinin haritasi icin mi? Onu, en azindan Kahin'imizin hava tahminiyle takas ederim.

english: As a navigator, the weather is extremely important for plotting the best course. Unfortunately the Seer is always too busy to help me with a forecast.
translation: Bir navigatör olarak, en iyi rotayi belirlemek icin hava durumu son derece önemlidir. Ne yazik ki Kahin her zaman cok mesgul oldugu icin bana hava tahmini konusunda yardimci olamiyor.

english: Where could I get a weather forecast from then?
translation: O zaman hava tahminini nereden alabilirim?

english: I just told you: from the Seer. You will need to persuade him to take the time to make a forecast somehow.
translation: Az önce söyledim: Kahin'den. Onu bir sekilde hava tahmini yapmak icin zaman ayirmasi konusunda ikna etmen gerekecek.

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a weather forecast from the Fremennik Seer do you?
translation: Fremennik Kahin'den hava tahmini alabilecegim bir yer biliyor musun?

english: Uh... from the Seer perhaps?
I would like your map of fishing spots.
I have already told you outerlander; I will not exchange it for anything other than a divination on the weather from our seer himself!
translation: Sana zaten söyledim yabanci; onu sadece Kahin'in hava tahmini ile takas ederim!

english: What, like this one I have here?
W-what...? I don't believe it! How did you...? I suppose it doesn't matter, you have my gratitude outerlander!
translation: N-ne...? Inanamiyorum! Nasil yaptiniz...? Sanirim önemi yok, size minnettarim yabanci!

english: With this forecast I will be able to plan a safe course for our next raiding expedition!
translation: Bu tahminle bir sonraki yagma seferimiz icin güvenli bir rota planlayabilecegim!

english: Here, outerlander; you may take my map of local fishing patterns with my gratitude!
translation: Alin yabanci, yerel balikcilik haritam size minnettarligimin bir göstergesi olarak size ait!

english: If this map of fishing spots is so valuable, why did you give it away to me so easily?
translation: Bu balikcilik haritasi bu kadar degerliyse, neden bana bu kadar kolay verdiniz?

english: Hmmm? Well, firstly it will be of value to our entire clan, so I have lost nothing from giving it to you.
translation: Hmmm? Öncelikle, bu harita tüm klanimiz icin degerli olacak, bu yüzden sana vererek hicbir sey kaybetmedim.

english: The other reason is of course that I have already memorised it, so I can make myself another copy whenever I want!
translation: Diger neden ise, elbette haritayi zaten ezberledigim icin, istedigim zaman kendime baska bir kopya yapabilirim!

english: Greetings to you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! How fare you today?
I am fine thanks Swensen. How are you doing?
I am fine too!
Yes
No
Ask about the Merchant's trial
translation: Tüccarin deneme süresi hakkinda bilgi al

english: Ask about becoming a Fremennik
Hello Sylas.
Ah, [player name]! Good to see you again.
translation: Ah, Maceraci! Seni tekrar görmek ne güzel.

english: How is the collection going now?
Thanks to you finding the golden goblin for me, I am the envy of the collector's group. I can't thank you enough.
translation: Altin goblin'i buldugun icin, koleksiyoncular grubunun kiskancligini cekiyorum. Sana ne kadar tesekkür etsem azdir.

english: I think I've lost Rupert's helmet.
Not to worry, [player name] Go and speak to Rupert. These items have a strange way of returning to their owners sometimes!
translation: Endiselenme, Maceraci. Git Rupert ile konus. Bu esyalar bazen garip bir sekilde sahiplerine geri dönüyorlar!

english: Ok, I will. Thanks.
No, no. Thanks for everything you've done!
translation: Hayir, hayir. Yaptigin her sey icin tesekkürler!

english: I'm just happy that I could help. Goodbye!
translation: Yardim edebildigim icin mutluyum. Hosca kal!

english: Goodbye.
Selling Magic Beans!
You there, you look like you could use some beans!
translation: Sen, fasulyeye ihtiyacin var gibi görünüyorsun!

english: All beans must go!
Buy 1 bean get a bean free!
Selling bags of Magic Beans!
Excuse me, human! Perhaps you shouldn't just go wandering through there without knowing what you're dealing with!
translation: Affedersin, insan! Neyle karsi karsiya oldugunu bilmeden oraya dalmamalisin!

english: Hello! Are you the leader of this expedition?
translation: Merhaba! Bu kesif gezisinin lideri sen misin?

english: Indeed I am, human! What's on your mind?
translation: Evet, ben, insan! Aklinda ne var?

english: What's going on here?
Well, the Hueycoatl has awoken.
The Huey- what?
Huey-co-at... oh, I don't have time for this! The thing you need to know is that it's dangerous and it's coiled throughout this entire mountain!
translation: Huey-co-at... oh, bununla ugrasacak vaktim yok! Bilmen gereken tek sey, onun tehlikeli oldugu ve tüm dagi sardigi!

english: Do you know where it came from?
We're not sure. There are some records of our ancestors having dealings with it, but the details have been lost, assuming they were ever recorded.
translation: Emin degiliz. Atalarimizin onunla ilgilendigine dair bazi kayitlar var, ama detaylar kaybolmus, tabii kayit edilmisse.

english: So it's old?
Does it really matter how old it is?
translation: Kac yasinda oldugu gercekten önemli mi?

english: I suppose not. I guess I just want to get a better understanding of what this thing is.
translation: Sanirim degil. Sanirim sadece bu seyin ne oldugunu daha iyi anlamak istiyorum.

english: We don't know how old it is. It could be extremely old, or this could be just one in a lineage of them. Still, we haven't heard of any others so maybe it is some sort of ancient creature.
translation: Kac yasinda oldugunu bilmiyoruz. Cok eski olabilir ya da bu, bir soyun tek örnegi olabilir. Yine de, baska bir örnegi duymadik, bu yüzden belki de bir tür eski yaratiktir.

english: And given that you're here, I assume it poses some sort of threat?
translation: Ve burada oldugunuzu düsünürsek, bir tür tehdit olusturdugunu varsayabilir miyiz?

english: Now you're getting it! While it doesn't seem to be innately aggressive, our concern is the potential risk of it tunnelling into Cam Torum.
translation: Simdi anliyorsunuz! Dogasi geregi saldirgan görünmese de, Cam Torum'a tünel acma potansiyeli bizi endiselendiriyor.

english: Oh, and given that it does lash out from time to time, I suppose it does pose a threat to your nearby human villages. A lesser priority for us, but maybe something for you to care about.
translation: Oh, ve zaman zaman saldirdigi düsünülürse, yakininizdaki insan köyleri icin bir tehdit olusturdugunu varsayabiliriz. Bizim icin önceligi düsük, ama sizin icin önemli olabilir.

english: Anyway, for now, our only option is to keep it in check while we figure out what to do in the long term.
translation: Her neyse, simdilik tek secenegimiz, uzun vadede ne yapacagimiza karar verirken onu kontrol altinda tutmak.

english: Unfortunately, that means recruiting all the help we can get, even from you humans...
translation: Ne yazik ki, bu da tüm yardimi toplamamiz gerektigi anlamina geliyor, siz insanlardan bile...

english: How can I help?
Well, despite what some of us may think of your kind, we need all the help we can get.
translation: Bazilarimizin sizin türünüz hakkinda ne düsündügü önemli degil, tüm yardima ihtiyacimiz var.

english: Well, as you've already proven yourself useful to Cam Torum, I'd be glad to have you help here!
translation: Cam Torum'a yararli oldugunu zaten kanitladigin icin, burada yardimina seve seve ihtiyacimiz var!

english: However, I'm not sure you have enough combat experience to face the Hueycoatl.
translation: Ancak, Hueycoatl ile yüzlesmek icin yeterli savas deneyimin oldugundan emin degilim.

english: To face the Hueycoatl, it's recommended you have a combat level of 85 and a Prayer level of 43.
translation: Hueycoatl ile yüzlesmek icin, 85 savas seviyesi ve 43 dua seviyesi olmasi önerilir.

english: We need to keep the Hueycoatl under control which, until we find a more permanent solution, means wearing it out through combat.
translation: Hueycoatl'i kontrol altinda tutmamiz gerekiyor, bu da daha kalici bir cözüm bulana kadar onu savasarak yormak anlamina geliyor.

english: Don't go killing it, mind you! Not that I think you could, but such a magnificent creature doesn't deserve destruction.
translation: Sakin onu öldürmeye kalkisma! Yapabilecegini sanmiyorum ama böylesine muhtesem bir yaratik yok edilmeyi hak etmiyor.

english: Do you have any tips for surviving?
translation: Hayatta kalmak icin herhangi bir ipucunuz var mi?

english: We've found our prayers can protect us from its shards, so keep an eye out for those.
translation: Dualarimizin bizi onun parcalarindan koruyabildigini kesfettik, bu yüzden onlara dikkat edin.

english: To reach the Hueycoatl's head, you'll need to get it to move its great body out of the way. We've found we can persuade it by giving the exposed parts a helpful nudge!
translation: Hueycoatl'in kafasina ulasmak icin, onun devasa vücudunu yolunuzdan cekmeniz gerekecek. Acikta kalan kisimlarina hafifce dokunarak onu ikna edebilecegimizi kesfettik!

english: Once you reach its head, you'll need to work with your comrades and the seer to balance your prayers and weaken the beast.
translation: Kafasina ulastiginizda, yoldaslariniz ve kahinle birlikte calisarak dualarinizi dengelemeli ve canavari zayiflatmalisiniz.

english: But I'm sure you'll figure it out!
Move the body, then attack the head while keeping prayers balanced. Got it!
translation: Vücudu hareket ettirin, sonra dualari dengede tutarak kafasina saldirin. Anladim!

english: What's on your mind, human?
Remind me, what's going on here?
Are there any rewards for helping?
translation: Yardim etmenin bir ödülü var mi?

english: Ugh, you greedy humans.
The Hueycoatl displaces a lot of materials as it moves, including all sorts of items and treasures.
translation: Hueycoatl hareket ederken her türlü esya ve hazine dahil olmak üzere bircok malzemeyi yerinden oynatir.

english: We collect as much as we can, so I suppose you can have a share for helping.
translation: Elimizden geldigince cok sey topluyoruz, yardim ettigin icin sen de payini alabilirsin.

english: That sounds good, thank you.
Goodbye.
Bye.
Remind me, what's going on here?
How can I help?
Are there any rewards for helping?
translation: Yardim etmenin bir ödülü var mi?

english: Goodbye.
Hi, my name is [player name]. What's wi...
translation: Merhaba, benim adim Maceraci. Ne oluyor...

english: I not be in the mood t' talk, sorry. If ye need anythin', talk to Cap'ain Pudi over by the dock.
translation: Konusacak havamda degilim, üzgünüm. Bir seye ihtiyacin olursa, rihtimdaki Kaptan Pudi ile konus.

english: I cannot believe that beast ruined me ship.
What happened to your ship?
Was awful, me crew an' I were out on our fortnightly fishin' excursion. We set sail from Al Kharid t' the deep-sea fishin' spot we usually use.
translation: Korkunctu, mürettebatim ve ben iki haftada bir yaptigimiz balik avi gezisine cikmistik. Al Kharid'den yola cikip her zamanki derin deniz balikciligi noktamiza gittik.

english: Was nothin' but smooth sailin' all the way, we got t' the spot an' started fishin'.
translation: Yolculuk sorunsuz gecti, noktaya vardik ve balik tutmaya basladik.

english: Sounds like a normal day of fishing to me.
translation: Bana normal bir balik tutma günü gibi geldi.

english: Aye, I s'pose it was. After a few days, the crew an' I sailed further t' the Karamjan coast t' catch some sharks. More plunder from sellin' sharks.
translation: Evet, sanirim öyleydi. Birkac gün sonra, mürettebat ve ben köpekbaligi avlamak icin Karamjan kiyilarina dogru yola ciktik. Köpekbaligi satarak daha fazla ganimet elde ettik.

english: While sailin', I noticed there was more debris than usual. Koanee said there must have been a storm recently.
translation: Yolculuk sirasinda, her zamankinden daha fazla enkaz oldugunu fark ettim. Koanee, yakin zamanda bir firtina olmus olabilecegini söyledi.

english: How did she know that?
Koanee is in charge of plottin' a course t' our destination an' watchin' the weather. I thought she was good at her job.
translation: Koanee, varis noktamiza giden rotayi cizmek ve hava durumunu izlemekle görevli. Isinde iyi oldugunu düsünüyordum.

english: We got to our final fishin' spot an' Lauretta let down the net. Almost a whole day went by an' we still 'ad not caught any fish.
translation: Son balik tutma noktamiza vardik ve Lauretta agi indirdi. Neredeyse bir gün gecti ama hala hic balik tutamamistik.

english: In fact, I could not see any fish in the waters at all. Such a strange sight.
translation: Aslinda, suda hic balik göremedim. Cok garip bir manzaraydi.

english: Not even bass?
Nothin'. We decided t' pack it in for the day an' I told Koanee t' leave the nets down, hoping we would catch some fish overnight.
translation: Hicbir sey yoktu. O gün icin pes etmeye karar verdik ve Koanee'ye agi indirmesini söyledim, gece boyunca balik tutabilecegimizi umuyordum.

english: That sounds like a bad idea. What would have happened if your net got too full or your ship started drifting and the net got caught on some rocks?
translation: Bu kötü bir fikir gibi geliyor. Aginiz cok dolarsa ya da geminiz sürüklenmeye baslarsa ve ag kayalara takilirsa ne olurdu?

english: 'Twas a risk we 'ad to take t' catch some fish.
translation: Balik tutmak icin almamiz gereken bir riskti.

english: The next day Koanee woke me up t' tell me a storm was on the horizon, so we lifted the anchor up an' adjusted our course.
translation: Ertesi gün Koanee beni uyandirip ufukta firtina oldugunu söyledi, biz de demir aldik ve rotamizi degistirdik.

english: Not sure what she was playing at with that decision, but out o' nowhere winds started t' change an' the storm was headin' in our direction, we couldn't outrun it.
translation: O karar ile ne yapmaya calistigini bilmiyorum, ama birdenbire rüzgar yön degistirdi ve firtina bize dogru geliyordu, ondan kacamazdik.

english: 'Twas also too dangerous to anchor down, so we 'ad to weather it.
translation: Demir atmak da cok tehlikeliydi, bu yüzden firtinayi atlatmak zorundaydik.

english: Thick fog rolled in, giant waves crashin' against the ship's hull. So much lightnin', it felt like Saradomin was angry with us.
translation: Yogun sis cöktü, dev dalgalar geminin gövdesine carpiyordu. O kadar cok simsek cakiyordu ki, sanki Saradomin bize kizmis gibiydi.

english: The lightnin' struck our sails, settin' them ablaze despite the 'eavy rain!
translation: Yildirim yelkenlerimize carpti ve siddetli yagmura ragmen onlari atese verdi!

english: The last thing I see is glowin' fish an' a monster in the distance with a twisted face. Next thing I know, I'm lying on the shore just south of Al Kharid with Pudi waving a kebab in me face!
translation: Son gördügüm sey, parlayan baliklar ve uzakta yüzü carpik bir canavardi. Sonra bir baktim, Al Kharid'in güneyindeki kiyida yatiyordum ve Pudi yüzüme kebap salliyordu!

english: That must have been awful. At least you and the crew survived.
translation: Cok korkunc olmali. En azindan sen ve mürettebat hayatta kaldiniz.

english: Aye, we survived, but the same cannot be said for me poor ship! Koanee should 'o known better!
translation: Evet, hayatta kaldik, ama ayni sey benim zavalli gemim icin söylenemez! Koanee daha iyi bilmeliydi!

english: Once Pudi and the others helped us back on our feet, the Chancellor sent us 'ere t' setup shop and recruit others.
translation: Pudi ve digerleri bize yardim edip ayaga kaldirdiktan sonra, Sansölye bizi buraya gönderip dükkan acmamizi ve baskalarini ise almamizi istedi.

english: Not really my area of expertise, mind, but Pudi sorts most of it out!
translation: Bu benim uzmanlik alanim degil, ama Pudi cogunu hallediyor!

english: Anythin' else I can help ye with?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim baska bir sey var mi?

english: Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?
translation: Tempoross ile savasmak icin herhangi bir ipucun var mi?

english: Always carry an 'ammer. That beast has a habit of destroyin' ships. You can fix it up by using said 'ammer.
translation: Her zaman bir cekic tasi. O canavar gemileri yok etme aliskanligi var. Söz konusu cekicle onu tamir edebilirsin.

english: The Spirit Anglers' ships you fight the beast from are kitted out with everythin' ye need.
translation: Canavarla savastigin Spirit Anglers gemileri ihtiyacin olan her seyle donatilmistir.

english: Can I help ye with anythin' else?
translation: Baska bir konuda yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: I found your ship's log.
Ye be stealin' me booty are ye?
No, I jus...
I be yankin' ye chain, 'tis all good. I put that 'ere book on that shelf so I may spread me tale.
translation: Sana saka yapiyorum, sorun yok. Hikayemi yaymak icin o kitabi rafa koydum.

english: It was a good tale. Is it true?
Of course 'tis true! Ye can ask me all about it.
translation: Tabii ki gercek! Bana her seyi sorabilirsin.

english: I have to go.
Be seein' ye.
Would you care for an egg in this difficult time?
translation: Bu zor zamanda bir yumurta ister misin?

english: Um... no, I don't want your damp egg, thanks...
I'll take my eggs elsewhere then.
translation: O zaman yumurtalarimi baska bir yerden alirim.

english: A damp egg? No thanks.
I'd rather not. Thanks, though.
Oh, thanks.
This is some comfort to be sure.
What happened to your ship?
Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?
translation: Tempoross ile savasmak icin herhangi bir ipucun var mi?

english: I found your ship's log.
I have to go.
Get out of my way! Argh! I'm hunting!
Die! Die!!
Move, lest I slay not the beast but you!
translation: Cekil, yoksa canavari degil seni öldürürüm!

english: Hello, Tamayu, first son of Timfraku.
Stranger, why you have returned?
I'm just passing through.
Using your new found poison I have been creating spears. Would you like to buy some?
translation: Yeni buldugun zehri kullanarak mizraklar yapiyorum. Satin almak ister misin?

english: Yes.
No.
As you wish, stranger.
Yes.
No.
Busy Busy Busy.
Why are you so busy?
Aluft Aloft is a bustling new business, here in the Gnome restaurant. We're getting food orders all the time.
translation: Aluft Aloft, Gnome restoraninda yeni acilan, cok hareketli bir isletme. Sürekli yemek siparisleri aliyoruz.

english: Do you have any jobs then?
If you want to get a job, talk to Aluft Gianne jnr. I'm sure he has plenty.
translation: Is ariyorsan, Aluft Gianne jnr ile konus. Eminim bir sürü isi vardir.

english: Have a nice day.
How are you doing today?
I am Tangleroot!
Hello there pretty plant.
I am Tangleroot!
I am [player name]!
Everything is crystal clear now.
I can't believe they made dragonfruit trees into a real thing!
translation: Dragonfruit agaclarini gercek hale getirdiklerine inanamiyorum!

english: I am Tangleroot?
Nothing.
Are you related to Herbiboar now?
I am Tangleroot.
I should have guessed.
Nevermind.
Oh dear, you've gone all red!
It must be something you ate.
I love your new hair cut!
Tangleeeee!
Ssss!
Rrowl!
Hiss!
Grrrr
Greetings friend. I am a manufacturer of leather.
Can I buy some leather then?
translation: O zaman biraz deri satin alabilir miyim?

english: I make leather from animal hides. Bring me some cowhides and one gold coin per hide, and I'll tan them into soft leather for you.
translation: Hayvan derilerinden deri yapiyorum. Bana biraz sigir derisi ve deri basina bir altin para getir, ben de onlari senin icin yumusak deriye dönüstüreyim.

english: Leather is rather weak stuff.
Normal leather may be quite weak, but it's very cheap - I make it from cowhides for only 1 gp per hide - and it's so easy to craft that anyone can work with it.
translation: Normal deri oldukca zayif olabilir, ama cok ucuzdur - sigir derilerinden deri yapiyorum ve deri basina sadece 1 altin para aliyorum - ve islenmesi o kadar kolay ki herkes kullanabilir.

english: Alternatively you could try hard leather. It's not so easy to craft, but I only charge 3 gp per cowhide to prepare it, and it makes much sturdier armour.
translation: Alternatif olarak sert deriyi deneyebilirsiniz. Islenmesi o kadar kolay degildir, ama hazirlamak icin sigir derisi basina sadece 3 altin para aliyorum ve cok daha saglam zirh yapiliyor.

english: I can also tan snake hides and dragonhides, suitable for crafting into the highest quality armour for rangers.
translation: Ayrica yilan derisi ve ejderha derisi de tabaklayabiliyorum, bunlar rangerlar icin en yüksek kalitede zirh yapmak icin uygundur.

english: Thanks, I'll bear it in mind.
I see you have brought me a hide. Would you like me to tan it for you?
translation: Bana bir deri getirmissin. Senin icin tabaklamami ister misin?

english: I see you have brought me some hides. Would you like me to tan them for you?
translation: Bana birkac deri getirmissin. Onlari senin icin tabaklamami ister misin?

english: Yes please.
No thanks.
Very well, [sir/madam], as you wish.
Er... Thanks, but no thanks!
Er... I have no use for that, I make the stuff!
translation: Sey... Onun bana bir faydasi yok, ben o seyi yapiyorum!

english: Can I buy some leather then?
translation: O zaman biraz deri satin alabilir miyim?

english: Leather is rather weak stuff.
Yes please.
No thanks.
Hello.
Not infected are you?
I don't think so.
You don't seem very sure. We don't want any infected near the children. Be off with you!
translation: Cok emin görünmüyorsun. Cocuklarin yaninda enfekte olanlar istemiyoruz. Defol git!

english: Whatever it is you're selling, we ain't interested!
But I'm not...
Did you not hear me? Clear off!
Greetings human. These Hydras are not to be harmed unless you have permission. To act otherwise would be a danger to the balance.
translation: Selam insan. Bu Hydralara izin almadan zarar verilmemelidir. Aksi takdirde denge bozulur.

english: Human! To attack these creatures would be a threat to the balance. Only those with permission may fight them!
translation: Insan! Bu yaratiklara saldirmak dengeyi bozacaktir. Sadece izin alanlar onlarla savasabilir!

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
You don't have any seeds planted in that patch. Plant some and I might agree to look after it for you.
translation: O tarlada tohum ekmedin. Ekerlerse bakmayi kabul edebilirim.

english: That patch is already fully grown! I don't know what you want me to do with it!
translation: O tarla zaten tamamen yetismis! Onunla ne yapmami istiyorsun bilmiyorum!

english: That patch is dead - it's too late for me to do anything about it now.
translation: O tarla öldü - artik onunla ilgili bir sey yapmam icin cok gec.

english: That patch is diseased - you should cure it before asking me to be responsible for it!
translation: O tarla hastalikli - benden ona bakmami istemeden önce onu iyilestirmelisin!

english: I don't know what you're talking about - I'm already looking after that patch for you.
translation: Neden bahsettigini bilmiyorum - o tarlaya zaten senin icin bakiyorum.

english: Oh sorry, I forgot.
If you like, but I want 4 sacks of cabbages for that.
translation: Isterseniz, ama bunun icin 4 cuval lahana istiyorum.

english: I'm afraid I don't have any of those at the moment.
Well, I'm not wasting my time for free.
I'm afraid I don't have enough of those at the moment.
translation: Maalesef su anda elimde yeterince yok.

english: Okay, it's a deal.
That'll do nicely, [sir/madam]. Leave it with me - I'll make sure that patch grows for you.
translation: Bu cok iyi olur, . Bana birakin, o tarlanin sizin icin yetismesini saglayacagim.

english: No, that's too much.
If you like, but I want 3 baskets of tomatoes for that.
translation: Isterseniz, ama bunun icin 3 sepet domates istiyorum.

english: If you like, but I want 3 baskets of strawberries for that.
translation: Isterseniz, ama bunun icin 3 sepet cilek istiyorum.

english: If you like, but I want 6 watermelons for that.
translation: Isterseniz, ama bunun icin 6 karpuz istiyorum.

english: If you like, but I want 8 Bittercap mushrooms for that.
translation: Isterseniz, ama bunun icin 8 adet Bittercap mantari istiyorum.

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: Bana tarimla ilgili tavsiyelerde bulunabilir misiniz?

english: The only way to cure a bush or tree of disease is to prune away the diseased leaves with a pair of secateurs. For all other crops I would just apply some plant-cure.
translation: Bir cali veya agacin hastaligini tedavi etmenin tek yolu, hastalikli yapraklari bir budama makasi ile budamaktir. Diger tüm mahsuller icin ise bitki ilaci kullanirim.

english: Tree seeds must be grown in a plantpot of soil into a sapling, and then transferred to a tree patch to continue growing to adulthood.
translation: Agac tohumlari, toprak dolu bir saksida fidan haline getirilmeli ve ardindan yetiskinlige kadar büyümeye devam etmesi icin bir agac tarlasina aktarilmalidir.

english: You can put up to ten potatoes, cabbages or onions in vegetable sacks, although you can't have a mix in the same sack.
translation: Sebze cuvallarina en fazla on adet patates, lahana veya sogan koyabilirsiniz, ancak ayni cuvalda farkli türleri karistiramazsiniz.

english: You can buy all the farming tools from farming shops, which can be found close to the allotments.
translation: Tüm tarim aletlerini, tarim dükkanlarindan satin alabilirsiniz. Bu dükkanlar, tarim arazilerinin yakininda bulunur.

english: Bittercap mushrooms can only be grown in a special patch in Morytania, near the Mort Myre swamp. There the ground is especially dank and suited to growing poisonous fungii.
translation: Bittercap mantarlari sadece Morytania'daki Mort Myre batakligi yakinindaki özel bir alanda yetistirilebilir. Oradaki toprak özellikle nemli ve zehirli mantarlarin yetismesine uygundur.

english: Supercompost is far better than normal compost, but more expensive to make. You need to rot the right type of item; show me an item, and I'll tell you if it's super- compostable or not.
translation: Süper kompost normal komposttan cok daha iyidir, ancak yapimi daha pahalidir. Dogru türdeki ögeyi cürütebilmeniz gerekir; bana bir ögeyi gösterin, süper kompostlanabilir olup olmadigini size söyleyeyim.

english: There is a special patch for growing Belladonna - I believe that it is somewhere near Draynor Manor, where the ground is a tad 'unblessed'.
translation: Belladonna yetistirmek icin özel bir alan vardir - sanirim Draynor Malikanesi yakinlarinda, topragin biraz ‘kutsanmamis’ oldugu bir yerde.

english: Applying compost to a patch will not only reduce the chance that your crops will get diseased, but you will also grow more crops to harvest.
translation: Bir alana kompost uygulamak, mahsulünüzün hastalanma olasiligini azaltmakla kalmaz, ayni zamanda hasat edeceginiz mahsul miktarini da artirir.

english: If you want to grow fruit trees you could try a few places: Catherby, Brimhaven, Gnome Stronghold and the Farming Guild all have fruit tree patches.
translation: Meyve agaclari yetistirmek istiyorsaniz birkac yeri deneyebilirsiniz: Catherby, Brimhaven, Gnome Stronghold ve Farming Guild'de meyve agaclari yetistirilen alanlar vardir.

english: You can fill plantpots with soil from any empty patch, if you have a gardening trowel.
translation: Bahce küreginiz varsa, bos bir alandan aldiginiz toprakla saksilari doldurabilirsiniz.

english: Hops are good for brewing ales. I believe there's a brewery up in Keldagrim somewhere, and I've heard rumours that a place called Phasmatys used to be good for that type of thing. 'Fore they all died, of course.
translation: Serbetciotu, bira yapiminda kullanilir. Keldagrim'de bir bira fabrikasi oldugunu saniyorum ve Phasmatys adli bir yerin eskiden bu tür seyler icin uygun oldugu söylentileri duydum. Tabii ki hepsi ölmeden önce.

english: Vegetables, hops and flowers need constant watering - if you ignore my advice, you will sooner or later find yourself in possession of a dead farming patch.
translation: Sebzeler, serbetciotu ve cicekler sürekli sulanmalidir. Tavsiyemi dikkate almazsaniz, er ya da gec kendinizi ölü bir tarim arazisiyle karsi karsiya bulursunuz.

english: You can put up to five tomatoes, strawberries, apples, bananas or oranges into a fruit basket, although you can't have a mix in the same basket.
translation: Meyve sepetine en fazla bes domates, cilek, elma, muz veya portakal koyabilirsiniz, ancak ayni sepete farkli meyveleri karistiramazsiniz.

english: Don't just throw away your weeds after you've raked a patch - put them in a compost bin and make some compost.
translation: Arazinizi tirmikladiktan sonra yabani otlari cöpe atmayin, kompost kutusuna koyun ve kompost yapin.

english: There are five other Farming areas like this one - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius and Alan's area in the Farming Guild.
translation: Bunun gibi bes tane daha tarim alani vardir - Falador yakinlarindaki Elstan'in alani, Catherby yakinlarindaki Dantaera'nin alani, Morytania'daki Lyra'nin alani, Hosidius'daki Marisi'nin alani ve Tarim Loncasi'ndaki Alan'in alani.

english: There are fiveother Farming areas like this one - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius, Alan's area in the Farming Guild and Oswallt's
