translation: Bunun gibi bes tane daha tarim alani vardir: Falador yakinlarindaki Elstan'in alani, Catherby yakinlarindaki Dantaera'nin alani, Morytania'daki Lyra'nin alani, Hosidius'daki Marisi'nin alani, Tarim Loncasi'ndaki Alan'in alani ve Prifddinas'daki Oswallt'in

english: area in Prifddinas.
If you want to make your own sacks and baskets you'll need to use the loom that's near the Farming shop in Falador. If you're a good enough [craftsman/craftswoman], that is.
translation: Kendi cuvallarinizi ve sepetlerinizi yapmak istiyorsaniz, Falador'daki Tarim dükkaninin yakinindaki dokuma tezgahini kullanmaniz gerekir. Tabii yeterince iyi bir [zanaatkar]saniz.

english: You don't have to buy all your plantpots you know, you can make them yourself on a pottery wheel. If you're a good enough [craftsman/craftswoman], that is.
translation: Tüm saksilarinizi satin almaniz gerekmez, cömlek carkinda kendiniz yapabilirsiniz. Tabii yeterince iyi bir [zanaatkar]saniz.

english: Can you sell me something?
That depends on whether I have it to sell. What is it that you're looking for?
translation: Satacak kadar var mi bana bagli. Ne ariyorsun?

english: Some plant cure.
Plant cure, eh? I might have some put aside for myself. Tell you what, I'll sell you some plant cure for 25 coins if you like.
translation: Bitki ilaci, ha? Kendim icin ayirdigim biraz olabilir. Bak ne diyecegim, istersen sana 25 sikkeye bitki ilaci satarim.

english: I don't have enough money for that, I'm afraid.
translation: Korkarim bunun icin yeterli param yok.

english: Actually, I don't think I'd be able to carry it.
Yes, that sounds like a fair price.
No thanks, I can get that much cheaper elsewhere.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, baska yerde daha ucuza bulabilirim.

english: A bucket of compost.
A bucket of compost, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 35 coins if you like.
translation: Bir kova kompost mu? Yedek bir tane olabilir... Bak ne diyecegim, istersen 35 sikkeye satarim.

english: A rake.
A rake, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: Bir tirmik mi? Yedek bir tane olabilir... Bak ne diyecegim, istersen 15 sikkeye satarim.

english: A plant pot.
Eh, I suppose I can spare you a plant pot, but I'll want 40 coins for it.
translation: Eh, sanirim bir saksi verebilirim, ama 40 sikke istiyorum.

english: A watering can.
A watering can, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 25 coins if you like.
translation: Bir sulama kabi, ha? Yedek bir tane olabilir... Bak ne diyecegim, istersen 25 sikkeye satarim.

english: A gardening trowel.
A gardening trowel, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: Bahce küregi, ha? Yedek bir tane olabilir... Bak ne diyecegim, istersen 15 sikkeye satarim.

english: A seed dibber.
A seed dibber, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: Tohum ekme cubugu, ha? Yedek bir tane olabilir... Bak ne diyecegim, istersen 15 sikkeye satarim.

english: Forget it, you don't have anything I need.
translation: Bos ver, ihtiyacim olan hicbir seyin yok.

english: I'll come back another time.
I have a question for you.
Please enter the answer to the question.
No, try again.
Correct!
Would you look after my crops for me?
Okay, it's a deal.
No, that's too much.
Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: Bana tarimla ilgili tavsiyelerde bulunabilir misin?

english: Can you sell me something?
Some plant cure.
Yes, that sounds like a fair price.
No thanks, I can get that much cheaper elsewhere.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, baska yerde daha ucuza bulabilirim.

english: A bucket of compost.
A rake.
A plant pot.
(See more items)
A watering can.
A gardening trowel.
A seed dibber.
(See previous items)
Forget it.
I'll come back another time.
Ouch!
Are you alright?
I'm fine, I'm fine. Just a scratch.
If you're sure. Who are you?
Me? I'm Tarik.
That hat you're wearing doesn't look like it comes from around here?
translation: Basindaki sapka buralardan degil gibi görünüyor?

english: It was a present. My employer thought it would suit me. I'm not sure it does, though it does keep the sun off very well.
translation: Hediyeydi. Isverenim bana yakisacagini düsündü. Yakistigindan emin degilim, ama günesi cok iyi engelliyor.

english: Who is this employer?
Simon Templeton. He's an archaeologist. I worked as an assistant for him, though I haven't seen him since the plague business started, so I work for myself now.
translation: Simon Templeton. O bir arkeolog. Onun asistani olarak calisiyordum, ama veba salgini basladigindan beri onu görmedim, simdi kendi isimi yapiyorum.

english: I see. So what have you been up to?
Simon suggested that there might be riches to be found in this pyramid.
translation: Simon bu piramitte hazineler olabilecegini söyledi.

english: All I've found so far are injuries though.
translation: Ama su ana kadar sadece yaralar buldum.

english: Interesting... What can you tell me about this pyramid?
translation: Ilginc... Bu piramit hakkinda ne söyleyebilirsiniz?

english: Well, I'm not sure. It's called Jalsavrah apparently. It's a strange place.
translation: Sey, emin degilim. Görünüse göre adi Jalsavrah. Garip bir yer.

english: How so?
First of all, there's something odd about the doors. There's four of them, but three of them lead to an empty tomb.
translation: Öncelikle, kapilarda tuhaf bir sey var. Dört kapi var, ama ücü bos bir mezara aciliyor.

english: The other one is guarded by something, and whatever it is, it doesn't like visitors.
translation: Digeri ise bir sey tarafindan korunuyor ve her ne ise, ziyaretcileri sevmiyor.

english: The thing is, the doors seem to change around sometimes. It's all quite confusing.
translation: Mesele su ki, kapilar bazen yer degistiriyor gibi görünüyor. Hepsi oldukca kafa karistirici.

english: What's this thing guarding one of them.
I think it might be a mummy. It's not very friendly, but it does allow you to enter some of the rooms in the tomb. They are dangerous though.
translation: Sanirim bir mumya olabilir. Cok dost canlisi degil, ama mezardaki bazi odalara girmenize izin veriyor. Ancak bu odalar tehlikeli.

english: Well I'm not afraid of a little danger.
Are you sure? The place is full of poisonous snakes and scarabs along with some rather nasty mummies as well. You could die in there.
translation: Emin misin? Burasi zehirli yilanlar ve bok böcekleriyle dolu, ayrica oldukca kötü mumyalar da var. Orada ölebilirsin.

english: I managed to get into one room, but the next room was harder. My lockpicking skills weren't good enough. Maybe I should have taken a lockpick.
translation: Bir odaya girmeyi basardim, ama sonraki oda daha zordu. Kilit acma becerim yeterince iyi degildi. Belki de bir kilit acma aleti getirmeliydim.

english: It all sounds like fun to me. So, is there anything valuable in there?
translation: Bana eglenceli geliyor. Peki, orada degerli bir sey var mi?

english: There are lots of artefacts that you should be able to sell to a legitimate trader...
translation: Yasal bir tüccara satabilecegin bircok eser var...

english: Like your friend Simon Templeton?
Of course. He's as 'legitimate' as you can get.
Is there anything else of value in there?
translation: Orada baska degerli bir sey var mi?

english: I've heard a rumour that there is an ancient magic sceptre somewhere inside.
translation: Iceride eski bir sihirli asa oldugu söylentisini duydum.

english: Ah, now you've piqued my interest. What do you know about this sceptre?
translation: Ah, simdi ilgimi cektin. Bu asa hakkinda ne biliyorsun?

english: Not a lot. It's apparently made of gold and covered in jewels. It's supposed to have some magical powers as well.
translation: Fazla bir sey bilmiyorum. Görünüse göre altindan yapilmis ve mücevherlerle kapliymis. Ayrica bazi sihirli gücleri de varmis.

english: Magical powers? This sounds good. What are they?
translation: Sihirli gücler mi? Kulaga hos geliyor. Nelermis bunlar?

english: I'll let you know when I find it!
Not if I find it first!
Hey! if you find it, I deserve a share of the profits! You wouldn't have known it existed without my help.
translation: Hey! Eger bulursan, kârin bir kismini hak edersim! Benim yardimim olmasaydi varligindan haberdar olmazdin.

english: I'll think about it...
Yes, it's an odd place, isn't it?
translation: Evet, tuhaf bir yer, degil mi?

english: You've been inside? Did you find anything?
translation: Iceri girdin mi? Bir sey buldun mu?

english: Nothing of particular note...
Well if you do, I'd appreciate a share of any profits.
translation: Bulursan, kârin bir kismini paylasirsan sevinirim.

english: Right... I'll think about it...
Hello again.
Oh, hello. Any luck in the pyramid? I'd appreciate a cut of anything you find.
translation: Merhaba. Piramitte sansin yaver gitti mi? Buldugun her seyin bir kismini paylasirsan sevinirim.

english: Right... I'll be sure to let you know if I come across anything good...
translation: Tamam... Iyi bir sey bulursam sana haber veririm...

english: Great!
You show the artefact to Tarik.
Ohh... That looks nice. I'm looking forward to my cut.
translation: Ohh... Cok güzel görünüyor. Payimi sabirsizlikla bekliyorum.

english: Ah, yes... I'll bring it round later.
I'll be waiting...
You show the sceptre to Tarik.
Hey, look at this sceptre I found!
Wow! It looks very valuable. What's my share?
translation: Vay canina! Cok degerli görünüyor. Payim ne kadar?

english: Well given the work I had to go through to get it, I think I earned it all by myself.
translation: Onu elde etmek icin yaptigim onca cabayi düsünürsek, hepsini kendim hak ettim bence.

english: Hey, that's not fair. I told you about this pyramid!
translation: Hey, bu adil degil. Sana bu piramidi ben söylemistim!

english: The world is a harsh place. Live and learn.
translation: Dünya acimasiz bir yer. Yasa ve ögren.

english: Hello there.
Hello old bean. Is there something I can help you with?
Who are you?
My name is Tarquin Marjoribanks.
I'd be surprised if you haven't already heard of me?
Why would I have heard of you Mr. Marjoribanks?
translation: Neden sizi duymus olayim ki Bay Marjoribanks?

english: It's pronounced 'Marchbanks'!
You should know of me because I am a member of the royal family of Misthalin!
translation: Beni tanimalisin cünkü ben Misthalin kraliyet ailesinin bir üyesiyim!

english: Are you related to King Roald?
Oh yes! Quite closely actually.
I'm his 4th cousin, once removed on his mothers side.
translation: Onun annesi tarafindan dördüncü dereceden kuzeniyim.

english: Er... Okay. What are you doing here then?
translation: Er... Tamam. O zaman burada ne yapiyorsunuz?

english: I'm canoeing on the river! It's enormous fun! Would you like to know how?
translation: Nehirde kano yapiyorum! Cok eglenceli! Nasil yapildigini ögrenmek ister misiniz?

english: Could you teach me about canoes?
Well, you don't look like you have the skill to make a canoe.
translation: Kano yapma beceriniz yok gibi görünüyor.

english: You need to have at least level 12 woodcutting.
translation: En az 12. seviye odun kesme becerisine sahip olmaniz gerekir.

english: Once you are able to make a canoe it makes travel along the river much quicker!
translation: Kano yapmayi ögrendiginde nehirde cok daha hizli seyahat edebilirsin!

english: It's really quite simple. Just walk down to that tree on the bank and chop it down.
translation: Gercekten cok basit. Kiyida duran agaca dogru yürü ve onu kes.

english: When you have done that you can shape the log further with your axe to make a canoe.
translation: Bunu yaptiktan sonra baltanla kütügü sekillendirerek kano yapabilirsin.

english: My personal favourite is the Stable Dugout canoe. A finer craft you'll never see old bean!
translation: Benim en sevdigim kano, Stable Dugout kano. Daha güzel bir tekne göremezsin dostum!

english: A Stable Dugout canoe will take you pretty much the length of the Lum river.
translation: Stable Dugout kano ile Lum nehrinin neredeyse tamamini gecebilirsiniz.

english: Of course there are other canoes.
translation: Tabii ki baska kanolar da var.

english: Further up river, near the Barbarian Village, I saw some darned fool 'canoeing' on a log!
translation: Nehrin yukarisinda, Barbar Köyü yakinlarinda, bir kütük üzerinde “kano yapan” birkac aptal gördüm!

english: Unfortunately, you don't have the skill to create anything more than one of those logs. I dare say it will only get 1 stop down the river!
translation: Ne yazik ki, o kütüklerden daha fazlasini yapabilecek beceriniz yok. Nehrin sadece 1 duragini gecebilecegini söyleyebilirim!

english: Still, I'm sure it will satisfy one such as yourself.
translation: Yine de, senin gibi birini tatmin edeceginden eminim.

english: What's that supposed to mean?
Do not profane the royal house of Varrock by engaging me in further discourse you knave!
translation: Varrock kraliyet ailesini, benimle daha fazla konusarak kirletme, seni alcak!

english: Pfft! I doubt he even knows the King!
You seem to be quite handy with an axe though!
I'm sure you can build a Dugout canoe. Not as fine as a Stable Dugout but it will carry you 2 stops on the river.
translation: Eminim bir kano yapabilirsin. Stable Dugout kadar iyi olmasa da, nehirde 2 durak boyunca seni tasiyacaktir.

english: I should imagine it would suit your limited means.
What do you mean when you say 'limited means'?
Well, you're just an itinerant adventurer!
What possible reason would you have for cluttering up my river with your inferior water craft!
translation: Neden benim nehrimi senin kalitesiz teknenle kirletiyorsun?

english: Ah! Perfect! You can make a Stable Dugout canoe! One of those will carry you to any civilised place on the river.
translation: Ah! Mükemmel! Stable Dugout kano yapabilirsin! Bunlardan biri seni nehirdeki herhangi bir medeni yere götürür.

english: If you were of good pedigree I'd let you join my boat club. You seem to be one of those vagabond adventurers though.
translation: Eger iyi bir soydan gelseydin, seni tekne kulübüme alirdim. Ama sen o serseri maceracilardan biri gibi görünüyorsun.

english: Charming!
Be off with you rogue!
Well ... erm. You seem to be able to make a Waka!
Sounds fun, what's a Waka.
I've only ever seen one man on the river who uses a Waka. A big, fearsome looking fellow up near Edgeville.
translation: Nehirde Waka kullanan tek bir adam gördüm. Edgeville yakinlarinda, iri ve korkutucu görünümlü bir adam.

english: People say he was born in the Wilderness and that he is looking for a route back.
translation: Insanlar onun Wilderness'da dogdugunu ve geri dönüs yolunu aradigini söylüyor.

english: Is that true!
How should I know? I would not consort with such a base fellow!
translation: Ben nereden bileyim? Öyle asagilik bir adamla arkadaslik etmem!

english: No thanks, not right now.
Can you teach me about canoes?
translation: Bana kano hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Who are you?
Yes
No
Can you teach me about Canoeing?
translation: Bana kano hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Please feel free to use the pottery wheel, I won't be using it all the time. Put your pots in the kiln when you've made one.
translation: Cömlek carkini istedigin gibi kullanabilirsin, ben sürekli kullanmiyorum. Cömleklerini yaptiginda firina koy.

english: And make sure you tidy up after yourself!
What'you want?
Do you-
What? Speak up, I can't hear you!
Uhm... I'm just looking for some pickaxes! Do you have any?
Do I have any pickaxes? Do I? Of course I do, this is a pickaxe shop, isn't it!
translation: Kazmam var mi? Var mi? Tabii ki var, burasi kazma dükkani degil mi!

english: What? Stop mumbling!
I want a quest!
I don't have any lousy quests... I've got someone who's helping me already!
translation: Berbat görevlerim yok... Zaten bana yardim eden biri var!

english: Well, I say helping... he takes his merry time to do his chores, my son does.
translation: Yardim ediyor diyorum ama... oglum islerini yapmak icin bol bol zaman harciyor.

english: Then perhaps I can help in some way?
translation: O zaman belki ben bir sekilde yardimci olabilirim?

english: Pfft, I doubt it... maybe when my son fouls up again, but not now.
translation: Pfft, sanmiyorum... belki oglum yine isleri batirdiginda, ama simdi degil.

english: Nothing really.
Then clear off!
Do you have any pickaxes?
Do you have any quests?
Nothing really.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu var. Merhaba, selam, selam...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her türlü sey! Kuleler harika bir manzara sunuyor.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmeni tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Please excuse me, I'm rather busy.
Hey, I'm your contractor from Mahogany Homes, what did you want done?
translation: Merhaba, ben Mahogany Homes'tan müteahhidin, ne yapilmasini istiyorsun?

english: I'd like my sink fixed.
I'd like two Wooden tables built.
I'd like a Wooden cupboard built.
I'd like two Wooden shelves built.
I'd like my hat stand fixed.
I'd like two Oak tables built.
I'd like a Oak cupboard built.
I'd like two Oak shelves built.
I'd like two Teak tables built.
I'd like a Teak cupboard built.
I'd like two Teak shelves built.
I'd like two Mahogany tables built.
I'd like a Mahogany cupboard built.
I'd like two Mahogany shelves built.
I've finished with the work you wanted.
Thank you so much! Would you like a cup of tea before you go?
translation: Cok tesekkür ederim! Gitmeden önce bir fincan cay ister misiniz?

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks, I better be off.
Aaah, nothing like a nice cupppa tea!
translation: Aaah, güzel bir fincan cay gibisi yok!

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks.
Oh, hello. Have you got something you want preserving?
translation: Oh, merhaba. Korunmasi gereken bir seyin var mi?

english: Yes please.
Give it to me to look at then.
Not right now.
Well, you go kill things so I can stuff them, eh?
translation: Sen gidip bir seyler öldür, ben de onlari doldururum, olur mu?

english: What?
If you bring me a monster head or a very big fish, I can preserve it for you so you can mount it in your house.
translation: Bana bir canavar kafasi veya cok büyük bir balik getirirsen, onu senin icin koruyabilirim, böylece evine asabilirsin.

english: I hear there are all sorts of exotic creatures in the Slayer Tower -- I'd like a chance to stuff one of them!
translation: Slayer Tower'da her türlü egzotik yaratik oldugunu duydum - onlardan birini doldurma sansi istiyorum!

english: Don't be silly, I can't preserve that!
Killing a chicken is hardly worth boasting about!
translation: Bir tavugu öldürmek övünmeye deger bir sey degil!

english: That's a pretty ordinary fish, isn't it? Not really worth preserving.
translation: Bu oldukca siradan bir balik, degil mi? Korumaya degmez.

english: You should have seen the one that got away!
That's a mighty fine sea bass you've caught there.
I can preserve that for you for 1,000 coins.
translation: Bunu 1.000 sikke karsiliginda senin icin koruyabilirim.

english: Maybe another time.
There you go!
No thanks.
All right, come back if you change your mind, eh?
translation: Tamam, fikrini degistirirsen geri gel, olur mu?

english: Don't point that thing at me!
I can preserve that for you for 2,500 coins.
translation: Bunu 2.500 sikke karsiliginda senin icin koruyabilirim.

english: Goodness me! That thing's more of a weapon than a fish!
translation: Aman Tanrim! Bu sey balik degil, silah gibi!

english: I can preserve that for you for 3,500 coins.
translation: Bunu 3.500 sikke karsiliginda senin icin koruyabilirim.

english: That's quite a fearsome shark! You've done everyone a service by removing it from the sea!
translation: Bu oldukca korkutucu bir köpekbaligi! Onu denizden cikararak herkese bir iyilik yaptin!

english: I can preserve that for you for 5,000 coins.
translation: Bunu 5.000 sikke karsiliginda senin icin koruyabilirim.

english: That's a very fine crawling hand.
translation: Bu cok güzel bir sürünen el.

english: A cockatrice! Beautiful, isn't it? Look at the plumage!
translation: Bir cockatrice! Cok güzel, degil mi? Tüylerine bak!

english: I can preserve that for you for 2,000 coins.
translation: Bunu 2.000 sikke karsiliginda senin icin koruyabilirim.

english: My, he's a scary-looking fellow, isn't he? He'll look good on your wall!
translation: Vay canina, cok korkutucu bir yaratik, degil mi? Duvarinda cok güzel duracak!

english: I can preserve that for you for 4,000 coins.
translation: Bunu 4.000 sikke karsiliginda senin icin koruyabilirim.

english: A kurask? Splendid! Look at those horns!
translation: Bir kurask mi? Harika! Su boynuzlara bak!

english: I can preserve that for you for 6,000 coins.
translation: Bunu 6.000 sikke karsiliginda sizin icin koruyabilirim.

english: Goodness, an abyssal demon!
See how it's still glowing? I'll have to use some magic to preserve that.
translation: Hala parladigini görüyor musunuz? Bunu korumak icin biraz sihir kullanmam gerekecek.

english: I can preserve that for you for 12,000 coins.
translation: Bunu 12.000 sikke karsiliginda sizin icin koruyabilirim.

english: Three?! This must be a King Black Dragon!
translation: Üc tane mi?! Bu bir Kral Kara Ejderha olmali!

english: I'll have to get out my heavy duty tools -- this skin's as tough as iron!
translation: Agir hizmet aletlerimi cikarmam gerekecek - bu deri demir kadar sert!

english: I can preserve that for you for 50,000 coins.
translation: Bunu 50.000 sikke karsiliginda senin icin koruyabilirim.

english: That must be the biggest kalphite I've ever seen!
translation: Bu gördügüm en büyük kalphite olmali!

english: Preserving insects is always tricky. I'll have to be careful...
translation: Böcekleri korumak her zaman zordur. Dikkatli olmam gerekecek...

english: That's not the most impressive head I've seen but I think I can just about manage this one.
translation: Bu gördügüm en etkileyici kafa degil ama sanirim bunu halledebilirim.

english: This blue dragon smells like it's been dead for a remarkably long time. Even by my standards, it smells awful.
translation: Bu mavi ejderha, cok uzun süredir ölüymüs gibi kokuyor. Benim standartlarima göre bile kokusu berbat.

english: This hydra looks like it might fall to pieces soon. I'll have to be careful to preserve it properly.
translation: Bu hidra yakinda parcalara ayrilacak gibi görünüyor. Onu düzgün bir sekilde korumak icin dikkatli olmaliyim.

english: Yes please
Not right now
What?
No thanks
The killer appears from a closet, stabbing Tayten, who is reading a book.
translation: Katil dolaptan cikip kitap okuyan Tayten'i bicakliyor.

english: Gurgle...
Nooooo!
The killer slips a note under the door, and escapes using the closet.
translation: Katil kapinin altindan bir not birakir ve dolaptan kacar.

english: What's this? A note? I guess I should read it.
translation: Bu ne? Bir not mu? Sanirim okumaliyim.

english: Nilsal. Are you here to watch the ents with me?
translation: Nilsal. Benimle birlikte ents'leri izlemeye mi geldin?

english: I wasn't explicitly here for that, though I'm sure I could stop for a moment.
translation: Özellikle bunun için gelmedim, ama bir süreligine durabilirim.

english: You really should! They're such fascinating creatures. I could stay here for hours!
translation: Kesinlikle kalmalisin! Onlar çok ilginç yaratiklar. Saatlerce burada kalabilirim!

english: Greetings! Are you in need of refreshment?
translation: Merhaba! Bir seyler icmek ister misiniz?

english: Yes please.
What are you selling?
Only the most delicious infusion of the leaves of the tea plant. Grown in the exotic regions of this world. Buy yourself a cup !
translation: Sadece cay bitkisinin yapraklarindan yapilan en lezzetli infüzyon. Bu dünyanin egzotik bölgelerinde yetistiriliyor. Kendinize bir fincan alin!

english: No thanks.
Well, if you're sure. You know where to come if you do!
translation: Peki, emin misiniz? Isterseniz nereye geleceginizi biliyorsunuz!

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
You're the one who stole something from me!
Guardsguards!
Yes please.
What are you selling?
No thanks.
Stop pulling, we've plenty of time to see everything.
translation: Cekmeyi birak, her seyi görmek icin bolca vaktimiz var.

english: Aww, but miss, it's sooo exciting.
translation: Ama bayan, bu cok heyecan verici.

english: That man over there talks funny, miss.
That's because he's an art critic, dear. They have some very funny ideas.
translation: Cünkü o bir sanat elestirmeni, canim. Onlarin cok komik fikirleri vardir.

english: Go away. We don't want any.
I'm a friend of Jethick's, I have come to return a book he borrowed.
translation: Ben Jethick'in arkadasiyim, ödünc aldigi bir kitabi geri getirmeye geldim.

english: Oh... Why didn't you say, come in then.
translation: Oh... Neden söylemedin, iceri gel o zaman.

english: Thanks, I've been missing that.
Hi, I hear a woman called Elena is staying here.
translation: Merhaba, Elena adinda bir kadin burada kaliyormus diye duydum.

english: Yes she was staying here, but slightly over a week ago she was getting ready to go back. However she never managed to leave.
translation: Evet, burada kaliyordu, ama bir hafta kadar önce geri dönmeye hazirlaniyordu. Ancak hic ayrilmayi basaramadi.

english: My daughter Milli was playing near the west wall when she saw some shadowy figures jump out and grab her. Milli is upstairs if you wish to speak to her.
translation: Kizim Milli bati duvarinin yaninda oynarken, gölgeli figürlerin atlayip onu yakaladigini gördü. Milli yukarida, onunla konusmak isterseniz.

english: Any luck finding Elena yet?
Not yet...
I wish you luck, she did a lot for us.
translation: Iyi sanslar dilerim, bizim icin cok sey yapti.

english: Yes, she is safe at home now.
That's good to hear, she helped us a lot.
translation: Bunu duyduguma sevindim, bize cok yardimci oldu.

english: Good day friend.
Hello [player name]! Thanks again for your help with the dig.
translation: Merhaba Maceraci! Kazi calismalarina yardim ettigin icin tekrar tesekkürler.

english: Bartak used the design of the shield you extracted to recreate a shield like it. Even though the original shield was poorly made, the design itself was a good one.
translation: Bartak, cikardigin kalkanin tasarimini kullanarak benzer bir kalkan yapti. Orijinal kalkan kötü yapilmis olsa da, tasarimi iyiydi.

english: Perhaps there is some important knowledge that we have lost since the early, more war-like days of Dorgesh- Kaan.
translation: Belki de Dorgesh-Kaan'in savasci günlerinden beri kaybettigimiz önemli bilgiler vardir.

english: The helmet you helped to unearth has come in useful. I used it as a visual aid when I went to talk to the children in the nursery about our history.
translation: Kazida buldugunuz migfer cok isimize yaradi. Kresteki cocuklara tarihimizi anlatirken görsel bir yardimci olarak kullandim.

english: It's amazing that the ancient goblins' eyes were even smaller than a child's!
translation: Eski goblinlerin gözlerinin cocuklarinkinden bile kücük olmasi sasirtici!

english: Oldak examined the axe blade you dug up and found that it had a faint magical aura. It looks like the mace wasn't the only magical weapon our ancestors brought from the surface.
translation: Oldak, kazdigin balta bicagini inceledi ve üzerinde zayif bir büyülü aura oldugunu fark etti. Görünüse göre, atalarimizin yüzeyden getirdikleri tek büyülü silah mace degildi.

english: In fact, it could be that a lot of their equipment was magical. This means that either the ancient goblins were skilled magical craftsmen, or some other power was supplying them with magical equipment.
translation: Aslinda, ekipmanlarinin cogu büyülü olabilir. Bu, ya eski goblinlerin yetenekli büyülü zanaatkarlar oldugu ya da baska bir gücün onlara büyülü ekipman sagladigi anlamina gelir.

english: We used the armour fragment you unearthed to reconstruct the shape of the original armour, and with it the shape of the goblin who wore the armour.
translation: Kazidigin zirh parcasini kullanarak orijinal zirhin seklini ve zirhi giyen goblinin seklini yeniden olusturduk.

english: This told us a lot about how the goblin body shape changed from its surface form to that of the cave goblins.
translation: Bu, goblinlerin vücut seklinin yüzeydeki halinden magara goblinlerinin sekline nasil degistigi hakkinda bize cok sey ögretti.

english: When we examined the sword you dug up, we found that the blade is covered in tiny symbols.
translation: Kazidigin kilici inceledigimizde, kilicin bicaginin kücük sembollerle kapli oldugunu gördük.

english: The scribe thinks he has enough of them to begin understanding the ancient goblin language, but it will take a while for him to decipher them.
translation: Yazman, eski goblin dilini anlamaya baslamak icin yeterli sayida sembol oldugunu düsünüyor, ancak bunlari desifre etmesi biraz zaman alacak.

english: I lost the ancient goblin mace.
I know. Zanik says she found it lying around in the caves near the city, almost as if it had made its way back here and wanted her to find it.
translation: Biliyorum. Zanik, onu sehir yakinlarindaki magaralarda buldugunu söylüyor, sanki buraya geri dönmüs ve onun bulmasini istemis gibi.

english: I know. We found it lying around in the caves near the city, almost as if it had made its way back here and wanted to be found.
translation: Biliyorum. Onu sehir yakinlarindaki magaralarda bulduk, sanki buraya geri dönmüs ve bulunmak istemis gibi.

english: If you want it back, I will sell it to you for 1,000 coins. That should discourage you from losing it again.
translation: Geri istiyorsan, sana 1.000 sikkeye satarim. Bu, onu bir daha kaybetmemeni saglar.

english: Okay.
But I'll have to go and get the money.
But I should free up some inventory space first.
translation: Ama önce depoda yer acmam lazim.

english: Look after it well. All the goblins who have handled it say it made them feel uneasy. We want it kept safe, but we don't want it near the city.
translation: Ona iyi bak. Onu eline alan tüm goblinler, kendilerini tedirgin hissettiklerini söylüyorlar. Onu güvende tutmak istiyoruz, ama sehrin yakininda olmasini istemiyoruz.

english: No way!
Suit yourself.
What have you learned about the artefacts we dug up?
translation: Kazi yaptigimiz eserler hakkinda ne ögrendin?

english: I lost the ancient goblin mace
Okay
No way
So, you're doing laundry, eh?
Yes. What is it to you?
Nice day for it.
I suppose it is.
Do you know any way to remove blood stains?
translation: Kan lekelerini cikarmak icin bir yol biliyor musun?

english: Blood stains is it... Well, the soap I use can clean almost any stain.
translation: Kan lekeleri mi... Kullandigim sabun neredeyse her lekeyi cikarabilir.

english: Really?!? That sounds like just the thing I need, can I use some?
translation: Gercekten mi?!? Tam da ihtiyacim olan sey gibi, biraz kullanabilir miyim?

english: No, I don't have very much soap left and I still have lots to get clean.
translation: Hayir, sabunum cok az kaldi ve hala temizlemem gereken cok sey var.

english: Alright can you tell me where I can buy some?
translation: Peki, nereden satin alabilecegimi söyleyebilir misin?

english: You can't... I make it to my own secret recipe.
translation: Satin alamazsin... Kendi gizli tarifimle yapiyorum.

english: Could you be less helpful?
Like you were, taking those robes from my washing line?? So yes, if you know a way I can be less helpful just tell me. I'll try it.
translation: Senin, camasir ipimden o cüppeleri alirken yaptigin gibi mi? Evet, daha az yardimci olmanin bir yolunu biliyorsan, söyle bana. Deneyecegim.

english: Nilsal, iknami. Are you in need of some runes?
translation: Nilsal, iknami. Rünlere ihtiyacin var mi?

english: Yes please.
Where do you get your runes from?
A few different places. Used to be that they were mostly from old stockpiles or from trading with the Dwarves of Cam Torum. Now that trade has opened with the east, I get a lot imported as well.
translation: Birkaç farkli yerden. Eskiden çogunlukla eski stoklardan veya Cam Torum'daki cücelerle ticaret yaparak temin ederdik. Artik dogu ile ticaret açildigindan, çok sayida ithal de ediyorum.

english: Old stockpiles? What do you mean?
translation: Eski stoklar mi? Ne demek istiyorsun?

english: The Old Ones had some way to create runes, but we've never discovered how they did so. I'm guessing the dwarves did though, given they never seem to run short on them...
translation: Eskiler runeleri yaratmanin bir yolunu bulmuslardi, ama biz bunu nasil yaptiklarini hiç kesfedemedik. Cüceler ise bunu kesfetmis olmalilar, çünkü runeleri hiç bitmiyor gibi görünüyor...

english: Anyway, after they died, the Old Ones left plenty of runes behind. Some of the earliest settlers here then stockpiled them.
translation: Her neyse, Eskiler öldükten sonra geride bol miktarda runeler biraktilar. Buradaki ilk yerlesimcilerden bazilari bunlari stokladi.

english: I see. Thanks for the information.
Don't mention it, iknami. Now, would you like to buy some runes?
translation: Önemli degil, iknami. Simdi, biraz rün satin almak ister misin?

english: Not right now, thanks.
Fair enough, iknami. Timoiva for now.
Yes please.
Where do you get your runes from?
Not right now, thanks.
Hi.
Greetings young one. What is it you wish to know?
translation: Selam genc dostum. Ne bilmek istiyorsun?

english: What do I have to do in this room?

In this room you will see a maze within which one of my fellow Guardians has been turned to stone for the purposes of this exercise. You must move the statue using your telekinetic grab spell to the exit square at
translation: Bu odada, bu alistirma icin arkadaslarimdan biri tasa dönüstürülmüs bir labirent göreceksin. Telekinetik yakalama büyünü kullanarak heykeli labirentin kenarindaki cikis karesine tasiyarak

english: the edge of the maze to bring the Guardian back to life. Simply stand on the side that you wish for the statue to travel towards and cast the spell on the statue. Once you have solved the maze, the statue will change back
translation: Guardian'i hayata döndürmelisin. Heykelin gitmesini istedigin tarafa gec ve heykelin üzerine büyüyü yap. Labirenti cözdügünde, heykel tekrar

english: into the Guardian and he will award you with Telekinetic Pizazz Points and teleport you to the next maze. You can switch to a better view of the maze by selecting the 'Observe' option on the statue and return
translation: Muhafiz'a dönüsecek ve sana Telekinetik Pizazz Puanlari verecek ve bir sonraki labirente isinlayacak. Heykelin üzerindeki ‘Gözlemle’ secenegini secerek labirentin daha iyi bir görüntüsüne gecebilir ve

english: your view to normal by selecting the same option again. There is also a 'Reset' option on the statue just in case things aren't going too well.
translation: ayni secenegi tekrar secerek görüntüyü normale döndürebilirsin. Isler pek iyi gitmezse diye heykelde bir de ‘Sifirla’ secenegi bulunmaktadir.

english: What are the rewards?

As well as the experience in casting magic, you will get Telekinetic Pizazz Points for each maze successfully solved and bonus points for completing five mazes in a row without returning to the entrance.
translation: Büyü yapma deneyiminin yani sira, basariyla cözdügünüz her labirent icin Telekinetik Pizazz Puanlari ve girise dönmeden arka arkaya bes labirenti tamamladiginizda bonus puanlar kazanacaksiniz.

english: Got any tips that may help me?
translation: Bana yardimci olabilecek herhangi bir ipucunuz var mi?

english: Have a good look at the maze before you try to solve it because this can save you time and runes required to navigate the maze. Although you will still be getting magic experience for moving the statue incorrectly, you
translation: Cözmeye baslamadan önce labirenti iyice inceleyin, cünkü bu size zaman ve labirenti gecmek icin gereken rünlerden tasarruf etmenizi saglayabilir. Heykeli yanlis hareket ettirseniz de büyü deneyimi kazanmaya devam edersiniz, ancak

english: won't be progressing towards collecting Telekinetic Pizazz Points. Lastly, all the mazes can be solved in ten moves or less.
translation: Telekinetik Pizazz Puanlari toplamaya devam edemezsiniz. Son olarak, tüm labirentler on hamle veya daha az hamlede cözülebilir.

english: Thanks, bye!
Use what you've learned, young one.
What do I have to do in this room?
What are the rewards?
Got any tips that may help me?
translation: Bana yardimci olabilecek herhangi bir ipucun var mi?

english: Thanks, bye!
You! Time for some questions.
Why did you join the Emissaries?
To do my duty, of course. Ralos and Ranul wish us to bring about the end of this world. Only then will we see the birth of a new one.
translation: Görevimi yapmak icin, elbette. Ralos ve Ranul bu dünyanin sonunu getirmemizi istiyorlar. Ancak o zaman yeni bir dünyanin dogusunu görebiliriz.

english: To do my duty, of course. Ralos and Ranul wish us to bring about the end of this world. Only then will we will all unite in Mictl.
translation: Görevimi yerine getirmek icin elbette. Ralos ve Ranul bu dünyanin sonunu getirmemizi istiyorlar. Ancak o zaman hepimiz Mictl'de birlesebilecegiz.

english: Who do you worship?
I worship both Ralos and Ranul equally, for in reality they are one. They have been separated for now, but soon they will rejoin once more.
translation: Ralos ve Ranul'a esit derecede tapiyorum, cünkü gercekte onlar birdir. Su anda ayrilmis durumdalar, ama yakinda tekrar birlesecekler.

english: Tell me about the Final Dawn.
The Final Dawn is our destiny. Ralos and Ranul will unite us all and end this world, but in doing so, we will all play a part in forming a new one.
translation: Son Safak bizim kaderimizdir. Ralos ve Ranul hepimizi birlestirecek ve bu dünyayi sona erdirecek, ama bunu yaparken hepimiz yeni bir dünyanin olusumunda rol oynayacagiz.

english: The Final Dawn is our destiny. Ralos and Ranul will unite us all and end this world, but in doing so, they will grant us eternal life in Mictl.
translation: Son Safak bizim kaderimizdir. Ralos ve Ranul hepimizi birlestirecek ve bu dünyayi sona erdirecek, ama bunu yaparken bize Mictl'de sonsuz yasam verecekler.

english: Why did you join the Emissaries?
Who do you worship?
Tell me about the Final Dawn.
You knock on the door.
No milk today! Thank you!
Can I buy some Climbing boots?
Sure, I'll sell you some in your size for 12 gold.
translation: Tabii, sana 12 altin karsiliginda senin bedeninde olanlari satarim.

english: OK, sounds good.
I don't have the money on me.
Was there anything else?
No, thanks.
What does a Sherpa do?
We are expert guides that take adventurers, such as yourself, on mountaineering expeditions.
translation: Biz, senin gibi maceracilari dagcilik gezilerine götüren uzman rehberleriz.

english: How did you find out about the secret way?
I used to take adventurers up Death Plateau and further north before the trolls came. I know these mountains well.
translation: Troller gelmeden önce maceracilari Ölüm Platosu'na ve daha kuzeye götürürdüm. Bu daglari iyi bilirim.

english: Nice place you have here.
Thanks, I built it myself! I'm usually self sufficient but I can't earn any money with the trolls camped on Death Plateau.
translation: Tesekkürler, kendim yaptim! Genelde kendi kendime yetiyorum ama Ölüm Platosu'nda troller kamp kurdugu icin para kazanamiyorum.

english: Now that the Imperial Guard know about the secret way they will be able to destroy the trolls!
translation: Artik Imparatorluk Muhafizlari gizli yolu ögrendigine göre troller yok edilebilecek!

english: Let us hope so traveller!
Nothing, thanks!
Can I buy some Climbing boots?
OK, sounds good.
No, thanks.
What does a Sherpa do?
How did you find out about the secret way?
Nice place you have here.
Nothing, thanks!
Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: Hey, bu Kahraman! Vay canina! Sen harikasin, o iki juvinate ve Gadderank'i nasil alt ettin? Kasaba da cok güzel, harika bir is cikarmissin!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
I'm Teodor, I be a farmer, oh arrr....and what can I do for you?
translation: Ben Teodor, ciftciyim, oh arrr... Senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: Oh, pek bir sey yok, hepimiz hala vampirlerden saklaniyoruz ve bu korkunc yerde gecimimizi sagliyoruz, umarim yakinda Salve'deki tapinaga yolculuk yapacak kadar gücleniriz.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: Bildigim kadariyla yok, su anda cok yararli olan bazi temel olanaklara sahibiz, hepimiz size cok minnettariz. Daha önce hic bir kahraman görmedim veya tanimadim, bu yüzden karsilastirma yapabilecegim bir sey yok, ama sanirim

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: cogu insanin görüsüne göre, siz bir kahramansiniz! Ben sahsen sizinle tanistigima cok memnunum.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Ok, thanks.
Hello again.Was that translation any use to Asgarnia?
translation: Merhaba tekrar. Bu ceviri Asgarnia icin yararli oldu mu?

english: I think it was, thanks!
Hello again. I am now studying this mysterious altar and its inhabitants. The markings are strange...
translation: Merhaba tekrar. Su anda bu gizemli sunak ve sakinlerini inceliyorum. Isaretler cok garip...

english: It refers to a god I have never heard of before, named Zaros. It must be some pagan superstition.
translation: Daha önce hic duymadigim Zaros adinda bir tanriya atifta bulunuyor. Pagan bir batil inanc olmali.

english: That was a great find; who knows what other secrets lie buried beneath the surface of our land...
translation: Bu harika bir kesifti; kim bilir, topraklarimizin altinda baska hangi sirlar yatiyor...

english: That staff is incredible! It's the same symbol that was on that talisman you found here. Does this mean you've found out more about Zaros?
translation: Bu asa inanilmaz! Burada buldugun tilsimda da ayni sembol vardi. Bu, Zaros hakkinda daha fazla sey ögrendigin anlamina mi geliyor?

english: I found out that he was banished, and that the people's hero was trapped in a pyramid and...
translation: Onun sürgün edildigini ve halkin kahramaninin bir piramitte hapsoldugunu ögrendim ve...

english: So you're the one who found out about that. I've heard the story from my friends in the museum. Well done on being able to wield such an impressive symbol.
translation: Demek bunu sen ögrendin. Müzedeki arkadaslarimdan bu hikayeyi duydum. Böylesine etkileyici bir sembolü kullanabildigin icin tebrikler.

english: Anyway....
What do you think of this?
Do you know what this is?
Where did you get this?
From one of the barrels at the digsite.
This is a VERY dangerous liquid called nitroglycerin. Be careful how you handle it. Don't drop it or it will explode!
translation: Bu nitrogliserin adinda COK tehlikeli bir sivi. Dikkatli kullan. Düsürme, yoksa patlar!

english: Can you tell me any more about this?
translation: Bununla ilgili daha fazla bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Nitroglycerin! This is a dangerous substance. This is normally mixed with other chemicals to produce a potent compound.
translation: Nitrogliserin! Bu tehlikeli bir madde. Normalde diger kimyasallarla karistirilarak güclü bir bilesik olusturur.

english: Be sure not to drop it! That stuff is highly volatile...
translation: Düsürmemeye dikkat et! Bu madde cok ucucudur...

english: Have a look at this.
Really, you do find the most unusual items. I know what this is - it's a strong chemical called ammonium nitrate. Why you want this I'll never know...
translation: Gercekten, cok sira disi seyler buluyorsun. Bunun ne oldugunu biliyorum - amonyum nitrat adi verilen güclü bir kimyasal. Neden bunu istedigini asla anlayamayacagim...

english: Hey, look at this.
Hmm, that looks dangerous. Handle it carefully and don't drop it!
translation: Hmm, tehlikeli görünüyor. Dikkatli kullan ve düsürme!

english: See what I have done with the compound now.
Seriously, I think you have a death wish! What on earth are you going to do with that stuff?
translation: Cidden, bence sen ölüm arzusun! O maddeyle ne yapacaksin ki?

english: I'll find a use for it!
What do you think about this?
What have you concocted now? Just be careful when playing with chemicals!
translation: Simdi ne uydurdun? Kimyasallarla oynarken dikkatli ol!

english: I have these gold nuggets...
I can't do much with these nuggets yet. Come back when you have 3 and I will exchange them for you.
translation: Bu külcelerle henüz pek bir sey yapamam. 3 tane topladiginda geri gel, senin icin takas edeyim.

english: Good – that's three; I can exchange them for normalgold now. You can get this refined and make a profit!
translation: Güzel, üc tane oldu, simdi normal altinla degistirebilirim. Bunu rafine edip kar elde edebilirsin!

english: Excellent!
I found a needle.
Hmm, yes; I wondered why this race were so well dressed! It looks like they had mastery of needlework.
translation: Hmm, evet, bu irkin neden bu kadar iyi giyindigini merak ediyordum! Görünüse göre igne isinde ustalarmis.

english: I found these...
Ew! Throw them away this instant!
Have a look at this glass.
Hey you should be careful of that. It might cut your fingers, throw it away!
translation: Hey, buna dikkat etmelisin. Parmaklarini kesebilir, at sunu!

english: Have a look at this arrow.
No doubt this arrow was shot by a strong warrior – it'ssplit in half! It is not a valuable object though.
translation: Bu ok, güclü bir savasci tarafindan atilmis olmali – ikiye bölünmüs! Ama degerli bir nesne degil.

english: I have no need for panning trays!
Have you searched this tray yet?
Not that I remember...
It may contain something; I don't want to get my hands dirty.
translation: Icinde bir sey olabilir; ellerimi kirletmek istemiyorum.

english: The expert hands the tray back to you.
Have a look at these bones.
Ah, yes – a fine bone example... no noticeable fractures...and in good condition. These are common cow bones,however; they have no archaeological value.
translation: Ah, evet – güzel bir kemik örnegi... göze carpan kirik yok... ve iyi durumda. Ancak bunlar siradan inek kemikleri; arkeolojik degeri yok.

english: I found these buttons.
Let's have a look. Ah, I think these are from the nobility, perhaps a royal servant?
translation: Bir bakalim. Ah, sanirim bunlar soylulara ait, belki de bir kraliyet hizmetkarina?

english: I found this rock...
What a shame it's cracked; this looks like it would have been a good sample.
translation: Ne yazik ki catlamis; iyi bir örnek olabilirdi.

english: Hey look at this.
Oh, an old tooth. It looks like it has come from a mighty being. Pity there are no tooth fairies around here!
translation: Oh, eski bir dis. Güclü bir varliga ait gibi görünüyor. Ne yazik ki buralarda dis perisi yok!

english: I found an old sword.
Oh, it's very rusty isn't it? I'm not sure this sword belongs here, it looks very out of place.
translation: Oh, cok paslanmis, degil mi? Bu kilicin buraya ait oldugundan emin degilim, buraya hic uymuyor gibi görünüyor.

english: Have a look at this staff.
Look at this... Interesting... This appears to belong to a cleric of some kind; certainly not a follower of Saradomin, however.
translation: Suna bak... Ilginc... Bu bir tür rahibe ait gibi görünüyor; ancak kesinlikle Saradomin'in takipcisi degil.

english: I wonder if there was another civilization here before the Saradominists?
translation: Saradoministler'den önce burada baska bir medeniyet var miydi acaba?

english: I found some armour.
It looks like the wearer of this fought a mighty battle.
translation: Görünüse göre bunlari giyen kisi güclü bir savasta savasmis.

english: I found some old armour.
How unusual. This armour doesn't seem to match with the other finds. Keep looking.
translation: Ne kadar sira disi. Bu zirh diger buluntularla uyusmuyor gibi görünüyor. Aramaya devam et.

english: I found some pottery pieces.
Yes, many parts are discovered. The inhabitants of these parts were great potters.
translation: Evet, bircok parca kesfedildi. Bu bölgenin sakinleri harika cömlekcilerdi.

english: You mean they were good at using potions?
No, no, silly. They were known for their skill with clay.
translation: Hayir, hayir, aptal. Kil isciligindeki becerileriyle taninirlardi.

english: Have a look at this unusual item...
translation: Su sira disi esyaya bir bak...

english: Let me see. This is a belt buckle. Not so unusual - I should imagine it came from a guard.
translation: Bir bakayim. Bu bir kemer tokasi. O kadar da sira disi degil - muhtemelen bir muhafizdan kalma.

english: Hmm, an interesting find; an animal skull for sure. Another student found one just like this today.
translation: Hmm, ilginc bir buluntu; kesinlikle bir hayvan kafatasi. Baska bir ögrenci de bugün aynisindan buldu.

english: Looks like an award cup for some small find. Perhaps it belongs to one of the students?
translation: Kücük bir buluntu icin ödül kupasi gibi görünüyor. Belki de ögrencilerin birine aittir?

english: Why, it looks like a teddy bear to me. Perhaps someone's lucky mascot!
translation: Bana ayicik gibi görünüyor. Belki de birinin ugurlu maskotudur!

english: Ah yes, an old boot. Not really an ancient artefact, is it?
translation: Ah evet, eski bir cizme. Pek de eski bir eser sayilmaz, degil mi?

english: The expert has already seen the talisman.
There's no point in giving me this back!
translation: Bunu bana geri vermenin bir anlami yok!

english: I found this in a hidden cavern beneath the digsite.
translation: Bunu kazi alaninin altindaki gizli bir magarada buldum.

english: Incredible!
There is an altar down there. The place is crawling with skeletons!
translation: Orada bir sunak var. Yer iskeletlerle dolu!

english: Yuck!
This is an amazing discovery! All this while we were convinced that no other race had lived here.
translation: Bu inanilmaz bir kesif! Bunca zaman burada baska bir irkin yasamadigini düsünmüstük.

english: It seems the followers of Saradomin have tried to cover up the evidence of the Zaros altar. This whole city must have been built over it!
translation: Görünüse göre Saradomin'in takipcileri Zaros'un sunaklarinin izlerini örtbas etmeye calismislar. Bütün sehir bunun üzerine insa edilmis olmali!

english: Thanks for your help; your sharp eyes have spotted what many have missed. Here, take this gold as your reward.
translation: Yardimin icin tesekkürler; keskin gözlerin bircok kisinin gözden kacirdigi seyi fark etti. Al, bu altin ödülün olsun.

english: QUEST COMPLETED!
I don't need another tablet! One is enough, thank you.
translation: Baska bir tablet istemiyorum! Bir tane yeter, tesekkürler.

english: I don't think that has any archaeological significance
translation: Bunun arkeolojik bir önemi oldugunu sanmiyorum.

english: Ask about the Desert Treasure I quest.
Ask about the Digsite quest.
Hello there. What do you do here?
Ah, I'm just keeping an eye on things and making sure nothing untoward happens.
translation: Ah, sadece göz kulak oluyorum ve ters bir sey olmamasi icin dikkat ediyorum.

english: That's reassuring.
One day I hope it will be.
Ah, [player name], it's good to see you again.
translation: Ah, Maceraci, seni tekrar görmek ne güzel.

english: Hello there, Thaerisk. Any word on Lucien?
translation: Merhaba, Thaerisk. Lucien'den haber var mi?

english: Nothing yet, but we're doing everything we can to find him. I hope he's ready for us, because once we do locate him, we're going to give him quite the bloody nose...
translation: Henüz yok, ama onu bulmak icin elimizden geleni yapiyoruz. Umarim bize hazirdir, cünkü onu buldugumuzda burnunu kanatacagiz......

english: ... or at least whatever passes for a nose on a Mahjarrat!
translation: ya da en azindan Mahjarrat'in burnu sayilabilecek seyi!

english: Thank you for leading the Burgher's militia against the Troll King.
translation: Troll Krali'na karsi Burgher milislerini yönettigin icin tesekkürler.

english: Now that the trolls are leaderless I have repaired the bridge to the central isle for you as best I can.
translation: Artik trollerin lideri yok, bu yüzden senin icin elinden geldigince merkezi adaya giden köprüyü onardim.

english: Thanks Thakkrad. Does that mean I have access to the runite ores on that island?
translation: Tesekkürler Thakkrad. Bu, o adadaki runite cevherlerine erisebilecegim anlamina mi geliyor?

english: Yes, you should be able to mine runite there if you wish.
translation: Evet, istersen orada runite madenciligi yapabilirsin.

english: Cure my yak-hide, please.
I will cure yak-hide for a fee of 5 gp per hide.
translation: Yak derisini deri basina 5 altin karsiliginda isleyebilirim.

english: You have no yak-hide to cure.
You don't have enough gold to pay me!
translation: Bana ödeme yapacak kadar altin yok!

english: There you go.
Bye.
Can you cure any other type of leather?
translation: Baska tür derileri de isleyebilir misin?

english: Other types of leather? Why would you need any other type of leather?
translation: Baska tür deriler mi? Neden baska tür derilere ihtiyacin olsun ki?

english: I'll take that as a no then.
translation: O zaman hayir olarak kabul ediyorum.

english: Nothing, thanks.
See you later.
You won't find anyone else who can cure yak-hide.
translation: Yak derisini isleyebilecek baska kimseyi bulamazsin.

english: Cure my yak-hide, please.
Cure all my hides.
Cure one hide.
Cure no hide.
Can you cure any other type of leather?
Nothing, thanks.
Hi there!
Can I have some more headgear?
The 'Wedge' gives you some more headgear.
Who are you?
Call me The 'Wedge', I'm the taskmaster for the Achievement Diary here in Kandarin.
translation: Bana “Wedge” de, ben Kandarin'deki Basari Günlügü'nün görev sorumlusuyum.

english: What is the Achievement Diary?

It's a diary that helps you keep track of particular achievements. In and around Kandarin it can help you discover some quite useful things. Eventually, with enough exploration, the inhabitants will reward you.
translation: Belirli basarilari takip etmene yardimci olan bir günlüktür. Kandarin ve cevresinde oldukca yararli seyler kesfetmene yardimci olabilir. Yeterince kesif yaptiktan sonra, bölge sakinleri seni ödüllendirecektir.

english: You can see the list of tasks on the side-panel.
I have a question about my Achievement Diary.
translation: Basari Günlügümle ilgili bir sorum var.

english: Well, there are four different Kandarin headgears, which match up with the four levels of difficulty. Each has the same rewards as the previous level and some additional benefits too... which tier of rewards would you
translation: Kandarin'de dört farkli zorluk seviyesine karsilik gelen dört farkli baslik vardir. Her biri bir önceki seviyeyle ayni ödüllere ve bazi ek avantajlara sahiptir... Hangi ödül seviyesini

english: like to know more about?
Tell me more about the Easy rewards please!
translation: Kolay ödüller hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin lütfen!

english: If you complete all of the easy tasks in Kandarin, the headgear functions as a light source and you have a chance of receiving an extra log when cutting normal trees. You can get the flax keeper to convert 30 flax
translation: Kandarin'deki tüm kolay görevleri tamamlarsaniz, baslik bir isik kaynagi olarak islev görür ve normal agaclari keserken ekstra bir kütük alma sansiniz olur. Keten bekcisine her gün 30 keten

english: to bowstrings each day, coal trucks hold up to 140 coal and you'll find 5% more marks of grace on Seers' rooftop agility course.
translation: ipligi yay ipi haline getirmesini saglayabilirsiniz, kömür kamyonlari 140 kömür tasiyabilir ve Seers'in catidaki ceviklik parkurunda %5 daha fazla lütuf isareti bulabilirsiniz.

english: Thanks!
Tell me more about the Medium rewards please!
translation: Orta zorlukta ödüller hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin lütfen!

english: In addition to the easy rewards, cutting maples in Seers' village provides 10% more experience. You can spin materials 33% faster at the spinning wheel, get the flax keeper to convert 60 flax to bowstrings each day,
translation: Kolay ödüllere ek olarak, Seers köyünde akcaagac kesmek %10 daha fazla deneyim saglar. Iplik carkinda malzemeleri %33 daha hizli egirebilir, keten bekcisine her gün 60 keten ipi yay ipi haline getirtir

english: and the Catherby herb patch provides a 5% higher crop yield. Coal trucks will hold up to 280 coal too.
translation: ve Catherby ot bahcesi %5 daha fazla mahsul verimi saglar. Kömür kamyonlari da 280 kömür tasiyabilir.

english: Tell me more about the Hard rewards please!
translation: Zor ödüller hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verir misiniz?

english: In addition to the easy and medium benefits, Thormac will enchant battlestaves for 30,000 gold and you can move the Camelot teleport location to outside of Seers' bank. You'll find 15% more marks of grace on Seers'
translation: Kolay ve orta seviye avantajlara ek olarak, Thormac 30.000 altin karsiliginda savas asalarini büyülü hale getirecek ve Camelot teleport konumunu Seers'in bankasinin disina tasiyabileceksiniz. Seers'in catisinda %15 daha fazla lütuf isareti bulacak,

english: rooftop, receive 10% higher yield from Catherby farming patch, get the flax keeper to convert 120 flax to bowstrings each day, and get 10% more points from Barbarian Assault as well one free daily teleport to
translation: Catherby tarim bahcesinden %10 daha fazla verim alacak, keten bekcisinin her gün 120 keten ipligini yay ipi haline getirmesini saglayacak ve Barbarian Assault'tan %10 daha fazla puan ve Sherlock'a günlük bir ücretsiz teleport hakki kazanacaksiniz.

english: Sherlock. Your chances of having an enchanted bolt use it's special attack has increased by 10% too.
translation: Sherlock. Büyülü oklarin özel saldirilarini kullanma sansiniz da %10 artti.

english: Tell me more about the Elite rewards please!
translation: Elit ödüller hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin lütfen!

english: In addition to the previous tiers of rewards, Thormac now enchants battlestaves for 20,000 gold, Otto will provide a 50% discount when converting Zamorakian spears into hastae. You'll get unlimited teleports to
translation: Önceki ödül kademelerine ek olarak, Thormac artik 20.000 altin karsiliginda savas asalarini büyülüyor, Otto Zamorakian mizraklarini hastae'ye dönüstürürken %50 indirim sagliyor. Sherlock'a sinirsiz teleport

english: Sherlock and 15% increased yield from Catherby herb patch and can get the flax keeper to convert 250 flax to bow strings every day. The first 200 coal placed in coal trucks every day will be automatically transported
translation: ve Catherby ot bahcesinden %15 daha fazla verim elde edeceksiniz ve keten bekcisinden her gün 250 ketenin yay ipi haline dönüstürülmesini saglayabilirsiniz. Her gün kömür kamyonlarina yerlestirilen ilk 200 kömür otomatik olarak

english: to your bank too.
How do I claim the rewards?
Just complete the tasks in Kandarin so they're ticked off, then come and speak to me for your rewards.
translation: Kandarin'deki görevleri tamamlayarak isaretleyin, ardindan ödülleriniz icin benimle konusun.

english: Bye!
See you around.
Can I have some more headgear?
Who are you?
I have a question about my Achievement Diary
translation: Basari Günlügümle ilgili bir sorum var.

english: What is the Achievement Diary?
What are the rewards?
Easy Rewards.
Medium Rewards.
Hard Rewards.
Elite Rewards.
How do I claim the rewards?
Bye!
Hello cat.
~The cat glowers back at you.
Friendly aren't you?
The large cat near the stairs glowers menacingly at you as you approach the stairs.
translation: Merdivenlere yaklasirken merdivenlerin yanindaki büyük kedi sana tehditkar bir sekilde bakiyor.

english: I think I had better stay away from the stairs for now.
translation: Simdilik merdivenlerden uzak dursam iyi olacak.

english: It's beautiful, isn't it?
What is?
Everything! The wonders right here in this museum, collected from all corners of the land.
translation: Her sey! Bu müzede, ülkenin dört bir yanindan toplanmis harikalar.

english: I guess it is, you're right.
Matter of fact, I consider myself quite the collector. I keep a record of just about everything that I find!
translation: Aslinda, kendimi oldukca iyi bir koleksiyoncu olarak görüyorum. Buldugum her seyi kayit altina aliyorum!

english: Would you like one? You could keep track of your own collections.
translation: Bir tane ister misin? Kendi koleksiyonlarini takip edebilirsin.

english: Yes, that sounds helpful!
No thanks. I think I'll pass.
I should've guessed you wouldn't understand the true beauty of a good collection!
translation: Iyi bir koleksiyonun gercek güzelligini anlamayacagini tahmin etmeliydim!

english: There! Now you'll be able to see the true beauty of everything you collect on your adventures.
translation: Iste! Artik maceralarinda topladigin her seyin gercek güzelligini görebileceksin.

english: Thanks!
You might struggle to carry that right now.
Oh... I'll come back when I'm carrying a little less.
translation: Oh... Biraz daha hafifledigimde geri gelirim.

english: Don't you have one lying around somewhere already?
translation: Zaten bir tane yok mu sende?

english: I think you're right!
Could you count how many uniques I've obtained in my collection?
translation: Koleksiyonumda kac tane essiz parca oldugunu sayabilir misin?

english: I'd love to count everything you've collected on your adventures, although you might want to take a seat this could take a while.
translation: Maceralarinda topladigin her seyi saymak isterim, ama oturman iyi olabilir, bu biraz zaman alabilir.

english: The collector starts counting the items in your collection.
From what I can see you have collected [number] in your collection!
I see you are just starting out on your collecting adventure. I wish you luck!
translation: Koleksiyon macerasina yeni basladigini görüyorum. Sana sans diliyorum!

english: You've made a good start at filling your collection, keep at it!
translation: Koleksiyonunu doldurmaya iyi bir baslangic yaptin, devam et!

english: You're starting to get a hang of this collecting business!
You have a very respectable collection indeed, one day you'll have a better collection than me!
translation: Gercekten cok saygideger bir koleksiyonun var, bir gün benimkinden daha iyi bir koleksiyonun olacak!

english: Now that's an impressive collection, I haven't seen many with a collection better than yours!
translation: Bu gercekten etkileyici bir koleksiyon, seninkinden daha iyi bir koleksiyon görmedim!

english: Colour me impressed, you've collected more items than me, I look forward to seeing your collection grow even more!
translation: Etkilendim, benden daha fazla esya topladin, koleksiyonunun daha da büyümesini sabirsizlikla bekliyorum!

english: Wait, you finished it? You actually finished the entire collection? I never thought that was even possible!
translation: Bekle, bitirdin mi? Gercekten tüm koleksiyonu bitirdin mi? Bunun mümkün oldugunu hic düsünmemistim!

english: This... idea! The idea of something nice! Those nice little tokens!
translation: Bu... fikir! Güzel bir sey fikri! O güzel kücük simgeler!

english: What tokens?
Oh, er... never you mind!
I have some tokens!
Only some? Well you need more! Until you have them, I should get going...
translation: Sadece biraz mi? Daha fazlasina ihtiyacin var! Onlari alana kadar, ben gitmeliyim...

english: Oh yes, I've got this wonderful collection of tokens!
translation: Oh evet, harika bir jeton koleksiyonum var!

english: May I see them?
Yes, here they are.
May I have them?
Yes, I suppose you can.
No.
Fine.
Yes.
No thanks.
Yes, here they are.
Yes, I suppose you can.
No.
Your collection is one of the finest I've seen, it's almost on par with mine!!
translation: Koleksiyonunuz gördüklerimin en iyilerinden biri, neredeyse benimkiyle ayni seviyede!

english: I can officially say that you are now an elite collector and few can stand as your equal in that regard.
translation: Resmi olarak söyleyebilirim ki, artik seçkin bir koleksiyoncisiniz ve bu konuda size denk çok az kisi var.

english: As an accomplished collector I'd like to offer you a special reward.
translation: Basarili bir koleksiyoncuyken size özel bir ödül vermek istiyorum.

english: Actually, it appears you already have all the rewards I'd like to give you.
translation: Aslinda, vermek istedigim tüm ödüllere zaten sahip görünüyorsunuz.

english: Your collection is maturing well, you're making great strides to becoming a top collector, keep it up!
Woah! What's going on here? There are so many bunnies!
translation: Vay canina! Burada neler oluyor? Cok fazla tavsan var!

english: I don't know what happened, things happened so quickly.
translation: Ne oldugunu bilmiyorum, her sey cok hizli oldu.

english: This certainly seems like a hare-y situation, where did you get them all?
translation: Bu kesinlikle tavsanlarla dolu bir durum gibi görünüyor, hepsini nereden buldun?

english: I didn't, they just kept jumping out of my hat.
What do you mean? Are you a wizard?
translation: Ne demek istiyorsun? Sen bir büyücü müsün?

english: Wizard? No, I'm just a street magician, they call me The Disappointing Gelt. I was out here practicing my tricks and things went south quickly.
translation: Büyücü mü? Hayir, ben sadece bir sokak sihirbaziyim, bana Hayal Kirikligi Gelt derler. Burada numaralarimi calisiyordum ve isler bir anda ters gitti.

english: Don't tell me, you were trying to pull a rabbit out of your hat and you accidentally pulled out hundreds?
translation: Sakin söyleme, sapkanizdan bir tavsan cikarmaya calisiyordunuz ve yanlislikla yüzlerce tavsan cikardiniz mi?

english: Well... yes, some old guy gave me these magical looking stones, so I thought I'd practice my act with them.
translation: Sey... evet, yasli bir adam bana bu sihirli görünen taslari verdi, ben de onlarla numaralarimi calisayim dedim.

english: The magician shows you some rune stones.
translation: Sihirbaz size bazi rün taslari gösterir.

english: You do know these are rune stones, they're used in actual magic.
translation: Bunlarin rune taslari oldugunu biliyorsun, gercek sihirde kullanilirlar.

english: You're chatting rubbish... real magic doesn't exist.
translation: Sacmaliyorsun... gercek sihir diye bir sey yoktur.

english: Then how did all these rabbits appear?
translation: O zaman bu tavsanlar nasil ortaya cikti?

english: I don't know, I put the runes in my hat, said the magic words 'Rabbaradoo' and stuck my hand in and felt something fuzzy. When I pulled my hand back, I was holding a rabbit.
translation: Bilmiyorum, rune taslarini sapkama koydum, “Rabbaradoo” sihirli kelimesini söyledim ve elimi soktum ve tüylü bir sey hissettim. Elimi geri cektigimde, elimde bir tavsan vardi.

english: Mind if I take a look at your hat? I think there's more to this than meets the eye.
translation: Sapkana bakabilir miyim? Bence bu is göründügünden daha karmasik.

english: You take a look into the darkness of the magician's hat.
You see a glowing green portal staring back at you.
translation: Sana bakan parlak yesil bir portal görürsün.

english: Well Gelt, I don't know how you've done it, but it looks like you've opened a portal.
translation: Gelt, nasil yaptigini bilmiyorum ama bir portal acmissin gibi görünüyor....

english: Huh.
Please, you must help me, I beg you.
Ah, I mean, I'm pretty busy... but I suppose I can find the time to help you.
translation: Ah, yani, oldukca mesgulüm... ama sanirim sana yardim etmek icin zaman bulabilirim.

english: You put your hand in the hat and feel the portal start to pull you in.
translation: Elini sapkaya sokarsin ve portalin seni icine cekmeye basladigini hissedersin.

english: Player is teleported to The Rabbit Realm
Hello Gelt, I need to go back.
Please don't dawdle, I need you to fix this before the master of my order finds out.
translation: Lütfen oyalanma, tarikatimin lideri ögrenmeden bunu düzeltmen gerek.

english: I have returned.
Oh, please tell me you managed to do something?
translation: Oh, lütfen bir seyler yapabildigini söyle?

english: I'll be honest with you Gelt, it got a bit weird.
translation: Sana dürüst olacagim Gelt, biraz garip oldu.

english: What do you mean?
Somehow, you opened a portal to a dimension, very similar to ours, but run by rabbits instead of humans.
translation: Bir sekilde, bizimkine cok benzeyen ama insanlar yerine tavsanlar tarafindan yönetilen bir boyuta acilan bir portal actin.

english: That's incredible...
That's not even the weird bit! They live in a cult worshipping an egg, they ask it a question and whatever it says, they do.
translation: Garip olan bu bile degil! Bir yumurtayi tapan bir tarikatta yasiyorlar, yumurtaya bir soru soruyorlar ve yumurta ne derse onu yapiyorlar.

english: That's why they all started coming through, the Duke Rabbacio asked the egg if they should jump through and it said yes.
translation: Bu yüzden hepsi buraya gelmeye basladi, Dük Rabbacio yumurtaya atlamalari gerekip gerekmedigini sordu ve yumurta evet dedi.

english: What the...
It's a lot to take in, but I've managed to stop them jumping through for now, however I couldn't close the portal.
translation: Kabul etmesi zor, ama simdilik gecmelerini engelledim, ancak portali kapatamadim.

english: ...am I a god?
What?
Have I managed to conjure an alternate dimension with my own hands...
translation: Kendi ellerimle alternatif bir boyut yaratmayi basardim mi...

english: Hello? Gelt?
I'm the most powerful magician that has ever lived...
translation: Ben simdiye kadar yasamis en güclü büyücü...

english: No, you're not Gelt, you've used magic that's existed for millennia.
translation: Hayir, degilsin Gelt, binlerce yildir var olan büyüyü kullandin.

english: You have my thanks adventurer, when I return to my order, I'll report this to our leader, Magnus.
translation: Tesekkürler maceraci, tarikatima döndügümde bunu liderimiz Magnus'a rapor edecegim.

english: What will you do with all these rabbits?
Since you couldn't close the portal, I'll try usher them back in.
translation: Portali kapatamadigina göre, onlari geri götürmeye calisacagim.

english: Would you mind letting me return to Bunbridge? I feel I have some unfinished business.
translation: Bunbridge'e dönmeme izin verir misin? Bitmemis bir isim var gibi hissediyorum.

english: Not a problem if you wish to return just talk to me, I'll stay for a while longer.
translation: Dönmek istersen sorun degil, bana söyle, ben biraz daha kalacagim.

english: Feel free to keep anything you found there as well, as a thanks from me.
translation: Orada buldugun her seyi de alabilirsin, benden bir tesekkür olarak.

english: Thank you again for your help, do you wish to return to the Rabbit Realm?
translation: Yardimin icin tekrar tesekkürler, Tavsan Diyari'na dönmek ister misin?

english: No thanks, I've had enough of rabbits for now.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, simdilik tavsanlardan yeterince gördüm.

english: So be it, I'll be contemplating my power for a little while if you change your mind.
translation: Öyle olsun, fikrini degistirirsen, ben biraz gücümü düsünürüm.

english: Yes
No
...[player name]?
Um, yes?
Boss wants to talk to you. She's downstairs in the pits.
translation: Patron seninle konusmak istiyor. Asagida, cukurlarda.

english: Got it!
Hello.
Oh. It's you again.
Have you spoken with the boss yet?
Yes. Actually, I wanted to ask you about the task she gave me...
translation: Evet. Aslinda, bana verdigi görev hakkinda sana bir sey sormak istiyordum...

english: Stop right there. You'll get not hints out of me.
translation: Dur orada. Benden hicbir ipucu alamayacaksin.

english: You know, you're very pretty...
Ha! That's a good one.
I hope you're better at ratcatching than lying.
translation: Umarim yalan söylemekten daha iyi fare yakalamaktasindir.

english: That's a powerful-looking cat you have there.
translation: Orada cok güclü görünen bir kedin var.

english: Bellemorde? Beautiful, isn't she?
translation: Bellemorde mu? Cok güzel, degil mi?

english: Er... yes.
I've had her since she was a kitten. Felkrash trained her for me.
translation: O daha yavruyken aldim. Felkrash onu benim icin egitti.

english: Oh really? Does she know any cool tricks?
translation: Öyle mi? Havali numaralar biliyor mu?

english: Oh yes! There was this one time she helped Felkrash wipe out all the rats in town by -
translation: Evet! Bir keresinde Felkrash'in kasabadaki tüm fareleri yok etmesine yardim etti...

english: Hiss!
Oh, I see. Nice try, [player name], but you'll have to be cleverer than that.
translation: Anliyorum. Iyi denemeydi Maceraci, ama daha zekice davranman gerek.

english: Almost had it...
I just don't think Felkrash was that impressive.
translation: Felkrash'in o kadar da etkileyici oldugunu düsünmüyorum.

english: What?
All the other ratcatchers I've met had loads of tricks to show me.
translation: Tanistigim diger tüm fare avcilari bana bir sürü numara göstermisti.

english: In comparison, Felkrash was just... disappointing.
translation: Onlara kiyasla Felkrash sadece... hayal kirikligiydi.

english: How dare you! Felkrash is the greatest ratcatcher Gielinor's ever seen!
translation: Bu ne cüret! Felkrash, Gielinor'un gördügü en büyük fare avcisidir!

english: Oh yeah? What's the most impressive thing she's done then?
translation: Öyle mi? O zaman yaptigi en etkileyici sey nedir?

english: I'll have you know she once killed all the rats in Port Sarim with just one attack!
translation: Bir keresinde Port Sarim'deki tüm fareleri tek bir saldiriyla öldürdügünü bilmen gerekir!

english: I don't know. That just sounds like one of her stories.
translation: Bilemiyorum. Bu sadece onun hikayelerinden biri gibi geliyor.

english: It's true! I saw it happen. She used a magic flute to charm the rats into the sea!
translation: Bu dogru! Ben gördüm. Sihirli bir flüt kullanarak fareleri denize cekmis!

english: Wait... I uh, I shouldn't have said that.
Don't worry, I won't tell Felkrash you snitched.
translation: Merak etme, Felkrash'a seni ispiyonladigini söylemeyecegim.

english: You'd better not!
They charm snakes over in Pollnivneach... maybe they charm rats, too?
translation: Pollnivneach'ta yilanlari büyüleyebiliyorlar... belki fareleri de büyüleyebiliyorlardir?

english: Oh it's you again.
Felkrash told me of the task she set you.
Oh, er, really?
I shouldn't have told you that story. Shame on you for coaxing it out of me.
translation: Sana o hikayeyi anlatmamaliydim. Benden bunu ögrenmek icin beni kandirdigin icin utanmalisin.

english: If it makes you feel better, I lie to a lot of people.
translation: Eger kendini daha iyi hissedeceksen, ben bircok insana yalan söylerim.

english: That was an amazing performance! I've only seen one like it... as you know.
translation: Harika bir performansti! Benzerini sadece bir kez gördüm... bildigin gibi.

english: Don't worry, Felkrash has no idea how I figured it out.
translation: Merak etme, Felkrash nasil anladigimi bilmiyor.

english: And it had better stay that way!
translation: Ve öyle kalmasi da iyi olur!

english: She looks through you as if you don't exist.
Step away from that manhole, you've no business down there.
translation: O kanalizasyon kapagindan uzak dur, orada isin yok.

english: Ah you, peasant. Felkrash wishes to speak with you.
translation: Ah sen, köylü. Felkrash seninle konusmak istiyor.

english: 'The Face' comports herself in an air of haughtiness uncommon to those with appearances as ugly as hers.
translation: “Yüz”, onun kadar cirkin görünüslü kisilerde nadir görülen bir kibirle davraniyor.

english: Ok, where would I find her?
You should find her below in the pits.
Oh it's you again.*She glances at you with barely disguised disdain.*
translation: Oh, yine sen.*Sana zar zor gizledigi kücümsemeyle bakar.*

english: *Aside* I wonder what her problem is?
Have you spoken with Felkrash yet?
Yes.
You notice a rather unkempt looking cat nearby. Despite its bedraggled appearance it exudes power, strength and intelligence beyond that of a normal cat.
translation: Yakinlarda oldukca daginik görünümlü bir kedi fark ediyorsun. Daginik görünümüne ragmen, normal bir kediden cok daha fazla güc, kuvvet ve zeka yayiyor.

english: That's an interesting looking cat.
Ah yes Belle. What a cat. Felkrash trained her for me shortly after she single handedly charmed all the rats of the Port and drowned them.
translation: Ah evet, Belle. Ne kedi ama. Felkrash, limandaki tüm fareleri tek basina büyüleyip bogduktan kisa bir süre sonra onu benim icin egitti.

english: I love that story. My favourite part is how she managed to get rid of all the rats. Would you tell it to me?
translation: Bu hikayeyi cok seviyorum. En sevdigim kismi, tüm fareleri nasil yok ettigi. Bana anlatir misin?

english: I don't know, I really shouldn't.
*Aside* I'll get the story out of her, a little sweet talking should do the trick.
translation: *Kenara* Ondan hikayeyi ögrenecegim, biraz tatli dilli olmak ise yarayacaktir.

english: Oh please tell me, I'm sure you'd tell the story wonderfully, you have such a pretty ...
translation: Lütfen anlat bana, eminim hikayeyi harika anlatirsin, cok güzel bir...

english: Yes..?
*The face'sface perks up at the mention of the word pretty.*
...voice.
Oh.*And just as quickly turns sour again.*
translation: Oh.*Ve hemen tekrar somurtkan bir ifadeye bürünür.*

english: *Aside* Dang!
... which compliments your radiant aura!
translation: ...ki bu da senin parlak auranla cok uyumlu!

english: *Aside* That should do the trick.
Oh you're too generous.
Do you know something, I think I'll tell you, mind you, don't tell Felkrash about this, she'd only get sore with me.
translation: Biliyor musun, sanirim sana anlatacagim, ama Felkrash'a bundan bahsetme, bana kizar.

english: She's the story teller not me.
One day ......
The camera fades briefly to black and back.
translation: Kamera kisa bir süre karardiktan sonra tekrar acilir.

english: And that is how she drowned the rats.
..and that is how she drowned the rats.
You just about manage to stay awake through the long and turgid recital of the story.
translation: Uzun ve sikici hikayeyi dinlerken zar zor uyanik kalabiliyorsun.

english: The snakecharmer of Pollnivneach from what you gathered seemed to play a critical role in the story.
