translation: Anladigin kadariyla Pollnivneach'in yilan oynaticisi hikayede önemli bir rol oynamis gibi görünüyor.

english: *Aside*PerhapsI should pay this snake charmer a visit.
translation: *Kenara* Belki de bu yilan oynaticisini ziyaret etmeliyim.

english: Really?
I shouldn't have told that story. Shame on you for coaxing it out of me.
translation: Bu hikayeyi anlatmamaliydim. Benden bunu ögrenmek icin beni kandirdigin icin utanmalisin.

english: I promise I won't tell her you helped me.
translation: Sana yardim ettigini ona söylemeyecegime söz veriyorum.

english: I must congratulate you on your performance, I have only ever seen one other display of musicality to match, as you should know.
translation: Performansin icin seni tebrik etmeliyim, bildigin gibi, buna esdeger baska bir müzik performansi daha görmüstüm.

english: Thank you, and don't worry, I won't tell Felkrash that you helped me.
translation: Tesekkürler, merak etme, Felkrash'a yardim ettigini söylemeyecegim.

english: Here you go.
You've found another clue!
You've obtained a casket!
You know, you're very pretty...
That's a nice cat you have there.
I just don't think Felkrash was that impressive.
translation: Felkrash'in o kadar da etkileyici oldugunu düsünmüyorum.

english: The Great Guardian seems to be resting. You should probably not disturb it.
translation: Büyük Muhafiz dinleniyor gibi görünüyor. Onu rahatsiz etmemelisin.

english: My power level is too low. Bring me guardian stones.
translation: Güc seviyem cok düsük. Bana koruyucu taslari getir.

english: Thanks, adventurer. I am now fully powered up.
Human, I need the power of the guardian stones.
translation: Insan, koruyucu taslarin gücüne ihtiyacim var.

english: Humans, I now have the power to close the rift. Thank you, brave ones.
translation: Insanlar, artik yarigi kapatacak güce sahibim. Tesekkürler, cesur insanlar.

english: Now, for the final blow. Let the Scar be no more!
translation: Simdi, son darbeyi vuracagim. Yara izi artik yok olsun!

english: Brace yourselves!
Now, I shall rest until it opens once more...
Good day to you sir.
Who are you?
I am the Lady of the Lake.
Good day.
I seek the sword Excalibur.
Aye, I have that artefact in my possession.
'Tis very valuable, and not an artefact to be given away lightly.
translation: Cok degerli bir eser ve kolayca verilecek bir sey degil.

english: I would want to give it away only to one who is worthy and good.
translation: Sadece layik ve iyi olan birine vermek isterim.

english: And how am I meant to prove that?
I shall set a test for you.
First I need you to travel to Port Sarim. Then go to the upstairs room of the jeweller's shop there.
translation: Önce Port Sarim'e gitmen gerekiyor. Orada kuyumcunun dükkaninin üst katindaki odaya git.

english: Ok. That seems easy enough.
Please kind sir... my family and I are starving...
translation: Lütfen efendim... ailem ve ben acliktan ölüyoruz...

english: Could you find it in your heart to spare me a simple loaf of bread?
translation: Bana bir somun ekmek verebilir misiniz?

english: Yes certainly.
You give the bread to the beggar.
Thank you very much!
The beggar has turned into the Lady of the Lake!
Well done. You have passed my test.
Here is Excalibur, guard it well.
No I don't have any bread with me.
Well if you get some, you know where to come.
The beggar isn't interested in talking.
Have you got any bread for me yet?
Yes, here you go.
Actually, I'm wrong. I still don't have any bread. Sorry.
translation: Aslinda yanilmisim. Hala ekmegim yok. Üzgünüm.

english: Sorry, no, I still have none.
Hello. I am here for Excalibur. Can I have it yet?
translation: Merhaba. Excalibur icin geldim. Alabilir miyim?

english: I don't think you are worthy enough.
Come back when you are a better person.
translation: Daha iyi bir insan oldugunda geri gel.

english: ...But you have already proved thyself to be worthy of wielding it once already. I shall return it to you if you can prove yourself to still be worthy.
translation: ...Ama sen onu kullanmaya layik oldugunu bir kez kanitladin bile. Hala layik oldugunu kanitlayabilirsen sana geri verecegim.

english: ...And how can I do that?
Why, by proving yourself to be above material goods.
500 gold coins ought to do it.
Ok, here you go.
You are still worthy to wield Excalibur! And thanks for the cash! I felt like getting a new haircut!
translation: Hala Excalibur'u kullanmaya layiksin! Ve para icin tesekkürler! Yeni bir sac kesimi yaptirmak istedim!

english: I don't have that kind of money...
Well, come back when you do.
Who are you?
Good day.
I seek the sword Excalibur.
Yes certainly
No I don't have any bread with me.
Yes, here you go.
No, I still have none.
How dare you come near my farmhouse! Guards! Guards! Remove this human!
translation: Nasil cüret edersin ciftligime yaklasmaya! Muhafizlar! Muhafizlar! Bu insani uzaklastirin!

english: (monkey guards appear and attempt to capture the player)
translation: (maymun muhafizlar ortaya cikar ve oyuncuyu yakalamaya calisir)

english: Guards! Here's a human!
Hello! What's a monkey like you doing here?
translation: Merhaba! Senin gibi bir maymun burada ne ariyor?

english: I'm just passing through actually.
Fair enough then.
What are you doing in my house?
I'm just passing through!
Well I don't give a monkey's uncle!
How curious? I have not seen a creature of your kind for many years. You have ventured into the Nexus human - I should warn you to be aware of the Abyssal Sires.
translation: Ne kadar ilginc! Senin türünden bir yaratik görmeyeli yillar oldu. Nexus'a girmissin insan - Abyssal Sires'e karsi dikkatli olmani tavsiye ederim.

english: Tell me about yourself.
Ah... Time does not pass in the Abyss at the same rate that it does in your realm, but nevertheless I have been in this place for aeons.
translation: Ah... Abyss'te zaman senin dünyandaki gibi akmiyor, ama yine de ben buradayim, eonlarca zamandir.

english: Indeed, when I was last in your realm, the armies of Zamorak were battling the other gods for control, and we sought reinforcements from any plane we could reach.
translation: Aslinda, senin dünyana son geldigimde, Zamorak'in ordulari diger tanrilarla kontrol icin savasiyordu ve biz ulasabildigimiz her düzlemden takviye kuvvetleri ariyorduk.

english: That was how I came here. We broke through to the Abyss, seeking allies for our cause, but instead I ended up a prisoner in this place, unable to leave, while the God Wars continued without me.
translation: Bu yüzden buraya geldim. Davamiz icin müttefikler aramak üzere Abyss'e girdik, ama bunun yerine ben bu yerde tutsak kaldim, buradan ayrilamadim ve Tanri Savaslari bensiz devam etti.

english: What can I do here?
There is something you can do here, human. In fact it may perhaps benefit us both.
translation: Burada yapabilecegin bir sey var, insan. Aslinda bu belki de ikimize de fayda saglayabilir.

english: Bring me a spine, a claw and an axon from the Abyssal Sires, and I shall construct them into a mighty weapon for you. Yes, we shall both benefit from this.
translation: Bana Abyssal Sires'ten bir omurga, bir pence ve bir akson getir, ben de bunlari senin icin güclü bir silaha dönüstürecegim. Evet, ikimiz de bundan faydalanacagiz.

english: Tell me about the Abyssal Sires.
The Sires are the engineers of this living pocket universe known to you and I as the Abyss.
translation: Sires, senin ve benim Abyss olarak bildigimiz bu canli cep evreninin mühendisleridir.

english: At the hands of the 'Chaos God', Zamorak, like myself, they too were cast down and imprisoned in this living tomb.
translation: “Kaos Tanrisi” Zamorak'in elinde, benim gibi onlar da bu yasayan mezara atildilar ve hapsedildiler.

english: They worked for centuries attempting to escape the pull of the Abyss but as food resources began to deplete they knew that their only chance for survival was to construct this Nexus.
translation: Yüzyillar boyunca Abyss'in cekiminden kacmaya calistilar, ancak besin kaynaklari tükenmeye basladiginda, hayatta kalmak icin tek sanslarinin bu Nexus'u insa etmek oldugunu anladilar.

english: They absorb flesh and bone of their demon kin, weaving it into the fabric of these very walls. Here they have remained in deep stasis, asleep.
translation: Iblis akrabalarinin etini ve kemiklerini emerek, bunlari bu duvarlarin dokusuna islediler. Burada derin bir uyku halinde kaldilar.

english: If you succeed in awakening them, they will no doubt unleash their full fury upon you. Someone of your calibre should be able to deal with them though, especially with the shadows on your side...
translation: Onlari uyandirmayi basarirsan, süphesiz tüm öfkelerini sana yönelteceklerdir. Senin kalibren birisi, özellikle de gölgeler senin tarafinda oldugundan, onlarla basa cikabilmelidir...

english: If you succeed in killing a Sire, you may be fortunate enough to find one of its unsired offspring among its remains. Bring the Unsired here, to the Font of Consumption.
translation: Bir Sire'yi öldürmeyi basarirsan, kalintilari arasinda onun unsired yavrularindan birini bulma sansin olabilir. Unsired'i buraya, Tüketim Kaynagi'na getir.

english: By placing the Unsired into the Font, I will be able to consume its flesh and perhaps you will receive something worth having.
translation: Unsired'i Font'a koyarak, onun etini tüketebilecegim ve belki de sen de degerli bir sey elde edebileceksin.

english: I'll be off for now.
I did not ask you to bring me anything, human.
translation: Senden bana bir sey getirmeni istemedim, insan.

english: Yes, human?
Have you harvested any components for me?
translation: Benim icin herhangi bir bilesen topladin mi?

english: What's this stuff for?
I shall use the components to construct a mighty weapon for you. Rest assured, the process will be beneficial to both of us.
translation: Bu bilesenleri senin icin güclü bir silah yapmak icin kullanacagim. Merak etme, bu sürec ikimiz icin de faydali olacak.

english: No, sorry.
I still require [bludgeon component(s)] from an Abyssal Sire.
translation: Hala Abyssal Sire'dan bludgeon bilesenleri gerekiyor.

english: You hand over the component(s) to the Overseer.
I now have all the components I require, so here is the weapon I promised you.
translation: Artik ihtiyacim olan tüm bilesenlere sahibim, iste sana söz verdigim silah.

english: You have served me well, it is good to see that you humans are still as gullible as ever!
translation: Bana iyi hizmet ettin, siz insanlarin hala eskisi kadar saf oldugunu görmek güzel!

english: Bringing me those body parts from the Sires has now granted me enough teleportation energy to leave this living hell hole. Perhaps I will pay your realm a visit and there will be much to harvest!
translation: Sires'lerden aldigin bu vücut parcalari sayesinde, bu cehennem cukurundan cikmak icin yeterli teleportasyon enerjisi elde ettim. Belki senin dünyani ziyaret ederim ve orada hasat edecek cok sey bulurum!

english: Yuck! This is disgusting. What use is this? It's unwieldly!
translation: Igrenc! Bu igrenc. Bunun ne faydasi var? Kullanimi zor!

english: Have you not learned yet, appearances can be deceiving. You hold in your hands a living weapon whose power is rivalled by few weapons from your world, use it wisely.
translation: Hala ögrenmedin mi, görünüs aldatici olabilir. Elinde, dünyanizdaki cok az silahin gücüne rakip olabilecek canli bir silah tutuyorsun, onu akillica kullan.

english: Do not think that I am ungrateful for my freedom human. I will leave you this ancient tome that will instruct you in creating more of these weapons in future.
translation: Özgürlügüm icin nankör oldugumu düsünme insan. Sana gelecekte bu tür silahlari daha fazla üretmen icin talimatlar iceren bu eski kitabi birakacagim.

english: Just use the three components on the book, and it will do the rest. You can get spare copies here any time you need.
translation: Kitaptaki üc bileseni kullan, gerisini o halleder. Ihtiyacin oldugunda buradan yedek kopyalar alabilirsin.

english: Thank you.
Farewell...
The Overseer teleports away.
Perhaps I shall use it to slay you, demon.
translation: Belki de onu seni öldürmek icin kullanirim, iblis.

english: So be it... I will await you on the fields of blood!
translation: Öyle olsun... Kanli tarlalarda seni bekliyor olacagim!

english: I do not require anything further from you, human.
translation: Senden baska bir sey istemiyorum, insan.

english: Tell me about yourself.
Tell me about the Abyssal Sires.
What can I do here?
I'll be off for now.
What's this stuff for?
No, sorry.
Thank you.
Perhaps I shall use it to slay you, demon.
translation: Belki de onu seni öldürmek icin kullanirim, iblis.

english: Hello mortal. What do you seek?
What changes have been made for this League?
translation: Bu Lig icin ne gibi degisiklikler yapildi?

english: Much has happened since the last passage of the Trailblazers. This time, I have awakened the wrathful spirits of enemies across Gielinor.
translation: Trailblazers'in son gecisinden bu yana cok sey oldu. Bu sefer, Gielinor'daki düsmanlarin öfkeli ruhlarini uyandirdim.

english: Each region now contains a Raging Echo boss. These bosses are more powerful versions of their original self that drop unique rewards.
translation: Artik her bölgede bir Raging Echo patronu bulunuyor. Bu patronlar, orijinal hallerinden daha güclü versiyonlari ve benzersiz ödüller birakiyorlar.

english: To help you overcome these new challenges, you may now gain power through Combat Masteries, which you can obtain access to by completing the Combat Mastery tasks.
translation: Bu yeni zorluklarin üstesinden gelmenize yardimci olmak icin, Combat Mastery görevlerini tamamlayarak erisebileceginiz Combat Masteries araciligiyla güc kazanabilirsiniz.

english: As before, you'll initially be restricted to the Regions of Misthalin and Karamja. However, as you progress, you'll be able to unlock new areas of your choosing.
translation: Daha önce oldugu gibi, baslangicta Misthalin ve Karamja bölgeleriyle sinirli olacaksiniz. Ancak ilerledikce, istediginiz yeni alanlarin kilidini acabileceksiniz.

english: Be warned though - you won't be able to unlock every area, so choose wisely.
translation: Ancak dikkatli olun, her alanin kilidini acamayacaksiniz, bu yüzden akillica secim yapin.

english: You must participate as an Ironman. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.
translation: Ironman olarak katilmalisiniz. Bu, tek basiniza oldugunuz ve diger katilimcilarla ticaret yapamayacaginiz anlamina gelir.

english: And that's not all. Training skills during the League will grant you substantially more experience than you'd normally expect.
translation: Ve hepsi bu kadar degil. Lig sirasinda becerilerinizi gelistirdiginizde, normalde beklediginizden cok daha fazla deneyim kazanacaksiniz.

english: These experience increases are known as passive effects, which get more generous the higher your Relic tier.
translation: Bu deneyim artislari pasif etkiler olarak bilinir ve Relic seviyeniz ne kadar yüksekse o kadar cömert olurlar.

english: Finally, some quests have been completed for you automatically. Further quests and more will be completed as you unlock the relevant areas.
translation: Son olarak, bazi görevler sizin icin otomatik olarak tamamlanmistir. Ilgili alanlarin kilidini actikca daha fazla görev ve daha fazlasi tamamlanacaktir.

english: I think that covers the basics. Would you like to know more, [player name]?
translation: Sanirim temel bilgiler bu kadar. Daha fazla bilgi almak ister misiniz, Maceraci?

english: Yes, please.
Not right now.
Is there anything else you need from me?
translation: Benden baska bir sey ister misin?

english: Can you tell me about Combat Masteries?
translation: Savas Ustaliklari hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Combat Masteries are powerful boons granted by me that enhance your combat abilities for the entire League.
translation: Savas Ustaliklari, tüm Lig boyunca savas yeteneklerini gelistiren, benim tarafimdan verilen güclü avantajlardir.

english: After all, it wouldn't be very interesting to ask you to defeat the enemies' raging echoes without allowing you to draw on your own.
translation: Sonucta, kendi gücünü kullanmana izin vermeden düsmanlarin öfkeli yankilarini yenmeni istemek pek ilginc olmazdi.

english: You can obtain them by completing specific combat tasks to prove yourself to me.
translation: Bana kendini kanitlamak icin belirli savas görevlerini tamamlayarak bunlari elde edebilirsin.

english: Combat Masteries are split into the three combat styles: Ranged, Melee, and Mage. To unlock each mastery, you must have unlocked the previous mastery for that style.
translation: Savas Ustaliklari üc savas stiline ayrilir: Menzilli, Yakin Dövüs ve Büyücü. Her ustaligi acmak icin, o stilin önceki ustaligini acmis olman gerekir.

english: There are 6 combat masteries for each style, but only 10 mastery points can be obtained. Once you have selected a mastery there is no going back, so choose your masteries wisely.
translation: Her stil icin 6 savas ustaligi vardir, ancak sadece 10 ustalik puani elde edilebilir. Bir ustaligi sectikten sonra geri dönüs yoktur, bu yüzden ustaliklarini akillica sec.

english: Now, would you like to take a look at the Combat Masteries available to you?
translation: Simdi, kullanabileceginiz Savas Ustaliklarina bir göz atmak ister misiniz?

english: Fair enough. Is there anything else you need from me?
translation: Peki. Benden baska bir sey ister misiniz?

english: How do tasks work?
In every League, there are a number of tasks for you to complete. Each task has a level of difficulty: Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite and Master.
translation: Her Ligde, tamamlamaniz gereken bir dizi görev vardir. Her görevin bir zorluk seviyesi vardir: Kolay, Orta, Zor, Elit ve Usta.

english: Completing tasks allows you to access new areas. The more tasks you complete, the more areas become available to unlock.
translation: Görevleri tamamlamak, yeni alanlara erismenizi saglar. Ne kadar cok görev tamamlarsaniz, o kadar cok alanin kilidini acabilirsiniz.

english: Not only that, completing tasks also earns you League Points. The number of points earned is dependent on the difficulty of the task.
translation: Sadece bu da degil, görevleri tamamladikca Lig Puanlari da kazanirsiniz. Kazandiginiz puan sayisi, görevin zorluk derecesine baglidir.

english: What do these points do?
Once you have achieved a certain amount of League Points you can unlock a new Relic of mine. These are powerful artefacts to help you in this world.
translation: Belirli bir miktar Lig Puani kazandiginizda, benim yeni bir Kalintimi acabilirsiniz. Bunlar, bu dünyada size yardimci olacak güclü eserlerdir.

english: League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.
translation: Lig Puanlari, Lig Ödül Dükkanindan ödüller satin almak icin de kullanilabilir.

english: So how many tasks are there?
More than you'll ever be able to complete, most likely. It's up to you which ones you attempt.
translation: Muhtemelen tamamlayabileceginizden daha fazla. Hangi görevleri deneyeceginiz size kalmis.

english: Thanks!
Now, would you like to take a look at the tasks for this League?
translation: Simdi, bu Lig'in görevlerine bir göz atmak ister misiniz?

english: How does the area system work?
Currently, you are restricted to the Kingdom of Misthalin and the island of Karamja. However, as you progress, you can unlock more areas.
translation: Su anda, Misthalin Kralligi ve Karamja adasiyla sinirlisiniz. Ancak ilerledikce daha fazla alanin kilidini acabilirsiniz.

english: There are eleven different areas in total. However, you can only unlock a maximum of five, including the two you've started with. Choose wisely.
translation: Toplamda on bir farkli alan vardir. Ancak, basladiginiz iki alan dahil olmak üzere en fazla bes alanin kilidini acabilirsiniz. Akillica secim yapin.

english: I give the first two area unlocks to everyone. You can unlock the other three by completing the tasks I've set.
translation: Ilk iki alanin kilidini herkese aciyorum. Diger üc alanin kilidini, belirledigim görevleri tamamlayarak acabilirsiniz.

english: The more tasks you complete, the more areas you can unlock.
translation: Ne kadar cok görev tamamlarsaniz, o kadar cok alanin kilidini acabilirsiniz.

english: I see. Thanks!
Would you like to take a look at the available areas now?
translation: Simdi mevcut alanlara bir göz atmak ister misiniz?

english: What are Relics?
Relics are powerful artefacts made by me that grant unique abilities for the entire League.
translation: Kalintilar, tüm Lig'e benzersiz yetenekler kazandiran, benim tarafimdan yapilmis güclü eserlerdir.

english: You may even recognise a few from Leagues past.
There are 23 separate Relics, split across 8 different tiers. You can only have one Relic from each tier, however.
translation: 8 farkli seviyeye ayrilmis 23 ayri Kalinti vardir. Ancak, her seviyeden yalnizca bir Kalintiya sahip olabilirsiniz.

english: The first Relic tier is available to everyone. The others must be unlocked with League Points.
translation: Ilk Relic seviyesi herkes tarafindan kullanilabilir. Digerleri ise League Puanlari ile acilmalidir.

english: League Points are earned by completing tasks.
Once you have selected a Relic, your choice can't be changed for the rest of the League. Make your choices carefully.
translation: Bir Relic sectikten sonra, Lig'in geri kalaninda seciminizi degistiremezsiniz. Secimlerinizi dikkatli yapin.

english: Would you like to take a look at the Relics for this League?
translation: Bu Lig'in Relic'lerine bir göz atmak ister misiniz?

english: Very well. Is there anything else you need from me?
translation: Peki. Benden baska bir sey ister misiniz?

english: Can I claim some combat achievement rewards?
translation: Bazi savas basari ödüllerini talep edebilir miyim?

english: You do not appear to have any combat achievement rewards available to claim.
translation: Talep edebileceginiz herhangi bir savas basari ödülünüz yok gibi görünüyor.

english: You don't have enough room.
You don't have enough gold.
There you go. Congratulations, even if it may have been accelerated with my power, it's still a real accomplishment.
translation: Iste oldu. Tebrikler, benim gücümle hizlandirilmis olsa da, yine de gercek bir basari.

english: I have some more questions.
Tell me about League rewards.
As well as letting you unlock new areas, completing tasks in the League will earn you League Points. The more League Points you have, the more Relic tiers you have available.
translation: Ligde görevleri tamamlayarak yeni alanlarin kilidini acmanin yani sira Lig Puanlari da kazanirsiniz. Ne kadar cok Lig Puaniniz olursa, o kadar cok Relic kademesine erisebilirsiniz.

english: However, alongside allowing you to unlock Relics, League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.
translation: Ancak Lig Puanlari, Relic'lerin kilidini acmanin yani sira Lig Ödül Magazasindan ödüller satin almak icin de kullanilabilir.

english: What rewards can I buy?
Oh, all sorts of things. New cosmetic kits, an alternative Home Teleport animation, some rather stylish outfits... and much more.
translation: Oh, her türlü sey. Yeni kozmetik kitleri, alternatif Ev Teleport animasyonu, oldukca sik kiyafetler... ve cok daha fazlasi.

english: Many of these rewards can be traded with your fellow mortals, so if you wish, you can earn some money by selling them on. Of course, you might prefer to keep them for yourself instead.
translation: Bu ödüllerin cogu diger ölümlülerle takas edilebilir, yani isterseniz bunlari satarak biraz para kazanabilirsiniz. Tabii ki, bunlari kendiniz icin saklamayi tercih edebilirsiniz.

english: I see. That all sounds good to me.
You can use this shop to buy previous League rewards, too.
translation: Bu magazayi önceki Lig ödüllerini satin almak icin de kullanabilirsiniz.

english: Alongside the rewards in the Leagues Reward Shop, there's also League Ranks.
translation: Lig Ödül Dükkani'ndaki ödüllerin yani sira Lig Siralamalari da var.

english: League Ranks? How do they work?
During the League as you gain more points you will gain a League Rank. This rank can be seen in the Ranks interface.
translation: Lig sirasinda daha fazla puan kazandikca Lig Siralamasi kazanirsiniz. Bu siralama, Siralamalar arayüzünde görülebilir.

english: You currently have the rank: [rank].
As you get ranks you will gain access to trophies.
translation: Siralamalar kazandikca kupalara erisim hakki kazanirsiniz.

english: Trophies?
That's right. Trophies are items that are awarded to you for competing in the League. You can use them to show off your League Rank.
translation: Dogru. Kupalar, Lig'de yaristiginiz icin size verilen ögelerdir. Bunlari Lig Siralamanizi göstermek icin kullanabilirsiniz.

english: Connected to League Ranks are the League to League rewards. These are unlocked in the next League based upon the League Rank you earn in this one.
translation: Lig Siralamalari ile baglantili olan Ligden Lig'e ödülleri vardir. Bunlar, bu Lig'de kazandiginiz Lig Siralamasina göre bir sonraki Lig'de acilir.

english: League Starter Outfits and League Icons are some of things you can unlock for the next League. In addition, any pets you earn in this League will transfer over to the next one.
translation: Lig Baslangic Kiyafetleri ve Lig Simgeleri, bir sonraki Lig icin acabileceginiz ögelerden bazilaridir. Ayrica, bu Lig'de kazandiginiz tüm evcil hayvanlar bir sonraki Lig'e aktarilir.

english: Finally, on top of the tasks for this League, there are some other activities for which I will recognise the first person who completes them.
translation: Son olarak, bu Lig'deki görevlerin yani sira, bunlari ilk tamamlayan kisiyi ödüllendirecegim baska etkinlikler de var.

english: You can view the entire list of activities, as well as whether or not someone has completed them, by reading the board beside me.
translation: Etkinliklerin tam listesini ve bunlarin tamamlanip tamamlanmadigini yanimdaki panodan görebilirsiniz.

english: My pleasure. Now, is there anything else you need from me?
translation: Rica ederim. Baska bir sey var mi?

english: Let's talk about pets.
Can you tell me how pets work in Leagues?
translation: Lig'lerde evcil hayvanlar nasil calisir, anlatabilir misiniz?

english: But of course. If you're lucky enough to obtain a pet during a League, it will automatically be insured for you.
translation: Tabii ki. Bir Lig sirasinda bir evcil hayvan elde etme sansiniz varsa, otomatik olarak sigortalanir.

english: This means that if you lose it somehow you can talk to me and I'll give it back to you. Insurance and reclaiming is all free of charge.
translation: Bu, bir sekilde kaybettiginizde bana gelip geri alabileceginiz anlamina gelir. Sigorta ve geri alma islemleri tamamen ücretsizdir.

english: Additionally, each pet you obtain will be transferred to the next League. I'll take good care of it until you're ready to reclaim it.
translation: Ayrica, elde ettiginiz her evcil hayvan bir sonraki Lige aktarilir. Siz geri almaya hazir olana kadar ona iyi bakacagim.

english: Okay! Thank you.
Come back to me once you have some pets and you can view your collection. Now, is there anything else you need from me?
translation: Evcil hayvanlariniz oldugunda bana geri gelin, koleksiyonunuzu görebilirsiniz. Simdi, benden baska bir sey isteyecek misiniz?

english: Do I have any League items to collect?
translation: Toplamam gereken Lig ögeleri var mi?

english: You receive some items from the Sage.
Can you help me smash vials?
With all of my power, this is something I can manage. You will now automatically smash vials.
translation: Tüm gücümle, bunu yapabilirim. Artik siseleri otomatik olarak kiracaksiniz.

english: With all of my power, this is something I can manage. You will no longer smash vials automatically.
translation: Tüm gücümle, bunu yapabilirim. Artik siseleri otomatik olarak kirmayacaksiniz.

english: Let's circle back.
I'm good, thanks.
Very well. I'll be here if you ever need to know anything more.
translation: Cok iyi. Daha fazla bilgiye ihtiyacin olursa ben buradayim.

english: Oh my, that's a rare thing you've got there.
translation: Vay canina, elinde cok nadir bir sey var.

english: I guess you'll be wanting to trade it in for one of Gielinor's powerful weapons.
translation: Sanirim onu Gielinor'un güclü silahlarindan biriyle takas etmek isteyeceksin.

english: Enjoy.
You cannot do that in this world, you must abide by my rules, mortal.
translation: Bu dünyada bunu yapamazsin, benim kurallarima uymalisin, ölümlü.

english: What changes have been made for this League?
translation: Bu Lig icin ne gibi degisiklikler yapildi?

english: Yes, please.
Not right now.
Can you tell me about Combat Masteries?
translation: Savas Ustaliklari hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: How do tasks work?
How does the area system work?
More options...
What are Relics?
Yes.
No.
Can I claim some Combat rewards?
Could I buy a max cape off you?
translation: Senden maksimum pelerin satin alabilir miyim?

english: I have some more questions.
Tell me about League rewards.
Let's talk about pets.
Do I have any League items to collect?
translation: Toplamam gereken Lig ögeleri var mi?

english: Can you help me smash vials?
Let's circle back.
I'm good, thanks.
Previous options...
Twisted Bow
No, I've changed my mind.
Yes, I want Twisted bow
Scythe of Vitur
Yes, I want Scythe of vitur (uncharged)
Tumeken's shadow
Yes, I want Tumeken's shadow (uncharged)
Greetings, how may I be of service.
Who are you? What is your name?
Who am I?
I am whatever is needed of me.
I am a form undefined by natural laws, manifested by someone we mustn't speak of.
translation: Dogal kanunlarla tanimlanamayan, bahsetmememiz gereken biri tarafindan ortaya cikarilan bir formum.

english: I'm a clay doll, shaped by a sculptor. Never allowed to set, forever malleable. But maybe, not for long...
translation: Ben bir heykeltiras tarafindan sekillendirilmis bir kil bebekim. Asla sertlesmem, sonsuza kadar sekillendirilebilirim. Ama belki de bu uzun sürmeyecek...

english: My true name is immaterial, But you may call me...
Let's see now, what would be most appropriate?
translation: Bir bakalim, en uygun olan ne olabilir?

english: Ah, yes.
You may call me The Sage.
Uhhh, ok... Sage. Where did you bring us?
translation: Uhhh, tamam... Bilge. Bizi nereye getirdin?

english: 'Where' is the right question my friend, but maybe not in the way you are accustomed to hearing.
translation: “Nerede” dogru soru dostum, ama belki de alistigin sekilde degil.

english: Reality as you know it has many layers, all slightly different with their own rules.
translation: Bildigin gerceklik bircok katmandan olusur ve her biri kendi kurallariyla biraz farklidir.

english: Through the power granted to me, I brought us to this layer using the River-Between. The River of Souls.
translation: Bana verilen gücle, bizi River-Between'i kullanarak bu katmana getirdim. Ruhlar Nehri.

english: We now stand on the stage of what is yet to be your most entertaining performance yet!
translation: Simdi, senin icin simdiye kadarki en eglenceli performansinin sahnesinde duruyoruz!

english: Layers? River-Between? What does any of this mean?
translation: Katmanlar? Nehir Arasi? Bunlarin anlami ne?

english: To give everything away at this point would be unwise, considering we are being watched even now. You should only be concerned about one thing.
translation: Su anda her seyi aciklamak akillica olmaz, cünkü su anda bile izleniyoruz. Tek bir sey hakkinda endiselenmelisin.

english: Being entertaining.
That's the only way you will get out of this event alive...
translation: Bu etkinlikten sag cikmanin tek yolu bu...

english: Entertaining? What are you talking about? Who am I entertaining? Stop talking in riddles!
translation: Eglenceli olmak mi? Neden bahsediyorsun? Kimi eglendirecegim? Bilmece gibi konusmayi kes!

english: Ahh, [player name], please forgive me. In my attempts to explain, I appear to have confused you even further...
translation: Ahh, Maceraci, lütfen beni affet. Aciklamaya calisirken, seni daha da kafani karistirmisim galiba...

english: I will keep things simple for you; Participate in this event and you will continue to exist. Refusal to participate will end in your eventual destruction.
translation: Senin icin basitce aciklayayim; Bu etkinlige katilirsan, var olmaya devam edersin. Katilmayi reddedersen, sonunda yok olursun.

english: The choice is yours... hero.
Well, that doesn't really answer anything...
Worry not. I have much grander plans for you yet, but like all good stories we must wait for the right time and place...
translation: Endiselenme. Senin icin cok daha büyük planlarim var, ama tüm iyi hikayelerde oldugu gibi dogru zamani ve yeri beklemeliyiz...

english: You mentioned other Leagues - how does this differ from those?
translation: Diger Liglerden bahsettin - bu onlardan nasil farkli?

english: Like all events before it, the rules of the world have been altered to be more entertaining for those who are watching.
translation: Önceki tüm etkinliklerde oldugu gibi, dünyanin kurallari izleyenler icin daha eglenceli hale getirildi.

english: The biggest change has been to the Relics from the previous chapter.
translation: En büyük degisiklik, önceki bölümdeki Kalintilarda oldu.

english: These objects of power are now gone, I have broken them into Fragments and spread across this iteration of the world.
translation: Bu güc nesneleri artik yok, onlari Parcalara ayirdim ve bu dünyanin versiyonuna dagittim.

english: When multiple Fragments are in harmony, they can be used together to create powerful effects.
translation: Birden fazla Parca uyum icinde oldugunda, birlikte kullanilarak güclü etkiler yaratabilirler.

english: Yes, I remember you shattering them on the boat ride.
translation: Evet, tekne yolculugunda onlari parcaladigini hatirliyorum.

english: So I have Fragments to collect... got it. Are there any OTHER weird rules I should know about?
translation: Yani Parcalari toplamam gerekiyor... anladim. Bilmem gereken baska garip kurallar var mi?

english: I understand that in previous Leagues, they limited you to smaller spaces of your world.
translation: Anladigim kadariyla önceki Liglerde, dünyanizin daha kücük alanlariyla sinirliydiniz.

english: That restriction doesn't exist in this event.
translation: Bu etkinlikte böyle bir kisitlama yok.

english: You're free to roam your world, exploring the furthest reaches from Morytania to Kourend & Kebos.
translation: Dünyanizi özgürce dolasabilir, Morytania'dan Kourend ve Kebos'a kadar en uzak noktalari kesfedebilirsiniz.

english: But there's a catch.
Oh great... there's always a catch.
translation: Harika... her zaman bir sorun vardir.

english: I've limited and reset some of your memories, meaning you won't be able to interact with certain elements of this world.
translation: Bazi anilarini sinirladim ve sifirladim, yani bu dünyanin belirli unsurlariyla etkilesime giremeyeceksin.

english: For example, you'll only have access to three skills: Defence, Fishing and Thieving, as well as the Combat Class you chose earlier.
translation: Örnegin, daha önce sectigin Savas Sinifi'nin yani sira sadece üc beceriye erisebileceksin: Savunma, Balikcilik ve Hirsizlik.

english: In order to gain access to other skills, you need to complete Tasks for me.
translation: Diger becerilere erismek icin benim icin Görevleri tamamlaman gerekiyor.

english: Doing so gives you Sage's Renown. A rather fitting name, I thought.
translation: Bunu yaptiginda Sage's Renown kazanacaksin. Oldukca uygun bir isim, bence.

english: With Renown you can purchase access to new skills as well as bosses and quests.
translation: Söhret ile yeni becerilerin yani sira patronlara ve görevlere erisim satin alabilirsin.

english: Why are you doing all of this? Surely I'd be more 'entertaining' if I could have all the power at once?
translation: Bütün bunlari neden yapiyorsun? Tüm gücü bir anda elde edebilseydim, kesinlikle daha “eglenceli” olurdum, degil mi?

english: I can't just give you all that power. What kind of story starts the hero with all the power they want?
translation: Sana tüm bu gücü öylece veremem. Kahramanin istedigi tüm güce sahip oldugu bir hikaye nasil baslar ki?

english: No, your story needs good rhythm. A sort of cadence that makes things interesting for your audience.
translation: Hayir, hikayenin iyi bir ritmi olmali. Izleyicilerin ilgisini cekecek bir tür ritim.

english: Start slow, work your way up. Become the hero you were always meant to be...
translation: Yavas baslayin, yavas yavas ilerleyin. Her zaman olmaniz gereken kahraman olun...

english: Once you have proven yourself, then and only then will you earn my renown.
translation: Kendinizi kanitladiginizda, ancak o zaman benim söhretimi kazanacaksiniz.

english: That's how you provide good entertainment my friend...
That's how you make a hero.
I suppose you're right...
Do you desire more information?
Go forward and continue your journey.
Remember, we are always watching...
Any tips you can give me on being 'entertaining'?
translation: “Eglenceli” olmak icin bana verebilecegin herhangi bir ipucu var mi?

english: I have devised a number of tasks to help keep your story on track.
translation: Hikayeni yolunda tutmana yardimci olacak bir dizi görev tasarladim.

english: Each task has a level of difficulty: Beginner, Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite and Master.
translation: Her görevin bir zorluk seviyesi vardir: Baslangic, Kolay, Orta, Zor, Elit ve Usta.

english: The more tasks you complete, the more activities you can unlock.
translation: Ne kadar cok görev tamamlarsan, o kadar cok aktiviteyi acabilirsin.

english: The more content you unlock the more interesting your story will become.
translation: Ne kadar cok icerik acarsan, hikayen o kadar ilginc hale gelir.

english: The more interesting the story the more entertained the ones watching will be.
translation: Hikaye ne kadar ilginc olursa, izleyenler o kadar eglenir.

english: What do I use these 'points' on?
Once you have achieved a certain amount of League Points you can unlock a new Fragment Slot.
translation: Belirli bir miktar Lig Puani elde ettiginizde, yeni bir Parca Yuvasi acabilirsiniz.

english: These slots allow you to equip more Fragments and become even stronger.
translation: Bu yuvalar, daha fazla Parca donatmaniza ve daha da güclenmenize olanak tanir.

english: Right now, you are playing on your Leagues profile. The Leagues Reward Shop can only be opened on your main profile.
translation: Su anda Ligler profilinizde oynuyorsunuz. Ligler Ödül Magazasi yalnizca ana profilinizde acilabilir.

english: You can access your main profile by switching to any normal Old School RuneScape world. The world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.
translation: Herhangi bir normal Old School RuneScape dünyasina gecerek ana profilinize erisebilirsiniz. Oturumu kapatma menüsündeki dünya degistirici, dünyalar arasinda gecis yapmak icin kullanilabilir.

english: More than you'll ever be able to complete, given our limited time here.
translation: Burada gecirebilecegimiz sinirli süre icinde tamamlayabileceginizden cok daha fazlasi.

english: With so many to choose from, it's up to you to decide how your story plays out...
translation: Secebileceginiz cok fazla secenek varken, hikayenizin nasil gelisecegini belirlemek size kalmis...

english: Ok... I think I understand what I should do now.
translation: Tamam... Sanirim simdi ne yapmam gerektigini anladim.

english: Very good. I knew I made the right choice bringing you to this chapter.
translation: Cok iyi. Seni bu bölüme getirerek dogru karari verdigimi biliyordum.

english: What is a Fragment?
You remember the Relics from the previous event, yes? The sources of great power that let you achieve amazing feats.
translation: Önceki etkinlikteki Relics'i hatirliyorsunuz, degil mi? Size inanilmaz basarilar elde etmenizi saglayan büyük gücün kaynagi.

english: Fragments are similar. As the Fragments were created from the Relics, much of their power remains but in a much-diminished form.
translation: Fragments da benzerdir. Fragments, Relics'ten yaratildigindan, güclerinin cogu kalmistir, ancak cok daha zayif bir formdadir.

english: They bestow many different bonuses: from helping you cut wood, to making you a more formidable warrior.
translation: Size bircok farkli bonus saglarlar: odun kesmenize yardimci olmaktan, sizi daha güclü bir savasci yapmaya kadar.

english: Equipping Fragments will grant you their power.
translation: Fragments'i donatmak size onlarin gücünü verir.

english: You can also level up your Fragments, making them even MORE powerful.
translation: Fragmanlarinizi seviye atlatarak onlari daha da güclü hale getirebilirsiniz.

english: Gaining experience as you normally would will level up your Fragments, making them even more useful.
translation: Normal sekilde deneyim kazanarak Fragmanlarinizi seviye atlatabilir ve onlari daha da kullanisli hale getirebilirsiniz.

english: How do I find these Fragments?
I have scattered the Fragments evenly across the world.
translation: Fragmanlari dünyanin dört bir yanina esit olarak dagittim.

english: Anytime you kill a monster or gain more experience in a particular skill, you'll have a chance to receive a Fragment.
translation: Bir canavari öldürdügünüzde veya belirli bir beceride daha fazla deneyim kazandiginizda, bir Fragman alma sansiniz olur.

english: The harder the enemy or activity, the better chance you'll have.
translation: Düsman veya aktivite ne kadar zor olursa, sansiniz o kadar artar.

english: You will only receive Fragments relevant to the activity, with a few exceptions.
translation: Birkac istisna disinda, yalnizca aktiviteyle ilgili Fragmanlari elde edersiniz.

english: I know your kind enjoy seeking out treasure. Fragments related to Treasure Trails can come from anywhere.
translation: Sizin gibilerin hazine aramayi sevdigini biliyorum. Hazine Izleri ile ilgili Fragmanlar her yerden gelebilir.

english: What happens if I try to put the Fragments back together?
translation: Parcalari bir araya getirmeye calisirsam ne olur?

english: As I said, the Fragments still contain some of their residual Relic energy.
translation: Dedigim gibi, parcalar hala kalinti Relic enerjisi iceriyor.

english: When enough Fragments are brought back together they will emit the same energy they did when they were whole.
translation: Yeterli sayida parca bir araya getirildiginde, bütün olduklari zamanki enerjiyi yayarlar.

english: For example, if you find five Fragments imbued with Last Recall, you can complete the set and gain access to that Relic's full power.
translation: Örnegin, Last Recall ile asilanmis bes parca bulursan, seti tamamlayabilir ve o Relic'in tam gücüne erisebilirsin.

english: A sort of 'Set Effect' if you will.
Is there anything else you wish to know?
translation: Bilmek istediginiz baska bir sey var mi?

english: How does the content unlock system work?
In this iteration of the event I have limited you, at first, to three skills: Thieving, Fishing and Defence.
translation: Bu etkinlikte, sizi baslangicta üc beceriyle sinirladim: Hirsizlik, Balikcilik ve Savunma.

english: You can still do simple things like cut trees or mine ore, but doing so will be fruitless, as no experience will be gained.
translation: Agac kesmek veya maden cikarmak gibi basit seyleri yapmaya devam edebilirsiniz, ancak bunu yapmak deneyim kazanamayacaginiz icin sonucsuz kalacaktir.

english: In order to gain experience in these skills, you'll need to unlock them by using my Renown.
translation: Bu becerilerde deneyim kazanmak icin, benim Söhretimi kullanarak bunlari acmaniz gerekir.

english: You gain renown by being entertaining, by completing tasks. The amount of Renown you earn depends on the difficulty of the task.
translation: Eglenceli davranarak ve görevleri tamamlayarak söhret kazanirsiniz. Kazandiginiz söhret miktari, görevin zorluguna baglidir.

english: When it comes to exceptionally strong creatures, you'll need to unlock the ability to fight them. You can see all locked creatures by opening the unlock interface.
translation: Olaganüstü güclü yaratiklar söz konusu oldugunda, onlarla savasma yeteneginin kilidini acmaniz gerekecektir. Kilitli tüm yaratiklari, kilit acma arayüzünü acarak görebilirsiniz.

english: One final morsal of information you might be interested in. I understand that in previous Leagues you were forced to complete certain 'Quests' in their entirety.
translation: Ilginizi cekebilecek son bir bilgi daha var. Anladigim kadariyla, önceki Liglerde belirli “Görevleri” tamamen tamamlamak zorunda kaliyordunuz.

english: If you wish, you may spend Sage's Renown to skip through these Quests while still gaining any final rewards. However, be warned thaatI will not offer any gifts to you if you finish these quests by yourself.
translation: Isterseniz, Sage'in Söhretini kullanarak bu Görevleri atlayabilir ve yine de son ödülleri kazanabilirsiniz. Ancak, bu görevleri kendi basiniza tamamlarsaniz size herhangi bir hediye vermeyecegimi unutmayin.

english: You should also know that by completing quests with Sage's Renown, you will not earn any final experience like you would if you finished the quest yourself.
translation: Ayrica, Sage'in Söhretini kullanarak görevleri tamamladiginizda, görevi kendi basiniza tamamladiginizda oldugu gibi son deneyim puanlari kazanmayacaginizi da bilmelisiniz.

english: Is there anything else you wish to know.
translation: Baska bilmek istediginiz bir sey var mi?

english: How did I get here again?
I can retell the story, if you wish me to.
League Intro cutscene replays.
So be it.
Will I be rewarded for participating in this event?
translation: Bu etkinlige katildigim icin ödül alacak miyim?

english: As you progress you'll earn League Points, which will unlock new slots and allow you to equip more Fragments.
translation: Ilerledikce Lig Puanlari kazanacaksiniz, bu da yeni yuvalarin kilidini acacak ve daha fazla Parca donatmaniza olanak saglayacaktir.

english: However, when our time in this world is over, you can spend your League Points to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.
translation: Ancak, bu dünyadaki zamanimiz bittiginde, Lig Puanlarinizi Lig Ödül Dükkanindan ödüller satin almak icin harcayabilirsiniz.

english: Of course, the real reward for participating will be my master and I sparing your life once the event ends...
translation: Tabii ki, etkinlige katildiginiz icin alacaginiz asil ödül, etkinlik bittiginde ustam ve benim hayatinizi bagislamamiz olacak...

english: Are there any other rewards I can earn from this event?
translation: Bu etkinlikten kazanabilecegim baska ödüller var mi?

english: I see...
In my time on the River of Souls I have found that when chapters are concluded their collapsing can be... incomplete.
translation: Ruhlar Nehri'nde gecirdigim zamanlarda, bölümler sona erdiginde cöküslerinin... tam olamayabilecegini fark ettim.

english: Therefore, certain items can slip through the cracks, so to say.
translation: Bu nedenle, bazi esyalar, tabiri caizse, catlaklardan sizabilir.

english: In fact, it's through one of these cracks that I was able to save you from the previous chapter's collapse.
translation: Aslinda, önceki bölümün cöküsünden seni kurtarmami saglayan da bu catlaklardan biriydi.

english: I collect these lost items from other worlds and keep them with me, should I ever need them one day.
translation: Bu kayip esyalari diger dünyalardan topluyorum ve bir gün ihtiyacim olursa diye yanimda sakliyorum.

english: I'm happy to offer them as an incentive for playing your part in this event.
translation: Bu etkinlikte rolünü oynadigin icin sana tesvik olarak bunlari sunmaktan mutluluk duyarim.

english: The first item is a powerful whip.
It is imbued with the energy of thousands of lost souls, forever trapped in the bondage of their iron chains.
translation: Binlerce kayip ruhun enerjisiyle dolu, demir zincirlerin esaretinde sonsuza kadar hapsolmus.

english: Each crack releases a deafening howl from the screams of its victims trapped within...
translation: Her catlak, icinde hapsolmus kurbanlarinin cigliklarindan gelen sagir edici bir uluma yayar...

english: The next item is a cannon.
It's poweeredby channelled arcane energy, each explosion teleported into the barrel from a border dimension.
translation: Gizemli enerjiyle calisir, her patlama sinir boyutundan namluya isinlanir.

english: Using a power unknwon, it expels shrapnel that tears through flesh and souls alike.
translation: Bilinmeyen bir güc kullanarak, hem eti hem de ruhlari parcalayan sarapnel parcalari firlatir.

english: There are others of course. You'll be free to trade these rewards to others in your world, or you can keep them. It doesn't matter to me.
translation: Elbette baska ödüller de var. Bu ödülleri dünyanizdaki diger oyuncularla takas edebilir veya saklayabilirsiniz. Benim icin fark etmez.

english: You can acess your main profile by switching to any normal Old School RuneScape world. Using world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.
translation: Herhangi bir normal Old School RuneScape dünyasina gecerek ana profilinize erisebilirsiniz. Oturumu kapatma menüsündeki dünya degistiriciyi kullanarak dünyalar arasinda gecis yapabilirsiniz.

english: And hero, beware - the Shattered Relic rewards won't be available until the League has ended. You can still buy rewards from previous Leagues, however.
translation: Ve kahraman, dikkatli ol - Shattered Relic ödülleri Lig sona erene kadar kullanilamayacak. Ancak önceki Liglerden ödüller satin alabilirsiniz.

english: Now, alongside the rewards in the Leagues Reward Shop, there's also League Ranks.
translation: Simdi, Lig Ödül Magazasindaki ödüllerin yani sira Lig Siralamalari da var.

english: At the end of the League, you will be judged and given a rank. This is based upon the number of League Points you have earned compared to the other participants.
translation: Ligin sonunda, degerlendirilip bir siralama verilecek. Bu, diger katilimcilara kiyasla kazandiginiz Lig Puani sayisina göre belirlenir.

english: Anyone who earns at least 100 League Points will be eligible for the Bronze rank. The top 80% of participants get the Iron rank. The top 60% get Steel.
translation: En az 100 Lig Puani kazanan herkes Bronz siralamasina hak kazanir. Katilimcilarin en iyi %80'i Demir siralamasina, en iyi %60'i Celik siralamasina, en iyi %40'i Mithril siralamasina, en iyi %20'si Adamant siralamasina, en iyi %5'i Rune siralamasina ve en iyi %1'e giren en iyi katilimcilar ise Ejderha siralamasina hak kazanir!

english: The top 40% get Mithril. The top 20% get Adamant. The top 5% get Rune. The best participants, those who make it to the top 1%, get the Dragon rank!
translation: Lig sona erdiginde, siralamaniza göre bir kupa alirsiniz. Bu kupalar, Lig'deki performansinizi simgeler.

english: When the League ends, you'll get a trophy based on your rank. These trophies symbolise your performance in the League.
translation: Lig sona erdiginde, siralamaniza göre bir kupa alacaksiniz. Bu kupalar, Lig'deki performansinizi simgeliyor.

english: You'll also get League-to-League rewards based on your League Rank.
translation: Ayrica, Lig Siralamaniza göre Ligden Lig'e ödüller de alacaksiniz.

english: League Starter Outfits and League Icons are some of things you can unlock for the next League. Also, any pets you earn in this League will transfer over to the next one.
translation: Lig Baslangic Kiyafetleri ve Lig Simgeleri, bir sonraki Lig icin acabileceginiz seylerden bazilari. Ayrica, bu Lig'de kazandiginiz tüm evcil hayvanlar bir sonraki Lig'e aktarilacak.

english: Finally, I plan to recognise the first heroes to complete particular activities.
translation: Son olarak, belirli etkinlikleri tamamlayan ilk kahramanlari ödüllendirmeyi planliyorum.

english: You can view the entire list of activities, as well as whether or not someone has completed them, on the board beside me.
translation: Etkinliklerin tam listesini ve bunlarin tamamlanip tamamlanmadigini yanimdaki tahtada görebilirsiniz.

english: Of course! If you're lucky enough to obtain a pet during a League, it will automatically be insured for you.
translation: Elbette! Lig sirasinda bir evcil hayvan elde etme sansiniz varsa, bu evcil hayvan otomatik olarak sigortalanir.

english: This means that if you were to ever lose it, you can talk to me and I'll give it back to you. Insurance and reclaiming is all free!
translation: Bu, evcil hayvaninizi kaybederseniz bana gelip geri alabileceginiz anlamina gelir. Sigorta ve geri alma islemleri tamamen ücretsizdir!

english: Additionally, each pet you obtain will be transferred to the next League. It'll be waiting with me for you to reclaim it!
translation: Ayrica, elde ettiginiz her evcil hayvan bir sonraki Lig'e aktarilacaktir. Benimle birlikte geri almanizi bekleyecektir!

english: Return to me once you have some pets and you'll be able to view your collection. Is there anything else you wish to know?
translation: Bazi evcil hayvanlar edindiginizde bana geri dönün, koleksiyonunuzu görebileceksiniz. Bilmek istediginiz baska bir sey var mi?

english: Do I have any items to collect?
translation: Toplamam gereken herhangi bir esya var mi?

english: It doesn't look like you need any League items right now. I'll be here if you ever do.
translation: Su anda Lig esyalarina ihtiyaciniz yok gibi görünüyor. Ihtiyaciniz olursa ben buradayim.

english: Very well. I'll be here if you ever need to know anything about Leagues.
translation: Peki. Ligler hakkinda bilmek istediginiz bir sey olursa ben buradayim.

english: Who are you? What is your name?
You mentioned other Leagues - how does this differ from those?
translation: Diger Liglerden bahsettiniz - bu Lig digerlerinden nasil farkli?

english: Any tips you can give me on being 'entertaining'?
translation: “Eglenceli” olmak icin bana verebileceginiz herhangi bir ipucu var mi?

english: What are Fragments?
How does the content unlock system work?
How did I get here again?
Will I be rewarded for participating in this event?
translation: Bu etkinlige katildigim icin ödül alacak miyim?

english: Repeat options...
Much has changed since the world was shattered. This time, I thought I'd turn the clock back and allow you to Trailblaze once more.
translation: Dünya parcalandigindan beri cok sey degisti. Bu sefer, zamani geri alip bir kez daha öncü olmaniza izin verecegim.

english: You must participate as an Iron Man. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.
translation: Iron Man olarak katilmalisiniz. Bu, tek basiniza olacaginiz ve diger katilimcilarla ticaret yapamayacaginiz anlamina gelir.

english: There are ten different areas in total. However, you can only unlock a maximum of five, including the two you've started with. Choose wisely.
translation: Toplamda on farkli alan var. Ancak, basladiginiz iki alan dahil olmak üzere en fazla bes alani acabilirsiniz. Akillica secim yapin.

english: Oh, how have you been getting on?
I've completed some more Combat Achievement tasks!
translation: Bazi Combat Achievement görevlerini daha tamamladim!

english: I can see that. Nice job. You'll be expecting your medium rewards?
translation: Görüyorum. Aferin. Orta düzey ödüllerini mi bekliyorsun?

english: Yes please!

There you go. I've provided you with one of our more modest ancient sword hilts. You'll also have an easier time obtaining medium clues, increased max quantities offered when given boss Slayer tasks, bonus tokens
translation: Al bakalim. Sana daha mütevazi eski kilic kabzalarimizdan birini verdim. Ayrica orta düzey ipuclarini daha kolay elde edebilecek, boss Slayer görevlerinde sunulan maksimum miktar artacak, Warrior guildinden bonus jetonlar

english: from the Warrior guild and two extra commendation points from each Pest Control game. Additionally, equipping one of my sword hilts at the Barrows will prevent your prayer points from being drained and
translation: ve her Pest Control oyunundan iki ekstra takdir puani kazanacaksin. Ayrica, Barrows'ta kilic kabzalarimdan birini takarsan, dua puanlarinin tükenmesini önleyebilirsin ve

english: your Dwarf multicannon can hold five extra cannonballs.
translation: cüce coklu topun bes ekstra top mermisi alabilir.

english: Thank you so much!
Can I claim any league trophies I may of earned from this league?
translation: Bu ligden kazandigim lig kupalarini alabilir miyim?

english: Would you like to look at the rewards shop?
You currently have the rank: Unranked.
I can give you [number] League [item/items] once you free up some space in your inventory.
Can I claim some trophies?
A cock-a-doodle hello to you! Caw!
Excuse me?
I speak for Clarence, and he bids you good day.
translation: Clarence adina konusuyorum ve sana iyi günler diler.

english: Clarence?
The rooster you see before you.
You speak for him?
I speak for him, he speaks through me, I speak through her. It is not important.
translation: Ben onun adina konusuyorum, o benim araciligimla konusuyor, ben onun araciligiyla konusuyorum. Önemli degil.

english: So I'm talking to you?
Yes, you are talking to me.
Which me is that? You or the other one?
translation: Hangi ben? Sen mi, yoksa digeri mi?

english: Now I'm lost. Who am I?
You're you and I'm me.
I'm me?
This is too confusing, I'll see you later.
translation: Bu cok kafa karistirici, sonra görüsürüz.

english: Who? Me?
Both of you.
Hello, I'm looking for a special egg, I don't suppose you could give me one?
translation: Merhaba, özel bir yumurta ariyorum, bana bir tane verebilir misiniz?

english: A special egg? All eggs are special.
translation: Özel bir yumurta mi? Bütün yumurtalar özeldir.

english: Yes I know that, but I need a particularly special egg.
translation: Evet, biliyorum, ama benim özellikle özel bir yumurtaya ihtiyacim var.

english: Do you have one of those?
One moment, we shall produce one.
But you're a... Rooster? And... A lady?
translation: Ama sen bir... Horoz musun? Ve... Bir bayan?

english: Rooster and lady yes this is true. But there is more than one way to make an egg.
translation: Horoz ve bayan, evet bu dogru. Ama yumurta yapmanin birden fazla yolu var.

english: Unfortunately I don't have space to carry around your questionable egg at the moment.
translation: Maalesef su anda senin süpheli yumurtani tasimak icin yerim yok.

english: Suit yourself!
There you go! Produced from my pocket, you see.
translation: Al bakalim! Cebimden cikardim, gördün mü?

english: Well that's a relief. Thanks.
Thanks again for the egg.
You are welcome! Cluck!
Hello again Clarence.
Oh and uh, hello your mouthiness.
What can two do for you?
translation: Iki kisi sizin icin ne yapabilir?

english: I need another special egg.
translation: Baska bir özel yumurtaya ihtiyacim var.

english: You don't have enough space for one of my special eggs. Come back when you do.
translation: Özel yumurtalarimdan birini tasiyacak kadar yerin yok. Yer acildiginda tekrar gel.

english: Okay then, thanks anyway.
translation: Tamam o zaman, yine de tesekkürler.

english: There you go! Use it wisely!
Thanks.
Ah, hello again, special egg person.
translation: Ah, tekrar merhaba, özel yumurta adam.

english: Hello.
We, that is to say, I, have decided, that you will receive no more special eggs.
translation: Biz, yani ben, karar verdik ki, artik özel yumurta almayacaksin.

english: Oh, well I don't actually need any more, so that's fine.
translation: Aslinda artik ihtiyacim yok, sorun degil.

english: Oh, you aren't devastated? Tormented by this great denial of eggs?
translation: Yikilmadin mi? Yumurtalarin reddedilmesinden dolayi aci cekmiyor musun?

english: Not really.
Curses!
And you're welcome! Cluck.
Do you want to buy any fine clothes?
Do you want to buy any fine clothes? Or would you like your scythe back?
translation: Güzel kiyafetler almak ister misin? Yoksa tirpanini geri ister misin?

english: Do you want to buy any fine clothes? Or would you like your bunny ears back?
translation: Güzel kiyafetler almak ister misin? Yoksa tavsan kulaklarini geri ister misin?

english: Do you want to buy any fine clothes? Or would you like your scythe or bunny ears back?
translation: Güzel kiyafetler almak ister misin? Yoksa tirpanini veya tavsan kulaklarini geri ister misin?

english: What have you got?
Well, I have a number of fine pieces of clothing on sale or, if you prefer, I can offer you an exclusive, total- clothing makeover?
translation: Satilik bircok güzel kiyafet var, ya da istersen sana özel, tam bir kiyafet makyaji yapabilirim.

english: Tell me more about this makeover.
translation: Bu makyaj hakkinda daha fazla bilgi ver.

english: Certainly!
Here at Thessalia's fine clothing boutique, we offer a unique service where we will totally revamp your outfit to your choosing.
translation: Thessalia'nin kaliteli giyim butiginde, kiyafetlerinizi tamamen sizin seciminize göre yenileyecegimiz essiz bir hizmet sunuyoruz.

english: It's on the house, completely free! Tired of always wearing the same old outfit, day in, day out? This is the service for you!
translation: Bu hizmet tamamen ücretsiz! Her gün ayni eski kiyafetleri giymekten biktiniz mi? O zaman bu hizmet tam size göre!

english: So what do you say? Interested? We can change either your top or your legwear!
translation: Ne dersiniz? Ilgileniyor musunuz? Üstünüzü veya altinizi degistirebiliriz!

english: Just select what style and colour you would like from this catalogue.
translation: Bu katalogdan istediginiz stili ve rengi secmeniz yeterlidir.

english: Wow! Good choice! You're looking great!
translation: Vay canina! Iyi secim! Harika görünüyorsunuz!

english: Totally cool! That outfit looks great!
translation: Cok havali! Bu kiyafet harika görünüyor!

english: Woah! Fabulous! You look absolutely great!
translation: Vay canina! Muhtesem! Kesinlikle harika görünüyorsunuz!

english: Very stylish! It really suits you!
WoooOOOooo! Hot stuff!
Fantastic! You should be a model!
No, thank you.
Well, please return if you change your mind.
translation: Peki, fikrinizi degistirirseniz lütfen geri gelin.

english: I have a frog token...
That entitles you to a free costume! Do you want a frog mask, a royal tunic & leggings or a royal blouse & skirt? I've also got some lamps a strange blue chap gave me.
translation: Bu size ücretsiz bir kostüm hakki veriyor! Kurbaga maskesi, kraliyet tunigi ve tayt mi, yoksa kraliyet bluzu ve etek mi istersin? Ayrica garip mavi bir adamin bana verdigi birkac lamba var.

english: A frog mask, please!
A royal tunic & leggings, please.
A royal blouse & skirt, please.
I'll take the reward lamp, thanks.
Maybe another time.
Can I have my scythe back?
Certainly. Here you go.
Would you like to buy any clothes?
Can I have my bunny ears back?
Are you able to offer any other services?
That depends... we mostly just sell clothes. What did you have in mind?
translation: Duruma göre degisir... Biz cogunlukla giysi satiyoruz. Aklinizda ne var?

english: I'm looking for some new shoes.
Hmm... It's not something I would normally sell, but I might be able to help you out.
translation: Hmm... Normalde sattigimiz bir sey degil, ama size yardimci olabilirim.

english: It's free to change your shoes here. You can choose a colour as well as a style, since I'm also stocking boots imported from elven lands.
translation: Burada ayakkabilarinizi degistirmek ücretsizdir. Elf topraklarindan ithal ettigim botlar da var, bu yüzden renk ve stil secebilirsiniz.

english: Just select the model you would like from this catalogue.
Are you able to give me a haircut?
Hah! Yeah, let me just go and grab my barbering equipment!
translation: Hah! Evet, gidip berber aletlerimi getireyim!

english: Alrighty then.
Oh, you're serious? Well, I guess I'd sillyto turn down extra business. I think I have andold pair of fabric scissors around here somewhere...
translation: Oh, ciddi misiniz? Ekstra is firsatini geri cevirmek aptalca olur. Sanirim burada bir yerlerde eski bir kumas makasi var...

english: I'm interested in changing my gender.
You're in a clothes store.
Could you at least try?
Well, a friend of mine did show me a spell once. I'll see if I can remember it, but I'm making no promises...
translation: Bir arkadasim bana bir keresinde bir büyü göstermisti. Hatirlayabilir miyim bir bakayim, ama söz veremem...

english: Actually, nevermind.
I have a frog token.
That entitles you to a free costume! Do you want a frog mask or a [prince/princess] outfit?
translation: Bu size ücretsiz bir kostüm hakki kazandirir! Kurbaga maskesi mi yoksa soylu kiyafeti mi istersiniz?

english: There you go!
A frog [prince/princess] outfit, please!
What have you got?
Tell me more about this makeover.
translation: Bu makyaj hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin.

english: I'd like to change my top please.
I'd like to change my legwear please.
I'd just like to buy some clothes.
No, thank you.
I have a frog token...
A frog mask, please!
A royal tunic & leggings, please.
A royal blouse & skirt, please.
I'll take a lamp, thanks.
Maybe another time.
Can I have my scythe back?
Can I have my bunny ears back?
I'm looking for some new shoes.
Are you able to give me a haircut?
Change my hairstyle.
Change my facial hair.
Cancel.
I'm interested in changing my gender.
Actually, nevermind.
A frog [prince/princess] outfit, please!
Hello there; I see you're qualified. Come to help us out?
translation: Merhaba, nitelikli oldugunu görüyorum. Bize yardim etmeye mi geldin?

english: Hello! You're that student who recently finished all three Earth Sciences exams, aren't you? Come to help us out?
translation: Merhaba! Sen yakin zamanda üc Earth Sciences sinavini da bitiren ögrenci, degil mi? Bize yardim etmeye mi geldin?

english: Greetings, my dear [sir/madam]. Have you come to give us a hand?
translation: Merhaba, sevgili . Bize yardim etmeye mi geldin?

english: Yes, how can I help out?

Well, you'll need to get your equipment first - it's all there on the tool rack. Use what you learned from your Earth Sciences exams. You'll need to be wearing your leather gloves and boots as well as have access to
translation: Önce ekipmanlarini almalisin - hepsi alet rafinda. Yer Bilimleri sinavlarinda ögrendiklerini kullan. Deri eldivenlerini ve botlarini giymeli ve

english: your trowel, rock pick and specimen brush.
translation: kürek, kaya kazma ve numune fircasina erisebilmelisin.

english: I see you have your equipment - well done.

To really give us a hand, you could clean some finds for us. They're mostly done - just some fine work to finish off. Take a find from the pile that the workmen are bringing in, then there are spare tables over there
translation: Bize gercekten yardim etmek istiyorsaniz, buluntulari temizleyebilirsiniz. Cogu isleri bitti, sadece son rötuslar kaldi. Iscilerin getirdigi yigindan bir buluntu alin, temizlemek icin orada bos masalar var.

english: to clean them on. If you find anything interesting, let us know and we'll see if it's good enough to go on display.
translation: Ilginc bir sey bulursaniz bize haber verin, sergilenmeye deger olup olmadigini kontrol edelim.

english: I found something interesting.
Oh? Let's take a look...
I found this pretty necklace.
Interesting...yes...yes...hmmm.... It looks like it's enchanted.
translation: Ilginc... evet... evet... hmmm.... Büyülü gibi görünüyor.

english: With what?

Oh, I think it's just a benign teleportation spell. I tinker in magic when I'm not doing archaeology. I can teach you how to make more necklaces like this. Amazing that they had this kind of knowledge back then.
translation: Oh, sanirim sadece zararsiz bir isinlanma büyüsü. Arkeolojiyle ugrasmadigim zamanlarda büyüyle ugrasirim. Sana bunun gibi daha fazla kolye yapmayi ögretebilirim. O zamanlar bu tür bilgilere sahip olmalari sasirtici.

english: That would be good. Where is the teleport to?
Hmm...all the indications are that it's somewhere to the east of us, but I'm not sure how far. Perhaps it was a teleport back to Saranthium. Let me just take a closer look.
translation: Hmm... tüm isaretler bunun bizim dogumuzda bir yer oldugunu gösteriyor, ama ne kadar uzak oldugunu bilmiyorum. Belki de Saranthium'a geri isinlanma icindi. Bir daha yakindan bakayim.

english: So I just make a ruby necklace and use five fire runes and one cosmic rune to enchant it.
translation: Yani bir yakut kolye yapip, bes ates runesi ve bir kozmik runesi kullanarak onu büyülüyorum.

english: Yes, indeed. Well done, youngster, thanks for helping us.
translation: Evet, aynen öyle. Aferin genc adam, yardim ettigin icin tesekkürler.

english: I've cleaned this old coin - is it of any use?
translation: Bu eski parayi temizledim, bir ise yarar mi?

english: Oh my! What a wonderful find! If this is what I believe it to be, it would allow us to date the Dig Site city.
translation: Vay canina! Ne harika bir buluntu! Eger tahmin ettigim gibi ise, kazi alanindaki sehrin tarihini belirlememizi saglayacak.

english: And look here, it has the name of the city too! Saranthium! That must be during the Saradominist occupation. This is a wonderful find. Please take it and place it in display case 45.
translation: Bakin, üzerinde sehrin adi da yaziyor! Saranthium! Saradominist isgali sirasinda olmali. Bu harika bir buluntu. Lütfen al ve 45 numarali vitrine koy.

english: Right, display case 45 it is...
Back again? Have you put the old coin in display case 45 yet?
translation: Yine mi geldin? Eski parayi 45 numarali vitrine koydun mu?

english: No, I'll go do that now
You've already shown me one of those, but it was in better condition. It's in the display case over there. You can pop this one in the finds crate over in the corner.
translation: Bana onlardan birini göstermistin, ama o daha iyi durumdaydi. Suradaki vitrinde. Bunu kösedeki buluntu sandigina koyabilirsin.

english: I found this really old coin - is it of any use?
translation: Cok eski bir sikke buldum, bir ise yarar mi?

english: What have we here?

Oh! This is very interesting...and confusing at the same time. This coin means that the city that we're excavating on the Digsite - Saranthium - was actually inhabited much, much earlier by followers of Zamorak,
translation: Oh! Bu cok ilginc... ama ayni zamanda kafa karistirici. Bu sikke, kazi alaninda kazi yaptigimiz sehir olan Saranthium'un aslinda cok daha önceden Zamorak'in takipcileri tarafindan iskan edildigini gösteriyor.

english: at which time, the city was known as Senntisten.
translation: O zamanlar sehir Senntisten olarak biliniyordu.

english: This is a most remarkable discovery, as we have other evidence indicating that Zarosian followers were resident before the Saradominists took over, but it also seems that Zamorakian forces used it during a battle of some
translation: Bu cok önemli bir kesif, cünkü Saradoministlerin yönetimi ele gecirmeden önce Zaros'un takipcilerinin burada yasadigini gösteren baska kanitlar da var, ama ayni zamanda Zamorak'in güclerinin bir tür savas sirasinda burayi kullandigi da anlasiliyor.

english: sort. Still, it allows us to roughly date when the city changed from following Zaros and Zamorak to following Saradomin. Put it in display case 44.
translation: Yine de, bu kesif, sehrin Zaros ve Zamorak'tan Saradomin'e gectigi tarihi yaklasik olarak belirlememizi sagliyor. 44 numarali vitrine koyun.

english: Case 44 it is!
Back again? Have you put the ancient coin in display case 44 yet?
translation: Yine mi geldin? Eski parayi vitrin 44'e koydun mu?

english: No, I'll go do that now.
I found this crumbly old decoration - is it of any use?
translation: Bu ufalanmis eski süslemeyi buldum, bir ise yarar mi?

english: Ahh... That looks like an altar piece. Hmm, yes...from the early Saradominist worshippers by the looks of it. Quite delicate, too. Put it in display case 37.
translation: Ahh... Bu bir sunak parcasi gibi görünüyor. Hmm, evet... Görünüse göre Saradoministlerin ilk takipcilerine ait. Oldukca narin de. Vitrin 37'ye koy.

english: Case 37 it is!
Back again? Have you put the ancient symbol in display case 37 yet?
translation: Yine mi geldin? Eski sembolü 37 numarali vitrine koydun mu?

english: I found this really old decoration - is it of any use?
translation: Bu cok eski bir süsleme buldum, ise yarar mi?

english: Wow!
That's in rather good condition, isn't it? An old altar decoration by the looks of things, from the Saradominist city no doubt. Put it in display case 36.
translation: Durumu oldukca iyi, degil mi? Görünüse göre eski bir sunak süslemesi, süphesiz Saradominist sehirden. 36 numarali vitrine koy.

english: Case 36 it is!
Back again? Have you put the old symbol in display case 36 yet?
translation: Yine mi geldin? Eski sembolü 36 numarali vitrine koydun mu?

english: I found this piece of pottery - is it of any use?
translation: Bu cömlek parcasini buldum, bir ise yarar mi?

english: Ahh... Oh! Hmm...yes...made by Zaros worshippers, by the looks of it. Beautifully-shaped. It looks as if this would go nicely in display case 22. This piece reinforces our evidence that the city was occupied by
translation: Ahh... Oh! Hmm... evet... görünüse göre Zaros'un tapinanlar tarafindan yapilmis. Cok güzel sekillendirilmis. 22 numarali vitrine cok yakisacak gibi görünüyor.

english: Zarosians before Saradominists.
translation: Bu parca, sehrin Saradoministler'den önce Zaros'lular tarafindan isgal edildigine dair kanitlarimizi güclendiriyor.

english: Case 22 it is!
Back again? Have you put the pottery in display case 22 yet?
translation: Yine mi geldin? Cömlekleri 22 numarali vitrine koydun mu?

english: I found these old arrowheads.
Ahh, yes, we find lots of those - they're not important. We already have some in our display. Just add it to the crate of finds over near the door.
translation: Ah, evet, bunlardan cok buluyoruz, önemli degiller. Vitrinde zaten var. Kapinin yanindaki buluntu sandigina koyabilirsin.

english: If there is anything already in the crate, feel free to take it as a reward for your work.
translation: Sandikta zaten bir sey varsa, calismanin karsiligi olarak alabilirsin.

english: Oh, okay.
Take a look at this...
I found these old necklaces.
An interesting find... Here, let me offer you something in return.
translation: Ilginc bir buluntu... Al, sana karsiliginda bir sey vereyim.

english: Oh! Okay.
I cleaned up this old vase.
Ah, the vases... I've lost count of how many we've found of those... The only completely intact one is in the display case already. Just add it to the crate of finds over near the door.
translation: Ah, vazolar... Kac tane buldugumuzu sayamadim bile... Tamamen saglam olan tek vazo zaten vitrinde. Kapinin yanindaki buluntu sandigina ekleyin.

english: Right.
Err... I seem to have lost it. Sorry.
Sounds like you never had it, [lad/lass]!
No, just here to watch.
Thank you, but I don't need that
Yes, how can I help out?
I found something interesting.
No thanks.
Another lovely day in this dung heap.
translation: Bu gübre yigininda bir baska güzel gün.

english: Watch yourself, I don't trust you.
The thieves down here are just small time. The real thieves are the ones who rule.
translation: Buradaki hirsizlar önemsizdir. Asil hirsizlar, burayi yönetenlerdir.

english: We're all liars here.
Ain't no honour down here. Never assume otherwise.
translation: Burada onur diye bir sey yok. Asla aksini düsünme.

english: I made a good score the other day.
translation: Gecen gün iyi bir is yaptim.

english: Gurrhh!
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu var. Merhaba, selam, selam...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her türlü sey! Kuleler görülmeye deger harika manzaralar sunuyor.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmenizi tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
If you're looking for dynamite, you've come to the right place, human.
translation: Dinamit ariyorsan dogru yere geldin, insan.

english: Who are you?
The name's Thirus Urkar. The Urkars have supplied the blast mines with the finest dynamite since they opened many ages ago.
translation: Adim Thirus Urkar. Urkarlar, yillar önce acildigindan beri patlayici madenlere en kaliteli dinamiti tedarik ediyorlar.

english: Now, can I help you today?
I'd like to buy some dynamite.
Sorry, human, I'm afraid you need more of a reputation in Lovakengj before I can sell you anything.
translation: Üzgünüm insan, sana bir sey satabilmem icin Lovakengj'de daha fazla itibar kazanman gerekiyor.

english: You do not have enough Lovakengj favour. Current favour: [0.0-14.9]% - Required: 15.0%
translation: Lovakengj'de yeterince itibarin yok. Mevcut itibar: [0,0-14,9]% - Gerekli: 15,0%

english: No, I'm fine.
There you go, [20/40/80] free dynamite. Return tomorrow for some more.
translation: Al bakalim, [20/40/80] bedava dinamit. Yarin tekrar gel de biraz daha al.

english: I've already given you your free allowance for today. Come back to me tomorrow for some more.
translation: Bugünlük bedava hakkini kullandin. Yarin tekrar gel de biraz daha al.

english: Who are you?
I'd like to buy some dynamite.
No, I'm fine.
Good day!
'Ello.
What stories do you bring from afar?
Between the mountains we witnessed the Chicken King invade a mountain fort full of Mount Tinmen.
translation: Daglarin arasinda, Tavuk Kral'in Tinmen Dagi'nin bulundugu bir dag kalesini isgal ettigini gördük.

english: The Chicken King? Ok...
That was his name! CHICKEN KING! By the light, he fought valiantly.
translation: Adi buydu! TAVUK KRAL! Isigin önünde cesurca savasti.

english: Did he win?
He screamed 'Off with their heads' while flailing around with a Halberd...
translation: Halberd ile etrafta savururken “Kafalarini kesin!” diye bagirdi...

english: So...
His paltry reign is sadly no more.
translation: Onun önemsiz hükümdarligi ne yazik ki artik yok.

english: Any other stories?
During our journey we came upon an abandoned house, it was eerily... silent.
translation: Yolculugumuz sirasinda terk edilmis bir eve rastladik, ürkütücü bir sekilde... sessizdi.

english: How... spooky.
As we entered the house we were hit by a horrendous smell - it was quite surprising.
translation: Eve girdigimizde korkunc bir koku bizi karsiladi - oldukca sasirticiydi.

english: Yuk.
The entire family was dead but there was not a single mark on them... Makes you think, what could do such a thing?
translation: Bütün aile ölmüstü ama üzerlerinde tek bir iz bile yoktu... Böyle bir seyi ne yapabilir ki diye düsündürür insani.

english: How unfortunate.
Such a waste... Such a pretty garden.
translation: Ne yazik... Ne güzel bir bahce.

english: What?
Oh, nothing...
Not right now... ask me later.
Fair enough.
Ok... Bye.
See you around.
What stories do you bring from afar?
Any other stories?
Ok... Bye.
Hello.
Good day, your Royal Highness.
Good day.
Good day, Your Royal Highness.
Oi!
Rahr!
No!
Grr!
Aargh!
I'm a gonner!
It's no use, I'm done for!
Uggh!
Hello there.
Hello yourself, outerlander. A little out of the way up here, aren't you?
translation: Merhaba, yabanci. Biraz uzaklara gelmissin, degil mi?
