english: I would love to stop and chat with you, but unfortunately we have a custom that no Fremennik may speak with the outerlanders without the permission of our chieftain.
translation: Durup seninle sohbet etmek isterdim, ama ne yazik ki Fremennik'lerin sefinizin izni olmadan yabancilarla konusmamasi gibi bir gelenegimiz var.

english: Don't take it personally. The Chieftain is stood just over there, his name is Brundt. I suggest you go and introduce yourself.
translation: Kisisel algilama. Sef tam orada duruyor, adi Brundt. Gidip kendini tanitmani öneririm.

english: You wouldn't want to go making any enemies because you weren't aware of our customs now, would you?
translation: Geleneklerimizi bilmedigin icin düsman edinmek istemezsin, degil mi?

english: No, I guess not. Thanks anyway.
translation: Hayir, sanirim istemezdim. Yine de tesekkürler.

english: Not a problem, outerlander. It's always nice to see a new face in the Longhall; it happens so rarely.
translation: Sorun degil, yabancilar. Longhall'da yeni bir yüz görmek her zaman güzeldir, cok nadir olur.

english: Only Fremenniks may buy drinks here.
translation: Burada sadece Fremennikler icki satin alabilir.

english: Hi. Are you a member of the council?
I am afraid not outerlander.
Oh, okay then.
I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find the longhall barkeeps' legendary cocktail, do you?
translation: Longhall barmenlerinin efsanevi kokteylini nerede bulabilecegimi biliyor musun?

english: How did you hear about that?!?!?
I didn't think anybody knew about that... Well, it is true that in my younger years as a barkeep, I wandered the lands trying various alcoholic delicacies.
translation: Kimsenin bunu bildigini sanmiyordum... Barmenlik yaptigim genclik yillarimda, cesitli alkollü icecekleri denemek icin ülkeyi dolastigim dogru.

english: Did you ever realise just how many different types of alcohol there are here in Gielinor? Lots!
translation: Gielinor'da ne kadar cok farkli türde alkol oldugunu biliyor muydun? Cok fazla!

english: Well, anyway, I used a fusion of various drinks from all around the world to create the greatest cocktail ever made!
translation: Neyse, dünyanin dört bir yanindan cesitli ickileri birlestirerek gelmis gecmis en iyi kokteyli yarattim!

english: Of course, when my wanderlust was gone, and I returned back to Rellekka to serve as barkeep here, I gave all that up.
translation: Tabii ki, gezginlik tutkum gectiginde ve Rellekka'ya geri dönüp burada barmenlik yapmaya basladigimda, tüm bunlari biraktim.

english: But you still remember how to make it, right?
translation: Ama hala nasil yapildigini hatirliyorsun, degil mi?

english: Of course.
And you have all the ingredients here? I don't need to go chasing round the world for obscure ingredients to make it?
translation: Ve tüm malzemeler burada mi? Yapmak icin dünyanin dört bir yanini dolasip bilinmeyen malzemeler aramama gerek yok, degil mi?

english: No, I have them all here. Why?
Can you make me your legendary cocktail then?
translation: O zaman bana efsanevi kokteylinden yapabilir misin?

english: I would rather not; it is a reminder of a life I left behind when I came back.
translation: Yapmak istemem; geri döndügümde geride biraktigim hayatimi hatirlatiyor.

english: Any way I could change your mind?
translation: Fikrini degistirebilmem icin bir yol var mi?

english: You need this to become a Fremennik, right? Well, you seem okay for an outerlander, it would be a shame to see you fail. You know Askeladden?
translation: Fremennik olmak icin buna ihtiyacin var, degil mi? Disaridan gelen biri icin fena görünmüyorsun, basarisiz olmani görmek yazik olur. Askeladden'i taniyor musun?

english: That kid outside? Sure.
He is nothing but a pest. He keeps sneaking in and stealing beer. I shudder to think what he will be like when he has passed his trial of manhood,
translation: O sadece bir bas belasi. Sürekli gizlice girip bira caliyor. Erkeklik sinavini gecip buraya yasal olarak girmeye basladiginda nasil olacagini düsünmek bile tüylerimi ürpertir.

english: and is allowed in here legitimately. If you can get him to sign a contract promising that he will NEVER EVER EVER darken my doorway here again, you get the drink.
translation: Onunla bir sözlesme imzalayip, bir daha ASLA buraya adimini atmayacagina dair söz vermesini saglayabilirsen, ickiyi alirsin. Eger ona bir daha ASLA ASLA ASLA buraya gelmeyecegine dair bir sözlesme imzalatabilirsen, ickini alabilirsin.

english: Any idea how I can get him to do that?
Knowing that little horror, he'll probably be willing to in exchange for some cash. You should go ask him yourself though.
translation: O kücük canavari taniyorsam, muhtemelen biraz para karsiliginda kabul eder. Ama gidip ona kendin sormalisin.

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a written promise from Askeladden to stay out of the Longhall?
translation: Askeladden'in Longhall'a gelmeyecegine dair yazili bir taahhütnameyi nereden bulabilecegimi biliyor musun?

english: Well, as I say, you should talk to him about that. Knowing the little runt as I do though He'll probably do it for the cash.
translation: Dedigim gibi, bunu onunla konusmalisin. O kücük veledi tanidigim kadariyla, muhtemelen para karsiliginda bunu yapacaktir.

english: Hi! Can I please have one of your legendary cocktails now?
translation: Merhaba! Efsanevi kokteyllerinizden bir tane alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: What?!?! I can't believe you... Let me look at that... Askeladden would NEVER... Gosh. It looks legitimate.
translation: Ne?!?! Inanamiyorum... Bir bakayim... Askeladden ASLA... Tanrim. Gercek gibi görünüyor.

english: Here you go, on the house! You have made my life SO much easier! Knowing that little monster won't be bugging me in here all the time anymore!
translation: Buyurun, ikramimizdir! Hayatimi cok kolaylastirdiniz! Artik o kücük canavarin beni burada sürekli rahatsiz etmeyecegini bilmek cok güzel!

english: That little weasel will have to abide by this written promise that Askeladden can never ever enter the Longhall again! He can't get round this one!
translation: O kücük sinsi, Askeladden'in bir daha asla Longhall'a giremeyecegine dair bu yazili sözü yerine getirmek zorunda kalacak! Bundan kacamaz!

english: Uh... yeah... yeah, you probably won't see someone called Askeladden coming in here...
translation: Uh... evet... evet, muhtemelen Askeladden adinda birinin buraya geldigini görmeyeceksiniz... .

english: (Thora takes the promise and gives the player a Legendary cocktail)
translation: (Thora sözü alir ve oyuncuya Efsanevi kokteyl verir)

english: Thanks for making me this cocktail. Why don't you make them anymore normally?
translation: Bu kokteyli yaptigin icin tesekkürler. Neden normalde bunlari yapmiyorsun?

english: Ah... when I gave up my travels across the world many years back, to return to my expected role as longhall barkeep, as my mother, and her mother, were before me,
translation: Ah... yillar önce dünyayi dolasmayi birakip, annem ve onun annesi gibi Longhall'da barmenlik yapmaya döndügümde,

english: I gave up a lot of the freedom I had found in the outside world. I know it is our custom to shun outerlanders and their ways, but I didn't find them as bad as the stories say.
translation: dis dünyada buldugum özgürlügün cogunu biraktim. Disaridan gelenleri ve onlarin yasam tarzlarini dislamak bizim gelenegimiz oldugunu biliyorum, ama ben onlari hikayelerde anlatildigi kadar kötü bulmadim.

english: Sometimes I feel as though we Fremennik live in a prison that we have constructed for ourselves, and that WE are the outerlanders, out here on the edge of the world...
translation: Bazen Fremennik'lerin kendimiz icin insa ettigimiz bir hapishanede yasadigimizi ve dünyanin kenarinda, burada, bizim disaridan gelenler oldugumuzu hissediyorum...

english: I'm sorry, I think it is part of the job of Longhall barkeep to get philosophical about things ocassionally. I wish you all the best of luck with your trials, outerlander.
translation: Üzgünüm, Longhall barmeninin görevi zaman zaman felsefi konusmak da dahil. Deneyimlerinde sana bol sans dilerim, yabanci.

english: When you have finished, perhaps you will come back here, and we can share a drink over tales of the outside world?
translation: Bitirdiginde, belki buraya geri gelirsin ve dis dünyayla ilgili hikayelerimizi paylasirken bir icki iceriz?

english: Thanks, I'd like that.
Hello again [Fremennik name]. I suppose you want a drink? Or are you going to try another scam with that terrible Askeladden again?
translation: Merhaba tekrar Dokrak. Bir icki ister misin? Yoksa yine o korkunc Askeladden ile baska bir dolandiricilik mi deneyeceksin?

english: Scam? Oh... You mean his promise not to come in here anymore?
translation: Dolandiricilik mi? Oh... Buraya bir daha gelmeyecegine dair verdigi sözü mü kastediyorsun?

english: Yes. Yes I do. I should never have trusted him not to come in here, even with that written promise.
translation: Evet. Evet, öyle. Yazili sözüne ragmen, buraya gelmeyecegine asla güvenmemeliydim.

english: Anyway, do you want a drink or not?
translation: Neyse, bir icki ister misin, istemez misin?

Welcome to Blackhole, human. Can I help you?
translation: Blackhole'a hos geldin, insan. Yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: Who are you?
Why, I'm Thordur. Thordur the dwarf. A long time ago, I used to run a business letting people visit my Blackhole for fun.
translation: Ben Thordur. Cüce Thordur. Uzun zaman önce, insanlara eglenmeleri icin Blackhole'umu ziyaret etme imkani sunan bir is yürütüyorduk.

english: The business was good, but eventually the time came for me to retire. So now I live here in Blackhole where it's more peaceful.
translation: Isler iyi gidiyordu, ama sonunda emekli olma zamanim geldi. Simdi daha huzurlu olan Blackhole'da yasiyorum.

english: What is this place?
Blackhole? Well, it's sort of like a hole, and it's generally not very well lit. I'll let you work out the rest.
translation: Blackhole mu? Sey, bir tür delik gibi bir yer ve genellikle cok iyi aydinlatilmiyor. Gerisini sen cöz.

english: If you're asking why it's here at all, it was a sort of prison. Bad people were locked here. But it's my home now.
translation: Neden burada oldugunu soruyorsan, burasi bir tür hapishaneydi. Kötü insanlar buraya kapatilirdi. Ama simdi burasi benim evim.

english: How can I leave?
Just activate your Disk of Returning. It'll pop you back out to the mines.
translation: Dönüs Diski'ni etkinlestir. Seni madenlere geri götürür.

english: Why, surely you've got your Disk of Returning? I can't believe you could have lost it in here.
translation: Dönüs Diski'nin var, degil mi? Onu burada kaybetmis olabilecegine inanamiyorum.

english: Nope, I don't have a Disk of Returning.
I really don't understand humans sometimes. Hold tight and I'll sort you out...
translation: Bazen insanlari gercekten anlamiyorum. Siki tutun, ben hallederim...

english: Yes, get me out now.
Thordur teleports the player to the Dwarven Mine
No thanks, I'll stay here.
I'm fine, thanks.

Hey there [player name], Do you want that shopping list now?
translation: Merhaba Maceraci, alisveris listesini istiyor musun?

english: It depends, what do I get out of it again?
I've got this Death Talisman I could give you in return. You'll need it if you want to get into the altar.
translation: Karsiliginda sana bu Ölüm Tilsimi verebilirim. Altara girmek istiyorsan buna ihtiyacin olacak.

english: Ok sure thing, what do you need?
You'd better take this list, we need everything on it! Just bring them to me and I'll take them off your hands.
translation: Bu listeyi alsan iyi olur, listedeki her seye ihtiyacimiz var! Onlari bana getir, ben de senden alayim.

english: Hmm no thanks, I'm not interested.
Hi again, how're you doing with those items we need?
translation: Merhaba, ihtiyacimiz olan esyalari bulabildin mi?

english: I've got some of them with me.
Great, can I take everything I need?
translation: Harika, ihtiyacim olan her seyi alabilir miyim?

english: Yeah sure.
Doesn't look like you do to me.
Thanks, I've updated your list for you.
Great, thank you so much for getting all that for us! Please take this Death Talisman as a reward.
translation: Harika, hepsini bizim icin aldiginiz icin cok tesekkürler! Lütfen bu Ölüm Tilsimini ödül olarak alin.

english: Anytime you want another one of those Talismans come see me and I'll sort you out with another list.
translation: Ne zaman baska bir Tilsim isterseniz bana gelin, size baska bir liste vereyim.

english: I'd rather you didn't.
I see you've got the [item], can I have it please?
Sure, here you go!
I think I'll keep hold of it for now.
Do you have another copy of the list?
translation: Listenin baska bir kopyasi var mi?

english: Try not to lose it this time, we need everything on it! Just bring them to me and I'll take them off your hands.
translation: Bu sefer kaybetmemeye calis, listedeki her seye ihtiyacimiz var! Onlari bana getir, ben senin icin hallederim.

english: Looks like you're carrying enough stuff at the moment.
translation: Su anda yeterince esya tasiyorsun gibi görünüyor.

english: You already have the list! Just bring them to me and I'll take them off your hands.
translation: Liste zaten sende! Onlari bana getir, ben senin icin hallederim.

english: What do you need all this stuff for?
translation: Bütün bu esyalari ne icin kullanacaksin?

english: Oh well, we don't get many deliveries down here, so it's supplies mostly...
translation: Sey, buraya pek teslimat gelmiyor, o yüzden cogunlukla erzak...

english: What about the [ticket]?
Well you see.. Umm... We don't really get much chance to.. Er.. Go out or anything... And we'd like some of the prizes some day...
translation: Sey, bak... Umm... Pek firsatimiz olmuyor... Sey... Disari cikmak falan... Ve bir gün ödüllerden bazilarini almak istiyoruz...

english: So why didn't you ask for the prizes then?
Oh no, that'd just be sad.
translation: Oh hayir, bu cok üzücü olurdu.

english: So why do you want the [book]?
Oh just some light reading, it's nice to catch up on current events occasionally.
translation: Oh, sadece hafif bir okuma, ara sira güncel olaylari takip etmek güzel oluyor.

english: Current events? But it's... Oh nevermind.
translation: Güncel olaylar mi? Ama bu... Oh, bos verin.

english: How do you explain the [key]?
Ah... Um... I'm not sure how that got on the list... Can we have it anyway?
translation: Ah... Sey... Onun listeye nasil girdigini bilmiyorum... Yine de alabilir miyiz?

english: Right, why do I get the feeling I shouldn't?
translation: Peki, neden almamaliyim gibi bir hisse kapiliyorum?

english: Pretty please with a Blood Talisman on top?!
translation: Lütfen, üstüne bir de Kan Tilsimi ekleyerek rica ediyorum!

english: A Blood Talisman?!
Oops! I meant 'Death Talisman'!
Yeah, right, all those are just 'supplies'.
No, I'd better get looking for them.
translation: Hayir, onlari aramaya baslasam iyi olacak.

english: Hello again, feel like getting us some more supplies?
translation: Merhaba tekrar, bize biraz daha malzeme getirir misin?

english: Okay sure thing, what do you need?
Here you go.
