translation: Bütün bu esyalari ne icin istiyorsun?

english: What about the [ticket]?
So why do you want the [book]?
How do you explain the [key]?
Yeah, right, all those are just 'supplies'.
No, I'd better get looking for them.
translation: Hayir, onlari aramaya baslasam iyi olacak.

english: Hello.
Good day.
Good day, Your Royal Highness.
Oi!
Rahr!
No!
Grr!
Aargh!
I'm a gonner!
It's no use, I'm done for!
Uggh!
I hear you killed the Troll King. Thanksyou for that, however I'm afraid I can't really talk to you any more, the King would be unhappy!
translation: Trol Krali'ni öldürdügünü duydum. Bunun icin tesekkürler, ancak korkarim artik seninle konusamam, Kral bundan hoslanmaz!

english: Hello I am Thormac the sorcerer. I don't suppose you could be of assistance to me?
translation: Merhaba, ben büyücü Thormac. Bana yardim edebilir misin?

english: What do you need assistance with?
I've lost my pet scorpions. They're lesser Kharid scorpions, a very rare breed.
translation: Evcil akreplerimi kaybettim. Onlar, cok nadir bir tür olan kücük Kharid akrepleri.

english: I left their cage door open, now I don't know where they've gone.
translation: Kafeslerinin kapisini acik birakmisim, simdi nereye gittiklerini bilmiyorum.

english: There's three of them, and they're quick little beasties. They're all over Gielinor.
translation: Üc tane var ve cok hizli kücük hayvanlar. Gielinor'un her yerinde olabilirler.

english: So how would I go about catching them then?
Well I have a scorpion cage here which you can use to catch them in.
translation: Burada onlari yakalamak icin kullanabileceginiz bir akrep kafesi var.

english: Well you have the scorpion cage I gave you, you can catch them using that.
translation: Sana verdigim akrep kafesi var, onu kullanarak onlari yakalayabilirsin.

english: If you go up to the village of Seers, to the North of here, one of them will be able to tell you where the scorpions are now.
translation: Buradan kuzeye, Seers köyüne gidersen, oradakilerden biri sana akreplerin su anda nerede oldugunu söyleyebilir.

english: Ok, I will do it then.
I'm not interested.
Blast, I suppose I'll have to find someone else then.
translation: Hay aksi, o zaman baska birini bulmam gerekecek.

english: I'm a little busy.
How goes your quest?
I've not caught all the scorpions yet.
Well remember to go speak to the Seers, North of here, if you need any help.
translation: Yardima ihtiyacin olursa, buradan kuzeydeki Seers'lerle konusmayi unutma.

english: I've not brought all the scorpions with me.
Well go and fetch them then.
I have retrieved all your scorpions.
Aha, my little scorpions home at last!
translation: Aha, kücük akreplerim sonunda eve döndü!

english: Thank you for rescuing my scorpions.
That's ok.
You said you'd enchant my battlestaff for me.
Yes, it'll cost you [20,000 / 30,000 / 40,000] coins for the materials needed though. Which sort of staff did you want enchanting?
translation: Evet, ancak gerekli malzemeler icin [20.000 / 30.000 / 40.000] sikke ödemen gerekecek. Hangi tür asayi büyülü hale getirmek istiyorsun?

english: What do you need assistance with?
So how would I go about catching them then?
Ok, I will do it then.
I'm not interested.
What's in it for me?
I'm not interested then.
I'm a little busy.
That's ok.
You said you'd enchant my battlestaff for me.
translation: Savas asami büyülü hale getirecegini söylemistin.

english: Hello!
Can I have some more boots?
Thorodin gives you another pair of boots.
translation: Thorodin sana bir cift bot daha verir.

english: Who are you?
Thorodin, taskmaster for the Fremennik Achievement Diary.
translation: Thorodin, Fremennik Basari Günlügü'nün görev sorumlusu.

english: What is the Achievement Diary?

It's a diary that helps you keep track of particular achievements. In the Fremennik lands it can help you discover some quite useful things. Eventually, with enough exploration, the inhabitants will reward you.
translation: Belirli basarilari takip etmenize yardimci olan bir günlüktür. Fremennik topraklarinda oldukca yararli seyler kesfetmenize yardimci olabilir. Yeterince kesif yaptiktan sonra, bölge sakinleri sizi ödüllendirecektir.

english: You can see the list of tasks on the side-panel.
I have a question about my Achievement diary.
translation: Basari Günlügümle ilgili bir sorum var.

english: Well, there are four different pairs of Fremennik sea boots, which match up with the four levels of difficulty. Each has the same rewards as the previous level and some additional benefits too... which tier of rewards
translation: Fremennik deniz botlarinin dört farkli cifti var ve bunlar dört zorluk seviyesine karsilik geliyor. Her biri önceki seviyeyle ayni ödüllere ve bazi ek avantajlara sahiptir... Hangi ödül kademesi

english: would you like to know more about?
translation: hakkinda daha fazla bilgi almak istersiniz?

english: Tell me more about the Easy rewards please!
translation: Kolay ödüller hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin lütfen!

english: If you complete all of the easy tasks in the Fremennik Province, Peer the Seer can bank items for you at all times and your enchanted lyre can hold an extra charge.
translation: Fremennik Eyaletindeki tüm kolay görevleri tamamlarsaniz, Peer the Seer her zaman sizin icin esyalari bankaya yatirabilir ve büyülü liriniz ekstra bir sarj tutabilir.

english: Thanks!
Tell me more about the Medium rewards please!
translation: Orta seviye ödüller hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin lütfen!

english: In addition to the easy rewards, your boots can teleport you to Rellekka once per day and you'll gain access a shortcut on the Miscellania docks as well as an increased rate of gaining approval with your subjects.
translation: Kolay ödüllere ek olarak, botlariniz sizi günde bir kez Rellekka'ya isinlayabilir ve Miscellania rihtiminda bir kisayola erisim kazanirsiniz, ayrica tebaasinin onayini kazanma oraniniz artar.

english: Tell me more about the Hard rewards please!
translation: Zor seviye ödüller hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin lütfen!

english: In addition to the easy and medium benefits, you'll be able to change your lyre teleport location to Waterbirth Island, use a shortcut to the roof of the Troll Stronghold and access two new Lunar spells.
translation: Kolay ve orta seviye avantajlara ek olarak, lirinizin isinlanma konumunu Waterbirth Adasi olarak degistirebilir, Troll Kalesi'nin catisina giden bir kisayol kullanabilir ve iki yeni Ay büyüsüne erisebilirsiniz.

english: Tell me more about the Elite rewards please!
translation: Elit ödüller hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin lütfen!

english: In addition to the previous tiers of rewards, your boots now have unlimited teleports to Rellekka, your lyre can be attuned to teleport you to Jatiszo or Neitiznot, you'll no longer need a seal of passage on Lunar Isle,
translation: Önceki ödül kademelerine ek olarak, botlariniz artik Rellekka'ya sinirsiz teleport yapabilir, liriniz sizi Jatiszo veya Neitiznot'a teleport etmek icin ayarlanabilir, Lunar Isle'da gecis mührüne artik ihtiyaciniz olmayacak,

english: Dagannoth bones will be dropped as notes and your subjects will approve of your kingdom management even faster than before.
translation: Dagannoth kemikleri notlar olarak düsecek ve tebaalariniz kralliginizin yönetimini eskisinden daha hizli onaylayacak.

english: Just complete the tasks in the Fremennik Province so they're ticked off, then come and speak to me for your rewards.
translation: Fremennik Eyaletindeki görevleri tamamlayip isaretleyin, sonra gelip ödüllerinizi almak icin benimle konusun.

english: Bye!
See you later.
About the Dagannoth Kings...
Ah, yes. Because you've completed the elite tasks for the Fremennik Province, their bones will be noted for you.
translation: Ah, evet. Fremennik Eyaletindeki elit görevleri tamamladiginiz icin, kemikleri sizin icin not edilecek.

english: If you'd prefer, I can change it so they will drop their bones as they normally would?
translation: Isterseniz, kemiklerini normalde oldugu gibi düsecek sekilde degistirebilirim.

english: Very well. In future, when you kill a Dagannoth King, they will drop their bones normally.
translation: Peki. Bundan sonra, bir Dagannoth Krali öldürdügünde, kemikleri normal sekilde düsecek.

english: Very well. If you change your mind, come talk to me again.
translation: Peki. Fikrini degistirirsen, tekrar gelip benimle konus.

english: Ah, yes. You wanted the bones from the Dagannoth Kings to remain unnoted when you killed them.
translation: Ah, evet. Dagannoth Krallarini öldürdügünde kemiklerinin not edilmemesini istemistin.

english: If you'd prefer, I can change them back to being noted instead?
Very well. In future, when you kill a Dagannoth King, their bones will be noted.
translation: Peki. Bundan sonra, bir Dagannoth Krali öldürdügünde, kemikleri isaretlenecek.

english: Exile. You don't have many friends around here at the moment.
translation: Sürgün. Su anda burada pek arkadasin yok.

english: How do you feel about it?
Doesn't bother me. Some people take these things more seriously than others. On that note, do you need something?
translation: Beni rahatsiz etmiyor. Bazi insanlar bu tür seyleri digerlerinden daha ciddiye alir. Bu arada, bir seye ihtiyacin var mi?

english: I've completed all of the easy tasks in my Fremennik Achievement Diary!
translation: Fremennik Basari Günlügümdeki tüm kolay görevleri tamamladim!

english: I can see that, well done! You'll be wanting your reward then!
translation: Görüyorum, aferin! O zaman ödülünü almak istersin herhalde!

english: Yes please!
These boots are a symbol of your exploration of the Fremennik lands. Peer the Seer can now bank items for you at all times and your enchanted lyre can hold an extra charge.
translation: Bu botlar, Fremennik topraklarini kesfettiginin sembolüdür. Peer the Seer artik senin icin her zaman esya saklayabilir ve büyülü lirinin ekstra sarj kapasitesi vardir.

english: Wow, thanks!
If you ever lose your boots, come back to me to reclaim them.
translation: Botlarini kaybedersen, geri almak icin bana gel.

english: I've completed all of the medium tasks in my Fremennik achievement diary!
translation: Fremennik basari günlügümdeki tüm orta zorlukta görevleri tamamladim!

english: I've upgraded your Fremennik sea boots for you. They can now teleport you here once per day and have an increased rate of gaining approval with your subjects.
translation: Fremennik deniz botlarini senin icin yükselttim. Artik günde bir kez buraya isinlanabilir ve tebaandan daha fazla onay alabilirsin.

english: I've completed all of the hard tasks in my Fremennik achievement diary!
translation: Fremennik basari günlügümdeki tüm zor görevleri tamamladim!

english: You need to complete all of the easy and medium tasks too before I can reward you for the more difficult sets.
translation: Daha zor görevler icin sana ödül verebilmem icin önce tüm kolay ve orta zorlukta görevleri de tamamlaman gerekiyor.

english: I've upgraded your Fremennik sea boots for you. You can now change your lyre teleport location to Waterbirth Island, access two new Lunar spells and you'll receive extra Agility experience from the Rellekka
translation: Fremennik deniz botlarinizi sizin icin gelistirdim. Artik lirinizle isinlanma konumunuzu Waterbirth Adasi olarak degistirebilir, iki yeni Ay büyüsüne erisebilir ve Rellekka

english: rooftop course.
translation: cati parkurundan ekstra Ceviklik deneyimi kazanabilirsiniz.

english: I've completed all of the elite tasks in my Fremennik achievement diary!
translation: Fremennik basari günlügümdeki tüm elit görevleri tamamladim!

english: I can see that, well done! You've completed all of the tasks in the Fremennik Province! Here's your reward!
translation: Görüyorum, aferin! Fremennik Eyaletindeki tüm görevleri tamamladiniz! Iste ödülün!

english: I've upgraded your Fremennik sea boots for you. In addition to all of the previous benefits, your boots now have unlimited teleports to Rellekka, your lyre can now teleport you to Jatiszo or Neitiznot, you'll no longer
translation: Fremennik deniz botlarini senin icin gelistirdim. Önceki tüm avantajlara ek olarak, botlarin artik Rellekka'ya sinirsiz teleport imkani sunuyor, lirsen artik seni Jatiszo veya Neitiznot'a teleport edebiliyor, artik

english: need a seal of passage on Lunar Isle, Dagannoth bones will be dropped as notes and your subjects will approve of your kingdom management even faster than before.
translation: Ay Adasi'nda gecis mührüne ihtiyacin yok, Dagannoth kemikleri not olarak düsecek ve tebaalarin krallik yönetimini eskisinden daha hizli onaylayacak.

english: Can I have some more boots?
Who are you?
I have a question about my Achievement Diary
translation: Basari Günlügümle ilgili bir sorum var.

english: What is the Achievement Diary?
What are the rewards?
Easy Rewards.
Medium Rewards.
Hard Rewards.
Elite Rewards.
How do I claim the rewards?
Bye!
About the Dagannoth Kings...
Yes, give me unnoted bones.
No, keep the bones noted.
translation: Hayir, kemikleri not alinmis olarak saklayin.

english: Yes, give me noted bones.
No, keep the bones unnoted.
Good day, [sir/madam].
What are you doing down here?
We're extending the cave so more people can live in it.
translation: Daha fazla insanin yasayabilmesi icin magarayi genisletiyoruz.

english: These Miscellanians aren't so bad. They appreciate the benefits of living underground.
translation: Bu Miscellanians o kadar da kötü degil. Yeraltinda yasamanin faydalarini takdir ediyorlar.

english: ...such as?
You don't get rained on, for example.
Of course, there are some problems, like the monsters Donal saw...
translation: Tabii ki, Donal'in gördügü canavarlar gibi bazi sorunlar da var...

english: Someone saw a monster?
Could you tell me more? The King asked me to investigate.
translation: Bana daha fazla bilgi verebilir misiniz? Kral benden arastirmami istedi.

english: One of the other dwarves who was working with us saw it. His name's Donal.
translation: Bizimle birlikte calisan diger cücelerden biri gördü. Adi Donal.

english: He went further into the caves to plan our excavations, and a while later he came out shaking.
translation: Kazi planlarimizi yapmak icin magaralarin derinliklerine gitti ve bir süre sonra titreyerek cikti.

english: He's been in the inn ever since.
Good day.
Have you spoken to Donal?
Not yet, no.
Well, if you want to hear stories about monsters, he's the best one to ask.
translation: Canavarlarla ilgili hikayeler duymak istiyorsan, ona sormak en iyisi.

english: Not getting rained on, for example.
I have. The monster he talked about could be in the caves nearby.
translation: Konustum. Bahsettigi canavar yakinlardaki magaralarda olabilir.

english: You'd better get in there and do something about it, then.
translation: O zaman iceri girip bir seyler yapmalisin.

english: It's not safe. I need to shore up the walls before I can go through.
translation: Güvenli degil. Iceri girebilmek icin önce duvarlari saglamlastirmam gerekiyor.

english: Did you do anything about that monster Donal was talking about?
translation: Donal'in bahsettigi canavarla ilgili bir sey yaptin mi?

english: It's been taken care of.
Glad to hear it. Now we can get on with excavating.
translation: Bunu duyduguma sevindim. Artik kaziya devam edebiliriz.

english: What are you doing down here?
Good day.
Leave me be, outerlander. I have nothing to say to the likes of you.
translation: Beni rahat birak, yabanci. Senin gibilere söyleyecek hicbir seyim yok.

english: Hello!
Hello yourself, outerlander. What brings you to dare speak to a mighty Fremennik warrior such as myself?
translation: Merhaba, yabanci. Beni gibi güclü bir Fremennik savascisina nasil cesaret edersin?

english: Erm... are you a member of the council?
The Fremennik council of elders? Why, of course I am. I am recognised as one the clans mightiest warriors. What is it to you outerlander?
translation: Fremennik yaslilar konseyi mi? Tabii ki öyleyim. Klanin en güclü savascilarindan biri olarak taniniyorum. Senin neyin var, yabanci?

english: Well... I was wondering if you could vote for me to become a Fremennik.
translation: Sey... Fremennik olmak icin bana oy verir misin diye merak ediyordum.

english: An outerlander wishes to become a Fremennik!?!? Ha! That is priceless!
translation: Bir yabanci Fremennik olmak mi istiyor!?!? Ha! Bu cok komik!

english: Well, let us say that I am not totally against this concept. As a warrior, I appreciate the value of brave and powerful warriors to our clan,
translation: Sey, bu fikre tamamen karsi degilim diyelim. Bir savasci olarak, klanimiz icin cesur ve güclü savascilarin degerini takdir ediyorum.

english: and even though you may be an outerlander, I will not hold this against you if you can prove yourself to be fierce of heart in a combat situation to me.
translation: Ve sen bir yabanci olsan da, savas durumunda bana cesur oldugunu kanitlayabilirsen, bunu sana karsi kullanmayacagim.

english: So how can I prove that? You want to fight me? Come on then, bring it on! Right here, right now, buddy!
translation: Peki bunu nasil kanitlayabilirim? Benimle dövüsmek mi istiyorsun? Hadi o zaman, gel bakalim! Hemen burada, simdi, dostum!

english: Hahahahaha! You certainly show some spirit for an outerlander!
translation: Hahahahaha! Bir yabancinin ruhunu gercekten gösteriyorsun!

english: But spirit does not always make a good warrior. It takes both skill and spirit to be so. I have a test that I give all Fremenniks on their path to be a member of the clan.
translation: Ama ruh her zaman iyi bir savasci yapmaz. Bunun icin hem beceri hem de ruh gerekir. Klanin bir üyesi olmak isteyen tüm Fremenniklere uyguladigim bir test var.

english: My test will challenge both your combat prowess and your bravery equally. Should you pass it you will earn my vote at the council, and more importantly my respect for you as a warrior.
translation: Sinavim, hem savas becerini hem de cesaretini esit sekilde test edecek. Eger sinavi gecersen, konseyde oyumu kazanacaksin ve daha da önemlisi, bir savasci olarak sana saygimi kazanacaksin.

english: So what say you, outerlander? Are you prepared for the battle?
translation: Ee, ne dersin, yabanci? Savasa hazir misin?

english: Am I prepared? I'll show you what combat's all about, you big sissy barbarian type guy!
translation: Hazir miyim mi? Sana savasin ne demek oldugunu gösterecegim, seni korkak barbar herif!

english: Hahahahaha! I'm beginning to like you already, outerlander!
translation: Hahahahaha! Seni simdiden sevmeye basladim, yabancisi!

english: Then allow me to present you with my challenge; This ladder here will take you to a place of combat. I have placed a special warrior down there to challenge you.
translation: O halde sana meydan okumami sunmama izin ver; bu merdiven seni savas alanina götürecek. Orada sana meydan okumak icin özel bir savasci yerlestirdim.

english: Battle him to the death, and you will pass my challenge. If at any point you wish to leave combat, simply climb back up the ladder, to leave that place.
translation: Onunla ölümüne savas ve meydan okumami gec. Herhangi bir anda savastan ayrilmak istersen, merdivenden yukari cikarak o yerden ayrilabilirsin.

english: If you leave you will of course fail the test. You may retry my test in the future if you fail, but you must stay down there until the death if you wish for my vote at the council.
translation: Eger ayrilirsan, elbette testi gecemeyeceksin. Eger basarisiz olursan, gelecekte testimi tekrar deneyebilirsin, ama konseyde benim oyumu istiyorsan, ölümüne kadar orada kalmalisin.

english: You must defeat him three times to prove that you are worthy. The fourth time that you fight him will be to the death, so do not show cowardice.
translation: Degerli oldugunu kanitlamak icin onu üc kez yenmelisin. Dördüncü kez onunla ölümüne savasacaksin, bu yüzden korkaklik gösterme.

english: Is that all? It will be easy!
No, there is one more important rule;
translation: Hayir, bir önemli kural daha var;

english: You may not enter the battleground with any armour or weaponry of any kind.
translation: Savas alanina herhangi bir zirh veya silahla giremezsin.

english: If you need to place your equipment into your bank account, I recommend that you speak to the seer, who knows a spell that will do that for you.
translation: Esyalarini banka hesabina koyman gerekiyorsa, bunu senin icin yapacak bir büyü bilen kahine danismani tavsiye ederim.

english: No thanks, I'm pretty sure that I can find someone else to vote for me.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, bana oy verecek baska birini bulabilecegime eminim.

english: Hmm, not so brave after all, outerlander? Perhaps it is for the best. I doubt you have what it takes to pass my challenge.
translation: Hmm, o kadar da cesur degilsin galiba, yabanci? Belki de en iyisi budur. Benim meydan okumami gececek kadar cesur oldugunu sanmiyorum.

english: Outerlander... do not test my patience. I do not take kindly to people wandering in here and acting as though they own the place.
translation: Yabanci... sabrimi sinama. Buraya gelip burayi kendi evi gibi davranan insanlari pek sevmem.

english: So what do I have to do to earn your vote at the council again?
translation: Peki, konseyde oyunuzu kazanmak icin ne yapmam gerekiyor?

english: I will not offer my vote to anybody whose bravery in combat I do not trust completely. You must go down that ladder and fight your foe to the death.
translation: Savasta cesaretine tamamen güvenmedigim kimseye oyumu vermeyecegim. O merdivenden asagi inip düsmaninla ölümüne savasmalisin.

english: So, who is my opponent?
Ah, a wise question before entering combat. His name is Koschei the deathless. He is something of a mystery, even to us.
translation: Ah, savasa girmeden önce akillica bir soru. Adi Koschei, ölümsüz olan. O, bizim icin bile bir gizemdir.

english: On one of our regular raiding parties, our longship discovered a man in the frozen waters far north-east of here. We took him aboard our ship, thinking he must be dead.
translation: Düzenli yaptigimiz baskinlardan birinde, uzun gemimiz buradan cok kuzeydogudaki donmus sularda bir adam kesfetti. Öldügünü düsünerek onu gemimize aldik.

english: To our amazement he was perfectly healthy, even though he must have been in those deadly icey waters for many weeks.
translation: Sasirtici bir sekilde, o ölümcül buzlu sularda haftalarca kalmis olmasina ragmen tamamen saglikliydi.

english: He has no memory of who he is, or how he came to be there, except for his own name: Koschei. We named him 'The Deathless' because he is seemingly unkillable!
translation: Kim oldugu veya oraya nasil geldigi hakkinda hicbir sey hatirlamiyor, sadece kendi adini biliyor: Koschei. Onu “Ölümsüz” olarak adlandirdik cünkü görünüse göre öldürülemez!

english: Any combat technique used against him, he learns instantly! He also apparently can heal himself from any wound at will! When he attacks, his weapon moves like a whirlwind!
translation: Ona karsi kullanilan herhangi bir savas teknigini aninda ögreniyor! Ayrica, istedigi zaman herhangi bir yarayi iyilestirebiliyor! Saldirdiginda, silahi bir kasirga gibi hareket ediyor!

english: He can hide his combat level from his opponents at will as well! He is truly a horribly fierce opponent to face! I am only glad that he has chosen to stay here with us!
translation: Istedigi zaman rakiplerinden savas seviyesini gizleyebiliyor! Gercekten de karsi karsiya gelmek icin korkunc derecede siddetli bir rakip! Onun bizimle kalmayi secmis olmasina cok seviniyorum!

english: The daylight makes him feel weak, so we have built him his own battleground beneath this building, where he can train his fiercesome skills without being disturbed.
translation: Gün isigi onu zayiflatiyor, bu yüzden bu binanin altinda ona kendi savas alani insa ettik, burada rahatsiz edilmeden siddetli becerilerini gelistirebiliyor.

english: But he can't REALLY be unkillable...  ...can he?
translation: Ama o GERCEKTEN öldürülemez olamaz...  ...degil mi?

english: Some say he cannot die, for he has hidden his heart outside of his body to be kept forever safe in a duck egg.
translation: Bazilari, kalbini vücudunun disinda saklayarak bir ördek yumurtasinda sonsuza kadar güvende tuttugu icin ölemeyecegini söylüyor.

english: Others say he has been cursed by the gods to wander this land forever, never knowing any peace in his life, but only combat.
translation: Digerleri ise tanrilar tarafindan bu topraklarda sonsuza kadar dolasmaya mahkum edildigini, hayatinda asla huzur bulamayacagini, sadece savasacagini söylüyor.

english: Some claim that the sword he carries is the source of all his power, and if he should lose it, then exactly one minute later, he will turn back into his true form;
translation: Bazilari ise tasidigi kilicin tüm gücünün kaynagi oldugunu ve eger onu kaybederse, tam bir dakika sonra gercek haline dönecegini söylüyor;

english: A weakened, lame, old man.
And what do you believe?
I believe you shouldn't look a gift horse in the mouth. He is a fearfully powerful warrior, but more importantly; He is on OUR side, not against us.
translation: Ben, hediye atin disine bakilmamasi gerektigine inaniyorum. O korkutucu derecede güclü bir savasci, ama daha da önemlisi; O bizim tarafimizda, bize karsi degil.

english: He is content testing the battle skills of anyone taking their Fremennik trials of manhood, and I am content knowing that should an enemy ever invade our town,
translation: Fremennik erkeklik sinavlarina girenlerin savas becerilerini test etmekten memnun ve ben de düsman kasabamizi istila ederse,

english: while our warriors are out on a raiding party, Koschei will be able to hold off ANY invader long enough for us to make our return.
translation: savascilarimiz yagma seferindeyken Koschei'nin geri dönmemiz icin yeterince uzun süre HERHANGI bir istilaciyi oyalamayi basaracagindan eminim.

english: I don't really like fighting that much... Isn't there something else I can do to earn your vote at the council of elders?
translation: Dövüsmeyi pek sevmiyorum... Yaslilar konseyinde oyunuzu kazanmak icin yapabilecegim baska bir sey yok mu?

english: Yes of course outerlander! If you bring me five raw sardines then I will vote for you instead!
translation: Tabii ki var, yabanci! Bana bes tane cig sardalya getirirsen, sana oy veririm!

english: REALLY?!?!?
HAHAHAHAHAHA! No, of course not! You are stupid, even by outerlander standards!
translation: HAHAHAHAHAHA! Hayir, tabii ki hayir! Yabanci standartlarina göre bile aptalsin!

english: If you want my vote, you must pass my trial. It is as simple as that.
translation: Oyumun istiyorsan, sinavimi gecmelisin. Bu kadar basit.

english: Congratulations! You have completed the warrior's trial! (Koschei disappears in a puff of smoke, the player receives a Fremennik blade)
translation: Tebrikler! Savasci sinavini tamamladin! (Koschei bir duman bulutu icinde kaybolur, oyuncu bir Fremennik kilici alir)

english: Hahaha! Well fought outerlander! Now come down from there, you have passed my trial with flying colours!
translation: Hahaha! Iyi savastin yabanci! Simdi oradan in, sinavimi basariyla gectin!

english: But... I don't understand... I did not manage to beat Koschei...
I did not say you had to, outerlander! All I asked was that you fought to the death! And you did! The death was your own!
translation: Yenmen gerektigini söylemedim, yabanci! Tek istedigim ölümüne savasmandi! Ve sen bunu yaptin! Ölüm senin oldu!

english: I was not interested in how strong you are! I was interested in how BRAVE you are! You fought a superior enemy to your very last breath - THAT is bravery.
translation: Ne kadar güclü oldugun umurumda degildi! Ne kadar CESUR oldugun umurumdaydi! Son nefesine kadar üstün bir düsmanla savastin - iste bu cesarettir.

english: I would be honoured to represent you to the council as worthy of being a Fremennik after watching that superb battle!
translation: O muhtesem savasi izledikten sonra, seni Fremennik olmaya layik olarak konseye sunmaktan onur duyarim!

english: So can I count on your vote at the council of elders now Thorvald?
translation: Öyleyse, yaslilar konseyinde senin oyuna güvenebilir miyim Thorvald?

english: Absolutely! I watched the entire battle, and was extremely impressed with your bravery in combat!
translation: Elbette! Savasi bastan sona izledim ve savastaki cesaretinden cok etkilendim!

english: I'd really rather not go back down there again, now that I have Thorvald's vote at the council of elders.
translation: Thorvald'in yaslilar konseyindeki oyunu aldigim icin, oraya bir daha geri dönmek istemiyorum.

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a brave and powerful warrior to act as a bodyguard?
translation: Cesur ve güclü bir savasci bulabilecegim bir yer biliyor musun?

english: Know you not who I am outerlander? There are none more brave or powerful than me amongst all the Fremennik!
translation: Benim kim oldugumu bilmiyor musun, yabanci? Fremennikler arasinda benden daha cesur ve güclü kimse yok!

english: However... The role of bodyguard is below me, as a noble warrior. You might as well ask me to babysit the children!
translation: Ancak... Asil bir savasci olarak, korumalik görevi benim icin cok asagilik bir is. Bana cocuklara bakicilik yapmami istesen daha iyi!

english: Is there no way you would do this for me?
translation: Bunu benim icin yapmanin bir yolu yok mu?

english: There is but one way outerlander. Since I was steeled in battle, I have dreamt of earning my place at the Champions Table in the Long Hall.
translation: Tek bir yol var, yabanci. Savasta sertlestigimden beri, Uzun Salon'daki Sampiyonlar Masasi'nda yerimi kazanmayi hayal ediyorum.

english: It is a tradition amongst us that the bravest and strongest are honoured with a table of champions to drink and feast all that they can in our Long Hall.
translation: Bizim aramizda bir gelenek vardir: En cesur ve en güclü olanlar, Uzun Salon'da icip yiyebilecekleri kadar icip yiyebilecekleri bir sampiyonlar masasiyla onurlandirilirlar.

english: Unfortunately, there are only a fixed number of places available at the table, and these places were all filled many moons ago by others.
translation: Ne yazik ki, masada sadece belirli sayida yer var ve bu yerler aylar önce baskalari tarafindan dolduruldu.

english: Although my worthiness is undeniable, the only way I may take my place is if one of those already there die, or give up their place to me voluntarily.
translation: Degerim yadsinamaz olsa da, yerimi alabilmemin tek yolu, orada bulunanlardan birinin ölmesi veya yerini bana gönüllü olarak vermesi.

english: So you want me to go kill one of them off for you? Make it look like an accident?
translation: Yani senin icin onlardan birini öldürmemi mi istiyorsun? Kaza gibi görünmesini mi?

english: WHAT? No, no, not at all! I am shocked you would suggest such a thing!
translation: NE? Hayir, hayir, hic de degil! Böyle bir sey önerdigin icin sok oldum!

english: If you can persuade one of the Revellers to give up their Champions' Token to you so that I might take their place, you may have my contract as a bodyguard.
translation: Eger Revellers'lardan birini, benim onlarin yerini alabilmem icin Sampiyonlar Jetonunu sana vermesi icin ikna edebilirsen, benim korumam olarak sözlesme yapabiliriz.

english: Okay, I'll see what I can do.
I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find the token to allow your seat at the champions table?
translation: Sampiyonlar masasinda senin yerini alabilmem icin jetonu nerede bulabilecegimi biliyor musun?

english: You will need to persuade one of the revellers in the Long Hall to give up their token, and their place, in deference to my own worthiness somehow.
translation: Long Hall'daki Reveller'lardan birini, benim degerime saygi göstererek jetonunu ve yerini sana birakmasi icin ikna etmen gerekecek.

english: I would like your contract to offer your services as a bodyguard.
translation: Bodyguard olarak hizmetlerini sunman icin sözlesmeni istiyorum.

english: Oh you would, would you outerlander? I have already told you, I will not demean myself with such a baby sitting job until I can sit in the Longhall with pride.
translation: Öyle mi, yabanci? Sana zaten söyledim, Longhall'da gururla oturabilecek duruma gelene kadar böyle bir bebek bakiciligi isiyle kendimi kücük düsürmeyecegim.

english: It's a good thing I have the Champions' Token right here then, isn't it?
translation: O zaman sampiyonlarin simgesi burada olmasi iyi bir sey, degil mi?

english: Ah... well this is a different matter. With that token I can claim my rightful place as a champion in the Long hall!
translation: Ah... bu farkli bir konu. O simgeyle Long Hall'da sampiyon olarak hak ettigim yeri alabilirim!

english: Here outerlander, I can suffer the indignity of playing babysitter if it means that I can then revel with my warrior equals in the Long Hall afterwards!
translation: Al yabanci, Long Hall'da savasci arkadaslarimla eglenebilmek icin bebek bakiciligi yapmanin asagilanmasina katlanabilirim!

english: Here outerlander, take this contract; I will fulfill it to my utmost.
translation: Al bu sözlesmeyi, yabanci. Elimden gelenin en iyisini yapacagim.

english: (Thorvald takes the Champions token and gives the player Warrior's contract)
translation: (Thorvald Sampiyonlar Jetonunu alir ve oyuncuya Savasci Sözlesmesini verir)

english: You didn't take much persuading to 'lower' yourself to a bodyguard.
translation: Kendini bir koruma görevlisi olarak “alcaltmak” icin fazla ikna edilmen gerekmedi.

english: You misunderstand, outerlander. Normally I will only battle for a noble cause, but have never been recognised as a true champion here.
translation: Yanlis anladin, yabanci. Normalde sadece asil bir amac icin savasirim, ama burada hic gercek bir sampiyon olarak taninmadim.

english: With this Champion's token, I can stand alongside my warrior brethren in the Long Hall, and revel in the glories of past victories together!
translation: Bu Sampiyon jetonuyla, Uzun Salon'da savasci kardeslerimin yaninda durabilir ve gecmis zaferlerin ihtisamini birlikte kutlayabilirim!

english: Howdy Thorvald!
And greetings to you too. It is good to see new blood entering the Fremennik; we gain our strength by bringing new warriors into the tribe.
translation: Sana da selamlar. Fremennik'e yeni kanin girmesini görmek güzel; kabileye yeni savascilar katarak gücümüzü artiriyoruz.

english: Yes
No
What do I have to do again?
Who is my opponent?
Can't I do something else?
Ask about the Merchant's trial
Ask about becoming a Fremennik
Welcome to the Realm of Memories, [player name].
Who were you?
I am Thrander. Long ago I used to live in Varrock, converting plate armour. For example, if you'd got a plate skirt, but you preferred leggings instead, I'd convert it, free of charge.
translation: Ben Thrander. Uzun zaman önce Varrock'ta yasiyordum ve zirhlari dönüstürüyordum. Örnegin, plaka etegin varsa ama bunun yerine tozluk tercih ediyorsan, onu ücretsiz olarak dönüstürürdüm.

english: Are you happy here?
Maybe retiring was a mistake. If the world ever wanted me again, I could come out of retirement and offer my services as before. Though people might fret about the economic impact if I did.
translation: Belki de emekli olmak bir hataydi. Eger dünya beni tekrar isterse, emeklilikten cikip eskisi gibi hizmetlerimi sunabilirim. Ancak bunu yaparsam insanlar ekonomik etkisinden endise duyabilirler.

english: Thanks.
Who were you?
Are you happy here?
Thanks.
Urg!
Urg!
What is it, human? I'm working.
How do I use the furnace?
Put your ore on the conveyor belt to get it smelted. We'll stoke the boiler and operate the rest of the machinery for you.
translation: Eriyik haline getirmek icin cevherini konveyör bandina koy. Biz kazanini yakip geri kalan makineleri senin icin calistiracagiz.

english: You'll have to help repair the furnace whenever a pipe blows, though. Just hit it with a hammer - that usually works.
translation: Ancak bir boru patladiginda firini onarmaya yardim etmen gerekecek. Cekicle vurman yeterli, genellikle ise yarar.

english: You'll have to put money in the coffer to pay for our services. We charge 72,000 coins per hour; money is deducted as long as you're in this room with us.
translation: Hizmetlerimizin bedelini ödemek icin kasaya para koyman gerekecek. Saat basina 72.000 sikke aliyoruz; bu odada bizimle birlikte oldugun sürece para kesilir.

english: Gosh, you're a remarkably big dwarf.
translation: Vay canina, sen gercekten cok büyük bir cücesin.

english: My brothers and I have a rare genetic condition affecting our growth. Rather than treating us as freaks, you might like to appreciate how useful it is that we can operate the machinery.
translation: Kardeslerim ve ben, büyümemizi etkileyen nadir bir genetik rahatsizliga sahibiz. Bizi ucube olarak görmek yerine, makineleri calistirabilmemizin ne kadar yararli oldugunu takdir etmelisin.

english: Sorry.
That's ok, human. You're not the first to comment on it. Now, did you need anything? I've got work to do here.
translation: Önemli degil, insan. Bunu söyleyen ilk kisi sen degilsin. Simdi, bir seye ihtiyacin var mi? Burada yapmam gereken isler var.

english: Are you sure you're really a dwarf?
... look, do you want help with something, or did you just come here to be rude? I've got work to do.
translation: bak, bir seye yardim mi istiyorsun, yoksa sadece kaba davranmak icin mi buraya geldin? Yapmam gereken isler var.

english: I'll let you get on with it.
How do I use the furnace?
Gosh, you're a remarkably big dwarf.
translation: Vay canina, sen gercekten cok büyük bir cücesin.

english: Sorry.
I'll let you get on with it.
Are you sure you're really a dwarf?
translation: Gercekten bir cüce olduguna emin misin?

english: What is that cape you're wearing?
It's a Skillcape of Smithing. It shows that I'm a master blacksmith, but that's only to be expected - after all, my ancestors were the greatest blacksmiths in dwarven history.
translation: Bu bir Demircilik Beceri Pelerini. Benim usta bir demirci oldugumu gösterir, ama bu beklenen bir sey - sonucta, atalarim cüce tarihinin en büyük demircileriydi.

english: If you ever achieve level 99 Smithing you'll be able to wear a cape like this, and receive more experience when smelting gold ore.
translation: 99. seviye Demircilik'e ulasirsan, böyle bir pelerin giyebilecek ve altin cevheri eritirken daha fazla deneyim kazanabileceksin.

english: Can you make me another of Sir Vyvin's swords?
translation: Bana Sir Vyvin'in kilicindan bir tane daha yapabilir misin?

english: You want that knight's sword again? I suppose you brought me a lovely pie, so I don't mind. I'll need a blurite ore and two iron bars, like before.
translation: Yine o sövalyenin kilicini mi istiyorsun? Bana güzel bir turta getirdin, o yüzden sorun degil. Daha önce oldugu gibi bir blurite cevheri ve iki demir cubuga ihtiyacim olacak.

english: Okay, I'll go and find that.
Would you like a redberry pie?
You see Thurgo's eyes light up.
I'd never say no to a redberry pie! We Imcando dwarves love them - they're GREAT!
translation: Kirmizi meyveli turtaya asla hayir demem! Biz Imcando cüceleri onu cok severiz, harikadir!

english: You hand over the pie. Thurgo eats the pie. Thurgo pats his stomach.
translation: Turtayi verirsin. Thurgo turtayi yer. Thurgo karnini oksar.

english: By Guthix! THAT was good pie! Anyone who makes pie like THAT has got to be alright!
translation: Guthix adina! Bu turta cok lezzetliydi! Böyle turta yapan biri mutlaka iyi biridir!

english: Can we talk about skillcapes?
What do you need, human?
Now that I am so skilled at Smithing, can I buy a Skillcape of Smithing from you?
translation: Artik demircilik konusunda cok yetenekli olduguma göre, senden demircilik Skillcape'i satin alabilir miyim?

english: I reckon so; we master smiths must stick together! I'll give it to you for just 99000 coins.
translation: Sanirim evet; usta demirciler birbirine destek olmali! Sana sadece 99.000 coin karsiliginda veririm.

english: Sorry, that's too much money.
Too much money? A smith of your calibre should be able to make that amount in an hour!
translation: Cok mu pahali? Senin kalibrede bir demirci bir saatte o kadar parayi kazanabilir!

english: Of course I'll pay you.
All Skillcapes come with a free hood. It's part of a deal: buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: Tüm Skillcapes'lere ücretsiz bir baslik dahildir. Bu bir anlasmanin parcasi: bir alana bir bedava, bilirsin. Yani sana bir tane satabilmem icin önce envanterinde yer acman gerekecek.

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: Harika! O pelerini gururla giy dostum.

english: I've met another Imcando dwarf.
translation: Baska bir Imcando cücesi ile tanistim.

english: I very much doubt that [player name]. I'm the last Imcando dwarf left in Gielinor.
translation: Bundan cok süpheliyim Maceraci. Gielinor'da kalan son Imcando cücesiyim.

english: No it's true. I was accidentally helping some grave robbers unearth some treasure below Ice Mountain. Long story short, it turned out to be the ruins of Camdozaal.
translation: Hayir, dogru. Kazara bazi mezar soyguncularina Ice Mountain'in altindaki bir hazineyi ortaya cikarmalarinda yardim ettim. Uzun lafin kisasi, orasi Camdozaal'in kalintilari cikti.

english: Camdozaal?
Yes!
I don't believe me ears! Tell me what else you know!
translation: Kulaklarima inanamiyorum! Baska ne biliyorsun, anlat!

english: Well there's not much left there really. It's just a ruin.
translation: Aslinda orada pek bir sey kalmadi. Sadece bir harabe.

english: But there's a lone Imcando dwarf keeping it alive. His name is Ramarno.
translation: Ama onu ayakta tutan tek bir Imcando cücesi var. Adi Ramarno.

english: Ramarno...
He's managed to keep the city going all these years, even with his lack of vision.
translation: Vizyon eksikligine ragmen, tüm bu yillar boyunca sehri ayakta tutmayi basardi.

english: Thank you for bringing me this news [player name]. I'll need to make some time to see the city with my own eyes.
translation: Bu haberi bana getirdigin icin tesekkürler Maceraci. Sehri kendi gözlerimle görmek icin biraz zaman ayirmam gerekecek.

english: What do you make of this, Thurgo?
Thurgo quickly reads the book.
Hmph, who wrote this text? It seems new.
translation: Hmph, bu metni kim yazmis? Yeni yazilmis gibi görünüyor.

english: I-
Nevermind! If you ever plan on going back to this island, I'll happily come along.
translation: Bos ver! Bu adaya geri dönmeyi planliyorsan, seve seve seninle gelirim.

english: Oh... Umm... Err...
So you believe it could possibly lead to the ancient ruins of your race?
translation: Yani bunun, irkinin antik kalintilarina götürebilecegine inaniyorsun?

english: I'll believe it when I see it... Now begone, I've got things to do.
translation: Gördügümde inanirim... Simdi git, yapacak islerim var.

english: Alright, Thurgo. I'll see you later.
The Wise Old Man says he's got the information you wanted. Here's his message.
translation: Bilge Yasli Adam, istedigin bilgiyi buldugunu söylüyor. Iste mesaji.

english: Ooh, thanks. I've been hoping he'd send me that information soon, although I wouldn't mind if he'd send me a pie instead!
translation: Ooh, tesekkürler. Bu bilgiyi yakinda gönderecegini umuyordum, ama yerine bir pasta gönderse de olurdu!

english: I'd give you a reward, but you don't seem to have any space for it. Come back when you do.
translation: Sana ödül vermek isterdim ama bunun icin yerin yok gibi görünüyor. Yer acildiginda tekrar gel.

english: Some guy died down in the hole just north of my house, and he dropped these herbs. Here, take them.
translation: Evimin kuzeyindeki cukurda bir adam öldü ve bu otlari düsürdü. Al, bunlari al.

english: Here's some cash for your time.
I found this while I was mining. Hope you like it.
translation: Madencilik yaparken bunu buldum. Umarim begenirsin.

english: Magic isn't really my thing. Here, take these.
translation: Büyü pek bana göre degil. Al, bunlari al.

english: Can you make me another of Sir Vyvin's swords?
translation: Bana Sir Vyvin'in kiliclarindan bir tane daha yapabilir misin?

english: Would you like a redberry pie?
What is that cape you're wearing?
Can we talk about skillcapes?
Sorry, that's too much money.
Of course I'll pay you.
I've met another Imcando dwarf.
translation: Baska bir Imcando cücesi ile tanistim.

english: Emerald
Looking to protect that nice brain of yours? Then you'll be wanting one of my helmets.
translation: O güzel beynini korumak mi istiyorsun? O zaman benim kasklarimdan bir tane isteyeceksin.

english: [Fremennik name]! Looking to protect that nice brain of yours? Then you'll be wanting one of my helmets.
translation: Dokrak! O güzel beynini korumak mi istiyorsun? O zaman benim migferlerimden birini isteyeceksin.

english: I'll have a look.
Good choice.
I'm good.
If you're sure.
I'll have a look.
I'm good.
Greetings stranger. If you wish to browse my wares, you will need to be more favoured by the people of Arceuus.
translation: Selam yabanci. Mallarimi incelemek istiyorsan, Arceuus halkinin daha fazla ilgisini cekmelisin.

english: What do you require, traveller? I deal in runes.
translation: Neye ihtiyacin var, yolcu? Ben runelerle ugrasirim.

english: Let's see what you've got.
translation: Ne var ne yok bir bakalim.

english: I don't need anything.
Let's see what you've got.
translation: Ne var ne yok bir bakalim.

english: I don't need anything.
Hello, Tiadeche.
Hello, Bwana! Would you like to buy some Karambwan?
translation: Merhaba, Bwana! Karambwan almak ister misin?

english: Yes.
No.
Very well. Let me know if you change your mind.
translation: Peki. Fikrini degistirirsen bana haber ver.

english: Yes.
No.
Can I buy a ticket?
There's no need. Under our agreement with the Dorgeshuun, you get free train travel in return for services rendered.
translation: Gerek yok. Dorgeshuun ile yaptigimiz anlasma geregi, verdigin hizmetlerin karsiliginda trenle ücretsiz seyahat edebilirsin.

english: Can I buy a ticket?
You don't need to buy a ticket! You're [player name]! Without you, this train wouldn't exist!
translation: Bilet almana gerek yok! Sen Maceraci'sin! Sen olmasaydin bu tren olmazdi!

english: Just board the train and wait for it to travel to Keldagrim.
translation: Trene bin ve Keldagrim'e varana kadar bekle.

english: Hi. What are you doing out here?
Oh, just looking out at the tide...
What tide?
It's great, isn't it?
Hello. Do you wish me to exchange banknotes for you? I charge only 5 coins for each banknote.
translation: Merhaba. Banknotlarini bozdurmak ister misin? Her banknot icin sadece 5 sikke aliyorum.

english: Yes please.
Hand me the banknotes you wish me to exchange.
Who are you?
I am Tiles. I can exchange banknotes for real items. Do you want any banknotes converted?
translation: Ben Tiles. Banknotlari gercek esyalarla degistirebilirim. Banknotlarini degistirmek ister misin?

english: No thanks.
Yes please.
Who are you?
No thanks.
You poke 10 flashing pillars, right? You NOT poke other pillars, right? Okay, you go play now.
translation: 10 tane yanip sönen sütunu dürtüyorsun, degil mi? Diger sütunlari dürtmüyor, degil mi? Tamam, simdi oyna.

english: Err...what am I supposed to do here again?
You gotta poke dem pillars.
What? All of them?
No, no. If you poke dem ones dat don't have a dem flashin' rings, den dats bad.
translation: Hayir, hayir. Yanip sönmeyen halkalari olanlari dokunursan, bu kötü olur.

english: So I have to poke the pillars that are flashing?
translation: Yani yanip sönen sütunlari mi dokunmam gerekiyor?

english: Yer. You do dat ten times, you get prize.
translation: Evet. Bunu on kez yaparsan, ödül alirsin.

english: So...I'm free to go now, right?
Yer, get going. We get break now.
translation: Evet, git hadi. Biz simdi mola veriyoruz.

english: Ok. Err...have a nice break.
Hey, how's it go...
Apples, trout. Maybe some spi... Oh sorry matey, busy getting the grub together for our next voyage. If ye need anything, talk t' Captain Pudi over by the dock.
translation: Elma, alabalik. Belki biraz spi... Üzgünüm dostum, bir sonraki yolculugumuz icin yiyecekleri topluyorum. Bir seye ihtiyacin olursa, rihtimdaki Kaptan Pudi ile konus.

english: I wonder what jelly would be like with cooked eels? Maybe a pie of some sor... Oh hey there stranger. What can I do for ye?
translation: Jöle, pismis yilan baligi ile nasil olur acaba? Belki bir tür turta... Hey, merhaba yabanci. Senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: Crab meat would do wonders in an admir... Oh hey there stranger. What can I do for ye?
translation: Yengec eti, bir admir... Merhaba yabanci. Senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: Maybe some pineapple. That could enhance the flavour of a summer pi... Oh hey there stranger. What can I do for ye?
translation: Belki biraz ananas. Bu, yaz turtalarinin lezzetini artirabilir... Merhaba yabanci. Senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: How was your last fishing trip?
'Twas a good and bad trip.
During the trip, I was cookin' up a nice fish pie for the crew. But then a storm 'it the ship.
translation: Gezi sirasinda mürettebat icin güzel bir balik turtasi pisiriyordum. Ama sonra gemiye firtina vurdu.

english: Water came a spewin' through the windows and with the water came some glowing fish. It flew straight into me cooking pie.
translation: Pencerelerden su fiskirdi ve suyla birlikte parlayan baliklar da geldi. Dogruca pisirdigim turtaya uctu.

english: I couldn't 'elp it, I 'ad to try it... The taste was amazin'! Never 'ad anythin' like it in me life before.
translation: Dayanamadim, denemek zorundaydim... Tadi muhtesemdi! Hayatimda hic böyle bir sey tatmamistim.

english: Maybe one day I will make that amazing pie again.
translation: Belki bir gün o muhtesem turtayi tekrar yaparim.

english: That sounds great. If you ever do make it again, tell me the recipe so I can make it myself please.
translation: Kulaga harika geliyor. Eger tekrar yaparsan, lütfen tarifini bana da söyle de ben de yapayim.

english: Me recipes are a secret and I am not sharin' 'em with anyone!
On with me story. after trying that amazing pie, the floor boards above fell down and the ship's wheel knocked me out.
translation: Hikayeme devam edeyim. O muhtesem turtayi denedikten sonra, üstteki döseme tahtalari düstü ve geminin dümeni beni bayiltti.

english: I woke up in Al Kharid with the others. Pudi and some local fisherfolk helped us out and now we're 'ere. Lots o' mouths t' feed now!
translation: Digerleriyle birlikte Al Kharid'de uyandim. Pudi ve bazi yerel balikcilar bize yardim etti ve simdi buradayiz. Artik besleyecek cok fazla agiz var!

english: Anythin' else ya be needin'?
translation: Baska bir seye ihtiyacin var mi?

english: You really like cooking. Can you share any recipes with me?
translation: Yemek yapmayi gercekten seviyorsun. Tariflerini benimle paylasabilir misin?

english: Unfortunately for ye, me recipes are a secret and I am not sharin' 'em with anyone!
translation: Maalesef tariflerim gizlidir ve kimseyle paylasmam!

english: Aw, please tell me! I've always wanted to try sailor food.
translation: Lütfen söyle! Her zaman denizci yemegi denemek istemisimdir.

english: Ye best become a sailor then.
translation: O zaman denizci olsan iyi olur.

english: Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?
translation: Tempoross ile savasmak icin herhangi bir ipucun var mi?

english: Ye should bring a harpoon t' fish for them harpoonfish. They be very effective against the beast.
translation: Onlari avlamak icin zipkin getirmelisin. Bu canavarlara karsi cok etkilidirler.

english: Ye could try cooking them too. Helps 'em shoot true.
translation: Onlari pisirmeyi de deneyebilirsin. Daha isabetli atis yapmalarina yardimci olur.

english: I have to go.
See ya around!
Would you care for an egg in this difficult time?
translation: Bu zor zamanda bir yumurta ister misin?

english: A damp egg! What a tragedy!
What?
A fate most foul has befallen our eggy friend 'ere!
translation: Yumurtali dostumuzun basina cok kötü bir talih geldi!

english: Wait a min-
This egg, once so full o' promise, set out on an adventure t' become somethin' more...
translation: Bir zamanlar umut dolu olan bu yumurta, daha fazlasi olmak icin bir maceraya atildi...

english: ...alas, it fell victim t' the briny depths thanks t' Tempoross. That fiend!
translation: ... ne yazik ki, Tempoross sayesinde tuzlu derinliklerin kurbani oldu. O seytan!

english: Perhaps a cake, this egg dreamt t' be? We shall never know, for a damp egg is only good as a solemn reminder of the things we've lost.
translation: Belki de bu yumurta bir pasta olmayi hayal ediyordu? Asla bilemeyecegiz, cünkü nemli bir yumurta sadece kaybettigimiz seyleri hatirlatmak icin iyidir.

english: Wow. You really like eggs, don't you?
translation: Vay canina. Yumurtalari gercekten seviyorsun, degil mi?

english: Aye, they truly are the most majestic an' versatile item in the culinary world. An inspiration t' us all!
translation: Evet, onlar gercekten mutfak dünyasinin en görkemli ve cok yönlü ögesidir. Hepimiz icin bir ilham kaynagi!

english: Timallus sniffles.
There there, it'll be okay.
translation: Sakin ol, her sey yoluna girecek.

english: Thank ye, friend.
Oh a gloriously dry egg! What a gift!
translation: Oh, ne muhtesem bir kuru yumurta! Ne güzel bir hediye!

english: Thank ye!
You're welcome!
Would you like a salmon?
Wha' am I supposed t' do wit' a raw salmon?
Cook and eat it, of course.
Do I look like some sort o' on demand chef t' ye.
translation: Sana siparis üzerine yemek yapan bir sef gibi mi görünüyorum?

english: Fine, I'll take my salmon elsewhere then.
translation: Peki, somonumu baska bir yere götürecegim o zaman.

english: Would you like a freshly cooked salmon?
Aye, I be very hungry today. Skipped breakfast.
translation: Evet, bugün cok acim. Kahvaltiyi atladim.

english: Thanks a lot, landlubber. I appreciate it.
What do you make of this egg?
AAAHH!!
What is it?
That egg!
'Tis horrifyin'!
Just looks like an egg to me...
Cautiously, Timallus peers more closely at the egg before recoiling suddenly.
translation: Timallus dikkatlice yumurtaya daha yakindan bakar ve aniden geri cekilir.

english: Shiver me timbers!
That there egg that ye unfortunately possess 'as a spooky soul.
translation: O yumurtanin icinde korkunc bir ruh var.

english: Surely an egg doesn't have a soul-
An omen, perhaps? Is our fight against Tempoross about t' take a turn for the worse?
translation: Belki de bir kehanettir? Tempoross'la olan savasimiz kötüye mi gidiyor?

english: Perhaps it's even bigger than that...
Look, I was just given this egg as a trick while Trick- or-Treating. It's just a joke!
translation: Bak, bu yumurtayi Trick-or-Treating yaparken saka olarak verdiler. Sadece bir saka!

english: A cruel trick is what it be! I wouldn't trust whoever gave yetthat... thing!
translation: Bu acimasiz bir saka! O seyi veren kisiye güvenmezdim!

english: There be shady dealings goin' on there, me friend, mark me words!
translation: Orada süpheli isler dönüyor, dostum, sözlerime kulak ver!

english: If you say so...
How was your last fishing trip?
You really like cooking. Can you share any recipes with me?
translation: Yemek yapmayi gercekten seviyorsun. Bana tariflerini paylasir misin?

english: Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?
translation: Tempoross ile savasmak icin herhangi bir ipucun var mi?

english: I have to go.
Good Day, how can I help you?
I was just wondering what you were up to.
I work for Aluft Aloft Gnome Food Delivery Service. It's a growing business you know. We get more customers every day!
translation: Aluft Aloft Gnome Food Delivery Service icin calisiyorum. Büyüyen bir is, biliyorsun. Her gün daha fazla müsteri kazaniyoruz!

english: So do you have any spare jobs then?
Aluft Gianne jnr. is in charge - he'll be able to help you.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr. sorumlu - o sana yardimci olabilir.

english: Thanks.
Have a nice day.
Heya! What can I get you?
What ales are you serving?
Well, we've got Asgarnian Ale, Wizard's Mind Bomb and Dwarven Stout, all for only 3 coins.
translation: Asgarnian Ale, Wizard's Mind Bomb ve Dwarven Stout var, hepsi sadece 3 sikke.

english: One Asgarnian Ale, please.
I said 3 coins! You haven't got 3 coins!
Sorry, I'll come back another day.
Thanks, Tina.
I'll try the Mind Bomb.
Can I have a Dwarven Stout?
I don't feel like any of those.
I've got this beer glass...
We'll buy it for a couple of coins if you're interested.
translation: Istersen birkac coin karsiliginda satin aliriz.

english: Okay, sure.
There you go.
Thanks!
No thanks, I like empty beer glasses.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, bos bira bardaklarini seviyorum.

english: I've got these beer glasses...
Ooh, we'll buy those off you if you're interested. 2 coins per glass.
translation: Ooh, ilgilenirseniz bunlari sizden satin aliriz. Bardak basina 2 sikke.

english: Thanks!
Party! Party!
Something's happening in the party room!
Everyone get to the party room!
What's happening in the party room?
Someone's having a big party!
Get to the party room NOW!
Get to the party room!
Get to the party room quick!
Big value items in the party room now!
translation: Parti odasinda cok degerli esyalar var!

english: Quick! Get to the party room!
One Asgarnian Ale, please.
I'll try the Mind Bomb.
Can I have a Dwarven Stout?
I don't feel like any of those.
What ales are you serving?
I've got this beer glass...
Okay, sure.
No thanks, I like empty beer glasses.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, bos bira bardaklarini seviyorum.

english: I've got these beer glasses...
Creeespy frogs' legs! Get your creeeespy frogs' legs! You want some crispy frogs' legs? Just 10gp.
translation: Creeespy kurbaga bacaklari! Creeeespy kurbaga bacaklarini alin! Citir citir kurbaga bacaklari ister misiniz? Sadece 10 altin.

english: Yes please!
But I don't have enough money on me.
Looks like your hands are full. You'll have to free up some inventory space before I sell you anything.
translation: Ellerin dolu görünüyor. Sana bir sey satmadan önce envanterinde yer acman gerekecek.

english: There you go.
No thanks.
Crispy!
Creeeespy frogs' legs!
Get your crispy frogs' legs!
Frogs' legs!
Crispy frogs' legs!
Yes please.
No thanks.
Hello there! Welcome to my special antiques boutique.
translation: Merhaba! Özel antika butigime hos geldiniz.

english: What do you do here?

I'm a specialist at identifying rare and antique weapons, specifically swords, but I plan to branch out. If you have any old and rusty weapons that you want me to check out, just show them to me, pay me 100 Gold and
translation: Nadir ve antika silahlari, özellikle kiliclari tanimlama konusunda uzmanim, ama is alanimi genisletmeyi planliyorum. Eger kontrol etmemi istediginiz eski ve pasli silahlariniz varsa, bana gösterin, 100 altin ödeyin ve

english: I'll see if you have an antique on your hands.
translation: elinizde antika bir silah olup olmadigini kontrol edeyim.

english: I can also repair some antique weapons and armours, just show me the item and I'll let you know if I can repair it and for how much.
translation: Bazi antika silah ve zirhlari da tamir edebilirim, bana esyayi gösterin, tamir edip edemeyecegimi ve ne kadar tutacagini size söyleyeyim.

english: What's involved?

Well, pay me 100 Gold and I'll see if any rusty swords that you've found are actually worth anything. Some of them might be worth some money! If it's an antique item though, I reserve the right to purchase it
translation: Bana 100 altin ödeyin, buldugunuz pasli kiliclarin gercekten bir degeri olup olmadigini kontrol edeyim. Bazilari para edebilir! Ancak antika bir esya ise, kendi kisisel koleksiyonuma eklemek icin

english: immediately for adding to my own personal collection. I'll give you fair price for it.
translation: hemen satin alma hakkini sakli tutarim. Size adil bir fiyat veririm.

english: What do I get from this?

If I can reclaim the sword with my own specialist skills, I'll return it to you in peak condition. If it's an antique, I'll just give you what I think it's worth and I generally pay quite well. However, if it's just a piece of junk, I'll
translation: Kendi uzmanlik becerilerimle kilici onarabilirsem, sana en iyi durumda geri verecegim. Antika bir esya ise, sana degerini düsündügüm kadarini ödeyecegim ve genellikle oldukca iyi bir fiyat veririm. Ancak, sadece cöp ise,

english: simply give you the bad news and get rid of the item for you.
translation: sana kötü haberi verip esyayi senin icin imha edecegim.

english: Ok, I'll give it a go!
Sorry my friend, but you don't seem to have any swords that need to be identified.
translation: Üzgünüm dostum, ama tanimlanmasi gereken bir kilicin yok gibi görünüyor.

english: Sorry my friend, but you don't seem to have enough money to cover my fee!
translation: Üzgünüm dostum, ama ücretimi karsilayacak kadar paran yok gibi görünüyor!

english: Which would you like to identify?
Ok, thanks.
There you go my friend, it turned out to be a bronze sword.
translation: Iste dostum, bronz bir kilic cikti.

english: There you go my friend, it turned out to be a bronze long sword.
translation: Iste dostum, bronz bir uzun kilic cikti.

english: There you go my friend, it turned out to be an iron sword.
translation: Iste dostum, demir bir kilic cikti.

english: There you go my friend, it turned out to be a long sword.
translation: Iste dostum, uzun bir kilic cikti.

english: There you go my friend, it turned out to be a steel sword.
translation: Iste dostum, celik bir kilic cikti.

english: There you go my friend, it turned out to be a steel long sword.
translation: Iste dostum, celik bir uzun kilic cikti.

english: There you go my friend, it turned out to be a black sword.
translation: Iste dostum, siyah bir kilic cikti.

english: There you go my friend, it turned out to be a black longsword.
translation: Iste dostum, siyah bir uzun kilic cikti.

english: There you go my friend, it turned out to be a mithril sword.
There you go my friend, it turned out to be a mithril long sword.
translation: Iste dostum, mithril uzun kilic cikti.

english: Sorry my friend, but the item wasn't worth anything. I've disposed of it for you.
translation: Üzgünüm dostum, ama bu esya hicbir degeri yoktu. Senin icin attim.

english: Wow! The item you gave me was a very rare antique...no real use...but hey, it's worth some money!
translation: Vay canina! Bana verdigin esya cok nadir bir antika... gercek bir kullanimi yok... ama hey, biraz para ediyor!

english: That's a fair price for the item! I'll add it to my collection!
translation: Bu esya icin adil bir fiyat! Koleksiyonuma ekleyecegim!

english: There you go my friend, it turned out to be a bronze scimitar.
translation: Al bakalim dostum, bronz bir kilic cikti.

english: There you go my friend, it turned out to be an iron scimitar.
translation: Al bakalim dostum, demir bir kilic cikti.

english: There you go my friend, it turned out to be a steel scimitar.
translation: Al bakalim dostum, celik bir kilic cikti.

english: There you go my friend, it turned out to be a black scimitar.
translation: Al bakalim dostum, siyah bir kilic cikti.

english: There you go my friend, it turned out to be a mithril scimitar.
Wizard Cromperty sent me to get some iron oxide. Do you have some?
translation: Büyücü Cromperty beni demir oksit almaya gönderdi. Var mi sende?

english: As a matter of fact, I do! However, it's the last in stock and I'm not likely to get more for a while so it's highly prized amongst the wizards at the moment.
translation: Aslinda var! Ancak, stokta sonuncusu ve bir süre daha alamayacagim icin su anda büyücüler arasinda cok degerli.

english: It's not easy to get so much rust together, even if I do come across it more often than most people with cleaning these rusty swords up!
translation: Bu kadar cok pasi bir araya getirmek kolay degil, pasli kiliclari temizlerken cogu insandan daha sik rastlasam da!

english: Rust? What do you mean? How much does it cost?
translation: Pas mi? Ne demek istiyorsun? Fiyati ne kadar?

english: Yes, iron oxide is more commonly referred to as rust. As for a price, hmmm...well...let me think now...I could give it to you for the price of...
translation: Evet, demir oksit daha cok pas olarak bilinir. Fiyatina gelince, hmmm... sey... bir düsüneyim... sana su fiyata verebilirim...

english: One small favour!
Groan!!!

I need a nice mattress to sleep on! I haven't had a decent night's sleep in an ice-age...could you take this stodgy mattress down to Rantz in the ogre area and ask him to fill it with prime chompy bird feathers please?
translation: Uyumak icin güzel bir yataga ihtiyacim var! Buzul cagindan beri düzgün bir gece uykusu uyumadim... Bu agir yatagi ogre bölgesindeki Rantz'a götürüp, onu birinci sinif cigneme kusu tüyleriyle doldurmasini rica eder misin lütfen?

english: So, let me get this straight.
