translation: Tamam, daha önce onlari yenmek cok zor olmamisti.

english: You might find it harder now! At least one is bound to cause you some sort of threat. Be careful! There isn't much in the way of items or treasure down there, it's purely for practicing your combat!
translation: Simdi daha zor gelebilir! En az biri sana bir tür tehdit olusturacaktir. Dikkatli ol! Orada cok fazla esya veya hazine yok, sadece savas pratigi yapmak icin!

english: Thanks.
Hello.
Greetings. What can I do for you?
What are you doing here?
I'm conducting important business here for the Kourend Council.
translation: Kourend Konseyi icin önemli bir is yapiyorum.

english: Is there anything I can help you with?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: There is something I could use some help with. I'm here on behalf of the Kourend Council to investigate some unusual happenings in Port Piscarilius.
translation: Yardimci olabilecegin bir sey var. Kourend Konseyi adina Port Piscarilius'ta meydana gelen olagandisi olaylari arastirmak icin buradayim.

english: What are you investigating?
Port Piscarilius is home to various gangs. They're a nuisance, but up until now we haven't had much trouble in dealing with them.
translation: Port Piscarilius cesitli cetelerin yuvasidir. Can sikicidirlar, ama simdiye kadar onlarla basa cikmakta fazla sorun yasamadik.

english: So what's the problem?
A new gang calling themselves the Saviours of Kourend has recently formed. That's not surprising as gangs come and go all of the time, but this one is different.
translation: Kendilerine Kourend'in Kurtaricilari adini veren yeni bir cete kuruldu. Ceteler sürekli gelip gittigi icin bu sasirtici degil, ama bu cete farkli.

english: How so?
The Saviours of Kourend have been absorbing many of the other gangs. Within a few weeks they've already become the largest gang in Kourend and more join them each day.
translation: Kourend'in Kurtaricilari diger cetelerin cogunu bünyesine katiyor. Birkac hafta icinde Kourend'in en büyük cetesi haline geldiler ve her gün yeni üyeler katiliyor.

english: The talk amongst the people is that it's all down to their leader, a mysterious figure known only as the Queen of Thieves.
translation: Halk arasinda bunun nedeninin liderleri oldugu konusuluyor, sadece Hirsizlarin Kralicesi olarak bilinen gizemli bir figür.

english: Nice name. Why doesn't the ruler of Port Piscarilius do something about this?
translation: Güzel isim. Port Piscarilius'un hükümdari neden bu konuda bir sey yapmiyor?

english: Shauna Piscarilius is the ruler of Port Piscarilius, but she spends most of her time galavanting around in that boat of hers rather than looking after her home.
translation: Shauna Piscarilius, Port Piscarilius'un hükümdaridir, ama zamaninin cogunu evine bakmak yerine kendi teknesinde gezerek gecirir.

english: Fair enough. So what do you need me for?
Well my original plan was to infiltrate the gang to get close to the Queen and capture her. However, I've been unable to make any progress. Apparently, I don't look the part.
translation: Asil planim ceteye sizip Kralice'ye yaklasmak ve onu yakalamakti. Ancak, hicbir ilerleme kaydedemedim. Görünüse göre, bu role uygun görünmüyorum.

english: Yeah not sure what that's all about. You clearly fit right in here.
translation: Evet, bunun ne anlama geldigini bilmiyorum. Buraya cok uygun görünüyorsun.

english: Quite right. They're quite insistent though, so someone else will need to give it a go. You look like you might be just the type they're after.
translation: Haklisin. Ancak oldukca israrcilar, bu yüzden baska biri denemeli. Sen tam da aradiklari tip gibi görünüyorsun.

english: What are you trying to say?
That you look poor.
Oh...
Anyway if you're up for the task you'll need to infiltrate the Saviours of Kourend, find the Queen of Thieves, apprehend her and then bring her to me.
translation: Her neyse, bu görevi üstlenmek istiyorsan, Kourend'in Kurtaricilari'na sizip Hirsizlarin Kralicesi'ni bulman, onu yakalayip bana getirmen gerekecek.

english: So are you up for it?
Absolutely.
Excellent. The Saviours of Kourend must have their headquarters somewhere nearby. You should ask around town and see if anyone knows where they are. Good luck.
translation: Harika. Kourend'in Kurtaricilari'nin karargahi buralarda bir yerde olmali. Kasabada etrafa sorup, kimse onlarin yerini biliyor mu diye bakmalisin. Iyi sanslar.

english: Nah.
Fair enough. I'll be here if you change your mind.
What's the Kourend Council?
Although it's called a kingdom, Great Kourend hasn't actually had a king for many years. These days Kourend is a republic and it is ruled by the Kourend Council.
translation: Krallik olarak adlandirilsa da, Büyük Kourend'in aslinda yillardir bir krali yok. Günümüzde Kourend bir cumhuriyet ve Kourend Konseyi tarafindan yönetiliyor.

english: The Council consists of four councillors who are elected by the people every four years. The current councillors are Councillor Hughes, Councillor Unkar, Councillor Orson and Councillor Andrews.
translation: Konsey, her dört yilda bir halk tarafindan secilen dört konsey üyesinden olusuyor. Su anki konsey üyeleri Konsey Üyesi Hughes, Konsey Üyesi Unkar, Konsey Üyesi Orson ve Konsey Üyesi Andrews'dur.

english: I see. So what are you investigating?
I'm looking for a quest.
Well there is something I could use some help with. However, you're not really the person I need for this task.
translation: Aslinda yardima ihtiyacim olan bir sey var. Ancak, bu görev icin ihtiyacim olan kisi sen degilsin.

english: Well there is something I could use some help with. I'm here on behalf of the Kourend Council to investigate some unusual happenings in Port Piscarilius.
translation: Aslinda yardima ihtiyacim olan bir sey var. Kourend Konseyi adina Port Piscarilius'ta meydana gelen bazi olagandisi olaylari arastirmak icin buradayim.

english: Well good luck with that.
Nothing thanks.
Very well. Until next time.
Let's talk about my quest.
Very well. How goes things?
I haven't had any luck finding the Queen of Thieves. However, I've come across this letter which you might find interesting.
translation: Hirsizlarin Kralicesi'ni bulamadim. Ancak, ilginizi cekebilecek bir mektup buldum.

english: Blimey! Forget the Queen of Thieves. If this letter is to be believed, Councillor Hughes is working with those vile Disciples of Yama. I must report this to the council immediately.
translation: Vay canina! Hirsizlarin Kralicesi'ni unut. Bu mektuba inanacak olursak, Konsey Üyesi Hughes o asagilik Yama'nin Müritleri ile isbirligi yapiyor. Bunu derhal konseye bildirmeliyim.

english: Great! So can I have a reward?
You've done a great service to the people of Kourend. As I'm sure you know, there is no greater reward than the satisfaction of a job well done.
translation: Kourend halkina büyük bir hizmet ettin. Bildigin gibi, iyi yapilan bir isin verdigi tatmin duygusundan daha büyük bir ödül yoktur.

english: Now be on your way. I have a lot of work to do.
translation: Simdi yoluna devam et. Yapacak cok isim var.

english: What do you know of the Disciples of Yama?
They're a group of deranged cultists that worship some sort of demon. They're not a big threat compared to the lizardmen, but they're still an enemy to Kourend.
translation: Bir tür iblisi tapan cilgin bir tarikat grubu. Kertenkele adamlara kiyasla büyük bir tehdit olusturmuyorlar, ama yine de Kourend'in düsmanlari.

english: And Councillor Hughes is helping them? That's not good.
translation: Ve Meclis Üyesi Hughes onlara yardim mi ediyor? Bu hic iyi degil.

english: Indeed. I must report this to the Council immediately.
So can I have a reward?
Hello Tomas. How's things?
Very well thank you. My work in bringing down Councillor Hughes means that I'm finally starting to get the recognition that I deserve.
translation: Cok iyi, tesekkürler. Konsey üyesi Hughes'u devirme isim sayesinde nihayet hak ettigim takdiri görmeye basladim.

english: But that was my work!
Yes, yes, very good job. I'll make sure to mention you in my acceptance speech when I'm voted in as her replacement.
translation: Evet, evet, cok iyi is cikardin. Onun yerine secildigimde kabul konusmamda senden bahsedecegim.

english: Hello Tomas.
Oh... Hello there.
Something wrong?
I'm ruined. Everything was perfect under the Council, but now I'm right back in the dirt again.
translation: Mahvoldum. Konsey döneminde her sey mükemmeldi, ama simdi yine sefalete döndüm.

english: You were very close to the Council. You should be glad you got to keep your job at all.
translation: Konseye cok yakindin. Isini kaybetmedigin icin mutlu olmalisin.

english: But I didn't keep my job. Now I spend every day doing boring administrative work. It's a nightmare.
translation: Ama isimi kaybetmedim. Simdi her gün sikici idari islerle ugrasiyorum. Bu bir kabus.

english: Come now Tomas, it can't be all bad. Show a little enthusiasm.
translation: Hadi ama Tomas, her sey o kadar da kötü olamaz. Biraz heyecan göster.

english: Eugh.
What are you doing here?
Anything I can help with?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Absolutely.
Nah.
What's the Kourend Council?
I'm looking for a quest.
What are you investigating?
Well good luck with that.
Nothing thanks.
Let's talk about my quest.
Great! So can I have a reward?
What do you know of the Disciples of Yama?
Say, aren't you a bit tall for a dwarf?
translation: Sen bir cüce icin biraz uzun degil misin?

english: Was there anything in particular you wanted?
translation: Özellikle istedigin bir sey var mi?

english: I'd like a quest please.
I have nothing to do for you, I'm afraid. Ask around town, though, there are always people who need some work done around here.
translation: Korkarim sana verecek bir isim yok. Ama kasabada bir sapa bak, burada her zaman is arayan insanlar vardir.

english: No, I just like talking to strangers.
Well I don't.
I'd like a quest please.
No, I just like talking to strangers.
Hello.
So how's life as a pirate?
What kind of question is that? How's life as a... I dunno. Whatever it is that you do for a living.
translation: Bu ne bicim bir soru? Nasil gidiyor... Bilmiyorum. Ne is yapiyorsan o.

english: I'm a freelance troubleshooter.
What does that entail then?
Mostly killing things for money and delivering items around the planet for people.
translation: Cogunlukla para karsiliginda bir seyler öldürmek ve insanlara gezegenin dört bir yanina esya teslim etmek.

english: I collect stuff.
So how's that life?
Can't complain, can't complain...
Well, there you go.
Aren't you a little short for a pirate?
translation: Korsan icin biraz kisa degil misin?

english: My mother was a gnome. Apparently it was a very painful birth.
translation: Annem bir cüceydi. Anlasilan cok aci verici bir dogum olmus.

english: More info than I wanted, thanks!
Sorry, can't stop, the Captain will have my guts for garters if he catches me slacking off talking to the stowaway.
translation: Üzgünüm, duramam, kaptan beni kacak yolcuyla konusurken yakalarsa bagirsaklarimi cikarir.

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard!
translation: Ben kacak yolcu degilim! Gemiye davet edildim!

english: Yeah, whatever [guy/lady], it doesn't really matter who you are I'll get in trouble!
translation: Evet, neyse , kim oldugun önemli degil, basim belaya girecek!

english: You know, I've always wondered what life as a pirate actually entails.
translation: Biliyor musun, korsan olmanin hayati nasil bir sey oldugunu hep merak etmisimdir.

english: Well, at the moment it mostly involves being asked random questions by a stowaway.
translation: Su anda cogunlukla kacak yolcunun rastgele sordugu sorularla geciyor.

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard! By Lokar! Ask him!
translation: Ben kacak yolcu degilim! Gemiye davet edildim! Lokar tarafindan! Ona sor!

english: Hey, whatever [love/pal]. Just make sure the captain doesn't catch you, pirates don't like stowaways much.
translation: Hey, neyse . Kaptan seni yakalamasin, korsanlar kacak yolculari pek sevmezler.

english: Ah, good day to you [milady/sirrah]! Your face is unfamiliar, did you perhaps join us aboard the ship at Lunar Isle?
translation: Ah, iyi günler ! Yüzünüz tanidik gelmiyor, Lunar Isle'da gemiye mi bindiniz?

english: No, Lokar offered me a lift in Rellekka actually.
translation: Hayir, Lokar aslinda Rellekka'da beni gemiye davet etti.

english: Oh, really? You don't look like a Fremennik to me!
translation: Oh, gercekten mi? Bana Fremennik gibi gelmedin!

english: Well... I kind of am, and I kind of aren't. It's a long story.
translation: Sey... Bir bakima öyleyim, bir bakima degilim. Uzun hikaye.

english: Sorry I don't have time to hear it then! See you around young fremennik-who-is-not-really-a-fremennik!
translation: Üzgünüm, dinleyecek vaktim yok! Görüsürüz genc fremennik-ama-aslinda-fremennik-olmayan!

english: 'Bye.
Brrrr! Its cold up here!
You think this is cold? Up by Acheron it gets so cold that when you talk you see the words freeze in the air in front of you!
translation: Sence burasi mi soguk? Acheron'da hava o kadar soguk ki, konustugunda sözcüklerin havada dondugunu görebiliyorsun!

english: REALLY?
Nah, not really. I was exaggerating for humourous effect. It is very very cold though!
translation: Hayir, aslinda degil. Komik olsun diye abarttim. Ama gercekten cok soguk!

english: Hello to you too.
Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!
translation: Yar! Biz korsaniz, yar! Dur, seni pis kara kurdu!

english: Please don't talk like that, it is extremely irritating.
translation: Lütfen böyle konusma, cok sinir bozucu.

english: Also, please don't call me a lychee, whatever that may be.
translation: Ayrica, lütfen bana lychee deme, o ne demekse.

english: Oh. Okay. Sorry.
ARGH! SOUND THE ALARM! STOWAWAY ON BOARD! STOWAWAY ON BOARD!
translation: ARGH! ALARMI CALIN! GEMIYE KACAK YOLCU BINMIS! GEMIYE KACAK YOLCU BINMIS!

english: No! I'm not a stowaway! Honest! I was invited here!
translation: Hayir! Ben kacak yolcu degilim! Gercekten! Buraya davet edildim!

english: Oh, sorry, my mistake then.
You must admit you do look a lot like a stowaway though.
translation: Ama kacak yolcuya cok benzedigini kabul etmelisin.

english: Why, what do they usually look like?
Erm... I've never actually met one...
Okay then...
Hello.
So... You're a pirate, huh?
It's what it says on my pay-packet at the end of the month.
translation: Ay sonunda maas cekimde öyle yaziyor.

english: How's that working out for you?
Pretty good so far. All the grog and loot that we can plunder, plus full medical including dental.
translation: Su ana kadar oldukca iyi. Yagmalayabildigimiz tüm icki ve ganimetler, ayrica dis tedavisi dahil tam saglik sigortasi.

english: You mean you have insurance?
Not as such. If any of us get sick we kidnap a doctor and don't let him go until we're better.
translation: Öyle sayilmaz. Icimizden biri hastalanirsa bir doktor kaciririz ve iyilesene kadar onu birakmayiz.

english: You'd be surprised what an incentive for expert health care that is.
translation: Bunun uzman saglik hizmeti icin ne kadar tesvik edici oldugunu bilsen sasirirsin.

english: I can imagine.
Hello there. So what brings you aboard the Lady Zay?
translation: Merhaba. Lady Zay'e ne getiriyor seni?

english: Well, I was planning on visiting the Moon Clan, but I have to say your ship is very impressive.
translation: Aslinda Moon Klani'ni ziyaret etmeyi planliyordum, ama geminizin cok etkileyici oldugunu söylemeliyim.

english: Aye, she's a beauty alright! The Lady Zay has been my home for many hard months, through storm and sun, and she always gets us to here we were headed!
translation: Evet, gercekten cok güzel! Lady Zay, firtinalarda ve günesli günlerde, zorlu aylar boyunca benim evim oldu ve bizi her zaman hedefimize ulastirdi!

english: Yes, she's certainly one of the finest boats I've seen on my travels!
translation: Evet, seyahatlerim sirasinda gördügüm en güzel gemilerden biri!

english: That she is [lad/lass], that she is.
Nilsal, traveller. You walk on holy ground. Please ensure you are respectful.
translation: Nilsal, gezgin. Kutsal topraklarda yürüyorsun. Lütfen saygili davran.

english: Nilsal, traveller. You walk on holy ground. Please ensure you are respectful.
translation: Nilsal, gezgin. Kutsal topraklarda yürüyorsun. Lütfen saygili davran.

english: I'm sorry, traveller, but access into the Crypt of Tonali is restricted. You may not enter.
translation: Üzgünüm, gezgin, ama Tonali Mezarligi'na giris yasaktir. Giremezsin.

english: Ah, 'tis a foine day to be sure! Were yez wantin' me to store yer tools, or maybe ye might be wantin' yer stuff back from me?
translation: Ah, bugün gercekten güzel bir gün! Aletlerinizi depolamami mi istiyorsunuz, yoksa esyalarinizi benden geri almak mi istiyorsunuz?

english: Why are you here in Weiss?
An' why would I not be here? Now that there be farming patches, there'll be folk needing a leprechaun to hold their stuff! So, dod ye want to be using the store?
translation: Neden burada olmayayim ki? Artik tarim alanlari olduguna göre, esyalarini saklayacak bir leprikon arayan insanlar olacaktir! Peki, depoyu kullanmak ister misiniz?

english: Can you tell me about the Lost City?
translation: Kayip Sehir hakkinda bana bilgi verebilir misiniz?

english: Nay, ye be wantin' to ask Shamus if ye wants to know about the Lost City. He be living up a tree somewhere near Draynor Village. Last I heard he were wailin' about some biggun tryin' to chop his tree down!
translation: Hayir, Kayip Sehir hakkinda bilgi almak istiyorsan Shamus'a sormalisin. Draynor Köyü yakinlarinda bir agacta yasiyor. Son duydugumda, bir devin agacini kesmeye calistigindan sikayet ediyordu!

english: What can you store?
We'll hold onto yer rake, yer seed dibber, yer spade, yer secateurs, yer waterin' can and yer trowel - but mind it's not one of them fancy trowels only archaeologists use!
translation: Tirmiginizi, tohum ekme aletinizi, küreginizi, budama makasinizi, sulama kabinizi ve küreginizi saklayabiliriz - ama arkeologlarin kullandigi süslü küreklerden olmasin!

english: We'll take a few buckets off yer hands too, and even yer compost, supercompost an' ultracompost! Also plant cure vials.
translation: Birkac kova da alabiliriz, hatta kompostunuzu, süper kompostunuzu ve ultra kompostunuzu da! Ayrica bitki ilaci siselerini de.

english: Aside from that, if ye hands me yer farming produce, I can mebbe change it into banknotes for ye.
translation: Bunun disinda, bana tarim ürünlerinizi verirseniz, onlari sizin icin banknotlara cevirebilirim.

english: So... do ye want to be using the store?
What do you do with the tools you're storing? They can't possibly all fit in your pockets!
translation: Sakladiginiz aletlerle ne yapiyorsunuz? Hepsi cebinize sigmaz ki!

english: We leprechauns have a shed where we keep 'em. It's a magic shed, so ye can get yer items back from any of us leprechauns whenever ye want. Saves ye havin' to carry loads of stuff around the country!
translation: Biz leprikonlarin bunlari sakladigimiz bir kulübemiz var. Bu kulübe sihirli, bu yüzden istediginiz zaman herhangi bir leprikondan esyalarinizi geri alabilirsiniz. Böylece ülke capinda bir sürü esya tasimak zorunda kalmazsiniz!

english: No thanks, I'll keep hold of my stuff.
Ye must be dafter than ye look if ye likes luggin' yer tools everywhere ye goes!
translation: Gittiginiz her yere aletlerinizi tasimayi seviyorsaniz, göründügünüzden daha aptal olmalisiniz!

english: Nay, I've got no banknotes to exchange for that item.
translation: Hayir, o esya icin degistirecek banknotum yok.

english: Nay, there's no such thing as a banknote for that.
translation: Hayir, bunun icin banknot diye bir sey yok.

english: That IS a banknote!
A cabbage? Don't ye go showing me yer cabbage; this whole farm stinks of the things! Take it away and get it exchanged somewhere else.
translation: Lahana mi? Bana lahanani gösterme, bütün ciftlik bu kokudan igrenc kokuyor! Al ve baska bir yerde degistir.

english: Ye did foine, yer'll be wanting this!
Why are you here in Weiss?
Can you tell me about the Lost City?
translation: Kayip Sehir hakkinda bana bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Yes please.
What can you store?
What do you do with the tools you're storing?
No thanks, I'll keep hold of my stuff.
Aye, top o' th' mornin' to ya! Are ye wantin' help with th' tool store?
translation: Evet, günaydin! Alet deposunda yardima ihtiyacin var mi?

english: Why are you sunbathing up a mountain?
We tool leprechauns work hard, that we do. An' nary a penny do we get in return. So ye cannae begrudge me mah holiday an' a wee drink or twelve!
translation: Biz alet cüceleri cok calisiriz. Ve karsiliginda bir kurus bile almayiz. O yüzden tatilimi ve bir iki icki icmemi kiskanma!

english: Yes, very nice, but why are you sunbathing up a mountain? Surely a beach would be more appropriate?
translation: Evet, cok güzel, ama neden dagda günesleniyorsun? Plaj daha uygun olmaz miydi?

english: Ahh, but I likes th' ruggedy mountain, ye see. Also, I ha' a terrible allergy to sand.
translation: Ahh, ama ben engebeli daglari seviyorum. Ayrica kuma karsi cok alerjim var.

english: Fair enough, I suppose.
So were ye wantin' help with th' tool store?
translation: Peki, alet deposunda yardima ihtiyacin var mi?

english: Would you like to trade?
Ach! Can ye no' leave a body to ha' a little peace? Very well, I have a bit o' stuff to trade with ye. But don't be expectin' yerself any discounts.
translation: Ach! Biraz huzur icinde birakamaz misin beni? Pekala, seninle takas edecek birkac seyim var. Ama indirim bekleme.

english: Are you going to move that other deckchair?
An' get ambushed by that damn bird again? Nae, I'll be keeping my distance, thank ye very much!
translation: Ve yine o lanet kusun saldirisina mi ugrayacaksin? Hayir, mesafemi koruyacagim, cok tesekkürler!

english: Plus, if ye've got a farmin' patch up 'ere, th' union boys'll want me posted nearer it.
translation: Ayrica, burada bir ciftlik arazin varsa, sendika üyeleri beni daha yakina yerlestirmek isteyeceklerdir.

english: I'm not one of them farmin' leprechauns! I don't want yer garbage!
translation: Ben ciftci leprikonlardan biri degilim! Senin cöpünü istemiyorum!

english: Why are you sunbathing up a mountain?
Would you like to trade?
Are you going to move that other deckchair?
Aye? What do ye need?
Tell me about this mine.
translation: Bu maden hakkinda bana bilgi ver.

english: 's a sulphur mine. Ye get sulphur here. For making the dynamite, ye know? Folks use it in the blast mine. Watch the poison gas clouds, though - they'll choke ye.
translation: Bu bir kükürt madeni. Burada kükürt cikarilir. Dinamit yapmak icin, biliyor musun? Insanlar bunu patlayici madende kullanir. Ama zehirli gaz bulutlarina dikkat et, seni bogabilirler.

english: Grab yerself a pickaxe if ye wants to mine some sulphur. Make sure ye keeps yer mouth an' nose covered too.
translation: Kükürt cikarmak istiyorsan bir kazma al. Agzini ve burnunu da kapatmayi unutma.

english: What have you got to trade?
Pickaxes. For the mining. An' pots to make dynamite in.
translation: Kazma. Madencilik icin. Ve dinamit yapmak icin tencere.

english: Why are you called Toothy?
'Cos of my teeth.
I'll be off.
Tell me about this mine.
What have you got to trade?
Why are you called Toothy?
I'll be off.
You dare disturb my rest!
You dare steal from us!
YOU ARE A TERRIBLE BARD!
Don't give up your day job outerlander!
I thought somebody was murdering a cat!
You know, I actually quite liked that verse...
That's kind of catchy. Irritating. But catchy.
translation: Kulaga hos geliyor. Sinir bozucu ama hos.

english: Hey, I've done that quest too!
translation: Hey, ben de o görevi yaptim!

english: I have produced better sounds in the outhouse!
Your song makes no sense outerlander!
What kind of bard are you anyway?
translation: Sen ne bicim bir ozan sensin?

english: I have met cows more musical than you!
When do you get to the good parts?

english: Yes, well, no need to ignore me.

translation: Alinma, sevgili dostum. Sadece tarihle cok ilgileniyorum, hepsi bu.

english: Okay. Have you seen the Natural History exhibit in the basement?
translation: Tamam. Bodrumdaki Doga Tarihi sergisini gördün mü?

english: Oh, yes, marvellous isn't it! I particularly like the wyvern, very interesting considering they've never found a live specimen. And to think they could possibly have been flapping around at one time!
translation: Oh, evet, harika degil mi! Özellikle wyvern'i cok begendim, canli bir örnegi hic bulunmamis olmasi cok ilginc. Bir zamanlar etrafta ucuyor olabileceklerini düsünmek bile!

english: A bit like the crazy gnomes and their gliders. Have you seen the model they have upstairs?
translation: Cilgin cüceler ve planörleri gibi. Üst kattaki modeli gördün mü?

english: Yes, very intricate isn't it? Worrying to think some people risk their lives in them! You wouldn't catch me up in one. Had a chat with Jacques while I was up there, the art critic...he's a bit funny in the head.
translation: Evet, cok karmasik, degil mi? Bazi insanlarin hayatlarini tehlikeye attigini düsünmek endise verici! Beni bir tanesine bindiremezsin. Oradayken sanat elestirmeni Jacques ile sohbet ettim... Biraz kafasi karisik biri.

english: I guess so. Wonder what poetry he'll come up with then! Still, I must get on with this display. See you around I hope!

translation: Dinleyin! Dinleyin! Oyuncu Moderatörleri RuneSc'ye büyük yardimda bulunuyorlar...

english: Oh, hello citizen. Are you here to find out about Player Moderators? Or perhaps would you like to know about the laws of the land?
translation: Merhaba vatandas. Oyuncu Moderatörleri hakkinda bilgi almak icin mi buradasin? Yoksa buradaki kanunlar hakkinda bilgi almak mi istiyorsun?

english: Tell me about Player Moderators.
translation: Bana Oyuncu Moderatörleri hakkinda bilgi ver.

english: Of course. What would you like to know?
What is a Player Moderator?

Player Moderators are normal players of the game, just like you. However, since they have shown themselves to be trustworthy and active reporters, they have been invited by Jagex to monitor the game and
translation: Oyuncu Moderatörleri, tipki senin gibi oyunun normal oyuncularidir. Ancak, güvenilir ve aktif raporlayicilar olduklarini kanitladiklari icin, Jagex tarafindan oyunu izlemek ve

english: take appropriate action when they see rule breaking. You can spot a Player Moderator in game by looking at the chat screen - when a Player Moderator speaks, a silver crown appears to the left of their name.
translation: kural ihlali gördüklerinde uygun önlemleri almak üzere davet edildiler. Oyun icinde Oyuncu Moderatörlerini sohbet ekranindan taniyabilirsiniz - Oyuncu Moderatörü konustugunda, adinin solunda gümüs bir tac belirir.

english: Remember, if there's not silver crown there, they are not a Player Moderator!
translation: Unutmayin, gümüs tac yoksa, o kisi Oyuncu Moderatörü degildir!

english: Thanks!
Is there anything else you'd like to know?
translation: Bilmek istediginiz baska bir sey var mi?

english: What can Player Moderators do?

Player Moderators, or 'P-mods', have the ability to mute rule breakers and Jagex view their reports as a priority so that action is taken as quickly as possible. P- Mods also have access to the Player Moderator Centre.
translation: Oyuncu Moderatörleri veya “P-modlar”, kural ihlali yapanlari sessize alma yetkisine sahiptir ve Jagex, raporlarini öncelikli olarak degerlendirir, böylece mümkün olan en kisa sürede önlem alinabilir. P-Modlar ayrica Oyuncu Moderatör Merkezi'ne erisebilir.

english: Within the Centre are tools to help them Moderate Old School RuneScape. These tools include dedicated forums, the Player Moderator Guidelines and the Player Moderator Code of Conduct.
translation: Merkezde, Old School RuneScape'i yönetmelerine yardimci olacak araclar bulunmaktadir. Bu araclar arasinda özel forumlar, Oyuncu Moderatörü Yönergeleri ve Oyuncu Moderatörü Davranis Kurallari bulunur.

english: How do I become a Player Moderator?
Jagex picks players who spend their time and effort to help better the Old School RuneScape community. To increase your chances of becoming a Player Moderator:
translation: Jagex, Old School RuneScape toplulugunu iyilestirmek icin zaman ve caba harcayan oyunculari secer. Oyuncu Moderatörü olma sansinizi artirmak icin:

english: Keep your account secure! This is very important, as a player with poor security will never be a P-Mod. Read our Security Tips for more information.
translation: Hesabinizi güvende tutun! Bu cok önemlidir, cünkü güvenligi zayif olan bir oyuncu asla P-Mod olamaz. Daha fazla bilgi icin Güvenlik Ipuclarimizi okuyun.

english: Play by the rules! The rules of Old School RuneScape are enforced for a reason, to make the game a fair and enjoyable environment for all.
translation: Kurallara uyun! Old School RuneScape kurallari, oyunu herkes icin adil ve keyifli bir ortam haline getirmek icin uygulanmaktadir.

english: Report accurately! When Jagex consider an account for review they look for quality, not quantity. Ensure your reports are of a high quality by following the report guidelines.
translation: Dogru raporlar verin! Jagex bir hesabi incelemeye aldiginda, nicelik degil nitelik arar. Raporlama kurallarina uyarak raporlarinizin yüksek kalitede olmasini saglayin.

english: Be excellent to each other! Treat others as you would want to be treated yourself. Respect your fellow player.
translation: Birbirinize karsi nazik olun! Baskalarina, kendinize davranilmasini istediginiz gibi davranin. Diger oyunculari saygiyla karsilayin.

english: What can Player Moderators not do?

P-Mods cannot ban your account - they can only report offences. Jagex then take action based on the evidence received. If you lose your password or get scammed by another player, P-Mods cannot help you
translation: P-Modlar hesabinizi yasaklayamaz, sadece ihlalleri rapor edebilir. Jagex, aldigi kanitlara göre harekete gecer. Sifrenizi kaybederseniz veya baska bir oyuncu tarafindan dolandirilirsaniz, P-Modlar hesabinizi geri almaniza yardimci olamaz.

english: get your account back. All they can do is recommend you to go to Customer Support. They cannot retrieve any items you may have lost and receive no free items from Jagex for helping moderate the game. They are
translation: Tek yapabilecekleri, Müsteri Destegi'ne basvurmanizi önermektir. Kaybettiginiz ögeleri geri getiremezler ve oyunu denetlemeye yardimci olduklari icin Jagex'ten ücretsiz öge almazlar. Onlar,

english: players who give their efforts to help the community out of the goodness of their hearts! P-mods do not work for Jagex and so cannot make you a Moderator, or recommend other accounts to become moderators. If
translation: iyi niyetleriyle topluluga yardim etmek icin caba gösteren oyunculardir! P-modlar Jagex icin calismadiklari icin sizi Moderatör yapamazlar veya baska hesaplari Moderatör olmalari icin öneremezler.

english: you wish to become a Moderator, please feel free to ask me how!

At once. Take a look at my book here...

english: Did you know most skills have right click 'Make-X' options to help you train faster?
translation: Cogu becerinin, daha hizli antrenman yapmana yardimci olmak icin sag tiklama ile acilan “Make-X” secenekleri oldugunu biliyor muydun?

english: Make your recovery questions and answers hard to guess but easy to remember.
translation: Kurtarma sorularini ve cevaplarini tahmin edilmesi zor ama hatirlanmasi kolay hale getir.

english: Don't use your RuneScape password on other sites. Keep your account safe!
translation: RuneScape sifreni baska sitelerde kullanma. Hesabini güvende tut!

english: If you think someone knows your password - change it!
The squirrels! The squirrels are coming! Noooo, get them out of my head!
translation: Sincaplar! Sincaplar geliyor! Hayir, kafamdan cikarin onlari!

english: Did you know you burn food less often on the range in Lumbridge castle than other ranges?
translation: Lumbridge kalesindeki ocakta diger ocaklara göre daha az yemek yaktiginizi biliyor muydunuz?

english: Players can not trim armour. Don't fall for this popular scam!
translation: Oyuncular zirhlarini kesemezler. Bu popüler dolandiriciliga kanmayin!

english: Feeling harassed? Don't forget your ignore list can be especially useful if a player seems to be picking on you!
translation: Taciz ediliyor musunuz? Bir oyuncu size satasiyorsa, görmezden gelme listenizin özellikle yararli olabilecegini unutmayin!

english: If you're lost and have no idea where to go, use the Home Teleport spell for free!
translation: Kaybolduysaniz ve nereye gideceginizi bilmiyorsaniz, ücretsiz olarak Ev Teleport büyüsünü kullanin!

english: If you see someone breaking the rules, report them!
translation: Kurallari ihlal eden birini görürseniz, onu bildirin!

english: Did you know that at high levels of Runecrafting you get more than one rune per essence?
translation: Yüksek seviye Runecrafting'de her özden birden fazla rune elde edebileceginizi biliyor muydunuz?

english: Never lend your items out unless you expect them not to come back.
translation: Geri gelmeyecegini düsünmüyorsaniz, esyalarinizi asla ödünc vermeyin.

english: Never question a penguin.

translation: Sohbet penceresi bir oyuncuyu dogru bir sekilde bildirmek icin cok hizli hareket ediyorsa, sakin bir yere gidin ve sohbeti rahatca inceleyin!

english: Take time to check the second trade window carefully. Don't be scammed!
translation: Ikinci ticaret penceresini dikkatlice kontrol etmek icin zaman ayirin. Dolandirilmayin!

english: Did you know having a bank pin can help secure your valuable items?

english: Did you know that mithril equipment is very light?
translation: Mithril ekipmanlarinin cok hafif oldugunu biliyor muydunuz?

english: There are no cheats in RuneScape! Never visit websites promising otherwise!
translation: RuneScape'te hile yoktur! Aksini iddia eden web sitelerini asla ziyaret etmeyin!

english: Jagex will never e-mail you. Do not believe any e-mails that claim to be from us.
translation: Jagex size asla e-posta göndermez. Bizden geldigini iddia eden e-postalara inanmayin.

english: If you're stuck on a skill, talk to the Lumbridge Tutors for help and tips.
translation: Bir beceride takildiysaniz, Lumbridge Ögretmenleri ile konusarak yardim ve ipuclari alin.

english: Did you know that you can wear a shield with a crossbow?
Beware of players trying to lure you into the wilderness. Your items cannot be returned if you lose them!
translation: Sizi Wildernessya cekmeye calisan oyunculara dikkat edin. Kaybettiginiz esyalarinizi geri alamazsiniz!

english: If a player isn't sure of the rules, send them to me! I'll be happy to remind them!
translation: Bir oyuncu kurallardan emin degilse, onu bana gönderin! Ona hatirlatmaktan memnuniyet duyarim!

english: Never tell your password to anyone, not even your best friend!
translation: Sifrenizi kimseye söylemeyin, en yakin arkadasiniza bile!

english: Be careful when fighting wizards! Wearing heavy armour can lower your Magic resistance!

english: If you get harassed by a player in game, don't take it personally - the player is reacting to your silver crown, not to you!
translation: Oyunda bir oyuncu tarafindan taciz edilirseniz, bunu kisisel algilamayin - oyuncu size degil, gümüs taciniza tepki gösteriyor!

english: Make sure you log out of the game and the forums whenever you leave your device. Don't allow others to see confidential info!

english: Never answer questions if you feel the answer will breach confidentiality.
translation: Cevabin gizliligi ihlal edecegini düsünüyorsaniz asla soruya cevap vermeyin.

english: Remember, if offensive language has been completely filtered out then there's no need to report or mute it!

english: Use the Jagex PMod team if you need to - they're there to help!

Choose again
Cancel
Oh, hello. How's everything?
Not too bad thanks, but I wanted to ask a question.
translation: Fena degil, tesekkürler, ama bir sey sormak istiyorum.

english: Go ahead.
What have you got for sale?
Take a look.
What do you do here?
I'm a black-market trader. Fancy taking a look at my wares?
translation: Ben karaborsa tüccariyim. Mallarima bir bakmak ister misin?

english: Yes, I'll take a look at your wares.
Good on ya!
What sort of stuff have you got?
Well then, young [lad/lass], that is a good question. In fact, I specifically deal in vyrewatch uniforms. They might leave you alone a bit more if they think you're one of them!
translation: Peki o zaman, genc , bu iyi bir soru. Aslinda, ben özellikle vyrewatch üniformalari satiyorum. Onlardan biri oldugunu düsünürlerse seni biraz daha rahat birakabilirler!

english: Makes it easier to move around the sectors without them demanding a blood tithe every time you dare breathe. So then, do you wanna have a look at my stuff?
translation: Böylece, nefes aldigin her seferinde kan vergisi talep etmeden sektörlerde dolasman daha kolay olur. Ee, mallarima bakmak ister misin?

english: I'm good.
Where am I?
You're in sector one of Meiyerditch. And don't forget, we're all here forever.
translation: Meiyerditch'in birinci sektöründesin. Unutma, hepimiz sonsuza kadar buradayiz.

english: Actually, I'm good.
Hello.
Oh... Sorry, we're not meant to talk to the nobles.
What have you got for sale?
What do you do here?
Yes, I'll take a look at your wares.
What sort of stuff have you got?
I'm good.
Where am I?
Actually, I'm good.
Who are you then?
Hurumph.
Nacklepen, tortoise trainer extraordinaire.
What's extraordinary about you?
Do you know any other tortoise trainers?
Well, no.
Well there you go then.
Tortoises are naturally pacifistic animals that eat nothing but cabbages. I am required to beat those peaceful tendencies out of the softies and turn them into hardened battle-trained killers.
translation: Kaplumbagalar dogal olarak bariscil hayvanlardir ve sadece lahana yerler. Benim görevim, bu yumusak basli hayvanlarin bariscil egilimlerini ortadan kaldirip onlari sert savas egitimi almis katillere dönüstürmek.

english: Firstly I acclimatise them to excessive aural stimulation and simple physical confrontation.
translation: Ilk olarak, onlari asiri isitsel uyarilara ve basit fiziksel catismalara alistiriyorum.

english: You shout at them and beat them with sticks?
translation: Onlara bagiriyor ve sopayla dövüyor musun?

english: Of course. Then I re-educate them to become comfortable with riders and military combat situations.
translation: Tabii ki. Sonra onlari binicilere ve askeri savas durumlarina alismalari icin yeniden egitiyorum.

english: You sit on their backs and prod them with sharp pointy things.
translation: Sirtlarina oturup keskin sivri seylerle dürtüyorsun.

english: If you like.
Doesn't seem very fair on the tortoises.
This is War! Fairness is a luxury of the weak.
Hmmm, profound but disturbing.
So why tortoises?
Isn't it obvious? Surely even to your untrained eye that giant tortoises are the perfect mobile armoured field unit?
translation: Bu cok acik degil mi? Egitimli olmayan gözlerinle bile dev kaplumbagalarin mükemmel bir mobil zirhli saha birimi oldugunu görebilirsin.

english: They are sturdy animals, and well protected by their shell. They can even swim! All we need to do is put a bit of fire in their bellies.
translation: Onlar saglam hayvanlardir ve kabuklari tarafindan iyi korunurlar. Hatta yüzebilirler! Tek yapmamiz gereken, karinlarina biraz ates koymak.

english: I suppose so....
Where do these tortoises come from?

We breed them. The originals were found by gnome explorers back in King Healthorg the Great's rule. On their discovery King Healthorg authorised a small party to go there and transport a breeding pair back here. He
translation: Onlari biz yetistiriyoruz. Orijinalleri, Büyük Kral Healthorg'un hükümdarligi döneminde cüce kasifler tarafindan bulundu. Kral Healthorg, kesiflerinin ardindan kücük bir grubu oraya göndererek bir cift kaplumbagayi buraya getirmesini emretti.

english: kept one for himself to ride into battle.
translation: Bir tanesini kendisi savasta binmek icin sakladi.

english: Trouble is they take a lot of skill and time to breed, so we're only just getting them battle ready.
translation: Sorun su ki, onlari yetistirmek cok beceri ve zaman gerektiriyor, bu yüzden onlari savasa hazir hale getirmek icin henüz baslangic asamasindayiz.

english: So what are you training these tortoises to do?
translation: Bu kaplumbagalari ne yapmak icin egitiyorsunuz?

english: Why tortoises?
Where did these tortoises come from?
I've heard enough.
Got any spare change, mate?
translation: Biraz bozuk paran var mi dostum?

english: Yes, I can spare a little money.
Thanks, mate!
Sorry, you'll have to earn it yourself, just like I did.
translation: Üzgünüm, benim yaptigim gibi sen de kendin kazanmalisin.

english: Please yourself.
I haven't got any.
Yeah, right, they all say that.
I know I've asked you before, but have you any spare change this time?
translation: Daha önce sormustum ama bu sefer bozuk paran var mi?

english: I hate [player name]!
[player name] is mean!
Don't ask [player name] for anything - [he's/she's/they're] stingy!
translation: Maceraci'dan hicbir sey istemeyin, o cimri!

english: Yes, I can spare a little money.
Sorry, you'll have to earn it yourself, just like I did.
translation: Üzgünüm, benim yaptigim gibi kendin kazanmalisin.

english: Take that you thief!
Can I help you today?
Can I go for a ride?
Minecart rides are 20 coins.
Of course.
I'm fine, thanks.
As a loyal customer of the Lovakengj Minecart Network, you're entitled to this.
translation: Lovakengj Maden Arabasi Agi'nin sadik bir müsterisi olarak, buna hakkin var.

english: Now, can I help you today?
translation: Simdi, bugün size nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: You're already here, human.
Sorry, human, you can't use the Lovakengj Minecart Network. Speak to Miriam, at the main station by the southern Lovakengj bank, if you've got any questions.
translation: Üzgünüm, insan, Lovakengj Maden Arabasi Agi'ni kullanamazsin. Sorulariniz varsa, güney Lovakengj bankasinin yanindaki ana istasyonda Miriam ile konusun.

english: Sorry, human, the Lovakengj Minecart Network is for citizens of Lovakengj only.
translation: Üzgünüm insan, Lovakengj Maden Arabasi Agi sadece Lovakengj vatandaslari icindir.

english: I've got this control scroll for you.
translation: Sizin icin bu kontrol parsömenini getirdim.

english: Thanks, human. I guess it's okay for you to ride my carts after all. So, can I help you?
translation: Tesekkürler insan. Sanirim arabalarimi kullanabilirsiniz. Peki, size yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: Thanks again for bringing me that control scroll. Can I help you today?
translation: Kontrol parsömenini getirdiginiz icin tekrar tesekkürler. Bugün size yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: No thanks, you've already given me one of those.
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler, zaten bir tane verdin.

english: Can I go for a ride?
I'm fine, thanks.
I will hide somewhere in the house.
These magic stones will guide you to me!
translation: Bu sihirli taslar sizi bana götürecek!

english: [player name] has found me!
Hello?
Ssshhh! What do you want?
Well, it's not every day you see a man up a tree.
translation: Her gün bir adamin agacta oldugunu görmezsin.

english: I'm trying to observe a suspect. Leave me alone!
translation: Bir süpheliyi gözlemlemeye calisiyorum. Beni rahat birak!

english: What's this all about?
Hadn't you heard? You'd better go and talk to the other guard, the one by the bank door. He'll tell you all about it.
translation: Duymadin mi? Gidip banka kapisinin yanindaki diger güvenlik görevlisiyle konussan iyi olur. O sana her seyi anlatir.

english: Go on, ask him what's wrong with the bank wall. He loves when people ask him that.
translation: Hadi, ona banka duvarinin ne sorunu oldugunu sor. Insanlarin ona bunu sormasini cok sever.

english: Ok, if you say so..
This is about the bank robbery, right?
translation: Bu banka soygunuyla ilgili, degil mi?

english: Yes, that's right. We're keeping the suspect under tight observation for the moment.
translation: Evet, dogru. Su anda süpheliyi siki gözetim altinda tutuyoruz.

english: Can't you just... I dunno... arrest him?
I'm not meant to discuss the case. You know what confidentiality rules are like.
translation: Bu davayi tartismamam gerekiyor. Gizlilik kurallarini bilirsiniz.

english: Fair enough.
You're not being very subtle up there.
I'd be doing a lot better if nits like you didn't come crowding around me all day!
translation: Senin gibi sinekler bütün gün etrafimda dolanmasa cok daha iyi olurdu!

english: But your legs are hanging down!
Go away!
Please yourself!
Can I do anything to help?
That's very kind of you. I'd rather like a nice bowl of stew, if you could fetch me one. I don't get many meal breaks.
translation: Cok naziksin. Bana bir kase güvec getirirsen cok sevinirim. Yemek molasi pek yok da.

english: You want a bowl of stew?
If you wouldn't mind...
I'll think about it!
Yes, what do you... I say, is that stew for me?
translation: Evet, ne... Diyorum ki, o güvec benim icin mi?

english: Ok, take the stew!
Gosh, that's very kind of you! Here, have a few coins for your trouble...
translation: Vay canina, cok naziksin! Al, zahmetin icin birkac bozuk para...

english: The guard eats the stew
The guard drops the empty bowl out of the tree!
translation: Muhafiz bos kaseyi agactan asagi atar!

english: No, I want to keep this stew!
Fair enough. But if you change your mind, I'll probably still be here.
translation: Haklisin. Ama fikrini degistirirsen, muhtemelen hala burada olacagim.

english: Here's some stew.
I think I should leave him in peace to finish his stew!
translation: Onu rahat birakip yahnisi bitirmesine izin vermeliyim!

english: Why the demoninikinare you waving THAT at me?
Sorry, I thought you'd like it.
Erm... No thanks! Now, if you don't mind, I'm trying to observe this suspect!
translation: Erm... Hayir, tesekkürler! Simdi, sakincasi yoksa, bu süpheliyi gözlemlemeye calisiyorum!

english: Sorry!
Ooooch!
Oi!
Watch what you're doing with that axe, you nit!
translation: O baltayla ne yaptigini dikkat et, seni aptal!

english: You'll blow my cover! I'm meant to be hidden!
translation: Kimligimi aciga cikaracaksin! Gizli kalmam gerekiyor!

english: Will you stop that?
Don't draw attention to me!
Hey - gerroff me!
Ow! That really hurt!
This is about the bank robbery, right?
translation: Bu banka soygunuyla ilgili, degil mi?

english: You're not being very subtle up there.
Can I do anything to help?
Ok, take the stew!
No, I want to keep this stew!
You must defeat me before touching the tree!
Grr ... Get out of my way...
Hello there.
Greetings, traveller. Are you interested in any throwing weapons?
translation: Selamlar, yolcu. Firlatma silahlariyla ilgileniyor musun?

english: Yes I am.
That is a good thing.
Not really.
No bother to me.
Yes I am.
Not really.
Ho, [Fremennik name]! The brave warrior returns!
translation: Ho, Dokrak! Cesur savasci geri döndü!

english: It was a hard-fought battle, but we Fremennik prevailed!
translation: Zorlu bir savasti, ama biz Fremennikler galip geldik!

english: I expect we'll be hearing songs about the 'Slayer of the Troll King' for many years to come.
translation: Önümüzdeki yillarda “Trol Krali Katili” hakkinda sarkilar duyacagimizi umuyorum.

english: It would be an honour to be remembered in such a way! Thanks.
translation: Böyle hatirlanmak benim icin bir onurdur! Tesekkürler.

english: Hello there.
Thanks for rescuing my mum and dad!
Thanks again for freeing me from that ice block! I might be a troll, but it was real uncomfortable in there!
translation: Beni buz blokundan kurtardigin icin tekrar tesekkürler! Ben bir trol olabilirim, ama orada gercekten cok rahatsizdim!

english: Thanks again for freeing me from that ice block! I don't know what my little snookums would have done without us!
translation: Beni o buz kütlesinden kurtardiginiz icin tekrar tesekkürler! Kücük canim onsuz ne yapardi bilmiyorum!

english: Can I help you, traveller?
Why do you stand here?
This is the northernmost reach of Kourend. Beyond these cliffs you will find the Doors of Dinh and the prison of the Wintertodt.
translation: Burasi Kourend'in en kuzey noktasi. Bu kayaliklarin ötesinde Dinh Kapilari ve Wintertodt'un hapishanesi var.

english: The Pyromancers do what they can to keep the Wintertodt contained but I fear it will not be enough.
translation: Pyromancers, Wintertodt'u kontrol altinda tutmak icin ellerinden geleni yapiyorlar ama korkarim bu yeterli olmayacak.

english: I come here to keep watch, whenever my time permits, so that the city may be warned if the Wintertodt escapes.
translation: Zamanim elverdiginde buraya gelip nöbet tutuyorum, böylece Wintertodt kacarsa sehir uyarilabilir.

english: Interesting... Thanks.
I'm fine, thanks.
What's this for?
For your troubles.
Right... Well, thanks.
Thanks.
About this circle of dead mushrooms...
You know very little of such circles, traveller. Perhaps one day we will have more to discuss. Now, can I help you with anything else?
translation: Bu cemberler hakkinda cok az sey biliyorsun, yolcu. Belki bir gün daha fazla konusabiliriz. Simdi, baska bir konuda yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: Yes, the circle is dead. Crops die quite often, according to the Hosidius peasants. Do you wish me to reanimate it? I can, for a mere 80,000 coins.
translation: Evet, cember öldü. Hosidius köylülerine göre ekinler sik sik ölüyor. Onu yeniden canlandirmami ister misin? Yapabilirim, sadece 80.000 sikke karsiliginda.

english: I don't have the money.
In that case the circle will remain dead. Now, can I help you with anything else?
translation: O halde cember ölü kalacak. Baska bir sey icin yardim edebilir miyim?

english: Okay, here's 80,000 coins.
Trossa casts a reanimation spell on the mushrooms
There, the deed is done. Now, can I help you with anything else?
translation: Iste, is tamam. Baska bir sey icin yardim edebilir miyim?

english: No thanks, I'm not interested.
Why do you stand here?
I'm fine, thanks.
About this circle of dead mushrooms...
Okay, here's 80,000 coins.
No thanks, I'm not interested.
Hello there.
Oh, what do you want? Can't you see I'm trying to nap?
translation: Ne istiyorsun? Uyumaya calistigimi görmüyor musun?

english: Shouldn't you be catching rats?
Oh my, no. I have humans for that.
translation: Hayir, hayir. Bunun icin insanlar var.

english: Meow.
Greetings.
Hello Bwana. I conclude that you have been successful. Mosol sent word that the village is clearing of zombies. You have done us all a great deed!
translation: Merhaba Bwana. Basarili oldugun sonucuna vardim. Mosol, köyün zombilerden temizlendigini haber verdi. Hepimize büyük bir iyilik yaptin!

english: Why not go and visit him and have a look around Shilo village. You may find some interesting things there!
translation: Neden gidip onu ziyaret edip Shilo köyünü gezmiyorsun? Orada ilginc seyler bulabilirsin!

english: Hello!
Hello again Bwana! Well Done again for helping to defeat Rashiliyia. Hopefully things will return to normal around here now.
translation: Merhaba Bwana! Rashiliyia'yi yenmemize yardim ettigin icin tekrar tebrikler. Umarim artik buradaki isler normale döner.

english: Hello Bwana!
Greetings!
I hope things are going well for you now. I have no new information since last we spoke. Needless to say, that if something does come up I will certainly get in touch directly.
translation: Umarim islerin yolunda gidiyordur. Son konusmamizdan bu yana yeni bir bilgi almadim. Tabii ki, bir sey olursa kesinlikle dogrudan sizinle iletisime gececegim.

english: So how are you doing?
We walk in the light of Tumeken. Gone he may be, but his fire burns on through all who remain. For some, the fire heals. For others, it destroys. This is as it should be. It is all part of the plan.
translation: Tumeken'in isiginda yürüyoruz. O artik aramizda olmayabilir, ama atesi kalanlarin icinde yanmaya devam ediyor. Bazilari icin bu ates sifa kaynagi, bazilari icinse yikim kaynagi. Bu olmasi gerektigi gibi. Her sey planin bir parcasi.

english: Okay... never mind.
*Brrrrrrr*
Even the tiniest grain of sand is illuminated by his light.
translation: En kücük kum tanesi bile onun isigiyla aydinlaniyor.

english: His light still burns within me.
... light... meken. Gone... fire bur...
Are you okay?
*Brrrrrrrrr* 404: *Zkxhcz*
Maybe you should get some rest?
Malfunction... ERROR... Malfunction...
We are ever faithful to the guidance of Elidinis. Her water sustains us, and brings life to the lifeless. We grow with her, and she with us. For as long as we remember her, we will never be alone.
translation: Elidinis'in rehberligine her zaman sadik kaliriz. Onun suyu bizi besler ve cansiz olanlara hayat verir. Onunla birlikte büyürüz, o da bizimle birlikte büyür. Onu hatirladigimiz sürece, asla yalniz kalmayiz.

english: *Brrrrrrr*
Even a single one of her tears could grow an oasis.
translation: Onun tek bir gözyasi bile bir vaha yaratabilir.

english: Her river flows within me.
... faithful... guidan... dinis... water... life...
*Brrrrrrrrr* 34: *KzZhc*
Instructions... unclear... ERROR... stuck...
May shadows be your grave!
That's not a nice way to greet someone, is it?
translation: Bu birini selamlamak icin hos bir yol degil, degil mi?

english: All will be ashes!
Has anyone ever told you that you're a bit gloomy?
translation: Hic kimse sana biraz kasvetli oldugunu söyledi mi?

english: Resisting only delays the inevitable!
Alright then.
All will be ashes.
Fight back, coward.
From one prison, to another.
What's life like as anbaboon?
Have you seen me? I look a bit dead. How about you tell me what's life like.
translation: Beni gördün mü? Biraz ölü gibi görünüyorum. Hayatin nasil oldugunu sen anlat bana.

english: Well, it's just life, isn't it?
Well, it's just life, isn't it?
Yes... That's what I said.
Yes... That's what I said.
Stop aping!
I physically cannot do that.
Then maybe the same could be said for me.
translation: O zaman belki benim icin de ayni sey söylenebilir.

english: I suppose. I would really like to know your story though.
translation: Sanirim. Ama senin hikayeni gercekten cok merak ediyorum.

english: Now that's a different question. I am the daughter of a most powerful matriarch.
translation: Bu farkli bir soru. Ben en güclü matriarkin kiziyim.

english: While I grew up with many siblings, she always took care of us. In fact, I've never been scared.
translation: Bircok kardesimle birlikte büyüdüm, o hep bize bakti. Aslinda, hic korkmadim.

english: Why do you think that is?
It must be due to her motherly love and my great family.
translation: Annesinin sevgisi ve harika ailem sayesinde olmali.

english: Mhm. I'm sure... That must be it.
Hand over all the bananas, and no one will get hurt.
translation: Tüm muzlari verin, kimse zarar görmesin.

english: Hello, little one.
Hello?
Do you not like me?
Are you shy? Why would you follow me and not say anything?
translation: Utangac misin? Neden beni takip edip hicbir sey söylemiyorsun?

english: Do not mistake my silence for shyness. Can't we just quietly share the road together?
translation: Sessizligimi utangaclikla karistirma. Sessizce yolu birlikte paylasamaz miyiz?

english: Oh... well, yes, I suppose we can.
Bzzzzz!
Feed me.
That's quite demanding, but sure. What would you like?
translation: Bu oldukca zor bir istek, ama tabii. Ne istersin?

english: I demand sustenance.
I might have some cooked lobsters somewhere... Maybe a Saradomin brew?
translation: Bir yerlerde pismis istakozlarim olabilir... Belki bir Saradomin birasi?

english: Food.
You really have a one-track mind, don't you?
translation: Gercekten tek bir sey düsünüyorsun, degil mi?

english: Hungry.
Look what I have!
I'm on a diet.
You're joking aren't you?!
I only eat adventurers... Like you.
translation: Ben sadece maceracilari yerim... Senin gibi.

english: Oh... okay, as you were.
Feeeed me!
I will devour you!
Where food?
Who are you?
I'm one of the elite Slayer Masters.
What's a slayer?
Oh dear, what do they teach you in school?
translation: Oh canim, okulda sana ne ögretiyorlar?

english: Well... er...

I suppose I'll have to educate you then. A slayer is someone who is trained to fight specific creatures. They know these creatures' every weakness and strength. As you can guess it makes killing them a lot easier.
translation: O zaman sana ögretmem gerekecek. Slayer, belirli yaratiklarla savasmak icin egitilmis kisidir. Bu yaratiklarin tüm zayifliklarini ve güclerini bilirler. Tahmin edebilecegin gibi, bu onlari öldürmeyi cok daha kolay hale getirir.

english: Never heard of you...
That's because my foe never lives to tell of me. We slayers are a dangerous bunch.
translation: Cünkü düsmanlarim beni anlatacak kadar yasamazlar. Biz slayerlar tehlikeli bir grubuz.

english: Wow, can you teach me?
translation: Vay canina, bana da ögretebilir misin?

english: Hmmm well I'm not so sure...
Pleeeaasssse!
Oh okay then, you twisted my arm. You'll have to train against specific groups of creatures.
translation: Tamam o zaman, beni ikna ettin. Belirli yaratik gruplarina karsi egitim alman gerekecek.

english: Okay, what's first?
We'll start you off hunting [monster name], you'll need to kill [number] of them.
You'll also need this enchanted gem, it allows Slayer Masters like myself to contact you and update you on your progress. Don't worry if you lose it, you can buy another from any Slayer Master.
translation: Ayrica bu büyülü mücevheri de almalisin, bu mücevher benim gibi Avci Ustalarinin seninle iletisim kurup ilerlemeni takip etmesini saglar. Kaybetersen endiselenme, herhangi bir Avci Ustasi'ndan yenisini alabilirsin.

english: Okay, great!
Good luck! Don't forget to come back when you need a new assignment.
translation: Iyi sanslar! Yeni bir görev istediginde geri gelmeyi unutma.

english: Sounds useless to me.
Suit yourself.
'Ello, and what are you after then?
I need another assignment.
You're actually very strong, are you sure you don't want Chaeldar in Zanaris to assign you a task?
translation: Aslinda cok güclüsün, Zanaris'teki Chaeldar'in sana bir görev vermesini istemediginden emin misin?

english: No that's okay, I'll take a task from you.
translation: Hayir, sorun degil, senden bir görev alacagim.

english: Oh okay then, I'll go talk to Chaeldar.
Excellent, you're doing great. Your new task is to kill [amount] [task monster].
You're still hunting [task monster], you have [amount] to go.
Although, it's not an assignment that I'd normally give... I guess I could give you a new assignment, if you'd like.
translation: Aslinda bu normalde verecegim bir görev degil... Ama istersen sana yeni bir görev verebilirim.

english: If you do get a new one, you will reset your standard task streak of [task streak amount]. Is that okay? It won't affect your Wilderness task streak of [task streak amount].
No, thanks.
You're still hunting [monster], with [amount] to go.
I don't think that's a suitable task for you. Shall I cancel it? This will not wipe your task streaks.
translation: Bunun senin icin uygun bir görev oldugunu sanmiyorum. Iptal edeyim mi? Bu, görev serilerini silmeyecek.

english: Yes, please cancel it.
Alright, consider the task cancelled. You can now get a new assignment when you want one.
translation: Tamam, görev iptal edildi. Artik istediginiz zaman yeni bir görev alabilirsiniz.

english: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
Good luck with that.
Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?

translation: Karanlik Sunak, Arceuus'un hazinesidir. Atalarimiz hayatlarini, bazilari kelimenin tam anlamiyla, onun sirlarini cözmeyi ve gücünü kullanmayi ögrenmek icin harcadilar.

english: The power of the Dark Altar, reflected in these great crystals, can twist dimensions, warp minds, and even bridge the gulf between life and death.
translation: Karanlik Sunak'in gücü, bu büyük kristallerde yansitilir ve boyutlari bükebilir, zihinleri carpitabilir ve hatta yasam ile ölüm arasindaki ucurumu kapatabilir.

english: Can I try the magicks myself?
Very well. If you find an ensouled cadaver in your travels, you may attempted to reanimate it with the magicks I have placed in your mind.
translation: Tabii ki. Yolculugun sirasinda ruhu olan bir ceset bulursan, zihnine yerlestirdigim büyüyle onu yeniden canlandirmayi deneyebilirsin.

english: Thanks.
I'd like to stop using your spellbook now.
translation: Artik büyü kitabini kullanmayi birakmak istiyorum.

english: Very well, the magicks of the Dark Altar have been lifted from your mind.
translation: Peki, Karanlik Sunak'in büyüsü zihninden kaldirildi.

english: Do you sell souvenirs?
I suppose you are a friend to us. Free up some space and I will give you something.
translation: Sanirim sen bizim dostumuzsun. Biraz yer ac, sana bir sey verecegim.

english: I suppose you are a friend to us. Here, you may have this.
translation: Sanirim sen bizim dostumuzsun. Al, bunu alabilirsin.

english: Can I have an ash sanctifier, please?
No. You need to complete all of the hard tasks in your Kourend & Kebos Achievement Diary.
translation: Hayir. Kourend & Kebos Basari Günlügündeki tüm zor görevleri tamamlaman gerekiyor.

english: Not unless you make space to carry it, traveller.
translation: Onu tasiyacak yer acmazsan olmaz, gezgin.

english: Thanks for your efforts throughout the tasks set. Here, you may have this.
translation: Görevler boyunca gösterdigin cabalar icin tesekkürler. Al, bunu alabilirsin.

english: You already appear to own such a device, traveller.
translation: Gezgin, zaten böyle bir alete sahip görünüyorsun.

english: Can I sacrifice my trophy heads on the altar?
Yes, I believe the Dark Altar may even reward you for such a sacrifice.
translation: Evet, Karanlik Sunak böyle bir kurban icin seni ödüllendirebilir bile.

english: What is this place?
Can I try the magicks myself?
I'd like to stop using your spellbook now.
translation: Artik senin büyü kitabini kullanmak istemiyorum.

english: Do you sell souvenirs?
Can I have an ash sanctifier, please?
Can I sacrifice trophy heads on the altar?
translation: Kazanc kafalarini sunakta kurban edebilir miyim?

english: Can I help you [TzHaar caste]-[player name]?
Are you not [TzHaar caste]-[player name]?
What's a '[TzHaar caste]'?
That what you are... you tough and strong no?
translation: Sen öyle birisin... sert ve güclü, degil mi?

english: That what you are... you user of mystic powers no?
translation: Sen öyle birisin... mistik gücleri kullaniyorsun, degil mi?

english: That what you are... you agile and quick no?
translation: Sen öyle birisin... cevik ve hizlisin, degil mi?

english: That what you are... you skilled at making things no?
translation: Sen öyle birisin... bir seyler yapmada yeteneklisin, degil mi?

english: Well yes I suppose I am...
Then you [TzHaar caste]!
What are you then?
Silly JalYt, I am TzHaar-Hur, one of the crafters for this city.
translation: Aptal JalYt, ben TzHaar-Hur, bu sehrin zanaatkârlarindan biriyim.

english: There are the wise TzHaar-Mej who guide us, the mighty TzHaar-Ket who guard us, and the swift TzHaar-Xil who hunt for our food.
translation: Bizi yönlendiren bilge TzHaar-Mej, bizi koruyan güclü TzHaar-Ket ve yiyecegimizi avlayan cevik TzHaar-Xil var.

english: Thanks for explaining it.
I guess so...
Well then, no problems.
No I'm not!
What ever you say, crazy JalYt!
No I'm fine thanks.
What do you have to trade?
What did you call me?
What are you then?

translation: Aptal JalYt, ben TzHaar-Hur'um, bu sehrin zanaatkârlarindan biriyim.

english: There are the wise TzHaar-Mej who guide us, the mighty TzHaar-Ket who guard us, and the swift TzHaar-Xil who hunt for our food.
translation: Bizi yönlendiren bilge TzHaar-Mej'ler, bizi koruyan güclü TzHaar-Ket'ler ve yiyecegimizi avlayan cevik TzHaar-Xil'ler var.

What did you call me?
What are you then?
