I guess so...
No I'm not!
No I'm fine thanks.
You need help JalYt-[TzHaar caste]-[player name]?
Why can't I go past here?
This area closed to JalYt.
Why's that?
JalYt are not trusted. Nor are capable of withstanding the heat. The features of the city are a secret.
translation: JalYt'lere güvenilmez. Ayrica sicaga dayanamazlar. Sehrin özellikleri gizlidir.

english: That's a shame.
What if I could prove that I am capable?
translation: Eger yetenekli oldugumu kanitlayabilirsem ne olur?

english: [TzHaar caste]-[player name], I suppose that is perfectly acceptable, but it would take lots to convince.
translation: Zak-Zuk-Zok-Maceraci, sanirim bu tamamen kabul edilebilir, ama ikna etmek icin cok sey gerekir.

english: How about a large stack of coins.
translation: Büyük bir yigin para nasil olur?

english: Gold is bad currency, I have no use for JalYt coins.
translation: Altin kötü bir para birimidir, JalYt paralarinin bana bir faydasi yok.

english: I managed to defeat TzTok-Jad and obtain this firecape.
translation: TzTok-Jad'i yenip bu ates pelerinini elde etmeyi basardim.

english: That is most impressive [TzHaar caste]-[player name].
Surely this proves I am capable? Can I pleeease come through now?
translation: Bu yetenekli oldugumu kanitlamiyor mu? Lütfen gecmeme izin verir misin?

english: I suppose so, I'll grant you access to Mor Ul Rek. The guards will open the gates for you, you are the first JalYt to pass these gates!
translation: Sanirim evet, Mor Ul Rek'e giris izni verecegim. Muhafizlar kapilari senin icin acacak, bu kapilardan gecen ilk JalYt sensin!

english: Sorry, I don't think I am capable.
I'm a hardened adventurer, nothing can stop me!
translation: Ben sert bir maceraciyim, beni hicbir sey durduramaz!

english: Back off JalYt-[TzHaar caste]-[player name], trust me when I say our obsidian bodies are harder.
translation: Geri cekil JalYt-Zak-Zuk-Zok-Maceraci, obsidiyen bedenlerimizin daha sert olduguna inan bana.

english: What are you guarding?
Ah, trusted and most capable JalYt, this is the city of Mor Ul Rek. It has grand central inferno, our birthing pool. Go! See for yourself [TzHaar caste]-[player name]
translation: Ah, güvenilir ve yetenekli JalYt, burasi Mor Ul Rek sehri. Büyük bir merkezi cehennemi var, bizim dogum havuzumuz. Git! Kendin gör Zak-Zuk-Zok-Maceraci

english: [TzHaar caste]-[player name], you are not trusted, this is secret area. Less questions! I will say that it's the inner core of the city though.
translation: Zak-Zuk-Zok-Maceraci, sana güvenilmiyor, burasi gizli bir alan. Az soru sor! Sehrin ic cekirdegi oldugunu söyleyebilirim.

english: Oh well, goodbye.
Oh well, [TzHaar caste]-[Player name] over and out.
Haha funny JalYt try to speak language, why do you put that accent on when attempting it?
translation: Haha, komik JalYt, dil konusmaya calisiyor, neden konusurken o aksani kullaniyorsun?

english: maybe it helps you to understand what I'm saying. See you around.
translation: Belki de söylediklerimi anlamana yardimci olur. Görüsürüz.

english: Fair enough.
Are you not [TzHaar caste]-[player name]?
What's a '[TzHaar caste]'?
That what you are... you tough and strong no?
translation: Sen öylesin... Sen sert ve güclüsün, degil mi?

english: That what you are... you user of mystic powers, no?
translation: Sen öylesin... Sen mistik güclerin kullanicisisin, degil mi?

english: That what you are... you agile and quick no?
translation: Sen öylesin... Sen cevik ve hizlisin, degil mi?

english: That what you are... you skilled at making things no?
translation: Sen öylesin... Sen bir seyler yapmada yeteneklisin, degil mi?

english: Well yes I suppose I am...
Then you [TzHaar caste]!
What are you then?
Silly JalYt, I am TzHaar-Ket, one of the guardians of our city.
translation: Aptal JalYt, ben TzHaar-Ket, sehrimizin koruyucularindan biriyim.

english: There are the wise TzHaar-Mej who guide us, the swift TzHaar-Xil who hunt for our food, and the skilled TzHaar-Hur who craft our homes and tools.
translation: Bizi yönlendiren bilge TzHaar-Mej, yiyecegimizi avlayan cevik TzHaar-Xil ve evlerimizi ve aletlerimizi yapan yetenekli TzHaar-Hur var.

english: Thanks for explaining it.
I guess so...
Well then, no problems.
No I'm not!
What ever you say, crazy JalYt!
translation: Sen ne dersen o, cilgin JalYt!

english: No I'm fine thanks.
Hello JalYt-[TzHaar caste]-[player name].
Hello!
You need help little JalYt?
translation: Yardima ihtiyacin var mi kücük JalYt?

english: Not unless you can help me in The Inferno.
We dare not go there. That job is for you.
translation: Oraya gitmeye cesaret edemiyoruz. O is sana kalmis.

english: Oh... worth a try I suppose.
Why can't I go past here?
Why's that?
That's a shame.
What if I could prove I am capable?
How about a large stack of gold?
translation: Büyük bir altin yiginina ne dersin?

english: I managed to defeat TzTok-Jad and obtain this firecape.
translation: TzTok-Jad'i yenip bu ates pelerinini elde ettim.

english: Sorry, I don't think I am capable.
I'm a hardened adventurer, nothing can stop me!
translation: Ben sert bir maceraciyim, beni hicbir sey durduramaz!

english: What are you guarding?
Oh well, Goodbye.
Oh well, [TzHaar caste]-[player name] over and out.
Fair enough.
What did you call me?
What are you then?
Thanks for explaining it.
I guess so...
No I'm not!
No I'm fine thanks.
Not unless you can help me in the Inferno.
It is not for us to help. You must fight alone.
translation: Yardim etmek bize düsmez. Tek basina savasmalisin.

english: Oh... Worth a try I suppose.
Yes, JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name]?
Tell me about the Inferno.
TzHaar are born from eggs incubated in lava pools. When hatched, we retain memories. Memories and knowledge passed on from ancestors who returned to the lava.
translation: TzHaar, lav havuzlarinda kuluckaya yatirilan yumurtalardan dogar. Yumurtadan ciktigimizda, anilarimizi koruruz. Lavlara geri dönen atalarimizdan miras kalan anilar ve bilgiler.

english: When TzHaar hatch, some memories are lost. Those about earliest ancestors are not retained. We experiment.
translation: TzHaar yumurtadan ciktiginda, bazi anilar kaybolur. En eski atalarimizla ilgili anilar korunmaz. Biz deneyler yapiyoruz.

english: This here was once our largest birthing pool. We use it for experiment. We increased the depth at which eggs are incubated. Over time, newly hatched TzHaar had more memories of lost history!
translation: Burasi bir zamanlar en büyük dogum havuzumuzdu. Deneyler icin kullaniyoruz. Yumurtalarin kuluckaya yatirildigi derinligi artirdik. Zamanla, yeni yumurtadan cikan TzHaar'lar kayip tarihin daha fazla anisina sahip oldular!

english: But we kept pushing. We wanted answers, but we went too deep.
translation: Ama biz devam ettik. Cevaplar istiyorduk, ama cok derine indik.

english: Eventually the pool collapsed into a sinkhole. At the bottom we found some sort of ancient incubation chamber, from before earliest memories. We now call it the Inferno.
translation: Sonunda havuz cöktü ve bir cukur olustu. En dipte, en eski anilardan önceye ait bir tür eski kulucka odasi bulduk. Artik ona Inferno diyoruz.

english: We decide to experiment more. We take eggs from creatures in Fight Cave and incubate them down there.
translation: Daha fazla deney yapmaya karar verdik. Fight Cave'deki yaratiklardan yumurtalar alip onlari orada kuluckaya yatiriyoruz.

english: When eggs hatched, we see that it was not good decision. They were bigger and stronger, and fought each other for dominance.
translation: Yumurtalar catladiginda, bunun iyi bir karar olmadigini anladik. Daha büyük ve daha güclüydüler ve hakimiyet icin birbirleriyle savastilar.

english: Instead of knowledge, we now have chamber of dangerous creatures, and they're not alone. Another being lives in the Inferno, one more powerful than any TzHaar.
translation: Bilgi yerine, simdi tehlikeli yaratiklarin bulundugu bir odamiz var ve onlar yalniz degiller. Inferno'da baska bir varlik yasiyor, TzHaar'lardan daha güclü bir varlik.

english: We do not know where he came from. All we know is that TzKal-Zuk is hungry. Hungry for memories, memories beyond the Inferno.
translation: Nereden geldigini bilmiyoruz. Tek bildigimiz, TzKal-Zuk'un ac oldugu. Anilara, Inferno'nun ötesindeki anilara ac.

english: We think his goal is the city itself. Lots of TzHaar memories here for him. Luckily, he is trapped in prison down there, and we are keeping him at bay by offering sacrifices.
translation: Hedefinin sehrin kendisi oldugunu düsünüyoruz. Burada onun icin cok sayida TzHaar anisi var. Neyse ki, o asagidaki hapishanede mahsur kaldi ve biz de kurbanlar sunarak onu uzak tutuyoruz.

english: We fear he can't be defeated, but maybe we can hold back his creatures and keep city safe.
translation: Onun yenilemeyeceginden korkuyoruz, ama belki de yaratiklarini geri püskürtebilir ve sehri güvende tutabiliriz.

english: You, a mere JalYt, showed us he can be stopped though. Thanks to you, we still have hope.
translation: Sen, basit bir JalYt, bize onun durdurulabilecegini gösterdin. Senin sayende, hala umudumuz var.

english: Instead of knowledge, we now have chamber of dangerous creatures. It gets worse, but I don't know if I can trust JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name] with this knowledge.
translation: Bilgi yerine, artik tehlikeli yaratiklarin bulundugu bir odamiz var. Durum daha da kötüye gidiyor, ama bu bilgiyi JalYt--Xo-Maceraci'ya güvenip güvenemeyecegimi bilmiyorum.

english: I like to think I'm pretty trustworthy. If you tell me, maybe I can help in some way.
translation: Kendimi oldukca güvenilir biri olarak görüyorum. Bana söylersen, belki bir sekilde yardimci olabilirim.

english: I have one idea. If you sacrifice your fire cape to me, I can take your word.
translation: Bir fikrim var. Bana ates pelerinini kurban edersen, sözüne güvenebilirim.

english: Okay, I'd like to sacrifice my fire cape.
translation: Tamam, ates pelerinimi feda etmek istiyorum.

english: Very well, just hand it over.
Sorry, I want to keep it for now.
Thank you, JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name]. You can enter Inferno now.
What should I do down there?
The creatures down there are dangerous. If you can kill some of them, it would be very helpful to TzHaar.
translation: Oradaki yaratiklar tehlikelidir. Bazilarini öldürebilirsen, TzHaar icin cok yardimci olursun.

english: But now you can be trusted, I must also give warning. Another being lives in the Inferno, one more powerful than any TzHaar.
translation: Ama artik sana güvenebilirim, yine de bir uyarida bulunmaliyim. Inferno'da baska bir varlik yasiyor, TzHaar'lardan daha güclü bir varlik.

english: Well I definitely think I can help with that.
Thank you, JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name].
I'll need to take it off first.
I don't have a fire cape on me unfortunately.
Can I help here in some way?
translation: Burada bir sekilde yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: I think maybe you can, but first you need to prove I can trust you.
translation: Sanirim olabilirsin, ama önce sana güvenebilecegimi kanitlaman gerekiyor.

english: If you sacrifice your fire cape to me, I can take your word.
translation: Ates pelerinini bana feda edersen, sözüne inanabilirim.

english: Never mind.
A great power is starting to shake the cavern...
translation: Büyük bir güc magarayi sarsmaya basladi...

english: No! TzKal-Zuk's prison is breaking down. There's nothing I can do for you now, JalYt!
translation: Hayir! TzKal-Zuk'un hapishanesi yikiliyor. Artik senin icin yapabilecegim bir sey yok, JalYt!

english: You are very impressive for a JalYt. You managed to defeat TzKal-Zuk, for now...
translation: Bir JalYt icin cok etkileyicisin. TzKal-Zuk'u yenmeyi basardin, simdilik...

english: Please accept this cape as a token of appreciation.
translation: Lütfen bu pelerini minnettarligimin bir göstergesi olarak kabul et.

english: Wow what has happened here? That doesn't look good!
translation: Vay canina, burada ne oldu? Durum iyi görünmüyor!

english: We pushed it too far! JalYt would not understand. The memories, we needed them. Now big Inferno.
translation: Cok ileri gittik! JalYt anlamazdi. Anilara ihtiyacimiz vardi. Simdi büyük bir cehennem var.

english: What is this place?
This is our birthing pool. TzHaar are born from eggs incubated in this large pool here.
translation: Burasi dogum havuzumuz. TzHaar'lar bu büyük havuzda kuluckaya yatirilan yumurtalardan dogar.

english: When hatched, we retain memories. Memories and knowledge passed on from ancestors who returned to the lava.
translation: Yumurtadan ciktigimizda, anilarimizi koruruz. Lavlara geri dönen atalarimizdan miras kalan anilar ve bilgiler.

english: Something doesn't seem right... There's a large opening.
translation: Bir seyler yolunda degil... Büyük bir aciklik var.

english: What happened here?
We went too far... way too far, we need the memories. JalYt would not understand.
translation: Cok ileri gittik... cok fazla ileri, anilara ihtiyacimiz var. JalYt anlamaz.

english: Please help me to understand then.
translation: O zaman lütfen anlamama yardim et.

english: We TzHaar have special ability. When incubated in lava, a hatched TzHaar retains knowledge and memories of ancestors who returned to the lava.
translation: Biz TzHaar'larin özel bir yetenegi var. Lavda kuluckaya yatirildiginda, yumurtadan cikan TzHaar, lavlara geri dönen atalarinin bilgilerini ve anilarini korur.

english: Not all memories though, those about earliest ancestors were not being retained. We experiment.
translation: Ancak tüm anilar degil, en eski atalarimizla ilgili olanlar korunmuyordu. Biz deney yaptik.

english: We increased the depth at which the eggs are incubated. Over time this worked, newly hatched TzHaar had more memories of lost history!
translation: Yumurtalarin kuluckaya yatirildigi derinligi artirdik. Zamanla bu ise yaradi, yeni yumurtadan cikan TzHaar'lar kayip tarihin daha fazla anisina sahip oldular!

english: That sounds fantastic though, uncovering the past to determine where your species originated?
translation: Bu harika bir sey gibi görünüyor, türünüzün kökenini belirlemek icin gecmisi ortaya cikarmak?

english: Yes, but you JalYt do not understand, we kept pushing it. We wanted answers, but too deep we went.
translation: Evet, ama siz JalYt anlamiyorsunuz, biz bunu zorladik. Cevaplar istiyorduk, ama cok derine indik.

english: Eventually the pool collapsed into a sink hole, huge Inferno there. This was big ancient incubation chamber.
translation: Sonunda havuz cöktü ve büyük bir cehennem olustu. Burasi büyük bir eski kulucka odasiydi.

english: We decide to experiment. We take eggs from creatures in Fight Cave and incubate them.
translation: Deney yapmaya karar verdik. Fight Cave'deki yaratiklardan yumurtalar aldik ve onlari kuluckaya yatirdik.

english: We hatched eggs in there and it was not a good decision. They were so different, bigger, stronger and fought each other for dominance.
translation: Orada yumurtalari kuluckaya yatirdik ve bu iyi bir karar degildi. Cok farkliydilar, daha büyüktüler, daha güclüydüler ve hakimiyet icin birbirleriyle savastilar.

english: Instead of knowledge, we now have a prison of dangerous TzHaar creatures - it gets worse but I cannot trust JalYt with this knowledge yet.
translation: Bilgi yerine, simdi tehlikeli TzHaar yaratiklarinin bulundugu bir hapishaneye sahibiz - durum daha da kötülesiyor ama bu bilgiyi JalYt'e henüz güvenemem.

english: Instead of knowledge, we now have a prison of dangerous creatures... and they're not under our control.
translation: Bilgi yerine, simdi tehlikeli yaratiklarin bulundugu bir hapishaneye sahibiz... ve onlar bizim kontrolümüz altinda degiller.

english: One grew incredibly strong, powerful. He controls those creatures in the prison. TzKal-Zuk, as we call him...is hungry.
translation: Biri inanilmaz derecede güclü ve kuvvetli oldu. Hapishanedeki yaratiklari kontrol ediyor. TzKal-Zuk, ona böyle sesleniyoruz... ac.

english: Hungry for memories, memories beyond the Inferno, which only TzHaar in the city can provide.
translation: Anilara ac, Inferno'nun ötesindeki anilara, ki bunlari sadece sehirdeki TzHaar saglayabilir.

english: Do you know what he's planning? What are you doing?
translation: Ne planladigini biliyor musun? Ne yapiyorsun?

english: We can only guess one day he will want to scale up into the city himself. We are keeping him at bay by offering sacrifices for him to feast on.
translation: Bir gün kendisi de sehre saldirmak isteyecegini tahmin edebiliyoruz. Ona kurbanlar sunarak onu uzak tutmaya calisiyoruz.

english: Is there no way to take him out?
translation: Onu ortadan kaldirmanin bir yolu yok mu?

english: We fear not. But we hoped you, with your fancy JalYt weaponry, would be able to help hold back his creatures. You proved your commitment by sacrificing your fire cape.
translation: Korkarim yok. Ama senin, o süslü JalYt silahlarinla, onun yaratiklarini geri püskürtmeye yardimci olabilecegini umuyorduk. Ates pelerinini feda ederek bagliligini kanitladin.

english: Can I go down there?
JalYt, we need help, but this is extremely dangerous. TzHaar not strong enough to take control back.
translation: JalYt, yardima ihtiyacimiz var, ama bu cok tehlikeli. TzHaar kontrolü geri almak icin yeterince güclü degil.

english: We are worried about trusting JalYt to take on this task for us.
translation: JalYt'in bu görevi bizim icin üstlenmesine güvenmekten endise duyuyoruz.

english: Let me prove it.
I have one idea, if you could sacrifice your fire cape to me, I can take your word.
translation: Bir fikrim var, ates pelerinini bana kurban edersen, sözüne güvenebilirim.

english: You hand over your cape to TzHaar-Ket-Keh.
Give it your best shot JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name].
Let me just take it off first.
You can head into The Inferno anytime. We trust you to help us JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name].

translation: Bir dakika... Kolezyum bir rahip tarafindan mi yönetiliyor?

english: Well much of the day-to-day running is handled by the Colosseum Master, but yes, I am the one in overall charge of this place.
translation: Günlük islerin cogu Kolezyum Ustasi tarafindan yürütülüyor, ama evet, burayi genel olarak ben yönetiyorum.

english: So why is that?
This is more than just a place of spectacle. You stand in one of the holiest sites in all of Varlamore. Each drop of blood spilt here is a glorious offering to Ralos.
translation: Burasi sadece bir gösteri yeri degil. Varlamore'un en kutsal yerlerinden birinde duruyorsun. Burada dökülen her damla kan, Ralos'a sunulan sanli bir adaktir.

english: It is these offerings that sustain him. Without them, he will not have the strength to light our way.
translation: Onu ayakta tutan bu adaklardir. Onlar olmadan, yolumuzu aydinlatacak gücü olmaz.

english: Interesting... Thanks for the information.
Hello again.
Hey yous creature...yous did good fings gedin that glug-glugs for da sickies! All is ogries pepels are not gettin dead cos of you.
translation: Hey siz yaratiklar... Sizler iyi isler yaptiniz, hastalar icin o glug-gluglari aldiniz! Sizin sayenizde tüm ogreler ölmüyor.

english: What are you selling?
Me's not got no glug-glugs to sell, yous bring me da sickies glug-glug den me's open da stufsies for ya.
translation: Satacak glug-glugum yok, bana hastalarin glug-gluglarini getirin, ben de size esyalari acayim.

english: Me's showin' you da stufsies for yous creatures!
Ok, thanks.
Hey, here you go! I brought you some of the potion which should cure the disease. You said that you would buy some from me.
translation: Hey, al bakalim! Hastaligi iyilestirecek iksirden biraz getirdim. Benden biraz satin alacagini söylemistin.

english: Yous creatures is da funny ones...yous already solds me's ones now..and us can now sell un to yous!
translation: Siz yaratiklar cok komiksiniz... siz zaten benimkini sattiniz... ve simdi biz de size satabiliriz!

english: Yous creatures done da good fing...yous get many bright pretties for dis...!
translation: Siz yaratiklar iyi is cikardiniz... bunun icin bircok parlak güzellikler alacaksiniz...!

english: I's gots a thinky number puzzley for yous!
translation: Sizin icin zor bir sayi bulmacasi var!

english: Yous gots da numbers?
I's thinks yous needs to thinks again.
Dats da right answer!
Hello again.
What are you selling?
Ok, thanks.
Mmm... looks like that camel would make a nice kebab.
translation: Mmm... bu deve güzel bir kebap olur gibi görünüyor.

english: If I go near that camel, it'll probably bite my hand off.
translation: O deveye yaklasirsam, muhtemelen elimi isirir.

english: I wonder if that camel has fleas...
The camel tries to stamp on your foot, but you pull it back quickly.
translation: Deve ayaginiza basmaya calisir, ama siz hizla geri cekilirsiniz.

english: The camel turns its head and glares at you.
translation: Deve basini cevirir ve size öfkeyle bakar.

english: The camel spits at you, and you jump back hurriedly.
translation: Deve size tükürür ve siz aceleyle geri atlarsiniz.

english: Come over here, I'll bite your leg off!
Prepare to die, you two-legged combat wrangler!
Your mother was a jackal, and your father smelt of cactuses!
translation: Annen bir cakal, baban da kaktüs kokuyordu!

english: Say, aren't you the human who got arrested here the other day, by the boat?
translation: Sen, gecen gün teknenin yaninda tutuklanan insan degil misin?

english: Yes, but we cleared up the whole situation.
translation: Evet, ama her seyi acikliga kavusturduk.

english: Right, right.
Hello there.
What... Oh, don't creep up on me like that... I thought you were a Ghast!
translation: Ne... Oh, bana öyle gizlice yaklasma... Seni Ghast sandim!

english: Can I go through the gate please?
Absolutely not! I've been given strict instructions not to let anyone through. It's just too dangerous. No one gets in without Drezelssay so!
translation: Kesinlikle olmaz! Kimseyi gecirmemem konusunda kesin talimat aldim. Cok tehlikeli. Drezelssay olmadan kimse giremez!

english: Where is Drezel?
Oh, he's in the temple, just go back over the bridge, down the ladder and along the hallway, you can't miss him.
translation: Oh, tapinakta, köprüden geri dön, merdivenden asagi in ve koridordan ilerle, onu görmezden gelemezsin.

english: But I'm doing a quest for Drezel!
translation: Ama ben Drezel icin bir görev yapiyorum!

english: Ok, on your way then!
translation: Tamam, o zaman yoluna devam et!

english: Yes of course my friend, you seem to be able to handle yourself with those ghasts really well.
translation: Tabii ki dostum, o ghastlarla cok iyi basa cikabiliyorsun gibi görünüyor.

english: Oh my! You're still alive!
Very well done! Here you go!
Ulizius has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
The serum it works...but it's not too fresh, make some yourself and then it might work for longer.
translation: Serum ise yariyor... ama cok taze degil, kendin yaparsan daha uzun süre ise yarayabilir.

english: Ah, hello again, what can I do for you now?
translation: Ah, tekrar merhaba, simdi senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: Hello there.
Hello again! Many thanks for helping us to solve the  riddle with the Shades, we can start to work now  putting all those Shade spirits to rest and get  a little bit of a reward to go along with it!
translation: Tekrar merhaba! Gölgelerle ilgili bilmeceyi cözmemize yardim ettigin icin cok tesekkürler, artik tüm Gölge ruhlarini dinlendirmeye baslayabilir ve bunun karsiliginda kücük bir ödül alabiliriz!

english: Well done...I feel this serum is really working on me. I think you've cracked it my friend!  I'd like to give you something for your trouble!
translation: Aferin... Bu serumun bende gercekten ise yaradigini hissediyorum. Sanirim sorunu cözdün dostum! Zahmetin icin sana bir sey vermek istiyorum!

english: You've already used the permanent serum on me, you don't need to use that any more.
translation: Bana kalici serumu zaten kullandin, artik ona ihtiyacin yok.

english: You can't milk this cow, as its udders seem to have fallen off at some point.
translation: Bu inegi sagamazsin, cünkü memeleri bir ara düsmüs gibi görünüyor.

english: Hello there [laddie/lass].
Tell me about the Wintertodt.
They say it's some kind of powerful fire spirit.
translation: Onun bir tür güclü ates ruhu oldugunu söylüyorlar.

english: Don't you mean ice?
Aye that as well.
What it is doesn't bother me, just as long as we keep it behind the Doors.
translation: Ne oldugu umurumda degil, yeter ki Kapilar'in arkasinda kalsin.

english: Tell me about the Doors of Dinh.
The Doors were built by Dinh to contain the Wintertodt. This was over a thousand years ago and they still stand today.
translation: Kapilar, Wintertodt'u hapsetmek icin Dinh tarafindan insa edildi. Bu bin yildan fazla bir süre önceydi ve Kapilar bugün hala ayakta.

english: Who was Dinh?
Dinh was the greatest smith that the world has ever seen. I am the finest smith around today and even I cannot match his abilities.
translation: Dinh, dünyanin gördügü en büyük demirciydi. Ben bugün buradaki en iyi demirciyim ama onun yeteneklerine bile ulasamiyorum.

english: Tell me about yourself.
The name's Undor. You'll struggle to find a dwarf in this land who knows more about metalwork than me.
translation: Adim Undor. Bu topraklarda metal isciliginden benden daha fazla anlayan bir cüce bulmak zor.

english: One day I hope to be as good as the legendary Dinh himself.
translation: Bir gün efsanevi Dinh kadar iyi olmayi umuyorum.

english: What are you doing here?
They say the doors are failing and the Wintertodt is trying to escape. I'm here to prove to them that the Doors are fine.
translation: Kapilarin bozuldugunu ve Wintertodt'un kacmaya calistigini söylüyorlar. Kapilarin saglam oldugunu onlara kanitlamak icin buradayim.

english: And are they?
Of course they are! They were made by Dinh himself.
translation: Tabii ki öyle! Onlari Dinh kendisi yapti.

english: I'm just here to keep an eye on things. Even though the Doors are fixed now, it will take many years for things to get back to normal.
translation: Sadece göz kulak olmak icin buradayim. Kapilar simdi tamir edilmis olsa da, her seyin normale dönmesi yillar alacak.

english: Goodbye.
Until next time [laddie/lass].
Tell me about the Wintertodt.
Tell me about the Doors of Dinh.
Tell me about yourself.
Goodbye.
Hi Unferth. How are you doing?
It's just not the same without Bob around.
I'm so sorry Unferth.
Gertrude asked me if I'd like one of her new kittens. I don't think I'm ready for that yet.
translation: Gertrude bana yeni yavru kedilerinden birini isteyip istemedigimi sordu. Henüz buna hazir oldugumu sanmiyorum.

english: Give it time. Things will get better, I promise.
translation: Zamanla. Her sey düzelecek, söz veriyorum.

english: Thanks [player name].
Your Legendary exploits are travelling the whole jungle.

Gujuo has been to see me. He told me that you have been given a sacred totem pole. It was constructed by one of my ancestors many moons ago. It is a noble prize Bwana, you have earned it. Look after it well.
translation: Gujuo beni görmeye geldi. Sana kutsal bir totem diregi verildigini söyledi. Bu direk, uzun zaman önce atalarimdan biri tarafindan yapilmis. Bu asil bir ödül Bwana, bunu hak ettin. Ona iyi bak.

english: Ungadulu unleashes a bolt of magical energy at you. You're knocked out of the octagram by the power of the spell.
translation: Ungadulu sana büyülü bir enerji isini firlatir. Büyünün gücüyle sekizgenin disina firlarsin.

english: I hope that teaches you to respect your elders!
translation: Umarim bu sana büyüklerine saygi duymayi ögretir!

english: The spell fizzles and has no effect as it passes through the flames.
translation: Büyü alevlerin icinden gecerken etkisini yitirir ve hicbir etkisi olmaz.

english: You feel certain that your weapon would melt if you tried to attack through these magical flames.
translation: Bu büyülü alevlerin icinden saldirmaya calisirsan silahinin eriyip gideceginden eminsin.

english: You missed!
The vial smashes on Ungadulu, soaking him in sacred water.
translation: Sise Ungadulu'nun üzerine düser ve onu kutsal suyla islatir.

english: Vile serpent, thou wilt pay for that!
...What, what happened? Why am I all wet?
Please, just run...
The shaman seems to be fighting an inner battle.
translation: Saman icsel bir savas veriyor gibi görünüyor.

english: The shaman's expression changes entirely.
Welcome Vacu, to eternal...
Foolish Vacu... now thou shalt be my pawn...
translation: Aptal Vacu... artik benim piyonum olacaksin...

english: The thing that was the shaman begins to chant...
translation: Saman olan sey ilahi söylemeye baslar...

english: Iles Resti Yam Darkus Spiritus Possesi Yanai...
translation: Iles Resti Yam Darkus Spiritus Possesi Yanai...

english: You feel a strange power coming over you...
translation: Üzerine garip bir güc geldigini hissedersin...

english: You feel very weak..
The thing seems to get stronger!
translation: Bu sey gittikce gücleniyor gibi görünüyor!

english: Run, Bwana! Stay away from here!
Just in time, the shaman wrests back control.
translation: Tam zamaninda, saman kontrolü geri alir.

english: Thank you, Bwana! You have released me from the demon's grasp, but only for a short while! You must seek out the Book of Binding - it's hidden in these caves somewhere!.
translation: Tesekkürler, Bwana! Beni iblisin pencesinden kurtardin, ama sadece kisa bir süreligine! Baglama Kitabi'ni bulmalisin - bu magaralarin bir yerinde sakli!

english: There are many trials you must pass... but please, you're my only hope of escape!
translation: Gecmen gereken bircok sinav var... ama lütfen, kacisim icin tek umudumsun!

english: You open the Book of Binding in front of Ungadulu and a supernatural light emanates from the pages. Ungadulu's face twists and contorts in wild spasms.
translation: Ungadulu'nun önünde Baglama Kitabi'ni acarsin ve sayfalardan dogaüstü bir isik yayilir. Ungadulu'nun yüzü cilginca spazmlarla bükülür ve carpilir.

english: Curse you... foul intruder... wretched Vacu! Thy meddling ways hath brought thee to thy doom!
translation: Lanet olsun sana... igrenc davetsiz misafir... sefil Vacu! Kariskanligin seni felakete sürükledi!

english: Ungadulu drops to the floor, unconscious. From his prone body rises the shape of an enormous, angry demon...
translation: Ungadulu yere düser, baygin halde. Yere yatan bedeninden devasa, öfkeli bir iblisin sekli yükselir...

english: Nezikchened: Thy faith will help you little here.
translation: Nezikchened: Inancin burada sana pek yardimci olmayacak.

english: A sense of hopelessness fills your body...
The shaman somehow resists the power of the spell.
translation: Saman bir sekilde büyünün gücüne direnir.

english: What...what's happening...
Perhaps you should try again?
Ha ha ha ha! Die, Vacu!
translation: Ha ha ha ha! Öl, Vacu!

english: Ungadulu casts a spell!
At the next council meeting, I'm going to recommend that we change the guards' uniform to be red.
translation: Bir sonraki konsey toplantisinda, muhafizlarin üniformasini kirmiziya cevirmemizi önerecegim.

english: Why?
We have surface-dwellers coming down into our mines and our city now, and remember that they don't have very good eyesight.
translation: Artik yüzey sakinleri madenlerimize ve sehrimize iniyorlar ve onlarin görme yeteneklerinin cok iyi olmadigini unutma.

english: I worry that they can't see our guards very clearly in the dark. It is important for a guard to be seen.
translation: Karanlikta muhafizlarimizi net göremeyeceklerinden endiseleniyorum. Muhafizlarin görünür olmasi önemlidir.

english: You have a point. But I don't think red would be the best colour. It is the colour of blood, so it might give the wrong impression.
translation: Haklisin. Ama kirmizinin en iyi renk oldugunu sanmiyorum. Kan rengi oldugu icin yanlis bir izlenim verebilir.

english: What colour do you suggest, then?
I suggest green. I have heard that the plants that grow on the surface are mostly green, so surface-dwellers might find that colour soothing.
translation: Yesili öneriyorum. Yüzeyde yetisen bitkilerin cogunun yesil oldugunu duydum, bu yüzden yüzey sakinleri bu rengi rahatlatici bulabilir.

english: No, I disagree. Guards should not be soothing, they should be seen as formidable. Red will give the correct impression.
translation: Hayir, katilmiyorum. Muhafizlar yatistirici olmamali, korkutucu olarak görülmelidir. Kirmizi dogru izlenimi verecektir.

english: Oh, hello surface-dweller. We were just discussing some council business.
translation: Merhaba yüzey sakini. Konsey islerini tartisiyorduk.

english: Do you want me to pick an armour colour for you?
translation: Zirh rengini senin icin secmemi ister misin?

english: No, thank you. We don't let any one single goblin make decisions, and certainly not an outsider!
translation: Hayir, tesekkürler. Tek bir goblinin karar vermesine izin vermeyiz, hele ki bir yabancinin!

english: But we could do with an opinion. What colour do you think is best?
translation: Ama bir görüs alabiliriz. Sence en iyi renk hangisi?

english: Red.
Thank you, surface-dweller. That's what I'll be recommending in the next meeting.
translation: Tesekkürler, yüzey sakini. Bir sonraki toplantida bunu önerecegim.

english: Green.
Thank you, surface-dweller. That's what I'll be recommending in the next meeting.
translation: Tesekkürler, yüzey sakini. Bir sonraki toplantida bunu önerecegim.

english: I think the guards are fine as they are.
translation: Bence muhafizlar oldugu gibi gayet iyi.

english: Perhaps you're right. Not making any change would certainly be the easiest option!
translation: Belki de haklisin. Hicbir degisiklik yapmamak kesinlikle en kolay secenek olur!

english: I think I've been here before...
Oh? How so?
This is a lot like a conversation I had with some goblins on the surface.
translation: Bu, yüzeyde bazi goblinlerle yaptigim bir sohbete cok benziyor.

english: Really? Which armour colour did they pick?
translation: Gercekten mi? Hangi zirh rengini sectiler?

english: They ended up with the same armour colour that they started with!
translation: Sonunda basladiklari zirh rengiyle devam ettiler!

english: You know, I think that's probably what we'll end up doing.
translation: Biliyor musun, sanirim biz de sonunda öyle yapacagiz.

english: Do you want me to pick an armour colour for you?
translation: Senin icin bir zirh rengi secmemi ister misin?

english: Red
Green
I think the guards are fine as they are
translation: Bence muhafizlar oldugu gibi gayet iyi.

english: I think I've been here before...
Oh dear...
What's the matter?
I'm worried. I think the Council is neglecting a big issue. I tried to bring it up at the last meeting, but they didn't pay attention.
translation: Endiseliyim. Bence Konsey önemli bir konuyu ihmal ediyor. Son toplantida bu konuyu gündeme getirmeye calistim ama kimse ilgilenmedi.

english: What issue?
I'm very happy for you humans to come down to the city, but what about...them?
translation: Siz insanlarin sehre gelmesinden cok memnunum ama ya... onlar?

english: What about who?
Them! *whispers* The G-O-D-S.
The gods?
Don't say it! What if they hear?
Why are you scared of the gods?
Because they're so powerful, of course!
In the time of the great war, they forced all the goblin tribes to fight one another. Our ancestors weren't powerful enough to stand up to them.
translation: Büyük savas sirasinda, tüm goblin kabilelerini birbirleriyle savasmaya zorladilar. Atalarimiz onlara karsi koyacak kadar güclü degildi.

english: We've hidden down here for this long, but now the way to the surface is open, what if they find us again?
translation: Bu kadar uzun süre burada saklandik, ama simdi yüzeye cikan yol acildi, ya bizi tekrar bulurlarsa?

english: Goodbye.
Goodbye.
You don't need to worry!
I don't?
The God Wars are over! The gods don't intervene directly in the affairs of mortals any more.
translation: Tanri Savaslari bitti! Tanrilar artik ölümlülerin islerine dogrudan müdahale etmiyorlar.

english: Are you sure?
Yes!
I do hope you're right! I still can't help being worried, though.
translation: Umarim haklisindir! Yine de endiselenmeden edemiyorum.

english: Don't you want to worship the god of the goblins?
No! How could you even suggest that? We're not going to worship some supernatural being just because it's bigger and more powerful than us.
translation: Hayir! Nasil böyle bir sey söyleyebilirsin? Sirf bizden daha büyük ve güclü diye dogaüstü bir varliga tapinmayacagiz.

english: It may seem to you that we're cowardly, hiding here from the gods all this time, but I know that every Dorgeshuun would rather die than submit to the rule of any god.
translation: Sana, tanrilardan saklanarak korkakca davrandigimizi düsünebilirsin, ama ben her Dorgeshuun'un herhangi bir tanrinin egemenligine boyun egmektense ölmeyi tercih edecegini biliyorum.

english: Why are you scared of the gods?
You don't need to worry!
Don't you want to worship the god of the goblins?
Goodbye

I think the guards are fine as they are
translation: Bence muhafizlar oldugu gibi gayet iyi.

english: I think I've been here before...
translation: Sanirim daha önce de buraya gelmistim...

english: Headman Ur-tag, I cannot stress enough how important it is that this train link be completed on time. The mining companies have taken out considerable loans...
translation: Baskan Ur-tag, bu tren hattinin zamaninda tamamlanmasinin ne kadar önemli oldugunu yeterince vurgulayamiyorum. Maden sirketleri önemli miktarda kredi aldilar...

english: I understand your concerns, Ambassador, but you must realise that the discoveries must change the whole schedule. To remove them too hurriedly would be a crime against knowledge.
translation: Endiselerinizi anliyorum Büyükelci, ama kesiflerin tüm programi degistirecegini anlamalisiniz. Onlari aceleyle kaldirmak bilgiye karsi bir suc olur.

english: What are you talking about?
It's the new underground train link being built between our city and the dwarven city of Keldagrim.
translation: Sehrimiz ile cüce sehri Keldagrim arasinda insa edilen yeni yeralti tren hatti.

english: It will be the pinnacle of dwarven engineering! A great leap forward from the old steam-powered minecarts! A monument to the power and ingenuity of the Consortium!
translation: Bu, cüce mühendisliginin zirvesi olacak! Eski buharli maden arabalarindan büyük bir sicrama! Konsorsiyumun gücü ve yaraticiliginin bir aniti!

english: And it would be finished by now, except that they found some old goblin bones they want to dig up.
translation: Ve simdiye kadar tamamlanmis olacakti, ancak kazmak istedikleri bazi eski goblin kemikleri buldular.

english: We've unearthed some very important artefacts that were buried during the Dorgeshuun Civil War. They could shed important light on our history.
translation: Dorgeshuun Ic Savasi sirasinda gömülmüs cok önemli eserler ortaya cikardik. Bunlar tarihimize önemli bir isik tutabilir.

english: [player name], do you have any experience with archaeology?
translation: Maceraci, arkeoloji konusunda deneyimin var mi?

english: I passed my archaeology exam at the Digsite!
Excellent! We have not had a major archaeological project for generations, so if you could give us some help we would appreciate it.
translation: Harika! Nesillerdir büyük bir arkeoloji projemiz olmadi, bu yüzden bize yardim edersen cok seviniriz.

english: I'd love to help!
Splendid! The path to the train tunnel is in the south- west of the city.
translation: Harika! Tren tüneline giden yol sehrin güneybatisinda.

english: Perhaps now we can get this finished quickly and get on with laying the tracks.
translation: Belki simdi bunu cabucak bitirip raylari dösemeye devam edebiliriz.

english: Do your own digging!
Oh well. We will continue at our own pace.
What can I do in the city?
Why don't you visit the market? I hear there is quite a craze for surface foods at the moment, so you might be able to sell something there.
translation: Pazari ziyaret etsene. Su anda yüzey gidalarina büyük bir ilgi oldugunu duydum, belki orada bir seyler satabilirsin.

english: You might also want to visit the caves to the south of the city. There are many monsters to fight there, and Zanik apparently found ways to cross over their heads!
translation: Sehrin güneyindeki magaralari da ziyaret etmek isteyebilirsin. Orada savasacak bircok canavar var ve Zanik görünüse göre onlarin üstünden gecmenin bir yolunu bulmus!

english: Why did you decide to open the city?
For trade, and for fostering goodwill between races! I am sure that it will benefit both our races.
translation: Ticaret ve irklar arasi iyi niyetin gelistirilmesi icin! Bunun her iki irkimiza da fayda saglayacagindan eminim.

english: Greetings, surface-dweller. Welcome to Dorgesh-Kaan.
translation: Selamlar, yüzey sakini. Dorgesh-Kaan'a hos geldin.

english: What are you arguing about?
Yes.
No.
What can I do in the city?
Why did you decide to open the city?
Hello there; are you interested in any of my fine daggers? Ideal for slipping under desert robes to give your enemies a nasty surprise...
translation: Merhaba, güzel hancerlerimden herhangi biriyle ilgilenir misin? Cöl cüppelerinin altina gizlemek ve düsmanlarina kötü bir sürpriz yapmak icin ideal...

english: I'd rather help you in return for better prices.
translation: Daha iyi fiyatlar karsiliginda sana yardim etmeyi tercih ederim.

english: I think it will take months for me to return to normal business. If you can wait that long, however, I may have tasks for you.
translation: Normal islerime dönmem aylar sürer sanirim. Ancak o kadar bekleyebilirsen, sana verebilecegim görevler olabilir.

english: No thanks.
I'm looking for daggers, yes.
I'd rather help you in return for better prices.
translation: Daha iyi fiyatlar karsiliginda size yardim etmeyi tercih ederim.

english: No thanks.
A great captain is always ready to change course.
translation: Büyük bir kaptan her zaman rotasini degistirmeye hazirdir.

english: Actions have consequences.
Can I have your teabag?
Can you stand me?
Have you found the key to the secret room?
I am the egg man, are you one of the egg men?
translation: Ben yumurta adamiyim, sen de yumurta adamlarindan misin?

english: I believe that it is very rainy in Varrock.
I have a story about that.
I heard that the tall man fears only strong winds.
translation: Uzun boylu adamin sadece kuvvetli rüzgarlardan korktugunu duydum.

english: I quite fancy an onion.
In Canifis the men are known for eating much spam.
translation: Canifis'te erkekler cok fazla spam yedikleri ile bilinirler.

english: In the end, only the three-legged will survive.
translation: Sonunda, sadece üc ayaklilar hayatta kalacak.

english: It is possible to commit no mistakes and still lose.
Loser says what.
My magic carpet is full of eels.
Once, I was a poor man, but then I found a party hat.
translation: Bir zamanlar fakir bir adamdim, ama sonra bir parti sapkasi buldum.

english: Quickly! I've got a bee sticking out of my arm!
The slowest of fishermen catch the swiftest of fish.
translation: En yavas balikcilar en hizli baliklari yakalar.

english: *sneezes* What?
The sudden appearance of a deaf squirrel is most puzzling, comrade.
translation: Sagir bir sincabin aniden ortaya cikmasi cok sasirtici, yoldas.

english: There were three goblins in a bar, which one left first?
translation: Bir barda üc goblin vardi, hangisi ilk cikti?

english: Up in the north, I hear they keep milk in bags rather than buckets.
translation: Kuzeyde sütü kovadan ziyade torbalarda sakladiklarini duydum.

english: Want to see me bend a spoon?
What's cheese?
Would you like to buy a pewter spoon?
What?
You have been given a [new clue/casket]!
I do not believe we have any business, Comrade.
The puffins are up to something!
9 years my princess, forever my light.
Ahhhhhh, leeches!
The Ankou's are a lie.
(Breathing intensifies)
Brother, do you even lift?
Connection lost. Please wait - attempting to reestablish.
translation: Baglanti kesildi. Lütfen bekleyin - yeniden baglanmaya calisiyorum.

english: Do you want ants? Because that's how you get ants.
translation: Karinca ister misin? Cünkü karincalar böyle gelir.

english: Don't forget to find the jade monkey.
Fancy a holiday? I heard there was a whole other world to the west.
translation: Tatil yapmak ister misin? Batida bambaska bir dünya oldugunu duydum.

english: Guys, let's lake dive!
I don't like pineapple, it has that bone in it.
I gave you what you needed; not what you think you needed.
translation: Sana ihtiyacin olani verdim, ihtiyacin oldugunu sandigin seyi degil.

english: I once named a duck after a girl. Big mistake, they all hated it.
translation: Bir keresinde bir ördege bir kizin adini vermistim. Büyük hata, hepsi bundan nefret etti.

english: I told him not to go near that fence, and what did he do? Sheesh....
translation: Ona o citin yakinina yaklasmamasini söyledim, ama o ne yapti? Hayret...

english: I took a college course in bowling; still not any good.
translation: Üniversitede bowling dersi aldim, ama hala iyi degilim.

english: I'm going to get married, to the night.
I'm looking for a girl named Molly. I can't seem to find her. any assistance?
translation: Molly adinda bir kiz ariyorum. Onu bulamiyorum. Yardimci olabilir misiniz?

english: Init doe. Lyk, I hope yer reward iz goodd aye?
translation: Baslangicta. Umarim ödülün iyidir, tamam mi?

english: Is that Deziree?
It is quite easy being green.
Mate, mate... I'm the best.
Mother's parsnips tasted like onion.
translation: Annemin yaban havuclari sogan gibi tadi vardi.

english: Oranges are the fruit of the vegetable.
Some say...
There's this guy I sit next to. Makes weird faces and sounds. Kind of an odd fellow.
translation: Yanimda oturan bir adam var. Garip yüzler ve sesler cikariyor. Biraz tuhaf bir adam.

english: This is the last night you'll spend alone.
Tonight we dine................quite nicely actually.
translation: Bu gece yemek yiyecegiz... Aslinda oldukca güzel bir yemek.

english: Took a hair dryer to a party in my handbag. Ah, so fabulous!!
translation: Cantamda bir sac kurutma makinesi ile partiye gittim. Ah, ne kadar muhtesem!

english: The curse has been removed. Word around the town is that you were the one who helped remove it.
translation: Lanet kaldirildi. Kasabada, laneti kaldirmaya yardim edenin sen oldugu söyleniyor.

english: Yes that is correct. The spirits of the Elid cursed the town for throwing away a statue to Elidinis. I got it back
translation: Evet, dogru. Elid ruhlari, Elidinis heykelini attiklari icin kasabayi lanetlemisler. Ben onu geri getirdim.

english: Well we thank you. You're pretty much a local hero now.
translation: Sana tesekkür ederiz. Artik neredeyse bir yerel kahramansin.

english: All this mining is tiring work.
But you're not even mining at the moment.
translation: Ama su anda madencilik yapmiyorsun bile.

english: Hey! I've been mining all day thank you very much! I'm allowed a break ain't I?
translation: Hey! Bütün gün madencilik yaptim, cok tesekkürler! Mola verebilirim, degil mi?

english: Yes, I suppose.
I should think so. Anyway did you need anything?
translation: Öyle olmali. Neyse, bir seye ihtiyacin var mi?

english: What are these rocks?
Rocks? They're not rocks, they're minerals!
translation: Taslar mi? Onlar tas degil, mineraller!

english: Oh okay. What are they though?
translation: Tamam, peki. Ne olduklarini biliyor musun?

english: Amethyst! We use it a lot back in Keldagrim but this is the only place we've managed to find it.
translation: Ametist! Keldagrim'de cok kullaniyoruz ama bunu bulabildigimiz tek yer burasi.

english: What can I use it for?
We've found it's quite good for ranging ammunition, something you adventuring lot might like.
translation: Mühimmat menzilini ölcmek icin oldukca iyi oldugunu gördük, maceraperestler olarak hosunuza gidebilir.

english: We use it a lot for Construction back in Keldagrim as well.
translation: Keldagrim'de insaat islerinde de sik sik kullaniyoruz.

english: Awesome! Does that mean I can use it in my house?
translation: Harika! Yani bunu evimde de kullanabilir miyim?

english: No.
Why not?
Because I said so that's why! Even the best human builders wouldn't know how to build with this stuff.
translation: Cünkü ben öyle diyorum, o yüzden! En iyi insan insaatcilar bile bu malzemeyle nasil insaat yapilacagini bilmezler.

english: And you're a long way off the best, believe me.
translation: Ve sen en iyilerden cok uzaksin, inan bana.

english: Awww.
No thanks.
Well be on your way then. I've got mining to do!
translation: O zaman yoluna devam et. Madencilik yapmam lazim!

english: What are these rocks?
No thanks.
Hello, who are you?
Greetings human. I am Uurrak quo Narga, a guardian for the Kahlith. Have you come to serve the balance?
translation: Selamlar insan. Ben Uurrak quo Narga, Kahlith'in koruyucusuyum. Dengeyi saglamak icin mi geldin?

english: Yes.
Then you should speak to Konar quo Maten. She will guide you.
translation: O zaman Konar quo Maten ile konusmalisin. O sana yol gösterecektir.

english: No.
A shame. You are a bringer of death, you could be of great use to the balance.
translation: Yazik. Sen ölümün habercisiisin, denge icin cok yararli olabilirsin.

english: I'm not sure.
Then you should speak with Xorrah quo Sihar. He will show you the way.
translation: O zaman Xorrah quo Sihar ile konusmalisin. O sana yolu gösterecektir.

english: Yes.
No.
I'm not sure.
Good day, Uwogo.
Get away from me, you foul commoner!
Hello. Shouldn't you be on guard duty?
translation: Merhaba. Nöbet görevinde olman gerekmiyor mu?

english: In this state? I've had too many beer s'already, beside' s'I'm off duty.
translation: Bu halde mi? Cok fazla bira ictim, ayrica görevim bitti.

english: The commander 's'given me the day off.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: Insanlari selamlamanin pek cok farkli yolu var. Merhaba, selam, selam...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: Merhaba! Kristal sehirde ne güzel bir gün, degil mi?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: Her türlü sey! Kuleler görülmeye deger harika bir manzara.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: Bugün gibi bir günde pazari ziyaret etmeni tavsiye ederim.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Hello there. Want to have a look at what we're selling today?
translation: Merhaba. Bugün sattigimiz ürünlere bakmak ister misin?

english: No thank you.
Yes please.
No thank you.
Hello there. What are you doing here?
I'm waiting here hoping that someone can guide me to the Paterdomus, the temple on the Salve.
translation: Salve'deki Paterdomus tapinagina giden yolu bilen biri cikarsa diye burada bekliyorum.

english: Where is Paterdomus?
Oh, Paterdomus is that rather impressive looking temple on the Salve... I'm sure you must have passed it on your way into Morytania.
translation: Paterdomus, Salve'deki oldukca etkileyici görünümlü tapinaktir... Morytania'ya giderken oradan gecmis olmalisin.

english: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
I'm hoping to get back to civilisation and see what the lands of Misthalin look like.
translation: Medeniyete geri dönüp Misthalin topraklarinin nasil bir yer oldugunu görmek istiyorum.

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Paterdomus?
translation: Paterdomus'a giderken yol üzerinde düsmanlarla karsilasirsak kendini savunabilir misin?

english: I can defend myself somewhat if we run into trouble...yes, but let's hope that we don't, eh!
translation: Basimiz belaya girerse kendimi bir sekilde savunabilirim... evet, ama umalim da basimiza bela gelmesin, degil mi?

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: Hmmm, görünüse göre bir takipcin var. Bu yolculukta kendi basina dolasirsa kaybolabilir. Takipcin güvende oldugunda yola cikalim.

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: Gercekten mi? Bu harika olur! Hedefe vardigimizda sana kücük bir ödül verecegim.

english: Temple Trekking begins
Ok, which route should we take?
Ok, thanks.
Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: Ah, bana biraz erzak vermek istiyorsun, ha? Sirt cantami acayim.

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than staying in Burgh de Rott.
translation: Oh, bu yolculuktan nefret ediyorum, ama Burgh de Rott'ta kalmaktan iyidir.

english: It's scary here...let's get going!
When are we going to get to Paterdomus?
We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on.
translation: Bütün gün burada durup sohbet edemeyiz, hadi devam edelim.

english: Do you visit Paterdomus often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: Paterdomus'a sik sik gider misin? Rotayi iyi biliyorsun gibi görünüyor.

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...?
Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Burgh de Rott. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: Hay aksi! Burgh de Rott'a geri dönmek zorunda kalacagiz galiba. O köprüden gecemeyiz!

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
Player completes the bridge event
Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Burgh de Rott.
translation: Bu is bitti... Bu batakliktan gecemeyecegiz galiba. Burgh de Rott'a geri dönmek zorunda kalacagiz.

english: Player completes the bog event
Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: Hey... bu harika... harika bir is cikardin... Seni takip edecegim.

english: Whahay...that was great!
But we really should be heading off now.
Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
Player completes the river event
That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: Bu harika! Ben de aynisini yapmaliyim.

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: Whahay! Bu harikaydi! Ama artik gercekten yola cikmaliyiz.

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
This is scary!
Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
Ahhh, two tentacles!
...three tentacles!
I think I'm going to faint!
Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: Vay canina! Su canavara bak! O seyi kendi basina halletmen gerekecek!

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the temple. Here's your reward.
translation: Beni tapinaga güvenle ulastirdigin icin cok tesekkürler. Iste ödülün.

english: Valantay Eppel gives you a reward token!
translation: Valantay Eppel sana bir ödül jetonu veriyor!

english: Where is Paterdomus?
Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
I can take you to Paterdomus.
Ok, thanks.
Hello there.
Wooo?  Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!
translation: Wooo?  Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!

english: You don't say?
Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!
translation: Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!

english: You don't say!
Wooowoowoooooo.... Woowoowoo? Woooo, wooowoo wooowooowooo!
Well, I guess you didn't say.
Yeah, I don't want to brag, but seriously: I am SOOOO rich....
translation: Evet, övünmek istemem ama cidden: Ben COK zenginim....

english: Yeah, I know they say money doesn't bring you happiness, but sometimes I just like to open my bank account and look at all of the stuff I own and just think to myself:
translation: Evet, paranin mutluluk getirmedigini söylerler, ama bazen banka hesabimi acip sahip oldugum her seye bakip kendi kendime söyle düsünüyorum:

english: Wow. I am soooooo rich.
Well, us rich alive people don't want to waste all day spending time with you poor dead people, because I'm just sooooo rich I have to go now, and very possibly make myself even richer.
translation: Biz zengin yasayan insanlar, tüm günümüzü siz fakir ölülerle gecirmek istemiyoruz, cünkü ben cok zenginim ve simdi gitmeliyim, muhtemelen kendimi daha da zenginlestirmeliyim.

english: See ya around ghosty!
Yeah, I heard about that, ha-ha-ha!
With a MACKEREL? Ouch!
Well, it was fun. Let's do it again sometime.
translation: Evet, eglenceliydi. Bir ara tekrar yapalim.

english: Why, thank you very much!
I know, but what are you going to do?
Well, I guess that's always true in the long run. See you around, weird invisible dead person!
translation: Evet, uzun vadede bu her zaman dogrudur. Görüsürüz, garip görünmez ölü insan!

english: Yeah it's not bad, but I prefer cooked chicken.
translation: Evet, fena degil, ama ben pismis tavugu tercih ederim.

english: Maybe, but nothing beats a home cooked pie!
translation: Belki, ama ev yapimi turta gibisi yoktur!

english: Man, I love pie!
You don't say? I never knew that. Well, I must be going, see you around.
translation: Öyle mi? Bunu bilmiyordum. Peki, gitmem gerek, görüsürüz.

english: We get signal!
Somebody set up us the bomb!
You have no chance to survive make your time.
translation: Hayatta kalma sansin yok, zamanini iyi degerlendir.

english: Woo?
All your base are belong to us.
Hey, don't think you can talk to me like that!
Are you threatening me?
Just because you're already dead, doesn't mean I can't find a way to hurt you ghosty!
translation: Senin zaten ölmüs olman, sana zarar verecek bir yol bulamayacagim anlamina gelmez hayalet!

english: No, I've never been there in my life and CERTAINLY didn't steal anything when I was!
translation: Hayir, hayatimda oraya hic gitmedim ve oradayken KESINLIKLE hicbir sey calmadim!

english: Are you calling me a liar?!?! I have never stolen a thing in my life, and I resent the implication that I am the kind of morally depraved individual that would steal someone else's hard earned
translation: Bana yalanci mi diyorsun?!?! Hayatimda hicbir sey calmadim ve baskalarinin zor kazandiklari parayi

english: money from their very pockets!
translation: ceplerinden calacak kadar ahlaksiz bir insan oldugumu ima etmene cok kizdim!

english: Or cakes. Or fur. Repeatedly. For long periods at a time.
translation: Ya da kekleri. Ya da kürkleri. Tekrar tekrar. Uzun süreler boyunca.

english: Well if you are going to take that attitude, then I have nothing further to say on the matter, and bid you good day!
translation: Eger bu tavri takinacaksan, bu konuda söyleyecek baska bir seyim yok, iyi günler!

english: Hello.
H-hello!
So what's up?
I cannot believe it! You can see me? You understand my words?
translation: Inanamiyorum! Beni görebiliyor musun? Sözlerimi anliyor musun?

english: Sure can. So why are you hanging around here?
My tale is one of woe... No doubt you will have little interest in hearing it...
translation: Benim hikayem bir felaket hikayesi... Hic süphesiz onu dinlemekle pek ilgilenmeyeceksin...

english: Though it has been so many moons since last I had company in this endless non-life...
translation: Son kez bir arkadasim oldugundan bu yana cok uzun zaman gecti, bu sonsuz ölümsüzlükte...

english: Well, actually I would like to know what happened to you to turn you into an invisible ghost.
translation: Aslinda, seni görünmez bir hayalete dönüstüren seyin ne oldugunu bilmek isterim.

english: If only so I can make sure it doesn't happen to me...
translation: Böylece ayni seyin bana da olmamasi icin önlem alabilirim...

english: My name is Valdez. I served my Lord Saradomin faithfully for many years, as an explorer of this strange land we had been brought to.
translation: Adim Valdez. Uzun yillar boyunca, getirildigimiz bu garip topraklarda kasif olarak Lord Saradomin'e sadakatle hizmet ettim.

english: I remember the day this curse fell upon me clearly... I had just discovered a huge temple, hidden below the ground, of one of Saradomin's compatriots.
translation: Bu lanetin üzerime düstügü günü cok net hatirliyorum... Saradomin'in yoldaslarindan birinin yeraltinda gizlenmis devasa bir tapinagini kesfetmistim.

english: I am unsure who had built it, or why they had left it seemingly abandoned, but inside I located a great treasure...
translation: Kim insa etti, neden terk edilmis gibi biraktilar bilmiyorum, ama icinde büyük bir hazine buldum...

english: It was the godstaff of Armadyl. Oh, how I rue my choice that day!
translation: Armadyl'in tanri asasiydi. O gün yaptigim secimden ne kadar pismanim!

english: Choice?
Aye, stranger. I chose that day to take it so that my Lord Saradomin's power and prestige could be increased by its possession.
translation: Evet, yabanci. O günü sectim ki, Lord Saradomin'in gücü ve prestiji onunla artabilsin.

english: A god-weapon! Do you have any comprehension of the difficulty and rarity in obtaining such a thing?
translation: Bir tanri silahi! Böyle bir seyi elde etmenin ne kadar zor ve nadir oldugunu biliyor musun?

english: To find such an artefact of power just lying around, it is almost incomprehensible...
translation: Böyle güclü bir eserin ortalikta durdugunu bulmak, neredeyse anlasilmaz bir sey...

english: So it was there in that deserted temple that I made my choice. I took the staff, and left that temple for Entrana immediately.
translation: Iste o terk edilmis tapinakta kararimi verdim. Asayi aldim ve hemen Entrana'ya dogru yola ciktim.

english: This was the cause of my cursed state.
What, you mean you gave it to Saradomin and in return he cursed you???
translation: Ne, yani onu Saradomin'e verdin ve karsiliginda o da seni lanetledi mi?

english: Seems kind of ungrateful if you ask me...
translation: Bana sorarsan bu biraz nankörlük gibi...

english: No stranger, you misunderstand completely... Firstly my gracious Lord would never treat anyone in such a manner; If he felt it was beyond my bounds as a mere mortal
translation: Yabanci degil, tamamen yanlis anliyorsunuz... Öncelikle, merhametli Lordum kimseye böyle davranmaz; eger böyle bir eseri elinde tutmanin benim gibi bir ölümlü icin sinirlari astigini düsünseydi,

english: to hold such an artefact, he would simply have commanded me to return it to whence I had claimed it, and I being eternally loyal would have obeyed without question...
translation: onu aldigim yere geri götürmemi emrederdi ve ben de sonsuza kadar sadik olarak sorgusuz sualsiz itaat ederdim...

english: And secondly?
And secondly, I never managed to pass the artefact on to my Lord...
translation: Ve ikincisi, o eseri Lorduma teslim edemedim...

english: The vile thief Rennard accosted me as I made my way to Entrana, and after defeating me with a sneak attack, plundered the staff from my person, and left me for dead...
translation: Entrana'ya giderken asagilik hirsiz Rennard bana saldirdi ve gizli bir saldiriyla beni yenilgiye ugrattiktan sonra, asami benden caldi ve beni ölüme terk etti...

english: I do not know what became of the staff, but I can feel in my very bones that whatever its final fate was, it is somehow related to this curse upon me...
translation: Asanin ne oldugunu bilmiyorum, ama icimden bir ses, onun sonunun ne olursa olsun, benim üzerimdeki lanetle bir sekilde ilgili oldugunu söylüyor...

english: Wow. Tough break.
I am sorry to bore you with my tale stranger, please allow me to compound my rudeness by asking you for one favour, small to perform?
translation: Sizi hikayemle sikmis oldugum icin özür dilerim yabanci, lütfen kabaligimi bir de size kücük bir ricada bulunarak telafi etmeme izin verin.

english: Eh, I won't make any promises, but if it's nothing too annoying I guess I can help you out.
translation: Eh, söz veremem ama cok can sikici bir sey degilse sana yardim edebilirim.

english: Many thanks stranger, this existence tortures me...
translation: Cok tesekkürler yabanci, bu varlik bana iskence ediyor...

english: I need you to find Rennard and if he has the staff yet reclaim it, or find out what hideous deed he performed to curse me so!
translation: Rennard'i bulmani ve asayi hala elindeyse geri almani ya da bana bu laneti getiren korkunc eylemini ögrenmeni istiyorum!

english: I have nothing I may offer you save this piece of clothing, please take it as payment...
translation: Sana sunabilecegim tek sey bu giysi, lütfen ödeme olarak kabul et...

english: Where can I find this Rennard then?
Ah, the infamous Rennard... The last I had heard of that vile thief, he had joined a group of bandits in an evil land to the North-east of here, where they had made their home living outside of
translation: Ah, kötü söhretli Rennard... Bu alcak hirsiz hakkinda son duydugumda, buradan kuzeydogudaki kötü bir ülkede bir haydut grubuna katilmisti. Orada, onlari takip eden yetkililerin ulasamayacagi bir yerde

english: the reach of the authorities that pursued them...
Okay, well I'll try and find him for you then.
translation: Tamam, o zaman onu senin icin bulmaya calisacagim.

english: Ah, the infamous Rennard... The last I had heard of him, he had sought passage on a ship crewed by none but the most dastardly lowly pirates...
translation: Ah, kötü söhretli Rennard... Onun hakkinda son duydugumda, en alcakca korsanlarin mürettebatinda bir gemiye binmeye calisiyordu...

english: I also heard that this ship had been caught in a violent storm, and stranded upon rocks, where the pirates then made their home...
translation: Ayrica bu geminin siddetli bir firtinaya yakalandigini ve kayaliklara carparak karaya oturdugunu, korsanlarin da orada yerlesip yasamaya basladigini duydum...

english: Ah, the infamous Rennard... The last I had heard of that vile thief, he had joined a group of bandits in a barren land to the South-east of here, where they prey upon the unsuspecting visitors to
translation: Ah, kötü söhretli Rennard... O alcak hirsiz hakkinda son duydugumda, buradan güneydogudaki corak bir arazide bir haydut grubuna katilmisti. Orada, karanlik efendilerinin dönüsünü bekleyen cölde, masum ziyaretcileri avliyorlardi...

english: the desert awaiting the return of their dark master...
Well, that's all fascinating, but I just don't particularly care. Bye-bye.
translation: Tüm bunlar cok ilginc, ama beni pek ilgilendirmiyor. Hosca kal.

english: Thank you for hearing my tale... It has been so lonely here...
translation: Hikayemi dinlediginiz icin tesekkürler... Burasi cok yalniz bir yer...

english: Can you remind me where to find the thief Rennard who caused this curse to befall you again?
translation: Bu lanetin üzerine cökmesine neden olan hirsiz Rennard'i nerede bulabilecegimi tekrar hatirlatir misiniz?

english: Of course...
Could I have more of those ghostly robes you gave me?
translation: Bana verdiginiz hayalet gibi cüppelerden biraz daha alabilir miyim?

english: It seems as though the curse that keeps me here extends to my very clothing... how many robe tops do you want?
translation: Beni burada tutan lanet giysilerime de bulasmis gibi görünüyor... Kac tane cüppe üstü istiyorsunuz?

english: Here you go.
Tell me your story
Goodbye then
Chat about the curse.
Ask for more ghostly robes.
Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: Hey, bu Kahraman! Vay canina! Sen harikasin, o iki juvinate ve Gadderank'i nasil alt ettin? Ve kasaba cok güzel, harika bir is cikarmissin!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
Well met! My name's Valeria, I do a bit of this, a bit of that. Just try to survive really, there's nothing much else we can do.
translation: Merhaba! Benim adim Valeria, biraz sundan, biraz bundan yapiyorum. Aslinda sadece hayatta kalmaya calisiyoruz, baska yapabilecegimiz pek bir sey yok.

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: Oh, pek bir sey yok, hepimiz hala vampirlerden saklaniyoruz ve bu korkunc yerden gecimimizi sagliyoruz, umarim yakinda Salve'deki tapinaga yolculuk yapacak kadar gücleniriz.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: Bildigim kadariyla yok, su anda cok yararli olan bazi temel olanaklara sahibiz, hepimiz sana inanilmaz derecede minnettariz. Daha önce hic bir kahraman görmedim veya tanimadim, bu yüzden karsilastiracak bir seyim yok, ama sanirim

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: cogu insanin görüsüne göre, sen bir kahramansin! Ben sahsen seninle tanistigima cok memnunum.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Ok, thanks.
Hello.
Good day.
Good day, Your Royal Highness.
Oi!
Rahr!
No!
Grr!
Aargh!
I'm a gonner!
It's no use, I'm done for!
Uggh!
What's your problem, food sack? Better move on before I perforate you real good!
translation: Sorunun ne, yemek cuvali? Seni delik desik etmeden önce yoluna devam etsen iyi olur!

english: Leave me alone. I'm busy.
You're not meant to be here human! Time to die!
translation: Senin burada olmaman gerek, insan! Ölme zamanin geldi!

english: What are you doing?
Minding my own business. You should do the same.
translation: Kendi isime bakiyorum. Sen de aynisini yapmalisin.

english: Yes?
Did you want something?
Nope.
Then why don't you get lost?
What do you want?
Nothing.
Go away then.
Hey there.
I'm not interested in making small talk.
Suit yourself.
Graahhhhhhh!
Rarrrghhhh!
Thanks so much for saving me from being a vampyre. Here, take this certificate, I'm sorry but it's all I can offer as a reward.
translation: Beni vampir olmaktan kurtardigin icin cok tesekkürler. Al, bu sertifikayi al, üzgünüm ama ödül olarak sunabilecegim tek sey bu.

english: Ha, ha, ha, time to disappear and rejuvenate!
translation: Ha, ha, ha, ortadan kaybolup genclesmenin zamani geldi!

english: What's through here?
Ver Sinhaza, home to the Theatre of Blood.
Can I go in?
Yes. Now leave me alone.
Can I go through here?
Yes. Now get lost.
What's your problem, food sack? Better move on before I perforate you real good!
translation: Sorunun ne, yemek cuvali? Seni delik desik etmeden önce yoluna devam etsen iyi olur!

english: Leave me alone. I'm busy.
Hey! How do I get out of here?
When you've filled the mine cart, we'll think about it.
But I've filled the mine cart.
Okay, I guess you can go then, food sack!
translation: Tamam, o zaman gidebilirsin, yemek cuvali!

english: The player is teleported to the mine entrance, in the northwestern part of Meiyerditch
translation: Oyuncu, Meiyerditch'in kuzeybati kesimindeki maden girisine isinlanir.

english: I can show you the way out. Follow me.
translation: Sana cikis yolunu gösterebilirim. Beni takip et.

english: The player is lead out to the mine entrance, in the northwestern part of Meiyerditch
translation: Oyuncu, Meiyerditch'in kuzeybati kesimindeki maden girisine götürülür.

english: Hello. How can I help you?
Can you give me any Farming advice?
translation: Bana tarimla ilgili tavsiyelerde bulunabilir misin?

english: Yes - ask a gardener.
I'm okay, thank you.
What are you selling?
Can you give me any Farming advice?
translation: Bana tarimla ilgili tavsiyelerde bulunabilir misin?

english: Hello. What's happening in town at the moment?
translation: Merhaba. Su anda kasabada neler oluyor?

english: These dwarves have arrived from Keldagrim - the Chancellor has asked me to look after them, but they are eating all of our food and drinking all of our booze.
translation: Bu cüceler Keldagrim'den geldiler. Sansölye bana onlara göz kulak olmami söyledi, ama tüm yiyeceklerimizi yiyorlar ve tüm ickilerimizi iciyorlar.

english: What are the dwarves doing here?
They are organising some sort of trade agreement. I don't know what they are trading.
translation: Bir tür ticaret anlasmasi yapiyorlar. Ne ticareti yaptiklarini bilmiyorum.

english: Thanks.
Hello, Vanligga!
Oh, hello [Fremennik name]. Always good to see a friend.
translation: Merhaba Dokrak. Bir dostu görmek her zaman güzel.

english: Hmmm, I suppose I can trust you, since you have done me a favour in the past. Can you keep a secret?
translation: Hmmm, gecmiste bana bir iyilik yaptigin icin sana güvenebilirim sanirim. Sir tutabilir misin?

english: Of course.
Well as you probably already know, all yak meat and yak products are banned on this island - orders of the King...
translation: Muhtemelen zaten biliyorsundur, bu adada tüm yak eti ve yak ürünleri yasaklanmistir - Kralin emriyle...

english: That King has some very strange attitudes.
translation: O Kralin cok garip tavirlari var.

english: Well, I have a contact on the other island. Are you interested in obtaining some produce?
translation: Diger adada bir baglantim var. Bazi ürünler almak ister misin?

english: No, thanks.
Well, any time you need black market yak produce, you know where to come.
translation: Siyah pazarda yak ürününe ihtiyacin olursa, nereye gelecegini biliyorsun.

english: Wanna buy some yak?
Yes, please.
No, thanks.
Need some farming supplies?
What is this place?
It's a farming supply stall. Hosidius is farming country, so it's a big business. Do you need anything now?
translation: Tarim malzemeleri satilan bir tezgah. Hosidius tarim ülkesi, bu yüzden bu büyük bir is. Su anda bir seye ihtiyacin var mi?

english: What have you got?
No, I'm fine.
What is this place?
What have you got?
No, I'm fine.
'Ello, and what are you after then?
I need another assignment.
Excellent, you're doing great. Your new task is to kill [amount] [task monster].
Got any tips for me?
translation: Bana verebilecegin bir ipucu var mi?

english: Great, thanks!
Okay, great!
Good luck! Don't forget to come back when you need a new assignment.
translation: Iyi sanslar! Yeni bir görev istediginde geri gelmeyi unutma.

english: You're still hunting [task monster]; you have [amount] to go. Come back when you've finished your task.
You're still hunting [monster], with [amount] to go.
I don't think that's a suitable task for you. Shall I cancel it? This will not wipe your task streaks.
translation: Bence bu senin icin uygun bir görev degil. Iptal edeyim mi? Bu, görev serini silmez.

english: Yes, please cancel it.
Alright, consider the task cancelled. You can now get a new assignment when you want one.
translation: Tamam, görev iptal edildi. Istedigin zaman yeni bir görev alabilirsin.

english: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
translation: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.

english: Good luck with that.
Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?

english: I have quite a few rewards you can earn, and a wide variety of Slayer equipment for sale.
translation: I have quite a few rewards you can earn, and a wide variety of Slayer equipment for sale.

english: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
translation: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.

english: The Slayer Masters may currently assign you any task in our lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: The Slayer Masters may currently assign you any task in our lists, regardless of your combat level.

english: That's fine - I can handle any task.
translation: That's fine - I can handle any task.

english: That's the spirit.
In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: In future, please don't give anything too tough.

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.

english: The Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: The Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
translation: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.

english: Okay, we'll keep checking your combat level.
translation: Okay, we'll keep checking your combat level.

english: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will assign you anything from their lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will assign you anything from their lists, regardless of your combat level.

english: Er... Nothing...
'Ello, can I help you?
Hello?
'Ello, who's that?
I'm [player name]. I'm using my magic to communicate with you.
translation: I'm [player name]. I'm using my magic to communicate with you.

english: Bizarre, go on, what do you want then?
translation: Bizarre, go on, what do you want then?

english: Hi! My name's [player name].
Do I look like I care? To me you're just another newcomer who thinks they're ready to fight.
translation: Do I look like I care? To me you're just another newcomer who thinks they're ready to fight.

english: I am Vannaka, the greatest swordsman alive, and I'm here to teach you the basics of combat. Let's get started by teaching you to wield a weapon.
translation: I am Vannaka, the greatest swordsman alive, and I'm here to teach you the basics of combat. Let's get started by teaching you to wield a weapon.

english: Let's get started by teaching you to wield a weapon.
translation: Let's get started by teaching you to wield a weapon.

english: Very good, but that little butter knife isn't going to protect you much. Let's get you something a bit better. Once you're properly equipped we can move on to some actual combat.
translation: Very good, but that little butter knife isn't going to protect you much. Let's get you something a bit better. Once you're properly equipped we can move on to some actual combat.

english: Let's get you equipped.
You should check out the combat interface.
translation: You should check out the combat interface.

english: Time for some actual combat! Head into the pen and kill one of those rats.
translation: Time for some actual combat! Head into the pen and kill one of those rats.

english: I did it! I killed a giant rat!
translation: I did it! I killed a giant rat!

english: I saw. You seem better at this than I thought. Now that you have grasped basic swordplay, let's move on.
translation: Gördüm. Bu konuda düsündügümden daha iyi görünüyorsun. Artik temel kilic kullanimi ögrendigine göre, devam edelim.

english: Next up we have ranged attacking. With this you can kill foes from a distance. With ranged, you'll be able to attack the rats without entering the pit meaning they won't be able to fight back.
translation: Sirada menzilli saldiri var. Bununla düsmanlari uzaktan öldürebilirsin. Menzilli saldiri ile cukura girmeden fareleri öldürebilirsin, böylece onlar da karsilik veremezler.
