english: Use your bow and arrows to kill one of those rats from outside the pen.
translation: Yay ve oklarini kullanarak kafesin disindan farelerden birini öldür.

english: Do you need something?
Tell me about combat stats again.
Certainly. You have three main combat stats: Strength, Defence and Attack.
translation: Elbette. Üc ana savas istatistigin var: Güc, Savunma ve Saldiri.

english: Strength determines the maximum hit you will be able to deal with your blows, Defence determines the amount of damage you will be able to defend and Attack determines the accuracy of your blows.
translation: Güc, vuruslarinla verebilecegin maksimum hasari belirler, Savunma savunabilecegin hasar miktarini belirler ve Saldiri vuruslarinin isabetini belirler.

english: Other stats are used in combat such as Prayer, Hitpoints, Magic and Ranged. All of these stats can go towards determining your combat level, which is shown near the top of your combat interface screen.
translation: Savasta Dua, Can Puani, Büyü ve Menzil gibi diger istatistikler de kullanilir. Tüm bu istatistikler, savas arayüzü ekraninin üst kisminda gösterilen savas seviyenizi belirlemede kullanilir.

english: You will find out on the mainland that certain items can also affect your stats. There are potions that can be drunk that can alter your stats temporarily, such as raising Strength.
translation: Anakarada, belirli ögelerin de istatistiklerinizi etkileyebilecegini göreceksiniz. Icildiginde istatistiklerinizi gecici olarak degistirebilen, örnegin Gücü artiran iksirler vardir.

english: You will also raise your Defence and Attack values by using different weapons and armours.
translation: Farkli silahlar ve zirhlar kullanarak Savunma ve Saldiri degerlerinizi de artirabilirsiniz.

english: Before going into combat with an opponent it is wise to put the mouse over them and see what combat level they are.
translation: Bir rakiple savasa girmeden önce, fareyi rakibin üzerine getirip savas seviyesini görmek akillica olacaktir.

english: Green coloured writing usually means it will be an easy fight for you, red means you will probably lose, yellow means they are around your level and orange means they are slightly stronger.
translation: Yesil renkli yazi genellikle sizin icin kolay bir savas olacagi anlamina gelir, kirmizi muhtemelen kaybedeceginiz anlamina gelir, sari sizin seviyenizde olduklari anlamina gelir ve turuncu ise biraz daha güclü olduklari anlamina gelir.

english: Sometimes things will go your way, sometimes they won't. There is no such thing as a guaranteed win, but if the odds are on your side, you stand the best chance of walking away victorious.
translation: Bazen isler istediginiz gibi gider, bazen gitmez. Garantili zafer diye bir sey yoktur, ancak sans sizin tarafinizda ise, zaferle ayrilma sansiniz en yüksektir.

english: Now, was there something else you wanted to hear about again?
translation: Simdi, tekrar duymak istediginiz baska bir sey var mi?

english: Tell me about melee combat again.
Ah, my speciality. Close combat fighting, which is also known as melee fighting, covers all combat done at close range to your opponent.
translation: Ah, benim uzmanlik alanim. Yakin dövüs, ayni zamanda melee dövüs olarak da bilinir ve rakibinize yakin mesafeden yapilan tüm dövüsleri kapsar.

english: Melee fighting depends entirely upon your three basic combat stats: Attack, Defence, and Strength.
translation: Yakin dövüs tamamen üc temel dövüs istatistiginize baglidir: Saldiri, Savunma ve Güc.

english: Also, of course, it depends on the quality of your armour and weaponry. A high-levelled fighter with good armour and weapons will be deadly up close.
translation: Tabii ki, zirhinizin ve silahlarinizin kalitesine de baglidir. Iyi zirh ve silahlara sahip yüksek seviyeli bir dövüscü, yakin mesafede ölümcül olacaktir.

english: If this is the path you wish to take, remember your success depends on getting as close to your enemy as quickly as possible.
translation: Eger bu yolu secmek istiyorsan, basarinin mümkün oldugunca cabuk düsmanina yaklasmana bagli oldugunu unutma.

english: Personally, I consider the fine art of melee combat to be the ONLY combat method worth using.
translation: Sahsen, yakin dövüs sanatini kullanmaya deger TEK savas yöntemi olarak görüyorum.

english: Now, did you want to hear anything else?
translation: Baska bir sey duymak ister misin?

english: Tell me about ranged combat again.
translation: Uzaktan savas hakkinda tekrar anlat bana.

english: Thinking of being a ranger, eh? Well, okay. I don't enjoy it myself, but I can see the appeal.
translation: Ranger olmak mi istiyorsun? Peki, tamam. Ben pek sevmem ama cazibesini anlayabiliyorum.

english: Ranging employs a lot of different weapons as a skill, not just the shortbow you have there. Spears, throwing knives, and crossbows are all used best at a distance from your enemy.
translation: Menzilli savas, sadece elindeki kisa yay degil, bircok farkli silahi beceri olarak kullanir. Mizraklar, firlatma bicaklari ve tatar yaylari, düsmanindan uzakta en iyi sekilde kullanilir.

english: Now, those rats were easy pickings, but on the mainland you will be very lucky if you can find a spot where you can shoot at your enemies without them being able to retaliate.
translation: Simdi, o sicanlar kolay avlardi, ama anakarada düsmanlarina karsilik vermeden ates edebilecegin bir yer bulabilirsen cok sanslisin demektir.

english: At close range, rangers often do badly in combat. Your best tactic as a ranger is to hit and run, keeping your foe at a distance.
translation: Yakin mesafede, okcular genellikle savasta basarisiz olurlar. Okcu olarak en iyi taktigin, düsmanini uzakta tutarak vur ve kac taktigidir.

english: Your effectiveness as a ranger is almost entirely dependent on your Ranged stat. As with all skills, the more you train it, the more powerful it will become.
translation: Okcu olarak etkinligin neredeyse tamamen Menzil istatistigine baglidir. Tüm becerilerde oldugu gibi, ne kadar cok antrenman yaparsan, o kadar güclü olursun.

english: Anything else you wanted to know?
translation: Baska bilmek istedigin bir sey var mi?

english: Tell me about the Wilderness again.
Ah yes, the Wilderness. It is a place of evil, mark my words. Many is the colleague I have lost in that foul place.
translation: Ah evet, Wilderness. Orasi kötü bir yer, sözlerimi unutma. O igrenc yerde bircok meslektasimi kaybettim.

english: It is also a place of both adventure and wealth, so if you are brave enough and strong enough to survive it, you will make a killing. Literally!
translation: Ayni zamanda macera ve zenginlik dolu bir yer, yani hayatta kalacak kadar cesur ve güclüysen, büyük para kazanabilirsin. Kelimenin tam anlamiyla!

english: It is also the only place in the land of Gielinor where players are able to attack each other at will, and as such is the haunt of many Player Killers, or PKers if you will.
translation: Ayrica Gielinor topraklarinda oyuncularin birbirlerine istedikleri gibi saldirabildikleri tek yer burasidir ve bu nedenle bircok Oyuncu Katili'nin, ya da PK'larin ugrak yeridir.

english: There are a few things different in the Wilderness in comparison to the rest of the lands of Gielinor. Firstly, as I just mentioned, you can and will be attacked by other players.
translation: Wilderness, Gielinor'un diger topraklarina kiyasla birkac farkli özellige sahiptir. Ilk olarak, az önce de bahsettigim gibi, diger oyuncular tarafindan saldiriya ugrayabilirsiniz ve ugrayacaksiniz.

english: For this reason, you will be given a warning when you approach the Wilderness, as it is not a place you would wish to enter by accident.
translation: Bu nedenle, Wilderness'a yaklastiginizda bir uyari alirsiniz, cünkü burasi kazara girmek isteyeceginiz bir yer degildir.

english: Secondly, there are a number of 'levels' to it. The further into it you travel, the greater the range of people you can attack.
translation: Ikincisi, burada bir dizi “seviye” vardir. Iceriye dogru ilerledikce, saldirabileceginiz kisilerin sayisi artar.

english: In level 1 wilderness you will only be able to attack, or be attacked by, those players within one combat level of yourself.
translation: Seviye 1 Wilderness'ta, yalnizca kendi savas seviyenizle ayni seviyedeki oyunculara saldirabilir veya onlar tarafindan saldiriya ugrayabilirsiniz.

english: In level 50, any player within fifty levels of you will be able to attack, or be attacked by you. Always keep an eye on what level of the Wilderness you are currently in.
translation: Seviye 50'de, sizin seviyenizden elli seviye icindeki herhangi bir oyuncu size saldirabilir veya sizin saldiriniza maruz kalabilir. Her zaman su anda hangi Wilderness seviyesinde oldugunuzu göz önünde bulundurun.

english: Your current Wilderness level is shown at the bottom right of the screen. The final thing you should know about the Wilderness is being 'skulled'.
translation: Mevcut Wilderness seviyeniz ekranin sag alt kösesinde gösterilir. Wilderness hakkinda bilmeniz gereken son sey ise “skulled” olmaktir.

english: If you attack another player without them having attacked first, you will gain a skull above your character's head.
translation: Baska bir oyuncu size saldirmadan siz ona saldirirsaniz, karakterinizin basinin üzerinde bir kafatasi belirir.

english: What this means is that if you die while skulled, you will lose EVERYTHING that your character was carrying.
translation: Bu, skulled durumundayken ölürseniz, karakterinizin tasidigi HER SEYI kaybedeceginiz anlamina gelir.

english: When skulled, you should try to avoid dying for the twenty minutes or so it will take for the skull to wear off.
translation: Skulled oldugunuzda, skull'in etkisinin gecmesi icin gereken yaklasik yirmi dakika boyunca ölmemeye calismalisiniz.

english: If you wish to find the Wilderness, head north from where you start on the mainland. It is rather large and hard to miss.
translation: Wilderness'i bulmak istiyorsaniz, ana karada basladiginiz yerden kuzeye dogru ilerleyin. Oldukca büyük ve gözden kacmasi zor bir yerdir.

english: If you don't wish to end up there, take notice of the warning you will receive when getting near to it.
translation: Oraya gitmek istemiyorsaniz, oraya yaklastiginizda alacaginiz uyariyi dikkate alin.

english: Now, was there anything more?
Nope, I'm ready to move on!
Okay then.
Here, have this.
Here, have this!
I need another assignment.
Got any tips for me?
translation: Bana verebileceginiz bir ipucu var mi?

english: Okay, great!
Yes, please cancel it.
No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: Bana verebileceginiz bir ödül veya takas edebilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Look at rewards.
Look at shop.
Cancel.
Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
That's fine - I can handle any task.
In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: Gelecekte lütfen cok zor görevler verme.

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
translation: Sorun degil, cok zor görevler istemiyorum.

english: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: Savas seviyemi kontrol etmeyi birak, her seyi halledebilirim!

english: Er... Nothing...
Err... Nothing...
Tell me about combat stats.
Tell me about melee combat again.
Tell me about ranged combat again.
Tell me about the Wilderness.
Nope, I'm ready to move on!
Now you look like a vyre in need of some new threads.
translation: Simdi yeni kiyafetlere ihtiyaci olan bir vyre gibi görünüyorsun.

english: Let's trade.
Do I?
Oh yes. And luckily for you, I have everything you could ever need. Clothes, or the materials to make them if that's more your thing. All pre-scented as well.
translation: Evet. Ve sanslisin ki, ihtiyacin olan her sey bende var. Kiyafetler ya da daha cok hosuna gidiyorsa, onlari yapmak icin gerekli malzemeler. Hepsi önceden kokulandirilmis.

english: Pre-scented?
Oh don't go acting like you don't know what I mean. You've done a decent job, but behind that scent, I can tell you're just a lowly vyre.
translation: Oh, ne demek istedigimi bilmiyormus gibi davranma. Iyi bir is cikarmissin, ama o kokunun arkasinda, senin sadece asagilik bir vyre oldugunu anlayabiliyorum.

english: Fear not, I am no judge. I know that there are many like you who want a taste of upper class life. That's why all my outfits are scented. Helps you fit right in.
translation: Korkma, ben yargilayan biri degilim. Senin gibi üst sinif hayatinin tadini cikarmak isteyen bircok kisi oldugunu biliyorum. Bu yüzden tüm kiyafetlerim kokulandirilmis. Uyum saglamana yardimci olur.

english: Does it not bother you having lower class vampyres up here?
translation: Alt siniftan vampirlerin burada olmasi seni rahatsiz etmiyor mu?

english: Me? No. As long as you've got money, I don't care who you are.
translation: Beni mi? Hayir. Paran oldugu sürece kim oldugun umurumda degil.

english: Fair enough.
So, want to take a look?
I'm fine, thanks.
I'll be here if you change your mind.
Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: Insan! Muhafizlari cagirmadan köle kafeslerine geri dön!

english: Let's trade.
Do I?
I'm fine, thanks.
Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: Hey, kahraman! Vay canina! Harikasin, o iki genc ve Gadderank'i nasil alt ettin? Kasaba cok güzel, harika bir is cikarmissin!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
Oh, hello, Vasile is the name and I help to keep the village clear of rat infestations. Clearly I love my work, as I bring it home with me...on a stick!
translation: Merhaba, benim adim Vasile ve köyü sican istilasindan korumaya yardim ediyorum. Isimi cok seviyorum, cünkü onu eve de götürüyorum... bir sopanin ucunda!

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: Oh, pek bir sey yok, hepimiz hala vampirlerden saklaniyoruz ve bu korkunc yerde gecimimizi sagliyoruz, umarim yakinda Salve'deki tapinaga yolculuk yapacak kadar gücleniriz.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: Bildigim kadariyla yok, su anda cok yararli olan bazi temel olanaklara sahibiz, hepimiz size cok minnettariz. Daha önce hic bir kahraman görmedim veya tanimadim, bu yüzden karsilastirma yapabilecegim bir sey yok, ama sanirim

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: cogu insanin görüsüne göre, siz bir kahramansiniz! Ben sahsen sizinle tanistigima cok memnunum.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Ok, thanks.
Boots alone do not make an Araxyte.
It's a step in the right direction, proceed.
translation: Dogru yönde bir adim, devam et.

english: Go.
I thought you were going to pass over to the next world.
All in good time, [player name]. We stand forever in your debt, and will certainly put in a good word for you when we pass over.
translation: Her seyin bir zamani var, Maceraci. Sana sonsuza kadar minnettariz ve öbür dünyaya gectigimizde senin icin iyi seyler söyleyecegiz.

english: Can I have another Ectophial?
Really? You've already got an Ectophial.
translation: Gercekten mi? Zaten bir Ectophial'in var.

english: I know, but can I have another one anyway?
translation: Biliyorum, ama yine de bir tane daha alabilir miyim?

english: Of course you can, you have helped us more than we could ever have hoped.
translation: Tabii ki alabilirsin, bize umdugumuzdan daha fazla yardim ettin.

english: Have I? Okay, forget it.
I thought you were going to pass over to the next world.
Can I have another Ectophial?
I know, but can I have another one anyway?
translation: Biliyorum, ama yine de bir tane daha alabilir miyim?

english: Have I? Okay, forget it.
It's a damn good thing I don't have arachnophobia.
We're misunderstood. Without us in your house, you'd be infested with flies and other REAL nasties.
translation: Yanlis anlasiliyoruz. Biz olmasaydik, evin sinekler ve diger GERCEK pisliklerle dolardi.

english: Thanks for that enlightening fact.
Everybody gets one.
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
Hello, who are you?
I am Veos and I've just arrived in Port Sarim from a distant land.
translation: Ben Veos ve uzak bir ülkeden Port Sarim'e yeni geldim.

english: Where's that?
Across the sea, to the far west.
Tell me more about Great Kourend.
translation: Bana Büyük Kourend hakkinda daha fazla bilgi ver.

english: Great Kourend is a magnificent kingdom comprising of five cities. They are the cities of Arceuus, Lovakengj, Shayzien, Piscarilius and Hosidius. Each city is ruled by one of the five houses of Kourend.
translation: Büyük Kourend, bes sehirden olusan muhtesem bir kralliktir. Bu sehirler Arceuus, Lovakengj, Shayzien, Piscarilius ve Hosidius'tur. Her sehir, Kourend'in bes hanedanindan biri tarafindan yönetilmektedir.

english: At one time, the kingdom as a whole was ruled over by a king or queen that the five houses answered to.
translation: Bir zamanlar, kralligin tamami bes hanedanin bagli oldugu bir kral veya kralice tarafindan yönetiliyordu.

english: However, since our last King died 20 years ago, the kingdom has instead been ruled by an elected council.
translation: Ancak, son kralimiz 20 yil önce öldügünden beri, krallik secilmis bir konsey tarafindan yönetilmektedir.

english: Where are you from?
I am from the magnificent kingdom of Great Kourend, across the sea, to the far west.
translation: Denizin ötesinde, uzak batida bulunan muhtesem Büyük Kourend kralligindan geliyorum.

english: That's great, can you take me there please?
translation: Harika, beni oraya götürebilir misiniz lütfen?

english: Certainly! I hope you don't get seasick, it is a long voyage.
translation: Elbette! Umarim deniz tutmazsiniz, uzun bir yolculuk olacak.

english: Unfortunately it seems that you're not quite ready to visit Great Kourend yet. Come back when you are and I'll happily take you there.
translation: Maalesef, Büyük Kourend'i ziyaret etmek icin henüz hazir degilsiniz. Hazir oldugunuzda geri gelin, sizi oraya seve seve götürürüm.

english: You must be a member to travel to Great Kourend.Upgrade now to unlock extra quests, weapons, bosses, and more, within Great Kourend.
translation: Büyük Kourend'e seyahat etmek icin üye olmalisin. Simdi yükselt ve Büyük Kourend'de ekstra görevler, silahlar, bosslar ve daha fazlasini ac.

english: I'm afraid access to Great Kourend is currently prohibited.
translation: Maalesef Büyük Kourend'e erisim su anda yasak.

english: You cannot pass as you haven't unlocked access to the Great Kourend and Kebos Lowlands area in this League.
translation: Bu Lig'de Büyük Kourend ve Kebos Lowlands bölgesine erisim acmadigin icin gecemezsin.

english: Good bye.
Hello Veos.
Hello there. What can I do for you?
Can you take me somewhere?
Where would you like to go?
I'd like to travel to Port Piscarilius, please.
As you wish, I hope you don't get seasick, it is a long voyage.
translation: Nasil istersen, umarim deniz tutmazsin, uzun bir yolculuk olacak.

english: I'd like to travel to Land's End, please.
Actually I'd like to stay here.
As you wish.
Nothing.
What's this old book you gave me?
translation: Bana verdigin bu eski kitap nedir?

english: Ah that. I bought it at an auction a while back. Apparently, it belonged to the daughter of King Kharedst IV, the final king of Great Kourend.
translation: Ah, o mu? Bir süre önce bir müzayededen satin aldim. Görünüse göre, Büyük Kourend'in son krali Kral Kharedst IV'ün kizina aitti.

english: Why did you give it to me?
I'd hoped it might have some interesting information in it. Most of the pages are missing though so I have no use for it. I thought you might be able to find something to do with it.
translation: Icinde ilginc bilgiler olabilecegini ummustum. Ancak sayfalarin cogu eksik, bu yüzden benim icin bir faydasi yok. Belki sen onunla ilgili bir seyler bulabilirsin diye düsündüm.

english: Fair enough. Thanks!
These remind me of a pet I once had. Please... put them away.
translation: Bunlar bana bir zamanlar sahip oldugum bir evcil hayvani hatirlatiyor. Lütfen... bunlari kaldir.

english: Sorry, Veos. I didn't know.
Would you feel comfortable sharing your story?
I once had a wolf, [player name]. His name was Copper. He was loyal. Brave... Gentle. He'd wear this beautiful crimson red collar.
translation: Bir zamanlar bir kurtum vardi, Maceraci. Adi Copper'di. Sadikti. Cesurdu... Nazikti. Bu güzel kirmizi tasmayi takardi.

english: One day, I was travelling on the mainland, nearby a tribe of Fremenniks. Not exactly a spring chicken at this point, my own wolf was pushing 19...
translation: Bir gün, Fremennik kabilesinin yakinlarinda, anakarada seyahat ediyordum. O zamanlar artik genc sayilmayacak olan kurtum 19 yasina yaklasiyordu...

english: 19 years old? That's an incredible amount of time for a wolf to live!
translation: 19 yasinda mi? Bir kurt icin inanilmaz uzun bir ömür!

english: Indeed. Sadly, a group of feral foxes ambushed us. I fought back, along with Copper, though he took wounds that even a young wolf would struggle dealing with.
translation: Gercekten. Ne yazik ki, bir grup vahsi tilki bize pusu kurdu. Copper ile birlikte karsi koyduk, ancak o, genc bir kurtun bile basa cikmakta zorlanacagi yaralar aldi.

english: What did you do?
I ran, [player name]... Like a coward.
Did you ever find him?
I did not... I searched for days, but I was unable to find even his collar.
translation: Bulamadim... Günlerce aradim, ama tasmasini bile bulamadim.

english: I can help! I'll search for Copper's collar. I'm sure I can find the fox that has it...
translation: Yardim edebilirim! Copper'in tasmasini arayacagim. Onu alan tilkiyi bulabilecegime eminim...

english: Truly? You'd do that for me? Thank you so much, [player name]. I can't thank you enough! My heart's been filled with regret ever since it happened... and I think having a small part of Copper back, would make me complete again.
translation: Gercekten mi? Benim icin bunu yapar misin? Cok tesekkür ederim, Maceraci. Ne kadar tesekkür etsem azdir! O olaydan beri kalbim pismanlikla dolu... Copper'in kücük bir parcasini geri almak, beni tekrar tamamlayacaktir.

english: I'll return when I have found Copper's collar. Take care!
translation: Copper'in tasmasini buldugumda geri dönecegim. Kendine iyi bak!

english: How goes the hunt for Copper's collar, [player name]?
translation: Copper'in tasmasini aramak nasil gidiyor, Maceraci?

english: I haven't had any luck finding it yet, Veos. Where would you recommend searching?
translation: Henüz bulamadim, Veos. Nerede aramami önerirsin?

english: I'd imagine the fox which killed Copper will likely still have the collar in their possesion. They were nearby a Fremennik town.
translation: Copper'i öldüren tilki muhtemelen tasmayi hala elinde tutuyordur. Fremennik kasabasinin yakinlarindaydilar.

english: Thanks, Veos. I'll return when I have the collar!
translation: Tesekkürler, Veos. Tasmayi buldugumda geri dönecegim!

english: [Player name]... I can't thank you enough. I don't have a reward, but know that to me, this means so much. Perhaps in the future, I can repay you.
translation: Maceraci... Ne kadar tesekkür etsem azdir. Sana bir ödül veremem ama bunun benim icin cok önemli oldugunu bil. Belki gelecekte sana borcumu ödeyebilirim.

english: You're more than welcome Veos, and don't worry about a reward. Losing your best friend is always hard. Hopefully that item will bring you some comfort. Take care!
translation: Rica ederim Veos, ödül icin endiselenme. En iyi arkadasini kaybetmek her zaman zordur. Umarim bu esya sana biraz rahatlik verir. Kendine iyi bak!

english: [Player name]... I can't thank you enough for what you've done for me. I don't have a reward, but know that to me, this means so much. Perhaps in the future I can repay you.
translation: Maceraci... Benim icin yaptiklarin icin ne kadar tesekkür etsem azdir. Sana verebilecegim bir ödül yok, ama bunun benim icin cok önemli oldugunu bil. Belki gelecekte sana borcumu ödeyebilirim.

english: I am from the magnificent kingdom of Great Kourend on the continent of Zeah, to the far west.
translation: Ben, Zeah kitasinin en batisinda bulunan muhtesem Büyük Kourend kralligindan geliyorum.

english: Great Kourend is a magnificent kingdom comprising of five districts called Houses. The houses are ruled by the Lords of Arceuus, Lovakengj, Shayzien, Piscarilius and Hosidius.
translation: Büyük Kourend, bes bölgeyi kapsayan muhtesem bir kralliktir. Bu bölgeler Arceuus, Lovakengj, Shayzien, Piscarilius ve Hosidius lordlari tarafindan yönetilmektedir.

english: Since our last King died 20 years ago the kingdom has been ruled by an elected council.
translation: Son kralimiz 20 yil önce öldügünden beri krallik, secilmis bir konsey tarafindan yönetilmektedir.

english: Tell me more about Zeah.
translation: Bana Zeah hakkinda daha fazla bilgi verin.

english: Zeah is a huge continent far to the west of here full of new adventures and hidden treasures. Sadly, the kingdom of Great Kourend is besieged by lizard creatures and it is not possible to get out of the kingdom just yet.
translation: Zeah, buradan cok batida bulunan, yeni maceralar ve gizli hazinelerle dolu devasa bir kitadir. Ne yazik ki, Büyük Kourend kralligi kertenkele yaratiklar tarafindan kusatilmistir ve simdilik kralliktan cikmak mümkün degildir.

english: Who're you? I've never seen you around these parts before.
translation: Kimsiniz? Sizi daha önce buralarda görmedim.

english: I am Veos. Port master and scout for an elite Triumvirate.
translation: Ben Veos. Liman müdürü ve seckin bir üclü yönetimin kesifcisiyim.

english: Triumvirate?
Who? Where? Why have you suddenly docked here?
translation: Kim? Nerede? Neden aniden buraya demir attiniz?

english: These are questions to which you shall not find answers, adventurer.
Then why are you here?
There are secrets in this world for which you are not ready.
translation: Bu dünyada senin hazir olmadigin sirlar var.

english: Veos whispers...
Yo.... we, are not alone.
Where's that?
That's great, can you take me there please?
translation: Harika, beni oraya götürebilir misin lütfen?

english: Tell me more about Great Kourend.
translation: Bana Büyük Kourend hakkinda daha fazla bilgi ver.

english: Goodbye.
Can you take me somewhere?
I'd like to travel to Port Piscarilius, please.
I'd like to travel to Land's End, please.
Actually I'd like to stay here.
Nothing.
Would you feel comfortable sharing your story?
I can help! I'll search for Copper's collar.
I'm sorry. Thank you for sharing your story.
I'll leave you be. Sorry.
Where are you from?
Tell me more about Zeah.
translation: Bana Zeah hakkinda daha fazla bilgi ver.

english: Good bye.
If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: Senin kadar cirkin olsaydim, yüzümü halka göstermeye cesaret edemezdim!

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: Oh! Sey... Az önce bir tane yedim de ondan!

english: Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: Hayatina deger veriyorsan bir daha benimle konusma!

english: Get lost!
I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: Sana verecek hicbir seyim yok, birak beni rahat, dilenci.

english: Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
translation: Su anda bununla ugrasacak vaktim yok.

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: Senin gibi zavalli bir et yiginiyla konusmak istemiyorum.

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: Cok kötü bir gün... tadini cikar, bitmeden.

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: Eger birini yakalarsan, paylasacagina söz ver.

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
You smell familiar...
Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: Buralarda insan gördün mü? Cok acim.

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: Bana kan tadi seven biri gibi görünüyorsun.

english: Good day to you, my friend.
Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: Bana bir dakika izin ver, dislerime bir sey sikismis...

english: You dare disturb my rest!
You dare steal from us!
Thanks so much for saving me from being a vampyre. Here, take this certificate, I'm sorry but it's all I can offer as a reward.
translation: Beni vampir olmaktan kurtardigin icin cok tesekkürler. Al, bu sertifikayi al, üzgünüm ama ödül olarak sunabilecegim tek sey bu.

english: Thanks for changing me back, it must have been hard for you. I must be off now.
translation: Beni eski halime döndürdügün icin tesekkürler, senin icin zor olmus olmali. Artik gitmeliyim.

english: Welcome to my clothes stall, can I help you with anything?
translation: Giysi tezgahima hos geldin, yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: Yes, what clothes do you have in stock?
Not a lot, I'm afraid, most of what I produce goes to my sister. Her shop is in Keldagrim-West.
translation: Maalesef cok fazla yok, ürettigim giysilerin cogu kiz kardesime gidiyor. Onun dükkani Keldagrim-West'te.

english: Well, show me what you do have then.
translation: Peki, ne var ne yok gösterin bakalim.

english: No, I'm just browsing.
Yes, what clothes do you have in stock?
No, I'm just browsing.
Can you please help me? I'm in a terrible spot of trouble.
translation: Lütfen bana yardim eder misiniz? Basim büyük belada.

english: Aha, sounds like a quest. I'll help.
translation: Aha, bir görev gibi görünüyor. Yardim ederim.

english: Yes yes, I suppose it is a quest. My fiance Ernest and I came upon this house.
translation: Evet, evet, sanirim bir görev. Nisanlim Ernest ve ben bu eve rastladik.

english: Seeing as we were a little lost Ernest decided to go in and ask for directions.
translation: Biraz kayboldugumuzu görünce Ernest iceri girip yol tarifi almaya karar verdi.

english: That was an hour ago. That house looks spooky, can you go and see if you can find him for me?
translation: Bu bir saat önceydi. O ev ürkütücü görünüyor, gidip onu bulabilir misin?

english: Ok, I'll see what I can do.
Thank you, thank you. I'm very grateful.
No, I'm looking for something to kill.
Oooh, you violent person you.
Have you found my sweetheart yet?
No, not yet.
Yes, he's a chicken.
I know he's not exactly brave but I think you're being a bit harsh.
translation: Cesur olmadigini biliyorum ama bence biraz sert davraniyorsun.

english: No no, he's been turned into an actual chicken by a mad scientist.
translation: Hayir hayir, cilgin bir bilim adami tarafindan gercek bir tavuga dönüstürülmüs.

english: Eeeeeek!
My poor darling, why must these things happen to us.
translation: Zavalli sevgilim, neden basimiza böyle seyler geliyor?

english: Well I'm doing my best to turn him back.
translation: Onu geri dönüstürmek icin elimden geleni yapiyorum.

english: Well be quick, I'm sure being a chicken can't be good for him.
translation: Cabuk ol, tavuk olmak onun icin iyi olamaz.

english: Thank you for rescuing Ernest.
Where is he now?
Oh he went off to talk to some green warty guy. I'm sure he'll be back soon.
translation: Yesil sigilli bir adamla konusmaya gitti. Eminim yakinda geri döner.

english: Well done.
You've obtained a [new clue/casket]!
Aha, sounds like a quest. I'll help.
translation: Aha, bir görev gibi görünüyor. Yardim edecegim.

english: No, I'm looking for something to kill.
Now that was quite the show! I haven't been that entertained in a long time.
translation: Bu tam bir gösteriydi! Uzun zamandir bu kadar eglenmemistim.

english: Of course, you know I can't let you leave here alive. Time for your final performance...
translation: Tabii ki, buradan canli olarak cikmana izin veremem. Son performansinin zamani geldi...

english: Oh I'm going to enjoy this...
Back again for more? I admire your perseverance. Shall we begin?
translation: Yine mi geldin? Azminizi takdir ediyorum. Baslayalim mi?

english: You think you can defeat me?
There's nothing for you there!
translation: Orada senin icin hicbir sey yok!

english: Behold my true nature!
I'm not finished with you just yet!
You think this is over?!
Yes, let's begin.
No, don't start yet.
Welcome, oh great Fishing Champion! Feel free to pop by and use our tunnel any time.
translation: Hos geldiniz, ey büyük Balikcilik Sampiyonu! Istediginiz zaman ugrayip tünelimizi kullanabilirsiniz.

english: Thank you, I think I'll stop by for a beer one day.
translation: Tesekkürler, bir gün bira icmek icin ugrayacagim.

english: Well you already gave me one, but I won't say no to another, thank you kindly!
translation: Zaten bir tane verdin ama bir tane daha istersem hayir demem, çok tesekkürler!

english: I will smite you!
I've got you now!
Stand still, rat!
You can't escape!
For the lord!
You call that a weapon?!
You are weak! You are feeble!
Hold still so I can smite you!
translation: Hareket etme de seni yok edeyim!

english: Dodge this!
You are powerless to me!
I will cut you down!
I will end you!
You're mine now!
Time to die, mortal!
Raaargh!
Die, rodent!
Die!
Now I've got you!
Hands off, wretch!
Grrrah!
Take this!
You're not blocking this one!
Defend yourself!
Back off, mutt!
Perish, fool!
Time to feast, hounds!
Go forth, my hounds, and destroy them!
Hounds! Dispose of these tresspassers!
translation: Köpekler! Bu davetsiz misafirleri ortadan kaldirin!

english: I've had enough of this! Hounds!
Hounds! Get rid of these interlopers!
translation: Köpekler! Bu davetsiz misafirleri ortadan kaldirin!

english: I'll kill you for killing my pets!
Must I do everything around here?!
translation: Burada her seyi ben mi yapmaliyim?!

english: Now... DO IT AGAIN!!!
I WILL SMITE YOU!
DODGE THIS!
TAKE THIS!
PERISH, FOOL!
RAAARGH!
FOR THE LORD!
HOLD STILL SO I CAN SMITE YOU!
YOU CAN'T ESCAPE!
DIE!
STAND STILL, RAT!
YOU'RE MINE NOW!
YOU ARE POWERLESS TO ME!
I WILL CUT YOU DOWN!
TIME TO DIE, MORTAL!
FILTHY WHELPS!
YOU CALL THAT A WEAPON?!
DIE, RODENT!
YOU'RE NOT BLOCKING THIS ONE!
DEFEND YOURSELF!
HANDS OFF, WRETCH!
BACK OFF, MUTT!
HOUNDS! DISPOSE OF THESE TRESSPASSERS!
translation: KÖPEKLER! BU IZINSIZ GIRENLERI ORTADAN KALDIRIN!

english: HOUNDS! GET RID OF THESE INTERLOPERS!
translation: KÖPEKLER! BU IZINSIZ GIRENLERI ORTADAN KALDIRIN!

english: TIME TO FEAST, HOUNDS!
GO FORTH, MY HOUNDS, AND DESTROY THEM!
translation: ILERLEYIN, KÖPEKLERIM, VE ONLARI YOK EDIN!

english: I'LL KILL YOU FOR KILLING MY PETS!
translation: EVCIL HAYVANLARIMI ÖLDÜRDÜGÜN ICIN SENI ÖLDÜRECEGIM!

english: MY HOUNDS! I'LL MAKE YOU PAY FOR THAT!
GAH! HOUNDS! GET THEM!
FINE! I'LL DEAL WITH YOU MYSELF!
Urgh... not... again...
Urk! I... failed...
I'll... be... back...
This isn't... the last... of me...
My lord... I'm... sorry...
I'll get you... next... time...
Who is the true lord and king of the lands?
translation: Bu topraklarin gercek efendisi ve krali kimdir?

english: The mighty heir and lord of the Wilderness.
Where is he? Why hasn't he lifted your burden?
I have not fulfilled my purpose.
What is your purpose?
Not what is, what was. A great war tore this land apart and, for my failings in protecting this land, I carry the burden of its waste.
translation: Ne oldugu degil, ne oldugu. Büyük bir savas bu topraklari parcaladi ve bu topraklari korumadaki basarisizligimdan dolayi, onun yikiminin yükünü tasiyorum.

english: *slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: Hey, bu Kahraman! Vay canina! Sen harikasin, o iki juvinate ve Gadderank'i nasil alt etmeyi basardin? Ve kasaba cok güzel, harika bir is cikarmissin!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
I'm Victor, I'm just a kid, but I'll duff you in! You don't look that tough to me!
translation: Ben Victor, sadece bir cocugum, ama seni yenebilirim! Bana o kadar da sert görünmüyorsun!

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: Oh, pek bir sey yok, hepimiz hala vampirlerden saklaniyoruz ve bu korkunc yerden gecimimizi sagliyoruz, umarim yakinda Salve'deki tapinaga yolculuk yapacak kadar gücleniriz.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: Bildigim kadariyla yok, su anda cok yararli olan bazi temel olanaklara sahibiz, hepimiz sana cok minnettariz. Daha önce hic bir kahraman görmedim veya tanimadim, bu yüzden karsilastiracak bir seyim yok, ama sanirim

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: cogu insanin görüsüne göre, sen bir kahramansin! Ben sahsen seninle tanistigima cok memnunum.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: Yardimci olabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Ok, thanks.
Have I seen you before?
I don't think so... I've just got one of those faces.
You're probably right.
I'm rather busy at the moment. I've got to organise my cupboards of jewels.
translation: Su anda oldukca mesgulüm. Mücevher dolaplarimi düzenlemem gerekiyor.

english: Want any help?
Absolutely not! You stay away from my jewels.
Interested in buying a house like mine?
translation: Benimki gibi bir ev satin almak ister misin?

english: Not sure I've got enough coins to do that.
translation: Bunun icin yeterli param oldugundan emin degilim.

english: Silly me! I mistook you for one of us wealthy folk.
translation: Ne aptalim! Seni zenginlerden biri sanmistim.

english: Well that's rude.
You'll catch on.
Hello there. Are you liking the city?
It's beautiful!
It really is.
Huh? Are you an encyclopediasalesman?
No, sir, I'm a burglar. I burgle people.
translation: Hayir efendim, ben hirsizim. Insanlari soyarim.

english: Hmm... I think you're an encyclopediasalesman?
Not at all. I just want to ransack the place. Honestly.
translation: Hic de degil. Sadece burayi talan etmek istiyorum. Gercekten.

english: Hmm... Alright then.
I've just spent so much money!
Good for you.
I've got something in the back of my mind telling me I should go back home.
translation: Icimden bir ses eve dönmem gerektigini söylüyor.

english: You don't say...
Lovely day for a stroll, wouldn't you say?
translation: Yürüyüs icin harika bir gün, degil mi?

english: It is!
Sorry, but I don't have time to chat. I've got important errands to run.
translation: Üzgünüm ama sohbet edecek vaktim yok. Önemli islerim var.

english: I can't talk right now. I'm busy.
Time to go check how rich I am!
translation: Ne kadar zengin oldugumu kontrol etme zamani!

english: Lovely day for a stroll.
You are escorted out of the house as the owner has locked the door.
translation: Ev sahibi kapiyi kilitledigi icin evden disari cikarildiniz.

english: You hear someone outside spot the homeowner coming back!
translation: Disarida birinin ev sahibinin geri geldigini fark ettigini duyarsin!

english: Now where did I put my keys...
Ah, there they are!
It smells funny in here...
There's mud all over the floor!
Something isn't right here...
How did you get in here?
Hello, land dweller.
Hello, sea dweller.
What are you doing here?
The sea has been getting quite busy all of a sudden. I surfaced to see what the fuss was about and found that lots of you seem interested in diving down to the sea floor.
translation: Deniz birdenbire oldukca hareketli hale geldi. Neler oldugunu görmek icin su yüzüne ciktim ve cogunuzun deniz tabanina dalmakla ilgilendigini gördüm.

english: I'm offering my services as a guide, for a price. The price in this case, is knowledge!
translation: Rehberlik hizmetimi ücret karsiliginda sunuyorum. Bu durumda ücret, bilgi!

english: Interesting... It might be good to add some data about the depth of the sea to my charts.
translation: Ilginc... Deniz derinligi ile ilgili bazi verileri haritalarima eklemek iyi olabilir.

english: Can I dive to the sea floor with you?
translation: Seninle birlikte deniz dibine dalabilir miyim?

english: I don't think you are practised enough to dive here. I don't want you getting swept away!
translation: Burada dalmak icin yeterince deneyimli oldugunu sanmiyorum. Akintiya kapilmani istemem!

english: You need a Sailing level of 13 to dive here.
translation: Burada dalmak icin 13 seviye Yelkencilik seviyesine sahip olmalisin.

english: You need to be wearing deep sea diving equipment to dive with me!
translation: Benimle dalmak icin derin deniz dalis ekipmani giymelisin!

english: I want something in return if you're going to dive with me...
translation: Benimle dalacaksan karsiliginda bir sey istiyorum...

english: I'd like to try making some of your land food. Can you tell me the raw ingredients and tools I need to make an apple pie? Don't worry about water. I have plenty of that.
translation: Senin kara yiyeceklerinden bazilarini denemek istiyorum. Elmali turta yapmak icin gerekli malzemeleri ve aletleri bana söyleyebilir misin? Suyu dert etme. Bende bolca var.

english: This puzzle has three answers and you'll need to tell me all of them.
translation: Bu bulmacanin üc cevabi var ve hepsini bana söylemelisin.

english: I don't think that's right... You should try again.
translation: Bence bu dogru degil... Tekrar denemelisin.

english: The mermaid, satisfied with your answer, escorts you to the bottom of the sea. You take some depth readings from your diving equipment and note down the interesting local flora and fauna.
translation: Cevabindan memnun kalan deniz kizi, seni deniz dibine götürür. Dalis ekipmanindan derinlik ölcümleri yapar ve ilginc yerel flora ve faunayi not alirsin.

english: There you go. Hope the dive got you everything you needed!
translation: Iste oldu. Umarim dalista ihtiyacin olan her seyi bulmussundur!

english: Goodbye.
Goodbye, land dweller.
What are you doing here?
Can I dive to the sea floor with you?
translation: Seninle birlikte deniz dibine dalabilir miyim?

english: Goodbye.
: Cooking Apple, Pot of Flour, Pie Dish
translation: : Pisirmelik Elma, Un kabi, Turta kalibi

english: Hello!
Hello, human. What can I do for you?
translation: Merhaba, insan. Senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: What are you doing here?
Protecting the camp from wildlife and thieves.
translation: Kampi vahsi hayvanlardan ve hirsizlardan koruyorum.

english: What about the giant monster up there?
Hah! Why would I rush up there when you foolish humans are more than willing to throw yourself into its jaws?
translation: Hah! Siz aptal insanlar kendinizi onun agzina atmaya bu kadar istekliyken, neden oraya kosayim ki?

english: Besides, someone needs to keep an eye on the happenings down here.
translation: Ayrica, birinin buradaki olaylari gözetlemesi gerekiyor.

english: I suppose that's fair.
It is hungry work though, and we don't have the most interesting supplies up here.
translation: Ama bu is aclik cekmek demek ve burada cok ilginc malzemelerimiz yok.

english: Got me thinking about those sunlight antelope. Quite an interesting flavour, but I think we can do even more...
translation: Günes isigi antiloplarini düsündüm de. Oldukca ilginc bir tadi var, ama bence daha da iyisini yapabiliriz...

english: Anyway, I shouldn't really be talking to you. Move along, please.
translation: Neyse, seninle konusmamam gerek. Lütfen yoluna devam et.

english: Oh, is that sunlight antelope meat you're carrying?
translation: Oh, tasidigin sey günes isigi antilop eti mi?

english: Yes... Why?
Come closer, I have a request to make.
Sitting up here under the looming threat of death at the jaws of a giant beast that tunnels beneath our very feet got me thinking.
translation: Ayaklarimizin altinda tüneller kazarak dev bir canavarin agzinda ölüm tehdidi altinda burada otururken aklima bir sey geldi.

english: Could we combine the sweet stickiness of redberries with the strong, gamey flavour of sunlight antelope?
translation: Kirmizi meyvelerin tatli yapiskanligi ile günes isigi antilopunun güclü, av eti tadini birlestirebilir miyiz?

english: What?
Don't get me wrong, Marla is cooking up some wonderful stuff considering the circumstances. I just need something a little more adventurous, you know?
translation: Yanlis anlama, Marla bu kosullar altinda harika seyler pisiriyor. Sadece biraz daha maceraci bir sey istiyorum, anliyor musun?

english: I'm sure she'd be happy to experiment if you bring her some raw sunlight antelope and redberries!
translation: Ona cig günes isigi antilopu ve kirmizi meyve getirirsen, denemekten mutluluk duyacagina eminim!

english: I suppose I can help out.
Wonderful, thank you! I can't wait to try this!
Sorry, I'm a bit busy right now.
Aren't we all? Ah well, maybe another time.
translation: Hepimiz öyle degil miyiz? Ah, neyse, belki baska bir zaman.

english: Hello! What can I do for you?
What did you want me to get you?
I'd like to try redberries combined with sunlight antelope! Marla the chef will prepare it if you take her the raw ingredients.
translation: Kirmizi meyveleri günes isigi antilobuyla birlikte denemek istiyorum! Marla sef, ona cig malzemeleri götürürsen hazirlayacaktir.

english: I'll see what I can do.
Never mind.
Okay, bye!
Oh wow, it smells amazing!
Hmm...
...Mmmhhmm...
...Mmm.
Well, it's... interesting and complex. Definitely an experience.
translation: Sey, bu... ilginc ve karmasik. Kesinlikle bir deneyim.

english: Thank you... err...
[Player name].
Thank you, [player name]!
Viero looks up from his meal.
Yes?
Uh, usually there's a reward for doing this sort of thing.
translation: Uh, genellikle bu tür seyler icin bir ödül vardir.

english: Seriously, human? You couldn't just do this out of kindness? For the enjoyment of the journey and the feeling of helping another?
translation: Ciddi misin, insan? Bunu sadece nezaketen yapamaz miydin? Yolculugun tadini cikarmak ve bir baskasina yardim etme hissi icin?

english: You weren't helping me out of appreciation for my work here and the service I provide?
translation: Burada yaptigim is ve sundugum hizmet icin bana minnettar oldugun icin yardim etmedin mi?

english: Or, at the least, to push the boundaries of culinary achievement?
translation: Ya da en azindan mutfak basarilarinin sinirlarini zorlamak icin?

english: I... uh... of course. Enjoy your meal.
translation: Ben... uh... tabii ki. Afiyet olsun.

english: I suppose you can have a bite if you like?
I think I'll pass, thanks.
Can I try some?
Oh. Yeah, I suppose so.
Interesting and complex is a good way to describe it...
translation: Ilginc ve karmasik, bunu tanimlamak icin iyi bir yol...

english: An experience!
Enjoy your meal.
Oh, thank you! Have a great day!
Hello, Viero!
Hello, [player name]! What can I do for you?
translation: Merhaba, Maceraci! Senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: Protecting the camp from wildlife and thieves.
translation: Kampi vahsi hayvanlardan ve hirsizlardan korumak.

english: Hah! Why would I rush up there when you foolish humans are more than willing to throw yourself into its jaws?
translation: Hah! Siz aptal insanlar kendinizi onun pencelerine atmaya bu kadar istekliyken, ben neden oraya kosayim ki?

english: Besides, someone needs to keep an eye on the happenings down here.
translation: Ayrica, burada olan biteni gözetlemek icin birinin kalmasi gerekiyor.

english: Seriously though, [player name], do be careful up there.
translation: Cidden ama, Maceraci, orada dikkatli ol.

english: I'll try!
Would you like any more redberry antelope?
translation: Biraz daha kirmizi meyveli antilop ister misin?

english: You know, I think I've had enough. Thanks, though.
translation: Sanirim yeterince yedim. Yine de tesekkürler.

english: Okay, bye!
Oh, more antelope. You know, I think I've had enough. Thanks, though.
translation: Oh, yine antilop. Sanirim yeterince yedim. Yine de tesekkürler.

english: Yes.
No.
What are you doing here?
What did you want me to get you?
Never mind.
Uh, usually there's a reward for doing this sort of thing.
translation: Uh, genelde bu tür seyler icin bir ödül olur.

english: Can I try some?
Enjoy your meal.
Would you like some more redberry antelope?
translation: Biraz daha kirmizi meyveli antilop ister misin?

english: Hello there.
Wooo?  Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!
translation: Wooo?  Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!

english: You don't say?
Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!
translation: Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!

english: You don't say!
Wooowoowoooooo.... Woowoowoo? Woooo, wooowoo wooowooowooo!
Well, I guess you didn't say.
Yeah, I don't want to brag, but seriously: I am SOOOO rich....
translation: Evet, övünmek istemem ama cidden: Ben COK zenginim....

english: Yeah, I know they say money doesn't bring you happiness, but sometimes I just like to open my bank account and look at all of the stuff I own and just think to myself:
translation: Evet, paranin mutluluk getirmedigini söylerler, ama bazen banka hesabimi acip sahip oldugum her seye bakip kendi kendime söyle düsünüyorum:

english: Wow. I am soooooo rich.
Well, us rich alive people don't want to waste all day spending time with you poor dead people, because I'm just sooooo rich I have to go now, and very possibly make myself even richer.
translation: Biz zengin yasayanlar, tüm günümüzü siz fakir ölülerle gecirmek istemiyoruz, cünkü ben cok zenginim ve simdi gitmeliyim, muhtemelen kendimi daha da zenginlestirmeliyim.

english: See ya around ghosty!
Yeah, I heard about that, ha-ha-ha!
With a MACKEREL? Ouch!
Well, it was fun. Let's do it again sometime.
translation: Evet, eglenceliydi. Bir ara tekrar yapalim.

english: Why, thank you very much!
I know, but what are you going to do?
Well, I guess that's always true in the long run. See you around, weird invisible dead person!
translation: Evet, uzun vadede bu her zaman dogrudur. Görüsürüz, garip görünmez ölü insan!

english: Yeah it's not bad, but I prefer cooked chicken.
translation: Evet, fena degil, ama ben pismis tavugu tercih ederim.

english: Maybe, but nothing beats a home cooked pie!
translation: Belki, ama ev yapimi turta gibisi yoktur!

english: Man, I love pie!
You don't say? I never knew that. Well, I must be going, see you around.
translation: Öyle mi? Bunu bilmiyordum. Peki, gitmem gerek, görüsürüz.

english: We get signal!
Somebody set up us the bomb!
You have no chance to survive make your time.
translation: Hayatta kalma sansin yok, zamanini iyi degerlendir.

english: Woo?
All your base are belong to us.
Hey, don't think you can talk to me like that!
Are you threatening me?
Just because you're already dead, doesn't mean I can't find a way to hurt you ghosty!
translation: Senin zaten ölmüs olman, sana zarar verecek bir yol bulamayacagim anlamina gelmez hayalet!

english: No, I've never been there in my life and CERTAINLY didn't steal anything when I was!
translation: Hayir, hayatimda oraya hic gitmedim ve oradayken KESINLIKLE hicbir sey calmadim!

english: Are you calling me a liar?!?! I have never stolen a thing in my life, and I resent the implication that I am the kind of morally depraved individual that would steal someone else's hard earned
translation: Bana yalanci mi diyorsun?!?! Hayatimda hicbir sey calmadim ve baskalarinin zor kazandiklari parayi

english: money from their very pockets!
translation: ceplerinden calacak kadar ahlaksiz bir insan oldugumu ima etmene cok kizdim!

english: Or cakes. Or fur. Repeatedly. For long periods at a time.
translation: Ya da kekleri. Ya da kürkleri. Tekrar tekrar. Uzun süreler boyunca.

english: Well if you are going to take that attitude, then I have nothing further to say on the matter, and bid you good day!
translation: Eger bu tavri takinacaksan, bu konuda söyleyecek baska bir seyim yok, iyi günler!

english: So... You must be the infamous Viggora.
Hold thy tongue varlet! Speak fast, how come you to find me here, and how doth you understand mine speech?
translation: Dilini tut, seni alcak! Cabuk konus, beni burada nasil buldun ve benim dilimi nasil anliyorsun?

english: You want me to hold my tongue and tell you how I found you?
translation: Dilimi tutup seni nasil buldugumu mu söylememi istiyorsun?

english: Cease thy chatter and respond to my demand!
translation: Gevezelik etmeyi birak ve istegime cevap ver!

english: Cease my chatter AND respond to your demand?
translation: Gevezelik etmeyi birakip istegine cevap vermek mi?

english: I warn thee knave, this curse upon me hath not improved my temper, these centuries past...
translation: Seni uyariyorum, bu lanet benim mizacimi iyilestirmedi, gecen yüzyillar boyunca...

english: Well, it's actually about that curse that I have come to speak to you.
translation: Aslinda, seninle konusmaya geldigim konu o lanetle ilgili.

english: Oh, be that so? Then forgive my swift anger, and speak to me of how you plan to break this curse.
translation: Öyle mi? O zaman öfkemi bagisla ve bu laneti nasil bozmayi planladigini anlat bana.

english: Erm... I didn't actually mention anything about breaking the curse...
Then what lets you dare speak to me?
translation: O zaman neden benimle konusmaya cüret ediyorsun?

english: Well, I heard of your name from a mage called Dhalak, and I'm trying to find out what exactly caused the curse to befall him, and you as well apparently.
translation: Sey, Dhalak adinda bir büyücüden adini duydum ve lanetin ona ve görünüse göre sana da neden düstügünü ögrenmeye calisiyorum.

english: Ha! So the weak-willed mage was cursed along with me?
translation: Ha! Demek iradesiz büyücü de benimle birlikte lanetlendi?

english: Well now, that is an interesting turn of events... Then am I to assume that Valdez, Rennard, Kharrim and Lennissa were also cursed along with me?
translation: Vay canina, bu ilginc bir gelisme... O zaman Valdez, Rennard, Kharrim ve Lennissa da benimle birlikte lanetlendi mi?

english: ...How did you know that?
Ha ha ha! Oh, the curse cut deeper than I had previously thought!
translation: Ha ha ha! Lanet sandigimdan daha derinmis!

english: Stranger, this news has brought me a ray of sunshine in an otherwise dreary millennium! Please, ask any question you wish!
translation: Yabanci, bu haber bana kasvetli bir bin yilda bir isik tuttu! Lütfen, istedigin soruyu sor!

english: Erm... Thanks, I think. So what exactly happened on that day you were all cursed?
translation: Sey... Tesekkürler, sanirim. Peki, hepinizin lanetlendigi o gün tam olarak ne oldu?

english: I know that Valdez discovered the Staff of Armadyl, was robbed by Rennard, who then sent Kharrim to tell Zamorak of it.
translation: Valdez'in Armadyl'in Asasini kesfettigini, Rennard tarafindan soyuldugunu ve Rennard'in Kharrim'i Zamorak'a haber vermeye gönderdigini biliyorum.

english: Meanwhile Lennissa heard of the sale, and informed Dhalak who placed an enchantment upon it so that its power would be hidden.
translation: Bu sirada Lennissa satistan haberdar oldu ve Dhalak'a haber verdi, Dhalak da asanin gücünü gizlemek icin üzerine bir büyü yapti.

english: I still don't know what happened with the staff to cause this curse, or what you had to do with it though...
translation: Hala bu lanetin neden asayla ilgili oldugunu ve senin bununla ne ilgisi oldugunu bilmiyorum...

english: Well stranger, rest yourself awhile, and I will recount a tale of the events of that day, for I was one of the few actually there when it happened...
translation: Peki yabanci, biraz dinlen, ben de o gün olanlari anlatayim, cünkü o olaylar sirasinda orada bulunan birkac kisiden biriydim...

english: When what happened?
When my Lord Zamorak first got his taste of godhood!
translation: Lord Zamorak ilk kez tanrisalligi tatti!

english: Wow. Sounds like quite the dinner party anecdote.
translation: Vay canina. Aksam yemegi partisinde anlatilacak bir anekdot gibi.

english: You can take the snide venom out of your voice whelp, you came to me; 'twas not the other way round.
translation: Sesindeki alayci tonu birak, sen bana geldin, tersi degil.

english: Okay, okay. Please continue.
Well now, let us see... As you may have heard tell, my affiliation lay with General Zamorak, a mighty warrior of the Mahjarrat tribe, and my skill on the battlefield had quickly brought
translation: Peki, bakalim... Duymus olabilecegin gibi, ben Mahjarrat kabilesinin güclü savascisi General Zamorak'in yanindaydim ve savas alanindaki becerim kisa sürede

english: me to his attention.

So pleased was he with my bloodlust that he promoted me on the battlefield once to serve in his honour guard, and let me tell you, this was a rare honour indeed, for I was the only human chosen to take such a position.
translation: Benim kan dökme arzumdan o kadar memnun kaldi ki, savas alaninda beni bir kez terfi ettirerek seref kitasinda görevlendirdi. Ve inanin bana, bu gercekten nadir bir onurdu, cünkü bu göreve secilen tek insan bendim.

english: Really?
Oh yes, the dragon riders, Mahjarrat, demons and vampyre warriors made up the bulk of the force, but I wager I was their equal in all ways of combat.
translation: Evet, ejderha binicileri, Mahjarratlar, iblisler ve vampir savascilar ordunun cogunlugunu olusturuyordu, ama bahse girerim ki ben de onlarla her türlü savasta esit seviyedeydim.

english: Ha, when I think of someone like Lucien struggling to lift a blade, in some ways I was even their better!
translation: Ha, Lucien gibi birinin kilici kaldirmakta zorlandigini düsündügümde, bazi yönlerden onlardan bile daha iyiydim!

english: Please continue.
Well anyway... Myself and the rest of Zamoraks honour guard were formulating stratagems in our battle-tent, when that sneaky messenger Kharrim came in offering to sell us
translation: Neyse... Ben ve Zamorak'in seref muhafizlarinin geri kalani savas cadirimizda stratejiler gelistirirken, o sinsi haberci Kharrim gelip bize

english: the god-staff of Armadyl!
translation: Armadyl'in tanri asasini satmayi teklif etti!

english: Naturally, we suspected that this was some trick by our Lord to test our loyalty...
translation: Dogal olarak, bunun efendimizin sadakatimizi sinamak icin yaptigi bir oyun oldugunu düsündük...

english: Yes, who was your lord? Everyone has been very evasive about that...
translation: Evet, efendiniz kimdi? Herkes bu konuda cok kacamak cevaplar verdi...

english: Quiet fool, all things in their course; You are disrupting my train of thought!
translation: Sessiz ol aptal, her sey yolunda gidiyor; düsüncelerimi bozuyorsun!

english: Sorry...
Well anyway, we thought it was too good to be true, yet when we visited this scummy tavern we were amazed to discover there was no trick, no test of loyalty, no hidden trap:
translation: Neyse, bunun gercek olamayacak kadar iyi oldugunu düsündük, ancak bu pis tavernayi ziyaret ettigimizde, hicbir hile, sadakat testi veya gizli tuzak olmadigini görünce sasirdik:

english: Somehow this fool had actually managed to obtain the god-staff of Armadyl!
translation: Bu aptal bir sekilde Armadyl'in tanri asasini ele gecirmisti!

english: Its power was incredible, you could almost feel the energies crackling around it in the air!
translation: Gücü inanilmazdi, etrafindaki enerjinin havada catirdandigini neredeyse hissedebiliyordunuz!

english: So what happened then?

Well, with such a weapon, the plans we had been developing for a rebellion against our lord could finally be put into action, but we knew that we would have to act swiftly, before he heard that we had a weapon
translation: Böyle bir silahla, lordumuza karsi bir isyan icin gelistirdigimiz planlari nihayet hayata gecirebilirdik, ama onun bizi yenebilecek bir silahimiz oldugunu duymadan önce hizli hareket etmemiz gerektigini biliyorduk.

english: capable of defeating him, and we would have to act decisively, for even amongst our group there were still those loyal to the lord - such as that pathetic fool Azzanadra.
translation: Kararli davranmamiz gerekiyordu, cünkü grubumuzda bile lorda sadik olanlar vardi - mesela o zavalli aptal Azzanadra gibi.

english: So JUST WHO WAS this lord you speak of?
And I tell thee again, I will say when it is appropriate, now do not disrupt my tale!
translation: Sana tekrar söylüyorum, uygun oldugunda anlatacagim, simdi hikayemi bölme!

english: Okay, carry on then...
So anyway, Lord Zamorak and his most trusted compatriots, namely myself, Hazeel, Drakan, Thammaron and Zemouregal made plans to overthrow our lord using the god-weapon, and by pledging
translation: Her neyse, Lord Zamorak ve en güvendigi yoldaslari, yani ben, Hazeel, Drakan, Thammaron ve Zemouregal, tanri silahini kullanarak lordumuzu devirmek icin planlar yaptik ve Zamorak'a efendimiz olarak baglilik yemini ederek

english: allegiance to Zamorak as our master, were each to be given a large piece of land as our own in return.
translation: karsiliginda her birimize büyük bir arazi parcasi verilecekti.

english: We decided to move immediately, before anyone got cold feet, or any other parties could interfere in our work, and made haste towards the castle where our Lord lived.
translation: Kimse caymadan veya baska taraflar isimize karismadan hemen harekete gecmeye karar verdik ve lordumuzun yasadigi kaleye dogru aceleyle yola ciktik.

english: If Lucien had not been otherwise occupied, he would have probably accompanied us with his magicks, but it turned out the foolish Dhalak had made his involvement unnecessary with some spells of his own allowing us to
translation: Lucien baska bir isle mesgul olmasaydi, muhtemelen büyüleriyle bize eslik ederdi, ama aptal Dhalak kendi büyüleriyle onun katilimini gereksiz hale getirdi ve

english: get close enough to the castle with the staff without the Empty Lord being able to sense its presence.
translation: Bos Lord'un varligini hissetmeden asayla kaleye yeterince yaklasmamizi sagladi.

english: So your lord was the one that cursed you?
I am coming to that... So anyway, we made our way to the castle, under the pretense that we had war plans against Saradomin and the other deities to discuss.
translation: O konuya geliyorum... Neyse, Saradomin ve diger tanrilara karsi savas planlari tartismak icin bahanesiyle kaleye dogru yola ciktik.

english: As usual, our lord was guarded well, but this was why Zamorak had brought his most trusted fighters with him.
translation: Her zamanki gibi lordumuz iyi korunuyordu, ama Zamorak bu yüzden en güvendigi savascilari da yaninda getirmisti.

english: While we distracted the Empty Lord with our feints and attacks, and kept his bodyguards busy, Lord Zamorak outflanked him, unsheathed the staff and plunged it into his back!
translation: Biz bos lordun dikkatini aldatmacalarimiz ve saldirilarimizla dagitirken ve korumalarini mesgul ederken, Lord Zamorak onu kusatti, asayi kinindan cikardi ve sirtina sapladi!

english: Ah, it was a glorious sight... At that moment I was reminded for whom I fought, and why General Zamorak had earned his nickname 'the scourge' upon the battlefield...
translation: Ah, muhtesem bir manzaraydi... O anda kimin icin savastigimi ve General Zamorak'in savas alaninda neden “felaket” lakabini kazandigini hatirladim...

english: And the next thing you know you were cursed?
No, it was not quite that simple... The Empty Lord turned away from our battle, eyes burning with hatred, and towards Zamorak instead. Seeing this, we all fought with extra vigour, so that
translation: Hayir, o kadar basit degildi... Bos Lord, nefretle yanan gözlerle savasimizdan uzaklasti ve Zamorak'a yöneldi. Bunu gören hepimiz, General Zamorak'in lordumuzla tek basina yüzlesmemesi icin daha da siddetle savastik, ancak yüzlerce savasci ve iblis tarafindan sayica üstünlük saglandigindan ona yardim etmek icin ulasamadik!

english: General Zamorak would not face our lord alone, but we were outnumbered by many hundreds of warriors and demons, and could not reach him to assist him!
So what then?
Why, it was the Empty Lord versus Zamorak, in single combat! And the sight of the battle will be with me forever more...
translation: Bos Lord ile Zamorak teke tek dövüstü! Ve o savasin görüntüsü sonsuza kadar benimle kalacak...

english: The Empty Lord was a powerful god, stronger than any of the others awake at that time, possibly even as strong as Guthix is, and Zamorak was but a mortal: A Mahjarrat warrior all the same, with all of the
translation: Bos Lord, o dönemde uyanik olan diger tanrilardan daha güclü, hatta muhtemelen Guthix kadar güclü olan güclü bir tanriydi ve Zamorak ise sadece bir ölümlüydü: Bir Mahjarrat savascisiydi, bunun getirdigi tüm

english: strength and power that that entails, but mortal nonetheless, but to see him fight, you would not think of him as a 'mere' anything...
translation: güc ve kudrete sahipti, ama yine de bir ölümlüydü, ancak onun savasisini görenler, onu ‘sadece’ bir sey olarak görmezlerdi...

english: He was war itself! Flurry after flurry of blows he rained upon the Empty Lord, and the very castle walls shook and quivered with their power, but the Empty Lord would not fall!
translation: O savasin ta kendisiydi! Bos Lord'a arka arkaya darbeler yagdirdi ve kalenin duvarlari bile bu gücün etkisiyle sallandi ve titredi, ama Bos Lord düsmedi!

english: Even with the weapon of a god embedded in his back, he fought on, and with each blow our victory seemed less and less certain...
translation: Sirtina bir tanrinin silahi saplanmis olsa bile savasmaya devam etti ve her darbeyle zaferimiz giderek daha belirsiz hale geldi...

english: Well, then a miracle happened. Or luck. Or natural justice.
translation: Sonra bir mucize oldu. Ya da sans. Ya da dogal adalet.

english: You can call it what you want, but as the Empty Lords hands wrapped tightly around Zamorak's throat, Lord Zamorak, kicking and screaming defiantly and radiant in his anger until the very last, plunged towards the
translation: Ne derseniz deyin, ama Bos Lord'un elleri Zamorak'in bogazini sikica kavradiginda, Lord Zamorak, son ana kadar öfkeyle tekmeleyip bagirarak direndi ve Bos Lord'a dogru atildi.

english: Empty Lord, who seemed to lose his footing slightly, and fell in such a way so that the staff plunged deeper into his body, but also impaled Lord Zamorak with it at the same time...
translation: Bos Lord biraz dengesini kaybetmis gibi görünüyordu ve öyle bir sekilde düstü ki, asa vücuduna daha da derinlemesine saplandi, ama ayni zamanda Lord Zamorak'i da delip gecti...

english: And then...
And then what?
And then nothing. There was a sudden flash of bright light, and then a sudden blink of cold darkness, and it was over.
translation: Ve sonra hicbir sey kalmadi. Ani bir parlak isik cakti, ardindan ani bir soguk karanlik cöktü ve her sey bitti.

english: Zamorak stood over the Empty Lord who was slowly... fading from existence... And as he faded, it seemed as though... It almost seemed as though Zamorak became more real,
translation: Zamorak, yavas yavas varligindan silinen Bos Lord'un üzerinde duruyordu... Ve o silinirken, sanki... Sanki Zamorak daha gercek,

english: more solid than he had been before...

And as the Empty Lord faded from this world completely, I heard his voice, almost a whisper upon the wind, cursing all who had helped Zamorak in his victory, which as you now tell me seems to have been all who
translation: Ve Bos Lord bu dünyadan tamamen kaybolurken, rüzgarda fisildayan bir ses gibi, Zamorak'in zaferine yardim eden herkesi lanetleyen sesini duydum. Simdi bana anlattigina göre, bu zaferden sorumlu olanlar,

english: were responsible for the staff ending up in Zamorak's hands at the castle.
As I heard it, I saw that I too was fading, just as the Empty Lord had, and I called to my brethren for their assistance, but they could no longer hear my words, nor see my form.
translation: Bunu duydugumda, Bos Lord gibi benim de kayboldugumu gördüm ve kardeslerimden yardim istedim, ama artik sözlerimi duyamiyorlardi, ne de beni görebiliyorlardi.

english: It was then that the other gods appeared and banished Zamorak from the world completely for daring to kill one of their kind, although as it turned out it didn't quite work out that way for them, when he returned
translation: O zaman diger tanrilar ortaya cikti ve Zamorak'i, kendi türlerinden birini öldürmeye cüret ettigi icin dünyadan tamamen kovdular, ancak sonucta bu onlar icin pek de ise yaramadi, cünkü Zamorak

english: stronger than ever, a god himself.
translation: her zamankinden daha güclü, bir tanri olarak geri döndü.

english: But the god wars were another story entirely...
translation: Ama tanri savaslari tamamen baska bir hikayeydi...

english: But... I don't understand... If it was Zamorak who used the weapon, then why was it only you who were cursed?
translation: Ama... Anlamiyorum... Silahi Zamorak kullandiysa, neden sadece sen lanetlendin?

english: And the other people who were cursed, why them? Why not the other Mahjarrat for example?
translation: Ve lanetlenen diger insanlar, neden onlar? Neden örnegin diger Mahjarratlar degil?

english: And just who was this 'Empty Lord' you keep speaking of?
translation: Ve sürekli bahsettigin bu “Bos Lord” kimdi?

english: Well, in my life I was nothing but a warrior. I had no hidden knowledge, I didn't especially care about the gods or their magics, and I certainly didn't respect them.
translation: Hayatim boyunca ben sadece bir savasciydim. Gizli bilgim yoktu, tanrilara veya onlarin büyülerine özellikle ilgi duymuyordum ve onlara kesinlikle saygi duymuyordum.

english: Now in my... I suppose this is my death. I am but a shade on the wind, unnoticed by all who pass me, until today anyway, and the only answer I can give you is that the others who were with me, the
translation: Simdi ise... Sanirim bu benim ölümüm. Ben rüzgarda bir gölgeyim, yanimdan gecenlerin hicbiri beni fark etmiyor, en azindan bugüne kadar, ve sana verebilecegim tek cevap, benimle birlikte olan digerleri,

english: Mahjarrats and the Vampyre, they were beings of magic.
translation: Mahjarratlar ve Vampyrler, onlarin büyülü varliklar oldugu.

english: It runs through their very veins, and ebbs through their bones.
translation: Büyü onlarin damarlarinda akiyor ve kemiklerinde dolasiyor.

english: Who knows why the curse fell as it did? Perhaps as a mere human I was more susceptible to it, when they were not. Perhaps they too are cursed, but their life spans are so
translation: Lanet neden böyle düstü, kim bilir? Belki de ben siradan bir insan oldugum icin ona daha duyarliydim, onlar ise degildi. Belki onlar da lanetlidir, ama ömürleri o kadar

english: long that it will be millennia before they feel it upon them. Perhaps because it did not affect them, it extended backwards through time, to the moment the staff was
translation: uzun ki, lanetin etkisini hissetmeleri binlerce yil sürecektir. Belki de onlari etkilemedigi icin, zaman icinde geriye dogru uzanarak, asanin

english: taken from its rightful place, and all who had known of its theft were cursed too. Perhaps there are others also cursed, who played no part in this tale, and were merely unlucky enough to be
translation: hakli yerinden alindigi ana kadar uzanmis ve hirsizligi bilen herkes de lanetlenmistir. Belki de bu hikayede hicbir rolü olmayan, sadece yanlis zamanda yanlis yerde bulunma sanssizligina ugrayan

english: in the wrong place at the wrong time...
I don't know. Things do not always happen for a reason, just as tales do not always end with all of the loose ends neatly tied up and all answers supplied.
translation: Bilmiyorum. Her seyin bir nedeni yoktur, tipki hikayelerin her zaman tüm uclari düzgünce baglanip tüm cevaplar verilmis olarak bitmedigi gibi.

english: I have simply told you the events I was witness to, for I can do no more.
translation: Sadece tanik oldugum olaylari anlattim, cünkü daha fazlasini yapamam.

english: You have cheered me no end to let me know that this curse that has afflicted me has not left me alone here, in this void between worlds.
translation: Beni etkileyen bu lanetin beni burada, dünyalar arasindaki bu boslukta yalniz birakmadigini bilmemi saglayarak bana sonsuz bir nese verdin.

english: Perhaps I will hunt down these others who have also been cursed as I was, but I feel I must reward you for your efforts; Here, take my cloak, it is drenched in the blood of a
translation: Belki de benim gibi lanetlenmis olan digerlerini de avlayacagim, ama cabalarin icin seni ödüllendirmem gerektigini hissediyorum; Al, pelerinimi al, binlerce düsmanin kaniyla islanmis

english: thousand foes, and may bring you luck in battle.
So how can I break this curse?
Who knows? If it was the death curse of the Empty Lord, there may be no way to break it.
translation: Kim bilir? Eger bu, Bos Lord'un ölüm laneti ise, onu bozmanin bir yolu olmayabilir.

english: If it was not his death curse, and he is still alive but not on this world, then the only way to break it may be to bring him back here;
translation: Eger onun ölüm laneti degilse ve o hala hayatta ama bu dünyada degilse, o zaman onu buraya geri getirmek laneti bozmanin tek yolu olabilir.

english: But I would rather stay cursed than suffer under his rule again...
translation: Ama onun yönetimi altinda tekrar aci cekmektense lanetli kalmayi tercih ederim...

english: But WHO was this 'Empty Lord'? WHAT was his NAME?
translation: Peki bu “Bos Lord” kimdi? Adi neydi?

english: You do not know? You have not guessed yet?
translation: Bilmiyor musun? Henüz tahmin etmedin mi?

english: He was Zaros.
Well, that's all fascinating, but I just don't particularly care. Bye-bye.
translation: Bu cok ilginc, ama ben pek umursamiyorum. Hosca kal.

english: Hello.
Hello yourself.
I really liked your little story. Can you tell me another one?
translation: Kücük hikayenizi cok begendim. Bana baska bir tane daha anlatir misiniz?

english: Preferably something with a big fight and lots of explosions!
translation: Tercihen büyük bir savas ve bolca patlama olan bir tane!

english: ...You are a very strange young .
Could I have more of those ghostly robes you gave me?
translation: Bana verdigin hayalet gibi cüppelerden biraz daha alabilir miyim?

english: It seems as though the curse that keeps me here extends to my very clothing... which piece do you want?
translation: Beni burada tutan lanet giysilerime de bulasmis gibi görünüyor... Hangi parcayi istiyorsun?

english: Here you go.
Hey, I have something for you but you don't have any space for it!
translation: Hey, sana bir seyim var ama koyacak yerin yok!

english: Tell me your story
Goodbye then
Talk about Viggora's story.
Ask for more ghostly robes.
...You are a very strange young [man/woman].
What do you want, human?
Ehm, anything on offer?
Can you wield a warhammer? If not, then go away.
translation: Savas cekici kullanabilir misin? Kullanamazsan git buradan.

english: Of course I can.
I can, but I won't.
Yeah, right.
That furnace is the property of the Red Axe! Hands off!
translation: O firin Kizil Balta'nin mali! Ellerini cek!

english: That furnace is my property! Hands off!
translation: O firin benim malim! Ellerini cek!

english: Didn't all this belong to the Red Axe? And weren't you a member?
translation: Bunlarin hepsi Kizil Balta'ya ait degil miydi? Sen de üye degil miydin?

english: I don't know what you're talking about.
Who do you think are, coming in here and using the property of the Red Axe!
translation: Kim oldugunu saniyorsun da buraya gelip Kizil Balta'nin malini kullaniyorsun!

english: Who do you think are, coming in here and using my property?
translation: Kim oldugunu saniyorsun da buraya gelip benim malimi kullaniyorsun?

english: Hands off! That fireplace belongs to the Red Axe, not some puny arrogant human!
translation: Cek ellerini! O sömine Kizil Balta'nin mali, zavalli, kibirli bir insanin degil!

english: Hands off! That fireplace belongs to me! Not some puny arrogant human!
translation: Cek ellerini! O sömine benim malim! Zavalli, kibirli bir insanin degil!

english: Who gave you permission to use that?
translation: Onu kullanmak icin kim izin verdi sana?

english: Of course I can.
I can, but I won't.
I am offering a cart ride to Brimhaven, if you're interested. It will cost [amount] coins. Is that okay?
Yes please, I'd like to go to Brimhaven.

You hop into the cart and the driver urges the horses on. You take a taxing journey through the jungle to Brimhaven. You feel tired from the journey, but at least you didn't have to walk all that distance.
translation: Arabaya atliyorsunuz ve sürücü atlari sürmeye basliyor. Brimhaven'a gitmek icin orman icinden zorlu bir yolculuk yapiyorsunuz. Yolculuktan yorgun düsüyorsunuz, ama en azindan o kadar yolu yürümek zorunda kalmadiniz.

english: Sorry, but it looks as if you don't have enough money. Come and see me when you have enough for the ride.
translation: Üzgünüm, ama yeterli paraniz yok gibi görünüyor. Yeterli paraniz oldugunda gelip beni görün.

english: No thanks.
Okay, Bwana, let me know if you change your mind.
translation: Tamam, Bwana, fikrini degistirirsen bana haber ver.

english: I am offering a cart ride to Brimhaven, if you're interested. For you, it's free.
translation: Brimhaven'a arabayla götürürüm, ilgilenirsen. Senin icin ücretsiz.

english: Sorry, I'm busy. I've got to get out of here! This place is swarming with zombies.
translation: Üzgünüm, mesgulüm. Buradan gitmem lazim! Burasi zombilerle dolu.

english: Yes please, I'd like to go to Brimhaven.
No thanks.
Hello, how's it going?
Hello there! Nice weather we've been having.
All these newcomers - what are they up to?
translation: Bütün bu yeni gelenler neyin pesindeler?

english: What are you talking about?
Argh! Another one! No, I don't want to help with your scheme! I'm very busy!
translation: Ah! Bir tane daha! Hayir, planina yardim etmek istemiyorum! Cok mesgulüm!

english: Ohhh kaaay... I'll leave you to it then.
translation: Tamam... O zaman seni rahat birakayim.

english: I'm fine, how are you?
Very well, thank you.
Do you wish to trade?
No, I have nothing I wish to get rid of. If you want to do some trading, there are plenty of shops and market stalls around though.
translation: Hayir, elden cikarmak istedigim bir sey yok. Takas yapmak istersen, etrafta bircok dükkan ve pazar tezgahi var.

english: Argh! Don't rob me!
Sorry, I thought you were a bandit.
There are a lot of them around here...
None of your business.
Get out of my way, I'm in a hurry!
Not too bad, thanks.
