I'm in search of enemies to kill.
The desert just outside of town is full of wolves, snakes, and even wild Ugthanki. Try there.
translation: Kasabanin hemen disindaki cölde kurtlar, yilanlar ve hatta vahsi Ugthanki'ler var. Orayi dene.

english: I'm in search of a quest.
I'm sorry, I can't help you there.
translation: Üzgünüm, bu konuda sana yardimci olamam.

english: How can I help you?
Do I know you? I'm in a hurry!
I'm very well thank you.
Who are you?
I'm a bold adventurer.
Ah, a most noble profession.
Do you wish to trade?
I'm in search of a quest.
I'm in search of enemies to kill.
Nilsal, friend. How goes it?
Do you need any help in the vineyards?
Well we could always use a spare pair of hands!
translation: Ekstra bir cift ele her zaman ihtiyacimiz var!

english: Here, fill this barrel with four sets of ripe grapes and bring it back to me.
translation: Al, bu ficiyi dört set olgun üzümle doldur ve bana geri getir.

english: Got it! One barrel full of grapes coming right up.
translation: Anlasildi! Bir fici dolusu üzüm hemen geliyor.

english: Just remember, I need them to be ripe. Generally, perfectly ripe grapes are full and vibrant. They'll shine in the sunlight more than others.
translation: Unutma, üzümlerin olgun olmasi gerekiyor. Genellikle, mükemmel olgunlukta üzümler dolgun ve canlidir. Günes isiginda digerlerinden daha fazla parlarlar.

english: Hopefully you know what you’re doing now. Just fill this barrel with four sets of ripe grapes and bring it back to me.
translation: Umarim ne yapman gerektigini biliyorsundur. Bu ficiyi dört set olgun üzümle doldur ve bana geri getir.

english: We could always use a spare pair of hands! I have a grape barrel here for you, but you don't have enough room for it at the moment. Come back once you can carry it.
translation: Yardimci olacak birine her zaman ihtiyacimiz var! Senin icin bir üzüm ficisi var, ama su anda onu tasiyacak yerin yok. Tasiyabilecegin zaman geri gel.

english: You've already got that grape barrel I gave you. Fill it with four sets of ripe grapes and bring it back to me.
translation: Sana verdigim üzüm ficisi zaten sende. Onu dört set olgun üzümle doldur ve bana geri getir.

english: Doesn't it get hot standing out here all day?
translation: Bütün gün burada durmak sicak degil mi?

english: Ah, you get used to it. Besides, I have a near-infinite supply of lukewarm grape juice to keep me hydrated!
translation: Ah, alisirsin. Ayrica, susuz kalmamam icin neredeyse sonsuz miktarda ilik üzüm suyu var!

english: I'm good. I'll be going now.
One barrel o' grapes here for you, boss!
translation: Iste sana bir fici üzüm, patron!

english: Great work! Here, keep some grapes as payment.
translation: Harika is cikardin! Al, ödeme olarak biraz üzüm al.

english: Can I have some gold instead?
No.
Oh...
Now, if you're up for it, I wouldn't say no to you filling the barrel up again.
translation: Simdi, eger isterseniz, ficiyi tekrar doldurmaniza hayir demem.

english: Do you need any help in the vineyards?
Doesn't it get hot standing out here all day?
translation: Bütün gün burada durmak sicak degil mi?

english: I'm good. I'll be going now.
Hello there. How's it going?
Lovely day for some wine!
translation: Sarap icmek icin harika bir gün!

english: I wish these grapes could pick themselves.
The grapes are in good shape for this harvest.
translation: Üzümler bu hasat icin iyi durumda.

english: I'm sorry, but the vineyards need tending to.
Have you tried the wine? You won't regret it if you do!
translation: Sarabi denedin mi? Denersen pisman olmazsin!

english: Nilsal. Do you wish me to exchange banknotes for you? I charge only 10 coins for each banknote.
translation: Nilsal. Banknotlarini degistirmemi ister misin? Her banknot icin sadece 10 sikke aliyorum.

english: Yes please.
Then hand me the banknotes you wish me to exchange.
translation: O zaman bozdurmami istediginiz banknotlari verin.

english: Who are you?
I am Virilis. I can exchange banknotes of bones for real items. Do you want any banknotes converted?
translation: Ben Virilis. Kemik banknotlarini gercek esyalara bozdurabilirim. Banknotlarinizi bozdurmak ister misiniz?

english: What can I do here?
I'm glad you've asked! Next to me is an old altar of Ralos, upon which you can ask for bones and wines to be blessed.
translation: Sordugunuz icin tesekkürler! Yanimda Ralos'un eski bir sunagi var, üzerinde kemiklerin ve saraplarin kutsanmasini isteyebilirsiniz.

english: You should beware though, Ralos won't hear your prayers if you aren't experienced enough. I wouldn't want you to get caught in the cold just waiting for nothing to happen.
translation: Ancak dikkatli olmalisin, yeterince deneyimli degilsen Ralos dualarini duymaz. Hicbir sey olmamasi icin sogukta bekleyip donmani istemem.

english: Anyway, once you've had Ralos' blessing, you can break the bones down into shards. Then, along with your blessed wine, you can take them to the libation bowl and sacrifice them in Ralos' honour!
translation: Her neyse, Ralos'un kutsamasini aldiktan sonra kemikleri parcalara ayirabilirsin. Sonra kutsanmis sarabinla birlikte onlari libasyon kasesine götürüp Ralos'un serefine kurban edebilirsin!

english: Libation bowl?
Yes! You'll find it inside the Teomat, near the library.
translation: Evet! Teomat'in icinde, kütüphanenin yaninda bulabilirsiniz.

english: I see. And what happens if I drink the blessed wine?
translation: Anliyorum. Kutsanmis sarabi icersem ne olur?

english: The last person to try that ended up in the libation bowl. I do not recommend it.
translation: Bunu deneyen son kisi libasyon kasesine düstü. Tavsiye etmem.

english: Anyway, do you want any banknotes converted?
No thanks.
I'm afraid I can only exchange bank notes for real items.
translation: Korkarim ki banknotlari sadece gercek esyalarla degistirebilirim.

english: I only exchange bones that you can bless at Ralos' altar.
translation: Sadece Ralos'un sunakinda kutsayabileceginiz kemikleri degistiririm.

english: I require 10 coins for exchanging each banknote.
translation: Her banknotu degistirmek icin 10 sikke istiyorum.

english: Your inventory is too full.
Yes please.
Who are you?
What can I do here?
No thanks.
I don't want whatever it is you're selling.
But I'm not selling anything.
You think I believe that? Why else would you be here?
translation: Buna inanacagimi mi saniyorsun? Yoksa neden burada olasin ki?

english: Just seeing the sights?
What sights? What's wrong with you.
Nothing...
Get out, you weirdo!
Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: Insan! Muhafizlari cagirmadan köle kafeslerine geri dön!

english: What is it, human? Speak and begone, your presence disgusts me!
translation: Ne var, insan? Konus ve git, varligin beni igrendiriyor!

english: Oh, uh, I'm sorry.
Stop your muttering and get to the point!
W-Who are you?
I am the Voice of Yama.
Yama?
Yama is my master, a powerful demon of fire.
translation: Yama benim efendim, güclü bir ates iblisi.

english: Why can't Yama speak for themself?
Currently my master resides below us, building strength. Worry not, human, my master will eventually own your soul too.
translation: Su anda efendim bizim altimizda, güc topluyor. Endiselenme insan, efendim sonunda senin ruhunu da ele gecirecek.

english: I'll be leaving now.
I suspect you should.
You must complete A Kingdom Divided to access Yama's domain.
translation: Yama'nin bölgesine erismek icin Bölünmüs Krallik görevini tamamlamalisin.

english: The arrogant human finally arrives...
Upset that I disrupted your plans?
Disgusting. My master, the great demon Yama, wishes to speak with you.
translation: Igrenc. Efendim, büyük iblis Yama, seninle konusmak istiyor.

english: Yama wants to speak with me? How do you know that? You shouldn't even be able to talk to him.
translation: Yama benimle konusmak mi istiyor? Bunu nereden biliyorsun? Sen onunla konusamazsin ki.

english: My master wishes to have the satisfaction of explaining that to you himself. For this, I envy him. I will make do with the idiotic expression you wear presently.
translation: Efendim bunu sana kendisi aciklamaktan memnuniyet duyar. Bu yüzden onu kiskaniyorum. Su anda yüzündeki aptal ifadeyle yetinecegim.

english: I planted the device! Your connection should be severed!
translation: Cihazi ben yerlestirdim! Baglantin kesilmis olmali!

english: Silence, human! You will make no demands of me. Proceed to my master's domain and speak with him yourself if you desire an answer.
translation: Sessiz ol, insan! Benden hicbir talepte bulunmayacaksin. Bir cevap istiyorsan, efendimin diyarinda onunla kendin konus.

english: Player is transported to Yama's Domain.
You enter Yama's Domain.
I think I'd rather stay here.
Weakness! Cowardice! Disgusting. Begone, human!
Proceed or begone, human. I will not bear your foul presence any longer than is necessary.
translation: Devam et ya da git, insan. Senin igrenc varligini gereginden fazla tahammül edemem.

english: Enter Yama's domain.
Stay.
The purple, western portal shield is down!
The blue, eastern portal shield is down!
The yellow, south-eastern portal shield is down!
The red, south-western portal shield is down!
Sorry, outlander, but I have things to be doing.
translation: Üzgünüm, yabanci, ama yapmam gereken isler var.

english: Hello there. Enjoying the view?
Yes I am. You have a lovely yurt.
translation: Evet, begendim. Cok güzel bir cadirin var.

english: Thanks! I exercise it regularly.
Hello again! Does my father send any word...or treasures like before?
translation: Merhaba tekrar! Babam haber gönderdi mi... ya da eskisi gibi hazineler?

english: Not today, but if he does, you will be the first to know.
translation: Bugün göndermedi, ama gönderirse ilk bilen sen olacaksin.

english: Volf? Son of Olaf Hradson?
Yes. Do I know you?
No, but I do know your father. He sent me with a present for you from, err...
translation: Hayir, ama babani taniyorum. Sana bir hediye gönderdi, seyden...

english: From the Island of Obscurity.
Oh! That was fast! He only set off recently, and I was wondering how he was doing. So, where is this gift?
translation: Oh! Cok hizli oldu! Daha yeni yola cikti, nasil oldugunu merak ediyordum. Peki, hediye nerede?

english: Right here. Enjoy!
What is it?
Very valuable. Have a nice time!
Wait! Here, take this. I was going to have it for my lunch, but I suppose you can have it in payment.
translation: Bekle! Al sunu. Ögle yemeginde yiyecektim ama sanirim ödeme olarak alabilirsin.

english: Thanks! Enjoy your new...thing!
Hey! I'm [Vampyre name]. What's your name?
Von van Von.
I'm sorry... What?
Did I stutter? My name is Von van Von.
translation: Kekeledim mi? Adim Von van Von.

english: Your name is Von van Von?
Yes.
Sorry, just to clarify. Von van Von? That's your name?
translation: Pardon, sadece netlestirmek icin. Von van Von mu? Adin bu mu?

english: Yes! Is there a problem?
Well... I guess not.
Good! Now leave me alone!
Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: Insan! Muhafizlari cagirmadan köle kafeslerine geri dön!

english: Get out of my house!
But I...
But nothing! Get out!
Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: Insan! Muhafizlari cagirmadan köle kafeslerine geri dön!

english: Hey Vorki, got any interesting dragon facts?
translation: Hey Vorki, ejderhalar hakkinda ilginc bilgiler var mi?

english: Although they have wings, dragons rarely fly. This is because the animals they prey on are all ground dwelling.
translation: Kanatlari olmasina ragmen ejderhalar nadiren ucarlar. Bunun nedeni, avladiklari hayvanlarin hepsinin yerde yasamasidir.

english: Unlike their creators, dragons have the ability to reproduce. Like most reptiles, they are oviparous. This means that they lay eggs rather than birthing live young.
translation: Yaraticilarinin aksine ejderhalar üreme yetenegine sahiptir. Cogu sürüngen gibi, onlar da yumurtlayan hayvanlardir. Bu, canli yavru dogurmak yerine yumurta biraktiklari anlamina gelir.

english: Dragons have a very long lifespan and can live for thousands of years. With a lifespan that long, most dragons die to combat instead of age.
translation: Ejderhalarin ömrü cok uzundur ve binlerce yil yasayabilirler. Ömürleri bu kadar uzun oldugu icin, cogu ejderha yasliliktan degil, savasta ölür.

english: While very closely related, dragons and wyverns are actually different species. You can easily tell the difference between them by counting the number of legs, dragons have four while wyverns have two.
translation: Ejderhalar ve wyvernler cok yakindan akraba olsalar da, aslinda farkli türlerdir. Bacak sayilarini sayarak aralarindaki farki kolayca anlayabilirsiniz; ejderhalarin dört bacagi varken, wyvernlerin iki bacagi vardir.

english: Metallic dragons were created by inserting molten metal into the eggs of other dragons. Very few eggs survived this process.
translation: Metalik ejderhalar, diger ejderhalarin yumurtalarina erimis metal ekleyerek yaratilmistir. Bu islemden cok az yumurta sag cikmistir.

english: The dragonkin created dragons by fusing their own lifeblood with that of a lizard. The dragonkin created other species in similar ways by using different types of reptile.
translation: Ejderhalar, kendi kanlarini bir kertenkelenin kaniyla birlestirerek yaratilmistir. Ejderhalar, farkli türdeki sürüngenleri kullanarak benzer sekilde baska türler de yaratmistir.

english: Dragons have the ability to speak. However, most dragons don't have the brain capacity to do it very well.
translation: Ejderhalar konusma yetenegine sahiptir. Ancak cogu ejderha, bunu cok iyi yapabilecek beyin kapasitesine sahip degildir.

english: Dragons share their name with dragon equipment, which was also created by the dragonkin. This equipment is fashioned out of Orikalkum.
translation: Ejderhalar, yine ejderhalar tarafindan yaratilan ejderha ekipmanlariyla ayni adi paylasir. Bu ekipmanlar Orikalkum'dan yapilmistir.

english: Although very aggressive, dragons do not typically stray from their own territory. They instead make their homes in places where there is plenty of prey to be found.
translation: Ejderhalar cok saldirgan olsalar da, genellikle kendi bölgelerinden uzaklasmazlar. Bunun yerine, bol miktarda av bulabilecekleri yerlerde yuvalarini kurarlar.

english: Dragons have a duct in their mouth from which they can expel various internally produced fluids. The most common of these is a fluid which ignites when it reacts with air. This is how dragons breathe fire.
translation: Ejderhalarin agizlarinda, iclerinde ürettikleri cesitli sivilari disari atabilecekleri bir kanal vardir. Bunlarin en yaygin olani, hava ile reaksiyona girdiginde alev alan bir sividir. Ejderhalar bu sekilde ates püskürürler.

english: Grrrr!
Bleugh!
Rawrrr!
What are you drinking?
Blood!
How are you getting drunk on blood?
They keep some of the tithes drunk all the time and then take it from them.
translation: Vergilerin bir kismini sürekli sarhos tutuyorlar ve sonra onlardan aliyorlar.

english: How very creative.
I know right! Bloody brilliant!
Hello.
I'll have a pint please.
I don't work here.
Sure you do!
No, I really don't.
Well clear off then.
Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: Insan! Muhafizlari cagirmadan köle kafeslerine geri dön!

english: Hello there. Who are you?
I am Vortas quo Keran. I am an artisan of the Kahlith. Have you come to serve the balance?
translation: Ben Vortas quo Keran. Kahlith'in zanaatkâriyim. Dengeyi saglamak icin mi geldin?

english: Yes.
Then you should speak to Konar quo Maten. She will guide you.
translation: O zaman Konar quo Maten ile konusmalisin. O sana yol gösterecektir.

english: No.
A shame. You are a bringer of death, you could be of great use to the balance.
translation: Yazik. Sen ölümün habercisiisin, denge icin cok yararli olabilirdin.

english: I'm not sure.
Then you should speak with Xorrah quo Sihar. He will show you the way.
translation: O zaman Xorrah quo Sihar ile konusmalisin. O sana yolu gösterecektir.

english: Yes.
No.
I'm not sure.
Humans!
Destroy them! Our king must be freed!
It will be done.
With me [Fremennik name]! Let's kill these foul beasts!
translation: Benimle gel Dokrak! Bu igrenc canavarlari öldürelim!

english: Hey.
Yes?
What's there to do around here?
Eat, drink and...
Sounds great! I'll be sure to try those things.
translation: Kulaga harika geliyor! Bunlari mutlaka deneyecegim.

english: Okay...
Hey there.
Hmmm?
What are you doing?
Nothing.
Sounds fun.
It is.
What are you looking at?
You.
Why?
Why not?
I guess. It's a bit weird though.
Many would say the same about drinking blood. What do they know though?
translation: Bircogu kan icmek hakkinda da ayni seyi söyler. Onlar ne bilir ki?

english: Well it's their loss.
There's nothing to do in this city. Might be time to give the theatre a visit.
translation: Bu sehirde yapacak bir sey yok. Tiyatroya gitme zamani gelmis olabilir.

english: I hear it's all the rage.
Indeed it is. I'd recommend going yourself if you haven't been before.
translation: Gercekten öyle. Daha önce gitmediysen, gitmeni tavsiye ederim.

english: I've been a few times. Always worth another trip though. See you around.
translation: Birkac kez gittim. Her zaman tekrar gitmeye deger. Görüsürüz.

english: Hey. Anything interesting going on around here?
translation: Selam. Buralarda ilginc bir sey var mi?

english: Well rumour is that there's some plans for a new tithing project. Apparently, they're going to put the humans in boxes and drain their blood over time to be collected in batches.
translation: Söylentilere göre yeni bir vergi projesi planlaniyormus. Görünüse göre, insanlari kutulara koyup zamanla kanlarini bosaltarak toplu olarak toplayacaklar.

english: I hear they're calling it the Tithe Farm.
That sounds... great. Although, I have heard of another Tithe Farm very far from here.
translation: Kulaga... harika geliyor. Gerci, buradan cok uzaklarda baska bir Tithe Ciftligi oldugunu duydum.

english: Ah, the one that runs it must also be a vyre of culture.
translation: Ah, onu isleten de kültür meraklisi bir vyre olmali.

english: Err... Yeah...
Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: Insan! Muhafizlari cagirmadan önce köle kafeslerine geri dön!

english: Only the Theatre can free you!
Verzik Vitur cordially invites you to the Theatre.
translation: Verzik Vitur sizi Tiyatroya davet ediyor.

english: Welcome, one and all, to the Theatre of Blood.
Glory awaits those who enter the Theatre!
Prove your worth in the Theatre!
I do enjoy a day out at the Theatre.
translation: Tiyatroda gecirdigim günlerden cok keyif aliyorum.

english: Will you be entering the Theatre? It will be fun to watch you die.
translation: Tiyatroya girecek misin? Ölmeni izlemek eglenceli olacak.

english: Get lost!
Leave me alone food sack!
Come to see this show? I bet it's going to be a good one.
translation: Bu gösteriyi izlemeye mi geldin? Eminim cok güzel olacaktir.

english: I do enjoy a day out at the Theatre.
Will you be entering the Theatre? It will be fun to watch you die.
translation: Tiyatroya girecek misin? Ölmeni izlemek cok eglenceli olacak.

english: Get lost!
Leave me alone food sack!
Come to see this show? I bet it's going to be a good one.
translation: Bu gösteriyi izlemeye mi geldin? Eminim cok güzel olacaktir.

english: Clear off food sack.
Hello?
Get lost, food sack!
Get out of my face, meat sack, I don't 'play' with my food.
translation: Yüzümden cekil, et cuvali, ben yemegimle “oynamam”.

english: Get about your business, meat sack, before I perforate you real good!
translation: Isine bak, et cuvali, yoksa seni iyice delik desik ederim!

english: Send me to the mines!
Very well...
Sorry.
I want a word with you!
Stand where you are!
Halt! Halt, I say!
Slurp! You look positively delicious - let me help you lose a bit of weight! Either I get a bite or you can go to the mines; which is it to be, meat sack?
translation: Slurp! Cok lezzetli görünüyorsun, biraz kilo vermen icin sana yardim edeyim! Ya bir isirik alirim ya da madenlere gidersin, hangisini seciyorsun, et torbasi?

english: Hmm, you look like a tasty specimen - in fact I'm quite peckish right now. You can either go to the mines or give me a bite; what do you say?
translation: Hmm, lezzetli bir örnek gibi görünüyorsun, aslinda su anda oldukca acim. Ya madenlere gidersin ya da bana bir isirik verirsin, ne dersin?

english: Ooh, a meat sack... I could just do with a snack. What's it to be: some time in the mines or do I get a bite?
translation: Ooh, bir et torbasi... Atistirmalik bir seyler iyi olurdu. Ne olacak: madenlere mi gideceksin yoksa bir isirik mi alacagim?

english: Okay, have a bite.
The Vyrewatch bites the player, draining their blood and damaging them.
translation: Vyrewatch oyuncuyu isirir, kanini emer ve ona zarar verir.

english: The Vyrewatch teleports the player to the Meiyerditch mine
Hey, look over there!
Ha! I'm not falling for that! Prepare to be tithed...
translation: Ha! Buna kanmam! Vergi ödemeye hazirlan...

english: What? What? Where?
The player runs away a short distance while the Vyrewatch is distracted.
translation: Vyrewatch'in dikkati dagildigi sirada oyuncu kisa bir mesafe kacar.

english: Could you send me to the mines?
You want to go to the mines? Well that's a new one. You asked for it though...
translation: Madenlere mi gitmek istiyorsun? Bu yeni bir sey. Sen istedin...

english: Let's fight, you evil bloodsucker!
translation: Hadi savasalim, seni kötü kan emici!

english: Impressive. Not many of you have the spine for it, these days!
translation: Etkileyici. Bugünlerde pek cok kisinin buna cesareti yok!

english: Hello.
Need something?
Very well.
Nope. I'm good.
Give me your best shot, you evil bloodsucker!
translation: En iyi vurusunu yap, seni kötü kan emici!

english: Could you escort me to the mines?
Yes. I can provide you with a teleport there.
I'm good.
Send me to the mines.
Sorry.
Could you send me to the mines?
Let's fight, you evil bloodsucker!
translation: Hadi savasalim, seni kötü kan emici!

english: Nope. I'm good.
Could you escort me to the mines?
I'm good.
What was I talking about, now?
Weren't you going to tell me about the rumour?
Oh yeah, that was it!
Carry on.
It's about the new family.
That joined our horde?
The very same!
Oh my! Do tell.
I were hangin' out me washin'.
Yes...
And I looked over at-
I'm listening.
Wait, we're being watched!
We are?
Yes, a person over there.
Where?
No! Don't make eye contact.
Oh my!
They're listening to us.
A goblin folk?
Oh no! It's one of those tall people.
translation: Hayir! O uzun boylu insanlardan biri.

english: Bizarre creatures for sure.
Makes my skin crawl to see them.
translation: Onlari görmek tüylerimi diken diken ediyor.

english: Why?
So tall and neat.
For sure, my dear.
I hope it doesn't come to speak with us.
What a horrid thought!
Horrid indeed, my dear.
What should we do?
Let us carry on our conversation.
Let's!
So...
Yes?
Die, foul demon!
Now, what was that incantation again?
[word 1]... [word 2]... [word 3]... [word 4]... [word 5]!
I am the greatest demon slayer EVER!
translation: Ben gelmis gecmis en büyük seytan avcisiyim!

english: I probably shouldn't break into a house in full view of a guard.
translation: Muhtemelen bir muhafizin gözü önünde bir eve zorla girmemeliyim.

english: I definitely wouldn't recommend it.
Is it here? Is it there? Is it elsewhere?
translation: Burada mi? Orada mi? Baska bir yerde mi?

english: Is what where?
This gate's sister...
I didn't know gates had relations.
Oh yes. This one here - she is calm and boring. She stays here all the time. She doesn't like to move, but her sister is fidgety and refuses to stay in the same place for more than half an hour.
translation: Evet. Buradaki bu kapi sakin ve sikicidir. Hep burada durur. Hareket etmeyi sevmez, ama kardesi yerinde duramayan biridir ve yarim saatten fazla ayni yerde kalmayi reddeder.

english: So where is the, errr, fidgety sister at the moment?
translation: Peki, yerinde duramayan kardes su anda nerede?

english: Oh well. I don't know what you humans call these places. Let me show you.
translation: Oh, peki. Siz insanlarin bu yerlere ne dediginizi bilmiyorum. Size göstereyim.

english: Cutscene plays showing the location of the crop circle.
translation: Ekin cemberinin yerini gösteren bir kesit oynatilir.

english: Oh she's asleep at the moment. I'm sure she'll go somewhere in the next half an hour though.
translation: Oh, su anda uyuyor. Ama eminim yarim saat icinde bir yere gidecektir.

english: I cannot show you this gate's sister on this world.
translation: Bu kapinin kardesini bu dünyada size gösteremem.

english: Your teleport is blocked as you haven't unlocked access to the [region name] area.
translation: [Bölge adi] alanina erisim kilidini acmadiginiz icin isinlanmaniz engellenmistir.

english: Yes? Do you have business with one of the prisoners?
translation: Evet? Mahkumlardan biriyle isiniz mi var?

english: I don't think so. What are they in for?
Does it matter? They are criminals.
Are all criminals the same?
They will be if they're found guilty.
What happens if they are?
In most cases, death.
Ah, nice. Bit brutal though, right?
translation: Ah, güzel. Biraz acimasiz ama, degil mi?

english: Brutal? Yes. Effective? Yes.
translation: Acimasiz mi? Evet. Etkili mi? Evet.

english: Fair enough.
Hello there traveller.
What are you camped here for?
We're looking for Zanaris...GAH! I mean we're not here for any particular reason at all.
translation: Zanaris'i ariyoruz... GAH! Yani, burada özel bir nedenimiz yok.

english: Who's Zanaris?
Ahahahaha! Zanaris isn't a person! It's a magical hidden city filled with treasures and rich.. uh, nothing. It's nothing.
translation: Ahahahaha! Zanaris bir kisi degil! Hazinelerle ve zenginlikle dolu gizli bir sehir... uh, hicbir sey. Hicbir sey.

english: If it's hidden how are you planning to find it?
Well, we don't want to tell anyone else about that, because we don't want anyone else sharing in all that glory and treasure.
translation: Sey, bunu kimseye söylemek istemiyoruz, cünkü o ihtisami ve hazineleri kimseyle paylasmak istemiyoruz.

english: Well, it looks to me like YOU don't know EITHER seeing as you're all just sat around here.
translation: Bana öyle geliyor ki, siz de bilmiyorsunuz, cünkü hepiniz burada oturmus bekliyorsunuz.

english: Of course we know! We just haven't found which tree the stupid leprechaun's hiding in yet!
translation: Tabii ki biliyoruz! Sadece o aptal cinin hangi agacin icinde saklandigini henüz bulamadik!

english: Leprechaun?
GAH! I didn't mean to tell you that! Look, just forget I said anything okay?
translation: GAH! Sana söylemek istemedim! Bak, söylediklerimi unut, tamam mi?

english: So a leprechaun knows where Zanaris is eh?
translation: Demek cüce Zanaris'in yerini biliyor, ha?

english: Ye.. uh, no. No, not at all. And even if he did - which he doesn't - he DEFINITELY ISN'T hiding in some tree around here. Nope, definitely not. Honestly.
translation: Ye... uh, hayir. Hayir, hic de degil. Ve biliyor olsa bile - ki bilmiyor - kesinlikle buradaki agaclarin arasinda saklanmiyor. Hayir, kesinlikle degil. Gercekten.

english: Thanks for the help!
Help? What help? I didn't help! Please don't say I did, I'll get in trouble!
translation: Yardim mi? Ne yardimi? Ben yardim etmedim! Lütfen yardim ettigimi söyleme, basim belaya girer!

english: So let me get this straight: I need to search the trees around here for a leprechaun; and then when I find him, he will tell me where this 'Zanaris' is?
translation: Sunu bir netlestirelim: Buradaki agaclari leprechaun icin aramam gerekiyor; ve onu buldugumda, bana bu “Zanaris”in nerede oldugunu söyleyecek mi?

english: What? How did you know that? Uh... I mean, no, no you're very wrong. Very wrong, and not right at all, and I definitely didn't tell you about that at all.
translation: Ne? Bunu nereden biliyorsun? Uh... Yani, hayir, hayir, cok yaniliyorsun. Cok yaniliyorsun, hic de dogru degil ve ben sana kesinlikle bundan bahsetmedim.

english: Right... Well good luck with it.
There's no such thing!
When we've found Zanaris you'll... GAH! I mean, we're not here for any particular reason at all.
translation: Zanaris'i buldugumuzda sen... GAH! Yani, biz burada özel bir amac icin bulunmuyoruz.

english: What's Zanaris?
I don't think we want other people competing with us to find it. Forget I said anything.
translation: Baskalarinin bizimle rekabet etmesini istemiyoruz. Söylediklerimi unut.

english: Oh well. Never mind.
What makes you think it's out here?
Don't you know of the legends that tell of the magical city, hidden in the swam... Uh, no, you're right, we're wasting our time here.
translation: Bataklikta gizlenmis sihirli sehirle ilgili efsaneleri bilmiyor musun... Uh, hayir, haklisin, burada zamanimizi bosa harciyoruz.

english: Do you know any good adventures I can go on?
translation: Gidebilecegim iyi bir macera biliyor musun?

english: Well we're on an adventure right now. Mind you, this is OUR adventure and we don't want to share it - find your own!
translation: Su anda bir maceranin icindeyiz. Unutma, bu bizim maceramiz ve paylasmak istemiyoruz - kendin bul!

english: Please tell me?
No.
Please?
No!
PLEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEASE?
NO!
I don't think you've found a good adventure at all!
translation: Bence hic iyi bir macera bulamadin!

english: Hah! Adventurers of our calibre don't just hang around in forests for fun, whelp!
translation: Hah! Bizim kalibremizdeki maceracilar eglence icin ormanda dolasmazlar, velet!

english: Oh really?
Have you found anything yet?
We're still searching for Zanaris...GAH! I mean we're not doing anything here at all.
translation: Hala Zanaris'i ariyoruz... GAH! Yani burada hicbir sey yapmiyoruz.

english: I haven't found it yet either.
Hey, thanks for all the information. It REALLY helped me out in finding the lost city of Zanaris and all.
translation: Hey, tüm bilgiler icin tesekkürler. Kayip sehir Zanaris'i bulmamda bana GERCEKTEN yardimci oldu.

english: Oh please don't say that anymore! If the rest of my party knew I'd helped you they'd probably throw me out and make me walk home by myself!
translation: Lütfen bunu bir daha söyleme! Eger diger arkadaslarim sana yardim ettigimi bilselerdi, muhtemelen beni kovup eve yürüyerek gitmemi isterlerdi!

english: You know.... I think I'll keep that to myself.
translation: Biliyor musun... Sanirim bunu kendime saklayacagim.

english: So anyway, what have you found out? Where is the fabled Zanaris? Is it all the legends say it is?
translation: Neyse, ne buldun? Efsanevi Zanaris nerede? Efsanelerde anlatildigi gibi mi?

english: What are you camped out here for?
Who's Zanaris?
If it's hidden how are you planning to find it?
translation: Eger gizliyse, onu nasil bulmayi planliyorsunuz?

english: Please tell me.
Looks like you don't know either.
Yes.
No
There's no such thing.
What's Zanaris?
What makes you think it's out here?
Oh well. Never mind.
There's no such thing!
Do you know any good adventures I can go on?
translation: Gidebilecegim iyi bir macera biliyor musun?

english: I don't think you've found a good adventure at all!
translation: Bence hic iyi bir macera bulamadin!

english: Who are you? Are you one of the new guards?
translation: Kimsin sen? Yeni muhafizlardan biri misin?

english: No, I'm an adventurer.
Well what are you doing here?
Looking for adventures - what else?
translation: Macera ariyorum, baska ne olabilir ki?

english: Oh my, oh my! What does it all matter in the end, anyway?
translation: Aman Tanrim, aman Tanrim! Sonucta bunlarin ne önemi var ki?

english: What's the matter?
Oh dear, oh dear. Darn and drat!
translation: Aman Tanrim, aman Tanrim. Kahretsin, lanet olsun!

english: We try hard to keep this town protected.
translation: Bu kasabayi korumak icin elimizden geleni yapiyoruz.

english: But how can we do that when the Watchtower isn't working?
translation: Ama Gözetleme Kulesi calismiyorken bunu nasil yapabiliriz?

english: What do you mean it isn't working?
The Watchtower over here works by the power of magic. An ancient spell designed to ward off ogres that has been in place here for many moons.
translation: Buradaki Gözetleme Kulesi sihirin gücüyle calisir. Uzun zamandir burada bulunan, ogreleri uzak tutmak icin tasarlanmis eski bir büyü.

english: The exact knowledge of the spell is lost to us now, but the essence of the spell has been infused into four powering crystals that keep the tower protected from the hordes in the Feldips.
translation: Büyünün tam olarak nasil yapildigi artik bilinmiyor, ama büyünün özü, kuleyi Feldips'teki ordulardan koruyan dört güc kristaline aktarilmis.

english: So how come the spell doesn't work?
The crystals! The crystals have been taken!
Taken?
Stolen!
Stolen?
Yes, yes! Do I have to repeat myself?
Can I be of help?
Help? Oh wonderful, dear traveller!
Yes I could do with an extra pair of eyes here.
translation: Evet, burada fazladan bir cift göze ihtiyacim var.???

english: There must be some evidence of what has happened here. Perhaps you could assist me in searching for clues?
translation: Burada olanlarla ilgili bazi kanitlar olmali. Belki ipuclarini aramama yardim edersiniz?

english: I would be happy to.
Try searching the surrounding area. If you find anything unusual, bring it here. Try the bushes - I've read enough adventure stoies to know that clues get caught in bushes all the time.
translation: Cevrede arama yapin. Olagandisi bir sey bulursaniz buraya getirin. Calilari kontrol edin. Yeterince macera hikayesi okudum, ipuclarinin her zaman calilarda saklandigini biliyorum.

english: I will tell the guards to let you past - that way, you can just use the ladder to get in and out.
translation: Muhafizlara seni gecirmelerini söyleyecegim - böylece merdiveni kullanarak iceri girip cikabilirsin.

english: I'm not interested.
That's typical, nowadays. It's left to us wizards to do all the work.
translation: Bu günümüzde cok yaygin bir durum. Bütün isi biz büyücülere birakiyorlar.

english: I'm not interested in your rantings.
Hmph! Suit yourself.
You wizards are always complaining.
Complaining? Complaining!
What folks these days don't realise is that if it weren't for us wizards, this entire world would be overrun with every creature you could possibly imagine. And some you couldn't even conceive of!
translation: Günümüzde insanlar, biz büyücüler olmasaydik, tüm dünyanin hayal edebileceginiz her türlü yaratikla dolup tasacagini fark etmiyorlar. Hatta hayal bile edemeyeceginiz yaratiklarla!

english: Hello again. Did you find anything of interest?
translation: Merhaba tekrar. Ilginc bir sey buldun mu?

english: No, sorry, nothing yet.
translation: Hayir, üzgünüm, henüz bir sey yok.

english: Oh dear, oh dear, there must be something, somewhere...
translation: Oh hayir, oh hayir, bir yerlerde bir sey olmali...

english: Have a look at these...
Interesting, very interesting.
Long nails...grey in colour...well chewed...
translation: Uzun tirnaklar... gri renkli... iyice cignenmis...

english: Of course! They belong to a skavid!
translation: Tabii ya! Bunlar bir skavidin tirnaklari!

english: A skavid?
A servent race to the ogres: grey, depressed-looking creatures, always losing nails, teeth and hair!
translation: Ogrelerin hizmetkar irki: gri, depresif görünümlü yaratiklar, sürekli tirnaklarini, dislerini ve saclarini kaybederler!

english: They inhabit the caves in the Feldip Hills.
They normally keep to themselves, though. It's unusual for them to venture from their caves.
translation: Ama normalde kendi hallerinde yasarlar. Magaralarindan cikmalari alisilmadik bir durumdur.

english: What do you suggest I do?
Shall I search the caves?
It's no good searching the caves. Well, not yet, anyway.
translation: Magaralari aramak ise yaramaz. En azindan simdilik.

english: Why not?
They are deep and complex. The only way you will navigate the caves is to have a map or something.
translation: Derin ve karmasiktirlar. Magaralarda yolunuzu bulabilmenin tek yolu bir harita veya benzeri bir sey edinmektir.

english: It may be that the ogres have one...
And how do you know that?
Well... I don't.
You need to be fearless and gain entrance to Gu'Tanoth, the city of the ogres, then find out how to navigate the caves.
translation: Korkusuz olmalisin ve ogrelerin sehri Gu'Tanoth'a girip magaralarda yolunu bulmalisin.

english: That sounds scary...
Ogres are nasty creatures, yes. Only a strong warrior, and a clever one at that, can get the better of them.
translation: Ogreler kötü yaratiklardir, evet. Sadece güclü ve zeki bir savasci onlari yenebilir.

english: What do I need to do to get into the city?
translation: Sehre girmek icin ne yapmam gerekiyor?

english: You'll need some way to make the guards let you in.
translation: Muhafizlarin seni iceri almasi icin bir yol bulmalisin.

english: You could start by checking out the ogres settlements around here. Tribal ogres often dislike their neighbours... In the meantime, I'll throw those fingernails out for you.
translation: Buradaki ogre yerlesimlerini kontrol etmekle baslayabilirsin. Kabile ogreleri genellikle komsularini sevmezler... Bu arada, o tirnaklari senin icin atacagim.

english: (The fingernails are removed from your inventory)
Won't bother? Won't bother!
Perhaps this quest is too hard for you!
translation: Belki de bu görev senin icin cok zor!

english: How's it going?
I am having difficulty with the tribes.
Talk to them face to face and don't show any fear. Make sure you are rested and well fed, and fight the good fight!
translation: Onlarla yüz yüze konus ve korkunu gösterme. Dinlenmis ve iyi beslenmis ol, ve iyi savas!

english: I have everything under control.
Good, good! I will expect the crystals back shortly then...
translation: Güzel, güzel! O zaman kristalleri yakinda geri alacagim...

english: I have lost something the ogres gave to me.
translation: Ogrelerin bana verdigi bir seyi kaybettim.

english: Oh, deary me! Well, there's nothing I can do about that. You will have to go back to them, I'm afraid.
translation: Oh, hay Allah! Eh, bu konuda yapabilecegim bir sey yok. Korkarim onlara geri dönmen gerekecek.

english: An ogre called Og gave me this...
translation: Og adinda bir ogre bana bunu verdi...

english: Ah, it's part of an old ogre statue. I'll take that off you - it might come in handy if I can fix it up.
translation: Ah, bu eski bir ogre heykelinin parcasi. Onu senden alacagim, tamir edersem isime yarayabilir.

english: (Dialogue continues)
An ogre called Grew gave me this...
translation: Grew adinda bir ogre bana bunu verdi...

english: Ah, it's more of that old ogre statue. I'll take this bit too.
translation: Ah, bu da o eski ogre heykelinin bir parcasi. Bunu da alacagim.

english: An ogre called Toban gave me this...
translation: Toban adinda bir ogre bana bunu verdi...

english: It looks like you've brought me all the pieces of the relic. It is as I thought - a statue symbolising an ogre warrior of old.
translation: Görünüse göre bana kalintinin tüm parcalarini getirdin. Düsündügüm gibi - eski bir ogre savascisini simgeleyen bir heykel.

english: Well, if you ever want to make friends with an ogre, this is the item to have! Now I'll try to assemble it...
translation: Eger bir ogre ile arkadas olmak istersen, bu esya tam sana göre! Simdi onu birlestirmeye calisacagim...

english: Ah, the warrior returns. Have you found a way into Gu'Tanoth yet?
translation: Ah, savasci geri döndü. Gu'Tanoth'a girmenin bir yolunu buldun mu?

english: I can't get past the guards.
Well, ogres dislike others apart from their own kind. What you need is some form of proof of friendship, something to trick them into believing you're their friend.
translation: Ogreler kendi türlerinden baska kimseyi sevmezler. Sana gereken sey, dostlugunu kanitlayacak bir sey, onlari senin dostlari olduguna inandiracak bir sey.

english: Which shouldn't be too hard, considering their intelligence.
translation: Zekalarini düsünürsek, bu cok da zor olmamali.

english: I have lost the relic you have me.
Have you gone mad? I can see you have it with you!
What? Lost the relic? How careless! It's a good job I copied its design, then! You can take this copy instead - it's just as good.
translation: Ne? Kalintiyi mi kaybettin? Ne dikkatsizsin! Iyi ki tasarimini kopyalamisim! Bunun yerine bu kopyayi alabilirsin, ayni derecede iyidir.

english: The wizard gives you another statue.
translation: Büyücü sana baska bir heykel verir.

english: I will find my way in, no problem.
translation: Iceri girmenin bir yolunu bulacagim, sorun degil.

english: Yes, I'm sure you will... Good luck!
I have found the cave of ogre shaman, but I cannot touch them!
translation: Ogre samaninin magarasini buldum, ama onlara dokunamiyorum!

english: That is because of their magical powers. We must fight them with their own methods; do not speak to them! I suggest a potion...
translation: Bunun nedeni onlarin sihirli gücleri. Onlarla kendi yöntemleriyle savasmaliyiz; onlarla konusmayin! Bir iksir öneriyorum...

english: Collect a guam leaf, add jangerberries, then mix in some ground bat bones. You must return it to me before you use it, so that I can empower it with my magic.
translation: Guam yapragi toplayin, jangerberry ekleyin, sonra biraz ögütülmüs yarasa kemigi karistirin. Kullanmadan önce bana geri getirin, böylece sihrimle onu güclendirebilirim.

english: Be very careful how you mix it as it is extremely volatile. Mixing ingredients of this type in the wrong order can cause explosions!
translation: Karistirirken cok dikkatli olun, cünkü cok ucucudur. Bu tür malzemeleri yanlis sirayla karistirmak patlamalara neden olabilir!

english: I hope you've been brushing up Herblore and Magic? I must warn you, only experienced magicians can use the potion. It is too dangerous in the hands of the unskilled.
translation: Umarim bitki bilimi ve büyü bilgilerinizi tazelemissinizdir? Sizi uyarmaliyim, bu iksiri sadece deneyimli büyücüler kullanabilir. Deneyimsizlerin elinde cok tehlikelidir.

english: Any more news?
Can you tell me again what I need for the potion?
translation: Iksir icin neye ihtiyacim oldugunu tekrar söyleyebilir misin?

english: Yes indeed, let me see, what was it again...
You will need a guam leaf. That goes into the mix first.
translation: Guam yapragina ihtiyacin olacak. Bu ilk olarak karisima eklenir.

english: What is the next ingredient?
You need some jangerberries.
I have some of those.
Wonderful!
You will need to add those after the guam leaf has gone in, but before the final ingredient.
translation: Guam yapragi eklendikten sonra, ama son malzeme eklenmeden önce bunlari eklemelisin.

english: What is the final ingredient?
The final ingredient is ground bat bones.
Are these ground up well enough?
Yes, those will do nicely.
When you have mixed the potion correctly, then I can empower the potion with magic and the ogre shamans can be destroyed.
translation: Iksiri dogru sekilde karistirdiginda, iksiri sihirle güclendirebilirim ve ogre samanlari yok edilebilir.

english: No, I'm still working on it.
I have made the potion.
That's great news; let me infuse it with magic...
translation: Bu harika bir haber, birak da iksiri sihirle güclendireyim...

english: Here it is - a dangerous substance. I must remind you that this potion can only be used if your Magic level is high enough.
translation: Iste burada - tehlikeli bir madde. Bu iksiri ancak büyü seviyen yeterince yüksekse kullanabilecegini hatirlatmaliyim.

english: How high is high enough?
Well, if you can cast Bones to Bananas, or any spells beyond that, you should be alright.
translation: Sey, Kemikleri Muzlara dönüstürme büyüsünü veya daha üst düzey büyüleri yapabiliyorsan, sorun olmaz.

english: Hello again. Did the potion work?
translation: Merhaba tekrar. Iksir ise yaradi mi?

english: I am still working to rid us of the shamans...
translation: Hala samanlari ortadan kaldirmak icin calisiyorum...

english: May you have success in your task.
You'll have to get that magic potion back from wherever you've stored it, I think.
translation: O sihirli iksiri sakladigin yerden geri alman gerekecek sanirim.

english: I have another potion - will you infuse it with magic?
translation: Baska bir iksirim var - ona sihir katar misin?

english: Alright, but I'd prefer it if you didn't keep asking me for this.
translation: Tamam, ama bunu benden sürekli istememeni tercih ederim.

english: Dialogue continues as the first time the potion was enchanted
translation: Iksir ilk kez büyülendiginde diyalog devam eder

english: Indeed it did! I wiped out those ogre shamans!
translation: Gercekten ise yaradi! O ogre samanlari yok ettim!

english: Magnificent! At last you've brought all the crystals!
Now the shield generator can be activated and, once again, Yanille will be safe from the threat of the ogres.
translation: Artik kalkan jeneratörü etkinlestirilebilir ve Yanille bir kez daha ogrelerin tehdidinden kurtulacak.

english: Put the crystals on the pillars there and throw the lever to activate the system.
translation: Kristalleri suradaki sütunlarin üzerine koy ve kolu cekerek sistemi etkinlestir.

english: The system is not activated yet. Throw the switch to start it.
translation: Sistem henüz etkinlestirilmedi. Anahtari cevirerek baslat.

english: Marvellous! It works! The town will now be safe. Take these coins as a token of my gratitude. Also, let me improve your Magic level.
translation: Harika! Calisiyor! Artik kasaba güvende olacak. Minnettarligimin bir göstergesi olarak bu paralari al. Ayrica, sihir seviyeni yükselteyim.

english: I've given you a special scroll too - it's a new spell. Read the scroll and you will be able to teleport yourself here.
translation: Sana özel bir parsömen de verdim - bu yeni bir büyü. Parsömeni okursan kendini buraya isinlayabilirsin.

english: Wizard, look what I have found.
Well done, well done! You are clever; hold onto it until you have all four.
translation: Aferin, aferin! Cok zekisin; dördünü de bulana kadar sakla.

english: Keep searching for the others. If you've dropped any, then you will need to go back to where you got it from.
translation: Digerlerini aramaya devam et. Eger düsürdünse, onu aldigin yere geri dönmen gerekecek.

english: Greetings, friend. I trust all is well with you? Yanille is safe at last!
translation: Selam dostum. Her sey yolunda mi? Yanille sonunda güvende!

english: I lost the scroll you gave me.
I lost the scroll you gave me.
Ho, ho, ho! A comedian to the finish! There it is, in your backpack!
translation: Ho, ho, ho! Sonuna kadar komedyen! Iste orada, sirt cantanda!

english: Never mind, have another...
translation: Bos ver, bir tane daha al...

english: That's okay.
We are always in your debt; do come and visit us again.
translation: Sana borcluyuz; tekrar bizi ziyarete gel.

english: Do you have any more quests for me?
translation: Bana verecek baska görevlerin var mi?

english: More quests? No, indeed, adventurer. You have done us a great service, already.
translation: Baska görevler mi? Hayir, maceraci. Bize zaten büyük bir iyilik yaptin.

english: What's the matter?
So how come the spell doesn't work?
Yes.
No.
I'm not interested in your rantings.
You wizards are always complaining.
What do you suggest I do?
Shall I search the caves?
So what do I do?
I won't bother then.
I am having difficulty with the tribes.
I have everything under control.
I have lost something the ogres gave to me.
translation: Ogrelerin bana verdigi bir seyi kaybettim.

english: I have lost the relic you have me.
I will find my way in, no problem.
translation: Iceri girmenin bir yolunu bulurum, sorun degil.

english: Can you tell me again what I need for the potion?
translation: Iksir icin neye ihtiyacim oldugunu tekrar söyleyebilir misin?

english: No, I'm still working on it.
That's okay.
Do you have any more quests for me?
translation: Bana verebilecegin baska görev var mi?

english: Gratias tibi ago!
Hello there [player name].
Who are you?
I am Watson, the master of clue scrolls. I have lived a long life here in Kourend. The lands are beautiful here.
translation: Ben Watson, ipucu parsömenlerinin ustasiyim. Uzun zamandir Kourend'de yasiyorum. Buralar cok güzel.

english: You're the master are you?
Ha! It is not so much due to my ego, but the fact that I give out master tier clue scrolls.
translation: Ha! Bu benim egomdan degil, usta seviyesinde ipucu parsömenleri verdigimden dolayi.

english: Interesting. Do you get many treasure hunters here in Kourend?
translation: Ilginc. Kourend'de cok hazine avcisi var mi?

english: I have seen many, but few are good enough. I only give out my clue scrolls to the very best.
translation: Cok gördüm, ama cok azi yeterince iyi. Ipucu parsömenlerimi sadece en iyilere veririm.

english: Ah! I am just the adventurer you are looking for. If you hand me a clue, I'll be on my way.
translation: Ah! Ben tam da aradigin maceraciyim. Bana bir ipucu verirsen, hemen yola cikarim.

english: Not so fast [player name]. I require payment. You must bring me a clue scroll of all lower tiers.
translation: O kadar acele etme Maceraci. Ödeme yapman gerekiyor. Bana tüm alt seviye ipucu parsömenlerini getirmelisin.

english: I will remember which ones you have given me though. I expect you'll find that useful.
translation: Bana verdiklerini hatirlayacagim. Bunun isine yarayacagini umuyorum.

english: Have you heard of Sherlock?
Never heard of the bloke. I haven't a clue who he is.
He also claims to be the master of all clue scrolls.
translation: O da tüm ipucu parsömenlerinin ustasi oldugunu iddia ediyor.

english: As I said, I've never heard of him. If he was such a big deal, I would have heard of him...
translation: Dedigim gibi, onu hic duymadim. Eger o kadar önemli biriyse, onu duymus olurdum...

english: Something tells me you're lying! I bet you're just his underling aren't you.
translation: Bir sey bana yalan söyledigini söylüyor! Eminim sen onun yardimcisisin, degil mi?

english: So what are master clue scrolls anyway?
translation: Peki, ipucu parsömenlerinin ustasi ne demek?

english: Master clue scrolls are the most challenging of all clue scrolls. They will test you in ways you have not been tested before.
translation: Ipucu parsömenlerinin ustasi, tüm ipucu parsömenleri arasinda en zor olanidir. Seni daha önce hic denenmemis sekillerde sinayacaklar.

english: You will be led all over Gielinor with your strengths, your weaknesses, your mental strength and your reactions all scrutinised.
translation: Gielinor'un her yerine götürülecek ve güclü yanlarin, zayif yanlarin, zihinsel gücün ve tepkilerin incelenerek degerlendirilecek.

english: I assume there is treasure to be found?
That is for you to find out, [player name].
You need to bring me clue scroll you haven't already given me [player name].
translation: Bana henüz vermedigin ipucu parsömenini getirmen gerekiyor Maceraci.

english: Thank you very much.
I have a master clue scroll for you, but you already have one to complete! Finish it or discard it, I don't care which.
translation: Senin icin bir usta ipucu parsömenim var, ama zaten tamamlaman gereken bir tane var! Bitir ya da at, hangisini yaparsan yap, umurumda degil.

english: Nice work [player name], I've had one of each lower tier clue scroll from you.
translation: Aferin Maceraci, senden her bir alt seviye ipucu parsömeninden bir tane aldim.

english: What is that noticeboard for?
It lets you view any of your S.T.A.S.H units that you have built around Gielinor.
translation: Gielinor cevresinde insa ettigin S.T.A.S.H birimlerini görüntüleyebilmeni saglar.

english: Oh that seems really useful! It's a bit of a shame I need to come here everytime to check though.
translation: Oh, bu gercekten kullanisli görünüyor! Her kontrol etmek icin buraya gelmem gerekmesi biraz üzücü.

english: Well it's just a board with some notes on it. I'm sure you could figure something out.
translation: Sadece üzerinde bazi notlar olan bir tahta. Eminim bir cözüm bulabilirsin.

english: I suppose you're right, I don't suppose you have a spare one I could buy off you to save me the hassle?
translation: Haklisin galiba, bu zahmetten kurtulmak icin senden satin alabilecegim yedek bir tane var mi?

english: No, but I could write down the instructions to make one. Then all you'd need is a house with a study to build it in, and a bolt of cloth.
translation: Hayir, ama bir tane yapmak icin gerekli talimatlari yazabilirim. O zaman tek ihtiyacin olan, onu insa etmek icin bir calisma odasi olan bir ev ve bir parca kumas.

english: I'm not giving it away for free, 500 coins is just covering my expenses!
translation: Bunu bedavaya vermeyecegim, 500 sikke sadece masraflarimi karsiliyor!

english: You don't have enough space for it.
Here you go.
Alright, feel free to carry on using mine.
Goodbye.
You said you didn't know Sherlock!
Sure is windy today, did you hear that?
translation: Bugün hava cok rüzgarli, duydun mu?

english: Sorry [player name]. That scroll is for you, not me.
translation: Üzgünüm Maceraci. O parsömen senin icin, benim icin degil.

english: Do you want to trade that in? You'd need another copy to take your scrolls out again. But I'll swap it for some teleport scrolls if you like, so you can travel here more easily.
translation: Onu takas etmek ister misin? Parsömenlerini tekrar cikarmak icin baska bir kopyaya ihtiyacin olacak. Ama istersen teleport parsömenleriyle takas edebilirim, böylece buraya daha kolay gelebilirsin.

english: Watson exchanges your book for [amount] scrolls.
Come again if you change your mind.
Who are you?
Have you heard of Sherlock?
So what are master clue scrolls anyway?
I have something for you.
Hand over easy clue.
Hand over medium clue.
Hand over hard clue.
Hand over elite clue.
Hand over all clues.
What is that noticeboard for?
Goodbye.
Cancel.
Yes
No
Exchange the book for teleport scrolls
Don't exchange the book
I have a master scroll box for you, but you already have too many of them! Finish them or discard them, I don't care which.
translation: Sana bir ana parsömen kutusu verebilirim, ama zaten çok fazla var! Onlari bitir ya da at, hangisini yaparsan yap.

english: Can you tell me about scroll boxes?
translation: Parsömen kutulari hakkinda bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Well, the long and short of it is that scroll boxes contain clue scrolls, but in a much easier to carry form factor.
translation: Kisaca, parsömen kutulari ipucu parsömenleri içerir, ancak tasinmasi çok daha kolay bir formdadir.

english: Now, just because they're easier to carry, it doesn't mean you can take as many as you want. You'll need scroll cases to be able to store them.
translation: Tasimasi daha kolay olmasi, istedigin kadar alabilecegin anlamina gelmez. Onlari saklayabilmek için parsömen kutularina ihtiyacin olacak.

english: You can get scroll cases by completing clues. You can get up to two extra scroll cases for each clue tier by doing that kind of clue.
translation: Parsömen kutularini ipuçlarini tamamlayarak elde edebilirsin. Bu tür ipuçlarini tamamlayarak her ipucu kademesi için iki adede kadar ekstra parsömen kutusu elde edebilirsin.

english: I can give you the exact numbers, but I wouldn't worry too much about them. You'll get them eventually.
translation: Sana kesin sayilari verebilirim, ama çok fazla kafana takma. Eninde sonunda elde edeceksin.

english: If you want to help deal with the strange casket I have upstairs, I think it also has some scroll cases as well.
translation: Yukarida bulunan garip tabutla ilgilenmek isterseniz, sanirim onda da bazi parsömen kutulari var.

english: So how many scrolls can I carry right now?
translation: Peki su anda kaç tane parsömen tasiyabilirim?

english: You'll find that information written on the statistics board by the door.
translation: Bu bilgiyi kapinin yanindaki istatistik panosunda bulabilirsiniz.

english: Can you tell me about scroll boxes?
translation: Parsömen kutulari hakkinda bilgi verebilir misiniz?

english: Shall we return to Crash Island?
Yes, let's go.
As you wish.
Not yet. I'll be back later.
Yes
No
Hi Waymottin, what are you up to?
Someone has to keep an eye on Bunkwicket!
Well, try to enjoy yourself.
Ha, no chance!
Welcome to Wayne's Chains. Do you wanna buy or sell some chain mail?
translation: Wayne's Chains'e hos geldin. Zincir zirh satin almak veya satmak ister misin?

english: No thanks.
Very well done, take this.
You've been given another clue!
You've obtained a casket!
Yes please.
No thanks.
Hello there.
Hello. How are you liking the city?
It's truly spectacular.
I'd recommend the Colosseum. Me and a few associates always wager bets on the contenders.
translation: Colosseum'u tavsiye ederim. Ben ve birkac arkadasim her zaman yarismacilara bahis oynariz.

english: As you can tell, I'm doing quite well winning! Plenty of coin to pass around.
translation: Gördügün gibi, oldukca iyi kazaniyorum! Dagitacak bolca param var.

english: Got any spare for me?
No! We don't care for begging in the city!
How am I supposed to get past this?
Gah!
Did that owl statue just move?
translation: O baykus heykeli hareket etti mi?

english: I can't wait until I get full graceful, then I can head back to the rooftop courses.
translation: Tamamen zarafet kazanana kadar sabirsizlaniyorum, sonra cati kurslarina geri dönebilirim.

english: I wonder if the Hallowed grapple is worth it?
translation: Kutsal kanca buna deger mi acaba?

english: I wish I could trade Hallowed marks in for amylase crystals.
translation: Kutsal isaretleri amilaz kristalleriyle takas edebilmeyi isterdim.

english: Two pieces dyed, four more to go!
translation: Iki parca boyandi, dört tane daha kaldi!

english: Well, this is definitely more difficult than training on rooftop courses.
translation: Bu, cati kurslarinda antrenman yapmaktan kesinlikle daha zor.

english: Greetings, stranger. How can I help you?
What is this place?
It's a cave filled with araxytes, a rare form of arachnid. I've been here researching them for some time.
translation: Burasi araxytlerle dolu bir magara, nadir bir örümcek türü. Bir süredir burada onlari arastiriyorum.

english: My niece, Nieve, is one of those Slayer Masters. You know, they tell people what to go kill. I also look after this cave for people on assignments like that.
translation: Yegenim Nieve, Slayer Master'lardan biri. Bilirsin, insanlara neyi öldürmeleri gerektigini söylerler. Ben de bu magarayi, bu tür görevlerdeki insanlar icin koruyorum.

english: My nephew, Steve, is one of those Slayer Masters. You know, they tell people what to go kill. I also look after this cave for people on assignments like that.
translation: Yegenim Steve, Slayer Master'lardan biri. Bilirsin, insanlara neyi öldüreceklerini söylerler. Ben de bu magarayi, bu tür görevlerde olan insanlar icin koruyorum.

english: Discovered anything interesting?
Hmm... Not really.
However, the araxytes here are rather venomous... and when I say venomous, I mean venomous.
translation: Ancak, buradaki araxytler oldukca zehirlidir... ve zehirli derken, gercekten zehirli demek istiyorum.

english: Is that really noteworthy?
translation: Bu gercekten dikkate deger bir sey mi?

english: Well, I didn't think so by itself, but lots of other people seem to find it very interesting.
translation: Sey, ben öyle düsünmüyorum, ama bircok insan bunu cok ilginc buluyor.

english: For example, there were some particularly pale wanderers doing their own research in here. They didn't bother me though.
translation: Örnegin, burada kendi arastirmalarini yapan bazi solgun gezginler vardi. Ama beni rahatsiz etmediler.

english: Hmm...
Goodbye.
Bye bye.
I found this Jar, I think it's full of venom.
translation: Bu kavanozu buldum, sanirim zehirle dolu.

english: Oh wow, can I see it?.
That is really fascinating. Thank you for sharing that with me.
translation: Bu gercekten cok ilginc. Benimle paylastigin icin tesekkürler.

english: Next I'll need to find something a little more potent to progress my research...
translation: Simdi arastirmami ilerletmek icin biraz daha güclü bir sey bulmam gerekecek... .

english: I'll keep my eyes open!
Did you want to see the Jar again?
No that's quite alright, I've nothing else to learn from that particular sample. I need to find something else to progress my research...
translation: Hayir, gerek yok, o örnekten ögrenecek baska bir seyim yok. Arastirmami ilerletmek icin baska bir sey bulmam lazim...

english: No problem.
Bad! Don't touch these unless you have a Slayer task to kill them.
translation: Kötü! Onlari öldürmek icin Slayer görevin yoksa bunlara dokunma.

english: What is this place?
Discovered anything interesting?
Goodbye.
She likes to be tickled hehehehe.
Okay...
No thanks, I don't want any.
Pst, wanna hear a secret?
translation: Pst, bir sir duymak ister misin?

english: Sure!
They've got six legs... SIX!
No thanks.
AAAAAAAAARRRRRRGGGGGHHHHHHHH!
What's wrong?
I'll leave you to it then...
Ah! This is for you.
What?
I need answers.
AHHH HELP! What's the answer?
They like it when you scream! AHHHHHHH. That's not right!
translation: Ciglik attiginda hoslarina gidiyor! AHHHHHHH. Bu dogru degil!

english: Spot on!
Sure!
No thanks.
What's wrong?
I'll leave you to it then...
Three stories... Multiple entries... Numerous butlers...
translation: Üc kat... Birden fazla giris... Cok sayida usak...

english: Hello! What're you doing up here?
I'm here on business. I'd suggest you not worry about it. My line of work can be rather... cutthroat.
translation: Is icin buradayim. Endiselenmemenizi öneririm. Benim isim oldukca... acimasiz olabilir.

english: I'm not sure what you're up to, but if it's got anything to do with that villa, then I think someone might've beaten you to it...
translation: Ne yapmaya calistigini bilmiyorum, ama eger bu villa ile bir ilgisi varsa, sanirim biri senden önce davranmis olabilir...

english: Then it seems I now have a gap in my schedule...
translation: O zaman programimda bir bosluk var gibi görünüyor...

english: Well you enjoy it!
What a nice man.
I'm just watching and observing. I find that doing so offers plenty of... opportunities.
translation: Sadece izliyor ve gözlemliyorum. Böyle yapmanin bircok... firsat sundugunu düsünüyorum.

english: I'm just enjoying the view. I find a place like this good when you want to... elimitatedistractions.
translation: Sadece manzarayi seyrediyorum. Böyle bir yer, dikkatinizi dagitan seyleri ortadan kaldirmak istediginizde cok iyi geliyor.

english: What can I interest you in? Need any pipes? I make very sturdy pipes.
translation: Sizi neyle ilgilendirebilirim? Boruya ihtiyaciniz var mi? Cok saglam borular yaparim.

english: No, not really... what kind of shop is this anyway?
translation: Hayir, pek degil... Burasi ne tür bir dükkan?

english: Why, it's Wemund's Wrench Warehouse. Wemund, that's me.
translation: Burasi Wemund'un Ingiliz Anahtari Deposu. Wemund, o benim.

english: I don't really sell just wrenches, you know, I sell anything related to the maintenance of dwarven steam machines.
translation: Sadece Ingiliz anahtari satmiyorum, cüce buhar makinelerinin bakimiyla ilgili her seyi satiyorum.

english: Sometimes I do repair work as well. Or I send my assistant.
translation: Bazen tamir isleri de yaparim. Ya da asistanimi gönderirim.

english: Who's he then?
Oh, he's right over there... used to work in the mines to the south, poor lad. Made a bit of a mess of things I believe.
translation: Surada... eskiden güneydeki madenlerde calisirdi, zavalli cocuk. Sanirim isleri biraz karistirdi.

english: So what'll it be then? Got any ship engines to repair?
translation: Ne olacak peki? Tamir edilecek gemi motoru var mi?

english: Thanks, but I don't think your services are required.
translation: Tesekkürler, ama hizmetlerine ihtiyacim yok sanirim.

english: Hey!
What?
What are you doing?
Waiting.
For what?
For you to go away.
Oh... okay.
There's nothing good to drink here.
translation: Burada icecek iyi bir sey yok.

english: What's wrong with blood?
Blood's only good if there's meat to go with it.
Why even come here if there's nothing for you to drink?
translation: Icecek bir sey yoksa neden buraya geldin?

english: I'm here on business.
What business?
My business is none of your business. Go poke your nose somewhere else.
translation: Benim isim seni ilgilendirmez. Git baska bir yere burnunu sok.

english: Don't disturb me. I need to guard the tithes.
translation: Beni rahatsiz etme. Onlari korumam gerekiyor.

english: Why? Where would they even go if they escaped?
Escape? I'm not here to stop them escaping. I'm here to stop them getting stolen.
translation: Kacmak mi? Ben onlari kacmalarini engellemek icin burada degilim. Onlarin calinmasini engellemek icin buradayim.

english: Oh...
Now take your stupid questions somewhere else. I have a job to do.
translation: Simdi aptal sorularini baska bir yere götür. Yapmam gereken bir isim var.

english: You shouldn't be here, slave. Go back to your master before you get yourself killed.
translation: Burada olmamalisin köle. Öldürülmeden önce efendine geri dön.

english: Got anything you want me to crush?
translation: Ezmeni istedigin bir sey var mi?

english: Okay, I'd like you to crush something.
Hand it to me, and I'll get to work. I charge 50 coins per item.
translation: Bana ver, ben de isime bakayim. Her bir esya icin 50 sikke aliyorum.

english: What sort of things do you crush?
All kinds of things! Unicorn horns, goat horns, blue dragon scales and much more besides. Hand me your stuff, and I'll try to crush it. I charge 50 coins per item.
translation: Her türlü seyi! Tek boynuzlu at boynuzlari, keci boynuzlari, mavi ejderha pullari ve daha fazlasi. Esyalarini bana ver, ezmeye calisayim. Her esya icin 50 sikke aliyorum.

english: Who are you?
I'm Wesley. I used to work on a big ship, exploring the world with my mother, but then I didn't get on very well at the fleet's training school, so I quit all that.
translation: Ben Wesley. Eskiden büyük bir gemide calisiyordum, annemle birlikte dünyayi kesfediyorduk, ama sonra filonun egitim okulunda pek iyi anlasamadim, ben de her seyi biraktim.

english: So I moved to Nardah and took up this job crushing stuff instead. It's always been a passion of mine, crushing things. I'm a lot happier now.
translation: Sonra Nardah'a tasindim ve bunun yerine esyalari ezme isine basladim. Esyalari ezmek her zaman tutkum olmustur. Simdi cok daha mutluyum.

english: The world is so much simpler when you're crushing. You know you just have to grind for long enough until you get the job done. It might take hours, but you just grind until you're done.
translation: Esyalari ezdiginizde dünya cok daha basit hale geliyor. Isi bitirene kadar yeterince uzun süre ezmeniz gerektigini biliyorsunuz. Saatler sürebilir, ama bitirene kadar ezmeye devam edersiniz.

english: I'm not interested, thanks.
No, that's not the sort of thing I like crushing.
translation: Hayir, ezmekten hoslandigim türden bir sey degil.

english: Sorry, I charge 50 coins per item.
translation: Üzgünüm, her öge icin 50 jeton aliyorum.

english: Wesley puts your item[s] in his mortar and crushes it. You pay him [amount] coins.
I'm not very good at Herblore, so you'll only get 3 shards from lava scales that I crush. You might get more if you do it yourself.
translation: Bitki bilimi konusunda pek iyi degilim, bu yüzden ezdigim lav pullarindan sadece 3 parca alabilirsiniz. Kendiniz yaparsaniz daha fazlasini alabilirsiniz.

english: 3 shards per scale is fine.
Forget it - I'll do it myself.
Grind it!
Crush it!
The grind is real!
Griiiiiiind!
Gotta crush 'em all!
Crush crush crush!
Round and round and round we go!
Okay, I'd like you to crush something.
What sort of things do you crush?
Who are you?
I'm not interested, thanks.
3 shards per scale is fine.
Forget it - I'll do it myself.
Hello, what's a little boy like you doing down here?
translation: Merhaba, senin gibi kücük bir cocuk burada ne ariyor?

english: I ain't no little boy. Me dad, Steve, said I was big enough to take care of these 'ere wyverns, as the pal- palint-palintililiolog- those blokes from the museum are too scared of them.
translation: Ben kücük cocuk degilim. Babam Steve, bu wyvernlerle basa cikacak kadar büyüdügümü söyledi, cünkü müzedeki pal-palint-palintililiolog-adli adamlar onlardan cok korkuyorlar.

english: Yeah, whatever. I know how to look after myself, my entire family are slayer guardians or something like that.
translation: Evet, neyse. Kendime bakmayi biliyorum, tüm ailem avci koruyuculari ya da onun gibi bir sey.

english: To guard the wyverns of course.
Guard them? From what?
From people like you who just want to kill 'em.
translation: Onlari öldürmek isteyen senin gibi insanlardan.

english: But... that's what they're for?
translation: Ama... onlarin amaci bu degil mi?

english: They have lives too. They were created for a purpose. But whatever, you can only kill these ones if the Slayer Masters say you can.
translation: Onlarin da hayatlari var. Bir amac icin yaratildilar. Ama neyse, Slayer Ustalar izin verirse bu wyvernleri öldürebilirsin.

english: I'm Weve, son of Steve.
That's... an interesting name.
Well, it's kinda a family tradition you might say. Plus I'm good at looking after wyverns and fast enough to weave between their legs and not get hurt.
translation: Sey, bir nevi aile gelenegi diyebilirsin. Ayrica wyvernlere bakmakta iyiyim ve bacaklarinin arasindan gecip yaralanmayacak kadar hizliyim.

english: Ok, bye.
Hey! Leave them alone! My dad Steve will beat you up unless a Slayer Master has given you special permission.
translation: Hey! Onlari rahat birak! Avci Ustasi sana özel izin vermedikce babam Steve seni döver.

english: Calm down, I was just worried.
Why are you here?
Who are you?
Ok, bye.
Hi there, nice to see you! Care for a mug of beer?
translation: Merhaba, seni görmek ne güzel! Bir bardak bira ister misin?

english: I'm a bit busy at the moment, maybe later.
translation: Su anda biraz mesgulüm, belki sonra.

english: Well alright then.
Hello!
Can I interest you in a drink?
Not right now, thank you. I was wondering if you might be able to help me with something else.
translation: Su anda istemiyorum, tesekkürler. Baska bir konuda bana yardim edebilir misin diye merak ediyordum.

english: And what would that be?
Do you know the Easter Bunny?
I do! He's just over there. Lovely guy.
translation: Tabii! Surada duruyor. Cok sevimli bir adam.

english: Does he seem unhappy to you?
Now that you mention it, yes he does.
translation: Simdi sen söyleyince, evet öyle görünüyor.

english: He was always so cheery, bouncing around like a fuzzy avatar of joy.
translation: Her zaman cok neseliydi, sevinc dolu tüylü bir avatar gibi ziplardi.

english: He's been in a sorry state lately though.
translation: Ama son zamanlarda cok üzgün görünüyor.

english: Indeed, I've never seen him like this.
Have you noticed anything odd?
translation: Garip bir sey fark ettin mi?

english: Hmm... He used to drink pint after pint of carrot juice! Barely sips the stuff now though, just stares into the glass.
translation: Hmm... Eskiden litrelerce havuc suyu icerdi! Simdiyse neredeyse hic icmiyor, sadece bardaga bakiyor.

english: He used to LOVE it.
Interesting, could I try the carrot juice please?
translation: Ilginc, havuc suyunu deneyebilir miyim lütfen?

english: Absolutely! One C.J. coming right up!
translation: Tabii ki! Bir C.J. hemen geliyor!

english: Euargh! That's...
Good right? I make it myself.
It's definitely an experience, how do you make it?
translation: Kesinlikle ilginc bir deneyim, nasil yapiyorsun?

english: I put some carrots into a juice press, then add some good old-fashioned elbow grease.
translation: Havuclari meyve sikacagina koyuyorum, sonra da eski usul el emegi ile sikiyorum.

english: That would explain the flavour.
Do you have any particularly nice carrots we could use to make some special juice just for the Easter Bunny?
translation: Paskalya Tavsani icin özel bir meyve suyu yapmak icin kullanabilecegimiz özellikle güzel havuclarin var mi?

english: I think he would perhaps appreciate something different.
translation: Sanirim farkli bir sey hosuna gider.

english: You can ask Weasel in the kitchen, he chooses which carrots get used for juice.
translation: Mutfaktaki Weasel'a sorabilirsin, meyve suyu icin hangi havuclarin kullanilacagini o secer.

english: Be warned though, he's not much of a people person.
translation: Ama dikkatli ol, pek insanlarla arasi iyi degildir.

english: What do you mean by that?
Oh you'll soon find out! Don't worry though, just tell him I sent you and that you're trying to help the Easter Bunny.
translation: Yakinda anlarsin! Ama merak etme, ona benim gönderdigimi ve Paskalya Tavsanina yardim etmeye calistigini söyle.

english: He'll give you some fantastic carrots.
Once you have them, you can use the juice press to extract their goodness!
translation: Onlari aldiktan sonra, meyve sikacagiyla iclerindeki besinleri cikarabilirsiniz!

english: Alright, I'll be back soon!
Have you been to see Weasel in the kitchen about those nice carrots yet?
translation: Mutfakta Weasel'i o güzel havuclar icin görmeye gittin mi?

english: Not yet.
Well there's no need to be scared of him! Fetch some carrots and I'll let you use my juice press.
translation: Ondan korkmana gerek yok! Biraz havuc getir, meyve sikacagimi kullanmana izin vereyim.

english: I'm not scared, I just haven't gotten round to it yet.
Whatever you say.
I need more carrots..
Why? What happened?
Let's call it a quality control incident.
You drank the juice didn't you?
Perhaps.
Right well you best go see Weasel again, but he won't be happy.
translation: Tamam, en iyisi Weasel'i tekrar görmeye git, ama mutlu olmayacak.

english: Is he ever happy?
Hah! Good point! Best hurry along now!
translation: Hah! Iyi noktaya degindin! En iyisi acele et!

english: Bye.
Ooh look at those carrots, fantastic! This juice is sure to be a treat.
translation: Ooh, su havuclara bak, harika! Bu meyve suyu kesinlikle cok lezzetli olacak.

english: Let's hope so.
You'll need a special glass for the juice, come back when you have space for one.
translation: Meyve suyu icin özel bir bardak lazim, yerin oldugunda geri gel.

english: Here's a carrot juice glass, make sure you use this!
translation: Iste havuc suyu bardagi, bunu kullanmayi unutma!

english: Isn't this just a beer glass?
translation: Bu sadece bira bardagi degil mi?

english: Ha! Just a beer glass! You're a real joker!
translation: Ha! Sadece bira bardagi! Sen tam bir sakacisin!

english: It's VERY important that you use the correct glassware.
Alright, I will. Goodness me.
The juice press is in the storage room behind the bar. Have fun, and don't make too much mess!
translation: Meyve suyu presi barin arkasindaki depoda. Iyi eglenceler, ortaligi cok kirletme!

english: Will do, thanks!
How's the juicing going?
Erm, I lost the glass.
Lost or broke? I'm not stupid. Those glasses are expensive you know!
translation: Kaybettin mi, kirdin mi? Aptal degilim. O bardaklar pahalidir, biliyorsun!

english: Sorry, can I have another glass please?
translation: Üzgünüm, baska bir bardak alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: Make some room for a new one and you can, yes.
translation: Yeni bir tane icin yer acarsan alabilirsin, evet.

english: Yes you can, but take care of it this time!
translation: Evet alabilirsin, ama bu sefer dikkatli ol!

english: Thanks, and I will.
I'm about to get juicing!
Well hurry up, we don't want to keep the Easter Bunny waiting!
translation: Acele et, Paskalya Tavsanini bekletmek istemeyiz!

english: Remember, the juice press is in the storage area behind the bar.
translation: Unutma, meyve suyu sikacagi barin arkasindaki depoda.

english: I remember!
Then why are you still here?
Good question, I'll go and make some juice.
translation: Iyi soru, gidip meyve suyu yapayim.

english: Ohhhh! Look at that juice! Such colour. It smells divine too.
translation: Ohhhh! Su meyve suyuna bak! Ne renk ama. Kokusu da harika.

english: Oh it's good stuff, I should know.
Well let's see what the Easter Bunny thinks.
I'll go and give it to him now, bye!
Hello again!
Hi [player name].
I think that fancy carrot juice has cheered the Easter Bunny up a bit, he really seemed to like it!
translation: Sanirim o süslü havuc suyu Paskalya Tavsanini biraz neselendirdi, gercekten cok begendi gibi görünüyordu!

english: That's great!
Thanks for the help.
Any time.
I'm making some Easter Buns for the Easter Bunny, and I need some Easter Spices.
translation: Paskalya Tavsani icin Paskalya Cörekleri yapiyorum ve Paskalya Baharatlarina ihtiyacim var.

english: Do you have any I could use?
Oh yes of course, we keep plenty behind the bar for cocktails.
translation: Tabii ki var, kokteyller icin barin arkasinda bolca bulunduruyoruz.

english: Of course I can't give you the spices unless you can carry them. Come back when you have space!
translation: Tabii ki, tasiyabilecegin kadarini verebilirim. Yer acildiginda tekrar gel!

english: There you go, I hope they work well!
Thanks!
I bet those spices will bring those buns to life!
Judging by the smell, I'd say so. Powerful stuff.
translation: Kokusu öyle diyor. Cok güclü bir sey.

english: Thanks for both juice and spices, EB really liked the buns!
translation: Meyve suyu ve baharatlar icin tesekkürler, EB cörekleri cok sevdi!

english: Talk about carrot juice.
Talk about Easter Buns.
Hi!
Hi!
So, what you up to out here?
Oh...er...nothing!
Hello there, are you interested in buying one of my special capes?
translation: Merhaba, özel pelerinlerimden birini satin almak ister misin?

english: What's so special about your capes?

Ahh well they make it less likely that you'll accidently attack anyone wearing the same cape as you and easier to attack everyone else. They also make it easier to distinguish people who're wearing the same cape as you
translation: Ahh, ayni pelerini giyen birine yanlislikla saldirma olasiligini azaltir ve diger herkese saldirmayi kolaylastirir. Ayrica, seninle ayni pelerini giyenleri digerlerinden ayirt etmeyi kolaylastirir.

english: from everyone else. They're very useful when out in the wilderness with friends or anyone else you don't want to harm.
translation: Arkadaslarinla veya zarar vermek istemedigin baska kisilerle Wildernessda dolasirken cok kullanislidir.

english: So would you like to buy one?
translation: Peki, bir tane almak ister misin?

english: No thanks.
What's so special about your capes?
Yes please!
No thanks.
Hello there. What are you doing all the way out here?
Nothing you need to worry about.
So this is where you scampered off to after the monster awoke?
translation: Demek canavar uyandiktan sonra buraya kactin?

english: Look [player name], it was a simple misunderstanding, that's all...
translation: Bak Maceraci, bu sadece basit bir yanlis anlasilmaydi, hepsi bu...

english: Oh really? You threatening to kill me was just a misunderstanding?
translation: Öyle mi? Beni öldürmekle tehdit etmen sadece bir yanlis anlasilma miydi?

english: Things got a little heated down there, but we all made it out alive, right?
translation: Orada isler biraz kizisti, ama hepimiz sag salim kurtulduk, degil mi?

english: Barely... I had to defeat that monster on my own!
translation: Zar zor... O canavari tek basima yenmek zorunda kaldim!

english: What are you doing out here, anyway?
We thought you'd rat us out to the authorities, so we came out here to hide.
translation: Bizi yetkililere ihbar edecegini düsündük, bu yüzden buraya saklanmaya geldik.

english: Plus, we heard there are some sealed tombs in the desert that haven't been touched in hundreds of years...
