translation: Ayrica, cölde yüzlerce yildir dokunulmamis bazi mühürlü mezarlar oldugunu duyduk...

english: Ah, of course... scoping out your next grave to rob.
translation: Ah, tabii ki... soyacak bir sonraki mezari arastiriyorsun.

english: Hello youngster!
[I/We] don't talk to strange old people.
Hey who you calling old?! And strange?!
translation: Hey, kime yasli diyorsun?! Ve yabanci?!

english: Hello again.
You think you're tough do you?
Pardon?
I can beat anyone up!
He can you know!
Really?
The boy begins to jump around with his fists up. You decide it's best not to kill him just yet.
translation: Cocuk yumruklarini kaldirip ziplamaya baslar. Onu henüz öldürmemenin en iyisi olduguna karar verirsin.

english: Hello there, I've been looking for you.
I didn't mean to take it! I just forgot to pay.
What? I'm trying to help your mum find Fluffs.
translation: Ne? Annen Fluffs'i bulmasina yardim etmeye calisiyorum.

english: Ohh...well, in that case I might be able to help. Fluffs followed me to my secret play area, I haven't seen her since.
translation: Ohh... o zaman ben de yardim edebilirim. Fluffs beni gizli oyun alanima kadar takip etti, o zamandan beri onu görmedim.

english: Where is this play area?
If I told you that, it wouldn't be a secret.
Tell me sonny, or I will hurt you.
translation: Söyle bana evlat, yoksa canini yakarim.

english: W..wh..what?! Y..you wouldn't! A young lad like me! I'd have you behind bars before nightfall!
translation: N... ne... ne?! Yapmazsin! Benim gibi genc bir delikanliya! Aksam olmadan seni parmakliklar arkasina tikarim!

english: You decided it's best not to hurt the boy.
translation: Cocuga zarar vermemenin en iyisi olduguna karar verdin.

english: What will make you tell me?
Well...now you ask, I am a bit short on cash.
translation: Sey... madem soruyorsun, biraz nakit sikintim var.

english: How much?
10 coins.
10 coins?!
I'll handle this.
100 coins should cover it.
100 coins! Why should I pay you?
You shouldn't, but we won't help otherwise. We never liked that cat anyway, so what do you say?
translation: Ödememelisin, ama aksi takdirde yardim etmiyoruz. O kediyi zaten hic sevmedik, ne dersin?

english: I'm not paying you a penny.
Okay then, I'll find another way to make money.
translation: Tamam o zaman, para kazanmanin baska bir yolunu bulurum.

english: Okay then, I'll pay.
You give the lad 100 coins.
There you go, now where did you see Fluffs ?
I play at an abandoned lumber mill to the north east. Just beyond the Jolly Boar Inn. I saw Fluffs running around in there.
translation: Kuzeydogudaki terk edilmis kereste fabrikasinda oynuyorum. Jolly Boar Inn'in hemen ötesinde. Fluffs'i orada kosustururken gördüm.

english: Anything else?
Well, you'll have to find the broken fence to get in. I'm sure you can manage that.
translation: Iceri girmek icin kirik citi bulman gerekecek. Eminim basarabilirsin.

english: Well, never mind, it's Fluffs' loss.
I'm sure my mum will get over it.
Where did you say you saw Fluffs?
Weren't you listening? I saw the flea bag in the old lumber mill just north east of here. Just walk past the Jolly Boar Inn and you should find it.
translation: Dinlemiyor muydun? Bu yerin kuzeydogusundaki eski kereste fabrikasinda o pire torbasini gördüm. Jolly Boar Inn'i gecince bulabilirsin.

english: My brother reckons I can't solve this puzzle. I can't have him laughing at me! Do me a favour and solve it for me.
translation: Kardesim bu bulmacayi cözemeyecegimi düsünüyor. Bana gülmesine izin veremem! Bana bir iyilik yap ve bulmacayi cöz.

english: Sorry but you haven't solved the puzzle yet.
Thanks [mister/miss]!
Tell me sonny, or I will hurt you.
translation: Söyle bana evlat, yoksa canini yakarim.

english: What will make you tell me?
I'm not paying you a penny.
Okay then, I'll pay.
Well never mind, it's Fluffs' loss.
How are you doing?
Purr...I'm happy. [player name] is good to me. But don't start neglecting me now that I've told you that.
translation: Mir... Mutluyum. Maceraci bana iyi davraniyor. Ama bunu sana söyledigim icin beni ihmal etmeye baslama.

english: Don't worry, I won't.
How old are you now?
I feel as old as the last rat I killed and seeing as it was so tender and juicy, it must have been fairly young.
translation: Son öldürdügüm fare kadar yasli hissediyorum ve o fare cok yumusak ve sulu oldugu icin oldukca genc olmaliydi.

english: Where do you want to go?
Let's go to the sewers of Varrock.
What do you want to do now?
I don't know. Master knows me thinks.
Is there anywhere in particular that you would like to go?
translation: Gitmek istedigin özel bir yer var mi?

english: How are you doing?
How old are you now?
Where do you want to go?
What do you want to do now?
I've got you the limpwurt roots!
Good! Good! My potion is nearly ready! Bubble, bubble, toil and trouble!
translation: Güzel! Güzel! Iksirim neredeyse hazir! Kabarcik, kabarcik, emek ve sikinti!

english: Now we shows them ours magic! Hold on tight!
translation: Simdi onlara sihrimizi gösterelim! Siki tutun!

english: A cutscene is shown where the player is teleported across the lava.
translation: Oyuncu lavlarin üzerinden teleport edildigi bir kesit gösterilir.

english: Hehe! We see you're in a pickle!
Wants to be getting over the nasty lava do we?
translation: Kötü lavlarin üzerinden gecmek mi istiyorsun?

english: Nah, not bothered!
Hehe! Ye'll come back! They always come back!
translation: Hehe! Geri geleceksin! Hep geri gelirler!

english: Mocking us are we? Clever one aren't we?
translation: Bizimle alay mi ediyorsun? Akilli misin?

english: I'm knowing some magic trickesses! I could get over easy as that!
translation: Bazi sihirli numaralar biliyorum! Kolayca gecebilirim!

english: Don't tell them! They always come! They pester poor Winelda!
translation: Onlara söyleme! Hep gelirler! Zavalli Winelda'yi rahatsiz ederler!

english: If you're such a great witch, get me over!
translation: Madem o kadar büyük bir cadisin, beni gecirin!

english: See! They pester Winelda!
I can do something for you!
Good! Don't pester! Help!
Get Winelda 20 limpwurt roots for my pot.
translation: Winelda'ya benim tencerem icin 20 limpwurt kökü getir.

english: Then we shows them some magic!
Yes I do!
Have you got roots for poor Winelda?
translation: Zavalli Winelda icin köklerin var mi?

english: How many did you need again?
We needs 20 Limpwurt roots for pot.
translation: Tencere icin 20 tane Limpwurt köküne ihtiyacimiz var.

english: I've got some limpwurt roots!
We needs 20 rooteses!
Hi again. Could you do the honours again please?
translation: Merhaba tekrar. Lütfen tekrar yardim eder misin?

english: Certainly! We helps those that helps poor Winelda!
translation: Tabii ki! Zavalli Winelda'ya yardim edenlere yardim ederiz!

english: Nah, not bothered!
Yes we do!
Yes I do!
It's a bit hot and dry round here for a gnome isn't it? I thought you gnomes liked your home comforts.
translation: Burasi bir cüce icin biraz sicak ve kuru degil mi? Siz cücelerin ev konforunu sevdiginizi saniyordum.

english: Certainly I miss home cooking, but gnomes are also fundamentally curious people. I'm here exploring the furthest reaches of the world for the King.
translation: Elbette ev yemeklerini özlüyorum, ama cüceler de temelde merakli insanlardir. Kral icin dünyanin en uzak köselerini kesfediyorum.

english: Found anything interesting?

Sophanem is a curious place, if you can get into the blighted place. There are several pyramids round here as well. Fascinating architecture, I've heard stories that some of them contain treasure tombs and mummies.
translation: Sophanem, bu lanetli yere girebilirsen, ilginc bir yer. Burada birkac piramit de var. Büyüleyici bir mimari, bazilarinin hazine mezarlari ve mumyalar icerdigine dair hikayeler duydum.

english: Cats seem to have considerable importance round here, they certainly seem tied into their religion. The Gods round here seem very alien to me - I've never heard of them before.
translation: Kediler burada oldukca önemli görünüyor, kesinlikle dinleriyle baglantililar. Buradaki tanrilar bana cok yabanci geliyor, daha önce hic duymadim.

english: Thanks.
What does this mint cake do?
translation: Bu nane keki ne ise yarar?

english: Gnomish mint cake is a great source of energy for the gnome traveller. It will give you that extra bit of zip when you are running out of steam.
translation: Gnomish nane keki, gnome gezginler icin harika bir enerji kaynagidir. Enerjiniz tükendiginde size ekstra bir güc verir.

english: Ooh, that might come in very handy. Do you have any spare?
translation: Ooh, bu cok isime yarayabilir. Fazladan var mi?

english: I need all the mint cake I have, I'm afraid.
translation: Korkarim, elimdeki tüm nane kekine ihtiyacim var.

english: What does this seed pod do?
translation: Bu tohum kabugu ne ise yarar?

english: Ah, the seed pod of the Grand Tree is a fascinating spirit artefact. It is a very useful thing, though one must treat it with respect, since the Grand Tree has a connection with all of its parts, however distant they
translation: Ah, Büyük Agac'in tohum kabugu büyüleyici bir ruhani eser. Cok kullanisli bir seydir, ancak ona saygi ile davranmak gerekir, cünkü Büyük Agac tüm parcalariyla baglantilidir, ne kadar uzak olurlarsa olsunlar.

english: may be. How do you think the Spirit Trees work?

If you launch its seeds in a far flung location, you will be helping the tree survive, so the grand tree will help a gnome glider pilot find you, using the seed burst itself (which marks the sky) and a little magic, and bring you
translation: Tohumlarini uzak bir yere firlatirsan, agacin hayatta kalmasina yardimci olursun, böylece Büyük Agac, tohum patlamasini (gökyüzünü isaretler) ve biraz sihir kullanarak bir cüce planör pilotunun seni bulmasina yardim eder ve

english: back home as an act of gratitude. Budding farmers will also find their link with plants to be just a little bit better than before.
translation: minnettarlik göstergesi olarak seni eve geri getirir. Yeni baslayan ciftciler de bitkilerle olan baglarinin eskisinden biraz daha iyi oldugunu göreceklerdir.

english: However, it takes time for a pilot to find you, and if you are in a real hurry, and I mean a real emergency, you can just squash the seed pod. The Grand Tree doesn't like this, but will pull you back
translation: Ancak, pilotun sizi bulmasi zaman alir ve gercekten aceleniz varsa, yani gercek bir acil durum varsa, tohum kabugunu ezebilirsiniz. Büyük Agac bundan hoslanmaz, ancak sizi hemen

english: home straight away. Don't do this if you need to do anything with plants straight away, though - your fingers will be considerably less green for a while after using the seed pod this way, and the journey is not
translation: eve geri götürür. Ancak, bitkilerle hemen bir sey yapmaniz gerekiyorsa bunu yapmayin - tohum kabugunu bu sekilde kullandiktan sonra parmaklariniz bir süre icin oldukca yesil olmayacak ve yolculuk da

english: very pleasant...
Wow, that's very interesting. Thanks.
translation: Vay canina, bu cok ilginc. Tesekkürler.

english: Here, solve this.
Wingstone hands you a [light box/puzzlebox]!
That doesn't look solved to me.
Well done [player name]. Here you go.
You've obtained a [new clue/casket]!
You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food item] to Wingstone.
This will hit the spot. Oh yes. Thanks.
translation: Bu tam da ihtiyacim olan sey. Evet. Tesekkürler.

english: Now that I have some proper food, I won't need this any more.
translation: Artik düzgün bir yemegim olduguna göre, buna artik ihtiyacim yok.

english: Here, take these Grand Seed pods. Very useful in emergencies!
translation: Al, bu Grand Seed podlarini al. Acil durumlarda cok kullanislidir!

english: I was given this odd device, maybe you can do something with it.
translation: Bana bu garip cihaz verildi, belki sen onunla bir seyler yapabilirsin.

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: Bunu bana getirmek icin uzun bir yol kat etmis olmalisin. Iste sana bahsis olarak kücük bir sey.

english: You are given [a/some] [reward item(s)] as a tip.
translation: Bahsis olarak bazi ödül ögesi verilir.

english: It's a bit hot and dry round here for a gnome isn't it?
translation: Burasi bir cüce icin biraz sicak ve kuru degil mi?

english: What does this mint cake do?
translation: Bu nane keki ne ise yarar?

english: What does this seed pod do?
translation: Bu tohum kabugu ne ise yarar?

english: Why are you in that cage?
That evil witch put me in here! She kidnapped me!
translation: O kötü cadi beni buraya koydu! Beni kacirdi!

english: That's awful! Why did she do that?
translation: Bu cok kötü! Neden böyle bir sey yapti?

english: She wanted the secret of my ogleroots, so she did!
translation: Ogleroot'larimin sirrini ögrenmek istedigi icin yapti!

english: Your ogleroots? I don't think I understand. What secret is that?
translation: Ogleroot'larin mi? Anlamadim. Ne sirri bu?

english: Well now, I have perfected a spell that would grow an ogleroot to an enormous size.
translation: Sey, ogleroot'u devasa bir boyuta büyütecek bir büyü gelistirdim.

english: That's amazing! But how do you move the ogleroot around if it's so big?
translation: Bu harika! Ama ogleroot bu kadar büyükse onu nasil tasiyabiliyorsun?

english: You know, I had the very same problem so I came up with a simple solution. I used a spell I learned from a chap called Larry to shrink 'em down really small so that I could carry whole bags filled with 'em to the market place. Then when I got there, I would use the growing spell once more to make 'em huge and sell 'em for a tidy sum.
translation: Ben de ayni sorunu yasadim, bu yüzden basit bir cözüm buldum. Larry adinda birinden ögrendigim bir büyüyle onlari cok kücük hale getirdim, böylece cantalar dolusu ogleroot'u pazara tasiyabiliyordum. Pazara vardigimda, büyüyen büyüyü bir kez daha kullanarak onlari devasa hale getirip iyi bir fiyata satiyordum.

english: That's amazing! So how does the witch fit in to all this?
translation: Bu harika! Peki cadi bu isin neresinde?

english: Well that old witch - she's a sly one, I tell you. She found out about my spell and kidnapped me along with my bag of ogleroots. She wants the secret of the spell but I ain't talking! No sir! So she's been feeding my mini-ogleroots to those ugly...things over there.
translation: Su yasli cadi, cok kurnaz biridir. Büyümü ögrendi ve beni ogleroot torbamla birlikte kacirdi. Büyünün sirrini ögrenmek istiyor ama ben söylemeyecegim! Hayir efendim! O da benim mini oglerootlarimi suradaki cirkin... seylere yediriyor.

english: So she hasn't found out the spell yet?
Not yet, no. And I still ain't telling her. But from what I gather, she's started to use them ogleroots in some of her potions for something. I don't know what, though.
translation: Henüz ögrenmedi. Ve ben hala söylemiyorum. Ama anladigim kadariyla, o oglerootlari bazi iksirlerinde bir sey icin kullanmaya basladi. Ne icin oldugunu bilmiyorum ama.

english: I see. Can I get you out of there somehow?
translation: Anliyorum. Seni oradan bir sekilde cikarabilir miyim?

english: No, it's ok. I want to keep an eye on what the witch is up to down here with these odd creatures.
translation: Hayir, sorun degil. Cadinin bu tuhaf yaratiklarla burada ne yaptigini gözlemlemek istiyorum.

english: So, will you be alright?
Yes, I'll be fine for now. Good luck with your tasks!
translation: Evet, simdilik iyiyim. Görevlerinde bol sans!

english: This could be worse I guess. Oh wait... No it can't.
translation: Daha kötüsü de olabilirdi sanirim. Dur biraz... Hayir, olamaz.

english: I'm hungry...
Sometimes I wish this thing would just escape. At least we'd have something to do then.
translation: Bazen bu seyin kacmasini diliyorum. En azindan o zaman yapacak bir seyimiz olurdu.

english: It's so cold...
Greetings, [player name].
So you're a wise old man, huh?
translation: Demek bilge bir yasli adamsin, ha?

english: Less of the 'old' man, if you please!
But yes, I suppose you could say that. I prefer to think of myself as a sage.
translation: Ama evet, öyle denebilir. Kendimi bir bilge olarak görmeyi tercih ederim.

english: So what's a sage doing here?
translation: Peki bir bilge burada ne ariyor?

english: I've spent most of my life studying this world in which we live. I've strode through the depths of the deadliest dungeons, roamed the murky jungles of Karamja, meditated on the glories of Saradomin on Entrana,
translation: Hayatimin cogunu, yasadigimiz bu dünyayi inceleyerek gecirdim. En ölümcül zindanlarin derinliklerinde yürüdüm, Karamja'nin karanlik ormanlarinda dolastim, Entrana'da Saradomin'in ihtisamini meditasyonla düsündüm

english: and read some dusty tomes in the Library of Varrock.
translation: ve Varrock Kütüphanesi'nde tozlu kitaplari okudum.

english: Now I'm not as young as I used to be, I'm settling here where it's peaceful.
translation: Artik eskisi kadar genc degilim, bu huzurlu yere yerlestim.

english: It's a pity about that vampyre that keeps attacking the village. At least Saradomin protects me.
translation: Köyü sürekli saldiran vampir cok yazik. En azindan Saradomin beni koruyor.

english: That's quite an exciting life you've had.
Exciting? Yes, I suppose so.
Now I'm here, perhaps I could offer you the benefit of my experience and wisdom?
translation: Simdi buradayim, belki size deneyimlerim ve bilgeligimden faydalanabilirsiniz?

english: Thanks! So you can help me?
translation: Tesekkürler! Yani bana yardim edebilir misiniz?

english: Well, I imagine you've gathered up quite a lot of stuff on your travels. Things you used for quests a long time ago that you don't need now.
translation: Sanirim seyahatlerinizde epey bir seyler biriktirmissinizdir. Uzun zaman önce görevlerde kullandigin, ama artik ihtiyacin olmayan seyler.

english: If you like, I can look through your bank and see if there's anything you can chuck away.
translation: Istersen, bankana bakip atabilecegin bir sey var mi diye bakabilirim.

english: Alternatively, you can bring items here and show them to me. If I see that it's something you don't need, I'll let you know. I might even be willing to buy it.
translation: Ya da esyalari buraya getirip bana gösterebilirsin. Ihtiyacin olmayan bir sey oldugunu görürsem, sana söylerim. Hatta satin almayi bile düsünebilirim.

english: So you'll help me clear junk out of my bank?
translation: Yani bankamdaki gereksiz esyalari temizlememe yardim edecek misin?

english: Yes, that's right. Or I'd be happy to chat with you about the wonders of this world!
translation: Evet, dogru. Ya da bu dünyanin harikalari hakkinda seninle sohbet etmekten memnuniyet duyarim!

english: Could I have some free stuff, please?
translation: Biraz bedava esya alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: Deary deary me...
I'm not giving out free money, but if you try again later I'd be glad to reward you if you'd do a little job for me.
translation: Bedava para vermiyorum, ama daha sonra tekrar denersen, benim icin kücük bir is yaparsan seni ödüllendirmekten memnuniyet duyarim.

english: I'm not giving out free money, but I'd be happy to reward you if you'll do a little job for me.
translation: Bedava para vermiyorum, ama benim icin kücük bir is yaparsan seni ödüllendirmekten memnuniyet duyarim.

english: Ok, what do you want me to do?
I'm sure I can think of a few little jobs. This won't be a quest, mind you, just a little favour...
translation: Birkac kücük is düsünebilirim. Bu bir görev degil, sadece kücük bir iyilik...

english: Thanks, maybe some other time.
I'd just like to ask you something.
Please do!
Is there anything I can do for you?
translation: Senin icin yapabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Could you check my items for junk, please?
translation: Lütfen esyalarimda cöp olup olmadigini kontrol eder misin?

english: Can I get another hood for my Quest Point Cape?
translation: Görev Puani Pelerini icin baska bir baslik alabilir miyim?

english: You don't appear to have enough space in your inventory. Come back and see me when you do.
translation: Envanterinde yeterli yer yok gibi görünüyor. Yer actiginda tekrar gel.

english: Can I buy a Quest Point Cape, please?
translation: Görev Puani Pelerini satin alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: Gladly, though they cost 99,000 coins.
Okay, 99,000 coins is fine.
All skillcapes come with a hood - you're not going to be able to hold them now. Try again another time.
translation: Tüm skillcapes kapüsonludur - su anda onlari tutamayacaksiniz. Baska bir zaman tekrar deneyin.

english: I'll have to come back another time.
Actually, no thanks.
Is there anything I can do for you?
translation: Sizin icin yapabilecegim bir sey var mi?

english: Thanks, but I don't have anything I need doing right now.
translation: Tesekkürler, ama su anda ihtiyacim olan bir sey yok.

english: Could you tell me about the Wilderness, please?
translation: Wilderness hakkinda bilgi verebilir misiniz lütfen?

english: If Entrana is a land dedicated to the glory of Saradomin, the Wilderness is surely the land of Zamorak.
translation: Entrana, Saradomin'in ihtisamina adanmis bir toprak ise, Wilderness kesinlikle Zamorak'in topragidir.

english: It's a dangerous place, where adventurers such as yourself may attack each other, using all their combat skills in the struggle for survival.
translation: Burasi, sizin gibi maceracilarin hayatta kalmak icin tüm savas becerilerini kullanarak birbirlerine saldirabilecekleri tehlikeli bir yerdir.

english: The Wilderness has different levels. In a low level area, you can only fight adventurers whose combat level is close to yours.
translation: Wilderness'in farkli seviyeleri vardir. Düsük seviyeli bir bölgede, sadece savas seviyesi size yakin olan maceracilarla savasabilirsiniz.

english: But if you venture into the high level areas in the far north, you can be attacked by adventurers who are significantly stronger than you.
translation: Ancak kuzeydeki yüksek seviyeli bölgelere girerseniz, sizden cok daha güclü maceracilar tarafindan saldiriya ugrayabilirsiniz.

english: Of course, you'd be able to attack considerably weaker people too, so it can be worth the risk.
translation: Tabii ki, sizden cok daha zayif kisilere de saldirabilirsiniz, bu yüzden riske girmeye deger olabilir.

english: If you dare to go to the far north-west of the Wilderness, there's a building called the Mage Arena where you can learn to summon the power of Saradomin himself!
translation: Wilderness'nin kuzeybatisina gitmeye cesaret ederseniz, Saradomin'in gücünü cagirmayi ögrenebileceginiz Mage Arena adli bir bina var!

english: Is there anything else you'd like to ask?
translation: Baska soracaginiz bir sey var mi?

english: Yes please.
As you wish. Farewell, [player name].
What can you tell me about jungles?
If it's jungle you want, look no further than the southern regions of Karamja.
translation: Orman istiyorsaniz, Karamja'nin güney bölgelerine bakin.

english: Once you get south of Brimhaven, the whole island is pretty much covered in exotic trees, creepers and shrubs.
translation: Brimhaven'in güneyine geldiginizde, adanin tamami egzotik agaclar, sarmasiklar ve calilarla kaplidir.

english: There's a small settlement called Tai Bwo Wannai Village in the middle of the island. It's a funny place; the chieftain's an unfriendly chap and his sons are barking mad.
translation: Adanin ortasinda Tai Bwo Wannai Köyü adinda kücük bir yerlesim yeri var. Komik bir yer; sefi dost canlisi bir adam degil ve ogullari deli gibi.

english: Honestly, one of them asked me to stuff a dead monkey with seaweed so he could EAT it!
translation: Acikcasi, iclerinden biri bana ölü bir maymunu deniz yosunu ile doldurmami istedi, böylece onu YIYEBILECEKTI!

english: Yes, I've met them.
Further south you'll find Shilo Village. It's been under attack by terrifying zombies in recent months, if my sources are correct.
translation: Daha güneyde Shilo Köyü var. Kaynaklarim dogruysa, son aylarda korkunc zombilerin saldirisina ugramis.

english: I've dealt with them, although there are a few still knocking about.
translation: Onlarla ilgilendim, ama hâlâ birkac tanesi ortalikta dolasiyor.

english: The jungle's filled with nasty creatures. There are vicious spiders that you can hardly see before they try to bite your legs off, and great big jungle ogres.
translation: Orman, igrenc yaratiklarla dolu. Bacaklarinizi isirmaya calismadan önce zorlukla görebileceginiz vahsi örümcekler ve kocaman orman ogreleri var.

english: Tell me about what's underground.
Oh, the dwarven realms?
Yes, there was a time, back in the Fourth Age, when we humans wouldn't have been able to venture underground. That was before we had magic; the dwarves were quite a threat.
translation: Evet, Dördüncü Cag'da, biz insanlar yeraltina inemezdik. Bu, sihirli güclere sahip olmadan önceydi; cüceler oldukca büyük bir tehdit olusturuyordu.

english: Still, it's much more friendly now. You can visit the vast dwarven mine if you like; the entrance is on the mountain north of Falador.
translation: Yine de, simdi cok daha dostane bir yer. Isterseniz genis cüce madenini ziyaret edebilirsiniz; girisi Falador'un kuzeyindeki dagda.

english: If you go further west you may be able to visit the dwarven city of Keldagrim. But they were a bit cautious about letting humans in, last time I asked.
translation: Daha batiya giderseniz, cüce sehri Keldagrim'i ziyaret edebilirsiniz. Ama en son sordugumda, insanlari iceri almaya biraz temkinli davraniyorlardi.

english: On the other hand, if you go west of Brimhaven, you'll find a huge underground labyrinth full of giants, demons, dogs and dragons to fight. It's even bigger than the caves under Taverley, although the Taverley
translation: Öte yandan, Brimhaven'in batisina giderseniz, devler, iblisler, köpekler ve ejderhalarla savasabileceginiz devasa bir yeralti labirenti bulacaksiniz. Taverley'deki magaralardan bile daha büyük, ancak Taverley

english: dungeon's pretty good for training your combat skills.
translation: zindani savas becerilerinizi gelistirmek icin oldukca iyi.

english: What mystical realms can I visit?
Well, you've been to Zanaris. I met a fairy years ago who said she lived there. She was an incredible warrior, considering that she wasn't even a metre tall.
translation: Zanaris'e gittin. Yillar önce orada yasadigini söyleyen bir peri ile tanistim. Boyu bir metre bile olmamasina ragmen inanilmaz bir savasciydi.

english: Also, in my research I came across ancient references to some kind of Abyss. Demons from the Abyss have already escaped into this land; Saradomin be thanked that they are very rare!
translation: Ayrica, arastirmalarim sirasinda bir tür Abyss'e dair eski referanslar buldum. Abyss'ten gelen iblisler bu topraklara coktan kacmislar; Saradomin'e sükürler olsun ki cok nadir görülüyorlar!

english: I've been through a portal into the lair of some ancient demon. It was in the city of Uzer.
translation: Bir portaldan gecerek eski bir iblisin inine girdim. Uzer sehrindeydi.

english: Ah, Uzer. A city much favoured by Saradomin, destroyed by Thammaron, the elder-demon, late in the Third Age.
translation: Ah, Uzer. Saradomin'in cok sevdigi, Ücüncü Cag'in sonlarinda yasli iblis Thammaron tarafindan yok edilen bir sehir.

english: Yeah, there isn't much left there.
translation: Evet, orada pek bir sey kalmadi.

english: What's the biggest monster in the world?
There's a mighty fire-breathing dragon living underground in the deep Wilderness, known as the King Black Dragon. It's a fearsome beast, with a breath that can poison you, freeze you to the ground or
translation: Derin Wilderness'da yeraltinda yasayan, Kral Kara Ejderha olarak bilinen güclü, ates püskürten bir ejderha var. Bu korkunc canavar, nefesiyle sizi zehirleyebilir, yere dondurup

english: incinerate you where you stand.
But even more deadly is the Queen of the Kalphites. As if her giant mandibles of death were not enough, she also throws her spines at her foes with deadly force. She can even cast rudimentary spells.
translation: Ama daha da ölümcül olani Kalphitlerin Kralicesi'dir. Devasa ölümcül ceneleri yetmezmis gibi, düsmanlarina ölümcül bir gücle dikenlerini firlatir. Hatta basit büyüler bile yapabilir.

english: Some dark power must be protecting her, for she can block attacks using prayer just as humans do.
translation: Onu koruyan karanlik bir güc olmali, cünkü insanlar gibi dua ederek saldirilari engelleyebilir.

english: Another beast that's worthy of a special mention is the Shaikahan. It dwells in the eastern reaches of Karamja, and is almost impossible to kill except with specially prepared weapons.
translation: Özel olarak bahsetmeye deger bir baska canavar da Shaikahan'dir. Karamja'nin dogu kesimlerinde yasar ve özel olarak hazirlanmis silahlar disinda öldürülmesi neredeyse imkansizdir.

english: Actually, that one's dead. I've been helping a barmy hunter who'd sworn to kill it.
translation: Aslinda o öldü. Onu öldürmeye yemin etmis cilgin bir avciya yardim ettim.

english: What does poison do?
Many monsters use poison against their foes. If you get poisoned, you will not feel it at the time, but later you will begin to suffer its effects, and your life will drain slowly from you.
translation: Bircok canavar düsmanlarina karsi zehir kullanir. Zehirlenirseniz, o anda bir sey hissetmezsiniz, ancak daha sonra etkilerini hissetmeye baslarsiniz ve hayatiniz yavas yavas tükenir.

english: Over time the effects dwindle to nothing, but if you had already been wounded you might die before they wear off completely.
translation: Zamanla etkiler tamamen kaybolur, ancak zaten yaraliysaniz, etkiler tamamen gecmeden ölebilirsiniz.

english: Fortunately, followers of Guthix have devised potions that can cure the poison or even give immunity to it.
translation: Neyse ki, Guthix'in takipcileri zehri tedavi edebilen ve hatta zehire karsi bagisiklik kazandiran iksirler gelistirmistir.

english: Should you wish to use poison against your own enemies and those of our Lord Saradomin, there is a potion that you can smear on your daggers, arrows, spears, javelins and throwing knives.
translation: Kendi düsmanlariniza ve Lord Saradomin'in düsmanlarina karsi zehir kullanmak isterseniz, hancerlerinize, oklariniza, mizraklariniza, ciritlerinize ve firlatma bicaklariniza sürebileceginiz bir iksir vardir.

english: What monsters drop good items?
As a general rule, tougher monsters drop more valuable items. But even a lowly hobgoblin can drop valuable gems; it just does this extremely rarely.
translation: Genel kural olarak, daha güclü canavarlar daha degerli esyalar birakir. Ancak, düsük seviyeli bir hobgoblin bile degerli mücevherler birakabilir; sadece bunu cok nadiren yapar.

english: If you can persuade the Slayer Masters to train you as a Slayer, you will be able to fight certain monsters that drop valuable items far more often.
translation: Slayer Ustalarini sizi Slayer olarak egitmeleri icin ikna edebilirseniz, degerli esyalari cok daha sik düsüren belirli canavarlarla savasabilirsiniz.

english: You might care to invest in an enchanted dragonstone ring. These are said to make a monster drop its most valuable items a little more often.
translation: Büyülü bir ejderha tasi yüzügüne yatirim yapmak isteyebilirsiniz. Bunlarin, canavarlarin en degerli esyalarini biraz daha sik düsürmesini sagladigi söylenir.

english: What are these strange monsters that keep appearing out of nowhere and attacking me when I'm training?
translation: Egitim yaparken birdenbire ortaya cikip bana saldiran bu garip canavarlar nedir?

english: Ah, I imagine you see a lot of those.

Creatures such as the rock golem, river troll and tree spirit dwell in places where adventurers frequently go to train their skills. While you're training you will often disturb one by accident. It will then get angry and
translation: Kaya golem, nehir trolü ve agac ruhu gibi yaratiklar, maceracilarin becerilerini gelistirmek icin sik sik gittikleri yerlerde yasar. Egitim sirasinda sik sik kazara birini rahatsiz edersiniz. O zaman sinirlenir ve

english: attack you. The safest way to deal with them is to run away immediately, but they sometimes drop valuable items if you kill them.
translation: size saldirir. Onlarla basa cikmanin en güvenli yolu hemen kacmaktir, ancak bazen onlari öldürürseniz degerli esyalar birakirlar.

english: Tell me about valiant heroes!
Ha ha ha... There are plenty of heroes. Always have been, always will be, until the fall of the world.
translation: Ha ha ha... Kahramanlar coktur. Her zaman vardi, her zaman da olacak, dünyanin sonu gelene kadar.

english: If you'd do a few more quests, you'd soon become a fairly noted adventurer yourself.
translation: Birkac görev daha yaparsan, yakinda sen de oldukca taninmis bir maceraci olursun.

english: You're quite a noted adventurer yourself!
translation: Sen de oldukca taninmis bir maceracisin!

english: But I suppose I could tell you of a couple...

Yes, there was a man called Arrav. No-one knew where he came from, but he was a fearsome fighter, a skillful hunter and a remarkable farmer. He lived in the ancient settlement of Avarrocka, defending it from
translation: Evet, Arrav adinda bir adam vardi. Kimse nereden geldigini bilmiyordu, ama korkunc bir savasci, yetenekli bir avci ve olaganüstü bir ciftciydi. Avarrocka'nin eski yerlesim yerinde yasiyordu ve orayi goblinlerden koruyordu,

english: goblins, until he went forth in search of some strange artefact long desired by the dreaded Mahjarrat.
translation: ta ki korkunc Mahjarrat'in uzun zamandir arzuladigi garip bir eseri aramaya cikana kadar.

english: Perhaps some day I shall be able to tell you what became of him.
translation: Belki bir gün sana onun akibetini anlatabilirim.

english: But do not let your head be turned by heroics. Randas was another great man, but he let himself be beguiled into turning to serve Zamorak, and they say he is now a mindless creature deep in the Underground Pass that
translation: Ama kahramanliklarin basina vurmasina izin verme. Randas da baska bir büyük adamdi, ama kendini Zamorak'a hizmet etmeye ikna etti

english: leads to Isafdar.
translation: ve simdi Isafdar'a giden Yeralti Gecidi'nin derinliklerinde akilsiz bir yaratik oldugu söyleniyor.

english: Where did humans learn to use magic?
Ah, that was quite a discovery! It revolutionised our way of life and jolted us into this Fifth Age of the world.
translation: Ah, bu büyük bir kesifti! Yasam tarzimizi kökünden degistirdi ve bizi dünyanin Besinci Cagi'na soktu.

english: They say a traveller in the north discovered the key, although no records state exactly what he found. From this he was able to summon the magic of the four elements, using magic as a tool and a weapon. He and
translation: Kuzeydeki bir gezgin anahtari kesfettigi söylenir, ancak hicbir kayitta tam olarak ne buldugu belirtilmemistir. Bundan yola cikarak, büyüyü bir arac ve silah olarak kullanarak dört elementin büyüsünü cagirmayi basardi. O ve

english: his followers learnt how to bind the power into little stones so that others could use it.
translation: takipcileri, bu gücü kücük taslara baglayarak baskalarinin da kullanabilmesini sagladilar.

english: in the land south of here they constructed an immense tower where the power could be studied, but followers of Zamorak destroyed it with fire many years ago, and most of the knowledge was lost.
translation: Buranin güneyindeki topraklarda, bu gücü inceleyebilecekleri devasa bir kule insa ettiler, ancak Zamorak'in takipcileri yillar önce bu kuleyi atesle yok etti ve bilginin cogu kayboldu.

english: Perhaps one day those lost secrets will be uncovered once more.
translation: Belki bir gün bu kayip sirlar yeniden ortaya cikar.

english: I hear you've been very helpful to the wizards who are working on the mysteries of the rune stones.
translation: Rün taslarinin gizemlerini arastiran büyücülere cok yardimci oldugunuzu duydum.

english: Well, I didn't do much...
I suppose you'd know about the history of today's cities?
Yes, there are fairly good records of the formation of the cities from primitive settlements.
translation: Evet, ilkel yerlesim yerlerinden sehirlerin olusumuna dair oldukca iyi kayitlar var.

english: In the early part of the Fourth Age, of course, there were no permanent settlements. Tribes wandered the lands, staying where they could until the resources were exhausted.
translation: Dördüncü Cag'in baslarinda elbette kalici yerlesim yerleri yoktu. Kabileler topraklari dolasir, kaynaklar tükenene kadar kalabilecekleri yerlerde kalirlardi.

english: This changed as people learnt to grow crops and breed animals, and now there are very few of the old nomadic tribes. There's at least one tribe roaming between the Troll Stronghold and Rellekka, though.
translation: Insanlar ekin ekmeyi ve hayvan yetistirmeyi ögrendikce bu durum degisti ve simdi eski göcebe kabilelerden cok azi kaldi. Yine de Troll Kalesi ile Rellekka arasinda dolasan en az bir kabile var.

english: Yes, I've met them. They're all mad.
Truly, their faith in natural spirits is rather foolish, but they're a pleasant enough people.
translation: Dogal ruhlara olan inanclari gercekten aptalca, ama yeterince hos insanlar.

english: Anyway, what was I saying? Ah, yes...
One settlement was Avarrocka, a popular trading centre.
translation: Bir yerlesim yeri, popüler bir ticaret merkezi olan Avarrocka'ydi.

english: In the west, Ardougne gradually formed under the leadership of the Carnillean family, despite the threat of the Mahjarrat warlord Hazeel who dwelt in that area until his downfall.
translation: Bati'da, Ardougne, Mahjarrat savas lordu Hazeel'in tehdidine ragmen, Carnillean ailesinin liderliginde yavas yavas sekillendi. Hazeel, düsüsüne kadar bu bölgede yasiyordu.

english: He'll be back, just you wait!
Oh dear, I hope you haven't done anything rash!
I've foiled a dastardly Zamorakian plot to have Hazeel resurrected.
translation: Hazeel'i diriltmek icin Zamorakian'in alcakca planini bozdum.

english: So I'd heard. Lord Saradomin is smiling on you.
Tell me about yourself, old man.
Ah, so you want to know about me, eh?
translation: Ah, benim hakkimda bilgi mi istiyorsun?

english: Mmm... what could I say about myself? Let's see what I've done...
translation: Mmm... kendim hakkinda ne söyleyebilirim? Bakalim neler yaptim...

english: I've delved into the dungeon west of Brimhaven and heard the terrifying CRASH of the steel dragons battling each other for territory.
translation: Brimhaven'in batisindaki zindana girdim ve celik ejderhalarin toprak icin birbirleriyle savasirken cikardiklari korkunc CARPMA sesini duydum.

english: I spent some years on Entrana, where I learnt the techniques of pure meditation.
translation: Entrana'da birkac yil gecirdim ve orada saf meditasyon tekniklerini ögrendim.

english: I've wandered through the vast desert that lies south of Al Kharid and seen the great walls of Menaphos and Sophanem.
translation: Al Kharid'in güneyindeki ucsuz bucaksiz cölde dolastim ve Menaphos ile Sophanem'in büyük duvarlarini gördüm.

english: That feline statue you've got on your bookshelf there - I'm sure I saw something like that when I was in Sophanem.
translation: Kitap rafinda duran o kedi heykeli... Sophanem'deyken buna benzer bir sey gördügümden eminim.

english: I've always liked to collect little trinkets to remind me of the time when my life was more - ah - exciting.
translation: Hayatimin daha heyecanli oldugu zamanlari hatirlatmak icin kücük biblolar toplamayi hep sevmisimdir.

english: So you've spoken to the Sphinx, then?
Spoken to a sphinx, you say? My dear young lady, you can't possibly be serious!
translation: Sfenks ile konustun mu dedin? Sevgili genc bayan, ciddi olamazsin!

english: What do you mean?
Ha ha ha! The people who live deep in the shifting sands of the desert will often tell travellers tall tales of strange beasts, but that doesn't mean any of it's remotely true!
translation: Ha ha ha! Cölün degisken kumlarinin derinliklerinde yasayan insanlar, gezginlere sik sik garip yaratiklar hakkinda abartili hikayeler anlatirlar, ama bu, bunlarin gercek oldugu anlamina gelmez!

english: But I've met the Sph...
Please, adventurer, there is nothing to be gained by interfering in matters you do not understand.
translation: Lütfen, maceraci, anlamadigin konulara karisarak hicbir sey kazanamazsin.

english: Even if such a creature were to exist...
translation: Böyle bir yaratik var olsa bile......

english: ... which it does...
EVEN IF SUCH A CREATURE WERE TO EXIST it would be terribly dangerous for you to get involved in its business.
translation: BÖYLE BIR YARATIK VAR OLSADA, onun isine karisman senin icin cok tehlikeli olur.

english: I have heard of terrible things happening to travellers in that land, and I would not wish for you to be dragged into anything like that.
translation: O topraklarda gezginlerin basina gelen korkunc olaylari duydum ve senin de böyle bir seye bulasmani istemem.

english: Indeed, I have heard of adventurers doing the most shameful and blasphemous deeds believing themselves to be acting on behalf of some false god!
translation: Hatta, kendilerini sahte bir tanri adina hareket ettiklerini sanan maceracilarin en utanc verici ve küfürlü eylemlerde bulunduklarini duydum!

english: Hmmm?
So please do not speak to me of this matter again. Now, I believe I was telling you of my adventurous youth...
translation: Lütfen bu konuyu bir daha benimle konusma. Simdi, sana macerali gencligimden bahsediyordum...

english: Apart from all that, I've spent many a happy hour in dusty libraries, searching through ancient scrolls and texts for the wisdom of those who have passed on.
translation: Bunun disinda, tozlu kütüphanelerde, eski parsömenleri ve metinleri inceleyerek, ölenlerin bilgeligini arayarak bircok mutlu saat gecirdim.

english: Plus plenty of other adventures, quests, journeys... Is there anything else you'd like to know?
translation: Ayrica bircok baska macera, görev, yolculuk... Bilmek istedigin baska bir sey var mi?

english: I heard that Gielinor has three gods.
Indeed. This is correct: Saradomin, Guthix and Zamorak.
translation: Evet, bu dogru: Saradomin, Guthix ve Zamorak.

english: Saradomin, the great and glorious, gives life to this world.
translation: Saradomin, yüce ve sanli, bu dünyaya hayat verir.

english: Zamorak craves only death and destruction.
translation: Zamorak ise sadece ölüm ve yikim arzu eder.

english: Guthix, calling itself a god of 'balance', holds no allegiance, but simply aids whatever cause suits its shifting purpose.
translation: Guthix, kendini “denge” tanrisi olarak adlandirir, hicbir tarafa baglilik göstermez, sadece degisen amaclarina uygun olan her seye yardim eder.

english: So who's Zaros?
What did you say?
I discovered a buried altar to a god called Zaros.
translation: Zaros adinda bir tanriya ait gömülü bir sunak kesfettim.

english: Please, do not speak further of this. No good can come of meddling in such things.
translation: Lütfen bu konuyu daha fazla konusma. Bu tür seylere karismanin hicbir faydasi olmaz.

english: So Zaros is real?
Adventurer, my patience is limited. Speak to me no further of this - this - this foolishness.
translation: Maceraci, sabrim sinirlidir. Bana bu... bu... bu aptalliktan bahsetme.

english: Does that mean I shouldn't ask you about the ancient magicks I learnt in that pyramid north of Sophanem?
translation: Bu, Sophanem'in kuzeyindeki piramitte ögrendigim eski büyüler hakkinda sana soru sormamaliyim anlamina mi geliyor?

english: ENOUGH! Begone from me, you foul trickster!
translation: YETER! Git buradan, seni igrenc düzenbaz!

english: I've heard of another god, called Armadyl.
translation: Armadyl adinda baska bir tanri duydum.

english: What is this of which you speak?
A strange man asked me to go into the Temple of Ikov and steal the Staff of Armadyl.
translation: Garip bir adam benden Ikov Tapinagi'na girip Armadyl'in Asasi'ni calmami istedi.

english: And what makes you believe in this 'Armadyl'?
Well, there were servants of Armadyl living down in the depths of the temple. They'd been there for generations, guarding the staff.
translation: Armadyl'in hizmetkarlari tapinagin derinliklerinde yasiyorlardi. Nesillerdir orada kalmislar ve asayi korumuslardi.

english: So you trusted the word of these people who had been sitting down a hole all their lives?
translation: Yani hayatlari boyunca bir delikte oturmus olan bu insanlarin sözlerine mi inandin?

english: Um... Yes, I suppose so.
I wouldn't worry about this sacred 'armadyllo' anymore. Just another foolish myth.
translation: Bu kutsal “armadyllo”yu artik dert etmiyorum. Sadece aptalca bir efsane.

english: Oh well, the servants rewarded me very kindly for defeating Lucien for them.
translation: Neyse, hizmetkarlar Lucien'i yenmem icin bana cok cömert bir ödül verdiler.

english: That is an impressive feat, adventurer. Truly you must be beloved in the eyes of Saradomin.
translation: Bu etkileyici bir basari, maceraci. Saradomin'in gözünde gercekten cok seviliyorsun.

english: It's lucky there's no Armadyl! I've pinched his staff and given it to Lucien.
translation: Armadyl'in olmamasi ne sans! Asasini caldim ve Lucien'e verdim.

english: YOU'VE DONE WHAT?
Adventurer, I beg of you, do not meddle in the gods' affairs. No good can come of it.
translation: Maceraci, sana yalvariyorum, tanrilarin islerine karisma. Bundan iyi bir sey cikmaz.

english: How about Tumeken, Elindis, Icthlarin and the Devourer?
translation: Peki ya Tumeken, Elindis, Icthlarin ve Yiyici?

english: What names are these?
Down in Sophanem, they've got a chief god named Tumeken, plus a fertility goddess named Elindis. Icthlarin is their god of the dead and the Devourer...
translation: Sophanem'de Tumeken adinda bir bas tanrilari ve Elindis adinda bir bereket tanricasi var. Icthlarin onlarin ölüm tanrisi ve Yiyici...

english: Adventurer, what folly leads you to think any of these - things, exist?
translation: Maceraci, hangi delilik seni bu seylerin var olduguna inandiriyor?

english: But I've met Icthlarin! He'dgot a jackal's head!
translation: Ama ben Icthlarin'le tanistim! Cakal kafasi vardi!

english: It is hot in that land, and the heat can affect a traveller in strange ways. Tell me, when you met 'Icthlarin', had you been feeling at all unwell?
translation: O topraklar sicaktir ve sicaklik gezginleri garip sekillerde etkileyebilir. Söylesene, “Icthlarin” ile tanistiginda kendini hic iyi hissetmiyor muydun?

english: Well, now you mention it, I'd just been hypnotised by a weird woman I met in the desert.
translation: Simdi sen söyleyince hatirladim, cölde tanistigim tuhaf bir kadin tarafindan hipnotize edilmistim.

english: So a strange woman interfered with your mind, then you met a man with the head of a jackal, and you decided he must be a god?
translation: Yani tuhaf bir kadin zihnini etkiledi, sonra cakal kafali bir adamla tanistin ve onun bir tanri olduguna karar verdin?

english: Umm...
Well, make sure you don't get hypnotised again, and I'm sure you'll not meet any more jackal-headed men claiming to be gods!
translation: Tekrar hipnotize edilmediginden emin ol, o zaman tanri oldugunu iddia eden cakal kafali adamlarla karsilasmayacagindan eminim!

english: But...?
It'd probably be best if you don't go there again.
translation: Oraya bir daha gitmesen iyi olur.

english: But you've been all around that area, haven't you? When you were travelling?
translation: Ama sen o bölgenin her yerini gezdin, degil mi? Seyahat ederken?

english: Indeed, I have.
So you'd know all about their gods?
translation: O zaman onlarin tanrilari hakkinda her seyi biliyorsundur?

english: I know what I know.
And knowing what I know, I do not speak of this matter. Perhaps you would be wise to heed my example.
translation: Ve bildiklerimi bildigim icin, bu konu hakkinda konusmuyorum. Belki de benim örnegime uymak akillica olur.

english: I wanna know about the wars of the gods!
Ah, that was a terrible time. The armies of Saradomin fought gloriously against the minions of Zamorak, but many brave warriors and noble cities were overthrown and destroyed utterly.
translation: Ah, o korkunc bir dönemdi. Saradomin'in ordulari Zamorak'in kölelerine karsi sanli bir savas verdi, ama bircok cesur savasci ve asil sehir yenilgiye ugradi ve tamamen yok edildi.

english: You have visited Uzer, and seen for yourself the damage that could be wrought by an elder-demon in its wrath.
translation: Uzer'i ziyaret ettin ve bir yasli iblisin öfkesinin yol acabilecegi hasari kendi gözlerinle gördün.

english: How did it all end?
Before the Zamorakian forces could be utterly routed, Lord Saradomin took pity on them and the battle- scarred world, and allowed a truce.
translation: Zamorak'in ordulari tamamen yenilgiye ugratilmadan önce, Lord Saradomin onlara ve savasin yaraladigi dünyaya acidi ve ateskes ilan etti.

english: What are the Mahjarrat?
Very little is written about the tribe of the Mahjarrat. They are believed to be from the realm of Freneskae, or Frenaskrae - the spelling in this tongue is only approximate.
translation: Mahjarrat kabilesi hakkinda cok az sey yazilmistir. Onlarin Freneskae veya Frenaskrae kralligindan geldiklerine inanilir - bu dilde yazilislari sadece yaklasik olarak bilinmektedir.

english: One of them, the foul Zamorak, has achieved godhood, although none knows how this came about.
translation: Onlardan biri olan kötü Zamorak, nasil oldugu bilinmemekle birlikte tanrisalliga ulasmistir.

english: Other Mahjarrat who have been particularly active upon this plane are Hazeel, Lucien, Azzanadra and Zemouregal.
translation: Bu düzlemde özellikle aktif olan diger Mahjarratlar Hazeel, Lucien, Azzanadra ve Zemouregal'dir.

english: Hazeel will rise again, you'll see!
Adventurer, your actions fill me with concern!
I've defeated Lucien.
Truly, your bravery exceeds your stature. But I fear his defeat will not be permanent.
translation: Gercekten, cesaretin boyunu asiyor. Ama korkarim ki onun yenilgisi kalici olmayacak.

english: I've met Lucien. He paid me very nicely for bringing him a staff he wanted.
translation: Lucien ile tanistim. Istedigi asayi ona getirdigim icin bana cok iyi para ödedi.

english: Traveller, I beg of you, do not have further dealings with such creatures! You do not know their power as I do.
translation: Gezgin, sana yalvariyorum, bu tür yaratiklarla daha fazla is yapma! Onlarin gücünü benim kadar bilmiyorsun.

english: Azzanadra taught me some ancient magical powers after I unlocked the pyramid where he had been trapped.
translation: Azzanadra, onun hapsoldugu piramidi actiktan sonra bana bazi eski büyülü gücler ögretti.

english: Leave me, traveller; I am old, and your words fill me with horror.
translation: Beni birak, gezgin; ben yasliyim ve sözlerin beni dehsete düsürüyor.

english: Can I wield the power of Saradomin myself?
I see you are already learning to summon the power of Saradomin.
translation: Saradomin'in gücünü cagirmayi ögrenmeye basladigini görüyorum.

english: If you travel to the Mage Arena in the north-west reaches of the Wilderness, the battle mage Kolodion may be willing to let you learn to summon the power of Saradomin, should you be able to pass his test.
translation: Wilderness'nin kuzeybatisindaki Büyücü Arenasi'na gidersen, savas büyücüsü Kolodion, sinavini gecersen Saradomin'in gücünü cagirmayi ögrenmene izin verebilir.

english: I want to ask you about your hat.
translation: Sapkan hakkinda bir sey sormak istiyorum.

english: Why, thank you! I rather like it myself.
Did you steal it from the bank?
Me? Steal from the bank? Whatever do you mean?
translation: Ben mi? Bankadan calmak mi? Ne demek istiyorsun?

english: There's been a break-in at Draynor Bank, and I bet you did it.
translation: Draynor Bankasi'na hirsiz girmis ve eminim bunu sen yapmissindir.

english: Oh my goodness, what in the world could make you think I did such a thing?
translation: Aman Tanrim, nasil böyle bir sey yapabilecegimi düsünebilirsin?

english: Well, you've been sitting here looking at the bank ever since you moved into this house. Now someone's robbed the bank, and suddenly your house is full of expensive stuff!
translation: Sey, bu eve tasindigindan beri burada oturup bankayi izliyordun. Simdi biri bankayi soydu ve birdenbire evin pahali esyalarla doldu!

english: Oh dear, oh dear...
So what do you think I did? March across the street, smash the bank wall, knock out the bankers and steal all the money?
translation: Peki sence ne yaptim? Caddenin karsisina gecip banka duvarini yikip, bankacilari bayilttim ve tüm parayi caldim mi?

english: I'm an old man! I walk with a stick! How could I possibly have done that?
translation: Ben yasli bir adamim! Bastonla yürüyorum! Bunu nasil yapabilirim ki?

english: So you didn't rob the bank?
Just run along now, be a good lad, and don't worry yourself about me or my finances!
translation: Simdi git buradan, uslu bir cocuk ol ve beni ya da mali durumumu dert etme!

english: Hmmm... But I'll be keeping an eye on you.
translation: Hmmm... Ama seni gözümün önünden ayirmayacagim.

english: Now you've got that off your chest, would you like to ask me about anything else?
translation: Simdi icini döktün, baska bir sey sormak ister misin?

english: You stole it off that woman in the bank! You stole all this valuable stuff too!
translation: Onlari bankadaki kadindan caldin! Bütün bu degerli esyalari da caldin!

english: Stole it? How could you possibly think I did such a thing?
translation: Caldim mi? Nasil böyle bir sey yapabilecegimi düsünebilirsin?

english: I saw you robbing the bank! You killed all those people!
translation: Seni bankayi soyarken gördüm! Bütün o insanlari öldürdün!

english: Deary me, [player name], your imagination is running wild! What could make you think you saw me do that?
translation: Hay Allah, Maceraci, hayal gücün cok calisiyor! Beni bunu yaparken gördügünüze nasil karar verdiniz?

english: I've seen a security recording that shows you robbing the bank. The bank's guard showed it to me.
translation: Sizi bankayi soyarken gösteren güvenlik kamerasi görüntülerini gördüm. Banka görevlisi gösterdi.

english: You've seen the bank's security recording?
translation: Bankanin güvenlik kamerasi görüntülerini mi gördünüz?

english: Tut tut tut... Oh well, at least you'll never be able to tell the bank about me. They'll never listen.
translation: Tüh tüh tüh... Neyse, en azindan bankaya benden bahsedemezsiniz. Asla dinlemezler.

english: So you're just going to get away with it?
That's my plan, yes.
But that's... well, it's WRONG!
Wrong? WRONG? I'll tell you what's wrong!
translation: Yanlis mi? YANLIS mi? Sana neyin yanlis oldugunu söyleyeyim!

english: I've spent my whole life travelling the world, doing quests for people, saving lives, saving villages from terrifying monsters and all that sort of thing.
translation: Hayatim boyunca dünyayi dolastim, insanlar icin görevler yaptim, hayatlar kurtardim, köyleri korkunc canavarlardan kurtardim ve bunun gibi seyler yaptim.

english: Now I'm old, and where do I have to live? In this freezing old house next to a pig-sty, with a bunch of yobs outside who can't keep their hands off the market stalls! What sort of reward is that?
translation: Simdi yaslandim ve nerede yasamak zorundayim? Domuz ahirinin yanindaki bu dondurucu eski evde, disarida pazar tezgahlarindan ellerini cekemeyen bir grup serseriyle birlikte! Bu ne bicim bir ödül?

english: So don't talk to me about right and wrong!
translation: O yüzden bana dogru ve yanlis hakkinda konusma!

english: Maybe someone SHOULD talk to you about right and wrong...
translation: Belki de biri sana dogru ve yanlis hakkinda konusmali...

english: Bah!
Hmmph!
How can I get a hat like that?
You could buy one off another player, or wait until they're next made available by the Council.
translation: Baska bir oyuncudan satin alabilir ya da Konsey tarafindan tekrar satisa sunulana kadar bekleyebilirsin.

english: Can I buy your hat?
Ohhh no, I don't intend to part with this. Would you like to ask me about something else?
translation: Ohhh hayir, ondan ayrilmak niyetinde degilim. Baska bir sey sormak ister misin?

english: You should give it back, you know.
No, I think I'll keep it.
But...
That was quite an exciting quest we did together!
translation: Birlikte yaptigimiz oldukca heyecan verici bir görevdi!

english: Oh yes, it was certainly a fitting end to my adventuring days. Your fight against the Sea Troll Queen was highly impressive!
translation: Evet, macera günlerimin sonuna yakisir bir son oldu. Deniz Trol Kralicesi ile mücadelen cok etkileyiciydi!

english: Are you tempted to go on another quest in the future?
translation: Gelecekte baska bir göreve cikmak ister misin?

english: No, I feel I am a bit old for that kind of thing now. New times need new heroes, and I'm sure you'll always be there to answer the call!
translation: Hayir, artik bu tür seyler icin biraz yaslandigimi hissediyorum. Yeni zamanlar yeni kahramanlar gerektirir ve eminim sen her zaman bu cagriya cevap vereceksin!

english: I'll certainly see what I can do!
When we finished fighting those sea trolls, you said you'd finished with adventuring, didn't you?
translation: Deniz trollerle savasi bitirdigimizde, maceralara son verdigini söylemistin, degil mi?

english: Yes, that's right. I'm an old man, there's no denying it, and I need a nice quiet retirement.
translation: Evet, dogru. Ben yasli bir adamim, bunu inkar edemem, ve sakin bir emeklilik hayatina ihtiyacim var.

english: Besides, I think you've proved that the new generation has its own heroes and adventurers - I should step back and let you get on with it!
translation: Ayrica, yeni neslin kendi kahramanlari ve maceracilari oldugunu kanitladigini düsünüyorum - ben geri cekilip senin devam etmene izin vermeliyim!

english: Does this mean you're not going to do any more big robberies?
translation: Bu, artik büyük soygunlar yapmayacagin anlamina mi geliyor?

english: Well, since you saved my life when we were fighting the Sea Troll Queen, I don't mind telling you... I trust you won't tell anyone about this?
translation: Deniz Trol Kralicesi ile savasirken hayatimi kurtardigin icin sana söylemekte sakinca görmüyorum... Bunu kimseye söylemeyecegine güvenebilir miyim?

english: Go on...
I might just have something in mind. After all, that little bank incident went very smoothly.
translation: Aklimda bir sey olabilir. Sonucta, o kücük banka olayi cok sorunsuz gecti.

english: But you're retired!
I retired from adventuring and questing. The episode in the bank was hardly a quest, more like a shopping trip!
translation: Maceraciliktan ve görevlerden emekli oldum. Bankadaki olay bir görevden cok, alisveris gezisine benziyordu!

english: Your shopping trip killed 3 bank staff and several innocent bystanders, not to mention the watchman!
translation: Alisveris gezinde 3 banka calisani ve birkac masum yoldan gecen öldü, bekciyi saymiyorum bile!

english: I've saved countless villages from unspeakable terrors and slain innumerable evil monsters - surely I deserve some sort of reward in return? Yet what did I get? NOTHING!
translation: Sayisiz köyü tarifsiz dehsetlerden kurtardim ve sayisiz kötü canavari öldürdüm - karsiliginda bir tür ödül hak etmiyor muyum? Peki ne aldim? HICBIR SEY!

english: You yourself would get pretty angry if you did a long and dangerous quest and didn't get any reward from it, eh? I'm sure you would!
translation: Sen de uzun ve tehlikeli bir görev yapip karsiliginda hicbir ödül almazsan oldukca sinirlenirdin, degil mi? Eminim sinirlenirdin!

english: Well imagine how I felt at the end of a long life of questing when was left penniless, and I had to move into this thief-infested village! This little shack was falling apart when I arrived!
translation: O zaman, uzun bir görev hayatinin sonunda bes parasiz kaldigimda ve hirsizlarin istila ettigi bu köye tasinmak zorunda kaldigimda nasil hissettigimi bir düsün! Bu kücük kulübe geldigimde yikilmak üzereydi!

english: You go speak to that hag who keeps looking through my window - she'll show you how it used to look before I could afford to redecorate it!
translation: Penceremden iceriye bakip duran o cadalozla konusun, size yeniden dekore etmeye param yetmeden önce nasil göründügünü gösterecektir!

english: Being noble and virtuous simply doesn't put food on the table, and I don't intend to sit in banks begging like so many people do these days.
translation: Asil ve erdemli olmak masaya yemek koymaz ve ben de bugünlerde pek cok insanin yaptigi gibi banklarda oturup dilenmek niyetinde degilim.

english: So all those quests in the past, when you saved people from monsters and stuff like that... You only helped them because you wanted a reward?
translation: Yani gecmiste yaptiginiz tüm o görevler, insanlari canavarlardan kurtardiginiz ve benzeri seyler... Onlara sadece ödül almak icin mi yardim ettin?

english: No, it wasn't always like that. I used to be satisfied just knowing that I'd helped, and that was reward enough.
translation: Hayir, her zaman öyle degildi. Eskiden yardim ettigimi bilmek bana yetiyordu, bu benim icin yeterli bir ödüldü.

english: But eventually I realised that people forgot about me as soon as the danger was gone, and I wasn't even getting paid properly for my services. Sometimes they offered training in the various skills, but that's no use to me!
translation: Ama sonunda, tehlike gecince insanlarin beni unuttugunu ve hizmetlerim icin düzgün bir ödeme almadigimi fark ettim. Bazen cesitli beceriler konusunda egitim teklif ediyorlardi, ama bunlarin bana bir faydasi yoktu!

english: I eventually realised that the only way I could get a proper reward for my life's efforts is if I took the reward myself. So I took up my cape and staff and headed for the bank.
translation: Sonunda, hayatim boyunca yaptigim cabalarin karsiligini alabilmemin tek yolunun ödülü kendim almam oldugunu fark ettim. Bu yüzden pelerinimi ve asami alip bankaya gittim.

english: And now you're planning to do another robbery? Didn't you get enough from the bank?
translation: Ve simdi baska bir soygun mu planliyorsun? Bankadan aldigin yetmedi mi?

english: Perhaps not... But enough of this matter! Is there anything else you'd like to ask?
translation: Belki de... Ama bu konuyu kapatalim! Baska soracagin bir sey var mi?

english: Humph! You could at least say hello before waving your items in my face.
translation: Humph! En azindan merhaba diyebilirdin, yüzüme esyalarini sallamadan önce.

english: Do you think I need to keep this?
I suppose you could use that in combat.
Thanks, old man.
I suppose you could use that for defense.
Runes are very useful things, but I'll take some of those off your hands for you.
translation: Rünler cok kullanisli seylerdir, ama ben senin icin bunlardan bazilarini alacagim.

english: Ooh, runes? Yes, they're quite valuable.
translation: Ooh, rünler mi? Evet, oldukca degerlidirler.

english: That's called 'money'. Money is fantastically important if you haven't got enough of it, but when you've got as much as I have, you realise that money doesn't matter.
translation: Buna “para” denir. Para, yeterince yoksa inanilmaz derecede önemlidir, ama benim kadar cok paran varsa, paranin önemi olmadigini anlarsin.

english: Right...
That's mine. I'll take it back, thank you very much!
translation: O benim. Geri alacagim, cok tesekkürler!

english: How did you get your hands on that?!
Get out of here this instant.
Tell you what, rather than you showing me items individually, I'll look through all your possessions to see if I can find anything worth discarding.
translation: Bak ne diyecegim, bana esyalari tek tek göstermen yerine, tüm esyalarini inceleyip atmaya deger bir sey bulabilir miyim diye bakacagim.

english: It'd be politer to come and talk to me before you start messing around with my possessions!
translation: Esyalarimi karistirmaya baslamadan önce gelip benimle konussan daha kibar olur!

english: I see you've got your telescope pointing at the Wizards' Tower.
Oh, do I? Well, why does that interest you?
It just seems a bit odd.
Odd? There's nothing odd about a fascination with the magical arts. Besides, the architecture of that Tower is truly remarkable, for one who studies such things.
translation: Tuhaf mi? Büyü sanatlarina ilgi duymakta tuhaf bir sey yok. Ayrica, bu tür seyleri inceleyen biri icin o kulenin mimarisi gercekten olaganüstü.

english: So you're not planning to attack the Tower?
No, I wouldn't dream of doing anything of the sort!
translation: Hayir, böyle bir seyi hayal bile edemem!

english: Hmmm...
Well, you robbed a bank, and I bet you're now planning something to do with that Tower!
translation: Bir banka soydugun icin, eminim simdi de o kuleyle ilgili bir seyler planliyorsundur!

english: No, no. I'm not planning anything like that again.
translation: Hayir, hayir. Bir daha böyle bir sey yapmayi planlamiyorum.

english: Well I'll be watching you...
Oh, he's not here.
Well, this is rather embarrassing, but I think there's some kind of monster in my house. Could you go upstairs and get rid of it, please?
translation: Bu biraz utanc verici ama sanirim evimde bir tür canavar var. Yukari cikip onu ortadan kaldirabilir misin lütfen?

english: Where do I need to go?
I think it's somewhere upstairs. It kept me awake all last night.
translation: Sanirim üst katta bir yerde. Dün gece bütün gece uykumu kacirdi.

english: Right, I'll see you later.
I need some bronze bars. Please bring me [#].
translation: Biraz bronz cubuk lazim. Lütfen bana [#] getir.

english: Where can I get that?
Mine some copper ore and tin ore. The furnace in Lumbridge can smelt them into bars of bronze.
translation: Biraz bakir cevheri ve kalay cevheri cikar. Lumbridge'deki firin bunlari bronz cubuklara dönüstürebilir.

english: I need a few bronze daggers to keep the goblins at bay. Please bring me [#].
I'd like some maces made of bronze. Please bring me [#].
I need a few bronze arrowheads to complete some arrows I was making. Please bring me [#].
I'd like some bronze knives to throw at goblins. Please bring me [#].
My weapons collection isn't all it used to be. Some short swords made of bronze would be much appreciated. Please bring me [#].
The head fell off my axe when I was chopping wood last week, so I need some more bronze axes. Please bring me [#].
Could you fetch me some big warhammers made of bronze? Please bring me [#].
I could do with some medium-sized helmets. I'd like bronze ones. Please bring me [#].
I need some lengths of bronze wire to repair something. Please bring me [#].
Try smelting some copper and tin ore to make bronze. Then hammer the bronze on an anvil to make [daggers/maces/arrowheads/throwing knives/short swords/axes/warhammers/helmets/wire].
I need some iron bars. Please bring me [#].
Mine some iron ore. The furnace in Lumbridge can smelt them into bars of iron.
translation: Biraz demir cevheri cikar. Lumbridge'deki firin bunlari demir cubuklara eritebilir.

english: I need some iron arrowheads to put on the arrows I was making. Please bring me [#].
translation: Yaptigim oklarin üzerine takmak icin biraz demir ok ucu lazim. Lütfen bana [#] getir.

english: I could do with some iron throwing knives to keep the goblins away from my house. Please bring me [#].
translation: Goblinleri evimden uzak tutmak icin demir firlatma bicaklari isime yarayabilir. Lütfen bana [#] getir.

english: I'd like some chunky iron warhammers. Please bring me [#].
translation: Kalin demir savas cekicleri istiyorum. Lütfen bana [#] getir.

english: Some iron maces would be useful. Please bring me [#].
translation: Demir topuzlar isime yarayabilir. Lütfen bana [#] getir.

english: Try smelting some iron. Then hammer the bronze on an anvil to make [arrowtips/throwing knives/warhammers/maces].
A few lumps of iron ore would be nice. Please bring me [#].
It should be easy enough for you to mine some iron ore.
translation: Demir cevheri cikarmak senin icin kolay olmali.

english: I've found a use for cadava berries. Please bring me [#].
Just look around the woods south-west of Varrock.
The hail can be very heavy here, so I'd like a few leather cowls. Please bring me [#].
translation: Burada dolu cok siddetli olabilir, bu yüzden birkac deri baslik istiyorum. Lütfen bana [#] getirin.

english: If you get the tanner in Al Kharid to turn some cowhides into leather, you'll be able to make the cowls yourself. Buy needles & thread from the crafting shop in Al Kharid if you need any.
translation: Al Kharid'deki tabakciya birkac sigir derisini deriye dönüstürmesini söylerseniz, basliklari kendiniz yapabilirsiniz. Ihtiyaciniz olursa Al Kharid'deki zanaat dükkanindan igne ve iplik satin alin.

english: Strange as it may seem, I want a lot of beer! Please bring me [#].
There's a pub not far from here that will sell you plenty of that. Go west to Port Sarim.
translation: Buradan cok uzak olmayan bir pub var, orada bolca bulabilirsiniz. Batiya, Port Sarim'e gidin.

english: I don't have a decent larder here, so I can't store food very well. Now I'm out of loaves of bread. Please bring me [#].
translation: Burada düzgün bir kilerim yok, bu yüzden yiyecekleri iyi saklayamiyorum. Simdi ekmegim bitti. Lütfen bana [#] getirin.

english: Mix some flour and water to make bread dough, then bake it on a cooking range.
translation: Un ve suyu karistirip ekmek hamuru yapin, sonra firinda pisirin.

english: I'll be needing a few pieces of soft leather. Please bring me [#].
There's a tanner in Al Kharid who will turn cowhides into leather.
translation: Al Kharid'de sigir derilerini deriye dönüstüren bir tabakhane var.

english: I saw an interesting bed in Karamja called a 'hammock'. It seemed to be made out of string, and I'd like some balls of wool so I can make my own. Please bring me [#].
translation: Karamja'da “hamak” adi verilen ilginc bir yatak gördüm. Ip ile yapilmis gibi görünüyordu ve kendiminkini yapabilmek icin birkac yün yumak istiyorum. Lütfen bana [#] getir.

english: You can buy shears from the general store east of here. Shear some sheep, then spin the wool into balls on the spinning wheel in Lumbridge Castle.
translation: Buradan dogudaki genel magazadan makas satin alabilirsin. Koyunlari kirk, sonra Lumbridge Kalesi'ndeki egirme carkinda yünü top haline getir.

english: It's a bit nippy in this house, and my hands are cold. I need some leather gloves. Please bring me [#].
translation: Bu ev biraz soguk ve ellerim üsüyor. Deri eldivenlere ihtiyacim var. Lütfen bana [#] getir.

english: If you get the tanner in Al Kharid to turn some cowhides into leather, you'll be able to sew the gloves yourself. Buy a needle & thread from the crafting shop in Al Kharid.
translation: Al Kharid'deki tabakciya inek derilerini deriye dönüstürmesini söylersen, eldivenleri kendin dikebilirsin. Al Kharid'deki zanaat dükkanindan igne ve iplik satin al.

english: I'm going to make an omelette, so I'll need some eggs. Please bring me [#].
translation: Omlet yapacagim, bu yüzden yumurtaya ihtiyacim var. Lütfen bana [#] getir.

english: Eggs are usually found where chickens are farmed.
translation: Yumurtalar genellikle tavuklarin yetistirildigi yerlerde bulunur.

english: My undergarments are getting a bit worn out. I'll be needing some sheets of silk to patch them. Please bring me [#].
translation: Ic camasirlarim biraz eskidi. Onlari yamalamak icin ipek kumasa ihtiyacim var. Lütfen bana [#] getir.

english: There's a man in Al Kharid who sells it very cheaply. If you ever take any to Ardougne you'll get a good profit.
translation: Al Kharid'de cok ucuza satan bir adam var. Ardougne'a götürürsen iyi bir kâr elde edersin.

english: I'll need some clay that's been softened so I can craft it. Please bring me [#].
translation: Isleyebilmem icin yumusatilmis kil lazim. Lütfen bana [#] getir.

english: If you mine some clay, you can use containers of water on it to soften it.
translation: Kil madenciligi yaparsan, üzerine su dolu kaplar koyarak yumusatabilirsin.

english: Believe it or not, I need a few unfired clay pots. Please bring me [#].
translation: Inan ya da inanma, birkac tane pismemis kil cömlek lazim. Lütfen bana [#] getir.

english: Mine some clay. Then use a container full of water to soften it. In the Barbarian Village you'll be able to form this into pots. Just don't bake them.
translation: Biraz kil cikar. Sonra su dolu bir kap kullanarak yumusat. Barbar Köyü'nde bunu cömlek haline getirebilirsin. Sadece pisirme.

english: My roof is leaking, so I need some swamp paste to fix it. Please bring me [#].
translation: Catim akiyor, tamir etmek icin bataklik macunu lazim. Lütfen bana [#] getir.

english: Swamp tar is found south-east of here. Add it to a pot of flour and cook it on an open fire to make the paste.
translation: Bataklik katrani buradan güneydoguda bulunur. Un dolu bir tencereye ekleyip acik ateste pisirerek macun yap.

english: Potatoes
There's a field of those north of Lumbridge.
I want to make some arrows, so I'll need some headless arrows that have the feathers attached. Please bring me [#].
translation: Ok yapmak istiyorum, bu yüzden tüyleri takili bassiz oklar lazim. Lütfen bana [#] getir.

english: Use a knife to chop some logs into arrowshafts. Then add a feather to each arrowshaft.
translation: Bicakla kütükleri kesip ok saplari yap. Sonra her ok sapina bir tüy ekle.

english: I need some bronze spears. Please bring me [#].
translation: Biraz bronz mizrak lazim. Lütfen bana [#] getir.

english: If you kill some of those pesky goblins, you're bound to get some bronze spears.
translation: O sinir bozucu goblinlerden birkacini öldürürsen, bronz mizraklar elde edersin.

english: My glassware got damaged when I moved here, so I need some new beer glasses. Please bring me [#].
translation: Buraya tasinirken cam esyalarim kirildi, bu yüzden yeni bira bardaklari lazim. Lütfen bana [#] getir.

english: If you get some seaweed and a bucket of sand, you'll be able to mix them at a furnace to make molten glass. Then use a glassblowing pipe to make beer glasses. Most of what you need can be found on Entrana.
translation: Biraz deniz yosunu ve bir kova kum bulursan, bunlari firinda karistirarak erimis cam yapabilirsin. Sonra cam üfleme borusu kullanarak bira bardaklari yap. Ihtiyacin olan cogu seyi Entrana'da bulabilirsin.

english: My plans for today require some sets of bones, the normal-sized sort you get from goblins. Please bring me [#].
translation: Bugünkü planlarim icin birkac set kemik lazim, goblinlerden elde edebilecegin normal boyutta olanlardan. Lütfen bana [#] getir.

english: You'll find bones easily enough if you fight creatures.
Strange as this may seem, I need some unfired pie dishes. Please bring me [#].
translation: Garip gelebilir ama pismemis turta kaliplarina ihtiyacim var. Lütfen bana [#] getir.

english: Mine some clay. Then use a container full of water to soften it. In the Barbarian Village you'll be able to form this into pie dishes. Just don't bake them.
translation: Biraz kil cikar. Sonra su dolu bir kap kullanarak yumusat. Barbar Köyü'nde bunu turta kaliplarina dönüstürebilirsin. Sadece pisirme.

english: I hear pet cats are getting popular these days. I'd like some raw rat in case I get one. Please bring me [#].
translation: Son zamanlarda evcil kedilerin popüler oldugunu duydum. Bir tane alirsam diye cig fare istiyorum. Lütfen bana [#] getir.

english: You should find some big rats south-east of here in the swamp.
translation: Buranin güneydogusundaki bataklikta büyük fareler bulabilirsin.

english: I need a few lumps of copper ore. Please bring me [#].
translation: Birkac parca bakir cevheri lazim. Lütfen bana [#] getir.

english: It should be easy enough for you to mine some copper ore.
translation: Bakir cevheri cikarmak senin icin kolay olmali.

english: I'm out of flour, so I could do with a few pots of that. Please bring me [#].
translation: Unum bitti, birkac tencere un getirebilir misin? Lütfen bana [#] getir.

english: There's a windmill north of here. You can use it to grind grain into flour. Then use an empty pot to collect the flour.
translation: Buranin kuzeyinde bir yel degirmeni var. Orayi kullanarak tahillari un haline getirebilirsin. Sonra bos bir tencere kullanarak unu topla.

english: I need a handful of feathers to stick in my beard. Please bring me [#].
translation: Sakalimi süslemek icin bir avuc tüy lazim. Lütfen bana [#] getir.

english: The cheapest way to get feathers is to kill chickens.
translation: Tüyleri elde etmenin en ucuz yolu tavuklari öldürmektir.

english: This house is a bit cold, so I could do with some normal logs to burn. Please bring me [#].
translation: Bu ev biraz soguk, bu yüzden yakmak icin normal odunlara ihtiyacim var. Lütfen bana [#] getir.

english: I suggest you take an axe and chop down some standard trees.
translation: Bir balta alip normal agaclari kesmeni öneririm.

english: I'm running short of food, so I'd like some cooked chickens. Please bring me [#].
translation: Yiyecegim azaliyor, bu yüzden pismis tavuk istiyorum. Lütfen bana [#] getir.

english: You could try killing some chickens, then cooking their meat.
My footwear is getting a bit worn out, so I need a few pairs of leather boots. Please bring me [#].
translation: Ayakkabilarim biraz eskidi, bu yüzden birkac cift deri bot lazim. Lütfen bana [#] getir.

english: If you get the tanner in Al Kharid to turn some cowhides into leather, you'll be able to make the boots yourself. Buy needles & thread from the crafting shop in Al Kharid if you need any.
translation: Al Kharid'deki tabakciya birkac inek derisini deriye dönüstürmesini söylersen, botlari kendin yapabilirsin. Ihtiyacin olursa Al Kharid'deki zanaat dükkanindan igne ve iplik satin al.

english: I'd like a few cowhides. Please bring me [#].
translation: Birkac inek derisi istiyorum. Lütfen bana [#] getir.

english: If you slaughter some cows, you'll get cowhides easily enough.
translation: Birkac inek kesersen, kolayca inek derisi elde edebilirsin.

english: My shortbow's string is getting a bit worn out, so could you fetch me some bow strings? Please bring me [#].
translation: Kisa yayimin ipi biraz yipranmis, bana biraz yay ipi getirir misin? Lütfen bana [#] getir.

english: If you pick some flax, you can use the spinning wheel in Lumbridge Castle to spin it into bowstrings.
translation: Keten toplarsan, Lumbridge Kalesi'ndeki egirme carkini kullanarak onu yay ipi haline getirebilirsin.

english: I'm a bit hungry. I'd like some cooked meat, not chicken or any sort of bird. And definitely not camel or rabbit either! Please bring me [#].
translation: Biraz aciktim. Tavuk ya da baska bir kus degil, pismis et istiyorum. Kesinlikle deve ya da tavsan da istemiyorum! Lütfen bana [#] getir.

english: Just cook some beef, rat or bear.
translation: Sigir eti, sican ya da ayi eti pisir.

english: I'm short of ammunition, so I could do with some bronze arrows. That way I can shoot at goblins through my window. Please bring me [#].
translation: Mühimmatim azaldi, bu yüzden bronz oklar isime yarar. Böylece penceremden goblinlere ates edebilirim. Lütfen bana [#] getir.

english: You can make them by chopping a log into arrowshafts and adding feathers to them, then smithing a bronze bar into arrowheads to complete the arrows.
translation: Bunlari, bir kütügü ok sapi olarak kesip üzerine tüyler ekleyerek, ardindan bronz cubugu ok ucu olarak döverek yapabilirsiniz.

english: I'd like a bit of grain. Please bring me [#].
translation: Biraz tahil istiyorum. Lütfen bana [#] getirin.

english: There's a field full of it north of here.
translation: Buranin kuzeyinde tahil dolu bir tarla var.
