english: I need a few lumps of tin ore. Please bring me [#].
translation: Birkac parca kalay cevheri lazim. Lütfen bana [#] getirin.

english: You shouldn't have any trouble mining tin ore.
I could do with some freshly cooked [anchovies/shrimps] for a salad I'm planning. Please bring me [#].
Use a small fishing net to get [anchovies/shrimps] from the sea south of here. Then cook them on a fire or range.
I'd like to study the rune essence that the wizards have been talking about recently, so I need a few pieces. Please bring me [#].
translation: Son zamanlarda büyücülerin bahsettigi rune özünü incelemek istiyorum, bu yüzden birkac parca lazim. Lütfen bana [#] getirin.

english: Ask the Archmage in the tower south of here to teleport you to the Rune Essence mine. Then you can mine me some pieces.
translation: Buradan güneydeki kuledeki Basbüyücü'den sizi Rune Essence madenine isinlamasini isteyin. Sonra bana birkac parca cikarabilirsiniz.

english: Some chunks of molten glass would be the ideal patch for my cracked window. Please bring me [#].
translation: Catlak pencerem icin erimis cam parcalari ideal bir yama olur. Lütfen bana [#] getirin.

english: Use a bucket of sand with some soda ash on a furnace.
translation: Firinda bir kova kum ve biraz soda külü kullanin.

english: Greetings, [player].
I've killed a creature that was under your bed.
Ah, thank you very much! Now I shall be able to sleep in peace.
translation: Ah, cok tesekkür ederim! Artik huzur icinde uyuyabilecegim.

english: Allow me to offer you an appropriate reward for your assistance...
translation: Yardimin icin sana uygun bir ödül sunmama izin ver...

english: I've got some of the stuff you wanted.
Ahh, you are very kind.
I'll come back when I've got the rest.
translation: Geri kalanini da aldigimda geri gelecegim.

english: I've got all the stuff you asked me to fetch.
Thank you, thank you! In thanks, I shall bestow on you a simple blessing.
translation: Tesekkürler, tesekkürler! Tesekkür olarak sana basit bir lütuf bahsedecegim.

english: Thank you, thank you! Please take this money as a sign of my gratitude.
translation: Tesekkürler, tesekkürler! Lütfen bu parayi minnettarligimin bir göstergesi olarak kabul et.

english: Thank you, thank you! Please take these seeds as a sign of my gratitude.
translation: Tesekkürler, tesekkürler! Lütfen bu tohumlari minnettarligimin bir göstergesi olarak kabul et.

english: Thank you, thank you! Please take these herbs as a sign of my gratitude.
translation: Tesekkürler, tesekkürler! Lütfen bu otlari minnettarligimin bir göstergesi olarak kabul et.

english: Thank you, thank you! Please take these runes as a sign of my gratitude.
translation: Tesekkürler, tesekkürler! Lütfen bu rünleri minnettarligimin bir göstergesi olarak kabul et.

english: Thank you, thank you! Please take this gem as a sign of my gratitude.
translation: Tesekkürler, tesekkürler! Lütfen bu mücevheri minnettarligimin bir göstergesi olarak kabul edin.

english: Here, I've got the items you wanted.
Those are banknotes! I can't use those!
I'd give you a reward, but you don't seem to have any space for it. Come back when you do.
translation: Sana bir ödül vermek isterdim, ama bunun icin yerin yok gibi görünüyor. Yer acildiginda geri gel.

english: If you come back with at least one inventory space, I'll give you another copy.
translation: En az bir envanter yeri acildiginda geri gelirsen, sana bir tane daha veririm.

english: Father Aereck in Lumbridge is sure to reward you if you take a note to him for me.
translation: Lumbridge'deki Peder Aereck, ona benim icin bir not götürürseniz size ödül verecektir.

english: Here's the letter.
Just head eastwards to Lumbridge. He'll be in the church.
translation: Doguya, Lumbridge'e dogru gidin. Kilisede olacaktir.

english: Could you please take a message to the High Priest of Entrana for me?
translation: Entrana'nin Bas Rahibine benim icin bir mesaj götürür müsünüz?

english: There are some monks in Port Sarim, west of here, who will take you there so long as you're not carrying any weapons or armour.
translation: Buradan batiya, Port Sarim'de silah veya zirh tasimadiginiz sürece sizi oraya götürecek bazi rahipler var.

english: Reldo, the librarian in Varrock Palace, wrote to me recently about something. I need you to take my reply to him.
translation: Varrock Sarayi'ndaki kütüphaneci Reldo, bana yakin zamanda bir mektup yazdi. Ona cevabimi götürmenizi istiyorum.

english: The library is on the ground floor of the Palace in Varrock.
Thurgo the dwarf is from an ancient tribe. I've found some of its history that he was asking about, and I need you to deliver the information to him.
translation: Cüce Thurgo, eski bir kabileden geliyor. Onun sordugu kabilenin tarihiyle ilgili bazi bilgiler buldum ve bu bilgileri ona iletmenizi istiyorum.

english: Go west to Port Sarim, then southwards to some cliffs. He lives on the beach there.
translation: Batiya, Port Sarim'e gidin, sonra güneye, bazi kayaliklara dogru ilerleyin. Orada, sahilde yasiyor.

english: I hear my old friend FrLawrence in Varrock is drinking a bit too much. I'd like to get a letter to him about it.
translation: Varrock'taki eski dostum FrLawrence'in biraz fazla ictigini duydum. Ona bu konuyla ilgili bir mektup göndermek istiyorum.

english: Varrock is a fairly long way north-east of here. The church is at the eastern side of the town, near the Palace.
translation: Varrock, buradan kuzeydoguya dogru oldukca uzakta. Kilise, kasabanin dogu tarafinda, Saray'in yakininda.

english: I've written a letter to my old friend Abbot Langley that I'd like you to deliver.
translation: Eski dostum Abbot Langley'e bir mektup yazdim, onu ona ulastirmani istiyorum.

english: Walk northwards, past Draynor Manor. When you reach the Barbarian Village, go north-west until you find his Monastery. He'll be downstairs.
translation: Kuzeye dogru yürüyün, Draynor Malikanesi'ni gecin. Barbar Köyü'ne vardiginizda, manastirini bulana kadar kuzeybatiya dogru ilerleyin. Asagida olacaktir.

english: I'd like to get a note up to the Oracle on Ice Mountain.
translation: Buz Dagi'ndaki Kahin'e bir not göndermek istiyorum.

english: Walk northwards, past Draynor Manor. When you reach the Barbarian Village, go north-west until you see the Ice Mountain. It'll be at the top.
translation: Kuzeye dogru yürüyün, Draynor Malikanesi'ni gecin. Barbar Köyü'ne vardiginizda, Buz Dagi'ni görene kadar kuzeybatiya dogru ilerleyin. Dagin tepesinde olacaktir.

english: Yes, you're meant to be delivering it for me!
translation: Evet, benim icin teslim etmen gerekiyordu!

english: I asked you to deliver that for me. But I may as well take it back now.
translation: Bunu benim icin teslim etmeni istemistim. Ama simdi geri alayim bari.

english: You seem to have mislaid my letter, so here's another copy.
translation: Mektubumu kaybetmissin galiba, iste bir kopyasi daha.

english: Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to answer this for me.
Please enter the answer to the question.
How can that be? Try again!
Spot on!
Could I have some free stuff, please?
translation: Biraz bedava malzeme alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: Ok, what do you want me to do?
Thanks, maybe some other time.
I'd just like to ask you something.
Could you check my items for junk, please?
translation: Esyalarimda cöp var mi kontrol eder misin lütfen?

english: Can I get another hood for my Quest Point Cape?
translation: Quest Point Cape'im icin baska bir baslik alabilir miyim?

english: Can I buy a Quest Point Cape, please?
translation: Quest Point Cape satin alabilir miyim lütfen?

Actually, no thanks.

Wisp starts to whisper into your ear...
Woah, woah, woah! None of that! I know what your whispers are capable of.
translation: Dur, dur, dur! Yapma! Fisiltilarinin neye kadir oldugunu biliyorum.

english: Can you sing me a song?
If I were to do that, your mind would perish.
translation: Eger bunu yaparsam, zihnin yok olur.

english: Maybe I can sing you a song instead?
translation: Belki ben sana bir sarki söyleyebilirim?

english: I'd rather you d-
Ehem...
Let my voice lead you this waaay!
translation: Sesimin seni bu yöne götürmesine izin ver!

english: I will not lead you astraaay!
Please... No more.
Suit yourself. I'd make a great siren.
translation: Sen bilirsin. Harika bir siren olurum.

english: Mmmhmm.
Hows it going, Wisp?
There is too much light here. It's awful.
translation: Burada cok fazla isik var. Berbat.

english: I love it!
I miss the shadows.
The darkness here is comforting.
It is, isn't it.
One day I will return to the shadows.
Will you now...?
I can feel the power of the shadows. You shall be my servant soon enough.
translation: Gölgelerin gücünü hissedebiliyorum. Yakinda benim hizmetkarim olacaksin.

english: Well... that's dark.
Hi!
Welcome to Burthorpe Supplies. Your last shop before heading north into the mountains!
translation: Burthorpe Supplies'a hos geldiniz. Daglara dogru kuzeye gitmeden önce son duraginiz!

english: Would you like to buy something?
translation: Bir sey satin almak ister misiniz?

english: Yes, please.
No, thanks.
Yes, please.
No, thanks.
Hello deary. Don't worry, I'm friendly.
translation: Merhaba canim. Merak etme, ben dost canlisi biriyim.

english: You look very familiar but I can't remember chatting to you before.
translation: Cok tanidik geliyorsun ama seninle daha önce konustugumu hatirlamiyorum.

english: Well, my sisters used to live here but folk kept on killing them. A terrible affair, it was. I knew that no one would want to kill a chatty old dear like me, though.
translation: Kiz kardeslerim eskiden burada yasiyordu ama insanlar onlari öldürüp duruyordu. Korkunc bir olaydi. Ama benim gibi geveze bir yasliyi kimsenin öldürmek istemeyecegini biliyordum.

english: Oh, well...
We still have a problem with local louts, though. Poisoning my fish, spilling my compost all over the place and causing a nuisance for the dear count.
translation: Yine de yerel serserilerle sorunumuz var. Baligimi zehirliyorlar, kompostumu her yere döküyorlar ve sevgili kontu rahatsiz ediyorlar.

english: I think...
I'm sure a nice young sort like you won't be any trouble, though. In any case, the Professor will soon share the secret of chickenisation with me... Not that I'd use it these days of course.
translation: Senin gibi hos bir genc sorun cikarmayacaktir. Her halükarda, Profesör yakinda tavuklastirmanin sirrini benimle paylasacak... Tabii ki bu günlerde onu kullanmayacagim.

english: I have to go now.
Hello my ickle...oh, it's you. What do you want?
translation: Merhaba benim kücük... oh, sensin. Ne istiyorsun?

english: I wondered whether you had anything interesting to say.
translation: Ilginc bir sey söyleyecek misin diye merak ettim.

english: Clearly not.
Great, you'll go far! I made some nice painted metal toys for you, snookums.
translation: Harika, cok basarili olacaksin! Senin icin güzel boyali metal oyuncaklar yaptim, tatlim.

english: Toys? Snookums? What are you on about, you deranged old bat?
translation: Oyuncaklar mi? Tatlim mi? Ne diyorsun sen, kacik yasli kadin?

english: Oh, forget it, then. If you won't react to kindness, I'm back to luring infants into my oven. You'll have it on your conscience.
translation: Oh, bos ver o zaman. Eger nezakete karsilik vermeyeceksen, bebekleri firinima cekmeye devam edecegim. Vicdanin rahat etmeyecek.

english: Go to the iron mine just north-east of Rimmington and hit the bar with a plain old smithing hammer while facing north. Then take your new magnet to Ava. Poor girl, having to deal with whippersnappers like you.
translation: Rimmington'un kuzeydogusundaki demir madenine git ve kuzeye bakarak eski bir demirci cekiciyle cubuga vur. Sonra yeni miknatisini Ava'ya götür. Zavalli kiz, senin gibi küstahlarla ugrasmak zorunda kaliyor.

english: Miaoww
Sssss! Thou art brave to wander so far into the domain of Kardia, mine mistress!
translation: Sssss! Kardia'nin topraklarina bu kadar girerek cesur davraniyorsun, benim hanimim!

english: But soon thou shalt become a soulless servant of Lord Iban, like all who come here.
translation: Ama yakinda buraya gelen herkes gibi Lord Iban'in ruhsuz bir hizmetkari olacaksin.

english: Glad shall mine heart be when I see thee prostrate thineself before the altars of Zamorak the Mighty.
translation: Seni Zamorak the Mighty'nin sunaklari önünde secde ederken gördügümde kalbim sevinecek.

english: No milk for you, puss!
Hello there.
What have you got to be so cheerful about?
Well, it's another nice day.
Ha! Try worrying about how you feed a family with no job. Then tell me how nice the day is!
translation: Ha! Issiz bir ailenin gecimini nasil saglayacagini düsünsen de bir bak, sonra bana günün ne kadar güzel oldugunu söyle!

english: Okay, I guess I've caught you at a bad time. Goodbye.
translation: Tamam, sanirim seni kötü bir zamanda yakaladim. Hosca kal.

english: Hmm? Oh, hello there.
Are you okay? You seem a bit preoccupied.
It's nothing stranger. No need to concern yourself.
translation: Önemli bir sey degil. Endiselenmene gerek yok.

english: Spare a coin mister?
translation: Bir bozuk para verir misiniz bayim?

english: What do you need it for?
For a poor unemployed fisherman what needs to eat.
translation: Yiyecek ihtiyaci olan fakir, issiz bir balikci icin.

english: Why don't you just fish for some food?
Err... Goodbye mister.
Can you believe they did this to us?
Wha...
I mean, what did they think would happen?
Who...
Building that whacking great Fishing Platform just off the coast.
translation: Kiyiya yakin o devasa balikci platformunu insa ettiler.

english: Fish...
Dratted thing stole all of our trade.
translation: Lanet olasi sey tüm isimizi elimizden aldi.

english: Excuse...
I'm sorry, I'm too angry to speak right now. Goodbye
translation: Üzgünüm, su anda cok kizginim, konusamiyorum. Hosca kalin.

english: With our nets and gear we're faring,
On the wild and wasteful ocean,
It's there on the deep that we harvest and reap our bread,
As we hunt the bonny shoals of herring.
That's a lovely song.
Aye lad, and sing it every day we did.
'Till the Fishing Platform came and ruined everything.
translation: Ta ki Balikcilik Platformu gelip her seyi mahvedene kadar.

english: Oh, I'm sorry.
No need lad, it not be your fault.
translation: Gerek yok evlat, senin sucun degil.

english: Their eyes are staring vacantly into space.
Ye mariners all, as ye pass by,
Come in and drink if you are dry,
Come spend, me lads, your money brisk,
And pop your nose in a jug of this.
translation: Ve burnunuzu bu sürahinin icine sokun.

english: You're not fooling anyone you know.
We fooled you easily enough.
Free. She is free...
What?
The mother is free.
You! You did it!
I didn't mean to!
You killed him!
It was an accide... Killed who?
Our Prince, you killed our Prince.
Oh that, yes I did.
Leave us alone.
Soon now... So soon...
The stars are almost right.
For what?
Ahh, our saviour.
Please don't remind me.
Do not worry, soon your regret will be gone.
If you think you will get to me...
All in good time.
What are you doing here?
I've heard there is a powerful magic presence in these lands, I'm gathering notes to take back with me to the Wizards' Tower.
translation: Bu topraklarda güclü bir sihirli varligin oldugunu duydum, Büyücüler Kulesi'ne götürmek icin notlar topluyorum.

english: What are you doing?
When we heard of a magical presence in the Western lands, the Wizards' Tower had no choice but to send out a research party.
translation: Bati topraklarinda sihirli bir varligin oldugunu duydugumuzda, Büyücüler Kulesi bir arastirma ekibi göndermekten baska secenegi yoktu.

english: Learned anything interesting?
Some of these texts describe a 'Dark Altar', one can only imagine what power it possesses.
translation: Bu metinlerin bazilari 'Karanlik Sunak'tan bahsediyor, sahip oldugu gücü ancak tahmin edebiliriz.

english: The beings here seem to have transcended beyond the corporeal realm, truly fascinating!
translation: Buradaki varliklar maddi alemin ötesine gecmis gibi görünüyor, gercekten büyüleyici!

english: A casual game will start in the next [60 - 5x] seconds!
translation: Bir casual oyun [60 - 5x] saniye icinde baslayacak!

english: A casual game is starting!
Why are all of you standing around here?
Hahaha you dare talk to a mighty wizard such as myself? I bet you can't even cast windstrike yet amateur!
translation: Hahaha, benim gibi güclü bir büyücüyle konusmaya cesaret mi ediyorsun? Eminim henüz rüzgar saldirisi bile yapamiyorsundur, amatör!

english: ...You're an idiot.
Found that leprechaun yet?
Hahaha go away amateur! You're not worthy of joining our great group!
translation: Hahaha git buradan amatör! Bizim harika grubumuza katilmaya layik degilsin!

english: ...right.
Hahaha you're such an amateur!
Go away and play with some cabbage amateur!
translation: Git buradan ve biraz lahana ile oyna amatör!

english: All's well that ends well.
translation: Sonu iyi biten her sey iyidir.

english: I've got some questions about the search for evidence.
translation: Kanit arama konusunda bazi sorularim var.

english: You'll have to speak to the Watchtower Wizard about that.
translation: Bunun icin Gözcü Kule Büyücüsü ile konusmalisin.

english: I've got some questions regarding the tribal ogres.
translation: Kabile ogreleriyle ilgili bazi sorularim var.

english: Who are you? Get out of here, I don't have anything for you.
translation: Kimsin sen? Defol buradan, sana verecek hicbir seyim yok.

english: You must have completed The Hand in the Sand to use the Guild's shop.
translation: Guild'in dükkanini kullanmak icin The Hand in the Sand görevini tamamlamis olmalisin.

english: I don't know if I can trust you with any of my supplies...
translation: Sana malzemelerimi emanet edebilir miyim, bilmiyorum...

english: Welcome to the Magic Guild Store. Would you like to buy some magic supplies?
translation: Sihirli Lonca Dükkani'na hos geldin. Sihir malzemeleri satin almak ister misin?

english: Yes please.
No thank you.
Yes please.
No thank you.
Hello there. My name is Cromperty. I am a Wizard, and an inventor.
translation: Merhaba. Benim adim Cromperty. Ben bir büyücü ve mucidim.

english: There you go, [amount] free pure essence. Return tomorrow for some more.
I've already given you your free allowance for today. Come back to me tomorrow for some more.
translation: Bugünlük ücretsiz hakkini zaten kullandin. Yarin tekrar gel de biraz daha al.

english: You must be [player name]. My good friend Sedridor has told me about you. As both wizard and inventor, he has aided me in my great invention!
translation: Sen Maceraci olmalisin. Iyi arkadasim Sedridor bana senden bahsetti. Hem büyücü hem de mucit olarak, benim büyük icadimda bana yardim etti!

english: Two jobs? That's got to be tough.
translation: Iki is mi? Bu zor olmali.

english: Not when you combine them it isn't! I invent MAGIC things!
translation: Ikisini birlestirdiginde zor degil! Ben SIHIRLI seyler icat ediyorum!

english: Well, I shall leave you to your inventing.
Thanks for dropping by! Stop again anytime!
translation: Ugradigin icin tesekkürler! Istedigin zaman tekrar ugra!

english: So what have you invented?
Ah! My latest invention is my patent pending teleportation block! It emits a low level magical signal, that will allow me to locate it anywhere in the world, and teleport anything
translation: Ah! Son icadim, patent basvurusu yapilmis teleportasyon blogum! Düsük seviyeli bir sihirli sinyal yayiyor, bu sayede dünyanin herhangi bir yerinde onu bulabilir ve herhangi bir seyi

english: directly to it! I hope to revolutionise the entire teleportation system! Don't you think I'm great? Uh, I mean it's great?
translation: dogrudan oraya teleport edebilirim! Tüm teleportasyon sisteminde devrim yaratmayi umuyorum! Harika oldugumu düsünmüyor musun? Yani, harika oldugunu?

english: So where is the other block?
Well... Hmm. I would guess somewhere between here and the Wizards' Tower in Misthalin. All I know is that it hasn't got there yet as the wizards there would have contacted me.
translation: Sey... Hmm. Sanirim burayla Misthalin'deki Büyücüler Kulesi arasinda bir yerde. Tek bildigim, oradaki büyücüler benimle iletisime gececekleri icin henüz oraya ulasmamis oldugu.

english: I'm using the GPDT for delivery. They assured me it would be delivered promptly.
translation: Teslimat icin GPDT'yi kullaniyorum. Hemen teslim edilecegini garanti ettiler.

english: Who are the GPDT?
The Gielinor Parcel Delivery Team. They come very highly recommended. Their motto is: 'We aim to deliver your stuff at some point after you have paid us!'
translation: Gielinor Paket Teslimat Ekibi. Cok tavsiye ediliyorlar. Sloganlari: “Ödemeyi yaptiktan sonra bir noktada esyalarini teslim etmeyi hedefliyoruz!”

english: Can I be teleported please?
By all means! I'm afraid I can't give you any specifics as to where you will come out however. Presumably wherever the other block is located.
translation: Tabii ki! Ancak nereye cikacagin konusunda sana kesin bir bilgi veremem. Muhtemelen diger blogun bulundugu yere.

english: Yes, that sounds good. Teleport me!
translation: Evet, kulaga hos geliyor. Isinla beni!

english: Okey dokey! Ready?
Hmmm.... that's odd... I can't seem to get a signal...
Oh well, never mind.
That sounds dangerous. Leave me here.
translation: Bu tehlikeli görünüyor. Beni burada birakin.

english: As you wish.
Well done, that's very clever.
Yes it is isn't it? Forgive me for feeling a little smug, this is a major breakthrough in the field of teleportation!
translation: Öyle degil mi? Biraz kendini begenmis gibi davrandigim icin özür dilerim, bu isinlanma alaninda büyük bir atilim!

english: Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence?
Seventior disthine molenko!
Here you go.
Your magical prowess... it is most impressive.
Claim free pure essence.
Chat.
Two jobs? That's got to be tough.
So what have you invented?
Well, I shall leave you to your inventing.
So where is the other block?
Can I be teleported please?
Who are the GPDT?
Yes, that sounds good. Teleport me!
translation: Evet, kulaga hos geliyor. Beni isinla!

english: That sounds dangerous. Leave me here.
translation: Bu tehlikeli görünüyor. Beni burada birak.

english: Well done, that's very clever.
Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence?
Welcome to the Magicians' Guild!
Hello there.
What can I do for you?
Nothing thanks, I'm just looking around.
translation: Hicbir sey, tesekkürler, sadece etrafa bakiniyorum.

english: That's fine with me.
Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence?
Senventior Disthine Molenko!
You need a magic level of 66. The magical energy in here is unsafe for those below that level.
translation: 66 seviye büyü gücüne ihtiyaciniz var. Buradaki büyülü enerji, bu seviyenin altindaki kisiler icin güvenli degildir.

english: You need a magic level of 66 for admittance to the guild. The magical energy inside the guild is unsafe for anyone below that level. For any other business please ring for attention.
translation: Loncaya girmek icin 66 seviye büyü gücüne ihtiyaciniz var. Loncadaki büyülü enerji, bu seviyenin altindaki kisiler icin güvenli degildir. Diger isleriniz icin lütfen zili calin.

english: Nothing thanks, I'm just looking around.
Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence?
Do you like my magic Zombies? Feel free to kill them, there's plenty more where these came from!
translation: Sihirli zombilerimi begendin mi? Istedigin kadar öldürebilirsin, bunlarin geldigi yerde daha fazlasi var!

english: I spoke to the necromancer like you suggested...
translation: Senin önerdigin gibi necromancer ile konustum...

english: Please - let's not talk about it. Distentor and Zavistic would get very annoyed if they found I'd sent you to a necromancer.
translation: Lütfen, bu konuyu konusmayalim. Distentor ve Zavistic, seni bir necromancer'a gönderdigimi ögrenirlerse cok sinirlenecekler.

english: Ok, fair enough.
You can't attack the Zombies in the room, my Zombies are for magic target practice only and should be attacked from the other side of the fence.
translation: Odadaki zombilere saldiramazsin, benim zombilerim sadece sihirli hedef talimi icindir ve citin diger tarafindan saldirilmalidir.

english: So you think finding those beads makes you clever, do you?
translation: O boncuklari bulmanin seni zeki yaptigini mi düsünüyorsun?

english: Well yes, actually.
Well you'd better just watch your back, because when you least expect it I'll be there. You shouldn't go sticking your nose into other people's affairs, meddler.
translation: O zaman arkani kolla, cünkü en beklemedigin anda orada olacagim. Baskalarinin isine burnunu sokmamalisin, burnunu sokan.

english: Not now, I'm trying to concentrate on a very difficult spell!
translation: Simdi olmaz, cok zor bir büyüye konsantre olmaya calisiyorum!

english: You were nicer to me when you had that little gnome wandering around here before.
translation: O kücük cüce burada dolasirken bana daha nazik davraniyordun.

english: Well he's not bothering me anymore, is he? And you don't need to bother me either!
translation: Artik beni rahatsiz etmiyor, degil mi? Sen de beni rahatsiz etmene gerek yok!

english: Hello there, can I help you?
What do you do here?
I've been studying the practice of making split-bark armour.
Split-bark armour, what's that?
Split-bark armour is special armour for mages. It's much more resistant to physical attacks than normal robes.
translation: Yarik kabuk zirh, büyücüler icin özel bir zirhtir. Normal cüppelerden cok daha fazla fiziksel saldirilara karsi dayaniklidir.

english: It's actually very easy for me to make, but I've been having trouble getting hold of the pieces.
translation: Aslinda yapimi benim icin cok kolay, ama parcalari bulmakta zorlaniyorum.

english: Well good luck with that.
Can you make me some?
I'm sorry, but I can't do that right now.
translation: Üzgünüm, ama su anda bunu yapamam.

english: I need bark from a hollow tree, and some fine cloth. Unfortunately both these items can only be found in Morytania, especially the cloth which is found in the tombs of shades.
translation: Ici bos bir agacin kabugu ve ince bir kumas lazim. Ne yazik ki bu iki malzeme de sadece Morytania'da bulunabiliyor, özellikle de gölgelerin mezarlarinda bulunan kumas.

english: Of course I'd happily sell you some at a discounted price if you bring me those items.
translation: Tabii ki, bu malzemeleri bana getirirsen sana indirimli fiyattan satmaktan memnuniyet duyarim.

english: Okay, guess I'll go looking then!
Okay, how much do I need?
I need 1 piece of each for either gloves or boots, 2 pieces of each for a hat, 3 pieces of each for leggings, and 4 pieces of each for a top.
translation: Eldiven veya bot icin her birinden 1 parca, sapka icin her birinden 2 parca, tozluk icin her birinden 3 parca ve üst icin her birinden 4 parca lazim.

english: I'll charge you 1,000 coins for either gloves or boots, 6,000 coins for a hat, 32,000 coins for leggings, and 37,000 for a top.
translation: Eldiven veya bot icin 1.000 sikke, sapka icin 6.000 sikke, tozluk icin 32.000 sikke ve üst icin 37.000 sikke alacagim.

english: What's that you're wearing?
This is split-bark armour, it's special armour for mages. It's much more resistant to physical attacks than normal robes.
translation: Bu, büyücüler icin özel bir zirh olan yarik kabuk zirhi. Normal cüppelerden cok daha fazla fiziksel saldirilara dayaniklidir.

english: Can you make me some armour please?
translation: Bana da bir zirh yapabilir misin lütfen?

english: Certainly, what would you like me to make?
No thanks.
There you go, enjoy your new armour!
translation: Al bakalim, yeni zirhinin keyfini cikar!

english: You need 2 pieces of bark, 2 pieces of fine cloth and 6,000 coins for a splitbark helm.
translation: Yarik kabuklu migfer icin 2 parca kabuk, 2 parca ince kumas ve 6.000 altin gerekir.

english: You need 4 pieces of bark, 4 pieces of fine cloth and 37,000 coins for a splitbark body.
translation: Yarik kabuklu gövde icin 4 parca kabuk, 4 parca ince kumas ve 37.000 altin gerekir.

english: You need 3 pieces of bark, 3 pieces of fine cloth and 32,000 coins for splitbark legs.
translation: Yarik kabuklu bacaklar icin 3 parca kabuk, 3 parca ince kumas ve 32.000 altin gerekir.

english: You need 1 piece of bark, 1 piece of fine cloth and 1,000 coins for splitbark gauntlets.
translation: Yarik kabuk eldivenleri icin 1 parca kabuk, 1 parca ince kumas ve 1.000 sikke gerekir.

english: You need 1 piece of bark, 1 piece of fine cloth and 1,000 coins for splitbark boots.
translation: Yarik kabuk botlari icin 1 parca kabuk, 1 parca ince kumas ve 1.000 sikke gerekir.

english: What do you do here?
Split-bark armour, what's that?
translation: Yarik kabuk zirhi, o da ne?

english: Well good luck with that.
Can you make me some?
Okay, guess I'll go looking then!
Okay, how much do I need?
What's that you're wearing?
Can you make me some armour please?
translation: Bana da zirh yapabilir misin lütfen?

english: If the player is on a non-members world:
translation: Oyuncu üye olmayan bir dünyada ise:

english: No thanks.
Buy Helm
Buy Body
Buy Legs
Buy Gauntlets
Buy Boots
Give me a quest!
Give me a quest what?
Give me a quest please.
Well seeing as you asked nicely... I could do with some help.
translation: Madem kibarca sordun. ... Biraz yardima ihtiyacim var.

english: The wizard Grayzag next door decided he didn't like me so he enlisted an army of hundreds of imps.
translation: Yan komsum büyücü Grayzag benden hoslanmadigini karar verdi ve yüzlerce imp'ten olusan bir ordu kurdu.

english: These imps stole all sorts of my things. Most of these things I don't really care about, just eggs and balls of string and things.
translation: Bu imp'ler tüm esyalarimi caldilar. Bu esyalarin cogu benim icin pek önemli degil, sadece yumurtalar, iplik yumaklari ve benzeri seyler.

english: But they stole my four magical beads. There was a red one, a yellow one, a black one, and a white one.
translation: Ama dört tane sihirli boncukumu caldilar. Kirmizi, sari, siyah ve beyaz renkli boncuklardi.

english: These imps have now spread out all over the kingdom. Could you get my beads back for me?
translation: Bu cinler simdi kralligin her yerine yayilmis durumda. Boncuklarimi geri alabilir misin?

english: Well this is a surprising turn of events!
translation: Bu olaylar ne kadar da sasirtici!

english: What?
Well I just so happen to have all of those beads on me!
Are you saying that you stole my beads all this time and I’ve been blaming these imps!?
translation: Yani bunca zamandir boncuklarimi sen caldin ve ben de cinleri sucladim mi diyorsun?

english: No, not at all! I just found them throughout my travels and presumed somebody would need them at some point.
translation: Hayir, hic de degil! Seyahatlerim sirasinda buldum ve bir gün birinin ihtiyaci olacagini düsündüm.

english: Bah! Fine.
Give them here and I'll check that they really are MY beads, before I give you your reward. You'll like it, it's an amulet of accuracy.
translation: Onlari buraya ver, ödülünü vermeden önce gercekten benim boncuklarim olup olmadigini kontrol edecegim. Begeneceksin, bu bir isabet muskasi.

english: You give four coloured beads to Wizard Mizgog.
translation: Dört renkli boncugu Büyücü Mizgog'a veriyorsun.

english: Wizard Mizgog places the four beads on the table and casts a spell on them.
translation: Büyücü Mizgog dört boncugu masanin üzerine koyuyor ve üzerlerine büyü yapiyor.

english: The wizard hands you an amulet.
Congratulations! Quest complete!
I'll try.
That's great, thank you.
I've better things to do than chase imps.
translation: Impleri kovalamaktan daha iyi islerim var.

english: Well if you're not interested in the quests I have to give you, don't waste my time by asking me for them.
translation: Eger sana verecegim görevlerle ilgilenmiyorsan, bana sorarak zamanimi bosa harcama.

english: Give me a quest or else!
Or else what? You'll attack me?
Hahaha!
Just stop messing around and give me a quest!
translation: Sacmalamayi birak ve bana bir görev ver!

english: Ah now you're assuming I have one to give.
translation: Ah, simdi de bir görevim oldugunu varsayiyorsun.

english: Got any more quests?
No, everything is good with the world today.
Do you know any interesting spells you could teach me?
translation: Bana ögretebilecegin ilginc büyüler biliyor musun?

english: I don't think so, the type of magic I study involves years of meditation and research.
translation: Sanmiyorum, benim calistigim türden büyü yillarca meditasyon ve arastirma gerektirir.

english: Have you got another one of those fancy schmancy amulets?
translation: O süslü muskalardan baska var mi?

english: I have a few spare. I'd like one of each coloured bead again in return, though! Black, white, yellow and red.
translation: Birkac tane yedegim var. Karsiliginda yine her renkten bir tane istiyorum! Siyah, beyaz, sari ve kirmizi.

english: I have them with me! Here you go.
Thanks, Mizgog!
What are you going to do with all of these extra beads, anyway?
translation: Bu fazla boncuklari ne yapacaksin ki?

english: You don't want to know. Take care!
Maybe later.
Perhaps some other time, then.
I don't have them all on me at the moment. I'll come back when I have them!
translation: Su anda hepsi yanimda degil. Yanimda oldugunda geri gelirim!

english: Very well. See you soon!
You have done well, [player name]!
Give me a quest please.
Yes.
No.
Give me a quest or else!
Just stop messing around and give me a quest!
translation: Oyun oynamayi birak da bana bir görev ver!

english: Got any more quests?
Do you know any interesting spells you could teach me?
translation: Bana ögretebilecegin ilginc büyüler var mi?

english: Have you got another one of those fancy schmancy amulets?
translation: O süslü muskalardan baska var mi?

english: I have them with me!
Maybe later.
Welcome to the Magic Guild Store. Would you like to buy some magic supplies?
translation: Sihirli Lonca Magazasina hos geldin. Sihirli malzemeler satin almak ister misin?

english: Can you tell me about your cape?
Certainly! Skillcapes are a symbol of achievement. Only people who have mastered a skill and reached level 99 can get their hands on them and gain the benefits they carry.
translation: Tabii ki! Beceri pelerinleri basari sembolüdür. Sadece bir beceriyi ustalastirip 99. seviyeye ulasan kisiler bu pelerinleri elde edebilir ve sagladiklari avantajlardan yararlanabilir.

english: The Cape of Magic allows you to switch spellbooks five times per day. Now, would you like to buy some magic supplies?
translation: Sihir Pelerini, günde bes kez büyü kitabini degistirmenize izin verir. Simdi, sihir malzemeleri satin almak ister misiniz?

english: Yes please.
No thank you.
May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: Pelerinim icin baska bir baslik alabilir miyim, lütfen?

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
Can you tell me about your cape?
I'd like to view your store please.
No thank you.
May I have another hood for my cape?
translation: Pelerinim icin baska bir baslik alabilir miyim?

english: Yes please.
Ello young thingummywut.
What's a thingummywut?
A thingummywut? Where? Where?
Those pesky thingummywuts. They get everywhere. They leave a terrible mess too.
translation: Su sinir bozucu seyimler. Her yere yayiliyorlar. Ayrica ortaligi da berbat ediyorlar.

english: Err you just called me thingummywut.
You're a thingummywut? I've never seen one up close before. They said I was mad!
translation: Sen bir seyim misin? Daha önce hic yakindan görmemistim. Deli oldugumu söylediler!

english: Now you are my proof! There ARE thingummywuts in this tower. Now where can I find a cage big enough to keep you?
translation: Simdi sen benim kanitimsin! Bu kulede seyler var. Simdi seni tutacak kadar büyük bir kafes nerede bulabilirim?

english: Err I'd better be off really.
Oh ok, have a good time, and watch out for sheep! They're more cunning than they look.
translation: Tamam, iyi eglenceler ve koyunlara dikkat et! Göründüklerinden daha kurnazlar.

english: They're right, you are mad.
That's a pity. I thought maybe they were winding me up.
translation: Yazik. Belki de benimle dalga geciyorlar sanmistim.

english: Tell me what they look like and I'll mash 'em.
translation: Bana neye benzediklerini söyle, ben de onlari ezeyim.

english: Don't be ridiculous. No-one has ever seen one.
They're invisible, or a myth, or a figment of my imagination. Can't remember which right now.
translation: Onlar görünmezler, ya da bir efsane, ya da benim hayal gücümün ürünü. Su anda hangisi oldugunu hatirlayamiyorum.

english: Teach me to be a mighty and powerful wizard.
translation: Bana güclü ve kudretli bir büyücü olmayi ögret.

english: Wizard eh? You don't want any truck with that sort. They're not to be trusted. That's what I've heard anyways.
translation: Büyücü mü? O tür insanlarla isin olmasin. Onlara güvenilmez. En azindan ben öyle duydum.

english: So aren't you a wizard?
How dare you? Of course I'm a wizard. Now don't be so cheeky or I'll turn you into a frog.
translation: Nasil cüret edersin? Tabii ki büyücüyüm. Sakin küstahlik etme yoksa seni kurbagaya ceviririm.

english: Oh I'd better stop talking to you then.
translation: O zaman seninle konusmayi biraksam iyi olur.

english: Cheerio then. It was nice chatting to you.
translation: Hosca kal o zaman. Seninle sohbet etmek güzeldi.

english: I need to get a key given to you by Sir Prysin.
translation: Sör Prysin'in sana verdigi anahtari almam gerekiyor.

english: Sir Prysin? Who's that? What would I want his key for?
translation: Sör Prysin mi? O kim? Onun anahtarini ne yapacagim?

english: He told me you were looking after it for him.
That wasn't very clever of him. I'd lose my head if it wasn't screwed on. Go and tell him to find someone else to look after his valuables in future.
translation: Bu pek akillica bir hareket degildi. Kafam vidalanmis olmasaydi, onu kaybederdim. Git ve ona gelecekte degerli esyalarini saklayacak baska birini bulmasini söyle.

english: Okay, I'll go and tell him that.
Oh that's great, if it wouldn't be too much trouble.
Well, have you got any keys knocking around?
Now you come to mention it, yes I do have a key. It's in my special closet of valuable stuff. Now how do I get into that?
translation: Simdi sen söyleyince hatirladim, evet bir anahtarim var. Degerli esyalarimi sakladigim özel dolabimda. Peki onu nasil acacagim?

english: I sealed it using one of my magic rituals. So it would make sense that another ritual would open it again.
translation: Onu sihirli ritüellerimden biriyle mühürledim. Yani baska bir ritüelle acilmasi mantikli olur.

english: He's one of the King's knights.
Say, I remember one of the King's knights. He had nice shoes...
translation: Bir kralin sövalyesini hatirliyorum. Güzel ayakkabilari vardi...

english: ...and didn't like my homemade spinach rolls. Would you like a spinach roll?
translation: ...ve benim ev yapimi ispanakli böreklerimi sevmezdi. Ispanakli börek ister misin?

english: Yes please.
Thank you very much.
So do you know what ritual to use?
Let me think a second.
Yes a simple drazier style ritual should suffice. Hmm, main problem with that is I'll need 25 sets of bones. Now where am I going to get hold of something like that?
translation: Evet, basit bir drazier tarzi ritüel yeterli olacaktir. Hmm, bununla ilgili asil sorun, 25 set kemige ihtiyacim olmasi. Peki, böyle bir seyi nereden bulacagim?

english: Hmm, that's too bad. I really need that key.
translation: Hmm, cok kötü. O anahtara gercekten ihtiyacim var.

english: Ah well, sorry I couldn't be any more help.
translation: Ah, üzgünüm, daha fazla yardimci olamadim.

english: I'll help get the bones for you.
Ooh that would be very good of you.
Okay, I'll speak to you when I've got some bones.
translation: Tamam, kemikleri buldugumda sana haber veririm.

english: How are you doing finding bones?
I haven't got any at the moment.
Nevermind, keep working on it.
I have some bones.
Give 'em here then.
That's all of them.
I still need 24 more.
Ok, I'll keep looking.
Hurrah! That's all 25 sets of bones.
Wings of dark and colour too, Spreading in the morning dew; Locked away I have a key; Return it now, please, unto me.
translation: Karanlik ve renkli kanatlar, Sabah ciyinde yayiliyor; Kilitli bir anahtarim var; Lütfen simdi bana geri ver.

english: Not a problem for a friend of Sir What's-his-face.
translation: Sör Ne-ad-ti'nin arkadasi icin sorun degil.

english: I've lost the key you gave to me.
Yes I know, it was returned to me. If you want it back you're going to have to collect another 25 sets of bones.
translation: Evet, biliyorum, bana geri verildi. Geri istiyorsan, 25 set kemik daha toplamalisin.

english: Here you go!
What?
I need you to answer this for me like a good thingummywut.
translation: Bana iyi bir sey gibi cevap vermen gerekiyor.

english: Wizard Traiborn has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Büyücü Traiborn sana bir meydan okuma parsömeni verdi!

english: Please give me your answer, young thingummywut!
translation: Lütfen bana cevabini ver, genc sey!

english: How can that be? Go check again, silly thingummywut!
translation: Bu nasil olabilir? Tekrar kontrol et, aptal sey!

english: Spot on!
Wizard Traiborn has given you another clue scroll!
translation: Büyücü Traiborn sana baska bir ipucu parsömeni verdi!

english: What's a thingummywut?
Err you just called me a thingummywut.
Err I'd better be off really.
They're right, you are mad.
Tell me what they look like and I'll mash 'em.
translation: Bana neye benzediklerini söyle, ben de onlari ezeyim.

english: Teach me to be a mighty and powerful wizard.
translation: Bana güclü ve kudretli bir büyücü olmayi ögret.

english: So aren't you a wizard?
Oh I'd better stop talking to you then.
translation: O zaman seninle konusmayi biraksam iyi olacak.

english: I need to get a key given to you by Sir Prysin.
translation: Sör Prysin'in sana verdigi anahtari almam lazim.

english: He told me you were looking after it for him.
translation: Bana senin onun icin sakladigini söyledi.

english: Okay, I'll go and tell him that.
Well, have you got any keys knocking around?
He's one of the King's knights.
Yes please.
Hmm, that's too bad. I really need that key.
translation: Hmm, cok kötü. O anahtara gercekten ihtiyacim var.

english: I'll get the bones for you.
Just tell me if you have the key.
How are things at Weiss?
Snowflake and My Arm are ruling the town together, and now I've built them a special fire, they can grow goutweed there.
translation: Snowflake ve My Arm birlikte kasabayi yönetiyorlar ve simdi onlara özel bir ates yaptim, orada goutweed yetistirebilirler.

english: So My Arm taught Weiss the farming knowledge of the Stronghold trolls. Now Stronghold trolls can be given firemaking knowledge from Weiss, like I promised.
translation: My Arm, Weiss'a Stronghold trollerinin tarim bilgilerini ögretti. Artik Stronghold trollerine, söz verdigim gibi Weiss'tan ates yapma bilgisi verilebilir.

english: Snowflake gave me a book containing all the information she could find from Odd Mushroom's notes.
translation: Snowflake, Odd Mushroom'un notlarindan bulabildigi tüm bilgileri iceren bir kitap verdi.

english: Give it to Burntmeat. He can teach trolls what they want to know from it.
translation: Onu Burntmeat'e ver. O, trollerin bilmek istediklerini bu kitaptan ögretebilir.

english: Hopefully Snowflake will give me another one.
translation: Umarim Snowflake bana bir tane daha verir.

english: Now that My Arm has taught the Weiss trolls what he knows about farming, here's a book containing what the Weiss trolls know about firemaking.
translation: My Arm, Weiss trollerine tarimla ilgili bildiklerini ögrettigine göre, iste Weiss trollerinin ates yakma konusunda bildiklerini iceren bir kitap.

english: Odd Mushroom invented lots of clever stuff with Snowflake. Might be handy for Stronghold trolls.
translation: Odd Mushroom, Snowflake ile birlikte bircok akillica sey icat etti. Stronghold trollerine faydali olabilir.

english: Let Burntmeat see...
Uh...
Yeah, lotsa learnings here. Very clever stuff. We oughta reward you.
translation: Evet, burada cok sey ögrenilebilir. Cok akillica seyler. Seni ödüllendirmeliyiz.

english: Don't give me more burnt meat. I've been here before, and you gave me a load of burnt meat.
translation: Bana daha fazla yanmis et verme. Daha önce buraya geldim ve bana bir sürü yanmis et verdin.

english: Silly human pretends he don't like Burntmeat's lovely burnt meat! But okay, Burntmeat will not make any more for you. Ever.
translation: Aptal insan, Burntmeat'in lezzetli yanmis etini sevmiyormus gibi davraniyor! Ama tamam, Burntmeat sana bir daha yapmayacak. Asla.

english: Ever? You're never ever going to give me burnt meat again?
translation: Asla mi? Bana bir daha asla yanmis et vermeyecek misin?

english: No more burnt meat from Burntmeat, ever. Wolfbone here has made reward for you instead.
translation: Burntmeat'ten bir daha asla yanmis et yok. Wolfbone senin icin bir ödül hazirladi.

english: Yes, I have learnt a lot here from my friend Burntmeat, and he has let me prepare a reward for you myself.
translation: Evet, arkadasim Burntmeat'ten burada cok sey ögrendim ve o da senin icin bir ödül hazirlamama izin verdi.

english: That's very kind of you.
Burntmeat got feeling you no like Burntmeat's burnt meat. Burntmeat made some for you before, an' you not seem grateful. So Burntmeat will not make any more for you. Ever.
translation: Burntmeat, senin Burntmeat'in yanmis etini sevmedigini hissetti. Burntmeat daha önce senin icin biraz hazirladi, ama sen minnettar görünmedin. Bu yüzden Burntmeat artik senin icin yapmayacak. Asla.

english: Don't give me more burnt meat.
That's very kind of you.
Hello, how's it going?
Not too bad, but I'm a little worried about the increase of goblins these days.
translation: Fena degil, ama son günlerde goblinlerin sayisinin artmasindan biraz endiseliyim.

english: Don't worry, I'll kill them.
How can I help you?
Do you want to trade?
No, I have nothing I wish to get rid of. If you want to do some trading, there are plenty of shops and market stalls around though.
translation: Hayir, elden cikarmak istedigim bir sey yok. Takas yapmak istersen, etrafta bircok dükkan ve pazar tezgahi var.

english: I'm in search of a quest.
I'm sorry I can't help you there.
I'm in search of enemies to kill.
I've heard there are many fearsome creatures that dwell under the ground...
translation: Yeraltinda yasayan bircok korkunc yaratik oldugunu duydum...

english: Get out of my way, I'm in a hurry!
I'm fine, how are you?
Very well thank you.
Hello there! Nice weather we've been having.
I'm very well thank you.
Who are you?
I'm a bold adventurer.
Ah, a very noble profession.
Do I know you? I'm in a hurry!
I think we need a new king. The one we've got isn't very good.
translation: Bence yeni bir krala ihtiyacimiz var. Su anki kral pek iyi degil.

english: Not too bad thanks.
Are you asking for a fight?
The woman attacks the player
I'm busy right now.
Hello.
None of your business.
Do you wish to trade?
No I don't have any spare change.
I'm a little worried - I've heard there's lots of people going about, killing citizens at random.
translation: Biraz endiseliyim - bircok insanin rastgele vatandaslari öldürdügünü duydum.

english: No, I don't want to buy anything!
That is classified information.
Have this flyer...
Yo, wassup!
I like our king, he's keeping the poor and infected away from us decent folk.
translation: Kralimizi seviyorum, fakirleri ve enfekte olanlari biz iyi insanlardan uzak tutuyor.

english: Not too bad. Glad the plague hasn't touched, the better areas of town.
translation: Fena degil. Veba sehrin daha iyi bölgelerine bulasmamis olmasina sevindim.

english: Err... yeah.
Good day.
An outsider! Can you get me out of this hell hole?
translation: Bir yabanci! Beni bu cehennem cukurundan cikarabilir misin?

english: Sorry, that's not what I'm here to do.
Hello there.
Go away. People from the outside shut us in like animals. I have nothing to say to you.
translation: Git buradan. Disaridan gelenler bizi hayvanlar gibi buraya kapattilar. Sana söyleyecek hicbir seyim yok.

english: Hello.
... whassup?
Are you alright?
... see... two of you... why there two of you?
There's only one of me, friend.
... no, two of you... you can't count... ... maybe you drunk too much...
translation: hayir, ikiniz... sayamiyorsun... ... belki de cok ictin...

english: Whatever you say, friend.
... giant hairy cabbages...
Bah, those mourners... they're meant to be helping us, but I think they're doing more harm here than good. They won't even let me send a letter out to my family.
translation: Bah, su yas tutanlar... bize yardim etmeleri gerekirken, bence burada yarardan cok zarar veriyorlar. Aileme mektup bile göndermiyorlar.

english: Have you seen a lady called Elena around here?
translation: Buralarda Elena adinda bir bayan gördün mü?

english: Yes, I've seen her. Very helpful person.
Not for the last few days though... I thought maybe she'd gone home.
translation: Ama son birkac gündür yok... Belki eve gitmistir diye düsündüm.

english: You should stand up to them more.
Oh I'm not one to cause a fuss.
translation: Oh, ben sorun cikaran biri degilim.

english: Do you want to trade?
I'm in search of a quest.
I'm in search of enemies to kill.
Have you seen a lady called Elena around here?
translation: Buralarda Elena adinda bir bayan gördün mü?

english: You should stand up to them more.
It stinks down here.
Can't you just leave me alone.
I don't trust that fish monger.
Lighting fires in an enclosed space is probably not a good idea. Oh well.
translation: Kapali bir alanda ates yakmak iyi bir fikir degil. Neyse.

english: I guess it's not all bad down here. At least we have a pub.
translation: Buradaki her sey o kadar da kötü degil. En azindan bir pub var.

english: I'll leave this place one day. You'll see.
Life is tough.
Yes, living in a plague city must be hard.
translation: Evet, veba salgini olan bir sehirde yasamak zor olmali.

english: Plague? Pah, that's no excuse for the treatment we've received. It's obvious pretty quickly if someone has the plague.
translation: Veba mi? Peh, bu bize yapilan muamelenin mazereti olamaz. Birinin vebaya yakalandigi hemen anlasilir.

english: I'm thinking about making a break for it. I'm perfectly healthy, not gonna infect anyone.
translation: Kacmayi düsünüyorum. Ben tamamen saglikliyim, kimseye bulastirmam.

english: I'm sorry to hear that.
Well, ain't much either you or me can do about it.
translation: Ne sen ne de ben bu konuda bir sey yapabiliriz.

english: Yes, living in a plague city must be hard.
translation: Evet, veba salgini olan bir sehirde yasamak zor olmali.

english: I'm sorry to hear that.
Hello!
Hello friend. I wish to slay evil and avail them of their loot! Take me to Burgh de Rott!
translation: Merhaba dostum. Kötülügü yok etmek ve ganimetlerini ele gecirmek istiyorum! Beni Burgh de Rott'a götür!

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
I think so? At least my heart knows courage and that should be sufficient for the meantime. I expect that when we get to Burgh de Rott, we'll be able to purchase suitable provisions.
translation: Sanirim öyle. En azindan kalbim cesaret dolu ve bu simdilik yeterli olmali. Burgh de Rott'a vardigimizda uygun erzak satin alabilecegimizi umuyorum.

english: But you do realise that the vampyres in Morytania are immune to everything except silver?
translation: Ama Morytania'daki vampirlerin gümüs disinda her seye karsi bagisik oldugunu biliyor musun?

english: Er...well, I've not heard mention of that fact, but I have faith that Saradomin will provide the means to furnish me with suitable weapons when I reach Burgh de Rott.
translation: Sey... Bu konuda bir sey duymadim, ama Burgh de Rott'a vardigimda Saradomin'in bana uygun silahlar saglayacagina inaniyorum.

english: And if we happen to run into some vampyres on the journey down there?
translation: Ya oraya giderken yolda vampirlerle karsilasirsak?

english: I trust that you will help us to avoid them. You are a guide after all, aren't you? Anyway, you look like you can handle yourself. I presume you've fought such creatures before and won? How hard can it be?
translation: Onlardan kacinmamiza yardim edecegine inaniyorum. Sonucta sen bir rehbersin, degil mi? Her neyse, kendini savunabilecek gibi görünüyorsun. Daha önce bu tür yaratiklarla savasip kazandin mi? Ne kadar zor olabilir ki?

english: It can be pretty difficult, actually. But you're right, I'll be your guide so I should be able to handle the situation.
translation: Aslinda oldukca zor olabilir. Ama haklisin, ben senin rehberin olacagim, bu yüzden durumu halledebilmeliyim.

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Neden Burgh de Rott'a gitmek istiyorsun?

english: I'm going down there to teach those vampyres a lesson or two. I've heard about the terrible conditions down there and I intend to put a stop to it.
translation: Oradaki vampirleri bir ders vermek icin gidiyorum. Oradaki korkunc kosullari duydum ve buna bir son vermek niyetindeyim.

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Burgh de Rott'a giderken yol üzerinde düsmanlarla karsilasirsak kendini savunabilir misin?

english: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of enemies. You don't need to worry about that.
translation: Diyelim ki biraz tecrübeliyim ve düsmanlarla savasmaktan cekinmem. Bu konuda endiselenmene gerek yok.

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: Hmmm, görünüse göre bir takipcin var. Kendi basina dolasirsa bu yolculukta kaybolabilir. Takipcin güvende oldugunda yola cikalim.

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: Gercekten mi? Bu harika olur! Hedefe vardigimizda sana kücük bir ödül verecegim.

english: Burgh de Rott Ramble begins
Ok, which route should we take?
Ok, thanks.
Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: Ah, bana biraz erzak vermek istiyorsun, ha? Sirt cantami acayim.

english: This place is a bit grim. How can people live here?
translation: Burasi biraz kasvetli. Insanlar burada nasil yasayabiliyor?

english: Do you visit Burgh de Rott often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: Burgh de Rott'a sik sik gelir misin? Rotayi iyi biliyorsun gibi görünüyor.

english: When are we going to get to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Burgh de Rott'a ne zaman varacagiz?

english: We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on. I have loot to get.
translation: Bütün gün burada durup sohbet edecek vaktimiz yok; devam edelim. Yagmalayacak seyler var.

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than the opulet life styles forced on us adventurer types. I'd much rather be up to my eyes in mud and having a good fight!
translation: Bu yolculuktan nefret ediyorum, ama maceraperest tiplere dayatilan lüks yasam tarzindan daha iyidir. Gözlerime kadar camura batip iyi bir kavga etmeyi tercih ederim!

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...
Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Paterdomus. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: Hay aksi! Görünüse göre Paterdomus'a geri dönmek zorundayiz. O köprüyü gecemeyiz!

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
Player completes the bridge event
Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Paterdomus.
translation: Eh, bu is bitti... Görünüse göre bu batakligi gecemeyiz. Paterdomus'a geri dönmek zorundayiz.

english: Player completes the bog event
Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: Hey... bu harika... harika bir is cikardin... Seni takip edecegim.

english: Whahay...that was great!
But we really should be heading off now.
Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
Player completes the river event
That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: Bu harika! Ben de aynisini yapmaliyim.

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: Vay canina! Bu harikaydi! Ama artik gercekten yola cikmaliyiz.

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
This is scary!
Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
Ahhh, two tentacles!
...three tentacles!
I think I'm going to faint!
Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: Vay canina! Su canavara bak! O seyi kendi basina halletmen gerekecek!

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the Burgh de Rott. Here's your reward.
translation: Beni Burgh de Rott'a güvenle ulastirdigin icin cok tesekkürler. Iste ödülün.

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Neden Burgh de Rott'a gitmek istiyorsun?

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
Ok, thanks.
Hi, why do you have twigs growing out of you?
Heehee, what a strange question, that's because I'm a Wood Dryad.
translation: Heehee, ne garip bir soru, cünkü ben bir Orman Dryadi'yim.

english: Grand job, what an obnoxious tree, spreading rumours 'bout other trees and sucking up all the water.
translation: Harika is, ne igrenc bir agac, diger agaclar hakkinda dedikodular yayiyor ve tüm suyu emiyor.

english: As a reward, I'll let ye use me full banking services!
translation: Ödül olarak, tüm bankacilik hizmetlerimi kullanmana izin verecegim!...

english: Okay then.
What an obnoxious tree, spreading rumours 'bout other trees and sucking up all the water.
translation: Ne igrenc bir agac, diger agaclar hakkinda dedikodular yayiyor ve tüm suyu emiyor.

english: Since you're here, I'll let you use me restricted banking services.
translation: Madem buradasin, sinirli bankacilik hizmetlerimi kullanmana izin verecegim.

english: Your items cannot be stored in the bank from here.
It be yer lucky day, Foresters!
I'll have to go shortly...
translation: Kisa bir süre sonra gitmem gerek...

english: Well, I must be getting on now.
Open deposit box
Deposit all
Say nothing
Deposit all woodcutting resources
Yes, bank it all
Only bank woodcutting resources
translation: Sadece odun kesme kaynaklarini bankaya yatir

english: No, don't bank anything
Open my bank deposit box
Can you teach me the basics of Woodcutting and Firemaking, please?
translation: Bana odun kesme ve ates yakmanin temellerini ögretir misin lütfen?

english: I'd give you an axe to chop trees with but you don't have room in your inventory.
translation: Sana agac kesmek icin bir balta verirdim ama cantanda yer yok.

english: As you're already here, have an axe so that you can chop the trees around me.
translation: Madem buradasin, etrafimdaki agaclari kesebilmen icin bir balta al.

english: When you see a likely looking tree, appreciate its beauty, then simply click on it to chop it down.
translation: Uygun görünen bir agac gördügünde, güzelligini takdir et, sonra üzerine tiklayarak kes.

english: When you have a full inventory of logs, you have a choice. You can take it to the bank, there's one on the roof of the castle in Lumbridge, or you can burn them.
translation: Envanterin odunlarla doldugunda, bir secim yapabilirsin. Onlari bankaya götürebilirsin, Lumbridge'deki kalenin catisinda bir tane var, ya da yakabilirsin.

english: Ah, you've lost your tinderbox have you? Have another!
translation: Ah, cakmaktasini mi kaybettin? Al baska bir tane!

english: Click on your tinderbox, then click on one of the logs in your inventory, this will attempt to light a fire that you can use for cooking.
translation: Cakmaktasina tikla, sonra envanterindeki odunlardan birine tikla, bu sekilde yemek pisirmek icin kullanabilecegin bir ates yakmaya calisacaksin.

english: What is that cape you're wearing?
This is a Skillcape of Woodcutting, wearing one increases your chance of finding bird's nests. Only a person who has achieved the highest possible level in a skill can wear one.
translation: Bu, Odun Kesme Beceri Pelerini, bunu giydiginde kus yuvalari bulma sansin artar. Sadece bir beceride en yüksek seviyeye ulasmis kisiler bunu giyebilir.

english: Choose carefully where and what you chop, you can get different trees in different places throughout the land.
translation: Nerede ve ne kesecegine dikkatlice karar ver, arazinin farkli yerlerinde farkli agaclar bulabilirsin.

english: Make sure you hang on to your logs, don't throw them away as you can get valuable firemaking experience from them! Look out for other things too...
translation: Tomruklarini sakla, atma, cünkü onlardan degerli ates yakma deneyimi kazanabilirsin! Diger seylere de dikkat edin...

english: Watch out for the tree spirits, they really don't like you chopping trees, they can really do some damage if you're not paying attention...
translation: Agac ruhlarina dikkat edin, agac kesmenizi hic sevmezler, dikkat etmezseniz size ciddi zarar verebilirler...

english: Don't forget you can always use logs for fletching experience too.
translation: Tomruklari ok yapimi deneyimi icin de kullanabileceginizi unutmayin.

english: Yes, you'll need lots of logs if you want to be a good fletcher. Talk to the ranging tutor for more information.
translation: Evet, iyi bir okcu olmak istiyorsaniz cok sayida tomruga ihtiyaciniz olacak. Daha fazla bilgi icin menzil ögretmeni ile konusun.

english: As you get better and better you'll find that you can chop trees such as Maple and Yew! These are very good for firemaking.
translation: Gittikce daha iyi hale geldikce, akcaagac ve porsuk gibi agaclari kesebileceginizi göreceksiniz! Bunlar ates yakmak icin cok iyidir.

english: Of course, they're also very useful for fletching.
translation: Tabii ki, ok yapimi icin de cok kullanislidirlar.

english: Also, look out for birds' nests, you never know what our feathered friends have been collecting. Jewellery and Clue scrolls maybe?
translation: Ayrica, kus yuvalarina da dikkat edin, tüylü dostlarimizin ne topladigini asla bilemezsiniz. Mücevherler ve ipucu parsömenleri olabilir mi?

english: Tell me about different trees and axes.
translation: Bana farkli agaclar ve baltalar hakkinda bilgi verin.

english: Hollow trees can be found in the Haunted Woods east of Canifis, but be careful of the leeches.
translation: Canifis'in dogusundaki Haunted Woods'ta ici bos agaclar bulabilirsiniz, ancak sülükler konusunda dikkatli olun.

english: As you progress in your combat skill you will find you can wield your woodcutting axe as a weapon, it's not very effective, but it frees up a slot for another log.
translation: Savas beceriniz gelistikce, odun kesme baltasini silah olarak kullanabileceginizi göreceksiniz. Cok etkili degildir, ancak baska bir kütük icin yer acar.

english: Goodbye.

Wow! It's not often I meet somebody as accomplished as you in Woodcutting! Perhaps you should become the tutor, instead of me! Seeing as you're so skilled, maybe you are interested in buying a Skillcape of
translation: Vay canina! Woodcutting'de senin kadar basarili biriyle pek sik karsilasmiyorum! Belki de benim yerime sen ögretmen olmalisin! Bu kadar yetenekli olduguna göre, belki de Woodcutting Skillcape satin almak istersin?

english: Woodcutting?
No, thanks.
Ok, come back to me if you change your mind.
Yes, please.
I can't sell you one here. Try talking to me later.
translation: Burada satamam. Daha sonra benimle konus.

english: Anybody who has spent as much time cutting trees as you deserves the right to own one. Wearing this cape will increase your chance of finding bird's nests. That'll be 99000 coins, please.
translation: Senin kadar agac kesmeye zaman harcayan herkes bir tane sahibi olmayi hak eder. Bu pelerini giyerek kus yuvalarini bulma sansin artar. 99.000 sikke lütfen.

english: 99000! That's too rich for me.
Well go chop down a few mahogany trees and sell the timber; then you'll be able to afford one.
translation: O zaman birkac maun agaci kesip kerestesini sat, o zaman bir tane alabilirsin.

english: No problem.
But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: Ama maalesef yanimda yeterince param yok.

english: Well come back and see me when you do.
translation: Paran oldugunda tekrar gelip beni gör.

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: Harika! Bu pelerini gururla giy dostum.

english: Can you teach me the basics of Woodcutting and Firemaking, please?
translation: Bana odun kesme ve ates yakmanin temellerini ögretir misin lütfen?

english: What is that cape you're wearing?
I already know a bit about Woodcutting and Firemaking, any tips?
translation: Odun kesme ve ates yakma konusunda biraz bilgim var, herhangi bir ipucun var mi?

english: Any advice for an advanced woodcutter?
translation: Ileri düzey oduncu icin herhangi bir tavsiyen var mi?

english: Tell me about different trees and axes.
translation: Bana farkli agaclar ve baltalar hakkinda bilgi ver.

english: Oak and Willow
Maple and Yew
Magic and other trees
Axes
Go back to teaching
Goodbye
No, thanks.
Yes, please
99000! That's too rich for me.
No problem.
Hello there.
Leave me alone. I have work to do.
translation: Beni rahat birak. Yapacak isim var.

english: Whatever you want, the answer's no.
I don't have time to talk to you.
Please don't disturb me.
I'm busy right now.
Hello.
Hey there!
You seem rather happy for a busy labourer with a bad case of spots.
translation: Sivilceleri olan mesgul bir isci icin oldukca mutlu görünüyorsun.

english: Of course! These spots are the best thing since log rollers!
translation: Tabii ki! Bu sivilceler, kütük yuvarlamadan bu yana en iyi sey!

english: I really don't follow.
Well thanks to these spots, the city has been under quarantine. That means there's no goods coming in or out. No goods means we don't have any work to do!
translation: Bu sivilceler sayesinde sehir karantina altina alindi. Bu da mal giris cikisinin olmadigi anlamina geliyor. Mal giris cikisi olmamasi, bizim isimiz olmadigi anlamina geliyor!

english: But aren't the spots intolerable?
I would take a dermatological irritation over back-breaking, mind-numbing labour any day!
translation: Sirtimi kiran, zihnimi uyusturan bir istense, dermatolojik bir tahrisi tercih ederim!

english: Right... Okay then...
Hey.
What's wrong?
The High Priest has determined that these spots aren't contagious. He's opened the city up again, which means we have to go back to work.
translation: Basrahip bu sivilcelerin bulasici olmadigina karar verdi. Sehri tekrar acti, bu da ise geri dönmemiz gerektigi anlamina geliyor.

english: Now that all the plagues have been cured, we've had to go back to work.
translation: Artik tüm hastaliklar tedavi edildigine göre, ise geri dönmek zorundayiz.

english: Cheer up! Work can't be that bad.
translation: Neselen! Is o kadar da kötü olamaz.

english: You have no idea...
What are you doing?
I have this acne potion that I thought might clear up your spots?
translation: Sivilcelerini temizleyebilecegini düsündügüm bir akne ilaci var.

english: What, so that I can get back to work?
translation: Ne, böylece ise geri dönebileyim diye mi?

english: So that you don't suffer needlessly?
translation: Böylece gereksiz yere aci cekmeyesin diye.

english: I know your type, trying to ruin the small man's fun! I won't have it!
translation: Senin gibileri tanirim, kücük adamin eglencesini mahvetmeye calisiyorsun! Buna izin vermeyecegim!

english: Look, I'm sorry. I only wanted to help you.
translation: Bak, özür dilerim. Sadece sana yardim etmek istedim.

english: Clear off!
No, I don't want to buy anything.
translation: Hayir, hicbir sey satin almak istemiyorum.

english: Can't stop to talk. I have work to do.
translation: Konusacak vaktim yok. Yapacak isim var.

english: Hello there!
Oh, hello.
How are things going up here?
The beast still rages, but we're managing.
translation: Canavar hâlâ öfkeli, ama idare ediyoruz.

english: Plenty of treasure and materials to be found in the tunnels, at least!
translation: En azindan tünellerde bolca hazine ve malzeme var!

english: What will you do with it all?
The raw materials will be used to maintain Cam Torum. As for everything else, if you help us, you're allowed a share of the treasures.
translation: Hammaddeler Cam Torum'u korumak icin kullanilacak. Diger her sey icin ise, bize yardim edersen, hazinelerden pay alabilirsin.

english: That's very generous, thank you.
Hello!
Hmm? Did you say something?
I said hello.
Oh, that's nice.
Are you okay?
Why wouldn't I be? I'm not the one lost in the mountain!
translation: Neden iyi olmayayim ki? Dagda kaybolan ben degilim!

english: Excuse me? Who's lost in the mountain?
Karlo! Oh sweet Karlo... An inspiration to us all!
translation: Karlo! Ah, tatli Karlo... Hepimize ilham kaynagi olan Karlo!

english: He really knew how to swing a pickaxe, but where did that get him?!
translation: Kazmayi kullanmayi cok iyi bilirdi, ama bu ona ne kazandirdi ki?

english: Trapped in the depths under all that rock and stone...
translation: Tüm o kaya ve taslarin altinda, derinliklerde mahsur kaldi...

english: Do you think he's still alive?
I don't know.
What I do know is that I do this for Karlo. Let's make him proud!
translation: Bildigim tek sey, bunu Karlo icin yaptigim. Onu gururlandirmaliyiz!

english: For Karlo!
For Karlo!
Into the tunnels, quick!
Let's go!
Quickly, while it's recovering!
What's it left this time?
It's coming back!
Prepare yourselves!
Retreat!
Run!
Hi there.
Can I help you?
I don't know. Can you?
Probably not. I'm on break.
Break from what?
See that big mountain outside? That's the Darkfrost. There's a nice beastie up there called the Hueycoatl.
translation: Disaridaki büyük dagi görüyor musun? Orasi Darkfrost. Orada Hueycoatl adinda hos bir canavar var.

english: You humans don't seem to care that much, so as usual it's up to us to stop it making a big mess of the entire area.
translation: Siz insanlar pek umursamiyor gibisiniz, bu yüzden her zamanki gibi tüm bölgeyi mahvetmesini engellemek bize kalmis.

english: Hello again. Still on break?
I am. Dealing with the Hueycoatl is hard work, and it's not like you humans care enough to contribute much.
translation: Evet. Hueycoatl ile ugrasmak zor bir is ve siz insanlar da pek umursamiyorsunuz.

english: Well, if you're in need of help, I'm open to contributing.
translation: Eger yardima ihtiyacin varsa, ben yardim etmeye hazirim.

english: You are? Oh... Fair enough then. In that case, head on up the mountain and get stuck in.
translation: Öyle mi? Oh... Tamam o zaman. O halde daga cik ve ise koyul.

english: Well, I've actually been up there helping myself.
translation: Aslinda ben de orada kendime yardim ediyordum.

english: You have? Oh... Fair enough then. I guess you've earned yourself a break as well.
translation: Öyle mi? Oh... Tamam o zaman. Sanirim sen de bir mola hak ettin.

english: Hello there. How's it going?
Sorry, but I have lots of work to do.
translation: Üzgünüm, ama yapacak cok isim var.

english: Not too bad, but the work is definitely tiring.
translation: Fena degil, ama is kesinlikle yorucu.

english: Well I could do with a good rest, but fine otherwise.
translation: Iyi bir dinlenmeye ihtiyacim var, ama onun disinda iyiyim.

english: Sorry, but I'm busy right now.
Busy, busy, busy.
Hiya.
What do you want? I've got work to do!
Can you teach me anything?
No - I've got one lousy apprentice already, and that's quite enough hassle! Go away!
translation: Hayir, zaten berbat bir ciragim var, bu da yeterince basimi agritiyor! Git buradan!

english: Got another load for ya!
Great, just what my arms need!
translation: Harika, tam da kollarimin ihtiyaci olan sey!

english: Ohhh, time for a break.
Time I got moving...
Keep 'em coming!
Bleah
Another lot for ya!
Alright, thanks!
Off we go again!
How's it going, officers?
Another boring day.
Nothing new there.
I'm being slaughtered!
Oh, they're all dead.
Don't dawdle there!
Yeah, yeah, I'm movin' guv.
Hmm, time for a break.
You there! Over here! Let's have a little chat before you head up there!
translation: Sen, oradaki! Buraya gel! Oraya gitmeden önce biraz sohbet edelim!

english: Hello.
Hello there, my short-tongued friend. What can I do for you?
translation: Merhaba, kisa dilli dostum. Senin icin ne yapabilirim?

english: What are you doing here?
What do you think I'm doing here?
I wouldn't like to guess.
How disappointing. I enjoy a good guessing game! No matter. My colleague and I are here are on a mission of preservation!
translation: Ne kadar hayal kirici. Ben tahmin oyunlarini severim! Önemli degil. Meslektasim ve ben buraya koruma görevine geldik!

english: Preservation of what?
Preservation of these magnificent colossal wyrm remains, of course! You see, we have a termite problem.
translation: Tabii ki bu muhtesem devasa ejderha kalintilarini korumaya! Görüyorsunuz, termit sorunumuz var.

english: I'm beginning to see your role in all of this.
Indeed! And while my archaeological skills are certainly exemplary, I also bring a certain set of more unique skills to this troublesome assignment.
translation: Aynen öyle! Arkeolojik becerilerim kesinlikle örnek teskil ediyor, ama bu zorlu göreve daha benzersiz beceriler de katiyorum.

english: Oh for goodness sake, he just eats the termites!
translation: Tanri askina, o sadece termitleri yiyor!

english: Ahem! I am able to dispose of the termites in ways others cannot.
translation: Ahem! Termitleri baskalarinin yapamadigi sekillerde ortadan kaldirabiliyorum.

english: I see. So can I help your preservation efforts?
translation: Anliyorum. Koruma cabalarina yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: Why yes! It seems our scaffolding has proven to be a useful place for adventurous types to practice running and jumping in quick succession.
translation: Tabii ki! Iskelemiz, maceraci tiplerin hizli kosma ve atlama pratigi yapmak icin kullanisli bir yer oldugu ortaya cikti.

english: Should you also wish to practice these skills, you may come across the aforementioned termites while you traverse the ropes. Simply scoop them up and bring them to me.
translation: Siz de bu becerileri gelistirmek isterseniz, ipleri gecerken bahsettigim termitlerle karsilasabilirsiniz. Onlari toplayip bana getirin.

english: I'll happily exchange them for some goodies I've collected during my time here! You can also keep any bone shards they may have unfortunately chipped off.
translation: Burada topladigim bazi esyalarla seve seve takas ederim! Ayrica, maalesef kirilmis kemik parcalarini da alabilirsiniz.

english: Sounds simple enough!
Wonderful! To get started, just use the ladder by the wyrm's skull to climb up onto the scaffolding.
translation: Harika! Baslamak icin, ejderhanin kafatasinin yanindaki merdiveni kullanarak iskeleye tirmanin.

english: Initially the route is the same for everyone, but part way round you'll find a loftier section of scaffolding. If you're skilled, that route might be more appealing to you.
translation: Baslangicta rota herkes icin aynidir, ancak yolun bir kisminda daha yüksek bir iskele bölümü bulacaksiniz. Eger yetenekliyseniz, bu rota sizin icin daha cekici olabilir.

english: That said, don't go up there unless you know what you're doing. I have work to do so I can't spend all my time patching people up when they hurt themselves!
translation: Ancak, ne yaptigini bilmiyorsan oraya cikma. Yapacak islerim var, bu yüzden yaralananlari tedavi etmekle tüm zamanimi harcayamam!

english: You'll need at least 50 Agility to tackle the basic course and 62 Agility to take on the advanced course.
translation: Temel parkuru tamamlamak icin en az 50 Ceviklik, ileri seviye parkuru tamamlamak icin ise 62 Ceviklik gerekir.

english: Great, thanks!
Good luck!
Remind me, what are you doing here?
Would you like to trade?
I certainly would!
How am I doing so far?
Which route would you like to know about?
translation: Hangi rota hakkinda bilgi almak istersin?

english: You haven't completed any laps of the basic agility course yet. There's been X global completions and the global best time is X.
translation: Henüz temel ceviklik parkurunda hicbir tur tamamlamadin. Küresel olarak X tur tamamlandi ve küresel en iyi zaman X.

english: You haven't completed any laps of the advanced agility course yet. There's been X global completions and the global best time is X.
translation: Henüz ileri seviye ceviklik parkurunda hicbir tur tamamlamadin. Küresel olarak X tur tamamlandi ve küresel en iyi zaman X.

english: I'd better get going.
Farewell.
Remind me, what are you doing here?
Would you like to trade?
How am I doing so far?
Colossal Wyrm Basic Course.
Colossal Wyrm Advanced Course.
I'd better get going.
Whut you want?
What are you in for?
Me not sure. Me pick some stuff up and take it away.
translation: Emin degilim. Bazi esyalari alip götürdüm.

english: Well, did the stuff belong to you?
translation: Peki, o esyalar sana mi aitti?

english: Umm...no.
Well, that would be why then.
Oh, right.
Sorry, thought this was a zoo.
translation: Üzgünüm, burasinin hayvanat bahcesi oldugunu sanmistim.

english: I believe you've got piece of a map that I need.
translation: Sanirim ihtiyacim olan haritanin bir parcasini sende var.

english: So? Why should I be giving it to you? What you do for Wormbrain?
translation: Ee? Neden sana vermeliyim? Wormbrain icin ne yapiyorsun?

english: I'm not going to do anything for you. Forget it.
translation: Senin icin hicbir sey yapmayacagim. Unut gitsin.

english: Be dat way then.
I'll let you live. I could just kill you.
Ha! Me in here and you out dere. You not get map piece.
translation: Ha! Ben buradayim, sen disaridasin. Harita parcasini alamayacaksin.

english: I suppose I could pay you for the map piece. Say, 500 coins?
translation: Harita parcasi icin sana para verebilirim. Mesela 500 altin?

english: Me not stoopid, it worth at least 10,000 coins!
translation: Ben aptal degilim, en az 10.000 altin degerinde!

english: You must be joking! Forget it.
Fine, you not get map piece.
Oops, I don't have enough on me.
Comes back when you has enough.
Alright then, 10,000 coins it is.
Fank you very much! Now me can bribe da guards, hehehe.
translation: Cok tesekkürler! Artik muhafizlara rüsvet verebilirim, hehehe.

english: Where did you get the map piece from?
We rob house of stupid wizard. She very old, not put up much fight at all. Hahaha!
translation: Aptal bir büyücünün evini soydum. Kadin cok yasliydi, hic direnmedi. Hahaha!

english: Uh... Hahaha.
Her house full of pictures of a city on island and old pictures of people. Me not recognise island.
translation: Evi, adadaki bir sehrin resimleri ve eski insan resimleriyle doluydu. Adayi tanimadim.

english: Me find map piece. Me not know what it is, but it in locked box so me figure it important.
translation: Harita parcasini buldum. Ne oldugunu bilmiyorum, ama kilitli bir kutunun icindeydi, bu yüzden önemli oldugunu düsündüm.

english: But, by the time me get box open, other goblins gone. Then me not run fast enough and guards catch me.
translation: Ama kutuyu actigimda diger goblinler gitmisti. Sonra yeterince hizli kosamadim ve muhafizlar beni yakaladi.

english: But now you want map piece so must be special! What you do for me to get it?
translation: Ama simdi harita parcasini istiyorsun, o zaman özel bir sey olmali! Onu almak icin ne yapacaksin?

english: You have just beaten Wormbrain up. Give the poor goblin a break.
