translation: Az önce Wormbrain'i dövdün. Zavalli goblini rahat birak.

english: You have already taken Wormbrain's map piece. There is no use in beating him up further.
translation: Wormbrain'in harita parcasini zaten aldin. Onu daha fazla dövmenin bir anlami yok.

english: What are you in for?
Sorry, thought this was a zoo.
translation: Üzgünüm, burasinin hayvanat bahcesi oldugunu sanmistim.

english: I believe you've got a piece of map that I need.
translation: Sanirim ihtiyacim olan harita parcasini sende var.

english: I'm not going to do anything for you. Forget it.
translation: Senin icin hicbir sey yapmayacagim. Unut gitsin.

english: I'll let you live. I could just kill you.
I suppose I could pay you for the map piece...
translation: Sanirim harita parcasi icin sana para ödeyebilirim...

english: You must be joking! Forget it.
Alright then, 10,000 it is.
Where did you get the map piece from?
Hello there friend.
Oh..what am I to do, Christmas is ruined.
What's the matter?
Christmas is ruined, my bakery is ruined, everything is ruined!
translation: Noel mahvoldu, firinim mahvoldu, her sey mahvoldu!

english: Maybe this has something to do with Santa in Varrock Square.
translation: Belki bunun Varrock Meydani'ndaki Noel Baba ile bir ilgisi vardir.

english: Adventurer! You've come at the right time. I need your help.
translation: Maceraci! Tam zamaninda geldin. Yardimina ihtiyacim var.

english: Could this have something to do with some missing Gingerbread Gnomes?
translation: Bu, kaybolan Zencefilli Gnome'larla bir ilgisi olabilir mi?

english: How did you know?
Santa told me to sort it out for him, he said his son has taken over the Gingerbread Gnome production.
translation: Noel Baba bana bu isi halletmemi söyledi, oglunun Zencefilli Gnome üretimini devraldigini söyledi.

english: He has been an absolute disaster, he suddenly showed up and took control of our bakery. We tried to stop him, but he locked up the two other bakers!
translation: O tam bir felaket, aniden ortaya cikip firinimizi ele gecirdi. Onu durdurmaya calistik ama diger iki firinciyi kilitledi!

english: How did you manage to escape?
Well... I don't think he knows how Gingerbread Gnomes are made, he brought in an Icelord to ice the gingerbread.
translation: Sey... Sanirim zencefilli kurabiye cücelerin nasil yapildigini bilmiyor, zencefilli kurabiyeleri buzlamak icin bir Buz Lordu getirdi.

english: I threw a stone at it to cause a distraction, giving me a chance to escape. After I got out, I heard Jack lock the entrance behind me.
translation: Dikkatini dagitmak icin ona bir tas attim, bu da bana kacma sansi verdi. Disari ciktiktan sonra Jack'in arkamdan girisi kilitledigini duydum.

english: He brought in an Icelord!? I don't know how to deal with one of those.
translation: Bir Buz Lordu mu getirdi? Nasil basa cikacagimi bilmiyorum.

english: It's terrifying! I think Jack must have a few screws loose to think that was a good idea.
translation: Bu cok korkunc! Jack'in bunun iyi bir fikir oldugunu düsünmesi icin kafasinda birkac tahtanin eksik olmasi gerek.

english: Well, I better tell Santa, since I can't get into the bakery from here....
translation: Buradan firina giremedigim icin Noel Baba'ya haber versem iyi olacak...

english: Please hurry, we need to restart production as soon as possible.
translation: Lütfen acele edin, mümkün olan en kisa sürede üretime yeniden baslamamiz gerekiyor.

english: Have you managed to free the other bakers and stop Jack Frost yet?
translation: Diger firincilari kurtarmayi ve Jack Frost'u durdurmayi basardiniz mi?

english: Not yet, I'm still working on it.
Hurry we need to get back into production, before it's too late.
translation: Acele et, cok gec olmadan üretime geri dönmeliyiz.

english: Got a medpack? I feel terrible.
translation: Ilk yardim cantan var mi? Kendimi cok kötü hissediyorum.

english: What happened to you?
Lizardman bite. There's always a fever after you've been bitten by one of those. I'm sure they don't clean their teeth.
translation: Kertenkele adam isirdi. Onlardan biri isirdiginda her zaman ates cikar. Eminim dislerini temizlemiyorlardir.

english: Sorry, I haven't got one.
Try looking in the storage tents outside.
Thanks for the medpack. I'm feeling a lot better now.
translation: Ilk yardim cantasi icin tesekkürler. Simdi cok daha iyi hissediyorum.

english: While you're here, you could help the war effort by fetching medpacks for my sick comrades. There'll be some in the storage tents outside.
translation: Buradayken, hasta arkadaslarim icin ilk yardim cantalari getirerek savas cabalarina yardimci olabilirsin. Disaridaki depo cadirlarinda biraz var.

english: I'll bear that in mind.
Gimme a medpack - I need my strength back.
translation: Bana bir ilk yardim cantasi ver, gücümü geri kazanmam lazim.

english: What happened to me is nothing compared to what's gonna happen to the filthy lizardman who did it. When I'm out of here, I'm gonna find him and fix him good.
translation: Bana olanlar, bunu yapan pis kertenkele adamin basina geleceklerle karsilastirildiginda hicbir sey. Buradan ciktigimda onu bulup hakkindan gelecegim.

english: Cheers. When I get back on my feet, there's gonna be one sorry lizardman out there.
translation: Tesekkürler. Ayaklarimin üstüne ciktigimda, disarida pisman olacak bir kertenkele adam olacak.

english: Those lizardmen gotta die! Ya hear me? I want them all dead! All of 'em!
translation: O kertenkele adamlar ölmeli! Duydun mu? Hepsinin ölmesini istiyorum! Hepsi!

english: Those ruffians hit me pretty hard. Have you got a medpack?
translation: O haydutlar beni fena dövdü. Ilac cantan var mi?

english: Gangsters. I was on patrol in the docklands, but those Piscarilius scumbags lured me into an alley and hit me with a stick.
translation: Gangsterler. Liman bölgesinde devriye geziyordum, ama o Piscarilius pislikleri beni bir sokaga cekip sopayla dövdüler.

english: Thanks. Hopefully I'll be back on patrol again soon.
translation: Tesekkürler. Umarim yakinda tekrar devriyeye cikabilirim.

english: We'll never keep on top of the crime in this kingdom at this rate. Maybe you could help deal with some gangsters while you're in Kourend.
translation: Bu gidisle bu kralliktaki suclari asla kontrol altina alamayiz. Belki Kourend'deyken bazi gangsterlerle ilgilenmene yardim edebilirsin.

english: I'm alright now. Try another soldier.
translation: Su anda iyiyim. Baska bir askere bak.

english: Oh dearie me...
Ooo-er...
Relapse over here!
Medic!
What happened to you?
Sorry, I haven't got one.
I'll bear that in mind.
Gah! You play like a donkey, don't just sit there, get up and get the ball back!
translation: Gah! Esek gibi oynuyorsun, orada oturma, kalk ve topu geri al!

english: Hello?
That's more like it, get in there!
Excuse me?
Oof. That's got to hurt.
You think this guy is far too engrossed in the sport to pay any attention to anything else.
translation: Bu adamin spora o kadar dalmis oldugunu düsünüyorsun ki baska hicbir seye dikkatini veremiyor.

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: Hazir yemekler maalesef ise yaramaz. Aluft Aloft'un müsterileri icin sadece el yapimi Cüce Mutfagi yeterince iyidir.

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Wurbel
Come on guys, I've got a blurberry special riding on this one. Oh my order? Thanks.
translation: Hadi cocuklar, bu sefer blurberry spesiyali var. Siparisim mi? Tesekkürler.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr'dan ücretsiz teslimat jetonunu almayi unutma.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: Teslimatin cok gec! Aluft jnr'a geri dön ve baska bir siparis al. Artik ihtiyacin olmadigi icin teslimat kutunu atiyorsun.

english: Welcome to my food store! Would you like to buy anything?
translation: Yiyecek magazama hos geldin! Bir sey almak ister misin?

english: Yes please.
No, thank you.
What can you recommend?
We have this really exotic fruit all the way from Karamja. It's called a banana.
translation: Karamja'dan gelen cok egzotik bir meyve var. Adi muz.

english: Hmm, I think I'll try one.
Great. You might as well take a look at the rest of my wares as well.
translation: Harika. Diger ürünlerime de bir göz atabilirsiniz.

english: I don't like the sound of that.
Well, it's your choice, but I do recommend them.
translation: Secim sizin, ama ben tavsiye ederim.

english: Is it nice and tidy round the back now?
translation: Arka taraf simdi düzenli ve temiz mi?

english: Yes, can I work out front now?
translation: Evet, artik ön tarafta calisabilir miyim?

english: No, I'm the one who works here.
Yes, are you going to pay me yet?
Umm... No, not yet.
No, it's a complete mess.
Ah well, it'll give you something to do, won't it.
translation: Ah, en azindan yapacak bir seyin olur, degil mi?

english: Can I buy something please?
translation: Bir sey satin alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: Yes, of course.
Yes please.
No, thank you.
What can you recommend?
Hmm, I think I'll try one.
I don't like the sound of that.
Yes, can I work out front now?
translation: Evet, artik ön tarafta calisabilir miyim?

english: Yes, are you going to pay me yet?
No, it's a complete mess
Can I buy something please?
translation: Bir sey satin alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: I'm the head gardener around here. If you're looking for woad leaves, or if you need help with owt, I'm yer man.
translation: Ben buradaki bas bahcivanim. Woad yapragi ariyorsan veya yardima ihtiyacin varsa, ben senin adaminim.

english: Yes please, I need woad leaves.
translation: Evet lütfen, woad yapragina ihtiyacim var.

english: How much are you willing to pay?
How about 5 coins?
No no, that's far too little. Woad leaves are hard to get. I used to have plenty but someone kept stealing them off me.
translation: Hayir hayir, bu cok az. Woad yapraklari bulmak zor. Eskiden bol miktarda vardi ama biri sürekli caliyordu.

english: How about 10 coins?
How about 15 coins?
Mmmm... okay, that sounds fair.
I don't have enough coins to buy the leaves. I'll come back later.
translation: Yapraklari alacak kadar param yok. Daha sonra tekrar gelirim.

english: Thanks.
I'll be around if you have any more gardening needs.
translation: Bahcenizle ilgili baska bir ihtiyaciniz olursa ben buralardayim.

english: How about 20 coins?
Okay, that's more than fair.
Here, have two, you're a generous person.
translation: Alin, iki tane alin, siz cömert birisiniz.

english: How about ME helping YOU instead?
translation: Ben size yardim etsem nasil olur?

english: That's a nice thing to say. I do need a hand, now you mention it. You see, there's some stupid mole digging up my lovely garden.
translation: Cok naziksiniz. Aslinda yardima ihtiyacim var, simdi siz söyleyince aklima geldi. Bakin, aptal bir köstebek benim güzel bahcemi kaziyor.

english: A mole? Surely you've dealt with moles in the past?
translation: Köstebek mi? Eskiden köstebeklerle ugrasmissindir herhalde?

english: Ah, well this is no ordinary mole! He's a big'un for sure. Ya see... I'm always relied upon to make the most of this 'ere garden - the faster and bigger I can grow plants the better!
translation: Ah, bu siradan bir köstebek degil! Kesinlikle kocaman bir köstebek. Anlayacagin... Bu bahceyi en iyi sekilde degerlendirmek icin her zaman bana güvenilirler - bitkileri ne kadar hizli ve büyük yetistirebilirsem o kadar iyi!

english: In my quest for perfection I looked into 'Malignius- Mortifer's-Super-Ultra-Flora-Growth-Potion'. It worked well on my plants, no doubt about it! But it had the same effect on a nearby mole. Ya can imagine the
translation: Mükemmelligi arayisimda “Malignius-Mortifer'in Süper Ultra Bitki Büyüme Iksiri”ni arastirdim. Bitkilerimde cok iyi sonuc verdi, buna süphe yok! Ama yakindaki bir köstebek üzerinde de ayni etkiyi gösterdi.

english: havoc he causes to my patches of sunflowers! Why, if any of the other gardeners knew about this mole, I'd be looking for a new job in no time!
translation: Ayciceklerime verdigi zarari tahmin edebilirsiniz! Diger bahcivanlar bu köstebegi ögrenirse, hemen yeni bir is aramak zorunda kalirim!

english: I see. What do you need me to do?
If ya are willing maybe yer wouldn't mind killing it for me? Take a spade and use it to shake up them mole hills. Be careful though, he really is big!
translation: Eger isterseniz, benim icin onu öldürür müsünüz? Bir kürek alin ve onu köstebek yuvalarini kazmak icin kullanin. Ama dikkatli olun, o gercekten cok büyük!

english: Is there anything in this for me?
translation: Bunun bana bir faydasi olacak mi?

english: Well, if yer gets any mole skin or mole claws off 'un, I'd trade 'em for bird nests if ye brings 'em here to me.
translation: Eger köstebek derisi veya penceleri bulursaniz, onlari bana getirirseniz kus yuvalariyla takas ederim.

english: Right, I'll bear it in mind.
Sorry, but I'm not interested.
Fair enough.
If I'm not mistaken, you've got some body parts from a big mole there! I'll trade it for bird nests if ye likes. Or was ye wantin' some woad leaves instead?
translation: Yanilmiyorsam, orada büyük bir köstebekten bazi vücut parcalari var! Istersen kus yuvalariyla takas edebilirim. Yoksa woad yapraklari mi istiyorsun?

english: Okay, I will trade the mole parts.
Here, have this.
Yes please, I need woad leaves.
translation: Evet lütfen, woad yapraklarina ihtiyacim var.

english: How about 5 coins?
How about 10 coins?
How about 15 coins?
How about 20 coins?
How about ME helping YOU instead?
translation: Ben sana yardim etsem nasil olur?

english: Sorry, but I'm not interested.
Okay, I will trade the mole parts.
I can't believe she's done this.
Who's done this?
Fabia! She asked me to meet her, and I quote, 'by the special tree'. You may notice that she isn't here! I've been waiting for hours!
translation: Fabia! Benden onunla bulusmami istedi, aynen söyle dedi: “Özel agacin yaninda”. Burada olmadigini fark etmissindir! Saatlerdir bekliyorum!

english: Do you think she might just be delayed?
I know her too well. She wouldn't be delayed coming to see me.
translation: Onu çok iyi taniyorum. Beni görmeye gelmek için gecikmez.

english: Could you be at the wrong special tree?
translation: Yanlis özel agacin yaninda olabilir misin?

english: No! This is the one, singular, special tree!
translation: Hayir! Bu tek ve özel agaç!

english: Humour me for just a moment. What if, amongst this entire rainforest, there's a second very similar tree?
translation: Beni bir saniye dinle. Ya bu yagmur ormaninda ikinci bir benzer agaç varsa?

english: And Fabia would find herself at the wrong tree in this scenario?
translation: Ve Fabia bu durumda yanlis agaca gelmisse?

english: Or maybe it's you who is at the wrong one?
translation: Ya da belki de yanlis agaca gelen sensin?

english: No, absolutely not! I know where to meet Fabia and I wouldn't miss any opportunity to do so!
translation: Hayir, kesinlikle hayir! Fabia ile nerede bulusacagimi biliyorum ve bunu kaçirmam!

english: This was the tree where we first met. It was a lovely day! A botanical tour of the rainforest, but the only thing I found myself looking at was her...
translation: Bu, ilk tanistigimiz agaçti. Çok güzel bir gündü! Yagmur ormanlarinda botanik turu yapiyordum, ama tek baktigim sey oydu...

english: Well, I'm sure the two of you will find each other soon. However, I do suspect that might happen sooner if you considered looking by some other trees...
translation: Eminim ikiniz yakinda birbirinizi bulacaksiniz. Ancak, baska agaçlara da bakmayi düsünürseniz, bunun daha çabuk gerçeklesebilecegini düsünüyorum...

english: Hmm... I'll think about it, but for now, I'll wait here a while longer.
translation: Hmm... Bunu düsünecegim, ama simdilik burada biraz daha bekleyecegim.

english: Hello again, iknami! Thank you for helping us find each other!
translation: Merhaba iknami! Birbirimizi bulmamiza yardim ettigin için tesekkürler!

english: To think we were waiting by different trees! It was so silly of us!
translation: Farkli agaçlarin yaninda bekledigimizi düsünmek! Ne kadar aptalcaydi!

english: Well, I'm happy to see you together again. Now, I'm sure you have a lot of catching up to do. I'll leave you to it.
translation: Sizi tekrar birlikte gördügüme sevindim. Simdi, eminim konusacak çok seyiniz vardir. Sizi yalniz birakayim.

english: Timoiva, iknami!
Nilsal! Looking to buy some dyes?
I'll have a look.
I'm good, thanks.
In that case, timoiva for now.
I'll have a look.
I'm good, thanks.
Nilsal, traveller.
Can you heal me? I'm injured.
Sorry, but I cannot.
I could, but you don't appear to actually need healing right now.
translation: Yapabilirim, ama su anda iyilesmeye ihtiyacin yok gibi görünüyor.

english: Of course.
The teoki whispers a prayer and you suddenly feel a bit better.
translation: Teoki bir dua fisildar ve aniden kendini biraz daha iyi hissedersin.

english: How are things here?
Very busy, my friend. We have a lot of repairs to be doing, not to mention that there will soon be a new Gathering taking place here.
translation: Çok yogun, dostum. Yapmamiz gereken çok fazla onarim var, yakinda burada yeni bir Toplanma olacagi da cabasi.

english: Any problems of note?
We did have a creature from down in the caverns try to come up here at one point. Presumably they've been disturbed by recent events. The warriors quickly dealt with it though.
translation: Bir ara magaralardan bir yaratik buraya çikmaya çalisti. Muhtemelen son olaylardan rahatsiz olmuslardir. Ancak savasçilar hizlica hallettiler.

english: That's good to hear.
I'd better be off.
May the sun light your way, traveller.
Can you heal me? I'm injured.
How are things here?
I'd better be off.
Greetings human. Do you seek guidance?
Who are you?
I am Xorrah quo Sihar. I am one of the mystics of the Kahlith.
translation: Ben Xorrah quo Sihar. Kahlith'in mistiklerinden biriyim.

english: Kahlith?
Yes. At one time we were like you, but then we met the Tasakaal. They taught us to have purpose. They taught us to serve the balance.
translation: Evet. Bir zamanlar biz de senin gibiydik, ama sonra Tasakaal ile tanistik. Bize bir amac sahibi olmayi ögrettiler. Bize dengeyi korumayi ögrettiler.

english: Our old lives were left behind. In their place, the Kahlith were born.
translation: Eski hayatlarimiz geride kaldi. Onlarin yerine Kahlith dogdu.

english: Tasakaal?
Our teachers. They showed us the way and taught us to serve the balance.
translation: Ögretmenlerimiz. Bize yolu gösterdiler ve dengeyi korumayi ögrettiler.

english: The balance?
For every death, there must be life. For every life, there must be a death. This is the balance.
translation: Her ölüm icin bir yasam olmali. Her yasam icin bir ölüm olmali. Denge budur.

english: Our purpose, as taught to us by the Tasakaal, is to keep this balance, no matter the cost.
translation: Tasakaal'in bize ögrettigi gibi, amacimiz ne pahasina olursa olsun bu dengeyi korumaktir.

english: A mystic?
Yes. All Kahlith serve the balance. To do this, we take on one of four roles.
translation: Evet. Tüm Kahlith dengeye hizmet eder. Bunu yapmak icin dört rolden birini üstleniriz.

english: My role is that of a mystic. I learn from the Tasakaal and then pass on their teachings.
translation: Benim rolüm mistik rolüdür. Tasakaal'dan ögrenir ve onlarin ögretilerini aktaririm.

english: That's all thanks.
What is this place?
This is our home. In your tongue, it is known as Mount Karuulm.
translation: Burasi bizim evimiz. Sizin dilinizde Karuulm Dagi olarak bilinir.

english: My tongue?
Yes. You speak the language of humans but we Kahlith have our own language.
translation: Evet. Siz insanlarin dilini konusuyorsunuz ama biz Kahlith'lerin kendi dilimiz var.

english: In the past, we have tried to teach our language to your kind. However, despite the simplicity of our tongue, success was limited.
translation: Gecmiste, dilimizi sizin türünüze ögretmeye calistik. Ancak, dilimizin basitligine ragmen, basari sinirli kaldi.

english: We find that it is easier to just use your language when your kind are around.
translation: Sizin türünüz etrafta oldugunda, sizin dilinizi kullanmanin daha kolay oldugunu fark ettik.

english: Can you give an example?
Of our language?
Yes please.
Well you'll find our language is quite a simple one. Our names are a good example of how it is used.
translation: Dilimizin oldukca basit oldugunu göreceksiniz. Isimlerimiz, dilimizin nasil kullanildigina dair iyi bir örnektir.

english: I am Xorrah quo Sihar. The first word, 'Xorrah', is unique to me and it is how I can be identified.
translation: Ben Xorrah quo Sihar. Ilk kelime, “Xorrah”, bana özeldir ve bu sekilde tanimlanirim.

english: The second word, 'quo', is a basic Kahlith word that translates to 'the' in your language.
translation: Ikinci kelime olan “quo”, sizin dilinizde “the” anlamina gelen temel bir Kahlith kelimesidir.

english: The final word, 'Sihar', is my title. There are four possible titles, one for each role in Kahlith society. My title translates to 'Mystic' in your tongue.
translation: Son kelime olan “Sihar” ise benim unvanimdir. Kahlith toplumunda her rol icin bir tane olmak üzere dört unvan vardir. Benim unvanim sizin dilinizde “Mistik” anlamina gelir.

english: So in my language your name would be Xorrah the Mystic?
translation: Yani benim dilimde sizin adiniz Mistik Xorrah mi olur?

english: Exactly.
Interesting. Thanks for the information.
I'm good thanks.
Who are you?
Kahlith?
Tasakaal?
The balance?
What is this place?
That's all thanks.
A mystic?
My tongue?
Can you give an example?
I'm good thanks.
Ahhh, hello there, [player name].
Can you tell me a bit about skillcapes?
translation: Bana skillcapes hakkinda biraz bilgi verebilir misin?

english: Sure. You can buy a skillcape when you reach level 99 in a skill. Apart from boosting your statistics in that skill, they can also be used to perform some pretty amazing emotes!
translation: Elbette. Bir beceride 99. seviyeye ulastiginizda beceri pelerini satin alabilirsiniz. Bu pelerinler, o becerideki istatistiklerinizi artirmanin yani sira, oldukca etkileyici emote'lar yapmak icin de kullanilabilir!

english: The Cape of Strength also provides you with unlimited teleports to our guild. Is there anything else you would like to know?
translation: Güc Pelerini ayrica guildimize sinirsiz teleport imkani saglar. Baska bilmek istediginiz bir sey var mi?

english: What can I do here?
Ahh, the shot put is a great test of strength and can be quite rewarding. Mind you do it properly though, you might want to dust your hands with some powdery substance first. It'll give better grip.
translation: Ahh, gülle atma gücü test etmek icin harika bir spor ve oldukca tatmin edici olabilir. Ancak bunu dogru sekilde yapmaya dikkat edin, önce ellerinize toz halinde bir madde sürmek isteyebilirsiniz. Bu, daha iyi tutus saglar.

english: I'll remember that. What should I use?
I personally prefer ground ashes, it makes a nice fine powder and gives some really good grip.
translation: Ben sahsen ögütülmüs külü tercih ederim, güzel bir toz olusturur ve gercekten iyi tutus saglar.

english: Ok, what else?
Basically you'll need to go in there, make sure you've got nothing cluttering up your hands, pick up a shot and throw it.... depending upon your technique, you can get quite long throws.
translation: Temel olarak oraya gitmeniz, ellerinizde hicbir seyin olmadigini kontrol etmeniz, bir gülle alip atmaniz gerekir... Tekniginize bagli olarak, oldukca uzun atislar yapabilirsiniz.

english: What was your best?
Ahh that would be telling...
Why are you wielding a tree branch?
Well...there's a story to that. You see, I should have an axe but-
translation: Sey... bunun bir hikayesi var. Aslinda bir baltam olmaliydi ama...

english: Sloane's axe?
My axe. He won it because of a squirrel.
translation: Benim baltam. Bir sincap yüzünden onu kazandi.

english: A squirrel?
He bet me that I couldn't catch the squirrel while still holding my axe, but that he could... Thing is, he tricked me! When it was his turn, he just chopped the tree down!
translation: Bana, baltami tutarken sincapi yakalayamayacagima, ama kendisinin yakalayabilecegine dair iddiaya girdi... Mesele su ki, beni kandirdi! Sira ona geldiginde, agaci kesti!

english: I see. That doesn't explain why you have a tree branch though.
translation: Anliyorum. Ama bu, neden agac dali tasidigini aciklamiyor.

english: A barbarian warrior is bound to his axe, I cannot take up another unless my axe is ruined beyond repair. So I used part of the tree that Sloane cut down as my weapon...it also reminds me of him.
translation: Bir barbar savasci baltasina baglidir, baltam tamir edilemeyecek kadar bozulmadikca baska bir tane alamam. Bu yüzden Sloane'in kestigi agacin bir parcasini silah olarak kullandim... ayni zamanda bana onu hatirlatiyor.

english: He was a great warrior.
Yes, and a good friend, Still, he would want us to be happy that he is now with his warrior brethren. Can I help you with anything else?
translation: Evet, ve iyi bir arkadasti. Yine de, simdi savasci kardesleriyle birlikte oldugu icin mutlu olmamizi isterdi. Baska bir sey yardimci olabilir miyim?

english: May I claim my tokens please?
I'm afraid you have not earned any tokens yet. Try some of the activities around the guild to earn some.
translation: Korkarim henüz jeton kazanmadiniz. Bazi jetonlar kazanmak icin lonca cevresindeki etkinliklerden bazilarini deneyin.

english: Ok, I'll go see what I can find.
You don't have space to carry them.
Of course! Here you go, you've earned [amount] tokens!
Thanks!
Bye!
Be well, warrior [player name].
Ah, but I can see you are already as strong as is possible! Perhaps you have come to me to purchase a Cape of Strength, and thus join the elite few who have mastered this exacting skill?
translation: Ah, ama görüyorum ki zaten mümkün olan en güclü halindesiniz! Belki de bana Güc Pelerini satin almak icin geldin ve böylece bu zorlu beceriyi ustalasmis seckin birkac kisiye katilmak istiyorsun?

english: As an additional recognition of your achievement, the Cape of Strength can teleport you to our guild.
translation: Basarini takdir etmek icin, Güc Pelerini seni guildimize isinlayabilir.

english: May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: Pelerinim icin baska bir baslik alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: You don't appear to have enough space in your inventory, come back and see me when you do.
translation: Envanterinde yeterli yer yok gibi görünüyor, yer acildiginda tekrar gelip beni gör.

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
May I buy a Skillcape of Strength, please?
translation: Güclü Beceri Pelerini satin alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: Hmm, yes, you certainly look strong enough. That'll be 99000 gold coins, please.
translation: Hmm, evet, kesinlikle yeterince güclü görünüyorsun. 99.000 altin lütfen.

english: Sorry, that's just too much to pay.
Not at all; there are many other adventurers who would love the opportunity to purchase such a prestigious item! You can find me here if you change your mind.
translation: Hic de degil; böyle prestijli bir esyayi satin alma firsatini kacirmak istemeyecek bircok maceraci var! Fikrini degistirirsen beni burada bulabilirsin.

english: Sure.
But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: Ama maalesef yanimda yeterince param yok.

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.
translation: Peki, paran oldugunda tekrar gelip beni gör.

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: Maalesef tüm Skillcapes sadece ücretsiz bir baslik ile satiliyor, bu bir beceri promosyonunun parcasi; bir alana bir bedava, bilirsin. Yani sana bir tane satabilmem icin önce envanterinde yer acman gerekiyor.

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: Harika! O pelerini gururla giy dostum.

english: Can you tell me a bit about skillcapes?
translation: Skillcapes hakkinda biraz bilgi verebilir misin?

english: What can I do here?
Why are you wielding a tree branch?
May I claim my tokens please?
Bye!
May I buy a Skillcape of Strength, please?
translation: Güc Skillcape'i satin alabilir miyim lütfen?

english: Skillcape
Hood
Sorry, that's just too much to pay.
Sure.
If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: Senin kadar cirkin olsaydim, yüzümü halka göstermeye cesaret edemezdim!

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: Oh! Sey... Az önce bir tane yedim de ondan!

english: Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: Hayatina deger veriyorsan bir daha benimle konusma!

english: Get lost!
I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: Sana verecek hicbir seyim yok, birak beni rahat, dilenci.

english: Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
translation: Su anda bununla ugrasacak vaktim yok.

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: Senin gibi zavalli bir et yiginiyla konusmak istemiyorum.

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: Cok kötü bir gün... tadini cikar.

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: Eger birini yakalarsan, paylasacagina söz ver.

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
You smell familiar...
Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: Buralarda insan gördün mü? Cok acim.

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: Bana kan tadi seven biri gibi görünüyorsun.

english: Good day to you, my friend.
Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: Bir dakika izin ver, dislerime bir sey sikismis...

english: Moo
Ah... [player name], welcome. I would offer you some water, but we don't get much of it down here.
translation: Ah... Maceraci, hos geldin. Sana su ikram etmek isterdim ama burada pek su bulamiyoruz.

english: Thanks...
I take it you have questions.
I do, but it is important that it is you who is asking for information, not me that is offering it.
translation: Evet, ama önemli olan bilgileri senin istemen, benim vermem degil.

english: Okay... How are you still communicating with your followers?
I take it you have answers.
I do, but I rarely share them umprompted.
Okay, how are you still communicating with your followers?
Yes, a few of them actually. How are you still communicating with your followers?
translation: Evet, aslinda birkac tanesi var. Takipcilerinle nasil iletisim kuruyorsun?

english: Why, through my voice, of course.
You know what I mean. How are you still communicating with your voice?
translation: Ne demek istedigimi biliyorsun. Sesinle nasil iletisim kuruyorsun?

english: The same way I always have.
But the dark nullifier... I thought it was supposed to sever your connection.
translation: Ama karanlik yok edici... Senin baglantini kesecegini saniyordum.

english: Hmm... Yes, if anything could have done so, it would have been the power of the Dark Altar.
translation: Hmm... Evet, eger bir sey yapabilseydi

english: However, when your opponents have only one angle of approach, it makes them so predictable.
translation: Ancak, rakiplerinizin tek bir yaklasim acisi oldugunda, bu onlari cok tahmin edilebilir hale getirir.

english: You knew we would try to use it?
Yes. When I heard you would be hand delivering me a connection to the Dark Altar... Why, I was overjoyed.
translation: Evet. Bana Karanlik Sunak'a bir baglanti getirecegini duydugumda... Cok sevindim.

english: But... I remember planting it! The plan went off without a hitch!
translation: Ama... Onu yerlestirdigimi hatirliyorum! Plan sorunsuz bir sekilde isledi!

english: I do not doubt that you remember it that way.
What did you do?!
A simple transfiguration of the mind. My disciples granted you a memory of success. A fitting payment for your gratiousservice.
translation: Basit bir zihin dönüsümü. Ögrencilerim sana basari anisi verdiler. Cömert hizmetin icin uygun bir ödeme.

english: You modified my memory?! That's only the second time someone has done that to me, and I wasn't very happy about it then either!
translation: Hafizami degistirdin mi?! Bu bana yapilan ikinci kez oluyor ve o zaman da pek memnun olmamistim!

english: Yes. And I have now answered five of your questions. I believe my generosity has been both demonstrated and exhausted.
translation: Evet. Ve simdi bes soruna cevap verdim. Cömertligim hem kanitlandi hem de tükendi.

english: You call that gloating generosity? If you didn't want something from me, I wouldn't still be down here. Get to the point.
translation: Buna cömertlik mi diyorsun? Benden bir sey istemeseydin, hala burada olmazdim. Sadede gel.

english: Hmm... Perhaps you are more astute than I thought. Very well, there is something that I want.
translation: Hmm... Belki de sandigimdan daha zekisin. Pekala, istedigim bir sey var.

english: Well you won't be getting it from me!
I am Yama. Every mortal desires something of mine. Ancient armaments? Hidden knowledge? Or perhaps a taste of revenge...
translation: Ben Yama'yim. Her ölümlü benim bir seyimi ister. Eski silahlar mi? Gizli bilgiler mi? Ya da belki intikamin tadi...

english: These things could be yours.
Face me in combat. If you win, you take it all. Armaments, knowledge, revenge.
translation: Benimle savas. Kazanirsan, hepsini alirsin. Silahlar, bilgiler, intikam.

english: And if I lose?
I take your soul. For all of eternity.
No thanks.
I see. Perhaps we could lower the stakes then.
translation: Anliyorum. O zaman belki de bahsi düsürebiliriz.

english: I will face you in an inhibited form. I'll even allow you to bring an ally, provided they have entered the same contract.
translation: Seninle sinirli bir sekilde karsilasacagim. Hatta ayni sözlesmeyi imzaladiklari takdirde bir müttefikini de getirmene izin verecegim.

english: If you win, I will give you a chance to gain some of my treasures, and of course, you will have sampled your revenge.
translation: Kazanirsan, sana hazinelerimden bazilarini kazanma sansi verecegim ve tabii ki intikamini da almis olacaksin.

english: When you take your final rest, I shall take your soul for a year. A drop in the ocean compared to eternity.
translation: Son uykuna yattiginda, ruhunu bir yilligina alacagim. Sonsuzluga kiyasla okyanusta bir damla gibi.

english: How can I know you'll keep your word?
The same way I will know you shall keep yours. A binding contract. As luck would have it, I had one of my scribes draft one up for just such an occasion.
translation: Senin sözünü tutacagini bildigim gibi. Baglayici bir sözlesme. Sans eseri, tam da böyle bir durum icin yazmanlarimdan birine bir taslak hazirlattim.

english: ...Okay.
Sign right here.
Excellent... Challenge me when you are ready, [player name]. I very much look forward to it.
translation: Mükemmel... Hazir oldugunda bana meydan oku, Maceraci. Sabirsizlikla bekliyorum.

english: I'm not sure I want to...
Of course. There is no rush. Leave, with your tail tucked between your legs. If you grow a spine and wish to fulfil your revenge, I will be waiting.
translation: Elbette. Aceleye gerek yok. Kuyrugunu kistirip git. Cesaretini toplar ve intikamini almak istersen, ben bekliyor olacagim.

english: You are back. Excellent. I have little time for cowards. If you are ready, I will retrieve the contract.
translation: Geri dönmüssün. Mükemmel. Korkaklara ayiracak vaktim yok. Hazirsan, sözlesmeyi getireyim.

english: Welcome, [player name]. Have you come to challenge me?
translation: Hos geldin, Maceraci. Bana meydan okumaya mi geldin?

english: Yes. Let's do this.
Yama snaps his fingers and teleports off his throne.
translation: Yama parmaklarini siklatir ve tahtindan uzaklasir.

english: Actually, I have some questions.
Of course.
There's something in our contract about additional contracts... Why would I want to sign any more of them?
translation: Sözlesmemizde ek sözlesmelerle ilgili bir madde var... Neden daha fazla sözlesme imzalamak isteyeyim ki?

english: As outlined in subsection C, if you wish for your revenge to feel more 'real', I am willing to lift some of the restrictions placed by the original contract.
translation: C alt bölümünde belirtildigi gibi, intikaminin daha “gercek” olmasini istiyorsan, orijinal sözlesmede yer alan bazi kisitlamalari kaldirmaya hazirim.

english: Why would I want that?
You seem to enjoy self-imposed difficulty. I thought I would indulge you.
translation: Kendi kendine zorluklar yaratmaktan hoslaniyor gibisin. Seni memnun etmek istedim.

english: You may not, in which case you can sell them to someone with greater respect for themselves. But if you do, the option is there.
translation: Istemiyorsan, kendini daha cok saygi duyan birine satabilirsin. Ama istersen, bu secenek mevcut.

english: And if you manage to claim victory, there is of course a reward for each contract.
translation: Ve zaferi elde edersen, elbette her sözlesme icin bir ödül var.

english: Okay, can I see the contracts?
No. For this, I require from you a service. My demons are... Lacking, of late. Unrefined.
translation: Hayir. Bunun icin senden bir hizmet istiyorum. Iblislerim... Son zamanlarda yetersiz kaliyorlar. Rafine degiller.

english: They must fight, suffer and reform. If you deliver them specific ends during your 'tasks' in my domain, they may leave behind a contract.
translation: Savasmali, aci cekmeli ve yeniden sekillenmeliler. Benim alanimdaki ‘görevler’ sirasinda onlara belirli sonlar verirsen, bir sözlesme birakabilirler.

english: And of course, if you defeat me, I may also reward you with one.
translation: Ve tabii ki, beni yenersen, ben de sana bir sözlesme ile ödüllendirebilirim.

english: What kinds of 'ends'?
Death by two-handed melee weapons, heavy ranged weapons, magic spells, special attacks, and defeating them whilst bound. Each kind may award a different contract.
translation: Iki elli yakin dövüs silahlari, agir menzilli silahlar, büyü büyüler, özel saldirilar ve baglanmis haldeyken onlari yenmek. Her tür farkli bir sözlesme ile ödüllendirilebilir.

english: If you find yourself eager to obtain any contract, I will use a glyph to indicate my preferred method, which you can utilise for a better chance to receive that contract.
translation: Herhangi bir sözlesmeyi elde etmek icin istekliysen, tercih ettigim yöntemi gösteren bir sembol kullanacagim, bu sembolü kullanarak o sözlesmeyi alma sansini artirabilirsin.

english: What kinds of contracts can I obtain?
Were you more adept at reading you would find the details in our original contract. Otherwise, bring any you obtain to me and I shall explain then.
translation: Okumaya daha yatkin olsaydin, orijinal sözlesmemizde ayrintilari bulabilirdin. Aksi takdirde, elde ettigin sözlesmeleri bana getir, ben de sana aciklayayim.

english: Do you keep any record of our fights?
I do, I can have somebody retrieve your file. One moment.
translation: Evet, birine senin dosyani getirmesini söyleyebilirim. Bir dakika.

english: A mail-imp holding a scroll appears. Yama smites the imp.
translation: Bir parsömen tutan bir posta cin ortaya cikar. Yama cini öldürür.

english: For your reading pleasure.
That's all.
No, I'd rather not.
I see. Perhaps you are just here to waste my time then? Return when you are not.
translation: Anliyorum. O zaman belki de sadece zamanimi bosa harcamak icin buradasin? Öyle olmadiginda geri gel.

english: Your strike lacks bite.
A change of pace.
Colabi, infernus
Ven, estella infernus
Colabesur infernus
Ven, umbra eclipta
Umbra, proriumpse
Umbra apprerendehe
Begone
You bore me.
Enough.
Lacking.
Pathetic.
The price is paid.
Fair is fair.
Your reward, as agreed.
A satisfying warmup. Collect your loot and let us continue.
translation: Tatmin edici bir isinma. Ganimetini topla ve devam edelim.

english: A passing performance.
A close fight. Your nerve was well held.
A good risk, adequately rewarded.
Excellent performance. Again?
Effective, if a bit cowardly.
Risk averse, are we?
Missed the fine print, did we? Our contract forbids you from picking up stashed items.
translation: Kücük yazilari gözden kacirdik, degil mi? Sözlesmemiz, saklanmis esyalari almanizi yasakliyor.

english: I hope you are finding the spoils from my treasury to your liking. There are plenty more for you to claim.
translation: Umarim hazinemden aldiginiz ganimetler hosunuza gidiyordur. Alabileceginiz daha cok sey var.

english: Your victories mount. You are getting better at this.
translation: Zaferleriniz artiyor. Bu iste gittikce daha iyi oluyorsunuz.

english: A victory earned. But there is room for improvement, is there not?
translation: Bir zafer kazandiniz. Ama daha da gelisebileceginiz alanlar var, degil mi?

english: Here we go again. I suppose it is entertaining watching you desperately guzzle potions, at the very least.
translation: Yine basliyoruz. En azindan, caresizce iksirleri icisinizi izlemek eglenceli.

english: I must once again commend your strategy. Employing tactics so boring that they put your opponents to sleep is very novel.
translation: Stratejini bir kez daha övmeliyim. Rakiplerini uyutacak kadar sikici taktikler kullanmak cok yenilikci.

english: Back again I see. I can see how you find these bouts exhilarating, being such a feeble opponent.
translation: Yine geldin. Bu kadar zayif bir rakip olarak bu dövüsleri heyecan verici buldugunu anlayabiliyorum.

english: Your willingness to wager your soul continues to surprise. I suppose you think of it even less worth than I do.
translation: Ruhunu ortaya koymaya istekli olman beni sasirtmaya devam ediyor. Sanirim sen onu benden daha degersiz buluyorsun.

english: : Honestly, I expected more. That it takes you as long as it does to defeat my inhibited form is rather embarrassing.
translation: : Acikcasi, daha fazlasini bekliyordum. Benim engellenmis halimi yenmek icin bu kadar uzun sürmen oldukca utanc verici.

english: You look happy with yourself. How endearing.
translation: Kendinden memnun görünüyorsun. Ne kadar sevimli.

english: In any case, [player name], are you here to challenge me?
translation: Her neyse, Maceraci, bana meydan okumak icin mi buradasin?

english: Don't let a single defeat set you back. You could have so many more.
translation: Tek bir yenilgi seni geriye götürmesin. Daha cok yenilgi alabilirsin.

english: My treasury remains over capacity. And here I was hoping to be relieved of some of its contents.
translation: Hazine dolum hala kapasitesinin üzerinde. Ben de iceriginin bir kismindan kurtulmayi umuyordum.

english: What a shame for our last bout to have ended that way! Maybe you will do better next time.
translation: Son dövüsümüzün bu sekilde bitmesi ne yazik! Belki bir dahaki sefere daha iyi olursun.

english: Back after being defeated so quickly? I suppose what you lack in skill you make up for with perseverance.
translation: Bu kadar cabuk yenildikten sonra geri mi döndün? Sanirim beceri eksikligini azimle telafi ediyorsun.

english: If you are struggling to achieve victory, I suppose avoiding defeat is the best you can do.
translation: Zafer elde etmekte zorlaniyorsan, yenilgiyi önlemek en iyisi sanirim.

english: You must be tired, having to run all the way back here.
Back for more? Well, you can always escape again I suppose.
translation: Daha fazlasi icin mi geri döndün? Sanirim yine kacabilirsin.

english: Excellent work evading. Next time, try fighting back.
translation: Kacisin mükemmeldi. Bir dahaki sefere karsilik vermeye calis.

english: Our last bout was cut short. Perhaps the next will be more fruitful.
translation: Son dövüsümüz kisa sürdü. Belki bir dahaki sefere daha verimli olur.

english: After all the confidence you demonstrated... still you lost your nerve. Perhaps I should have included in our contract a clause to cover your cowardly retreats.
translation: Gösterdin tüm o özgüvene ragmen... yine de cesaretini kaybettin. Belki de sözlesmemize korkakca kacislarini kapsayan bir madde eklemeliydim.

english: In any case, [player name], have you come to challenge me?
translation: Her neyse, Maceraci, bana meydan okumaya mi geldin?

english: Why... Do my eyes deceive me? I see a glimmer of courage within you.
translation: Neden... Gözlerim beni yaniltiyor mu? Icinde bir parca cesaret görüyorum.

english: I know what I'm doing, sign the contract.
With pleasure.
The [contract name] burns up and Yama breathes a contented sigh...
Good luck.
On second thought, I think I'll hold off.
translation: Bir daha düsündüm de, sanirim bekleyecegim.

english: Do not make a habit of wasting my time like this. Get out of my sight.
translation: Böyle zamanimi bosa harcamayi aliskanlik haline getirme. Gözümün önünden kaybol.

english: I want to know more about this contract.
translation: Bu sözlesme hakkinda daha fazla bilgi istiyorum.

english: Signing these contracts agrees us to a duel in which I am less inhibited. My powers will be greater than what you have experienced before.
translation: Bu sözlesmeleri imzalamak, benim daha az kisitli oldugum bir düelloya razi oldugumuz anlamina gelir. Güclerim, daha önce deneyimlediklerinden daha büyük olacak.

english: Each one details unique rules and rewards, the details of which you can read on the contract itself.
translation: Her biri benzersiz kurallar ve ödüller iceriyor, ayrintilari sözlesmenin kendisinde okuyabilirsin.

english: But I'm sure you already have. Shall we?
translation: Ama eminim zaten okumussundur. Baslayalim mi?

english: No, I think I'd like to read over the terms again.
translation: Hayir, sartlari bir kez daha okumak istiyorum.

english: Very well. Return when you are ready.
Er... No, I thought you'd lost this.
No, that contract was allowed to come into your possession quite deliberately. And I see you have bravely decided to make use of it.
translation: Hayir, o sözlesmenin senin eline gecmesi kasitli olarak saglandi. Ve görüyorum ki onu kullanmaya cesurca karar vermissin.

english: I'm not sure I...
I see that I had missjudgedyou, [player name]. Let us sign the contract and cement that assessment.
translation: Seni yanlis degerlendirmisim, Maceraci. Sözlesmeyi imzalayip bu degerlendirmeyi kesinlestirelim.

english: No, I think it might have been somebody else that dropped it. I should really go and find them...
translation: Hayir, sanirim onu düsüren baska biri olabilir. Gidip onu bulmaliyim...

english: Yes, perhaps it was. Perhaps it belonged to somebody else. Somebody with a semblance of pride or self respect.
translation: Evet, belki de öyledir. Belki de baska birine aittir. Gururlu ve kendine saygisi olan birine.

english: If you find them, be sure to send them my way.
Ah... The humble plain pizza. Unremarkable, yet powerful. Hand me it.
translation: Ah... Mütevazi sade pizza. Siradan ama güclü. Ver bana.

english: Yes... Delicious.
You think you can deny me pizza? Double check the fine print of our contract, [player name].
translation: Bana pizzayi reddedebilecegini mi saniyorsun? Sözlesmemizin kücük harflerini iki kez kontrol et, Maceraci.

english: What do you mean?! You can't just take my pizza!
translation: Ne demek istiyorsun?! Pizzami öylece alamazsin!

english: Oh but I can. As per our contract, any pizza you present to me cannot be taken back. Right here.
translation: Ama alabilirim. Sözlesmemize göre, bana sundugun hicbir pizza geri alinamaz. Iste burada.

english: That's outrageous! You can't hold me to this!
translation: Bu cok sacma! Beni buna mecbur edemezsin!

english: Perhaps you should have expressed that opinion before signing. Indeed, perhaps if you felt that way you should not have signed at all.
translation: Belki de imzalamadan önce bu fikrini belirtmeliydin. Aslinda, böyle düsünüyorsan hic imzalamamaliydin.

english: The meat pizza. An adequate if uninspired offering. Hand me it.
translation: Etli pizza. Yeterli ama ilham verici olmayan bir secenek. Ver sunu bana.

english: Anchovy pizza. Flavourful and bold. Hand me it.
translation: Hamsi pizzasi. Lezzetli ve cesur. Ver sunu bana.

english: Pineapple pizza, topped with delicious acidic flavours and the angry tears of a thousand nay-sayers. Excellent. Hand me it.
translation: Ananasli pizza, lezzetli eksi tatlar ve binlerce hayircilarin öfkeli gözyaslariyla süslenmis. Mükemmel. Ver sunu bana.

english: Is that your favourite kind of pizza?
No. My favourite kind of pizza is the jalapeño pizza. Were it that I could enjoy its zesty heat for every meal.
translation: Hayir. En sevdigim pizza jalapeño pizzasi. Her ögünde onun baharatli aciligini tadabilsem.

english: Do not insult me. I will not eat your leftovers.
Do you think you are funny, [player name].
Not at all, Yama. Here, take it.
translation: Hic de degil, Yama. Al sunu.

english: I'm quite alright. You can keep the evidence of your lackluster cooking ability to yourself.
translation: Ben iyiyim. Sikici ascilik yeteneginin kanitini kendine saklayabilirsin.

english: I'm afraid I can't. As per our contract, once shown to you, a full pizza cannot be taken back.
translation: Korkarim ki yapamam. Sözlesmemize göre, sana gösterildikten sonra, tam bir pizza geri alinamaz.

english: Do not test me, [player name]. I will not be eating burnt pizza today.
translation: Beni sinama, Maceraci. Bugün yanmis pizza yemeyecegim.

english: Do whatever you like with it, but I cannot take it back.
translation: Onunla ne istersen yap, ama geri alamam.

english: Very clever. Now get out of my sight.
translation: Cok akillica. Simdi gözümün önünden kaybol.

english: You thought you could escape with your pizza? I'm afraid not, [player name].
translation: Pizzanla kacabilecegini mi sandin? Korkarim ki hayir, Maceraci.

english: I'm afraid my scribes are a tad overwhelmed at the moment. Please, return with your contract soon, I would be delighted to sign once they are unblocked.
translation: Korkarim su anda katiplerim biraz mesgul. Lütfen sözlesmenizi yakinda geri getirin, engel kaldirildiginda imzalamaktan memnuniyet duyarim.

english: Contracts will be enabled 1-2 weeks after Yama has launched.
translation: Sözlesmeler Yama'nin lansmanindan 1-2 hafta sonra etkinlestirilecektir.

english: You know why I'm here. Stop messing around.
translation: Neden burada oldugumu biliyorsun. Oyalanmayi birak.

english: I take it you have answers.
Yes, a few of them actually.
Yes.
No.
Yes. Let's do this.
Actually, I have some questions.
There's something in our contract about additional contracts...
translation: Sözlesmemizde ek sözlesmelerle ilgili bir madde var...

english: Do you keep any record of our fights?
That's all.
No, I'd rather not.
I know what I'm doing, sign the contract.
I want to know more about this contract.
translation: Bu sözlesme hakkinda daha fazla bilgi istiyorum.

english: Er... No, I thought you'd lost this.
Another day, perhaps.
Another day, another soul.
translation: Baska bir gün, baska bir ruh.

english: Honestly, I expected more. That it takes you as long as it does to defeat my inhibited form is rather embarrassing.
translation: Dürüst olmak gerekirse, daha fazlasini bekliyordum. Benim engellenmis halimi yenmek için bu kadar uzun sürmen oldukça utanç verici.

english: Some losses are unavoidable. Yours, of course, was not.
translation: Bazi kayiplar kaçinilmazdir. Seninki elbette öyle degildi.

english: Your donation is greatly appreciated.
Defeat finds you. Of course, that is hardly unexpected.
translation: Yenilgi seni bulur. Elbette, bu hiç de beklenmedik bir sey degil.

english: Back again? Watching you escape in such a hurry, I thought you might never return.
translation: Yine mi geldin? Seni bu kadar aceleyle kaçarken görünce, bir daha dönmeyecegini sandim.

english: Ah, I see your legs have stopped quivering. Perhaps next time you will fight to the end.
translation: Ah, bacaklarinin titremesi durmus. Belki bir dahaki sefere sonuna kadar savasirsin.

english: I've seen what you have to offer. It doesn't scare me.
Excellent! letus sign the contract and find out how long that feeling lasts.
translation: Mükemmel! Sözlesmeyi imzalayalim ve bu duygunun ne kadar sürecegini görelim.

english: The terms of this contract dictate that you are to make your choice of oathplate to receive known prior to the fight. Sign it here.
translation: Bu sözlesmenin sartlari, dövüsten önce yemin plakasi seçiminizi bildirmenizi gerektirir. Burayi imzalayin.

english: My my, that's a lot of goods your dealing with. What are your terms?
translation: Vay vay, elinde çok fazla mal var. Kosullarin nedir?

english: I'm looking for a fight, show me how much these are worth to you.
translation: Kavga etmek istiyorum, bunlarin senin için ne kadar degerli oldugunu göster bana.

english: Hmm. No reward, but purely action? I could be convinced.
translation: Hmm. Ödül yok, sadece aksiyon mu? Ikna olabilirim.

english: The Pineapple pizza burns up and Yama breathes a contented sigh...
translation: Ananasli pizza yanar ve Yama memnuniyetle iç çeker...

english: I've seen what you have to offer. It doesn't scare me.
Oathplate helm
No, I've changed my mind.
Yes, I want the Oathplate helm.
Oathplate chest
Oathplate legs
Yes, you fool?
Excuse me?
You looked like you wanted to speak to me, you halfwit. You dullard.
translation: Benimle konusmak istiyormus gibi görünüyordun, seni yarim akilli. Seni ahmak.

english: That's enough.
My contract stipulates that I must follow you, you insufferable ignoramus. My contract does not stipulate that I must be polite, you ignorant buffoon.
translation: Sözlesmemde seni takip etmem gerektigi yaziyor, seni dayanilmaz cahil. Sözlesmemde kibar olmam gerektigi yazmiyor, seni cahil soytari.

english: What have I ever done to you?
How about parading me around like a trophy, you idiot clown? How about stuffing me in your rotten backpack, you inclement cretin? How about-
translation: Beni bir ganimet gibi sergilemek neydi, seni aptal palyaco? Beni cürümüs sirt cantana tikman ne dersin, seni acimasiz aptal? Ya da...

english: -locking me in your house, you absolutely intolerable moron.
translation: Beni evine kilitlemene ne dersin, seni tahammül edilemez moron.

english: Okay, I get the idea.
Good. Release me, then.
translation: Güzel. O zaman beni serbest birak.

english: Why would I do that after all of that rudeness?
translation: Bütün bu kabaliklarindan sonra bunu neden yapayim?

english: Bah!
I do not have the patience for you today.
I just want to chat.
You want to 'chat'? It is not enough that I must stare at your backside all day, I must suffer your sorry attempts at conversation as well?
translation: “Sohbet etmek” mi istiyorsun? Bütün gün senin kicina bakmak yetmiyor mu, bir de senin zavalli sohbet denemelerine katlanmak zorunda miyim?

english: Well if you're going to be rude, I'll find somebody else.
translation: Eger kaba davranacaksan, baska birini bulurum.

english: Somebody else? Who? Introduce me to this paragon of virtue, who can tolerate the torrent of spittle you call speech. The incoherent messes you call sentences.
translation: Baska birini mi? Kim? Beni, senin konusma dedigin tükürük seline tahammül edebilen bu erdem timsaliyle tanistir. Senin cümle dedigin tutarsiz karmasayla.

english: I have plenty of friends!
Oh yes, your friends. And do these friends, perhaps, live very far away? Are they perhaps too busy to meet up frequently?
translation: Evet, arkadaslarin. Peki bu arkadaslarin cok uzakta mi yasiyor? Belki de cok mesguller ve sik sik görüsemiyorlar?

english: Well...
The next time I am left stranded by your incompetence, which I'm sure won't take long, do us both a favour and don't reclaim me.
translation: Bir dahaki sefere senin beceriksizligin yüzünden ortada kalirsam, ki eminim cok uzun sürmez, ikimize de bir iyilik yap ve beni geri isteme.

english: I could incinerate you if I wanted.
I'm holding back because this house is actually habitable.
translation: Bu ev aslinda yasanabilir oldugu icin kendimi tutuyorum.

english: Oh no.
Get your hands off of m-
Hello.
Woooo wooo wooooo woooo
Hello.
How are you doing?
Meh, I don't want to talk about it.
Oh ummm... fair enough. Goodbye.
Not too well. I miss my friend. She couldn't join us here today.
translation: Cok iyi degilim. Arkadasimi özlüyorum. Bugün bize katilamadi.

english: Why couldn't she join you?
She had some afterlife business to take care of. Nieve's always so busy.
translation: Öbür dünyada halletmesi gereken bazi isleri vardi. Nieve her zaman cok mesguldür.

english: Nieve? I used to know a Nieve, but she died during horrible circumstances.
translation: Nieve mi? Ben de bir Nieve taniyordum, ama korkunc bir sekilde öldü.

english: Really? You must be [player name]! She talks about you a lot.
translation: Gercekten mi? Sen Maceraci olmalisin! Senden cok bahseder.

english: Does she? I miss her. Steve is alright, but... he's not Nieve.
translation: Öyle mi? Onu özlüyorum. Steve iyi biri, ama... o Nieve degil.

english: Anyway, please send her my regards and let her know that I avenged her death.
translation: Neyse, lütfen ona selamlarimi ilet ve onun intikamini aldigimi söyle.

english: I will.
Hello there!
Greetings Bwana! My name is Yanni and I buy and sell antiques.
translation: Selamlar Bwana! Benim adim Yanni ve antika alip satiyorum.

english: Tell me about this antiques business.
I buy antiques and other interesting items. If you have any interesting items that you might want to sell me, please let me see them and I'll offer you a fair price.
translation: Antika ve diger ilginc esyalari aliyorum. Satmak isteyebilecegin ilginc esyalarin varsa, lütfen bana göster, sana uygun bir fiyat teklif edeyim.

english: Would you like me to have a look at your items and give you a quote?
translation: Esyalarina bakip sana bir fiyat teklif etmemi ister misin?

english: Yes please!
Sorry Bwana, you have nothing I am interested in.
translation: Üzgünüm Bwana, ilgimi ceken hicbir sey yok.

english: I'll give you 100 coins for the Bone Key...
translation: Kemik Anahtar icin sana 100 sikke veririm...

english: I'll give you 100 coins for the Stone Plaque...
translation: Tas Plaka icin sana 100 sikke veririm...

english: I'll give you 100 coins for the tattered scroll...
translation: Yirtik parsömen icin sana 100 sikke veririm...

english: I'll give you 100 coins for the crumpled scroll...
translation: Burusuk parsömen icin sana 100 sikke veririm...

english: I'll give you 500 coins for your locating crystal...
translation: Konum belirleme kristaliniz icin size 500 altin verecegim...

english: I'll give you 1000 coins for your 'Beads of the Dead'...
translation: Ölülerin Boncuklari icin size 1000 altin verecegim...

english: And that's the only item I am interested in. If you want to sell me that item, simply show it to me.
translation: Ve ilgimi ceken tek esya bu. Bana bu esyayi satmak istiyorsaniz, göstermeniz yeterlidir.

english: Those are the items I am interested in Bwana. If you want to sell me those items, simply show them to me.
translation: Ilgilendigim esyalar bunlar Bwana. Bana bu esyalari satmak istiyorsaniz, göstermeniz yeterlidir.

english: Maybe some other time?
Sure thing. Have a nice day Bwana.
Do you have any interesting items for sale?
Sorry, [Sir/Madam], I have nothing that you need.
translation: Üzgünüm, , ihtiyaciniz olan bir seyim yok.

english: Hmm, sorry, not interested.
Fair enough, come back if you change your mind.
That's a great bone key. Here's 100 coins for it.
translation: Bu harika bir kemik anahtar. Iste 100 sikke.

english: That's a great crumpled scroll. Here's 100 coins for it.
translation: Bu harika bir burusuk parsömen. Iste 100 sikke.

english: That's a great tattered scroll. Here's 100 coins for it.
translation: Bu harika bir yirtik parsömen. Iste 100 sikke.

english: That's a great copy of Bervirius notes. Here's 100 coins for it.
translation: Bu harika bir Bervirius notlari kopyasi. Iste 100 sikke.

english: That's a great Locating Crystal. Here's 500 coins for it.
translation: Bu harika bir Yer Belirleme Kristali. Iste 500 sikke.

english: That's a great stone-plaque. Here's 100 coins for it.
translation: Bu harika bir tas plaket. Iste 100 sikke.

english: Impressive necklace there, here's 1000 coins for it.
Ah you'd like to sell this to me would you? I can offer you 5000 coins!
translation: Ah, bunu bana satmak ister misin? Sana 5000 sikke verebilirim!

english: Yes, I'll sell it for 5000 coins.
Very well my friend, let me count out your reward.
Thanks!
No, I think I'll hold on it a while longer yet.
Very well my friend, come back if you change your mind.
translation: Peki dostum, fikrini degistirirsen tekrar gel.

english: Tell me about this antiques business.
Yes please!
Maybe some other time?
Do you have any interesting items for sale?
Hmm, sorry, not interested.
Yes, I'll sell it for 5000
No, I think I'll hold on it a while longer yet.
Fancy some pie? Mine are far better than any you'll find up on the surface.
translation: Pasta ister misin? Benimkiler, yüzeyde bulabileceginiz her seyden cok daha iyidir.

english: I'll take a look.
No thanks.
Fine. Enjoy your human muck then.
translation: Peki. O zaman insan pisliginin tadini cikarin.

english: I'll take a look.
No thanks.
Good day to you, welcome to my pickaxe shop. Are you interested in making a purchase?
translation: Iyi günler, kazma dükkanima hos geldiniz. Satin almak ister misiniz?

english: No thanks.
Suit yourself. I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: Keyfinize bakin. Fikrinizi degistirirseniz ben buradayim.

english: Yes please.
No thanks.
Hello.
Hello.
You don't look very well. Are you alright?
No, I'm dead.
Dead as in... feeling a bit under the weather?
No, dead as in I got stabbed and died.
That's awful! How are you still here? And how can you still talk?
translation: Bu korkunc! Nasil hala buradasin? Ve nasil hala konusabiliyorsun?

english: Eve brought me back from the afterlife. She's a party lion, that one.
translation: Eve beni öbür dünyadan geri getirdi. O bir parti aslanidir.

english: How could she bring you back from the afterlife?
translation: Seni öbür dünyadan nasil geri getirebilir ki?

english: I'm not sure how the magic works exactly. Only Eve knows that. All I know is that she usually does this every year.
translation: Büyünün tam olarak nasil isledigini bilmiyorum. Bunu sadece Eve biliyor. Tek bildigim, genellikle her yil bunu yaptigi.

english: I didn't see her around last year. Are you sure she always comes here?
translation: Gecen yil onu görmedim. Her zaman buraya geldiginden emin misin?

english: She returns to the world of the living every year. That doesn't mean she has to go to Lumbridge Swamp every year.
translation: Her yil yasayanlarin dünyasina geri dönüyor. Bu, her yil Lumbridge Batakligi'na gitmesi gerektigi anlamina gelmez.

english: Fair enough.
What more can you tell me about the afterlife?
translation: Öbür dünya hakkinda baska ne söyleyebilirsin?

english: Not a lot. Most of it you'd have to see for yourself.
translation: Fazla bir sey yok. Cogunu kendin görmen gerek.

english: I don't feel quite ready for that yet.
And I was going to offer you a quick way there... what a shame.
translation: Sana oraya hizli bir yol sunacaktim... ne yazik.

english: Whelp. I should go.
Why do you choose to come back?
While the afterlife is not that bad, I do sometimes miss some things from when I used to be alive. There's nothing quite like Eve's special brew.
translation: Öbür dünya o kadar da kötü olmasa da, bazen hayattayken yasadigim bazi seyleri özlüyorum. Eve'in özel birasi gibisi yok.

english: So you just come here for fun? Like on holiday?
translation: Yani buraya sadece eglenmek icin mi geliyorsun? Tatil gibi mi?

english: You could say that. I could always come back to haunt people, but that gets tedious after a while. I'd much rather enjoy my time here.
translation: Öyle de denebilir. Insanlari korkutmak icin geri dönebilirdim, ama bir süre sonra sikici oluyor. Burada vakit gecirmeyi tercih ederim.

english: Well I'm glad you're not causing any harm by being here.
translation: Burada bulunarak kimseye zarar vermedigine sevindim.

english: The only way I'd cause harm is if someone were to interrupt my enjoying this party.
translation: Zarar vermemin tek yolu, birinin bu partinin tadini cikarmami engellemesi olur....

english: ... I should go.
Goodbye.
Goodbye.
What more can you tell me about the afterlife?
translation: Öbür dünya hakkinda bana baska ne anlatabilirsin?

english: Why do you choose to come back?
Hey, human.
Who are you?
I am Yellow Snow.
How did you get called Yellow Snow?
We trolls are named after the first thing we try to eat, an' some things are kinda inevitable in a big snowy land with almost no toilets.
translation: Biz troller, ilk yemeye calistigimiz seyin adini aliriz ve neredeyse hic tuvalet olmayan büyük karli bir ülkede bazi seyler kacinilmazdir.

english: We dug smelly hole in prison so Mother's prisoners wouldn't go all over floor, but it not very convenient. Trolls like things convenient.
translation: Annemin mahkumlari yere pislememesi icin hapishanede kokulu bir cukur kazdik, ama bu pek kullanisli degil. Troller kullanisli seyleri sever.

english: Do you mind being asked about that?
translation: Bu konuda soru sorulmasi seni rahatsiz ediyor mu?

english: Can't be helped. Everyone I meet, once they want to talk about me personally, it like they only got two choices of what to ask.
translation: Elimde degil. Tanistigim herkes, benim hakkimda konusmak istediklerinde, sormak icin sadece iki secenekleri varmis gibi davraniyor.

english: Tell me about this place.
This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: Burasi Weiss. Troller, yillar önce güneydeki magaralardan kovulduktan sonra burayi insa etti. Simdi Weiss bizim evimiz.

english: We done pretty good here. Got lots of goat and wolf to eat - they taste kinda boring after all this time, but there not much other choice.
translation: Burada oldukca iyi durumdayiz. Yemek icin bolca keci ve kurt var - bunca zaman sonra tadi biraz sikici geliyor, ama baska secenek yok.

english: Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it. In fact My Arm is an expert on growing the stuff.
translation: Goutweed denedin mi hic? Onu seven troller taniyorum. Aslinda My Arm bu bitkinin yetistirilmesinde uzmandir.

english: Never heard of no gouty weed, no. But it sound like a vegetable, an' Mother not like eating those, so we probably not gonna try it.
translation: Gouty weed diye bir sey duymadim, hayir. Ama sebzeye benziyor ve annem sebze yemeyi sevmez, o yüzden muhtemelen denemeyecegiz.

english: Mother not like new ideas much, but he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: Annem yeni fikirleri pek sevmez, ama o cok büyük ve patron, o yüzden ne derse onu yapariz.

english: I see.
Do you like it here?
Eh, it kinda rough, but it our home. Odd Mushroom say he can make it nicer with fancy fires what he invented, but Mother not interested in that, so Odd Mushroom not allowed to do it.
translation: Eh, biraz zorlu ama burasi bizim evimiz. Odd Mushroom, icat ettigi süslü ateslerle burayi daha güzel hale getirebilecegini söylüyor ama annem bununla ilgilenmiyor, bu yüzden Odd Mushroom bunu yapamiyor.

english: Mother only care about stuff to help him fight better. An he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: Annem sadece onun daha iyi savasmasina yardimci olacak seylerle ilgileniyor. O cok büyük ve patron, bu yüzden ne derse onu yapiyoruz.

english: I'll be off.
Hey, friend of Snowflake!
We trolls are named after first thing we try to eat, an' some things are kinda inevitable in a big snowy land with almost no toilets.
translation: Biz troller, ilk yemeye calistigimiz seyin adini aliriz ve neredeyse hic tuvalet olmayan büyük karli bir ülkede bazi seyler kacinilmazdir.

english: It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: Burasi harika, simdi Snowflake ve kocasi troll bize goutweed yetistirmeyi ögretti. Yemekler artik cok daha iyi.

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: Eh, biraz zorlu ama gittikce iyilesiyor. Snowflake bize goutweed yetistirmeyi ögretti. Keci, kurt, insan, goutweed ile cok daha lezzetli oluyorlar.

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: Evet, Weiss yasamak icin iyi bir yer, artik Kar Tanesi sorumlu. Tüm troller Kar Tanesi'ni sever. Kocasi biraz tuhaf ama bu bizim sorunumuz degil.

english: Who are you?
How did you get called Yellow Snow?
Do you mind being asked about that?
Tell me about this place.
Ever tried goutweed?
I see.
Do you like it here?
I'll be off.
Hello there.
Clear off! Let me drink in peace!
translation: Defol! Birak da huzur icinde iceyim!

english: Okay then.
Hello.
Sorry, but the smithery is closed. You can use the furnace for a fee, and I can hold a coffer of gold so you don't need to pay each time.
translation: Üzgünüm, ama demirci dükkani kapali. Firini ücret karsiliginda kullanabilirsiniz ve her seferinde ödeme yapmaniz gerekmesin diye altin sandigini saklayabilirim.

english: It's already empty.
Sorry, but the smithery is closed. But since you've completed the elite tier of the Karamja diary, I will allow you to use the furnace.
translation: Üzgünüm, ama demirci dükkani kapali. Ancak Karamja günlügünün elit seviyesini tamamladiginiz icin firini kullanmaniza izin verecegim.

english: Sorry Bwana - I charge a fee of 20 coins to use my furnace.
translation: Üzgünüm Bwana, firinimi kullanmak icin 20 sikke ücret aliyorum.

english: You have earned the Elite Karamja reward, so you no longer need to pay to use this furnace.
translation: Elit Karamja ödülünü kazandiniz, bu yüzden artik bu firini kullanmak icin ödeme yapmaniz gerekmiyor.

english: I'm getting out of here Bwana, the place is infested with Zombies.
translation: Buradan gidiyorum Bwana, burasi zombilerle dolu.

english: Deposit coins
Empty coffer
Cancel
Nilsal, my child. Welcome to our humble camp. Do stop and rest if you need to.
translation: Nilsal, cocugum. Mütevazi kampimiza hos geldin. Ihtiyacin olursa durup dinlenebilirsin.

english: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
Sorry, but I cannot.
What brings you out here?
My companion and I are the teoki responsible for the Proudspire obelisk, one of our most precious holy sites. However, the peak of the mountain is not overly welcoming, so we keep our camp down here.
translation: Arkadasim ve ben, en degerli kutsal yerlerimizden biri olan Proudspire obeliski'nden sorumlu teoki'leriz. Ancak, dagin zirvesi pek misafirperver degil, bu yüzden kampimizi burada kurduk.

english: What's so important about this obelisk?

It was built by those who wandered these lands before we did. They worshipped Ralos and Ranul just as we now do. The obelisk was a site of great religious importance to them, and so it is to us as well.
translation: Bizden önce bu topraklarda dolasan insanlar tarafindan insa edildi. Onlar da bizim gibi Ralos ve Ranul'a tapiyorlardi. Obelisk onlar icin dini acidan cok önemli bir yerdi, bizim icin de öyle.

english: But what is it actually for?
That is something we sadly don't know. It is why the obelisk is especially important to those who serve Ranul. It is a reminder of the importance in ensuring knowledge is preserved.
translation: Maalesef bunu bilmiyoruz. Bu yüzden obelisk, Ranul'a hizmet edenler icin özellikle önemlidir. Bilginin korunmasinin önemini hatirlatir.

english: I see...
I'd better be on my way.
Take care, my child. May the sun light your way.
translation: Kendine iyi bak, cocugum. Günes yolunu aydinlatsin.

english: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
What brings you out here?
I'd better be on my way.
Ga ga?
Heeheehee!
*cough*
*gurgle*
*hic*
I don't get it... Are you real or not?
translation: Anlamiyorum... Sen gercek misin, degil misin?

english: I'm a crystalline formation, made by the elves.
translation: Ben elfler tarafindan yapilmis bir kristal olusumum.

english: But, like... Can you feel it if I pinch you?
translation: Ama, sey... Seni cimdikledigimde hissedebiliyor musun?

english: Don't you even think about it.
What actually are you? A big wolf or something?
translation: Sen aslinda nesin? Büyük bir kurt falan mi?

english: I suppose I might look something like that.
That sounds like a no. What are you then?
translation: Bu hayir demek gibi geldi. O zaman nesin?

english: A hunllef.
A what?
Nevermind.
You know, you can be a real nightmare sometimes.
Grrrrrr!
Hoooooooooowl!
I'm a crystalline formation, made by the elves.
translation: Ben elfler tarafindan yapilmis kristal bir olusumum.

english: Don't you even think about it.
I suppose I might look something like that.
A hunllef.
Nevermind.
Grrrrrr!
Hoooooooooowl!
Hello!
I'm sorry outerlander, I cannot sell you any clothes. Our customs forbid it.
translation: Üzgünüm yabanci, sana kiyafet satamam. Geleneklerimiz bunu yasakliyor.

english: Only Fremenniks may buy clothes here.
translation: Burada sadece Fremennikler kiyafet satin alabilir.

english: Only Fremenniks may change their shoes here.
Are you a member of the council of elders?
No, sorry, I'm not. Best look elsewhere outerlander.
translation: Hayir, üzgünüm, degilim. Baska bir yere baksan iyi olur, yabanci.

english: Okay, thanks.
I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find some custom sturdy boots, do you?
translation: Özel yapim saglam botlari nerede bulabilecegimi biliyor musun?

english: Well, I don't usually have many shoes in stock here in my little clothes shop... I will be able to make you up a pair if you are really desperate though?
translation: Sey, kücük giyim dükkanimda genellikle cok fazla ayakkabi bulundurmam... Ama gercekten cok ihtiyacin varsa sana bir cift yapabilirim.

english: They're not for me... I need them for Olaf.
translation: Onlar benim icin degil... Olaf icin lazim.

english: Oh, that foolish bard... Why didn't he just ask me to make him some? It is his stupid pride, I believe!
translation: Ah, o aptal ozan... Neden bana yapmami istemedi ki? Sanirim aptal gururu yüzünden!

english: I will tell you what I will do outerlander; I know that you must have the ear of the chieftain for him to consider you as worthy of becoming a Fremennik by trial.
translation: Sana ne yapacagimi söyleyeyim yabanci; sef, seni Fremennik olmaya layik bulmasi icin onun sözünü dinlemesi gerektigini biliyorum.

english: I will make you a pair of sturdy boots for Olaf if you will persuade him to reduce the sales tax placed upon all Fremennik shopkeepers. It does nothing but hurt my business now.
translation: Olaf icin saglam bir cift bot yapacagim, eger onu tüm Fremennik dükkan sahiplerine uygulanan satis vergisini düsürmeye ikna edersen. Bu vergi su anda isime zarar veriyor.

english: Okay, I will see what I can do.
I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a guarantee of a reduction on sales taxes, do you?
translation: Satis vergisinin düsürülecegine dair bir garanti bulabilecegim bir yer biliyor musun?

english: Yes I do outerlander. Only the Chieftain may permit such a thing. Talk to him.
translation: Evet, biliyorum yabanci. Sadece sef böyle bir seye izin verebilir. Onunla konus.

english: Hello. Can I have those boots now? Here is a written statement from Brundt outlining future tax burdens upon Fremennik merchants and shopkeepers for the year.
translation: Merhaba. Botlari alabilir miyim artik? Iste Brundt'un Fremennik tüccarlari ve dükkan sahipleri icin gelecek yilin vergi yükünü özetleyen yazili beyani.

english: Certainly! Let me have a look at what he has written here, just give me a moment...
translation: Elbette! Ne yazdigini bir bakayim, bir saniye...

english: Yes, that all appears in order. Tell Olaf to come to me next time for shoes!
translation: Evet, her sey yolunda görünüyor. Olaf'a bir dahaki sefere ayakkabi icin bana gelmesini söyle!

english: Hey, these shoes look pretty comfy. Think you could make me a pair like them?
translation: Hey, bu ayakkabilar oldukca rahat görünüyor. Bana da aynisindan yapabilir misin?

english: Maybe if you pass your trial and become a full fledged member of the Fremennik...
translation: Belki denemeyi gecip Fremennik'in tam üyesi olursan...

english: Hi. You wanted to buy some clothes? Or did you want to makeover your shoes?
translation: Merhaba. Giysi mi almak istiyordun? Yoksa ayakkabilarini mi degistirmek istiyordun?

english: It's free to change your shoes here. You can choose a colour as well as a style, since I'm also stocking boots imported from the elven lands.
translation: Burada ayakkabilarini degistirmek ücretsizdir. Elf topraklarindan ithal ettigim botlar da var, istedigin rengi ve modeli secebilirsin.

english: Just select the model you would like from this catalogue.
translation: Bu katalogdan istedigin modeli sec yeter.

english: Hey! They look great!
Thanks!
Nice choice!
Good call!
I think they suit you!
Neither thanks.
As you wish.
Ask about the Merchant's trial
translation: Tüccarin deneme süresi hakkinda bilgi al

english: Ask about becoming a Fremennik
I'd like to buy some clothes
I'd like to change my shoes
Neither thanks
Hey.
Can I help you?
Not really I just wanted to chat.
Sorry, I do not have time for idle gossip. Good day.
translation: Üzgünüm, bos bos dedikodu yapmak icin vaktim yok. Iyi günler.

english: Hey, fancy having a go at our agility course?
translation: Hey, agility parkurumuzu denemek ister misin?

english: What do I need to do?
Just head up the ladder to get started. Try not to fall!
translation: Baslamak icin merdivenden yukari cik. Düsmemeye calis!

english: You've not completed any laps of our agility course yet. There's been [amount] global completions and the global best time is [time].
Hey, I see you've been having a go at our agility course.
Have you been spying on me?
I like to keep an eye on everyone who gives it a go. Speaking of which, want to know more about how you've been doing?
translation: Denemeye gelen herkesi gözlemlemeyi seviyorum. Bu arada, performansin hakkinda daha fazla bilgi almak ister misin?

english: Yes please.
You've completed [amount] laps of our agility course with a best time of [time]. There's been [amount] global completions and the global best time is [time].
No thanks.
Yes please.
No thanks.
If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: Senin kadar cirkin olsaydim, halka acik yerlerde yüzümü göstermeye cesaret edemezdim!

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: Oh! Sey... Az önce bir tane yedim de ondan!

english: Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: Hayatina deger veriyorsan bir daha benimle konusma!
