english: Get lost!
I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: Sana verecek hicbir seyim yok, beni rahat birak dilenci.

english: Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
translation: Su anda bununla ugrasacak vaktim yok.

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: Senin gibi zavalli bir et yiginiyla konusmak istemiyorum.

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: Cok kötü bir gün... tadini cikar.

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: Eger birini yakalarsan, paylasacagina söz ver.

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
You smell familiar...
Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: Buralarda insan gördün mü? Cok acim.

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: Bana kan tadi seven biri gibi görünüyorsun.

english: Good day to you, my friend.
Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: Bir saniye, dislerime bir sey sikismis...

english: I've agreed to let you use the bank. What do you want today?
translation: Bankayi kullanmana izin verdim. Bugün ne istiyorsun?

english: This is an odd-looking bank.
It's an odd-looking town. Those Corsairs are basically no better than pirates, you know, and the adventurers they bring in are worse. That's why I keep a cannon for protection.
translation: Bu garip görünümlü bir kasaba. O korsanlar aslinda korsanlardan farksiz, biliyorsun, ve getirdikleri maceracilar daha da kötü. Bu yüzden korunmak icin bir top tutuyorum.

english: Anyway, did you want something?
I want nothing.
Then you shall get it.
Bank's closed. Go away.
This is an odd-looking bank.
I'd like to access my bank account, please.
translation: Banka hesabimi kontrol etmek istiyorum, lütfen.

english: I'd like to check my PIN settings.
I'd like to collect items.
I want nothing.
Would you like to buy or sell some staffs?
translation: Bazi esyalari satin almak veya satmak ister misin?

english: No, thank you.
Well, 'stick' your head in again if you change your mind.
Huh, terrible pun! You just can't get the 'staff' these days!
translation: Huh, berbat bir kelime oyunu! Bu günlerde “personel” bulmak cok zor!

english: Would you like to buy or sell some staffs? Or is there something else you need?
translation: Bazi esyalari satin almak veya satmak ister misin? Yoksa baska bir seye mi ihtiyacin var?

english: Have you any extra stock of battlestaffs I can buy?
translation: Satin alabilecegim fazladan savas sopasi stogun var mi?

english: For you, my friend, maybe. Take a look in the barrel in the corner.
translation: Senin icin olabilir, dostum. Kösedeki varile bir bak.

english: Can I have another ring?
There's still one in your inventory, [player name]!
translation: Envanterinde hala bir tane var, Maceraci!

english: Go and get the one that's in your bank, [player name]!
translation: Git ve bankandaki olani al, Maceraci!

english: I would be happy to give you another ring, but I'm afraid you don't have enough inventory space for it!
translation: Sana baska bir yüzük vermek isterdim, ama korkarim envanterinde bunun icin yeterli yer yok!

english: Yes, of course, [player name]. Here you are. Please bear in mind that this ring has no charges left with which to summon me, however.
translation: Evet, tabii ki, Maceraci. Al bakalim. Ancak bu yüzügün beni cagirmak icin yeterli gücü kalmadigini unutma.

english: Can you make me a staff?
Make you a staff? With what?
I found this magical essence when I was out on my adventures. I'd like to attach it to a battlestaff, but I'm not sure how to do that myself.
translation: Maceralarim sirasinda bu sihirli özü buldum. Onu bir savas asasina takmak istiyorum ama nasil yapacagimi bilmiyorum.

english: Let me see this essence.
Interesting, very interesting. This would indeed make a very nice staff.
translation: Ilginc, cok ilginc. Bu gercekten cok güzel bir asa olur.

english: You could make it yourself if you wanted. Just attach the essence to a battlestaff.
translation: Istersen kendin de yapabilirsin. Özü bir savas asasina takman yeterli.

english: Nevertheless, I'm happy to do it for you if you like.
translation: Yine de, istersen senin icin seve seve yaparim.

english: I'll attach it to a battlestaff for you if you are willing to pay me 50,000 coins. How does that sound?
translation: Bana 50.000 altin ödersen, onu bir savas asasina takarim. Ne dersin?

english: Yes, please.
Thank you, here you go. I'm not sure what it does, but it feels pretty magical.
translation: Tesekkürler, al bakalim. Ne ise yaradigini bilmiyorum ama oldukca büyülü görünüyor.

english: Thanks!
Oh, I don't have enough coins. I'll come back later.
translation: Oh, yeterince altinim yok. Daha sonra tekrar gelirim.

english: No, thanks.
I'll be here if you change your mind.
Yes, please!
No, thank you.
Have you any extra stock of battlestaffs I can buy?
translation: Satin alabilecegim ekstra savas asasi stogunuz var mi?

english: Can I have another ring?
Can you make me a staff?
Yes, please. (Costs 50,000 coins and Bryophyta's essence)
translation: Evet, lütfen. (50.000 altin ve Bryophyta'nin özü gerekir)

english: No, thanks.
Talk about something else.
Hello.
You don't look too happy.
True. We've not fallen on the best of times here.
translation: Dogru. Burada pek iyi zamanlar gecirmiyoruz.

english: Any way that I can help?
Possibly. I'd go talk to Awusah the Mayor of Nardah. He's in the big house on the east side of the town square.
translation: Olabilir. Nardah Belediye Baskani Awusah ile konusurdum. Kasaba meydaninin dogu tarafindaki büyük evde.

english: Hi, I am trying to find the cause of the curse on your town.
translation: Merhaba, kasabanizdaki lanetin nedenini bulmaya calisiyorum.

english: Ah I see. Awusah has enlisted your help?
translation: Anliyorum. Awusah senin yardimini mi istedi?

english: Yes he has.
Well, I really don't know why it might have happened. Maybe Ghaslor has some ideas. He's very wise and old and is the town's archivist. He lives in the northeast corner of town.
translation: Neden böyle bir sey oldugunu gercekten bilmiyorum. Belki Ghaslor'un bir fikri vardir. O cok bilge ve yaslidir, kasabanin arsivcisidir. Kasabanin kuzeydogu kösesinde yasiyor.

english: I heard the people of Nardah threw their statue of Elidinis away.
translation: Nardah halkinin Elidinis heykelini attigini duydum.

english: Yes that's correct. Why do you ask?
I've found out that action seems to have caused this town's curse.
translation: Bu eylemin kasabanin lanetine neden oldugunu ögrendim.

english: Well, I guess that would be logical conclusion. I don't really know where the statue was thrown. Awusah might know.
translation: Bu mantikli bir sonuc olurdu. Heykelin nereye atildigini bilmiyorum. Awusah biliyor olabilir.

english: How's life now the curse has been lifted?
Much better thanks to you. We're all very impressed.
translation: Sizin sayenizde cok daha iyi. Hepimiz cok etkilendik.

english: Hi!
Hi!
Ughhhh....
I could've 'ad 'im!
Er...
I was robbed!
Right.
It was rigged I tell you!
Uh huh.
Leave me alone!
Are you alright?
NURSE!
Do I look alright?!
Yeh. The nurses here are...wonderful!
It's just a flesh wound!
Can't....go....on!
Leave me behind!
I'll leave you here, OK?
Oh. OK.
Die, human!
What brings you all the way out into the Wilderness?
The hunt.
Oh... you partake in that?
translation: Oh... sen de buna katiliyor musun?

english: Not the hunt for other beings! The hunt for knowledge.
translation: Diger varliklari avlamak icin degil! Bilgiyi avlamak icin.

english: Knowledge? Can't say I've seen much of that around here. In case you didn't notice, it's all ruins.
translation: Bilgi mi? Burada pek fazla gördügümü söyleyemem. Fark etmediysen, burasi tamamen harabe.

english: Maybe for someone like you, but to us followers of Zamorak, there's relics of his mighty power everywhere.
translation: Belki senin gibi biri icin öyle, ama Zamorak'in takipcileri olarak bizler icin, her yerde onun muazzam gücünün kalintilari var.

english: Isn't it a little dangerous to be looking for knowledge out here?
translation: Burada bilgi aramak biraz tehlikeli degil mi?

english: That doesn't bother us. Our lord will protect us, we hunt in service of him.
translation: Bu bizi rahatsiz etmez. Efendimiz bizi koruyacaktir, biz onun hizmetinde avlaniyoruz.

english: I'll leave you to it then.
You're a lot calmer than the other Zamorakian followers I've come across in the Wilderness.
translation: Wilderness'da karsilastigim diger Zamorak takipcilerinden cok daha sakinsin.

english: We only search for answers.
Don't think you'll find much in these ruins.
translation: Bu harabelerde pek bir sey bulabilecegini sanmiyorum.

english: Be that as it may, it is our duty to honour our god and hunt for knowledge.
translation: Öyle olsa da, tanrimizi onurlandirmak ve bilgiyi aramak bizim görevimizdir.

english: All power to the almighty Zamorak.
I take it you're with the others dressed in red.
translation: Sanirim sen de kirmizi giyinen digerleriyle birliktesin.

english: We are here in service of the only true god.
translation: Biz burada tek gercek tanriya hizmet ediyoruz.

english: Hey there, what's with all the shouting.
translation: Hey, bu bagirislar da neyin nesi?

english: Our all-powerful Lord Zamorak is looking for the strongest of champions, you hardly look like you fit that criteria.
translation: Yüce Lord Zamorak en güclü sampiyonlari ariyor, sen bu kritere pek uymuyorsun.

english: I am big and strong, what does he need new champions for?
translation: Ben iri ve güclüyüm, yeni sampiyonlara ne ihtiyaci var ki?

english: The glorious battlefield of Castle Wars, where we can smite down the weak followers of Saradomin needs new blood.
translation: Saradomin'in zayif takipcilerini yenebilecegimiz muhtesem Castle Wars savas alani yeni kanlara ihtiyac duyuyor.

english: That sounds neat, I'll be a champion for Zamorak.
translation: Kulaga hos geliyor, Zamorak'in sampiyonu olacagim.

english: Bring death to Saradomin in his great name.
translation: Saradomin'i onun yüce adina yok edecegim.

english: Some items are stopping you from entering the Castle Wars waiting area. See the chat for details.
translation: Bazi esyalar Castle Wars bekleme alanina girmeni engelliyor. Ayrintilar icin sohbet bölümüne bak.

english: The player is teleported to the current world's Zamorak Castle Wars lobby.
translation: Oyuncu, mevcut dünyanin Zamorak Castle Wars lobisine isinlanir.

english: He can find a champion somewhere else, I'll pass.
translation: Baska bir yerde sampiyon bulabilir, ben almayayim.

english: Fool, you'll regret this one day.
Sorry, you can't play Castle Wars on this world. Try world 334 for the official world.
translation: Üzgünüm, bu dünyada Castle Wars oynayamazsin. Resmi dünya icin 334 numarali dünyayi dene.

english: Fight for Zamorak today!
Join the fight now.
Saradomin is weak, use your strength where it's respected!
translation: Saradomin zayif, gücünü saygi duyulan yerde kullan!

english: Your Lord Zamorak needs your help!
Yes.
No.
What do you want? We're trying to sing! Leave us alone and we won't bother you!
translation: Ne istiyorsun? Sarki söylemeye calisiyoruz! Bizi rahat birak, biz de seni rahatsiz etmeyelim!

english: Where are you going? Can we come too?
translation: Nereye gidiyorsun? Biz de gelebilir miyiz?

english: Why do you resort to violence so often?
translation: Neden bu kadar sik siddete basvuruyorsun?

english: If you should think of cutting a tree, don't do it!
We do hope we are not too annoying!
Look at that outfit! Can't you afford a decent one?
translation: Su kiyafete bak! Düzgün bir tane alamiyor musun?

english: Are you going to craft cosmic runes? Can we come too?
translation: Kozmik rünler mi yapacaksin? Biz de gelebilir miyiz?

english: Just go about your business and ignore us!
translation: Isine bak ve bizi görmezden gel!

english: Who are you?
My name is Zandar Horfyre, and you [player name] are trespassing in my tower, not to mention attacking my students! I thankyou to leave immediately!
translation: Benim adim Zandar Horfyre ve sen Maceraci, ögrencilerime saldirmanin yani sira kuleme izinsiz giriyorsun! Hemen gitmeni rica ediyorum!

english: Ok, I was going anyway.
Good! And don't forget to close the door behind you!
No, I think I'll stay for a bit.
Actually, that wasn't an invitation. I've tried being polite, now we'll do it the hard way!
translation: Aslinda bu bir davet degildi. Kibar olmaya calistim, simdi sert yöntemlere basvuracagiz!

english: The player is teleported to the Lumbridge swamp
Zamorak curse that mage!
Actually, I guess he already has!
Ok, I was going anyway.
No, I think I'll stay for a bit.
Hello, [player name]!
Hello, Zanik! What have you been up to?
I've been helping Oldak with his experiments!
I took his magic ball all over the caves and even to Lumbridge to test what happened when I broke it, and I always ended up back here.
translation: Onun sihirli topunu magaralarin her yerine ve hatta Lumbridge'e götürdüm, kirdigimda ne olacagini test etmek icin, ama her seferinde buraya geri döndüm.

english: You might find one of those balls useful if you wanted to visit me! Perhaps you should talk to Oldak.
translation: Beni ziyaret etmek istersen o toplardan birinin isine yarayabilir! Belki Oldak'la konusmalisin.

english: The story isn't true! I had too much rum and ended up here!
translation: Hikaye dogru degil! Cok fazla rom ictim ve buraya geldim!

english: I'm not banished, I've been ship wrecked help!
translation: Sürgün edilmedim, gemi kazasi gecirdim, yardim edin!

english: Save me!
Help! I've been ship wrecked for years!
translation: Yardim edin! Yillardir gemi kazasi gecirdim!

english: A thousand greetings, sir.
Do you want to trade?
Yes, certainly. I deal in scimitars.
Nice cloak.
Thank you.
Could you sell me a dragon scimitar?
translation: Bana bir ejderha kilici satabilir misiniz?

english: A dragon scimitar? A DRAGON scimitar?
translation: Ejderha kilici mi? EJDERHA kilici mi?

english: The banana-brained nitwits who make them would never dream of selling any to me.
translation: Onlari yapan muz beyinli aptallar bana asla satmayi hayal bile edemezler.

english: Seriously, you'll be a monkey's uncle before you'll ever hold a dragon scimitar.
translation: Cidden, ejderha kilicini eline almadan önce maymun amcasi olursun.

english: Oh well, thanks anyway.
Hmmm, funny you should say that...
Perhaps you'd like to take a look at my stock?
translation: Belki de stoklarima bir göz atmak istersiniz?

english: What do you think about Ali Morrisane?
He is a dangerous man.
Although he does not appear to be dangerous, he has brought several men to this town who have threatened me and several others.
translation: Tehlikeli görünmese de, beni ve birkac kisiyi tehdit eden birkac adami bu kasabaya getirdi.

english: One man even threatened me with a hammer, saying that when he set up his smithy, my shoddy workmanship would be revealed!
translation: Bir adam beni cekicle tehdit etti ve demirci dükkanini actiginda benim kalitesiz isciligimin ortaya cikacagini söyledi!

english: What will you do about these threats?
Oh, I am quite confident in the quality of my work...as will you be if you take a look at my wares.
translation: Oh, isimin kalitesinden oldukca eminim... sen de mallarima bakarsan emin olursun.

english: Do you want to trade?
Nice cloak.
Could you sell me a dragon scimitar?
translation: Bana bir ejderha kilici satabilir misin?

english: Yes please, Zeke.
Not today, thank you.
What do you think of Ali Morrisane?
Hello there! I sell plate mail bodies, are you interested?
Sorry, I'm not interested.
I'm here to tell you about some new taxes.
translation: Size yeni vergiler hakkinda bilgi vermek icin buradayim.

english: I'm already paying my taxes though?
These are new ones. They are to help pay for the king's upcoming visit to Great Kourend.
translation: Bunlar yeni vergiler. Kralin Büyük Kourend'e yapacagi ziyaretin masraflarini karsilamak icin.

english: Well I don't see why I have to pay for that! If the king can't afford the trip, then maybe he shouldn't be going!
translation: Bunun icin neden para ödemem gerektigini anlamiyorum! Kral bu geziyi karsilayamiyorsa, belki de gitmemeli!

english: It's an important diplomatic trip I'm afraid so it has to go ahead. The first payment will be collected soon.
translation: Korkarim bu önemli bir diplomatik gezi, bu yüzden devam etmek zorunda. Ilk ödeme yakinda tahsil edilecek.

english: And he's getting a mourner to tell me this? Nice try.
translation: Ve bunu bana bir yas tutan kisi mi söyleyecek? Iyi deneme.

english: And he's getting a citizen to tell me this? Nice try.
translation: Ve bunu bana bir vatandas mi söyleyecek? Iyi deneme.

english: I'm interested.
Sorry, I'm not interested.
I'm here to tell you about some new taxes.
translation: Size yeni vergiler hakkinda bilgi vermek icin buradayim.

english: Fingers!
Wall beast fingers!
Fresh wall beast fingers!
Lovely wall beast fingers!
Tasty wall beast fingers!
FIND THE GODSWORD!
FIND THE GODSWORD!
I FOUND THE GODSWORD!
GOOD!!!!!
Find the godsword!
I sharpen my blade for Saradomin!
Smite the evildoer!
Saradomin guide my sword!
*slap*
Evildoers get ragged!
For Saradomin!
My faith pwns your faith!
Wotcha guv'na!
Hey! Talk to me if you want to know anything worth knowing.
translation: Hey! Bilmeye deger bir sey ögrenmek istiyorsan benimle konus.

english: Best talk to his highness over there, 'fore he goes gettin' upset.
translation: Oradaki majestelerine konussan iyi olur, yoksa sinirlenecek.

english: Hey Zimberfizz.
What exactly is the Soul Obelisk?
It's 'ard to say. Me master never told what it is or why he built it.
translation: Söylemesi zor. Efendim ne oldugunu veya neden yaptigini hic söylemedi.

english: Wait a second... He built it?
I saw 'im build it with me own eyes. I were the one who 'ad to carry his materials to this island!
translation: Onun yaptigini kendi gözlerimle gördüm. Malzemelerini bu adaya tasiyan bendim!

english: So what is Nomad really up to?
Well, me master is as secretive as they come. Af'er all my time here, I still know next to nuffin' about him.
translation: Efendim cok gizemli biridir. Buradaki tüm zamanima ragmen, onun hakkinda hala neredeyse hicbir sey bilmiyorum.

english: Well, what do you know?
He's been up to summat since I've been here, but 'e had to have been an adventurer at some point. He has a massive stockpile of loot.
translation: Ben buraya geldigimden beri bir seyler pesinde, ama bir zamanlar maceraci olmali. Cok büyük bir ganimet stogu var.

english: He seems to know his way around some strange creatures too.
translation: Garip yaratiklar hakkinda da bilgisi var gibi görünüyor.

english: He does. He doesn't seem to care about that sorta stuff no more though. Since I've known 'im, he's only been obsessin' over gettin' as many people to play his game as possible.
translation: Evet, var. Ama artik bu tür seyleri umursamiyor gibi görünüyor. Onu tanidigimdan beri, tek takintisi mümkün oldugunca cok insanin oyununu oynamasini saglamak.

english: Why is he so obsessed?
Lost if I know. Like I said, 'e's as secretive as they come.
translation: Bilmiyorum. Dedigim gibi, o cok gizemli biridir.

english: Tell me how you got to be here.
I don't really know. I just woke up one day and 'ad to obey me master's commands.
translation: Gercekten bilmiyorum. Bir gün uyandim ve efendimin emirlerine uymak zorunda kaldim.

english: You just woke up here?
Aye. All I can remember before that is a glowing box and sumfin' to do with beads.
translation: Evet. Ondan önce hatirladigim tek sey parlayan bir kutu ve boncuklarla ilgili bir sey.

english: It sounds like Nomad is quite the hunter.
translation: Nomad oldukca iyi bir avci gibi görünüyor.

english: What makes you say that?
I read somewhere that skilled hunters can capture imps.
translation: Yetenekli avcilarin imp yakalayabildigini bir yerde okumustum.

english: That's sad to hear. It's just so 'ard to ignore shiny beads when I see 'em.
translation: Bu cok üzücü. Parlak boncuklari gördügümde onlari görmezden gelmek cok zor.

english: I'm quite the hunter myself, and some hunters like to capture imps.
translation: Ben de oldukca iyi bir avciyim ve bazi avcilar imp yakalamayi sever.

english: Really? They abuse our love of beads just to test their skills?
translation: Gercekten mi? Becerilerini test etmek icin boncuklara olan sevgimizi suistimal mi ediyorlar?

english: No need to worry, I'll give you no hassle. I'm only here to chat.
translation: Endiselenme, sana sorun cikarmayacagim. Sadece sohbet etmek icin buradayim.

english: Phew!
I'm quite the hunter myself, and I love capturing imps.
translation: Ben de avciyim ve imp yakalamayi seviyorum.

english: Oh no!
Only joking! I couldn't resist. Now, where were we?
translation: Sadece saka yapiyordum! Dayanamadim. Nerede kalmistik?

english: See you later.
Bye!
You've got no reason to bother that poor imp.
translation: O zavalli imp'i rahatsiz etmek icin hicbir nedenin yok.

english: I can't really chit-chat with me Master 'round. Go see what he wants.
translation: Efendim etrafta dolasirken sohbet edemem. Ne istedigini git sor.

english: What exactly is the Soul Obelisk?
So what is Nomad really up to?
translation: Nomad'in gercekte neyin pesinde oldugunu biliyor musun?

english: Tell me how you got to be here.
I'm quite the hunter myself, and some hunters like to capture imps.
translation: Ben de avciyim ve bazi avcilar imp yakalamayi sever.

english: I'm quite the hunter myself, and I love capturing imps.
translation: Ben de avciyim ve imp yakalamayi cok severim.

english: See you later.
If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: Senin kadar cirkin olsaydim, yüzümü kimseye göstermeye cesaret edemezdim!

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: Oh! Sey... Az önce bir tane yedim de ondan!

english: Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: Hayatina deger veriyorsan bir daha benimle konusma!

english: Get lost!
I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: Sana verecek hicbir seyim yok, beni rahat birak dilenci.

english: Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
translation: Su anda bununla ugrasacak vaktim yok.

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: Senin gibi zavalli bir et yiginiyla konusmak istemiyorum.

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: Cok kötü bir gün... tadini cikar, bitmeden.

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: Eger birini yakalarsan, paylasacagina söz ver.

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
You smell familiar...
Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: Buralarda insan gördün mü? Cok acim.

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: Bana kan tadi seven biri gibi görünüyorsun.

english: Good day to you, my friend.
Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
translation: Kaleye gidip atistirmalik bir seyler yemeye ne dersin?

english: Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: Bana bir dakika izin ver, dislerime bir sey sikismis...

english: Durrrr...
Hey! Come over here!
Who? Me?
Yes, you!
Give me a moment...I can't move that fast.
translation: Bana bir dakika izin ver... O kadar hizli hareket edemem.

english: Why not?
I used to be a magician's assistant until the accident...
What accident?
Looook...
Braaaaains...
Zombie, it has come to my attention that you are a fool, a nitwit if you will.
translation: Zombi, senin bir aptal, hatta bir salak oldugunu fark ettim.

english: I propose that your head, instead of being filled with the brains you so crave, is instead filled with a mixture of crushed lemons and kelp!
translation: Senin kafani, o kadar cok istedigin beyinlerle doldurmak yerine, ezilmis limon ve yosun karisimiyla doldurmayi öneriyorum!

english: Oh noooo..I'd best take it off then...
translation: Olamaz... O zaman cikarsam iyi olur...

english: What?
Traaa laaa laaa...
Oogaboogabooga!
Aaaaaargh!
DUUUHHH
Alas!
Mwuhahahaha!
Hey, Head?
What?
How did you die?
I stuck my neck out for an old friend.
translation: Eski bir arkadasim icin kendimi tehlikeye attim.

english: You shouldn't get so cut up about it.
Well if I keep it all bottled up I'll turn into a total head case.
translation: Eger icime atarsam, tamamen deliye dönerim.

english: What is your name?
Mumblemumblemumble...
What was that?
My name is Edward Cranium.
Edd Cranium?
Hahahahahahahahahahaha!
Har har...
Hey Head?
What now?
Can you do any tricks?
Not any more...
How come?
Because I used to be able to do a handstand for over an hour while juggling cannon balls with my feet...
translation: Cünkü eskiden bir saatten fazla el üzerinde durup ayaklarimla top mermisi jonglörlügü yapabiliyordum...

english: Wow, you were quite the entertainer.
translation: Vay canina, tam bir eglence ustasiymissin.

english: Yep. Now I can barely roll my eyes...
translation: Evet. Simdi ise gözlerimi zar zor cevirebiliyorum...

english: I know what you can do!
Vent...
Don't even suggest it!
Ok.
Can't I rest in peace?
No!
Would you like a new hat?
No, but could you screw a handle into the top of my head?
translation: Hayir, ama kafamin üstüne bir tutamak takabilir misin?

english: A handle? Why?
Because currently you wave me about by my hair, and it hurts!
translation: Cünkü su anda beni sacimdan salliyorsun ve bu cok acitiyor!

english: Will you ever leave me alone?
Want to go scare some people?
Let's leave it for now.
All right...
We'll quit while we're ahead!
If I try really hard I might be able to will myself deader...
translation: Cok ugrasirsam kendimi daha da ölü hale getirebilirim...

english: I have a winner for you here, Doctor! Look! It's still moving!
translation: Sizin icin bir kazananim var Doktor! Bakin! Hala hareket ediyor!

english: Nobody knows the troubles I've seen...nobody knows my sorrow...
translation: Kimse yasadigim sikintilari bilmiyor... kimse acimi bilmiyor...

english: I can't use that head!
Why not?
If that thing keeps wriggling around, I'll never get the stitches straight.
translation: O sey kivrilmaya devam ederse dikisleri düzgün atamam.

english: ...And who knows what problems will come up if we have an undead head on a truly dead body.
translation: ... Ve gercekten ölü bir vücutta ölümsüz bir kafa olursa ne gibi sorunlar cikacagini kim bilir.

english: Bring me another head, one that isn't still moving
translation: Bana baska bir kafa getir, hala hareket etmeyen bir tane.

english: How did you die?
What is your name?
Can you do any tricks?
Want a new hat?
Want to go scare some people?
Hello! What brings you here?
I'm here to guard this ship from any scurvy dogs darin' to loot her cargo.
translation: Bu gemiyi, kargosunu yagmalamaya cüret eden alcak köpeklerden korumak icin buradayim.

english: How did your ship end up here?
Arr, 'tis a woeful tale.
translation: Ah, bu cok üzücü bir hikaye.

english: Me hearties and I were enjoying a bit o' grog when we espied a group of landlubbers fightin' on the shore. 'Twas such an exciting battle that our navigator forgot to watch for the rocks.
translation: Arkadaslarim ve ben biraz icki icip eglenirken, kiyida bir grup karada yasayanlarin kavga ettigini gördük. O kadar heyecanli bir kavgaydi ki, navigatörümüz kayalari izlemeyi unuttu.

english: Now we've run aground, as ye can see.
Where's the rest of your crew?
They're searchin' for booty at that temple to the west.
Will they return to the ship?
They best do! That scurvy lot keep fillin' their lockers with loot and sneakin' off without swappin' places!
translation: Dönseler iyi olur! O alcaklar dolaplarini ganimetle doldurup yerlerini degistirmeden kaciyorlar!

english: Do you really want to go to the temple? I've heard the mages there have some really annoying spells.
translation: Gercekten tapinaga gitmek istiyor musun? Oradaki büyücülerin cok sinir bozucu büyüler yaptigini duydum.

english: Nothin' we can't handle! We've a way of stoppin' their tricksy teleports.
translation: Basa cikamayacagimiz bir sey yok! Onlarin hileli isinlanmalarini durdurmanin bir yolunu bulduk.

english: How can a group of mindless zombies invent a counter to magic?
translation: Bir grup akilsiz zombi nasil sihre karsi bir önlem bulabilir ki?

english: What we lack in brains, we make up for in gold! We found us a landlubber willin' to share their knowledge... for a price.
translation: Beyin eksikligimizi altinla telafi ediyoruz! Bilgilerini paylasmaya razi olan bir kara adami bulduk... tabii bir bedel karsiliginda.

english: They wrote us down a spell on some magic scrolls. All we 'ave to do is read one, and then we're properly anchored! Those mages can't teleport us anywhere!
translation: Bize sihirli parsömenlere bir büyü yazdilar. Tek yapmamiz gereken onu okumak, sonra da düzgün bir sekilde demir atabiliriz! O büyücüler bizi hicbir yere isinlayamaz!

english: Wow, I'm actually impressed. Do you think your friends at the temple will lend me one?
translation: Vay canina, gercekten etkilendim. Tapinaktaki arkadaslarin bana bir tane ödünc verir mi sence?

english: Naw, they're too busy fightin' to talk to the likes of ye. Besides, we stash all our spare scrolls in these lockers for safekeepin'.
translation: Hayir, savasmakla mesguller, senin gibilerle konusacak zamanlari yok. Ayrica, yedek parsömenlerimizi güvenli bir yerde saklamak icin bu dolaplara koyuyoruz.

english: Can I take a scroll from a locker, then?
translation: O zaman dolaptan bir parsömen alabilir miyim?

english: Ye'll need a key for that, matey! One of the crew should 'ave one.
translation: Bunun icin anahtar lazim dostum! Mürettebattan birinin anahtari olmali.

english: And when ye see 'em, tell 'em it's their turn to keep watch!
translation: Onlari gördügünde, nöbet sirasinin onlara geldigini söyle!

english: There be plenty o' loot in them lockers, matey. Don't expect to find a scroll right away.
translation: O dolaplarda bolca ganimet var dostum. Hemen bir parsömen bulmayi bekleme.

english: Thanks. I'd say 'see you around', but I sort of hope I don't.
translation: Tesekkürler. “Görüsürüz” demek isterdim, ama umarim görüsmeyiz.

english: Aye, the feelin's mutual.
Goodbye, I hope your crew comes back soon.
translation: Hosca kal, umarim mürettebatin yakinda geri döner.

english: Arr, me too matey.
Goodbye.
Bye, matey.
Arr, I've still not seen any of my crew.
Oh dear, how strange.
Can you tell if I've used the Teleport anchoring scroll?
translation: Teleport demirleme parsömenini kullandigimi anlayabilir misin?

english: Aye, I can tell by the cut of your jib that ye haven't yet read the Teleport anchoring scroll.
translation: Evet, jibinin kesiminden Teleport demirleme parsömenini henüz okumadigini anlayabiliyorum.

english: Aye, I can tell by the cut of your jib that you've read the Teleport anchoring scroll.
translation: Evet, yelkeninin kesiminden Teleport demirleme parsömenini okudugunu anlayabiliyorum.

english: How many times have I opened your lockers?
Ye've never done it even once!
Ye've done it once, and once only.
translation: Bir kez actin, sadece bir kez.

english: Ye've done it [#] times.
I'll leave you to wait for your crew.
I can tell by the cut of your jib that ye haven't yet read the Teleport anchoring scroll, and ye've never opened our lockers.
translation: Yelkeninizin kesiminden, Teleport demirleme parsömenini henüz okumadiginizi ve dolaplarimizi hic acmadiginizi anlayabiliyorum.

english: I can tell by the cut of your jib that ye haven't yet read the Teleport anchoring scroll, and ye've opened our lockers once, and once only.
translation: Yelkeninizin kesiminden, Teleport demirleme parsömenini henüz okumadiginizi ve dolaplarimizi bir kez, sadece bir kez actiginizi anlayabiliyorum.

english: I can tell by the cut of your jib that ye haven't yet read the Teleport anchoring scroll, though ye've opened our lockers [#] times.
translation: Jibinizin kesiminden, Teleport ankraj parsömenini henüz okumadiginizi, ancak dolaplarimizi [#] kez actiginizi anlayabiliyorum.

english: I can tell by the cut of your jib that you've read the Teleport anchoring scroll, but ye've never opened our lockers.
translation: Jibinizin kesiminden, Teleport ankraj parsömenini okudugunuzu, ancak dolaplarimizi hic acmadiginizi anlayabiliyorum.

english: I can tell by the cut of your jib that you've read the Teleport anchoring scroll, and ye've opened our lockers once, and once only.
translation: Jibinizin kesiminden, Teleport sabitleme parsömenini okudugunuzu ve dolaplarimizi bir kez, sadece bir kez actiginizi anlayabiliyorum.

english: I can tell by the cut of your jib that you've read the Teleport anchoring scroll, and ye've opened our lockers [#] times.
translation: Jibinizin kesiminden, Teleport sabitleme parsömenini okudugunuzu ve dolaplarimizi [#] kez actiginizi anlayabiliyorum.

english: Still here?
I've not seen any of my crew yet.
I wonder why.
Where's the rest of your crew?
Do you really want to go to the temple?
Goodbye.
Oh dear, how strange.
Can you tell if I've used the Teleport anchoring scroll?
translation: Teleport sabitleme parsömenini kullandigimi anlayabilir misin?

english: How many times have I opened your lockers?
I'll leave you to wait for your crew.
Arrrr! Tis yerself! Have a drink!
translation: Arrrr! Sen misin! Bir icki al!

english: Errr...Arrr! I will in a sec, I've just go to, err, plunder some landlubbers...
translation: Errr... Arrr! Bir saniye, biraz karada yasayanlari yagmalamaliyim...

english: Good huntin'!
Rum, rum, we want rum!
Give us rum or give us death!
translation: Bize rom verin ya da bizi öldürün!

english: Whadda we want? Rum!
Spare us a drop, you scurvy dogs!
translation: Bize bir damla verin, sizi pis köpekler!

english: Yer rum or yer brains!
When do we want it? Now!
Arr! Come back here!
Ye'll never get away!
Where d'ye think yer goin?
Give us yer rum, ye scurvy dog!
translation: Bize romunu ver, seni pis köpek!

english: Ye'll never beat us all!
United we stagger!
Rum! Rum! Rum!
Drink!
Hi!
Welcome to the Ardougne Zoo! How can I help you?
translation: Ardougne Hayvanat Bahcesi'ne hos geldiniz! Nasil yardimci olabilirim?

english: Do you have any quests for me?
translation: Bana vereceginiz bir görev var mi?

english: Not at the moment. The explorers that come back from far away lands tell such amazing tales. Make sure you keep eyes and ears open as you may find new places to explore!
translation: Su anda yok. Uzak diyarlardan dönen kasifler cok ilginc hikayeler anlatiyorlar. Gözlerinizi ve kulaklarinizi dört acin, kesfedilecek yeni yerler bulabilirsiniz!

english: Ooh, I will!
Where did you get the animals from?
We get them from all over the place! The most exotic creatures have been brought back by explorers and sold to us.
translation: Her yerden buluyoruz! En egzotik yaratiklar kasifler tarafindan getirilip bize satildi.

english: Where on Gielinor did you get that scary looking Cyclops?!
translation: Gielinor'un neresinden bu korkunc görünümlü Cyclops'u buldunuz?

english: Yes he is scary looking!
He's from a very far away land, we couldn't find out more as the explorer who brought him back died shortly afterwards!
translation: Cok uzak bir ülkeden geldi, onu getiren kasif kisa süre sonra öldügü icin daha fazla bilgi edinemiyoruz!

english: Before I help you, can you do something for me?
translation: Size yardim etmeden önce, benim icin bir sey yapabilir misiniz?

english: Sure.
I need to know how many animals we have now.
translation: Su anda kac hayvanimiz oldugunu bilmem gerekiyor.

english: The zoo keeper has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Hayvanat bahcesi görevlisi sana bir meydan okuma parsömeni verdi!

english: Please tell me how many animals there are.
translation: Lütfen kac tane hayvan oldugunu söyle.

english: Sorry, but that doesn't sound right!
Thanks!
You've obtained a casket!
Do you have any quests for me?
translation: Benim icin herhangi bir görevin var mi?

english: Where did you get the animals from?
It's not often that we see more humans in this place.
translation: Bu yerde sik sik insan görmüyoruz.

english: How did you come to be here?
General Hining sent us out in a scouting party. We got separated from the rest, and became completely lost. Soon we ran out of rations.
translation: General Hining bizi kesif görevine gönderdi. Digerlerinden ayrildik ve tamamen kaybolduk. Kisa sürede erzaklarimiz bitti.

english: Eventually we stumbled upon this place. They saw we were starving, and allowed us to eat of their sacred eels if we vowed to serve Zulrah.
translation: Sonunda buraya rastladik. Acliktan öldügümüzü gördüler ve Zulrah'a hizmet edecegimize söz verirsek kutsal yilan baliklarini yememize izin verdiler.

english: Since then, we've settled here. We went back up north once, to see how the king's campaign was going, but they drove us out of the camp, calling us unclean.
translation: O zamandan beri burada yasiyoruz. Kralin seferinin nasil gittigini görmek icin bir kez kuzeye geri döndük, ama bizi kirli diyerek kamptan kovdular.

english: It's probably the sacred eels that did it. They change you, you know. Once you've tasted them, you're part of the tribe forever.
translation: Muhtemelen kutsal yilan baliklari yüzündendir. Onlar insani degistirir, bilirsin. Bir kez tattiginda, sonsuza kadar kabilenin bir parcasi olursun.

english: Thanks.
I'm off.
How did you come to be here?
I'm off.
It's not often that we see more humans in this place.
translation: Bu yerde sik sik insan görmüyoruz.

english: How did you come to be here?
General Hining sent us out in a scouting party. We got separated from the rest, and became completely lost. Soon we ran out of rations.
translation: General Hining bizi kesif ekibiyle gönderdi. Digerlerinden ayrildik ve tamamen kaybolduk. Kisa sürede erzaklarimiz bitti.

english: Eventually we stumbled upon this place. They saw we were starving, and allowed us to eat of their sacred eels if we vowed to serve Zulrah.
translation: Sonunda buraya rastladik. Acliktan öldügümüzü gördüler ve Zulrah'a hizmet edecegimize söz verirsek kutsal yilan baliklarini yememize izin verdiler.

english: Since then, we've settled here. We went back up north once, to see how the king's campaign was going, but they drove us out of the camp, calling us unclean.
translation: O zamandan beri buraya yerlestik. Kralin seferinin nasil gittigini görmek icin bir kez kuzeye geri döndük, ama bizi kirli diyerek kamptan kovdular.

english: It's probably the sacred eels that did it. They change you, you know. Once you've tasted them, you're part of the tribe forever.
translation: Muhtemelen kutsal yilan baliklari yüzündendir. Onlar insani degistirir, bilirsin. Bir kez tattiginda, sonsuza kadar kabilenin bir parcasi olursun.

english: Thanks.
I'm off.
How did you come to be here?
I'm off.
You queue-jumper! My eldest son was chosen as a sacrifice to Zulrah, but now the priests say you're going to sacrifice yourself first.
translation: Sirayi bozuyorsun! En büyük oglum Zulrah'a kurban olarak secildi, ama simdi rahipler önce senin kendini kurban etmeni istiyorlar.

english: You're angry that I've saved your son's life?
translation: Oglunun hayatini kurtardigim icin mi kizginsin?

english: The sacrifice is the greatest honour to which any of us can aspire! He was so excited to be coming face-to-face with Zulrah, and offering himself on behalf of the tribe.
translation: Kurbanlik, hepimizin ulasabilecegi en büyük onurdur! Zulrah ile yüz yüze gelip kabile adina kendini kurban etmek icin cok heyecanliydi.

english: Also, I won't get the extra large ration of sacred swamp eels if my son doesn't make the sacrifice. Shame on you!
translation: Ayrica, oglum kurban olmazsa kutsal bataklik yilanbaligindan ekstra büyük pay alamayacagim. Utanmalisin!

english: I see.
I'm sorry.
Quite right. Now get on with sacrificing yourself.
translation: Haklisin. Simdi kendini kurban etmeye devam et.

english: Have you heard? My eldest son has been chosen as a sacrifice to the mighty Zulrah!
translation: Duydun mu? En büyük oglum, güclü Zulrah'a kurban edilmek üzere secildi!

english: How do you feel about that?
Oh, it's such an honour. He's so excited to be coming face-to-face with Zulrah, and offering himself on behalf of the tribe.
translation: Oh, bu büyük bir onur. Zulrah ile yüz yüze gelip kabile adina kendini kurban etmek icin cok heyecanli.

english: Also, when the sacrifice is made, his brother and I will get an extra large ration of the sacred swamp eels that Zul-Onan catches. I can't wait!
translation: Ayrica, kurban sunuldugunda, kardesi ve ben Zul-Onan'in yakaladigi kutsal bataklik yilanbaliklarindan ekstra büyük bir pay alacagiz. Sabirsizlaniyorum!

english: Don't you mind that your son will die?
It's the greatest honour to which any of us can aspire! I only hope that the High Priestess will one day choose me.
translation: Bu, hepimizin ulasabilecegi en büyük onur! Umarim bir gün Bas Rahibe beni secer.

english: The extra large ration of sacred swamp eels will be nice too.
translation: Ekstra büyük kutsal bataklik yilanbaligi payi da güzel olacak.

english: I'm off.
You have done well, [player name]!
You're angry that I've saved your son's life?
translation: Oglunun hayatini kurtardigim icin bana kizgin misin?

english: I'm sorry.
How do you feel about that?
Don't you mind that your son will die?
translation: Oglunun ölecek olmasi umurunda degil mi?

english: I'm off.
My brother was chosen as a sacrifice to Zulrah, but now the priests say you're going to sacrifice yourself first. You ruined everything!
translation: Kardesim Zulrah'a kurban olarak secilmisti, ama simdi rahipler önce senin kendini kurban edecegini söylüyorlar. Her seyi mahvettin!

english: You're angry that I've saved your brother's life?
translation: Kardesinin hayatini kurtardigim icin mi kizginsin?

english: You don't get it, do you? He'd been looking forward to this for ages, and you ruined it. Now we won't even get the extra ration of sacred swamp eels.
translation: Anlamiyorsun, degil mi? O bunu yillardir bekliyordu ve sen her seyi mahvettin. Artik kutsal bataklik yilanbaliginin ekstra payini bile alamayacagiz.

english: I hope Zulrah chews you slowly when you sacrifice yourself.
translation: Umarim Zulrah kendini kurban ettiginde seni yavasca cigner.

english: I'm sorry.
Have you heard? My brother has been chosen as a sacrifice to the mighty Zulrah!
translation: Duydun mu? Kardesim güclü Zulrah'a kurban edilmek üzere secildi!

english: How do you feel about that?
I'm jealous! I want to see Zulrah face-to-face too. Maybe next year they'll let me go.
translation: Kiskandim! Ben de Zulrah'i yüz yüze görmek istiyorum. Belki gelecek yil beni de gönderirler.

english: Also, when the sacrifice is made, our mother and I will get an extra large ration of the sacred swamp eels that Zul-Onan catches. I can't wait!
translation: Ayrica, kurban sunuldugunda, annem ve ben Zul-Onan'in yakaladigi kutsal bataklik yilanbaliklarindan ekstra büyük bir pay alacagiz. Sabirsizlaniyorum!

english: I'm off.
You're angry that I've saved your brother's life?
translation: Kardesinin hayatini kurtardigim icin mi kizginsin?

english: I'm sorry.
How do you feel about that?
I'm off.
Shhh! Don't disturb the sacred eels.
translation: Sss! Kutsal yilan baliklarini rahatsiz etme.

english: Tell me about the sacred eels.
translation: Bana kutsal yilan baliklari hakkinda bilgi ver.

english: As Zulrah's skin is shed, the scales fall to the bottom of the swamp, where I believe the eels are permitted to consume them. Thus the eels become sacred, dumb though they are.
translation: Zulrah'in derisi döküldügünde, pullari batakligin dibine düser ve sanirim yilan baliklari bunlari yemeye izinlidir. Böylece yilan baliklari, aptal olsalar da kutsal hale gelirler.

english: Then the mighty Zulrah sends the eels to us. Once you eat of them, and absorb their sacred properties yourself, you become part of our tribe forever - no other community will let you in.
translation: Sonra güclü Zulrah yilan baliklarini bize gönderir. Onlari yiyip kutsal özelliklerini kendinize emdikten sonra, sonsuza kadar kabilemizin bir parcasi olursunuz - baska hicbir topluluk sizi kabul etmez.

english: Can you give me any eels?
Zul-Cheray and her younger son are due for an extra large ration of eels when her older son is sacrificed, so I can't spare any for you.
translation: Zul-Cheray ve kücük oglu, büyük oglu kurban edildiginde ekstra büyük bir yilan baligi payi alacaklar, bu yüzden sana ayiramam.

english: But I'm being sacrificed first.
All the same, after your sacrifice is complete, Zulrah will return for Zul-Cheray's son, and she will want her eels at that time.
translation: Yine de, senin kurban edilmen tamamlandiktan sonra, Zulrah Zul-Cheray'in oglu icin geri dönecek ve o zaman yilan baliklarini isteyecektir.

english: Can I catch some eels myself?

The mighty Zulrah sends us the eels as part of a sacred contract with our tribe, as the High Priestess told you. Although you are not of our tribe, Zulrah may be willing to grant you eels too. You may try.
translation: Yüce Zulrah, bas rahibenin sana söyledigi gibi, kabilemizle olan kutsal sözlesmenin bir parcasi olarak bize yilan baliklarini gönderir. Kabilemizden olmasan da, Zulrah sana da yilan baliklari verebilir. Deneyebilirsin.

english: I'm off.
You know nothing of the sacred contract between our tribe and the mighty Zulrah! Ask the High Priestess to educate you about Zulrah before you meddle further.
translation: Kabilemizle güclü Zulrah arasindaki kutsal antlasma hakkinda hicbir sey bilmiyorsun! Daha fazla karismadan önce Bas Rahibe'den Zulrah hakkinda bilgi al.

english: Ignorant tourist! The mighty Zulrah sends us the eels as part of a sacred contract with our tribe - you know nothing of these matters. Ask the High Priestess to educate you about Zulrah first.
translation: Cahil turist! Güclü Zulrah, kabilemizle yaptigi kutsal antlasma geregi bize yilan baliklari gönderiyor. Sen bu konulardan hic anlamiyorsun. Önce Bas Rahibe'den Zulrah hakkinda bilgi al.

english: Tell me about the sacred eels.
translation: Kutsal yilan baliklari hakkinda bilgi ver.

english: Can you give me any eels?
Can I catch some eels myself?
I'm off.
Human agreed to sacrifice [himself/herself] to mighty Zulrah! We all most grateful.
translation: Insan, güclü Zulrah'a kendini kurban etmeyi kabul etti! Hepimiz cok minnettariz.

english: Puny human show respect to Zulrah or I smash you head.
translation: Zayif insan, Zulrah'a saygi göster yoksa kafani ezerim.

english: Zulrah the great god. He mighty. You go see High Priestess, she tell you lots and lots.
translation: Zulrah büyük tanridir. O güclüdür. Basrahibeye git, sana cok sey anlatacaktir.

english: I'm off.
You leave that alone, human. You not one of us.
translation: Onu rahat birak, insan. Sen bizden degilsin.

english: Tell me about Zulrah.
I'm off.
Nilsal, [player name].
Hello, Zuma. How are things?
A lot less stressful up here. I think I might leave the adventuring to people like you from now on.
translation: Burada cok daha az stresli. Sanirim bundan sonra maceralari senin gibi insanlara birakacagim.

english: Still, at least it gave me a lot to talk about. Those Moons of Peril are concerning, but exciting! I just wish we knew more about their potential links to Ranul.
translation: Yine de, en azindan konusacak cok seyim oldu. O Tehlikeli Aylar endise verici, ama heyecan verici! Keske Ranul ile olan olasi baglantilari hakkinda daha fazla sey bilseydik.

english: So you still think there is a link?
translation: Hala bir baglanti oldugunu mu düsünüyorsun?

english: Oh yes. It may not have been the one I originally thought, but there must be something! They're called Moons after all!
translation: Oh evet. Baslangicta düsündügüm gibi olmayabilir, ama bir sey olmali! Sonucta onlara Aylar deniyor!

english: The all-powerful Ranul wouldn't have just let some random creatures take on a name like that!
translation: Her seye gücü yeten Ranul, rastgele yaratiklarin böyle bir isim almasina izin vermezdi!

english: Hmm... It's an interesting thought.
Indeed. And on that note, I have some research to do! Until next time.
translation: Gercekten. Bu arada, yapmam gereken bazi arastirmalar var! Bir dahaki sefere görüsmek üzere.
